Each of these Xia Clan Demigods were furious. They were bitter, yet there was nothing they could do. These enemies from the Dark Abyss were the cream of the crop, chosen from a wide selection. There was no way for the Transcendents from a mortal world to stand against them.
…
As the Demigods were racking their brains, the three terrifying existences kept hovering in mid-air. The leader, Lord You Lan, was disinclined from giving the Xia Clan any more time, so he began speaking, "Transcendents of the Xia Clan, there are two options available to you. The first is to use all your treasures, including the Deity grade scrolls and even your Battleship D9, to fight me, You Lan! The second is to obediently give me thirty Deity grade scrolls as an apology for offending me.
"Those are your options—give me the 30 Deity grade scrolls, or fight me. Make your choice," Lord You Lan continued, "I’ve no more time to waste here. I’ll give you ten breaths’ worth of time to discuss. If that amount of time passes, and I still haven’t received an answer, I can just start playing around. You lot might be able to hole up inside that battleship, but what about all the mortals in this Xia Clan World? You can’t stuff them up with you. I’ll kill all of them, not a single soul remaining. Have no doubt, I can easily do that.
"Starting from this moment, you have ten breaths worth of time left."
On the other side, inside Battleship D9.
A group of Xia Clan Demigods were looking outside the main deck through a transparent wall, looking at the barefoot black-skinned young man covered in the white cloth. Unlike the majority of the other demons, he had no horns or scales, nor did his body show any other characteristics of a demon. Despite that, the Demigods all shivered; he was the worst, most terrible demon from the Dark Abyss they had ever seen.
"What should we do? What can we do?"
"We have to either fight or surrender?"
"In ten breaths worth of time, he’ll begin a massacre."
Not only the Demigods, but even the six ordinary Transcendents of the Black White Deity Mountain inside the main deck all paled with anxiety. They began transmitting the situation left and right, and even started preparations for the evacuation of the nearby mortal population.
"What are we going to do?!" The heads of each member of the Xia Clan’s high echelon, including Palace Head Chen, Mountain Lord He, and the Grand Elder Palace Head all began to ache. They were sweating all over, and their expressions were hard to discern.
It was a crucial time!
"We can’t surrender; there’s no way! My Xia Clan would rather die than bow their heads to outsiders," Si Kong Yang howled.
"We can’t surrender, but can we fight? We’d have to use countless treasures… What will we do in the future, when we’ll face the Sorcerer God and the Great Demonic God?" Mountain Lord He continued, a bitter taste in his mouth. "Do we flee? Do we watch from the sidelines as countless mortals of our Xia Clan are killed?"
"Then tell me, what do you think we should do?" Si Kong Yang urged.
"I…I don’t know either." Mountain Lord He shook his head, faint traces of tears visible at the corners of his eyes.
They truly wished to put their full might on display and fight back. If it would rid them of this damnable Lord You Lan, they would even use the entire foundation of the Xia Clan. But they knew that if they did that, they really would be wiped out in the future battle against the Sorcerer God and the Great Demonic God. They would become the ones who doomed the Xia Clan for the sake of a moment’s delight.
"Mn?" The Demigods in the battleship turned their heads to look at a spot in mid-air where a dark tear in space had suddenly appeared.
"What? Who would dare rip through space to come here at such a moment."
…
The three members of You Lan’s group who were still waiting for the Xia Clan’s answer also turned to look at that location. For that moment, both sides were focusing all their attention on that spot.
In the distance, a white-clothed youth could be seen flying out of that tear in space.
Lord You Lan remarked, "Oh, is that Dong Bo Xue Ying?" Having been sent here, they had naturally received some information regarding the Xia Clan World, including intel on some of the powerful locals. Xue Ying also appeared on that list.
"He is Dong Bo Xue Ying? Judging by his complexion, he must be afflicted by some sort of hexing poison. But why is he here; did he come to meet his demise?" said the black-robed Nuo Nuo An.
General Ku Meng jeered, "Perhaps he knew he’ll die soon, so he just couldn’t wait any longer?"
On the other hand, the Xia Clan were nothing but anxious.
Even the Xia Clan Demigods had not come directly there. They first gathered inside Battleship D9 before making their way over. They did not dare arriving so recklessly, out of fear that the three Dark Abyss team members would attack them in a moment of carelessness.
Battleship D9’s doors opened, and Palace Head Chen urged from inside, "Why’d you come here? Quickly, get inside! Quick!"
Xue Ying smiled back. "Why shouldn’t I have come? You have wronged me, Palace Head Chen. There was such a big event, and yet you didn’t let me know. I had to find out from the other Transcendents that such a great incident occurred here, at the Black White Deity Mountain. Don’t forget I’m also a Transcendent of the Xia Clan!"
Palace Head Chen’s heart soured upon hearing Xue Ying’s words.
"Just hurry up and enter! Quick!" Palace Head Chen kept anxiously waving his hand. He knew Xue Ying did not fear death, but he saw no worth in such a death. He was afraid that Xue Ying had become reckless due to the suffering caused by the hexing poison. They might have been able to control the other Demigods, but Xue Ying could walk inside the Mirage. They couldn’t stop him even with the battleship’s help.
Si Kong Yang appeared next to Palace Head Chen and said with shared anxiety, "Xue Ying, hurry up and come here."
But Xue Ying didn’t pay them any more attention. Instead, he flew towards Lord You Lan and his group.
"Xue Ying, are you crazy?" Palace Head Chen transmitted breathlessly. "There’s no meaning in you going there. You’re just throwing away your life to become a hero for a moment; there’s no merit in that! Those three demons are incredibly powerful, especially that Lord You Lan. He’s like a real Deity! What can you do if you go there? Giving your life away like this is despicable."
Palace Head Chen couldn’t stand this situation; nothing he told Xue Ying had any effect! Had he known Xue Ying would try to come over, he would have definitely locked the surrounding thousand kilometer wide space around their location to stall him. Since he wanted to save the ship’s energy, however, he only locked an area of fifty kilometers to prevent Lord You Lan and his group entrance to the battleship.
…
Having arrived at the Black White Deity Mountain and near Battleship D9, Xue Ying simply hovered there, looking at Lord You Lan and the rest of the group.
"Sir, my Xia Clan has welcomed you. We have not done a single thing to offend you and have never meddled in any of your business. And what did we get in return?"
Xue Ying gloomily continued, voice trembling, "You treated my Xia Clan like livestock, slaughtered millions of our people, and devoured their souls. Vice Mountain Lord Feng Dong refused to bow to you or beg for your mercy, so you took his life. Did he ever do anything wrong? He was merely protecting his clan. But you weren’t satisfied with just his death, so you demanded thirty Deity grade scrolls from my Xia Clan as reparation. You claimed that if we don’t hand them over, you’ll kill every last mortal of our clan, not sparing a single one!"
Listening to Xue Ying’s words, every single Xia Clan Transcendent on the ship grieved, furious beyond measure. Some of them were gritting their teeth so hard, they nearly broke.
"I don’t like your tone." Lord You Lan frowned. "So you’ll be the next to die." As he spoke, he once again stretched his hand, and his finger elongated.
"The one who’ll die is you!" Xue Ying roared. A spear with a body like a cloud of flames instantly appeared in his hand.
But with the spear’s appearance, Xue Ying’s own figure disappeared, not a trace of him remaining in the surroundings.
"Mn?" Previously ready to attack, Lord You Lan knitted his eyebrows and retracted his hand. "Where did he go?"
"Ah, where is he?" The expressions on Nuo Nuo An and General Ku Meng’s faces slightly shifted. They carefully searched their surroundings.
"I’ve heard he has comprehended the True Meaning of Shadow or the True Meaning of Mirage. But if he was still in the stage one realm, there’s no way he could have avoided our probing." Lord You Lan looked all around with a grim look, but no matter what he did, he couldn’t detect any Transcendent other than the ones inside the distant Battleship D9.
There was nothing! Dong Bo Xue Ying had vanished into thin air!
"Don’t worry, I’ll handle you one by one. Take your time," a familiar voice resounded, making Lord You Lan and the other two put even more effort in their probing. But they still failed to find the source. The voice then echoed again, "Nuo Nuo An, you’ve massacred countless people of my Xia Clan. You shall be the first to die!"

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: Strength
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
Lord You Lan snorted. "Hmph! Are you seriously trying to confuse me with an illusion of this level?" He emitted a strong spiritual wave of willpower to forcefully break the illusion, shifting the scenery back to the one in the real world. Back in the Dark Abyss, You Lan had started off a weak demon crawling about and had slaughtered his way up to his current level. On his road to power, he had witnessed a myriad of charming attempts and countless enticements.
General Ku Meng and Nuo Nuo An were similar in that they could not so easily be trapped inside the Mirage. In but a short moment, they had also broken their way outside through force.
"We’re still trapped inside an illusion." Waves began rippling from Lord You Lan’s body, spreading out uniformly and shaking the layer of space as it passed along. The white mist surrounding him slowly dispersed until there was none left in a radius of five hundred meters around him.
"My Time Domain is only able to reflect this illusory white fog," Lord You Lan began, his demeanour calm. "The illusion is spread over more than a thousand kilometers. It seems his True Meaning is not the True Meaning of Shadow, but that of Mirage. Considering its range, he must have reached at least the stage two realm in it, which means that before he moves, we can’t find any trace of him. The most we can do is wait for him to make his move; only then can we counter it and kill him!"
"Hehehe, Dong Bo Xue Ying dared say he would kill me. He was even arrogant enough to call me out as the first target. Leader, just leave him to me." The black-robed Nuo Nuo An looked around. His eyes radiated with a green light tinted by killing intent.
During his time in the Dark Abyss, Lord You Lan had faced plenty existences Xue Ying couldn’t compare to. He calmly faced the current situation; in his opinion, his subordinate was more than enough to handle it.
…
But the observation tools of a battleship from the Deity Realm allowed them to see through it, giving those inside a clear view of Lord You Lan’s group.
"Is this Xue Ying’s True Meaning of Mirage?" Palace Head Chen, Mountain Lord He, and the other Transcendents all watched with bated breaths.
Without any warning, a voice resounded inside the battleship’s main deck. "Palace Head Chen, please isolate the surrounding thousand kilometers of space."
"Alright." Palace Head Chen agreed, prompting Mountain Lord He to quickly put Battleship D9 into operation. This type of action only consumed his personal magic power as a Demigod and had no effect on the ship’s energy reserves or other sources of power.
The space in a thousand kilometers around Battleship D9 seemed to freeze solid as the World Energy moved to seal and isolate the area from the outside.
"Indeed, his actions are too risky. Although his True Meaning of Mirage has a bewildering effect, is it really sufficient to deal with Lord You Lan and his group?" Palace Head Chen shook his head. "I tried warning him, but it was for naught."
The atmosphere turned heavy. The Xia Clan Transcendents all put their hopes on Xue Ying, on him somehow being able to suppress and kill them—even just one if at all possible! But they were aware of just how hard it was to kill an Era Suppressor. Even with the Nine Dragon Fire Deity Armor boosting his power to the level of an Era Suppressor, Si Kong Yang had been unable to put even the slightest of scratches on Nuo Nuo An, far from killing him.
Surrounded by his spell waves, Lord You Lan hovered high in the sky, joined by General Ku Meng standing calmly nearby. Nuo Nuo An carefully inspected his surroundings through his green pupils, which brimmed with killing intent. He let out a cold laugh.
"Come, Dong Bo Xue Ying. Come and let me see how—" He had yet to finish his phrase when the shaft of a fiery-red spear flashed before him. It shot forward fueled by an oppressive killing intent, piercing even space as it directly impaled Nuo Nuo An’s head!
Unexpectedly, Nuo Nuo An had not even attempted to dodge. Despite the spear stuck between his eyebrows, he merely let loose an evil laugh.
"Die for me!" He spread his mouth wide to release a terrible growl. His snarl was accompanied by a quiet wave of sound which spread along the Stellar Fire Cloud Spear and pushed directly into the Mirage! Considering the power of the three from the Dark Abyss, they could forcefully attack and affect the Mirage.
Inside the Mirage, Xue Ying watched indifferently as the soundless wave approached. To break into the Mirage, the wave of sound had expended 90% of its power, while the remainder energy was too weak to even shake Xue Ying’s protective True Meaning of Star.
The True Meaning of Star was famous for its defensive ability and its power. Even without the Mirage, the sound wave would have still been too weak to bother him, not to mention this weakened version.
"Ah!" After unleashing his growl, Nuo Nuo An’s complexion paled. "Damn it!"
Pu! His body exploded into hundreds of chunks, and each individual part transformed into an evil spirit. One had the appearance of a seductress, one a wicked youth, one an old man—there were many kinds. They spoke simultaneously, "Lord, this Dong Bo Xue Ying’s spearmanship has a terrifying destructive ability. My body can’t withstand it—" He was still speaking when the spear struck once more out of thin air with lightning speed. Setting aside its speed, the spear possessed incredible sharpness. As soon as it appeared, it would instantly pierce the body of an evil spirit and cause it to immediately begin dispersing.
Si Kong Yang exclaimed in surprise, "Xue Ying can kill those spirits I was unable to scratch in a single strike. Incredible… Simply describing ‘space’ to be powerful is truly a joke. In the end, only the Laws of Profound Mysteries truly matter. Without them, even if they were more powerful, they still couldn’t use that power. Xue Ying’s True Meaning of Extreme Penetration certainly allows him to destroy that Undying Body. There’s not even a need for multiple moves, he can simply annihilate one with each attack."
"I had no idea Xue Ying’s power increased so much over the years." Palace Head Chen gave a slight chuckle. They had guessed Xue Ying would display some growth, but they were surprised to see his progress far exceeded their estimates. As soon as they saw his ability, they realized how much they had underestimated him.
"It might only be at the peak of the stage two realm, but its destructive power is already comparable to an ordinary grade two True Meaning at the stage three realm," General Ku Meng, said, voice filled with worry. "Even now, it has a terrifying destructive power—one at an even higher level than the Xia Clan’s most powerful Demigod. His and Nuo Nuo An’s might are only separated by the Deity treasure."
A powerful existence whose comprehension reached the stage three realm with a grade two True Meaning would reach the level of an Era Suppressor once they wielded a Deity treasure. With Xue Ying’s Extreme Penetration being a grade two True Meaning with power comparable to the stage three realm, he now only lacked a Deity treasure! A common Deity treasure would usually double one’s power.
"That’s wrong. You’re underestimating this Transcendent afflicted by the hexing poison," Lord You Lan said, his tone solemn. "He’s stronger than Nuo Nuo An. True, if he only had the True Meaning of Extreme Piercing, he would have been weaker than Nuo Nuo An. But don’t forget he also has the True Meaning of Mirage! With the two combined, he can really guide his opponents into despair."

chapters.title: Chapter 289 - Fatal Weakness
chapters.content:
Chapter 289: Fatal Weakness
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
Back when Xue Ying fought the Reincarnators from the Temporal Temple, his victory would have been much less certain had he only relied on his True Meaning of Extreme Piercing. In fact, it would have been very difficult even with the True Meaning of Star backing him up as well. It was only after unleashing his True Meaning of Mirage that the difficulty of the mission was bumped from Hard to Nightmare. As soon as he used the Mirage, his opponent could no longer resist his attack; if he wanted to kill them, he would do it!
"He can strike whenever and without warning! As soon as he makes his move, the spear is already before his opponent!"
"As long as he doesn’t strike, there’s no way to find him!"
"His True Meanings complement each other. He’s completely overpowering Nuo Nuo An!"
"When it comes to strength, more isn’t always better; it must be properly unleashed. His two True Meanings mesh well, which turns every strike into a fearsome attack." Lord You Lan shook his head. "The most dangerous part of it is that if he doesn’t make a move, we can’t even detect him. His attacks are also very swift; as soon as he strikes, he quickly withdraws. We’ve no way of capturing him."
With how fast Xue Ying’s strikes were, he could withdraw as soon as he attacked! The advantage his opponents had from their numbers was nullified.
General Ku Meng transmitted with a perplexed tone, "Don’t tell me…Nuo Nuo An is going to die?"
"In this mortal world, Nuo Nuo An’s power is that of an Era Suppressor! How could he so easily be killed? This Dong Bo Xue Ying is only able to suppress him because his True Meanings work together so well. To suppress Nuo Nuo An is one thing, but to kill him? The victor is not yet set in stone." The corners of Lord You Lan’s mouth twitched upwards slightly. "Look, Nuo Nuo An is going all out! Having lived in the Dark Abyss until now… he can’t be that simple."
"Aaah!" The large group of evil spirits all began to roar in fury at the same time. "Dong Bo Xue Ying, I want your death!"
All of a sudden, a pair of ominously glowing green eyes appeared in mid-air. It was Nuo Nuo An’s Deity treasure!
The green light forming the eyes began to expand and shape itself into two channels, out of where countless evil spirits flew.
Xue Ying’s wrinkled his brows inside the Mirage. "What’s going on? How can there be so many evil spirits?"
"Th-th-this…"
Even the hundred evil spirits from before had been troublesome enough, but those which had just rushed out of the eyes numbered in the hundreds, with more still coming. In what felt like the blink of an eye, tens of thousands of evil spirits, enough to cover the lands and blot the skies, had appeared—each exuding an oppressive aura. They seemed to be confused and began howling.
An instant later, the tens of thousands of evil spirits were attracted by an invisible force which force them to quickly converge in the center.
Countless horrifying energies surged.
A towering devil appeared, its body a mass of darkness with large fangs. It had twin eyes of radiant green, and atop its head were no less than nine black horns. Its body emitted an endless Qi which seemed to engulf the heavens and earth, smothering the surrounding Mirage. The white fog couldn’t get closer than five kilometers to his location.
"So strong."
Inside the Mirage, Xue Ying was inwardly surprised. "What mighty Qi. It’s gotten much stronger than it was at first."
…
"Of course he doesn’t have a Ten Thousand Ghost Body. Had he cultivated that, even I would have a hard time defeating him. He has evil spirits in the tens of thousands, but he normally only controls up to 100. He’s currently going all out by relying on his Deity treasure to forcefully engulf the evil spirits and form a sort of Ten Thousand Ghost Body. Look, his strength is spilling; he has no way of restraining it in the least. There’s no way he can control it. If you look at his eyes, you can tell his mind is confused. But this is still enough." Lord You Lan revealed a smile.
He immediately transmitted a shout—"Nuo Nuo An!"
"I’ll assist you by manipulating the flow of time in your area, but Dong Bo is proficient in Extreme Penetration, and he can use it to forcefully pierce through the obstructions of time and space. My Time Flow will probably only have a limited effect at the most! The rest you will have to do yourself. Remember, he has a fatal weakness."
Lord You Lan’s voice was transmitted into Nuo Nuo An’s ear in his Ten Thousand Ghost Body form.
He replied, "Rest assured, my lord. I know of his weakness. It just so happens that my Death Howl is able to restrain him."
Nuo Nuo An turned his head in a flash but kept his body in the same position.
He spread open his mouth to reveal his fangs, akin to a ferocious beast.
Pu! The Stellar Fire Cloud Spear stabbed straight into Nuo Nuo An’s towering head, a hundred meters high in the air. Its size alone reached two meters, but after getting hit by the spear just once, the head began collapsing. Soon, however, it began reforming!
"My Death Howl will be enough to kill you." Nuo Nuo An was brimming with confidence. "The True Meaning of Mirage has next to no defensive ability, while the True Meaning of Extreme Piercing is even worse. You don’t even have Qi to protect you body! Do you perhaps have a Deity Warrior protecting you? While they might not be afraid of soul attacks, they are also worthless when it comes to stopping them. Try blocking this!"
But even so, most soul attacks were not particularly powerful, with Transcendents generally enduring them by relying on their own souls.
He had condensed a Deity Heart using the grade three True Meaning of Death. By using that Deity Heart in conjunction with the Ten Thousand Ghost Body to employ his Death Howl, he could unleash a terrifying soul attack!
Deity Warriors, Deity grade armor, and other treasures would normally not have much of a diminishing effect on soul attacks.
Transcendent Qi and Magic Power, on the other hand, were the special energies wielded by Transcendents and usually had good effects.
But the best by far were still the True Meanings! There were even some mysterious ones which specialized in defending that would be able to completely block them.
…
Within the Mirage.
In his Ten Thousand Ghost Body form, Nuo Nuo An’s hands collided with the spear, the resulting impact being transmitted into the Mirage, albeit with sharply reduced force. Xue Ying’s dominant hand holding onto the end of the spear barely registered the attack. And that was only because the spear had acted as a conduit for the force. Had there been no object to transmit the impact through, this sort of pure power wouldn’t even have been able to enter the Mirage!
Surprisingly, the bellow had formed black ripples visible to the naked eye.
Once the ripples crossed the threshold of the real world and passed into the Mirage, their power was immediately reduced by 90%. The remaining 10% still crashed into Xue Ying’s body, which was covered with a protective layer of True Meaning of Star!
But sometimes, a more laid-back attitude would actually bring better results. It was the same as in the case of how Xue Ying had practiced his spear techniques focusing on the aspect of speed; the more he pursued this goal, the faster his True Meaning of Extreme Piercing had improved. Naturally, his Extreme Piercing had advanced by leaps and bounds.
Until now.
All of his True Meanings had reached the peak of the stage two realm, but breaking through stages had always been difficult. Xue Ying had reached this peak several years ago.
The body of a cultivator of the True Meaning of Star was akin to a celestial body, proficient in both offense and defence. Gravity only seemed to serve as a complement.
Hua, hua, hua! The surface formed by the True Meaning of Star had the depth of the Earth and the stars.
In truth, had he been forced to face the Death Howl of the Ten Thousand Ghost Body outside the Mirage, he would have been injured at most, thanks to the defense granted by the True Meaning of Star.
f he could resist even outside the Mirage, by receiving the attack inside the mirage with the True Meaning of Star, he wasn’t injured in the least!
The gigantic Nuo Nuo An wondered to himself expectantly, Is he dead?
Pu.
"It must be due to that Six Ghost Resentment hexing poison. His many years of enduring its suffering are bound to have tempered his mind and strengthen it. But with my Ten Thousand Ghost Body, I can resist for longer than he can! I trust that in about eight to ten more exchanges, he’ll drop dead." Nuo Nuo An instantly focused his thoughts. Once more, he faced the attacks slowed down by the Time Flow and countered them. Not only was the True Meaning of Extreme Penetration incredibly fast, it also had the ability to pierce space. By the time it left the Time Flow, it would already penetrate the skull.
Too cruel!
Hou!
Hou!
The terrible Death Howl, formed with the grade three True Meaning of Death at the base and built upon the foundation of the Ten Thousand Ghost Body, was unleashed time after time. Each of these instances unleashed was terrifying.
…
"This move contains the True Meaning of Death," Mountain Lord He explained. "Moreover, it’s a soul attack which turned even the stones and soil in the distance to nothing. The effect it will have on the soul will be even more devastating. Xue Ying might have the Green-Armored Protector, but its proficiency doesn’t lie in blocking this type of attack."
Si Kong Yang asked anxiously, "Can Xue Ying take it? His body is so weak."
Despite being struck by Xue Ying’s spear more than eight times, Nuo Nuo An’s gigantic body showed no signs of being affected. The Ten Thousand Ghost Body was clearly very sturdy.
"Oh, Xue Ying." Palace Head Chen was worried sick, but he couldn’t even send him a message while he remained in the Mirage!
…
The afterimages of his spear pierced Nuo Nuo An time and time again, seemingly from every angle.
"How is he able to keep going?" Nuo Nuo An’s titanic figure was gradually shrinking. With each stab, some more of his energy spilled.
"This can’t be! The True Meanings of Extreme Penetration and Mirage don’t specialize in defense, and he doesn’t even have Qi. How can he still be standing?"
"No, No …" Nuo Nuo An’s body began shrinking faster and faster, prompting him to bellow a frightened yell.
He had come from the Dark Abyss, and here, in the mortal world, he was at the level of an Era Suppressor! He was so strong, so how could he die so easily?
He simply couldn’t believe it. "How come he isn’t dying? What’s keeping him alive? Is he really stronger than I am?"

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - Number One Under the Heavens
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: Number One Under the Heavens
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
As he watched Nuo Nuo An despair in his Ten Thousand Ghost Body form, General Ku Meng turned to look towards Lord You Lan beside him and transmitted a message to him, "Lord, is there no way you can think of to save Nuo Nuo An?"
"How would I save him? Dong Bo Xue Ying attacks without warning, and he withdraws as soon as he strikes. There’s nothing I can do." Despite saying that, Lord You Lan actually had a way to save him, but it was intended as a life-saving measure for a critical time inside the Crimson Rock Mountain. He had no mind to waste it on Nuo Nuo An. To him, Nuo Nuo An was merely a subordinate, while the main force actually intended for searching the Crimson Rock Mountain for treasures consisted of only himself! Be it Nuo Nuo An, General Ku Meng, or even both of them together, they didn’t come even close to the importance he placed on his own safety.
Lord You Lan watched on with added interest. Nuo Nuo An’s incomplete Ten Thousand Ghost Body sent out multiple Death Howls, but none of them accomplished anything. His opponent doesn’t even have Qi… perhaps he wields some sort of odd treasure? Or is it that he’s also grasped a protective True Meaning on top of the others?"
"Argh!" From the distance, Nuo Nuo An’s mournful howl resounded. His face displayed a fierce expression and his growls actually seemed to be a collection of innumerable voices.
He growled sharply, his voice clear among the numerous screams, "I can’t accept this! It can’t be!"
The titanic Ten Thousand Ghost Body exploded with a deafening bang! The frightening power contained by the body erupted in a split second, scattering in every direction. This short-lived explosion was absolutely at the Deity level in terms of its power.
"It’s the Ten Thousand Ghost Body’s retaliation!" Lord You Lan’s eyebrows twitched. The frightening shockwaves had spread to his location in a flash. It was definitely powerful, but its energy was scattered due to its area of effect! The further it spread, the less powerful it was. By the time it reached Lord You Lan and General Ku Meng, it barely posed any threat.
General Ku Meng’s silvery body moved in front to forcefully shield Lord You Lan from the incoming shock wave. Hong long long—
Like the reef when struck by waves, he didn’t move in the least.
General Ku Meng gloomily said, "He actually self-detonated."
"He was, from the very start, not at a high enough realm, so he could barely maintain the Ten Thousand Ghost Body. Even then, he was not able to hold that form for long! Once he couldn’t hold it together any longer, he self-detonated." Lord You Lan shook his head. "He lost. It’s notable that Dong Bo Xue Ying’s defense is stronger than we had expected. I suspect he either has some sort of special protective treasure, or he must have grasped a defensive True Meaning! "
"Unless he has a special treasure, it’s probably another True Meaning focused on defensive ability." Lord You Lan smiled. "This Xia Clan Transcendent is quite hard to deal with, but he’s still young, and his Extreme Penetration and Mirage are probably still at the peak of the second stage. If they have yet to hit the third stage, he’s unlikely to harm you, General Ku Meng."
His greatest accomplishment was his body. It was overbearing, exuding enough pressure to even suppress Nuo Nuo An.
While Lord You Lan and General Ku Meng had calmly analyzed the attack, the Transcendents of the Xia Clan were really moved. They watched the gigantic Nuo Nuo An explode, with the resulting armageddon-like power turning the surrounding five hundred kilometers into scorched earth despite being suppressed by Battleship D9.
"He…he died? Just like that?"
Behind the transparent walls of the deck, the Xia Clan Demigods, down to the very last, witnessed the dazzling explosion; it looked like a colossal firework blast! This particular firework, however, marked the fall of an Era Suppressor!
That was how Nuo Nuo An met his demise at Xue Ying’s hands. His Ten Thousand Ghost Body could strike fear into the hearts even of those just looking from afar, yet in the end, he had still died.
"Xue Ying can already be considered the strongest member of our Xia Clan," Mountain Lord He spoke freely, revealing a smile. "Neither Great Elder Ao Lan, the Infernal Emperor, the Blood Devil, nor even the mysterious Third Priests…can measure up to Xue Ying any longer. He already possesses the strength of an Era Suppressor! And he’s this strong without even wielding a Deity Treasure!"
"Hahaha!" Si Kong Yang’s smile widened even further. "Good, good. He’s part of our Water Daoist Faction, and I was even his master back in the Scarlet Cloud Mountain!"
"Stop showing off, Si Kong Yang! Back then, you even berated him and tried to force him into comprehending the True Meaning of Water and Fire." Off to the side, Gong Yu joined them in smiling.
"He’s strong. Very strong."
Xue Ying received the status of ‘Era Suppressor’ upon having killed another outsider of that level!
It was clear; despite having grasped three grade two True Meanings, all of them were at the peak of the second stage! Not only that, the three True Meanings—of Extreme Penetration, of Mirage, and of Star—were scary enough alone, but even scarier when combined. Nuo Nuo An had witnessed that.
"Looking back, however, Nuo Nuo An should be the weakest member of the team from the Dark Abyss." Palace Chen looked in the distance. "I can see no change in Lord You Lan’s expression, in spite of Nuo Nuo An’s death."
A weight was bearing down on the hearts and minds of every present Xia Clan Demigod. They had all seen how Lord You Lan’s strike had easily crushed the main defensive array of the Black White Deity Mountain, with a power which was definitely on the level of a Deity! He was on a fundamentally different stage than an ordinary Era Suppressor.
In the Temple of the Earth God Headquarters, inside the garden.
The Temple of the Earth God team sent over from the Deity Realm—made up of the red-haired Bo Bo, the thin and tall Ba Han, as well as the young master, the golden-armored youth, Wu Ma Hai—all turned to look in the distance. They could feel terrifying fluctuations coming from over fifty thousand kilometers away. Although the energy they felt was very weak, they could tell that, in the distance, those waves had to be immensely strong.
"Such strong fluctuations. They seem to have come from hundreds of thousands of kilometers away. Over there, the wave must be strong enough to have breached into the Deity realm." Wu Ma Hai’s eyes shone, and he immediately stood up. "Let’s go take a look. Perhaps they came from an opponent we’ll have to face inside the Scarlet Rock Mountain."
"Let’s go." Ba Han and Bo Bo both stood up as well.
In a flash, the three of them had flown up high and opened a tunnel in space, through which they then hurried towards the Black White Deity Mountain.
They were not the only ones to have felt the fluctuations. One by one, the the other teams also left for the source.
******
"A Deity Treasure?" Xue Ying looked at the pair of glowing green eyes for a moment before placing them inside his storage treasure. The great existence from the Dark Abyss who had sent this Deity Treasure down might have also left behind some trick, making it difficult to refine. In any case, he couldn’t even use Qi, so he had no way of refining it, prompting him to quickly set it aside.
He then picked up a storage ring, and a drop of blood from his fingertip quickly permeated it. It was easy for a Transcendent to refine an ownerless treasure like this. They could use Qi, magic, soul force, or even blood! Even the most ordinary Transcendent who couldn’t even use Qi or magic power had the option of using the aid of formation arrays and blood to take ownership of a storage ring.
After transferring its ownership to himself, he searched its contents. He quickly discovered numerous crystal balls inside the ring, and inside every one of these balls were innumerable howling departed spirits.
Xue Ying’s face turned ashen, and he growled, "Damn it all!"
A hundred thousand kilometers away, space tore open, and several powerful figures flew over from inside. The first to appear was the elderly Meishan Clan Master, a black-clothed male, and a young lady in white garments.
Xue Ying understood why they had arrived. "It seems like they’ve noticed the explosion from earlier. I didn’t expect the Meishan Clan Master to have some companions as well."
Following closely behind were another two teams, one of them being the one from the Temple of the Earth God. Its members were precisely Wu Ma Hai and his two subordinates.
"Five Teams?" Xue Ying waited a while longer, but no other teams arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - Biting Cold Murderous Intent
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: Biting Cold Murderous Intent
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
The surroundings of the majestic Black White Deity Mountain was like a piece of scored earth; the white fog temporarily dissipated.
Hovering above the piece of scorched earth were Lord You Lan and General Ku Meng. Everything was calm; they were facing off against Battleship D9, which was not too far off into the distance.
"Mn?" Lord You Lan’s expression changed slightly. He looked into the distance.
Four teams of Transcendents were coming one after another.
"Oh? This should be the team from the Dark Abyss, right?" The commander from the last team was a teenager garbed in gold. He casually commented, "What is going on? According to the rules of the Temporal Temple, sending a powerful Demigod allows for two others to accompany him as well! Why is the Dark Abyss team left with only two Demigods? Unless, one of them had died at the hands of the Xia Clan?"
"The Xia clan may be weak, but with their accumulated foundations, they aren’t a force to anger. His underling had probably died." The team commander from the Temple of the Earth God, the golden armored young man named Wu Ma Hai, laughed savagely.
"I am Chen Jiu, may I know who this is?" The Bloodshed Tavern commander, Chen Jiu, was the most polite of them all.
"Wu Ma Hai!" the golden-armored young man responded.
The teenager garbed in gold robes’ smiling gaze landed on the Meishan Clan Master instead. "Wu Huang, I’ve heard that you have already broken away from the control of the Temporal Temple. Who would have imagined that you would be here participating in this affair as well. Haha, it really has been a long time since we last met. Especially since the previous time when we fought, that battle is really something I can’t forget!"
The Meishan Clan Master frowned. "Jian Huang, do you want to fight right now?"
"There’s no point. Within the Crimson Rock Mountain, our enemy is the dangers that lurk within . We may still have to work together." The golden-robed teenager smiled.
Meishan Clan Master snorted and did not speak thereafter.
The two of them were once Reincarnators of the Temporal Temple and had fought before. Of course, the Meishan Clan Master had already regained his freedom.
"Foolish Nuo Nuo An." Lord You Lan cursed inwardly, "After his death, he has even attracted these other people."
However, he was not worried.
This was because they had quite a lot of detailed information related to Crimson Rock Mountain. Adventuring through the mountain did not require slaughter. They only needed to break through the many dangers lurking within before being able to obtain what they wanted. They could even cooperate with one another! This was also the reason why the Bloodshed Tavern had agreed to bring Xue Ying with them; they were not afraid of them snatching the treasures.
Lord You Lan cast his vision towards the distant Battleship D9 and coldly snorted. "Enough! Xia Clan, you all want to threaten me with just Dong Bo Xue Ying? Hmph, I’d suggest that you all better obediently hand over the Deity grade scrolls!"
He did not have any patience left.
"Hand over the Deity grade scrolls?" A laughter filled with suppressed anger and killing intent reverberated, and a white-robed teenager appeared from the Mirage. It was none other than Xue Ying.
"Lord You Lan!" Xue Ying’s eyes were filled with a raging inferno. A crystal ball appeared on his right hand and with a pa, it was instantly smashed. Countless trapped souls from within immediately roared with anguish as they flew outwards before disappearing into nothingness due to the laws of the world.
"Do you see this? Do you see these departed spirits demand vengeance for their grievances?" Xue Ying took yet another crystal ball filled with countless spirits, smashing it in order to allow these souls to return to the world. "They were all killed by you! Furthermore, they are filled with resentment after you had killed them and countless more of my clansmen! They did not have any malice against you and lived their lives peacefully, yet you slaughtered them and tortured their souls to the extent where they are filled with grievances. You still dare to demand for more Deity grade scrolls?"Deity grade scrolls?"
Xue Ying’s voice was cold, and this cold was seemingly suppressing the volcano from erupting.
Crystal ball after crystal ball smashed apart in his hands.
Countless spirits returned to the world.
This single scene had made all of the Xia Clan Transcendents in Battleship D9 to feel heartache.
"Oh? I almost forgot to say this, but I’ve already eaten a hundred million of your clansmen’ souls." Lord You Lan licked his teeth before revealing its pure whiteness. "Truly tasty. No wonder the Demonic Gods from our Dark Abyss all love the souls of humans from the material worlds. It’s an absolute delicacy!"
Xue Ying’s pupil contracted. The anger in him was making his chest explode.
At this moment—
Weng!
An enormous skull illusion appeared beside Lord You Lan and General Ku Meng. This skull had a helmet on it, though the two yellowish eyes underneath were just like an endless dead ocean. Even though it was merely a skull illusion and was not a World Projection, it was enough to make Xue Ying and the commanders of the four other teams to feel uncomfortable.
"Great Demonic God." Lord You Lan and General Ku Meng slightly bent their back.
Xue Ying immediately understood that this skull illusion with a helmet on it was that majestic existence who arranged to send Lord You Lan and the others down into their world.
And it did not seem as if this Great Demonic God was the same figure as the one controlling the Demonic Faction!
The Great Demonic God…
To phrase it was it would be phrased in the Deity World, he was actually at the World Deity realm! It represented power. Naturally, there were huge differences between World Deities too. With the requirements the Temporal Temple demanded for sending Demigods over, the price for sending Demigods at the level of Lord You Lan was extremely terrifying! At the least, the ancestor Deities from the Xia Clan could not afford it. Those who would be willing to pay the price for a gamble were those World Deities that were extraordinary—or the Great Demonic Gods!
The helmeted skull stared at Xue Ying. "Human, you actually dared to kill my underling!"
"They massacred countless Xia Clan clansmen, so why should I not kill him?" Xue Ying coldly retorted.
"Oh? Interesting. You truly have a courageous side with you and are filled with potential. No wonder even Da Er Meng and the others wish to eradicate you as well. Who would have thought that after a hundred years, your combat power has improved so much. I truly want to know how Da Er Meng and that Lord Sorcerer Deity will react after knowing that your combat power has increased greatly. Truly interesting." The helmeted skull illusionlaughed out loud. He did not even want to bicker with Xue Ying, as there was no point.
If they were in the Dark Abyss, how would these little bugs dare to be so unbridled with him!
But they were currently in a mortal world!
"You Lan." The helmeted skull illusionlooked towards Lord You Lan. "Right now, you haven’t even entered the Crimson Rock Mountain, yet Nuo Nuo An is dead already!"
"Hmph, Great Demonic God, you should be rest assured. If the mission fails, then I’ll definitely die. Thus, I’ll be doing my utmost! Right now, I am thinking of ways to increase my chances of victory!" Lord You Lan frowned.
"If you understand that failure is not an option, then it’s fine." The helmeted skull illusion nodded.
They had all signed an Abyss Oath. The Abyss Oath had a terrifying binding towards the lives of these lifeforms from the Dark Abyss, and even the Temporal Temple could not save them at all. Those who went against the oath, unless the wronged party was unwilling to overlook said oath-breaking, would die!
Hua.
The helmeted skull illusion disappeared.
…
The four teams who were watching the battle felt great shock. From the previous conversation, they could deduce that the member ‘Nuo Nuo An’ from the Dark Abyss had died in the hands of Xue Ying!
"He killed Nuo Nuo An?" The red-haired male, Bo Bo, from the Temple of the Earth God bewilderedly asked, "How is that possible? Is he that strong? Or could it be that Nuo Nuo An is weak?"
"Enough."
Young Master Wu Ma Hai had a cold expression. "Nuo Nuo An’s combat power isn’t weak at all! I’m sure you could feel the remnants from the explosion previously—it has reached the level of Deity realm. So how could Nuo Nuo An be weak? It should be that the combat power of Dong Bo Xue Ying is more formidable than we expected!"
In the hearts of the members of this team, they felt displeased.
Previously, they had looked down upon Xue Ying, believing that he had nothing they would desire and that he would undoubtedly die upon entering Crimson Rock Mountain. But now that he could kill Nuo Nuo An…it represented that even if Xue Ying was to move by himself, he still had hope despite the dangers.
"Manor Master, you invited Dong Bo Xue Ying to join our team because Manor Master had discovered his combat power to be this strong?" the mountain-goateed old man asked in astonishment. He did not kept his voice soft since there was no need. When everyone went to the Crimson Rock Mountain, they would naturally find out.
"What!"
"Dong Bo Xue Ying has joined the team of Bloodshed Tavern?"
Meishan Clan Master’s team and Jian Huang’s team were still relatively calm.
The team from the Temple of the Earth God, though, was uncomfortable, for they had previously ascertained that no other team would accept Xue Ying.
…
And on the other side…
After being threatened by the helmeted skull illusion, Lord You Lan’s eyes were filled with killing intent. He looked towards the distant Xue Ying and Battleship D9 before coldly saying, "I do not have any patience left!"
"If you think you don’t, then I should have even less of my patience left!" Xue Ying’s voice was low and filled with countless killing intent. "As I said before, Nuo Nuo An was just the beginning! The next person I will kill right now is the second!"
Lord You Lan and General Ku Meng’s expressions slightly changed.
Under their vision, the distant Xue Ying, who was enveloped in a swelling killing intent, disappeared into nothingness.

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - General Ku Meng
chapters.content:
Chapter 292: General Ku Meng
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
Wearing a cold expression, Lord You Lan said, "General Ku Meng, you’re the one who should deal with Dong Bo Xue Ying next."
"Hmph! Should he even dare try to face me, I’ll take the chance and kill him!" General Ku Meng’s eyes glimmered with indifferent ruthlessness.
Lord You Lan continued, "I’ll be controlling the flow of time in the surrounding area."
General Ku Meng responded with a slight nod.
With a hong, General Ku Meng’s figure rapidly increased in size. His original three-meter-tall figure had before long reached a height of close to two thousand meters; he was essentially a moving mountain! This new silver-colored figure of his had not a single strand of hair on his entire body. His breaths created wind and thunder, and his eyes were just as cold and devoid of emotion.
"His power has increased!" Wu Ma Hai, the golden-armored young man, raised his head to take in the sight of the towering, mountain-like silver giant. "The innate talents of demons from the Dark Abyss give them a great advantage over simple cultivators like us, who rely on Deity-grade secret techniques. We simply can’t train to such a level. Even someone previously weaker than us can cause Deity-level suppression after reaching that size!"
"His power might have increased after becoming so gigantic, but his defensive ability is actually weaker now," Ba Han, the man with a tall and thin figure, commented from the side.
Bo Bo shook his head in dismay. "Even so, it’s still stronger than mine. These demonic bodies of the people from the Dark Abyss are truly perverse."
Ordinary cultivation would not result in such strong fleshy bodies. Even those who underwent body cultivation using a Deity-grade secret technique would be limited in the ultimate strength of their fleshy bodies. On the other hand, the demons of the Dark Abyss were born with powerful, tyrannical bodies without the need to cultivate them. The moment they attained certain unique demonic body secret techniques, they could increase the strength of their bodies to a terrifying degree. However, the price of attaining the techniques was huge, and the requirements equally titanic. It was not something any ordinary Demigod-level demon could accomplish.
"A demonic body alone doesn’t mean much. It is having a deep comprehension of the Laws of Profound Mysteries that’s really important!" Wu Ma Hai exclaimed in slight interest. "Let us then take a good look at just how formidable this Dong Bo Xue Ying’s true combat power is."
It was not just the team from the Temple of the Earth God who watched with great interest. The Bloodshed Tavern Team, the team which Meishan Clan Master commanded, and Jian Huang’s team also considered this a good opportunity to observe the combat power of the team from the Dark Abyss, while also getting to see just how capable this genius from the Xia Clan World was.
Back inside the pitch-black Battleship D9, the Demigods of the Xia Clan were nervously watching in rapt attention. They had originally believed that Xue Ying would stop after killing Nuo Nuo An, but he was clearly moving on to the next opponent. Was he really that confident?
"This silvery giant seems to be more powerful than Nuo Nuo An." Mountain Lord He stared up at that towering figure standing in mid-air.
Even Battleship D9, which reached a thousand meters in length, seemed small by comparison. The aura emitted by the giant swept across the heavens and the earth, causing winds to form and lightning to crash with every breath. Such might was, by all means, that of a Deity!
"Inside the Mirage, Xue Ying should be at the very least able to survive without issue," Palace Head Chen began. "Rest assured; Xue Ying was able to kill Nuo Nuo An, so he should have the power to back his words."
Both Lord You Lan and the titanic General Ku Meng were on full alert. Unable to catch even a trace of Xue Ying, they had no choice but to be silent and guarded for any motion, so as to counter as soon as he attacked!
This True Meaning of Mirage is proving to be very troublesome. At least his comprehension of the realms isn’t that deep, though. I’ve heard that once a cultivator condenses a True Deity Heart, they become even harder to deal with; for now, we just have to keep a look out for sneak attacks, Lord You Lan thought to himself.
Despite being extremely weak among grade two True Meanings, Demigods still wished they could grasp its secrets. It being weak in power didn’t was inconsequential, since all they had to do was cultivate another True Meaning to circumvent this weakness. Yet no matter how much they wished for it, the True Meaning of Mirage wasn’t something so easily attained.
With a hu, a revolving spear shot out from within the void in a piercing motion. Its body was akin to a swimming dragon, with additional revolving waves materializing around it as caused by the True Meaning of Extreme Piercing. The spear’s origin point was right behind the silvery giant, and its destination was the back of his head!
The silvery giant released a hu sound as it turned around lightning-fast and sent out a palm attack. That single strike generated countless rays, surrounded at the sides by surging airflow. Even its speed was incredible…this was the might of a Deity!
The spear ultimately reached near enough to pierce the silvery giant’s head. A small portion of flesh broke off from his skull, almost like a fragment of marble falling off a great sculpture, and was eventually destroyed.
The very moment the spear tried pulling back, it was met with the incoming slap from the giant.
As the two clashed, a tremor was released that seemed like it could shake the very heavens and the earth! This single clash was so powerful, it did not lose out to the self-destruction of the Ten Thousand Ghost Body! The difference, however, was that the power of the palm was focused on the spear it had clashed into.
"Die!" What General Ku Meng saw through the expressionless eyes of his silvery giant form was the flow of countless particles.
The True Meaning which he had grasped, as well as the True Meaning which he had used to condense his True Deity Heart, was precisely the True Meaning of Particles!
The body of the spear released a weng sound as it began to bend.
The scene inside the Mirage, however, was different. The terrifying power of that strike couldn’t be transmitted fully inside, and its might was rapidly shaved off under the influence of the Laws of the Mirage! Even then, Xue Ying’s arm holding onto the spear was forced back from the impact, twisting and revolving as he worked to dissipate the remnants.
Xue Ying was startled at the sight. Such incredible strength. His pure physical ability together with the True Meaning of Particles allow him to send a greater portion of his power inside the Mirage!
Usually, it would be hard to transmit one’s pure strength inside the Mirage.
A pity for him, however, that my True Meaning of Star specializes in strength and defense. While Xue Ying’s right hand was moving to dissipate the leftover force, his palm was not even numb in the slightest, much less trembling! After all, Xue Ying’s True Meaning of Star allowed him to reach a similarly vigorous condition, and his every action was close in strength to that of an Era Suppressor!
Such strength meant that while he could not compete head-on with the silvery giant in the real world…he could easily do so inside the Mirage.
He wasn’t slapped away? General Ku Meng’s appraisal of Xue Ying was that he possessed a weak fleshy body. He had assumed that after the spear began bending, it would quiver so much from his full-power strike, which was combined with his True Meaning of Particles at the True Deity Heart realm even after passing through the boundary of the Mirage, that Xue Ying would no longer be able to hold onto the spear, causing it to naturally fly out into the real world.
Is it that he has a Deity warrior which he depended on to hold onto the spear? General Ku Meng could only guess.
With another hu, the revolving spear once more reached out from the Mirage and pierced the back of the giant’s neck.
Every single action General Ku Meng took in his silvery giant form tore space itself apart, formed howls of wind, and caused countless rays to appear at the edges of his body.
Time and time again, he sent out his palm in a slap. Assisted by the True Meaning of Time Deceleration, General Ku Meng was able to counter each spear strike with his own palm attack! Under normal circumstances, that terrifying slap alone would be powerful enough to deal with any Era Suppressor—not even Nuo Nuo An himself could clash against it directly and would be left heavily injured by it.
As the two continued this back and forth, General Ku Meng began to ponder, He must be just barely withstanding my attacks. Not even a Deity warrior could resist my assault! He’s surely injured…just a few more attacks, and he should die.
But time went by, and with each attack, another small fragment of his body would be destroyed. Once could be overlooked, but after twenty of thirty of these attacks, even General Ku Meng couldn’t hold on any longer!
Lord You Lan transmitted, "Just give up, Ku Meng! He must have a very powerful defensive True Meaning or some sort of unique treasure! Since he can just keep attacking, there’s no point in you doing this any longer."
Even General Ku Meng himself wouldn’t have dared keep such a pace up.
A hu sound marked the shrinking of the nearly two-thousand-meter-tall giant back into the silvery person close to three meters in height.
Another spear strike released a chi sound as it approached at lightning speeds, piercing all the way through the neck of that silvery person!
General Ku Meng revealed an ugly sneer at the sight. His gigantic figure had caused his power to skyrocket, but now that his body shrunk back to its previous size, his defense rapidly instantly increased at the cost of his previous offensive ability! It was at this size that his defense was the strongest, and not even Xue Ying’s formidable offense was enough to injure his tyrannical demonic body. Back in the Dark Abyss, due to the miraculous act of condensing his True Meaning of Particles into a True Deity Heart, he was able to cultivate his demonic body to where it made him invulnerable to ordinary existences at the same level as him. When he exploded out offensively, on the other hand, his power reached the Deity realm, while his defenses were weakened. Naturally, his techniques became simpler as well, but they were still at the Deity realm in terms of power. This was precisely why Nuo Nuo An had been so meek and quiet in front of him.
Unfortunately for General Ku Meng, Xue Ying could hide in the Mirage, and his defenses were similarly formidable. He was also helpless to do anything to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - Dong Bo Xue Yings Killing Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 293: Dong Bo Xue Ying's Killing Technique
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying, unconvinced, continued attacking over and over again.
The silvery man’s figure rippled indistinctly, yet no injuries could be seen!
A Demigod can actually have a body so tyrannical that it can withstand my Extreme Piercing? Xue Ying was startled. Had anyone in the Xia Clan World dared to say they were capable of withstanding an attack of his Extreme Piercing, he would certainly not have believed them. But this General Ku Meng from the Dark Abyss had achieved just that! Such a fleshy body was truly too perverse and heaven-shaking. If General Ku Meng was so powerful already, then what of Lord You Lan?
…
"His attack is still too weak." The commander of the team from Bloodshed Tavern, Chen Jiu, nodded, a smile on his lips. "Dong Bo Xue Ying’s Extreme Piercing should be at the peak of the stage two realm! If he could break through to the stage three realm, or if he could utilize a Deity weapon, then he might have long killed General Ku Meng."
Despite its strength, the demonic body still had a limit.
Xue Ying’s attack was clearly lacking that small difference. As long as he could reach that limit, he would be able to injure General Ku Meng! As long as he could injure him, once his attacks accumulated to a certain extent, General Ku Meng would certainly die!
"We can’t blame him for being weak offensively." The bald-headed yellow-robed old man added, "It’s just that the demonic body of those Demigods from the Dark Abyss is too strong. If it’s us, our body would not be able to resist against his attacks."
"We might not be able to resist, but there exists no reason for us to resist as we have our own techniques. With my creation of illusions, he will most likely be unable to find my true self." The mountain-goateed old man wasn’t willing to admit weakness.
"But even you can’t injure him either." The bald-headed yellow-robed old man laughed.
Chen Jiu nodded. "We have almost finished our investigation of this Dong Bo Xue Ying’s combat power. It’s not bad, and he is quite good in all aspects. Even though he might not be able to use a Deity weapon, if he uses all his True Meanings, then he isn’t someone others should easily offend. He should be someone on the level as Uncle Fu and Old Thief; though when comparing your survival capabilities, he is on a much higher level when compared to the two of you."
"Mn." The mountain-goateed old man and the bald-headed yellow-robed old man both nodded. They had their own techniques, but they had to admit that Dong Bo Xue Ying, while in the Mirage, had the better chance of survival when facing danger within Crimson Rock Mountain.
"He’s indeed quite a good aide." Chen Jiu laughed. Previously, he had gone to find Xue Ying and was willing to bring him along with them for the sake of his innermost feelings. But now that Xue Ying was evidently a good aide, he was relatively delighted.
…
"Things are getting troublesome for the Xia Clan." Meishan Clan Master looked into the distance. "Dong Bo Xue Ying might be quite formidable, but his strength is not enough to deal with the two of them! And Lord You Lan will certainly not let this go. One of his underlings has just died, so he will assuredly continue to demand for more Deity grade scrolls. The Xia Clan might have to gamble everything."
"Big Brother Wu Huang, will you help the Xia Clan?" The eyes of the white-robed young woman brightened as expectantly stated, "You had onced loved helping the weak."
"Third Brother, will you act?" The black-robed male continued, "That Lord You Lan’s combat power is extremely deep and unfathomable. Furthermore, adventuring in Crimson Rock Mountain means there’s no competition between us and them. I think completing the mission given by the World Deity is more important."
"I understand the gravity of the situation, but you shouldn’t look down upon the Xia Clan either. Once they start staking everything, they aren’t a clan one can easily offend. If the Xia Clan is willing to give me some benefits, then I might lend a helping hand." The Meishan Clan Master laughed. "Lord You Lan wants Deity grade scrolls. We’ll ask for some as well, since it’ll be of a great help in the Crimson Rock Mountain."
"Mn." The black-robed male did not rebuke him.
"Big Brother Wu Huang, can you sense that Dong Bo Xue Ying?" The white-robed young woman asked. "We can’t sense him at all. Most likely, even Lord You Lan himself can’t sense him. Big Brother Wu Huang, you should be able to do so, right?"
Meishan Clan Master glanced at the white-robed young woman before transmitting a message over. "I can barely gauge where he is! I grasped hold of the complete True Meaning of Space, so I am quite sensitive in terms of sensing space itself; this is the same for the Mirage too. Yet, I can barely sense the figure of Dong Bo Xue Ying. If he reached the stage three realm of True Meaning of Mirage, then I’ll not be able to sense him anymore."
"Oh." The white-robed young woman let out a breath of relief before revealing a grin as she transmitted back, "That’s good. An invisible enemy is someone that would cause my goosebumps to rise. Big Brother Wu Huang, since you can sense him, then we won’t be afraid anymore."
From the start to finish…
During the battle, he could merely see a spear piercing out from nothingness and not the spearman himself.
This was indeed something that made them feel tense! Dong Bo Xue Ying was truly a terrifying assassin!
…
As the different teams discussed amongst each other while following this battle, they were able to analyze and conclude the degree of threat and combat power of Xue Ying! They could see that this battle was about to end. Xue Ying’s combat power might let him kill some Era Suppressants, but General Ku Meng was someone Xue Ying could not do anything to.
They were currently even more curious on how the Xia Clan would deal with this!
"Xia Clan, Dong Bo Xue Ying can’t help you any longer!" Lord You Lan looked toward the black Battleship D9 floating in midair. "Nuo Nuo An has died, and his treasure has been taken away by your Xia Clan’s Dong Bo Xue Ying. But as long as you hand me thirty Deity grade scrolls, it will be as if nothing has happened. I will even let you guys have the treasures of Nuo Nuo An! If you don’t hand me the Deity grade scrolls, I’ll seek compensation from your entire Xia Clan for Nuo Nuo An’s death!"
Lord You Lan’s icy voice carried indescribable killing intent.
The other four teams’ commanders remained silent.
What a joke.
The team from the Dark Abyss was not someone they could offend easily. This Lord You Lan, according to their understanding, had grasped hold of the True Meaning of Time Deceleration. He personally had another combative True Meaning as well. These two True Meanings used together…was something none of them was willing to face. After all, the time flow when both sides were battling would be unequal, with them on the losing side! Lord You Lan could elongate his arm to over five kilometers in length, which was grander than that of the silvery giant, so most likely, he should have a terrifying demonic body too! Such an opponent was too difficult to face against. It was difficult to declare the winner of the battle, and they might even die!
Without any benefits, who would be willing to fight for the Xia Clan?!
Furthermore, they had the missions given by various magnificent existences to consider; Crimson Rock Mountain was much more important to them!
"Damn!"
The atmosphere in Battleship D9 completely froze.
"Everyone, what should we do?" The Grand Palace Elder Head frowned. "Xue Ying has already tried his best. His combat power is more formidable than expected, but we have no choice. The enemy is truly too powerful."
"Thirty Deity grade scrolls is something we would never hand over!" Mountain Lord He grimaced.
"Ai ai ai! Why must he be able to control the time flow, damn it." Palace Head Chen was even more anxious. Even if the Xia Clan’s treasures were more powerful, it would be used by the Demigods present, and the power they would be able to display could not match its usage by a Deity! Under the influence of time deceleration…the power of those treasures would be much weaker.
"I’ll count to ten. If you want to delay any further, then all the humans in the entire Xia Clan World will die!" Lord You Lan’s eyes released terrifying golden rays, and his voice shook the heavens and earth.
"One!"
The Xia Clan Demigods in the battleship trembled as they glanced at each other.
The commanders of the four teams outside were also silently observing. Even though the Meishan Clan Master had his plans, since the Xia Clan did not request for their help, he naturally would not take initiative to act.
"Two!"
"Three!"
"Four!"
Lord You Lan continued counting with a cold veneer.
"What, what should we do!"
"Let’s just stake everything and destroy him!"
"Happiness comes temporarily. Loss comes in huge amounts. In the future, we’ll certainly face an extinction!"
The Xia Clan Demigods nearly went insane.
Must they bow their heads?
But that was harder to accept than dying!
"Nine!" Lord You Lan coldly shouted. The killing intent over his body became increasingly heavy.
Hong!
Suddenly, a terrifying undulation rippled out.
Not to mention Lord You Lan, even the distant four teams and the Demigods of the Xia Clan on Battleship D9 simultaneously looked toward the origin of said ripple.
A spear had appeared from nothingness! This spear was akin to a moving fire cloud!
At this moment!
Lord You Lan and the others could see a huge star appearing. On this star, flowers, plants, and trees grew; there were birds and beasts living on it too! This gigantic star suddenly expanded, causing a dazzling ray to erupt before it started falling apart! The dazzling rays rapidly caved in, condensing into a single point. This point was where the Myriad Existences had originated from and where everything ended.
This point had an unfathomable and terrifying might that suppressed everything around it!
Pu!
The spearhead pierced through the eyebrows of General Ku Meng. Struck with terror, General Ku Meng’s eyes widened.
Ka ka ka~
His body started shattering apart like grit and soon disappeared into nothingness. Only Deity weapons, wristbands, and other treasures remained, falling down to earth.
General Ku Meng died in a single hit!
Lord You Lan, Wu Ma Hai, Meishan Clan Master, Jian Huang, Chen Jiu, and the others watching the battle, including those Xia Clan Demigods on Battleship D9, were shocked with disbelief as they watched what happened.
Hu.
That person who pierced through the eyebrow of General Ku Meng did not withdraw his spear. Instead, he, a white-robed teenager, started walking out from nothingness.
The white-robed teenager Xue Ying was filled with killing intent as he held onto the spear and collected the treasures left behind by General Ku Meng with a wave of his hand.
"You are all that is left!" Xue Ying looked toward the distant Lord You Lan, his voice serene. These few words, however, contained an unshakeable murderous desire!

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - Deity Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 294: Deity Realm
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
Within Battleship D9…
The Transcendents of the Xia Clan were silent. All of them were astonished as they looked through the cabin windows at that spear-wielding, white-robed teenager.
"Xue Ying, he…?"
"He…"
"He actually…"
This was something truly unimaginable! All the Xia Clan Transcendents had been going insane from anxiety! And now, Xue Ying had simply used a single spear…to change the entire outcome! He had destroyed the darkness surrounding the heads of those from the Xia Clan. Previously in the hearts of those Xia Clan Transcendents, everything was gloomy, and they were filled with anxiety. But now, it had transformed into happiness, excitement, and brightness! This feeling felt akin to an illusion; they felt as light as a feather
That was right—it was truly too illusory!
The Xia Clan Transcendents did not dare believe what was before their eyes, yet it had actually happened!
"Oh heavens, my heavens, this, this… I did not see wrongly, right?" The Grand Elder Palace Head blinked a few times. This usually overbearing Grand Elder Palace Head had lost all his composure at this very moment. "A move, a single move had killed that silvery person? This is truly unfathomable. Xue Ying did not have any Deity weapons either!"
"A single move to kill him! That silvery person with a tyrannical demonic body could not even withstand a single move!"
"This is absolutely a power at the Deity realm!"
They were all in a daze.
The degree of stupor they felt was significantly more than what they previously felt when Lord You Lan had easily destroyed the Black White Deity Mountain and pinched Feng Dong to his death! Lord You Lan’s palm was a unique Deity weapon, and he had an even stronger demonic body. But what about Xue Ying?
Xue Ying’s fleshy body was merely at the middle stage of the Saint realm! He also did not have any Qi!
Other than that spear, which did not contain a single formation, he could only rely on his understanding of his True Meanings!
"By solely relying on his True Meaning, he is able to display a power that reached that of the Deity realm!" Palace Head Chen’s voice slightly quivered. "This, this is truly too unfathomable. This is something I had never imagined to happen!"
"I, I don’t even dare believe that everything is real!" Mountain Lord He was excited as well. "Our Xia Clan history has never had such a situation happening. It is truly something unexpected!"
His body was inflicted with the hex poison.
Previously, the combat power displayed by Xue Ying was already spectacular, and the Xia Clan Transcendents could accept it readily since he was already outstanding a hundred years ago. After a hundred years of torture, Xue Ying was able to break through and improve in his combat power, so being an Era Suppressor was something they could accept and understand.
But right now…
This was a situation beyond their wildest dreams! The combat power Xue Ying currently displayed had far surpassed their imaginations!
They had a clear idea of that General Ku Meng’s fleshy body defenses—it was a terrifying and heaven-defying demonic body. But this demonic body…had completely crumbled apart not after ten or a hundred moves, but after one single move! The terrifying life force inherent within a demonic body had actually been completely extinguished in a single move.
"That was absolutely at the Deity realm!" Chi Qiu Bai was also uncontrollable excited. "And not just any ordinary Deity realm power—more importantly, it is his understanding of the Laws of Profound Mysteries that reached the Deity realm!"
Someone who attained the Deity realm in terms of his power wasn’t a big deal.
Si Kong Yang had relied on the Nine Dragon Fire Deity Armor to reach the power of a Deity realm! But his understanding of the Laws of Profound Mysteries was too lacking.
General Ku Meng and Nuo Nuo An, who had grade three Deity Hearts, were considered ordinary, for their understanding was similar to that of an ordinary Deity who just broke through. But if they were to battle against a Deity, they would remain suppressed.
Because—
A Deity, other than his comprehension of the realms, had Deity energy, Deity Domain, and many other aspects of strength.
"I could even believe that if Xue Ying was to fight a newly emerged Deity, he might not be worse off." Chi Qiu Bai was confident in this.
"Right." Mountain Lord He nodded too. "In the history of our Xia Clan, those who condensed a True Deity Heart of a lower grade is really few and far between. Usually, they become a Deity only after having condensed a grade three True Deity Heart! The heart realm of a grade three Deity Heart…was the current realm which Nuo Nuo An and the silvery person had attained. But Xue Ying’s previous spear techniques contain a realm that is much higher than the silvery person!"
"In other words, to ordinary new Deities, Xue Ying holds the advantage in terms of his comprehension of the realms! It’s just that he doesn’t have any Deity energy nor Deity Domain… Yet by just depending on his comprehension of the realms, he just might be able to fight a new Deity to a draw," Mountain Lord He analyzed.
A single move to slaughter the silvery person.
They could affirm that this was absolutely at the level of Deity power. Lord You Lan had previously displayed a combat power that could match that of a Deity, and now, Xue Ying had similarly displayed the same level of combat power!
"But when Xue Ying previously displayed his spear techniques, its power was clearly not as strong. How could it explode all of a sudden? Even if he had a breakthrough in his comprehension of the realms, it should be a gradual increase, unlike the illogical explosion in strength." Grand Elder Palace Head remained suspicious. For instance, reaching the stage three realm from the stage two realm would see an increase in one’s combat power, but not one as exaggerated as Xue Ying’s.
Previously, a spear of his couldn’t kill General Ku Meng.
Yet he could suddenly kill him with a spear strike?
His power increased obscenely, causing them to think it was simply their imagination!
"Haha, Xue Ying is the Transcendent who has the greatest talent in our Xia Clan history. How many apex Transcendents like him have you guys seen before? That General You Lan, that Wu Ma Hai, and that Bloodshed Tavern’s Chen Jiu are all from the Deity World or Dark Abyss, chosen as the apex Demigods amongst many others. They are all tyrannical and unparalleled. Have you ever imagined that such power could exist prior to this? Furthermore, there’s also the heaven-defying Transcendents who grasped hold of a grade one True Meaning, and these Transcendents would most likely be even stronger! Who knows, they could easily kill a Deity at the Demigod realm." Palace Head Chen laughed. "These are all situations which we have never seen before, as we are ultimately mere Transcendents from the mortal world and have yet to experience enough of such situations."
"Mn." The Transcendents present all nodded.
…
As for the four teams observing by the side, the appallment they felt was not insignificant either.
"This, this…have I seen something wrong? Is this an illusion?" The team from the Temple of the Earth God was astonished. Bo Bo was even more in disbelief as he commented, "Such combat power, if it was able to kill that silvery person with a single spear, wouldn’t it kill me as well?"
"That offense is truly terrifying." The tall and thin male, Ba Han, felt his heart grow colder as he commented, "It could absolutely match that of a Deity! He has reached the level of a Deity power."
Wu Ma Hai’s pupil contracted as well.
Even though they did not want to admit, the truth was right before their eyes.
The combat power displayed by this Xue Ying was on the same level as he was! At the level of a Deity! Only Demigods like them, who stood at the apex, could be on this level. And at this moment, Xue Ying had reached it.
"Damn!" Wu Ma Hai growled.
The World Deity that sent him down had paid a terrifying price before being able to send Wu Ma Hai here. Previously, Xue Ying, who had a power that could match his, wanted to join his team, yet he himself had chased away such a powerful expert? The other teams only had a single Demigod at the level of a Deity, but if his team had two of them, it would cause a qualitative change. The two of them teaming up would most likely increase their survival chances when faced with danger.
Unfortunately, he had missed the opportunity!
"Young Master Wu Ma Hai, were you able to see clearly? How did his combat power increase so much?" Ba Han could not help but ask.
Wu Ma Hai shook his head, silent.
…
"This is mad! Another native has exploded in power!" The white-robed young woman in the team of Meishan Clan Master was shocked. "A sick person has exploded with such terrifying combat power."
Their Temporal Temple Reincarnators had walked across countless of worlds and had occasionally heard of terrifying Transcendents appearing in certain mortal worlds.
And right now in the Xia Clan World, they had actually met such an existence!
"Truly powerful. Third Brother, did you see clearly? How did he become so powerful?" The black-robed male asked.
"I don’t dare to affirm it yet…" The Meishan Clan Master was staring at Xue Ying, unblinkingly. "I am kind of wondering if this had truly happened, but let’s wait for him to display the move once more. I should be able to affirm it by then!"
…
"Unless it is…!" The golden-robed teenager Jian Huang opened his eyes wide.
As the geniuses amongst the Reincarnators of the Temporal Temple, their horizons were much broader than many, as they had experienced significantly more. Even if they never met with such a circumstance before, they would have heard of it!
Thus, when Xue Ying displayed that spear of his, Jian Huang had thought of a single legend…
"It can’t be, this is truly too crazy." Jian Huang was dumbfounded. "Let’s see it again."
…
Wu Huang and Jian Huang were amongst those who had faintly guessed what just happened, though they did not dare believe it.
Although Chen Jiu, Wu Ma Hai, and Lord You Lan originated from the Deity World and the Dark Abyss, and despite the broadness of their horizons, they could not guess what had happened. Still, they were contemplating several possibilities in their heart. Nonetheless, they were all terrifying possibilities!
In mid-air…
Xue Ying and Lord You Lan faced each other.
"Killing Nuo Nuo An and Ku Meng…" Lord You Lan’s killing intent, at the moment, rose. His eyes glowed with golden rays. "Unless…you are thinking that you can kill me too? I am a lord, and that is someone with a combat power comparable to a Demonic God. Do you think you could kill a Demonic God?"
