chapters.title: Chapter 295 - Secret Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 295: Secret Skill
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
"Is your body that much stronger than Ku Meng’s?" Xue Ying stared at Lord You Lan. "I can kill him with a single spear, and I can do the same to you!"
"General Ku Meng’s demonic body might be powerful, but how can it compare to mine? Hmph." Lord You Lan had just finished half of his sentence when he suddenly shot out both his palms without warning. His arms starting elongating explosively, and within the blink of an eye, those two black arms had reached Xue Ying. This pair of enormous palms was covered with gold seals, and some circles of gold seals were also amassed on his fingers.
That pair of enormous palms directly slapped against the body of Xue Ying.
Hua.
Xue Ying’s body dissipated, leaving behind only a destroyed illusion.
Hong hong!
Even though those enormous palms had suddenly stopped, the airflow they had generated produced two rays that rushed forward, gouging two large scars on the ground.
"Another illusion!" Lord You Lan frowned. His black and sinister countenance was filled with indignation. He remained vigilant of his surroundings. Meanwhile, time began flowing slower and slower in the domain around him.
The power of Dong Bo Xue Ying’s spear techniques is terrifying. Even General Ku Meng’s formidable body was still killed in a single hit. I’ve attained the help of the Great Demonic God and perfected my demonic body prior to coming here. My body is now stronger than that of Ku Meng, but if I face such a terrifying attack, I’ll most likely be injured even if I don’t die, Lord You Lan thought. His demonic body was strong, but he would not be able to withstand that terrifying spear technique.
Thus, he had to guard against him!
I must guard myself against him!
I must! I must defend. Lord You Lan was on full alert. He extended his senses to cover everything around him. He did not even dare to let his spirit relax, as he had to react as quickly as possible to any incoming attacks!
That was because Xue Ying’s spear would be coming from the Mirage at an extreme speed.
If he was careless for even a moment, the spear would most likely strike his body.
Just like Nuo Nuo An! Just like General Ku Meng!
Even though Lord You Lan had helped them, Nuo Nuo An and General Ku Meng still ended up being pierced by the spear. Xue Ying’s spear was too fast, and the distance between where it came out from the Mirage and the target was really short. Of course, even though it was really short, it still couldn’t directly come out from within the body of the enemy. Even though the Mirage could reflect reality, Xue Ying would not be able to discern the enemy’s face if they wore a mask—only the outermost appearance was reflected!
Xue Ying could only enter ordinary regions when leaving the Mirage and entering reality.
For instance, a Transcendent was able to fly in the sky, swim in the sea, or tunnel through the ground. Similarly, his weapon was able to transition from the Mirage directly into the sky, underground, or the sea.
But if he wanted to kill someone, the weapon would have to pierce through the body of the enemy. Thus, coming out from the Mirage…would similarly require the weapon to pierce into the body of the enemy.
The Extreme Piercing was a grade two True Meaning—an extremely offensive True Meaning at that. It also had to pierce into the enemy’s body. During this process of piercing, the enemy would be able to sense it and defend against it!
The speed of the spear is fast, and the distance it must travel is short. Nuo Nuo An and Ku Meng were both hit by the spear. I must defend myself against it. Lord You Lan prepared himself to face his adversary.
Right here!
Lord You Lan’s eyes glowed with golden rays. He suddenly turned around, as he could sense a terrifying force emerging from the Mirage.
Hong!
A spear, one akin to a moving fire cloud, emerged from the Mirage, appearing behind Lord You Lan.
But as soon as the spear materialized, Lord You Lan turned around and started retreating, simultaneously slapping his palms out!
This single spear…
It had a terrifying undulation just like the Laws of Profound Mysteries. It was just like an enormous star. This star suddenly expanded and released dazzling lights that began caving in, accumulating into a single point just like the start of all and the end of everything. Under the powerful binding of the True Meaning of Time Deceleration, its speed was halved, yet its power and profundity remained the same as before!
"Mn?" Countless gold seals appeared on Lord You Lan’s palm. Once this palm struck out, his expression suddenly changed. He could sense that this spear…was just like a terrifying maelstrom!
It had an extremely frightening attractive force!
Just as his palm technique changed accordingly…
Chi! The spear lunged out at an extremely fast speed. At the same time, the maelstrom’s attractive force suddenly converted into a repulsive force. It was hard for one to even get near the spear. That abrupt transformation from attraction to repulsion caused his palm techniques to fluctuate. One had to know that such an instantaneous transformation of force at such a close distance was life-threatening.
Crack! Lord You Lan’s five fingers suddenly swelled up rapidly, and amidst this danger, two of his fingers directly parried the spearhead.
The spearhead pierced through his fingertips.
Lord You Lan immediately flicked a finger, causing a dim, golden light to form on his fingertip. Space itself was directly shattered apart when his finger clashed with the spearhead. The moment the finger was flicked, a strength lesser than General Ku Meng’s, when he released all of his power yet of greater offensive threat was released. That was a result of his Laws of Profound Mysteries being more profound. The extent of the force’s reduction as it entered the Mirage was also smaller.
Xiu.
The spearhead withdrew before disappearing into nothingness.
Almost! I did not think that his spear could undergo such a terrifying gravitational change. This inversion of gravitational force is comparable to a peak stage three realm True Meaning of Gravity! Lingering fear struck Lord You Lan.
…
"Was that really…" The Meishan Clan Master and the other golden-robed male, Jian Huang, felt an inexplicably grand wave surge through their hearts.
…
The spear appeared time after time from nothingness.
Lord You Lan’s heart was as calm as still water. He concentrated fully on sensing his surroundings. Every time he felt a ripple in the surroundings, he would immediately put forth his strength into defense. Now that he knew of the inverse gravitational changes, he was able to defend himself from every single incoming attack. He could even try his best in counterattacking.
It was clear, however, that after his attack was weakened by the spear and traversed through the Mirage, the threat it imposed on Xue Ying was significantly smaller. At most, he would cause Xue Ying’s palm to feel numb.
"Third Brother, have you seen through it?" The black-robed male and white-robed young woman looked towards the Meishan Clan Master.
The Meishan Clan Master lightly nodded as he continued observing the fierce fight in the distance. Lord You Lan was currently having an intense fight with a spear that pierced out from nothingness.
"I’ve seen through it." Meishan Clan Master’s heart was shaking, and his eyes were filled with a complex emotion.
"Big Brother Wu Huang, what is the reason?" the white-robed young woman asked.
"Secret skill!" Meishan Clan Master transmitted over.
"Ah!" The black-robed male and white-robed young woman were extremely stunned.
They were all members of the Temporal Temple, so they clearly understood what ‘secret skill’ meant. This was quite similar to ‘secret technique.’
…
"Secret skill?" the gold-robed teenager, Jian Huang, quietly mumbled to himself. "This is crazy. Someone who cultivated for less than two hundred years in the mortal world and currently tortured by the hex poison can actually craft his own secret skill? And it is a secret skill that fuses two different True Meanings with it?"
…
Even though Wu Ma Hai and Chen Jiu did not see through it at the beginning, as Xue Ying fought time after time with Lord You Lan, the two of them were able to discern the truth.
"Secret skill!"
Wu Ma Hai and Chen Jiu were certain of it.
But this conclusion led the two to internally feel upset.
Was it due to envy?
…
What was a secret skill?
In simple words—a secret skill was also a secret combat technique!
Secret technique…
This meant unique ways of applying the Laws of Profound Mysteries!
Under normal circumstances, the Laws of Profound Mysteries was extremely crude and direct when used in battle. For example, the secret technique which Xue Ying had learnt previously, "Magic Dragon Force", imprinted countless Magic Dragon Divine Seals into one’s body, allowing one’s fleshy body to become stronger.
The Magic Dragon Divine Seals, by nature, were filled with the Profound Mysteries of the World. They seemed ordinary yet were transformed into complex Divine Seals! Imprinting them would produce miraculous effects!
This was a type of usage.
A unique usage!
The Xia Clan had many secret techniques, like Qi-related secret techniques and physical body-related secret techniques! These were learnable techniques. Because they were in the shape of "Divine Seals" and unchanging after materialization, one could use them as long as they learned them, cultivated their body, or improved how efficiently they used Qi itself.
But—
A combat secret technique was different!
Combat also represented change! A secret combat technique that was used during battle was unlike the Divine Seals, which were immutable. Instead, a combat secret technique was a type of secret technique that changed accordingly and were thus formed from a huge amount of Profound Mysteries fused in a complex manner. Since they did not consist of unchanging Divine Seals, it was almost impossible for one to learn them from books!
For a long time, everyone has agreed—a combat secret technique had to be crafted by oneself!
Even the many powerful existences in the Deity world could not impart these techniques to their disciples.
Thus, secret techniques were classified into two categories.
First, there were those that could be taught; in other words, the more orthodox ones. The Xia Clan could learn them; the Deity world could learn them. These were classified under the first category. Most secret techniques fell under this category!
As for the other category, it would be techniques crafted by the user himself. These were the secret combat techniques! For the sake of drawing a distinction, they were also called secret skills.
Secret skills…
Under the same Laws of Profound Mysteries, utilizing a special skill would cause one’s power to explosively increase!
"According to the legend spoken within the Temporal Temple…" The Meishan Clan Master looked out into the distance. "Amongst ten thousand Transcendents who grasped hold of grade two True Meanings, there would only be one who could craft his own secret skill!"
There were very few Transcendents who had grade two True Meanings, and before Xue Ying’s birth era, the Xia Clan history had more than ten thousand Transcendents with grade three True Meanings. However, only one had grasped hold of a grade two True Meaning.
But if one was to look beyond the material world…in the countless billions of mortal worlds, the Deity World, and the Dark Abyss, then after a cumulative addition across the eras, there would be a huge amount of Transcendents who had grasped hold of grade two True Meanings! Grade two True Meanings were only legends in the mortal worlds! It was the grade one True Meanings…that were legends in the Deity World and Dark Abyss!
"Transcendents with a grade one True Meaning are legends amongst the legends even across the billions of mortal worlds, the Deity World, and the Dark Abyss! Finding one of them is even harder than finding a genius who can craft his own secret skill. Even though they are rare, I’ve seen such a person once while I served the Temporal Temple." The Meishan Clan Master sighed. "And I’m considered quite lucky. Yet when comparing myself to Transcendents who can craft their own secret skills, I’m still lacking quite a bit."
Meanwhile, Chen Jiu shook his head. "Self-crafted secret skill! If he can reach the stage three realm in his True Meanings, with his secret skill, he should be able to kill a Deity. Such existences would most likely not be sent adventuring in the Crimson Rock Mountain, and even if they were, the price demanded by the Temporal Temple would be so high that it would seem exaggerated!"

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - Lord You Lans Crisis
chapters.content:
Chapter 296: Lord You Lan's Crisis
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
"This pervert! His secret skill must’ve fused together two different True Meanings." The gold-robed teenager Jian Huang shook his head. "His power wouldn’t have increased by such an exaggerated amount if he hadn’t!"
"Lord You Lan has grasped hold of two grade two True Meanings." The temple of the Earth God’s team commander, Wu Ma Hai, gazed towards Lord You Lan and Xue Ying and then said, "Both of which have reached the peak of the stage three realm! His demonic body could match that of a Deity’s, and he even has a Deity weapon with him. Who would’ve thought that Xue Ying’s secret skill would be so powerful, and that it would be purely offensive, such that he was able to reach the peak of the stage three realm for his Extreme Piercing!"
Wu Ma Hai continued to observe…
Xue Ying had neither Qi nor a Deity weapon; he had to depend solely on the might of his True Meanings! Consequently, that spear technique of his was purely destructive in nature, as the Myriad Existences it held had transformed into a point of extremity. In short, it was a purely offensive move. Compared to the might that Lord You Lan had shown in their previous clashes, it was only a notch lower. One had to realize that Lord You Lan was both using a Deity weapon and had a demonic body.
"What a formidable secret skill!"
"His comprehension of the realms was already quite good. With this secret skill of his added to the fray, however, he’s definitely on the same level as us."
They were all Demigods who stood at the apex.
The Meishan Clan Master, Chen Jiu, Jian Huang, Wu Ma Hai, Lord You Lan… All of them had reached the peak of the stage three realm in their various grade two True Meanings! However, it was impossible for them to condense grade two Deity Hearts.
That was because…
The moment that they condensed a grade two Deity Heart, they’d easily be able to become a Deity!
If they could truly become a Deity, all of them would’ve done so long ago. Who’d be willing to gamble with their life in the Crimson Rock Mountain, where only one out of every ten people survived?
A Transcendent with a grade five or a grade four Deity Heart would have a hard time becoming a Deity. A Transcendent with a grade three Deity Heart wouldn’t have an easy time becoming a Deity. Someone with a grade two Deity Heart, however, would definitely become a Deity. As for those with a so-called ‘grade one Deity Heart’…that was something both unfathomable and terrifying…
In actuality, somebody that simply had a grade one True Meaning was already too rare.
Just like the difference between grade four and grade three True Meanings—generally, there would only be one person who grasped a grade three True Meaning out of countless others with grade four True Meanings.
From grade three to grade two True Meanings, only one person out of ten thousand would have a grade two True Meaning. Furthermore, this was already considered a legend.
As for grade two to grade one True Meanings…only one person out of a million people would acquire one. The emergence of one was something that pure statistics couldn’t be used to calculate, as every single emergence of a grade one True Meaning was a miracle in and of itself. In fact, it was even rarer than a grade one Deity Heart.
Why so?
This was because once one had become a Deity, such as those who had grade two Deity Hearts, they could continue to cultivate over a long period of time in order to transform their grade two Deity Heart into a grade one Deity Heart.
For those at the Transcendent level, people that could comprehend a grade one True Meaning would certainly become amazing characters!
Thus—
Anytime someone with a grade one True Meaning emerged, based on their comprehensive abilities, they’d easily be able to condense a Deity Heart. Even if they were to die prematurely, several powerful existences from the Deity World would do their best to protect their souls and refine a new fleshly body in order for them to live on in.
Regardless, anybody with a grade one True Meaning would be treated as a precious treasure!
At the same time, any enemy superpowers would certainly attempt to think of ways to kill these geniuses as soon as possible! Thus, when needed, the existence of those with grade one True Meanings would be kept a secret. Even the Temporal Temple had to swear an oath to ensure that they didn’t gain too much power.
"It seems the battle is coming to an end." Chen Jiu looked into the distance and smiled. "It’ll be hard to have a victor appear between Dong Bo Xue Ying and Lord You Lan."
"What if that Lord You Lan decides to continue slaughtering mortals and threatens the Xia Clan?" the nearby old man with a mountain-goatee asked.
"Rest assured. Lord You Lan has to remain fully focused to defend himself against Dong Bo Xue Ying’s spear techniques; he shouldn’t take a wild risk like that… " Chen Jiu said…
"It shouldn’t distract him that much to slaughter mortals, right?" the old man with a mountain-goatee mumbled.
"Even if he truly does decide to do that, as one of Dong Bo Xue Ying’s comrades, I’ll act. With Dong Bo Xu Ying working alongside me, Lord You Lan’s only option would be to escape in panic. If he doesn’t do so, he’ll definitely die," Chen Jiu said. Previously—before Xue Ying had revealed his secret skill—they could’ve at most attained a draw with You Lan. But now…?
Now that Xue Ying had revealed his secret skill, if he decided to help out Xue Ying, things would be different…
…
Within the Mirage.
Xue Ying gazed at the black-skinned teenager wrapped in white cloth, fully alert. He frowned. "This Lord You Lan is truly too powerful. There aren’t any gaps in the ripples of True Meaning covering his body. Even my previous fantasy domain didn’t let me approach him, despite removing certain parts of the True Meaning! In fact, he’s still emitting ripples of True Meaning, despite my previous domain being removed. He’s preventing my Mirage Avatars from approaching."
He was currently able to control nine Mirage Avatars. During battle, he could completely formulate ten spears to surround and attack the enemy!
The other nine spears were all controlled by the Mirage Avatars!
It was a pity that these Mirage Avatars were too weak. The True Meaning of Mirage was, by nature, weak in terms of offense. The nine Mirage Avatars could barely fight against an ordinary Demigod. Even if this power was channelled through the spear, it would not allow them to get close to Lord You Lan! And they were pointless in terms of ‘confusing’ the enemy! Even if the Mirage Avatars appeared all around Lord You Lan, with a slight ripple of the other party’s True Meaning, they would all turn back to nothingness.
"Other methods are all useless. I have never thought that this ‘Star Meteor Annihilation’ technique of mine, which I comprehended during the past hundred years, could not kill him. It seems that I have to make one last gamble." Xue Ying frowned.
That year when he was inflicted with the hex poison…
He had not perfectly comprehended his True Meanings in a holistic manner; he had only been seeking to perfect his spear techniques, unknowingly fusing the Profound Mysteries of both the True Meaning of Star with the True Meaning of Extreme Piercing. Due to the short lifespan he had left, where he was tortured day and night, Xue Ying did not have any worries and went on about seeking to perfect that spear technique in his heart!
Who cared about Profound Mysteries! The more tremendous his spear techniques, the better his spear techniques would become!
That was how Star Meteor Annihilation gradually came to be!
He had never heard of secret skills; however, this Star Meteor Annihilation had been his greatest achievement during the past hundred years! As his comprehension of the Extreme Piercing and Star deepened, this secret skill of his had similarly strengthened.
"Palace Head Chen!" Xue Ying called out.
His Mirage Avatar transmitted his voice directly into Battleship D9.
"Xue Ying." The Xia Clan Demigods present within the battleship were all feeling extremely excited; the Xia Clan was actually witnessing the emergence of such a powerful Transcendent!
"Palace Head Chen, I’ll be taking on one last gamble, and thus, I sincerely need your help. I’ve heard that an attack previously released by Battleship D9 had almost annihilated Lord You Lan. I wish for you to use that move again… Even though the price might not be small, I think that it is worth it." Xue Ying’s voice resounded throughout Battleship D9.
"It merely costs a single Deity Crystal! That’s about the price of a Deity grade scroll. It’s not much." The Transcendents of Xia Clan became elated.
Back then, they had tore several scrolls for the sake of saving Xue Ying.
A Deity Crystal was something they could afford to use.
Without Xue Ying, even if they spent a few dozen Deity Crystals, they still could not win the battle.
"Alright. You guys just look for an opportunity while I attack Lord You Lan!" Xue Ying glanced at the Stellar Fire Cloud Spear in his hand—the spearhead was currently smeared dark red.
…
Lord You Lan hovered in mid-air, carefully sensing his surroundings. The ripples of his True Meaning were sweeping through his surroundings while reducing the flow of time.
I’ve actually been forced to this stage by Dong Bo Xue Ying. Since you can’t kill me, then I’ll ensure that you regret this. Lord You Lan glanced toward the four teams in the distance. The moment I am on the losing end, those four teams will most likely take action. Despite this, I’ll rather use a Deity grade scroll to ensure the Xia Clan understands the price of offending me!
Vengeance had long been seeped through the bones of Lord You Lan with each step he climbed within the Dark Abyss.
This time, he had brought with him five Deity grade scrolls! The price for bringing them was truly tremendous, and thus, with these five Deity grade scrolls, he had hoped to attain another thirty from the Xia Clan! Consequently, his certainty of crossing through the Crimson Rock Mountain would be much higher.
If I attain some miraculous encounter in the Crimson Rock Mountain, enabling me to condense a grade two Deity Heart and turning me into a Demonic God, I’ll definitely ensure the Xia Clan pays the price! Lord You Lan gritted his teeth.
He had two grade two True Meanings.
They were both at the peak of the stage three realm! Power-wise, he was a level higher than Nuo Nuo An and General Ku Meng. His understanding of the Laws of Profound Mysteries was also much deeper than them. With this gap in both power and the Laws of Profound Mysteries, it was enough for Lord You Lan to attain an absolute suppressive advantage against them—not to mention the addition of two grade two True Meanings.
Hong~
Lord You Lan blocked off more of Xue Ying’s attacks, placing his entire focus into the battle.
Pa!
It suddenly came without warning!
An azure lightning suddenly struck out from the distant Battleship D9. This savage azure serpent flew at an extremely fast speed. Its might was similarly terrifying, so terrifying that the heavens and earth trembled faintly. Everywhere it passed through, space itself had been torn into void, leaving behind pitch-black cracks. Within a moment, it reached Lord You Lan!
"Xia Clan!" Lord You Lan was terrified. Under Xue Ying’s pressure, he had almost forgotten that the attack from Battleship D9 was even more terrifying! This Deity grade battleship, which depended on a Deity Crystal for its power, allowed these Demigods to unleash an attack far stronger than that of a newly ascended Deity.
"Dodge, dodge, dodge!"
Lord You Lan was doing his very best to evade as fast as he could. His demonic body exploded with speed; the True Meaning of Time Deceleration was also being unleashed to reduce the incoming attack of that serpentine azure lightning.
Hua!
The serpentine azure lightning passed through him, extinguishing Lord You Lan’s mirror image.
He reappeared to the side, still hovering in the air.
Too close, too close. Lord You Lan still retained some lingering fear, but there was no time for him to relax.
Pu!
A spear suddenly appeared from the side. The distance was too close, and the speed was too fast! Lord You Lan, who had just used all his strength to evade the serpentine azure lightning, was barely able to send out a palm attack—but it was too late. He had just started waving his palm when the spear pierced through his eyebrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - Escape
chapters.content:
Chapter 297: Escape
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
"What!" The four teams were all shocked at the sight of the battle unfolding before their very eyes. It was too fast! A short while ago, they still thought Xue Ying was unable to handle Lord You Lan, but the situation had changed so quickly! The Xia Clan had decided they would rather pay the hefty price required to have Battleship D9 strike again, and then Xue Ying’s frightening spear attack followed right after. Lord You Lan managed to dodge the first attack, but he failed to avoid the second.
"He won’t die, right?" Everyone stared in rapt attention; Lord You Lan was a Demigod with power comparable to the Deity realm. Could he die just like that?
Inside Battleship D9, the Xia Clan Transcendents watched with trepidation.
…
"No!" Lord You Lan felt waves caused by the Profound Mystery of Destruction blasting through him, wrecking his demonic body in the process. In but an instant, his skull was smashed into oblivion.
Even so, the attack had barely managed to destroy the skull alone; the rest of the black-skinned body below the neck remained in good condition!
What was left of his figure immediately fell back into an explosive retreat!
As he moved backwards, Lord You Lan’s body quickly grew a new skull from the stump of his neck. His demonic body was even more formidable than General Ku Meng’s, and if it were to expand, it would reach upwards a terrifying height of a hundred fifty kilometers! This meant his arm alone could easily reach a length of over five kilometers. By comparison, such a body was genuinely close to that of the great Demonic God!
But his skull was nonetheless completely crushed after a single strike!
With attacks like this, my Demonic Body will be obliterated in less than ten strikes. Having survived the calamity, a wave of dread still lingered in Lord You Lan’s heart. The newly grown head’s face displayed a pale complexion.
He felt it.
Some mysterious sort of poison was spreading rapidly through his body. Not even his fierceful body comparable to that of a Demonic God was capable of hindering the spread of this poison. It pervaded and corroded every part of him, even reaching down to the depths of his Devil Sea, where he cultivated dark magic power. There, the poison continued all the same and even began to affect the revolving of his Devil Sea.
Soon, this poison, which permeated everything down to a fundamental particle level, spread through his brain.
Aaaaaah! A terrible pain overcame him, the sort of which Lord You Lan had never felt before. Throughout his life in the Dark Abyss, he had experienced and fought through countless dangers, yet a pain of this intensity caught even him unprepared.
It was the sort of pain which transcended the physical body, causing even the spirit to tremble.
"AAAAHHH!" In his pain, Lord You Lan bellowed a roar of rage. His complexion was sinister, and he seemed to have turned mad.
"It’s a Hexing Poison, Six Ghosts Resentment!" Lord You Lan’s roar was filled with boundless hatred and killing intent. His voice reverberated throughout the heavens and over the earth.
"What?!"
The four teams, as well as the Xia Clan Transcendents who were watching the battle from within Battleship D9, were shocked at this sight! They had all heard Lord You Lan’s roar of pain and grudging roar and witnessed the pain he felt!
"So it was the Six Ghosts Resentment Poison."
"Yes. He must be Dong Bo Xue Ying then. His body is already inflicted with the hexing poison, so he must have been planning from the start to smear some of it on his weapon to use in the midst of battle. He is certainly vicious."
"I pity Lord You Lan. Being poisoned with the Six Ghosts Resentment? From what I’ve heard, that hexing poison is unbearably painful."
"So ruthless. He really has no mercy."
Every member of the four teams sympathized with Lord You Lan to some degree, due to his strength. He had dared to threaten the Xia Clan with his time-decelerating True Meaning, and he might have even succeeded, had his luck not been so poor. But the Xia Clan sent out Xue Ying, whose incredible talent had sent Lord You Lan into dire straits.
…
In spite of the incomparable pain, Lord You Lan’s heart was calm, for he knew he was in a life-or-death situation!
This Six Ghosts Resentment…is just a diluted version which had accumulated in his blood. It’s already much weaker than the original. It might be a powerful hexing poison, but I can resist it with the regeneration ability of my Demonic Body. The only thing I find rather troublesome is that it’s already entered my internal Devil Sea, which means that I’ll only be able to cultivate with half efficiency now, Lord You Lan determined.
This was normal.
Even the Six Ghosts Resentment Xue Ying was inflicted with was not the true original, but a version with only half the original strength which was carried by the Sorcerer God’s sword.
Back when Xue Ying was first struck by the sword, his body’s recovery ability was sufficient to fight off the damage caused by the poison. The successive strike following that attack was what really caused the end result.
While every part of Xue Ying’s body now contained Six Ghosts Resentment, it was just a diluted version, weaker even that the Sorcerer God’s Sword by a whole level.
After all, it would be impossible that some blood which was afflicted with Six Ghosts Resentment, upon being taken outside the body, would be identical to the original Six Ghosts Resentment. Otherwise, one could simply make an infinite amount of the poison! It was simply not possible.
As such, the hexing poison within Xue Ying’s blood was weaker than the poison coating the Sorcerer God’s Sword by a grade.
After the poison entered his Demonic Body, Lord You Lan was easily able resist its corrosive power. His cultivation speed of Dark Magic Power was affected, but that was the extent of the damage. But the most important thing was…that the poison still caused pain!
This hexing poison is greatly weakened, but it’s still too painful! I don’t have to spare much effort to keep my calm, but at this rate, I might easily get afflicted with more of it as I keep fighting Xue Ying! Lord You Lan’s willpower was strong, but compared to Xue Ying’s, who had suffered every day and night for a hundred years, his was still down a notch.
Thankfully, the hexing poison was just a diluted form, so he could keep fighting.
I have to escape!
I can’t keep going like this; I can’t even hold an absolute focus right now! Suffering from this hellish torment, Lord You Lan’s expression turned fierce. A thought crossed his mind, and he instantly made his decision.
Without even a hint of hesitation in his movements, Lord You Lan summoned a blood-colored scroll in his hand.
Si la~
He tore it apart!
Weng!
A layer of bizarre, red-colored light formed on the surface of his body, spreading until it covered him in its entirety. This was precisely one of the life-saving Deity scrolls he had brought over from the Dark Abyss. Dark Magic power was a refined sort of force—it could be used to battle like a transcendent knight, to cast spells, operate scrolls, and so on.
Transcendent knights by the like of Xue Ying had no way of operating scrolls like these.
"Run!" Lord You Lan immediately transformed into flowing light and began to flee in disarray! He still had not found a way to block Xue Ying’s spear, so he had to rely on the scroll’s power to flee. He didn’t dare taste the flavor of Xue Ying’s spear once more. After all, not only would his injuries worsen with each attack that landed, the poison would also accumulate and increase the pain he had to endure!
He had no intention to accept either of the two results.
…
The actions were slow to describe, but in reality, it only took an instant after Lord You Lan was struck by the spear and felt the frightening poison for him to make his decision, tear the scroll, and flee!
"Trying to flee?" Just how fast was Xue Ying inside the Mirage? Using his Extreme Penetration, he could traverse five hundred kilometers in a moment! No matter how fast Lord You Lan ran, he couldn’t exceed this speed.
Hua.
Lord You Lan flew away with all his might.
His speed was really something to behold, worthy of being compared to a Demonic God’s corporeal body. After his body turned into the golden light which could ignore air resistance, he reached a terrifying speed of five hundred kilometers per second—even faster than the Third Priest of the Demonic God’s Sect when he used the shadow image. After all, Lord You Lan was comparable to a Demonic God not just in terms of his body; even the depths of his laws and Profound Mysteries were close to that of a Demonic God.
But no matter how fast he ran, inside the Mirage, Xue Ying could easily keep up.
"Die." A spear struck from nothingness.
Hong! Lord You Lan kept relying on his speed to flee, and nearly all his attention was focused on his surroundings. In spite of the pain he felt, he kept his head cool and managed to divert all of his might to defend against this attack.
He managed to block the dangerous strike.
Xue Ying was unfazed. He continued chasing and launching attacks.
Over ten seconds and a distance of five thousand kilometers, Lord You Lan kept fleeing while Xue Ying struck time and time again. A total of nine attacks landed on Lord You Lan’s body, but the defensive power provided by the blood-colored light covering it was quite powerful! These nine strikes actually didn’t even manage to shatter it, only dimming it significantly instead, which didn’t surprise Xue Ying.
Back then, he suffered a lot from the attacks launched by the Sorcerer God’s Sword, despite the Profound Mysteries commanded by Great Elder Ao Lan being comparatively weak. But the Sorcerer God’s Sword more than made up with its might. Even after being weakened by the green-armored protector, its strength was still at the level of the Deity realm. Even so, the sword also needed ten strikes to break through the Purple Lightning Shield!
The power of Lord You Lan’s protective scroll shouldn’t be inferior to the Purple Lightning Shield I used in the past and is likely to be even stronger. The power of my strikes should be comparable to the Sorcerer God’s Sword after passing through the Green-Armored Protector, but my Star Meteor Annihilation is more powerful in terms of Profound Mystery, and its destructive power is higher than Greater Ao Lan’s attacks. The light should shatter in three to five strikes, Xue Ying thought.
Si la!
Upon leaving the range of the seal on space, Lord You Lan immediately ripped open a tunnel in space and attempted to flee as fast as possible.
Hong! Xue Ying’s spear appeared out of thin air and struck Lord You Lan while he was still inside the spatial tunnel.
In regards to speed.
The spatial tunnel was reflected identically in the Mirage, so the assault continued!
…
"Follow them!" Wu Ma Hai and the rest of the four teams chased after them in quick succession by following the fluctuations of the spatial tunnel. They were easily able to keep up with the battlers.
"Damn!" The Demigods inside Battleship D9 were unhappy with this outcome.
"Once the Battleship goes into full-speed flight, it can no longer seal space off, nor can it continue to attack." Mountain Lord He’s head began to ache from the feeling of helplessness. This situation was akin to how a mortal would find it nigh impossible to paint a picture while running at full-speed, or how weaker Transcendent mages could not easily clear their minds and use magic properly when running at high speeds. By this same principle, Mountain Lord He’s realm was simply too low—once the battleship began moving at high speeds, he was unable to conduct it to launch attacks.
Only when it stood in place or flew extremely slowly could it seal space or carry out attacks.
"We’ll also follow," Palace Head Chen said.
Mountain Lord He nodded his head. "Good."
As soon as it released the seal on space, Battleship D9 immediately followed the fluctuations of Lord You Lan’s previous space tunnel and chased alongside their direction.
…
His Extreme Penetration allows him to be even faster than me. Flying inside the spatial tunnel, Lord You Lan suffered further attacks from Xue Ying’s spear. He was very aggrieved at the situation, but he knew there was nothing to be done; each True Meaning had its own specialties. Of his two grade two True Meanings, one excelled in offensive power, and the other, Time Deceleration, was of the domain type. Unfortunately, unlike the Meishan Master’s complete True Meaning of Space, Lord You Lan’s Time Deceleration couldn’t penetrate the Mirage…
Not good. I have to switch this shield. Lord You Lan quickly realized that his protective layer of blood-colored light was on its last legs. Damn this pain!
Had he been able to focus completely, he could block these attacks, but the hexing poison was simply too painful!
Not only could he not maintain absolute focus, he could barely even keep himself cool-headed.
"Hm?"
Inside the Mirage, Xue Ying was following closely behind inside the same tunnel in space when he suddenly furrowed his brows. His spatial tunnel leads to Crimson Rock Mountain?
Lord You Lan couldn’t maintain the same speed inside the spatial tunnel because of the obstruction of invisible Laws. This tunnel had already penetrated into the ground and was continuously slanted. According to its direction… it seemed to lead directly towards the location of Crimson Rock Mountain which the Black Wind Ancestor had left behind for Xue Ying on the detailed map.

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - The First View of Crimson Rock Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 298: The First View of Crimson Rock Mountain
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
As Xue Ying continued to dive deeper…
The pressure from the unseen laws hindered him from moving forward, in spite of him being inside the spatial tunnel reflected in the Mirage.
Xue Ying pondered, At this depth of fifteen thousand kilometers, the unseen laws start influencing the Mirage, as well as the way I pierce the way forward. Even so, a hindrance on that level didn’t mean much to him. After all, even powerful Demigods, such as Chao Qing, could rely on their personal strength to reach Crimson Rock Mountain. Xue Ying was presently protected by the True Meaning of Star, leaving him able to easily withstand the binding force.
He kept moving without the slightest break. His Stellar Fire Cloud Spear passed through the Mirage and into the real world, sending attack after attack towards Lord You Lan as he attempted to flee with his life.
Lord You Lan fell into a state of despair, but he still tried his utmost to parry the incoming attacks.
All of a sudden, he left the void tunnel, entering once more into ordinary space.
He was now in what seemed like a world of magma—this whole space was filled to the brim with molten rock. Front, back, left, right, everywhere Xue Ying looked, there was magma, or at least that was what was reflected inside the Mirage from the real world—just thick, viscous, slow moving molten rock on all sides!
Upon entering the magma, Lord You Lan continued flying at top speed.
Shua!
Suddenly, he left disappeared, leaving the area of influence of Xue Ying’s Mirage.
My Mirage is indeed only effective inside a certain range, but even if he were to teleport, he couldn’t have disappeared so quickly. Inside his heart, Xue Ying understood what had happened. This should be Crimson Rock Mountain.
According to the map, the Crimson Rock Mountain was located right before him!
The unique properties of the Crimson Rock Mountain made it so that all forms of observation, outside of using the naked eye, were ineffective! It had been the same when he tried to find the sack left behind by Ancestor Black Wind, but the sack hadn’t been reflected in the Mirage. It seemed as if all Laws of Profound Mysteries simply lost their power.
Xiu.
Xue Ying immediately moved into the real world and then entered the magma-filled space.
"Mn?" Assisted by his True Meaning of Star, he was able to easily traverse the magma. Xue Ying didn’t react when an unseen feeling of oppression began to exert its influence on him. He had long since acquired detailed information on Crimson Rock Mountain from Ancestor Black Wind and knew this force was simply an effect of the Crimson Rock Mountain. He immediately approached the entrance.
"Whoa."
As he closed in, he began to see an area of void before him. This dark void space was easily visible to the naked eye and small in size—about one meter in diameter. It was a truly bizarre sight!
At its center, there was an infinitely small point…so small, in fact, that even the most fundamental particle of a body was bigger than it! That single point was so clear and dazzling, and emitted such pressure on the surroundings, that it formed the void space bordering it.
It was no wonder that Ancestor Black Wind had warned that, should it suffer any change, it could easily destroy the entire Xia Clan World.
This is so bizarre.
As light fell on the surface of that centric point inside the void, it seemed to rapidly increase in size! It grew bigger and bigger, as if some enormous world existed right inside that single point in the center. Before long, that seemingly small point…had deluged Xue Ying’s whole field of vision. It was like a symbol of infinity—a mountain so high that its tip was not even visible to the naked eye. The rocks covering it were all colored a fiery-red, and they seemed to contain a boundless mystical strangeness.
Crimson Rock Mountain truly was unfathomably enormous and seemingly endless.
With a blink of his eyes, Xue Ying turned his vision. He no longer dared to stare in the point’s direction. The very next moment, that boundless mountain which had filled his whole field of view had turned once again into a single small point.
"Lord You Lan." Xue Ying inspected the dark, one-meter-wide area of void, and inside, he saw a tiny person flying at a fast pace toward Crimson Rock Mountain.
This small person was actually only about the size of a single particle! As he neared Crimson Rock Mountain, he became smaller and smaller. Before long, the figure began scaling the mountain.
Following Lord You Lan’s path, Xue Ying’s vision once again reached the direction of Crimson Rock Mountain, which rose to fill his field of vision again—boundless and endless! With the mountain’s increase in size, Lord You Lan had also somehow regained his ordinary shape.
"Truly mysterious," Xue Ying murmured.
Having climbed Crimson Rock Mountain, Lord You Lan turned around to give the outside a look. He seemed to be speaking, but no sound reached outside.
"He has already ascended the Crimson Rock Mountain?" One of the teams—that of the Meishan Clan Master—arrived quickly after, with the other three following behind. Soon, the huge Battleship D9 pushed apart the magma to join them beside the dark void.
"This Crimson Rock Mountain is the inheritance left behind by a powerful World Deity after his death." Chen Jiu came over to Xue Ying’s side and laughed. "Our attacks wouldn’t even be able to pass through the void, much less actually reach the Crimson Rock Mountain. Let’s forget about Lord You Lan. He’ll most likely reach the inner parts of the Crimson Rock Mountain and then begin his adventure."
"Haha, let’s go have a closer look." Jian Huang, the gold-robed teenager, laughed.
"Right now?" Chen Jiu sent him a glance.
"Of course not! That would be way too rushed. We still need some time to finish preparing," Jian Huang replied. They had brought along several treasures for this trip, but they were in parts, so they still needed some time to refine them. As for the reason they did so, it was to reduce the transportation fees.
The Temporal Temple truly was self-centered.
The price required to send over a Demigod sitting at the apex, who could match the might of a Deity like Chen Jiu and Jian Huang, was high enough to send even some of the titanic existences of the Deity world and the Dark Abyss into despair. They weren’t even slightly inclined to send two of such Demigods! Fortunately for that level of transaction, the Temporal Temple had been kind enough to allow them to bring over two comrades as well.
As for the Deity grade scrolls and other medicine pills, they were charged for every single item they wanted to bring, down to the smallest.
Smuggling them in?
Under the thorough investigation of the Temporal Temple, not even the items placed inside storage treasures could avoid detection! In this situation, they prefered to bring over raw materials! In the case of Xue Ying’s Hundred Bitter Restoration, it was simply too hard to brew, so the final product had to be sent over instead.
The red-haired Bo Bo at Wu Ma Hai’s side muttered, "We also need to prepare. We must first confirm the price asked by the Temporal Temple for sending us over. It truly is too high."
This price was calculated through consideration of many aspects.
To send someone into the mortal world was already costly enough! But if one wanted to send someone over to compete for treasures inside the Crimson Rock Mountain…the price would be even higher!
The price would only be paid after various experts of the Temporal Temple agreed upon what would be an accurate assessment of cost!
…
The group of people were chatting amongst themselves as they made their way toward the dark void. Moving closer, Xue Ying found that instead of feeling his body shrink, he instead saw the dark void becoming bigger and bigger before him.
"Woah, this is truly mystical."
"Crimson Rock Mountain is really huge."
The four teams, Xue Ying, Palace Head Chen, and Si Kong Yang, as well as all of the others inside of Battleship D9 closed in. They dared do so only because they knew there were no dangers lurking inside the dark void. The dangers would only begin revealing themselves after they ascended Crimson Rock Mountain.
"It is indeed enormous." They soon reached the boundary of Crimson Rock Mountain. There, Xue Ying took a look upwards.
Towering!
The mountain was so tall that its peak wasn’t even visible! It was just as large at the sides, as it was simply impossible to see where it ended. The oppressive aura it emitted was such that it left even Xue Ying short of breath. This Crimson Rock Mountain was, in one word, big!
"This should be the true size of Crimson Rock Mountain. To us, it might as well be endless," Chen Jiu expounded. "Due to its unique properties, it can occupy a space smaller than a particle. A legend of our Deity world spoke of ‘a leaf being a world,’ and that should be what we’re witnessing here."
"Lord You Lan is going to enter soon," the Meishan Clan Master said.
Xue Ying looked into the distance.
There was a broad stone pathway atop which a fiery airflow occasionally formed, and red-hot flames flared from time to time. The airflow might not prove deadly to some, but if they were to be swept up by the flames, they would undoubtedly perish! No matter their strength, they would die! Even Xue Ying would most probably die from such a flare even when hiding in the Mirage.
The danger posed by Crimson Rock Mountain was simply beyond the realm of imagination. Xue Ying couldn’t just avoid it by hiding inside the Mirage.
Lord You Lan carefully walked along the stone path, using only ginger movements. With how deep and formidable his combat power was, extending his senses gave him the opportunity to evade the moment any red-hot flame came popping up.
About this stone path…
While it was true that one would die as soon as they came into contact with the red flames, the historical Demigods who came adventuring on the mountain would generally not die on this path, as long as they were careful.
Those who took this chance to enter the mountain would certainly receive enough information, so that they would know not to let their guard down.
Hong long~ The end of the stone path was marked by a huge black door, bordered at its edges by golden decorative motifs. As soon as Lord You Lan reached it, the door boomed open. With one final cold glance back at Xue Ying and a sneer, he entered the inner portion of the Crimson Rock Mountain.
Soon after, the huge door closed shut once more with another boom.
Chen Jiu spoke up, "He’s entered. His mission inside is likely to be quite similar to ours, so he should stay inside for at least three years. Dong Bo Xue Ying, for the duration of these three years, there’s no reason to worry about him. Once inside, you will most likely cross paths with him again."
"When do we go in?" Xue Ying questioned.
"Gentlemen, what are your plans?" Chen Jiu asked around.
"I am fine with entering anytime," the Meishan Clan Master answered.
"I need another half month," Wu Ma Hai replied.
"A month for me," said the gold-robed youth, Jiang Huang.
Chen Jiu declared, "Alright then. Let’s set the date at one month from now. In one month, we’ll gather here and enter together."
They didn’t really mind Lord You Lan entering first. In fact, there wasn’t much point to comparing when any individual entered. After all, as long as one was able to brave the risky areas inside the mountain and reach the final destination, they would certainly attain that which they desired!
"Will Lord You Lan suddenly return?" Xue Ying frowned.
Palace Head Chen laughed. "Xue Ying, you can rest easy. For the duration of this one month, Battleship D9 will be stationed here. Our battleship might not necessarily be able to seal the space around the Crimson Rock Mountain, but it can still do so in an area of five thousand kilometers around the dark void surrounding it! The unseen pressure of the laws is very powerful over here, so Lord You Lan would have to spend a very long time to be able to leave here once space is sealed!"
Xue Ying nodded.
On the surface, Lord You Lan’s speed could indeed reach five hundred kilometers per second. But at a depth of fifty thousand kilometers, the oppressive force exerted by the unseen laws would make even flying at fifty kilometers per second an achievement. Traversing a distance of five thousand kilometers at that slow pace would leave Xue Ying with enough time to tear through space and rush over in time.
"Let’s go."
Soon after having one last look at this towering and endless Crimson Rock Mountain, Xue Ying and the other four teams left.
Only Battleship D9 remained behind as sentry.
Palace Head Chen continued discussing with the other Transcendents. "During more ordinary eras, so few members of our Xia Clan would even be aware of Crimson Rock Mountain that you could count them all on your fingers. This era we live in, however, is rather special. Everyone has heard of it, and they’ve even experienced it for themselves. "
…
Hu.
After exiting a tear in space, Xue Ying looked downward toward the White River Town below.
"Mn?" He received a sudden message from Palace Head Chen containing detailed information regarding Crimson Rock Mountain! He hadn’t found time before to send any of it over to Xue Ying, who had first been busy meeting up with Chen Jiu and his Bloodshed Tavern team, a meeting which was soon followed by the wanton slaughter of the Xia Clan perpetrated by the team from the Dark Abyss.
"Alright. At least this issue has been solved for the moment."
He walked on the familiar street of White River Town, toward his Restaurant Dongyu situated in the distance. Watching people enter and leave his restaurant, looking at the hawkers shouting out to sell their goods on the streetsides, Xue Ying couldn’t help but reveal a grin.
Up until just previously, he had been stressed out with fear over whether he could handle the threat of Lord You Lan or not, and over how a catastrophe would befall the Xia Clan world if he couldn’t.
"Boss Dong Bo, come and have a taste! This steamed bun is fresh out the oven," a woman shouted with a smile in an attempt to sell one of her buns. As a resident of many years, she naturally recognized the boss of Restaurant Dongyu.
Xue Ying casually threw over a few copper pieces and then took a bun to eat on the way. It had a truly fragrant aroma.
It was in this manner that Xue Ying enjoyed his walk back toward his Restaurant Dongyu.
Suddenly—
Weng!
The surrounding world turned still. Soon, a terrifying and mystical power descended, a power which Xue Ying was familiar with.
"The Temporal Temple?" Xue Ying had already experienced this sensation once before in the past.

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - Another Invitation from the Temporal Temple
chapters.content:
Chapter 299: Another Invitation from the Temporal Temple
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying watched as everything on the street before him turned still. He was able to sense through the Laws of Profound Mysteries that the time flow in the external world was slowed down to a crawl—time essentially stopped passing! Or rather, it was more accurate to say that the time flow in his region was actually much, much faster than that of the external world.
A powerful voice rang, "Dong Bo Xue Ying." It was a dull sound, as if the speaker was in a much higher position.
"My Temporal Temple is extending another invitation to you," the voice began. "This is the second time, and as per the rules set by my Temporal Temple of each person being given a maximum of two invitations…there will be no third! You could even grasp hold of a grade one True Meaning in the future, but my Temporal Temple would still not offer you a third chance! I suggest you think this over carefully."
While the Bloodshed Tavern belonged to the Bloodshed God Palace, the Temporal Temple belonged to the Temporal Island!
These two organizations were the strongest and biggest superpowers of the Deity World and the Dark Abyss, situated at the very apex of influence. They had deep foundations and could be considered unshakeable by any external factors! While a grade one True Meaning might be able to attract the attention of certain World Deity experts, the Bloodshed God Palace and the Temporal Island both had their own rules and procedures to follow. They wouldn’t be so thick-skinned as to just send out invitations over and over again.
The Temporal Temple was able to extend its influence throughout the countless mortal worlds, the Deity World, and the Dark Abyss, which greatly increased their chances to find genius Transcendents. That also meant, however, that their conditions for accepting them into their ranks were stricter than usual.
The other superpowers were to be pitied, however, since if they wanted to send any treasures to a mortal world, they would have to suffer through the Temporal Temple’s fierce exploitation!
For instance, even the entire resource pool of all of the ancestor Deities of the Xia Clan wouldn’t be enough to send a complete cure for Xue Ying; the price was truly exaggerated. For the moment, Xue Ying did not possess the qualifications necessary to persuade those superpowers into saving him. The Temporal Temple alone had the possibility of moving Xue Ying to the Deity World, where he could be cured at a negligible price.
"If you accept joining us, curing the Six Ghosts Resentment in your body would be a cinch! Once completely recovered, your current comprehension of the realms would allow you to easily get a secondary primordial bloodline awakening to enter the realm of Demigods, and you would also be able to use your Qi one again," the voice explained. "Furthermore, you would become a gold order emissary, as previously mentioned, and receive two Deity weapons well suited to you. Your fortune would be completely transformed! If you refuse the help of my Temporal Temple, I’m afraid you’re simply not qualified to have the other superpowers give you a hand in curing the poison. You’ll have to continue suffering under the torture of the hexing poison, finally gambling your life in the Crimson Rock Mountain just for a chance at life."
"There’s always hope that I’ll manage to cure the poison by going to Crimson Rock Mountain, is there not?" Xue Ying laughed.
"Indeed, there’s hope, but there’s just as much of a chance you’ll die," the voice replied. As a Treasure Spirit of the Temporal Temple, he would never respond with a lie. "I have to let you know, curing the Six Ghosts Resentment is not something your Xia Clan sees as an easy task that can be achieved just by taking a trip to Crimson Rock Mountain. It will be truly difficult to cure the poison, and the mountain itself is incredibly dangerous."
"But there’s still a huge chance of success, right??" Xue Ying retorted.
"Are you ready to reject our offer?" the grand voice questioned back.
"I’m trying to weigh my options carefully at the moment, so I’m asking more questions," Xue Ying continued. "Oh, right. The conditions you’re offering this time around are about the same as the last time, with the exception of those two Deity weapons, correct? That shouldn’t make much of a difference, seeing how I’ve already been able to obtain more than one Deity weapon."
"That’s simply because there aren’t any major differences from the last time we approached you," the voice explained. "Back then, you had only cultivated for a few dozen years including your time as a mortal, and were able to grasp hold of three grade two True Meanings, all of them following different directions. Your comprehension ability is extremely impressive! Had you joined us back then, you would have likely attained a secret skill much faster than you did by yourself! The conditions we may offer are limited and can’t get better than that. Even the Temporal Temple follows some rules."
Xue Ying was contemplating.
"Allow me to remind you that your Xia Clan is on the brink of a huge catastrophe. Not only are your enemies two World Deities, they aren’t your run of the mill Deities, with one of them a Great Demonic God who cultivated to quite a deep level of the realms and the other a lord of a unique material world! Right now, your Xia Clan can only depend on those several ancestor Deities for help, and none of them are even World Deities. It’s quite clear your foundation doesn’t compare with theirs.
"As soon as they put their plans in motion, there’s a 99% chance you’ll be defeated, with your whole clan facing extinction!"
The more Xue Ying heard, the more his pupils contracted.
"The only reason they’re being so careful, outside of being on guard against your Xia Clan, is that they’re mindful of the Temple of the Earth God. But I can tell you that, as long as they paid the right price, the Temple of the Earth God would easily give up on their believers in this mortal world," the powerful voice continued. "If you were to join our Temporal Temple, you could turn your hometown into your resting area, where you can return after finishing your missions! Furthermore, you could also purchase a huge amount of treasures within the Temporal Temple, which you could then bring back to your hometown. By doing so, you wouldn’t have to pay any price. Your ancestors, on the other hand, can only send treasures over at a great cost!
"Considering your innate talent and combat power, in addition to the grooming abilities of my Temporal Temple, you would probably send over many more treasures than your ancestor Deities combined have ever sent!
"Not only that, your combat power will also quickly increase! By the time the war even begins…you will have become a huge boon to your Xia Clan.
"Alright, take your time to consider it."
The treasure spirit of the Temporal Temple hadn’t spent any time researching Xue Ying in particular, but with his ability, he could easily understand Xue Ying’s state of mind and send the invitation according to his personality.
Xue Ying nodded but didn’t hide his frown. "Have I heard correctly that as soon as I join the Temporal Temple, it will be very hard to me to regain my freedom, and that even my soul will be controlled?"
"The Temporal Temple would be sending you to various locations, and very fast at that, so there will naturally be some degree of control involved. However, everything is governed by certain rules! Had my Temporal Temple simply acted as they wished, the Temporal Island would not have become such an incredible superpower in the Deity world and the Dark Abyss," the voice relayed. "As a gold order emissary, you would naturally be quite free. Once you become a World Deity, you would get an even bigger degree of freedom. By then, you could simply ignore these restrictions."
He was once again disregarded…
The control on his soul was a certainty.
Even so, everyone would still be under some degree of control! As his combat power rose, the restrictions would become weaker and weaker. Xue Ying found that joining the Temporal Temple would fit him quite well at that moment!
After all, the threat brought about by the Sorcerer God and the Great Demonic God was too big!
It had yet to surface, but once it did…would they really be able to repel it?
At the small price of some of his freedom, as well as the danger of those missions, he could trade for a great amount of resources which might give the Xia Clan a chance at becoming the victor of the incoming war. It was worth the price.
"Once I join the Temporal Temple, must I begin going on missions right away without break?" Xue Ying asked.
The voice replied, "Indeed, during these early periods of your cultivation, we can’t go easy with training you."
"What I’m afraid of is that the Sorcerer God and the Great Demonic God might trigger the war while I’m on one of my missions," Xue Ying explained. This was a true possibility. He was the strongest member of the Xia Clan, and he would certainly become even stronger with time. The two Deities were not idiots; they would certainly choose a moment when he wasn’t in the Xia Clan World to being the war.
"Which is why I have a request. I would like for the Temporal Temple to keep watch over the Xia Clan World, and inform me as soon as the war erupts. At that point, I would have to stop doing my mission and return back home! As for the mission, I could just complete it some other time," Xue Ying finished.
"There’s no problem with stopping the mission, as it is one of the privileges of gold order emissaries, but I couldn’t possibly keep watch over the Xia Clan world," the powerful voice replied. "I am in charge of moving thousands of Reincarnators, so I must scout the many worlds out there. It’s impossible for me to keep watch over a single world."
Xue Ying was startled.
"You must also understand this—the Temporal Temple is only inviting you as part of an order given by my master; you’re not qualified to ask us to do anything. Even World Deities are existences I can afford to ignore. I only follow the orders of my master. As such, once you join us, you’ll only have the privileges any ordinary gold order emissary has as you go on missions. You will not receive any more than that."
Xue Ying was enlightened. Indeed, he was just a minor character. The treasure spirit of the Temporal Temple didn’t have to fulfil his requests, and the invitation was just part of the rules.
"Then, may I exchange the Deity weapons which I would receive for certain treasures which I can leave behind in the clan, whose activation by my clansmen I will be able to sense when completing my mission?"
"Your combat power is, indeed, quite high, so you will almost certainly be sent on missions in the Dark Abyss and the Deity world. The distance between them and your mortal world is simply too large, and the material world would block off your senses; you couldn’t even maintain a Qi avatar. You’re also not yet a Deity, so it is impossible for you to sense the world by using a treasure. However, with a good enough performance, you might be able to exchange for certain precious avatar cultivation techniques."
"Avatar?" Xue Ying asked.
"World Deities, as well as other various experts of that level, all have several avatars made with a technique which Demigods are also able to cultivate. You could exchange for the manual within the Temporal Temple," the voice clarified. "At that point, you could leave your true body behind in your hometown while sending your avatar on missions."
Xue Ying asked, "Exchange for it at what price? How many ordinary Deity weapons is it the equivalent of?"
"A hundred of them," the voice answered.
"So expensive?" Xue Ying was stunned.
"It’s rare even for Deities to have avatars, much less Demigods, so avatar cultivation techniques are truly precious. This can even be considered a low price. In the Deity world, you might not even be able to get such a technique with over a thousand Deity weapons. The price we’re giving you is a privilege of a gold order emissary," the voice continued. There was another side of this deal which he did not reveal to Xue Ying, however, and that was that even if he did attain the cultivation method, he would still need many other treasures on top of it. But as Xue Ying didn’t ask, he wouldn’t tell him of his own accord. After all, his purpose was to ensure Xue Ying joined them.
Xue Ying frowned. He was not pleased with the deal.
He was fine with joining the Temporal Temple, but the problem of him doing missions while the war erupted still stood. If the war ended before he had the chance to return, would there even be any point in him joining them?
"If I can’t help the Xia Clan, is there even any sense in joining the Temporal Temple?" Xue Ying shook his head.
The voice tried to persuade him, "You can exchange for certain treasures to help the clan."
Xue Ying shook his head once more.
Treasures?
Treasures needed someone to use them. Hadn’t the Xia Clan just earlier been under huge pressure because of Lord You Lan? Xue Ying’s combat power was now comparable to his, and would only rise in the future! His abilities would certainly be of greater help in the war than a few treasures.
"If you can’t ensure I will be present when the war begins against my Xia Clan, and that I would be immediately able to join them, I will have to decline the invitation," Xue Ying began. "I would rather risk my life in the Crimson Rock Mountain. There’s hope within it that I’ll be able to cure my poison and attain treasures, while also retaining my freedom."
"There’s also the chance you’ll die inside."
"Being alive makes no difference if it means I can’t even join my Xia Clan in the war."
"Keep in mind that the Temporal Temple will not give you a third chance! Once you decline, it will mean that the temple will never invite you again."
"Then I’ll have to see that I have no fate with your Temporal Temple!"
"Alright."
That mystical, boundless wave of force rapidly retreated, leaving the Xia Clan world and returning the time flow in the region to its original speed.
The hawkers on the sides of the street continued their shouts, and the voices and laughter of the people could be heard again.
Xue Ying looked up at the sky. He felt a bright light fill his heart; this was his path, and he would walk it to the end! He would go to Crimson Rock Mountain and carve himself a future—everything now depended on that spear in his hand!

chapters.title: Chapter 300 - Departure
chapters.content:
Chapter 300: Departure
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
Behind Restaurant Dongyu, in the backyard of the residence, there was a garden. Within the garden, there was a pavilion where Xue Ying was currently sitting beside Jing Qiu as they enjoy warm fruit wine together.
A red robed-teenager greeted respectfully, "Teacher." It was Ye Qing.
"Ye Qing." Looking towards this disciple he was most fond of during the last hundred years of teaching, Xue Ying couldn’t help but reveal a grin. "I’ll be leaving White River Town with my wife. This restaurant now belongs to you. Whatever you do with it, whether you decide to sell it or keep it, is all up to you."
That Scarlet Flame Knight, the Sand Tiger of White River Town, was now treating Ye Qing with great care, and seeing how formidable Ye Qing’s combat power already was, he would certainly step into the Legend realm sooner or later. Managing a restaurant was but a minor matter to him in this situation.
"Teacher and teacher’s wife will be leaving?" Ye Qing hurriedly asked.
Ye Qing had no father as he grew up, while his mother was like a broken thread who cared not whether he lived or died. It was only now, with Ye Qing’s combat power becoming stronger, that his mother opened her eyes at the sight of money and came over to coax her son, though their relationship remained as distant as ever.
Regardless of his real family, Ye Qing had a very deep affection for his teacher and his teacher’s wife and saw them as his real parents.
And the Restaurant Dongyu…had become his own home!
"There is a very important matter I must attend to," Xue Ying began. "There is not much I have to leave behind for you which I don’t think you could attain with your own combat power. Which is why I’ll hand over this flask of fruit wine to you. Remember, you may only drink two sips of it per day." With those words, he waved his hand to send a copper-colored flask flying towards Ye Qing.
"I’ve taught you all I could, but cultivation is ultimately something where you must rely solely on yourself," Xue Ying explained. "Move according to what your heart and soul dictate! Don’t let external matters confuse or influence you!"
"Yes, teacher." Ye Qing held onto that copper flask; his eyes were starting to get red.
"Little Ye, remember to cultivate well. Don’t let your teacher down." Jing Qiu was also entrusting a task to him.
The two of them—husband and wife—had watched Ye Qing grow ever since he a sickly eleven-year-old child who looked more like a seven- or eight-year-old boy. Back then, he was guileless and left up to fate’s devices.
"Then when will I be able to see teacher and teacher’s wife again?" Ye Qing asked.
"We can meet once you’ve become a Transcendent." Xue Ying laughed, but Jing Qiu sent her husband a meaningful look. She understood that, this time around, it was hard to say whether Xue Ying would return from Crimson Rock Mountain with his life. "If there are any problems, you can seek the Dragon Mountain Manor. They can find a way to contact us immediately."
"Yes." Ye Qing nodded.
He had to…he had to become a Transcendent no matter what. He didn’t want to disappoint his teacher.
"Let’s go." Jing Qiu and Xue Ying stood up and then began to fly into the sky. They tore apart space and left through the tear.
Ye Qing looked up at this scene. "Teacher, teacher’s wife, we’ll definitely meet again in the future."
******
Tranquil Sun Province, Azure River County, Water Rites Town, Snowrock Castle.
Snowrock Castle had presently turned into the ancestral home of the Dong Bo Clan, where only those of the clan’s direct bloodline lived. The defense provided by arrays was also at a different level compared to what it was before, and many more refined organisms guarded the region. There were even Deity warriors protecting the perimeter. The current defenses of this area had become truly terrifying, even approaching the standards of the Water Daoist Faction and the Black White Deity Mountain.
Of course, this was also due to the Water Daoist Faction as well as the other factions not really spending too much on defenses, seeing as how they had already been forced to give up on those places multiple times in the past.
"Great uncle!"
"Great grandfather!"
"Ancestor!"
There were many descendants of the clan living inside Snowrock Castle, which made Xue Ying feel awkward whenever he returned and was faced with the scene.
These descendants all originated from the line of his little brother, Qing Shi. A year after Xue Ying married, his brother had also found a wife for himself. Quickly after the ceremony, he broke through to become a Transcendent and began having children. These delightful moments were truly piling up! Back then, the entire Snowrock Castle was truly happy for Qing Shi who ended up having three children—two sons and a daughter. However, all of those children of his were quite ordinary in terms of cultivation. In spite of the help provided by the Dong Bo Clan while they were still young, which helped them all reach the Star realm, none of them had been able to break through to become a Legend expert!
Eventually, however, those children grew up to have their own children, and they became more and more numerous.
This was especially the case with Qing Shi’s second son, Dong Bo Feng, who was essentially a flower prince who spread his love all over the place. Sixty children were discovered to be his progeny, and there was a high chance of many more being yet to be found. While the Dong Bo Clan had a way to appraise the bloodlines of people, they did not know who those illegitimate children might even be, so it was impossible to test them.
Qing Shi had been truly angry upon noticing that.
He had a single wife to his name, and his big brother whom he greatly idolized, Xue Ying, was also loyal in love…
Why did he have to give birth to such a flower prince?
Meanwhile, the oldest ancestor of the clan and Xue Ying’s father, Dong Bo Lie, was actually quite happy about this matter. He felt that this descendant of his had allowed the Dong Bo Clan to truly start branching out and grow leaves, which made him truly happy. He thus decided to protect Dong Bo Feng!
As a result—
A hundred years down the road, the number people belonging to the direct line of descent started growing, while those who were allowed entrance to the ancestral home were all quite outstanding.
"What are you thinking about?" Jing Qiu looked towards Xue Ying.
Xue Ying took a quick glance at the group of teenagers in the distance, all part of the Dong Bo Clan, and laughed. He turned to speak to Jing Qiu. "Jing Qiu, wait until I get back from Crimson Rock Mountain and get cured of the Six Ghosts Resentment. I want us to have our own children."
"Mn." Jing Qiu blushed ever so slightly. "So old and yet so shameless…speaking of this in public."
"Haha, what about me is old and shameless? I should be considered quite young among Transcendents, right?" Xue Ying laughed and joked about. His mood now that he arrived at Snowrock Castle was quite good. This was where he grew up, and the architecture of the Castle remained just as he remembered it, bringing many of his memories to surface. Over time, many of the people he was familiar with were no longer around.
The servants he was most familiar with and whom he grew up with, Mage Bai Yuan and Uncle Tong, were also not around anymore.
But many more descendants were born and were growing up.
"It’s close to a month since I’ve returned to Snowrock Castle," said Xue Ying. "I will leave tomorrow."
"Do be more careful inside Crimson Rock Mountain," Jing Qiu reminded him.
"Relax, I’ll certainly survive and come back," Xue Ying reassured her.
…
The next day, after bidding farewell to his Qing Shi and his parents, Xue Ying left together with Jing Qiu.
He did not tell them about Crimson Rock Mountain, which was still a secret despite those on Battleship D9 becoming aware of it—all of them were ordered to continue keeping it a secret.
"Xue Ying, do try to come back more often. You always leave and only return many years later." Mo Yang Yu reminded him. Her current temperament was quite extraordinary.
"Rest assured, mother." Xue Ying laughed.
Hu.
Xue Ying took Jing Qiu along into the sky, and they both disappeared.
Mo Yang Yu, Dong Bo Lie, and Xue Ying’s brother, Qing Shi, didn’t pay this matter any more attention. The way they saw it, this was just one of Xue Ying’s visits back home.
******
The couple first went to the Xia Capital of the Infernal World, where they greeted the true body of Palace Head Chen inside.
"Palace Head Chen." Xue Ying passed him a ring. "These are some of the treasures I’ve attained after killing Nuo Nuo An and General Ku Meng. Inside, there are two Deity weapons, though they likely possess some restrictions set by the Great Demonic God. As for the other treasures, I’ve taken some which seemed useful to leave behind for my clan."
"These are originally your spoils of war." Palace Head Chen didn’t decline the offer, taking the rings from Xue Ying.
Indeed, the Deity weapons could not be used for the moment.
But once a Deity emerged from the Xia Clan, they would be able to use Deity energy to forcibly refine the weapons! While Deity warriors had command seals which were necessary for controlling them and could not be refined without attaining them, Deity weapons were different! They did not have anything like the command seals of the warriors, so it was possible to use Deity energy to slowly erase any restrictions left behind on the weapons. Once the restrictions were gone, the Deity weapons would be usable again!
Naturally, the time it took to refine those sorts of weapons depended on how formidable the original restrictions were. Some might take a thousand years, while others might even have to be refined over ten thousand years!
If they didn’t manage refining them within ten thousand years, the Xia Clan Deity could then bring the weapon along to the Deity world—as long as it originated from the Dark Abyss.
If the weapon belonged to a Deity from the Deity world, they would be able to sense its presence and kill a path to the user!
Of course, the more common case was these Deities leaving behind the acquired weapons within their hometown and waiting for another Deity to emerge and continue slowly refining it. If one wasn’t enough, they could always wait for another.
"I’ve attained seven Deity warriors inside the Black Wind Deity Palace," Xue Ying began. "The gold man was forcibly taken away by the Beast Clan when I was surrounded, though, so I now only have six! I have ordered them to return to the Infernal Palace and forever protect the Xia Clan once I, Jing Qiu, and Qing Shi are no longer around. The weaker ones will remain in my clan to forever protect it."
"Thank you." Palace Head Chen did not speak too much.
Of the seven, he only held in his regards the three most powerful of the Deity warriors! All three had reached the peak of the Demigod realm, but with the gold man having been taken away, only two remained.
According to the previous practices the Xia Clan had, they would usually exchange these for goods of an equal value.
But Xue Ying had contributed too much to the Xia Clan! Palace Head could only keep all of these actions in his heart, and when the time came to write Xue Ying’s dossier, he would make sure to record all of his achievements.
