"I originally planned to not take the green-armored protector with me inside Crimson Rock Mountain," Xue Ying added, "but another invitation from the Temporal Temple caused me to change my mind and decide to bring him along after all."
"Another invitation from Temporal Temple?" Palace Head Chen asked in shock. "Then, why did you reject it?"
Xue Ying explained what happened previously.
Palace Head Chen understood as well.
"Ai, won’t your hexing poison be cured the moment you accept their invitation?" Palace Head Chen shook his head.
Xue Ying likewise shook his head. "But the Sorcerer God and the Great Demonic God will definitely look for the moment when I’m outside the Xia Clan world on a mission to begin the war. There’s no point in discussing this further, seeing how I’ve already rejected the invitation."
"A 99% chance of defeat, and we’ll face extinction?" A feeling of anxiety overcame Palace Head Chen. "For the Temporal Temple to have said this…what exactly is this plan the Sorcerer God and the Great Demonic God have drawn to have such a high chance of success?"
Xue Ying nodded. "I’m feeling quite anxious as well. As for the green-armored protector; whether he’d be there or not would not make much of a difference for the Xia Clan. But to me, since I don’t have any Qi and can’t properly use a Demigod robe, the protector would be of much greater help, which is why I’ve decided to bring him along. I’ll certainly do my best on this trip. I’ll get the poison cured and undoubtedly return alive!"
This point of curing his poison was of great importance. After all, returning alive would not mean much if the poison remained inside him. The Sorcerer God and the Great Demonic God could just delay the war until Xue Ying’s poison relapsed and then trigger the war.
"I’ll have to trouble you again, Senior Green Armor," Xue Ying said.
"Contributing to the Xia Clan is the why I exist," a voice coming from his green-gray wristband said.
…
Xue Ying brought his wife along as he left the Infernal Palace. Soon, they had torn through space to reach the underground area some five thousand kilometers deep. The pressure emitted by the unseen laws at such a depth was not something Jing Qiu could withstand alone.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying." The three people from the Bloodshed Tavern team had already arrived.
"Brother Chen Jiu," Xue Ying greeted. The silvery-white robe which covered Jing Qiu was none other than a transformed Deity warrior in the form of a protective layer of silvery-white material.
"The only ones missing are the members of Jian Huang’s team, and we’re already prompted them to come," Chen Jiu explained. "We depart as soon as they get here. Brother, this should be your wife, right? Truly beautiful; your eyesight must be truly good to have found such a beautiful partner."
Xue Ying exchanged a glance with Jing Qiu.
"Jing Qiu, take a look. That’s Crimson Rock Mountain." Xue Ying pointed to that tiny, meter-long area of dark void. "It is that single point at the very center."
Seeing it, Jing Qiu muttered, "So mystical."
The two of them chatted amongst themselves for a while, until an undulation in space reached them; the final team arrived at last.
"Aiya, I’m truly ashamed to have made everyone wait for us," the gold-robed teenager, Jian Huang, said. He had brought a tall, muscular man, and an enchanting woman along.
"Ladies and gentlemen." The golden-armored teenager Wu Ma Hai’s eyes were cold; he was currently revealing his capability. "It is now time for us to set off."
With those words, he entered the dark void along with the red-haired Bo Bo and the thin man by the name of Ba Han.
"Let’s go." The Meishan Clan Master’s was the next to set off.
The golden-armored teengager, Jiang Hu, and his team also entered, as well as Chen Jiu and his team who were next.
"I’ll be leaving now." Xue Ying sent Jing Qiu, who was beside him, a big smile and then flew into the dark void.
These thirteen figures were the only ones visible as they flew towards the dark void. Approaching Crimson Rock Mountain, they became smaller and smaller, as if turning into particles.
"You must return safely." The silvery-white robed Jing Qiu watched as Xue Ying left her; her eyes were filled with longing and worry.
She was afraid…afraid that this might truly be their last farewell.
"Rest assured. Xue Ying will certainly return." Chi Qiu Bai, Palace Head Chen’s Magic Avatar, Mountain Lord He, Si Kong Yang, and the Grand Elder Palace Head were all watching from a distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 301 - What is a Lord?
chapters.content:
Chapter 301: What is a Lord?
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
Chen Jiu, the old man with a mountain-goatee, the bald-headed old man wearing yellow robes, and Xue Ying all flew together towards the Crimson Rock Mountain.
"Xue Ying, from this point forward, we’ll be brothers in arms. You probably don’t even know the names of Uncle Fu and Old Thief right here, am I correct?" Chen Jiu laughed. "Haha, I’ll introduce you to them first. Old Thief over here is also known as Chen Gu. Meanwhile, Uncle Fu’s actual name is Chen Fu."
Chen Gu, the old man with the mountain-goatee, laughed. "You can just call me Old Thief in the future."
"Greetings, brother Dong Bo Xue Ying. You can just call me Chen Fu." The bald old man with yellow robes wore a lopsided grin. "I’ll be troubling you for assistance once we enter Crimson Rock Mountain."
Xue Ying replied, "Chen Fu, Old Thief, we live together and die together. Let us help one another when we can."
Chen Jiu, Chen Gu, Chen Fu…were they from the same clan?
Xue Ying found this interesting to note.
Chen Jiu smiled. "They are both people of my manor, where I grew up since I was young. Naturally, we all share the same clan name of ‘Chen.’"
"I truly admire your manor to have had so many experts emerge from it," Xue Ying praised. "There are truly too few experts in my entire Xia Clan."
"That’s not exactly it," Chen Jiu began as they flew along. "The material world is quite different from the Deity world, in that it is much easier to become Transcendent in the Deity world. That’s why there are many more experts within."
"Our Flying Sword Mountain Manor is quite famous even in the Deity world. Several hundred of our members are Demigods, and two are even Deities. In truth, the Manor Master didn’t have to personally come here and risk his life." Chen Gu shook his head.
Xue Ying was flabbergasted at the thought of that.
Several hundred Demigods? Two Deities? Chen Jiu was also the Manor Master?
"Our Flying Sword Mountain Manor is currently facing a huge threat, and it might be annihilated in a single day and night. Because of that, I decided to seek the support of a powerful World Deity and willingly take such a huge risk for his sake." Chen Jiu shook his head. "Indeed, compared to a mortal world, the Deity world is countless times bigger, but…even my Flying Sword Mountain Manor could simply end up being annihilated if certain people were to covet it. I only came here and accepted to risk my life because that powerful World Deity promised to ensure the protection of my manor for a period of ten thousand years! If I’m to succeed on this mission, things will naturally be quite different. I can’t help but accept this gamble."
Xue Ying commented, "It’s indeed a tough situation."
"Truthfully, the trouble your Xia Clan is facing is even worse than ours. A powerful Great Demonic God, as well as a Lord of a material world?" Chen Jiu shook his head.
"The Lord of a material world? What does that signify?" Xue Ying asked in confusion.
As they traversed the dark void, they adopted a relatively slow pace of flight. They were not in any particular rush, especially considering this was Xue Ying’s team. This was the first time they they actually got to talk. Naturally, they were left behind by the others.
Chen Jiu was aware of this position but made no comment on it. "Transcendents of mortal worlds who become Deities may have several breakthroughs before reaching an age of ten thousand years! If one reaches the peak stage of the Deity realm, they’ll be able to refine the mortal world’s World Core! If an expert manages to refine it before being forced to leave the world, that entire world will become their territory! At that point, the expert may live forever in that mortal world, and they would be referred to as its Lord—the Lord of a material world!"
"Refining a mortal world? Becoming a peak stage Deity within ten thousand years and successfully refining the World Core?" Xue Ying clarified his doubts. "Is it that formidable and special to be considered the Lord of a material world?"
Of the many ancestors of the Xia Clan who entered the Deity world, only three were successful in reaching the peak stage of the Deity realm! Not only that, all of those three were only able to do so after entering the Deity world and having some fortuitous encounters.
"Very formidable!"
Chen Jiu continued his explanation, "All those who are able to achieve such things within ten thousand years are truly unfathomable characters. Considering their comprehension abilities, they are all certain to reach the World Deity realm after going to the Deity world! The Sorcerer God might still be young, but he’s already a magnificent existence who reached the World Deity realm! You must understand…to compare a World Deity to an ordinary Deity is like comparing a Transcendent to a mortal."
Xue Ying lightly nodded.
"Once an experts becomes a Lord, their next step is attaining a avatar cultivation technique! By then, they could cultivate an avatar to send on adventures in the Deity world while the true body remained safely in their hometown." Chen Jiu sighed. "Doing this, the expert can assure his absolute safety! Not even those powerful existences in the Deity world may forcibly descend into the material world. As such, being the Lord of a material world…essentially means that one cannot die! Even if the avatar adventuring in the outside world were to perish, the expert could simply cultivate another to replace it, while their true body remains safe from harm.
"As a result—
"These material world Lords usually have a special status in the Deity world. After all, even if you manage to ‘kill’ them, all you’d really accomplish is to destroy their avatar, which is also why these lords would usually be more fearless when they went about their business," Chen Jiu said. "Of course, the mortal world would get older and older and eventually reach the end of its life cycle, something which the Lord would try to delay as much as possible. When that happens, the Lord himself would be no longer be immune to death.
"And the Sorcerer God is precisely one of such Lords!" Chen Jiu finished.
Xue Ying felt his heart getting heavy.
"The countless mortal worlds are what make up the material world, and the laws of the entire material world create an incredibly powerful force of repulsion! Although many powerful existences of the Deity world are proficient in their control of space, this force of repulsion makes it nigh impossible for them to send Transcendents into the material world," Chen Jiu clarified. "The Temporal Temple alone is able to send Transcendents into mortal worlds, and even then, they can only transfer Transcendents below the Deity level! It is fundamentally impossible even for them to send a Deity to the material world!
"Who could possibly kill a World Deity located in a mortal world completely refined by him?" Chen Jiu continued. "The Sorcerer God can be considered essentially invincible. Considering that an existence of his level dared plan such a war…it’s quite certain there will be devastating consequences."
Xue Ying lightly nodded.
Chen Jiu also treated Xue Ying as his life and death comrade, which was why he shared these things with him.
It’s a pity. Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
While many Deities had emerged from the Xia Clan over the years, it was simply too difficult to reach the peak stage of the Deity realm and then refine the World Core in just ten thousand years. None of them had managed to achieve such a feat.
If someone had accomplished such a thing, the Xia Clan would have truly been fortified. In such a state, what superpower would even be qualified to plot against them?
…
Chatting the entire way, Chen Jiu, his two servants, and Xue Ying finally reached the boundary of Crimson Rock Mountain.
Xue Ying first looked up to see the towering Crimson Rock Mountain before him, its peak not even visible, and then turned around to look at the woman in the distance wearing silver-white robes—Xue Ying’s wife! Together with her were Palace Head Chen, Chi Qiu Bai, Si Kong Yang, Mountain Lord He, City Lady Bu, and other Demigods standing by.
"I’ll certainly return," Xue Ying said to himself and promptly turned around.
"Let’s enter."
Xue Ying’s team was the very last to enter of the four. They took their first steps on the stone path up Crimson Rock Mountain, gingerly moving forward. Crimson Rock Mountain was presently emitting intense heat from its whole surface, while red-hot waves formed every now and then as well as those terrifying bouts of flame! Those flames would always spurt through the chinks between the mountain rocks, however, so they could be seen in advance.
As long as they were careful and remained alert, observing the surroundings for any scars, it was essentially impossible for them to be so unlucky as to be affected.
Not too long passed before Chen Jiu, Xue Ying, and the other two finally reached the end of the stone path.
A huge black door bounded at the sides by mysterious golden seals currently stood before them. Once more, the door boomed open. Inside were the three teams which had long since entered.
"Let’s go inside." Xue Ying no longer looked back as he passed through the black door along with the others.
Hong long long~
The black door closed once again.
…
"We’re in."
After passing through the door, the booming sound of it shutting behind them sounded out.
Xue Ying, Chen Jiu and the other two looked forward to see Wu Ma Hai’s team, the Meishan Clan Master’s team, and the golden-robed teenager Jian Huang’s team all currently standing still by the side.
Looking further forward…there was a vast island, and beyond it still was an endless starry sky!
The sky was bright, with the countless stars that filled it blinking, moving, and constantly changing their trajectories.

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - Floating Sky Island
chapters.content:
Chapter 302: Floating Sky Island
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
The sight of the vast starry sky beyond the island, especially those countless stars always changing trajectories, mesmerized Xue Ying to the point of dizziness.
Only after he immediately closed his eyes did that spell of dizziness disappear.
"Truly frightening." Xue Ying gasped. "The intelligence report was exactly right."
Chen Jiu began explaining, "It was the master of Crimson Rock Mountain who changed the heavens and the earth to create this starry sky. From what I’ve heard, this nightscape was created with the help of extremely deep Laws of Profound Mysteries, so deep that even World Deities do not understand them, much less us. We won’t gain anything by forcing ourselves to stare at it, and it might even harm us. Even so, we might as well take a glance at it now before we start climbing the mountain. We won’t get another chance to see the this scene once we begin."
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
This area next to the big door was the starting point and was an absolutely safe location.
The moment they stepped away from this region, they would find themselves on a hostile island brimming with danger! It would be no place to relax. In that sort of situation, wouldn’t they be simply seeking death if they decided to take a look out at the starry sky and make themselves dizzy?
"This Floating Sky Island is truly beautiful." Xue Ying smiled in appreciation.
The decorations spread over the island were truly exquisite: the small bridges over the flowing rivers, the stone path, the forest and the mountain ranges…there were even the occasional buildings of various types and colors.
Stone sculptures lay scattered around in various spots around the island! Some of them were large while some were small, but the majority were around the height of an ordinary person. Most were human-shaped, and a small portion of them depicted beasts. Of the countless statues, some were faulty, covered in scratches; the sculptor was quite clearly not a grandmaster.
"Very beautiful," Chen Jiu praised. "I’ve heard before that, long ago, the master of Crimson Rock Mountain—that incredibly powerful existence of the Deity world—had lived here for a time, right on this Floating Sky Island! Those buildings were made for him to reside in! From here, he operated the starry sky, changing the heavens and the earth while working on comprehending the laws and cultivating. Apparently, a long time ago, every single cup or table found in those buildings was potentially a treasure! Those Demigods who entered Crimson Rock Mountain in the period after it first fell had actually gained a lot from the buildings! By now, though…hehe, those structures have long since been swept clean."
Xue Ying laughed. He was thinking back to the sack which Ancestor Black Wind left behind.
In order for one to see it, they had to look at it with the naked eye. Any other form of observation was useless; even the Mirage could not reflect it! That was mostly likely a common item used by powerful existences of the Deity world.
"No wonder it’s so masterfully crafted," Xue Ying commented.
"In spite of its beauty…it hides countless dangers in its midst," Chen Gu, the old man with the goatee, muttered. His eyes wandered to those stone sculptures scattered practically everywhere on the island. "That powerful expert from the Deity world is really bad at sculpting. Why would he even bother making so many of these…"
Xue Ying laughed.
On the Floating Sky Island…
The most dangerous objects were these stone sculptures! Every last sculpture had the combat power of an Era Suppressor. Not only that, there were more than ten thousand such stone sculptures on the entire island, and they were all ‘of one heart!’ The moment one of them discovered a Transcendent, every other sculpture would also become aware of them and immediately rush over to suppress them! Fortunately, the island was large enough, and the sculptures were relatively slow, which gave the Transcendent at least a chance of survival.
Otherwise, instead of one out of ten making it out alive…it would have been ten out of ten who died!
After all, each sculpture had the combat power of an Era Suppressor. Not even Xue Ying or Chen Jiu could survive being surrounded and attacked by as many as a hundred of them.
These statues were also known as the ‘Stone Sculpture Protectors.’
Chen Jiu stepped in again. "These sculptures were crafted by that powerful existence from the Deity world; they’re truly mystical. Through their direct vision, these Stone Sculpture Protectors can see through any sort of concealment or disguise! However, as long as we don’t enter their field of view, we’re completely safe. Old Thief, Uncle Fu, remember to stick to the shadows. If we’re to be discovered by those sculptures, we have to immediately switch to speed and get away as quickly as possible. Keep in mind: you cannot fight against them, since you’d be doomed the moment they surround you."
"Understood." Old Thief and Uncle Fu nodded.
"As for other dangers on the Floating Sky Island, the two of you should be able to handle them with a little caution. It’s just the Stone Sculpture Protectors that we have to be aware of. Xue Ying, you should also be cautious. Even if your combat power is quite formidable, upon getting trapped by these sculptures, more and more of them will come to surround us, and that would simply spell doom for us. Don’t think you can just hide in the Mirage—the Stone Sculpture Protectors are very unique in that no form of hiding techniques can be used against them," Chen Jiu reminded.
"Understood." Xue Ying nodded.
"You’re in a much better position than us." Chen Jiu gazed into the distance. "As long as you get through the Floating Sky Island and cross the Meteor Bridge, you should be able to find a cure for your Six Ghosts Resentment hexing poison."
"Mn."
Xue Ying also turned to look into the distance.
Countless meteors could be seen floating at the end of the island, each of them linked to the others, thus forming a passage toward someplace deep in the starry sky. It was those countless meteors connecting with one another…that made up the Meteor Bridge!
At the end of this bridge was a long, jade-green vine extended all the way across the starry sky. It had grown all the way to the highest point in the starry sky and was surrounded by many gigantic leaves, each one bigger than a star.
"Our intelligence reports say that, as long as I get through the Floating Sky Island and reach the end of the Meteor Bridge, I’ll be able to request a treasure I seek," Xue Ying said. "I hope I’ll be able to acquire some medicine to cure my poison there."
The Floating Sky Island and the Meteor Bridge…
Those were the paths which many Demigods had to go through after entering this place.
Ancestor Black Wind as well as many outsiders had crossed these paths over the years, yet they would cause about nine out of ten Era Suppressors to perish.
"In my case, however, I have to cross the Sky-Reaching Vine and continue even further upwards," Chen Jiu said, with a subtle shake of his head. "I have to pass the Sky-Reaching Vine and reach an even higher level while keeping myself alive; that’s where the treasure sought after by that powerful World Deity is located."
"To pass the Sky-Reaching Vine?" Xue Ying also gently shook his head. "You’ll face more than any normal amount of danger."
"Nine die, yet one lives. It’s nothing but a gamble with your life!" Chen Jiu replied.
The path through the Crimson Rock Mountain was split into two sections.
The first consisted of the Floating Sky Island and the Meteor Bridge. Successfully getting through them would allow one to request and attain a certain treasure.
The second section went along the Sky-Reaching Vine toward the space of a higher level. It was there that those treasures sought after by World Deities existed.
"Crimson Rock Mountain is essentially a proving ground which the expert from the Deity world used to select his disciples. Despite that, rewards would be given out for anyone who could get through the first section, while those who passed the second section would be even better recompensed! That’s exactly why even those who had no hopes of becoming the disciples of that powerful Deity would still try their luck inside Crimson Rock Mountain."
"A trial for selecting disciples?" Xue Ying shook his head and laughed.
He was aware of his own capabilities.
His primary objective on this trip was to find a cure for his hexing poison, while keeping himself alive! He was certainly not arrogant enough to gamble his life for the chance of getting a bit further. After all, it was very important for the Xia Clan that he kept his life.
Furthermore, his current comprehension of the realms wasn’t deep enough yet. In the future, after he reached the peak stage three realm for all three of his grade two True Meanings, or perhaps even the Deity Heart realm, as well as with the help of his secret skill, the combat power he could unleash would be even more formidable. At that point, he would be in no rush to become a Deity, and he would be in a much safer spot to try his luck here again.
Even if such a heaven-defying Transcendent was willing to come down, those formidable World Deities would simply not be able to afford the price! If even sending Demigods of Chen Jiu’s level already left them with their hearts aching and unwilling to send another, how could they afford to send someone stronger than him?
…
The atmosphere around the four teams was solemn. Their goal was, of course, to get through the Sky-Reaching vine and reach the higher-levelled space.
Even with a mortality rate of 90%, they still had to take this gamble!
They thus decided to be more cautious in the early phases, which would ensure that more of their team members could stay alive until later. It was only in this way that they could hope to reach a bit further.
"I have to get through the Sky-Reaching Vine and enter the higher-levelled space." The Meishan Clan Master’s eyes emitted a faint light. It was for the sake of this very day that he chose to go through three hell-ranked missions, leave the control of the Temporal Temple, and come to the Xia Clan world!
"The higher-levelled space…" Chen Jiu also sent a look towards the enormous Sky-Reaching Vine that split the starry sky in two. His eyes were filled with killing intent. "I have to return alive; I will ensure the prosperity of my Flying Sword Cloud Manor and exterminate all enemies!"
"The extinction of a certain clan… I, Wu Ma Hai, have long since looked forward to that day. Even if only one out of ten can come back alive, as long as I’ll be that one, I’ll be able to change everything." Wu Ma Hai clenched both his fists so hard that black cracks appeared at their center.
Jian Huang casually said, "This is our chance to get out of this impasse. So what if only one out of ten gets out alive? Haven’t we already gotten through two of the hell ranked missions?" Yet the tall and thin man as well as the enchanting woman wore serious expressions. It was for the sake of this gamble that they had come all the way to this point.
Xue Ying was also expectant.
The pressure on him was lighter. As long as he could cure the poison, he would be successful in his venture.
His only other hope was that he could attain treasures from the mountain which could grant the Xia Clan a greater chance of victory in the upcoming war.
"Everyone, those Stone Sculpture Protectors are extremely dangerous. We’d be doomed the very moment we get surrounded. I therefore think that it would be better for us to operate in smaller groups," Wu Ma Hai said. "Let’s maintain a distance of more than five thousand kilometers between each group. We’ll be the first to leave!"
He didn’t even finish speaking when he took Bo Bo and Ba Han along and left the safety region around the black door. They began walking along the seemingly beautiful stone path before heading deep into the forest.

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - One Dead
chapters.content:
Chapter 303: One Dead
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
Wu Ma Hai disappeared into the forest. About the time it took to brew a cup of tea later, the faint sound of roaring resounded.
"They’ve been discovered." The Meishan Clan Master lifted his eyebrows.
Jian Huang laughed lightly. "There are countless dangers other than those Stone Sculpture Protectors that make it essentially impossible to just get through stealthily."
The Meishan Clan Master nodded as he casually replied, "We’ll be next to enter." Skipping pleasantries, he took off along with the white-robed young woman as well as the man dressed in black robes.
"They didn’t even ask for our opinions." To the side, Jian Huang looked towards where Xue Ying, Chen Jiu, and the others were all waiting. "Chen Jiu, Xue Ying, do you want to set off first, or should we go next?"
Chen Jiu exchanged a glance with Xue Ying.
"We are not in a hurry." Chen Jiu answered.
"Alright. We’ll be third to go then," Jian Huang replied, setting off before long.
Chen Jiu was a patient man, and Xue Ying wasn’t in any hurry either.
The sounds of fighting could be heard coming from different regions on the island; clearly, the battles had already begun.
"It’s about time for us to set off as well." Chen Jiu chuckled. "With those four teams having gone ahead, the pressure on us will be a bit lighter. Still, we can’t be too careless, or we might just end up buried on this island."
"I understand. Don’t worry, I’ll be right behind you." Saying this, Xue Ying disappeared into the Mirage.
Old Thief and Uncle Fu exchanged a glance.
The Floating Sky Island was relatively dangerous to them.
"Let’s go."
Chen Jiu, Old Thief, Uncle Fu, and Xue Ying, who was inside the Mirage, all began this trial of the Floating Sky Island.
******
Within the Mirage.
Xue Ying advanced quietly. He could see reflected in the Mirage anything happening in a range of five thousand kilometers around his position. Not only that, his nine Mirage Avatars allowed him to maintain an overview of the entire zone from a higher vantage point. Quite clearly, even an area as large as five thousand kilometers…was well within this observation radius.
A single glance filled Xue Ying’s with sorrow as he let out a sigh.
Wu Ma Hai’s team was rushing at the forefront. The huge distance to their location made it so he couldn’t see them very clearly, but the team seemed rather stealthy and didn’t arouse much activity outside the occasional battle.
Jian Huang’s team, though, had already surpassed the Meishan Clan Master’s team, taking over the second position. This team was more overbearing in their behaviour. Be it the Stone Sculpture Protectors or other enemies, the golden-robed Jian Huang would rush over even a thousand kilometers in advance and attack them! He put those Stone Sculpture Protectors in a tough position, as they couldn’t even see who they was attacking them.
Through using this tactic, the golden-robed Jian Huang’s team had advanced the fastest.
In the third place was still the Meishan Clan Master’s team, which was actually the most mysterious of them!
As they proceeded, space itself was changing and distorting. At times, they would be further ahead, only to then reappear further back! Despite Crimson Rock Mountain’s seal on space making them unable to teleport, the Meishan Clan Master’s team was truly formidable in terms of their comprehension of Space. They proceeded without facing any enemies.
Hua! A stone sculpture from the distance turned abruptly; its eyes glowed a dim golden light which seemed able to see through anything.
Xue Ying’s Mirage had even been seen through!
The Mirage wasn’t like the distortion of space used by the Meishan Clan Master’s team, which allowed them to distort the vision of the stone sculptures who looked their way! Naturally, the Meishan Clan Master’s team was essentially invisible to them!
Their control of space is truly frightening. Xue Ying was inwardly startled. To be considered a commander of a team really means you have to be extraordinary.
"Xue Ying."
A sound forcibly made its way into the Mirage. "Remember, neither your Mirage Avatars nor Old Thief’s Illusion Avatar can be used casually. If you absolutely must use them, try to be as stealthy as possible. If we’re discovered and those sculptures think there are ten people here, they might send even more Stone Sculptures Protectors rushing over to surround us."
"I understand," Xue Ying transmitted back. He was simultaneously shocked at the realization that, if Chen Jiu was able to transmit sound inside the Mirage, he was likely to also have a way to send attacks inside.
Xue Ying’s team carefully proceeded forward.
As they got closer to Meteor Bridge, more and more of those dangerous Stone Sculpture Protectors would show up, especially so for a large region just before the bridge of which more than half was covered in these sculptures. This was exactly the reason why Wu Ma Hai’s team had only begun fighting after the time it took to brew a cup of tea. Of course, this also meant that the other regions had fewer Stone Sculpture Protectors.
Crossing an arch bridge, walking along a stone path next to a river…it was quite clear that Xue Ying and the rest of the team were very cautiously moving ahead.
Kong~
All of a sudden, an enormous azure head shot out from the river. It had a bald horn, and its mouth was ferocious and filled with ivory teeth. Azure scales covered the creature’s body. As soon as it appeared, it charged out from the river.
Danger had struck so abruptly…
Chen Jiu looked towards the side.
Hong! An illusory golden dragon appeared in mid-air. Its upper-body was congealed, while its back was completely illusory. It immediately waved its sharp claws, striking the azure beast with tyrannical force. With a booming sound, the strange azure beast was slapped back into the river it came from before it was even able to completely leave.
"Let’s get away from here. If we get tangled up in this location, those sculptures will surely be attracted over," Chen Jiu’s voice simultaneously sounded out in the ears of Uncle Fu and Old Thief and within Xue Ying’s Mirage.
Xiu!
They were truly fast; within moments, they had crossed a few dozen kilometers along the path and entered the depths of the mountains. That strange beast tried to search for the team but didn’t find the slightest trace. In its rage, it let out a roar.
The previous battle had attracted the attention of the stone sculpture protectors who rushed over to this region.
…
Chen Jiu’s combat power really was very high. He could attack from many thousands of kilometers away from his target, and each of his strikes summoned an illusory dragon!
Even a stone sculpture protector would be forced backwards a few hundred somersaults by a single claw strike of the dragon.
This also let Xue Ying feel relatively more relaxed as they proceeded on.
Having strength really made a huge difference.
When it came to simple Era Suppressors, nine out of ten would perish on the Floating Sky Island, but the chances of survival for people like Chen Jiu, the Meishan Clan Master, and Wu Ma Hai was much higher.
"We’re nearing the most dangerous area surrounding the Meteor Bridge. There should be up to tens of thousands of sculptures gathered around there! It would be truly difficult to just kill a path through them," Chen Jiu transmitted to the others. "We don’t have the qualification to relax until we cross that area!"
"Mn."
Xue Ying could certainly see the end of the Floating Sky Island through his Mirage Avatar, which was still watching from above. Indeed, the end was marked by the head of the Meteor Bridge.
That region was filled to the brim; at least fifty thousand stone sculpture protectors situated no more than five kilometers apart from one another! These five hundred kilometers leading to the Meteor Bridge were clogged. It was truly hard to kill a way through them!
"Wu Ma Hai’s team has started rushing forward." Xue Ying watched as Wu Ma Hai’s team rapidly neared the entrance…
Hong!
It was the start of a lofty battle!
Wu Ma Hai’s team suddenly unleashed a dazzling golden light and the speed of each member sharply increased. Within two seconds, they had already crossed the remaining five hundred kilometers or so of the final region. They had been under the assault of countless frenzied Stone Sculpture Protectors along the way, but those two seconds was all it took to force a path onto the Meteor Bridge.
"Bo Bo of Wu Ma Hai’s team has died!" Chen Jiu’s voice sounded in the Mirage.
"Bo Bo’s dead?" Xue Ying was startled.
He didn’t suspect the accuracy of this report, however, since he was aware that the four teams had left avatars behind in the Xia Clan world. That way, they could rapidly transmit relevant information. They were afraid they might be forced apart inside the Crimson Rock Mountain, but this method provided them with a better way to keep in contact at all times. Xue Ying’s lack of Qi made it impossible for him to leave behind a Qi Avatar in the Xia Clan world.
When Bo Bo died, his Qi Avatar had naturally dispersed. That is how the other teams became immediately aware of his death.
"Xue Ying, your Mirage Avatar should have allowed you to stealthily observe the battle from a distance. How did Wu Ma Hai and his team get through the final part?" Chen Jiu asked in a transmission.
"They relied solely on speed to charge through," Xue Ying transmitted back.

chapters.title: Chapter 304 - True Meaning of Only Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 304: True Meaning of Only Me
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
"They are actually so reckless? He did not lie at all." Chen Jiu frowned. He wanted to learn from the previous few teams as they tried passing through the last stage so as to improve the chances his team had in getting through it.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, tell me in detail how he got through it," Chen Jiu inquired.
Xue Ying acknowledged him with an explanation.
Only with his Mirage Avatar would he be so reckless in observing the others. If it was anyone else, how would they possibly be able to observe what was happening? They would easily be discovered by the Stone Sculpture Protectors.
Xue Ying’s Mirage Avatar had many different transformations and could even turn into part of the Mirage! It was the Mirage, and thus, when the Stone Sculpture Protectors looked up, even if they could see through the Mirage, they would only feel that the Mirage Avatar was merely part of the Mirage and nothing more. Thus, as long as the Mirage Avatar did not move, the protectors would essentially not sense him at all.
…
Seconds passed by slowly.
Xue Ying’s team also proceeded cautiously. Along the way, there was no need for Xue Ying to act at all; they relied solely on Chen Jiu releasing an illusory dragon to attack from a distance, eliminating every single danger that was ahead.
"Jian Huang’s team has started moving." Xue Ying carefully proceeded, his Mirage Avatar observing what happened from afar.
Hong!
The distance was too far, and he could only vaguely see what was happening. That team’s speed also suddenly exploded out. With the densely-located Stone Sculpture Protectors surging up violently forward, several Stone Sculpture Protectors even started flying and attacking from the sky; for a moment, all of them started charging from all over toward that team.
A strange-looking Dragon Turtle illusion appeared, protecting the entire team.
But within a few seconds, it was unable to withstand any further damage.
Under the frenzied attack by the dense crowd of Stone Sculpture Protectors, the Dragon Turtle illusion had crumbled apart almost instantaneously.
Following that, a dazzling sword light could be seen. It was so bright that within moments, the Stone Sculpture Protectors were either falling to the ground, falling backwards, or clashing against other Stone Sculpture Protectors. Regardless, there were many more Stone Sculpture Protectors attacking them in frenzy.
"Truly too many." Xue Ying shook his head,
The entire process took approximately five seconds.
Jian Huang’s team had also finally reached the Meteor Bridge. The moment they reached that enormous floating meteor, the Stone Sculpture Protectors would no longer attack them anymore.
******
In the Xia Clan world, on a piece of grassland.
There were currently many figures either seated cross-legged on the ground or on rocks or walking about. They were none other than the Qi or Magic Avatars comprising of the four teams, with some even having Demonic Energy within.
"Sister Xue Wei!" The golden-robed teenager Jian Huang was seated on a piece of big rock. It was originally very calm, but suddenly, his expression had a huge change as it was filled with disbelief and terror.
"Xue Wei!" The tall and big hunk by his side was also trembling.
"How could it, how could it be…" The golden-robed teenager Jian Huang collapsed to his knees, unable to bear the shock; his entire body was trembling too. "Why, just a little more and I could have saved you, but why…?"
Ever since they had been captured by the Temporal Temple and became Reincarnators…
Jian Huang was originally the weakest amongst the team. The enchanting woman, Big Sister Xue Wei who had just died moments ago, was a legend. It was she who favored Jian Huang, absorbing him into her team! She had also taken care of him. The two was as close as brother and sister and had a deep relationship. Jian Huang was someone who had been grabbed as a mortal; he improved since then to nearly be a Deity.
"Team Commander." The tall and big hunk was also in despair. He lightly patted Jian Huang’s shoulder.
"Why, why must it be like this? I was too arrogant and proud and shouldn’t have promised to enter Crimson Rock Mountain." Jian Huang was full of loathing. Even though he was mentally prepared for the entire team to be wiped, coming here to take on a gamble with their lives, the moment Sister Xue Wei, who had been through life and death with him, died in front of him, he couldn’t bear it.
Dying within Crimson Rock Mountain meant that even the Temporal Temple could not take away the soul of that person—that person would die permanently!
"You shouldn’t take the blame. No one is to blame; this has been agreed upon by all of us prior to coming. If you want to blame someone, you should blame the Temporal Temple." The tall and big hunk said in a grave tone, "It’s them who forced us to walk by the boundary of death time and again. If not for their direction and coercion, which team would ever be willing to enter such a predicament? In the end, we chose to come to Crimson Rock Mountain."
The golden-robed teenager Jian Huang stood up. Ultimately, he had experienced too many eternal partings and was currently forcing back his agony.
"Wu Huang." The golden-robed teenager Jian Huang looked toward the nearby Meishan Clan Master. "I truly admire you for you to dare take three consecutive hell-rank missions to finally rid yourself of the control of the Temporal Temple, regaining your own freedom."
"Let’s look forward to the future." The Meishan Clan Master looked toward Jian Huang, who stood before him silently.
…
Wu Ma Hai’s team lost Bo Bo. Jian Huang’s team lost the enchantress Xue Wei. This made the two other teams even more anxious.
Clearly, from what had happened, the usual Deity grade scrolls were quite limited in aiding them, especially those defense-related ones; they were futile in the current situation. As it had to protect the entire time, it could not withstand the all-around attacks by the densely-crowding Stone Sculpture Protectors for such a long period of time. Unless they were willing to use more than ten scrolls, they could not force their way through.
To rush through…
One way was to rely on power, and the other way was to depend on luck! If they could sneak through the gaps in between the Stone Sculpture Protectors’ surround attack within a short period of time, it would be enough for them to get through this stage. If they could not get through? Then the team was doomed.
The more people in the team, the bigger the target. Conversely, it made charging through the gap even harder.
But as each team had people like Chen Jiu, Jian Huang, Wu Ma Hai, and the Meishan Clan Master, their comrades were willing to advance together.
"The Meishan Clan Master and his team are beginning to move."
Xue Ying was observing from the side, describing the situation to Chen Jiu.
As they proceeded forward, Xue Ying’s distance was quite close to that of Meishan Clan Master’s team—within the five thousand kilometers range of influence! He was able to clearly see what was happening through the Mirage.
"I’ve discovered them too." Chen Jiu borrowed his own True Meaning domain region to scout out what was happening with the battle.
"This!"
Xue Ying was suddenly startled.
The Meishan Clan Master’s team’s method of getting through was something that had startled Xue Ying, regardless of it happening after seeing the other two previous team’s methods.
His two arms lengthened—reaching about six meters long—and rapidly attacked every single incoming Stone Sculpture Protectors! Furthermore, the surrounding space was like a swamp, causing the speed of the incoming Stone Sculpture Protectors to become slower the closer they approached them. For a moment, the Meishan Clan Master had actually depended on solely his strength to obstruct the entire group of Stone Sculpture Protectors jointly attacking them!
Of course, the surrounding area could only be so big, and the Stone Sculpture Protectors were of the same height as ordinary humans, ensuring that only a few hundred Stone Sculpture Protectors could attack them at any one time!
But with the protectors attacking from all directions, a single pair of arms was not enough to block them all.
The Meishan Clan Master’s body was full of weapons-his head, his back, his legs… they were all being used to attack! And every single part of his body was truly tyrannical.
"The True Meaning of Only Me! And he also has a Deity armor?" Chen Jiu’s voice transmitted into the Mirage.
"The True Meaning of Only Me?" Xue Ying was similarly shocked.
Amongst the grade two True Meanings…
The True Meaning of Only Me was purely a fleshy body-related True Meaning! It did not have any offensive Profound Mysteries inherently within, and neither did it contain other sort of Profound Mysteries; instead, it did one single thing… It unleashed the fleshy body’s fullest potential! The True Meaning of Only Me recognized the body as the heaven, earth, and cosmos; it contained all sorts of inexhaustible Profound Mysteries. One did not have to care about other external objects and only needed to comprehend one’s own body, allowing one to similarly be able to become a Deity and be unparalleled.
That was the meaning behind Only Me!
Thus, those who had the True Meaning of Only Me would have a fleshy body that was truly tyrannical! For instance, his body was so much more terrifying than the demonic body of Lord You Lan and General Ku Meng’s demonic body.
It was purely an extreme fleshy body-related True Meaning!
"Only Me seeks perfection inwardly. Space seeks perfection externally! One within and one outside…this Meishan Clan master is truly formidable. And he has somehow obtain a Deity armor as well?" Chen Jiu transmitted over his astonishment.
Xue Ying was similarly startled too.
He understood…
Ever since Crimson Rock Mountain landed on the Xia Clan world, the price for Deities to send a Deity armor down into this world had rapidly increased! Those magnificent existences did not have an easy time sending Wu Ma Hai, Lord You Lan, and Chen Jiu. To send a Deity armor was similar to sending a Demigod at the level of Chen Jiu—they would certainly not be so willing to do so!
And within Crimson Rock Mountain, the Deity armor was advantageous in facing against any direct attacks. But should the attacks come from behind, there would be many ways those attacks could transmit through the Deity armor!
"I’ve heard that the Meishan Clan Master has long arrived on the Xia Clan world." Chen Jiu commented, "Thus, there’s no need to pay the price of sending him down. Ultimately, the Deity armor has a limited effect when met with certain unique attacks and would usually not be worth sending it down. But the Meishan Clan Master has the True Meaning of Only Me, and his body is originally very tyrannical. Adding on a Deity armor would make it extremely difficult for others to kill him. With the True Meaning of Space, his survivability is probably the strongest amongst all of us."
Xue Ying agreed with that.
…
Under the head-on protection by the Meishan Clan Master, the entire team made it onto the Meteor Bridge. It was also the only team with all members surviving.
"It’s our turn now." Soon after, Chen Jiu, Old Thief, Uncle Fu and Xue Ying began moving closer to the bridge.
There were tens of thousands of Stone Sculpture Protectors, filling every single direction.
There was practically no gap for them to tunnel through.
Xue Ying and the others had long discussed and agreed upon a plan.
"Mn?" Amongst the five hundred kilometers range that was filled densely with Stone Sculpture Protectors, they all suddenly turned toward a single direction—a similar amount of Transcendents were currently killing their way in. There were Mountain Lord He, Faction Head Si Kong Yang, Chi Qiu Bai, Elder Ao Lan, Demonic Faction’s three High Priests, Monarch Qing Yan, City Lady Bu, Xue Ying…and many other Transcendents.
Xue Ying’s nine Mirage Avatars had transformed into nine Demigods he recognized and were all walking within the Mirage. Naturally, they would be discovered by the Stone Sculpture Protectors too! That was because the Mirage Avatar’s bodies had long since coagulated into figures.
And Old Thief was even more formidable. He could use the Deity Heart condensed from the True Meaning of Illusion—which specialized in creating illusions—and had created a total of thirty-six Illusion Avatars! Every single one of them was at the peak stage Demigod realm and was at about the combat power Ghost Deity Knight Feng Dong had. Each and every one of them was unique, emitting unique auras as well. Most likely, these were Demigods that Old Thief himself had recognized.
"My Flying Sword Cloud Manor’s Demigods have arrived!"
The huge group of Demigods had suddenly charged toward the Stone Sculpture Protectors! But at this moment, Chen Jiu, Xue Ying, and the others were starting to get nervous for whether they lived or die depended on this short five hundred kilometers of distance! One had to know that even if the other teams’ methods were formidable, other than the Meishan Clan Master’s team, the other teams had similarly lost a single comrade.

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - Stepping onto the Meteorite Bridge
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: Stepping onto the Meteorite Bridge
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
Dong Bo Xue Ying looked at the vast stretch of numerous Stone Sculpture Protectors ahead. A lot of of them abruptly shot up, making the earth tremble, and began to surround them, covering the earth and sky. The pupils of every single stone sculpture protector glowed with golden light as they looked coldly upon the outsiders.
Xue Ying was also flying at high speeds within the mirage. His Extreme Penetration had reached the peak stage two realm, and his flight speed was even a bit faster than Uncle Fu and Old Thief, but of course, it was slower than Chen Jiu by a large margin. The entire team approached the crowd of Stone Sculpture Protectors with a speed of two-hundred-fifty kilometers per second, while the Stone Sculpture Protectors met them with a speed of fifty kilometers per second.
As for the Mirage Avatars and Illusion Avatars, they could go as fast as one wanted, and they easily kept up.
Hong~~~~
In the instant the forces of both sides collided—
Xue Ying immediately returned from within the Mirage, looked at the Stone Sculpture Protectors with golden eyes, and immediately used the True Meaning of Star’s gravitational domain.
Hong long long~~~ A terrifying repulsive force, with Xue Ying at the center, immediately spread out in all four directions! Under the control of Xue Ying, the gravitational domain’s Laws and Profound Mysteries opened up a path for their troops.
Immediately, the besiegement of the stone protector sculptures that had covered the earth and sky was entirely repelled by the crazily fierce gravitational force! Every one of them was obstructed, their speed slowing by a grade.
"Ha ha, Dong Bo, that’s not bad." Chen Jiu loudly laughed at the sight.
As the True Meaning of Star was a grade two True Meaning, even though it was a supplementary gravitational domain, compared to the pure grade three True Meaning of Gravity, it was more complete. At the moment, the gravitational domain’s might was equivalent to the stage three realm of the True Meaning of Gravity! What a pity, the height of these stone sculptures was only as high as an ordinary person. Their weight wasn’t too significant, so the effects of the repulsion force weren’t too ridiculous.
But even slowing them down by a grade was already pretty good.
"Outsiders, kill!"
"Kill!"
The Stone Sculpture Protectors covered the earth and sky to besiege all the outsiders, and the Mirage Avatars and Illusion Avatars were intentionally luring and leading on enemies. It let the attacks suffered by Xue Ying and his team be as reduced as possible
But Xue Ying, Chen Jiu, and the others hadn’t displayed too much strength. As for the gravitational domain…it was only at the level of a grade three True Meaning’s stage three realm. This kind of technique was unremarkable.
In fact, if a large group of people charged forward together, they’d suffer an attack from a large amount of Stone Sculpture Protectors; normally, the casualties would be disastrous. It wasn’t worth it.
But the Mirage Avatars and Illusion Avatars were purposefully luring the enemy; that was different.
Peng peng peng ! ! !
Under the attack of countless Stone Sculpture Protectors, the Mirage Avatars were smashed into pieces, but they reformed right after. One could see Si Kong Yang, Palace Head Chen, Ao Lan Great Elder, Chi Qiu Ba,i and the others all being crushed to death onto to revive immediately after. The Stone Sculpture Protectors even thought that these enemies had an extraordinary life-saving method, but after extinguishing them two to three times, they gradually realized.
After all, not only the Mirage Avatars, but also the group of Illusion Avatars revived after being beaten to death!
If it was merely one, it could be explained that they had some sort of heaven-defying life-saving True Meaning. But an entire group would be abnormal.
"Those guys are phantom avatars." The Stone Sculpture Protectors began to realize the deception and started to attack the enemies that hadn’t died, and naturally charging toward Xue Ying, Chen Jiu, and the others.
But by the time they had realized and charged over…
Xue Ying and the others had already charged a distance of two-hundred-fifty kilometers and were only about two-hundred-fifty to three-hundred kilometers from the Meteor Bridge.
"They only just realized? Ha ha ha, get lost!" Chen Jiu let out a loud bellow and instantly materialized eight arms. Upon every arm was a layer of grey metal. His arms grew dramatically, up to about seven or eight meters, and immediately attacked in every direction. His palm practically shielded the entire team.
The eight arms used all kinds of powerful attacks.
Savage ruthlessness, dark ferociousness, enigmatic mysteries …All kinds of attacks allowed Xue Ying to broaden his horizons.
He can actually materialize eight arms, only having true meaning really is extraordinary. Xue Ying inwardly exclaimed in admiration. When he had laid down plans with Chen Jiu earlier to charge through Floating Sky Island, they had talked together, and he had learned each member’s True Meanings and techniques.
He had also told Chen Jiu that he had the three grade two True Meanings— of Extreme Penetration, Mirage, and Star—and the technique Star Meteor Annihilation. From Chen Jiu, Dong Bo Xue Ying knew that Star Meteor Annihilation counted as a ‘secret skill’
Chen Jiu had also told his Old Thief and Fu Shu’s techniques as well as his own.
The two True Meanings that Chen Jiu had grasped were also very formidable.
Separately, they were the True Meaning of Only Me as well as the True Meaning of Eight Dragons.
The True Meaning of Only Me pursued the peak of the body. In order to complement the True Meaning of Eight Dragons, he had gone to the Deity world to purchase an eight-armed creature, so he could dissect and study it again and again. He even looked for similar cultivation methods to ponder over, until finally his own body could form eight arms! One should know that these arms couldn’t exhibit power just by forming them.
To transform? For a Transcendent, there were a countless number of transformations, even transforming a thousand hands was but a trivial matter.
But normally only one’s regular body could bring out the most perfect strength, so to form eight arms that were genuinely useful and could exhibit sufficiently strong strength was a very difficult thing to do. Thankfully, he had comprehended the True Meaning of Only Me and had dissected an eight-armed creature for research. With all these accumulated efforts, he succeeded.
He had eight arms.
It suited the True Meaning of Eight Dragons. The two True Meanings that Chen Jiu used almost perfectly complemented each other. His close combat ability was extremely terrifying and was above Lord You Lan and the Meishan Clan Master!
Of course, the Meishan Clan Master and Lord You Lan each had their strengths! Chen Jiu was merely strong at close combat.
Hong hong hong. With his spear, Dong Bo Xue Ying displayed his Star Meteor Annihilation.
Each movement surged with power.
For the Stone Sculpture Protectors, a single touch sent them flying. A scrape made them collapse! Chen Jiu’s eight arms stunned enemies in all directions, and to the side, Xue Ying covered any gaps with his spear! He also had the gravity domain’s repulsion. In an instant, Xue Ying and Chen Jiu practically blocked all the Stone Sculpture Protectors.
But even though he had eight arms, there were more Stone Sculpture Protectors. In an instant, a hundred Stone Sculpture Protectors arrived and began fervidly attacking.
Si la.
The claw of one of the Stone Sculpture Protectors penetrated Old Thief’s chest, but although Chen Jiu was nearby, he did not help him.
"Ha ha ha, that’s useless." The mountain-goateed old man’s body dissipated, and the appearance of an Illusion Avatar not far away changed, becoming the mountain-goateed old man.
Shua shua shua!
His body changed erratically. Every single Illusion Avatar could become his true body at any time! The Stone Sculpture Avatars were completely unable to attack him.
So strong, Xue Ying silently exclaimed.
After the True Meaning of Illusions condensed into a Deity Heart, it had a heaven-defying ability.
The true body could switch between the Illusion Avatars! Although, the distance between the Illusion Avatar and the true body had to be within a hundred meters. Even if space was sealed, he could transfer all the same. Because his realm of comprehension reached this extent, his true body already began to ‘become an illusion;’ he could make the Illusion Avatars condense into his true body at any time.
Thus, as he had this trick, trying to kill Old Thief would be very difficult.
Unfortunately, the only weakness was that it must be within hundred meters! As long as the enemies attack covered a hundred meters, the Old Thief would still die. Yet if he had just switched to another Illusion Avatar which was killed at the same time, he would still die. Normally it wouldn’t happen so coincidentally; after all, he had thirty-six Illusion Avatars.
…
Chen Jiu’s eight grey metal arms swept across in all directions. Xue Ying was also helping in warding off the attacks.
The two diverted attention to protect Uncle Fu.
In this way—
They simply rushed through the last five to six hundred meters!
Hong!
Xue Ying landed on a floating gigantic meteorite. It was called a meteorite, but it actually had a diameter of over a hundred meters. Its entire body was a single gigantic stone, and the surface of the meteorite had some veined patterns.
After landing on the meteorite, Xue Ying relaxed.
On top of this gigantic meteor, the three other teams—comprised of Wu Ma Hai, Jian Huang, the Meishan Clan Master, and the others—rested. They weren’t in a hurry to move, and they looked toward Xue Ying, Chen Jiu, and their team with surprise
This team’s total strength was the strongest.
Chen Jiu’s strength was even higher than they had thought! The Bloodshed Tavern’s high-leveled candidates were really extraordinary!

chapters.title: Chapter 306 - Deity World Organism
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: Deity World Organism
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
The four teams were all located upon the very first meteorite on the long Meteor Bridge.
"Cultivating eight arms along with the True Meaning of Only Me is something I have to admire you for," the Meishan Clan Master praised him. Of the two True Meanings he grasped hold of, one of them was the True Meaning of Only Me, so he clearly understood the difficulty in forming eight arms.
"If we were to say who would have the greatest certainty in getting through the Sky-Reaching Vine amongst us, I would have to say that it is you, Meishan Clan Master," Chen Jiu said.
"Sky-Reaching Vine? Just based on this Deity armor of mine?"
The Meishan Clan Master looked toward that enormous Sky-Reaching Vine that practically stretched across the entire starry sky, starting from the end of the entire Meteor Bridge. "The Sky-Reaching Vine is also one of the most terrifying plants in the Deity world, with most magnificent World Deities not being an opponent of this Sky-Reaching Vine! But on Crimson Rock Mountain, it is merely used for testing of the disciples. This path is truly too difficult."
Wu Ma Hai, Jian Huang, Xue Ying, and Chen Jiu all looked toward that grand towering Sky-Reaching Vine.
"On the Deity world, in order to become the disciple of any powerful existences, he could become a legend among the legendary… a grade one True Meaning Absolute Transcendent! Otherwise, he could cultivate a grade one Deity Heart within a short period of time after turning into a Deity," Wu Ma Hai said gravely.
"Amongst us, it is most likely only brother Dong Bo Xue Ying who has that talent," Chen Jiu said.
Grasping hold of a grade one True Meaning during the Transcendent realm was the most difficult task to do.
A Grade one Deity Heart…had a lower difficulty as one could become a Deity with a grade two Deity Heart before slowly cultivating it with time into a grade one.
The earlier one obtained a grade one True Meaning, however, the earlier it represented that one had pried into the essence of the Laws of Profound Mysteries!
"Who knows, Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying might possibly be the one to walk the furthest." Meishan Clan Master laughed.
"You overestimate me." Xue Ying turned toward the end of the Meteor Bridge. "I only want to get through the Meteor Bridge and successfully get rid of the Six Ghost Resentment Hex Poison in my body. That’s enough for me."
Sky-Reaching Vine.
Like people at the level of the Meishan Clan Master, Chen Jiu, and Wu Ma Hai, it was statistically said that nine would die with one surviving through.
His current offensive power might be close to them, but he was much weaker in terms of survivability. Chen Jiu and Meishan Clan Master both cultivated the True Meaning of Only Me and had an extremely tyrannical body that even Lord You Lan’s was inferior to! As for himself? If he was to met with those powerful attacks, he would most likely die in one single hit. After all, what he borrowed upon was the might of True Meanings, borrowing on the force of the world. The True Meaning of Star was quite good in terms of protection, but the moment it could not withstand the attacks…and if the green-armored protector could not withstand the attacks too, with his weak fleshy body, he would most likely be doomed in a single hit.
Undying Body?
His own Star Meteor Annihilation could even annihilate the body of General Ku Meng. Unless it was an attack that was being barely controlled by the user—like the Sorcerer God Saber, which did not use any form of Laws of Profound Mysteries—he could possibly survive. But that was impossible here, as the deeper into Crimson Rock Mountain he proceeded, the more terrifying those enemies would be in terms of their comprehension to the Laws of Profound Mysteries. Even those Stone Sculpture Protectors had easily seen through the Mirage, much less those who were on the Sky-Reaching Vine.
"What Dong Bo Xue Ying said is right. There is no point in thinking so much. Let’s get through the Meteor Bridge before speaking any further." Wu Ma Hai said in a low tone, "Previously, we were the first to get through it. This time, let’s reverse the order. How about it?"
"We do not have any objections to that." The golden-robed teenager Jian Huang and Meishan Clan Master both looked toward Xue Ying and Chen Jiu.
The moment they reversed the order…
Xue Ying and his team, who went last, would be the first this time round.
"We are fine with it too." Xue Ying exchanged a glance with Chen Jiu before expressing this opinion.
This was a minor matter.
Because regardless of whether it had been the intelligence from the Xia Clan or that from the World Deity existences, they had both explicitly introduced in detail the danger on Crimson Rock Mountain. The danger on the Meteor Bridge was something clearly stated, and whoever tried crossing it first or last did not matter much.
…
Xue Ying, Chen Jiu, Uncle Fu and Old Thief were currently discussing what to do.
"There are primarily two main forms of danger on the Meteor Bridge." Chen Jiu began, "One is located at the center of the bridge, while the other is at its end! As long as we can get through both these dangerous points, we’ll successfully pass the Meteor Bridge. By then, Dong Bo Xue Ying, you will have hopes of curing your poison."
Xue Ying laughed. "I hope so."
"At the center of the Meteor Bridge, there is a group of Deity world organisms." Chen Jiu explained, "It’s the frequently seen Flying Venomous Scorpion. In the Deity world, there are certain Deities who specially breed certain unique organisms, even breeding up to a few hundred thousand Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions. The moment they come flying in hordes, even a star will most likely be gnawed clean by them."
Xue Ying exclaimed in admiration inwardly. The Deity world was indeed different from a mortal world.
"However, the Meteor Bridge itself isn’t that dangerous comparatively. The Flying Venomous Scorpion located at the center of the Meteor Bridge will send out a corresponding team of scorpions based on the incoming team. If there’s only an outsider, they will send out a single team. We have a total of four people and will thus be attacked by four teams of Flying Venomous Scorpion teams. One Flying Venomous Scorpion team will be formed by a Deity rank and ten ordinary Flying Venomous Scorpions." Chen Jiu continued, "And in other words, we’ll be attacked by a total of four Deity rank and forty ordinary Flying Venomous Scorpion, which to us, will be much more dangerous than crossing the Floating Sky Island."
Xue Ying, Old Thief, and Uncle Fu all nodded.
Meteor Bridge…
Compared to the Floating Sky Island, it was even more inappropriate for a huge group of people crossing it. For instance, with ten people crossing it together, there would be a total of ten Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions in addition to a hundred ordinary ones.
Going solo would instead be more beneficial to them!
One could depend on his speed!
The Transcendent could fight against the ordinary Flying Venomous Scorpions rather than combating the Deity rank scorpion and rush to the other half of the bridge; by then, the Flying Venomous Scorpions would most likely not follow up in their pursuit.
Meteor Bridge…as long as one could get through it, they were fine. It was not a requirement to kill these Flying Venomous Scorpions! Thus, an Era Suppressant had hopes of getting through it.
WIthin Crimson Rock Mountain, the further one headed in, the most demanding it would be on the adventurer.
"The plan is as such. The Flying Venomous Scorpion is known for its speed. It’s quite unpredictable as it flies, so everyone will have to be extra careful," Chen Jiu said. Only Chen Jiu’s current speed could possibly match up with the Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpion; Xue Ying and the other two could not! Ordinary Flying Venomous Scorpions could reach up to a total of three hundred kilometers per second, and they could change direction while traveling really quickly. A Deity rank scorpion could reach an even greater five hundred kilometers per second.
"Everyone has to be careful." Xue Ying took a deep breath. He was being really serious. As long as he could get through the Meteor Bridge, there would be hopes for him to get his poison cured, and with how Crimson Rock Mountain had many rewards which it could give to the outsiders, he would most likely not be disappointed.
"Let’s begin!"
Hu!
Xue Ying and the other three immediately flew across the Meteor Bridge in high speed. This time, Xue Ying had completely entered the Mirage. Due to the small figure the Flying Venomous Scorpions had, the effects of Gravity Domain would be comparatively weaker. With how powerful the Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpion was, the moment he was hit, he would most likely die. Thus, he naturally entered the Mirage.
The other three teams were watching as Xue Ying’s team went on ahead.
After a while, they began following behind while maintaining the five thousand kilometers distance, allowing them to get a more accurate representation of what was happening ahead.
"What do you think? Will all of them be able to survive through this stage?"
"Previously, all of them had survived. This time, I think it’s not as simple as it was. With the Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions, Dong Bo Xue Ying and Chen Jiu will most likely have no time for anyone else but themselves."
…
The Meteor Bridge had a distance reaching hundreds of millions of kilometers.
The first half of the bridge was completely filled with black meteors, while the second part was filled with white ones in order to differentiate the two sections.
Hua.
The team of Xue Ying and Chen Jiu flew for a total of one day before they finally started getting close to the center of the Meteor Bridge. That was when they could see the other half of white meteors.
Ca ca ca~ Suddenly, a very low-pitched sound could be heard. It came from the fluttering of those Flying Venomous Scorpions as they flew out from a gap in between a huge black meteor. Not to mention those thin and long scorpion tails they had, all of them each of them had a body length of about half a meter long and were pitch-black in color. Their wings were translucent, and their tails were bent upwards with a glittering sharpness at the tip.
Amongst them, there were some starkly different from the others; these venomous scorpions were faint violet in color. Even though their body size was smaller, according to the intelligence reports, these were none other than the Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions. The danger in Crimson Rock Mountain was not exactly that unreachable; these scorpions were merely at the newly emerged Deity level.
Ca ca ca~
Four violet Flying Venomous Scorpions were flying with the group of ordinary scorpions. Their bulging eyes brimmed with cold killing intent as they stared at Xue Ying’s group.
Such organisms… had been bred by a certain powerful existence in the Deity world and was not naturally born into this world. They were bred to kill! Their entire body was extremely hard in addition to their sharp teeth and the terrifying poison at their tails. Their flying speed and direction-changing were really quick as well. The stronger the Flying Venomous Scorpion, the smaller they would get. In the Deity world, the moment a certain apex scorpion totally violet in color started attacking someone, its attacks would amount to more than a million and cover the sky. Even peak stage Deities could be eaten within the blink of an eye.
Xue Ying’s team of four all stopped moving.
"The other ordinary Flying Venomous Scorpions cannot sense me at all, but the Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions are currently observing me," Xue Ying transmitted.
Chen Jiu did not have time to reply, as the Flying Venomous Scorpions started attacking.
Hong! The low-pitched flying sound reverberated as these scorpions all turned into streams of light—just like shooting stars crossing the sky. Their speed was really fast. The four streams faintly filled with violet light were moving at an even more exceptional speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 307 - As Long as I Survive, Theres Always Hope!
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: As Long as I Survive, There's Always Hope!
Translator: Radiant
Editor: Radiant
"Forward!"
Chen Jiu, Xue Ying, Old Thief and Uncle Fu immediately forge on ahead.
At the juncture where both sides were about to clash…
Hua.
Many Demigods starting appearing in mid-air. Si Kong Yang, Mountain Lord He, Chi Qiu Bai, Elder Ao Lan, and the three high priests of the Demonic Faction were formed from the nine Mirage Avatars in addition to thirty-six other Illusion Avatars. At the same time, this huge group of people started splitting apart, with a group of people heading toward the left of the Flying Venomous Scorpions and a group heading toward the right.
Chen Jiu and Uncle Fu accompanied the group of nine Mirage Avatars and sixteen Illusion Avatars.
Xue Ying and Old Thief accompanied the group of twenty Illusion Avatars.
According to their plans, Chen Jiu and Xue Ying could count on their own combat strength, and Old Thief had the illusion transformation to give him a greater certainty in getting through. It was only Uncle Fu who had the least chance of surviving! Thus, Chen Jiu personally decided to bring Uncle Fu with him.
Hong! Hong!
This group of Flying Venomous Scorpions were all very intelligent; they immediately started separating into two groups while fixating on the initial four members who appeared right from the start—Chen Jiu, Uncle Fu, Xue Ying and Old Thief.
"Hahaha, come on, come on!" The mountain-goateed Old Thief was extremely delighted. He wasn’t afraid of fighting one on one with the ordinary Flying Venomous Scorpions. If he was to be surrounded or to be attacked by the faintly violet Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpion, he would immediately switch position with his Illusion Avatar. With twenty Illusion Avatars that he could switch positions with, this group of Flying Venomous Scorpions simply could not injure him at all.
Hmph.
Xue Ying was also moving at high speed. The ordinary Flying Venomous Scorpions could not enter the Mirage at all. Those two Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions fixated on him. With a single flap of their wings, these two Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions could actually tunnel into his Mirage, causing Xue Ying’s expression to change slightly.
He knew that at the level of Deities, things like time and Mirage were not something very mysterious anymore.
Still, after these two Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions tunneled into the Mirage, they started slowing down as if they entered into a quagmire—matching Xue Ying’s current speed of 335 kilometers per second.
Dong dong. Xue Ying materialized a spear. He did not dare fall into a battle craze; instead, he rushed toward the other side of the Meteor Bridge, parrying the incoming Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions on the way with his spear. Fortunately…those Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions were quite weak in their offense techniques and depended more on their nimbleness and sneak attacks with those scorpion tails of theirs. Furthermore, in the Mirage, their attacks had been suppressed significantly.
It was thus quite an easy and casual task for Xue Ying to ward off those attacks.
In two seconds, Xue Ying had rushed towards the later half of the Meteor Bridge in the Mirage. Those huge white meteorites…improved Xue Ying’s mood tremendously.
"Haha, I feel so much easier this time as compared to when I was on the Floating Sky Island." Old Thief had also reached the white meteors and laughed. "Dong Bo Xue Ying, thank you so much. Fortunately, you attracted those two Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions; otherwise, it would have been more troublesome for me."
"It’s also because those Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions couldn’t attack you that they started fighting against me," Xue Ying said.
"Ai! So what if they couldn’t attack me once? What if they attacked me ten times or a hundred times? Their speed is indeed too fast, and their attacks are unpredictable. My Illusion Avatars require me to be within a hundreds meters distance to switch positions with them. A hundred meters? That’s a blink of an eye for those Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions. If it could attack me just as I was about to switch positions with my Illusion Avatar, I might not react fast enough." The mountain-goateed old man sighed.
By depending on his illusion switching, he could only dodge those attacks. If his luck wasn’t good, he might just die from a single blow.
Meanwhile, Xue Ying and Chen Jiu could directly parry against those attacks; there wasn’t a single component where luck was involved.
"They have arrived." Xue Ying glanced backward.
Uncle Fu’s figure was releasing several rays of golden light; it was shining all over the place, causing countless seals to appear. Chen Jiu’s eyes were filled with killing intent. His eight arms had already extended to a length of ten meters and swept across in all directions. He was completely parrying those Deity rank Flying Venomous Scorpions head-on successfully, and once that happened, the threat of those Flying Venomous Scorpions was considerably reduced. Even though there were some that occasionally got through his palms, they were handled by Uncle Fu, whose combat strength was not weak at all either.
Just like this, they arrived on the white meteorites a few seconds after Xue Ying.
The Flying Venomous Scorpions stopped their murderous pursuit.
"Hahaha, the two of you are really fast." The bald-headed yellow-robed old man, Uncle Fu, laughed out loud. Chen Jiu had a shallow smile as well. Clearly, his mood was quite good as well.
"Don’t be so happy prematurely; the final section of the Meteor Bridge should be the hardest of them all." Chen Jiu said, "The Laws of Profound Mysteries used in the attacks of the Stone Sculpture Protectors and the Flying Venomous Scorpions are very ordinary. However, it’s quite different for the final section of the Meteor Bridge… Our opponents are truly formidable in terms of the orthodox Profound Mysteries."
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
The final obstacle.
After getting through the Meteor Bridge, he should be able to get his poison cured. And as long as he got his poison cured, he believed that with his current comprehension of the realms, he could immediately undergo the secondary Primordial Bloodline awakening, strengthening his physical body and stepping into the Demigod realm. With Demigod Qi powering his own armor, his current defense would greatly increase. Furthermore, without any hex poison in his body, he would be able to concentrate even further into comprehending his True Meanings.
Today, he had three True Meanings all at the peak stage two realm. These had naturally increased in realms as a result of cultivating his spear techniques since he could not fully concentrate on comprehending them.
As long as he could delve entirely into cultivation, he might possibly be able to breakthrough straightaway to the stage three realm!
As long as I get the poison cured, I might be able to undergo special cultivation using Crimson Rock Mountain! Xue Ying had a plan in his heart a long time ago. Crimson Rock Mountain was huge, and there were many different special regions which the Xia Clan Demigods had surveyed before in the past.
Everything will depend on whether I can get the poison cured or not.
…
Xue Ying and the others had safely gotten through; the three teams behind them also started attempting to get through the first section.
It was the Meishan Clan master’s team who went first.
"Formidable." Xue Ying, Chen Jiu, and the others watched from a distance. The Meishan Clan Master brought the white-robed young woman and black-robed male across. The black-robed male had a pair of black claws placed over his hands; they were like an endless darkness, swallowing everything in their way. The white-robed young woman had a sword that was truly dazzling; she had easily parried away those Flying Venomous Scorpions.
Still, the most formidable of them was the Meishan Clan Master.
The space around the Meishan Clan Master was distorted, increasing the distance in between him and those incoming Flying Venomous Scorpions and causing those who were near him to move as if they were traversing through mud.
