"I was sent over by the Patrol Master to hand over a brief and simple overview of specific arrangements such as rules and timings for the upcoming Prefecture Capital Battle." The soldier passed over a golden scroll and continued, "Patrol Master has also asked you to not run around too much in the next few days, since the battle will begin in three days’ time."
"I understand." The legionnaire only left after making sure Xue Ying properly received the golden scroll.
"Quick, open it up and have a look," Purple Thunder Emperor, Yun Hai and all the others urged him from the side.
Xue Ying laughed as he displayed the scroll to the rest.
The Prefecture Capital Battle would proceed largely the same from generation to generation, albeit with some minor differences in details.
"There’s the ranking trial, the arena trial, and survival trial." Xue Ying nodded after perusing through.
The Prefecture Capital Battle would always be split into those three stages.
All of the roughly thirty-two thousand Deity experts would first participate in the ranking test, and a thousand of them would be chosen according to their performance! All the others would be eliminated!
As for the arena battle, the remaining experts from the last trial would be pit amongst themselves to select the top two hundred fifty experts!
Finally, the survival trial would be organized for the last two hundred fifty Deities…so as to sieve out the top hundred.
Those final hundred Deities would be sent over to the Bloodshed God Palace, where they would represent the Calm Sea Prefecture in the Bloodshed God Palace Battle. They could display their skills before the topmost experts in the entire Deity World, including the ruler of the Bloodshed God Palace as well as various other powerful existences!
I’ve only cultivated for two thousand years. As long as I can successfully reach the Bloodshed God Palace, so that the powerful existences can get their eyes on me, I’m basically guaranteed to become the disciple of one of them, Xue Ying thought. That is why my current target is to successfully get a spot in the top hundred and participate in the final Bloodshed God Palace Battle. If I succeed in that, I can consider this Myriad Flower Feast to have been a great success!
The top hundred… Xue Ying’s eyes turned sharp as he looked toward the three selection stages, where the Prefecture Capital Battle was to take place.

chapters.title: Chapter 429 - The Prefecture Capital Battle Begins!
chapters.content:
Chapter 429: The Prefecture Capital Battle Begins!
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Back in the courtyard, the Deities of Xia Clan were sitting in groups of twos or threes, chatting with one another while eating and drinking their fill.
"This Prefecture Capital Battle might have three stages in total, yet the first one, the ranking battle, will see more than thirty thousand of the participants already eliminated." The Purple Thunder Emperor sighed. "Just a thousand out of all thirty-two thousand participants get to move on to the second stage! At the same time, the Starfield Selection already eliminated everyone but a dozen participants. If we extrapolate that, we’ll find that it’s quite possible for every single Deity from a starfield to be eliminated from the first stage."
"From what I’ve heard, not one Deity from the Celestial Star Field, where I used to live, managed to pass the ranking trial portion of the Myriad Flower Feast." Yun Hai laughed. "Still, I believe in Dong Bo’s combat power. I’m quite certain he’ll be get a spot in the top thousand."
"He defeated the Fierce Shaman Warrior in just one move. It won’t be any big deal for him to get a spot in the top thousand," the Dragon Mountain Emperor added.
This group of Deities continued chatting at their leisure.
Xue Ying laughed. "Gentlemen, there’s no sense in over-praising me. It seems to me that your confidence in my chances is greater than my own."
"I’m with them; you’ll definitely succeed," Jing Qiu stepped in from Xue Ying’s side. "It’s a pity that the ranking trials aren’t shown to the public, so we have no way of watching you."
"Right."
"They’re actually keeping the battles private."
"Such a pity…"
Many of the Deities were shaking their heads or sighing.
The first stage of the Prefecture Capital Battle, the ranking trial, was not shown to the public! Only the other two, the arena battle and the survival battle, would made public for anyone to watch.
After the ranking battle, the Calm Sea Prefecture would announce the top thousand Deities, and those whose names were on the list could move on to the next stage. As for those who weren’t? It simply spelled the end of the road for them! Naturally, there would even be Deities who pushed themselves past their limits and end up dead during the ranking trial.
With how long the lifespan of Deities was, the passage of three days was nothing more than a flash in their eyes.
"Dong Bo, the Patrol Master has invited you to go over. The Prefecture Capital Battle will begin soon," one of the soldiers came over to inform him.
"Please, lead the way." Xue Ying left the room, followed closely behind by Jing Qiu and the group of Xia Clan Deities. Very soon, they all arrived at the abode of the Patrol Master. A large amount of people had already gathered there, and the whole area was bustling with activity!.
After all, most Deities who were participating in the Prefecture Capital Battle had brought along most of their good friends.
"The sixteen Deity participants, follow me. As for everyone else, I must ask you to remain behind," Patrol Master Guan ordained in a loud voice. "The ranking trial section will not be made public, and nobody is allowed to watch them! Please wait until the trial itself is finished and the rankings are announced. Everything will be cleared up at that point."
"Mn."
"Second Brother, you must be careful. If you can’t hold on any longer, just admit defeat. Don’t waste your life."
"Commander, it’s up to you now."
Various well-wishes could be heard.
Xue Ying bade his farewell to Jing Qiu, Yun Hai, Purple Thunder, and the others before following Patrol Master Guan alongside Seventh Mei Yu and the other fourteen Deities. They all left the area together.
******
Hu.
A large amount of groups could be seen as they made their way through the sky in the form of streams of light before finally descending.
Upon landing, Xue Ying’s group looked around them, only to see a ridiculous amount of people. Most of them were Deity experts, while some were, naturally, the other starfield Patrol Masters!
"Right before us but much higher above is where the Prefecture Master himself is seated," Patrol Master Guan suddenly said.
Xue Ying and the others all looked upward.
As the Patrol Master mentioned, eight figures were situated high up before them. Amongst them, an amiable old man was located right in the middle, and to his side was a thick-gowned old man with a snowy-white beard. Below the two sat six other figures, all of them exuding extraordinary auras.
"Eh?" From a glance, Xue Ying could recognize one of the figures. "The White Sand City Lord?"
At the same time, the plump White Sand City Lord swept his gaze along the dense group of figures, and before long, his eyes landed landed right on Xue Ying. His expression turned into a grin, as he transmitting straight into the ears of Xue Ying, "Dong Bo, I have said to the prefecture master and the others, telling them that you will certainly enter the top hundred, participating in the final God Palace Battle. So you better not disappoint me."
Xue Ying was at a loss. The White Sand City Lord had more confidence in him than he himself did.
It was at that moment—
That the old man with a snowy-white beard also looked over in his direction, with his vision landing right in that area.
Every member of the group from the Mountain Wu Star Field, be it the Deities or Patrol Master Guan himself, felt their heart tighten.
What’s going on? Why would he look this way? Xue Ying and the others were bewildered. Only Seventh Mei Yu ignored it and looked in some other direction. Seeing that, the old man laughed and then returned to his chat with the Prefecture Master.
"Your Highness, Seventh Mei Yu," Patrol Master Guan began asking with a laugh, "are you perhaps acquainted with that senior?"
"I am not," the handsome teenager in white robes, Seventh Mei Yu, coldly replied.
Patrol Master Guan was stunned. He could not help but chortle.
Any ordinary Deity would never dare speak so coldly to him, yet this person had a stage two World Deity as a subordinate. It was very clear to him that he could not afford to offend this person.
"This old man…" Xue Ying sent a glance at that old man, his mind focused on contemplating the issue. Many figures and a large amount of information filled his mind. As the master of the Crimson Rock Mountain, he had knowledge of most big characters of the Deity World. He is sitting right next to the Prefecture Master, so he must be at least a stage four World Deity. There are only so many stage four World Deities throughout the entire Deity World! With that appearance…perhaps he is the one called Monarch Mo Xue?
He’s an impressive one, Xue Ying muttered inwardly. Monarch Mo Xue is ranked at the very top even amongst stage four World Deities. He’s been alive for an incredible amount of time, and his combat power is comparable to my teacher’s, the Sacred Master Crimson Dust.
High up on the platform, the emissary from the Bloodshed God Palace stood up and bowed in the direction of the Calm Sea Prefecture Master. "Prefecture Master, these fellow ladies and gentlemen from the many starfields were quite prompt in their arrival. Shall I begin hosting the battle then?"
"Carry on." The Calm Sea Prefecture Master nodded.
The emissary immediately walked toward the frontmost portion of the high platform to look toward the many figures beneath. He then said in a raised voice, "As per His Majesty’s orders, the Prefecture Capital Battle will be hosted by me, with the Calm Sea Prefecture Master acting as supervisor."
His mighty voice reverberated throughout the entire area.
In response to it, Xue Ying and all the others looked upward and listened carefully.
"The Starfield Selections you’ve previously passed were merely meant to set down a basic threshold, so as to set apart the Deities that have an acceptable combat power," the emissary expounded. "This time, the Prefecture Capital Battle will be a bloody event that will serve to filter out the most outstanding hundred Deities amongst you all, so they may proceed on to the Bloodshed God Palace! There, they will face each other in a final competition right before the eyes of His Majesty and many other powerful existences."
"The Prefecture Capital Battle is split into three separate stages, and of the three, only the first trial will take place today."
As those last words left his mouth, the emissary immediately waved his hand. A scroll materialized before him which he grabbed and then threw out. It immediately grew an enormous size. Once it finished growing, it was a full hundred million kilometers long, floating high up in the sky like a net seeking to capture the heavens.
The scroll then slowly began unraveling, and images of the heaven and earth, of the mountains and rivers, were vaguely visible within. Together, they formed a complete inner world.
"I will be sending 1,000 Deity experts within at a time," the emissary’s voice once more sounded out, as if coming from right beside everyone’s ears. "Batch after batch will go in, and only after all 31,865 Deity experts are finished will the ranking trial reach its conclusion. You will be ranked according to your ability to deal with your enemies, and in the end, the top 1,000 of you will be announced to the public. As for the others—they will all be eliminated.
"As for the rules, I’m sure you are all already aware of them.
"You are forbidden from bring any of the following items inside: World Deity treasures, blood-refined Deity warriors, or any unique or ordinary treasures. Should it be discovered that someone brought an item of that sort inside, they will be summarily sentenced to death," the emissary of the Bloodshed God Palace coldly explained. "Once you realize that you can no longer hold on, you may simply shout out that you admit defeat, and I will teleport you outside."
The Bloodshed God Palace emissary cited out the rules one after another.
As the one responsible for carrying out the orders of His Majesty, the Bloodshed God Emperor himself, there was no reason for him to be afraid of any repercussions! Not even powerful existences would dare stir up trouble! After all, anyone who dared disrupt the Bloodshed God Palace Myriad Flower Feast would be directly offending His Majesty!
"The Prefecture Capital Battle begins now!" the emissary coldly voiced. "It is time for the first batch to enter the world."
Hua.
As soon as he finished speaking, an unseen power enveloped the area beneath him. As a stage three World Deity, he was easily able to move around just a thousand Deities. Sou sou sou… Those thousand figures were grabbed against their will and shoved into the enormous scroll floating in mid-air. As soon as they came into contact with it, they were immediately taken inside.
Xue Ying, in a similar fashion to all other thirty thousand Deity experts left behind, was looking up toward the enormous scroll in the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 430 - Gamble
chapters.content:
Chapter 430: Gamble
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
It took no more than a moment before the first human figure covered in blood was expelled from the enormous scroll. He was able to regain consciousness while falling from mid-air. At first, his terror was on full display on his expression, but he then realized that everyone was staring at him and went back to his original position with an awkward look. His shame for being defeated too quickly was beyond description.
Sou, sou, sou…
As more time passed, there were many experts falling from the enormous scroll spanning a few hundred million kilometers. They all showed clearly visible heavy injuries as they were expelled. As more and more of them left, everyone could clearly see their true forms. For instance, some were beasts with bodies more than hundreds of kilometers in length, and even several unique organisms had made an appearance. They were only willing to show their true forms because several of their moves could unleash stronger effects that way.
Blood sprayed everywhere in mid-air—fresh red blood, violet or green blood…regardless of color, it was certain that blood flowed in rivers. Some of the expelled participants had even gotten their bodies torn apart and could only put themselves back together after leaving the scroll.
They were, after all, Deities! As long as their True Deity Heart wasn’t extinguished, they could persevere!
"How was it? What’s going on inside there?"
"What happened to you within the scroll world?" A number of Deity experts went over to question the ones who were already expelled.
One of them had cleared off the blood from his body, but he couldn’t dispel the pale expression on his face. His mood had yet to recover, which was evident from his frown. He was not particularly inclined to speak, "You will all understand once it’s your turn to enter."
Xue Ying looked all over the place, seeing how those who survived were unwilling to explain much. It was only normal, since everyone there was a competitor.
The rate of people being expelled into the sky slowly decreased, and now it was only occasionally that somebody would be sent out!
Hua. Finally, a teenager towering in both height and width, with silver hair adorning his head, left the scroll world. He immediately stopped his body from plummeting in mid-air, and his expression betrayed his dissatisfaction.
"That is all for the first batch of Deities!" the emissary stated in a cold voice, his voice reverberating all around the area.
At the sound of those words, the silver-haired teenager from before finally revealed a grin. He had clearly been the last one to be expelled.
"A reminder for everyone: you will be ranked according to your performance in regards to slaughtering the enemy and not how long you can survive within the scroll world! The amount of time you can survive will have no effect on the final rank. For instance, the last one to have come out from this first batch…is actually ranked the 200th," the emissary explained, his voice as cold as ever. "It is time for the next batch!"
That revelation left the silver-haired teenager momentarily stunned, his face turned bright red. Fury pervaded his heart, yet he would never dare vent his anger against the emissary himself. He just descended without uttering a word of complaint.
Sou sou sou…
The Bloodshed God Palace emissary’s mighty power once again enveloped a thousand Deity experts and sent them flying up into the sky uncontrollably. They were thrown inside the enormous scroll like stones into a lake.
From this first batch of Deities, did only 395 survive? He had kept track of the Deities as they came out, so he could easily calculate their number. What of the remaining 605 Deity experts? Did they really all die inside there?
To think that this ranking trial is nothing more than the first stage of the Prefecture Capital Battle… He inwardly shook his head. Such a casualty rate was nothing short of exaggerated.
"Ah!"
A mournful sound reverberated throughout the sky as fresh blood sprayed out in mid-air. Its source was a mutilated body which had just been expelled. Once it arrived in mid-air, the body condensed back into its original form—a gray-robed teenager small in stature and form. He sent awkward glances all around as he rushed back to his original position.
Once the second batch entered, a large number of people were expelled one after another, many of them covered in gruesome injuries.
Hong~ An enormous, twin-headed monster appeared in mid-air before condensing back into his humanoid shape in a hurry.
The majority of those who were expelled were riddled with injuries; most people were unwilling to give up until the very last moment. It was only natural for anyone who could pass the Starfield Selections to hold some amount of pride.
Batch after batch…
In the blink of an eye, ten Deity batches had already went inside, yet not one of the sixteen Deities from the Mountain Wu Starfield were chosen so far.
"The tenth batch is now through. In other words, ten thousand Deity experts have already gone through the battles." From his vantage point high above, the emissary from the Bloodshed God Palace swept his gaze across everyone below, a trace of coldness ever present in his eyes. "What hubris! So many of the Deities who went inside overestimated themselves. In spite of sensing danger and accumulating injuries, they still went crazy trying to kill more enemies. Once the enemy’s combat power surpasses what you can withstand, you might just die without even getting the chance to admit defeat! In any case, it is time for the next batch."
Hua.
The eleventh batch of Deities was enveloped and sent flying high into the sky.
"Mn?" Xue Ying realized that, this time around, someone from Mountain Wu Star Field was finally pulled in. Even so, only seven of them were take into the scroll, the red-haired man with heavy killing intent being one of them.
The current batch was slowly being thinned out as well.
Among those recently expelled was the red-haired man. He was heavily injured, but he quickly recovered after being thrown out in mid-air.
After getting back to the ground, he looked back into the sky with an ice-cold expression. He was staring intently at enormous scroll, watching the other experts as they were expelled.
Finally—
It was time for the twelfth batch of Deities to enter. The emissary’s gaze swept down in the direction of the participants from the Mountain Wu Star Field. As host for the current Prefecture Capital Battle, he naturally received a huge amount of intelligence and was made aware of certain experts from the prefecture who were which quite dazzling. Other than those, there were also a few whose backgrounds were very impressive. His decision to separate them into a separate batch, so that he could observe them properly, was nothing strange.
Hu.
An unseen power appeared to envelop them.
"Is it my turn?" Xue Ying was able to sense an unseen power sweep him up into the sky and then sendhim flying toward the enormous scroll. The enormous scroll was getting closer and closer before his eyes.
Pu.
Just like with the Deity experts from before, this time’s batch seemingly clashed against the scroll. Moments before making contact, Xue Ying could tell that this batch actually contained a person that was familiar to him, who would also be entering the scroll. That was, of course, His Highness Seventh Mei Yu.
******
"Brother Mo Xue, your daughter has entered." The Calm Sea Prefecture Master gazed in the direction of the scroll, his vision easily bypassing the obstruction of the scroll world. He was able to directly look into the inner world and see the thousand experts within. Naturally, he had discovered Seventh Mei Yu amongst them.
"Brother Dragon, how about we watch how this little daughter of mine fares?" Monarch Mo Xue caressed his snowy-white beard with an expression of delight plastered on his face. Just like the others, he could easily send his vision through the interference and watch the events happening within without any issue.
"This current batch is quite interesting." The yellow-robed woman, the Venomous Ying World Deity, giggled charmingly. "Not only do we have the daughter of Monarch Mo Xue in there, but there’s also the inner disciple of the Primal Ivory powerful existence, Zang Xiao, as well as that Dong Bo that Brother White Sand regards highly upon. Everyone, how about we have a gamble in regards to who will be the strongest participant from this batch?"
"That’ll be Dong Bo!" The White Sand City Lord touched his pointed beard as he swept his gaze over his surroundings.
"It will likely be Her Highness, Seventh Mei Yu." Marshal Qin, the woman in silver armor, casually mentioned without letting go of her wine glass.
"I’ll place my bet on the one called Zang Xiao then. He brought himself up from a tiny being before eventually being accepted as an inner disciple under a powerful existence. I don’t think his comprehension ability would be low," the handsome Mo Yun stepped in.
The yellow-robed woman continued spurring the others on, "Big Brother Rong Hai, what about you?"
King Rong Hai laughed out loud. "I think Brother Mo Yun’s judgement is sound. I’ll also choose Zang Xiao. Little Sister Venomous Ying, you also have yet to tell us your choice!"
"We’re both women, so it’s only natural that I’d choose Her Highness, Mei Yu," the Venomous Ying World Deity replied.
"I’ll also join in on this gamble, and I’ll be betting on my daughter." Monarch Mo Xue laughed as he spoke up from above. "Should I lose, each and every one of you will receive a flask of Bamboo Fiery Snow Serum."
"If that is the case, I’ll join in by betting on Zang Xiao. I have some info on the combat strength of this chap, and he seems to be quite good," the Calm Sea Prefecture Master said. "If I am to lose, the winners will each receive a Calm Sea Spirit Pearl from me."
"Bamboo Fiery Snow Serum…that’s Monarch Mo Xue’s specialty! And even a Calm Sea Spirit Pearl has been added to the pot. Even as host, I’m afraid this junior cannot hold back any longer. I shall be placing my bet on Zang Xiao." The emissary from the Bloodshed God Palace laughed.
The yellow-robed woman, the Venomous Ying World Deity, stepped in to give the final announcement, "A total of eight bets, four of them on Zang Xiao, three on Her Highness, Seventh Mei Yu; ai…brother White Sand, you’re actually the only one who chose that little brother of yours, Dong Bo."
The White Sand City Lord glared back. "The Prefecture Master and the Monarch have both brought out their stakes, but what of you all? Hurry up and take everything out, you all!"
In spite of his rampant behaviour as he shouted out, the White Sand City Lord was wracked by nerves in his heart. Brother Dong Bo, you must not fail me.
He had long since began bragging about how highly he regarded Xue Ying, so even if he was to truly gamble, he would still have had to stand beside him, even if just for the sake of his reputation!
However, in his inner heart… the White Sand City Lord was confident that Xue Ying would get into the top hundred, but he couldn’t hold that same confidence when it came to comparing him with the likes of Zang Xiao or Her Highness, Seventh Mei Yu. The ugly truth was that Zang Xiao cultivated according to the guiding of a powerful existence, while Seventh Mei Yu was taught by her father. Monarch Mo Xue was, indeed, slightly weaker than powerful existences in terms of his comprehension of the realm, but it was only normal that he would put in all of his effort for the sake of his daughter.
In any case, the White Sand City Lord did not have much confidence, yet he had to carry on with this gamble, all for the sake of his reputation!
He looked up toward the sky, since he, like all of the other spectators located on the high platform, could look into the scroll world. They could do so since the emissary did not block them from looking inside. They could see the diverse locations within the wide world, one of them showing Xue Ying standing on a beach.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 431 - Combat Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 431: Combat Power
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
On an island, somewhere in the ocean.
Xue Ying descended upon a beach with sand as pure as snow, contaminated by neither dirt nor soil.
The air permeating the entire scroll world was relatively cold. From a cursory glance at his surroundings, Xue Ying spotted a hourglass floating in mid-air, filled with shining sand. As soon as he laid eyes upon it, the sand started flowing!
Hu!
A current of black power converged on the island, forming into ten black-robed people. They all wore identical garb, and even their appearances were all the same. The only thing setting them apart from each other were the weapons on their backs. Some used twin swords, some spears, pikes, whips, even shackles… Regardless of weapon, they charged in to attack as soon as they materialized.
All of them were able to move at very high speeds—some even penetrating into the Mirage, others into the shadow space, a select few turning into fiery spheres…
They were all employing different techniques to increase their speed, and their battle styles all differed from one another.
"Come then." A thought from Xue Ying’s part caused another Xue Ying with the same starry robes and similar appearance to appear beside him.
There were two different images of him, but both held onto spears.
One used a black spear, while the other one’s was fiery-red in color; the one holding onto the fiery-red spear was none other than a Mirage avatar!
"The more of you I kill, the higher my rank will be, so I should get to killing!" The two Xue Yings moved simultaneously.
Pu!
Their spears thrust out with lightning-speed, piercing one of the black-robed men before him all the way through—the man instantly dissipated! Back in mid-air, the hourglass flipped, and the allocated time repeated.
Xiu xiu xiu! The Mirage avatar thrust out another three times, each strike carrying the Profound Mysteries of Extreme Piercing as it pierced the throats of three different black-robed men. The hourglass in mid-air reversed once more to restart the countdown.
For the moment, Xue Ying did not even have to use any of his secret skills.
His third level Time Immemorial body gave him the strength and speed necessary to easily kill his enemies using the Profound Mysteries of Extreme Piercing and of Star alone.
With every black-robed man dealt with, a new one would appear on the island. At the same time, the hourglass would also restart its flow. If one did not kill any enemy for a long period of time, and if that the flow of sand within the hourglass reached its end, the contestant would be immediately expelled! Even so, the majority of people would end up expelled because of admitting defeat or dying in the battle. It was very rare that someone would be sent out due to running out of time.
Their combat power increases this fast? Xue Ying frowned.
He killed these men at a rapid pace.
After all, his true body was working in concert with his Mirage avatar to focus on dealing with the men as quickly as possible. Their moves were nothing short of ruthless. At the very beginning, the black-robed people only had combat power at the peak of the Deity realm. Later on, however, they were growing stronger by the second. Within the time it took to brew a cup of tea, the combat power these black-robed people could use was of a new World Deity. And that was not judging solely by their strength or speed; even their usage of the Laws of Profound Mysteries continuously increased.
Not only were they powerful, every time they attacked, they would do so in groups. Xue Ying was therefore forced to further increase his killing speed, so that he would not end up surrounded.
The only positive fact about this trial was that they were separated all throughout the island. As long as Xue Ying kept killing and moving, he could prevent a situation where he was surrounded.
I have to start showing my secret skills already… Once faced with enemies at the level of new World Deities, Xue Ying’s usage of spear techniques transformed. He was primarily displaying the offensive skill, Chaotic Suppression.
Peng peng peng! His spear swept across, space crumbling apart and falling into darkness wherever it passed. A first attack caused the shield held by a black-robed man to vibrate and be thrown to the side, while a second lashed directly against his torso which immediately caved in. The third strike struck his body directly, and he was forced to finally dissipate.
Violence.
Brutality.
On the outside, Xue Ying seemed to have a very reserved nature, but today, the moves he displayed were all incredibly ferocious. Even then, it still took a full three attacks to kill a single black-robed man, and in the meantime, the others had already begun homing in on his location. Not only that, another black-robed man, stronger than the previous ones, now emerged not too far away. The amount of pressure placed on Xue Ying was accumulating, which actually helped him further his comprehension regarding the usage of Chaotic Suppression.
It is not savage enough, and the transmission of strength should be smoother—only once it becomes like a single entity can it be passed onto the enemy in its entirety. At that point, it will no longer be affected by their weapons, instead being sent directly into various parts of their bodies. With that ability, I can kill the enemy in a single move.
This stronger pressure suppressing Xue Ying only served to make him more excited. This was precisely what he required right now!
All ten enemies he faced were unique and varied, so the Laws of Profound Mysteries they displayed were also different. In this way, the pressure he faced would be even stronger, which was much more helpful than burying himself in cultivation.
Hu hu hu…
People with heavy injuries started being expelled from the enormous scroll.
"Neither Dong Bo, nor His Highness Seventh Mei Yu, has been expelled yet."
"Both have incredible combat power. I do wonder how long they will be able to hold on for."
Everyone who came from Mountain Wu Star Field discussed with one another.
"Hehehe, elder brother White Sand, this little brother Dong Bo of yours should have learned some World Deity ranked secret techniques like the others! His realm also seems to be quite deep. His moves are all so strong," King Rong Hai praised as he watched the scenes of battle from afar. "He also has that Mirage avatar that’s killing alongside him. Hehe, he’s actually dealing with them as fast as Her Highness, Seventh Mei Yu, and slightly faster than Zang Xiao."
"This Dong Bo can only depend on that Mirage avatar his. Her Highness, Seventh Mei Yu, is the one who is truly fast," the yellow-robed Venomous Ying World Deity praised.
"Seventh Mei Yu’s sword technique and her body technique are both truly perfect," the Ink Cloud City Lord joined in with praise.
"Hahaha…" Monarch Mo Xue laughed from above.
All of them could clearly see the scenes of battle depicted within the enormous scroll.
Her Highness, Seventh Mei Yu, was located within a forest. She was surrounded, under the assault of many black-robed men. However, she had long since turned into an illusion herself, while many other misty illusions appeared all around her original position and went out to kill her enemies using swords. On top of that, flower petals were floating about in the surroundings, each of them carrying an inherent might which served to tear apart the black-robed people with reckless abandon.
"Her sword is just cold and clean enough." Marshal Qin revealed a grin. "Through her sword techniques, you can feel her will fusing with the sword and slashing all enemies in front of her apart. For her to have created such a secret skill, and her will to remain unwavering…should she keep going on this path, I believe she will definitely break through the final obstacle to become a World Deity."
"It looks like we’ll be the winners this time around," the Venomous Ying World Deity added.
"Hold your horses now." The emissary from the Bloodshed God Palace chuckled. "Zang Xiao has yet to display his true strength. He is just starting to do so now."
Zang Xiao used twin sabers in battle. Just moments before, he was still using an ordinary saber technique created using a World Deity ranked secret technique as a base. Now, however, he began to display his self-created saber secret skill. At the moment, there were only two indistinct blood-colored rays flashing out time after time, every flash accompanied by a piercing whistle like the screeching of a bird. Under the concert of mournful whistling sounds, the black-robed men were being killed one after another. His killing speed immediately skyrocketed, and it was now very clearly beyond that of both Xue Ying and Seventh Mei Yu. The number of black-robed men he killed had naturally increased by a tremendous degree.
"He’s surpassed them." The Ink Cloud City Lord smiled. "He is now killing them at the fastest rate. This saber technique of Zang Xiao’s was created precisely for the purpose of slaughter!"
******
Back on the beach, Xue Ying was still enjoying the fight, however, the efficiency of his Chaotic Suppression when it came to killing was starting to dwindle. After all, this was a move focused entirely on offensive power. The ten black-robed men all had different specialities, after all, and some employed strong defenses or had strong physical bodies. That allowed them to easily withstand his spear technique.
Xue Ying was working in concert with his Mirage avatar, both bodies doing their best to increase their killing speed.
But it was to no avail.
My strength is not sufficient? It’s time to increase it! The Great Chaotic True Force within Xue Ying’s body began rumbling and then surged out. It was now time to put this technique he cultivated to the peak Deity stage on full display! His spear’s power exploded.
Peng! The black-robed men, who would previously not die even after being hit eight to ten times, now suddenly disintegrated from a single sweep of his spear.
Now at the peak of the Deity stage, Xue Ying’s Great Chaotic True Force was clearly much stronger in terms of offense than the Time Immemorial Body!
Peng Peng Peng Peng Peng Peng Peng !
The black-robed men exploded one after another! With every instance of his spear striking one of them, they would immediately explode. They would be directly suppressed, regardless of their relative strength.
This was also among the reasons Xue Ying did not previously use the Great Chaotic True Force. Only when his combat power was close to the enemy’s would he get the chance to refine himself. Otherwise, the effect of training himself would be that much weaker! It was only normal that, as the black-robed men became stronger, Xue Ying would also push his combat power to a higher level.

chapters.title: Chapter 432 - Consecutively Coming Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 432: Consecutively Coming Out
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
When employed through the usage of Chaotic Suppression, Xue Ying’s Great Chaotic True Force would assuredly bring about miraculous effects. The black-robed men condensed by the arrays were being destroyed as soon as they spawned. It was only after a full thirty of them were destroyed that they reached a combat power that allowed them to exchange a few moves with him.
"This is finally getting interesting." Just as Xue Ying was battling to his heart’s content, one of the black-robed men turned himself into lightning. He was using twin pikes, and his speed was far beyond Xue Ying’s. He employed various moves to envelop Xue Ying in a continuous assault.
It was fast to the extreme!
In spite of Xue Ying’s speed not quite matching up to the black-robed man, his spear still swept and lashed about! This single strike was enough to cover an enormous area. Then, once it curved back, it struck out toward another huge area. Altogether, the lightning-form man had a hard time dodging the attacks, especially considering that Xue Ying’s spear technique could even generate a terrifying gravitational force of attraction, which could send everything nearby into a collision course. The men tried escaping within the Mirage or within the Shadow Space, but nothing could resist that force.
The Chaos Hole was originally one of the ultimate patterns of the World. Xue Ying’s ‘Chaotic Suppression’ secret skill had long created two different colors of the Chaos Hole.
A light touch from Xue Ying’s spear was enough to destroy the black-robed man with weaker bodies, while with stronger bodies would still suffer heavy injuries! It would take no more than two to three moves for them to die.
The difficulty is increasing bit by bit. Xue Ying’s Mirage body was off fighting one of the black-robed men with better defenses. Even after ten or so exchanges, neither was able to kill their opponent.
His true body, on the other hand, could easily skewer his opponents.
In any case, the ranking battle doesn’t pose as much of a threat to me, since I’ll only ever face ten opponents at most, and not one more, Xue Ying thought. On top of that, the combat power of these black-robed men is gradually increasing. I won’t often get opportunities as good as this one for refining my skills."
Xue Ying was completely engrossed in his spear techniques.
Even now, he was mostly only using Chaotic Suppression, since it was the skill he sought to improve in the most.
In a dark portion of the wasteland.
Hua hua hua~
The expression on Zang Xiao’s scarred face was ugly. He could have easily gotten rid of the two scars adorning his face after becoming a Deity, but he chose to leave them as they were. Holding onto his twin sabers, his body moved like a phantom as it disappeared time after time only to reappear at random throughout that wasteland. He could simply appear in any area he wished, before twisting his twin sabers into a indistinct, blood-colored saber light.
The saber light whistled, producing a piercing and mournful sound.
He slaughtered the black-robed men one after another, as if reaping wheat on a field.
The speed at which he killed was blinding and had improved even further after he brought out his secret skill. Even now, his pace was beyond Xue Ying’s and Seventh Mei Yu’s.
His eyes were cold, his expression devoid of emotion. He was simply reaping the lives of his enemies without care, displaying his saber techniques as he liked.
His saber technique was created purely with slaughter in mind!
Dang dang.
Weapons clashed, and Zang Xiao’s figure continued flashing all around. His indistinct light rays moved through the air along an arc as they killed another black-robed man.
I’m starting to feel some pressure. Zang Xiao was well aware of that in his heart, but that did not keep him from killing any further.
Slowly…
The black-robed men strengthened further and further, and before long, one of them, with a more tyrannical physical body, reached a level at which he could tangle with Zang Xiao. Soon afterwards, another one appeared, whose speed was much faster than his own…
It didn’t take much longer until a large portion of the black-robed men were already very difficult to kill.
Pu.
A sword’s slash landed across Zang Xiao’s body, and fresh blood splashed out…
"I admit defeat!" Unperturbed, Zang Xiao immediately shouted, his eyes as cold as ever. With how merciless he was to his enemies, there was no way he would give himself any leisure. He had set down a condition from the very start—he would admit defeat as soon as he received any injury. Regardless of how light that injury was, he would surrender just the same!
Hu.
A force enveloped him and took him out of the scroll world.
"Mn?" After being sent out in mid-air, he looked up toward the enormous scroll in the sky and then to the other Deities who were occasionally being expelled.
He was well aware that he did not spend very long within the battlefield, but he was confident in himself nonetheless. After all, his speed of slaughter was just that fast, likely close to ten times above any ordinary Deity’s!
Sou.
Zang Xiao landed below and kept to himself. Regardless of the result, he would keep his confidence.
"Zang Xiao has admitted defeat and left the scroll world." The personages up on the high platform were paying attention to every single detail. The emissary continued with a laugh, "He might have surrendered, but his slaughtering speed was truly fast. Once he began displaying his secret skill, he surpassed both Dong Bo and Her Highness, Seventh Mei Yu. In spite of being the first to admit defeat, his result has passed both Dong Bo’s and Seventh Mei Yu’s by a large margin."
"It’s hard to tell for sure. Look at Dong Bo’s current speed," White Sand City Lord retorted.
They had clearly seen Xue Ying begin displaying his Great Chaotic True Force, which caused his speed to greatly increase. Even so, that speed had already returned to a normal pace at the moment.
"His offensive ability is to be admired. That level can most likely only be reached through a World Deity ranked secret technique with a focus on unbridled strength," Marshal Qin stepped in with some words of praise. "On top of that, his secret skill is quite appropriate for the utilization of that force. However, he has reached a bottleneck. It’s unlikely that we will witness any further increases in his combat ability! That secret skill of his is, indeed, formidable, but it clearly at a bottleneck."
"It’s true that he’s getting slower. Most likely, he will finish this battle on a full level below Zang Xiao," Venomous Ying World Deity agreed with the previous assessment. "Meanwhile, Her Highness, Seventh Mei Yu, can truly be considered formidable. Her limit should be quite a ways off still."
"Indeed," Marshal Qin agreed.
"The young lady’s sword technique is not only fast, but also exquisite." Calm Sea Prefecture Master analyzed, a smile plastered on his face all the while. "Even if we were to judge purely on speed, she would still be beyond Dong Bo and Zang Xiao, yet her sword technique is more refined; she can kill her enemies clearly and cleanly. And if that strike isn’t enough, she’ll link it together with another eight to ten attacks, so that any opponent will fall into her hands with ease! On top of that, her sword technique secret skill has materialized into a personal domain; it truly is on a nearly perfect level. She has command over every important aspect of combat, even domains. As far as I can tell, she is a level above Zang Xiao. It would seem that this old man has judged her wrongly, so I’ll be losing out on this bet."
"Hahaha…" Monarch Mo Xue laughed out loud as he heard the Prefecture Master’s words. "This little daughter of mine is a bit of a perfectionist. If a single strand of her strength is enough to deal with her enemy, she will absolutely not use any more than that."
"Indeed, she seems to have several sets of World Deity ranked secret techniques, yet she isn’t in any hurry to put them on display." Calm Sea Prefecture Master shook his head.
"Formidable."
"Truly formidable."
Even the ones below were gradually discovering how formidable Her Highness, Seventh Mei Yu, was.
The speed at which Seventh Mei Yu killed her enemies couldn’t compare to Xue Ying’s explosive strength or to Zang Xiao’s rampant slaughter, but her sword technique had an inherent aura of perfection. Despite her being only in the Deity realm, it was enough to make even stage three World Deities feel like her skill was nearly perfect in every aspect. Regardless of how difficult it would normally be to deal with an enemy, Seventh Mei Yu would still show some method to easily deal with them.
She kept killing and killing, and only when she could no longer deal with a black-robed man would she finally change to another World Deity ranked secret technique.
Indeed, Seventh Mei Yu had that many World Deity ranked secret techniques at hand. A single glance could determine that she had control over at least four different World Deity ranked secret techniques, a number far beyond that of Zang Xiao’s.
She was killing and reaping without stop, yet she remained completely calm as she did so. To her, displaying sword techniques was a form of fun; it left her with an intoxicating feeling of enjoyment.
Gradually, as Xue Ying’s spear techniques began to no be longer sufficient to suppress his enemies, and his killing speed reached an impairment… Seventh Mei Yu’s speed surpassed him and, before long, exceeded even Zang Xiao’s final result!
"I think you were right when you said that her innate talent is able to match your eldest daughter’s." The Calm Sea Prefecture Master looked up toward the scene of battle within the enormous scroll before turning aside and laughed. "You, old man, have that much life experience, and it would seem you’re quite good at teaching your children. How exactly did you go about training this little daughter of yours?"
"Haha…" Monarch Mo Xue laughed out. "I just hoped I would get to see her reach the stage three World Deity realm. As soon as that happens, I’ll seal my memories and proceed with my reincarnation. I could at least do that without having to worry too much."
"Mo Xue, can you not hold on for any longer?" the Prefecture Master transmitted over.
"To what purpose? I just spend most of my time hidden inside the cultivation Eden treasure, controlling the flow of time," Monarch Mo Xue transmitted back. "Ai, Old Long, I truly would not dare immediately go over to reincarnate myself. After all, after living for so long, I have truly gathered a lot of hatred on my back, and the desire for revenge that others have toward me is boundless! That’s the only reason I’m doing my best to delay just a bit little longer, until I truly reach my limit. I will then seal my memories and enter the reincarnation cycle."
The process of sealing one’s memories and reincarnating was fraught with danger.
The best outcome would be reaching the Deity realm and awakening the memories from their previous life. Cultivating from the level of a mortal to the Deity realm was easy to describe, but any misstep along the way might cause one to die and lose their soul. And this death was of the eternal sort.
As such, there were truly too many cases of old World Deities who decided to seal their memories and reincarnating, only to disappear from the world forever. After all, without the advantage of their memories, they might simply be born as slaves and never even get the opportunity to cultivate. Or, they might be used as human resources in the experiments of some mage out there, with their souls being used as the source of ingredients—which would cause them to dissipate in the process. Both of these were possible outcomes.
"I am truly envious of you, Old Long, for having been born as a mutated beast and having a lighter temperament. You have a much easier time keeping guard of your true heart due to these traits," Monarch Mo Xue transmitted.
"Unless one can step out of the temporal river to transcend all restrictions, can their life truly be eternal?" the Calm Sea Prefecture Master said.
As two men who had lived for far too long, they naturally shared a similar way of thinking.
"There’s not much I really care about, in the event of my death. My single wish is that you may take care of my daughters," Monarch Mo Xue requested.
"If it’s within my power, I will naturally do my best. In any case, this daughter of yours should get the chance to enter the tutelage of a powerful existence and become their disciple." The Prefecture Master nodded before looking upward and laughing. "Brother Mo Xue, it looks like your daughter has also come out."
Monarch Mo Xue followed the same motion. He had also seen Seventh Mei Yu be expelled.
Dressed in her white robes, Seventh Mei Yu remained as pure as ever. Her palms alone showed traces of blood, but even those dissipated into nothingness before long. She descended as calm as ever.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 433 - The Last One
chapters.content:
Chapter 433: The Last One
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"Our pitiful combat power leaves us with no hope to continue participating in the Myriad Flower Feast. Still, it’s worth it, even if just to broaden our horizons." Two Deities were chatting among themselves as they glanced at their surroundings. There were various Starfield Patrol Masters parading their grand auras, all of them at the World Deity level.
"There are nearly two thousand World Deities here, and even a grade two legion, the Calm Sea Legion, is here." One of the Deities, tall and thin in figure, raised his head to look toward the high platform. The pressure coming from that direction, even from someone like King Rong Hai who was seated at the boundary, could send any Deity experts into a shudder. There was no need to even mention the ancient and powerful Calm Sea Prefecture Master and Monarch Mo Xue, who were as profound as the world itself; they were like the origin and end of all, like the core of every Law of the World.
Their invisible pressure was such that it spawned a reverence at the most fundamental level of life.
"It’s true. Broadening our horizons is a welcome thing."
"Except for events like these, we would never get the chance to witness an existence at the level of the Calm Sea Prefecture Master…" Despite feeling rather jittery in their reverence, the Deities were still stealing glances upward. Their current experiences would be topics for discussion for a long time to come.
In the end, there could only be a total of one hundred Deities to represent the Calm Sea Prefecture at the Bloodshed God Palace.
Hu.
Seventh Mei Yu descended next to the Mountain Wu Star Field patrol legion, where she turned to look around her. Is Brother Dong Bo’s battle still ongoing?"
Indeed, Xue Ying was still in the middle of fighting.
His current situation was rather difficult, as the effect of his Chaotic Suppression had already long since lost its effectiveness. At the moment, he was relying on his Mirage body to hold on by the skin of his teeth, while using his Chaotic Suppression time after time! He was doing his utmost to hold on for a bit more time, but with the black-robed men surrounding him, the pressure he was facing was also much greater now.
Good, very good! The Chaotic Suppression has, indeed, too many weaknesses. Xue Ying was focused most on this move while under the absolute pressure. He was ecstatic to be in this situation, since one of his goals for participating in the Myriad Flower Feat had always been to challenge and refine himself, so as to quickly grasp hold of his next grade one Deity Heart, the Chaotic Deity Heart. At that point, he would be a stage two World Deity.
It seems I’ve truly reached a limit. These black-robed men are too strong. As he thought that, the spear techniques he was unleashing transformed.
Sou!
The originally tyrannical Chaotic Suppression followed an arc through space, accompanied by a terrifying penetrative force. The space surroundings the spear condensed into a star which gradually expanded before rapidly caving in and exploding. The spear’s tip pierced rapidly through the chest of a black-robed man before him, sending him crumbling and dissipating.
Secret skill—Star Meteor Annihilation!
In terms of pure strength, the Chaotic Suppression took the prize, but the outcome of a battle did not depend on solely strength. By comparison, Xue Ying’s strongest absolute move, the Star Meteor Annihilation, was a fused secret skill. In the end, Xue Ying had a large number of different skills to choose from.
Shua shua shua!
For a moment, countless illusory spear strikes could be seen arcing through the sky, each of them followed by an illusory meteor. This sort of attack causing the surrounding eight black-robed men to immediately retreat.
Secret skill—Star Aggregation!
At that moment, Xue Ying’s many different secret skills were finally put on full display. Now that they were being used in tandem, the black-robed men had a hard time trying to surround him and were instead being killed one by one! Their defenses and physical bodies were strong and could normally withstand many attacks, but very few of them could resist the piercing power of the Star Meteor Annihilation!
"Hahaha!" Previously keeping a low profile and merely whimpering and eating by himself, the White Sand City Lord finally stood up and burst into laughter. "Did I not say that this Brother Dong Bo of mine is the strongest? Just look at him, hehe, that combat power, that killing speed…it seems that you guys rejoiced a bit too early."
"So many secret skills?"
"Extreme Piercing? Mirage? Star? Space? This brat has grasped hold of four different grade two Deity Hearts? On top of that, he even has command over so many secret skills?"
"There’s that Mirage Deity Heart of his. It lets him condense that Mirage body, which essentially means that there are two of him participating in the battle."
Be it Marshal Qin, the Venomous Ying World Deity, the Ink Cloud City Lord, King Rong Hai, or the emissary from the Bloodshed God Palace, none of them could hide their shock.
This was because Xue Ying had just been using that overwhelming and direct move until that point! Even though he would occasionally display his Extreme Piercing, the only secret skill he displayed was of one type, his Chaotic Suppression. This spawned among them the misconception that Xue Ying could only use a single secret skill.
Kill, kill, kill!
A single use of Star Meteor Annihilation was much more effective than Chaotic Suppression! There was no need to even mention what happened with so many secret skills complementing each other. In a moment, the black-robed men were being killed one by one, and it didn’t take long until his result surpassed Zang Xiao’s.
"He is indeed slightly stronger than Zang Xiao, but a gap still exists between him and Her Highness, Seventh Mei Yu," Marshal Qin lightly said.
"Take another look." The Ink Cloud City Lord frowned.
Of the eight people present, a total of four had betted on Zang Xiao, including the Calm Sea Prefecture Master.
Upon placing their bets, they had immediately eliminated Xue Ying from their calculations and then also removed Seventh Mei Yu. After all, while they understood that she was groomed by Monarch Mo Xue, they felt that her personal comprehension ability wasn’t that great and could not compare with Zang Xiao, who improved by himself. In reality, however, Seventh Mei Yu truly was magnificent and talented of her own accord; she could grasp hold of a complete secret skill that was relatively perfect.
But now, it seemed that the one they underestimated most was actually the one called Dong Bo, who previously seemed able to use only direct and overbearing moves. Who would have thought he was hiding other moves?
Was it really the case that, up until that point, he was deliberately putting on a front of being overbearing?
"His secret skill is also quite perfect, but slightly lacking when compared to Seventh Mei Yu’s."
"He just hasn’t had enough time to cultivate. Seventh Mei Yu has lived for eighty thousand years already, but Dong Bo has merely spent about two thousand years cultivating. For his secret skill to be lacking by a bit is very normal. However, he has the Mirage Deity Heart, which essentially makes it so that two of him are participating together in this battle. His Mirage body can never die, so I feel like he has some chance for his kill count to surpass Her Highness, Seventh Mei Yu’s."
Second passed after second, and Xue Ying’s battle was starting to become taxing. After all, the black-robed men continuously increased in strength, until they eventually reached his own level.
Hong long long~ The offensive ability of the black-robed men already reached a terrifying level. At that point, a single move from their part could easily exterminate a Fierce Shaman Warrior.
"Time for the final stage!" Xue Ying reached his last stand. He was now using his body to directly withstand the attacks.
This was his Time Immemorial Body, a technique that specialized in survivability.
Back in Crimson Rock Mountain, Xue Ying had long since experimented with the limits of the third level of Time Immemorial Body and even tested the limits of the fourth level. Thus, he was feeling relatively confident.
"Good brat."
"He has a World Deity ranked secret technique focused on survivability."
"He even cultivated it to the grand success stage of the Deity realm." The ones watching him from the high platform—the Calm Sea Prefecture Master, and Monarch Mo Xue and the others—let out an involuntarily laugh. The two old men even turned toward each other as they continued laughing. The Calm Sea Prefecture Master said, "Hahaha, who would have thought the two of us would lose like this."
"I’ve won! This is awesome, so awesome!" The White Sand City Lord was so happy that his grin stretched from ear to ear. Moments ago, Xue Ying’s kill count had nearly reached Seventh Mei Yu’s. Once he began using his body to directly resist the attacks, it didn’t take long until he surpassed Seventh Mei Yu.
To the sides, the yellow-robed Venomous Ying World Deity, Marshal Qin, the Ink Cloud City Lord, King Rong Hai and the emissary were all helpless and speechless at the same time.
This was a loss they could accept—Dong Bo’s combat power was, indeed, stronger than they expected.
On the surface, it seemed like he had at least two World Deity ranked secret techniques, and he had trained them both to the limit of the Deity realm. It must be mentioned that there were quite a few who got their hands on World Deity ranked secret techniques, but very few of them succeeded in reaching the peak of Deity realm; it was a very difficult task. Even Xue Ying had only reached that level of the Great Chaotic True Force after getting through the Stafield Selections. As for the Time Immemorial Body, only after reaching the stage three realm of the grade one True Meaning of the World did he break through.
"I admit defeat." Xue Ying’s body was very tough, and the black-robed men could not harm him, but it did not take long until his true body was finally surrounded.
He found no sense in continuing after they entangled him, so he immediately admitted defeat.
Hua.
He was expelled back in mid-air, from where could see a large amount of figures below. All of a sudden, a sound was transmitted into his ears, "The twelfth batch has ended!"
The voice reverberated across every single location throughout the world.
For a moment, everyone below was looking toward Xue Ying, and even the existences on the high platform were staring in his direction.
After all, Xue Ying had lasted for an unusually long amount of time! His undying body allowed him to hold on for much longer and keep fighting until he had no more ways to continue.
I truly was last to exit, Xue Ying thought. I wonder what my rank will be.
He immediately flew back to the region where the people of Mountain Wu Star Field were located.
From a different location, Zang Xiao looked coldly at Xue Ying, who was descending from mid-air. He was among those who came out quite early. So what if he lasted longer? Who knows, this brat might not even rank in the top thousand.
"Brother Dong Bo, not bad; that was a truly good performance. Wait until the Prefecture Capital battle is over. I have a gift for you." Up on the high platform, the White Sand City Lord smiled as he looked toward Xue Ying. He had even transmitted a message over for Xue Ying’s ears alone to hear. He was in an ecstatic mood after having won huge in the previous gamble!
The sound of the White Sand City Lord’s voice startled Xue Ying so much that he jolted from his position.
The handsome teenager dressed in white robes who had long since come out, Seventh Mei Yu, smiled at him. "Brother Dong Bo was actually the last to come out, and with no injury to be seen on your body no less. Truly admirable, truly admirable."
"Coming out last doesn’t necessarily mean my kill count is the best. Let’s just wait until the rankings come out; we will know then," Xue Ying replied.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - Wait
chapters.content:
Chapter 434: Wait
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Jing Qiu and the other Deities from Xia Clan were gathered inside Xue Ying’s cavern, in the Bloodshed region of the Calm Sea Prefecture Capital. Everyone was focused on the ranking battle of the Myriad Flower Feast.
"I wonder what situation is Dong Bo in right now. That scroll world seems very dangerous." Emperor Yun Hai looked up into the sky, where the enormous scroll was located somewhere in the distance. Every once in a while, figures could be seen as they were expelled from within. There were even signs of fresh blood spraying out and the occasional shouts of agony. Together, they served to leave Emperor Yun Hai in a state of constant anxiety.
"Don’t worry so much. Dong Bo’s combat power is incredible; I’m sure he won’t encounter any problems with this ranking battle. Even if the worst should happen, Dong Bo is still a Realm Lord, and he could easily just refine another avatar." The Dragon Mountain Emperor laughed.
"What load of crap!" The Purple Thunder Emperor glared at him. "How could there be any problem with Dong Bo’s ranking battle. It’s only the first stage of many, while Dong Bo is at a level where powerful existences will surely fight over him as a disciple."
"Older Brother Purple Thunder, I was mistaken; my words were untrue. I admit my fault and will accept any punishment." The Dragon Mountain Emperor took up the cup of wine beside him and gulped it down.
The Purple Thunder Emperor laughed at the sight. "Dragon Mountain, you call this punishment? The content of that cup is an excellent and beneficial wine. According to Dong Bo’s words, it was obtained from Crimson Rock Mountain."
The Dragon Mountain Emperor chuckled.
Jing Qiu merely stood to the side, keeping her eyes peeled at the situation over at the distant enormous scroll. Suddenly, she stood up. "Look, quickly! It’s Dong Bo!"
"Dong Bo!"
Everyone present turned over.
As Deities, they could clearly discern that the figure who had just been expelled was none other than a completely uninjured Xue Ying! At the same time, a mighty voice resounded all over the place, "The twelfth batch has ended!" As soon as the voice ended, they saw Xue Ying descending down.
"Haha, Dong Bo was actually last to exit from the twelfth batch."
"Just because he was last to exit doesn’t necessarily mean he has the highest kill count."
"Mn, look at Dong Bo! There’s no sign on injury on his body, and neither is there a trace of blood."
The various Deities from the Xia Clan let out a collective sigh of relief upon seeing Xue Ying coming out alive. They all understood that the probability of Xue Ying being trapped within there would be low, but that didn’t stop them from worrying until they saw him with their own eyes!
"This was merely the twelfth batch. It seems like the ranking battle will last for another day," a hunk from Xia Clan, the Fierce Tiger Emperor, announced. "Now that Dong Bo is out, there’s nothing interesting to watch out for regarding this battle. Should we just wait around here like fools? How about we all go for a walk? I haven’t really gotten a chance to look around the Calm Sea Prefecture Capital after arriving here."
"Go out for a walk? Older Brother Fierce Tiger, have you no awareness of where you are? This is the prefecture capital! The Calm Sea Prefecture Capital! Even World Deities aren’t any big deal here. There are just too many people with huge backgrounds here! Disciples of powerful existences, children and relatives of the Calm Sea Prefecture Master, heirs from other nations… these people might not be anything much in terms of their cultivation, but their skill in bringing trouble to others is first class," Yun Hai explained.
"As we arrived, we saw some disciples and relatives from extravagant clans moving around in carriages and generally being very arrogant, but they would still follow the law to some degree."
"That’s not what it was," The Scarlet Flame Emperor, who wore a battle saber on his back, coldly stated. "We’ve been following the group participating in the Myriad Flower Feast, so there would naturally be nobody out there who would dare offend us. But if we were to go out by ourselves, we would have to be as obedient and low-profile as possible. The disciples and relatives of the extravagant clans here do follow the rules more strictly than those in smaller regions like starfields, but should it be in their interest to do so, they could easily capture a number of Deities and push them into slaughtering each other. It would truly be a pity for you to be one of those people."
"Ah." The Fierce Tiger Emperor was stunned. This was his very first time in a prefecture capital, after all.
"On a normal occasion, like a rare visit over to the prefecture capital, taking that risk would be fine," Scarlet Flame Emperor frankly stated. "But we are here following Dong Bo. His future is immeasurable, and it won’t be long until even we, as his followers, might get the chance to enter the Bloodshed God Palace and even obtain an entry rank each! By then, our identities will be on another level. So tell me, why would we take any unnecessary risks now?"
"Oh." Fierce Tiger nodded.
Of the Deities from the Xia Clan currently present, there were only a few who were reluctant to leave their old homes in the Deity world, while the majority was very willing to follow Xue Ying.
The more experienced they were, the better they understood that this chance to follow someone like Xue Ying was truly rare to come by!
In this regard, Xue Ying welcomed such an opportunity, since deepening his roots in the Deity world require many helpers. Of course he would resort to the ancestral Deities of the Xia Clan first to that purpose. Furthermore, he was overjoyed to be able to assist the ancestral Deities of his Xia Clan in any way.
Another day passed.
Most had stayed within their caverns, at most walking around the Bloodshed region. Very soon, Jing Qiu and the other Deities of the Xia Clan discovered that Xue Ying had returned.
With the ranking battle having ended, the participants were all returning to their caverns.
"Brother Dong Bo’s combat power is truly high. There should be no issue in getting through the ranking battle, and I trust you will make it all the way to the Bloodshed God Palace."
"Haha, you overpraise me. Even if you two fellow brothers were to fail, it should still be pretty easy to join the Bloodshed God Palace and gain an entry rank … In any case, the ranking results have yet to come out, so it’s too early to tell anything."
Xue Ying was walking alongside two other Deities, chatting on their way back. Soon, they separated and each flew toward their respective cavern, Xue Ying himself included.
"Xue Ying."
"Dong Bo."
Jing Qiu and the others all welcomed him by the entrance.
"How was it?" Jing Qiu asked. "How did the ranking battle of the Myriad Flower Feast go?"
"It was quite alright." Xue Ying nodded. "I’m quite certain I am in the top thousand for this battle."
Xue Ying would be humble in front of any random passersby, but he did not really care about putting any appearances in front of his loved ones and friends.
"Details regarding the rankings come out in three days." Yun Hai nodded from the side. "Ai, the battle is already over, and the results should logically have come out. They could easily announce the ranking results right now, yet they’re stubborn enough to wait for three more days."
Xue Ying laughed. "For the most part, it’s so they can turn time back to be sure that nobody went against the rules. Other than that, they want to investigate those who have potential… so as to make arrangements for the upcoming arena battle. From what I’ve heard, information about those with great potential is being sent back to the Bloodshed God Palace as we speak, and their background is also going to be checked in detail!"
"They’re sending back reports on the participants with high potential to the Bloodshed God Palace? And they will even be investigating their past experiences?" Everyone was shocked at this new information.
Xue Ying laughed. He found about about this matter from the treasure spirit, Crimson Rock.
"Indeed." Xue Ying nodded. "For instance, there are a few who have yet to cultivate any World Deity ranked secret techniques but have a truly high comprehension ability, so they will suffer more. The arrangements for the arena battle must be done properly, so it’s only natural that they would want to know more about the background of the participants. The Bloodshed God Palace will collect all of that intelligence before the next battle starts."
It was very likely that information on himself would also be reported.
That included his time in the Xia Clan…from his birth, to his entry into Crimson Rock Mountain, killing the Sorcerer God and Great Demonic God’s avatars, dealing with the avatar of the Wo Hai World Deity, and any event from after he entered the Deity world. Everything would be investigated.
Naturally, the matter of his grade one True Meaning had never been revealed to the public! The Temporal Temple could use all its strength to investigate, and they might be able to arrive at that conclusion, but even if that were to be done, it could not leak out the news! As a treasure spirit, it was bound to follow the rules absolutely.
"People with ultra-high comprehension abilities, who have yet have to cultivate any World Deity ranked secret techniques?" The Purple Thunder Emperor shook his head. "Such cases should be few and far between. After all, Transcendents with great innate talent would normally see a lot of focus placed on them! That is even more true once they become Deities and their comprehension abilities increased. As soon as they’re discovered, they would be invited over by the powerful organizations, becoming disciples under stage four World Deities or even powerful existences!"
"Mn. A large amount of participants for the Myriad Flower Feast are already disciples of powerful existences," Xue Ying said.
Before they became World Deities, even if they were disciples of powerful existences, they would, for the most part, only reach the level of honorary disciples and at most become inner disciples. As such, their status was naturally not that high. Of course, that statement did not include grade one True Meaning Transcendents! Powerful existences would naturally treat grade one True Meaning Transcendents like precious children, grooming them to the best of their abilities.
Xue Ying occasionally accompanied Jing Qiu and the other Deities from the Xia Clan, but the majority of his time was spent cultivating. The ranking battle had provided him with a lot of inspiration, especially when it came to the Chaotic Suppression—which he had already started pondering with the purpose of perfecting it.
Three days were truly too short an amount of time for any cultivator.
Lacking any sense of the flow of time, Xue Ying soon heard his wife’s voice calling out to him. "Xue Ying, Xue Ying, come out, quickly! The ranking results are going to be announced soon!" she shouted out.

chapters.title: Chapter 435 - Ranking
chapters.content:
Chapter 435: Ranking
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Hong long~
The stone gate leading to a quiet room opened, and Xue Ying rushed out. The Xia Clan Deities inside the cave abode already had their heads raised to see the results while Jing Qiu was waiting outside for Xue Ying. "Dong Bo, Look."
Xue Ying looked up. Before he realized, a huge, blood-colored scroll had already appeared in mid-air. It was unfolding little by little, the revealed parts showing various names from the the top to the very bottom.
"Number one thousand, Luster Horn Star Field, Yan Feng."
Name after name was revealed on the scroll. The ranking and starfield of each individual was written in rather small text, while the name was much larger!
The Deities of the Xia Clan, including Xue Ying and Jing Qiu, were all nervously watching the scroll. Xue Ying himself had to be on the current rankings, or his journey on the Myriad Flower Feast would be over!
"Hahaha, father, father, that’s your name." A clear joyous voice could be heard coming from an abode a few tens of meters away. Seeing how all of the Deity stage experts attending the Myriad Flower Feast were all arranged in that general area, the distance between the lodgings would be at least a few tens of meters, and at most a million meters. This could be the case since an ordinary abode was only a few meters in area.
"Congratulations, congratulations."
"Brother Yuan."
Voices sound out from all places.
As more rankings were announced, the ones who saw themselves taking a spot were all in a state of extreme joy.
Faint voices could be heard coming from the distant abodes, yet the small region where Xue Ying resided, in other words, the area resided by the Mountain Wu Starfield’s experts, was dead silent. Three hundred names had already been announced, yet not even one of them belonged to any expert from the Mountain Wu Starfield.
"All of you, make your way here," the voice of Patrolman Guan resonated.
"Patrolman Guan has asked us to go over, so let’s not tarry," Xue Ying said, doing his best to control his emotions. At the same time, he inwardly broke into laughter; he, a grade one True Meaning Transcendent, was actually nervous because of this public ranking.
"Dong Bo’s strength is incredible, so he’s surely ranked at the very top."
"Certainly."
"As I see it, his rank must be in the topmost one hundred."
The Xia Clan Deities chatted amongst themselves as they walked out. As they made their way along, all of them were looking up at the slowly unfolding scroll high in the air, watching out for any newly appeared name.
******
The abode where Patrolman Guan resided was naturally luxurious. At his behest, even the stage two World Deity Madam Sang, General Tu, as well as a few other World Deities had come over. In addition, there were many experts that had rushed over from various locations.
Despite Mountain Wu Starfield having sixteen peak Deities as participants, only eight of them were still alive after experiencing the ranking battle.
Of course, whether or not those who died had cultivated avatar techniques was unknown! In any case, of those who had rushed over to the battle, only only eight were still currently present.
"Brother Dong Bo."
Brother Dong Bo."
"Your highness Seventh Mei Yu."
Everyone hurried over to offer each other simple greetings, before turning back to to look up towards the scroll.
The a half-masked man with red hair, who was exuding extremely heavy killing intent, was holding onto the handle of his blade, occupied with staring rigidly at each name that appeared on the unfurling scroll. Not there; it was not there! It still did not appear!
"How can there still be nothing?" Patrolman Guan frowned.
"They’ve already announced six hundred names," General Tu stated. Both of them had been very confident in regards to the Mountain Wu Starfield, since their current forces were made up of two sufficiently strong existences—Seventh Mei Yu, and Dong Bo! Both of them had easily killed the Fierce Shaman Warrior. In their minds, breaking into the top hundred to enter the Bloodshed God Palace Battle was not certain, but to get some ranks in the first thousand should be no big deal.
However, as the rankings moved forward, everyone’s anxiety also increased. The further ranks were much harder to obtain!
"The eighth hundredth name!"
"The nine hundredth name!"
Time seemed to pass at snail’s pace. With nine hundred names having been announced, and the top hundred rankers now being announced, the names on the slowly unfolding scroll increased in size by a notch! The characters were larger and more eye-grabbing.
"There shouldn’t be any problem with your highness’ ranking." Even Madam Sang felt somewhat nervous. She was very confident in her highness, and even Prefecture Master Mo Xue himself had come over to watch the battle. As she saw it, the Prefecture Master was likely already aware of the final rankings. But, seeing how he had not come over to inform them, she would not dare inquire him of her own accord.
I’ve got to get in. I absolutely must get in! Hidden by the half mask, the eyes of the red-haired man overflowed with killing intent as he silently spoke to himself.
This was a chance to soar into the sky!
If one’s name was found amongst the top thousand, they could even lose further in the battle and still find it easy to join a powerful organization. Even entering the Bloodshed God Palace and obtaining ranking title would be very easy, perhaps even on a rather high ranked position! Usually, passing the Starfield Preliminaries was enough for one to obtain a ranked position. After all, in ten million years… a starfield would only produce ten or so such people, so it was only normal for them to be qualified for such positions.
The ninetieth rank.
The eightieth rank.
The names were now being revealed much slowe, and each time another showed up, it lead to loud cheers from some distant abode.
The seventieth rank.
Sixtieth… fiftieth… fortieth… thirtieth… twentieth…
"How can this be possible. It’s surely somewhere in there." The stage two World Deity, Madam Sang, frowned. Traces of anxiety were clearly visible in her eyes.
The handsome youth garbed in white clothing, Seventh Mei Yu, looked up serenely while showing a faint frown. It seemed as if a trace of worry plagued her also.
They’ve reached the first twenty names. Anxiety started affecting Jing Qiu’s thoughts as well. She watched attentively each new name as it appeared. Where’s Xue Ying? He can’t not have ranked amongst the top thousand…
"Next ranked is… Next ranked is…"
The Xia Clan’s Purple Thunder Emperor, Emperor Yun Hai, the Dragon Mountain Emperor and all the others looked on with nervous expressions.
None of them were able to hide their anxiety.
