Even Patrolman Guan and General Tu were now in the same boat. As the rankings went higher, their hopes were also becoming more and more uncertain. Patrolman Guan shook his head. "There’s no way. We have both His Highness, Seventh Mei Yu, and Xue Ying, so there’s no way we did not take any place in the rankings. I wouldn’t dare ask that they all enter, but at least one of them should have." Nine hundred and eighty five had now already appeared, yet not one of them belonged to the Mountain Wu Starfield.
Before long…
The twelfth name appeared, and then the eleventh.
And finally the tenth name!
"Tenth—Multi-Crane from the Three Spring Star Field." This name was clearly much bigger than those from before, with a single character practically taking up an entire row in the scroll."
"Multi-Crane."
"Ha ha, Master Multi-Crane, you are truly formidable."
"Ancestor Multi-Crane."
Celebratory voices could soon be faintly heard coming from afar.
However, silence reigned over the entire courtyard of Patrolman Guan’s abode. Everyone present stared closely at the scroll, taking in every single detail. The scroll slowly unfolded, and a new row was revealed.
"Ninth ranked—Mountain Wu Starfield’s Seventh Mei Yu."
For a split second, everyone in the courtyard assigned to the Mountain Wu Starfield was stunned.
"Hahaha…" Patrolman Guan finally let out a loud laugh. "He’s from my Mountain Wu Starfield, hahaha…"
"Congratulations, your majesty." Madam Sang was first to talk.
The white-clothed Seventh Mei Yu looked up, loosened her brows, and softly said, "The experts of the Calm Sea Prefecture truly are numerous like the clouds."
"Your majesty is unfathomable. Number ninth…you are ranked in the top ten."
"With your majesty’s strength, it’s guaranteed that the next stages will also be a breeze. There’s no way you won’t get to participate in the Bloodshed God Palace Battle."
"Amazing, amazing."
The surrounding people, including even the World Deities, all approached with words of congratulations.
Their compliments truly came from their hearts. Someone ranked eightieth or ninetieth in the ranking battle might not necessarily get a place in the top hundred after the remaining arena battle and survival battle. But for someone placed in the ninth spot, there was essentially no chance that they would not rank in the top hundred, even after two more rounds of selection. In other words, their passage onto the Bloodshed God Palace to attend the final battle there was assured.
The area controlled by Mountain Wu Starfield was booming with tumultuous cheers.
Yet amidst the uproar, the ancestor Deities of the Xia Clan were unable to hide their anxiety.
"How is he still not there. He should have appeared already!"
One after the other, they parsed the scroll again and again.
Alongside the celebration of Seventh Mei Yu’s accomplishment, the rankings displayed had unknowingly already reached the fifth name, and then the fourth.
"Third ranked—Hole Horizon Starfield’s Jiu She." This time around, the characters were even larger than before, and even suffused with rays of light.
Every living being in the Calm Sea Prefecture Capital seemed to focus on the scroll, all of them memorizing said name. To have taken third place in the ranking battle…just how exceptional would they have to be?
"Second ranked—Temple Comb Starfield’s Zui Gu Ke." This name was a size larger, and it released dazzling rays of light in every direction.
The entire Calm Sea Prefecture turned completely still. Everyone was watching and waiting…waiting for for the final name to appear!
This one has to be me, the red-haired man tightly gripped the handle of his blade with one hand as he silently spoke in his heart.
"The last one."
Yu Jing Qiu, as well as the Xia Clan Elders, all nervously raised their heads in expectancy.
Even Xue Ying himself was somewhat jittery as he looked up to see the final name…
"First ranked—" The final ranking was releasing a golden light of exquisite grandeur as it was slowly revealed, letter by letter…
"Mountain Wu…"
******

chapters.title: Chapter 436 - First
chapters.content:
Chapter 436: First
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Word by word, the final name began appearing on the scroll, attracting the attention of all the countless lifeforms present in Calm Sea Prefecture Capital.
"First ranked…"
"Mountain Wu Starfield’s…"
Patrol Master Guan, who had previously been congratulating Seventh Mei Yu, had been holding a goblet of wine; at this moment, his eyes became wide and round, and he subconsciously tightened his grip on the goblet. Chi chi chi~ The goblet became even more distorted despite being composed of extraordinary material.
"He is from our Mountain Wu Star Field." General Tu and the other World Deities were all stunned.
"Right, right, right; it’s me. It’s me." The half-masked, red-haired male became even more anxious as he looked at the scroll.
Everyone in the courtyard nervously gazed at the scroll.
The many Deities of the Xia Clan, Jing Qiu, and Xue Ying were also looking up at that enormous scroll, as it slowly revealed the full name of the first place contestant.
"Dong Bo!"
"First ranked—Mountain Wu Starfield’s Dong Bo!"
That huge row of characters, located at the very top, was the most dazzling name amongst all those currently glowing brightly, with the largest font as well. Presently, countless lifeforms in the Calm Sea Prefecture Capital were staring at that name. Being ranked first clearly indicated one’s combat power and potential. For that person to be ranked first in the ranking battle…as long as he did not die, he would certainly become a World Deity and have a bright future ahead! He could even be compared to the more extraordinary World Deities.
Patrol Master Guan and the others within the courtyard carefully examined that name, as they were afraid of being mistaken.
They were right!
Clearly revealed on the blood-colored scroll, in those dazzling golden characters, was—‘First place, Mountain Wu Starfield, Dong Bo!’
"Hahaha…"
"Dong Bo!"
"Brother Dong Bo, you are truly formidable."
"Haha, Dong Bo, I knew you could do it. First place, you ranked first in the ranking battle of the entire Calm Sea Prefecture Battle Selections for the God Palace Myriad Flower Feast."
Everyone in the courtyard began cheering. Patrol Master Guan, Madam Sang, General Tu, the Soaring Cloud Lake Master, and the other World Deities all came over to congratulate him. Those Deities who lived through the ranking battle, with the majority not harboring an hopes, also came over to congratulate him. After all, they met each other during the God Palace Myriad Flower Feast and were even from the same starfield! In the future, this friendship of theirs might be really helpful, as they could reach out to Xue Ying for help—with said help being provided as long as these minor matters were not of any issue to Xue Ying.
Cheers and laughter gushed up to the sky. The distant caverns from other starfields realized the moment they heard the loud racket—the one ranked first in this ranking battle should be located over there.
"Brother Dong Bo." The handsome, white-robed teenager, His Highness Seventh Mei Yu, smiled at Xue Ying. "Brother Dong Bo, you must really be formidable to seize the championship within the ranking battle. Close to two thousand starfields in the Calm Sea Prefecture, as well as many outsider Deities who had come to participate…yet in the ends, it’s still Brother Dong Bo who is the strongest."
"Brother Mei Yu praises me too much. Being ranked first in the ranking battle does not signify that I’ll rank first in the survival battle. Even if I rank first in both, that does not mean I am the strongest as well in life-and-death battles," Xue Ying replied.
"Brother Dong Bo is too humble." Seventh Mei Yu’s voice was truly gentle and pure. "You do know that such humility will displease others."
Xue Ying was dumbstruck.
Seventh Mei Yu giggled after seeing that.
At that moment, Jing Qiu, who stood beside Xue Ying, transmitted to him, "Xue Ying, I am standing right here!"
"Eh…" Xue Ying looked at his wife, transmitting back, "Jing Qiu, is there something wrong?"
"I am next to you, yet you are exchanging glances with someone else at this moment?"
"But he is a man!"
"Who says so! From what I see, she seems like a woman."
"You are truly…"
"Why, are you unhappy? Do you think I’m intruding on your flirtations with her?"
Xue Ying and his wife Jing Qiu transmitted messages back and forth.
Her Highness Seventh Mei Yu giggled upon seeing Xue Ying and his wife constantly transmit messages and turned away to leave.
"How, how can this be… It’s impossible. I must have seen wrongly; I must have seen wrongly." The red-haired male looked upward, staring intensely at that blood-colored scroll hanging in mid-air—at those golden characters, especially the biggest and most dazzling name of all. He neither dared to believe nor dared to trust that the name appearing there wasn’t his.
Thereafter, he carefully read through the entire scroll, from top to bottom. He wanted to find the fish that escaped the net; he wanted to find his own name!
But there were only two names appearing on the scroll from Mountain Wu Star Field. One was ranked first, while the other ranked ninth!
"I…
"I lost?
"Is this the end?"
The red-haired man gripped his saber sheath tightly, gritting his teeth as he walked away. He loathed the idea of even going to congratulate Xue Ying! Neither would he go congratulate Seventh Mei Yu!
"The God Palace Myriad Flower Feast has ended for me. In the future, I’ll definitely become stronger, transcending beyond Seventh Mei Yu and Dong Bo." The red-haired man’s eyes grew cold as he headed toward his own cavern.
In the huge Deity world, the Dark Abyss, the Material World…
There were people of many varying personalities.
There were those who thought their talents to be great. In the region they originated from, this might be true, but upon entering the vast Deity world, they would realize a huge gap existed! There would always be someone out there more talented than one could possibly imagine. If one always competed with others with the notion of complete superiority, it would create a mental imbalance. For example, Xue Ying was a grade one Transcendent but did not reveal this fact as he competed within the God Palace Myriad Flower Feast, nor did he dare to be arrogant. He had at least some self-awareness. His goal was to participate in the God Palace Battle and become a disciple under a powerful existence. If he could enjoy the Myriad Flower True Fruit, then that would be an even better outcome than he hoped.
As for his rank? It would be fine as long as he tried his best!
******
The arena battle was held three years after the ranking battle, followed by another three years before the survival battle would be held. Three years after that, qualified participants would proceed on to the God Palace to compete in the final God Palace Battle!
After each selection, a break of three years was provided, to give the participating experts a decent amount of time to consolidate their gains since tempering themselves on such a level during the selection battles was a truly rare opportunity. Three years was not a long stretch of time, but neither was it short. It was enough for one to quietly cultivate. In the face of the long lifespans of Deities, what was three years? That was truly not worth considering.
"Old Brother Dong Bo, in the future, you can visit my territory over at Luster Horn Star Field. I’ll certainly receive you well." The tall, huge figure entirely covered in golden fur then walked out of Xue Ying’s cavern. His head was entirely furred in golden hair as well, and a horn protruded from his head.
Xue Ying was even there to personally send him off. "Old Brother Ju, have a nice day. I’ll definitely go visit you when I am free."
After seeing him off, Xue Ying casually turned around and returned to his cavern.
"Dong Bo, there should be over thirty World Deities who have already visited you, right? That was even a stage two World Deity." Purple Thunder Emperor laughed.
"It is quite a headache becoming famous." Xue Ying shook his head.
Suddenly a voice transmitted in from outside.
"Dong Bo." A legion soldier came rushing in. He said in a polite manner, "Receiving orders from the master; the recently purchased intelligence report has just been sent over!"
"Intelligence report?" Xue Ying was startled as he walked over.
"It is the intelligence report on the top thousand Deity experts of the ranking battle. As of today, it is on the sale. The patrol master has bought copies and has gifted the report to you and His Highness Seventh Mei Yu," the legion soldier explained.
"I would have to ask you to help me transfer my thanks to the patrol master." Xue Ying immediately said. He then received a crystal being sent over by the legion soldier.
The soldier quickly left afterward.
Xue Ying began reading through the report. After touching the jade crystal, a huge influx of information surged into his mind. The crystal ball itself soon started dissipating.
"1000th place, Luster Horn Star Field, Yan Feng: cultivation period of about 1,653,000 years, has easily defeated the Fierce Shaman Warrior." The intelligence report even provided the scene of this ‘Yan Feng’ battling the Fierce Shaman Warrior during the Starfield Selections.
"999th place…"
Each and every one of the experts on the report was stated as such.
This intelligence report primarily stated one’s cultivation age and showed their battle during the Starfield Selections.
Because it was relatively simple, the price wasn’t that exorbitant.
After all, asking for a more detailed report—such as the battle scene during the ranking battle—was too difficult to compile. Only the God Palace Emissary, the Calm Sea Prefecture Master and a few others knew of such information. Even the Temporal Temple would be unable to investigate what occurred within that scroll treasure! As for intelligence reports on past history?
Like Xue Ying being a Material World Lord? A report on just Xue Ying was already truly expensive, much less a thousand Deity experts altogether.
At that moment, not just Xue Ying, but many experts including World Deities and several rich clan disciples and children had obtained that intelligence report.
Of course, they would closely follow those ranked at the top.
"Third place, Hole Horizon Star Field, Jiu She: cultivated period of about 5,916,000 years."
"Second place, Temple Comb Star Field, Drunk Guest: cultivated period of about 21,500 years."
"First place, Mountain Wu Star Field, Dong Bo: cultivated period of about 2,300 years."
The moment the intelligence report was released, and despite the report also including the battle scenes from the Starfield Selections, everyone focused primarily on the ages of the ranked experts.
"What, 2,300 years?"
"He cultivated for just over 2,000 years?"
"This Dong Bo…"
Everyone staying within Calm Sea Prefecture Capital, when reading this intelligence report, felt that the time this ‘Dong Bo’ spent on cultivation was truly astonishing.

chapters.title: Chapter 437 - Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 437: Invitation
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within the Calm Sea Prefecture Capital, the biggest and most extravagant palace, the Calm Sea Prefecture Master’s palace, served as the home of the Long Shi Clan.
The Long Shi Clan’s territory occupied an area of millions of square kilometers. The palace extended endlessly into the distance. Tremendous amounts of legion soldiers drove carriages through the sky as they patrolled the territory. Several rare Deity-level organisms also lived here. The closer one was to the core of the territory, the stricter the security would be—with more armor-clad World Deities standing at various checkpoints and periodically sweeping their gazes across the region.
The entire Calm Sea Prefecture rested in the palm of the Calm Sea Prefecture Master, and the legion directly subordinate to him was significantly stronger than that of the Starfield Patrol Army, with even World Deities filling the middling and upper ranks.
After all, being a prefecture master…
His own combat power could easily build an enormous empire! However, prefecture masters would rather be under the power of His Majesty Bloodshed God Emperor, as His Majesty would naturally not treat them unfairly.
Hou~ Deep within one of the magnificent palace halls in the Long Shi Clan’s territory, there resided an enormous pithole with three shackled Deity world creatures. Each and every one of them had four hooves, blood-red scales, and blood-red vertical eyes. These were none other than the famous Blood-eyed Fragment World Beasts, extremely precious World Deity-level organisms!
Just like Senior Xi Wei from Crimson Rock Mountain, whom was a World Deity realm plant life with immense power at her fingertips…
These Blood-eyed Fragment World Beasts were immensely precious. If properly groomed, a single beast could match the might of a stage two World Deity.
Beside the pithole, a teenager dressed in a luxurious black robe leaned against a railing. He tossed many precious fruits down to the beasts, causing them to leap up and try to snatch the fruits from the air. Occasionally, they would battle against each other for the sake of obtaining one.
"Second Prince, you desired my presence?" A tall, thin old man came hurrying over.
"Mn." The luxuriant-looking black-robed teenager nodded lightly.
The Calm Sea Prefecture Master was not actually a human! He was some sort of mutated beast from the dragon clan. He only ever had two children his entire life, the famous Crown Prince and Second Prince! Although the Second Prince’s combat power was weaker, as he was merely a stage one World Deity, the Calm Sea Prefecture Master quite liked his children. For example, these three Blood-eyed Fragment World Beasts had been acquired in a fortuitous encounter by the prefecture master, and he had given them to his own children.
The Second Prince also liked those three beasts of his and had paid the utmost attention in taking care of them.
"The result for this God Palace Myriad Flower Feast’s ranking battle is out, with the same old rules being used." The luxuriant-looking black-robed teenager continued overlooking at the three Blood-eyed Fragment World Beasts below as he ordered, "Invite those who are ranked in the top ten to my palace. I want to host a banquet."
"Yes," the tall and thin old man acknowledged.
"Is there anyone special among the top ten that needs to be noted?" the teenager casually asked.
The tall, thin old man respectfully answered, "There are three who should be watched.
"The first is the ranked one Deity called Dong Bo. According to our intelligence report, he has cultivated for about 2,300 years, yet he is ranked first. Furthermore, he is also a Material World Lord." The tall and thin old man added, "He is someone worthy of treating properly."
"Material World Lord?" The teenager nodded."Interesting. He has also cultivated for only a mere two thousand years or so. He is truly young and might possibly acquire a grade one Deity Heart within ten thousand years."
A cultivator being able to grasp a grade one Deity Heart within ten thousand years was second in status to only the grade one True Meaning Transcendents. Such cultivators could easily become a personal disciple of a powerful existence!
"What about the other two?" the luxuriant-looking, black-robed teenager asked.
"The other one is the ranked nine Seventh Mei Yu." The tall, thin old man elaborated, "This is news this old housekeeper obtained from the prefecture master; supposedly, that Seventh Mei Yu…is in reality the seventh daughter of Monarch Mo Xue."
"Seventh daughter of Monarch Mo Xue? Who would have thought this daughter of Monarch Mo Xue to be so formidable." The teenager nodded.
"The final one of note is the ranked two Drunk Guest; he is none other than the personal disciple of Yu Gong," the tall, thin old man finished.
"Yu Gong?"
The teenager turned around with slight signs of shock. "Yu Gong, that is a powerful existence! That Drunk Guest has already cultivated for over twenty thousand years and has yet to become a World Deity, yet he is a personal disciple of Yu Gong?"
"Right." The old man nodded. "This intelligence was gathered only after news of him attaining the second position had been reported up to the God Palace. It seems that Yu Gong likes him very much and has decided to accept him as his personal disciple."
"Drunk Guest?" The luxuriant-looking black-robed teenager lightly commented, "This is clearly just a title for him. Things are getting interesting. Personal disciple of Yu Gong, eh."
Disciples of powerful existences had differing statuses too.
Being an honorary disciple of a powerful existence? That was too ordinary a rank and shouldn’t even be mentioned. Such a cultivator would most likely be unable to obtain any chances of getting pointers from the powerful existence.
As for inner disciple? They had, at the very least, a chance of getting some mentoring.
Personal disciple! Those cultivators were truly regarded as important by powerful existences, with some being treated as if they were their children. These personal disciples of powerful existences, everyone was very vigilant in regards to these experts… During some battles or fights within the Deity world, it meant little if those honorary disciples and inner disciples died since battles truly happened too often. If any personal disciple were to be included, however, nobody would dare to easily kill them as it would incur the wrath of a powerful existence!
Powerful existences accepted very few personal disciples. Typically, the total number of personal disciples accepted by any powerful existence throughout their entire life could be counted on one’s fingers.
"This is getting interesting. It seems that our Calm Sea Prefecture will become increasingly lively in the future." The black-robed teenager smiled.
"Mn, Her Highness Seventh Mei Yu will most likely be returning to the Mo Xue Empire afterward. Dong Bo and Drunk Guest, however, will most likely have arrangements made for them to return to their home by the God Palace, but only if they prove successful in the future. They will surely gain a high status in our Calm Sea Prefecture," the tall, thin old man concluded.
"All of them have huge potential and should stand by my side. Hurry and make arrangements; send out invitations for them to visit," the teenager ordered.
"Yes," the tall, thin old man acknowledged.
The teenager garbed in black continued to observe those three Blood-eyed Fragment World Beasts within the enormous pithole. "Calm Sea Prefecture is truly becoming interesting." Even though the prefecture master was in possession of great combat power, was known to control everything within the prefecture, and was respected by many organizations, one could never be too careful! Ultimately, this territory belonged to the Bloodshed God Palace, as one of many territories under His Majesty. Nobody could do as they wished.
Even an ordinary legion soldier with an entry rank could not casually kill someone.
Even if the Calm Sea Prefecture Master was stronger, he could not casually kill others. Within the prefecture, there was a separation of powers, as was natural. Although the prefecture master himself paid little attention to such power struggles, those who were merely just a stage one World Deity, like the ‘Second Prince,’ deemed such matters to be of extreme importance! After all, the stronger one’s power, the greater the amount of attainable freedom and happiness.
Within Xue Ying’s cavern.
Ever since the intelligence report revealed his cultivation period to be a mere 2,300 years, the number of World Deities visiting him increased explosively! In the past, those who ranked first would usually have cultivated for a million or so years and could easily become a stage one, possibly a stage two, World Deity. Such a person was not someone many World Deities would come and visit.
But now…
They acknowledged Xue Ying’s youth and that his future would be even brighter than they expected. In the future, Xue Ying would most likely have a high status within Calm Sea Prefecture, and many World Deities would have to work under the whim and fancy of Xue Ying. While Xue Ying was still weak, they would naturally come and send gifts while befriending him; when Xue Ying became strong, he would most likely not care about such gifts anymore.
"Ze ze ze, not only are World Deities coming to visit you, even the Second Prince of Calm Sea Prefecture has sent an invitation over," Purple Thunder Emperor praised.
Xue Ying alo gazed at the black invitation card in his hand. It was imbued with a Deity imprint, which formed the words: ‘Long Shi.’
"I’ve heard that during every God Palace Myriad Flower Feast, the Second Prince of Calm Sea Prefecture will invite the top ten ranked experts from the ranking battle over for a banquet." Xue Ying laughed. "Earlier, that World Deity who came to deliver the invitation also mentioned that I can bring two people at most with me. Who among you are willing to go?"
The many ancestral Deities of Xia Clan shook their head profusely after hearing that.
"Not going, not going."
"If you can only bring two, then who will go? Definitely not me."
"You should bring along mage Jing QIu with you. We shouldn’t disturb you two."
The many Deities of the Xia Clan nodded.
Xue Ying smiled, shifting his gaze to his wife beside him, "Jing Qiu, how about you come with me?"
"Of course." Jing Qiu smiled. "I must go and experience such things."
The next day, an extravagant, black carriage landed by the entrance of Xue Ying’s cavern, pulled by nine lifeforms. Ten black-armored legion soldiers sat atop the carriage alongside a green-robed carriage driver, who respectfully shouted out when they reached the cavern entrance, "Sir Dong Bo, we are following the orders of our master to escort Sir Dong Bo to the banquet."
The door to the cavern opened, and Xue Ying and Jing Qiu walked out side-by-side.
Upon seeing the carriage, Xue Ying could not help but sigh inwardly. Each beast pulling the carriage was significantly more expensive than the Tapir Beast he had previously met. This carriage was far more extravagant than the one belonging to Soaring Cloud Lake’s Young Master, yet this carriage was merely being used to escort guests. This Second Prince of Calm Sea Prefecture was truly someone extraordinary.
"I’ll have to trouble everyone. Let’s go." Xue Ying walked up to the carriage with his wife and took a seat.
The ten legion soldiers accompanying the carriage were there as bodyguards.
The green-robed carriage driver began driving the carriage, urging the nine beasts to rapidly charge forward and pull the carriage with them as they flew through the vast sky like a meteor.
******

chapters.title: Chapter 438 - Banquet
chapters.content:
Chapter 438: Banquet
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The carriage, being pulled by multiple beasts, traveled very fast towards its destination…
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu were surveying the passing scenery from their seats inside the carriage. As a whole, the Calm Sea Prefecture Capital reached enormous proportions, making sights such as vast and grand structures, as well as undulating mountains, common.
"I didn’t even get the chance to properly see the Calm Sea Prefecture Capital in its entirety. At most, we got a glance from the distance because of that huge wall blocking off the path." Jing Qiu sighed in praise.
"Indeed." Xue Ying turned his sight towards the enormous wall shrouded by clouds blocking off the end of the road. "The Calm Sea Prefecture Capital is an extraordinary place. It’s only normal, seeing how it’s been crafted by the first Prefecture Master, and then fortified by the many subsequent generations. The arrays on the wall are truly deep, nothing someone like us could hope to understand."
Together with his amazement, a feeling of pride surged up in Xue Ying’s heart.
As long as he did not slack off, he was predestined to become a stage four World Deity in the future, and he even had hope to join the ranks of powerful existences!
"We’ll arrive soon," the green-robed carriage driver interjected.
The nine beasts were now descending towards the clump of towering palaces. One of them belonged to none other than the Calm Sea Prefecture Master himself, and the territory of the Long Shi Clan was in that area also.
As it rapidly descended, the carriage soon arrived in front of the door leading to a side palace chamber.
"Sir Dong Bo." A female attendant dressed in violet robes was waiting by the entrance; she was the one responsible for receiving guests.
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu came down from the carriage.
Heavens! Xue Ying swept his vision across his surroundings. Standing right outside the entrance to the palace was a row of legion soldiers wearing golden armor, all of them emitting auras at the level of World Deities!
There are ten World Deities standing outside the palace as mere guards? Xue Ying inwardly sighed at the thought of how deep the foundation of the top clan in the Calm Sea Prefecture was. Accompanied by his wife, he finally entered the towering palace, as led by the attendant.
A number of guests had already arrived at the palace hall, a group which also included the handsome teenager dressed in white robes, Seventh Mei Yu. He was sitting cross-legged by the side of a long table, with two beautiful women at his back.
"Sir Dong Bo, this way, if you please." The violet-robed attendant brought Xue Ying to his seat which was located right next to Seventh Mei Yu’s.
There, he also entered a cross-legged posture, with his wife at his side.
"Brother Dong Bo, is your wife the only one accompanying you?" Seventh Mei Yu turned over.
"We’ve come here merely to broaden our horizons. Is Madam Sang not here also?" Xue Ying asked, a hit of surprise in his tone. Madam Sang was the stage two World Deity charged with protecting Seventh Mei Yu, yet she was not present?
"There is no need in her attending such a banquet," Seventh Mei Yu said frankly. What a joke. Monarch Mo Xue was currently there, at the Long Shi Clan, accompanied by the Prefecture Master himself! As long as she remained in the Calm Sea Prefecture Capital… it would be impossible for her to face danger. With how powerful her father was, he could easily suppress the entire region of the Calm Sea Prefecture Capital with but a thought. There was simply no need for Madam Sang to guard her closely under such circumstances.
As they chatted, attendants stepped up again and again, respectfully kneeling down before bringing more delicious food and wine to Xue Ying’s table. "This is a token of appreciation from the second prince. Sir Dong Bo, please enjoy," an attendant said as he left.
"A token of appreciation from the second prince?" Xue Ying saw a stony food tray holding a flask of wine, as well as six separate plates, atop of which spirit fruits and various other types of food were placed.
Xue Ying removed the stopper from the flask, lightly sniffing its contents before turning to his wife with a laugh. "Jing Qiu, it would seem this second prince has spent quite a lot. Altogether, the flask of wine and the spirit fruits should cost around 1,000 Deity crystals."
"Xue Ying, take a better look at the tray," Jing Qiu replied.
Giving the stone tray a more thorough investigation, Xue Ying was stunned to find that, despite seeming like a commonplace item at first, an incomparably pure energy was emitting from it.
"Faith Stone?" Xue Ying was startled.
The reason World Deities would try to spread their name and gather the faith of countless living beings was precisely the incomparably precious type of energy known as Faith Energy.
Meanwhile, Faith Stone a material condensed from the Faith Energy itself! Normally, it would be cut into smaller pieces of standardized sizes, normally as large as the thumb pig. The tray before him would have to be crafted out of several thousand Faith Stones. In this case, the material used was most likely the primitive form of condensed Faith Energy, which was then cut into this specific shape.
Her Highness, Seventh Mei Yu, laughed from the side. "Those rich clans sure love doing such things most. Other than cutting Faith Stone in the form of trays, they would even use some larger chunks which accumulated over longer periods of time to make sculptures. Even the material used to make this tray alone, if calculated in terms of Deity crystals, would likely cost around 100,000 Deity crystals! And that gift wasn’t sent to you alone; all those who ranked in the top ten have likely already received a similar tray. This is the true present the second prince sent."
"100,000 Deity crystals? Adding up the cost of ten such items will bring the total to one million Deity crystals." Xue Ying shook his head and sighed. "That’s one incredible sum."
One million Deity crystals was around roughly equivalent to what an ordinary stage one World Deity could normally save up, yet it was nothing more than a welcoming gift in the hands of the second prince!
In truth, it was not that exaggerated. Any one who could rank in the top ten was devilish, and had most likely been through various miraculous encounters in their pasts. Even a million or two Deity crystals would not be anything much to them! However, for a gift of 100,000 Deity crystals to be a ‘token of appreciation’… This gift of a tray made from Faith Stone would most likely be remembered by the top ten rankers for the rest of their lives.
More guests arrived, one after another. Amongst them were other top ten rankers from the Calm Sea Prefecture ranking battle, as well as various personages from rich clans throughout the Calm Sea Prefecture.
Finally, after everyone else arrived, the second prince finally made his appearance.
"Ladies and gentlemen, as you know, the Bloodshed God Palace only hosts the Myriad Flower Feast every 10 million years, and as such, it is known as the the grandest occasion in the entire Deity world. Today, I have invited the top ten rankers of the ranking battle because I believe that, nine years from now, they will all be on their way to the Bloodshed God Palace itself, to fight in the final battle before the very eyes of His Majesty and many other powerful existences. Come now, all of you, in commemoration of this grand occasion, and in celebration you ten, let us have a toast." The luxuriant-looking teenager in black robes who was seated in the highest position, raised his wine goblet.
Everyone else raised their wine goblets in response to the second prince’s words.
"Let me briefly introduce the others." The black-robed teenager laughed. "To my left is Brother Zhen Feng, and he is none other than the great-grandson of the Left Palace Master." The full names of powerful existences could not be casually mentioned.
The one mentioned was a blue-robed man with a full beard, his appearance rather decadent as a whole. He was sitting there, focused on his wine. When he was referred to, he casually glanced around him, and then went back to his drinking.
"This is Old Brother Luan Qi, the only son of the West Yong Legion Marshal."
"This is…"
The second prince gave a short presentation of the other guests.
A total of twelve heirs from the rich clans had come over today, with nine of them being World Deities, and three others being Deities! For the most part, Deities would not be able to keep their true hearts stable. They would eventually crumble and, after a period of time, they would die! In the case of the West Yong Legion’s Marshal Luan… he had a total of nine children, but only one of them had became a World Deity, while the other eight remained ordinary Deities. Eventually, each and every one of their True Deity Hearts had crumbled, causing them to die. The only one still alive was this Luan Qi.
Among those invited over today were heirs from the clans that wielded real power in the Calm Sea Prefecture.
After the introductions were concluded, everyone became more familiar with each other.
There were beauties singing and dancing within the hall, and the heirs from the rich clans had also taken to conversing with Xue Ying and the other nine Deities.
This is not that bad. Any one of these heirs from the rich clans is more polite than that Young Master of the Soaring Cloud Lake. Xue Ying discovered that most of them were World Deities, two of them even at the stage two, yet they were all speaking respectfully to him. It was only the three Deities who were more lacking in terms of etiquette.
"Big Brother Luan Qi, come, come. Why don’t the two of us have a bet?" A tall, silver-garbed teenager shouted.
"Since Old Brother Ying wants to bet, there’s no way I could refuse." A strand of coldness flashed through Luan Qi’s eyes as he casually laughed. "I wonder, will it be in war or beauty?"
"It’ll have to be beauty! A fight would only serve to dirty this place, which would make the second prince unhappy. I would have to suffer the consequences of that myself," the silver-robed teenager said. "There’s this World Deity treasure I have which my father gave me to play around with. However, I find it rather boorish, so I’ll use it as my part of the best."
With those words, the silver-robed teenager flipped his hand to take out a blood-colored, twin-headed axe.
Luan Qi frowned for a second, before a smile returned to his face. "Alright. I’ll play with you. The only thing I can bring out is this World Deity treasure worth one million Deity crystals." He casually flipped his hand, taking out a sword kept in an azure sheath.
At this sight, Xue Ying could not help but feel that some sort of enmity existed between the Deity known as General Ying and Luan Qi. Otherwise, there would have been no sense in bringing out such expensive items for a bet.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 439 - Falling Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 439: Falling Out
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying was already aware that the rich clans would often employ different type of gambling platforms. Other than the most commonly seen one, known as the bloody battle platform’s bloody battle, there were other kinds of betting such as in terms of beauties, or mutated beasts. The type known as the battle of beauty was amongst the more commonly seen ones, and it entailed each side sending out a beautiful woman, with no protective garb of any kind, who would fight using only the weapons they were provided with.
This type of battle would end once either side was injured, so it could already be considered quite ‘benevolent’, by comparison with the bloody battles of the mutated beasts, which would not end until one side killed the other.
"Hahaha, since Old Brother Ying and Old Brother Luan Qi are in such a happy mood, as the host, I will allow everyone to place their bets as well. The rates are 1:2, so anyone can enjoy some casual gambling," the second prince dismissively said, with an expression that seemed like he was smiling, but at the same time not.
"I’ll place my bet on Old Brother Ying’s side. Last time, he lost quite wretchedly, so I’m sure he’ll be bringing out quite an extraordinary beauty this time around."
"I’ll still bet on Brother Luan Qi’s side."
The heirs from the rich clans were already placing their bets. At the same time, Xue Ying and the other nine rankers also joined them in betting, so as to give them face. Naturally, they had a tacit understanding of each other, so they did not bring out huge sums; their bets did not exceed 10,000 Deity crystals each.
Very soon…
Two women walked inside the palace from outside.
One was dressed in white, the other in violet, yet both were barefoot and bereft of any form of armor.
The two women were now facing each other, one now holding onto a sword, the other wielding a scimitar with both hands. They were staring at each other.
"You’ve actually sent Bai Ji again?" The silver-robed teenager, General Ying, laughed. "Big Brother Luan Qi, you know that I’m well aware of Bai Ji’s combat power, yet you would still dare send her out again?"
"You can continue talking once you show me that you have any chance of winning," Luan Qi replied frankly.
The silver-robed teenager gaze a meaningful look towards the violet-robed woman.
And in response, the violet-robed woman understood that she could not afford to lose this battle! It might have been just a beauty battle which would end as soon as one was injured, but General Ying would never let her off if she were to lose!
Sou. Sou.
The two women finally made their moves. The fluttering white robes of the first spawned a blurrish illusion, and her sword followed an arc through the sky.
At the same time, the violet-robed woman had disappeared nearly instantly, only to reappear next to her opponent. The two immediately took to trading blows in mid-air.
The weapons of the two clashed as they exchanged moves time after time, dodging with any opportunity.
The figures of the two participants in the beauty battle warmed the heart and delighted the eyes!
Formidable, Xue Ying muttered to himself. The combat power of both these girls should definitely be enough to let them pass the starfield selections. However, they are likely quite old already, so they’re no longer qualified to participate in the Myriad Flower Feast."
Any participant in the Myriad Flower Feast had to be below eleven million years in age!
In truth, most Deities would cultivate really slowly. For instance, the ancestral Deities of the Xia Clan such as the Purple Thunder Emperor, Emperor Yun Hai, or the Scarlet Fire Emperor, were all more than ten million years old. The Deities of the Deity world who truly reached an extremely powerful level would have usually cultivated for more than 50 million years. However, old age would greatly decrease the chances for a cultivator to reach the World Deity realm. The Myriad Flower Feast ultimately sought after experts of incredible potential.
If age wasn’t taken into consideration, the strongest Deity of all might just prove to have lived for more than 100 million years. There would even be a chance of such a person dying from their True Deity Heart crumbling before the Myriad Flower Feast even ended. That would be nothing less than a bad joke!
Pu!
Another sword light passed through the sky.
When the two figures landed, the violet robe of the woman was now torn, and a huge injury could be seen on her arm. Traces of blood had spread throughout the palace hall. In spite of her injuries rapidly recovering, the woman’s face turned pale. She had lost. She had really lost.
"Trash!" the silver-robed teenager roared, a savage expression on his face.
As she heard that, the violet-robed woman was unable to stop herself from trembling.
"Get yourself over here," the silver-robed teenager coldly ordered, and the woman immediately rushed over nervously.
"Old Brother Ying, don’t tell me you’re actually about to kill another beauty who lost a battle." Luan Qi laughed. "That would have been fine on a different occasion, but we’re here today in front of the top ten rankers who are here as guests."
"It’s not up to you how I manage my own business." General Ying sneered.
Luan Qi frowned, but then simply let out a laugh of satire, not saying anything else after that.
"Haha, it’s Old Brother Luan Qi’s victory. There were quite a few people who placed bets on on Old Brother Luan Qi. It seems that, as the banker, I’ve incurred some heavy losses this time." Not moving from his seat above, the second prince instead sent down orders for the Deity crystals to be brought out and distributed to the winners. Xue Ying himself had also placed his bet on Luan Qi. He felt that, as a World Deity, Luan Qi would have a greater chance to win such deals, and that proved to be correct. He earned a bit through this deal—10,000 Deity crystals.
General Ying grabbed the violet-robed woman who was kneeling by his side and forced her to help pour wine and serve him during the banquet.
The songs and dances resumed, some rarely seen lifeforms even having come out to perform. Overall, the banquet was bustling with activity.
General Ying was being rather silent; he was bummed out after losing the bet. Eventually, his vision landed on the opposite side of the room where Xue Ying was located alongside Jing Qiu. She was laughing and chatting alongside her husband.
Why is it that, no matter how I try to cultivate, it proves useless, yet he can cultivate for only 2,000 over years and become so powerful? He’ll even geto to become a World Deity with ease! Even his woman is so beautiful. General Ying’s eyes were filled with coldness.
"Haha… Brother Dong Bo," General Ying suddenly mouthed.
Back in his seat on the opposite side, Xue Ying was initially startled. He then looked back and replied with a smile, "General Ying."
"Brother Dong Bo, I’ve witnessed you act before, and I feel some affinity towards you. You may have this beauty." General Ying waved his hand. The violet-robed woman was momentarily startled, yet he only glanced at her. "Your life will be in Brother Dong Bo’s hands in the future."
As soon as she heard that, the mood of the violet-robed woman immediately brightened, and she turned happy. She had been afraid that General Ying would just sentence her to death.
Xue Ying couldn’t comprehend the situation. "General Ying, what is going on?"
"Are you perhaps looking down on me?" The silver-robed General Ying frowned.
"I would not dare," Xue Ying replied.
"Haha, Brother Dong Bo, since seeing how Old Brother Ying is offering her to you, it would be best if you just accept her."
"This is just him giving you a beauty. You best receive her."
The other heirs from the rich clans took to encouraging him.
"I’ll have to thank General Ying, then." Xue Ying sent a glance to his side. It was not difficult to discern how terrible the outcome would be for the violet-robed woman after her defeat. In that case, he found it fit to just accept her. As he did so, he transmitted over to his wife, "Jing Qiu, she’ll be yours to command in the future." Jing Qiu smiled back.
At the sight of her smiling, General Ying could not help but squint his eyes.
She was beautiful beyond words.
And her temperament only served to make her beauty even more transcendental!
"Haha. Brother Dong Bo, seeing how I’ve given you a beauty, it would only be fair that you send one back to me, am I correct?" General Ying said. "I think it would be best if you give me the blue-robed woman by your side, alright?"
Xue Ying was stunned at first, but his expression rapidly turned ashen-gray.
At the same time, to his side, Jing Qiu was astonished for a moment, before a fury hard to conceal overtook her.
The atmosphere permeating the entire palace hall turned heavy, and the heirs from the rich clans started to sense that things were about to go awry.
"General Ying, have you perhaps drunk too much?" Xue Ying coldly retorted.
"What, you’re not even willing to hand over a single woman? Are you looking down on me?" A layer of frost was now visible in the eyes of the silver-robed General Ying.
"This woman is my wife." Xue Ying unknowingly crushed the wine goblet he was holding into pieces. He sent the silver-robed teenager a cold glare, "General Ying, don’t you think you’re taking this too far?"
"Who cares that she’s your wife? Did you not hear me when I told you to hand her over?" General Ying replied with squinted eyes.
A trace of killing intent was now easy to discern in Xue Ying’s eyes.
It was at that precise moment that Luan Qi’s transmission reached Xue Ying’s ears, "Old Brother Dong Bo, Ying Er’s father might be a stage three World Deity, but he is merely an imperial bodyguard under His Majesty. However, his aunt is none other than the famous Venomous Ying World Deity of our Calm Sea Prefecture! He is his father’s sole child, and he’s just a Deity. He has only cultivated for 70 million years so far, but his personality is quite unique; without consuming any more treasures, he’ll find it unable to hold onto his true heart any longer. That is why he’ll go rather crazy every time he goes about conducting business. You’ll find no real worth in going against him head-to-head."
"Old Brother Dong Bo," another voice transmitted a different message to him, this one belonging to the second prince. "General Ying’s background is truly huge. He is rapidly nearing the time for his True Deity Heart to crumble, so he has turned rather mad. Even I can no longer handle him nowadays, so don’t go hard against him."
The two of them transmitted messages over.
"Old Brother Ying, Old Brother Dong Bo took the top rank in the ranking battle, and his relationship with his wife is very deep. I suggest you take a step back this time," the second prince said from his seat high above.
"Second prince, this matter is between me and Dong Bo. It’s best if you don’t barge in." General Ying sent a savage glare in Xue Ying’s direction. "Now, are you deaf or what? Did you really not hear what I just said?"
Xue Ying’s right hand went loose, and the fragments of the wine goblet he had just crushed fell onto the table. He then looked at that silver-robed teenager with a grin.
Hua.
A blue-robed teenager had suddenly appeared right next to General Ying—it was none other than Xue Ying.
Pa pa pa pa pa pa pa! He immediately took to slapping General Ying’s face. The scene of him being slapped a dozen times in a row was like an illusion. In fact, he was slapped so hard that he was sent flying backwards. It was only after a gray-robed old man acted that he stopped in mid-air. The old man was livid, but he was, after all a stage one World Deity, and he did not think there would actually be someone in the palace who would be so daring as to act against his young master. The appearance of the Mirage body had truly been too sudden.
"You…you would dare hit me?" The slaps from before actually forced him to spit out some blood, and his teeth were all absent. Even his head felt dizzy. Even so, General Ying still turned back and to glare at Xue Ying on the other side of the room.
"Your mouth is too dirty!" Xue Ying sneered.
******

chapters.title: Chapter 440 - See-through
chapters.content:
Chapter 440: See-through
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
A freezing atmosphere immediately descended upon the big hall.
The second prince, Luan Qi, and all the other heirs were shocked to witness such a scene. Even the rest of the top ten rankers, such as Drunk Guest or Seventh Mei Yu, each and every one of them was bewildered.
Not for a moment did they consider Xue Ying would have such a violent temper that he would immediately resort to violence against General Ying.
This Dong Bo, he was so humble and polite before that it would have been impossible to guess he would have such backbone. Despite my warnings about Ying’s background, he didn’t hesitate to hit him. It would seem Dong Bo might have a good temperament, but he’s not the sort of person you can recklessly insult, the second prince thought to himself, back on his high seat. He had clearly witnessed everything Xue Ying had done to General Ying.
The second prince gained a much clearer understanding of Xue Ying’s temperament from his previous actions. In the future, once Xue Ying reached a high standing in the Calm Sea Prefecture, the prince would find it much easier to deal with him being already aware of the other party’s temperament.
"You, you…" The silver-robed General Ying turned livid. Over the many years, had anyone ever dared to hit him before?
"Your mouth was too dirty, so I decided to thrash it about a little. I won’t pursue this matter any further, so just let it end like this, okay?" Xue Ying was still sitting calmly at his table. "General Ying, I hope you now understand that not everyone will sit still and take it while your provoke them through your actions."
By this point, General Ying was trembling in fury.
Truthfully, his True Deity Heart was very close to crumbling, and he was already somewhat crazy. In the end, Xue Ying’s slaps and his following sermon finally took him over the brink.
"What are the two of you doing just standing around?" General Ying turned his head to look at the gray-robed old man and another male attendant of his and shouted, "Go on and catch him for me! Catch that damned couple; I want to show them the consequences of offending me!"
"You’re telling us to act against him?" The grey-robed old man and the other male attendant were clearly hesitant.
The old man was a stage one World Deity, while the male attendant was only a peak Deity.
"Not only is he a participant in the Myriad Flower Feast, he actually took the top spot in the ranking battle…" The grey-robed old man was unsure how to proceed. His Majesty had already sent orders down to stop anyone from disrupting the Myriad Flower Feast.
"You piece of trash! I just ordered you to catch him, not kill him! What I told you to do was catch both of them. I may not be allowed to kill him, but his wife holds no official rank, nor did she participate in the Myriad Flower Feast. Go, go! You’ve already received your orders!" the silver-robed General Ying hollered.
Knowing that his young master had finally turned completely mad, the grey-robed old man didn’t dare to disobey him. He turned his head to look at Xue Ying.
Back in his seat right in front of General Ying’s entourage, Xue Ying calmly took another bottle of good wine and pour some for him. Only then did he spare a glance in their direction. This calm gesture sprouted a seed of admiration in the grey-robed old man heart. I have no choice but to move against him. The general won’t spare me if I hesitate any further.’
轰~~~~
Hong~
The old man immediately unleashed his deity domain, and then appeared before Xue Ying with a single step.
Watching this scene from his seat high above, the second prince creased his brows into a frown. An old man with a tall and skinny figure that served him was also coldly looking down on them when, all of a sudden, the palace hall covered by another, more powerful domain, in its entirety. This new domain sent even space itself in that area to the brink of collapse, and some faint particles could be seen flowing lazily all around it. Everyone could tell from a glance that the particles contained great power.
The grey-robed old man felt himself be bound. He would have likely been able to break free, but he was also well aware of the strength difference between him and the caster of that domain, so he could only look up towards the second prince.
"Lord Cang." The old man turned his vision towards the man to the second prince’s side. That person named Can Chun was the second prince’s butler. He was of the younger generation from Cang Shi Clan, a clan more powerful than the Long Shi Clan itself, since it had a powerful existence as their ancestor. Cang Chun had received great favor from Calm Sea Prefecture Master, having expressed his desire to forever serve Long Shi Clan even before becoming a third stage World Deity. The Prefecture Master therefore sent him to serve his second son instead.
"That’s quite enough." The second prince knit his eyebrows. "Brother Ying, Dong Bo took the top spot in the ranking battle. It’s already been ordered for anything pertaining to his person to be reported to the higher ups of the Bloodshed God Palace. With how you’re acting, are you perhaps seeking death of your own accord?"
"Second prince, are you sure you want to stand in my path?" The silver-robed teenager looked up at the second prince with the eyes of a lunatic, an action towards which the second prince could only feel disdain.
This one had really gone mad!
He had witnessed many Deities who had reached this stage before—they could no longer keep their True Deity Heart in check, and it would soon crumble. Unless he absolutely had to, he would never bother with this kind of lunatic. The banquet itself was a good example; he had not wanted to invite him, but was afraid that General Ying might show up even if he didn’t. It was impossible to predict the actions of lunatics like him.
"Yes. Of course I have to stop you," the second prince replied from his seat.
General Ying was stunned to hear such blunt words. The second prince rarely went hard on him, but if they really were to clash, General Ying would find himself in a difficult position; he had no way to win over the second prince.
"Stopping you now is also my way of helping you," the second prince explained. "Are you not aware that Dong Bo comes from the material world?"
"Material world? What does his coming from the material world have to do with this current matter? To have dared hit me… hmph hmph. How could I spare him after having suffered such disgrace?" General Ying said with a frown.
Second prince secretly cursed. This Dong Bo… I only asked him to endure so that I could stop General Ying in time before he became even more arrogant. Had Dong Bo not made his move, I could have easily solved this issue. But now… This second Ying has gone completely off the rails.
His original plan was to act late so that Xue Ying would feel grateful towards him. He would only move once he felt that Xue Ying could no longer endure it any longer, but who could have known that Xue Ying would be so fast to resort to violence.
"He came from the material world, and has only cultivated for around two thousand years. Are you still unable to connect the dots?" The second prince sighed. "Brother Ying, Dong Bo is a Realm Lord! This body joining us here, at our banquet, is nothing more than an avatar. His original body still resides in the material world. Unless I’m mistaken, his wife’s real body is also still in the material world."
"He’s a Realm Lord, while his and his wife’s body are in the material world. What about it?" General Ying mindlessly retorted.
"Do you still not get it? This couple is not afraid of death in the least," the second prince shook his head as he explained. "Should you push them too far, they might just self-destruct. To them, that would be nothing more than losing an avatar; they could easily cultivate more. However, to nurture another avatar from the embryo stage to his current stage… I’m afraid he would not have enough time until the next battle.
"For the first ranker to be obstructed from joining the Myriad Flower Feast… His Majesty has already given strict orders in this regard. Should news of this reach higher up, the fault will be completely on you. You tell me, what would happen to you then?" the second prince asked.
General Ying was stunned at the revelation.
"On top of that, even your aunt and your father might be implicated in your crime," the second prince stated.
"Ah!" General Ying was startled. He glanced across the room in Xue Ying’s direction.
Still holding onto his wine goblet, Xue Ying lazily looked back.
This damned brat! He was actually hiding this kind of scheme. General Ying gritted his teeth.
Xue Ying inwardly praised, This second prince is pretty smart! He’s putting pressure on General Ying, while also explaining my true intentions to him.’
Even then, Xue Ying wasn’t afraid of General Ying in the least.
Self-destruction?
That was nothing more than a last resort, since doing that would still result in him losing an avatar!
In truth, Xue Ying understood the most fundamental part of this exchange. Other than himself, the one within the hall who wanted him unscathed most was the second prince himself!
**

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - Fury
chapters.content:
Chapter 441: Fury
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The Second Prince had brought over the top top ten rankers from the ranking battle as guests and was generally known for his good reputation and wide-spread connections. How could he, having operated for long, allow a guest he had invited to his banquet have something happen to them? Be it the excessive matter of Xue Ying's wife being forcibly snatched aware, or both husband and wife being forced to disclose matters about themselves, would he, a prince, let such events just pass their course?
Should such news be spread about, what would the other experts of the ranking battle think of him?
What of the top ten rankers from past generations of the ranking battles—how would they see him then?
Would the Second Prince, who had always delighted in roping in other people's hearts, let a madman destroy his reputation? His previous act of trying to calm General Ying down was merely done since he thought Xue Ying had fallen into a rough spot, and he was planning to wait for a more apt moment to actually step in. His plan was to gain Xue Ying's gratitude.
All of these were facts that Xue Ying was certain of.
On top of that, both he and his wife were merely avatars sent to the Deity world! Would they really accept any bullsheet and humiliation from random people? He was merely offering some respect for the other party's reputation. If he decided that General Ying was no longer worth his respect, of course he would treat him like no more than some trash on the roadside!
Would it even matter if he fell out with him and turned to hostilities? Would the Venomous Ying World Deity herself dare to come out just to kill him?
"That's grand. Do you think you've formed some brilliant scheme?" The silver-robed General Ying stared at Xue Ying. "You believe that, as a Realm Lord, your prospects for the future are immeasurable, don't you? And what does your future have to do with me? My True Deity Heart is already on the brink of collapse; why would I be afraid of you?"
"You aren't afraid of me." Xue Ying nodded. "But I've no reason to fear you either."
"Good! Very good!"
General Ying glanced at the particles flowing all around him. The entire palace was being suppressed so that his subordinate could not act. The sight of it turned him even crazier. He looked up at the Second Prince. "Second Prince, are you truly thinking of stopping me?"
"Old Brother Ying, is there really a need to go this far? A few more steps, and this matter, since it concerns the Myriad Flower Feast, will have to be reported to His Majesty." The Second Prince shook his head. "I'm doing this for your sake also."
The whole situation of being suppressed through force while being told it was for his own good left General Ying speechless.
In truth, the Second Prince did not think much of a madman like him, but he was still worried about his banquet!
He could not possibly let this crazy person ruin this occasion!
"Very well."
General Ying gritted his teeth, turning to look at Xue Ying. "Dong Bo, just you wait. You'll see upon leaving this palace hall that I have my own ways of dealing with you," he said as his eyes turned red.
He truly was holding back a bellyful of fury! To have been slapped so many times in front of everyone… In the past, he was the one who would be so arrogant as to casually step down upon others. When had he ever been slapped like this before? Not even the Second Prince himself would be so daring as to humiliate him like this! He had been quite mad from the start, and after he was humiliated, his mental state only worsened.
"Aunt, aunt, I am truly turning crazy. I'm being bullied and humiliated!" General Ying immediately transmitted a message to his aunt. After all, his father was still over at the Bloodshed God Palace where he was doing his job as one of the Bloodshed God Emperor's guards.
The Venomous Ying World Deity was staying over at the Long Shi Clan. At the moment, she could be seen resting on a couch inside of a courtyard. Even her black, enormous tail was out in the open, seeing how she saw no need to hide her true self when she was alone.
After all, she wasn't a human.
And it wasn't just her. Her elder brother and General Ying himself—none of them were human. Instead, they were all of a different race from the Deity world. With their low rate of reproduction and similarly poor comprehension ability, their race had only ever seen her brother and she becoming famous. Her elder brother only had two children, and neither was able to break through the Deity realm and become a World Deity. Overall, their Deity realm comprehension was simply not high enough. After a very long time, they might not necessarily be killed, but they would die nonetheless after proving unable to hold onto their true hearts.
"Mn?" The expression on the Venomous Ying World Deity's face suddenly changed, and a hint of unbridled savagery appeared in her eyes. "That Dong Bo is so daring!"
Sou.
She immediately disappeared from the courtyard.
******
Back in the palace, the banquet continued under normal terms after the Second Prince defused the situation.
"Xue Ying, that General Ying is completely mad. Don't you think he'll attack us on our way back home from the banquet?" Jing Qiu transmitted over.
Xue Ying replied, "Don't worry, Jing Qiu. If General Ying had not uttered such ruthless words, things might have been a bit troublesome, but seeing how he dared say such things, we will certainly be safe on our trip back. The Second Prince won't have any choice but to protect us."
Jing Qiu lightly nodded.
The silver-robed teenager, General Ying, had taken to drinking wine with his head lowered. Only once in a while would he look up with eyes red from anger.
Ai. Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
He clearly didn't like the man, but he did feel pity for him.
Even a more unbridled person, such as the Young Master of the Soaring Cloud Lake, would not be so rampant as to act against Xue Ying during a banquet of this level and with an understanding of his identity.
General Ying was, undoubtedly, a spoiled brat, but anyone able to become a Deity would still have some degree of rationality!
Unfortunately, any person whose True Deity Heart was crumbling would fall into such a state of madness and lose all signs of rationality. They would act without any mind for consequences! How could it be possible to discuss anything rational with a madman on the verge of death?
"Who!" A roar reverberated from outside the palace. Hong! A terrifying aura followed, rushing fiercely inside.
The aura sent everyone present trembling down to their bones. It was ancient and extremely vile. A yellow-robed woman then entered the hall, her eyes so frightfully cold as she swept across the area. Seated high above, the Second Prince was astonished for a second but then hurriedly stood up. "Senior Venomous Ying."
As she moved, a vile, black aura revolved around the yellow-robed figure. She had slit pupils, and her eyes made her seem like an lifeform incapable of feeling emotion.
Guest and host alike of the banquet felt jittery.
This was the Venomous Ying World Deity—the famous Venomous Ying World Deity in flesh! Her reputation started building up after she poisoned a stage four World Deity by the name of Pu Zhang, which left him suffering to such a degree than he was unable to continue chasing after her. Her achievements relating to hex poison were many and deep, ranked at the very top in the entire Calm Sea Prefecture. After all, she was at the level where she could cause even a stage four World Deity to suffer!
"Dong Bo, is it?" The Venomous Ying World Deity's gaze landed on Xue Ying.
"Senior Venomous Ying…" The Second Prince began.
"Shut up!" she coldly rebutted.
The Second Prince felt himself fall into an awkward position.
Xue Ying immediately understood that, from that point on, he could no longer rely on the Second Prince.
It was only normal. He had acquired all his influence using his father's might and through his many friends.
Meanwhile, the Venomous Ying World Deity was depending on her personal power alone! Her incredibly high combat power allowed her to disregard all else.
"I am Dong Bo." Xue Ying stood up. "I offer my greetings to the Venomous Ying World Deity."
"You can start begging for mercy, but it won't do you any good." The yellow-robed woman's slit eyes swept to look at Xue Ying's wife who stood beside him. "Your wife truly is beautiful. It's no wonder she was able to garner my nephew's interest."
"I have greeted you merely from respect for your combat power and not as a way to plead for mercy," Xue Ying stated frankly. "As a Realm Lord, I see no need in begging for your mercy."
The atmosphere froze in an instant, and everyone could feel pressure mounting on them.
"He dared to slap me a dozen times. Not even you or father have beaten me before," General Ying hollered. "I want to see him plead and let him understand the price of offending me."
"Don't worry. Just sit back and watch how your aunt helps you vent your anger," the Venomous Ying World Deity declared.
"You dared act so brazen in front of me." The yellow-robed woman sneered. She extended her right hand. A terrifying power congealed before her, which went over to envelop both Xue Ying and his wife.
"I won't act against you, but I will take your wife in your place." The yellow-robed woman sneered. "Tell me, what can you do about that? Even if you become the disciple of a powerful existence, what does it matter? My teacher is also a powerful existence!"
Those who could become stage three or four World Deities, even if not originally disciples under powerful existences, could easily join their ranks afterward.
"Senior Venomous Ying…" Seventh Mei Yu could not stop herself from trying to step in from the side.
"Your Highness Mei Yu, this matter does not concern you," the Venomous Ying World Deity briskly cut her off before glaring at Xue Ying emotionlessly. "Weren't you very rampant just now? Now that your wife is in my hands, she couldn't suicide even if she wanted to. I'll soon bring her over to become my nephew's plaything!"
Xue Ying's cold eyes betrayed his endless fury. This time, he was truly angry.
General Ying's True Deity Heart was on the verge of collapse. It was normal for him to act like a madman, but he had not considered that the Venomous Ying World Deity would shield his shortcomings! As he saw it, she found no need to regard him at all. It only made sense; she was a stage three World Deity, so she could fearless and rampant. Why would she care about a mere Deity like him?
"Venomous Ying World Deity, some things are fine for you to do as you wish, but there are also some actions you'll never be able to take back afterward." Xue Ying's eyes were filled with killing intent.
"Hahaha…you're such a small thing, yet you still dare be so arrogant in front of me? Who cares that you are a Realm Lord? What level will you even reach in your lifetime?" the Venomous Ying World Deity said satirically. With a wave from her hand, Jing Qiu immediately flew toward her.
By this point, Xue Ying's eyes were blazing with fury.
Alright.
He had not been in any rush to reveal his status, but now that the situation devolved to this extent, he had no reservations to invite a powerful existence over!
As a grade one True Meaning Transcendent, he always had the option of inviting a powerful existence to act in his stead! So as to not invite further suspicion, he could request Senior Scarlet Fire with whom he already had some relation to help him! With how close the relationship between Senior Scarlet Fire and the Sacred Master, Crimson Dust was, and him having already saved his wife before, it would not be strange for him to act for him again.
In fact, it was quite easy to invite a powerful existence over.
He only had to shout out his name, and he could immediately begin communicating with him!
Xue Ying was not so anxious at first, but the Venomous Ying World Deity simply forced him to the brink!
"Hahaha… Dong Bo, did you really think you have the qualification to be so arrogant with me?" The silver-robed General Ying raved with madness.
Hua hua hua~
Without warning, countless grains of white sand appeared within the hall, rampantly clumping up to emit a terrifying feeling of suppression on everything inside. It wrapped so easily around Jing Qiu that even the Venomous Ying World Deity's expression changed greatly as a result. She immediately retreated, and a uniquely-shaped trident appeared in her hands.
The boundless white sand condensed together in the form of a plump man dressed in white robes, his beard pointing upwards at the end.
As he caressed his beard, the plump man sneered at the yellow-robed Venomous Ying World Deity before him. "Venomous Ying, you're actually quite arrogant, aren't you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - Madman
chapters.content:
Chapter 442: Madman
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The plump man turned toward Xue Ying, "Little brother, now that your big brother is here, nobody would dare bully you any longer!" As soon as she was saved, Jing Qiu immediately ran over to Xue Ying's side. Xue Ying's heart swelled with gratitude. Not for a moment did he think that the White Sand City Lord would go so far as to stand by his side and enter a straight-up conflict with the Venomous Ying World Deity. Back when he mentioned the two of them being brothers, Xue Ying had simply thought it an offering of ordinary friendship.
Now, that same man was willing to come out to defend him! How could Xue Ying not feel grateful toward him?
"City Lord…" Xue Ying unknowingly blurted.
"Call me big brother!" The plump man stared back. "Are you still going to treat me as an outsider?"
"Big brother," Xue Ying said, "I must thank you. If you hadn't come…"
"Yeah, yeah, wait just a bit. I'll deal with this woman, and then we can talk." The plump man caressed his upward-oriented beard as he looked toward the yellow-robed woman currently on full alert. "What's wrong, Venomous Ying? Is there still something you're unhappy with? Perhaps you want to fight me a bit?"
The many rich clan heirs, including the Second Prince himself, were staring at this scene in complete silence.
Both the White Sand City Lord and the Venomous Ying World Deity were awe-inspiring existences and were quite famous within the Calm Sea Prefecture. Two such beings facing each other head-on was a very rare occurrence.
"Auntie," General Ying bellowed.
"Shut up," the yellow-robed woman roared back. The silver-robed General Ying's eyes had long since turned completely red from fury. He was in no condition to heed her words, so he continued talking, "Auntie, you cannot let that Dong Bo off. Grab both him and his wife along as well!"
The White Sand City Lord stroked his beard, letting out a sneer. "Hehehe, Venomous Ying, your nephew's True Deity Heart is on the verge of crumbling apart completely. Why don't you find a safe place for him to pass the rest of his days peacefully, instead of letting him go around, creating disasters? Also, what do you think of doing with that Venomous Trident you took out? Do you think you can defeat me? If it's a fight you want, I'll be sure to accompany you. I'll even give you a good lesson in the process."
Venomous Ying World Deity gritted her teeth.
The two of them had different specialties!
In a pure, head-on battle, she was rather weak and only barely met the standards of ordinary stage three World Deities. What she actually specialized in was hex poison!
But the White Sand City Lord was different!
He had crafted a terrifying secret skill known as the White Sand of Annihilation, which he then fused together with a World Deity ranked secret technique. It was a secret techniques which he had comprehended ever since he was a Deity, and one which he had improved over such a long time that he gained the moniker, White Sand! Even the city he built used that same name as a base.
Once his white sand started blowing, it would annihilate Myriad Existences; it was an incredibly powerful domain-type secret skill! Having entered his region of white sand, ordinary stage three World Deity could only escape with heavy injuries, and anyone trying to resist the White Sand of Annihilation while continuing to fight could only unleash a part of their original combat power. In most cases, that situation would only end with the White Sand City Lord easily smashing them afterward!
The White Sand City Lord was known as an expert sitting at the very top of stage three World Deities. On top of that, his White Sand Body offered him survival capabilities of an unfathomable level. All of these made it so that, during the meeting with the Calm Sea Prefecture Master, even the Venomous Ying World Deity herself had to resort to a respectful way of addressing him—Big Brother White Sand.
"Are you truly dead-sent on protecting him?" The Venomous Ying World Deity was in true anguish.
"Of course." The expression displayed by White Sand City Lord was completely neutral. "Listen well, Venomous Ying; Dong Bo is my brother, and I will protect him no matter what it takes! If you dare to continue bullying him, don't blame me for being heartless."
The Venomous Ying World Deity gritted her teeth one last time before finally turning around. The black aura previously revolving around her body went over to envelop the silver-robed General Ying. "Let's go."
Sou.
The two of them left the great palace.
Due to his long stay in the Calm Sea Prefecture Capital, General Ying had acquired an extravagant courtyard within the capital, and that was where the Venomous Ying World Deity brought him over as they descended. She had been too lazy to care about his servants. They would naturally run over after them.
The Venomous Ying World Deity flew into an extravagant palace hall and then released General Ying from the black aura.
"Auntie, we can't put matters to rest like this." General Ying's expression was savage, his eyes bloodshot as he roared without stop. "The White Sand City Lord might have helped him now, but we just have to find an opportunity to secretly grab Dong Bo's wife again."
"Shut up!" the Venomous Ying World Deity angrily rebuked him.
"Auntie!" General Ying stretched over in an attempt to grab hold of his aunt's hand. "If you don't settle this resentment of mine, I won't be happy again until I die."
However, the Venomous Ying World Deity waved her hands once and left the place.
Hong long~ the great door to the palace was shut close.
She then turned back, sending countless threads of black aura over to shroud the whole palace hall. They weaved together into an array that suppressed the space within. Back inside, General Ying was madly smashing at the doors and windows, yet he was unable to break them apart due to the suppression of these arrays. "Grab him, kill him, kill him…"
He went mad again. A trace of disgust and loathing flashed through the Venomous Ying World Deity's eyes.
She was selfish by nature and had gained infamy for turning against her friends without a trace of remorse.
In reality, she had no friends in the entire Calm Sea Prefecture Capital. Naturally, she was close with her elder brother who served His Majesty as an imperial guard, which gave him some influence. On the account of that relationship, her Venomous Ying World Deity days were still relatively calm.
However, that also meant she had to take care of that only son of her elder brother. In terms of real feelings, though? She looked down greatly upon that nephew of hers.
Even then, someone who dared bully her nephew was practically not showing any respect to her either. Xue Ying's slapping General Ying was akin to slapping her in the face directly! Considering her cold and callous personality, she would definitely intervene.
He's completely unhinged, going all crazy without any warning at all. She glanced toward the palace hall where General Ying was still raving with madness, smashing at the doors while shouting. The sooner he dies, the better.
She then turned around and walked off.
A couple of guards were stationed over by the palace's entrance.
