"Take care of the general," the Venomous Ying World Deity ordered.
"Yes." The two guards respectfully acknowledged. They had also glanced toward General Ying who was raving in madness, a flash of pity visible in their eyes as they realized the situation was getting worse. It seemed like his True Deity Heart would collapse within eight to ten years at most.
******
Now that the situation had devolved to the extent that the White Sand City Lord had to face off against the Venomous Ying World Deity, Xue Ying was naturally no longer in any mood to continue enjoying the feast.
The White Sand City Lord brought Xue Ying along with Jing Qiu away from the banquet, and the Second Prince had even personally stepped up to send them off. "Brother Dong Bo, I simply had no way to act against the Venomous Ying World Deity."
"Second Prince, this was not your fault. No matter way, I am truly thankful to you for having obstructed General Ying back there," Xue Ying replied.
"Let's go."
The White Sand City Lord, Xue Ying, and Jing Qiu all took to the skies as they left.
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu took advantage of the time spent flying back toward the capital to thank the White Sand City Lord, who simply laughed in response.
"There's no need for you two to say anything else. I have personally admitted to everyone that we're brothers, so it's normal that I would protect you. I was staying right next-door, inside the the residence of the Long Shi Clan, so I could act as soon as I understood the situation! In truth, it's about time for General Ying's True Deity Heart to crumble, and he will occasionally turn crazy. Even when he does his best to stay calm, his thinking is still past the brink of normalcy. His personality can no longer be explained through a lens of rationality."
"I've heard long ago that people who can no longer keep their hearts stable will turn mad and that their True Deity Heart would crumble in due time." Xue Ying sighed. "Yet I still did not think they would be this irrational or this mad."
Even their brewing madness followed a set process.
They could start out as a normal, rational person before slowly turning crazy with time. Even when calm, General Ying would still act in an unbridled manner. Once his mental state was further affected, he would turn raving mad.
"You finally got the chance to experience it first-hand, then?" The White Sand City Lord was poking fun at Xue Ying.
"I did, indeed, get to witness it in its true form." Xue Ying nodded.
He was quite knowledgeable, and the treasure spirit Crimson Rock had shared much information with him; yet, he had never gotten the chance before to witness such behaviour first-hand. It was truly something unfathomable how just how crazy those Deities on the verge of death would turn.
"Remember, you can never quite predict what Deities or World Deities who are about to die will do," the White Sand City Lord said. "The stronger a World Deity is, the more awareness they would get to hold onto as they turn mad."
"I understand." Xue Ying nodded.
"Even then, it's normally only Deities or weaker World Deities who really end up turning mad. Powerful World Deities will always choose to seal their memories and reincarnate as soon as they feel things going awry," the White Sand City Lord explained. "Without being affected by their previous memories as they begin an entirely new life, their heart realm will grow much more peaceful using this new life as a base. That is, of course, if they manage to survive long enough to become a Deity and awake the memories from their past life."
Xue Ying nodded.
Matters like this were still way too far for him to even consider.
"There's really no need to keep General Ying in your mind anymore, since he is most likely going to die soon. However, you'll have to be more careful around that b*tch, Venomous Ying," the White Sand City Lord warned.
"Oh?" Xue Ying frowned.
"She's a selfish being by nature, and she's prone to remember anyone who offended her for the rest of her life. Should she see any opportunity to do so, she'll be certain to act against you. Of course, there's no need to worry while the Myriad Flower Feast is still underway. However, in the future, I won't always be by your side. She's always going to keep an eye on you, so you should remember to be extremely careful at all times!"
"Understood." Xue Ying nodded.
Wasn't the Venomous Ying World Deity the one who dared try to take Jing Qiu away by force and hand her over to General Ying to use as a plaything? That single moment was enough to fill Xue Ying with killing intent! Even so, he was quite clear on the fact that, if he invited a powerful existence like Senior Scarlet Flame over, his wife would have been saved, but he most likely would not have killed the Venomous Ying World Deity.
With how high the status of any powerful existence was, they would usually not resort to killing World Deities unless under very special circumstances.
Venomous Ying, just you wait. Xue Ying's killing intent grew by the minute.
*******

chapters.title: Chapter 443 - Three Years Later
chapters.content:
Chapter 443: Three Years Later
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Back in the cultivation room inside his cavern, Xue Ying sat cross-legged on a praying mat, all by himself. His eyes were closed as he focused on comprehending all his recent experiences, his mind comprehending more of the countless Profound Mysteries imbued in his spear techniques by the second. And it wasn't just his avatar that was doing this; back in the Material World, in the Xia Clan World, his true body was similarly cultivating. That body had already become a World Deity after he grasped hold of the World Deity Heart, and all of his concentration was now dedicated to grasping the Chaotic Deity Heart.
The three years time limit is fast approaching. Xue Ying opened his eyes. I've been through countless spear technique training sessions now, and I've pondered their mysteries countless times. I've also put a lot of focus on the Laws of Profound Mysteries, but it seems that, no matter what, there's some sort of barrier separating me from the Chaotic Deity Heart, blurring the way forward. Whatever hints I get are always very vague.
I didn't gain much comprehension in regards to Chaotic Suppression during these past three years, but my secret skills have improved countless times over. Xue Ying laughed involuntarily.
This was largely because he had already spent too much time and effort on Chaotic Suppression, causing his improvements to now be marginal.
Instead, a small bit of time and effort spawned incredible improvements in his other secret skills, especially in the case of his Star Meteor Annihilation! As its power grew, a more accurate name for this move would instead be the Extreme Chaos Strike.
Three years was too short a time to any Deity.
The Calm Sea Prefecture Capital was turning lively once again now that the second stage of the Myriad Flower Feast's prefecture battle, the arena stage, was about to start. Unlike the ranking battle from three years before, this stage would be available for the public to spectate! It was the same case for the survival battle, which would also be shown to the public, so humans and experts from other races would all come over to watch these battles.
"Retreat."
"Stand back."
The legion soldiers were occupied with maintaining order in the Bloodshed Region.
Seated on an exquisite platform high up in the sky was none other than the all-powerful Calm Sea Prefecture Master, together with Monarch Mo Xue. A bit lower were were the other six World Deities—the White Sand City Lord, the Ink Cloud City Lord, Marshal Qin, the Venomous Ying World Deity, King Rong Hai and the emissary sent by the Bloodshed God Palace.
On ground level, there were a thousand experts sitting around. These were none other than the top thousand rankers from the previous previous stage, which included Xue Ying and Seventh Mei Yu.
"Old Brother White Sand." King Rong Hai looked toward the White Sand City Lord, who was seated by his side, in a forthright manner. "Are those rumors about you arguing with Venomous Ying not long ago true? Did the two of you really almost begin a fight?"
Instead of White Sand, the yellow-robed Venomous Ying World Deity deliberately acted pitiful as she said, "Are they not? That little brother of his, Dong Bo, the one who took the top spot in the ranking battle, actually dared to hit my nephew! That's nothing short of slapping my face directly. I merely considered it fit to vent my nephew's anger, but who would have thought that Big Brother White Sand would be so ruthless as to insist on protecting that little brother of his. I can't take Big Brother White Sand in a fight, so I had no choice but to step back."
"Brother White Sand, how rude of you to bully a woman," the emissary teased from the side.
"That's right! Old Brother White Sand, Venomous Ying is such a delicate flower. For you to bully her…that's truly making my heart ache," King Ron Hai also took a jab at him.
The White Sand City Lord glanced from one to the other. "Woman? Delicate? Hahaha, once you get a taste of her hex poison, I bet neither of you will go around saying she's delicate anymore."
"Big Brother Rong Hai is one existence I could never offend. He already cultivated his body to such an extent that my hex poison is useless against him," the Venomous Ying World Deity retorted. "As for the emissary…how could I ever dare act against him?"
"Like there would be anything you, Venomous Ying, would not dare to do." Marshal Qin sneered. "You didn't even shy away from acting against Emperor Pu Zang, so how can you say there are people you would not dare act against? Also…I've heard many times over the years of your nephew bullying others around the Calm Sea Prefecture, but never about someone would dare bully him. The way I see it, you had better just look after him properly."
The yellow-robed woman looked at Marshal Qin with a frown, refusing to speak any further.
Back in the higher section, the Calm Sea Prefecture Master and Monarch Mo Xue were merely watching this happen.
"Tell me, Old Long," Monarch Mo Xue began talking as he stroke his white beard, "amongst the stage three World Deities of your Calm Sea Prefecture…who would you say has the greatest chance of becoming a stage four World Deity and succeed your position as Prefecture Master?"
"It's likely to be Black Ink." The Prefecture Master smiled. "He became a World Deity within approximately ten thousand years, has reached the stage two realm in three hundred thousand years, and has reached stage three in ten million years. His talent is overflowing, and his rate of improvement approaches that of grade one True Meaning Transcendents. I regard him quite highly, but I can't help but feel he needs some refinement. In terms of how shrewd and ruthless one can be, he's much worse than even White Sand and Marshal Wu. Both of these two have cultivated for a few dozen million years and have each cultivated an extremely powerful secret skill of their own. It's a pity, however, that White Sand and the rest have stopped at the stage three realm; it's very unlikely that any of them will have any further breakthroughs."
"If we're to talk about hope to break through…" Monarch Mo Xue lightly nodded, "then I'm in the same boat as they. I've always struggled to find a way to break free of these bindings, yet I can't seem to escape the river of time and reach true eternity. I always turn back to wondering if I'll manage to survive this route of reincarnation…"
"Reincarnation." The Calm Sea Prefecture Master sighed. "Brother Mo Xue, even I might have to walk down this route, some time in the future."
Sealing one's memories and reincarnating meant not being able to use any of the knowledge from their previous life. At the same time, their souls would be brought to an extremely weak level, with only a nascent of their original soul being left behind. That would be nothing less than giving up on all of their strengths!
To become a Deity again in this new life? It would be very unlikely. Of the stage four World Deities who chose to reincarnate, most disappeared completely after a time.
"Don't give up, not until the very last moment. There's always the chance that you'll cross that final step." Monarch Mo Xue laughed. "Should you succeed, I can definitely ask you to help look after these few daughters of mine."
"Haha, it would be a small matter, if that really were to happen." The eyes of the Prefecture Master still showed hope for such a future.
In truth, the two of them were very close to powerful existences if speaking just in terms of combat power.
But without stepping out of the river of time, without escaping their bindings, they would simply sink into oblivion and be forever unable to transcend into eternity!
I've faced defeat once already. It seems that I'll have to go to the Moon Planet again, the Calm Sea Prefecture Master thought to himself. There's so other choice but to take the risk once again!
"Prefecture Master." The emissary from the Bloodshed God Palace stood up in the section below. "It is time. Shall we begin?"
These words served to wake up the Prefecture Master from his thoughts. "Let's start."
Xue Ying and the others were all sitting below. A bit to their north was an arena more than five thousand kilometers in diameter. The area all around it was filled with spectators who had arrived from all over the world to spectate, among them Jing Qiu and the Deities from the Xia Clan.
"The second stage of the Myriad Flower Feast Prefecture Selections, the arena battle, is officially underway!" the emissary's voice resounded all across the heaven. He walked over to the edge of the high platform where he swept his gaze below. The countless Deity spectators did not ever dare look up at him. "The first battle—Dong Bo versus Zhan Yan Feng! Begin!"
The sound of that sent the spectators into loud cheering.
Dong Bo had taken the first place in the ranking battle, while Yan Feng was the last!
"The strongest against the weakest. This Yan Feng is truly to be pitied."
"Dong Bo is ranked first, so he couldn't possibly be fighting against the second ranker in the arena battle, right? It's normal for those who were ranked further behind to fight against the top few, but who could have thought the first would be pitted against the last."
"There is no suspense at all with such a fight."
"It's fine; let's just have a look at how powerful Dong Bo is."
"To have ranked first, there's no way he wouldn't have some strength."
Everyone was looking forward to the upcoming battle.
Nobody had any doubt as to what the final result of the battle would be; it was certain that Dong Bo would win. However, they had never watched Xue Ying fight before, only a minority of the people present had been there to witness the battles held during the Mountain Wu Star Field's Starfield Selections. Even that battle had been ultimately too simple—it ended with a single move!
Xue Ying immediately stood up and headed toward the arena. Not too far from him was a man with white hair, his body shrouded by a gray cloak. His eyebrows had furrowed upon learning he had just been matched up against the top ranker from the ranking battle, Dong Bo; how could he not be somewhat downcast.

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - A Prominent Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 444: A Prominent Technique
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying walked up to the arena and calmly stood there, facing the gray-cloaked man who had also just arrived there.
"Greetings, Dong Bo. I do hope you will go easy on me," Yan Feng saluted without hesitation.
Xue Ying was momentarily startled before replying frankly, "Who dies and who lives is never certain in the arena battle. Don't resent me for being merciless."
Yan Feng awkwardly laughed.
What a joke.
With just a thousand experts from the entire Calm Sea Prefecture being selected, it meant that no more than a single person from each starfield was a ranker! How could he be careless when fighting any of these people? Would he not fall into a trap if he was too careless?
Who would have thought that this brat who cultivated for no more than 2,000 years would show no arrogance even on this Myriad Flower Feast's arena stage. Yan Feng seemed awkward on the outside, but deep inside his heart, he had a shrewd nature. His plan was to make use of his opponent's arrogance during the battle. Being able to rank in the top 1,000, his combat power was relatively close to an entry World Deity's.
He was much stronger than the red-haired man, Xue Yun, from before and the rest.
"The two of you, prepare yourselves." A golden-armored commander began operating the arrays from below the arena, and an enormous confinement array materialized around it. It was like a blanket shrouding the entire battle platform, with only a hourglass being left inside.
"Begin," the golden-armored commander ordered.
Shua shua shua!
Without a moment's hesitation, Yan Feng began to brandish his saber.
At that moment, a total of seven identical figures of Yan Feng moved out in different directions, seeking to attack Xue Ying.
"Hmph." The Great Chaotic True Force within Xue Ying's body moved into operation, and he swept his spear across once. In response to his attack, the surrounding space turned dark and crumbled apart. The surging power caused all those seven bodies of Yan Feng to turn into dust in an instant. Unlike the ranking battle, when the opponents would gradually increase in power, this stage was a straight-up battle in which people were gambling their lives! Xue Ying put his Great Chaotic True Force to use from the very start and followed up with his secret skill.
A single move was enough to shroud the surrounding space into darkness, sending it crumbling apart.
Still in his original position, Yan Feng stared at this scene with a trembling heart. He immediately shouted out, "I admit defeat!"
Ahead of him, he could see space in a range of fifty kilometers around Xue Ying having completely crumbled apart. This level of might sent his heart trembling from just watching from afar. Not only that, his illusory wind clones had actually received that power directly. They might not have been as strong as his true body, with only about 50% of its power, but even still…seven clones had been extinguished before even coming into contact with the spear.
Just how powerful was that?
It was certainly far beyond the power of a new World Deity.
"Yan Feng has admitted defeat. Dong Bo is victorious!" the golden-armored commander shouted loudly from below the stage.
In any arena battle, the victor and loser could be decided either by one side admitting defeat or either party dying during battle!
"He admitted defeat? Just like that?"
"He didn't even truly act, right?"
"This Yan Feng guy is still in his original spot, and he merely scouted out a bit, yet he was actually frightened to that degree?"
"He was too quick to admit defeat…"
The many spectators were discussing amongst themselves.
"Idiot! That guy is truly an idiot. He didn't even fight for real before admitting defeat." Within the sea of spectators was a certain group of legion soldiers sitting protectively next to a silver-robed teenager. He was none other than General Ying, who showed a cold and scheming expression. With three more years having passed since that event, General Ying's eyes were now even more terrifying and evil, but he could still maintain some fundamental degree of calmness.
"Is there really nobody in that group who has strength enough to defeat this Dong Bo? Or at least give him a hard time?" General Ying felt displeased at how the battles were going.
Of course, he was against Dong Bo winning.
In the first place, he was too dazzling and too young! Anyone could easily tell he would have an immeasurable potential in the future. General Ying, however, had reached the final moments of his life, and even whatever power he had was not gained through personal strength but by means of his father's help. Comparing himself to Xue Ying left General Ying even more unhappy, and his loathing for Xue Ying only further increased.
"Beautiful."
"Formidable, Xue Ying is truly formidable."
"They didn't even truly fight, yet his opponent was still left so frightened that he took the initiative to admit defeat." The Deities from the Xia Clan, including Jing Qiu, were watching the battle in joy. They were standing in a certain corner in that sea of spectators.
"You are indeed formidable, Dong Bo. This Yan Feng is ashamed at being this inferior." Back on the battle arena, Yan Feng saluted his opponent.
"Your combat power was not bad either. That cloning technique of yours is quite powerful," Xue Ying praised. This was his honest opinion. With seven clones, all of them even higher in might than a peak Deity, Yan Feng had likely triumphed over the Fierce Shaman Warrior in no more than ten moves.
The two continued chatting as left the battle arena and returned to their original resting positions.
"The second battle," the emissary continued from the high platform, "Drunk Guest against Cun Qing."
Xue Ying arrived back to his original seat.
"Dong Bo, congratulations," Seventh Mei Yu said from the side.
"I was pitted against the last placed in the ranking battle, so it was an easy victory. I estimate it should be the same for you as well." Xue Ying laughed, while turning toward the distant arena stage. Drunk Guest and Cun Qing had already stepped up onto the platform.
The expert named Drunk Guest donned green robes, was seemingly quite old, and carried a sword on his back. For Deities, age could not be determined simply through one's appearance. For instance, Drunk Guest had cultivated for merely 20,000 years or so.
The fight soon began, and it seemed to closely resemble the previous battle—it ended as soon as it began! The main difference was that, during this battle, the lower-ranked expert named Cun Qing had actually perished.
A single sword strike was enough to him.
"Such a fast attack." Xue Ying's pupils dilated at the feeling of threat. "What a terrifying technique."
"Formidable." Seventh Mei Yu was similarly startled.
Both of them were stunned beyond words.
Seventh Mei Yu also specialized in sword techniques. Her strikes were very fast and were clean to her heart, while her sword techniques were very close to perfection.
The Drunk Guest's technique, however, was even simpler. It seemed like his strikes did not contain any complex mysteries inherent within, yet that simple move of his had managed to unleash such formidable power.
"Splitting Heaven?" Xue Ying mumbled.
"Right, it looks like Splitting Heaven." Seventh Mei Yu nodded from the side. "That move contained traces of the Splitting Heaven Deity Heart."
They had received some intelligence reports about his performance in the Starfield Selections, but during that battle, Drunk Guest had casually struck the Fierce Shaman Warrior once, causing it to crumble apart. He had not displayed any of his sword techniques.
However, during this arena battle, he brought some of his techniques out for everyone to see.
"His sword techniques focused completely back to the basics, turning them into a single sword strike. No matter who he faces, that single sword is all that matters. It's just like splitting the heavens…a single move that no enemy can withstand." Seventh Mei Yu sighed. "To think that his sword techniques have reached such a stage. I feel like he could grasp the grade one Deity Heart, the Splitting Heaven Deity Heart, whenever he wishes."
"That's an expert." Xue Ying nodded. His position during the ranking battle was higher by one than Drunk Guest's, but it seemed that the gap between the two of them was very small. Perhaps he could only achieve first place due to his Time Immemorial Body.
Admittedly, comparing their comprehensions of the realm, Xue Ying's World Deity Heart brought him far beyond his opponent. Over the past few years, he had even begun pondering a new secret skill for his World Deity Heart.
In terms of his accomplishments in the Chaotic Deity Heart, however, he was a notch below the the Drunk Guest with his Splitting Heaven Deity Heart. Fighting him one-on-one would be quite taxing!
"After seeing him use that single sword strike to slap the Fierce Shaman Warrior apart during the Starfield Selections, I started to believe he specialized in strength. It would seem that his sword technique is even more terrifying instead." Xue Ying had to admit that, if he were to fight the Drunk Guest during the arena battle, he was not sure he could achieve victory.
Very soon, the third battle begun.
The participant to come out in this third battle was the third ranker called Jiu She. He was quite different from Xue Ying and Drunk Guest, having cultivated more than five million years already.
"Too powerful."
"This, this is practically…"
"He seems even stronger than Dong Bo and Drunk Guest!"
As soon as Jiu She acted, the spectators all seemingly turned mad with cheering.
Even Xue Ying and Seventh Mei Yu were startled at what had just happened!
Jiu She had just stood there, yet as soon as the battle begun, the platform was filled with densely packed figures sharing Jiu She's appearance, all of them fiercely hacking down at the same time! They had merely struck down using their palm, but adding up the countless figures made it so that the entire region where his opponent was located started crumbling apart. His opponent did not even get the chance to escape or to admit defeat!
Jiu She's white hair, white robe and white brows were swaying in the wind. He stood there, grinning lightly at Xue Ying and Drunk Guest.
Being ranked first did not mean one's combat power was the highest!
******

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - Opposing Each Other
chapters.content:
Chapter 445: Opposing Each Other
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Jiu She flashed a light grin at Xue Ying and Drunk Guest as he stood on the platform. Anyone could see that he was provoking those two.
"Brother Dong Bo, Drunk Guest had not provoked you earlier, yet this Jiu She proactively provoked both of you." Mei Yu then added, "It seems like he is very domineering."
Xue Ying nodded.
Wildness and arrogance did not mean much. Those with great talent and power were, to their very core, proud beings. Even if Xue Ying seemed very polite and humble on the surface, he was similarly proud.
Xue Ying did not care much about how domineering the other party was. He cared more about his combat power.
Truly powerful. Xue Ying mused, That single move of his has somehow appeared everywhere, leaving no place left untouched? Furthermore, his power is very formidable, to where he could easily destroy the entire region. That expert he faced, who had still ranked in the top thousand, did not even have the chance to escape with his life.
I wonder how it will be like if I were to fight with him. Xue Ying looked forward to it. Only, this arena battle will never arrange for us to fight.
The top ten within the Prefecture Selections would never match up against each other.
Because ultimately, the Calm Sea Prefecture would be selecting the strongest hundred!
"He is provocative, but it's a pity that the arena battle will not see me fighting him," Xue Ying remarked.
"It is indeed impossible in the arena battle, but in the final survival battle, there will still be a ranking within." Seventh Mei Yu laughed. "You ranked first in the ranking battle, but don't let yourself be surpassed by them…during the final survival battle."
Xue Ying laughed.
No wonder Jiu She was provoking him. It seemed that he was banking on the final survival battle.
The battles that came thereafter became increasingly fierce the later it got, since the difference in combat power between the two parties became smaller.
None of them, however, had given Xue Ying a similarly powerful, threatening feeling like Jiu She and Drunk Guest had.
This included Seventh Mei Yu! Even though she did surprise Xue Ying, he felt no threat from her at all. Firstly, her battle ended too quickly in just two moves; with her opponent admitting defeat, Seventh Mei Yu had no need to reveal her true sword techniques. Seventh Mei Yu, after all, specialized in a prolonged battle, not one ended with an instantaneous, explosive killing strike.
"The top five hundred has been chosen."
"The first battle of the second batch in the arena battle, Dong Bo against Wu Yong."
The second batch began once again…
Just as both of them stepped onto the platform…
Wu Yong shouted out, "I admit defeat."
Thereafter, when Drunk Guest and Jiu She went onto the platform, their opponents similarly admitted defeat!
Precisely because their prowess had stunned others during the first battle round, it caused all the other experts to determine the gap in combat power to be too vast and their hopes of victory to be nil. Admitting defeat was better than losing their lives in a battle where they would have no time to even act.
******
On the platform, the Calm Sea Prefecture Master, Monarch Mo Xue and the others were observing the battles below.
Despite ten or so honorary and inner disciples of powerful existences participating in the arena battle, the most dazzling experts were still the top three in the ranking battle: Dong Bo, Drunk Guest, and Jiu She! That person called Zang Xiao, for instance, had merely ranked twenty-seventh in the ranking battle. While such a rank was quite good, he still could not match the top three experts.
"That Jiu She seems to have not revealed all his strength during the ranking battle?" White Sand City Lord was quite startled.
"He has indeed not displayed this secret skill during the ranking battle." King Rong Hai nodded.
"It's merely the ranking battle. This Jiu She is extremely self-confident and thus did not display this killing move of his. Even with his half-hearted efforts, he could still rank third." The yellow-robed Venomous Ying World Deity giggled. "Having discovered there are two others who ranked above him, he will naturally display his techniques to make a statement. From my perspective…that Jiu She should be the strongest. Drunk Guest is the personal disciple of a powerful existence, so his combat power is similarly very deep and unpredictable; he should be able to grasp a grade one Deity Heart at any time. Meanwhile, this Dong Bo seems quite weak."
Marshal Qin calmly interjected from the side, "You have some hatred against that Dong Bo, so are you deliberately targeting him?"
"Targeting him?" Venomous Ying World Deity sneered. "Is he even qualified to hold my attention?"
"Venomous Ying, Dong Bo is ranked first." The White Sand City Lord laughed. "Despite what you say, he is still first in regards to the ranking battle."
"Then do you dare to bet? I wager that during the survival battle, that Dong Bo will absolutely not be first. He will most likely not be second either!" Venomous Ying World Deity sneered.
The White Sand City Lord shook his head. "Bet? Why must we bet? The rules for the ranking battle and the survival battle are not the same. Who can be sure of the final ranking? It would not be surprising if Dong Bo is not first."
"You have no confidence?" Venomous Ying World Deity sneered.
"Then are you confident to declare that Drunk Guest will definitely be the first? Or that Jiu She will definitely be the first?" The White Sand City Lord retorted.
Venomous Ying World Deity was stunned.
According to history, the gap between those ranked in the top three was practically nonexistent, and any of them could possibly rank first in the final survival battle. It was to the extent that even those ranked fourth, fifth and sixth…could all possibly seize first place if any of them specialized in survival.
Thus, the chances of anybody becoming the champion did not exceed 30%!
The chances of winning such a gamble was truly quite low.
The White Sand City Lord wasn't willing to gamble on the outcome—and neither was Venomous Ying World Deity!
"You say so much merely because you aren't that confident in Dong Bo." The yellow-robed Venomous Ying World Deity shook her head and returned to gaze to the arena platform.
The White Sand City Lord stroked the upward-oriented beard of his. He could feel how Venomous Ying was opposing him as well and grinned. "Haha, alright then. Since I've earned quite a lot in my previous gamble, I'll be the banker this time around… The rules are as such: Dong Bo ranking first, 1:1 payout! Dong Bo ranking second, 1:2 payout! Dong Bo ranking third or beyond, 1:5 payout! The maximum bet is set at ten million Deity crystals per person!"
"Such boldness."
"Old Brother White Sand, you are truly daring."
"You are this confident?"
Marshal Qin, King Rong Hai, the God Palace Emissary, the Ink Cloud City Lord, and the Venomous Ying World Deity all turned toward White Sand City Lord.
This gamble represented how truly confident he was of his judgement.
The 1:1 payout for Dong Bo ranking first meant he would not win anything no matter how much the others bet on him. If he lost, he would simply refund the bet! Thus, nobody would be foolish to bet on that option.
Ranking second, with a 1:2 payout…was considered an ordinary bet ratio.
Ranking third or beyond, with a 1:5 payout…that was a truly frightening payout ratio.
"White Sand, you are truly sending yourself to death." Venomous Ying World Deity derided, "Are you that confident?"
"Here's the gamble. If you have the capability, then set down your bets." White Sand City Lord turned toward her.
"Rest assured. I'll certainly satisfy you." Venomous Ying World Deity had felt gloomy ever since she had been suppressed during the banquet. At this moment, she would naturally take this opportunity in earning a windfall.
"Haha, Old Brother White Sand, for you to open such a gambling stake, we'll definitely make use of it as well." King Rong Hai laughed. "Dong Bo ranking second; I'll bet five million Deity crystals on it. Dong Bo ranking third and beyond, I'll also bet five million Deity crystals on it! Ze ze… if he ranks second, I'll simply break even. But if he ranks third or beyond, it'll be a huge jackpot of twenty-five million Deity crystals… As long as he does not rank first, I'll not be losing out!"
"Who says that King Rong Hai's mind is bad?" The Ink Cloud City Lord laughed. "As long as he isn't first, he'll lose nothing and might even possibly be earning a jackpot. Brother White Sand, you have earned quite a huge sum earlier, so I'll be betting the same as Brother Rong Hai."
"I'll be doing the same too." Marshal Qin beamed.
"Me too," the God Palace Emissary added in from the side.
The White Sand City Lord glared. "You all are truly…"
The four of them had similarly set down their bets.
Five million Deity crystals on Dong Bo ranking second.
Another five million Deity crystals on Dong Bo ranking third or beyond.
"You all are truly too conservative. I'll be betting on the final option, with him ranking third or below." Venomous Ying World Deity coldly laughed. "Ten million Deity crystals! If you lose, you will be compensating me fifty million Deity crystals!"
The upper limit was ten million Deity crystals.
Venomous Ying World Deity had staked everything on the final option.
"When the moment comes, you better not be a spoilsport when you lose." Venomous Ying World Deity chuckled. Even stage three World Deities would feel the pain if they were to lose out on fifty million Deity crystals.
"If Dong Bo gets first, I'll be cleaning out everyone!" White Sand City Lord glanced at the Venomous Ying World Deity, before turning toward the others. "I had cleaned out all of you guys earlier. So who knows, this time might end up being the same as well."
"The survival battle…has different rules. It is hard to predict." The Ink Cloud City Lord laughed. The few of them had seen the previous ranking battle and all felt that while Xue Ying might specialize in survivability, but he wasn't the best in that field.
Monarch Mo Xue and the Calm Sea Prefecture Master laughed at seeing this.
"This time, White Sand might be suffering huge losses," the Prefecture Master transmitted over.
"Mn, they have all made an error of judgement." Monarch Mo Xue nodded.
Very soon, the arena battle's two batches of fights ended, leaving behind the final top 250 experts. This arena battle had also led to a total of 96 deaths.
"The arena battle has ended. We will proceed on with the survival battle three years later. The final top hundred experts will represent Calm Sea Prefecture as they proceed to the God Palace!" the God Palace Emissary announced.

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - The White Sand City Lords Gift
chapters.content:
Chapter 446: The White Sand City Lord's Gift
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The arena battle ended.
Under watch of the legion troop soldiers, the spectators all began to leave.
The white-browed Jiu She, with his fluttering white hair and white clothes, glanced at Xue Ying and Drunk Guest with long and narrow eyes. He then smiled and departed.
"He seems very confident." Seventh Mei Yu and Xue Ying walked side by side. "Is he certain he'll win against you and Drunk Guest?"
"Once the survival battles finish, the rankings will be declared; all of this will naturally be disclosed," Xue Ying calmly replied. Although Jiu She seemed rather provocative, Xue Ying was still unperturbed. He didn't care too much about ranking first; as long as he could attend the God Palace Battle, wouldn't things be fine? He would showcase his true power at the God Palace; as for the survival battles, it would be enough to make an effort. There was no need to go all out.
He had only cultivated for two thousand years, so for those like Jiu She who had cultivated for over five million years, what need was there to compete?
…
The crowd dissipated.
Xue Ying soon met up with Jing Qiu and the others. On the way back, the guards on the road came over to congratulate them. Soon after, they reached their adobe.
Just when they had entered the abode and began steeping tea——
"Dong Bo." A sound transmitted in from outside.
As soon as Xue Ying heard it, he stood up at once and went to the door to greet the visitor. He opened the door to reveal a white-clothed plump man standing outside—the White Sand City Lord.
"Big Brother, why have you come?" Xue Ying was very surprised. "Come in, come in."
The White Sand City Lord beamed as he entered. When he saw the welcoming Jing Qiu, he immediately said, "Sister-in-law, Xue Ying and I have some things we need to talk about; there's no need to attend to us."
"Yes, Big Brother." Jing Qiu smiled and walked over to the side.
"Dong Bo." The White Sand City Lord pulled Xue Ying along and sat down next to him. He picked up the cup on the table and drank a gulp of tea before saying, "Do you still remember how I previously said to you…that when the Prefecture Selections are finished, I will have a present to give to you."
"I remember." Xue Ying nodded.
The White Sand City Lord mischievously laughed. "Although the Prefecture Selections have not finished, you will certainly compete in the God Palace Battle, so there isn't much difference between giving it now and giving it a while later. Thus, I've come to gift it to you! Take a look."
Once he explained his presence, he flipped his hand. A dark brown crystal bottle appeared, of which he uncorked.
Immediately, a faint fragrance wafted out of the bottle.
"This is?" Xue Ying was startled, yet he had recognized the treasure already.
This was a rare treasure of the Deity realm, the 'Rock Flower Cold Cloud Nectar.' This bottle's assessed value was around two million Deity crystals, causing Xue Ying to be somewhat speechless. Remember, the Second Prince's gift had merely been worth a hundred thousand Deity crystals, whereas a gift of two million Deity crystals?
This Big Brother's strength was powerful, but he was this forthright in his spending?
"This is the Rock Flower Cold Cloud Nectar. You have probably not heard of it, but you'll learn of its worth later." The White Sand City Lord smiled. "Take it. Although it's counted as a treasure, it's not worth much to me."
"I've heard that one bottle has to be around two million Deity crystals, right?" Xue Ying asked.
The White Sand City Lord was astonished.
He'd heard of it?
A Deity stage expert actually knew of the Rock Flower Cold Cloud Nectar? He even roughly knew of its price?
"It's too precious; I can't accept it," Xue Ying then said.
"Ha ha, when you were in the ranking battle, the Calm Sea Prefecture Master, Monarch Mo Xue, and all the others were in the mood to gamble, and I bet on you. Ultimately, I won big." The White Sand City Lord smiled in delight. "Although the Calm Sea Prefecture Master and Monarch Mo Xue didn't care, the prices of the treasures they had brought out far exceed this Rock Flower Cold Cloud Nectar. Therefore, I've already earned much to where this isn't valued highly anymore."
"In gambling, there's winners and losers. Big brother being able to win such a gamble is an example of big brother's strength." Xue Ying continued to decline, however, "This truly is too precious."
The White Sand City Lord remained silent.
His natural disposition was very straightforward, and sometimes when doing things, he followed his instinct! Back then, he had pilfered the Bloodshed God Emperor's 'World Sandheart Fruit' because he desired to eat it. Only after eating it did he become scared and frightened. He felt that he had earned too much on his previous bet on Xue Ying. Taking out a little of his fortune to gift to his little brother was simply not much in his eyes.
"You really are…" The White Sand City Lord helplessly explained, "I won't hide this matter from you. During the arena battle, that World Deity Venomous Ying kept targeting me, so I set down a bet! The bet is on your ranking in survival battle. If you're first, I take it all. If you're second, my losses will be tolerable. If you're third or even lower, then I'll be truly miserable."
If he ranked third or even lower, the World Deity Venomous Ying would earn forty million Deity crystals, while Monarch Rong Hai and the others would each earn fifteen million Deity crystals.
Altogether, those five would win from him a grand total of a hundred million Deity crystals!
The pressure the White Sand City Lord faced was enormous.
"Ah." Xue Ying was speechless. "Big brother, why?"
"To see that Venomous Ying suffer." The White Sand City Lord elaborated, "Following one's heart is quite delightful. Alright, you should use it quickly. With the Rock Flower Cold Cloud Nectar, perhaps your strength can increase a little in these next three years. Let's end our conversation here; I'll go now."
"Ai ai ai…" Xue Ying still wanted to refuse.
Yet in a flash, the White Sand City Lord disappeared into the horizon.
Xue Ying stared at the dark brown crystal bottle on top of the table and then softly muttered, "I didn't think I'd have to use it this early."
There were many priceless treasures within Crimson Rock Mountain.
Xue Ying originally planned on tempering himself at the God Palace Myriad Flower Feast, paying respects to a powerful existence, gaining pointers from a powerful existence, and cultivating persistently until he reached a bottleneck. Only then would he return home and go to Crimson Rock Mountain to take out some priceless treasures to use! Xue Ying felt that his improvements in the Chaotic Deity Heart had slowed down greatly, but at least he was still progressing somewhat. His secret skill was likewise being perfected slowly.
If he took the medicine now, it would be a waste.
"Since Big Brother White Sand has set up such a huge bet, I naturally have to go all out." Xue Ying swooped up this dark brown crystal bottle.
In the ranking battles, Xue Ying had used quite a bit of effort, but it couldn't be counted as him going all out.
Originally, Xue Ying had been unwilling to expend too much effort in the survival battles. But now, he changed his plans! To help the White Sand City Lord win the bet, he was willing to try his best.
…
Gu gu.
Inside his room, Xue Ying calmly grabbed the dark brown crystal bottle and tossed his head back to drink two mouthfuls. A cool feeling entered his body and spread throughout, causing his soul's awareness to instantly increase. Xue Ying's analysis and comprehension skills had always been quite high, but now…as he looked around, all of the surroundings, including space, time, and all other mysteries, became under his purview. In his mind, a halo flashed unceasingly. His analysis of these aspects became extremely high; he rapidly comprehended all of these newfound realizations thoroughly.
Xue Ying had always felt that priceless treasures had to be used at critical times, but in order to help his big brother White Sand, it was alright to use this gift.
Secret skill after secret skill…Xue Ying once more refined these toward perfection.
Faraway, his original body at home also helped in perfecting his secret skills.
No matter what!
In the survival battles, excluding any skills retaining to his his grade one Deity Heart, he had to fight with all his strength!
Without notice, three years passed.
The God Palace's Myriad Flower Feast…Calm Sea Prefecture's last survival battle—was about to begin!
This last survival battle would once more pick out the top hundred experts from within two these hundred and fifty extremely gifted participants and send them onward to the God Palace.
"Although the arena battle before wasn't bad, the most formidable experts simply hadn't shown their true strength. All of them had finished their battles in one or two moves; some even had their opponents voluntarily conceded.
"Yes, yes, yes, especially the top three rankers; they won too quickly."
"This time, they'll surely have to make an effort in the survival battle. Additionally, it's open to the public, which means we can watch them battle."
"Watch carefully…The true apex experts amongst the Deities—what kind of power can they display?"
A carriage was being pulled across the sky at a rapid pace.
Many Legion soldiers rushed over from all directions. Countless ordinary Deities walked on the ground, not daring to fly, although they were all very expectant. Amongst them, many had spent a lot merely on space transportation fees. In order to see a once or twice in a lifetime occasion, however, they went all out.
It was not a lie for this event to happen only once or twice in a lifetime for these cultivators.
Because it was exceptionally cruel within the Deity world, many deities would fall early in battle. For example, half of the Xia Clan deities had already fallen.
As increasingly more Deities rushed over, the legion soldiers in charge of maintaining order began shouting even more! If one dared to destroy the public order, they'd be whipped on the spot. After a long while, the Calm Sea Prefecture Master, Monarch Mo Xue, and the others arrived, alongside Xue Ying and the rest of the two hundred fifty Deity experts.
Hu.
Under the gaze of countless Deities, the God Palace Emissary straightforwardly waved his hand, sending a beam of light into the sky.
Two hundred and fifty beams of light flew into the sky, stopped, and became huge spheres. Two hundred and fifty spheres…floated high in midair, some high, some low.
"Prefecture Master, can the survival battles begin?" the God Palace Emissary asked.
"En." The Calm Sea Prefecture Master nodded.
The God Palace Emissary then turned around and looked down at the countless Deities distantly below their viewing platform. He brightly declared, "In regards to the God Palace Myriad Flower Feast, the first hundred ranked experts selected out of the final survival battle of the Calm Sea Prefecture will advance to the God Palace! The survival battle…is very simple. The longer one stays alive while imprisoned, the higher the ranking. The one that survives the longest will be ranked first. Go on in."
He waved his hand.
An incorporeal power immediately enveloped all those below, sweeping along all of them. Xue Ying, Seventh Mei Yu, and the others all uncontrollably flew into the sky and into their own spherical cage.

chapters.title: Chapter 447 - Within the Cage
chapters.content:
Chapter 447: Within the Cage
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying watched as the spherical cage increased in size above him before finally, his body made contact with that cage and became enveloped upon entering within.
"Mn?" Xue Ying carefully observed his surroundings. This cage was about five thousand square kilometers. He stood on a flat ground in this area, with countless of black light streams revolving around him.
"This is the survival battle and is publicized. Everyone can clearly see what is happening inside the cages." Xue Ying could see the countless spectators watching the battle through the transparent walls as well as the various spherical cages all around him, each with a talented Deity expert enclosed within.
"I don't think I'll need to elaborate further on the rules of the survival battle." Standing on the high platform beneath the spherical cages, the God Palace Emissary announced, "Those who can't endure any longer can simply admit defeat. Don't lose your life! The final hundred who survive within the cages will ranked in the top hundred of the survival battle."
"Begin!" the God Palace Emissary declared with a cold voice.
嗡~~~
Weng~
Within the two hundred plus spherical cages floating in the sky, the streams of black light soon began condensing into monsters. The spectators below attentively watched the battle. They were currently focusing on the top ten ranked experts, especially the highly famous Dong Bo, Drunk Guest, and Jiu She. After all, it was rare for them to meet with such Deity experts.
******
Xue Ying calmly stood on the flat ground within the cage. He extended his right hand, materializing a spear.
At this moment, the streams of black light began condensing, forming into all sorts of beasts and monsters. All the monsters were covered in black scales, with some being terrestrial and some being avian. Ten mutated beasts appeared at different locations in the cage, and the moment they appeared, their visions landed right on Xue Ying.
Si si~ Hou~ The mutated beasts glanced at each other, mutually communicating with their eyes. Even though they were life forms formed from arrays, they were relatively intelligent. One had to know that even Transcendent-refined puppets had intelligence. Even though the life forms formed in this cage had a shorter period of existence, the cage was specially made for the God Palace Myriad Flower Feast and had personally been refined by a stage four World Deity.
Ten different mutated beasts were not in a rush to attack despite surrounding Xue Ying.
"You guys aren't acting, but I can't delay as well." Xue Ying shook his head. With a thought, another starry-blue-robed Xue Ying appeared from nothingness nearby. He wielded a fiery-red spear. The mirage body hurled the spear; it arced through space, causing the surrounding to start crumbling into darkness as the spear flew lightning fast toward a black-scaled beast. That black-scaled mutated beast had been slapped away, spinning a few times as it flew back. Its mouth and nose spurt out fresh blood, but this injury wasn't considered much.
"What?" Xue Ying was startled. "I used the Time Immemorial Body's strength to execute Chaotic Suppression, but this isn't able to kill it? This is even the very first opponent in the survival battle."
What was the survival battle?
In the survival battle, a mutated beast would form after a set period of time. The beasts would keep forming continuously.
If one's killing speed did not at least match the speed at which the beasts formed, the beasts would keep accumulating…with the newly formed mutated beasts increasing in strength as well, causing one to fall into an even more dire situation.
The best method was still to kill as many as possible! Using one's full strength to kill!
Crack. Xue Ying thought.
The distant mirage body once again displayed its spear techniques. This time, he had utilized the Great Chaotic True Force. This was already the strongest force Xue Ying could exert. As his spear passed by, the surrounding space crumbled into darkness. His spear swept toward the black-scaled mutated beast, causing it to explode and turn back into black energy which then returned back to the ground.
"I still wonder how powerful its body was." Xue Ying laughed. His true body had been standing there without moving. Only his mirage body was moving at top speed around the various locations, rapidly killing the enemies. Within a single breathe, he killed the ten mutated beasts.
After temporarily stopping for a moment, huge amounts of black light stream began condensing into a new black-scaled mutated beast once again. Its strength had slightly increased, yet that beast was killed with a single sweep!
After which, he had to wait for another period of time.
Thus, Xue Ying seemed very carefree as he waited casually for a period of time before his mirage body appeared and killed its opponent with a single move.
"Dong Bo, Drunk Guest, and Jiu She seem to be having an easy time."
The countless spectators could clearly discern what was happening within the spherical cage.
"What Dong Bo utilized was his mirage body. The mirage body's strength is similar to his true body, and even if it was hit to the extent of it crumbling apart, it could immediately condense back again; a truly formidable method. Dong Bo's strength is also too strong…the mutated beasts in this survival battle are far stronger than the Fierce Shaman Warrior, yet in front of Dong Bo, they were smashed to death in a single hit without having a single bit of resistance."
"Drunk Guest is also very formidable. He stands there without moving. He simply waves his sword, and the sword light sweeps through the entire five thousand square kilometers, causing all those black-scaled mutated beasts to be cut into smithereens."
"Jiu She isn't using weapons at all, just his palm. A single palm will cause that single black-scaled mutated beast to shatter."
The spectators howled in amazement as they viewed the battle.
They clearly understood that it was not that the mutated beasts were weak—Dong Bo and the other two were just too strong.
This understanding came from seeing the lower ranked experts amongst the top 250 having an increasingly harder time battling! Because the defenses of those black-scaled mutated beasts were indeed strong, even killing a single beast taxed a lot of their strength. The combat power of an ordinary entry-level World Deity would merely injure those beasts at most, which required them to spend some time and effort to kill a single beast.
"I admit defeat." Within the time taken to brew a cup of tea, there was already a Deity expert admitting defeat from the survival battle.
He was instantly expelled into the sky outside.
Sweeping his eyes, he realized that he was the first amongst all Deity experts participating in the cage battles.
"Ai." This tall and sturdy male shook his head and sighed, "The black-scaled mutated beasts are truly too powerful. Killing them was too tough; as the amount of beasts increased, his resistance began faltering when they began surrounding him.
"I admit defeat."
"I admit defeat."
Very quickly, people were admitting defeat one after another.
Everyone knew an overwhelming majority of the experts were still battling, but expert after expert soon found themselves unable to endure; it was impossible for them to be in the top hundred, so they naturally chose to save their lives over continuing to resist.
Finally—
A voice resounded across the world.
"Two hundred remaining!" The God Palace Emissary's voice resounded far and wide.
Many of the Deity experts began feeling inwardly helpless as they kept battling within the spherical cages. There were still two hundred experts left? It truly was too hard to try to hold out until just a hundred remained.
"A hundred ninety."
"A hundred eighty."
The God Palace Emissary would shout out every once in a while. Even if he did not inform the public of the numbers, however, the audience could still calculate how many Deity experts remained since they could watch the battles themselves and could similarly inform their good friends about the current situation.
"A hundred seventy."
"A hundred sixty."
Since these Deity experts were giving up, none of the participants died yet! Due to the huge gap between the current ranking to the top hundred, everyone would voluntarily admit defeat once they realized they could not endure battling any longer.
As time went by, the remaining Deity experts became fewer and fewer.
"A hundred ten!" When the God Palace Emissary's voice ran out, those Deity experts felt their hearts tightening as they kept enduring. Soon—once ten more experts were eliminated, the remaining hundred could advance to the God Palace.
"The finale—those who hold on for a longer period of time and rank in the top hundred can proceed on to the God Palace. Naturally, however, you must pay attention to your own lives." The God Palace Emissary indifferently watched the battles continue. During this crucial moment, death rates were at the highest. Those struggling Deity experts were becoming more frenzied in persevering even further.
There was a huge qualitative difference between the 100th and 101st.
The top hundred could advance to the God Palace. By then, their futures would be entirely different. Thus, since they were already fighting for their future, they might as well stake their lives.
"A hundred nine." The God Palace Emissary personally watched a Deity expert be torn apart by the black-scaled mutated beasts, soul being extinguished upon death. He was used to this as this final moment of struggle would, in most cases, have the highest rate of death.

chapters.title: Chapter 448 - The Prefecture Masters Deduction
chapters.content:
Chapter 448: The Prefecture Master's Deduction
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"108, 107, 106…"
With the emissary's voice resounding throughout the world as a backdrop, the Deity experts were doing their best to persevere. It might seem like there would be a huge gap of 30 rankings between the 80th and the 110th, but their combat powers were relatively similar. The Deity experts were now at an extremely challenging point, and every moment they lasted longer had to be gained through sheer effort.
Some might depend on body techniques focused on agility, others on combat techniques, while some even used illusory tactics…
However, the mutated beasts could also travel through the void, step into shadow space, and would always assault the Deities in huge groups!
"103. 102. 101."
"Any moment now."
"Gotta hold on."
"I must persevere. Just a little more."
More and more of the Deity experts were accruing injuries.
"The top hundred Deity experts have emerged," the emissary's voice finally announced, a feeling of joy inherent within.
"I admit defeat.""I admit defeat.""I admit defeat."…
The instant in which the emissary announced that the top hundred experts had been selected, the Deities who were on the brink all admitted defeat at once; they were immediately expelled from the spherical cage. In the blink of an eye, twenty Deities had all been sent out. Even then, all of those who were just sent out had one thing in common—they were all ecstatic. They had succeeded in holding on for long enough.
"I was so close. Just a little bit more!" The one ranked 101st, a white-haired old man, was racked with regret. His two bodies had already merged back into his original body. "Why? Just why could I not hold on for a little longer?"
"Lost."
"Ai."
"Didn't get into the top hundred."
The others, who had also finished just a little way off, were very dejected.
Meanwhile, those who successfully obtained a spot in the top hundred were in a terrific mood.
"Congratulations, congratulations."
"Hahaha, Brother Ling, we should go to the Bloodshed God Palace together! The battle there is the safest. If we're lucky, we might even get to become disciples of a powerful existence." All those set to participate in the Bloodshed God Palace battle were overjoyed. Between the Starfield Selections, the Prefecture Selections, and the Bloodshed God Palace Battle, the last was the safest. Deaths would never occur during this stage!
There were many reasons for one to participate in this final battle.
To become the disciple of a powerful existence? Or of a stage four World Deity? To obtain a high-ranking position within the Bloodshed God Palace? To enter the Bloodshed Tavern?
One's participation in the Bloodshed God Palace Battle represented their whole future identity! Even the lower-ranked people could obtain a tenth rank straightaway! What did a tenth rank signify? Even the stationing legion generals or the patrol legion generals would only be of the ninth rank for the most part. The tenth rank would put one on the vice general position at the very least! There would only ever be one person with this position in a grade three legion.
******
In the highest section of the platform above, Monarch Mo Xue and the Calm Sea Prefecture Master were grinning.
"By now, the hundred experts who will move on to the Bloodshed God Palace have been selected." Monarch Mo Xue stroke his snow-white beard, chuckling. "It would seem this time's batch is not bad at all. That brat called Drunk Guest…his sword techniques already have an implicit level of the Splitting Heaven Deity Heart. For his self-created secret skill to have reached this stage, I think it'll take at least one or two days, but no more than a thousand years, for him get a grasp on the grade one Splitting Heaven Deity Heart."
"He is, after all, the the personal disciple of Gong Yu." The Calm Sea Prefecture Master nodded his head in praise. "Having cultivated for just twenty thousand years or so, his talent is rather good."
Attaining a grade one Deity Heart in ten thousand years and attaining a grade one Deity Heart in twenty thousand years were still quite different achievements. But the difference wasn't that huge.
"That guy, Dong Bo, is not half bad either," Monarch Mo Xue commented. "The only issue is that he's more of a mixed bag of knowledge. He has at least four different grade two Deity Hearts, with his attainments in the Star Deity Heart and the Mirage Deity Heart being the highest. He has long since reached the perfection stage of the Deity realm in both the Great Chaotic True Force and the Time Immemorial Body. His Extreme Piercing Deity Heart and Space Deity Heart are weaker by comparison. In any case, no matter what Deity Heart we consider, his comprehension is weaker by a bit than that brat, Drunk Guest."
"True. He is still quite far from condensing a grade one Deity Heart." The Calm Sea Prefecture Master nodded.
"That Jiu She person is likely the strongest of the participants this time." Monarch Mo Xue laughed. "A pity, however, that he's already cultivated for roughly six million years. That's far too long."
The Calm Sea Prefecture Master nodded in agreement. "In terms of combat power, Jiu She is definitely first. But in the eyes of any powerful existence… Dong Bo is preferable due to how young he is! Having cultivated for only two thousand or so years, he formed four grade two Deity Hearts already. Anyone can tell from a glance that there are many glaring mistakes in the secret skills he created, so it's very likely that he wasn't taught by any powerful existences before or by any stage four World Deities."
"Mn, without any formal teaching, he cultivated by himself for two thousand years to reach a decent level in four grade two Deity Hearts." Monarch Mo Xue nodded. "As soon as he receives guidance, he will certainly make huge progress. If I were to select a disciple, it would certainly be Dong Bo."
"That's only fair." Monarch Mo Xue nodded. "Jiu She's combat power might be strongest, but Dong Bo's potential is the highest!"
"How do you think the top three ranks will pan out in the survival battle?" Monarch Mo Xue asked.
"Jiu She will indisputably end up first. As for Drunk Guest and Dong Bo… Drunk Guest is stronger in terms of offensive might, and his secret skill is more perfect, but his survivability is not as high. Dong Bo focuses on a more mixed set of techniques, and he specializes in survival, so his offense is weaker…" the Calm Sea Prefecture Master analyzed. "I think Drunk Guest will be second and Dong Bo third."
Monarch Mo Xue nodded in response.
With their judgement skills, they could easily tell from Xue Ying's secret skills that he had not been taught by any powerful existence in the past. From that point, it was easy for them to deduce the final outcome of the battle.
"Hahaha." Monarch Mo Xue laughed. "I agree with your assessment. It seem like that thieving rat will be losing out big this time around."
The Calm Sea Prefecture Master joined in the laughter. "Last time, that little rat won quite a lot by taking away all our treasures. This time, he's trying to clean everyone out. A pity, however, that he will be the one losing everything instead."
The ones below—the White Sand City Lord, Marshal Qin, the Ink Cloud City Lord, the Venomous Ying World Deity, King Rong Hai and the emissary from the Bloodshed God Palace—were not aware of this conversation between Monarch Mo Xue and the Calm Sea Prefecture Master.
Instead, all six were watching the battles excitedly.
After all, this battle was the subject of a huge bet between them!
"Thirty people remaining!" the emissary shouted out. He then laughed toward the other people seated by his side. "Old Brother White Sand, did you see it? Can you tell how powerful Jiu She's combat power is? Drunk Guest's sword techniques are also very powerful, with him being the personal disciple of Gong Yu and having received his guidance. Hehe, looking at his sword technique secret skills alone, he has already surpassed Dong Bo."
"Dong Bo will likely end up in the third position." As she watched the battles unfolding up in the suspended spherical cage, the yellow-robed Venomous Ying World Deity was gaining more and more confidence in her judgement. She glanced over at the White Sand City Lord. "Big Brother White Sand, don't forget, the rate is 1:5!"
"Don't be so happy until you've seen the very last moment." The White Sand City Lord stroke his beard, though his heart was vaguely trembling. Little Brother Dong Bo is still too young. It looks like he'll be the first to lose.
******
Garbed in his green clothing, Drunk Guest was moving about in the cage, wielding a sword in one hand.
Hua.
When he walked, his entire person felt like a sword which could split the world and pierce through any obstacle. A single step would bring him to the side of any mutated beast, a single strike would cut it in two. His sword techniques were truly too simple. Be it a hacking motion, a cut, a slash or a thrust, they all seemed so very simple. They were all just strikes imbued with the power of splitting the world.
His attacks could not be parried. His sword techniques might have seemed extremely simple, but they were nearly perfect. Clearly, the Laws of Profound Mysteries inherent within had reached a peak, and he could grasp hold of a grade one Deity Heart any time he wished.
The man with white hair and white brows, dressed in white robes, and with long and narrow eyes, was currently displaying a calm and haughty expression.
Countless visages identical to himself had appeared in his spherical cage. He was in every single spot inside there. The very moment a mutated beast would appear, all of his clones would wave their palms in its direction, causing it to crumble and dissipate directly.
As of now, only thirty participants remained, yet he was still killing his enemies with a single strike each!
At that point, only Drunk Guest and Jiu She were able to kill their enemies using a single move.
If Xue Ying were to display his strongest and most penetrative skill, the Star Meteor Annihilation, he could also destroy his opponents in a single strike, but his current goal was to use his Chaotic Suppression in tandem with his other spear technique moves. Clearly, he viewed this survival battle as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to refine himself. His focus was placed completely on refining his Chaotic Suppression in hopes of condensing the Chaotic Deity Heart as soon as possible.
With his spear techniques complementing each other, and followed by his Extreme Piercing secret skill of Star Aggregation, he could still kill the mutated beasts by relying on the Great Chaotic True Force. It was occasionally that he would be forced to employ his Star Meteor Annihilation.
There are still twenty Deities remaining? Xue Ying sighed inwardly. It seems like I'm in no position to look down on the others.
*******

chapters.title: Chapter 449 - Hidden Move
chapters.content:
Chapter 449: Hidden Move
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
For the sake of Big Brother White Sand's gambling match, I have to do my best. Xue Ying might have been focused on refining his secret skills, but he didn't neglect killing the black-scaled mutated beasts at a quick pace. He would deal with any beast within a short period of time after its appearance.The mutated beasts are getting stronger and stronger, and my secret skills are already losing effectiveness against them. I have to start using Star Meteor Annihilation now.
Xue Ying's secret skill based on Extreme Piercing, Star Aggregation, was barely able to pierce their hides, while 'Chaotic Suppression would cause his opponents to vomit blood at most. Such injuries were too light, allowing him to kill off one beast after two or three breaths worth of time.
Too slow!
He had to start using his Star Meteor Annihilation! He began coordinating his spear techniques, while launching a final Star Annihilation Meteor strike as the killing move. This allowed him to barely maintain a good killing pace.
Will I really fail to enter the top 20? Zang Xiao wore a savage expression, his eyes filled with reluctance. His phantom-like body surrounded a black-scaled mutated beast, striking it time after time with two demonic, blood-colored saber lights. This attack, however, was just barely enough to cause it a slight injury which the beast recovered from within moments. Regardless of what attack he used, he was no longer able to kill any of the mutated beasts.
With every breath's worth of time that passed, another mutated beast would appear.
As of that moment, a total of three mutated beasts were already surrounding him. It was quite taxing for Zang Xiao to manage.
"Master, there are still 26 Deities within," he received a transmission from his servant, but he was still unwilling to give up. The ranking battle had left him ranked 27th, which was already hard enough to take. He had decided to try even harder in this stage.
Four mutated beasts, five…
Zang Xiao was completely surrounded! He was like nothing more than a stray dog, doing his best to survive the danger coming from all sides. However, the mutated beasts specialized in different Laws of Profound Mysteries. They could pierce through the void and even display illusory techniques.
"Master, there are twenty-five left."
"I admit defeat."
Zang Xiao finally lost all will to defend himself.
Sou.
His figure was expelled from the spherical cage.
He reappeared in mid-air, his chest showing an injury recovering by the moment. Instead of tending to it, he looked up toward the many floating spherical cages. I really tried my best this time, yet I still ranked only 25th. It's true that there are as many experts in the Calm Sea Prefecture as there are clouds. Even my status as an inner disciple of a powerful existence is nothing much, seeing how I couldn't even rank in the top 10.
Below, the countless spectators were watching the battles and discussing amongst themselves in a elated mood.
After all, the more time passed, the more exciting the battles would become.
Even the top few ranked were already forced to show their best.
"Twenty participants remaining," the emissary calmly stated.
"Ten participants left!" he said, his voice was clearly louder than before. By this point, his every word was akin to thunder booming in the sky. "Nine left! Eight now!"
By this point, Seventh Mei Yu had already reached a frantic stage of the battle.
Flower petals were floating inside the cage, sweeping all throughout it. Their coming into contact with the black-scaled mutated beasts would produce an extremely powerful explosive force. Seventh Mei Yu's sword techniques were a truly beautiful sight, his body quickly flashing around and forming images as he moved. Those visages of him surrounded a mutated beast, landing strike after strike on its body, stacking up sword light, turning his already unfathomable might even stronger.
It was hard to tell how many strikes it took, but the mutated beast, which failed to escape the trap no matter how it struggled, was eventually cut into pieces and dissipated away.
But during that time, the number of mutated beasts surrounding Seventh Mei Yu had already increased by three, and that number would be rising to four in another breath's worth of time.
It seems I won't be able to hold on any longer.
He would normally employ his body techniques to evade the other mutated beasts while focusing on a single one. But as the number of beasts increased, he began having a harder and harder time doing so, to the extent that he was now doing his best just to survive. He was no longer able to kill the beasts.
Very soon, five mutated beasts surrounded Seventh Mei Yu at the same time, all of them particularly powerful.
"I admit defeat," he finally mouthed.
Once he admitted defeat, it was immediately confirmed that he had obtained the seventh rank in the survival battle!
"Mei Yu's body techniques are truly powerful, giving her quite an advantage in the survival battle. Her sword techniques form a full set of perfected secret skills, and her skill in dodging and defending are exquisite." The Ink Cloud City Lord looked up at Seventh Mei Yu, who had just been expelled, and then toward the other six who were still fighting in the spherical cages. "For her to have ranked seventh is a good outcome."
"She takes a more balanced approach to combat, so her absolute killing moves are a slight bit weaker than the others," the emissary joined in with his own evaluation.
"Old Brother White Sand, the outcome is getting clearer and clearer. It seems very likely that you'll be suffering some huge losses this time around," King Rong Hai teased. "If you don't have enough treasures, we can arrange a deal to postpone your payment of the twenty-five million Deity crystals you owe me."
"How about you shut up for me?" The White Sand City Lord stroked his beard in a more anxious manner as he stared at the strongest three people still fighting in the spherical cages. "It's best that you wait until the very last moment before you reveal your delight."
"Any fool could tell that Dong Bo is no longer able to hold on." The yellow-robed Venomous Ying World Deity laughed coldly. "Big Brother White Sand, adding up all our bets, you'll have to give away a total of hundred million Deity crystals."
Marshal Qin looked up and lightly nodded. "Dong Bo should rank third, Drunk Guest second, and Jiu She first."
They could judge that from how the battles were going at the moment.
Currently there were still six people still fighting it out, of which three were already in desperate situations and would likely be giving up soon.
Dong Bo, Drunk Guest, and Jiu She could all likely hold on for a little longer.
But of the three, Dong Bo's situation seemed to be the most dire. In his current position, he had to depend on his Mirage body to frantically parry attacks, as he was brought to the last of this power. Truthfully, it was already tough for him to kill mutated beasts even after using the Star Meteor Annihilation. He could, at the very most, injure the beasts now.
Dressed in his green robes and with his sword in hand, Drunk Guest seemed like he could tear the world apart with every moment. His every single strike seemed like it would split anything apart.
However, the mutated beasts had already become incredibly powerful. Even he needed about two breaths worth of time to kill just one beast! Very soon, the number of beasts within the cage went up to two, and it would only rise further with time.
Even then, he could at least still kill the mutated beasts.
Jiu She seemed to be the most casual of the three.
His white robe, his white hair, and white brows were undisturbed, and his eyes remained as sharp as ever. His clones covered every single point in the cage, all of them furiously slapping out at every opponent, attacking the beasts all at once! As of that moment, the strength of each black-scaled mutated beast reached an incredible level, one of them snarling as it attacked Jiu She. But, there were simply too many clones. They could be killed with ease, but whenever a clone disappeared, another would simply take its place in another region.
His clones could simply never dwindle in number, and they would strike out using their palms without pause!
The regions surrounded by his clones kept collapsing, but the black-scaled mutated beasts would merely get injured in the process. Usually, a few hits would be needed for a beast to finally dissipate. Even then, he could still maintain a pace where he could kill a beast within a breath's worth of time.
That meant that there would only ever be a single beast in his cage.
"Jiu She seems like he'll be able to hold on for quite a bit more time. Compared to the rest, he's still having the easiest time. Drunk Guest's killing pace is already unable to match the rate at which the beasts emerge. It's unlikely that he'll manage to hold on much longer. Dong Bo is already unable to kill the mutated beasts any longer. He already has two beasts inside his cage, and this is likely the end of the road for him," the Ink Cloud City Lord evaluated.
The yellow-robed Venomous Ying World Deity was incredibly delighted by this conclusion. "Big Brother White Sand, you're bound to lose!"
"No more beating around the bush."
"His body refinement technique would be useless even if was stronger. Once the beasts capture him, even if he remains alive, he will still be thrown out of the cage." Everyone was watching the battles intently.
The White Sand City Lord was the only one with a solemn expression as he stared above, hoping for a miracle.
His innermost thoughts revealed his regret, Why were you so rash! Did you really think that, just because you earned huge before, it will happen again this time? All in all, Brother Dong Bo has only cultivated for two thousand years. He was going to be losing out due to that.
"Take a look," Monarch Mo Xue laughed as he spoke to the Calm Sea Prefecture Master. "Watch the expression on that thieving rat's face."
"Seeing how he'll be losing hundred million Deity crystals, his heart must be aching hard." Calm Sea Prefecture Master shook his head with a smile. "That's quite a heavy hit."
******
By this point, there were two black-scaled mutated beasts inside Xue Ying's cage. The two starry-robed Xue Ying were fleeing in the same direction while jointly assaulting a beast as they moved. At this stage in the battle, his Star Meteor Annihilation was barely enough to leave a cavity in the beast's body, his strike being forcibly stopped by the flesh further in. Injuries of this level were not enough to take down a single beast.
