I can't let the amount of beasts increase any further! Xue Ying glanced outside through the transparent wall, toward the remaining two spherical cages where Drunk Guest and Jiu She were still fighting. I have to bring forth all my strength.
With a thought from Xue Ying's part, four starry-blue-robed teenagers suddenly appeared in the huge dark land of the enormous cage.
That was right, four!
The four starry-blue-robed teenagers were holding onto a spear each as they frantically attacked a mutated beast.
Pu pu pu!
The figures all displayed the Star Meteor Annihilation, and, for a time, scenes of dark stars expanding before collapsing appeared in their surroundings. Countless bloody holes had appeared all over the bodies of the mutated beasts as they started roaring out in pain. A few dozen strikes from Xue Ying sent a piece of their scales flying apart to reveal the bones beneath.
Hong~ All four Xue Yings launched Chaotic Suppression attacks, hacking fiercely at the beast.
Without the defensive ability provided by the black scales, and with Xue Ying's strongest offensive ability striking the beast's backbone, the beast's body immediately exploded. How powerful was a joint attack launched by four Xue Yings? Just what level did it reach?
I truly did not wish to display this one move of mine, Xue Ying thought.
Mirage secret skill—Condensing Reality!
He had created this secret skill back when his True Meaning of Mirage was still at the stage three realm and he was still in the Crimson Rock Mountain. Upon condensing the grade one World Deity Heart and becoming a World Deity, Xue Ying began to comprehend many other secret skills through the aid of his World Deity Heart. One of them was this World Mirage secret skill. He could condense eight World avatars with a single thought!
Without his complete understanding of the Profound Mysteries of World Deity Heart, and just by depending on his understanding of the Profound Mysteries of Mirage, Xue Ying would have been able to use Condensing Reality to form three Mirage bodies at most. That was even after becoming a World Deity through the World Deity Heart.
Becoming a World Deity first, and then researching Condensing Reality, would allow one to form three bodies at most. If they wanted to condense more, they would have to use Profound Mystery based on the complete World Deity Heart.
Altogether, this fact left Xue Ying feeling that he was bullying others through this ability. With four of him teaming up together, his strength would be multiplied more than once over.
"Mirage secret skill?"
"This brat?"
Back on the highest platform, the Calm Sea Prefecture Master and Monarch Mo Xue were startled.
Below, the White Sand City Lord, the Ink Cloud City Lord, the Venomous Ying World Deity, King Rong Hai, Marshal Qin, and the emissary from the Bloodshed God Palace were all just as startled as the two above.
Four bodies? And each of them were about as powerful as the true body?
"He can command the Mirage secret skill to this extent?" King Rong Hai was truly stunned. "Truly, incredibly formidable! Even a World Deity who grasped the World Deity heart and used a World Avatar secret skill would be able to form nine avatars at most. To use a Mirage secret skill to form a total of three Mirage bodies…his attainments in the Mirage have truly reached a frightening level."
"It looks like his comprehension of the Mirage Deity Heart is at an even higher level than of the Star Deity Heart!" Monarch Mo Xue praised. "His Star Deity Heart will most likely require quite a lot more time before evolving into the Chaotic Deity Heart. But his Mirage Deity Heart…could most likely evolve into the World Deity Heart whenever he wanted it to."
"Mn." The Calm Sea Prefecture Master nodded in agreement. "It seems that our judgement was wrong. His highest comprehension is in terms of the Mirage Deity Heart!"
**

chapters.title: Chapter 450 - Bumpy
chapters.content:
Chapter 450: Bumpy
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Just three people were still fighting in the spherical cages suspended in the sky. They were none other than Xue Ying, Drunk Guest, and Jiu She.
Just a while ago, Xue Ying was having a very hard time and seemed to be the one to draw out first. At that point, four Xue Yings appeared without warning inside his cage. With them teaming up together, displaying the Star Meteor Annihilation, the black-scaled mutated beasts could do nothing but howl in grief. Xue Ying's bodies then followed up with Chaotic Suppression to smash the beasts directly apart.
With four of Xue Ying joining together, the beasts could no longer hope to dodge his attacks. In the blink of an eye, his cage emptied of beasts.
"Woah."
"Dong Bo is too formidable. His combat power has actually exploded so much!"
"He exterminated all the mutated beasts!"
Various spectators of different races let out a collective sigh at this sight. In their view, each mutated beast was easily strong enough to slaughter a huge group of peak Deities, yet Xue Ying was able to exterminate them nonetheless.
"I've heard that Dong Bo only cultivated for roughly two thousand years, yet look at how strong her is."
"My clan's ancestor has purchased a set of intelligence reports which stated that Dong Bo has only cultivated for 2,300 years, give or take a few. Despite the very short period of cultivation, his Mirage and Star Deity Hearts have both reached such a high level. The way I see it, he will likely manage to grasp a grade one Deity Heart within 10,000 years."
"He'll condense a grade one Deity Heart within 10,000 years? Doesn't that mean he will definitely become a personal disciple under a powerful existence?"
"That is hard to say! He has reached such a high realm after cultivating for just 2,000 years, but who can say that he won't get stopped here by a bottleneck for a few tens of thousands of years."
"Even if he doesn't manage a breakthrough with the Star Deity Heart, there's no chance that will be the case with his Mirage Deity Heart, right? No matter how I look at it, Dong Bo is very likely to grasp a grade one Deity Heart within 10,000 years."
Countless spectators were discussing amongst themselves.
Grade one True Meaning Transcendent?
They were no more than rumors or legends to the people…
After all, it was that rare for even one such existence to appear even after hundreds of millions of years. One of them showing up would send most powerful existences tumbling over to snatch them away, while any enemies they might have would stop at nothing to get rid of them as fast as possible.
The very next level of talent was that of grasping a grade one Deity Heart within 10,000 years! A relatively greater amount of people could accomplish this, compared to how many grade one True Meaning Transcendents there were. Opposing powerful existences would not ignore their reputations to deal with such people, and most of them would manage to become stage three World Deities in the end. Even of these people, only a small amount could become stage four World Deities. Such potential was enough to allow them easy entrance into the ranks of personal disciples under powerful existences, and they were worthy of the grooming and resources which powerful existences had at their disposal.
"He's this powerful?" Protected by a team of legion soldiers, the silver-robed General Ying spectated the battles. His expression was getting uglier by the second, and his eyes were showing signs of madness. "How…how is it that he only cultivated for only two thousand years, yet his Star Deity Heart and Mirage Deity Heart still have such accomplishments? He even has two different routes through which he can become a World Deity? What about me? Why am I unable to move a single inch forward?"
As he looked upward, his vision was starting to distort, and his True Deity Heart was starting to tremble.
"Why?"
"I am unwilling."
"Unwilling…"
"I'll destroy him. Destroy him." General Ying's eyes were bathed in a blood-red glow, and his body was shivering.
The gray-robed old man's expression shifted as soon as he saw that. He immediately grabbed hold of General Ying, using a surging force of World Deity energy to seal the Deity energy in his body. In his condition, General Ying was unable to resist. He could only look with savageness toward the gray-robed old man behind him, speaking in a lowered voice, "Are you seeking death?"
"General Ying has turned mad again. Take him back," the gray-robed old man disregarded him and instead gave orders to the surrounding soldiers.
With the time for General Ying's True Deity Heart to crumble fast approaching, his aunt, the Venomous Ying World Deity, had ordered for him to be taken home as soon as he showed any signs of turning crazy. This would prevent him from losing her any reputation within the Calm Sea Prefecture Capital.
Hua.
This group of soldiers rapidly brought him away.
Amidst the sea of spectators watching the battle, General Ying's group was merely a drop of water. In another corner, the Deities of the Xia Clan, including Jing Qiu, were watching the battle with great excitement.
"Dong Bo truly is formidable. Despite having cultivated for such a short period of time, he is able to surpass all the other Deities."
"Amazing."
"He is, after all, the strongest Deity in the entire history of our Xia Clan."
The Purple Thunder Emperor, Emperor Yun Hai, and all the others were feeling a mixture of pride and excitement. Jing Qiu seemed to be simply smiling at this, but her eyes were very, very bright. Seeing her husband reach such heights, as his wife, there was no way she wouldn't be happy.
******
On the high platform.
"Hahaha…" The White Sand City Lord laughed in an exceptionally pleased manner. He stroked his beard upward-slanting beard and glanced toward the Venomous Ying World Deity to see her expression, which had turned quite ugly, and then turned to the others. "Fellow ladies and gentlemen, it would seem all of you were too early to become delighted. Did you really think that Jiu She could conceal his combat power, while Dong Bo couldn't? Hahaha…what do you think? You better just accept your losses wholeheartedly, right?"
"You're the one who's in a rush. The crucial point hasn't arrived yet." The Ink Cloud City Lord looked upward.
"Brother White Sand, aren't you also celebrating early?" Marshal Qin looked up too.
"Right, all three have yet to give up. It's too early to tell who will be second." The yellow-robed Venomous Ying World Deity was sneering on the outside, but her heart was bursting with anxiety.
Everyone could easily tell that the current situation within the spherical cages was most favorable for Xue Ying. All things considered, the three participants had started out quite similar in terms of combat power, but Xue Ying's had risen considerably once he started displaying the Mirage secret skill, Condensing Reality. With how fast he was killing the beasts, it was easy to tell that Xue Ying would rank first.
"Not good," King Rong Hai suddenly shouted.
"I admit defeat," Drunk Guest hollered from within one of the three spherical cages suspended in the sky.
Hu.
He was sent back to the sky outside. He put his Deity sword back into its scabbard and lightly shook his head as he looked toward the other two cages, where battles were still undergoing. I've already displayed all my abilities. If I wish to improve any further, I must grasp hold of a grade one Deity Heart. I can't regret losing to those two. He continued on downward.
"Haha, Venomous Ying." The White Sand City Lord turned toward the yellow-robed woman as soon as he saw that. "We can't yet tell who will end up first or second. But the third place is already decided! It is occupied by none other than Drunk Guest! Is it not a pity that you betted on Dong Bo being third?"
The Venomous Ying World Deity showed a terrible expression. She sneered once and then refused to say anything more. Regardless of how thick her skin was, losing ten million Deity crystals still left her with a sullen heart.
"Jiu She's killing pace is also starting to slow down." The Ink Cloud City Lord and the others were frowning.
"Is White Sand really going to clean us up again?" Marshal Qin felt helpless too.
White Sand City Lord was stroking his beard in absolute delight while murmuring to himself, This little brother of mine is incredible. I set up the gambling match simply because I wanted to vent some frustration, but who would have thought that Dong Bo had still been concealing his strength during the ranking battle. That Mirage Deity Heart…his Mirage secret skill lets him condense three other mirage bodies. It probably won't take him more than ten thousand years to become a World Deity.
Back in the highest section of the suspended platform, the Calm Sea Prefecture Master and Monarch Mo Xue were also looking up at the battles.
"This Dong Bo truly has incredible potential. Such a pity that he had no good teacher to guide him," Monarch Mo Xue blurted out. "Just look at him! That Star Deity Heart secret skill he's using has such hilarious mistakes! His Mirage secret skill can form three bodies as powerful as the true body, which means it reached the limit, but that's nothing more than a waste of his talent. He's doing twice the work for half the result."
"What's this; are you distressed over something?" The Prefecture Master laughed.
"I'm looking at someone with great talent, who could clearly grasp hold of a grade one Deity Heart, yet he is walking along such a bumpy road. How could I not be distressed?" Monarch Mo Xue shook his head. "Think about that Mirage secret skill of his. The Mirage Deity Heart can be evolved into the World Deity Heart, but what does the World Deity Heart really represent? It's a Deity Heart that specializes most the aspect of domains. To transform the Mirage Deity Heart into a World Deity Heart, he should be spending most of his time focusing on that aspect. But what is he doing?
"He actually spent so much time on that desolate aspect of the mirage body. He might have trained it to the very limit, but it doesn't mean it was worth the effort." Monarch Mo Xue sighed.
"Hahaha… so you would like him to be your disciple but can't have him. Instead, you're just saying this stuff," the Calm Sea Prefecture Master teased.
"You're damn right about that. Forget the fact that my True Deity Heart is about to crumble, even without that obstacle, a stage four World Deity like me would never be able to snatch such a disciple." Monarch Mo Xue nodded with a sigh. "The path Dong Bo walks down might include so many hilarious mistakes, but he's still achieved this much. Should he succeed in getting a powerful existence as his teacher, he will be able to walk down a proper road at a much better pace. There's a huge chance he'll succeed in grasping a grade one Deity Heart in ten thousand years."
"That's true. Drunk Guest was taught by a powerful existence, so his sword techniques are moving along the path of the Splitting Heaven Deity Heart in a complete manner; he'll have a much easier time breaking through," the Calm Sea Prefecture Master said.
The way they saw it, for the Mirage Deity Heart to evolve into the World Deity Heart, Xue Ying should be proceeding along the primary road, the main path!
But he was instead pursuing the side path of the mirage body and even going along it to the very end! Despite being able to produce three mirage bodies, he would still find it tough to break through to condense a World Deity Heart even if he walked close to it. Still, with a powerful existence teaching him, they were still certain he would very likely grasp a grade one Deity Heart within ten thousand years.
"It's about to end." Monarch Mo Xue looked upward. "It seems that, from your Calm Sea Prefecture, Jiu She will be ranked first, Dong Bo will be second, and Drunk Guest third. They're all pretty good, so you'll be able to hold your head high during the Myriad Flower Feast."

chapters.title: Chapter 451 - Boundless
chapters.content:
Chapter 451: Boundless
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Only two of the original two hundred fifty spherical cages suspended in the air now remained. The ones inside them were Jiu She and Xue Ying, who were both still fighting.
The man dressed in white robes and who had white hair and brows, Jiu She, still put on a graceful show.
His numerous clones filled the cage, each of them furiously waving their hands over to hack and injure the mutated beasts. It was only now that he finally needed a full breath's worth of time to kill just one mutated beast.
"Mn?" He turned to look a certain spot in the distance, only to see the other spherical cage where Xue Ying was still fighting.
This Dong Bo…despite his short cultivation time so far, he reached such a high level in both the Mirage Deity Heart and the Star Deity Heart. Is he not aware that he should be focusing on a single aspect to become a World Deity and only then branch off to other areas? Perhaps he's never received any guidance so far, instead cultivating only by himself, Jiu She thought to himself.
I originally thought this one secret skill would be enough to net me the number one spot in the survival battle. Not for a moment did I consider Dong Bo would have the skill to leave us in a stalemate. It seems like I have to show my real strength. I was planning on keeping this hidden and only unleash it before His Majesty and other powerful existences, but I must assure the first place in this battle. Unless I leave this stage with the first rank, it'd be nothing more than a joke to wish for a powerful existence to take me as a disciple, Jiu She inwardly considered.
Hong~
The numerous visages of Jiu She scattered all throughout the spherical cage moved their arms all at once. Their countless palm shadows quickly converged into a huge golden palm, so large that it occupied half of the entire cage as it descended.
Pu.
Everything in the path of this attack was destroyed in its entirety; anything it touched perished, and even the scales of the mutated beast were scattered without effort.
"What!"
"How could it be possible!"
The White Sand City Lord, the emissary from the Bloodshed God Palace, the Venomous Ying World Deity, the Ink Cloud City Lord, Marshal Qin, and King Rong Hai, as well as the spectators such as the Xia Clan Deities and Jing Qiu, were all startled at the sight of this palm and what it brought in its wake.
By this point of the survival battle, just how strong would the mutated beasts that the cage produced even be?
Drunk Guest had a very hard time killing just one of them.
And it took the coordination of four Xue Yings launching several attacks to kill them.
Yet…Jiu She did so in one attack?
"Boundless Deity Heart?" The White Sand City Lord, the emissary, and all the others up on the platform glanced at one another.
"Jiu She has grasped the Boundless Deity Heart?" Marshal Qin exclaimed. "That's the grade one Boundless Deity Heart. This guy's pretty smart. He's grasped a grade one Deity Heart, but he waited until now to show it."
"Perhaps he made a breakthrough during the battle?" King Rong Hai laughed.
"What coincidence would that be for him to have made a breakthrough during this very battle." The Black Ink City Lord smiled. "It's much more like that Jiu She grasped Boundless Deity Heart long ago but decided to keep it hidden. He's not that bad, seeing how he managed to condense a Boundless Deity Heart after cultivating for roughly six million years. Brother White Sand, it looks like Jiu She will be first, and Dong Bo will finish second. You won't be profiting off our Deity crystals again."
The emissary, Marshall Qin, and the others all laughed.
With Xue Ying ranking second, they wouldn't win anything, but they wouldn't have to pay anything either. They still find it to be a good conclusion, seeing how they thought they would have to hand over ten million Deity crystals. At least it ended up as a draw.
The Venomous Ying World Deity was the only one keeping her mouth shut.
She was the only loser in this bet.
"It's no big deal. I'm still earning a bit off of Venomous Ying," the White Sand City Lord purposely replied.
"Hmph." She simply sneered in response.
"It's hard to believe that our Calm Sea Prefecture actually gave rise to a participant with a grade one Deity Heart. Generally speaking, it's very rare to see a participant with a grade one Deity Heart during the Myriad Flower Feast. How unexpected that, of the Bloodshed God Palace's nineteen prefectures, such a Deity would emerge in my Calm Sea Prefecture."
"True."
"With his Boundless Deity Heart, Jiu She might even rank amongst the top ten during this time's Myriad Flower Feast." The people on the platform agreed amongst themselves.
There had been some occasions in the past of people with grade one Deity Heart participating in the Bloodshed God Palace Myriad Flower Feast, which sparked some arguments at first. One side sought to prohibit people like them from participating in the event, while the other side voiced concerns over how such a prohibition would be unfair. What if some participant had a breakthrough during the course of the event? Would they also have to be disqualified? That would be nonsense! On top of that, who could really say if that person really made their breakthrough during the event, or was just hiding it from long before?
In the end, His Majesty stepped out and made a decree: Any participant must have cultivated for no more than eleven million years and must be a Deity. It does not matter if they have a grade one Deity Heart. Everyone gets an equal opportunity to participate.
Truth was that…it really was that difficult to grasp hold of a grade one Deity Heart.
Deities would usually only break through to become World Deities after cultivating for more than a hundred million years. The Sorcerer God, for instance, had still needed a few of million years of cultivation before he became a World Deity, in spite of his great talent. The majority of World Deities would spend hundreds upon hundreds of millions of years as Deities before getting any chance at a breakthrough. With how difficult the process was, it was easy to tell that even the small number of World Deities found throughout a starfield had actually accumulated over long eras.
As for those who could condense a grade one Deity Heart in less than eleven million years of cultivation…to speak nothing of the territory controlled by the Bloodshed God Palace, even throughout the whole Deity World, no more than ten would spawn in the period between each Myriad Flower Feast. Moreover, those who showed decent talent would have already become disciples under powerful existences, or they would belong to the Temporal Island or the Myriad God Palace. Most would see no need to participate in this selection.
After all, any participant in the Myriad Flower Feast Selections would be henceforth counted as a member of the Bloodshed God Palace and be granted a tenth rank at the least!
Which meant that anyone who refused to join the Bloodshed God Palace would not participate. In turn, however, they would also lose eligibility to enjoy a Myriad Flower True Fruit.
All of these facts considered, every Myriad Flower Feast would only see a paltry number of grade one Deity Heart participants.
"These six still lack some vision, seeing how they've only now realized that Jiu She has a Boundless Deity Heart," Monarch Mo Xue said as he looked at White Sand and the others.
The Calm Sea Prefecture Lord joined in, "That secret skill which Jiu She used before, the one which could conjure numerous clones, contained a few Profound Mysteries of the Boundless Deity Heart, though they weren't easy to discern."
Both Monarch Mo Xue and the Calm Sea Prefecture Lord found out about Jiu She's Boundless Deity Heart from the very beginning of the arena battle, when Jiu She used his secret skill to conjure numerous clones. That skill he displayed contained a very small trace of Profound Mysteries belonging to the Boundless Deity Heart!
Jiu She was not afraid to expose his Deity Heart, and he was also very eager to get the first place in the battle, which together brought him to the decision to use his hidden secret skill. That secret skill of his contained some traces of the Boundless Deity Heart, but he was confident that no one could detect them.
In the end, he was still forced by Xue Ying to used his trump card. Brought to this point, he no longer bothered concealing anything. He revealed his true strength straightaway.
"You can't blame them for that," the Calm Sea Prefecture Lord chastised. "The Boundless Deity Heart is rarely seen even amongst the known grade one Deity Hearts. Of White Sand and others, none has a Boundless Deity Heart. On top of that, his secret skill from before did not explicitly put it on display, so it's normal that they wouldn't find out about it."
"Mn." Monarch Mo Xue nodded in agreement.
Of the grade one Deity Hearts, the more commonly seen in the Deity World were those like the Time Space Deity Heart, the Splitting Heavens Deity Heart, the Chaotic Deity Heart, or the World Deity Heart. The Boundless Deity Heart was much rarer by comparison. It only appeared about as often as the Mirage Deity Heart was seen amongst grade two Deity Hearts.
The Boundless Deity Heart was so rarely seen because it represented a special essence of the universe. Even World Deities were hard-pressed to comprehend this aspect. Stage four World Deity might begin to touch upon it, but they could only roughly understand it, with no guarantee of complete comprehension. As stage four World Deity themselves, the Calm Sea Prefecture Lord and Monarch Mo Xue could easily recognize it.
Jiu She had only managed to comprehend this Deity Heart due to a chance encounter. Upon cultivating in a certain place for many years, he suddenly discovered the what it meant to be 'boundless.' He then moved on to cultivate for many, many years before finally condensing the Boundless Deity Heart. This Deity Heart was not only very rare, but also quite unique and peculiar.
******
Formidable. Xue Ying looked toward the other distant sphere where Jiu She's figure could be seen fighting, his countless slaps condensing into a golden palm so powerful even he was amazed. Unless I show my own grade one Deity Heart, there's no way for me to take first place. It's one thing for him to have a grade one Deity Heart, after having cultivated for six million years, but with my having only cultivated for two thousand years… if I were to put my grade one Deity Heart on display, those powerful existences will likely find out immediately, Xue Ying silently thought. Forget it. Brother White Sand told me that second place would be a good enough result, and that only if I would finish third or below would he lose greatly.
He then immediately said, "I admit defeat."
Xue Ying could have prolonged the fight further, but he saw no need to do so.
Hua~
He was summarily expelled.
From his position in mid-air, Xue Ying looked toward the distant sphere where numerous visages of Jiu She were still fighting, and he was secretly shocked. Boundless? Is that the grade one Boundless Deity Heart? No wonder I couldn't even tell his true body apart from his countless clones. It could be said that all of them are fake bodies, but also that all of them are the real body.
Those millions upon millions of bodies could be considered all fake, or one could be said to be real with the rest being fakes, or even that all of them were his real body.
Even the Chaotic Deity Heart or the Extremity Deity Heart, which were considered incredibly powerful, would see some difficulty in dealing with the Boundless Deity Heart. Its power was so sinister that ordinary enemies would never even get the chance to touch any person who condensed one. Xue Ying, however, grasped the World Deity Heart—which was famed for its domain abilities; within his domain, his power would be akin to a Realm Lord's in his territory. It could also place down an area of world suppression, which was similar to the suppression the Material World could place upon someone. This ability was a natural and perfect counter to the Boundless Deity Heart.
"I admit defeat." As soon as Xue Ying admitted his defeat, Jiu She's numerous clones scattered, leaving only a single body behind. This figure was dressed in white, with even his hair being white. When he glanced toward Xue Ying indifferently, there was even a trace of haughtiness in his eyes. The way he saw it, his grade one Deity Heart would allow him to have an easy time throughout the rest of the Myriad Flower Feast, and it was only normal for him to be ranked first within the Calm Sea Prefecture. As for Xue Ying? Jiu She saw some great potential in him, but when it came to his current strength? It was still lacking—much lower than his.
"Grade one Deity Heart?
"This Jiu She individual has a grade one Deity Heart?"
"He's this powerful?"
"It's nothing strange that Dong Bo would lose to him. They are simply on two different levels of comprehension."
Most of the spectators were stunned.
Jiu She was soon expelled from the sphere. The corners of his mouth were curled up into a smile, while his eyes swept all over the spectators.
By that point, Xue Ying had already landed and was now back in his original spot.
"Brother Dong Bo, nobody could have known that Jiu She has grasped a grade one Deity Heart. There's no way to win over him," Seventh Mei Yu consoled him from nearby.
"Yeah, no way to win," he nonchalantly replied.
Very soon, the Bloodshed God Palace emissary announced, "The Calm Sea Prefecture Selection for the Myriad Flower Feast has been concluded. The top one hundred participants from this prefecture have been selected, and they will proceed on to the Bloodshed God Palace three years from now."

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - Accept Whom as Master?
chapters.content:
Chapter 452: Accept Whom as Master?
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The legion soldiers were in charge of maintaining order as the spectators, who had rushed over from every direction, finally began to disperse. Xue Ying, Drunk Guest, and the rest also returned to their own abodes.
Back on the high platform.
The World Deity group got up and began to depart. Now that all three rounds of the Calm Sea Prefecture's were through, there was no longer a need for them to remain there.
"Brother White Sand, are you going to the Bloodshed God Palace?" King Rong Hai asked.
"Even if just for his brother Dong Bo, he'll surely go over to watch the battle." To the side, the Ink Cloud City Lord smiled.
The White Sand City Lord smiled back and rubbed his pointed beard in a pleased manner. "Ink Cloud City Lord, your guess is not wrong. I have to go to the Bloodshed God Palace, even if just to see which powerful existence my brother Dong Bo will become the disciple of."
"There's no need for you to worry about that. This Dong Bo chap's talent is pretty incredible," the Ink Cloud City Lord confidently stated. "He's only lived for 2,300 years, and he's this strong already. Furthermore, his Mirage and Star Deity Hearts are both on the brink of a breakthrough. With the guidance of a powerful existence, he's basically assured to get a grade one Deity Heart within 10,000 years. His talent is god enough to send powerful existences fighting over him."
"It's not whether he'll be chosen as a disciple by a powerful existence that I'm worried about." The White Sand City Lord shook his head. "If they don't choose someone of Dong Bo's potential, how many people out there would qualify?"
It might seem like Jiu She's strength was higher than Xue Ying's, but the former had already cultivated for nearly six million years!
His potential was far from being comparable to Xue Ying's!
"What I am worried about is whether Xue Ying will be chosen as a disciple by one of the three." The White Sand City Lord couldn't hide his expectation.
"The three?" Marshal Qin, King Rong Hai, and the rest couldn't help but slightly shake their heads.
Difficult!
"Reporting to the Prefecture Master: the Calm Sea Prefecture's selections are over. I will now return to the Bloodshed God Palace," the emissary said to the aforementioned Calm Sea Prefecture Master.
"Alright. Go right ahead." The Calm Sea Prefecture Master nodded. Upon returning, the emissary would swiftly report the information of the survival battle to his superiors so it could be organised into more detailed intelligence, which could then be handed to the powerful existences.
******
As per custom, the experts attending the Bloodshed God Palace Battle would all become members of the organization! This meant that, when the time for the battle arrived, there would be many powerful existences who came over to spectate, but only the ones belonging to the Bloodshed God Palace would be allowed to receive disciples.
Hong long long~
A vast river covered by thick fog was flowing out of the void, revolving around a vast land in the starry sky. Its waves carried inexhaustible might, such that even World Deities were unable to fly past it and were forced to instead cross it by ship. The river spanned millions upon millions of kilometers, with even a region as large as the Calm Sea Prefecture Capital barely fitting in the width of this river.
Thousands of cultivators lived on that vast land, with an extravagant black palace at its very center. Within a garden inside the black palace was a black-robed old man with black hair sitting cross-legged with his eyes closed. He exuded no aura, as if he was one with the entire palace, the entire continent, and even the rolling void river.
"Reporting to master," a beautiful woman dressed in red garb stepped into that area, glancing somewhat nervously toward the man as she spoke in deferrence.
The black robed old man opened his eyes and looked toward the red-clothed woman,
"This is an intelligence report sent over by the Bloodshed God Palace. All nineteen prefectures under their command have completed their selections, with one hundred final participants from each of them. In total, there is information on a thousand nine hundred people here." The red-clothed woman respectfully handed over a blood-colored scroll, which unfurled in mid-air before the black-robed old man. It took him a mere glance to take in all of the information it contained.
"Not bad."
"This time's Myriad Flower Feast has truly unearthed some decent chaps." The black-robed old man sighed.
"Are there any you've got your eye on, master?" the red-garbed woman asked with a smile.
"Two or three of them," the old man answered. "The one I'm most fond of is this chap by the name of Dong Bo. Sadly, if I took a fancy to him, the other powerful existences have probably… Many of them have probably taken an interest in him already, so it's hard to say whose disciple he will end up as.
"If master truly were to fight for him, I'm sure you could get him," the woman continued.
"It's already been so long since His Majesty has last received a disciple, so it's not very likely for him to do so now," the old man said. "I'm more wary that those three will come out to fight me over a disciple."
"Those three?" The red-garbed woman was shocked.
Information spread quickly, and a large portion of the powerful existences who would attend the Myriad Flower Feast were now aware of the youngsters with a lot of potential. Drunk Guest, for instance, was among the better ones, but he was already the personal disciple of a powerful existence who went by 'Yu Gong.' The number of people with great talent who were not disciples under powerful existences was overly small, while those who didn't show enough potential could not attract the attention of powerful existences. When it came to such people, the powerful existences would not gain anything from taking them as disciples.
All things considered, there were only a few worth vying for, with Xue Ying being one of them.
In the Calm Sea Prefecture, inside the cultivation room within Xue Ying's abode.
The best outcome I can hope for in the Myriad Flower Feast is to become a disciple under His Majesty, Xue Ying inwardly said. But His Majesty is the strongest existence in the Deity World, and there's not much meaning in him accepting disciples. It's already been so very long since he's last taken a disciple. Being apprenticed to one of those three would also be a good outcome.
Powerful Existences.
Detached from the endless river of time, they were truly eternal existences. Stage four World Deities were very rare, and crossing the final step to become a powerful existence was very difficult. Even so, after countless years…twenty three powerful existences had accumulated in the Bloodshed God Palace!
And the most dazzling figure of them all was His Majesty, the Bloodshed God Emperor!
Second to him in status were the three ancestors!
The other nineteen powerful existences followed after them.
The three ancestors…
The first was known as the 'Overlord of Destruction.' He started out as the ruler of a world from the Dark Abyss and was known as one of the oldest powerful existences from the Dark Abyss; his age was definitely ranked in the top three oldest. At one point, his avatar arrived to the Deity World and walked about it, eventually taking on a disciple—a disciple now known as the Bloodshed God Emperor! As one of the oldest rulers of the Dark Abyss, he also gradually improved as he instructed the Bloodshed God Emperor. His current strength might have been inferior to his disciple's, but he was still stronger than any ordinary powerful existence.
Furthermore, he was best known for his talent in instructing disciples!
Over countless years, he taught a total of five powerful existences other than the Bloodshed God Emperor!
Therefore, despite having been born in the Dark Abyss, the status which the Overlord of Destruction held within the Bloodshed God Palace was extremely high, and he was treated with utmost respect. He usually resided within the territory ruled by the Bloodshed God Palace.
The second ancestor went by 'Pang Yi.'
He was a savage creature who spawned very soon after the Deity world's birth! During the first stages of the Deity world's life, countless creatures roamed its territory who would kill each other at every turn. Ultimately, only five of these creatures survived, and they all became powerful existences. They were known as the 'Fierce Five of the Deity World.'
Pang Yi was the head of this group! While the other four were only at the level of ordinary powerful existences, the strength of their ruler was much higher.
The third ancestor was the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master.
The Bamboo Mountain was one of the nineteen prefectures ruled by the Bloodshed God Palace, and its Prefecture Master was only a stage four World Deity!
According to common sense, any stage four World Deity who lived for too long would see their nature gradually changed, and they would eventually find it unable to keep their original heart secure! The lifespan of any ordinary stage four World Deity was around ten billion years, and it was very rare to see it go beyond a few billion years more than that. It was very rare to see a stage four World Deity live for more than twenty billion years.
However, the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master had already lived for five hundred billion years and was known as the stage four World Deity with the longest lifespan in history. To this very day, not even the slightest sign of his True Deity Heart crumbling could be detected. Furthermore, his strength was especially high, even more so than any ordinary powerful existence! It assured him a spot within the ranks of the three ancestors! There was no one in the Deity world or the Dark Abyss who still hoped to see his True Deity Heart crumble, seeing how ordinary stage four World Deities would only live for ten billion years, yet he lived for this long. There had even been powerful existences who did not manage to live for as long as he did. Altogether, he was not a powerful existence, but everyone treated him as one. Even ordinary powerful existences would treat him with courtesy and respect.
Even the Holy Master, Crimson Dust, did not live for as long as this man did.
All three ancestors are more powerful than any ordinary powerful existence, Xue Ying thought to himself. The only issue is that, with their strength being what it is, they don't place much importance on receiving disciples.
"Xue Ying, Seventh Mei Yu has come over to pay you a visit." Jing Qiu's voice arrived from outside the cultivation room.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - Going to the Bloodshed God Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 453: Going to the Bloodshed God Palace
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying left his cultivation room to see Seventh Mei Yu standing within the courtyard. He was still using the appearance of a handsome teenager dressed in white robe. Turning toward Xue Ying, he said with a giggle, "Brother Dong Bo, my father wishes to see you."
"Your father?" Xue Ying was startled. "Dare I ask who your father is…?"
"He is Monarch Mo Xue," Seventh Mei Yu stated without any attempt to conceal it.
"Monarch Mo Xue?"
Xue Ying was enlightened. He had long been confused as to why Monarch Mo Xue came over to watch the Calm Sea Prefecture battles in person. The reason turned out to be that his child was participating. He had heard that Monarch Mo Xue had six daughters in total! Seeing how Seventh Mei Yu was younger than any of them…it seemed like Monarch Mo Xue finally had a son?
Jing Qiu, startled by these words, blurted out, "Monarch Mo Xue wants to see Xue Ying?"
"Mn." Seventh Mei Yu nodded. "My father is currently back at my cavern residence. Brother Dong Bo, we should make our way over quickly."
"Jing Qiu, I'll be going now," Xue Ying said. Since Monarch Mo Xue took the initiative to look for him, he did not dare delay the matter any longer.
Jing Qiu lightly nodded. She sent Xue Ying and Seventh Mei Yu off with her eyes.
Monarch Mo Xue was sitting cross-legged inside the living hall of Seventh Mei Yu's cavern dwelling, in the position occupied by the house master. Xue Ying respectfully bowed as soon as he entered. "Junior Dong Bo greets Monarch."
"Have a seat." Monarch Mo Xue smiled.
Xue Ying hastily grabbed a seat by a table to the side, while Seventh Mei Yu sat down opposite to him.
Currently, the living hall housed Monarch Mo Xue, Xue Ying, Seventh Mei Yu, and several other attendants.
"I've watched those battles you've participated in," Monarch Mo Xue began. "Your potential is rather good, but you're walking along a side path, while your mistakes are many and hilarious. If I'm not wrong, you've never been taught by a powerful existence or a stage four World Deity, right?"
Stage four World Deities were just a step behind powerful existences, and there was not much of a gap in terms of their understanding of the Laws of the World.
"That's correct. This junior has always walked along his own path during cultivation," Xue Ying respectfully replied.
"I thought that would be the case. Let's just look at that Star Deity Heart secret skill of yours." Monarch Mo Xue casually waved his hand, and a spear appeared before him. Using it, he displayed none other than Xue Ying's own Chaotic Suppression. To have reached his current realm, Monarch Mo Xue had long since grasped hold of the Chaotic Deity Heart. It was child's play for him to grasp hold of this secret skill. "Take a look at this secret skill…"
Monarch Mo Xue went on to mentor Xue Ying, which left the latter quite puzzled.
Why was Monarch Mo Xue treating him so well? Was it because of his potential? However, in the eyes of any common passerby, he wasn't a grade one True Meaning Transcendent, which meant it would take him an overly long time to become a stage three or four World Deity!
This confusion didn't prevent Xue Ying from listening in rapt attention! After all, it remained that such pointers were extremely precious.
The training session lasted for a full two days. During that time, Seventh Mei Yu was watching calmly from the side, drinking fruit wine.
Monarch Mo Xue was in great spirits the entire time he taught. From time to time, Xue Ying would mention some of the doubts he had, which served to further confirm to Monarch Mo Xue just how high Xue Ying's comprehension ability was.
"Alright, let's stop here." Monarch Mo Xue abruptly stopped.
Xue Ying was hesitant to interrupt this training session. After two days of teaching, Monarch Mo Xue no longer felt unfamiliar to him. They might not have a real teacher-student relationship, but there was stille some vague connection. After all, even an inner disciple of a powerful existence would hardly ever be taught directly. These two whole days full of attention from a stage four World Deity were worth much more than what an inner disciple could get in their entire life as a student under a powerful existence.
"Why is Monarch treating me so well…?" Xue Ying could not help but finally blurt out.
"To create karma." Monarch Mo Xue smiled. "Three years from now, at the Bloodshed God Palace, there will certainly be a large number of powerful existences who will want to take you as their disciple. Have you considered whose invitation you'd like to accept?"
"It would naturally be best to have as strong a teacher as possible," Xue Ying spoke honestly. "I would be most happy if I could become the disciple of His Majesty, but even choosing one of the three ancestors as my master would be a very good outcome. In case I get neither of these chances, I'll simply find the most appropriate teacher for me."
Monarch Mo Xue nodded. "His Majesty has been accepting disciples for a very long time. Even grade one True Meaning Transcendents aren't worth a thought of his. As for the three grand elders…you do have some hope with them. Remember, of the three, the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master would be the best choice. Following him would be the Overlord of Destruction, and finally Pang Yi."
"The Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master would be the best choice?" Xue Ying was startled. "Isn't he a stage four World Deity, though?"
"Has there ever been another stage four World Deity who lived for five hundred billion years?" Monarch Mo Xue shook his head, lowering his voice. "I will tell you something which you must never spread this to others."
"Yes." Xue Ying nodded.
"The Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master might be a stage four World Deity on the surface, but his level is such that he can no longer be considered a World Deity," Monarch Mo Xue explained with a complex look in his eyes.
"He's not a World Deity?" Xue Ying was befuddled.
"That geezer never agreed to let his Absolute Art spread to the public. If only I could have learned it…" Monarch Mo Xue muttered. His eyes betrayed his unwillingness, but he soon grinned. "I won't tell you too much. Just keep in mind that it would absolutely be in your interest to have him as your master. Should he be willing to accept you, you better accept his offer immediately. If your potential is high enough to receive his pamper and care, eventually even learning that Absolute Art of his, you'll truly be thanking me afterward."
"This junior understands." Xue Ying nodded.
"As for the case in which none of the three ancestors invite you, it's best if you just judge for yourself," Monarch Mo Xue said.
Soon after they finished their chat, Xue Ying returned to his own cavern dwelling and went into what would be a long period of closed-door cultivation. The guidance he had just received had been of huge help to him.
Monarch Mo Xue mostly taught him about the Star Deity Heart.
As for the Mirage Deity Heart? Monarch Mo Xue had actually taught him some minor things about it as well, guiding him to abandon his study of the mirage body aspect and delve more into the area of domains.
******
Three years passed in the blink of an eye.
An extravagant-looking starfield flying ship set off from Calm Sea Prefecture. It was driven personally by the Prefecture Master, who brought Xue Ying and the other people along.
"Travelling in a starfield flying ship is a true luxury." On the deck, the shocked Xue Ying, Jing Qiu, Purple Thunder Emperor, and other Deities of Xia Clan had their gazes cast across the flowing lights and colors along the spacetime passageway. Naturally, the subordinates of the top hundred rankers were all allowed to witness this view.
"By comparison, travel via the space teleportation array is fairly uncomfortable and feels a lot like tunnelling through soil," the Purple Thunder Emperor commented. "Indeed, it feels much better to travel in a starfield flying ship."
The spacetime passageway they were in was filled with flowing lights and colors all throughout.
The ship was currently making its way across, a trip that would last about the time it took to brew a cup of tea from its original departure.
With how far away the Calm Sea Prefecture was from the Bloodshed God Palace, the trip by teleportation array would also last about the time it took to brew a cup of tea. Having to spend that much time being squeezed through soil was greatly uncomfortable. Only those of high status and power, such as stage three World Deities and higher, would own their personal starfield flying ship.
"We are here!"
The timespace passage filled with flowing lights and colors finally opened up as the ship reached its end.
"Is this the Bloodshed God Palace?" Xue Ying and the others were watching an unbelievable scene unfold right before their eyes.
The Myriad Flower Feast? A flying ship made of dead wood arrived at the Bloodshed God Palace, navigated by a bald teenager dressed in white robes. His eyes seemed to encompass the entire boundless world. The corners of his lip curled upward. From what I've heard, youngest disciple brother Dong Bo is participating in the Myriad Flower Feast, and he even put on quite the show in the Calm Sea Prefecture. As his elder disciple brother, there's no way I wouldn't take a look.
A fiery-red ship of titanic proportions and covered with flames was in the middle of ascending. It was one of the other ships which tunneled through spacetime in order to make its way over to the starry sky outside of the Bloodshed God Palace.
Very soon, the ship disappeared, and only a white-haired old man with the countenance of a child remained in its place. He had a beaming, ear-to-ear smile on his face; he was none other than Forefather Scarlet Flame. I've led Dong Bo over to participate in this battle, but who could have known this brat would be so dazzling.
During this time's Myriad Flower Feast…Xue Ying ranked in the top three in terms of potential!
Sou sou sou…
As the Myriad Flower Feast reached its final stages before the opening, most of the stage four World Deities and many powerful existences who were invited had already arrived. Most of them were not from the Bloodshed God Palace's territory, some even having come over from the Dark Abyss after receiving the invitation. There were many ancient and mystical existences in the Deity world who made their way here, as well some other very powerful but low-key figures.
As long as they held no hatred toward the Bloodshed God Emperor, it was only natural that they would come over in respect toward him.

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - Elder Disciple Brother Hui Ming
chapters.content:
Chapter 454: Elder Disciple Brother Hui Ming
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying and the others were standing on the deck of the starfield flying ship, admiring the speckling scene ahead of them.
"The Bloodshed God Palace. This is the Bloodshed God Palace!" All of them were truly startled.
There was a piece of land floating in the starry sky that was even bigger than the Calm Sea Prefecture Capital! A continuous range of palaces spread along its surface, with a central palace marked with the characters 'Bloodshed' being the grandest and largest. Other than the palaces, nine different sculptures were situated throughout the four corners of the Bloodshed God Palace land. These exquisite statues depicted various mutated beasts, their bodies adorned with armor.
Each mutated beast was more than a hundred billion kilometers tall, about the same height as the main palace in the center.
"So beautiful."
The entire Bloodshed God Palace was emitting a dream-like rainbow light. Every palace, building, street, and even the nine sculptures were surrounded by ancient arrays. These arrays unceasingly let out a worldly might accompanied by colorful lights.
This made it so that, despite the relatively meager size of the Bloodshed God Palace, its radiance reached more than billions upon billions of kilometers away…
"This place isn't only beautiful; those arrays operating spontaneously are so powerful that it's hard to even imagine how frightening it would be to see them unleashed." Seventh Mei Yu was watching from afar. "It's been said that the magnificent Bloodshed God Emperor has built this Bloodshed God Palace himself. After being continually reinforced over countless years, the slightest show of strength from those arrays might even kill powerful existences, much less to say World Deities!"
"Not even powerful existences can resist it?"
"The Bloodshed God Palace is worthy of its fame!"
Everyone listened closely, some even sighing in astonishment. This place was none other than the core essence of the Bloodshed God Palace, as well as the main residence of the strongest expert in the Deity World—His Majesty, the Bloodshed God Emperor. He was an existence for whom killing any ordinary powerful existence was child's play. It was not hard to discern just how powerful the arrays he took the effort in setting down were.
At the helm of his large ship, the Calm Sea Prefecture Master finally arrived at the Bloodshed God Palace. There, the experts were led to their lodgings by a group of soldiers.
"Dong Bo, this is where you and your comrades will stay temporarily," said a tall and sturdy soldier wearing black armor. "I trust you all know the rules of the Bloodshed God Palace already. Should you go against any of them, you might just lose your life before you even get the chance to regret your action."
"We understand," Xue Ying replied.
"Mn. You can all go into closed-door cultivation. Once it's time for the final battle to begin, we will, of course, inform you and take you over to where it will take place." Having explained this final bit of information, the black-armored soldier finally left.
Xue Ying sent him off with his eyes.
To the side, the Dragon Mountain Emperor let out a sigh. "This is the Bloodshed God Palace alright. Even the most ordinary of soldiers here is a World Deity! In fact, we didn't come across a single Deity soldier on our way here."
"Dragon Mountain," the Purple Thunder Emperor began with a laugh, "the legions commanded by the palace are separated into three different classes. The third class legions are lowest in rank, while the prefecture capitals usually house second class legions. As for the ones located here, they are all of the highest rank—class one legions! Any such legion has World Deities as soldiers of the lowest rank, and they are usually only mobilized to deal with powerful existences."
"Oh!" The Dragon Mountain Emperor felt enlightened. He had not lived in the Deity world for very long time, and most of the time he did live here was spent living in a small, isolated corner of the world. His knowledge wasn't as complete as some of the others'. In fact, his trip to the prefecture capital had cost him all of the treasures he still had!
"We'll go in first, then," Xue Ying said. He looked around at his surroundings to see the other experts participating in the Bloodshed God Palace Battle along with their comrades.
The type of cavern dwellings they were assigned was of the smallest scale, only occupying an area of around five kilometers.
******
Xue Ying sat cross-legged on the grass next to one of the rivers within his cavern dwelling, holding a crystal jade in his hand. The information inside this piece of jade was rapidly entering his mind. It had been sent over by the soldier from before, and it contained the battle scenes of all nineteen hundred Deity experts who would participate in the following battle, mainly those from the arena and survival battles.
Of the nineteen hundred participants, a total of five are like Jiu She in that they grasped hold of a grade one Deity Heart. Perhaps there'll even be another two or three who were still concealing their strength? Xue Ying thought. I have no way of defeating any of those people. In most of the previous instances of the Myriad Flower Feast, people like them would always occupy the top few spots in the rankings."
Alas, my goal is to become the disciple of a powerful existence, as well as accumulate some more experience and knowledge. If possible, I would also like to eat a Myriad Flower True Fruit. Xue Ying immersed himself in studying his opponents. Looks like the average combat power in this batch of opponents is quite high.
As he watched those scenes of past battles, he split the participants into categories according to their combat power. There were people he could not fight, some whom he could fight one-on-one, as well as a group of people he could easily defeat.
The Bloodshed God Palace would send every participant the intelligence reports on all of their opponents so that they would be aware of who they were about to go against. This would serve make the following battle that much more exciting. If a powerful expert were to go into a blind fight against a Deity with a grade one Deity Heart, their loss would simply be unfair.
"Xue Ying, Xue Ying," a voice reached him from afar in the form of a transmission.
He turned over, only to see his wife walking over with a bald young man dressed in white robes. This youngster carried an exquisite aura about him, as if he could observe, and transcend, anything. His eyes were filled with endless might, as if they encompassed billions of worlds. Xue Ying instantly understood this person to be an ultimate expert on the same level as Monarch Mo Xue and the Calm Sea Prefecture Master.
"Disciple Brother Dong Bo." The white-robed young man walked over to Xue Ying with a smile.
"Greetings, Disciple Brother Hui Ming." Xue Ying stepped up to greet him.
"I've heard that, after teacher died, Crimson Rock Mountain fell into the Material World. It then conveniently received such a good disciple. Who could have known that you, Disciple Brother Dong Bo, would turn out to be this amazing," the bald young man sang Xue Ying's praises with a laugh. "Forefather Scarlet Flame let me know that, a while ago, you've used up half your soul for the sake of saving your wife. Even then, there's still such great talent within you. The way I see it, it won't be just one powerful existence who will want to receive you a disciple after the upcoming battle."
"Disciple Brother is exaggerating," Xue Ying replied humbly.
Jing Qiu stepped in, "Since Eldest Disciple Brother has come over to visit, I thought I'd bring him over straightaway."
Seeing how both she and Xue Ying cultivated on Crimson Dust Island, they were naturally aware of Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming's appearance.
"By the way, Disciple Brother, that enemy of ours who killed teacher is not a member of the Bloodshed God Palace, right?" Xue Ying asked. "Is there a chance I'll accidentally become their disciple after the feast?"
"They are a powerful existence from the Temporal Island," Hui Ming answered. "Had they been a powerful existence from the Bloodshed God Palace, Scarlet Flame would not have led you to participate in the Myriad Flower Feast."
"Understood." Xue Ying nodded.
The two of them continued chatting with each other, though an unseen undulation had enveloped their surroundings at some point.
These waves served to shield them from any spying or eavesdropping techniques, in a similar way to how that sack which Ancestor Black Wind obtained long ago prevented the Laws of Profound Mysteries from entering it. Powerful existences could transcend the Laws of the World, allowing them to easily refine such goods. Thus, it was not only Hui Ming or Xue Ying who owned such preventive treasures, but both of them.
Once they entered the influence of such treasures, not even the Temporal Temple could succeed in investigating their conversation. After all, the technique employed by the temple was ultimately just a reversal of time.
In the Deity world, when assassins kill, they would usually bring along such treasures so that others could not discover whom they were killed by.
"Teacher's hatred concerns a powerful existence, so there's no point in you thinking about it right now," Hui Ming said. "It's too distant a matter for you."
"I understand. It's not like teacher asked us to help him get revenge in any case." Xue Ying laughed.
"Haha…" Hui Ming lightly nodded with a smile. "I envy you, Disciple Brother. Not only are you a Realm Lord, but you're also accompanied by your true love. You even have your brothers and sisters following you along as you participate in the Myriad Flower Feast… Truth be told, I'm quite jealous of all that."
Jing Qiu giggled from the side.
Xue Ying looked to his wife, and the two of them seemed to understand each other through their gazes. Both could feel the other's love.
"I'm also very satisfied with my life," Xue Ying said. What did it matter that one was unparalleled…if they were alone?

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - The Myriad Flower Feast Officially Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 455: The Myriad Flower Feast Officially Begins
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Disciple Brother Dong Bo, I've been spending quite some time at Remote Dust Temple. If you ever want to find me, you should look there first. As for ordinary communication, let's just handle that via communication treasure," said Hui Ming.
"Alright." Xue Ying and Hui Ming exchanged imprints so that they could, in the future, create a more solid relationship through their communication wristbands.
It wasn't long before Hui Ming bade his farewell and left the place.
"Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming is heavily respected by the disciples of Crimson Rock Mountain, and now that I've finally met him, I really do think he's extraordinary. He took the initiative to come meet me, and he's acted so polite toward me, as his disciple brother." Xue Ying sighed. It was true that he displayed some huge potential, but the news of him having a grade one True Meaning had yet to be made public. On top of that, Hui Ming had also been a grade one True Meaning Transcendent in the past, the only such Transcendent Sacred Master Crimson Dust received when he was still alive. Currently, he was a stage four World Deity.
"Apparently, Disciple Brother Hui Ming was met with a huge setback in his relationship when he was still young and thus became a monk." Jing Qiu sighed. "As a grade one True Meaning Transcendent, his talent is nothing short of extraordinary, but that mixture of gratitude and resentment he held pushed him to spread his religion rampantly…just so he could become a stage four World Deity that bit faster."
Xue Ying nodded.
The power of faith…
Was very beneficial toward one's cultivation! The accumulation of faith power would bring one's cultivation speed to a whole new level. Hui Ming's talent had always been outstanding, seeing how he was a grade one True Meaning Transcendent, and his cultivation speed only soared higher with it. But while the power of faith brought him success, it also led him to ruin! Faith was, after all, bound by karma. The more one absorbed, the harder it became for them to escape that karma. This was the sole biggest obstacle he, a stage four World Deity, faced in becoming a powerful existence.
Even so, countless World Deities were still spreading their faith wherever they could. They found this path to be their only chance at becoming stage three World Deities! The luckiest of them might even become stage four World Deities. It was only natural for such people to willingly absorb faith power. As for the fact that they would then find it more difficult to become powerful existences? Just how many powerful existences had there appeared in the Deity world and Dark Abyss, from ancient times and all the way to now?
It was simply too difficult.
Grade one True Meaning Transcendents, on the other hand, would usually not absorb faith unless they had a very good reason to do so. Xue Ying had also been warned by Crimson Rock that he should never absorb faith power. Any grade one True Meaning Transcendent had boundless potential and were practically set from the start to become stage four World Deities. To absorb faith just for the sake of saving time, while destroying all hope of becoming a powerful existence, was absolutely not worth it.
******
As the days went by, the moment for the Myriad Flower Feast to officially begin soon arrived.
In the central palace of the Bloodshed God Palace.
The start of the Myriad Flower Feast was held at none other than the highest spot of this palace which towered above all others. Clouds could be seen surrounding the place, and many powerful existences made their way through the sky before landing there. All of the powerful existences exuded vastly different auras. Some of them were so scorching hot that they could instantly burn all life within an area of a billion kilometers, while others would be as reserved as the endless abyss. There were even powerful existences with auras so sharp that they could tear through the void. Xue Ying and the others all felt jittery at this sight.
The nineteen hundred final participants were currently sitting at the outermost perimeter, with tables brimming with food placed in front of each and every one of them.
There were soldiers situated all around them, tasked with guarding the area and all of them at least at the grade one World Deity realm. There was even the occasional stage two World Deity here and there. Closer to His Majesty, powerful existences were flanked by stage three World Deities acting as imperial guards, respectfully watching over them.
From what I remember, General Ying's father is a stage three World Deity and one of His Majesty's imperial guards. Xue Ying took a glance in the direction of His Majesty, sweeping his vision over the stage three World Deities there. He is most likely one of those people.
They, mere Deities, were naturally unable to see what was happening over at the feast. Instead, they felt an invisible force pressing down on them, and their naked eyes could only see a blurry scene.
The Bloodshed God Emperor could be seen in the highest position, crimson robes adorning his figure. His eyes were deep, and his aura could be vaguely described as boundless, dark, and destructive. Just by sitting there, he was able to leave the other powerful existences feeling uneasy. To his sides were three other people seated at an equally high position, their auras comparable in power to the Bloodshed God Emperor's.
One of them was a Dark Abyss ruler with a towering body and eyes covered in their entirety by countless blood signs. Much like how the Temporal Island Lord, the Bloodshed God Emperor, and the Myriad God Palace Head were the absolute existences of the Deity world, there were also three rulers who stood at the very peak of the Dark Abyss.
The next person was also a ruler of the Dark Abyss. This one was a cold and handsome man adorned by golden armor. He had the sharpest eyes of the three, and none of the powerful existences below dared look into them.
The third and final expert was a graceful, luxurious-looking woman. Her aura was the most reserved and warm amongst them, though she did not seem to be at any disadvantage in face of the Bloodshed God Emperor and the others.
Other than these four…
The other powerful existences were not split or seated in any hierarchy, though all of them were mighty in their own ways. There were about close to a hundred of them! Some had come from the Dark Abyss, while others were the subordinates of the Bloodshed God Emperor. The largest group was formed of idle powerful existences coming from various organizations. After all, powerful existences were all prideful by nature, and most refused to sit under other people. Even the powerful existences under the Bloodshed God Emperor, the Temporal Island Lord, or the Myriad God Palace Head were not necessarily simple servants.
For instance, the Bloodshed God Emperor had quite a few subordinates, but a portion of them had joined as a means to evade danger, while others joined due to a teacher-student relationship…
Other than powerful existences, there were a number of stage four World Deities who had come over to participate in the feast! However, the largest portion of this group was actually made up of experts from the Bloodshed God Palace. Most stage four World Deities from other organizations were not qualified to attend such an event.
"Old monkey, is it true that you've found a Sun Star Essence Rock in the Sun Star?"
"Who's spouting this rubbish about a Sun Star Essence Rock? No such rock has been found in the Sun Star since more than a hundred billion years ago, so how could I get one? You all must have been thinking about it so much that you've turned mad."
"Quick, come join us for a drink, Old Brother Wu. It's been too long since we two last met, right? I didn't think for a second that you'd come over to participate in this Myriad Flower Feast."
"I've finished a closed-door cultivation session, and I've gained quite a lot from it, so I thought I'd to come out for a stroll."
The powerful existences were all talking amongst themselves. The ones who were relatively close would sit close to each other, while those who shared enmity would maintain some distance.
"Fellow ladies and gentlemen," from his high position, the Bloodshed God Emperor began to speak in a low voice. "So many good friends have come today. I am truly happy to see the Myriad Flower Feast so crowded. You can all keep on drinking and chatting amongst yourselves… but while you do that, how about we watch those youngsters from my Bloodshed God Palace fight each other?"
The many powerful existences turned over to look in the distance, their vision landing on the nineteen hundred Deity experts. Since only the members of the Bloodshed God Palace could accept disciples, most of the powerful existences had simply come to enjoy the crowd.
Forefather Scarlet Flame was also part of the latter group. He had refused to join the Bloodshed God Palace and was instead one of the idle powerful existences.
"Let it begin, then," the Bloodshed God Emperor calmly ordered. In the eyes of this existence who had always been standing at the apex, the Myriad Flower Feast was nothing more than a gathering of old friends. The matter of choosing disciples was no more than an afterthought. Even ordinary existences of high status would rarely select disciples, while the Bloodshed God Emperor would usually not care enough even to select grade one True Meaning Transcendents.
******
Powerful existences saw this as no more than a small event and more of a small pleasure. But to Xue Ying and the other Deities, this was a hard-earned opportunity! They sought to make as good a use of this moment as possible, for it was truly rare to see so many powerful existences gathered in the same place!
"Prepare yourselves." A blood-armored commander walked out from the inner section. As a stage four World Deity, his aura was vast and mighty. He swept his gaze across the nineteen hundred Deity experts. "I'll be sending you all inside now. The battle will begin soon."
Xue Ying, Seventh Mei Yu, Jiu She, Drunk Guest, and many other extremely formidable Deity experts were all quietly waiting.
Finally-
The commander from before activated the arrays, and the region where the nineteen hundred Deity experts stood began to glow a golden light. An invisible force then promptly moved the consciousness of Xue Ying and all the others to a distant location, while their true bodies were cut off from their senses.
"Mn?"
Soon, Xue Ying could see a towering mountain stretching up before him. It was surrounded by many other mountains, with which it connected into a chain. The mountain was littered with caverns, and a fog of various colors—from violet, to black, to golden—spiraled within.
With a sweep of his gaze, Xue Ying detected the other Deity experts who were hovering in the distance. Clearly, all nineteen hundred of those Deity experts were scattered across this mountain range.
So formidable. That array was actually able to move our consciousness here? Xue Ying inspected the body his consciousness currently inhabited. This body is very similar to my true body, being at the third level of Time Immemorial Body and also powered by the Great Chaotic True Force.
The Bloodshed God Palace Battle was known as the safest stage precisely because only the consciousness of a participant would ever be sent into battle! Even if this body perished, their consciousness would simply return to the original body.
Is that Dong Bo from the Calm Sea Prefecture? He took first in the ranking battle and second in the survival battle. One of the experts noticed Xue Ying and immediately flew away to some other place with a frown.
Indeed, Xue Ying ranked very high amongst the nineteen hundred Deities. Only someone with a grade one Deity Heart could hope to suppress him.

chapters.title: Chapter 456 - Battle in the God Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 456: Battle in the God Palace
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying gaze swept over the continuous chain of mountains. Altogether, three Deity experts were currently situated atop towering mountains, including himself—all of whom were keeping an appropriate distance against each other.
Hua~ Suddenly, the only thing that could be seen was an endless torrent of weapons rapidly condensing from the soil and mountainous rock of the surrounding terrain. Sabers, swords, staves, clubs, whips, spears, hammers, axes…all sorts of Deity grade weapons had formed.
With a wave of his hand, three spears and a huge amount of pikes flew toward Xue Ying from a storage treasure beneath him. He'd easily refined the storage treasure and then stored those weapons inside of it whilst keeping a spear in his hand. Actually, to Xue Ying, his 'mirage body,' with a weapon formed from the mirage, was already strong enough.
The other two distant Deities also chose their respective weapons and then waited silently. The fact that they'd dared to remain here served to showcase how strong their survival capabilities were.
"The God Palace Battle doesn't limit your actions. No matter what you do, you'll be ranked according to how many venomous bugs you've killed at the end of the competition." A vast and mighty voice resounded through the ears of all of the Deity experts, "The top hundred will all be able to attend the Myriad Flower Feast and enjoy a Myriad Flower True Fruit. Furthermore, these hundred will also definitely be accepted as the disciple of a powerful existence. As for those ranked beyond hundred…it will be up to your luck."
Hua!
A huge, blood-red list of names suddenly appeared high up in the sky above the mountain range.
"Your current ranking will be displayed on this list based on how many venomous bugs you've killed. The list will be kept up to date in real time, so that you all will be able to know your rankings." The mighty voice continued, "Then…the God Palace's Battle begins now!"
The instant he finished his announcement, a huge amount of power surged through each of the mountains in the mountain range, causing them to faintly tremor.
Xue Ying and the other two experts turned to stare at what was happening in the mountain range they were in. The only thing they could see was violet fog rapidly condensing into a violet venomous bug that was about the size of a millstone in one of the caves. It had a tough outer shell and a pair of compound eyes that it swept over its surroundings with. Afterward, its wings fluttered, and it disappeared from its original position.
Shua.
Three starry-blue robed Xue Yings and a thin, small swordsman simultaneously appeared. An arrow also tore through as it flew through space in their direction.
All three of them had thrown themselves toward the bug!
The arrow had still torn through the empty void, however; thus when it struck the violet venomous bug that was situated over five hundred kilometers away in the void, it had been forced back into the real world. Its collision with the bug's outer shell caused slight cracks to appear, which gradually began to recover after a moment.
"What a formidable venomous bug." Xue Ying, the thin swordsman, and the enormous hunk who'd shot the arrow were all inwardly startled to see this.
The enormous hunk was known as Guo Xie and had been ranked 19 during the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture's survival battle. His arrow techniques were thus extremely powerful. Even though that shot hadn't been a desperate killing blow, it had still been quite formidable. Yet, it had only left a few cracks on the venomous bug's outer shell.
Sou, sou, sou.
All three Xue Yings disappeared simultaneously and then reappeared next to the violet venomous bug. All three of his spears were imbued with the destructive might of Chaotic Suppression using the Great Chaotic True Force as they swung toward the bug. As his spear swung through the air, nearby space began to crumble apart. The venomous insect intended to pierce through the void in order to escape, yet it was to no avail. Its only choice was to face this Xue Ying's terrifying attack head-on.
Peng, peng, peng~ At times, a spear would collide with the venomous bugs' claws as it swept across its abdomen. Other times, a spear would slam into its shell, which caused the venomous bug to let out an agonized screech that reverberated in all directions. When this happened, it made Xue Ying's three mirage bodies all feel a sharp pain in their ears as dizzy spells hit them. Fortunately, his Time Immemorial Body was able to completely resist against the sound.
Si la! A terrifying beam of sword light suddenly appeared from the side and pierced into the venomous bug's head, though it was only able to pierce halfway through. However, the thin swordsman immediately retreated afterward, as the three Xue Yings had lashed their spears at him!
"He retreated really fast." The three Xue Yings glanced at him and then continued their attack on the bug.
"This Dong Bo truly is quite formidable, while that venomous bug is quite tough to kill. It'll be tough for us to try and kill that bug right under his nose." The thin swordsman frowned as he mused from afar.
The enormous hunk, Guo Xie, frowned as he held onto his bow. "Dong Bo's attainments in the Mirage Deity Heart have reached an unfathomable stage. His true body is able to hide in the mirage; thus, there's no way for us to find it. As for the other three Xue Yings fighting, they're nothing more than mirage bodies; let's not think about killing them. Even if we did, it'd be useless, as he can immediately condense another when one dies."
"Mn. It seems I have no way to kill that venomous bug," the swordsman said before turning around and disappearing.
The enormous hunk, Guo Xie, wasn't in a rush to run away however. Instead, he continued to watch from afar. He then raised his Deity-grade bow and notched three arrows.
The distant three Xue Yings were currently attacking the venomous bug together in a frenzied state. The venomous bug truly had a great amount of defense. Only after a full-out frenzied attack from Xue Ying did its shell begin to crumble and blood began to show on its body.
