It howled in pain as it continued to fight Xue Ying, but its chest suddenly shot out a venomous strike that was extremely fast and sudden. This strike pierced through one of his mirage bodies, which—despite its fearlessness and strength—easily dissipated only to recondense after expelling the strong venom.
"Now." Guo Xie's eyes suddenly brightened.
Xiu xiu xiu!
His three arrows were akin to three dazzling meteors and left three different projections as they pierced through the void and appeared around the violet venomous bug.
Dang, dang, dang. The three 'Xue Ying's used their their own bodies to absorb the continues attacks of the venomous bug in order to reach out and parry these three arrows! Considering Xue Ying's level of control toward the mirage and toward space, and considering how mysterious his spear techniques were, it was hard for him not to block those three arrows.
"Those arrows were truly quite powerful." The three Xue Yings were shaken from the impact of the arrows, and they all immediately flew backward. At that moment, the venomous bug seized the opportunity and attempted to escape.
Sou.
The three 'Xue Ying's immediately pursued the bug.
"He'd rather ignore the venomous bug in order to block my attacks?" Guo Xie frowned. If it had been any other Deity expert, they wouldn't have been able to lock down this venomous bug like Xue Ying had. Though, he was able to let the bug freely attack him because of his mirage bodies.
"Whatever, I'll just give this bug to him." Guo Xie moved. He left a dazzling trail of light as he soared through the sky at a rapid speed until he'd disappeared from the area.
The only reason that he and that thin swordsman had dared to try and steal this insect from Xue Ying was because of their relatively strong movement techniques.
Peng, peng, peng~
Xue Ying continued to utilize several spear techniques in tandem with one another. He pierced and crushed the bug's skull, yet the bug still didn't die and continued to frenziedly retaliate.
Pu!
When its shell finally broke apart completely, Xue Ying rapidly pierced its body with one of his spears, causing it to tremble violently before its body began to break apart. Only now did the venomous bug truly die.
"Oh boy, killing a venomous bug will take ten breaths of time?" Xue Ying was dumbstruck at this. He then turned his gaze upwards to look at the enormous, blood-red list in the sky. There were currently a total of sixty-five names listed on it, of which Xue YIng was currently ranked sixty-fifth!
The entire sky above the palace was filled with an illusion of the chain of mountains. Several illusory figures of Deity experts were also present, as well as the immeasurably huge blood-red list.
Everyone inside of the God Palace was currently watching the God Palace's Battle.
His Majesty the God Emperor, as well as the many powerful existences, were all chatting amongst themselves as they enjoyed the battle.
As for the World Deities in the God Palace, such as White Sand City Lord and King Rong Hai, as well as the Deities present such as those from the Xia Clan and Jin Qiu, they were all looking upward.
"Look quickly!" The Xia Clan Deities were truly excited when they saw the enormous, blood-red list update. "Even though there's only sixty-five names on the list, Dong Bo's on it!"
"The God Palace Battle has only just begun," the Purple Thunder Emperor instantly retorted. "The longer the battle goes on for, the crueler it will become. The participants might even begin to kill one another."
"Considering Dong Bo's combat power, he'll definitely be able to attend the final Myriad Flower Feast and enjoy a Myriad Flower True Fruit," Yun Hai said.
They were all looking forward to seeing Xue Ying succeed.
******

chapters.title: Chapter 457 - Moving Alone
chapters.content:
Chapter 457: Moving Alone
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The Bloodshed God Palace Battle was finally underway.
A group of six Deity experts was currently assaulting a black venomous bug. Particles were forming in the surrounding space which would crumble ever so often at times; other times, it was cut… The six experts were putting all their power and techniques on display, leading the black venomous bug to howl and struggle. Its injuries were getting more serious by the second before a thin sword finally pierced its body, out of which fresh blood spurted out. At that point, the venomous bug finally stopped struggling, though the other five experts quickly followed with a few more strikes.
The six experts then looked up at the enormous blood-colored list which now contained a total of 191 names, with new names appearing ever so often.
"Haha, fellow gentlemen, my luck was good enough to net me the last hit on that venomous bug." A rangy man holding onto two swords laughed. "It's only by teaming together that we'll have any hope to net a place in the top hundred. If each of us were to move alone, we'd all likely take spots lower even than the 500th! Instead, you can all see that Brother Ni is ranked 15th, while I am already in the top 200."
"Alright, alright. It's too early to celebrate; we four have yet to enter the list."
One's rank was determined by how many fatal blows they landed on venomous bug!
"Let's keep going. I don't think our luck can be this poor."
"Continue."
The six went on to seek more venomous bugs to kill.
In the air some three mountains away, Xue Ying was also looking for venomous bugs. He glanced over to the side, where he saw those six Deity experts killing a bug together. Are they some of those Deities with weaker combat power? They're likely aware that it would be impossible for them to get spots in the top hundred if they were to move alone, so they chose to act together.
I should avoid them. Xue Ying was on full alert. With so many Deity experts acting all around, he had to be incredibly wary of any who might have grasped grade one Deity Hearts! If he wasn't careful, he'd be killed and sent back immediately.
The records marked at least one instance of an expert with huge combat power being killed prematurely by a group of Deities during every single Myriad Flower Feast.
However, even if he carefully avoided them, how fast would a group of Deities rushing over to him be?
Hong hong hong~
Just as the three bodies of Xue Ying were attacking a venomous bug together, space suddenly distorted, and a group of figures flashed twice before appearing at the mountain where Xue Ying was.
This group of Deity experts had a total of eight members!
"He is Calm Sea Prefecture's Dong Bo! Kill him!"
"Kill."
The eight Deities sent out attacks without a trace of hesitation.
One of them, a gray-robed man, extended both his hands, which caused the surrounding space to as if turning into an endless quagmire. Invisible waves enveloped their surrounding, making it hard to see. This force permeated the Mirage, the Shadow Space, and the real world; nothing could resist it. It even affected Xue Ying's true body which was hiding in the Mirage, which served to greatly shock him.
"I've found his true body." Of this group of experts, only the gray-robed man was able to discover Xue Ying's true body. He had just easily dealt with his concealment.
"Kill." A thunder blade moved through the sky along an arc, pierced the void, and finally reached Xue Ying.
"Go." Countless densely interwoven strands of white web were also sent over to envelop Xue Ying's position.
"Extinguish." A dazzling light condensed and converged on Xue Ying's position from every direction.
All those Deity experts were simultaneously displaying their offensive skills.
Shua.
Xue Ying was so frightened that, without a second thought, he immediately switched positions with one of his mirage bodies.
Sou sou sou…
With the help of his mirage bodies, Xue Ying rapidly shifted his position all around as he fled with great speed! It was very difficult to predict where his true body was at any moment, since his mirage bodies could appear at any spot with a single thought from his part.
"There, there, here." The gray-robed man was able to sense every switch of Xue Ying's true body with his mirage bodies, but the offensive techniques of the others could not so easily follow his instructions. In the end, they could only watch Xue Ying escape with their eyes wide.
"That Dong Bo's Mirage secret skill makes him truly formidable. It's not such an easy thing to kill him."
"Whatever, let's just hurry up and eliminate this venomous bug first."
The eight figures were standing to the side, watching Xue Ying escape into the distance, before finally killing the venomous bug which Xue Ying had heavily injured.
They had not been fully confident that the sneak attack would work. Successfully killing Xue Ying would have been a matter to celebrate, but even failing to do so and just killing a venomous bug was fine.
Only after fleeing about ten mountains away did Xue Ying finally stop. There, he turned to look around him and helplessly muttered to himself, Normally, there would truly be few people who can discover my true body if it hides in the Mirage. But the people who get to participate in this battle are all quite capable… It's likely that, in any group of ten, there would be one who's able to discover my true body.
The Mirage was powerful, but it's ability wasn't absolute. The gray-robed man from before, for instance, was employing the Minute Deity Heart trained to an extremely high stage through a domain-related secret skill he created himself! This domain sensory ability was one that broke through the deepest level of fundamental particles, which left Xue Ying unable to escape it even when hiding in the Mirage.
There were other similar skills that could easily break his concealment, such as secret skills with inherent space-related profound mysteries. Xue Ying discovered that there was quite a number of Deities who could easily discover his true body, seeing how the participants in this battle were all experts with high realms. They might not necessarily succeed in defeating him, but they could at least discover the position of his true body.
Alas, the only thing I can do is be a little more careful. It wasn't long before he discovered another venomous bug starting to form in a distant cave. He immediately went over.
His combat power actually left him in a rather awkward position.
He had no way of fighting the most powerful experts, like those who had grade one Deity Hearts.
But the people with lower combat power were well aware that they had no hope of success in moving alone, so they decided to team up. In some cases, they would even set down oaths to ensure that they would not betray one another.
It was only those with combat power that was closer to the top…that would often refrain from teaming up.
To them, whether they teamed up or not would have no effect on how efficiently they could search for venomous bugs, while problems would often arise in regards to how the prey would be split. Equally? Neither party saw any benefit in that.
******
"So despicable. They actually dared to team up together and kill our master."
"Ai, master failed to escape in the end."
"Quick, run away!"
"That team of Deities actually killed our big brother."
"I've finally escaped! This was so dangerous I nearly died."
Back in the Bloodshed God Palace, countless spectators were engrossed in watching the illusory scenes of fighting from the enormous mountain range. Following the battles was a very nerve-wracking experience. Most of the participants in the battle were moving in groups, while a select few were confident enough to move alone! Those who killed the venomous bugs alone knew that the credit went to themselves, while those who went around in groups would have points distributed to one of them at time. It only made sense that moving alone was more efficient.
The only problem was that quite a few of these people with great combat power would fall under a group's joint assault.
"Interesting."
"Look at that little brat, he is truly cunning."
"That tall person with the greataxe came up with a pretty good body-enhancing secret skill."
The many powerful existences were leisurely watching the battle.
They did not feel any pity for those lone rangers who were killed by a group of people. The way they saw it, everyone was free to make their own decision. If they were that confident in themselves, they should also be willing to admit their own defeat after one of these group attacks.
"Run away, Dong Bo! That situation is too dangerous."
"What danger are you talking about? With Dong Bo's combat power, he's not one of those people others can so easily team up against." The Xia Clan Deities, including Jing Qiu, were all nervously spectating, their hearts tightening each and every time they saw Xue Ying encounter and be pursued by a group of Deity experts.
Moving alone might have been more dangerous, but every venomous bug he killed went to him alone.
Xue Ying's kill count was steadily increasing, and his name was rapidly moving up on the list. 52th, 39th, 33rd, 25th, 19th…
Naturally, Xue Ying's combat power was quite high, with only those who grasped hold of a grade one Deity Heart having any advantage over him. As long as he survived, his ranking would naturally rise as well.
"He's 15th!" the White Sand City Lord remarked while drinking and enjoying the battle alongside his good friends, such as King Rong Hai.
"Dong Bo might manage to land a spot in the top ten." The Ink Cloud City Lord laughed to the side.

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - Sneaking Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 458: Sneaking Attack
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying wasn't surprised by his rank steadily rising. He might have only taken the 65th spot or so at first, but the majority of the experts ranked higher than him were the lucky ones who succeeded in killing a venomous bug after teaming up. It was impossible for the same person to be so lucky as to always be the one to land the final hit on each bug. If someone kept being the one to take each kill, their team would likely just go ahead and kick them out!
There's no huge gap in combat power between any of the final nineteen hundred participants in this Bloodshed God Palace Battle. Once five, six, or even eight or nine people team up, there aren't many outside those who grasped hold of a grade one Deity Heart who can survive such an assault. Xue Ying shook his head inwardly. A team of experts would also cover many different specializations, allowing them to cover for the others' weaknesses. This only further increases their threat. In any case, I can only try my best to survive.
The Bloodshed God Palace Battle wasn't meant to select the strongest hundred participants.
What it did sift out… were those who could kill the most venomous bugs under a set of rules! This meant that, rather than strength, this battle tested the decision-making of each expert.
Sou.
Xue Ying continued piercing through the many mountain ranges, and, as more time passed, the pace at which the venomous bug emerged gradually increased. Even then, Xue Ying maintained his usual vigilance and focus on survival. He would only go out to kill venomous bugs once he made sure it was safe. Due to this, his ranking began to stagnate, still lingering around 15th.
However, his vigilance combined with his self-set rule of placing survival first made sure that, even though many other Deities died and were eliminated, he kept hold of his place in the mountain range.
There's truly nothing here that can threaten me. As he walked along the mountain range, the white-robed, white-haired, white-browed Jiu She waved his hand, causing a huge golden palm to condense in mid-air which then squashed a venomous bug which was fleeing frantically. Upon coming into contact with the palm, the venomous bug was summarily splattered. I wasn't planning on revealing my skills so early in the Calm Sea Prefecture. I could have then seemed to struggle a bit more in this battle, and only reveal my true skill in the most crucial of moments. In that way, I might have sneaked in a kill on someone who grasped hold of a grade one Deity Heart. That would have been a joyous occasion.
If only that Dong Bo hadn't forced me to reveal my power so early. Now everyone's running away as soon as they land eyes upon me, Jiu She inwardly complained. The eyes beneath his white brows swept across the surroundings. There's also some invisible obstacle surrounding the boundary of this mountain range, preventing any domain from passing outside.
With his grade one Deity Heart, he could simply use his domain laws to cover an area of more than a hundred million kilometers with a single though. That was enough to envelop the entire mountain range of the Bloodshed God Palace Battle.
This gave those who grasped hold of grade one Deity Heart free range to slaughter people as they wished! After all, nobody could escape the range of their domain law.
But-
His Majesty, the Bloodshed God Emperor would never allow such a thing to happen. If those who grasped hold of grade one Deity Heart were to just kill as they pleased, there would be no meaning in the Bloodshed God Palace Battle. People like Xue Ying and Drunk Guest had huge talent and were seen as good seedlings with much higher potential than Jiu She and the others by the powerful existences and His Majesty.
Wait, is that… Jiu She cast his gaze far away to witness a scene depicting three young men in starry-blue robes, each wielding a spear, as they surrounded and attacked a venomous bug. This was happening in a place about seven mountains away.
Dong Bo? Jiu She smirked. What a coincidence. I've already killed over thirty Deity experts during this battle, but none of their deaths have made me as happy as killing you will.
Jiu She's figure then disappeared without a trace.
At his level, he could remove all sound and trace of his presence. Only when he crossed the boundary separating any two towering mountains would the invisible obstacle force him to reveal his true body. However, once got through them, he could then meld into nothingness again.
Stealthily…
He closed in with extreme caution. He used the towering mountain to block line of sight while borrowing his Laws and Profound Mysteries to distort his image as he moved closer to Xue Ying's location.
Having managed to survive all the way until now was a testament to Xue Ying's extreme vigilance. Even so, the invisible obstacles set down by His Majesty made it so that both his Mirage and Space senses were limited to the area of a towering mountain and not any of the regions next to it. He was forced to use his naked eyes to see any further than that. It was nothing strange for him to not realize that Jiu She was closing in on him.
With a final piercing screech of resentment, the venomous bug before him shattered and died.
Another one down. Xue Ying glanced up at the enormous blood-colored list floating in the sky. He had dropped down to 17th for a moment, but killing this bug gave him back his 15th spot. This was only natural, seeing how there were other experts on a quite similar level to his, and they were also killing bugs.
"Mn?" Xue Ying suddenly turned around.
To his back and to the left, the boundary of the towering mountain seemed to contain complete emptiness, yet Xue Ying had clearly sensed a figure appear there mere moments ago. That figure wore white robes, and their white hair and white brows were flowing about. Whenever Jiu She passed a boundary, he could, at most, distort vision in that area, but anyone with a realm as high as Xue Ying could bypass that distortion of light. He could not conceal his figure under Xue Ying's sensory ability, as provided by the Laws and Profound Mysteries.
"Jiu She!" Xue Ying was startled. This was his first time meeting someone with a grade one Deity Heart.
The combat power of any expert with a grade one Deity Heart vastly surpassed that of any Deity expert without one. They could casually kill whomever else they wanted to!
"Die!" Jiu She shouted in a tyrannical fashion. He clearly understood from the start that he would be spotted as soon as he crossed the boundary, so he waved his hand without hesitation.
An enormous golden palm condensed in mid-air, which pressed down on the area where Xue Ying was located. Even hiding in the Mirage was useless in front of Jiu She's might.
Shua shua shua.
Xue Ying had turned his body illusory the very moment he discovered Jiu She's presence, while his three mirage bodies simultaneously appeared at the boundaries of three different towering mountains. As soon as the golden palm began pressing down on his true body, he immediately switched positions with one of those three bodies.
"Break!" Jiu She frowned. His eyes glittered with sharpness.
Hong hong hong~
Every last corner of the towering mountain was affected by a terrifying feeling of suppression. Xue Ying's true body had switched positions with a mirage body and was busy fleeing toward the boundary, yet when that terrifying suppression descended, it enveloped the entire place… Regardless of where Xue Ying moved, as long as he remained in the region of that specific towering mountain, he would be hit.
"Careful!"
"Xue Ying!"
Jing Qiu and the rest of the Xia Clan Deities nervously watched on. Since they could only use their naked eyes to witness the scene, and as Jiu She distorted light each time he passed any boundary obstacle, nobody had discovered his presence. However, since their primary focus was on Xue Ying's situation, they immediately discovered the sudden appearance of that golden palm! It wasn't long after its appearance that the entire region around that towering mountain began breaking down under its crushing might…
"Does someone who grasped hold of a grade one Deity Heart really have to resort to sneak attacks?" The White Sand City Lord went livid as soon as he saw that. Killing some expert every so often whenever they stumbled upon them was good and all, but to deliberately set up a sneak attack…that was simply excessive!
The terrifying suppression caused every spot within that region to start crumbling apart. Xue Ying's true body felt that terrifying power pervading madly into his body, seeking to break down and tear apart every last particle within! He could feel some pain even through his Time Immemorial Body, though he remained unhurt. He was clearly able to resist this domain suppression.
I didn't die? I'm actually still alive? Xue Ying didn't even stop to think about why that would be the case as he immediately crossed the boundary obstacle to enter the region of a different towering mountain, where he rushed ahead to cross into another region. Sou sou sou sou… He ran away without pause, and in a single breath, he crossed a dozen mountain regions.
It wasn't enough to kill him? Jiu She finally revealed his true body in its entirety. Beneath his white floaty brows, his eyes showed a strand of fury. I've got to give him props for being so fast to flee!
It must be stated that Jiu She had merely grasped hold of a grade one Deity Heart and had yet to open his inner world to become a true World Deity! What he previously used was merely a domain built through the Laws of Profound Mysteries. It was an attack with a wide area of effect, which was naturally far weaker than striking someone directly.
Meanwhile, Xue Ying's Time Immemorial Body specialized in survivability. With it at the third level, his toughness was similar to that of a true stage one World Deity, and even a domain attack coming from a stage one World Deity would merely leave him heavily injured. They would have to be completely serious to have any hope at killing him. WIth Jiu She having used a single domain attack, there was hardly any chance for him to succeed.
Was there really a need for that? With your grade one Deity Heart, there's no way you won't get one of the top spots. What's the point in launching a sneak attack on me? Xue Ying was furious. If not for the fact that I'm temporarily unable to reveal my World Deity Heart, would I have had any need to be afraid of you?
Of course someone with a grade one Deity Heart could suppress him.
But only the consciousness of any Deity expert would be sent into the Bloodshed God Palace Battle. Even if they died, their consciousness would simply be sent back without any negative effect on their real body. In such an environment, it was natural for those with grade one Deity Hearts to occupy spots at the very front. In that case, was there any need for them to bother the others who were simply trying their best to raise their own ranks? Or to go as far as launching a sneak attack on someone like Xue Ying?
Whatever. I guess such is the temperament of someone who grasped hold of a grade one Deity Heart only after six and a half million years of cultivation. Xue Ying was well aware that he would vastly surpass Jiu She in the future.
The Bloodshed God Palace Battle was becoming more and more exciting.
With the exception of those who grasped hold of grade one Deity Heart, every Deity expert was fighting with their life on the line. Furthermore, as the rate at which the venomous bugs emerged further increased, they also began to pose a more significant threat. The rate at which the Deity experts was killed was quickly increasing.
"Over fifteen hundred have been eliminated, leaving behind only three hundred or so. We're fast approaching the final stage of this slaughter."
"It will only be getting more interesting from now on."
The many World Deities who were spectating the battle understood clearly how things would progress next.
In the highest seat of the highest position of the Bloodshed God Palace, His Majesty, the Bloodshed God Emperor, revealed a smile. "Most participants in this battle have been eliminated, with only three hundred still alive. I think it's time we send in the Deity warriors."
"Sending in the Deity warriors will only serve to heighten the pace of this slaughter."
The other powerful existences were spectating the battle from afar.
The Bloodshed God Emperor waved his hand, sending thirty streams of bloody light hurtling toward the distant mountain range.

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - Descent of the Diety Warriors
chapters.content:
Chapter 459: Descent of the Diety Warriors
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The 325 Deity experts still fighting in the range of mountains looked upward all at once, toward the thirty dazzling streams of bloody light descending upon various locations in the mountain range.
"The Deity warriors are descending!"
"It's the Deity warriors!"
"Quickly now; this is our final chance. We have to snatch one." At that moment, every last Deity expert was in a mad rush toward the stream closest to them. Even the seven grade one Deity Heart experts tried their best to get a Deity warrior. Xue Ying immediately entered the Mirage to chase the nearest one.
The Bloodshed God Palace Battle was split into two distinct parts. The first marked the time before the descent of the Deity warriors and was also known as the early phase! The second phase started once the Deity warriors descended and was known as the late phase!
"All thirty of those Bloody Slaughter Deity warriors descended where the lowest ranked participants are." The White Sand City Lord looked up, sighing. "Teacher truly tries very hard to give even them a chance to struggle."
"What's this about him trying hard? Isn't he just trying to make the battle more interesting and its final outcome harder to predict?" King Rong Hai laughed to the side. "Old Brother White Sand, I can see that you're boasting about every tiny thing His Majesty does, but that doesn't mean he'll let you go back to his side."
The White Sand City Lord took on a solemn tone as he said, "I would naturally want to get back my status as a disciple under His Majesty, but I've committed a grave mistake. I am already truly happy and thankful that teacher let me go with my life! Furthermore, I was not even boasting. Considering teacher's combat power, he should see no need in letting those Deities get a last struggle, but he had still convened this grand feast just to give these brats a chance at soaring to the skies, even giving them a chance to enjoy a Myriad Flower True Fruit. If this isn't charity, then what is?"
"Alright, alright."
"Let's not speak of that anymore."
Marshal Qin and the others kept their mouths shut after that. They knew that the White Sand City Lord would absolutely not speak bad about anything His Majesty ever did. He'd always been looking for a way to return back to His Majesty's side, but after he was chased away once, would the decision of his exile be so easily changed?
"That Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior landed too far from Dong Bo. He might not manage snatching it." The Xia Clan Deities and Jing Qiu were nervously watching the battle.
"In all the previous Bloodshed God Palace Battles, the Bloody Slaughter Deity warriors would always land near the weaker Deity experts," the Purple Thunder Emperor explained. "They've also been personally refined by His Majesty, so they are, without doubt, extraordinary in power. Any participant of this battle, even the Deities with grade one Deity Hearts, will perish from the slightest scratch inflicted by these weapons."
"These Deity warriors can raise one's combat power to a whole new level."
The Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior… Xue Ying had done his best to arrive as soon as possible, but he had started out too far away. A full fifteen people that were closer than him had also rushed over as fast as they could, and it was not long before they arrived at a certain towering mountain. Xue Ying could do nothing but watch wide-eyed as a black-armored man grabbed a blood-colored circular stone located halfway through the mountain.
The very moment he grabbed it, the stone rapidly transformed, taking on the shape of a long, bloody saber.
"Hahaha…" The black-armored man holding the blood-colored saber was in an exuberant at mood. "I've got one! I might be ranked lower than 500th at the moment, but with this Deity warrior, I might even get into the top hundred."
The man swept surveyed his surroundings to see five other Deities begin to decelerate.
"Congratulations."
"Who could've known you'd be faster than us by a single step."
"Let's go." Those five Deity experts turned around and left. As members of the same team this black-armored man was a part of, they had set down oaths to not hurt fellow teammates. Without such an oath, would they have had any peace of mind as teammates? Now that the black-armored man snatched the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior, they naturally chose to leave.
"Kill."
"Surround and kill him."
"Grab that Deity warrior." While those five Deities had turned to leave, the others were still rushing over snatch the weapon away from the man.
The black-armored man simply sneered. "If you're not afraid of death, then come!" With a single step, he teleported away, even going past the boundary of that towering mountain. Another step left him at the side of a venomous bug. His saber only flashed once, and the hard shell of that violet-armored bug was cut through without any sign of resistance, leaving behind a gash. The black-armored man stepped backward, watching the violet-shelled bug struggle in mid-air before finally falling back to the earth.
One move had been enough to kill a violet-shelled bug!
There was nobody who would dare confront someone who held a Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior in straight-up combat. Their body touching that weapon directly meant instant death!
I've got to get my hands on that Deity warrior. Xue Ying rapidly approached the scene. Each of those weapons is so powerful that a single strike using it is enough to kill a venomous bug! With that pace of dealing with the bugs, someone could easily get into the top hundred. I might be ranked 16th now, but if I were to be eliminated prematurely, the others would keep rising in rank and eventually pass me by.
It was very difficult for a participant to secure a spot in the top hundred without one such Deity warrior.
That was because they allowed their user to slaughter with great efficiency. Even if they were then surrounded and killed in the end, their ranking would still be high.
"Surround."
"Attack."
"Don't let him escape."
Many of the black armored man's pursuer began to act.
A pair of green shackles moved across the sky, followed by countless more. They quickly enveloped the fleeing man, causing his expression to pale.
"I'm afraid your survival capabilities are too weak. You're not qualified to hold on to that Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior," a grand voice resounded. A large number of black wheels surrounded the black-armored man to launch a joint attack on his position.
"Die!" A violet stream of light immediately tore through anything in its path to arrive before the black-armored man.
The Bloody Slaughter Deity warriors truly were formidable weapons, but they still had to at least come into contact with the enemy. At the moment, the Deity experts were either displaying powerful self-created magic spells or attacking from afar with various weapons. None dared come too close to him!
On top of that, all of this black-armored man's pursuers were currently teaming up against him without any prior agreement.
"You want to kill me?" the black-armored man hollered. His body techniques were erratically put on display, while that blood-colored saber's length rapidly expanded to more than five thousand kilometers. Once it reached that size, he began to swipe it rampantly all around, shua shua shua! His saber techniques were truly formidable. For the moment, those countless bloody saber lights were pushing out in a tyrannical manner, putting those Deities in a position where they could do nothing but dodge and keep their distance.
Having survived up until that moment meant the combat power the black-armored man was capable of using was not much weaker than the others'. He also had a World Deity ranked secret technique; he would not die just from a few casual strikes! Meanwhile, those other Deity experts were certain to perish upon coming into contact with his saber.
The pursuers were doing their best to resist his attacks, while he did his best to flee. At the moment, the black-armored man was triying to think of some way to rid himself of the Deities following him.
This is bad. The black-armored man suddenly spotted a figure moving toward his direction. As soon as the figure crossed the boundary of the towering mountain region, the black-armored man could clearly tell who that was. That's Dong Bo, from the Calm Sea Prefecture!
After the five Deities decided to give up on their pursuit, only a total of twelve Deities, including Xue Ying, were now truly going after the black-armored man! Furthermore, the large distance between them made it so Xue Ying and the others had not yet caught up to him, so only seven people had acted against him until that point! That was, seven Deities jointly attacking, none of them daring to go into close combat, and only sending in attacks from afar. In such conditions, they could only display a combat power of 60-70% of their full potential at best. The rampant strikes of the Blood Slaughter Deity warrior left them extremely vigilant, so the amount of combat power they could unleash was even lower than norma. In addition, they were working together for the very first time, so they could not coordinate very well. It was only normal that they would find it difficult to kill the black-armored man.
Not good at all. The black-armored man was now using all his power to flee. The threat Xue Ying alone posed was much higher than that of the other seven combined.
After all, the other seven might be comparable in combat power to Xue Ying, but they would never dare approach him carelessly!
But Xue Ying did! Using his three Mirage bodies, he had no reason to fear anything. Seeing how he had no reason to fear the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior, Xue Ying was very dangerous.
Even so, despite the black-armored man's desperate attempt to escape, the other seven were preventing him from doing so.
Shua shua shua.
Xue Ying finally arrived at the towering mountain region where the black-armored man was. With a single thought from his part, three teenagers dressed in starry-blue robes appeared right next to the black-armored man. Pu pu pu… Saber lights and spear images flashed all about. Unlike the true body, Xue Ying's mirage bodies would simply condense once more after getting injured, which allowed him to put his combat power on full display. Without a care for defense, the mirage bodies were frantically attacking, successfully suppressing the black-armored man within moments. It wasn't long before a spear stabbed all the way through the man's abdomen.
When not taking Jiu She into account, Xue Ying was absolutely the most powerful participant from the Calm Sea Prefecture!
Meanwhile, the black-armored man had been closest to the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior, so the Bloodshed God Emperor had clearly determined him to be amongst the weakest participants in terms of combat power. In the Calm Sea Prefecture, the black-armored man would not have ranked higher than 30th at best. With how ineffective the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior was against the Mirage bodies, and in a 'one'-on-one fight, it was only natural that the black-armored man would be suppressed!
"We can't let Dong Bo get his hands on the Deity Warrior." The other seven Deities went into panic upon seeing this happen. They were certain of stopping the black-armored man from fleeing, but now, they had to obstruct Xue Ying.
Once Xue Ying got the Deity warrior, he would be so much more dangerous than the black-armored man from before.
At that point, four other Deities were still approaching them from behind.
"We should all work together," the four Deities transmitted to one another in unison. The thought of how hard it would become to get the Deity warrior back once it was obtained by Xue Ying left them distressed.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 460 - Bloody Contest
chapters.content:
Chapter 460: Bloody Contest
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Alright, let's work together."
"We have to stop Calm Sea Prefecture's Dong Bo!" All of the eleven experts accepted this offer to work together. They could easily judge that, if they didn't cooperate, Xue Ying would get his hands on the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior with relative ease.
One of the members of this group of Deities was a woman wearing long green robes; she was looking straight at Xue Ying, her eyes emitting an icy, green light. Her lips quivered as she spoke, her voice engulfing the heaven and earth, "Everyone, Dong Bo's true body is right there!" The sound waves she emitted superimposed on a specific spot—none other than the location where Xue Ying's true body was hiding in the Mirage.
"Mn?" Xue Ying's ears were battered by a piercing, painful sound which tunneled into his mind, where it buzzed without stop. Sound attack? The experts participating in this battle are truly many and varied. My Mirage Deity Heart is famous for its ability in assassination, and I've already displayed it almost to its maximum potential without using any moves from the World Deity Heart. Yet even with all of that, I was still discovered."
The power of that soundwave was mighty, yet the resisting ability of his Time Immemorial Body was even stronger as it completely withstood against the attack. Those soundwaves could not influence the three mirage bodies in their assault at all.
The three mirage bodies kept attacking without a care for defense. After having his abdomen pierced, the black-armored man's eyes had filled with fury and unwillingness. Yet the attack hadn't been fatal! If Xue Ying truly wanted to kill this man, he would still have to skewer them twenty times over before he could hope to succeed. Even so, the attack he just received let the man firmly understand…that he had no hope to hold onto the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior any longer.
If he were to stubbornly resist, there was only one outcome possible for him…death and subsequent elimination from the battle.
"Dong Bo, I might not manage to keep this warrior, but you better forget about getting it either!" the man roared. He then tossed the blood-colored saber out toward the six Deity experts who were a few thousand kilometers away.
Xue Ying was startled.
"That's admirable." Xue Ying's three bodies sent a final glance toward the black-armored man before disappearing. They only appeared again when they were a few thousand kilometers away, where the six Deities had already begun fighting over the Deity warrior.
"Admirable?" The black-armored man remained standing in mid-air. Everyone stopped attacking him, yet he still let out a slight sigh. It's such a pity I had to come across that Dong Bo from the Calm Sea Prefecture. His mirage bodies are completely separate from his true body, so they have no reason to fear that Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior.
Sou.
The man rapidly retreated to the boundary of that particular mountain region, watching the battle from afar all the while. He was waiting for an opportunity, like Xue Ying dying, so he could continue the fight for the Deity warrior.
Xue Ying didn't feel much resentment toward his opponents; everyone was simply doing their best to land a spot in the top hundred. Being one of the top hundred rankers signified that they would certainly be accepted as a disciple under a powerful existence, while also granting them the right to obtain a Myriad Flower True Fruit! Since the black-armored man decided to let go of the Deity warrior, Xue Ying would naturally leave him alone as well.
"Be careful of Dong Bo."
"We can't let him get it."
The six Deity experts, as well as the other five in the distance, were all trying their best to snatch the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior while keeping an eye out for Xue Ying.
He was ranked first or second amongst this group in terms of combat power, though the gap was not so large as to be suppressive. The main issue was that his mirage bodies were very dangerous if he wished to snatch the Bloody Slaughter Deity warriors.
"Hmph." Xue Ying decided to at least give it a try. In the distant group, there was a sword user who could casually parry the attacks of two of his mirage bodies with just his single sword. At the same time, the other Deity experts were obstructing him, which left Xue Ying with no hope of success.
The others might all be afraid of Dong Bo, but I am not. Once I get my hands on the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior…I'll be able to rapidly attack his true body. The woman in long green robes was standing in some place further away, looking for an opportunity to get her hands on the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior without getting too close.
Shua shua shua.
Without warning, three young men in starry-blue robes appeared simultaneously before her.
"You…" The woman was shocked by this development.
"You can discover my position, so I'll have send you out first." The three Xue Yings smiled at her while displaying his spear moves in a frenzied assault.
The woman immediately tried to parry the incoming attacks in a panic, but she found it difficult to maintain her ground when facing three mirage bodies that held defense in no regard. She immediately transmitted an anxious message to the others, "All of you, come over here and help me defend against Dong Bo! If I die, none of you will be able to discover his true body! By then, he can easily hide his true body, and his mirage bodies can casually act against you all."
With the exception of a couple Deity experts who tried to control the situation from afar using spells, none of them others did anything to help her.
"It's useless. One of them already got their hands on the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior, so the others are all trying to snatch it away! If they were to shift all their attention here, they'll likely lose any chance to acquire the Deity warrior," the three Xue Yings said while sending another strike through woman's shoulder. "They might see me as a big threat, but they still place more importance on getting rid of that expert who has the Deity warrior in their possession."
"Damn it all!" The woman in long green robes gritted her teeth. Blood began to spurt from her wounded shoulder.
She understood that everything Xue Ying said was true. The Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior was just too dazzling, so everyone would rather obstruct the person who currently had it. It would become much harder for them to get it back once someone escaped with it .
"I admit defeat. This is my loss," she anxiously shouted.
Pu pu pu…
Peng.
Xue Ying's spear pierced the already heavily injured woman's chest, causing her to explode and then turn to nothing. She had been eliminated.
"Unfortunately for you, there's no way I'd trust your words." Xue Ying's three bodies turned over at the same time. In the distance, there was a man holding onto a blood-colored scimitar, doing his best to resist the attacks of the other Deities.
"Not good!"
"Dong Bo has already killed Chen Qing."
All of them were shocked.
Their plan was to snatch the Deity warrior and flee while Xue Ying was still fighting Chen Qing.
"A pity that you guys were slower than me." The three Xue Yings simultaneously laughed as they disappeared into nothingness. Then they appeared again, they were right next to the man holding onto the blood-colored scimitar. All three bodies disregarded any other weapons striking their way, focusing solely on the man with the Deity warrior.
Now that the green-robed woman was dead, there was nobody in that group of experts who could discover his true body! Now that he made sure he was absolutely safe, Xue Ying no longer spared any effort and shifted all his focus toward the Deity warrior.
"Damn, damn." The man who currently had the blood-colored scimitar in his possession went into a complete panic. It had been very hard for him to hold onto the Deity warrior from the start, and now that he found himself under the joint attack of three Xue Yings, he was beginning to accrue injuries.
"I don't want this anymore. You all can go grab it instead," he said, immediately throwing the blood-colored scimitar into the distance.
Sou.
All three of Xue Ying's bodies moved, two of them blocking the way of the other experts, while one went over to grab the scimitar.
The black-armored man from before had some attainments in the aspect of space, which allowed him to throw the scimitar as a projectile on a difficult to predict course. The current holder's method of throwing the blood scimitar away was much poorer, allowing Xue Ying to determine its path with ease.
"Hahaha…" As he grabbed the scimitar, he could feel the terrifying strength contained by the weapon. This was, after all, a Deity warrior personally refined by His Majesty. Despite it being quite crude, it was still powerful enough to kill any stage one World Deity from a slight scratch. As soon as it entered Xue Ying's hands, the scimitar shifted its from into a blood-colored spear.
The current scene showed Xue Yings laughing while holding onto a bloody spear each.
Indeed, there were three spears!
The other ten Deity experts could no longer discern which one held the real Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior. With Xue Ying's Mirage Deity Heart at the stage it was at, he found it so very simple to fake the Deity warrior's appearance through illusion.
"All who obstruct me shall receive death," the three Xue Ying turned to observe his surroundings.
The ten Deity experts glanced toward one another before making a collective decision to escape without a trace of hesitation.
"Dong Bo, it's your lucky day."
"Ruthless indeed."
"Admirable."
The black-armored man who was previously waiting for an opportunity shook his head at the sight of Xue Ying grabbing hold of the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior. Without dallying any longer, he crossed the boundary and left that mountain region.
At that point, there was nobody left who could discover Xue Ying's true body. To keep fighting the three mirage bodies, each of them holding onto an identical Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior? They had no method of discerning which one had the real Deity warrior, while the mirage bodies could fight without any mind to defend. Was there really any hope in defeating him? If they were to continue risking their lives, the most likely outcome would be death at Xue Ying's hands, while their chance to snatch the Deity warrior away would be too faint.
The battles were all bitter. Over at Xue Ying's site, his mirage bodies made sure that his opponents would never find his real body, so they all decided to retreat.
But the other locations saw desperate battles unfolding! As soon as one died, the others would surround and attack the next person 'lucky' enough to obtain the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior, a process which repeated itself all the way until someone manage to escape with it!
These skirmishes over the Bloody Slaughter Deity warriors alone sent eighty Deity experts to their deaths, all throughout the mountain range!
"He got it! He has the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior!"
"Beautifully executed, Dong Bo!"
The Xia Clan Deities, including Jing Qiu, entered a great mood as they watched on.
"Hehehe… this Brother Dong Bo of mine is truly formidable. He's showing more and more potential in spite of his very young age! He's strong enough to catch the eyes of those powerful existences," the White Sand City Lord drank his wine, praising Xue Ying all the while. "With so many powerful existences willing to receive him, I truly wonder whose disciple this brother of mine will become after this battle ends."
**

chapters.title: Chapter 461 - Forefather Fierce Tyrant
chapters.content:
Chapter 461: Forefather Fierce Tyrant
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Up at the Myriad Flower Feast, the powerful existences were toasting and exchanging glasses of wine as they watched the Bloodshed God Palace Battle and chatted amongst themselves.
"This Dong Bo brat is so capable, yet he's only cultivated for 2,300 years. If I were to give him some guidance, he'll grasp hold of a grade one Deity Heart within 10,000 years without a doubt. On top of that, he's proficient in so many grade two Deity Hearts that even an idiot could realize that he could be easily guided toward the World, Chaotic, Extremity, and Time-Space grade one Deity Hearts," a powerful existence with a robust frame and a huge head commented. His eyebrows were even dancing as he watched on. "According to the intelligence reports regarding his growth back in his homeworld, the Xia Clan World, he's the sort of person to place a large importance on relationships. Forefather, he's the kind of disciple I like most. Think about how hard it would be to find another one like him. I must find a way to get my hands of him. I must!"
This powerful existence was known as Fierce Tyrant, though many people referred to him as Forefather Fierce Tyrant. He had an extraordinary background, and in regards to his foundation alone, he was much stronger than both Forefather Scarlet Flame and Sacred Master Crimson Dust.
As one of the primeval Deity world lifeforms, he was actually one of the Fierce Five of the Deity world!
It must be stated that the strongest amongst the Fierce Five was one of the three ancestors, Pang Yi, and all five of them were on good terms with each other.
However, Forefather Fierce Tyrant had one of the worst temperaments of all five members of his group. When he was still a stage four World Deity, he had been taken to use as a mount by another of the three ancestors, the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master! The latter had transmitted a secret move to him and guided him in his cultivation, which helped Forefather Fierce Tyrant to finally succeed in becoming a powerful existence!
All things considered, Forefather Fierce Tyrant had a very solid foundation on which he could depend, be it through his position as one of the Fierce Five of the Deity world, or the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master's mount.
He had also accrued fame as a teacher who covered for the 'shortcomings' of his disciples. Usually, powerful existences would leave their disciples freedom to kill and slaughter, but if they were to die, they could not blame anyone else for their mistake. Forefather Fierce Tyrant, however, was so protective of his students that everyone began to greatly fear offending any of his personal disciples. It was rumored that Forefather Fierce Tyrant would forego all reputation to go out himself to fight for their sake!
His overprotectiveness made it so that all five of his disciples actually stopped improving after becoming stage three World Deities, with not a single one reaching stage four!
Other than that reputation, Forefather Fierce Tyrant was also known for ignoring anyone with weaker talent.
People of high talent would usually become disciples under other powerful existences, while very few would accept entering the tutelage of Forefather Fierce Tyrant, mostly due to a rumor that spread throughout the outer world: Forefather Fierce Tyrant is incapable of properly guiding his disciples, seeing how none of them have become stage four World Deities! He only succeeded in becoming a powerful existence under the guidance of the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master. Without the Prefecture Master's help, he would not have become a powerful existence.
"Someone who hold relationships in such high regards, like he does, would definitely make for a good disciple. I've got to snatch him." Forefather Fierce Tyrant was staring at Xue Ying.
There were quite a few other powerful existences, other than Forefather Fierce Tyrant, who were eyeing Xue Ying. They all had a very good judgement for talent, so they could easily see how much potential Xue Ying held! Such a good disciple would become a stage three World Deity with just a bit of guidance, and he even held great hope for becoming a stage four World Deity.
"Prefecture Master, Prefecture Master," Forefather Fierce Tyrant suddenly said to a man who was sitting next to him.
Said man was garbed in a luxurious violet robe and was quite handsome in appearance. His eyes were narrow and long and were sharp like blades. Between his eyebrows, a crack that was imbued with golden light could be seen. He turned toward Forefather Fierce Tyrant and replied, "Fierce Tyrant, what's the matter?"
"Hehehe, Prefecture Master." Forefather Fierce Tyrant sent him a virtuous gaze. "Do you plan on taking on a disciple during this Bloodshed God Palace Battle, Prefecture Master ?"
"No, I don't." The Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master's long and narrow eyes turned to Forefather Fierce Tyrant. "I see no point in accepting disciples. If I manage to take that final step, I'll be able to face the Bloodshed God Emperor. Otherwise, I'll just have to remain as I am. As for accepting disciples, I'd gain nothing from it."
Forefather Fierce Tyrant nodded repeatedly.
Having acted as the Prefecture Master's mount once in the past, he was quite clear of how proud and aloof this man was. He didn't care much for teaching his disciples, unless he saw someone he absolutely liked.
"Alas, while Prefecture Master doesn't plan to accept a disciple, I do. I've got my eye on a young fellow who I would truly want to accept as disciple. I feel that, if I were to teach him, he'll surely succeed in becoming a stage four World Deity," Forefather Fierce Tyrant said.
"If you're going to accept a disciple, why are you here, looking for me?" The corners of the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master's lips curled upward. "What do you want? Stop beating around the bush."
Forefather Fierce Tyrant chuckled. "The Prefecture Master is, indeed, the Prefecture Master. You are already aware that I don't have a proper reputation when it comes to teaching disciples… Not a single one of the disciples I've taught have become stage four World Deities. I've no doubt that there are many others who plan on accepting Dong Bo Xue Ying, so even though I want him to be my disciple, there's a high chance he'll enter the tutelage of a different powerful existence as it stands. That is why I thought I'd ask, you Prefecture Master, for some help. If he were to become my personal disciple, he'd also be a sort of grand-disciple to you, no? At that point, I'll have to request Prefecture Master to give your agreement in handing this kid a chance to enter your Violet Bamboo Sea and cultivate there."
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master looked back at Forefather Fierce Tyrant, who held a simple and straightforward smile on his face.
"You're this thick-skinned despite being a powerful existence." The Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master shook his head lightly. Forefather Fierce Tyrant was one of the Fierce Five of the Deity World, and he was much more tyrannical than the usual powerful existence. However, his temperament was much better than the majority of the powerful existences.
"Prefecture Master, it would be very difficult for me to a disciple as good as him," Forefather Fierce Tyrant continued.
"Alright, I'll give you my promise, then." The Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master nodded.
"Haha, thank you, Prefecture Master. Thank you so much. Now that you've given me your word, he'll definitely become my disciple." Forefather Fierce Tyrant already began looking forward to it.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master said, "You have to remember, though, that if His Majesty, the Overlord of Destruction, or Pang Yi were to decide on accepting him, you probably won't get to snatch this disciple."
"If one of them is to take the initiative, there's nothing I can do about it," Forefather Fierce Tyrant confidently replied. "I won't say anything of His Majesty. He doesn't care enough to accept even those monstrous grade one True Meaning Transcendents. As for Big Brother Pang Yi, there's also no reason to take him into account. For him to accept another a disciple? There was a time when he accepted 108 disciples in one breath, but for so long a time after that, he's only accepted two more. It's very rare that he'd take the initiative to do such a thing. The Overlord of Destruction has also not accepted a disciple for a very long time…"
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master nodded.
All three of the ancestors put much more emphasis on their personal cultivation.
The general rule was that, the stronger a powerful existence was, the more less they would care about taking disciples! They all saw their own power as paramount! It was only occasionally that they would be willing to give a couple of pointers to some juniors they particularly liked. Otherwise, they would have to be prompted by some sudden impulse, such as the case when the head of the Fierce Five, Pang Yi, accepted 108 disciples in a single breath. He had done so due to some secret technique he was comprehending, and he actually taught them in a serious manner.
Under normal circumstances, it was very rare to see them accept any disciple. On the other hand, ordinary powerful existences were much more eager to take disciples under their wing.
The powerful existences kept watching the battle from a distance, which proceeded as fiercely as ever.
The descent of the Bloody Slaughter Deity warriors sent the degree of excitement skyrocketing. Several Deity experts were fighting together to kill a single person, while the Bloody Slaughter Deity warriors were so terrifying that they could kill anyone with the slightest bit of contact.
150…
120…
100…
80…
The number of surviving Deities in the mountain range was steadily decreasing.
The main source of that drop in numbers was infighting. The secondary reason was the increased pace at which the venomous bugs would appear. The combat power of the venomous bugs was very high, and it was no trivial task to kill any one of them! Unless one was in possession of a Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior, they would die after being surrounded by only two or three such bugs.
Having a Deity warrior changed the situation, however. The increased speed at which venomous bugs emerged simply meant that they would be killed faster by these people! After all, one strike was sufficient to kill any bug.
Other than the seven who grasped hold of grade one Deity Hearts, there were a few more relatively dazzling Deities, such as Xue Ying himself! His mirage secret skill was powerful enough to materialize three mirage bodies, which was a heaven-shaking ability. However, this was only a utilitary secret skill; he was was still quite lacking in terms of pure offense. In fact, his power was even weaker than that of Drunk Guest.
Yet the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior he previously obtained covered up any weakness Xue Ying might have had in terms of his offense.
Seeing how the mirage bodies could never be killed, they were a perfect match for the Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior! Especially so, considering that the three mirage bodies were holding onto a weapon each, confusing his enemies as to which was the real one.
There are only 75 people still inside the mountain range, and I'm currently in eleventh place. Xue Ying was quite relaxed as he thought of that. In other words… I've already secured as spot in the top hundred.
"Mn?"
Xue Ying's expression suddenly changed upon seeing three figures passing through the boundary from the neighboring towering mountain region. They were holding onto a Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior each.
There's three of them? Xue Ying was aware of the spots each of the three currently held. They were respectively the 9th, 15th and 18th ranked! None of them were any weaker in terms of combat power than he was.
It was already certain that all three of them would finish in the top hundred, so why had they come over to attack him?
One member of this group was a male expert with an ugly face. He was holding onto a blood-colored arc-blade as he coldly said, "Dong Bo of the Calm Sea Prefecture. You've nothing more than a brat who cultivated for just 2,000 years or so, yet you're still moving around, flaunting your combat power. I'm here to show you that, in terms of direct combat power, you're still lacking. You can make one of two choices—try to escape our joint attacks, or fight me in a one-on-one battle. Neither of these two comrades of mine will act against you if you agree to this duel. Make your decision."
**

chapters.title: Chapter 462 - Final Stage (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 462: Final Stage (1)
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Hua.
White fog enveloped the towering mountain, and another Xue Ying appeared in the middle of the three present before. The four figures looked toward the distant ugly man who wielded a blood-colored arc-blade and lightly greeted, "Wan Jiu from the Milky Way Prefecture."
"That's me." The corners of the ugly man's lip curled upward ever so slightly.
Wan Jiu had taken first place in both the ranking battle and the survival battle of the Milky Way Prefecture Selections.
"One-on-one. Even if one of us is about to die, neither of my comrades will interfere," the ugly man continued, his eyes betraying his expectation. He was currently ranked ninth in the Bloodshed God Palace Battle, and with only seventy people still alive for the moment, it was no doubt that he and his comrades would rank in the top hundred. However, there were only twenty three powerful existences, including the three grand elders and His Majesty, currently in the Bloodshed God Palace. Once the time came for the powerful existences select disciples, they would generally select about eighteen in total.
As for the rest?
Anyone who ranked in the top hundred but had not been accepted as a disciple by any of the powerful existences under their own initiative would still eventually end up as disciples, after His Majesty ordered the powerful existences to take about four to six each.
However, these Deities would usually not be emphasized as much by the powerful existences and would only receive casual guidance. It was only those the powerful existences truly regarded highly upon, or those whose characters they liked, that they would truly teach with more heart.
The difference between casual guidance and serious tutelage was insurmountable!
Wan Jiu had long decided to first secure a position in the top hundred before trying to make himself seem dazzling in the eyes of the powerful existences, which eventually led to him putting this plan into motion.
He first made sure to grab a Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior for himself and raised his rank to the very top. He then used his combat power to snatch a second Deity warrior which he then handed over to one of the Deities with a combat power similar to his, whom he ordered: I'm giving you this Bloody Slaughter Deity warrior so it may aid you in landing a spot in the top hundred. However, you must follow my orders for the rest of this battle.
Seeing how the other party did not have a Deity warrior, and therefore no certainty of getting into the top hundred, he had naturally accepted this proposition.
Using this same method, Wan Jiu then coerced another Deity into following him, the two of them now being ranked 15th and 18th respectively! They had both secured their positions in the top hundred.
Having used my strength to bring two other Deities into the top hundred, I've most likely already caught the eye of some powerful existences… Wan Jiu looked forward to the fruits of his toil. It's still not quite enough, though. I've got to do a final stunt, where I defeat a Deity who's currently attracting the attention of all those powerful existences. That will cause more powerful existences to place their focus on me.
As for the person currently attracting the attention of most powerful existences?
Wan Jiu had selected Xue Ying for the role. This Dong Bo is about evenly matched with me in terms of strength, but he's far too young, having cultivated for only 2,000 or so years! He's likely the expert most focused on by the powerful existences.
I'm also certain I can deal with him too.
It has to be him!
Wan Jiu therefore chose Xue Ying, bringing along the comrades he had previously aided to surround Xue Ying.
The other two would not participate in the battle, since their combat power wasn't on the same level as Wan Jiu's. They were only here to frighten Xue Ying, so as to dissuade him from fleeing. If he were to try to escape, they would immediately surround him! He had chosen those two comrades since they were quite close to him in terms of combat power, though they had a poorer fortune, seeing how they had been unable to obtain Deity warriors by themselves.
He felt that, with the three of them surrounding him, Xue Ying would be rational enough to make the right decision.
"One-on-one?" The four Xue Yings looked toward Wan Jiu. "A life or death battle between the two of us?"
"Right." Wan Jiu's eyes were cold.
"Let's do as you wish, then," all four Xue Yings collectively replied. "Bring it."
"That's the Dong Bo from the Calm Sea Prefecture I've heard about. Such courage." Despite his words, Wan Jiu was inwardly rejoicing. The outcome he was most afraid of was Xue Ying trying to escape. With the three of them surrounding him afterward, they could certainly kill him, but that would do nothing to reveal his true personal value.
Standing a fair distance away, Wan Jiu's figure suddenly turned blurry before condensing into two bodies.
Two of Wan Jiu were now standing side by side, both holding two identical blood-colored arc-blades each.
"Mirage Deity Heart?" Xue Ying chuckled.
"I've not delved as far as you have in the Mirage Deity Heart, and I am only able to produce one avatar," Wan Jiu's two bodies said at the same time. "But can you tell the real body apart from the avatar? Do you know which of these four arc-blades is the real one?
As soon as he finished speaking, the surrounding world began to distort as an invisible force surged all throughout the surrounding mountain region.
Sou! Sou!
Two of Wan Jiu came charging forward at the same time.
The four Xue Yings also stepped forward to block their advance, although they had became quite a bit slower under the effect of the quagmire.
Dong Bo Xue Ying put most of his focus on that Mirage secret skill of his, with his Star Deity Heart skills in second place. But inside my domain, his speed is greatly decreased. Even with four of them working together, there's little chance he'll defeat me! Wan Jiu was brimming with confidence.
The two finally began their fight.
Outside, everything was going according to Wan Jiu's plans.
Since Xue Ying was the main focus of a number of the powerful existences, this battle was sure to catch their attention.
"Interesting. This Wan Jiu person was able to put two other Deities under his command. Those two listen to all his orders."
"He personally handed out Bloody Slaughter Deity warriors to those two a while ago."
"So he's good at snatching them, eh."
"He has a mirage body as well as a decent domain secret skill. He's also quite formidable in terms of close combat… With the exception of those seven who grasped hold of grade one Deity Hearts, there aren't many who can defeat him."
Wan Jiu had indeed received the praise from several powerful existences, and they also understood that this was precisely what Wan Jiu wanted! The only problem was that he had already cultivated for about eight hundred to nine hundred thousand years!
"It seems that Dong Bo is in danger."
"It's hard to say how this battle will end!"
"His only way to win would be to put all his hopes on those three mirage bodies of his and fight for his life. Unless he does that, he will lose for certain."
******
"No matter how I look at it, those four bodies of Dong Bo working together can hardly hold up against his opponent…" The Xia Clan Deities were feeling a mix of anxiousness and distress. Xue Ying and Wan Jiu were fighting in the sky above the mountain range. Despite Xue Ying having a total of four bodies, including his true body, he was still on the losing side. Wan Jiu's two bodies were sufficient to suppress Xue Ying.
Hua.
Wan Jiu's blades were truly formidable; they could cut through anything! His speed was also blindingly fast, and his defenses airtight! The surrounding quagmire-like domain affected Xue Ying's speed. Even though the effect wasn't that great, at this level of fighting…that slight decrease in speed put him at a firm disadvantage.
Such formidable blade techniques. Xue Ying sighed mentally. They're even stronger than Drunk Guest's by quite a lot. This Wan Jiu really deserves the first place in the Milky Way Prefecture.
Wan Jiu was just a very slight step away from completing both the World Deity Heart and the Splitting Heavens Deity Heart. With his accomplishments in the Profound Mysteries of both these aspects, he could craft a nearly perfect blade technique with the base of 'one becoming the world!' This blade technique of his was practically flawless. Furthermore, the Profound Mysteries of Splitting Heaven brought the power of his blade technique to a terrifying stage. He had even created a domain-related secret skill with a taste of the world.
He had a domain secret skill focused on oppression!
His true body was working hand-in-hand with his mirage body!
And he was doing close combat using his virtually perfect blade technique!
Dang dang dang. Xue Ying might have had four bodies working in concert, but he was having a hard time trying to break through the defense conferred by his opponent's blade technique.
"You can only stay alive for a bit longer because of those four bodies of yours, but I've no reason to fear three of them. As you fight frantically for your life, a gap will surely appear in your defenses, and I might just kill your true body instead," Wan Jiu's voice immediately permeated Xue Ying's mind. His eyes burned with excitement.
He was deliberately taunting Xue Ying.
The blade technique he displayed using his arc-blades seemed like a sphere of absolute beauty. This was 'one becoming the world,' a skill with practically no weaknesses.
"Keep fighting." The actions of the Xue Yings were turning more and more frenzied.
"Good, good, good. Come now, let's go!" Wan Jiu talked non-stop. The entire battle was happening just as he imagined it. Xue Ying was taking no account of his opponent's retaliation, and while his mirage bodies were not afraid of being hacked, Wan Jiu's terrifying arc-blade attacks sent the mirage bodies flying backward, leaving Xue Ying's true body open to receive his strikes.

chapters.title: Chapter 463 - Final Stage (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 463: Final Stage (2)
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Hong hong hong~
The two became even more frenzied as the fight kept going. Xue Ying occasionally pierced Wan Jiu, but it always turned out to be his mirage body that he struck. Clearly, Wan Jiu was deliberately letting Xue Ying hit him.
Pu.
Xue Ying's spear was like a venomous snake, thrusting forward and then immediately retreating.
"This…"
Wan Jiu's two bodies suddenly stopped, followed by one of them dissipating.
Only a single Wan Jiu was now standing in mid-air, and he was staring at Xue Ying in disbelief. "How…how did you…"
"Your blade technique wasn't quite perfect, and my luck turned out to be better than yours," Xue Ying said.
Wan Jiu's eyes were filled with unwillingness.
His technique wasn't perfect? Xue Ying's luck was better?
He was well aware, however, that he had yet to grasp hold of the true World Deity Heart. Despite calling his blade technique 'one becoming the world,' the fact stood that it had yet to reach that stage.
"Just a little bit more. Just a little…" Wan Jiu's inner heart fell to anguish. Had he defeated Xue Ying in the one-on-one fight, the outcome would have been wonderful. But now, in spite of attracting the attention of several powerful existences, he had essentially handed all that attention for Xue Ying to use as a stepping stone.
His body soon crumbled apart, and his consciousness returned to his body.
His two comrades were shaking their heads inwardly.
"Brother Wan Jiu was certain of his victory, but he still ended up losing by a small margin."
"Dong Bo put the lives of all four bodies on the line, and that eventually gave him the opportunity to triumph." It wasn't long before these two people also left. The only reason they had been sticking around was the oaths they had sworn.
Xue Ying shook his head with a smile as he watched those two depart.
This Wan Jiu was quite the formidable expert, but he had no way of knowing that I've already grasped hold of the complete World Deity Heart, or that I've created quite a lot of secret skills using it as a base. If we're to compare our comprehension of the World Deity Heart, there's no doubt my knowledge of the details is deeper than his. Xue Ying sighed inwardly. His so-called 'one becoming the world' blade technique had a glaring weakness which I could determine from a mere glance!
I only had to wait for an opportune moment to break through his blade technique. Xue Ying sighed once more.
"He put those mirage bodies out with no regard to their well-being, pushing forward to break apart his opponent's blade techniques and finally thrusting out at the right moment." The White Sand City Lord held onto a wine goblet as he looked up toward the scene of battle from within the mountain range. "All of that led to his eventual success."
"Is it not possible that he might have discovered a gap in the other party's blade technique during this very battle? This win is a testament to his own power," the Ink Cloud City Lord praised.
******
There was no way Xue Ying would so easily admit defeat. Wan Jiu tried to put on a dazzling display in hopes that the powerful existences would take the initiative to select him as a disciple, but Xue Ying was also chasing his own dreams. His greatest hope was that either His Majesty or one of the three Grand Elders would take him under their tutelage! Naturally, he would not accept defeat without even trying to resist.
Hu.
Xue Ying moved along the mountains range. With a step empowered by his Extreme Piercing, he casually approached and killed another venomous bug.
He then repeated the process, killing more and more bugs. Before long, his ranking rose up to the ninth position, occasionally even holding the eighth spot. But the other Deity experts were all formidable and had their own fortune, leaving Xue Ying to hover around the eighth to tenth positions.
The Deities within the mountain range were numbering lower and lower. 60, 50…
"Mn?" Xue Ying's expression suddenly changed.
He had just sensed a figure stealthily pass through the boundary of the mountain region he was in. Despite his expert having distorted his image, Xue Ying could still use his Mirage domain to clearly tell apart the other party's appearance. He had the same white robe, white hair, and white eyebrows as before—this was none other than Jiu She.
"You again!" Xue Ying began to flee by switching positions with his mirage bodies, not a hint of hesitation in his movements.
"Suppress!"
"Break!"
Jiu She chased after him while simultaneously unleashing his domain-related technique.
Even then, the Time Immemorial Body's toughness proved too formidable. In spite of it being at merely the third level…Jiu She was still unable to suppress and kill him using that domain technique alone.
Sou sou sou!
Xue Ying was in a mad retreat. He didn't even consider displaying his grade one Deity Heart in the course of this battle, being aware that the enemy of Sacred Master Crimson Dust might just forego his reputation to act against him. After all, anyone able to grasp hold of a grade one Deity Heart within 2,300 years was as talented as a grade one True Meaning Transcendent. He had already decided that he would rather die than reveal his true power.
He would wait until he became a stage two World Deity to reveal his capabilities. By then, the only people who could kill him without him even getting to react were the Bloodshed God Emperor or the Temporal Island Lord. Powerful existences at their level would generally not act against someone like him.
Once he became a stage three World Deity, and even without the agreement in place, the Bloodshed God Emperor himself would be unable to kill him, a Realm Lord.
That was why he decided to be patient. It was only through sufficient patience that his future could truly be dazzling.
"Jiu She, why must you go so far to pursue me?" Jiu She's persistence dumbfounded Xue Ying, but it didn't stop him from fleeing across the many mountain regions.
Shua.
Just as he passed the boundary to another region, a fat old man with white hair appeared right before him.
Xiu.
A dazzling light suddenly crossed through Xue Ying's body.
"That's a grade one Deity Heart-" Xue Ying looked with wide eyes toward the fat old man. He recognized this old man as none other than the one to take first place in both the ranking stange and the survival battle of the Nine Rigid Prefecture Selections—Monarch Yue. Rumors said that he originally called himself Emperor Yue, but only the most extraordinary existences of the Deity world dared refer to themselves as emperors. He thus decided to change his appelative to Monarch Yue. The title of monarch was, after all, a bit more reserved than something like 'emperor.'
"I was never in any rush to display my skills, not until the very last moment. And the person I chose to finally dispose of is you, Dong Bo." The fat old man smiled. If he was going to kill someone, he would clearly kill the person who attracted most of the attention from the powerful existences.
Xue Ying's body dissipated, followed by the return of his consciousness to his body.
Sou.
