Of all the inner disciples within this courtyard today, I am the oldest, which is why teacher often hands many matters for me to arrange! If there's anything you need, you can come over and find me."
"Thank you, Disciple Sister," Xue Ying said.
"It's just a minor matter." The gray-robed woman laughed, bringing Xue Ying along into a different courtyard.
This new courtyard had a large lake with many aquatic plants within, and it was by the side of this lake that the crimson-robed Bloodshed God Emperor was sitting cross-legged. His big robes extended to the ground, and his eyelids were drooping. Yet, he was emitting an unseen aura that seemed to pacify the entire courtyard. On his shoulder was a rather unique-looking black bird. The bird's feathers were of a deep black, but if one were to look more carefully at them, these feathers seemed to be shimmering with unremarkable colorful lights.
"Teacher," the gray-robed woman bowed and greeted the man. "I have brought Disciple Brother Dong Bo."
"Greetings, teacher." Xue Ying joined in from the side with a respectful greeting.
The expressions on the Bloodshed God Emperor's face were hard to predict, mostly due to an endless feeling of darkness and destruction which dispersed all around him. Even though he was simply sitting cross-legged, Xue Ying still felt like no more than an ant standing before an enormous dragon, billions of kilometers long. He gave off that sort of oppressive feeling.
Hua.
The Bloodshed God Emperor's drooping eyelids suddenly opened wide, and two rays of light shot out from his eyes and right into Xue Ying's.
Hong hong hong…
An overwhelming amount of information began to surge into his mind.
The World Deity Heart is all-encompassing; the same way the river flows into the sea… A world-shaking voice began resounding within Xue Ying's mind. There was simply too much information, complete with huge amounts of battle scenes and recorded movements. What they displayed was a warrior holding onto a spear in battle.
Voices, scenes, words…
Boundless amounts of information.
Half the time it took to brew a cup of tea later, Xue Ying finally regained his consciousness and woke up. His face clearly displayed his truly joyous mood which stemmed from him knowing that he had just received truly detailed guidance. This information that had just been sent was split into two parts, one focused on the World Deity Heart, the other on the Chaotic Deity Heart.
"Thank you, teacher," Xue Ying hurriedly expressed his gratitude.
"You have hope to grasp both the World and the Chaotic Deity Hearts. Cultivate properly, and don't let yourself fall into laziness by any means," the Bloodshed God Emperor indifferently stated as he waved his hand, causing two black command tokens to appear, which flew right over to Xue Ying.
Xue Ying quickly took them and gave them a good look.
The two tokens had the numbers 351 and 95 imprinted on them respectively.
"These are your tokens for the Sealed World Pagoda," the Bloodshed God Palace freely explained. "By holding onto these two tokens, you may visit both the 95th and the 351st level worlds and cultivate there! These two worlds will prove beneficial in your quest to grasp the World and Chaotic Deity Hearts. Alright, you may go back now."
"Yes." Xue Ying was feeling rather awkward in his heart. This was their first actual meeting, yet they had not exchanged more than a few sentences before he was asked to leave. The Bloodshed God Palace truly had a tyrannical way of teaching.
Xue Ying immediately stood up, turned around, and then quickly left the courtyard.
He gave me two Sealed World Pagoda command tokens?
Xue Ying was quite happy with this outcome. Having already discussed with his Eldest Disciple Brother, Hui Ming, for quite some time, he knew that inner disciples would usually only acquire a single command token for the Sealed World Pagoda! It was a very good sign that he had received two on his very first meeting with his teacher.
In his mind, Xue Ying was beginning to comprehend a great many things from just a glance. The Bloodshed God Emperor's guidance…was indeed much more formidable than Monarch Mo Xue's.
The Bloodshed God Emperor remained seated back in the courtyard with his eyes closed.
"Bloodshed," the black bird on his shoulder suddenly spoke., "Gagaga, isn't this rare. You've given an inner disciple two Sealed World Pagoda command tokens straightaway? Do you regard him that highly?"
"Mn." The Bloodshed God Emperor indifferently responded.
"How long do you think he'll need to grasp a grade one Deity Heart, then?" the black bird inquired.
"A thousand years or so. With my guidance combined with the help provided by the Sealed World Pagoda, as well as his comprehension ability, he should be able to grasp a grade one Deity Heart within a thousand years. He'll likely comprehend the World Deity Heart first, with the Chaotic Deity Heart following behind after a while longer," the Bloodshed God Emperor said indifferently. His eyelids lifted ever so slightly as he looked toward the gray-robed woman who served him. "Gong Feng."
"Disciple is here," the gray-robed woman respectfully acknowledged.
"For the next thousand years, send him a Nine-Fruit every single year," the Bloodshed God Emperor ordered. "Go now."
The gray-robed woman was slightly startled.
Nine-Fruit? Only the disciples His Majesty truly liked would ever receive such a gift. Nine-Fruit was a type of unique fruit wine made from eight different kinds of spirit fruit. It was very precious and rare.
"Yes," the gray-robed woman replied and then left.
"Gagaga! Bloodshed, you're giving him some Nine-Fruit every single year. If he doesn't succeed within a thousand years, won't you end up losing face?" the black bird joked.
"I won't be wrong," the Bloodshed God Emperor indifferently replied.
After the gray-robed woman heard the the conversation between the Bloodshed God Emperor and the black bird, she let out an inward sigh. Her teacher truly regarded this disciple of his highly.

chapters.title: Chapter 471 - Entering the Sealed World Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 471: Entering the Sealed World Pagoda
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
On the same day, just as it was getting dark, the Bloodshed God Emperor's disciples held a sumptuous feast within the Crimson Stone Courtyard, to which they also invited Xue Ying.
"Disciple Brother, when we first entered teacher's tutelage, most of us only received a single command token for the Sealed World Pagoda. You, on the other hand, got two. Tell me, how can we not be jealous about that?"
"That's what you're jealous about? Didn't you hear what Disciple Sister Gong Feng said? He'll get to consume some Nine-Fruit every year for a total of a thousand years."
"So what if we envy him? Disciple Brother Dong Bo will most likely grasp a grade one Deity Heart within a few thousand years. With a cultivation speed that fast, he's almost at the level of those grade one True Meaning Transcendents. I'm sure it'll be a breeze for him to become a stage four World Deity." The disciples were chatting and laughing amongst themselves, most of their conversation revolving primarily around Xue Ying. This was primarily so they could all subtly flatter him.
Xue Ying was replying to what all the others said.
Including himself, there were a total of nineteen inner disciples living within the Crimson Stone Courtyard at the moment, as well as twenty-five honorary disciples! Most of them had reached a bottleneck in terms of their combat power and could hardly improve any further. They were largely inner disciples at the level of stage two or three World Deities. As for the honorary disciples, they were practically all stage one World Deities, with only a few at stage two.
They could hardly improve further, yet they still stayed over at the Crimson Stone Courtyard for the sake of attempting to learn the "Mountain World" absolute art hidden within the Library House.
This secret art had once been used by Monarch Green to defeat Pang Yi, one of the three ancestors, some time in the past! That event granted it an incredible reputation. By now, Monarch Green's combat power and status were comparable to those of the three ancestors as well as the Mysterious Northern Palace Head—all of them experts of incredible status. He was also the closest person in the Deity world to the power of the Bloodshed God Emperor, the Temporal Island Lord, and the Myriad God Palace Head.
Being aware of the absolute art hidden within the Library House, they all naturally came over! Even if they failed to get the complete absolute art, comprehending even bits and pieces of it would still grant them tyrannical status amidst World Deities.
"Disciple Brother Dong Bo, are you aware that any disciple of His Majesty who wants to stay in the Crimson Stone Courtyard must undergo forced labor?" a sloppy old man said.
"Forced labor?" the gray-robed Gong Feng stepped into the conversation. "Disciple Brother Dong Bo doesn't have to do forced labor. I helped him waive it off."
"Why don't you waive us off our forced labor too, then?"
"We're put into forced labor every time we come here!"
The inner disciples all turned to complaining, while the honorary disciples were more reserved. They were merely shouting, 'Disciple Brother Dong Bo.'
The rules placed down by the Bloodshed God Emperor were strict.
Honorary disciples would have to refer to inner disciples as Disciple Brother or Disciple Sister, while inner disciples would have to call personal disciples in much the same way!
"Forced labor?" Xue Ying felt puzzled.
"Disciple Brother Dong Bo, most disciples must undergo forced labor, and the person responsible for that is none other than Disciple Sister Gong Feng," the sloppy old man said with a grin.
Xue Ying watched from the side.
He had noticed that Disciple Sister Gong Feng was extraordinary cold toward the more ordinary disciple brothers and sisters, while taking on a polite behaviour toward himself and two younger stage three World Deities.
After attending the feast, Xue Ying began to recognize his fellow inner disciples. Despite his apparent popularity amongst them, the fact remained that, on the surface, his combat power was the lowest. He was the only Deity of the group.
On the dawn of the next day, an insipid morning fog filled the air. Xue Ying arrived alone before a tall pagoda situated by the edge of the courtyard. The building was towering in size, and anyone could sense the suppressive feeling it exuded from a glance. It felt like watching the humongous Material World after conjoining into the Xia Clan world. It seemed as if multiple worlds were piled up on top of each other, and it only took a single look for Xue Ying understood that this Sealed World Pagoda was much more precious than his Crimson Rock Mountain.
This is worthy of the strongest expert in the Deity world. The foundation of the Bloodshed God Emperor cannot be underestimated. This Sealed World Pagoda was just some treasure he casually placed, yet it's so awe-inspiring. Xue Ying sighed inwardly before walking through the entrance.
As an inner disciple, he had the freedom to learn any World Deity ranked secret technique he wished.
His Majesty left behind a total of 328 different World Deity ranked secret techniques within the courtyard, an amount that was a whole order of magnitude larger than what was available in the Crimson Rock Mountain! Even then, it wasn't just Xue Ying, but none of the other inner disciples truly cared about the World Deity ranked secret techniques either. What they they truly sought…was an absolute art! Grasping just bits and pieces of it would still grant them more power than World Deity ranked secret techniques.
Every single level of this Sealed World Pagoda has a certain secret technique hidden within. Several of these secret techniques can be fused together into a complete absolute art set. Soon after entering the pagoda, Xue Ying discovered many cultivation rooms inside.
He casually chose a room and then pushed the stone door open to enter it. It was entirely empty!
Weng!
The stone door closed behind him. Xue Ying sat down cross-legged and took out the command token with the number '351' imprinted on it.
"Let's begin." Xue Ying immediately activated this command token, which responded by releasing a bright light.
Hua-
An invisible power enveloped Xue Ying's consciousness, bringing it directly into the world of the 351st level.
Xue Ying saw everything brighten before his eyes. He was greeted by the image of a vast world populated by countless sculptures. Despite being sparsely spread, there had to be at least a million such sculptures throughout the huge world.
According to teacher's words, these two command tokens will enable me to enter the 95th and 351th levels for cultivation! It turns out that only my consciousness descends upon these worlds, much like it did during the Bloodshed God Palace Battle. Xue Ying was enlightened. With only his consciousness ever descending into a world, it meant that no danger would ever come to him. As he looked around him, he noticed many of the sculptures in the distance gradually awakening, with the soil and dust falling from their surface.
Xue Ying extended his hand, and a spear sitting far away on the ground flew into his hand.
Mn, what is that?
Xue Ying's great eyesight allowed to see many images imprinted on a huge rock from a single glance, all of them mysterious and mystical in nature.
The secret technique? Xue Ying immediately guessed. He had long since found out that every level of the Sealed World Pagoda contained a secret technique, and that they were all scattered pieces of an entire absolute art.
"Kill!"
"Kill!"
Those sculptures finally awoke to reveal their true shape and appearance. Every last one wore thick armor and held various types of weapons. All of them were now moving in Xue Ying's direction.
Xue Ying had already engraved the images on that huge stone in his mind, which served to stir his inner heart. For the moment, however, he was focused on using his spear techniques to deal with the sculpture warriors. He found no reason to hide his combat power inside the Sealed World Pagoda, so he formed his three mirage bodies as soon as the battle began. All three figures employed the Great Chaotic True Force to fiercely welcome the savage attacks sent by the sculpture warriors.
Shua. The first to arrive was a warrior holding a long staff. It waved its weapon in a heroic motion, though it seemed to act quite reserved with its offense.
Peng.
The mirage body which blocked the attack using its spear was sent flying backward without any signs of resistance! As it flew back, the sculpture warriors in the region began moving forward to surround it. The mirage body did not even have the time to react and was instantly annihilated by a joint attack from an axe and a hammer.
Hong hong hong~
With the sculpture warriors coming in from every direction, the mirage bodies all began to crumble apart in the blink of an eye, all while Xue Ying was trying his best to keep his true body safe through use of the Mirage, continually switching positions with his avatars.
Even so, he only managed to resist for a total of three breaths of time.
Peng!
A blade cut through the Mirage and Xue Ying right across.
Despite this blade's ordinary appearance, its power transmitted completely into Xue Ying's body. Even his Time Immemorial Body at the third level exploded just the same.
Xue Ying's consciousness returned from that world.
Hu. Back in the cultivation room, the starry-blue-robed Xue Ying opened his eyes wide in disbelief. I was defeated way too fast. Those sculpture warriors were all so powerful, any one of them having more offensive might than I do. My body might be good at surviving, but it couldn't withstand even a single blow.
This can't be right!
Xue Ying was startled. The images he saw on the huge rock began floating in his mind, alongside scenes of battle with the sculpture warriors. These sculpture warriors…no matter what weapons they use, they all display the same secret technique imprinted on the huge rock?
The previous battle had been too intense, and he had lost too quickly. Now that he returned, however, he finally understood this fact.
Let's try again! Xue Ying started to get excited.

chapters.title: Chapter 472 - Secret Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 472: Secret Technique
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying once again activated the command token in his hand, and his consciousness returned into the Sealed World Pagoda's 351st level world.
The world was as vast as before, with the countless sculptures initially still. Once Xue Ying began descending, the sculptures again gradually woke up.
Sou.
Xue Ying shot up into the sky, looking all around him. As he deliberately searched huge rocks with the images imprinted on them, it didn't take long for him to discover them and begin memorizing them one by one. That was when the many sculpture warriors came rushing over to him, and he began working together with his three mirage bodies to fight one of the sculpture warriors.
His previous defeat had been too quick. However, he now understood that he lost any chance to resist as soon as he was surrounded by the sculptures. Therefore, he decided it would be best to quickly put in all of his strength to fight one of them as soon as he entered!
Hu~ That sculpture warrior released a fierce slash, devoid of any unusual effects. That simple flash of a blade was enough to leave two mirage bodies heavily injured, followed by them immediate crumbling apart. Xue Ying's true body took this opportunity to execute a move together with his last mirage body. One used Chaotic Suppression, the other Star Meteor Annihilation!
Hua! The spear's shaft started bending from its revolution, and it was followed by the illusory images created by the Star Meteor Annihilation. The spear rubbed against the back of the blade and then struck the sculpture right in its chest. Its heavy armor trembled, and even showed vague signs of cracking.
Peng. Xue Ying's other attack instead lashed out against the sculpture warrior's back, which was flung backward. However, it didn't seem to be the least bit injured.
What? On top its strong attacks, it even has such a formidable body defense? Xue Ying was truly startled.
"Kill!"
That short exchange of moves was enough to give time for many more sculpture warriors to charge over, overwhelming Xue Ying within mere moments. Xue Ying was struggling at death's door, switching positions with his mirage bodies all the while and doing his utmost to observe the offensive techniques used by the warriors. Even so, it only took five to six breaths worth of time for him to once again die.
"Mn." Still seated cross-legged within the cultivation room, Xue Ying nodded. These sculpture warriors may use various weapons, but they all employ the same secret technique, and a truly powerful technique at that. All their moves and styles seem ordinary despite being stronger than any of my own skills!
This secret technique gives off a vague taste of the Chaotic Deity Heart.
From the looks of it, cultivating in this world will likely be helpful toward grasping the Chaotic Deity Heart. Xue Ying understood his teacher's intention.
The information transmitted by the Bloodshed God Emperor was still hovering inside Xue Ying's mind. It included many pointers to aid in his cultivation, and it was split into two parts—the Chaotic Deity Heart and, respectively, the World Deity Heart. There was no issue with the World Deity Heart, since he could understand everything from a single glance. He had, after all, already condensed the World Deity Heart. As a result, he spent most of his time trying to figure out his teacher's guidance regarding the Chaotic Deity Heart.
While he experienced that guidance, he was also battling within the 351st level of the Sealed World Pagoda.
Time flowed on, and he finally acquired the complete secret techniques from all the huge rocks within the world! At that point, he discovered that the sculpture warriors were only displaying a mere part of the full secret technique; they were not using it at its true power. After all, if they were to fully display it, he would not even get the chance to struggle against them! On top of that, this partial display of its might was still enough to give him a feel for it during the close-combat struggles.
Battling was also a way of learning.
******
If spending time in the 351st level world while learning how to fight the enemies seemed taxing and slower in terms of progress made, the situation on the 95th level world was entirely different.
This world appeared to be a lush forest.
Xue Ying looked all around him to see many sculpture warriors begin awakening amidst the countless trees extending to the heavens. Other than that, the same trees hid a large number of big rocks with mysterious images imprinted on them.
"Kill." The sculpture warriors awakened completely. The first one to wake up stepped on a huge tree before leaping over in a flash while also beginning to flutter the long whip in its hand.
哗~~~~
Hua~
The whip followed an arc across the sky, and within moments, it formed thousands of illusions that enveloped Xue Ying completely, preventing him from escaping.
"Kill." A different sculpture warrior charged over, immediately taking out the sword from its scabbard.
This demonic sword light moved through the sky like a coiling finger, flickering in space as it looped around Xue Ying.
"Kill!" One more sculpture warrior began waving a big hammer, which it ruthlessly smashed over toward Xue Ying. Hong long long~ A black aura followed alongside the hammer wherever it passed, which them condensed around Xue Ying's position and shrouded him from sight.
All those sculpture warriors could attack from afar! Countless sword lights overwhelming Xue Ying, countless blade lights struck wantonly…
Fortunately, there would only ever be a total of ten sculptures launching attacks at any time, so Xue Ying could barely resist them. The defenses of the sculpture warriors on this level were not as strong as the others, but he could still only barely kill one. He then held on for another two breaths worth of time before he was restricted from all sides and was summarily killed.
Back in the Xia Clan world, inside Crimson Rock Mountain.
This secret technique?…?
Xue Ying only had to enter the 95th level world twice before completely memorizing the secret technique, and he had even begun comprehending and learning it. However, he acted as if he did not understand an iota within the Sealed World Pagoda, since him learning it too fast would give rise to suspicions, which might lead to someone easily seeing through his falsity.
It is not yet the right moment to reveal my World Deity Heart, Xue Ying thought. I must keep my vigilance. For now, I can't even inform teacher about it."
The safest secret is one that only one person knows!
He had great trust in his teacher, the Bloodshed God Emperor, but his enemy was from the Temporal Island.
The Temporal Island, the Bloodshed God Palace, and the Myriad God Palace…these three powerful organizations held great hatred for one another, and it was common to see conflict occur between them! Even assassinations or slaughter conducted by powerful existences were frequently seen. Instances of powerful existences of the Temporal Island killing one of the inner disciples of Bloodshed God Emperor were seen as small matters that everyone had already become numb to. If, however, someone were to kill one of the Bloodshed God Emperor's personal disciples, the Temporal Island would certainly be delighted to hear it.
Thus…
He had to be vigilant.
I must wait until I grasp the Chaotic Deity Heart. By then, I'll already be a stage two World Deity, Xue Ying thought. At that level, powerful existences can no longer kill me with a single thought. The only ones who can kill me are my teacher, the Temporal Island Lord, and the Myriad God Palace Head.
With how powerful these three great existences were, they would not stain their reputation and identity just to deal with a tiny junior.
The only beings he truly had to be careful of were the ordinary powerful existences.
Even normal powerful existences could sense him hiding in the Material World with a single thought and kill him just the same! Xue Ying would have nowhere to hide, and even the Bloodshed God Emperor's protection would mean nothing.
Take it slow… Xue Ying was very patient. He had a boundless future and wasn't in any hurry. Naturally, he would take whatever step was more steady while still allowing =him to stay free from the influence of others.
I'll just learn this secret technique first.
Xue Ying stood alone under a huge tree, its crimson tree leaves fluttering all about the place.
Spear in hand, he began slowly displaying the secret technique, experiencing the Profound Mysteries behind it. Gradually, strands of air stream began revolving around his spear. This breeze was full of vigor, and even a towering mountain seemed like it would be shattered by a strand of its aura. At that point, the stream of air started to envelop the surrounding space and then disperse out to the area around Crimson Dust Island.
The countless streams of air moved unhindered for more than a hundred million kilometers away. Under the influence of this surging force revolving about, those sculpture warriors back in the Sealed World Pagoda would most likely be killed within moments!
I've only just comprehended the first step and have yet to completely finish the technique. However, this domain move is exquisite indeed, and its focus is in a different direction than the domain secret skill which I crafted, the World Prison, Xue Ying thought. Having grasped hold of the World Deity Heart for so many years, he already created a few secret skills based on the World Deity Heart, one of them being a domain-related secret skill he named 'World Prison.'
The skill was focused on oppressing and trapping his opponents.
But what he was currently learning in the Sealed World Pagoda was originally part of an absolute art, which gave Xue Ying hints as to a new direction he could follow.
Hu hu hu~
Xue Ying sat down in a cross-legged position under the big tree. He rested his spear on his knees and started cultivating calmly. Those countless streams of air that moved unhindered for more than a hundred million kilometers within the Crimson Dust Island were now condensing more and more, akin to the criss-crossing of dragon-snakes.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 473 - Shackles
chapters.content:
Chapter 473: Shackles
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying was by his lonesome in the vast world spanning millions of kilometers inside the inner world of his true body. The world was filled with earth, forests, mountains, rivers, deserts, plains, plants…but there was no sign of animal life within.
High up in this world's sky, there were countless dark droplets of water which condensed to form a huge dark cloud. This was the materialization of Xue Ying's Great Chaotic True Force.
Hong hong hong~
Underground, deep beneath this vast land, there was a vast fiery-red force surging and flowing about; it was Xue Ying's fundamental energy—World Deity energy! At the core of this ocean of energy, countless seals fused together to form a solid but blurry construct, where, after some processing, World Deity energy was condensed into streams of air!
This secret technique is very complex. My comprehension regarding the World Deity Heart is quite deep, and I was even able to create a full set of secret skills, yet I'm still finding it tough to train in this secret skill. The same underground location contained an enormous illusory image of Xue Ying's head, which he was thoroughly inspecting at the moment.
As more time passed, the blurriness of that solid image began to clear up as countless seals were finely integrating with each other to form a complete construct.
About three more years later, the solid image finally cleared up completely.
It was now a black spherical body!
Indeed, the countless seals eventually melded into a tiny black sphere. This sphere seemed ordinary on the surface, but it was exceptionally profound. In fact, this secret technique was much more profound than any of the ordinary World Deity ranked secret techniques. Even successfully cultivating it to the first step was this difficult.
Hua hua hua—
The sea of fiery-red Deity energy was processed by the black sphere to form more tiny black spherical bodies, and these resulting spheres chained together to form shackles!
The long black shackles were tangled up and continually collided with one another.
Finally, I've succeeded in training this technique.
The white-robed Xue Ying stood up from under the three for the first time in more than three years, and many black shackles suddenly flew out from his body. These countless fine shackles were moving unhindered through the sky.
Any opponent bound by these shackles…if they try to struggle free, they will just end up bound even tighter. Xue Ying grabbed onto one of the many surrounding shackles. Its surface was ice-cold, and it was very tough. Under the binding of these shackles, even my true body would probably fail to exert more than half of its true strength.
This mystical secret technique I've learned in the 95th level world…since teacher hasn't named it, I shall temporarily refer to it as World Shackles, Xue Ying decided. If I use this secret technique together with the other secret skill I've created, World Prison, my total strength will likely increase by a lot!
This World Shackles technique was similar to how the Great Chaotic True Force operated.
Both were a type of strength formed through processed World Deity energy! While the Great Chaotic True Force focused on brute strength, the World Shackles specialized in binding.
Xue Ying's self-created skill, World Prison, was originally meant to move World energy by means of a mysterious manner, stacking multiple times in order to forcibly restrain his enemy! It was a manner of activating World energy which he termed World Prison.
But now, I can use the power of the World Shackles to forcibly restrict the enemy instead!
If I operate these World Shackles to display the World Prison, its strength becomes even more formidable!
Xue Ying laughed. Only a prison formed using shackles can be called a true prison.
He was vaguely beginning to feel that the White Sand City Lord's secret technique known as Annihilation White Sand, despite generally being considered to have been created using a World Deity ranked secret technique as a base, was rather some sort of fusion between secret techniques from the Sealed World Pagoda which White Sand only created after spending much effort! It was the only way for it to be this powerful. After all, as soon as the White Sand City Lord used his Annihilation White Sand, most stage three World Deities would only ever escape after suffering heavy injury! As for those who did not flee, they would merely be able to display a portion of their total strength.
Because he had already created a secret skill beforehand, which he now used in combination with the shackles, Xue Ying only had to spent about three hundred years to improve on his original technique so as to employ the shackles before finally forming this new version of World Prison!
The current iteration of this domain secret skill would stack layers upon layers of extremely dark shackles in an exquisite pattern. Xue Ying estimated that, of stage one World Deities, only experts with the technique to quickly escape the technique might survive. As for those who failed to do so…they would only be able to display about twenty to thirty percent of their total combat power.
Unfortunately, my current combat power is simply too weak. Xue Ying shook his head in dismay.
The World Deity Heart ultimately specialized in domain-related skills. By fusing together his domain secret skill with the secret technique from the Sealed World Pagoda, he eventually succeeded in forming this incredibly powerful, absolute move. But in terms of close-combat strength, Xue Ying estimated that he might only have half that of someone who grasped hold of the Splitting Heavens Deity Heart or the Chaotic Deity Heart. Even so, now that he had the World Prison secret skill, he would not be so easily pushed around.
All of the grade one Deity Hearts had their own strong points, and what truly mattered was whether the user could display them or not!
******
Within the vast Bloodshed God Palace, in the Crimson Stone Courtyard…
"Disciple Brother Dong Bo." Xue Ying stumbled upon Disciple Sister Gong Feng in the corridor.
"Disciple Sister," Xue Ying replied.
"You've entered teacher's tutelage about eight hundred years ago, yet you still haven't grasped a grade one Deity Heart?" Disciple Sister Gong Feng questioned.
"I keep feeling like there's something missing," Xue Ying explained.
Gong Feng frowned in response. She was well aware that their teacher, the Bloodshed God Emperor, had clearly stated that Xue Ying would succeed within a thousand years. But eight hundred years already passed, and Xue Ying had still not yet grasped a grade one Deity Heart.
"Teacher likes you quite a bit, so you better not disappoint him," she said with the same frown.
"Junior Disciple Brother understands," Xue Ying replied.
"Mn. Go now. Get back to your business," Gong Feng concluded.
Xue Ying left in the direction of the Sealed World Pagoda.
Gong Feng looked at him from afar, visibly displeased. Disciple Brother Dong Bo seems quite diligent in his cultivation. But teacher's deduction should not be wrong… Perhaps he's only pretending to be diligent while actually being very lazy?
Hmph! If he's the kind to become lazy in his cultivation just because he became teacher's disciple, he's nothing more than a joke. Gong Feng's eyes were filled with cold intent.
She truly held those with low combat powers in no regard.
Unless she saw great potential in terms of combat power in a person, she would simply not care enough to be polite toward them.
Within a hidden palace underneath the region of the Bloodshed God Palace.
There was an enormous scarlet-red furnace nearly fifty thousand kilometers in height, colored by blazing flames within. Although the surrounding space had been fortified, it was still starting to distort under the extremely high temperature. It was so blazing hot, in fact, that most stage four World Deities would be burned to a crisp in an instant! And right in front of this scarlet-red furnace, a towering figure was sitting cross-legged.
Even seated, this figure was still a few tens of thousands of kilometers tall. He wore crimson robes, and his eyes were fixed on the flame coming from the scarlet-red furnace.
It must be stated that, if the temperature coming from the furnace was so terrifying, the flame within it had to be even worse—it was probably no less hot than the temperatures deep within the Sun Star.
Chi chi~
Within the furnace, a strand of black energy was flashing here and there amidst the flame.
"It's only after placing down this array and depending on the Cosmos Furnace that I can occasionally form this strand of power," the Bloodshed God Emperor muttered to himself, his vision locked on that strand of power. "When can I truly grasp hold of it and use it as I wish? What is it that I'm still lacking in terms of 'Destruction?'"
"Bloodshed, you've already obtained this Cosmos Furnace and created the arrays," the black bird on top of the Bloodshed God Emperor's shoulder cried. "You can clearly see that the furnace is occasionally forming that strand of strength. Observe and emulate it closely. The Temporal Island and the Myriad God Palace Head are both likely seeking improvement through different means! But now, Bloodshed, you have seen this strength. Once you break through, you will reach a new realm! You will truly be unparalleled, and you will be able to step down upon all the others!"
For the moment, the Bloodshed God Emperor, the Temporal Island Lord, and a few others were all at the exact same level.
"Mn." The Bloodshed God Emperor smiled. "I've risked my life to get this Cosmos Furnace. It will prove its worth in the future."
"By the way, Bloodshed, I've something to remind you of. That disciple Dong Bo Xue Ying you've previously taken in has already cultivated for a thousand years," the black bird began, "but he still hasn't grasped hold of a grade one Deity Heart!"
**

chapters.title: Chapter 474 - Forced Labor
chapters.content:
Chapter 474: Forced Labor
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The black bird was bouncing on the Bloodshed God Emperor's shoulder in sheer delight. Despite being in an environment that could easily burn stage four World Deities to death, it didn't seem disturbed in the least. It was easy to see just how terrifying that was. It kept bouncing around and commenting in a joyous mood, "Bloodshed, weren't you the one who solemnly told me back then: 'I won't be wrong!'" It even deliberately mimicked the Bloodshed God Emperor's voice as it repeated his words.
"How's that slap on the face treating you? Does it feel disgraceful?" the black bird cackled out. "Didn't I tell you before to not be overconfident? The future has yet to happen, and anything is a possibility."
"He has yet to grasp a grade one Deity Heart?" The Bloodshed God Emperor put on a slight frown. "It looks like I've regarded him too highly. He's likely not worth grooming any longer. Alright, let's just stop mentioning him."
Concluding the matter with those words, the Bloodshed God Emperor continued watching the flame within the Cosmos Furnace, observing the occasional strand of dark energy forming within. He was doing his best to understand the revolving Law behind the Profound Mystery, always in search of a breakthrough.
"I see," the black bird obediently acknowledged. It was clear, however, that the Bloodshed God Emperor would not care about Xue Ying anymore, which led to an inward sigh from it. Such a pitiful brat!
Clearly, deep down in his bones, the Bloodshed God Emperor had a cruel personality.
He lived too long and experienced too many things. Matters of life or death were nothing out of the ordinary in his eyes. He also accepted many disciples over the years, and all of his current inner and honorary disciples had been accepted in the last few billion years. After all, any of the disciples who failed to become powerful existences would have limited lifespans. As for the others, some had died in battle, others saw their True Deity Heart crumble apart, and some went on to reincarnate. Over a very long time, the Bloodshed God Emperor actually accepted a large number of disciples, since he would take them in whenever he felt like it. But when he wasn't inclined to take disciples, even grade one True Meaning Transcendent would be pushed to the side.
He would properly groom those who were worth grooming. But those who weren't worthy in his eyes…he would be too lazy to even look at. He would immediately throw them to the back of his brain! He found them not worth to pay the slightest bit of attention.
He was the Bloodshed God Emperor, and his time and effort were truly precious!
Even to his two most successful disciples, Monarch Green and Monarch Gu Zang, he merely gave a destined path and then allowed them to grow by themselves. He didn't bother to care any more than that about them, preferring to instead spend more time on his own cultivation. This was part of what allowed him to stand at the apex of the Deity world. Deep within, he put the greatest importance on his personal combat power. As for the so-called 'Bloodshed God Palace,' he mostly disregarded it. Even when his disciple, Monarch Green, betrayed the Bloodshed God Palace, he merely accepted it tacitly as one of his disciples taking their own route. Although, despite being too lazy to care, he still quite liked seeing his disciples grow strong.
As for the territory regions? His Majesty simply gave them over to the governors to take care of.
"Mn." The Bloodshed God Emperor extended his right hand, and a destructive light began flashing about on his palm. "Everything can be traced back to a single origin. I'm clearly lacking by just a single bit."
The Bloodshed God Emperor continued looking up at the Cosmos Furnace, watching the strands of dark energy flashing occasionally amidst the blazing flame.
Xue Ying had yet to fully train the secret technique hidden within the 351st level world of the Sealed World Pagoda. Naturally, he had yet to grasp hold of the Chaotic Deity Heart as well.
"Too ruthless."
"They give us no face."
"Just a while ago, we could even stroll around the garden by the next wall. But now they've simple forced us out."
The many Deities of the Xia Clan were discussing amongst themselves within Xue Ying's cavern dwelling. As soon as Xue Ying entered, they immediately stormed toward him to complain.
"Dong Bo, according to the rules, our allowed area of activity within the Crimson Stone Courtyard should extend to this dwelling and that corridor…" Emperor Yun Hai walked over with a frown. "In reality, however, the attendants of other inner disciples are still allowed to enter the garden separated by the wall and take a stroll. But when we went over today, the attendants of the garden actually forced us out. Dong Bo, seeing how those guards dared treat us this way…is His Majesty perhaps not pleased with you?"
They were not fools.
After being forced out, they were not particularly angry about it, but rather worried that Xue Ying might have lost His Majesty's favor.
"There are just some slight issues." Xue Ying smiled. "Nothing major."
"Oh." The Deities exchanged glances without continuing on the topic.
Jing Qiu walked over to him and transmitted him a message, "Xue Ying, what exactly is going on? Even the guards dare mess with our people?"
"I might have disappointed teacher with my cultivation," Xue Ying sent back. "Don't worry. It's no big deal."
"You should take more care of yourself. Don't give in to the pressure," Jing Qiu consoled him.
Suddenly—
"Disciple Brother Dong Bo," a cold voice arrived from outside by means of transmission.
Xue Ying looked outside to see a gray-robed woman with a cold countenance currently standing by the entrance. She was none other than Disciple Sister Gong Feng who coldly said, "In the future, you better take proper care of your men. I've already told you about the places your attendants can and cannot go. Fortunately, they did not intrude upon the forbidden grounds. If they had, they would have most likely been sentenced to death."
"Junior Disciple understands." Xue Ying was not anguished at this treatment. After all, strictly speaking, it was his subordinates who had, indeed, gone against the rules! Previously, everyone was simply closing an eye to the situation.
The Crimson Stone Courtyard was under the management of Disciple Sister Gong Feng.
At the moment, seeing how her expression became cold toward Xue Ying, it was clear that she was no longer pleased with him. He had long since known that Disciple Sister Gong Feng was a cold person; she would only treat those with great combat power or potential in a more polite manner, and did not give a damn about the rest. The subordinates of stage three World Deities might be less restricted by the rules in the Crimson Stone Courtyard, and Xue Ying himself had enjoyed the same treatment. Clearly, however, he was no longer in that same position.
"On top of that, now that you've cultivated for a total of two thousand years without grasping a grade one Deity Heart and have proven yourself to be so useless, you're no longer qualified for me to waive you from doing forced labor." Gong Feng threw out a crystal jade to Xue Ying. "For every thousand years in the Crimson Stone Courtyard, you will have to undergo one session of forced labor. Go do it now."
"Alright," Xue Ying replied upon receiving the crystal jade.
He should have been doing forced labor from the very start, so there was no way he could decline Gong Feng now that she asked him to go do it.
Xue Ying was currently wielding an axe to chop down a huge tree somewhere in the mountain range behind the courtyard. The tree he was working on was towering in size, and Xue Ying had to put in all of his strength to chop it down. With how tough they were, he had spend an entire half-hour to chop down a single tree!
Peng peng peng… the continuous drone of chopping reverberated throughout the range, causing Xue Ying's heart to gradually calm down.
His Disciple Sister, Gong Feng, was not pleased of him! His teacher never asked him over anymore. The rest of the inner disciples were still rather polite, only talking about him behind his back, though some were clearly much colder whenever they saw him! Such was the world of cultivation, where combat power was paramount. He had received some Nine-Fruit every year for a total of a thousand years, and he had even received personal guidance from his teacher, on top of cultivating within the Sealed World Pagoda. Under such treatment, two thousand years of training was equivalent to ten thousand years under some other powerful existence.
The inner disciples now felt that Xue Ying's potential wasn't as great as initially thought, and that naturally caused their attitude toward him to shift.
Peng peng peng… The axe continued to come down on the tree. Xue Ying became quieter, only the corners of his lips now sticking up slightly.
It was the business of others to think of him what they will.
As long as he walked down the path he decided to walk, proceeding onward without stop, he found no need to be disappointed at his situation. He would once more begin to shine in the future, and countless people would start being respectful and polite to him again.
It's no wonder that teacher wants his disciples to undergo forced labor. As I go through this task, I have to put in all of my energy and spend a lot of effort to cut down even a single tree. It might seem that this makes it hard to calm down and cultivate as a result, but whenever the body is tired, the mind also relaxes, Xue Ying thought. Clearing and loosening up my thoughts might prove helpful to my cultivation.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 475 - Chaotic Deity Heart
chapters.content:
Chapter 475: Chaotic Deity Heart
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Time kept flowing, year after year. In the blink of an eye, 3,300 years had already passed since Xue Ying entered the Bloodshed God Emperor's tutelage.
In the range of mountain behind the Crimson Stone Courtyard…
Jing Qiu, Dragon Mountain Emperor, and Scarlet Flame Monarch were walking along the mountains, carefully looking at everything around them and listening to any sound.
"Over there!" Jing Qiu vaguely detected a sound.
Sou sou sou.
The three rapidly flew over. Before long, they were able to see Xue Ying in his simple black robes, brandishing a spear. He was stabbing the tree in front of him without stop. These trees…had been produced and nurtured within the unique environment of Bloodshed God Palace and were all extraordinary breeds. Even when Xue Ying put all of his energy into chopping them, he would still need half an hour to finish any of them. Now that he was using a spear to jab at it, the tree remained upright even after a whole day.
Dong! Dong! Dong!
The spear thrusted out time after time, each strike accompanied by great power.
"Don't disturb him," Monarch Scarlet Flame said solemnly to the others. "It's already been ten years since Dong Bo entered these mountains to train his spear techniques. He'll likely come out with some accomplishments."
Jing Qiu kept watching him from a distance as she revealed a smile. "Ever since he first entered the mountains to train ten years ago, I've not dared transmit him any message from fear that it might disrupt his concentration and cultivation heart realm. His true body has also entered closed-doors cultivation…I was starting to think some accident might have occured. Now that I know he is here, I can rest easy."
"You say that, but why exactly is he just staying there, thrusting his spear at that tree time after time?" the Dragon Mountain Emperor muttered. "What use will any of that be?"
"Naturally, it's not anything you can comprehend. If you could understand it, you would not be stuck at middle stage of the Deity realm," the Scarlet Flame Monarch teased him.
The Dragon Mountain Emperor didn't even know how to respond.
Xue Ying was feeling truly comfortable as he displayed his spear technique time after time. He was being quite reserved in terms of his power, through every one of his strikes hit right against against the tree's branches without exception. Once one of the trees fell down, he would just move on to another. His only focus at the moment was the feeling of his cultivation heart realm transforming before his eyes. He felt himself getting close to his desires, so he wanted to grasp hold of this opportunity and keep going.
For so many years, he had just been comprehending the great amount of guidance provided by the Bloodshed God Emperor regarding the Chaotic Deity Heart, experiencing it time after time. Combined with his training in the Sealed World Pagoda over that whole time, he was getting close and closer to breaking through that bottleneck.
From the moment he first went through forced labor, he started to love using these trees to polish his spear techniques. It relaxed his mind, and he found that he was inspired more frequently in this state.
And this training session was precisely the same!
As he kept pondering the Sealed World Pagoda secret technique while attacking the tree time and time again, Xue Ying suddenly had a revelation, and he immediately entered a mysterious state of mind. His inner heart was also enjoying this feeling, in which he completely immersed himself.
Right now, he found that displaying his spear technique was also a form of enjoyment to him! Every single attack he launched left him feeling delighted, and whenever he found something that was not quite right, he would simply adjust it.
Hong~
Xue Ying once again struck his spear out. Even though he restrained the strength internally, whenever he lashed at a completely undamaged tree, it would release an explosive and terrifying booming power! The towering tree would explode into pieces and turn into countless splinters. This scene was sufficient to startle Jing Qiu and the others, all of them having watched him for six to seven years already.
Awesome! Xue Ying's eyes brightened. A spirited feeling filled his body as he let out all of his stifling feelings in one go!
This is awesome, so awesome! I don't have to care about anything! I can just be free, and let out everything I have! Xue Ying's eyes were glittering. The Laws of Profound Mysteries began descending upon the surrounding space. The different grade one Deity Hearts are, indeed, all focused on different directions. Ever since I was young, I would cultivate my spear techniques in search of balanced perfection, which is why grasping the World Deity Heart was so simple for me to do! However, that same state of mind turned out to be the biggest obstacle toward comprehending the Chaotic Deity Heart.
The space surrounding Xue Ying began crumbling apart as dark holes began forming all around him.
Once the dark holes arrived upon Xue Ying's body, all of that space in his vicinity, which was crumbling apart, was swallowed by these dark chaotic holes. The weeds around him, the tree splinters, all of them were being swallowed whole.
"This—"
"Chaotic Deity Heart?"
"Dong Bo has broken through?"
Jing Qiu, the Dragon Mountain Emperor, and the Scarlet Flame Monarch who were watching him all entered a state of elation.
Xue Ying himself was also soaking in the joyous feeling, the sort of feeling which one would die for at night after feeling it during the day! He truly was in a grand mood after comprehending the Deity Heart. The others could speak as much as they wanted, but they could only say their own opinions! Even the pointers he received from the Bloodshed God Emperor, despite being very detailed, proved ultimately useless! It was similar to how the Bloodshed God Emperor could put in all his effort for the sake of his wife, but she still couldn't become more than a stage one World Deity due to her weak heart realm.
On the road of cultivation, people could receive pointers from others, but they would still have to ultimately walk the road themselves. It all came down to one's own comprehension.
Xue Ying had succeeded, and it was only natural for him to be excited and happy. He also finally understood what kept him stuck at this bottleneck and how taxing it was. Even so, he finally broke through on that day.
The various grade one Deity Hearts definitely head in different directions.
The World Deity Heart uses the elements of earth, fire, water, and wind as a base. Together with the aura of life, they can reach an equilibrium. It is balanced and all-encompassing, like the rivers which flow into the sea!
But the Chaotic Deity Heart is entirely different! It walks down a path to an absolute extreme!
Xue Ying shook his head.
Even with his teacher's guidance, he still had to understand this problem by himself. After all, this mindset focused on encompassion and equilibrium was one that Xue Ying gained when he was still young! As he trained his spear techniques, his offense and defense were both aspects which he had to polish in search for the perfect balance. Even the way he treated others, despite him being an introvert, would still be quite polite on the surface.
This was all part of his mindset centered on equilibrium, and it was a balance that had seeped down to his bones.
It wasn't the sort of thing he could change as soon as he understood the problem. While comprehending that secret technique, especially as he jabbed at the tree using his spear, his mind would empty. He would throw away all external influences, which served to break the shackles of his mentality. His mind and soul were both cleared to an empty state, like a clean sheet of paper. It was this training which allowed him to gradually start breaking through the bottleneck of that secret technique gleaned from the 351st level world from the Sealed World Pagoda and eventually comprehend it in its entirety.
It's no wonder that the World Deity Heart is much weaker than the Chaotic Deity Heart in close combat. Xue Ying revealed a grin. The Chaotic Deity Heart originates from the most basic instinctual self. It's about throwing everything aside and just completely destroying all before oneself.
They might all be completely different directions, but after reaching grade one, all of the Deity Hearts would still be somewhat similar in the end! It was part of the reason why fusing grade one Deity Hearts together was comparatively less difficult. They were all different parts of the most basic essence of the Laws of the World.
The World Deity Heart might be balanced and encompassing, but it's precisely because it is so encompassing that it can also take in this most intrinsic destruction. The two grade one Deity Hearts within Xue Ying were rapidly fusing together. It was an extremely fast process, without any sign of confusion. In just a few breaths of time the two grade one Deity Hearts were already underway in the process of fusing as one.
Xue Ying's aura began transforming at the same time, and it was now starting to show signs of a deeper level of the Laws of Profound Mysteries.
"Breakthrough."
"Dong Bo has broken through."
Jing Qiu, the Dragon Mountain Emperor, and Scarlet Flame Monarch were all looking from a distance. They could see that Xue Ying was in the process of breaking through and did not dare disturb him until he finished.
Within the hidden underground palace of the Bloodshed God Palace, there was an enormous furnace, scarlet-red in color, within which a blazing flame was burning. The huge figure of Bloodshed God Emperor could be seen sitting cross-legged right outside this furnace, focused on observing everything that was happening within the furnace. He was pondering on the mysteries within it without pause.
"Master," a mighty voice resounded throughout the entire palace hall.
"Mn?" The Bloodshed God Emperor frowned. "What is the matter?"
This mighty voice belonged to none other than the treasure spirit of the palace itself. The Bloodshed God Palace, in spite of its incredible size, was indeed a treasure, complete with a treasure spirit which could discover everything that happened within its premises. Whenever someone was to pay him a visit, or if any disciples or subordinates were to enter the forbidden grounds, he would receive word of it through this treasure spirit! It was only this treasure spirit which was sure to be eternally loyal to him.
However, he had long since ordered it to not disturb him unless an important matter came up.
"Master take a look at that inner disciple, Dong Bo Xue Ying, of yours," the voice resounded.
"Oh?"
The Bloodshed God Emperor was rather puzzled, but he had great trust in the treasure spirit. With a thought, his spiritual awareness covered the entire Bloodshed God Palace, and he naturally discovered Xue Ying in the process as well.
He broke through? The Bloodshed God Emperor calmly assessed the situation. So what if he did, tough? For someone to become a stage one World Deity within five thousand years was nothing strange.
However, his initial reaction was followed by a frown of disbelief. Stage two?
******

chapters.title: Chapter 476 - Stage Two World Deity
chapters.content:
Chapter 476: Stage Two World Deity
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
It was true that the Bloodshed God Emperor had strict requirements for selecting disciples and was quite willful with his choices…
But he was still accepting disciples regularly! The Myriad Flower Feast, for instance, was still a method for selecting future disciples, as the event was considered a chance for the many juniors to shine! After all, the Bloodshed God Emperor himself clearly understood that even though it seemed like he was standing at the very peak, he was, in reality, on the same level as the Temporal Island Lord, and the Myriad God Palace Head, as well as several other existences.
He was strongest in terms of direct combat, but the Temporal Island Lord was unparalleled in terms of time and space. He could go wherever he wanted, and nobody could restrict him!
In any case, all of the existences standing at the very apex had their own formidable techniques.
At such a stage, having a good helper was actually quite important. He had spent quite a lot of effort on his disciples, both on Monarch Green and Monarch Gu Zang. A teacher-student relationship was an important tie. The Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, for example, was one of the three grand elders at the moment, but if he were to reach the apex in the future, he might not necessarily have good ties to the Bloodshed God Emperor.
The stronger an expert, the less probable it was for them to be loyal to someone else. At that point, it was their sentiments that served to influence relationships more.
As such, the Bloodshed God Emperor had actually accepted many batches of disciples over the many years, though most of them he took in because of his mood at the time. For instance, when someone could move his heart, even if they were weaker in terms of talent, the Bloodshed God Emperor would still accept them as an honorary disciple! As for those he found better in terms of talent and more worthy of grooming, he would accept them as inner disciples! Even then, there were certainly a lot of disciples who disappointed him over the time, by failing to even become stage four World Deities.
People whom he truly liked and also regarded highly upon were few and far between.
But now, the Bloodshed God Emperor was shocked to discover that he actually had such a talented disciple!
"What stage two? Bloodshed, what are you talking about?" the black bird on his shoulder asked in confusion.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying's True Deity Heart has broken through. However, after the evolution of his inner world, he became a stage two World Deity straightaway." The Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled.
"What, stage two? Wasn't it the case that this Dong Bo brat couldn't even break through to grasp a single grade one Deity Heart? How could he suddenly have become a stage two World Deity?" The black bird felt puzzled. However, it joined His Majesty in extending its senses, discovering Xue Ying in the mountain range. Once it saw him, it could not help but gasp from shock. "It truly is…his true body's Deity Heart had already broken through. He should have only cultivated for five to six hundred years, right? This…this is… Such cultivation speed is too terrifying."
"Let me think…" The black bird began hopping around Bloodshed's shoulder. "Over the history of the Deity world and Dark Abyss, the fastest person to become a stage one World Deity was Monarch Green, right? He spent three hundred years total to become a stage one World Deity! As for the fastest one to become a stage two World Deity, it's probably that mad brat, Monarch Extermination, who did it within twenty-nine hundred years. He was truly too crazy, and his bloodlust too pronounced. He ended up dying prematurely without any hope to become a powerful existence. The fastest to become a stage three World Deity should be the Flying Snow Manor Lord, who spent roughly fifty-three thousand years, and when it comes to stage four World Deities, the fastest was likely the Temporal Island Lord at about a hundred eighty thousand years."
"Except for Monarch Extermination who died prematurely, Monarch Green, Flying Snow Manor Lord, and the Temporal Island Lord are all very formidable figures right now," the black bird concluded.
Bloodshed God Emperor lightly nodded.
His own cultivation speed was slower than the others. However, his position was still very high. That was part of the reason he was willing to give an opportunity to all of his many disciples.
"Let me take a more thorough look at his cultivation past." The Bloodshed God Emperor swept his gaze in a specific direction.
His mighty power began penetrating through countless space obstructions and even forcibly pierced through the membrane of the material world!
It was commonly known that only the Temporal Temple could break through the Material World protection and reverse time so as to investigate different matters, while the other powerful existences could not do so!
In reality…
Breaking through the protections of the Material World was very tough indeed, and it was true that ordinary powerful existences could not revert time within the Material World. Those apex existences, however—such as the Bloodshed God Emperor, the Myriad God Palace Head and the rest—could still do so if they acted personally. The only difference was that the Temporal Island Lord was strongest in this regard, since he had no need to act personally. The treasure he personally refined, the Temporal Temple, could do so for him.
Hua~
An unseen power descended over the Xia Clan World.
The white-robed Xue Ying was currently sitting cross-legged inside his cultivation room in the Crimson Rock Mountain. Currently, his inner world was starting to transform…
Hong long long~
His originally billions of kilometers large inner world was currently expanding explosively in size. Its lands were stretching in all directions, and the seas were expanding as well. All throughout his inner world, huge amounts of energy were being absorbed.
Originally, this realm did not contain any kind of gaseous substance, and the trees and plants were strangely unable to grow or wither!
But now, after fusing in the Laws of Chaos Hole, the insides of the plants and trees were starting to grow. The cells within were being continuously destroyed while new ones formed in their place. The trees and plants were actually growing! As they grew, they eventually started to wither before finally returning to the earth and growing once again!
Countless forms of life were now emerging within his inner world. This life cycle was also generating gas and various matter, and air was now starting to circulate within.
"Mn?" Xue Ying looked upward, feeling an unseen power shrouding over him.
Teacher? Xue Ying immediately deduced. This was the aura of his teacher, the Bloodshed God Emperor. He is reverting the river of time to investigate what happened in the past?
As the Realm Lord of this world, he was naturally able to discover what his teacher was doing.
After it pierced the many obstructions placed by the Material World, the remaining power which descended was not very strong. Xue Ying could forcibly push this power out if he wanted to.
Knowing that it was sent by his teacher, however, he naturally did not dare do such a thing.
"This brat has even spent more than six hundred years in a time-acceleration environment?" Back in front of the Cosmos Furnace, the Bloodshed God Emperor lightly nodded. "If we add it all up, he should have become a stage one World Deity within nine hundred years, and he reached stage two within five thousand years."
"He might not have broken the record, but he's still ranked at the very front amidst grade one True Meaning Transcendents," the black bird said with joy. "Monarch Green might have been dazzling back then, having reached stage one within three hundred years and needing only thirty-nine hundred years to reach stage two, but you've put quite a lot of effort into teaching him, and you've even fought the Myriad God Palace Head once in order to receive him as your disciple."
Monarch Green had truly been a dazzling figure back in his time.
He was born a Transcendent with outstanding talent. He had actually grasped the embryonic form of a grade one True Meaning when he was still a child. After that, it didn't take him long to grasp the complete grade one True Meaning, becoming a World Deity within three hundred years! It must be stated that the fastest person to have become a stage one World Deity before him had needed a total of six hundred years, a record put in place by the Temporal Island Lord. However, Monarch Green needed just half that time! This shocked even the Bloodshed God Emperor and other apex existences!
All of them tried to snatch him away as their disciple!
The Temporal Island Lord had accepted a compromise, while the Myriad God Palace Head went out to fight the Bloodshed God Emperor. In the end, His Majesty proved to be the more tyrannical figure of the two.
Before long, Monarch Green became the Bloodshed God Emperor's disciple!
It was only natural that he would spend a lot of effort and time to guide such a pupil. As a result, Monarch Green currently had unmeasurable combat power.
"Congratulations, master! Congratulations!" the black bird shouted out. "For you to have gotten your hands on such a good disciple, and so easily at that! Even if the Myriad God Palace Head and the Temporal Island Lord were to try to snatch him now, it would be too late!"
"Haha…" the Bloodshed God Emperor laughed. "It's still too early to say. Back then, that brat, Monarch Extermination, riled up the whole Deity world and Dark Abyss, causing two rulers from the Abyss to personally come over and snatch him. However, because his bloodlust was too strong, and because he was too arrogant, he ended up losing his little life.
"Dong Bo's cultivation might be slightly slower than Monarch Green and Extermination…but I still like his personality most. He's an upright person, full of emotion, and without any trace of arrogance or bad temper." The Bloodshed God Emperor had finally understood the whole situation after reverting the time flow. "He formally accepted Crimson Dust as his teacher in the past and was likely worried that Forefather Devil would try to kill him before he had the chance to resist. That's why he's been concealing all information and didn't even tell me about it even after falling out with his fellow disciples.
"He doesn't place his dreams and ambitions on the shoulders of others, and he has plenty of patience to boot."
The Bloodshed God Emperor was truly pleased.
As a truly patient figure himself, he was bound to like other people who showed patience the most. He had also taken step after step before finally reaching his current status.
******
Back in the Crimson Stone Courtyard, Gong Feng was sitting by herself, enjoying some wine. However, her cold eyes were fixed on a place in the distance.
Her personality was cold, and she held weak people in no regard. However, in the face of experts, she would suddenly become very docile. This was doubly true for whenever she met His Majesty, the Bloodshed God Emperor; she would be truly loyal and obedient. This was precisely why her teacher sent her around on tasks as his underling.
"Go out and bring Dong Bo here," her teacher's voice resounded within her mind.
"Mn?"
Gong Feng opened her eyes wide as she respectfully acknowledged the order, "Yes, teacher."
She then stood up and went out. After leaving her cavern dwelling, she released her domain to sweep through the entire Crimson Stone Courtyard. In her heart, however, she was still puzzled. Why did teacher ask me to find Dong Bo? No matter how I think about it, teacher should be very disappointed in him! Unless…has Dong Bo has broken through? Is it the case that teacher truly likes Dong Bo that much and wants to teach him again?
Mn, back during their first meeting, teacher passed two command tokens over to Dong Bo. It's probably the case that he likes him quite a bit.
In spite of her confusion, Gong Feng still went over to find Xue Ying without hesitation.
Why isn't he here? She walked along the corridor while inspecting her surroundings. She even used her domain to sweep through the place, but she could not find Xue Ying at all.
Right at that moment, four people walked in through the backdoor of the courtyard. They were Xue Ying, who was wearing an ordinary black robe, Jing Qiu, the Scarlet Flame Monarch, and the Dragon Mountain Emperor.
You've finally showed up. Gong Feng frowned. She could tell from a glance that Xue Ying was still a Deity! He had yet to become a World Deity.
You haven't even broken through? Gong Feng sneered in her heart.
"Junior Disciple Dong Bo!" Gong Feng coldly hollered.
Xue Ying turned over to his companions and said, "Jing Qiu, you guys should return first." He then went over to Gong Feng.
His Deity Heart had just broken through, but in order for his inner world to transform, he would still need a large amount of Deity crystals. He was not so silly as to do so within the mountain range. He wanted to first return to the cultivation room within his cavern dwelling to cultivate and let his inner world transform. After he did so, he could form World Deity energy. Before he went through that process, he could not be considered a World Deity.
"Disciple Sister Gong Feng." Xue Ying went over.
"What are you doing, running around the place instead of cultivating properly?" she coldly said, looking over to Xue Ying with a strand of disgust. "Teacher has ordered me to send over, so it's best if you just follow me quickly."
With those words, she turned around and continued walking.
Xue Ying shook his head but followed behind nonetheless. Thinking about how his teacher's power had descended over the Xia Clan world, he could vaguely guess as to why he was being called over.

chapters.title: Chapter 477 - Personal Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 477: Personal Disciple
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
In any case, the one walking in front, Gong Feng, was still a stage three World Deity. Even without looking at him, she still knew what kind of expression Xue Ying was making. His simple gesture of shaking his head with a smile on his face served to anger her.
"I've given you some words of guidance, yet you're sitting there, shaking your head?" Gong Feng turned to face Xue Ying. "Disciple Brother Xue Ying, are you trying to provoke me?"
Xue Ying coldly replied, "Teacher is waiting for me at the moment. If there's something about me that dissatisfies you, Disciple Sister, wait until we return from teacher's place to settle it."
"Fine." Gong Feng suppressed her anger. She didn't dare delay their teacher's summon.
Deep inside, however, she was still angry. She had always acted obedient before her teacher, so he entrusted all of the more trifling matters pertaining to Crimson Stone Courtyard to her. Because of this, the honorary and inner disciples all had no choice but to give her face. The way she saw it, there was no way that Dong Bo, a mere Deity, would be qualified to disrespect her! She decided to take this matter to heart. So you dare bare your fangs in front of me? Hmph!
Gong Feng lead the way with Xue Ying following behind. Before long, they arrived at a tranquil, beautiful garden. There, the Bloodshed God Emperor, wearing his deep scarlet robes, was silently watching the lake next to him.
"Teacher," Gong Feng greeted with utmost obeisance. "Disciple Brother Dong Bo has arrived."
"Teacher," Xue Ying also gave a polite greeting.
The Bloodshed God Emperor turned his head to face the two when a black bird suddenly appeared from nothingness to land on his shoulder. "Dong Bo brat, not bad. Heh, you've been hiding it pretty well, haven't you?"
Standing to the side, Gong Feng was starting to get suspicious. Hiding it well? What did he hide?'
"Teacher's eyes are truly discerning," Xue Ying respectfully replied. "I've only concealed it because of the looming danger of a great enemy."
Bloodshed nodded slightly and said with a laugh, "Not bad."
It was only two words, but they were enough to startle Gong Feng. What? Did teacher just laugh? This…how could this possible? She had been serving the Bloodshed God Emperor for many years and was well aware of his usual temperament. With how cold and detached his usual demeanour was, she had never before seen him display any kind of expression in front of his disciples. Not to mention laughing, it was very rare to see him even become angry at them.
For instance, back in the Myriad Flower Feast, an event attended by many powerful existences, the Bloodshed Emperor only ever interacted with the greater existences who had more or less equivalent power to him, and even then he only let out the occasional smile. As for everyone else? They were given the cold shoulder.
Another case was back when Xue Ying had just become his disciple. His Majesty might have given him two command tokens, but his demeanour was still indifferent, having just told Xue Ying to withdraw without any pleasantries. But now? The Bloodshed God Emperor even showed a faint smile the very moment Xue Ying said anything?
What is going on? Just what the hell is going on? Dong Bo hid it quite deep? Hid what? Gong Feng came up with some speculations, but as soon as she remembered that Xue Ying had only cultivated for around five thousand years, she quickly discarded them.
"You've condensed a grade one Deity Heart within nine hundred years." The Bloodshed God Emperor gave a slight nod. "Not only do you have innate talent, but you're also able to endure silently when needed. You've kept it all hidden all the way until your breakthrough as a stage two World Deity. You might still be young, but you have good patience; a good trait. For the moment, you're still advancing every time by leaps and bounds, but it doesn't mean that, when your realm and power deepen in the future, you won't face any difficulty and setbacks in your cultivation. In the face of such trouble, that patience will prove vital."
"Disciple understands," Xue Ying respectfully replied.
"Your caution is also a welcome trait. On the path of cultivation, teachers can only ever provide you limited help. In the end, it's still yourself that you must rely on." The Bloodshed God Emperor was clearly quite satisfied with this disciple of his.
After all, these two traits of patience and caution he was also well-known for possessing.
He had always been talented in assassination. Back when he still young and weak, he relied the most on his caution and patience. Step by step, he followed his own road of cultivation with firm footing, all the way until he reached his current unfathomable realm. It could even be said that he was the most influential being throughout the whole Deity world and Dark Abyss. That could also be inferred from how how well-spread his Bloodshed Tavern was throughout the Deity world, the Dark Abyss, and even the material world.
Even tyrannical beings such as the Abyss Rulers were willing to become his friends!
This was precisely why seeing Xue Ying's cautious and patient self left the Bloodshed God Emperor feeling satisfied.
"Have you heard about what happened to Monarch Extermination?" the Bloodshed God Emperor asked.
"I have," Xue Ying replied.
"He became a grade two World Deity within twenty-nine hundred years of cultivation. He was even faster than you are. In the end, however, his character proved too mad. His lack of caution and patience eventually ruined his life. You have take note of his story."
"I understand," Xue Ying replied.
Gong Feng could only listen, dumbstruck. She couldn't comprehend the meaning behind this conversation between Xue Ying and the Bloodshed God Emperor.
Monarch Extermination? He should take note of him? Did teacher put Xue Ying on the same standing as Monarch Extermination, just like that? Nine hundred years to become a stage one World Deity? He only revealed himself after breaking through to become a stage two World Deity? Caution? Patience?
This…this is just… Gong Feng couldn't organize her thoughts. When did the Bloodshed God Emperor ever teach his disciples with such attentiveness. He would usually give them some simple pointers before summarily asking them to leave.
Did Dong Bo really become a stage two World Deity? She didn't want to believe it, but she couldn't deny it after hearing them say it so clearly. There was no way that His Majesty would be lying. He's only been cultivating for such a short period of time, though… Even a grade one True Meaning Transcendent usually needs about three thousand years to become a World Deity, and they'd only reach stage two within ten thousand years. No, this Dong Bo Xue Ying really is a grade one True Meaning Transcendent, and a very formidable one at that!
This was the first time she heart about Xue Ying having condensed his grade one Deity Heart within just nine hundred years of cultivation.
"From today, you are my personal disciple," the Bloodshed God Emperor said, out of the blue.
"Yes, teacher." Xue Ying had already guessed this might happen, but he was still excited to hear it. He was, after all, the master of Crimson Rock Mountain, so he understood how good his his cultivation speed really was; it was still quite rare, however, for the Bloodshed God Emperor to take a personal disciple. In fact, it was so rate that, in the current era, his only personal disciples were the long-lived Monarch Gu Zang and Monarch Green! He was now the only World Deity under the personal tutelage of the Bloodshed God Emperor.
"My greetings to Elder Brother," a voice sounded from the side.
Xue Ying glanced toward Gong Feng who was now showing utmost respect.
The rules set in place by the Bloodshed God Emperor were very strict.
There was a difference of night and day between his personal disciples, his inner disciples, and his honorary disciples. All of these groups held vastly differing statuses.
"Gong Feng, you can go back now," the Bloodshed God Emperor ordered.
"Yes, teacher," Gong Feng obediently retreated.
