Gong Feng was starting to feel uneasy as soon as she left the garden. How can this be true? Xue Ying was actually this powerful? This… how could such a thing happen? Now that he became a personal disciple, Xue Ying held a much loftier position, perhaps only lower than his majesty himself, and while personal disciples had no direct authority over the inner and honorary disciples, Xue Ying still had plenty of ways to deal with her. Such punishments like directly kicking her out of Crimson Stone Courtyard were not impossible.
The Bloodshed God Emperor had been delegating tasks to Gong Feng to finish, even putting her in charge of Crimson Stone Courtyard itself—which gave her a somewhat decent position. She was, in fact, even higher in position than the stage Three World Deity guards, while her clan had used that position to flourish. However, if she were to offend one of His Majesty's personal disciples and end up being chased from Crimson Stone Courtyard, everyone she or her clansmen offended in the past would definitely come back to get revenge.
What should I do? I have to find some way…there must be some way to salvage this situation! Gong Fengwas filled with anxiety.
******
Xue Ying was standing respectfully before his teacher.
It was only after Gong Feng left that the Bloodshed God Emperor said, "As my personal disciple, I will not treat you any different than the others. Just as the rest of my personal disciples, you will receive the same opportunity to learn an absolute art."
Xue Ying's eyes sparkled.
Absolute art?
"The absolute art you will receive has yang and firm characteristics. Its potential is matchless, its might comparable with Monarch Green's "Mountain World"absolute art," the Bloodshed God Emperor explained. Xue Ying excitement reached a peak when he heard that it was as powerful as the "Mountain World".
"Don't be too happy just yet. I am imparting this absolute art to you, but what level you can reach in it is ultimately up to you. Over my long lifespan, I have received several personal disciples, but out of all of them, only Monarch Green and Gu Zang succeeded in becoming powerful existences. The absolute art I imparted to Gu Zang was not the slightest bit inferior to the one Monarch Green received, but even though he diligently practiced it, he still couldn't reach a level comparable to Monarch Green," the Bloodshed God Emperor explained.
"Your disciple understands," Xue Ying assented.
"Other than the absolute art which I imparted to him, Green got his hands on another absolute art from the Library House. Although he has two absolute arts, he still proved more proficient in the"Mountain World". All absolute arts are powerful, but that doesn't mean they're all suitable for you, and neither is it the case that your power will necessarily increase as the number of absolute arts you own increases.
"Of course, I'm giving you an absolute art that's most suitable for you. You've already received two secret arts from the two worlds within the Sealed World Pagoda. Those two are both parts of the absolute art I'm imparting to you—small, scattered parts from it. Absolute arts are sought after by all World Deities, and they will even influence their Deity Heart.
"In any case, I can't so easily hand the absolute art over to you. In order to receive it, you must first pass a test," the Bloodshed God Emperor stated.
Xue Ying understood this to be an incredible opportunity. Just by passing a test, he would receive an absolute art. "Teacher, what kind of test is it?"
"It's very simple. In the mountain beside Crimson Stone Courtyard, you will find a prison. The only thing you must do is kill the prisoner locked inside that prison. Do that, and you will receive the absolute art," the Bloodshed God Emperor said with faint smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 478 - Prisoner
chapters.content:
Chapter 478: Prisoner
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The Bloodshed God Emperor waved his hand, throwing out a prisoner token. "Take this token with you. Once you activate it, you will enter the prison where you will find your opponent. Without this token, you would never find him regardless of how much you search. This prisoner won't go down easily, but there's no need to be anxious about it. Kill him, and you will get to learn that absolute art."
"Yes," Xue Ying replied as he received the token.
The Bloodshed God Emperor continued, "I'll be taking a bit of your blood."
With those words, an invisible power cut down on Xue Ying's wrist, causing his blood to fill the air.
Xue Ying did not attempt to resist this power. At his stage, losing blood couldn't threaten his life in any way and would only cause him to lose some energy at most. Within moments, the amount of blood accumulated in mid-air was enough to fill a tiny lake.
"You are my personal disciple, so I will personally craft a blood-refined Deity warrior for you," the Bloodshed God Emperor said indifferently. With a casual wave of his hand, the tiny lake of blood went into his storage.
"Thank you, teacher," Xue Ying replied.
"Should your blood-refined Deity warrior have the shape of a spear?" the Bloodshed God Emperor asked again.
"Yes."
With Xue Ying having cultivated the avatar technique, his two bodies would require a blood-refined deity warrior each.
This spear, however, would certainly be more powerful than the previous! It would be personally refined by His Majesty, after all, and would naturally be extraordinary.
"Alright, go on and cultivate properly now. Once you kill the prisoner and obtain the absolute art, you can come see me again," the Bloodshed God Emperor ordered.
Xue Ying immediately retreated.
The Bloodshed God Emperor let out a laugh after seeing his disciple leave. The black bird quacked out on his shoulder, "Bloodshed, you're leaving Dong Bo to kill that prisoner? That guy won't be so easily killed. Who knows, that brat might only succeed after becoming a stage three World Deity."
"In that case, he'll learn the absolute art after becoming a stage three World Deity. This will prove a good opportunity to sharpen himself," the Bloodshed God Emperor indifferently replied. "The higher one's talent, the more they need to be sharpened."
"He sure is unlucky to have you as a teacher," the bird muttered.
The Bloodshed God Emperor did not respond to the black bird's provocation. Once their exchange ended, ripples began to form in the surrounding space, and both man and bird disappeared into nothingness, once again returning to the underground palace, right in front of that Cosmos Furnace.
Within a hall inside Xue Ying's cavern dwelling, the Xia Clan Deities as well as Jing Qiu fell into a daze the sight of a group of attendants coming over. The hall was now full to the brim with precious treasures, as well as a total of ten Myriad Flower True Fruits. A single glance at these exorbitant treasures was enough to leave them with their hearts trembling. Even the White Sand City Lord would be dumbstruck after seeing those treasures, much less Deities like them.
"May I know what these are…?" Jing Qiu asked.
"We've arrived under His Majesty's orders. These gifts have been sent over for His Highness, Dong Bo," a black-robed old man explained with a smile. His aura was completely retracted. "Perhaps you all haven't heard about it yet? His Highness Dong Bo has become one of His Majesty's personal disciples."
"Personal disciple?"
Emperor Yun Hai, Monarch Scarlet Flame, Monarch Sky Sea, the Dragon Mountain Emperor, and all the others were speechless. Even Jing Qiu found it hard to believe. They were aware that Xue Ying had broken through, and for an ordinary powerful existence to receive him as their personal disciple would be normal! But…the strongest existence in the Deity world, the Bloodshed God Emperor, had higher requirements for taking someone as his personal disciple. Not even grade one True Meaning Transcendents would necessarily qualify.
It was at that moment that Xue Ying stepped in from outside.
"Greetings, Your Highness. These gifts have been sent over by His Majesty. Also, whenever Your Highness is free, you may move over to a different cavern dwelling." The black-robed old man chuckled. He wasn't required to act as respectful as the attendants by his side were.
"Mn?" Xue Ying looked over to the old man, whose aura was kept completely hidden. He could not sense what his realm was! He could, at most, feel an unseen oppressive feeling coming from him. This should be a hidden expert within the Bloodshed God Palace, just like that black bird on the shoulder of His Majesty.
"Thank you, everyone," Xue Ying said.
"Now that you have received these gifts, we will be taking our leave." The black-robed old man smiled and left together with his group of attendants.
As soon as the men were outside, the entire hall was filled with clamoring.
"Dong Bo, you've become a personal disciple of His Majesty?"
"They're actually calling you 'Your Highness' now?"
"Of all the disciples of His Majesty, only personal disciples are qualified to be referred to as 'Your Highness'…" The Xia Clan Deities could not hide their excitement.
Xue Ying nodded.
Jing Qiu followed up with a question of her own, "Xue Ying, you've only just become a World Deity, yet His Majesty has already accepted you as a personal disciple?"
"I've broken through to become a stage two World Deity," Xue Ying replied. There was no longer a reason to hide anything. In fact, even Gong Feng and those attendants were already aware. Clearly, His Majesty did not plan on keeping this fact a secret any longer. After all, at Xue Ying's current stage, only the Temporal Island Lord, the Myriad God Palace Head, and those at that level could hope to kill him. In reality, however, there was no previous occurence of the Bloodshed God Emperor, the Temporal Island Lord, or other such powerful beings from the the Deity world and Dark Abyss dealing with brats.
They were standing at the true apex of the world, and even seeing their subordinate powerful existences battling could not cause them to act.
At the sound of these news that Xue Ying had become a stage two World Deity, the hall turned quiet, followed by an explosion of activity and noise.
The deluge of news today made them truly unable to hold it in any longer.
"Hahaha, let's see if that Gong Feng person dares act so arrogantly in front of Dong Bo now."
"She's probably crying about it right about now, but it's too late for that!"
"Dong Bo is too formidable."
The hall was filled with noise.
Xue Ying first moved to another cavern dwelling and then accompanied everyone for a celebratory feast. He even passed some of his treasures over to the rest of the Deities. His Majesty God Emperor truly treated his personal disciples well! The things he gave them were small in Xue Ying's eyes, but they were enough to make those Deities decline them again and again. Every treasure they received would cost more than 100,000 Deity crystals to buy, and some were valued even higher. They were not the sort of items the Deities of the Xia Clan would just accept with not second thought.
"Jing Qiu, I've got to go into closed-door to transform my inner world. Unless it's on important business, ignore anyone who comes over," Xue Ying said.
"Mn. Alright," she replied with a vibrant smile. But after seeing Xue Ying enter the cultivation room, she began contemplating.
Gong Feng was pacing around the corridors, filled with hesitation.
She was clear that she was now at a crucial fork in her path. Having offended Xue Ying, a personal disciple of her teacher, so if he wanted to deal with her, she would no longer be allowed to live there! The moment the other organizations out there found out that she offended a personal disciple of the Bloodshed God Emperor, and that she was no longer serving under His Majesty, her clan would certainly be heavily affected, and the status of all its members would plummet! Her way of handling matters and treating others in the past was truly too ugly, and she had offended quite a number of people. It was likely that trouble would soon arrive at her doorstep.
He is a personal disciple, so a simple apology won't mean much to him.
So what if I have to lower my head?
I must endure it… Gong Feng gritted her teeth and encouraged herself. She had, after all, lived so far as a person of great status, and for her to now endure and swallow her resentment was not so easy to do.
Endure, endure, endure!
Gong Feng quickly headed in the direction of Xue Ying's cavern dwelling with gritted teeth. She was aware that he had already moved to new lodgings.
Once she reached the entrance, her eyes fell upon the Dragon Mountain Emperor who was standing there, drinking wine from a flask.
"Go ahead pass on a message. I want to meet with Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo," Gong Feng said. All of the inner disciples and honorary disciples were now required to call Xue Ying 'Senior Disciple Brother!'
"Oh?" The Dragon Mountain Emperor glanced at her with indifference. "His Highness is currently undergoing closed-doors cultivation. He is not receiving guests!"
"You haven't even passed the message on." Gong Feng's expression turned ugly. In the past, would she have had any reason to care about this little servant? Now, however, she could only endure this indifferent treatment from him, a subordinate of Xue Ying's.
"Are you deaf or what? I said His Highness is in closed-doors cultivation!" The Dragon Mountain Emperor sneered.
Not too much time passed since Gong Feng had reprimanded and scolded Xue Ying right in front of everyone else. They were all Deities, and their auditory prowess was quite sensitive. After that event, they had to keep that resentment to themselves, but their dislike of this person was very clear nonetheless.
"Alright. Tell Senior Disciple Brother that I'll come and greet him again as soon as he finishes his cultivation session, then," Gong Feng forced herself to say, upon which she then immediately turned to leave. She felt her entire person turning crazy.
Dragon Mountain Emperor just sneered in response. He soon turned around and entered the cavern dwelling to discuss this matter with other Deities from the Xia Clan.
A fragrant aroma permeated Xue Ying's cultivation room. The roof of the house was octagonal, with eight mystical violet wooden columns acting as supporting pillars. These violet pillars would continually emit mystical undulations which then dispersed throughout the cultivation room, helping anyone inside to empty their heart.
Xue Ying was sitting cross-legged in the center as he began the transformation of his inner world.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 479 - Prisoner (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 479: Prisoner (2)
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
A tiny man was currently sitting within Xue Ying's sea of consciousness. This tiny man was actually Xue Ying's soul, as well as his True Deity Heart!
At the moment, the tiny man had a very tender and cute appearance, but his aura was becoming stronger by the second. Around him, a huge illusory world was revolving around the tiny figure, becoming clearer and clearer. It seemed like every single action taken by man was now filled with boundless might.
The world is me; I am the world.
Transform.
Xue Ying's Deity sea had long since opened, having reached the limit of the Deity realm.
Now, under the action of Xue Ying's True Deity Heart, the mighty Deity sea began to change. The scene seemed similar to the Creation of Heaven and Earth, down to the emergence of Myriad Existences. The land began expanding; mountains were raised, followed by valleys forming and the vegetation on the plains growing. With the huge amount of treasures provided by his teacher, as well as more than a hundred million Deity crystals, Xue Ying could rapidly absorb the energy required to catalyze the transformation of his inner world.
The inner world continuously expanded until it became a billion kilometers in area.
It was so incredible in size, in fact, that without the exorbitant amount of Deity crystals, it would have taken Xue Ying a horrendous amount of time to cultivate and absorb the World energy required.
Hong long long~ Deep beneath this vast land, the strength of the surging, fiery-red Deity energy was exploding. The World Deity energy was becoming purer and purer, and it now contained the Profound Mysteries pertaining to World and Chaos Hole.
At the same time, Xue Ying's fleshy body was rapidly transforming.
His Time Immemorial Body first reached the fourth level with great ease, while the Great Chaotic True Force made the jump to the third level unhindered.
Of course, both the fifth level of the"Time Immemorial Body" and the fourth level of the"Great Chaotic True Force" were now available for Xue Ying to cultivate at his current realm. He only had to spend a little more time pondering them.
I should leave closed-doors cultivation first. Xue Ying wasn't willing to spend any more time in this cultivation session because he estimated that the blood-refined Deity warrior his teacher had personally refined for him was already finished! On top of that, he first wanted to witness the combat power of that prisoner, so that he could prepare himself better for the fight! As for secret techniques, he had the World Deity ranked secret techniques he learned in Crimson Rock Mountain, as well as the two from the Sealed World Pagoda, but comprehending any more would take much longer. Understanding the combat strength of his opponent would instead allow him to plan out a good method to deal with him.
Ka ka ka.
The door to the cultivation room opened, and Xue Ying left. Once outside, he saw a female attendant standing right next to him.
"Your Highness," the attendant respectfully greeted while simultaneously transmitting a message over to Jing Qiu. "Madam, madam. His Highness has just come out."
The light-blue-robed figure of Jing Qiu appeared right outside the room, and she giggled. "You weren't in closed-doors cultivation for quite so long this time around. Right, this is the blood-refined Deity warrior His Majesty has sent someone to hand it to you. Hurry up and take it. The power of this spear is a bit too much." With those words, she took out a scarlet-red spear. It was faintly releasing a terrifyingly high temperature, which caused even space itself to distort. Jing Qiu did not dare to touch it directly, yet Xue Ying felt like love coming from his inner heart for this spear, and his True Deity Heart even formed a resonance with it.
"Come," Xue Ying beckoned, and with a sou sound, the scarlet-red spear flew over.
"Oh, wow." Xue Ying grabbed hold of the spear, and his eyes brightened. "I didn't even dare think this spear would be an upper grade World Deity rank weapon from the very moment teacher finished refining it."
Most blood-refined Deity warriors that World Deities possessed had started out as low-grade World Deity rank weapons after their refinement. Normally, they would have to be taken care of and groomed by the user himself to reach the upper grade.
However, the Bloodshed God Emperor's methods were extraordinary indeed. A blood-refined Deity warrior of the upper grade World Deity rank was that much more expensive than a top-grade World Deity treasure, due to its ability to increase in strength over time!
"From now on, you'll be accompanying me in my battles against World Deities." Xue Ying chuckled. It only took a thought from his part for the scarlet-red spear in his hand to disappear, having entered his inner world. At the moment, deep beneath the vast land of his inner world, there were countless strands of fiery-red World Deity energy revolving about, and amongst them the spear, floating and absorbing Xue Ying's energy.
******
That same day, Xue Ying left Crimson Stone Courtyard alone to walk along the mountain range.
Over there. Upon activating the token he was holding, he immediately sensed it directing him toward a certain direction.
Sou!
Turning into a stream of particles, he rushed right over to the target destination.
By going right through the mountains, he could reach incredible speeds. He would at times penetrate through space itself, continuously closing in on his destination. Finally, a ripple formed from an array in front of him with a 'weng' sound.
At that point, Xue Ying stopped still and went no further.
Hua!
A new Xue Ying dressed in starry-blue robes appeared by his side. It must be stated that, considering his current level in the World Deity Heart, Xue Ying could easily form eight separate world bodies. Seeing how the prisoner's combat power was unknown, this visit was nothing more than a way for him to get a feel of how high the other party's combat strength was. It only made sense that he would not risk his true body for the sake of surveillance.
The starry-blue-robed Xue Ying took hold of the token and easily passed through the array ripple.
"Mn?" Xue Ying's expression changed ever so slightly. What stood before him was now a dark scene, as well as a figure sitting cross-legged right in the middle of that darkness. He was bound down by two separate shackles.
According to the probind done by the token, this is the right location! I've been told of a single prisoner at the location. Xue Ying looked at the figure in the center. He should be the one I have to kill.
"So, you've finally come to kill me?" The figure said in a deep tone. He raised his head, on which two sharp horns could now be seen to protrude from his head. His entire body was covered by black scales, and his hands had claws as sharp as blades. His scarlet eyes showed cold killing intent.
A race from the Dark Abyss? Xue Ying instantly deduced. He understood the man to be a life-form from the Dark Abyss, and one who could become a World Deity at that. If using the stages of power from the Dark Abyss, the man was at the level of a Great Demonic God!
"Mn? It's just you? A puny stage two World Deity like you has come to kill me?" The Great Demonic God's scarlet eyes bore into Xue Ying as he sneered. "What a joke."
"Joke, you say? There's no way to know before I try," Xue Ying retorted.
"Scram!"
The Great Demonic God let out a fierce roar.
轰~~~~
Hong~
The terrifying sound waves spread out in all directions from the central position of the Great Demonic God, overwhelming the entire region within mere moments. The dark region now seemed much like the surface of a lake, upon which ripples spread outwards without stop; under the might of these ripples, the starry-blue-robed Xue Ying's figure began distorting, much like an image on such a lake. He quickly turned around, throwing the token out of the region just as his entire body started to shatter.
The Great Demonic God sneered coldly at the sight of this before once again closing his eyes, going back to sitting cross-legged in silence.
Outside the array ripple, Xue Ying was dumbstruck. He had already guessed prior to entering that the prisoner would be very powerful, which was why he decided show some vigilance by only sending a world body inside! He did not think, however, that a single roar would be enough to shatter that world body. He had fortunately been fast enough to react, or that token might have been forever lost inside.
Sou. Xue Ying waved his hand and once again grabbed the token.
Such combat power?…isn't it too much? He's a stage three World Deity without a doubt! In fact, he's likely one of the more powerful stage three World Deities at that. Even with him being locked and shackled, it will still prove very difficult to actually kill. Xue Ying was speechless. What plan does teacher have for me? Is he trying to keep me from learning the absolute art until I become a stage three World Deity?
**

chapters.title: Chapter 480 - Presumptuos
chapters.content:
Chapter 480: Presumptuos
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Looking at the formation array in front of him ripple, Xue Ying's expression became somewhat solemn. "If I'm to kill this prisoner, I'll have to pull out all the stops."
He turned around and, with a sou, quickly departed.
Back in the Xia Clan World, in a still room within Crimson Rock Mountain.
A white-clothed Xue Ying was sitting cross-legged. He softly muttered to himself, "I've got to increase the time acceleration to a hundred times. At that speed, I might not be able to comprehend the Laws of the World, but I can still study secret techniques and secret skills without issue." The time within that room immediately accelerated, and although the Laws of the World began to feel somewhat distorted, they remained within tolerable margins. Any environment with faster acceleration would not be suitable for cultivation.
"I've got to raise my strength as high as it can go!"
Under the hundredfold increase in time acceleration, the white-clothed Xue Ying began to calm his heart and focus all his effort on comprehension and pondering. He first turned to the "Time Immemorial Body" and the "Great Chaotic True Force", since they were relatively easier to improve in a short time. He would then place his attention on the Sealed World Pagoda techniques to create secret skills, which was quite harder to accomplish. Even so, unless he improved significantly in every aspect, he would never reach the necessary confidence to kill the prisoner.
******
The plain and unadorned Xue Ying flew back from the mountain range and walked into Crimson Stone Courtyard through the back door.
"Senior Disciple Dong Bo."
"Greetings to Senior Disciple Dong Bo."
There, he found a crowd of inner disciples and honorary disciples who had come to greet him. Most were stage one or two World Deities, and they were headed by three different stage three World Deities! Even those three group leaders, as stage three World Deities, would still refer to Xue Ying respectfully as 'Senior Disciple.' They were very clear that, seeing how he only cultivated for five thousand years to become a stage two World Deity, Xue Ying would soon catch up to them and even surpass them.
Furthermore, the personal disciples of His Majesty were known to have grasped absolute arts, so they could not be looked at as ordinary World Deities.
"Why is everyone over here?" Xue Ying spoke.
"Senior Disciple, upon hearing that you've become a personal disciple, we junior disciples naturally had to come over and congratulate you," a slim man in golden robes smiled. "We've prepared a banquet, and Senior Disciple's relatives and friends have already taken their seats."
The other disciples were also cordially talking amongst themselves.
However, there were also a few people in this group who were feeling silently regretful. I didn't think Dong Bo would so unexpectedly become this formidable, this fast. An exceptional Transcendent like him who is one of the top talents throughout the entire history of the Deity world will have boundless prospects for his future. We've been acting cold toward him in the past, so there's always the chance he might hold a grudge.
Xue Ying nodded at once. "Lead the way."
A while ago, he was forced to endure silently and not expose his strength as some of his fellow disciples were talking behind his back and acting coldly toward him. Xue Ying had taken note of who had been good to him, so he naturally chose to become close to them! He didn't care much about the grudges, however, since of his fellow disciples, it was only Gong Feng who had berated and cursed him several times in the past. The rest of the disciples had been much more tame.
Within the Palace Hall.
Escorted by a crowd of fellow disciples, Xue Ying naturally sat at the seat of honor. To his side was his wife, Jing Qiu.
Once the two took their seats, the rest of the disciples also took their seats one by one.
"Senior Disciple."
"Senior Disciple Dong Bo."
A large group of disciples rushed in from outside the palace, each of them greeting him as they entered. This group was headed by Gong Feng. She was full of smiles as she said, "Senior Disciple Dong Bo, we'd been waiting at the front door all this time, but we didn't even consider that you would come in through the back door, missing us in the process. We are all truly ashamed for having been unable to properly greet Senior Disciple." A few of the at her side were muttering to themselves as they listened to her speak.
Such a scene of Gong Feng flattering and fawning over someone in this manner was truly a rare sight!
"You all can take your seats," Xue Ying said.
"We thank Senior Disciple." Each of these disciples found a seat for themselves.
"Senior Disciple Dong Bo is now a personal disciple, and you have high hopes to become a powerful existence in the future. This Junior Disciple of yours is less fortunate, so I can only give you a meager gift as a means of congratulation, Senior Disciple. Your Junior Disciple has incidentally received these two precious stones, and they have some wonderful uses in regards to the True Deity Heart." A stage two World Deity, from the ranks of the honorary disciples sitting in the back, stood up, and a plate appeared on his palm with two peculiar yellow stones placed atop it. He handed this plate over to a maid behind him, who took it and briskly walked over to Xue Ying's table.
Xue Ying raised an eyebrow.
These two lumps, known as Yellow Ocean Deity Stones, were worth five million Deity crystals! Such a gift was truly generous. He remembered that the honorary disciple he received them from was named World Deity Vast Benevolence.
"This Junior Disciple also has some meager gifts to offer." Some other honorary disciples quickly followed up with more presents.
If they thought their presents valuable enough, they would usually follow up with a small introduction, but the strength of any honorary disciples was generally weak, especially when it came to the stage one World Deities. They were either unable or unwilling to hand over a valuable gift.
More and more gifts came in.
"Xue Ying, these gifts from your Junior Disciple Sisters and Brothers are all quite expensive," Jing Qiu transmitted with a smile. "With their status as your fellow disciples in addition to these valuable gifts they've given you just now, I'm afraid you won't be able to decline if they were to ever plead at your door for some small favors."
"If it's just small matters, I see no issue with giving my fellow disciples a hand. If they come with larger problems, I'd have to carefully consider it," Xue Ying sent back.
These fellow disciples estimated that, considering Xue Ying's cultivation speed, he would likely become a stage four World Deity within a million years! In the eyes of a World Deity, such an amount of time wasn't even worth mentioning. On top of that, as a stage four World Deity and a personal disciple of His Majesty, with the heaven-defying strength of an absolute art and his status as a Realm Lord, Xue Ying's status would definitely surpass even those of people like Monarch Mo Xue, the Calm Sea Prefecture Lord, and many more.
This was the time for these disciples to grasp the opportunity by giving some gifts to create a friendly relationship with such an overlord, since in the future, Xue Ying wouldn't even look upon such meager gifts.
More gifts came in, one after another. After the honorary disciples finished with their gifts, the inner disciples stepped in. First were the stage two World Deities, followed by the stage three World Deities.
Gong Feng waited until the very end, when she finally got up with a smile and even displayed some feminine qualities that she usually kept hidden. She even kept her posture lowered. "Senior Disciple Dong Bo, this Junior Disciple has also prepared some gifts." As she said that, a long plate appeared on her left hand, upon which no fewer than five treasures were arranged.
"This is a treasure originating from the Moon World, a Cold Star Rock." Gong Feng began to summarily describe this truly uncommon treasure which had come directly from the Moon World. "This is a demon heart from the Dark Abyss. It was left behind by a Demon Monarch after his death. This is…"
They were just five treasures, but their summed up value was close to a hundred million Deity crystals!
The total value of all the previous gifts from the other disciples was only roughly equivalent to a single gift of hers! She could only do so because of her high position, which meant that the amount of treasures she accumulated over many years was large enough. On top of that, she truly was that scared of being chased out of Crimson Stone Courtyard.
Hua.
Without warning, a black-robed old man walked in from outside the palace, followed closely behind by two stage three World Deity guards.
As soon as the old man entered, he coldly said, "Gong Feng, as per His Majesty orders, from this day forward, you will no longer serve as the overseer of Crimson Stone Courtyard."
"Ah." Gong Feng fell into a daze.
Without her status as supervisor, she would no longer have any opportunity to meet the Bloodshed God Emperor, so her status would be about the same as that of the other inner disciples.
"It's you!" Gong Feng turned abruptly to look at Xue Ying, her complexion warped and somewhat sinister. "Dong Bo Xue Ying, you've complained before master, did you not?"
Xue Ying frowned.
"What, did I really offend you that badly? To think you would actually be this ruthless. It was you who was hiding your strength. If you had shown your talent from the start, would I have acted that way toward you?" Gong Feng was unmistakably angry. She forgot, however, that if Xue Ying had publicly exposed his strength, he would surely have been killed in a thought by Sacred Master Crimson Dust's enemy, Forefather Black Devil. Could she have paid for his life then?
"So what if you're a personal disciple? For better or worse, I'm still a stage three World Deity, and I have a fourth step entry rank in the Bloodshed God Palace." Gong Feng flipped her hand, and the plate she was holding disappeared. "You're not qualified to receive my treasures."
Indeed, Gong Feng's status within the Bloodshed God Palace was still rather high. Even stage four World Deities would not be qualified to just kill her as they wished, and Xue Ying had no way to deal with her either.
After all, he had received gifts from everyone due to their anticipation that he would become an overlord of the Deity world in not too long a time, not from recognition of his current strength.
"What you said isn't wrong."
Xue Ying looked down toward the unbridled Gong Feng from atop his seat of honor and nodded. "I was, indeed, the one who asked teacher to strip you of your position as overseer."
"So it was you! Of course it was!" Her expression turned malevolent.
"With how insolently you've been acting, it can be said that you've offended me, doesn't it?" Xue Ying coldly said.
Gong Feng froze.
From nearby, the black-robed old man nodded. "Any inner disciple who offends a personal disciple will be punished severely."
His teacher's sect only had three positions: personal, inner, and honorary disciples. These positions, however, were extremely rigid and enforced.
"Just give her a hundred lashes of the whip," Xue Ying coldly said.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 481 - Blood Sea Demon Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 481: Blood Sea Demon Body
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Within the hall were a total of four World Deity guards who went forward to surround Gong Feng, including the black-robed old man and his subordinates. All of them were stage three World Deities.
Crimson Stone Courtyard was relatively unique, and the stage three World Deity guards here were more formidable than normal.
"You, you dare…" Gong Feng couldn't believe her current situation.
"Take her out," Xue Ying coldly ordered. By this point, he no longer cared about Gong Feng. His nature was such that he disliked dealing with such meager matters, but with such a person jumping right in front of him, there was no way he would show mercy.
"Let's go. World Deity Gong Feng, do you perhaps plan to resist?" The four surrounding World Deity guards looked at her.
Gong Feng glared at Xue Ying. Her eyes betrayed her unbridled fury, but she did not dare to resist arrest.
Those hundred whips…every last one would hurt down to her soul!
Xue Ying did not treat this conflict with Gong Feng as a major matter. He was focused mostly on his current combat power and obtaining that absolute art which even powerful existences desired! It was his fortune to have become a personal disciple of the Bloodshed God Emperor, giving him the chance to learn an absolute art. Without such an opportunity, it would be too difficult to acquire such a technique.
The way he saw it, it was only those with great combat power that truly had stable influence. Gong Feng, for instance, depended on her position to gain power, but such a status could disappear like the wind if someone even higher than her wished it!
Naturally, there were also many World Deities who could no longer improve their combat power. It was such people who saw aiming for higher official positions as a good method to increase their influence.
******
Xue Ying's true body and avatar were located at Crimson Rock Mountain and Crimson Stone Courtyard respectively, both immersed in cultivation. His true body and avatar were cultivating in a hundred-times accelerated environment, doing their best to improve.
The Time Immemorial Body was easily raised to the fifth level, which brought about a qualitative change in his survival capabilities! Now, his body would certainly not crumble apart from just the sound waves emitted by the prisoner's roar.
The Great Chaotic True Force also reached the fourth level with relative ease, causing his strength to explosively increase.
Of the two secret techniques he learned in the Sealed World Pagoda, one he termed World Shackles, or the Shackle Technique. The other he called the Herculean Technique. The latter was quite similar to his World Deity ranked secret technique, the "Great Chaotic True Force", but it used the Chaotic Deity Heart as a foundation. In terms of how profound it was, however, it greatly surpassed the Great Chaotic True Force!
This Herculean Technique from the Sealed World Pagoda belonged to the same category as the Great Chaotic True Force, but it was simply stronger! By this point, he could very well give up in training the "Great Chaotic True Force" altogether!
Hua hua hua~
In the sky above the vast land of Xue Ying's inner world, there was a huge cloud formed from the water droplets of the Great Chaotic True Force. The cloud had begun to gradually shrink after Xue Ying decided to give up on the technique, but there was now a different cloud beside it, even bigger in side. This new cloud surged with power from the countless black snakes slithering within. This was the Xue Ying's new Herculean Technique.
The two techniques were very similar in the way that both transformed World Deity energy into water droplets, yet the Herculean Technique's water droplet were made up of many flowing jets of water which, in an exquisite manner, formed into black snakes that looked like black whips. This form made it possible to exhibit more might—the Herculean technique was a few times stronger than the Great Chaotic True Force at the fourth level.
If I use this Herculean Technique, I should be strong enough to threaten the prisoner's life, Xue Ying thought. I will still have to improve my usage of the Laws of Profound Mysteries, though, and must also create more powerful secret skills.
He first focused on the domain-related secret skill which used the Shackle Technique to form a World Prison.
Of course, this secret skill had also improved after he became a stage two World Deity.
Within his cultivation room in Crimson Stone Courtyard, the black-robed Xue Ying was in a sitting position as countless thin black shackles surrounded him. They enveloped the entire cultivation room, continuously moving and attacking in certain specified direction. They would first stack up and then immediately rush over to restricting the specified location. Xue Ying, as a personal disciple of the Bloodshed God Emperor, had naturally received a cultivation room able to accelerate time a hundredfold, to an even better quality than the cultivation room within Crimson Rock Mountain.
This time's cultivation session lasted for a total of three thousand years. Naturally, when taking the time-accelerated environment into account, only thirty years had passed in the external world.
Hu.
Dressed in ordinary black robes and wearing a calm expression, Xue Ying flew along the mountain range next to Crimson Stone Courtyard. After this closed-door cultivation session that lasted for three thousand years, his secret skills and secret techniques had all reached the very peak they could arrive to in a short period of time. Any attempt to improve further would most likely be fruitless.
I've cultivated for a total of three thousand years, during which I've brought my use of the Laws of Profound Mysteries to a new high. Furthermore, through the fusion of the two secret techniques from the Sealed World Pagoda, I might see some hope. Xue Ying soon arrived to the location of the array ripple, and a flash of killing intent appeared in his eyes. He would try his best to succeed this time around!
He grabbed the token and immediately passed through the ripple.
Inside, he was met with the same dark area from before, and no life forms other than the prisoner with his arms bound by shackles. At the moment, the prisoner was sitting cross-legged with his head lowered, after which he slowly raised his head to look at Xue Ying. His face was covered in black scales, and his pair of red eyes betrayed his suppressed fury.
"You again?" the prisoner said in a low voice before roaring ruthlessly. "Scram for me!"
Just like before, the terrifying sound waves exploded out in every direction, just like ripples forming on the surface of a lake. Xue Ying couldn't escape the effect of these waves, and his figure could be seen rippling along under their impact. However, countless black shackles then began forming around Xue Ying, spreading out rapidly to cover the entire dark area.
These black shackles showed incredible toughness, seeing how the sound waves of the roar were unable to destroy them. After being enveloped by the countless shackles, the sound waves quickly decreased in power, and what force finally reached Xue Ying's fifth level Time Immemorial Body was negligible.
Forget these waves that already had their power reduced, Xue Ying's body would not have been destroyed even under normal circumstances!
"Isn't this getting interesting?" The Great Demonic God looked up and swept his gaze across his surroundings.
Dang dang dang~
The countless thin and long shackles were present in such dense amounts that they actually filled every last corner. Occasionally, they would clash with one another, sending out metallic ringing sounds. Despite having surrounded the figure of that Great Demonic God, the shackles did not seem to attempt to bind him.
"Brat, you are truly here to kill me?" The Great Demonic God sneered. "I've been tortured here, in the Deity world, for so many years; I've long since grown tired of it. In fact, I've also been looking forward to my eventual death. But it was you, a tiny stage two World Deity, who they sent out to do the job? Isn't that too much of a joke?"
"I am here to kill you." Xue Ying nodded. "But I am also quite curious as to why a Great Demonic God of the Dark Abyss would be kept as a prisoner here."
"Hmph. I've nothing to fear by telling you this." The Great Demonic God chuckled. "It's the Deity world's own damn fault for being so pleasant. There are countless forms of life who carry out peaceful lives throughout the many planets here, but the Blood Sea Demon Body I cultivate requires me to the slaughter innumerable living beings. Back in the Dark Abyss, every last area is under the control of a territory lord, and every region of the world also has its sovereign! I thus decided to switch worlds and enter the Deity world. Hehehe, with how vast the Deity world is, as long as I casually hid my location, it wouldn't be so easy to find me… I killed and killed, carrying out a delightful massacre. I've consumed blood, flesh, and soul beyond measure, even my blood sea began began to take shape. My only regret is that, right as I was planning to go back, a stage four World Deity discovered me. Such misfortune… I had dared to barge into the Deity world, however, so I'd long since made my preparations. But not for a moment did I consider that those powerful existences would actually act in person to destroy my true body and hold this avatar of mine behind as a prisoner. Did I not just take some lives on a few planets? What worth were those life to the entire Deity world?
"What do you think, brat? Are you furious? Come now, take what action you will." The Great Demonic God sneered. He no longer had such matters like life and death in mind. He was well aware that, as a prisoner in this place, he would definitely die in the end.
Xue Ying looked at him coldly but couldn't be bothered to respond.
Hua hua hua…
Many figures of Xue Ying wearing starry-blue robes began forming all around the dark region. There were nine total world bodies, and ten figures in total when including his true body! Xue Ying's high attainments in the aspect of World now allowed him to condense the maximum number of world bodies possible: nine bodies.
The ten figures scattered in different directions, all of them holding onto spears as they stared at the Great Demonic God who was sitting cross-legged in the center.
"Kill!" the black-robed Xue Ying said.
Hua hua hua~ The countless black shackles, which had previously been moving around by the sides of the Great Demonic God, began stacking up on top of him. Added up, they created a restrictive force that was incomparably mystical, which completely enveloped the prisoner in a tight embrace. The nine world bodies immediately followed up with attacks.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 482 - Going All Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 482: Going All Out
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The Great Demonic God Prisoner was sitting motionless with a big sneer plastered on his face. He did nothing to stop the countless black shackles from twisting and binding him.
Spear after spear attack struck at him from every direction, passing through the minute chinks left deliberately by the black chains. The starry-blue-robed Xue Yings all employed the Herculean Technique to its fullest, the power inside each body violently rolling and surging as the speartips landed onto the Great Demonic God's body. Chi~ Upon coming into contact with the black scaly surface of the body, sparks sprang off everyone, and the furious attack didn't leave behind anything more than some white marks.
What? Xue Ying's heart was shaken. He had upgraded his strength in every aspect he could, especially in regards to the two Sealed World Pagoda secret techniques. He had even concluded that, of all the stage two World Deities, he would certainly be at the very top. Even so, he found himself unable to even break through the prisoner's scales. Master, oh Master. This prisoner you've picked might be a little too formidable.
The Great Demonic God was still in his cross-legged position, disinclined to move a muscle.
He finally opened his eyelids, his scarlet eyes penetrating the black chains to clearly see the faraway Xue Ying in his unadorned black robes. He said in a low tone, "Boy, if this all the power you've got, I suggest you don't waste your strength."
"Is that so?" Xue Ying suddenly grasped hold of a scarlet-red spear, which he sent into a whirling motion streaking across the sky. He sent a profoundly might thrust toward the Great Demonic God.
This scarlet spear was precisely the blood-refined Deity warrior refined by the Bloodshed God Emperor, which Xue Ying named Scarlet Cloud as a way to commemorate the Scarlet Cloud Mountain World from back in the Xia Clan world, as well as a few of his close friends he met there. It was also a way to remind himself that, even as his status became higher and higher, he should never forget his original heart.
The Scarlet Cloud Spear's might was quick and violent, having disappeared without a trace as soon as it zoomed across the dark area and neared the Great Demonic God.
Pu!
When the spear finally reappeared, it had already breached the Great Demonic God's body.
Such an attack wasn't exactly Extreme Penetration, but rather a use of the Laws of Profound Mysteries. It was an application of becoming one with the realm—omnipresent.
"Hahaha…" The Great Demonic God laughed out loud and suddenly exerted force from both his arms. Peng, peng, peng. The countless chains shattered without resistance. The prisoner then turned to look at the distant black-clothed Xue Ying with a laugh. His abdomen had just been stabbed by the Scarlet Cloud Spear, but a terrifying strength quickly pushed it outward. Xue Ying failed to suppress this force even after putting in all of his effort, so the spear popped out of wound, which speedily healed. Before long, there wasn't even the slightest trace of an injury remaining.
"Boy, I've cultivated a Blood Sea Demon Body to a realm that, while I might not see as satisfactory, is an extremely high level nonetheless." The Great Demonic God sneered. "Due to this Blood Sea Demon Body, my body gains the characteristics of a mass of blood. It makes no difference whether you strike my scales or the insides of my body. Had I not been imprisoned here, incapable of struggling free, I would have long since slapped you to death with ease. You simply cannot harm me, so you'd better just get out and stop coming here to bother me.
Xue Ying's expression was grave.
He could tell that, although he struck the insides of the Great Demonic God's body, even piercing an internal organ in the process, he had not managed to crush even a single particle! In other words, seeing how not even a particle disintegrated, it meant that the prisoner hadn't spent an ounce of his energy so far! Anyone who cultivated an undying body would see that, as long as their particles were not shattered, they were simply invincible. It was only when the particles that made up their bodies were crushed, forcing them to consume energy to heal, that that hope of killing them appeared.
"You have a Blood Sea Demonic Body, huh? You say there's no difference between striking your scales and piercing your body?" Xue Ying softly nodded. "Perfect. I'll just strike your scales then!"
Hua.
In a flash, the spear had turned into a revolving scarlet vortex, and a faint scene of the world collapsing and shattering appeared all around it. This was Xue Ying's secret skill with the strongest penetrative nature. The Great Demonic God's arms were bound by shackles, and he was simply standing there with a cold demeanour. He did not even attempt to block, instead just letting the scarlet vortex change into a point and directly stab into his stomach.
Pu~~~The scales on his stomach were shattered apart in an instant, exposing the flesh behind them. It was only after the spear pierced into the flesh that it stopped, with purple blood flowing from the wound.
"You're able to wound me?" The Great Demonic God's expression turned into one of shock. The wound he had been inflicted wasn't major, but the flesh protected by those scales had still been completely shattered at the particle level, which forced him to consume some energy. Under normal circumstances, he would naturally not have been afraid of such injuries, but now that he was imprisoned with the World Deity energy inside his body being sealed, he was unable to exert even a strand of energy. Even his True Deity Heart had been suppressed, making him unable to mobilize a domain. The only method of fighting he had was to use his body in close combat.
Any energy that he consumed had to be replenished using the vitality of his Blood Sea Demonic Body. Although the amount of vitality he possessed was unfathomable, if he was forced to continuously use it up, eventually there would be nothing left.
"I actually thought I wouldn't be able to wound you, but it turns out you aren't that strong." A severe light flashed through Xue Ying's eyes. "Die."
Sou sou sou.
Nine Xue Yings in starry-blue robes immediately rushed forward, and countless black chains appeared all around the dark domain, twisting and binding the Great Demonic God's movements.
"Leave." The prisoner was no longer so carefree as to block the incoming attacks using his body. With a wave of his hand, the countless black chains that were enveloping him all shattered at once.
Peng, peng, peng, peng, peng, peng, peng… The nine world bodies simultaneously brandished their spears, displaying Xue Ying;s most powerful secret skill. As the spears moved, it seemed like a vast and mighty world was about to crash. A mere world body attacking by itself wouldn't mean much, but with no less than nine simultaneously using this sort of killer move, their combined might was sufficient to match the power of a stage three World Deity.
Peng!
With the two shackles binding him, the Great Demonic God was simply unable to dodge, with the range could move in being a very small circle of ten or so meters, as allowed by the chains.
Nine spears furiously whipped at his body from the same direction.
Upon receiving the attacks, the Great Demonic God's feet left the ground, and after being knocked backward for just seven or eight meters, he was tugged to a stop in mid-air by the shackles.
Pu. The black-clothed Xue Ying seized this chance to strike, his Scarlet Cloud Spear once more carrying the might of a world's collapse and shattering.
"Damn it." The Great Demonic God made a furious attempt to resist, using all of his might.
"Stop struggling. It's useless," Xue Ying's voice rang out, and the nine world bodies once more launched wild attacks while sending the countless black chains to restrict him once more. The weapons used by the world bodies were ultimately inferior to the sharpness and might of the Scarlet Cloud Spear, but when they moulded their power into a crushing force, the disparity no longer seemed as large. One spear furiously whipped out, leaving the Great Demonic God in an unsteady position. It was difficult, after all, to guard against nine spears using only two hands! Furthermore, there were countless chains restricting him.
The nine world bodies continued to disturb the prisoner and interfere with his movements as to create opportunities for the true body which held the Scarlet Cloud Spear. The weapon was pacing back and forth, again and again grasping the opportunities created to launch frenzied attacks onto the Great Demonic God's body, which was accruing more and more injuries as time passed.
"Ah ah ah…" The Great Demonic God was incomparably furious. Having cultivated the Blood Sea Demon Body to some extent, he stood at the very pinnacle amongst stage three World Deities, but due to the suppression and seal on his True Deity Heart and his World Deity energy, as well as the shackles that bound him, he was actually being bullied by a stage two World Deity youngster.
"You're forcing my hand. Come then." The maddened Great Demonic God got up, and a number of arms began to grow out of his underarms.
After the transformation, he now had eight total arms.
Still standing in his original place and waving his eight arms, the Great Demonic God was now easily blocking all nine incoming spears. Although he was still unable to mobilize World Deity energy and was forced to rely purely on the strength of his demonic body, the speed at which he could wave his arms was very fast nonetheless.
At that point, it no longer mattered how Xue Ying tried to attack; even when he used the Scarlet Cloud Spear, the Great Demonic God would still easily defend himself. He was also no longer dim-wittedly meeting the strikes head-on, instead relying on the Laws and Profound Mysteries to delicately block each move.
Xue Ying was now going all out while trying to think of a solution.
However, the defensive might of the Great Demonic God who had expended his vitality to grow six more arms was now watertight; regardless of what move Xue Ying employed, he was incapable of stirring him. As for the World Prison Shackles—they would certainly be very dangerous to any stage two World Deity. Any such people who witnessed this technique would flee with pale faces, but prisoner could shake free from the chains with a single strike.
What do I do now? What other methods do I have? Xue Ying inwardly muttered.

chapters.title: Chapter 483 - Grinding
chapters.content:
Chapter 483: Grinding
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Peng peng peng!
The Great Demonic God's eight arms casually blocked the attacks sent by the the nine world bodies; he was using his hands to deflect them! After all, the nine world bodies did not carry blood-refined Deity warriors and were entirely unable to injure the Great Demonic God, making it so that the prisoner only had to focus on blocking the Scarlet Cloud Spear.
At that point, Xue Ying could no longer cause injury to the Great Demonic God, regardless of how he attacked.
"You can't use World Deity energy, and forming six extra arms will have definitely consumed much of your lifeforce." Xue Ying stopped.
"That is indeed the case." The Great Demonic God stared at Xue Ying, his scarlet-red eyes filled with fury. "I'm locked here, and I have no way to replenish my energy, which is why I have to be smart about every single strand of lifeforce I use. It's you who forced me, forced me into this state! However, while forming these six arms has consumed much of my lifeforce, I can still maintain this state with only a minimal amount of my lifeforce usage, and my Blood Sea Demon Body can easily last for a hundred million years more."
Xue Ying turned silent.
He knew the Great Demonic God's words to be true. The Great Demonic God could not absorb energy from the external world, yet his powerful body could still survive for a long period of time, precisely because Xue Ying himself was just a stage two World Deity! If using lifeforce to merely maintaining those six arms, the prisoner could easily another hundred million years.
By the time a hundred million years passed, Xue Ying would have long since become a stage four World Deity.
"Hmph." The black-robed Xue Ying turned around and left through the undulating array ripple. The nine world bodies quickly disappeared like bubbles popping, followed by the countless black shackles dissipating into nothingness.
The Great Demonic God's eyes brimmed with fury as he watched Xue Ying leave.
During the first visit, he did not think much about this matter. This time, however, he had been forced to form six extra arms, all of them with bones and muscles, and covered in scales. They were ultimately arms formed according to the Blood Sea Demon Body, and were all truly strong, but that also meant that they consumed an extra large amount of his energy! Forming those six arms consumed close to half of all the energy stored within his body! At the moment, he was maintaining those arms formed, since if he were to create them again next time, he would have to use a large amount of his energy again.
He was convinced that this stage two World Deity would not give up so easily.
******
Back in the Bloodshed God Palace, within the hidden underground palace, the enormous Cosmos Furnace was burning with a blazing hot flame, as always. The Bloodshed God Emperor was still sitting cross-legged in front of it, observing the behavior of the flames within the furnace. To achieve strong combat power, one would require great patience, and the Bloodshed God Emperor clearly understood how difficult it would be to take that final last step. In fact, it was even harder for him to take this single step…than for a stage four World Deity to become a powerful existence.
Even so, as soon as he stepped through, the Bloodshed God Emperor would be indubitably become an unparalleled expert, undoubtedly standing above the three rulers from the Dark Abyss, the Temporal Island Lord, and other such experts.
At the same time, he was clear that each and every one of these existences all sought to take that single step.
"Bloodshed, Bloodshed, that Dong Bo brat finished cultivating the two secret techniques from the Sealed World Pagoda and went to fight the prisoner again," the black bird said. "He was on the verge of success when the prisoner formed six arms, and he's now using a total of eight arms to defend himself. Dong Bo no longer has a way to reach him. You, his teacher, are truly too ruthless. Do you really want to see him become a stage three World Deity before he learns the absolute art?"
"I'll have to force him a little. All talented figures are, by nature, arrogant and proud. It's that pride of his that must be suppressed and ground down," the Bloodshed God Emperor replied indifferently.
He was aware that Xue Ying, his disciple, had a good temperament, but the Bloodshed God Emperor was also clear that all those who had hopes of becoming powerful existences in the future would hold some form of pride in their hearts. It was up to him to polish and grind that pride and arrogance.
The Bloodshed God Emperor himself, for instance, was trying to grasp hold of an even higher form of power like what the Cosmos Furnace contained, yet he had failed time after time. He was prepared to spend billions and billions of years in failure! To spend billions upon billions of years without being proud or frustrated, how much patience would one need? The very moment he became frustrated, his heart would no longer be stable, and he could no longer continue his comprehension.
Being forced by his teacher into this situation, Xue Ying left the mountain range to go back to Crimson Stone Courtyard. He was showing some slight signs of distress.
"Senior Disciple Brother."
"Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo."
As we passed, most of the inner disciples he encountered treated him politely.
Xue Ying would respond every time with a smile, and before long, he had arrived back at his cavern dwelling.
Teacher arranged this encounter as a trial for me. If I were to succeed too easily, there would not be much meaning in even going through this. Xue Ying soon calmed down his complex feelings. As for the fight against the prisoner, I could have easily killed him by forcing him to consume all his energy, if he had not formed the six arms. Now that he entered that eight-armed from, I'll have to get stronger if I'm to defeat him! And it's not my true body alone that must be stronger; my world bodies must also improve their strength. Each body must pose some threat to the Great Demonic God as well.
If his true body was the only one to become stronger, the prisoner would be able to block against his attacks just by relying on his higher realm, but once all nine world bodies became able to injure him, it would no longer be such an easy task for the Great Demonic God to defend against him.
In order to increase the threat posed by the world bodies, I'll have to create a more formidable secret skill! Xue Ying thought.
He wasn't in any particular hurry for the moment, since his current combat power was already at the highest level he could bring it to within a short period of time. For him to become any stronger would take significantly more time.
This was why he decided to rather accompany his wife, Jing Qiu, for food and casual chatting.
"Xue Ying." Jing Qiu poured Xue Ying some wine as she brought up a certain topic of discussion. "Yu'er and Qing Yao are both Deities now. It's not like those two children of ours will spend the rest of their lives in Crimson Rock Mountain, right? They might be safe there, but they both have access to the avatar technique anyway! They can just follow on our footsteps in letting their avatars roam the Deity world. I think it would be best if you just let them move as they wish."
"Their combat power is still quite weak, though," Xue Ying retorted.
"Under the effect of those World Deity ranked secret techniques, they can now match up a peak stage Deity in might," Jing Qiu began. "They can no longer be considered weak! Is it not the case that you were already the lord of Snow Eagle Territory when you were just eight?"
Xue Ying laughed. Indeed, during their time in Crimson Rock Mountain, his children had underwent multiple life-or-death situations. Alas, Xue Ying had instructed the treasure spirit to protect them in the dark, but the children themselves were not aware that they were actually safe, which is why those situations could prove useful in tempering and allowing them to take charge of their lives.
"How about this—I'll do my best to deal with that prisoner from the mountain range," Xue Ying began. "Once I succeed, I will essentially have graduated from my teacher's tutelage! If I can accomplish that within a short period of time, I'll take Disciple Brother Ge Bai and Disciple Brother He Fei Yun out of the material world, and I'll take Yu'er and Qing Yao along at the same time. If I prove unable to make any breakthrough within a short period of time, I'll be sending them out ahead of time."
Jing Qiu nodded. She didn't try pushing it any further.
The main point of it all was that Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao were now both huge characters within Crimson Rock Mountain, and there was practically nobody left who could oppose them. Very few way for them to sharpen themselves remained inside.
"By the way, Jing Qiu, why is it that I see you cultivating so rarely?" Xue Ying asked. "Your talent is not bad, and I still wish I'll get to see you become a World Deity in the future."
Initially startled, Jing Qiu quickly recovered and replied, "What are you talking about? Is my true body back in the Crimson Rock Mountain not spending a lot of time in cultivation? Since my avatar is here, in the Deity world, I naturally have to experience the world! One body is cultivating in a time-accelerated environment, the other is out experiencing the world; one's tightening up the other loosening. That's a good way to go about it."
"You say that, but I don't think you're cultivating too much in Crimson Rock Mountain either." Xue Ying shook his head. "Jing Qiu, you can never be too lax in your cultivation. Anyone whose comprehension of the realm is too low will find it hard to keep themselves alive for long. Peak Deities usually only live for a hundred million years or so before they can no longer protect their True Deity Heart, resulting in its crumbling."
"I am aware." Jing Qiu giggled as her heart swelled with warm emotion. "I know you aren't willing to leave me."
Xue Ying nodded. He had also given her various spirit fruits and treasures; as the master of Crimson Rock Mountain, he wasn't lacking in the treasure department. He had, after all, inherited all of the treasures left behind by Sacred Master Crimson Dust. Yet even with those treasures, without sufficient diligence in cultivation, he would have never become a World Deity.
Within the cavern dwelling's cultivation room, a fragrance was diffusing in the air.
The black-robed Xue Ying was sitting in a cross-legged position, and countless seals were floating right in front of him, their positions superimposing before they finally merged into a pitch-black perfect sphere. This was the fundamental Deity imprint of the Shackle Technique. Naturally, this meant he had already reached the second level realm of the Shackle Technique. Both techniques from the Sealed World Pagode were split into six total levels, with stage one World Deities usually having a chance to reach the first level, while stage two World Deities could potentially reach the second level.
Xue Ying had long since trained the techniques to the highest level he could reach at his current realm.
Hua. Countless seals came together to form a black water droplet. This was the fundamental Deity imprint of the Herculean Technique.
Xue Ying looked at this minute black sphere and a black water droplet floating ahead of him.
The way these techniques employ the Laws of Profound Mysteries is truly unfathomable. Xue Ying sighed in praise.
The secret techniques he received from the Sealed World Pagoda were both incredibly exquisite.
While the"Great Chaotic True Force" was an impressive technique in its own right and had also been created with the same basic idea of using the Laws of Profound Mysteries to form water droplets, the Herculean Technique had more than double its strength! This was precisely because the utilization of the water droplets under this technique coming from the Sealed World Pagoda was much more formidable.
By observing these two secret techniques and comprehending their utilization of the Laws of Profound Mysteries, I might be able to extrapolate a secret skill of my own, Xue Ying thought to himself.
It was similar to how, back as a Transcendent, he had created the Chaotic Suppression secret skill based on Profound Mysteries of the Great Chaotic True Force.
In much the same way, he would now observe the Profound Mysteries of these new secret techniques, absorbing and derive knowledge before finally creating his own secret skill! This was a road many experts chose to walk, in spite of it being generally harder and requiring more time.
Slowly…
Xue Ying turned his focus to comprehending the Profound Mysteries behind the two secret techniques from the Sealed World Pagoda, deriving their knowledge in hope of creating a more formidable secret skill.
Back in Crimson Rock Mountain, the white-robed Xue Ying was cultivating in a similar manner.
Outside of these secret skill cultivation sessions, Xue Ying would occasionally come out and have a walk to relax, or focus on comprehending the Laws of the World to try and grasp his third grade one Deity Heart, the Extremity Deity Heart. In truth, comprehending one more grade one Deity Heart would be the most direct method to improve his combat power. In any case, comprehending the Laws of the World and creating a secret skill were mutually exclusive, since the creation of secret skill was done in a time-accelerated of a hundred times normal.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 484 - Third Attack on the Prisoner
chapters.content:
Chapter 484: Third Attack on the Prisoner
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
In the blink of an eye, a thousand years had already passed since Xue Ying became a personal disciple under the Bloodshed God Emperor. Various parts of the Deity world had long since received news that the Bloodshed God Emperor had taken another personal disciple, the brat called Dong Bo who participated in the previous Myriad Flower Feast. They were even aware that Xue Ying had become a stage two World Deity in just five thousand years, which assured his position as one of the most talented experts in the entire history of the Deity world and the Dark Abyss.
While the powerful existences were sighing about it and regretting not getting the chance to accept him as their own disciple beforehand, none of this had any influence on Xue Ying. He was, after all, still cultivating in the Bloodshed God Palace and had yet to graduate from his tutelage.
Sou.
The black-robed Xue Ying was currently flying through the sky along mountain range next to Crimson Stone Courtyard, approaching his destination. The wind was whistling by him, and his eyes were calm.
This was his third time heading toward the prisoner.
His first visit was back when he had just become a stage two World Deity. He had only gone there to probe the strength of the prisoner, yet his world body had still been shattered from a single shout from his opponent. He then returned after he refined his secret techniques and skills, but that second trip also led nowhere. This was the third time!
I've arrived. Xue Ying's speed decreased upon reaching the array ripple undulating ahead of him.
Passing through the ripple, he was now surrounded by a region of complete darkness, except for the prisoner who cultivated the Blood Sea Demon Body. He remained in his cross-legged position, his eight arms still out. Only two of his eight arms were kept bound, but these chains served to suppress the Great Demonic God's World Energy as well as his True Deity Heart so as to prevent him from escaping.
Beneath his two sharp horns, the prisoner's two scarlet eyes turned to stare at Xue Ying, the corners of his mouth stuck up in derision. "You've already come? That's faster than I expected. It's only been a thousand years, and you seem to still be a stage two World Deity. Tell me, what new techniques have you devised to deal with me?"
"You'll find out know enough," the black-robed Xue Ying coldly replied.
Hua hua hua~
Countless black shackles appeared around Xue Ying's body, rapidly multiplying and spreading in all directions to cover the dark region, yet the Great Demonic God did not seem to mind them. At the same time, the black shackles swimming around the Great Demonic God himself seemed like a single entity, binding and restricting his movements just like before.
"Mn?" He had brought forth all his strength in an attempt to struggle free from the shackle, only to find himself unable to resist the binding power, which left him in shock. How could the restricting ability of these shackles have increased so much? This single technique should already make him unparalleled amongst stage two World Deities, right?
In truth, there were many stage two World Deities, such as those who cultivated the Extremity Deity Heart or the World Deity Heart, who had their own methods to escape the bindings.
In fact, the World Prison was unable to truly bind down the enemy, its actual focus being on forming a complete domain of suppression! It didn't matter where one escaped; as long as they remained in the domain, the shackles would suppress them!
It was only because the Great Demonic God was bound down and could not escape that he was so easily restricted by the World Prison!
"Break!" The Great Demonic God released his strength in an explosive push, causing his aura to suddenly surge in might. As he exerted force from all eight arms, the countless shackles binding him from all sides were instantly smashed apart.
The starry-blue-robed Xue Yings now appeared in the surroundings, with a total of nine bodies being scattered all throughout the area. Using the spears that each of them wielded, they began to launch attacks! All of those spears moved across an arc through the air, followed by a terrifying strength which caused space itself in the surroundings to shatter. The strikes were headed in the direction of the Great Demonic God who could only dance on the spot as he attempted to use his eight arms to parry.
Peng!
As soon as one of his palms clashed against a spearhead, the terrifying impact which resulted left the Great Demonic God feeling startled. He had actually been forced to retreat a few steps! The other spear strikes followed quickly after, forcing the Great Demonic God to keep moving about in order to deflect the incoming force. Its might had already reached a stage that prevented him from resisting it in a head-on approach.
Hong! The distant black-robed Xue Ying made use of the opportunity to launch a thrusting attack. This ruthless strike using the Scarlet Cloud Spear came from a blind spot behind the Great Demonic God. He tried his best to slap the spear away so he could then dodge the attack, but as soon as his palm hit the spearhead, the scales at the center of his palm shattered in all directions. The spearhead then corrected its course and continued moving towards the back of the Great Demonic God, causing the scales protecting it to break. There was even a hole left behind where he had struck, out of which fresh blood began spurting out.
"Ah! Your spear technique has changed!" the Great Demonic God shouted in an alarmed state.
"As long as I can kill you using it, any spear technique works!" The black-robed Xue Ying continued its frenzied assault. Nothing in that few kilometers space around him could contest the power of his Scarlet Cloud Spear. As it moved through the air, its might was heaven-shattering. His nine world bodies seemed to have entered a berserk state, some of their attacks even succeeding to break off scales from the Great Demonic God's body. Though it did not reach a point where his fundamental particles were breaking down, the prisoner's complexion still paled at the sight.
"You may want to kill me, and my True Deity Heart might be sealed alongside my World Deity energy, but your strength is still not sufficient for that." The Great Demonic God was holding back three of his arms to block the Scarlet Cloud Spear, while he primarily used the rest of his five arms to block off attacks coming from the nine world bodies. At times, he would use his body to directly resist one or two attacks at a time.
At the moment, the Great Demonic God's scales were being smashed apart time and time again, and it even seemed like his injuries were heavy. However, like the flow of water, his scales would rapidly recover to their original state, revealing that he had received no real injury so far.
Peng peng peng~
The countless black shackles were also restricting him. The shackles were now much stronger than before, and the prisoner was forced to use all of his strength to slap them away each time; this was enough to affect his defenses.
It's fortunate that the spear techniques of those world bodies aren't powerful enough to harm me. The Great Demonic God was in a sullen mood. Damn it! Had I not been sealed, with only this small of an area available to dodge his attacks, I wouldn't be in such a miserable state. If I could use all my strength, I wouldn't need more than two or three moves to slap him to death.
On the other side, Xue Ying was thinking to himself, As expected, the power granted by these two secret skills alone wasn't enough. I'll just have to rely on my final killing move, then.
It was at that moment that the spear techniques used by the black-robed Xue Ying and the nine world bodies all changed at once.
The spears followed an astonishing arc as they smashed everything in their way to dust. The Great Demonic God himself was startled as soon as he witnessed the spears thrusting out, having even felt a hint of threat coming from them. This, in fact, was the first time he ever felt any threat coming from this stage two World Deity. As the spears approached, it was followed by a clear scene of everything being smashed apart—this was true destruction!
The Scarlet Cloud Spear, as well as the nine other spears, all represented the heart-palpitating destruction.
I've got to block these attacks! The Great Demonic God used four of his arms in an attempt to resist the incoming Scarlet Cloud Spear, which was a blood-refined Deity warrior, as well as an upper grade World Deity rank weapon. Its power was clearly a whole lever higher than the other spears. At that point, the four arms mobilized by the Great Demonic God formed an illusion of space-time. From a bystander's perspective, it seemed like the four arms were either slapping or pulling back, all in order to divert the direction of that spear away from piercing straight through him.
However, due to the influence of the black shackles, he was unable to so easily parry the other spears as well!
Pu pu pu…
A total of five spears pierced right into the Great Demonic God. After the impact, he was left with many bloody holes all throughout his body, and his whole figure was now covered in fresh blood.
At the sight, a mixture of fury and alarm appeared in the eyes of the Great Demonic God. "Your world bodies can also injure me now?"
"You're already dead, Great Demonic God!" Xue Ying roared. "Just lay down."
