The ten figures of Xue Ying were frantically attacking him from all directions, while the black shackles were restricting and binding him time after time. The Great Demonic God roared, trying to break free from the black shackles and doing his best to parry the incoming attacks, but every single spear coming his way was now filled with terrifying power. At the same time, the Scarlet Cloud Spear was even more frightening than the rest! He had to use four of his arms just to barely manage to block it. The Great Demonic God was, after all, empty-handed, with no weapon available for him to use, while his scales were not truly able to resist the spear.
His scales were smashed, his flesh torn, and his bones broken.
The Great Demonic God was now accruing serious injuries.
"How could this be…" The Great Demonic God found his situation hard to believe. "You're just a stage two World Deity… How could you have already begun to create such a destructive secret skill of your own, and even succeed in finishing it?!"
"It was all to deal with you!" Xue Ying furiously roared back.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 485 - Absolute Art Luminous Sun
chapters.content:
Chapter 485: Absolute Art Luminous Sun
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The prisoner was still under suffering from a joint attack from ten Xue Yings, all while also being bound and restricted by the black shackles. He was a Great Demonic God, yet he could use neither his domain nor his World Deity energy reserves. He did not even have a weapon! He was limited to moving within an area of a dozen meters under the entrapment of the two shackles, which left him feeling truly stifled. At the same time, he was accruing heavier and heavier injuries; many of his scales were already crushed, and there were cavities all over his body. Healing them would require lifeforce he wasn't in any position to use.
"How long has it even been? A thousand years or so? You… you could actually comprehend such a destructive secret skill?" The Great Demonic God was well aware that his defeat was nigh, followed by his inevitable death, yet he still found it hard to believe.
Xue Ying did not relent at all, continuing on with his berserk assault.
A thousand years? It was actually a hundred thousand years spent in the time-accelerated environment.
After comprehending the fundamental Deity imprint of the Shackle Technique, it had only taken him three thousand years to perfect the domain-related secret skill, World Prison! Against a stage two World Deity, this domain secret skill was very threatening, but when facing the stage three Great Demonic God, it was nothing more than a nuisance.
Meanwhile, it had taken him well over six thousand years to comprehend the fundamental Deity imprint of the Herculean Technique. Using it, Xue Ying created a personal technique which specialized in strength, which he termed Heaven and Earth Crush! This move sought the limits of strength.
Even then, however, Xue Ying was still not confident in his chances.
He had also spent some time to comprehended the World, pondering over the Extremity Deity Heart.
World, Chaotic, Extremity…
These three aspects formed a scene of a world's destruction; a vast world would start crumbling and, upon its destruction, would form a chaos hole, which would, in turn, eventually collapse into a final point of extremity! This point of extremity was the endpoint of Myriad Existences, but the same singularity was the source of everything! Eventually, it would form a new world.
Xue Ying had yet to comprehend the Extremity Deity Heart, but this scene still gave him an ambition!
What if I fuse the entire destruction of a world into a single move? Xue Ying thought.
In most cases, World Deities would use the World Deity Heart as their primary deity heart. Xue Ying had similarly used the World Deity Heart to first form his True Deity Heart, before fusing in the Chaotic Deity Heart. The plan was eventually also fuse in the Extremity Deity Heart, followed by the Time-Space Deity Heart! However, since he used the World Deity Heart as a base, the Laws of Profound Mysteries he comprehended would always have some focus on the world, and the secret skills he created would also tend to use this aspect as a foundation for the other Deity hearts to then fuse into and improve upon.
In this manner, it was much easier to create new secret skills!
However, powerful existences had complete control over the Laws of the World! Their secret skill killing moves could encompass all laws in a single move; that was what truly made them so terrifyingly powerful. It was only by encompassing as many of the Laws of the World as possible in an efficient manner that a move would become its strongest self!
Stage four World Deities also tended to begin comprehending additional Laws and sense out even more Deity Hearts. Even though most of them would remain stuck at the final stage, never to become powerful existences, they usually would be able to create their own terrifying killing moves which encompassed as many of the Laws of the World as possible! In fact, some were even so powerful—due to their moves being able to coordinate well with the Laws of the World—that they would surpass even ordinary powerful existences.
Even when using the same ingredients, food would still have different standards when cooked by different people.
For the most part, powerful existences could succeed in creating killing moves that were stronger than those of stage four World Deities. At the same time, there were also some truly strong experts amongst four World Deities!
However, while it could be said that most stage four World Deities were able to create such a killing move, there were only very few who could succeed amongst stage three World Deities. If they succeeded in creating such a killing move, they were sure to to stand at the very apex.
The White Sand City Lord, for instance, didn't possess a truly strong secret skill made for combat. In fact, his only absolute move was the Annihilation White Sand, and this was a move which depended solely on the secret technique he obtained from the Sealed World Pagoda that he then perfected over a period of time.
Xue Ying, however, was different—he was filled with determination.
His goal was to bring one of the great Laws of the World, the aspect of destruction, and fuse it into a single move. The way he saw it, the three Deity Hearts of World, Chaos, and Extremity coincided with different stages of the law of destruction. Unfortunately, he had yet to comprehend the Extremity Deity Heart, which was why this move of his had not reached its true potential. Even so, Xue Ying still had to spend a great amount of effort to come up with this single move.
He had only spent five thousand years cultivating before he became a stage two World Deity, while it took him a total of ninety thousand years to finally perfect this move, albeit in a time-accelerated environment!
He had been in closed-doors cultivation for a total of a hundred thousand years, with roughly ninety thousand years being alloted to this single move! Even then, he could only accomplish this because his talent was great enough, in addition to the fact that these three aspect of World, Chaos, and Extremity happened to be three different components of the law of destruction. Despite having yet to comprehend the Extremity Deity Heart, Xue Ying had some attainments and talent toward Extremity from back when he was a Transcendent, and he had long since reached the peak of Deity realm in it.
With partial aid from his understanding of Extremity…as well as nearly ninety thousand years of cultivation, Xue Ying finally created a move that represented the destruction of the world, a so-called 'destruction spear technique.'
"I truly did not think I would die by your hands, the hands of a stage two World Deity. I can't be satisfied with this conclusion…" The Great Demonic God's whole body was severely damaged, and his lifeforce was very close to emptying up. He was now no longer able to recover, causing his additional six arms to even show signs of crumbling apart.
Pu!
After a strike directly to the Great Demonic God's head, the Scarlet Cloud Spear succeeded in piercing the skull right through.
Even now, the Great Demonic God's scarlet eyes showed his fury and unwillingness, yet his aura started gradually dulling at the same time.
Xue Ying pulled out his spear and dispersed his nine world bodies. The World Shackles also followed in disappearing.
This destruction spear technique I made might encompass the destructive Laws of the World, but it is simply too crude, Xue Ying reflected. If only I could have comprehended the Extremity Deity Heart beforehand; it would have made for a better framework for this move.
If he wanted to reach a large success stage in this move, he would have to first become a stage four World Deity. Only at that point could he comprehend other parts of the Law, as well as sense the other Deity Hearts which he had not comprehended. By then, he could bring this technique to a stage of grand perfection.
It was still enough to deal with the imprisoned Great Demonic God. Xue Ying looked at the corpse of this Great Demonic God. Under normal circumstances, his combat power was likely comparable to that of the White Sand City Lord. In fact, if he wasn't restricted, a few moves from his part would most likely have been sufficient to destroy Xue Ying. If that had been the case, however, there was no way his teacher would have used him for this trial.
Ka ka ka~
Suddenly, a patch of ground beside the corpse protruded, startling Xue Ying in the process.
In a short time, that spot already a height of a dozen meters, and it now displayed many levels of steps, just like a pagoda. In the highest spot of this protruded surface, a bright white sphere had appeared at some point, floating slightly above it. Its pure white surface gave the sphere an exceptionally dazzling quality, while also giving off the feeling of heart-palpitating sharpness. The sphere was floating lazily, revolving around its own axis, but there was an unseen sharpness surrounding it, which seemed to easily cut through space, leaving countless cracks in its wake.
Upon laying eyes on the sphere, Xue Ying was hit by a wave of instinctual suppression and terror.
In fact, he could tell that any strand of that sharp quality exuded by the white sphere could easily cut down even a stage four World Deity.
"Dong Bo, walk up there and take it in your hand," a cold voice resounded.
"Teacher?" Xue Ying acknowledged the voice.
Hold it?
With that level of sharpness, it was not unlikely for the sphere to cut him down as well, right? However, his teacher had given him an order, and he had also cultivated an avatar technique, so he wasn't afraid to do as told. Bit by bit, he walked up the steps. Once he reached the top, he neared the white sphere when, all of a sudden, the sharp aura emitted by the white sphere retracted within it.
Once he got close enough, Xue Ying finally saw that there were many patterns revolving on the surface of the sphere, all of them mysterious and mystical by nature. He extended his hand, grabbing hold of the sphere.
Hong long long~
At that moment, a terrifying power left the the sphere and immediately rushed into Xue Ying's body. There was even a layer of white light forming on the surface of his figure, giving him the appearance of an expert wearing bright white armor. As he stood at the top of the stairs in his armor of white, Xue Ying's aura charged up to the sky and began to emit a terrifying sharpness which cut rampantly through the surrounding space. This explosive might was powerful enough to cause even powerful existences to cower in fear.
At the same time, a boom rang through Xue Ying's mind.
"Luminous Sun", like the dazzling, strong sun, can conquer any obstacle in its path. There's nothing it cannot break… a mighty voice resounded directly into Xue Ying's consciousness. An incredible volume of information was transmitted into his mind, and even though Xue Ying's True Deity Heart was fairly strong, he still found himself momentarily unable to think. He was completely overwhelmed by the incoming information.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 486 - Establishing Oneself
chapters.content:
Chapter 486: Establishing Oneself
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
At times fleeting, at other times lasting.
Information finally stopped flowing into Xue Ying's sea of consciousness, and his True Deity Heart was now able to relax and start comprehending the huge volume of knowledge he received. Inside the inner space, a tiny man with Xue Ying's appearance was looking upward at the dazzling white sphere floating above him. On its surface were countless patterns swirling all around, giving it a truly mystical quality. Watching the white spherical body gave Xue Ying a similar feeling to that which he got as he watched the Laws of the Material World revolving about.
As a Realm Lord, he could meld into the mortal world to view the law of the entire Material World. This Law was more vast, encompassing, and complex than that of the mortal world alone. It only made sense, considering that the Material World was made up of billions upon billions of mortal worlds!
But now, watching this white sphere gave him the same taste as watching the Law of the entire Material World.
Such is an absolute art that even powerful existences hope to get their hands on. It truly is the sort of technique which allows one to transcend their current realm. Xue Ying had tried to prepare himself mentally for this, but as he received the huge amount of information, he still found himself unable to suppress his excitement.
He had first been fortunate enough for the Bloodshed God Emperor to accept him as a disciple during the Myriad Flower Feast and then to become a stage two World Deity within five thousand years!
Even then, it was only after he was accepted as a personal disciple that he finally got the opportunity to learn an absolute art! As for the hard work he put in for a hundred thousand years just to create what was a rather crude destruction spear technique, he also did it in order to kill the the prisoner and learn the absolute art. This was of secondary importance, however, since he would have improved enough sooner or later.
"Luminous Sun", like the dazzling, strong sun, can conquer any obstacle in its path… Xue Ying revealed a grin as he went down the stairs, casually sitting down at an empty space by the side to begin cultivating the absolute art.
He was, after all, in the Bloodshed God Palace, and his safety was guaranteed. On top of that, he was also inside the impregnable prison.
Most of all, the absolute art was truly too alluring, so Xue Ying decided to learn it right away.
The "Luminous Sun" was split into a total of six volumes. Stage one World Deities could cultivate the first volume, the second volume was reserved to stage two and so on…!
On top of that, the volumes themselves were split into four different boundaries.
First was the entry boundary, followed by a minor success, a major success, and finally grand perfection.
As an absolute art, the technique was very difficult to cultivate. Anyone who could reach the volume reserved for powerful existence would become truly formidable, but to cultivate it to the grand perfection boundary was, indeed, tough to achieve! Monarch Gu Zang, for instance, was also in possession of an absolute art, but even now he was not strong enough to match the three ancestors! Monarch Green, on the other hand, had similarly cultivated an absolute art in the past, and he was now seen as a powerful expert on the same level as the Bloodshed God Emperor, the Temporal Island Lord, and a few others.
This was the difference between the different cultivation levels of an absolute art.
The Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Lord was merely a stage four World Deity, yet it was precisely by relying on an absolute art that he received the qualification of being one of the three ancestors! He had also tried imparting his absolute art to some of his fortunate personal disciples, but none of them had been able to reach as dazzling a stage as himself.
Hu.
Xue Ying was sitting cross-legged, breathing through his mouth, with nine golden beads placed on the ground right in front of him. Without warning, golden light began to fly into Xue Ying's open mouth.
Xue Ying's innate comprehension ability was at a very high level. How formidable did he have to be in order to become a stage two World Deity within just five thousand years? He had also spent a total of a hundred thousand years in an attempt to refine a secret skill, before finally coming up with a rather crude form of a destruction spear technique. Even in this crude stage, however, its power was already incredible. It could be said that, in terms of his usage of the Laws of Profound Mysteries, Xue Ying was already sitting at the highest spot amongst all stage two World Deities.
Naturally, he managed to easily cultivate the first volume, yet the second volume was already giving him problems.
This"Luminous Sun" art uses the World Deity Heart as a base, the same World Deity Heart I grasped back in the Xia Clan world. Not only that, my best usage of the Laws of Profound Mysteries are also in terms of the aspect of the world, yet I'm still having a hard time cultivating this absolute art, Xue Ying reflected. Its usage of the Profound Mysteries of the Law is simply unfathomable. Clearly, it surpasses World Deity ranked secret techniques by an overly large amount! It's no wonder that by relying on this absolute art alone, one can transcend their own realm in battle.
Transcending one's current realm was extremely difficult to accomplish.
Stage two World Deities could mop the floor with stage one World Deities, while stage three World Deities could similarly sweep away all stage two World Deities! That prisoner, for instance, could have easily extinguished Xue Ying in a few moves had he not been suppressed and restricted. It was the same case for stage four World Deity in relation to stage three World Deities.
However, the gap between powerful existences and stage four World Deities was not as large.
The cause of this was that stage four World Deities were able grasp entire Laws of the World in practice and were only a very small step away from becoming powerful existences themselves. Thus, there were many stage four World Deities who could match powerful existences in might.
Breathe…
The nine golden beads in Xue Ying's possession were known as Golden Fiend Beads. They contained the sharpness of golden fiends and were required in the cultivation of the "Luminous Sun". They were one of the treasures Xue Ying received from the Bloodshed God Emperor. However, this golden fiend sharpness inherent to the nine beads was only useful for cultivation up to the grand perfection boundary of the second volume. Once Xue Ying became a stage three World Deity, he would have to seek the necessary treasures for himself.
Indeed, absolute arts were obviously different from the World Deity ranked secret techniques in that they would require external help from certain items so they could be cultivated to higher realms.
After a whole night of cultivation, Xue Ying opened his eyes and waved his hand to store the nine beads away.
This"Luminous Sun" absolute art is truly difficult. Even after struggling for an entire night, I have yet to reach a major success! Xue Ying stood up and countless white tips flew out from his body without warning. These white tips intertwined with space, slithering about through the air with an unparalleled sharpness! Those white tips…were precisely what made up the luminous sun force Xue Ying gained after cultivating the absolute art. The Shackle Technique and the Herculean Technique which Xue Ying previously learned were both merely small parts of the entire absolute art "Luminous Sun".
Once he learned the absolute art, these two secret techniques were naturally of no more use.
Pu pu pu~
This white luminous sun force that was intertwining with space with unparalleled sharpness would be threatening even to stage three World Deities.
"Hmph." As the luminous sun force was revolving through his body, Xue Ying fiercely punched out. Hong long long~ Space itself began to fold and be crushed under the pressure. In fact, the affected portion of space even seemed to tremble faintly. This casual strike was so powerful that it even surpassed that of the imprisoned Great Demonic God! Naturally, the Great Demonic God's True Deity Heart had been sealed alongside his World Deity energy, so the strength of his fleshy body alone was greatly weakened.
Even then, Xue Ying's punch still had the necessary power to match stage three World Deities.
Once I succeed in cultivating the third boundary, I'll be able to suppress some stage three World Deities, Xue Ying thought.
Such was the power of an absolute art. Anyone possessing them would easily transcend their realm during battle!
"Dong Bo, you brat, stop showing off. Once you finish your cultivation, hurry over to see your teacher," a screech resounded within the surrounding space. Xue Ying knew this voice to belong to the black bird which always followed his teacher.
"Yes." Xue Ying felt rather awkward. It was true that he was showing off in style, but to think he was actually clearly seen by the black bird…
He quickly left through the array ripple with a smile plastered on his face, passed the mountain range, and then rushed back to Crimson Stone Courtyard.
******
In a quiet region of Crimson Stone Courtyard, the Bloodshed God Emperor was currently standing with his hands behind his back. This place was where he usually met his disciples.
Xue Ying walked in through the entrance to the garden and immediately greeted, "Teacher."
Only then did Bloodshed God Emperor turned around.
"What level did you reach after a night of training?" The corners of the Bloodshed God Emperor's mouth curled upward ever so slightly.
"I found it quite easy to comprehend up to the first two boundaries of the second volume, but the the third boundary seems relatively harder. After struggling for an entire night, I'm just a small ways off," Xue Ying politely replied. At first, he thought that spending that hundred thousand years to create his secret skill would have given him enough experience, but who would have thought that he could not even succeed in cultivating to the third boundary within a night.
According to the information provided by the "Luminous Sun", it was very simple to reach the entry boundary. A minor success was harder to achieve, but it wouldn't take very long, if the direction of one's comprehension matched. Experts with higher comprehension ability could succeed within a short amount of time.
Meanwhile, third boundary was very difficult! It was only those with great comprehension ability who could hope to succeed.
The fourth boundary? It was nigh impossible to comprehend. It was only in one of two scenarios that someone might succeed: the user would either need to have a truly heaven-defying comprehension ability, or their realm had to reach the next level. For instance, a stage one World Deity could not grasp the last boundary of the first volume, but as soon as he succeeded in becoming a stage two World Deity, he would find it simple to reach grand perfection for the first volume.
Yet despite Xue Ying's current experience and comprehension ability, he was still unable to reach the third boundary of the second volume.
"Your comprehension ability is quite high, and you managed to kill even that Great Demonic God. I don't doubt that it will only take a little more time for you to succeed in crossing the third boundary." The Bloodshed God Emperor nodded. "Now that you've obtained the "Luminous Sun" absolute art, it's about time for you to leave and establish a name for yourself."
**

chapters.title: Chapter 487 - Receiving the Supervision Mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 487: Receiving the Supervision Mission
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The Bloodshed God Emperor's eyes suddenly sent out rays of illusionary light, which rushed straight into Xue Ying's eyes. Through it, a large volume of information was speedily transmitted.
"In the Extremity Deity Heart lies the source, the beginning and the end, and there also lies the 'one'…" His teacher's current lecture focused mostly on the Extremity Deity Heart and the Space-Time Deity Heart, and even contained a few hints on the path to becoming a powerful existence. Although an enormous amount of information was being transmitted, Xue Ying was now a stage two World Deity, and his True Deity Heart was much stronger than the previous time. It only took him one or two seconds of pondering to completely recover his clear-headedness.
"Thank you, teacher." Xue Ying got on his knees to express his gratitude. From the absolute art to this transmission on his comprehension of the Laws of the World, Xue Ying had received a truly big favor this time!
"Your apprenticeship is now complete. Once you've established yourself, I won't be instructing you so often, and you will have to rely mostly on yourself," the Bloodshed God Palace said, seemingly without sympathy. "In the end, it's up to you to walk along your own path of cultivation. You will find it easy to become a stage four World Deity, but it will be much more difficult to take the next step and transcend the long river of time. That is why you must remember not to absorb faith under any circumstance."
"Disciple understands," Xue Ying replied.
Although the power of faith was helpful for cultivation, its downside was that it formed karma.
It was very difficult to rid oneself of karma. It created fetters that were extremely hard to cast away, which was necessary for one to truly transcend! There were stage four World Deities out there who were comparable in strength with powerful existences, but most of these people were unable to break free because they were bound by karma. In the end, they would all fade into oblivion.
"You're from the Xia Clan World, which corresponds to the territory of the Calm Sea Prefecture," the Bloodshed God Emperor continued.
"Indeed, " Xue Ying respectfully said.
The Calm Sea Prefecture was one of the nineteen prefectures ruled over by the Bloodshed God Palace, and its territory was incomparably large.
Because of this, the Calm Sea Prefecture was divided into the five large regions, which corresponded to the four cardinal directions and a central region. The Deity World, the Dark Abyss, the material world—all of them distinguished directions based on the Moon Star and the Sun Star. While the Sun Star was furthest to the east, the Moon was was the furthest to the west!
"In that case, your mission will be to supervise the Eastern Region of the Calm Sea Prefecture, and your official rank will be the third rank," the Bloodshed God Emperor said. "You have the right to recruit a personal guard, with a temporary limit set to four thousand people, as a second grade legion. Warships, armor, military supplies, everything will be sent along with you. As for the recruitment process of that personal guard, that will be fully up to you!"
"Yes." Xue Ying silently marveled at how his master truly was magnanimous and didn't seem to care at all about what gossip that would create.
What did a third rank position represent? It meant that in the the entire Calm Sea Prefecture, only the Calm Sea Prefecture Master would have a higher rank than him! Normally, it was only stage four World Deities who could obtain a third rank position. Clearly, as a personal disciple of the Bloodshed God Emperor, he had been given an appropriately high rank.
"Go now. In the future, it'll all be up to you alone, and whatever results your actions might bring you will have to bear yourself. No matter what, remember not to ruin yourself," the Bloodshed God Emperor instructed.
"Yes. I will take my leave." Xue Ying kowtowed all the way down. He then immediately got up and left.
The Bloodshed God Emperor silently watched as his disciple left.
He might have been one of the strongest figures in the Deity world and Dark Abyss, but when it came to instructing disciples, there was not much more he could do. He gave Xue Ying pointers for cultivation and passed on an absolute art to him as well as sufficient treasures. As for the rest? There truly was not much more he could do. He didn't mind whatever disaster Xue Ying could bring upon himself, since there was nothing out there that his Bloodshed God Palace feared, but he could not help but worry that Xue Ying might remain stuck as a stage four World Deity.
Over the long years of his life, only two of the disciples he taught ever succeeded in becoming powerful existences, after all.
"Bloodshed, this Xue Ying youngster has his own road to walk. Before this, he did not even have a powerful teacher, yet he could still become this strong. With you to guiding him him, he'll surely have boundless prospects," cried the black bird on top of the Bloodshed God Emperor's shoulder.
It didn't take long for the Bloodshed God Emperor to restrain his mood.
He was a habitually calm figure. Throughout a virtually endless amount of time, there had been countless people springing up, obtaining his interest, but the amount who were still alive after experiencing the cleansing of time was not large. He could only hope that this rather talented disciple of his, Dong Bo, would be among those who succeed.
******
On the same day, the military supply manager came to pay Xue Ying a visit.
This man was a stage two World Deity who went by Qu Cheng. He was a rather amiable fellow, having respectfully saluted Xue Ying upon meeting him. "Your Highness, I have brought the warships, armor, and other military supplies. You will find that there are five ships as well as five thousand sets of armor."
"Five thousand sets?" Xue Ying asked in suspicion. "Was the limit not set to four thousand people?"
"Those four thousand people you are referring to are to be your personal guard, which will also include ten officers," the military supplies manager replied. "There is always the chance that accidents might occur in the future, so we've prepared extras in advance.
Xue Ying nodded and immediately followed up with a question he was most concerned about. "My personal guard will be a second class legion, and second class legion soldiers are all required to undergo a bodily transformation by means of a secret skill technique. This time, I will be personally recruiting soldiers, and I will naturally be getting people from within the Eastern Region of the Calm Sea Prefecture. When the time comes for it, how will I be able to transform their Deity body through the secret technique?"
"There's absolutely no need to worry about that." World Deity Qu Cheng smiled. "I am an appointed military supply official, and it only makes sense that I'll make the necessary preparations. I am completely proficient in this secret technique transformation, and all the necessary supplies have been brought over. There are enough resources available to conduct body transformation on five thousand soldiers. Furthermore, His Majesty values Your Highness very much, so the Azure Dragon Army secret technique transformation provided to your personal guard will see any of those soldiers reach the peak Deity stage merely through the strength of their bodies after the transformation. Once they put on special sets of armor, they could even exhibit strength close to a World Deity. Once the legion moves and the members join their strength into one, their power will be even more formidable."
Xue Ying's eyes gleamed.
According to his knowledge, when it came to second class legions, after the soldiers underwent bodily transformation by means of secret techniques and donned their armor sets, their individual strength would usually be at peak of the Deity stage. It must be stated that, back when Xue Ying cultivated the Time Immemorial Body to the third level, his strength was barely close to that of a World Deity. Of course, this was also because the Time Immemorial Body's primary focus was survivability, and not attacking.
Even so, this Azure Dragon Army transformation could clearly be counted amongst the relatively stronger transformations.
"Very good." Xue Ying nodded.
"Although, there is something I must let you know, Your Highness—if it's merely about transforming the Deity Body through the secret technique, any Deity will suffice," World Deity Qu Cheng began. "But in the case of a fight, the Deity will have to make use of the Deity runes inscripted on the armor, and to do that, they have to be late stage Deities at the very least. Otherwise, if their comprehension is too low, they simply cannot activate the Deity runes and cannot make use of them. That would disturb the entire battle array."
"I understand." Xue Ying inwardly sighed. Although he gave the Deities of the Xia Clan many rare treasures, improving their strength by a lot, only half of them successfully became late stage Deities! Even that was fine, however, since the legion would contain five thousand soldiers who all underwent bodily transformation. The Xia Clan Deities added together only counted for a tiny bit of that force.
Merely two days later.
Xue Ying brought Jing Qiu, the military supplies manager—Qu Cheng—and the Xia Clan Deities together for a ride on a dark-blue luxurious Starfield Flying Ship, leaving the Bloodshed God Palace.
An ordinary Starfield Flying Ship would cost ten million deity crystals at the very least.
But Xue Ying's current Starfield Flying Ship had actually been personally granted by the Bloodshed God Emperor when he first became a personal disciple and was even more precious.
Hong long long~
The Starfield Flying Ship shuttled through a spacetime tunnel at incredible speeds.
A high-spirited Xue Ying could be seen at the bow of the ship. He thought about how back when he had just exited the Xia Clan World, he had just been a mere nobody, but now, he was already in charge of supervising the eastern area of the Calm Sea Prefecture. He even had a personal guard numbering four thousand soldiers, as well as an absolute art.
Soon, a light appeared in front of the ship, marking the end of the spacetime tunnel.
Hu.
The ship flew out into the starry sky. Nearly simultaneously, a figure appeared in a distant region of the starry sky; it was the white-robed Xue Ying. Of course, this was merely an avatar he made through World Deity energy. This white-clothed Xue Ying waved his hand, and a few different figures immediately appeared right beside him. They were the rather elegant Dong Bo Yu, Dong Bo Qing Yao with his domineering aura, the thick-robed Ge Bai, the scarlet-cloaked He Fei Yun, and finally, a woman with fluttering green hair—Xi Wei.
It was now time for them to enter the Deity world.
******

chapters.title: Chapter 488 - Will of the Material World
chapters.content:
Chapter 488: Will of the Material World
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The thick-gowned Senior Disciple Brother Ge Bai looked toward the luxuriant Starfield Flying Ship flying through the void in front of him, his eyes brightening up as he laughed. "This ship looks rather extraordinary. Its price should be no less than a hundred million Deity crystals! Old Seven, us two couldn't afford this ship even if we pawned off all our treasures."
The scarlet-cloaked He Fei Yun remained as cold as ever. He replied through pursed lips, "Junior Disciple Brother Dong Bo is now His Majesty's personal disciple, and five thousand years ago, he was already a stage two World Deity. There's no point in being envious of him."
Hua.
Watching this, the white-robed Xue Ying turned around and left.
Shua!
He disappeared, having returned directly into the material world.
It was very simple to go back to the material world from the Deity world…such was the case for Realm Lords only, of course! With a single thought, he could send a displacement order to the Xia Clan world, causing the Xia Clan world to attract him back! In most cases, he would be sent back in the blink of an eye. This time, however, an accident occurred.
What's this? The white-robed Xue Ying looked at the blurry space passage around him as a mighty power descended to envelop him.
The will of the material world! Xue Ying immediately understood.
The Xia Clan World, like every other mortal world, had its own set of laws of operation. It had the ability to expel outsiders and encompass the natives.
As a group, the countless mortal worlds constituted the material world. Its law was even stricter than that of a mortal world, and it had some more fundamental capabilities. This law was known as the will of the material world! Just like the Dark Abyss which had its own will of the abyss, anyone would have to respect the will of the material world when living in it.
Weng!
The power of the material world was now directed toward Crimson Rock Mountain, which Xue Ying had brought along.
Release the seals on the Crimson Rock Mountain… Once the material world transmitted its will over, Xue Ying understood that, if he did not follow the laws the material world set down, it would most likely expel him as a Realm Lord without hesitation! Straightaway, Xue Ying obediently released the seals, allowing the material world's power to permeate Crimson Rock Mountain.
Sou! Sou!
Before long, two figures were thrown straight out of Crimson Rock Mountain and then out of the material world.
With the exception of the Realm Lord, it is forbidden for World Deities to enter the material world. With those words, the power of the material world retreated.
Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao, Xi Wei, Ge Bai and He Fei Yun were now situated in the starry sky of the Deity world, when two more figures suddenly appeared beside them. They were also figures of He Fei Yun and Ge Bai, but in a more sorry state.
The Starfield Flying Ship had already stopped in its tracks.
"Junior Disciple Brother Dong Bo, why did you throw us out?"
"What's wrong? I was still in closed-doors cultivation when I was thrown out without any warning." The two figures of He Fei Yun as well as the two figures of Ge Bai were staring straight at Xue Ying and Jing Qiu, who had just left the Starfield Flying Ship. Both senior disciple brothers of his had cultivated avatar techniques.
"Father, Mother."
Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao both shouted out.
Xue Ying gave a nod toward his children with a smile before turning toward Ge Bai and He Fei Yun and helplessly replying, "Senior Disciple Brothers, I was not the one to throw you out here. The will of the material world is responsible for having thrown you two out! The laws of the material world…stipulate that a Realm Lord's cultivation eden treasures are forbidden from carrying World Deities within. I've only recently found out as well."
"Ah." The thick-gowned Ge Bai was stunned. "I thought there would be no issue with leaving an avatar within."
"Back when our teacher, Crimson Dust, threw out Crimson Rock Mountain, the treasure entered the Xia Clan World without a master," Xue Ying began. "Because of that, the material world power was unable to forcibly enter the inner regions of Crimson Rock Mountain, so the two of you were allowed to remain inside. But now that I refined Crimson Rock Mountain and carried Crimson Rock Mountain into the material world, the will of the material world descended to investigate Crimson Rock Mountain. I guess this will now be happening whenever I try to bring a cultivation eden treasure into the material world."
"What are we supposed to do, then?" Ge Bai and He Fei Yun looked at each other.
"We could cultivate in an time-accelerated environment inside Crimson Rock Mountain, but the outside world does not have the same conditions." Ge Bai sighed. "Whatever. It's out of our control. It's not like we could remain stuck inside Crimson Rock Mountain forever."
Crimson Rock Mountain was a cultivation eden, and it contained precious cultivation rooms which could accelerate time. They could also generate various experimental environments, which were helpful to the two.
In the past, both Ge Bai and He Fei Yun would cultivate inside Crimson Rock Mountain using both their true bodies and avatars. This was because they still held onto a strand of hope that they could become stage three World Deities.
"Then what do you two Senior Disciple Brothers plan to do now?" Xue Ying laughed. "You are here in both true body and avatar form. How about following me to Eastern Region City?"
"I'm fine with that." He Fei Yun nodded.
"Since both my bodies are now out, I can send one back to my old hometown, and the other can follow you, Junior Disciple Brother Dong Bo." Ge Bai caressed his lower chin before joking, "However, I will require your help with some of the materials we need for researching arrays, Junior Disciple Brother."
"A minor matter." Xue Ying laughed. "Let's go, then. Once we're back on the flying ship, we can leave for Eastern Region City."
Seeing how he was put in charge of four thousand personal guards, every year, the Bloodshed God Palace would give him enough of a salary to also take care of the resources his two Senior Brothers would require for their cultivation.
******
Eastern Region City of the Calm Sea Prefecture was incredible in terms of size. The many planets around it were nothing more than decoration to it. A few billion kilometers long winding river meandered through the starry sky, flowing in a circle around the entire city.
In fact, when considering size, within the entire Calm Sea Prefecture, Eastern Region City was second only to the capital itself! It was comparable to the other three regional cities.
On that day, a great many soldiers were standing orderly in rows by the entrance of Eastern Region City. To the front of this group could be seen various World Deities, and even a total of eight stage three World Deities! As for stage two World Deities, around a hundred of them were currently standing in an orderly fashion.
"Almost all the superpowers of the Calm Sea Prefecture Eastern Region have gathered here today." The group was led by a white-robed middle-aged man who chuckled at the sight. "This supervisor envoy of ours is truly very famous. I remember that, back when I took up the same position, only half of the people present here welcomed me. Hahaha…I'm not trying to complain or anything. All I'm saying is that this supervisor envoy, His Highness Dong Bo, is a personal disciple under His Majesty, and he has a rank three official position. In the Calm Sea Prefecture, only the prefecture head himself has a higher position than him. Even I would have to lower my head in front of him."
"General Mo, there are only eight stage three World Deities here! There's actually one missing." A muscular cow-headed male laughed from the side.
"Indeed, there's one person who's not attending. That person is quite a proud and lofty figure, seeing how she refused to come." An enchanting woman holding onto a fan giggled.
"She has some huge enmity with His Highness, Dong Bo. I thought she would at least come here to try and resolve it, but who would have thought that she would now show up at all."
"Interesting, interesting."
"I wonder how that Little Sister Venomous Ying reacted upon finding out that His Highness Dong Bo was accepted as His Majesty's personal disciple, and that he even became a stage two World Deity within just five thousand years."
The stage three World Deities were all chatting and laughing amongst themselves.
That's right.
Currently, regardless of whether they were in closed-doors cultivation or had gone out on adventures, almost all the stage three World Deities had rushed here from throughout the entire Eastern Region of the Calm Sea Prefecture, and it was just to welcome Xue Ying! That is, all except for one—the Venomous Ying World Deity! A long time had passed since she created enmity with Xue Ying, and the various superpowers from this Eastern Region were all wondering as to whether the Venomous Ying World Deity would show up or not. And, in the case that she did show up, would His Highness Dong Bo even show her any respect? Even then, everyone could guess from the fact that Venomous Ying World Deity had wanted to snatch away Jing Qiu and trample on Xue Ying himself for the sake of her nephew, that 'His Highness Dong Bo' would never forgo such humiliation, especially considering his current identity.
In the end, it seemed as if the Venomous Ying World Deity had decided to just not show herself!
"His Highness is here."
At the moment, the many World Deities were all looking into the distance, where a huge emerald ship could be seen flying over through the starry sky. It had left through a spacetime passage, suppressing the surrounding airflow to rapidly arrive at its destination. Standing at the helm of that huge ship were several human figures.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 489 - The Supervisor Envoy has Arrived
chapters.content:
Chapter 489: The Supervisor Envoy has Arrived
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying was standing at the head of the ship with a few others, looking at the mighty legion right outside the entrance to the enormous city. To the front of these soldiers was a group of extraordinary World Deities, eight of which were stage three World Deities. These were in charge of commanding the rest.
As he swept his gaze across, Xue Ying muttered, "She really did not come!"
"The Venomous Ying World Deity is likely aware that the enmity between the two of you can't be settled." Jing Qiu giggled.
"It can be said that she has some self-awareness in that case." A glimmer of coldness flashed through Xue Ying's eyes. The Venomous Ying World Deity had truly acted too overbearingly back then, having tried to grab Jing Qiu directly away. She had actually brought him to the verge of wanting to contact Forefather Scarlet Flame and ask to become his disciple just to request his help! Fortunately, his Big Brother, the White Sand City Lord, had instead acted to stop her from doing as she wished.
Had the White Sand City Lord not acted, and had he not been a grade one True Meaning Transcendent, he could have only watched as his wife was humiliated.
In truth, Xue Ying still held onto some slight fury and killing intent toward General Ying, but it was not even close to being as heavy as the hatred he felt for the Venomous Ying World Deity! After all, General Ying had long since turned completely mad, and it was always difficult to tell what a crazy person would do next! Nevertheless, the Venomous Ying World Deity, despite not being crazy herself, had still been too overbearing. Her actions had stemmed precisely from her knowing that he was too weak back then, so she had no reason to even consider him.
At that time, the Venomous Ying World Deity had sneered to his face and said, "You're just a small thing, yet you dare be arrogant in front of me? So what if you're a Realm Lord? To what extent will you even be able to cultivate in your entire life?" She had not placed Xue Ying in her eyes at all.
Even this could be considered natural.
How many stage four World Deities were there even in the entire world? Every single prefecture would only have one or two in its premises! At the same time, the Myriad Flower Feast would only be held every ten million years, so the Venomous Ying World Deity truly did not think that Xue Ying would become a stage four World Deity. It only made sense that she would not care about him.
However, the natural law cycled ever onward, and the appropriate retribution for her actions had come quickly.
Hua.
The Starfield Flying Ship soon began to slow down before stopping entirely. Xue Ying, Jing Qiu, their children, Ge Bai, He Fei Yun, Xi Wei, the military supplies officer Qu Cheng, and the Xia Clan Deities were all standing there. With a single thought, the flying ship disappeared as Xue Ying put it back into his storage.
From the distance, the World Deities rushed forward to welcome them, while Xue Ying's entourage also began moving to meet them.
"Greetings, Your Highness Dong Bo," the white-robed middle-aged man in the lead opened up in greeting with a smile.
"General Mo," Xue Ying returned the greeting. "I've long since heard of your name. In the future, many matters pertaining to this Eastern Region will be up to you to attend to. My hope is that you, General, won't see this as too troublesome. We'll have to coordinate properly."
General Mo was left startled at the sound of those words, though he didn't show it outwardly. The first thing Xue Ying had spoken of…was that he would have to attend to certain matters? And he hoped that he wouldn't find this matter too troublesome?
Incredibly, it seemed like this supervisor envoy truly planned on 'supervising' the place! In truth, any supervisor envoy faced huge responsibility. If Xue Ying was to thoroughly supervise the entire Eastern Region, the various powers from throughout the region would certainly feel their heads ache, and some might even furiously rebel! On the other hand, as long as he closed an eye to some matters, both parties would have a much better time. However, the first thing Xue Ying spoke of upon meeting him was that he would be troubling the general frequently. He couldn't help but feel that something was amiss.
Even so, this supervisor envoy was the personal disciple of His Majesty!
"It is within my responsibilities, so it's only natural that we'll have to coordinate well." General Mo was beaming. "The various superpowers from throughout the Calm Sea Prefecture Eastern Region have arrived, and they are prepared to welcome Your Highness."
"You say they've all arrived?" Xue Ying swept his gaze across. "It seems to me like the Venomous Ying World Deity isn't here, though."
Some of the stage three World Deities were inwardly laughing. They were all excited for the show that was about to happen.
"My clan master is undergoing closed-doors cultivation, and before entering, she had strictly ordered for nobody to disturb her. Because of that, my clan master is mostly likely not aware that Your Highness has taken up the supervisor envoy role. Hopefully, Your Highness can pardon us," a rangy man hurriedly said from the back.
Xue Ying glanced at him. "Oh, it seems like the Venomous Ying World Deity is truly busy. Alright then, let us enter the city, ladies and gentlemen."
"Let's go then. Time to enter the city," General Mo followed up.
The mighty crowd of World Deities escorted Xue Ying and the others into the city.
Two figures were currently standing side by side in the starry sky outside Eastern Region City. These figures belonged to a yellow-robed woman and a silver-robed man respectively. The face of the latter seemed to be covered in various unique patterns.
"He especially called out my name outside the city during the initial welcome." The yellow-robed Venomous Ying World Deity sneered. "This Dong Bo Xue Ying has not arrived with friendly intents. You've come to fight with me, but do you really think I'm afraid? Big Brother, you've been at the side of His Majesty for so many years, and some of your good friends are also under him. Can't you make use of your relations to bring some of them over to this side?"
"Little sister," the silver-robed man helplessly began, replying from the side, "I really am quite close with those brothers of mine. Even the officers in charge of the official positions have to show me some respect. In fact, you'd be fine even if you were to fight General Mo and the others! However, the one you're facing this time around is His Highness, Dong Bo.
"General Mo and these other people have been stationed in Eastern Region for such a long time, and they aren't qualified to meet His Majesty. Naturally, you're already aware of this." The silver-robed male shook his head. "But Dong Bo is different. He is one of His Majesty's personal disciples, and he can directly contact His Majesty and report to him at any time! More importantly, his potential is incredible, seeing how he is already a stage two World Deity. It's likely that he'll be able to become a stage four World Deity within a million years. What officers would dare offend a stage four World Deity?"
The gap between any stage three and stage four World Deity was as vast as the one between the heaven and the earth!
While there were dozens of stage three World Deities throughout the Calm Sea Prefecture, there was only a single stage four World Deity stationed there!
"Little sister, forget this matter," the silver-robed man continued. "I'll approach some of my friends and ask them to talk to Dong Bo. I'll try to find some way to dissolve this issue."
The yellow-robed Venomous Ying World Deity gritted her teeth. She hesitated slightly before replying, clearly at a loss, "Do you really think this matter can be dissolved at this point?"
"We can try, at least," the silver-robed man advised.
"The way I see it, there's not much of a chance," the Venomous Ying World Deity coldly replied. "Hmph, I am still a rank five official and also a member of the Bloodshed God Palace. Does he have any way to touch me? Even if he were a stage four World Deity, he would still not be qualified to attack and kill me directly. Should he truly force my hand, I have my own way to survive."
The Bloodshed God Palace had its own rules in place. Just having huge combat power would not allow one to casually kill as they pleased.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying is certainly going to charge up to the skies, so how can hope to confront him?" The silver-robed man shook his head. "Whatever, just remember not to fight him. Let me think of a solution. For now, just stay away from him."
"Big brother, you go ahead and find your solution." The yellow-robed Venomous Ying World Deity laughed coldly. "I'll lower my head for now, but if he doesn't show me any face… Hmph, hmph! I've my own way to handle this problem."
"You…" The silver-robed man simply shook his head.
This man was trying his best to think up a way to defuse the situation. His nature was clearly more amiable, or his network of friends would never have grown so vast. He even sought a way to completely dissolve this enmity.
There were many guests who had come over to welcome Xue Ying. Naturally, the number of gifts he received had also piled up to form a venerable mountain.
Everyone was already aware of this supervisor envoy, and they knew he was different from those in the past. His backing was truly solid, his potential great. Because of that, the gifts they sent over had to be similarly weighty.
The welcoming ceremony soon ended, and Xue Ying's group returned to the residence reserved to the supervisor envoy. Xue Ying, Qu Cheng, Senior Disciple Brothers Ge Bai and He Fei Yun, and Xi Wei could all be seen in the main hall.
"Qu Cheng, make the arrangements for hiring personal guards. I'll be starting tomorrow," Xue Ying ordered. "Everyone must be a peak Deity at the very least, and there's no limit to how many World Deities we may accept."
Even if they exceeded the number of positions he had, he could still receive them as guests! After all, not all World Deities were willing to be part of the legion, with several of them simply wishing to find some good backing for themselves. Xue Ying was a naturally good target for such people, since it would not be long before he was set to become a stage four World Deity.
"Yes." World Deity Qu Cheng respectfully acknowledged.
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded. "Go on, then."
World Deity Qu Cheng retreated.
Xue Ying then looked toward Xi Wei, who was standing to his side, and laughed. "Xi Wei, there's a matter I'll have to trouble you with as well."
"Your Highness, please give me your orders." Xi Wei was also one of Xue Ying's followers now.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 490 - Offering an Apology
chapters.content:
Chapter 490: Offering an Apology
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"I will need your help with purchasing more Golden Fiend Beads and Demon Bone Ash," Xue Ying began. "For the moment, I'll need thirty-eight Golden Fiend Beads. I've already passed a hundred million Deity crystals to you a while ago, and that should suffice. As for the Demon Bone Ash, just go out and find someone to buy some from. If you obtain any information, I will go negotiate personally."
"Yes." Xi Wei smiled. She had lived for so long within Crimson Rock Mountain, as she had followed the Sacred Master Crimson Dust, and had begun to feel truly stifled. At some point while they were still there, Xue Ying's true body had handed her a hundred million Deity crystals.
Xue Ying nodded.
Golden Fiend Beads and Demon Bone Ash were rare treasures which he needed in order to continue his cultivation of the "Luminous Sun". His teacher had only given him enough treasures to reach the second volume. From the third volume and until the final sixth volume, he would have to prepare the treasures himself. For the third volume, he would would require a total of thirty-eight Golden Fiend Beads and four kilograms of Demon Bone Ash.
While Golden Fiend Beads were quite expensive of themselves, their price couldn't compare with Demon Bone Ash.
Just five hundred grams of Demon Bone Ash would cost more than fifty million Deity crystals! Naturally, as the master of Crimson Rock Mountain, he could afford that. The problem, however, was how rare it was to find.
"The first thing you want to purchase already costs a hundred million Deity crystals. Hehehe," the thick-gowned Ge Bai chuckled. "Despite having lived for so many years, I've never seen such a sum in person."
Xue Ying laughed. "Senior Disciple Brother Ge Bai, should I pass these hundred million Deity crystals over for you to purchase the treasures?"
"No, no, there's no need. I have to continue researching the arrays." Ge Bai hurriedly shook his head.
"If you're not going to do it, then what are you grumbling about?" He Fei Yun pursed his lips.
"Are you going to do it, then?" Ge Bai mocked him back.
He Fei Yun snorted.
These two Senior Disciple Brothers had a very deep friendship, though it was quite common for them to undermine each other. Seeing this, Xue Ying asked, "Senior Disciple Brothers Ge Bai and He Fei Yun, since I've sent out the announcement that I'll start recruiting for my personal guard, a lot of people will soon arrive, and we'll see fish and dragons mixed up in one big group. I'm not really concerned with the peak Deities, since they can't create too big of a wave. However, when it comes to the World Deities who'll be coming to seek shelter… I'll have to ask you two to help me observe and investigate them."
"Leave it to us." Ge Bai laughed.
Just how many World Deities could there even be to come over in search for shelter? This matter was a breeze for the two of them.
"In any case, would the two of you be willing to become commanders of my personal guard?" Xue Ying asked.
"Second Disciple Brother will want to concentrate on researching the arrays, and I don't enjoy being restricted that way either," the scarlet-cloaked He Fei Yun replied. "We two would prefer taking up the roles of idle guests."
Ge Bai nodded from the side.
"Alright." Xue Ying did not attempt to persuade the two.
The official residence of a supervisor envoy covered an incredible area, with every single soldier who arrived being given his own cavern dwelling to live in. The dwellings assigned to World Deities would be even bigger.
Hua~
Xue Ying was currently standing by some railings, looking down upon a wide lake which could be found in the residence. He spotted some vague signs of beasts swimming within the lake.
"Father, it's so lively outside. Won't you go out to take a look?" A figure flew over in his direction, following an arc as he landed by the side of the railings. It was the handsome Dong Bo Yu garbed in blue robes. Dong Bo Yu had inherited all the best from both Xue Ying and Jing Qiu, leaving him even more attractive than Xue Ying himself.
"Is that so?" Xue Ying laughed as he asked.
"Everyone's here to seek shelter; they all want to become part of your personal guard." Dong Bo Yu's eyes were very bright as he exclaimed, "Your personal guard is a class two legion, and even the lowest position of any given soldier is a rank ten official position. Their treatment is higher than even than that of an ordinary class three legion's commander."
Xue Ying nodded.
In terms of official rank, the highest commander of a class three legion—its general—would usually only have a tenth or ninth rank position. They would, however, have more power and rights.
Even the lowest ranking soldier of a class two legion would be given a rank ten official position.
It was easy to see the disparity in their positions, but also the gap in combat power between the two type of legions!
A class three legion with a thousand members could at most deal with a stage one World Deity. But a thousand members of a class two legion could easily defeat a stage three World Deity! It was this gap in combat power that naturally solidified this difference of status.
"Have any World Deities arrived?" Xue Ying asked.
"A dozen stage one World Deities, and even a single stage two World Deity have come over to seek shelter," Dong Bo Yu answered.
Xue Ying was slightly astonished at how fast that was. It was only the first day of recruitment, and the news had yet to completely reach far and wide. Yet, a stage two World Deity had already arrived. It was a much better outcome than expected!
Sou.
A figure belonging to a gray-robed World Deity came flying over from the distance and respectfully greeted, "Greetings, Your Highness. General Mo and World Deity Ying have arrived." This gray-robed man was a subordinate assigned to the supervisor envoy. It must be stated that Xue Ying's personal guard was considered a private legion, and it was bound to follow him regardless of what position he held. As for the previous legion assigned to the supervisor envoy, they were stationed at the official residence.
The supervisor envoy's legion was much smaller, having just a thousand people under it. However, these thousand people were also part of a class two legion! Their numbers were sufficient to take care of their supervision responsibilities.
"World Deity Ying? Which World Deity Ying?" Xue Ying asked.
"I'm talking about the Venomous Ying World Deity's older brother, one of His Majesty's close imperial guards. His name is World Deity Ying Gu Liang," the gray-robed World Deity replied.
Xue Ying chuckled. "Lead them to the side chamber and tell them to wait. I'll come over right away."
"Yes," the gray-robed man immediately acknowledged as he left.
"Father, that Venomous Ying World Deity's older brother has come? Is he here to apologize?" Dong Bo Yu's eyes flashed with light. "We couldn't possibly let them off so easily. They tried to corner father and mother without any route of retreat back then. They might have learned to apologize by now, but I'd say it's too late!"
Xue Ying waved his hand dismissively. "There's no need for you to involve yourself in this issue. Hurry up and go back to your own things. At the moment, you have yet to reach the peak of the Deity stage. In your stead, I would have long since entered closed-doors cultivation."
Dong Bo Yu giggled. "Father, do you think everyone can be like you and become a stage two World Deity within five thousand years? Even becoming a stage one World Deity within ten thousand years would allow someone to become a personal disciple of a powerful existence. In any case, I feel like I'll be able to become a peak Deity soon. My goal at the moment is to become a World Deity within a million years!"
"Go then, and do your best." Xue Ying shook his head.
When it came to those children of his, his son was rather carefree and without worry. Meanwhile, his daughter was more initiative-driven.
Whatever the case, Xue Ying did not try to force them. He found it best to let things take their natural course.
Xue Ying entered the palace hall and went into a side chamber reserved for welcoming guests. There, the two guests, who were seated behind a long and narrow table, both stood up at the same time. These two were none other than General Mo and the silver-robed World Deity Ying. A unique pattern could be clearly seen on the latter's face as he chuckled. It was easy to tell that he was a more amiable and easy to talk to, a polar opposite of his little sister, the Venomous Ying World Deity. Her antisocial behavior was much more pronounced.
"Greetings, Your Highness," World Deity Ying Gu Liang opened up with a polite greeting.
"Your Highness, this is World Deity Ying. He was aware of the issue between you and the Venomous Ying World Deity, so he found it best not to come during the welcome ceremony yesterday. However, he has arrived earlier today," General Mo took over. He still had to show some respect toward this World Deity Ying Gu Liang.
In truth, the Venomous Ying World Deity was able to produce such wind and waves only because she could rely on this older brother of hers.
"World Deity Ying Gu Liang, I'd heard about you back when I was still at Crimson Stone Courtyard." Xue Ying smiled. "Please, take your seat."
Xue Ying then went over to one of the cushions next to the long table and sat down.
Ying Gu Liang followed with the same motion and said, "I've come here today in order to apologize to Your Highness. As you're aware, my little sister is truly too antisocial, and her behaviour is very overbearing. I've asked her what happened at that time, and I've concluded that my son's actions were, indeed, excessive. He we was only that way, however, because his True Deity Heart was crumbling apart; he had already turned mad. A long time has already passed since his death after his True Deity Heart shattered completely, and there is no meaning in blaming him any longer. If there is anyone is to blame…it should be me and my sister, who were unable to truly take proper care of my son. We should not have let him out any longer once he started turning mad."
Xue Ying listened to the man talk. He found that Ying Gu Liang seemed to approach matters in a quite logical manner.
Indeed, back then, General Ying had reached such a dangerous stage, yet the Venomous Ying World Deity was still willing to let him roam free. Was that not treating the lives of others poorly? With him killing people casually, who could those who died from this injustice cry to and blame?
At that time, Xue Ying had been forced into a corner, while the Venomous Ying World Deity was even overbearingly bullying him, all because his combat power was weak!
**

chapters.title: Chapter 491 - Paying Close Attention
chapters.content:
Chapter 491: Paying Close Attention
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"This matter was, indeed, caused by my little sister's misbehaviour. The fault lies on our side entirely," Ying Gu Liang began. "If you truly wanted to deal with her, I wouldn't find it anything but normal! I am, however, her older brother, so I couldn't just watch as that happens. On top of that, brother White Sand was quick to act at that time, so the overall outcome was not too dire. Because of all this, I wish we could find some space to alleviate this enmity."
Listening to the man speak, Xue Ying revealed a frown. "There weren't any dire consequences? Indeed, that was because my Big Brother, the White Sand City Lord, arrived. Hmph, without him, I would have long since embarked on a path of endless vengeance!"
Ying Gu Liang paused for a moment before adding on, "You're completely right. We're truly indebted to brother White Sand; we have to show him our gratitude. In any case, I have arrived at this time to sincerely apologize, hoping to defuse this enmity. Your Highness, should you have any conditions, please state them right away."
"You're letting me state the conditions?" Xue Ying coldly said. "Alright then. Don't say I'm not giving Venomous Ying a way out."
"Just state them freely, Your Highness." Ying Gu Liang let out a breath of relief inwardly. Since Xue Ying had conditions that could be mentioned, he could follow up with a negotiation.
"I have two conditions," Xue Ying said directly. "The first is to bring out ten kilograms of Demon Bone Ash!"
Ying Gu Liang's expression changed greatly at the sound of those words, while General Mo was sighing inwardly at how amazingly ruthless Xue Ying could be!
Just five hundred grams of Demon Bone Ash was valued at fifty million Deity crystals at the very least, while ten kilograms would cost a full billion Deity crystals! General Mu had no way to bring out such a sum, and not even Ying Gu Liang could possibly arrange that sum. Furthermore Demon Bone Ash was a very rare material and was relatively hard to purchase!
"The second condition is for the Venomous Ying World Deity herself to come kneel right outside my residence for ten thousand years," Xue Ying continued. "Fulfill both conditions, and you can consider our enmity dissolved! Don't say I'm not giving you a way out. I've told you the conditions, and it's up to the Venomous Ying World Deity to meet them or not."
"This… this is just…"
Ying Gu Liang laughed bitterly. "You might as well have not even mentioned these conditions. In the case of the ten kilograms of Demon Bone Ash, forget me and my little sister, even stage four World Deities would have to go through a lot of trouble to acquire them. As for my little sister kneeling for ten thousand years, considering her temper, she'd refuse it even when faced with death…"
"Great temper, you say?" Xue Ying sneered. "Have you not come to apologize? What's the point in this garbage talk about her temper if you're here make amends? I can leave you ten thousand years to arrange the ten kilogrammes of Demon Bone Ash, but the Venomous Ying World Deity must be outside my residence kneeling within three days! Hmph! If she doesn't show up, don't blame me for giving you a chance.
"Send them off!" Xue Ying stood up immediately.
The guards immediately entered from outside and turned to look at General Mo and Ying Gu Liang. The two, General Mo and Ying Gu Liang, traded gazes.
"Is there any chance that the conditions might be lowered?" Ying Gu Liang asked.
Xue Ying only frowned in response, while the two guards stepped in, "Guests, if you could follow us, please!"
"Let's go, then," General Mo said.
Ying Gu Liang helplessly exited the place.
General Mo turned toward Xue Ying and transmitted him a message, "Your Highness, there's absolutely no chance that the Venomous Ying World Deity will accept such conditions. They couldn't possibly afford ten kilograms of Demon Bone Ash, and it's unlikely they could find so much of it either."
"I've given my conditions. Everything is now in their hands," Xue Ying replied indifferently.
The place known as the Nest of Myriad Devils was a towering mountain floating in the starry sky, shrouded in black fog and littered with venomous snakes. It was a well-known place within the Calm Sea Prefecture as a territory under the control of the Venomous Ying World Deity, an extremely famous figure within the Calm Sea Prefecture. It was not only her elder brother's influence that helped her, but also her extreme proficiency in hexing poisons. In fact, she was said to be the strongest expert in the entire Calm Sea Prefecture in that regard.
"Delusional! He's delusional! He wants me to kneel in front of his official residence for ten thousand years? Who does he think he is? I've cultivated for so long to become a stage three World Deity, but I would never accept his order and kneel before him! He could threaten to kill me, and I still would not do it." The Venomous Ying World Deity's enormous tail was winding around the enormous palace hall, and her eyes were filled with fury. "On top of that, he wants ten kilograms of Demon Bone Ash? What does he even think that means? Does he think you can find Demon Bones on any corner of the street? Is that ash so easy to find? Forget ten kilograms, I wouldn't give him even five hundred grams! What's with these conditions? He is just trying to humiliate the both of us, big brother!"
Her voice reverberated within the huge hall to the degree that it began to tremble under its force.
There was no attendant nor guard who dared stay there any longer.
"Ten kilograms of Demon Bone Ash? We couldn't afford it even if we pool our resources." Ying Gu Liang shook his head. "His Highness Dong Bo is indeed quite the bully; he's essentially giving us no way out."
"I'd never accept to kneel for ten thousand years before him in any case!" Venomous Ying World Deity's eyes were filled with madness. "Very good, then. Since he dares act this way, let's see who will be the one who triumphs in the end!"
"Little sister," Ying Gu Liang tried to step in.
"There's no need to say anything else. There's no more turning back from this." The Venomous Ying World Deity sneered. "Let's see just how powerful this Dong Bo Xue Ying is! He's still only a stage two World Deity, yet he dares be so overbearing? Hmph, hmph, hmph."
"He'll most likely become a stage four World Deity within a million years." Ying Gu Liang sighed.
"What can I do, then, seeing how he's not giving me any path to retreat?" the Venomous Ying World Deity angrily retorted before giving another sneer. "In any case, is it not true that he has yet to become a stage four World Deity? In fact, he isn't even a stage three World Deity yet!"
******
The news soon quickly spread, though nobody knew whether the source was the supervisor envoy's residence or General Mo's Eastern Blaze Legion.
In any case, everyone was now aware that the conditions Xue Ying placed in order for his enmity with the Venomous Ying World Deity to be dissolved—was a compensation of ten kilograms of Demon Bone Ash and for her to kneel in front of the supervisor envoy's official residence for ten thousand years. Furthermore, she had to start kneeling within three days.
Day after day passed, with the various superpowers from throughout the entire Calm Sea Prefecture Eastern Region paying close attention. There were even several powers from other regions who caught wind of it. After all, both Xue Ying and the Venomous Ying World Deity were rather famous in the entire Calm Sea Prefecture.
"It has been three days."
"The Venomous Ying World Deity did not show up."
"Let's see how His Highness Dong Bo deals with her, then."
"The way I see it, the Venomous Ying World Deity isn't a fool either, having managed to live for this long. His Highness Dong Bo might have great potential, but his combat power is still just average, and he has no way to do anything to Venomous Ying."
"Let's just watch. Considering Dong Bo's temperament, there'll likely be some action soon!"
Various superpowers were paying close attention to every movement within the official residence of the supervisor envoy, watching out for any event.
Having begun recruiting people for the personal guards for a while, the official residence of the supervisor envoy had already filled up all its spots. After all, while World Deities were quite rare, there was truly an uncountable amount of peak Deities out there. At the moment, the personal guard was only recruiting stage one or two World Deities.
Day after day passed. Ten days, half a month… In the blink of an eye, an entire month was already through.
Even then, no huge movement could be seen happening within the official residence of the supervisor envoy.
The superpowers were sighing inwardly, and even the Venomous Ying World Deity, currently in an anxious state, was beginning to feel frustrated. "It's already been a month since Dong Bo Xue Ying let out those ruthless words, yet there's still no sign of no movement? Hmph. I thought he would do something drastic right away."
******
"Big brother!"
Xue Ying took the initiative in coming out to the entrance of the official residence to welcome a white-robed plump man. This man was in the middle of stroking his beard when he saw Xue Ying coming out, and his eyes could not help but brighten. He let out a laugh. "Brother Dong Bo, I was sure you would have an immeasurable future, but even I didn't consider you might become one of teacher's personal disciples! And you've even become a stage two World Deity within five thousand years. Hehehe, I was shocked silent upon receiving these news."
"Big brother, hurry up and come in. There's no need to give a report whenever you visit me. Just transmit a message straight to me, and I'll handle it," Xue Ying said.
The White Sand City Lord couldn't hide his jubilant mood as he entered the residence and swept his gaze around. Inside, there were countless soldiers walking around, with the ones wearing green armor possessing fierce auras of soldiers. "Right now, you already have a thousand supervision guards, on top of four thousand personal guards! On top of that, these personal guards of yours are even stronger than the average class two legion. Your retinue of soldiers could easily match an ordinary class two legion with of ten thousand soldiers in might. Amazing. Truly incredible. In the entire Calm Sea Prefecture, perhaps only the Prefecture Master's personal guard is stronger than yours."
"This could only be the case because of teacher's generosity." Xue Ying laughed.
The two continued chatting as they walked.
"Dong Bo, those ruthless words you've previously utterred forced the Venomous Ying World Deity to lower her head slightly, but she did not see it as any big deal in reality! At the moment, it's not just the Eastern Region of the Calm Sea Prefecture; the entire Calm Sea Prefecture is paying close attention to this matter." The White Sand City Lord laughed. "If there's anything you want me to do, just say the word! I've always found that Venomous Ying unfavorable to behold."

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - Seeking Shelter
chapters.content:
Chapter 492: Seeking Shelter
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying said, "There's no rush, big brother. I've already decided how to deal with Venomous Ying. As for why I'm not in any hurry to act, that's just because the right time has yet to come. Thousands of years have already passed; a few months more is nothing to be impatient about."
The White Sand City Lord stroked his beard, understanding the situation, and let out a chuckle. "It's good that you've got everything already planned out. Remember, should you need me to act, just send me a message. Others might be afraid of offending that Ying Gu Liang, but I am not."
"He is just an imperial guard. Everything will be fine as long as he remembers to be obedient, but if he does dare stir up trouble, I'll just have to be thick-skinned and tell teacher about the situation," Xue Ying said.
"That's ruthless," the White Sand City Lord praised.
Xue Ying was revered by the various superpowers for two specific reasons. The first had to do with his great potential for the future. The other, however, was his status as a personal disciple under His Majesty! The Bloodshed God Emperor actually placed a lot of value on his personal disciples. If Xue Ying truly went out to tell His Majesty about this issue, the outcome truly would be frightening.
Naturally, Xue Ying was simply stating his options. In reality, it was only when his own combat power could not solve the situation that he would resort to such a thing.
"By the way, Dong Bo." The White Sand City Lord chuckled. "There's this matter I would like to tell you about in advance."
"Pray tell, big brother," Xue Ying said.
"Ai…you're already aware that I've made a blunder back then, and I was chased out of teacher's tutelage," the White Sand City Land began. "Every day until now, I've kept thinking and thinking, trying to find a way to return to teacher's side."
"This…" Xue Ying hesitated.
