Back then, his big brother, the White Sand City Lord, had stolen one of the precious World Sand Heart Fruits from his master, which sent his teacher into a rage, breaking their teacher-disciple relationship in the process. Such matters were truly too difficult to come back from.
"I'm not asking you, Dong Bo, to help me right now. You've only been under teacher's tutelage for a short while, and even if you were to speak out for me, it would likely be useless," the White Sand City Lord quickly added. "I'm aware just how furious teacher was at that time, and even if I want to make amends, it will be very difficult. But I've lived for so long, and more than half of my life went to thinking of this one thing. I only wish to become teacher's disciple once more before my True Deity Heart crumbles apart."
"Big brother… Don't worry. Once my combat power is a bit stronger, and I find the correct opportunity, I'll definitely let teacher know about this matter."
The White Sand City Lord immediately entered a cheery mood, laughing out in joy. "Good. As long as I have your word."
At that moment, two streams of light flew over. One of them belonged to Ge Bai, and the other was an unfamiliar man standing out due to his suntan.
"Why haven't you greeted His Highness yet?" Ge Bai immediately said.
"Bai Li Shang greets Your Highness," the man politely bowed in a hurry.
Xue Ying could tell from Bai Li Shang's aura that he wasn't some ordinary stranger. He was likely a stage two World Deity who came in search of sanctuary. From the moment he began recruiting, including this person, there had been three stage two World Deities who sought him for shelter.
"Brother Bai Li, where have you come from?" Xue Ying asked.
The suntanned man immediately replied, "Reporting to Your Highness: I was originally traveling around the Deity world, looking for adventure and trying to sharpen my combat skills. However, I've already cultivated for more than two billion years…and I seem to be stuck on this road of cultivation. I've been traveling all over the place for a long period of time, and I've been gathering fatigue all the while. Now, I only wish to find a peaceful place where I can cultivate quietly. That is why I decided to seek shelter under Your Highness."
Xue Ying lightly nodded. "Alright. Brother Ge Bai, take Brother Bai Li Shang to a resting place first."
It wasn't long after Xue Ying said this that Ge Bai and the suntanned man turned illusory and then disappeared altogether.
"Hehehe, I've come to meet you randomly, yet there I actually got to see a stage two World Deity coming to seek shelter under you?" The White Sand City Lord sighed. "Tell me, how many stage two World Deities have you recruited so far?"
"It's not that many. Just three," Xue Ying replied.
"And you're saying that's 'not many?' How long has it even been since you started recruiting…" The White Sand City Lord sighed. "If you're to continue recruiting at this pace, you'll likely have more than ten stage two World Deities before long! I've lived for a few billion years already, but even I have no more than eight stage two World Deities under me. Not only that, the majority of them were weaker at first, and they only gradually cultivated and improved to reach their current level. How many were already accomplished in terms of strength when they came to seek shelter under me? I'll tell you—very few of them! Meanwhile, these people can see that you are His Majesty's personal disciple, and they can also sense your extraordinary potential for the future. That's exactly what led them to seek shelter with you from early on. Ai…I'm truly envious of you."
Xue Ying laughed.
"Brother Bai Li, if there's any matter, just come and find me." Ge Bai laughed. "In the future, you shall live here, in this cavern dwelling. As for whether you will become a commander in the personal guard…there's no rush. His Highness will eventually make his selection. With your combat power, even if you don't become a commander, you'll surely be a vice-commander at the very least."
"Thank you, Brother Ge Bai." Bai Li Shang chuckled.
Ge Bai nodded. "I won't keep you any longer then. Rest well. When you're free, you can travel around the place. I've already instructed the female attendants to let you know where you're allowed to go and where you can't enter."
With those final words, Ge Bai left.
Bai Li Shang turned around. The cavern dwelling he received was not the sort that was reserved temporarily for guests. On top of that, he was also a stage two World Deity, so his assigned lodgings occupied an area of several thousand kilometers. World Deities would not be able to practice their cultivation properly unless they had enough space, after all.
"Unless there's an important matter, do not disturb me," Bai Li Shang ordered his attendants. He then quickly entered his personal hall's cultivation room.
Once inside, Bai Li Shang inspected his surroundings and then waved his hand, causing black World Deity energy to fly in all directions so as to shroud the cultivation room. The energy then formed into a complex array that isolated any and all methods of scouting. He had even taken out a specific pendant from his storage treasure, which he then placed in front of his chest. The pendant quickly began to emit waves, enveloping the surroundings and further protecting his room from prying eyes.
Assassins and people with high status, for instance, would usually own time-space isolation treasures which they could use to obscure their surroundings.
Hu.
Bai Li Shang let out a sigh of relief, and a feeling of excitement he could hardly contain overcame him. With a flip of his hand, an ordinary wooden box appeared before him, which he carefully placed down and opened.
A black sphere covered in a large volume of uneven vein patterns could be seen inside this wooden box
I finally have it! Bai Li Shang's eyes beamed with excitement. Monarch Cang Yong took out all the resources he could in an attempt to get his hands on this treasure, even causing our entire group to be killed. Hmph, hmph. Even so, this treasure is finally in my hands.
Bai Li Shang caressed the black sphere in his hand, sending his World Deity energy inside.
Weng!
The initially black sphere gradually brightened up. The uneven patterns on its surface were now glowing, which served to light up the whole area. The sphere formed an extremely complex image of truly unmeasurable might. As he looked toward the image that was floating in mid-air within the cultivation room, Bai Li Shang was quickly engrossed by it. He had already witnessed this image several times before as he fled for his life. It had only been in short bursts, but it was still able to bring about huge changes in his understanding and sensitivity in regard to the Laws of the World.
Within those vast ruins, even stage four World Deity might has lost their lives at any given moment. Seeing how Monarch Cang Yong went so mad over it, this treasure is sure to be extraordinary. Bai Li Shang carefully pondered the item. At first, he had been nothing more than cannon fodder which Monarch Cang Yong forcibly captured after he set out an inescapable web within the ruins. Logically speaking, he should not have been able to escape.
However, the very moment he got his hands on the black sphere, the ruins began to crumble, and the array set down by Monarch Cang Yong followed suit. He had no time to care about others, so as soon as the spacetime within the area turned to chaos, all of the many World Deities that were to be cannon fodder escaped wherever they could.
He, Bai Li Shang, had been the most fortunate of the bunch, having escaped the ruins with the precious relic.
I've been running away all this time, all while moving stealthily and even isolating myself from all spying methods… I've passed through the boundary of the Temporal Island territory before finally reaching the Bloodshed God Palace's turf. And now I'm here, under Dong Bo Xue Ying. Bai Li Shang grinned. Dong Bo should be able to protect me, while Monarch Cang Yong is very unlikely to find me in any case.
Upon finishing his mental recollection, Bai Li Shang began to carefully ponder the black sphere, in search of the secret hidden within.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - Completing the Third Boundary
chapters.content:
Chapter 493: Completing the Third Boundary
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
More than three months had already passed since Xue Ying became a supervisor envoy. By now, it was not only Eastern Region City—the entire Calm Sea Prefecture was waiting to see what kind of action he would took to deal with the Venomous Ying World Deity. However, even after so much time passed, there was still no sign of movement coming from Xue Ying. This degree of calmness from him left people secretly speculating.
"What's going on with this Dong Bo Xue Ying? Is he so lacking in strength that he can't do anything to Venomous Ying?"
"He can't assault Venomous Ying directly. At most, he can deal with her if he makes a petition for help from His Majesty! But if he were to resort to His Majesty's aid for such a small matter, his teacher will think him useless."
"There's no way around it. He might have boundless prospects for the future, but he's still weak for the moment."
Even then, Deities had long lifespans, so they could afford to patiently wait and watch. The way they saw it, Xue Ying had already placed down some ruthless condition on the Venomous Ying World Deity, giving no face to the brother and sister pair; he was sure to take some action sooner or later. It would be nothing more than a disgrace if he dared speak such big words but did not follow them up with any action. What mattered most was that he would make a move. Whether he succeeded or not was less important!
In a room inside supervisor envoy's residence, Xue Ying was sitting cross-legged with nine golden beads placed before him. These beads were emitting streams of golden light, which flowed continuously into Xue Ying's body through his nostrils. Inside his body, his World Deity Energy and the streams of golden light were merging together, undergoing mysterious transformations that eventually changed that original energy into threads of white colored energy. This newly formed white energy was known as Luminous Sun Energy! It was purer, heavier, and sharper than its previous form. His already existing reserve of Luminous Sun Energy also absorbed the golden light coming through his nostrils to undergo a new transformation.
Inside Xue Ying's inner world, a large amount of white clouds appeared instantaneously. They were covering the sky above the continent, with each separate cloud having been formed through the condensation of Luminous Sun Energy.
Hong long long~ The Luminous Sun Energy flowing through Xue Ying's body eventually permeated into his flesh, bones, and internal organs. It even went as far as to fill his most fundamental particles and combine with them. Through this new transformation, Xue Ying could feel the energy of destruction.
After cultivating for more than three months, I've finally succeeded in breaching the third boundary. Xue Ying let out a sigh. It really was difficult. Definitely no easy task. It seemed like it only took a bit over three months, but his real body in the Xia Clan World was actually cultivating times inside Crimson Rock Mountain under a time-accelerated environment of a hundred times the normal flow of time. It was only through the combined effort of his real body in the Xia Clan World and his avatar in Deity world that he could deepen his comprehension and cultivate the"Luminous Sun" to the major success stage.
Xue Ying continued his pondering. The next boundary will be even more difficult to breach. Even with my good comprehension ability, I'm afraid it will still take me quite some time. In truth, Xue Ying was happy to spend his time in cultivation, in spite of the difficulty of reaching each new level. By cultivating, not only could he obtain greater strength, but he could also deepen his understanding toward the Laws of the World which, in turn, would greatly help his future cultivation.
It's about time I make my move on Venomous Ying. Xue Ying stood up and waved his hand to collect the nine Golden Fiend Beads. A long time has already passed, and I have yet to act. Did she begin to think I had no way of dealing with her? Hmph!
Hong long long~ The door to the cultivation room opened, and Xue Ying walked out through it.
Once outside, Xue Ying stood beside some railings, and from there, his clear voice spread throughout the entire official residence, "Commander Bai Li, Commander Jiu Qi, quickly gather our troops."
Before long, the entire official residence of the supervisor envoy turned restless from the great number of soldiers gathering.
Sou sou sou. Like streams of light, Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, Dong Bo Qing Yao, Ge Bai, He Fei Yun, and a few others landed near Xue Ying.
"Xue Ying, why are you gathering your personal guard? What's the plan?" Just as Jing Qiu finished speaking, Dong Bo Yu, who was standing beside her, excitedly stepped in to say, "Father, are you going to deal with that Venomous Ying World Deity?"
"Yes." Xue Ying smiled and nodded.
"Are you certain of your chances?" Jing Qiu asked.
"Don't worry about it," Xue Ying confidently replied.
"Father, take me with you," Dong Bo Qing Yao said, brimming with anticipation.
Dong Bo Yu also requested, "I also want to go."
Xue Ying turned to look at his wife then said, "Alright. I'll take you two as well. Jing Qiu, help me look after them. Don't let them be too impulsive or reckless."
At that point, two imposing groups of soldiers flew over. Every last soldier could be seen wearing green armor, while the leader wore a similar looking armor, only adorned with more black lines. The commanders were each wearing similar-looking green sets of armor, but theirs had more complicated golden lines all over the surface. Each commander acted as the core of a formation of soldiers.
"Greetings, Your Highness." More than two thousand soldiers descended, all of them respectfully greeting him at the same time. Their voices were so loud that it seemed to shake the world. Soon, the two commanders and the rest of the World Deities also came over.
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded before giving his orders, "Commanders Bai Li and Jiu Qi, the two of you will lead the teams in following me. The rest shall remain at the residence, where you will listen to Ge Bai and He Fei Yun."
"Yes." The two answered in unison.
"Xi Wei, you're also coming along." After finishing the arrangements, he ordered in a loud voice, "Let's go!"
Hong~ Xue Ying left the official residence together with his majestic troops.
"They've left."
"HIs Highness, Dong Bo Xue Ying is finally making a move."
"He set out together with more than two thousand of his personal guard." There were many eyes affixed on Xue Ying's every movements, included those which belonged to the Venomous Ying World Deity's faction. Upon seeing such a huge mobilization, the spies of the Venomous Ying World Deity quickly made their report.
Xue Ying didn't particularly care to prevent that activity. He simply took his personal guard to the eastern part of the city, to a vast area belonging to the Eastern Blaze Legion.
General Mo was already waiting outside the Eastern Blaze Legion barracks. He was standing next to the gate alongside several soldiers to welcome Xue Ying.
Xue Ying landed in front of General Mo with his personal guard in tow as he greeted, "General Mo."
"I'm afraid I don't know why Your Highness has come to my abode together with so many soldiers?" General Mo said with a smile.
"It's been a while since I took on the role of supervisor envoy, but I have yet to do anything worthy of this position. I felt ashamed that such a thing would happen, so I have come to perform my duty. In other words, I am here on an inspection," Xue Ying replied in a straightforward manner.
"I shall cooperate with Your Highness. Please, be at ease," General Mo complied.
"Let's talk inside, then." Xue Ying entered first, accompanied by General Mo. Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, and Dong Bo Qing Yao all took a look at the barrack first before quickly entering alongside the rest of the soldiers.
"What kind of orders does Your Highness have? Please, feel free to tell this general," General Mo said, humbly. It was a given that he would act this way; he had a high position in Calm Sea Prefecture, being even above the other four generals, but his personal strength was relatively low. He was unlike General Wu, who could be counted as one of the top stage three World Deities, and Marshal Qin, who was supported by a huge backer.
In front of Xue Ying, General Mo naturally took on a humble attitude.
"How many starfields does the Nest of Myriad Devils rule over?" Xue Ying asked.
It's coming. The Nest of Myriad Devils is a force ruled by the Venomous Ying World Deity. It seems like Xue Ying is really planning to deal with her, General Mo thought to himself.
"They control thirty-two starfields. They are also responsible for the collection of faith in those starfields," General Mo replied.
"Bring out all the records regarding the collection of faith done by the Nest of Myriad Devils. All the records, from the very first to the latest one," Xue Ying ordered right after he entered the hall.
"Yes. Why aren't you moving yet?" General Mo lashed out to his underling.
It only took a short moment for a high ranking World Deity officer to come over. Dong dong dong. Three trunks appeared as he waved his hand, and with another wave, the trunks opened. Each of the tree containers was filled with scrolls.
Xue Ying looked over the trunks, and his fiery-red World Deity Energy spread over and penetrated every last scroll. How fast were the thought processes of a World Deity? He finished checking all of the scrolls almost instantaneously.
"Interesting." Xue Ying turned over to General Mo. "Is it just me, or does the Nest of Myriad Devils not have that much faith energy?"
**

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - The Soldiers Arrive at the Newst of Myriad Devils
chapters.content:
Chapter 494: The Soldiers Arrive at the Newst of Myriad Devils
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The Bloodshed God Palace arranged for each of the countless planets within their territory, to have their many lifeforms put their faith in certain powerful Deities! After placing a 'Deity Image' on the planet, they could then condense the faith energy into an item. The various superpowers would then proceed with collecting these items and sending a portion as tribute upward. However, since the legion was unable to pervade every last planet, due to a shortage of manpower, it was impossible for them to truly control this process. Therefore, it was not uncommon for the many World Deity superpowers to spread their roots even deeper all over the many planets! They would then be responsible for collecting faith energy, which was an extremely complex task.
As for the others who sought faith, they would have to be daring enough to steal the faith energy directly from a planet!
Even so, lured by their desire to become World Deities, many late stage Deities, or even peak Deities, would commit to this risk! As a result, enough control over a planet was necessary in order to make sure that faith energy was not pilfered.
The Xia Clan World was a good example. After Xue Ying grasped hold of the Mirage Deity Heart, he was able to block the transmission of faith energy from the Xia Clan World into the external world, which left the World Deity from the Temple of the Earth God anxious, even making him go as far as to send a Deity Avatar down in hopes of regaining the faith energy.
Faith energy…was known to be even more valuable than Deity crystals! Or so was the case for everyone except for people like Xue Ying; if one's goal was to become a powerful existence, they would absolutely not absorb any faith energy. However, most other World Deities were absolutely willing to do so, since it would aid them in their cultivation. If someone like Xue Ying used faith energy, he could have easily cultivated the "Luminous Sun" to the fourth boundary, and he would have even become a stage three World Deity already.
Faith energy lent itself to bringing about a qualitative change in one's cultivation.
"The Nest of Myriad Devils controls thirty-two starfields in total? Why is it that the faith energy they've collected is so pitiful, then?" Xue Ying sneered.
"The reason is recorded above," General Mo began. "The starfields under their rule saw frequent cases of Deities stealing their faith energy, while large scale wars in the past resulted in a reduction of human population."
Xue Ying sighed. "All of those starfields under their control see such things happening frequently, you say? Aren't they extraordinarily unfortunate? General Mo, have you ever gone over to investigate? Can you confirm that their reports are correct?"
General Mu helplessly replied, "That is… This eastern region of the Calm Sea Prefecture is so vast, and there are so many planets in it. Even if I were to visit each of those planet one by one, would I even be able to conduct a proper investigation? Could I reverse time on every single planet? Such a thing is would not be feasible! Don't worry though, our intel is complete, with each report containing the name of who went to collect each planet's faith energy."
Xue Ying sneered.
His Majesty really was relatively lax in terms of his management of the various strata belonging to the Bloodshed God Palace.
However, the places like the Nest of Myriad Devils which dared to be so excessive in how they went about such matters were still the minority. Most other superpowers would never dare be so upfront! The Nest of Myriad Devils relied on Ying Gu Liang, after all, as well as General Mo who closed an eye on their business, allowing them to report a tribute of faith energy that was much lower than what was expected of them.
"Alright. I'll be taking these scrolls with me," Xue Ying said. "There's no issue with that, right?"
"Naturally," General Mu replied.
"Let's go!" Xue Ying waved his hand to store the wooden trunks on his person. Soon after he left the palace hall, an enormous emerald ship appeared in mid-air, upon which Xue Ying and his large group of subordinates then flew onto.
Sou.
The Starfield Flying Ship flew away with great speed, quickly disappearing into the horizon.
General Mo watched it depart from afar.
"General, does His Highness plan to gather the faith energy for himself?" an old man with a long beard asked.
"The Venomous Ying World Deity and Ying Gu Liang have been stuffing their pockets with faith energy for a very long time. Adding everything up, they should have gathered faith energy with an approximate value of eight hundred million Deity crystals." General Mo sneered. "However, even Ying Gu Liang has to distribute some to that to the officials in charge over at the Bloodshed God Palace, so the brother and sister pair likely only has about five hundred million Deity crystals worth of energy."
"I personally have no way to deal with those people, but His Highness, Dong Bo… Hehe, His Highness has His Majesty backing him. There's no better backing anyone could ever have," General Mo said. "Things should be getting interesting."
******
The Starfield Flying Ship passed through the spacetime passage, rushing over to the Nest of Myriad Devils.
The Nest of Myriad Devils took the form of many enormous mountains amidst a vast starry sky. These mountains were so tall that each occupied an area of more than a few hundred million kilometers. There was also a black fog shrouding the mountain range, and countless venomous snakes slithered within. Countless Deities lived here, and even a number of World Deities. In total, there were five stage two World Deities, most of them specializing in hexing poison. After all, the Venomous Ying World Deity was known as the strongest expert in terms of hexing poison in the entire Calm Sea Prefecture, and the large amount of poisonous substances within the Nest of Myriad Devils made it a truly appropriate location for researching hexing poison.
"Quick, take a look."
"It's a Starfield Flying Ship."
"That's a Starfield Flying Ship. Send a report to master, quickly." The social stratification within the Nest of Myriad Devils was quite strict. Soon, the Venomous Ying World Deity herself flew out from an enormous palace. By her side was a short subordinate, and to her back was a group of stage two and stage one World Deities. As for Deities, there were so many that they were practically uncountable. From a glance, it seemed like there were more than a hundred million Deities with her.
The Nest of Myriad Devils seemed to be quite tyrannical indeed.
The Venomous Ying World Deity watched on with a sneer. In the distance, an enormous Starfield Flying Ship was crushing apart the void to fly over. There where rows upon rows of green-armored soldiers standing on the deck of this ship, every single one of them displaying a powerful aura. Every last one reached the combat power of a new World Deity, after all.
Even though there were only two thousand soldiers on this ship, the collective aura they emitted completely surpassed that of the hundreds of millions of Deities below!
This was the qualitative difference between a legion of Bloodshed God Palace and a bunch of troops from all over the place!
Hua~ The green-armored soldiers rapidly flew out to occupy some space in the void, and the Starfield Flying Ship soon disappeared.
Xue Ying flew out to stand at the very forefront of the legion, together with Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao, and Xi Wei.
"Dare I ask you, supervisor envoy, why you have come?" The Venomous Ying World Deity sneered. "I have reached at a crucial moment in my cultivation, so unless you are here on an important matter, I'm afraid I can't accompany you."
"Venomous Ying," Xue Ying shouted. "After investigating the collection of faith energy, I've discovered that the amount of faith energy you have sent upwards is suspiciously small! I want you to bring out every last person who was responsible for collection in your Nest of Myriad Devils. I want to interrogate every single one of them."
"They are all dead," the Venomous Ying World Deity casually replied.
"All dead?" Xue Ying frowned. "You control thirty-two starfields, with so many planets under your rule, yet you want me to believe that every last one of those million Deities who were responsible for collecting faith are all dead?"
"I'm telling you they're dead." The Venomous Ying World Deity sighed. "I was researching my hexing poison, and a careless mistake on my part caused the experimental poison to spread out, sending countless Deities to their deaths. If they're dead, they're dead. Supervisor envoy…there's nothing I can do about it."
Could she really send those responsible for the collection over? She would not hand over even a single one.
It was enough to investigate one of those people thoroughly, or even just to reverse time to view what happened on the the many planets, and the truth would easily come out. Therefore, she had already decided not to hand a single one of them over.
Xue Ying sneered after understanding the situation. "A total of one million Deities were responsible for collecting faith energy, yet every last one died. What a miraculous outcome. You may believe that lie, but I do not. I doubt any of the officials responsible in the Bloodshed God Palace would accept it either."
"If you don't want to believe it, there's nothing I can do about it either way. It's just the reality," the Venomous Ying World Deity replied. "If you truly don't trust me, you can go ahead and search this Nest of Myriad Devils to your heart's content."
"One million Deities, and they're all dead! Can there be that big of a coincidence?" Xue Ying roared. "Your excuse, Venomous Ying World Deity, is beyond belief. I'm afraid I can only capture you and send you over to the Bloodshed God Palace. There, you will be interrogated to find out the truth. Hear my orders! Commander Bai Li, capture the Venomous Ying World Deity and send her over to the Bloodshed God Palace for me! Deities of the Nest of Myriad Devils, do not attempt to resist. Anyone who resists…will be judged as having disobeyed the Bloodshed God Palace and will be sentenced to death!"
"Yes!" Commander Bai Li Shang acknowledged. His subordinates all revealed the killing intent in their eyes, one after one.
This was to be the very first battle they would participate in after joining Xue Ying's personal guard.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 495 - Capture!
chapters.content:
Chapter 495: Capture!
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Hold it!" a voice suddenly cut through the void. The one whom the voice belonged to was the short man standing next to the Venomous Ying World Deity.
Xue Ying looked over.
This short man was garbed in black, and his voice was bright as he said, "Your Highness Dong Bo, I have come under the orders of my clan master."
"Your clan master?" Xue Ying waved his hand to stop his subordinates. "Unless I'm mistaken, you are World Deity Dong Xiao, and your clan master is Monarch Wu Chen, right?"
"Indeed." The short man chuckled.
Monarch Wu Chen was a stage four World Deity and one of the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master's pupils.
However, it was widely known that Monarch Wu Chen was totally engrossed in his personal cultivation, so it seemed to make no sense that he would send someone to protect Venomous Ying World Deity. Xue Ying was puzzled at this turn of events.
Xue Ying's subordinates began to hesitate upon hearing that. A stage four World Deity was now involved! Any stage four World Deity could become the overlord of any territory he was found at! Anyone would feel restraining fear and hesitation at the thought of them.
"That's right. I have come at Monarch Wu Chen's order." The short man laughed. "I also think this matter about faith energy is a misunderstanding. We just sit down and resolve the misunderstanding, don't you think? Your Highness Dong Bo, how about giving some face to my clan master?"
"Is Monarch Wu Chen sure he wants to intervene on this matter?" Xue Ying frowned.
The enmity he shared with Venomous Ying was no secret!
Now that Monarch Wu Chen dared to intervene, trying to forbid him from carrying out his vengeance, was it not the case that he disregarded Xue Ying completely? Why would Monarch Wu Chen, who was always so mad and focused on cultivating, do such a thing?
"Since the monarch has said such, he naturally wants to intervene." The short man frowned. "Do you plan on not giving him any face, Your Highness Dong Bo?"
To the side, the Venomous Ying World Deity let out a sneer.
"The Venomous Ying World Deity is suspected to have stolen a large amount of faith energy over the years. But now, the million people responsible for collecting that faith energy tribute are all dead. Such a situation is too strange, so I must bring her back to the Bloodshed God Palace for interrogation," Xue Ying coldly said. "World Deity Dong Xiao, it would be best if you left now."
The short man was startled, and the Venomous Ying World Deity just as shocked.
"You would dare?!" The short man immediately launched into a fury. "You would actually dare challenge my clan master?"
"Your clan master? You've asked me to give him face when he did not show me any." Xue Ying's eyes betrayed his fury. "Everyone, proceed!"
"Yes!"
Commander Bai Li Shang immediately acknowledged the order.
Hong!
Commander Bai Li, the commanders of the other ten teams, and the soldiers all began to activate the seals on their armor sets. For that moment, the mighty legion acted like a single entity. At the same time, Commander Bai Li hacked out with his greataxe, which followed a great arc across the sky to cut down fiercely upon his opponents! Hong long long. The axe was followed by the might of the entire legion. In truth, this fierce attack he sent out had already reached the level of an entry stage three World Deity.
The axe tore through the sky, and in a flash, it appeared right in front of the Venomous Ying World Deity.
In response, the Venomous Ying World Deity's figure suddenly enlarged to an enormous degree. Her tail wriggled and twisted, and Xue Ying's personal guard of two thousand thousand looked like no more than ants in front of her. The upper half of her body remained humanoid, and an titanic poisonous trident had appeared in her hands. At the same time, the black fog previously surrounding the Nest of Myriad Devils came rolling forward to envelop her body.
This was her territory, which she fortified by setting down numerous arrays, strengthening it greatly over the years. Her combat power here was much more powerful than normal! Normally, she could not fight a head-on battle, but as long as she remained within her territory, her combat prowess in close quarters combat was tremendously larger. Every single action she took was backed by incredible might.
"Scram." The Venomous Ying World Deity hurled her tail over.
Hua-
The tail moved through the void along an arc in a tyrannical fashion, intercepting the incoming axe. At the sight, Commander Bai Li's expression changed slightly. At the same time, all of the soldiers, including him, retreated a small amount under the backlash.
"Mn?" Xue Ying frowned. "The way I've heard it, this Venomous Ying shouldn't be any good in close-combat battles, since her specialty is hexing poison. To think she could actually fight this thousand-strong legion, and even push them back… Looks like the arrays set down on her territory have truly strengthened her by quite a bit."
"Again."
"Surround her."
Commander Bai Li he brought along the soldiers under his command under another joint attack.
"You can all get lost!" The Venomous Ying World Deity waved her poisonous trident in a savage, mighty strike. After the impact, the personal guards were left dispersed all over the place. The ordinary soldiers had been flung backward, smashing against the mountainy rocks of the distant Nest of Myriad Devils, while several were hurled all the way into the void. Even so, with the army array enhancement provided by the Bloodshed God Palace, these people with combat power of new World Deities could all display the might of a true World Deity. The impact of this attack they had just received had been spread through the entire array, allowing everyone to remain uninjured.
"Your Highness, this Venomous Ying World Deity's is too strong in close combat. We can't deal with her," Commander Bai Li anxiously transmitted a message.
Xue Ying's personal guard could merely match the might of any ordinary stage three World Deity.
But now, under the strengthening effect of the arrays set down on her territory, the Venomous Ying World Deity could unleash a tyrannical power comparable to the most powerful stage three World Deities. Much less this single legion, even two like it would be able to fight an even battle at most, but they still could not hope to capture her.
"I am a member of the Bloodshed God Palace as well, and I have an official position of the fifth rank. Dong Bo Xue Ying, you are just a supervisor envoy; you do not have the right to capture me." The Venomous Ying World Deity was standing in the void, her enormous tail fiercely sweeping from left to right to smash those soldiers back while she sneered at Xue Ying.
This was meant to be an altercation.
Xue Ying's position was truly not that incredible. Even he did not even have the authority to punish a World Deity with a fifth rank official position.
At the same time, if he truly was to capture her and bring her back to the Bloodshed God Palace, and if the interrogation determined that she truly did not commit any crimes, Xue Ying would be punished instead. If she did commit the crimes, however, this little matter of him having gone against the rules would be mostly disregarded.
The problem, however, was that his legion could not capture the Venomous Ying World Deity!
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, your subordinates are not strong enough, yet they still dare come up to try and capture me?" The enormous figure of the Venomous Ying World Deity looked toward the group of soldiers as if they were ants. "My cultivation is focused on hexing poison, and I've long since turned my body into a hexing poison body. On top of that, I have these arrays set down here, at the Nest of Myriad Devils. Do you truly think yourself able to deal with someone like me?"
"Hexing poison body? Strengthening from the arrays of Myriad Devils' Nest?"
Without warning, Xue Ying extended his right hand.
That palm of his that looked as gentle as jade suddenly expanded explosively. Within moments, it reached a length of roughly five hundred thousand kilometers. It tore through the void with mighty force! It must be stated that the Time Immemorial Body would transform every single particle of one's body into a Time Immemorial World. Every last particle that constituted his body would thus fundamentally be a Time Immemorial World. Once the user reached a stage of major success, just how big would their body be?
A single finger would most likely be a few hundred millions kilometers large!
Naturally, Xue Ying had merely trained his Time Immemorial Body to the sixth level, but if he truly were to bring his Deity body to its real size, it would be huge without a doubt.
After expanding his arm, he slapped out using his palm; his five fingers looked like five pillars holding the heavens. At the same time, white streams of light began to revolve around those fingers, giving them an appearance of being as pure and holy as a transcendent crystal.
"Haha, that is pitiful, Highness Dong Bo. This is not about who can make their palm bigger." Venomous Ying World Deity cackled, her voice reverberating all throughout the void. However, she did not seem to be giving any qualms; she ruthlessly swung her enormous tail out with unparalleled strength. It lashed out directly against the enormous palm.
Peng!
The enormous palm that seemed to block out the void slapped out, while the Venomous Ying World Deity's tail swung over. Soon, the two clashed.
The enormous palm paused for no more than a moment before striking out with an even fiercer feeling of oppression. The Venomous Ying World Deity's eyes went wide at the sight. "That's impossible!" She failed to escape in time, and with a peng sound, the enormous palm struck her straight-on, sending her flying back into the tall mountains of the Nest of Myriad Devils. The palm was so powerful that it left an enormous imprint on the towering mountain, while countless rocks were blown out in every directions.
"What?!" The short man, World Deity Dong Xiao, eyes went wide at the sight. He seemed like he couldn't believe what he was seeing as he turned toward the Venomous Ying World Deity. Despite having been strengthened by the Nest of Myriad Devils, she had actually been slapped right back into the mountain.
Behind him, the World Deities belonging to the Nest of Myriad Devils, and the hundreds of millions of Deities were all in disbelief.
And not just them—even the subordinates Xue Ying brought along, as well as Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao, were startled at the sight of how powerful their father's palm strike was.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - Overbearing, Terrifying!
chapters.content:
Chapter 496: Overbearing, Terrifying!
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Powerful combat power, that was the true way to intimidate someone!
Once the ones present at the scene saw the terrifying might behind Xue Ying's strike, they were all left in shock and disbelief, and the status they had assigned to Xue Ying in their hearts was surging ever upward. By now, it was not just Xue Ying's potential that was great; his actual combat power had already reached such a terrifying stage that he could easily intimidate others.
Hu.
The Venomous Ying World Deity suddenly disappeared, while large amounts of fog appeared all over the place and eventually condensed into another Venomous Ying World Deity. She was standing there, holding onto her poisonous trident and looking at Xue Ying in disbelief. She was the only one to truly feel that palm strike with her own skin, and she clearly realized just how powerful it was.
In an instant, Xue Ying's figure expanded to a towering height of about five million kilometers. He then extended his right hand, with which he grabbed his scarlet-red spear that had just appeared like a huge blazing fire.
The Luminous Sun Force truly is as powerful as expected. Xue Ying inwardly sighed in praise.
The "Luminous Sun" absolute art had been known throughout the Bloodshed God Palace by one phrase: Like the dazzling, strong sun, it can conquer any obstacle in its path.
Just how dazzling was the Bloodshed God Emperor himself? Even he had commended this absolute art.
That was precisely because the "Luminous Sun" was an extremely overbearing absolute art. It must be stated that a qualitative gap existed in-between the usage of the :aws of any stage two and a stage three World Deity. This was one of the main facts that made it extremely difficult to surpass one's own realm during battle.
But absolute arts would bring about great advantages in certain aspects, covering up weaknesses in terms of the usage of :aws.
It was similar to how the legions of the Bloodshed God Palace could depend on the legion arrays. These arrays had been personally crafted by His Majesty, the Bloodshed God Emperor himself, so it was only natural that their strength would be so great.
In a similar fashion, the "Luminous Sun" absolute art granted its user tyrannical strength and extreme speed! It took after the sun, which was dazzling and strong! After Xue Ying brought his cultivation up to the third boundary of the second volume, his strength and speed already eclipsed stage three World Deities! Even if he was weaker than them in terms of his usage of the :aws, he could still triumph over them in battle!
After all, once someone successfully cultivated to the third boundary of the second volume of this absolute art, they would be able to suppress stage three World Deities!
That was how imposingly powerful this absolute art was! Like the dazzling, strong sun, it would conquer any obstacle in its path.
"Venomous Ying, stop resisting. You're no longer able to defend yourself." Xue Ying brandished his enormous Scarlet Cloud Spear. The Luminous Sun Force passed through the entire spear, causing it to reach an even higher level! Xue Ying thoroughly understood that, on that first strike, his opponent had been careless, having tried to match force with force. After losing out once, the Venomous Ying World Deity was unlikely to take the same approach and would definitely try to overpower him through the Laws of Profound Mysteries.
In that case, Xue Ying simply had to be more imposing. He would not show any mercy.
Cheng.
The Venomous Ying World Deity attempted to flee, yet faced with the omnipresent lashes of the enormous spear, she couldn't help but try to make use of her poisonous trident, employing mystical waves to try and guide the incoming spear away.
She was no longer trying to overpower the spear, and instead tried to rely on the Laws of Profound Mysteries to battle.
Even then, once the two weapons clashed—despite it not being any more than a very slight contact and much unlike the previous clash of power—the Venomous Ying World Deity could still feel a terrifying impact rushing out from her weapon and into her body, sending her flying all the way back into the mountain behind. As she hit the mountain, her body gouged out a hole in it. At the sight of it, her complexion paled even further. I'm not even trying to overpower him through force any longer, yet even the slightest bit of contact with his weapon still sent me flying backward. His close combat power is too strong, stronger than even White Sand's.
The White Sand City Lord could triumph in battle because of his Annihilation White Sand, but in a close-combat encounter, even he would not match up to Xue Ying.
It was mostly due to the Luminous Sun Force within his body, but it was also because Xue Ying specialized most in close combat.
"Dong Xiao, you still haven't moved to help me?" the Venomous Ying World Deity transmitted. "Don't tell me you forgot about your clan master's orders."
"Don't worry," Dong Xiao replied with a gulp. In truth, he did not wish to act. Xue Ying was simply that overbearing! To think that a stage two World Deity could be so so strong already… Even then, in spite of his unwillingness, he had already received his orders from Monarch Wu Chen to protect the Venomous Ying World Deity.
Hua.
Dong Xiao took a single step to arrive right next to the Venomous Ying World Deity, and a black saber appeared in his hand.
"Are you still resisting capture?" Xue Ying continued his display of spear techniques, every one of his moves being so fierce and ferocious that the Nest of Myriad Devils by the side began to crumble and shatter from its foundations. Many of the arrays had already been destroyed, and even with Dong Xiao now working together with the Venomous Ying World Deity, they were still completely suppressed. At most, they could try to evade the incoming attacks and rely on their superior usage of the Laws to keep struggling.
"How come this feels similar to fighting General Wu?" Dong Xiao felt his heart trembling.
"If you had been facing General Wu, you would not have been able to struggle for so long," the Venomous Ying World Deity replied, despite her heart having already turned bitter. The Nest of Myriad Devils where she had lived for such as long time was being destroyed and damaged before her eyes. Apparently, it was quite easy to break the construct apart; as long as a minor part of the arrays was damaged, the entire array would become useless. Half of the supporting power which the Venomous Ying World Deity received from the arrays was already lost.
Xue Ying shouted out with a frown, "Stop struggling!"
Hong hong hong hong hong hong hong!
Many enormous figures could now be seen forming all around the void, each and and every one of them taking the form of a towering Xue Ying at five million kilometers in height. Nine Xue Yings had formed in the void, for a total of ten when also including the one wielding the Scarlet Cloud Spear.
"Kill." These nine World bodies, if not for them not having a blood-refined Deity warrior each, would not lose out to the true body in terms of pure strength. Each wielded its own spear and were all tyrannical in might.
Hua.
Countless white tips began flying out all around the black-robed Xue Ying. They began to move in a criss-cross motion with one another, rapidly shrouding both Dong Xiao and the Venomous Ying World Deity.
Xue Ying had clearly lost his patience and decided to just display his killing move to capture Venomous Ying in one fell swoop!
World Prison!
Nine World bodies!
"This…this is just…I'm starting to feel like he's even more terrifying than General Wu." Dong Xiao looked up at the ten enormous figures of Xue Ying and could immediately tell that he could not match even one of them in strength. As soon as the white tips arrived and restricted him, he was overcome by fear. He quickly waved his hand to grab the Venomous Ying World Deity and said, "Let's flee!"
Si la.
Spacetime began distorting, and Dong Xiao pulled along the Venomous Ying World Deity to escape through it. Clearly, this was a World Deity ranked secret technique focused on spacetime.
Xue Ying frowned. By now, his biggest weakness was related to his movement techniques. After all, he had yet to make any improvements related to spacetime. On top of that, none of the secret techniques which he cultivated in were of any use when it came to movement.
"You want to escape?" Xue Ying waved his hand, and a Starfield Flying Ship immediately appeared in the void before him.
Sou sou sou sou sou sou…
His ten figures then immediately landed on it. When it came to piercing through spacetime passage, was there even any secret technique which could surpass a Starfield Flying Ship?
"Xi Wei, you guys will wait for me here and protect my wife and the others in the meantime. I'll come back in a while," Xue Ying's voice had yet to reverberate by the time he had already disappeared using his flying ship.
"Yes, Your Highness."
Xi Wei, Commander Bai Li, Commander Jiu Qi all acknowledged the order.
Everyone watching the battle from the side had a hint of terror and astonishment in their eyes. One Xue Ying had already been so tyrannical, but for ten of them to have appeared at the same time? That was nothing short of excessive! He had actually beaten both Dong Xiao and Venomous Ying to the point that they had to flee.
"Father is…father is just too powerful!" Dong Bo Yu's eyes brightened up. "Truly…this is just…"
Everyone present, including the World Deities from the Nest of Myriad Devils and the hundreds of millions of Deities had watched the battle in complete astonishment.
The way they saw it, any one of Xue Ying's body had enough destructive power to wipe all of out with a single thought.
"Quick, let's get out. Quickly now!" Dong Xiao and the Venomous Ying World Deity found themselves in a difficult situation, despite having fled through the spacetime passage. By now, both had entered their own Starfield Flying Ship. Previously, they had been trapped in the World Prison, and they did not have the time to take out a Starfield Flying Ship while under the joint attack of ten Xue Yings.
"You guys can forget about escaping." A starfield flying ship had already appeared behind them. Xue Ying was staring at them from the bow of said ship's deck. With a thought from his part, hua hua hua, his nine world bodies appeared right next to Dong Xiao and the Venomous Ying World Deity, each of them holding onto their own spear. With a horizontal sweep, they separated Dong Xiao and Venomous Ying World Deity from each other.
Chi chi chi~
Countless white tips appeared, restricting the two.
As they watched the surrounding white tips restrict them and the nine Xue Yings surround them, the two World Deities fell into despair.
"How… how could this be? How long has it even been?" The Venomous Ying World Deity simply could not believe the situation. Just a while ago, Xue Ying was nothing more than an ant to her, but he had become so powerful in what seemed like the blink of an eye. She was beaten like a stray dog. No, unlike a stray dog, she had no way of escaping!

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - Evidence is Not Proof
chapters.content:
Chapter 497: Evidence is Not Proof
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Venomous Ying and Dong Xiao left the tunnel in spacetime to reappear amidst a starry sky.
As soon as they left, however, they were surrounded by no fewer than ten Xue Yings, each of them with spear in hand. They found themselves separated before long. On top of that, they were restricted and bound on all sides by the countless flowing chains of white light. The Venomous Ying World Deity turned into a black stream of air in an attempt to avoid the bindings, while Dong Xiao brandished his knife to cleave the chains apart as he said, "Your Highness, I've arrived at the Nest of Myriad Devils on order from above for the sake of resolving the enmity between you and Venomous Ying. My clan master wishes to protect her; could it be that you truly plan to go against this wish of his?"
The black-robed Xue Ying looked toward Dong Xiao, fury evident in his eyes.
Seeing how Monarch Wu Chen had meddled in his affairs, he was surely aware of the enmity between him and Venomous Ying. Yet even knowing that, Monarch Wu Chen still unexpectedly tried to make him give up him enmity just with a few words?
"Can you say for sure that, if I were to deal with Venomous Ying, your Clan Master would become my enemy?" Xue Ying looked to Dong Xiao with a chill in his gaze.
Dong Xiao tensed.
Become his enemy?
It was true that Monarch Wu Chen had told him to resolve the enmity while protecting World Deity Venomous Ying, but he never mentioned anything about becoming Xue Ying's enemy.
Furthermore, Dong Xiao had just felt Xue Ying's formidable strength on his own skin, and it was enough to leave incomparably fear in his heart. For just how long had he even cultivated? With only six thousand years of cultivation, Xue Ying was already able to beat two stage three World Deities—Venomous Ying and Dong Xiao—like stray dogs; they did not have the slightest ability to retaliate. Just thinking of it left him feeling somewhat terrified. He was too young. After a few tens of thousands more years passed, what level would Dong Bo Xue Ying even reach?
"Dong Bo!" The nearby Venomous Ying World Deity clenched her teeth. "Monarch Wu Chen has personally made a promise to protect me! Do you truly wish to become his enemy? Monarch Wu Chen is very close in might to a powerful existence, and his master is the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Lord!"
"Oh? You're saying that just dealing with you would make me Monarch Wu Chen's enemy? I think you're overestimating yourself." Xue Ying sneered. "And even if I were to become Monarch Wu Chen's enemy, do you really believe I'd give a crap?"
The Venomous Ying World Deity was stunned, and Dong Xiao was just as startled.
Would he care about it?
Indeed, Monarch Wu Chen's strength was tyrannical, and he was one of the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Lord's disciples; he had no need to fear Xue Ying in the slightest! But at the same time, would Xue Ying be afraid of him? He was such a person whose pride could afford to reach the heavens, being someone who had the upper hand over stage three World Deities with just a few thousand years of cultivation! On top of that, he was His Majesty's personal disciple, and a Realm Lord on top of that. Would he really be afraid?
"Venomous Ying, there's nothing more I can do." Dong Xiao sighed. "Dong Bo's strength far surpasses our expectations, and I'm finding myself now at wit's end.
"You, you…" Venomous Ying's expression was anxious.
"Venomous Ying, just be obedient and come with me to the Bloodshed God Palace. Why not just accept their investigation?" There was a now trace of ridicule in Xue Ying's eyes. "If I really am wrongly accusing you, I'm afraid I'll even suffer a punishment! It's only if you truly committed a crime that the Bloodshed God Palace will punish you.
Venomous Ying's complexion turned ugly. She had lied as she wished up until now, but she knew that, as soon as she was investigated by the Bloodshed God Palace, many holes would be revealed in her story.
While stealing massive amounts of faith energy was not considered a capital offense, and she could avoid the worst types of punishment, she would see plenty of hard times ahead! The punishment would still be extremely frightening. After being tortured and punished for many years…she might just find out after being let go that Xue Ying had already become a stage four World Deity. Should that time come, he would be able to bully her as he wished.
"No. I'm not going. There's no way I'm going." Venomous Ying World Deity seemed to have turned completely mad. She turned to Dong Xiao and said, "Dong Xiao, what is Monarch Wu Chen saying. Won't he come?"
"Monarch Wu Chen isn't from the Calm Sea Prefecture, and even if he rushed over in a Starfield Flying Ship, it would still take him quite a while to arrive." Dong Xiao shook his head. "Don't look at me. I'm sure you already understand that I simply have no way of resisting."
"You…"
Venomous Ying then anxiously turned to look toward Xue Ying, "Dong Bo Xue Ying, you're very good, and I'll be first to admit that I was overlooking you. I did not expect that the tiny peak Deity from back then would become this formidable in just a few thousand years! That being said, I will not go to the Bloodshed God Palace with you today even if I die. And if I say that I don't want to go to the Bloodshed God Palace, what can you do about it?"
Hua hua hua~
Although the countless flowing white light shackles were surrounding them on all sides, they failed to trap the Venomous Ying World Deity in any way. Xue Ying was, after all, just a stage two World Deity, and his comprehension was simply insufficient. Although he could directly suppress the two, he could not seal Venomous Ying's True Deity Heart or her World Deity Energy.
"Eh?" Xue Ying also found it unexpected that Venomous Ying would actually rather die than agree to go to the Bloodshed God Palace.
"Do you dare kill me? You have no evidence to prove my guilt, and neither do you have any right to kill a third stage World Deity with a fifth rank official position like me. Forget you, even the Calm Sea Prefecture Lord himself would have no right to kill me." Venomous Ying looked at Xue Ying and sneered. "Kill me, and you will have gone against the laws of the Bloodshed God Palace!
The Venomous Ying World Deity looked at Xue Ying while also transmitting out a message to to inform Monarch Wu Chen that she was sealed off. "Monarch, Dong Xiao simply has no means to help me, and Xue Ying does not seem to plan on giving up. Quickly, come save me. You promised you would."
What could he do?
His comprehension was still weak, and he was simply unable to seal the other party's True Deity Heart. If his personal guard had been with him, as a legion of the Bloodshed God Palace, they had formation methods available which they could use to imprison the enemy. However, he had been in a hurry, so he passed through a spacetime tunnel alone, and the distance from his current location to the Nest of Myriad Devils was too large. Even if he dispatched a World Deity energy avatar together with the Starfield Flying Ship to bring back his personal guard, as soon as he was left without his Starfield Flying Ship, Dong Xiao would be able to immediately flee with Venomous Ying using a spacetime related secret technique.
Damn it.
If he sent his Starfield Flying Ship back to bring his personal guard, the enemy would escape, but if he didn't bring his personal guard over, he alone could neither seal nor capture Venomous Ying. Neither path was any good.
"We two are both members of the Bloodshed God Palace, and we must follow their laws. We cannot simply fight and kill as we wish." Venomous Ying stared at Xue Ying. "I'm afraid there is no chance I'll be going back to the Bloodshed God Palace with you on this day. In truth, you were only a Deity back then, so I had acted in a slightly excessive manner. Would I be so stupid as to become your enemy now?"
Her mouth kept spewing out words, but inwardly, she was anxiously waiting. The more time she could waste, the more hope there was that Monarch Wu Chen could hurry over! Once he arrived, he would be able to easily save her.
Hmph. Once Monarch Wu Chen saves me, there will be no chance for you to ever retaliate, Venomous Ying inwardly said. Since our enmity is already irreconcilable… Hmph, hmph, I'll let you know what it means to offend me.
A great many schemes were brewing within Venomous Ying's heart when all of a sudden—
Hong!
A dazzling ray of red light streaked across the sky and faded away just as quickly. As soon as it appeared, it had already pierced Venomous Ying straight through. Her eyes went wide as she looked at the huge wound in the pit of her stomach. Xue Ying's Scarlet Cloud Spear was hanging from her chest, and a large amount of blood splattered all over the place and onto her immense tail.
"You, you would dare?!" The Venomous Ying World Deity couldn't help but stare wide-eyed.
Hong, hong, hong! Immediately after, the other nine Xue Yings simultaneously struck out with their own spears. This assault was different from the one before, which only sought to coerce her and suppress her. By now, each move seemed to spare no mercy.
Venomous Ying's body was completely split open in an instant, and it took no more than one attack for her True Deity Heart to be destroyed.
"Luminous Sun" was a very hard and focused art, and it was now being employed through nine World Deity bodies. Venomous Ying, now without the support provided by the arrays from the Nest of Myriad Devils, was completely crushed; her True Deity Heart was extinguished, and her body died on the spot.
Nearby, a region where the void had been split open and was now flowing in a disorderly and turbulent manner gradually recovered its stillness.
The ten Xue Yings put away their spears.
Only the poisoned trident and several materials left behind by Venomous Ying were still floating in the void.
"Hmph, you're saying I would not dare kill you? I have treasures with which I can obscure spacetime, making it impossible to turn back time for an investigation. There simply isn't any evidence to prove I was the one who killed you," the black-robed Xue Ying coldly said. In the Deity world, anyone who sought to murder someone would bring along treasures to obscure spacetime as to block future investigation. Only then would they carry out their assassination. If a murder was done this way, it was simply impossible to discover any evidence.
Nearby, Dong Xiao was staring wide-eyed at the scene.
Xue Ying turned his head to the man and said, "Oh, what's this? Dong Xiao, did you see anything?"
"I…I didn't see anything happen," Dong Xiao said with a mixture of eagerness and nervousness. "Not only did I not see anything, a witness couldn't even be considered evidence! If I just said some random name, would that make them a murderer? A witness can't be considered evidence, and without conclusive, undeniable evidence, it is impossible to say someone is guilty of a crime. Don't worry, don't worry. There are plenty of murderers out there who carry out their deeds in this manner, and none of them have ever been discovered. Your Highness, please let off this underling. Please let me off."
******

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - Myriad Poison Record
chapters.content:
Chapter 498: Myriad Poison Record
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Dong Xiao was feeling truly regretful at the moment. Had he known that Xue Ying's combat power was so strong, there was no way he would have let himself be muddied into his affairs!
He became a stage two World Deity within five thousand years, and he could already face stage three World Deities without losing out. He even has His Majesty as a backer! Of course he wouldn't be afraid of offending my master. Dong Xiao was afraid, afraid that Xue Ying would kill him to cover his bases. He hurriedly replied, "Your Highness, Dong Bo, please show me mercy. I have come under orders."
Xue Ying chuckled. "You're right. Human testimony would never triumph over real, hard evidence."
The rules and regulations by which the Deity world was governed were extremely strict. Someone could only be judged guilty of a crime under concrete evidence.
It was not sufficient to say someone was guilty for them to be convicted with a crime.
Furthermore, someone like the Venomous Ying World Deity, who had a fifth rank official position and had great status and authority, could not be killed even by stage four World Deities. Powerful existences, on the other hand, would certainly have the necessary authority.
Xue Ying was in a similar situation; he had a third rank official position, and it was unusual for anyone who was not a stage four World Deities to be given such a high rank. His status and authority were higher than Venomous Ying's, and he would, at most, be heavily punished even if he were to publicize killing Venomous Ying, instead of being sentenced to death. Even so, a 'heavy punishment' was still a truly terrifying outcome. It was precisely for this same reason that the Venomous Ying World Deity said she would rather die than to go to the Bloodshed God Palace—she was afraid of that heavy punishment.
"Exactly! This can't be considered actual evidence." Dong Xiao was truly nervous.
"Hurry off," Xue Ying said casually with a chuckle.
"Of course, of course. I'm going!" Dong Xiao did not hesitate to once again display his spacetime related secret technique to flee at the top of his lungs. After entering the spacetime passage, he couldn't help but keep looking behind his back to make sure Xue Ying was not chasing after him.
"Hmph." Xue Ying let out a chuckle before waving his hand to store the treasures left behind by the Venomous Ying World Deity.
While he was unhappy with how Monarch Wu Chen had treated him, it was not to the extent that he wanted to kill of Dong Xiao as well. Dong Xiao was, after all, nothing more than a subordinate under Monarch Wu Chen and had only interfered on his master's orders. Xue Ying didn't have any enmity with Dong Xiao, and he saw no need to kill off someone who acted purely on orders.
It was only toward Venomous Ying herself that his killing intent reached an extremely deep level, and that was precisely why he had shown her no mercy!
Oh? These items are still attached to their owner? Xue Ying immediately discovered an issue with the treasures left behind by the Venomous Ying World Deity. As expected, she should have an avatar left alive somewhere.
It was overly common for World Deities to cultivate the avatar technique.
Just now, he had killed off one of the Venomous Ying World Deity's bodies, but she was sure to have another one alive. Before long, she could just use the avatar technique to recreate this body she just lost.
But she still lost an avatar alongside all of these treasures. I'm sure her heart must be aching by now. Xue Ying returned to the Starfield Flying Ship before rapidly refining the storage ring. Whatever. This poisonous trident is a blood-refined Deity warrior and is known to be her favorite weapon. This weapon she personally groomed and refined over a few billion years is now in my hands.
It was similar to the importance he placed on the Scarlet Cloud Spear. Losing a blood-refined Deity warrior would definitely make anyone's heart ache.
Sou.
The Starfield Flying Ship flew through the spactime tunnel at great speed, on a course back toward the Nest of Myriad Devils.
"Ahhhhh!" The Venomous Ying World Deity was standing with her enormous tail laid down in a certain courtyard, her savage face contorted from malevolence and madness. "My poisonous trident, my treasures, my hexing poison materials… Damn it! Damn it all! Ahhhhh! I just lost half of all the treasures I've been gathering over countless years!"
In Xue Ying's case, his true body in the Xia Clan World was absolutely safe, which was why he left most of his treasures back there with it. A good example of this was Crimson Rock Mountain itself.
Even then, the body he used in the Deity world still carried extreme importance because it wielded many of the treasures he received from His Majesty, such as the Scarlet Cloud Spear and some others. This body was also the one to cultivate the Luminous Sun Force! The absolute art "Luminous Sun" required the absorption of energy from external materials during training. Materials like the Golden Fiend Beads and Demon Bone Ash carried exorbitant prices. The more he improved, the higher the cost of training the Luminous Sun Force would become!
If he were to die in battle, he would lose his blood-refined Deity warrior, and the Luminous Sun Force he cultivated would be gone, alongside all of the treasures he carried!
Even if his true body condensed another body, he would still have to start cultivate the Luminous Sun Force from scratch and also redo all of the grooming of a blood-refined Deity warrior!
While Xue Ying would suffer some loses from his body dying in battle, other World Deities would be in an even worse situation, for most did not have an absolutely safe location to store their treasures and would usually just split them between the two bodies. Like this, they would only lose half of their treasures upon the death of a body.
But even losing just half was enough to leave one grieving!
"Give them back, Dong Bo Xue Ying! Give back my hexing poison materials!" The Venomous Ying World Deity felt urgent and angry. She had thought of so many ways to steal and accumulate a great amount of faith energy, just for the sake of purchasing materials for her hexing poisons, yet half of all those treasures were now in Xue Ying's hands.
Hong.
Suddenly, the figure of a sloppy-looking man appeared in the distant void.
"Monarch!" The Venomous Ying World Deity hurried out of her courtyard. The region she just left had been built atop one of many mountains that were connected into a range floating amidst the starry sky.
"Venomous Ying," the sloppy man began speaking as he looked at her. "I was simply too far away from the Calm Sea Prefecture. It wasn't long after I started moving that Dong Xiao already informed me that your avatar was killed. I couldn't make it in time."
"Monarch, I must ask for your help in demanding my treasures back from Dong Bo Xue Ying," Venomous Ying immediately said.
"You want to make demands? I might be able to force him back if he tries to kill you right in front of me," the sloppy man began, his previously indifferent eyes now showing a strand of coldness, "however, I have no way to snatch back any treasures he has on his hands. Do you think I can just steal his storage treasure?"
Monarch Wu Chen was certainly not afraid of Xue Ying, but that was not to say that Xue Ying feared him! He had a third rank official position that only stage four World Deities would normally have, and he was backed by his status as a personal disciple under the Bloodshed God Emperor! Wu Chen could attempt to protect Venomous Ying, but he would not go as far as to act against Xue Ying. As soon as he went out and forcibly took away Xue Ying's treasures, even if he made sure not to leave behind any evidence through treasures that obscured spacetime, he would still have offended Xue Ying. Wu Chen was not willing to do such a thing.
"But…but you said Dong Xiao would resolve this matter, and that you would protect me," Venomous Ying anxiously cut in.
"Dong Xiao tried his best." The sloppy man shook his head. "Alright now. Don't push your luck!"
"I… I gave you that piece to the "Myriad Poison Record" though. Are you planning on breaking your promise, Monarch?" The Venomous Ying World Deity was angered to the point of anxiety.
The reason Venomous Ying gained such accomplishments in hexing poison, to the point that she was seen as the strongest expert in the entire Calm Sea Prefecture in this area, was precisely because of a miraculous encounter she had undergone to receive a supreme inheritance relic, the "Myriad Poison Record". Unfortunately, however, it was nothing more than a fragmented relic.
The Dao of hexing poison, of insects, or of medicine…
If one had incredible achievements in any of the side Daos, they would be just as terrifying as any other path.
"Are you not here, in my Heavenly Cloud Mountain, receiving my protection?" The sloppy man glanced at her. "As long as you remain here, I'll make sure you remain in good health," as he said this, the sloppy man took a single step to enter a palace within one of the mountain peaks.
Damn you, the Venomous Ying World Deity cursed inwardly.
******
The entire Nest of Myriad Devils actually covered an immense area, so only a part of it had been damaged. At the moment, more than a hundred million Deities and huge amount of World Deities could be seen right outside that region. They were Venomous Ying's subordinates. All of them were currently trembling in fear after witnessing the terrifying scenes of battle from just before. It had been sufficient to cause them all to lose their guts!
Hua~
A gap suddenly appeared in the distant void, followed by an emerald ship soon flying out of it. A black-robed teenager could be seen standing on its deck.
"Father."
"Your Highness."
"Your Highness Dong Bo."
All sorts of excited voices sounded out at once. Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao, and Commanders Bai Li Shang and Jiu Qi, together with the soldiers under their command, all looked toward Xue Ying with a look of extreme fervor. That same Venomous Ying which two legions working together could not defeat had just been easily dealt with by Xue Ying alone. Even Dong Xiao had been helpless in front of him.
A strong combat power was enough to turn them frenzied.
Up until this point, they had been listening to Xue Ying's orders and respected him only because of the potential he showed for the future, as well as his status as a personal disciple under His Majesty. But now, they revered Xue Ying in view of his powerful combat ability! It was one's combat power that would genuinely lead people to respect them!
"Commander Bai Li, take your men to investigate the Nest of Myriad Devils. Check all of Venomous Ying's subordinates to see whether the million Deities who were responsible for faith energy collection are truly dead," Xue Ying ordered.
"Yes," Commander Bai Li Shang responded, his words resounding and filled with vigor.
"Follow me," he ordered loudly, leading his soldiers to proceed with the task he was given.
At the same time, Xue Ying looked down at the storage ring in his hand. Using his Luminous Sun Force, he wiped out all the energy left behind by Venomous Ying in the ring.

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - Reputation
chapters.content:
Chapter 499: Reputation
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
As soon as he sent his consciousness into the storage treasure, Xue Ying immediately laid eyes upon countless shelves filled to the brim with pots and vases. Other than that, he saw all sorts of weird treasures and materials, and he also found a few Deity crystals faith stones. In addition, there were a large number of scrolls placed within, as well as other random goods piling up into mountains. A stage three World Deity who lived for several billion years like Venomous Ying had accumulated quite a large mass of treasures indeed.
It only makes sense that she would have so many many pots and vases on her, as an expert in hexing poison. I've long since heard that her skill with hexing poisons is formidable; there's no chance I'll ever give her the opportunity to make use of it, Xue Ying thought. The Venomous Ying World Deity indeed specialized in using hexing poison, but in the previous fight, Xue Ying had already arranged for his personal guard to protect his children and the rest. At the same time, he was personally able to completely resist any hexing poison that had spread through the void.
The more formidable a hexing poison, the harder it was to spread. Venomous Ying's most formidable hexing poison was the one which she spread through her poisonous trident, but with Xue Ying's extra nine bodies and ten spears attacking her together, she did not get any chance to use it.
With so many treasures and materials, there's bound to be some precious stuff here. I'll have to thoroughly check everything, Xue Ying thought.
"Father," Dong Bo Yu shouted from the side. His eyes glimmered with excitement. The scene he saw on that day made him truly worship his father, especially after seeing his body expand to a towering size of several tens of millions of kilometers! It must be stated that the Xia Clan World was only about five million kilometers wide in total, a size that Xue Ying could easily reach with his Time Immemorial Body. In truth, that size couldn't even be considered much. Someone who succeeded in training the Time Immemorial Body to its absolute limit would see their body become a real Time Immemorial Body, and a single finger of such a being would be a few times bigger than what Xue Ying had just shown.
But Dong Bo Yu was just a Deity, and he had spent the majority of his time in the Xia Clan World or the inner world of Crimson Rock Mountain. Because of this, his knowledge of the World Deity realm was rather shallow.
"Yu'er, is there a problem?" Xue Ying looked to his son.
"Father, I was hoping you might teach me a few things once we return to the official residence," Dong Bo Yu replied.
Xue Ying laughed. "You brat, whenever I told you to cultivate until now, you were always so lazy. It's such a rare thing so see you take the initiative and ask me to teach you." What Xue Ying did not know was that after he revealed such an earth-shattering technique on that day, his son actually awakened to some lofty aspirations.
"Your Highness, Your Highness."
Commander Bai Li Shang tore through the void to arrive in front of him all the way from the distance. His absolute respect was visible in spite of the tan covering his face. It was the sort of respect coming directly from his inner heart. "We have confirmed that the million Deities who were responsible for collecting faith energy within the Nest of Myriad Devils are all dead."
"They're really dead?" Xue Ying was startled. He had thought that Venomous Ying would have merely moved them to various other places, but he didn't consider that she would really kill them all.
"Truly?" Xue Ying wanted to make sure.
"I can't be 100% sure because the Venomous Ying World Deity only went through with the deed after obscuring the space time continuum," Commander Bai Li Shang replied. "However, I've already ordered my men to question everyone and have received some information that many of lower ranking members of the Nest of Myriad Devils were not aware. Only the higher echelon World Deities knew of this: on the very day after Your Highness took on the position of supervisor envoy, Venomous Ying summoned all of those million Deities to her palace. After the doors to the palace went shut, none of those Deities were ever seen again!"
Xue Ying's expression turned ashen-gray.
This Venomous Ying really was amazing—amazingly ruthless, that was.
Right on the day after he took on the position of supervisor envoy? Wasn't that the same day when Ying Gu Liang had come to offer an apology? It seemed like as soon as the attempt at reconciliation failed, the Venomous Ying World Deity immediately killed all million of those people! She had destroyed every last strand of evidence.
That's not right. How could it be that all those Deities just happened to be at the Nest of Myriad Devils at the same time? Xue Ying pondered. I'm afraid that, the very moment she heard that I became teacher's personal disciple, she would have already summoned all of those subordinates and ordered them to stay within the Nest of Myriad Devils so that she could eliminate them at any time.
She only had to give the word for all of them to be killed. Xue Ying's eyes turned icy. That is some ruthless behaviour indeed.
Xue Ying himself was also decisive when it came to killing people, but he would never so willfully slaughter innocent people. There were experts out there who had slaughtered weaker lifeforms because of the impact from their techniques, without even realizing it, but those people had not schemed to specifically massacre them. The Venomous Ying World Deity, on the other hand, had no qualms with killing all the Deities! As soon as she heard that the apology failed, she had immediately eliminated all of them.
Anyone who was not loyal to her had to be killed, leaving only death behind as evidence.
You think you've cleaned up all traces? Xue Ying had already made a certain decision in his heart.
While Xue Ying and the others swept through the Nest of Myriad Devils, news had already begun spreading like wildfire across the entire Calm Sea Prefecture!
From one point of view, the Calm Sea Prefecture was big, incredibly so. Travelers would have to spend quite a lot of time passing through it, even when using space teleportation arrays.
But from a different point of view, it could also be considered small, very small at that. By means of communication treasures, news could quickly and easily spread across the entire region!
