There were only so few experts in the highest echelon of the Calm Sea Prefecture, and they had long since set their eyes on this matter regarding Xue Ying and Venomous Ying. Naturally, it did not take long for the news to be known throughout the prefecture.
"This Dong Bo brat is indeed formidable."
The Calm Sea Prefecture Master, an amiable, ever-smiling old man was in the middle of watering plants when he was reported this article of news by his attendant. As he heard it, he could not help but offer some praise.
A young man with delicate features by his side added, "That's right, that's right. He's very formidable. Despite having cultivated only for so long, he could so easily devastate both the Venomous Ying World Deity and Dong Xiao. Such combat power would undoubtedly place him at the very top amongst stage three World Deities! He would most likely be close to General Wu in terms of strength. Furthermore, I've heard that he even killed Venomous Ying's avatar!"
"Chun Hua, you brat, where did you even hear these news?" The Calm Sea Prefecture Master smiled as he shot a glance toward this young attendant of his.
"Hehehe, it came straight from the Heavenly Cloud Mountain. I would not dare say I'm certain, but I'm still about 80-90% sure," the attendant replied. "From what I've heard, Venomous Ying sent her avatar over to the Heavenly Cloud Mountain as soon as Dong Bo Xue Ying took over the position of supervisor envoy. She went over to find Monarch Wu Chen."
"Brother Wu Chen is mad about cultivation," the Calm Sea Prefecture Master said. "He's investigated many daos and plans to walk one of them in order to become a powerful existence. He is known to collect various treasures from all over the Deity world and the Dark Abyss. Venomous Ying likely had some sort of treasure she handed over to Brother Wu Chen, and it proved to be something he wanted. That's likely why Brother Wu Chen decided to protect her."
"It wasn't wise of Monarch Wu Chen to have taken this decision." The young attendant shook his head.
"Don't you be disrespectful to your seniors!" the Calm Sea Prefecture Master shouted. "What do you, a brat, even know about this matter? Finding oneself blocked by that final obstacle, despite one's only dream and desire being to break through and become a powerful existence, to truly transcend beyond eternity… For the sake of taking this step, what would such a person not dare to do?"
The Calm Sea Prefecture Master's eyes vaguely shone with a strand of sharp light.
He was an old man even amongst stage four World Deities, so he clearly understood the thought process behind Wu Chen's decision.
If he saw hope of transcending to reach eternity, even he, the Calm Sea Prefecture Master would disregard all in his path! He would not even hesitate to kill Xue Ying if that was what it took! Upon killing him, he would have to immediately betray the Bloodshed God Palace and rely on another superpower like the Temporal Island! For ancient cultivators like him, personal combat power was paramount. Any other form of authority was vain.
"Hehehe." The young attendant immediately diverted the conversation away from this topic with a smile. "Prefecture master, how can Dong Bo Xue Ying be so formidable and strong in spite of him only being a stage two World Deity? Is it because he got to learn an absolute art?"
"Mn." The Calm Sea Prefecture Master nodded. "As His Majesty's personal disciple, he should have already learned an absolute art."
"An absolute art!" The attendant's eyes brightened up. "If I could learn one, hehehe, I might be able to match the might of stage four World Deities." He was a stage three World Deity.
The Calm Sea Prefecture Master shook his head and chuckled. "His realm was clearly a whole level lower, yet he could display such tyrannical strength. Everything has an equilibrium. Since absolute arts are so incredibly strong, learning them is sure to be extremely difficult. Just what kind of comprehension ability do you think Dong Bo Xue Ying has? If that same art was given to some ordinary stage two World Deity instead, they would have surely been so much slower than him. Furthermore, look at that Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master; he is known as one of the three ancestors, but he's actually nothing more than a unique stage four World Deity. With his realm, it would have only made sense to see him become a powerful existence long ago, but, unfortunately, he was instead influenced by some absolute art."
"Oh." The young attendant nodded.
"All things considered, this Dong Bo brat is still amazing. At the rate he cultivates, he'll likely become a stage three World Deity within a hundred thousand years. By then, his combat power will become even more amazing." The Calm Sea Prefecture Master laughed.
It was not just this strongest expert in the Calm Sea Prefecture, the Calm Sea Prefecture Master, that was astonished. All of the stage three World Deities, like the famous General Wu and other high ranked people like King Cong Shi and the White Sand City Lord, couldn't quite believe what they had heard. The White Sand City Lord had even let out a sigh upon receiving the news. The combat power of this brother of mine is improving at breakneck speeds. Even I, his elder brother, cannot be truly certain I can win over him. Mn. I have to go over and have a match with him. The White Sand City Lord left his city as soon as the news got to him and headed straight toward Eastern Region City.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - Capture!
chapters.content:
Chapter 500: Capture!
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying, accompanied by his wife and children, very quickly led his personal guard back from the Nest of Myriad Devils. It wasn't long before the Starfield Flying Ship arrived at Eastern Region City of the Calm Sea Prefecture. By this point, the White Sand City Lord had yet to even depart from his territory.
In the sky above Eastern Region City, General Mo was leading a large group of subordinates from Eastern Blaze Region, all of them waiting in mid-air. As soon as they saw the Starfield Flying Ship appear in the distant void, they rushed over to welcome the people it carried.
"Your Highness, news of your battle has spread out all over the Calm Sea Prefecture. I believe that many more World Deities from the territory of the Bloodshed God Palace will soon be informed of your combat power." General Mo was now acting with deep passion. Previously, he had merely been trying not to offend Xue Ying, while he had now naturally lowered his position; the stronger a cultivator, the more respect they would be shown.
"It's a pity that Venomous Ying actually dared to exterminate every last one of those million Deities responsible for collecting faith energy." Xue Ying shook his head. "In the end, this expedition was a failure."
"They were all killed?" General Mo was startled.
"I've made sure to thoroughly interrogate everyone, so this information is likely true. It's truly unfortunate that Venomous Ying distorted the space time continuum to avoid investigation as she killed those Deities," Xue Ying lamented. "Without sufficient evidence, we can't get rid of her."
"Considering the combat power you've shown, Your Highness, you will definitely get the chance to deal with Venomous Ying before long. She can't run forever," General Mo replied.
Xue Ying sent a sidelong glance toward General Mo. This was the first time the man had taken a clear-cut stand for his faction.
"I still have some matters to attend to, so I'll have to return to my residence first. General, should you find yourself free in the future, I'll reserve you a seat at my place," Xue Ying said.
"Certainly, certainly," General Mo replied.
Xue Ying then rushed over back to the residence, followed by his subordinates.
General Mo looked toward Xue Ying's back with a grin. The words Xue Ying left with gave off a sense of closeness! With him being so powerful as a stage two World Deity, he would likely be able to match stage four World Deities in might as a stage three World Deity in the future! Any fool could understand that offending such an existence was a foolish affair. In any case, he, General Mo, would definitely do no such thing.
******
Upon returning to the supervisor envoy's residence, Xue Ying turned around and left in secret for the location of the Temporal Temple within the city.
As the most important city in the entire eastern region of the Calm Sea Prefecture, Eastern Region City's Temporal Temple was lofty and majestic, with it being only slightly smaller than the nearby Bloodshed Tavern.
The Temporal Temple, huh? As he entered the Temporal Temple, complex emotions swirled through the black-robed Xue Ying's heart.
He had been through a few entanglements with the Temporal Temple before.
"Ah, Your Highness Dong Bo." Once Xue Ying was inside the majestic palace, a silver-robed World Deity immediately came over to welcome him. The man was a stage two World Deity, and he held the highest authority within the entire eastern region in the Temporal Temple, an organization known for its ability to collect intelligence and information. Naturally, they were well aware about what Xue Ying had done to startle the entire Calm Sea Prefecture. This person in charge spoke in a respectful and humble tone. "Your Highness, this one is called Yu Yun. I am the one responsible for this temple. Please, come in and have a seat inside."
Inside the temple, Xue Ying could detect several other guards looking at him from the distance, yet not one dared to move any closer.
Ordinary outsiders who frequented the Temporal Temple would be received by various attendants, yet as soon as Xue Ying entered, the person with the highest authority, Yu Yun, had rushed over and taken the initiative in welcoming him.
After entering an elegant reception hall, Yu Yun sent for his attendants to pour tea for the both of them.
"Your Highness, is there any issue in particular that brought you to my Temporal Temple today?" World Deity Yu Yun asked.
"I would like to place a request. I want the Temporal Temple to collect any available information in relation to the collection of faith energy, from every planet that has life within the White Yang Starfield," Xue Ying said.
World Deity Yu Yun stared at Xue Ying, astonished at what he just heard. "Every planet that has life?"
Any single starfield would have many planets with life within its borders. They had to be extremely big, or there would not have been so many Deities who emerged from them.
"Your Highness, the collection of faith energy is done every ten thousand years," Yu Yun began. "If you truly want us to investigate every last planet with life within an entire starfield, it will cost you quite a lot."
Xue Ying nodded. "I'm aware."
Of course it would cost a lot!
When it came to reversing the flow of time, it wasn't very difficult to merely reverse it to recent events. However, the further back one wanted to move, the more energy they would have to use, and the greater their understanding of the Profound Mysteries of Space and of Time would have to be. Xue Ying himself could have also summoned a large amount of Deities who specialized in the Profound Mysteries of Spacetime if he just wanted to find out about some recent events. It was simple to set down a large group of Deities and let them slowly investigate.
But if he wanted to investigate events that went further into the past, this method was no longer viable. At that point, only World Deities with great talent in regards to the Spacetime Deity Heart would be able to do so. But would such experts accept to go through and investigate every single planet? Even if they didn't dare ask for more than a Deity crystal per planet, when counting all the planets in a starfield, not even powerful existences could afford it! In that case, Xue Ying had no other option than to turn to the Temporal Temple.
The Temporal Temple was one of the strongest weapons related to Spacetime refined by the Temporal Island Lord. Most powerful existences could not use their strength to pass through the material world and attempt teleportation, but the Temporal Temple was different. It was easy to see just how formidable it was, as a weapon that could even match the might of the Bloodshed God Emperor himself in regards to Spacetime. It was, after all, just a weapon, and it would make nothing of hardships.
"It would cost you three billion Deity crystals," Yu Yun said directly.
Xue Ying nodded. "Alright. I accept the trade." He had earned quite a lot from killing off Venomous Ying's avatar. Using such a sum to deal with her wasn't anything much.
In about the time it took to brew a cup of a tea, the Temporal Temple had already collected the relevant information regarding the recent handing of faith energy on the stipulated starfield. Such speed was nothing short of terrifying.
"Your Highness, this is the detailed information. It includes scenes taken from every single planet after reversing the flow of time," Yu Yun said as he passed over a crystal token.
After grabbing the crystal token, Xue Ying quickly discovered that, other than the recorded scenes taken after reversing time on the many planets, the intel also contained a quantitative record of the handling of faith energy.
How unscrupulous. She actually dared give in no more than 30% of the total faith energy she collected. Xue Ying was inwardly dumbstruck. This Venomous Ying is way past any normal degree of daring.
Let's see just how you plan to escape this time around, then, Xue Ying thought.
He immediately stood up and left the Temporal Temple. Yu Yun naturally first saw him out and then watched him pass into the distance while sighing inwardly. From what I've heard, His Highness Dong Bo is originally from a material world. My Temporal Island should have extremely detailed information on anyone born in the material world, so it would have made more sense for such a formidable talent to have been discovered by the Temporal Temple instead. But, in the end, he still landed in the hands of the Bloodshed God Palace. Truly a pity.
What Yu Yun did not know was that even the Temporal Island Lord himself, the highest existence in the organization, had taken notice of Xue Ying.
It was back when Xue Ying had just been received as a personal disciple. The Temporal Island Lord was quite startled to hear about it. Someone who could become a stage two World Deity within just five thousand years had been taken in as personal disciple by the Bloodshed God Emperor? He immediately went on to investigate more about the situation, and it was only at that point that the Temporal Temple treasure spirit finally reported the past events to him.
Xue Ying had been through three encounters with the Temporal Temple.
The first was in the form of an invitation which the Temporal Temple gave to Xue Ying. He refused it because he was unwilling to accept the restrictions.
The second encounter was another invitation, and it was one that Xue Ying had originally planned to accept. However, after finding out that he would not be able to control what missions he took after joining, he began worrying that the Xia Clan World would be attacked while he was on a mission, preventing him from lending a helping hand. Because of this, he decided to refuse this invitation as well.
The third and final encounter was back when Xue Ying took the initiative in asking to join them. He had a single motive for doing so, and that was to save his wife, whose soul was about to crumble apart.
Unfortunately, the treasure required for the reconstruction of one's soul was too precious, and the Temporal Temple determined that Xue Ying was not of an equivalent value, which led them to refusing him.
I've actually missed such a good opportunity to get my hands on a talented person. Who knows, though, he might not even succeed in becoming a powerful existence in the future. After understanding the situation, the Temporal Island Lord simply let out a sigh and then went back to refining his weapon.
Xue Ying sent out a subordinate to pass the information he gathered back to the Bloodshed God Palace, via the Spacetime delivery array. The report reached the Bloodshed God Palace on the same day he sent it.
Before long, the officials over at the Bloodshed God Palace received the report in person.
As officials located at the headquarters of the Bloodshed God Palace itself, their intelligence network was fast and up-to-date. Just previously, they had been discussing the matter regarding Xue Ying having personally suppressed both Venomous Ying and Dong Xiao, both of them stage three World Deities.
"Such a short while has passed since we were talking about His Highness, yet, in the blink of an eye, he already sent over the necessary evidence."
"His Highness is, indeed, very formidable. He bought this evidence straight from the Temporal Temple. I'm sure they asked for an exorbitant price to investigate every planet with signs of life in an entire starfield, right?"
"It had to cost a lot."
"His Highness even said before that all those million Deities responsible for the collection of faith energy were eliminated."
"In any case, the White Yang Starfield governed by the Nest of Myriad Devils handed no more than 30% of what they were meant to sent as the most recent tribute! There is no way to refute this claim. I feel that we should transmit an order for the Venomous Ying World Deity to be captured for interrogation, so that we can determine whether she really killed those million Deities and also find out what reason she could have had for slaughtering the people responsible for collecting faith energy."
The case relating to the slaughter of those million Deities could not proceed any further because of a lack of evidence.
However, the matter regarding the collection of faith energy in the White Yang Starfield was clearly undeniable and proven! With the Temporal Temple having undergone a full investigation through the reversal of the flow of time, it didn't matter how formidable Venomous Ying was; there was no way for her to obscure the spacetime continuum on every single planet. Even she had no more than two such treasures on her person.
"I agree."
"Indeed. Let's first capture her and bring her back for interrogation."
While her stealing a large amount of faith energy during the last ten thousand years was undoubtedly a crime, that alone would not lead to a very heavy punishment.
But after she was captured and interrogated, the Bloodshed God Palace would discover that the same thing had happened in all thirty-two of the starfields under her control, and she had been doing so over a long period of time. Added up, the criminal charges for her would be extremely heavy. This was the main reason she was unwilling to accept being captured by Xue Ying.
"Capture her."
The Bloodshed God Palace was extremely efficient.
A team from a first class legion was immediately sent over to Monarch Wu Chen's Heavenly Cloud Mountain! It was easy to see just how precise the intelligence of the Bloodshed God Palace was.

chapters.title: Chapter 501 - Floating Realm Flower
chapters.content:
Chapter 501: Floating Realm Flower
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Somewhere in the vast starry sky floated a certain mountain range; it was none other than the Heavenly Cloud Mountain, Monarch Wu Chen's residence.
The Venomous Ying World Deity was currently inside the cultivation room of a courtyard, staring at a bizarre branch soaked in liquid in its entirety. Occasionally, green bubbles could be seen forming on its surface. Venomous Ying was concentrating on observing the minute particles permeating the bubbles using her naked eyes. Lately, she had taken a turn to become even crazier in her cultivation; the dao of hexing poisons was also a Law to be comprehended through the Myriad Existences. After her avatar was killed by Xue Ying, she found herself in urgent need of breaking through to become a stage four World Deity.
However, would such a breakthrough be so easy to achieve? At the moment, no more than one stage four World Deity could be found in the Calm Sea Prefecture.
Hong. The door to her cultivation room got smashed, and a figure immediately rushed in.
"Who dares!" The Venomous Ying World Deity was enraged. Nobody would take being disturbed in the middle of a cultivation session well. On top of that, her cultivation room was well-fortified and should not have so easily been destroyed.
The one who charged in was a certain sloppy man, a sharp current of air still vaguely revolving enveloping his figure.
"Monarch?" The Venomous Ying World Deity was stunned.
The man grabbed Venomous Ying's arm and shouted out, "The Bloodshed God Palace has dispatched a first class legion, and it's already reached the mountain. They're on their way to capture you as we speak. You have to hurry out of here."
"A first class legion?" At the sound of it, Venomous Ying was so frightened that her heart trembled. First class legions were normally dispatched to deal with powerful existences! Any one squad from their ranks could easily deal with a stage four World Deity. Such people had come to capture her? Venomous Ying's was instantly overcome by a feeling of deep terror.
Such a thing shouldn't have happened; Xue Ying should not have had any conclusive evidence! On what basis had the Bloodshed God Palace sent a team to capture her?
Despite her doubts, she could not bother considering the issue any longer.
"Let's go." The sloppy male grabbed Venomous Ying World Deity before tearing through the void and left.
At the very same moment, a Starfield Flying Ship popped out of a spacetime tunnel in the void right outside Heavenly Cloud Mountain. Atop the ship, there stood a great many soldiers, all of them clad in heavy armor; even their faces were masked. All the soldiers donned uniforms of the same emerald color, complete with countless strands of green lightning flashing on the surface of their equipment. Every last one of those thousand plus soldiers forming the squad was a World Deity. First class legions were the highest ranking legions the Bloodshed God Palace had at its disposal, and they had all been formed by His Majesty through incredible effort.
It was mainly due to their complex secret techniques and suits of armor that their combat power was so terrifying.
With ten such squadrons teaming up, the legion could even deal with a powerful existence!
Hong long long~
The group flew off the Starfield Flying Ship under the lead of their commander. Under the might of the green lightning surrounding them, even the surrounding void began to crumble.
"This is my Heavenly Cloud Mountain!" An icy-cold voice rang out.
The sloppy man walked out to stand in mid-air right in front of the Heavenly Cloud Mountain, obstructing the path of the squadron. The man's eyelids were drooping, and he seemed to be smiling but also not. He sent a cold glance at the squadron and said, "What is this? Since when does a legion from the Bloodshed God Palace dare barge right into my Heavenly Cloud Mountain? Have I ever disobeyed any rules or regulations?"
The commander, whose face was also covered by a mask, coldly replied, "Monarch, we've come under orders to capture the Venomous Ying World Deity. We must ask you to stop obstructing our path."
"Hmph. You've come here, to my home, and you're telling me to not obstruct your path?"
The sloppy man let out a savage roar.
Hong~
A terrifying violet flame surrounded his body, and even his skin seemed to emit violet sparkles. The space surrounding him was burned to the point that any trace of a particle turned into nothingness before long. The terrifying temperature began to spread out in every direction. The sloppy man's eyes blazed as he glared at the thousand World Deities in front of him.
First class legions were extremely famous, and a squadron alone could terrify most people. Monarch Wu Chen, however, was the overlord of a territory.
"Monarch?" The commander showed some slight hesitation. If his order had been to deal with Monarch Wu Chen, his team would have long since acted, but his task was simply to capture the Venomous Ying World Deity.
"My territory is no place for you to act as you wish." The sloppy man released his mighty power that even transcended the sun itself. Naturally, this was because the sun was just too far away. Every single part of his body, be it his eyes, his skin or his eyebrows, were all burning violet.
"Move out separately. Everyone is to try and capture Venomous Ying." Feeling that he could no longer delay, the commander immediately sent down his orders.
"Yes."
Sou sou sou…
The soldiers began to disperse, rushing onto the Heavenly Cloud Mountain from every direction. Meanwhile, the commander himself instead charged right up to the sloppy man. Despite him being only a stage three World Deity, his Deity body had undergone a reconstruction, and when using his armor in concert with the array merging the power of the thousand subordinates, he was easily able to display the combat power of a stage four World Deity.
"Small Sword World!" At the sight of so many soldiers rushing towards his Heavenly Cloud Mountain, the sloppy man gave a frown before sending out a thought.
Shua Shua Shua Shua Shua Shua!
Countless sword lights began flying out from the Heavenly Cloud Mountain. They were so dense that they seemed to cover the entire world and become a system in and of itself. The sword lights completely enveloped the incoming soldiers, its power breaking, drying, pulling and forcing the soldiers back. Unable to dodge the attack, the soldiers themselves were all pierced by the sword lights, tumbling backwards under the bombardment. Even so, the defensive power of any soldiers from a first legion was extremely tyrannical; with ten squadrons working together, even powerful existences would find themselves unable to kill even one soldier. An attack like this, spread over such a large area, was practically unable to harm the soldiers.
"Monarch Wu Chen, you're being excessive!" That commander furiously began to launch his attacks.
But in response, the sloppy man instead just turned around and left. Taking a single step, he tore through the void and disappeared as his voice reverberated through the void. "Upon seeing you dare barge into my Heavenly Cloud Mountain, I had to teach you a lesson. As for Venomous Ying? Indeed, she has passed through here, but you guys have come too late. By the time you arrived, she was already long gone."
Upon hearing this, the squadron sent by the Bloodshed God Palace immediately descended upon the Heavenly Cloud Mountain to begin their search, but it was to no avail. They could only return home and helplessly report about what had just happened.
Inside a mountain, somewhere in the Heavenly Cloud Mountain…
Chi chi chi~ There was an enormous lake, in the middle of which floated a red flower of vibrant yet strange appearance with countless faces on its surface.
The sloppy man was standing by the side of the lake, closely observing the flower while nodding lightly. This remnant piece of the"Myriad Poison Record" is extraordinary indeed; it actually allows this Floating Realm Flower to grow. The Floating Realm Flower contains the Laws of the World; an isolated world forms inside it, which formulates the transformation of the Laws during its growth. I hope that while watching these transformation, I'll be able to truly raise my comprehension and take that final step.
He had remained within the body of the mountain this whole time.
Just before, as he went out into battle, it was actually his avatar that met the legion squad, and it was also his avatar who brought Venomous Ying out. He had taken her over to an old friend of his; he found that, in this way, he could be said to have kept his promise.
The Floating Realm Flower combined with the remnant piece of the"Myriad Poison Record", the ancient book of records on the sword world, or the Inferno Prison World Body… should I succeeded in any one of these three paths, I'll be able to transcend eternity. The sloppy man's eyes were filled with a blazing expectation. However, the same could be said of the majority of stage four World Deities, since all of them sought to transcend into eternity in their own way. Unfortunately, it truly was difficult. Incredibly, almost impossibly difficult.
Xue Ying had just returned from the Temporal Temple, having yet to even thoroughly investigate the storage treasure Venomous Ying left behind after killing her death when he met his Big Brother, the White Sand City Lord.
Naturally, he had to welcome him.
The two had been chatting idly for about half an hour when some news finally arrived.
"Oh?" Xue Ying received some information from his fellow disciple brothers and sisters back at the Bloodshed God Palace—the Venomous Ying World Deity refused to be taken back to the Bloodshed God Palace for interrogation. After she escaped during the process of being captured, her official rank was stripped, and she was placed on a list of people to be arrested on sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - 30,000 Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 502: 30,000 Years
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"She's a wanted criminal now?" The White Sand City Lord was holding a wine flask, slowly pouring wine for Xue Ying and himself. After he finished pouring for the two of them, he said, "Brother Dong Bo, what exactly did you even do to make the Bloodshed God Palace dispatch a squadron to capture Venomous Ying? Unless I'm mistaken, the Bloodshed God Palace only dispatches a team when there's sufficient evidence, and it's only after the officials responsible for such matters are informed that they'll send down the order."
Xue Ying flashed a mysterious smile. "They just received the evidence they needed. I went to the Temporal Temple to obtain all the relevant information regarding past collection of faith energy from every single planet with life within the entire White Yang Starfield."
"That's quite the ruthless move. How much was it?" White Sand asked.
"Three billion," Xue Ying replied, unable to hide his aching heart.
"Nobody else would do such a thing!" The White Sand City Lord sighed. "That Nest of Myriad devils collects faith energy from a total of thirty-two starfields, and they've been doing so over a long period of time. Your evidence was based solely on the past ten thousand years of collection from a single starfield. Usually, such a meager level of corruption would not be worth dispatching a first class legion squadron over. Venomous Ying also has that older brother of hers, so those officials won't be too harsh or demanding. At most, they would have first given an order to question her! She could have found a scapegoat, saying the crime was caused by a greedy subordinate of hers, and she would only have had to pay a fine of several times the original amount for this matter to be easily covered. Or so would have happened in most cases.
"Unfortunately for her, it was you, 'His Highness Dong Bo,' who acted this time! Those officials immediately took to your side, and they surely passed a swift judgement to send the legion over and capture her directly." The White Sand City Lord shook his head and laughed. "To think that you would frighten Venomous Ying to the extent that she would rather run away, not daring to even approach the Bloodshed God Palace."
Xue Ying replied, "It's like she has a ghost in her heart."
"Is there a superpower out there who can truly say they're clean? Can someone who's done no wrongs truly feed the lives of so many subordinates?" the White Sand City Lord remarked.
"I'm aware of that, but it's also true that the people who are as greedy as Venomous Ying are a minority," Xue Ying retorted. "Throughout the eastern region of the Calm Sea Prefecture, the overall situation dealing with the collection of faith energy is still within norms; it's only those thirty-two starfields under the governance of the Nest of Myriad Devils that reported a much smaller value than normal."
The White Sand City Lord nodded. "That's true. Other superpowers who don't have any strong background with the Bloodshed God Palace would never dare be so rampant. In most cases, their greed will bring them to subvert a slight amount of faith energy, like 10 or 20%! Venomous Ying was much more ruthless than that."
"The mistake she made falls within my authority as a supervisor envoy. Nobody can call me out for the way I deal with her. If she wants someone to blame, she should blame herself for seeking death!" Xue Ying casually said. "This time, she simply had Monarch Wu Chen protecting her, or she would have never been able to escape the legion with her own combat power."
"In any case, she's no longer a cause for concern." The White Sand City Lord continued drinking his wine. "The Bloodshed God Palace already placed her on an arrest-on-sight list, so she has to be prudent at all times. She can't even enter any of the territories ruled by the Bloodshed God Palace! Since she no longer has an official rank, anyone can just kill her as they please."
Xue Ying nodded.
At the moment, Venomous Ying was restricted in how she could move, yet it was still difficult to find any trace of her.
Even so, it was no cause for concern. Xue Ying's combat power was still weak, so he had room to rapidly improve in a short period of time. Naturally, the further he improved, the more time he would need to advance further! Passing stage three to become a stage four World Deity, he would need a much longer time than previously. But the process of becoming a powerful existence as a stage four World Deity… it was like a gulf between the heaven and earth! Many heaven-shakings talent would fail to ever take this final step. In any case, Xue Ying was still only at the stage where he was trying to become a stage three World Deity, and that, in addition with his absolute art, would be enough to make him a tyrannical figure in most circles. By then, he would only have to spend a little more effort in searching for Venomous Ying and finding an apt opportunity to eliminate her directly.
In reality, Xue Ying had already begun to disregard Venomous Ying. Right now, he was already more concerned about the one who had once led him into the realm of Transcendents, the Eternal Wind Knight, Chi Qiu Bai. Chi Qiu Bai had always taken care of him, and they had long since developed a good relationship. Xue Ying found the feeling of seeing Chi Qiu Bai die very hard to bear.
The only issue was that he could not hope to enter the Dark Abyss with his current combat power!
The Deity World and the Dark Abyss were at odds. Only a powerful existence might hope to entertain some friendly relations between the two, but, at a fundamental level, World Deities would slaughter each other on sight. Great Demonic Gods would not give a damn about Xue Ying's identity. As soon as they laid eyes upon an outsider from the Deity world, they would immediately think up any way to either kill them or capture them alive for use in all sorts of bloody experiments. It must be stated that the will of the abyss would reward any abyss lifeforms for killing outsiders.
Meanwhile, the will of the material realm focused more on blessing and protection. Against a form of life found within the material realm, even the killing power of the Bloodshed God Emperor would drop rapidly. Without the right pledge, such beings could kill stage two World Deities from a single thought at most. Inside the Deity world or the Dark Abyss, the Bloodshed God Emperor and other existences of his level would be at least a few times stronger.
The will of the abyss, however, focused more on such matters like killing, swallowing, blood, and darkness. The lifeforms from the Dark Abyss would be rewarded the more they killed, especially so for killing those from the Deity world or the material world.
As such, unless he had sufficient combat power, Xue Ying would be immediately surrounded and attacked as soon as entered.
After I have the combat power of the topmost stage four World Deity, I'll definitely go in. At that level, I won't be so easily killed even by the sovereigns of the abyss, Xue Ying thought. Any sovereign within the Dark Abyss would be a stage four World Deity at the very least. Eternal Wind, I hope you can hold on for a bit longer. Considering the techniques those Great Demonic God usually employ, they'll likely be torturing you for a long period of time.
At the thought of that, Xue Ying felt his heart ache. Finding himself helpless to do anything at the moment, he instead wished that the Great Demonic God would torture and imprison him for a little longer until he could help him. What a joke.
At a continuous chain of black palaces where countless beauties were moving about, Venomous Ying was currently staying within one of the more desolate courtyards.
She gazed at the endless starry sky in the distance, looking in the direction of the territory ruled by the Bloodshed God Palace.
Damn it! If only I could have forced Dong Bo Xue Ying into self-detonation back then, thus preventing him from participating in the Myriad Flower Feast; things would have been much easier now. Even though forcing him to die would have placed some responsibility on me, I would not have been the one who killed him, but he who suicided! The Venomous Ying World Deity felt as if countless ants were gnawing at her heart. Had he not participated in the Myriad Flower Feast, he would not have become His Majesty's disciple; he would not have risen up so fiercely, nor would he have an absolute art. A stage two World Deity could actually suppress me. Venomous Ying was experiencing all sorts of emotions, from jealousy, to envy, and to deep unwillingness.
Had she obtained the full version of the "Myriad Poison Record" instead of a remnant piece, it would surely have been at the level of an absolute art. The difference was huge! Similarly, the secret techniques within the Sealed World Pagoda were all merely small parts of the entire absolute art.
It's already too late to regret it. Too late… Venomous Ying once more turned her vision in the direction of the distant territory of the Bloodshed God Palace. She could have been even crueler and more ruthless, yet she would have still felt helpless at the moment.
After all, she clearly accepted that she would not have to be very careful of the brat which she previously disregarded. After all, considering his terrifying rate of growth, he would easily become an overlord of a part of the Deity world before long, and she could not afford to stir such an existence.
The more time passed, the wider the gap between the two of them would become!
If only…if only I could become a stage four World Deity. Venomous Ying gritted her teeth. The pride in her heart let her harbor a strand of hope.
Time was merciless.
The Xia Clan World underwent huge transformations; more Transcendents were now emerging, and the human population grew ever larger. In fact, it reached the extent that training via entering Crimson Rock Mountain World had become a common method. Since Xue Ying now controlled Crimson Rock Mountain, he saw no need to hide the matter any longer. He was, after all, the personal disciple of the Bloodshed God Emperor, and it was a given that he could shoulder the responsibility of the mountain.
In that same time, however, the Deity world and the Dark Abyss remained practically the same.
To an ordinary Deity, thirty thousand years was a very short period of time.
Within that same period of time, Xue Ying's influence within the Calm Sea Prefecture grew even further. Such people like the White Sand City Lord, General Wu, King Cong Shi, and many others experts of that level were coming to greet him, even extending a hand of friendship. It was very clear by now that Xue Ying would soon become a stage three World Deity, which would make his combat power even more terrifying. Naturally, Xue Ying's influential power was huge.
Even Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao had become disciples under some of the topmost experts within the entire Calm Sea Prefecture! The Calm Sea Prefecture Prefecture Master's second prince himself and others like him would have no option but to politely receive them. As for Xue Ying himself? He had long since surpassed people of the second prince's level.
As Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao found more to interact with, their horizons broadened further and further. They quickly discovered that Deities rarely ever became disciples under superpowers since their short lifespans assured they would die before long. It was only World Deities who would live for a relatively longer period of time. The two of them became extremely hardworking in their cultivation. Having inherited some of the talent of their parents, they both had long since become peak Deities. However, even they did not find it so easy to become World Deity.
However, there was another reason for their rate of improvement being stifled—Xue Ying and Jing Qiu did not allow their children to absorb faith stones! Both two husband and wife had long discussed and agreed that before that they would not let their children absorb faith energy. It was only if they seemed like they could not become World Deities within their lifetimes that they would be allowed to do so.
**

chapters.content:
Chapter 503: An Ill Wind
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Within the Eastern Region City of the Calm Sea Prefecture, there was an extravagant restaurant where an azure-robed man and a gray-robed man were sitting, eating and drinking to their hearts' content as they looked outside through the window. With how good the vision of a World Deity was, these people could clearly see the front gate of the conspicuous supervisor residence in spite of their large distance from it.
"Sir, Shang Yi has transformed his appearance, changed his name to Bai Li Shang, and entered Xue Ying's retinue in search of shelter. The investigation has confirmed all of this. What is our next step? Do we search for an opportunity to kill him directly?" the grey-robed man asked. As the two conversed, they simultaneously blocked off forms of probing around them, so they did not fear the possibility of anyone eavesdropping on them.
The azure-robed man looked to the distance with a frown. "Back when the ruins collapsed, a large amount of World Deities scattered in every direction, and we're not sure which of them ended up with the absolute treasure. Furthermore, everyone in that group was scared back then, and they were are all incredibly cautious and timid. Monarch used up any method he could to find a few of them and, in the end, spared no small cost to conduct an investigation through karma… We've found all the others one after another. So far, we've searched 355 World Deities, yet the one who hid away the absolute treasure still eludes us. We might have found another World Deity, but who knows whether this Shang Yi guy really has the absolute treasure…"
After the search of so many World Deities ended up in failure, Monarch Cang Yong begun to wonder whether the absolute treasure really was ever hidden within the ruins! However, the large amount of treasures and different evidence he received all pointed to one thing…the ruins contained an important absolute treasure. That was precisely why Monarch Cang Yong had spared no effort or resources to look for each and every World Deity.
"Had he been hiding by himself, we could've grabbed him as we wished." The azure-robed man shook his head. "However, he's now relying on his connection with Dong Bo! It was long ago that he first sought help, and he's now one of the commanders of his personal guard. Would Dong Bo really permit us to just grab one of the commanders of his personal guard just like that?"
"What, are you saying Monarch is afraid of Dong Bo?" the gray-robed man couldn't help but blurt out.
"Hmph! Of course Monarch doesn't fear Dong Bo. Unless it's absolutely necessary, however, he's also unwilling to start a feud." The azure-robed man shot a glance toward the gray-robed man. "It's not that simple to provoke Dong Bo. He is the Bloodshed God Emperor's personal disciple, and he possesses one of those absolute art of legends. I'm afraid that even if I move, I would not necessarily match his power. Not only that—in the future, he will become a terrifying existence that even Monarch would never dare provoke. Once he becomes a stage four World Deity, he is sure to be an overlord amongst all other stage four World Deities."
The gray-robed man nodded. "What do we do, then?"The gray robed man nodded: "Then what do we do?"
"In the end, we're talking about Xue Ying's personal guard; had he been an idle visitor, Xue Ying's protection would not have been too excessive, but he's one of the commanders, so he'll surely try to keep him safe," the azure-robed man's voice became cold as he considered his possibilities. "Either way, Monarch has already paid a huge price for the treasure in the ruins. No matter what, we have to check all the World Deities that fled back then to the last, with no exceptions!""In the end it's a personal guard army, so if he's an idle visitor, Xue Ying's protection will not be too excessive. But as a commander of the Personal Guard Army, he surely will protect him." The azure robed man pondered, and his voice also became cold, "However, Monarch has already paid a huge price for the treasure of the ruins, so no matter what, all the World Deities that fled back then must be sifted through, and not even one can be let off!"
"Mn." The gray-robed man nodded then suddenly continued, "Look, quickly! Shang Yi has returned to the supervisor residence."En." The gray robed man suddenly said, "Quickly look, that Shang Yi has returned to the supervisor residence.
At that moment, Commander Bai Li Shang was flying back from the distance to enter the supervisor residence, followed by a few other soldiers. His expression was relaxed and he seemed to be at ease. After he became a commander of Xue Ying's personal guard, his days became rather free, seeing now nobody dared to provoke him any longer.Commander Bai Li Shang was now bringing along a few soldiers, flying back mid-air from the distance an entering the Supervisor Residence. His expression was relaxed and at ease. Being able to become Xue Ying's Personal Guard Army Commander, his days were rather free and easy, and nobody dared come to provoke him.
"That Shang Yi who was known to be rather handsome has unexpectedly took on this ordinary tanned appearance." The azure-robed man shook his head. "He's quite cautious." The World Deities that had fled back then were all cautious, which made Monarch Cang Yong's search for them very difficult. Ultimately, he had to resort to tracking them through karma, despite the fact that Monarch Cang Yong himself had not grasped the Karma Deity Heart."Shang Yi was thought of as rather handsome, and unexpectedly has become so ordinary, and so tanned." The azure robed man shook his head, "He's quite cautious." The World Deities that had fled back then were all cautious, therefore Monarch Cang Yong's search had been very difficult, and ultimately had tracked them through karma, yet Monarch Cang Yong himself hadn't grasped the Karma Deity Heart.
"Very well, everyone can disperse. I'll be going into closed-doors cultivation for a period of time, so unless something important comes up, you guys can do as you see fit," Bai Li Shang gave a casual order then returned to his abode."Very well, everyone can disperse. I intend to close up for a period of time, so if there's nothing important you guys do as you see fit." Bai Li Shang returned to his own abode, and casually commanded.
"Yes, Commander."
The soldiers also laughingly dispersed.
As Xue Ying's power increased, the other parties from throughout the eastern region of the Calm Sea Prefecture all turned extremely obedient, and even those with rather strong backgrounds and connections who would normally hand over a small amount of faith energy had now temporarily put a limit on their greed. As per their words, "The speed at which Xue Ying cultivates is astonishing, and it won't be long until his power becomes even stronger. By that point, perhaps His Majesty would value him even more, so it's best not to provoke him during his time as a supervisor envoy."Because as Xue Ying's power increased, all parties in the Calm Sea Prefecture Eastern Region were all extremely obedient, and even those with rather strong backgrounds and connections who had handed over less Belief Energy now temporarily did not dare covet too much. Using their words: "The speed that Xue Ying cultivated was astonishing, and in not too long, his power would be even stronger, and perhaps His Majesty the God Emperor would value him more. During his period as a Supervisor, it was better not to provoke him."
As such, be it Xue Ying's personal guard, or the supervisor army, they were truly without a care.Therefore whether it was the Personal Guard Army of the Supervisor Army, they were truly very carefree.
"These days are truly carefree." Bai Li Shang entered his cultivation room where he obscure time and space to block any prying eyes, and finally took out and opened the wooden case. Inside the case was the same black sphere with uneven patterns from before."These days are truly carefree." Bai Li Shang soon entered his calm room, obscuring Time and Space, blocking probes, and only after that did his take out and open the wooden case. Within the wooden case was the black sphere with uneven patterns.
Bai Li Shang lightly stroked the black sphere which, in response, slowly lit up, its uneven patterns sending out rays of light to shine in the surrounding space. The complicated three dimensional patterns covering up the whole area were still immeasurably profound—the most complex Bai Li Shang had ever witnessed. Even the formation arrays of the Capital were far from being able to compare with them…
The Black Sphere slowly lit up, the uneven patterns giving off rays of light, and shined in the surrounding space. The complicated three dimensional patterns were still immeasurably profound in the surroundings. The patterns were the most complex that Bai Li Shang had seen in his life. Even the formation arrays of the Capital were far from being able to compare with it.
Monarch Cang staked his life and paid an enormous price, even going as far as to send so many World Deities to die, just to get this! Bai Li Shang caressed the black sphere, as anxiety gathered in his eyes. But what secret do you have? What are you hiding? Is it an absolute art? Is it some fearsome, exotic treasure?"Monarch Cang staked his life, paying such a huge price, letting so many World Deities die, just for you!" Bai Li Shang felt the black sphere, anxiety in his eyes, "But what secret do you have? What do you have? Is it an absolute art? Is it a fearsome and exotic treasure?"
Thirty thousand years…
Over thirty thousand years, Bai Li Shang had thought up all sorts of methods, and all kinds of refining techniques, sensing abilities, even anxiously experimenting with an increasingly large amount of brute force, yet nothing he did managed to disturb the sphere in any way.The thought of all sorts of methods, all kinds of refining methods, sensing methods, and even anxiously experimented with increasingly more brute force, yet could not disturb this black sphere at all.
He was unable to damage it, to disturb it, or to refine it in any way.Just like that, unable to damage, unable to disturb, unable to refine
With the exception of using Deity energy to light up te incomparably profound three-dimensional patterns, nothing else seemed to work.Other than deity energy causing incomparably profound three dimensional patterns to shine, there were no other uses.
I can tell that something isn't quite right. Bai Li Shang felt himself grow increasingly anxious. But just what am I doing wrong. What secrets do you hide?"I can feel that something isn't quite right," Bai Li Shang was anxious, "But just where am I wrong, what secrets do you have?"
The treasure was in his hands, yet he was unable to unravel the profound mysteries inside.The treasure was in hand, yet he was unable to unravel the profound mysteries inside.
Bai Li Shang found himself in a hurry.Bai Li Shang was also hurried.
The supervisor residence only had a few areas in front reserved as abodes for Xue Ying's personal guard. A much vaster area in the back was left for Xue Ying's family to use as a cultivation ground.In the Supervisor Residence, it was only a few areas in front which were the abodes of the Personal Guard Army, and the even vaster area in the black was the residence of Xue Ying's family, a Cultivation Ground.
Xue Ying was sitting cross-legged alone, within a sealed gloomy palace hall deep beneath the ground.Within a gloomy palace hall sealed underground.
Xue Ying sat alone cross-legged.
Hong long long~"Hong Long Long~~~"
Countless scenes appeared all around him depicting the crumbling of the world, the collapse of chaos, and even a faint image of the appearance of an extreme point. These were joined by scenes of flowers and plants wilting, of flying insects and grounded beasts ageing and turning into dessicated bones, as well as fires raging and turning entire forests into ash.Countless scenes appeared around him, the World crumbling, Chaos collapsing, an Extreme Point faintly appearing. There were scenes of flowers and plants wilting, and also scenes of flying insects and legged beasts age and become dessicated bones, as well as scenes of fires raging and turning entire forests into ashes.
Countless scenes had appeared, surrounded by a destructive intent that rippled in a way that could strike fear in most people's hearts.Countless scenes appeared.
In the surroundings of these scenes there was a destructive intent that rippled and make one fearful.
World, Chaos, and Extremity were the three stages of the Large Destruction aspect pertaining to the laws of the world. Xue Ying unceasingly pursued them as the three strongest killing moves he had at the moment. As his destruction spear techniques were perfected, he could also increase his comprehension of the Extremity Deity Heart.World, Chaos, Extremity, these were the three stages of Large Destruction of the laws of the world. Xue Ying unceasingly pursued the three strongest killing moves of his current self——As his spear techniques 'Destruction' became more perfect, he would use this to comprehend the Extremity Deity Heart.
Extremity…
As a young Transcendent, Xue Ying began his comprehension with the True Meaning of Extreme Piercing. But now, he finished his comprehension of the World Deity Heart and the Chaos Deity Heart, while the Extremity Deity Heart still eluded him.When he was young, Xue Ying had first comprehended the 'True Meaning of Extremity', and now the World Deity Heart had been comprehended, the Chaos Deity Heart had been comprehended,yet the Extremity Deity Heart was the slowest.
This was because Extreme Piercing and the Extremity Deity Heart were as far apart as the heaven and the earth, and they even followed completely different directions.It was because 'Extreme Penetration' and the 'Extremity Deity Heart' were as far apart as the heavens, and were even in completely different directions.
While Extreme Penetration walked a path of total extremity, the Extremity Deity Heart itself focused on absolute unification and balance; it was the beginning and end of everything. He had long since understood this point to be true, but of all the beginnings and endings in laws of the world, that incomparably profound one, was very hard to truly grasp. Still, Xue Ying's focus on his destruction spearmanship over many years, combined with a deep foundation in the direction of Extremity, he had long since touched that upon that separating layer.Extreme Penetration walked the path of the extreme.
Yet the Extremity Deity Heart was an absolute unification, and absolute balance, and the beginning and end of everything. He had long since recognized this point, but all beginnings and endings in Laws of the World, that incomparably profound 'One', was very hard to truly grasp. Comprehending spearmanship 'Destruction' for many years, as well as having a deep foundation in the direction of Extremity, Xue Ying had long since touched that layer of cloth.
He was separated by what seemed like nothing more than a layer of cloth, yet he still found himself unable to truly breach it.Just separated by a layer of cloth, yet why was he unable to grasp it?
I can feel myself unceasingly approaching it. Xue Ying smiled faintly, and the countless scenes of destruction surrounding him began to dissipate. There's no hurry. Where water flows, a canal is formed."I can feel myself unceasingly approach it." Xue Ying faintly smiled, and the surrounding countless scenes of destruction began to dissipate, "Don't hurry, where water flows, a canal is formed."
Then, he got up.
Xue Ying left the underground palace hall, walking upwards along a flight of stairs before eventually arriving at an outer door. Opening it, Xue Ying walked right out. The palace hall which he just left was a secret area Xue Ying used for cultivation and practice. Without his permission, nobody was allowed to enter. Normally, he would only go as far as to bring his son, daughter, and wife inside, giving out pointers to help solve problems his children faced in their cultivation.Xue Ying left this underground palace hall, and walked upwards along a flight of stairs, and soon arrived at the outer door and opened it. Xue Ying walk out. This Palace Hall was the secret area for Xue Ying's cultivation and practice, and without his permission nobody was allowed to enter. Normally he would only bring his son, daughter, and wife inside, and give pointers to problems in his son and daughter's cultivation.
As soon as he walked out, an attendant respectfully called out to him, "Your Majesty, a guest has come over on a visit, and he has already been waiting for two days."Once he walked out, an attendant respectfully said: "Your Majesty, a guest has come to visit, and has already waited for two days."
******

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - Emissary
chapters.content:
Chapter 504: Emissary
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"They've waited for two days?" Xue Ying nodded. He had forbidden anyone from disturbing him during closed-doors cultivation, unless it related to an absolutely important matter, "Who is it?"
"The visitors are His Highness, Long Yu, and he is accompanied by an unknown stage three World Deity," the attendant politely replied.
"His Highness Long Yu? Take me to them," Xue Ying ordered.
Xue Ying entered the hall accompanied by his wife went to welcome the two guests.
"Your Highness Long Yu, it's been a while. Since we've last met, back during the Myriad Flower Feast, 30,000 years have passed as if in the blink of an eye." Xue Ying gave the relatively luxurious black-robed teenager a once-over. This youngster was precisely the second prince of the Calm Sea Prefecture Master's Clan, the Long Shi Clan. He was the same second prince who hosted the banquet to which Xue Ying had been invited, which had led to tying a knot of enmity between him and Venomous Ying World Deity.
"Brother Dong Bo, it's fine if you just call me Long Yu. How could I dare to tell you, Brother Dong Bo, to call me 'Your Highness' or any such words," Long Yu replied. Despite his status as the Prefecture Master's favorite son, he had remained a stage one World Deity over such a long time. He could maintain such influential ability through his relationships, but Xue Ying depended on his own combat power. With such a status, Xue Ying was someone that even the Calm Sea Prefecture Master himself would not dare to slight, so there was no way Long Yu would dare to be disrespectful.
A mixture of complex emotions swirled through Long Yu's heart. Back during the banquet, Xue Ying was no more than a Deity, at least on the surface, but in the blink of an eye, his status underwent heaven-shattering transformations, only to now be ranked in the top three within the entire Calm Sea Prefecture.
"The reason I've come today is merely to help someone hand you a referral." Long Yu smiled, and turned to look at the green-robed man by his side. "This is a subordinate of my father's good friend, Monarch Cang Yong. His name is Mou Xiao."
"World Deity Mou Xiao?" Xue Ying nodded.
The green-robed man immediately said in a humble tone, "This Mou Xiao has arrived under orders. However, I had yet to meet Your Highness before this, so I requested the second prince's help in giving me a referral."
"Orders?" Xue Ying was startled. "You've come under Monarch Cang Yong's order?" Sitting beside Xue Ying, Jing Qiu also sent him a curious glance.
"Indeed. I've been ordered to come by the monarch," the green-robed man said.
A large volume of information regarding Monarch Cang Yong began emerging within Xue Ying's heart. The man was a stage four World Deity, but he was unlike Monarch Mo Xue, who had simply lived for far too long already, and whose True Deity Heart could crumble at any given time. Monarch Cang Yong was still quite young, and had friends all over the place. A young stage four World Deity like him was the sort of figure most superpowers would never dare to offend.
These people could live for a very long period of time, and they even held huge hopes of becoming powerful existences too. Other experts, such as Monarch Mo Xue and the Calm Sea Prefecture Master, had spent a lot of time to slowly improve their combat power, so their potential had long since been used up. Their chances at becoming powerful existences were slim.
"I've never even met Monarch Cang Yong before, so what matter could he have that required him to send you over to meet me?" Xue Ying asked.
"The Monarch had originally planned to come in person, but some other business on the same day prevented him from making it. This one hopes Your Highness might forgive us for it." The green-robed man lowered his stature. "Indeed, I have come due to a matter with which I might have to trouble Your Highness."
"Pray, tell." Xue Ying brought up his wine cup, lightly drinking a mouthful.
The green-robed man complied. "There is a stage two World Deity who goes by the name of World Deity Shang Yi who has sprouted some enmity with my clan's monarch! This enmity is such that monarch could never forget it, but World Deity Shang Yi conducted his act only after using a treasure which could distort the space time continuum, which made it very difficult to find any trace of him. However, the monarch stopped at nothing, even sowing karma to connect with others before finally finding out where this Shang Yi is located."
Long Yu stepped in, startled, "He actually sowed karma just to find traces of the target? The monarch must have truly hated this World Deity Shang Yi."
"Right." The green-robed man nodded. "Our investigations of the traces left by this World Deity Shang Yi led to me coming out to find Your Highness Dong Bo."
"Meet me? I do not know of any person called World Deity Shang Yi, though," Xue Ying replied.
"World Deity Shang Yi is aware of how furious the monarch was, so he carefully hid all traces of himself, and he has also changed his appearance. On top of that, he crafted a new name for himself, which is 'Bai Li Shang'. Under that name, he entered Your Highness' personal guard, and even became one of your commanders." The green-robed man said.
"Commander Bai Li Shang?" The expressions on both Xue Ying's and Jing Qiu's faces changed slightly.
One of his personal guard's commanders had offended Monarch Cang Yong?
"Had he thrown himself to some other superpower, we would have already acted long ago. However, he decided to rely on Your Highness, so we naturally had to come inform you about this matter," the green-robed man said. "My clan's monarch stopped at nothing, even sowing karma just to find this enemy he'd been trying to find for tens of thousands of years. My hope is that Your Highness can conveniently chase him out of your personal guard."
Acting directly against commander of Xue Ying's personal guard would be akin to slapping him in the face! Even someone of Monarch Cang Yong's status would have to think twice before doing it. After all, Monarch Cang Yong was not certain who held the historical treasure yet. Had he been sure that Bai Li Shang had it, he would have long acted.
"I can't help but wonder how this enmity began, that it could make monarch stop at nothing to deal with Bai Li Shang." Xue Ying frowned.
"It is a private matter, and monarch has not disclosed any details to me." The green-robed man said. "The monarch's killing intent is undoubtedly heavy, however, and disregarded any price he had to pay just to kill this Shang Yi! Furthermore, Shang Yi has not been truly sincere to Your Highness either. He deliberately crafted a fake name before entering Your Highness' retinue, just to increase his chances of survival."
Xue Ying frowned. "He might have faked his identity, but he's already been here for thirty thousand years. During his time as a commander in my personal guard, he worked assiduously and did not make any mistakes."
"Your Highness, all you need is to chase him out of your retinue," the green-robed man retorted. "My clan master will naturally remember this favor, and will certainly come in person to repay you, sometime in the future."
Xue Ying shook his head. "Bai Li Shang is a stage two World Deity, while your clan monarch is an overlord! What great enmity could even form between such two figures? How did it happen?"
"The monarch has not disclosed any details." The green-robed man was helpless.
"Once you clearly tell me how the enmity between the two parties formed, I'll naturally find Commander Bai Li Shang and investigate the matter. If the investigation is verified, and he is found to be a scheming person, I'll naturally chase him out of my personal guard," Xue Ying indifferently said. "However, should Commander Bai Li have been accused wrongly and been pursued without having done anything wrong, could I just watch him die?"
The green-robed man's expression changed.
He was merely a commander!
Over the many years, the number of stage two World Deities steadily increased. Adding up the four commander figures under Xue Ying with several guests who were staying over, there were now ten such figures! Was there really a need to go against his clan's master, Monarch Cang Yong himself, just for the sake of a single stage two World Deity?
"Your Highness, will you not accept to chase him out of your personal guard?" The green-robed man frowned.
"Are you threatening me?" Xue Ying's eyes turned cold.
The green-robed man growled. "I am doing no such thing. The only thing I'll say is that my clan monarch will definitely not spare World Deity Shang Yi!"
"I won't accept anyone daring to even to think of touching my people!" Xue Ying coldly retorted. "Attendant, send this guest away!"
"Please!"
Two World Deity attendants immediately shouted. The sight of His Highness being so willing to protect his subordinates left them feeling truly excited and simultaneously at ease.
The green-robed man stood up with an ugly expression.
"This is unnecessary, why not just talk things over?" Long Yu said from the side.
"Long Yu, this doesn't concern you." Xue Ying glanced at the green-robed man. "I've shown you enough respect in this discussion. Taking out Monarch Cang Yong's name to threaten me? What a joke!"
The green-robed man was forcibly suppressing his anger. He slightly clasped his hand for a farewell and then immediately took his leave.
Long Yu hurriedly explained, "Brother Dong Bo, I've merely come to give a referral. I did not think the situation would turn out like this. However, you should be a bit more careful. The way I see it, Monarch Cang Yong truly seems to hold some huge killing intent towards Commander Bai Li Shang, and I don't think their enmity is small at all."
"I appreciate the concern." Despite having acted coldly toward the green-robed man, Xue Ying was smiling as he talked with Long Yu.
"I'll be taking my leave first, then." Long Yu hurried out of the place.
Back in the hall, Xue Ying revealed a frown. "Jing Qiu, Monarch Cang Yong is a stage four World Deity, and he's the overlord of a region in the Deity world. What kind of vengeance could he have with Bai Li Shang? And for it to be something that he isn't even willing to talk about…"
"Something casually fabricated will be easily exposed," Jing Qiu replied. "If he isn't willing to talk about it, it likely involved some other secret which he isn't willing to publicize. Furthermore, the vision and temperament of any stage four World Deities is normally extraordinary, and it's very rare that they would see a need to be so picky about bullying someone weaker. Monarch Cang Yong has three children, but I've not heard of his children having encountered any danger in the past. For the moment, I can't think of any way that enmity could form between the two parties."
Xue Ying nodded.
This matter left him puzzled as well. Without even clarifying the contents of this enmity, how could he be willing to let his subordinate die? If he was to chase Bai Li Shang out of his personal guard, it would be nothing short of sending him to his death!
"Attendant," Xue Ying suddenly voiced.
"Your Highness," an attendant outside the room acknowledged his order.
"Bring Commander Bai Li Shang over to see me," Xue Ying ordered.
******

chapters.title: Chapter 505 - Diplomacy Before Violence
chapters.content:
Chapter 505: Diplomacy Before Violence
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Back in his cultivation room, Bai Li Shang was currently pondering the secrets of the black sphere in his hands. The surface of the object showed its usual glowing uneven patterns.
How should I solve this?
What secret is it hiding? Bai Li Shang was racking his brains for an answer. He was clear that this sphere represented the biggest gain of his life, as well as his most important miraculous encounter! Should he succeed in solving the profound mysteries within, his destiny would very likely change. However, even with the relic now in his hands, Bai Li Shang simply could not solve its secrets.
All of a sudden, a voice came into the room from outside, "Commander Bai Li, Commander Bai Li."
Cultivation room arrays would allow normally allow sound to be sent in from outside, but would prevent anything from leaking to the outside.
"Mn?" Bai Li Shang frowned. He immediately stored the black sphere back into the wooden box before opening the stone door to leave his cultivation room.
"What's the matter? Did I not say tell you not to disturb me unless it's about an important matter?" Bai Li Shang swept his gaze across, only to see a single World Deity attendant right outside. He immediately recognized him as the person responsible for the protection of the main hall.
The World Deity attendant smiled. "Commander Bai Li, His Highness has given order for you to quickly go see him."
"His Highness?" Bai Li Shang was stunned. "Alright, I'll go over right this moment."
Bai Li Shang felt his head muddled with fog as he rushed over to the main hall. Over the many years he had been depending on Xue Ying, not once did Xue Ying summon him for a meeting while he was undergoing closed-doors cultivation. After all, once everyone saw how the Venomous Ying World Deity was dealt with, nobody dared to offend the supervisor envoy residence any longer. As such, the place remained extremely peaceful.
Upon entering the main hall, Bai Li Shang saw Xue Ying and Jing Qiu seated next to each other on the head positions.
"Greetings, Your Highness and madam," Bai Li Shang politely greeted.
"Commander Bai Li, or should I be calling you World Deity Shang Yi instead?" Xue Ying suddenly said.
Bai Li Shang was momentarily stunned.
Shang Yi?
He had been discovered? Revealed? The relic was still on his body. Would Xue Ying snatch it from him?
As soon as his identity was revealed, his expression quickly changed. He was looking at Xue Ying with a strand of panic in his eyes. Very soon, however, he recovered his calm. Dong Bo Xue Ying's combat power far surpasses mine. On top of that, we're here, at the supervisor envoy's territory and residence. With countless arrays strengthening the residence, I am entirely helpless to face him. He'll just have to do as he wishes.
He already controls whether I live or die. If that's the case, is there any need for me to be so anxious? Bai Li Shang understood that struggling was futile, and decided to simply stop doing it. Quickly after, he understood a second fact. Nobody can be certain that I'm holding the relic. If he were to be sure that the treasure is with me, he would have long since acted. He would have no reason to be spouting rubbish with me.
At first he was nervous, then he became anguished and helpless. Eventually, however, he calmed down and recovered his wits.
All of this had happened really quickly.
"Your Highness is aware of this matter?" Bai Li Shang turned his vision upwards to match Xue Ying's.
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded. "It'll be best if you're honest and explain everything to me."
At this point, Bai Li Shang was sure that Xue Ying did not know the full story. Furthermore, he himself would certainly not reveal his greatest secret until the most desperate moment. He immediately answered, "How did Your Highness find out about my identity? Ws it Monarch Cang Yong who sent someone over?"
Bai Li Shang was a very intelligent fellow, so he could guess what had happened right away.
"What kind of enmity do you have with Monarch Cang Yong?" Xue Ying asked. Seeing Bai Li Shang become flustered just moments before had caused a strand of suspicion to sprout in the minds of both Xue Ying and Jing Qiu.
"I am no more than a tiny and weak World Deity. How could I ever be qualified to offend Monarch Cang Yong? In reality, it was Monarch Cang Yong who was entirely too ruthless," Bai Li Shang helplessly replied. "A while ago, he captured a group of World Deities, including myself, and forced us to enter some ruins, effectively sending us to our deaths. Later, when the place collapsed, the many World Deities all escaped in different directions. Using that opportunity, I also escaped, and only then did I regain my freedom. Who would have thought that Monarch Cang Yong would still continue chasing me!
"Your Highness, Your Highness," Bai Li Shang was staring at Xue Ying, begging without stop. "I can only hope that Your Highness can continue to protect this life of me. Without your help, I would have long since been dead."
Xue Ying exchanged glances with Jing Qiu.
Ruins?
"The Deity world is vast and wide, and there are many World Deities within it. Since you managed to escape, the enmity should just have ended there. Why would it be that, without a care for sowing so much karma, he'd continue pursuing you guys?" Xue Ying frowned. "What do you all hold that makes it worth for him to so frantically chase you and kill you off?"
"Karma?" At this point, Bai Li Shang finally understood how Monarch Cang Yong had found him.
Karma was a truly mystical force.
Even the powerful existences, who could transcend the river of eternity, would produce karma just the same. It was through karma that the powerful existences would immediately know when Xue Ying or anyone else called out their name! This was precisely because they reached the realm they were at that they could have such intricate senses towards karma. Stage four World Deities had yet to transcend eternity, so their senses could not reach such a stage.
"I'm going to ask you once more: what exactly do you all have that is worth him chasing after you guys?" Xue Ying asked again.
Bai Li Shang felt his heart tightening.
"This is something I'm also unsure of," Bai Li Shang helplessly replied. "It's likely because we've uncovered his secrets."
"Secrets?" Xue Ying asked.
"It's about those ruins!" Bai Li Shang waved his hand, causing a complex diagram to appear in mid-air. "This star map marks the position of the ruins. At first, we also did not know the position of the ruins, and it was only after they collapsed and we escaped that we finally understood their accurate position! The ruins might have already collapsed, but they are still incredible in size. My guess is that they still hold something that cannot be revealed?"
Xue Ying looked at Bai Li Shang. "This is all because of some ruins?"
"I can't think of anything else it might be," Bai Li Shang added.
"Mn." Xue Ying lightly nodded then left him with an order, "Commander Bai Li, from now on, you should not leave the supervisor envoy residence. Monarch Cang Yong has left one of his subordinates outside to keep a close a watch on you. I'm afraid that, as soon as you leave, you might just die at any time."
Bai Li Shang felt flustered and lost.
"Also, if you have an avatar, it would be best if you moved it away from your true body," Xue Ying concluded.
What does he mean? Is he perhaps already aware that my avatar is also here? Bai Li Shand thought to himself. His true body and avatar were both located within the supervisor envoy residence. Since he only had one treasure he could use to distort spacetime, this was the only way he could protect and conceal himself. If his avatar were to be captured by Monarch Cang Yong, the latter had methods to ensure that he could not even kill himself! On top of that, the monarch could very easily sweep through and investigate his memories!
"Many thanks, Your Highness. I'll certainly be careful," Bai Li Shang said.
"You may leave," Xue Ying said, and Bai Li Shang politely complied.
Only Xue Ying and Jing Qiu now remained within the hall.
"Those ruins he mentioned are likely real. It's not the sort of matter he could easily lie about. However, he was too vague when talking about them. He might have provided a map, but he did not give any details about it." Xue Ying frowned.
Jing Qiu giggled. "You've overthinking it. In fact, it was you who did not ask him for details."
"Perhaps." Xue Ying nodded.
"Even so, I think you should give your personal guard order to increase the scope of their patrols. The way I see it, Monarch Cang Yong is unlikely to let go of this matter so easily," Jing Qiu said.
In the Deity world, over at the distant Cang Yong Empire.
The Cang Yong Empire was truly sprawling, and it had been single-handedly brought up through Monarch Cang Yong's efforts. In his country, he had an overwhelming amount of power; his will was also this country's will! It was for reasons like this that many experts were not willing to join organizations such as the Bloodshed God Palace, the Temporal Island, or the Myriad God Palace. To depend on someone also meant that they would have to be restricted by many rules and limitations.
Even killing a stage three World Deity would be tough. How troublesome was that?
"Monarch," the green-robed World Deity Mou Xiao respectfully greeted.
High above, a large, tall figure could be seen sitting atop a throne of white jade. Behind his back were many bony protrusions, rows of them forming a fan-like shape. The figure's head was bald, and neither did there seem to be any hair on his face. His eyes were apathetic, and it was easy to determine from his appearance that he was not human.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying said he would defend his subordinate. He will not chase out World Deity Shang Yi under any circumstance, unless we clearly state the contents of the enmity between us and World Deity Shang Yi and affirm the truth," the green-robed man respectfully said.
"This Dong Bo Xue Ying…" Monarch Cang Yong's long and slender finger drummed upon the armrest of his throne.
