The rock shook once more before that single part keeping it attached broke completely, leaving the rock to fall to the side.
"Success!" Xue Ying immediately praised her.
Jing Qiu extended her hand, causing the piece of Calamity Rock Essence to fly into her hands. She felt it for a second before she finally threw it in Xue Ying's direction. "You can keep it."
"You're giving it to me?" Xue Ying was startled.
"This is the most valuable thing I've ever found, and I want you to have it as a gift." Jing Qiu giggled.
Xue Ying grabbed the fragment of Calamity Rock Essence. As he felt it over, he gave a nod. "It weighs roughly six kilograms, so I can see how it would be the most valuable thing you've found." This single rock was worth about seven to eight hundred million Deity crystals, a value comparable to the entire accumulated wealth of a newly-emerged stage four World Deity. Of course, some of the stronger stage three World Deities who had lived for a longer period of time might also have been able to earn such a sum.
Even greedier figures like the Venomous Ying World Deity would fear to covet such a huge amount.
"Let's go check out the next crack, then." Jing Qiu was relatively happy. Essentially stumbling across such a huge sum of money was bound to make anyone happy.
…
The two then teamed up to break apart some rocks in one more location. When it came to this second fragment, they only managed to separate it once after launching a joint attack on the weak spot. As for the other six more distinct cracks, they had failed to break a fragment off regardless of how they went about it.
Even then, these two rocks alone reached a combined weight of ten kilograms.
"These Lake Heart Island ruins are, indeed, something different. We've had some pretty huge gains before we even reached the island itself," Jing Qiu said.
"We could only gain this much because we were lucky enough to land on this specific meteor with the abode where the senior left behind a notice to inform us of this matter. Otherwise, we might have never discovered this secret," Xue Ying said. Very few people were aware of this information. This was primarily because there just were not that many people who would dare to venture into the Lake Heart Island, while the number of people who just happened to land on a meteorite was even smaller.
After all, the enormous silvery-white sphere of water which enveloped Lake Heart Island had a diameter of 9.45 trillion kilometers. Even with a hundred million meteorites inside, when they were scattered all throughout such a large space, they became rather hard to find.
Of course, Xue Ying himself had no intention of publicizing this matter either. He was not so foolish as to lose such an opportunity. The myriad existences of the world all followed a cycle of the laws, so anyone who hoped to obtain something would have to pay an equivalent price.
Hu.
The two continued walking along the surface of the meteorite, crossing through many huge valleys.
"It's deep within here." Xue Ying's luminous sun force spread out. He had long since discovered the corpse and pavilion left behind by Emperor Heavencloud.
Within a deep recess of the great canyon, there was a circular gap in an array diagram. In fact, the array diagram itself was formed up entirely of patterns formed by similar gaps.
"Let's go inside."
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu passed through the first gap, following the enormous array diagram gaps for more than fifteen hundred kilometers before finally entering an enormous empty cavern.
This enormous empty cavern was about 500 kilometers in length of area.
At the very center of this cavern was a pavilion. Inside it, the two spotted a figure sitting cross-legged and looking forward. A ball of silver and red light was floating right across his eyes. The light had a truly dazzling feel to it, and it seemed to have formed a truly splendid array diagram with more than a hundred million nodes continuously revolving about.
"Monarch Heavenly Cloud." Xue Ying and Jing Qiu walked over.
While there was no doubt that the figure sitting cross-legged was none other than Emperor Heavencloud… he was actually just a corpse!
Emperor Heavencloud was a truly muscular, sturdy man. Even after his death, his figure sitting cross-legged on the floor still had a broad back and a muscular frame that emitted a truly heroic, tyrannical aura. His will had long since become one with his body, despite his death having occurred more than two hundred billion years earlier, his terrifying willpower had yet to dissipate. The sight of such strong will caused the expressions on the two's faces to change.
"This is…!" Xue Ying walked closer to take a look at Emperor Heavencloud's face, and the sight left him stunned.
"He, how could he…"
"Even after his death, he refused to close his eyes or lower his head?" Xue Ying did not dare believe his eyes.
Emperor Heavencloud was simply sitting there, looking up at the array diagram illusion in front of his eyes. His eyebrows were thick, his eyes filled with spirit and terrifying desire. It must be stated that, during one's death, their True Deity Heart would immediately dissipate. For him to remain staring at the array diagram even after his True Deity Heart crumbled apart, and to never stop fighting and searching for any strand of hope…
"Even death couldn't force him to give up." Xue Ying watched on with a solemn expression.
This was what it meant to be an absolutely proud and heavenly character.
Even after his True Deity Heart crumbled, he still kept his head raised and his eyes open, fixed on the array diagram. His eyes were filled with desire so intense that Xue Ying could actually feel it.
"Such will."
"What a Dao Heart."
Xue Ying imeediately began contemplating.
Emperor Heavencloud had died more than two hundred billion years ago, yet his will did not disperse from this space. Such characters were so rare that Xue Ying might never get to see another in his entire life. He had seen many stage four World Deities before, but not one ever astonished him so much. Having met such people like his Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming, as well as Forefather Scarlet Flame and other powerful existences, he still had to admit not one of those people had a will that was as strong as this person's.
Only the people who had come during the Myriad Flower Feast like the the Abyss Rulers, His Majesty and the three ancestors might compare, but was unable to discern such things back then.
Even so, ordinary powerful existences, in Xue Ying's opinion, would absolutely not have the will or Dao Heart to surpass this person before him. After all, this man had thoroughly terrified even the Overlord of Destruction himself. Emperor Heavencloud had brought the overlord to a point where he was so frightened that he even disregarded his reputation just to beg the Bloodshed God Emperor for a treasure which would allow him to scheme against him.
"Will, will…" Xue Ying continued contemplating.
He sat cross-legged next to the emperor and closed his eyes.
"Xue Ying?" Standing at the side, Jing Qiu had also been startled by the terrifying undulations of will released by Emperor Heavencloud's corpse. By the time she regained her senses, she discovered that her husband had taken a cross-legged stance on the ground and began cultivating with his eyes closed. She could not help but feel puzzled about this matter, but she did not dare disturb him either.
…
After he sat down with his eyes closed, Xue Ying finally became aware of something.
Ever since he he became the Bloodshed God Emperor's disciple, he was seen as a truly dazzling figure. By now, however, he felt it necessary to take the initiative and bring his wife over to the ruins of Lake Heart Island partly because he felt his peaceful life had begun eroding his will.
At first, it was nothing more than a vague feeling, but as soon as he saw Emperor Heavencloud's corpse whose head was head raised even after death, and his eyes still open, something moved inside of Xue Ying.
He understood that there was a huge gap between him and the man sitting before him.
To seek the Dao Heart! To have a determined will!
From my youth and to this moment, I've kept pushing my way forward, be it for the sake of my little brother, or for the sake of my parents, or for the sake of Xia clan, or for my wife's sake. Before I knew it, I had already become a grade one True Meaning Transcendent. But what then? After I became teacher's disciple, I might have increased in power really quickly, but that was only because the aspects of extremity, chaos, and world were three of my favourite paths from back when I was still a Transcendent. It was only natural that I could succeed in comprehending them so quickly. In reality, however, my Dao Heart is simply not that strong anymore.
Right now, I am lacking a razor-sharp will, lacking an intense desire for a strong Dao Heart. Compared to Emperor Heavencloud, there's so much I'm lacking!
**

chapters.title: Chapter 527 - Eleven Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 527: Eleven Years
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Jing Qiu looked to her side to see Xue Ying, who had already been sitting cross-legged for half an hour, finally start to open his eyes. His vision seemed much more focused now.
"Xue Ying, what happened to you?" Jing Qiu couldn't help but ask.
Xue Ying stood up, turned to look Emperor Heavencloud's corpse still staring at the array diagram even in death, and said, "The heart is like a mirror, while cultivating the heart is much like polishing that mirror to allow a clearer reflection. That's something I must frequently remind myself of time and time again. Otherwise, if dust is left to cover that mirror, the reflection will also dull before long. Emperor Heavencloud's Dao Heart is strong that it allowed me to understand this point. It let me understand that my Dao Heart is simply not strong enough!
"However, just having this understanding is not sufficient. If I wish to cultivate my heart, I must walk forward on actual ground. Only by doing so can I ever hope to reaffirm my Dao Heart," Xue Ying explained.
Jing Qiu saw a newfound sharpness in Xue Ying's eyes, and could not help but be stunned! Her Dao Heart was quite firm in and of itself, but it was in no way comparable to Xue Ying's or Emperor Heavencloud's. Characters like them would be able to press forward regardless of circumstance, and they had a kind of tyranny and focus that came from their ability to give up anything for the sake of their goals.
"My will might not be comparable to his at the moment, but that might not necessarily be true forever. After all, he's been refining his Dao Heart over ten billion years." Xue Ying smiled. He walked further into the pavilion to take a closer look at the floating ball of silver and red light. These two colors combined with the countless nodes to form a complete array diagram, with those nodes criss-crossing and transforming without end.
Xue Ying carefully inspected it before speaking out, "Jing Qiu, it's quite likely that Emperor Heavencloud is the one who activated this array."
"I think so too." Jing Qiu agreed. "I've spent a bit of time inspecting and I've found that it truly is quite deep."
"Mn."
Xue Ying did the same, moving up to get a more thorough look at the array diagram.
Weng~
His consciousness entered the array, making him feel as if his body had shrunk into nothing more than a small dot in the midst of this enormous array diagram. Surrounding it, he could only see seemingly countless planets revolving all around. In fact, there were than a hundred million planets in uninterrupted motion. While seemingly slow at glance, every last planet gave off an unique sense of beauty. On top of that, each planet was moving along a distinct orbit which gave the whole set a sense of vastness.
It gave off a feeling similar to facing the entire material world. The plants were like the countless mortal realms revolving through the material world.
In spite of their similarities, the array exuded an aura that was more tyrannical than what the material world was known for! It was a direct, oppressive tyranny, as if nobody would be allowed to move the array even an inch!
If the vast law of the material realm gave off the feeling of an ordinary person, then this array could be compared to a full-plated warrior holding onto their weapon!
"Mn?"
As he watched the countless planets moving along their orbits, Xue Ying had a sudden insight. He had vaguely sensed the concept of destruction in that motion, and it had even been at a level comparable to the destructive aura which he felt coming from his teacher, the Bloodshed God Emperor! There was a terrifying killing intent fermenting inside these slowly moving planets.
Once this killing intent was let loose, it seemed like it would tear through the earth and shatter the heavens.
Since one of Xue Ying's three most important secret skills focused precisely on this aspect of destruction, he could not help but immerse himself in that feeling. As soon as he did so, he forgot even time.
…
The days passed, one after another.
Jing Qiu had also immersed herself in studying the array diagram, yet she would wake up every once in a while. As a stage four World Deity, she could understand a larger part of the array. However, that only served to startle her even more. "It's no wonder that Emperor Heavencloud chose to focus on this array diagram prior to his death, and use it as his last gamble! This array formed by the hundred million meteorites of Lake Heart Island only feels more unfathomable the more I study it."
The two of them simply stood there and watched the array for more than a month.
"Xue Ying, Xue Ying," a voice reached him, seemingly coming from far away.
Peng.
Xue Ying suddenly woke up, and immediately sensed the acute pain coursing through his body. Seeing this, Jing Qiu retrieved her palm and hurriedly asked, "What happened to you?"
"Ah." Xue Ying raised his hands to grab his head as the pain passed through it. At the same time, blood started dripping out from his nose.
His avatar was not the only one to receive the backlash either. His white-robed true body back in the Xia Clan world's Crimson Rock Mountain felt some pain pass through his head and had a similar nosebleed. However, the treasure spirit of the Crimson Rock Mountain had also awoken him at about the same time Jing Qiu did.
"After I discovered the great destruction aspect of this array, I kept on pondering and gaining new insights. However, without me even realizing it, my True Deity Heart was hurt by the terrifying killing intent of the array, and the damage reflected on my body." Xue Ying shook his head. "In fact, this avatar was not the only one to get hurt. Even my true body back in the Xia Clan world received the same injury. That killing intent was simply too terrifying. Merely studying the array was enough to cause me this much damage."
Jing Qiu was astonished. "By damaging your True Deity Heart, it also damaged your body? And it even injured the true body back in the material world? Powerful existences might be able to use karma to kill an enemy that is very far away, but this array could actually damage your true body without using any trace of karma?"
"Indeed, it did not use karma. My avatar and my true body were both comprehending the array, and that's why both were injured. This array is just too strong. It doesn't feel any shred weaker than the operating laws of the entire material realm." Xue Ying shook his head. "I can't continue studying it. My comprehension of the aspect of destruction contained by this array has reached a limit. Trying to go any further would just get me killed."
"I can still keep going," Jing Qiu said. "Likely because I'm not focused on the aspect of destruction. I am prepared to leave behind a World Deity avatar here to continue studying the array."
"Alright, let's quickly set off for Lake Heart Island, then," Xue Ying replied.
Before leaving, Xue Ying turned towards Emperor Heavencloud's corpse which was still sitting there, cross-legged. With a wave of his hand, a large amount of soil and rocks emerged and moved around according to an invisible force. He first moved the corpse to the side, then covered him under the soil and rocks, forming a grave.
"Emperor Heavencloud, return to safety under the ground," Xue Ying lightly muttered.
…
Xue Ying left the meteorite alongside his wife. He used his luminous sun force to scout a path ahead through the endless flow of water before moving out at high speed.
The enormous silvery-white sphere of water had a diameter of more than 9.45 trillion kilometers, an entirely enormous size.
While inside the flowing water, experts could not tear through space, so they had to resort to flying continuously. Back on the road, the two experienced many more dangers. They even encountered a school of violet sword fish and some other unique lifeforms living in the flowing water. These lifeforms had existed ever since the Lake Heart Island ruins first emerged. Xue Ying and Jing Qiu had suffered the pursuit of some of these lifeforms, forcing them to leave behind Deity avatars to confuse the enemies.
They even encountered the undercurrent a few more times.
As they became more experienced, they could determine from afar whether the undercurrent would arrive soon through the current flow of the water. They could even begin to estimate whether terrifying lifeforms were approaching them.
They had traveled for a total of eleven years!
Indeed, it took eleven years of traveling through the enormous silvery-white sphere of water, crossing through the various obstacles found in the flow of water, before the two finally approached the central island.
Hong~
Upon crossing an invisible boundary that was able to block even the flowing water, the black-robed teenager and the white-robed girl with silver hair were both startled by the sight of the huge island ahead of them. Other than its ability to block all water from nearing it, the island stood out because of its pure silver color and endless frost covering its surface. The cold icy aura it exuded left Xue Ying and Jing Qiu both trembling uncontrollably. The size of Lake Heart Island proper was naturally nowhere near that of the silvery-white sphere of water, but it was still reported to cover an area of more than half a trillion kilometers.
"Jing Qiu, this is truly not easy, but we finally arrived at this piece of Lake Heart Island." Xue Ying shook his head, "I thought I would have lost my life on the road here through the water flow level."
Jing Qiu also nodded. The road here was truly arduous.
"Fortunately, we're arrived at a good time. The Lake Heart Island is currently frozen, making it much much safer," Jing Qiu said. "We must make use of this opportunity and hurry over to find my father! Of course, we'll also have to find the true god weapon. By the way, we won't be able to take the same path which my father and the rest previously followed. Old Mother Withered Tree, the Nine Yang Palace Head and the rest are likely keeping watch over that road, and we must try our best to avoid them."
"I'll leave everything for you to decide," Xue Ying replied.
"I hope we'll be able to save my father before Lake Heart Island warms up," Jing Qiu said. The temperature on Lake Heart Island was always changing. It would first get colder and colder down to a limit, before starting to get warmer and warmer up to a different limit!
It could exhibit both extreme cold and extreme heat.
The cultivators who visited the ruins of Lake Heart Island, even if they were powerful existences, would usually refrain from entering during the periods of extreme heat. During such times, the danger level of the island would rapidly surge.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 528 - First Time Entering teh Cavern
chapters.content:
Chapter 528: First Time Entering teh Cavern
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu were flying at high speed over the icy-cold Lake Heart Island all while carefully observing their surroundings. With how big the island was, there were bound to be many caverns around.
"We're quite some distance away from the region where father entered," Jing Qiu said. "Let's enter here and then make our way over to him."
"Alright." Xue Ying nodded when, all of a sudden, he turned toward a certain direction with a frown.
Two streams of light were flying rapidly over to his location.
"Hahaha."
"Isn't this His Highness, Dong Bo?"
The two figures followed an arc through the sky then landed on the ground. Both of them were well-known stage four World Deities. One was a plump man violet outer robes. He also had two antennas dangling from his head. The other was a seemingly ordinary World Deity carrying a huge black ruler on his back. His clothing was all-black, his expression cold and callous. He had taken on the appearance of a middle-aged man. The two of them took the initiative to approach the couple, and the violet-robed fatty said, "Your Highness, I've visited you some years ago. Do you still remember me?"
"Monarch Armadillo Jade?" Xue Ying laughed. "Who could have known we would meet here, at Lake Heart Island."
"Lake Heart Island is a truly large place; for us to have met means there must be some fate binding us. Fu Qiong and I both noticed Your Highness while you were quite some distance away, so we rushed over," the plump Monarch Armadillo Jade added.
The black-robed middle-aged man with a cold demeanour, King Fu Qiong, slightly cupped his hands in greeting. "Your Highness."
"King Fu Qiong. I've long since heard of your name," Xue Ying politely replied.
"And this is?" Monarch Armadillo Jade turned to face the masked girl with silver hair. She was emitting the aura of a stage four World Deity. There were only so many stage four World Deities throughout the Deity world and Dark Abyss, so most would recognize each other at a glance.
"This is my good friend, Empress Nine Swords," Xue Ying answered.
Hearing this, Jing Qiu shot Xue Ying a meaningful glance.
"Greetings, Nine Swords," the two said in unison. In spite of their polite greeting, they couldn't help but feel confused; from where did this Empress Nine Swords suddenly appear?
"Your Highness, are you two perhaps preparing to enter the inner section of Lake Heart Island?" Armadillo Jade asked.
"Indeed. By walking on the boundary of life and death, I hope to refine my Dao Heart," Xue Ying replied.
"If Your Highness doesn't mind, would you agree with the two of us joining in on your adventure?" Armadillo Jade and King Fu Qiong had clearly set up the stage for this very moment.
Xue Ying exchanged a glance with Jing Qiu.
They were about to go through a more unfamiliar cavern, and it was impossible to know how dangerous it would be. The two of them could be seen as weak, but Monarch Armadillo Jade and King Fu Qiong had much more experience than either of them. Monarch Armadillo Jade's combat power was especially deep and profound, likely comparable to Hui Ming's. Indeed, they would be of much help.
"Hahaha, I am truly happy that Brother Armadillo Jade is willing to join us," Xue Ying said. "The two of us are prepared to go through the cavern ahead of us, though. I do wonder, were you two also heading that way?"
"The cavern ahead of here?" Both Armadillo Jade and King Fu Qiong were startled as they turned to look at the cavern not too far from them.
King Fu Qiong couldn't help but put on a frown as he said, "Your Highness Dong Bo, not even powerful existences tend to enter from this cavern. I think it would be best that we entered through a more familiar cavern. That way, we'll be more certain of making it inside."
"That might be true, but opportunities will also be harder to come by if we go through a more familiar cavern." Xue Ying shook his head. "I've already decided to go through this cavern. Should the two of you not be willing to follow, we can only go our separate ways."
"This…"
King Fu Qiong and Monarch Armadillo Jade exchanged a momentary glance before quickly settling on a decision.
The two of them had already taken the initiative to join Xue Ying for the sake of befriending him. Friendships were easiest to develop by means of sharing life-or-death encounters, after all.
"Fu Qiong, let's just treat this as a chance encounter with His Highness and gamble away these avatars of ours. If we manage to develop a closer friendship with Dong Bo, who might become a powerful existence in the future, and immediately reach the power of a venerable existence. We'd be able to reap huge benefits from that," Monarch Armadillo Jade tried to persuade his companion. The power of a venerable was comparable to that of the three ancestors.
The three ancestors were known to be on the Bloodshed God Palace's side.
Meanwhile, other experts of that level, like Monarch Green, the Mysterious North Imperial Empress, and similar existences who were moving freely without joining any organizations were termed known as venerable existences.
"Alright." King Fu Qiong quickly decided without mulling over it for long. "I do feel that Dong Bo should be well-prepared since he dares take such a risk."
"True. He might have some secret treasure map," Monarch Armadillo Jade sent back.
The two of them had decided so quickly that they startled Xue Ying and Jing Qiu. Despite their surprise, they were inwardly happy to know that two people who were more experienced than them would be helping out, greatly increasing their chances of success. They had come at this time purely because they wished to help Monarch Mo Xue. But in reality, the ruins of Lake Heart Island were so dangerous that they probably could not even hope at a 10% success rate.
However, their chances could have been even lower and they still would have come. They knew how likely they were to fail before even setting off.
"I'll be in the vanguard, scouting the route ahead. I've cultivated a secret technique that gives my eyes an ability to see through any illusions" Monarch Armadillo Jade explained while his eyes became incomparably deep; vague maelstroms could be seen within them.
"Alright."
Xue Ying, Jing Qiu, Monarch Armadillo Jade, and King Fu Qiong all had their own profound combat skills, and they would naturally be able to coordinate well with one another.
The four carefully entered the cavern.
…
The cave turned out to be truly deep, such that the end was impossible to see with the naked eye.
Xue Ying and the other three proceeded carefully along. As they walked, they would spot a fork in the road every now and then.
"Mn, be careful. Some sort of terrifying existence seems to be hiding along this side path," Monarch Armadillo Jade transmitted to the others. All four experts had brought along treasures meant for isolating them from scouting technique, seeking to prevent their enemies from discovering them. However, the degree of danger inside Lake Heart Island far surpassed their imagination. Even if they tried avoiding every place that seemed dangerous, it would still probe difficult to not stumble into one accidentally.
"Oh?" As Xue Ying and the others walked past that specific side road, they couldn't help but look more carefully inside.
Deep into that path was an ice sculpture, its scarlet-red eyes were staring straight toward Xue Ying and the others. It could also be said that the ice sculpture was set to look straight at where the road split into two.
Xue Ying and the others could feel their hearts palpitating at the sight of this statue.
"Let's hurry out of here." They immediately began to feel that something was amiss.
As soon as the group departed, signs of cracks began appearing on the surface of the ice sculpture, sending out sounds of ka ka ka. Soon, fragments of the ice began to shatter, revealing a tall, sturdy warrior wearing black armor with a single horn that seemed to reach the sky. His face was shrouded by yellow hair, and his eyes were scarlet-red. As he stared toward the source of the side path, the corners of his mouth curled upwards. It's been a long time, but some outsiders have finally crossed through my place again. Hehehe, I've only just woken up, so I'm in no rush to kill you. I'll take my time and kill them at the very last moment. I hope you all will be able to hold on for as long as possible.
Hu.
The body of this black-armored warrior smashed into the icy-cold rock wall to his side, melding in and disappearing inside it.
…
"I've got this strange feeling that something amiss." In the frontmost position, Monarch Armadillo Jade's vision darted all over the place and his expression was ugly. "Your Highness, are we truly making our way forward? We've no experience with this cavern, and neither do we know what's ahead."
"Just continue along this path," Xue Ying replied.
There was a safer road, but it was being watched by Old Mother Withered Tree and the others!
Monarch Armadillo Jade began muttering to himself. I've already discovered three dangerous routes, yet neither Dong Bo, nor that Empress Nine Swords managed to detect any dangers! Do they actually have nothing to count on on their trip through this cavern? Ai, what a blunder.
Due to his secret technique, Monarch Armadillo Jade could specialize in discovering dangers ahead of time. His vision was always shifting to observe his surroundings, and the Profound Mysteries the laws of the world appeared in his eyes as they operated in the surroundings. Any minute change in the distance would lead to a small change in the world which he could then discover.
"Careful! There's a powerful being moving closer to us. We have to flee." Monarch Armadillo Jade quickened his pace. At the same time, invisible World Deity energy spread to sweep Xue Ying and the others along, allowing their flying speed to explode to about 300,000 kilometers per second. Such speed left Xue Ying and Jing Qiu tongue-tied. Their normal speed could never hope to reach such a level, but Monarch Armadillo Jade could maintain it while bringing three more people along.
It seemed that Monarch Armadillo Jade's reputation was not without reason.
Hong.
The figure following them tore through the ice, rushing into the passage of the cavern. Looking closer, the two could see that the figure rushing toward them actually belonged to a four-legged black-armored creature. Before long, however, it disappeared by tunneling into cavern's wall.
"It's approaching at truly too fast a speed." The group moved very quickly after Monarch Armadillo Jade increased their pace, but even he was feeling anxiety mount at the moment. "It can move along a straight line through the body of the mountain, so it's nearing us very, very quickly. It'll most likely reach us within a breath's worth of time. Prepare for battle!"
**

chapters.title: Chapter 529 - The Old Chaps Awaken
chapters.content:
Chapter 529: The Old Chaps Awaken
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
While Xue Ying and the others were fleeing rapidly along the complex cavern, in the depths of a mountain not far from them.
Ka ka ka~ Cracks began to form on the cold icy surface of some statues. The ice revealed some black armored soldiers, black armored birds, and even black armored beasts. All of them had just awakened from deep sleep.
"Looks like Lake Heart Island entered its freezing period again. We've only just woken up, and were already frozen solid. This is not so bad, though. If we'd been in the burning hot period, the warping and rising of the surroundings would be even more uncomfortable." A flood dragon covered by a layer of black armor had also waken up. His head was adorned by two horns, and his golden eyes concealed a glimmer of joy. "Oh, these old chaps are still alive and kicking."
Hu.
The black flood dragon touched one of the cave's wall, immediately sinking inside and disappearing.
Very soon, in a relatively wide room.
One after another, the black armored soldiers, birds and beasts were hurrying here.
"Hahaha, long time no see. I can't help but be happy to see your old face again.
"Ah, Young Master Flying Feather, is it not? Your heroic disposition is as prominent as ever.
"Hahaha, you're still kicking, elder brother! As your younger brother, I'm afraid that one day I'll wake up just to see that you've already passed away." These black-armored creatures were incomparably happy to be together, and their expressions were ones of bliss.
Part of this group was a gigantic snake covered in black scales that coiled around itself with a rumbling sound. "Unexpectedly, most of our group is still alive, and that's most likely because there are so few outsiders who enter our area."
"Actually, I'd prefer it if outsiders would come more often. That way, we could stay awake for longer."
"Be that as it may, more outsiders would also increase our chances of perishing."
"Defeating us might be relatively easy, but killing us? Hmph, hmph. I'd like to see them try."
"Could it be that you don't know? There are many areas in the Lake Heart Island where even True God Rulers broke in, turning many of us old chaps into dust in an instant. In front of people like them, we wouldn't even have time to flee."
"In master's place, even True God Rulers would not dare act with reckless abandon."
The black-armored creatures were immersed in their various discussions.
"Even now, the only reason we're still alive is master's grace! Without his help, with all of us here having failed to transcend and become powerful existences, it's reasonable to say that we would have died long ago. Even so, Master gave us the chance to live up to now," a black bird with purple eyes said through a relatively shrill sound.
"Master truly was very benevolent toward countless of us cultivators."
"We've failed to transcend and become True Gods simply because our perception was not good enough. The help Master provided us with is already impossible to ever pay back. However, we've been awake here, at the Lake Heart Island, for an unknown amount of time, yet it's been so very long since we've last felt master's presence."
These black creatures sighed at each other as they recalled various events from the past. However, that did not prevent them from sensing Xue Ying group of four as they were fleeing in the distance."
"Don't make a move so soon. We've got to make these intruders feel like the area is rather safe so that they'll send the information out. That should make other intruders feel more willing to enter through here, leaving us able to awaken more often. The feeling sleeping through most of our lives is truly uncomfortable," a sturdy fighter wearing the same black armor said.
"There are three stage four World Deities and someone who seems to be a stage three World Deity but has cultivated an absolute art. With how weak they are, there's simply no need to chase them too hard," a black-armored bird flying all over the place screeched. "We can let them play around some more; the truly important places are all strictly guarded anyway. With how puny they are, they're just courting death by coming here."
…
Back in the ice-cold cave, a four-legged black-armored creature attacked Xue Ying's group with incomparable savagery. Its usage of the Profound Mysteries of the law was pitiful, so it instead relied on its terrifying strength and speed, as well as the sharpness of its claws!
"Hmph." Xue Ying's spear streaked across the sky in a thrusting motion. It was surrounded by myriad faint scenes of objects and creatures, both alluring and gorgeous. This one strike gave off a feeling of the allure and beauty of the myriad of creatures in the world.
This was one of Xue Ying's three great secret skills, Life.
This was a move which put into practice all of Xue Ying's comprehension of the beauty of the myriad of creatures and existences in the world. Beauty was but a concept, and intrinsically, it was actually vitality. It was a vitality that could move one's soul! This strike had the spirituality and firmness of a small blade of grass that grew through a crack in a stone, of a green retreat in the middle of a desert, like the rainwater that floated over the world.
This strike full of freedom contained all of the spirituality of the world, and his moves contained myriad changes.
Peng. The spear struck forth, letting out a tremble of energy. In the blink of an eye, that original energy turned into 320 different kinds of energy. Life—this move was created with unpredictability and change in mind, and it had no need for meticulous control. In fact, if one was to attempt to carefully guide it, they would only weaken it. What it truly needed was perception! Even someone who comprehended it would have a very hard time describing it. Xue Ying had only comprehended it by following his heart's guidance.
The four-legged creature in black armor shook and was sent smashing into a nearby rock wall, shattering countless layers of ice in the process, yet it displayed no sign of injury as it continued its frenzied assault.
"Hou~ Too weak, simply too weak. You cannot harm me," the creature howled madly, continuing its chase.
"Hmph." King Fu Qiong, the man holding a great black ruler, also made his move. His ruler seemed slow yet fast, and as it struck, the surrounding timespace shifted and the world changed. Unexpectedly, the four-legged creature found itself unable to avoid the strike or even to parry the ruler with its claws, allowing it to smash directly against its skull.
A booming sound spread out, and the weapon's force spread all throughout the creature's body.
But even after being smashed into the cave floor, plowing a deep ditch behind it and cracking apart large amounts of ice chunks, the black-armored creature remained unharmed and continued to chase the group.
"This creature's comprehension of the Profound Mysteries of the Law is average; it's comparable to a stage three World Deity," Xue Ying sent to his companions. "It's even weaker by a bit than I am when it comes to style and exquisiteness, but its strength, speed, and toughness, as well as the sharpness of its claws, are all on an inconceivable level. It can move at six hundred meters per second, it is even slightly more physically strong than me, and its claws are so terrifyingly sharp that they surpass our blood-refined deity weapons. On top of that, we can't harm it no matter what kind of attack we use."
"We're lucky, lucky that its realm is so low," King Fu Qiong sent back. "We can rely on our superior comprehension to suppress it."
Peng.
Without warning, Monarch Armadillo Jade stamped its foot on the black-armored creature's face, directly trampling over it and onto one of the corridor's rock walls. Countless chunks of ice shattered, and the creature only landed back on the ground after tumbling a few times in mid-air.
This four-legged creature in black armor sent a rigid gaze at the four, and then proceeded to swish its tail and let out a low howl. At the same time, it turned to ram straight into a nearby wall, but instead of hitting it, the creature simply disappeared in its entirety.
"It gave up?" Xue Ying and the others heaved a collective sigh of relief.
"We were able to suppress it, so it's only natural that it would give up," Monarch Armadillo Jade replied as he stroked his chubby face. "But we can't rejoice just yet. Its comprehension was clearly low, but it still took all four of us only to suppress it. If we had been forced to fight it one-on-one… Its defenses are unequalled, and its speed and strength were frightening to behold. On top of that, its comprehension was just a bit worse than Dong Bo's. It would not be so easy to handle in a fair battle.
"En." Xue Ying and the others nodded in approval of this assessment. Xue Ying did not have the confidence to face the creature one-on-one. After all, the whole group had attacked with all its might, yet none of their attacks could harm the opponent. Against such enemies with unequalled defenses, achieving victory was very difficult.
"Your Highness Dong Bo, Empress Nine Swords, I'm afraid I must let you know that this black-armored creature is not alone here," King Armadillo Jade solemnly transmitted. "I can detect some even stronger and more murderous beasts hiding in all throughout our surroundings. Even King Fu Qiong and I have no confidence in handingly so many beasts. We two are willing to accompany Your Highness through this encounter, but you must also prepare. If you don't have the confidence to proceed, it would be best to give up as soon as possible."
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu exchanged a glance, and Xue Ying replied without hesitation, "Let's keep moving. The road ahead is dangerous, but I will guide us through."
His guidance, of course, would lead them toward the True God Weapon.
"Guide us?"
King Fu Qiong and Monarch Armadillo Jade felt their hearts stand still. It seemed like His Highness, Dong Bo, truly was holding some sort of secret hidden treasure diagram. These kinds of hidden diagrams, however, were easy to come by. Some were worth extremely little, others would lead to unimaginable gains.
"I'm afraid that, as we further approach our destination, we might just all die," Monarch Armadillo Jade helplessly replied.
"If we're to die, let it be so; we'd only be losing our avatars anyway. Let's just keep going." The nearby King Fu Qiong frowned.
"You… you're quite domineering, Fu Qiong. Once we approach danger, I'll have to ask you to go first!" In spite of his teasing, Monarch Armadillo Jade kept his position in front of the group.
…
At that moment, large amounts of creatures were silently spying on their small, weak team from all around, seemingly disinclined to make their move.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 530 - Blazinig Blood Door
chapters.content:
Chapter 530: Blazinig Blood Door
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Who is directing them? How come they're heading towards the Blazing Blood Door?" A flash of confusion pass through the black-armored flood dragon's golden eyes as it lay there. "Do they have some sort of map that let them know about the Blazing Blood Door's location?"
"Hmph." A huge black-armored flying creature sneered then spoke in a sharp voice, "You're overthinking it. Did you see their combat power? If they truly knew about the existence of the Blazing Blood Door, they would have been sure to take an alternate route. Back when we were still stage four World Deities, none of us would have dared to take the risk of approaching the Blazing Blood Door even though we knew of its existence inside of the Lake Heart Island. If they did come to take that risk, I don't think even one would be able to keep their little life. Well, even if they don't go there and are instead just passing by, they'll still have a hard time staying alive."
"The Blazing Blood Door…"
"What a terrifying place. Even with the door itself being closed, it's still incredibly dangerous. Once it opens, it will be nothing short of a nightmare." Those black-armored lifeforms were all sighing. There was not one among them who would dared pass through the Blazing Blood Door, knowing their own abilities.
"What do we do, then? If the four of them are to die there and spread the word that this region is very dangerous, I don't think another cultivator would pass through for a very long time to come. We'd have to go back to sleeping."
"Mn."
These black-armored lifeforms were feeling troubled.
Their responsibility was such that, as long as Xue Ying's group did not approach the more important regions, they would not have to act. Before that happened, however, they wished to allow the four to move around freely for a time, perhaps even letting them acquire some treasures if they were lucky enough! That would be even better. By doing so, they would hopefully see more invaders entering their region.
Even then, they could not go as far as to just send treasures out themselves, since that would be considered a breach of duty. Such a thing would turn them to ashes immediately.
"Let's go after them and force them to go in a different direction."
"Yeah. We can make them go in other directions. There's a fork in the road about fifteen million kilometers ahead. Let's force them off-course over there."
"As long as they change directions there, they won't be able to approach the Blazing Blood Door."
These black-armored lifeforms made their decisions.
…
Xue Ying's group was flying at a rapid pace of about 300,000 kilometers per second. In but a moment, they had already traversed a few million kilometers.
Hong long long~ A fierce and cruel battle was underway. Xue Ying and the others were now in the middle of their most dangerous battle since they entered the cavern. A terrifying, tall, and sturdy warrior in black-armored had stepped up to deal with them. His combat power was incredible, and he would most likely match up even to powerful existences! Xue Ying and the others were having a hard time resisting his assault.
Pu. King Fu Qiong was even force to vomit blood. At the same time, an enormous array appeared in his surroundings, followed by many black rulers which went out to attack the black-armored warrior.
In response, the sturdy warrior brandished his great axe. His every movement accompanied by a frightening destructive energy that could shatter anything in its path. Even in Lake Heart Island, where the laws were extremely suppressive, his strikes powerful enough to turn the surrounding space into void.
"Let's run. How about going through a different passage?" Monarch Armadillo Jade sent to the others. "This is too taxing. We're very close to being unable to hold on. On top of that, this black-armored creature is only blocking our path, as if he's protecting this specific passage."
"We've got to keep following this passage," Jing Qiu replied.
"Right. We must go this way," Xue Ying added. If they were to change directions, they would find themselves going in the opposite direct of the hidden True God weapon.
King Fu Qiong stepped in as well with a comment, "This black-armored monster is blocking this path. Is he trying to force us onto the other path? Who knows, he might be leading us into a trap."
"That might be," Monarch Armadillo Jade agreed.
One party had a single, very powerful member, while the other was made up of four people working together. Xue Ying displayed one his three most powerful secret skills, a domain-related secret skill he simply called Prison. Jing Qiu and King Fu Qiong were both striking using their blood-refined Deity warriors and Monarch Armadillo Jade's combat power was the most profound of all four. He would always act at the most crucial moment, allowing the group to coordinate perfectly.
After another moment of fighting, Xue Ying and the others broke free of the warrior and continued down the path.
That tall, sturdy warrior wearing black armor stopped chasing after them, putting on a cold expression as he watched them leave into the distance. Frowning, he muttered, "They're dead-set on to taking that path. I even tried helping them, tried to give them a chance to live a bit longer, but they still decided to rush down this path. Whatever, we're not allowed to truly teach them, after all. If they seek death, let them find it."
His words were reverberating throughout the surrounding area that was, however, isolated from all scouting techniques. Xue Ying and the others had not heard a word of it.
They still had their duty, and they did not dare disobey it. While selfish by nature, they had little room to wiggle within the scope of their assigned duty.
******
Hu. Hu.
Further down the passage, Xue Ying and the others were taking some time to rest .
King Fu Qiong and Jing Qiu were slightly more injured than the rest. Monarch Armadillo Jade was the most slippery and cunning of the group, and he actually seemed completely uninjured. Xue Ying's luminous sun force provided him with great power and speed which served to improve his might in close-combat, so the damage he had accrued was slightly lighter as well. Meanwhile, neither Jing Qiu nor King Fu Qiong specialized in close-quarters combat. Their specialty lay more in the usage of array diagrams.
"Fortunately, the black-armored creatures seem to be responsible for only a region each. If they were to act together, we might have been dead by now," Monarch Armadillo Jade muttered. "That creature from before was simply too strong. We've only managed to barely resist it by teaming up."
"Mn." Xue Ying had also taken on a more solemn mood. "Fortunately we had Monarch Armadillo Jade to aid us. With just the three of us, we might very well have died to that beast."
Indeed, Monarch Armadillo Jade's combat power was the highest of their group.
His confidence that allowed him to only step in during the most crucial moment of battle, as well as his combat power left Xue Ying with a good impression. Indeed, this was an expert close to a powerful existence in power, comparable to his Eldest Disciple Brother, Hui Ming. These were not empty words.
"I've merely lived a humble life for many years now." Monarch Armadillo Jade caressed his chin, feeling quite pleased.
"Let's go. We have to move further down this path," King Fu Qiong said. "Staying too long in one place might just invite unneeded dangers."
"Mn, let's continue."
Xue Ying nodded too.
The four proceeded further inward with ginger steps. The road ahead seemed safer at a glance, showing nothing more than the occasional sneak attack from a black-armored creature, but their combat power was still sufficient to resist these ambushes. It was, after all, quite rare for creatures to reach a levle comparable to powerful existences.
Gegege~ A black-armored bird's screech began spreading through the corridor, followed immediately by the bird's division into more than a thousand bodies which attacked everyone in Xue Ying's group simultaneously.
The four continued progressing down the path while blocking any incoming attacks.
Their superior coordination allowed them to resist these birds quite well.
"Mn? Be careful ahead!" Monarch Armadillo Jade suddenly transmitted a message.
Xue Ying was also paying close attention to the path ahead of them. Somewhere in front of them seemed to be a large by empty cavernous region in the mountain. Inside of this enormous region he could vaguely see a blood-red disk. With how powerful the eyes of Xue Ying and the others were, they could still see the path ahead quite clearly in spite of their vision being blocked. The disk seemed to cover an area of roughly 500,000 kilometers in total, it was red in color, and there were various patterns of blades and swords engraved on its surface.
"Is that a door?" Xue Ying didn't know what to make of it.
The huge disk looked a lot like a circular door placed right on the floor. It even had a vertical mark left right at its center, seemingly placed there to allow people to push it open.
"A door placed flat on the floor?" Xue Ying quickly noticed the blade and sword patterns on the disk, as well as various blood-vein patterns, and it was not long before he detected an endless killing intent and a bloody aura coming off of it. Every last member of this group was an expert, and they could naturally feel the unseen threat coming exuded by the disk! It was much more terrifying than the black-armored creature they had previously met.
Hua.
Xue Ying's group was traveling at great speeds, so it was not long before they arrived at the empty region. At that point, the black-armored bird previously chasing them suddenly stopped. It simply cawed at them from afar, seemingly in no rush to act.
"Everyone be careful. We need to pay attention to the ice sculptures," Monarch Armadillo Jade transmitted to the others.
Xue Ying had also noticed two rows of ice sculptures on two separate sides of this region. There was a great number of creatures similar to the ones from before—roughly one hundred of them.
"These can't also be some creatures, right?" Jing Qiu sent to Xue Ying. "There are, after all, many creatures here which take the form of ice sculptures."
"There's no need to be so scared. It might be true that many creatures spawn from ice sculptures, but that doesn't mean that every sculpture we come across will just turn into a creature." In spite of his words, a feeling of light numbness spread through Xue Ying's heart. Even one of those black-armored creatures was hard to deal with, so to see two neat rows formed from more than a hundred ice sculptures… If every last sculpture was to awaken and become a creature, how could the four of them ever hope to deal with them?
"That disk is emitting an aura of blood, as well as a pressure many times more terrifying than any of those three ancestors from your Bloodshed God Palace can put out," Monarch Armadillo Jade's eyes carefully observing his surroundings as he sent a message to his companions. "Everyone make sure not to alarm the rest. Let's step lightly and pry open the disk and then move out to rapidly cross this region. It's best not to touch anything else."
"Mn." Xue Ying, Jing Qiu and King Fu Qiong all agreed; they could feel the invisible pressure.
"Go" Monarch Armadillo Jade immediately ordered…
The four turned into four different streams of light as they tried to fly over from the side without even daring to touch the ground.
However, just as they were flying along—
Those hundred different ice sculptures forming two neat rows, saw the ice on their surface shatter to reveal many that were eyes already open. It was clear that they had all awakened in order to deal with the four people who were making their way over…

chapters.title: Chapter 531 - Danger!
chapters.content:
Chapter 531: Danger!
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Not good!" A shiver passed through Xue Ying's True Deity Heart, followed by the sight of the entire area of the juncture turning dim. His ears were ringing, and his heartbeats were accelerating. The flow of blood in his body turned chaotic, and he even lost his ability to properly sense his surroundings. "The shock alone was strong enough to permeate directly my True Deity Heart directly? This, this is…"
In spite of Xue Ying's extraordinary will, the terror he had felt stemmed from his very instincts of survival.
This was akin to how an ant might feel an overwhelming terror when it was about to be stepped upon by a human! It must be stated that Xue Ying was a stage three World Deity, and at his level, even a powerful existence looking at him would not be sufficient to suppress him, to cause his True Deity Heart to tremble, or to disrupt his ability to sense his surroundings. But now, the combined killing intent of one hundred of these ice sculptures had done just that.
Under their watch, his ears were ringing, his heart was beating faster, his blood was flowing chaotically, his eyes could not see clearly, and his True Deity Heart was trembling.
"How can this be?!" Even Jing Qiu, a stage four World Deity, could feel her True Deity Heart tottering on the verge of collapse. Her vision turned blurry, and she was unable to control the World Deity energy coursing through her body. "Why are they so terrifying? I would not feel so helpless even when facing powerful existences."
"Not good! Try to flee, quickly now!" King Fu Qiong and Jing Qiu were similar in the way that neither could control the energy coursing through their body smoothly.
"吼~~~~"
Hou~
A savage expression on his face, Monarch Armadillo Jade let out a sudden roar. He had cultivated for so many years, and had many secret techniques at his disposal; his True Deity Heart had long since been greatly strengthened. As such, even after being affected by the previous shockwave of powerful sense, he was still able to maintain his combat power. He let out a furious roar accompanied by a unique wave that spread out all around him and clashed against the shockwave, reducing its influence.
Only once he did this did Xue Ying, Jing Qiu and King Fu Qiong regain their bearings. They could once again see their surroundings clearly.
The layer of ice on the surfaces of all those hundred ice sculptures finally shattered completely apart, revealing their true appearances—all of them were wearing sets of blood-colored armor. Some had humanoid figures, others were beasts, and there were also some metallic creatures. Regardless of shape, every single one was releasing powerful killing intent as they stared at Xue Ying's group, as if the four were just bumbling clowns.
"You would dare come here and challenge the Blazing Blood Door with that pitiful amount of combat power?" One of the blood-armored warriors sneered.
Hong! Hong! Hong! Hong!
Without warning, four figures flew out simultaneously from the ranks of the blood-armored soldiers. Shua shua shua shua. Two approached the group from behind, and the other two intercepted them from the front.
"Such trouble… Your Highness, this path you've pointed us toward is truly formidable," Monarch Armadillo Jade sent the others a message accompanied by a bitter laugh.
"How can they be so powerful…" Xue Ying could hardly believe it.
According to the information he'd gathered, most ordinary regions of Lake Heart Island would be weak enough for someone with the combat power of a powerful existence to withstand! The deeper one went, the more dangerous it would become, up to a point when even the Bloodshed God Emperor or the Temporal Island Lord could no longer proceed!
However, Monarch Mo Xue did not hide the true god weapon that deep inside the ruins; their encounters should not have been so dangerous!
"We'll stake it all," King Fu Qiong transmitted. His eyes were filled with madness.
"Let's do it." An enormous sword appeared to begin floating around Jing Qiu. Before long, the sword divided into different parts.
"Kill!" Of the four blood-armored warriors who had come over to stop them, one had a female figure of an enchanting quality. All of a sudden, a vertical eye appeared right between her eyebrows and shot out a red light which charged right at the only woman from Xue Ying's group, Jing Qiu. Faced with this attack, Jing Qiu felt an instinctive dread overcome her.
It was at this moment that she understood how wide the gap between her and this warrior was! This was the most terrifying opponent met ever since she entered Lake Heart Island.
Hua. The enormous sword behind Jing Qiu split into nine thinner swords which formed a resplendent starry diagram with countless planets floating lazily within. She moved the starry diagram to defend her front, but as soon as it came into contact with the red light, it immediately froze. The nine thin swords were also unable to move any longer, having taken on a stationary spot in mid-air.
"This, this is just…" Jing Qiu did not even consider that her blood-refined Deity warrior would actually be frozen solid after a single exchange of moves. Such an outcome served to spread a feeling of helplessness through her heart. Perhaps they had been too conceited by barging into the ruins of Lake Heart? Were they so overconfident that they misjudged the dangers they would be facing?
Hong!
Another blood-armored warrior came charging forward. His body was thin, his eyes contained two pupils each, and he was wielding a blade. With a single step, he was already next to King Fu Qiong, where he waved his blade, creating thousands of illusions. Even King Fu Qiong, a stage four World Deity, was unable to discern which blade was real and which illusory.
Pu. Pu. Pu. Pu…
King Fu Qiong used his enormous wooden ruler to form an array in an attempt at defending himself, but his body was cut into thousands of pieces regardless.
It turned out that every single one of those thousands of 'illusory' blades was real and held terrifying power!
"Hmph." The alluring woman who had just shot out the red light through her vertical eye decided to suddenly switch targets. Her vertical eye shot out a another red light that split out to land on every single one of those thousand chunks that King Fu Qiong had been turned into, stopping them from fusing back into his body. Ka ka ka ka ka… Every single one of those tiny fragments of his body began shattering and dissipating.
King Fu Qiong was straight-up annihilated; he had died in this battle. He had been the first to perish from their group.
The rest—Xue Ying, Jing Qiu and Monarch Armadillo Jade—did not have the leisure to be angry about this in light of the incoming threat.
"Hahaha…" Mighty laughter served as a backdrop to the sight of an enormous golden fist suppressing Monarch Armadillo Jade. Simultaneously, a muscular warrior was hurling his hairy black palm towards Xue Ying.
"Prison!"
At this moment, Xue Ying's countless dazzling white edges finally launched out to restrict the four blood-armored warriors. His luminous sun force was very fast, but the red light sent out by the enchantress and the blade attack of the blood-armored warrior had been even faster. Still… his luminous sun force spread out through his surroundings, and it now finally enveloped the entire battlefield to begin restricting his enemies.
This was one of Xue Ying's three most important secret skills-Prison!
After Xue Ying's advances in his comprehension, this secret skill transformed to far surpass the restriction by means of shackles he used before. It was now a sort of gentle binding force that was omnipresent. With countless strands of luminous sun force coordinating, he could restrict and influence the movements of his enemies without stop.
Against stage four World Deities, this skill would have certainly been formidable, but its effect on these blood-armored soldiers was clearly weaker.
Hou~ Monarch Armadillo Jade opened his bloody mouth and let out a furious roar.
Following his roar, a large amount of circular black ripples gushed out in a fan shape towards the four blood-armored warriors. Once the black ripples came into contact with anything, pi pa pi pa, many small chaos holes would appear on their surface. The four warriors failed to evade these ripples and were affected by their impact. Even they were left slightly disoriented for a short moment.
One of their members, the muscular warrior covered in black hair, was even assaulted by a slight pain as he raised his hands to hold his head. Turning to stare at Monarch Armadillo Jade, the speed of the other three warriors was clearly much slower now.
The rest of the hundred blood-armored warriors spread throughout the surroundings were also looking at Monarch Armadillo Jade.
"Leave, quickly. I can't match them," Monarch Armadillo Jade sent a message to the others as he let out an anxious roar. At the same time, he was helping Xue Ying and Jing Qiu along, increasing the speed of their retreat.
"You want to leave?" The tallest, biggest blood-armored warrior in the group let out a sneer at the sight of this. The golden fist which had stopped momentarily due to the roar was now once again hurling out accompanied by a suppressive effect. The golden fist rapidly increased in size, and within moments, it was large enough to block their escape path. There were countless deity imprints orbiting around the fist, granting it an immeasurably terrifying might.

chapters.title: Chapter 532 - Die Fighting, Friend
chapters.content:
Chapter 532: Die Fighting, Friend
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The enormous golden fist was hurling over, rendering spacetime in the surroundings unable to function. Before the strike itself even arrived, the unseen shockwave already reached Xue Ying and Jing Qiu, leaving them helpless to respond. With the gap in combat power so obviously wide, any kind of resistance was nothing more than a joke! Neither of the two could understand why they had met such danger so soon after they entered Lake Heart Island.
Was their luck that bad?
Jing Qiu operated her nine thin swords, turning them into a resplendent starry maelstrom in an attempt to resist this fist strike.
At the same time, Xue Ying displayed his domain-related secret skill, Prison, using his luminous sun force. This served to disturb his opponent, giving him enough time to follow up with his other spear secret skill, Life. He did not dare even try to use his Destruction to force back the attack directly, aware that he would be overwhelmed immediately.
Monarch Armadillo Jade rushed out ahead of the group, his figure having transformed into an enormous four-legged mutated beast. The head of this new form wa
Peng~
The enormous golden fist smashed right into this four-legged beast, striking its head directly, peng peng peng! The shockwave generated was so strong that void itself exploded in the surroundings! Xue Ying's brandished his spear in a revolving motion, striking layer upon layer of this shockwave. However, his speed was still greatly reduced in the process.
The golden fist retreated after this clash.
Monarch Armadillo Jade's entire body was left trembling after having used his head to block the incoming attack. Very soon, his figure began crumbling and shattering into pieces, startling Xue Ying and Jing Qiu. Monarch Armadillo Jade, was, after all, the strongest member of their team. Once he died, any chance of escaping would disappear alongside him.
Hua hua hua~ Still in mid-air, Monarch Armadillo Jade's crumbling body turned into a stream of black water which rumbled for a while before condensing back into the mutated beast from before.
"This mutated beast's must have trained that special survival technique to quite a formidable level." The blood-armored warrior from before frowned upon seeing this. He immediately sent a message to his companions, "My technique might be able to suppress him, but it's not enough to kill him. We'll have to work together if we're to get rid of him."
"Mn."
Both the enchanting woman and the muscular black-haired warrior agreed to this assessment. Their foresight was extraordinary, so they could easily tell that this stage four World Deity mutated beast's combat power in close quarters was close to that of a powerful existence, and his secret survival technique was even more formidable, having reached an extremely high realm. Unless they could completely overwhelm him, even ordinary powerful existences would have a hard time killing him.
"Only three of them remain. I'll let you all handle them." The blade-wielder from before moved to the side and removed himself from the fight, as if he disdained the very idea of overwhelming enemies with numbers.
…
"Formidable." Xue Ying and Jing Qiu both noticed Monarch Armadillo Jade had recovered properly, and could not help but shout in joy. His body had turned into a stream of water, a form that was impossible to damage through sheer strength.
Monarch Armadillo Jade truly is formidable. He might have a happy-go-lucky attitude most of the time, but his survival capabilities are unfathomable. Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
"Go."
Monarch Armadillo Jade's mutated beast form once again turned into a stream of water, encompassing Xue Ying and Jing Qiu to continue their escape.
"Still trying to run?" The enchanting woman's vertical eye shot out red light once again. The strand of light reached Monarch Armadillo Jade's body in the blink of an eye, but the stream of water simply kept moving; the light had failed to stop it.
The warrior covered in black hair simply shook his head without acting. He was aware of his inability to stop an opponent with such of survival capabilities.
Hong! The terrifying golden fist once again Monarch Armadillo Jade's body, causing him to explode. However, even after scattering apart, the stream continued to protect Xue Ying and Jing Qiu and allow them to keep struggling.
Si la~
The enchanting woman appeared once again. Her fingernails glowed a green color as she grabbed the stream of water into which Monarch Armadillo Jade had transformed. For a moment, green strands of light flowed through the water.
Hou hou hou! Monarch Armadillo Jade seemingly turned crazy and he began roaring as this happened. He had been completely unable to resist!
Forced to depend entirely on his special survival techniques, he tried seemingly in vain to flee and move even a bit forward. However, after the two sides exchanged about a dozen moves, Monarch Armadillo Jade finally brought Xue Ying and Jing Qiu out of that empty cavernous region, moving further through the corridor and escaping their pursuers.
"Escaped?"
"He escaped, just like that?"
The four blood-armored warriors stood in mid-air inside the cavernous region, looking at the stream of water as it fled. They did not attempt to keep pursuing it.
"It looks like they did not actually know about the Blazing Blood Door, and were merely passing by it." The enchanting woman lightly giggled. "Third Brother, had you also acted just now, he would most likely have died."
The blade-wielder was the fastest member of their group. Had he used his full strength to obstruct him, Monarch Armadillo Jade would have a much harder time escaping.
"Hmph." The man shook his head in response.
"Their combat power is very ordinary," said the warrior with the tallest and biggest build. "Had they known about the Blazing Blood Door, they would not have dared attempt to charge through."
"In spite of having barged through here, some of those four actually escaped. With two dead and two still alive, I'd say their luck is not bad at all," the black-haired warrior said.
******
Hu.
After they fled for a bit more time and they confirmed that they were not being pursued, Monarch Armadillo Jade finally stopped. The flowing stream turned back into the shape of a human, reverting to his original figure. Seeing this, Xue Ying and Jing Qiu finally let out a sigh of relief.
"They did not continue to chase us." Xue Ying couldn't help but look behind him.
"It's all thanks to Monarch Armadillo Jade. Without him, both of us would have surely died inside there," Jing Qiu said.
"Unfortunately, Fu Qiong did not make it." Xue Ying shook his head.
After the calamity passed and they found themselves with renewed life, Xue Ying and Jing Qiu found themselves feeling jittery and unable to calm down. The threat they had just faced was as real as they went; they had been entirely suppressed! Their side was absolutely weaker than the opposite, and their only luck was that Monarch Armadillo Jade's survival capabilities were incredible.
Monarch Armadillo Jade sighed. "The techniques of our enemies were too fast. The man wielding a blade was able to reach Fu Qiong and shatter his body in the blink of an eye. The enchanting woman then used her red light to prevent him from reforming his body. Fu Qiong ended up dying in a single exchange. I hoped I could save him, but it was to no avail. In any case… he's dead now. Truthfully, even if he had not died in that exchange, he would likely have failed to survive the aftermath anyway."
"How come?" Xue Ying and Jing Qiu were stunned.
"Monarch Armadillo Jade, why the lack of confidence?" Xue Ying felt puzzled.
After they survived this battle, Xue Ying felt incomparable admiration towards Monarch Armadillo Jade. Such survival capability was likely on the level of powerful existences. He should be able to withstand whatever this ordinary region threw at him.
"That woman, outside of her ability to display that strange red light, was an expert in hexing poisons" Monarch Armadillo Jade helplessly replied. "I'm already feeling the effects of her hexing poison, and I won't be able to hold on for much longer."
"What?!" Xue Ying and Jing Qiu were shocked silly.
"In truth, her hexing poison has entered every last part of my body. It's already begun to consume my strength at a rapid pace, and my body will soon collapse," Monarch Armadillo Jade helplessly explained. "Her hexing poison is too terrifying. My Black Water True Body was badly damaged, and it's very close to collapsing."
Monarch Armadillo Jade's wave of his hand was followed by the sudden appearance of a black ruler, some storage treasures and some other materials.
"These are the treasures which the two of us have brought along." Taking on a seated position in the corridor, Monarch Armadillo Jade entrusted Xue Ying and Jing Qiu with a task: "Your Highness, should the two of you be fortunate enough to get out alive, grant me and Fu Qiong the favor of bringing these treasures out. At least this way, our losses would be smaller."
"Certainly." Xue Ying nodded continuously, though his feeling of helplessness caused him to add, "I've begun to notice my own weakness during this trip inside of Lake Heart Island, and I'm afraid our chances of surviving are essentially zero. Brother Armadillo Jade, if I fail to bring these treasures out, you better not blame me."
"Hahaha, just try your best." A layer of green light suddenly condensed over Monarch Armadillo Jade's face.
Noticing this, he looked to Xue Ying, "This time, we've fought together on the verge of life and death. Dong Bo, I'd say we can call each other friends by now, right?"
"Yes, definitely. To have a friend like you, Brother Armadillo Jade is a true fortune," Xue Ying added.
"Hahaha, if I could make His Highness see me as a friend, then this death was not in vain." Monarch Armadillo Jade laughed out loud.
With his loud laughter as a backdrop, Armadillo Jade's body began to crumble apart before dissipating into nothingness.
A tinge of pain passed through the hearts of both Xue Ying and Jing Qiu.
King Fu Qiong had died, and now Monarch Armadillo Jade was dead too, leaving the two of them alone. How far down this path could they hope to reach now?
**

chapters.title: Chapter 533 - Many-legged Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 533: Many-legged Beast
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
As she walked along the icy-cold cavern passage, Jing Qiu could not help but blurt out, "Xue Ying, were we not too blind by taking this trip inside the ruins of Lake Heart Island? Our combat power is quite a bit weaker than the norm, and we even entered through a lesser-known cavern that not many cultivators use. Our companions, Armadillo Jade and Fu Qiong, have both already died, and had it not been for Monarch Armadillo Jade's aid, we would not have even managed to get to this point."
"I understand your concern, but we've already come so far, so there's no point in overthinking it." Xue Ying waved his hand to store the treasures and weapons left behind by Monarch Armadillo Jade, and continued speaking, "Both of us have long since prepared ourselves, mentally speaking. Both Brother Armadillo Jade and Brother Fu Qiong were prepared to die ever since they entered. Furthermore, if we refused to enter through this desolate cavern tunnel, did we even have the choice to take a safer route? The Nine Yang Palace Head is most likely paying close attention to such passages."
"Mn." Jing Qiu lightly nodded. "This place is relatively close to where father hid the true god weapon. I hope we can arrive there safely."
Xue Ying nodded.
Prior to his coming here, Xue Ying, as a stage three World Deity who cultivated the "Luminous Sun" absolute art to the third boundary and whose combat power would be seen as high even amongst stage four World Deities, was quite satisfied with himself. He was strong enough to be seen as an overlord-level figure in the vast Deity world! However, this trip saw him entering some of the most dangerous ruins in the entire Deity world. Only those with powerful existence-level combat power could feel relatively safe as long as they didn't leave the more ordinary regions.
As soon as they arrived, the two had stumbled across Emperor Heavencloud corpse. Afterwards, as they proceeded through the cavern, they had been attacked time and time again. It was mostly Monarch Armadillo Jade who had held the team together during that time! All of these experiences left Xue Ying feeling truly inadequate, and gave him a clearer sense of the fact that his power left him still in the lower rung, when compared to the true peak powers of the entire Deity world.
Even then, reaching that lowest level was still a source of pride! After all, this level meant his combat power was not insignificant. Even passing the initial layer of the silvery-white enormous sphere was incredibly difficult, after all.
"We're not far from our destination. Let's keep moving," Xue Ying said.
The two turned into streams of particles, flying at high speed through the rest of the cavern passage.
…
Roughly five million kilometers away from them, two black-armored creatures were currently resting in a narrow space inside the mountain. One was a black-armored flood dragon, the other a many-legged beast wearing a similar set of black armor.
"This time around, the team was quite weak. There was an expert who had an extremely powerful secret survival technique that was quite a bit harder to deal with, but the other three were all average," the many-legged creature muttered, its voice reverberating through the narrow space. "Two have already died, and the only ones remaining are the two weakest ones. Big brother, what should we do? Should I go, or are you going to do it? If you decide to act, big brother, you would kill them so easily."
"Very few outsiders come in through that region, and it was only once a team enters that we finally wake up again." That flood dragon's golden eyes were looking in the distance. His vision seemed to pass through any obstacle, since he was looking straight at the couple currently fleeing through the tunnel. "Their luck must be pretty pitiful; they actually arrived at the Blazing Blood Door by accident. I feel like it must have frightened them greatly, and I'm starting to doubt that there will be more teams entering our passage in the future."
"The Blazing Blood Door… they might have discovered the strangeness of that place. Who knows, they might deliberately come back to investigate it after their combat power becomes stronger," the many-legged beast said.
"That would also make sense." A glimmer of interest appeared in the flood dragon's eyes. "Since their combat power is so weak, you should be the one to go! Take your time and get rid of them, one after the other. At the very least, your combat power shouldn't leave them shaking in terror."
"Yes, big brother." The many-legged beast in black armor immediately left. Its ten legs stepping across the void, the creature smashed into the wall by its side before passing into it.
The black-armored flood dragon was just watching this happen.
In its eyes, Xue Ying and Jing Qiu were simply too weak. If it were the one to act instead, it would frighten Xue Ying and his wife too much.
"For them to enter Lake Heart Island with that combat power…" The flood dragon shook its head.
******
Xue Ying and his wife were flying along at high speed, albeit much slower than what Monarch Armadillo Jade could achieve. The many-legged beast wearing black armor was hiding in the dark, stealthily crossing the mountain to approach the couple. It wasn't long before it chased up to them, neither of the two having sensed anything. They could not be blamed for this; they were ultimately too tender.
While Xue Ying was merely a stage three World Deity at the moment, Jing Qiu herself had only just become a stage four World Deity not too long ago. She could only depend on the remnant fragment of the"Heart Sword Diagram", and the small bit she understood of it to gain her current combat power. Her skill in scouting, survival, and other similar aspects was even lower.
As such, in spite of the incoming danger, they were entirely unalerted.
Hong!
The black-armored many-legged beast suddenly charged out from the mountain wall.
The luminous sun force spread through the surroundings enveloped the black-armored beast within moments, impairing its movements, while Xue Ying and Jing Qiu had both taken to evading the attacks and using their weapons to parry what they could not dodge.
