Dong. The scarlet cloud spear struck lower body of the many-legged beast with incredible velocity, lifting it off the ground and sending it flying backwards. However, just as it began to tumble, the beast's body began increasing in size, and it sent out its ten legs to grabb the mountain walls and the ground surrounding it. Within moments, the layer of ice covering everything shattered, and its body stabilized.
Hou~ With a low growl, the black-armored beast's figure began emitting a dazzling gold light, so bright that Xue Ying and Jing Qiu could no longer see their surroundings clearly. However, by through the use of his luminous sun force, Xue Ying could still infer the position of his opponent.
"Die." Xue Ying's hand sent his Scarlet Cloud Spear out in a thrusting motion and within moments, three separate spear shadows appeared.
Hong~
The first strike seemed ordinary at first, but a huge amount of power began accumulating to accompany it.
The second strike caused the surrounding space to distort.
And the third strike was focused completely on a single spot so incredibly small that it was essentially a point! Naturally, the feeling of this strike being extremely feeble only lasted for a moment since it was immediately followed by an eye-piercing light!
Its brightness truly was overwhelming!
Even the figure of the many-legged beast which seemed supremely bright and fierce just moments ago now was turned dim by comparison once Xue Ying unleashed his attack. A small circle surrounding the spearhead was filled with a perfect void of darkness, while its exterior displayed an eye-piercing brightness.
This was Xue Ying strongest killing move, Destruction.
After he witnessed Emperor Heavencloud's corpse, Xue Ying's understanding began to transform. Quickly afterwards, he discovered that the countless meteorites, more than a hundred million of them, surrounding Lake Heart Island formed a terrifying array diagram, which gave Xue Ying a chance to increase his comprehension regarding the aspect of destruction. At that time, Xue Ying's avatar and his true body back in the Crimson Rock Mountain of Xia Clan world was similarly injured by means of his True Deity Heart!
Using these opportunities, Xue Ying's true body had used these eleven years travel through the outer icy layer to reconstruct his Destruction secret skill from the ground-up within the hundred times accelerated environment of Crimson Rock Mountain! He had even been through multiple life-or-death encounters within these very caverns of the Lake Heart Island, enlightening Xue Ying and allowing his secret skill to improve even further. While it was still far from approaching the ancient array in complexity, the minor part he could unleash was enough to grant it the position of Xue Ying's most powerful skill.
Dong! The spearhead smashed right against the black-armored beast's head. In response, the beast took on an extremely savage expression, glaring at Xue Ying. This was the first time it spoke to the two: "There actually exists a stage three World Deity who can hurt me? Unfortunately for you, even powerful existences can't kill me."
Having arrived at this juncture, Xue Ying felt his heart start to grow cold.
The defensive ability of this black-armored monster was supreme, rendering even his most powerful killing move useless. What could he do now?
Hua. This black-armored many-legged creature's ten legs stepped on the void. Its body was moving in an extremely quick and unpredictable manner as it neared Xue Ying.
An enormous sword array diagram suddenly appeared some distance away—Jing Qiu had just taken action.
Hong~
The black-armored beast found itself unable to dodge the attack, so it was forced to use its body to forcibly resist it. This strike had only managed to stop it momentarily, and it was not long before it leapt forward again. This jump brought it to a speed close 300,000 kilometers per second. While people as fast as Monarch Armadillo Jade might be able to could suppress it, Xue Ying and his wife were both too weak to do so
The two exchanged a meaningful glance. Their combat power was not enough to suppress their opponent, and their speed was much slower as well. They simply had no way of escaping by either means.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 534 - The Right Bet
chapters.content:
Chapter 534: The Right Bet
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Jing Qiu, run! Quick!" Xue Ying's sent his spear flying outwards while employing his luminous sun force to put pressure on the many-legged beast and bind its movements by using his Prison secret skill.
"You have to run! If we remain here, we will both perish sooner or later! It might not be too big a deal for our avatars to here, but is there any point to it either? I can stall the beast for a while longer with my domain skill and my speciality in close quarters combat, but you have practically no means of resisting it. Just flee from here, quickly! I'll try to think up a way to escape after you get away. Who knows, I might even survive this too."
"Mn."
Jing Qiu had the experience of an entire past life, so she could be extremely decisive when it mattered. Though she found it difficult to just watch as her husband blocked the enemy's path, she found it easier to bear by keeping in mind that both she and her husband had merely sent their avatars here, and for them to perish did not mean much. Even so, they preferred only ever sacrificing their lives with good reason.
Sou…
Jing Qiu transformed into stream of particles and fled.
In the meanwhile, Xue Ying and the many-legged beast wearing black armor continued their frenzied battle.
Hong, hong, hong~ Xue Ying's body was smashed repeatedly into the surrounding mountain walls. By using his domain-related secret skill to slow down his opponent's movements, he could, with much difficulty, obstruct it by following up with his spear techniques. Though the beast had immense strength, Xue Ying's luminous sun force was best known for increasing the user's physical power, so he was able to hold back the beast through repeated usages of his secret skill, Life.
While this many-legged beast's strength far exceeds mine, but I can still somewhat resist it in a straight-up fight, Xue Ying thought.
Unknown to him was the fact that this relatively weaker many-legged beast was dispatched precisely in order to prolong this battle as long as possible before finally killing them.
Even so, I can no longer continue fighting it. I've reached my limits. Xue Ying turned to flee at high-speed while continuing to display his spear technique.
Xiu!
A stream of particles flew away in a spurt.
"You think you can escape?" The black-armored beast roared took to chasing after him, its speed easily surpassing Xue Ying's. It wasn't long before the beast caught up to him and the two began exchanging killing moves in the midst of high-speed flight.
However, instead of trying to leave the tunnel, Xue Ying fled back along the same path, routing back to the cavern from which he entered.
After all, his wife had headed in the direction of the true god weapon, and him taking the same route might have gotten her implicated.
If he was going to die anyway, he would rather protect his wife with his life.
…
After transforming into a stream of particles, Jing Qiu had flown away. There was a sharp glow in her eyes stemming from a dissatisfaction with herself. After all, Xue Ying had only come to the ruins because he wanted to help her.
"Xue Ying…" Jing Qiu looked behind her, but there was no sign of anyone chasing up to her.
******
Xue Ying and the many-legged beast were still engaged in lethal combat while flying at high speeds through the air.
Pu~ One of the beast's claws smacked Xue Ying and sent him flying backwards. He had even tried parrying the attack with his spear, but the impact still caused him to throw up a mouthful of blood. In spite of having been struck, Xue Ying kept flying, and the wound on his chest was already beginning to heal; injuries like these were mere flesh wounds to cultivators. However, had he been struck directly, his body wouldn't have been able to take it, and he would have likely likely died on the spot.
In the midst of bloody combat, Xue Ying's understanding of his secret skill, Life, steadily increased.
His display of his spear technique came from the heart, and it seemed as if its beauty was formed from all myriad beings of the world. Such a combat style seemed almost perfect, seeing how it allowed him to keep holding on for so long.
However, even this skill would eventually fail him, and the longer this fight continued, the more Xue Ying was that he would soon lose his life.
I have to go even quicker. It should be right around the corner. Xue Ying's heart now longed for the sight of a certain thing.
"Eh?" The many-legged beast that had been chasing after his life all this time suddenly slowed down, and it seemed to have lost any will to continue hunting him down. A certain doubt appeared in his mind. The Blazing Blood Door?
Indeed, as Xue Ying fled on the same path he had previously taken, it was not long before he arrived back at the Blazing Blood Door.
"Interesting! Very interesting!" The black-armored beast's eyes sparkled in expectation.
Xiu!
Xue Ying spotted the vast empty region from before, as well as the same enormous blood-colored disk about half a million kilometers wide laying on the ground. Various patterns of swords and blades were carved on its surface, emitting an aura of blood and death. Surrounding this disk were the awakened pairs and trios of blood-armored warriors chatting with one another. All of a sudden, they all turned their heads to look in Xue Ying's direction.
"What? He actually had the courage to return here?"
"That guy is back?"
All hundred or more of those warriors wearing blood-colored armor were looking at him in shock. At the same time, the many-legged beast chasing Xue Ying halted completely, staying behind at the mouth of the tunnel leading to this empty region.
Sou.
Xue Ying descented to land directly on the blood-colored disk while keeping close watch on the movements of the warriors. All of them focusing their attention on him left him feeling uneasy, and it was only once they slightly relaxed their grips on their weapons that Xue Ying was able to able to regain control of his strength.
"What, do you plan on passing through the Blazing Blood Door?" From the ranks of the blood-armored warriors, a tall and slim woman suddenly asked in a rather feminine voice.
"Enter the Blazing Blood Door?" Xue Ying sighed inwardly once he noticed that the warriors did not attack immediately, and then turned to looked at the many-legged beast which stopped in its tracks quite some distance away.
Very soon, a warrior of small stature flew out from the midst of all the other blood-armored warriors and landed atop the Blazing Blood Door. Its eyes showed malicious intent as he stared at Xue Ying.
Juse one opponent? Xue Ying thought. The other warriors wearing blood-colored armor are simply watching, not even bothering to hunt down and kill the black-armored beast from before. My guess should be correct, then.
He had fled along the same route that he entered through, ending up back at the Blazing Blood Door. However, he had only used this path due to a certain conjecture he had.
When they first passed by the door, four of the warriors had stepped up to block their path! It must be stated that, at the time, they had been surrounded by hundreds of warriors, so why would only four of them go out to fight them? Could it have been mere coincidence that there were also four members on his team?
On top of that, as soon as King Fu Qiong died, the blade-wielding warrior ceased to fight and the fight turned into a three versus three battle! If not for this fact, Monarch Armadillo Jade could not have escaped with the two of them, considering just how fast the blade-wielder was.
The fight had begun as a four versus four, and then turned into a three-on-three.
This created a certain doubt in Xue Ying's mind. On top of that, the blood-colored disk gave him a very strange sensation, which only served to make him even more curious about the truth of the matter.
'If I return by myself, would I be placed in a one versus one fight?' Xue Ying had begun to guess.
Of the four opponents from the previous battle, the blade-wielder, the tall fighter with golden fists, and the enchanting female warrior were obviously stronger than the black-haired fighter who did not reveal any particular strategy, Xue Ying pondered. Did they send out those four specific warriors to match each particular member of our team?
Three of our four members were stage four realm World Deities, with me being the only stage three World Deity. As such, of the four warriors that were dispatched, three were stronger much stronger than the last one.
Xue Ying was obviously a skilled expert, and his speed of thinking was hard to match. Despite his sorry position during that previous fight, he had observed every step of the battle carefully, and came up with some speculations based on that.
As such, he decided that he would rather gamble his life away to verify these speculations.
It would at least give some meaning to his death. Even if he ended up dead afterwards, he could retain some insights regarding the Blazing Blood Door.
Not to mention that, if he won the gamble, he might even avoid death!
It seems like my choice was correct. Xue Ying looked at the small warrior having descended upon the huge disk. His opponent was singular, and threat he felt from him was much weaker.
"You asked me whether I want to enter the Blazing Blood Door?" Xue Ying looked at the tall and thin woman, and inquired with a grin, "Are there any rules set down for people who want to go through the Blazing Blood Door?"
A glimmer appeared in the woman's eyes as she looked at Xue Ying with interest. The corners of her mouth even curled up into a smirk as she replied, "It seems that, despite your lack of knowledge, you still dared step upon the Blazing Blood Door. How brave."
"I'm simply gambling for my life," Xue Ying said.
The low rumble of diskussion could be heard coming from the ranks of the blood-armored warriors. Some were staring out with a smile, others shook their heads wearing a similar grin.
"Could you perhaps tell me the rules set down for entering through the Blazing Blood Door? So that I may at least die with a clear understanding, that is," Xue Ying said with a grin.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 535 - Another Battle at the Blazing Blood Door
chapters.content:
Chapter 535: Another Battle at the Blazing Blood Door
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The tall, slender woman nodded. "The Blazing Blood Door was crafted by my master for the sake of accomodating outsiders. However, very few of those who have visited Lake Heart Island so far showed the qualifications to see my master. Anyone who sought his treasures, master would just send here to attempt the trials of the Blazing Blood Door. This place has many dangers, and the more of them one overcomes, the greater the benefits they would obtain."
Xue Ying was enlightened.
He could imagine that the master of Lake Heart Island had been an incredible figure very long ago, and there would certainly have been many people coming to visiting him. Since the master had been too lazy to welcome everyone, he had simply created the Blazing Blood Door.
"Not everyone has the qualifications necessary to open this Blazing Blood Door," the woman continued. "As such, before they're allowed to step through, one has to experience a trial of selection which serves to cull the majority of cultivators."
"A selection trial?" Xue Ying was bewildered.
"That's right. Your opponent has already arrived before you. Defeat him, and you will have passed the trial. That will grant you the status necessary to enter the inner section of the Blazing Blood Door," the slender woman explained as she pointed to the small blood-armored warrior who had stepped onto the blood-colored disk a while ago. "You can either force him to acknowledge defeat, or just send him flying out of the range of the Blazing Blood Door. Either of these methods will be counted as your victory."
"Begin," the woman indifferently stated.
"Chao Wu, be careful that you don't lose," a tall, sturdy warrior with golden eyes shouted from the side.
"Little Brother Chao Wu, show us that you can gain us some face and kill off that outsider." The enchanting woman who specialized in hexing poison, covered her mouth and giggled.
"Brother Chao Wu, settle him, get rid of him."
"We believe in you."
The various blood-armored warriors were all cheering loudly. Having just woken up after a long time, witnessing a selection trial at the Blazing Blood Door left them feeling incredibly excited and joyful, something they had not felt for so long. These old people were, after all, too lonely, and they were looking forward to seeing Xue Ying die in this battle.
Hong! The blood-colored disk roughly five hundred thousand kilometers in width shot out a dim red light which enveloped the entire surrounding region up to the skies.
Xue Ying and the small warrior were both inside this region.
"I've got to either force him to admit defeat or send him out of this region of red light to win, right?" Xue Ying said.
"Look at this brat's confidence."
"Chao Wu, get rid of him!"
By now, a large amount of black-armored creatures had appeared at the entrance of the passage leading to this distant region. Some of them were humanoid, others had beastly figures, and there were even creatures with bird-like features. Regardless of shape, they were all watching the battle with great interest. In fact, the black-armored creatures had even begun chatting with the blood-armored warriors as if they had already been acquainted.
"I am Chao Wu." Back on the disk, the small warrior was staring at Xue Ying as he said in a shrill voice, "I was witness to that battle you've participated in before, and I know that you've cultivated an absolute art. Unfortunately for you, I have a way to deal with that ability of yours perfectly! Die!"
With those words, the warrior sprouted six arms, each of them having grabbed a curved saber.
Hua.
Under the guise of a silver trace that seemed distorted as it flashed through the air, the small warrior arrived next to Xue Ying. In spite of this, Xue Ying was in the middle of investigating the surrounding area unperturbed. Ever since the red light appeared, Xue Ying noticed that the usual instinctual suppression placed down by Lake Heart Island had disappeared! He could now display his World Deity domain and operate World Deity energy.
It was clear that, for the sake of making this selection trial as fair as possible, the ruins of Lake Heart Island would not suppress Xue Ying during the fight.
"How swift!" With a step, Xue Yin disappeared, only for his figure to appear once again a few hundred thousand kilometers away from his original position. At the same time, the warrior's blade light landed on empty space.
At the sight of this, the warrior showed a frown as he roared, "Seal!"
Xue Ying felt the space surrounding him being sealed but he simply chuckled in response. With a thought, he operated his World Energy, followed by condensing it. As a result, a large number of Xue Yings wearing starry-blue robes appeared in his surroundings. There were a total of nine of them, and each was holding onto a black spear which they used to launch a great assault, putting all sorts of spear techniques on display.
The dazzling luminous sun force edges filling the surroundings became visible, overwhelming the entire area. Within moments, it was already restricting the small warrior's movements.
"Kill"! A gillmer of cold intent flashed through the warrior's eyes…
Hong!
His figure blurred and the space surrounding him began to distort.
The blurred figure arrived next to one of Xue Ying's world bodies that was nearest to him. His six arms sent out blade lights in a flowing manner similar to a dance, these lights following the trajectory of a silver light. Before long, the attacks became so powerful that Xue Ying's world body, which had already been having a hard time defending himself, was hacked apart and exploded. The other eight world bodies had been sending out continuous attacks during that whole time, but the defenses of this small warrior were seemingly impervious. The world bodies were entirely unable to injure him, being able to slightly disrupt his body-enhancement technique at most.
That body-enhancement technique makes him so fast, and that blade technique is so difficult to counter. It's no wonder that he was so confident in being able to defeat me. Xue Ying was startled as he looked at all of this happen from a distance. With those blade techniques and his six arms, he'll be quite troublesome to deal with."
As soon as that world body was dealt with, another simply condensed to take its place. The nine world bodies were once again attacking the small warrior, no trace of fear in their movements.
At the same time, Chao Wu, the small warrior, was also feeling inwardly distressed. Back when Xue Ying and his team had been first attacked, the four had not approached the Blazing Blood Door, so the suppression was preventing them from displaying their World Deity domains. THat also meant that Xue Ying had now shown his world bodies! Now that Chao Wu acted, he discovered that his opponent could condense nine world bodies, and his head was already starting to ache at the thought of the implications.
I was careless. It's been so long since I last fought someone that I actually forgot to observe his movements properly that previous time! Chao Wu thought. Be that as it may, I still have to win this battle!
Hong!
Chao Wu's fury increased explosively.
His figure once again blurred, followed by a similar distortion of the surrounding spacetime continuum. However, his speed now reached a truly terrifying stage. He forcibly launched himself forward with such swiftness that he could now evade most of the attacks sent in his direction by those nine world bodies. As for the attacks he could not dodge, he would simply use his weapons to lightly parry them. In fact, he would even use his body to resist some of the attacks, as long as he was sure it would not affect his speed.
Xue Ying's attacks were entirely unable to injure him.
Right now, his target was one—Xue Ying's true body!
"You want to kill me? I am one with the world, and the world is one with me. Within this entire region, I am everywhere." Xue Ying chuckled. Within moments, he was already three hundred thousand kilometers away. Chao Wu's speed could have been even faster, and he would still have been helpless against Xue Ying's disappearing act.
From the ranks of the blood-armored warriors watching the battle, the enchanting woman from before said with a giggle, "You brat, how long are you going to keep dodging? You'll have to force Chao Wu to admit defeat, or send him flying out of the region specified by the Blazing Blood Door in order to win. You can keep evading, but you will never achieve victory."
"Right, you can't win just by running around."
"Unless you manage to win, you'll still end up dead sooner or later."
The warriors watching the battle from the side felt quite carefree.
Xue Ying ignored all of these comments coming from everyone around him. Unperturbed, he simply moved here and there while displaying his domain-related secret technique, Prison, to restrict his opponents while his nine world bodies continued attacking him! In fact, he had been so careful during this fight that he had yet to even use his Scarlet Cloud Spear. He simply continued observing his opponent's blade technique without saying a word.
It was only by understanding his enemy perfectly that he could have any hope of winning this battle.
On the other side, Chao Wu instead tried his hardest to kill a path over to Xue Ying in his fury. However, no matter what he tried, he simply could not get close to him. Time and time again, he was forced to continue fighting the world bodies.
Mn, that's it. After observing his opponent for the time it took to brew a cup of tea, his true body cultivating back at the Crimson Rock Mountain in the distant Xia Clan world in a hundred-times accelerated environment finally finished analyzing all the observations and came up with a strategy.
Hu! Xue Ying's Scarlet Cloud Spear seemed to jump out, moving along an unpredictable trajectory as it came piercing over.
******

chapters.title: Chapter 536 - Guest of Lake Heart Island
chapters.content:
Chapter 536: Guest of Lake Heart Island
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
When Xue Ying released his spear, the other nine world bodies had done the same.
First spear, ordinary, but its power started accumulating.
The petite armoured warrior was, however, quite excited, as Xue Ying's real body had finally released his spear. If not for that, he would have felt sullen, if Xue Ying continued hiding.
Second spear, its surroundings started twisting and this increased the petite armoured-warrior's 'Chao Wu's' alertness, something was not right!
Third spear!
"Boom!""Boom!""Boom!""Boom!""Boom!""Boom!"……
As if ten incomparably dazzling 'Sun Stars' had all appeared before his eyes at once, he was blinded and couldn't see at all. He was left only with relying on using the laws of profound mystery to sense his surrounding to detect traces of the ten spears. He also detected a strong trace of menace! That had to be the most tyrannic move Xue Ying had ever made.
"En?" The bystanding groups of Blood-colour-armoured warriors were quite taken aback.
His newly comprehended secret skill, 'Destruction' which drew out a enlightenment from of the ancient array in the Lake Heart Island and gathering the accumulation from two previous spears, caused the explosive power from the third spear to be very powerful!
A Scarlet Cloud Spear appeared to be speeding over in fury.
That was the secret skill 'Destruction'.
That was considered a spear technique as well, a marvelous play of the rules, and without a fixed style of use. It could be used to thrust, to hack, to sweep, or to drill into.
And when the world bodies in nine other realms activated the skill of 'Destruction', whether it was thrusting, or sweeping, they were all directed towards the Chao Wu.
"It's bad." Chao Wu's expressions changed drastically. The real intention of this activation of the third spear was only revealed when it exploded, and it was too late for him but he started displaying and combining martial arts and blade technique, in hope to block that off.
"Pu.""Peng.""Chi." The spears had all came at once, and while observing this in a fraction of a moment, the Chao Wu's blade technique had been spied on by Xue Ying.
"Bang!!!"
The last Scarlet Cloud Spear was surrounded by a darkness in absolute black, and surrounded by a surge of power, surging violently towards the Chao Wu that had already been trapped by the nine spears, and after working very hard, he was unable to restrain his emotions as he's transformed into a flowing light and left in the opposite direction.
But this berserk move kept thrashing perfectly at his body, it's power too great.
The continuous thrashing sent him flying backwards, and out of the parameters of the red light, and onto the cliff walls, shattering down countless layers of ice before he managed to stabilise himself. With an unsightly face, he looked towards Xue Ying, who was standing afar on the Blood-coloured disc. And though he was not injured to the slightest hair, he knew clearly that he lost!
To be expelled out of the Blood Fire Door would have rendered his lost in the battle!
"Not bad spearmanship you've displayed. This move way exceeds the stage three realm, and basing solely on its marvelous play of rules, this would have easily be recognised as a move from stage four realm." The tall and thin woman praised with a smile.
"It's a very powerful spear, little brother Chao Wu did not lose in injustice." The enchanting women continued.
"A World Deity from the stage three realm with such strength definitely have the rights to open the gates into the Blood Fire Door." The tall and thin woman continued, "Foreign practitioner, you've passed the screening test, and is now a guest of Lake Heart Island! This is a gift for you, on your passing of the test."
As she spoke, the tall and thin woman took out a Blood-coloured talisman.
The Blood-coloured talisman had only one strange-looking character on it.
Though he had not seen anything similar to this character, Xue Ying had a sudden recognition of the character - 'Mo (Ink?)'.
"Mo?" By the time Xue Ying grew doubtful, the Blood-coloured talisman had flown to his side.
"What's the use of this talisman?" Xue Ying asked.
"It should be useful." The tall and thin woman spoke with a matter of indifference, "You've only passed the screening test, the reward for this would not be too high. There will be more treasures for the more dangers you've survived after the gates to Blood Fire Door open."
The petite Chao Wu spoke softly from the side, "What matters to you is that you are now a guest of Lake Heart Island, and that's your greatest reward. Having been a guest of this island, you will no longer be viewed an intruder, and would not be succumbed to our attacks. You can walk freely in our common areas. However, you are prohibited from trespassing the island's restricted area."
"Walking freely within the common areas?" Xue Ying was delighted.
Such are the benefits of being a guest here.
How wonderful.
That was such a useful reward to have, and to himself, having to be in constant danger would have been such a headache.
"Hong Long Long~~~" Suddenly, the Blood-coloured disc beneath Xue Ying's feet separated slowly, and withdrew to the sides, revealing a horrendous-looking tunnel.
Xue Ying felt a jab of bone-chilling terror, and flew up to get a view of what's below.
There seemed to be a suction from below, and it was in the process of sucking Xue Ying in.
The tunnel that was revealed after the Blood-coloured discs withdrew, was a space of twisted hollowness. However in this twisted space, there were eighteen vein lines in Blood-colour, and in every line, they seemed to be howling from countless lives. A mere sight had involuntarily brought out the terror in him, and it obstructed his breathing to the extent that he felt like crouching down.
Even facing His Majesty Master God Emperor was not as frightening as this.
However, this tunnel had given Xue Ying a sense of terror to such an extent.
"Stop stop stop." Xue Ying spoke, "I'm giving up. I'm giving it up."
"Giving up?" That tall and thin woman was surprised, "You aren't going to crash into the Blood Fire Door anymore?"
Xue Ying continued, "The Blood Fire Door is laced with layers of perils, it should not be mandatory, could I give up?"
"En." The tall and thin woman nodded her head, and at a wave of her hand, the Blood-coloured disc came together again, sealing up the horrendous-looking tunnel.
"You're quite smart. With your strengths, you might have been killed in the tunnel." The tall and thin woman continued, "However, when you've grown stronger, you are welcome to challenge this door again."
"I will, I will." Xue Ying agreed.
Though he mutually agreed to the woman's suggestion, he knew well that he shouldn't treat this matter too lightly.
This was carefully constructed by the owner of Lake Heart Island with intention to ward of intruders, and by the look of it, it would have been extremely perilous inside. The mere 'Screening test' was already quite hard for me, am I trying to seek death going into the tunnel? I would probably consider this when I'm stronger.
"And since I'm a guest of Lake Heart Island, I wouldn't be attacked in the common areas right?" Xue Ying questioned.
"En." The tall and thin woman nodded in agreement, "But do not trespass the restricted area."
"Where's this restricted area?" Xue Ying asked.
"Worry not. If you did trespass by accident, you would be expulsed. But if it was intended, you would be killed." The tall and thin woman replied his query.
"Understood." Xue Ying gave a smile, "Everybody, I would make my departure."
Right after he turned to leave, Xue Ying made a halt and looked towards the petite warrior far away, "Brother Chao Wu?"
The petite warrior 'Chao Wu' turned and looked at Xue Ying in surprise, "What's the matter?"
"You're a Stage three realm World Deity right?" Xue Ying asked.
"I think so." Chao Wu answered with a frown.
Xue Ying nodded lightly.
He found that out when he fought against Chao Wu, and though Chao Wu's Secret Skill, blade technique, was very powerful, he was however a stage three World Deity, albeit good at defending. And he would only be comparable with Xue Ying only if he increases his power and speed tremendously.
"These armoured warriors, no matter the Black or Blood-coloured, are all good at defense." Xue Ying thought, "To estimate would have been Lake Heart Island's strategy."
At the very same moment, he sped up and flew off.
And those Black-armoured beasts that were blocking the valley retreated, by touching the mountain walls before disappearing.
"You've even become a guest of Lake Heart Island?" The Black-armoured many-legged beast muttered in apprehension, before disappearing into the mountainous walls with the others.
Xue Ying felt unreasonably jubilant after seeing the Black-armoured beasts making their departure. This is true, they are no longer attacking me.
Whoosh!
Xue Ying had sped quickly along the direction that his wife went, in catching up with her.
"Jing Qiu, tell me, where are you? Don't run, I'm coming!" Xue Ying communicated immediately, feeling emotional and full of confidence at the same time. That was his first, the confidence to bring his wife to safety. His confidence was brimming to such an extent that he was confident in rescuing his father-in-law as well.
******

chapters.title: Chapter 537 - Father Monarch Mo Xue
chapters.content:
Chapter 537: Father Monarch Mo Xue
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Come to speak of it, in reality Xue Ying had only experienced a battle of blood and fire.
"Dong Bo" Jing Qiu was incomparably moved, she had still believed that she was the only one alive of the team this time.
"I'm coming, where are you?" Xue Ying inquired
"I just got the True God Weapon" Jing Qiu transmitted.
"Good, just wait there for me, I'll come over." Xue Ying transmitted, "Back then when I split up from you, I gambled a little, and received some benefits. Now that I am at the ordinary area of Lake Heart Island, I will not suffer any attacks."
Sou!
Xue Ying rushed forth with the limit of his speed. His journey was unhindered, and there were not any black armored that came to ambush him. He was also worried, worried that during this period his wife Jing Qiu would suffer an ambush.
"It's still fine"
A short while later, Xue Ying finally saw the incomparably cold, silver haired, masked woman in the distance, and couldn't help but let out a breath of air.
"Dong Bo" Jing Qiu exclaimed, with joy in her voice.
"Jing Qiu, I'll send you out first." Xue Ying said, "go find a place near the border of the lake heart Island to temporarily reside."
"Oh?" Jing Qiu was somewhat puzzled.
Xue Ying faintly smiled, and explained the matter in detail, the situation of the 'Blood Fire Door', as well as a few benefits of passing through the selection trials.
After Jing Qiu finished listening, she couldn't help but let out a smile, "No longer an intruder? As a guest of the Lake Heart Island, this time Lake Heart Island you'll be much more safe."
"En." Xue Ying nodded, "Originally I was not sure of saving your father, but now I have a strand of confidence, but not matter all, everything is because of this True God Weapon! The True God Weapon is too precious, and cannot be lost. I'll first send you outside the Lake Heart Island… wait outside there! I will go alone to rescue him."
Jing Qiu thought a while, then nodded in approvement.
By reason, she understood, this was the most suitable, as her following along would not be helpful.
"Then let's go." Xue Ying waved his hand, and directly took his wife inside his inner world.
A world deities inner world was incredibly vast, and had many uses such as guiding a person's to reconstruct their fleshly body, and after becoming a powerful existence, their inner world would be completely perfected, and even be capable of creating life by itself, letting countless creatures reproduce and live.
Sou!
Following that, Xue Ying immediately began to return.
For safety, he returned by the same road from which he came, as this road was more remote, and the existences on the level of Nine Yang Palace Head and Dried Tree Old Mother would not seal and probe such a remote area.
…
"Hu." He charged out of the cave tunnel from which he arrived.
The outside was an expanse of ice and frost.
In the instance, there were boundless layers of water.
Xue Ying waved his hand, and Jing Qiu appeared beside him.
"We just exited so effortlessly." Jing Qiu looked towards the surroundings, and couldn't help let out a cheerful look, "I was worried that there would be dangers on the way back."
"Before we came across Monarch Armadillo Jade here, but now they are already…" Xue Ying softly shook his head, "Fortunately, we have now discovered the way to exit safely, and when the time comes we can bring back their blood refined deity warriors, so that their losses are minimal. That's right, Jing Qiu, you should go look for a place to seclude yourself nearby first."
"En." Jing Qiu nodded.
Breaking through the water layer would take too much time, and it would be too dangerous for Jing Qiu alone, so naturally they would temporarily find a safe place in the surroundings of the island.
Very soon.
In the depths of a tall mountain, Jing Qiu waved her hand and created an ice room condensed from world deity energy, and the surroundings were isolated from the detection of laws.
"The entire Heart Lake Island is incomparably big, and added together, there's only a tiny amount of stage four world deities and powerful existences here, so there's not much probability that someone will pass through here! Even if they pass by, they would be unable to use their world deity domain, as i've isolated this place from all detection of laws. They simply won't be able to find me here." Jing Qiu was rather confident.
"Alright." Xue Ying waved his hand, and left the treasures left behind by Monarch Armadillo Jade and the others as well as the Calamity Stone Essence to his wife. As for goods on the level of the Scarlet Cloud Spear and Ink Character Tablet, he carried on his person.
The Scarlet Cloud Spear held his personal strength a great deal, and the Ink Character Tablet was a reward from the selection test, and might have uses in the Lake Heart Island.
"Then I'll be leaving first." Xue Ying said, "You should quickly contact your father, and havehim meet up with me."
"En." Jing Qiu was somewhat worried, "You be a little careful, Nine Yang Palace Head, Dried Tree Old Mother, and the other three surely are also using the laws of karma to trace my father, and my father is using the laws of karma to try to maintain his distance from them! Once you meet up with my father and try to return home, I'm afraid there will be dangers."
"Don't worry, in any case the important treasures have all been left here." Xue Ying smiled.
Nine Yang Palace Head and the others, were either powerful existences, or stage four world deities that were comparable to powerful existences.
Monarch Mo Xue was also comparable to a powerful existence.
Each of them were very proficient in karma.
By using 'Karma' they would be able to confirm the relative locations of each other! This was also the reason that Nine Yang Palace Head and the others found it difficult to pursue Monarch Mo Xue, as Monarch Mo Xue knew when they approached, therefore he would stubbornly head towards the interior. With the caverns and side paths in the interior the direction was not certain. They could clearly confirm which direction Monarch Mo Xue was in, but following the cavern tunnels continuously lead them in other directions.
"I'll be going first." Xue Ying smiled, then immediately speedily went away.
Jing Qiu distantly looked at him, her long silver hair fluttering, with expectation silently in her heart.
She hoped that this time they would be able to succeed, that her husband would be able to successfully bring her father out.
******
The black robed, white haired, and white-bearded old man was relaxedly sitting on a protruding chunk of ice, using the detection of karma, he could detect threads of karma in the midst of nothingness connected to different directions. Amongst them there was a relatively coarse thread of karma that extended to an area more than one billion meters away, but that area was an expanse of primal chaos, and it was impossible to carefully monitor it.
Monarch Mo Xue was very clear, the reason why he was in an expanse of primal chaos was because that expanse of primal chaos isolated all detection of laws.
"Heng heng, want to chase me?"
"I've cultivated many years, and am proficient in the law of karma. In the interior of the Lake Heart Island the arrangement is also profound and strange. Wanting to catch up to me?" Monarch Mo Xue coldly laughed, then immediately looked around him. Around him was a completely empty mountainside. The mountainside and mountain walls contained eight caverns leading to different directions in total. Monarch Mo Xue showed a trace of a smile, "I, Mo Xue, have never gone this deep into the Lake Heart Island."
Within the information that he had received, there was not even a little bit recorded of this.
Because he was far too deep.
In this kind of place, perhaps only those on the level of the three ancestors or even a True God Ruler would dare to enter. It was because Monarch Mo Xue was fleeing for his life that he was unconcerned, crazily randomly entering.
"Father." Jing Qiu's transmission.
Monarch Mo Xue immediately exposed a smile, the thing that he was happiest about was that his eldest daughter had unexpectedly successfully reincarnated, and had awakened her memory to become a stage four world deity. This made Monarch Mo Xue incomparably happy. Even if he died, he would have no regrets. What made him even happier was that, his daughter's previous incarnation simply disdained males, but after being reincarnated, before even becoming a deity, she had unexpectedly already married to a young man of a material, mortal world.
Furthermore, this young man had extremely high talent, as was directly received by the Bloodshed God emperor as a direct disciple.
He has happy, delighted, and felt that even if he died, there was not much to worry about! Furthermore, he himself had truly lived too, too long, and had long accepted it, therefore at the final moments he had entered the Lake Heart Island ruins to fight and adventure a little. For a True God Weapon, even if he fell out with Nine Yang Palace Head, he would not hesitate!
As long as he could give this True God Weapon to his daughter, it would be too perfect. With a true god weapon, the chances of his daughter becoming a powerful existence would largely increase, and she had an even more formidable husband, who Mo Xue believed would surely be able to surpass himself in the future, truly transcend, and become a powerful existence.
"My obedient daughter, is something the matter?" Monarch Mo Xue carefreely chatted with his daughter.
"Father, I've already obtained the True God Weapon, and am now safely waiting on the outside of the Lake Heart Island." Jing Qiu transmitted.
Monarch Mo Xue Ying suddenly both happy and shocked.
They had unexpectedly succeeded?
"Xue Ying is currently in the interior of the Lake Heart Island, waiting to come rescue you, father! Tell me your general location, so I can tell Xue Ying." Jing Qiu said.
"He's coming to rescue me?" Monarch Mo Xue Frowned, then immediately transmitted, "My obedient daughter, don't waste your energy! I'm already at the extreme depth of the Lake Heart Island, which is too dangerous to Xue Ying! You two children shouldn't bother, lead your husband to immediately depart."
**

chapters.title: Chapter 538 - The Gray-Robed Male Beneath the Layer of Ice
chapters.content:
Chapter 538: The Gray-Robed Male Beneath the Layer of Ice
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Father, ever since I and Xue Ying came over, we have never minded the dangers. Furthermore, the two of us came as avatars, and you don't have to be worried about us." Jing Qiu transmitted a message over, "Also, we discovered a place called the blood fire door."
Jing Qiu introduced the everything thoroughly once through. This was something Xue Ying agreed with.
There was no need to hide anything from his own father-in-law.
"Getting through the selection, and you will not be attacked in ordinary regions, and as long as one accidentally barge into the important grounds, one will merely be chased out? Only by resisting would one be killed?" Monarch Mo Xue was startled. He immediately understood the importance of this guest identity!
"Alright." A new desire began growing within Monarch Mo Xue.
With his son-in-law's help, he might possibly escape out of this place and reincarnate!
"Daughter, I am too deep within the Lake Heart Island, and could only use karma to sense my location approximately. Furthermore, I've entered several dangerous grounds as I was escaping, fortunately surviving through before arriving here! This road I came is also a road which Xue Ying can't come along the same path I took." Monarch Mo Xue transmitted over. Primarily, it was because Nine Yang Palace Head and the others were too ruthless in their pursuit. Otherwise, why would Monarch Mo Xue charge into the dangerous areas? Nine Yang Palace Head and the others would not dare to gamble their lives off.
"Father, tell us your position first." Jing Qiu transmitted a message over.
******
Hu.
Crossing through the internal section of Lake Heart Island, the surrounding place was all frozen and covered in layers of ice. Xue Ying was instead, quite carefree as he wasn't attacked at all.
"This feeling is truly awesome." Xue Ying revealed a grin.
Previously, he was experiencing battle after battle with fear and trepidation. If not for Monarch Armadillo Jade, he and his wife might not reach the ground where the true god weapon was hidden at. That was also because Monarch Mo Xue had placed it at a more safer place.
"Mn?" Xue Ying received the map transmitted by his wife.
"So deep in?" Xue Ying frowned.
Monarch Mo Xue seemed to be at a distance beyond 100 billion kilometers from the boundary of the Lake Heart Island outer perimeter! This was also solely talking about the straight path distance, and due to the arrangement of the Lake Heart ISland, it was in reality an extremely far distance.
"Slowly proceed."
Because he was safe, Xue Ying could completely use the most basic method-to just keep proceeding closer to the position of Monarch Mo Xue! If he could not get through a passage, he would simply take another!
Time passed.
One day, two days, three days…
Xue Ying had crossed through a depth more than hundred times that when he first came. Yet not a single battle happened.
"This is truly mystical." Xue Ying looked forward. The end of this passage was actually a spatial maelstrom. If Xue Ying did not have the confidence, he would not dare to casually enter. None would know where one would be teleported after tunneling through the maelstrom! Clearly, this was a spatial tunnel, and would lead to some sort of place.
"Turn." Xue Ying did not hesitate in turning back before following his original path to find another side path to continue.
The inner section of Lake Heart ISland was too big.
There were also few stage four World Deities and powerful existences who came here from the Deity world and abyss-Xue Ying had not met any single one of them! But the places he moved through had been recorded on a very detailed map.
…
In the blink of an eye, one month passed. Even though Xue Ying was rerouting frequently, he was using his fastest pace to proceed. Any places that seemed more unique and dangerous were avoided. Thus, he had yet to meet any trouble as he proceeded along the ordinary regions. A month's time had shortened the distance by about 250 billion kilometers.
"Hu."
Within a passage that was entirely black, Xue Ying was flying at top speed.
The passage might be covered in thick ice layers, but one could see that deep within the icy layers, there were some kind of black material.
"Peng." Xue Ying waved his hand, causing a white light to shoot out, blasting off a large piece of icy layer, revealing the dark black corridor walls. The black corridor walls even had some simple patterns imprinted on it, though it gave off a bizarre charm.
"The deeper into the Lake Heart Island, I can finally see some structures." Xue Ying thought. And now, these structures were all sealed in ice.
"What is that?"
Xue Ying suddenly stopped. He turned around towards the icy layer which he just passed.
Within that thick icy layer, there was a humanoid figure appearing and disappearing. He was seated cross-legged inside.
"No armor?"
"Seated cross-legged?"
Xue Ying went high up the sky, carefully paying close notice through the icy layer. This icy layer was very thick, and there was a gray-robed male seated cross-legged within. He was entirely frozen in ice.
"I've seen truly many things over the one month here. I can be considered to be quite deep within the Lake Heart Island, but those icy sculptures would all be wearing armors." Xue Ying thought, "This is the first time I've seen one without an armor."
Xue Ying had some sort of impulse which caused him to ponder about what was happening.
"Whatever.
"Even if this gray-robed male is someone formidable in a certain area of Lake Heart Island, I am not deliberately interrupting. With my identity as a guest, he should not directly kill me off." Xue Ying decided in his head. He waved his hand immediately, causing many white edges to fly out from his fingertips, clashing and tearing apart the icy layer. Hua hua hua, large amounts of icy layer began crumbling apart.
The icy layer which was more than a hundred meters thick began shattering apart. The luminous sun force was controlled exquisitely, not harming the gray-robed male at all. The other surrounding icy layer was completely shattered apart as well, revealing the figure of the gray-robed male.
He was seated cross-legged without emitting any aura.
"Dead?" Xue Ying immediately determined the case after sensing him, "His true deity heart is gone?"
Xue Ying operated a strand of luminous sun force to permeate through this gray-robed male corpse. Indeed, it was empty, though this corpse made Xue Ying changed his expression because the moment his luminous sun force went tunneling through along his nose, he discovered that the muscles and nerves and organs of this corpse were truly powerful.
"He is absolute a powerful existence, and also one who cultivated his body to an extremely high realm." Xue Ying thought.
"But the question is who is he?"
Xue Ying carefully inspected him, "From the aura of his body, he should be from Deity world and not the Dark Abyss. But the powerful existences in the history of my Deity world, including those who died, I should know all of them. Yet I can't recognize him."
Xue Ying frowned as he looked carefully at this gray-robed male in front of him. An unfamiliar powerful existence. The history had not recorded the existence of him at all.
"But it isn't entirely exhaustive for those who were recorded in the history of Deity world, like the master of Lake Heart Island, he isn't recorded in the history either." Xue Ying guessed.
His vision landed on the wrist of this gray-robed male. There was a scarlet red wristband on his wrist. Waving his hand, this scarlet red wristband began flying over. This was the only treasure left behind on the body of this gray-robed male corpse. He, Xue Ying, was still not someone who would take away the clothes of a dead cultivator despite that robe being a top grade World Deity rank equipment.
The scarlet red wristband was a storage treasure, and also a very unique World Deity weapon used for battling.
"Interesting, even though it is a World Deity weapon, its power seemed very big." Xue Ying had a change in his expression inwardly. During the moment he refined this scarlet red wristband, he immediately discovered the ancient array within the inner section of this wristband. That mighty array seemed dark and unpredictable, causing Xue Ying to feel jittery. The inner section of the array had been a piece of stable time-space, "This is a weapon that could seal the enemy into the 'time-space' within. As long as I activate this weapon, I'll be able to keep the enemy into this time-space."
"Who is the one who refined the profound mystery within this weapon? I feel that the cultivation eden Crimson Rock Mountain could not compare to it." Xue Ying frowned, "And this gray-robed male corpse is someone I can't recognize either."
"Whatever."
If he could not get an answer, he would temporarily throw it aside. Regardless of what, this gray-robed male should have died for an unknown period of time, and he was also deep within the Lake Heart Island.
"There are even some other material goods within. Maybe from these goods, I could discover his identity." Xue Ying probed through it with his consciousness. The insides of the wristband had been divided into close to a hundred layers, and one of the layer of time-space had been saved for material goods to be placed within.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 539 - Leaving a Message
chapters.content:
Chapter 539: Leaving a Message
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying took out four items from within the wristband, which were also the more unique ones within the wristband. Other items were just the commonly-seen ones like Deity crystals.
These four items, were respectively, an axe, a piece of sharp remnant piece, a black whip and a golden book.
"The axe and this whip are both top graded World Deity weapons, and the refiners seem similar." Xue Ying came to the conclusion after inspecting through them once. The Deity imprints on the axe and the whip were both extremely ancient and unique, and were styles which he had never seen before prior to coming here. Strictly speaking, it was similar to the scarlet red wristband, with both containing the taste of time-space.
"Axe, whip, scarlet red wristband… their refiners must be good at time-space, and the person who currently is the greatest expert in time-space is the Temporal Island Lord." Xue Ying pondered on for a moment, but he could not guess the identity of this gray-robed male corpse. It seemed as if he was a powerful existence that popped out of nowhere.
He casually took out the sharp remnant piece once again.
Caressing the remnant piece, the remnant piece was crimson red in color. There were some ancient and simple patterns on it, and was emitting a vast and calm aura. This made Xue Ying feel his inner heart becoming calmer.
"Indeed some extraordinary, just that I can't determine its function just from a look. Furthermore, it is only a remnant piece, unless it is a piece coming from a true god weapon?" Xue Ying made his guesses before placing it aside. He turned towards the final item.
Xue Ying took up this thick golden book, flipping it open only to see many ancient words on it. He used his consciousness to sense.
Hong-
Large amounts of information began surging into his mind.
"I am Paragon Dust Cloud."
"The scarlet red wristband, axe and whip are weapons which I personally refined. It is just that they are lacking in materials, causing their grades to be limited to World Deity weapons. And that remnant piece of mine has been fortuitously obtained by me. Until today, I have yet to discover its function."
"These are gifts I am leaving behind to you, inheritor! I, Dust Cloud, has also been bitterly cultivating for a long period of time, without having many treasures. I do wish for inheritor to forgive me on this."
"Other than sending these items, I have a matter to request of you!"
"If inheritor is to meet 'Paragon Qing Yuan', please pass this book to him. Otherwise, it is fine."
"Qing Yuan, I've already completed the matter which you asked of me. It's just that I've belittled the danger in Lake Heart Island, and that we have no destiny to meet once again. Regretful!"
Just a few words, following which were many extremely complex array diagrams. There was a total of 325 array diagrams, with all of them being extremely complex.
Xue Ying became silent as he held onto the book.
He could sense the regret this male who died left behind. These were his last words.
"Paragon Dust Cloud? Paragon Qing Yuan?"
"Unless he is an existence at the Paragon realm?" Xue Ying reckoned. When he was adventuring with Monarch Armadillo Jade and the others, he knew of how many of the powerful existences were also called 'True God', and they were separated into three levels. Ordinary True God, Paragon True God and True God Ruler! Just like his own teacher, Temporal Island Lord and others on their levels, they were all Ruler realm existences.
"There isn't many at the Paragon realm in the entire Deity world and Abyss, but why have I never heard of the two?" Xue Ying thought, "And this Paragon Dust Cloud seems to not have any communication means? Prior to dying, he has instead left behind his last words on the book he is carrying?"
Usually, one would have communication means for contacting others.
One could also communicate via karma despite being separated by many worlds.
Leaving behind his last words in a book was something unique.
…
After investigating for a moment, he kept these. Xue Ying then looked at the gray-robed male corpse who was seated cross-legged with a calm look, before extending his hand, causing many soil and rocks to condense from the world energy. The soil and rocks soon covered the entire corpse of the gray-robed male corpse. Since he had died, he should return to the safety beneath the soil.
"Such an expert should have some identity. But he has died here, leaving behind a parting message. It should be his true body which died." Xue Ying thought to himself as he looked at this grave, "The Lake Heart ISland is indeed ranked in the forefront of historical remains in the entire Deity world and Abyss. Its degree of danger has surpassed our imaginations, and it should most likely have methods of killing both avatars and true bodies."
Just like Bloodshed God Emperor, he could use karma while killing powerful existences to transmit to the other body that was far away, killing both together!
Only when hiding oneself in the material realm, with the material realm laws, that would protect the native lifeforms. The stronger the expert, the more his strength would be suppressed. Those at the level of rulers, even if they borrowed upon an oath to send an attack down, could only kill a stage three World Deity. Without an oath, they could only kill a stage two World Deity.
One had to know that in the Deity world and Abyss, experts like the Blood God Emperor could easily kill the ordinary powerful existences. One could see how formidable the intrinsic laws of the 'material realm' was.
"The danger of the Lake Heart Island historical remain should most likely be greater than the abilities of my teacher and the others. I can't be careless."
It's after he had seen the corpse of Monarch Heavenly Cloud, the huge array formed from the billions of meteorites, that enormous array diagram, which gave Xue Ying a sense of feeling that this place wasn't any weaker than the laws of material realm! Thus, it made Xue Ying feel that… the protection of the laws of material realm wasn't absolute!
"Fortunately, I am a guest of the Lake Heart ISland. As long as I do not deliberately seek death, I should not be so unfortunate."
Xue Ying looked at the grave.
"No destiny to meet once again, regret!" Xue Ying was chanting these words in his heart, "I wonder if the two are lovers or relatives?"
"The road of cultivation isn't easy. Entering the historical remain might be beneficial, but it has its dangers too." Xue Ying sighed.
An existence of True God Paragon had died here.
Sou.
Xue Ying continued proceeding ahead.
…
As the distance to Monarch Mo Xue got closer, Xue Ying was also starting to communicate with Monarch Mo Xue via his wife. Monarch Mo Xue was also not staying at one spot. He was avoiding the pursuit of others and thus, was always on the move. But because he was located deep within, there were many dangers. Thus, the movement distance was very small.
15 billion kilometers, 5 billion kilometers, 2.5 billion kilometers, 500 million kilometers…
The distance between the two got closer and closer.
"I've entered the wrong path. This is a dead end." Even though he knew that their distance was getting closer, there were still many obstacles between them, and he had to take the detour for a long time.
"No rush, no rush."
Monarch Mo Xue was currently standing on a piece of empty ground. The entire empty ground was sealed in ice. He was just looking afar while waiting. At the same time, he was sensing the distance between him and Nine Yang Palace Head and the others. He was dodging them while at the same time, moving closer to Xue Ying.
Hu.
Monarch Mo Xue's eyes brightened. He could see a streamer arcing through the sky, following which he landed on the plaza. He was none other than a black-robed young man who had several frost left on his body.
Monarch Mo Xue caressed the snowy-white beard of his, grinning at the same time. The last time he saw Xue Ying at the Myriad Flower Feast was when Xue Ying was still a Deity. Now, he had the combat power of a stage four World Deity.
"Good son-in-law." Monarch Mo Xue shouted out as he laughed. His voice was grand, and had reverberated around the plaza with joy.
Xue Ying also greeted back, "Xue Ying greets sir father-in-law."
**

chapters.title: Chapter 540 - Entry
chapters.content:
Chapter 540: Entry
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The more Monarch Mo Xue looked at Xue Ying, the more he liked him. It was a pity that he would not be living for long, so why would he not be happy for he could still have a look at such a son-in-law before dying?
"Xue Ying." Monarch Mo Xue was laughing out, "I knew you are my son-in-law that time when we were in Calm Sea Prefecture Capital. That time, even though I might be happy that my daughter has successfully reincarnated, and that my eldest daughter of mine finally has someone who wanted her, you were just a Deity brat and that wasn't something I'm totally pleased."
"But seeing how your potential was quite good, I let it go and did not regarded it much since I can't decide ultimately what my daughter wanted." Monarch Mo Xue said with smiles.
Xue Ying helplessly replied, "Sir father-in-law, you and jing Qiu were both hiding from me. I was feeling quite puzzled that time when Monarch Mo Xue has looked so greatly upon me."
"Hahaha…" Monarch Mo Xue continued laughing.
He then casually said, "Xue Ying, we are currently deep in the LAke Heart Island, with dangers all around. That Nine Yang Palace Head will have a hard time trying to capture me, but the moment we returned, the more we moved outside… the lower the danger and it will not be considered much to Nine Yang Palace Head and the others. They can surround me together, and furthermore, they have avatar techniques too. Trying to escape from their blockade is something that has low chances of success."
Xue Ying replied, "Sir father-in-law, I and Jing Qiu have both thought of how we will stake it even if the chances are lower. If we stay in the deep region of Lake Heart Island, over time, we will only be waiting for death. As long as we escaped and leave the region of the laws of the Lake Heart Island historical remain, father-in-law, you could reincarnate then. Jing Qiu could successfully reincarnate, and sir father-in-law, you completely have hopes of reincarnating too."
Monarch Mo Xue nodded with a smile, "I understand. You don't have to speak too much. Indeed, there's chances of success. But for my daughter to succeed, it doesn't represent that I'll succeed too. The chances are ultimately lower. Right now, if you and I charged out, we might not possibly escape and your identity might be discovered by Nine Yang Place Head, causing a enmity to form."
"I am not even afraid. Sir father-in-law is still afraid of this?" Xue Ying said.
Monarch Mo Xue was stunned before he nodded, "Alright, then I'll have to trouble you, Xue Ying."
He had also thought of how Xue Ying was a material realm lord, and the personal disciple of the God Emperor. Such trouble was something he could withstand. He decided not to be pretentious anymore.
"When I came, I've already scouted the road, and we can use the straightest path out." xue Ying said.
"Alright, you point out the road and we'll take the gamble." Monarch Mo Xue said.
Sou!
The two people immediately went flying at high speed.
Monarch Mo Xue let out his power to bring along Xue Ying, causing the speed they were flying at to reach 300,000 kilometers every second. Clearly, this old man who cultivated for a long period of time and could match the might of powerful existences was also good in terms of speed.
…
Within the icy corridor, a cold teenager was folding his arms. He had always been borrowing karma to sense the direction of where Monarch Mo Xue was in the distant. Monarch Mo Xue had always been using treasure to isolate all means of karma scouting methods, causing his senses to only lock on to a region. That region had been very vague and blurrish, and he could not scout clearly what was happening within.
"What a miscalculation. If I knew that Monarch Mo Xue isn't afraid of death, I would not have brought him along." the cold teenager shook his head.
That time, he was leading several of his comrades together.
He was the leader of the team. Ultimately, his combat power was the strongest. Being the personal disciple of Temporal Island Lord, when he was a World Deity, he was quite dazzling already. Furthermore, his combat power was truly deep and profound. Who would have thought that the moment Monarch Mo Xue discovered the true god weapon, he immediately took it and escaped and did not care about this team leader.
"True god weapon."
"As long as I can acquire the true god weapon, completely refine it over night, I'll be able to open up a new path of mine, allowing my chance of entering the paragon realm to soar." The cold teenager's eyes were filled with unwillingness, "Whoever dares to obstruct me, kill."
He was truly filled with killing intent.
The cold teenager, 'Nine Yang Palace Head' suddenly turned towards another direction, "He is moving at high speed?"
Even though Monarch Mo Xue was deliberately controlling the region and isolate methods of probing, as he flew at high speed, the isolated region was ultimately moving still.
"What is he preparing to do?" Nine Yang Palace Head was not in a rush to act. Because they were not certain if the main motive of Monarch Mo Xue was trying to escape or to head into a deeper region.
After waiting for Monarch Mo Xue to fly for the time taken to brew a cup of tea.
Nine Yang Palace Head finally affirmed. His eyes were filled with a strand of frost, "This Mo Xue is actually escaping outwards. Did he think he could escape?"
Sou!
Nine Yang Palace Head also began acting.
…
At another pathway.
The old granny who was holding onto a wooden walking stick, communicated with Nine Yang Palace Head, "Alright, Palace Head, be rest assured. This matter can be left to I, old granny to do. I'll certainly help." Her hair began rapidly extending into many grayish-brown tree root. These grayish-brown tree roots directly broke apart and soon, formed into many grayish-robed old granny. There was a total of nine bodies.
Sou sou sou sou sou sou…
The nine bodies began moving out in different directions rapidly. They were also moving ahead to act as blockade. This was a method which the Dried Tree Old Mother could use due to her innate talent. Even under the suppression of the Lake Heart Island, she could still separate into many bodies.
Her avatar technique was also the reason why Nine Yang Palace Head was so confident in capturing Monarch mo Xue.
******
"What's the matter?"
"He is escaping truly fast!"
"Why isn't he slowing down at all during the path? Unless he isn't afraid of being attacked?"
Nine Yang Palace Head discovered something as they pursued.
"Hear my orders, use all your strength to first rush towards the outer perimeter of the Lake Heart Island. We'll form a blockade in the outer perimeter." Nine Yang Palace Head transmitted his orders. Emperor Prison Dragon and he had a relationship of life and death. Dried Tree Old Mother also promised to help him. As for the Red Transient Empress and Ze Nuo Sovereign, both did not dare to act against him. None was as courageous as Monarch Mo Xue.
"Alright.""Understood."
Since all of them had been pursuing into deep within the Lake Heart ISland, they were currently flying along their original path, evading all sorts of road that would bring them injustice.
For a moment, their speed was extremely fast.
Like Nine Yang Palace Head and Emperor Prison Dragon, their speed was even higher than Monarch Mo Xue! The moment they did not care about Monarch Mo Xue and just rushed out towards the outer perimeter, they soon reached the forefront.
"Trouble."
Xue Ying and Monarch Mo Xue knew that something was amiss.
No matter how, they still had to fly towards the outermost perimeter.
"There are many people at the exit. There are many people at the sidepaths too. We can only gamble." Xue Ying and Monarch Mo Xue did not have any other methods.
…
As time pased, ever since he linked up with Monarch Mo Xue, a month had passed.
Their distance towards the exit wasn't far anymore. It would most likely take about 2-3 days before they would leave the place. But it was becoming more dangerous at this moment because Nine Yang Palace Head and the others were frenziedly forming a blockade.
"Sou."
Deep in the cavern passage, Xue Ying and Monarch Mo Xue were both flying along as streamers.
"They are moving closer. They are moving closer in all directions." Monarch Mo Xue felt quite anxious, "We have to change directions."
"Change." Xue Ying agreed.
He did not point out the direction at this moment since he was forced to move randomly, and was no longer traveling in a path he was familiar with. The only thing he could rely on is his identity of a guest, allowing him to prevent any attacks from happening.
Change path! Change again! Change change change!
"Chase."
"They can't escape." Nine Yang Palace Head also staking it all at this moment. They could feel that Monarch Mo Xue would already be blockaded at this moment.
Monarch mo Xue had always been escaping for his life.
But the more he escaped, the more the region he was blockaded in would become smaller. This made Monarch Mo Xue feel more despondent.
"Can't escape anymore." Monarch Mo Xue sighed, "Actually I knew also that as long as Nine Yang PAlace Head decided to blockade me, the chances of me escaping is very low. Xue Ying, you should leave. Don't care about me anymore. If you followed me any further, you'll just be affected."
"Sir father-in-law, don't give up. I have another method." Xue Ying said.
"You have another method?" Monarch Mo Xue looked at Xue Ying with shock. Previously, Xue Ying had always been following and allowing Monarch Mo Xue in changing paths.
"Let's attempt." Xue Ying said, "Sir father-in-law, you should not resist."
Saying which, he waved his hand before bringing Monarch Mo Xue into his inner world.
Xue Ying then flew to a nearby destination by himself. He soon saw a spatial maelstrom that looked dark in the distant. Walking by the spatial maelstrom, he sat down cross-legged beside it.
"They are getting closer." Monarch Mo Xue was inside the inner world, informing Xue Ying.
Just a moment later.
Hu.
A figure soon came flying out from the dark cavern, coming out from the bend, before seeing Xue Ying who was seated cross-legged.
"Oh? Dong Bo Xue Ying?" The person who came was a cold teenager.
Xue Ying looked up before standing, "Greetings Nine Yang Palace Head."
The cold teenager nodded slightly with a grin on the edge of his lips. He had good feelings towards this Xue ying as he laughed, "Previously, I felt puzzled that time since Scarlet Flame Forefather has descended into Xia Clan World with just an incarnation, so how could he save your wife. I've asked Scarlet Flame Forefather, and he told me that you have given half of your soul to your wife."
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
"Your Xia Clan war is so tough, and I believe that you shouldn't have grasped a grade one Tru Meaning during the end of the war." The cold teenager guessed, "If you have a grade one True Meaning, saving your wife shouldn't be that hard."
"Yes." Xue Ying felt weird in his heart. Why was this Nine Yang Palace Head so familiar with him?
"For the sake of your wife, you gave half of your soul up. You aren't a grade one True Meaning Transcendent either that time. Such a danger which broke your cultivation path." The cold teenager smiled and nodded, "Truly courageous. Even though I quite like you brat, this concerns a true god weapon. Whoever dares to obstruct me will be killed. Thus, I hope you better not help Monarch mo Xue since you can't do so."
Sou.
Another black dragon came flying from another direction. His speed was truly fast. After landing, he became a tall and big black-armored male.
"How is it? Have you discovered Monarch Mo Xue around?" The cold teenager asked.
"Nope." The black-armored male, Emperor Prison Dragon said.
The cold teenager looked at Xue Ying. a strand of sharpness appeared in his eyes as he coldly stated, "The region which isolated probing is so large, and there aren't any other life forms within, with only you alone! Furthermore, through karma, I can be certain that Monarch Mo Xue is around here. There aren't any other regions he could escape from. He should most likely be located in your cultivation eden treasure or your inner world right?"/
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, for the sake of Monarch Mo Xue, going against me isn't something worth the price." The cold teenager said, "We can be friends and not enemies."
Xue Ying looked at him, "There's some matters which I have no choice of."
Sou!
He directly flew right towards the spatial maelstrom by his side, disappearing within.
The cold teenager's expression changed. Usually, areas like the spatial maelstrom were much more dangerous and important. He frowned, "Just teaching him slightly, is it worth helping Mo Xue this much?"
…
Sou.
This was the first time Xue Ying entered a spatial maelstrom after coming to Lake Heart ISland. This was also one of the reasons why he felt he could still stake it on since he was a guest, and barging into an important ground, he would not be directly killed.
"Hu." The surrounding space was transforming.
Suddenly, a vast great space appeared in front of him.
Landing on this piece of vast ground, he looked up, only to see a huge golden-armored giant who was like a mountain seated cross-legged in the distant. This towering golden-armored giant also began opening his eyes, overlooking to his direction.
Xue Ying felt awkward as he asked, "I have accidentally barged into this place. I dare ask where exactly is here?"
*

chapters.title: Chapter 541 - Talk After Winning
chapters.content:
Chapter 541: Talk After Winning
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The golden-armored giant which was as big as a mountain overlooked beneath him. His expression was like a chisel, his eyes were gentle, his lips were thicker than normal, just that he had this unseen pressure which made Xue Ying feel the suppression.
"He should be stronger than Forefather Scarlet Flame and Monarch Mo Xue. This feeling is closer to that from the Nine Yang Palace Head." Xue Ying thought.
Nine Yang Palace Head was a powerful existence and the personal disciple of the Temporal Island Lord.
How could he make Emperor Prison Dragon and Dried Tree Old Mother listen to his commands? Precisely because his combat power was beyond ordinary powerful existences. Although it wasn't at the paragon realm yet, his combat power was infinitesimally close.
That towering golden-armored giant looked over before speaking, "This destruction eden isn't a place you can barge in."
"Someone actually dares to barge into the destruction eden?" On the surface of this golden-armored giant, a black figure suddenly appeared. This black figure arced through the sky, leaping towards Xue Ying.
Xue Ying was startled.
He could see clearly with a glance that the black figure leaping over was thin, small and monkey-like. He was wearing a black armor, and was holding onto a deep violet pole. One could see that as he flew over, he waved the pole in his hand, causing it to elongate in length, akin to extending across the entire world. The deep violet pole emitted a power that made Xue Ying feel his heart palpitate as it smashed against Xue Ying.
"I am a guest, even if I barge in, they should first chase me away. Why would they fight me right away?" Xue Ying felt his heart getting numbed. He did not have the time to hesitate anymore as he hurriedly display the scarlet cloud spear to parry against this pole.
"I come without any malice intention!" Xue Ying had tried explaining himself through sound transmission.
"Peng!'
The deep violet pole swept across the world, sweeping against the spear of Xue Ying. Xue Ying could only feel a vast power rushing over. He cultivated the "Luminous Sun" absolute art, which was known for its powerful strength. Yet at this moment, facing this deep violet pole sweeping across him was just like an ant trying to shake the tree; he was suppressed immediately.
Sou.
Xue Ying was lashed by the impact that the bones in his hands became fractured. The spear directly clashed against his chest, causing it to cave in. Xue Ying spurt out a mouth of fresh blood as he fell back rapidly, only stopping after flying for a few hundred thousand kilometers.
"The gap is too big!" Xue Ying's expression changed. He had met many opponents, and even meeting those blood-armored warriors from the blood fire door and the black-armored creatures did not give him such a feeling.
The enormous gap made Xue Ying feel helpless and without any thoughts of resisting! Because he would only be smashed even if he resisted.
"Fortunately, he did not have any killing intent. Previously, he had merely smashed the pole over, yet he did not let the strength explode within my body, and had merely caused me to fly back a few hundred thousand kilometers." Xue Ying thought. If the opponent was evil, he would most likely have died, with every single particle of his body exploding and dissipating. He would be 'deader' than dead.
One move killed him! This was the gap between the two.
"This senior…" Xue Ying had just transmitted his voice.
"Ah ah ah." That monkey had instead shouted out weirdly, He waved the deep violet pole over again.
Peng.
Xue Ying barely had the time to bring up his spear. He was once again lashed out to the extent that he spurt out blood.
"Peng." Halfway through the distance he flew back, the monkey can once again with a pole.
Peng Peng Peng Peng Peng Peng…
