He threw himself entirely into researching hex poisons, and it was normal for him to spend tens of billions of years researching in one go.
"I have never thought that Your Highness knows my name too. Haha, I haven't left for a long time. Your Highness, right now, it isn't the time to chat. Shall I bring Your highness off first? Nine Yang is catching up soon." Purple-gowned Hex Emperor said.
"There's no need to trouble Hex Emperor." Xue Ying smiled.
Purple-gowned Hex Emperor shook his head lightly, "It's not troublesome."
The moment he finished speaking, Xue Ying felt a wave of dizziness. Fortunately, he cultivated the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body", allowing his body to reach a very tyrannical stage, and was much stronger than even powerful existences. His ability to withstand had increased very much too. Even though something created a spell of dizziness, he could still maintain his consciousness. It was not hard for a soldier from the Destruction Legion to be captured.
"Not good." Xue Ying rapidly retreated.
"Mn?" Purple-gowned Hex Emperor was startled. Even ordinary powerful existences would fall unconscious, yet this Xue Ying could resist it? This body's ability to resist the power of hex poison was kind of too strong already…?
The moment Xue Ying retreated, his speed immediately accelerated.
When Purple-gowned Hex Emperor tried grabbing out, it took some time, though it was too late.
Sou.
A cold teenager came flying over from afar. His face was filled with killing intent as he swept across that Dried Tree Old Mother. Dried Tree Old Mother had instead stood there by the side of Purple-gowned Hex Emperor, chuckling, "Old granny has sought Hex Emperor, so Palace Head, I can't help you anymore."
Nine Yang Palace Head looked towards Purple-gowned Hex Emperor with a cold expression, gowling, "Purple-gown, you want to fight against me too? You have always been researching on hex poison, yet you still want to grab a true god weapon?"
"Every single true god weapon belongs to a dao of its own. Currently, I am stuck in a bottleneck and can't break through any more. As long as I could borrow some pointers from it, it might possibly provide me with some inspiration to take that next step." Purple-gowned Hex Emperor's face which was filled with violet deity marks chuckled, "Nine Yang, you have an absolute art from the Temporal Island Lord, but if you were to truly fight with me, most likely, I will still be the one to bring His Highness Dong Bo away. So I suggest for you to give up."
"Is that so?" The killing intent within Nine Yang Palace Head's eyes surged.
The two were facing each other.
The terrifying aura caused even the surrounding Dried Tree Old Mother and Sovereign Ze Nuo to feel their hearts tightening. These two had tyrannical combat powers, with that close to a paragon. Ordinary powerful existences could not fight against them.
"You should know that your chances are low." Purple-gowned Hex Emperor remained indifferent.
Nine Yang PAlace Head's killing intent had instead become even stronger.
He knew that the two combat powers were comparable, but Purple-gowned Hex Poison had reached his level step by step, and he had no absolute arts either. His combat power relied on many different techniques! Like some avatar techniques of his were much stronger than that of the Nine Yang Palace Head, and Nine Yang Palace Head understood in his heart that if the two were to compete in capturing Xue Ying, his own success rate would not exceed 10%.
"It seems I still have to act." Purple-gowned Hex Emperor's golden eyes were filled with countless patterns flowing. The surrounding laws of the world could clearly be seen by him. His killing intent began surging.
And in the distant, Xue Ying felt the incoming threat. He transmitted a message, "Big Brother Huo Cheng, I am unable to hold on these two fellows anymore!"
"Hu."
A figure appeared by the side of Xue Ying. It was none other than Paragon Huo Cheng.
"Leave the rest to me. Rest assure, I'll end this quickly."
Paragon Huo Cheng grinned, revealing his white teeth.
He then walked over, stepping on the void. And the distant Nine Yang Palace Head and Purple-gowned Hex Emperor suddenly felt an intense feeling of danger at the same time as if there was an enormous sun star incoming, causing the two to turn over. They only saw a figure bathed in surging flames stepping across the void walking over. His figure was so grand, and he was dressed simply, revealing his skin of scarlet red, red hair, red beard and red brows as if he was a ruler amidst the flames.
Both his eyes looked over. That pair of eyes felt as if an endless volcano was hidden within.
"Paragon Huo Cheng!" Purple-gowned Hex Emperor and Nine Yang Palace Head were both startled.
Paragon Huo Cheng was a very ancient paragon existence. His teacher was also the very first ruler in the Deity world and Abyss, 'Primal Master'. Paragon Huo Cheng had lived for far too long, and his combat power was extremely powerful. Before Monarch Green and the others had even rose, Paragon Huo Cheng was one of the few powerful paragons already. That time, Pang Yi had to even stand behind.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying is my brother, my life and death brother!" Paragon Huo Cheng's entire body was bathing in raging flames. His eyes were releasing a might that felt heaven-shattering.
"Are you all planning to scram yourselves? Or should I beat you all till you scram?" Paragon Huo Cheng's voice felt like thunder, rolling over.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 557 - Big Benefit
chapters.content:
Chapter 557: Big Benefit
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Violet-gowned Hex Emperor and Nine Yang Palace Head felt their hearts being stifled as the pressure enveloped down on both of them.
If it was some new Paragon who had just opened up their own Dao path, the two were not afraid of them. However, Paragon Huo Cheng was different. He had lived for far too long, and had long opened up his own dao path. Furthermore, he had walked down this path for a long distance, and the gap in combat power between the two parties were clear. Even if the two of them worked together, they would easily be suppressed.
"Hong~" A wave of heat came assaulting over, causing even the stable space within Lake Heart Island to be distorted.
"Greetings Paragon Huo Cheng." Violet-gowned Hex Emperor had greeted with a slight bow.
Paragon Huo Cheng looked at him, nodding, "Violet-gown, I still remember the previous time when we both met, you were just an ordinary true god. Now, your combat power has actually reached this stage and you depended on your own comprehensions. It should be about time when you opened your own dao."
Violet-gowned Hex Emperor smiled with some signs of humility, "Paragon Huo Cheng has over-praised me. I am stuck at a bottleneck, and have always been feeling an unseen obstacle when trying to take this step. Thus, I came seeking for an opportunity."
"Mn, don't be so anxious. Take your time." Paragon Huo Cheng said. He might be overbearing, but he did not have any killing intent towards Violet-gowned Hex Emperor and Nine Yang Palace Head.
"Since Paragon Huo Cheng is willing to act out for His Highness Dong Bo, then I'll naturally not be in a tangle with him anymore. I'll bid my farewell first." Violet-gowned Hex Emperor chuckled before bringing Dried Tree Old Mother in leaving the place, leaving behind Nine Yang Palace Head with some slight unwillingness.
Paragon Huo Cheng's unseen pressure glare landed on Nine Yang Palace Head, curling his lips in saying, "Nine Yang, you are a disciple under the Temporal Island Lord, and is even his personal disciple. Currently, you are comparable to Violet-gown, and now, you still wish to take away the true god weapon of Monarch Mo Xue."
"Dong Bo Xue Ying!" Nine Yang Palace Head growled instead.
In the distant, Xue Ying flew over to the side of Paragon Huo Cheng. He replied with a relatively polite tone, "Nine Yang Palace Head, Monarch Mo Xue has helped me a lot, so I have to protect him."
Even though his combat power had rose a lot, it was not the time for his wife to expose his identity. After all, Paragon Huo Cheng could not always be there to protect himself. Wait until he became a stage four World Deity, by then, he would not care about this anymore.
"Helped you, what favor, what is it that made you risk your life?" Nine Yang Palace Head felt anguished, "Isn't it just a little pointer given to you during the Myriad Flower Feast? You protected his nation, this should be enough to settle the karma."
"I am doing things according to my heart. This matter is something I will not move back from." Xue Ying answered.
Paragon Huo Cheng's eyed glared, causing an unseen wave of heat to rush over, causing Nine Yang Palace Head's expression to change. On his surface, a layer of dull sword light appeared, defending him against the wave of heat. Paragon Huo Cheng furiously berated, "Nine Yang, I have given you enough respect. And entering the historical remain for an adventure, obtaining a treasure depends solely on one's own techniques and strategies. Mo Xue has disregarded his life in seeking for treasure, and now that he has gotten a true god weapon, it is his fortune. If you were to rely on your combat power to snatch it over successfully, it's fine. But now, I am here! Your combat power is too far off, so stay here like a hoodlum."
Nine Yang Palace Head gritted his teeth.
Unwilling.
He cultivated for many years, and yet, he could still not take that last step to open his own dao path! This true god weapon was an opportunity to him.
"Scram!" Paragon Huo Cheng no longer had any patience.
"We'll leave." Nine Yang Palace Head looked ahead, yet he gritted his teeth and left after that. Sovereign Ze Nuo and the others, including Emperor Prison Dragon who had rushed over, were also leaving.
Xue Ying looked at this scene.
Big Brother Huo Cheng was indeed famous for his power. He did not need to act yet he could force the other party to leave.
"Nine Yang this brat has an extraordinary potential." The eyes beneath the red brows of Paragon Huo Cheng held some regret, "It's a pity that his cultivation heart is lacking. He is too anxious to succeed, and am trying his best to seek for all sorts of external aid to help him become a paragon. But the more rushed he is, the more hopeless it will be. Ultimately, an external aid is an external strength. What one has to depend is still inside one's own body."
"Nine Yang PAlace Head should understand this logic too." Xue Ying said, "But knowing and doing it are two different things."
"Mn." Paragon Huo CHeng nodded.
Knowing and doing it were different.
Logic was something everyone knew of. But truly doing it was something difficult.
"Let's go, let's go fetch your wife." Paragon Huo Cheng laughed. Xue Ying immediately led the way as they rushed out.
…
In an icy mountain cave right at the outer perimeter of the Lake Heart Island, Jing Qiu was here silently cultivating. And now, she was instead standing on a piece of ice looking afar.
"Father." Jing Qiu saw the distant figure of a white-haired white-bearded black-robed old man, and could not help but be joyous.
"Daughter." Monarch Mo Xue also rushed over.
The two father and and daughter hugged each other the moment they met. Jing Qiu's eyes were filled with tears. Father had given her the true god weapon, and soon later, her father would be reincarnating soon. This had caused a strand of unwillingness to form in the heart of Jing Qiu.
Not far away, Xue Ying and Paragon Huo Cheng were both looking. Paragon Huo Cheng was entirely scarlet red in color with red hair and red brows. He stood there emitting a wave of heat, causing the surrounding icy layer to start melting. He looked from afar, "Nine Yang and Purple gown both do not know that actually, this Mo Xue is your father-in-law. Your wife is not bad. She is actually a stage four World Deity."
Paragon Huo Cheng's eyes had some recollections. In his eyes, Monarch Mo Xue, Jing Qiu and Xue Ying were all brats.
After all, he had solely been trapped here for more than a hundred billion years!
"It's a pity he can't transcend and reach eternity." Xue Ying sighed.
"As long as one lived happily enough, why care about the length?" PAragon Huo Cheng chuckled, "Oh right, Brother Dong Bo, I previously told you that after saving me, I'll give you plenty of good benefits. It's a pity that your combat power is still lacking, so the use of this benefit to you might be lower. However, to your teacher Bloodshed God Emperor, it is a huge benefit."
Xue Ying asked, "What good benefits?"
"That time when I first barged into the Lake Heart Island, even though I was eventually imprisoned, I have gotten a huge reward." Paragon Huo Cheng chuckled, "I discovered records of an ancient cavern dwelling which was where the Lake Heart Island master previously stayed at."
"A cavern dwelling where the Lake Heart Island master previously stayed at?" Xue Ying felt puzzled.
Lake Heart Island master.
Even though he had merely entered a dangerous place, the 'Destruction Eden', when coming to the Lake Heart Island this time, that was merely a garrison ground for a subordinate legion! It could not be considered as a true important ground within Lake Heart Island. Yet this single dangerous place made Xue Ying understand that 'Lake Heart Island master' was extremely amazing.
The cavern dwelling which he had previously stayed at? Just thinking of it and he understood it must be extraordinary.
"Mn."
Paragon Huo Cheng nodded, "Lake Heart Island master should want to leave some presents and gifts for the living beings in the future cosmos epochs! I discovered the records of the cavern dwelling which the Lake Heart Island master lived at, and it should be one of the presents left behind deliberately by the Lake Heart Island master."
"It's a pity that this level of cavern dwelling which might have been casually left behind is also filled with dangers. Without enough power, one would not be able to obtain the gifts given by Lake Heart Island master." Paragon Huo Cheng said, "Brother Dong Bo, your combat power is still too weak and it isn't appropriate for you to participate in it."
"I understand." Xue Ying nodded.
He was just a stage three World Deity. Even if his current combat power had rose, he was still not an opponent of Nine Yang Palace Head and the others, much less some ancient paragons and rulers like his teacher, 'Bloodshed God Emperor'.
"I've already informed my teacher about this matter, and informed Bloodshed God Emperor about it too." Paragon Huo Cheng chuckled, "This time, the scouting of the Lake Heart Island master ancient cavern dwelling will be led by both my teacher and Bloodshed God Emperor. Originally, I only wanted to let my teacher conduct this operation, but now, it is an operation of two huge sects, and everything is because of you, Brother Dong bo!"
Xue Ying was stunned.
"Xue Ying." A voice suddenly resounded in the mind of Xue Ying.
"Teacher." Xue Ying immediately recognized the voice. It was his teacher, Bloodshed God Emperor. He could even feel that in a faraway place… his teacher Bloodshed God Emperor was currently looking at him!
"Come with Huo Cheng together to my God Palace to meet me." Bloodshed God Emperor transmitted over.
"Right." Xue Ying replied.
"Not bad, brat, you are quite amazing to be able to help your teacher even." Another voice resounded in the mind of Xue Ying too. It was that black bird.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 558 - Primal Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 558: Primal Master
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
After Monarch Mo Xue had reunited with his daughter, he was not in a hurry to reincarnate. Even though his true deity heart was close to crumbling apart, with his realm, he could still delay for one million years easily. He still wanted to arrange for matters properly before reincarnating.
"Follow me." Xue Ying brought along Paragon Huo Cheng, Jing Qiu and Monarch Mo Xue through the inner caverns of Lake Heart Island.
After flying for close to half an hour, they finally arrived at an enormous mountain belly cavern. Xue Ying had waved his hand, bringing Jing Qiu and the others into his own inner world temporarily.
"I request for Lake Heart Island to send me out." Xue Ying announced with a bright voice.
At that moment, a power descended.
Hua.
Xue Ying was instantly swept along a tunnel formed by an unseen law before being thrown out.
Being a soldier of the Destruction Legion, when fighting in a war, he would naturally not have to go through that lake water layer which was far away! Even the Destruction Eden had some methods of sending one directly out. Even within the Lake Heart Island, there were many places of teleportation.
"We are out."
Xue Ying saw the vast starry sky. Turning around, he saw that enormous silvery-white water sphere behind him.
That enormous silvery-white water sphere was Lake Heart Island! That time when he had traveled through the lake water layer to arrive at the island, he had spent a total of 11 years. Yet leaving the place took a moment.
Sou sou sou.
Jing Qiu, Monarch Mo Xue and Paragon Huo Cheng all looked around them.
"We are out so fast?" Paragon Huo Cheng looked around him with shock, "Even me will spend a lot of time trying to escape the lake water layer. Dong Bo, being a person of the Lake Heart Island, leaving and entering has become much easier."
"We are just teleported out like this?" Monarch Mo Xue had said, "It seems that the inner section of Lake Heart Island is still operating."
"Mn, the Cosmos Apocalypse could not destroy Lake Heart Island at all. Thus, Lake Heart Island is still operating inwardly." Xue Ying nodded. Previously, he had talked with the commander, and learned of this. The inner parts of the Lake Heart Island was still processing, and it was it that allowed them, the living beings from future cosmos epoch, to adventure within. If it had forbidden others, even Bloodshed God Emperor could not enter the island.
"Are we directly going to the Bloodshed God Palace now?" Xue Ying asked.
"No rush. My teacher is arriving soon." Paragon Huo Cheng said.
Xue Ying was astonished.
Big Brother Huo Cheng's teacher was the very first ruler of the Deity world and Abyss.
One could see the void being torn apart by the side. An old man adorned in simple robe came walking out. There did not seem to be any pressure being emitted from him, as if he was just an old farmer working hard amidst the farmland with an amiable aura. His eyes seemed even more ordinary. But this seemingly ordinary old man had caused all sorts of laws to lose effect the moment it touched him. His speed might seem slow but a single step he took let him reached Xue Ying and the others.
Monarch Mo Xue was startled and excited at the same time. Jing Qiu was instead puzzled as she did not know who the teacher of Paragon Huo Cheng was! And Monarch Mo Xue had lived for a long time, so he knew of some secrets.
"Teacher." Paragon Huo Cheng shouted.
"Greetings, Senior Primal." Xue Ying suppressed his excitement. He greeted politely.
Monarch Mo Xue and Jing Qiu both hurriedly greeted too, "Greetings, Senior Primal."
"Dong Bo, it's all because of you that Huo Cheng is able to get out from the Destruction Eden. If you are free, you can come and have a walk in my primal world." Primal MAster said.
Xue Ying acknowledged hurriedly.
Primal…
He heard his Big Brother Huo Cheng introducing once that he was the earliest to become a True God Ruler. Even though he might seem amiable, deep in his bone, he was actually the most proud and aloof within the entire Deity world and Abyss! Usually, he would be too lazy to even care about other powerful existences. He would not even participate any of the gatherings like the Myriad Flower Feast. In the earliest period, he had once been called the 'Primal Daoist', precisely because he had been the first to open his own dao.
Thereafter, he created the Primal world, leaving within it for a long period of time and thus, was called the 'Primal Master'.
But regardless what, this was an existence with a combat power that was so deep others could not comprehend! Even Bloodshed God Emperor and Temporal Island Lord were on the same level.
"Who is he?" Jing Qiu might be polite and respectful from the side, but she felt puzzled in her heart.
Monarch Mo Xue had hurriedly informed his own daughter. Even though Primal Master could have known what they had transmitted, people at his level disdained from acting such.
"What? An existence on the same level as Bloodshed God Emperor and Temporal Island Lord?" Jing Qiu was startled. She had only been a stage three World Deity in her previous life, so her knowledge and understanding of the Deity world and Abyss was lacking.
"See how you create trouble." Primal Master looked at Paragon Huo Cheng, shaking his head as he said, "That time, your avatar has fallen in the Lake Heart Island yet you still dared to send your true body to save your friend. Your true body has died, and you are trapped in the Lake Heart Island. Fortunately, there's little friend Dong Bo who came to save you, else you might just be trapped until the Cosmos Apocalypse."
Paragon Huo Cheng accompanied that with a laugh and nod.
"This is your true god weapon." Primal Master casually threw, causing an enormous great axe that was emitting endless blaze over. That time when his true body died, Primal Master had personally gone to take back this true god weapon belonging to his disciple.
"My fortune is good to meet my brother, Dong Bo." Paragon Huo Cheng snickered.
"An avatar of yours is still trapped in the Destruction Eden and could not even die, leaving behind this avatar for acting outside. In the future, you should not be so careless." Primal Master reprimanded.
"Nothing big, just losing an avatar and I can still let Brother Dong Bo pick up my other avatar from the Destruction Eden." Paragon Huo Cheng looked towards Xue Ying, "Brother Dong Bo, by then, I'll have to trouble you. Hope you will not reject me."
"Definitely not." Xue Ying replied.
Primal Master lightly nodded, "Let's go to the Bloodshed God Palace then."
Saying which, he was still quite pitable.
He might be the first ruler in the Deity world and Abyss, yet he only had a single paragon under him, 'Paragon Huo Cheng'. Naturally, it was because he was too proud and aloof, and was not willing to accept any subordinates.
…
Hu.
Primal Master brought along Xue Ying and the others, forming a blurred tunnel around them. IT did not take a breath of time before they came walking out from this blurred distorted tunnel. In the distant, it was the Bloodshed God Palace land floating amidst the starry sky.
"Dong Bo, you and Huo Cheng should come with me to see Bloodshed." Primal Master indifferently said.
"Yes."
Xue Ying hurriedly replied. At the same time, he asked his wife and father-in-law, "Jing Qiu, you should bring father-in-law to the Crimson Stone Courtyard first." They had discussed this before. After all, the true god weapon was too important, and it was enough to make other stage four World Deities and powerful existences to act without regard of any consequences. Thus, it was still safest within the Bloodshed God Palace.
Over here, she could safely comprehend the true god weapon without being afraid of anyone daring to come and snatch it.
Sou sou.
Jing Qiu and Monarch Mo Xue immediately flew over before descending on a piece of land.
And Primal Master had brought along Xue Ying and Paragon Huo Cheng, arcing through the sky before directly landing in the core ground of Bloodshed God Palace.
…
"This is?" Xue Ying was startled as he looked at the scene ahead of him.
An ancient wooden house. Outside the wooden house, Bloodshed God Emperor garbed in a long crimson robe stood there waiting for the guests. There was also a black bird situated on his shoulder.
Hu.
The old man who adorned a simple-looking robe, 'Primal Master', had followed along the wooden door of this little courtyard before entering. Xue Ying and Paragon Huo Cheng followed closely behind.
"Xue Ying, come over to my side." Bloodshed God Emperor ordered.
"Yes, teacher." Xue Ying hurriedly go over, standing by the side of his teacher.
Bloodshed God Emperor looked at Xue Ying. on his face, he did not conceal a look of satisfaction, "For you to join the Destruction Legion of the Lake Heart Island as a stage three World Deity, not bad. You have cultivated for a short period of time too. Yet you are too daring to barge into Lake Heart Island with just this combat power. When fighting with a power that far surpassed your own limits, it isn't training but is sending yourself to your death."
Xue Ying did not dare to retort.
"Little Friend Dong Bo is not bad indeed. It's because of him that Huo Cheng is saved out." Primal Master said too.
Bloodshed God Emperor looked over.
The two peak existences in the Deity world and Abyss.
One was the oldest and first person to become a Ruler.
The other was the current seemingly strongest expert.
"Shall we go to the ancient cavern dwelling to have a look?" Bloodshed God Emperor had an intent of smile by the edge of his lips. He had indeed obtained a huge benefit this time.
Primal Master lightly snorted, "You have to thank this disciple of yours."
"That you don't have to worry." Bloodshed God Emperor's smile became even clearer now.
*

chapters.title: Chapter 559 - Six People
chapters.content:
Chapter 559: Six People
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying stood by the side obediently. Paragon Huo Cheng had stood by the side of Primal Master.
And Bloodshed God Emperor and Primal Master were both seated as they talked about the matter regarding how they should enter the ancient cavern dwelling.
"Your Majesty God Emperor, teacher, this is the detailed records regarding the ancient cavern dwelling." Paragon Huo Cheng had also brought out a grayish drawing. On it, there written the details regarding the ancient cavern dwelling.
Bloodshed God Emperor and Primal Master both had a look.
"Indeed, he is the strongest legendary expert across many of our cosmos epochs." Bloodshed God Emperor praised, "We could pry into his techniques just from an ancient cavern dwelling could. It's a pity that we are born too late and could not meet this existence."
"Mn, he is indeed profound and unfathomable." The proud and aloof Primal Master was filled with admiration too.
Xue Ying felt bewildered as he listened.
There were several terrifying existences which emerged in the previous few epochs in this cosmos which he was totally oblivious of. If not for visiting the Lake Heart Island this time, he himself might not even understand what the so-called 'cosmos epoch' meant. And his teacher dared say that Lake Heart Island master was actually the strongest expert in this cosmos throughout the many epochs. Daring to say this meant he was absolutely confident of his understanding towards the history. It seemed that the secrets which his teacher and Primal Master understood were much more than he knew.
Those standing at the apex of this cosmos epoch actually had a scope of knowledge a thousand or ten thousand times more than he had.
"According to the record, we can visit six places." Bloodshed God Emperor looked towards Primal MAster.
"Let's take half each." Primal Master said.
Bloodshed God Emperor lightly nodded, "Alright. You'll take three places over there and I'll take three positions over here. Actually, Primal, you do not have many subordinates either. Why not let me have this quota?"
This drawing had been left behind by the Lake Heart Island master.
Six positions meant he could have six people entering! Having one more might actually introduced many variables.
"I and Huo Cheng, and also Violet gown." Primal Master said.
"Violet Gown?" Bloodshed God Emperor was startled.
Paragon Huo Cheng was shocked too because not long ago, Violet Gown Hex Emperor had even wanted to obtain a true god weapon from Xue Ying.
"He is from the Myriad God Palace right?" Bloodshed God Emperor asked back.
"I do not really care about any territorial superpowers. Whether he is from the Myriad God Palace or not, it doesn't affect if I bring him to the ancient cavern dwelling or not right?" Primal Master did not care about this. He acted alone, and even that 'Myriad God Palace Head' from the Myriad God Palace was someone he did not even care. Actually, in the entire Deity world, there was only one person whom this Primal Master actually paid great importance to-Bloodshed God Emperor!
As for the Myriad God Palace Head? From how he see, he was too foolish!
Temporal Island Lord? In front of him, he could only hide!
Empress Qian He? She had to retreat in front of him!
This stemmed from a confidence as being the most ancient Ruler in the Deity world and Abyss! But still, he paid importance on Bloodshed God Emperor because he recognized him as someone who was qualified to fight against him equally.
Bloodshed God Emperor… was also known as the number one fighter in the entire Deity world!
Furthermore, Bloodshed God Emperor was similarly called the 'number one assassin in the entire Deity world and Abyss'!
That's right, a Ruler was actually a terrifying assassin. He was also the number one fighter! Thus, that was why other Rulers had to respect him for his power.
"I once incarnated a body to travel upon the material realm, and at that time, I met this brat Violet Gown. That time, I once taught him casually." Primal Master chuckled, "And thereafter when he entered the Deity world, I have always been paying close attention to his growth. Unknowingly, he has accumulated to a rich extent, and could open his own dao path anytime! Opening his own dao is extremely important. Letting him enter the Ancient Cavern Dwelling to broaden his perspective of some marks left behind by the strongest expert acoss many epochs should be of a great help to him."
"Prepared to take him as disciple?" Bloodshed God Emperor asked.
Primal Master chuckled, "It depends on whether this brat Violet Gown is willing or not."
"It isn't easy for you to accept a disciple. Observing him for so long, he is about to open his own dao path, only then did you decide to accept him." Bloodshed God Emperor said, "Just you, the Primal Master, personally acting is an opportunity that Violet Gown could beg for in his dreams. Taking you as his teacher is certain so I'll have to congratulate you in advance."
"Your disciple is also very formidable." Primal Master was quite delighted, but he still asked, "Bloodshed, who are you prepared to bring in?"
"I should be bringing Bamboo Mountain and Gu Zang." Bloodshed God Emperor said, "Gu Zang has entered a bottleneck, and this visit should help him. Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master has great potential, but it's a pity that he is unable to transcend beyond stage four World Deity. He ultimately remains reliant on me, so I'll naturally help him."
Primal MAster nodded.
This was one of the reasons why he appreciated Bloodshed God Emperor. The three big giants of the Deity world, Temporal Island Lord, Bloodshed God Emperor and the Myriad God Palace Head… from how he see, only Bloodshed God Emperor was someone who focused more on affection.
…
After the two Rulers finished discussing, setting down the dates of acting, they bade farewell.
"Brother Dong Bo, if you have any matters, just transmit a message over. Even if it is dangerous, I'll definitely rush over." Paragon Huo Cheng said before leaving.
"Hmph, we are about to go to the Ancient Cavern Dwelling. After entering, you still think you can leave anytime you want?" Primal MAster frowned. This disciple of his was good at many aspects, just that his personality was too straight. Previously, because of his good friend, he had gotten an avatar trapped in the Lake Heart Island already yet he still did not care about the dangers and acted. That's how he ended up in that state.
"Ah, I'll be entering the Ancient Cavern Dwelling soon. It's nothing much. I think I will get out of it soon enough anyway." Paragon Huo Cheng said.
"Let's go." Primal Master was too lazy to argue with this disciple of his.
Sou.
His power directly swept along Paragon Huo Cheng, disappearing within the region of Bloodshed God Palace.
Within this wooden courtyard, there were only Bloodshed God Emperor and Xue Ying left behind. Naturally, there was also the black bird on the shoulder of the God Emperor.
"Xue Ying." Bloodshed God Emperor turned towards Xue Ying.
"Teacher." Xue Ying respectfully replied.
"This time, it is also because of you that Huo Cheng has sent this gift right over to me." Bloodshed God Emperor said, "Your Senior Disciple Brother Gu Zang and Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master both owe your a favor too, and they will naturally return this favor in the future. Actually, I truly wanted to bring you over, but firstly, you aren't even a stage four World Deity, so it isn't of a great help to you. Secondly, your combat power is still too weak, and it is truly too dangerous within. If you were to follow me all the time without experiencing the danger yourself, then it is the same as not going."
"Disciple understands." Xue Ying politely replied.
Within the Deity world and Abyss, he could be said to be an expert already, and was comparable with those ordinary true gods who transcended.
But going together with his teacher, Primal Master, Paragon Huo Cheng and Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, his combat power was still too weak. This time, there were six people who were moving… and the weakest was his senior disciple brother 'Gu Zang' and Violet Gown Hex Emperor, and both of them were close to that of the Paragon realm. They could survive even when facing the weaker new Paragons.
"Wait until I come out from the Ancient Cavern Dwelling, I'll definitely select some rewards which are beneficial to you. I, being the teacher, will definitely not take advantage of you." Bloodshed God Emperor said.
Xue Ying grinned.
"Don't be so excited." Bloodshed God Emperor's expression had slightly became serious, "Previously, I've given you the position of being a supervisor envoy, yet you actually ran all the way to the Lake Heart Island. It seems like you are too carefree when taking up this position."
Xue Ying could not help but be embarrassed, "Disciple understands."
"Since you are so carefree, and your combat power has increased greatly, then I'll give you a more important position." Bloodshed God Emperor declared.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 560 - Tavern Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 560: Tavern Master
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying was also listening carefully.
Bloodshed God Emperor looked at him, "You should know that my sect can be divided into two sections. One belongs to the Bloodshed God Palace territory, and the other belongs to the Bloodshed Tavern."
Xue Ying nodded.
That's right.
Bloodshed God Palace territory had occupied one third of the entire Deity world, and was separated into a total of 19 prefectures. Furthermore, there were many legions stationed within. The legions were also a method which the Bloodshed God Palace used to control this territory. According to their statuses, there were 15 ranks divided accordingly. Xue Ying previously was merely a supervisor envoy within the 'Eastern Region' of Calm Sea Prefecture with a rank three official position.
And the Bloodshed Tavern had been an organization of assassins that could be found across the Deity world, Abyss and the material realm! The statuses of the assassins were given according to the combat power of the assassins themselves before eventually, their ranks were given and divided similarly into fifteen ranks.
At the most fundamental level, the assassins were given the 'Attendant Rank'. These ranks were given to those lower than rank nine and were mostly peak Deity experts.
The principal rankings were of the the 'Manager Rank', separated respectively into the 'Black Edge Manager', 'Shadow Edge Manager' and 'Bloodshed Manager'. These were rankings usually equivalent from the ninth to the second ranks!
There was one higher than these!
That of the rank one position-Bloodshed Tavern Master rank!
Every Bloodshed Tavern Master would be someone managing countless assassins within a certain location, and those who could be given this rank would at the lowest have a combat power comparable to a powerful existence!
Beyond them… was the Bloodshed Tavern Chief Tavern MAster, and also the strongest assassin in the entire Deity world and Abyss-Bloodshed God Emperor!
"I do not have many powerful existences under my control, and those who were willing to become assassins are even fewer. And my Bloodshed Tavern is found all over the Deity world and Abyss, yet I have too few subordinates. Thus, you should become a Bloodshed Tavern Master and become responsible for a territory then." Bloodshed God Emperor looked at Xue Ying, "Being the highest manager of a territory, however you want to manage the location and however you want to arrange is all up to you. The details will be told to you later by someone else."
"Bloodshed Tavern Master?" Xue Ying was speechless.
It was a byword for terror in the Deity world and the Abyss since all of them were ultimate assassins! Above them were the highest commander of the Bloodshed Tavern-Bloodshed God Emperor.
"Not willing?" Bloodshed God Emperor asked.
"The assassination mission… unless forces me to kill someone?" Xue Ying asked. He felt some resistance in his heart.
"Haha." Bloodshed God Emperor laughed out loud, "You are truly a foolish brat. There are so few Bloodshed Tavern Master in the entire Deity world and Abyss. Any one of them manages an entire territory, and I am not that bored to get involved with your management. However you manage is up to you! Even if you let half of the assassins under you die, I'll not interfere with you."
"Even if you aren't willing to take the mission, I'll not care about that."
"Killing many, making the world chaotic or peaceful… I do not really care. Only the consequences matter the most." Bloodshed God Emperor explained.
"The consequences?" Xue Ying was puzzled. What consequences were they?
"After you accept the position, you'll understand." Bloodshed God Emperor said, "Are you accepting this position or not?"
"Since I am not forced to accept the mission, I believe teacher will not defraud me too so I'll accept it." Xue Ying did not hesitate.
Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled, "You are still too tender and do not have much experience. I'll first let you manage all the Bloodshed Taverns within the Calm Sea Prefecture, Cavern Crane Prefecture and Nine Rigid Prefecture because these are within my territory, so it'll be easier to manage. When you become a stage four World Deity and your combat power has increased, I'll increase the region which you manage."
"Yes." Xue Ying acknowleged.
The three prefectures might seem big, however, Bloodshed God Emperor's Bloodshed Tavern could be found throughout the Deity world, Abyss and material realm. The material realm need not be said as powerful existences did not have to manage them, but Deity world and Abyss would require ultra strong experts to manage! There were not many powerful existences who were willing to become assassins, and so, there were indeed few subordinates the Bloodshed God Emperor had. Managing a region of three prefectures… was already very light.
"This is the command token. This is the uniform." Bloodshed God Emperor waved his hand, causing a red robe to appear. The robe had a command token placed on it. The command token was emitting a terrifying power, and one could vaguely feel the aura of the Bloodshed God Emperor from it. It could not be fake.
"This robe has been personally refined by me. It contains many effects which you will know after refining and wearing it. After all, being an assassin, you will have to have an appropriate robe." Bloodshed God Emperor said, "Having the command token, you can proceed to any Bloodshed Tavern and they could use it to identify your identity."
"Understood." Xue Ying received this command token and the unique robe which only the Bloodshed Tavern Master could wear.
"Teacher." Xue Ying respectfully asked, "After becoming the Bloodshed Tavern Master, I wonder if it is possible for me to enter the Dark AbysS?"
Bloodshed God Emperor frowned, "You want to enter the Dark Abyss?"
"Yes." Xue Ying nodded, "There is a life and death brother of mine from my hometown. He is currently suffering from torture day and night. Previously, my combat power isn't enough and I could only endure. Now that I feel that my combat power is strong enough, and that I have the identity as a Bloodshed Tavern Master, I might be able to enter the Dark Abyss."
"Do you know about the unique point of the Dark Abyss?" Bloodshed God Emperor frowned.
"Disciple understands!" Xue Ying replied.
The laws of the material realm was there to protect all living beings within.
Similarly, the laws of the Dark Abyss were made of darkness, destruction and slaughter. It was a fusion of all darkness and chaos, and the entire will of the Dark Abyss… led all living beings within the Dark Abyss to fight against any outsiders! The more they killed, the more the will of Dark Abyss would reward the locals. It would pamper them even more.
And if an outsiders entered the Dark Abyss, it was akin to fresh blood landing amidst a group of shark-it would induce frenzy!
After killing the outsider, one would gain an extremely high reward from the will of the Dark Abyss! It would allow their true deity heart to be washed clean closer towards the darkness. It would allow their demonic body to become stronger and more powerful, and allow them to have an easier time to transcend!
Thus-
Even powerful existences would usually meet with the powerful existences from Dark Abyss at the Deity world. Rarely would they meet within the Dark Abyss.
Because the moment they entered the Dark Abyss, the Dark Abyss will would consider them as 'prey', and it would induce countless Dark Abyss experts to come and surround him!
"Disciple only have to isolate all sorts of probing method to prevent the will of Dark Abyss from discovering my identity. It should still be fine." Xue Ying said, "And my combat relies more on my own physical strength. Without using the World Deity energy, I should not be revealed."
Just like how Crimson Rock Mountain isolated all scouting, the laws of material realm would have to attain his own agreement, only then could it scout the inner area.
Otherwise, it could not scout within.
It was the same logic.
As long as he did not reveal his 'World Deity energy', and not reveal his identity, the laws of Dark Abyss would not be able to identify his origin. As long as it was not confirmed, he would not be considered a 'prey'!
"The moment your identity is revealed, you will be in great trouble." Bloodshed God Emperor said, "Alright, I've given you the Bloodshed Tavern Master robe and it should be able to hide your traces, and contain several effects. The laws of material realm… hmp hmph, is after all not a true lifeform. It is merely just a very simple will. As long as you are careful, you should be able to evade its eyes. But the moment you are revealed, you can only depend on yourself."
"Disciple understands." Xue Ying respectfully replied.
He understood what the God Emperor meant. He himself was the one who suggested this, and any consequences would be taken up by himself!
"You can directly receive a Bloodshed Tavern mission located in the Dark Abyss before entering it." Bloodshed God Emperor said.
"Yes." Xue Ying answered.
"When are you prepared to enter?" Bloodshed God Emperor asked.
"The sooner the better." Xue Ying answered.
"Then I'll immediately arrange for someone to contact you and inform you your responsibilities." Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled, "This time, your trip to the Dark Abyss is filled with enemies all around! Even those members of the taverns which I've set up within the Dark Abyss are lifeforms from the Dark Abyss too. You have to be careful all around, and never reveal your identity. This could be an appropriate training for you, so better not die within."
"Be a little more wary. The Dark Abyss is different from the Deity world. That place is filled with savageness and terror. Those Dark Abyss powerful existences have practically been killing from the moment they are given birth. And in their bones, they are all lunatic." The black bird said.
"Alright, don't frighten him anymore. You should go and accompany your wife first." Bloodshed God Emperor ordered.
"Disciple will withdraw now." Xue Ying politely bowed.
Big Brother Eternal Wind had been trapped for far too long.
His current combat power had increased and he could no longer wait anymore. It had already been a few tens of thousands of years since Big Brother Eternal Wind had been captured into the Dark Abyss. As for waiting until he became a stage four World Deity? That would likely not be certain even if 100,000 years passed! By then, Big Brother Eternal Wind might not be able to withstand anymore.
"Dark Abyss." Xue Ying's eyes were filled with a sharpness. He had the ultimate survival capabilities after training in the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body", and that was the reliance he had for daring to enter the Dark Abyss.

chapters.title: Chapter 561 - Preparation
chapters.content:
Chapter 561: Preparation
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
After Xue Ying withdrew, he headed towards the Crimson Stone Courtyard.
"Senior Disciple Brother."
"Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo."
The inner disciples and honorary disciples under the God Emperor within the Crimson Stone Courtyard had to politely greet Xue Ying when they see him. At this current generation, underneath the powerful existences… Xue Ying was the only personal disciple of the God Emperor, and also the Eldest Disciple Brother of all of them. Furthermore, the news that Xue Ying had a combat power of a stage four World Deity had long been publicized, and all of them accepted it wholeheartedly.
What they did not know though was that after Xue Ying experienced an encounter within the Lake Heart Island, cultivating the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" and "Luminous Sun" fourth boundary successfully, he had a combat power comparable to that of a powerful existence already.
Just as he walked past the bent of a corridor, he saw a black metallic man walking towards him. Xue Ying determined with a glance that this was not an ordinary living being, and should be a battle puppet, and the aura it was emitting should have reached that of a stage four World Deity.
"Your Highness Dong Bo." the black metallic man walked over, saying politely, "Under His Majesty's orders, I am here to pass over several matters to you."
"So fast?" Xue Ying was startled as he looked at this black metallic man.
"This is the communication treasure." The black metallic man passed over a blood-colored ring.
During that juncture Xue Ying recei ed it, he had refined the ring by sending his World Deity energy into it. Immediately, he discovered many functions within this ring. Via this ring, he could actually control all the Bloodshed Taverns which he was responsible for within the three prefectures! Giving out missions, sending down orders, dispatching manpower… everything could be done via this communication ring.
"If your highness loses this ring, you can directly transmit a message to me and I'll help Your Highness send the order down." The black metallic man respectfully said.
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
Just like the Temporal God Palace, it was the treasure spirit that handled matters! Over at the Bloodshed Tavern, those beings who handled the miscellaneous tasks were not true living beings too. They were much more loyal and would never be fatigued.
"My teacher has once said that he did not care about how I manage things. He only cared about the final result." Xue Ying said.
"Indeed, the final result."
The black metallic man respectfully replied, "His Majesty only cares about the final result which consists of two things. First, any guest, as long as he is able to pay the appropriate price, then our Bloodshed Tavern will have to do our utmost in completing it. If it exceeds the combat power of Your Highness, you can send the mission upwards to His Majesty. The other is that every 100 million years, the subordinates under Your Highness must achieve at least a total of 300 billion 'contribution points'!"
"Oh?" Xue Ying nodded.
As long as one paid the price, the mission must be completed. This wasn't tough. If the weaker assassins could not achieve it, then it would merely be sending a strong assassin to act.
As for achieving at least '300 billion' contribution points, this was much harder.
One had to know that the difficulty of the mission would be determined by a system under the Bloodshed Tavern. Every single mission would reward a certain contribution point within the limits!
"The first point is easy." The black metallic man said, "The second point isn't that hard either. Within the period of 100 million years, if the subordinates under Your Highness aren't able to complete enough missions, then Your Highness can issue the appropriate missions yourself! But Your Highness will have to be careful for issuing missions is also forming karma."
"I understand." xue Ying nodded.
Karma?
Assassins were not willing to shoulder the karma. Karma would be generated in between the issuer and the target!
If Xue Ying personally issued a mission, he would have to complete the matter cleanly, killing all enemies and to reduce any sort of influence from karma. Actually, when transcending to become a powerful existence… having a few karma would not induce a huge impact since walking in the mortal realms, one would kill and fight so how could one be clean of karma? It's just that matters like rampantly spreading a religion to make other living beings worship you! That would be forming karma with countless living beings, and with karma formed in between billions and billions of living beings, that would be a huge trouble!
When cultivators acted, they would either reduce any influence on karma and to act with a clear conscience!
The heart of cultivation was very important! As long as one had doubts on oneself, becoming hesitant, then how could he transcend still?
"Why did teacher set down these two conditions to be met?" Xue Ying felt puzzled inwardly.
"He is already standing at the apex of the Deity world and Abyss, why would he still have to form an organization of assassins, and that he would complete the task as long as the price is right?" Xue Ying felt really bewildered, "The other point feels even weirder. Why must teacher ensure the Bloodshed Tavern have enough missions?"
It seemed that his teacher wished for missions.
But what help would this be to his teacher?
"Also, teacher, Temporal Island Lord and Myriad God Palace Head are all very willing to act as a witness for pledges taken by others." Xue Ying thought. Experts would usually not like to be restricted under oaths. But during crucial moments, they would still pledge on oaths. Oaths would usually be personally witnessed by the Bloodshed God Emperor, the Temporal Island Lord and other experts.
The moment one decided to go against the oath, the Bloodshed God Emperor and others could kill the recipient with a thought.
"Killing those people who violated the oaths… they should be killing many people every single day right?" Xue Ying had a vague feeling, "If it is just a single person doing it, then it should be because he liked it. But for teacher, the Temporal Island Lord and others to all act as such, there should be some purpose."
"And for this Bloodshed Tavern to accomplish so many missions, setting off so many slaughters…"
Xue Ying felt that there should be some deeper secrets behind this. His current realm was still too low. His teacher and the others were all Rulers, and there should be some motives behind this.
…
After pondering over it for a moment at the corridor, Xue Ying soon returned to his own cavern dwelling.
"Xue Ying." Jing Qiu and Monarch Mo Xue were both currently chatting and drinking tea within the courtyard. Seeing Xue Ying entering, both of them stood up to welcome him.
"Jing Qiu, Sir Father-in-law." Xue Ying greeted.
"Hahaha, Xue Ying, this time, it has all been due to you that I can still be here enjoying a cup of tea with my daughter." Monarch Mo Xue laughed.
"It should be so." Xue Ying replied. Thereafter, he turned to Jing Qiu, "Jing Qiu, I am prepared to enter the Dark Abyss."
"Dark Abyss"? Jing Qiu and Monarch Mo Xue were both startled. Jing Qiu had even spoken with anxiety, "So fast? Is it because of Big Brother Eternal Wind?"
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
Jing Qiu felt kind of worried, "Isn't this too rushed? How about waiting until you are a stage four World Deity and for your combat power to become stronger before going?"
There were enemies everywhere within the Dark Abyss.
Xue Ying shook his head, "I am afraid Big Brother Eternal Wind will not be able to hold on if I waited for too long. Furthermore, my combat power has increased greatly this time after the Lake Heart Island encounter, and I am still quite confident. Worse come to worse, I'll just lose an avatar."
"I'll come with you." Jing Qiu added.
"No need." Xue Ying chuckled, "I have a method to camouflage myself. Bringing you along might not be a good idea."
"Daughter, you shouldn't go. Your current combat power could not match up with Xue Ying's. IF you go, you might affect him. The Dark Abyss isn't similar to other places, and one could not be too careless." Monarch Mo Xue said.
As he accompanied his wife and father-in-law, Xue Ying arranged for some other miscellaneous tasks to be done. His wife Jing Qiu naturally stayed within the cavern dwelling to comprehend and refine that true god divine sword. Monarch Mo Xue was instead forming an avatar. His true body would stay here, cultivating while seeking that last hope of transcending. The other avatar would go meet his children and juniors.
And prior to Xue Ying leaving for the Dark Abyss, he had also obtained several messages from a few powerful existences.
Primarily, they were powerful existences from the territory of Bloodshed God Palace or those who could match up with the might of powerful existences.
"Old Brother Dong Bo, who would have thought that you will reach our level so soon, and has taken up the position as the Bloodshed Tavern Master. Hahaha, if you need any help in the future, just say."
"Brother Dong Bo is indeed formidable. Being a stage three World Deity yet you could take up the position as a Bloodshed Tavern Master. I've heard that you fought with Dried Tree Old Mother, and she was on the losing end?"
"Dong Bo…"
The many Bloodshed Tavern Masters were considered a sect of their own.
The moment a new Bloodshed Tavern Master appeared, they would all be aware of it. Naturally, they would send messages to congratulate him. This was done via the internal communication system of the Bloodshed Tavern.
There were even two existences transmitting messages to Xue Ying specially. Because they did not have his communication imprint, they had borrowed on karma to communicate. These two were Monarch Gu Zang and Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master.
"Junior Disciple Brother Dong Bo, for I to have this opportunity is all because of junior disciple brother. As the senior disciple brother, I'll certainly remember this favor." Monarch Gu Zang was extremely low-key, and he had merely spoken a few words through karma.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master was even more blunt, "I am able to visit the ancient cavern dwelling the Lake Heart Island master left behind solely because of Dong Bo. This favor is something I'll never forget. IF you need any help in the future, just say. Even if it is a life and death danger, I, Bamboo Mountain, will not hesitate."
The outside world had publicly recognized Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master as one of the three ancestors of Bloodshed God Palace. How dazzling was it?
But deep in the heart of Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, he had a strand of anxiety precisely because he was unable to transcend!
What identity did the Lake Heart ISland master have?
He was the strongest expert throughout the many epochs of this cosmo! Within the six people who could proceed into the ancient cavern dwelling for adventure, when would it ever be his turn? If not for Xue Ying, this opportunity was something even the Bloodshed God Palace could not have. It would entirely be used by the people with relationship to that 'Primal Master'. This opportunity would usually not be taken out for exchange.
Xue Ying naturally would not put on airs, and had humbly replied the two.
…
During the third day after returning to the Bloodshed God Palace, Xue Ying had personally left the Bloodshed God Palace. He first took a trip to the Xia Clan World in the material realm before proceeding on to the Dark Abyss.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 562 - Entry
chapters.content:
Chapter 562: Entry
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Within a vast violet bamboo sea, there was a bamboo house and a violet-robed male currently enjoying wine in front of it.
"Prefecture Master, prefecture master."
Along with the shout, a stream of light arced across and landed in front of the bamboo house. It was a muscular and big powerful existence. He was none other than Forefather Vicious Tyrant.
"Vicious Tyrant? Aren't you in a closed door cultivation deep within my Violet Bamboo Sea? Why are you out?" The white fingers of that violet-robed male held a wine cup. His handsome face with a pair of long and narrow eyes swept across Forefather Vicious Tyrant.
Forefather Vicious Tyrant had instead said, "Prefecture Master, have you heard of it? Dong Bo Xue Ying that brat has fought with the stage four World Deity, 'Sovereign Ze Nuo' from the Dark Abyss at the Lake Heart Island historical remain. This is too… ai, I say Prefecture Master, why do you not have any single reaction at all?"
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master remained carefree as he drank a mouthful of wine, indifferently saying, "For the fastest cultivator in the history to become a stage three World Deity to create such a miracle isn't something huge."
Forefather Vicious Tyrant was speechless. He pursed his lips before saying, "I don't want to speak with you anymore. Prefecture Master, you have a paragon realm combat power despite being a stage four World Deity."
"I am different from him." Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master lightly shook his head.
How could they be the same?
Those who could become a paragon would usually grasp hold of an absolute art and had opened their own dao. Wanting to match a paragon wasn't something that easy.
"But Dong Bo Xue Ying is indeed not bad." Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master praised. What he praised was of Xue Ying successfully joining the Destruction Legion, saving Paragon Huo Cheng out of it. Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master could guess… that Xue Ying had certainly joined the Destruction Legion. Otherwise, there was no way of saving him! Pang Yi might be a member of the Destruction Legion too, but with the relationship between Pang Yi and Primal Master, it was impossible for him to save him.
Other than the rulers who were high above that were too disdained from entering…
Those who knew of Destruction Legion had tried taking the trials, but the majority of the true gods and even paragons had been eliminated!
Xue Ying had instead succeeded! This startled Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master a lot! Because one could always rely on absolute art and other opportunities to obtain and ultra strong combat power, but getting through the trials of the 'Destruction Legion' meant that Xue Ying's cultivation potential was very high since that was a trial which the Lake Heart Island Master personally set.
"Right, amazing." Forefather Vicious Tyrant added, "Aiya, aiya, he should originally be my disciple, what a pity."
"Your disciple?" Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master glanced at him sideways, "You shouldn't hold him back."
"What is this, hold him back?" Forefather Vicious Tyrant said unhappily.
"How long has he cultivated? His combat power is close to yours already and you still want to teach him?" Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master snickered.
Forefather Vicious Tyrant was speechless.
That's right.
Xue Ying's current combat power was already comparable to his. After all, he could cause Dried Tree Old Mother to suffer, and that wasn't something easy.
"I am prepared to enter closed-door for a period." Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master suddenly said, "Do not disturb me temporarily."
"Oh." Forefather Vicious Tyrant obediently nodded.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master looked afar. His gaze was fairly discernible.
This opportunity was very precious.
He had to grasp hold of it!
One had to know that Lake Heart Island master had deliberately left behind an ancient cavern dwelling usually for the descendents. Such opportunity… was much more beneficial than going out blindly in search for one! Lake Heart Island master would personally guide them, allowing them to walk down further in the road of cultivation. This was also one of the reasons why the two people which the Bloodshed God Emperor decided to bring along were Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master and Monarch Gu Zang.
The two of them were anxiously wanting to break through.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, this time, I owe you a huge favor." Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master revealed a grin. He would gladly owe this kind of favor for it was an opportunity for him too.
…
The matters which happened in Lake Heart Island-Xue Ying causing both Sovereign Ze Nuo and Dried Tree Old Mother to suffer and for Paragon Huo Cheng to proclaim Xue Ying as his life and death brother, helping him to force Nine Yang Palace Head and Violet Gown Hex Empress to a retreat-weren't concealed at all. After all, there were only a few who knew of this, and over time, it would circulate across the many powerful existences.
Xue Ying's reputation was also starting to become bigger. Many powerful existences who were hiding in the dark also began paying attention to Xue Ying.
This world was as such. Combat power was the most fundamental! Xue Ying's current combat power had reached a stage that many powerful existences would attach importance to him.
******
Within the material realm, Xia clan world.
The black-robed Xue Ying had just come out from the Crimson Rock Mountain, he left that flying knife true god weapon within the Crimson Rock Mountain, allowing his true body to refine it. Wanting to refine a true god weapon wasn't something easy. And this time, he going to the Dark Abyss was truly too dangerous, and he had yet to succeed in refining the true god weapon so naturally he would not bring it over.
Actually, the flying knife and that divine sword had been comprehended by both him and his wife, just that his current realm was just at stage three, and he grasped hold of only three grade one Deity Hearts. It was still appropriate for him to comprehend that flying knife which he was good at. As for the divine sword… the profound mysteries had surpassed his current understanding.
Wait until he was a stage four World Deity realm before he might possibly go and comprehend that divine sword.
"Sou."
Leaving the material realm, he entered the Deity world once again.
Thereafter, Xue Ying took the starfield flying ship, traveling towards the Dark Abyss.
The Dark Abyss had a shape of a distorted pillar, just like intestines. It was stacked by layers and layers of world together, thus, the Dark Abyss was also called 'endless abyss'. The entire Dark Abyss was pitch black as if it had swallowed everything.
"This is indeed the Dark Abyss. Just looking from afar, I could feel its aura that is filled with darkness, annihilation and the feeling of it trying to swallow everything." Xue Ying sighed inwardly. He stood at the deck of the starfield flying ship looking to the distant. For the sake of hiding his own identity, even the appearance of the starfield flying ship had transformed greatly into one entirely black in color.
Xue Ying's own appearance had been transformed too.
There was a savage mask on his face with two black spiral horns on his head. He was wearing a crimson robe, and his entire figure was emitting a terrifying dark destructive aura. This aura felt akin to those lifeforms which had been given birth and lived in the Dark Abyss.
One had to know it was very tough trying to imitate a living being's aura. But Xue Ying was able to achieve that precisely because of that robe which he got due to his identity as the 'Bloodshed Tavern Master'. That robe was able to imitate another lifeform to a huge extent! One had to know that the Bloodshed God Emperor had spent so much effort in refining only these few specially for the Tavern Masters under him.
It wasn't easy being an assassin.
"Hong~"
The starfield flying ship flew along the time-space tunnel, arriving finally at the surface of the Dark Abyss.
The Dark Abyss world was formed with layers stacked on top of one another. Thus, Xue Ying had to proceed down the many layers in order to reach his destination.
"Fortunately, the Great Demonic God 'Da Er Hao' is situated at an Abyss world relatively close to the surface." Xue Ying thought.
"Hu hu hu~"
An endless dark destruction will swept over. That will seemed very lofty as it brought along slaughter, destruction and darkness; it was akin to trying to assimilate everything together.
But Xue Ying had isolated all scouting methods within the area more than a few hundred thousand kilometers from his position, and the will of the abyss could not come close.
"This darkness destruction feeling isn't comfortable. Those demons who have been given birth and have always been living here in the Dark Abyss could eventually transcend to become true god in the end? But like what teacher and the others said before, even if they become a true god, they are still lunatics deep deep in their bones." Xue Ying thought.
**

chapters.title: Chapter 563 - Abyss World
chapters.content:
Chapter 563: Abyss World
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Dark Abyss had land and ocean too with towering trees reaching up to the sky and rivers flowing along.
It's just that there was a dark aura which would not dissipate all-year round. This aura nourished all native living beings here, allowing the natives to have a powerful body, though it caused all of them to be bloodthirsty and love to fight. These native beings were termed by those in the material realm and Deity world… as demons!
"Sou."
A demon passed through the jungle, carefully observing all directions around him. During the growth of a demon, it would be filled with slaughters. The path to becoming a Demonic God was something extremely arduous, so even the most foolish demons would have a 'cunningness' within their bones.
"That bone dragon isn't around. He should have gone patrolling. Good." This thin and small demon was on top of a huge tree looking afar. He made that judgement after observing for a long time.
At this moment-
"Hong long long~"
In the depth of the crimson sky, a huge black ship came flying from another side of the time-space tunnel. It was emitting an aura which caused space around it to condense. Its prowess had caused this thin and little demon to tremble uncontrollably. The thin and small demon could vaguely see an existence standing at the head of the ship. He was emitting a dark destruction aura.
Just a look, even though he did not get a clear one, this thin and small demon immediately lowered his head and dared not to look anymore. The terror was brewing in his heart.
Truly too frightening!
This was much more frightening by a few times as compared to the Sir Demonic God he had seen in the past! Being separated by a few tens of thousands of kilometers, a vague look had caused terror to engulf his entire self.
"Hua."
That black ship soon tore through another time-space tunnel before proceeding forward and disappearing from this layer of the Abyss World.
Only then did this thin and small demon let out a relief, "Which existence is he from? Is it some Great Demonic God?"
Towards the lower levelled demons, Great Demonic Gods were considered as someone with an extremely high status. As for the Abyss Sovereigns? Those at the level of this thin and small demons would never have the opportunity to meet one in their entire life.
…
Another level of Dark Abyss.
A vast wilderness with many undulating mountains. Currently, there were two parties fighting crazily with each other, and the shockwave from their attacks had spread across all directions. Countless trees were felled, with some frozen and shattered, and others burning in raging flames! Many demonic legions were moving forward and retreating backwards, killing others madly. Many Demonic Gods were even leading the troops as they fought at the head.
This was a huge battle which swept across a huge region!
It was a battle between two Great Demonic Gods!
Two Great Demonic Gods were also at the center of the battlefield fighting with one another madly. The Demonic Gods and demons had all avoided them and were fighting far away.
"Heh heh heh." A Great Demonic God with 16 arms stood in the void. His sneer reverberated across the entire battlefield, "One-eyed Demon, your avatar has been destroyed, and you don't even have the most important blood refined deity warrior, yet you still want to fight against me? This time, you will certainly die without being able to escape."
The other side was a towering Great Demonic God. His head was half his body big, and there was even a sinister red vertical eye on his head. He let out a growl, "You are seeking death. My children, as per my will, kill all of them!"
"Kill all of them! Kill all of them! Kill all of them!"
The subordinates of the One-eyed Great Demonic God had all turned crazy. All of them seemed to not mind death at all.
At this moment-
"Hong~"
A black flying ship came flying over from another level of the Abyss World. The moment it came flying out from the time-space tunnel, that unseen aura which it emitted alarmed the two Great Demonic God. As for the subordinates, the many Demonic Gods and Demons, they were feeling a terror stemming from their instincts.
Standing at the head of the black ship, that crimson-robed figure with two curved horns had also noticed this big-scaled war over here, causing him to sweep his gaze over.
Even though he did not deliberately emit his suppressive power…
Just a natural aura which accompanied his gaze had caused the demons to feel everything becoming dark as their consciousness turned chaotic-they fell down one by one. The Demonic Gods were trembling, and even the Great Demonic Gods were feeling extremely frightened.
One had to know that Xue Ying's cultivation heart realm had long allowed his true deity heart to be similar to ceramic glaze. He had an understanding from inside to outside, and could release a great light! If he deliberately released his willpower, the true deity hearts of these two stage one Great Demonic Gods would most likely explode and they would die. Those Demonic Gods and demons were even further off in terms of power, and a single gaze of his could kill many others.
Xue Ying had casually swept across his gaze before proceeding ahead with his starfield flying ship, crossing through this layer of Abyss World before heading towards the deeper layer of Abyss World.
Only when the black ship disappeared did the two Great Demonic Gods let out a sigh of relief.
"Unless it is some Abyss Sovereign? He could even possibly be a powerful existence from our Dark Abyss?"
"That combat power is truly too frightening. Just sweeping his gaze alone has made me not dare to even move." The two Great Demonic Gods were still trembling now.
******
Standing at the head of the deck of the starfield flying ship, Xue Ying did not care about those billions of demons. Much less them, even the Abyss Sovereigns on every single level of Abyss World were ignored by Xue Ying since the deeper down the Dark Abyss, the stronger the experts were. The Abyss Sovereigns closer to the surface were mostly stage four World Deities.
To him, they did not have any threat at all. One had to have a powerful existence combat power in order to threaten him.
What he was truly on guard against was the 'Abyss Will' which was present everywhere.
"I must never allow the Abyss Will to discover my identity. The moment it discovers my identity, then I'll be mobbed! Most likely, there will be countless terrifying experts coming to deal against me. That will be very troublesome." Xue Ying thought, "But still, being the Bloodshed Tavern Master, this robe of mine is able to disguise me to an exquisite extent, so the chances of being revealed is very low."
Sou.
He went through many levels of Abyss World.
The 12th level of Abyss World.
"Hua." The black big ship arrived at this level of the Abyss World. At the moment it arrived, Xue Ying could feel a threatening feeling.
"His combat power should be stronger than mine." Xue Ying looked afar before immediately bringing his flying ship forward, hastening the pace to travel to the next level.
At a total of a few hundred billion kilometers away from Xue Ying.
This was a piece of vast lake. The lake was dark and was always peaceful within. It did not create any sort of ripples.
Deep within the lake, an enormous living being opened his eyes. A pair of blood eyes looked through the lake water, tore through the obstacles of space before looking at that black big ship a few hundred billion kilometers away
"Bypasser?" The enormous living being looked at the black ship leaving this level of Abyss World, heading down to a lower level of Abyss World, only then did he close his eyes and go back to sleep.
…
The 23rd level of Abyss World.
This Abyss World had a beautiful scene. The weather was pleasant, and was also the most beautiful world Xue Ying had seen that seemed alike of that in the human realm. Even the clouds in the sky were few, and the sun rays were shining on this level of world. This level of world had very few ordinary demons, and very few Demonic Gods and Great Demonic Gods. All of them were very obedient, and would rarely enter big-scaled wars.
A very peaceful Abyss World.
But Xue Ying became more alert! This was also the most dangerous Abyss World he had passed through.
"The master of this level is called White Sovereign King, a paragon of the Dark Abyss who loved slaughtering." Xue Ying thought. White Sovereign King was a relatively younger paragon, though his reputation was huge. It was known that every single paragon would have his own dao path, and this White Sovereign King walked down some sort of slaughter dao path.
His battling and killing skills were extremely formidable!
At a luxurious palace hall relatively far away from Xue Ying, there were large numbers of chefs currently making all sorts of delicious meals before sending them to respectable master.
And the person eating the food was a silvery-white-armored male who was very handsome. He had a knife on each hand cutting the food with great familiarity before eating them. He was truly enjoying life.
He was none other than White Sovereign King!
He was known for his killing and slaughtering throughout the entire Dark Abyss. But during normal occasions, he was quite amiable and friendly, and he loved eating.
Suddenly, he looked afar.
Only to see the crimson robe figure standing on top of the black ship.
"This robe? It's a Tavern Master from the Bloodshed Tavern?" White Sovereign King muttered before continuing with his meal.
It was quite ordinary for some powerful existences occasionally traveling across his world. He was too lazy to care about them either.
…
After leaving this 23rd level of Abyss World, only then did Xue Ying let out a sigh of relief. This was the only existence which he would be meeting during his travel down that could easily kill him. It was very real that he would be killed with a single move.
"Soon." Xue Ying revealed a grin.
He continued traveling forward.
The 26th level of Abyss World was also the destination of his-the place where the Great Demonic God 'Da Er Hao' lived in!
**

chapters.title: Chapter 564 - Da Er Haos Cry for Help
chapters.content:
Chapter 564: Da Er Hao's Cry for Help
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The final section of Xue Ying's journey was distinctly uneventful. The Starfield Flying Ship arrived at the 26th layer world of the Dark Abyss. In truth, it was to be expected that he would not encounter any danger on his way here, seeing how powerful existences would often travel along the same path. If most people would die just trying to get through the various layers, it would be nothing short of a joke! Overall, the journey here was bound to be relatively safe… as long as he did not reveal his identity, that is!
'I've finally arrived.' Standing at the prow of his Starfield Flying Ship, Xue Ying cast his gaze far into the distance. There was a trace of expectation clearly visible in his eyes. 'Big Brother Eternal Wind, I'm here. I hope you were able to resist until now!'
'Da Er Hao!'
Xue Ying's eyes were filled with cold intent.
Back then, Da Er Hao was separated from Xia Clan world by an essentially endless distance, yet his remote schemes and plans still led to a massacre that nearly annihilated the entire Xia Clan! Xue Ying would never be able to show any compassion or leniency to him. However, he still had to put saving his Big Brother Eternal Wind and his wife first.
'Big Brother Eternal Wind's willpower is extraordinary, and he should have been able to hold on for a few tens of thousands of years with relative ease.' The closer Xue Ying got to his final destination, the more nervous he became.
…
In a grand palace hall, a Great Demonic God wearing black armor was sitting on a throne.
"Hahahaha…" Da Er Hao laughed out loud from his seated position. His face was thin and covered by scales. A pair of enormous twisted horns were protruding from his head, and his blood-colored eyes were emitting a vicious aura. "Your dance pleases me. Come, come over to my side."
Several beautiful demonesses and devils were dancing below with enchanting smiles. As soon as they heard his words, they rushed up the stairs to arrive at Da Er Hao's side, revolving around him and serving him. While these demonesses and devils were of a rather low rank, every single one was still a Demonic God.
"Master, are you comfortable?" the devils massaging him asked.
"Master, please have a taste of this wine." A couple of demonesses were moving around, giving him wine in a mouth-to-mouth exchange.
Da Er Hao was indeed enjoying himself.
In truth, most experts of the Dark Abyss behaved similarly. They slaughtered with unparalleled ruthlessness, but on most occasions, they would simply enjoy themselves. It was only sometimes that they would act like deranged, mad people.
Right now, Da Er Hao was in a great mood, and the reason for that was that he had just broken through to become a stage three World Deity.
'Going from stage two to stage three was quite difficult, but at least I would now be ranked at the very front among His Majesty subordinates,' Da Er Hao thought. 'My current territory is already much larger than before, and I have several Great Demonic Gods supporting me as underlings. I haven't cultivated for too long a time either; I should be quite young amongst the stage three Great Demonic Gods. Perhaps… there is hope in trying to reach stage four after all. By then, I could even find an Abyss World and become its sovereign!'
In his heart, Da Er Hao already began looking forward to this.
