Indeed, he was quite young, and while he might not have dared even hope at becoming a stage four World Deity beforehand, he was now already a stage three World Deity—he could at least dream of it.
'I did hear that Dong Bo Xue Ying, that kid from the Deity world, is rising very quickly.' As he thought of this, Da Er Hao could not help but feel a heavy burden press upon him. 'He was the fastest to become a stage three World Deity in the entire Deity world and Dark Abyss, and he now even has an absolute art. Unless I'm mistaken, his combat power should already be comparable to that of stage four World Deities.'
Xue Ying's reputation was so big that news of him had even spread all throughout the Dark Abyss! Once Da Er Hao heard of it, he started feeling jumpy from fright. After more thoroughly investigating the matter, he found out that the Xue Ying from the rumors had actually arrived from the Xia Clan world of the material realm! This confirmed him to be the same Xue Ying that he knew.
In response, Da Er Hao was terrified to the point that his heart was trembling! He was afraid that Xue Ying might try to find him, seeking revenge! Under the pressure of this invisible foe, he was actually fortunate enough to break through, becoming a stage three World Deity. The Abyss Sovereign of this layer had greatly rewarded him for this achievement.
"Mn?"
An enormous palm suddenly appeared inside this palace hall. Accompanied by a dark aura, it slapped directly against Da Er Hao's body.
Da Er Hao's expression immediately paled at the sight. Seeing the enormous palm exuding a dark aura approach him, he shouted in terror: "Mercy!" At the same time, he tried his best to dodge the strike. The surging aura that left his body as he tried to dodge was so powerful that the bodies of all the demonesses and devils surrounding him exploded; such was the power of a stage three World Deity. The slight shockwave caused by one of his movements could easily kill Demonic Gods.
Despite his effort, Da Er Hao only managed to cross a distance of ten or so meters before the palm hit him.
"Peng!"
Da Er Hao did not have the slightest ability to retaliate in the face of such devastating force. Within moments, his body exploded and his true deity heart was extinguished. Even his armor warped before finally breaking apart! It must be stated that, with Xue Ying's current strength, even powerful existences would not be able to maintain their bearings. Him having the combat power of a powerful existence was primarily because of his physical prowess—pure strength and speed!
…
Inside a stone dwelling, just 5,000 kilometers away from the palace hall. Here is where Da Er Hao's true body was cultivating, where he had just broken through to become a stage three World Deity.
'Not good.' Realizing that his avatar had just been exterminated in mere moments, his true body tried to flee.
"You think you can escape?" a voice reverberated with an indifferent tone. The sound of it caused Da Er Hao to freeze on the spot. He looked toward the crimson-robed man who appeared in front of the stone dwelling with apprehension. This newcomer was wearing a mask, and he had two horns spiraling out of his head, yet it was the aura he emitted that left Da Er Hao feeling frightened. When his avatar was destroyed just moments ago, he understood just how wide the gap the two of them was.
No trace of hesitation in his movements, Da Er Hao knelt down with a 'pa' sound, and began to plead for his life: "Mercy! Mercy! Please, senior, be lenient. I will act according to your every wish!"
But at the same time, he was secretly sending a message to his master, "Your Majesty, Your Majesty, a powerful existence is trying to kill me. He has already destroyed my avatar. Please save me, Your Majesty. Please!"
…
'Mn?'
Next to a river of magma, a golden-armored person who was sitting cross-legged began opening his eyes. His unbridled fury was obvious in his gaze. 'This level of the Dark Abyss is my territory! Who dares enter my realm and kill my subordinate without as much as sending me a message?'
As one of the Abyss Sovereigns, he naturally had his own pride.
Da Er Hao had already broken through to become a stage three World Deity, making him one of the sovereign's most important subordinates. After all, even an Abyss Sovereign like him had no more than a dozen or so stage three World Deities under him.
'I want to see just who dared act so rampantly.' The golden-armored man's eyes were filled with fury. In the blink of an eye, he disappeared.
…
Xue Ying watched Da Er Hao as he begged for mercy, and a rather complex feeling overcame him at the sight of this. This was, after all, the very person who built the Demonic Faction in the Xia Clan world! His shadow enveloped the entire Xia Clan world for tens of millions of years, but now, here he was, kneeling down in front of Xue Ying as he begged for mercy.
Xue Ying did not find it strange it all that Da Er Hao would plead for his life. Too many slaughters and fights were carried out within the Dark Abyss, and the weak would oftentimes be forced to serve the strong. This was by no means uncommon.
"Please, just let me live. I can become senior's servant," Da Er Hao said with a virtuous expression.
Xue Ying frowned at the sight of this Great Demonic God's expression.
"Hong."
The golden-armored figure finally appeared.
"Your Majesty!" Da Er Hao hurriedly shouted. The layer worlds of the Dark Abyss usually only spread over several hundred billion kilometers, a distance easily traversable within mere moments by any stage four World Deity.
"Hm?" Xue Ying frowned, sweeping his gaze across this golden-armored figure.
The man looked back at Xue Ying. At first, he had been prepared to give him a piece of his mind, but as soon as he laid eyes on the crimson robe Xue Ying was wearing, his expression changed. That robe meant… that the person before him was a Bloodshed Tavern Master! Only those who had accepted the position of Bloodshed Tavern Master would receive such robes from the Bloodshed God Emperor himself. Every tavern master would have the combat power of a powerful existence, at the very least!
He, a stage four World Deity, could not afford to offend any expert with the combat power of a powerful existence. On top of that, the Bloodshed Tavern Masters were all assassins, and their methods involved killing people and accomplishing missions stealthily, before the other party got any word of it!
"Ah, Tavern Master, sir! I see you have come on a mission." The golden-armored man squeezed out a smile. "I will not keep you any longer then. No, I won't disturb you." Leaving behind these words, he hurriedly turned around and, with a 'sou' sound, he disappeared.
Da Er Hao's eyes went wide as he frantically shouted out, "Your Majesty, Your Majesty!"

chapters.title: Chapter 565 - The First Mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 565: The First Mission
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Da Er Hao had just witnessed the Abyss Sovereign awkwardly leave after saying 'Tavern Master, I see you have come on a mission'. His knowledge might not be as encompassing as some of the other Great Demonic God, but he could still determine that crimson-robed man, an expert able to force His Majesty to awkwardly depart, likely has the combat power of a powerful existence. This, combined with the title of 'Tavern Master' and the mention of a 'mission', allowed Da Er Hao to fit the pieces and guess at the man's identity. 'A Tavern Master ranked assassin from the Bloodshed Tavern?'
'How could this be? Someone sent out a Tavern Master just to deal with me?' Terror gripped his heart. The Tavern Masters was second only to the Chief Tavern Master himself, who was none other than the top assassin of Deity world and Dark Abyss, the Bloodshed God Emperor himself!
'It might be unbelievable, but only someone like a Tavern Master could force His Majesty to leave like that.'
'Just who was the person who ordered a mission for my assassination, and even mobilized a Bloodshed Tavern Master in the process?' Da Er Hao felt despondent and unwilling. With how large the gap in combat power between the two was, what else could he feel but despair?
Looking at him, Xue Ying slowly began, "Da Er Hao."
"Tavern Master, Tavern Master," Da Er Hao knelt down, replying respectfully and even adding even some flattering words.
"Tens of thousands of years ago, you have captured the soul of a Transcendent called Chi Qiu Bai, am I correct?" Xue Ying continued. "You should also have the soul of his wife. Tell me, where are they now?"
The reason Xue Ying even bothered to ask was that he could not detect Eternal Wind's soul in the surrounding territory, despite having already spread his world domain to cover the whole area. As a result, he could only let Da Er Hao live a while longer.
Da Er Hao was startled. "Chi Qiu Bai?"
"Have you already forgotten?" Xue Ying coldly asked.
Da Er Hao looked at the Bloodshed Tavern Master. This crimson-robed expert had a cold demeanour as he simply stood there, with a mask covering his face and two spiral horns protruding from his forehead. He was even emitting a ruthless and dark aura of destruction. Under ordinary circumstances, nobody could imitate another living being's aura, and Da Er Hao was not aware that the robe of a Bloodshed Tavern Master could achieve this very feat.
Having arrived at a certain conclusion inwardly, Da Er Hao asked, "Tavern Master, was Dong Bo Xue Ying the one who sent you here?"
Xue Ying frowned. "I am the one asking questions here."
This person who emitted a dark aura of destruction was a powerful existence from the Dark Abyss—of this, Da Er Hao was certain! He also confirmed his identity as a Bloodshed Tavern Master. The way he saw it, the Xue Ying he knew might have high innate talent, but the news he heard only mentioned him having the power of a stage four World Deity despite being a stage three World Deity. Naturally, this level was not sufficient for Xue Ying to take up the position as a Bloodshed Tavern Master, much less to imitate another living being's aura.
Even then, he considered that with the incredible potential Xue Ying showed, in addition to his status as a personal disciple of the Bloodshed God Emperor, he would likely succeed in sending out a Bloodshed Tavern Master.
"Tavern Master, for someone of your caliber, killing me would be no more difficult than pinching a little insect to death." Da Er Hao chuckled. "The way I've heard it, Dong Bo puts a lot of emphasis on his relationships, and no matter how I think of it, he is the only enemy I've made who could afford to send out a Tavern Master! If I were to just tell you all I know, Tavern Master, you would likely just kill me with a flip of your hand afterward."
"Oh?" Xue Ying let out a low growl accompanied by clear killing intent.
"Hehehe, don't try to scare me, Tavern Master." Da Er Hao took the initiative to stand up. "If you wish to kill me, you can go ahead and do so, but if you want to find out Chi Qiu Bai's location, you must first pledge an oath with the Will of the Abyss itself as a witness!"
The Will of the Abyss was the most threatening force for any lifeform of the Dark Abyss.
Even experts from the Deity world or the material realm would not dare to easily pledge an oath with Will of the Abyss as a witness. It was well-known that the moment one broke one such oath, the Will of the Abyss would retaliate with terrifying might!
"Refuse to pledge the oath, and you won't get the information even if you kill me…" The corners of Da Er Hao's lips twitched upwards.
Peng!
That was when, without warning, Xue Ying's sent out a slap using his right hand. This strike swept across Da Er Hao's Great Demonic God body like a terrifying tsunami. Quickly afterward, Xue Ying's luminous sun force permeated through his body, blocking his True Deity Heart from fleeing and sealing it within moments.
Da Er Hao's body was thus destroyed.
Xue Ying's grabbed the miniature Da Er Hao—the demon's true deity heart.
Xue Ying stared coldly at the miniature version of his opponent. "Fool! You actually dared challenge me? I know full well that Chi Qiu Bai is no more than a Transcendent; he's not even a Deity! Taking him out of the river of time and reincarnating him is simplicity itself to someone like me. For you to challenge me and threaten me to set an oath… do you even know what the price of offending me is?"
Sitting immobile within Xue Ying's palm, Da Er Hao was so frightened his heart began to tremble. Even so, he could not help but blurt out, "You'll guide Chi Qiu Bai out of the river of time to reincarnate? You wouldn't even recognize him! You couldn't tell him apart from the others!"
"So what if I can't tell him apart myself? I can always ask His Highness Dong Bo to send a World Deity avatar here. Problem solved!" Xue Ying replied. "At most, I'll have to trouble myself slightly more. Speak; where is Chi Qiu Bai's soul? If you don't tell me, I must let you know that there are many things more frightening than even death itself."
Da Er Hao was naturally aware of this! After all, the Dark Abyss itself had too many techniques for torturing souls.
"You have a breath's worth of time. Any answer that is given afterward will be considered void," Xue Ying indifferently said.
A certain feeling began brewing in Da Er Hao's heart; it was a mixture of despair, unwillingness, and pure terror.
In any case, as a demon native to the Dark Abyss, he was well aware that he would not escape this situation alive.
"I'll speak, I'll speak." Da Er Hao lowered his head. "I only hope that Tavern Master will grant me a clean death."
"Speak, then," Xue Ying coldly replied.
Da Er Hao lowered his head to his palms. "Chi Qiu Bai's willpower was very formidable; he was able to hold on for so long… but thirty thousand years ago, the Howling Devil Cult Leader announced that he was seeking souls with extremely powerful willpower. The stronger, the better. I was one of the people who sent him a batch of souls in exchange for certain benefits, and amongst these souls was Chi Qiu Bai's as well. As for what happened to it afterward, I have no idea."
"The Howling Devil Cult Leader?" Xue Ying mumbled. "What of his wife's soul?"
"Her willpower was more ordinary, and she ended up dying under my torture," Da Er Hao calmly explained. "I have said all that I had to say. I now ask Tavern Master to proceed as promised."
"Naturally," Xue Ying said.
"I feel obligated to let you know… that you are wrong about my identity," Xue Ying's voice passed into Da Er Hao's true deity heart directly, who was stunned by this reveal. Had his guess been wrong? Xue Ying had not been the one who invited the Tavern Master? Who else could it have even been? Yet he could think of nobody other than Xue Ying who would be able to send out such a grand existence and even ask him to search Chi Qiu Bai's and his wife's soul.
How had he been wrong? Unless… unless…
Da Er Hao could think of a single possibility.
"Peng." This was when Xue Ying squeezed his hand, destroying the Da Er Hao's True Deity Heart in the process.
Whether Da Er Hao had arrived at the correct conclusion or not, Xue Ying did not care. After all, Da Er Hao's True Deity Heart had already been sealed, leaving him unable to send messages out. Xue Ying had only left him with such thoughts because of the fury he felt: for the sake of Big Brother Eternal Wind and various others, for the sake of the many Transcendents of the Xia Clan who died because of the Demonic Faction, as well as the countless mortals whom they slaughtered!
The faith of the Demonic Faction in a Great Demonic God from the Dark Abyss meant they were unscrupulous in their behavior. Countless Transcendents and Deities throughout the history of the Xia clan sought to extinguish the Demonic Faction, yet it was only after Xue Ying became the Realm Lord that he Xue Ying finally got rid of the Demonic Faction in the Xia Clan world for good.
'Howling Devil Cult Leader?' Xue Ying looked toward a distant location, and then took a step single step followed by his disappearance. From that day onward, the demon named Da Er Hao no longer existed.
Meanwhile, Xue Ying used the internal communication system of the Bloodshed Tavern to announce his success in the mission of killing Da Er Hao, and then immediately issued another mission! He issued the mission, and he would be the one to complete it! He chose this method as to make sure things were handled cleanly, with a start, and a finish! As for the chance that he might reveal his identity, he wasn't worried one bit. The operating laws of the Bloodshed Tavern's would never ask the identity of anyone who came to issue a mission! As for the assassins who took up the missions, it was only natural that their identities would remain anonymous as well.
Many assassins of the Bloodshed Tavern concealed their real identity, so they could only communicate through simple code names. Naturally, if someone were to take the initiative to reveal their identity, their fate would then fall into their own hands.
There had once been an assassin who deliberately made up eighteen code names, just to make sure his identity was well-hidden.
Since this was the first time Xue Ying acted as an assassin, he had been forced to come up with a code name for himself as well. He chose 'Flying Blade'.

chapters.title: Chapter 566 - Chi Qiu Bai
chapters.content:
Chapter 566: Chi Qiu Bai
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
In a dark palace hall, the Howling Devil Cult Leader was sitting atop a skeleton throne with a content expression. His throne was made up of countless palm-sized humans and animal bones, all of them emitting light.
The man simply sat there, his tender white fingers lightly drumming one of the throne's handle pieces, sending out continuous 'dong dong dong' sounds which reverberated throughout the deathly silent hall.
"Begin."
"Again." The Howling Devil Cult Leader finally settled his state of mind. He seated himself properly on the skeleton throne then begun to display his secret technique.
His face, which was covered in fine scales, displayed a look of pain, and his expression turned ugly to behold. In the meanwhile, a large number of illusions had begun leaving his body, some of them male, some female, some demons, and some beasts. Regardless of race and gender, all of these illusions let out soundless screams which created shockwaves reverberating all throughout the palace hall and causing even space to distort.
The man's black robe protruded slightly upwards as it revolved unceasingly. The vague shape of a head appeared on it.
"Ahhhhh." The Howling Devil Cult Leader roared loudly. Painful… cultivating this secret technique was truly painful!
"You wish to refine us?"
"Die!"
"We won't let you!"
"Die!"
"I'll use even my life to curse you. Just die."
Nine illusions formed around the Howling Devil Cult Leader's body, every last one howling with savagery. One of these figures belonged to a white-haired man—it was Chi Qiu Bai. He had been able to maintain his consciousness up to this very moment, yet his heart was already filled with nothing but fury and killing intent. In this contest between billions of souls, in this battle of wills, he continued fighting and surviving until he proved himself to be one of the nine people with the strongest will.
"Hehehe, you wish to kill me?" the Howling Devil Cult Leader said in a piercing shriek. "You weaklings think you can threaten this cult leader? Hahaha! It won't be long until you will all be refined and become part of my body. By then, my blood demonic body will be complete. At that point… ahhhh!"
The Howling Devil Cult Leader could not stop himself from letting out a pained scream.
'The "Blood Demon Scripture" deserves to be one of the legendary absolute arts. Cultivating it is truly painful…' The Howling Devil Cult Leader's eyes were filled with madness. But was there any stage four World Deity in the Dark Abyss who could walk this far without being a madman? They were all required to have extraordinary willpower.
"You will die."
"You will definitely die."
Chi Qiu Bai and the other eight were brimming with hatred towards the Howling Devil Cult Leader. All the torture and pain they experienced over thirty thousand years left them unable to even recall their pasts.
"Hehehe…" Despite the extreme pain he was feeling, the Howling Devil Cult Leader was incomparably excited inwardly.
After all, he was actually cultivating the "Blood Demon Scripture"!
Though he only managed to get his hands on the first half of it.
The second half of the "Blood Demon Scripture" had once made its appearance in the Dark Abyss, only to eventually be obtained by the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction. It was precisely because he owned the second part but not the first that he was unable to actually cultivate it. Even then, the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction still succeeded in gaining incredible status, for he had managed to create a new absolute art from the second half of the "Blood Demon Scripture". This brought him the Paragon realm and landed him a fierce reputation in the entire Dark Abyss. Also, having created an absolute art, the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction was known as the expert closest to becoming a Ruler in the entire Dark Abyss.
The second half alone enabled the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction to create his own absolute art and achieve such outstanding results. While this could only happen because of the great innate talent he had, the "Blood Demon Scripture" also became very famous in the process.
'For the sake of finding even the smallest chance at transcending, I went adventuring on dangerous sites, but not for one second did I consider that I might stumble upon the legendary first half of the"Blood Demon Scripture"! It might just be the first half, but it's enough for anyone below the true god realm to cultivate.' The Howling Devil Cult Leader was very happy. 'More importantly, this first half could lead me to success in my cultivation, since my case is different from that of the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction. Once I succeed, I'll be able to form an actual blood demon body!'
'Still, cultivating it is proving to be truly difficult,' the Howling Devil Cult Leader thought.
Successfully cultivating a blood demon body came with harsh requirements. The Howling Devil Cult Leader had already spent thirty thousand years in cultivation before finally reaching the final stage. It took billions of souls going through intense competition, only to leave behind nine souls with the strongest willpower. As long as he reached one final success, his cultivation would be complete.
'The Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction created an absolute art for himself, but it contains the tyrannical aspect of the blood demon body, and not the undying aspect,' the Howling Devil Cult Leader thought. 'Even though his innate talent is very high, how can an absolute art he created be compared to the ancient "Blood Demon Body" that has been passed down from generation to generation?'
'If I become a powerful existence, the first half of the"Blood Demon Body" should make me unparalleled in my realm. At that point, I could start just think up ways to get the second half of the inheritance from the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, and fuse it with my half.' The Howling Devil Cult Leader already started looking forward to that day, yet he did not dare start looking for Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction at the moment. On top of that, he could only succeed in his cultivation of the blood demon body using only the first half because the second half was meant for the realms higher than true god.
"Ah!"
The Howling Devil Cult Leader finally stopped. Chi Qiu Bai and the other eight illusions were rapidly absorbed into his body. An ugly expression appeared on his face as the scales and skin on his hands broke down to the point his bones were visible. Clearly, cultivating this technique involved an extraordinary level of pain.
'Not too long now… If everything goes according to plan, I should only take me another thirty thousand years to finish,' the Howling Devil Cult Leader thought. He understood well enough that the final step was also the hardest. According to the records pertaining to the "Blood Demon Scripture", he had to tread very carefully. If he were to rush things too much, it might lead to his True Deity Heart being swallowed by the nine huge sources of willpower! While this would only lead to his avatar's death, all the souls and materials he used would also be wasted; he would have to start from scratch. On top of that, it was normally easiest to succeed in the first attempt at cultivation, while the chances of succeeding during a second attempt would be very low. The records of the "Blood Demon Scripture" also mentioned how nobody had ever succeeded in a third attempt.
…
The black ship continued moving through the Dark Abyss, passing through many levels of the world.
Xue Ying was standing at the head of the deck. He was sending out messages through a ring along the internal communication channels of the Bloodshed Tavern. "I want a record of all the relevant information pertaining to the Howling Devil Cult Leader, especially if it relates to the location of his true body and avatar."
"Hua."
Without any delay, a huge volume of information was sent directly over to him.
"He is a stage four World Deity, the abyss sovereign of the 37th layer of the Dark Abyss. His current residence is isolated from scouting methods so, for the moment, we are unable to locate his true body and avatar," the Bloodshed Tavern replied.
"Is it possible to investigate conduct further investigation?" Xue Ying sent back.
The Bloodshed Tavern also dealt in selling intelligence.
"We would have to ask cultivators proficient in the Dao of Karma to make the investigation. The price is either ten million contribution points, or one hundred million Deity crystals worth of treasures," the Bloodshed Tavern replied.
"Proceed."
As a Bloodshed Tavern Master, Xue Ying would receive his pay every hundred million years. Naturally, using his contribution points was the better choice in this situation.
The current situation was similar to when the Nine Yang Palace Head was pursuing Monarch Mo Xue—for the sake of finding the Howling Devil Cult Leader, Xue Ying would have to depend on someone who already knew him and was proficient in the Dao of Karma, who could then trace his location through karma.
Half an hour later, the Bloodshed Tavern replied, "The Howling Devil Cult Leader has two bodies. One is located in his territory, the Skeleton Sea. The other is out adventuring inside one of the three historical ruins of Dark Abyss, in a place called 'Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain'."

chapters.title: Chapter 567 - Hand Him Over
chapters.content:
Chapter 567: Hand Him Over
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"What?" Xue Ying frowned. "The other is at Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain?"
Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain was situated in the 40th layer of the Dark Abyss. It might not compare to the Lake Heart Island when it came to how dangerous it was, but no place able to resist the Cosmos Apocalypse could be underestimated.
'Going into the ruins to find the avatar would be too difficult. I'm not proficient in the Dao of Karma either, so it would be impossible for me to keep track of him once I enter.' Xue Ying shook his head inwardly. 'It seems I'll have to enter his territory in search of answers.'
"Sou."
The Starfield Flying Ship entered another tunnel in spacetime it created then headed toward the deeper layers of the Dark Abyss.
Xue Ying had yet to even meet the Howling Devil Cult Leader, but he began feeling a trace of enmity towards this person once he found out that he was collecting countless souls. In most cases, demons would gather souls if they cultivated certain savage secret techniques. If that was indeed the case, Chi Qiu Bai's destiny would surely be tragic!
'I can only hope my conjecture is wrong and Big Brother Eternal Wind is still alive,' Xue Ying thought.
Before long, Xue Ying arrived at the 37th layer world of the Dark Abyss.
This was a vast world, and a cold wind, sharp like a blade, whistled all over the place; some of the weaker demons would simply be cut to pieces by this wind. At the very center of this vast world resided the central power! Here, a large palace ceaselessly shone light on a sea made up of countless bones.
'I hear that this Howling Devil Cult Leader personage is completely mad. He started a sect by himself, and even had his palace built over a sea of skeletal remains.' Xue Ying stored his Starfield Flying Ship. Standing above the sea of bones, he looked towards the palace, which was now relatively close to his location. 'There are various people with eccentric personalities in the Deity world as well, but I've never heard reports of someone building their palace on a sea of bones.'
"Hong~"
Xue Ying released a dark aura of destruction and even some of his willpower. Together, they spread out in every direction like a shockwave. The sea of skeletons, which originally saw many ghosts howling out over their injustice, turned completely silent at that moment! Even the gale of sharp wind turned dead silent.
An entire region of five million kilometers became still and silent—there was not even a trace of wind—and in mid-air, at the very center of this area, stood the crimson-robed Xue Ying.
"Cult Leader."
"Cult Leader." The Demonic Gods on patrol immediately rushed out to report the incident to their superiors in a panic as soon as they saw this scene.
Back in the skeleton palace giving off a sinister feeling, the Howling Devil Cult Leader was sitting on his throne while being served by a large group of demonesses. With a frown, he looked up, his vision passing through the palace door to land directly on the crimson-robed figure who was standing just five million kilometers away. As soon as he got a proper look at the figure, especially at the robe he wore, the Howling Devil Cult Leader's expression paled ever so slightly; he had instantly recognized the robe.
In the Deity world and the Dark Abyss, these robes which were known to have been personally refined by the Bloodshed God Emperor were only worn by Bloodshed Tavern Masters. They were also quite unique in their design, which made them was easily recognizable. Of course, if one sought to deliberately hide the unique appearance of the robe, people would not be able to recognize them. In most cases, however, no Bloodshed Tavern Master would care enough to conceal the unique appearance of their robe.
"A Bloodshed Tavern Master?" The Howling Devil Cult Leader immediately roared, "Everyone, get lost."
The very moment he finished speaking, the Howling Devil Cult Leader turned into a black fog. He passed through the obstacles of the void to arrive five million kilometers away, right in front of Xue Ying. There, the black fog condensed back into the figure of the Howling Devil Cult Leader who politely bowed. "Greetings, Bloodshed Tavern Master. Might I ask what is your business here, in my Howling Devil Abyss World? If there's any matter I can assist with, please let me know. I'll do my best to help."
"Howling Devil Cult Leader, I have indeed come on business," Xue Ying began. "Of the countless souls you've collected over thirty thousand years, you've obtained a certain one from Da Er Hao. I must ask that you return that soul."
The Howling Devil Cult Leader was astonished.
Souls?
He had indeed collected countless souls for the sake of cultivating the first half of the "Blood Demon Scripture", but he had never revealed this matter to anyone. Was this matter something than an expert with the combat power of a powerful existence would ask about? Unless… this man suspected him of having obtained the "Blood Demon Scripture"?
The Howling Devil Cult Leader could not be blamed for overthinking this matter. After all, the allure of this first half of "Blood Demon Scripture" was incredible indeed, especially considering it was an absolute art. In addition, the second half of the scripture was the basis of the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction's fame, the existence closest to becoming a Ruler in the entire Dark Abyss! If this matter were to be revealed, the Howling Devil Cult Leader would certainly fail to keep it safe. Of course, he had already obtained the inheritance, but he still wished to hold onto the treasure, which he could then exchange in the future, once he became stronger.
He could allow other people to receive the inheritance… for an appropriate price, of course.
"Tavern Master… I've indeed collected countless souls back then. How could I even know which was the one I received from Da Er Hao?" The Howling Devil Cult Leader shook his head.
"It was the soul of one named Chi Qiu Bai," Xue Ying continued, giving the Howling Devil Cult Leader a meaningful look.
The Howling Devil Cult Leader felt a shock pass through his heart.
Chi Qiu Bai?
Of course he knew about him. He originally seemed to be an unremarkable soul—not even a Deity! But this was purely a battle of wills, and one the final nine souls which eventually emerged victorious belonged to a person named Chi Qiu Bai. Since he only recently attempted refining these nine souls with the greatest willpower, he also received part of their memories and had a brief understanding of Chi Qiu Bai's situation.
In spite of the inner shock he received, he remained outwardly calm.
"Have you used these souls to cultivate a secret technique?" Since Xue Ying could not decent any gap in the man's behavior, he could only become more direct in his questioning.
"Hahaha, in the Dark Abyss, using souls to cultivate secret techniques is far too ordinary." The Howling Devil Cult Leader laughed. "Can you blame me for such a thing, Tavern Master?"
The killing intent in Xue Ying's eyes was now clearly visible.
The Howling Devil Cult Leader's heart jolted in surprise. Such terrifying willpower!
"You will hand over Chi Qiu Bai's soul. Don't worry if you can't tell him apart from the others; you can just take out every soul you still have in your possession and I'll check through them. You can refuse… but that will only mean I'll have to act and check through everything myself," Xue Ying coldly said. "I suggest you just hand them over."
Personally act to check through everything?
How could he let the Bloodshed Tavern Master search through his belongings? The true body he left behind in his territory held his most important treasure, the first half of the "Blood Demon Scripture"! If Xue Ying were to check through everything, it would surely be discovered!
"I truly do not know anything about the soul of any person named Chi Qiu Bai." The Howling Devil Cult Leader was adamant in his refusal.
"Hm?" Xue Ying frowned.
"Right! Back then, I handed over a batch of souls to another powerful existence," the Howling Devil Cult Leader added. "I remember now; that batch also contained the souls I received from Da Er Hao. Yes, I'm quite sure of this."
Powerful existences were known to have a nigh-perfect memory.
"Pledge an oath with the Will of the Abyss as the witness that you are not lying," Xue Ying said. "I will then let you go search for that powerful existence."
The Howling Devil Cult Leader immediately became anxious.
Of course, he had never given souls over to any powerful existence!
He had personally used up all those souls, and Chi Qiu Bai was already one of the nine souls with the most willpower! How could he dare pledge an oath with the Will of the Abyss as the witness!
"Tavern Master, you should not be too excessive in your behavior." The Howling Devil Cult Leader began to feel quite frustrated and inwardly anxious at the same time. He was well-aware that there was no powerful existence in the Dark Abyss who would care about any logic he presented. Their tempers were all very unreasonable. But it was precisely because he was refining the first half of the"Blood Demon Scripture", even though he had yet to finish his cultivation, that his attitude already transformed. The way he saw it, it would not be long until no ordinary powerful existence could afford to be his opponent?
"If you aren't willing to pledge the oath, I can only assume that you are lying. I'll just go ahead and personally conduct the check, then." Xue Ying was still just standing there, but the surrounding void began distorting, followed by the appearance of many figures. A total of nine bodies appeared, all of them wearing the same black armor. This set of armor was actually the true appearance of the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body". Every last one of these figures was emitting a destructive, vicious aura.
World bodies could take on millions different transformations. They could change into any appearance, allowing them to transform even into weapons. In fact, they could imitate Xue Ying's luminous sun force as well as his extreme annihilation mysterious body. Of course the dark destructive aura could be easily mimicked.
These nine bodies surrounded the Howling Devil Cult Leader from all sides.

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - Kill
chapters.content:
Chapter 568: Kill
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Stop, stop. Stay your hand," the Howling Devil Cult Leader hurriedly shouted.
"What else is there to say?" Xue Ying's true body was accompanied by his nine world bodies to surround the Howling Devil Cult Leader. He was ready to act at any time.
The Howling Devil Cult Leader said, "Unless I'm mistaken, you were sent here by His Highness, Dong bo Xue Ying. Is that correct, Tavern Master?"
"How did you know?" Xue Ying frowned.
"Hahaha…" The Howling Devil Cult Leader did not answer. The actual reason related to the fact that he obtained part of the memories of each of the nine souls with the greatest willpower. This included some basic information from Chi Qiu Bai's memory, which let him know that a certain famous character originated from Chi Qiu Bai's hometown, and that was Xue Ying! His reputation was too big, having long since spread across the whole Deity world and Dark Abyss, and his background wasn't secret—he was native to the Xia Clan world from the material realm.
It wasn't difficult for the Howling Devil Cult Leader to deduce that Chi Qiu Bai, a mere Transcendent from the material realm, could not know anyone with enough influence to invite someone over other than Xue Ying.
"It seems you know quite a lot about Chi Qiu Bai," Xue Ying said in a cold tone of voice.
"Tavern Master, Dong Bo Xue Ying is just an expert from the Deity world; is it worth becoming my opponent for the sake of an outsider?" The Howling Devil Cult Leader then added, "In truth, I'm sure you can guess that I've already used up Chi Qiu Bai's long ago during the cultivation of my secret technique. I couldn't bring him out even if I wanted to! You can kill me, but you still won't gain anything out of it. I can only hope that Tavern Master might show mercy. I, the Howling Devil Cult Leader, will definitely do my best to repay Tavern Master for any kindness you show."
"He's already dead?" A tinge of fury appeared in Xue Ying's eyes.
"That is the case." The Howling Devil Cult Leader was nodding ceaselessly.
"Then pledge an oath to confirm that his soul has already dissipated. Do this, and I'll just start thinking up ways to bring him back from the river of time," Xue Ying said. If he was unable to accomplish something, he could just ask someone else to do it in his stead. The stronger the person being reincarnated, the greater the price that had to be paid. Eternal Wind died as a Transcendent, so it would not be so difficult to reincarnate him. With Xue Ying's current influence, it would be very easy to do so.
"That is…" The Howling Devil Cult Leader was clearly hesitating. Pledging an oath? Strictly speaking, Chi Qiu Bai could not be said to have truly died.
"You won't pledge the oath? Does that not mean you're lying?" Xue Ying no longer hesitated. The Howling Devil Cult Leader first said that he gave the souls over to some other powerful existence, and then immediately changed his mind, saying that how Chi Qiu Bai's soul dispersed. Even then, he was ultimately unwilling to pledge an oath.
This meant he could only act!
"Hong hong hong!"
Xue Ying's nine world bodies all waved their poles at the same time. Indeed, for the sake of concealing his identity, Xue Ying forewent using spears in favor of poles! In truth, poles and spears were similar in many aspects.
'This isn't good.' The Howling Devil Cult Leader's expression went completely pale. 'Damn it! This Tavern Master is clearly a powerful existence from the Dark Abyss, but for the sake of that Dong Bo, he's not showing me any mercy.'
Xue Ying's nine poles were like nine pillars surrounding the world. Everything around was twisted and smashed entirely as if the cosmos apocalypse itself was descending upon this area. His surroundings turned into streams of particles, mainly because every last world body was powered by the luminous sun force coupled with the extreme annihilation mysterious body. Their physical prowess wasn't any lower than that of the true body, making them so powerful that it felt exaggerated—he could rely on pure strength to produce an effect similar to the apocalypse.
Faced with this heaven-shattering assault, the Howling Devil Cult Leader felt his heart tighten; such power was truly too fierce. He could no longer afford to conceal any part of his combat power, so he erupted out with his full strength.
"Peng~"
Having fallen under the shrouding assault of the nine poles, the Howling Devil Cult Leader began feeling a strand of despair, yet he was nonetheless doing his best to fight back. His body began distorting, eventually taking on the form of a bloody shadow. While it was true that his body cultivation technique was not completely, he had already reached the final step, leaving him quite different from an ordinary figure.
Nine powerful souls were snarling out from the surface of his body, some male, other female, humans or beasts, young and old. Every last one of these nine souls was filled with hatred.
"This…" A feeling of great alarm overcame Xue Ying's heart.
Of the nine illusions filled with rancor, one was a white-haired man with an appearance strikingly similar to that familiar older brother of his. This was the person he followed when he first became a Transcendent—he was the Eternal Wind Knight, Chi Qiu Bai. However, the current him was no longer as unruly as he had been in the past, and neither was the grief he had always been hiding inside visible. Instead, he seemed like nothing more than a crazy ghost, struggling with hatred as he leaped against the blood shadow.
Just what could he have been experiencing for him to turn into such a resentful ghost?
Xue Ying's killing intent towards the Howling Devil Cult Leader suddenly exploded! By now, he could easily understand that Chi Qiu Bai and the other eight souls were in a similar state. Eternal Wind would never be able to regain his usual self, and Xue Ying could only ever hope to save him by killing the Howling Devil Cult Leader and then retrieving Chi Qiu Bai's soul from the river of time.
With how strange his current state was, Chi Qiu Bai would never be able to reincarnate unless the Howling Devil Cult Leader died.
"Peng peng peng~" In spite of the complex emotions he was feeling, Xue Ying's nine poles struck with the same destructive force from before. Rather, the killing intent in his moves was now even sharper.
"Hu."
Through arduous effort, the blood shadow managed to flee the region of mounting apocalypse, though not before being struck by one of the poles. The terrifying strength caused his body to distort and tremble. Fortunately, his body had already transformed; bolstered by his current realm, he was able to shave off much of the impact, allowing him to survive the strike.
"Monarch Cheng Ming, save me, save me! If you rescue me, I'll do whatever you ask," the Howling Devil Cult Leader immediately sent a message out to a powerful existence of the Dark Abyss who resided three layers away.
"Die for me."
This time, Xue Ying's true body acted in concert with his nine world bodies. The ten earth-shattering, enormous poles struck out simultaneously, their power as terrifying as ever, their speed blindingly fast.
'What? He's not controlling the surrounding spacetime?' the Howling Devil Cult Leader noticed, just as he began to despair. While his realm was not as deep as Monarch Mo Xue's, he had long since grasped hold of the Time-Space Deity Heart, so he was startled to discover that the surrounding spacetime wasn't being suppressed. This was a mistake that no ordinary powerful existence would ever commit! He immediately moved his blood shadow.
"Hua."
Tearing through spacetime, the Howling Devil Cult Leader began his escape.
'He's running?' Xue Ying began to feel a headache incoming. Indeed, his realm was simply not high enough. While he was quite strong in terms of head-on combat, he had no easy way of suppressing people using the fleeing ability of the Time-Space or Boundless Deity Heart. The Boundless Deity Heart and the Material Deity Heart were, after all, incredibly hard to grasp a hold of. Even stage four World Deities would usually only ever hope to slowly comprehend them, and most lacked the ability to grasp them entirely.
However, the Time-Space Deity Heart was much more common, and the Howling Devil Cult Leader was clearly one of the many who comprehended it.
"What?!" The Howling Devil Cult Leader's expression changed greatly as he looked behind him while he was fleeing through the tunnel in spacetime.
"You can't escape." Xue Ying had stepped back on his black Starfield Flying Ship to begin his chase, and it so happened that his Starfield Flying Ship's speed was much faster than his opponent's.
Standing at the prow of his ship, Xue Ying opened his mouth wide, sending out a dull violet flame, which gave off the feeling of an incandescent dragon being formed. This technique was a domain-related ability that could envelop an entire target area. The Howling Devil Cult Leader failed to dodge it—he was engulfed whole. "Ah!" The burn was so painful that he let out a cry of agony. Such pain! When raised to the seventh layer, the Ten Apocalyptic Fire burned so hot that its power was similar to that of a powerful existence. In mere moments, the blood shadow of the Howling Devil Cult Leader began letting out sounds of 'chi chi chi'. 'This is bad… the flame is too terrifying! At this rate, it won't be long until I burn to ashes!'
The "Blood Demon Scripture" was not a weak technique by any measure, but the Ten Apocalyptic Fire was simply too close to being an absolute art. On top of that, the Howling Devil Cult Leader's body had yet to truly transform.
"Hong hong hong!" Simultaneous to the release of the Ten Apocalyptic Fire, Xue Ying's nine world bodies all appeared and waved their poles in the cult leader's direction.
On one side, the cult leader had to resist the burning ability of Xue Ying's Ten Apocalyptic Fire, while on the other, he was facing the fierce assault poles of nine poles; he could do nothing but despair. By now, his focus was completely on escape, and it was only when he could not dodge an attack completely that he would try his best to reduce the incoming force.
But while he started out thinking he would die in mere moments, as he continued to struggle, he realized that he was strangely able to resist this two-pronged assault.
'Something's off.' A certain suspicion began rising up in the Howling Devil Cult Leader's heart. 'This pole technique is mighty and fierce, but why is it that its application of the profound mysteries of the laws isn't even comparable to mine? Furthermore, I was able to evade so many of these pole strikes, without him even managing to scratch me. Even when it comes to the strikes that hit me, as long as I concentrated on reducing the force, I was able to do it. Just how is it that I could survive up to this point?'
'On top of that… he actually didn't seal spacetime?'
'Is there really a powerful existence out there who didn't comprehend the Time-Space Deity Heart?'
'Such incredible strength, yet he could barely match a new stage four World Deity with that pole technique. One's realm can never be faked, so his realm likely is just this ordinary… perhaps he's not even a new stage four World Deity, but actually a very powerful stage three World Deity? Is he just using special techniques to achieve such strength?' The Howling Devil Cult Leader was quickly able to deduce a large part of the truth. He suddenly shouted out: "You're not a powerful existence of the Dark Abyss! Are you not Dong Bo Xue Ying?"
He could think of nobody other than Xue Ying who would be able to put out this level of combat power despite having such a low realm. There was no need to even mention his willingness to act for Chi Qiu Bai's sake!

chapters.title: Chapter 569 - Killing!
chapters.content:
Chapter 569: Killing!
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying and his nine World Avatars were attacking with all their strength, but hearing Howling Devil Religious Leader yell out the words "You aren't a powerful existence of the Dark Abyss, you are Dong Bo Xue Ying", he was startled, then completely calm.
He had always been afraid to be discovered, therefore had been very careful, not using his spear, using the pole! He didn't even dare to use the blood refined deity warrior 'Scarlet Cloud Spear'.
But now it had been shouted out by his opponent.
He had been revealed.
Since he had been revealed, then regretting it was no use. Contrarily, he was completely calm in his heart.
"If I'm exposed, I'm exposed. At worse, I'll have to conduct a great massacre in the Dark Abyss." The killing intent in Xue Ying's eyes became even brighter, and simultaneously the weapons in his nine World Avatars directly changed from a pole to a spear! The pole in the hands of his True Body was also put away, taking out his blood refined deity warrior 'Scarlet Cloud Spear'. Although the spear technique displayed by using the pole was relatively close, in the end, there were many differences, and there were some losses in displaying its strength.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, as long as you let me go, I'll definitely not announce this!" The Howling Devil Religious Leader who had transformed into a blood-colored shadow anxiously transmitted. Seeing Xue Ying change his weapons, he knew that he was in great trouble.
If he used the weapons he knew best, his strength would increase.
If he truly were killed, then the "Blood Demon Scripture" that he had cultivated for such a long time would have been wasted, and he would need to collect precious materials and countless souls once more, and the difficulty of cultivation would be even more difficult. Furthermore, the original of the "Blood Demon Scripture" would land in the lands of Xue Ying. Howling Devil Religious Leader was not willing to accept these losses. Although he had now recognized Xue Ying's identity, because the surroundings were isolation from all detection of laws, the will of the abyss had not known Xue Ying's identity. Clearly Howling Devil Religious Leader was still not willing to discard all cordiality.
"I am truly unwilling to become the enemy of your highness Dong Bo." Howling Devil Religious Leader transmitted.
"Die for me." Xue Ying's murderous intent overflowed to the heavens, without the slightest bit of mercy. If he did not kill Howling Devil Religious Leader, then how could Chi Qiu Bai, who was in a state of symbiosis with Howling Devil Religious Leader be able to be resurrected?
"If you kill me, you will also be unable to escape the Dark Abyss." Howling Devil Religious leader was somewhat crazy.
"Hong Long Long Long~~~~"
The ten spear's power became even more fierce and sharp, especially the blood refined deity warrior 'Scarlet Cloud Spear', whose strength became a great deal larger. Howling Devil Religious Leader was instantly once more seriously hurt, and simultaneously the surrounding Ten Apocalyptic Fire was burning him at all times, making his injuries continuously increase, and making him feel that he was close to death.
'Although I've used my spear and my full power, I was unexpectedly still unable to deal with him in one wave of attacks.' Xue Ying inwardly said, 'My boundary is still too lacking. As his body has turned into a blood-colored shadow, it seems like nothingness. Even my World Prison is unable to bind him, and only the shapeless flames can burn him. But even so, he's been able to live till now even with the attacks of the nine world avatars. My boundary is too low, and it seems that I'll have to become a stage four world deity to gradually make up the deficiency.'
'The will of the Abyss is unable to discover my true identity, but Howling Devil Religious Leader has enough wisdom to discover the lacking of my boundary, and thereby inferring my identity is not a difficult matter.' Xue Ying's heart flitted over these thoughts, but his attacks did not decrease in the least, displaying his familiar blood refined deity warrior, displaying it to his heart's content.
Just at this time——
'Mn?' Xue Ying felt a space-time undulation from a distance of many trillions of miles way.
It was a black-skinned demon. His body was merely wrapped in black rags, and everything else was uncovered, revealing his hands and feet. His approximate appearance was very similar to that 'Lord You Lan' that Xue Ying encountered in the Xia Clan World. This black skinned demon wrapped in rags wore a smile, and his voice directly transmitted, drawing from karma to directly Also: "This Bloodshed Tavern Master, give I, Cheng Ming, some face. Could you let off this Howling Devil? If you kill him, it would be merely killing an avatar. What need is there for that?"
His voice resounded within Xue Ying's brain.
This Monarch Cheng Ming shuttled through space to rapidly speed over.
"Monarch Cheng Ming!" The Howling Devil Religious Leader who had turned into a blood-colored shadow was exhilarated, "Save me, save me."
"Cheng Ming?" Xue Ying naturally knew.
Monarch Cheng Ming was a True God of the Dark Abyss and was somewhat similar to Howling Devil Religious Leader, also liking to spread sects. In the Abyss there were no less than five layers of Abyss Worlds that believed in Monarch Cheng Ming.
"Hua~~~"
The true body which held the spear and the nine avatars speedily displayed their second strike. This second strike's power was distinctly stronger than the first wave, and the surrounding space began to warp.
'Not good.' Howling Devil Religious Leader's complexion changed, and he sensed that the profound mysteries of Xue Ying's spear technique were increasing.
"Kill." The True Body and the nine avatars simultaneously displayed their third strike.
"Hong Hong Hong Hong Hong Hong"
The ten spears transformed into a dazzling 'Sun', and its might and quickness far surpassed the earlier spear technique. The originally terrifyingly fast and powerful Xue Ying now displayed a power that made Howling Devil Religious Leader let out despair from the bottom of his heart! This move was the move with the strongest attacking nature of Xue Ying's three secret skills, 'Destruction'.Back then, relying on this move, Xue Ying had passed through the Blood Fire Door's main selection, becoming a guest of the Lake Heart Island.
Furthermore, when he had been stranded in the Destruction Legion and comprehended the 'Ten Apocalyptic Fire', he had pondered over the other secret technique's secret skills. The power of 'Destruction' also gradually was perfected and improved.
At present, this move's profound mysteries completely was no worse than a senior stage four world deity.
"Peng Peng Peng Peng"
All the surroundings were demolished, and all space was crushed and shattered.
Under this kind of power, the Howling Devil Religious Leader who had turned into a blood-colored shadow, who was originally seriously hurt and close to death, finally was unable to resist any longer, and under the rays of the endlessly dazzling ten 'Suns', he was vast crushed and on the spot killed.
"Stay your hand!" Monarch Cheng Ming angrily transmitted, at last, he had entered the range of his domain.
Hong.
Millions and millions of rag-covered black skinned demons simultaneously appeared, covering the skies and the earth. A vast forest below them became a mess, and a great pit no less than a million meters wide appeared. Xue Ying was currently standing in the sky above the huge circular pit.
"You've come too late." Xue Ying calmly said.
He said it was slow.
But actually, how fast was the fight of those on the layer of Xue Ying and Howling Devil Religious Leader? In a wink, they had fought for thousands of moves, and the spear technique destruction that he had used was merely used three times in a row! Only until Xue Ying had killed Howling Devil, flipped his hand and took all of the treasures left behind by Howling Devil, did Monarch Cheng Ming rush over! In the end, Howling Devil was an apex stage four world deity, and Xue Ying still had to take his treasures. After all, requesting a powerful existence to resurrect Eternal Wind from the river of time would require him to pay no small price.
"But why, he was only an avatar, why must you kill him." Monarch Cheng Ming's countless bodies dissipated, leaving behind his True Body.
Yet Xue Ying had already stood on the bow of the Star Field Flying Ship and apathetically said: "If I receive a mission, naturally I must kill him. What, will Monarch Cheng Ming obstruct me?" Saying this, he shot a glance at Monarch Cheng Ming.
Monarch Cheng Ming smiled.
For an already dead Howling Devil, and furthermore one that had only lost an avatar, would he become enemies with a Bloodshed Tavern Master? What unwiseness?
Let alone the fact that he had not saved Howling Devil, therefore perhaps Howling Devil would not honor his promise, then there would be even less reason to obstruct him.
The most important thing was! He had only the strength of an ordinary True God, and to kill Howling Devil he also had to expend some moves. The moves that this Bloodshed Tavern Master had finally used to kill Howling Devil Religious Leader, Monarch Cheng Ming had observed it all. At the very least, in the aspect of tyrannical ness, it was slightly better than himself. He was only somewhat crude in terms of the manner of profound mysteries. He was very clear if he fought with this Bloodshed Tavern Master, he perhaps would not necessarily gain the upper hand, and therefore, there was no need to act.
"Mn." Xue Ying urged on his Star Field Flying Boast, and under the attentive gaze of Monarch Cheng Ming, he directly tore open a space-time tunnel and rapidly left.
…
Within the Three Chief Sacred Mountain.
Back then Howling Devil Religious Leader had fortunately received the first portion of the "Blood Demon Scripture" at the Three Chief Sacred Mountain, therefore had an avatar continue to sneak into the Three Chief Sacred Mountain!
Within an ordinary rock cave.
Howling Devil Religious Leader was currently cross-legged sitting here. The original body and the avatar's appearance were exactly the same.
'Ah Ah Ah Ah, That damned Xue Ying.' Howling Devil Religious Leader's heart hurt too much that it bled. His true body being destroyed, the chances of him once more cultivating the "Blood Demon Scripture" were lower. Even the upper portion of the "Blood Demon Scripture" was lost, and he did not believe that Xue Ying would return again. Also, if Xue Ying was killed, the treasures would reside in the hands of another hegemon of the Dark Abyss, and perhaps there would be no one to return it to him.
Therefore, that most valuable treasure had no more connection to him henceforth.
'I won't let you go, you cannot escape the Dark Abyss, you cannot escape!' Howling Devil Religious Leader's heart was filled with bitterness and killing intent, and at that time he directly raised his head and called out "Great Will of the Abyss, that Bloodshed Tavern Master that killed my True Body, is the Dong Bo Xue Ying of the Deity World! He is not from the Dark Abyss; he is a foreigner!"
His voice resounded.
Howling Devil Religious Leader also put away any treasures that isolated from probing, allowing the Will of the Abyss to know all of this. Although the Will of the Abyss was only a basic instinct, it would similarly forever operate by following this most ancient instinct.
Right after, Howling Devil Religious Leader's consciousness directly permeated into his transmission treasure.

chapters.title: Chapter 570 - Spreading Across the Entire Deity World and Abyss
chapters.content:
Chapter 570: Spreading Across the Entire Deity World and Abyss
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"I am Howling Devil. The disciple of Deity world's Bloodshed God Emperor, 'Dong Bo Xue Ying', has used the identity of Bloodshed Tavern Master to kill my True Body over at the 37th level Abyss World, taking away all my treasures. I had once been fortunate enough to obtain the first half of the original copy of "Blood Demon Scripture". Currently, it has landed in the hands of Dong Bo Xue Ying. He is currently suffering from the rejection of the Dark Abyss and is fleeing! I am saying this with the Will of the Abyss as my witness!" Howling Devil Cult Leader immediately relied on his communication treasure to broadcast this message to all stage four World Deities and powerful existences! As long as it was someone he knew, he would inform him.
"If I can't get it, then I'll not make it convenient for you! Let's see how you are going to flee at this rate!" Howling Devil Cult Leader's anger was shooting up to the heaven. He felt heartache and agony at the same time.
His future was originally bright and immeasurable.
The moment he succeeded in cultivating the "Blood Demon Scripture", his combat power would rapidly increase, and his combat power might even surpass those at his current realm to match that of powerful existences! He might even be ranked in the forefront amongst powerful existences, yet everything had been destroyed by Xue Ying. The first failure had affected his true deity heart, reducing the chances drastically of succeeding the second time. As for any attempts thereafter, there was no one in history who had succeeded in cultivating the Blood Demon Scripture.
"Under the guidance of the Abyss Will and the allure of the Blood Demon Scripture, even powerful existences could hardly resist against this allure." Howling Devil Cult Leader was previously worried because with the rejection of Abyss Will, several powerful existences within the Abyss would act but most would never risk their lives. Some might even let go of Xue Ying for the sake of befriending him.
But with the first half of the original copy of "Blood Demon Scripture", things would be different.
…
"Hu."
Stepping on the starfield flying ship, Xue Ying went through the time-space tunnel, arriving at the 38th level Abyss World.
He had just entered this level of Abyss World when Xue Ying felt the surrounding Abyss Willpower rejecting him and transmitting a destructive killing intent over. Clearly, the Abyss Willpower had recognized him as enemy!
"Fortunately, the Abyss Willpower will not act personally so easily." Xue Ying thought.
If he had been under an oath, the Abyss Willpower would descend with a terrifying punishment.
In normal occasions… even if he were to take the risk of intruding into the place, the Abyss Willpower would only reject him while guiding the any experts belonging to the Abyss to kill him. Clearly, there were always hopes of survival. Fighting head-on against the Abyss Willpower was something Xue Ying estimated only his teacher could do.
"Outsider from the Deity world, you dare come to my Dark Abyss?" A cold voice resounded.
An unseen power began spreading, covering the entire level of this Abyss World. At the same time, nine bodies appeared ahead of Xue Ying who was on the starfield flying ship. They were all thin and small. These nine old men were carrying a thin sword each as they surrounded Xue Ying.
"His control of the world is very formidable." Xue Ying was startled.
This old man should be the 38th level Abyss Sovereign! Also known as 'Monarch Sword World'.
He seemed old, yet he had cultivated for only one billion years or so, and was considered young. His accomplishments in terms of the 'world' aspect seemed profound.
One had to know that Xue Ying's accomplishments in the aspect of world had reached a deep and profound stage. He had used the 'World Deity Heart' as the main heart, fusing in the Chaotic Deity Heart and Extremity Deity Heart in addition to many years of comprehension. One could say that ordinary stage four World Deities, if not for deliberately studying the World Deity Heart, would not have obtain such comprehension comparable to that of Xue Ying. But this 'Monarch Sword World' was clearly different.
"Control of the world enabled him to control the region in trillions of kilometers wide. That's practically the entire level of Abyss World." Xue Ying was speechless.
One could determine the party's attainment in the world by seeing the size of the region he could control the world energy from.
He himself was only able to control the world energy close to half a trillion kilometers wide. The gap between their attainment was clear.
"You dare block me?" Xue Ying was filled killing intent. The starfield flying ship underneath him did not seem to be stopping.
"I might not be Tavern Master's opponent, but all I have to do is to obstruct you, and that would meant I have contributed. The Abyss Will would naturally reward me." The nine thin and small old men laughed. At the same time, they pulled out the thin sword from their back, stabbing out at the next moment.
Xue Ying was feeling puzzled too.
In the past, he had always been the one ganging others. Now, he was considerable on.
But the world bodies were actually condensed using the world energy! And this was also a fight between how exquisite their control over the world energy is! Xue Ying was stronger than the Howling Devil Cult Leader in the world aspect, allowing him to condense the world bodies. Since this thin small old man was able to control the world energy from the entire level of Abyss World, Xue Ying was practically unable to snatch any strand of world energy away from him at all. Naturally, he could not condense any world body at all.
'But, I do not need them either.' Xue Ying stood at the deck head of the starfield flying ship. The scarlet cloud spear in his hand was unparalleled across the world, bringing with it endless power as it swept over.
"Hong long long~"
Too fierce.
Displaying the full strength of the blood refined deity warrior, he released a powerful might-a terrifying strength which made even powerful existences jittery. One could see the space ahead shattering completely that was akin to a great apocalypse. That 'Monarch Sword World' who wanted to defend against the attack initially, had a change in expression, "So tyrannical!"
"Peng peng peng~" As the spear swept through, it had practically caused six of the world bodies to explode. At the same time, the world bodies began condensing at other places.
'In my Abyss World, even powerful existences can't touch me.' The thin and small old man remained confident.
Sou.
The starfield flying ship tore through the time-space tunnel before proceeding ahead. The world bodies could appear with a thought to chase after the starfield flying ship. As long as he did not escape out of this level of Abyss world, it would be within the region of attack by the thin small old man.
What a pity.
It might be tough for Xue Ying to kill the other party, but trying to escape was something easily done. He could just charge ahead straightly! Under the fierce hack of the spear, everything would fall in front of it.
'Dong Bo Xue Ying? First half of the "Blood Demon Scripture"?' The thin and small man was startled. He was the neighbour of Howling Devil Cult Leader and so naturally, he had obtained a transmission from him.
'First half of the Blood Demon Scripture? Great Destruction Heavenly Emperor has relied upon the second half of the Blood Demon Scripture to become someone weaker only to Rulers.' The thin and small old man's eyes were filled with fervor, 'If I can get it, my combat power will definitely be able to rapidly increase. In the future when I become a powerful existence, my combat power should be extraordinary too. I might not be the opponent of this Dong Bo Xue Ying currently, but it is certain that many powerful existences will be coming to surround him. Who knows, I might even gain a lucky opportunity with my world bodies?'
For the sake of the first half of "Blood Demon Scripture", the thin and small old man's true body which had been hiding in his territory started moving personally too. His true body brought along the blood refined deity warrior, allowing his overall combat power to increase.
'Stake everything.'
Absolute art.
And it was also the very famous absolute art-first half of the "Blood Demon Scripture"-who wouldn't turn crazy over it?
Xue Ying was able to become this outstanding precisely because he had obtained an absolute art after becoming the personal disciple of Bloodshed God Emperor. Furthermore, after arduously passing through the trials and joining the Destruction Legion, he had gotten another absolute art. The Destruction Legion was one which only Xue Ying and Pang Yi, out of everyone in the Deity world and Abyss, had successfully joined. One could see how difficult it was.
An absolute art was indeed enough to turn countless powerful existences crazy.
…
'What!'
At the 37th Abyss World, Monarch Cheng Ming who had just let Xue Ying go had a huge change in expression.
"First half of the Blood Demon Scripture?"
'Howling Devil ah Howling Devil, why did you not mention it earlier on!' Monarch Cheng Ming immediately revealed an expression of fury and unwillingness. If he had tried his best, with his combat power and realm that was far beyond that of Xue Ying's, he could completely restrict Xue Ying, 'That Bloodshed Tavern Master is Dong Bo Xue Ying? His realm is much lower than mine, and I completely have the chance of getting the Blood Demon Scripture.'
'Chase!'
Monarch Cheng Ming's eyes were filled with madness. His expression might seem calm, but being a lifeform from the Dark Abyss, he had become a True God after walking step by step from an ordinary little demon. His bones were similarly filled with madness too.
During crucial moments, he would stake it all!
…
'Blood Demon Scripture?'
'The first half of Blood Demon Scripture has appeared?'
'It is actually in the hands of Deity World's Dong Bo Xue Ying?'
A large group of powerful existences in the entire Dark Abyss knew of this at the first moment. And because this information had been spread far away, those who were located far from the 37th level Abyss World or those who were adventuring in some other places and could not participate, had taken the initiative to transmit the message to their good friends, and powerful existences they could depend, allowing even more powerful existences to know of this! Just a moment later, along with the information of the first half of "Blood Demon Scripture" appearing, Xue Ying's name had spread across the entire Deity world and Abyss.

chapters.title: Chapter 571 - Encircle, Pursue, and Intercept
chapters.content:
Chapter 571: Encircle, Pursue, and Intercept
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The news was transmitted too quickly.
Being the Chief Tavern Master of Bloodshed God Palace and being the teacher of Xue Ying, the Bloodshed God Emperor naturally received this news soon later!
Within a secretive underground palace.
In front of an enormous scarlet red furnace, Bloodshed God Emperor was seated cross-legged over here. His avatar was currently moving alone across the Deity world and Abyss. Adding his true body, he had a total of three bodies. Even though 'he' went adventuring in the ancient cavern left behind by Lake Heart Island master, it was only an avatar that went over. His true body remained here studying the cosmos furnace. Maybe to Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master and Monarch Gu Zang, visiting that ancient cavern dwelling was something important.
But to the Bloodshed God Emperor, this was merely an opportunity which was alright. Yet what he wanted was to take that last essential step. Even if the Lake Heart Island master had descended here to guide him personally, it would be useless too because guidance was pointless at this step.
"Chi chi chi~"
Within the scarlet cosmos furnace, the flame was burning with some black light flashing occasionally.
The Bloodshed God Emperor looked on silently.
Suddenly, he revealed an expression of shock, "Xue Ying?"
The black bird on his shoulder which had seemingly fallen into a deep sleep woke up and cried in alarm, "Wa, Bloodshed, this disciple of yours is very formidable. The moment he visited the Dark Abyss, he has actually caused such a huge incident."
"Hahaha, the more outstanding a cultivator is, the more he will be pampered by the universe. Naturally, his luck will accumulate gradually over time." Bloodshed God Emperor laughed, "This represents opportunity, and calamity at the same time. These calamities could allow Xue Ying to train himself into becoming stronger. But at the same time, it could destroy him too."
The God Emperor was relatively optimistic because every expert had walked down this path. That time, he had experienced so much more than Xue Ying did. The degree of danger was unknown, yet eventually, he walked to who he was today-someone standing at the apex.
"Blood Demon Scripture, that should be one of the six grand inheritances passed down by Ancestor Devil right?" Black bird cried in alarm.
"Mn." Bloodshed God Emperor lightly nodded, "Ancestor Devil is someone considered as second only to the Lake Heart Island master across the many epochs of this cosmos."
Lake Heart Island master was ranked first across the many cosmos epochs.
Ancestor Devil was second to him, and also the existence closest to the level of the Lake Heart Island master.
"Ancestor Devil's cultivation is very messy, and he is good in many things. As for the Lake Heart Island master, he focuses on purity. The two competing with each other allowed them to reach such a high level. That particular cosmos epoch which they were born in… was also the strongest cosmos epoch across time." Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled, "Compared to them, my cultivation is also quite messy, and is more similar to that of the Ancestor Devil."
…
Despite knowing this, the Bloodshed God Emperor remained watching from the sidelines. He understood that the path of cultivation was one Xue Ying had to experience personally. How dazzling he became would depend on how much trials he undertook. Either he succeeds or he would be destroyed! The path of cultivation was such. The more failures one experienced, the more he unafraid he would be in moving forward with his back upright.
******
There was only a single Paragon in the top 50 levels of the Dark Abyss-White Sovereign King!
"Drinking two cups after eating. Life is truly carefree."
White Sovereign King was currently seated on a chair casually holding onto a flask of wine. As he swayed on the chair, he would take a mouthful of wine. His current expression was of pure comfort and enjoyment, and the weather on this level of Abyss World was bright and clear, beautiful and calm.
Suddenly, he opened his eyes.
"First half of the Blood Demon Scripture? That should be one of the six grand inheritances left behind by Ancestor Devil right? It actually appeared during our cosmos epoch along with the second half." White Sovereign King's eyes brightened. Reaching his level, the allure of the complete scripture wasn't huge since he had already walked down his own Dao path, and would at most use it as a reference.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying? That is a genius from the Deity world. He is truly too daring."
"The first 50 levels of Abyss World is my territory. If I let him bring the Blood Demon Scripture out of the Abyss, then it'll be a tarnish on my reputation." White Sovereign King stood up, bringing a smile by the edge of his lips. He directly transmitted out via karma-
"Great Destruction, do you want the first half of the Blood Demon Scripture?" White Sovereign King transmitted over.
…
Over at the 199th level Abyss World.
This level of Abyss World had a river connecting through it. This river was pitch-black in color, and one could not see any debris within; it was just pure black in color! Just observing it would cause one to feel jittery. This black river had even permeated down to the next level of Abyss World.
By the side of the river, there was a muscular male wearing violet armor sitting cross-legged. This muscular male had two black curved horns protruding from his head. His two bare arms were extremely muscular and powerful, with dragons lying vaguely on it. Even as he was seated there, the overbearing pressure he was emitting had enveloped the entire level of this Abyss World-it was seriously overwhelming.
Even as ordinary True Gods enter this level world, under the overbearing aura, they would be forced to kneel down! Causing a True God to kneel was something most Paragons could do, but they would not do so! It was only Great Destruction Heavenly Emperor who conduct such an act.
This overbearingness and tyranny w what he was famous for.
"Great Destruction, do you want the first half of the Blood Demon Scripture?" White Sovereign King transmitted a message over.
"Hmph, I am disdainful of even the second half of the Blood Demon Scripture, so what about the first half? You can just keep it for yourself." Great Destruction Heavenly Emperor opened his eyes. His violet eyes were slightly surging with thunder as he snorted with disdain.
"The first and second half coming together forms one of the six grand inheritances of the Ancestor Devil." White Sovereign King continued persuading.
"I've already walked out of the influences by the Blood Demon Scripture, walking down my path." Great Destruction Heavenly Emperor coldly replied.
"Since it will not influence you, why are you not daring enough to read through the complete inheritance?" White Sovereign King continued, "Are you scared? Scared that the allure is too big?"
"Scared? Old White Ghost, aren't you just wanting to get the second half of the scripture from me so that you can gain the complete inheritance?" Great Destruction Heavenly Emperor coldly laughed, "Alright, if you have the capabilities, then take the first half before exchanging inheritance with me."
"Alright." White Sovereign King laughed.
White Sovereign King stood in front of the bamboo chair. He immediately used his karma to broadcast a message to the monarchs located at the top 50 levels, "Hear my orders, team up together to deal against Dong Bo Xue Ying! After you obtained the first half of Blood Demon Scripture, those who have contributed enough will have the chance to obtain the inheritance."
"Yes."
"Yes."
"Yes."
White Sovereign King's deterrence was seriously too much. With a single order, these Abyss Sovereigns did not dare to have their own schemes. If they did not acknowledge the orders of White Sovereign King, even if they obtained the first half of the Blood Demon Scripture personally, they might not be alive to even use it.
…
"What is going on? Why did this Monarch Sword World turn crazy, obstructing me to this extent? Even his true body has acted personally."
