Xue Ying stood on the starfield flying ship, easily parrying against Monarch Sword World while traveling through the time-space tunnel as he rushed down. The true body of Monarch Sword World was very cunning, and he could easily exchange positions with the other bodies, thus making it hard to kill him…
It was fortunate the gap in combat power wasn't small.
As such, Xue Ying could easily suppress him.
"Hong."
The starfield flying ship finally arrived at the 39th level Abyss World.
Just as he arrived, Xue Ying's expression changed because he could feel three powerful forces located within this level of Abyss World. One was originally there, and the other two had come over via the time-space tunnel.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying!" One who displayed the Boundless body appeared with countless copies of his original figure. The other one was an enchanting red-robed succubus with a seductive desire in her eyes, "Hand over the Blood Demon Scripture!"
"Sou."
The last one was a towering mountain demon. The magma on the surface of his body looked shiny and bright-more like metal instead. That mountain demon's aura was much stronger. He also the only powerful existences amongst the three of them. He growled, "Dong Bo Xue Ying, don't struggle. You can't escape."
"Your Highness Dong Bo, I suggest you hand over the Blood Demon Scripture." The other was a blurred greenish fog which formed into an illusion.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, I have been tricked by you. Hand over the Blood Demon Scripture!" A time-space undulation also appeared behind him. It was Monarch Cheng Ming who was currently bound in rags. He had come chasing via the time-space tunnel. That thin and small old man 'Monarch Sword World' had displayed his world avatars to try and restrict Xue Ying.
Xue Ying felt kind of puzzled.
He had just escaped from the pursuit of Monarch Sword World, rushing to the 39th level Abyss World. Moments later, so many experts came surrounding him! Even Monarch Cheng Ming had come chasing after him.
'Blood Demon Scripture? What Blood Demon Scripture?' Xue Ying felt confusion in his heart.
At the same time, he also received another transmission coming from Paragon Huo Cheng.
"Brother Dong Bo, I've just received the news that you have entered the Dark Abyss, killed a stage four World Deity before obtaining the first half of "Blood Demon Scripture"?" Paragon Huo Cheng's transmission felt relatively anxious. He was very concerned for Xue Ying, yet at this moment, he was stuck in the ancient cavern dwelling and could not come out to lend a helping hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 572 - Fight for a Road to Survival!
chapters.content:
Chapter 572: Fight for a Road to Survival!
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
As soon as the transmission from Paragon Huo Cheng reached Xue Ying, he immediately understood. With Monarch Sword World trying to restrict his movements from the side, three other monarchs coming in from the front, and Monarch Cheng Ming madly chasing him from the back, Xue Ying couldn't see much hope in his current situation.
'The first half of the "Blood Demon Scripture"? I was aware that the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction owned the second half of this technique, but who would have thought that the Howling Devil Cult Leader would have obtained the first,' Xue Ying thought. 'And now it's landed in my hands. The Howling Devil Cult Leader's heart must be aching so badly that he might turn crazy. Was it that he realized it would be impossible for him to regain the first half of Blood Demon Scripture anyway, so he preferred to make the matter public?'
This was an absolute art, and the original copy of it at that! Even Xue Ying had merely inherited the "Luminous Sun" absolute art from his teacher, who kept the original copy on his person.
The value of any technique's original copy was so incredibly high precisely because it allowed others to inherit it.
'No wonder everyone is turning crazy.' Xue Ying's thinking was extremely fast; within mere moments, he understood his current predicament as well as the degree of danger he was in.
To hand over the Blood Demon Scripture?
The thought did not even cross his mind!
After all, even if he were to just hand them over, with how many powerful existences were surrounding him from all over the place, the ones who failed to get their hands on the scriptures would just eliminate him along the way to gain the reward granted by the Will of the Abyss.
'In that case… I'll just stake it all! I'll fight it out for a road to survival!' Xue Ying's eyes glittered with fearsome sharpness. At the same time, a layer of black armor appeared over his body; it enveloped his figure in its entirety. His head was protected by a war helmet, while a black, soft mask covered his face. His whole body was covered from head to toe.
The previous blood-robed man was now a full-fledged soldier of the Destruction Legion!
"Hehehe, Your Highness, how about you stop running and accompany me for a while?" A blurred green fog enveloped Xue Ying's Starfield Flying Ship. Within moments, an unseen force permeated his body and began eroding his True Deity Heart.
'An illusory technique?'
Xue Ying's mighty willpower spread out in every direction. He was a soldier of the Destruction Legion and one who passed the trials a much higher difficulty than usual. Xue Ying's Deity Heart had long since taken on an appearance similar to glass, so his willpower directly and forcibly broke through this illusory technique, and then continued spreading outwards towards the various Abyss Sovereigns surrounding him.
Except for two True Gods—Monarch Cheng Ming and Sovereign Mountain Ridge—who were able to resist the effect, every one of the other three Abyss Sovereigns felt their Deity Hearts tremble under the shockwave. For a moment, their ability to sense their surroundings by means of their Deity Hearts became ever so slightly blurred. It was a rather suffocating feeling.
"So that's the ability of a genius World Deity from the Deity world… such formidable willpower," Sovereign Mountain Ridge's voice boomed with grandeur, reverberating throughout the entire world. At the same time, his huge fist came smashing over! This scene gave off the feeling of divine retribution descending upon the world in the form of a huge hammer. As the fist approached, it seemed to Xue Ying as if an enormous dark cloud was instead making its way over. In fact, it was bigger even than his Starfield Flying Ship.
"Get lost!" Xue Ying, who was already covered in black armor from head to toe, could no longer care less about holding back; this was all for the sake of escaping with his life. His Scarlet Cloud Spear rose and lashed against the enormous cloud-like fist like a divine dragon.
"Peng!"
As the two clashed directly, space began crumbling apart. This layer of the Dark Abyss even began to tremble vaguely.
Sovereign Mountain Ridge had entered the fight brimming with confidence, but at this moment, his expression was one of shock, his eyes wide-open. The Scarlet Cloud Spear had elongated like a divine dragon and lashed out against his fist, yet his strike could not even shave off much of the incoming strength; the spear had struck directly against his enormous chest. Sovereign Mountain Ridge's towering figure, as high as the heavens, was simply smashed away. His legs left the ground, and 'hu hu', he was sent flying backward. Such power left Monarch Cheng Ming and the other four people to the sides with pale faces.
"What? He actually sent Sovereign Mountain Ridge flying away directly?"
"Even Sovereign Mountain Ridge, whose specialty lies mostly in his power, was suppressed entirely?"
The small and thin old man whom Xue Ying had fought just before was dumbstruck. During his fight with Xue Ying, his world bodies had exploded directly, which signified a massive gap between his strength and his opponent's! However, not for a moment did he think that this powerful existence known for his huge strength, Sovereign Mountain Ridge, would be lashed away! Where did he get this incredible power?
"Hmph." Xue Ying sneered. The soldiers of the Lake Heart Island master's Destruction Legion we able to move unhindered wherever they wished in the past. Ordinary True Gods could not hope to face even the most ordinary of soldiers. On top of that, Xue Ying had access to his luminous sun force.
In terms of the realm, his five opponents all far surpassed him.
But when it came to strength and speed, not one could be his match!
"Hong~" Xue Ying's Starfield Flying Ship tore directly through the tunnel in spacetime and proceeded on to fly at high speeds. Xue Ying was still covered in the black armor, and he was brandishing his Scarlet Cloud Spear with extreme valiance and ferocity. Anyone who dared obstruct him would be suppressed! The three sovereigns who were merely stage four World Deity realm could never hope to become an obstacle in his path.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, you should just stop," Monarch Cheng Ming's voice reverberated in Xue Ying's mind.
"Hua hua hua hua hua…"
A large number of figures identical to Monarch Cheng Ming appeared in front of the Starfield Flying Ship. Together, these bodies formed a swarm so dense that they were essentially uncountable. Some of them were clearly illusory, but some were real.
All of these figures were holding onto single blades as they came leaping over.
"Scram." Xue Ying's spear swept out, forming a fierce gale and a terrifying shockwave. His strike tore space apart and seemed able to destroy anything in its way. Monarch Cheng Ming's many figures seemed like mere bubbles being popped as soon as the spear approached them. But at the same time, even more figures identical to Monarch Cheng Ming had arrived at Xue Ying's side; the spacetime around was unable to obstruct him.
"Pu."
"Chi."
"Dong."
Many blades landed on Xue Ying's body. Some of the strikes were simple hacking motions, while others were thrusts, slashes, lashes or stabs…
Monarch Cheng Ming was indeed an expert in blade techniques. He was a True God—a transcended World Deity—and countless of years of experience fighting in the Dark Abyss allowed him to fuse his blade techniques with complete laws of the world. He had formed a complete set of blade techniques! Furthermore, he eclipsed Xue Ying in terms of comprehension of the realm, with every single one of his blade techniques containing all sorts of profound mysteries. Some were meant to forcibly permeate into the body, some shook the body from the inside, some sought to make it crumble, and some were as sharp as the edge of a blade…
However, any blade technique that hit Xue Ying's armor disappeared, leaving behind not even a single scar on its surface. With the armor dissipating so much of the impact, and when taking Xue Ying's tyrannical body and his terrifying strength into consideration, the attacks were entirely unable to affect his movements.
"Mn?" Xue Ying's gaze swept over the collection of figures identical to Monarch Cheng Ming who were currently attacking him. He sent his Scarlet Cloud Spear out in a sweeping motion once again, using his force directly against them.
"Peng peng peng…" A very large portion of this group dissipated, and even Monarch Cheng Ming's true body seemed hard-pressed to make an escape.
'He's letting me attack his body however I wish? Also, why can't I seem to injure him at all?' Monarch Cheng Ming was greatly startled.
Unparalleled defenses! Simply unmatchable.
It was very likely that he could simply stand there, allow everyone to attack him, and Monarch Cheng Ming would still have no way of injuring him.
"Anyone who blocks my path shall die!" Xue Ying shouted out in a fearsome tone. His roar spread out in every direction, accompanied by his willpower. As a result, the three stage four World Deities who were preparing to launch a joint attack on his person slightly trembled. His voice pulsed out without stop, allowing the countless demons on this layer of the Dark Abyss to get a vague sense of his willpower's wrath.
A portion of the demons had already retreated into the distance, while those who remained closer to the battlefield had long since turned to ash.
Such a momentous battle could be felt from up to a few trillion kilometers away.
"Anyone who blocks my path shall die!""Anyone who blocks my path shall die!""Anyone who blocks my path shall die!"…
Xue Ying's willpower-fueled roar spread out again and again, leaving the many demons feeling terrified.
In fact, this roar had already branded this particular portion of space, and even ten million years into the future, someone passing through might still vaguely hear its echo.
"We can't kill him," Monarch Cheng Ming sent to his companions. "Fellow cultivators, let us work together to trap him, to delay his escape. As long as we contribute anything to his capture, I trust that the White Sovereign King won't treat us unfairly."
"Alright." Sovereign Mountain Ridge agreed. These types of existences who had unparalleled physical prowess were impossible to hold back in a one-on-one fight. Only by working together could they hope to obstruct him.
"Hong."
The Starfield Flying Ship showed no signs of stopping.
Inside, Xue Ying was actually feeling extremely anxious. He understood a certain fact very well—the longer he was delayed here, the smaller his chances of survival would become. After all, the Dark Abyss had many more sovereigns than just these few. Over time, many more formidable, peak-level powerful existences would be coming out, some of whom could even fight against experts on the level of the Nine Yang Palace Head. Even worse would be the arrival of a Paragon! Xue Ying was very clear that if he were to meet a Paragon here, he would be eliminated in a single move.
"Block his path."
"Hinder his escape." Monarch Cheng Ming and the other four were trying their best, but they had to be very careful in their approach; none of them was willing to die here. An angered Xue Ying was truly that dangerous.

chapters.title: Chapter 573 - Escape Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 573: Escape Plan
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Relying on his superior power to control the Starfield Flying Ship, Xue Ying soon arrived at the 40th layer world of the Dark Abyss.
Xue Ying felt like a giant bear being hunted by the five Abyss Sovereigns. Fortunately, these hunters could do no more than slow him down slightly.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying!"
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, do you dare go even deeper into the Dark Abyss?"
Some shadows began charging towards him.
Xue Ying felt it—there were more than eleven Abyss Sovereigns in the 40th layer world of the Dark Abyss! Some of them had pursued him from the previous levels, while others had arrived to intercept him from the levels below.
'As time drags on, even more of them will show up. My defensive ability is decent thanks to the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body, but that's only when it comes to ordinary powerful existences. Any stronger opponent, especially if the difference in strength is too pronounced, I would have no confidence in facing with this armor alone,' Xue Ying pondered. He was, after all, just a stage three World Deity. Indeed, he was also a member of the Destruction Legion, but he was by far the weakest one. Any other soldier could overpower him without breaking a sweat.
'That place is my only chance at survival.'
Xue Ying used all of his power to face off against the Sovereigns who were besieging him. Even though his hands were full with suppressing his opponents, his sight was already set on a majestic location in the distance.
It was a rather odd-looking mountain range. It had three entrance spread apart in different positions around the mountains, each of them taking on the appearance of a huge demonic head. These heads seemed like they reached up to the ceiling of this layer world, in spite of its height of multiple trillions of kilometers. With each head in its own location, their mouths, nostrils, eyes, and ears served as entryways into the mountain range.
This was the location of some ancient ruins that resisted the destruction of the cosmos—the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain!
'The Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain… whether I survive or not will only be decided in the final battle.' A glimmer of expectation appeared in Xue Ying's eyes.
Why did he not flee towards the outer layers of the Dark Abyss, and instead decided to proceed even deeper?
It was all because of this Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain!
Xue Ying was well aware that, as soon as the Will of the Abyss rejected him, a significant amount of powerful Abyss natives would be attracted to come and try to kill him. Even if they were not determined enough to take his life, he was still very deep into the Dark Abyss—at the 37th layer—which would make it very difficult for him to flee all the way out. Perhaps he could escape the 37th layer, but what about the next one, or the one after? Forget the other Abyss natives, the White Sovereign alone could kill Xue Ying with a flip of his hand.
And the White Sovereign was not the only threatening figure. The Patrol Devil Lord would also be impossible to deal with. Although he wasn't a Paragon, he could still defend himself from a Paragon's attacks and even kill people on a higher level than him. His strength was roughly comparable or even greater than Nine Yang Palace Head's or that of the Purple-Gowned Hex Emperor.
Any one of these existences could easily handle him.
Without even minding other dangers, these two existences alone made it impossible for Xue Ying to cross the thirty-something layers of the Dark Abyss.
Xue Ying was well-aware that entering the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain was his only way out, be it with or without the first half of the Blood Demon Scripture.
First of all, the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain was located in the 40th layer of the Dark Abyss, which was relatively close to his previous location in the 37th.
Secondly, the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain was an ancient ruin. Unlike the other areas in the Abyss where anyone could do as they wished, even powerful existences wouldn't dare be so reckless here. Even if they did chase him inside, these powerful existences would have to be on guard against the dangers of the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain itself.
Taking his excellent survivability into account, Xue Ying believed he could leave the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain with his life.
'If it weren't for these Blood Demon Scripture, things would not be so hectic. Perhaps I could have fled and entered the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain easily, without all these pursuers.' Xue Ying began to feel somewhat helpless. The Blood Demon Scripture truly attracted too much attention. He had traversed no more than three layers, from the 37th to the 40th, yet so many powerful existences had already come out to chase and surround him.
"Sou."
Using his Starfield Flying Ship, Xue Ying quickly approached the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain.
This place was truly gigantic! The area occupied by the three heads was over a trillion kilometers in size. In fact, the Sacred Mountain alone occupied half of the entire area of this particular layer of the Dark Abyss. Xue Ying continued to fly towards the mountain range, trying his hardest to reach the closest entrance as soon as possible; the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain had no openings other than the three demon heads.
"Stop him!"
"Don't let him enter!"
The demons who were still trillions of kilometers behind Xue Ying were agitatedly sending messages to the Abyss Sovereigns of this layer.
At this stage, a single moment could make a world of difference.
Although eleven Abyss Sovereign had already arrived at this level, only seven of them were close enough to attack Xue Ying. The other four were still quite some distance away. Of the seven who could attack him, only three were powerful existences, and they were all quite ordinary regarding strength. Faced with this level of opposition, Xue Ying was able to make his way towards the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain.
"Get out of my way!" Only a million kilometers now stood between him and the nearest entrance. Using his Starship Flying Ship, Xue Ying tore through space, rapidly approaching his destination, all while employing his Spearmanship as well as his physical defense to buy more time.
Finally——
"Xiu!"
Just like a shadow…
Xue Ying rode his Starfield Flying Ship in through the orifices of one of the three demonic heads with goat-like appearances. The hole he entered through took the shape of a fur-covered ear, and its opening measured hundreds of millions of kilometers. Each strand of fur on this ear looked like a towering tree. Xue Ying instantly flew right through the ear hole.
"Chase after him!" The Abyss Sovereign who had been pursuing him all this time sensed a sort of invisible force press down on them as soon as they entered the ear-shaped hole.
Immediately, they became unable to make use of their domains.
In fact, they were no longer able to employ their world energy, nor could they tear through spacetime!
Every single Abyss Sovereign on Xue Ying's tail immediately reduced their speed; these great ancient ruins were significantly suppressing them. It was even rumored that in specific locations, the operation of the laws would constantly change in a similar manner to places within the ruins of Lake Heart Island. However, Xue Ying had no precise knowledge relating to this matter since, to date, the Destruction Eden was still the only unique location of Lake Heart Island that he ever visited.
In truth, the Blazing Blood Door was also a special location that he knew of, but he did not dare to actually enter it. His actions back then were spurred only by his need to save his wife, but he was well aware that his current power would give him no more than a slim chance to enter and leave that place safely.
…
Dressed in his set of silvery-white armor, the White Sovereign had an incomparably handsome appearance. He stepped forward into the void.
He traversed the 35th, 36th, 37th and 38th layers of the Dark Abyss with great haste. Though he was able to move faster than any Starship Flying Ship, he was still forced to pass through the layers one by one.
'The Dao I've opened is mainly meant for fighting. It doesn't give me much of an edge in traversing space.' The White Sovereign shook his head. In truth, despite it not being his strongest point, his speed was still much faster than that of any ordinary powerful existence.
"Reporting to White Sovereign: Dong Bo Xue Ying's defense and power are formidable. We were merely able to slow him down slightly."
"Reporting to White Sovereign: he has already reached the 40th layer world of the Dark Abyss."
"Reporting to White Sovereign: Dong Bo Xue Ying has charged straight into the Three Chieftain Sacred Mountain."
"We're too late."
"We couldn't stop him."
The three heads served as the only entrances to the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, and Xue Ying had chosen the one nearest to him, allowing him to quickly enter it.
As soon as Xue Ying came to the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain through the ear-shaped hole of the goat-like demon head, the White Sovereign had already traversed the 35th layer of the Abyss.
'This Dong Bo kid is very conscious of his ability. He's been flying towards the 40th layer from the very start, knowing that his only chance at survival lies in entering the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain. Fleeing to any other place in the Abyss would offer him no hope.' The White Sovereign lightly shook his head. 'Though, the True Gods in that group really are no more than useless trash. He's just a grade three World Deity, but they still failed to stop him.'
'He did save Paragon Huo Cheng…'
'Is this the true power of the Destruction Legion's soldiers? He is, after all, just a grade three World Deity,' the White Sovereign pondered. He too had once entered the Destruction Eden to attempt the tests in hopes of joining the Destruction Legion, but he had unfortunately failed. However, by the time he tried taking the test, he was already a Paragon, and the tests for joining the Destruction Legion were known to increase in difficulty as the examinee's strength level increased. As a Paragon, the difficulty of his test was much higher than what someone weaker would have to pass.
"Do you really think you'll survive just because you fled inside of the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain?" the White Sovereign said, a hint of derision in his tone.
…
Inside the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain.
Once Xue Ying passed through the ear-shaped cave, he made sure to carefully watch his back. However, his expression changed without warning as the crimson-edged relic inside his storage ring began to tremble. Xue Ying felt an unseen force of attraction pulling on this item, and he could clearly detect its source.
'Something is resonating with this remnant piece?' Xue Ying was startled by this turn of events.
He had obtained this relic some time ago, inside of Lake Heart Island, where it was sitting alongside a frozen corpse. Even the expert who previously owned it could merely deduce its exceptional quality, but not its use.
Xue Ying had also mulled over this relic for a while, yet he had been similarly unable to discover any use for it. As a result, he had merely tossed it into his treasure storage without bothering to care for it again.
But who could have known that the crimson-edged relic would resonate with something inside of the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain!

chapters.title: Chapter 574 - Difficult Situation
chapters.content:
Chapter 574: Difficult Situation
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
'To think that this relic would be summoned at such a moment.' Xue Ying inwardly shook his head. 'It is unfortunate, but it is not a good time for this! I must focus completely on escaping with my life. If I don't leave this place alive, I won't get to keep any of the treasures I have on me, including the first half of the"Blood Demon Scripture",'
Xue Ying immediately threw the matter of the resonating crimson-edged relic to the back of his mind. He was very clear about his current priorities.
A great many Abyss Sovereigns were currently entering the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountains, amongst them some with combat power even higher than Xue Ying's. In fact, some of these people might have been able to exterminate him with a flip of their hand. At such a time, searching for treasures would amount to nothing more than his own untimely death.
"Sou!"
Turning into a stream of particles, Xue Ying rose his speed to his maximum as he made his escape.
"Sou, sou, sou, sou, sou, sou."
The Abyss Sovereigns, who had by now already entered through various orifices, such as the nose, the mouth, its ears or other parts of the head, employed karma to sense Xue Ying's approximate position. They were Xue Ying's pursuers, so it was only natural that some karma would have formed between them.
"The area within five million kilometers around us is blurred. He must have own treasure that allows him to isolate himself from scouting techniques. But we can at least determine his approximate position." The Abyss Sovereigns were rushing over with full confidence. They were very clear that the number of sovereigns coming out to capture Xue Ying would only increase as more time passed.
In fact, other than the sovereigns found in the first fifty layers, even experts located deeper in the Dark Abyss might act. Similarly, there was a possibility that paragon realm experts might step in as well.
At that point, the numbers of experts chasing Xue Ying would be tremendous! It could be said that he was merely struggling at death's door.
******
News of Xue Ying's retrieval of the first half of the "Blood Demon Scripture" as well as his being pursued throughout the Dark Abyss had already spread to the Deity world. Initially, only peak experts like the Bloodshed God Emperor and Paragon Huo Cheng were made aware of this, but as time passed, most powerful existences and stage four World Deities of the Deity world got to learn of it. After all, the disturbance created by so many people chasing after Xue Ying was enormous! A very large amount of sovereigns from the Dark Abyss were participating in the chase, making it a rare event for the Dark Abyss.
"Xue Ying." Back in the Xia Clan world, in the inner section of Crimson Rock Mountain, Jing Qiu was currently accompanying Xue Ying in the corner of an elegant restaurant as they enjoyed its unique delicacies.
Jing Qiu was looking at Xue Ying, a trace of worry in her eyes. "Are you really being pursued right now?"
"Mn." The white-robed Xue Ying smiled and gave a nod.
"I've been told that there are a lot of Abyss Sovereigns heading toward the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain. I've even heard the news that the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction has set off in that direction," Jing Qiu said with concern. "The Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction has a combat power that is unfathomably deep."
The white-robed Xue Ying raised his cup of wine and replied alongside a light chuckle, "Jing Qiu, your intelligence network is not bad."
"My father was the one who told me. He and many of his old friends have been discussing this matter. By now, this incident must have spread throughout the entire Dark Abyss, and even most powerful existences of the Deity world, as well as a considerable amount of stage four World Deities, are discussing it," Jing Qiu explained.
"This husband of yours is quite amazing, don't you think? This is my first time visiting the Dark Abyss, yet look at what a huge commotion I've managed to create." Xue Ying was beaming.
"How can you still be joking about this?!" A wave of helplessness washed over Jing Qiu. She truly was full of nothing but concern and anxiety.
"Why shouldn't I joke about it? Worse come to worse, I'll lose an avatar. I can always refine another. The only pity would be losing my weapon, the Scarlet Cloud Spear personally refined by my teacher," Xue Ying said.
"Is it a lie that you have the first half of the "Blood Demon Scripture", then?" Jing Qiu asked.
"It's just one half, not the entire thing. Furthermore, now that I have a better grasp on what this technique is all about, I can't help but feel that it is overly bloody and savage; it wouldn't be a good fit for me to cultivate." Xue Ying shook his head. He wasn't too greedy for it since he already had two complete absolute arts—the "Luminous Sun" and "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body". It only made sense that he wouldn't act as crazed as those stage four World Deities and powerful existences.
Most paragons were indifferent to this same reason: they would normally have their own absolute arts. On top of that, the "Blood Demon Scripture" he owned was just a portion of the entire technique, so it had even less value in their eyes. Its greatest advantage lay in the fact that it was the original copy, which meant it could then be inherited by others. This was the only reason paragons paid any attention to it.
Xue Ying's carefree attitude began to affect Jing Qiu, helping her reduce her anxiety to some degree. However, she still had to ask, "How certain are you in your ability to escape?"
"How certain? Hahaha…" Xue Ying shook his head. "My avatar is already inside Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, and an endless stream of Abyss Sovereigns seem to be coming out to surround me. Being in such a situation, how could I dare to say I have any certainty of surviving? The only certain point is that I'll be trying my best. Experiencing this sort of battle to my heart's content is not that bad of an outcome anyway."
Jing Qiu nodded lightly.
The two of them were discussing. Others within the restaurant could not hear what they were speaking. They could not even fathom that one was a stage four World Deity existence, and the other was someone with a powerful existence combat power, and also the master of this Crimson Rock Mountain world.
…
There was one person other than Paragon Huo Cheng who would be willing to risk his life for Xue Ying, and also had the combat power to rescue him, and that is one of the three ancestors—the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master!
In the Violet Bamboo Sea.
The arrays surrounding the bamboo houses had since long been activated, making it very difficult for any outsider to approach. The Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master was currently sitting cross-legged in an empty location in front of the house, with a number of bamboo sticks dispersed all around him.
While his avatar was moving further inside the ancient cavern dwelling, his true body was still here, doing his best to improve his comprehension so as to help his avatar.
"Hm?" The Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master opened his long, narrow eyelids to reveal a look of doubt. 'Dong Bo Xue Ying has encountered trouble? He obtained the first half of the Blood Demon Scripture by coincidence after he killed a stage four World Deity? Is this the sort of fortune condensed for an absolute genius pampered by the cosmos itself?'
The Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master's lips shifted into a sneer.
He disdained the very notion of karmic luck.
This was because… he himself had once experienced it! Back then, his cultivation speed might have been slightly slower than Xue Ying's, but his dazzle did not seem any weaker. In fact, his ability to fight someone far beyond his realm at the time was even stronger than Xue Ying's!
'This sort of treatment is more calamity than fortune. If given the chance, I would have rather lived a more mundane life,' the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master was mulling over his own experience. It was a fact that anyone pampered by the cosmos would find a bitter life waiting for them. However, it was also the fact that every single expert currently standing at the apex had suffered from many difficulties before eventually growing up. Meanwhile, he, the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, was still stuck at a most crucial bottleneck—he could not transcend.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying," the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master used karma to send a direct message. "This is Bamboo Mountain."
…
"Pu."
Xue Ying found himself in a somewhat tricky position. He was in currently busy with spitting out blood as he tried his best to flee.
"Your Highness Dong Bo, is running the only thing you're good at?" A unique living being similar in appearance to an octopus was currently chasing him from behind. However, Xue Ying's fleeing speed was indeed very fast, mostly because both the luminous sun force and his Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body provided additional strength and speed. His strength was terrifying, and his speed had long since reached a frightening stage.
Anyone who entered the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain would suffer from an invisible suppressive force. The powerful existences could no longer utilize their domains or their world energy, forcing them to make their way over by means of flight slowly!
And when it came to pure speed of flying, Xue Ying held the advantage. As a result, he was starting to feel that there might still be some hope in making it out alive.
'This Emperor Qi Hai personage is truly strong when it comes to direct battles, and his realm is also very mystical. Not even the black armor provided by the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body could fully block his attack.' Xue Ying was forcibly holding back the blood in his body from surging out; he had to escape with his life! However, while Emperor Qi Hai's speed was also very fast too—much faster than that of most powerful existences—he was still a strand away from matching Xue Ying.
'Should he manage to trap me, I can forget about escaping.' Xue Ying was very clear about the threat posed by the tentacles he was frantically fleeing from.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying. This is Bamboo Mountain," a transmission suddenly arrived via karma.
"Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master," Xue Ying immediately replied.
"I understand that you are currently located inside of Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain. Do you need my help?" the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master continued. He had said these words even though his avatar was inside the ancient cavern dwelling, and his true body was doing his best to deduce the many dangers so as to help it on its journey. He owed Xue Ying a huge favor, and if Xue Ying were to request his assistance, he would naturally not hesitate to offer it.
Xue Ying immediately replied, "Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, I'm sure you understand my current situation well enough. I'm afraid that even if you, prefecture master, were to act, it would not necessarily result in my rescue."
"Indeed. The way I understand it, both the White Sovereign and Paragon Devil Kite, both of whom are at the paragon realm, have already arrived at the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain. While I was unable to confirm whether the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction arrived as well, I do not doubt that his full focus is currently on the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain. I'm only confident in my ability to deal with the White Sovereign. Should Paragon Devil Kite act as well, I might be able to save you from the two working together. But if the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction makes his move… there is simply no hope," the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master calmly explained.
Xue Ying was not surprised to hear any of this either.
The Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master was one of the three ancestors, and he truly was powerful. He could easily fight a head-on battle against the White Sovereign, an expert famous for his prowess in murder and battle! He was even stronger than Paragon Devil Kite, who was weaker in direct combat. As for the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction? He was one of the strongest paragons in the entire Dark Abyss, as well as the closest expert here to becoming a ruler.
"Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, if you were to act, some of the paragons of the Dark Abyss might begin to feel that the Dark Abyss itself would suffer a great humiliation by letting you rescue me. There is always a chance other paragons might step up as well," Xue Ying replied. "Haha, I am grateful for Prefecture Master's thoughtfulness, but this trip of mine can also be considered something of a training excursion, so there's no need to worry too much about me. At most, I'll only lose my avatar."
"Mn. Okay." Hearing this, the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master immediately cut off the karma conversation.
Xue Ying felt the taste of blood fill his mouth, but his body was already recovering from the damage it received. However, on the inside, he could not help but feel somewhat helpless. It was true that he had been full of confidence when he reassured his wife or discussed the matter with the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, but he understood well enough that his position was getting worse and worse.

chapters.title: Chapter 575 - Demonic Maelstrom
chapters.content:
Chapter 575: Demonic Maelstrom
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying had entered the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain for no less than an hour when he began to notice that he was having a harder and harder time fleeing. For instance, Emperor Qi Hai, the expert whom he had just fought against, and who was still chasing after him, was actually the sovereign of the 85th layer of the Dark Abyss! The number of Abyss Sovereigns coming out to pursue him was clearly increasing with time. They all entered through different entrances and followed different passages, all in hopes of killing him!
Luck had been on his side during the previous encounter, for Emperor Qi Hai was strong indeed, and he was known as an expert even amongst powerful existences, but his speed turned out to be slower than his. As a result, Xue Ying had still somehow managed to struggle free from him.
But what if next time he met someone whose speed was not any worse than his? What would the result of meeting a Paragon be?
'Ai… I've been looking for somewhere to hide this first half of the"Blood Demon Scripture", but I've yet to find any good fit for it.' Xue Ying was intently observing the dark passage he was currently flying through.
Him dying wouldn't mean much, but losing the original copy of the Blood Demon Scripture' fight half would be a great failure for him.
He had been looking for an opportunity to use what he learned from his father-in-law, the technique for hiding the true god weapon he put to use a while ago, on the Blood Demon Scripture!
'It's a shame that I'm stuck inside the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain,' Xue Ying thought.
Lake Heart Island was covered in many layers of frost, making it easy to hide treasures inside by changing their appearance into ice crystals.
But the passageways inside of the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain were hard and impenetrable! Even if he forced the Blood Demon Scripture to take on a new appearance, the Abyss Sovereigns would only need to release the world deity energy inside their bodies, allowing them to rampantly sweep through the place and find it with ease.
Meanwhile, back in Lake Heart Island, powerful existences would never dare to act with such reckless abandon as to destroy everything in their path—the ruins were simply too dangerous. Creating a big disturbance like that would only result in great danger. Anyone who dared to sweep through countless layers of frost all along the passageways would likely invite frightening existences to their doorstep. As a result, all of the experts who entered Lake Heart Island would generally keep to themselves. It was only on special occasions that they would actually fight, only to rapidly leave the battlefield after a conclusion was reached.
As for the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain? The danger here was much lower, with rulers actually being completely safe here. While Paragons might find the place slightly more dangerous, they were still sure to survive as long as they stayed vigilant. Not even powerful existences would consider this place overly dangerous. There were only a few places which could pose a true threat to them.
More importantly, Xue Ying had only been inside for a single hour. How far could he fly in such a short amount of time? It was not even fifty billion kilometers!
As long as they did a carpet search while following the path previously traversed by Xue Ying, they could easily and swiftly find the Blood Demon Scripture.
'If only this were Lake Heart Island… These people would not be so mad as to conduct a destructive carpet search there.' Xue Ying shook his head inwardly.
…
Time flowed on, and by now, two Paragons and 125 Abyss Sovereigns had gathered inside of the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain. They moved along different passageways so as to try and block Xue Ying's path from different directions.
'I can't continue fleeing like this.'
'If nothing changes, I'll be captured within half an hour.' Xue Ying's black armor was already littered with cracks, which were already in the process of recovering. Every bone in his body was shattered, and large amounts of his muscles were torn, yet even they were healing. At the moment, a giant whose lower region was covered by a leather skirt was chasing after him, roaring out as he raised his enormous ax.
This giant was able to move at incredible speeds, so fast that he roughly matched Xue Ying's speed.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, you can't escape from me." As it charged ahead, the giant's light brown eyes were filled with cold intent. "Hand over the Blood Demon Scripture!"
He was a famous powerful existence of the Dark Abyss who went by the name of Wild Mo. While his might have seemed like an ordinary name, he was ranked near the top among the powerful existences beneath the Paragon realm. In fact, his combat power was roughly comparable to the Nine Yang Palace Head's or the Purple-Gowned Hex Emperor's. He was famous for his fierce offensive techniques, as well as his strong defense. On most occasions, he would use his body to block the attacks launched by his opponents directly, followed by brandishing his ax to kill them when the opportunity was ripe.
His ax was overwhelmingly powerful.
Xue Ying had already tested it on his own skin once. A single strike had been enough to send him flying far into the distance, followed by a number of cracks appearing on his black armor. His body had shattered as a result, but he had been fortunate enough to have a layer of luminous sun force covering his body, allowing him to instead make use of the strike's propulsive force to aid in his fleeing.
"Hand over the Blood Demon Scripture! Just hand it over!" roared Wild Mo without stop. His body was overly large, and he seemed rather daft. While his figure was extremely tyrannical and his speed blindingly fast, he was still comparable to Xue Ying at best.
'If I get the original copy of the Blood Demon Scripture, the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction will exchange for it, and I'll use this chance to obtain the full volume. The Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction once used it to become a Paragon. I think I'll be able to do it too.' This Wild Mo personage was clearly brimming with ambition.
"Hm," Xue Ying suddenly noticed an enormous cavernous entrance ahead of him. At the same time, the passageway he was in the middle of traversing was rapidly becoming larger as it connected with various other caves in the distance. The cavernous hole ahead had a diameter of a full five hundred billion kilometers. It must be stated that Xue Ying had spent an entire hour fleeing, yet he had cover no more than fifty billion kilometers. This cavern hole was amazingly large, and there was so much wind being swallowed within that it seemed to form an intense maelstrom.
As he approached, Xue Ying's body became unstable; the attractive force of this cavernous entrance was too strong.
'I'm going in.' Xue Ying did not hesitate, well aware that if he were to just keep running, his chances of making it out alive would only decrease with time. As such, despite being faced with a terrifying passageway that emitted such a terrifying attractive force, he did nothing to reduce his speed. On the contrary, he borrowed this attractive force to accelerate even faster towards it.
"What?" Meanwhile, Wild Mo had already begun slowing down. He was getting slower and slower, and before long, he had reached a full stop just ahead of the enormous cavernous entrance. He was clearly disinclined to chase Xue Ying any further inside.
'This place is too dangerous; I might even lose my life inside.' Wild Mo began showing signs of hesitation. Moments later, an avatar separated from his body, which immediately proceeded to enter the terrifying maelstrom.
…
"Hu~"
The wind within this cavernous passage was becoming stronger and stronger.
By following the guidance of this swallowing wind, Xue Ying's speed was rapidly increasing. Furthermore, spacetime itself in the surroundings showed signs of being distorted. While his current speed was only about twice or trice that from before, the distortions of time-space in this region allowed him to occasionally cross as little as half a billion kilometers, and up to five billion kilometers in a single motion. He did not even dare accelerate any further, seeing how the wind had long since begun sweeping him along, wrestling away all control over his body.
"Sou." Xue Ying was being swept at high speeds along this cavernous tunnel. This particular portion of the cave was dark and extremely long.
"Mn?" Xue Ying finally noticed a light in the distant—an opening in the tunnel.
Yet Xue Ying chose not to enter. Instead, he continued to fly along the tunnel.
"Hu, hu, hu~"
He flew on and on, ignoring any occasional tunnel opening that appeared to his sides.
'This should be the so-called 'Demonic Maelstrom' of the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain.' Xue Ying continued flying along the gusting wind. 'It is also the most dangerous place in these ruins.'
Indeed, this was the most dangerous location found in the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, so dangerous that it could even threaten the life of a Paragon.
The Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain was littered with tunnels which all linked to the Demonic Maelstrom. Anyone who entered the maelstrom would have the chance to be sent towards the true ancient grounds of the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain. However, this was a place fraught with danger where even Paragons had to tread carefully.
'Over here.' Xue Ying had already bypassed fifteen tunnel openings. But the next light he saw ahead of him, he no ignored. This time, instead of letting himself be flown deeper along the Demonic Maelstrom, he took back control over his strength and approached the light.
This light represented an opening in the tunnel with a diameter of approximately fifty billion kilometers.
"Hu."
Xue Ying's current speed was nearly one billion kilometers per second. He swiftly rushed into the tunnel, breaking free from the attractive force of the gust of wind. Once inside, he noticed that the surrounding spatial resistance had greatly increased. Looking ahead, he saw a dark world with a dim sky. The earth's surface was bland and shiny, similar to a desert. It was also very flat, with no visible protruding areas.
'Most powerful existences would hesitate for a moment or two before entering this place, but the same can't be said for Paragons,' Xue Ying thought. 'They'll easily succeed in finding me here as long as they use karma.'
'I must think of a solution.' Xue Ying took to thoroughly inspecting this region of the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - Seclusion
chapters.content:
Chapter 576: Seclusion
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying swept his vision across the surroundings. His eyesight was extremely potent, allowing him to easily detect the spread of this layer world—it was roughly two trillion miles in diameter, and it had no entrance or exit other than the huge tunnel that he had just left!
The location he found himself in had a barren and smooth gravely ground, giving it an appearance quite similar to a desert. He was unable to detect any other living being inside.
'What? The ground is fully gravel?' Xue Ying's heart shook. He immediately descended, and as his feet landed on the gravely surface, they sunk in ever so slightly, leaving behind two footprints.
'As I fled on my life all along this Three Chieftains Sacred Mountains, the passages I traversed were all indestructible. How come I've encountered gravel all of a sudden?' Xue Ying looked down. 'Should I check out what's beneath all this gravel?'
'Hong~'
Xue Ying's surging luminous sun force diffused as it began to push out gravel underneath him.
An immeasurable amount of gravel was pushed aside, followed by a huge hole, more than a hundred million kilometers in diameter, appearing directly underneath Xue Ying. As the majestic and dazzling rays of white light spread, more and more gravel was being pushed out, and the hole was becoming deeper and deeper, pushing even more gravel over into the surroundings! Before long, the hole reached a depth of ten thousand kilometers. The layer of gravel all around had already begun to thicken.
"Yi?" Xue Ying discovered that the very round and smooth gravel pieces below him were no longer there; they were instead replaced with thick pieces of gravel, and even some irregular shapes that weren't even spheres.
"What's this?" Xue Ying waved his hand, and one of the thick pieces of gravel flew into it.
These thicker pieces were all ashen gray.
Xue Ying squeezed his fist, but even all the strength he had did not allow him to damage these the thick gravel pieces in any way; they were incomparably hard.
'Let's keep going.'
Xue Ying's majestuous luminous sun force continued penetrating downwards, and countless pieces of gravel were pushed aside. The deeper he went, the thicker the gravel became, and the stranger the shapes that appeared were. Xue Ying gradually began coming up with some conjectures, and once he reached about sixty thousand kilometers deep, his complexion suddenly changed. He encountered an incomparably large black bone. Although the diameter of the deep hole he had created was more than a hundred million kilometers wide, he could see no more than a small portion of this bone.
Xue Ying immediately controlled his luminous sun force to begin pulling on the bone.
'Hua la!'
The black bone was dragged into flight. It was now visible that its width was no less than 160 million kilometers, and that it had already begun breaking and fracturing. Furthermore, there were a large number of particles flowing on its surface. These particles were all ashen grey, and upon further inspection, they proved to be the afore-seen gravel from before.
'Could it be that this bone decomposed to form the immeasurable amount of gravel?' Xue Ying raised his head to look out towards this vast expanse of gravely ground. 'Is this boundless ground made of gravel all made up of decomposed bone?'
Xue Ying tried conveniently picking up this bone to bring inside his Eden treasure. This particular item had been obtained and refined upon destroying the Howling Devil Cult Leader's true body.
"Eh?" Xue Ying's eyebrows knitted. He had originally planned on taking this ancient bone away, yet he immediately began sensing that the entire world bound it through an invisible force. He was simply unable to take it away.
'I really can't take it? And why does it seem as if it has become one with the world?' Xue Ying shook his head, placing the bone back down. Once it reached the ground, the black bone sunk down with great speed. It was swiftly dragged to the very bottom by the formless energy.
Xue Ying looked back at the bottom of the deep hole he made, where an immeasurable amount of thick gravel had been pushed aside to clearly reveal the floor.
The black bone was now back at the bottom, and below it was a very tough and thick membrane, dark red in color.
"Break." Xue Ying tried attacking it.
A strand of his luminous sun force pierced into the membrane barely managing to pierce it up to a depth of about a finger. As Xue Ying withdrew his energy, the small crack which had just formed immediately healed.
…
Xue Ying speedily flew off to investigate other areas.
"In the depths of this gravel ground, there are indeed some remains in the middle of decomposing," Xue Ying softly said. "At the very bottom, there is a thick, dark red membrane, which I've only managed to penetrate up to a hundred meters deep even and even using the Scarlet Cloud Spear. On top of that, when I withdrew it, the thick membrane immediately healed."
"En."
There was some anxiety in Xue Ying's heart since the sovereigns of the Dark Abyss could arrive at any moment. He did not dare waste any more time.
'I should hide the Blood Demon Scripture first,' Xue Ying suddenly thought. He flipped over his hand to pick up a blood-colored book which gave off the feeling an endless ocean of blood might have, as well as a sinister bloody aura, and even an enticing formless energy. A more ordinary, weaker World Deity might simply be unable to resist its enticement. However, Xue Ying was relatively exceptional in terms of his willpower, so he managed to resist it.
He placed the first half of the original copy of the "Blood Demon Scripture" inside a storage treasure, then bound this treasure with another which helped isolate it from probing techniques, and then easily changed its appearance to look exactly like the material making up the dark red membrane.
"Break!" He furiously thrust forth his Scarlet Cloud Spear a hundred meters deep into the ground, then threw the disguised treasure down, all the way to the bottom of the crack which he had just split open. He then withdrew his spear, allowing the crack to heal.
"If you have the skill, you can go ahead and look for it." Xue Ying softly smiled.
He had entered the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain so long ago, yet it was only now that he found a suitable place to hide the Blood Demon Scripture.
'Sou.'
Xue Ying continued to fly.
"Pa pa pa…" Raindrops suddenly began falling from the sky.
'It's starting to rain?' Xue Ying looked towards the sky with a tinge of shock. Indeed, the rain had just begun to fall, and the raindrops even seemed to be rapidly increasing in size.
"Eh?" Xue Ying's complexion slightly changed as he looked towards the black armor covering his body. The rain fell gently, easily running through the layer of luminous sun force surrounding Xue Ying's body! It must be stated that in this kind of dangerous place, any expert would send some energy out to surround their body and protect them. However, these raindrops easily bypassed Xue Ying's luminous sun force to drip directly onto his black armor. The surface of his armor was making 'chi chi chi' noises, and it was showing signs of damage. "The black armor is being damaged?"
Xue Ying immediately thought of the bones he had formerly discovered. The bones were indestructible, the surface showed many damaged pieces which formed the gravel. "Could this rainwater be the reason for the bones decomposing?"
"Hong, hong~" The rain was getting stronger and stronger. Despite only a breath's worth of time having passed since it had begun to fall, the rain already gave the feeling that the world was toppling over. Puddles were accumulating in the gravel which swiftly grew at a rate visible to the naked eye.
"Chi chi chi." The black armor covering Xue Ying's body also began to suffer even more damage. Fortunately, it was extremely hard and stable, so it could hold on for quite some time. Furthermore, Xue Ying was constantly sending out more energy to restore it.
'I've got to find somewhere to hide, and quickly.'
Xue Ying no longer flew, and immediately dove downwards.
He dove past the already layer of water which was already a few meters deep, then into the incomparably concentrated layer of gravel, then continued boring downwards for another sixty thousand kilometers before finally arriving at the thick, dark red membrane.
This was the deepest he could go, and the rainwater could not permeate all the way down here there.
"Break for me."
Xue Ying fully used his spear technique, furiously thrusting in.
At the same time, his entire body simultaneously dove inwards. Once he reached a hundred meters deep, he dove directly into the deepest part of the membrane. He felt the pressure of the surrounding dark red membrane, but his strength was sufficient to resist it. There, he continued to furiously thrust his spear, only to realize that it was much harder to go any deeper from here. After a furious assault that lasted quite some time, he was twenty or so meters deeper than before. He was unable to continue any deeper. After all, the lower he went, the tougher it became.
'This is good enough.' Xue Ying flipped his hand, taking out the Eden treasure left behind by the Howling Devil Cult Leader after his death. The Eden treasure immediately changed to take on an appearance that was similar to the material making up the thick dark red membrane.
"Sou."
Xue Ying disappeared without a trace, leaving behind only the extremely small disguised Eden treasure. The surrounding membrane then immediately closed up, wrapping all around it.
'Eden treasures are very proficient in isolating what's inside from probing techniques. It has already isolated an area of ten million kilometers. For someone to find me here, they would have to penetrate the whole interior of the membrane, which is no easy matter.' Xue Ying was rather confident since even he only managed to go this deep by choosing one area and furiously striking it.
Blasting a hole that was both deep and a full ten kilometers in range into this thick dark red membrane would be harder than making a crack smaller by a thousand or ten thousand times.
And even if someone were to blast a hole that was ten meters wide in one single strike, how long would it even take to conduct a carpet-style search over a ten million kilometers wide area?
On top of that, Xue Ying would never dimwittedly place his Eden treasure, so he left it at the very center of a vague area of the primordial chaos. The distance from the core of the isolated area was a full three million kilometers. Unfortunately for them, the sovereigns of the Dark Abyss had no way of knowing this.
…
Countless creatures lived in the inner world of the Cultivation Eden, all of them having their faith placed in the Howling Devil Cult Leader.
"Spirit artifact, from this day on, the Howling Devil's faith shall be severed from this inner world." Unhappy with this situation, Xue Ying at once gave the command. He had no time to do such things himself.
"Yes, master," the spirit artifact replied.
Xue Ying at once looked for a random field of grass, and then completely isolated it and the surrounding million kilometers, thus turning it into his person cultivation ground.
'It should not be so easy for the true god paragons to find me, but I have no way of knowing for sure. After all, their techniques are impossible for me to predict.' Xue Ying sat down cross-legged on the vast field. 'Let's see, then if I'll become a stage four World Deity first, or if they can find me before that!'
If he was found first, he could only accept his fate.
Back in the Crimson Rock Mountain world of the Xia Clan world.
Jing Qiu and Xue Ying were sitting together inside a restaurant, chatting idly.
"Xue Ying, there are more and more Abyss Sovereigns making their way to the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain." Jing Qiu always seemed aware of all such external pieces of information, primarily because her father, Monarch Mo Xue, would receive information from all sorts of places. It was clear that the situation within the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain was becoming tenser! The sovereigns of the Dark Abyss converging here were rapidly increasing in number, and everyone was starting to guess on just how long it would be before Dong Bo was captured or killed.
"Don't worry about them." Xue Ying grasped his wine cup, softly lifting it up to his mouth to take a sip, then got up. "Let's go."
"We're leaving?" Jing Qiu was stunned.
Both of them were still in the material world. Where could they even go?
"I've already readied everything to seal myself off. I won't exit seclusion before I become a stage four World Deity," Xue Ying said. "Should the avatar over in the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain be captured, I can only blame my luck for being bad."
He had already done everything he could in his situation.
And now… he could only rely on chance!
Furthermore, this experience allowed Xue Ying understand one thing—if one lacked the necessary strength, adventuring was truly too tiresome. Even a stage four World Deity could suppress him in terms of their World Energy! And his realm wasn't even comparable to theirs! In truth, back at Lake Heart Island, he had already begun feeling somewhat weary, and he began to think of the fact that not every step he took was as beautiful as it should. However, he truly was unable to relax and cultivate leisurely until he became a stage four World Deity, and only then go out to save Eternal Wind. He had been too afraid that his senior brother Eternal Wind would not be able to keep holding on, which led to him rushing over to the Dark Abyss.
'I've already done everything I could.'
'I won't ever do this sort of strenuous trips again in the future. Before all else, I'll cultivate my way to becoming a stage four World Deity, calm and content.' Xue Ying's thoughts were clear—for the following years, he would enter proper seclusion. By the time he came out again, he would not be so easy to bully.

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - Give Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 577: Give Up
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
A figure came flying into the world where Xue Ying was hiding, but then he stopped in mid-air. It was a handsome man wearing silvery-white armor, and he was also known as the White Sovereign, a person of great status in the Dark Abyss.
'He's actually hiding here…' The White Sovereign looked all around him.
There were countless droplets of water pouring down.
What was originally a flat and plain ground had transformed into a vast body of water, about a thousand meters deep.
'Those fools are entirely useless. They actually allowed him to enter the Demonic Maelstrom, and even let him go as far as this Vast Water World.' The White Sovereign was flying about at high speeds, using karma to confirm that not too far away was a five million kilometer area which seemed fuzzier than normal. Of course, it was where Xue Ying was hiding.
As he flew through the high sky, none of the omnipresent rainwater could touch the White Sovereign. On the surface of his body was an aura of blood and slaughter which isolated him from the rainwater completely.
Very soon, the White Sovereign reached the area where Xue Ying was hiding.
'Xue Ying could be hiding anywhere in this five million kilometers wide area.' The White Sovereign frowned. He extended his right hand slightly.
"Hong-"
A powerful, terrifying aura of blood and slaughter gushed downwards, spreading outwards to envelop the entire region within moments! It covered every single drop of water within this region. On top of that, immediately afterward, the accumulated water began to float, revealing the plain flat ground beneath. Even the gravel all over the plain flat ground was shrouded by the aura just the same.
All of that accumulated water condensed into an enormous sphere!
On top of that, the entire five million kilometers wide region beneath, up to a depth of 30,000 kilometers was completely shrouded by the aura of blood and slaughter, and all that gravel also began floating up to reveal the dark-red membrane underneath. The aura of blood and slaughter was isolating and protecting this place, allowing none of the rainwater to flow down here.
"Hong long long~" The White Sovereign changed his mind. All of a sudden, the enormous sphere made of water began to tremble as every last droplet swiftly dissipated.
'He's not here!' The White Sovereign immediately realized. With a wave of his hand, the water sphere flew aside.
Afterward, he brought up an even greater amount of the gravel making up the surface, again in a region of five million kilometers wide and 30,000 kilometers deep. How big was this? Even some of the bigger pieces of black bone were being dug out.
"Split!"
The White Sovereign's frosty eyes flashed.
At that moment, the aura of blood and slaughter invaded the gravel, turning it all to powder. The particles became even more minute, and even the originally firm pieces of black bone were broken to pieces. Before long, all that remained of them were countless black particles, which were very distinct from the other grayish-white pieces of gravel.
'Not here either…' The White Sovereign shook his head slightly. He threw these countless particles far into the distance, where they landed alongside accumulated water.
'He really is hiding within this thick membrane.' The White Sovereign began to see a headache coming his way.
He tried pressing down on the ground.
The aura of blood and slaughter pushed downwards on an area of the membrane that was a hundred or so meters wide, forming a hole roughly sixty meters deep.
'If he's hiding deep enough, it won't even matter if I press downwards. That would only cause the place he's hiding to go even deeper.' The White Sovereign shook his head. With a wave of his right hand, a sword appeared which he immediately proceeded to hack downwards. "Hong long long." Countless sword rays began descending, acting rampantly as they destroyed everything in their path. The membrane in a hundred meters wide area was destroyed up to a depth of about 150 meters. All of the membranes in the area was literally smashed to nothing.
Such a terrifying attack would have greatly shocked Xue Ying, had he seen it.
After all, he had used his spear to push onto a single point, and even then he created a hole that was no more than 120 meters deep. After all, Xue Ying merely used the combat power of an ordinary true god to analyze the power of a Paragon. He did not understand how unique it was for one to open up their own Dao path. Furthermore, the White Sovereign was also famous for his proficiency in battle and slaughter, giving him an even more extraordinary status.
'His combat power should let him reach a depth of no more than a hundred meters, which means I have to use attacks that hit at least that depth in order to have any chance of finding him.' The White Sovereign shook his head. 'If this is the largest area I can cover in a single hit, how long would it take me to search through a region that is a full five million kilometers wide?'
That was an extremely long time.
If it was the sake of something truly important, the White Sovereign might not have minded the hassle of searching every single area. Even if it meant spending more than a hundred million years doing this menial task, he would still have accepted it—that is how patient experts were! However, the first half of Blood Demon Scripture was not valuable enough in the eyes of the White Sovereign King. Especially so considering that the first half of the absolute art was only meant for those below the true god realm to cultivate.
On top of that, for someone at the level the White Sovereign was at, even the complete absolute art would not be too attractive! That is unless it was a very unique absolute art.
For instance, the absolute art of the Destruction Legion was known to provide the 'strongest defensive ability'. It was the strongest expert throughout all the many cosmos epochs, the Lake Heart Island master himself, who created it for the sake of his subordinates. One's defense was crucial on the path of cultivation. After all, the longer one lived, the further they could walk! Unfortunately, joining the Destruction Legion was too difficult. With the exception of Pang Yi, Xue Ying was the only one who barely managed to pass the selections.
Even he had only succeeded in passing the soldier rank trial.
As for the "Blood Demon Scripture", the White Sovereign would at most use it as a reference, as well as for the sake of determining the techniques used by the Ancestor Demon, the expert second only to the Lake Heart Island master across the many cosmos epochs. On the other hand, he could also use the original copy to teach his subordinates and disciples. At the very least, it was useful for those beneath the true god level to use.
However, this was all there was to it!
…
"Hu."
The White Sovereign left the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, then took a single step to arrive at a certain location high into the sky. Naturally, some chairs and a table made of clouds formed as he arrived here.
The White Sovereign sat here by himself and began enjoying some wine. At the same time, his domain spread out to envelop this entire layer of the Dark Abyss. Once Xue Ying left the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, he would have no chance of escaping him. As for his combat power? The White Sovereign had no care for such things.
"The White Sovereign himself gave up?" A figure appeared to his side. It was a bird-headed man wearing a black robe. His eyes were also glowing in a dim golden color.
"The first fifty layers of the Dark Abyss are my territory, which means that the first half of the Blood Demon Scripture also belongs to me," the White Sovereign indifferently said as he continued to drink. "Devil Kite, the other Paragons did not even come to try their hand. Your courage sure is considerable."
"Hehehe." Paragon Devil Kite laughed in a piercing voice. "White Sovereign, it's up to one's own combat power whether they acquire this treasure or not. Also, the first half of the Blood Demon Scripture is still on Dong Bo Xue Ying's body, so it can't be considered yours."
"Hmph hmph." The White Sovereign swept his gaze over, too lazy to acknowledge the other party's words.
He did not think too highly of Paragon Devil Kite.
In a direct battle, he could eliminate Devil Kite in just three moves! However, it would be impossible to ever fight him in a direct battle, since the Dao path opened by Paragon Devil Kite was not focused on killing, but fleeing. As such, the escaping techniques of Paragon Devil Kite were extraordinary. If he wished to flee… forget the White Sovereign, even the much stronger Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction could not do much about it. The White Sovereign could only treat such Paragons who could never be killed and were only proficient in running away, as non-existent.
"The Blood Demon Scripture are over in the Vast Water World. If you want to, you can continue searching for it." The White Sovereign King drank another cup of wine. In a single move, he was able to scout a region of the membrane which was roughly a hundred meters wide. But Paragon Devil Kite wasn't very proficient in combat, so he would be able to scout a region that was no wider than one meter at a time.
"Hehehe, just to get the Blood Demon Scripture? It's not worth it." Paragon Devil Kite carefully chose these words to say on the surface, but in reality, he was just unwilling to lose any face over this matter. After all, his searching speed was truly too slow!

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - Years of Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 578: Years of Time
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Within the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, inside Xue Ying's Cultivation Eden.
Xue Ying sat cross-legged on a flat region, with three items placed in front of him. One was a scarlet wristband, one a black whip, and the final one was a greataxe. These were the three items he obtained back when he discovered Paragon Dust Cloud's corpse back at Lake Heart Island. This mysterious paragon was an expert in the utilization of spacetime, and he had even refined three top-grade World Deity rank treasures, all of them specialized in manipulating spacetime.
'I'll just take some time to ponder these three World Deity items properly,' Xue Ying thought.
Even though his teacher, the Bloodshed God Emperor, provided him with some detailed pointers regarding the Time-Space Deity Heart, Xue Ying still wished to ponder these three World Deity ranked treasures, hoping to comprehend their secrets before comparing them to his teacher's guidance. He would then consolidate the resulting information and use it to further his cultivation.
'This scarlet wristband can be used to trap enemies.' Xue Ying carefully sensed the arrays within. This treasure allowed its user to keep their enemies trapped within. It excelled in its operation of spacetime which far surpassed the Time-Space Deity Heart category.
'This whip is also relatively unique.' Xue Ying then took up the black whip. It too had an array contained within, such that, when it was used to attack, it would direct the surrounding spacetime to form a domain which restricted one's enemies.
'The ax is the most tyrannical of the three items.' Xue Ying looked at the greataxe. Whenever this weapon was used to attack, it would break the spacetime continuum with terrifying power. However, Xue Ying's comprehension of spacetime was too low. In fact, forget the current him, even if he were to grasp hold of the complete Time-Space Deity Heart, it would still be difficult to truly comprehend the profound mysteries behind the arrays of this greataxe.
It was quite clear that long-dead paragon had refined these three unique weapons with the ultimate goal of refining a True God weapon. However, because of a lack of materials, he ultimately only ever managed to refine top-grade World Deity ranked weapons, albeit very unique for their rank.
'Let's begin.' Xue Ying started concentrating on pondering these three unique World Deity weapons, pouring his entire heart into trying to understand the Dao of Spacetime.
…
While Xue Ying was focused on his closed-door cultivation, all of the Abyss Sovereigns outside were feeling helpless. The Vast Water World was considerably dangerous to Abyss Sovereigns, and even the more powerful ones were still forced into conducting a carpet search throughout the entire area. Faced with the idea of searching a five billion kilometers wide area of membrane, they all decided they would rather give up. After all, their searching speed was too slow. Even after a full hundred million years of searching, they would at most have finished searching a very small portion. What if they spent more than a hundred million years? Considering Xue Ying's current improvement speed, he would have long since become a powerful existence.
They all knew their limits and thus gave up their pursuit.
Time passed, and Xue Ying continued to hide, not coming out even once! The Abyss Sovereigns who had gathered at the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain still saw no reward for their effort, while six of them even ended up dead inside the ruins themselves. Of course, this only meant they lost their avatars! Although many of the peak experts of the Dark Abyss frequently fought, all of them having avatars meant they would never truly lose their lives in battle.
Such events like the Sacred Master Crimson Dust's death were truly rare.
"They can't find him no matter what?"
"Dong Bo Xue Ying hid in the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain of the Dark Abyss. None of those sovereigns are able to find him."
"Interesting."
"His Highness Dong Bo sure knows how to hide."
"He still has to come out eventually, right? As soon as he leaves, there won't be any way for him to make his getaway."
The news had spread all across the Deity world. All of the powerful existences and even the stage four World Deities here were all discussing this matter.
In any case, the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain truly did calm down before long. Most of the Abyss Sovereigns left this layer of the Dark Abyss and returned to their own territories. It was only a select few who were unwilling to accept this outcome, and thus decided to stay!
Meanwhile, the number of people paying close to this event in both the Deity world and the Dark Abyss was gradually shrinking.
…
150,000 years passed in the blink of an eye.
In the Crimson Stone Courtyard of the Bloodshed God Palace. Jing Qiu, Monarch Mo Xue, and a few others were all currently found inside Xue Ying's cavern. Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao would occasionally stop by as well.
"Mother." Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao were standing side by side while Jing Qiu and Monarch Mo Xue were standing on the other side.
The aura Jing Qiu was currently emitting suddenly became even more extraordinary than normal, and a terrifying sharpness seemed to leave her body. She was constantly interacting with divine sword's aura. After cultivating for so many years, Jing Qiu successfully refined the true god weapon, and her grasp over the laws of the world became even stronger. As for her comprehension of the side Daos, she had grasped hold of the profound mysteries directly related to the divine sword, while her comprehension of the "Heart Sword Diagram" further deepened. Naturally, her combat power had improved greatly. While it was still lacking by a bit when compared to Monarch Mo Xue's, it was extremely close nonetheless.
If she were to make use of the true god weapon, not even Monarch Mo Xue could pose a threat to her. Such was the terror of a true god weapon.
"Qing Yao." Jing Qiu gave a few words of praise as she chuckled: "Not bad; you've already become a World Deity at your age without having to use faith stones. That's pretty good."
"Compared to father and mother, I'm still quite lacking." Qing Yao possessed extraordinary charm, though she was only ever obedient in front of her mother. However, her words were nothing but the truth. Forget Xue Ying, even Jing Qiu had become a World Deity very quickly in her previous life.
