"Hmph, hmph." To her side, Dong Bo Yu said through curled lips: "Stop being so humble. I'm sure you're pleased with having become a World Deity before me."
Even the frightfully obedient Qing Yao saw the corners of her lips curl upwards as she glanced towards her brother with an even more delighted expression.
Dong Bo Yu felt unhappy about the situation, but he was also in no position to say anything.
Jing Qiu simply giggled from the side.
These two siblings came into the world at the same time, so their relationship was very good. They had always been together, not just during their time in the Xia clan world, but even after they proceeded into the Crimson Rock Mountain world for training. Even though they had cultivated for so many years and their temperament was extraordinary, they would still casually tease each other whenever they met up. This had long since become a habit for them.
"Yu'er, you can't be too anxious in cultivation. What matters most is patience," Jing Qiu said. Monarch Mo Xue added from the side, "Yu'er, I think you should try to reach a more relaxed state of mind. It might prove helpful."
"Yes, grandpa." Dong Bo Yu nodded.
Due to the great worship he held in his heart for his father, Dong Bo Yu was quite diligent in his cultivation.
And now, he was also made aware of his mother's true identity. After all, Jing Qiu had already moved into the Bloodshed God Palace, and she had no plans on concealing this matter from her children! Once Xue Ying became a stage four World Deity and returned safely, he would naturally resolve the enmity his wife had with Forefather Golden Firmament.
"Mother, it's already been such a long time since father last showed up," Dong Bo Yu helplessly said.
"He's undergoing closed-doors cultivation. There's no need to be anxious," Jing Qiu said. 150,000 years had already passed since Xue Ying hid inside of the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain. Adding up the rest of his time spent cultivating would bring Xue Ying's total to more than 210,000 years. It was already certain that he would not break the record for becoming a stage four World Deity in the shortest period of time. The fastest person thus remained the Temporal Island Lord, who succeeded in 180,000 years.
"I wonder what stage Xue Ying's cultivation has reached." Jing Qiu was somewhat concerned, yet she knew that Xue Ying's true body was still in closed-doors cultivation back in the Crimson Rock Mountain. She could not see him, and neither would she dare disturb him.
…
In Xue Ying's Cultivation Eden over at the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain.
Xue Ying was standing on top of a tall mountain, carrying a crimson wristband. With a wave of his hand, the crimson wristband flew out. Once it was in mid-air, the spacetime within the wristband began to flow, swallowing a distant mountain range which began to tremble. Before long, every last mountain in the mountain range was pulled up from its roots and began flying rapidly towards the scarlet wristband. The closer it got, the smaller it became. In the end, the entire mountain turned into a single point and entered the scarlet wristband.
The scarlet wristband returned to Xue Ying's hands.
'I finally managed to activate this.' Xue Ying revealed a grin. He then continued immersing himself in the arrays of the scarlet wristband.
Of the three unique World Deity weapons, he found this scarlet wristband easiest to comprehend. After all, while the wristband contained profound mysteries related to spacetime, it also held some profound mysteries of the world. As a result, Xue Ying had a much easier time when comprehending it.
150,000 years had passed before he was able to truly activate the spacetime arrays within the wristband. Naturally, even now he could activate but a strand of it, and not completely control it.
However, this activation allowed Xue Ying to understand a great deal more things. Delighted by this result, he continued immersing himself in comprehending and researching the aspect of spacetime.
"Weng~"
A moment later, a grayish illusion spread all around him. In fact, even the surrounding mountains and plains began to distort under the effect of countless illusions from different periods of time.
Standing at the mountain peak, Xue Ying revealed a stunned expression. Only after a while did he break free from his focus on the crimson wristband. Just as he finished comprehending the spacetime array and without even realizing it, he actually succeeded in grasping hold of the Time-Space Deity Heart.
'I've already succeeded?' The corners of Xue Ying's lips curled up into a grin.
******

chapters.title: Chapter 579 - Stage Four
chapters.content:
Chapter 579: Stage Four
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Standing at the mountain's peak with the wind blowing down on him, Xue Ying looked toward the vast world in front of him. There was a continuous flat region ahead, and at the rear end of these plains was a community of farmers, complete with its own government, its own Transcendents and Deities…
Xue Ying then vaguely noticed a long river where countless humans, beasts, and other lifeforms seemed to be sinking. There were Deities and even World Deities here. In fact, Xue Ying even felt himself be a part of this very river! He was like a towering giant, and half of his body was above the surface of the water. From his vantage point, he could easily glance at all the countless lifeforms surrounding him. However, this long river emitted a powerful attractive force which pulled and bound him, preventing him from escaping.
'The River of Time?' Xue Ying nodded slightly.
It was only now that he grasped the Time-Space Deity Heart that he could finally 'see' the River of Time.
This rumored location was filled with countless lifeforms; even the dead continued existing within! As long as one was a lifeform born after the emergence of the cosmos and they had yet to escape from it, they would be found here! It was the goal of many others, as well as Xue Ying's, to transcend this River of Time and finally reach true eternity.
Otherwise, they would remain bound to the River of Time. Anyone stuck within would be unable to reach eternity.
'The laws of the world are truly orderly.' Xue Ying looked at the beautiful sceneries surrounding him, yet in his eyes, they were no longer vistas, but rather countless laws in operation.
Every central or essential law was like a string instrument, and it formed something like a 'law' zither!
At the moment, Xue Ying could comprehend and use four of these zithers, and even these four zithers alone could allow him to play beautiful music! This was just like how a long bridge that would normally be supported by nine pillars could also stand and be stable with just four! In any case, now that Xue Ying grasped hold of four grade one Deity Hearts, his understanding of the complete laws of the world was naturally at a very high stage.
On top of that, these four grade one Deity Hearts were core, essential parts of the world. They were imprinted on one another, thus allowing Xue Ying to begin gathering a comprehension towards all the other grade one Deity Hearts.
These were the so-called 'side Daos'. Once one's realm reached a high enough stage, they could smoothly sense various other Deity Heart. In fact, Xue Ying inwardly knew that he could even begin to comprehend the extremely mysterious 'Karma Deity Heart' if he so wished. Maybe comprehending the entire Karma Deity Heart would be very difficult, but comprehending a major part of it would be relatively easy.
Jing Qiu, for instance, had already comprehended the majority of it, and could now use it to sense where other people were located.
…
The world was like a ball of yarn, strung together by means of many strings.
At first, it seemed complex and chaotic, but upon grasping four of the main pillars, four of these strands of yarn, an expert could easily attempt to reorder the entire ball of yarn.
'I've finally taken this final step.' Xue Ying chuckled. However, if I were to leave with my current combat power, I'll most likely be easily stomped by the more formidable powerful existences like Emperor Qi Hai.'
The realm was, indeed, fundamental, but the factor that mattered most in a fight remained one's combat power. In Xue Ying's case, it meant the combined power of his spear technique secret skills, his absolute arts, and various other aspects of cultivation.
'Whether it's cultivating the "Luminous Sun" to the fourth boundary realm, or the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" to the fourth level, either would be extremely difficult.' Xue Ying understood this well. 'Still, the"Luminous Sun" and "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" use different sorts of profound mysteries. The one I should focus more on is… hmm, I think it's the"Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body".'
Even if he were to cultivate the "Luminous Sun" to the fourth boundary of the fourth volume, he would still die as soon as he left!
This fourth boundary was very formidable; it would allow him to reach an extremely powerful stage even amongst powerful existences—he would be at the very gates of the paragon realm. Most likely, even the Nine Yang Palace Head and the Purple-Gowned Hex Emperor were only close to this level. That's it, just very close! They would still be lacking in an actual fight against such enemies. After all, the Nine Yang Palace Head was one of the Temporal Island Lord's disciples, as well as a powerful existence who owned an absolute art.
The gap between stage four World Deities and powerful existences was small. After all, powerful stage four World Deities who accumulated power for a long enough time could practically comprehend the complete laws of the world, and they would only be lacking by a single bit in terms of the realm, even when compared to powerful existences.
When it came to the "Luminous Sun" absolute art, the fourth volume's fourth boundary would provide combat power comparable to the second boundary of the fifth volume. The only came in one's use of the laws. The fourth volume of "Luminous Sun" used the profound mysteries of side laws, and the fifth volume even used the complete law of the world. Cultivating to the second boundary was relatively easy, but reaching the third boundary of this fifth volume was way more difficult even than reaching the fourth boundary of the fourth volume!
And as for the fourth boundary of the fifth volume… by the time he reached that, he would certainly have already opened his own Dao path to become a Paragon. This is why Xue Ying felt that both the Nine Yang Palace Head and the Purple-Gowned Hex Emperor only one step away from opening their own Dao paths.
'While the "Luminous Sun" is formidable enough, especially since it allows my strength and speed to greatly increase, I'd still be eventually and killed if I were to ever face that a whole bunch of enemies at once!' Xue Ying understood this point well enough. 'Furthermore, the White Sovereign is also waiting outside.'
'If I wish to survive, I'll have to cultivate the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body",' Xue Ying thought to himself.
The Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body had the most heaven-shattering defensive ability he ever experienced! If his defenses were already so powerful, despite having only trained the technique to the third level, as soon as it reached the fourth level, nobody any weaker than a paragon could hope to injure him. Furthermore, the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body also provided him with incredible strength and speed.
'I must calm my heart, take it slowly.' Xue Ying was very clear that cultivating the fourth level of the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" was not any less difficult than the cultivating the fourth boundary of the "Luminous Sun"'s fourth volume. As such, it will definitely take a long time for him to succeed.
The fourth level of the"Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" already begun displaying just how powerful this absolute art truly was, but it was also reaching a more profound level.
At this point, the "Luminous Sun" and "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" began to move in different directions.
"Luminous Sun" cultivated one's energy to spawn the luminous sun force.
But the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" cultivated the substance, improving the body and creating the armor!
Xue Ying was fully aware of the fourth level's difficulty, but it was only once he actually started cultivating it that he realized that its difficulty far surpassed even his imagination…
******
Xue Ying had already become a stage four World Deity and immediately began concentrating on cultivating the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body". He knew nothing of what was happening outside.
In the clouds just outside the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, where tables and chairs made of a cloudy material were laid out.
The White Sovereign was sitting here, enjoying his wine and the scenery. He was fully appreciating every single point of beauty in the world.
"Sou." A figure suddenly appeared by his side belonging to a green-robed madame. She had a humanoid appearance and was relatively beautiful. The weapon she carried was a divine sword, and she seemed to be keeping her aura inside.
The White Sovereign looked at the madame, and could not help but be stunned. He actually took on a more reserved attitude as he laughed out. "I see you have arrived, monarch. Please, have a seat."
The green-robed madame chuckled then sat on one of the chairs. "Old White Ghost."
The corners of the White Sovereign's eyes could be seen twitching slightly.
There were not many experts in the entire Dark Abyss who would dare refer to him an 'Old White Ghost' to his face. In fact, the only person he could not be angry at was this woman sitting in front of him.
"Monarch, what's the matter?" White Sovereign chuckled.
"Old White Ghost, you sure are carefree. For the sake of that useless first half of some absolute art, you're actually wasting your time here?" The green-robed Madame shook her head.
"I've nothing to occupy my time with in any case. I'll be able to use that first half of the absolute art to teach my disciples, or to exchange for some treasures with Great Destruction," the White Sovereign said.
The green-robed madam solemnly said, "I have something important to tell you about."
"Something important?" the White Sovereign asked, a trace of anxiety in his voice.
"Indeed." The green-robed madame nodded. "While you were sitting here so carefree, the Ruler took me, the Hex Devil, the Bloodshed God Emperor of the Deity World, and the Overlord of Destruction together for an operation…" she began explaining in detail.
"Ruler Nile and the Bloodshed God Emperor?" White Sovereign carefully listened.
"The Temporal Island Lord is indeed a most cunning character, and he left no chance untouched. This time, we were schemed on by him. He, together with the Myriad God Palace Head and Empress Qian He, worked together to kill Ruler Nile and take away a most important treasure. Both my avatar and the Hex Devil's avatar died in the battle, as well as the Overlord of Destruction. The Bloodshed God Emperor escaped the battle alone, even when faced against the other three!" the green-robed madame said.
"What! Ruler Nile died?" The White Sovereign was shocked silent. Even though it was just an avatar who died, it still belonged to one of the three rulers of the Dark Abyss, the 'Bloody Ruler' Nile. For even his avatar to perish, it was easy to see just how intense the battle must have been.
"The relationship between Empress Qian He and the Bloodshed God Emperor is really good. To think that they would actually fall out at such a time." The White Sovereign shook his head.
"Isn't this a common theme, when a huge opportunity arises?" The green-robed Madame shook her head. "Which of these rulers do not wish to be the first to take that step?"
"Just what was this important treasure?" the White Sovereign hurriedly asked.
"I'm not sure. All I could see was that it had the appearance of a three-legged cauldron emitting a bloody aura. I would guess it is related to Ancestor Devil," the green-robed madame said. "Ruler Nile is furious. He scolded the Temporal Island Lord in his anger and considering his, there's a high chance he'll start a war against the Temporal Island in the following years."
White Sovereign sneered mildly. "Of the three rulers of our Dark Abyss, Ruler Nile is the weakest. For him to be the most irritable of the three is nothing but a joke."
The green-robed madam heard this, and could not help but comment: "You better pay more respect to the rulers."
"If there's ever anything troubling you, just come to find me," the White Sovereign said.

chapters.title: Chapter 580 - Refining the Flying Blade
chapters.content:
Chapter 580: Refining the Flying Blade
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying only wished to cultivate the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" to the fourth level, yet as he studied deeper, he came across many more hard problems. If it were just the 'Substance Deity Heart', then that would be fine, as it was not difficult to deduce and grasp hold of a new deity heart with his current realm. But the fourth level of the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body was not merely the Substance Deity Heart…
It sought after the pinnacle of Substance, and its usage of the laws of substance was extremely high. Furthermore, the fundamental makeup of 'substance' required the inner world, and the strength of the inner world had an enormous influence on the power of the entire armor.
The black armor on the surface of his body might seem like one, yet it was actually just a durable substance comprised of countless worlds.
'The laws of substance must be properly comprehended over, and my understanding of the profound mysteries of the world still need to be improved further.' If Xue Ying wished to improve his usage of the laws of substance, he could only singed-mindedly experience it over and over again. Yet the improvement of the 'profound mysteries of the world' could be achieved by other methods-refining the True God Weapon Flying Blade.
…
In the Xia Clan World, within the Eden treasure, Crimson Rock Mountain.
The white-clothed Xue Ying was currently seated cross-legged underneath a large tree within the courtyard. There was a flying knife that was sheathed floating in front of him currently. At that moment, his consciousness permeated into it.
That was the True God weapon's interior space of laws, just like the Xia Clan World's 'Realm Heart' room.
A black world. It was seemingly real, yet it also contained a strange and illusory feel.
'Mirage, it can develop into a true world's Mirage.' Xue Ying thought, 'Its usage of the World has already exceeded the natural Law of the World! Refining this Flying Blade will also greatly improve my usage of the 'Law of the World.'
Mirage.
It was originally a portion of the world albeit a reflection of the true world. Yet the possibilities in the Mirage were endless.
But the Mirage within this True God Weapon included all laws of a complete world-the World's cracks, the Shadow World, the True World, etc. were all included. Furthermore, it also had the distinctive illusory feel of the Mirage! This unreal feel enveloped the entire dark world and was also something that made Xue Ying feel unfathomable.
'The world embraces a single grit. Yet within that grit, a world can similarly be contained within.' Xue Ying thought, 'Everybody says that the Temporal Island Master is most skilled in Space-Time and that my teacher is very skilled at 'Shadow'; he is also the most terrifying assassin in the Deity world and Dark Abyss. 'Shadow', is originally only a grade two Deity Heart, yet teacher has already improved the those 'Shadow' techniques beyond the Law of the World.'
As Xue Ying had received the absolute arts "Luminous Sun" and "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body", he understood it clearly.
Comprehending the complete Law of the World would only enable one to become an ordinary True God!
Only when one opened their own Dao, reaching beyond the Law of the World, would one become a Paragon. A regular stage four World Deity would perhaps not understand how extraordinary Paragons were, and Xue Ying had merely understood a little by looking through the descriptions written in the absolute arts he cultivated in.
'I'll take it slowly. I haven't even understood the complete Law of the World, so it's better for me not to think about opening my own Dao.' Xue Ying attentively perceived.
The dark illusory world seemed real and illusory.
Suddenly-
A small light spot appeared in front of Xue Ying's consciousness with a flash before penetrating through!
'Slaughter.' Xue Ying understood then.
The flying blade was originally meant for killing enemies! Within the flying blade True God Weapon, aside from the extraordinary laws of the Mirage, there were some exceedingly terrifying slaughters laws as well. These slaughter laws had similarly exceeded the ordinary Law of the World.
Because of these two points, the flying blade's power was extremely formidable.
Of course, while refining the True God Weapon, 99% of Xue Ying's thoughts were on the 'Profound Mysteries of the World'. Occasionally, he would ponder a little over the 'Slaughter laws' contained within that spot of light to relax.
…
Time was ruthless.
Under a hundred times time-accelerated environment, Xue Ying gradually became accustomed to the seemingly endless period of time. His thoughts were entirely immersed amongst the countless laws and profound mysteries. Even if he were not meticulously cultivating, he would comprehend other laws under the world, understanding a vast deal of profound mysteries in other aspects, thus broadening his mindset. He even had that kind of feeling as if he could understand the entire world.
This was not a misconception, but rather an authentic feeling. Because of the improvement in his understanding towards the Law of the World along with his speed of cultivation, he was sure he could grasp hold of every single law and profound mystery. But understanding all the components of a towering skyscraper did not mean that one would be able to build a tower. By the same principle, comprehending all the laws and profound mysteries did not indicate that one had a complete understanding of the Law of the World. This was the gap that grade one True Meaning Transcendents like Xue Ying and the others wished to transcend beyond, and needed to surpass.
Many grade one True Meaning Transcendents would be able to smoothly cultivate into a stage four World Deity! Yet they would eventually be unable of transcending!
Of course, for those stage four World Deities who had absorbed a significant amount of belief energy, and were plagued with karma, grasping the Karma Deity Heart would be a huge problem. Under the bindings of many karmas, understanding the complete Law of the World was even harder.
'I've successfully refined it.'
In the eighty thousand years after becoming a stage four World Deity, Xue Ying finally refined the True God Weapon flying blade!
Refining it was relatively easy-as long as one had some understanding towards the laws within it, one could use the True God weapon without having to completely grasp it.
"True God Weapon.
The white-clothed Xue Ying stood amidst the clouds. He then unsheathed that flying blade.
The handle of the Flying Blade was black, and the edge of the blade was suffused with a silver-white glow.
It seemed like an ordinary flying knife.
Yet this was actually a True God Weapon that contained two Daos above the Law of the World.
"Xiu."
Xue Ying flung out his right hand, causing the flying blade to disappear without a trace.
'It has disappeared? Master, I could not sense its existence at all!' The treasure spirit Crimson Rock immediately transmitted.
"Shua!"
In the distance, a tiny ray of light suddenly flickered.
As that tiny ray of light suddenly disappeared, Xue Ying looked down at his side-the flying knife had already reappeared sheathed in the scabbard by his side!
'Killing the enemy without a sound-my understanding towards it is now clear. If it were in the hands of its creator, its power would perhaps be much greater.' Xue Ying also understood why all powerful existences longed for a True God Weapon. In addition to increasing their strength, the other benefit was that they could use the weapon as guidance towards comprehending a 'Dao' that was above the Law of the World.
Everybody talked about opening their own Dao, yet within this Flying Blade, there were two types of 'Dao' included.
For those powerful existences who were stuck in a bottleneck without having any idea of how to break through, how could they not long for this? It was typical for Nine Yang Palace Head and the others to crave for it, but the cosmos possessed many unseen rules operating within. Back then, Monarch Mo Xue had gone to those hazardous areas by his own volition, and it was natural that he could be the first to discover the True God Weapon.
Only with his efforts could Jing Qiu get the weapon.
Xue Ying had arduously entered the Destruction Legion, and only then was he qualified in earning that single True God Weapon.
…
Although he had refined the True God Weapon, his understanding towards the profound mysteries of the world was still not enough. Currently, he was still in the midst of comprehending the profound mysteries of Substance, all the way until the 110,000th year since he became a stage four World Deity.
In the 'Vast Water World' of the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, within the Eden treasure.
Xue Ying sat with his legs crossed on the vast grassland, trying to cultivate the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body"over and over again. Every single time he did so, he would gain some enlightenment for which he would proceed on with it.
"Hong!" Suddenly a terrifying aura surged forth with Xue Ying at the center. The surrounding grassland had been completely destroyed in that split second, with the distant mountains turning into fine powder. However, this surge of aura had been isolated within a range of one million meters by the treasure spirit. Within this area of one million meters, there were no other creatures. It was a forbidden area, and Xue Ying had cultivated there.
Xue Ying's skin which was exposed, his fingers, muscles, bones, skin, and the flesh on his face faintly trembled. It was an entire world was being created inside; it contained a massive amount of energy. Even the aura emitted was incomparably shocking.
'I've succeeded, I've finally succeeded.' Xue Ying felt joyous from the bottom of his heart. He had finally succeeded, and his body had already begun to evolve from its most fundamental component. Every single particle within his body was a chaotic world in itself, and in each chaotic world, no less than seven black holes were revolving around each other with a terrifying suction force, making the seven black holes maintain a strange equilibrium.
Of the seven black holes, some were big, and some were small, and their suction forces influenced each other, making the density of the entire chaotic world extremely high and thus, maximizing the degree of stability too.
Each particle within Xue Ying's body had already contained endless might! And the particles which formed his hair, flesh, and skin were naturally even more extraordinary!
His body began to transform rapidly. At his current level, it was simple to destroy the starry sky with a snap of his fingers. Because he had cultivated the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body", even if he did not have his armor on, just his body would rival the ninth level of "Time Immemorial Body".

chapters.title: Chapter 581 - Exiting the Closed-Door Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 581: Exiting the Closed-Door Cultivation
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
There was once the Destruction Legion commander had given him enough precious materials to train the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" to the fourth level. Thus, Xue Ying was able to reach grand perfection in a single breath.
"Hua hua hua~"
Vast Water World-it was just a piece of ocean. The water was over 5,000 kilometers deep.
Xiu!
A stream of light shot up to the sky, breaking out of the water surface to reach the sky above. His entire body was enveloped in black armor. Even his face was covered in a soft black mask. It was precisely Xue Ying who had entered closed-door cultivation for 260,000 years. Actually, to cultivators, going into closed-door cultivation for one million years straight was normal. Some World Deities who had wanted to alleviate the fatigue of their hearts might even sleep for more than 100 million years.
Xue Ying was still very young. Naturally, he did not require to sleep for long periods of time.
"I'm out." Xue Ying's gaze swept across the immense Vast Water World. Previously when he came, this was just a piece of plain flat ground. And now, it was a piece of water body. The water body had a strong erosion power, though the black armor on his body had a qualitative change, and even, the soaring luminous sun force covering his body was able to isolate the water flow. Even though he did not train in the Luminous Sun deliberately, after cultivating for so long, his Luminous Sun cultivation had naturally significantly improved. He reached the third boundary of the fourth volume. Regardless, its contribution to the increase of his combat power wasn't as evident as that of the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body.
"Karmic Sensing!"
Xue Ying thoroughly sensed.
He had yet to grasp hold of the complete Karma Deity Heart, but he had grasped hold of the majority. Within his senses, he could feel many imaginary karmic lines connecting his body to other lives, of which the most obvious karmic line was connecting himself and his true body. This karmic line was pitch black in color and seemed real. The enemies could possibly use this karma to attack his true body when killing him!
Naturally, his true body was in the material realm and was under the protection of the laws of the material realm. Those who were powerful like his teacher and Temporal Island Lord could rely on the great karma formed on oath, but they could only kill a stage three World Deity at most located within the material realm.
Other than the strongest karma happening between himself and his true body, the second strongest karma was with his wife Jing Qiu, and his son Dong Bo Yu, his daughter Qing Yao, his little brother Qing Shi and his parents and loved ones. The karma between him and Bloodshed God Emperor was ranked behind.
In the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, there were nine Abyss Sovereigns who had formed karma with his existence. But the karma was much lighter
"I would not have thought that there are still nine Abyss Sovereigns now at the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain even now." Xue Ying relied on the lines of karma to quickly deduce the approximate positions of where the enemies were. For such enemies to chase after him, it wasn't that easy.
"White Sovereign King!" Xue Ying's heart reminisced him, though this line of karma was vaguely trembling.
That line of karma connecting himself and the other person outside the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, though he was still on this level of Abyss World. It was attached to a line that was vaguely emitting a bloodiness which caused others to feel their hearts tremble.
"White Sovereign King is actually still on this level of Abyss World?" Xue Ying lightly shook his head, "Troublesome."
"Whatever. Since I could rely on karma to get an approximate position of the others, I will no longer be bullied so easily by them anymore." Xue Ying turned into a stream of light. His current speed was much faster than before. He directly flew towards that enormous exit of the Vast Water World! As for the location where the Blood Demon Scripture was hidden, he naturally knew about it, though it was not the time for him to bring it along.
Because White Sovereign King was still making Xue Ying feel a considerable pressure. He did not have the certainty of surviving after White Sovereign King acted!
But he had to come out regardless!
His own combat power had reached a new high, and cultivating would not improve his strength further.
"Sou."
Going through the entrance of the Vast Water World, he immediately entered the Demonic Maelstrom.
'I'm not in a rush to leave. Let's follow along my senses to go and have a look at what exactly is it that attracted this piece of remnant piece." Xue Ying's right hand flipped, causing a crimson sharp remnant piece to appear. There were ancient markings on it, and now, it was vaguely trembling as if it was being attracted by a strong force, "I truly do not know when is the next time I'll return after leaving the Dark Abyss this time."
'Everyone is suppressed within the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, and they could only fly slowly. It isn't as dangerous for me.' Xue Ying thought. And the moment he left, White Sovereign King could most likely tear through the world until he reached him! By then, he would have to deal with him!
Hu!
Within the Demonic Maelstrom, following along his senses, Xue Ying was also moving forward along the maelstrom.
…
"He is out." This was a male wearing an azure armor. He had a single horn protruding from his head. His eyes were dark yellow in color. This was after he turned humanoid. He was actually a great existence in the entire Dark Abyss-King Patrol Devil! He had lived for an extremely long time, and his combat power was much stronger than even Monarch Gu Zang, Nine Yang Palace Head, and Violet Gown Hex Poison.
King Patrol Devil's eyes were calm, ""Blood Demon Scripture" is one of the six grand inheritances of Ancestor Devil. It might be the hope for me in opening my Dao path."
"He is out?" Over at another place, there was an octopus lifeform currently entangled around a giant rock-'Emperor Qi Hai'. His figure was huge, and there was a single eye on His head. His voice was mighty as he muttered to himself, "260,000 years. Adding up the total time from when he is born, he should have cultivated for more than 300,000 years. With his talent, he should have long become a stage four World Deity. Hmph, unless he thought he could survive as a stage four World Deity? Hmph hmph hmph, as long as he is being shackled by me, he will definitely die."
Other than these two, there were seven others.
These two were existences closer to the Paragon realm. Naturally, King Patrol Devil's reputation was the biggest. Emperor Qi Hai's was weaker.
…
Outside the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, above the cloud layer, there were cloud chairs and table.
White Sovereign King was enjoying his wine in a carefree mood. He looked toward the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain that had practically reached the sky membrane of this world, "This Dong Bo Xue Ying finally exits. It has been only 260,000 years-such a short period."
To him, a single daydream could last for a million to 10 million years.
******
Xue Ying followed along the Demonic Maelstrom, before entering a bent passage according to his senses.
The passage was very long.
Xue Ying had also borrowed on karma to sense the positions of his enemies. Of those nine Abyss Sovereigns, Xue Ying did not care about seven of them. He only had to truly focus on King Patrol Devil and Emperor Qi Hai.
"Why am I getting closer to Emperor Qi Hai?" Xue Ying pursed his lips, "It's good that he isn't with King Patrol Devil."
Sou!
He flew at high speed. Xue Ying's unfathomable powerful body allowed him to reach such a transcendental speed. Emperor Qi Hai wasn't too good at the speed aspect, and Xue Ying was still confident of dealing against him.
"Weng weng weng~" The crimson sharp remnant piece placed in his storage treasure was constantly trembling. The trembling force was becoming stronger.
"Soon." Xue Ying vaguely understood this point.
This bent passage was very very long.
Xue Ying turned into a stream of light, moving forward steadily. He had also met many side paths, and relying on the senses of the remnant piece, he chose the right way! Every single side path would lead to a narrower location. From the beginning passage of more than 50 million kilometers in diameter… after moving through more than 100 side paths, the current passage was only about half a meter in diameter. Xue Ying was forced to shrink his body.
Reaching his level, the body could be big or small. Big-his finger could curl around a planet. Small-it could become even smaller than dust.
"I'm here."
Only then did Xue Ying finally stopped.
He looked upwards. On the wall of the passage, there was a crimson sharp remnant piece stuck in an oblique position. It was almost the same as the piece he had.
"The passage of Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain is substantial. I can't even damage it at all, yet this piece of remnant piece is able to pierce into it?" Xue Ying was inwardly startled. He then brought out the other crimson sharp remnant piece with a flip of his hand.
Sou.
The crimson sharp remnant piece pierced in the wall of the passage immediately flew out at the speed of lightning. It had practically fused together with the bit in Xue Ying's hand. Initially, it was just a remnant piece. As the two came combining together, it had formed a complete crimson talisman. Xue Ying felt the talisman, feeling information transmitting over from within.
"Mn?" Xue Ying's expression had a slight chance.
It was out of his expectations.
"Is it a blessing or a disaster?" Xue Ying muttered to himself. He then turned around, looking at how Emperor Qi Hai was currently moving closer to his location. The other eight Abyss Sovereigns were also moving closer to him, though some had stopped by the side of the Demonic Maelstrom. The Demonic Maelstrom was much more chaotic, and when flying along it, one might travel through time-space, unknowingly reaching some dangerous location.
"Hurry off. If I were to be surrounded by all of them, I'd be in trouble." Xue Ying turned into a stream of light before flying in the direction he came from rapidly. He did not dare to continue ahead. This piece of passage was becoming narrower and narrower. Who knew if it was a dead end! He had to follow by the path he came from.

chapters.title: Chapter 582 - Emperor Qi Hai Intercept
chapters.content:
Chapter 582: Emperor Qi Hai Intercept
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying turned into a streamer. He traveled at high speed within the bent passage and followed along the path he took to reach here. As he proceeded back through many of the sidepaths, the passageway became wider and wider.
"He isn't actually running and is flying towards me?" Emperor Qi Hai floated in the passage. His eight tentacles were floating, with the single eye staring at the passage ahead. The mouth on his ugly head had a weird smile, "Previously, he escaped successfully from me. Does he think I can't capture him? Heh heh heh, this young brat is truly overconfident of himself!"
Emperor Qi Hai felt that he had seen many of the secrets of this vast cosmos over his long life, and had become even more reverence after knowing more about the powerful experts in the past cosmos epochs like 'Lake Heart Island master' and 'Ancestor Devil'! From how he sees it, Xue Ying was truly too overconfident of himself! Being a stage four World Deity, he proclaimed himself hegemon after thinking he could slightly fight against the more ordinary powerful existence and deduced that he should be able to compete against those close to Paragon in combat power. What a joke!
One had to know, those who could fight against him, Emperor Qi Hai, included only those like Monarch Gu Zang or Nine Yang Palace Head. They were either the personal disciples of Rulers or were powerful True Gods with absolute arts! Or that they had a considerable foundation like King Patrol Devil and Violet-Gowned Hex Emperor.
"Xiu."
As the two parties grew closer, Emperor Qi Hai remained unmoving. His figure became bigger and bigger, and his eight tentacles were practically almost touching the boundary of this 5 million kilometers diameter passage. It was not that they could not become bigger, but it was that their flexibility would be significantly affected in battle if they became too big.
"He is here." Emperor Qi Hai seriously faced this. Over his extended period of life, he understood one thing-he should never treat his opponents lightly! Anything could happen in the vast cosmos. Only when he used all his strength would he be able to greatly reduce the chances of accidents.
"Mn? Emperor Qi Hai!"
Xue Ying was flying at high speed. His eyes were able to penetrate through the influence of time-space to look at that towering figure of Emperor Qi Hai! If he were in the external world and weren't affected by the suppression of Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, Xue Ying would be able to see a further distance.
"He is quite confident." Xue Ying flew at high speed. A scarlet spear had already appeared in his hand. It was the scarlet cloud spear.
The distance between the two became closer.
15 million kilometers, 10 million kilometers, 5 million kilometers…
"Your Highness Dong Bo, you can't pass through this road." Emperor Qi Hai's rich voice reverberated within the entire passageway.
"Emperor Qi Hai, the path is vast. You aren't able to block me." Xue Ying's voice similarly reverberated in this piece of space. His speed did not decrease at all.
The expression of Emperor Qi Hai became much more solemn, 'This Dong Bo Xue Ying's speed is very fast. It seems from his aura that he has become a stage four World Deity, and his speed is actually faster by a multitude as compared to previously! He was already slightly faster than me previously. Just considering flying speed, I am not able to match him. But what I specialize isn't escaping but frontal battles.' Emperor Qi Hai looked at Xue Ying who was rushing at him with high speed, and began acting immediately!
One could see his eight large tentacles moving directly. They created fluctuations in time-space, and his eight tentacles had vaguely formed an enormous time-space maelstrom. The time-space vortex generated a compelling attraction collapsing force. This force had caused many chaotic holes to develop around them.
The eight tentacles had practically covered the entire passageway.
With the time-space maelstrom that was spread across the whole passage, Xue Ying had no places to escape from.
"Hmph." Xue Ying sent out the spear in his hand.
The spear became long immediately. Surrounding the spearhead, many rings of absolute darkness were formed. Outside these rings of darkness, it was a light that was absolutely dazzling! The dazzling light was akin to a sun appearing in front of it.
That time when Xue Ying displayed the secret skill 'Destruction', he had to undergo the first two spears before he could display the truly terrifying third spear. And now, after cultivating for over 200,000 years, in addition to the hundred-times time accelerated environment, he had practically cultivated for over 10 million years. His true body's understanding of the law of the world had greatly increased. Furthermore, just refining the True God weapon 'Flying Knife' alone, the True God weapon had two 'Daos' within. One was the Dao of Mirage, and the other was the Dao of Slaughter! Xue Ying refined the True God weapon, obtaining some experienced of the Slaughter Dao from within, allowing his spear techniques to have a vast qualitative change. Currently, any single spear of his was able to have that terrifying destruction force. And if he had used three spears to accumulate in power, it would become even more amazing.
"Hong long long~"
The spear turned into a dazzling sun, effectively piercing through the time-space maelstrom. Many of the surrounding micro-chaos holes began becoming destroyed. The attractive force had grown messy, and the time-space vortex was even trembling. The eight huge tentacles came striking together.
"Peng!" The power of the spear met with the eight tentacles.
"What!" Emperor Qi Hai was startled. He felt that Xue Ying's spear contained an extremely intense penetrative force. The power was so strong he could not suppress it! Emperor Qi Hai's head immediately evaded from his current position. "Hua"! The spear vigorously pierced through the obstacles formed by the eight tentacles, piercing by the side of his head.
Hereafter, Xue Ying immediately moved his spear sideways at speed as fast as lightning!
One of the tentacles of Emperor Qi Hai had flexibly moved away. With the transformation of time-space, the tentacle had strangely appeared in front of the spear.
"Peng." The spear slapped against the tentacle. Following which, it struck out on Emperor Qi Hai's head.
Emperor Qi Hai's immense body had been forced to the side, heavily clashing against the stone passage wall.
'His strength is so powerful, so much stronger than mine. Most likely, amongst powerful existences, those who could use strength to suppress him includes only those with strength King Patrol Devil had.' Emperor Qi Hai was greatly alarmed.
Xue Ying had two absolute arts.
Luminous Sun was filled with Yang and was hard. It was able to become unparalleled with its ferocity, and it specialized in strength and speed. Currently, Xue Ying had cultivated it to the fourth volume third boundary realm.
The Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body was the so-called inheritance technique created by the strongest expert in the many cosmos epochs, the Lake Heart Island master. It similarly specialized in strength and speed! One's defenses would be unparalleled with it, and now that he reached the fourth level, his strength and speed were able to match the fourth boundary realm of Luminous Sun.
Two absolute arts fusing together.
One was the strength of his inner body, and the other was the strength of his substance body. The luminous sun force was able to display an even stronger advantage over its opponent. With the two fusing together, Xue Ying's strength and speed were much more fierce.
Wanting to triumph over him regarding power, the powerful existence must similarly learn an absolute art specializing in power. Emperor Qi Hai was apparently not such an existence. He might have many experiences of adventuring, but he had only cultivated an absolute art which was cultivated by a True God previously and some ancient technique remnant pieces! He then ultimately created quite a vile and unique cultivation technique, allowing him to stand on an equal level with Nine Yang Palace Head and the others.
But at least he wasn't able to grasp hold of an advantage concerning strength.
"You can't escape!" Emperor Qi Hai had been slapped until he was slammed against the passage stone wall. Even though he was greatly startled, he did not hesitate in displaying the killing move of his self-created absolute art.
Weng, Weng, Weng, Weng, Weng, Weng, Weng, Weng!
One could see his eight tentacles breaking at the same time.
His true body had new tentacles forming, and those eight tentacles immediately turned into demons which were entirely red in color. All of them had a pair of horns, and their knees were reversely connected. Their body was muscular, and the eight demons all had a tentacle tail.
"Scram." At the same time Xue Ying slapped out at Emperor Qi Hai, he was already flying away at high speed. After the eight tentacles turned into eight demons, Xue Ying had already killed his way to the eight demons, and amongst which, two nearest demons were snarling as they tried obstructing him.
"Peng peng peng…"
Xue Ying did not stop at all. He used his strength to wave his spear.
"Peng peng!"
The spear was very flexible. And his speed and strength both surpassed that of his opponents. It directly forced the two demons apart.
Xiu.
Xue Ying's true body had flashed and crossed over.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, don't escape!" Emperor Qi Hai roared furiously. His eight demon avatars were similarly snarling out as well.
"Emperor Qi Hai, I'll not play with you anymore. I'll first take my leave." Xue Ying naturally knew the perfect technique which Emperor Qi Hai was known for. His ability to divide into eight huge avatars was well-known, and every single avatar of his had a strength comparable to his true body! If in the external world, he could form world bodies, and every single demon avatar could do so.
His true body and eight demon avatars could turn into a total of 81 bodies!
Thus, Emperor Qi Hai specialized in flock attack!
"He actually…" Seeing Xue Ying rapidly flying away, his speed was more than a time faster than his, and Emperor Qi Hai felt genuinely indignant and helpless.
He was very clear that Xue Ying's speed was swift. That was why he performed a domain-related absolute move, the 'Time-Space Huge World', to try and trap Xue Ying. But it's a pity that Xue Ying's strength had far surpassed his imagination. A single spear was able to destroy his Time-Space Huge World! As for flock attack, Emperor Qi Hai was clear that even if he teamed up together with the other eight weaker demon avatars, with Xue Ying's speed that was faster than his by more than a time, as long as he found a gap, he could easily escape.
'Chase! There should not just be me alone in the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain.' The eight demon avatars rapidly turned into streamer as they entered Emperor Qi Hai's body. Emperor Qi Hai immediately continued chasing, though his speed was obviously slower by too much.

chapters.title: Chapter 583 - Fighting One on Three (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 583: Fighting One on Three (1)
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
After throwing Emperor Qi Hai behind, Xue Ying raised his speed to the limit to travel through the bent and dark passage.
'Indeed, he is Emperor Qi Hai. That Time-Space Huge World is very mystical.' Xue Ying thought back to the short fight he had as he flew along. After all, during those years he was in closed-door cultivation, he had been primarily cultivating in the World Deity Heart, and had refined the True God weapon Flying Knife. Thus, his experience towards the profound mysteries of the world had greatly increased. As such, he could see how extraordinary the 'Time-Space Huge World' was.
Not just this, of the three unique weapons which Xue Ying had gotten from the mysterious Paragon expert corpse which had been frozen sealed, they all contained the 'Dao of Time-Space'. Amongst which, one was used to trap the enemy, and the two were alike. Thus, he could see the unique points of this move made by Emperor Qi Hai.
'Scarlet wristband's usage of time-space is even more amazing. It has already placed above the laws of the world, and is of opening the dao of time-space.' Xue Ying thought, 'Emperor Qi Hai might be strong, but he has not opened his own Dao path. Still, he is able to fuse time-space and world together, forming a sealed world. If my combat power is slightly weaker, then I'll not be able to break that terrifying maelstrom, and will only be swallowed into the Time-Space Huge World and be suppressed and trapped.'
Xue Ying praised inwardly.
He was confident of his comprehension of the world aspect, but comparing with Emperor Qi Hai, he felt ashamed for being inferior. At least, the current him was able to see through what is real and what is false. Clearly, the gap in between the two wasn't as exaggerated like that previously as a stage three World Deity.
'His self-created fission avatar technique is also very amazing.' Xue Ying recalled when the demon avatars were formed from eight of the tentacles. It was like his world bodies, a technique that borrowed on the world energy to condense them. What was the world energy? That was the fundamental force of a world, and it could transform into the myriad existences. Thus, borrowing the world energy could allow him to transform into anything.
It could form an avatar, or it could form a weapon.
Naturally, it was on the condition that he understood everything from the essence! Like the luminous sun force or the Extreme Mysterious Annihilation Body, he had completely comprehended them and could form them. Like the usual gold, silver, mountain rocks and other simple materials, he could simply see through the fundamental structure and transform into those objects. But for the Blood Refined Deity Warrior like 'Scarlet Cloud Spear', since he was unable to see through the structure of the many materials used, he could not transform into it, and could only transform into some of the more ordinary weapons.
But there was a huge flaw with the world energy! The moment the enemy's usage of world energy was stronger, he would be able to snatch away the control rights of the world energy. He would have no way of fighting that.
Or for instance, at the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain or Lake Heart Island, these ancient locations suppressed specific laws. Xue Ying would not be able to control even the slightest strand of world energy. He was also unable to tear through time-space or display his world deity domains and other external strengths! He could only depend on himself.
'His fission avatar is a technique stemming from himself without any external requirements.' Xue Ying thought, 'His tentacles are able to form avatars, and they can maintain their strong combat power. This should be some unique body remodeling secret technique.'
Like Bloodshed God Palace's third class legion, second class legion and first class legion, the soldiers would all undergo a body remodeling.
Emperor Qi Hai had apparently experienced some unique body remodeling technique. Even though the eight demon avatars were slightly weaker, they could still allow his combat power to increase by a few times. This was a very formidable technique.
'If in frontal combat, his usage of the realm is ultimately higher than me. It will be hard for me to obtain victory.' Xue Ying thought. He did not feel discouraged because every expert had their specialties. He had his own too.
"Mn?"
At this moment, his distance to the Demonic Maelstrom was only about 100 million kilometers away when Xue Ying's expression changed color, "Such a coincidence?"
He could clearly sense.
There were two Abyss Sovereigns who were traveling through the Demonic Maelstrom, crossing through time-space and amongst which, one single travel actually directly landed them at the end of the road ahead of his path. They had already entered this bent passage.
'Demonic Maelstrom. Flying within, one will travel through time-space that doesn't contain any rules. Yet it is so coincidental that they ended up at my location?' Xue Ying was speechless, 'Fortunately, they are just two ordinary Abyss Sovereigns!"
In Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, amongst these Abyss Sovereigns, only King Patrol Devil and Emperor Qi Hai could be considered to be on his level.
King Patrol Devil was someone Xue Ying wished not to meet the most!
…
"We actually reached him."
The two Abyss Sovereigns reached the entrance of the bent passage as they left the Demonic Maelstrom. Joyous expression filled their faces.
"Previously, borrowing on karma sense, we could feel that this Highness Dong Bo is reaching the Demonic Maelstrom soon, and will most likely escape to an even further location. We thought we could not reach up to him! But who would have thought that one single travel through the time-space in Demonic Maelstrom allowed us to reach the location." One who was translucent, and had dozens of antennas, a plump Abyss Sovereign said.
"Mn, our luck is not bad." The other gray-robed Abyss Sovereigns nodded.
"Sovereign Du Luo, do you have the confidence of trapping this Highness Dong Bo behind? He is most likely a stage four World Deity and has become stronger by much. And according to my karma sense, previously, Emperor Qi Hai isn't able to obstruct him at all." The translucent plump Abyss Sovereign said.
"Rest assured, as long as you are able to keep me safe, then I'm absolutely sure I can hold him back." The gray-robed Abyss Sovereigns confidently declared, "I cultivated for 50 billion years for the sake of seeking an opportunity. This is a ripe chance for us. As long as we succeed… with the personality of White Sovereign King, imparting the first half of the "Blood Demon Scripture" is assured. Who knows, we might possibly obtain the entire inheritance from the "Blood Demon Scripture"."
"Mn." The plump Abyss Sovereign nodded.
The gray-robed Abyss Sovereign glanced at his partner, 'Sovereign Qu Fu'. This was a partner he chose because he knew that His Highness Dong Bo was able to fight against powerful everyday existences when he was a stage three World Deity; his advantage in strength was undeniable. After becoming a stage four World Deity, his combat power should become even stronger. In the history, some of the apex World Deities could also have a combat power close to that of a Paragon as a stage four World Deity.
Thus, he pulled along this partner who was known for his defenses.
"This time, it is my biggest chance. As long as I succeed, my contribution will be the greatest, and the hopes of getting the complete version of the blood demon scripture are huge too. Even if it is just the first half… the moment I succeed, my combat power will surely increase greatly." The gray-robed Abyss Sovereign's eyes were filled with desire. Even if the absolute art were on the level of a stage four realm, if he could succeed in doing it, he would have a combat power close to that of a Paragon.
"Hu hu."
The two of them turned into streamer before proceeding forward to block the road.
The bent passage contained only a single way. Facing these two ordinary Abyss Sovereigns, Xue Ying would definitely not retreat. Even when facing Emperor Qi Hai, he had just charged ahead directly, so why would he be afraid of two ordinary Abyss Sovereigns?
'One is Sovereign Du Luo, and the other is Sovereign Qu Fu. Sovereign Qu Fu has cultivated in the aspect of defense and survivability to a very high realm, and is enough to match the ninth layer of the "Time Immemorial Body".' Xue Ying thought. The Time Immemorial Body specialized most in survival. Once one cultivated it to grand perfection, he might not even be able to kill the other party!
'If I can't kill him, I can still disregard him. What about Sovereign Du Luo? I've not heard of him being an expert in anything.' Xue Ying thought back to what he knew.
The distance between the two parties shortened.
50 million kilometers, 45 million kilometers, 40 million kilometers…
Xue Ying flew at a speed faster than the other party by a few times. He was rapidly getting closer to them. Xue Ying held onto the scarlet cloud with one hand, and his strength was violently rising! He did not treat these two powerful existences of the Dark Abyss as his opponents.
"He is here."
Sovereign Qu Fu and Sovereign Du Luo both stopped. They were looking at the bent passage from afar. The two of them were powerful existences, and their eyes were able to see through the influence of time-space to that fierce figure flying at about 5 million kilometers away. That figure garbed in black armor holding on to a scarlet spear was operating at speed close to 100 million kilometers every second. This was a speed that made them dumbstruck!
The terrifying aura emitting from his body had made the two of their hearts tremble despite watching from afar. After cultivating the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body to the fourth level, Xue Ying was already a Destruction Legion soldier who passed the mettle. Even if he was an ordinary member, it was enough to cause ordinary True God to feel terror.
The aura was fierce and tyrannical!
Even when the two had yet to fight, they could feel the unseen pressure!
"Sovereign Qu Fu, are you sure you can block him?" Sovereign Du Luo asked.
"Rest assure." Sovereign Qu Fu gritted his teeth, "You know that King Patrol Devil requires the time taken to brew a cup of tea to get rid of an avatar of mine. This Highness Dong Bo is someone I can certainly defend against."
At this moment, that figure who was in black armor and holding a scarlet spear was getting close to them at high speed.
At the same time, a voice came transmitting from afar, "Two Abyss Sovereigns, I request for you to open the path."

chapters.title: Chapter 584 - Fighting One on Three (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 584: Fighting One on Three (2)
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Open the path?" The gray-robed Sovereign Du Luo stood in midair. The True God energy in his body transformed into strands of void energy that was spread out, enveloping the passage with a diameter of more than 50 million kilometers, forming a very unique array. The array had countless deity marking moving on it, emitting in golden light. The vast array had completely blocked off the entire passage, not leaving behind any gaps in place.
"Your Highness Dong Bo." The gray-robed Sovereign Du Luo announced, "I think you should still stop. You can't escape from this."
And the plump translucent-bodied Sovereign Qu Fu had also turned into a translucent sphere, shrouding around Sovereign Du Luo. This translucent sphere was close to a thousand meters long, with bright rays revolving around. One could see the face of Sovereign Qu Fu vaguely from the surface of this translucent sphere.
"Xiu!"
Xue Ying who was flying over at high speed looked at it from afar, frowning, "This array seems to contain many spatial profound mysteries."
"Break for me!" Xue Ying was too lazy to think either. He directly pierced the Scarlet Cloud Spear in his head out.
The Scarlet Cloud Spear exploded in length, showing its tyranny to the world.
With a power that was unparalleled, it swept over forcibly. Before entering closed-door cultivation, he held a significant advantage in his strength already. And now after closed-door cultivation, his strength had long reached an unfathomable stage. Emperor Qi Hai has even been forced by the power of Xue Ying away in a direct collision, the 'Time-Space Huge World' had been destroyed in a single move.
An ultra-strength working in tandem with a realm that was relatively high, it was enough for him to move unhindered.
"Hong long long~" The spear pierced into that giant array.
The array was akin to the void.
The spear was not affected by the obstacle at all. It just swept across the array.
'Mn?' Xue Ying's expression had a slight change, 'No obstacles at all?'
"Hong! Hong! Hong!" The Scarlet Cloud Spear which had already elongated to a few million kilometers in length, showed its might to void as it rampantly destroyed it. With Xue Ying's terrifying strength, he displayed the spear technique 'destruction' three consecutive times. The first spear was akin to a dazzling sun. The second spear was even fiercer, though the third spear had caused Sovereign Du Luo and Sovereign Qu Fu to greatly lose color.
"Too powerful." Sovereign Qu Fu nervously transmitted a message over, "Du Luo, do you think you could hold back Dong Bo Xue Ying?"
"As long as you can defend against him, then I can hold him back." the gray-robed Sovereign Du Luo felt his heart tightening too. That spear technique was indeed too terrifying! An incomparably dazzling sun was suppressing its way over, crushing the entire array.
The array remained entirely void.
No sort of obstructing force!
'Mn?' Xue Ying frowned slightly. He was also a daring expert who did not reduce his speed at all, directly flying into that void array.
Right at that moment, he charged in…
The scenery around him changed.
The original void array had turned into boundless space. Xue Ying flew into this space.
'An array controlling space?' The edge of Xue Ying's lip edged upwards, 'Become bigger, bigger, bigger!'
One could see Xue Ying's figure rapidly increasing in size.
Within moments, his body had burst up to 25 million kilometers tall. With his sturdy body, Xue Ying could even deliberately reach a size of over billions of kilometers! But because the passage was only 50 million kilometers large, it would affect his movement in battle if he became even bigger. The enormous Xue Ying was emitting a powerful aura. The spear in his hand also went hacking forward at the void.
"Hmph, he can't escape." Under the control of the gray-robed Sovereign Du Luo, the void array could become big along as well. It wasn't affected by the external force.
"Truly interesting. Are you playing domain with me?" Xue Ying shook his head.
After that, the body of the towering Xue Ying had emitting countless of dazzling white edge. Every single white edge was incomparably sharp and overbearing. It was none other than the luminous sun force! The luminous sun force went spreading out, leaving no stones unturned. Its speed of spreading was truly too fast; it was akin to a domain, scattering in all directions.
Very soon, the many white edge had covered the majority half of the void array, covering even Sovereign Qu Fu and Sovereign Du Luo who were both at the center of the array. Very soon, the luminous sun force enveloped the entire void array. The luminous sun force might be very fierce, though it remained unable to break through the void energy because it was akin to not existing.
"Your Highness Dong Bo." Sovereign Du Luo's voice reverberated through every single area within the array, "It's useless. Even with your strength spreading out, you can't escape from this."
"Is that so?" After Xue Ying confirmed the scene of the entire void array, he did not care about the illusions. Instead, he flew along a single direction at high speed.
Xiu!
He flew as fast as lightning.
But as he flew, the entire void array was also moving continuously, causing the surrounding space to also teleport continuously alongside. After flying for the time taken to breathe, it remained that he was still within the area of influence!
'It's like a circle! Flying over here and there, under the teleportation of the layered void, I actually flew back to my original point.' Xue Ying frowned. He was clear of everything after using the luminous sun force. He was on the passive end because the void array was being controlled by that Sovereign Du Luo, 'Who would have thought that this Sovereign Du Luo has reached such accomplishment on the aspect of arrays.'
His flying speed was slower than the attacking speed of the weapon, and the speed of luminous sun force. Sovereign Du Luo could ultimately allow the void array to transform alongside.
As the weapon and the luminous sun force were too fast, it had transcended beyond the controlling capabilities of Sovereign Du Luo. It was to the extent that for the sake of not affecting his restriction of the body of Xue Ying, Sovereign Du Luo did not dare to multitask and go influencing the weapon of his either.
'Since I can't fly out of this, then I can only resolve this with the controller of the array.' Xue Ying stood in midair. The spear in his hand was moving fiercely. Under his extraordinary strength, the Scarlet Cloud Spear of close to 50 million kilometers in length had just slightly swept across, covering a distance of tens of millions of kilometers. It was so much faster than solely flying.
Under the sweeping of the spear, it had fiercely hacked against the translucent sphere.
"Peng!" The sphere had slight caving in, though Sovereign Du Luo who was within the translucent sphere remained smiling.
"Break for me." Xue Ying once again displayed his spear technique.
The spear was fierce as it went hacking out repeatedly.
But the sphere had just caved in a bit from this attack.
"Your Highness Dong Bo, hahaha, you remained unable to escape." Emperor Qi Hai who had been chasing after him had reached up to him.
"Hmph."
At this moment, Xue Ying did not care about him either. He knew that if he wanted to leave, he had to resolve the controller of the void array, Sovereign Du Luo. He had never thought that this person who was not famous, could actually control such a fabulous void array! The intelligence he gathered previously did not note this point.
"Destroy." Xue Ying displayed the spear technique 'Destruction'.
Hong hong hong!
Every spear had fiercely pierced on the translucent sphere. During the first pierce, the translucent sphere which 'Sovereign Qu Fu' had transformed into, had been pierced a great half.
The second spear came.
After comprehending part of the profound mysteries from the 'Slaughter Dao' of the True God weapon flying knife, Xue Ying's profound mysteries of the spear technique Destruction had become more terrifying, and Sovereign Qu Fu had a hard time dissipating it. He could only rely on his unique body to withstand the force.
"Sovereign Du Luo, this Dong Bo Xue Ying's spear technique is too formidable. It might not be able to kill me, but it can very well pierce through my body to kill you." Sovereign Qu Fu transmitted a message immediately.
"What? You can't protect me?" The gray-robed Sovereign Du Luo panicked. He was also scolding this Sovereign Qu Fu inwardly for not being reliable.
"Emperor Qi Hai, I request for you to work together with us to trap this Dong Bo Xue Ying." Sovereign Du Luo transmitted a message over.
"Alright."
Emperor Qi Hai did not hesitate.
He immediately rushed into the void array. He wasn't affected by any sort of obstacles within the void array and had directly rushed towards Xue Ying.
'Break for me, break break break!' Xue Ying became even more fierce in his offense when he saw Emperor Qi Hai coming over.
"Hahaha, Your Highness Dong Bo, even if you ran, you still land in my hands in the end." Emperor Qi Hai's eight tentacles were broken apart. The eight tentacles formed into eight demon avatars, and for a moment, the true body of Emperor Qi Hai with his eight demon avatars had reached the true body of Xue Ying.
"Peng."
One of the demon avatars had brought out a Greataxe, hacking out at Xue Ying. Another demon avatar brought out a saber, cutting at Xue Ying's head.
The eight demon avatars had practically attacked at the same time.
Xue Ying's spear technique did not stop. He did not care about the attack by these demon avatars.
When the Greataxe landed on his body, the black armor on his body did not leave behind any signs of scars. Crossing through the black armor dissipating the remnant force, Xue Ying's body could easily withstand the attack. His body did not move at all! The eight demon avatars attacking fiercely, and every single attack was just slightly weaker than Emperor Qi Hai himself and was close to a Paragon combat power.
But regardless of how they attacked, Xue Ying's muscular body had just jolted by a bit before withstanding the force easily. He did not move at all, much less being injured.
"What!" Emperor Qi Hai who was attacking behind, had a huge change in expression, "How is this possible!"
Eight avatars with combat power close to a Paragon attacking together.
This was his, Emperor Qi Hai's, absolute move. He was able to move unhindered in the Deity world and Abyss because of this reliance! There were not many powerful existences who dared to meet his attack with force, but Xue Ying did not display any spear techniques in defending against it. He depended on his body to withstand against the attacks and remained unbudged from the attack.
"What a Joke." Xue Ying coldly looked at him, treating Emperor Qi Hai as a fool.
This absolute move might be formidable, and he, Xue Ying, did not know how to use it.
And even a frontal battle against him was tough.
But-
He had his own strengths.
Other than his colossal power and speed, another point he was good at was his defenses that were unparalleled! His defense should be Xue Ying's greatest strength.
'That time when the Lake Heart Island Destruction Legion acted, they will usually deal against minimally, a Paragon existence! Even Paragon existence will have a tough time trying to break this black armor of mine, much less your eight demon avatars which could only be considered as having the standard of a powerful apex existence.' Xue Ying disdained from acting against them. This was still a very far off from the withstanding ability of his black armor.
If one who was not even a Paragon could destroy the armor of a regular soldier from the Destruction Legion, that would be the real joke.
"Hong hong hong!" Xue Ying did not care about Emperor Qi Hai. He let Emperor Qi Hai attack him however he wanted. He was instead focusing on attacking the gray-robed Sovereign Du Luo. His Scarlet Cloud Spear was displaying the spear technique Destruction, and the final move of every three spears would explode in a terrifying might that could pierce through the sphere, causing Sovereign Qu Fu to have a hard time covering Sovereign Du Luo in evading the attacks.
"Emperor Qi Hai, quick, obstruct Dong Bo Xue Ying." Sovereign Du Luo transmitted a message over.
Emperor Qi Hai roared. The enormous eight tentacles elongated and covered around Xue Ying, frantically trying to bind him. The restriction ability of the tentacles was solid and had indeed affected Xue Ying's utilization of the spear technique.
"Open." Xue Ying exerted strength in both of his arms.
"Beng beng beng… "
Many tentacles were actually being broken by the two arms of Xue Ying. The tentacles that were broken had rapidly flown back, and the injuries of Emperor Qi Hai were rapidly recovering too. But it remained that he was feeling a huge pressure, "This Dong Bo Xue Ying's combat power is indeed comparable with mine, but his strength is too exaggerated, and his defenses could completely withstand any of my attacks."
"Emperor Qi Hai!" Sovereign Du Luo was extremely panicking at this moment.
"I can't hold on any longer." Sovereign Qu Fu was turning crazy too. The translucent sphere which Sovereign Qu Fu transformed into had been wholly pierced through many times already. Sovereign Du Luo who was inside had also been evading the attacks time after time.
And this time, Xue Ying's spear had once again torn through the body of Sovereign Qu Fu, causing the translucent body of his to turn into two. Amongst which, one half was escaping with Sovereign Du Luo within.
Hong!
Xue Ying's spear was too fast. The surging spear came continuously. Dodging it time after time, facing such a quick spear, one would eventually miss a step.
"Pu."
The spear once again tears through the translucent body and also penetrated into the body of the gray-robed Sovereign Du Luo. The spear with the Destruction intent within had practically destroyed the body of Sovereign Du Luo, causing him to turn into fine pieces. Clearly, the survivability aspect of his was too far off as compared to Sovereign Qu Fu's. Xue Ying could only break the body of Sovereign Qu Fu without killing him.
"No!" Sovereign Du Luo's consciousness rapidly entered darkness as his body was extinguished.
The void array also directly dissipated.
The scene in front of Xue Ying was changed clearer. The bent dark passage appeared once again.
"I'll not accompany you guys to play anymore." Xue Ying held onto the spear and flew on at high speed. Those demon avatars which wanted to obstruct Xue Ying had been directly slapped aside by his spear. He flew away at high speed.
Emperor Qi Hai looked on this from afar without intending to continue pursuing him, "This Dong Bo Xue Ying's combat power is comparable with mine. But his defenses are too exaggerated."
"Fighting three on one, and still killing Du Luo in the end?" That translucent sphere which had transformed back into the plump-looking Sovereign Qu Fu had also looked towards Xue Ying's disappearing figure with astonishment, "The moment this news spreads, I believe Dong Bo Xue Ying will certainly stun the entire Dark Abyss and Deity world. It seems another astounding existence below the level of Paragon realm has emerged."
******

chapters.title: Chapter 585 - Coming Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 585: Coming Out
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The news could not be hindered.
Other Abyss Sovereigns could rely on karmic sensing to discover that Emperor Qi Hai and the other sovereigns surrounding Xue Ying. But very soon, the avatar of Sovereign Du Luo disappeared! Xue Ying actually escaped, and Emperor Qi Hai and the other sovereigns did not continue chasing.
"Emperor Qi Hai, what happened? The three of you are dealing with this Highness Dong Bo together, yet he escaped in the end?"
"Sovereign Qu Fu, you guys fought three on one and still let Dong Bo Xue Ying kill one of you in the end?"
Many of them came asking.
"Right." Sovereign Qu Fu was still politely replying, "His Highness Dong Bo's combat power isn't any weaker than Emperor Qi Hai. His advantage in close combat was even bigger though. In the future when you meet His Highness Dong Bo, it'll be better for you to avoid him, else you are sending yourself to death."
"Hmph! Right, we fought three on one against him and got one of us killed in the end." Emperor Qi Hai's temper wasn't good. He coldly transmitted a message, "If you have the capabilities, then you all can go and attempt it for yourself!"
…
Fighting one on three.
One had to know that any powerful existence could not be belittled because their lifespan was eternal after transcending, and they would usually spend much effort on researching towards one aspect, and had their own unique techniques! Some specialized in arrays, some in hex poison, some in illusory techniques… regardless, each of them had their own specialties, and three powerful existences working together, if they were able to coordinate well enough, their overall combat power would have a qualitative change.
Just like Sovereign Qu Fu and Sovereign Du Luo, the two of them working together were able to hold Xue Ying back. It was because Xue Ying's offensive power was too fierce that he eventually killed Du Luo and broke through the array!
If not for studying the True God weapon flying knife's 'Slaughter Dao' before, allowing his spear technique 'Destruction's power to increase significantly, he would not be able to break apart the body of Sovereign Qu Fu. By then, he would be trapped forever!
As for Emperor Qi Hai, Xue Ying depended on his terrifying defenses to withstand against him.
Thus-
For him to fight one on three, especially with Emperor Qi Hai included, was something challenging! Any powerful existence understood that fighting three on one and could still kill Sovereign Du Luo was something where luck could not be a factor of.
"So formidable?"
"Aren't we sending ourselves to death if we go?"
"Whatever, let's forget it."
The other Abyss Sovereigns within Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain decided to give up. They were not confident. Only King Patrol Devil was still chasing after Xue Ying.
******
Facing a few powerful existences as one and could still kill one from the many was a rare event. Every time it happened, it would spread across the Deity world and Abyss.
It was the same this time too!
As the news spread across the powerful existences, they were all dumbstruck.
"This Highness Dong Bo has become a stage four World Deity, yet he is so formidable?"
"In the history, most heaven-shattering stage four World Deities aren't that exaggerated right? Fighting three on one? And there's still Emperor Qi Hai within!"
"Too formidable."
They felt their hearts trembling.
Xue Ying was after all one of the only two members belonging to the Destruction Legion from this cosmos epoch. The other one was Pang Yi.
Within the Crimson Stone Courtyard of Bloodshed God Palace, inside Xue Ying's cavern dwelling, Jing Qiu was currently discussing with her daughter Qing Yao on the path of cultivation. As for her son, Dong Bo Yu, because he was presently stuck in a bottleneck and had yet to break through, he had long gone out for adventure.
"Daughter, daughter!" Monarch Mo Xue came over with a look of joy.
"Father, what happened?" Jing Qiu was slightly surprised.
