"This son-in-law of mine is truly amazing!" Monarch Mo Xue praised.
"Oh?"
Jing Qiu and Qing Yao were both puzzled.
"Let me recount this in detail to you all." Monarch Mo Xue was extremely excited. He was never able to be so impressive before. This son-in-law of his had finally reached this stage.
…
Hu.
Xue Ying was passing through the Demonic Maelstrom. He would tear through time-space repeatedly within the maelstrom. Tearing through time-space would not lead him to a fixed position, though he was able to sense the approximate location of 'King Devil Luo'!
Even though he had just fought a battle, Xue Ying remained conscious of himself.
'In the fight with Emperor Qi Hai, he could not deal against me, and I similarly could not deal against him.' Xue Ying understood this point, 'But it's different with King Devil Luo! King Devil Luo should be the most formidable one in the entire Deity world and Abyss beneath the Paragon realm. Previously, he had fought with Paragons before in a frontal battle. He is best in strength, and most likely, his strength is above mine. His killing move is something I can't break either.'
King Devil Luo was known for his strength!
A very, very long time ago, he had once fought against eight enemies by himself on the moon star, and his terrifying power had swept across the eight powerful existences who worked together, causing two to die and six to escape!
He had fought with Paragons in a direct battle, and not just once! After that, he was able to survive.
'It seems several others do not dare to pursue after me anymore?' The edge of Xue Ying's lip moved upwards, 'Good for me too.'
Just evading King Devil Luo alone would make his life easier.
'I would never have thought that in the blink of an eye, I'll be an existence just like those in the legend, fighting many as one, and is able to kill a powerful existence.' Xue Ying sighed, 'Unknowingly, I have reached this level. But still, the path in the future will be harder.'
In the future, his combat power would rise very slowly.
After all, as a grade one True Meaning Transcendent, being able to cultivate to stage four World Deity in a single breath was also the fastest period for which his combat power rose! In the history, most grade one True Meaning Transcendents were similar. Of course, Xue Ying was also a master amongst them for he was the fastest to become a stage three World Deity in history.
'There are no other paths. I can only slowly accumulate experience and knowledge.' Xue Ying understood this point very clearly. Only by cultivating step by step and accumulate enough experience and knowledge would he be able to naturally break through the entire law of the world! Transcending beyond the river of time and attain true eternity. Currently, he was already a powerful expert in this river of time, yet he had not escaped from it.
Xiu!
Within Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, only King Devil Luo was still chasing after him. Xue Ying easily returned back to the Vast Water World.
Within Vast Water World, it remained a piece of ocean.
Xue Ying flew at high speed, tunneling into the water before traveling passed the earth of grits, reaching the lowest layer of the surface. Standing on the crimson membrane, Luminous Sun appeared on his figure. This surging Luminous Sun directly tore through the thick crimson membrane, entering the depth before keeping back the storage treasure which he had hidden.
He then took out the original copy of the Blood Demon Scripture from the storage treasure.
'Absolute art first half?' Xue Ying looked at this book in his hand. The book was akin to a sea of blood as it attacked Xue Ying's true deity heart. The vile, bloody aura also began emitting.
'I wonder who was the one who created this absolute art that seems so vile and evil.' Xue Ying flipped his hand before keeping it.
'Originally, I never thought of bringing this original copy out.' Xue Ying chuckled, 'But who would have thought that the two remnant pieces fusing together as a talisman has that effect.'
Even with his current combat power, Xue Ying was not confident of keeping his life in front of White Sovereign King.
He did not intend to bring the treasures out. The moment he was killed, would the blood demon scripture not end up in White Sovereign King's hands?
But-
With that piece of talisman, it had an incredibly unique property.
Even though it caused a restraining fear on Xue Ying, at least he had the confidence of escaping Dark Abyss alive.
'I hope I do not have to use it.' Xue Ying thought.
'Go.'
"Xiu."
After keeping the Blood Demon Scripture, Xue Ying immediately broke through the sky.
After leaving the Vast Water World, he flew ahead without stopping! He had long gotten some primary intelligence on Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain from Paragon Huo Cheng. Thus, he was deliberately maintaining a distance from King Devil Luo, taking a detour before finally arriving at one of the large entrances leading out from the demon head.
'I am finally out. White Sovereign King should be outside I guess.' Xue Ying looked ahead. In front of his was the exit coming from the bloody mouth of the demon head. He could see the cloud in the sky right outside that enormous exit.

chapters.title: Chapter 586 - White Sovereign King
chapters.content:
Chapter 586: White Sovereign King
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying turned into a streamer as he flew out from the bloody mouth of the demon head.
"I am out."
"Hmph!"
A cold snort was suddenly heard.
Xue Ying turned around, only to see a handsome male in silvery-white armor. This attractive male had a cold expression. His eyes were filled with cold intent as if he was looking at an ant! White Sovereign King was known for his inclination towards slaughter in the entire Dark Abyss. That fondness was able to make even the demons living in it feel terror. One could imagine how ruthless and demented he was!
Demons were terrifying! But White Sovereign King was the demon amongst demons!
"White Sovereign…" Xue Ying started.
"Hua." White Sovereign King had a sword by his waist. He rapidly drew out the sword from the scabbard, hacking over without speaking anything.
The surrounding world became utterly frigid, preventing Xue Ying from dodging the attack.
The sword light was gorgeous.
It arced through the sky as if it was rainbow.
Very beautiful!
Following which, this sword light landed on his body. Xue Ying did not have the time to use any defensive maneuver. That sword by the waist of White Sovereign King was a True God weapon! His display of sword technique had surpassed that of ordinary True Gods, and this sword had transcended entirely above the law of the world! As the sword light landed on his body, Xue Ying finally understood the gigantic chasm in between himself and the other party.
Hong!
Xue Ying was directly hacked backward, clashing against the face of that enormous demon head of the Three Chieftain Sacred Mountain, tumbling down twice before he finally held himself firm on the magma rock of the mountain.
The blood inside his body was boiling. He felt the sweetness in his throat. Xue Ying looked at the spot on his chest that had been slashed by the sword. There was a long wound on it.
'One sword is able to damage my armor? According to the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body", Paragons aren't able to kill me easily. Only the mightiest experts could do so. White Sovereign King casually struck me with his sword and is able to injure me. It seems with the analysis of power hierarchy done by the Lake Heart Island, he should be considered as an apex existence even amongst Paragons.' Xue Ying made his judgment.
He looked upwards at the distant silvery-white-armored handsome male, 'Who would have thought that he has acted without even speaking a second time. This is troublesome. Unless I have to use that talisman?'
The talisman was very unique. It could help him and could give him difficulty as well. Xue Ying was not willing to use it until the very last moment.
"It is indeed created by the greatest expert of all cosmos epochs-a soldier from the Destruction Legion is able to protect himself so well." White Sovereign King stood in midair as he said. He was indeed astonished. Who was he? He wasn't even afraid of Rulers, being very carefree and had commandeered the top 50 levels of abyss world, the White Sovereign King! The Dao he opened was the Dao of Slaughter, and he could not kill a stage four World Deity with a single sword?
"For you to receive one sword from me without dying, you have the qualifications to drink a few cups with me." White Sovereign King nonchalantly said.
"A few cups?" Xue Ying was slightly startled.
"Why, you don't want to drink? You want to die instead?" White Sovereign King looked at him.
Xue Ying hurriedly added, "Who would want to die voluntarily? Furthermore, for White Sovereign King to invite me for a cup of wine, I am certainly delighted."
The two went flying upwards.
They flew till they reached above the cloud layer. There were cloud tables, cloud chairs and a young woman standing there. The young woman was charming, though Xue Ying could deem that she was not a true lifeform.
"Sit." White Sovereign King sat down first before ordering.
Xue Ying had gotten himself seated too.
The charming young woman was pouring wine for them.
"The absolute art from the Destruction Legion is formidable." White Sovereign King sighed as he sat there, "It is indeed the absolute art termed as the strongest in defense across the cosmos epochs. You are not bad too for being able to pass through the selections of the Destruction Legion."
"It's luck." Xue Ying said.
"Success means strength. There's no luck involved." White Sovereign King chuckled. He brought up his cup of wine, "Come, let us down a cup first."
Xue Ying immediately took up the cup of wine and accompanied him.
White Sovereign King laughed, "There aren't many who have the qualifications to drink with me. You are one of them."
"If I can't survive that sword, I should be dead right?" Xue Ying said.
"Those ants who can't receive a single strike from me, how could they be qualified to sit with me?" White Sovereign King looked at Xue Ying, "After killing you if you don't carry the blood demon scripture along, I can always send people to slowly scour through the Vast Water World! You do know that 10 billion or 100 billion years is nothing much to me."
Xue Ying nodded.
This White Sovereign King did not kill him. Instead, he had seated down with him for a chat.
On one aspect, it was indeed because of his combat power that earned him this opportunity since his defenses were solid, and that he wasn't an ant that could be casually pinched to death by White Sovereign King.
On the other hand, White Sovereign King had most likely recognized the fact that the chance of Xue Ying keeping the blood demon scripture with him wasn't great, and a higher possibility was it being hidden in Vast Water World. Saying it might be easy, but if he was to slowly search through, spending one billion years was normal.
These two reasons made White Sovereign King willing to sit down for a chat!
"Hu!"
Two figures appeared suddenly from afar.
Two figures tore through space, arriving above the cloud layer. Xue Ying and White Sovereign King who were both seated there turned over. It was a towering demon with six arms. He walked over with Howling Devil Cult Leader in one hand. Howling Devil Cult Leader was just like a chick; he could not retaliate despite being caught.
"Sovereign, his avatar has been killed. This is his true body." The six-armed demon casually threw out Howling Devil Cult Leader. After he fell down, he cooed in trying to stand up. Even though his true deity heart was sealed, he could still fly in the sky.
Howling Devil Cult Leader had a face full of horror.
Seated by there, there was Xue Ying and another handsome-looking male who was also the legendary White Sovereign King! The Dark Abyss first 50 level worlds had always been governed by White Sovereign King alone for a long period of time!
"Sovereign, sovereign." Howling Devil Cult Leader knelt down, begging for mercy, "Your Highness Dong Bo, Your Highness Dong Bo, mercy! mercy!"
"I've heard that you came to the Dark Abyss this time to save your good friend Chi Qiu Bai?" White Sovereign King casually said.
Xue Ying was startled at how detailed the other party understood his circumstances. He immediately nodded, "Right."
"It's a pity that this good friend of yours has been used by him to cultivate in a secret technique. It should most likely be the Blood Demon Scripture." White Sovereign King looked towards Howling Devil Cult Leader who was currently kneeling down and begging for mercy. He then casually waved his hand, causing a blood slaughter aura to envelop the body of Howling Devil Cult Leader. Howling Devil Cult Leader's eyes were widened and were filled with terror. Following which, he was completely broken down into nothingness.
Xue Ying immediately discovered that he could not find Howling Devil Cult Leader via karma! Clearly, after his true body had died, he was completely dead.
"This is one of my ways of showing you my sincerity for this negotiation." White Sovereign King said.
Xue Ying lightly nodded. That time when he saw Chi Qiu Bai entering a crazed state and was filled with grievances, he decided there and then to kill Howling Devil Cult Leader. Even if White Sovereign King did not kill him, Xue Ying would still kill him in the future!
White Sovereign King lightly sipped from the cup of wine, saying, "I am not asking you for the original copy of the first half of Blood Demon Scripture either. I only require for you to let I and Great Destruction to receive the inheritance once. To reciprocate the effort, Great Destruction will let you inherit the second half of the Blood Demon Scripture. Furthermore, we will send you off the Dark Abyss!"
"Alright." Xue Ying did not hesitate at all.
"Then I'll let Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction come." White Sovereign King nodded. He then used karma to transmit a message over to the person at the 199th level of Abyss World, "Great Destruction, you can come."

chapters.title: Chapter 587 - A Round of Exchange
chapters.content:
Chapter 587: A Round of Exchange
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Above the cloud layer.
Xue Ying was drinking with White Sovereign King, waiting for the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction.
"Brother Dong Bo." Paragon Huo Cheng transmitted a message over, "I've heard that you fought one against three, and still killed a powerful existence. Not bad!"
"I killed an avatar only." Xue Ying transmitted back.
"This is very amazing already! Oh right, you should be careful of White Sovereign King. That old person is very ruthless and cunning, and can do anything." Paragon Huo Cheng transmitted a message to remind him.
Xue Ying looked at White Sovereign King who was seated on the other side, enjoying his wine, and could not help but transmit a message, "I am right in front of White Sovereign King! I am currently drinking wine with him. In a while, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction will come over too. We will be discussing about the Blood Demon Scripture."
"Right in front of him? You are actually seated with this cruel person together, wu… Great Destruction is coming too? If Great Destruction comes, then what White Sovereign King said could be trusted. Because anything Great Destruction said, even those who die will follow! As for White Sovereign King, you can only trust a sentence of his out of every ten sentences because the moment he wanted to, he will just fall out with you the next moment." Paragon Huo Cheng transmitted a message.
Xue Ying was startled.
Falling out with you the moment he wanted? Could only trust on sentence out of every ten sentences?
The White Sovereign King was actually like this?
Fortunately, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction had come too, else this negotiation might be a scam.
"Who would have thought that Brother Dong Bo, you have unknowingly become so strong. You should know some of the details behind the scene already. I will not tell you. Instead, your teacher will most likely be telling you soon." Paragon Huo Cheng followed with a large transmission a message, "These are the intelligence regarding the powerful existences in our vast cosmos, the Deity world, and the Abyss. Regardless if their reputation is huge or not, as long as I know them, I'll record them within here. You have a good look through and understand their combat power and temperament. Only then will you know how to deal with them."
How mighty was Xue Ying's true deity heart? He could digest the vast amount of intelligence and remember them in moments.
"So…"
In the past, what Xue Ying understood were mostly the powerful existences.
His understanding of the Paragons was too few!
And Paragon Huo Cheng was an extremely old Paragon of the entire Deity world and Abyss. The secrets he knew were too much.
"The Deity world and Abyss, beneath the Rulers, the strongest one was Monarch Green! The second was Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction. These two's combat power was unquestionably the strongest. Following closely are White Sovereign King, Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, Bitter Cultivator, Purgatory Great Commander, Mysterious North Imperial Empress, and Paragon Huo Cheng with comparable combat power." Xue Ying looked at the detailed records, and he felt enlightened.
Paragons could be split into three different levels.
The first level was those who could wrestle with the Ruler-Monarch Green and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction.
The second level was the apex Paragons-White Sovereign King, Paragon Huo Cheng, Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master and several others. A long time ago, 'Pang Yi' was at this level too, and now, he had reached an unfathomable stage.
The third level consisted of the more ordinary Paragons like Monarch Destruction, Paragon Devil Kite, and the majority of the other Paragons.
Naturally, because all of them walked different Dao paths, the combat power they displayed were different either.
Some were very good at escaping, and even Rulers had a hard time trying to kill them!
Some were extremely strong with offense-reaching the standard of Rulers. But their other aspects were weaker! For instance, 'Bitter Cultivator'.
Some were very cunning and ruthless, like White Sovereign King!
…
"One requires to fight for opportunities in the road of cultivation! Don't see how peaceful it seems the Deity world and Abyss is on the surface, in reality, for the sake of getting opportunities in cultivation, Rulers might not even care about anything. When Paragons truly got crazy, they would similarly just kill! But it was still good since everyone was chasing after different things. The apex Paragons wanted to become Rulers, and they would usually not have any conflicts with powerful existences." Paragon Huo Cheng transmitted over.
Xue Ying understood this point.
Just like how powerful existences wanted to obtain True God weapons and absolute arts…
To the apex Paragons, they had already left on their own Dao path! They did not lack in True God weapons, and they had their own absolute arts. So it was impossible for them to fight with powerful existences for it.
Thus, battles would usually happen to those at the same level! Like Bloodshed God Emperor, Temporal Island Lord, Myriad God Palace, Bloody Ruler, Purgatory Ruler would also fight amongst each other.
"But occasionally, it might concern with some important treasures, causing Paragons and powerful existences to fight with each other. Like the original copy of the absolute art, under ordinary circumstances, powerful existences do not have qualifications to grasp hold of it." Paragon Huo Cheng transmitted over, "That is why they will create such huge trouble. But since White Sovereign King, this cunning old person is here, it should be because he thinks that you have hidden the Blood Demon Scripture. That is why he decided to trade with you."
"Mn." Xue Ying understood.
The original copy of absolute art.
That was something he could impart to others, and indeed, most powerful existences did not have the qualifications of getting it! Xue Ying because his combat power was close to Paragons, and his defenses were solid, and more importantly because White Sovereign King and the others thought… that the Blood Demon Scripture should be hidden in the Vast Water World, trying to seek for it would be too tedious. Thus, he was willing to do an exchange.
…
Xue Ying was drinking with White Sovereign King. White Sovereign King did not speak much, and Xue Ying was also chatting with Paragon Huo Cheng. After a while…
"Hong!"
The time-space in the distant had an undulation appearing.
A figure appeared.
Xue Ying felt his heart tightening after sensing that aura. Turning over, he saw a muscular man with two black curved horns. His bare body skin had some dragon entrenched on it as if a dragon was entangling him. Stepping across the void, he came over. Just like a vast world that was emitting a substantial worldly pressure coming over, that pressure made Xue Ying hold his breath.
'He should be Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction?' This was the first time Xue Ying saw this person.
His violet eyes had lightning surging within.
His aura made this level of Abyss World tremble. As his eyes turned over, White Sovereign King's pupils dilated, and Xue Ying could feel the terrifying willpower charging out at him. For a moment, his sensation towards the surrounding became blurred, and he felt his true deity heart trembling too. It felt as if he could hardly discern his surroundings and was like a 'blind man', though Xue Ying was still seated very stable.
"Mn?" Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction looked at Xue Ying. The edge of his lip curled upwards, "Interesting, you actually did not kneel down?"
One had to know,
Most powerful existences could not even withstand his willpower and had come kneeling down.
Xue Ying might have affected a powerful impact, his true deity heart was clear, and his willpower was able to maintain his calmness.
"Great Destruction." White Sovereign King stood up.
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction kept his aura too. Taking a step, he arrived by the cloud chair. Only then did Xue Ying regained his sense of the surroundings, and saw that the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction was by his side. He stood up and greeted him. There was nothing much to talk about due to the difference in their combat power, but he was still young and would become stronger in the future,
"Hahaha, not bad, you actually did not kneel down in front of me. For you to have such combat power as a stage four World Deity, not bad, not bad indeed." Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction laughed out loud.
"The members of the Destruction Legion of this cosmos epoch, other than Pang Yi, there's only him. Can he be lacking?" White Sovereign King laughed, "You actually tried vainly to let a member of the Destruction Legion kneel."
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, after the exchange, Old White Ghost will send you off safely." Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction said, "You be rest assured. He will not scam you."
White Sovereign King heard the term 'Old White Ghost' and could not help frowning, though he still endured it.
"I trust the two of you." Xue Ying said.
"I'm sure you should be clear of the exchange this time." Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction said, "I will let the two of you receive an inheritance from the second half of the Blood Demon Scripture. Dong Bo Xue Ying, your first half of the Blood Demon Scripture will also be allowed for I and Old White Ghost to learn. But, Old White Ghost… you are the one contributing the least in this exchange."
White Sovereign king chuckled, "Dong Bo Xue Ying wants to save a good friend of his. His good friend has already died, and I'll be reincarnating him from the river of time."
Xue Ying immediately added, "Thank you, White Sovereign King."
Chi Qiu Bai was only a Transcendent.
Reincarnating a Transcendent was still relatively easy to achieve! If Chi Qiu Bai were a World Deity, White Sovereign King would not so casually promise him.
"It should be. It's an exchange, and it should be fair." White Sovereign King laughed, "Dong Bo Xue Ying, right now, just go over to the Vast Water World to bring that first half of Blood Demon Scripture original copy out."

chapters.title: Chapter 588 - River of Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 588: River of Time
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Go, hurry and get the original copy of the first half of Blood Demon Scripture over." Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction sat there, glancing at White Sovereign King, "You can be rest assured. With me over here, Old White Ghost will not play any tricks. If in the future when you do an exchange with him by yourself, you must be very careful."
White Sovereign King laughed, "Great Destruction, don't you defile my reputation."
Saying that, White Sovereign King looked at Xue Ying with bewilderment.
Why had he not depart?
Xue Ying sat there very naturally. Flipping his hand, he took out a blood book. The book was releasing an endless bloody and murderous aura. The entire book was akin to an endless blood sea, "Coincidentally, I brought this absolute art original copy with me, so there's no need for me to return to the Vast Water World to fetch it back."
"You brought it along with you?" White Sovereign King was startled.
"You actually have it with you?" Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction was also exceptionally surprised.
They both thought that Xue Ying would have most certainly been hiding the original copy of the first half of Blood Demon Scripture. By hiding it, the initiative would be with Xue Ying. Even if they killed him, they would not get the original copy of the absolute art.
But Xue Ying had actually brought it along with him!
Was it unwise and arrogance? Or was it self-confidence?
"I feel kind of frustrated and regretful for not killing you. If I did that, then the original copy will be with me already." White Sovereign King shook his head and sighed, "Admirable, admirable that you are so daring, deceiving even I."
Xue Ying chuckled without explaining more.
If not for that talisman, he would definitely not bring this original copy of absolute art with him.
"Haha, this is good too." Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction chuckled and nodded. He waved his hand, causing a black book to appear. The black book's aura was similarly as bloody and vile, and it was much denser.
The auras from the two books were of the same origin.
The second half had a slightly more reserved aura.
"Both of you, just learn it then." Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction did not hesitate in letting a strand of his strength out to the first part of the original Blood Demon Scripture, accepting the inheritance.
…
Xue Ying, White Sovereign King and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction all studied the scripture consecutively.
"Hu~" This was the first time Xue Ying learn this Blood Demon Scripture. He studied both first and second half of the scripture.
With how strong his true deity heart was, comprehending it was relatively quick.
'This is a creation of Ancestor Devil. Who is Ancestor Devil? It seems that he is mighty.' Xue Ying thought to himself, 'The Blood Demon Scripture is one of his six grand inheritances?'
Blood Demon Scripture was a very vile absolute art. To learn it, one was required to transform his own body. There were two ways to do so. One was purely depending on one's own body and had a high demand for one's comprehension and perseverance. Cultivating it was excruciating. The other method was to depend on many ghosts for help. The difficulty was lower by ten times. If he depended on the ghosts, the further one went, the more it was required for the user to swallow souls, and it was harder to walk. The realm beneath True God was still relatively easy, but it was almost impossible to reach large success once one reached beyond True God.
And purely depending on one's own body was considered as a large Dao.
The cultivation method might be evil.
But one's own body was pure!
If one could reach large success in "Blood Demon Scripture", transforming the form of life, then Rulers would not be able to kill him. The aura emitted out from his body would not be any weaker than the malevolent hex poison, and the user's combat power would jump straight to that of Monarch Green and the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction!
"Great Destruction, how is it? Is it worth learning from?" White Sovereign King had a face full of smile. He was apparently pleased.
"Learning from it?" Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction sneered, "This inheritance of the Ancestor Devil walks down the path of body transformation, eventually reaching a transformation in the form of life. If I were to truly concentrate on walking down this path, then it will be straying from the true path! If you want to know, Ancestor Devil has six incarnations, and this is merely one of the inheritances created by one of the six incarnations. In total, he had six grand inheritances for his six incarnations! And Ancestor Devil's true body is able to accept all of these. Furthermore, my self-created absolute art is much stronger than the "Blood Demon SCripture"!"
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction's words held absolute confidence towards himself.
After getting the complete Blood Demon Scripture, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction became even more disdained of the scripture after understanding it.
"Right right right, what Great Destruction said is right. You are the closest existence to a Ruler in our Abyss." White Sovereign King praised, "I am unable to compete with you. I know my own limitations, and being able to take that step in becoming a Ruler will make me satisfied. This Blood Demon Scripture is very beneficial to me still."
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction looked at White Sovereign King.
One could only trust one sentence out of ten from White Sovereign King.
He said he was satisfied after becoming a Ruler? How could it be possible!
'This old person.' Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction coldly laughed inwardly. There were not many Paragons who could make him vigilant and attach importance to. In the entire Dark Abyss, there were only two! One was Purgatory Great Commander, and the other was White Sovereign King. Purgatory Great Commander was extremely capable, and had made Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction suffered from losses twice! But when comparing the two, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction was even more vigilant against White Sovereign King.
Purgatory Great Commander did not seem to rely on a Ruler on the surface! But in reality, he had a shallow relationship with one of the three Great Rulers of the Abyss, 'Purgatory Ruler'.
White Sovereign King was different.
He honestly did not have any backing! Yet he was able to stand straight and not fall.
"Formidable, this Blood Demon Scripture is truly formidable. It is much better than what I expected." The heart of White Sovereign King felt delightful. This opportunity was much better than what he expected, "Never would I have thought of that this Blood Demon Scripture is actually from the same origin as the Dao I opened!"
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, have you learned them?" Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction asked.
"I've finished learning." Xue Ying said.
"Old White Ghost, reincarnate the Transcendents from the River of Time." Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction said.
White Sovereign King's reward was huge this time. He had a great impression of Xue Ying too, so he chuckled, "That is natural. I've said before I'll reincarnate them."
Saying that, he stood up. Xue Ying and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction both stood up too. The three looked towards the distant sky.
Weng~
Operating time-space…
The initially lingering cloud and mist had suddenly been peeled open just like peeling apart the skin of a tangerine! This layer of space became blurry, revealing an even deeper vast and long river! This river was rolling on in waves. It was spread across the entire vast cosmos, moving in the Deity world, Abyss and even the material realm.
Every single life.
Even those at the stage four World Deity realm and those without much wisdom like ants would be immersed within this river of time.
This River of Time seemed to be on a different level as compared to the cosmos.
Just like-
Two levels, with the Deity world, Abyss and material realm being on the same level, and the River of Time being on a deeper level! The River of Time recorded down every single lifeform which was immersed within from their birth to their death. As long as they had yet to transcend beyond it, they would be designated within.
'Truly difficult to bear.' Xue Ying saw himself. He was likewise within, and the aura and figure he had were massive too. It was akin to the most prominent body within the broad river! After all, the strongest being immersed within the River of Time were the stage four World Deities, and stage four World Deities could hardly be stronger than Xue Ying. There was only Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master alone.
But Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master was on a different section of the river flow.
Within this part of the river flow, that towering figure was extremely humongous, and there were countless of lifeforms immersed within, with billions surrounding Xue Ying.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying." On the void bank by the side of the River of Time, there were two figures. They were White Sovereign King and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction.
The two had already transcended and left the river; they were both on the banks.
Standing by the bank, White Sovereign King and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction looked at the countless lives within the river, and also saw Xue Ying.
"You recognize Chi Qiu Bai. Find him in through the past in your time-space." White Sovereign King asked.
"Alright."
Xue Ying grasped hold of the complete Time-Space Deity Heart. Even in the River of Time, he could see the other lives immersed within, and also himself! Behind him was a piece of shadow. The shadow was layered on top of one another, recording his life from the start of birth till now. Amongst which included the record of himself with Chi Qiu Bai.

chapters.title: Chapter 589 - Pull Them Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 589: Pull Them Up
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The River of Time was genuinely vast and deep.
His shadow was located deep within the river, and there seemed to be some slight intersection in it. During this junction with his shadow, Xue Ying saw countless of people he was familiar with. Some were alive, and some died. Even Xiang Pang Yun, Si Liang Hong, Uncle Tong, Chen Ling Shu and the others were clearly seen by him. Their lives were relatively short and unremarkable in this River of Time. Compared to Xue Ying, their bodies were just like ants.
'In the future when I transcend, I'll similarly reincarnate Uncle Tong and the rest of you.' Xue Ying thought, 'And let you guys live a more spectacular life.'
But he could anticipate that even if he reincarnated them, the majority would not become Deities still! The chances of becoming World Deities were even lower. Their lives would thus be brief, and they would live until their true deity heart disintegrated and died. By then, it was impossible for them to be reincarnated! Because their true deity heart would only disintegrate again.
"White Sovereign King, if it is possible, can you reincarnate my good friend's wife as well?" Xue Ying said. He was very clear of the relationship between Chi Qiu Bai and his true love, "His wife is also a Transcendent, and a very weak one."
"Hahaha… alright. I'll reincarnate them together." White Sovereign King laughed in reply as he stood by the edge on the void. Firstly, the Blood Demon Scripture had been of enormous help to him, brightening his mood. Another reason was that reincarnating a weak little Transcendent was unquestionably simple. If he had to reincarnate a Deity, he might hesitate.
"Just these two."
Xue Ying's colossal figure pointed out.
Operating the strength of time-space, it enveloped around Chi Qiu Bai and another woman. The confluence between that woman and Chi Qiu Bai seemed to be dense. During Chi Qiu Bai's craziest state, only after Xue Ying had killed Howling Devil Cult Leader did his life finally ended. And that woman had been whipped until she dissipated.
But Xue Ying had merely reached this stage. He was unable to reincarnate the two of them.
"Leave the rest to me." White Sovereign king was extremely confident of himself.
He stood by the side of the void bank, extending his hand. His arm elongated and continued into the void river.
Just a palm was enough to grab Chi Qiu Bai and that woman. Following closely, he coercively teleported the positions of the two, moving them to the surface of the River of Time.
"Hua hua hua."
This was a long river.
Different depths were representing different timelines. The deeper it was, the further in the past it would represent! And on the surface of the river, it marked the present!
Under the protection of the right hand of White Sovereign King, Chi Qiu Bai and his wife had been coercively moved to the surface of the river. During the process of moving him, the entire stream had produced a resistance force! The mystical power of the River of Time was endless, but fortunately, the figures of Chi Qiu Bai and his wife were very small and were akin to ants. Moving them to the surface of the river produced minimal resistance force. It was relatively easy on the side of White Sovereign king as well.
At the moment when they were moved to the surface of the river, it represented that the two of them had lived until this time period.
"What is this happening?" In the distant, there was a figure much more prominent than Chi Qiu Bai by about 10,000 times, yet at about one-thousandth of Xue Ying's size. He looked upwards, looking at White Sovereign King and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction who were both by the void bank, and seeing White Sovereign King extending his hand into the River of Time and pulling the lives within.
"Is this reincarnating lives?" That stage two World Deity had just comprehended the Time-Space Deity Heart and was able to investigate through the River of Time to see this scene.
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction sensed it. He looked over to his direction.
It frightened that stage two World Deity so much that he gave up looking at it. He brought consciousness out of the river, and his figure became muddled once again.
…
In midair.
By the side of Xue Ying, White Sovereign King, and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, two new figures appeared. The two characters were condensing-they were a white-robed male and a black-robed woman. But they were just soul bodies! The snowy-white-robed male was still maintaining his calmness, thought that black-robed woman's expression became distorted. Her entire soul body was trembling.
"Mn?" White Sovereign King slightly frowned. Because he was the one saving them, and thus, the two lives had been moved to his side.
"It seems as if she can't stand her memories?" White Sovereign King's strength permeated into the body of this black-robed woman, merely flipping through the memories of the black-robed woman and forcibly sealing out the latest memory of her torture. Operating the soul of a weak little Transcendent… was just too easy to White Sovereign King who was standing high above.
After sealing the last section of the memories, the black-robed woman had regained her calmness.
"Mn?"
Chi Qiu Bai and the woman, 'Wu Xi', both opened their eyes and regained their consciousness.
"Little Xi?" Chi Qiu Bai had a nice surprise.
"Chi Bai." The black-robed woman was also filled with disbelief and excitement.
Their final memory was different. Chi Qiu Bai was clear that he had been used by an Abyss Sovereign called 'Howling Devil Cult Leader' as a tool to train his secret technique, and had experienced terrifying torments, yet he had not dissipated. It's just that he had no memory of what happened after that.
The black-robed woman had remembered that she had always been tortured. Chi Qiu Bai was also abused. As for what happened in the end, she did not know. It was just eternal torturous punishments. This section of memory had been sealed.
"Aren't I already…" The black-robed woman looked around her.
Chi Qiu Bai also gazed to his side.
Astonishment closely followed because he could see White Sovereign King, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction and Xue Ying right there. At the first moment when they saw them… Chi Qiu Bai could only sense the huge and unfathomable aura coming from them. The gap in life was too big, too big. Fortunately, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction and the rest had kept their auras. Otherwise, a slight strand of aura was enough to exterminate them.
Chi Qiu Bai soon had a closer look. One of the three vast auras was someone he recognized.
"Xue Ying?" Chi Qiu Bai was startled. In his memory, he remembered that during the final battle, Xue Ying might be formidable, but it was far beneath the aura which this person in front of him was giving out! The Xue Ying in front of him gave him a feeling that far surpassed the Great Demonic God from the past, and also that of the high-status Abyss Sovereign, 'Howling Devil Cult Leader'.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, the two of them have already been reincarnated from the River of Time." White Sovereign King chuckled, "Our exchange is also about done. In a while, I'll send you away from the Dark Abyss."
"I'll have to trouble you, White Sovereign King." Xue Ying replied.
"I reckon that resculpting their fleshy body doesn't require for me to act right? Haha, if I was to act, then I'll most likely use the Dark Abyss energy to condense their body. To you material realm lifeform, you would most likely not like the power from the Dark Abyss." White Sovereign King said.
"Just leave it to me." Xue Ying said. Resculpturing the fleshy body was still relatively easy.
"Oh right, that woman's willpower is much weaker, and the experience of her torment has made her unable to withstand. Thus, I've temporarily sealed that part of her memory. Over time, this part of memory will slowly be regained, and it will be a gradual process so that the influence on her is lesser." White Sovereign King said. Although White Sovereign King was cunning, he would finish things perfectly when he had to do it.
Xue Ying nodded.
Chi Qiu Bai and the black-robed woman heard it from the side.
"Eternal Wind, Sister-in-law." Xue Ying looked at Chi Qiu Bai and the black-robed woman, laughing, "I'll bring you two away from the Dark Abyss. Other matters can be spoken after we reached the Deity world."
"Alright." Chi Qiu Bai nodded. In his eyes, there was a strand of gratitude. He looked towards his wife while lightly hugging her.
Embracing his love, this was something he had been dreaming of doing for years, and finally, he had done it.

chapters.title: Chapter 590 - Monarchs of the Five Places
chapters.content:
Chapter 590: Monarchs of the Five Places
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The black-robed woman was likewise puzzled about Xue Ying's identity because she did not recognize him, and only after listening from the side did she understand that for her and Qiu Bai to be able to be reincarnated from the River of Time, it was all because of this Xue Ying.
Feeling Chi Qiu Bai hugging her from the side, the black-robed woman giggled. She felt sweet. This was something she had desired too.
"Old White Ghost, you should send them away. The exchange is over, so I'll be leaving first." Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction said.
"This time, I'll have to thank Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction." Xue Ying expressed his gratitude too.
Without the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction's participation, Xue Ying did not dare trust White Sovereign King.
"Hahaha…" Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction smirked, glancing at White Sovereign King before turning around, taking a step into the time-space tunnel and disappearing.
White Sovereign King looked at Xue Ying; he was too lazy to speak more.
He knew his own reputation wasn't too good.
"Let's go." White Sovereign King ordered.
"Go." Xue Ying waved his hand, keeping Chi Qiu Bai and his wife into his Cultivation Eden. Following that, he went along with White Sovereign King into the time-space tunnel, going along the path back home.
With White Sovereign King accompanying him, the path back home was much safer because with Xue Ying's current combat power, as long as it wasn't a Paragon who acted, there wasn't many who could threaten him. Even that 'King Patrol Devil' was someone Xue Ying estimated could suppress him at the most.
Hu hu.
Finally, they reached the surface level of the Dark Abyss, traveling through the blurred piece of darkness and following along the time-space tunnel. Xue Ying who had been traveling along felt the higher-up 'Willpower of the Dark Abyss' which represented destruction, darkness, and slaughter, finally retreating back.
As he walked out from the time-space tunnel, it was a piece of void already, and also the region within the Deity world.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying." White Sovereign King walked out of the time-space tunnel, standing on the void. The edge of his lips curled up, "This time, for you to get the original copy of the first half of Blood Demon Scripture from my territory meant that you are quite amazing. But you shouldn't be too delighted. You better cultivate properly and transcend beyond the River of Time. If you can't, you will only have a lifespan of 10 billion years. A pathetic brat who can't transcend and is able to take this original copy of absolute art is a humiliation to me."
"There is no need for Sovereign King to worry about this point." Xue Ying indifferently said.
That sir commander from the Destruction Legion was a stage four World Deity, and he had been mentioning to Xue Ying many times that 'the realm was fundamental'.
Xue Ying personally understood this point. If he could not transcend, everything would turn to emptiness.
"Sovereign King, then we'll take our leave first." Xue Ying said. White Sovereign King nodded before returning to the Dark Abyss once again. And ahead of Xue Ying, a Starfield Flying Ship appeared. He stepped on it before beginning his journey through the time-space once again.
******
Standing on the deck of the Starfield Flying Ship, there were currently Xue Ying, Chi Qiu Bai, and the black-robed woman Wu Xi. The two of them had their bodies reconstructed. To Xue Ying, it was a simple task.
"I truly would not have thought that I, Chi Qiu Bai, will have this day either." Chi Qiu Bai stood at the deckhead, looking at the surrounding stream of colorful time-space tunnel, "I could actually regain my fleshy body, and arrive in the Deity world. There's also Little Xi with me."
"Qiu Bai." The black-robed woman giggled too.
Xue Ying was happy to see this scene.
Eternal Wind had always been living a life of torture. Near the end of his life, he was incarcerated and tortured by Da Er Hao for many years and had also been used by Howling Devil Cult Leader to cultivate in the Blood Demon Scripture, causing him to be filled with resentment. The previous life… of Eternal Wind was indeed too sullen. Even his true love, 'Wu Xi', had been tortured to death by Da Er Hao, and was similarly in a tragic state.
And now, everything changed. Xue Ying felt happy for Chi Qiu Bai too.
"Xue Ying, this gratitude is something I'll inscribe in my heart." Chi Qiu Bai said, "It's just that with your current combat power and status, it'll be hard for me to return the favor."
"What are you saying these for? Eternal Wind, where do you and your wife want to travel? Is it to the Xia Clan world? Or the Deity world?" Xue Ying asked, "The Xia Clan world has the Crimson Rock Mountain world too, and it'll be easy for you all to enter there."
"Let's go to the Xia Clan world." Chi Qiu Bai looked at his wife, "I and Little Xi have been away from home for too long."
The black-robed woman chuckled too.
"Alright." Xue Ying nodded.
The speed of the Starfield Flying Ship was relatively fast. As they arrived at their destination, Xue Ying brought them into the material realm, 'Xia Clan world'.
…
In midair of the Xia Clan world.
The black-robed woman Wu Xi was standing in midair, looking at the rich, vast world. Her eyes were full of brightness, and she looked, "Xia Clan, hometown…"
"We are back." Chi Qiu Bai revealed a grin too.
"Then I'll leave first and not disturb both you husband and wife, hahaha, if there's any matter, just send a message to me." Xue Ying laughed as he took a step and disappeared.
Only then did Chi Qiu Bai and Wu Xi regained their romantic couple's world, looking at each other.
"The things I want to do are many." Chi Qiu Bai said.
"Me too." Wu Xi said, "Qiu Bai, come with me. I'll bring you to a place."
The two turned into streamers and flew along the sky.
******
Xue Ying brought along the True God weapon Flying Knife, leaving Xia Clan world. At his current combat power, the True God weapon Flying Knife had already been refined, and he naturally could bring it along.
"Hu."
The Starfield Flying Ship arrived at the Bloodshed God Palace.
Xue Ying's current mood was excellent. Other than the massive transformation in his combat power, the more important point was that he had completed a vital matter by helping Eternal Wind.
'With Eternal Wind's talent, even as his soul was split into two when he was a Transcendent, he was able to grasp hold of the grade two True Meaning. His talent was extremely high, and I wonder how far he could walk to now that he experienced so much hardship.' Xue Ying was looking forward to it. In the entire history of Xia Clan, if comparing talent, then other than his true body and Jing Qiu who reincarnated as a stage three World Deity, the other person with the highest talent was Chi Qiu Bai. Even though his own children might be outstanding, but they pale in comparison with Chi Qiu Bai. His children had been groomed by him and Jing Qiu, so the cultivation resources they obtained were a few times better than that received by Chi Qiu Bai.
Just landing at the Bloodshed God Palace, Xue Ying rushed over to the Crimson Stone Courtyard.
Suddenly, a message transmission came.
"Xue Ying, come over to my place." A voice resounded by his ears.
"Teacher?" Xue Ying immediately confirmed before moving towards his teacher.
That was a wooden courtyard.
That wooden courtyard stood a crimson-robed Bloodshed God Emperor alone. The black bird wasn't there.
Xue Ying had just walked over from outside, moving forward and politely greeting, "Disciple greets teacher."
"This time, the disturbance you created isn't small." Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled, "Fighting one on three and could still kill a powerful existence of the Abyss, and for you to bring the original copy of the first half of Blood Demon Scripture from the Dark Abyss. Haha, those three Rulers from the Abyss must have felt ashamed. I might have always been paying close notice to this, but it isn't good for me to act either. The moment I act, those three Rulers from the Abyss will definitely act too."
"Disciple understands." Xue Ying said.
"This absolute art from the Destruction Legion is very amazing. You could attain this combat power after becoming a stage four World Deity." Bloodshed God Emperor praised, "Your current combat power could be considered at the apex amongst powerful existences, and close to the Paragon."
Xue Ying agreed with this point in his heart.
"Since you are stronger now, it is due time for you to accept greater responsibility." Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled, "You are currently a Bloodshed Tavern Master, so the region you are responsible for will naturally increase."
Xue Ying immediately received a piece of information. It was information coming from the internal system of the Bloodshed Tavern, telling him the change in the region he was responsible for.
"Yes." Xue Ying immediately acknowledged.
This little responsibility was something he had to shoulder!
"With your current combat power now, it is time for you to learn of more things too." Bloodshed God Emperor calmly said, "On the road of cultivation, it is impossible to avoid certain battles. If you don't fight for opportunity, it will only land in your opponents' hands. Your opponents will be able to become stronger and trample on you! The moment you fall, the second time you fall behind… it will keep accumulating until you are thrown far away! Thus, on the path of cultivation, you must always fight for it. You have to emphasize your internal strengths, and external resources too."
"Disciple understands." Xue Ying nodded.
He had received the three unique treasures left behind by the ice-sealed dead Paragon like the 'crimson wristband' and others. The crimson wristband and other treasures had the 'time-space Dao' inherent within, allowing him to reduce many obstacles when comprehending the Time-Space Deity Heart. If not for these three treasures, he would have to spend a few hundred thousand years.
Because of the True God weapon Flying Knife too, allowing him to improve his comprehension of the 'slaughter' and 'mirage's world profound mysteries. That was why he could attain success in cultivating the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body"in a shorter period of time, and for his spear technique secret skill 'Destruction's power to increase significantly. Otherwise, when he was fighting one on three that time… and if his spear technique was not powerful enough, it was unlikely for him to escape.
This was resources.
His own cultivation was more critical, but external resources could help to catalyze his improvement.
"All sorts of battle allow the Deity world and Abyss to form into separate superpowers. Many powerful existences decided to rely on us for the sake of survival." Bloodshed God Emperor said, "But I can only ascertain the safety of their avatars within the God Palace territory. As for going out to fight and kill… I will not participate in the battle between ordinary powerful existences. Pang Yi, Destruction, and Bamboo Mountain are all Paragons, and it isn't good for me to participate in their matters too."
Xue Ying nodded.
"The powerful existences under me, other than the scattered idle powerful existences, there is also the 'Monarchs of the Five Places'." Bloodshed God Emperor said.
"Monarchs of the Five Places?" Xue Ying was puzzled. He honestly did not know of this.
"The Monarchs of the Five Places require to have power close to Paragons. Only then could they take the position. I'll also put in all my efforts to groom them. During any external-facing battle, the many powerful existences in my Bloodshed God Palace will also treat them as the commanders." Bloodshed God Emperor said, "But currently, of the Five Monarchs of the Five Places, there are only two taking up the roles, and they are Gu Zang and North Hu."
Xue Ying knew these two as well.
Monarch Gu Zang was his own senior disciple brother and had a combat power close to that of a Paragon.
North Hu Palace Master was an extremely ancient powerful existence and had a combat power close to that of a Paragon too.
"The other powerful existences are not strong enough, so they naturally do not have the qualifications to take up the responsibility." Bloodshed God Emperor looked at Xue Ying, "You might only be a stage four World Deity, but your combat power is strong enough! Thus, I wish for you to become the third Monarch of the Five Places."
"From today onwards, the many powerful existences in the Bloodshed God Palace will also be under the three of your command. Fighting with other superpowers…" Bloodshed God Emperor said, "The responsibilities you shoulder will be more, but naturally, you will get more benefits too, and it will be of great help to your cultivation."
Xue Ying immediately answered, "Yes, disciple understands."

chapters.title: Chapter 591 - Cosmos Epoch
chapters.content:
Chapter 591: Cosmos Epoch
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled and nodded as he looked at this. He was delighted with this disciple, Xue Ying, of his. Over the many years, he had seen many stage four World Deities with great innate talents, and he had taught many of these outstanding ones. Amongst which, those who successfully transcended were Monarch Gu Zang and Monarch Green! But those who made him feel satisfied and pleased were few and far between.
Most of them were too arrogant. There was only a gap between complacency and confidence! Any powerful existences should be self-confident, but many had become overly so. Naturally, they would grow blind, and it would be hard for them to walk a further path.
Bloodshed felt that amongst his disciples, he was most satisfied with Monarch Green. The next person would then be Xue Ying.
"With how calm and reserved he is, I believe it isn't hard for him to transcend. In the future, there is hope of him opening his own Dao path too." Bloodshed God Emperor thought.
"Xue Ying." Bloodshed God Emperor said, "The Monarchs of the Five places have their own respective forbidden ground too."
"Forbidden grounds?" Xue Ying was startled.
"Mn." Bloodshed God Emperor nodded, "Ever since the Great Apocalypse of the cosmos, the cosmos will reform, forming many unique places in the entire vast Deity world that are beneficial to cultivation. My Bloodshed God Palace territory have five such places, and naturally, I'll deem these five places as forbidden grounds for the Monarchs of the Five places. Now, two have their owners, leaving the remaining three for you to select."
Xue Ying was carefully listening.
"Of the five places, the 'Corpse Burial Cavern' and 'Ice Origin Planet' have owners already, leaving behind the remaining three-Black Fog Sea, Fire God Tree, and Lightning Island." Bloodshed God Emperor introduced.
"Corpse Burial Cavern?" Xue Ying was dumbstruck. This name did not sound comfortable to him, yet it was one of the five forbidden grounds, and had been chosen already?
"Teacher, is the Corpse Burial Cavern also a land of treasure?" Xue Ying could not help but ask.
Bloodshed God Emperor lightly chuckled, "The Corpse Burial Cavern is a very ordinary-looking cavern on the surface, and it is merely a few meters wide. But the moment one enters, it is actually an Eden world! The Eden world contains many corpses. It is an ancient battlefield of the second cosmos epoch, and of the corpses within, there are two Rulers' corpses! Do you think its not a land of treasure? That place is very appropriate for your Senior Disciple Brother Gu Zang; thus, he chose it."
"There are two corpses of Rulers?" Xue Ying was very shocked. But if he were given a choice, he would not select a place filled with corpses. This was forbidden ground for himself.
"Even if you want to choose, you can't select it. Let me briefly explain the remaining three places." Bloodshed God Emperor said, "The Black Fog Sea is a place filled with much black fog within the starry sky. The black fog has been naturally formed from the cosmos, and the moment one enters, there will be many illusions appearing. The deeper one enters, the stronger the illusions. With my combat power, I could barely reach the deepest end within the black fog. Those who are weaker will most likely be trapped within, eternally unable to regain their consciousness."
"Illusions?" Xue Ying nodded.
"The Fire God Tree is a huge tree. This huge tree has been rooted in the void and is about 195,000 kilometers in diameter. The entire tree is burning in flame eternally. Those who want to cultivate over here include many, like Paragon Huo Cheng whom you are close to, he has cultivated there before. Naturally, his teacher Primal Master had paid quite a huge price for it, only then did I allow him to cultivate for 10,000 years there. After 10,000 years, I'd chased him away." Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled, "The final place is the Lightning Island, and is located at a place similar to the Temporal Island. It is an empty island. The Temporal Island is located in a unique place where time-space could hardly arrive at, and the Lightning Island is flourishing with myriad lightning and also a place full of extraordinary things."
"Select a place." Bloodshed God Emperor said.
Xue Ying pondered for a while, "Black Fog Sea!"
"You chose this place?" Bloodshed God Emperor laughed, "It seems the case indeed that you emphasize your profound mysteries of the world the most."
Xue Ying chuckled, "Nothing can be hidden from Teacher."
Black Fog Sea…
Even Bloodshed God Emperor could barely reach the end of the Black Fog Sea. Those who were weaker would be immersed in the hallucination world for eternity. This hallucination, firstly, it was an 'illusion' and the other was sketching the outlines of a world. It was relatively close to the Mirage, and besides with the 'Dao of Mirage' in his True God weapon Flying Knife, Xue Ying naturally would want to have proper research over it.
"The world specializes in encompassing and is indeed appropriate for you to cultivate. If your realm is high enough, you could use the World Deity Heart to encompass all laws of profound mysteries, forming a complete law of the world. By then, you would have transcended beyond the River of Time." Bloodshed God Emperor nodded and praised.
Xue Ying nodded too. During transcending, the hardest matter was to fuse all Deity Hearts comprehended into a complete entity.
As for grasping the other Deity Hearts?
It was tough to some stage four World Deities because they had absorbed belief energy. But Xue Ying had never depended on Belief Stones before. He cultivated for a short period of time too, so the karma formed was very little! Comprehending the 'Karma Deity Heart' was a simple matter, and even the tough Substance Deity Heart had been comprehended. He believed that the 'Boundless Deity Heart'… would be comprehended after not too long later.
With the World Deity Heart that completely encompassed everything, fusing together everything into a single entity in the end! This formed the law of the world!
That was also known as large success!
"As for transcending, you should focus on this as well. Firstly, your cultivation must focus more on the full law of the world. You can't seek strength, and madly comprehend all sorts of other secret techniques! Seeking the strength of the secret techniques alone." Bloodshed God Emperor reminded him.
"I can't pursue strength too madly?" Xue Ying was bewildered.
"Look at Bamboo Mountain as an example, and you will know it." Bloodshed God Emperor had just finished saying when large amounts of information were transmitted to his disciple.
Xue Ying immediately sensed the communication treasure receiving a significant amount of information.
It was a considerable amount of detailed intelligence from the Deity world and Abyss, and it was so much more detailed than the one provided by Paragon Huo Cheng! Amongst which, there was a comprehensive introduction to Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master concerning his cultivation aspect.
"So it's like this, only then did he not transcend?" Xue Ying was startled and enlightened at the same time.
"Understand?" Bloodshed God Emperor said.
"Disciple understands, but this stage is still far for me." Xue Ying said.
"Mn, your foundation is not built deep enough, so there is no need for you to worry about this." Bloodshed God Emperor said, "Furthermore, those who could achieve this stage as a stage four World Deity could be counted with one's fingers in the many cosmos epochs! Our cosmos epoch only has Bamboo Mountain doing it."
Xue Ying nodded.
"Also, if there's any karma entangling you, you should resolve them as soon as possible." Bloodshed God Emperor reminded, "Some karma might influence your cultivation."
"Yes." Xue Ying said.
He did not form much karma actually. More importantly, it was karma built with his loved ones and good friends. These karmas were benign, and would not affect his cultivation. Even the karma with 'Forefather Scarlet Flame' might be heavier, but that had been because Forefather Scarlet Flame saved Jing Qiu at that time! Still, Forefather Scarlet Flame was a friend and did not deliberately demanded Xue Ying to do anything, so the influence on him wasn't huge.
Those who had an influence on him included Forefather Black Devil! Forefather Black Devil had been the one who killed Sacred Master Crimson Dust last time. He was Sacred Master Crimson Dust's personal disciple, so naturally, he had enmity with him! But Sacred Master Crimson Dust did not require his disciples to avenge him before transcending so this karmic influence wasn't that huge too.
"To you, you just have to pay close attention to these two points when transcending." Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled. Waving his hand, he passed a triangular talisman to Xue Ying, "This is the key to the Black Fog Sea's array. Because it is too dangerous, I've long set an array down to prevent others from entering."
Xue Ying received it immediately.
"Teacher, previously you talked about the cosmos epochs a few times." Xue Ying asked, "And also said about how the Corpse Burial Cavern had been left behind by the second cosmos epoch. Then which cosmos epoch are we currently at? And what about the Lake Heart Island master?"

chapters.title: Chapter 592 - ‘Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master’, the one who could not transcend
chapters.content:
Chapter 592: ‘Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master’, the one who could not transcend
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"The plants have their stages of withering, and the worlds have their periods collapse. Similarly, the cosmos will rise and fall. From the beginning when the cosmos emerges until the Great Apocalypse, this period of time could be considered as an epoch." Bloodshed God Emperor looked at Xue Ying, "Just like how the mortal realm's mortal world all last differently, every epoch has a different length too. If we, the lifeforms created a huge burden on the cosmos, or that we destroyed too much, then this cosmos will be shorter, and it will enter the period of Great Apocalypse in a shorter time."
Xue Ying was carefully listening.
"Strictly speaking, our cosmos epoch is actually the eighth cosmos epoch." Bloodshed God Emperor sighed, "And it is one of the more ordinary ones. According to the experts who emerged, the most dazzling one is during the third cosmos epoch! The third cosmos epoch saw two amazing existences emerging. One was the Lake Heart Island Master, and the other was Ancestor Devil."
"The eighth cosmos epoch?" Xue Ying slightly nodded.
"Those were the past. Now, we can only find some clues to their existences in the historical remains." Bloodshed God Emperor explained, "Alright, now, you should focus more on cultivating and transcend as soon as possible! With your talent, if you are fast enough, you should be able to transcend in a million years."
Xue Ying felt that his teacher's hope for him was indeed tremendous. Transcending in a million years?
"Disciple will try my best." Xue Ying answered.
"Haha…" Bloodshed God Emperor did not think much about it. Instead, he changed the topic, "I originally said that after exploring the ancient cavern dwelling, I'll select a good reward for you. But the improvement of your combat power has been faster than I expected. Now that you are close to a Paragon combat power, it isn't appropriate for you to continue seeking power, and instead, you should grasp hold of the law of the world. For a moment, I truly do not have any treasures for you."
"This treasure will be left temporarily with me. Wait until you transcend, and I'll give you, greatly increasing your hopes of opening your Dao path." Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled.
"Disciple isn't in a rush. The strongest disciple's combat power is, the better the treasure teacher will give to me." Xue Ying laughed too.
"Alright." Bloodshed God Emperor laughed as well, "Go, go and hurry up with your own matters."
"Disciple will withdraw now."
Xue Ying bowed before leaving the place.
Bloodshed God Emperor saw Xue Ying going, and could not help but smile and nod. In his long years of cultivation, the loved ones would gradually leave. Instead, it was the 'disciples' who would accompany him for a longer period of time! To Bloodshed God Emperor, the teacher-disciple relationship would eventually become their most important relationship. Naturally, those 'emotionless descendants' were another matter.
…
Xiu.
Leaving the abode of his teacher, Xue Ying flew towards the Crimson Stone Courtyard.
Flying in the high sky, he could not tear through space here and could only fly slowly.
As he flew, Xue Ying was carefully looking at the massive amount of information provided by his teacher. With the identity of Bloodshed God Emperor, the information he gave was very much detailed, allowing Xue Ying to have a more comprehensive understanding of the entire cosmos.
'So, the reason why Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master is unable to transcend is due to this. No wonder that commander from the Destruction Legion is feeling extremely regretful.' Xue Ying thought.
During ordinary cultivation, one would begin to sense other side Deity Hearts after becoming a stage four World Deity before finally, once the foundation was thick enough, one would comprehend and fuse all laws of profound mysteries into the complete entity-the law of the world! That would be when one transcended to become a True God.
After becoming a True God, one would begin analyzing other secret techniques or self-created secret skills, studying the laws of profound mysteries before finally, one was able to rise above the law of the world, a 'Dao'! As one opened his own Dao path, he would become a Paragon.
Opening one's own Dao… did not mean one was mature. It had to be perfected continuously. As long as this Dao which one opened had reached true eternity, one would become a 'Ruler'.
For instance, Bloodshed God Emperor had opened his 'Dao of Bloodshed', 'Dao of Shadow' and 'Dao of Destruction'.
Temporal Island Lord had opened the 'Dao of Time-Space'.
As an example, to open this 'Dao of Time-Space', one would primarily gain a deeper understanding towards the foundation of the laws of profound mystery behind time-space. After comprehending a deeper and more profound time-space profound mystery, he would then fuse it together with his current comprehension, forming the 'Dao of Time-Space'. Thus, to open the 'Dao of Time-Space', there was no need to comprehend the Creation of Heaven Deity Heart, Karma Deity Heart and the rest. And there was no need to comprehend the complete law of the world.
Thus-
Theoretically speaking, if a stage four World Deity's realm reached an adequately profound stage, he could open his own Dao path too.
'Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master' had precisely opened his 'Dao of Destructive Lightning' before comprehending the complete law of the world as a stage four World Deity then. Ever since, he was able to gain the combat power of a Paragon, yet he could not transcend.
'According to the records.'
Xue Ying thought, 'Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master is the only one to open his Dao path as a stage four World Deity in this cosmos epoch. According to the description of teacher's information, even across the many cosmos epochs, those who achieved this stage at a stage four World Deity realm could be counted with one's fingers.'
Indeed, that's the case.
There were very very few powerful existences who could reach the power of a Paragon realm despite cultivating for a long period of time! Those who could open their own Dao path were even fewer.
Clearly, opening one's own Dao was harder than comprehending the complete law of the world.
Under ordinary circumstances still, it wasn't the case that one could open his Dao path as a stage four World Deity.
'But if a talent happens to appear… it might have a contrary effect.' Xue Ying sighed, 'Transcending will be an even more arduous task.'
What was transcending?
Transcending meant pulling out from the River of Time, leaping onto the river bank.
Being submerged in the River of Time, the only way to escape its restriction was with the aid of a complete law of eternity.
But-
The lives within the River of Time had different degrees of strength. Mortals were small and feeble. Transcendents were weak and small too. Deities and World Deities were gradually stronger! Like Xue Ying, his body was extremely huge in the River of Time, and was much bigger than normal stage four World Deities!
The bigger his body, the stronger the restriction force from the River of Time!
Thus, even if he reincarnated, those whose body was huge had a harder time reincarnating because they were 'too steeped' in it, and 'could not be pulled out'!
And Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master?
Being a stage four World Deity who opened his own Dao path, his body was a hundred times bigger than Xue Ying's! With how big his body was, even if he comprehended the complete law of the world, under the help of the law of the world, he would still be unable to escape from the restriction by the 'River of Time'! He had to use a stronger more eternal law, and that was for him to become a Ruler.
Becoming a Ruler, the Dao he opened would be perfected and eternal. Only by borrowing this could he escape.
'Opening his Dao as a Stage four World Deity, only by becoming a Ruler could he transcend.' Xue Ying shook his head, 'Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master and the commander of the Destruction Legion, that is truly pitiable.'
'No wonder, one could not be too reliant on strength, seeking the extremes of secret techniques. Usually, cultivators would not fall into such predicament. My talent might be high, and I have always been pursuing secret techniques to increase in my power. Who knows, I might really be that 'fortuitous' in opening my Dao path as a stage four World Deity, and similarly encountering this issue.' Xue Ying grinned.
He knew that this probability was extremely low. Even across the many epochs, those who did it could be counted with one's finger!
Even if he deliberately chased after power, he might not be able to do it. Otherwise, Nine Yang Palace Head, Violet-Gowned Hex Emperor, King Patrol Devil and the others would have become a Paragon after so many years.
'Amongst the ordinary World Deities, they thought Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master is able to become so heaven-shattering by relying on his absolute art.' Xue Ying shook his head, 'Now that I know of it, it is indeed a huge joke!'
Actually, he had long been suspicious of it.
Why was Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master so dazzling? His absolute art was very unique?
So would that mean that the absolute arts of those Bloodshed God Emperor and the other Rulers could not compare with that of Bamboo Mountain's? Now that he was stronger, Xue Ying finally knew of the behind-the-scenes' secret.

chapters.title: Chapter 593 - Forbidden Ground
chapters.content:
Chapter 593: Forbidden Ground
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Other than the report on why Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master was unable to transcend, there were two other intelligence reports which Xue Ying paid greater importance to.
One of it was according to his teacher, other than the five Rulers from the Deity world and the three Rulers of the Abyss from the various superpowers; there was still another superpower hidden in the cosmos. This superpower was extremely secretive, and there should be very few experts amongst them. Those who knew of their existences were very few too, and even some Paragons might not know of their existences.
This superpower had a distinctive trait-their members all had no lines of karma!
'No karmic lines?' Xue Ying was a bit puzzled. Discovering others from karma was a commonly used method. Even his teacher Bloodshed God Emperor had a karmic line too-like the karma linkage between him and his teacher!
But some experts had no karmic lines at all?
According to the intelligence report, this was an extremely hidden secret in the entire cosmos, and only Rulers knew of it! Some Rulers had not even told the Paragons underneath them. Naturally, Bloodshed God Emperor had spoken to all disciples and good friends he valued.
"This matter is unique, and could not be leaked out! The moment one discovers an enemy with no karmic line, one has to report those he called as a teacher." Bloodshed God Emperor also heavily reminded him in the intelligence report.
'Who would have thought.'
Xue Ying sighed inwardly, 'There is such a secret superpower hidden in the cosmos. But the chances of me meeting them should be very low.'
He would temporarily place this aside.
Xue Ying paid closer notice of the final intelligence report that was interesting.
'Primal Master is truly bored.' Xue Ying revealed a grin. There was an intelligence report amongst that given by his teacher, 'Cosmos Deity-Demon List'.
The Cosmos Deity-Demon List was made by that unconventional independent, most ancient Ruler, 'Primal Master'. Under his boredom, he had created a list ranking the strongest 100 cultivators in the entire cosmos! And he had given them a ranking. Every time Primal Master affirmed the rankings, he would only pass to the experts with their names listed on it.
This list had merely recorded-
Cosmos Deity-Demon List: 1st, Bloodshed God Emperor
2nd, Abyss Primogenitor
3rd: Primal Master
4th: Purgatory Ruler
5th: Temporal Island Lord
6th: Myriad God Palace Head
7th: Empress Qian He
8th: Pang Yi
9th: Bloody Ruler
10th: Monarch Green
11th: Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction
…
99th: Forefather Fierce Tyrant
100th: Sovereign Star Meteor
It was solely a ranking list with no explanations at all.
'Pang Yi is ranked eighth? And he is higher ranked than Bloody Ruler?' Xue Ying was speechless after viewing this Cosmos Deity-Demon List. He had never heard of Pang Yi becoming a Ruler, yet he was able to rank eighth! Even the most famous person in the entire Deity world and Abyss, and publicly recognized as the existence closest to that of a Ruler, Monarch Green, was ranked tenth.
'But I do not have a ranking yet.' Xue Ying murmured inwardly. His combat power should be stronger than Forefather Fierce Tyrant and the others, 'I have only just broken through and has revealed my strength recently. I believe I will be able to be ranked the next time the list comes out.'
******
Crimson Stone Courtyard.
"Father." Xue Ying had just appeared in the cavern-dwelling when his daughter, Qing Yao, took the initiative in welcoming him joyously.
"Xue Ying." Jing Qiu and Monarch Mo Xue appeared too.
"Father, I've heard that you fought one on three against three powerful existences and killed one even still?" Qing Yao's eyes were twinkling. She was awfully yearning for that scene.
Xue Ying looked at his daughter and laughed, "I've only killed an avatar. Deaths and injuries are still quite common when powerful existences fought amongst each other, but most of them were merely avatars! It is rare when both true bodies and avatars are exterminated."
"Good Son-in-law, the whole scene created in the Dark Abyss by those killing you is huge. So many Abyss Sovereigns acting and even existences like King Patrol Devil, Emperor Qi Hai have acted… and there are even rumors of White Sovereign King supporting behind them! For you to come back alive is something very amazing already. Many good old friends of mine say that the chances of this Highness Dong Bo coming back is very low. It's a pity they were wrong!" Monarch Mo Xue was filled with praise.
Xue Ying chuckled, "Oh right, Teacher has given me the responsibility as one of the Monarchs of the Five Places, and has given me a forbidden ground. Let us prepare to move off."
