"Monarchs of the Five Places?" Monarch Mo Xue, Jing Qiu, and Qing Yao were all puzzled.
"It's only an official position, albeit a unique one." Xue Ying said, "Saying it as 'Monarchs of the Five Places', there are only two who took up positions, and they are North Hu Palace Head and my Senior Disciple Brother, Gu Zang."
"North Hu Palace Head and Monarch Gu Zang? They are already amazing existences amongst powerful existences." Monarch Mo Xue understood that this 'Monarchs of the Five Places' position must be something amazing.
"You even have a forbidden ground?" Jing Qiu was puzzled.
"Mn, it's at the Black Fog Sea." Xue Ying said, "Naturally, I'll have to reconstruct the place. Oh, and where's Yu'er?"
"Yu'er has been stuck at a bottleneck and can't break through. He is currently roaming around. I've already transmitted a message to Yu'er for him to come back as soon as possible. But he said he will be late, and will most likely come back after half a month." Jing Qiu said.
"If that's the case, then we'll let him go to the Black Fog Sea directly." Xue Ying said, "Let's not wait for him anymore."
That day, Xue Ying brought along his wife and the others on the Starfield Flying Ship towards Black Fog Sea.
…
"That is Black Fog Sea?" Qing Yao's eyes were very bright. She was delightedly looking at the huge black fog filled within the starry sky.
"I've heard that there is a huge array enveloping this area, preventing us from getting near to it." Monarch Mo Xue said.
Xue Ying replied, "You guys wait here for me."
"Sou."
He broke through the sky and went forward.
Jing Qiu, Monarch Mo Xue, and Qing Yao were all waiting on top of the flying ship deck, looking at it. They could only see Xue Ying easily entering through the array obstacles, arriving by the boundary of the Black Fog Sea.
'Let's begin.' Xue Ying looked at the rolling endless black fog which was also his forbidden ground from now. If he had become a powerful existence, he would most likely be spending a long period here. Most powerful existences would have their territory, and even Bloodshed God Emperor had his place-the 'Bloodshed God Palace'. After all, only when he constructed the place himself would he be most familiar with it.
And he could always fortify the ground continuously over the years.
"Hong long long~"
Xue Ying directly operated the World Energy. With his attainment in the world aspect, he could control the world energy from an area of 3 trillion kilometers.
World energy could transform into the myriad existences.
That was on the condition he understood the structure of the substance.
'Condense!'
Following which, with a thought by Xue Ying, he could see endless ground within forming within the 3 trillion kilometers in range of region. The land became denser deeper down. All sorts of subterranean rocks and even metals were forming. There were even some of the more unique materials within. Naturally, many Transcendents and ordinary Deities valued these materials. Because they were materials which Xue Ying had dissected entirely before, they were some of the more ordinary ones.
The world energy could transform however he wanted.
A vast land appeared, and the Black Fog Sea had surrounded the ground! The Black Fog Sea was approximately just a small area of the entire place.
Rivers were surging on the land.
Trees were growing, and mountains undulating. The scene was quite beautiful.
Right at the center of the land, there was a chain of palaces that were grand. Some were given for guests to stay in, and some were for protectors. Some were for disciples, and some were for World Deity lifeforms they were breeding. Some were even for descendants and disciples of the future generations for cultivating, adventuring, undertaking trials and other areas! There was also a cultivation ground for himself, a place for researching secret techniques, a place to welcome guests…
Even still, the chain of palaces made by Xue Ying as compared to the territory of other powerful existences was considered more ordinary.
He was after all, too young, and there were too few people following him. Thus, the chain of palaces he needed was smaller too.
'There's also the arrays.' Xue Ying might not be very formidable regarding arrays, but he had been researching the time-space array within the scarlet wristband, and also the 'Dao' within the True God weapon Flying Knife. He had also cultivated all sorts of arrays as part of the absolute arts, and naturally, his attainment had reached a high profound stage. He began rampantly weaving many arrays.
Especially for the mirage array, the time-space array, and the substance array-they were more common.
The substance array primarily borrowed upon some profound mysteries of the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body". After weaving them, he had fortified the structures. Even though it was far from the density and toughness of his black armor, only stage four World Deity could move the current structure now.
The time-space array had also caused space in many places to change.
The mirage array, borrowing upon some of the profound mysteries from the 'Dao of Mirage'… it was even more mythical. Even stage four World Deity could get lost if they barged into the place.
Saying it was fast. In reality, Xue Ying had spent three days or so before finally completing his construction of his territory. After constructing it, did he informed those subordinates of his from the 'Eastern Region Supervisor Envoy residence' to come over. After becoming a Monarch of the Five Places, he naturally would no longer take up the position as a supervisor envoy.
"This will be our future home." Xue Ying walked along with his wife Jing Qiu, his daughter Qing Yao and Monarch Mo Xue together, viewing the chains of palaces.
"This is the simplest of construction currently. If you have any desires for your own home, tell me anytime." Xue Ying laughed. He would fortify his territory as he grew stronger.
"Good son-in-law, the news of you promoting has already been spread. By then, I believe there will be many who comes paying a visit to you, Monarch Dong Bo." Monarch Mo Xue laughed, "You have also just constructed a forbidden ground, opened a residence, so it'll be best if you organized a feast and invited many powerful existences over."
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
With a forbidden ground and an official residence, this was a significant matter even to cultivators. He should indeed organize a feast.
"Sir Father-in-law, this matter is something you are more familiar with so I'll let you handle it." Xue Ying laughed.
"Good good good." Monarch Mo Xue laughed in reply. Contacting the powerful existences of many places was something that would give him respect. Before reincarnating, being able to gain such respect was something that made him truly happy.
Jing Qiu said from the side, "Xue Ying, you should send people from the God Palace and build a time-space teleportation array too."
"Alright." Xue Ying nodded.
Without a time-space teleportation array, some of the weaker cultivators without starfield flying ships would have a hard time coming over. For instance, his son Dong Bo Yu had no Starfield Flying Ship yet!
Suddenly, a voice came transmitting over. It resounded by the side of Xue Ying-
"Dong Bo, I've recently changed this Cosmos Deity-Demon List of mine. This is something which I made during my free time, and I'll only inform those cultivators on the list." Primal Master's voice was something Xue Ying was quite familiar with, so he was able to recognize him.
Following which, the latest Cosmos Deity-Demon List was transferred over to Xue Ying.

chapters.title: Chapter 594 - Cosmos Deity-Demon List
chapters.content:
Chapter 594: Cosmos Deity-Demon List
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Primal Master's identity was initially a secret. Many stage four World Deities did not know of the existence of this ruler. Amongst the Rulers, he was the most secretive yet extraordinary one. Similarly, he was also the oldest Ruler. Besides, he had developed the 'Cosmos Deity-Demon List' during his free time, informing only the experts on the list. Thus, the reputation of the 'Cosmos Deity-Demon List' was very small, and few knew of it.
In the vast cosmos, only the group of top existences knew of it.
Xue Ying carefully looked through-
1st, Bloodshed God Emperor
2nd, Abyss Primogenitor
3rd: Primal Master
…
8th: Pang Yi
9th: Bloody Ruler
10th: Monarch Green
11th: Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction
12th: Monarch Hex Cricket
13th: Water Devil King
14th: White Sovereign King
15th: Bitter Cultivator
16th: Purgatory Great Commander
17th: Paragon Huo Cheng
18th: Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master
19th: Mysterious North Imperial Empress
…
44th: King Patrol Devil
45th: Pan Yu
46th: Blind Old Man
…
50th: Purple Gown Hex Emperor
51st: North Wu Palace Head
52nd: Monarch Dong Bo
…
55th: Forefather Golden Firmament
56th: Prison Sea Devil King
57th: Nine Yang Palace Head
…
100th: Forefather Fierce Tyrant
There were only titles on this list; very few would use their true name. Only 'Pang Yi' and 'Pan Yu' had directly used their name.
Pang Yi was more special-that time, he had accepted disciples without restraint to teach them. He was also fair and had candidly renounced all titles.
As for 'Pan Yu', he was a powerful existence who had emerged during the earliest period of cosmos emergence. He was formerly an ordinary dog beast who cultivated step by step. After becoming a powerful existence, his relationship with Monarch Hex Cricket became very good. However, when Monarch Hex Cricket became a Paragon, there appeared to have some tensions between the two of them, resulting in them parting their ways ever since.
'In the vast cosmos, the top 100 strongest existences.' Xue Ying exclaimed in admiration inwardly, 'Who would have thought that I am ranked 52nd, higher than even Nine Yang Palace Head, Forefather Golden Firmament, and many other powerful existences.'
Ranking at 52nd was indeed a very high ranking for him. He was comparable to people like Violet Gown Hex Emperor.
'But I am still questioning myself if there exist many flaws in my secret skills.' Xue Ying pondered, 'Like Nine Yang Palace Head and the rest, they have their absolute arts, yet I am ranked beyond them?'
'Unless it's because of my True God weapon and stellar defenses which had a huge advantage against them?'
Xue Ying was guessing.
The True God weapon 'Flying Knife' wasn't brought along with him to the Dark Abyss. Thus, he had never used it. But what identity did Primal Master have? He should know that those who joined the Destruction Legion would obtain a True God weapon, and a True God weapon would increase his combat power. During the consideration for the rankings, Primal Master must have certainly taken into account his True God weapon.
Nine Yang Palace Head did not own a True God weapon! Besides with his heaven-shattering defenses, even Paragons like 'White Sovereign King' who was famous for his battling techniques, could only cause his armor to take damage. Such a defense was his biggest strength, and these were all taken into account to give rise to his current ranking.
…
At the same time when Primal Master was transmitting this new set of Cosmos Deity-Demon List, he had also transmitted it to other existences on the list.
Everyone discovered the change in the list. Due to the short interval between the releases, everyone could perceive the clear difference by the appearance of Xue Ying. He had caused everyone beneath to move back by one position. 'Sovereign Star Meteor' had even been kicked out of the list.
'Monarch Dong Bo? That should be His Highness Dong Bo. I've heard that he has taken up the role as one of the Monarchs of the Five Places in Bloodshed God Palace, yet he could be ranked 52nd so quickly. His senior disciple brother, Monarch Gu Zang, is only ranked 49th." Violet-Gowned Hex Emperor who was currently cultivating under Primal Master praised. His ranking was just slightly higher, but he did not seem to mind.
Violet-Gowned Hex Emperor was different from others. He did not care about absolute arts. What he focused more was on all sorts of cultivation path. That was why he might only be ranked 50th, but his foundation was solid. His specialized in all kinds of different paths and had cultivated to the limit for all of them. Any of these paths could be used to open his own Dao; it might even be possible that he would open a few Daos in the future.
"I hope he doesn't overly fixate himself in chasing after strength." Violet-Gowned Hex Emperor chuckled.
Paragon Huo Cheng glared at him from the side, "Violet Gown, don't say this to my Brother Dong Bo. With his cultivation speed, he should be able to transcend sooner or later. Why do you have the time to talk about others when you have yet to become a Paragon! He is also a member of the Destruction Legion, and the moment he transcends… he has hopes of bringing the absolute art of the Destruction Legion to an even more profound level. By then, he should be able to fight against Paragons!"
"It isn't he who is powerful. It is the absolute art crafted by Lake Heart Island Master that is powerful. The strongest experts across the many epochs have spent so much blood and effort in creating an absolute art, so it is normal that it is so powerful." Violet-Gowned Hex Emperor commented.
"Hmph hmph, he isn't powerful?" Paragon Huo Cheng turned slightly angry, "The Destruction Eden is just right there. If you have the capabilities, then you can take the trials too. See if you can enter the Destruction Legion too. In our cosmos epoch, other than Pang Yi, only Brother Dong Bo can do so! Unless this isn't his power?"
Violet-Gowned Hex Emperor was startled.
That's right.
Although not many knew about the Destruction Eden, those at the higher level would know of it, yet till now, all of them had failed to join the legion. Only Pang Yi and Xue Ying had succeeded.
"It's my wrong." Violet-Gowned Hex Emperor chuckled, "It is indeed his strength that enabled him to become a member of the Destruction Legion."
"Hmph hmph, that's right." Paragon Huo Cheng said, "Oh right, Brother Dong Bo has just informed me that he will be holding a feast three months later. Are you going or not?"
"I'll not be going. This time, I've gotten quite a lot of reward from the ancient cavern dwelling. I'll still be here reflecting in peace, seeking that spark." Violet-Gowned Hex Emperor replied, "You help me bring some gifts over, and also help mention it to Dong Bo Xue Ying. Currently, I have no wish of getting distracted."
"Alright alright, I know." Paragon Huo Cheng nodded.
He knew the temperament of this new disciple brother of his.
Violet-Gowned Hex Emperor was in love with cultivation and research, and it was normal for him to cultivate for 10 billion years in one ago. This time, he had obtained a huge reward from the ancient cavern dwelling so he would naturally not be willing to be distracted.
…
The many apex experts of this cosmos epoch knew of Xue Ying, and from then on, Xue Ying had entered this circle as well.
******
This time as he hosted a feast, even though it was primarily his father-in-law who sent out the invitations, Xue Ying personally invited some of the experts with a higher status like North Hu Palace Master, Monarch Gu Zang and the rest, like the Paragons-Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master and Paragon Huo Cheng. Regardless if they came or not, he would at least send an invitation!
Amongst which, Xue Ying had even personally invited a powerful existence-Forefather Golden Firmament!
'Forefather Golden Firmament has an old grievance with Jing Qiu. This matter could not be faulted on Jing Qiu, though to deal with someone who is carefree and specialized with escape, a powerful existence which even Paragons have a hard time in killing… there is no need to fight all the way on.' Xue Ying thought, 'This is a good time to resolve the conflict.'
Forefather Golden Firmament was someone with no concerns; such people were the hardest to handle.
He might not be able to deal with Xue Ying, yet he could entirely deal with Jing Qiu unless she hid in her territory forever!
And even Xue Ying himself could not cope with Forefather Golden Firmament as his escaping techniques were indeed too formidable.
"Forefather Golden Firmament, I am Dong Bo Xue Ying." Xue Ying did not have the transmission imprint of the other party. He had directly used karma to contact him, transmitting a message over.

chapters.title: Chapter 595 - Talisman
chapters.content:
Chapter 595: Talisman
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Dong Bo Xue Ying? Hmph hmph hmph, why are you here seeking me after being placed on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List by Primal Master?" Forefather Golden Firmament directly sneered back in the transmission, "Oh, I almost forgot but you are even ranked above me!"
Xue Ying felt his heart swelling.
The tone of this Forefather Golden Firmament did not seem right.
One of the Deity World's Fierce Five. Why was he called one of the 'Fierce Five'? And not the 'Five Holy' or other names? Precisely because the five of them were well known for their savageness. Even the leader, 'Pang Yi', was well known for his ruthlessness in the early periods. After all, they were born as Deity world lifeforms and were savage by nature. It was only after that did Pang Yi began changing. The biggest turning point for him was when he had been heavily injured by Monarch Green with a single fist.
Ever since then, Pang Yi became easygoing, and never had anyone heard of he becoming a Ruler. Yet Primal Master had ranked him ahead of one of the three Abyss Three Great Rulers, 'Bloody Ruler'!
Even if Pang Yi had become more moderate, the other four remained as savage as ever.
With Pang Yi's current identity, he would naturally not go back to what he was before. So the Deity world only had four of the Fierce Five left behind. These Fierce Four had Forefather Golden Firmament as leader. Forefather Golden Firmament had gone through a lot of hardships for the sake of the absolute art, "Heart Sword Diagram", for a few billion years, attaining four sets of the remnant pieces. The final one had had almost been gotten by him as he brought along his allies, braving through the dangers of the historical remains painstakingly. Yet in the end, it had been taken by Jing Qiu at that time who had not experienced any dangers.
Forefather Golden Firmament had long been angered to his tipping point!
With his technique of escaping, if he was able to obtain this absolute art which was entirely offensive, Forefather Golden Firmament would have hopes of competing against Patrol Devil King and the others. And if he was lucky, he was able to get some enlightenment-opening his own Dao was not something entirely impossible.
But regardless what!
This absolute art was lacking that final bit, yet it fell through.
Forefather Golden Firmament had guessed that Jing Qiu should have failed in her reincarnation and had thrown this behind his mind. But a few years ago, he obtained the information that Xue Ying had disregarded everything to save Monarch Mo Xue by entering Lake Heart Island! Furthermore, Jing Qiu and Monarch Mo Xue had been staying at the Bloodshed God Palace's Crimson Stone Courtyard, and more importantly… Jing Qiu was actually a stage four World Deity!
A 'Jing Qiu' who came from the material realm had actually become a stage four World Deity earlier than Xue Ying? With how fast her speed, she should have long broken through the record of becoming a stage four World Deity in the fastest time.
He had also heard…
That Jing Qiu specialized in sword techniques?
Forefather Golden Firmament was not stupid! He was able to reason and understand that Jing Qiu must have reincarnated, and in addition with her specialization in sword techniques, and the close relationship with Monarch Mo Xue, she must be the eldest daughter of Monarch Mo Xue.
"Forefather Golden Firmament." Xue Ying remained calm. He transmitted via karma, "I do not have other ideas. It's just that my teacher has just given me the position as one of the Monarchs of the Five Places, and in the future, I'll be staying here at Black Fog Sea. Thus, this is also an opening ceremony, so naturally, I'll be hosting a feast, inviting friends from all over the places. The opening feast will be held three months later, and I believe we will be honored by your presence three months later."
"Oh? Alright, this forefather will definitely be there!" Forefather Golden Firmament's voice was kind of sharp. He then immediately cut off the communication channel.
Xue Ying chuckled.
He had wanted to resolve the enmity, though he had his own limits. Whether he would be an enemy or a friend, Xue Ying would let Forefather Golden Firmament decide himself!
…
Of the three ancestors, 'Monarch Destruction' and 'Pang Yi' had been contacted by Xue Ying via the Bloodshed Tavern internal system. Regardless of who they were from the Bloodshed God Palace, he would still invite them! But Xue Ying reckoned… the chances of them coming is low. After all, Paragons rarely deigned themselves on participating in such events.
Xue Ying had even invited his teacher Bloodshed God Emperor.
Bloodshed God Emperor had immediately replied, "By then, I'll let your Fifth Disciple Uncle over. He loves the activity the most."
This kind of occasion was one which the Bloodshed God Emperor would not appear.
"Fifth Disciple Uncle?" Xue Ying was puzzled. Who was he?
"That's your black bird disciple uncle." Bloodshed God Emperor answered, "This willy bird has called himself 'His Highness Fifth'."
"Black Bird Disciple Uncle?" Xue Ying murmured inwardly. This was the first time he heard the God Emperor mentioned the black bird as his disciple uncle! He thought that he was just a more unique pet. But now it seemed, the God Emperor and the black bird had a brother-like relationship.
******
In the following days…
First, it was the personal disciples and Xia Clan Deities who were located at the supervisor envoy official residence who came moving over. The God Palace had also sent several people over to construct the teleportation arrays!
The huge palace chain had also turned into a luxurious-looking mansion house. At the front door of the residence, there was naturally the two words 'Dong Bo'. From now on, this would be the Dong Bo Mansion.
"I'm here."
A white-robed Dong Bo Yu came walking out from the teleportation array. By his side, there was the green-haired woman, 'Xi Wei'.
Xi Wei said, "Your Highness Yu, your father, and mother has been waiting for you anxiously. You said you will come in half a month, yet you have not That is why they ordered for me to bring you back."
"Mn." Dong Bo YU lightly nodded.
"Why, aren't you a little happier after coming to the Black Fog Sea and seeing the Monarch Dong Bo's mansion?"
Dong Bo Yu and Xia Wei were both flying along. At the same time, they were looking at that enormous residence from afar. Monarch Dong Bo's residence was indeed very big. After all, reaching the level of Xue Ying and Jing Qiu, just attempting to try out their techniques or to research in arrays, they would need a huge space. The mansion was naturally even bigger and had practically covered 10% of the entire land.
The front door courtyard wall of the residence was similarly huge and towering with many of the substance arrays fortifying it.
The front door was lavish and enormous. Those two words, 'Dong Bo', had been written by Xue Ying personally. The two words had vaguely caused the entire Monarch Dong Bo's residence to become mysterious and unmeasurable as if it was an enormous world.
This feeling wasn't wrong. Those two words had been the core of an ultra huge array! It took Xue Ying a month to weave before finishing it. It was a 'World Array', and Monarch Dong Bo Mansion just like a vast world in itself.
"Father personally wrote it?" Dong Bo Yu looked up.
"Naturally. Monarch is very formidable right?" Xi Wei praised him. She was respectfully calling Xue Ying as a monarch because she had personally seen the rise of Xue Ying, and now, he was standing at a position even higher than Sacred Master Crimson Dust of that year.
"Mn, formidable." A smile appeared on Dong Bo Yu's face.
Xi Wei was murmuring inwardly.
He finally smiled!
When she went to find Dong Bo YU, Dong Bo Yu had been intoxicated alone. He could obviously use the Deity energy to remove it, yet he continued drinking.
'I'll have to inform monarch and his wife.' Xi Wei thought, 'His Highness Yu seems to have encountered a huge setback. Unless it's because of relationship issues? or is it other matters?'
"Greetings Your Highness."
"Greetings Your Highness."
The guards by the entrance respectfully greeted him.
They were all old personal guards and had recognized Dong Bo Yu and Xi Wei. They were feeling especially delighted at this moment for Xue Ying's status had become even higher, and naturally, the influential power of they, the personal guards, had changed too.
…
In the underground palace.
Xue Ying was seated cross-legged on an icy-blue blanket. The blanket was softly emitting a cool energy that slowly caressed his entire body. At this moment, the surrounding space was entirely isolated from all sorts of scouting methods.
'Mn?' Xue Ying held onto a crimson talisman. That had been the fusion of the crimson sharp remnant edge he found on the corpse of the ice-sealed Paragon as well as another remnant piece within the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain. Xue Ying lowered his head, thoroughly looking at the markings on it, 'Just the simple markings seem ordinary, yet in reality, they are so profound.'
He could see nothing from the previous remnant piece.
And now, he was able to see a set of complete simple markings. The more he inspected it, the more mystical he found it was. It had reached such profoundness that it exceeded his current realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 596 - The Starting Point
chapters.content:
Chapter 596: The Starting Point
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying flipped the talisman and inspected it. The profundity behind the simple markings was beyond his current realm, and he had no ways of comprehending it.
'Talisman. Are you a blessing or a disaster?' Xue Ying frowned.
That time at the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, he had obtained another remnant piece. After fusing the two as one, the talisman had transmitted information to him.
The information was concise, yet it was enough to make Xue Ying feel an unseen pressure.
That information was a section of words-a parting message left behind by an ancient cultivator.
"This cosmos is fascinating. The grass, the trees, the sun and the dews have made me infatuated. However, I'll have to leave this cosmos eventually."
"Before leaving, I'll leave behind three talismans."
"After each piece of talisman recognize an owner, as long as he activates it, no matter which cosmos you are at, no matter if you are being imprisoned or sealed, or if you are trapped in an ancient historical remain! As long as you activate the talisman, you'll be teleported to where I had lived for a long period. That place has been called the 'Starting Ground' by me."
"There is the gift which I have left behind before leaving this cosmos, though it is accompanied with danger."
"Every time you enter, only one out of ten will live. The moment you die, the talisman will once again be scattered across the vast cosmos, waiting for the next cultivator to get it. If you succeed, you will obtain my gift. Furthermore, you can teleport to any single location in this cosmos from the starting point."
"There is a limit in the number of times you can enter too."
"At the World Deity realm, you can enter once. You can enter once at the World realm too, once at the realm of opening your Dao, and once at the Ruler realm."
Xue Ying was pondering.
This section of information was short, yet within it, he could somewhat discover many more secrets. Firstly, there were three similar talismans! Naturally, the other two could have an owner, or be ownerless; they might even be scattered across the cosmos still.
Secondly, the talisman would lead him directly to the 'Starting Ground'. It had been left behind by an ancient cultivator, and he had long left this cosmos.
'Leaving this cosmos?' Xue Ying was muttering inwardly, 'And even Rulers can enter them, with a death rate of nine out of ten? This senior who left behind the Starting Point should have a combat power beyond the Ruler.'
'Furthermore, any one of those who activated the talisman could teleport to the Starting Ground, and teleport to any place within the cosmos?' Xue Ying was slightly astonished. Just this talisman teleportation move had surpassed the techniques of the Temporal Island Lord. Like Lake Heart Island and other ancient historical remains, they were under suppression by arrays, and one had to fly slowly within and could not tear through space.
But with the talisman, one could directly teleport to the Starting Point, rendering all array suppressions of the historical remain useless!
It was too heaven-shattering!
'Unless he is stronger than the Lake Heart Island master?'
'No, Lake Heart Island Master was known to be the strongest expert across many cosmos epochs! Teacher's judgment is higher than mine. With how he admired Lake Heart Island Master, Lake Heart Island Master must be extremely formidable. This 'master' of the Starting Point might be very proficient regarding spatial teleportation?' Xue Ying thought. Just like the Cosmos Deity-Demon List…
Bloodshed God Emperor was ranked first.
But comparing time-space teleportation? Temporal Island Lord was the most formidable one!
Everyone had their specialties.
'Starting Ground' master might be an existence on the same level as the Lake Heart Island master and was also a terrifying existence ranked in the forefront across many cosmos epochs, just that he was proficient in spatial teleportation?
'Whatever, I don't want to think of this anymore.'
Xue Ying soon threw this question to the back of his mind. There was no need to care about who the master of the Starting Ground was! For him to allow anyone to teleport out from any ancient historical remains, he could not be any weaker than the Lake Heart Island master.
Even though the danger was huge, Xue Ying understood this was his opportunity too! If he could use this talisman well enough, he could escape with his life at a crucial moment! But at the World Deity realm, he could only use it once!
World Deity realm was easily understood.
The World realm represented the understanding of the entire law of the world.
The opening of Dao realm was when one opened his Dao path.
The Ruler realm was also the Rulers.
'I only have a chance at the World Deity realm, and there's no need to use it unless it is urgent. Furthermore, only one out of ten would live according to the senior. He must have left this as a trial for the descendants, and the stronger the person, the greater the chances of living.' Xue Ying thought, 'I must allow my strength to grow and reach grand perfection before entering.'
'I hope I'll not die the first time I visit that place.' Xue Ying continued thinking.
Suddenly-
"Monarch, His Highness Yu has been brought back." Xi Wei transmitted over.
"Yu'er is back?" Xue Ying revealed a look of joy. He immediately kept the talisman before rushing out of his underground palace.
******
The branch swayed down with the wind.
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu both saw a white-robed and handsome Dong Bo Yu currently walking on the stone path with the green-haired woman Xi Wei with a single glance from their high vantage point.
"Sou sou."
The two rushed down and descended on the stone path.
"This child greets father and mother." Dong Bo Yu saw his parents and could not help but reveal a strand of joy. He immediately greeted them.
"Hahaha, Yu'er, I've asked you back for this huge matter about building the residence, yet you did not come so. In the end, it has been Xi Wei who went to bring you over." Xue Ying laughed at his son. Previously, he had been in closed-door cultivation for far too long. Even the true body in the Crimson Rock Mountain World of Xia Clan world had similarly entered closed-door cultivation so that he could get out of it as soon as possible. Thus, he had not seen his children for a very long time. He could even feel Dong Bo Yu becoming more served as he saw himself.
Dong Bo Yu added, "It's this child's wrong."
Jing Qiu immediately pulled his son's hand, "What wrong are you talking! Come, let's go. Our entire family should have a good chat. Your sister will also arrive soon."
"Mn." Dong Bo Yu's eyes were slightly red.
Family. That was the most important people in his life.
Xue Ying slightly frowned.
Jing Qiu similarly discovered that something was amiss. Xue Ying because he had entered closed-door cultivation for too long, had thought that because he was away for too long until his son's eyes turned red. Would peak Deities reveal their feelings so easily? Only then did Xue Ying feel that something was wrong. And Jing Qiu had frequently been seeing her son, so she could determine the first moment she saw him. Only then did she take the initiative to pull his hands.
"Xue Ying, Yu'er seems to have experienced something outside." Jing Qiu transmitted a message.
"Mn, let me ask Xi Wei." Xue Ying immediately asked, "Xi Wei, what happened with Yu'er?"
"Reporting to monarch and madam." Following closely, Xi Wei said, "I am unsure of the details, but during the moment when I went to bring His Highness Yu back according to orders by Monarch, just as I found His Highness Yu, His Highness Yu has been intoxicated. That time, I asked him and tried looking around, discovering that His Highness Yu has been buying wine and getting himself drunk for 30 years long, and seemed rather depressed."
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu both exchanged glances.
"Jing Qiu, let me check it out." Xue Ying transmitted over. He immediately used the Bloodshed Tavern system to begin an investigation into the details of where his son had been.
The Temporal Palace sold intelligence reports. The Bloodshed Tavern was responsible for accepting assassination missions and had similarly emphasized greatly on intelligence reports, just that it was weaker on this aspect. But with Xue Ying's identity, the Bloodshed Tavern would naturally put in the utmost effort to investigate it.
Investigating took some time too.
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu accompanied their children for a long time. Dong Bo Yu was still relatively happy in the beginning, but he eventually became depressed and had mentioned, "Father, mother, I do not know where I am staying now. How about letting an attendant bring me over?"
"There's no need. Qing Yao, you go bring your little brother." Xue Ying ordered.
"There's no need to trouble sister." Dong Bo YU added.
"What trouble is it? Go!" Qing Yao grabbed hold of him. Being a World Deity, it was akin to an eagle catching a chick. Dong Bo Yu could not resist at all. But with how wanton his sister was with him, it was able to make Dong Bo Yu feel happier in his heart.
Very soon, the sister-brother pair left.
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu were both walking casually within the residence.
"It's here." Xue Ying said.
"You've Investigated it already?" Jing Qiu added. How would parents not be concerned with their children?
"Indeed as we expected." Xue Ying laughed, "It is truly a relationship issue."
Don't say Deities; relationship issues could even change the temperament of Rulers.
"Quickly say it!" Jing Qiu hurried.
"It should be about 10,000 years ago." Xue Ying started, "Yu'er has been adventuring outside, reaching a place called 'White Blossom Planet'! The master of White Blossom Planet was someone called 'White Blossom World Deity', a stage two World Deity. She is the absolute overlord of that starfield. Yu'er had befriended a girl when he was on the White Blossom Planet. That girl is from the clan of White Blossom World Deity and is only an ordinary Deity. As their relationship became deeper, at about 30 years ago, that girl had parted with Yu'er. Actually, it isn't something big with the separation, just that this was the first time Yu'er has been moved regarding relationship ever since he cultivated, and could not hold on to it. He has deliberately made himself drunk for the 30 years."
Jing Qiu giggled.
Xue Ying's expression was filled with laughter too.
The two husband and wife were not worried. Instead, they were quite happy since entangling with emotion was not a huge matter in the long road of cultivation! What made them happy was… their son who had cultivated for a few hundred thousand years without speaking about love had finally liked a girl.

chapters.title: Chapter 597 - Opening Feast
chapters.content:
Chapter 597: Opening Feast
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Cultivators would either meet true love early on in their lives and become husband and wife, fall in love very late in their lives, or even remain alone forever.
After all, once someone genuinely started walking down their path of cultivation, immersing themselves in the laws of the world, they might enter closed-door cultivations for very long periods of time, which meant very few would ever even talk about love. The stronger the expert, the calmer their inner heart was. Some were willing to get entangled in relationships for fear that it would distract them. In any case, they could get as many temporary partners as they wished. As for falling in love? It was rare. Certain situations, however, could cause even cultivators to fall in love—experts who experienced long-term bottlenecks without breaking through would often do so. In such a situation, one's inner heart would be affected and they might choose to roam the world in search of opportunities…
When faced with issues in their relationships, cultivators might even take the initiative to cut them off. Was it perhaps the case that experiencing relationship issues might lead to an opportunity of breaking through?
In any case, once they immersed themselves in a relationship, it might even transcend life.
"Why did that girl split ways with Yu'er?" Jing Qiu asked.
"It's because she looked down on him. She felt that Yu'er was not diligent in his cultivation, or that he neglected it. That is why they parted." Xue Ying laughed.
"It seems this girl had not truly immersed herself in the relationship," Jing Qiu commented.
"Indeed." Xue Ying agreed. "But this can also be a good thing for Yu'er. It might help him refine himself."
This was but a simple set-back in a relationship, much unlike a much heavier obstruction such as a life-and-death parting. Neither Xue Ying nor his wife was too worried about this since their son had already cultivated for so many years and experienced many things. There was no way he would be this weak. They estimated that their son had long since seen beyond the facade, and his getting drunk was just a means of venting the frustration in his heart.
…
In what felt like the blink of an eye, it was already time for the opening feast.
Many powerful existences had come from all over the place to congratulate Xue Ying. After all, his combat power was already very strong—very close to a Paragon's, in fact. The world of cultivators was very realistic, so the stronger a person was, the more they would be respected.
"Hua."
A Starfield Flying Ship came flying out of a tunnel in spacetime created in the starry sky. On the deck, this ship stood three figures. The leader was an old man with a roman nose, and to his side were two younger World Deities. These two were none other than Drunk Guest and Jiu She, both of whom had participated in the Myriad Flower Feast alongside Xue Ying. They were now disciples under Yu Gong, a powerful existence.
Yu Gong was the one who brought the two along on his visit.
Drunk Guest had already become a stage two World Deity, while Jiu She was stuck at stage one.
"Monarch Dong Bo has participated in the Myriad Flower Feast together with the two of you," the roman-nosed old man, Yu Gong, began, "yet he was likely already a grade one True Meaning Transcendent at the time, and he was deliberately hiding his strength. His combat power surpassed mine in what feels like the blink of an eye!"
Jiu She and Drunk Guest were obediently listening to the man as he quipped on and on.
Yu Gong had brought these two disciples along precisely for the sake of getting closer to Xue Ying! After all, it was certain that a large number of powerful existences would be coming out, and without bringing these two disciples over, Yu Gong would only be one of many; Xue Ying would likely not pay any attention to him.
"Alright, let's go down," Yu Gong said. A complex sensation washed over Jiu She and Drunk Guest. Jiu She had always been petty-minded, which meant he was now feeling all the more grieved and indignant. He did not receive much attention in Yu Gong's sect either, and he wasn't even a personal disciple. If not for him participating in the Myriad Flower Feast alongside Xue Ying, Yu Gong would likely have not brought him over on this occasion. As for Drunk Guest, he only his fighting spirit rise as he realized the gap between him and Xue Ying.
Very soon, they descended all the way to the front entrance of the Monarch Dong Bo Residence. The arrays lining this grand mansion sent out an invisible pressure that was strong enough to leave Jiu She and Drunk Guest short of breath.
The front door opened, and a couple, both with extraordinary auras, walked out alongside a weaker man and woman pair. They were coming out to welcome the guests.
"Hahaha, I've long since heard of Monarch Dong Bo's name, yet the battle over in the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain of the Dark Abyss truly left me stupefied." Yu Gong brought his two disciples along with a laugh.
Xue Ying recognized both Drunk Guest and Jiu She with a glance.
"Back then, brothers Drunk Guest and Jiu She has both participated in the Myriad Flower Feast alongside me, and you were both ranked in the top three of the Calm Sea Prefecture as well. For you two to be in Yu Gong's sect right now is no ordinary coincidence," Xue Ying said. Jing Qiu, Qing Yao, and Dong Bo Yu were slightly bowing to his sides.
"Such is destiny. Hahaha…" Yu Gong said. He felt that an aura surge behind him, and his heart could not help but jolt ever so slightly. He immediately said, "I'll be going inside first, then. Monarch must be very busy today."
"Please." Xue Ying sent Yu Gong and the rest off with his eyes.
He then immediately took the initiative, moving over to welcome his next guest: "Big Brother Huo Cheng."
"Brother Dong Bo." The next person in line was none other than Paragon Huo Cheng. Most other powerful existences would bring along two or three of their subordinates, but Paragon Huo Cheng arrived alone. However, his unseen aura had long since left the other powerful existences holding their breaths. He was, after all, an existence ranked in the top twenty across the entire cosmos, Rulers included.
…
Many powerful existences had come, and Xue Ying was accompanied by his wife and children as he went over to welcome them.
He would speak at least one or two sentences to each of them, and it was not too rare for him to stop for about the time it took to brew a cup of tea in some cases. However, as soon as a new guest arrived, he would naturally end the chat and move over to welcome them.
At this moment—
A plump man accompanied by two female World Deities came walking over. The man's eyes were deep and unfathomable, his aura extraordinary. This was a powerful existence from the Bloodshed God Palace. In fact, most of the powerful existences who stopped were not dependent on any of the superpowers. There were, after all, no more than twenty powerful existences who belonged to the Bloodshed God Palace.
"Monarch Dong Bo." The plump man walked over.
"God-Monarch Hunting Wind." Xue Ying laughed. God-Monarch Hunting Wind was a beast turned powerful existence.
"A huge group of sovereigns from the Dark Abyss attacked you, monarch, while you were by yourself, yet they were still helpless to defeat you. In the end, you were able to fight three of them off by yourself, and even killed one of the powerful existences from the Dark Abyss. Even just thinking of it is making my blood boil." The plump man praised Xue Ying in a few sentences, followed by some additional words of praise for his wife and children.
Behind this man were the two female World Deities accompanying him, and one of these two was actually the White Blossom World Deity.
The White Blossom World Deity noticed Dong Bo Yu, and Dong Bo Yu naturally noticed her back! He had gained intelligence on many World Deities, so he was able to recognize her from a glance.
'The White Blossom World Deity? Unless I'm mistaken, Feng Yu is a member of her clan,' Dong Bo Yu thought.
The White Blossom World Deity was acting relatively reserved.
After all, the current setting was rather extraordinary—even her teacher, God Monarch Hunting Wind, was nothing more than ordinary here. Suddenly, the White Blossom World Deity's vision focused on Dong Bo Yu.
'Monarch Dong Bo's son?' She was momentarily startled. She lived for a long time over in the White Blossom Planet and had once noticed Dong Bo Yu with a girl from her clan. Even though she had merely swept her gaze once from afar, the memory of any World Deity was simply that powerful! Naturally, she recalled everything. 'The person courting that Feng Yu lass back then was actually Monarch Dong Bo's son?'
'Hahaha, the heavens are looking out for me.'
'This Feng Yu girl's fortune must be splendid to have attracted the attention of Monarch Dong Bo's son.' The White Blossom World Deity was filled with delight. With how high her status was, she was not aware that Feng Yu had long since broken up with Dong Bo Yu.
In fact, she even sent a smile towards Dong Bo Yu, who couldn't help but feel somewhat awkward.
All of a sudden—
A savage aura entered through the front door.
The plump man first looked behind him, and then immediately said, "In that case, I'll be entering now. I wouldn't wish to disturb Monarch for too long." He then brought his two female disciples inside.
Xue Ying had already noticed a solitary figure walking in through the front door. This person was wearing golden garb from tip to toe, and even his sharp, savage eyes were the same golden color. He was none other than one of the Fierce Five of the Deity World, Forefather Golden Firmament.
He swept his gaze across until his vision landed on Xue Ying, as well as Jing Qiu who was standing behind him.
"Forefather Golden Firmament." Xue Ying welcomed him with a smile.
"Monarch Dong Bo. And is this your wife?" Forefather Golden Firmament walked inside, while the corners of his lips morphed his expression into a cold sneer.

chapters.title: Chapter 598 - Arrangements
chapters.content:
Chapter 598: Arrangements
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Right, this is my wife, Jing Qiu." Xue Ying passionately went to welcome him.
"Jing Qiu? She changed even her name after reincarnating." Forefather Golden Firmament looked at Jing Qiu, but he knew that it was different from the past. The current Jing Qiu had her husband, 'Xue Ying', backing her up. And Xue Ying was someone with a combat power not any weaker than his. After all, many experts had attended today's opening feast notably that life and death brother of his, Paragon Huo Cheng. Even if he wanted to vent his anger, it was not appropriate to do so today!
"Haha." Xue Ying laughed before changing the topic, "Forefather has given I, Dong Bo Xue Ying, respect for being here today. A little gratitude and grudge in the past showed that we are fated to meet. How about we continue chatting in private after the feast?"
"Alright." Forefather Golden Firmament nonchalantly acknowledged. He glanced at Jing Qiu, "Star Sword Mysterious Girl, your luck is not bad. In the past, you have your father protecting you, and now, you have your husband protecting you."
Jing Qiu stood by the side of Xue Ying, giggling, "Thank you, Forefather, for your praise. My luck has always been good."
Forefather Golden Firmament snorted before leaving.
He was already controlling himself not to act when facing Jing Qiu.
Sending Forefather Golden Firmament off, Jing Qiu let out a sigh of relief somewhat before transmitting a message over with a giggle, "Xue Ying, I still thought that Forefather Golden Firmament would come with hostile intention given the violent temper of his."
"He might be violent but not a fool." Xue Ying transmitted back, "If he dares to act, Big Brother Huo Cheng can defeat him with a single palm."
…
Guests were coming in succession.
There were quite a few Stage Four World Deities that attended, such as Calm Sea Prefecture Master whom he was friendly with, and Monarch Armadillo Jade and King Fu Qiong who he adventured with at the Lake Heart Island. Many stage four World Deities came, with the majority being those he had once befriended. Xue Ying was passionately welcoming them.
"Big Sister!"
A white-robed girl, 'Seventh Mei Yu', came with Monarch Mother Whirlpool.
Xue Ying and his wife brought along their children and welcomed them with greater enthusiasm. Even the smile on Jing Qiu became much brighter.
"Little sister." Jing Qiu was delighted. When they were at the Myriad Flower Feast, she had recognized her little sister, yet she did not dare reveal her identity.
"Little sister greets Big Sister and Uncle." Seventh Mei Yu was full of joy as well.
Xue Ying who was conversing with Monarch Mother Whirlpool began smiling even more brightly.
Monarch Mother Whirlpool laughed, "Haha, that time, this disciple of mine has participated in the Myriad Flower Feast together with Monarch. Who would have thought that she would end up being your wife's little sister? This is fate indeed."
"That time, this wife of mine has even hidden it from me. I didn't even know that Seventh Mei Yu was a girl." Xue Ying sighed and shook his head. Now that he thought back, it was fascinating.
"Yu'er, Qing Yao, why aren't you greeting your aunt?" Jing Qiu and her little sister were very close.
"Aunt."
Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao both obediently greeted.
"The two of you, bring your aunt together to find grandpa." Jing Qiu ordered.
"Yes."
"Aunt, follow us." Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao were quite enthusiastic when meeting their aunt. Seventh Mei Yu had immediately spoken a few words with her teacher, Monarch Mother Whirlpool. Monarch Mother Whirlpool naturally replied, "Go, go." She had many disciples, yet she only brought Seventh Mei Yu this time. It was, of course, to close up the gap between them. After all, Xue Ying's combat power was extraordinary, and he was one of the Monarchs of the Five Places. If she met with danger, she could always come seeking Xue Ying for help.
…
The guests, other than Forefather Golden Firmament who had some disagreement with him, were relatively friendly. Some even had an extraordinary relationship with him.
Just then, two figures were walking in-one was a bald white-robed teenager, and the other was a white-haired child-looking old man.
Xue Ying took the initiative to welcome them, "Elder Disciple Brother, Forefather."
These two were none other than Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming and Forefather Scarlet Flame.
"I've long known that Junior Disciple Brother has a boundless future, yet I would never have thought that you could grow so fast." Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming's laughter was genuine, "Senior Disciple Brother has to say this to you-admirable."
"Senior Disciple Brother has overpraised me. It isn't a hard task for a grade one True Meaning Transcendent to become a stage four World Deity. I am merely fortunate that I could learn an absolute art." Xue Ying humbly replied.
"Lucky? There is no luck in combat power. Junior Disciple Brother, don't be too humble." Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming laughed giddily. He was apparently in a good mood.
"Oh right, Senior Disciple Brother." Xue Ying transmitted a message, "Let us have a good chat in private after the feast ends."
"Oh?" Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming was startled.
"It's regarding the enmity of Teacher." Xue Ying transmitted over.
Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming lightly nodded.
The death of Sacred Master Crimson Dust might not be related to him as he had never met him, yet there was gratitude which he had to repay the sacred master. Furthermore, the character of Sacred Master Crimson Dust was something Xue Ying admired. Besides, Forefather Black Devil was a crafty and sinister person. Thus, he had to avenge Crimson Dust for justice. If Sacred Master Crimson Dust was a devil, and Forefather Black Devil had done things in an honest and upright manner, Xue Ying might not be so urgent to resolve this feud. Secondly, there was ultimately some karma compelling him to act on it. Thirdly, this was training for himself. How could he possibly bury himself in cultivation forever?
"Alright." Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming nodded.
Xue Ying could see many thoughts flickering across the mind of Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming.
He had obtained the original book of the first half of "Blood Demon Scripture" and had decided to impart it onto others. But those who were qualified weren't many. He was still thinking to whom he should bestow the absolute art to!
"Xue Ying." Forefather Scarlet Flame had spoken two sentences before transmitting a message over, "Xue Ying ah, there's a matter that I'll have to trouble you on."
"What trouble? If you have anything, just tell me. Even if I have to risk my life, I'll not think twice about doing it." Xue Ying immediately answered. He could not forget the enormous kindness Forefather Scarlet Flame had presented to him! If Forefather Scarlet Flame had not acted that time, Xue Ying did not dare imagine how he would be like today.
Forefather Scarlet Flame felt warmth in his heart at that moment.
That time, he had helped Xue Ying solely because his heart was stirred, yet the gratitude made Xue Ying willing to risk his life to repay this favor.
"You don't necessarily have to risk your life, just that this matter is quite complex. Since there are too many guests present, let us have a chat after the feast." Forefather Scarlet Flame said.
"Alright, we'll talk in detail after the feast then." Xue Ying nodded.
…
Guests continued streaming in. Most of them were stage four World Deities and powerful existences. There were even the stronger ones amongst the powerful existences like 'North Hu Palace Head' and senior disciple brother 'Monarch Gu Zang'.
Monarch Gu Zang was frequently in closed-door cultivation, and rarely would he leave.
But he had to participate in Xue Ying's opening feast! It puzzled many of the powerful existences present, but there was another matter that shocked them-
"Dong Bo Xue Ying." A figure came walking from the front door. It was a violet-gowned male. His eyes were long and narrow, and he was emitting an invisible aura that made even the hearts of powerful existences tremble.
"Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master!"
"It is Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master." The other guests present were feeling astonished. Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master was one of the three ancestors. His combat power was deep and unfathomable. Whenever he acted, it would shock the world.
Xue Ying naturally took the initiative in welcoming him. He understood a lot of things now. He knew that the Dao Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master opened was the 'Dao of Destruction Lightning'. This Dao was extraordinarily tyrannical and powerful, and its speed was transcendental. Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master had opened this Dao when he was a stage four World Deity. He was currently ranked 18th on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List and was comparable with the ancient Paragon Huo Cheng.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master chuckled, "Congratulations."
"I have never expected for Prefecture Master to come today. It is truly making thrilled." Xue Ying added.
"You are feeling thrilled because I came?" Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master had a smile, "Then what if your Eldest Disciple Brother came?"
"Eldest Disciple Brother?" Xue Ying was stunned.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master then turned around.
Xue Ying looked over.
A figure came walking over. His hair was messy and scattered. He was wearing a simple gray robe, and his eyes seemed warm and amiable. He was walking barefooted, and his legs were massive. As he stepped on the ground, it felt like he was a ruler of the surrounding world. His aura might not be domineering, but it still caused other cultivators present to feel an urge of declaring allegiance.
Xue Ying immediately understood who came-it was a legendary existence in both the Deity world and the Abyss-Monarch Green!

chapters.title: Chapter 599 - The Gift of the Fifth Uncle Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 599: The Gift of the Fifth Uncle Master
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Monarch Green was the most outstanding disciple of the Bloodshed God Emperor. However, he had long left the Bloodshed God Palace, becoming a superpower himself! He even had many powerful existences subordinates.
Xue Ying had received the relevant information from his teacher, Bloodshed God Emperor, and Paragon Huo Cheng; he was clear that this eldest disciple brother-in-name, 'Monarch Green', was outstanding! He was an influential person standing at the peak of the Deity world and Abyss, and was no weaker than a Ruler-instead, his influence might even be greater than a few of them!
Why was this?
That's because Monarch Green and the Bloodshed God Emperor were the same-they had both opened three Daos and cultivated all to the limits! He was currently only lacking the last step to break through and become a Ruler.
With the three Daos employed together, Monarch Green had no flaws.
He was the most terrifying Paragon realm existence that was close to 'perfection'. Rulers like Bloody Ruler, Temporal Island Master, Myriad God Palace Head, and Empress Qian He had only opened a single Dao! Of course, they had still reached the realm of Ruler. Although each of Monarch Green's Dao's was slightly lacking, using them together made Monarch Green's extremely strong.
Some Paragons could flee in front of a Ruler, yet Monarch Green could still restrain them! And after that, he could even kill them directly!
In the face of a Ruler, Monarch Green could similarly fight against them.
He was too well-rounded with each aspect being perfect. This combination of his Daos was much more congenial than the three the Bloodshed God Emperor had opened.
At the same time, in the Deity World and Abyss, aside from the Bloodshed God Emperor, Monarch Green was the only one with three bodies. The battle prowess of any of his avatars was exceedingly strong individually, yet he had three of them? Although Monarch Green did not have a territory, he had at least 15 powerful existences under him! It was much more than what Empress Qian He and Primal Master had. This number even approached that which Temporal Island Master, Myriad God Palace Head, and Bloodshed God Emperor had.
Empress Qian He's level of deterrence towards Paragons, was less than Monarch Green's!
And Primal Master someone disconnected from the world. He did not care to take in disciples. Before meeting Paragon Huo Cheng, Xue Ying had never even heard of his name. One could see how low-key he was.
Therefore in the Deity world, Monarch Green was fourth most considerable influential power!
"Senior Disciple Monarch Green." Xue Ying stepped forward politely and humbly. He did not dare to be sloppy. The arrival of Monarch Green was equivalent to the appearance of a Ruler. That was tremendous respect for him, and thus, he had to reciprocate.
"Junior Disciple Dong Bo." Monarch Green walked towards him bare-footed, "I've long since heard of junior disciple's name. Meeting for the first time, I could see how extraordinary you are."
Monarch Green had come to observe this junior disciple of his. One had to know that the Bloodshed God Emperor took in quite a few personal disciples, yet many did not get to meet Monarch Green at all! Monarch Green also did not bother to see them either since it was sure they would not be able to transcend. Even if they did, their future was ordinary. Monarch Green had disregarded them, yet in the eyes of Monarch Green, Xue Ying was different.
Firstly, Xue Ying had been the fastest in history to become a stage three World Deity! To break a record in cultivation speed across the entire history of the Deity World, as long as he lived, he would never remain as someone ordinary.
Secondly, aside from Pang Yi, Xue Ying was the only other person who became a member of the Destruction Legion. This point was something Monarch Green minded even more.
'Pang Yi…' Monarch Green silently spoke in his heart.
Pang Yi was a colossal provocation to him.
One had to know that during the rise of Monarch Green, he scorned all other Paragons! He had even given the strongest Paragon Pang Yi a grievous injury! Monarch Green had the qualifications to be arrogant, yet it was during this period that Pang Yi silently transformed. During the next battle which Pang Yi had with Bloody Ruler, he directly suppressed him and injured Bloody Ruler!
Monarch Green did not dare believe it and went to Pang Yi for a fight. The two of them fought without any spectators. During this battle, Monarch Green exposed a heaven-shattering strength, yet Pang Yi was not disadvantaged in the least. In the end, the two could not distinguish between victory and defeat.
"I cannot defeat Bloody Ruler, yet he could. However, he shouldn't have become a ruler yet.'
'Teacher had also said before-Pang Yi's self-created cultivation technique is on the verge of success. Once he succeeds, he will become a ruler and someone more outstanding. Teacher has great respect towards him.'
'I could feel myself reaching the limit in all aspects, yet I cannot win against a Paragon still.'
'Being a Paragon, I've gone to the Destruction Legion, yet I could not even pass the trials to become a soldier… But Pang Yi has become a captain?' Monarch Green was very arrogant, yet Pang Yi had brutally shattered his pride. 'Even that stage four World Deity commander of the Destruction Legion admired Pang Yi immensely.'
…
Monarch Green was very friendly, and there wasn't even a single strand of oppression in the aura he emitted. Disregarding the powerful existences present, even an ordinary mortal would not suffer a shock in his presence. However, whoever it was-whether it was a small and weak creature or a mighty True God, they all felt allegiance towards him.
"Teacher had told me he had received a disciple which pleased him a lot, asking me to have a look when I had the time." Monarch Green smiled.
"I am merely a stage four World Deity and have yet to transcend. There's no need for senior disciple brother to praise me so much." Xue Ying let out a breath of relief. Monarch Green was treating him quite well; he was not that unapproachable either.
Monarch Green's gaze landed on the nearby Jing Qiu: "Junior Disciple Brother Dong Bo, this should be your wife, right? Your wife is a stage four World Deity too. Not bad, not bad. If she could transcend, then the two of you would be able to live eternally in the future. By then, the two of you will become the admiration of many cultivators in the Deity World and Abyss."
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu looked at each other and smiled.
However, Xue Ying was clear from the information he got-during the life of Monarch Green, he never had a wife; this was someone wholly devoted to cultivation.
"Alright, your Fifth Uncle Master has arrived. I shan't speak more." Monarch Green said before walking to one side.
Xue Ying also immediately looked towards the door.
"Hu~~~"
A shadow had simply ignored the sealing array constructed by Xue Ying around his residence. It then directly appeared right in front of Xue Ying's front door before flying in. When that shadow stopped, and it had the shape of an ordinary black bird, albeit this black bird cawed and smiled at him, "Little brat Xue Ying, you're not bad to become an expert ranking in the forefront amongst your teacher's subordinates. Cultivate faster! You have to reach the Paragon realm as soon as possible to catch up with your senior disciple brother, Monarch Green."
"Please come in, Uncle Master Fifth. I'll naturally try my best when cultivating." Xue Ying said.
The black bird went grabbing his own body with a smile. He directly pulled out a black feather: "For this opening feast of yours, I have no other gifts. Instead, I'll give you a feather. You better prepare some delicious food for me to eat. I don't care about what others eat, but I must eat the best. If there's anything nice, feel free to give them to me. I am here today to eat, so if there's nothing good, then I'll have suffered from a huge loss by giving away such an important gift."
Xue Ying received it: "Fifth Uncle Master, do not worry. I'll definitely prepare the best delicacies."
Saying so, Xue Ying tried receiving the black feather, only for the black feather to pass through his hand.
"Don't use your real hand to take it. Use energy instead." The black bird said.
Xue Ying seemed to have some realization. The luminous sun force within him rushed forth, causing a layer of power to cover his palm. He then reached out and grabbed the black feather.
The black bird cawed joyously. He flapped his wings and flew towards the depths of the residence.
"Have all the guests arrived?" The nearby Jing Qiu transmitted.
"The World Deities have all arrived, whereas most of the powerful existences should be here." Xue Ying said while carefully looking at the black feather in his hand. Most of the guests had come personally to with some gifts, yet there were others who sent someone in their stead instead! Only this black bird uncle master of his had given him his gift directly.
'What kind of feather is this?' Xue Ying felt that it was extraordinary.

chapters.title: Chapter 600 - The Black Feather
chapters.content:
Chapter 600: The Black Feather
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying attempted sensing that Black Feather, yet it was a piece of fuzziness when his senses permeated through it. Eventually, he still had to depend on his naked eyes to look at it. With the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body", Xue Ying was able to cultivate his body to an extreme stage, allowing his eyes to become even more unfathomable. Even a grit was akin to a massive planet to him. And now, his body that was stronger than ordinary True Gods had improved his vision to such extent that he could see through the surface of the particle when he concentrated on it.
Under the inspection of his eyes, the boundary of the Black Feather was rapidly growing big, turning into a vast Black Feather land.
On this piece of vast land, there were countless black shaped things and many thin pipes. Xue Ying's eyes continued permeating through it, penetrating through the thin pipes…
"Hu hu…" Within the thin pipes, there was a piece of void passage tunneling to other regions. This void passage had an imprint revolving on it. This imprint was much similar to the markings on the 'talisman' that would bring him to the Starting Ground. Because his eyes had permeated into the Black Feather, seeing into the millions and millions of little thin pipes, even Xue Ying's eyes had starting to turn blurry with the imprints becoming indistinct.
Xue Ying was slightly startled. He continued investigating other thin pipes. Every single thin pipe had a void passage within.
'This feather is akin to a vast world. There are millions and millions of void thin pipe passage, and every single passage is unique in its way.' Xue Ying began receiving back his gaze. He then looked at the entire land of the Black Feather from a broader angle. The whole Black Feather land was formed from a dense number of thin pipes. This land was remarkably stable.
Countless black thin pipes formed the entire land. This structure was also stunning! It had already surpassed the category of being just arrays and was more of natural beauty.
'Unfathomable.'
'Mythical.' The soul in Xue Ying's heart emerged. That void passage within the tunnel was indeed too fuzzy, and he could hardly comprehend anything. But the entire Black Feather internal structure was much more perfect than the particles of his own Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body, allowing Xue Ying to gain some inspiration.
"Xue Ying, Xue Ying." Jing Qiu shouted from the side.
Only then did Xue Ying regained his consciousness. He then kept this Black Feather and said, "Fifth Uncle Master's gift is unique."
"How unique could a feather be?" Jing Qiu was puzzled.
"I'll let you have a thorough inspection after the feast." Xue Ying laughed. He felt that if given enough time, he would be able to comprehend some techniques from the Black Feather.
…
After Black Bird Uncle Master came, there were no more other powerful existences coming.
Xue Ying walked all around, chatting with the many powerful existences. Once the preparations were done, he would begin the feast officially.
The 'Opening Feast' was not all about eating. Most powerful existences would instead take this opportunity to network with others. Those whom they were not familiar with in the past were able to become more familiar with each other after exchanging some cups of wine and idle chatter.
68 powerful existences in total participated the feast.
The seating arrangement was also casually scattered within the garden in threes and twos. Statuses did not separate them. But regardless, cliques would still be formed. Black Bird Fifth Uncle Master, Monarch Green, Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, Paragon Huo Cheng, Monarch Gu Zang, Xue Ying, North Hu Palace Head and several others were situated closer to one another. Xue Ying was clamped in between the two groups of cultivators. The other side had Forefather Scarlet Flame, Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming, Jing Qiu, Monarch Mo Xue, Calm Sea Prefecture Master and several others whom he was closer.
Naturally, the weaker World Deities had to be situated further, like Seventh Mei Yu, Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao and White Sand City Lord. Letting them stay next to powerful existences would cause them to feel too uncomfortable even to eat.
At the same time, right at the center of the feast at the garden, there were some dances and songs to bring up the atmosphere.
"Brother Gu Zang, I've heard that you have been in closed-door cultivation for a long time. It is so rare for you to come out. Today is the opening feast of your junior disciple brother, and for senior disciple brother to attend it makes this junior disciple brother feel delighted. Let us have a toast." Xue Ying said.
Monarch Gu Zang was a handsome teenager with a delicate white face. His body though was emitting a heavy death aura. Monarch Gu Zang chuckled and raised his cup, "Junior Disciple Brother has granted me such a huge favor, how would I not attend?"
Paragon Huo Cheng was observing from the side, feeling startled inwardly at the same time, 'Gu Zang and Monarch Green don't seem too close! But they are ultimately quite close to Brother Dong Bo. Truly weird."'
Indeed, that's weird.
Monarch Gu Zang and Monarch Green were not seated too far away. But other than some simple two to three sentences of words, they did not continue chatting and were apparently unfamiliar with one another.
'I've not heard that these two disciple brothers have any conflict.' Xue Ying felt even more serious. The unfamiliarity between these two Senior Disciple Brothers was too blatant, and it was not right for him to say anything either. He continued accompanying his two senior disciple brothers and other friends.
…
'Mn?' Seated on the other side, Forefather golden Firmament frowned and glanced at the distant Monarch Green, Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, and Paragon Huo Cheng chatting happily with Xue Ying, 'This Dong Bo Xue Ying is friendly with Monarch Green and the other three! They are all currently ranked in the top 20 of the Cosmos Deity-Demon List. Monarch Green's power is even more boundless, and he could kill me with a single flip of his hands.'
'But my big brother should be stronger than Monarch Green still. Big brother has always been pondering over his cultivation technique, and the moment he succeeds, hmph hmph hmph'" Forefather Golden Firmament and Pang Yi were both one of the earliest lifeforms from the Deity world. The two had emerged from the Deity world, and were like brothers, 'It's just that I find big brother weird-his tamper has somehow become much better.'
…
A feast would usually continue for about three days.
To powerful existences, three days were short. They would casually chat with each other. For instance, they would talk about some historical remains for several hours. If the time was short, they could continue chatting endlessly. Once they conversed for some time, they would then become familiar with one another.
After the feast ended, people like Black Bird Uncle Master who had stayed until the end, left immediately. Monarch Green, Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, and the other powerful existences also began departing. Xue Ying sent them off personally. Soon, more than half of the crowd had left.
"DIsciple Brother Hui Ming, Forefather Scarlet Flame, let us have a chat after a while. I'll first meet Forefather Golden Firmament." Xue Ying said.
"Alright." Eldest disciple Brother Hui Ming nodded.
"You should go deal with that Forefather Golden Firmament first. He isn't someone you should offend." Forefather Scarlet Flame said too. They knew of Jing Qiu's identity at the current moment and naturally, the conflict between Xue Ying and Forefather Golden Firmament as well.
******
In a peaceful area at the back of the garden.
There were only two people there-Xue Ying and Forefather golden Firmament. There were also wine flasks being warmed. Xue Ying personally poured wine for Forefather golden Firmament and said at the same time, "Forefather Golden Firmament, you have spent billions of years collecting the "Heart Sword Diagram". The other four remnant pieces have been collected, leaving only the last piece uncollected. You have even spent plenty of effort and blood in trying to break through the seal of that historical remain, yet it ended up in the hands of my wife. That frustration you have is something I can understand! But forefather, you should understand that my wife is also being treated unjustly, did she do anything wrong? No! She has only entered some common dangerous area to have a look, and unknowingly, obtained the remnant piece of the Heart Sword Diagram. It can be said that it was luck that gave her this opportunity. Thus, that time when you wantonly pursued after her, wanting to collect her soul and had even forced my wife to reincarnate in the end, Forefather Golden Firmament, isn't this riding on the weak?"
"Why, are you thinking of seeking revenge for your wife?" Forefather Golden Firmament snorted.

chapters.title: Chapter 601 - The Decision of Forefather Golden Firmament
chapters.content:
Chapter 601: The Decision of Forefather Golden Firmament
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Xue Ying poured some wine then brought it in front of Forefather Golden Firmament. "How about we grab a drink first. This wine is one of the specialties from my hometown, the Xia Clan world, and its name is Hundred Fruit Wine. It is brewed with utmost care, and has an unique flavour."
Forefather Golden Firmament eventually took up cup of wine and drank a mouthful. "It's rather ordinary, but it indeed has a taste unique to the material realm."
Xue Ying continued with a laugh, "Forefather, did you not ask whether I would wish to avenge my wife? Haha, if I, Dong Bo Xue Ying, had my teacher's combat power, I really might have just exterminated you in a fit of anger!"
"Oh?" Forefather Golden Firmament noticed his expression visibly sink.
"However, I unfortunately do not possess such combat power." Xue Ying chuckled. "Forefather, your being in a bad mood is very understandable, but if you were to think this matter through, I'm sure you would become aware that my wife is purely innocent. She had no intention to go against forefather back then, and did not dare fight you. It's a pity that we can't go back in time to save her from being forced to reincarnate…"
Forefather Golden Firmament listened on with a sunken expression.
He had to acknowledge that, from Jing Qiu's perspective, she was indeed wronged. She had essentially been forced onto a path of no return, and eventually had to choose a path equivalent to death—reincarnation!
"Do you think that I, Dong Bo Xue Ying, am not angry? That I would have forgotten this enmity? Forefather, would you believe that to be true?" Xue Ying looked at Forefather Golden Firmament.
"Go ahead and act out your vengeance, then." Forefather Golden Firmament sneered. "Though I'm afraid you don't have the necessary combat power."
"My wife has reincarnated successfully, and it was that which brought her close to me. From a different perspective, this could be my fate with her, and karma with you." Xue Ying chuckled. "Neither of us has the means to deal with the other, so why not just take a step back? This enmity can be resolved now. Forefather, in the future, you are not to deal with any of the people from my Monarch Residence. Of course, fro the same reason, I will also take a step back and forego any attempts to deal with you."
Forefather Golden Firmament frowned. "Oh? And what if I don't want to take a step back?"
Xue Ying continued pouring wine into the cups as he indifferently replied, "The only outcome would be the two of us becoming enemies!"
While he seemed indifferent on the surface, his tone also had a cold sharpness.
Xue Ying would not be afraid of handling matters!
In terms of combat power, he was slightly above Forefather Golden Firmament.
In terms of background, his teacher, the Bloodshed God Emperor, was ranked first on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List, which meant he was much stronger than Pang Yi. Furthermore, the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master owed him a huge favor, while Paragon Huo Cheng was his life-and-death brother. Even if the forefather wished for them to become enemies, Xue Ying had no reason to fear him.
"Come." Xue Ying finished pouring the wine and pushed another cup towards Forefather Golden Firmament. "As we drink this wine, let us resolve our enmity and stop tangling in each other's business."
Forefather Golden Firmament looked at Xue Ying, who stared straight back.
"Hahaha…" Forefather Golden Firmament finally let out a laugh. "Alright! The only thing I can say now is that the Mysterious Star Sword Lady has indeed found a good husband after reincarnating!" Having said these words, he raised his cup of wine.
Xue Ying also revealed a grin and picked up his own cup.
The two then drank at the same time.
"Since this matter is concluded, I'll be taking my leave first." Forefather Golden Firmament stood up.
"My wife has already gained some understanding towards the Heart Sword Diagram relic. Once her comprehension reaches a sufficiently high level, she will naturally pass the part she understood over to you, forefather," Xue Ying said, then stood up.
Hearing these words, Forefather Golden Firmament looked towards Xue Ying then nodded. "Alright. At that point, I'll also be sending back some of the parts I've comprehended related to the Heart Sword Diagram."
And with these final words, Forefather Golden Firmament turned around and left.
Xue Ying looked on in silence, revealing a slight smile.
He was clear that both parties had their own reservations.
The other party feared Xue Ying's combat power.
