If they truly were to have an acrimonious falling out, they would have to consider that, with Xue Ying's rate of improvement, he would eventually become a paragon. On top of that, he was a member of the Destruction Legion. By then, Forefather Golden Firmament's days would certainly not be good. After all, Xue Ying was already comparable to him, yet how long had he even cultivated? Such characters were not to be made enemies with.
But Xue Ying also felt some fear.
He was afraid that a calamity might fall upon Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao. He was unable to kill Forefather Golden Firmament, and had no methods of dealing with him either. After all, not even paragons would necessarily be able to kill Forefather Golden Firmament. His fleeing techniques were too formidable!
Both parties had their reservations, and this was the main reason why they decided to resolve the matter peacefully.
In any case, Forefather Golden Firmament was a lifeform originating in the Deity world, and a savage by nature. By not giving him space to step down, his temper would naturally lead to them falling out entirely. As such, Xue Ying kept mentioning how Jing Qiu was the most wronged person in the matter, and that he himself had already taken a huge step back. As a result, the forefather was able to somehow accept this resolution.
'His fleeing techniques are very formidable, and his background is also solid. There was no reason for us to continue this enmity anyway. After all, if he were to ever become truly mad, it would have been a true headache.' Xue Ying slightly nodded. They had not signed any oaths. At their level, oaths are heavily emphasized, and the two sides were not too willing to become enemies with each other regardless. Naturally, if some absolutely outstanding treasure were to appear, they would simply fall out in spite of previous arrangements.
There existed treasures which could cause even the Temporal Island Lord, Empress Qian He and the Myriad God Palace Head to fall out with and scheme against Ruler Ni Luo and the Bloodshed God Emperor.
…
Xue Ying went over to the courtyard where his Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming and Forefather Scarlet Flame were.
On his way there…
"Master." A male and female pair of cultivators rushed over respectfully. The man was tall and thin, and his face was pale white, while the woman had an enchanting aura and red hair.
"White Bone, Xue Man, what's the matter?" Xue Ying looked at the two. The man was the treasure spirit of the Cultivation Eden he obtained from the Howling Devil Cult Leader after he killed him. Xue Ying gave him the name 'White Bone'. The enchanting red-haired girl was the transformed appearance of the Blood-Creeping Flower. Since Xue Ying's combat power had greatly increased, he also gained access to a larger number of treasures. As a result, he was able to spend a larger amount of resources on his loyal Blood-Creeping Flower. Considering how many treasures Xue Ying had, he was easily able to give the Blood-Creeping Flower a chance to transform once again and reach the World Deity stage. The current Blood-Creeping Flower would likely reach the level of the Sky-Reaching Vine before long. Wanting to become even stronger than that? That would be too difficult.
Xue Man obediently brought out a scroll using both her hands. "Master, this is the list of gifts provided by your guests."
"Oh?" Xue Ying extended his hand to receive it.
The ones in charge of accepting gifts were primary White Bone and Xue Man who would place them directly within the Cultivation Eden as soon as they received them. This was the same Cultivation Eden which Xue Ying carried on his person at all times. Only its treasure spirit, White Bone, could move treasures inside.
Even though he had received many gifts, he had yet to check through them, so Xue Ying had asked White Bone and Xue Man to list down who gave which gifts.
After all, the value of any gift he received would be the main factor for determining how much he would have to give back if a sender ever invited him over.
"Hua." He opened the scroll.
This scroll contained detailed records including the names of Monarch Green, Paragon Huo Cheng, the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master and everyone else, as well as their gifts. Naturally, the gift received from the Black Bird Uncle Master, the Black Feather, was on Xue Ying's person and was therefore not recorded.
Upon seeing everything recorded on the scroll, Xue Ying let out a laugh.
It was quite interesting.
For instance, Monarch Green's gift was written down as a palm-sized sculpture invisible to the naked eye, while the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master's gift which was a round plate adorned with a certain pattern. As for how they should be used or the types of treasures they were? Such things were not recorded. After all, the realm of either the treasure spirit, or the Blood-Creeping Flower was limited. It was sufficient for them to let Xue Ying know of each gift's sender!
"Eldest Disciple Brother is truly kind." Xue Ying had yet to properly investigate each gift, but he could easily tell that Monarch Green's gift was very mystical. It was an item that could not be seen with the naked eye, but could be observed using World Energy or one's consciousness. It took the shape of a palm-sized humanoid sculpture sitting cross-legged. As soon as he began pondering over its secrets, Xue Ying understood what kind of treasure it was. Naturally, he also began to realize just how conscientious Monarch Green was.

chapters.title: Chapter 602 - Forefather Black Devil
chapters.content:
Chapter 602: Forefather Black Devil
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
There was no hurry to check the gifts. After Xue Ying received the scroll of items, he immediately went to meet Eldest Disciple Hui Ming and Forefather Scarlet Flame.
Once he entered the courtyard, he saw that Eldest Disciple Hui Ming and Forefather Scarlet Flame were sitting there chatting.
"Senior Disciple Hui Ming, Forefather." Xue Ying smiled and walked towards them.
"Dong Bo, sit." Forefather Scarlet Flame said.
Xue Ying also sat and looked towards Eldest Disciple Hui Ming: "That's right, Senior Disciple, I do not have much understanding towards Forefather Black Devil, but if there is an opportunity, we must think of a way to right the wrong, and exterminate his true body and avatars in one fell swoop. If we are to act, it must be done neatly.
Hui Ming shook his head and said: "Master was like my father, so how could I dare to forget the enemy of my father. However, that Forefather Black Devil is too cautious and cunning, and since you've become the personal disciple of his majesty, the Bloodshed God Emperor, Forefather Black Devil has always had one of his avatars permanently reside at the Temporal Island. You say, what can we do?"
"Permanently at the Temporal Island?" Xue Ying was stunned.
The Temporal Island was the place that the Temporal Island Master lived.
It was the lair that the Temporal Island Master had run for endless years, and the danger there was severe. The Temporal Island Master could display an even more terrifying power there. Also if he were as strong as the Bloodshed God Emperor, and dared to kill his way in, he might have to be prepared to lose some avatars.
"Then is there a way to draw out his original body?" Xue Ying said, Forefather Black Devil was not invincible, and if his true body fought, Xue Ying had the certainty to kill him.
"We cannot draw him out." Hui Ming shook his head.
"Haha, it's impossible to draw him out?" The nearby Forefather Scarlet Flame said, "Xue Ying, you have not fought against Forefather Black Devil. That Forefather Black Devil is cunning and treacherous, and exceptionally afraid of death! When you had just become the God Emperor's personal disciple, you were only a stage two World Deity, yet he had made an avatar stay permanently at the Temporal Temple. It is reasonable to say that his cultivation ground is also within the range of the Temporal Temple's control, and with the Temporal Island Master's strength, he could totally shuttle through space-time and arrive at his cultivation ground in a blink. Regardless, he still moved over to the Temporal Island to live.
Xue Ying frowned.
"Furthermore, have you discovered that ever since you have become the personal disciple of the God Emperor, he has never acted against you? Even your wife and children have not been harmed." Forefather Scarlet Flame said.
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
"He doesn't respect me; he doesn't respect Hui Ming. But he fears you!" Forefather Scarlet Flame shook his head, "When you became the Bloodshed God Emperor's disciple and revealed your strength you were only a stage two World Deity. Furthermore, you were a material realm lord, and he did not have a way to eliminate you, and could only stare helplessly as you become stronger and stronger… therefore he directly did not provoke you and didn't dare to use any moves.
"He feared enraging you, feared making your killing intent even stronger." Forefather Scarlet Flame smiled, "To tell you the truth, there is no affection between you and Crimson Dust at all, and that your killing intent towards Forefather Black Devil is not that strong. Am I right?"
Xue Ying was stunned. He immediately nodded and admitted it.
Indeed.
After all, he had never seen Sacred Master Sacred Dust, and furthermore, if Sacred Master Crimson Dust had not thrown the 'Crimson Rock Mountain' into the Xia Clan World, the Sorcerer God and Great Demonic God would not plot against the Xia Clan World. The Xia Clan World would also not suffer these calamities. He, Xue Ying, would also not have suffered the Six Ghost Resentment Poison, and his wife would not have nearly died… therefore, Xue Ying was also somewhat awkward towards Sacred Master Crimson Dust.
One could only say that Xue Ying recognized this bit of kindness!
As for killing Forefather Black Devil…
Aside from Karma, the most important thing was that Forefather Black Devil was a kind of person who didn't shrink away from crime, and Xue Ying's killing intent on Forefather Black Devil was perhaps more because he was evil. If Crimson Dust had been sinister, and Forefather Black Devil kind and humane, Xue Ying might not even make a move. That little bit of karma did not have too big of an effect.
"Your Killing intent is not heavy, and he is unwilling to infuriate you in the slightest, so the probability of you making a move is even lower." Forefather Scarlet Flame said, "Even so, one of his avatars is still hiding inside the Temporal Island."
"He truly is crafty and cautious." Xue Ying nodded.
If he isn't, how would he scheme against Crimson Dust, exterminating Crimson Dust's original body?" Forefather Scarlet Flame shook his head, "Ai, Crimson Dust was too arrogant and was unwilling to look for a Ruler for help. If he had relied on the Bloodshed God Emperor, letting an avatar live within the Bloodshed God Emperor's territory… Bloodshed God Emperor would be able to appear and protect him in an instant. That way, how would Forefather Black Devil be able to kill him?"
Xue Ying nodded.
Relying on a Ruler had this benefit. Rulers could not protect one at all times, but as long as one was located within a certain range! The Ruler would be able to appear in an instant.
"But to rely on a Ruler and enjoy the benefits, one must pay too." Forefather Scarlet Flame said, "You are his disciple, so he has no requirements for you. But for an ordinary powerful existence, he has to take on the role of a Bloodshed Tavern Master, or to help the Bloodshed God Emperor gather materials, … In short, in the long run, they have to complete certain tasks."
"Everyone has their own choices." Hui Ming said, "Master chose this path, so he naturally must be willing to bear it. Forefather Black Devil is cunning, and killing him will be extremely difficult. Furthermore, junior disciple, you have many worries of your own. Failing to kill Forefather Black Devil might instead create more trouble."
Xue Ying nodded, his wife and his children were genuinely his concerns.
Furthermore, the vast majority of powerful existences that lived for a long time was carefree.
'I can only temporarily put it aside.' Xue Ying thought. Confronting such a cunning person, even a Paragon would have no chance of killing him.
In that split second, Xue Ying decided to give up temporarily. He then suddenly realized something.
What a good Black Devil!
By not infuriating him in the least, his killing intent towards him wasn't strong!
If the Forefather Black Devil had always schemed against him, for example dealing with his relatives, it would enrage him! Perhaps, Xue Ying would not be like this, and even if he was at the Temporal Island, the Bloodshed God Emperor was the number one killer in the Deity World and Dark Abyss! If he wanted to assassinate him, fighting and losing an avatar, he would undoubtedly still have hopes of accomplishing it.
But the price was huge, and Xue Ying was a Bloodshed Tavern Master, and was very clear what kind of price it would take for the God Emperor to act and kill a powerful existence! Perhaps it would require all the treasures of a Paragon.
However-
The price for other people would be huge, but Xue Ying was his personal disciple, and if he was truly angry, the God Emperor might sympathize and reduce the demand, helping to act once! That was why Black Devil did not dare enrage Xue Ying the slightest from start to end.
Although he understood his killing intent with Xue Ying was still not heavy, as an enemy that knew when to come and leave, he did not anger him at all.
…
Black Devil was cautious and cunning, not leaving behind the slightest amount of opportunity, and even put aside Eldest Disciple Hui Ming, who had intense sentiment towards Crimson Dust.
"That's right, Forefather." Xue Ying looked towards Forefather Scarlet Flame, "You said earlier that there was a problem?"
Hui Ming also looked towards Forefather Crimson Flame.
"I also hesitated three times, and originally didn't want to speak of it." There was some slight blush on Forefather Scarlet Flame's face, "But this is truly very important to me, and Xue Ying, you are strong enough. Thus, I would have to hicken my skin and ask you for help! Of course, Xue Ying, if you help me, then that will be counted as resolving the karma from that day when I helped you."
"What karma are you speaking of, Forefather? Back then, if you had not acted, then my entire life would have been practically destroyed." Xue Ying said, "Forefather, your matters are also my matters. Furthermore, don't think that it's bothersome, as a material realm lord, there is no true danger of dying, so why would I fear some inconveniences?"
Forefather Scarlet Flame was greatly moved.
Like Xue Ying, like Forefather Scarlet Flame, they were those who, after receiving great kindness, would never forget it. They would not end their relationship after the karma was resolved. Instead, they would still feel for the other party.
Back then Xue Ying had truly given up all hope, and Forefather Scarlet Flame Acting was no different from once more giving his life color.
"Things are like this." Forefather Scarlet Flame didn't hesitate and directly said, "All of you know that I often go to the Sun Star to cultivate.
Xue Ying and Eldest Disciple Hui Ming were listening.
"The Sun Star is an existence equal to the Dark Abyss and material world. The deeper one enters, the hotter it gets. Even if the Rulers reach the core of the Sun Star, they would be burned to death." Forefather Scarlet Flame began explaining right from the start.

chapters.title: Chapter 603 - Sun Star
chapters.content:
Chapter 603: Sun Star
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
As Xue Ying's combat power increased, Paragon Huo Cheng and the Bloodshed God Emperor were transmitting him greater amounts of information, and this naturally also meant an increase in his understanding of the Sun Star!
The Sun Star and the Moon Star both had their own natural slaw of operation, and they were no less powerful than those on the material realm or the Dark Abyss. Furthermore, it was hugely different when compared to the material realm and the Dark Abyss precisely because the latter intrinsically acted like cradles, giving birth to countless forms of life. The material realm was even protective of its weaker lifeforms. Even the Dark Abyss, while more sinister and savage, had countless demons emerging out of it, and it even rejected outsiders by motivating the native lives to kill any trespassers.
The Moon Star was vastly different from the Sun Star.
Neither of the two were appropriate for lifeforms to survive in, since they acted like complete extremes with ultra-powerful offensive natures. Forget getting anywhere deep, touching the surface alone was enough to freeze or burn stage four World Deities to the death! The deeper one went, the more dangerous it would become. Even Rulers might die, just like that, if they ventured too deep. It could be said that the danger here was higher than that of any ancient ruins!
Naturally, these two stars were created by the cosmos itself.
They were two celestial bodies juxtaposed with the material realm and the Dark Abyss, and their offensive nature transcended the imagination. This also served to attract many of the more powerful true gods.
"The Sun Star represents extreme warmth. The law inherent to it is even stronger than those of Rulers," Forefather Scarlet Flame explained. "However, if one were to merely touch upon the surface of the Sun Star, they will get no more than a fuzzy sensation of this law. But the deeper one goes, the stronger this feeling becomes in turn."
"The way I understand it…"
"The outermost layer of the Sun Star takes the form of burning surface flames. However, while this layer has the appearance of fire, it is, in actual fact, liquid. It is the first layer of the Sun Star, and we cultivators refer to it as the Sun Sea. It is extremely hot, and only powerful existences have any certainty of surviving in it.
"Going deeper through the Sun Sea, one would eventually reach a thick, substantial physical layer. The unique material forming this physical layer is known as Sun Stone. This is the second layer of the Sun Star—the Sun Stone Layer. It is much more dangerous, and even the occasional strand of flame would find powerful existences with a hard time surviving, much less other dangers.
"Legends speak of a third layer beyond the Sun Stone Layer, known as the Sun Ripple Layer.
"And even deeper is a fourth layer, the Void Black Soil Layer.
"Below it is the fifth layer—the Sun Abyss.
"And beneath the Sun Abyss is the final, most legendary sixth layer—Sun Star Nucleus," Forefather Scarlet Flame slowly said in a voice that clearly tinted with expectation. Over the long periods of time he had cultivated on the Sun Star, it essentially became his home.
Xue Ying and his Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming were listening closely, despite already being aware of this information.
"I used to own a Sun Star Nucleus Stone." Forefather Scarlet Flame lowered his voice. "Through its power, my body was protected, and the damage I took greatly reduced. I might not have dared enter the Sun Stone Layer, but I could at least use the Sun Star Nucleus Stone to sit cross-legged on its surface. By coming into contact with the Sun Stone Layer… my ability to sense the profound mysteries of the law on the Sun Star became clearer by a few dozen times, which, in turn, increased my cultivation speed.
"Any Sun Star Nucleus Stone is extremely precious, and not one has shown up in more than a hundred billion years," Forefather Scarlet Flame said. "From the emergence of the cosmos, and up until now, very few Sun Star Nucleus Stone have appeared, and every expert who got their hands on one treats it as a treasure. Even paragons or rulers would rarely ever trade their Sun Star Nucleus Stones."
Xue Ying and Hui Ming both nodded.
"However, about thirty million years ago, the second saint of the Two Saints Ink Clan, a person known as Bamboo Saint, somehow managed to find out that I own a Sun Star Nucleus Stone, and suddenly assassinated me, killing the body I had cultivating on the Sun Star. He then took away my Sun Star Nucleus Stone," Forefather Scarlet Flame lowered his voice and spoke calmly. He seemed calm on the surface, but he was essentially just trying to calm his boundless fury.
During cultivation, people mainly fought for opportunities. Forefather Scarlet Flame's most precious treasure had been snatched away, which created an enmity so huge that the two parties could not exist under the same sky.
"Bamboo Saint?" Xue Ying frowned.
The two saints of the Two Saints Ink Clan were powerful existences who did not belong to any of the superpower factions.
Of the two, Bamboo Saint was not too dangerous. Holding the 53rd rank on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List, he was a single spot lower than Xue Ying. Their power in combat was roughly on the same level.
However, the one truly establishing the status of the Two Saints Ink Clan was the elder brother, Leaf Saint—a paragon! He was just an ordinary paragon, and could not hope to fight against the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master or the Mysterious North Imperial Empress, yet the Dao he opened rather strange and unique, and it allowed him to roam freely without any need to depend on superpowers.
The two of them had once formed a clan, and their relationship was close.
"Forefather, what is it you request of me?" Xue Ying asked. If it was to deal with Bamboo Saint, the truth was he could hardly fight him! Even if they were to truly fight, the other party was backed by a powerful paragon.
"I would not think of taking revenge," Forefather Scarlet Flame said. "The gap between our combat power is too huge, and the person backing him is even more formidable! What I wish for is simply to acquire another Sun Star Nucleus Stone. The flame has been my aim for a very long time, and if I am ever to open up my own path, it would be on the flame Dao. Without a Sun Star Nucleus Stone, I would never dare to touch the Sun Stone Layer. I could only ever cultivate in the Sun Sea, and my senses there are too fuzzy; the efficiency of cultivation would not be even a thousandth of my previous speed. Such a rate of progress would lead nowhere. I would have no chance of breaking through. Of those I know and who I am close to, only you, Dong Bo, have any hope of getting me another Sun Star Nucleus Stone."
The way Forefather Scarlet Flame looked at it, Xue Ying's combat power, as well as his network, were stronger than his by many times! He had the Bloodshed God Emperor behind his back, as well as Monarch Green, the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, Paragon Huo Cheng and many others. Such connections were stronger than his by tens or even hundreds of times.
"You want me to make a Sun Star Nucleus Stone?" Xue Ying frowned. This would be a huge ordeal even for someone like him.
"There are two known origins for Sun Star Nucleus Stones," Xue Ying said. "The first origin refers to the stones which originate from the deepest layer of the Sun Star, the Sun Star Nucleus. The Sun Star Nucleus would occasionally form a speck of dust or two over a long period of time which would cross through the Sun Abyss and the Void Black Soil Layer… before finally being discovered."
Forefather Scarlet Flame nodded rapidly. "Back then, it was by luck that I discovered a unique source of light on the surface of the Sun Stone Layer. Using my weapon, I dug that part out and discovered a Sun Star Nucleus Stone. It was roughly the size of a fingernail, and it weighed about half a kilogram."
"Then it was your luck, forefather. It was likely a granule that moved all the way to the surface after a very long time," Xue Ying said. "However, getting another piece in this same manner is almost impossible. After all, no Sun Star Nucleus Stone has formed in the past hundred billion years! Or perhaps there has been one which was acquired by a powerful existence but not publicized.
"In any case, nobody would be willing to trade it even if they got one," Xue Ying said. "In that case, we must defer to the other method."
"We'd have to purify a large amount of Void Black Soil until a Sun Star Nucleus Stone forms out of it," Xue Ying said. This was a method discovered by the cultivators of Deity world and the Dark Abyss. The Void Black Soil layer was the fourth layer of Sun Star, and the Void Black Soil formed there was, by nature, very offensive. The temperature of its flames was such that only Rulers could barely resist it. However, if it was purified down to its very essence, it would eventually form an identical Sun Star Nucleus Stone.
Forefather Scarlet Flame felt slightly guilty. "I know how difficult this would be. I have hesitated a number of times before telling you. However, as time passed, I began to realize that I have no other hope to further my cultivation, and thus decided to thicken my skin…"
"Forefather, there's no need to keep speaking of it! Just leave it to me," Xue Ying said. Although it was troublesome, this was the first time Forefather Scarlet Flame ever asked for help. This was a matter related to his benefactor's cultivation path, so he had to help him!
******

chapters.title: Chapter 604 - Receiving a Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 604: Receiving a Disciple
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Hearing Xue Ying promised him without hesitation, Forefather Scarlet Flame felt his heart relaxing. At the same time, he said, "To purify a piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone, the price is huge. If you require any treasure, I'll try my best to pay for it! If I can't, then I'll let you, Xue Ying, help me."
"No need." Xue Ying had just started saying…
When Forefather Scarlet Flame's expression turned sullen: "Xue Ying, I am sure how much favor you will have to owe for this endeavor. There might even be several expenses far beyond what some treasures could be worth! If I can't do anything, I'll rather not have the Sun Star Nucleus Stone!"
Xue Ying was startled after seeing this. He understood that powerful existences had their dignity! Forefather Scarlet Flame had sought for help without caring about his pride because of a colossal matter like cultivation. If all the treasures were paid for by Xue Ying from his pocket… then that would be greatly hurt his dignity.
"Alright alright." Xue Ying laughed and nodded, "Since Forefather has said so, then we'll just listen to you."
Nevertheless, speaking about treasures…
Even though Forefather Scarlet Flame had saved up for an extended period, his foundation wasn't as deep as Xue Ying's. Other than the True God weapon Flying Knife, he even had precious treasures like the original copy of the upper half of "Blood Demon Scripture", the talisman and Fifth Uncle Master's feather. During this Opening Feast, many gave him gifts that were not cheap too. Most stage four World Deities would present him things that were worth several hundred million Deity crystals.
True Gods would naturally present even more. Like Monarch Green, Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master and Paragon Huo Cheng, they were all ranked in the top twenty of the Cosmos Deity-Demon List, so their gifts were all the more extraordinary.
Adding these up would yield a sum that was frightening!
Still, Xue Ying's current combat power was solid-it was close to a Paragon! With how powerful he was, these treasures were merely 'adding flowers to the brocade', and were considered as normal proper behavior based on reciprocity. Like in the past when Xue Ying took up the responsibility as supervisor envoy, he was weaker, yet many stage four World Deities wanted to form a karmic relationship with him, sending substantial gifts to Xue Ying which he did not dare receive.
Specifically, it was because his combat power was too inadequate, receiving those gifts worth several hundred of millions of Deity crystals would be doing a huge favor to him! And now? These gifts that worth several hundred of millions were just pittance to Xue Ying! Xue Ying was willing to receive them and allow the other party to attend his feast. These actions indicated respect for them since many other World Deities did not have the qualifications to participate in this feast.
In any case, this was his Opening Feast where everyone came to congratulate him. If it was an ordinary gathering, then there was no need for others to gift him.
Furthermore, the recipient was Xue Ying. If it was some regular stage four World Deity that had yet to transcend in becoming a powerful existence, the number of powerful existences attending would few, and gifts presented would not be that valuable either.
After all, the value of gifts presented depended on the recipient too.
"Oh right, Senior Disciple Brother Hui Ming and Forefather." Xue Ying said, "Both of you know that I've obtained the original copy of the upper half of "Blood Demon Scripture"."
"Mn." Forefather Scarlet Flame and Eldest Disciple Brother Hui Ming knew what Xue Ying was going to say when they heard this.
"Do you want to learn this "Blood Demon Scripture"?" Xue Ying asked with a chuckle, "To tell you the truth, there are two ways of cultivating this absolute art. One uses countless souls as an aide, and is extremely vicious. Those who are willing to use this method will not have great progress in the future. The second method is based on your capabilities. If you want to learn, I'll only impart the second method to you."
Those who had the qualifications for him to impart the "Blood DEmon Scripture" to were not many. Even if it was imparting down to them, Xue Ying forbade them from using the first method too because he wasn't too willing to generate countless sin from his actions.
"This old man will thicken my face and learn it then." Forefather Scarlet Flame laughed, "I can comprehend it and borrow it to gain some inspirations."
"I'll pass." Senior Disciple Brother Hui Ming chuckled.
Xue Ying and Forefather Scarlet Flame looked at him with astonishment.
Not learning it?
This was an absolute art sent to his doorsteps! And he did not want to learn it?
"Hui Ming, not cultivating it doesn't mean you can't gain some inspirations from it." Forefather Scarlet Flame encouraged him, "It'll be of help for you to transcend in the future."
"No need." Hui Ming shook his head, "The "Blood Demon Scripture" is one of the six grand inheritances of Ancestor Devil, and is extremely savage. It isn't appropriate for me. My current realm is also lacking that is is best if I do not have a look."
"Ancestor Devil's six grand inheritances? Who is Ancestor Devil?" Forefather Scarlet Flame was puzzled.
Xue Ying was startled inwardly though.
This Senior Disciple Brother Hui Ming knew who Ancestor Devil was?
"Forefather should know that this cosmos we are in has several other epochs too." Hui Ming looked towards him.
"I've heard of this before." Forefather Scarlet Flame nodded, "Everything has its beginning and end. The cosmos has its epochs too."
Hui Ming nodded, "Across the many cosmos epochs, there are two astounding individuals. One was the Lake Heart Island master, and the other was Ancestor Devil."
"I've heard of the Lake Heart Island master, but there's another comparable individual called Ancestor Devil?" Forefather Scarlet Flame nodded.
Xue Ying was silently looking at this senior disciple brother of his.
Senior Disciple Brother Hui Ming knew so many secrets, and it seemed he had great fortune too.
…
That day.
Forefather Scarlet Flame had first established an oath before learning the upper half of "Blood Demon Scripture". Hui Ming had also used this chance to bid them farewell.
The number of people who learned the "Blood Demon Scripture" wasn't many. Monarch Mo Xue's true deity heart would be crumbling soon, and he had decided to reincarnate. Jing Qiu had asked Xue Ying to impart the art to her, which Xue Ying did not hesitate. Nevertheless, Xue Ying knew that it was not much of help for him to transcend.
Other than him, Jing Qiu and the White Sand City Lord had both learned it too.
Other than these few, he did not teach the rest including his children because the "Blood Demon Scripture" wasn't an ordinary absolute art, and successfully cultivating it was challenging! Howling Devil Cult Leader's combat power had been obtained by relying on countless souls and a long period of cultivation. One could see how challenging it was! Xue Ying even felt that it wasn't too appropriate to teach his children. As for White Sand City Lord, given how old he was and that he had not become a stage four World Deity yet, he decided to let this brother of his learn it first regardless if it was useful or not.
"Big Brother Huo Cheng." Xue Ying immediately went to meet Paragon Huo Cheng. Paragon Huo Cheng had not left after the feast. He was currently staying within the residence.
Paragon Huo Cheng was currently seated on a chair. His right hand was lightly drumming on the armrest with his eyes closed humming.
The red-haired, red-browed and red-skinned Paragon Huo Cheng seemed to be in a good mood.
He looked up and saw Xue Ying coming. He grinned, "Brother Dong Bo, have you resolved the matter of Golden Firmament? Even if you don't come to find me, I have some matters in need of you too."
"Forefather Golden Firmament's matter has been resolved. Actually, he isn't too willing to become enemies with me." Xue Ying sat by the side, "I wonder why Big Brother Huo Cheng is looking for me?"
"Haha, I was strolling idly in your residence when I met your daughter. I decided to give her some pointers, of which she then asked if I could become her teacher… Honestly speaking, I find this little doll to be quite good, and I wonder if Brother Dong Bo is willing to let this daughter of yours become my disciple." Paragon Huo Cheng laughed.
Xue Ying was in great joy as he hurried, "Certainly, certainly!"
Regarding the matter of his children getting teachers…
Xue Ying had once discussed with his wife. Ordinary powerful existences were not too willing to do so since both husband and wife were not any weaker. Unless some Paragons were prepared to receive them as a personal disciple, but that was too hard.
"I still hope for Big Brother Huo Cheng to teach Qing Yao, and to tolerate with this child. Her personality is a little overbearing." Xue Ying requested for him to do so.
"Haha, why would the father be speaking about his daughter like this! I feel the personality of your daughter is not bad." Paragon Huo Cheng said, "Since you accepted it, then this matter is resolved! I'll definitely teach her conscientiously, but how she ends up, Brother Dong Bo, you better don't blame me."
"You don't have to take me into account with how you teach your disciple." Xue Ying added.
Paragon Huo Cheng nodded, "Oh right, is there a reason why you come looking for me too?"
"There is indeed a matter." Xue Ying said, "And it is related to the Void Black Soil."

chapters.title: Chapter 605 - Publicizing the Gathering of Materials
chapters.content:
Chapter 605: Publicizing the Gathering of Materials
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Void Black Soil?" Paragon Huo Cheng looked at Xue Ying with puzzlement.
"I want to make a Sun Star Nucleus Stone, and I have no other ways than to purify it from Void Black Soil." Xue Ying explained, "This Void Black Soil is something I'm requesting Big Brother Huo Cheng for help."
Paragon Huo Cheng frowned, "The Void Black Soil is a minor matter and not worth a mention! But to eventually purify it, the Void Black Soil is only considered the most fundamental material. There are still 12 other precious materials needed, and also an expert to personally purify it with great efforts…"
"But other than this, what can I do? Unless someone is willing to trade their Sun Star Nucleus Stone?" Xue Ying helplessly said.
"Mn."
Paragon Huo Cheng nodded.
The Sun Star Nucleus Stone, other than purifying it arduously, the other way was to obtain it from the Sun Star Nucleus! That was a perilous place, and even Rulers would turn into ashes if they entered. The 'Sun Star Nucleus Stone' was extremely precious, and the size of a fingernail… was enough to cause many powerful existences to use all their treasures in exchange for it. It was more valuable than the Cultivation Eden. Thus, Forefather Scarlet Flame felt guilty the moment he requested for one. He had no other ways, and only with Xue Ying would he have some hopes.
"I've never heard of anyone willing to exchange for it. I originally have one piece, but it's a pity that my true body died that time and it has long been lost." Paragon Huo Cheng said, "Exchanging is fine, but those who are willing to do so would set such exaggerated prices."
"Right." Xue Ying nodded.
"There are three difficult tasks when purifying it. One, there must be enough Void Black Soil. Second, there must be 12 precious materials. Third, find an expert to purify it." Paragon Huo Cheng said, "Amongst them, finding the Void Black Soil is the easiest. It is slightly harder finding 12 materials, though finding an expert to purify it is the most troublesome matter."
Xue Ying laughed, "I'll solve them one by one."
"You can leave the Void Black Soil to me. How much do you need?" Paragon Huo Cheng asked.
"At least 5 million kilograms of Void Black Soil." Xue Ying said. 5 million kilograms of Void Black Soil was enough to purify 0.5 kilograms of a nail-sized Sun Star Nucleus Stone.
"I'll get a million kilograms for you!" Paragon Huo Cheng forthrightly declared.
"Many thanks." Xue Ying laughed.
"We are brothers, so there's no need to say thanks. This is something elementary for me either way." Paragon Huo Cheng chuckled.
Xue Ying nodded.
To obtain the 'Void Black Soil', the best way was to directly enter the 'Void Black Soil Layer', the fourth layer of the Sun Star. Everywhere was filled with Void Black Soil over there, and however much one wanted could be procured! And according to the degree of danger, the fourth layer of Sun Star was one where most Rulers could safely enter as the flames emerging within the Void Black Soil were insignificant.
However, some apex Paragons could enter as well.
Like Monarch Green, he could do it.
And amongst the apex Paragons, Paragon Huo Cheng who specialized in flame could do so as well! Paragon Huo Cheng entering the Void Black Soil was practically like returning home-something simple. Thus, getting one million kilograms of Void Black Soil was only spending a little more time.
"Getting the 12 precious materials is slightly more troublesome." Paragon Huo Cheng said, "Requesting an expert to purify should be the most troublesome one. Other than Bloodshed God Emperor, Empress Qian He, the next who specialized in refining should be 'Ripple Lady Planet Master' who knew how to purify it. Purifying it was something extremely complicated, and one could not relax during the entire process. The moment one loses concentration, the purification would fail… requesting a Ruler would most likely be very difficult. We could only directly seek for Ripple Lady Planet Master, but he was the only Paragon under Empress Qian He, and Empress Qian He liked her very much. She specialized in refining for long periods of time, and rarely move outside of her places. Even to other cultivators, she was quite cold so requesting for her help is very difficult."
Xue Ying nodded.
This was indeed the most challenging point.
Seeking a Ruler?
Even though his teacher treated him very well, he could not rely on the pampering of his teacher and ask his teacher to do this and that! It would cause his teacher to find it burdensome since giving an inch and asking for a mile was something excessive!
Amongst powerful existences, it was more important to consider a fair trade.
He had to give something to get something!
"I'll just have to visit the Ripple Lady Planet Master." Xue Ying said, "Everything can be discussed further."
"Mn, you should go collect the 12 precious materials first. After collecting them, you could visit the Ripple Lady Planet Master after." Paragon Huo Cheng said, "I'll go to the Sun Star tomorrow."
"I am troubling you then, big brother." Xue Ying thanked him.
…
That night.
Under the witnesses of Xue Ying, Jing Qiu, Monarch Mo Xue, Forefather Scarlet Flame, White Sand City Lord and others, Qing Yao had officially become an apprentice of Paragon Huo Cheng.
"Hahaha, even though I've accepted two disciples before, I did not have any patience to teach them, and they had long died without becoming powerful existences." Paragon Huo Cheng sat there looking as Qing Yao kowtowed him as her teacher, laughing, "I've been locked in the Lake Heart Island for long periods of time, and my patience has somehow been refined. Qing Yao, you are currently the only disciple under me, but you must work hard and become a powerful existence. Only then could I, as your teacher, and your father, have some pride."
"Yes, teacher." Qing Yao immediately acknowledged.
"Mn, as I as your teacher has no other gifts to give you! This is the only treasure I've gotten from the ancient cavern dwelling, and I'll be giving it to you to protect yourself." Paragon Huo Cheng said before throwing a red bead. Qing Yao extended her hand to receive it. She had just tried refining it when the red bead immediately turned into a faint red light which enveloped Qing Yao, turning into a set of red robes.
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu were both relatively happy as they saw this. The path of cultivation was filled with ups and downs, and even though they were strong currently, it was hard to predict what might happen in the future. To see their daughter becoming a disciple under a powerful teacher was something that made them satisfied.
Monarch Mo Xue was even more joyful.
Even Dong Bo Yu who had been sullen recently, had currently revealed a grin.
******
On the second day, Paragon Huo Cheng who had just received a disciple left quietly, heading towards the Sun Star.
And Xue Ying had first used the Bloodshed Tavern to collect all the precious materials. The intelligence network of the Bloodshed Tavern was quite good, and he soon received 7 of the precious materials. The remaining five… he had no other choices then to published a news that stated he was collecting them. As long as powerful existences heard of these five precious materials, they could guess that Xue Ying should be trying to purify a piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone.
But Xue Ying wasn't afraid. At his current power, he was not afraid of who would dare to come snatch for it.
He had even directly publicized-he himself wanted to go to the Sun Star to cultivate and wanted a piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone! Who was willing to exchange for it?
The news had been publicized.
And according to what he expected, nobody was too willing to trade for it.
Instead, the five precious materials had been slowly being collected by him. As powerful existences came, they directly said forthright, "This Five-Colors Phoenix Blood Stone just be given to Monarch. It is a plaything for me anyway."
The price of the precious materials was limited.
Others might not mind, but Xue Ying had still given a gift of equivalent value to exchange for it. Otherwise, his reputation would worsen if he took without giving. In the future, how hard would it be to exchange for other things?
That time, it was very taxing for Xue Ying to even collect enough 'Demon Bone ashes'. And now, it was much faster collecting these rarely seen precious materials. This was the difference! With how much higher his current combat power and status was, powerful existences were willing to come and trade with him without minding those precious materials. They were more mindful of befriending Xue Ying and getting closer with him. As both became closer, it was easier for them to request Xue Ying to do something in the future too.
…
Time passed.
Paragon Huo Cheng had returned after a month of visiting the Sun Star, bringing back a total of one million kilogrammes of Void Black Soil.
And Xue Ying felt his head hurt as he had only collected 10 out of the total 12 precious materials. There were still 2 more which he had no news of.

chapters.title: Chapter 606 - Investigation
chapters.content:
Chapter 606: Investigation
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
Within the underground palace, on the icy-blue mat, Xue Ying was reflecting while seated cross-legged.
There were three big questions he had to solve in order to purify the Sun Star Nucleus Stone. Collecting the '12 precious materials' ranked second, and was a task harder than collecting the Void Black Soil! This was because half of the precious materials were very rare, and even though their use was narrow and the value wasn't high, they were rarely seen! Collecting them was exceptionally difficult, and he still lacked two currently.
'The news has long spread across all powerful existences. Those with the precious materials and are willing to trade have traded. Those who aren't willing, will not be doing so even if I waited for a longer period.' Xue Ying frowned, 'And now, I can only pass on my hope to the countless World Deities, hoping that there would be people with those two precious materials.'
There were many World Deities scattered across the entire Deity world and Abyss.
The probability of them getting the precious materials was much higher than the powerful existences getting them.
Xue Ying currently had already spread out the news that he was collecting those two precious materials.
'The Seven-Leaf Stone Fruit and Jade Heart Grass Root.' Xue Ying might be distressed, but he could only put it aside, 'There's no other ways than to wait.'
If he could not collect within a year, then he would wait ten years, 100 years, or even 10,000 years to a million years!
There would eventually be a day when he finished collecting them.
'I'll begin looking through these treasures.' Xue Ying began looking through what the guests of the opening feast had given him. He looked through those given by World Deities and ordinary True Gods, and even those given by Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, Paragon Huo Cheng and even Monarch Green!
'Those stronger will give more precious gifts.' Xue Ying laughed. The guests knew what they were doing, and were clear about what they should send at what level. In this Deity world and Abyss, it had long become a convention. Naturally, there would be those extraordinary ones like the gifts given by 'Forefather Golden Firmament' was very shameful, yet it was good he had even given something.
'Only the three Paragons and Fifth Uncle Master have given something unique.' Xue Ying thought.
'This is given by Big Brother Huo Cheng.' Xue Ying waved his hand, causing a wine flask to appear. The wine flask was sealed. Opening up the cap, he could smell a fragrance diffusing. The moment it entered his nose…
Hong!
An unseen power shot into his true deity heart, causing Xue Ying to tremble subconsciously.
'Fire Dragon Blood Fruit Wine?' Xue Ying immediately understood what treasure this was. The Fire Dragon Blood Fruit Wine was used to aid in cultivation. Sniffing it could cause the deity heart to tremble. If he drank it in one mouth, his true deity heart would release its potential, allowing him to enter a half-conscious fleeting state, and this sort of state was strangely right when comprehending during cultivation.
A cup of Fire Dragon Blood Fruit Wine was relatively precious, and this flask had an even higher value.
'Big Brother Huo Cheng is truly conscientious.' Xue Ying understood that such gift was a great help for transcending.
Xue Ying kept the flask of Fire Dragon Blood Fruit Wine, taking out a circular plate. This circular plate had an imprint diagram and was intricately beautiful. He had just inspected it when Xue Ying recognized what it was, 'It's an Array Disk!'
'This is the core of a mighty array.' Xue Ying thought, 'Seeing the shape of the array disk, it should be the core of an array left behind in a certain ancient historical remain. It has been taken out by Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master. This residence has just been constructed, and is indeed lacking a formidable array.'
The Monarch Residence was filled with arrays he comprehended and were able to cause Stage Four World Deity to cower slightly. But to those at the same level, it was no threat at all.
'With this array disk as the core, I'll be able to layer some more arrays.' Xue Ying revealed a grin. This gift by Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master was what he wanted.
Finally, Xue Ying flipped his hand, though it was empty on his hand.
In reality, he had a palm-sized sculpture on his palm, just that it could not be seen with the naked eyes.
If he used his consciousness to sense it, he should be able to detect that palm-sized humanoid sculpture. It was a cross-legged humanoid figure.
'Qing Yao has become a disciple under Big Brother Huo Cheng. This treasure can be given to Yu'er then.' Xue Ying lightly nodded. It was a unique treasure which the true deity heart could use. One had to know that a treasure the true deity heart could use was something even Xue Ying and Jing Qiu did not have! But their deity hearts were powerful, and this unique treasure wasn't of much use. The help to those weaker would be much more apparent.
If comparing value…
The sculpture was equivalent to the Fire Dragon Blood Fruit Wine. The array disk was relatively cheaper.
'The most precious should be this.' Xue Ying collected all other materials, taking out that piece of black feather. Black Bird Uncle Master had given him a Black Feather which made Xue Ying startled indeed.
From this feather, he could determine that the body of Black Bird Uncle Master was much stronger than his own Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body! The gap was so vast that it was crazy. Xue Ying estimated that even Rulers had a hard time trying to kill Black Bird Uncle Master.
"Hua."
Xue Ying lowered his head.
Permeating through, the Black Bird became bigger in his boundary, turning into a vast land. The entire land was formed from many thin pipes, intertwining in a truly mystical way! It was because of this twist that made the land more stable-and also the strength of this Black Feather. The degree of strength far surpassed that of the black armor from the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body.
'Every single thin pipe has its own void passage within? Heading to an unknown location?' Xue Ying was pondering. The inner part of the thin pipes had a profoundness that wasn't any less than the structure of the land of the entire Black Feather. It was just that the inner section had been too profound that Xue Ying could not see it. Even the flowing markings were fuzzy to him.
'Somehow, I feel that this void passage could not be resisted.' Xue Ying thought.
It was an instinct.
Just like a rat that would feel fear when meeting a mouse, this was an instinct stemming from life itself.
Xue Ying could feel that no matter what, he would be unable to suppress this void passage after seeing this void passage within the thin pipes! Through the void passage, he could arrive at a specific location! The void passage had a mystery… comparable to that piece of talisman he just got.
'Every single thin pipe has such a terrifying void passage. With millions and millions of thin pipes forming into the entire Black Feather land.' Xue Ying was startled with its structure. When would it be that his own body would have such a profound structure? By then, he should be able to match a Ruler at least.
'I wonder where Black Bird Uncle Master come from? He isn't on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List either.' Xue Ying thought for a moment before throwing it aside. He completely immersed himself in the structure of this Black Feather land.
The void passage was too fuzzy, and he could not comprehend it.
The Black Feather land was much clearer. It was even quite similar to some of the 'World Profound Mysteries' which he comprehended. It was just more complex by an unknown amount. This made Xue Ying vaguely understand that this might be his teacher's purpose! Borrowing this, he was able to increase his comprehension of the world, allowing him to be even more encompassing of all other Deity Hearts and transcend with a single move!
…
As time passed.
Dong Bo Yu had stayed for 300 or so years within the Monarch Residence. Under the help of his parents, and after being given by that sculpture given by Monarch Green, he left eventually. Xue Ying could only rely on the Bloodshed Tavern's intelligence network to understand the movement of his son.
Qing Yao had become even more hardworking in her cultivation after becoming a disciple under Paragon Huo Cheng, allowing Paragon Huo Cheng to frequently praise her whenever he sees Xue Ying.
Within the blink of an eye, it had been 16,000 years after the establishment of Monarch Dong Bo Residence.
"Hu."
By the Black Fog Sea land, the teleportation array had a figure appearing.
It was a green-robed silvery-haired girl.
This green-robed silvery-haired girl looked at the vast and grand Monarch Residence with some desire in her eyes, 'Monarch Dong Bo residence. I am finally here.'
Very soon.
She arrived at the front door of the residence.
The two words 'Dong Bo' inscribed on the front door gave an aura that made her tremble! The aura was so vigorous that it was akin to an ancient giant beast, somehow showing the capability of being able to destroy the world just by activating a strand of its power. Even powerful existences would die in front of it!
'Indeed, the legendary Monarch Dong Bo. For him to visit Dark Abyss by himself, fighting one on three and even killed a powerful existence of the Abyss.' The green-robed silvery-haired girl thought. She did not know that the clan protection array around Monarch Dong Bo residence had transformed. It was now using the array disk provided by Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master as the core, substantially increasing the operating power of the many arrays.
Even those at the level of Xue Ying would not dare to behave atrociously here.
"This is the Monarch Residence, are there any reasons you came here for?" A World Deity guard at the entrance of the residence chided.
"The Monarch is collecting precious materials. I have a precious material with me, and do hope for you to inform the Monarch." The green-robed silvery-haired girl respectfully said.
"Precious material?"
The two World Deity guards at the entrance and other World Deity guards were all startled. They knew that their Monarch had always been collecting precious materials.
"Wait here for me. I'll inform right at this moment." That World Deity guard did not dare to slight as he hurried on to report upwards.

chapters.title: Chapter 607 - Request
chapters.content:
Chapter 607: Request
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
The green-robed silvery-haired girl was waiting outside silently. After a moment, that World Deity guard who went to report came back. He shouted from afar, "Monarch has agreed to see you. Please come with me."
That green-robed silvery-haired girl took a deep breath before entering the residence.
Flying within the monarch residence, they arrived at a courtyard made for welcoming guests.
"Reporting to Monarch, the guest has arrived." The World Deity guard respectfully said.
The green-robed silvery-haired girl could see a black-robed male standing with his back facing them, looking at the beautiful scene of grass and flower. That black-robed male turned around. The shape of his face was bright and forthright, and his eyes were warm. The unseen aura emitted by him made her feel fear right in her inner heart. The aura of Xue Ying was ultimately too strong for her at this moment.
"Junior Chun Yu greets monarch." The green-robed silvery-haired girl respectfully bowed.
Xue Ying first gave the World Deity guard a look, hinting for him to leave. He then dutifully bowed before leaving.
"You say that you have a precious material that I need?" Xue Ying asked.
"Yes." the green-robed silvery-haired girl said, "I've just heard the news that the monarch requires the Jade Heart Grass Root and the Seven-Leaf Stone Fruit; thus I rushed over immediately."
Xue Ying sighed in his heart. He had spread the news 16,000 years ago, and only now did this stage two World Deity girl heard of it! It was apparent that the news spread much slower across World Deities, and this might be related to the weaker combat power this girl had. Some of the more powerful stage four World Deities should know of it already.
"Which precious material do you have?" Xue Ying asked.
"The Jade Heart Grass Root." The green-robed silvery-haired girl extended her hand, causing a plant that was glowing jade green to appear. This root was very long. The many sub-roots were growing distorted like dragon snakes. There were even illusory figures of jade dragons soaring away from the sub-roots.
Xue Ying revealed a grin. He was left with only one item after acquiring this Jade Heart Grass Root.
"Say, what do you want?" Xue Ying asked, "Deity crystals? Treasures? Or others?"
The green-robed silvery-haired girl looked up at Xue Ying. her eyes held a desire, "I want Monarch to help me kill an enemy."
"Kill an enemy?" Xue Ying was slightly startled.
"I do not have any other requests, just that I hope for Monarch to kill my enemy. After killing my enemy, this Jade Heart Grass Root will be given to Monarch." The green-robed silvery-haired girl said. She believed that with the identity of Xue Ying, he would not snatch away the precious material.
Xue Ying asked, "What identity does this enemy of yours have? What combat power? Tell me in detail."
The green-robed silvery-haired girl lowered her voice, explaining, "I have rushed over from a desolate area within the Bloodshed God Palace territory. This enemy of mine is called World Deity Mo Ba. He was originally a demon from the Dark Abyss, but after coming to the Deity world, he has stayed here ever since. He has a stage three World Deity combat power and should be ranked amongst the top across the stage three World Deities. He specialized in killing and is truly savage. He killed countless people, and he has massacred my loved ones and all my clan members. I was, fortunately, cultivating outside, thus, evading this encounter. I only hope for the monarch to kill him."
"A stage three World Deity?" Xue Ying lightly nodded.
He understood many of the intelligence regarding World Deities, yet they did not include this World Deity Mo Ba.
"He is a demon, yet he can stay rooted here in the Deity world precisely because he depended on Devil Dragon King." The green-robed silvery-haired girl respectfully said, "Devil Dragon King is a powerful existence, and World Deity Mo Ba is a valiant commander under him as someone whom the Devil Dragon King liked quite a lot."
"He is a subordinate of that Devil Dragon?" Xue Ying lightly nodded, "That Devil Dragon loves killing the most. No wonder he would accept a demon under him."
The Dark Abyss was more repulsive towards the experts of the Deity world.
The moment they entered… many experts would surround them due to the guidance of the Dark Abyss willpower.
But it was different in the Deity World. The Deity world encompassed people from all over the place, regardless of which expert he originated from, they would not be discriminated. Thus, within the Deity world, it was entirely reasonable to discover some experts arising from the Dark Abyss. Like previously, there was an expert from the Dark Abyss who pursued Monarch Mo Xue.
"Alright, I understand." Xue Ying nodded.
The green-robed silvery-haired girl was stunned.
What did it mean he understand?
Did it indicate he accepted or not?
Or was he planning to snatch it forcibly? This Monarch Dong Bo was a personal disciple of the God Emperor. His reputation was excellent, and he should not be that despicable right?
"I'll investigate for a moment or two. After understanding the matter, I'll give you an answer." Xue Ying chuckled, "Come come come, let's have a cup of tea first."
Not far away, the female attendant immediately came up to help pour tea for them.
Xue Ying also sat down, bringing up the cup of tea while at the same time, he had begun his scour through the internal system of Bloodshed Tavern to gather the detailed intelligence.
Very quickly, he received news-
Devil Dragon King stayed at the Devil Dragon Ridge.
It was said that there was a legion within the Devil Dragon Ridge which the Devil Dragon King commandeered. Within this Legion, one of the commanders was none other than 'World Deity Mo Ba'. World Deity Mo Ba was notably savage and battle-hungry precisely because he was born as a demon, and this was something which Devil Dragon King liked a lot.
'One of his avatars is living for long periods at the Devil Dragon Ridge?' Xue Ying frowned slightly.
It was a little troublesome.
If he had to kill, he would naturally kill both true body and avatars, only then would that be considered a kill!
Looking through the intelligence reports on World Deity Mo Ba, he was someone who should be killed, just that he had an avatar located within the Devil Dragon king's territory?
"Devil Dragon King." Xue Ying lightly mentioned.
His voice might be light, but that green-robed silvery-haired girl who was holding on to the cup of tea looked towards Xue Ying carefully.
…
"Weng!"
At the moment Xue Ying mentioned the name of Devil Dragon King, he had produced a small little karma with him.
Xue Ying's consciousness began extending over via the karmic line, tearing through the obstacles of space before arriving at one of the more overgrown starfields within the Deity world. Over at this overgrown starfield, there was a chain of mountain extending to a few trillion kilometers; this was the 'Devil Dragon Ridge', and Devil Dragon King had been operating over here for an extended period. Most powerful existences would not dare to barge into his territory.
"Mn?" Devil Dragon King's enormous body was lying on one of the mountain peaks. There were even many plates of delicacies placed in front of him. He would eat a dish now and then.
Even after becoming a powerful existence, he was still unable to get rid of this love for delicacies.
Devil Dragon King suddenly looked up and forward.
Weng!
A blurred figure suddenly appeared in front of him. The figure was condensing from a fog. It was a black robe male who stood in midair and was currently looking calmly at Devil Dragon King.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying?" Devil Dragon King immediately recognized him. It was the famous Xue Ying, and even though he, the Devil Dragon King, was slightly weaker, he was still ranked 95th on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List! Naturally, he knew that Monarch Dong Bo was ranked 52nd currently.
"I wonder what Monarch Dong Bo is here seeking me for?" Devil Dragon King looked up and asked. At the same time, he swept around him.
Those subordinates who had sent up the delicacies immediately retreated obediently. None dared disturb them.
It was only Devil Dragon King, and Xue Ying left on this mountain peak.
Xue Ying had merely descended with an incarnation via karma, just like how ordinary Deities could send a World Projection into the material realm via spatial imprint! Xue Ying might be far from Devil Dragon King, but within the region of Deity world, it was quite simple for him to condense an incarnation using karmic lines.
"I've come seeking Devil Dragon King for a matter." Xue Ying began.

chapters.title: Chapter 608 - Influence
chapters.content:
Chapter 608: Influence
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
"Since Monarch has a matter, do tell me what I can do." Devil Dragon King had some precautions. Even though he had no enmity with this Monarch Dong Bo, they were ultimately not from the same faction.
Xue Ying stood in midair looking at Devil Dragon King, "You have a subordinate called Mo Ba who is from the Dark Abyss right?"
"Right." Devil Dragon King nodded, "Why? How is this concerned with Monarch?"
Xue Ying nodded, "I was originally prepared to assassinate him, but knowing that he is a subordinate of yours, Devil Dragon King, if I don't tell you about it, then it is my mistake!"
Devil Dragon King's enormous eyes slightly dilated before he laughed out a booming sound, "Hahaha, Monarch has truly given this old dragon some respect. He is just a demon, so killing him is nothing big! Why the need for Monarch to be so polite? How about this, I'll eliminate Mo Bo personally."
"Many thanks then, Devil Dragon King." Xue Ying laughed.
"Minor matter, it is just a minor matter." Devil Dragon King laughed out loud.
Xue Ying nodded with a smile, "If Devil Dragon King is free, you can come anytime to my residence for a visit. By then, I'll accompany Devil Dragon King for a few cups."
"If I am free, I'll certainly go over." Devil Dragon King answered.
Xue Ying chuckled before his figure dissipated completely.
There remained only Devil Dragon King on the mountain peak.
Only then did Devil Dragon King's eyes turned colder and were filled with frost.
He was an old chap who lived for who knew how many years, so how could he not know what Xue Ying's meaning was? Xue Ying had explicitly stated that he 'originally thought of directly assassinating him'. It was apparent that his killing intent was extreme, and if he vigorously rejected Xue Ying, that would be angering this Monarch Dong Bo! This Monarch Dong Bo had come earlier to inform him precisely because he genuinely did not want to become an enemy.
For the sake of Mo Ba, was there a need to get into a conflict with Monarch Dong Bo? Devil Dragon King would never do this even if he were a fool.
"Mo Ba, come and see me immediately!" Devil Dragon King immediately ordered.
Very soon.
Sou.
A demon with two enormous curved horn and a body of black scale arrived. He respectfully knelt down, "Greetings King."
World Deity Mo Ba was still very satisfied with his current life. He formerly lived in the Dark Abyss, just that an enemy of his had become a stage four World Deity, frightening him so much that he had to escape. After escaping to the Deity world, he relied upon this Devil Dragon King who was quite savage too. Indeed, their temper was the same, and Devil Dragon King had heavily employed him.
"Truly comfortable." World Deity Mo Ba felt elation in his heart. In the Deity world, he could kill whenever he wanted; he could enjoy whenever he wanted. He had a powerful existence behind his back, and these days were so much better than living in the Dark Abyss.
"Mo Ba." Devil Dragon King lowered his tone, "Have you somehow offended Monarch Dong Bo?"
"Monarch Dong Bo?" World Deity Mo Ba was startled, "Monarch Dong Bo from the Bloodshed God Palace? I've heard of him, yet we have never interacted. Neither do I dare to offend Monarch Dong Bo."
Devil Dragon King sighed inwardly at seeing this.
Who cared about him.
Who cared about how he offended him! Xue Ying had personally told him about this matter.
"Hu." Devil Dragon King casually waved his claws. The claws rapidly pierced through the obstacle of space, causing World Deity Mo Ba to reveal a look of terror. He tried to evade it, only to realize that the entire area was utterly suppressing him. He could not even move, and could only see with his eyes wide open as the claws touched upon his body.
"Why!" World Deity Mo Ba was filled with grievance and confusion. He vaguely guessed that this was related with 'offending Monarch Dong Bo', but it was too late.
As the enormous claws arrived.
World Deity Mo Ba's entire body was torn apart just like paper, shattering into countless pieces before turning into nothingness.
At the same moment-
Over at another lavish palace, World Deity Mo Ba who was currently enjoying had been attacked by karma! The Deity world wasn't the material realm. There was no protection whatsoever in the Deity world. Devil Dragon King, this old dragon who could be ranked on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List was quite accomplished in his attainments on karma. He could use karma to create a force that caused World Deity Mo Ba's avatar to perish. As his body fell, his true deity heart was completely extinguished.
Just like Rulers, they could use karma to kill even existences close to Paragon.
Naturally, if they were under the protection of material realm, then it was another story!
In the material realm, Rulers could only kill a stage two World Deity with a thought. They had to borrow upon an oath to execute a stage three World Deity. Ordinary powerful existences could only kill a stage one World Deity via karma.
If it was in the Deity world…
The karmic attack by powerful existences was similarly frightening!
…
Within the residence of Monarch Dong Bo.
The green-robed silvery-haired girl was holding on to the cup of tea, lightly sipping. She was looking at Xue Ying who was seated not too far away, drinking tea too. She felt anxious and nervous, 'Too careless! I should have hidden this Jade Heart Grass Root, waiting until Monarch Dong Bo has truly killed my enemy before giving it to him. I am too optimistic about this Monarch Dong Bo, believing that with his identity, he would not forcibly snatch it… but even now, he hasn't given me an answer.'
'He should give me an answer at least! As long as he promised me, I believe that killing World Deity Mo Ba is easily done after a period.'
'Unless he is afraid of Devil Dragon King? Oh right, World Deity Mo Ba had an avatar staying at the Devil Dragon Ridge permanently. Maybe it is too troublesome for Monarch Dong Bo to kill a stage three world Deity at the Devil Dragon Ridge?'
The green-robed silvery-haired girl felt concerned and lost at the same time.
After all, she could not do much about this.
"Alright."
Xue Ying who was opposite her said suddenly.
The green-robed silvery-haired girl regained her mind and looked towards Xue Ying with a tremble. Was he going to give her an answer?
"World Deity Mo Ba is dead." Xue Ying said, "Your request is completed."
"Dead?" The green-robed silvery-haired girl lowered her head and looked at the cup of tea in her hands. She had yet to finish drinking the cup of tea. She had only mentioned her request not too long ago, yet World Deity Mo Ba was dead?
"Have a look." Xue Ying pointed to the midair by the side.
The space distorted.
Following which, it transmitted an image of an extravagant palace far away. At this moment, that lavish palace was in a panic as the palace head, 'World Deity Mo Ba', was lying there without any aura.
"This is the Devil Palace of Mo Ba?" The green-robed silvery-haired girl looked at this scene with astonishment.
"This is his avatar. His true body is dead, and avatar has been killed via karma. Thus, his corpse remains completely fine, just that his deity heart is exterminated." Xue Ying explained. During the death of Mo Ba, Xue Ying was able to determine his death via karma.
The green-robed silvery-haired girl looked at that corpse of the tyrannical and savage World Deity Mo Ba staying there unmoving. She felt complex in her heart. At this moment, she did not have many suspicions any longer. There was no need for Monarch Dong Bo to forge such a scene. Even snatching the precious material from her was something she could not retaliate against.
"Thank you monarch." The green-haired silvery-robed girl hurriedly gave up the Jade Heart Grass Root.
Xue Ying chuckled before accepting it.
…
The green-robed silvery-haired girl might believe in it, but she still let her true body visit the Temporal Temple to purchase an intelligence report. The Temporal Temple gave her an answer, "World Deity Mo Ba's true body and avatars are gone. His true body's death is suspected to be related to Devil Dragon King, and his avatar is killed via karma."
This conclusion made the green-haired silvery-haired girl feel astonishment.
Was it Devil Dragon King who personally acted?
She felt herself slightly quaking in fear. Monarch Dong Bo, this person was indeed formidable. She went to request something of him, yet she had yet to finish drinking a cup of tea, and Monarch Dong Bo was seated opposite of her without moving, but World Deity Mo Ba had died.
******
Currently, Xue Ying was left with the final precious material, the 'Seven Leaf Stone Fruit'. Being anxious about it was useless. He could only wait quietly, hoping for a certain World Deity to bring the news of the material. To Xue Ying, he wasn't afraid of any condition mentioned by these World Deities! After all, he was able to satisfy any conditions equivalent to the value of the precious material. It did not include situations like someone who wanted to learn the 'absolute art' for the sake of exchanging with precious material. Xue Ying would directly throw him out.
Time passed.
After 60,000 years since the moment the residence opened, the final precious material arrived.
"I have the precious material needed by Monarch; please inform him." A handsome teenager stood by the entrance of Monarch Dong Bo residence.

chapters.title: Chapter 609 - Set Off to the Ripple Lady Planet
chapters.content:
Chapter 609: Set Off to the Ripple Lady Planet
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
After a moment, Xue Ying who found out that he was about to get the last piece of precious material, turned to look at this teenager.
'Stage one World Deity?' Xue Ying was slightly startled. This time, the person who came was even weaker.
"Greetings, Monarch Dong Bo." The handsome teenager stood there with utmost respect, "Ever since I've heard that Monarch requires the Seven-Leaf Stone Fruit, I have been rushing over. It is fortunate that I was able to reach here alive at least."
Xue Ying was astonished.
Alive?
That's right, this handsome teenager's combat power was too weak. He was merely a stage one World Deity, and if he rushed over here from a desolate piece of land, it would be indeed dangerous for him.
"You have the Seven-Leaf Stone Fruit?" Xue Ying asked.
"I have!" The handsome teenager's eyes brightened, nodding, "I've obtained it fortuitously! But because the route is dangerous, I left the Seven-Leaf Stone Fruit with my true body."
Xue Ying chuckled and nodded, "Say, what request do you have? Deity crystals? Treasures? Or others?"
The handsome teenager respectfully said, "I do not need any treasures. I only hope to become Monarch's disciple and get some pointers. Otherwise, I am afraid that becoming a stage two World Deity will be the end of the path for my current life."
"Accepting me as a teacher?" Xue Ying was slightly astonished. He was able to understand soon enough though since to ordinary stage one World Deity, the greatest desire they had was to accept a great teacher formally, and it would be best if they could become a disciple of a powerful existence.
"I have cultivated for a short period, and there are many matters which I would most likely have the time to guide you properly." The moment Xue Ying's words came out, that handsome teenager's expression turned slightly ashen-gray. Xue Ying continued though, "But, I'll introduce to you an even better teacher than me."
He then transmitted a message to Forefather Scarlet Flame.
Forefather Scarlet Flame had always been staying in residence these few years. Understanding the situation from Xue Ying's transmission, he knew that the final precious material was with this teenager and naturally, he did not hesitate in rushing over.
"Hu." Forefather Scarlet Flame came into the courtyard.
Xue Ying pointed to Forefather Scarlet Flame who walked over, "Brat, this is a powerful existence who transcended, Forefather Scarlet Flame! Powerful existence has completely grasped hold of the entire law of the world. And I, no matter what, have yet to transcend. Thus, it will be more appropriate for him to guide the disciples."
The handsome teenager's eyes brightened.
Being able to become a disciple under a powerful existence? That's good too! Even though Monarch Dong Bo's reputation was great, and his combat power was powerful, what he said was logical since he was still a stage four World Deity, and he would not be as good as this powerful existence, 'Forefather Scarlet Flame' in teaching disciples.
"Forefather, he has cultivated just 30 million years and is considered to have some accomplishments." Xue Ying said.
"It's alright." Forefather Scarlet Flame chuckled and nodded, "Brat, what are you called?"
"I am Qi Qiong." The handsome teenager replied.
"Qi Qiong, I'll accept you as my disciple. Wait for me here. I'll go and collect that Seven-Leaf Stone Fruit." Forefather Scarlet Flame left after saying that. He had formed karma with this teenager and naturally, he was clear where his true body was using karma.
The handsome teenager hurriedly stated, "Teacher, my true body is…" He had yet to say when Forefather Scarlet Flame disappeared.
The handsome teenager looked at Xue Ying with a puzzled look, "Monarch, does my teacher know where I am?"
"He knows." Xue Ying chuckled and nodded.
Half an hour later.
Forefather Scarlet Flame returned, bringing with him the bead of Seven-Leaf Stone Fruit.
"Alright, at least the myriad matters have been prepared. Now I am left with the final matter." Xue Ying received over the seven pieces of green leaves and the stone fruit before revealing a grin, "Forefather, you should properly teach your disciple. I'll be leaving for a while."
…
He rode on the Starfield Flying Ship.
Xue Ying leaf the Black Fog Sea, heading towards the Ripple Lady Planet Master's location.
"Hu."
Standing on the deck of the starfield flying ship, he looked towards the surrounding colorful stream of light-the time-space tunnel-while contacting with Paragon Huo Cheng. Paragon Huo Cheng had long returned to his home. He had also brought Qing Yao with him for guidance.
"Big Brother Huo Cheng." Xue Ying transmitted over, "I am currently setting off to see Ripple Lady Planet Master. According to what I know, Ripple Lady Planet Master has always been placing her concentration on refining, and rarely does she travel outside. She is very cold to other cultivators too, and this time, I am going over to request her for a matter, and I wonder if Big Brother Huo Cheng has any good ideas?"
"That'll be troublesome. She stays at the planet that has been set up with help from Empress Qian He. There are many refining grounds, yet that made the planet a perilous place… even the strongest of Paragons do not dare barge in." Paragon Huo Cheng said, "So you can't take a hard approach. You can only go according to her personality, and at the worst, she might not even want to see you."
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
It was indeed a problem.
According to his understanding of the intelligence report, there were powerful existences whom the Ripple Lady Planet Master did not even meet despite they visiting her! This Ripple Lady Planet Master was famous for her 'coldness'. She was not only cold to ordinary powerful existences, but even formidable Paragons were treated coldly. Most likely, only Rulers had the overwhelming strength to cause her to feel fear. Only then would she not dare to delay in her action.
Her personality was as such. Instead, it had garnered a greater affection from Empress Qian He.
Currently, Xue Ying's attainment in 'time-space' was quite profound. Traveling on the starfield flying ship for just the time taken to brew a cup of tea, he was able to reach the desolate boundary of the Deity world. In the void, there was a black planet situated there. There were no other nearby planets at all. That black planet caused the surrounding space to condense completely, forming endless frost around the half-a-trillion kilometers in area.
"Si la."
Within the time-space tunnel, the Starfield Flying Ship came flying out. A black-robed Xue Ying stood on the Starfield Flying Ship looked afar at that secluded black planet.
"Ripple Lady Planet?" Xue Ying understood. It should be the home of the best refiner amongst Paragons, Ripple Lady Planet Master.
