Keeping his flying ship, Xue Ying stood on the void, walked on it before moving closer to the Ripple Lady Planet.
"Sou." At the moment he was getting close to the planet…
A wave of water rippled in the surrounding. The wave ripple pervaded the void, causing Xue Ying to feel the vague inherent threat. He did not resist. He only let this void wave permeate through the surrounding of his body.
A white-robed old man appeared in this void wave.
The white-robed old man looked at Xue Ying, chuckling, "This is the Ripple Lady Planet. My Clan Master doesn't easily meet anyone."
"I do have to trouble this gentleman to help inform your master, saying Dong Bo Xue Ying is requesting to meet the master." Xue Ying said.
"Please wait here and not proceed any further. If you proceeded any further and got killed by the array, don't blame me for not reminding you." The white-robed old man laughed before disappearing.
Xue Ying understood though that this white-robed old man wasn't a true lifeform. He was just an existence like that of a treasure spirit or array spirit.
Seeing the void water wave pervading around this Ripple Lady Planet, he could not help but sigh, "
Even apex Paragons would not dare to barge in. One could see the terrifying power of this Ripple Lady Planet.
…
On the Ripple Lady Planet.
A girl was wearing snowy-white robe who was lying back on an enormous leaf. She was holding on to a book, reading the arrays written on it.
Two other female attendants were serving her.
"Hua." The white-robed old man appeared by the side, respectfully bowing, "Master, a guest is coming to meet you."
"Who?" The eyebrows of the snowy-white-robed girl lifted up. Her eyes seemed warm.
"He said, he is called Dong Bo Xue Ying." The white-robed old man said. He, as a treasure spirit, did not know who Xue Ying was.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying?" The snowy-white-robed girl frowned, "The personal disciple of Bloodshed God Emperor. I've heard that the Empress, Temporal Island Lord and Myriad God Palace Head had once teamed up to deal with Bloodshed God Emperor and Ruler Nile! Ruler Nile's avatar has died in battle, and Bloodshed God Emperor has escaped awkwardly. They should be relatively angry over this, yet he as the disciple of Bloodshed God Emperor has still come to meet me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 610 - Ripple Lady Planet Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 610: Ripple Lady Planet Master
Translator: Radiant Editor: Radiant
A nearby maid said, "Master, I once heard that Xue Ying is collecting many precious materials, and have also heard that he wanted a Sun Star Nucleus Stone. Now that he's come to visit master, it ought to be that he's collected all the precious materials, and will be requesting master's help to refine a Sun Star Nucleus Stone."
Ripple Lady Planet Master looked outside; her gaze passed through the obstruction of space, landing on the black-clothed male in the midst of void outside the planet.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying?" Ripple Lady Planet Master faintly pondered, "The talent who was the fastest to cultivate to the stage three realm in the Deity world and Abyss? Let's meet him first. Go bring him in."
"Yes." The white-robed old man respectfully said.
There was still a little thing that Ripple Lady Planet Master hadn't told her subordinate. This 'Xue Ying' was one of the two people in the entire Cosmos that were members of the Destruction Legion, and Ripple Lady Planet Master felt that this kind of person would be able to transcend. Thus, he was someone worth meeting.
******
Within space.
"Please follow me in, and do not rush around." The white-robed old man led the way.
"Yes."
Xue Ying followed behind him and soon arrived onto the planet.
This cold planet was too desolate. In the distance, one could see deep blue flames burning, areas enshrouded in fog and black lakes… Peculiar areas were everywhere, and most of them were important facilities for refinement. Empress Qian He personally constructed some of the important facilities. Over here, danger lurked in every corner.
There was a building that occupied merely 5,000 kilometers. It was too small for someone with the identity as a Paragon.
There were creatures, Deities, and World Deities living here and obeying the orders of Ripple Lady Planet Master
"Come this way." The white-robed old man continued to guide him.
Finally, Xue Ying saw a snowy white-robed woman lying on a large soft leaf in front of him. The woman was reading the book in her hands barefooted with two pretty maids serving her.
"Greetings, Ripple Lady Planet Master." Xue Ying naturally recognized the other.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying?" Ripple Lady Planet Master raised her head and glanced at him, "Could it be that you don't know that Empress Qian He, the Myriad God Palace Master, and the Temporal Island Master had recently joined hands to fight a battle with Ruler Nile and your master, the Bloodshed God Emperor? Your teacher has suffered great losses."
Although tens of thousands of years had passed.
But with regards to Rulers, it truly was 'recent enough'.
"Ah." Xue Ying was stunned, he had indeed not known about the matter. During the Myriad Flower Feast, hadn't Empress Qian He returned his teacher's praises?
"Hmph Hmph, you truly didn't know." Ripple Lady Planet Master immediately said, "Coming to meet me, should be for a Sun Star Nucleus Stone?"
Xue Ying went straight to the point with a nod: "Exactly. I've already prepared the Void Black Soil as well as twelve kinds of precious materials
Ripple Lady Planet Master looked at him: "To smelt and refine is extremely difficult, you thought that I would agree? What do you have that's worth me putting forth this condition?"
Xue Ying's complexion did not change: "No matter what, I must try a little. If nothing could be done, I will turn and leave."
"A 500-gram Sun Star Nucleus Stone?"
Ripple Lady Planet Master softly said, "It isn't impossible to request my help, you must agree to three requests."
"Please say." Xue Ying said.
The other could make requests as they wished, but whether or not he agreed was ultimately his own decision.
"First, let one of my disciples learn the upper half of your "Blood Demon Scripture"." Ripple Lady Planet Master said. The original copy of absolute arts was scarce. Although she had become a Paragon, she did not own an original copy of absolute art.
"This isn't too difficult." Xue Ying said.
"Secondly…"
Ripple Lady Planet Master waved her hand, and a gray light flew towards Xue Ying. Xue Ying grasped it with his hand. In his hands, there was a tattered cloth scroll.
"This is a damaged Formation Array." Ripple Lady Planet Master said, "I've heard that you excel in the profound mysteries of the world, and I hope that you can help repair this array formation. As for the deadline, it's not too urgent for me. A stage four World Deity has a lifespan of 10 billion years. Then I will give you a deadline of 10 billion years! Help me repair this array formation within a span of 10 billion years. If you are unable to repair it… then when the time comes, return the Sun Star Nucleus Stone to me."
Hearing the deadline of 10 billion years, Xue Ying felt his heart relax, but if he failed to repair it, the Sun Star Nucleus Stone would have to be returned to the Ripple Lady Planet Master.
Xue Ying immediately looked down at the tattered cloth scroll in his hand
On the clothed scroll was a broken array formation.
When he looked at the formation array, immersing himself within it-
Xue Ying felt that the things before him began to become vague and fuzzy, and gradually became as if he had entered a vast world. This world was mostly intact, but some portions were shattered. Even the dome of the sky was crumbling and becoming grey mist.
Flames blazed within the broken world-great and overbearing. It gave off a feeling far more potent than what Xue Ying felt coming from the Paragon Huo Cheng.
"Was this shattered array formation found from a historical remain?" Xue Ying asked.
"The Empress gave it, and I do not know where it came from." Ripple Lady Planet Master said, "Do you agree to the second condition?"
Xue Ying asked: "Then what about the third condition?"
"The third condition… I still haven't thought of it yet." Ripple Lady Planet Master said, "How about this, for the third condition, you owe me a favor."
"A favor?" Xue Ying hesitated.
A favor could be large or small.
"Don't worry. I will not be too demanding. If my request is too excessive, you can always decline." Ripple Lady Planet Master said.
"I don't need to be bound by an oath?" Xue Ying asked.
"I believe you." Ripple Lady Planet Master said. From the information she had regarding Xue Ying, she had long since judged that this was a person that valued emotion and justice, and someone whose promise was worth a thousand in gold. He was not like those crafty demons of the Dark Abyss and was not like her Empress who would betray someone in an instant. Xue Ying was one of those who deserved to be trusted.
Ripple Lady Planet Master's final condition was only casually brought up.
If Xue Ying's strength later surged into the heavens, then this condition would be a significant gain.
If Xue Ying's power were not enough, then it would be like this negotiation hadn't been done.
"Three requests, correct?" Xue Ying asked, "As long as I agree, you will help me refine a Sun Star Nucleus Stone?"
Ripple Lady Planet Master nodded: "Xue Ying, I must inform you that refining it is something incredibly complicated and one cannot be the slightest bit careless, and once one is careless they will fail. Therefore, you must give me more Void Black Soil, only six million kilograms of Void Black Soil. The entire refining process will take at least 500,000 years. When I succeed, I will inform you.
"Alright." Xue Ying nodded, "I agree with your three requests. Is it a deal?"
"It's a deal." Ripple Lady Planet Master smiled.
She felt that the youthful Xue Ying who was part of the Destruction Legion along with Pang Yi, who had broken cultivation records was worth her spending some time for.
…
Both sides settled the discussion.
Xue Ying left behind six million kilograms of Void Black Soil as well as all 12 kinds of precious materials, took the tattered cloth scroll and left the Ripple Lady Planet.
Standing at the head of the Starfield Flying Ship that was tearing through the midst of a space-time tunnel, Xue Ying's mood was excellent.
'Spending 60,000 years of time, and also having to repair an ancient broken array fragment, as well as promising a favor, everything is at long last settled.'
Xue Ying let out a smile. To repay Forefather Scarlet Flame's kindness, he did not have the slightest hesitation to do all these.
'I am somewhat lucky to succeed in this endeavor. Ripple Lady Planet Master has agreed to help me. Although there are several conditions, it is quite rare for her to accept me." Xue Ying beamed.

chapters.title: Chapter 611 - Time to say goodbye
chapters.content:
Chapter 611: Time to say goodbye
Translator: Chaos_, Radiant Editor: Chaos_
Time is cruel.
To cultivators, time could polish them. Time could also enable them to comprehend more laws and profound mysteries, allowing them to understand stronger Daos and eventually bring them to greater heights. But in the end, if they could not transcend, time would bring them closer to death!
"Jing Qiu." Xue Ying looked at the graceful figure wearing a light blue robe standing by the lake.
Even though she had her back facing him, Xue Ying could see the tears in her eyes.
"Xue Ying." The tears in the eyes of Jing Qiu disappeared. She forced a smile towards her husband.
"Tomorrow is the day that Sir Father-in-law reincarnate. Did you not do it once before and succeeded in awakening? It might be the same for father-in-law too. This reincarnation might even evolve his heart realm, allowing him to transcend in the future. Nothing is impossible." Xue Ying consoled his wife.
"Mn, I understand. But the probability of success is low." Jing Qiu look towards the lake. Her eyes were red: "As the eldest daughter, my father treats me like a treasure. He looked after me on every single occasion and had never trusted me to any servant. I still remembered when I was a child; he would always accompany me to sleep, feeding me and teaching me swordplay…"
"As he grew old and is nearing his death, he had even gone to the Lake Heart Island for me, risking his life to get a True God weapon for me. Every moment I look at this True God weapon, it would remind me of my father."
Jing Qiu looked at Xue Ying, "In this world, there aren't that many people who loved me so much that they will not hesitate to risk their lives for me. Other than you, perhaps there's only my father, yet he is about to reincarnate at this moment."
Xue Ying held onto his wife's hand, "You're a cultivator too and should know that we have gotten much from life. It is the same with Sir Father-in-law too. He has experienced much and should be satisfied with life."
"Mn, I understand." Though she said it outwardly, she still felt gloomy all the same.
…
On the second day,
People came one by one. Those people included Mo Xue's daughters and their husbands. Other than them, there were also some good friends of his. Of course, all his granddaughters and grandsons came visiting him too.
"Father."
"Father."
"Grandpa."
"Ancestor."
Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao had come too.
Right now Dong Bo Yu had become much more reserved. There was even a violet-robed pretty woman by his side. Behind him, there were several youngsters, and some were shouting out Forefather Dong Bo Xue Ying on their mouths.
Xue Ying could not help but smile. He had never thought that after suffering from a setback, this son of his would venture out again. At that time, he had met a violet-robed girl-'Empress Wan He'-who was a stage one world Deity. After they married, Dong Bo Yu's combat power that had been stuck got 120,000 years suddenly rose.
Practically within a single day, he comprehended two grade one Deity Hearts-the 'Extremity Deity Heart' and 'Chaos Deity Heart'-to become a stage two World Deity. It was much faster than his sister, Qing Yao!
Xue Ying was surprised. Before this, his son had reached bottleneck in both Deity Hearts, yet never would he have imagined that his son could make a breakthrough in both deity hearts on the same day.
Dong Bo Yu and Empress Wan He had a daughter and son too, and they brought them countless descendants. It had only been 510,000 years since Xue Ying built his residence, yet he had a heap of descendants already.
"Ha ha ha, Qing Yao, you have become the disciple of brother Huo Cheng, but don't lose out to your little brother." Xue Ying laughed at his daughter.
"Hmph, be rest assured about this since his improvements should be credited to sister Wan He. Since his sudden improvement happen only after he together with sister Wan He. As an elder sister, I will definitely surpass him." Qing Yao replied as she walked along with that purple-robed woman.
Though Dong Bo Yu was introverted by nature, he was used to quarreling with his sister since their young. He could not help but retort back, "I think you need to find a partner before you can even think of surpassing me."
"Sister Wan He, you need to take good care of your man. You see, he dares to pour salt on his sister's wound." Qing Yao pouted.
The purple-robed Wan He had merely laughed by their side. She did not say much.
She had met Dong Bo Yu as she was traveling around the Deity World. Both of them gradually knew each other and, soon, their relationship grew deeper. Although she had restrained her aura in the beginning, it was later when they opened up to each other that she found out that her man had such frightening background.
"Xue Ying"
"Eternal Wind." Xue Ying saw Chi Qiu Bai and his wife coming.
"Both of you had come too?" Xue Ying smiled.
"Senior Mo Xue used to teach me. How could I not come?" Chi Qiu Bai replied. With his talent, even when his soul had split in two, Chi Qiu Bai could still comprehend a grade two True Meaning without guidance from any teacher. He had even suffered from agonizing torture when he was imprisoned in the Dark Abyss. When Howling Devil Cult Leader was practicing the "Blood Demon Scripture", many spirits more powerful than Chi Qiu Bai succumbed to him, yet Chi Qiu Bai could hold out till he became one of the last nine souls.
That terrible torture had become a huge tempering experience for him.
His determination to survive with his loved one brought Chi Qiu Bai's power to new heights rapidly. He became a Deity rapidly using his grade two Deity Heart before evolving it. After he resurrected, he only needed 80,000 years to become a World Deity and another 35,000 to become a stage two World Deity!
Even though he still couldn't be compared to Xue Ying, he was slightly weaker than other grade one True Meaning Transcendents. His achievement had even made Forefather Vicious Tyrant invite him to become his disciple. When Xue Ying chimed in, Chi Qiu Bai accepted the invitation without hesitation, becoming Forefather Vicious Tyrant's personal disciple in the end.
Forefather Vicious Tyrant felt great joy after that. He had even spoken to Chi Qiu Bai, "Eternal Wind, train well. If you need any secret techniques or treasures, do tell me directly."
Forefather Vicious Tyrant treatment of Chi Qiu Bai made Xue Ying happy.
After going through so many hardships, it was time for Chi Qiu Bai to shine! But let's not mention whether he could get out from the River of Time since it was uncertain if he could even become a grade four World Deity.
…
Many guests came over one by one. Each of them had some relationship with Monarch Mo Xue. Some were even his old subordinates. The entire gathering ended up with several hundred guests attending.
Finally, Monarch Mo Xue came out. He wore his usual thick black robe with a neat hair and mustache.
He looked at all his friends that came to bid him farewell: "Everyone!"
All those who were present turned silent and looked at him.
Monarch Mo Xue smiled: "Thank you, everyone, for coming. In this lifetime I have achieved many things-after being born into this world, I have fought hard to reach where I am today. I have set up a nation in the Deity World and even raised seven daughters till they all become World Deities!"
Jing Qiu, seventh Mei Yu and the other daughters of Monarch Mo Xue were looking at their father.
Even though he did not pamper the other younger daughters of his as much as his eldest daughter, Monarch Mo Xue still cared for all of them nonetheless. Otherwise, it would be impossible for them to become World Deities.
"I have already experienced many things in my life, and have gotten many things. I am fully satisfied with what I have experienced." Monarch Mo Xue shared, "However, it's a pity that in the end, I will still be stuck in the River of Time without being able to break away from it. If I don't transcend, my true deity heart will only crumble eventually. I have lived long enough, and it is time for me to leave this world. Naturally, even if I have to leave, I still want to have one last fight before reincarnating."
"Well, I won't say anymore." Monarch Mo Xue gave his last smile before he began to disintegrate. His true deity heart also started scattering away.
Jing Qiu held onto Xue Ying's hand tightly; her body was even slightly trembling.
Xue Ying watched silently. Despite studying the Blood Demon Scripture before, his father-in-law could not evade this ending. He could only choose to gamble on the last and final hope-to reincarnate!
"Weng."
When the true deity heart crumbled apart, all remnants of the soul would disappear.
Xue Ying faintly watched as the law of the cosmos took away that last remnant of the soul. Monarch Mo Xue had entered reincarnation and might be in the belly of a mother.
'All the best.' Xue Ying silently gave his wish.
******
That was the life of a cultivator. The further one walked, the harder it would be in breaking through. Only by overcoming all difficulties would one achieve more. There had never been a case in which one could easily achieve something huge without doing much.
Time passed after the reincarnation of Monarch Mo Xue. A thousand years, two, three, thousand years and even ten thousand years passed by without news about Monarch Mo Xue. Xue Ying and the others understood that Monarch Mo Xue had failed in his reincarnation.
As a grade four World Deity, and with herself going through a life and death separation, Jing Qiu gradually accepted everything with the help of Xue Ying.
In the blink of an eye, it was already 690,000 years after Xue Ying constructed his residence, and 680,000 years since Monarch Mo Xue reincarnated.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, I have finished refining the Sun Star Nucleus Stone." a voice passed through karma, sounding right beside Xue Ying's ears inside his cultivation room.

chapters.title: Chapter 612 - Heading to the Sun Star
chapters.content:
Chapter 612: Heading to the Sun Star
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"It's finally done." Xue Ying immediately left the Black Fog Sea alone, riding on the starfield flying ship towards Ripple Lady Planet.
Very soon, he arrived there.
This time, he wasn't affected by any obstructions. Instead, under the lead by the array spirit, the white-robed old man, Xue Ying went on to meet with the Ripple Lady Planet Master.
Ripple Lady Planet Master remained in her snowy-white robe. She sat by the side of the lake barefooted. Her tender white legs were kicking the water casually, and every single movement of hers let out a natural cadence.
Xue Ying sighed inwardly. This Ripple Lady Planet Master had the most natural aura amongst the Paragons he had seen.
"The water seems ordinary, yet it should be essential amidst the Myriad Existences of the entire Cosmos. Without it, no life could survive." Ripple Lady Planet Master said, "The strength of water is also an important strength when refining a piece of equipment."
"If mentioning about refining equipment, Planet Master is ranked in the top three even after including the Rulers." Xue Ying said.
"Compared to your teacher, I am still far off. Bloodshed God Emperor is indeed a miraculous existence in our cosmos epoch." Ripple Lady Planet Master stood up, stepping on the grass as she sauntered over, "Dong Bo Xue Ying, you are considered a miraculous existence too. I thought that you would have transcended into a True God during the period I was purifying out the Sun Star Nucleus Stone."
Xue Ying shook his head, "How could cultivation be that easy? I have merely comprehended nine different grade one Deity Hearts at this moment and want to fuse them together into the whole law of the world; I still lack that crucial last step."
"I believe that you will soon achieve it with your comprehension ability."
Ripple Lady Planet Master flipped her hand. A black glossy stone appeared in it. It was about the size of a nail and seemed ordinary.
But Xue Ying's eyes brightened the moment he saw it.
He could feel the law of profound mysteries changing around this Sun Star Nucleus Stone; it had repulsed the strength of water, and its surrounding temperature had risen by quite a few. Even time-space was suppressed…
"A stone can transform the laws?" Xue Ying was slightly astonished.
"For you." Ripple Lady Planet Master threw it to him, "I do not have any desires throughout these few years."
"I appreciate the effort made by Planet Master." Xue Ying said. He received the Sun Star Nucleus Stone with his hand. The stone felt warm, but when using the luminous sun force to permeate through it, he was able to discover the terrifying strength contained within this Sun Star Nucleus Stone! The luminous sun force was burnt to nothingness the moment it made contact upon it! Xue Ying might be alarmed, but he did not find it weird.
Even though he had long cultivated the "Luminous Sun" to the fourth boundary of the fourth volume, even Rulers who proceeded into the deepest area of the Sun Star-the Sun Star Nucleus-would be burned into nothingness.
This piece of nail-sized stone contained very little energy within, yet its quality was extremely high! Such a stone could easily burn away the luminous sun force.
'Being able to affect the surrounding law, it is truly unfathomable.' Xue Ying vaguely understood that the structure of this stone had an enormous secret, but he could not sense it. Any strand of energy was burned into nothingness the moment it touched upon the stone! Naturally, being unable to comprehend it, Xue Ying could guess that even Rulers would have a hard time trying to understand it.
"You have given me your promise. Do not forget it." Ripple Lady Planet Master chuckled.
"That's natural." Xue Ying said.
It was a promise that was worth a thousand gold.
"Also, I have not made known to any other people regarding the matter of I refining the Sun Star Nucleus Stone for you, other than my subordinates." Ripple Lady Planet Master mentioned, "My subordinates do not dare to spread outwards either. Thus, this matter should still be a secret. But with how you have been collecting the precious materials wantonly, many powerful in the Deity world and Abyss should be able to make their conclusions."
"Many thanks." Xue Ying said
He wasn't afraid of the threat. But Forefather Scarlet Flame was relatively weaker.
"Then I'll make my move first." Xue Ying said.
"I hope that the next time we meet, you would have transcended." Ripple Lady Planet Master stated, "I am truly waiting for the day you become a Paragon. Otherwise, this favor of yours is not much use to me."
"I hope that it will happen according to your wishes too." Xue Ying laughed. Towards Ripple Lady Planet Master, with her identity as a Paragon and also the number one refiner amongst Paragons, many came asking her for her help. If he did not become a Paragon, then this favor of his was useless to her indeed!
…
Xue Ying brought the Sun Star Nucleus Stone, returning home secretly.
Black Fog Sea.
During the way back, he had already transmitted and informed Forefather Scarlet Flame.
"Look." The moment he returned, he brought out that piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone.
Seeing this little black stone and discovering the transformation of the law of the world around it, Forefather Scarlet Flame's eyes immediately turned red. His body was slightly trembling. This Sun Star Nucleus Stone could vaguely affect the surrounding law, and thus, would greatly reduce the damage wrought on him, enabling him to descend to the second level, 'Sun Stone Layer' of the Sun Star.
Descending to this level, the hope of his path of cultivation would significantly increase. In his entire life, he would undoubtedly be able to open his own Dao path and become a Paragon!
If not for this stone, he would not see the light, and days of hope. Instead, he would feel tasteless despite living for the long periods of time! This was also the reason why Forefather Scarlet Flame asked Xue Ying for his help despite knowing that it might sound a little overbearing; instead, he had thickened his face to ask for his help.
And Xue Ying had put in all effort to help him accomplish it.
"Xue Ying, thank you, thank you." Forefather Scarlet Flame's voice was slightly trembling.
"Forefather, there is no need to say thanks to me." Xue Ying chuckled, "I'll temporarily not give this Sun Star Nucleus Stone to you."
Forefather Scarlet Flame was stunned.
Not give?
Forefather Scarlet Flame might be anxious, yet he still asked, "You are planning?"
"No other reasons." Xue Ying said, "If I give it to you, you will return to the Sun Star immediately! The moment any powerful existences discovered it… what do you say they would think? I have been collecting precious materials for over 600,000 years, and you have been staying over at my place during this period too. Now that you are planning to return to the Sun Star Planet? Adding up the time Ripple Lady Planet Master took to purify it, those who are slightly more intelligence could deduce what will happen."
Forefather Scarlet Flame felt a wave of fear.
That's right.
He had been staying here in the Black Fog Sea for over 600,000 years, and why would he suddenly return? Matters regarding the Sun Star Nucleus Stone would indeed cause others to pay their attention to this.
"You should continue staying here in the Black Fog Sea as if nothing has happened." Xue Ying said, "Isn't your true body at the Sun Star? I'll personally make a trip over to send the Sun Star Nucleus Stone. Furthermore, I plan on staying there to cultivate too. Firstly, those who are scheming would find out that it should be I who wanted to borrow the Sun Star Nucleus Stone in cultivating. Secondly, if there is someone who truly acted, I can help you too."
Forefather Scarlet Flame felt that what Xue Ying considered was thoughtful indeed. He added, "Actually, powerful existences would not think that you will give the Sun Star Nucleus Stone to me either since it is too precious."
"I know that you are anxious. I'll set off tomorrow." Xue Ying said.
…
After telling Jing Qiu, Xue Ying left on the next day. He and his wife or children parting was a minor matter since they could meet anytime within the Xia Clan World, Crimson Rock Mountain world. Being cultivators, they were still vigilant and stayed in the Material Realm; even Rulers could not kill him. Naturally, he had to make good use of it.
Over the long years, if Xia Clan World crumbled, then he would have to leave. By then, he would not be able to have such perfected protection.
"Hu."
Riding on the Starfield Flying Ship, Xue Ying was feeling expectant as he stood on the deck. Despite how familiar he was with the 'sun' as a mortal, he had never indeed entered the Sun Star ever.
The Sun Star was located at a different time-space.
And it was not on the same level as the ordinary time-space. It was even on a different level with the River of Time.
It was located at the level with the core of the entire cosmos; its brightness could shine across the whole cosmos.

chapters.title: Chapter 613 - Cultivating on the Sun Star
chapters.content:
Chapter 613: Cultivating on the Sun Star
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Standing at the deck of the Starfield Flying Ship, Xue Ying saw many layers of time-space being penetrated in front of him. The Sun Star ahead was emitting a brightness that felt warm at the start, but as he got closer, he could feel the temperature of the sun rays rapidly increasing. At the same time, the star was becoming more prominent in his vision. He could even feel a terrifying offensive nature inherent within.
"Hua~"
Finally, Xue Ying passed entirely through time-space and arrived at the innermost layer of the cosmos.
Xue Ying squinted his eyes, looking at the enormous Sun Star. The Sun Star had flames blasting up to the sky occasionally. It was releasing a blazing heat that could destroy all life energy. This heat ripped through time-space and was present everywhere! This strength from the Sun Star was even able to permeate through the dark region that had been covered!
At the same time, there was another extraordinary strength suffocated Xue Ying-a law that spread across all directions!
'The law of the Sun Star?' Xue Ying had to admit that only when he was genuinely close to the Sun Star did he discover that its law might be on the same level with the material realm and Dark Abyss, albeit its suppression was much stronger.
The material realm was akin to a land filled with life. The Dark Abyss was instead, a desolate place filled with danger and devastation.
What about the Sun Star?
It was instead a land-shaped meteor! The Sun Star contained an ultra-strong offensive nature and was dominant in all ways.
'Truly overbearing and tyrannical, bringing with it terrifying destruction. But in the midst of destruction, there is life energy hidden within too.' Xue Ying was amazed. He kept the Starfield Flying Ship before stepping on the void and headed towards the Sun Star.
…
The Sun Star was not appropriate to live on.
One had to attain a relatively high level of combat power before he could cultivate here. Ordinary stage four World Deities would most likely turn into ashes the moment they stepped on the Sun Star.
"Hua." Xue Ying descended on the 'surface of water' of the Sun Star.
There might be flames raging on the surface of the Sun Star, though these flames had liquefied. The entire surface of the Sun Star was considered a piece of 'ocean'. It was an ocean formed entirely of liquefied flames. This 'huge ocean' even had ripples fluctuating that agitated the flames, making them even more rampant.
"Hong long long~"
Xue Ying looked from afar. The brightness of the flames was truly dazzling. The ocean of flame underneath his feet felt quite peaceful, though the 'water' surface was slowly drifting. In the distant, there were a few areas of such surging waves.
"Xue Ying." A figure came flying from afar. It was none other than Forefather Scarlet Flame.
"Forefather." Xue Ying revealed a grin.
"I have troubled you to come all the way here." Forefather Scarlet Flame said.
"It isn't something big. I have cultivated bitterly for a long time, and it is time for me to have a walk." Xue Ying said. After comprehending the nine grade one Deity Hearts, the next step would be to fuse them into the complete law of the world. Burying himself in closed-door cultivation wasn't always the best method! Coming out to have a stroll on the Sun Star or Moon Star might sometime be more effective for his cultivation. After all, the laws here far surpassed that of the law of the world and pondering over them could allow him to break through.
"This is the Sun Star Nucleus Stone." Xue Ying threw over.
Forefather Scarlet Flame received it. Suppressing his excitement, he said, "Go, let me bring you in and have a look."
"Hu."
The two of them immediately tunneled into the Sun Ocean, flying afar.
There was a layer of luminous sun force on the figure of Xue Ying which easily isolated this Sun Water.
"The Sun Star is filled with destruction. There are no lifeforms which could form here." Forefather Scarlet Flame said.
"Oh?" Xue Ying laughed without rebuking him.
Actually, in the large number of intelligence reports given by his teacher Bloodshed God-Emperor, on the fifth level of Sun Star, the 'Sun Abyss', two terrifying lifeforms emerged there. Using the description given by his teacher, strictly speaking, they were not actual lifeforms. Instead, they were incarnations of part of the law from the Sun Star and had power equivalent to a Ruler. Even now, they had not taken a step out of the Sun Star, and had always been sleeping within the Sun Abyss, having fun and occasionally entering the fourth level, 'Void Black Soil Layer'.
The Void Black Soil Layer was a layer only most Rulers could enter. There might be a selective few amongst Paragons like Paragon Huo Cheng and Monarch Green who could enter.
Thus, these two terrifying lifeforms were indeed kept a secret. Most powerful existences did not know of them.
Flying for a long time, Xue Ying and Forefather Scarlet Flame finally arrived at the bottom of the surface 'Sun Ocean'.
Xue Ying overlooked below. He could see a continuous layer of thick stone. The stone layer had even more terrifying flame energy inherent within.
Forefather Scarlet Flame descended on the stone layer. He sat down cross-legged. The surface of his body had influenced the surrounding laws, to the extent of even resonating with the laws of the entire Sun Star. The damage of the surrounding flame inflicted on him had substantially decreased.
"Borrowing on the Sun Star Nucleus Stone, I can sit here, but I don't dare to venture deeper." Forefather Scarlet Flame laughed.
Xue Ying also descended.
He stepped on the stone layer.
"Be careful." Forefather Scarlet Flame reminded him.
Xue Ying was very calm though. The strands of flames immediately penetrated the luminous sun force which initially surrounded his entire body and his two feet. The 'luminous sun force' might be Yang and hard, yet it wasn't appropriate for defense. A layer of black armor naturally appeared on the surface of his body which easily parried against this layer of flames.
What a joke. Xue Ying's "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body"'s armor could completely withstand the full force of 'White Sovereign King' before getting damaged. Most apex Paragons would not dare to withstand against an attack from White Sovereign King forcibly.
One could see how strong the body and defenses of Xue Ying was as a member of the Destruction Legion. Just relying on his defenses, he was entirely not any weaker as compared to the apex Paragons.
"It is indeed different." Xue Ying stepped on the surface. At that moment, he could sense the transformation of nature from the law of the sun.
"Dong dong dong!" Some extremely profound impacts caused the heart of Xue Ying to accelerate. The dominant and overbearing law of profound mysteries completely enveloped around Xue Ying.
Xue Ying delicately experienced it for a moment before opening his eyes.
"How is it? Shocking right?" Forefather Scarlet Flame laughed, "It is entirely possible to open my own Dao path after grasping a strand of its power. Grasping part of it will enable one to match up against Rulers."
"It is indeed quite amazing. I'll go deeper in to have a look." Xue Ying said.
"Deeper?" Forefather Scarlet Flame was stunned.
He relied on the Sun Star Nucleus Stone to touch on the surface of the second layer.
"Hua-"
Saying that Xue Ying had already forcibly torn through space. His mighty strength squeezed apart the stone layer he went deeper in. As he got deeper, the stone layer on the surface was also slowly recovering. That was how Xue Ying flew deeper, penetrating through the stone layer. The flame energy inherent within the stone layer was also gradually increasing, yet it was unable to threaten his armor at all.
…
At a desolate ground in the Deity world, at an overgrown starry sky.
There was a land floating about.
On the land, many black bamboos were growing on it. The black bamboos were emitting a cold intent that could cause others to feel frosty! Countless black bamboos covered about 90% of the entire land.
Right at the center of this land, there was a chain of luxurious palaces.
And within one of the palaces…
The palace door was closed.
Within the great hall, there was only a black-robed thin male seated on the throne. His skin was black, and there were some mythical patterns on it. There were even two protrudes on his forehead.
He was 'Bamboo Saint' from the Two Saints Ink Clan, and had been the one who coercively snatched the 'Sun Star Nucleus Stone' from Forefather Scarlet Flame in the past.
A voice reverberated within the palace hall.
"Bamboo Saint, Ripple Lady Planet Master has purified a Sun Star Nucleus Stone for Dong Bo Xue Ying, and Dong Bo Xue Ying is currently heading to the Sun Star before passing it to Forefather Scarlet Flame. They are both currently on the Sun Star." A cold voice sounded.
The edge of Bamboo Saint's lips had a strand of smirk, "Admirable, admirable; you can sense the power coming from the Sun Star Nucleus Stone. Amazing."
"Hmph." That cold voice snorted before disappearing.
Bamboo Saint sat cross-legged over there.
Via karma, he was able to sense…
That indeed, Xue Ying and Forefather Scarlet Flame were both on the Sun Star!
"Dong Bo Xue Ying is there too? This is slightly troublesome. This brat has cultivated for a short period, yet his ranking on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List is higher than I slightly." Bamboo Saint said, "I'll have to wait, wait until Dong Bo Xue Ying left before killing Forefather Scarlet Flame to snatch away the Sun Star Nucleus Stone again."

chapters.title: Chapter 614 - Undulating Might
chapters.content:
Chapter 614: Undulating Might
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"The Religious Leader will grant me a huge blessing if I offer a piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone him-the Religious Leader is indeed magnanimous." Bamboo Saint chuckled before bringing out a simple-looking black metal. This black metal contained many dense golden words: "If I can get the Sun Star Nucleus Stone from Forefather Scarlet Flame and offer it to the Religious Leader, I should be able to obtain a reward not any lower than the previous time!"
"I feel that my foundation is getting more profound! Who knows if I might just open a Dao path after offering this stone."
Bamboo Saint grinned as he looked at the black metal in his hand.
"Forefather Scarlet Flame, you are truly my benefactor."
"Your face is quite huge to get Dong Bo Xue Ying to give you a piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone." Bamboo Saint became delighted the more he thought of it. If the Sun Star Nucleus Stone was with Xue Ying, he had no way of getting it! Xue Ying was too powerful, and even Paragons had a hard time trying to kill him. The moment he delayed the battle slightly, the good friends of Xue Ying like Paragon Huo Cheng and others would most likely arrive.
Thus, if the stone remained with Xue Ying, he would never dare do something like this.
As for Forefather Scarlet Flame?
He was much weaker!
…
Deep within the Sun Star.
Xue Ying was wearing a black armor as he forced his way through the Sun Stone Layer. He would squeeze out a passage through the Sun Stone Layer, traveled through it before the passage gradually recovered behind him.
He tore his way through the layer.
Many golden stars suffused the surrounding flames; the pressure was growing stronger. Nevertheless, the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor was still able to withstand it.
'This Sun Stone Layer is too thick. Comparatively speaking, the Sun Sea is much shallower.' Xue Ying thought. With his combat power, he could still travel through at speed close to 500,000 kilometers every second despite being obstructed by the Sun Stone Layer. He had been moving for a day now, yet he was situated within the same Sun Stone Layer albeit the flames around him were getting stronger.
Finally-
On the fifth day of his journey through the Sun Stone Layer, Xue Ying finally reached a deep region of the Sun Star. Within the sealed Stone Layer, many flames were glittering with golden stars. These flames could easily burn a powerful existence to death, and it was only because of the Extreme Mysterious Annihilation Body armor that Xue Ying was able to remain safe here.
'I am reaching the third layer?' Xue Ying finally stopped. He could vaguely feel a slightly weak undulation.
It felt weak, yet it had been transmitted out from the deepest area of the entire Sun Star.
The moment it touched his body, the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor of his was even faintly vibrating.
'The Sun Ripple Layer!' Xue Ying understood. He had reached the boundary to the third layer of the Sun Star-the 'Sun Ripple Layer'. Apex Paragons could safely reach the Sun Ripple Layer under ordinary circumstances. The weaker Paragons, however, would not be able to withstand this 'Sun Ripple'. Instead, they would be burned to death and their bodies incinerated into oblivion! There was a minority of Paragons though, like Paragon Huo Cheng and Monarch Green, who could cross through the entire Sun Ripple Layer to enter the 'Void Black Soil Layer'.
The Void Black Soil Layer was a place which Xue Ying did not even dare conceive the thought of going!
After all, Paragon Huo Cheng could enter because he specialized in flames, walking down the Flame Dao. Naturally, it was much easier for him. And 'Monarch Green' had a power matching that of Rulers. As for others like Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Lord, Mysterious North Imperial Empress and Bitter Cultivator, they might be heaven-shaking, yet they could not enter the Void Black Soil Layer at all.
Regarding defenses, Xue Ying dared to say that he was comparable with Bitter Cultivator and the others.
"Hu."
Xue Ying continued traveling deeper.
The Sun Ripple Layer still constituted of magma rocks. As Xue Ying got deeper, the power of the Sun Ripple would get stronger.
"Weng Weng weng~" The ripple was more potent the deeper he went; it caused Xue Ying's armor to vibrate continuously. Still, the armor was able to resist the ripples.
'The magma stone is becoming softer.'
Xue Ying was astonished.
The Sun Star magma stone wasn't really a stone. It was an existence formed after the flames solidified! And now, under the impact of the Sun Ripple, the deeper in, the softer this solid became after being affected.
…
Xue Ying relied on the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor to continue traveling deeper. He was relatively interested about the Sun Star, and thus, he decided to proceed on! But gradually, he would discover small cracks appearing on his Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor under the impact of the 'Sun Ripple'. Xue Ying immediately let the energy within his body recover the cracks! As long as his armor could still recover from all damages, he would continue heading in further. The surrounding magma stones were starting to turn softer-it felt like soft soil.
'This soft soil is starting to turn into the Void Black Soil.' Xue Ying looked at the surrounding soft soil. The soft soil was gold in color, and amongst which, some were black. The flame amidst the soft soil was also a flame of pure gold in color! The golden star was sparkling, and it was able to cause slight damage on Xue Ying's black armor. Comparatively speaking, the power from the Sun Ripple was much stronger than the golden star.
'I am reaching the limit of which I could venture with my current cultivation.' Xue Ying finally stopped. The surrounding golden soft soil was flowing with flames emerging every now and then. The terrifying ripple swept across a huge area time after time, and each time it pulsed, it would cause cracks on Xue Ying's armor.
Xue Ying was cultivating and sensing the law of the Sun Star at the same time.
He closed his eyes.
"Hong hong hong~" There were the profound mysteries of flame. The flames were overbearing and tyrannical, burning everything in its way. That was a tyranny which did not leave any possible path of return!
"Hu hu hu~" It was the profound mysteries of the Sun Ripple. The Sun Ripple swept across every single area, and every single ripple had their minute differences. As Xue Ying extended his senses, he could even feel that it was akin to watching the billowing ocean waves hitting the shore in the Xia Clan world. The Sun Ripple was as such-every single ripple was different. This was because they were formed from many different ripples that superposed on each other, increasing their overall power.
The deeper in, the more concentrated the ripples were, allowing more superposition to occur that increased the power even further.
The further out he got, the less concentrated the ripples were, and thus, the ripples' strength would be comparatively weaker.
Xue Ying could even understand that this Sun Ripple represented a sole Dao path! The moment one opened this Dao path, he would be able to stand there emitting Sun Ripples that would sweep across all directions! Even the strongest of Paragons could not withstand with their bodies! They would turn into smithereens!
'This is a domain-related Dao, and its power is extreme with huge offensive ability.' Xue Ying understood. The moment one unleashed the power of Sun Ripple, it would affect a huge area and the time-space situated within. There was no way of escaping from it. One could only withstand the ripples head-on.
If one could resist against the ripples, he would live.
Otherwise, he would die!
'But now, it isn't appropriate for me to seek power. If I bury myself into researching the Sun Ripple, it'll be too troublesome if I opened a Dao path as a result.' Xue Ying chuckled. He would be immersed in the River of Time forever and could not transcend: 'I should transcend first. After that, I can research all I want.'
Xue Ying slightly pondered over the Sun Ripple, throwing his heart concentration into the operating laws of the 'Sun Star'.
The Sun Star was by nature, a system in itself. It formed an even bigger world.
As Xue Ying was studying its construct, he perfected the comprehension he had towards the profound mysteries of the world. After all, his path was all about using the profound mysteries of the world to encompass all laws before forming the entire law of the world.
…
Deep within the third layer of the Sun Star, the 'Sun Ripple Layer', Xue Ying was quietly comprehending and experiencing the ripples personally.
Actually, Xue Ying had reached quite a profound comprehension of the world aspect, yet he lacked that spark to fuse the entire law of the world altogether.
As time passed, 13,000 years had already passed.
"Ai." A low booming voice came transmitting from deep within the Sun Star, causing Xue Ying who was still situated around the soft golden soil to open his eyes suddenly. His eyes were filled with a strand of shock: 'Are those the two Ruler lifeforms within the Sun Abyss?'

chapters.title: Chapter 615 - Who asked You to be Weak?
chapters.content:
Chapter 615: Who asked You to be Weak?
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying closed his eyes.
He was listening to the roaring sound-it became very weak when it reached here, but Xue Ying was still able to affirm the approximate position of the 'origin of the sound'. That should be from a humongous being… and it should currently be flying in pleasure while letting out sounds of roar. According to his deduction, it should currently be flying within the 'Void Black Soil Layer'.
'It's time to return.' Xue Ying opened his eyes and revealed a grin, 'Who would have thought that I can still hear the Sun Abyss lifeform roaring this time. A stroke of luck.'
He then returned after that.
…
On the surface of the Sun layer.
Forefather Scarlet Flame was currently sending Xue Ying off.
"Leaving so early?" Forefather Scarlet Flame said.
"Haha, Forefather, to you, its only 10,000 or so years and is extremely short. But to me, its notably long already." Xue Ying laughed, "And now, cultivating deep in the Sun Star requires me to multitask while tending to my injuries. I'll first make my way back to the Black Fog Sea and properly cultivate what I have perceived."
"When I cultivate in the Sun Stone Layer, I do have to multitask in combating the flames too. I couldn't focus entirely on my comprehension. Usually, I would return to the surface of the Sun Star to consolidate my understanding." Forefather Scarlet Flame mentioned, "Piece by piece."
Xue Ying nodded in understanding, "You don't have to send me off."
He casually waved his hand, causing a Starfield Flying Ship to appear before stepping on it and swiftly tearing through time-space.
Forefather Scarlet Flame looked at Xue Ying leaving with a smile. He then used karma to sense his surroundings before sighing in relief, "Bamboo Saint is still in his territory. Right, even if the matter of Xue Ying personally requesting for Ripple Lady Planet Master to purify a Sun Star Nucleus Stone is kept a secret, I still have to be cautious. It is likely that Bamboo Saint does not know this."
He then turned around before returning to his own wooden house on the surface layer of the Sun Star Ocean, quietly reflecting over his gains for the recent 10,000 years.
******
Within a dimmed palace hall.
Bamboo Saint was currently looking at the black metal in his hand while seated on his throne. His eyelids convulsed slightly before he turned towards the distant Sun Star. The edge of his lips lifted as he sneered, "Dong Bo Xue Ying has returned? I knew it. This brat has cultivated for only a short period, so how long can he stay on the Sun Star? To him, transcending is still more important."
"No rush! I'll wait for a few days before stealthily setting out to kill Forefather Scarlet Flame. By then, the Sun Star Nucleus Stone should be mine! Ze ze, such a huge reward." Bamboo Saint's eyes were emitting light.
…
Black Fog Sea.
"Hua."
Xue Ying returned to his Monarch Residence. He was not in a rush to cultivate. Instead, he was accompanying his wife, Jing Qiu. Coincidentally, his son Dong Bo Yu was around too. The family of three had gathered together to chat and discuss the profound mysteries of law.
On this day.
"Father, this is a new sword technique which I have created." Dong Bo Yu stood up.
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu were both seated at the side enjoying their tea while watching. It had been 700,000 years since the opening of the residence, and Xue Ying's current foundation was quite accumulated; he was so much stronger as compared to when he first came out from the Three Chief Sacred Mountain. He felt that his son was still quite immature and full of mistakes with his comprehension of the law. Nevertheless, Xue Ying would encourage and praise him before guiding him.
This sword technique was very dazzling.
It created a world that felt similar to entering the primal chaos. After which, a point of extremity would appear. The sword technique was dazzling and resplendent as if it was a rainbow.
"Father, how is my sword technique?" Dong Bo Yu asked.
"Appearing suddenly amidst the primal chaos without any signs. Not bad." Xue Ying commented, "But its power is lacking. The Profound mysteries of Primal Chaos could be used to condense into extremity, and this condensation has its finesse. Have a look."
Xue Ying lightly tapped with his right hand.
"Dong!"
The void which his finger touched suddenly collapsed. Many circular ripples that could be seen with the naked eyes caused the area to collapse right from the center before eventually, forming a dark point. That was also the starting point of 'extremity' as it turned into a dazzling rainbow, arcing through the sky and tearing apart the starry sky. It traveled to a far distance before eventually dissipating.
Dong Bo Yu's eyes turned bright as he saw that.
"This ripple…" Jing Qiu's eyes also brightened. Her cultivation was slow, and she had only comprehended a total of seven grade one Deity Herts. Nevertheless, she could discover the extraordinariness behind that Profound Mystery of Ripple which Xue Ying displayed.
"This has part of the profound mysteries from the Sun Ripple." Xue Ying mentioned.
Sun Ripple.
Xue Ying had, after all, spent 13,000 years there. Even though he wanted to comprehend the entire law of the Sun Star, after spending day and night being impacted by the Sun Ripple, some comprehensions dawned on him. Maybe, the ripples from the sun and the thin pipes from inside the 'Black Feather' had some points of similarity. Or maybe, he had some accidental comprehension in this aspect. Regardless, his harvest was pretty huge.
But Xue Ying did not dare continue researching in it. Even though reaching the 'Opening Realm' was tough, and opening his own Dao path was tough, and even if he genuinely went on researching in the Sun Ripple, the possibility of him opening his own Dao path wasn't huge, Xue Ying had drawn on the lessons learned from the commander of Destruction Legion in addition to a reminder by his teacher. That was why he deliberately decided not to seek for power that much.
"Sun Ripple?" Jing Qiu gasped, "The third layer of the Sun Star?"
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
"In a while, you must have a battle with me, and allow me to see how formidable this Sun Ripple is." Jing Qiu anxiously mentioned.
"I want to learn too!" Dong Bo Yu added.
Xue Ying laughed and nodded. Suddenly, his expression changed.
"Hong-"
A figure came scuttling out from within the monarch residence. It was Forefather Scarlet Flame who had been staying here for a long time. Forefather Scarlet Flame's current expression was filled with anxiety, "Xue Ying, you must help me this time!"
"I understand." Xue Ying's expression turned ashen-gray too, "Truly daring!"
******
On the surface of the Sun Star.
Fleeing from the wooden house, Forefather Scarlet Flame was looking at the distant black-robed thin male with fury. That thin male's black skin and markings on his face gave Forefather Scarlet Flame a look that seemed like a smile and not a smile at the same time, "Scarlet Flame, I am here to find you again."
"What are you here for?" Forefather Scarlet Flame angrily shouted back. His heart might be anxious, but he felt that there should be no one who knew that he had the Sun Star Nucleus Stone.
"Naturally, it's for that piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone with you." Bamboo Saint let out a weird laugh, "You better obediently hand it over. Otherwise, I'll kill you and snatch it."
"You!"
Forefather Scarlet Flame was filled with disbelief, "How did you…"
"Hand over. I do not wish to waste time." Bamboo Saint indifferently declared. At this moment, he was borrowing karma to sense the positions of Xue Ying, Paragon Huo Cheng, and others. Xue Ying would spend quite some time before reaching here, and this time should be enough for him to kill Forefather Scarlet Flame ten times over. After all, he was ranked 52nd on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List and was an existence close to a Paragon. His ranking was even higher than Forefather Golden Firmament.
"Hua."
Borrowing karma, a figure condensed by the side. It was none other than a black-robed cold and handsome teenager.
"Bamboo Saint."
"Oh?" Bamboo Saint glanced at the black-robed teenager by the side. It was merely an incarnation formed using karma and did not threaten him at all. He said with a startle, "So it is Monarch Dong Bo! Is there any matter?"
"Bamboo Saint, don't you find that you are going overboard?" Xue Ying was suppressing the fury-primarily because he could not rush there in time.
"Ah, overboard? Isn't it the law of the cosmos that the strong prey on the weak?" Bamboo Saint said with sarcastic stupor.
Xue Ying could sense that this Bamboo Saint wasn't afraid of him at all. His expression had a slight change. It seemed that this Bamboo Saint did not care about giving him any face, "Bamboo Saint, this piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone has been personally lent to Forefather Scarlet Flame by me. That is my item, so why are you planning to snatch away my item?"
"Snatch your item?" Bamboo Saint sneered, "So what if I snatched your item? Monarch Dong Bo, our combat powers are similar, yet why are you acting so overbearing in front of me?"
Forefather Scarlet Flame was angrily roaring by the side, "You snatch from me once, and now you are planning to snatch from me the second time?"
"So what if I snatch from you? Who ask you to be weak?" Bamboo Saint lightly said.
Forefather Scarlet Flame was so angry that his face turned red.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, those ordinary powerful existences respected you, yet what can you be considered in front of me? You are just a little brat with some absolute arts. Just a stage four World Deity." Bamboo Saint sneered, "Alright, I am too lazy to bramble on with you. Scarlet Flame, since you are not taking the initiative to give it up, I can only send you on your way."
"Bamboo Saint, you, you…" Forefather Scarlet Flame was furious, yet he felt despair in his heart.
He was clear the gap in combat power.
He could not escape.
One on one, Bamboo Saint could kill him quickly.
"Bamboo Saint." Xue Ying said from the side, "That matter in the past which you snatched from Forefather Scarlet Flame is something which we don't care anymore. But this time, you must stop."
According to the promise.
If he were unable to patch up that array on the broken-looking scroll, by then, he would have to return this Sun Star Nucleus Stone to Ripple Star Planet Master. If someone snatched it away, how would he return it?
"Stop?" Bamboo Saint suddenly extended his hand.
The huge right hand was akin to the heaven descending. Every single finger turned into a black bamboo. The five black bamboos were emitting an endless killing intent. Forefather Scarlet Flame let out a fierce roar, turning into a dazzling deep violet streamer! This dark violet streamer was emitting a terrifying heat, burning all in its way, yet Bamboo Saint's large palm had just come to grab him. Those black bamboos were filled with firmness and coldness and had utterly suppressed this flame.
"Peng! Peng! Peng!"
The two were clashing.
No matter how Forefather Scarlet Flame struggled, he was just like a beast trapped in a cage. Every time they exchanged moves, he would be injured. Even though this flame body of his was quite good in survival, but over time, he became more injured and got closer to death.
"Hahaha…" Bamboo Saint had even glanced at Xue Ying who stood at the side.
Following which, there was an unwilling roar, "Bamboo Saint!" Forefather Scarlet Flame's true body finally died.
Bamboo Saint soon retrieved that piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone from the treasure left behind by Forefather Scarlet Flame.
"Yet another piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone?" Bamboo Saint looked at Xue Ying, laughing out loud, "Hahaha, Dong Bo Xue Ying, I've killed him. What can you do about it? Hahaha…"
The killing intent in Xue Ying's eyes flashed, "You are seeking death."
"Hua."
Xue Ying's figure dissipated.
"Angry? Oh, he is angry?" Bamboo Saint saw this before chuckling, "His combat power is comparable to mine, so what if he is angry?" He then took a step before disappearing from the place.
Leaving behind the usual Sun Star which remained emitting light and heat as always.

chapters.title: Chapter 616 - Acting for the First Time after 700,000 Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 616: Acting for the First Time after 700,000 Years
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Black Fog Sea, Monarch Dong Bo Residence.
Jing Qiu and Dong Bo Yu were both looking at Xue Ying and Forefather Scarlet Flame in confusion.
"Father, Forefather, what happened?" Dong Bo Yu could not help but ask.
"There are some minor issues." Xue Ying frowned.
Forefather Scarlet Flame was slightly anxious. He grew ashen. After a while, his entire figure became powerless. He turned to Xue Ying, saying in a low voice, "Xue Ying, this time, I am unable to protect the Sun Star Nucleus Stone. Everything is because of me. In the future, if you still have to return the Sun Star Nucleus Stone to Ripple Lady Planet Master, everything will be handled by me." Forefather Scarlet Flame said with a feeble voice.
Forefather Scarlet Flame was clear that he had no means of returning it! The Sun Star Nucleus Stone was such a precious treasure!
"I am sorry, I am sorry." Forefather Scarlet Flame said in a low tone. Rage, guilt, and anguish filled him at this moment. He was even lamenting why he had asked Xue Ying for his help! If he had not done so, then would this matter have happened? In the future, how would Xue Ying return the Sun Star Nucleus Stone if he needed to?
"This isn't related to you." Xue Ying said frigidly, "This is a matter between Bamboo Saint and me. I had declared it as my belonging, and yet he still took it away!"
"Jing Qiu, Yu'er, I'll be going out for a while." Xue Ying stated.
"Oh." Dong Bo Yu responded.
"You must be careful." Jing Qiu could guess what Xue Ying was planning to do, and had reminded him.
"Rest assured. A Bamboo Saint is someone I don't put in my eyes." Xue Ying grinned.
"Hong!"
He shot up to the sky, leaving the place.
Forefather Scarlet Flame sent Xue Ying off with his eyes. He clenched his fist as unwillingness and agony filled him. Those words of Bamboo Saint resounded in his mind-"Who asked you to be weak?""Who asked you to be weak?""Who asked you to be weak?"… it kept repeating and repeating-just like countless ants gnawing on his inner heart. This feeling of guilt to Xue Ying and hatred towards Bamboo Saint, along with various other emotions, were currently inundating his heart.
******
On a relatively distant starfield, there was an enormous ink bamboo land, within the chain of mountains, Bamboo Saint was currently caressing a black bamboo with a smile on his face. He was in a good mood, "Who would have thought that I can obtain two precious Sun Star Nucleus Stone from the body of an ordinary powerful existence, Forefather Scarlet Flame. Hahaha, this luck is truly exceptional! Hahaha, when I offer that piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone to the Religious Leader, I wonder what he will give me?"
Suddenly, the expression of Bamboo Saint changed slightly. He turned towards the distance.
His eyes could see through the distance, seeing that time-space tunnel which had just been torn apart by the Ink Bamboo Land outer starry sky. A black-robed teenager had just come walking out from that tunnel, and he was emitting a killing intent which spread across the world.
Bamboo Saint's eyes dilated. Seeing that figure, he muttered, "Dong Bo Xue Ying, he dared to come?"
He was questioning himself.
He and Xue Ying were both ranked 53rd and 52nd respectively. Their combat power was comparable! And now, he was in his territory. From how he sees, if Xue Ying truly came killing his way, it would be a waste of energy; he could not threaten Bamboo Saint at all. Even still, he thought that with the intelligence of Xue Ying, he would not come killing his way irrationally.
In reality, Xue Ying had truly come.
"Paragon Huo Cheng did not come with him." Bamboo Saint borrowed on karma to affirm that Paragon Huo Cheng whom Xue Ying was very close to had not come.
"Just him alone?" The edge of Bamboo Saint's lip sneered, "He is deluded by his rage so much that he became a fool?"
…
Walking out from the time-space tunnel, the killing intent on Xue Ying's body rushed up into the sky. His eyes were cold as he looked at this piece of land filled with black bamboo. The many black bamboos were emitting a savage and bitter aura.
"Bamboo Saint!" Xue Ying roared out. His voice borrowed upon the world energy to wrap around the entire ink bamboo land.
"Bamboo Saint!" "Bamboo Saint!" "Bamboo Saint!"…
The angry shout thundered, reverberating in every single part of the vast Ink Bamboo land, causing many subordinates under Bamboo Saint to feel shocked. All of them were trembling as this roar had a willpower integrated within that paralyzed all of them. Some of the weaker ones had turned unconscious in a moment.
"Isn't this Monarch Dong Bo? Why? Losing a piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone and he dares act rampant over my place?" A figure flashed before appearing right above the Ink Bamboo land, facing the distant Xue Ying. This figure was none other than Bamboo Saint who was wearing a black robe and had black skin, with markings on his face. Bamboo Saint's smile was genuinely vibrant, "Dong Bo Xue Ying, are you rating yourself too highly? I urge you to leave obediently. Otherwise, if we were to battle on, you would only be inviting yourself to trouble."
The fury in Xue Ying was still growing.
This cultivation for over 700,000 years…
Xue Ying thought that he had tempered his character well enough, yet this Bamboo Saint had just turned him completely upside down with anger!
He had seized the Sun Star Nucleus Stone twice before, yet he remained so arrogant. Such cultivators were the ones Xue Ying despised the most. They were the dregs of society amongst the mortals! Conducting vile acts yet they did not find it despicable. Such savageness had long seeped into their bones. It was only because the Abyss was filled with such people, and his combat power was lacking that Xue Ying did not care about it. Still, this person had come stamping on his face and peed on him. How could Xue Ying remain calm?
"Old friend." Xue Ying flipped his hand, causing a scarlet spear to appear. It was the World Deity ranked Blood Refined Deity Warrior which he had been refining-'Scarlet Cloud Spear'. Over the many long years of refining it, its power had far transcended the might of conventional World Deity grade weapons in the hands of Xue Ying. It was just a gap away from becoming a 'True God weapon'.
"It has been 700,000 years. Time for the slaughter to start again." The killing intent in Xue Ying's eyes was blazing.
He had frequently killed during his mortal days when he went to the Mountain Range of Desolation.
Xue Ying might be more profound and introverted as a person currently, he would still act when it was time to do so.
"He is genuinely planning to attack?" Bamboo Saint was alarmed the moment he saw it, "I thought by throwing some vicious words, it might threaten him into negotiating. He hasn't even spoken for two sentences and is planning to attack already?"
"Monarch Dong Bo, this is my territory, and you can't defeat me here." Bamboo Saint announced once again.
"Is that so?"
Xue Ying growled, "Then let us try."
Bamboo Saint's expression turned violent the moment he saw it. Was he genuinely planning on attacking? Then he shall likewise do so!
"My arrays have been set with the help of my elder brother. Elder brother might be ordinary amongst Paragons, and the arrays he constructed might not be able to block a Paragon, yet hindering a 'Dong Bo Xue Ying' should be fine." Bamboo Saint glared at Xue Ying with a dark look, "I've even attempted it before without succeeding in breaking this clan protection array of mine."
Xue Ying looked up at Xue Ying. He then sent the spear in his hand chopping over.
"Hong-"
During the moment the Scarlet Cloud Spear was sent, it rapidly extended and became bigger. It was akin to an enormous sky pillar that could cross over billions of kilometers in the starry sky. At the same time when the Scarlet Cloud Spear was sent out, a piece of enormous land illusion appeared surrounding it. This piece of land was boundless and was much bigger than the Ink Bamboo land beneath.
The land illusion was filled faintly with many black thin pipes, generating a terrifying suppression.
"This is!" Bamboo Saint felt his heart turning cold the moment he saw it.
"Acting for the first time after 700,000 years." The luminous sun force in Xue Ying's body was awakening at this moment. The luminous sun force unique. If it left his body, its offensive power would greatly diminish. Only by residing inside his body, and enhancing his muscles would it be able to employ a potent force! That was the characteristic of energy. Only when energy was used together with substance could it exhibit a stronger force.
Xue Ying's body, because of "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body", had become extremely powerful. In Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, his strength could directly suppress Emperor Qi Hai.
And now, his luminous sun force had reached the fourth boundary realm.
Using both luminous sun force and Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body together, they would aid each other. This combination of energy and substance boosted Xue Ying's strength far beyond that time when he was at the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain.
More importantly, the period of 700,000 years was far longer than his entire length of cultivation before the period when he was at the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain! The nine Deity hearts were all comprehended, and he no longer was any weaker to the powerful existences regarding the realm. He just lacked that last bit before understanding the complete law of the world! Even though he dared not seek extreme power in a single aspect, he was still putting all his mind into understanding the 'Profound Mysteries of the World'.
Because he had decided upon his Dao path, and Bloodshed God-Emperor had agreed with it, this made Xue Ying decide to use the profound mysteries of the world to encompass all other laws of profound mysteries in forming the law of the world.
Thus, he was similarly placing all his concentration on cultivating the 'Profound Mysteries of the World'.
Cultivating for 700,000 years.
In addition to the time spent in a time-accelerated environment, and spending a long period trying to comprehend the black feather and the broken scroll, with his comprehension ability, he had created five secret skills! And they all utilized the profound mysteries of the world. These five big moves… were all very powerful even amongst those close to the realm of Paragon. Thus, as compared to the time when he was at the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, the flaw in his realm was completely covered up.
This spear technique he was displaying currently, was none other than one of those five secret skills, the 'Black Feather Land Suppression'.

chapters.title: Chapter 617 - The Strongest Killing Move
chapters.content:
Chapter 617: The Strongest Killing Move
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
That time during the opening feast, Fifth Uncle Master had given him that black feather as a celebratory gift. Xue Ying had spent much time comprehending this, and out of the five secret skills he had grasped, he had created two from this black feather. Even though it was just a feather, its contained a colossal power within.
This move-the 'Black Feather Land Suppression'-had been displayed. During the process of slashing the spear, the strength in his body would accumulate before finally, just like a 'Land Suppression', it would all be blasted out! One could say that this was utilizing the full strength of Xue Ying, and if he met Emperor Qi Hai and the others once again, Xue Ying could most likely slap them away with one single move.
'Not good.' Bamboo Saint looked upwards, seeing that huge spear which felt like sky pillar forming a vast land illusion. The entire land illusion presented a strange feather appearance.
Bamboo Saint could feel an intense peril in his heart, 'This spear cannot be dealt with head-on.'
Sou.
He immediately descended. At the same time, a magnificent aura began emanating from the central chain of palaces on the Ink Bamboo Land. Tens of thousands of streams began flowing in all directions, encompassing and shielding the majority half of the land. His elder brother, 'Leaf Saint', was the one who constructed this array. In Bamboo Saint's opinion, other than Patrol Devil King and others at his level, nobody beneath Paragons could threaten him in his territory.
"Hong~" The Scarlet Cloud Spear which was akin to a sky pillar came crashing down regally.
Bamboo Saint looked up from within the array.
Only when he looked on from a close distance could he discern the actual illusion of the vast feather-like land illusion, and only then could he feel a greater terror striking him.
'Why would there be a feather land illusion?' Bamboo Saint thought, 'Whatever, I'll not fight him. Instead, I'll hide here under the array and borrow its power to defend against him.'
Given his arrogance, he wanted to fight back originally.
But seeing the force from this spear, that thought vanished. He chose to hide like a turtle in its shell instead! He had no choice for the spear was too powerful! It was primarily because Xue Ying's strength was dominating, and had two compatible absolute arts-"Luminous Sun" and "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body", one cultivated energy and other cultivated the physique. These two absolute arts were hard to obtain since just the "Luminous Sun" alone was filled with Yang and toughness, and was an absolute art that sought supremacy in strength.
The other absolute art cultivated the physique. However, to search for one that could reach the standards of the "Luminous Sun" was difficult. Only the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" from the Destruction Legion could match its strength.
With the two being employed collectively, it gave him a power approaching Patrol Devil King's. Besides, with his current realm reaching a higher level and after comprehending the 'Black Feather Land' technique, he was naturally able to display a power that horrifies others.
"Peng!"
The Scarlet Cloud Spear smashed against that array which was letting out tens of thousands of air streams.
Under the gigantic land illusion suppression, it caused the entire array to warp. Following which, "pa pa pa pa pa pa"! Part of the array had collapsed. Even the tens of thousands of air streams were starting to disintegrate.
'How could this be!' Bamboo Saint looked on from within the array with disbelief as the entire array had directly collapsed, 'This is Elder Brother's array, how could this be?'
But it wasn't that improbable.
The current offensive power of Xue Ying was an entire level greater as compared to when he fought with three other powerful existences on the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain. It was also because he had cultivated for 700,000 years without displaying his strength that Primal Master did not change his ranking. One could say that this powerful technique which he just exhibited… though it might be slightly weaker than Patrol Devil King's strength, it should be at least 80% of his power.
Regardless whether it was Xue Ying or Patrol Devil King, both of them could match against ordinary Paragons with their offensive power!
With this technique, it would naturally break the array.
"Die for me." After Xue Ying broke the array with his spear, the power of his spear technique drastically reduced. Bamboo Saint waved a red pole and easily parried against this spear.
But Xue Ying just kept and hacked the spear down again with the same move!
The spear was immense, and the Black Feather Land illusion appeared once again.
'He strikes again?' Bamboo Saint was scared and infuriated. He did not have the slightest thought of meeting head-on against this, 'Dong Bo Xue Ying should be ranked close to the legendary Patrol Devil King with this frightening technique of his, yet why is he still ranked 52nd?'
"Hua."
Bamboo Saint's body turned into an illusion as he escaped. The red pole in his hand grew explosively. At the same time, many branches appeared around the pole. The entire pole had seemingly become a gigantic red bamboo. When Xue Ying hacked down his spear, for a moment, it besieged the many branch leaves and distorted them.
'I can't block this. His dominance in power over me is too huge! I'll only be swept away by him completely.' Bamboo Saint's expression changed considerably, 'I have to escape. Otherwise, it'll be the end for me.'
Just like when he was at the Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain, Xue Ying might have the upper hand regarding strength when fighting against Emperor Qi Hai, though firstly, the difference was not that great and secondly, Xue Ying's techniques were too crude. Others could completely evade his move and target his flaws.
But it was no longer the same now.
Xue Ying's spear technique was straightforward, yet the other party could not easily break it, or so at least the cunning Bamboo Saint could not do so.
"I can't break it. But you can't prevent me from escaping." Bamboo Saint was full of confidence as he flew away at high speed.
"Wanting to escape?"
Bamboo Saint looked on stupefied.
Nine figures appeared right in front of him-they were all 'Xue Ying' in deep blue robes.
"World Bodies?" Bamboo Saint frowned, "Are you thinking of stopping me without your Blood Refined Deity Warrior?"
"I can likewise overpower you even without my Blood Refined Deity Warrior." The nine deep-blue-robed 'Xue Ying's acted at the same time.
Furthermore, at the same time-
A tremendous luminous sun force appeared in the vast surrounding space. Under the revolving luminous sun force, the surrounding scene had changed! Bamboo Saint looked around him with shock. It was initially his Ink Bamboo Land, yet now he could only see that he was in a sealed world. This sealed world had parts collapsing and were severely damaged, turning into a grayish fog.
The grayish fog pervaded the place and enveloped Bamboo Saint.
Bamboo Saint suddenly felt himself entering a swamp, and even moving was taxing for him.
'Domain?' Bamboo Saint had a tremendous shock in his heart. This Xue Ying wasn't just stronger physically as stated in the reports. Did he not excel in other aspects too? That technique he displayed previously could be managed, yet this domain he displayed was horrifying.
Xue Ying slightly nodded at seeing this.
