These few years, he had been researching in that broken array scroll given by Ripple Lady Planet Master and had once attempted to set up that array. The profound mysteries within the array had reached a deep and profound stage. Xue Ying had researched it for many years before finally crafting this secret skill. It was also one of his five great secret skills under the world aspect-'Sky Dome Fog Prison'.
'I can't escape.' Bamboo Saint was trapped in this broken-looking world. After being enveloped by that fog, he knew he could no longer escape, 'But my Ink Bamboo Body is solid. It isn't easy for him to kill me. This body should be able to withstand for a period.'
"Big brother, big brother, quickly come and save me." Bamboo Saint was requesting for help.
Despite asking for help, he was quite confident in surviving. One could see his body transforming. The bones and muscles in his body turned into that of black bamboo. Even his face had changed into a black bamboo. His voice became piercing, "Dong Bo Xue Ying, who would have thought that your combat power had become so much stronger after 700,000 years! But wanting to kill me isn't something easily done."
'Two Saints Ink Clan's Leaf Saint?' Xue Ying who was holding on to the Scarlet Cloud Spear afar used karma to sense that Leaf Saint had already set off. But he still required some period before reaching.
'This is long enough to kill him.'
'Dying in front of my strongest move is too easy for him.' Coldness filled Xue Ying's eyes. He took out the flying knife from his waist.
Flying Knife, True God weapon.
The shaft of the knife was dark, and the blade itself was a glittering silvery white.

chapters.title: Chapter 618 - Begging for Forgiveness
chapters.content:
Chapter 618: Begging for Forgiveness
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within the Time-space tunnel, a green-robed black skinned man flew forward swiftly. There were markings drawn on his face and two horns on his forehead. He was one of the two from Two Saints Ink Clan, 'Leaf Saint'.
"Big brother, quick! He is completely suppressing me and has even used a domain to bind me. I cannot flee at all." Bamboo Saint anxiously cried out for help.
"Hold on! I'm rushing over as fast as I can." Leaf Saint transmitted back.
Leaf Saint was still calm and unperturbed.
Both of them were clanmates and close like brothers. He knew of Bamboo Saint's strength. To kill him in a short period without being a Paragon at least… was too hard to do so! Sometimes it would even be difficult to attack his true body! Countless leaves and branches surrounded and protected him layer after layer. Suppressing him might be easy, but touching his body was difficult, and killing him even much so. His body was the Ink Bamboo Body which could rapidly recover from injuries.
…
In the skies of the Ink Bamboo Great Lands, there was a sealed and somewhat damaged Eden world-the 'Sky Dome Fog Prison' formed by Xue Ying.
Within the Sky Dome Fog Prison.
Nine World Avatars surrounded Bamboo Saint. Bamboo Saint held a long red pole in his hand that was 5,000 meters long and had many bamboo leaves and branches on top of it. Those bamboo leaves and branches were used to display pole techniques, and countless streams of black air streams circled the surroundings to defend him. The nine World Avatars used normal weapons, and could barely suppress the bamboo pole to strike Bamboo Saint. Bamboo Saint's entire body was ink black. Occasionally, he would be struck, but those injuries would be restored in the next instant.
'Although I cannot escape, the defense of my weapon parries against more than half the incoming strikes, and my body can directly block the other remaining half.' Bamboo Saint thought, 'Furthermore, my body is more suited to resist the style of pure power!'
Despite comforting himself, Bamboo Saint was still speechless! The one attacking him was a World Avatar that did not use a Blood Refined Deity Warrior, yet he could still wound his Ink Bamboo Body. If Xue Ying's actual body made a move… he would suffer from heavier injuries!
Therefore Bamboo Saint remained alert of where Xue Ying's true body was in the distance.
'What happened?' Bamboo Saint discovered that Xue Ying's True Body was suddenly completely isolated from all senses, and a gray fog blocked the sight of his naked eyes.
Although he felt suspicious, Bamboo Saint still brandished his long red pole, forming many branches and leaves to form an air-tight defense around him.
Nine spears majestically swung towards him again and again, suppressing the Bamboo Saint.
Suddenly-
"Xiu."
Xue Ying who stood in the distance coldly looked at Bamboo Saint. The other party could not see him, but he could see him with his domain! The flying blade that he held in his hand was flung! In an instant, it disappeared.
The Flying Blade had disappeared entirely!
It vanished in the time-space continuum. It also was gone from the real world. Average powerful existences would not be able to find this flying blade.
It was a True God Weapon!
The flying blade was meant for assassination. It had two Daos within-'Dao of Mirage' and 'Dao of Slaughter'. One could imagine how dangerous an assassin would be if he grasped these two Daos and refined the True God Weapon. The 'Dao of Mirage' was already above the laws of the world, and average powerful existences who had only grasped the laws of the world naturally could not find this flying blade.
In Fact-
This flying blade was flying through an ordinary realm that was on another level. If the ordinary realm were the first floor of a tower, then where the flying blade flew would be the second! Therefore those that lived on the first floor would never be able to touch the second floor!
According to logic, the Mirage was a reflection of the true world.
The True World, Mirage, Shadow World, and gaps between the worlds together constituted an entire world.
The 'Dao of Mirage' had already exceeded the complete world. It had created another bigger 'Mirage World' on top of this complete world. Although the Mirage World was not perfect, it was placed above the real world. If the 'Mirage World' were truly perfected to the eternal stage, one would breakthrough to become a Ruler, and his techniques would be even more unfathomable.
Xue Ying was only a stage four World Deity, and it was reasonable to say that he could not use such unfathomable techniques. Nevertheless, with the help of the 'True God Weapon', he could do so.
The True God Weapon was extraordinary. But merely refining it would be very difficult, and Xue Ying had spent a long time doing so. 700,00 years of cultivation allowed him to comprehend more of the 'Dao of Mirage' and 'Dao of Slaughter', allowing him to display a greater power of the flying blade.
"Hu."
This Flying Blade flew and reached the Bamboo Saint soon enough.
Following that.
"Hua."
It entered the real world from the Mirage. Bamboo Saint who could not detect it initially, had a change in expression the next moment. He looked down towards his chest only to see the flying blade appearing right in his body.
"Hong!"
That flying blade was the one flung out by Xue Ying.
With Xue Ying's terrifying strength, and the sudden explosive force exerted as the blade entered the real world imbued with the 'Dao of Slaughter', Xue Ying had created an even more dangerous killing move after comprehending it for many years. He called it the 'Floating Blood Blade's Tip' and was also one of his five great world secret skills.
At this moment, the tip of the blade was thrust into Bamboo Saint's body. It felt like time had stopped to him.
"No." Bamboo Saint felt fear, yet had no way out.
"Peng!"
Bamboo Saint's entire body exploded.
It was much stronger as compared to an attack by Xue Ying with his Blood Refined Deity Weapon. The True God Weapon flying blade's killing move, evoked the profound mysteries of the 'Dao of Slaughter'! Paired with Xue Ying's terrifying strength and a weapon that directly burst out from within his body, it could not be blocked… Even if Bamboo Saint's body were more robust, it would still be shattered…
Although his body had shattered, the many particles were rapidly combining.
"You wish to recover?" Xue Ying coldly smiled, "How could I give you this chance."
"Hong Hong Hong Hong Hong Hong!"
At present no one was controlling that red bamboo pole. With no obstructions, the nine World Avatars used their spears to strike rampantly at Bamboo Saint's body, crushing them into fine particles once again and preventing him from recovering.
Once a sturdy cultivator's body was crushed, it was practically guaranteed that they would die since the enemy could attack unceasingly and wear down his energy. Those at the level of Xue Ying would never make such low-level errors to give Bamboo Saint an opportunity to fuse back his complete body! Without being to do so, it was almost impossible for him to make a comeback.
"Dong bo Xue Ying, I admit defeat." Besides him, an avatar was condensed in midair-the avatar of Bamboo Saint. He added, "Please spare me! Please!"
Although he was somewhat dazed with his loss, he did not hesitate to concede and beg for mercy.
"Hmph."
Xue Ying did not stop at all-the nine World Avatars continued to attack violently, continuously wearing down the energy Bamboo Saint had.
"I'm willing to return that Sun Star Nucleus Stone." Bamboo Saint loudly yelled.
"Just one? Let alone one stone, even if you returned two stones, it's still too late." Xue Ying coldly said. At the same time, his flying blade silently returned to his sheath.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, don't bully others!" Bamboo Saint raged.
He went out on missions with his avatar.
The one left in his lair was his true body! He had believed that it was safe. Thus, the countless years of treasures accumulated, and some of his collection was kept on his true body. Once his true body was killed, then his losses…
"Bully?" You know about what bullying is?" Xue Ying coldly smiled.
"You, you…" Bamboo Saint was anxious, "Don't be too excessive!"
"Excessive?" There was a cold glint in Xue Ying's eyes, "Who asked you to be weak?"
Bamboo Saint was stunned.
Not too long ago, he had once said this to Forefather Scarlet Flame.

chapters.title: Chapter 619 - Full of Confidence
chapters.content:
Chapter 619: Full of Confidence
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The first time when he killed Forefather Scarlet Flame and snatched away the Sun Star Nucleus Stone, Forefather Scarlet Flame was angry but not in despair. The second time he did it again, Forefather Scarlet Flame had become deranged. He was feeling guilty at the same time- guilt towards Xue Ying.
And now.
Bamboo Saint was experiencing that humiliating feeling for the first time of being called 'who asked you to be weak'.
But even if it was humiliating, his true body could not die for it had many treasures which must not land in the hands of Xue Ying.
'Amongst which, there is even a treasure related to the religious leader. Maybe Dong Bo Xue Ying might not recognize it, but the moment he did…' Bamboo Saint felt anxious, 'I'll be revealed, and that's doom's day for me.'
He could not reveal any traces related to the Religious Leader.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, Monarch Dong Bo." Bamboo Saint felt that the True God Energy in his true body was diminishing. The voice of the illusory incarnation screeched, "Spare me please, let us talk things through!"
"Is that so?" Xue Ying glanced at him.
"Right right right, everything can be discussed further. Anything can solved with words." Bamboo Saint anxiously turned towards the nine world bodies afar, "Why aren't you stopping?"
Stopping?
Xue Ying was sneering in his heart.
Bamboo Saint had acted twice against Forefather Scarlet Flame, and he wasn't even killing both the true body and avatars of Bamboo Saint unless he had even to spare this body of his?
On another aspect.
The true body which stayed in the territory should most likely carry some important treasures. Now that Bamboo Saint was earnestly begging for forgiveness, Xue Ying was all the more assured, 'There must be some essential treasures with him. Otherwise, he should not be so reluctant to die as an avatar since he could always form another easily.'
'Kill him, and take away the treasures. By then, only will I have the qualifications to negotiate further!'
'If I spare him, the moment his Elder Brother Leaf Saint comes and save him, he would most likely betray me.' Xue Ying was very clear about this point.
Thus, the nine world bodies did not stop at all.
Xue Ying could sense the speed which 'Leaf Saint' was rushing here using karma.
'He'll likely take five breaths of time before reaching.' Xue Ying looked towards the finely powdered form of the many ink bamboo. Those fine powder were trying to fuse together, and the life energy was intense, 'He can't withstand a breath of time.'
"Stop, quickly stop." Bamboo Saint shouted. His eyes were red, "You truly want to get into a conflict with me? Dong Bo Xue Ying, you have children too!"
"My children are both stage two World Deities now." Xue Ying indifferently answered.
Even still, Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao, and Jing Qiu all had an avatar in the Xia clan world.
"Then what about your countless grandchildren?" Bamboo Saint was turning mad.
"Just destroying a body of yours and you are turning crazy?" Xue Ying sneered, "Then do so. If you dare kill my descendants, I, Dong Bo Xue Ying, swear that I'll extinguish both your true body and avatar! After that, I'll reincarnate those grandchildren of mine from the River of Time."
Bamboo Saint was stunned.
This Xue Ying had a good relationship with many apex Paragons. His teacher was also the Bloodshed God Emperor. Furthermore, he was strong too. That declaration of his had been filled with confidence.
"You, you…" Bamboo Saint was turning crazy. This Xue Ying wasn't afraid of threats, and neither was he fearful of entering conflict because he was thinking of taking back the treasures too.
"Can you stop first and let us talk?" Bamboo Saint's voice was becoming softer and softer, yet anxiety of disbelief was still within his eyes.
Xue Ying glanced at him, "Have you forgotten how you treated I and Scarlet Flame?"
The moment he finished speaking.
Bamboo Saint looked towards those fine powder in despair. Those fine powder had finally dissipated powerlessly, turning into nothingness and leaving behind only the Cultivation Eden, the storage treasures, and the weapons.
"Hu." Xue Ying took a step before arriving there. Waving his hand, he kept all of them.
'It's in his hands. The handle is in his hands.' Bamboo Saint felt his heart trembling.
…
Leaf Saint who was currently rushing through the time-space tunnel, turned stunned.
'Dead?' Bamboo Saint frowned.
"Big Brother, you must kill Dong Bo Xue Ying. After killing you, take back all my treasures. The treasure which I accumulated for many years has been taken away by him. Big Brother, you must help me." Bamboo Saint transmitted a message over.
"But Paragon Huo Cheng has set off. His speed of travel is much faster than me." Leaf Saint transmitted back.
Indeed.
Paragon Huo Cheng was currently rushing over.
"Big brother, you must take it back with all your strength." Bamboo Saint was anxious.
Negotiate?
During the negotiation, would Xue Ying thoroughly inspect every single treasure? If it was revealed, nobody could protect him at all!
Thus, the best method was to let his big brother Leaf Saint kill Xue Ying before taking back the treasure.
"I'll try my best." Leaf Saint transmitted back. He was only worried about the lack of time, yet he was confident of dealing with Xue Ying.
Leaf Saint's intelligence was ultimately lacking by a bit.
He had not heard of the Destruction Legion, and neither did he know that Xue Ying was part of the Destruction Legion. He thought he had the certainty of dealing with Xue Ying despite being a Paragon.
******
Xue Ying was above the Ink Bamboo Great Land.
He could sense Leaf Saint and Paragon Huo Cheng both getting closer.
"Big brother, I'll have to trouble you for this." Xue Ying transmitted over.
"Why did you not inform me earlier?" Paragon Huo Cheng answered, "And you still treat me as your brother?"
Xue Ying transmitted back, "If not for Leaf Saint coming out, there's naturally no need to trouble big brother. Who would have thought that this Bamboo Saint has just lost a body, yet he asked Leaf Saint to act? But… I'm not afraid of this Leaf Saint since he only has the power of an ordinary Paragon. Naturally, with big brother helping me to suppress him, I'll be even more confident."
He then took a step.
Hua.
Xue Ying then tore through a time-space tunnel before flying towards Paragon Huo Cheng. The most important task he had was to take back the Sun Star Nucleus Stone. He temporarily did not have the idea of fighting with Leaf Saint.
'Escape?' Leaf Saint who was currently rushing over felt his headache.
If Xue Ying remained at his original position, he naturally could reach as soon as possible with enough time for dealing with Xue Ying.
But now, Xue Ying was moving towards Paragon Huo Cheng to meet him.
'I must reach him in time.' Leaf Saint was hurrying his way. Time was too tight, and the speed of Paragon Huo Cheng was faster than his by six times. But still, Paragon Huo Cheng had come from another side of the Deity world, so the journey was far.
Chase!
Chase!
Chase!
Leaf Saint, for the sake of his clan brother, was traveling with all his might.
Xue Ying was also doing his best to meet with Paragon Huo Cheng.
"Leaf Saint, stop." Paragon Huo Cheng transmitted over via karma, "Why, are you seeking death?"
"A little more." Leaf Saint did not care.
If Monarch Green said that, he would immediately surrender obediently.
But Paragon Huo Cheng? He specialized in the Dao of flame, and Leaf Saint specialized in survival. Thus, he was still confident of surviving in front of him.
'I've reached him.'
Within the colorful streaming time-space tunnel, Leaf Saint saw Xue Ying who was in front of him.
"Die." A unique-looking branch trident appeared in the hands of Leaf Saint. The branch trident had many leaves too-a total of seven such leaves. It was a piece of True God weapon, and that time, he had opened his Dao path via this True God weapon. At this moment, he was exerting his full strength the moment he acted, displaying the offensive power of the True God weapon.
"Hmph." Xue Ying knew he could not escape. He stopped. The surrounding world was booming as it transformed. Boundless luminous sun force directly formed a desolate world. This desolate world was currently crumbling apart, and a grayish fog pervaded through the place, enveloping Leaf Saint.
Nine world bodies appeared at the same time.
Xue Ying had even waved the Scarlet Cloud Spear in his hand.
"Hong~"
The Scarlet Cloud Spear and the other nine spears came out at the same time to directly suppress Leaf Saint.
Leaf Saint had lightly waved a section of the leaves on the branch trident, lashing against the Scarlet Cloud Spear. The Scarlet Cloud Spear's terrifying strength was reducing continuously at the same time. Still, it was able to change the expression of Leaf Saint as he could not help but take three steps back on the void. At this moment, the two had already left the time-space tunnel, arriving in the real world. The battle had caused some of the remote planets surrounding them to turn into nothingness.
"Such formidable strength." Leaf Saint was startled.
Xue Ying might be strong, but when that branch trident leaf lashed out against the Scarlet Cloud Spear, there was a strange power transmitting over which the weapon could not dissipate away.
But as it reached the surface of the black armor, the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious body armor had rapidly obstructed this mystical force. Finally, it left only a slight strand which could not threaten the tyrannical body of Xue Ying.
"What?" Leaf Saint had been watching all movements of Xue Ying from afar. He was clear about his move. Despite specializing in survival, he had still opened a Dao path, and towards those beneath Paragon realm, he should have an easy time dealing against them.
'Why is there no movement at all? It has been withstood just like that?' Leaf Saint was startled, 'His body is so resistant?'
How would he know?
That amongst the apex Paragons, White Sovereign King who was known for his slaughter, could only damage this armor with a single hit. If he knew of this point, he would not be shocked at all.
'Paragon Huo Cheng is reaching. I don't have time. Since I can't kill him directly, I'll imprison him and keep him in my Cultivation Eden.' Leaf Saint immediately changed his style of battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 620 - Just dream on!
chapters.content:
Chapter 620: Just dream on!
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Leaf Saint held onto the bamboo branch leaf, lightly hurling it.
"Hua~" The bamboo branch leaves rapidly extended outwards, causing Xue Ying's expression to change slightly. The many bamboo leaves had surrounded the world! The bamboo leaves had formed a prison with a diameter of a few hundred billion kilometers, trapping Xue Ying entirely within.
'Not good.' Xue Ying was inwardly startled, 'My world energy has been entirely isolated.'
By isolating the world energy, he would not be able to switch positions with his world bodies.
'Let him receive a blade by me then.' Xue Ying rapidly pulled out the flying knife by his waist. The flying knife seemed ordinary, but during the moment he held onto the handle and activated the internal power, Xue Ying could sense the 'Mirage World'. That was the 'Mirage World' that surpassed the law of the world. Borrowing upon the Mirage World, he naturally could sense Leaf Saint who had been outside of the encirclement by the many bamboo branch leaves.
Fixing on the position of Leaf Saint!
'Go.' Xue Ying hurled out the flying knife in his hand with all his strength. The combination of luminous sun force and Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body strength in his body had entirely been transmitted into the flying knife, causing the flying knife to travel at a terrifying penetrative speed in the Mirage World.
But in reality, it could not be seen.
…
"Just give up and be captured." Leaf Saint operated the large prison which had been formed by the many bamboo branch leaves using his True God weapon, causing it to turn smaller and smaller. Any Paragons could not be belittled even if they were ordinary ones! After all, they had opened a Dao, and dealing with those powerful existences close to the Paragon realm was quite easy for them.
For an ordinary True God or stage four World Deity to fight against them, they had to be strong enough and own a True God weapon! That's because the True God weapon had an effect of surpassing the law of the world.
Having a robust combat power… in addition to borrowing the power of the True God weapon would allow one to threaten a Paragon.
"Chi chi chi~" Countless bamboo branch leaves were rapidly becoming smaller.
"Hong hong hong~" Within the prison, the nine world bodies were displaying their spear techniques, using a heaven-shattering power to bombard against those bamboo branch leaves, causing the speed of prison shrinking to be slightly slower.
'He has such a huge strength. I must be faster!.' Leaf Saint was sensing the position of Paragon Huo Cheng all the while, and using all his strength to reduce the size of the prison.
Suddenly-
Leaf Saint's expression changed.
He could vaguely sense a savage and terrifying power coming from another location towards him.
"True God weapon!" Leaf Saint immediately understood that.
The Dao of Mirage was similar to Bloodshed God Emperor's 'Dao of Shadow'-both were good for assassination.
It's just that Xue Ying had yet to open the Dao of Mirage, and thus, he could only rely on the True God weapon to create such an effect. Thus, when attacking, he could not entirely conceal his method, and Leaf Saint was able to sense it during the last moment! If he had grasped the entire Dao of Mirage, the flying knife would most likely land on him before he could discover it.
But just sensing it a little earlier had a limited aid for him either way since the Flying Knife had come too suddenly from the Mirage!
'Not good.' Leaf Saint was rapidly moving. At the same time, he waved his left palm, causing many leaves to form around him.
Hong!
The flying knife suddenly appeared in the real world from the Mirage. Even though Leaf Saint had rapidly moved, the appearance of the Flying Knife was already just one meter away to his left! Even though Leaf Saint tried to wave his palm, but at such an ultra close distance… and the usage of Xue Ying's entire strength, alongside the activation of the 'Dao of Slaughter', the flying knife had already pierced into his body after just a slight movement of Leaf Saint's palm.
"Peng!" His entire body exploded. The body of Paragons was not always stronger than the body of True Gods.
"Success." Xue Ying revealed a grin.
The moment Leaf Saint's body exploded, the True God weapon lost its controller, thus, causing many bamboo-branch leaves to dissipate and reveal that single bamboo branch.
But soon, this True God weapon disappeared.
At the same time, seven figures appeared.
These seven figures were all Leaf Saints as they looked at Xue Ying with an ugly expression.
"Leaf Saint, just a little bit more." Xue Ying chuckled. At this moment, tearing through the time-space tunnel from another side of the starry sky, a mad figure bathed in flames came walking out. He had messy red hair, red brows, and red skin. His entire body was currently emitting a terrifying burning aura. His eyes landed on the body of Leaf Saint, saying with a grand voice, "Leaf Saint, you are truly daring."
The seven Leaf Saints turned back into one.
Leaf Saint looked at Xue Ying. He was a Paragon, yet even with his full strength, he was unable to capture Xue Ying and had his body assaulted by that flying knife of his.
'Such a sinister True God weapon.' Leaf Saint thought, 'A True God weapon containing two sorts of Dao?'
He had personally tasted it. That's why he was clear how terrifying that Flying Knife was.
If it merely had the Dao of Mirage within, then the Flying Knife would only be unpredictable at the most, and its offensive power would not reach such exaggerated stage. But adding the 'Dao of Slaughter' along with Xue Ying's terrifying strength, that was genuinely sinister and savage.
"Hua."
The Flying Knife returned to the sheath soundlessly. Xue Ying was delighted. He had not thought of genuinely killing the other party since Leaf Saint was known for his ability to survive. Even Paragon Huo Cheng would have a hard time trying to kill him, and for Xue Ying to destroy his body once was already very unusual. Also if he could not suppress his body, the Flying Knife alone was enough to delay for a period.
"Admirable, admirable." Leaf Saint laughed as he stood in the starry sky, "Monarch Dong Bo's combat power is indeed amazing. 700,000 years ago, Monarch was just ranked 52nd on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List with a power equivalent to that of my brother. Who would have thought that you could easily destroy my brother's body located in his territory, and even easily survive in front of me."
"My Brother Dong Bo is amazing, and there's no need for you to flatter about it." Paragon Huo Cheng coldly stated.
Leaf Saint's eyelids were twitching.
Flatter?
He was a Paragon and was there a need to flatter about a stage four World Deity? Was it not because of the madness Paragon Huo Cheng was currently in that he tried to smoothen the current atmosphere?
"I just said for you to stop! You remained unforgiving. Fortunately, Brother Dong Bo's combat power is formidable enough. Otherwise, he would have been captured by you. By then, you will be acting differently in front of me." Paragon Huo Cheng was furious. Actually, he belittled this Leaf Saint. He was only strong regarding his survival capabilities and was considered the padding amongst Paragons in terms of true slaughter combat capabilities.
But precisely because he could not be killed quickly, that's why Leaf Saint dared to challenge him!
"Hahaha, Being unable to capture Monarch Dong Bo meant that my combat power is lacking. Such a shame." Leaf Saint did not feel angry at all, "Since both sides can't deal with each other, then how about we negotiate and end this matter, how about it?"
"End this matter? How are you planning on ending this matter?" Paragon Huo Cheng coldly said.
Xue Ying was looking by the side of Paragon Huo Cheng.
Leaf Saint said, "My brother Bamboo Saint has accumulated quite a few precious treasures after a long period, and it isn't easy for him. Some were important for him, and it might not be that useful for Monarch Dong Bo. Thus, I hope for those treasures of his to be returned! Naturally… that piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone will be returned to Monarch Dong Bo too."
"Dream on!" Xue Ying could not help but shout back.
Leaf Saint was startled as he turned at Xue Ying.
He actually…
He actually dared to…
Xue Ying looked at Leaf Saint coldly. He honestly did not place this Paragon who was only good at survival in his eyes. In front of direct combat, Xue Ying did not fear him! Even under the attack by the bamboo leaves prison, he had merely used the nine world bodies previously to deal with them. Xue Ying had not used his true body to resist, and more importantly, he had yet to use the five great secret skills and other techniques of his.
With such weak offensive capabilities, and Leaf Saint could not even suppress him with strength, so why would Xue Ying be afraid of him?
"Monarch Dong Bo, what do you mean?" Leaf saint said in a low voice.
"You can forget about taking back Bamboo Saint's treasures." Xue Ying coldly retorted, "As for the Sun Star Nucleus Stone, you better return both of them, and we will end this matter here! Otherwise… forget about resolving this!"

chapters.title: Chapter 621 - All Gone?
chapters.content:
Chapter 621: All Gone?
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Leaf Saint's eyebrows jumped the moment he heard that. He also gave Xue Ying a cold and satirical look, "Dong Bo Xue Ying, I am negotiating peacefully with you because of Paragon Huo Cheng. You better not be so overbearing, if Paragon Huo Cheng isn't around… do you think I'll just let things go like this?"
"So what if you don't let things go?" Xue Ying retorted, "Do you think you can deal with me?"
Leaf Saint felt frustrated inwardly.
That's right.
Even though they fought for a short period, the terrifying flying knife had caused Leaf Saint to feel fear since he knew he could not dodge that Flying Knife!
Being a Paragon, he naturally had a demeaning outlook towards those stage four World Deity who had a limited lifespan and had yet to transcend! But speaking from a rational point of view… the heaven-shattering Xue Ying was someone he genuinely could not capture.
"Leaf Saint, I am indeed just a stage four World Deity, but if I do not care about paying the price, it isn't hard for you to die." Xue Ying coldly said, "I can't kill you, but there are many behind my back who could kill you. It is just that I am not too willing to pay a huge price."
He was not lying.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master owed him a huge favor! Paragon Huo Cheng was his life and death brother. More importantly, his teacher, 'Bloodshed God Emperor', wanted to repay him for the matter on the ancient cavern. If Xue Ying did not wish for any treasures, asking Bloodshed God Emperor to deal with an ordinary Paragon was something easily done.
It's just that it would be a waste to use the promise of Bloodshed God Emperor on Leaf Saint!
The eyes of Leaf Saint dilated, 'Behind his back? Monarch Green? I've heard that during his opening feast, Monarch Green had personally attended it. Bloodshed God Emperor also attaches huge importance on this personal disciple of his.'
…
The weak was food for the strong amongst cultivators.
Once Leaf Saint felt the personal threat brought by Xue Ying, he suppressed the demeaning outlook he had towards this stage four World Deity: 'This Dong Bo Xue Ying is after all the one to become a stage three World Deity in the shortest period. He is a stage four World Deity who can create a new record. I must not belittle him.'
"Haha, I said before that Monarch Dong Bo is very formidable that I can't even deal with." Saint Leaf chuckled. Though his expression slightly dimmed as he spoke, "But don't you find that for you not to pay anything and still want to take back the two Sun Star Nucleus Stone is kind of overboard?"
"Overboard?"
Xue Ying shook his head, "We can sort out this entire matter right to its origin. It is your clan brother Bamboo Saint who attacked Forefather Scarlet Flame twice before this, taking away two Sun Star Nucleus Stone from him! Of the two stones, one belongs to me. I lent it to Scarlet Flame, and at that time, I have descended using karma to warn Bamboo Saint that he should stop. If he had stopped then, we might be able to let the bygones be bygones."
"But it's a pity that Bamboo Saint looked down upon me and Scarlet Flame. He disregarded my words and took the stone away."
"Being so rampant to snatch things away from other people time after time, naturally, I want him to experience the feeling of someone taking his things away." Xue Ying coldly said, "Those two Sun Star Nucleus Stones are ours originally, and it is only natural for us to take them back. As for his precious belongings, that can be his punishment for conducting such despicable acts."
Leaf Saint could not help but try justifying after hearing that.
"Enough."
Paragon Huo Cheng who was standing by the side of Xue Ying, angrily shouted as he glanced towards Leaf Saint, "Leaf Saint, I once ordered you to stop, yet you did not. Even though I am here personally, you aren't apologizing to me. Hmph, why do I feel that you, Leaf Saint, is not placing me in your eyes?"
"How would I dare to?" Leaf Saint retorted. A bad-tempered Paragon Huo Cheng was not someone to be offended.
"Are there even things you dare not do? Your guts are truly huge."
Paragon Huo Cheng coldly said, "We do not have to discuss this matter any further. The two Sun Star Nucleus Stones belonged to us originally, so you better return them! And Leaf Saint's lowly belongings… precisely because he had been ignorant and egotistical, we can consider them as an apology for offending I and Dong Bo Xue Ying. I believe this isn't going overboard, am I right?"
Leaf Saint hesitated.
"Offend me, and I'll destroy your territory and pursue you all the way." Paragon Huo Cheng sneered, "I'll even ask one or two good friends of mine to surround you and kill you."
Leaf Saint gave an awkward laughter after seeing things heading this way, "Things can be discussed with words."
He had lived for such a long period in the Deity world and Abyss, and naturally, it was not easy for someone to kill him. His true body and avatars were always separated, and he had many good friends. During crucial moments, he could even decide to rely on a Ruler.
But, there was no reason for him to get into a conflict with Paragon Huo Cheng.
The moment they became enemies, the future would become bleak for him.
******
In another location.
On a planet, many huge starry sky arrays were surrounding it. On each array, many divine sword illusions were moving.
This planet had several buildings.
It was here where 'Leaf Saint' cultivated at.
"Big Brother." Bamboo Saint was garbed in black as he said, "You must get my precious belongings back."
"I can't take them back anymore."
Standing on the peak of the mountain, overlooking the plains, the golden-robed Leaf Saint said, "This Dong Bo Xue Ying's combat power has far exceeded my expectations. I can't capture him, and Paragon Huo Cheng has threatened me, asking you to return those two Sun Star Nucleus Stones. Otherwise… they will soon kill their way over, destroying this place and chase after you and me."
Bamboo Saint was stunned.
So tyrannical?
"Hand them over." Leaf Saint sighed, "Don't fight with them. It isn't good to offend this Dong Bo Xue Ying."
"Hand them over?" Bamboo Saint felt his heart turn bitter.
How could he hand over the stones?
That year, he had already offered the Sun Star Nucleus Stone to the Religious Leader! Now, he only had a piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone with him. Furthermore, he must take back those precious belongings of his; else he would be doomed if they were revealed.
"No other ways." Bamboo Saint thoroughly set his resolve.
"Big brother." Bamboo Saint said, "I only have a piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone with me. As for the other, I have long traded it with other powerful existences for treasures."
"No more?" Leaf Saint looked at him.
"Mn, truly no more." Bamboo Saint added.
"Then who did you exchange the treasure with?" Leaf Saint asked.
"I have promised before not to disclose it." Bamboo Saint added.
"They will not believe me if I say. You can tell them yourself. " Leaf Saint replied.
…
In the starry sky.
Xue Ying and Paragon Huo Cheng were both standing side by side in the starry sky. They were currently facing Leaf Saint and an illusion which was gradually condensing by his side. It was the incarnation of Bamboo Saint.
"Monarch Dong Bo, Paragon Huo Cheng." Bamboo Saint accompanied in laughter. At the same time, he said with a high voice, "Let the Bloodshed God-Emperor be the witness, that I, Bamboo Saint, has long exchanged the first piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone which I took from Forefather Scarlet Flame. I genuinely only have a single piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone with me. Even after killing me, it is impossible for me to take out the second piece."
Xue Ying and Paragon Huo Cheng were both stunned after hearing this.
Exchanged it away?
"Who did you exchange it with?" Xue Ying asked.
"The other party is afraid of revealing himself, and I have long promised not to disclose his identity." Bamboo Saint helplessly said.
Xue Ying and Paragon Huo Cheng exchanged glances.
Since he had already let his teacher, Bloodshed God-Emperor, be the person of witness and set down an oath, it should not be fake. Did he exchange it with other powerful existences already? Most likely, the other party was afraid of inviting trouble, and had asked to keep his identity a secret?
"You took away two Sun Star Nucleus Stones, and you want to return a piece just like that?" Paragon Huo Cheng angrily roared.
"I don't dare, I don't dare, I desire to return even more, but my belongings are with Monarch Dong Bo." Bamboo Saint said bitterly.
Paragon Huo Cheng turned to Leaf Saint, "If he can't afford it, you do it!"
Leaf Saint felt his head aching.
Xue Ying was standing by the side. To 'bleed' the Two Saints Ink Clan was something Xue Ying felt delighted to do so. After all, if his combat power was slightly weaker, and if Leaf Saint captured him, the whole situation would be entirely different.
Since both parties had negotiated to this stage, it would be easy after that.
Leaf Saint handed out several treasures. Bamboo Saint also gave up the Sun Star Nucleus Stone, and both parties had decided to end this matter.
"Big Brother Huo Cheng, let us leave."
"Go."
Xue Ying and Paragon Huo Cheng both tore apart the time-space tunnel before leaving.
Leaf Saint and Bamboo Saint were both helpless.
They rarely suffered from losses, but this time, they had got the worst of it.
…
And in Leaf Saint's territory.
Bamboo Saint soon returned to a cultivation room. He immediately used a unique communication treasure which could only be activated by him, "Protector, protector, there's a matter I would like to report to the religious leader."
"What's the matter?" The protector calmly asked via the communication treasure.
"All the treasures which you have given me, including those all sorts of materials which I have collected, everything is gone." Bamboo Saint transmitted over.
"What! All gone?" The protector had a considerable shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 622 - Religious Leader
chapters.content:
Chapter 622: Religious Leader
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within a distant huge object, in an ordinary palace hall, a violet-robed woman had a look of alarm. She immediately transmitted back a message to Bamboo Saint, asking, "What happened?"
The violet-robed woman's skin was dark gray, though her eyes were gold. She did not have any eyebrows nor hair, and her entire figure was emitting a cold feeling. Even if she was wearing a long violet robe, she was emitting an unseen aura. That was the aura coming from a powerful fleshy body. Her aura was so strong it was beyond Xue Ying's. She also had a unique point-there was no karma shrouding her body!
"It's like this. Previously, did all of you not inform me that the Sun Star Nucleus Stone was with Forefather Scarlet Flame?" Bamboo Saint reported, "I've killed Forefather Scarlet Flame and snatched the Sun Star Nucleus Stone, yet that Dong Bo Xue Ying killed his way over to my place, directly destroying my clan protection great array and destroying my true body. I have placed all my treasures with my true body with my avatar adventuring… this time, I have lost all of them, and even the Sun Star Nucleus Stone, under the coercion of Paragon Huo Cheng, could not be taken back. Only then did Dong Bo Xue Ying and Paragon Huo Cheng give up."
"Gone?" The violet-robed female protector squinted her eyes.
"My precious belongings-if Dong Bo Xue Ying was to inspect through thoroughly, he will possibly be able to discover my relationship with you guys." Bamboo Saint transmitted over, "And the moment I am revealed, I'll be dead! Thus, I hope for the protector to inform this matter to the religious leader, and I believe with religious leader's overwhelming strength, he should be able to easily exterminate Dong Bo Xue Ying, taking all those treasures I have away. That way, I'll not need to reveal myself."
"Kill Dong Bo Xue Ying?" The violet-robed female protector asked, "What kind of precious materials have you collected?"
"According to the mission religious leader gave, I've collected almost all of the precious materials from the eight mission, lacking only the 'Bracken Bird Whiskers'. Parts of the precious materials for other missions have been collected too." Bamboo Saint reported.
"Okay, I know." The violet-robed protector said, "I'll inform this matter to the religious leader."
"Thank you, protector! Thank you, protector!" Bamboo Saint said, "The moment you have news, I'll have to ask protector to hurry and tell me."
He had no other ways now.
Silencing Xue Ying by killing him?
Being a material realm lord, nobody in the Deity world or Abyss could kill him. Unless the Xia Clan world was destroyed, otherwise, there was no way of truly killing Xue Ying.
The other way was to kill the body of Xue Ying located in the Black Fog Sea, taking back those precious materials. As long as Xue Ying did not discover the secret within, everything would naturally not be too late.
But even still, it was challenging.
The Black Fog Sea was Bloodshed God Palace's territory! And the number one on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List, 'Bloodshed God-Emperor' would certainly be able to save his disciple in the Black Fog Sea in time. Furthermore, the previous battle with Bamboo Saint allowed him to vaguely deduce that it wasn't easy for ordinary Paragons to kill Xue Ying. As for the apex Paragons? He did not have that courage to ask them to act.
The only other way-let religious leader's side act.
…
The violet-robed female protector cut off the communication, pondering to himself and lightly muttering, "Truly trash! Such a minor matter and he can't even complete it properly."
Saying that the violet-robed female protector stood up before opening the palace door and walked out.
Very soon, she arrived at a vast and simple-looking stone step corridor.
There would occasionally be other figures on both ends of the hall.
On the way, she met a total of five black-robed men, three black-armored figure, and a violet-armored expert.
"Protector You." Some of the black-robed man and black-armored expert had respectfully greeted. As for the only violet-armored expert, he had merely glanced from afar without saying anything.
Very soon.
She walked to the end of this ancient corridor. The end of this corridor had an enormous bronze door with some spots on it.
Once the violet-robed female protector reached here, the bronze door had automatically opened with a boom.
It was an ancient towering palace hall.
The palace hall had a massive hunk with two fangs and garbed in several broken cloths seated cross-legged. The upper half of the huge hunk was naked, and his skin was gray as if it was a stone.
"Dong dong dong dong dong dong…" The entire palace hall had a heart-beating sound. The sound brought along a distant magical power, and even the violet-robed female protector felt her heart stopping at hearing that.
"Religious Leader." The violet-robed female protector came walking over before sitting cross-legged.
Both of them were seated cross-legged.
The heart-beating sound suddenly disappeared. That fanged-hunk also slowly opened his eyes. Those were a pair of eyes that felt very profound and unfathomable as if it held the river of stars. He turned towards the violet-robed female protector before revealing a chuckle. Even though he looked ugly, his laugh was filled was filled with an unseen force… causing the surrounding world to become warmer.
"It's Little Doll You. Is there any matter?" The huge fanged-hunk laughed as he pampered the girl.
"That person called Bamboo Saint has created trouble." The violet-robed female protector began explaining things clearly.
The huge fanged-hunk lightly nodded, "Dong Bo Xue Ying? It seems that the Bloodshed God Emperor has taught another formidable disciple. His combat power is not only strong, but even his way of teaching disciple is also very formidable."
"Mn." The violet-robed female protector nodded.
They were both very clear.
That the Bloodshed God-Emperor was someone genuinely terrifying! After all, he was the strongest existence in this cosmos.
"This Bamboo Saint has collected almost all precious materials of the 'Sky Destroying Egg'." The huge fanged-hunk lightly nodded, "But it's a pity that they have landed in the hands of this Dong Bo Xue Ying."
"Should we kill Dong Bo Xue Ying?" The violet-robed female protector asked.
"He has Paragon Huo Cheng by his side. Even if I act personally, Paragon Huo Cheng can resist for one or two moves from me, and by then, Temporal Island Lord, Bloodshed God-Emperor and Primal Master would have all rushed over. Thus, it isn't appropriate for me to act now. Furthermore, they will be able to reach the Black Fog Sea soon enough." The huge fanged-hunk said, "The Black Fog Sea is in the territory of Bloodshed God Palace. The Bloodshed God-Emperor will be able to move to any location within his territory. To the Bloodshed God-Emperor… it'll be better to evade him for now since we'll lose out in his hands."
The violet-robed female protector nodded, and then continued, "Are we not acting against Dong Bo Xue Ying?"
"We'll wait until he leaves the Bloodshed God Palace territory! With no apex Paragons by his side, we'll be able to send any protector to kill him easily." The huge fanged hunk laughed, "He is only a stage four World Deity with some great opportunity, and isn't someone with a huge threat! It's just that it's a pity we can't take back those precious materials."
"Mn." The violet-robed female protector nodded, "it's a pity we have no ways of collecting precious materials wantonly."
"We have no karmic lines, and the moment we reveal our identity, Bloodshed God-Emperor, and the others will team up against us." The huge fanged-hunk shook his head, "Thus, we have to treasure everyone who decided to rely on us. The stronger their combat power, the more we should protect them. But Bamboo Saint is only an ordinary true God, and his value to us is ordinary. Since he was revealed, he must be killed! After all, he knew quite a few things about us."
"Mn." The violet-robed female protector nodded.
"You should prevent him from overthinking first." The huge fanged-hunk said, "Over a few days, he will die secretly."
"Yes." The violet-robed female protector nodded. She then stood up and leave the place.
The huge fanged-hunk pondered inwardly.
"Hu."
His figure disappeared from the place. He soon appeared in a close dimmed towering palace hall. This dimmed palace hall had an enormous three-legged cauldron within with fire burning underneath it. Within the cauldron, there was some liquid moving continuously.
In front of the cauldron, there was currently a weak and thin old man curled up.
Even though he looked pale and feeble, this old man had a pair of eyebrows that drooped to the floor. Furthermore, he was also emitting a vibrant and terrifying aura which enveloped around that three-legged cauldron, controlling the flame within. The power of this aura… far surpassed that of Paragons.
"You are here?" The thin and weak old man glanced towards the huge fanged-hunk that appeared beside, "I know of the things you mentioned with little doll You already, asking me to go and kill that person called Bamboo Saint?"
"Yes."
The huge fanged-hunk chuckled, "He, after all, knows some information about us. And now, he is hiding in that territory of the person called Leaf Saint. Wanting to kill him stealthily, only you, old man, can do it."
"Their cosmos is different from our cosmos." The thin and weak old man nodded, "Even though their bodies are feeble, their techniques are very exquisite, so much so that they far surpassed us when battling! Their comprehension ability in understanding the profound mysteries of the law… prior to coming to this cosmos, we have never known what the profound mysteries of the law is. The arrays they set is truly hard to deal with especially when we have to enter stealthily."
"It is very mystical. Interacting with their cultivation techniques have broadened my perspective." The huge fanged-hunk said, "My combat techniques have also improved."
"Our cultivation system is perfect, though theirs require for them to grope about step by step." The thin and weak old man shook his head, "Bring the blood of that person called Bamboo Saint to me."
"Before relying on us, his blood has already been given to us." The huge fanged-hunk waved his hand, causing a drop of sparkling ink-green blood to fly towards the thin and weak old man.
"I have never fought others in a direct battle after coming to this cosmos. Instead, I have been killing those brats in the dark. Including this, I've already killed three of them." The thin and weak old man, "He'll die within half a month."
…
Bamboo Saint was temporarily staying in the territory of his elder brother. At the same time, he was forming another body.
"Religious leader has said that Dong Bo Xue Ying is always with Paragon Huo Cheng, and wanting to kill him directly is tough. He'll require some time to arrange. You should sit here quietly and wait for the results." The female protector transmitted over a message.
Bamboo Saint let out a sigh of relief after hearing that.
He was blindly confident towards religious leader because only after he had interacted with him did he understand that terrifying ability of his.
But being a powerful existence, he was on alert too.
Thus, he was temporarily staying over at his elder brother's territory. His elder brother had opened a 'Dao' known for its survival capability. Furthermore, he had fortified his territory for a long time. Thus, it was temporarily safe here.
'Dong Bo Xue Ying? I'll let you celebrate first.' Bamboo Saint looked forward to it, 'Very soon, those on the side of religious leader will be moving.'

chapters.title: Chapter 623 - Time to transcend
chapters.content:
Chapter 623: Time to transcend
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within the time-space tunnel.
"This time, it is all thanks to Big Brother Huo Cheng. If not for big brother around, the Two Saints Ink Clan will not lower their heads so easily." Xue Ying said.
"I have merely been present without acting." Paragon Huo Cheng laughed as he mentioned, "But Dong Bo, your combat power is not bad-you could even fight evenly with Leaf Saint. I believe that the moment this news is spread, the powerful existences in the Deity world and Abyss will all have a big shock. My teacher might even change the Cosmos Deity-Demon List again."
Xue Ying laughed.
The Primal Master updated the Cosmos Deity-Demon List whenever he wanted. Sometimes, he might delay for a long time because of particular reasons like entering closed-door cultivation.
"The ranking of combat power is a minor matter." Xue Ying said, "To me, what is more important is to transcend."
"Adding up, you should have lived for more than one million years now." Paragon Huo Cheng said, "With your comprehension talent, you should be able to transcend soon enough."
"My teacher has mentioned this too." Xue Ying shook his head, "If only everything is smooth, then naturally, I'll be able to transcend after a flash of enlightenment. But now, I find that I lack that final step."
Paragon Huo Cheng nodded, "Rushing is pointless. But this time, I can see from your actions that the foundation of your realm is thick enough, and your spear techniques should be considered to be top even amongst the powerful existences."
Xue Ying laughed.
He asked himself and knew that the five secret skills he created were powerful enough. He had the qualifications of being the strongest beneath Paragons.
"You have comprehended all nine Deity Hearts, and your foundation is thick enough. Coupled with your good comprehension ability." Paragon Huo Cheng added, "You have done well in your preparations. The moment you say breakthrough, you will break through. I think you should go out and have a walk and travel around the world. You will meet different things that could give you different stimulation. Who knows, you could transcend after that?"
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded, "I have this thought too."
"Hahaha… then I'll have to congratulate you beforehand. The moment you transcend, we brothers will be brothers for eternal." Paragon Huo Cheng laughed before turning around and look afar, "We will be reaching the Black Fog Sea soon. From how I see, there is no need for me to visit your Black Fog Sea. By then, seeing that Forefather Scarlet Flame, I'll feel even more embarrassed."
Xue Ying was startled momentarily before nodding.
Even though this matter ended with him taking back the Sun Star Nucleus stone, Forefather Scarlet Flame would still feel guilty and anguished in his heart.
…
After Xue Ying parted with Paragon Huo Cheng, he descended in the Black Fog Sea Monarch Residence.
Within the residence.
Xue Ying saw Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu and Forefather Scarlet Flame who had been waiting all along.
"Hu." Xue Ying landed.
"Father, why did you return so quickly? What happened?" Dong Bo Yu hurriedly asked. A smile appeared on Jing Qiu's expression too, and Forefather Scarlet Flame's appearance turned complex.
Xue Ying laughed before throwing the Sun Star Nucleus Stone over to Forefather Scarlet Flame.
Forefather Scarlet Flame finally let out a breath of relief the moment he saw the Sun Star Nucleus Stone. If Xue Ying did not take back the stone, how would he account for the Ripple Lady Planet Master in the future? If he let Xue Ying get into such predicament, or that he was forced to do specific tasks, Forefather Scarlet Flame would have no way of forgiving himself.
"Xue Ying." Forefather Scarlet Flame walked to the side of Xue Ying, placing the Sun Star Nucleus Stone back in the hands of Xue Ying, "You keep it."
"This…" Xue Ying was stunned.
"You should keep this. I feel nervous when I hold it." Forefather Scarlet Flame shook his head, "You can take it back this time, but should I let you take it back again if I met another issue in the future?"
Xue Ying added, "Bamboo Saint will not dare to do it anymore."
"He dares not, but what about other powerful existences?" Forefather Scarlet Flame rejected it, "I've used karma to sense that one of the bodies of Bamboo Saint has died. This time, the disturbance created is so huge, and most likely, it should spread across the entire Deity world and Abyss. By then, the matter about me having this piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone will most likely be dug out by them."
Xue Ying lightly nodded.
The previous battle had created a considerable amount of disturbances since it involved the entire Ink Bamboo Great Land. The Ink Bamboo Great Land's Bamboo Saint had many subordinates too, and those subordinates would most likely be telling their good friends about the massive battle. The Temporal Island could similarly understand what happened via time-space since no isolation treasure was able to hide such a fight happening in a vast area. This battle would likely be made known to the world.
"This, it isn't appropriate for me to hold this Sun Star Nucleus Stone anymore. I do not want to bring it along too." Forefather Scarlet Flame shook his head, "This matter is my mistake right from the start. For the sake of cultivation, I have thickened my face to ask you for help. Actually, I believe this is a huge pressure for you too. If it is any ordinary powerful existences, you can reject them, but you have put in so much effort to help me complete this task."
"I created the trouble, and I requested for you to help me solve it too."
"And in the future, if others attacked me, am I going to let you act again? I'm afraid those who dare to act will most likely be confident, and it might be a Paragon expert instead." Forefather Scarlet Flame shook his head, "I don't feel safe in my heart. Holding on to the treasure, yet I can't calm my heart enough to cultivate. Thus, I would rather not take it."
Forefather Scarlet Flame looked towards Xue Ying, "You should understand my meaning."
"I understand." Xue Ying nodded.
"Alright. There's no need for me to cultivate at the Sun Star either way. I can go visit other historical remains." Forefather Scarlet Flame said, "Xue Ying, then I'll not stay here any longer. You don't have to send me off."
"Wait a moment." Xue Ying added, "Forefather, your Cultivation Eden, and other weapons should be still with Bamboo Saint right?"
Forefather Scarlet Flame was startled for a moment before nodding.
The first time when he was attacked, all treasures carried by his avatar on the Sun Star were stolen.
Xue Ying laughed as he waved his hand. At the same time, many treasures began appearing, of which there was a unique-looking wooden stick. It was the well-known weapon belonging to Forefather Scarlet Flame according to the intelligence reports.
"Then I'll not be polite." Forefather Scarlet Flame revealed a happy look as he took back his own Blood Refined Deity Warrior and other treasures.
…
Forefather Scarlet Flame left in a casual, straightforward manner.
The Sun Star Nucleus Stone had been a psychological burden to him.
And everything was as expected. Just three hours after Xue Ying returned to the Black Fog Sea, the external world began spreading the news on the massive battle. Many of the powerful existences could quickly reverse the time flow to view the fight.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying has killed his way with extreme anger into the Two Saints Ink Clan, and in a move, he destroyed the entire clan protection array covering the Ink Bamboo Great Land. Bamboo Saint did not escape and had directly been killed in battle."
"Bamboo Saint himself has let out information saying that Dong Bo Xue Ying owns a True God weapon. Otherwise, he could not escape."
"One on one and he killed Bamboo Saint?"
"Bamboo Saint is an existence close to that of a Paragon."
"Dong Bo Xue Ying has fought with Leaf Saint too without anyone suppressing the other."
All sorts of news were spread.
Especially so for some of the veteran stage four World Deities and the powerful existences-the story was spreading even faster! Even Paragons and Rulers knew of this matter since the stronger their combat power, the clearer they understood that this battle outcome by Xue Ying was not something easily achievable.
…
In the Deity world.
Within the void, there was a chain of mountains. On one of the tallest one, there was currently a figure seated cross-legged on the mountain peak.
This figure was seated on a piece of enormous rock. He was wearing broken-looking clothes, and his hair was messy. He was barefooted, and he just seemed as if a beggar. But as he opened his eyes, nobody would treat him like one. His eyes were warm and were not tyrannical at all. Instead, it was filled with majesty, displaying strength and discipline. Naturally, it would cause others to feel that he seemed as if the ruler of this world.
He was none other than Monarch Green.
One who was apparently a Paragon yet he could fight against Rulers.
'This junior disciple of mine has been improving quickly'" Monarch Green chuckled, 'Indeed, he is the one who broke the record of becoming a stage three World Deity. Previously, the one who broke the record has died, leaving behind I and Temporal Island Lord. I wonder how far will this junior disciple walk to.'
'He has cultivated for more than a million years now and should most likely be transcending soon.' Monarch Green mumbled. He felt this was something expected for with Xue Ying's comprehension ability, and the lack of implication from vast karma, he should be able to transcend easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 624 - Death of Bamboo Saint
chapters.content:
Chapter 624: Death of Bamboo Saint
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within that wooden courtyard of Bloodshed God Palace.
There were currently two figures seated opposite of each other. They were both drinking and chatting happily. One was the Bloodshed God Emperor who had a black bird on his shoulder, and the other was a muscular man who was wearing a loose robe and a face full of beard stubble. Even as he sat there, this muscular man was vaguely giving off the strange feeling that caused the surrounding world to collapse; it felt like every single action of his could easily tear apart this world.
"Are you convinced?" Bloodshed God Emperor laughed, "It isn't baseless for the Primal Master to rank me first."
"I thought that I could defeat you this time, but I still lack by a bit. Bloodshed, you have cultivated so much later than me, yet why do you know so much?" That muscular man with beard stubble continued drinking in depression as he said. He was quite unhappy.
This muscular man seemed honest and straightforward.
But he was the top powerful existence in the entire Dark Abyss, and was termed as the 'Abyss Primogenitor'. His combat power was deep and unfathomable, and even Primal Master who was confident and arrogant had ranked him second on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List. The Primal Master himself was ranked third.
Though he was called the Abyss Primogenitor, he wasn't that brutal and ruthless. Instead, he was the most amicable Ruler out of the three from Dark Abyss.
"Your path of cultivation is different from mine." Bloodshed God Emperor carried his wine cup and chuckled, "You relied on Ancestor Devil to discover another system of cultivation from another cosmos. It is indeed most apt for you to train this. However, it is likely that you are the most lonely one in our cosmos since only you could follow down this system of cultivation!"
"There's another." Abyss Primogenitor said, "Bitter Cultivator; that brat is also moving along this path."
"But he is a Paragon, and his realm is not up to your standard so he can't help you at all." Bloodshed God Emperor added, "I am different. I comprehend the laws of profound mysteries, transforming my internal world and is also the conventional cultivation system of our cosmos. I can discuss with other Rulers, and can also gain some experiences from the records left behind by other seniors in the previous few cosmos epochs. Naturally, I'll grow faster."
"Don't quibble on that." Abyss Primogenitor frowned as he lowered his voice, "The Temporal Island Lord, Primal Master, and Nile are all cultivating using the conventional system, yet why aren't they your match? Saying that, it's just you who is too talented."
"Hahaha…" Bloodshed God Emperor laughed, "Many thanks for your praise. Your flattery is making me truly delightful."
The second-ranked in the entire cosmos praising him. Even if he was Bloodshed God Emperor, this flattery was making him truly satisfied and invigorating.
"Mn? This disciple of yours is quite formidable." The Abyss Primogenitor suddenly said with amazement.
Bloodshed God Emperor also received the information at the same time.
The two who were ranked topmost of this cosmos had obtained information at the very first moment and knew of the matter regarding Xue Ying and Bamboo Saint.
"This brat has cultivated to a stage that is comparable with that Leaf Saint." Bloodshed God Emperor lightly nodded, "It seems that other than the True God weapon, his comprehension of the realm has accumulated enough foundation. Doing a simple calculation, he should have cultivated for more than a million years and will be likely to transcend soon."
"Judging from his cultivation momentum, it should not be hard for him to become a Paragon." Abyss Primogenitor said, "As for becoming a Ruler? It'll have to depend on his fortune, his disciple and his comprehension ability and other aspects."
Bloodshed God Emperor nodded too.
Was Monarch Green's comprehension ability high? He had trained in three different Daos to a bottleneck, yet he could still not breakthrough to become a Ruler.
"Haha, Ruler? Don't think too far. He should be walking step by a step, and transcend first before speaking about that." Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled. He was delighted with his disciples.
…
Black Fog Sea, in the underground palace.
Xue Ying was currently inspecting through the massive number of precious belongings which Bamboo Saint left behind. There was a commotion going on in the outer world, and even powerful existences were talking about it. Deep in Xue Ying's heart, he was feeling elated, though he was very clear that external combative strength wasn't real power. It was still his realm that mattered more! It was more critical for him to transcend earlier.
'This Bamboo Saint has collected quite a few treasures.' Xue Ying was tongue-tied, 'The reward from this time is huge.'
The entire accumulation of existences close to Paragon realm would naturally frighten others!
'The precious treasures he collected are much more than I expected.'
'There are many precious materials too.'
Xue Ying felt slightly astonished. All sorts of weird and rare precious materials were not easy to collect. Previously, for the sake of getting 12 precious materials to purify the Sun Star Nucleus Stone, he had spent so much effort to collect them, yet this Bamboo Saint had rarer materials with him.
Placing the precious material aside, Xue Ying was currently focusing on finding those that would aid him in cultivation.
"Dang dang dang…" He was currently inspecting through three pieces of black metal each filled with a dense amount of golden characters. The record imprinted on it gave Xue Ying a mysterious feeling, 'It's a record of comprehension towards the law of profound mysteries?'
Xue Ying could not help but get absorbed at the moment he had a look.
That record was an analysis regarding the law of profound mysteries from another point of view.
"I'll research it slowly in a while." Xue Ying continued inspecting other treasures. He then took up a small lamp.
It was a bronze lamp.
The bronze had a unique symbol on it. The lamp fire was like a pea, gently swaying as it was burning. The flame was dark green.
"So strange." Xue Ying could vaguely feel that this bronze lamp held some secret. Otherwise, it would just be an ordinary lamp? How could it be!
It's just that his current experience limited him since his realm was not profound enough; for a moment, he could not see through it.
Xue Ying flipped over other treasures.
Piece by piece.
'Either Bamboo Saint took them, or that he obtained from historical remains. They are all some ancient and rare treasures.' Xue Ying slightly nodded, 'No rush. I'll place them by my side and ponder of them slowly. Let's first research that black metallic board.'
Xue Ying took up the black metallic board before immersing himself within.
******
Deity world.
The courtyard where Bamboo Saint was at, was also the territory of his Elder Brother Leaf Saint. He felt quite safe here.
"Hmph." Bamboo Saint's current mood wasn't well.
Because the news had spread across the external world, and everyone was shocked at the combat power of Xue Ying. And now, he, Bamboo Saint, was treated as a stepping stone.
'If not for his True God weapon, how would it be easy for him to extinguish that body of mine.' Bamboo Saint squinted, 'Let him be delighted for now. Since Religious Leader had mentioned it, he should act as well. By then when he died, everything of his will be taken by the Religious Leader, including the True God weapon. Hmph hmph, by then he would be regretting so much that he will want to cry.'
The more unhappy Bamboo Saint felt, the more he looked forward to the day Xue Ying suffer from a considerable loss.
He was waiting.
'Mn?' Bamboo Saint frowned. He clutched on to his mind, 'Why do I feel that something is amiss?'
He first felt dizziness.
Following which, unbearable nausea came over him. His true deity heart had a feeling of being torn.
'Not good.' Bamboo Saint knew that things were amiss. How could such things happen to powerful existences?
And closely following that…
His true deity heart which was distorted had shattered, and soon dissipated into nothingness.
Bamboo Saint's eyes were wide.
His figure had fallen on the ground unmoving.
Bamboo Saint had died.
How did he die! He died soundlessly and signless. Because the time was too short, he had no time to form another avatar. It was his true body dying! And even if he formed another avatar, the outcome would be the same either way!
And his Elder Brother 'Leaf Saint' soon discovered this shocking scene. He had not seen any other enemy from start to end, nor any other external aura within the place. There were even more signs of battles happening, yet this brother of his, 'Bamboo Saint' had died.
…
Temporal Island.
Many dispersed little islands were surrounding the main island. Those little islands could be as small as just a few kilometers in range of area and could be as huge as being a few hundreds of thousands of kilometers as if they were planets revolving around the Temporal Island.
On the Temporal Island, there was an extremely grand, dazzling and huge palace. There was a fragrant pervading the palace hall within.
Above the palace hall.
There was a grass mat woven by silvery-white weed. This grass mat was on top of the palace hall, and currently, there was a black-robed black-haired male seated cross-legged on it with his eyes closed as he cultivated. His pair of eyebrows were akin to sharp swords, and his expression was cold. He was none other than the existence who had the best control over time and space across the entire Deity world and Abyss-'Temporal Island Lord'. He was controlling countless lives as they went performing in many death missions.
"Master." A low voice resounded, "There's a matter I'll have to report."
"What's the matter?" Temporal Island Lord opened his eyes. He knew that this low voice was his most loyal subordinate, the treasure spirit, 'Temporal Temple'. The Temporal Temple was always operating, supervising the entire cosmos and all sorts of places within. If there's no vital matter, he would not come and disturb him.
"Bamboo Saint has died. His true body and avatar are dead, yet the way he died is extremely puzzling." The low voice said.

chapters.title: Chapter 625 - Summoning Xue Ying
chapters.content:
Chapter 625: Summoning Xue Ying
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Deity world. Within the courtyard where Bamboo Saint's corpse was.
His elder brother 'Leaf Saint' was frowning as he watched from the side, 'How did he die? How did he get killed? It can't be that he suicided right?'
Maybe stage four World Deities might die from their true deity hearts crumbling apart, but they would decide to reincarnate before that.
This brother of his who had become a powerful existence had just died silently like this?
"Hu."
Suddenly, a figure appeared by the side.
Leaf Saint was so startled that he jumped. This territory of his had many arrays arranged, yet an outsider had entered so easily.
But the moment he saw that cold black-robed black-haired male, he greeted politely, "Greetings Temporal Island Lord." So, the outsider was shockingly Temporal Island Lord. With the Temporal Island Lord's control over time-space, it was normal for him to appear stealthily.
"The Temple treasure spirit has told you about what happened?" Temporal Island Lord calmly said.
"Yes." Leaf Saint added.
"You did not discover any disturbances or signs?" Temporal Island Lord asked.
"Never!" Leaf Saint replied, "This cultivation place of mine is filled with many arrays, and those who could come here stealthily can be counted with one's finger in the Deity world and Abyss. But with the identity of Rulers, they would disdain from conducting such acts."
The Temporal Island Lord lightly nodded. If they, Rulers, wanted to kill an ordinary True God, they had so many different means of doing it. Even if they created a considerable disturbance, they would not care since those who offended a Ruler… would not be pardoned! Such a sneaky method of killing an ordinary powerful existence was too repugnant to the Rulers.
Temporal Island Lord surveyed that corpse which had its eyes full and round. He quietly inspected it a few times.
After examining it a few rounds, Temporal Island Lord frowned.
Sou.
He then disappeared from thin air.
Leaf Saint was startled as he stood by the side. Did he leave just like this? He did not even talk to him anymore? Was he going to keep this corpse? Or would he be handling it?
"Leaf Saint, master has finished his inspection. Everything here is left for you to handle however you want." The Temporal Temple treasure spirit transmitted a message over.
…
In the wooden courtyard of the Bloodshed God Palace.
The Abyss Primogenitor and Bloodshed God Emperor were both enjoying wine and chatting happily when suddenly, a figure arrived right outside the wooden courtyard.
"It's him?" Abyss Primogenitor had a look of shock as he glanced outside.
The door to the little wooden courtyard was pushed open.
A black-robed black-haired cold Temporal Island Lord came walking in.
"It is so rare that you come over to my place." The edge of Bloodshed God Emperor's lip moved upwards, "Aren't you afraid of me killing your avatar?"
"It's a matter regarding the Ancestor Mother Religion." Temporal Island Lord said indifferently.
"Ancestor Mother Religion?" Bloodshed God Emperor and Abyss Primogenitor were both startled as they tuned solemn.
"What happened? Did you discover anything?" Bloodshed God Emperor asked.
Temporal Island Lord explained, "My Temple treasure spirit discovered that Bamboo Saint has died peculiarly. I went over to investigate… and it seems to be the silencing method from the Ancestor Mother Religion."
"The silencing method from the Ancestor Mother Religion?" Bloodshed God Emperor frowned.
"Bamboo Saint has died in the cultivation territory of his Elder Brother Leaf Saint. When he died, there were no disturbances at all, and neither were there any signs of battles happening. Furthermore, he died with his true deity heart crumbling apart, and Leaf Saint had discovered no traces whatsoever. There are very few who could do this within our Deity world and Abyss, and clearly, it isn't us who did it. More importantly… he died with a look of shock. It seems he did not even have the time to tell his elder brother-it was very sudden." Temporal Island Lord elaborated, "Such a matter has happened twice before, and this is the third time! I reckon that with a probability of 99%, it should be the Ancestor Mother Religion."
Bloodshed God Emperor continued questioning, "Did he leave behind any materials on his body?"
Those who were silenced like this would know some secrets relating to the Ancestor Mother Religion.
Once they were dead, they could only investigate from the belongings they left behind.
"I've already checked through before. Other than some communication treasures which are slightly special, he has no other suspicious goods." Temporal Island Lord replied, "According to my understanding, about a dozen days ago, Bamboo Saint's true body has been killed by Dong Bo Xue Ying, and his many precious belongings have landed in the hands of Dong Bo Xue Ying. He is your disciple, so I came over asking you."
"Xue Ying?" Bloodshed God Emperor was stunned momentarily, "Alright, I'll summon him over now."
******
Black Fog Sea. Underground Palace.
Xue Ying was currently immersed entirely in looking at those many words on the black metal. There was a huge amount of information inscribed on it, and they were records related to the comprehension of the laws of profound mysteries.
'Those who could make these records must have an extraordinary realm. Their way of thinking is unique too.' Xue Ying felt that these objects were of huge help to him.
Suddenly-
"Dong Bo, Bamboo Saint has died. Do you know that?" Paragon Huo Cheng suddenly sent a message over.
"Dead?" Xue Ying was stunned. He immediately used karma to sense, yet no matter how, he could not detect the karma of Bamboo Saint anymore. It was clear that his true body and avatar were both killed.
"Unless it isn't you who sent someone to assassinate him? Isn't your Bloodshed Tavern specialized in assassinations?" Paragon Huo Cheng asked.
"Not really. Really, it isn't me. He has his elder brother there, and assassinating him is too difficult." Xue Ying replied.
Closely following that, another message came.
"Monarch Dong Bo, Bamboo Saint has died. Does Monarch know of it?" It was a message sent by Calm Sea Prefecture Master.
"Bamboo Saint's death is related to you, Xue Ying?" It was a message by Jing Qiu.
Many sent transmissions over to ask him.
Because the death of a powerful existence was enough to alarm the entire Deity world and Abyss. It was quite common to see avatars killed since everyone would frequently fight or enter the dangerous grounds of historical remains. Thus, losing an avatar was common. But the death of both true body and avatar was rare! Because most powerful existences would be very vigilant to protect at least a body of theirs.
Bamboo Saint was an existence close to a Paragon, and with his combat power, both his true body and avatar had died. Naturally, everyone was paying close attention to this.
Coincidentally, about a dozen days ago, Xue Ying had just killed his way to the territory of Bamboo Saint and murdered a body of his. Naturally, many powerful existences were making their guesses.
"Xue Ying, come over to my place." A voice sounded by his ears.
"Teacher?" Xue Ying was stunned. Even his teacher was summoning him over. Unless his teacher was suspecting that I'm the one who acted?
Xue Ying was filled with bewilderment and helplessness, yet he could not care about it anymore. He immediately used his fastest speed, leaving Black Fog Sea and heading towards the Bloodshed God Palace.
…
Over at that little wooden courtyard in the Bloodshed God Palace.
