Xue Ying had pushed open the door before entering. The moment he came, he could see two figures seated within, and a character with a cold expression standing by the side.
Xue Ying could immediately discern the two seated there as his teacher and the Abyss Primogenitor! It was enough to shock him. As for the other black-robed black-haired male with a cold expression standing by the side, he startled Xue Ying even more-Temporal Island Lord?
Honestly speaking, Xue Ying had some fear and dislike towards this Temporal Island Lord.
Primarily, it was because the Temporal Island Lord used the 'Temporal Temple' to rampantly capture countless lives and force them into many dangerous missions. Even their souls were controlled. Such conduct made Xue Ying feel extreme dislike for him. This treating billions and billions of souls as puppets were something Xue Ying could not agree with. Besides, after coming to the Deity world, his understanding towards the Temporal Island Lord increased, causing him to loathe him even further.
Amongst the rulers, Xue Ying had the greatest aversion to him!
"Greetings teacher, Abyss Primogenitor, Temporal Island Lord." Xue Ying respectfully greeted them.
The Abyss Primogenitor chuckled before nodding. It seemed he was quite friendly.
As for Temporal Island Lord, he glanced at Xue Ying with a cold expression before turning to look at another space. He was too lazy to reply. The dislike was mutual.

chapters.title: Chapter 626 - The origin of Fifth Uncle Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 626: The origin of Fifth Uncle Master
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Even though the Temporal Island Lord was standing by the side emotionlessly, Xue Ying maintained his smile. The Ruler 'Temporal Island Lord' who stood high above others could show him an ugly expression, but he had to keep the most fundamental respect for him. Naturally, his dislike towards this Temporal Island Lord remained as always.
"Xue Ying." Bloodshed God Emperor placed down his wine cup before saying, "Summoning you over is because of the death of Bamboo Saint. His death is very queer."
"Teacher will not suspect that it is this disciple who did it right? This disciple doesn't have that kind of strength." Xue Ying answered.
Right now, many discussions were going on outside, and many were suspecting that he was the one who did it.
"Naturally it isn't you." Bloodshed God Emperor laughed.
"Dnog Bo brat, if you can do it, you will be a Ruler." Abyss Primogenitor laughed from the side.
Xue Ying was astonished.
Ruler?
Unless it was a Ruler, who acted behind the scene? There were only so many Rulers in the entire Deity world and Abyss, and the statuses of these Rulers were so high that they had to deal with Bamboo Saint personally? Most likely, all they had to do was give an order and Bamboo Saint himself would have taken the initiative to be captured and ask for mercy. Why would they assassinate him?
"Finding you is because many of his treasures has landed in your hands." Bloodshed God Emperor explained, "We are suspecting the identity of Bamboo Saint and wanted to have a look at the belongings he left behind."
"This disciple has coincidentally brought them along with me." Xue Ying informed.
"Bring them out. Let us have a look." Bloodshed God Emperor ordered.
Xue Ying did not hesitate. He waved his hand before bringing out all those materials he got from Bamboo Saint, including the Deity crystals, belief stones, precious materials, weapons, robes, and others. Naturally, it excluded those that he gave to Forefather Scarlet Flame, but since those belonged to him, it should not be related.
"Mn?" Bloodshed God Emperor, Abyss Primogenitor, and Temporal Island Lord's eyes all landed on these belongings.
The black-robed black-haired cold Temporal Island Lord suddenly looked at those black metal boards. Waving his hand, one of the black metal board landed in his hands. He casually took a look before sneering, "These imbeciles from the Ancestor Mother Religion are still able to comprehend things, and are knowledgeable about our cosmos' cultivation system. Even though their perspective is a bit weird, this metal board has recorded comprehension up to the 'Opening Realm."
Bloodshed God Emperor and Abyss Primogenitor both took up a piece of black metal board and have a look.
"Mn, those chaps from the Ancestor Mother Religion might be a bit foolish, but their combat power is there. It is normal for them to have such comprehension on our cultivation system." Bloodshed God Emperor rated them.
"These people are living in seclusion, studying our cultivation techniques in the dark, allowing their combat power to increase. In the future, they will most likely bring some calamity." Abyss Primogenitor felt worried.
"Those fools aren't worthy to be worried for." Temporal Island Lord felt disdain over them.
Bloodshed God Emperor waved his hand, causing that bronze lamp to fly over. Bloodshed God Emperor took a look before sneering, "They came over to our place and are even spreading their religion."
Xue Ying was listening obediently from the side. He felt many thoughts appearing in his heart.
Ancestor Mother Religion?
Our cosmos' cultivation system?
"Xue Ying, I'll take this lamp away. Bringing it with you has no benefits for you." Bloodshed God Emperor mentioned, "The other you can keep. The Ancestor Mother Religion's understanding towards the law of the world is unique, and you can analyze from another perspective. It should be of help to you still."
"Yes." Xue Ying waved his hand before keeping everything.
Temporal Island Lord and Abyss Primogenitor did not inspect through the items anymore. They had what they wanted to know. The vile lamp had been taken away by the God Emperor, leaving behind only the ordinary stuff.
"Alright, you can leave. But remember, in the future, you should be wary when you meet those from the Ancestor Mother Religion. They will mark you down after this matter." Bloodshed God Emperor reminded him, "These people are like locusts, collecting all sorts of precious materials from our cosmos. Bamboo Saint has collected all sorts of rare and weird materials should be for the sake of them. Now that it has landed in your hands, they will be observing you."
Bloodshed God Emperor had merely reminded him.
This disciple of his was a material realm lord and would not be endangered at all.
"Observing me?" Xue Ying could not help but ask, "Teacher, where does the Ancestor Mother Religion come from?"
"It is as I mentioned to you before, those mysterious experts without any karmic lines." Bloodshed God Emperor said.
Temporal Island Lord had sneered from the side, "Bloodshed, no karmic lines doesn't mean they are from the Ancestor Mother Religion."
Bloodshed God Emperor laughed after hearing that. He nodded, "Those without karmic lines are 99% chance from the Ancestor Mother Religion. There is still a few minority who are from other cosmos."
"Other cosmos?" Xue Ying felt even more puzzled.
Bloodshed God Emperor did not hide this. He felt that with Xue Ying's combat power, he should have the qualifications to know these, "Mn, the Ancestor Mother Religion came from another cosmos. Their cultivation system is entirely different from ours. They do not cultivation an inner world, and neither do they comprehend the laws of profound mysteries. They believe in the so-called 'Mother Ancestor', and has cultivated their fleshy body to an unfathomable stage. Their bodies are much stronger than our cultivators. Naturally, they are too weak regarding the understanding of the law of profound mysteries, and playing with them is still relatively simple."
"Not cultivating an inner world and not comprehending the law of profound mysteries yet they could become very very strong?" Xue Ying did not understand. He had cultivated for so many years, and all he knew about was comprehending the law of profound mysteries, transcending and opening his Dao. Regardless, 'realm was fundamental'. But the Ancestor Mother Religion which comes from another cosmos seems different."
"You are too young and have experienced too few things." Bloodshed God Emperor laughed, "Wait until you become stronger, and these things will unravel themselves. Each cosmos is different in their way, like your Fifth Uncle Master, he is someone I brought back under a fortuitous encounter from some other cosmos. So you will discover that he has no karmic lines too."
"Fifth Uncle Master?" Xue Ying looked towards that black bird.
He had always found Fifth Uncle Master as someone mysterious.
A single feather had given him an unfathomable feeling. That bird always followed his teacher and had no karmic lines. Xue Ying was even suspicious that he was a non-living thing.
Now he finally understood that he came from another cosmos.
"Hmph hmph hmph, my master died, and I felt so lonely. In the end, I was scammed over by Bloodshed." The black bird muttered.
"It's you who is greedy." Bloodshed God Emperor laughed.
"Alright, go and cultivate. Do your best to transcend." Bloodshed God Emperor said.
"Yes." Xue Ying nodded.
The Ancestor Mother Religion, Fifth Uncle Master or even guests from other cosmos were things he did not have to worry about. He should focus more on studying the law of profound mysteries and transcend before speaking.
Xue Ying politely bid them farewell before leaving.
…
Sending Xue Ying off with his eyes, Temporal Island Lord sneered, "Bloodshed, it seems you are quite caring towards your disciple. Just a stage four World Deity yet you told him so much?"
"Do you think he will not transcend?" Bloodshed God Emperor indifferently mentioned. He was quite confident of his disciples.
Temporal Island Lord did not answer.
Even he felt that with the cultivation speed of Xue Ying, and with how his realm had accumulated enough foundation, transcending was something easily done.
"Abyss Primogenitor." Temporal Island Lord turned towards him, "Your disciple's fortune is not bad. That pair of Deity lifeforms has transformed into a talisman for the Starting Ground."
"Hahaha…" Abyss Primogenitor laughed too, "He can't help but have good fortune indeed."
His disciple had first taken in two Deity world life forms.
Who would have thought that after meeting these two Deity lifeforms, they would both emit a dazzling light, fusing together into a piece of talisman! Because there were many powerful existences present then, he could not hide it. Most cultivators and Paragons might not understand what that talisman meant, and knew that it should be some precious treasures. But the Rulers knew… that it was the key to entering the Starting Ground.
The talisman to the Starting Ground would form all kinds of shape when splitting apart. It could be two pieces of broken scrolls or even two actual Deity world lifeforms, or maybe some of the more precious materials.
But the moment one gathered different parts together, they would fuse into one entity and form a talisman.
The talisman recognized its master, and nobody could snatch it from them. If someone killed the owner, the talisman would disappear.
To get it, one must have combat power, and more importantly, one must be lucky enough.
"But he should be careful; else he might just die the first time entering the place." Temporal Island Lord closely added.
Bloodshed God Emperor laughed from the side, "I remembered you once said that you had obtained a talisman to the Starting Ground, but it's a pity that your avatar died within when you were at the opening realm, losing the talisman and any chances of entering once again."
"Hmph hmph, at least I got it before, yet you didn't." Temporal Island Lord turned around and left. He soon disappeared in the distance.
Bloodshed God Emperor sent him off while lightly muttering, "I might not have entered before, yet I am much stronger than you."

chapters.title: Chapter 627 - Emissary
chapters.content:
Chapter 627: Emissary
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
After meeting his teacher, Abyss Primogenitor, and Temporal Island Lord, Xue Ying went back to the Black Fog Sea to continue his closed-door cultivation. He was clear that he should try and transcend first.
After comprehending the complete 'law of the world', he was not in a rush to transform his inner world, or to promote his true deity heart, or to escape from the River of Time. Instead, he would enter the 'Starting Ground' as a stage four World Deity. As long as he did not use any combat techniques utilizing the 'complete law of the world', and if he did not mention it, who would know that he had transcended?
It was a standard way of doing things.
Day passed by day.
"Master." A voice resounded in the underground palace.
Xue Ying who was seated cross-legged in the palace hall opened his eyes. His eyes had many deity imprints vaguely revolving within. They then concealed themselves, turning into nothingness before Xue Ying spoke, "What's the matter?"
"There's a guest who wants to meet Master. This guest is quite domineering." The array spirit added.
"Domineering? Where is he from?" Xue Ying asked.
"He is an emissary under His Highness Water Devil King." The array spirit explained, "Saying that he is here under an order, and asking Master to hurry and meet him."
Xue Ying frowned after hearing it.
Water Devil King?
Ranked 13th on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List!
One had to know that adding up the mysterious Pang Yi and the eight Rulers, they had taken up the top 9 positions on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List. As for those who were not Rulers yet could fight against Rulers, they included just two-'Monarch Green' and 'Great Destruction Heavenly Emperor'. This added up to a total of 11.
Water Devil King was ranked 13th, signifying how powerful he was! He was ranked even higher than Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, Paragon Huo Cheng, and White Sovereign King.
"This Water Devil King isn't someone to offend." Xue Ying thought.
Water Devil King comprehended two Daos and had reached perfection in both. Fusing the two Daos together gave Water Devil King a heaven-shattering combat power. He was someone brutal and ruthless, and even the Rulers could not kill him.
In fact, the few Paragons ranked in the forefront had the certainty of surviving against Rulers.
Like Monarch Green and Great Destruction Heavenly Emperor, nothing had to be said for them. As for those on the second tier-Monarch Hex Cricket, Water Devil King, and White Sovereign King-they were Paragons who dared to challenge Rulers. Amongst which, Monarch Hex Cricket was the most friendly one. White Sovereign King, though, was cunning and scheming, yet he was relatively polite on the surface. Only Water Devil King had a peevish temperament. Even though he was an expert from the Deity world, he had this monicker, 'Devil King', showing his temperament.
He was strong and had grasped two strange Daos. Ordinary Rulers had a hard time dealing with him, causing him to become arrogant.
Because of how unbridled he was, he had eventually offended the ancient Primal Master. Primal Master was angry, yet he could not directly kill him. Thus, he decided to imprison Water Devil King for a total of 300 billion years! He made Water Devil King live forever in a little prison as big as a 'water droplet'! After 300 billion years, the kind-hearted Primal Master decided to let him go, "Cultivate properly. Become a Ruler soon. If you were to be deranged and tyrannical again, I'd lock you until the Cosmos Great Apocalypse, allowing you to die along with the Cosmos!"
After experiencing that, Water Devil King had become much lowkey. At least, he remained respectful in front of Rulers.
"He sent an emissary over?" Xue Ying felt puzzled. But he still left the underground palace.
…
Within the guest hall, Xue Ying sat on the throne while his subordinate personal guards led the emissary in.
"Emissary, please." The personal guard had personally brought him along to the guest hall, "Monarch is currently in the guest hall."
This emissary soon entered the guest hall.
Within the guest hall, other than Xue Ying who was seated above, there were several other female attendants.
"Please have a seat." Xue Ying said.
The emissary bowed before sitting down calmly. The female attendants naturally brought up the fruits, delicacies and good wine. This emissary had a bestial appearance. He had two sharp erected ears and a cat face. He sat there ramrod straight, emitting an aura that was of a stage three World Deity realm.
"Monarch, I am here under the orders of the great Water Devil King." The emissary said.
Xue Ying laughed, "The Water Devil King rarely comes out nowadays. Is he cultivating in closed doors?"
"The magnificent Water Devil King is single-mindedly cultivating. Naturally, he wants to break through and become a Ruler." The emissary said boldly, "This time, I came under orders because the magnificent Water Devil King requires several treasures for some testing purposes."
"Treasures?" Xue Ying felt his heart moving.
"The Water Devil King requires a Sun Stone Nucleus Stone. Hearing that you, Monarch Dong Bo, has a piece." The emissary responded, "He decided to come and ask for your help."
Xue Ying frowned slightly.
Sun Star Nucleus Stone?
This Sun Star Nucleus Stone was indeed very valuable. Being a material that originated from the core of the Sun Star's 'Sun Nucleus', other than using it to cultivate on the Sun Star, it was also a rare material! It could be used for refining weapons, researching flames and other purposes. Even the Ancestor Mother Religion desired the Sun Star Nucleus Stone very much, and they had ways of sensing it from afar. That was why it made Bamboo Saint act.
In most cases, nobody would broadcast they had a Sun Star Nucleus Stone.
Those who dared do so were usually Paragons.
Xue Ying was one of the weaker ones amongst those who publicized it, though he had a solid backing.
"The Sun Star Nucleus Stone is extremely precious, and it has a great use for me." Xue Ying tactfully declined.
The emissary frowned, "The magnificent Water Devil King requires a Sun Star Nucleus Stone currently. Is the monarch not planning to give face to him at this moment?"
Xue Ying did not suspect him at all. The two Dao paths that the Water Devil King opened were of the 'water' aspect. Water and fire were two very similar yet opposing energy. The Water Devil King wanted to borrow the 'Sun Star Nucleus Stone' to improve his Dao-it was something reasonable.
"If it is an ordinary treasure, it is fine. I'll give it to Water Devil King. But I believe you all have heard already that I paid a huge price for this piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone! After Bamboo Saint took it away, I've even killed my way to the Ink Bamboo Great Land to get it back." Xue Ying answered, "It is essential to me, and I will not be giving it away."
The emissary became gloomy as he continued, "Monarch, the magnificent Water Devil King has let me bring a treasure over as well to exchange for the Sun Star Nucleus Stone. Monarch should have a look first?"
"Oh?" Xue Ying said.
"Monarch, please have a look." The emissary felt rather contended as he waved his hand, causing a golden liquid to float in midair. The golden liquid had many imprints moving on it, "This is the third volume of the absolute art "One Line Attraction". Monarch can inherit it once."
Xue Ying's expression turned grave after hearing it.
The reputation of "One Line Attraction" was tremendous. It was one of the absolute arts which he heard of from the intelligence reports that were created by Lake Heart Island. The absolute art "One Line Attraction"'s original copy was of six droplets of golden liquid, and furthermore, these six droplets of liquid would not appear in a single cosmos epoch at the same time! There would be five droplets appearing at most in a single cosmos epoch.
According to the narrative of cultivation, six droplets, the first two volumes were meant for World Deities to cultivate. The third volume was for True God to cultivate. The fourth volume for Paragons, the fifth volume for Rulers, and the sixth volume for those at a higher realm. One could see how powerful the strongest expert across many cosmos epochs was for an absolute art he created to be so terrifying.
"Just a third volume without containing the first and second meant that I couldn't cultivate." Xue Ying coldly answered.
"Monarch can use it as a reference." The emissary retorted.
"It's a pity that I am a stage four World Deity." Xue Ying indifferently said. An absolute art which could not be cultivated and neither could it be used as a reference, along with him inheriting it just once, and the other party wanted to exchange it for the 'Sun Star Nucleus Stone'?
His own "Blood Devil Scripture" was one of the six grand inheritances of Ancestor Devil, and for the sake of requesting Ripple Lady Planet Master for help, he imparted the upper half of the "Blood Demon Scripture" to a disciple of hers, and he still owed her a favor and had to repair the array diagram. Furthermore, he had to personally give the Void Black Soil and 12 precious materials only to get a single Sun Star Nucleus Stone.
Just a broken and useless third volume absolute art, with only the opportunity to learn it once, and he wanted to use it to exchange for the Sun Star Nucleus Stone?
The value was more than ten times difference.
"The Sun Star Nucleus Stone is critical to me. Forgive me, but I am unable to give it to Water Devil King." Xue Ying stood up.
"Monarch Dong Bo, the magnificent Water Devil King requires this piece of Sun Star Nucleus Stone. Unless you dare to disobey the magnificent Water Devil King?" The emissary felt worried. That Water Devil King's temperament was very unreasonable. In the past, he did not place Rulers in his eyes, and now that he had suffered from the hands of Primal Master, he had become respectful to Rulers. To the other Paragons, he remained disdainful as well. As for Xue Ying who was a stage four World Deity, he did not even care about him.
He felt that by giving him a chance to step down, Xue Ying would obediently hand it over.
He was used to this behavior after so many years. Ordinary powerful existences would not dare to disobey after hearing the name of 'Water Devil King', and would obediently give up their treasure. Because the trade wasn't fair, they were full of resentment inwardly. The name 'Devil King' was not solely a name, but also in reality.
"Disobey?" Xue Ying's eyes became cold, "You, a measly stage three World Deity, dares to act so rampantly in my territory?!"
"Hong~"
Xue Ying's eyes were frosty.
A terrifying strength surged out and enveloped that emissary. The emissary felt his entire world turning dark as the frightening power suppressed him entirely. He could not even move, and neither could he see nor hear.
Following which, when he regained his consciousness, looking up, he realized that he had arrived outside the entrance of Monarch Dong Bo's residence.
"Scram!" A voice exploded by the side of his ears.
The emissary felt his heart trembling.
"Too daring, too daring." The emissary did not dare to seek trouble with Xue Ying. He was a stage three World Deity, and Xue Ying could extinguish him with a flip of his hands.
…
Within the palace hall.
Xue Ying's eyes were cold. Previously, Leaf Saint had caused him to feel a strand of being mocked and belittled. But this 'Water Devil King's feeling of disdain was even stronger! But Xue Ying had to admit… that being someone who could challenge the Rulers, he had the qualifications of doing so.
'I might be a little stage four World Deity, but does Water Devil King dare to come barging in my Black Fog Sea?' Xue Ying sneered.
The Bloodshed God Palace territory.
The ordinary battles were fine. But if an existence like Water Devil King dared to act here, much less Xue Ying, even any of the other powerful existences who had decided to rely on the Bloodshed God Emperor! The Bloodshed God Emperor would personally act. It was also one of the obligations which the Bloodshed God Emperor had to perform… after one relied on him. Otherwise, why would those powerful existences want to rely on him?
Bloodshed God Emperor was top-ranked on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List. his deterrence was much stronger than even Primal Master.
Xue Ying originally did not want to offend that Water Devil King. As long as he had given a slightly 'fairer' price, he would not care even if he suffered from a minor loss. After all, the Sun Star Nucleus Stone was not being used by Forefather Scarlet Flame currently, and neither was he temporarily using it.
But-
Wanting to pay a price that was worth nothing, meaning to say taking it for free! The Sun Star Nucleus Stone was not that cheap!
******
After forcing that emissary away, the days after regained its usual peacefulness. Water Devil King did not dare to act in many ways. He revered the Rulers, especially 'Bloodshed God Emperor'.
Time passed.
In the blink of an eye, it had been over 2,000 years since the death of Bamboo Saint.
'I feel that I've accumulated quite a resounding foundation already. The law of the world also feels faint as if I can grasp hold of it anytime. But no matter how, I can't seem to comprehend it. It appears that burying myself in cultivating isn't too appropriate… just like Big brother Huo Cheng has mentioned before, I should go out and have a walk, experience all sorts of sceneries and encounters. Who knows, a specific encounter might simulate me.' Xue Ying mentioned to his wife, Jing Qiu before leaving the Black Fog Sea by himself. He began traveling in all directions in search of an opportunity to break through.

chapters.title: Chapter 628 - Drifting around
chapters.content:
Chapter 628: Drifting around
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The Bloodshed God Palace occupied a third of the entire Deity world-it was a vast territory. Xue Ying had traveled through many different places within in search of an opportunity to break through.
Cloud Card Planet.
Within an ordinary little city, inside a usual civilian courtyard, there was an old carpenter currently carving a pattern on a wooden chair. There were much wooden shavings on the ground.
"Uncle." A green-robed teenager walked out from inside the house, "My body seems to be almost fully recovered, and it is time for me to leave. Many thanks for saving me."
The old carpenter's appearance was 70% similar to that of Xue Ying's.
It's just that his hair was white.
It was evident that this man was Xue Ying with a transformed appearance. He was currently roaming around the Deity world, staying for a few dozen years at a single place each time as a mortal. He would gradually grow old on the appearance, and when he was old enough, he would silently leave the area and start a new life in another place.
"Brat, your injuries have yet to recover fully." Xue Ying straightened his back while hammering it at the same time. Only then did he came walking over with a slight hunchback, "You should be at ease with staying over at my place. Rest well. It will not be late for you to leave when you are fully recovered."
"Uncle, I'll only bring you trouble if I stay here." The teenager added.
"Hahaha, your uncle's hair is already white. I am staying here alone too, so what trouble would I be afraid of?" Xue Ying laughed. As he laughed, he coughed twice, "Even if you don't tell me, I can guess it. During that night when I saved you, the person the entire city is searching should be you right?"
The green-robed teenager laughed awkwardly.
He knew that this uncle in front of him must have figured out since they had described the appearances and injuries of the person the city was searching. How could he not conclude it?
"Relax and stay here for a little longer. This uncle I, am just living alone. You could accompany me." Xue Ying said with his back hunched. He coughed twice before turning around and continued carving the pattern on the chair.
"Uncle, you are always coughing. You should go and get some medicine." The green-robed teenager was concerned.
"It's just an old illness, nothing much." Xue Ying's transformed body was akin to a mortal, and would similarly get old and sick.
Suddenly, Xue Ying looked outwards.
"Dong dong dong…"
Very soon, booming sounds could be heard vaguely from outside the courtyard. The expression of the green-robed teenager changed drastically. He immediately leaped to the roof of the house and tried to escape. But suddenly, a loud and clear sound resounded in the sky. Many birds came flying over. The birds were wearing armor, and there were even warriors on them as they enveloped the entire sky.
"Peng." The door to the courtyard was immediately shattered. Many soldiers riding fierce beasts came rushing in.
The green-robed teenager looked upwards at the dozens of soldiers riding on the flying birds before revealing a look of despair as he went back into the courtyard.
Among that group of soldiers within the courtyard was a teenager wearing gorgeous clothes and riding a white-haired mutated beast. He walked right at the forefront. He had a cold smile as he said to the green-robed teenager, "My beloved little brother, isn't it better if you could obediently become a puppet emperor? You'll be living a life of luxury, and can enjoy the beauties all you want as well."
"Becoming a puppet emperor? You are just asking me to die!" The green-robed teenager angrily shouted, "Don't think I do not know, three years later, the Deities will descend and take away the belief energy. If they discover that there's no belief energy, they will kill this emperor directly. Besides, if I am not wrong, you have a demon god behind your back who will act against me as well, controlling my soul and turning me into a true loyal puppet! That to me is worse than death."
"Ze ze ze, you know quite a lot of things." The gorgeous-clothed teenager exclaimed, "I have truly belittled you."
"You are my brother, so why are you treating me as such!" The green-robed teenager angrily shouted.
"Who made us the royal family? Who caused us to have a few hundred brothers and sisters?" The gorgeous-clothed teenager sighed, "Three years later when the Deities descend, everything must be hidden properly. We must prepare the scapegoat. There must not be the slightest mistake. Alright, it's time for you to return."
The green-robed teenager gritted his teeth, yet he looked around him with despair, "I can return with you, but you have to promise me and let go of this uncle. He is an ordinary man."
"Is it him?"
The gorgeous-clothed teenager turned towards Xue Ying who was slightly hunchbacked before sneering, "I said before I'll not let there be any mistakes."
"God emissary, kill him." The gorgeous-clothed teenager ordered.
"Yes, your highness." A black-robed man respectfully acknowledged.
"No, no, if you continued like this, I, I'll just suicide!" The green-robed teenager gritted his teeth.
"My little brother, are you brave enough to suicide? Rest assured. In front of me, any of you mortals can't suicide at all." The gorgeous-clothed teenager chuckled. Unseen world energy had long enveloped around the green-robed teenager, "Better accept your fate. This is the fate I have arranged for you."
The green-robed teenager's eyes were red as he looked at Xue Ying, "Uncle, I have implicated too many other people, and even implicated you."
"Aiyo."
"So this has even involved matters of stealing belief energy." Xue Ying coughed twice as he said, "The belief energy is something the higher level of the Deity world requires, and every single planet has to hand them in, yet there's a demon god who dares to steal the belief energy. Such huge courage."
As Xue Ying spoke, that black-robed man who was walking over could no longer move. He could only turn his eyes.
The gorgeous-clothed teenager's expression changed. Hearing that 'every single planet has to hand them in', and turning over to the god emissary who was stuck there unmoving, he knew he had met huge trouble.
"Teacher, teacher, there's trouble." The gorgeous-clothed teenager asked for help.
Very soon-
"Hong!"
The world began trembling. A towering figure appeared in the distant glowing in gold. Even as he stepped on the ground, his knees were beyond the cloud layer. That enormous figure was located in the void. A towering figure with a height tens of thousand kilometers was way too big as compared to this planet of just a few tens of thousand in diameter. This Deity who appeared furiously looked below with his eyes, overlooking that little city, and seeing that slightly hunchbacked old carpenter.
Xue Ying looked up with a smile that did not seem like a smile.
"Magnificent Deity." Countless mortals were so frightened that they knelt down after seeing this Deity towering over a few tens of thousands of kilometers in height.
"Who are you?" The towering Deity angrily shouted.
"Little brat, you have quite the courage." Xue Ying extended his hand. That towering Deity who was a few tens of thousands of kilometers in height became smaller without his control, flying towards the palm of Xue Ying. Soon, he turned into an ant.
The surrounding people were stunned. That gorgeous-clothed teenager and his subordinates within the courtyard, and the green-robed teenager were all stunned as they saw this scene.
The tens of thousands of kilometers towering Deity had become so small, and that he flew onto the palm of this old carpenter?
"From today on, you will be the servant of this brat." Xue Ying ordered. Waving his hand, that Deity immediately turned back into a gray-robed old man who respectfully knelt down, "Thank you for showing mercy!"
He was clear that those who could do this with a wave of his hand would at the very least be a World Deity. After all, he was someone at the middle stage Deity realm.
"Senior…" That gorgeous-clothed teenager knelt down the next moment.
Xue Ying turned towards the green-robed teenager, chuckling at him. World Deity energy began permeating through his body, rapidly transforming his fleshy body while turning it extraordinary. Xue Ying then said, "For you to think of this uncle still even at the end, I'll help you a little as well. Let it be the fate between us."
"Uncle." The green-robed teenager was stunned. Even fools could see that this uncle was undoubtedly a terrifying existence, and should be a big shot existence in the Deity world who lived for god knows how many years.
"Senior, three years later when they come collecting the belief energy, I am afraid I will be revealed…" That gray-robed old man felt cowardly.
Xue Ying waved his hand, causing a belief energy stone to be thrown over, "Other than paying off the deficit, there's still more than enough to spare."
The gray-robed old man felt joy the moment he saw it.
"Brat, you are on your own from now." Xue Ying looked at that green-robed teenager before disappearing in mid-air.
Only then did the gray-robed old man leaf out a sigh of relief. He turned towards the green-robed teenager who was at a loss, "Master, do you know who this senior is?"
"I do not know. I only know the surrounding people call him Old Man Dong Bo." The green-robed teenager was slightly startled.
"Old man Dong Bo."
The gray-robed old man was astonished, "There isn't many who are called 'Dong Bo' in the entire Deity world; they should be from the bloodline of Monarch Dong Bo's residence right? But that patriarch is a legendary existence."
Xue Ying's reputation was truly too great across the entire Deity world. He had shocked others during the Myriad Flower Feast, becoming a disciple under the God Emperor. Hearsay he had even killed other powerful existences before! Across the many Deities, he was also much more famous than the Calm Sea Prefecture Master.
'He should most likely be someone from Monarch Dong Bo's residence.' The gray-robed old man vaguely guessed.
…
After Xue Ying left the Cloud Card Planet, his appearance began changing. The mortal figure soon transformed back into his actual self.
He regained his youth.
A powerful and terrifying aura was displayed; this was the actual appearance of Monarch Dong Bo.
'I've walked across the many planets for at least 3,000 years, yet I have not transcended.' Xue Ying shook his head, 'It seems that it is too difficult for something to enlighten me as I cultivate my heart realm. Even though leaving the Bloodshed God Palace territory might endanger my life, I should go out and seek an opportunity.'
'Let us go to the Moon Star first.'
Xue Ying soon tear apart the time-space tunnel, taking a step before entering the time-space tunnel which was filled with colorful streamers as he headed towards the Moon Star.
He originally did not wish to leave the Bloodshed God Palace territory.
Primarily because he was afraid of meeting 'Water Devil King' and the Ancestor Mother Religion! Naturally, he felt that Water Devil King should not be that foolish to act against him since that time when the Water Devil King sent his subordinate, he should only want to threaten Xue Ying with his name and make Xue Ying give up his treasure willingly. But Xue Ying had after all cultivated very quickly, and naturally, he was very arrogant and would not be that forbearing.
'The probability of Water Devil King acting is quite low. As for the Ancestor Mother Religion, will they act for the sake of Bamboo Saint?' Xue Ying thought, 'Is their horizon set so low?'
But he did not know.
The Ancestor Mother Religion had no ways of rampantly searching for precious materials, and could only rely on Bamboo Saint and other experts from the Deity world and Abyss. Furthermore, other than Bamboo Saint and other experts being sent to collect materials, ordinary powerful existences including Paragons would usually not collect all sorts of weird and rare playthings.
Instead, they were collected because the Ancestor Mother Religion needed them urgently!
…
Within the Ancestor Mother Religion's territory, in an ancient towering palace hall.
The person with two fangs and wearing a few broken cloths with a bronze-colored skin gradually opened his eyes. His eyes were filled with an endless warmth, causing the entire atmosphere in the palace hall to turn more optimistic and warm.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying has set out of the Bloodshed God Palace territory." The huge fanged-hunk chuckled and nodded, "It is time to get back those precious materials."

chapters.title: Chapter 629 - Assassinating Xue Ying
chapters.content:
Chapter 629: Assassinating Xue Ying
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"Protector Qian." The huge fanged-hunk lightly mentioned, though his voice had rapidly resounded in the quiet secret room.
A monkey-like beast located within this quiet secret room was seated cross-legged like a human. He had golden hair and a look of calm. The moment he heard the voice called out by the religious leader, he opened his eyes. That pair of golden eyes were filled with loyalty and devotion.
This golden-haired monkey stood up. The door of the secret room automatically opened.
"Hua."
He took a step before crossing through a vast distance, arriving right outside the huge bronze door of the towering palace hall. The big bronze door was also opening by itself.
The golden-haired monkey remained like a wild monkey with his back hunched as he entered the room. The big bronze door soon closed up once again.
"Religious leader." The golden-haired monkey sat down cross-legged.
"Protector Qian, there's a matter which requires you to act." The huge fanged-hunk said.
"Religious leader, please give your instructions." The golden-haired monkey politely replied.
The huge fanged-hunk continued, "In this cultivator cosmos, there is one who goes by the name Dong Bo Xue Ying. Previously, he has destroyed the true body of Bamboo Saint, taking away all the precious materials which we require. He might be a stage four World Deity, but he is close to that of a Paragon in combat power. His defenses are very formidable, and in this Cultivator Cosmos, the apex Paragons could barely injure him with their full-powered attack. Because his defenses are solid, so we'll have to trouble you to act."
"Understood." The golden-haired monkey nodded, "Will he be bringing along those precious materials too?"
"Uncertain, but those precious materials are vital to us, yet it isn't too important to those powerful existences on this Cultivator Cosmos. They would only use them to refine some miscellaneous items, so Dong Bo Xue Ying will not place too great of importance in these precious materials." The huge fanged-hunk said.
Indeed.
Those precious materials were worth not even up to a single True God weapon.
But these valuable materials were enough to make the religious leader pay great importance to. The worth of these materials was more important than that of a True God weapon, just that they were outsiders and could not wantonly collect these items since they had no karmic lines-they could be identified easily.
"His teacher is the Bloodshed God Emperor. The moment he sees us, he'll call the Bloodshed God Emperor over." The huge fanged-hunk said, "It's fortunate that Dong Bo Xue Ying has left the Bloodshed God Palace territory, and examining the direction of the time-space tunnel, he should be heading towards the Moon Star! You should hurry up and kill him before he reaches his destination. After killing him, take all his treasures before leaving the place as soon as possible."
"Yes." The golden-haired monkey nodded. At their hometown, amongst the many protector rank experts, he was a terrifying existence ranked in the top three and was comparable to Monarch Green and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction from this cosmos.
"You must use all your strength and complete it swiftly. You should know how important these precious materials are to us." The huge fanged-hunk said, "I'll inform you of the location of Dong Bo Xue Ying constantly. Set off now."
The golden-haired monkey bowed respectfully before leaving the place.
…
Within the time-space tunnel.
Xue Ying was currently traveling at high speed. The surrounding colorful streams of light were warping.
'Moon Star.' Xue Ying was relatively looking forward to it, 'The previous time I went to the Sun Star. Now, I am thinking how special this Moon Star is.'
Even though the intelligence reports had recorded descriptions of the place, he had to experience it personally.
The Moon Star and the Sun Star were both violent and were not appropriate for life. But underneath the wild and destructive nature of the Sun Star, it was filled full of life energy.
The Moon Star was different. The environment of the Moon Star wasn't that brutal; it was more of the 'sinister' kind. The deeper a person went, it might seem as if his body could withstand the force, yet it was possible that he would freeze into a sculpture the next moment, causing his true deity heart to freeze and die. On the Sun Star… the moment he felt that he could not carry on, he could stop. Hence, it was advisable to take it easy on the Moon Star.
'Mn?'
Xue Ying suddenly felt the surrounding time-space shaking up.
'What is this?' Xue Ying was astonished as he looked forward. There was a lump of dazzling light appearing all of a sudden. Xue Ying was trying his best to look over, and could barely see a blurred figure within that dazzling golden light. Following which, a figure waved out his palm, and at that juncture, the palm light immediately exploded, causing the light on his body to dim.
'Monkey?' Xue Ying could see the other party now.
It was a golden-haired monkey emitting golden light. The golden-haired monkey's eyes were benevolent. That huge palm filled with hair was rapidly turning big as it slapped its way over. Within moments, it was akin to an enormous land! This enormous palm felt boundless, and every single hair on the hairy palm was akin to huge trees. The surrounding time-space had been condensed, with all revolving energy stopped in their movement.
Xue Ying's expression had a massive shift.
His expression changed not because the other party had no karmic lines! After all, Xue Ying was prepared to suffer from any assassination by those of the Ancestor Mother Religion after leaving the Bloodshed God Palace territory.
At this moment, what made his expression shift, was because the power of this palm was too terrifying. That vast hairy palm sending his way contained a strength that far surpassed the feeling Monarch Green gave him. It was even possible to match the suppressive feeling coming from the Bloodshed God Emperor, Temporal Island Lord and Abyss Primogenitor.
Naturally, because Monarch Green, Bloodshed God Emperor, and Temporal Island Lord did not emit their aura deliberately when they met Xue Ying, and they were not fighting as well. Thus, the suppression from their aura wasn't that strong.
But-
This palm was still too powerful! This sort of strength made Xue Ying feel his heart trembling from fear. It was an instinct of life.
Facing that sword coming from White Sovereign King, he did not fear it at all.
But meeting this palm made him feel fear.
Because this palm brought along a suppression that far surpassed that sword, and Xue Ying had a feeling that if he were to meet against the attack head on, even if he had the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor protecting him, he would directly be turned into pieces with his body dying soul extinguishing after that.
'It this the combat power of the Ancestor Mother Religion? Sending an expert so powerful?' Xue Ying was stunned. His teacher Bloodshed God Emperor and Temporal Island Lord had used all used words like 'fools' and 'idiots' to describe the Ancestor Mother Religion, yet someone who came to deal with him was so powerful already.
The enormous hairy palm rapidly shrouded over him. When the palm got closer, he could see the hairs on that palm which were as big as sky pillars. This palm thoroughly flooded the senses of Xue Ying! That's right, no matter how he tried extending his senses, this palm had already encompassed the surroundings, and he could neither escape nor retreat.
Xue Ying looked upwards. He was experiencing that sort of terrifying strength.
'Formidable.' Xue Ying praised with a sigh.
At the same time, he held onto that piece of talisman-the talisman that would teleport him to the Starting Ground.
With just a thought.
"Sou."
Xue Ying disappeared from midair. He completely disappeared from this piece of space.
…
Saying it was slow.
After the golden-haired monkey appeared, he sent his palm out. Xue Ying did not have the slightest thought of resisting and had used the talisman to teleport towards the Starting Ground. Before teleporting, he had transmitted a message to Bloodshed God Emperor, "Teacher, there's an enemy who wants to assassinate and kill me. It is a golden-haired monkey and has no karma surrounding him. He seems to be an expert from the Ancestor Mother Religion."

chapters.title: Chapter 630 - This is the Starting Ground?
chapters.content:
Chapter 630: This is the Starting Ground?
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
At the same moment.
Bloodshed God Palace. Over at that secretive underground palace.
Bloodshed God Emperor was scrutinizing the burning cosmos furnace when he heard the transmission by Xue Ying. His expression had a slight change: 'Golden-haired monkey? Ancestor Mother Religion?' He had used karma to ascertain the location of Xue Ying.
But closely following that.
"Hua."
That avatar of Xue Ying had disappeared entirely. Even his karma disappeared too!
'Gone?' Bloodshed God Emperor's eyes were filled with rage. If he could not sense Xue Ying with karma, under ordinary circumstances, there was only one possibility-death! Naturally, Xue Ying's true body was still in the Xia Clan world, but the avatar which was initially with the golden-haired monkey had disappeared entirely. Even his karma had disappeared.
Bloodshed God Emperor would naturally think that this avatar of Xue Ying had been killed.
After all, there were only a few possibilities of what could happen with a vanished karma according to the understanding of Bloodshed God Emperor, and each of them was rarely seen even by Rulers.
'Truly brutal.' Bloodshed God Emperor's eyes flashed with coldness as he disappeared.
…
"Hu."
After activating the talisman, Xue Ying sensed a warm energy originating from the surrounding cosmos protecting him. It was more comfortable than tearing through time-space. In the blink of an eye, he had arrived at his destination.
Xue Ying looked around him.
It was a formless void, yet underneath his feet, there was actually a land. This land was only a few kilometers wide.
"My eyes, my ears…" Xue Ying was stunned.
His vision which was terrifying and could even see the pattern on the back of an ant more than 100 million kilometers away, and his hearing ability which could hear many fluctuations-closing his eyes and he could even hear a large area around him… at this moment, they were gone. Xue Ying discovered that he could only see a few dozen kilometers away, and any distance further than that was blurry.
His ears could only vaguely hear the sound of wind; he could not hear the fluctuations any more.
This feeling was not too far off as compared to when he was a mortal at the One with the World realm.
"Mortal?" Xue Ying extended his right hand and clenched it.
There was no spatial explosion, and no fluctuation from air being pressed.
"My luminous sun force? World deity energy?" Xue Ying could feel the wealth of energy in his body, yet the luminous sun force and World Deity energy could not be moved at all.
"What is happening?" Xue Ying felt his strength becoming rather mediocre. He pulled out the flying knife from his waist. As he could not extend his senses, the True God weapon flying knife became an ordinary flying knife.
Xue Ying held the flying knife to his palm before slashing it across lightly.
A line of injury formed.
"What?" Xue Ying might have his guesses, but seeing his mighty body breaking apart after a simple slash, he was even bleeding?
"I've become a mortal?" Xue Ying placed the flying knife back into the scabbard by his waist. He felt lost.
He, Xue Ying, had cultivated for so many years and had a heaven-shattering combat power close to that of a Paragon. After activating the talisman which teleported him to the Starting Ground, he had become a mortal?
Xue Ying looked at this piece of land which was about a few kilometers in range.
In the distant, there were many rows of trees with shade-giving foliage. The leaves were rustling with the wind. Behind the trees, there were several simple-looking stone houses.
Other than the trees, there were also several flowerbeds, grassland, and even river flowing in the far distance with fishes leaping out of the water surface. There was a wooden bridge constructed across the small river. At the center of the entire land, there were three grass houses scattered. The withered yellowish grass on top of the grass houses gave off a natural beauty.
"This is the Starting Ground?" Xue Ying was puzzled.
He had thought of many possibilities.
Being able to teleport from any part of the entire cosmos even when there was suppression by the ancient historical remains into the Starting Ground, and to teleport to any places within the cosmos from the Starting Ground, and also the fact that even Rulers would die with a nine out of ten probability, gave Xue Ying a feeling that this was a perilous place. But after coming, he realized that this place seemed to be a leisurely and relaxed place.
"Pa." A sound came suddenly from afar.
Xue Ying looked over. It was from the unremarkable stone houses behind the trees by the boundary of the land. One of the stone houses' door had been pushed open, with an old man wearing simple clothing with white hair walking out.
"There are people here?" Xue Ying held his breath. There were other people within the Starting Ground?
"Little brat, have you experienced the feeling of being a mortal?" This old man laughed giddily as he walked over. He shouted from afar, "How tired would it be to cultivate every single day. Isn't it better to let you regain the feeling of being a mortal? See how fragrant the flowers are, how pretty the green leaves are! You should have long forgotten these feelings coming from a mortal already, am I right?"
Xue Ying was startled.
The feeling of being a mortal?
That's right.
His vision power was terrifying. Even if it was a piece of leaf, his vision could permeate through the leaf and see its internal structure. A piece of green leaf could be as big as a piece of enormous land to him! He could see the structure within the green leaf, and all profound mysteries within it. Even as he closed his eyes to smell, he could discern through the minute components constituting the entire structure of the leaf immediately.
"Sometimes, by making things a little blurry, the world becomes more meaningful." The old man laughed, "That time when forefather created this ground, he had done so because he wanted to relax and to regain the feeling of being a mortal. It doesn't matter how strong you are. Even Rulers will become mortals after coming in. This… is the rule of the Starting Ground!"
Xue Ying was slightly enlightened.
It was the rule.
One would become just like a mortal after coming in.
"Since we can't utilize the law of profound mysteries, we will not be able to display our combat power. How can we then determine how strong we are?" Xue Ying asked, "Isn't it the fact that the Starting Ground is perilous, with one surviving out of ten?"
"Don't be so anxious." The old man said, "You'll soon experience the one lives and nine deaths, but for now, you should calm yourself down. I can see your anxiety at this moment."
Xue Ying felt guilty.
Indeed, his heart realm had been affected. Ever since he became a Transcendent, this feeling of being a mortal was one he had never experienced ever again. Even by disguising himself as a mortal, that was 'disguising', yet at this moment on the Starting Ground, according to the rules… he was truly a mortal. Even a knife could easily break through his skin.
He became weak, and could hardly carry something of a few hundred kilometers in weight.
"Karma?" Xue Ying was startled, "The karma here?"
"Can't sense karma?" The old man said.
"My true body in the outside world can't sense this body of mine." Xue Ying nodded. It was truly enigmatic.
Under ordinary circumstances, if one could not sense the other party's karma, he would have died.
But at this moment, he was all okay in the Starting Ground, yet his true body could not sense his karma. Still, they could exchange memories.
"This is the influence of the Starting Ground." The old man mentioned, "You brat is still too weak, and are just a stage four World Deity. Your realm is too low too. How much of the world do you think you could see?"

chapters.title: Chapter 631 - Within the Eden
chapters.content:
Chapter 631: Within the Eden
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying nodded. At this moment, he was ranked in the top 50 on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List and was considered an existence standing absolutely in the forefront amongst countless cultivators.
But the higher he climbed, the more he had experienced, and only then did Xue Ying discovered how oblivious he was to many things.
"Did you not say you want to experience danger?" The old man chuckled, "Come, I'll bring you over."
Xue Ying nodded.
"Danger is always accompanied by fortune."
"Even though it might be nine deaths and one life to you, the moment you succeed, it'll make broaden your future." The old man said as he walked towards his destination. Xue Ying followed behind him obediently.
The two like mortals. They were sauntering over like mortals.
They had walked for an hour before traveling 10 kilometers.
There were five big trees here. The trees were so huge that it took a few people to hug around one. The old man walked towards one of the trees to the left before stating, "Follow me." He touched upon the tree, and at that instance, he had crossed through it.
Xue Ying looked back and murmured, "I've walked for 10 kilometers as a mortal." He snickered before walking towards the same tree as well.
The moment he touched it, he went through the tree.
"Hua."
Within was a vast world. At the moment Xue Ying entered, he could feel his strength recovering. His body had regained its usual strength, and the World Deity energy and luminous sun force could be controlled too. He stood in midair, enjoying the scenery of this world. There were many mountains in it.
On top of a mountain in the distance, there was a golden ax stuck on the top of the peak.
"Do you see that ax?" The white-haired old man also flew upwards and said with a smile.
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded. He was feeling startled inwardly though. Even after entering this Eden world, he could not sense the combat power of the old man; it felt like he was an ordinary person.
"Very good." The white-haired old man nodded. He then cast his sight on the distant frost mountain peak. That mountain peak which was covered entirely in frost had a figure within it which he could see vaguely.
Xue Ying's vision was very formidable.
He could see the character who was initially lying down, moving up. He then stretched his hands-"ka ka ka". The entire frosty mountain peak began splitting into two, forming a colossal crack in between. The crack extended all the way from the mountain peak until the section where that figure was sleeping at. Following which, that figure flew out and stood on one side of the frosty mountain peak.
That was a barefooted male wearing a broken-looking cloth.
He stood there lazily, casting his gaze on the figure of Xue Ying who was far away while revealing a slight grin. His body was emitting a terrifying aura.
"Hong!"
The terrifying aura coming from his body rushed out in all directions, causing space to echo with explosions. A distorted spatial fluctuation which the naked eyes could see had been formed.
For a moment, the surrounding space of over a few hundred billion kilometers was distorted. This male looked at Xue Ying with a smile that did not seem like one, "Are you my opponent this time?"
"Opponent?" Xue Ying's expression had long changed.
This powerful aura gave Xue Ying a considerable pressure.
"Little brat." The white-haired old man said, "This is your opponent. Your trial is… to pull that ax out under his interference. As long as you could do so successfully, you would have succeeded. You could then challenge again when you are at the World Realm."
"I do not have to defeat him?" Xue Ying was startled.
"Defeat him?" The white-haired old man was stunned before shaking his head continuously, "Naturally not! How could you defeat him? His realm might be low, and at the World Deity realm… but he is practically the strongest existence within the World Deity realm."
Xue Ying felt puzzled, "He hasn't opened his Dao?"
"Nope." The white-haired old man answered, "His realm is similar to yours at the stage four World Deity realm."
Xue Ying nodded.
The Starting Ground divided one's combat power primarily via realm. World Deity realm, World realm, Opening realm and Ruler realm. Like Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, even though he was a stage four World Deity, he had opened his Dao and was considered at the 'Opening realm'.
'I can't even defeat one who is at the stage four World Deity realm too?' Xue Ying thought to himself. Even though he felt that the opposing party's aura seemed strong, his Extreme Annihilation Mysterious body armor was solid too.
"You don't have to defeat him. As long as you pull that ax out, it will be count as your win." The old man said, "Remember, don't be too careless. His realm might be very ordinary, but his combat power is extraordinary! The forefather personally reconstructed this body to the same extent after he has researched it. He had given his memory back oo."
Xue Ying nodded.
That forefather who constructed the Starting Ground seemed to have met the strongest World Deity before?
But how strong could he be?
"Remember not to be grabbed by him. The moment you are grabbed and swallowed into his body, you will die for certain." The white-haired old man said, "The way his body is made could even digest True God weapon."
Xue Ying was dumbstruck.
"He is considered a unique existence in his hometown. Otherwise, the forefather will not spend so much effort in researching his body." The white-haired old man chuckled, "I hope you can survive under his hands."
"Begin!" The white-haired old man suddenly shouted out.
The originally fierce aura coming from that lazy male on top of the distant frosty mountain peak surged even further!
"Hong hong hong!"
Violet-gold patterns began extending on his skin. There were patterns on the side of his face, and it continued in a crisscrossed manner all the way till his eyebrows! His eyes were also emitting violet-gold light, and his hair was also emitting the same colored light. His aura was entirely on a different level as compared to how it was before. The entire Eden world was slightly trembling from his aura alone. Many miniature black holes were forming by his side, and these black holes were naturally spreading further, though they were limited and shattered by the distorting void.
Xue Ying could not help but feel a chill in his heart. This World Deity was giving off the same feeling he felt from the golden-haired monkey he met previously.
"Such a creature is a World Deity?" Xue Ying could hardly believe it.
"I said it before-this is the most terrifying World Deity the forefather has ever met." The white-haired old man said, "Be careful. He is coming."
…
Over at Ancestor Mother Religion's ancient towering palace.
"Hua."
Two figures appeared at the same time. The huge fanged-hunk grabbed the golden-haired monkey and teleported here.
"Many thanks, religious leader."
"Bloodshed God Emperor is personally moving, so we can't be too careless. It is natural that we have to bring you back as soon as possible." The huge fanged-hunk sighed, "You mentioned previously that Dong Bo Xue Ying disappeared from midair?"
"That's right. He disappeared from the void." The golden-haired monkey nodded, "Those who can do this in front of me can be counted with one's fingers in this cosmos. There are only these few who are good at escaping."
The huge fanged-hunk frowned, "I've obtained news that the karma of Dong Bo Xue Ying's avatar has also disappeared."
"What." The golden-haired monkey had a huge shock, "His karma disappeared?"
There were many ways of escaping.
But he had not just escaped, even his karma had strangely disappeared. This point made it extraordinary.
"It seems that Monarch Dong Bo has an unusual treasure." The huge fanged-hunk chuckled, "In the future, we should pay extra attention to him and properly examine what treasure he has that allowed him to escape from you so easily while hiding his karma too."
…
Back where Xue Ying met the golden-haired monkey.
A crimson-robed Bloodshed God Emperor appeared. His eyes were piercing as he looked around him.
"Hmph."
Bloodshed God Emperor was full of killing intent.
If it was a battle between those from his cosmos, and Xue Ying lost an avatar to the other party, he could only blame his disciple for lacking in strength. After all, there was a tacit understanding between Rulers.
As for the Ancestor Mother Religion? They actually dared to kill his disciple? It was an act the Bloodshed God Emperor would not tolerate.
"Time, flow back."
Bloodshed God Emperor coldly said.
His voice was just like an order.
The surrounding time-flow rapidly reversed. Even though that golden-haired monkey had activated a method to isolate probing, the top-ranked on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List could still force his way to determine what had happened.
Very soon, the scene in the past was shown.
That golden-haired monkey waved out his palm.
"His strength has reached the Ruler level." Bloodshed God Emperor lightly nodded, "But his realm is very crude. The Ancestor Mother Religion has hidden such an expert well."
Closely following that, as the palm came, Xue Ying disappeared from the place.
Bloodshed God Emperor was astonished as he stared at this scene. He had initially thought that his disciple was killed-causing his karma to vanish. But what he saw here showed otherwise-his disciple had escaped personally.
"This brat." Bloodshed God Emperor who was originally full of killing intent began chuckling, "It seems that I, as the teacher, has still underestimated this disciple of mine."

chapters.title: Chapter 632 - Fighting
chapters.content:
Chapter 632: Fighting
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within the Eden, the ragged-clothed barefooted male let out an aura that shook the entire place. He then suddenly stamped with his foot-"hong long"! Over half the ice mountain peak crumbled under his feet. Next, he turned into a golden ray of light and lunged forward. This speed made Xue Ying speechless: 'His pure flying speed is three times mine. He should be able to match a peak Paragon already.'
'What makes things troublesome is that he has controlled the entire space in the Eden, making it such that am unable to utilize the world energy.' Xue Ying thought.
If he was able to utilize the world energy, he could condense a world avatar by the ax, and pull it out directly.
"Sky Dome Fog Prison." Xue Ying made his resolution. The luminous sun force flew out from his body, forming many rays of white light flew.
"This is my territory." The ragged-clothed barefooted man stopped moving. Coldness flashed across his eyes.
"Weng."
Suddenly, cold Qi appeared within the space of Eden, causing the temperature to drop. Many layers of ice appeared on the ground. The luminous sun force that was moving in midair became frozen with a 'ka ka ka' sound. Furthermore, many snowflakes had formed and fluttered in the breeze. Each of this snowflake contained a force that greatly exceeded the 'luminous sun force'.
The snowflakes covered every single area. Xue Ying could not avoid them at all; he had to withstand it directly with his body. The luminous sun force on the surface of his black armor could not obstruct the snowflakes as they landed on it.
However, as an absolute art created by the Lake Heart Island master, the black armor easily parried against them.
'These snowflakes are too terrifying; even my luminous sun force became frozen.' Xue Ying was speechless, 'Furthermore, they are everywhere. Perhaps stage four World Deities with slightly weaker defenses would be frozen alive.'
Nine deaths and one lives. Those were not empty words.
Currently, the vast land was just like a silken-wrapped silver wrap, with many snowflakes floating. The ragged-clothed barefooted man stood in midair and coldly said: "Somewhat interesting, I thought that you would be frozen to death."
In his memories, he had frozen countless opponents to death with this single move…
"Heart World!" Xue Ying decided to display the only illusory technique in his five great secret skills. Because he was residing at the Black Fog Sea, he would naturally spend much time comprehending the illusory realm within the 'Black Mist'. Over the past years, he was able to create a terrifying illusion technique! Even if it were an ordinary powerful existence, as long as their cultivation heart was slightly weaker, they fall into the illusion.
The terrifying part of this move was that resisting against this technique depended only on the soul of the opponent!
They had to have a strong soul! Or a profound cultivation heart realm!
If they were unable to resist, they would be absorbed into the heart world, and be killed by Xue Ying easily.
"Hua~"
Xue Ying's eyes distantly gazed.
The shapeless fluctuations spread and immediately struck the rag-wearing barefooted man. At the moment when it struck him, Xue Ying became delighted: "He has a soul? Very good!"
Strictly speaking, his opponent was a non-living thing created by the creator of Starting Ground with his memories added later on. Xue Ying was worried that the opponent would be akin to a puppet. If it didn't have a soul, the results of his illusory techniques would be significantly reduced. Nonetheless, when he attacked his opponent, Xue Ying discovered that the other party actually had something similar to a true deity heart!
"Your illusory technique is truly formidable. But when I was growing, I suffered three times to illusory techniques. Afterward, I had the chance to obtain a soul-protecting treasure, and from then on, I was never misled again." There was killing intent in the ragged-clothed barefooted man's eyes, "It is better for you to die obediently."
Before he finished speaking, the ragged-clothed man had already approached.
Xue Ying fled with many thoughts flashing across his mind. He was quite anxious, 'Even his soul was not misled. How do I fight? Whatever, as long as I stall, I will be able to rush to that ax. Once I pull it out, I will win.'
He was flying the entire time.
But the ragged-clothed man was moving much faster; the distance between the two rapidly shrunk.
"Die." The ragged-clothed man immediately thrust out a fist. In that instant, his fist had turned into a fuzzy golden ray. His arm rose sharply, and his fist passed through the distance between them almost instantaneously, arriving in front of Xue Ying.
'So fast!' Xue Ying was dumbstruck, 'Although he does not have a power that could envelop the world like the golden-haired ape from the Ancestor Mother Religion, his speed is even faster.'
Xue Ying grasped the Scarlet Cloud Spear with both hands, directly blocking it.
"Hong Long Long~"
Xue Ying used his spear, and the image of a vast rotating meteorite suddenly appeared. The fist that had turned into a golden ray strike against this 'meteorite'. The next moment, that meteorite was broken-Xue Ying went flying with his spear across the distance, viciously striking onto a massive mountain and continued passing through it with a 'sou'. He only stopped after carving out a huge hole.
"Mn?" The ragged man exposed a look of shock, "He could actually block one of my fists?"
At the edge of the Eden, the white-haired old man who was leisurely watching the battle lifted an eyebrow: 'The little brat that has come this time is quite strong other than lacking in the grasp of the realm. It seems there's some chance of surviving.'
Xue Ying who had been struck into the distance was startled too.
'I have the two absolute arts-"Luminous Sun" and "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body". My strength is even at the level of a Paragon. One of my five self-created secret skills that is based on the Lake Heart Island master's array of billion meteorites, "Meteor Star", is used especially to block against his attack. Despite that and having a protective armor, everything was unexpectedly blasted apart by him." Xue Ying was somewhat dismayed.
The array formation of billion meteors was the protective formation of the Lake Heart Island. It specialized most in defense.
When Xue Ying was cultivating at the Black Fog Sea, he had contacted the members of the Destruction Legion, chatting with them, and asked them to pass down some information on the meteor formation array.
At that time, the lonely members had eagerly said: "We from the Lake Heart Island have studied the meteor formation array many times. All of us have gained something from it and had recorded down many of those arrays. This is merely the tip of the iceberg and could not be counted as the actual complete meteor formation array. As for the details of the entire formation array, probably only the master understands it."
"This is what I've observed and recorded."
"Brother Dong Bo, this is what I've recorded."
Every one of them was enthusiastic.
When Xue Ying was in closed-door cultivation, he had often discussed the Dao with them. The meteor formation array had become a world and had the profound mysteries of the world inside. Beginning from the profound mysteries of the world, after comprehending billions of meteor arrays, he ultimately embraced an all-inclusive defensive secret skill-Meteor Star.
He believed that with his strength, the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body as well as his defensive spear techniques, if he once again faced the White Sovereign King, he should be able to receive a few more moves.
'This guy's realm is very ordinary-at the stage four World Deity realm. He isn't even comparable to my father-in-law or Elder Disciple Brother Hui Ming.' Xue Ying thought, 'Under my defensive spear techniques, the strength of his fists is reduced by 90% at least! But just this remaining tenth could unexpectedly blast away my spear technique, and even cause my blood to boil underneath my armor.'
'The ultimate Strength, and the ultimate speed.' Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
His realm was low.
But his strength was exceedingly ferocious, and his speed was remarkably fast.
"He did not die?" The ragged-clothed man turned into a stream of light furiously as he rushed over once again.
Xue Ying flew towards the ax while parrying against the attacks at the same time.
"Hong Hong Hong!"
Both sides continued exchanging moves.
Each time Xue Ying was assaulted, he would fly in all directions. He was utterly suppressed and trampled. But because of his sufficiently large strength and the immense superiority of his spear technique, he was could still tangle on with his opponent.
'Soon.'
Although Xue Ying looked as if he was being trampled. In reality, he was moving closer to the ax.
"Hu."
The ragged-clothed man suddenly stopped. He looked at Xue Ying coldly.
Xue Ying ignored him. Even though his opponent stopped moving, Xue Ying was still rushing towards the ax.
"There aren't many opponents that could force me to use my forbidden technique. You have the qualifications of doing so. Recieve my move." The ragged-clothed man suddenly produced a mark in both hands. The many violet-gold patterns on his body suddenly lit up, causing an intense and terrifying energy to pass through his body by the patterns. Eventually, the energy converged towards his two eyebrows, along with his eyebrows as a large amount of light formed in the middle.
At the center between his eyebrows, a third eye suddenly appeared. It looked the same as his other two eyes.
But when Xue Ying was stared at by this eye, he could not help but feel a chill down his spine. At that moment he somewhat cursed inwardly, 'He still has a forbidden skill? With how low his realm is as compared to mine, how could he be this strong? Where did the forefather of the Starting Point find this freak?'

chapters.title: Chapter 633 - Return my Flying Knife
chapters.content:
Chapter 633: Return my Flying Knife
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Being vigilant, Xue Ying did not dare reduce his flying speed. Instead, he flew with all his strength towards where that ax was.
The ragged-clothed male opened his third eye. The image of Xue Ying flying was reflected faintly in that eye.
"Split." The ragged-clothed male coldly said.
Xue Ying who was originally flying at high speed suddenly felt his heart tightening, 'Not good.'
His twisted his body suddenly.
"Si la~"
The void around him shattered like a piece of glass. A brutal dark chasm appeared in the void. This void crack brushed past the twisted body of Xue Ying, giving him the feeling of death.
'This Eden has been constructed by the forefather and is exceptionally stable. He did not release such immense power during the previous battle we had." Other than being disturbed by the power of this move, Xue Ying was also stunned by how abrupt it was. The ragged-clothed male was at five million kilometers away at this moment, yet that attack had descended without warning. Only during the moment that the void was about to be torn did Xue Ying sensed it, yet he had barely twisted his body to evade death.
"Sou."
Even though he perceived danger, Xue Ying remained moving forward at high speed.
"Your luck is not bad to dodge the attack." The ragged-clothed male chuckled coldly. He then used his third eye to once again reflect upon the distant Xue Ying.
"Si la~"
Another long crack formed instantly. The crevice of the void arced by the nose tip of Xue Ying, cutting away a few strands of his hair. Still, Xue Ying was able to evade the attack again.
"Mn?" The ragged-clothed male frowned from a distance. Permitting Xue Ying escape from his attack twice made him feel slightly irritable.
"Again." He released the attack a third time. That third eye of his had reflected Xue Ying deep within it.
Xue Ying who was flying at high speed had sensed the changes in the void. He then used all his effort to evade the attack.
"Si la~"
A black crack that was more than 5,000 kilometers in length and about 100 meters wide had arced across with distortion.
Xue Ying who was moving at high speed might have tried his best to dodge this attack, but this time, the crack brushed past half of his body.
"Pu~" The moment that crack arced by the black armor, it had momentarily paused, allowing Xue Ying to have another chance to move his body. Following which, the crack continued its motion.
His left arm and some flesh by his left waist disappeared.
"Ah!"
Suffering from this attack, Xue Ying rolled a few times in midair. Following that, he stabilized his body, and once again continued at high speed towards the distant ax. The injury by his waist was rapidly recovering, and his left arm was also growing back.
'The Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body's armor could not block this attack.' The color of Xue Ying's face changed. He did not care anymore. He took out the flying knife with his right hand immediately.
The True God weapon Flying Knife was his strongest killing move.
Xue Ying who was originally quite confident of his defense had been forced to use the Flying Knife at this moment. He recalled the words by the white-haired old man, stating how this 'strongest World Deity's body was able to digest True God weapons. That was also why Xue Ying was not in a rush to use his True God weapon.
"Go."
Xue Ying could not care less anymore.
The Flying Knife rapidly disappeared. It flew forward within the Mirage world.
"Hmph hmph, I thought you could evade my attack again." The ragged-clothed male once again charged up another attack. The eye in between his eyebrows began reflecting the image of Xue Ying, yet at this moment, "shua"! A flying knife descended from the Mirage world, appearing right in front of him.
The ragged-clothed male had long discovered this flying knife.
After all, he had grasped hold of the void, and during the moment Xue Ying took out the flying knife, he had discovered it already. But he was too confident of himself since his body was tyrannical-nothing would be able to harm him. Thus, he did not care about that flying knife at all.
"Hong."
A move that was activated using all of Xue Ying's strength along with the 'slaughter Dao'-Floating Blood Knife's Edge.
The flying knife immediately appeared right in front of the ragged-clothed male's third eye.
"Foolish." The ragged-cloth male's third eye immediately closed.
Pu.
The knife tip of the flying knife pierced through the third eye, and at that moment, the flying knife suddenly stopped moving from a high speed! But still, the tip of the flying knife had vigorously pierced through an inch of the third eye-just an inch was enough to stop it from continuing on. There was violet blood flowing down at the position where the third eye was located, and this violet blood was glittering with golden light. The expression of that ragged-clothed male turned savage the next moment.
