"Weng weng weng." The flying knife tried its best to struggle and pull out, yet after penetrating an inch deep, it was seemingly stuck there unmoving.
"What!" Xue Ying had a huge shock in his heart. The flying knife could not be collected back!
It was stuck rigidly on the other party's third eye, and no matter what he did, it could not be moved!
The ragged-clothed male extended his hand to pull out the flying knife from his third eye. He then opened his mouth casually and swallowed this flying knife with a mouth.
This scene made Xue Ying feel both frustrated and anxious at the same time, 'He swallowed it?'
That was also the reason why he was not too willing to use the flying knife.
But if he did not employ the knife, he would just be killed. By then, all his treasures would be left here as well.
"Hu."
Even though he was feeling angry and anxious, Xue Ying remained flying at high speed towards the ax. The other party had already swallowed the flying knife, and he could not collect it back. If that's the case, he had to pull out the ax successfully.
The ragged-clothed male's third eye opened once again, though its pupil had an injury that was rapidly recovering.
"Damn." The ragged-clothed male glared coldly at Xue Ying. The distance between the two party was too far; there was not enough time for him rely on speed to slowly chase after him. He could only entrust his hope on his killing move.
Xue Ying remained flying at high speed; the distance between him and the ax was getting closer.
Even though he had lost his True God weapon flying knife…
It had stopped the other party's attack for a moment, forcing him to recover. This added time had significantly increased the survivability of Xue Ying! After all, the other party could very well release three to four more attacks during this recovery period.
"Quick quick quick." The ragged-clothed male was feeling anxious too. The injury of his third eye was healing.
'I've reached.'
Xue Ying gritted his teeth. He rushed with all his strength towards that mountain peak.
"Si la~" During the moment the third eye was fully recovered, the ragged-clothed male once again began charging his attack.
"Quick, faster!" Xue Ying squeezed his body to its limit. He could feel the incoming void crack and had to shift his body. "Hua~" the void crack brushed by the knee of Xue Ying, causing everything below it to disappear. Still, Xue Ying remained flying at high speed, reaching that mountain peak finally and grabbing the ax.
"Hong."
Exerting strength, at the juncture when the ax stopped moving, Xue Ying began kneeling down on the mountain peak. Everything beneath his knee was rapidly re-growing. Xue Ying used all his strength to pull that ax out before finally with a 'hong', it was out of the mountain peak.
Xue Ying whose legs had just fully recovered, stood on the mountain peak while raising the golden ax in one hand. He stared at the distant ragged-clothed male.
That ragged-clothed male stood there in a daze. He then sighed.
"I win. Return me my flying knife." Xue Ying shouted out.
"You say this?" The ragged-clothed male spat out, causing light to fly out of his mouth. He then extended his hand, showing a twisted flying knife on it. The flying knife was currently covered in cracks.
Xue Ying did not dare believe as he looked. How long had he swallowed the flying knife, yet it had turned into such a state?

chapters.title: Chapter 634 - Wild Dog
chapters.content:
Chapter 634: Wild Dog
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"For you to survive from me and pull that ax out meant that you are quite strong." The ragged-clothed male grabbed hold of the flying knife which was full of cracks. He casually threw it, causing the knife to fly as a stream of light towards Xue Ying.
Xue Ying extended his hand to receive it. He was anxiously asking for it for fear that the other party's body would completely digest the flying knife.
Looking downwards, even though he did not spend much time pulling out the ax, this flying knife seemed to be full of damages and was half-broken already.
He attempted to control it. The flying knife 'ohmed' with some slight vibration.
'The internal core Dao is completely fine, but the knife's exterior body has been damaged.' Xue Ying felt heartache, 'It seems that I'll have to find someone specialized in refining weapons to help repair it.'
If the inherent core 'Dao' were damaged, then this True God weapon would be completely wasted.
"It's just a true god weapon. Why the need to feel such heartache?" The ragged-clothed male sneered, "I've already destroyed a pile of True God weapons before, and those weapons aren't as useful as my fist. Brat, I hope that the next time you come, you still able to survive." Saying that he rushed downwards. The mountains beneath were already beginning to re-freeze completely.
The ragged-clothed male casually pointed downwards.
Hua.
Countless frost rapidly condensed, condensing into a frosty mountain peak. The frosty mountain peak was even split open right down the middle, causing an enormous fissure to form.
The ragged-clothed male directly flew downwards, following along the crack before entering the deep recesses of the mountain peak of this frosty mountain peak. Following that, he once again entered deep sleep. The two sides of the frosty mountain peak soon closed up.
"Forefather might have given him his full memories, but it is only a minor duplication of his battle memory. He lacks in other areas like emotions." The white-haired man took a step from afar before reaching the side of Xue Ying. He casually said, "He then created him. Forefather did so firstly because of wanting to research the profound mysteries of his body, and secondly because he wanted to give the little brats coming here in the future a little trial."
"This difficulty seems too high." Xue Ying sighed. The other party's absolute move was able to directly tear through the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor of his. Such an offensive strength was so much stronger than even White Sovereign King!
Naturally, the other party was lacking in the realm too.
Fighting with him head-on, Xue Ying was able to dissipate off 90% of the incoming impact.
If his realm were high enough, there would be no hope at all.
"Thus, we do not require you to defeat him. As long as you pull out the ax under his attack, it'll be fine." The white-haired old man chuckled, "Even so, the majority will die during the first time they enter the Starting Ground."
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
Even he had succeeded partly because of luck.
If not for the flying knife which injured the other party's eyes, he would be able to employ the absolute move a few more times. Xue Ying might just lose his life in the process.
"It has been a while since any stage four World Deities came." The white-haired old man said, "The talismans are located around different parts of the cosmos. It is usually difficult to even get to those places. The majority of those who came have reached the 'World Realm', and some even entered when they were at the 'Creation Realm' or 'Ruler Realm'."
"I have also lucked out." Xue Ying laughed. He had gotten the first piece of talisman from deep within the Lake Heart Island. Would ordinary stage four World Deity dare to enter? He had also run all the way in to save his father-in-law. He then obtained the second piece from the Dark Abyss. But because he had the first piece, he was able to sense the presence of the second piece after entering the Three Chief Sacred Mountain, substantially reducing the difficulty of searching for it.
"Obtaining the talisman could be luck, but if you want to survive, you'll have to rely on your strength." The white-haired old man said.
The two were chatting as they flew.
Xue Ying soon saw the ripple forming ahead of him. That was the exit.
Before leaving, Xue Ying turned back and gave the place another look. That golden ax remained stuck in the distant mountain peak. That frosty mountain peak still contained that terrifying World Deity sleeping within.
'No matter what, I've succeeded.' Xue Ying celebrated inwardly.
"Sou."
He flew out of the exit with the white-haired old man.
…
As they left, they were banished out from that big tree, landing on the ground.
Xue Ying felt himself turning into a mortal once again. He looked around-this place was still that small land located within the chaotic void which he arrived after using the talisman.
"World Deity realm, World Realm, Opening Realm, and Ruler Realm. Any of these realms can be used to enter once and experience danger. They are all 'nine deaths, one lives'. Furthermore, only those who stood at the apex of the similar realm will qualify for the standard of 'nine deaths and one lives'." The white-haired old man sighed, "The ordinary and weaker ones will only be sending themselves to their deaths."
Xue Ying agreed with that.
Like that strongest World Deity, just the great frost aura he emitted could freeze his luminous sun force to the extent that it dissipated! Thus, ordinary stage four World Deities would die from freezing. The more talented a stage four World Deity was-one who could surpass realms and battle-the higher the chances of surviving, yet it was still low. Xue Ying as an ultra heaven-shattering talent could barely survive.
"Thus, I'll be overjoyed every time someone succeeds." The white-haired old man pointed to the central three-story grass house located away, "Go, let's go there. Since you succeeded, there'll naturally be benefits. You should think through whether you want to cultivate techniques, absolute arts or if you want some weapons or treasures. The flying knife you have is damaged, so if you decided on a weapon, you could get a True God weapon better than your flying knife. You should consider what exactly you want. In a moment, you'll have to make your decision."
"Mn." Xue Ying was truly looking forward to it.
Starting Ground, it was truly tough to even succeed in a place like this. With the identity of that forefather, the reward should be extraordinary too.
The two walked towards the central three-story grass house.
Suddenly-
"Hou~" A black dog came charging out from the grass by the side. Its body was skinny. The dog was currently staring at Xue Ying.
"Dog?" Xue Ying was slightly startled.
"It has been bred by forefather over here." The white-haired old man chuckled, "Forefather has spent a huge effort before refining it for the sake of protecting the Starting Ground! This is also the strongest existence in the Starting Ground."
"It is the strongest existence?" Xue Ying was astonished as he looked at this black dog.
"Hou~ Brat, with your size, you aren't even able to fit the gap of my teeth." The black dog barked, "That time when the swordmaster came, I've bitten off a piece of his meat."
Xue Ying blinked a few times before lowering his voice, "Who is this swordmaster?"
"Swordmaster?"
The white-haired old man had slight amazement as he sighed, "That was a long time ago. Ever since forefather created this Starting Ground, under normal circumstances, one could only depend on the talisman to enter! Furthermore, there are countless lifeforms within the cosmos which could not find the Starting Ground at all. But Sir Swordmaster can discover the Starting Ground and force his way through. He was able to keep his power without obeying the rules. This wild dog has been taught a bad lesson, though it had injured Sir Swordmaster too."
"Sir Swordmaster has arrived and inspected the entire Starting Ground, yet he left without taking a piece of item." The white-haired old man sighed, "With Sir Swordmaster's strength, he is indeed scornful of this place."
"Swordmaster?" Xue Ying felt puzzled.
He had never heard of him before.
"Oh, Swordmaster is also the one you guys call Lake Heart Island master." The white-haired old man said.
Xue Ying was stunned.
This number one expert across the many cosmos epochs, 'Lake Heart Island master' had come here before, though he did not depend on the talisman, and had forced his way in? Even still, he had a piece of his flesh bitten off by this wild dog? This wild dog's combat power was indeed extremely terrifying!

chapters.title: Chapter 635 - Pondering in Front of the Grass House
chapters.content:
Chapter 635: Pondering in Front of the Grass House
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The black dog sniffed around Xue Ying before baring his teeth and howled, "Brat, you are just at the World Deity realm and is too weak. The World Deity realm, World realm, Opening realm, and Ruler realm. Master has left behind four levels of trials, and you are at the lowest level. Continue to cultivate." Saying that he wagged his tail before sauntering away.
Xue Ying was speechless.
He had been looked down upon, though the other party was able to injure the Lake Heart Island master, and was especially left behind by forefather to protect this Starting Ground. Thus, it had the qualifications to speak about him.
"It is rare for those at World Deity realm to come here." The white-haired old man laughed too, "Go go go, let us go over."
Saying that they continued walking towards the central three-story grass house.
As Xue Ying followed along, he asked, "Are there treasures in that three-story grass house?"
The white-haired old man gave a mysterious laugh, "Don't think it is just a three-story grass house. It is the most important place within the entire Starting Ground. Forefather has once lived that central grass house and only those who passed the Ruler realm trial have the qualifications to enter. To the left of the grass house… one must pass through the trial of the Opening realm before being able to enter."
"Then what about the right house?" Xue Ying asked, "Are we heading to the grass house on the right?"
"It is I who will enter!" The white-haired old man shook his head, "You are at the World Deity realm and do not have the qualifications to enter. The right grass house is a treasury. You should consider properly at this moment what treasure you want. I'll enter and bring it over for you!"
Xue Ying nodded.
At the same time, he felt helpless.
The lowest World Deity realm and World realm seemed not to be emphasized upon by that forefather. One did not even have the qualifications to enter the grass house.
Opening realm meant Paragons. And one realm above that was the Rulers.
The Ruler realm was where Bloodshed God Emperor, Temporal Island Lord, and other Rulers were at.
Only those at these two levels had the qualifications to enter the grass house!
…
Xue Ying and the old man were just like mortals. They did not walk at a fast speed and had spent quite some time before finally getting close to the grass house.
"We are here." Xue Ying looked at the grass house just one to two hundred meters away. At that moment, he felt his heart blazing.
As he walked closer…
Suddenly, the surrounding world by the grass house started distorting in his eyes. He was walking step by step towards it, yet the grass house remained forever there with its distance unchanged.
"This, what is happening?" Xue Ying felt stunned. At the same time, he felt his combat power rapidly recovering.
"Reaching the grass house, your combat power will completely recover." The white-haired old man said, "As for the transformation of the surrounding world, even though the grass house might be in front of your eyes, in reality, it is under the protection of countless of worlds. If not for me bringing you over, if an outsider is attacking his way in, it will be almost impossible for him to get through the countless of worlds and reach the grass house. Naturally, swordmaster has achieved it once, and the moment he decided to travel forward, nothing could obstruct him at all."
Xue Ying nodded.
This forefather would undoubtedly have set some protection.
Xue Ying continued moving forward while observing the many distorted worlds.
'So interesting.' Xue Ying was thoroughly observing it, 'Forefather is very amazing. His operation of the world has reached an unfathomable stage. It is so much more profound than all those world arrays I've seen in that broken scroll or the experiences and from the Lake Heart Island.'
'The world should be a real world. However, it is layered with distortion as if they are all illusory.'
'If not for someone guiding me along, I might just enter the illusory world and be trapped inside for eternity.'
Xue Ying sighed.
This was an illusory world. But the world within the illusion did not seem any different from the 'real world'! Thus, if he immersed himself within, it would become challenging to escape from it.
This method set by the forefather of the Starting Ground was more profound than the 'Mirage Dao' within his True God weapon flying knife.
'It doesn't seem intentional.' Xue Ying sighed as he continued observing.
As he walked, Xue Ying's footstep became slower and slower. The white-haired old man noticed this before chuckling. He had also slowed down his steps. He did not rush Xue Ying, and neither did he say anything! Because anyone who entered… had no limits to the time they could stay here in the Starting Ground! It was alright even if they remained here until the Cosmos Apocalypse.
Gradually, Xue Ying walked slower and slower and eventually stopped moving. He then closed his eyes.
'Who would have thought that the illusory world which forefather set has given him enlightenment.' The white-haired old man was grinning.
…
Xue Ying closed his eyes.
Cultivating for 700,000 years, he had consolidated the teachings by that commander from the Destruction Legion, teachings from Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, and thus, he did not dare to seek power deliberately! But with his comprehension ability, it was not challenging to comprehend the other Deity hearts at all. Thus, Xue Ying was able to comprehend them with most of his concentration remained on studying the profound mysteries of the world.
Profound mysteries of the world had many similarities with the profound mysteries of the mirage.
Xue Ying had comprehended both of them together. That was how he could create the five big secret skills. He wanted to use the world in encompassing the other Deity hearts to grasp hold of the complete law of the world.
Saying that it was 700,000 years, adding up the time-accelerated time, he had spent so much more time on studying the profound mysteries of the world.
And at this moment-
The many layers of illusory world surrounding the grass house within the Starting Ground had given Xue Ying a glimpse the more profound 'world', seeing a more formidable usage of the profound mysteries of the world. Naturally, he was enlightened.
In his mind, countless comprehension was clashing together as inspirations formed continuously!
Day passed by day.
Reaching the level of Xue Ying, the appearance of many inspirations would allow one to deduce even deeper. When the many profound mysteries were fused together, he would extrapolate them before receiving a new appreciation towards the 'world'. This process naturally required time.
'I wonder how long this brat will cultivate for.' The white-haired old man who had sat down on his butt began lying back and sleep.
In the blink of an eye, it had been a year and two months.
The comprehension and inferring within the mind of Xue Ying was fusing together, forming a grand new understanding! And at this moment…
'This is…'
Xue Ying fell in a daze.
"Hong!"
Just like a seed within the soil, the seed would eventually break the surface and germinate. It would form a fruit.
Xue Ying opened his eyes, looking at the many layers of the distorted world. This was the illusory world. Formerly, he felt that they were extraordinarily profound and unfathomable, yet at this moment, under his observation, he could vaguely see the shapeless law operating around these worlds before forming a vast illusory world. Xue Ying was able to spy upon this unformed law.
'The law of the world is just like lock and chain. The moment one becomes imprisoned, he would always be within the enclosure of prison no matter what he comprehended. Only by breaking it could he open his path, grasping everything he has understood." Xue Ying could feel the strength he had now-this was entirely his strength! He could kill and suppress the other, and nobody could take away this strength from him.
"Realm should be fundamental." Xue Ying muttered.
"Mn?" The white-haired old man who had been sleeping woke up all of a sudden. He opened his eyes and looked at Xue Ying who was by his side.
Xue Ying stood there. His entire figure seemed illusory and real at the same time.
He was a real person, yet he appeared unreal as if he was of one entity with the countless illusory worlds.
"Opening realm?" The white-haired old man had some uncertainty and suspicions.

chapters.title: Chapter 636 - Opening Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 636: Opening Realm
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The white-haired old man looked carefully with his eyes wide open. He was not a true lifeform. Nonetheless, he had been following forefather for so long his horizons had expanded and become extraordinary. Thus, it was reasonable for him to attest to the scene that was happening in front of him like that when one attained the 'opening realm'.
"Directly leaping from the World Deity realm to the Opening realm?" The white-haired old man did not dare believe, "This brat who came this time has such high comprehension ability?"
Ordinary breakthroughs would be from the World Deity realm to the 'World realm'. After grasping hold of the complete law of the world, they would eventually jump out of the 'world prison' and open their Dao path that rode above the law of the world.
But as a stage four World Deity, he had yet to grasp hold of the complete law and had instead directly opened a Dao path beyond the law of the world! The difficulty was extremely high.
Those who could do this could be counted with one's finger even in a cosmos epoch!
Before Xue Ying, there was only Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master in this cosmos epoch who had done so. One could see how tough it was! Naturally, this did not imply that the Bloodshed God Emperor, Temporal Island Lord, Primal Master, Pang Yi and the others had a worse comprehension ability as compared to Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master. It was just that they walked the more conventional path of cultivation, transcending before opening their Dao path.
If Xue Ying had not come to the Starting Ground, without observing the defenses left behind by forefather at the three-story grass house, the 'illusory world', he might first transcend after gaining some enlightenment before opening his Dao path via a long period of accumulation to become a Paragon.
But there were no 'ifs' during cultivation!
After comprehending it, the lifeform would reach a higher level. There was no way even if he wanted to move back.
'This is the feeling of Paragons?' Xue Ying revealed a grin.
Very beautiful.
His body was just like an illusion and real at the same time. If the enemy came attacking him, they could not touch him at all! His body was genuinely illusory.
That was the realm.
Even the strongest World Deities with extreme strength and speed and were fiercer than White Sovereign King could not touch Xue Ying if they met him.
The moment the realm broke through, the gap between parties would become enormous.
'I should have comprehended the Mirage Dao?' Xue Ying silently pondered.
The Mirage Dao rode above the law of the world! A vast illusory world could encompass many ordinary worlds. Xue Ying could attack the other party, yet the other party could not strike him since he was located within the illusory world.
'My teacher can become the number one assassin in the entire Deity world and Abyss, other than his mighty direct combative strength, more importantly, it is because he specialized stealth with his Dao of Shadow.' Xue Ying thought, 'And now, I could use the Dao that I opened in the same way.'
"But this Mirage Dao does not increase my offense at all." Xue Ying shook his head inwardly.
The Dao of Mirage could construct a 'mirage world'. This mirage world was an independent world in itself outside the ordinary world, and naturally, it was very mythical. But it did not improve his offensive strength at all.
Sometimes, there must be losses with gains.
Like Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master's 'Dao of Destructive Lightning, his body could turn into lightning, allowing his speed and offensive strength to reach a terrifying stage. His body protection was not bad, but that's it! He lacked survival capabilities! When compared to the 'Leaf Saint' who was supporting the floor of the Paragons, he could not even compare to him. That was why Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master had to depend on a Ruler.
Paragon Huo Cheng was similar. He lacked in the survival aspect.
And those who could genuinely become independent without relying on any other Rulers, and even dared to challenge them like Monarch Green, Great Destruction Heavenly Emperor, Water Devil King and White Sovereign King all had their formidable survival methods. Rulers could hardly kill them.
'If discussing 'Dao' is for surviving, then the Daos which teacher and I have should be considered ranked in the top.' Xue Ying chuckled. But still, other than the Dao of Shadow, the Bloodshed God Emperor had the Dao of Destruction and Dao of Bloodshed too! Naturally, his strength reached a terrifying stage.
'But I have just opened up my Dao path and is still immature.' Because his teacher had given him detailed information regarding the experts within the cosmos, Xue Ying was able to determine how strong he was. Xue Ying felt satisfied nevertheless for being able to open the 'Dao of Mirage'. If Paragons could choose, they would be willing to select a Dao that improved their survival capabilities.
Survival is essential. As for offensive methods? One could improve his strength via many other ways.
"Hua."
Xue Ying stood there.
Illusions began extending in all directions. Because he was under the effect of the illusory world, the 'illusory world' which Xue Ying opened up had just spread to the extent of hundred meters wide before being forced to stop by the illusory world left behind by the forefather.
'This is the world that I created that is entirely my strength.' Xue Ying stood here firmly on the illusory world.
'The feeling is wonderful.'
Xue Ying chuckled.
'Why did teacher remind me not to seek power that much? And why is he so afraid that I'll open my Dao path first?' Xue Ying frowned inwardly, 'Opening up the Dao path first will only make it harder to transcend. That's all."
"Brat, you have reached the Opening realm?" The white-haired old man saw Xue Ying sulking before deciding to ask.
Only then did Xue Ying wake up from his contemplation. He replied, "I apologize for making senior wait here for me for so long."
"Hahaha, my life is eternal, so it doesn't matter if I spend more time with you." The white-haired old man continued, "I am asking you this. Have you reached the Opening realm?"
"Yes." Xue Ying nodded.
"You have truly jumped from the World Deity realm to the Opening realm." The white-haired old man praised, "Oh right, how long have you cultivated for?"
"More than a million years. Adding up the time spent in a time-accelerated environment, it should be a few dozen million years I guess." Xue Ying replied.
The white-haired old man was startled before sighing, "Cultivating for such a short period and yet you have reached the Opening realm. Formidable, amazing."
Xue Ying laughed and helplessly responded, "I am quite happy, though I feel a little troubled now that I have opened my Dao path… it will be harder to transcend."
"Isn't it okay if you just become a Ruler?" The white-haired old man said as a matter of fact.
"Becoming Ruler is too difficult!" Xue Ying felt worried.
"Difficult? You have reached the Opening realm within a million years, yet you aren't confident about becoming a Ruler?" The white-haired old man snorted, "You opened up a Dao path, and your true deity heart is much stronger than the True Gods! You can live until the cosmos collapse. Unless you are not confident about becoming a Ruler during this period?"
Xue Ying was clear on this point too.
Deity Heart had laws fusing into one's soul. Comprehending a Ddao' would cause it to become stronger.
That was also the reason why Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master could survive until now! Those weaker ordinary World Deities had thought that Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master must have some heaven-shattering absolute art that gave him the ability to survive for so long. Looking back, it was felt like a joke! The primary reason was that many World Deities were delusional about an absolute art that could elongate their lifespan.
"How long does this cosmos epoch have before it enters an apocalypse?" Xue Ying asked.
"It is still very early-only a little more than half the epoch has passed." The white-haired old man said, "Naturally, the length of a cosmos epoch isn't absolute. If this epoch suffers from huge destruction, it'll enter apocalypse sooner."
"Understood." Xue Ying was the material realm territory lord and naturally knew of this logic.
Similarly, mortals had differing lifespans.
A mortal world would also have a differing length of 'life'.
This cosmos epoch would naturally have a differing period before it would enter the apocalypse. If it were protected well enough and suffer from little damage, it would typically survive for a more extended period.
"You just cultivated for a million years before reaching the Opening realm. What are you afraid of? You have plenty of time to cultivate." The white-haired old man said, "As long as you become a Ruler before the end of this cosmos, it'll be fine."
"What if I don't become a Ruler?" Xue Ying asked.
"The moment a cosmos epoch ends, the River of Time will bring all those lives situated within it down together in annihilation! If you are stuck inside, you will naturally be exterminated too." The white-haired old man said.
"Those who transcended will not suffer from annihilation?" Xue Ying asked.
"Alright." The white-haired old man's expression suddenly turned solemn. It became much gloomy, "Don't ask anymore."
Xue Ying was stunned.
Ever since he came to the Starting Ground, this white-haired old man had always been amicable. The moment he asked about the end of the cosmos epoch and the fate of those who transcended from the River of Time, this white-haired old man became irate.
That caused many thoughts to arise in Xue Ying's heart.
But still, this conversation calmed him down.
That's right.
He had opened his Dao within a million years. Why could he not become a Ruler before the cosmos apocalypse? If he could not, then he could only blame himself.
"Let us continue." the white-haired old man continued walking on.
Xue Ying hurried behind.
This time, they walked at a faster pace. They were flying and crossing the world. He felt that this white-haired old man wasn't feeling good, and thus, Xue Ying did not let his mind wander on to ponder about this 'illusory world'. It would not be late to comprehend it after acquiring the treasure from the grass house.
"We're here." The white-haired old man stopped.
Xue Ying and the white-haired old man stood before the grass house.
"Have you decided?" The white-haired old man asked, "Regardless of whether you want the cultivation techniques from other cosmos or absolute arts, or even weapons and treasures and anything you can think of. Just choose one from the above."

chapters.title: Chapter 637 - Returning Home
chapters.content:
Chapter 637: Returning Home
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying chuckled, "Senior, may I ask if there is anything that can greatly increase my offensive power?"
"Offensive power?" The white-haired old man frowned, "There are indeed three types of unique cultivation methods from other cosmos that can greatly increase your combat power, but it's a pity that you don't have the qualifications to get them. That's because you have only succeeded in surviving the World Deity trial, and the treasures you can select are the lowest leveled ones."
Xue Ying laughed involuntarily.
Alright, the lowest leveled ones.
"Are you certain that you need one of the offensive types? The absolute arts I have include those for escaping, domain-related ones…" The white-haired old man said.
"Offensive types." Xue Ying nodded.
He had opened the 'Dao of Mirage', and had two absolute arts, "Luminous Sun", and "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" with him. He only had to improve his offense now.
"You should have some absolute arts with you. Otherwise, you will not be so strong in the World Deity realm. However, there is no way I could get an offensive absolute art that far eclipsed those you have previously learned for you." The white-haired old man shook his head, "Not just cultivation methods or absolute arts, anything that can greatly improve your strength is precious. Only if you passed the World trial would you have a few options to select from."
Xue Ying was dumbstruck.
Completely eclipsing those absolute arts which he had learned? He had acquired an absolute art from the Destruction Legion and the other from his teacher. The degree of preciousness was unimaginable! Who would have thought that getting through the 'World realm' trial would grant him a chance to obtain an even more profound absolute art. It's a pity that he had just gotten through the World Deity realm trial.
"Only weapons can satisfy you." The white-haired old man said, "Weapons are external, and could improve your combat power directly. But comparably, it is valued at a lower rate as compared to the highest-leveled cultivation methods and absolute arts."
"Then weapon it'll be." Xue Ying nodded, "My future opponents are the Paragons and the Rulers, so I will need a weapon that can threaten them."
"Rest assured. I'll select the most appropriate weapon for you within the boundary demarcated by forefather." The white-haired old man laughed before pushing open the wooden door to the grass house.
The moment the door was opened, it was a piece of darkness within the grass house. It seemed like a storm within, and Xue Ying could hardly perceive what was inside; he only got a sense of danger from it.
'I wonder what he'll get for me.' Xue Ying thought to himself.
A moment after the white-haired old man entered.
"Hua."
He walked out of the house again. Casually closing the door, he was currently holding on to a black spear, though the head of this spear was entirely crimson. There was an exceptionally unremarkable crimson pattern intertwining each other on its body.
"If we are talking about weapons, there are too many of them to choose from. We have a large collection of weapons casually refined by the forefather and occasionally acquired by him." The white-haired old man laughed, "Seeing that you are using a spear, I've chosen one for you. This spear is called the Blood Serpent Spear. It has the 'Dao of slaughter' within. It should be a Ruler who refined this spear. After it came to the hands of the forefather, he had improved the Dao of Slaughter within to the Ruler realm. Other than that, the extremely sinister 'Blood Serpent Venom' is applied to this killing weapon. The Blood Serpent Venom is fatal to anyone with a weaker physique. The moment you pierce through them, it could cause their deaths. Those who have a stronger body might survive from this venom, yet the venom will wreck your opponents' body, making it tough for them to recover during battle."
Xue Ying looked at this black-colored spear and instantly fell in love with it. Hearing the introduction from the old man, he became even more wild with joy.
A huge sum.
His flying knife might have two types of Daos within it, but they were both at the Opening realm.
There was only a single Dao within that spear, yet it was at the Ruler realm! Furthermore, it was applied with the supremely terrifying 'Blood Serpent Venom'. Paragons would not care about average True God weapons, but a True God weapon with a Ruler realm 'Dao' was enough for them to covet over it.
"Take it." The white-haired old man passed it over, "The battle you had previously was at the World Deity realm. Now that you are at the Opening realm, the next trial you can participate will naturally be at the level of the Opening realm. That will be utterly different. The rewards you get will also be a hundred or a thousand times better! Those are treasures which will make even Rulers envy."
"Opening realm trial?" Xue Ying chuckled, "By then when I am at the Paragon realm, it will be nine deaths and one life right?"
"Right, the condition is for you to survive." The white-haired old man did not hide the fact.
Xue Ying laughed.
Experiencing this, he already knew of the temper of that white-haired old man.
The trials set would require one to be at the peak level. How strong was he as a World Deity? But it was extremely dangerous nonetheless.
The trial at the Opening realm level would be much more difficult, and there would be an opponent stronger than that strongest World Deity.
"I'll go and have a look at that illusory world before leaving." Xue Ying said, "You won't chase me out right?"
"You can stay however long you want." The white-haired old man nodded before slowly walking away. The surrounding illusory world began distorting layer by layer, and he soon disappeared after.
Xue Ying though lowered his head as he looked at the spear in his hand.
"Blood Serpent Spear?" Xue Ying tried refining it, "The True God weapon flying knife might have a slaughter Dao too, but firstly, it seems that the two aren't the same and secondly, the Dao inherent within this Blood Serpent Spea has reached the Ruler realm. Even refining it will most likely take me a long time."
Even though the weapon was formidable, his current realm had reached a more profound level. He was at the Opening realm now, and was at the Paragon level! Thus, refining it was still achievable.
"Hua." Keeping the weapons, Xue Ying entered this illusory world. The layers of distorted world began appearing, and he started studying them earnestly.
…
Time flowed. In the blink of an eye, five years passed.
Xue Ying walked on this little land at the Starting Ground within the chaotic void. He soon found the white-haired old man who was lying in the grass.
"Senior." Xue Ying shouted out.
The white-haired old man stretched as he woke up. Only after that did he stand up and glanced at Xue Ying, "Planning to leave?"
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
"Where to?" The white-haired old man asked.
"My hometown Xia Clan world. Does senior know of it?" Xue Ying asked.
"I know. In this cosmos epoch of yours, nothing can escape from me." The white-haired old man said, "Alright, I'll send you over at this moment."
Xue Ying did not have the time to say anything. He only felt warm energy enveloping him.
Just like coming here, it felt truly comfortable. After the time taken to blink, the scene in front transformed. Being a World Deity realm territory lord, Xue Ying promptly understood that he had arrived at his hometown-Xia Clan world.
'Teleporting me even into the material realm.' Xue Ying sighed inwardly. At the same time, he was overlooking the castle situated on top of the peak of a chain of mountains. That was where he grew up when he was young-Snowrock Castle.
'He has even directly sent me to the Snowrock Castle.'
Xue Ying looked up at the void. His vision had long penetrated through the mortal realm, seeing the countless mortal worlds revolving about outside. He had also observed that bigger Deity world situated beyond the many mortal worlds!
Xue Ying could see directly through to the Deity world, "I am back. The other party will most likely know that I am back soon enough."
The Ancestor Mother Religion could assassinate him the previous time even though they do not have karma meant that they must have borrowed a method of karma to pursue after him. For instance, those who relied on them could very well be used to locate him using karma.
His teacher Bloodshed God Emperor should know that he is back.
Xue Ying touched his lower chin, "I wonder what Teacher will think after finding out that I have entered the Opening realm."
"Sou."
He was too lazy to think anymore. Soon, he turned into a stream of light before flying happily above the Xia Clan world.
His realm had substantially increased; Xue Ying felt relatively pleased.

chapters.title: Chapter 638 - Law of the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 638: Law of the World
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying flew in the sky above the Xia Clan world. He looked at the world below. There were many villages, and the human population was ten times that in the past. In the distant, he could see many Transcendent flying across the sky. There were many humans taking root in places that included the Mountain Range of Destruction and the northern Great Snowy Plains; they had used Transcendental methods to create an environment suitable for living.
'The current Xia Clan has a more conducive environment to cultivate now as compared to the past.' Xue Ying was satisfied. When he was young, because his father was a noble, that was how he could obtain the Qi cultivation method. Now, everyone from the Xia Clan could receive Qi cultivation methods or magic techniques.
A million years down the road, the entire Xia Clan had a massive change. Just the number of Transcendents numbered tens of thousands in the Xia Clan-that was a hundred times more than his generation.
"Sou."
Xue Ying turned into a stream of light before landing on a beach.
The azure seawater was lightly charging on the snowy-white beach. There were quite a few people on this beach; they were all wearing beachwear and enjoying themselves. Women, though, were more conservative in their choice of attire.
"This section of beach belongs to the Transcendent family, Nancheng County's Mo Clan." Two young men in beachwear were chatting as they walked side by side.
"Mo Clan? Nancheng County's Mo Clan holds quite a lot of power around it. Their clan should have at least three Transcendents right?"
"Mn, three Transcendents is a number which our county can't compare with. It is enough to rule over the entire territory in this little place. Let's not talk about this. It has been a long time since we could relax. After a few days, we will be entering the Crimson Rock Mountain World for training. By then, more than half of us will be eliminated."
"I've heard the training is set up by our clan and a sect called the Iron Sword Sect within the Crimson Rock Mountain World. Ai, Third Brother, your combat power is high enough to be confident of succeeding, but it'll be dangerous for me. If I have no luck, then I'll become an Alchemist and hope to gain enough merit so that the clan will allow me to undergo body transcendence."
"Be what Alchemist? That is too tough. I've heard that you have quite a good relationship with a beauty from the Dong Bo Clan? The Dong Bo Clan is also the clan where Monarch Dong Bo is from! If you were to gain some slight benefits, then you will be able to enjoy yourself already."
"Honestly speaking, this Big Missy from the Dong Bo Clan is indeed beautiful, yet her temper is… I can't stand it!"
"What if she pays you?"
"That'll take my life!"
The two young men were chatting.
Not far away, a young man who was currently under the sun eating fruits turned sullen. He did not even want her even if she paid him? That was truly face-slapping.
'I wonder which lass he is speaking from my clan.' Xue Ying thought. Over the extended period, the Dong Bo Clan had continued expanding. Xia Clan World, Crimson Rock Mountain and even in the Deity World were filled with the descendants from the Dong Bo Clan. There were genuinely many of them.
'When I was young, a Legend ranker was able to become an expert within the County, and Transcendents are enough to cause countless deaths within a County! But now… there are even quite a few Transcendents in a little city.' Xue Ying looked above far away. With his vision, he frequently saw many streams of light arcing through the sky.
Hearing all sorts of discussions happening within the beach, Xue Ying could feel the transformation of an era.
Even though the current Xia Clan did not have an emperor, and that the Xia Clan's Elders were managing it, he, Xue Ying, had still been publicly recognized as the most magnificent Deity in the entire Xia Clan history and was called the 'Xia Emperor'.
"Hua~"
The sea water lightly charged up the shore.
Xue Ying walked along the beach, leaving behind footprints. The surrounding people did not know that this young man was that legendary Monarch Dong Bo from a million years ago who upended the heaven and earth.
As he walked and walked, suddenly, he was on the surface of the sea water, stepping on it as he proceeded on.
"Walking on water?"
"Which Transcendent is he? Or is he a Legend ranker showing off here?"
The many bypassers on the beach were discussing this. Transcendents were seen frequently, and Legend rankers even more so. Seeing someone walk on water was nothing special to them.
******
Xue Ying's heart was no longer present in this world. As he walked on the seawater, looking at the vast ocean, his eyes enjoying the azure-blue sky, the seawater, the islands far away, the sunlight, the many lifeforms underneath the water… an unseen law was controlling everything under his observation. In the past, he had grasped hold of nine grade one Deity Hearts, and now, he had even jumped out of the world prison, opening the 'Dao of Mirage'.
He could overlook the entire law of the world.
Just a moment later, the nine grade one Deity Hearts within his mind began fusing together as one, and naturally, it formed a beautiful and complete law.
'Law of the world?' Xue Ying was stunned, 'I comprehended it just like this?'
That's right.
Previously as he was observing the entire Xia Clan world, Xue Ying had comprehended the entire law of the world. In the past, there was a long period which he had tried all means to comprehend, yet he always lacked that bit. Finally, after he visited the Starting Ground, with his 700,000 years of accumulation in knowledge towards understanding the profound mysteries of the world, he was able to open the 'Dao of Mirage' after observing the great illusory world.
Now that he returned to the Xia Clan World, he had comprehended the law of the world!
'This is, this truly is…' Xue Ying did not know if he should cry or laugh, 'I wanted to comprehend yet I couldn't! Now that I am not seeking to do so, I have comprehended it. Such a pity that it is too late!'
He understood.
Because he had comprehended the Dao of Mirage and that he was able to jump out of the world prison, he would naturally be able to view the law of the world and comprehend it more efficiently.
'It's too late, too late. Now that I am in the Opening realm, this law of the world is unable to allow me to transcend.' Xue Ying shook his head. Looking forward, seeing through the world, he was able to see the vast river behind it.
This broad river covered the entire cosmos, piercing through the material realm, the Deity world, and even the Dark Abyss.
Countless lives were immersed within.
Amongst which, there was an immensely towering figure. It was none other than Xue Ying! With his figure now, it was much bigger than that when he saw at the Dark Abyss. The width of his waist had occupied one-tenth of the entire vast river of time! Compared to Xue Ying's colossal figure, the broad River of Time seemed to be a little river.
The river flow was encircling him as his figure was just too huge.
"He!"
The vast Xue Ying operated the law of the world and tried his best to escape from the river using the Dao of Mirage. "Hong long long", the surrounding river was surging, and the fiercer he pulled himself, the stronger the river restricted him. Xue Ying was doing his best to struggle forward, and he had even gotten half of his body out of the river surface, yet his legs were being restricted by the water, preventing him from escaping.
"Ai." Xue Ying gave up. His body fell back in.
'Indeed, as they say, I've reached a higher realm of life when I broke through to the Opening realm. Just the law of the world is unable to allow me to escape from it.' Xue Ying lightly shook his head, 'I will have to reach the Ruler realm before being able to escape from it.'
…
Standing on top of the Xia clan world ocean, even though he had comprehended the law of the world, he remained as calm as ever; this was within his expectations.
'I'll hurry and convert my realm into true combat power.' Xue Ying disappeared amidst the ocean as he returned to the Cultivation Eden, Crimson Dust Island.

chapters.content:
Chapter 639: Huge Breakthrough (End of Volume 20)
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within a cultivation room on Crimson Dust Island.
There were a total of 81 fiery-red circular inlays above the cultivation room. These inlays formed an array, covering the entire room with a tier of red light. On the surface of the cultivation room, there was a block of wood laid that was as black as ink. Looking at it from another perspective, one could see strands of violet light revolving on this wood. There were two silver silk praying mats placed on top of the wooden surface as well.
The black-robed Xue Ying and the white-robed Xue Ying were both seated respectively on a praying mat each.
Because his true body continued cultivating for extended periods here, after being bestowed the 'Black Fog Sea', Xue Ying had paid an enormous price to collect all sorts of treasures to build this cultivation room.
"Hua."
The Blood Serpent Spear was floating in front of the white-robed Xue Ying. Many strands of consciousness were continuously permeating through the spear as Xue Ying pondered over and attempted to refine it.
And on the other side, the black-robed Xue Ying was silently comprehending the "Luminous Sun" and the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body"-these two absolute arts. Since he had comprehended the law of the world and even opened the 'Dao of Mirage', his realm was comparable to that of Paragons. The fifth volume of "Luminous Sun" and the fifth level of "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" were naturally easier for him to comprehend, though he had to spend some effort in doing so.
15 years had passed in the real world, yet in reality, he was cultivating in an environment of a hundred times time-acceleration.
The black-robed Xue Ying was seated on top of the silver silk praying mat. Many gray fruits were floating in front of him, and also a crimson stone that was fist-sized, and many other crimson wooden pieces.
"Almost there." The black-robed Xue Ying extended his hand to grab that fist-sized crimson stone. He then bit on it, releasing sounds of 'ka cha ka cha'. The crimson stone had been chewed into pieces by him before he swallowed it. There was a total of 18 gray fruits and 30 fragments of crimson wooden pieces that were full of life energy, which had been eaten by Xue Ying.
'Eating fruits is fine, but why must I be eating stone and wood…' Xue Ying muttered inwardly, 'I wonder what the inspiration that led to the Lake Heart Island master to craft this cultivation method was.'
He then closed his eyes and began operating the fifth level of the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body.
His body had long been strengthened to the fifth level, though the black armor on the surface of his body required external materials to condense. Xue Ying did not dare to absorb those precious materials into his body after eating them. They would eventually be fused together with energy into forming the black armor, allowing the fourth level black armor to evolve and reach the next level.
Finally, a layer of entirely new black armor floated on the surface of his body. This armor even had a layer of dark light revolving on it.
'The fifth volume fourth boundary of "Luminous Sun" and the fifth level of "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" are both completed.' Xue Ying felt the strength in his body which far transcended that previously.
It was to note that reaching the fourth boundary realm of the fifth volume for "Luminous Sun" was almost impossible for ordinary True Gods. Most could only reach the fourth boundary after jumping out of the world prison and open their Dao!
The fifth level of the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" similarly required one to escape from the world prison before learning it.
Even though it was the fifth level, most had to open a Dao before they could train in it successfully. Otherwise, one could comprehend the third boundary realm of the fifth volume for the "Luminous Sun" at most.
As for after that?
The sixth volume? The sixth level? To reach large success, the chances were minute.
'They are of a different Dao.' Xue Ying slightly shook his head.
Most people could train the lower leveled cultivation.
They were all part of the law of the world. Just like becoming an ordinary True God, everyone would try to understand the law of the world. Thus, the content of absolute arts was similar for all.
But once a person reached the Paragon realm, it would be different since opened 'Dao' differed from person to person.
The sixth volume of "Luminous Sun" was just like the sun, filled with Yang and hardness and could destroy everything.
The sixth level of the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" sought the extremes of substance.
'I'll have to find something appropriate for me.' Xue Ying thought, 'Finding an absolute art that is compatible with the 'Dao of Mirage', or to create an absolute art myself.'
Why was the Great Destruction Heavenly Emperor so powerful?
That's because he created an absolute art, becoming an existence on the same level as Monarch Green.
'Fortunately, I have prepared enough precious materials. Otherwise, I still have to collect them.' Xue Ying chuckled. Previously during the 700,00 years of cultivation, he had also been collecting the materials required to reach a high level for "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" and the "Luminous Sun". Xue Ying had to prepare for transcending to True God! Who would have thought that he had not transcended and instead, he became a Paragon first, making it easy for him to cultivate the absolute arts.
Energy and substance were fusing together as one.
The fifth volume grand perfection realm for luminous sun force merging with the fifth level of the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body allowed Xue Ying to undergo a qualitative change in his body ever since he came out from the Starting Ground.
******
Cultivating the absolute arts took a short time, yet refining the true god weapon 'Blood Serpent Spear' was tedious! He spent a total of 300 years long to do that! It was under the environment of a hundred times time acceleration.
Fortunately, his realm was rather high. If ordinary True Gods were to refine it, it would be normal for them to spend 100 billion years even if they had good comprehension ability. Those who were weaker might not be able to grasp hold of it even if they spent their entire life. After all, this was a Dao of Slaughter at the Ruler realm! The difficulty of refining it was much higher than that for the flying knife.
'Very good.'
Wielding the Blood Serpent Spear, he felt the spear becoming one with him. He could even sense the terrifying aura inherent within the spear that came from the 'Dao of Slaughter'.
'Time to leave.' The black-robed Xue Ying disappeared from the cultivation room as he left the Xia Clan world and proceeded to the Deity world's Black Fog sea.
…
Temporal Island.
"Master, the avatar of Dong Bo Xue Ying has returned to the Deity world." A low voice resounded within the palace hall as a fragrance diffused within.
Within the palace hall, the black-robed black-haired male was currently seated cross-legged on a grass mat. He opened his eyes and had a grin at the edge of his lips, "Oh, this Dong Bo Xue Ying has been assassinated by those from the Ancestor Mother Religion, yet he could stealthily disappear even with his karma! And now, he is finally back in the Deity world, and Bloodshed will most likely summon this disciple of his."
"For him to disappear from mid-air and even hide his karma?"
"What treasure did he get?" The black-robed black-haired male was also pondering in puzzlement.
Xue Ying's karma had disappeared the previous time. The Temporal Island which was always controlling all sorts of places in the cosmos had discovered it very quickly. Because this pertained to the Ancestor Mother Religion, the Temporal Island Lord had personally gone to investigate it. With his accomplishments in time-space… he discovered that Xue Ying had personally escaped from his predicament and wasn't killed. That naturally incited the curiosity of Temporal Island Lord.
And even a strand of greed!
But he was clear that with Xue Ying's method of escapism, even if he acted, Xue Ying should be able to escape as well. Furthermore, he feared the Bloodshed God Emperor even more!
"What exactly is it?"
…
Black Fog Sea.
The black-robed Xue Ying had just returned and reunited with his wife when he received a transmission.
"Xue Ying, come over here." Bloodshed God Emperor transmitted.
"Teacher has summoned me over. I'll go over first." Xue Ying stood up.
Jing Qiu giggled, "The God Emperor has finally summoned you."
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
These few years, he had many good friends asking him about the disappearance of his avatar's karma. Many powerful existences thought that Xue Ying's avatar had been killed! This was a major matter since Xue Ying was someone who could kill 'Bamboo Saint' in a head-on battle. Thus, many people were investigating this matter at that time, as they thought that Xue Ying had been 'killed by the mysterious expert'.
Only when those like Paragon Huo Cheng or Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master asked did Xue Ying reply that it was 'related to the Ancestor Mother Religion'. He did not mention any details, though these people had long known of the Ancestor Mother Religion.
However, despite so many people asking him, his teacher Bloodshed God Emperor did not ask him at all!
…
Leaving the Black Fog Sea, Xue Ying arrived at the Bloodshed God Emperor.
Within that wooden courtyard.
"Teacher." Entering the courtyard, Xue Ying greeted with a bow.
"Xue Ying, have a seat." Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled.
Xue Ying immediately sat down.
"Let me ask you, when the Ancestor Mother Religion assassinated you, you disappeared from mid-air with even your karma disappearing. What opportunity have you obtained?" Bloodshed God Emperor asked, "If you don't feel like saying, you can not say."
Xue Ying did not hide it, "I have fortuitously gotten a talisman and proceeded on to the Starting Ground."
He had nothing to hide.
After all, even the Ancestor Mother Religion knew that he had disappeared from midair with his karma disappearing too! Why the need to hide from his teacher?
Furthermore, the talisman from the Starting Ground could not be snatched. Killing him would cause the talisman to disappear.
"Starting Ground?" Bloodshed God Emperor nodded with a smile, "No wonder. I see that you have yet to transcend, but the aura which your body is emitting has become much stronger-even stronger than that King Patrol Devil. I was puzzled had my suspicions, so you have gone to the Starting Ground. That Starting Ground contains the cultivation method from other cosmos, so it is easily achievable for it to make your body much stronger."
Xue Ying felt kind of awkward as he added, "Teacher, the aura of my body becoming strong isn't because I cultivated other cultivation methods."
"It isn't other cultivation methods?" The Bloodshed God Emperor felt suspicious.
"I, I have opened my Dao." Xue Ying obediently mentioned.
Bloodshed God Emperor was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 640 - Void Soul Liquid
chapters.content:
Chapter 640: Void Soul Liquid
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"You have opened the Dao already?" Even the calm Bloodshed God Emperor turned taciturn momentarily as he looked at this disciple in front of him.
His teacher was staring at him silently.
Xue Ying was filled with slight awkwardness as he replied, "I have never thought that this would happen. It's just that after being attacked by the Ancestor Mother Religion, I went on to the Starting Ground! I was fortunate enough to survive there, yet who would have thought that right when I was about to leave, I saw an illusory world within the Starting Ground. The forefather created this illusory world, and it is filled with such profoundness that I was startled. I'm sure teacher understands that I have always been focusing on comprehending the profound mysteries of the world, and as I was looking at it, I became immersed unknowingly, comprehending many things, and naturally comprehended the 'Dao of Mirage'. Once I have done that, I can't even forget it!"
"You are surely amazing. "The Bloodshed God Emperor finally said.
Xue Ying hurriedly added, "This disciple has already comprehended it, and it is too late to feel regret."
"What is there to be regretful about?" Bloodshed God Emperor retorted.
Xue Ying was stunned.
"Being able to open the Dao is a good thing. Why be regretful about it?" Bloodshed God Emperor took in a deep breath before carefully looking at this disciple in front of him, "I am just astonished that this treasured disciple of mine isn't just ordinarily amazing, he has opened the Dao after cultivating for a million years! Comparing with you, Bamboo Mountain might have cultivated quite fast, yet he is far worse as compared to you. I as the teacher felt kind of ashamed."
Only then did Xue Ying let out a sigh of relief, "I still thought Teacher is furious with me and wanted to reprimand me."
He did not mind opening a Dao.
When he was tortured by the 'Six Ghosts Resentment Hex Poison', Xue Ying had seen past life and death. Even if he could not become a Ruler during this entire cosmos epoch and eventually die, Xue Ying would still be filled with gratefulness. When he saw his teacher become flustered, he was worried his teacher had become disappointed with him! After all, Bloodshed God Emperor had once reminded him of that before.
"I don't even have the time to praise you, so why reprimand you?" Bloodshed God Emperor laughed out loud, "Actually, it will not affect anything even if you open a Dao first. As long as you become a Ruler before the end of this cosmos epoch, it'll be fine. I believe that since you could reach the Paragon realm within a million years, it will not be a difficult task for you to become a Ruler in the long period after that."
"Teacher, after the cosmos epoch, is it possible for us to live after transcending?" Xue Ying asked curiously.
Previously when he asked the white-haired old man at the Starting Ground, the white-haired old man became furious.
Xue Ying did not dare to ask more. He was currently asking his teacher.
"The end of this cosmos epoch?" Bloodshed God Emperor paused for a while. The expression on his face was quite complicated. It was filled with expectations and worry, and a little uneasy.
"You will know in the future." Bloodshed God Emperor did not explain more.
Xue Ying could have a vague guess about his teacher's expression and did not ask more.
"What kind of Dao is the Dao of Mirage?" Bloodshed God Emperor asked. He had his guesses, yet nobody had ever grasped hold of the Dao of Mirage during this cosmos epoch.
Xue Ying explained, "It isn't the simple Mirage Deity Heart any longer. Instead, it consists of an even greater and vaster Mirage World. The Mirage World could transform and encompass the real world! When I walk within the Mirage World, if the enemy isn't able to forcibly permeate into the Mirage World, then they will never be able to attack me from the ordinary world."
"Oh, this is very similar to my Shadow World." Bloodshed God Emperor laughed at that, "If talking about assassination means, both your Dao and my Dao are ranked at the forefront of the Deity world and Abyss."
Xue Ying agreed as well.
Both the Dao of Mirage had similar potential with the Dao of Shadow-they both transcended beyond the ordinary world.
"Being able to form an independent world meant that you would be good at assassination." Bloodshed God Emperor mentioned, "Other Daos such as Bamboo Mountain' Destructive Lightning, or Huo Cheng's 'flame' might be powerful, yet they are 'Daos' meant for combat, and that happens in the current world still."
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
There were differences in the Dao opened by a Paragon.
Like Leaf Saint, Paragon Huo Cheng and Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master or even amongst the Rulers, Myriad God Palace Head, Purgatory Ruler and others, even though they had all opened a Dao, it remained within the ordinary world. Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master's 'Destructive Lightning', was terrifying when displayed and contained a destructive nature that could kill weaker Paragons in a direct battle.
Xue Ying had instead borrowed upon the Dao he opened to control another world directly. Naturally, the 'Mirage World' was still at the opening stage, and could not compare with Bloodshed God Emperor's 'Shadow Space' which had attained eternity.
"I originally prepared a gift for you that will enable you to open a Dao as early as possible." Bloodshed God Emperor laughed, "But now that you have reached the Opening realm, my preparation is not needed anymore."
Xue Ying was stunned.
His teacher had long said he would be giving him something, though Xue Ying did not mind that at all since he had absolute arts and True God weapons, and was not in need of anything. He immediately answered, "Teacher, in the future, if you can find any treasures appropriate for me, it'll not be too late to give it to disciple."
"You have already reached the Opening realm. Naturally, I'll have to give you a gift. If this delays, when you become a Ruler… it'd be tough if I were to take out something that will satisfy you." Bloodshed God Emperor laughed. At the same time, he looked at the void beside him.
"Weng."
The void was torn.
A black bird flew out from within, landing on the shoulder of Bloodshed God Emperor.
"Bring out a bottle of the 'Void Soul Liquid'." Bloodshed God Emperor said to the black bird.
"Void Soul Liquid?" The black bird opened his eyes and weirdly shouted out, "Bloodshed, we only have one and a half bottle left! And you want a bottle?"
"Bring it." Bloodshed God Emperor ordered.
Only then did black bird unwillingly opened its mouth. At that moment there was a distortion in the time-space tunnel within its mouth, and a bottle came flying out and landing in the hands of Bloodshed God Emperor. It was a palm-sized black bottle
Bloodshed God Emperor looked at this black bottle with a complex expression, "The biggest danger that I have encountered since I cultivated is to obtain it."
Xue Ying was startled.
The biggest danger that his teacher experienced is used to get this treasure. Even Fifth Uncle Master Black Bird was not so willing to give it away.
"Teacher, this is too precious." Xue Ying said.
"That time, I was a Paragon, and have gone into another cosmos to get it after suffering greatly." Bloodshed God Emperor laughed, "Alright. Even though it is even important to Rulers, there are still many more precious treasures which Teacher has. This Void soul Liquid has a unique characteristic that is quite rare, in that it can strengthen your soul."
"Strengthen your soul?" Xue Ying's eyes brightened. It was the fusion of the soul and the laws that formed the true deity heart. Comprehending a 'Dao' that was strong would similarly make the true deity heart stronger. This was the conventional way of cultivating their soul in this cosmos.
"Right, I have already used it before, and having it with me is useless. I have given your senior disciple brother Monarch Green a bottle, and that is when your teacher has just become a Paragon." Bloodshed God Emperor laughed, "This bottle is for you."
"Brat." The black bird on the shoulder of the God Emperor was slightly angry as he snorted, "This is the final bottle in this cosmos. I have only half a bottle left."
"Black bird, Xue Ying has already opened a Dao. With his comprehension ability, I'll naturally have to aid him in becoming stronger." Bloodshed God Emperor said.
"What!" The black bird who was originally angry had become startled. He looked at Xue Ying was an astonishment, "You have opened a Dao?"
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
"This is only a million years, and this cultivation speed is much more terrifying than Monarch Green. Bloodshed, this disciple of yours is very formidable." The Black Bird was genuinely shocked. Cultivating for a million years was indeed very short, and it was quite unusual for one to become a stage two World Deity after a million years of cultivation. Xue Ying had already transcended across the entire World Deity realm, jumping out of the World realm and opened a Dao.
"Alright, properly groom him. Use all your strength in doing so. Bloodshed, the chances of this disciple becoming a Ruler isn't any worse than that for Monarch Green." The black bird added.
"I naturally know of it." Bloodshed God Emperor threw the palm-sized bottle to Xue Ying.
Xue Ying received it.
"There is a need to cherish it. After using it, if you discover that your soul is unable to improve any further, you could give the remaining to whoever you want. Naturally, the soul must reach at least the powerful existence level before they could use it. Most stage four World Deities will not be able to withstand this with their soul and will dissipate away. You must remember, if your soul can still be improved further, you must not give it away. You must do your best to improve your soul further. This is extremely helpful to your cultivation." Bloodshed God Emperor ordered, "This bottle is something that can't be exchanged even with ten True God weapons."
"I understand." Xue Ying nodded.
"In a while, after you leave, you should immediately use it. If other Rulers know of it, they will not care about respect and will come and snatch it away." Bloodshed God Emperor sighed, "After all, this is an opportunity of mine from another cosmos, and there is nothing of such thing in this cosmos."
"Many thanks, teacher." Xue Ying felt grateful.
"I only have three of you personal disciples, so if I don't help you all, who would I help?" Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled as he looked at Xue Ying.
From the perspective of Bloodshed God Emperor, Monarch Green might have the power to match Rulers and had high status, and Xue Ying was much weaker as compared to him, yet in his heart, he had already placed these two disciples side by side. Xue Ying had only started cultivating later, and as for Gu Zang? Compared to Xue Ying and Monarch Green, he was much weaker.

chapters.title: Chapter 641 - The Origin of the Dark Abyss
chapters.content:
Chapter 641: The Origin of the Dark Abyss
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Bloodshed God Emperor said, "You are already at the Opening Realm. Ordinary treasures will be worthless for you since it can't provide significant help to your cultivation. Other than that, you are qualified to visit some places previously forbidden or impossible for you."
Following that, a detailed set of information was transmitted over to Xue Ying.
The information contained intelligence about the five great historical remains.
The first was the Lake Heart Island historical remain. It included details about several places inside like the 'Sword World', 'Eternal God Palace', Blood Fire Door', 'Destruction Eden' and others. They were listed in order of importance.
Second-Six Heavenly Wheel.
Third-Arcadia Flying ship.
Fourth-Moon Palace.
Fifth-Purgatory Drift Hall
"These are the top five most dangerous historical remains known to us," Bloodshed God Emperor explained, "As for others, I'll tell you int he future! Naturally, I'll not elaborate on places like the Starting Ground since I haven't even been there. Other than that, there are also highly secretive places in the cosmos which even I aren't aware of."
Xue Ying placed more significant attention on the details of the five historical remains.
The more he learned, the more astonished he was.
For instance, the Lake Heart Island had many places within, and the Destruction Eden was ranked bottom! It made sense since the Destruction Eden was just a residential area for the Destruction Legion, unlike the Eternal God Palace where the core members of Lake Heart Island resided. That place was even given the 'Eternal' name because Rulers were the weakest within. Another place, the 'Sword World', was even more terrifying. The report stated that in this current epoch, anyone who dared venture in would meet their demise! Even Bloodshed God Emperor would fall after several breaths of time.
"What? Ancestor Devil created the Dark Abyss?" Xue Ying looked at the information provided on the 'Six Heavenly Wheel'. He could not help but be stunned.
Bloodshed God Emperor nodded, "Right. At that time, it was Ancestor Devil who created the Six Heavenly Wheel. The Six Heavenly Wheel took in all dark and negative energy from the cosmos, transforming them into layers of Dark Abyss. The Dark Abyss is well known as an endless abyss, yet in reality, the Six Heavenly Wheel is located at the deepest level. This Six Heavenly Wheel is also a special six-layered Eden world."
"According to the legend, Ancestor Devil had many powerful subordinates during the third cosmos. They were all termed as demons. All of them are ugly, evil and vicious. In the later eras, many lifeforms created by the Dark Abyss have similar features with these Ancient Demons. That is also why they are called demons. Still, their strength is a far cry from the Ancient Demon. The Ancestor Devil painstakingly nurtured each Ancient Demon. The Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain which you went before is Ancient Demon." Bloodshed God Emperor elaborated to Xue Ying.
Xue Ying was astonished. The Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain was an ancient demon corpse?
"Ancestor Devil had a strange temper. All other historical remains forbade lifeforms from other cosmos from entering. The moment they entered, they will be killed immediately. Nevertheless, places left behind by the Ancestor Devil permit lifeforms from other cosmos to enter."
Xue Ying was once again surprised. Logically speaking, the historical remains were left behind for later generations of this cosmos. Outsiders from other cosmos would usually not be able to enter. The Lake Heart Island and other historical remains followed this principle. Any outsiders would be killed if they dared enter!
"That is also why the Ancestor Mother Religion decided to venture into the Six Heavenly Wheel. They can seize resources from our cosmos in that place." Bloodshed God Emperor knitted his eyebrow before continuing, "The most troublesome part is, any lifeform can only enter the Six Heavenly Wheel three times! Previously, many powerful existences had entered that place thrice for cultivation. When we found out about the presence of the Ancestor Mother Religion in our cosmos, there weren't many people with a chance to enter the Six Heavenly Wheel anymore. Thus, it became exceedingly difficult for us to stop them."
Xue Ying nodded. The Six Heavenly Wheel consisted of six Eden layers.
Rulers could enter the 'Three Upper Edens' while those beneath Rulers could enter the 'Three Lower Edens'.
"Right now at the Three Lower Edens there is only one person on our side standing guard there-Monarch Hex Cricket," said Bloodshed God Emperor.
"It's him?" Xue Ying marveled.
From the Cosmos Deity-Demon List, after Monarch Green, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, the next person who followed closely by was Monarch Hex Cricket.
Monarch Hex Cricket had excellent temperament, outstanding reputation, mighty strength and was generous. Although he was low-profile, even Rulers admired him.
"Although Monarch Hex Cricket is strong, he is just a single person." Bloodshed God Emperor lamented, "Although many powerful existences have chances to enter still, they are too weak! Letting them enter is the same as sending them to die! Xue Ying, although you have just broken through, you have studied the Destruction Legion absolute art. You have also comprehended the Dao of Mirage. These are exceptionally useful for survival. I hope you will enter the Six Heavenly Wheel since you could always disrupt their activities while honing your skills."
"This disciple understands." Xue Ying nodded.
"Go then. I have already given all the necessary information to you. Don't feel pressured. We are ultimately still stronger than the Ancestor Mother Religion."
"Actually, this disciple has one more matter to ask Teacher for help." request Xue Ying.
"Haha, you seldom ask anything. What is it?" asked Bloodshed God Emperor.
"It's about this disciple's True God weapon, the flying knife." Xue Ying took out his flying knife. The True God flying knife was twisted and filled with scratches. "This disciple used it during the battle in Starting Ground, causing it to suffer from some damage."
Bloodshed God Emperor took it and gave it a look.
"It is still good. There are no damages in its internal part; The damages are all externally, making easy to fix." Bloodshed God Emperor stretched out his hand. A black flame appeared on his palm. As the black flame lightly touched the flying knife, the knife became smooth. After that, he took out two kinds of stone. He grabbed both stones and threw it into the flame, liquefying them. He then lightly smeared the surface of the knife with the liquid. An array was condensed finally before being imprinted on the body of the flying knife.
That was how he fixed the flying knife.
"Done." Bloodshed God Emperor threw the flying knife back, "I've made some improvements on it. It is sharper and more stable now."
Xue Ying was struck dumb. This…
Finished? It did not even take the time to brew a cup of tea?
As he had not asked his teacher for help in the arduous refinement of the Sun Star Nucleus Rock, he did not know how long he would take to refine the True God weapon since ultimately, it was still a True God weapon and he presumed his teacher would require one or two days to repair it fully. Who would have thought that his teacher took a short span of time to complete the task? He had merely touched the knife several times from start to finish.
The True God weapon melted easily over his teacher's black flame. Xue Ying finally felt the power of what it meant to be the 'number one existence from this cosmos' from this process.
"Anything else?" Bloodshed God Emperor laughed.
"This disciple hopes for Teacher to keep the matter of me opening a Dao a secret. I am planning to use the Bloodshed Tavern Master robe to conceal my aura. That way, the Ancestor Mother Religion will still think that I am merely a stage four World Deity." Xue Ying requested.
"Haha, alright." Bloodshed God Emperor happily nodded.
Xue Ying was ultimately still a World Deity. With the concealment from the Bloodshed Tavern Master robe, others would find it hard to discern his identity.
The only flaw to his disguise was Xue Ying's body within the River of Time. However, under normal circumstances, no one would deliberately go there to search for Xue Ying's body.
So, in this short period, this matter will not be exposed.
"Disciple will go back now." Xue Ying happily held on to his flying knife as he left.
Bloodshed God Emperor shook his head, "What a cunning fellow."
