"Who are you to talk about your disciple? Aren't you even more cunning than him?" The black bird remarked on his shoulder.
…
Leaving the Bloodshed God Palace, Xue Ying went back to Xia Clan World. He had decided to consume the Void Soul Liquid before entering the origin of the Dark Abyss-the 'Six Heavenly Wheel' Eden World.
'The previous time I fought with people from the Ancestor Mother Religion, I vanished into thin air. Thus, I believe they will keep a lookout on me and come pursuing me the moment I visited the Six Heavenly Wheel. Awesome! It is time for me to try out my strength after grasping the Dao of Mirage." Xue Ying was eagerly anticipating the fight.

chapters.title: Chapter 642 - Entering the End of Abyss
chapters.content:
Chapter 642: Entering the End of Abyss
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within the time-space tunnel.
An ordinary-looking Starfield Flying Ship was flying at high speed. The black-robed Xue Ying stood on the deck as he looked at the colorful streams of light within the tunnel.
'I have left the material realm and the Bloodshed God Palace territory. If the Ancestor Mother Religion is paying close attention to me, they should be alerted by now right?' Xue Ying guessed, 'Are they planning to send another expert to determine if I could escape just like how I did previously? Or are they afraid that I might have an ambush planned, making them think twice from acting?'
He had many theories.
But Xue Ying was calm. He was even flying the Starfield Flying Ship very slowly.
One had to know that he had opened the Dao of Mirage. If he were to travel through the Mirage World, he would be able to travel at a much faster speed since it was his world!
But since he had to conceal his actions, he would naturally have to fake his flying speed too! Otherwise, if the enemy were to use karma and learn that Xue Ying's speed was way too fast, they would be suspicious of Xue Ying.
'Powerful existences aren't so bored to investigate the River of Time and seek for me.' Xue Ying thought. Like himself, he did not care about seeking other powerful existences in the River of Time, 'Thus, my strength will be kept a secret for this period.'
'As such, I must be careful with my disguise.'
'And properly give the Ancestor Mother Religion a savage blow.'
Xue Ying was not lenient when dealing with the Ancestor Mother Religion.
They were ultimately from different cosmos, and the Ancestor Mother Religion wasn't soft when treating them too. They killed, and they stole. These were acts done by the Ancestor Mother Religion.
"Hu~"
The Starfield Flying Ship was continually flying forward.
Xue Ying would sometimes appear and disappear. It felt like he was real and unreal at the same time. Xue Ying cast his gaze far away. He was observing the vast Mirage World which encompassed the ordinary world and the time-space tunnel! The Mirage World began extending outwards with him at the center. It covered a vast area-this was an area which he controlled solely.
'After absorbing the Void Soul Liquid, my true deity heart has already undergone a qualitative change.' Xue Ying could feel his speed of deduction becoming ten times faster. He could not help but sigh.
Within the consciousness of his own body, the originally 'miniature Xue Ying' had already grown up. If it was the size of a baby previously, then now, it would be a child at about 7-8 years of age! The true deity heart was stronger than before.
Previously after he left his teacher Bloodshed God Emperor, he returned to the safest place for him-the Xia Clan world. Over there, Xue Ying's true body had consumed the 'Void Soul Liquid' entirely. He would consume bit by bit, and after spending a total of three days had he consumed 90% of that little bottle of Void Soul Liquid. That was when he was too full and unable to consume any further. By then, the 'Deity Heart' of his true body had undertaken a huge qualitative transformation.
Following closely, Xue Ying directly dissipated the true deity heart of his avatar and split the true body's deity heart into two.
With the realm of 'Dao of Mirage' in addition to a hundred times time-accelerated environment, Xue Ying spent just five days to allow both his true body and avatar's true deity heart' to recover to its peak.
After his transformation, Xue Ying could not help but sigh, 'My Senior Disciple Brother Monarch Green can become so heaven-shattering and fight with Rulers as a Paragon, other than his great innate talent, it is because this Void Soul Liquid is a great boon for him.'
He was clear on this point because he had felt the mysteriousness of this Void Soul Liquid personally.
His deity heart had become much stronger, and the speed of cultivation deduction alone was ten times faster. For instance, if he took a million years previously to deduce a certain secret skill, after this qualitative change of his deity heart, 100,000 years would be enough! This was solely the speed of deduction. The growth of a soul was also the growth of the essence of life. It would aid in all aspects.
Naturally, 'comprehension ability' was emphasized more during cultivation.
Those with weaker comprehension ability would get stuck at bottlenecks, and it would be pointless even if your deduction speed were faster.
And comprehension ability… was the formation from the accumulation of life experience, thoughts, heart temperament, understanding towards the world and many other aspects. One's comprehension ability would also transform countlessly over time as one trained himself.
Thus, some of the cultivators might stumble and fall due to a certain setback.
And some might just be enlightened, allowing him to move a thousand miles just in a single night of cultivation.
An example is 'Xue Ying' who was considered an average talent during his adolescence within the mortal world. But now, he could stand at a frightening height.
'This is weird.'
'Why did the Ancestor Mother Religion not attack me during my journey?' Xue Ying was riding on the Starfield Flying Ship, traveling out of the time-space tunnel while looking at the Dark Abyss in front of him.
The Dark Abyss was a piece of darkness in the shape of pillars just like intestines. It was piled up in many layers of Abyss Worlds.
Ordinarily, one had to enter through the first level before proceeding deeper if he wanted to travel to a certain level of the Abyss World.
And this time, the place where Xue Ying wanted to go was the origin of the entire Dark Abyss and the deepest region. That was where the 'Six Heavenly Wheel' was located.
"Hu."
Xue Ying directly tore through time-space and proceeded to the end of the Dark Abyss.
There were two places of the Dark Abyss which could be reached via the time-space tunnel-they were the uppermost level and the lowermost level! The lowermost level was dim and dark. Space there was distorted, and the entire area was turbulent. Those who were weaker might be twisted entirely into pieces by the warped space here, and Xue Ying had also gotten some of the detailed intelligence on this area from his teacher, allowing him to grasp of the method to proceed on to the Six Heavenly Wheel. Only then could he safely enter.
One had to know that ordinary True Gods would not have heard of the 'Six Heavenly Wheel'. It was after all different from the Lake Heart Island master. Instead, the Ancestor Devil had left behind the 'Six Heavenly Wheel' which formed the Dark Abyss. It sufficed to show how dangerous it was.
"Hua~"
Tearing through time-space, Xue Ying directly arrived there.
"Truly chaotic."
Everything was dark.
"Hong long!" A terrifying strength was stirring up the void frantically. The void was being distorted, forming terrifying maelstroms. This stirring force could easily tear apart ordinary True Gods! Even the lower part of the entire 'Dark Abyss' was distorted along. This place was even swallowing darkness and negative energy via the 'Dark Abyss'.
Ever since Ancestor Devil had formed the Six Heavenly Wheel, there would be Dark Abysses forming each cosmos epoch after that!
"Hmph." Xue Ying though did not care about this dark maelstrom. Instead, he forced his way towards the center of the maelstrom.
As he got deeper, the stirring energy became stronger.
But it was still manageable… one had to know that previously when his Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body was at the fourth level, Xue Ying's armor was able to withstand an attack by White Sovereign King. Just his defenses alone was comparable to peak Paragons, and he could easily ignore this stirring force. And now that Xue Ying had reached the fifth level of the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body, this armor of his had become even more heaven-shattering. After all, it was an improvement of an entire realm.
"I see it." Xue Ying saw a huge wheel.
This wheel was massive.
There were six colored wheels in the color of black, blood-red, silvery-white, ash-gray, dark yellow and gray respectively.
The large six-colored wheel was located right at the end of the center of the maelstrom. It was revolving very slowly accompanied by the diffusion of a terrifying dark, destructive aura. At his current Opening realm and that he had improved his soul using the Void Soul Liquid, Xue Ying's true deity heart could completely withstand this aura. It's just that he frowned slightly, "This should be the end of the Abyss, the core of it."
He could sense the Abyss willpower which had once repulsed him.
"Sou."
As Xue Ying got even closer to the wheel, suddenly, unseen energy enveloped around Xue Ying. With a 'sou', it had directly swallowed Xue Ying within, causing him to fall into the area where the 'blood-red' color was located on the Six Heavenly Wheel.

chapters.title: Chapter 643 - The First Prey
chapters.content:
Chapter 643: The First Prey
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Only after Xue Ying passed through the dense blood color did Xue Ying regain his freedom. He then slowly descended on top of the peak of a mountain. He cast his gaze across this vast world. The entire sky of this world was blood red, and the surface of the ground was black. Amidst the black, there were some faint signs of fresh blood mixed within.
"Blood Devil Eden." Xue Ying muttered softly, "The lower three Eden's Blood Devil Eden."
The so-called Six Heavenly Wheel crafted by the Ancestor Devil was a world formed by six huge Edens.
At the same time, each of these six huge Eden worlds concealed one inheritance left behind by Ancestor Devil each. Naturally, this was just one type of treasure hidden within the 'Six Heavenly Wheel'. Absolute arts were not appropriate for everyone! For instance, Xue Ying was currently cultivating the 'Dao of Mirage'. If the absolute art did not belong to the category of the Dao of Mirage, he could not cultivate it to a higher level.
The 'Six Heavenly Wheel' had many precious items hidden within. They were very attractive to cultivators and far surpassed that of the six grand inheritances.
'According to the information provided by Teacher.'
'The lower three Edens is currently guarded only by Monarch Hex Cricket. Monarch Hex Cricket is also only guarding the most important 'Black Rain Eden'. The other two worlds of the lower three Edens, the 'Blood Devil Eden' and the 'Icy Snow Eden', belonged to the protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion.' Xue Ying shook his head inwardly, 'However, there is an additional Paragon now in the Blood Devil Eden.'
"哼哼,母祖教,在外面你们不敢动手.在血魔洞天内应该敢动手了吧." 'Hmph hmph, Ancestor Mother Religion, you all dare not act when I am outside the Blood Devil Eden right?'
Xue Ying was looking forward to it.
'I don't have to care about them. They will be sending themselves to my doorstep naturally.' Xue Ying soon turned into a stream of light as he raced through the sky.
For the sake of disguising himself, he remained flying at his previous flying speed forward.
It was easy for the Ancestor Mother Religion to search for him-they could use karma.
But he had no ways of locating them! After all, the other party had no karmic lines, and if they were to hide, even the Bloodshed God Emperor and others could not find them.
Thus…
If The Ancestor Mother Religion did not act, Xue Ying would not be so foolish to wait. Coming to the 'Blood Devil Eden', other than dealing with the Ancestor Mother Religion, the other reason he came was to temper himself! After all, this was the end of the Dark Abyss and a location comparable to the 'Lake Heart Island historical remain'! He had once visited the Lake Heart Island historical remain and had only visited a place relatively less dangerous-the Destruction Eden. He had not been to other places. That time, the Blood Fire Door was opened, yet he did not dare to enter.
Now that he had seen through the intelligence reports provided by his teacher, he understood that his past decision was truly rational.
******
Deity world, within a piece of continuous land amidst the void, there were endless rays of light.
A silvery-robed old man was currently seated cross-legged.
"It is time to investigate the position of Dong Bo Xue Ying." The silvery-robed old man used karma to begin his investigation.
That time, the Ancestor Mother Religion was confident in getting those precious materials Xue Ying brought along with him. Naturally, they would be observing him at all times. The moment Xue Ying left the Bloodshed God Palace territory, the Ancestor Mother Religion would know of it immediately, sending out that golden-haired monkey.
But this time, it was different. Ancestor Mother Religion did not have any confidence of killing Xue Ying any longer! They felt that since Xue Ying would be able to teleport once again and escape, besides… the experts from the Ancestor Mother Religion would not be able to investigate the position according to karma. Bamboo Saint had died too, so the Ancestor Mother Religion could not use much more workforce for this. All of their combat powers were extraordinary and were ordinary True Gods at the very least.
With such a combat power and status, it was impossible for them to pay close attention to any single person. They would occasionally search for that person once per day.
How tiring would it be to pay close attention and follow a person all day long?
Without enough benefits, powerful existences would not be willing to do so.
The Ancestor Mother Religion was also paying close notice to Xue Ying and that they were not that crazy to 'capture Xue Ying at all costs'.
"Hmph hmph, finally left the material realm? Mn?" The silvery-robed old man was shocked, "He is within the Six Heavenly Wheel. The Six Heavenly Wheel is extremely mythical, and it is because the Religious Leader told me of it, only then did I know its position! Who would have thought that Dong Bo Xue Ying would dare to enter that place as a stage four World Deity? But it is right since his current combat power has reached the entry level of a Paragon. Thus, he has the qualifications to visit that place."
"Religious Leader."
The silvery-robed old man immediately transmitted a message.
His status was different from Bamboo Saint. He was trusted much more by the Ancestor Mother Religion to the extent that he could directly communicate with the Religious Leader.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying has already left the material realm. He is proceeding to the end of Dark Abyss-Within the Six Heavenly Wheel. According to my sensing, he should have gone to the Blood Devil Eden." The silver-robed old man informed him.
…
End of Abyss, within the 'Blood Devil Eden' of the Six Heavenly Wheel.
On top of a desolate plain, there were five ordinary stone houses, with a protector belonging to the Ancestor Mother Religion living in each of the homes.
Within one of the stone houses located closest to the boundary.
There was a stooped male currently curled up like a child deep in sleep. His green hair was very messy and everywhere. Even as he was in a deep sleep, the many ends of green hair were occasionally moving and flying.
"Protector Cheng Yun." A distant transmission sounded within his heart.
The stooped male opened his eyes-they were glowing in green.
"Religious Leader." The stooped male immediately sat up cross-legged and answered the transmission.
"Protector Cheng Yun, this cultivation cosmos 'Dong Bo Xue Ying' has already entered the Blood Devil Eden. Initially, we aren't in a rush to act against him. But since he has gone to the Blood Devil Eden, it is also a rare opportunity for us." The religious Leader sent a transmission, "This Dong Bo Xue Ying is a mighty stage four World Deity. The armor he has is very formidable, and that he has a bizarre escaping technique! Thus, I require for you to go over and utilize your void restriction method to restrict him. I would like to see if he can escape again this time."
"Yes, Religious Leader." The stooped male acknowledged.
"Use all your strength and vigilance to prevent him from escaping. But I predict that his escaping technique shouldn't be able to be used according to use whim and fancy! After all, even the Lake Heart Island master of this cosmos did not have such a heaven-shattering escaping technique." The Religious Leader said, "I guess that it should be a one-use treasure, or that many restrictions limit it. Thus, this time when you act, you could capture him in one fell swoop.'
"If you captured him, there is no need to kill him. Just seal his true deity heart and bring him back. I'll ask other Religious Leaders to investigate his soul and understand what secret is it exactly he has."
"Yes, I'll do my utmost to capture him." The stooped male was full of confidence.
After the transmission was cut off, the stooped male stood up and walked out of the stone house.
The moment he came out, there was another tall and sturdy figure walking out of one of the five stone houses. This tall and sturdy figure was similar to that 'fanged Religious Leader'-he had a pair of fangs too, though his entire skin was red. This tall and sturdy fanged-hunk shouted out at the stooped male, "Brother Cheng Yun, where are you planning to go? We are about to finish with our refinement, and after a while, we'll be going out for another attempt."
"Big Brother Huo Zhu, the Religious Leader has sent an order for me to go capture that Dong Bo Xue Ying." The stooped male replied.
"Oh, Dong Bo Xue Ying?" The red-skinned fanged hunk chuckled, "I've heard of him before. He is a stage four World Deity belonging to this cosmos. According to sources, he has fought against Leaf Saint, yet who would have thought that he dares enter the Blood Devil Eden. You will certainly succeed in capturing him."
"Mn." The stooped male nodded, "As long as he does not employ that escaping technique, I'll certainly be able to capture him and seal his true deity heart. By then, life and death are no longer up to him. We 'll control him."
"Go and hurry back! We'll be able to succeed with our refinement by the time you come back." The red-skinned fanged hunk said.
The stooped male immediately took a step before his body turned transparent soundlessly and merged into the void.
He began heading towards the position of Xue Ying. The Religious Leader did not provide an exact position. Instead, he had just given him an approximate area. It was apparent that scouting the exact position of a person via karma would be hard since he was within the Blood Devil Eden.
Rushing over, even though he could merge into the void, sealing the law of the world within the Blood Devil Eden was hard for him. The reason why these experts from the Ancestor Mother Religion were called as 'idiots' by Bloodshed God Emperor, Temporal Island Lord, and the others was that their realms were too low! Like this Protector Cheng Yun, he was an expert at the protector rank and was similar to that of Paragons. However, his realm was honestly very low, and it was only after coming to this cosmos that he had a slight improvement, reaching that of an ordinary stage four World Deity realm.
Just this realm meant that he had to fly obediently.
He flew for a total of over two days. It was fortunate that the Religious Leader had been providing the new approximate position of Xue Ying.
…
'I've found him.' Protector Cheng Yun was looking from afar. His terrifying vision enabled him to see the stream of light that was currently flying.
'Hmph hmph, even though he is famous for his body, his flying speed is much slower than me by an entire level.' Protector Cheng Yun revealed a cold smile, 'He is destined to be captured by me.'
And in the distant, Xue Ying was currently flying at his previous speed.
'The Blood Devil Eden is truly huge.' Xue Ying was flying along. With him at the center, there was an illusory world currently spreading outwards to cover a huge area. Naturally, it had encompassed the location where the distant Protector Cheng Yun was at, 'I've flown for so long, and only then did the Ancestor Mother Religion rush over. Seeing his aura, he should be at the protector rank, similar to our Paragons.'
His illusory world had completely covered Protector Cheng Yun. He could see every single hair and pore on Protector Cheng Yun, and was observing the cold smile and frosty light on Protector Cheng Yun.
Protector Cheng Yun was nevertheless ignorant of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 644 - The First Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 644: The First Battle
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
'The first prey.' Even though Xue Ying was flying normally, the blood within his body was boiling. Bloodshed God Emperor might have let him go and create some wreckages, but he had his plans. What he wanted to do was to kill the other party! But Xue Ying understood that killing a protector from the Ancestor Mother Religion was tough.
"Monarch Hex Cricket." Xue Ying transmitted a message via karma.
"Monarch Dong Bo." It was continuously raining black rain in the 'Black Rain Eden' of the Six Heavenly Wheel. On top of a vast black water lake, a stone head about a dozen meters wide was seen poking out from the surface. A middle-aged man who was wearing an azure and beautiful-looking robe sat on top of the stone head. His forehead had two soft feelers, and his eyes were glowing in green.
"Hong!"
A gigantic dimmed green light pillar reached up to the sky with him at the center; this pillar extended to the deepest part of the sky dome. The dimmed light pillar covered an area with a range of half a trillion kilometers! It was emitting a force that felt incomparably dreadful.
This was Monarch Hex Cricket!
Not just powerful existences from the Deity world, even those from the Dark Abyss respected Monarch Hex Cricket sincerely from deep within their hearts! Rulers relatively admired him too because Monarch Hex Cricket was someone who had wholeheartedly served the entire cosmos. He was extremely 'benevolent' and had a good reputation, a kind, and an honest nature. Naturally, his combat power was huge too-ranking at 12th of the entire Cosmos Deity-Demon List.
Relying solely on his strength, no Rulers could kill him! His avatar stayed permanently within the lower three Edens of the 'Six Heavenly Wheel', and only those beneath the Ruler realm could come in. Other than guarding this place for the entire cosmos, he was providing safety for his avatar since nobody beneath the level of Ruler and nothing in the lower three Edens could threaten him at all.
"Why did you suddenly contact me? Unless a fish has taken the bait?" Monarch Hex Cricket chuckled as he transmitted a message over.
"Right, a fish has taken the bait." Xue Ying replied. Not long after entering the lower three Edens, Monarch Hex Cricket had contacted him. The two talked for a moment, and he did not hide the matter of reaching the 'Opening realm' from Monarch Hex Cricket for he was trustworthy. It was also impossible for him to betray the cosmos because firstly, there was no reason for him to betray and secondly, even if he betrayed, it would not be because of this minor matter which Xue Ying had revealed.
"It is just a little fish, a male who was relatively stooped. He has green hair that is dancing about." Xue Ying answered, "Monarch Hex Cricket, do you know of him?"
"I do not know his name, but the Ancestor Mother Religion has attempted to attack this place I'm guarding before, so I am relatively knowledgeable about this group of protectors. This stooped male is considered average in strength amongst those protectors from Ancestor Mother Religion, though he specializes in controlling the void, especially when his hair can restrict the enemy." Monarch Hex Cricket warmly laughed as he answered the question. The surrounding black rain was pitter-pattering, yet they could not touch him at all, "The Ancestor Mother Religion sent him over because he knows that your defenses are very formidable and can't be killed. Thus, they wanted to capture you."
"I understand." Xue Ying had a baseline immediately in his heart.
"You must be wary. The Ancestor Mother Religion originates from another cosmos. Even though their realm is very low, and their techniques are truly crude, their bodies are mighty. Even this stooped male who specializes in control and is an ordinary protector, the pure strength of his fleshy body is enough to fight against me. The stronger protectors amongst them have a combat power that far surpasses mine." Monarch Hex Cricket transmitted over.
"But they lack in the realm compared to you, Monarch Hex Cricket." Xue Ying immediately said.
From Xue Ying's perspective, strength and realm were both complementary. Purely having power without realm at all would only allow the user to employ one-tenth his full force.
"Monarch, he is about to act. I'll play with him first." Xue Ying transmitted over.
"Be careful." Monarch Hex Cricket did not speak anymore.
Being the second person entering the Lower Three Edens who came from the same cosmos as him, Monarch Hex Cricket felt concerned over Xue Ying. It's just that the 'Black Rain Eden' was too important that he had to stay here without leaving it unguarded.
…
Xue Ying borrowed upon the 'Dao of Mirage'. The Mirage World began extending out, allowing him to observe the actions of that Ancestor Mother Religion protector constantly.
Protector Cheng Yun was spying upon Xue Ying, and his body had merged into the void; he was moving closer to him continuously.
'Hmph hmph hmph, a stage four World Deity dares to enter the Six Heavenly Wheel. Is it because he thinks his defenses are great? Even if your defenses are exceptional, and other protectors and I might have a hard time killing you, but capturing you will be easy.' Protector Cheng Yun was moving relatively quickly towards Xue Ying. At the moment when the gap in between the two reached just a few hundred million kilometers, Protector Cheng Yun did not dare get closer.
His eyes were glowing in green as he stared at the distant Xue Ying who was flying as if he was ignorant of everything.
"Hua."
The green hair of his started overgrowing. Every single strand of hair began entering the void and started surrounding Xue Ying.
This green hair was akin to a weapon. It elongated at a breakneck speed, and soon, it formed a sphere that completely sealed Xue Ying within. And Xue Ying was located at the center of this sphere that was formed from countless hairs. At this moment, he had an appearance as if he was oblivious of it; he was still flying on. As he flew, this spherical prison formed from hair was also flying along with him.
'Too easy.' Protector Cheng Yun thought with his heart. At the same time, his hair started shrinking.
The few hundred of millions of kilometers spherical prison was also beginning to contract.
Naturally, this disturbance could not be hidden any longer.
"What?" Xue Ying was 'startled' as he looked around him. He could only see countless green hairs appearing, enveloping the entire void as it was madly moving closer towards him.
"Hahaha, Dong Bo Xue Ying, you should just give up and be captured." The stooped male appeared from afar. His back had countless flying hair which eventually extended out to form the large prison that surrounded Xue Ying. This stooped male, 'Protector Cheng Yun', was staring at Xue Ying. He knew that Xue Ying had a very formidable teleportation escaping technique.
He was waiting to see if Xue Ying would genuinely teleport and escape.
"Idiot from the Ancestor Mother Religion!" Xue Ying extended his right hand, causing the Blood Serpent Spear to appear, "Die for me!"
"Just with you alone?" Protector Cheng Yun sneered.
"Hong!"
The Blood Serpent Spear in Xue Ying's hand began elongating swiftly. This black spear with crimson patterns on it started distorting. At this moment, the spear had rapidly extended into the shape of a sky pillar, directly piercing out fiercely. Xue Ying's current spear technique had undergone a qualitative transformation. After returning from the 'Starting Ground', he had entered closed-door cultivation to refine the Blood Serpent Spear.
During the process of refining the Blood Serpent Spear, he had comprehended part of the eternal level 'Dao of Slaughter' because only after his comprehension had reached a certain realm could he refine the spear.
During comprehension, Xue Ying fused his understanding of the 'Dao of Slaughter' together with the 'Dao of Mirage' which he just comprehended, completely using them to hone his spear techniques. The current spear technique was much more enigmatic as compared to earlier before he entered the Starting Ground.
However…
This Protector Cheng Yun from the Ancestor Mother Religion had a realm at the ordinary stage four World Deity level. His realm was way too lacking as compared to Xue Ying's, and could not see the profound mysteries inherent within this spear.
"You are still thinking of struggling? What a joke." Protector Cheng Yun did not seem to mind. At that moment, countless hair began enveloping around the incoming spear.
"Hong!"
The crimson spearhead had a world vortex appearing vaguely. There were many warped, broken worlds amidst the world vortex. Right at the center of this vortex was a terrifying killing intent.
A True God weapon which had an eternal Dao of Slaughter inherent within was utilized to display this move.
Furthermore, with Xue Ying attaining the fifth level large success of the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" and the fifth volume large success of the "Luminous Sun" strength, those firm and strong hairs which were tangling their way over, had been torn apart the moment they clashed due to the crude usage of realm, by the world vortex formed vaguely at the spearhead of the Blood Serpent Spear.
"Si la~" The spear forcibly tore through countless hair, directly piercing its way towards Protector Cheng Yun himself.
"What?" Protector Cheng Yun's expression lost color. He was very confident of the firmness of his hair and did not believe that the other party's spear could so easily break through the obstacle surrounding him. But no matter how he did not want to believe, that spear had already pierced its way over.
'He is a stage four World Deity who relied on absolute art and his Flying Knife True God weapon to barely fight against Leaf Saint? What a joke! He is absolutely at the Paragon realm. With such a powerful spear technique, he should have opened some Slaughter Dao.' Protector Cheng Yun was startled entirely by the power from this spear.

chapters.title: Chapter 645 - Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 645: Body
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
A dark-grey stone stick appeared in Protector Cheng Yun's hand. As he swung it over, all of the surrounding space began to collapse.
"Chi~chi~chi~"
His stone stick met the incoming Blood Serpent Spear whose movements gave it the feeling of a large, slippery snake. The spear-pointed blade seemed like a whirlpool, while the spear's shaft twisted with a strange force. Though the stone stick also contained the Profound Mystery of the Void, its attack could use no more than 20-30% of its force as it parried the spear. This was the result of a difference in comprehension realms.
"Mn?" Despite it being no more than 20% to 30% of the maximum output, Xue Ying still felt it.
"Such power!" Protector Cheng Yu was surprised. He thought he would just smash away his opponent's spear. "The power of the cultivators from this cosmos should be much weaker. This Dong Bo Xue Ying might have just broken through, but he is still just a newly advanced Paragon. How could he become so strong that I was unable to crush him?"
"Interesting." Xue Ying's pupils contracted. "Although I can hope to gain the upper hand in a direct clash, it will be hard for me to actually kill him. I must get an advantage… I'll just use my superior comprehension, then."
Xue Ying immediately changed his spearmanship.
"Hu~ hu~ hu~"
This time, his Blood Serpent spear took on the vivid image of a real, large snake. He simultaneously unleashed his spear attack. Each attack fell light as a feather, but at crucial times, it would unleash a powerful force. Protector Cheng Yun had already retracted a huge number of his hairs to envelop him, all while trying his hardest to defend his life using his stone stick.
"Pu." Due to the big difference in comprehension, the spear was free to continue the assault. After roughly ten strikes, Xue Ying finally managed to penetrate Protector Cheng Yun's defenses. A hole appeared in the protective layer made up of his numerous hairs, and Xue Ying's spear then successfully made contact with Protector Cheng Yun's stone stick around the latter's abdominal area. The true god weapon had been letting out its Dao of Slaughter in its attack from the very beginning, so it managed to pierce through Protector Cheng Yun's tough skin and right into his flesh, leaving behind a bloody hole in his body. By now, Protector Cheng Yun was simply receiving and blocking Xue Ying's Blood Serpent Spear attacks using just his body.
One side was attacking, the other was simply using his body to receive these attacks.
'Hmph, these kinds of injuries mean nothing to me,' Protector Cheng Yun thought, brimming with confidence. His powerful body was also accompanied by good recovery abilities. Although Xue Ying's spear was accompanied by that aura of slaughter, Protector Cheng Yun felt he could easily heal his injuries.
'How can this be?' Protector Cheng Yun was suddenly left surprised. He had just noticed a type of mysterious energy lingering around his injured area, and it was slowing down his healing to a crawl. In fact, other than affecting his healing speed, this energy was also attempting to seep out from his injured area and into other parts of his body. As a result, Protector Cheng Yun was forced to move split part of his focus from blocking and into isolating the energy.
Protector Cheng Yun's expression changed. 'Venom? This Dong Bo Xue Ying… is he proficient in his cosmos' hexing poisons? That type of poison is so potent that even I can feel some threat from it.'
Facing this Ancestor Mother Religion Protector, Xue Ying, who still some distance away, had already decided: 'As long as I rely on my Luminous Sun and Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body, my power is roughly equal to that of an apex paragon, even though I only recently opened my dao. Facing this Protector Cheng Yun, though, my strength is still only about half of his. After my spear passed through the protective layer formed from his hair, it was left with no more than 30-40% of its power. It would be hard for me to enter a frontal battle against him. I would have few advantages in such a fight.'
After all, Xue Ying's combat power was still weaker than his opponent's. His attack did manage to pass through Protector Cheng Yun's defensive layer, but those hairs were still extremely tough. By the time his strikes reached his opponent, they would have lost even more of their power, to the point where he had only about 30% of his opponent strength.
While his opponent also couldn't use his full power thanks to the venom, that alone wouldn't change the outcome.
'Based on Monarch Hex Cricket's information, this man is just an ordinary protector of the Ancestor Mother Religion. Despite that, his strength is still comparable to Monarch Hex Cricket's, and he is stronger than what I can handle using my two absolute arts.' Xue Ying was starting to feel the difference between the cultivators from two different cosmoses, and that difference was big.
Protector Qing Yun was becoming even more furious. 'I've been a protector for how many years, yet I'm still being suppressed by this kid? Monarch Hex Cricket is one thing, but for a puny Dong Bo Xue Ying's spearmanship to suppress me…'
The two of them had reached a stalemate.
One side's power stemmed from his absolute arts, which provided him with good enough strength, but still lacking when compared with his opponent's.
The other side was questioning why, even after having been a protector for so long, he was still being bullied by a newcomer.
'Looking at his current recovery rate, it would seem that this Blood Serpent venom is indeed extraordinary.' Xue Ying seemed pleased. He immediately launched another attack using his spear.
The Blood Serpent Venom was indeed an insidious and terrible venom.
Xue Ying's True God weapon imbued with the eternal Dao of Slaughter, which could only mean that it had been at least refined by a ruler! That existence had also deliberately infused it with the Blood Serpent Venom. Of course, the venom wasn't weak—according to the white-haired old man from Starting Ground, this spear could easily kill any existence with a weak constitution or who lacked life-preserving techniques! Even those who had stronger bodies or constitutions, upon being stabbed by the spear, would find it difficult to expel the venom. Since they couldn't get rid of the venom, it would become much harder for them to recover.
And this was exactly what happened to Protector Cheng Yun—he found it difficult to recover.
"Hu~hu~hu~" With mirage-like movements, the Blood Serpent Spear struck at Protector Cheng Yun. Not every attack landed, but every now and then, Xue Ying would successfully slash his opponent's body.
Protector Cheng Yun howled angrily, waving his stone stick with firm and forceful strength. However, this did nothing to improve his situation. It had a minimal effect on the Blood Serpent Spear, and with every ten attacks, perhaps no more than one would even land.
On the opposite side of things, his body had already suffered eight attacks from the Blood Serpent Spear. Each attack had left a gaping hole in his body, and there was even one such hole in his throat. Although Protector Cheng Yun had tried his hardest to recover, the process was extremely slow, and he had only managed to heal a very small portion of his injuries. He had no way of completely expelling the Blood Serpent Venom from his body, and each attack from Xue Ying's part that landed on his body only served to further saturate the venom in his body.
'This Xue Ying is all alone, and I still can't win over him!' Protector Cheng Yun suddenly raised his head and let out a roar. His countless strands of hair were fluttering and flickering with green light. A type of pattern began to appear on every strand of his hair, and even the air around him seemed to become sharper. He sent Xue Ying a sinister look, then waved his stone stick, causing the surrounding space to collapse in the process. This new move of his was very fierce.
Staring from a distance, Xue Ying knew that Protector Cheng Yun's moves had just become more powerful than ever.
'He went berserk?' Xue Ying was secretly shocked. He had already heard from his teacher that the members of Ancestor Mother Religion had extremely strong and tyrannical bodies and that at critical moments, they could go berserk. While they remained in this state, their power would increase exponentially. However, this state only lasted for a very short time.
"Hu." Xue Ying could not truly believe it yet, so he tried using his spear to clash directly against Protector Cheng Yun's attack; he was trying to test just how much stronger his opponent had become.
"Hong!"
The two weapons collided in mid-air, and the resulting impact sent Xue Ying flying downwards. Upon reaching the ground, the impact left a huge crater behind him.
'His strength is three times that from before.' Xue Ying rushed out of the crater while looking high above, only to see that Protector Cheng Yun had started to dive in his direction at high speeds. 'His strength was already overwhelming; how is it even possible for him to gain so much more of it?'
From the very beginning, Xue Ying had been looking down on the people from the Ancestor Mother Religion. He thought them to be brutes with low comprehension of the realm and crude techniques.
However, this time, he understood that they simply had their own cultivation methods! Although they lacked in terms of their comprehension of the realm, they made up for it with great power and speed. These two trains of thought were essentially equal, and even under normal circumstances, an ordinary Protector would have strength comparable to Monarch Hex Cricket's. Upon entering this berserk state, they would reach three times their original strength. Such power placed them on the level of rulers!
Although their comprehension was lower, this kind of power was also frightening in its own way.
'Thankfully, my strength is not too bad when I add up those two absolute arts. I'm somehow able to fight him off even when he is in this berserk state.' While Protector Cheng Yun was furiously rushing over, Xue Ying simply brandished his Blood Serpent Spear. However, this time he was not attacking, but rather wholeheartedly focusing on defense.
"Peng~peng~peng~"
The stone stick was backed by fierce might.
When Xue Ying was also attacking, about 30% of his opponent's strength could land on him. However, now that he was focused on defense, no more than one-tenth of his opponent's power was able to reach Xue Ying. Although an innumerable amount of Protector Cheng Yun's strands of hairs were flying about, twisting and turning, they only served to slightly bother and distract Xue Ying; they were not affecting his defense in any way.
'I can't hurt him.' Protector Cheng Yun simply watched as his last attempt ended in failure, while his opponent's Blood Serpent Venom was entrenching even further into his body. 'The berserk state will end soon. I have to get out.'
"Hu."
Turning his body, he immediately began to move away. Since he was still in his berserk state, his flying speed was also boosted.
"Religious Leader! Are you sure that the intelligence regarding Xue Ying being just a stage four World Deity is correct?" As he fled, Protector Cheng Yun sent a message over to the Ancestor Mother Religion Religious Leader. "His strength is much higher than what is recorded in our intelligence reports! He seems much less like a stage four World Deity, and way more like a paragon."
"A paragon? He became a paragon after cultivating for just a million years?" The Religious Leader couldn't believe it. The more he understood about this cosmos' cultivation, the more he felt that one of its natives becoming a paragon within just a million years was too incredible.
"How could I be mistaken? I was fighting him up until now, and I'm currently fleeing from him," Protector Cheng Yun urgently transmitted.
Meanwhile, Xue Ying, who was still chasing behind him, took out a flying knife.
"Hong."
This was one of his True God Weapon, the flying knife.
Xue Ying put all of his power into this strike, which served to enhance the knife's Dao of Massacre. It appeared right in front of Protector Cheng Yun's forehead and, without any warning, moved out of the mirage and into the real world. Considering Protector Cheng Yun's low comprehension of the realm, he could only react after he saw the flying knife appear in the real world.
"Peng!" His head was bombarded by more spear attacks, eventually leading to his head splitting open. However, as soon as it split open, another one started to regenerate. Unfortunately for Protector Cheng Yun, this regeneration left space for the Blood Serpent Venom to move up his throat and spread onto the newly formed chin.
"It's a flying knife!" Protector Cheng Yun suddenly remembered that Xue Ying still had another True God Weapon.
"You won't be able to get away from me," Xue Ying's voice was loud and clear. It reverberated throughout its surrounding with a tinge of passion.

chapters.title: Chapter 646 - The Anxiety of Ancestor Mother Religion
chapters.content:
Chapter 646: The Anxiety of Ancestor Mother Religion
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Protector Cheng Yun's expression changed. This flying knife came with less brute force than the Blood Serpent Spear, but it was harder for him to evade or guard against it. It was all due to the flying knife traveling inside the Mirage before suddenly appearing right in front of his eyebrows! Even when Xue Ying was attacking with his Blood Serpent Spear, his attacks were not so explosive, and Protector Cheng Yun could somehow defend against them. When the spear came, Protector Cheng Yun had protected himself with numerous hair strands. He was also focused on defending, diminishing the offensive power significantly before it could even reach him. In the end, the Blood Serpent Spear only left some bleeding cuts on him.
However, Xue Ying's attack with the flying knife was entirely on another level. With a deeper understanding of the 'Dao of Slaughter', there was no way for Protector Cheng Yun to withstand this attack.
'His flying knife has destroyed my head. I can always regenerate some parts of my body, but not all. Still, this attack caused me to lose 1% of my life force.' Protector Cheng Yun looked at the hole in his body. Blood Serpent Venom infested the flesh around his wound. This venom was consuming his life force, and if he did nothing, the venom would eventually kill him when he spent his life force. Thus, he had no other way but to dig out his flesh and discard it.
But if he dug out all the injured parts on his body, he would also have to abandon the life force in those parts. That added up to an amount no less than 30% of his life force! If this continued, there was no way he could maintain this state of power eruption.
If he was unable to keep this state, Xue Ying could reach and kill him easily.
'It is vital for me to suppress the venom and sustain my body right now. But he will continue attacking with his flying knife. Each attack will deprive me of more life force. If I used up too much life force, I'd not be able to erupt with power again, and that will affect my flying speed." Protector Cheng Yun become anxious.
'If this keep going…'
'I may die in his hands.'
Protector Cheng Yun became more panicked and anxious.
Die?
Coming to this Cultivation Cosmos, he knew he could die here. But if he had to die, he would rather die for something worthwhile. That way, he would be compensated handsomely by the religion. They could even bring him here to the Cultivation Cosmos again.
'I'll not gain anything if I were killed by Dong Bo Xue Ying here. I will not gain anything if I die here.' Protector Cheng Yun panicked, 'If I die, I'll have no way to enter this cosmos again. No, I can't die here! Absolutely not!'
Many thoughts flickered through his mind as the flying knife hit him. At the same time, he tried contacting the Religious Leader, "Religious Leader, Religious Leader, save me. Quickly ask Big Brother Huo Zhu to come rescue me!"
…
In the distant base of Ancestor Mother Religion in this Cultivation Cosmos,
Inside the base, within a grand bronze hall that was mottled with vestiges, a greenish-brown figure was sitting in the center of the hall. This huge fanged-hunk who was only wrapped in several broken pieces of cloth, had a startled look: "Protector Cheng Yun, you can't escape from him?"
"His weapon contains some venom. My body is barely suppressing it and is unable to force it out or neutralize it. His True God flying knife is even more sinister. It could come out from the Mirage and appear right in front of me. I have no way to defend against it! Moreover, that flying knife not only shattered my head but the slaughtering power within it has also destroyed the life force in my head."
"Every time I received his attack, it would also affect my flying speed."
"If this continues, it is highly possible for me to die in his hand." Protector Cheng Yun urgently asked for help.
"Alright, but there's still some distance between you and Huo Zhu. you have to try your best to resist," replied Religious Leader.
"Ask them to come as soon as possible." urged Protector Cheng Yun.
Without any hesitation, the Religious Leader immediately ordered the other four protectors who stationed in Blood Devil Eden, "Huo Zhu, you and the three, hurry up to where Cheng Yun is! You have to rescue him. Each of our member here is precious. We must keep it intact."
Anger appeared in the eyes of the Religious Leader.
They had made a considerable miscalculation this time.
"If the lives from this Cultivation Cosmos died, they could easily form another avatar. But it's not the same for us." The Religious Leader muttered.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, what kind of strength does he have?"
The Religious Leader suppressed his anger.
"Religious Leader, I have already gone to the River of Time to investigate. It appears that Dong Bo Xue Ying's body in the River of Time is quite significant. The body occupies one-tenth the width of the river. Even though he might seem like a stage four World Deity, he should have opened his Dao just like the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master." a voice transmission came over.
"He has only cultivated for a million years, yet he has opened his Dao?" The Religious Leader became all the more furious and anxious, "He has recently opened a Dao and could threaten Cheng Yun's life already?"
No matter how anxious he was, he could do nothing about it. There was no way for him to enter the Lower Three Edens. Even if he could, he had to fly slowly within.
The law of the world was suppressing the Six Heavenly Wheel and other historical remains. Unless someone came with a comprehension that rode above the law of the world, they would be unable to fly or move fast inside those places. Only those like Temporal Island Lord who was well-versed in time-space law could penetrate the space and travel through the insides of Six Heavenly Wheel and Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain.
Xue Ying could also borrow his Mirage World to move at high speed within the historical remains.
It's a pity that those Ancestor Mother Religion Protectors had low realm comprehension. The 'Realm' was not their original specialties. It was their great physical strength which they had an advantage. If they could cover their flaws with excellent comprehension of the realm, then there would be no way for this Cultivation Cosmos to fight against them.
…
On another side of Blood Devil Eden, four figures were gathered outside five stone houses on a desolate plain. These were the other protectors who were stationed here with Protector Cheng Yun. There were three men and one woman. All four of them had an unordinary aura, and Protector Huo Zhu led this group. Just like Protector Cheng Yun, three of them here was ordinary protectors. Only their leader, Protector Huo Zhu, had reached the apex level of which he could easily fight and escape against Monarch Hex Cricket.
Previously, they had received Protector Cheng Yun's transmission. But due to his low status, they thought it was impossible for the Ancestor Mother Religion to send them in to rescue him. Furthermore, the four were also in the midst of refining a medicinal liquid. This medicinal liquid was meant to overcome one of the dangerous regions within Blood Devil Eden.
"We haven't finished refining the medicinal liquid." whispered one of them, a lady in a grey robe.
"Put it aside first; it's more important for us to save Brother Cheng Yun. It's not easy for each of us to come to this cultivation cosmos, so we have to rescue him." A faint trace of anger appeared on Protector Huo Zhu eyes.
"Go." Another protector, one with bluish green eye bluntly said.
"I have already tried my best to protect this medicinal liquid. Hopefully, it will be in good condition when we return." The lady in a grey robe sighed.
"Let's go." said an old man who was entirely covered in purple. Only a pair of his eyes were revealed.
"Sou sou sou sou."
Under Huo Zhu's lead, the four of them changed out as streams of light. Using their fastest speed, they flew to Protector Cheng Yun's location.
******
While Ancestor Mother Religion was trying their best to save Protector Cheng Yun, Xue Ying was currently going all out to kill his opponent!
It might seem that Xue Ying was 'trying his utmost' to finish Protector Cheng Yun, yet in truth, he still not going all out. He wasn't using his Dao of Mirage! From the start, Xue Ying had not exhibited any aspect of his Dao of Mirage. Even when he was using the True God flying knife, he was merely activating the Profound Mystery of Mirage existing in the flying knife. He did not apply his comprehension at all.
Only then could he hide his scheme even further.
"Hu."
Xue Ying was currently flying at high speed. He threw out the flying knife once again.
Once he threw his flying knife, the knife instantly vanished.
"Damn." cursed Protector Cheng Yun in front. When he saw Xue Ying throwing his flying knife, Protector Cheng Yun who was trying his best to escape, panicked. Nevertheless, there was nothing he could do since the knife would have entered his body the moment it appeared in the real world.
"Peng!!!"
Protector Cheng Yun stomach exploded. His body was torn into two. However, following that, his body rapidly recovered. The naked eyes could even see his recovery. To minimize his losses, Protector Cheng Yun had even patched back some of his flesh that contained the Blood Serpent Venom.
'I nearly lost 2% of my life force this time?' Protector Cheng Yun felt bitter. He was trying to put more distance between him and Xue Ying. But each time the flying knife struck him, it would significantly affect his speed. Xue Ying would also take this opportunity to close their distance.
Soon, the flying knife appeared once again in Xue Ying's hand.
Flying in the Mirage world, the flying knife could move faster than that in the real world.
"Go."
The knife was attacking Protector Cheng Yun again and again.
'I'm finished.' Protector Cheng Yun thought. He did not give up on his escape.
But he knew Protector Huo Zhu and the others could not make it in time. Calculating the time they needed, they would not be arriving anytime soon. Previously, he had needed two days to reach here. Although Protector Huo Zhu had a faster speed, he still required a day at least to come. As for him? He felt he could not hold up for half an hour more.
"No!" When the flying knife struck him again, it consumed another portion of his life force. As he had been using some life force to suppress the Blood Serpent Venom, the remaining life force in him could no longer boost him. Without any boost, his speed began rapidly decreasing. In the beginning, both Protector Cheng Yun and Xue Ying were comparable in strength, though Xue Ying had a higher realm comprehension than him. With this last attack and its impact on Protector Cheng Yun's life force, Xue Ying was able to fly much faster than Protector Cheng Yun.
"You will die." Seeing that his speed was much faster than his opponent now, Xue Ying let out a grin.
"I'm finished." Grief and resentment filled Protector Cheng Yun.
At this moment, Xue Ying was only looking forward to killing his opponent, yet he did not know what killing a protector meant! From his viewpoint, the protector could refine another body out! Thus, he would only be earning some treasures.
But he was wrong. He did not know the difference between the two cosmos.

chapters.title: Chapter 647 - Despair
chapters.content:
Chapter 647: Despair
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Having just attained the realm of Paragon, Xue Ying could get rid of an expert on the same level. Furthermore, it was an enemy from a different cosmos.
That was an accomplishment that made cultivators excited!
'I didn't expect that the use of the True God Weapon flying knife is so huge.' Xue Ying was shocked, 'Back then that Leaf Saint could sense the flying knife slightly earlier, yet the realm of the Ancestor Mother Religion Protectors is too low, and he unexpectedly cannot sense it at all!'
There was not the slightest bit of sensing or defense.
The flying knife was able to produce a great result each time it was used.
As the flying knife approached, Protector Chen Yun became more and more indignant and unreconciled. He reminisced about his hometown and recollected about the noble aspirations he had when he arrived at the Cultivator Cosmos.
"I will accomplish something great."
"After entering the Cultivator Cosmos, perhaps I could even establish a sect, and become a religious leader."
Back then he had heroic and lofty emotions!
Now as his injuries worsened, Protector Cheng Yun felt more and more aggrieved: 'This avatar that has entered the Cultivator Cosmos will die soon. My death feels unworthy, and I've not accomplished any great merits after coming to the Cultivator Cosmos. The religion will definitely not pay a great price to let me nurture another avatar and come here."
"Cheng Yun, die!" Xue Ying had already approached rapidly. His flying knife was thrown out once again.
Protector Cheng Yun only glanced at Xue Ying.
His vitality was being eroded, turning him incapable of suppressing the Blood Serpent Venom. The Blood Serpent Venom had also begun to spread within his body. Ugly veins appeared on the surface of Protector Cheng Yun's skin as he looked at Xue Ying: "I have never imagined that such a simple mission will end up with my death at your hands."
"What are you talking about?" Xue Ying felt odd, "Am I not killing just an avatar? Why the need to despair?"
Although he was slightly puzzled, Xue Ying did not hesitate.
"Pu chi."
The Blood Serpent Spear once more struck forth. This time, Protector Cheng Yun did not block it at all. He let the spear hit his body, allowing it impale his body, and causing his body to and disappear.
As he shattered and disappeared, Protector Cheng Yun continued to look at the vast, blood-colored skies.
"Cultivation Cosmos, goodbye, I will not have the chance to see you again."
"Hua."
His body completely disappeared.
Xue Ying suddenly understood, 'The blood serpent poison is truly formidable, for it had pervaded his entire body and destroyed him from the inside.'
'The body of this Ancestor Mother Religion Protector is quite strong. Once he goes all out to explode, its power will be frightening. Fortunately, I have two absolute arts, both of which are extremely formidable in the aspect of strength. I can still resist it with all my defenses.' Xue Ying sighed inwardly. Under his most robust defense, the opponent can only display a tenth of his strength.
But just this tenth…
If he did not have the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" and "Luminous Sun", he would be utterly suppressed, and could only hide inside the Mirage World!
'This is only an ordinary protector, yet his power is so strong.' Xue Ying inwardly muttered, 'I don't even know if my plan will work. Even if it didn't, with the help of the Mirage Dao, survival isn't an issue.'
Xue Ying looked around at the treasures floating in midair-they were left behind by protector Cheng Yun. He waved his hand.
"Hu."
He kept these treasures and would thoroughly inspect them in a while.
'This Ancestor Mother Religion protector is somewhat odd. It was merely the loss of an avatar. Why do I find that things aren't right?' Back when they fought, he had not thought much about it. But now, the more he thought about it, the weirder the entire incident was.
If this was the Cultivator Cosmos…
Having an avatar killed?
Typically one would be indignant-If you dare to slay my avatar, then wait for my revenge! One would be distressed over their weapons and treasures at most since they could nurture another avatar in the future. Their original body could then easily split his soul in two. This damage from the splitting of the soul could be easily recovered as well. If no treasures were lost, then losing a body wasn't an issue at all.
"Monarch Hex Cricket." Xue Ying directly transmitted through karma, asking, "I just slew one of the protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion, yet the protector was in great despair. I keep feeling that things aren't right."
…
In the skies of the Blood Devil Eden.
A rapidly flying flame rainbow light stopped.
Protector Huo Zhu and the other three were all stunned.
"Cheng Yun has died." The grey-robed female protector slowly said, "I truly didn't expect that just after arriving at the Cultivator Cosmos, he would die like this."
"He was killed by a stage four World Deity." The blue-eyed man grimly laughed, "It's truly not worth the effort."
"Religious Leader has also said that although that Xue Ying is a stage four World Deity, he has already opened his Dao, and is equivalent to their Paragons." The grey-robed female protector said.
"A newly advanced Paragon had exterminated Cheng Yun?" The old man wrapped in a purple robe that merely exposed a pair of old eyes gloomily said.
"He was restrained by his flying knife." Protector Huo Zhu vigorously said, grinding his teeth, "We have been ordered to arrive at the Six Heavenly Wheel. Us five have stayed here as a team for an endless amount of time without dying. I didn't think that an unremarkable Xue Ying would cause the death of Cheng Yun."
They were currently feeling complex.
At the same time, the incomparably furious Ancestor Mother Religious Leader immediately transmitted an order: "Protector Huo Zhu, you four work together, and kill Xue Ying for me!"
"Yes."
Protector Huo Zhu and the three others all responded.
They did not place Xue Ying in their eyes. After all, the four of them had worked together in the Six Heavenly Wheel, facing many dangers, and had even fought with Monarch Hex Cricket. Therefore, they did not fear Xue Ying.
"Set off." Protector Huo Zhu's voice vigorously resounded as he looked towards the direction of Xue Ying, "Kill that Dong Bo Xue Ying."
"Go."
"Kill him."
"Within this Blood Devil, no one can save him."
These four protectors at once became a ray of flame rainbow light and rapidly rushed in the direction where Xue Ying was located.
******
Xue Ying could guess that after killing Protector Cheng Yun, The other protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion in the Lower Three Edens would perhaps take revenge! After all, he was a 'Newly advanced Paragon', and did not have much deterrence towards the Ancestor Mother Religion.
Knowing that they would come, Xue Ying had already discussed with Monarch Hex Cricket.
"You killed a protector of the Ancestor Mother Religion?" Monarch Hex Cricket replied, full of incredulous shock in his voice.
"Yes, what of it?" Xue Ying asked, "This should only be an avatar, and killing an avatar can't be such a big deal."
"You, you truly are amazing." Monarch Hex Cricket exclaimed.
"What's the matter?" Xue Ying was bewildered.
He was utterly ignorant of the Ancestor Mother Religion.
His teacher had told him many things, such as what techniques the known experts from Ancestor Mother Religion had, and what they specialized in. He also understood they had true bodies and avatars.
"Adding up the protector you have killed." Monarch Hex Cricket said, "Our Cultivation Cosmos has only killed three protectors up till now."
"Ah." Xue Ying was stunned.
Had they only killed three protectors? And he had disposed of one of them?
"The Ancestor Mother Religion is known for being crafty, and in the Cultivation Cosmos, one will usually not see them at all. Only in the Lower Three Edens of the Six Heavenly Wheel is there a group of protectors since there is only me located here!" Monarch Hex Cricket explained, "In essence, they will never do things they aren't confident of. If there are dangers, they will hide. They treasure their lives very much so! The exception is when a treasure that would turn them mad, only then will they will take the risk."
"Thus, excluding this kill, we have only killed two protectors before." Monarch Hex Cricket said, "I must tell this news to the eight Rulers immediately. This matter has become huge. You must also keep the treasures that protector has with you since your teacher and the others will probably wish to inspect them."
"Mn." Xue Ying responded.
…
Monarch Hex Cricket soon transmitted the information to the eight Rulers.
The Temporal Island Master, Bloodshed God Emperor, Myriad God Palace Head, Empress Qian He, Primal Master, Ruler Nile, Purgatory Ruler, and Abyss Primogenitor.
All eight of them received the information.
"What?"
"That little brat Xue Ying killed one of Ancestor Mother Religion's protectors?"
"Isn't he a stage four World Deity?"
"Ah, he opened his Dao?"
The Rulers were all extremely astonished as they received the information since aside from the Bloodshed God Emperor, none of them knew that Xue Ying had already opened his Dao. Opening his Dao in a million years… That was terrifying! It was even more terrifying than transcending in a million years. Right now Xue Ying had not only opened a Dao, he had even gotten rid of an Ancestor Mother Religion protector within the Six Heavenly Wheel.
"Dong Bo."
Xue Ying was standing on top of the peak of a mountain with the mountain wind blowing. He was leisurely enjoying the scenery when suddenly, the voice of Bloodshed God Emperor resounded, "You killed a protector of the Ancestor Mother Religion?"
"Mn." Xue Ying responded, "Teacher, what of it?"
"Hahaha, I'm afraid that the Ancestor Mother Religion might despairing to to death at this moment." The Bloodshed God Emperor laughed loudly, "You must take care of yourself. The Ancestor Mother Religion will not be afraid to act within the Six Heavenly Wheel. They hold an absolute advantage in strength, and there will surely be a group of protectors coming to deal against you."
"Teacher, please be assured, this disciple has long made preparations." Xue Ying said.
Previously, he did not display the Dao of Mirage all because he was preparing to hook more fishes.
"Teacher, you said that the Ancestor Mother Religion would be in despair?" Xue Ying asked curiously, "It is merely losing an avatar, yet why the need to feel despair?"
"Speaking of this, haha, you have gained a huge respect for your teacher this time." The Bloodshed God Emperor was somewhat happy.

chapters.title: Chapter 648 - Ancient Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 648: Ancient Demon
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying was able to sense the current superb mood his teacher had. Thinking about it, he understood that he must have narrated the matter of him killing the protector from the Ancestor Mother Religion to the other seven Rulers. By then, his breakthrough into the 'Opening realm' would be promulgated. One had to know that even that old man from the 'Starting Ground' was astonished to see him open his Dao within a million years,
The other seven Rulers would naturally be astounded too, and would undoubtedly have chatted with his teacher Bloodshed God Emperor. Reaching the level of his teacher, when other Rulers at the same level were astounded or filled with envy and jealousy, it would bring joy to the God Emperor.
"These few old men had been surprised by you." Bloodshed God Emperor's voice reverberated by the ears of Xue Ying, "Hahaha, you have done two things consecutively that shocked them."
"It's luck, just luck." Xue Ying humbly replied.
But this was just the beginning.
If his scheme succeeded, he might be able to kill one or two more protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion! However, the eventual outcome was a variable since those protectors had an overwhelmingly strong body. Furthermore, they were teaming up against him this time. He did not have the certainty, and thus, there was no need to mention it.
It would not be too late to inform his teacher after he had done the deed!
"Teacher, why would the Ancestor Mother Religion feel despair for the death of a protector?" Xue Ying asked again.
"The Ancestor Mother Religion is truly mysterious. Our understanding of them is lacking." Bloodshed God Emperor explained, "But according to the few interactions we had, and the experience of how difficult it was in heading to other cosmos… on one aspect, it isn't that easy for them to refine an avatar like us since we have a different cultivation system. On the other hand, they came over to our cosmos from another one. That requires a huge price."
"That time, it might be their religious leaders and protectors pooling in resources to send them over to our place via some treasure or by someone! But it might require a huge price. That was why many experts had come together."
"If a certain protector dies here, even if they could refine another avatar, it is impossible for them to pay such a huge price to send them over."
Bloodshed God Emperor said, "Naturally, there are other reasons too."
"Understood." Xue Ying was enlightened.
Sending another expert over was too pricey! Thus, this meant that the death of a protector would be a one less force on the side of the Ancestor Mother Religion!
Ancestor Mother Religion was initially at a disadvantage being outsiders of this Cultivator Cosmos! Each person they lost would diminish their overall combat force. The protectors were relatively important still for if too many protectors died, missions would have to be conducted personally by the 'religious leaders', and that was even more dangerous since Bloodshed God Emperor and the others would put in all effort to attack them!
They would not let go of the chance to kill a 'religious leader'.
"Xue Ying, right now you have just opened your Dao. Cultivating is still more important at this moment! Dealing with Ancestor Mother Religion? You don't have to spend too much effort on this. Your teacher and other Rulers will naturally handle these outsiders." Bloodshed God Emperor transmitted over.
"This disciple understands." Xue Ying acknowledged.
"Ancestor Devil is comparable with 'Lake Heart Island master' across the many cosmos epochs of our cosmos. He had created the Six Heavenly Wheels that results in the formation of a Dark Abyss across all epochs. His combat power is unfathomable… and compared to the Lake Heart Island, the Six Heavenly Wheel is much more sinister and dangerous. But behind the dangers, they are many benefits too. It is also one of the reasons why the Ancestor Mother Religion gathered so many protectors here. You should travel along the Lower Three Edens to broaden your perspectives." Bloodshed God Emperor ordered before cutting off the communication channel.
Standing at the peak, the mountain wind was whistling, and Xue Ying was thoroughly inspecting this Blood Devil Eden.
His teacher was right.
His current experience was lacking, and the places which he had been to that were comparable to the 'Six Heavenly Wheels' included only the Starting Ground and the Lake Heart Island. He had not gone to other dangerous places within the Lake Heart Island historical remains previously, and had visited just the 'Destruction Eden'. The Starting Ground was comparatively more peaceful-he became a mortal there, and fought a single battle with the 'strongest World Deity'.
With the temper of 'Ancestor Devil', the 'Six Heavenly Wheel' would not be that peaceful.
"Sou."
Xue Ying turned into a streamer before flying within the Blood Devil Eden.
The Ancestor Mother Religion could be chasing after him currently. If he were to remain still, he might cause the Ancestor Mother Religion to suspect if he had some motives.
'Blood Devil Eden.'
As Xue Ying flew along, he was also observing the place. The sky dome was blood in color, and the black soil of the ground was permeated with fresh blood, 'According to the intelligence reports, the Lower Three Edens may seem quiet and safe, but the dangers would descend suddenly without warning.'
Because there were no laws, the Six Heavenly Wheel was extremely dangerous to the weaker Paragons.
God Emperor was assured of Xue Ying because he cultivated the 'Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body' along with the newly opened 'Dao of Mirage'. Comparing his survival capabilities, he was ranked in the forefront amongst the Paragons! God Emperor was naturally at ease.
…
"He is moving."
A rainbow flame light was currently flying at top speed.
Within this rainbow flame light, there was only Protector Huo Zhu in it. He temporarily kept the other three protectors in his Eden.
"Is he guessing that we are pursuing after him?" Protector Huo Zhu sneered, "But it's a pity that it is useless."
"Lower Three Edens."
"Cultivators from the Cultivator Cosmos include only Monarch Hex Cricket and Dong Bo Xue Ying in the Lower Three Edens. Furthermore, Monarch Hex Cricket is guarding the Black Rain Eden and will not be leaving that place." Protector Huo Zhu was hoping for Monarch Hex Cricket to leave since another team would immediately kill their way over. Compared to that treasure within the Black Rain Eden, Xue Ying's importance was not worth mentioning.
"Hu."
He was flying at top speed and at the same time, he was receiving information about the new approximate position of Xue Ying regularly.
…
Xue Ying flew more than three hours when his eyes suddenly stared at a distant location.
It was a huge mountain that was regularly undulating. The vast mountains had some weeds growing on it.
'This is?' How great were the eyes of Xue Ying? With his physique far exceeding that of True Gods, he could even see those few legs of ants located more than 100 millions of kilometers away, much less this huge undulating mountain. He could see the 'true appearance' of that continuous chain of mountains underneath the many weeds.
It was a being currently lying there in somber.
Its body was huge as it lay there. Its head was currently facing the ground, and from his point of view, Xue Ying was able to see a huge drooping ear! Its face might be hidden, but Xue Ying could still 'see' it clearly according to the light reflection and by operating the mirage.
He clearly 'saw' that appearance of this existence, with a head that seemed like a dog!
It was a humanoid figure with dog head that had a body spanning hundreds of billions of kilometers long.
As long as he carefully extended his senses…
He could feel the colossal figure of this being that was sleeping. Its stomach was expanding at a languid pace-taking a single breath would take god knows how long, and were counted in numerical of hundreds of millions of years. Only those with great combat power could carefully discern the slow pace its stomach was moving. The more carefully he sensed, the more he could feel the power this sleeping existence had.
'Ancient Demon?' Xue Ying immediately understood what he met.
Ancient Demon.
The Ancestor Devil had painstakingly groomed it. They were not true lifeforms since a cultivator had to reach a higher realm to become a Ruler-this could not be attained simply by 'grooming' it.
Instead, it was the blood flesh warriors or machine puppets that could be easily groomed.
Like that black dog from the Starting Ground, it was not a true lifeform and had been refined with great effort by the Starting Ground Senior. But that black dog combat power was genuinely terrifying that it could even bite the Lake Heart Island master from the yesteryear and injure him!
Same with the Ancient Demon!
The Ancestor Devil had many specialties. He groomed these Ancient Demons which the Lake Heart Island Master had a relatively hard time fighting with.
'According to the intelligence reports, every single Eden within the Six Heavenly Wheel contain an Ancient Demon sleeping within. The Ancient Demons within the Lower Three Edens have all reached the Ruler level. The Ancient Demons located in the Upper Three Edens are even stronger-even Rulers are at a disadvantage against them.' Xue Ying thought. He could determine how strong Ancestor Devil was-far surpassing the Rulers of this epoch-just by looking at the six sleeping Ancient Demons within the Six Heavenly Wheels.
'I'll have to be stealthy and not wake it.'
Xue Ying carefully controlled his breathing.
His body had even started turning illusory. He began walking within the Mirage world and was trying his utmost to reduce any disturbances so as not to wake up this colossal being.
Even though the three Ancient Demons located in the Lower Three Edens were weaker, they were still at the Ruler realm!
"Hu." Xue Ying stealthily flew in the Mirage world. He avoided this Ancient Demon and tried his best to leave this place.

chapters.title: Chapter 649 - Trapped in a Deep Gouge
chapters.content:
Chapter 649: Trapped in a Deep Gouge
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Next to the sleeping Ancient Demon in mid-air, Xue Ying was carefully flying inside the Mirage. He even had the urge to just tear through the void!
That's right.
In an ordinary world, anywhere suppressed by the Six Heavenly Wheel could not be torn apart! But Xue Ying had complete control inside the Mirage, and he could just tear through the void. However, for the sake of avoiding the protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion from discovering this, Xue Ying decided to not do so, or his enemies would stop chasing as soon as they realized Xue Ying could travel a few trillion kilometers within moments!
As such, despite clearly feeling the pressure, Xue Ying could only continue to fly slowly.
"Hu."
Even after flying for a very long time, he had traveled no more than a few tens of billions of kilometers, and he was still very close to the Ancient Demon. But he had no choice; who was the one who made this Ancient Demon so huge.
"Hong."
Suddenly, a bubble appeared in mid-air.
It was translucent, and as soon as it appeared, it coincidentally wrapped around Xue Ying, who was currently flying. Despite his flying through the Mirage, Xue Ying was wrapped by this bubble with a diameter of 5,000 kilometers just the same.
'Not good!' Xue Ying's expression changed.
"Pa."
The bubble popped.
And Xue Ying, who was originally trapped in the bubble, also disappeared alongside the popped bubble. Xue Ying's body, as well as the black armor shielding his body, had completely shattered apart. In his terror, he had already disappeared from this location in mid-air.
…
Half an hour or so later.
A rainbow flame arrived in the same region. Once here, the flame stopped to reveal Protector Huo Zhe inside it.
Protector Huo Zhe's figure was strong, and his eyes burned in a vague flame. He was staring at the huge Ancient Demon in the distance and, with a wave of his hand, his three comrades also appeared by his side.
"Ancient Demon?" His three comrades were just as startled.
They had lived for a long time in the Lower Three Edens of the Six Heavenly Wheel, and were naturally aware of the most terrifying existences here—the Ancient Demons. Every single one had the combat power of a ruler.
"Who would have thought that there would be an Ancient Demon here. Things have become a little inconvenient." The gray-robed female protector transmitted a message from the side, "Dong Bo Xue Ying is hiding here somewhere. Are we supposed to deal with him in such a place? As soon as we begin fighting, it might very well end up waking up the Ancient Demon. That'd be very troublesome."
"Mn."
Everyone present agreed on this point.
