The moment an Ancient Demon awoke, it would attack any and all lifeforms in its proximity!
"Let's follow Dong Bo Xue Ying. It won't be too late to kill him after we leave this region." Protector Huo Zhu frowned as he pointed to the void afar. "The Religious Leader sent over a message stating that Dong Bo Xue Ying is right here, but ever after thoroughly searching for him, I just can't seem to find him. There seems to be no existence other than the Ancient Demon here."
"Mn." The three comrades were also thoroughly inspecting the place.
They were all protector rank existences and should be able to easily scour an area of half a hundred billion kilometers. Since their specialties differed, their methods for inspecting the surroundings also varied.
However, all of them arrived at the same conclusion—Xue Ying was not here!
"He isn't here."
"Not here either."
"I too have checked the surrounding half a hundred billion kilometers, and I can't find either," the three comrades said one after another.
"Big Brother Huo Zhu, are you certain he is here?" the blue-eyed man asked.
"I'll ask again." Protector Huo Zhu might have a deep trust in the Religious Leader, but he still found it prudent to ask.
"According to karma, he should be roughly half a hundred billion kilometers ahead of here. His position has not changed." Protector Huo Zhu frowned. "Even if he is trying to hide, I don't think he'd go next to the Ancient Demon. I think he's likely fallen into some sort of dangerous spot here, in the Blood Devil Eden."
"Right."
They were all very experienced, and naturally aware that the dangers of the Six Heavenly Wheel descended very suddenly and without following any rules.
"We'll retreat for a moment and carefully observe the surroundings." Protector Huo Zhu made his decision. The four immediately took some distance, trying their best to get as far away as possible from the sleeping Ancient Demon.
******
Xue Ying's body had instantly shattered, but he had been teleported through space at the same time.
"Truly painful."
The moment his body shattered, his True Deity Heart had also shattered.
However, an instant later, his body completely recovered, which was followed by a full recovery of his Deity Heart. Only after this series of events did Xue Ying dare inspect the surrounding scene.
He found himself in a huge, deep gouge in the earth.
The entire gap was filled with blood-colored liquid, and he was, in fact, completely immersed in it, his legs and arms restricted by it.
'This… what's going on?' Xue Ying was in a slight daze.
Under normal circumstances, the shattering of his body and deity heart would only mean one conclusion—death.
However, he had actually recovered completely, and there actually seemed to be no trace of injury on his body.
Furthermore, his hands and legs were being shackled here?
'The Ancestor Devil.' Xue Ying could think of no other explanation. The Lake Heart Island Master might have been a rather benevolent figure, but the Ancestor Devil was the very creator of the Dark Abyss, a place which groomed countless of lives through the guidance of dark destruction.
"My body and True Deity Heart did not truly shatter just now. I just had the feeling that they shattered because of the unique phenomenon of void teleportation," Xue Ying silently mumbled. "According to the intelligence reports I've received, Elder Disciple Brother Monarch Green could also cause people to shatter and disappear instantly, so that the moment when the bubble burst is bound to be a similar sort of void teleportation technique. But according to logic, this teleportation method should not cause me such intense pain. Even now I'm feeling the same powerful pain.
"Actually, isn't this pain rapidly increasing?
"The void teleportation is already done, so why would the pain increase?
"Is it because of this liquid?"
Xue Ying looked around him.
He was trapped in this deep gouge, and the blood-colored liquid filling this place was actually able to penetrate his Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor! Just like the flow of water could travel through sieves, the insides of the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body was also filled with countless holes which were easily bypassed by the blood-colored liquid. It was corroding the skin, his muscles and bones, and the process brought about an intense pain which was only slightly bearable.
Furthermore, as the blood-colored liquid gradually corroded at his person, the pain was only growing more intense.
'I have to leave this place,' Xue Ying thought. His body began turning illusory as it entered the Mirage and he tried to escape.
"Dang dang dang~"
However, the very moment he began flying, his legs and hands which were shackled were pulled taut, letting out shackling sounds.
'What?!' Xue Ying was stunned. He took another look at the shackles locking down his hands and feet. 'These shackles followed me into the Mirage?'
"Break."
With a thought, Xue Ying tried breaking his own hands and feet in an attempt to escape the shackles.
"Weng weng weng." The four shackles which restricted his hands and feet formed vague patterns, and an unseen force began enveloping Xue Ying's entire body through these bindings. This force served to prevent him from breaking his hands and feet.
'That's right… if the Ancestor Devil truly wishes to trap someone, how could I, with what little combat power I have, escape from his contraption? What reason could he have for trapping me here, though?' Xue Ying felt the blood-colored liquid filling the deep gouge as it continued invading his body, and the pain was gradually rising, yet he kept his cool. 'Paragon Huo Cheng was trapped inside the Destruction Eden because he angered the Lake Heart Island, but I did nothing of the sort after I arrived at this Blood Devil Eden, so why would I be trapped here?'
The gouge was no more than 33 meters deep, and the blood-colored liquid filling it was an unknown substance. Be it the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor, the Luminous Sun Force or the World Deity energy, they would all be easily penetrated by this blood-colored liquid.
'How can I leave this place?'
Xue Ying kept looking ahead, carefully looking for any opportunity that might present itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 650 - The Dissolving Blood Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 650: The Dissolving Blood Palace
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
After the shackles bound his hands and feet, Xue Ying could not think of any method to leave the deep gouge.
'Even the Mirage can't help me escape, and my strength is not sufficient to disturb these shackles. I'm afraid that even peak paragons might not be able to shake free.' Xue Ying inwardly said. While he was slightly weaker in terms of close combat, he was absolutely at the very peak when it came to evasion techniques. However, he had been unlucky enough to come across a technique left behind by Ancestor Devil, and he was simply too weak to deal with it.
'It truly is painful.' Xue Ying could not help but wrinkle his eyebrows as he took another glance at the blood-colored all liquid around him.
The liquid had gradually permeated the insides of his body, breaching every little nook before long, and the pain only continued to increase. Even considering the realm of Xue Ying's cultivation heart, as well as the body cultivated by the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body, the pain was still hard to bear.
The most painful part of it was the powerless feeling which stemmed from being unable to stop the blood-colored liquid, and all techniques being useless!
'In the Six Heavenly Wheel of the Blood Devil Eden, even the black soil making up the ground contains blood,' Xue Ying thought. 'The blood-colored liquid within this gouge is not uncommon, but who could have known it would be this dangerous?'
The Ancestor Devil once reached an extremely high level in the Dao of the Blood Devil.
According to the "Blood Demon Scripture"that he obtained, even just starting out on this path was very difficult and unimaginably painful. And now, being within the deep gorge left his body being eroded by the blood-colored liquid, and in unimaginable pain.
'Pain?'
Xue Ying was unable to break free, so he could only endure.
He was even getting flashbacks to the hundred years of suffering he spent due to the Six Ghosts Resentment back when he was still a Transcendent. Although this blood-colored liquid was much more terrifying than the Six Ghosts Resentment, his current body and True Deity Heart were also far more powerful than back then, so the pain that this blood-colored liquid caused was not sufficient to make him collapse like the Six Ghosts Resentment did back then.
He was recalling how he had been in so much pain that he would toss in his bed, and even his soul was left trembling.
Before he realized, the blood-colored liquid had entered every last nook and cranny of Xue Ying's body, and the pain had reached a peak. At this point, the pain began to decrease, and as it did, Xue Ying began to have a strange feeling of clarity.
"Ka ka ka~" The four shackles binding his hands and feet suddenly released themselves and rapidly began to retreat into nothingness.
Xue Ying was simply standing in the deep gouge in surprise.
'It's done?' Xue Ying was somewhat bewildered as he swept his vision across the surroundings. The four chains had all withdrawn into the nearby walls of the deep hole, disappearing completely into nothingness; even in the Mirage, he could not find them.
'I'll take a bit of this blood-colored liquid to study,' Xue Ying suddenly decided and immediately used the Mirage.
The Mirage swept along the blood-colored liquid in the deep gorge, directly moving it into the Eden treasure. A liquid that could penetrate his Luminous Sun Force, his World Deity Energy, and even the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body's armor was truly very miraculous. Collecting and storing this liquid alone had to be done with the aid of space manipulation. Before the chains even suppressed his body, if there hadn't been a suppression, Xue Ying would've long since fled. There would have been no reason to suffer through the pain.
"Sou."
He instantly soared into the sky, flew out of the deep gouge, and landed on the ground outside.
"Eh?" He glanced across the surroundings.
He found himself inside an expanse of blood-colored fog, in front of him the silhouette of a building.
Xue Ying walked towards it, and as he approached, the building finally took on a distinct shape. It was a rather old construction—an entirely blood-colored palace. Its walls, its pillars, and even doors all had mottled marks, and above the main door were three ancient characters—Dissolving Blood Palace. Although these three characters were not in use during the current cosmos epoch, a single glance was enough to understand their meaning.
'Dissolving Blood Palace?' Xue Ying suddenly understood. 'It's actually the Dissolving Blood Palace, one of the three Devil Palaces.'
'Hahaha, I didn't think my luck would be so good. I've only been to the Blood Devil Eden for a short while, yet I've already arrived at the mysterious Dissolving Blood Palace!' Xue Ying was rather happy. His teacher had handed him a large amount of information, and the records of the Six Heavenly Wheel were very detailed. After all, someone of his teacher's level was bound to know a large amount of insider information.
From the Lower Three Edens of the Six Heavenly Wheel, the opportunities which could be considered safest, by comparison, were precisely the three Devil Palaces.
The three Devil Palaces were the following: the Dissolving Blood Palace, the Bone Eroding Palace, and the Heart Refining Palace. These three places could not be found through usual means, and they were located separately from the Blood Demon Eden's Black Rain Eden and Icy Snow Eden.
'Being able to coincidentally enter the Dissolving Blood Palace is truly my good fortune. According to the recorded information, this place should hold the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique.' Xue Ying began walking towards the inside of the palace.
…
The inner portion of the palace was an expanse of silence.
After all, too long a time had passed since any form of life had last entered. Xue Ying was inspecting his surroundings with great attention, so he soon discovered that the walls were covered in densely packed characters; this was precisely the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique which he desired.
"Hu."
A faint light suddenly converged within the palace.
Xue Ying turned his head to look at the source, only to see that the light had already converged into a figure. It was gradually congealing into reality, forming a cold man dressed in blood-colored robes.
The man glanced at Xue Ying, his gaze just as frigid as before. "To have withstood the bite of the Blood Ant means you have the qualifications to enter the Dissolving Blood Palace."
"Blood Ant?" Xue Ying was stunned. "The blood-colored liquid within the deep gouge was actually made up of blood ants?"
The liquid had even been able to penetrate his Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body's armor; could it be true that its most minute components were actually tiny Blood Ants?
"When I speak, you are to remain silent," the man indifferently said.
Xue Ying was stunned.
He could easily tell that this man was a mere spirit artifact, yet his character was unexpectedly this bad! However, this couldn't be helped. Xue Ying was forced to endure the mood of this spirit artifact left behind by the Ancestor Devil. After all, there was no point in forming a grudge against a spirit artifact!
"The thing on the wall is the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique," the cold man began. "Seeing how you haven't gone to the other two Devil Palaces, you must experience two trials within the Dissolving Blood Hall. One is to successfully cultivate the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique, and the other is to successfully defeat one of my Dissolving Blood Hall's Blood Beasts. Should you succeed, I will grant you the Command Token of the Three Devil Palaces. With its help, you will be able to advance to the other two Devil Palaces."
Xue Ying was already aware of this point.
Him having luckily arrived at the Dissolving Blood Hall did not mean he would have the opportunity to enter the other two Devil Palaces.
Therefore, his only option was to pass the trials left at the Dissolving Blood Hall by the Ancestor Devil and obtain a command token. If he succeeded, advancing to the other two Devil Palaces would be much easier.
'If I can pass all three trials of the Devil Palaces, the benefits will be far above the Absolute Art of the Destruction Legion.' Xue Ying was very expectant. The trials of the Three Devil Palaces were normally targeted towards paragons, but it was also up to luck. An ordinary paragon would perhaps never manage to enter the Dissolving Blood Palace of the Blood Devil Eden, yet he had just happened to stumble upon it.
In any case, he had to pass through the Dissolving Blood Palace first! On the other hand, it was not urgent to pass through the other two Devil Palaces. After all, once he obtained the command token, he would be able to find the two other palaces whenever he wished.
But if he were to fail this attempt… who knew when he could get another chance to enter the Three Devil Palaces. It was quite possible he'd never get another chance in his lifetime.
The man indifferently said, "When it comes to cultivating the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique, a success requires you to cultivate it within ten thousand years. Fail, and I will throw you out myself."
"Ten thousand years?" Xue Ying was shocked. He helplessly inquired, "Was it not one million years?"
The information his teacher had given him was very detailed.
The three Devil Palaces held three great secret techniques, and each secret technique had to be cultivated within one million years. In fact, these secret techniques themselves would not be of any great assistance to one's own strength, and they merely served as a kind of trial.
"A million years?"
The cold man wearing blood-colored robes sneered. "A soldier of the Destruction Legion like you has arrived at our Ancestor Devil's place. Had we still been in the third Cosmos Epoch, I would have already slaughtered you! You actually want us to give you the full million years to cultivate? Hmph! Had it not been for the commands of the Ancestor Devil, I would not have even given you this chance! Ten thousand years. Cultivate the technique and you succeed; fail to cultivate it and you will be sent out. Seeing you Lake Heart Island scoundrels, I wish I could just slaughter you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 651 - Three Fundamental Secrets
chapters.content:
Chapter 651: Three Fundamental Secrets
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Inwardly, Xue Ying did not know whether he should cry or laugh.
So that was the reason.
Considering the relationship between the Ancestor Devil and the Lake Heart Island Master, if this was still the third cosmos epoch, any soldier of the Destruction Legion would be sending themselves to their death if they were to enter the territory of the Ancestor Devil! However, the Ancestor Devil and the Lake Heart Island Master were no longer here during this cosmos epoch. Whether they were alive or not, and regardless of where they decided to head, it was true that these strongest two existences across the many epochs of this cosmos were no longer around. But for their grievances to affect himself now? Would he not view this as an injustice?
"You have ten thousand years. If you don't think you can succeed, you can hurry up and get lost already," said the blood-robed man. He then sat down cross-legged right next to the side of the palace hall. He was too lazy to even send another glance in Xue Ying's way.
'There's no need to bother with every treasure spirit I meet.' Xue Ying did feel that the other party's attitude was vile, but he was also aware that any treasure spirit was bound to follow the rules set by their master. Even if he hated Xue Ying, he had limited scope in which he could find trouble for him. He had merely decreased the length from a million years to ten thousand years, and could not truly force Xue Ying away. Indeed, it wasn't that he was benevolent, but instead that he lacked the power to do any more than this.
'The Ancestor Devil provided even lifeforms from other cosmoses a chance. It's normal that I, a soldier of the Destruction Legion, would also be given an opportunity.' Xue Ying now set his gaze towards the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique.
The Dissolving Blood Secret Technique was, of course, a secret technique related to blood, so feeling pain while cultivating it was normal. The closer one got to success, the more gruesome the pain would become.
Despite having never cultivated it before himself, Xue Ying could understand from the intelligence reports he received that cultivating the Dissolving Blood secret technique was split into two areas of difficulty—one was a trial that tested one's comprehension ability; it was, after all, extremely difficult to succeed in cultivating a secret technique as complex as the Dissolving Blood! The other was the trial of enduring pain. The deeper one got into the technique's cultivation, the stronger the pain they would feel. Even then, they had to continue cultivating!
Having suffered the torture of a hexing poison, Xue Ying was very clear about how difficult it was to cultivate while being wracked by pain!
"Bring it on." Not even a trace of anxiety in his expression, Xue Ying sat down cross-legged in this broken palace hall and began his cultivation.
A mortal might fear pain, but upon reaching his realm, the pain was more of a refinement of his heart and soul.
…
The moment he began cultivating, Xue Ying's skin became covered by protruding veins and arteries as his blood started to surge.
'This secret technique implies an exquisite control of blood.' Xue Ying discovered just how mystical this secret technique was as soon as he began his cultivation. 'Indeed, it is the most fundamental secret technique of the "Myriad Devil True Body"absolute art.'
The Dissolving Blood secret technique, the Eroding Bone Secret Technique, and the Heart Cultivating Secret Technique—these three secret techniques made up the trials of the Three Devil Palace. However, they all originated from the legendary "Myriad Devil True Body" absolute art and were formulated from its most fundamental aspects.
This absolute art far surpassed the six grand inheritances which Ancestor Devil was famous for, since the"Myriad Devil True Body"was the first absolute art comprehended by the Ancestor Devil. Using this terrifying absolute art, he could even fight against Lake Heart Island Master. When it came to this absolute art—according to hearsay—one had to first reach the large success stage in the six grand inheritances before they could hope to reach a large success in it. This condition alone meant that one had to open six Dao paths that reached the Ruler realm, and there were other external supplementary requirements on top of this. All in all, the difficulty was immense.
In fact, obtaining the absolute art alone was already very difficult. It entailed entering deep into the Three Upper Edens.
But if he succeeded in passing the Three Devil Palace trials…
After cultivating these three secret techniques, he would have obtained the lowest, most fundamental scripture of the "Myriad Devil True Body". This was extremely precious even to paragons. Furthermore, he would gain other benefits as well.
Thus, it was Xue Ying's fortune to have managed to enter the Dissolving Blood Palace, but his misfortune for the treasure spirit to be treating the entire Lake Heart Island as its enemy.
"Weng!"
A red light suddenly enveloped the surface of Xue Ying's body while he was sitting cross-legged. This light had actually reflected from the blood within him, but it disappeared just as suddenly as it appeared. Immediately afterward, an expansive bloody fog began spurting uncontrollably from Xue Ying's skin.
"Pu." Not only was his skin spewing out this bloody fog, fresh blood even began coming out of his mouth.
"Hmph!." The blood-robed man from before, who was still in the palace hall, opened his eyes and glanced over with a sneer.
'Why would it be like this?'
Xue Ying frowned in a very distinct expression of doubt. 'This secret technique is clearly about the utilization of the profound mysteries of the law of the world. I've already opened up my Dao path, yet I've diverged as soon as I began to cultivate this technique?'
'This is, after all, a fundamental secret technique, and a part of the"Myriad Devil True Body". It's no wonder that the Ancestor Devil would want to use it to test paragons.' Xue Ying originally felt that seeing how he had been able to open his Dao path within just a million years, his comprehension ability would enable him to easily cultivate this secret technique. However, he had unexpectedly made a mistake right at the beginning. In fact, even his true body back in the material realm was coughing up blood; he had clearly failed in his cultivation attempt.
"Continue." Xue Ying calmed himself down completely and began another attempt at cultivating.
******
Day by day, month by month, year by year passed.
Back in the Blood Devil Eden, the distant Ancient Demon was just like a huge mountain as it remained in its deep slumber. As for the four protectors from the Ancestor Devil Religion, they were feeling truly sullen.
"A thousand years have passed," the gray-robed female protector said in a low voice. "We've been waiting here for a thousand years, but Dong Bo Xue Ying has yet to appear."
"The intelligence reports cannot be fake. His position was discovered through karma; he is still in this region, without a doubt." Protector Huo Zhe looked towards the distant Ancient Demon. "He has likely entered some sort of dangerous area within the Blood Devil Eden, and is temporarily unable to leave."
The gray-robed female protector nodded. "We could have completed our medicine as soon as we killed Dong Bo Xue Ying, but we've already delayed for too long. It'll soon become useless."
"Let's keep waiting," the blue-eyed man said.
"We have enough time. Let's just continue waiting," said an old man who was wrapped in a violet robe such that only his eyes were visible.
These four protectors were indeed anxious and sullen.
Their medicine which was originally planned for completion so as to allow them to continue their adventures was now useless. They could only continue waiting here.
The way they saw it, their opponent was just a new Paragon. If the four of them were to work together, and considering how strong Protector Huo Zhe was, it would be easy for them to eradicate Xue Ying. But who would have thought that they would be stuck waiting here for so long! Furthermore, they had to continue waiting while on full alert or they might just wake the Ancient Demon.
"Just wait until he gets out. He certainly won't get a quick death from us," the gray-robed female protector said in a low mutter, and the other three protectors also expressed their agreement.
They did not have the slightest ounce of pity for any of the lifeforms from this cultivation cosmos.
…
1,000 years, 2,000 years, 3,000 years… in the blink of an eye, more than 6,000 years had already passed.
Back in the Dissolving Blood Palace, Xue Ying's figure was trembling slightly as he continued his cultivation. The pain he felt was causing his expression to contort, and he eventually could not help but let out a grunt.
"Oh? Was that a sound I heard coming from you?" In the corner of the palace hall, the blood-robed man opened his eyes upon hearing the sound and revealed an excited grin. "Painful, isn't it? Hahaha, did you think the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique would be so easy to cultivate? It is one of the three big fundamental secret techniques forming the"Myriad Devil True Body"and its requirements of one's comprehension ability are such that most paragons have a hard time cultivating it within even a million years! You actually think you can cultivate it in ten thousand years?
"Not only that but the deeper you cultivate, the greater the pain you will feel. Even your True Deity Heart will be affected.
"During those moments of the most intense pain, it will become even harder to cultivate.
The blood-robed cold male stood up, appreciating the trembling Xue Ying's expression contorted from pain. "Still, I can't help but feel that you soldiers from the Destruction Legion are 'formidable'! It's already been a bit over years six thousand years, yet you've merely cultivated a minor part of the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique, and the pain you're not feeling is not even close to the maximum! Just wait until you reach the large success stage; by then, you'll feel it on your own skin. I might not have attempted cultivating the technique myself, but I've seen more than enough paragons lose themselves.
"Oh! I almost forgot.
"You have just ten thousand years of time to finish your cultivation. Once that term is over, I'll throw you right out! But even if you leave this place, you can continue cultivating and enjoying the feeling of the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique. Unfortunately for you, even if you succeed in cultivating the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique after you leave, it won't do you any good.
"You must succeed within ten thousand years—the Ancestor Devil is, after all, testing your comprehension ability!"
The blood-robed cold man continued speaking while he enjoyed the sight of Xue Ying being in agonizing pain.
But all of a sudden—
Xue Ying, who was originally in great pain, regained his calm. His originally contorted facial expression regained its usual calm, and he simultaneously opened his eyes to look at the blood-robed man.
"I spoke no more than a few sentences, and you already can't take it anymore? Your cultivation heart is truly pitiful," the man commented upon seeing him wake up.

chapters.title: Chapter 652 - Blood Creature
chapters.content:
Chapter 652: Blood Creature
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within the ancient Dissolving Blood Palace.
The treasure spirit—the blood-robed cold man—was still sneering at the soldier from Destruction Legion sitting in front of him.
However, Xue Ying wasn't angry at this. In fact, he was actually wearing a sly smile. He did not care about bickering with the treasure spirit, so he simply let out a terrifying aura.
"Hong!"
One could see bloody fog vaguely appear to envelop the surface of Xue Ying's body. On top of this, a huge, strange reptile appeared on his back. The lizard had an extremely long tail, so long that it surrounded his body twice over, and it seemed to be sleeping as it lay on its tail.
"Tiger Cricket Totem?" The blood-robed cold man was staring at the strange scene appearing behind Xue Ying. After cultivating the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique to the large success stage, one would be able to externally project this very scene. It was said that the Ancestor Devil had received enlightenment from three unique lifeforms, and it was this knowledge that he then used to create the profound "Myriad Devil True Body". Only then was he able to set down the fundamentals for this absolute art, fusing them together with his countless experiences and other external supplementary objects to eventually form his true body.
After he successfully cultivated this technique, even the Lake Heart Island master, whose combat power was known to be insurmountable, could not defeat the Ancestor Devil.
"You succeeded?" The blood-robed man was staring at Xue Ying with a frown of disbelief. "That scene just now was actually you reaching the final bottleneck?"
The expression of savage pain which Xue Ying had shown just a while ago, complete with his grunt, was actually the final moment agony he let out as he reached the final bottleneck. Thinking back on it, this was clearly the true reason he had let out a sound. It was very clear by now just how terrifying Xue Ying's comprehension ability was.
"Ten thousand years is indeed a very short time, but I was lucky enough to succeed nonetheless," Xue Ying said with a chuckle.
"Hmph." A feeling of grievance was brewing up in the cold man's stomach. "You, soldier of the Destruction Legion, are indeed quite proficient when it comes to comprehending techniques, for you to have succeeded within such a short time. However, you shouldn't be too happy! Remember, if you want to obtain the command token from the Three Devil Palace, you have to get through two trials. The Dissolving Blood Secret Technique was just the first trial. You might have passed this trial of comprehension ability, but the second trial is one that tests your true combat power."
"I know. What was it that you said before, something about defeating a Blood Creature?" Xue Ying nodded.
He had gotten quite a lot of information from his teacher. The process involved succeeding in cultivating the secret technique within a million years and then winning a frontal battle. Only then would he receive the command token.
This particular command token was actually the token for the entire Three Devil Palace.
Using it, he could easily make his way towards the other two palaces. Even if he failed ten or a hundred times, he could try it again and again.
Thus, obtaining the command token would mean that half the work was already done!
Even if he failed afterward, he could just wait until his combat power reached a higher level. However, if he could not find the Three Devil Palace, it would be pointless even if he was stronger.
"Indeed, the second trial is combat against a Blood Creature. They are a form of life bred by His Majesty precisely for the sake of battle. Its combat power is incredible, and most Paragons would likely end up either suppressed or torn apart and eaten in a fight against it." The blood-robed man sneered. "I've heard that the armor you soldiers of the Destruction Legion don in battle is formidable, but that won't matter if the Blood Creature just swallows you whole."
Having said these words, the man pointed to a corner of the palace hall.
Weng!
A drop of black-colored blood condensed out of nowhere then began floating in mid-air as golden patterns shifted on its surface.
Soon afterward, following a 'hua' sound, the black-colored liquid started rapidly distorting and expanding, and before long, transformed into a mutated beast covered in black scales, and standing upright to reach a height of roughly ten meters or so. Its legs were very short, but its claws were thick and long, and its arms reached a length that was approximately half of its entire body. There were three horns on its head, but its most distinctive trait had to be its huge, bloody mouth. Its two small eyes were flickering with savageness and cunningness.
The strangest part about this beast, though, was that even though it was just standing in place, its figure began emitting countless circular black ripples that affected the void. Xue Ying could easily feel an inherent threat present in these ripples.
'Such a terrifying beast. It's just standing there, but it can still give me a feeling of looming death.' Xue Ying heart was left in trepidation. 'This blood creature groomed by the Ancestor Devil is definitely not any weaker than those fools from the Ancestor Mother Religion whose realms are extremely low,.'
The Ancestor Devil was, after all, a member of this cultivation cosmos.
However, he was originally a cultivator during the third cosmos epoch and was ranked at the very top across the many epochs alongside the Lake Heart Island Master. These two figures could look down on any and all experts across the cosmos epochs.
There were many powerful experts having appeared during the other cosmos epochs, some even stronger than the Bloodshed God Emperor, but the gap between them and the Ancestor Devil was still clear.
"That swordmaster from your Lake Heart Island has even groomed a legion." The blood-robed cold man sneered. "When it comes to tactics and slaughtering ability, our Ancestor Devil is undoubtedly the expert! Back then, had the Ancestor Devil not seen the potential of your swordmaster, feeling that he would become a good opponent if he was shown mercy, your swordmaster would have died!"
"The world of cultivation functions on the base of cause and effect. The Ancestor Devil should have embarked on the path of cultivation earlier than the swordmaster," Xue Ying retorted.
It must be stated that the Starting Ground functioned as the beginning and the end. Only the swordmaster—the Lake Heart Island Master—had been able to discover its existence, and had even forcibly barged inside. In fact, even the black dog, a creature painstakingly refined by the senior from the Starting Ground to be responsible for guarding the place, could not obstruct him; he had merely bitten off a mouthful from the swordmaster's body. Fortunately, the swordmaster had been arrogant enough to not take away the treasures from the Starting Ground, or it could have had no further descendants.
And the Ancestor Devil stemmed from the same era as the Lake Heart Island Master, but he never discovered the Starting Ground, or he discovered it but never visited the place! From this, the gap their combat power was apparent. Furthermore, over the longest period of time, the Lake Heart Island Master remained recognized publicly as the strongest existence. From this too, the gap between the two parties was made clear.
Xue Ying estimated that the Ancestor Devil depended on the Myriad Devil True Body to stand straight against his rival.
"Hmph, but if we're to compare the methods of refining subordinates, he is absolutely not on par with our Ancestor Devil. Brat, aren't you a soldier of the Destruction Legion? It's not like I'm trying to bully you. Fighting a Blood Creature has always been one of the rules. If you're capable enough, you should just defeat it." The blood-robed man sneered, then turned towards the blood creature and said, "Start."
"A soldier of the Destruction Legion?" the blood creature growled. Its huge bloody mouth slowly opened, and the killing intent in its eyes intensified. "From the moment I began guarding this place and up until now, this is my first time fighting a soldier from the Destruction Legion."
"Come, then." Xue Ying extended his right hand, causing the Blood Serpent Spear to appear.
"Hu."
The blood creature suddenly moved.
A vague black ripple rapidly arced through the sky to appear in front of Xue Ying with the blood creature at its center. Once in front of his opponent, the creature began waving its terrifying claws. There were many patterns revolving on top of the claws, and the black ripples were rolling all about, sending a frightening destructive power into anything they touched. Xue Ying got the feeling that he would definitely receive a powerful backlash if he attempted to parry the ripples using his weapon!
"Die." The blood-robed man was watching the battle calmly from the side.
He was very clear about the blood creature's power level.
"Hu.""Hu."
The blood creature, which was itself just over ten meters tall, stretched its claws to become a dozen meters long as he waved them out.
These two front claws essentially slashed Xue Ying's body in an instant.
However, as if the claws were moving through empty space, Xue Ying was just standing there without making any move.
"Hu hu hu." The claws continued to move, and within a split second, a few dozen illusions started to condense all around. The beast's power was surging, but no matter how he attacked, Xue Ying was simply standing in place. His body did not even shake.
"What?" The blood creature and the blood-robed man were both stunned.
The beast's attacks could not reach Xue Ying.
The two of them quickly discovered that this cultivator who wore black armor possessed a body which seemed real and unreal at the same time. No matter how the beast struck, it could not touch him.
'Is he in another world?' the blood-robed man began to guess.

chapters.title: Chapter 653 - Thrown Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 653: Thrown Out
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The blood-robed cold man frowned. 'This soldier of the Destruction Legion is quite hard to deal with. The Dao he opened is actually one that allows him to create another world. That might seem weak in terms of offensive ability, but when it comes to survival capabilities and escaping methods, it is very formidable. The blood creature can't seem to even touch him!'
How could it win against an enemy it could not touch?
"Is that all you have?" Xue Ying stood there, sneering at the creature. "I'm just standing here, but it seems to me that you can't even touch a single strand of my hair. I thought you Blood Creatures were more formidable."
While it seemed like he was just criticizing the blood creature, he was actually also observing it searching for ways to defeat it.
"You're only hiding." The blood creature stopped in place, and let its huge claws fall by the sides of its body as it growled out, "Unless you come out, you won't be able to win either, and if you can't win, you will eventually be thrown out! By then, you likely won't get another chance to enter the Three Devil Palace for the rest of your life."
"Hide? I was merely giving you a chance by allowing you to attack first. Since you can't deal with me, I'll be making my move." Xue Ying's words had a tint of challenge in them, but it quickly became apparent that the blood creature, a lifeform groomed by the Ancestor Devil for the sake of battling, would not be affected in any way by any critique or challenging words.
"Hu."
Xue Ying suddenly disappeared from his original location.
While he was inside the Mirage world, if he decided to allow the other party to discover him, his opponent would be able to see him. But if he instead wished to conceal himself, the other party would not be able to see even a trace of him! This was just like how his flying knife True God weapon would disappear the moment it was thrown.
"He has truly entered another world." The blood-robed cold man watched on in silence.
…
Within the Mirage.
Just like standing by the side of a bank, watching the world underneath the surface of the water, Xue Ying got a rather unique feeling as he stood there, watching the ordinary world.
'The vast cosmos is truly mythical and unfathomable.'
'The ordinary world is where the absolute majority of lifeforms live in, but there are many unique places that can't be reached in the ordinary world. There are even other cosmoses!' Xue Ying was sighing. The more profound a realm he reached, the more he realized how little he knew. He now saw himself like an ant underneath the starry sky, seeing only half a dot within a single star.
However, he was quite happy and excited about his future journey down this road.
After all, with every bit of knowledge he gained, he would begin to understand more and more of the world. The current him had already transcended beyond the ordinary world, and he was starting to grasp hold of the Mirage world which he had opened. He was even starting to suspect that the Starting Ground was also some a sort of world similar to the Mirage world, but a few levels more profound. That is the reason he could teleport into the Starting Ground from anywhere in this cosmos, as well as the other way around.
The will of the material realm, the will of the Abyss, the Sun Star, the Moon Star, the Lake Heart Island, the Six Heavenly Wheel; none of these, or any other terrifying place could hope to obstruct the forced teleportation of the Starting Ground.
This single point was enough to leave Xue Ying sighing in praise.
Furthermore, the way he understood it, the senior of the Starting Ground should have been to many cosmoses and wasn't actually a member of this cultivation cosmos.
Even so, the strongest expert of his cosmos, the Lake Heart Island Master, had been able to discover the Starting Ground and force his way in, breaking through some of the security left behind by the senior. In terms of combat power, even if he had not reached that of the senior at that point, it should at least have been close.
'Since the Lake Heart Island Master was able to do it, our epoch should be able to achieve such a thing as well. I too must have a chance at reaching that level, and by then, I'll definitely start visiting the many different cosmoses to broaden my horizons.' Xue Ying revealed a grin. 'Maybe at that point, the Ancestor Mother Religion might be no more than a joke in front of me.'
The path of cultivation was indeed such that people would often become addicted to it.
Xue Ying could not help but laugh as he walked through the Mirage while continued to observe the alerted blood creature which was staring vacantly within the ordinary world.
'How about a slash as a start.' Xue Ying extended his hand, and the Flying Knife appeared in it.
"Hu."
In a flash, the Flying Knife reached the side of that blood creature and almost immediately afterward, it entered the ordinary world to attack the beast.
"Over here!" The blood creature twisted its body, and with a wave of its claw, parried the sudden appearance of the Flying Knife, sending it flying backward. Immediately afterward, the Flying Knife disappeared, returning to the Mirage world.
"What?!" Xue Ying was startled as he went out to collect his Flying Knife. Looking at the blood creature within the ordinary world, he thought, 'It was able to discover and parry the attack?'
Back when he fought Leaf Saint, he had yet to open his Dao of Mirage, so he was forced to rely on the Flying Knife itself. However, even though Leaf Saint had discovered it in advance, his combat power was much weaker, so he could only barely defend against it.
But this blood creature was different; it had discovered the attack even earlier! Furthermore, its combat power was much stronger than Leaf Saint', allowing him to parry the Flying Knife completely.
'Again.' Xue Ying did not dare believe it. 'I've already opened the Dao of Mirage, so my attacks should be harder to detect than this.'
"Xiu."
He threw the Flying Knife out again, but this time he was carefully observing its movements. What he discovered was that the creature discovered the attack as soon as the Flying Knife entered region filled with black ripples.
'It's those black ripples that are giving off the feeling of a powerful threat. Who would have thought that it could provide defenses in the ordinary world and even sense the Mirage world.' Xue Ying was shocked. 'The Ancestor Devil is indeed formidable. A simple lifeform he created for battle refined could actually sense my moves. Fortunately, his black ripples only affect a small area.'
The black ripples covered an area that was roughly 33 meters in diameter.
Xue Ying did not find this surprising. After all, even the Ancient Demons located in the Lower Three Edens were all at the ruler realm. Furthermore, similar demons located in the Upper Three Edens were even stronger. Even the Bloodshed God Emperor himself would suffer if he were to battle any of them! It must be stated that the Bloodshed God Emperor had reached the eternal large success level with his Shadow World, and the Temporal Island Lord had reached the eternal level with his Dao of Time-Space, but even they could not overwhelm these demons!
Clearly, even though their methods were rather unique and formidable, they were not even worth mentioning in front of the Ancestor Devil.
"Is throwing that Flying Knife the only thing you know how to do?" the blood creature growled but kept a close eye on any change in its surrounding.
"Have a taste of my spear technique, then," Xue Ying's voice reverberated within the palace hall. As he spoke, he had already begun charging forward with the Blood Serpent Spear in his hand. However, he did not forget to maintain a distance of more than 33 meters from the blood creature, so as not to enter the region covered in black ripples.
"Hu."
The Blood Serpent Spear began to stretch, quickly reaching a length of over 33 meters, then rapidly left the Mirage world to strike at the blood creature located in the real world.
There was a qualitative difference between the spear and the Flying Knife.
The Flying Knife was not very flexible, and its specialty laid n covert attacks alone.
However, when wielding the spear, he could make use of all his spear techniques, giving rise to flexibility and an element of surprise. Furthermore, Xue Ying could brandish it to much greater effect than the dagger. On top of that, while the spear had a single Dao inherent to it—the Dao of Slaughter—that single Dao had already reached the eternal level, giving it truly tyrannical power. On top of that, the Blood Serpent Venom it contained was also very sinister. Overall, while the spear was weaker than the knife in terms of its covertness, it triumphed over it in every other aspect! In addition, Xue Ying specialized in the Dao of Mirage, so he was able to keep his spear stealthy enough anyway. At least against this blood creature, it made no difference as long as the weapon did not enter the region where the black ripples could reach.
"Weng."
The spear's body twisted, bringing about a terrifying revolving force as it slithered toward the blood creature like a huge snake.
The blood creature hurriedly moved to parry the attack, but it was simply too close.
A region of 33 meters was too insignificant to someone of Xue Ying's level! Faced with the Flying Knife which was too straight-forward a strike, the blood creature was able to parry it easily. But now that he had to block a spear technique completely with its ability to change forms on the fly, the creature had a very hard time keeping up. It was, after all, not even a true lifeform. Although it could increase its power and defense, it was difficult for it to improve regarding its utilization of combat techniques.
In a single move, the spear poked through a gap between the beast's front claws and thrust itself right into its chest, leaving behind a fist-sized bloody hole.
"Hu hu hu~"
The Blood Serpent Spear formed afterimages as it struck frenziedly, but with great nuance in its movements.
The blood creature was roaring out as it tried its best to parry against the incoming attacks, but the Blood Serpent Spear had come thrusting straight out of the Mirage world, and was already too close by the time he could react, making it very difficult to deal with. The beast's claws turned huge as it tried its best to defend itself, but the spear would simply start sneaking attacks in from the flank.
"Peng."
Now and then, the spear would come into contact with the claws, yet even at such times, Xue Ying would merely be forced to take two steps back in the Mirage World. 'The force wasn't reduced at all even though it had to go through the weapon and into the Mirage world. This beast's attacks are truly concise.'
'Its strength is also slightly higher than mine, but it is fortunately still within a range I can manage without getting injured.'
Xue Ying was quite carefree; he had yet to suffer any injuries.
…
'He's opened a Dao that allows him to enter another world, so he should be very weak in terms of pure offense. On top of that, the defensive ability provided by the scales of the blood creature is quite formidable.' The blood-robed man continued to watch from a distance. Closely afterward, though, a fist-sized cavity hole appeared in the body of the blood creature, which left him in a momentary gaze. However, he quickly recovered his confidence as he thought, 'I did not think his offense would be this strong. The recovery ability of the blood creature is very strong, though, so it should be able to easily recover from this injury.'
But the actual result was quite different from his imagination. The beast's injuries were recovering very slowly, while more and more holes appeared all over its body; its injuries were getting heavier by the moment.
'How can this be?' The blood-robed man was genuinely shocked, and he hurriedly asked, "What happened, blood creature?"
"The assault launched by this soldier of the Destruction Legion is very unpredictable but also powerful," the blood creature growled. "On top of that, his weapon is coated in a hexing poison that is hard to deal with."
"This…"
The blood-robed cold man was staring slack-jawed at this scene.
Even though the battle was still ongoing, the conclusion was already clear.
The blood creature could not touch Xue Ying, while every attack Xue Ying launched further increased the blood creature's degree of injury. On top of that, its injuries were recovering much slower than new ones appeared. Unless something changed, the blood creature would die as a result of the battle.
The battle continued for an hour or more before the blood creature finally collapsed. It then condensed back into a drop of black blood, but this time, the aura inherent was much weaker.
The blood-robed man waved its hand, and the black blood disappeared.
"It's your win," the man said with a snort.
Only after hearing this did Xue Ying step out of the Mirage to once again stand within the palace hall.
"This is the command token for the Three Devil Palace," the blood-robed man said in a frigid tone as he threw the token towards Xue Ying.
"Now get lost."
Immediately afterward, the blood-robed man teleported Xue Ying out of the palace—a bubble enveloped him just like earlier.
Now that he was alone in the empty palace hall again, the blood-robed man muttered, "Who would have thought that a soldier of the Destruction Legion would obtain the command token for the Three Devil Palace! Sir Ancestor Devil was too benevolent to leave a chance even to those damned soldiers from the Destruction Legion."
…
"Hu."
Xue Ying had just obtained the command token for the Three Devil Palace when he felt his entire body shatter into pieces, then condense once again.
'This is…?' Xue Ying looked around him, quickly noticing the enormous Ancient Demon sleeping in the distance.
'I'm out, and I was sent back to where the Ancient Demon is.' Xue Ying smiled. At the same time, he borrowed the Mirage world's ability to investigate his surroundings, and it was not long before he discovered the four protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion who were hiding away. At the same time that he discovered them, the protectors also noticed Xue Ying, and vigor began filling their minds, followed quickly afterward by expressions of joy.

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - Four Protectors
chapters.content:
Chapter 654: Four Protectors
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Even though he discovered the four protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion, he acted as if he did not find them. The expression on Xue Ying had been carefully maintained as he kept all aura to the extent of where even light and sound around him was isolated. He could not be seen just by using the naked eyes alone, though the Ancestor Mother Religion protectors would have other methods of 'investigating' him.
Xue Ying carefully inspected the 'Ancient Demon' in front of him before beginning to fly far away.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying is out." Protector Huo Zhu revealed a cruel smile, "I still thought he will never come out forever. We have waited for more than 6,000 years, and it feels truly bitter."
"Cheng Yun has died, and the medicine which we refined has become useless. Everything is because of him." The gray-robed female protector was also revealing light in both her eyes. If it were her usual cultivation, one million years would seem just like a flash. However, waiting so bitterly like this was much more tiring for they had to pay close notice of their surroundings! Nobody knew when Xue Ying would come out. As long as they were careless, and did not discover Xue Ying, he would just escape far away, leaving the Six Heavenly Wheel and by then, it would be too late for regrets.
After leaving the Six Heavenly Wheel, those of the Ancestor Mother Religion could only carefully hide. Who would dare to openly slaughter others?
"We have waited for more than 6,000 years. Let us grant him death." The blue-eyed male's killing intent condensed.
"Everything will be done according to our previous plan." The violet-robed old man who had just an eye revealed said.
"We have prepared amply, bringing even the Religion Sacred Weapons. He is dead for certain." The blue-eyed male added.
"Let's go."
"Hu."
Following which, under a sound of command by Protector Huo Zhe, a fiery rainbow light enveloped around the four of them before flying towards the direction of Xue Ying.
Even though he had already erupted with speed brought about by the fifth volume of "Luminous Sun" and the fifth level of "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body", the speed of that fiery rainbow light was far beyond his speed. It was so fast that it made Xue Ying tongue-tied!
Their distances were still very far apart.
After an hour of flying, Xue Ying turned back, only to see the Ancient Demon still sleeping behind, 'Flying like this is truly slow-only tens of billions of kilometers an hour. If I borrowed upon the Mirage World to tear through the void, I could travel more than a hundred billion kilometers with a single thought.'
The fiery rainbow light that was pursuing him flew at an even faster speed reducing their distance to about 50 billion kilometers.
'Still not striking? They are really patient.' Xue Ying thought.
He had long discovered them, though he was acting as if he had not.
After all, the other party's method of hiding was genuinely profound. If not for the Mirage World, he would not discover them.
Another half an hour passed.
The gap between the two had shortened to just a few hundred million kilometers. This little distance to those at their level was indeed remarkably close. Yet the other party was still not striking. Xue Ying could only continue pretending as he flew.
"This cultivator called Dong Bo Xue Ying is truly too immature. Big Brother Huo Zhe has isolated all our movement, ensuring that he can't sense us at all." The gray-robed female protector sneered.
"Prepare to strike."
The crimson-skinned tall and sturdy hunk, 'Protector Huo Zhe' flipped his hand, causing a simple looking circular stone plate to appear. This stone plate had many circles of patterns on it. Then, the plate began emitting many undulations that started spreading in all directions…
…
'They finally strike.' Xue Ying felt elated, yet he put on a look of shock as he looked around frantically. The world began changing as many undulations started covering the entire place of 50 billion kilometers in range. This 50 billion kilometers in range rapidly formed an isolated world that contained mountains and rivers within.
In the distant, four entirely different auras belonging to the protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion appeared. Their eyes were cold. Some were filled with excitement and killing intent while some were filled with absolute coldness.
"Protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion?" Xue Ying announced, "Who would have thought that four protectors are dispatched to deal against me. You all are truly thinking highly of me."
"How would we dare to underestimate you?" The distant gray-robed female protector coldly said, "I've heard that you have a method for escaping that is more formidable than the Rulers. You should utilize it again so that we can have a look. Otherwise, you can't blame anyone for dying."
Xue Ying went silent.
The confidence in the hearts of the four protectors grew.
They actually made their judgment in advance. Those heaven-shattering methods that could hide even his karma-Bloodshed God Emperor and Temporal Island Lord could not do so-to them, they were confident that it was absolutely not Xue Ying's power. Instead, it should be some precious treasure's power. And such a heaven-shattering treasure could not frequently be used.
There should be some limitations! For instance, some heavenly-shattering treasure would rapidly increase the karma influence, or erode the true deity heart…
Regardless, everything was fair.
The more heaven-defiant the treasure was, the higher the tribute required.
"Such heaven-defiant treasure is one Dong Bo Xue Ying could not use within the short period of time! At the same time, he should not dare to bring it into the Six Heavenly Wheel since he would lose his treasure after his death, and that will be a huge loss for him." The protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion had long made their judgment about this. Furthermore, they could confirm it by his reactions.
"Hmph hmph, escape?" Xue Ying sneered, "You all already have a protector dying in my hands. Just relying on you all and you think I should escape? But your courage is quite huge to dare to deal against me right by the side of the Ancient Demon."
"The surrounding world has completely been sealed. You can't leave it at all. Even if you want to escape, you can't do so. As for the Ancient Demon, since the outside world will not be affected by our battle, we do not need to care about it. Thus, you are dead for certain." Protector Huo Zhe's voice was determined. The moment he finished speaking, a huge green wooden pole appeared. It began elongating explosively.
"Hua."
Protector Huo Zhe held onto the huge wooden pole, waving it across the sky. With the laws of profound mysteries utilized, it made Xue Ying shake his head inwardly because it was honestly too crude. But the speed and power had far surpassed that of the previous Protector Cheng Yun.
"Hong long long~" The wooden rod arced through the sky, suppressing the space around and causing this isolated world to tremble. Clearly, the power of that wooden pole had far surpassed the limit of this 50 billion kilometers world, causing cracks to form in many areas.
Xue Ying who fought with Protector Cheng Yun was clear that this move was one he could not block. He would definitely be injured.
But regardless, Xue Ying still brought out the Blood Serpent Spear to defend against it with his utmost strength.
"Peng."
During that moment when the wooden pole and the spear clashed, even though the technique used in defending was profound, causing only 10% of the incoming force to transmit across the spear to his body, it had bombarded Xue Ying to the extent that he flew backwards, smashing down against the earth and forming a massive gouge.
Closely following that…
"Sou."
Xue Ying flew out once again up to the sky.
'This Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor of mine is solid.' Xue Ying wasn't injured at all, 'The fourth level of Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body could withstand a move by White Sovereign King. Even though the strength of White Sovereign King is not as great as this protector, he is an apex Paragon with a much greater realm. And now, I've cultivated the fifth level of the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body, allowing my defenses to improve further. According to the what absolute art described, Paragons can't kill me at all, and could only injure me! This protector of the Ancestor Mother Religion might be strong, but my armor is able to withstand against his attacks.'
Borrowing his weapon to receive an attack, he understood the limits of the other party's combat power.
Even though it completely suppressed him, he would not die!
"You all should receive a few moves by me too." Xue Ying waved the Blood Serpent Spear in his hand across the sky, causing it to expand. He began his counterattack, piercing right against Protector Huo Zhe.
"Die."
Protector Huo Zhe waved his wooden rod out once again from a distance. He proceeded on with a frenzied attack.
"Xiu."
The queer and unpredictable Blood Serpent Spear did not parry against the wooden pole. Instead, it pierced right towards the body of Protector Huo Zhe, causing him to frown. His left hand extended out against this spear, yet this spear was just like a snake, slithering unpredictability with rotation. He did not know how but the left hand of Protector Huo Zhe had grabbed nothing yet the spear landed on his body.
"Pu~" The Blood Serpent Spear directly pierced towards this Protector Huo Zhe. Yet there was an unseen obstruction force which obstructed this attack, causing the might of that spear to rapidly decrease. At the moment when the spear reached his body, there was only 30% of the force left!
Piercing against his body was just like stabbing against a tough leather. Protector Huo Zhe's outer crimson skin had just formed a white spot, with his skin remaining unbroken!
'The strength of this body.' Xue Ying was speechless. He had an armor, yet the other party parried against his attack just with his skin, 'This protector is too strong. I can't kill him no matter what.'
He immediately understood.
Of the four protectors, he was sure he could not kill this one with his current abilities.

chapters.title: Chapter 655 - Arrival of the Illusory Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 655: Arrival of the Illusory Realm
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"Peng."
Simultaneous to Xue Ying's thrust towards Protector Huo Zhu, the latter's wooden rod also landed on Xue Ying with terrifying force. "Hong." He turned into a stream of light and was sent flying far into the distance. At the same time, the internal structure of his Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor rapidly dissipated the incoming force, so even though Xue Ying was flung far away and even spurt out a mouthful of fresh blood, his body and armor were not damaged in the least.
'What? He withstood the attack?'
'He actually used his body to withstand Big Brother Huo Zhu's the wooden rod straight-up?' The three protectors previously standing by the side in a carefree manner were shocked silly. They had nothing but confidence when it came to Protector Huo Zhu, their captain. His combat strength was known to be so tyrannical that he could even fight Monarch Hex Cricket.
While they had received information from the religious leader that Xue Ying's armor was absurdly strong when it came to its defenses, they still thought that Protector Huo Zhu's wooden rod, while it might not kill him in a single move, would be able to defeat Xue Ying in maybe ten or a hundred moves.
But they had just witnessed with their own eyes how Xue Ying remained unscathed and had merely spurt out a mouthful of fresh blood. At their level, as long as one didn't suffer the destruction of part of their life force, coughing out some blood was not even worth mentioning! If one's life force remained undamaged, they would be fine even if they spilled blood or suffered heavy injuries any number of times.
"Mn?" Protector Huo Zhu showed a slight frown. While he did have other moves that were more powerful than what he just used, such as his killing moves or his forbidden moves, an ordinary full-strength attack of his had still not even injured the other party, so he was starting to doubt that a forbidden move would even do the trick.
"This Dong Bo Xue Ying's offense is pitiful, but his armor is extraordinary indeed. Let us proceed with our plan—we will trap and then capture him," Protector Huo Zhu sent to the others.
"Mn."
"Let us capture him first."
After a single exchange of moves, they already decided to change their tactics.
"Sou sou sou sou!"
The four of them rapidly turned into streams of light and took separate paths to surround Xue Ying.
Xue Ying had also gotten a feel for his enemy after this short bout. 'This crimson-skinned protector is exaggeratedly strong. A full-strength attack from my Blood Serpent Spear could not even pierce his skin. I should ignore him and try attacking the other three!'
"Hu." Xue Ying's hand did not stop. Flipping it over, he sent his spear thrusting out towards the blue-eyed man.
The Blood Serpent Spear arced through the sky in an unpredictable motion.
The blue-eyed man's eyes were cold. With a sneer, he grabbed onto a long sword with both hands. The body of this sword was extremely thin and covered to the brim with sculptural images. Without hesitation, he slashed it over.
"Hua."
It was a vicious slash—the world itself seemed to have split into two before his eyes. As it approached Xue Ying, the sword also began stretching.
This time, Xue Ying reacted to the strike in a thoroughly offensive manner, having seemingly discarded any notion of defense. The way he saw it, the sword might have some strange, powerful effect, but it would undoubtedly be weaker than the attack let out by the crimson-skinned protector from before.
Since Xue Ying was the first to strike, his weapon immediately went flying out into the body of this blue-eyed man, who, in response, simply used his body to withstand it. It was quite clear that he had complete confidence in his toughness. As the Blood Serpent Spear neared the body of the blue-eyed man without having suffered any obstructive force, it proceeded to pierce right into his frame, leaving behind a huge, bloody hole.
Seeing this, the blue-eyed man could not help but pale. Even though he stumbled after being struck, the power of his long sword hadn't been affected—it successfully slashed down on Xue Ying.
"Pu~"
The vicious slash caused Xue Ying to be sent flying backward once again and bringing him ever closer to the gray-robed female protector.
"Catch him," the blue-eyed man transmitted to her. Clearly, his attack wasn't meant to kill him, but instead send him closer to the female protector.
"Just leave him to me." Countless green branches came to life and began to appear on the surface of the gray-robed female protector's body. Green leaves and branches were proliferating to envelop Xue Ying.
'Not good.'
Xue Ying did not dare let this restricts himself.
If he were to be caught firmly enough, even if he were to enter the Mirage world to hide, the branches surrounding his body would follow him inside. In fact, if the branches were strong enough, they could even forcibly draw him out!
"Go." Xue Ying's spear once again shot out, this time towards the gray-robed female protector. It was moving at incredible speeds, much faster than the growth of the branches and leaves.
The gray-robed female protector put on a slight smile. At this crucial point in the battle, she decided to move the branches and leaves to form a sphere around her.
"Pu!"
The spear struck the sphere, rapidly piercing the many branches and leaves. But it wasn't long until the force dissipated. It would apparently be tough to break through this sphere.
'Get back,' Xue Ying thought, quickly pulling the Blood Serpent Spear out. Without even a moment of pause, he flipped his hand to sent another strike, this time towards the distant old man dressed in violet robes.
"Be careful, his weapon is imbued with a hex poison that is proving very hard to remove," the blue-eyed man relayed to the old man. He had quickly discovered that the bloody hole in his body was recovering very slowly, much slower than it should have.
The violet-robed old man, who had only revealed a single eye up until this point, began frowning. Of the four protectors, he was the only one to not specialize in close combat. Even so, the strength of his body wasn't any weaker than Xue Ying's. Having cultivated to his current level, he was bound to have his ways of defending himself.
"Hu hu hu."
A layer of black fog began forming around his body as he stared towards Xue Ying, thinking to himself, 'Without his blood, the curse won't be sufficiently effective.'
Despite the frown he was wearing, the violet-robed old man was still muttering the said curse.
At the same time, a strange, invisible wave force arrived to envelop Xue Ying's position.
"Mn?" Xue Ying's expression shifted ever so slightly. This wave force was very queer as if it transcended this world and even the Mirage world which was under his control. It seemed to originate from an even higher plane, and it was a sort of energy that did not belong to any of the ordinary categories, and neither was it an attack on the soul. It felt even more mysterious than any of these.
When the attack landed near Xue Ying, it suffered from the influence of Xue Ying's inherent lifeforce which served to gradually reduce its energy, up until it finally caused it to disappear.
'Was that the so-called curse that teacher told me the Ancestor Mother Religion use for their murder attempts? From what I've heard, the best medium for it is one's blood; I can't let any of mine land in the enemy's hands, or the strength of that curse will greatly increase.' Xue Ying might have spurt out some blood just before, but that blood belonged to the energy in his body. A single thought was sufficient for him to bring it back without suffering any loss of energy.
Despite Xue Ying's inner shock, the Blood Serpent Spear continued its thrusting motion towards the violet-robed old man until it finally struck the black fog. The defensive force of the fog was incredible indeed—it felt as if countless lifeforms were rushing out to block the Blood Serpent Spear. After suffering a 50% loss of the original power, the spear eventually pierced right into the old man's frame.
"Pu." The moment it pierced through him, the spear seemed to encounter no more resistance, allowing it to form a massive hole in his chest; it went all the way through!
However, while this particular wound was healing very slowly, the violet-robed old man's other body parts did not suffer any injuries.
'I was unable to injure the crimson-skinned protector in any way. The female protector has those green branches and leaves serving as protection, and I can't utilize the Dao of Mirage to injure her! That means the violet-robed old man and the blue-eyed man are my only possible choices. The blue-eyed man's fleshy body defense is comparable to Protector Cheng Yun's, while the violet-robed old man has the weakest body,' Xue Ying thought. As soon as he got a clear idea of his opponents' strengths and weaknesses, he already began to formulate a plan.
"You can't escape."
The branches and leaves from before had already extended to Xue Ying's current location, but he only laughed in response. All of a sudden, his body turned real and unreal at the same time, and while he seemed to still be there at a glance, he had already entered the Mirage world.
The countless branches and leaves were supposed to pierce right through Xue Ying's body, but they ended up attacking empty space.
"What?!" Everyone, especially the female protector, was shocked. Why had her branches failed to restrict him?
'Time for me to act.' Xue Ying chuckled.
"Weng."
The Mirage world descended, and with it came Xue Ying's illusory realm!
According to the intelligence reports provided to him by the Bloodshed God Emperor, the members of the Ancestor Mother Religion's had powerful, borderline tyrannical bodies, but their weakness was also very apparent—their comprehension of the realm was shallow! A robust body led to a mighty soul, but their low realm meant that their cultivation hearts were merely ordinary. Even though there were a few who had managed to cultivate their hearts to a deep level, such people were exceptions and not the norm…
The higher one's realm, the deeper a level their heart of cultivation would reach.
The Bloodshed God Emperor, the Abyss Primogenitor, Pang Yi, and other such figures had all cultivated to a very high level, but when it came to ordinary True Gods, those who could reach Xue Ying's level were few and far between.
As for the protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion… they were, for the most part, all roughly equivalent to stage four World Deities, so their cultivation hearts were bound to be ordinary—not even close to powerful. Even though their souls were strong, a weak cultivation heart meant they would suffer greatly when faced with illusory techniques!
Speaking of illusory techniques, having lived in the Black Fog Sea and pondered over the arts of illusions alongside his opening of the Dao of Mirage meant that Xue Ying was at a very high level amongst the Paragons of the Deity world and Dark Abyss. In fact, he might even rank in the top three of this group! Even though other Paragons might have cultivated to deeper, more profound realms, the Daos they opened were not of the illusory type. Meanwhile, Xue Ying had opened the Dao of Mirage, a Dao known for its illusory characteristics. This gave him profound control over illusions.
'I shall let you all have a taste of the power my illusory realm reached with the help of my Mirage world.' It was the first time Xue Ying used the illusory realm against any enemy after his opening of the Dao of Mirage.
"Mn?"
Protector Huo Zhu and the other four felt their surroundings change before their very eyes, and an invisible force began influencing their souls.

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - Suffering a Grave Loss
chapters.content:
Chapter 656: Suffering a Grave Loss
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
As the illusory realm descended upon the four protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion, the blue-eyed man became immersed entirely within moments; his soul was led into an illusory world, and there, it started a new life.
He had a true love, he had his clansmen, and he fought for them. He even had a new name—Blade Nine! He completely forgot his real identity!
Such was the state of true immersion created by the illusory realm.
Just like when mortals dreamt, they often forgot who they really were, the souls of these protectors could be deceived by the illusory realm, leaving everything under another person's control, including the fate of their lives!
…
The gray-robed female protector proved to have a stronger cultivation heart. Even though she was also dragged into the illusory realm, her soul was not deceived. She maintained a fundamental clarity of thought and knew she was of the Ancestor Mother Religion and had been lured by Xue Ying of the cultivator cosmos into an illusory realm.
'This is just an illusory realm.'
'Break for me.'
'Break.'
The gray-robed female protector continued to sense her fleshy body, so she was able to operate countless of her green branches and leaves to protect herself. But despite being able to detect her own body, she would be unable to see the surrounding real world until her soul escaped from this illusory realm.
…
The moment Protector Huo Zhu was pulled into the illusory realm…
His powerful soul roared out—
'Break!'
The invisible energy surrounding the surface of his body tore apart the illusory realm. Now that his powerful soul and willpower were working in concert with the mythical energy surrounding his body, the illusory realm could not resist for long.
…
The one who had the easiest time dealing with the illusions was actually the violet-robed old man. He opened a single eye, but his vision was cold and filled with wisdom. The very moment he fell into the illusory realm, his soul and willpower had already shattered it!
"Huo Zhu, hurry up and save the other two," he transmitted in a clearly flustered tone.
"I know." Protector Huo Zhu was already conscious and had already opened his mouth to spill out flames. The surging inferno then split into many snakes which swimming out in every direction. They quickly spread out with speed far beyond that of Protector Huo Zhu's personal flying speed, and the direction they were heading in was that of the gray-robed female protector and the blue-eyed man.
'To have suddenly displayed such a formidable illusory realm… this Dong Bo Xue Ying truly hid his abilities well.' The violet-robed old man was slightly anxious.
******
Even though Xue Ying was already aware that the experts of the Ancestor Mother Religion were weaker on average regarding their cultivation hearts, the effect of the illusory realm still left him in shock and joy at the same time.
'The woman is maintaining her consciousness, but she can't struggle out of it. The man is in an even worse state—his soul was completely subdued.' Xue Ying tried to suppress the ecstasy rising up in his heart. The female protector might not be able to struggle out, but she was still able to control her body, as well as those branches and leaves, so killing her would not be easy. However, the situation was entirely different when it came to the blue-eyed protector.
His soul was thoroughly deceived, and Xue Ying was now in control of his fate.
'Get over here.'
Xue Ying took a single step inside the Mirage, teleporting directly to the side of the blue-eyed man. He then extended his hand which left the Mirage world, to grab him in the real world.
Once grabbed…
'In you go.' Xue Ying easily sent the blue-eyed man into his Cultivation Eden.
His soul had been hoodwinked, and the blue-eyed man was now essentially in a deep sleep—he was unable to offer any sort of resistance.
'Another one down!' Xue Ying was thrilled. Now that he eliminated two protectors, he could not help but feel proud of himself.
'Time to deal with another one.' Xue Ying multitasked in his control over the illusory realm to leave the blue-eyed man immersed in it, while simultaneously teleporting over to the side of the gray-robed female protector.
A shackle suddenly appeared in his right hand, and with a wave, the item entered the real world and moved out to entangle the gray-robed female protector; he was trying to pull her into the Mirage world.
However, the gray-robed female protector had managed to cover herself in many branches and leaves already, to the point that there wasn't even the slightest gap in her defense. Even the internal areas of her body were covered by the same branches and leaves.
