At the same time the shackles appeared to restrict her, the branches and leaves also began moving to entangle the shackles with strength so terrifying that Xue Ying found he could no longer move them. In fact, the shackles were starting to pull away from him.
Seeing this, Xue Ying quickly shrunk the shackles to get rid of the restriction, then brought them back into the Mirage world to collect them.
He no longer dared try to pull the gray-robed female protector using this item. After all, with the entire body of that gray-robed female protector being guarded by those branches and leaves, he simply could not move her even an inch.
'Those branches and leaves are stronger than me,' Xue Ying muttered inwardly. 'Right, even the Blood Serpent Spear could not penetrate them before.'
"Hong hong hong~"
The firm branches and leaves were suddenly forced apart, now that a figure of flame could be seen rapidly closing in. This was none other than the flame avatar previously displayed by the Protector Huo Zhu. Its strength was titanic, so it was able to quickly force apart those branches and leaves.
He had to do so since the female protector was trapped in an illusory realm so her branches and leaves could not discern between enemy and ally. However, Protector Huo Zhu's strength had always been much higher than Xue Ying's, so even this avatar of his was this powerful. He soon reached the side of the female protector, covering her with his boundless flames.
Xue Ying turned over, only to see that the distant violet-robed old man had already rushed over to Protector Huo Zhu's side, and had already been safely collected by him.
"Hu." The gray-robed female protector, who had already entered the protection of the flames, was quickly collected as well; Xue Ying's illusory realm could no longer influence her.
By now, there were only two people left in this sealed world.
One was Protector Huo Zhu, who was incomparably furious, and the other was Xue Ying, who was standing safely inside his Mirage world.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, hand over Protector Zhong She." Protector Huo Zhu's body was tall and sturdy, and the invisible force covering the surface of his body had already begun spreading over. "Do that, and I'll let you live."
"Hahaha, you sure can maintain your arrogance despite the terrible state you're in. Want to kill your way over to me? You can just go ahead and try. However, I have a feeling you won't even be able to find me." Xue Ying's voice was clearly reverberating within this sealed world, but no matter how Protector Huo Zhu tried to investigate its source, he could not find the slightest trace of Xue Ying's position.
"Hand over Protector Zhong She. If you have any conditions, you can go ahead and state them." Protector Huo Zhu was forcing down his fury.
He was one of the peak experts of the Ancestor Mother Religion, but he was well aware that he could not deal with Xue Ying as it stood. The contradiction left him feeling inwardly stifled. Regardless, he had to at least try and think of a way to save Protector Zhong She.
After all, from the very moment they first stepped into this cultivation cosmos, they had always been cautious. Many of the Paragons had never ever seen an expert from the Ancestor Mother Religion since they would only ever appear in the Lower Three Edens of the Six Heavenly Wheel, where they held an absolute superiority! From the time they entered this cultivation cosmos and up until just previously, they had lost just two of their protectors. But now, this seemingly ordinary Xue Ying had already caused the death of Protector Cheng Yun and even captured Protector Zhong She alive.
They had truly underestimated him.
After all, the intelligence reports stated that he was just a stage four World Deity, so sending Protector Cheng Yun should have sufficed. However, their carelessness led to them falling under a scheme which eventually caused them to lose a great general.
But never would they have thought that, even with four protectors acting together, they would still end up falling into another trap!
Xue Ying was absolutely one of the rarest types of experts in this cultivation cosmos, one of the few people who opened a Dao related to illusory techniques! People like the White Sovereign, the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, the Water Devil King, or Monarch Hex Cricket and such others might seem powerful, but all of the Daos they opened were in no way related to illusory techniques! Even the Rulers with the greatest of statuses like the Temporal Island Lord and the Myriad God Palace Head did not follow any Dao related to illusory techniques.
There were only a few Paragons who did.
The majority opened all sorts of Dao, but those who opened Daos related to illusions could be counted on one's fingers!
And Xue Ying, with his Dao of Mirage, was precisely one of these select few. His illusory realm was a technique with a wide area of effect, which meant he could cause four protectors to fall into it at the same time. Even though three of them managed to escape, the blue-eyed man, Protector Zhong She, had disappeared—he had evidently been captured by Xue Ying.
They had truly lost this battle to a great injustice! In truth, the main reason they lost was purely that they underestimated Xue Ying. This person had seemed entirely unremarkable amongst many powerful Paragons of the cultivation cosmos, but their carelessness and his techniques eventually led to them suffering a consequential loss.
'He is truly cunning; he's been planning this the whole time. Back when he dealt with Protector Cheng Yun, he did not display the illusory realm, nor that technique which allowed him to easily hide and flee.' Protector Huo Zhu looked around him, but he could find no trace of Xue Ying within the sealed world. 'He is not a part of the regular world. Does that mean he is in another world? He'd been flying slowly all this time, but even that was fake! He truly hid himself too deeply!'

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - Interrogation
chapters.content:
Chapter 657: Interrogation
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"You want me to let a protector of the Ancestor Mother Religion off? I can't make any promises based on most conditions you might provide," Xue Ying's voice continued reverberating within this sealed world. He was starting to negotiate with Protector Huo Zhu.
Naturally, this was done to stall for more time.
Most of his focus was actually placed on his Cultivation Eden. His luminous sun force had entered it directly, where it sealed the soul of the blue-eyed man who was in a deep sleep, his soul lost in the illusory realm.
"Teacher," Xue Ying simultaneously contacted his teacher, the Bloodshed God Emperor.
"Xue Ying, what's the matter?" replied the Bloodshed God Emperor, who was in the middle of cultivating in front of the Cosmos Furnace.
"I've captured a protector from the Ancestor Mother Religion using my illusory realm. How should I handle him?" Xue Ying asked. A protector captured alive would have a much higher value than a dead protector. As for how he could make use of this value, Xue Ying really had no clue. After all, he was clear that directly asking for information was not an option.
A superpower like the Ancestor Mother Religion was bound to have preventive methods in place. As such, he had decided to ask his teacher for help.
Situated in front of the Cosmos Furnace, the crimson-robed Bloodshed God Emperor fell in a daze. 'This brat captured a protector from the Ancestor Mother Religion? When did it become so easy to deal with those protectors?'
Even though he paid great importance to this disciple of his, he was still inwardly comparing him with his Eldest Disciple Brother, Monarch Green—in other words, he was only paying attention to Xue Ying's potential for growth!
In the Bloodshed God Emperor's heart, this little disciple of his was still too tender; he had only just opened his Dao path, so he could, at most, be considered a new Paragon. Compared to peak Paragons like Monarch Hex Cricket, the White Sovereign King, and the White Devil King, there was still a considerable gap. As for Monarch Green, who could even fight against Rulers, the difference in combat power was even more significant! Forget combat power, even their experience and horizons were just too far apart.
Even he, the Bloodshed God Emperor, had experienced many dangers and opportunities as a Paragon. He had also been to two other cosmoses.
Pang Yi too had been to other cosmoses and encountered many opportunities.
Compared to these old men…
Xue Ying indeed was too tender. He had only recently breached a million years of cultivation and had just opened his Dao path. The only opportunity he had was his entering of the Starting Ground, and the trial he took there was one meant for stage four World Deities! Thus, in the eyes of the Bloodshed God Emperor, the Temporal Island Lord, and the other rulers, Xue Ying was a tender little flower.
So young and fragile that it would take a very long time for the soil to nourish it, for the water to feed it, and for the sun to protect it, before eventually blooming with incomparable beauty.
'This disciple of mine has just opened his Dao path, yet he already killed one protector and now even captured another one alive? The Ancestor Mother Religion should most likely be speechless.' The Bloodshed God Emperor could not help but laugh. 'Even the Primal Master, the Abyss Primogenitor, and the others will be left speechless by this news.'
All of these elders together had managed to get rid of just two protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion over a very long time.
But now, Xue Ying went and dealt with two protectors by himself.
"Xue Ying." The Bloodshed God Emperor was inwardly shocked and sighing, but he still managed to ask Xue Ying to do something. "You should hurry up and proceed with your interrogation. The people from the Ancestor Mother Religion are definitely already seeking out the true body of this protector you captured alive! They'll be waking him up forcibly as soon as they can."
"How can I interrogate him?" Xue Ying asked.
"Ask him about the way they proceeded from their home cosmos to our cosmos, and where the route that led them here is," the Bloodshed God Emperor replied. "Try thinking up a non-conventional way of interrogating him. Don't be too direct. I've once captured a protector but asking him a single question led to his soul crumbling apart. It seems they have some preventive measures in place that work similar to our oath-breaking punishments."
"Alright."
"This position of their cosmos passage is vital. Asking him directly won't help in any way. It will all come down to the method you employ," the Bloodshed God Emperor said. "Xue Ying, your teacher believes in you."
…
Within the Cultivation Eden.
"Hu."
A luminous sun force avatar appeared on a mountain peak looking at the blue-eyed man who was fast asleep.
Xue Ying was at a loss. He had asked his teacher about how he should proceed with the interrogation, but he now understood that even his teacher knew of no sure way of succeeding. After all, his own attempt at it had caused the protector's soul to crumble.
'Let's try this.' Xue Ying began guiding the illusory realm, granting him easy control of the deceived soul.
'Cosmos Star Map.'
Xue Ying began transmitting a part of the cosmos star map directly into the man's soul.
He was sending it out bit by bit, yet for the sake of saving time, he even used the Cultivation Eden's ability to maintain a hundred-times accelerated flow of time. He could not go any faster because of the protector's strength—both in terms of body and of the soul—made it much more energy-expensive to control the flow of time.
Xue Ying had split the cosmos star map into ten thousand pieces, with the Deity world occupying 99% of them. The remaining places were all in the material realm and the Dark Abyss.
He continued sending over bits of the star map until, just moments later when he was transmitting the 6345th piece…
"Hou~"
The blue-eyed man who had been initially hoodwinked suddenly started to roar and countless blood strands appeared on his soul. He shortly regained his consciousness and began staring at Xue Ying.
"I can tell—this location is significant to you, right?" Xue Ying asked staring straight back at him.
The blue-eyed man let out a low growl in response: "It's useless. Nothing you do matters."
The blood strands finally began cutting up his soul, causing it to crumble apart.
'Dead already.' Xue Ying frowned. 'I even sealed his soul, but it was still able to crumble by itself. This Ancestor Mother Religion is truly strict and secretive.'
He had not even dared ask any direct questions, knowing that when his teacher had done so, it led to the protector's instant crumbling of the soul.
As such, he decided he would rather send over bits and pieces of a star map; normal maps might not lead to any outcome, but any important location would lead to the oath punishment effect to his soul.
******
Within a towering, ancient bronze palace hall owned by the Ancestor Mother Religion.
The fanged religious leader was sitting here in silence when an extreme pressure suddenly descended on the entire hall.
A fanged teenager wearing silver robes appeared in mid-air and said in a low voice, "I rushed over to find Protector Zhong She's as fast as I could, but I still did not manage to wake him up in time. His avatar has already crumbled to death. After he woke up, Zong She took the initiative to inform me… that Dong Bo Xue Ying has found out about a relevant region of the star map."
"A region of the star map?" The fanged religious leader frowned.
"Right. It should be a region of about ten starfields," the silver-robed teenager said. "We're stationed here and concealed, but their cultivation cosmos will definitely start a large-scale investigation on this region sooner or later. I did not even consider Dong Bo Xue Ying would actually think to send out pieces of a map into Protector Zhong She's to find out which region led to his soul's crumbling. They will naturally be paying great importance to this point. Regardless, he divided the cosmos into just ten thousand parts and was clearly rushing for time. Had he been slower even by a bit, I would have been able to wake Protector Zhong She and allow him to sever the connection with his avatar."
The huge fanged hunk sighed. "A puny Paragon like Dong Bo Xue Ying actually managed to cause us such huge losses. We've already lost two protectors, and there was even a leak regarding the location of our territory."
"Still, such a small leak shouldn't mean much—it is a region of ten starfields after all. It is almost impossible that they might find us," the silver-robed teenager said. "Furthermore, this territory we're stationed at is concealed using the most powerful treasures our cosmos could provide in many epochs. Even if they do reach our location, they simply won't be able to see us."
"Indeed, they should not be able to discover us, but there's always the chance an accident might occur!" the fanged hunk said.
The Bloodshed God Emperor had investigated the entire cosmos time and time again, but he never succeeded in finding where the people of the Ancestor Mother Religion were hiding.
But now that the region was reduced to just ten starfields, it would be exponentially more straightforward to find them.
"Who would have thought…" the huge fanged-hunk muttered, "we would be so careless. From this day onwards, we cannot be too careless even when dealing with stage four World Deities."
This whole ordeal had happened because of a stage four World Deity.
"Our losses are indeed huge." The silver-robed teenager squinted his eyes which held a silver glimmer akin to a cocoon. He muttered, "Dong Bo Xue Ying, I will etch this brat's name into my mind."
The religious leaders and protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion had long etched Xue Ying's name into their minds. After all, it was this tender and young cultivator who had only just opened his own Dao path that led to them suffering such grave losses. From now on, they would pay more attention and would never again dare to be careless against him. One who could walk in another world and even specialize in illusory techniques was a cultivator the Ancestor Mother Religion did not dare underestimate.

chapters.title: Chapter 658 - Waking up the Ancient Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 658: Waking up the Ancient Demon
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within the sealed world.
Protector Huo Zhu was standing in mid-air, his entire body surrounding by faint fire snakes when he announced: "Your demands are too excessive. There is no way I can agree to then…" At the same time, Xue Ying was pretending to negotiate with him to stall for more time…
This was when, all of a sudden, Protector Huo Zhu's expression changed.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, you've been lying to me!" Protector Huo Zhu roared out in anger, his voice so powerful that even the surrounding void began to tremble and form cracks.
"Haha, were you not also pretending, then?" Xue Ying's voice reverberated within this sealed world.
In the Mirage World, Xue Ying sneered as he looked at these events unfolding. A World Deity javelin appeared in his hand—he had brought along a significant amount of this sort of weapon.
'This protector from the Ancestor Mother Religion is much stronger than me, but I have something to help me.' Xue Ying suddenly stretched his right arm to hurl out the World Deity javelin with all his strength. The weapon flew through the Mirage world with 'hu', and then directly tore through the void to arrive at the sleeping Ancient Demon who was tens of billions of kilometers away.
After all, the sealing effect only worked on the ordinary world, so Xue Ying's Mirage was entirely unhindered by it.
The gray javelin tore through the void to arrive at the Ancient Demon, where it went back into the ordinary world from the Mirage world.
"Hong!"
The sharp head of the javelin landed straight by the arse of the Ancient Demon; who asked that specific body part of his to be sticking out and be the closest to Xue Ying?
When compared to a protector of the Ancestor Mother Religion, Xue Ying's strength might not be any big deal, but amongst cultivators of his cosmos, he was essentially at the same level as apex Paragons.
The arse of the Ancient Demon trembled lightly, followed by the World Deity weapon shattering in its entirety, and the humanoid, dog-headed Ancient Demon slowly opening its eyes. It had a pair of yellow eyes filled with intense coldness and killing intent. It immediately turned to face the distant sealed world.
Before long, its vision locked down on Xue Ying's figure who was still hiding in the Mirage World, its gaze so fierce that Xue Ying started to cower. A coldness invaded his heart, and an invisible force began to press down on him.
'It knows I'm the one who acted?' Xue Ying was much shocked.
"Hong."
The distant Ancient Demon, with its few hundreds of billions of kilometers large body, swung its right claw.
"Si la~"
It immediately tore through the sealed world, despite it being a few tens of billion kilometers long, and arrived immediately at the region where Xue Ying stood.
Describing this action might take some time, but everything had actually happened within moments.
The distant Ancient Demon swung its claw at a speed that was essentially instantaneous—it had clearly started out tens of billions of kilometers away, but it seemed to have arrived in front of Xue Ying within the blink of an eye. On top of that, Xue Ying was hiding in the Mirage world, yet he was still feeling an unseen force boring into the Mirage and lashing out against his black armor.
"Hong hong hong~" It was only now that Xue Ying finally managed to react. He spurted out a mouthful of blood and was sent flying back into the distance. At the same time he was falling, Xue Ying discovered that the claw had not actually entered the Mirage World.
In reality, the unseen strength of the claw had tunneled into the Mirage world where it bombarded his body. As he was suffering from this attack, Xue Ying's true deity heart momentarily 'stopped' working. In other words, his actions became minutely slower, and it was only after receiving the attack that he regained his natural processing speed. By then, however, he was already flying backward.
"Run, run, run."
"Sou sou."
Xue Ying immediately teleported away.
He teleported directly over to a location situated a few hundred billion kilometers away, where he let out a sigh of relief. Looking back at the distant Ancient Demon, he realized that it would not continue chasing after him, despite staring in his general direction. Instead, the demon turned towards Protector Huo Zhu, whose fire snakes were surrounding his body and who was still in a muddle-headed state.
'The intelligence provided by Teacher seems to be true. Once an Ancient Demon awakens, it won't distinguish between friend and foe, attacking any and all lifeforms around. However, that only applies to someone within a region of fifty billion kilometers around it. Now that I left that region, it will no longer chase after me,' Xue Ying thought. If the Ancient Demon were to continue chasing after anyone in a frenzy, the Ancestor Mother Religion would not have dared send so many protectors over.
'Ancestor Mother Religion, this is my final gift to you.' Xue Ying lowered his head. There were faint cracks all over his Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor. 'Such power… The demon can't even enter the Mirage world, yet the force it managed to transmit inside was sufficient to leave me grievously injured.'
'Had I been inside the ordinary world instead of the Mirage… I would most likely have been directly extinguished…' Xue Ying muttered inwardly. 'Such is a Ruler-realm existence.'
The Ancient Demon had the combat power of a ruler indeed, but because it was a refined lifeform, it was still slightly lacking compared to real rulers. It was likely comparable to a tender, newly emerged ruler, so his combat power was likely closer to that of Monarch Green!
…
Xue Ying had managed to rapidly escape through the Mirage world, but Protector Huo Zhu was in a much more miserable state.
'The Ancient Demon?' Looking at the Ancient Demon situated a few hundred billion kilometers ahead of him, his expression had a huge change. 'Dong Bo Xue Ying must have awoken him.'
The humanoid, dog-headed Ancient Demon was still half-lying on the ground, yet its huge dog head was staring in Protector Huo Zhu's direction. Its eyes were filled with killing intent as it roared: "Die!" Its voice engulfed the entire world, forming an immense force which rushed over in the protector's direction.
"Hu."
Shortly afterward, it swung one of its claws.
Protector Huo Zhu found himself in a better spot than Xue Ying. Even under the invisible pressure emitted by the Ancient Demon, he was still able to retain his consciousness. Roaring out, he waved the wooden rod in his hand. At the same time he swung out, countless fire snakes appeared around his body, then twirled around his right arm. These snakes served to significantly increase the already fierce power of the wooden rod, up to a level that was high above what he showed when he fought against Xue Ying.
Regarding pure strength, Protector Huo Zhu was unquestionably at the ruler realm.
However, as the claw of that Ancient Demon arrived, it seemed as if it did not even touch him. Instead, the invisible force it sent out caused the wooden rod to slow down dramatically, such that by the time the claw touched it, the rod was essentially unmoving.
"Peng!"
Protector Huo Zhu's body exploded, turning into three flame streamers which immediately dispersed. In the distance, the three flame streamers converged back into Protector Huo Zhu. However, his expression was now much paler than before.
'Damn. Damn it!' Protector Huo Zhu gritted his teeth. Although he was not afraid of fighting someone like Monarch Hex Cricket, this Ancient Demon was unquestionably at the ruler realm, and escaping it would not be easy.
"Ancestor Mother above all!"
A pale yellow leaf suddenly appeared in Protector Huo Zhu's hands. It was pale yellow in color, and it did not seem to contain any living energy, yet it was still somehow emitting immense strength. Its strength far surpassed the imagination, and it was even stronger than the Ancient Demon in terms of quality.
Protector Huo Zhu opened his mouth to swallow it, and one could now see a blurred, pale-yellow light forming on the surface of his body. His figure was also rapidly growing.
"Peng."
The Ancient Demon once again sent its claw over, and this time as well, Protector Huo Zhu moved his rod over to parry the attack.
"Peng, peng, peng…"
Every single exchange caused a full ten billion of kilometers around them to be pulverized; many deep gouges appeared in the ground all around, and the power left even Xue Ying, who had been watching this scene from a distance, to be left speechless. 'Truly fierce. The protector seems to have become even stronger than before.' Regardless, Protector Huo Zhu still seemed to be sent flying away after every single exchange, and he would again be forced to cough out mouthfuls of blood.
However, his body remained undamaged—unlike at first, it no longer exploded.
It seemed that after eating that leaf, not only his combat power increased, but even the defenses of his fleshy body grew to another level. Even though he was whacked away time after time, he could still create some distance after every exchange. On top of that, his current flying speed was much faster than before, and in the blink of an eye, he had already managed to cross tens of millions of kilometers.
'Still, you'll have to leave a region of fifty billion kilometers…' Xue Ying watched on in silence.
As he ran away, Protector Huo Zhu not only consumed the pale yellow leaf but also equipped a strange silver armor which seemed to reflect all light landing on it. As he received more strikes, the light of the silver armor gradually grew dark. In any case, roughly half an hour after he began his escape, the Ancient Demon finally stopped pursuing him.
'After all is said and done, he still managed to escape.' Xue Ying shook his head inwardly upon seeing this. 'I did hope the Ancient Demon would manage to kill him. That would have signified the death of three protectors in a single move.'
Clearly, Protector Huo Zhu and the others were just a small team, and Protector Huo Zhu, as the team's captain, had naturally brought along many essential treasures. During such crucial moments, he had to maintain the lives of his comrades. After all, it was only because of Xue Ying's illusory realm landing on a vast area that he failed to save his comrades in time.
"Hou~"
The distant Ancient Demon stood up, its dog head roaring into to the sky to send out a wave that charged out in all directions. The transmission was truly fast, and despite being isolated to a region of fifty billion kilometers around it, many spatial ripples still formed above Xue Ying.
Immediately afterward, the Ancient Demon disappeared from his previous spot.
'It likely went out to find another location where it could sleep,' Xue Ying thought. 'Overall, its combat power seems to be comparable to Eldest Disciple Brother Monarch Green's, although slightly weaker when it comes to controlling of the realm.'
'It would seem I'm still far from being able to compare with Eldest Disciple Brother…'
Having witnessed this battle, Xue Ying was now clearer about his standing.
'Time to visit the Three Devil Palaces.' Xue Ying immediately teleported, moving on to another one of the Lower Three Edens—the Black Rain Eden.
"Sou, sou, sou."
This time, he was moving out at full speed, traversing fifty billion kilometers with every single step he took as he rushed over in the direction of the passage connecting the Blood Devil Eden with the Black Rain Eden.

chapters.title: Chapter 659 - Must Not Treat Him Unfairly
chapters.content:
Chapter 659: Must Not Treat Him Unfairly
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
In a place shrouded by a blood-red sky.
Protector Huo Zhu landed on top of a mountain peak with an ugly expression on his face. He turned back to look towards the distant Ancient Demon, glancing over it. 'Not only did I use up one of the leaves from the Void Ancestor Tree, but I was even forced to take out the Ancestor Mother Protective Saint Armor. More than half the energy stored within the armor is lost, and we did not even manage to deal with Dong Bo Xue Ying after incurring such huge losses.'
"Huo Zhu," a voice reverberated in his heart.
"Religious leader," Protector Huo Zhu sent back. "What should we do? We've already suffered an enormous loss, so we should at least think of a way to get rid of Dong Bo Xue Ying as soon as possible."
"I've discussed this matter with the other religious leaders, and we've arrived at the unanimous decision to temporarily forgo dealing with Dong Bo Xue Ying as an enemy," the voice replied.
"What? How can we let things just slide by?" Protector Huo Zhu was unwilling.
It seemed that this was the biggest humiliation he suffered since his arrival at this cultivation cosmos.
Two of his team's protectors suffered from setbacks, and he was even forced to use up some of the critical religious internal treasures he had brought over. Such a huge loss left Protector Huo Zhu feeling humiliated.
"Religious leader, we had the absolute advantage inside the Lower Three Edens. We can still afford to use some extra resources. As long as we kill Dong Bo Xue Ying, we might even get the mysterious treasure he used to teleport back then," Protector Huo Zhu said.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying managed to enter a different world on top of his cultivation of the so-called absolute art with the strongest defense in this cosmos—the"Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body". You just mentioned that even the Ancient Demon failed to kill him since he could instantly teleport to a location that was fifty billion kilometers away. On top of that, our protectors do not have profound enough cultivations so they could not injure him at all," the religious leader explained.
"We could use up all our internal religious treasures, though," Protector Huo Zhu retorted.
"It's not worth the price," the religious leader sent back. "The losses we've suffered this time were by no means insignificant. Who dares to say that Dong Bo Xue Ying isn't just a trap set down deliberately by the Bloodshed God Emperor? He might have other important treasures which he received from the Bloodshed God Emperor. Should we try to kill him, it might just end up causing us even more grievous losses! Also, what if he can use that teleportation method of his again? Even if we send all our treasures over, it'll most likely still be in vain!"
Indeed, now that Xue Ying reached the Opening realm, he could once again teleport into the Starting Ground. However, since his combat power was still in the lower rung amongst Paragons, he would almost certainly end up dying inside.
But if he genuinely were to encounter a dire situation which left him without hope of escaping, everything he owned would end up in the hands of a religious leader. As such, Xue Ying would rather die inside the Starting Ground! No matter the case, he would never let the Ancestor Mother Religion gain any advantages because of him.
"But, but…" Protector Huo Zhu turned sullen.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying's offensive power is ordinary, but his survival capabilities are anything but. We would have to pay too high a price to kill him. In fact, even if he were to leave the Six Heavenly Wheel still in the World Deity realm, even I would not say for certain I'd be able to kill him. This matter has already been unanimously agreed upon by all the religious leaders, so there's no need to say anything more," the religious leader concluded.
"Yes." Protector Huo Zhu could only follow the orders.
"Don't approach him any longer. Since we can't kill him, there's simply no point in paying any notice to him," the religious leader ordered before cutting off the communication channel.
…
While the Ancestor Mother Religion decided to ignore Xue Ying after he was deemed too difficult to deal with, an uproar appeared amongst the Rulers holding the highest statuses in the cultivation cosmos.
The Abyss Primogenitor, the Primal Master, Empress Qian He, the Purgatory Ruler and the others were all incomparably shocked.
Xue Ying had killed two protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion one after another—this they could accept since him killing Protector Cheng Yun had already shocked them enough; they could only sigh and praise him for also getting rid of Protector Zhong She. However, there was also the fact that Xue Ying had brought over a specific portion of the cosmos map and said: "The base of the Ancestor Mother Religion and the passage to our cosmos could very well be located in one of these starfields."
This information had simply left the Rulers with their heads spinning.
After all, since the cultivation cosmos and the Ancestor Mother Religion were at war, the most crucial piece of information they could acquire was the location of the Ancestor Mother Religion's base and their cosmos passage!
As long as they closed the cosmos passage and destroyed it, the Ancestor Mother Religion would not be able to send any more experts over. This would leave the members of the Ancestor Mother Religion currently located within the cultivation cosmos cut off from help. In any case, it was sure that the position of the cosmos passage was of utmost importance. There was also an 80% to 90% chance that the Ancestor Mother Religion would place their base next to the passage to protect it! But even if the cultivation cosmos were to find this location, they would still have to break through the enemy base, or they would have no way to break the passage.
This was the most crucial location for both parties!
The Bloodshed God Emperor, the Primal Master, and all the others had been seeking the position to this cosmos passage for a very long period of time, but it was to no avail!
After all, it was only within the Six Heavenly Wheel that the protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion dared to act rampantly. Outside of this location, they would be extremely prudent and cunning. In fact, most Paragons would never even get the chance to meet a protector. It was easy to see how well-concealed they were.
"A region of just ten starfields?"
"Good!"
"Hahaha, this is great news!"
"As long as it's just this big a region, we'll definitely find them if we spend a little more time and effort."
"Let's find out where the Ancestor Mother Religion is hiding!"
The Rulers of the cultivation cosmos were all in high spirits. They had been feeling helpless for far too long! But they were different from the Ancestor Mother Religion—even if they died, their real bodies could just quickly refine another avatar. As such, they had no reason to fear a confrontation! With this significant an advantage, how could they be afraid of fighting? The actual reason they felt helpless was that they could not find any trace of their enemies so far.
"Bloodshed, was it your disciple who got this information?"
"It's that Dong Bo Xue Ying again! He's quite formidable, I say. What Dao did he open? You were afraid of telling us before, but the Ancestor Mother Religion already know of it, so it's about time you tell us as well." The Rulers were overjoyed. Up until now, killing a protector merely meant slightly decreasing the enemy's fighting force. After all, the Ancestor Mother Religion ultimately depended on the religious leaders themselves! However, this map might just end up influencing the outcome of the entire war.
"It is the Dao of Mirage," the Bloodshed God Emperor replied.
"It's no wonder, then. Xue Ying can walk through the Mirage World so even those protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion will have a hard time injuring him. His specialty lies in the illusory realm too, granting him the perfect chance to capture a protector alive and force the information out of him." The Rulers finally understood.
Capturing a protector alive was truly difficult, but even if they did catch one alive, getting any information out of him was even harder.
The protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion could break off all of their six senses, making it entirely impossible to interrogate them! It was only Xue Ying, with his ability to send the other party into an illusory realm, who could hope to efficiently interrogate his opponents. His enemies would not resist receiving any information he transmitted, including the many star maps, all the way to the crucial map which caused his soul to react and crumble.
"This brat has certainly made a great contribution. We can't mistreat Xue Ying." Primal Master took the initiative.
"Right, we can't ignore my disciple's contribution," the Bloodshed God Emperor added.
"Bloodshed, when it comes to treasures, what you own is far beyond our meager possessions." The Temporal Island Lord sneered. He wasn't overly willing to pitch in with treasures.
"This involves our entire cultivation cosmos. Since that Xue Ying kid made such a great contribution, we cannot act as if nothing happened," the Abyss Primogenitor stepped in to say.
Since the top three experts of this cosmos—the Bloodshed God Emperor, the Abyss Primogenitor, and the Primal Master—had agreed upon it, Rulers like Empress Qian He and the others could only nod their heads and go along with the crowd. Even the Temporal Island Lord remained silent.
"You all might already be aware of it, but because my disciple's comprehension ability is so high, he ended up opening a Dao as a stage four World Deity. This will prove quite troublesome for him since it means he must become a Ruler before he can break through again. As such, we must think up some way to improve his chances of becoming a Ruler." The Bloodshed God Emperor had long since thought of something he could give to Xue Ying, but he was trying to not mention it directly.
"Just get straight to the point," the Temporal Island Lord urged.
"My idea is actually quite simple…" the Bloodshed God Emperor started explaining.
…
In the Blood Devil Eden.
"Sou, sou, sou."
Xue Ying was traversing through the Mirage world, teleporting time and time again. The speed he could now travel at was much faster than before.
'Found it.'
Xue Ying looked upward and to the front to see a maelstrom formed by the clouds high in the sky which seemed to vaguely distort even space itself. Xue Ying was clear that this maelstrom was actually the entrance to the Black Rain Eden, one of the Lower Three Edens.

chapters.title: Chapter 660 - Reward
chapters.content:
Chapter 660: Reward
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying was in no rush to visit the Black Rain Eden. Instead, he descended onto a plain and sat down cross-legged. Nevertheless, his figure remained illusory and real at the same time as Xue Ying used the Mirage world to maintain a vigilant watch over his surroundings. He was, after all, still within the Lower Three Edens of the Six Heavenly Wheel, which meant he could not be careless.
'Let's see if these two protectors were carrying any good stuff.' Xue Ying had yet to thoroughly look through the treasures left behind by the protectors he killed.
With a flip of his hand, a dark gray stone rod appeared before him.
'So heavy.' Xue Ying felt apprehensive. Considering his strength, he could easily annihilate planets within the starry sky with a flick of his finger. However, even someone like him thought the stone rod to be very heavy.
'The manufacturing of this stone rod is too crude, so crude, in fact, that it can't even compare to a World Deity weapon.' Xue Ying was dumbstruck. This was ultimately a weapon used by a protector of the Ancestor Mother Religion, but it had no more than a single ordinary function that could be considered either strong or weak. In any case, the reason why it was incomparably heavy was purely because of the material it was crafted from. This was precisely Protector Cheng Yun's weapon of choice.
'Protector Cheng Yun was still at the stage four World Deity realm regarding his usage of the laws of profound mysteries, so why would his weapon be so crude?' Xue Ying thought.
What he did not know was that, before the Ancestor Mother Religion entering their cultivation cosmos, they had no mention of the laws of profound mysteries in their cultivation techniques! Their laws and profound mysteries were much cruder, and it was only after coming here that they gained some knowledge from the cultivation system of the cultivators. It was at that point that they started improving rapidly since their fundamentals were ultimately very high—most protectors could easily become stage four World Deities.
However, reaching a realm any higher than that would prove much more difficult.
'What material did they even use to make it so heavy? Furthermore, it is so tough that it might as well be unbreakable,' Xue Ying inwardly murmured. 'I'll just ask teacher once I get back. The value of this material alone should place it at a considerably high price.'
He brought out treasure after treasure.
Even though some of them were rather queer—he could not even recognize what they did—the majority were useless.
'Poor… truly poor. He basically brought no valuable treasure along with him. His belongings are most likely on Protector Huo Zhu's person,' Xue Ying thought. Back when Protector Huo Zhu brought out the dried yellow leaf, Xue Ying could sense the aura inherent within the item despite him being more than fifty billion kilometers away. It was far beyond even the Ancient Demon's aura.
Protector Cheng Yun was far too poor by comparison. He was likely at most comparable to ordinary Cultivators, and judging by his treasures alone, he was in no qualified to possess the identity of a protector.
'Let's check the other protector.' Xue Ying next brought out the treasures left behind by Protector Zhong She.
"Hua."
An entirely black blade appeared in his hand, its body thin and covered in sculpted patterns.
'This weapon's refinement is much more exquisite than that of the stone rod. What, a True God weapon?! And it even has a Dao that reached eternity?' Xue Ying revealed a cheerful expression. This True God weapon was bound to be worth a fortune. Since the actual bodies of the dead protectors were located back in their home cosmos, any True God weapon would no longer be able to sense the existence living in another cosmos upon their death. As a result, they would instantly become ownerless, a fact he could easily confirm.
'The Dao inherent to this weapon is quite unique.' Xue Ying sensed a void world within, as well as an unseen blade light emitting a sharp, bloody aura.
'The Dao of Blade, is it?' Xue Ying guessed.
Such terminology was granted by cultivators.
This True God blade's Dao had a crazed and frenzied aura embedded with slaughter. The blade sought to kill everything standing before it—kill, kill, kill—nothing could stand in its way. The killing intent was truly heavy, reaching the boundary of a mad devil's. It was faintly similar to the Dao of the demons within the Dark Abyss.
'I'll call it Devil Blade, then.' Xue Ying casually named the weapon. This might be a True God weapon containing an eternity-level Dao of Slaughter, placing its value extremely close to the Blood Serpent Spear, but he had to be very careful when comprehending it, since even a slight investigation of this weapon allowed him to realize that the crazed aura being transmitted from within was trying to influence him.
…
Having briefly investigated the items, Xue Ying was left with a sensation of both joy and shock. The treasures left behind by Protector Zhong She were much more valuable than Protector Cheng Yun's. From the types of treasures they were, he could deduce that they were likely obtained by killing paragons, or through miraculous encounters within the Six Heavenly Wheel. As such, most of these treasures actually belonged to the cultivation cosmos, with the most precious being the Devil Blade with its eternity-level Dao.
"Sou." Xue Ying stored everything back. Soon afterward, he shot up into the sky, flying towards the vast maelstrom formed by clouds.
The space within the maelstrom was distorted.
"Hu."
After entering, he proceeded without any wasted time to the new Eden.
As he moved further inwards, everything in front of Xue Ying turned illusory. As he appeared in mid-air, he noticed that everything in front of him was marked by endless rain. The rainwater here was black in color, and it seemed to fall without pause nor end.
'The Black Rain Eden…' Xue Ying flipped his hand, bringing out his Three Devil Command Token. At the same time he grabbed it, he employed its ability to get a sense of the location it was pointing towards.
'Over there.'
Xue Ying immediately understood that the Eroding Bone Palace was to his left.
But…
He was in no rush to get there! Having arrived at the Black Rain Eden, he would naturally first visit Monarch Hex Cricket who was stationed here permanently.
"Sou, sou, sou!"
Teleporting through the Mirage world allowed him to cover long distances in a short time. Even though he wasn't deliberately rushing, he still managed to include a few hundred billion kilometers within a breath's worth of time. He arrived by a black lake, where he found a dark-green middle-aged man wearing luxurious robes seated on top of a stone which jutted out of the lake. This man had two soft antennae on his head, and his eyes glowed green.
A pillar of dim green light covered a region of more than a trillion kilometers with him as the center. The pillar shot up into the sky, piercing through the blue dome of the heavens.
This person was precisely Monarch Hex Cricket, and he was tasked to remain stationed here, guarding the place all by himself. He was the sort of existence that left the Ancestor Mother Religion feeling helpless! After all, while he was indeed lacking in terms of frontal combat power when compared with someone like the Ancient Demon, the laws of profound mysteries used by Monarch Hex Cricket were at an extremely high level. His specialized in two Daos, both geared towards survivability, and he had already cultivated both to an extremely high degree; he lacked a single, final step before he could reach the ruler realm.
Most Paragons would be considered capable even if they specialized in a single survival Dao.
But Monarch Hex Cricket specialized in two different types! Since he was able to utilize them in concert, even rulers found themselves unable to deal with him. In fact, his survival capabilities were much stronger even than those of most Rulers! Even the Ancestor Mother Religion, with their clan protection treasures, could not deal with him; the two Daos Monarch Hex Cricket cultivated were heaven-shattering. One of them was called 'Undying', and the other one 'Life'. As a result of his cultivation, he was virtually unkillable under normal circumstances. Furthermore, according to the intelligence reports, the Ancestor Mother Religion had once paid a colossal price to kill him, and had seemingly succeeded—his soul had dispersed without leaving a single strand of his existence behind.
However, before they realized it, Monarch Hex Cricket had revived and was already back within the Black Rain Eden.
While someone like Water Devil King could at least be trapped by the Primal Master…
Monarch Hex Cricket… was someone whom even the Primal Master might not be able to imprison. Besides, with how kind and benevolent he was and how good of a temper he had, none of the rulers had ever even thought of moving against him. Even the Temporal Island Lord, who was known for his cunningness and selfishness, had never acted against him.
He was ranked behind Monarch Green and the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, but that was only because his offensive power was weaker than theirs.
"Hua." Monarch Hex Cricket opened his eyes, putting on a cheerful expression as he looked at Xue Ying. "Monarch Dong Bo."
His smile was filled with endless life. Despite being seated here, within this despondent Black Rain Eden, he was so full of life energy that he could even influence the surrounding region of a trillion kilometers.
"Monarch Hex Cricket." Xue Ying descended to stand atop of the Black Rain Lake.
"I heard you've killed another protector from the Ancestor Mother Religion. That makes two dead, one after the other," Monarch Hex Cricket exclaimed in admiration.
"It was just luck. I've only broken through recently, so nobody knew in the entire cosmos was aware of my true combat power. They also underestimated me, giving me the chance to succeed with a single move." Xue Ying laughed. "It would be much more difficult to kill another protector from now on."
The Ancestor Mother Religion now had a deeper understanding of Xue Ying, and would naturally raise their vigilance in his presence. They would not give him another chance.
"It's precisely because you opened a Dao within a million years—and the Dao of Mirage no less—that made them lose their heads and allowed you to succeed," Monarch Hex Cricket replied. "Not everybody can hope to accomplish such feats within a million years.
"By now, it's not just the rulers, but most of the apex paragons already know about your achievement." Monarch Hex Cricket chuckled. "The Ancestor Mother Religion is no secret amongst apex Paragons. Your killing two protectors actually managed to attract the astonishment of many old friends of mine. Even Great Destruction, with that cold temper of his, took the initiative to ask me about you as if he couldn't quite believe it. As of now, most of those old friends of mine are talking about you."

chapters.title: Chapter 661 - Eroding Bone Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 661: Eroding Bone Palace
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
After Xue Ying chatted with Monarch Hex Cricket for a while, he bid his farewell and proceeded to the Eroding Bone Palace.
"Hu."
He was continuously moving forward inside the Mirage world. Following the lead of the Three Devil Command Token, it was not long until he arrived at his destination.
"Mn?" He watched as a bubble appeared right in front of him. As soon as it enveloped him, he got a sensation similar to being shattered apart, and he disappeared from his original location.
…
Once he regained his bearings, he noticed a black lake right in front of his eyes, and at its very center many pillars going down deep. These pillars were propping up an ancient palace with some motley vestiges left on the main door. There were three words written on it—Eroding, Bone, and Palace.
With a single step, Xue Ying moved across a few hundred meters to arrive in front of the palace door.
'One of the Three Devil Palaces, the Eroding Bone Palace.' With another step, Xue Ying entered the palace, whose insides proved to be quite dilapidated. Since the palace door remained nearly always closed, the insides had slowly turned filthy. As he looked towards the walls, Xue Ying soon came across a large amount of densely written words; this was one of the three fundamental secret techniques, the 'Eroding Bone Secret Technique'.
"You came here using the command token… which means you're that soldier from the Destruction Legion, right?" Black water droplets began converging within the hall to form a black-robed old man.
"That's me," Xue Ying replied.
"The Eroding Bone Secret Technique is right there, so just hurry up and begin cultivating. If you do not succeed within 10,000 years, you can get lost," the black-robed old man hollered.
"Must the subordinates of the Ancestor Devil be so aggressive towards the soldiers of the Destruction Legion? We're not even in the third cosmos epoch anymore," Xue Ying muttered.
"Hmph." The black-robed old man gave a cold snort before going to a corner and sitting down cross-legged. He couldn't be bothered to even say another word.
Xue Ying did not attempt to bicker any further and instead looked upwards to carefully imprint the Eroding Bone Secret Technique in his mind. Now that he owned the command token, he was in no rush to actually cultivate this secret technique. If he could not succeed within 10,000 years and was thrown out, he could just continue cultivating outside. Once his cultivation succeeded, he could just come in again. As such, it would naturally be quite easy for him to eventually pass the trials. Such were the benefits of owning a command token.
With such a token, he could enter the Three Devil Palaces time after time, and he would have however many chances he needed.
As a result, back when he entered the first palace by coincidence was the only turning point, since he had to succeed on his first try.
'Eroding Bone Secret Technique?' Xue Ying nodded lightly after having finished reading through it. 'It goes in an entirely different direction compared to the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique, but cultivating one's bones is bound to be agonizing. I wonder why these three big secret techniques created by the Ancestor Devil as a base for his strongest absolute art—the "Myriad Devil True Body"—are so painful to train in?'
The Dissolving Blood Secret Technique, the Eroding Bone Secret Technique, and the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique were all very painful to cultivate.
The Dissolving Blood and Eroding Bone Secret Techniques were less so since they targeted the blood and the bones. Even in the worst case scenario, the pain would only slightly affect his soul.
But when it came to the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique… it purely targeted one's True Deity Heart.
Despite the pain, and even during the most intense moments, he would have to maintain his consciousness and continue cultivating. Xue Ying was lamenting over why the Ancestor Devil would have created such a secret technique. He was worthy of his status as the existence who created the Dark Abyss from how unique his ways of creating absolute arts were.
'I'll try starting my cultivation now. Hopefully, I will succeed within 10,000 years.' Xue Ying sat down cross-legged before starting his cultivation of the secret technique. Even his true body back at the Crimson Rock Mountain World immersed itself in pondering and cultivating it.
Over time, bones began gradually protruding from his skin to become visible to the entire world. In fact, these sparkling, translucent bones were connected to each other to form an entire body! The surface of Xue Ying's body was gradually being covered by a layer of bone, and he was slowly transforming in appearance into a literal man of bone.
"Pa!" The translucent bones broke down. Shortly afterward, 'pa pa pa', the bones covering the surface of his body also began breaking down. This was a result of a disintegration of the innermost structural makeup of the bones—almost instantaneously, every single bone within Xue Ying's body crumbled apart; there was not a single bone left. However, shortly afterward, his World Deity energy began transforming, and a new set of bones started growing once again to return him back to his original state.
Time passed in this manner, and a hundred years or so later, Xue Ying finally formed a layer of perfected bone armor. This armor was sparkling and translucent, and it formed a single piece. There was even a bone helmet over his head, which only revealed his pair of eyes.
'The first step was a success. Next step…' Xue Ying continued cultivating. One could see that the bone armor on the surface of his body was being eroded like rocks in the wind and the rain. The agonizing pain of this effect left Xue Ying unconsciously frowning. If previously he looked quite handsome in that sparkling, translucent armor made of bone, in the blink of an eye, all that bone eroded and took on a worn-out appearance.
'The Eroding Bone Secret Technique is truly fierce; this is erosion at its best.' Xue Ying was clear that this was only the first erosion technique. He would have to undergo three thousand types of erosion techniques before his cultivation could be completed.
However, what left everyone speechless about this technique was how useless it was in terms of improving its user's combat power. The only result of it was allowing a cultivator to increase their control over bones to an expert level.
…
Day passed after day, year after year.
The pain Xue Ying was feeling only became greater with time, but he was forced to suppress the feeling and continue cultivating. It was just because he knew that the Three Devil Palaces were one of the biggest opportunities left behind by the Ancestor Devil for his descendants that Xue Ying agreed to cultivate such a secret technique. Who would other cultivate an ability that caused such great pain yet had no benefits in terms of improving one's combat power?
"He~" A vague growl left Xue Ying's throat and his face contorted.
Such a level of torture caused his body to tremble, and he was only barely able to maintain his cross-legged posture. Regardless of his efforts, however, his legs and arms continued to tremble. This state had already persisted for three days or so.
Because he was now in the final stage of his cultivation, the pain he was feeling had also reached a maximum.
"Hong."
The bones in his body finally regained their usual calmness.
The sweat which had been leaving Xue Ying's body for a while all evaporated in an instant, and he finally let out a sigh of relief and opened his eyes.
"I succeeded." Xue Ying revealed a grin. Despite knowing that he could have as many tries as he wanted due to the Three Devil Palaces command token and that his chances of succeeding were very high, the satisfaction gained after knowing that he had succeeded still overwhelmed him. This was mainly because of how torturous this 3,000 years of cultivation had been.
Xue Ying looked towards that black-robed old man.
"Hong."
The aura within his body exploded, and at the same time, a colossal illusion appeared behind his back. It had the appearance of a four-legged beast with long hair. All four of this creature's legs were so gigantic that they seemed like pillars holding up the sky.
After seeing this totem, the black-robed old man said, "The Lofty Beast Totem, and you've succeeded in just three thousand years. Your comprehension ability is not half bad."
He had already heard of how Xue Ying had succeeded in his cultivation of the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique way before the set deadline, so he was not too surprised at this outcome.
Xue Ying's current mood was excellent. Now that he succeeded in his cultivation of the Eroding Bone Secret Technique, he was two-thirds finished with these three fundamental secret techniques, leaving behind only the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique as a final roadblock. The moment he succeeded in that as well… he would receive the inheritance left by the Ancestor Devil. This was seen as a great opportunity amongst Paragons, especially since most Paragons never even had the chance to enter the Three Devil Palaces. There were also some who did enter but were unable to take advantage of it. After all, cultivating the secret technique within a million years was actually tough for most Paragons. After all, a large portion of Paragons was used to a slow cultivation before opening their Dao as True Gods, and could easily have spent a few hundred million years in doing so. For such people, cultivating a secret technique in just a short million years was indeed rather tricky.
And if they were to fail their first attempt, the hopes of receiving another opportunity were nil.
As a result, there might be some people who successfully received the inheritance left behind in the Three Devil Palaces in this cosmos epoch, but they were few and far between.
'The Ancestor Devil would definitely treat his successors well.' Xue Ying was already looking forward to it. He then looked back at the black-robed old man who was wearing an ugly expression, and his heart could not help but jolt. "I might be a soldier from the Destruction Legion, and as such, I don't mind this unfair treatment at the moment. However, I hope you'll stop acting like this once I get through all the trials of the Three Devil Palaces."
"Now that you've succeeded, you must be ready to leave." The black-robed old man waved his hand.
A bubble appeared which enveloped Xue Ying, who then shattered apart and immediately disappeared from the palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 662 - Cultivating Heart Secret Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 662: Cultivating Heart Secret Technique
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying was teleporting within the Mirage world as he traversed the Black Rain Eden. He soon arrived at a huge maelstrom formed from the black clouds in the sky, and this maelstrom was distorting even space itself. This was a passage leading to the Icy Snow Eden.
'I only have one challenge from the Three Devil Palaces yet to complete, but it's the hardest one.' Xue Ying shot up into the sky and entered the maelstrom.
Icy Snow Eden was marked by a freezing wind blowing all throughout, complete with snow falling from the sky. Goose feather-like snow was piled up all around, forming a pure blanket of white snow.
Xue Ying had only just arrived, but he already noticed the bone-piercing temperature. Whenever one of the snowflakes landed on his body, it was immediately forced away by his luminous sun force.
Taking out the command token for the Three Devil Palaces, he began heading towards the location he was pointed.
…
Once he arrived, just like the first two times, a bubble appeared in the air to envelop him, and he was immediately teleported through the void at the location of the Cultivating Heart Palace.
Xue Ying appreciated the scene in front of him: he was in a region filled to the brim with snow, at the very center of which was a huge palace which was also covered in snow. There were three ancient words imprinted on the surface of the front door of this building—Cultivating, Heart, and Palace.
The interior of the palace hall showed no sign of the same snow found everywhere outside. Instead, many words were written all over the motley walls, making up the third and final fundamental secret technique, the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique.
"The Cultivating Heart Secret Technique," an aged voice sounded.
Xue Ying turned over to see an old man. He was dressed in white robes, had white hair and a white beard old, and he seemed to have suddenly materialized within the hall. His beard stretched all the way to his chest. "Listen here, Destruction Legion kid: the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique is the hardest of the three fundamental secret techniques. From the time the Ancestor Devil created the Six Heavenly Wheel, leaving behind the Three Devil Palaces, and until now, not many people got the command token for the Three Devil Palaces within each cosmos epoch. The demands for the other two secret techniques might be high, but they can't be considered exaggerated when compared to this Cultivating Heart Secret Technique. Many have succeeded in cultivating the previous two but remained forever stuck at this final technique."
"Dissolving Blood and Eroding Bone are fine and all…"
"But the Cultivating Heart focuses on cultivating one's True Deity Heart, your very soul. It is undoubtedly the hardest of the bunch."
The old man looked at Xue Ying. "This is the most important trial set by the Ancestor Devil. It is only if you pass it that you can gain the inheritance of the Ancestor Devil."
Xue Ying laughed. "Many thanks. You are much more polite than the other two."
"Treasure spirits have their own wisdom, and some might even have feelings," the white-haired old man concluded with these words, then walked to the side and sat down cross-legged with his eyes closed. He no longer paid Xue Ying any attention.
Xue Ying was startled momentarily as he gazed at the old man, but he quickly turned his attention towards the words written on the wall.
Very soon, he memorized the entire Cultivating Heart Secret Technique.
'The Cultivating Heart Secret Technique has three boundaries?' Xue Ying thought.
As long as his True Deity Heart could endure passing these three boundaries, he would have succeeded in cultivating the secret technique.
'According to the intelligence reports I received from Teacher, the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique is the hardest one.' Xue Ying did not dare underestimate this technique. If one's first entry into the Three Devil Palaces were the most critical part of the process and acquiring the command token represented half the work, then successfully cultivating this final secret technique would be the other half! Both the Dissolving Blood and the Eroding Bone secret techniques could be easily completed by most paragons with enough time.
However, the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique was different.
Some paragons would simply never succeed.
"Begin." Xue Ying sat down cross-legged, closed his eyes, and began his cultivation.
******
The Cultivating Heart Secret Technique was divided into three boundaries.
The first boundary was known as Despondence.
Xue Ying's True Deity Heart, as seen in his consciousness, was quite large. It had the appearance of a child-sized Xue Ying. The very moment he started his cultivation, shackles began appearing on the surface of his True Deity Heart, locking him within. These chains were like soldering iron, and they left anything they touched in intense pain. "Ah!" It was the sort of pain applied directly to the soul.
As the pain increased, Xue Ying could not help but growl. His body soon began to tremble, and he fell down paralyzed the very next moment.
He had not even once been left paralyzed during his cultivation of the previous two secret techniques, even as he was reaching the final stages. But cultivating the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique left him in such intense pain from the very start that he could not even move. On top of that, this pain would only increase with time.
"Ah!"
Xue Ying gritted his teeth. Blood began dripping from his mouth, and even from his skin. The pain was on such a level that his entire body was trembling without his will.
However, he was doing his best in trying to stay awake and continue cultivating this secret technique.
The pain was gradually rising.
At some point, Xue Ying had begun to feel as if he was in an endless hell, but then the pain suddenly began to recede. The pain had risen quickly, but it also receded just as fast. Xue Ying let out a sigh of relief before moving back into his initial cross-legged stance. The beads of blood which had been forming on his skin disappeared, and his figure regained its usual cleanliness.
And now that he regained clarity of mind, he could continue cultivating the secret technique, starting the cycle of pain from the beginning…
…
The pain rose to a terrifying stage then fell once again. This cycle repeated itself time after time, although the pain he was feeling would reach a new high with every iteration! Before long, a sense of terror had unknowingly begun to creep up in Xue Ying's mind, for it seemed like there would be no end to the torture. As he cultivated, he felt as if he had fallen into hell, with the agony becoming only stronger and stronger.
There was no end in sight—it was like a nightmare that would only ever become stronger.
Despite all of this, Xue Ying's goal remained clear though. He wasn't afraid nor was he worried. Whenever that feeling of creeping terror and despair appeared, he quickly threw them aside.
Yet some amount of fatigue began to gather.
Putting all his effort into completing a task was bound to eventually lead to some fatigue, and every cycle of pain was designed so that he would have to use all of his focus just to endure it. It all seemed endless. Xue Ying's heart might be firm, but even he was gradually turning wan and swallow as a sense of lethargy appeared in his mind. The so-called 'spurt of energy' from the beginning had waned over time to make place for pure exhaustion.
Xue Ying was becoming tired of having to endure the torture, but he had yet to succeed, so he was forced to continue! Every single boundary of the Cultivating Heart was arduous, and if he were to fail this current one, he would have to repeat the entire thing from the start.
He was naturally not willing to accept such an outcome, so he was trying his best to succeed in a single try. Despite the fatigue welling up in his heart, he persisted.
He was enduring.
Time after time…
It felt endless and eternal.
He felt himself fall into an abyss of despair, but there was still a tough bone in him which didn't accept failure. This was the so-called 'no confusion, no worries, no fear, empty state of mind, advancing forward with courage, and heart and mind as one'. The current Xue Ying had already reached the state of heart and mind as one. Even though his soul felt like it was crumbling apart, and he was only cultivating as a numb machine, he still held on.
When he was young, he would cultivate his spear techniques every single day to an extreme. Afterward, he was inflicted with hexing poison and had to hold on up until the very end before he could consume a dose of medicine to relieve the pain. After all, consuming the medicine while disregarding the schedule would shorten his lifespan.
But none of that had ever caused Xue Ying to feel such bitterness.
Endless.
It must be stated that the current state of Xue Ying's soul was so much stronger than it had been in the past, but he was still in despair. And 'Despondence' was merely the first boundary of the Cultivating Heart.
He did not know how long a time had passed, but he began to feel that he was on death's door. There was a single thought which gave him the ability to keep enduring. His heart was already faint, but he was still able to persist.
"Hong~"
Once an incomparably terrifying pain engulfed his soul and receded just as quickly, Xue Ying was left in a stunned state.
After all, he discovered…
That he had completed the cultivation content of the first boundary of the Cultivation Heart, 'Despondence'.
'I managed to endure?' Xue Ying was rather surprised. Even though he was still tired beyond words, a sense of happiness was growing in his heart, for he had finally escaped that terrifying hell. The smile on Xue Ying's face was exceptionally exuberant. He attempted to deduce how long had passed since he began his cultivation.
'What!? Only two days?' Xue Ying was aghast.
He thought he had been experiencing that endless pain for a very long time, perhaps a million years or ten million years. However, upon succeeding, he found that only two days had passed.
Xue Ying completely loosened up and relaxed for half a year until he was fully recovered.
Only then did he finally begin cultivating the second boundary of the Cultivating Heart—the 'Heart Arousal'.

chapters.title: Chapter 663 - Time, Discovery
chapters.content:
Chapter 663: Time, Discovery
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The second boundary of the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique was known as Heart Arousal. As soon as he began cultivating it, Xue Ying's True Deity Heart arrived in an illusory realm.
Within this illusory realm, Xue Ying was standing on top of a mountain peak, shivering. Pain was engulfing him time and time again.
Suddenly, a white, delicate finger touched his shoulder, and the pain he was feeling immediately dispersed.
"Mn?" Xue Ying turned around and saw a beautiful woman. Her appearance was exquisite, her temperament and charm such that even Xue Ying himself rarely saw. Her voice was so soft that it sent a tingling sensation through his bones. "Why torture yourself?" she asked. "Come, accompany me instead." With these words, she coiled around Xue Ying to release her breath next to his ears.
He was feeling genuinely comfortable; all that pain from before had vanished.
But at the very next moment, Xue Ying released his aura to push away the charming woman, then turned around and left. The very instant he drove her away, however, the pain returned to engulf his entire body.
…
An old man was fishing by the side of a lake, next to whom Xue Ying had suddenly appeared, pain still surging through his body.
"Youngster, what is the purpose of your painstaking cultivation? Is everything you're doing not for the sake of living a carefree life? But look at this old man—I can eat whatever I want to eat, and drink whatever I wish to drink. If I feel like fishing or sleeping, I can just do so. Say, why not let go of everything and enjoy the small pleasures of life?" the old man said with a smile.
During the previous encounter, Xue Ying never even spoke a word to the charming woman.
But as he faced this old man, he couldn't help but retort, "If you don't cultivate, you can live but a short hundred years or so. But if you do well in cultivation, you can live for much longer! So you tell me—why not cultivate?
"If you don't cultivate, what can you depend on for your sustenance? You might just starve to death. By cultivating, you get to enjoy all sorts of delicious foods and nectareous drinks, delicacies in all sorts of shapes and sizes; you get to enjoy all of that.
"If you don't cultivate, how many mountains can you hope to climb? How far can you walk? Cultivate, and you can fly anywhere and see the whole world.
"If you don't cultivate, any random soldier you meet might cause you to fall into a predicament. By cultivating, you can become a one-man army, someone comparable to Deities and Demons. Once you've considered all this, let me ask you again: would you rather cultivate or not?"
Xue Ying continued elaborating.
When he was young, his parents had been imprisoned, and this single fact alone allowed Xue Ying to realize that, without power, he could never hope to protect his loved ones. And if he could not do that, how would he be able to enjoy life? He would be like a little ant, hoping not to be stomped someday in the future.
"Furthermore…
"There are millions and millions of lives in the vast cosmos. If you don't cultivate, you will forever remain but one unremarkable being with a hundred years to live. Such a life is short and fleeting. But if you cultivate, you get the chance to stand at the very peak of the cosmos, to see the rise and fall of planets and of clans. You could easily destroy the void itself with a flick of your finger, and your willpower may affect countless lives and deaths."
As Xue Ying continued explaining, the old man simply dissipated at some point.
…
Xue Ying once again changed locations, this time to a luxurious-looking palace hall. He was seated high up on a throne, with a large group of subjects kneeling and begging him.
"Your Majesty, why the need to torture yourself? You are a mighty sovereign with countless generals and a loyal legion. Nobody would ever dare to treat you as their enemy."
"Your Majesty, why are you torturing yourself? The hearts of us loyal subjects ache for you."
Countless people were begging him.
Yet Xue Ying only lightly shook his head. "Only knowing how to enjoy myself would signify that I don't have what it takes to keep a stable hold over this throne."
…
The world had countless desires which people longed for. Be it beauty, all sorts of emotions, power, even gluttony; everything and anything with an alluring quality to it was included.
But Xue Ying treated everything cooly.
Having cultivated to his current realm, he was clear of the myriad existences which existed throughout the cosmos. Nothing could be obtained without an exchange. Holding a stable throne and having earth-shattering power would only be possible by paying an even higher price to control his many subjects to rule the entire world! In order to gain beauty, one needed the power to keep others who coveted her away.
To enjoy all sorts of delicious food, one needed the qualifications to ask great chefs to cook for them, as well as send countless people out to search for ingredients.
Even when it came to a simple relationship, he needed the power to protect it.
The laws of this cosmos were fair.
As such, while the Heart Arousal boundary seemed alluring at a glance, it was not practical. In Xue Ying's eyes, it was no more than a joke.
He was thus able to comfortably get through the Heart Arousal boundary.
******
Having gotten through two boundaries in one shot, Xue Ying had quite a confidence boost going into the third boundary.
The third and final boundary was known as the boundary of 'Time'.
As soon as he first started his cultivation of the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique third boundary, he was once again swept into an illusory realm. The flow of time here was different from that of the external world. Like an ordinary man having a dream, he could live here for a very long time, while in reality, only a short night might pass.
Such was the third boundary. Unlike the first two, it did nothing to intensify the pain he was feeling.
However, this stage involved him taking on specific roles in different lives, going from start to finish. Xue Ying could not resist this pull, and neither could he show any preferences! He could only turn into the protagonist and experience everything in this life as if in a trance. Any attraction he had for a girl, for instance, would be accepted within the dream, despite any feeling of rejection he might have buried in his heart.
Nothing was under his control, and events would just develop naturally.
The first role he had involved a long lifespan. He began this life as an ordinary mortal, experiencing love and hatred. Having embarked on the path of cultivation, he eventually took a wrong turn and became a devil. This life of his lasted for a total of 1.5 billion years. He had become a stage two World Deity before being finally killed because of his overwhelming cruelty and craziness.
A total of 1.5 billion years passed just like that amidst his immersion in the boundary of Time.
Xue Ying had never experienced such an extended period of time. How long had he even cultivated for? Even though his cultivation heart was at a very profound stage, he could not avoid being influenced by this life.
His second run proved to be even darker. He experienced all sorts of tragedies as a mortal, turning into a devil entirely by the time he was 16 years old. He relied on a Demonic God to destroy the entire mortal realm and even became a mighty Demonic God himself after entering the Dark Abyss. Savage, cunning, cold and untrusting towards everyone—in this way he lived for a total of 2.3 billion years before being killed at the stage three World Deity realm.
His third life was a much smoother journey. He lived the life of a genius who did not experience any setbacks. His path of cultivation was very smooth, and he even gathered a large group of wives and concubines, as well as having countless beauties sending themselves into his embrace. In fact, at some point, he stopped even desiring any more women, simply because there were too many beauties already around him! As such, he stopped accepting girls whom he did not have feelings for. This role continued all the way until he died as a stage four World Deity after an extremely elegant life which lasted 12 billion years or so.
And as he died…
"Peng."
Xue Ying's True Deity Heart trembled, his cultivation interrupted.
