'I failed?' Xue Ying woke up. He was now clear that he had failed in this cultivation of the third boundary of the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique. 'Only 1100 years have gone by in the real world, yet I've lived for more than 10 billion years in the Time Boundary…'
His soul had been affected by the passing of time, preventing him from being able to hold on any further.
Crossing the Time Boundary involved remaining awake during the entire process without being affected by any of the disturbances. Clearly, those three roles he had lived through were but a small part of the entire Time Boundary.
'The notion of time has always been rather mystical. After many long years, most human hearts would transform,' Xue Ying thought. 'Even though my heart is clear and I should be able to tolerate living for a long period of time… how could I be able to just disregard turning into someone else and experiencing new life for more than 10 billion years?'
How long had he genuinely cultivated for?
Xue Ying was even left absent-minded, as he could now hardly even discern what was real and what was illusory. Even his soul felt old and lethargic as if he had already reached the end of his lifespan and was about to die.
…
After his first failure in the third boundary, Xue Ying was in no rush to continue cultivating. The true body in his hometown was accompanying his wife and children. It was in this manner that his heart gradually recovered.
He was not sure how long the Time Boundary would last, and how many roles would he have to experience. It was no wonder that even most powerful Paragons would fail in their attempts at cultivating this secret technique.
After accompanying his wife and children for a total of three thousand years, he felt that he finally made a full recovery.
As such, it was time for another attempt!
On his second attempt, he once again experienced three roles before failing.
Fail.
Fail.
Very soon, the ten thousand years time limit was up.
The white-haired old man stood up. Looking at Xue Ying, he did not seem confused about his troubles. "Trapped in the Time Boundary? This final step is one that very few true gods and paragons have ever crossed. You are ultimately too young." With these final words, he waved his hand. A bubble then quickly enveloped Xue Ying to send him out.
…
Falling snow was covering up the entire sky.
Now back in the Icy Snow Eden, Xue Ying continued cultivating the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique, only to be met with another failure. Gradually, anxiety began creeping up on him.
Thirty thousand years after he was thrown out from the Cultivating Heart Palace, in the corner of the Deity world's starry landscape, an old man dressed in simple clothes was carefully investigating this particular region of the world. He was none other than the most ancient Ruler in the entire cosmos, the Primal Master.
"Mn?" The Primal Master frowned.
"Bloodshed, some of you should rush over here. I might have found the base of the Ancestor Mother Religion," the Primal Master sent over. Once Xue Ying passed the star map to the Bloodshed God Emperor, the Rulers began an incomparably thorough investigation of this particular area.
"You found something?"
"We'll be there as soon as possible."
"We're coming."
The Bloodshed God Emperor, the Temporal Island Lord, the Abyss Primogenitor and all the other Rulers were all feeling quite happy as they made their way over!

chapters.title: Chapter 664 - Ruler Pang Yi
chapters.content:
Chapter 664: Ruler 'Pang Yi'
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Many figures began appearing in this region of the starry sky.
There was the old Primal Master who was wearing simple robes, the luxurious-garbed Empress Qian He, the black-haired, black-robed Temporal Island Lord, the Purgatory Ruler—a somewhat cold and handsome man wearing golden armor. There was also Ruler Nile, whose colossal figure was emitting a bloody aura, the Abyss Primogenitor with his full beard and loose garb, the Myriad God Palace Master who was dressed in starry robes and had a seemingly cold countenance, and finally, a crimson-robed man holding the deepest and most profound aura of the bunch—the Bloodshed God Emperor himself. There were a total of eight Rulers and two other figures who had just appeared.
One of these newly appeared figures belonged to a teenager wearing moon-white robes and who wore a warm expression. The other was a barefoot man with messy hair and whose gray robes were half-exposed.
The warm teenager gave off the feeling of spring and rain. He was exuding now pressure whatsoever, which left others feeling like they'd want to get closer to him.
The gray-robed barefoot man had a gentle expression, but he gave off the natural feeling of a leader, giving everyone the impulse of wanting to serve him.
These two were none other than Pang Yi and Monarch Green! They both had power comparable to Rulers.
This time, all ten of the Cultivation Cosmos's top existences had gathered.
"Primal, you're worthy of your status as the oldest being in our epoch. We've all investigated this place, but you were the only one who discovered something strange about it," Ruler Nile joked.
"I too have gone over this place countless times, but it just so happened that this time I discovered something that wasn't quite normal. It was only after carefully pondering the situation that I discovered a gap." The Primal Master chuckled. He was relatively happy to have succeeded since the concealing techniques used by the Ancestor Mother Religion really were quite formidable.
"Since we've found the place, there's no reason to wait any longer. Prepare to move," the Bloodshed God Emperor immediately stated.
"Bloodshed, you take the lead," said the Abyss Primogenitor.
"I agree," the Primal Master added.
None of the nine people present disagreed.
After all, everyone knew that the Bloodshed God-Emperor had the most complex cultivation of the bunch! He was ranked first in terms of both arrays and refinement. It was easy to see how proficient he was in many different aspects. As a result, he seemed to be the only one fit to lead so many Rulers who all had different areas of expertise.
"Alright." The Bloodshed God Emperor did not try to decline. He immediately began making his preparations.
"Weng."
The void behind the Bloodshed God Emperor suddenly broke open, and an enormous golden eye appeared deep within the crack. The eyeball was pointed at a particular region far into the distance, and it was enough to leave the aura emitted by the Bloodshed God Emperor feeling chaotic. The black bird on his shoulder was maintaining a state of vigilance, knowing that the Bloodshed God Emperor currently had no way of retaliating and required it to protect him.
"They've discovered us, so they're getting ready to flee," the Bloodshed God Emperor mentioned. The crack behind him was rapidly closing up, and the enormous golden eye also disappeared.
"Hear my orders."
A flash of killing intent appeared in his eyes.
…
Thus the highest level of cultivators within this cosmos underwent a huge battle. This fight occurred in secret, and only ten people on the side of the cultivators participated in it.
******
Back in the Icy Snow Eden, Xue Ying was standing on the snow, displaying his spear techniques using the Blood Serpent Spear. The killing intent within his spear techniques began forming, causing many flashes of his weapon to arc through the sky and destroy the surroundings.
He was stuck at the Time Boundary of the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique. He had discovered in time that he was not well fit for an obstinate path of cultivation. As a result, he decided to place the matter aside and begin his research into the Dao of Mirage alongside the flying knife True God weapon, as well as the Dao of Slaughter within the Blood Serpent Spear. He understood well enough that what he currently lacked most was a powerful offense. As such, he was doing his best to study the Dao of Slaughter in hopes of eventually opening it.
He wished for this to the extent that he had even occasionally pondered the Devil Blade since the Dao of Slaughter Blade was also one of the aspects of slaughter.
"Hu."
Xue Ying suddenly put away his spear, a look of shock on his face.
"What? Big Brother Huo Cheng, are you certain this is true?" Xue Ying asked via karma.
"It is! Pang Yi has become a Ruler. I've received this information directly from my teacher, so how could it be fake?" Huo Cheng was clearly very excited.
"Pang Yi has finally become a Ruler…" Xue Ying was startled.
Pang Yi's combat power was unfathomable. Before even becoming a Ruler, he was already eight on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List, one position ahead of the Bloody Ruler and even beyond Monarch Green.
"Who was it that discovered this information?" Xue Ying asked. "Did he make it public of his own accord?"
"The Rulers discovered a certain important location belonging to the Ancestor Mother Religion. Thinking it was their base, eight Rulers joined by Pang Yi, and Monarch Green acted together to invade this location! However, the place only proved to contain a religious leader and two of his protectors, yet with the help of their territory, the religious leader was still able to hold on for a very long time. It was during this assault that Pang Yi suddenly displayed an incredibly powerful combat power, isolating the protectors within a certain area and killing them directly. This lead to a hole forming in the region which supposed to be held down by those two protectors, and the religious leader was forced to use a certain unique treasure which allowed him to disappear," Paragon Huo Cheng explained. "Even so, this raid proved to be very useful to us, according to Teacher, since it allowed us to discover many of the Ancestor Mother Religion's secrets."
Xue Ying nodded.
It was an area protected by a religious leader and two protectors; it was only natural that they'd uncover some secrets there.
"Now that Pang Yi has become a Ruler his combat power is simply unimaginable. Furthermore, he was able to separate the heavy protection of that important location and kill those two protectors located within directly, something that even the Bloodshed God-Emperor and the others had not managed to do," Paragon Huo Cheng said. "Formidable, truly too formidable. I've asked my teacher before, and it seemed that this ability was supposedly granted by a new cultivation technique created by Pang Yi himself."
"Formidable indeed," Xue Ying replied.
…
After Paragon Huo Cheng informed him of this matter, the Bloodshed God Emperor himself soon mentioned the same thing to his disciple. "Xue Ying, that portion of the star map you provided was indeed accurate. We've discovered an important location belonging to the Ancestor Mother Religion there, and through the arrays protecting the place, we are able to deduce that the whole region was part of a huge array, together with two other important locations and the main base of the Ancestor Mother Religion. That array is truly powerful and stable! Fortunately, Pang Yi was able to display his secret technique and kill off all the claws and teeth underneath the religious leader, leaving holes behind in the internal operation of the arrays. We were then able to rely on this new-found opportunity to destroy the array for good in a single move! Hahaha, since this area has already been broken through, the other two important locations, as well as the base of the Ancestor Mother Religion, lost their protection. According to these arrays, we are also able to deduce that the Ancestor Mother Religion is certainly located at that starfield."
Xue Ying was able to sense the joy his teacher had.
After the Bloodshed God-Emperor also finished sending this information over…
Very soon, other familiar Paragons and a considerable amount of powerful existences began transmitting the same news to him. After all, the emergence of a new Ruler… was a huge deal to the entire cosmos. It was bound to create a considerable disturbance. As the news gradually spread, many World Deities and even ordinary Deities started hearing about the same thing: a new Ruler had emerged in the Deity world—Pang Yi!
…
Half a year after Pang Yi became a Ruler, he took in a new disciple, and that disciple's name was none other than Hui Ming!
Indeed, he was Xue Ying's eldest disciple brother, Hui Ming.
A day after Hui Ming took on the role of Pang Yi's disciple, a considerable hullabaloo spread over the entire Deity world and Dark Abyss.
The reason for this was that Hui Ming actually transcended to become a powerful existence!
He, someone who had fervently spread his religion and caused countless karmic lines to entangle around him as a stage four World Deity, had actually transcended to become a powerful existence a single day after Pang Yi took him as a student! This matter stirred up countless rumors. Be they Rulers or World Deities, everyone was feeling dizzy.
He was someone who became a stage four World Deity by relying on absorbing belief energy, which should have meant it would be almost certain he could not transcend! But a single day after accepting Pang Yi as his teacher, Hui Ming broke through. Everyone could guess that this had to be related to the newly emerged Ruler, Pang Yi. In fact, even Pang Yi himself admitted that despite the countless karma threads entangling a person, someone who used his cultivation technique would be able to transcend.
As such—
The whole world was in a state of unbridled excitement. Large amounts of stage four World Deities hoped to become Pang Yi's disciples, and even some of the Rulers asked Pang Yi to help them. In fact, even the Bloodshed God Emperor himself had asked him, "Would it be possible for Xue Ying or Bamboo Mountain to break through by relying on this technique?"
"They have already opened their Dao paths, so there's nothing I can do to help them," Pang Yi answered directly.
Xue Ying himself was thinking of some way of giving his wife, Jing Qiu, the chance to join Pang Yi's sect.
There were too many experts wishing to seek his tutelage since everyone hoped to one day transcend just like Hui Ming.
After all, if it meant transcending, most stage four World Deities would not mind any price they'd have to pay, and Pang Yi himself was well aware of this.
"There is a chance for you to become my disciples. Come over and listen to three days of my teachings about the Dao. If you can comprehend them, you may stay. Otherwise, I must ask you to leave," Pang Yi had directly broadcasted these words. "However, I feel obligated to remind you all that Hui Ming was the only one to have succeeded in cultivating my technique so far."
The moment he broadcasted that he would be holding a public lecture on the Dao, a massive number of stage four World Deities, be they from the Deity world or the Dark Abyss, and even some of those secluded World Deities came rushing over. Even some of the weaker experts, such as stage three and stage two World Deities had arrived.
Paragons were not excluded from this meeting, and even the Rulers sent an avatar or True God avatar over.
Xue Ying himself had also sent a World Deity avatar over to listen to the lecture.
However, as soon as he heard the contents, Xue Ying immediately fell into a daze.
Pang Yi's cultivation technique required spreading one's religion and using the accumulated faith in cultivation, yet actually achieving success using this technique was truly difficult. During this meeting, despite so many World Deities being present, including even stage two and stage three World Deities, none succeeded! There were, after all, a significant number of people similar to Xue Ying in that they never even absorbed faith energy. For people like them, it was even more of an impossibility to succeed.
…
The wave created by Pang Yi's cultivation gradually spread, allowing everyone to once again confirm that transcending wasn't so easy.
One year after Pang Yi became a Ruler, the most ancient Ruler in the cosmos, the Primal Master, finally edited and released the newest revision of his Cosmos Deity-Demon List, and spread it out to every expert listed on it. Naturally, Xue Ying had also received a copy.

chapters.title: Chapter 665 - New Rankings
chapters.content:
Chapter 665: New Rankings
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying was sitting cross-legged on the same snowy mountain, just as before. A huge amount of snow had long since enveloped him, turning him into a literal snowman. However, Xue Ying did not seem to mind one bit. He was focused entirely on his progress with the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying," a familiar voice called him out; it was the Primal Master's voice. Xue Ying paused his cultivation.
At the same time, a copy of the Cosmos Deity-Demon List was passed over to him.
"Hong!" All of the accumulated snow was sent flying in every direction, and even the frost which had been forming all over his body was crushed to pieces. Finally, Xue Ying, who had been sitting cross-legged this whole time, stood up with a smile. 'The Primal Master actually placed me so high in the rankings. I thought I'd still be around the lowest ranks amongst Paragons. Seems like killing those two protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion gave me quite a push up the list.'
On the newly formed Cosmos Deity-Demon List…
The first rank remained with the Bloodshed God Emperor. Considering how unfathomable his power was, it would be unlikely for him to budge from this spot.
Second was the Abyss Primogenitor.
The Primal Master was third.
The positions of these three experts seemed to never change. Before Pang Yi's breakthrough, the other five Rulers all specialized in one specific aspect of cultivation, so the gap between them and these first three was quite evident during a real battle.
Fourth, Pang Yi.
Fifth, Purgatory Ruler.
Sixth, Temporal Island Lord.
Seventh, Myriad God Palace Head.
Eighth, Empress Qian He.
Ninth, Bloody Ruler.
Pang Yi, a new Ruler, had jumped all the way up to the fourth position in a single move, forcibly and directly suppressing the Temporal Island Lord and the rest of the five Rulers—he rushed all the way up to the top three rankers. It must be stated that whenever a new Ruler appeared, they would typically have to first consolidate their foundations, then gradually accumulate more power! However, Pang Yi had suppressed the Temporal Island Lord and the rest of his elders as soon as he broke through. It was easy to see just how this was.
The following rankings were reserved for Paragons.
10th, Monarch Green.
11th, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction.
12th, Monarch Hex Cricket.
13th, Water Devil King.
14th, White Sovereign King.
15th, Bitter Cultivator.
…
25th, Monarch Destruction.
…
33rd, Monarch Dong Bo.
…
65th, Hui Ming.
…
100th, Forefather Fierce Tyrant
There were a total of nine Rulers and 36 Paragons (including Bamboo Mountain and Xue Ying), which meant the lowest ranking Paragon held the 45th position!
'I am ranked 33rd, which means there are twelve Paragons behind me,' Xue Ying thought. He could not be considered an apex Paragon for the moment, only average! But most of those ordinary Paragons had already lived very, very long lives, some having lived far longer even than the Bloodshed God Emperor himself. They had countless experiences, opened many Daos, and comprehended all sorts of laws of profound mysteries. They had researched the vestiges of the previous cosmos epochs and understood all kinds of techniques.
It was accumulating power over such long periods of time that allowed these ordinary Paragons to become extraordinary. Most also held great treasures!
The Overlord of Destruction, for instance, was now but an ordinary Paragon, but he had once been the teacher of the Bloodshed God Emperor! It was quite likely that the Bloodshed God Emperor wished to repay him for that guidance he received. Just how many treasures would he have on him, when taking that into account? Even though he would normally be ranked towards the back amongst ordinary Paragons, he still held the 25th position.
Overall, Xue Ying was roughly smacked in the middle amongst ordinary Paragons!
And that was solely because his Dao of Mirage gave him such strong survival capabilities. However, despite having no real qualifications when it came to suppressing the other twelve ancient Paragons ranked behind him, being able to kill two protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion represented that he had some methods when it came to battle and slaughter. It was because of this information that he received such a high rank.
'Disciple Brother Hui Ming is quite formidable himself. He jumped all the way to the 65th position as soon as he broke through. Ruler Pang Yi's cultivation technique is indeed mystical,' Xue Ying inwardly praised.
******
Even though Xue Ying remained relatively calm and happy as he parsed the list, many of the experts across the Deity world and the Dark Abyss were exceptionally astonished at the sight of it. Hui Ming had transcended after formally accepting Pang Yi as his teacher, and was able to push himself all the way up to the 65th rank. The crowd was shocked, but they still felt that they could accept this. After all, the news of Pang Yi becoming a Ruler were already known by virtually everyone.
Until now, Hui Ming was the only one to successfully cultivate Pang Yi's technique, with the exception of the creator himself, of course.
Pang Yi took the fourth position amongst Rulers… and this too everyone felt was normal.
However!
"Dong Bo Xue Ying?" Many of the powerful existences and a few of the ordinary Paragons were dumbstruck.
The news of Xue Ying killing two protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion remained relatively secret, so there were very few who knew about the matter. Most powerful existences had never even heard of the Ancestor Mother Religion, and even many of the ordinary Paragons knew very little about them. As such, only the few apex Paragons and the Rulers knew about Xue Ying's achievement of killing the two protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion. However, this meant that most powerful existences still saw Xue Ying as just an unusually powerful stage four World Deity.
Even though he had once suppressed Bamboo Saint using his pure strength, there had been quite a few similarly talented stage four World Deities in the history of the Deity world.
However—
The Cosmos Deity-Demon List had actually placed Xue Ying amongst the ranks of Paragons, and right in the middle of them at that. His combat power was enough to place him above twelve other Paragons, which was simply incredible. Since the start of this cosmos epoch, the same thing had only happened once, in the case of the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master.
"33rd?"
"Dong Bo Xue Ying is ranked 33rd? This… how could such a thing be true?"
"This list can't be wrong; it was made by the rumored Primal Master after all. There's no way someone like the Primal Master would make such a grave mistake. Unless might it be true that Dong Bo Xue Ying opened a Dao just like the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master once did?"
The only ones who obtained the list were the top hundred rankers.
The horizons of such people were much broader, unlike those stage four World Deities who thought the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master had managed to live so long because of his absolute art. Those ranked in the top hundred were all aware that the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master had opened a Dao as a stage four World Deity, and cultivated it to an extremely high realm. This was the reason he could stand at the very top even amongst Paragons. And now, it seemed that another existence like him had appeared in this cosmos.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying has opened a Dao? Is this information correct?"
"How long has he even cultivated for? It's just a million years or so, right?"
"Old Brother Huo Cheng, has Monarch Dong Bo truly opened his Dao?"
Many of the powerful existences across the entire Deity world and Abyss were in fervently discussing this new version of the Cosmos Deity-Demon List. Even some of the weaker experts who never made it on the list received this news from their good friends! After all, such information was utterly shocking. In but a moment, it seemed like the news had already spread across the whole world. The Paragons and even many of the powerful existences were already aware of this matter.
Many of Xue Ying's acquaintances congratulated him on this matter.
"Monarch Dong Bo, congratulations on opening a Dao as a stage four World Deity. You are the second one in this cosmos."
"What is there to congratulate me on? I can't even transcend anymore."
"Monarch Dong Bo, you've opened a Dao in just a million years. I simply can't believe something like transcending would be difficult for you."
Many were transmitting messages to and fro, and Xue Ying was busy with replying to everyone.
…
Just as the latest Cosmos Deity-Demon List was released and the various powerful existences were still in the middle of discussing this matter, a rumor began to spread.
"Now that Pang Yi is a Ruler, one of the spots for the Bloodshed God Palace's ancestors has been freed. I think the new group of ancestors should be the Overlord of Destruction, the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, and Monarch Dong Bo."
Speculation about who the three ancestors would be after this event was naturally spreading.
Those at the very pinnacle, like Monarch Green, Paragon Huo Cheng, Monarch Hex Cricket, the Water Devil King and others like them had no reason to doubt any of it, since they already knew that Xue Ying was able to kill two protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion! His battle records alone were sufficient to grant him a position as one of the Bloodshed God Emperor's ancestors.
However, the weaker Paragons and ordinary powerful existences were still muttering amongst themselves: "The Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master is an apex Paragon, and Pang Yi was able to compete against Rulers while not even being a Ruler himself. Even the weakest of the three, the Overlord of Destruction, accumulated enough of a foundation to land the 25th spot. But now that Pang Yi has become a Ruler should Dong Bo Xue Ying really receive a position as an ancestor? He is only 33rd on the list… making him the weakest of the three."
A few people were feeling somewhat apprehensive since Xue Ying's weakness might pull down the status of the three ancestors as a whole.
Many of them knew that Xue Ying had already become a Paragon so he could meet the qualifications for holding that position.
However—
Any news regarding the three ancestors was closely followed by many of the stage four World Deities, and even the weaker World Deities across the world. It was because many of the weaker cultivators held some hope of becoming disciples of one the three ancestors! Now that Pang Yi had become a Ruler, would the newly opened position be taken by Xue Ying?
"Dong Bo Xue Ying?"
"Will he truly become an ancestor as a stage four World Deity?"
"Who's been spreading such rumors? What a joke. How long has he even cultivated for? Can such a person really be qualified to become one of three ancestors?"

chapters.title: Chapter 666 - Eight Million Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 666: Eight Million Years
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Luna
Editors: Hafoza
Eight Million Years
Most World Deities were naturally respectful towards Xue Ying, but they still couldn't help but arrive at certain conclusions in their hearts. To them, Xue Ying was a heaven-shattering stage four World Deity, much stronger than even some of the powerful existences. Was that enough to allow him to become an ancestor, though? They couldn't help but feel that Xue Ying lacked a foundation as well as the necessary qualifications.
Just like ordinary civilians discussing great generals or the emperor…
Clearly, these World Deities felt that Xue Ying was not worth to join the ranks of the three ancestors. Putting him on such a pedestal would only humiliate the great status which they held in their hearts regarding these figures.
But despite them being inwardly unconvinced, they would still be careful whenever they talked about this matter in public.
…
On the Temporal Island, three powerful existences were currently discussing matters.
As they chatted on and on, they eventually reached the topic of Xue Ying.
"Black Devil, Dong Bo Xue Ying has already opened his Dao. Are you feeling flustered? Afraid?" a lion-headed man teased as he laughed out loud.
By the side, Forefather Black Devil had been enjoying a cup of wine when he squinted his eyes and chuckled. "Afraid, you ask? Of course, I'm afraid. It's the only reason I'm holed up in the Temporal Island, not daring to take even a step outside. My luck truly is rotten—I've merely killed that Sacred Master Crimson Dust guy, yet he somehow managed to groom two disciples like Hui Ming and Dong Bo Xue Ying. Both are becoming so formidable."
"Indeed, Crimson Dust's disciples are becoming really formidable. One accepted Pang Yi as his teacher, whose cultivation technique is truly mysterious. Remember, Black Devil: you might be hiding, but you still have to be really careful, or you might just end up dead either way. There might even be no traces left behind by such an attack. Dong Bo Xue Ying is clearly the more formidable of the two, having managed to open up his Dao within a million years, and he'll only become even more amazing with time." Another man, whose face was adorned by violet patterns, sneered. "Black Devil, I have to admire your luck."
Forefather Black Devil let out a laugh but did not reply.
"What about those rumors that have been spreading regarding how the new three ancestors of the Bloodshed God Palace will be the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, the Overlord of Destruction, and Dong Bo Xue Ying?" The lion-headed man smashed his wine cup against the table. "So many of them are placing Dong Bo Xue Ying on such a high pedestal, even though it's already been determined by the Cosmos Deity-Demon List that he's much weaker than either of the two."
"We still can't underestimate him."
Forefather Black Devil chuckled before lowering his voice. "Since he's opened his Dao within a million years, he might just become a Ruler!"
"Become a Ruler?" The other two turned towards Forefather Black Devil. "Black Devil, you're doomed if that happens."
"What can I do about it?" Forefather Black Devil chuckled helplessly. There was a trace of calmness in his helpless laughter.
******
The rumors about Xue Ying becoming one of the three ancestors were generally accepted by the upper echelon, while the countless weaker, ordinary World Deities felt that Xue Ying's combat power was lacking and that he did not qualify for the position! Since their combat power was weak, they experienced too little, so it was only natural that they would fall into a pitfall when making their judgments.
…
Xue Ying completely disregarded all of these matters. He had opened his Dao in a million years and fought with the Ancestor Mother Religion, and he had also visited the Starting Ground, allowing him to witness that strongest World Deity, as well as the black dog which could even injure the Lake Heart Island master. This experience allowed Xue Ying to understand that his little realm was truly too shallow. He wished to step upon even greater heights, and stand higher amidst the stars.
He also wanted to become a Ruler and transcend. For the moment, this was his singular goal. He wished to become more formidable, like the Lake Heart Island master and the Ancestor Devil, or perhaps even to reach the realm of that forefather who constructed the Starting Ground.
As such, these discussions going about in the outer world were of no significance to him.
"Hu hu~"
The cold wind was whistling.
Within the Icy Snow Eden, time did not seem to leave behind any scars. The eternal cold wind, the forever falling snow, and even Xue Ying who was engrossed in his meditation here.
In what felt like the blink of an eye, more than eight million years passed.
These eight million years might be considered a very long time to someone like Xue Ying since he had only cultivated for a total of a million years prior to entering the Icy Snow Eden, but to most of the powerful existences across the vast cosmos, these eight million years were fleeting! As for experts like the Bloodshed God-Emperor and the Primal Master, they only measured their cultivation in terms of billions of years.
Within these eight million years, a 'fleeting' moment, not much change came across the Deity world and the Dark Abyss. Naturally, countless mortals and Transcendents were replaced by the following generations and the ones after. The Dong Bo clan was now spreading across the entire world, and Xue Ying was turning into more and more of a legend.
On top of a mountain peak, a figure was standing there, with their hands crossed.
It was Xue Ying, looking at the vast snowy plains. Despite his apparent lack of focus, the spirit in his eyes was as sharp as a blade. It must be stated that the Time Boundary of the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique required him to hold onto himself for an incomparably long period of time. Refining himself time after time within the Time Boundary while gradually increasing his understanding towards the profound mysteries of the laws, Xue Ying was essentially training his inner heart and sharpen it like a blade.
"Hu." The surface of Xue Ying's body emitted an invisible wave.
"Hong long long~"
A black fog began spreading out rapidly, covering more than a hundred million kilometers in a flash…
The surrounding world turned pitch-black as the fog was rolling over, circulating with Xue Ying as its center. This appearance gave him the sense of being a terrifying Demonic God with control over all darkness.
"Si la!"
A stream of light flashed through the black fog which covered an area that was more than fifty billion kilometers wide.
Followed by this flash, the fog was torn apart like paper! This sort of extremity which could spread out then condense into explosive might have even left Paragons feeling jittery.
'It's been eight million years, and I have yet to succeed in cultivating the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique. I have, however, succeeded in opening the Dao of Slaughter.' Xue Ying chuckled lightly. With a thought, countless flashes of light cut across a region of 500 billion kilometers surrounding him, cutting it into pieces chaotically, before eventually turning everything into nothingness. The world then regained its usual calm, and the snowflakes started falling down once more.
'The Dao of Slaughter.'
Xue Ying lightly nodded. 'The Time Boundary is partially to thank for this.'
The Time Boundary would either force him to immerse himself, or it would be like a blade which helped him cut apart all obstacles. As his heart became more tangible and he comprehended more of the Dao of Slaughter, he eventually completed it with the added help of the three True God weapons.
'Now that I have the Dao of Slaughter, my weakness when it comes to offense is finally covered,' Xue Ying thought. Throughout his past, he had been forced to rely on the Eternal Dao of Slaughter inherent to the Blood Serpent Spear. Only by depending on the True God weapon itself as well as the Blood Serpent Venom in addition to his own physical strength could he hope to hold on. 'Now that I've grasped the Dao of Slaughter, both the Blood Serpent Spear and the Flying Knife should be much stronger assets.'
The Dao of Slaughter was entirely different from the Dao of Mirage.
Its existence was solely for the sake of killing.
Xue Ying comprehended the aspect of Extreme Condensation, which allowed him to condense all of his power into a single point. This single point was akin to the eruption of light, and it could cut through everything in its path. Everything it reached would be cut and destroyed. It was truly clean and concise! This was the only technique he gained, yet its offensive power was so powerful to more than make up for that.
'Two Daos.' Xue Ying revealed a grin. These two Daos would be the source of countless benefits.
First of all, these two Daos aided each other. He could use the Dao of Mirage to step into another world and easily assassinate people, putting his techniques to good use! He could also easily escape whenever it was called for.
The second point was the benefit it brought to his cultivation. With two Daos, he had two paths he could walk towards becoming a Ruler, therefore significantly increasing his chances of success.
The reason why Xue Ying had focused entirely on comprehending the Dao of Slaughter, other than seeking a technique that offensively oriented, was the following: as a young man, he had also comprehended the True Meaning of Extreme Piercing which he used as his killing technique; he had desired a similar thing all this time. Whenever he cultivated, he would always seek certain aspects. Naturally, the three True God weapons were also of great help when it came to his comprehension of the Dao of Slaughter. As a result, he continued researching this aspect until he finally succeeded.
Having grasped two Daos, Xue Ying finally had the courage to fight even apex Paragons. After all, among apex Paragons, there were still some who only had one Dao. Naturally, these people would have reached a very high level in these Daos, and might become eternal once they improved a bit more. However, that gap was like the distance to the heavens, which was extremely hard to cross.
'Compared to those apex Paragons, I am much more balanced. Naturally, I still wouldn't be a match to the likes of Disciple Brother Monarch Green, though.' Xue Ying was very clear that Monarch Green had already fused three Daos and trained them to the very limit; such a being could even contend with Rulers.

chapters.title: Chapter 667 - Third Boundary of the Cultivating Heart
chapters.content:
Chapter 667: Third Boundary of the Cultivating Heart
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
'It's been a long time since I last tried cultivating the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique. Now that I've opened up the Dao of Slaughter, I should give it another go,' Xue Ying thought. Because every attempt at reaching the Time Boundary of the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique took a few thousand years, it would affect his heart realm. As such, he usually separated each training session by a period of time. However, over eight million years, he truly attempted it far too many times.
Now that he succeeded in opening the Dao of Slaughter, Xue Ying was once more filled with fighting spirit, and he immediately gave it another try after sitting down.
Snowflakes began falling on his body, to the point where his entire figure seemed to have frozen solid. Gradually, Xue Ying turned into a literal snowman.
The Time Boundary involved living life after life without getting to choose his roles. Instead, he would simply become the protagonist of another person's life.
Some of these lives were filled with darkness and madness, others with freedom and ease, cunning and savageness, or even tyranny and domination… Xue Ying had never experienced so many unfathomable matters during his life as a cultivator so far, yet he now could do so within the Time Boundary! One of his incarnations actually had quite a similar temperament to his own! Such a distortive feeling was time and time again influencing Xue Ying's spirit.
Even Paragons would have a very hard time trying to stabilize their heart realm in the Time Boundary.
'The ninth life…' Xue Ying began experiencing a ninth life in the body of yet another person. Never before had he managed to enter a ninth life prior to this.
The ninth role was a simple and honest one. Before he turned twenty-five, he lived the life of an ordinary mortal who had only been to big cities a few times, but as soon as he reached his 25th birthday, he awakened the World Deity bloodline in him to directly become a Transcendent. Throughout his past, he had simply not experienced enough, and as soon as he became a Transcendent and organizations from everywhere began roping him in, he eventually became intoxicated with several women, sure that each and every one of them was his true love. Over time, however, he was exploited by them time and time again and eventually even imprisoned by a Demigod mage who treated him as an experimental subject.
Only when he found himself in prison did he gain a real understanding of his plight, yet he did not dare believe that the three women he loved most had been deceiving him all that time. The experiments conducted by the mage involved torture, and it was during this process that a different experimental subject locked in the same prison—an incomparably ugly woman—begun conversing with him. Always separated by a wall, he unknowingly became fond of this ugly woman.
He felt that she was the only person in his life who was true to him.
Finally, during an experiment one day, the woman died.
He felt suffocated, mad.
Thunder boomed in the sky that day and a region of 5,000 kilometers wide surrounding that place turned to ruins. The Demigod mage imprisoning him had died instantly in the calamity.
From then on, he lived his life as a madman, his behavior perverse. He was also very powerful, and could even match Deities as a mere Transcendent. In the end, his combat power began growing continuously with no end in sight—Deity, stage one World Deity, stage two… all while acting like a madman. At times, he would fall madly in love with some mortal woman, at other times he would scheme against his enemies and play them to death, and sometimes he would just violently murder anyone who stood in his path…
His character was filled with all kinds of variations.
After becoming a stage four World Deity and then transcended to become a powerful existence, he brought the woman back to life. A period of calm followed, and the woman ended up becoming an ordinary Deity, before dying once her lifespan dried up, followed by the crumbling of her True Deity Heart. He became even more perverse after that point, opening up the Dao of Punishment Thunder, first becoming a Paragon, then even a Ruler.
This life lasted a total of fifty billion years.
During this life, Xue Ying's mood would change according to the weird temper of the protagonist. He soon noticed himself slowly turning into a madman, but he still managed to resist these changes. During these final fifty billion years of his life, the life of a powerful existence, a Paragon, and even a Ruler, Xue Ying managed to achieve an even deeper refinement of his heart realm.
"Hong."
The Time Boundary ended, but this time, it was an ordinary conclusion—the conclusion of his training.
The thick snowman who had remained seated on the mountain peak for so long began to gradually move. Snow started falling off, revealing a layer of ice underneath. Soon, cracks began appearing on this ice, followed by sounds of 'pa pa', and finally, Xue Ying, who had been sitting cross-legged encased by the ice, began opening his eyes. There was a power within them which could chill anyone who saw him. Space itself ahead of him was penetrated and showed signs of cracking.
'Is this the result of cultivating my heart to a deeper level?' Xue Ying muttered to himself. At the same time, he was investigating his True Deity Heart.
Within his consciousness, the child-sized Xue Ying was still sitting cross-legged. He had the appearance of colored glass, albeit with a very bright pair of eyes—so bright that people would not be able to look directly into them. Sharp edges had begun appearing all over this True Deity Heart.
In the past, his True Deity Heart had always been rather ordinary, but now it was just like the blade of a sword. The willpower of his soul could actually exude a tangible sharpness.
'So this is the result of succeeding in cultivating the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique?' Xue Ying stood up. 'I have now succeeded in all three secret techniques. Time to pay the Cultivating Heart Palace a visit.'
"Sou!"
He immediately charged up into the sky, and his body turned illusory soon afterward. "Sou, sou, sou." He began moving towards his destination by means of teleportation.
…
Using the Three Devil Palaces command token, Xue Ying entered the Cultivating Heart Palace once again. This was the same palace hall covered in snow as before.
Within the ancient palace hall, the white-haired old man appeared once again. He looked up towards Xue Ying, his eyes squinted. "You're back. Have you succeeded?"
"I have." Xue Ying nodded.
"Let me witness your willpower, then," said the old man.
Xue Ying's eyes let out an unseen strength which swept across the area ahead of him. It blasted out on the walls of the palace hall, causing them to tremble violently. This was the Cultivating Heart Palace, a region left behind by the Ancestor Devil; to have caused the walls of such a place to tremble, it was easy to see how powerful he was. Many powerful existences could only do so by using their entire strength.
"Heart as a blade. You have indeed succeeded. A stage four World Deity opening their Dao is no easy task, but for you to have succeeded in the Cultivating Heart Secret Technique…" The white-haired old man was slightly stunned. "And you're even a soldier of the Destruction Legion on top of that."
"Heart as a blade?" Xue Ying felt puzzled.
"The cultivation of heart is split into three boundaries as follows: heart like colored glass, heart as a blade, and heart of the world," the old man explained directly.
Xue Ying instantly memorized these words.
Heart like colored glass, heart as a blade, and heart of the world?
"What of the third boundary, the one you call the heart of the world?" Xue Ying could not help but ask.
"Hmph, there's no reason to even consider it. Throughout the many cosmos epochs so far, not many Rulers have ever reached this realm. From my understanding, only the Lake Heart Island Master and the Ancestor Devil have ever reached this realm, one after the other. When the heart's cultivation reaches this level, one could easily kill Rulers with their willpower alone," the old man explained. "But it is too difficult. Across the many cosmos epochs, there have actually been quite a few Rulers who walked that final step, but only two have ever reached the third boundary of the heart realm. As such, brat from the Destruction Legion, you should become a Ruler before it's even worth mentioning. Don't think too far ahead."
"Killing Rulers using one's willpower alone?" Xue Ying was speechless.
It was easy to see by just how much both the Lake Heart Island Master and the Ancestor Devil surpassed all others across the many epochs.
"You've succeeded in all three of the secret techniques, and you shall thus receive the inheritance left behind by the Ancestor Devil." The old man waved his hand, causing an enormous bubble to appear. Taking a step, he entered the bubble and said, "Follow me."
Xue Ying obediently entered.
"Hua."
The bubble burst apart, and the two of them shattered alongside it, being directly teleported through the void.
Soon, space itself began to shift. There was a single, small region of land amidst the primal chaos, and the whole area contained only one structure—a pagoda!
Xue Ying and the old man appeared right at the entrance to this pagoda.
"Follow me inside," the white-haired old man said, entering the pagoda as Xue Ying followed closely behind.

chapters.title: Chapter 668 - Inside the Ancient Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 668: Inside the Ancient Pagoda
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying looked upwards. The pagoda was about 39 meters tall, it seemed ancient and simple, and did not show any special characteristics; it was ordinary by every definition of the word.
Going up the stairs, he went inside along with the old man.
The pagoda seemed completely empty, with the sole exception of a pure, sparkling and translucent, thumb-sized stone made of green crystal floating in mid-air. The drizzle of light it emitted brightened up the entire pagoda, causing Xue Ying to quieten down without even realizing it.
"This is…?" Xue Ying soon discovered countless words that were transforming within the drizzle of light emitted by the stone.
"Since you've passed the trials of the Three Devil Palaces, you are permitted to receive the inheritance left behind by the Ancestor Devil—the first scroll of the "Myriad Devil True Body". Every person to have ever passed the trials is to get this scroll. Another part of the inheritance is the right to get a single treasure, but the nature of it will depend solely on your luck. Just grab any single item left behind by the Ancestor Devil within this treasury, and you will be allowed to keep it." The white-robed old man chuckled. "If your luck is any good, you might even get an Ancient Demon to act as your servant."
"Ancient Demon?" Xue Ying's eyes brightened.
"The weakest of them is at the Ruler realm." The old man was deliberately enticing Xue Ying. "Naturally, never has there been a person who came inside this pagoda and left with an Ancient Demon."
Xue Ying pursed his lips.
Clearly, the probability of getting something heaven-shattering was extremely low.
"This is the initial scroll of the Myriad Devil True Body. Hurry up and take a look." The old man pointed towards the words that were transforming inside the drizzle of green light. "The "Myriad Devil True Body" is the strongest absolute art used by the Ancestor Devil, and this initial scroll is the most important one since it allows you to build up your fundamentals. To someone on the level of the Ancestor Devil, such a slight increase in strength isn't even worth mentioning, but many Paragons deeply desire it. You must understand, the Ancestor Devil has relied precisely on this"Myriad Devil True Body"to leave even the Lake Heart Island Master unable to deal with him."
Xue Ying began trying his best to memorize the written words as soon as he calmed himself down.
He was clear of the value of this Myriad Devil True Body.
What was the reason so many sought the opportunities of the Three Devil Palaces?
Indeed, it was all because of this absolute art.
While the "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" was a standardized absolute art the Lake Heart Island master created for the sake of his legion, as well as a simplified version for soldiers…
The "Myriad Devil True Body" was created by the Ancestor Devil for his own use and was the most significant success he achieved over an extended period of time. Not even the Lake Heart Island Master could match him in terms of this aspect. The Ancestor Devil had even used the ideology behind this absolute art to refine many of those powerful Ancient Demons.
This might just be the initial scroll, but it was still something many Paragons could only dream of obtaining.
'Truly enigmatic.' Xue Ying was memorizing the countless words within the green light. They were continuously transforming, and the more Xue Ying memorized of them, the better he understood some of the meaning inherent within. It must be stated that the three fundamental secret techniques were all part of this initial scroll. Having already cultivated the three fundamental secret techniques, he would naturally have a better comprehension of this initial scroll even on first viewing.
Xue Ying looked through the scroll for close to an hour, then he instantly understood.
As soon as he gained a complete comprehension of those words, Xue Ying understood that these words were only meant as a form of guidance. Only after understanding the fundamental qualities of the initial scroll could it be said that he had learned its contents. Otherwise, there would be no point in looking at any more of these endless words.
"Have you learned it?" asked the white-haired old man. "Since you've successfully cultivated the three secret techniques, comprehending this initial scroll should pose no challenge to you."
Xue Ying nodded.
"It seems there'll be a need to depend on external materials if I hope to succeed in cultivating this initial scroll," Xue Ying mentioned.
"It will be up to you to collect these materials. In truth, there is no real need to depend on external materials, if you don't mind spending a bit more time in your cultivation," explained the old man.
Xue Ying curled his lips. To cultivate it independently? He had just learned the contents of this initial scroll and was very clear that if he were to rely only on World Deity energy to transform his body, he might not finish even after ten billion years. Even if he spent all his time under the hundred times accelerated environment of his cultivation Eden, it would still be a full hundred million years in the outside world.
This was simply too long a time, and Xue Ying could not accept it; he was simply not willing to spend so much time cultivating a single absolute art.
Using external materials was so much faster a method. In fact, he could succeed in as short a time as ten thousand years.
"Come." The white-robed old man pointed to the wall next to him, and a hole opened up in it. "Place your hand inside. Remember, you receive what you grab, and it all comes down to luck."
"Alright." Xue Ying was speechless at the thought that the Ancestor Devil would create such an arrangement.
Regardless of his thoughts, he could only walk on and extend his hand into the hole.
It seemed to be empty within as if there was actually nothing there! Xue Ying waved his hand, trying to grab onto something when he suddenly caught onto an item.
An invisible strength then pushed Xue Ying out. The hole them mended and faded away.
"What is this?" Xue Ying looked in his hand. The item he had barely grabbed was a black piece of paper. It was soft to the touch, and as soon as he focused on it, information began entering his mind. Closely afterward, the paper turned into dust alongside a 'hua' sound.
"This is…" Xue Ying felt puzzled.
The information that entered his mind was a huge star map.
It had the Sun Star, the Moon Star, and the Dark Abyss on it, as well as countless planets. Even the Lake Heart Island and the Six Heavenly Wheel seemed to have been written down.
He could accurately ascertain his own position on the map.
'Isn't this just our own cosmos' star map?' Xue Ying felt speechless. One must know that every cosmos epoch would eventually culminate in a Great Apocalypse. Could the thing that was accurately plotted in the past on the star map be used by him during this eighth cosmos epoch?
'Fortunately, the Moon Star, the Sun Star, the Lake Heart Island, and the Six Heavenly Wheel remained stable and unperturbed,' Xue Ying thought. 'If I consider their positions, I should be able to get an accurate read of the location marked on this map.'
"A piece of paper?" the white-robed old man mused after seeing this item. "Your fortune is indeed unique. I wonder if it will prove good or bad. Alright, time for you to leave."
"Hu."
A bubble appeared and enveloped Xue Ying. 'Pa.' The bubble then burst, sending Xue Ying away.
…
Icy Snow Eden.
Xue Ying was gazing at the countless falling snowflakes as he sent a transmission through karma: "Monarch Hex Cricket, I'm ready to leave the Six Heavenly Wheel."
"EIght million years. Considering how long you'd cultivated for before this, even I was startled to see you stay for so long," Monarch Hex Cricket replied.
Xue Ying chuckled.
He had not planned on staying that long at first, but the opportunity of the Three Devil Palaces led to him prolonging his stay here for such a long while. Now that he succeeded in all three secret techniques, it was only natural for him to leave.
"I won't be bothering you any longer, then. If you have anything you need my help with, you can find me anytime," Xue Ying said. Any lifeform could only enter this place as many as three times, but if any matter appeared that was related to the Ancestor Mother Religion, he was willing to enter the Six Heavenly Wheel again.
"If there seems to be a problem of lacking manpower, I'll definitely be asking you to come over as well." Monarch Hex Cricket laughed.
After the two bid their farewells, Xue Ying rapidly entered the Mirage World and teleported away, heading towards the exit.
Every single Eden within the Six Heavenly Wheel contained an exit situated deep within a maelstrom in the ground. If one said that the maelstrom in the sky led him to another Eden, then the one on the ground would always lead outside.
"Hu." Xue Ying rushed towards the dark maelstrom situated on the ground.
He soon appeared once again, only this time he was outside the Six Heavenly Wheel.
Seeing the enormous, six-colored wheels revolving slowly, Xue Ying chuckled. He then tore open a tunnel in spacetime and left the area.
…
He was in no rush to visit the accurate location marked on the star map he got from the ancient pagoda, knowing that fortune and disaster were always intertwined! If he hoped to face any place left behind by someone like the Ancestor Devil, he would have to prepare himself very well beforehand. He would wait until he succeeded in cultivating the initial scroll of the"Myriad Devil True Body", followed by consolidating his Dao of Slaughter and arranging all his matters in the Deity world, before finally going on another adventure. It would not be too late by then.
After all, those places had been around for a few cosmos epochs, and would certainly remain there for quite a lot more time.
"Hu."
Leaving the end of the Dark Abyss, the Six Heavenly Wheel, Xue Ying soon arrived back at the Black Fog Sea.
"I've returned." Standing in the sky, looking down at his immense mansion, Xue Ying couldn't help but let out a grin. He had truly been gone for too long this time round.

chapters.title: Chapter 669 - Returning Home
chapters.content:
Chapter 669: Returning Home
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Black Fog Sea.
Many long narrow tables seemed to be placed without order all along the garden, yet they actually followed the profound mysteries of the laws, albeit just vaguely. Xue Ying, Jing Qiu, Qing Yao, Mo Yang Yu and Dong Bo Lie, Uncle Zong as well as Chi Qiu Bai and his wife, Dong Bo Yu, and his wife, Qing Yao… and some of the most outstanding descendants from the Dong Bo Clan, as well as old friends from the Xia Clan like Chao Qing, Mountain Lord He, Si Kong Yang and the rest—everyone could be found here.
"Father," Qing Yao greeted. "Even though I saw you around in the Crimson Rock Mountain World, it's been eight million years since I last met you here, in the Black Fog Sea. Father, how can you bear it?"
Xue Ying let out a laugh full of joy. "We met quite often in the Crimson Rock Mountain World, so why talk about me like this?"
"Xue Ying, you've indeed disappeared for too long this time around." Chi Qiu Bai laughed as well. He was a stage three World Deity as of present. With the exception of Xue Ying and Jing Qiu, he was the strongest person to have originated from the Xia Clan world. Furthermore, Jing Qiu had actually reincarnated, so her length of cultivation truthfully far surpassed Chi Qiu Bai's.
"This might be your Monarch Residence, but you're never around," even Mo Yang Yu, Xue Ying's mother, chided him. "Your father and I have come to visit you at the Black Fog Sea so many times, but we never got to see you."
"It's my bad, my bad." Xue Ying relented.
In front of his mother, he naturally would acknowledge his mistake.
To powerful existences and World Deities, eight million years seemed fleeting, but to this group of Xia clansmen, eight million years was indeed too long! As such, hearing that Xue Ying had returned, everyone came rushing over to meet him. Even the Dong Bo couple who had been roaming all around the world rushed back to meet their son. Xue Ying's little brother, Qing Shi, also rushed over. It was, indeed, a rarely seen reunion of the clan.
The people were all here, chatting with one another.
Even though Xue Ying's current status was high, the relationship between everyone here was anything but ordinary. He and Chao Qing, Mountain Lord He, and all of the others once had their fates entwined, and went through a life-or-death crisis together.
As such, this reunion greatly delighted Xue Ying.
After this brief gathering, the clansmen left to various places to rest, leaving behind some smaller groups of people who met among themselves.
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu were also strolling about their residence.
"Xue Ying, I thought you might not return until after the Myriad Flower Feast." Jing Qiu giggled.
"The Myriad Flower Feast?" Xue Ying was momentarily startled.
"Have you forgotten? His Majesty, the Bloodshed God Emperor, organizes a Myriad Flower Feast once every ten million years," Jing Qiu replied. "The next Myriad Flower Feast should be starting quite soon."
Xue Ying nodded. A feeling of nostalgia overtook him as he reminisced of the time he participated in the Myriad Flower Feast after leaving the Xia Clan world. Back then, his Elder Brother White Sand protected him from the Venomous Ying World Deity, while he sought to make a name for himself, only to become a disciple under the Bloodshed God Emperor himself. At the time, he had grasped hold of a single grade one Deity Heart, the World Deity Heart, yet for the sake of preventing Forefather Black Devil from trying to off him, he did not dare reveal this secret.
And now, in what felt like the blink of an eye, he had already opened two Daos. He didn't even have to care for most powerful existences, and even the Rulers, whom back then seemed so very high up, no longer felt untouchable. As long as he making progress along these two Daos, he might be able to achieve eternity in either of them and become a Ruler!
"The new Myriad Flower Feast…" Xue Ying muttered.
"I'll have to participate in it. Of course, you, the disciple of Bloodshed God Emperor, have an even greater responsibility of participating," Jing Qiu said. "Some of the descendants from our Dong Bo Clan have long since readied themselves, and will be staking it all during this Myriad Flower Feast."
"Oh? Are there any outstanding brats who might be qualified to join the sect of a powerful existence?" Xue Ying laughed as he asked.
Jing Qiu shook her head. "Even though the Dong Bo Clan provided them with the chance to learn World Deity ranked secret techniques, as well as giving them proper guidance, there might at most be some who get through the Starfield Selections. As for ones whom you might consider outstanding? There just aren't any…"
Xue Ying nodded. "The Myriad Flower Feast… Not too long ago I was the one to participate in the battles of the Myriad Flower Feast, yet now the roles are already reversed. This time, I'll be the one watching those little descendants fight one another."
…
After returning to the Black Fog Sea, Xue Ying used the Bloodshed Tavern's ability, activating his network of friends to help him collect the required materials required for training in the initial scroll of the"Myriad Devil True Body". He had killed two protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion, which brought him vast riches, which meant he more than had the foundation necessary to dare collect these treasures. After all, he was bound to bring out treasures or items of equivalent value when making trades with powerful existences. He would ensure nobody suffered any losses if they brought out one of the materials he needed.
Many of the materials he could only obtain because of his reputation! Otherwise, regardless of price, the other parties might simply refuse to make the exchange!
During his time organizing people to trade for these materials, Xue Ying spent most of his time consolidating the Dao of Slaughter which he had just opened. All of his concentration was focused on this single point.
In the blink of an eye, another thirty thousand years passed.
The Bloodshed Tavern succeeded in collecting more than half of the more commonly seen materials he needed. He then depended on his many friends to finish collecting the rest before long.
There were even two apex Paragons who took the initiative to help him—Monarch Green and the Bitter Cultivator respectively.
"Monarch Dong Bo, judging from the materials you seek, it would appear that you've also obtained the initial scroll of the Myriad Devil True Body?" the Bitter Cultivator sent a message through karma from all the way in the Dark Abyss. This was the first time the two ever conversed, and Xue Ying understood that this person possessed great strength, seeing how he was ranked 15th on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List. He had also once passed the trials of the Three Devil Palaces.
"Disciple Brother Dong Bo, congratulations. Passing the trials of the Three Devil Palaces is no easy task. I've suffered from some serious setbacks back when I attempted them," Monarch Green messaged him too.
Xue Ying immediately understood that his Elder Disciple Brother Monarch Green had also once succeeded in these trails.
According to the words of the white-haired old man, there were indeed too few people in this cosmos epoch who passed the trials.
…
Within the Monarch Residence.
Inside the underground palace, Xue Ying dug out a pit for a special occasion and filled it with a pitch-black liquid. As he stood by the side, a jade bottle appeared in his hands. He poured its contents directly into the liquid below, leaving large amounts of silvery dust to flow into the pool. As soon as it touched the surface of the liquid, it got completely dissolved in it. After the time it took to brew a cup of tea, the silvery grit was finally all poured into the pool.
Xue Ying then followed up with a gourd of a black, bloody liquid, then with golden, glowing leaves. There were also a few other ingredients already ground into a powder.
All sorts of different precious materials were thrown into the pool. It took an entire half-hour just to finish mixing everything together—he did not afford to mess up the procedure. During this process, the deep pool of liquid began changing in color.
'Almost there.' Xue Ying looked towards the pool and watched as the liquid within turned crimson. It was now also continuously swishing about and emitting a blazing aura. 'These materials add up to the value of an ordinary True God weapon. I was fortunate to have earned so much off of killing those two protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion, or I might have been forced to think until my head hurts of a way to obtain everything off of others.'
There was no way he could ask for materials while empty-handed.
'The initial scroll of the Myriad Devil True Body… I wonder how much my body will evolve once I'm done cultivating it.' Xue Ying already began looking forward to it. He took a step forward, entering the pool of crimson liquid, and as he did so, the liquid swamped all the way up to his chest. The very next moment, all his clothing disappeared.
Xue Ying enlarged his body, allowing him to sit cross-legged in the pit. At this point, he finally started cultivating the initial scroll of the"Myriad Devil True Body". Only with the aid of these materials could he hope to 'move a thousand miles in but a day'.

chapters.title: Chapter 670 - Success
chapters.content:
Chapter 670: Success
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The glowing, dark-red liquid was incomparably hot, no less so than the surface of the Sun Star. Of course, Xue Ying was able to completely disregard it.
"Ka ka ka~"
Xue Ying's body was emitting crackling sounds as his very firm and tough bones were being shattered to pieces. Considering his current heart realm—the heart as a blade—granted him such powerful willpower, he was able to forcibly control the strength of the crimson liquid and only allow it to carefully enter his body. This required an even more delicate control as that power began entering his bones since every single one of those shattered pieces would have to be controlled as to permeate into a very minute location.
The primary objective of this initial scroll of "Myriad Devil True Body" was that of transforming one's blood alongside their bones!
His entire physique and blood would be completely transformed, bringing about a qualitative evolution. The physique and blood would could then naturally nourish his organs, his muscles, and his skin. According to the Ancestor Devil, the most essential part of one's fleshy body would be their bones and their blood. As such, two of the three fundamental secret techniques were selected to be the Eroding Bone Secret Technique and the Dissolving Blood Secret Technique. Yet without the unfathomable control he possessed, it would be impossible for him to cultivate this technique as he was doing now.
Once a cultivator's heart realm reached a profound enough stage, it would enable them to remain composed even under the incomparably intense pain of cultivation, and allow them to control their external strength to seep through their physique and blood.
This meant that all three of the secret techniques were indeed significant. It was only by cultivating them that going through the initial scroll was this easy.
'This pain is truly on another level,' Xue Ying muttered inwardly. However, considering his current willpower, he was able to maintain his composure without being affected.
His bones were gradually transforming, and they even started forming a surface layer of glowing, sparkling light. However, this layer of light was not actually emitted by the bones themselves, and it was rather a form of reflected light. This process of transforming his bones alone lasted more than 3,000 years. By the end, his entire physique had fully evolved. The bones had such toughness that it was not exaggerated to say that they would be harder to destroy than most World Deity ranked equipment. And the tendons covering these bones were brimming with such vitality that they could easily be used to refine powerful weapons.
Once the transformation of his bones was concluded, he started the process of transforming his blood.
This phase also took more than 3,000 years. Once this transformation was finished, the blood in his body was like the gems of the world. Even though it was still red in color, vague rainbow light could be seen coming off of it.
The process that followed the transformation of his blood was relatively simple.
He had to wait for his blood to finish nourishing his muscles, skin, and his organs, allowing them to gradually evolve. That was the easiest, most comfortable part of the cultivation.
…
The crimson liquid within the pool was gradually consumed, and during the final moments of cultivation, no more than a shallow layer of it remained.
Xue Ying, who could be seen sitting cross-legged within the pit, began to put his clothes back on. The aura emitted from his body was much more vibrant than before, and a small shockwave started breaking out in all directions, causing the entire palace hall to vibrate slightly. Fortunately, this was Xue Ying's usual cultivation ground, so it was made to be truly stable. Otherwise, this wave alone that he emitted could have easily killed even ordinary stage four World Deities. Such was the natural aura of someone truly powerful.
If he did not manage his strength, any simple movement from his part could bring about calamities.
"Hu."
Xue Ying slowly lets out a deep breath. The flow of air within the underground palace began releasing a piercing whistle, and what followed was another shockwave.
His exhaling lasted the entire time it would take to brew a cup of tea, allowing him to spurt out all of the remaining impurities his body had.
'What an awesome feeling.' Xue Ying investigated the current state of his body—he had unfathomable strength, his recovery ability had increased, and even his explosiveness and speed were far beyond what he could achieve in the past. He had the feeling that he could casually pinch even a Paragon to death. Indeed, however, this was no more than a misconception formed in his mind after the explosive improvement of his body's physique. After all, Paragons all had certain Daos that they opened, which meant that even if they could not win against their enemies, they would still be very difficult to kill off.
Xue Ying grabbed hold of the rocky walls surrounding the deep pit as he tried getting up.
"Chi~"
The walls immediately shattered apart.
'This…' Xue Ying was stunned. This pit had been created for use in cultivation, and the rocky material was protected by many arrays, making it extremely stable. His casual movement had actually destroyed such walls? Prior to cultivating the initial scroll of "Myriad Devil True Body", he might have only achieved such a result through a full-powered attack.
'How much strength did my body even gain?' Xue Ying felt puzzled. He then extended his hand, taking out a long pole. It was an upper-grade World Deity ranked weapon.
After all, even he was not too keen on using top-grade equipment for the sake of a simple experiment.
'Let's give it a try.'
He grabbed the long pole by its two ends. The moment he put some force into it, the World Deity ranked weapon, an item he had not even refined, began to bend, so he immediately stopped. Since he had not refined it, it would simply snap if he were to continue bending it.
'It seems breaking a World Deity weapon is quite easy.'
Xue Ying then rubbed both his palms on the long pole! "Weng!"
The long pole trembled, then began twisting, then finally fractured into pieces. There was even some powder flowing down from the area where it broke apart. Xue Ying lowered his head at the sight of this, nodding lightly. 'So this is the level my strength has reached?'
He began making a rough estimation of his current state.
'The luminous sun force is no longer of much help to me.' Xue Ying clearly understood this to be true. As for the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body? Since his body was already transformed, only the body armor was still of some use.
'My body should now be stronger than those possessed by ordinary protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion. Compared to a peak protector like Protector Huo Zhu, my strength should reach about 30% of his.' Xue Ying made his guesses. With 30% of the other party's physique, as well as a great advantage in terms of his realm, he could be sure that he would not be at a disadvantage in a frontal battle even if he never displayed the Dao of Slaughter. 'If I were to display both the Dao of Slaughter and the Dao of Mirage, I might even be able to suppress Protector Huo Zhu.'
Naturally, just like Protector Cheng Yun during his struggle, his strength and speed would substantially increase.
Xue Ying had been a spectator to Protector Huo Zhu's last bout against the Ancient Demon. The former's power was genuinely terrifying, and if the current Xue Ying were to do his best against him, he could at the most match up with the other party.
However, he could definitely outlast him!
After all, his Mirage World allowed him to chase after the enemy however long he wished!
'Right now, I should already be comparable to apex Paragons.' Xue Ying lightly clenched his fist, and a miniature black hole began to flash out from the gap within. He could sense the power in his body. In truth, having a powerful body alone would not mean much, but he also possessed both the Dao of Mirage and the Dao of Slaughter.
It must be stated that even when using the same Dao of Slaughter and the same weapon to attack, now that his physical strength reached a new high, his overall offensive power would naturally follow.
…
Xue Ying was by no means arrogant; he was as clear of his strengths as he was of his weaknesses. The initial scroll of Myriad Devil True Body granted him a powerful body, but when compared to Monarch Green, the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, the White Sovereign, or the Water Devil King and such others, he still was quite immature in terms of his understanding of the realm. As long as continued raising his realm to deeper levels, he would eventually be able to match up against them, or even fight Rulers without losing out.
But this would require time!
He had only cultivated his Dao of Mirage for a bit more than eight million years, and it was still very far from reaching its limit.
'Let's take it slowly.' Xue Ying was currently not in any rush.
…
Xue Ying spent his time in his Monarch Residence over at Black Fog Sea together with his wife, training his spear techniques all the while. Before long, the day of the Myriad Flower Feast was already on the horizon.
"There actually won't be a single person from our Dong Bo Clan proceeding on to the final battle over at the Bloodshed God Palace…" Jing Qiu mentioned.
"I'd definitely be able to succeed, but I'm already a stage two World Deity, so I'm not allowed to participate," Dong Bo Yu added from the side.
"Those who were already certain to become World Deities are already worthy of being groomed. The Myriad Flower Feast is meant to be a way of granting all those countless other Deities another chance, as well as a venue for those with high enough talent to show their skills," Qing Yao said.
"Alright, let us depart. You two kids should stick to your mother's side once you get there," Xue Ying said.
"Yes," Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao obediently answered at the same time. The two had taken the initiative in asking to go, which was the only reason their parents accepted to bring them along.
"Hu."
The group tore directly through spacetime.
Xue Ying traveled side by side with Jing Qiu, and the two took their children along in flight through the tunnel in spacetime as they headed towards the Bloodshed God Palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 671 - Ultra-Miniature Cosmos
chapters.content:
Chapter 671: Ultra-Miniature Cosmos
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
As Xue Ying and his wife brought their children via the time-space tunnel to the Bloodshed God Palace, suddenly, a familiar voice sounded by their ears, "Xue Ying, come over to my side first."
"Jing Qiu, bring Yu'er and Qing Yao to the Main Palace. I'll go see Teacher first before going there." Xue Ying immediately said to his wife.
"Alright." Jing Qiu nodded.
The eyes of the nearby Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao brightened. Meeting the God-Emperor! His father was going to meet with the rumored strongest cultivator in the Deity world.
"Remember to be more reserved tacit in today's banquet." Xue Ying reminded them once more. There were likely to be a few Rulers participating in today's banquet. Xue Ying would definitely be losing face if his children created some disturbances.
"Don't worry, father."
"Father, why don't you go see his majesty the God-Emperor first."
Dong Bo Yu and her brother both successively urged him.
Only after this did Xue Ying take a stride and leave.
…
Within the small courtyard of a quiet wooden house in the Bloodshed God Palace, two figures casually sat down chatting. One of them was naturally the dark red-clothed Bloodshed God-Emperor, and the other was a moon-white-clothed male youth, Pang Yi.
The courtyard door was open. As Xue Ying walked in and saw the two of them, he immediately greeted them respectfully, "Greetings, Teacher and Ruler Pang Yi."
"God-Emperor, your disciple is truly extraordinary. His cultivation has advanced by leaps and bounds. It was fine for him to open the Dao of Mirage in one million years. He had even gotten his hands on the "Myriad Devil True Body". We could probably count the number of Paragons and Rulers who received the initial scroll of "Myriad Devil True Body" with our fingers.
