Xue Ying was figuring it out, 'According to logic, I've passed through the Three Devil Palaces trial, casually grabbing a treasure from his cove, and the ancient star map should bring me benefits, not disasters.'
'The stronger the cultivator, the more secrets he would know.'
'I'll first ask the leader of the strongest organization in the Deep-Blue Water Nation.'
Xue Ying made his decision.
He soon arrived at the foot of a chain of mountains looking upwards.
'This should be the strongest organization within Deep-Blue Water Nation, 'Black Sky God Palace'. Even the king of Deep-Blue Water Nation have to lower their heads?' Xue Ying looked upwards. It was a chain of mountains to the distant. Many black pillars were shooting up into the sky amidst the mountains. These black pillars were much taller than the mountain peak, and with more than a thousand pillars used as the foundation, a palace that was emitting a dark aura was built on top. It was where he planned on going-'Black Sky God Palace.
In the sky.
Within a palace hall inside the Black Sky God Palace.
There was a black-robed bald male seated cross-legged overlooking at his servants. His eyes swept across, and none dared look up at him. It was because this black-robed bald male was the most terrifying existence across the entire Deep-Blue Water Nation-Black Sky Palace Master!
"In this Deep-Blue Water Nation, none dares disobey my will." The black-robed bald male coldly looked beneath him. His voice was grand as it reverberated within the hall, "Those who disobey my will, will only have a single outcome-death!"
"Go, eliminate the entire 'Phi Fish Tribe'. Leave none alive." The black-robed bald male gave his order.
"Hua."
Suddenly, a black-robed figure appeared in the hall.
However, the palace hall was silent. All the servants and even the Black Sky Palace Master who was seated on the highest location had entered a deep slumber; they were all trapped in an illusory realm.
"Tell me." The black-robed figure was none other than Xue Ying. He looked towards the Black Sky God Palace, "Where is the strongest organization in this world?"
The Black Sky Palace Master muttered, "This world is endless, and is too dangerous. I've never heard of who the strongest organization is, just that the ancient 'Chong-Shi World Clan' had started since the emergence of the world, and has conquered more than a thousand nation surrounding it. It an ancient clan which stood at the peak of the entire world."
"Chong-Shi World Clan?"
Xue Ying frowned.
"Are there powerful existences? Several of them?" Xue Ying asked again.
"The Chong-Shi World Clan has powerful existences. I saw one before." Black Sky Palace Master continued saying.
…
Xue Ying did not stop his interrogation. Reaching the level of stage four World Deity, it was tough to flip over his memories. Only by using the illusory realm could he let the other party spit out all secrets.
This Black Sky Palace Master was indeed a stage four World Deity; he knew many secrets.
This interrogation lasted a total of half an hour.
After asking, Xue Ying borrowed on karma to destroy both true body and avatar of the Black Sky Palace Master. Because the soul of stage four World Deity was too strong, the moment he woke from the illusory realm, he would find out that he had once entered the 'illusory realm' before. It would reveal his existence! Thus, choosing to interrogate the 'stage four World Deity', Xue Ying would eventually silence him. That was why he chose this biggest demonic person, 'Black Sky Palace Master'.
As for those who were weaker, even though they entered the illusory realm, Xue Ying could easily flip through their memories, seal them and remove the incident. Naturally, he was not afraid of revealing himself to them.
The Deep-Blue Water Nation's strongest 'Black Sky Palace Master', had died just like this-silently and soundlessly.
To the current Xue Ying, killing a stage four World Deity was just like pinching an ant! As for whether he should kill, Xue Ying had a baseline in his heart too.
******
"Hu."
Rushing along the road for more than 500 billion kilometers, one had to know that the faster one flew in this world, the stronger the restrictive force! With Xue Ying's speed, he could fly a few tens of thousands of kilometers per second-that was too slow as compared to the outer world! Fortunately, he borrowed upon the 'Mirage World' to teleport. Otherwise, he would spend a long time trying even to travel.
'Chong-Shi World Clan?'
Xue Ying stood in midair as he looked towards the residence of that clan. The residence was massive, and experts numbered like clouds inside.
From his vision, he could see that the 'Chong-Shi World Clan' was the overlord of this territory! How would they know how terrifying this ancient clan which commanded the entire land was? Only the apex cultivators would understand the frightening strength of the Chong-Shi World Clan.
'What a Chong-Shi World Clan'. Xue Ying observed the place. He could see that there were many ancient arrays constructed deep within the entire place. The arrays were silently guiding the world force and were truly powerful-it was stronger than the arrays on his Monarch Residence! Furthermore, there was a large number of protectors patrolling the place, and all were World Deities!
'It is big enough so it should know more secrets of this world. Only then can I understand the reason why Ancestor Devil pointed me here.' Xue Ying thought.
Ancestor Devil might leave behind an opportunity.
But getting it was possibly very difficult.
"Sou."
Xue Ying turned into a stream of light, flying towards the entrance of the Chong-Shi World Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 679 - Chong-Shi World Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 679: Chong-Shi World Clan
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Chong-Shi World Clan. There were vestiges of time left on the walls of the residence. By the entrance, a bronze-armored guard was there keeping a lookout.
Xue Ying arrived at the front door to the Chong-Shi World Clan.
All eyes of the guards landed on Xue Ying's figure at that moment. These World Deity guards generated an unseen pressure on the recipient. Naturally, it felt like some passing breeze blowing on Xue Ying.
"I am here to join the Chong-Shi World Clan." Xue Ying said with a smile.
"The Chong-Shi World Clan will only be accepting guards and guests 36,000 years later. You can come again during that time." One of the bronze-armored guards responded.
"No, I am here to recommend myself as a Guest Elder." Xue Ying chuckled, "And I hope for you to report upwards."
"Guest Elder?"
These bronze-armored protectors were startled.
The foundation of Chong-Shi World Clan was tremendous. Thus, some of the cultivators who knew of this desired to join the clan so that they could acquire more resources and better guidance. Most would join the clan as guards or guests! The guards would be subjected to greater supervision, whereas the guests would have more freedom, but would merely be similar to hired thugs! As for the 'Guest Elder', it was a much higher position. The Chong-Shi World Clan would not force the Guest Elder since every single one of them was a massive force in itself for the clan.
"Senior, please wait a moment. I'll be reporting your arrival at this moment." The chief guard stated before leaving for the residence.
…
"Guest Elder?"
An old man from the Chong-Shi World Clan who had white beard and hair was seated cross-legged as he looked at the bronze-armored guard in front of him.
"Reporting to Second Elder, the visitor has indeed stated that he is here to become a Guest Elder." The bronze-armored guard answered.
"Then we'll have a look at his combat power." The white-haired old man stood up, "Pass down my orders-wake nine Demonic Gods."
"Yes." The guard immediately acknowledged.
At that moment, news began spreading across this ancient world clan. A powerful existence was planning to join the clan as a Guest Elder. There were very few 'Guest Elder' within the Chong-Shi World Clan. Usually, only stage four World Deities were qualified to be one! Naturally, some who had absolute arts and could rival a stage four World Deity would have hopes of becoming a 'Guest Elder' too.
******
Xue Ying entered the Chong-Shi Clan residence under the guidance of that guard. Soon, he saw the white-haired old man.
"Greetings, Second Elder." Xue Ying greeted. At the same time, he felt astonished. This white-haired old man was a powerful existence who had transcended.
"You are?" Second Elder frowned. According to the intelligence gathered by the Chong-Shi Clan, there was no such formidable black-robed teenager recorded within, and he did not recognize him either.
Xue Ying chuckled, "This one is called Flying Snow."
When he was young, his weapon had been the Flying Snow God Spear. Thus, he casually gave himself a name, 'Flying Snow', to prevent any accidents from happening since there might be methods of 'spying' on the outside worlds which were owned by the apex organizations in this world. As such, he had to alter his appearances to one that was colder.
"My Chong-Shi World Clan has not had any new Guest Elder for a few hundred million years already. We only have a total of six currently." The white-haired old man mentioned, "Reaching the realm of stage four World Deity, most would prefer to remain free. Thus, there aren't too many willing to join my Chong-Shi World Clan."
"I have always been cultivating in secret. After stepping into the stage four World Deity realm, I have yet to break through after a long time. Hearing that the Chong-Shi World Clan has three formidable absolute arts, and one is called the "Six Sever Sword Styles". I use the sword and have come specially to recommend myself as a Guest Elder to learn this absolute art." Xue Ying said. He felt rueful as he said that.
This world had a huge difference from their Deity world and Abyss, primarily since it was much easier to learn any cultivation techniques or absolute arts!
Almost every single person had the chance to learn a cultivation technique. As for 'absolute arts', one had to know that even powerful existences sought for a complete absolute art in the Deity world and Abyss! But in this world, Xue Ying had learned from the dead Black Sky Palace Master that a single Chong-Shi Clan had three absolute arts-they were also their clan's absolute arts which could be imparted anytime.
How did Chong-Shi World Clan attract many of the experts over to become Guest Elders? It's because of their treasures and absolute arts.
Those three absolute arts were "Celestial Water Illusory Body", "Thunder Dao", and "Six Sever Sword Styles". According to the information he heard from Black Sky Palace Master, the "Celestial Water Illusory Body" should be related to 'Water', the "Thunder Dao" related to thunder, and the "Six Sever Sword Styles" should be a frightening sword technique that was meant for killing. Xue Ying could deduce… that it should be an absolute art on the 'Dao of Slaughter'.
One had to know that ever since he opened the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter, he had always been seeking for an appropriate absolute art for himself.
Otherwise, it would be like "Luminous Sun" and "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" for which he could only cultivate to the fifth volume grand perfection before stopping there. Otherwise, it would not be compatible with the 'Dao' he opened.
In the Deity world and Abyss, he had never heard of any absolute arts which were appropriate for the Dao of Mirage. Even though there were some which were appropriate for the 'Dao of Slaughter', it wasn't that easy to learn them in the Deity world and Abyss. That time, he had gotten the lower half of Blood Demon Scripture using the upper half of it.
'Who would have thought that I'll discover an absolute art for the Dao of Slaughter in this world.' Xue Ying entered the Chong-Shi World Clan firstly because he wanted to get this absolute art and secondly so that he could mix himself in to search for the real identity of the entire world.
He did not wish to force his way through!
After all, his illusory realm could deal with stage four World Deities, but the effects would not be as effective when dealing with powerful existences. Ordinary powerful existences had extraordinary heart realm, and their realms were high too.
Adding up to his unfamiliarity with this world, he might lose his life if he were to force his way through.
Thus, it was more advisable to mix in the crowd, spend a little more time before spreading his investigation silently.
'It is worth it to enter this world since I get to learned his Dao of Slaughter absolute art.' Xue Ying's mood was excellent.
"Absolute art?" The white-haired old man, Second Elder, laughed after hearing it. Most Guest Elders came for the sake of those three absolute arts, "My Chong-Shi World Clan will not present the three clan absolute arts that easily. You will naturally be able to learn it after contributing greatly to the clan."
"That's natural." Xue Ying nodded.
"Even though I can sense your aura that it is of the stage four World Deity realm, you must undergo a trial still." The second Elder told him, "Come with me."
Xue Ying nodded.
His aura had been disguised using the Bloodshed Tavern Master robe. One had to know that after cultivating in the Myriad Devil True Body and having opened the Dao, his aura from both his true deity heart and body had become very strong-much stronger than the average Paragons. The aura of the Myriad Devil True Body could easily jolt a stage four World Deity to death, so he naturally had to conceal it! Killing his way after entering an unfamiliar world was foolish.
Just judging by the absolute arts which the Chong-Shi Clan had, Xue Ying understood this world was not ordinary! Because absolute arts would not be produced from nothing; there must be some experts who created them. Hence, it was better to stay low-key and discover the real face of this world.
…
"The clan will be getting a new Guest Elder."
"They are going to start with the Guest Elder trial soon."
"Quick quick quick."
Some of the clan disciples within the Chong-Shi World Clan were excitedly heading to watch the battle. Even some of the higher ranking guards who could move freely had rushed over since the 'Guest Elder trial' was not ordinary!
"Seventh Highness, Seventh Highness, please be careful!" Two maidservants followed behind a child.
This child was dashing, "Where's the Guest Elder trial? Hurry up! I want to have a look! I've never seen that before."
The two maidservants were stage one World Deity. They were both carefully serving this child because he was the seventh son of that forefather who had the highest status in the entire world clan. Previously, Sixth Highness had died without becoming a World Deity, whereas the other five highnesses had all stepped into the World Deity realm.
Very soon, Seventh Highness, other disciples, the guards, and even two Guest Elders appeared.
"World Deity Flying Snow. Have a look." The Second Elder pointed forward. Nine puppets were 3.3 meters tall standing in the empty field ahead. All of them were emitting quite a vigorous aura. They were currently staring at Xue Ying with their pair of red eyes.
"The nine Demonic Gods are approximately as strong as peak stage three World Deities. You will pass the trial when you defeat them, becoming a Guest Elder of my Chong-Shi World Clan." The second Elder chuckled.
"Alright."
Xue Ying directly pulled out a sword from behind his back.
He had always been carrying the sword on his back; it was a peak grade World Deity ranked weapon. Because there were similarities between 'sword' and 'spear'-a sword was just like a short spear, and the basic sword moves were to pierce, hack, jab, horizontal slash, etc. Since he was concealing his identity, he would use this weapon to strength his disguise further! With his attainments in the Dao of Slaughter, crafting a set of sword techniques casually with his Dao of Slaughter was simple. This set of sword techniques was naturally within the boundaries of the world laws.
But it was the standard of a peak powerful existence already. Among stage four World Deities, it was an extremely formidable technique.
"He's here."
"They are going to battle."
The audiences including three elders and two Guest Elders, Seventh Highness and many other disciples were looking forward to this 'Guest Elder Trial'.

chapters.title: Chapter 680 - Becoming a Teacher
chapters.content:
Chapter 680: Becoming a Teacher
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Under the attentive gaze of the audience, Xue Ying who pulled out a sword turned into an image with a single step.
"Hong!"
Flames were burning on the surface of his body. This layer of fire appeared in the shape of an arc; his speed was reaching a terrifying stage.
"Thunder-fire has appeared!" Many disciples of the clan, guards, and maidservants brightened up as they watched the battle. That Seventh Highness had become even more thrilled after seeing it. Usually, only stage four World Deities could cause the thunder-fire to appear just with their flying speed. This scene was something which many people could rarely get to watch.
The nine Demonic God puppets growled at the same time before leaping forward.
"Hua."
Closely following that, a blood strand arced across the sky. This strand turned back thrice in the air and had precisely wrapped around the necks of those nine puppets.
"Hu."
Xue Ying's figure appeared not far away. He then kept the sword back to its sheath on his back.
Only at this moment did a large wound appear on every single neck of those nine Demonic God puppets. Their throats had been cut, and the internal workings of those puppets were affected-all puppets stopped moving. Only then did the injuries gradually recover.
"I've won already right?" Xue Ying turned towards the Second Elder.
"Such formidable sword technique." The eyes of the Second Elder brightened. He nodded with a smile, "No wonder Guest Elder Flying Snow wishes to learn our "Six Sever Sword Styles"."
The two Guest Elders and other two elders who were just stage four World Deities felt shocked at that moment. From what they saw, this combat power… was utterly beyond an ordinary stage four World Deity's. It should be comparable to an average powerful existence.
However, it was quite common in this world for stage four World Deities to compete against powerful existences because it was easier to learn absolute arts!
'His combat power should be similar to our clan elders." The two elders thought. Most Guest Elders had to contribute significantly to the clan before they could get the chance to learn the absolute arts, but those clan elders would get to learn it directly.
'Maybe he is still hiding his combat power. We cannot belittle him.'
The two made their analysis.
"Organize a feast tonight to celebrate our new Guest Elder Flying Snow." Second Elder announced.
Many of those who were present felt excited.
Defeating nine Demonic God puppets with a single strike was something incredible.
'Very formidable. Truly formidable.' Even the child, Seventh Highness, was emitting light in his eyes. He had etched that scene of the blood strand turning thrice in the air in his mind. That was the arc formed by a sword, and he felt it was so much beautiful than the rainbow in the sky, 'I want to learn that sword, and I will learn it from this Guest Elder Flying Snow.'
…
Time flowed.
In the blink of an eye, Xue Ying had joined the Chong-Shi World Clan for more than a year.
"Sir Flying Snow."
The guard to the book pavilion greeted respectfully.
Xue Ying lightly nodded before entering. He began flipping through the books within the pavilion. The status of a guest elder was quite high, and they could enter most of the places within the Chong-Shi World Clan such as the book pavilion which contained many cultivation methods, World Deity ranked secret techniques, ancient arrays, and others. These were all accessible by guest elders. Naturally, the essential items to the clan would be kept a secret, like the absolute art "Six Sever Sword Styles" which Xue Ying wanted to learn. He could temporarily not get it.
He had to contribute first.
'The three Holy Grounds and nine Great World Clans.' Xue Ying was pondering as he flipped through the books.
Over the year, he had browsed through many books and interacted with the other guest elders and elders. Other than talking about the Dao, they would talk about the different dangerous grounds and historical remains. They would also talk about the biggest organizations in the world. Since he had once interrogated 'Black Sky Palace Master', Xue Ying could iterate through many dangerous places so as not to reveal any holes in his disguise. He had even deliberately spoken about how 'he had always been cultivating in closed-door and knew very few things'.
Soon, he became aware of the 12 most influential organizations in the world-the three Holy Grounds and nine Great World Clans.
They stood at the peak and governed the world as a whole.
'The three Holy Grounds of this world could not be moved. Second to that should be the nine Great World Clans. Chong-Shi World Clan is one of the nine Great World Clans… and have a total of four powerful existences.' Xue Ying thought, 'But they have truly a lot of absolute arts.'
The nine Great World Clans.
Every single world clan had at least two absolute arts. The most a world clan had was five.
As for the three Holy Grounds, their foundation was much more unfathomable. A single order could enable elites they were grooming to enter any of the nine Great World Clans to learn their absolute art. The nine Great World Clans did not dare disobey. From this evidence, it seemed that the three Holy Grounds were extremely powerful and must have Paragons within.
'What exactly is the reason Ancestor Devil's ancient star map led me to this location?' Xue Ying was still pondering over it, 'The three Holy Grounds are deep and unfathomable, but I'm not in a rush. I should first learn the absolute art related to the Dao of Slaughter!'
From the information he collected, he had never heard of anyone having an absolute art related to the Dao of Mirage.
There were two absolute arts related to the Dao of Slaughter though. One was the "Six Sever Sword Styles" which the Chong-Shi World Clan had, and the other was the "Mass Extinction Scripture".
"Take care, Sir Flying Snow." The guard respectfully addressed as Xue Ying left the book pavilion.
"Senior Flying Snow, Senior Flying Snow." A child's voice sounded.
Xue Ying clutched his forehead and helplessly turned around. He saw a child dashing over with two maidservants following behind. The child said, "Senior Flying Snow, you should accept me as your disciple! I sincerely and earnestly want to learn sword technique from you!"
"Seventh Highness, Forefather has already arranged it for you. You should listen to him and not make things difficult for me." Xue Ying helplessly responded. This Seventh Highness was a child of the Chong-Shi Clan's Forefather. His status was unique, and could not be beaten nor scolded. He could only persuade him. After all, he still planned to learn the absolute art using his original plan-the standard route.
He just had to spend more time; that was something he had plenty.
"Hahaha, Brother Flying Snow, it seems Seventh Highness has stuck his eyes on you. You should just give in." A red-nosed male who was holding a wine flask staggered over.
"Drunkard, less nonsense from you since you aren't taking in disciples." Xue Ying chided. Drunkard was also one of the guest elders from the Chong-Shi World Clan.
"I am willing to teach, but it seems Seventh Highness does not regard me highly at all." The red-nosed male gave a weird chuckle.
"Senior Flying Snow, I am really sincere." Seventh Highness stared at Xue Ying with his wide eyes.
"I've said before that as long as your Forefather agrees, I'll take you in as a disciple." Xue Ying helplessly replied, "Don't make my life difficult anymore."
Saying that, he moved.
"Sou."
He disappeared into nothingness, running off at speed much faster than anyone!
'Sigh, when did I, Dong Bo Xue Ying, ever end up in such a sorry state by an eight-year-old child?' Xue Ying felt helpless. Actually, Seventh Highness had always been harassing him for the past year. Xue Ying liked this Seventh Highness who had no arrogance at all and wanted to take him in as a disciple, albeit that Forefather did not seem to be too willing.
The forefather wished to send his son to one of the three Holy Grounds! He would get better guidance there. One had to know that there were only four powerful existences in the Chong-Shi Clan, and there were many more in the three Holy Grounds. Unless he should let his son accept a stage four World Deity as a teacher? He was not too enthusiastic about it.
…
"Father, father, I said before that I want to take Senior Flying Snow as my teacher. I'll not accept anyone else other than him." Seventh Heaven was shaking his head profusely. He would not agree even if he died.
The violet-robed male who sat on the throne felt helpless.
Being the strongest in the clan, he was incapable of dealing with an eight-year-old child.
"You have a chance of becoming a disciple under a Holy Master, yet you don't agree and want to take a stage four World Deity as your teacher." The violet-robed male shook his head and sighed.
"Forefather." The housekeeper whispered by the side, "Why not let Seventh Highness stay in the clan?"
The violet-robed male turned to the housekeeper.
"Firstly, even if His Highness enter the Holy Ground, it might not be sure that he'll become a disciple of the Holy Master; there are many trials. Secondly, the sword techniques of Guest Elder Flying Snow is extraordinary. His realm isn't weaker than ordinary powerful existences. Thirdly, isn't Forefather here? Forefather can always see His Highness anytime within the clan and personally guide him as well." The housekeeper explained, "Furthermore, over this year, His Highness wants to only accept Guest Elder Flying Snow as his teacher no matter what…"
The violet-robed male softly nodded. He did not say more. Indeed, he could take good care of his child if he was here.
Seventh Highness gave his father a full and expectant look.
"Alright, I'll allow you to take Guest Elder Flying Snow as your teacher." The violet-robed male said.
"Hahaha, thank you, father!" Seventh Highness dashed over and leaped into his body. He hugged him and sent kisses all over his face. The violet-robed male could not help but chuckle. What he chose might be right.
The violet-robed male glanced at the housekeeper and transmitted a message, "Go inform Guest Elder Flying Snow that as long as he could guide my son to the realm of World Deity, the "Six Sever Sword Styles" will be imparted to him."
"Yes." The housekeeper acknowledged.
…
Xue Ying stared at Seventh Highness who was kneeling on the ground. Seventh Highness lowered his head and shouted, "Disciple greets teacher."
"This…" Xue Ying did not know what to do.
The housekeeper chuckled from the side, "Guest Elder Flying Snow, Forefather has been pestered by Seventh Highness and eventually gave in."
Xue Ying blinked a few times.
Coming to this world, he wanted to investigate the secrets behind this world yet who would have thought that he had gotten a disciple instead.

chapters.title: Chapter 681 - Thousand Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 681: Thousand Years
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The housekeeper quietly transmitted over, "Forefather has already mentioned it. As long as Guest Elder Flying Snow make Seventh Highness a World Deity, then Guest Elder Flying Snow will have the chance to learn the "Six Sever Sword Styles"."
"The Forefather has truly given it a lot of thought." Xue Ying smiled. He was also a father, and therefore understand the intentions of the Chong Shi Clan's forefather. And because of this, Xue Ying had a much favorable opinion towards the Forefather.
"Teacher, then why not take me as a disciple." Seventh Highness knelt down and raised his head.
Xue Ying softly nodded. He then sat down on the chair and solemnly answered, "Since you have taken me as your master, I will not coddle you from now on. From henceforth, you are no longer the Seventh Highness in front of me but merely Chong Yan."
"Yes, from now on, this disciple with take any beatings and punishments, and will not complain about it." Seventh Highness Chong Yan raised his head and said-his childish voice was clear and sweet.
"Kowtow to your teacher." Xue Ying instructed him.
"Peng Peng Peng."
Seventh Highness immediately kowtowed three times heavily: "Disciple Chong Yang pays respects to Teacher."
Upon seeing this, the nearby housekeeper became somewhat unhappy: 'This Guest Elder Flying Snow… Seventh Highness is still young and immature. That is why he was so set on taking him as a Teacher! Even from now on, it is still forefather himself who will be teaching him primarily. How could a stage four World Deity like him compare with our forefather? Nevertheless, who would have thought that this guest elder would assume the arrogance of being a teacher the moment he took in a disciple.'
"Good." Xue Ying smiled and nodded, "Get up."
Seventh Highness instantly stood up.
"Little Seven, go rest today. Meet me at dawn tomorrow." Xue Ying instructed. In his speech, Xue Ying had directly addressed him as "Little Seven".
Seventh Highness was joyous from the bottom of his heart. The young master respectfully saluted, "Yes, this disciple will take his leave."
He then obediently left without any arrogance at all.
The nearby housekeeper glanced at Xue Ying. He did not say much before following the Seventh Highness and left.
Xue Ying was watching his disciple leave with a smile: "Back then when I first encountered that child, Ye Qing, he should be around this age. However, Ye Qing had lived in poor circumstances, causing his body to be weak and small. In reality, he was only slightly older than Little Seven and also much wiser. This time, Little Seven is truly the youngest fellow I've ever interacted with."
Eight years old.
If one said he was knowledgeable, then he was knowledgeable. He knew all kinds of etiquette, and even understood how to determine the expression of others.
If one said he wasn't knowledgeable, then he was indeed young and immature. He had been raised by the Chong Shi World Clan without having any experiences of the vile acts in the world.
"He's a child that Forefather Chong Shi had after he became a powerful existence. This child has extraordinary talent, and guiding him to become a world deity?" Xue Ying did not believe that it was something difficult.
…
Time passed year by year.
The 'Seventh Highness' Chong Yan who was usually doted on the most by the Chong Shi clan, was being obedient and brave. Under the instructions of Xue Ying, he cultivated step by step. Although it was secret, Forefather Chong Shi would usually instruct his son too. Nevertheless, Xue Ying was not bothered about it. He guided Chong Yan however he wanted. As a Paragon who had opened two Daos, Xue Ying's comprehension towards the Dao was extremely deep, and he knew how to guide and teach more effectively.
In the blink of an eye, a thousand years had passed.
"Teacher." A white-clothed youth carried a sword on his back. He came rather excitedly to greet Xue Ying.
The black-clothed Xue Ying was similarly carrying a sword. He stood to one side and emitted an aura of cold energy. Nevertheless, as he looked at his disciple, his gaze was somewhat warm: "Little seven, seeing that you are so full of confidence, it seems you have made some progress?"
"This disciple has completely mastered the "Chasing Light Sword" that teacher passed down to me." The white-haired youth said.
"Demonstrate it for me." Xue Ying ordered from the side.
"Yes."
The Seventh Highness Chong Yan immediately pulled the sword out from behind his back. He then began to display the sword technique. It created a sword light that formed a ray of light immediately. It was so fast that it left behind an afterimage.
Xue Ying quietly looked on before grinning. Seeing the growth of his disciple gave Xue Ying a sense of accomplishment: 'Now he is already a mid-stage Deity. It seems that becoming a World Deity in ten thousand years will be somewhat tough. I'm afraid that it will take several ten thousand years. Let's not talk about comparing to myself. When compared to Jia Yun of my three disciples, the setbacks that Little Seven has experienced are too little. But nothing can be done. Even if I order him to go out and attend to some matters, Forefather Chong Shi will order some experts to protect him in the dark. He would encounter some minor setbacks at most without suffering from a genuinely difficult situation.'
Without sufficient temperament, how could one become stronger?
Since he already had a Deity avatar, why would he protect his child so much?
Forefather Chong Shi naturally understood this point, yet he always worried about his children, and could not help dispatching experts to protect them in the dark.
'In the Chong Shi clan, the will of Forefather Chong Shi's could not be violated. No matter what, it is pointless for me to fight him for such minor matter on teaching a disciple.' Xue Ying lightly shook his head. He was already trying his best to teach, and Forefather Chong Shi was also delighted-amongst his children, the cultivation speed of Seventh Highness was the fastest. Forefather Chong Shi had become much closer to Xue Ying and had personally mentioned that the day Chong Yan became a World Deity would be the day he offers the absolute art "Six Sever Sword Styles" to Xue Ying.
'The three holy grounds…'
Xue Ying inwardly said.
In the past thousand years, he had not wasted his time.
Because of the closer relationship he had with Forefather Chong Shi, they actually conversed with each other several times. Forefather Chong Shi had also brought up the three holy grounds which Xue Ying was able to deduce many more things from the few isolated phrases.
'Although the three great holy grounds are formidable, according to Forefather Chong Shi, even if he was afraid of them, it was not to the point of being unable to resist.' Xue Ying thought, 'Judging by the exchange we had, the three great holy grounds should have Paragons at most, and there should not be any Rulers.'
If there was a Ruler, then with his strength, Forefather Chong Shi and the others would have long ago become obediently and docile.
The difference between an ordinary powerful existence and a Ruler was too great!
Therefore the three great holy grounds probably did not have any Rulers! This deduction allowed Xue Ying to let out a sigh of relief. At the same time, he felt that it was expected: 'Although it is easier to obtain cultivation techniques and absolute arts in this world, this world is ultimately only this big! There could only be that much danger for the experts to temper themselves in.'
'Without the fighting against experts and without experiencing enough tempering from dangerous situations, without having any guidance from some of the stronger seniors like those in the Lake Heart Island or Six Heavenly Wheel and Starting Ground… it was difficult even to open a 'Dao', much less becoming a Ruler.' In the thousand years he had lived here, Xue Ying knew that this world was much weaker than the world outside.
Even though in the outside world, one could attain guidances left behind by stronger seniors, and proceed to other cosmos to temper themselves, obtain the pointers of the Bloodshed God Emperor, Temporal Island Master and others who had already become Rulers, the task of becoming a Ruler was still challenging.
The so-called outstanding 'Monarch Green' who had cultivated three Daos to the bottleneck still lacked that tiny bit before he could break through.
Even Pang Yi had created his current cultivation technique before becoming a Ruler.
Thus, becoming a Ruler was extremely difficult.
And in this world, the difficulty of becoming a Ruler would perhaps be more than ten times that of the outside world!
…
Standing there and watching his disciple practice the sword, Xue Ying's thoughts drifted He began thinking of his matters. The more he understood about this world, the better he could plan and act 'appropriately'! If he were too rude and impetuous which led to his death, it would be too much of an injustice. In the information recorded on the Deity World and Abyss, many powerhouses' deaths were caused by their own 'carelessness'.
For example, the deaths of the two protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion were primarily because they were careless and had underestimated Xue Ying.
Therefore Xue Ying did not dare to underestimate the power in this world.
"Teacher, how is it?" Seventh Highness Chong Yan looked towards Xue Ying.
"Although you've successfully mastered it, don't you feel that those sword moves aren't connected to each other?" Xue Ying smiled and asked in reply.
Little Seven Chong immediately felt somewhat embarrassed.
He had done his best to master it successfully, so how would he have the concentration to take into consideration linking one move after another?
"Practice some more. Only when all the moves are linked as one should you come and see me again." Xue Ying smiled and instructed. Suddenly, his expression changed. He raised his head and looked towards the surroundings, "Mn? There are actually enemies who dare deal with the Chong Shi Clan? Interesting!"

chapters.title: Chapter 682 - Unremarkable Battle History
chapters.content:
Chapter 682: Unremarkable Battle History
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
High up above the Chong-Shi World Clan, there was a planar warship. Beneath the ship contained many circular images of arrays. As an unseen wave began spreading out, it had concealed the ship entirely. Even those from the Chong-Shi World Clan located beneath did not sense it at all. Naturally, this warship had not entered the region of Chong-Shi World Clan's scouting array.
There were seven figures currently standing within the ship. They were gazing at the ancient Chong-Shi World Clan from above.
Of the seven characters, six were in blood robe, and they were all led by a golden-robed golden-haired male.
"The fortune of Old Chong is magnificent. I've heard that he has gotten a rumored True God weapon." The golden-haired male sighed. Following which, he gave a cold laughter, "But he should die for not offering it to the Holy Ground after getting it. Instead, he is thinking of keeping it for himself."
"True God weapon. It is said that refining one is tough. There has not been a single one in our epoch who succeeded in doing so." The blood-robed men behind him added.
True God weapon.
It might be valuable in the Deity world and Abyss, yet the price had not reached an excessive stage since most Rulers could refine them! Like the number one refiner amongst Paragons, 'Ripple Monarch Planet Lady', she could refine one after putting in a great effort. But this world… had no Rulers at all. Thus, for there to give birth to someone knowing how to refine a True God weapon was almost impossible.
One must understand that Ripple Monarch Planet Lady was able to refine one due to the guidance of Empress Qian He.
Hence, a True God weapon in this world… was much more valuable than that in the Deity world and Abyss! Even the required materials for refining a True God weapon were much harder to find in this world as compared to the Deity world and Abyss.
"Start." The golden-robed golden-haired sneered.
…
This planar warship suddenly released a terrifying aura. At the same time, the circular images of arrays gave off a dazzling golden light. This golden light went shining down grandly. One could see the clan protection arrays of the Chong-Shi World Clan reciprocating immediately in strength. "Hong long long~" Many layers of enormous array began appearing in the entire residence, forming black energy that blanketed the whole clan while resisting against the incoming golden light.
"Who!" A heaven-shattering roar was released. A figure rushed up into the sky. It was the violet-robed patriarch of the Chong-Shi Clan.
When Chong-Shi Forefather saw that planar warship above, his expression changed.
Not just him, even the Grand Elder, Second Elder and Third Elder within the clan had recognized that planar warship situated in the sky.
"The palace treasure, 'Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship'." Both Forefather of the Chong-Shi World Clan and the three powerful existences elder felt their heart sinking. The threat of the 'Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship' need not be explained. The moment it appeared, it represented the 'Sky Fire Palace' of the three Holy Grounds. According to logic, the Chong-Shi World Clan should be closest to the Sky Fire Palace, and the Sky Fire Palace should be protecting them instead of attacking.
"I wonder who the emissary is?" Chong-Shi Forefather looked above and shouted out. The three elders similarly flew to his side. As for the other stage four World Deity elders, guest elders and copious amounts of disciples, guards and maidservants, they were all watching this scene with unease.
"Hahaha…"
Crazed laughter accompanied.
Seven figures appeared beneath that planar warship. The golden-robed golden-haired male who led the team sneered, "Old Chong, you can't even recognize me?"
Chong-Shi Forefather and the other three elders felt that things were amiss.
The one appearing in front was a judge emissary and six law enforcers from the Sky Fire Palace! A total of seven powerful existences! One had to know that due to the higher number of absolute arts which the Sky Fire Palace had, the average strength of the powerful existences there was higher than that of the Chong-Shi Clan.
"So it is Judge Sheng." Chong-Shi Forefather slightly frowned, "Why has Judge Sheng come to suppress my clan array?"
"Stop with your nonsense."
The golden-robed golden-haired male sneered, "Do you think no one knows the treasure you got? I give you two choices now. One, hand that treasure over. Two, I'll pull up the entire Chong-Shi Clan from its roots."
Chong-Shi Forefather felt his heart speeding up, though fury was shown on the surface, "What treasure? Who told you what? And Judge Sheng, you should know that all of us have avatars. Our true bodies and avatars will not be located in the same place! Destroying this clan is easy, but exterminating the four powerful existences of my Chong-Shi World Clan… is almost impossible."
He was warning the other party.
"Also, does the Left Palace Master know of your arrival?" Chong-Shi Forefather asked.
"I came under the orders of the Right Palace Head." The golden-robed golden-haired male curled his lips, "Do you think that we don't dare to touch you despite having Left Palace Head as your backing?"
Chong-Shi Forefather felt stifled and helpless.
There were many factions within the 'Sky Fire Palace'. They were primarily the faction led by Left Palace Head and Right Palace Head. According to rumors, there was a slightly low-key third faction even.
"Hand it over. Otherwise, your Chong-Shi Clan will be no more." The golden-robed golden-haired male coldly ordered.
"I truly do not know what you are saying." Chong-Shi Forefather sneered. Hand over? How could he hand it over? That was the hope for him to break through into the realm of Paragon!
"I do want to see if you have it with you now." The golden-robed golden-haired male sneered, "Kill!"
"Sou sou sou sou sou sou."
The six blood-robed men went rushing down. All of them had blazing fire surrounding their figures as they flew at high speed. Those flames even formed a distorted arc.
"Those who go against my Chong-Shi World Clan, die!" Chong-Shi Forefather was filled with killing intent. The three powerful existences elders by his side had similarly moved.
"Hong-"
A terrifying wave formed in the sky.
This world had an unseen law suppression, limiting their speed and power. Thus, the disturbances created were not that huge-at least when compared to that in the Deity world and Abyss. Besides, the Chong-Shi Clan's clan protection array was there to protect the cultivators of the clan against the 'Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship'.
…
In the sky, that judge emissary controlled the entire Holy Ground palace treasure, 'Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship' to aid in the battle, completely suppressing Chong-Shi Forefather who was originally stronger than him.
"Forefather, we can't hold on any longer."
The other three powerful existences elders were having a bitter time.
The six law enforcers were stronger than them in all aspects, and they outnumbered the elders too. Just a short while later, the weakest Third Elder had been cut into pieces by an ax. His body was soon exterminated, leaving behind only the Grand Elder and Second Elder, and things became more taxing for them… the two were trying their best to survive. They did not dare retaliate at all. At least under their teamwork, they could barely hold on.
"The two of you deal with them. We'll eliminate those little brats below and annihilate the entire Chong-Shi World Clan." Very soon, the blood-robed law enforcers rushed downwards.
"Old Chong, it seems your Third Elder has died, and the Grand Elder and Second Elder can only hold on a little longer." The golden-robed golden-haired male said while fighting, "Obediently hand that baby over. Why complicate things? You see, those stage four World Deities of your clan and the guest elders are all dying in battle."
Chong-Shi Forefather felt incomparably sullen.
This time, the 'Right Palace Head' from the Sky Fire Palace had prepared themselves very well.
Right Palace Head sent out even their palace protection treasure and almost all his subordinates. A judge emissary and six law enforcers… their Chong-Shi Clan could not overcome this at all.
…
"Ai, why must such a thing happen when I come to be a guest elder?" The red-nosed male who was drinking from his wine flask, 'Drunkard', said bitterly.
"Surrender yourself, and we will let you live." A blood-robed enforcer shouted out.
"Since I joined the Chong-Shi World Clan, how can I admit defeat so easily?" Drunkard looked upwards, "I do want to see how powerful the law enforcers from the Sky God Palace is."
"You will know soon."
The blood-robed law enforcer sneered.
Just a moment later.
Drunkard could no longer resist. He was cut into two by a blade. A sad look appeared in his eyes, "There's quite a huge gap between a powerful existence still."
Very soon, Drunkard's entire body was destroyed. He died in combat.
…
Other than two guest elders who ran away immediately, the others were fighting against the enforcers since most of them were just avatars! They would merely lose an avatar after dying.
…
"Judge Sheng." Chong-Shi Forefather's eyes were red. He looked at the battle happening below. After all, those four law enforcers were powerful existences and had cultivated in the absolute arts from the Holy Ground. Overall, they were much stronger than the stage four World Deities. The same absolute art, like the "Luminous Sun" for instance, could only be trained to the fourth volume fourth boundary by stage four World Deities. Those who were weaker in talent could merely reach the third boundary realm.
As for powerful existences, they could cultivate it to the fifth volume.
Thus, powerful existences would have the advantage even when using the same absolute arts.
"You can't obstruct us. Your clan and your children will all die today." The golden-robed golden-haired male looked beneath.
******
Xue Ying was looking at the four blood-robed law enforcers rushing down with thunder-fire surrounding their bodies. It was just a one-sided massacre. One of the enforcers had even rushed his way over.
"The Seventh Highness of Chong-Shi Forefather, Chong Yan?" The blood-robed law enforcer said with glee, "Little brat, if you want to blame, blame your father for bringing this entire clan to ruins."
The white-robed teenager, Chong Yan, clenched his fist.
He was angry and anxious at the same time.
He was no longer the eight-year-old kid of that year. He knew that this respected teacher of his was only a stage four World Deity, and facing such predicament, his teacher should not have any way of retaliating.
"Isn't it too overbearing for a powerful existence to deal against a brat?" Xue Ying took a step before standing right in front of his disciple, Chong Yan.
"Oh?"
The blood-robed law enforcer looked at Xue Ying, "It is indeed overbearing. Today, we want to exterminate the entire Chong-Shi World Clan including this little brat. You must be that Guest Elder 'Flying Snow World Deity' from the Chong-Shi World Clan right? According to reports, you are even the teacher of this Chong Yan? Hmph hmph, why, are you planning to show some heroism in front of your disciple?"
This law enforcer did not care about his opponent. After all, the current battle was one-sided.
"Flying Snow World Deity, a stage four World Deity without any famous battle history." The blood-robed law enforcer sneered as he recited what was recorded in the intelligence reports.
"Teacher." Chong Yan felt very worried.
"Little Seven, watch from the side." Xue Ying took out the Divine sword from behind his back emotionlessly.
"Qiang."
The divine sword was unsheathed.
Wielding a sword, Xue Ying stared at that blood-robed enforcer and declared coldly, "I might not have any famous battle history, but from today on, I'll have one."

chapters.title: Chapter 683 - Action
chapters.content:
Chapter 683: Action
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Chong Yan had been under Xue Ying's tutelage since young. Over the many years, he had naturally formed a close relationship with him. As he stood behind Xue Ying nervously, he felt worried and unease at the same time. He transmitted, "Teacher, my Chong-Shi Clan could no longer survive after today. If Teacher has been implicated due to your relationship with our clan, infuriating the Sky Fire Palace, they might take it out on you."
If a stage four World Deity infuriates the Sky Fire Palace, they could pursue him using karma!
"Leave me behind, teacher. Even if I were killed, Father could reincarnate me from the River of Time." Chong Yan was worried for his teacher since he had long treated him as someone close.
Xue Ying turned around to look at his disciple. He felt warmth in his heart. Xue Ying chuckled, "Relax. Take a good look at how your teacher uses the sword. I have never displayed it properly for so many years."
"You haven't fought with a law enforcer of the Sky God Palace before too right?" The blood-robed law enforcer sneered after seeing him, "In a while, your disciple will see how you die."
"Are you prepared?" Xue Ying asked, "If you are, I'll be starting now."
"Enough exaggeration!"
The blood-robed law enforcer became furious at that moment, "Die for me!"
"Hong!"
He held on to a black great-hammer. When the great-hammer moved, there was an unseen flow of air surrounding it. Furthermore, due to how fast it was moving, under the suppression of laws in this world, thunder-fire appeared.
Xue Ying moved too. A fire sword light went cutting by that black great-hammer, arcing across the body of the blood-robed law enforcer. The blood-robed law enforcer had an alarming look of disbelief at the next moment: "How could this be, how could you be so fast I can't even touch you?" And the terrifying power within that sword shattered the entire body of the law enforcer. Xue Ying kept his sword while standing at his original position without moving, yet he had already exterminated the other party with many sword streams.
The blood-robed emissary was dead!
Xue Ying felt calm. He cultivated the True Devil Myriad Body which could overwhelm even Paragons in the Deity world and Abyss. Only the protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion who came from another cosmos-the apex protectors-could surpass him in strength. But Xue Ying held a superior realm as compared to them.
A casual sword with speed far beyond his opponent led to his death.
'What!' The golden-robed judge emissary had a change in expression. He looked at this corner by the massive connection of structures within the Chong-Shi World Clan. There was a black-robed teenager who stood in front of Seventh Highness Chong Yan with a sword in his hand. It was this black-robed teenager who killed a law enforcer with a single strike.
'Where exactly did this expert appear? Isn't that Guest Elder Flying Snow a stage four World Deity? How could he kill a law enforcer?' The golden-robed judge emissary knew that things were amiss. He had to eliminate this Guest Elder Flying snow. Otherwise, the outcome of the entire battle would change. He immediately sent his orders, "The five of you team up and kill him for me."
"Yes."
Currently, Chong-Shi World Clan's Second Elder had died in battle, leaving behind only the Forefather and Grand Elder remaining.
"Sou sou sou sou sou."
The five law enforcers rushed down at the same time.
The golden-robed judge emissary was single-handedly suppressing Chong-Shi Forefather using the power from the 'Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship', yet nobody was dealing with the Grand Elder; he was standing there staring in space.
"Grand Elder, quickly go and save the clansmen!" Chong-Shi Forefather sent his orders. At the same time, he noticed Xue Ying; a strand of hope began brimming in his eyes.
…
"Kill."
"Who would have thought this Guest Elder Flying Snow is concealing such powerful strength."
"Let's exterminate him together."
The five blood-robed law enforcers turned into five streams of light. All of them had thunder-fire covering their bodies. Their eyes were filled with killing intent as they lept towards Xue Ying as a group.
Nevertheless, Xue Ying remained standing there. Behind him, Seventh Highness Chong Yan was slightly dazed-his teacher had handled his opponent with a single sword. He could not believe what had happened even until now.
"Did you see clearly?" Xue Ying's voice sounded, "If you didn't, then have a closer look this time to see how your teacher uses his sword." If in the Deity world and Abyss, the battle at the level of powerful existences could not be discerned clearly by Deities. However, in this world, the suppression of laws had wholly suppressed the speed of powerful existences, thus making their movements perceptible.
Before he finished speaking, Xue Ying had already turned into a stream of light as he took the initiative to attack.
"Hong!"
A thunder-fire stream of light went crashing against the other five streams of thunder-fire light in midair.
"Die."
"Fighting against my Sky Fire Palace?"
"Where did this brat appear?"
The killing intents within those five law enforcers rushed up to the sky. They did not think that they would lose after teaming together.
Suddenly, the figure of Xue Ying who came up to them brought his blade up and bypassed them. At the same time, the divine sword slashed directly at a tall enforcer. That tall enforcer was furiously waving the great-ax in his hand, yet the divine sword was fleeting and unpredictable-its speed was miraculously fast and went brushing past 'sinisterly' under cover of the thunder-fire. That great-ax could not parry against the sword. Instead, the sword severed the other party's neck, causing his head to fly.
Closely following that, the power in that divine sword was released in the other party's body, causing it to start disintegrating as those sword streams diverged and sliced everything in their way.
"What."
The four law enforcers who were originally full of confidence felt a chill down their spine.
Just a single move and another succumbed. Moreover, their weapons could not touch Xue Ying at all.
"So fast."
"Such fast speed, such fast sword too."
They could not believe it.
Under the suppression of laws in this world, the other party could hold such superiority in speed still.
"Hu, hu."
After Xue Ying killed an enemy, he did not stop. Sword streams that were like reflections from the sun moved at a magical speed-"Hong". Another exchange and he had killed another emissary who was wielding a blade.
The law enforcers who were stronger than average, could not retaliate in front of this 'Guest Elder Flying Snow'.
"Flee!"
"Quickly flee!"
"Flee!"
The remaining three law enforcers did not have any single thought of a miracle happening. They could feel the gap in combat power. Even though they could not comprehend how this 'Guest Elder Flying Snow' become such a terrifying existence in an instance, they understood that they would never triumph over the other party. Hence, they had to flee. Despite these bodies being avatars, they would still lose all treasures if they died.
"Xiu xiu xiu", the three law enforcers went on separate ways as they fled.
They were very clear that if they escaped together, they would only be killed one after another considering the speed of 'Guest Elder Flying Snow'.
"Hu."
At that moment when two law enforcers were escaping towards the Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship in the sky, another law enforcer was exterminated. Xue Ying watched this happening indifferently with a sword in his hand. He knew that he could not catch up to the enemies unless he exposed more of his power, yet it would be detrimental to reveal his strength so early since he was here for the secret of this world.
"Judge emissary, that Guest Elder Flying Snow is too formidable. We can't defeat him."
"Quickly leave."
The other two law enforcers hid in the Golden termination Fire Cloud Ship.
The golden-robed judge emissary who had been suppressing Chong-Shi Forefather gave the distant Xue Ying a look of shock. He had seen the entire battle and knew that in a one-on-one confrontation, it would be tough even for him to kill a law enforcer since he was only slightly stronger than them. Moreover, even with the help of the 'Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship', he had to use a considerable amount of moves to kill one.
This Guest Elder Fly Snow was too powerful.
"Judge emissary?" Xue Ying stood in midair. His gaze landed on that emissary, "You can always stay here if you are not thinking of leaving."
The moment he finished speaking, "sou", the golden-robed judge emissary instantly retreated. He tunneled into the Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship. It was clear that he did not wish to fight against such terrifying expert.

chapters.title: Chapter 684 - 《Six Sever Sword Styles》
chapters.content:
Chapter 684: 《Six Sever Sword Styles》
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Hiding in the Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship, the golden-robed 'judge emissary' and the other two law enforcers let out a sigh of relief. That mysterious 'Guest Elder Flying Snow' had given them too much pressure.
"Where did that Guest Elder Flying Snow originate from?" The golden-robed judge emissary frowned, "He is so powerful?"
"That's right. Four out of six of us have died in his hands." The other two blood-robed law enforcers did not believe it. It felt like a nightmare to them. "The intelligence has reported him as a very low-key stage four World Deity. In my opinion, he should be some old monster who is hiding within the Chong-Shi World Clan. With such a powerful strength, only the two palace master of our Sky Fire Palace could have some chance of killing him."
The other three looked beneath them through the Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship. They felt great injustice at failure this time.
Despite preparing adequately which the Chong-Shi World Clan could not defend against them, this 'Guest Elder Flying Snow' had suddenly appeared.
…
In midair, Xue Ying sheathed back the sword in his hand. The Grand Elder soon came flying over. Chong-Shi Forefather was also flying in his direction. The two of them were feeling very excited at this moment.
They were not fools.
At that juncture, they understood that the 'Guest Elder Flying Snow' who joined their Chong-Shi World Clan, should be a terrifying, powerful existence, one who eclipsed the entire clan regarding power! Most likely only experts from the three Holy Lands in the whole world could deal with this old monster.
"Flying Snow…" Chong-Shi Forefather flew over. He hesitated when calling out to him.
"Just continue calling me Guest Elder Flying Snow." Xue Ying mentioned.
"Guest Elder Flying Snow." The smile on Chong-Shi Forefather became much more vibrant. Even Grand Elder who was by the side was laughing out loud. Despite the enormous losses they suffered this time, those who died like Second Elder and Third Elder were just avatars and could be cultivated back quickly. Moreover, the foundation of their clan territory had not been destroyed, so the losses were much better than what they expected it to be.
"This time, it has been all thanks to Guest Elder Flying Snow. Otherwise, our Chong-Shi Clan would have encountered huge trouble, with many dying in the battle. Who would have thought the Sky Fire Palace will be so vicious. It is fine for them not to act, yet the moment they acted, even the palace protection treasure-the Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship-had been sent." Chong-Shi Forefather felt quite furious at that.
"Right, if not for Guest Elder Flying Snow, we are all doomed." Grand Elder began flattering him. In the past, his demeanor was quite snobbish, yet at this moment, he was genuinely respectful of this guest elder.
That was how the cultivation world functioned.
The strong was respected!
With Xue Ying's combat power, he could easily exterminate their Chong-Shi Clan.
"I am the teacher of Little Seven, so it is natural for me to stand out." Xue Ying chuckled.
"Right right right." Chong-Shi Forefather nodded profusely, "Yan'er's teacher."
It was truly lucky of him-lucky that his son could become the disciple of such a powerful expert and allow their Chong-Shi clan to gain a huge, reliable pillar.
And at this moment, a huge sound that reverberated across the sky came from that Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship: "Old Chong, don't think that you can disregard my Sky Fire Cloud just because you have the reliance of that Guest Elder Flying Snow. I urge you to hand over that treasure obediently still… otherwise, Guest Elder Flying Snow will not be able to protect you another time! Ultimately, this world belongs to the three Holy Grounds, and a single Guest Elder Flying Snow could not overthrow the world."
Xue Ying looked towards that Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship in the sky.
"Guest Elder Flying Snow." That cold voice continued, "You have killed the law enforcers from my Sky Fire Cloud. Thus, I encourage you to plead guilty and ask for mercy from the Sky Fire Palace yourself. Otherwise… hmph, even if you are stronger, you will only die in the end."
"Your tone is quite huge, but it's a pity that your guts is quite lacking and do not dare to come out from that warship." Xue Ying chuckled. Even though this warship was stalwart in defense and nobody could enter it directly under ordinary circumstances, he could always rely on the 'Mirage World' to sneak his way in and obliterate them. However, revealing his absolute move for the sake of these few brats was not worth it.
"Hmph, then you should just wait and see."
That Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship disappeared along with the accompaniments of cold laughter.
Chong-Shi Forefather and Grand Elder felt anxious in their heart after seeing this. The two of them understood that the Sky Fire Palace would not let things by so easily.
"Patriarch, what should we do?" The Grand Elder transmitted, "Unless we have to hand over the True God weapon?"
"The True God weapon is our only hope for opening the Dao. Naturally, we will never hand it over. We create the Chong-Shi World Clan, and as long as I am alive, we can rebuild it again. Thus, we must keep the True God weapon with us." Chong-Shi Forefather remained unwavering. He transmitted, "Fortunately, we have Guest Elder Flying Snow. Besides, our relationship with the Left Palace Head of Sky Fire Palace is good. This time, it had been the Right Palace Head who acted, so the Sky Fire Palace will not put in all the effort to deal with us. We can still persevere on, and in the worst case, we could always give this place up."
"Mn." The Grand Elder agreed as well.
The two had the same thinking.
At the same time, they were exceptionally grateful to Xue Ying.
"Guest Elder Flying Snow, let us descend first." Chong-Shi Forefather said.
"Let's." Xue Ying nodded.
The many clansmen from the Chong-Shi World Clan were watching from below. There was even a large number of guards and maidservants, and also Seventh Highness 'Chong Yan' especially who were watching this in a daze. He could not help but rub his eyes and looked towards those two with the highest statuses in their clan-his father and the Grand Elder who were currently treating his teacher passionately.
'Teacher is actually so formidable. My teacher is way too formidable already!' Chong Yan did not dare believe it.
"Seventh Highness." A figure appeared beside. It was the housekeeper within the Chong-Shi World Clan. The housekeeper was watching ruefully and transmitting, "Your Highness, that time when you decided stubbornly to take Guest Elder Flying Snow as your teacher, I had felt that Your Highness is just throwing your tantrum. Now that I see, Your Highness' decision is the wiser choice, and I was indeed wrong. Guest Elder Flying Snow's combat power is too unfathomable."
…
The Chong-Shi World Clan was bustling with activity. Many guards, maidservants, and clansmen were surreptitiously discussing about this Guest Elder Flying Snow. They did not even dare to speak about it; instead, they were transmitting messages around since they were afraid of offending him.
And within the main visitor hall, Chong-Shi Forefather took the initiative to hold a feast just to show his appreciation for Guest Elder Flying Snow. Seventh Highness 'Chong Yan' had even attended it. As for the Second Elder and Third Elder who were located 500 billion kilometers away, they borrowed upon karma to form an incarnation to participate in the feast.
Everyone was full of praises.
The star of the feast was Xue Ying, and even Chong-Shi Forefather lowered his posture against him.
After the banquet ended, everyone went back, leaving behind the patriarch and three elders who accompanied Xue Ying.
"Guest Elder Flying Snow, the Sky Fire Palace will most likely not let things by with how huge the matter has become." Only then did Chong-Shi Forefather started saying. He sighed, "Things are becoming complicated."
"The Sky Fire Palace is tough to deal with." Xue Ying sighed back, "And the power of the three Holy Grounds is unfathomable too.
"Mn."
Chong-Shi Forefather and the three elders could feel an unseen pressure pressing on them.
The three Holy Grounds had rooted their foundation firmly in this world. Could they really protect their True God weapon? Yet they had cultivated for an extended period, and this True God weapon was their hope towards opening the Dao. How could they be willing to give it up?
'This Guest Elder Flying Snow did not mention if he will help us defend against the Sky Fire Palace.' Chong-Shi Forefather thought, 'And I wonder if the "Six Sever Sword Styles" will satisfy him?'
Chong-Shi Forefather and the three elders exchanged glances.
And then, Chong-Shi Forefather personally asked, "Guest Elder Flying Snow has saved our Chong-Shi World Clan this time. It is hard for my Chong-Shi World Clan to repay this gratitude. I've heard that Guest Elder Flying Snow requires the "Six Sever Sword Styles"?"
"Yes, I like researching into sword techniques." Xue Ying replied.
That was a lie.
He wanted to learn this absolute art because of the higher usage of 'Dao' since after all, sword techniques, spear techniques, or blade techniques were just external displays.
"Follow me, Guest Elder Flying Snow." Chong-Shi Forefather chuckled.
Xue Ying smiled back as he followed behind the patriarch into the forbidden ground of the clan.
Layers of array heavily guarded it.
Deep within the forbidden ground, there was a bookshelf within a cultivation room. Chong-Shi Forefather took a piece of silk and passed it to Xue Ying: "This is the original copy of "Six Sever Sword Styles". Please have a look, Guest Elder Flying Snow."
Xue Ying received that gray piece of silk. He could see the six main sword techniques with a glance.
After slightly extending his senses across the scroll, dim golden lights were appearing over those six main sword techniques depicted on the scroll. At the same time, large amounts of information went surging into his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 685 - Dumbstruck
chapters.content:
Chapter 685: Dumbstruck
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying's soul was much stronger than it had been in the past; learning a complete absolute art was easy and relaxed for him now. Even his thoughts were barely affected as he multi-tasked and read through it.
"It's the same as I had thought." There was a restrained ecstasy in Xue Ying's heart, "This truly is an Absolute Art of the Slaughter Dao!"
Previously he had made a judgment based on outside rumors. Although he was 70% to 80% confident, he had been worried that he concluded it wrongly.
"The Six Sever Sword Styles…"
Countless sword lights flickered within Xue Ying's eyes.
The first Sword Sever Style, the second Sword Sever Style… he quickly comprehended and learned them. He had opened the Dao of Slaughter. For the first five sword styles, he was able to understand most of them at first glance. Naturally, learning it was swift.
"What an awesome killing move." Xue Ying exclaimed in his heart, "The killing intent is deeply hidden. There is no need to be anxious in battle too. rather, it seeks for the crucial moment before unleashing the killing move without any forewarning and killing the enemy outside their expectations."
Xue Ying couldn't help but admire the creator of the "Six Sever Sword Styles".
The Dao of Slaughter that he had grasped was about condensing one's power before bursting forth in an instant!
Nevertheless, the core line of thought for the "Six Sever Sword Styles" was not to attack the enemy first, but rather to 'hide oneself deeply' and bury one's killing intent. As the power of the sword technique was being accumulated silently, at the most crucial moment, the technique would expose a horrifying fang that could kill the other party in one fell swoop!
…
The nearby Forefather Chong Shi looked at Xue Ying somewhat astonishingly. The current Xue Ying was holding onto a grey cloth. Sword lights were flickering in both eyes. There was a terrifying killing intent sometimes deeply hidden in his eyes and occasionally bursting forth. When it was deeply hidden… even Forefather Chong Shi couldn't detect the slightest trace of killing intent. But when it burst forth, even Forefather Chong Shi couldn't help but have his heart tremble and feel fear.
'What a terrifying killing intent.' Forefather Chong Shi sensed the fear that couldn't help but be borne out of his heart, 'This guest elder Flying Snow seems not to have gone all out when he was fighting the Judge Emissary and the others.'
'That's good too. The stronger he is, the more helpful he could be towards our Chong Shi World Clan.' Forefather Chong Shi felt his heart turning calm, 'If he wished to deal against my Chong Shi Clan, he would have done so a long time ago. Since he hasn't done anything for a long time and is even teaching Yan'er, he should probably have some affection towards Yan'er.'
Towards the terrifying and mysterious guest elder Flying Snow, Forefather Chong Shi could only hope for the other party to not be a malicious character.
"What a good "Six Sever Sword Styles"." The swords lights in Xue Ying's eyes dissipated, regaining their gentleness. He then passed the cloth in his hand back to Forefather Chong Shi, "Patriarch of Chong Shi, it is unlikely that the Sky Fire Palace will drop this matter. The other two of the three great holy grounds might perhaps pay closer notice to this clan. The precious treasure you received would likely entice the greed of the Sky Fire Clan, and even the other two holy grounds as well."
"Yes." Forefather Chong Shi nodded.
"What precious treasure is it?" Xue Ying asked.
"A True God Weapon." Forefather Chong Shi did not conceal it. It was no longer a secret, and there it was no reason to hide it from Guest Elder Flying Snow and make him unhappy.
"Oh." Xue Ying nodded.
Forefather Chong Shi was somewhat nervous upon seeing this. He was afraid that Guest Elder Flying Snow would also develop thoughts of avarice. Thus, he said, "If Guest Elder Flying Snow wishes to examine the True God Weapon, then I can let an incarnation of Guest Elder Flying Snow go over and have a look."
"No need." Xue Ying indifferently said.
Xue Ying genuinely did not care about the True God Weapon so valued by this world.
In the Deity World and Dark Abyss, although True God Weapons were precious, those on his level would still come into contact with them. Personally, he even had three such weapons of which two contained an Eternal Dao! His wife, Jing Qiu, also had one. Furthermore, after receiving a True God Weapon, he understood that True God weapons might be helpful in opening one's Dao, but it was constrained too.
If one could easily open up Dao after Dao, then the Bloodshed God-Emperor and Monarch Green would not have only opened up three Daos. The Temporal Island Master and Myriad God Palace Master would not merely master one type of Dao.
The Dao that one comprehended was usually closely related to oneself.
When Xue Ying had been a Transcendent, he comprehended the 'True Meaning of the World', and the 'True Meaning of Mirage' first. Towards the areas he originally had talent in coupled with the aid of many opportunities, he was ultimately able to open the 'Dao of Mirage'.
For example, amongst the grade two True Meanings he had comprehended as a Transcendent, the first was the embryonic form of Extreme Piercing. That led to the Slaughter Dao that he now comprehended to converge power to one point before bursting forth…
The sentiments of the world, the understanding of the myriad existences, as well as the heart realm were all aspects that influenced the direction of cultivation.
External opportunities would only hasten the journey.
Therefore if one found a True God weapon that suited themselves, it might be helpful. If one received a True God weapon that did not suit themselves, for instance, even if someone placed the 'Temporal Palace' in front of Xue Ying and forced him to comprehend it, Xue Ying would still have a hard time trying to open the 'Dao of Time-Space'.
"You really do not want to?" Forefather Chong Shi couldn't help but ask, "Guest elder has been extremely generous to our Chong Shi clan, and inspecting this True God weapon is merely a minor matter."
"No need"
Xue Ying said.
He felt that the Dao of Mirage and the Dao of Slaughter were enough for him to study, and for the moment, he had no longing for other Daos.
"The Sky Fire Palace and the two other Holy Grounds will perhaps pay greater interest here. Since I am helping your Chong Shi Clan, I will also personally face them. Thus, I hope to deepen my understanding of the other party." Xue Ying said.
"That is natural." Forefather Chong Shi repeatedly nodded. He then took the initiative to narrate, "Of the Three Great Holy Grounds, I'll speak of the Sky Fire Palace first…"
…
As Forefather Chong Shi narrated, Xue Ying soon understood the compositions of this world's power.
The Three Great Holy grounds all had Paragon level existences.
There were two Paragons in the Sky Fire Palace and Xu Kingdom, and one Paragon level existence in the Spectre Prefecture.
In this world, there was a total of five Paragons, and this occupied the highest level. They had plundered many treasures and absolute arts, stabilizing their dominance in this world.
Actually, there were, in fact, many 'absolute arts' in this world.
They were passed down one by one from the previous epochs.
Moreover, there were no restrictions on these absolute arts. As long as one thoroughly comprehended it, it was possible for them to create new originals before passing them on! Therefore there were many Absolute Arts. Every single epoch would see copies other than the original one being passed down.
"What is the reason that Ancestor Devil's old Star Chart lead me here?" Xue Ying felt puzzled. The more he understood about this world, the more bewildered he became.
******
This world.
Because of the suppression of laws, it was usually impossible to teleport, and tunnel through space. Only when one opened their Dao, transcending the ordinary laws of the world, such as Xue Ying's 'Mirage World', could one teleport! Therefore, traveling took a long time for them. Even if one traveled at full speed from the Chong Shi Clan to the Sky Fire Palace with the Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship, it would still take more than five years to arrive.
Of course, as they were moving, their incarnations had already reported upwards.
"Guest Elder Flying Snow?" Within the Sky Fire Palace, A red-haired man with faint flames over his body frowned.
The Judge Emissary and six law enforcers appeared with their incarnations. They were incomparably respectful currently.
"Palace master, the strength of that Guest Elder Flying Snow is deep and unfathomable. One of his moves can kill an enforcer. When five enforcers joined hands to surround him, three of us have been killed in an extremely short period. The last two were able to escape because they hid themselves within the Golden Termination Fire Cloud Ship. If they were a little slower in fleeing, I'm afraid that we would all have been killed this time." The golden-haired enforcer deferentially reported.
"Too strong."
"His strength far exceeds ours." Each of the law enforcers said.
The red-haired man surrounded with flames frowned and nodded, then waved his hand: "You guys are dismissed."
"Yes."
Each of their incarnations disappeared immediately.
At this time another figure walked over. He was a black-haired golden-robed male. There were golden flames in his eyes, and he smiled: "What is it, they lost? As I said, it's only a True God Weapon, so why must you plunder it forcefully?
"Elder brother." The red-haired man frowned, "True God Weapons are extremely rare. We've already opened our Dao, so their aid is limited to us. But our Sky Fire Palace has many powerful existences, and how is it that the Chong Shi Clan deserves treasures like a True God Weapon?"
The black-haired golden-robed man shook his head and smiled. He did not continue speaking anymore.
Although the Sky Fire Palace was split into factions, in reality their relationship was excellent. There were only two existences in this world who had opened the Dao of Flames. Naturally, they would discuss on the Dao with each other and help each other.
"With how powerful that Guest Elder Flying Snow is, it is unlikely that he is a stage four World Deity." The black haired golden robed man said.
"I agree with you on this. Perhaps, he is a newly-emerged Paragon who deliberately disguised his power." The red-haired man was somewhat anxious, "Senior brother, if it's some newly emerged Paragon, then the problem will be significant.
"Go have a look at the River of Time. If he is a Paragon and has already transcended, then he should not be in the River of Time." The black-robed golden-haired man said.
"Mn." The red-haired male nodded.
"Hu."
The two of them looked towards the distance in midair.
