This layer of space began to blur, showing a deeper layer of space underneath it with a majestic, surging river in it.
The two palace lords of the Sky Fire Palace stared at this River of Time. Within the River of Time, countless lives bobbed. It was possible for them to find the living beings situated within by following along karma.
"Guest Elder Flying Snow." The two of them began their search by using the karma they had with Guest Elder Flying Snow.
Soon.
Because Xue Ying had arrived in this world, it was possible to find Xue Ying within the area of the River of Time that corresponded to this world.
"Mn?"
The two Palace Lords stared at the scene in front of them with shock.
Within this River of Time, there was an incomparably huge and lofty figure in the water. He was too large, and the width of his waist occupied nearly a tenth of the width of the river. If both his hands were stretched out, perhaps it was possible for those hands to envelop half the River of Time. Even ordinary stage four World Deities were as small as crickets and ants in front of this lofty giant.
"This, why is it so huge?" The two Palace Lords of the Sky Fire Palace were dumbstruck.
"He truly has not transcended, but why would…"
Seeing such a large body within the River of Time, the two Palace Lords of the Sky Fire Palace felt somewhat threatened.
…
It was not just the two palace masters of the Sky Fire Palace, even the 'Xu Kingdom' and 'Specter Prefecture' had checked the River of Time. They wanted to know if this Guest Elder Flying Snow was really a stage four World Deity.
Seeing that scene, they fell into a daze too.
"This kind of body?"
"In front of him, the river of time is only a small stream."
The two Emperors of the Xu Kingdom, and the Prefecture Master of the Spectre Prefecture were all dazed.
Before this they hadn't seen it or even heard of it.
It didn't even exist in the records of history! There was never a stage four World Deity who appeared in their world that had opened a Dao. Thus, this scene sufficed to turn them dumbstruck.

chapters.title: Chapter 686 - Your Honor
chapters.content:
Chapter 686: Your Honor
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The five Paragons who were from the three Holy Grounds-Sky Fire Palace, Xu Empire, and Specter Prefecture, vaguely understood from that incomparably vast and towering figure situated within the River of Time, that this Guest Elder Flying Snow was someone extraordinary! After all, what was shown in the 'River of Time' could not be disguised, and everything would appear according to the operating cosmic laws.
Knowing that 'Guest Elder Flying Snow' was extraordinary was one thing. Where was he extraordinary? Why exactly was he so unique? What made him so special?
These remained unknown!
Such an occurrence had never been recorded in history before, yet it was no longer the case! Guest Elder Flying Snow was the only stage four World Deity who had that huge of a figure within the River of Time. His waist was one-tenth of the width of the River of Time. Such a diameter was unfathomable.
"Paragon Emperor Xu, you are the most experienced of us. Do you know what makes this Guest Elder Flying Snow so special?"
"I don't. I have never heard of such things either."
"Brother Golden Fire, what about you?"
"I am also bitterly pondering over this, yet to no avail. However, the cosmic laws will never be fake."
The strongest amongst the five Paragons were Paragon Emperor Xu and Golden Fire Palace Master; the other three were comparably weaker. Even though the Specter Prefecture Master had started a Holy Ground all by himself, it was because the Dao he opened was relatively bizarre.
"Fellow gentlemen, for such an unfathomable stage four World Deity to appear unprecedented, is it related to the legendary 'Ancient Shrine'?"
"Ancient Shrine?"
"Right, it is most likely only the Ancient Shrine will create such mysterious circumstances."
"But the Ancient Shrine is located in my Xu Empire. I dare say that this Guest Elder Flying Snow has never stepped into the Ancient Shrine before." Paragon Emperor Xu directly declared. He was the oldest Paragon in this world, and also the strongest amongst them. That time, he had long built his Xu Empire right around the boundary region of this mysterious 'Ancient Shrine'.
"Fellow gentlemen had been to the Ancient Shrine, so think about it-if that Guest Elder Flying Snow has been there as an ordinary stage four World Deity, he will not have any benefits. I believe fellow gentlemen know how frightening that place is."
"Mn."
"But other than the Ancient Shrine, I can't think of any other reasons."
The five Paragons were discussing amongst each other. They were all feeling bewildered.
"My Sky fire Palace has caused this matter, so I and Fei Huo will take responsibility in investigating the background of this guest elder." Paragon Golden Fire said.
…
Chong-Shi World Clan.
At this moment within the Chong-Shi World Clan, the clan disciples, guards, maidservants, guest elders and elders were all looking at Xue Ying differently; their attitude towards him had become much more respectful. They were clear that he was someone who could kill powerful existences like killing chickens. And Seventh Highness 'Chong Yan' was even more proud of his teacher for he had been teaching him sword techniques frequently.
Instead, it was those with the highest statuses-Chong-Shi Forefather, Grand Elder and several others who felt worried inwardly. They knew that the 'Sky Fire Palace' would not let matters rest!
Year passed by year.
Under the suppression of laws, one could only travel a few ten thousand kilometers every second. Rushing over from the Sky Fire Palace to the Chong-Shi World Clan, with how big this world was, it would take a few years to travel.
Within the courtyard, Xue Ying was seated cross-legged on the plains. A sword was placed on his leg. He was currently cultivating with his eyes closed and would display a few moves with his divine sword time after time.
Not far away, the white-robed teenager 'Chong Yan' widened his eyes and observed his teacher: 'Formidable, truly formidable. At first glance, it seems ordinary. However, the more I experience it, the more unfathomable it becomes.' Chong Yan felt startled in his heart. He did not know that the current sword technique Xue Ying was casually displaying had been his understanding of the sixth and final style from the "Six-Swords Sever Style".
Being an existence who opened the Dao of Slaughter, he had finished cultivating the first five styles of the "Six Sever Sword Styles" in just three days. Even though he spent a longer period trying to cultivate the final style, he had completed it within 200 years or so.
That's because his true body was cultivating within a hundred times time-accelerated environment within the distant material realm in the Crimson Rock Mountain, yet only two years passed in the outer world.
After grasping hold of the "Six Sever Sword Styles", Xue Ying began researching into how the sixth and final style was created along with how the Dao of Slaughter was added. One had to know that the 'Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction' was someone with power very close to Monarch Green's. He had comprehended the lower half of the Blood Demon Scripture before creating an absolute art that belonged to himself! Learning an absolute that used the Dao that belonged to oneself was one aspect. More importantly, it was how the creator created it.
Creating an absolute art that belonged to oneself would greatly boost one's combat power!
After all, there were differences in the usage of the same Dao of Slaughter.
As for the sword technique?
It was the most shallow on the outer appearance. Using the sword, using the blade or using the spear were just external appearances. What was core would be the inner law of profound mysteries!
'Learning an absolute art utilizing the Dao of Slaughter will greatly increase the power of my attacks using the Dao of Slaughter.' Xue Ying was in great joy, 'But this isn't enough. If I can create my absolute art in the future, it might be possible for me to fight against Rulers.'
The Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction had precisely created an absolute art for himself that gave him the power to fight against Rulers.
Many within the Deity world and Abyss wished to follow what Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction did. Xue Ying did think he could undoubtedly achieve it, though he had his strengths. With the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter used together, even Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction would envy him.
"Hong!"
Suddenly, a terrifying aura rushed over from afar.
Xue Ying who was seated in the courtyard turned over. His right hand beckoned to the distant Seventh Highness, causing him to fly directly over to where Xue Ying was. Chong Yan felt puzzled: "Teacher, what's the matter?"
"Look by the side obediently." Xue Ying ordered.
"Who?" The Chong-Shi Forefather had angrily shouted out. The clan arrays were activated.
A dazzling stream of flames fell towards the Chong-Shi World Clan with frightening power.
This might made Xue Ying frowned slightly: 'Paragon?'
That flame was not just the thunder-fire which appeared because of the laws of this world. Instead, it was a terrifying flame that appeared after opening one's Dao. Even though it could not compare with what 'Paragon Huo Cheng' could do, it made Xue Ying feel the threat: 'It seems that he should have studied some absolute art related to the Dao of Flame. The Paragons of this world could not be underestimated since most of them could learn an absolute art suitable for them.'
"Hong."
This stream of flame directly clashed into the courtyard. It was very overbearing. The unseen power rushed out in all directions.
The entire arrays within the Chong-Shi World Clan were operating. Black waves began surging up violently as it suppressed the incoming flames. After all, this was just some repercussions coming from the aura emitted by a Paragon, and the arrays of the Chong-Shi World Clan could still resist against it.
But half of the entire courtyard had been destroyed.
Behind where Xue Ying stood, the grass remained untouched.
"Sou sou sou sou!"
Following that, four figures rushed over. They were Chong-Shi Forefather and the three powerful existences elders. They saw that it was a red-haired male who was bathed in flame arriving from that stream of fire. He stood with his hands behind his back, and his eyes were carrying endless power. The fire on the surface of his body was filled with grandeur, causing Chong-Shi Forefather and the rest to feel the threat of death.
"Right Palace Head." Chong-Shi Forefather and the other three elders felt heart tightening. Even though they were prepared, seeing one of the two palace masters from the Sky Fire Palace which stood at the peak of the world, the Right Palace Head's 'Fei Huo Palace Master' standing here made them tremble.
"Sky Fire Palace's Right Palace Master?" Chong Yan who stood behind Xue Ying felt nervous too. He could not help but take a step towards Xue Ying.
Xue Ying stood there with his sword still behind his back. He looked at that red-haired male who was emitting an oppressive aura and chuckled, "Fei Huo Palace Master?"
Those present at the scene-the patriarch, the three elders and Seventh Highness, could not help but feel admiration for him.
They were feeling nervous when facing Fei Huo Palace Head. Nevertheless, this Guest Elder Flying Snow remained calm as if he was meeting an ordinary enemy.
"Interesting." Fei Huo Palace Head looked at this black-robed teenager who had a divine sword on his back. He gave off an ordinary stage four World Deity aura, but he had seen the River of Time and knew this guest elder was extraordinary.
"Are you thinking of helping the Chong-Shi World Clan?" Fei Huo Palace Master asked casually.
"Yes." Xue Ying nodded. His reply was likewise casual.
"Then you are planning to become enemies with my Sky Fire Palace?" Fei Huo Palace Master continued asking.
The hearts of the five other people including the Chong-Shi Forefather were racing. They were genuinely anxious at that moment.
"I do not wish to become enemies with the Sky Fire Palace, but if the Sky Fire Palace do not give up, then let us become enemies." Xue Ying answered.
"Oh?" Fei Huo Palace Master frowned slightly.
Too calm.
Too indifferent.
There were almost none who dared remain calm while saying 'to become enemies with the Sky Fire Palace'.
"You are a World Deity, yet you have such a power. I believe you should have met some phenomenal opportunity." Fei Huo Palace Head asked.
"Indeed." Xue Ying did not elaborate.
"Even if you don't tell me, I know that you have been to the Ancient Shrine." Fei Huo Palace Head continued. At the same time, he was carefully observing the expression of Xue Ying to confirm his deductions.
Xue Ying felt his heart palpitating after hearing that.
Ancient Shrine?
He was a stage four World Deity who could display such heaven-shattering power, and from the reports obtained in the Chong-Shi Clan, such occurrence had never happened in history. Regardless, the other party though he had been to the Ancient Shrine?
'Ancient Shrine?' Xue Ying had a vague feeling that this place should be an extraordinary place. It could possibly be related to the destination plotted on that star map which led him here!

chapters.title: Chapter 687 - Kill
chapters.content:
Chapter 687: Kill
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"Where is this Ancient Shrine?" Xue Ying asked.
"You do not know?" Fei Huo Palace Master sneered.
"I do not know." Xue Ying nodded.
Fei Huo Palace Master frowned.
He was such a powerful stage four World Deity; this was unprecedented in history. That was why they had guessed that it must be something related to the mysterious 'Ancient Shrine'.
"Then why is your combat power so much greater than powerful existences?" Fei Huo Palace Master yelled out with a frown.
"Because I cultivated." Xue Ying coolly answered.
A sneer appeared on the edge of Fei Huo Palace Master's lips: "Guest Elder Flying Snow, you do know that it has been a long time since there is someone who dares to be so insolent in front of me other than the other four Paragons."
"Insolent? Am I?" Xue Ying questioned.
"Not respecting me means you are insolent." Fei Huo Palace Master sneered.
Chong-Shi Forefather, the three elders, and Seventh Highness Chong Yan were feeling nervous by the side. If it were them, they would never be able to converse so casually with 'Fei Huo Palace Master'. After all, he was the Fei Huo Palace Master, and also one of the five apex existences in this world! He had the qualifications to disdain upon countless lives! Ordinary powerful existences did not dare to be disrespectful when facing these five beings.
"Not being respectful means insolence?" Xue Ying chuckled, "Quite interesting. Then respectable Fei Huo Palace Master, if you have no other matters, please leave. I still wish to continue guiding my disciple and will not accompany you any further."
"Guide your disciple? Survive first before speaking!" Fei Huo Palace Master roared in a fury.
Since he could not find out the other party's secrets with words, he would fight!
He could always understand what was the background of the other party by fighting with him!
"Hong~"
Fei Huo Palace Master suddenly sent a punch out.
"Hong!"
A terrifying flame of light charged over. Everywhere it passed would be burnt to ashes. The surrounding space even had many black cracks forming. This was a flame that was formed after opening the Dao; it was immeasurably tyrannical. This single scene made the Chong-Shi Forefather, Chong Yan and the others feel a chill down their heart.
"Hmph." Xue Ying sent out his fist. His fist was covered in a layer of black armor. When he punched out, it caused space to collapse. This fist was moving at speed beyond Fei Huo Palace Master's as it directly clashed against the other party's fist.
Fist against fist.
"Peng!"
The entire figure of Fei Huo Palace Master was blasted back. Alarm filled his face as he spurted out blood.
Xue Ying then coldly mentioned, "You are within the clan's arrays, so don't leave."
"Sou."
Xue Ying shot out towards the Fei Huo Palace Master.
"This, this, this…" Chong-Shi Forefather fell in a daze. The other three powerful existence elders were also in a trance. As for Seventh Highness Chong Yan, he was entirely stunned.
Fei Huo Palace Master was someone who stood at the peak of this world, yet he had been blasted away with a single fist! The status of Fei Huo Palace Master in this world was comparable to the Rulers in Deity world and Abyss. A situation when some random ordinary powerful existence appeared that blasted a Ruler away with a single fist would similarly shock countless cultivators.
…
Fei Huo Palace Master felt that terrifying strength engulfing his entire body. His fist was utterly shattered-the bones were also fractured. Blood spurt out from his whole body as he trembled and flew back for a few ten thousand kilometers.
'How could this be?' Fei Huo Palace Master did not dare believe, 'I am a Paragon! I am a Paragon and have cultivated absolute arts, yet why would I be blasted by a single punch from a stage four World Deity?'
"Sou."
Xue Ying appeared in the space on the other side. He shook his head inwardly while standing in the air, 'I exerted too much strength, thinking that the Paragons in this world can't be underestimated because they have cultivated in an appropriate absolute art. As a result, I've used 50% of my strength all of a sudden! It is too overwhelming. Even though this world has absolute arts that could provide them with a spurt of strength and speed, it is far beyond to the "Myriad Devil True Body".'
It wasn't just this world. There was truly no absolute arts even in the Deity world and Abyss that were on the same level as the "Myriad Devil True Body". Ancestor Devil had relied on it to render Lake Heart Island master helpless against him. He had even utilized his art to refine the Ancient Demon.
Cultivating all six grand inheritances, with the 'Blood Demon Scripture' being one of them, it would allow one to reach large success in the foundation of "Myriad Devil True Body".
Xue Ying had suffered so much to reach the second level in his cultivation heart. Only then could he succeed in cultivating the initial scroll. One could see how frightening this absolute art was. It was the strongest absolute art in the history of Deity world, and Abyss meant to cultivate one's body.
Even if he used 50% of his strength, it was enough to suppress this Fei Huo Palace Master completely.
'Just having strength and speed is useless; instead, usage of the realm is more important.' Fei Huo Palace Master was slightly angry and mad. The injuries on his body were rapidly recovering. At the same time, he extended both his hands, causing numerous flames to form. It had generated an enormous array in midair and went engulfing towards Xue Ying.
"Hmph." Xue Ying took out his sword.
This opponent in front of him was not worth him using his spear.
Using the sword sufficed.
"Hua!"
A blood sword stream that was like silk appeared. It directly cut across the incoming red flames before proceeding on to Fei Huo Palace Master. This sword was so swift that it gave Fei Huo Palace Master the feeling that he could not evade: 'What is happening? I am a Paragon, yet why am I unable to evade his sword technique? I am unable to see through the profound mysteries in his sword technique?'
He felt slightly flustered. A black wooden rod soon appeared in his hand as Fei Huo Palace Master used it to parry against the incoming sword stream.
"Hong." Even though he parried against it, the Dao of Slaughter in that sword stream which was like silk blasted Fei Huo Palace Master once again, causing him to fly behind while spurting another mouth of blood.
'Sever Sword.' Xue Ying chuckled. He was truly pleased with the power of this Sever Sword.
Fei Huo Palace Master regained his control in midair. He could not believe what just happened, nor could he accept it: 'My strength and speed are weaker than the other party. I can't even break through the mysteriousness of his sword technique.'
"Hua."
Xue Ying did not stop. Another sword descended once again. It was rare for him to fight a Paragon. It was coincidentally the right time to verify his understanding of the "Six Sever Sword Styles". He had even deliberately reduced his strength this time to prevent the other party from flying back.
One could see many sword streams that were like blood silk being shot out. These swords left behind vestiges in the sky, and their prowess was great. Fei Huo Palace Master had barely parried against two swords, yet the third had raced through his body, cutting him into two…
'Flee!' Fei Huo Palace Master's two body parts were rapidly re-connecting. At the same time, he no longer had any fighting spirit. He understood that he was not the opponent of this Guest Elder Flying Snow.
"Fleeing?"
Xue Ying saw that the other party was trying to escape, and decided to no longer train his sword techniques. He was too lazy to waste any time, and had brought the strength in his sword back to 50% of his full strength, greatly increasing the speed and strength of the sword techniques to another level. If comparing flying speed, Xue Ying's speed was beyond the other party. Under the whistle of the sword, the fleeing Fei Huo Palace Master was cut into pieces like beancurd. Closely following that, he was exterminated by the power of the sword technique.
Fei Huo Palace Master died in combat!
One of the five Paragons who stood at the peak of this world, Fei Huo Palace Master, had been killed by 'Guest Elder Flying Snow'! Naturally, it was an avatar who died.
Xue Ying waved his hand before collecting the treasures left behind.
"Hu."
Xue Ying turned into a stream of light as he returned into the Chong-Shi Clan.
Within the courtyard, Chong-Shi Forefather and the other four were looking at Xue Ying with enthusiasm and disbelief! Seventh Highness Chong Yan was merely proud for he had such a formidable teacher. As for Chong-Shi Forefather and the rest, they realized that the power of this Guest Elder Flying Snow had reached the extent that he could start a new Holy Ground by himself!
The power hierarchy of this world would be changing soon.
And this Guest Elder Flying Snow did not have any powerful experts under him. His Chong-Shi Clan might become the new core of Holy Ground.
"Chong-Shi Patriarch." Xue Ying looked towards him, "Do you know what the Ancient Shrine is?"
"Of course, of course, that is an ancient legend." Chong-Shi Forefather was extremely obedient. Whatever he asked would be answered swiftly by him.
…
At the same time, news of Fei Huo Palace Master's death in battle was spread across the entire Sky Fire Palace. The other two Holy Grounds, the 'Spectre Prefecture' and 'Xu Empire' were both aware of it too.
All of them were exceptionally stunned, especially after Fei Huo Palace Master's true body reiterated what just happened, causing them to disbelieve it even more.
"I am completely suppressed. Even in the realm, I do not hold any advantages at all. The gap between our strength and speed is even bigger. Because my speed was slow, I could not even escape from him." Fei Huo Palace Master had utterly lost his confidence after this battle. He knew the gap between him and the other party was too enormous.

chapters.title: Chapter 688 - Spectre Prefecture Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 688: Spectre Prefecture Master
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying had some conjectures regarding the consequences of killing Fei Huo Palace Master's avatar, though he wasn't too mindful of it. He was more concerned about the 'Ancient Shrine'.
Within the hall, Chong-Shi Forefather sent everyone away. He sat opposite of Xue Ying and personally poured a cup of fruit wine for Xue Ying: "Guest Elder Flying Snow, there has always been a legend about the Ancient Shrine, though few knew about it. I have coincidentally learned of it."
"A legend?" Xue Ying looked at him. He was waiting for the other party to continue.
"A world has its rise and fall. Each cycle is called an epoch." Chong-Shi Forefather continued, "The legend goes something like this. A very long time ago, during the earliest inception of this world, there are no lifeforms within. Suddenly, a group of humans has descended into this world at a certain point in time. Among them, there is also a very ancient-looking shrine."
Xue Ying was stunned after hearing that: "The world doesn't give birth to the earliest humans. Rather, they descended here suddenly?"
"As I said, it is a legend." Chong-Shi Forefather continued explaining, "Within the legend, it is said that there are many cultivation techniques within that Ancient Shrine accompanying the descent of humankind, and also large amounts of absolute arts within. The legend also says that almost all our absolute arts originated from that Ancient Shrine."
"Oh?" Xue Ying had some guesses.
He was always mystified.
This world could not compare with the Deity world and Abyss in strength. There were not many Paragons existing here. It was tough for a Paragon alone to create an absolute art, and even if this world emerged along with the formation of the cosmos-this would be at most the eighth epoch. With so few Paragons existing in this world, having two to three absolute arts created by them was something exceptional already.
But how could there be so many of it here! It seemed that there was a high probability of this legend being true. The cultivation techniques and absolute arts had been left behind by a mighty senior, and it could even be Ancestor Devil!
'Ancestor Devil did not even leave behind many absolute arts in the Deity world and Abyss, so why did he do so in this world?' Xue Ying felt something was not right.
"Those absolute arts have been taken from the Ancient Shrine. Today, there is nothing within the Ancient Shrine anymore." Chong-Shi Forefather continued, "Thus, this so-called legend is something which we feel dubious about."
"Other than that…"
"There's also another legend regarding the Ancient Shrine-as long as one conquered the palace, he will become the strongest expert in this world, conquering the entire world." Chong-Shi Forefather sighed, "And precisely because of this legend, 'Paragon Emperor Xu' from the Xu Empire have personally constructed his nation right where the palace was located at, occupying the Ancient Shrine himself."
"Naturally, if we requested to enter, Paragon Emperor Xu might let us in. It's just that the Ancient Shrine is horrifying; the moment we step through the doors of the shrine, we had been forced to kneel on the ground by an unseen pressure. In the end, we had to crawl out of that place." Chong-Shi Forefather recounted his experience while shaking his head in lament, "From what I know, even Paragon Emperor Xu could not proceed deep into the Ancient Shrine."
"Oh?" Xue Ying squinted his eyes.
Chong-Shi Forefather had excellent combat power because he cultivated in absolute arts, yet he was forced to kneel after walking past the doors of the Ancient Shrine. This Ancient Shrine seemed genuinely mysterious and unfathomable.
'Conquering the Ancient Shrine meant one would become the strongest expert and become the overlord of this world?' Xue Ying thought, 'Regardless, it seems that my previous suspicions about the presence of many absolute arts seem to stem from the Ancient Shrine. Even Fei Huo Palace Master and the others have never seen a stage four World Deity opening his Dao. With how powerful I am, they must have guessed that it was related to the Ancient Shrine.'
'This Ancient Shrine… is indeed extraordinary, and could be the final destination led by the marking on Ancestor Devil's star map.' Xue Ying thought.
He had been living in seclusion on this world for more than a thousand years.
After this thousand years, he had finally found out that the Ancient Shrine could be his destination.
"Mn?"
Xue Ying frowned, "Patriarch, I'm taking a walk outside."
Chong-Shi Forefather was slightly alarmed. They were chatting normally when Xue Ying wanted to leave abruptly. Nonetheless, Chong-Shi Forefather did not dare ask him why and just smiled: "I'll not disturb Guest Elder Flying Snow then. If Guest Elder has any matter, do tell me."
"Mn." Xue Ying went out.
…
The current sky was dark. Night had arrived.
Xue Ying walked within the vast mansion of the Chong-Shi World Clan residence. He soon came by a lake. There was a black figure standing by that lake. This black figure was wrapped entirely in black cloth, revealing just a pair of violet eyes.
"If I am not wrong, you should be the Spectre Prefecture Master right?" Xue Ying asked.
"That's me indeed. Guest Elder Flying Snow is amazing. Despite entering stealth mode and slightly extending my senses towards guest elder, I've been discovered straight away." Spectre Prefecture Master said.
Xue Ying sighed instead, "Spectre Prefecture Master's method of hiding is amazing. If not for prefecture master taking the initiative to sense me, I might not know about your presence."
There were five Paragons in this world.
According to the intelligence he gathered, the strongest two were Paragon Emperor Xu and Golden Fire Palace Master-they should have an Apex Paragon combat power. The other three were weaker by a level, and amongst them, 'Spectre Prefecture Master' was slightly special. He could appear and disappear soundlessly and was the only one who could teleport in this world.
According to this intelligence, Xue Ying understood that he must have created his world since he could teleport!
It should be something similar to the 'Mirage World' or 'Shadow world'.
Furthermore, he had just killed Fei Huo Palace Master. According to the distance of this world, it might take eight to ten years to rush form the Spectre Prefecture, yet the other party had arrived here within a single night after knowing that he had killed Fei Huo Palace Master. Such speed could only be achievable by teleportation.
"Haha, we should not flatter each other." Spectre Prefecture Master chuckled, "I came this time to invite Guest Elder Flying Snow to join my Spectre Prefecture. You and I will command the entire Spectre Prefecture with equal statuses. All the treasures within my Spectre Prefecture can be enjoyed by Guest Elder Flying Snow any time. For instance, my Spectre Prefecture has a total of eight absolute arts currently."
Xue Ying sighed after hearing it. A Paragon could obtain eight original copy of absolute arts personally. If in the Deity world and Abyss, a Paragon would be overjoyed to own a single original copy of absolute art.
"Guest Elder Flying Snow, what do you think?" Spectre Prefecture Master said, "You are formidable in front battle, and I can hide in the dark. With both of us working together, how could the Sky Fire Palace and Xu Empire deal with us?"
"Let me think about it." Xue Ying chuckled.
No matter how Spectre Prefecture Master persuaded, Xue Ying did not agree temporarily. Instead, he left his decision hanging.
Thus, Spectre Prefecture Master could only temporarily leave: "If Guest Elder Flying Snow has made your decision, you can contact me via karma."
"Alright." Xue Ying nodded.
…
But three days later, Xue Ying left the Chong-Shi World Clan secretly. He borrowed the Mirage World to teleport continuously, spending just half an hour to arrive at the distant region of Xu Empire. In this world, other than Spectre Prefecture Master who could travel so quickly, the only other person who could do it was Xue Ying.
'Ancient Shrine?'
Xue Ying stood in midair watching that distant location.
There was an ordinary-looking shrine. This shrine was made from rocks which could be seen everywhere. The shrine itself was quite dilapidated, yet this shrine… was emitting an extremely frightening might. The region 5,000 kilometers around the God Palace had been suppressed, with this suppression becoming stronger the closer one got to the palace.
'Ordinary powerful existences could not even enter the God Palace. They will just be forced to kneel.' Xue Ying thought.
The surrounding aura was too powerful. Thus, no living beings could stay here! Even 'Paragon Emperor Xu' could not live in this region since who would be willing to do so when he had to suffer from suppression all the time?
"Xiu."
Using the Mirage World, he teleported once.
Xue Ying arrived at the entrance of this Ancient Shrine. Even though the pressure was intense, it was like a slight breeze to Xue Ying as he had cultivated the initial scroll of Myriad Devil True Body.
'It is indeed mysterious.' Xue Ying frowned as he inspected this God Palace. Borrowing the Mirage World, he could only teleport here. As for the insides of the God Palace, there was an unseen ripple covering it that did not belong to the ordinary world. It had even entered all regions within the Mirage World, preventing Xue Ying from teleporting in.
'It could even suppress the Mirage World?' Xue Ying was clear that even the Rulers-Bloodshed God-Emperor and the rest, could not suppress the entire Mirage World just by relying on arrays!
'The existence who created this Ancient Shrine must be stronger than Rulers.' Xue Ying casually made his way in the Ancient Shrine. During that moment when he passed through the door, the pressure began getting even stronger.

chapters.title: Chapter 689 - Black Gourd
chapters.content:
Chapter 689: Black Gourd
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The Ancient Shrine was simple. Even its construct came from ordinary rocks.
Nevertheless, after stepping through the doors of the shrine, the pressure he felt reached an entirely new level. Xue Ying swept his gaze across. The hall in front of him was approximately a few kilometers wide. There was also a green rock passage that led all the way to the end of this hall. Situated there was a stone door.
'In the legend of this world, the Ancient Shrine has appeared in the earliest period across many epochs. After reaching here, it seems that the pressure pressing down on me is so terrifying. Given how mystical it is, it is indeed a shrine that could survive the Great Cosmos Apocalypse.' Xue Ying thought. It was comparable to the Six Heavenly Wheel, Lake Heart Island historical remain and Starting Ground-they were all able to withstand the force from the Great Cosmos Apocalypse. The 'Three Chieftains Sacred Mountain' which was an Ancient Demon corpse, could also withstand against it-one could see how strong its corpse was.
Xue Ying walked in step by step.
As the pressure starting from the doorstep could force those at the level of 'Chong-Shi Forefather' to kneel, no guards were needed; the arrays at the outer perimeter were enough to protect it. Paragon Emperor Xu was confident-he believed that other than 'Spectre Prefecture Master', there were no other Paragons who could enter stealthily without alerting the arrays.
But now, it seemed that Xue Ying could do so as well.
The green rock passage was just a few kilometers long. Xue Ying moved slightly slower-taking a few breaths of time to reach the end,
'The pressure here will likely force ordinary Paragons to kneel.' Xue Ying estimated with the pressure he was feeling on his body, 'If I did not cultivate the Myriad Devil True Body, it would be taxing for me even to stand straight. Nonetheless, I could do so easily now.'
'This stone door…'
Xue Ying looked at the stone door in front of him.
The stone door was one entity in the form of a 'sluice gate'. Only by lifting it up could he enter.
"Mn?" Despite concluding how he should open this door, Xue Ying still released his spirit to investigate any unusual points of this stone door, 'It is indeed a sluice gate, and also the most common machinery mechanism. As long as I lift it up, I can enter.'
'And it seems this is the only way?' Xue Ying extended his hand to the gap by the boundary of the stone door. He wanted to turn into mist to bypass it. But at that moment when he turned into mist, he felt an unseen obstructive force.
"Hu."
The mist condensed back into Xue Ying.
'It seems I can't be lazy about this.' Xue Ying felt helpless. He could only extend his hands and prop by the lowest gap of this stone door before exerting his strength! The stone door lightly trembled.
"Yi?"
Xue Ying felt shocked. Ever since he cultivated the initial scroll of the Myriad Devil True Body, he thought that his strength was overwhelmingly strong; only those who came from another cosmos, the Ancestor Mother Religion's protector, could have a body slightly stronger than his-and it was just the apex protectors! In the Cultivator Cosmos, his strength felt so exaggerated, and only 'Bitter Cultivator' and others who cultivated the Myriad Devil True Body could compete with him in strength.
At this moment, he released 50% of his full force yet he could not lift the door up.
'70%'! Xue Ying's strength was rising.
Xue Ying's arms had vaguely turned thick. The stone door was finally moving up slowly. A terrifying aura coming from Xue Ying's body spread out in all directions, blasting at the distant hall walls and causing even the walls to boom. Even though the shockwave created by his aura was powerful, it did not damage the Ancient Shrine at all. Still, because this place was suppressed-even his Mirage World-the disturbance created by his frightening aura on the walls could not be hidden.
'It seems I'll be exposed.' Xue Ying frowned, though he couldn't care less. He continued using all his strength to lift the door.
When the stone door was slowly being raised, an unseen spatial ripple appeared beneath.
Xue Ying knew that it was this spatial ripple that obstructed him from tunneling through previously when he tried turning into mist. Even though this spatial ripple seemed ordinary, he could not penetrate even with his full strength.
"Rise."
Xue Ying used both arms to lift the stone door up. At the same time, his body became big, allowing him to raise the door higher and higher.
…
The Xu Empire had two Paragons.
The two had the relationship of a teacher and student. Paragon Emperor Xu's status was the highest-he was also the first Paragon of this epoch in this vast world! His current combat power was profound and unfathomable, and he understood much more about the 'Ancient Shrine' than Chong-Shi Forefather. He was clear that those legends were correct, and he desired to conquer it.
However…
What made Paragon Emperor Xu helpless was that he could not lift that stone door.
'Entering the Shrine, I have to walk step by step to the stone door and lift it. Only then will I see the steps of the legend… reaching the peak of the step represented the achievement of the ultimate goal-the Black Gourd.' Emperor Xu stood by a porch within his palace, looking at that Ancient Shrine within the region of his palace. Paragon Emperor Xu's eyes were filled with desire, 'As long as I got this Black Gourd, I'll be able to obtain the ultimate strength and truly leave this world into the more bigger Cosmos.'
Reaching this stage, he was clear that this enormous world was just a small recess in the cosmos.
'But it seems our epoch is too weak, with none being able to lift that stone door, much less stepping on the stairs.' Paragon Emperor Xu shook his head inwardly.
"Hong long long~"
A booming sound came transmitting from the distant Ancient Shrine.
Paragon Emperor Xu's senses were very acute. He discovered beforehand from the waves coming via void, causing his expression to change: 'What is happening? What happened to the Ancient Shrine?'
"Sou."
He turned into a stream of light, rushing over to the entrance of the Ancient Shrine a few ten thousand kilometers away. After all, he was living close to this location.
"This…" Paragon Emperor Xu was shocked as he watched the scene-a black-robed teenager turned into a giant with a divine sword on his back was currently propping the stone door up. The stone door was moving upwards with booming sounds. That black-robed teenager's powerful body had emitted an aura causing a shockwave that rushed out towards the entire hall, causing the hall to keep booming.
The eyes of Paragon Emperor Xu dilated. From the aura emitted by the other party's body, he understood that it was overwhelmingly powerful and immeasurable!
Furthermore…
'He lifted the stone door?' Paragon Emperor Xu was genuinely alarmed because none was able to do so in this epoch. That stone door was too heavy.
'He is Guest Elder Flying Snow?' Paragon Emperor Xu had long gotten the intelligence reports on anything regarding 'Guest Elder Flying Snow'. He could recognize him immediately.
******
At that moment when Xue Ying lifted the door open, the stone door had been lifted beyond his head, allowing him to see the scene behind the spatial ripples. Behind the stone door was an even bigger hall. At the center of the hall was a series of stone steps that led directly upwards. At the highest point, there was a Black Gourd.
This Black Gourd was only 0.33 meters high.
The current Black Gourd was vaguely glowing in crimson, releasing a terrifying temperature with it at the core of it. As the heat spread out, it distorted space and formed white fog at further distances. A large section of the entire gray hall was rolling in white fog, with the closer area filled with distorted space.
And now, Xue Ying was not suffering from any obstruction from the spatial ripple, though just watching that Black Gourd made Xue Ying feel fear and alarm in his heart.
This fear and alarm were flourishing without control.
It was an overwhelming gap in levels.
'What is that plaything?' Xue Ying felt that this was the most terrifying thing he had ever seen.
Despite seeing that Black Gourd, Xue Ying was maintained alert all the while. When Paragon Emperor Xu came closer to the Ancient Shrine entrance at high speed, Xue Ying naturally felt that undulation, causing him to turn over and have a look. It seemed that a silver-haired old man was standing by the door at the outer perimeter. He had a startled expression.
"Hong-"
Xue Ying finally lifted the entire stone door up. Once it reached the highest point, it got stuck.
At the same time, the spatial ripple naturally dispersed away.
"Hu."
At that moment, the white fog from within the large hall came rushing out, slightly staggering Xue Ying. The temperature of the surrounding was rising rapidly, and in a moment, it reached a warmth that could match the surface of the Sun Star.

chapters.title: Chapter 690 - Climbing up the stairs
chapters.content:
Chapter 690: Climbing up the stairs
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying glanced at the silver-haired old man behind him before entering the vast hall directly.
"Guest Elder Flying Snow?" Paragon Emperor Xu chuckled, "I've long heard of the great fame Guest Elder Flying Snow has, but never would I have thought that Guest Elder Flying Snow could enter the Ancient Shrine soundlessly, and even lift this stone door up. Truly admirable."
Paragon Emperor Xu who was quite confident previously, felt paralyzed after seeing that scene of Xue Ying lifting the stone door.
He understood that this stage four World Deity, 'Guest Elder Flying Snow', had a strength far beyond his.
"Guest Elder Flying Snow's strength is so formidable. I wonder where have you come from, and what opportunity have you experienced? Or is it that Guest Elder Flying Snow is originally from the outside cosmos?" Paragon Emperor Xu said.
"Outside cosmos?" Xue Ying turned back and frowned at Paragon Emperor Xu, "There is a cosmos outside this world?"
Paragon Emperor Xu was suspicious.
A stage four World Deity having such strength was too unusual! That's when he thought of the vast cosmos spoken in the legends that were located outside this world. However, judging from the reaction of this 'Guest Elder Flying Snow', it seemed that he did not know of the cosmos? Was it honestly ignorance or simply deception?
"Hu."
As Xue Ying spoke, he was simultaneously moving onwards. Soon, he arrived at the foot of the stairs.
Even though the white heatwave was rushing towards him at this moment, that layer of black armor which condensed on his body blocked off the heat efficiently.
"Guest Elder Flying Snow, the stairs aren't that easy to climb." Paragon Emperor Xu said from afar. At the same time, he took a step and turned into a streamer, rushing into the inner hall. Being an apex Paragon, he cultivated various absolute arts. Thus, it was easy for him to withstand the pressure. After entering the inner hall, he watched on as Xue Ying began climbing the stairs without stopping him.
…
Xue Ying looked at that Black Gourd located at the highest part of the stairs: 'Placed at the center and highest section of this hall, it seems that just the slightest of aura from this Black Gourd has created such huge disturbance. It is much more terrifying than any other treasures I've seen in my life. Even Rulers could not release an aura that reaches this extent.'
'Such a valuable treasure. Regardless of the reason why the ancient star map is pointing me here for, it'll be worth my time as long as I got that treasure.' Xue Ying could deduce that this Black Gourd should be worth more than all the treasures he had gotten so far. It should be beyond the 'Temporal Temple' which belonged to the Temporal Island Lord.
With his current combat power after cultivating the Myriad Devil True Body, he could still resist against Rulers.
But this Black Gourd was causing him to feel fear deep in his heart. It had transcended beyond the levels of treasures depicted by their cosmos.
"Dong."
Xue Ying took a step on the stairs.
The moment he stepped on it, it felt like stepping on his soul. His soul was rumbling. Xue Ying had never thought that this would happen. He could not help trembling from the aftereffects.
'Heart like a blade.'
Xue Ying's Cultivation Heart Realm had reached the second level. He soon adapted to it and took the second step onto the second flight of stairs.
"Dong!"
The moment he went onto the second flight, his soul suffered from a similar terrifying shockwave. It was stronger than previously, though he was prepared this time and could adapt quickly to it.
'It seems that acquiring this Black Gourd isn't easy.' Xue Ying looked at the highest section. The stairs had an unseen undulation which Xue Ying vaguely understood that he had to move step by step. If he were to extend his hand to grab that Black Gourd, he might either be forced out or suffer from a greater punishment.
The undulation within the stairs belonged to a level that surpassed his current realm. It made Xue Ying obedient.
This kind of trial left behind deliberately by a senior must be completed according to his rules! Otherwise, the consequences would be dire.
"Teacher." A voice sounded.
"Xiu."
Another figure tunneled into the Ancient Shrine- a handsome silver-haired teenager. He rushed towards Paragon Emperor Xu, though it was clear that he was trembling lightly. Entering the 'inner hall' of the Ancient Shrine required all his strength.
Xue Ying glanced afar. That handsome silver-haired teenager should be the other Paragon from the Xu Empire, 'Paragon Sword Emperor'. He was famous for being tyrannical, though his strength was lower by an entire level as compared to Paragon Emperor Xu, and was someone at the average Paragon level.
"He is Guest Elder Flying Snow?" Paragon Sword Emperor felt surprised as he looked at that black-robed teenager on the stairs.
"Mn." Paragon Emperor Xu nodded as he looked upwards, "He is very formidable, and has lifted up the stone door. After stepping on the stairs, I thought he would fall from it the next instance, yet he was able to reach the second step."
"Lifted up the stone door? Both Teacher and Golden Fire Palace Master couldn't do so yet that guest elder has done it?" Paragon Emperor Xu did not dare believe it.
"If not him, then who?" Paragon Emperor Xu nonchalantly answered.
And in the distant, Xue Ying was taking his steps slowly and steadily. Every single time he took another step up, he would pause for a moment to get over the soul attack.
"He has already walked up more than half the stairs, yet he is continuing." Paragon Sword Emperor's expression had slightly changed, "Teacher, did you not say that it is even harder to walk up the stairs than lifting the stone door?"
"He should not be able to reach the end." Paragon Emperor Xu softly said, "Very soon, he'll be forced out by the void of the Black Gourd."
Indeed.
The terrifying power emitted by the Black Gourd had caused the surrounding void to distort. The outer areas contained only the white fog.
Xue Ying was moving up step by step, moving closer and closer to the Black Gourd. He finally entered that distorted void.
"Hong~" A terrifying power charged onto his body.
Xue Ying who had long prepared himself mentally, felt his legs stuck rooted. He was enduring it. This powerful shockwave hit his body, bringing an even hotter blaze towards him. Furthermore, he had taken the next step, causing a stronger soul attack to assault him. But with the 'Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor', it had dissipated much of the incoming force. With the overwhelming strength of the Myriad Devil True Body, Xue Ying could still withstand against such vile environment.
'The closer it is to the Black Gourd, the more threatening it will be. Most apex Paragons would not dare to get close to it.' Xue Ying was dumbstruck. This power from the gourd was too frightful. It was comparable to some items spoken in the legends.
He took another step.
Xue Ying continued moving forward.
…
Paragon Emperor Xu was gawking at him. The moment he noticed Xue Ying continuing upwards despite suffering from the distorted void shockwave, his expression shifted. If this maintained, he would reach the end. By then, he would be taking that Black Gourd for himself. Would this be what the legends said? That the one who owned the Black Gourd would conquer the entire world and could even enter the bigger cosmos?
"I can't let him get it." Paragon Emperor Xu waved his hand.
"Hu."
Large amounts of white silk strands flew out from his hand. They moved swiftly to engulf the distant Xue Ying.
"Mn?" Xue Ying who stood on the step had a slight change in his expression as he saw the incoming white silk strands.
"Break." He immediately unsheathed his sword to form a vortex.
The vortex tore apart the many white silk strands.
And those silk strands began tangling the vortex which influenced the divine sword.
Xue Ying stood there not daring to advance. With an apex Paragon attacking him, he was not confident of stabilizing himself on a higher step; he would fall.
"Worldless." Paragon Emperor Xu's eyes were sparkling silver.
"Hua hua hua."
Countless white silk strands suddenly produced black holes. It was dark within. Those black holes generated a heaven-shattering swallowing force on Xue Ying. Currently, Xue Ying was steadily resisting against the void shockwave attack by that Black Gourd. All of a sudden, he was experiencing an additional swallowing force. As a result, he could no longer stand firm on the step and was forced to stumble out of it.
Just after stumbling out of the stairs, Xue Ying immediately turned around and slashed his divine sword furiously. A dazzling sword stream began acting rampant in its direction. It besieged the faraway black hole. That black hole fluctuated, yet it remained there albeit with a weaker swallowing force.
Xue Ying descended on the ground of the hall, staring at the Black Gourd which was located high up the stairs before turning to Paragon Emperor Xu who had a cold expression: "Are you thinking of obstructing me?"
"You aren't qualified to get that Black Gourd." Paragon Emperor Xu coldly retorted.
He had occupied this place for an extended period.
That Black Gourd should be his! None should think about snatching it away.
"It seems I have to chase you away first." A cold light flashed in Xue Ying's eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 691 - Sweeping out
chapters.content:
Chapter 691: Sweeping out
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"Disciple, let us bind him together. We must not allow him to get that Black Gourd." Paragon Emperor Xu stared at the distant Xue Ying. His eyes were frigid. According to legends, those who got the black Gourd would be able to conquer the entire world and leave for the outer cosmos anytime! Whatever the reason was, he would not allow other experts to get it.
"Yes, teacher." Paragon Emperor Sword took out his sword.
"You are sending your disciple to his death." Xue Ying wielded the sword as he moved forwardly step by step. Every single step of his produced an illusion. They were getting closer to each other.
"Just with you alone?" Paragon Sword Emperor was confident. He knew that Xue Ying had exterminated Fei Huo Palace Master from the 'Sky Fire Palace' previously, but he considered himself to be good at surviving. In a one-on-one battle, there should be no problems for him to survive more than seven moves from Guest Elder Flying Snow. Furthermore, he even had his teacher with him currently, assuring his survival!
"Hong."
Xue Ying suddenly slashed out.
"Kill-" Paragon Emperor Xu's silver hair was flowing. Countless white silk strands were fluttering around his body. It had even formed many layers of vortex that led to another world. These vortexes enveloped Xue Ying.
Paragon Emperor Sword was much more brilliant. He brought his sword and turned into a dazzling golden light on his way towards Xue Ying.
Because the power of the white fog within the inner hall of the Ancient Shrine was tremendous, the thunder-fire resulting from the laws of the world did not form. Their speed was much slower as a result due to the greater suppression here as compared to the external world.
'100% strength from the Myriad Devil True Body!' Xue Ying's mind was concentrated entirely on the Black Gourd. He did not want to waste too much time and decided to use the strength he previously exerted when lifting the stone door up.
"Hong!"
"Hong!"
Two sword streams that were extremely violent were sent with Xue Ying's Myriad Devil True Body's ultra speed. The first sword stream bombarded against that incoming dazzling golden sword light, causing it to dissipate. Paragon Emperor Sword who was within the light, revealed a look of terror. Closely following that, his body 'boomed' and exploded. The second sword stream had similarly broken apart the many vortices, greatly diminishing the swallowing force within those vortexes. The strength of the divine swords sent by Xue Ying was overwhelming, forcing Paragon Emperor Xu back to reduce the incoming force. In the process, he trembled as a huge impact was released on him, bombarding him out of the Ancient Shrine's entrance.
After Paragon Emperor Xu retreated for about 150 kilometers, he was able to regain his stance. He had a look of disbelief as he stared at that black-robed teenager situated within the distant Ancient Shrine.
'How, how could it be as such?'
Just two swords.
Paragon Emperor Sword was dead, and Paragon Emperor Xu was forced back.
Xue Ying kept the treasures left behind by the dead Paragon Emperor Sword in front of him. Actually, his death was quite unjust since he could still condense his body if he weren't located within the Ancient Shrine. But due to the pressure within that could force even 'Chong-Shi Forefather' to kneel, it had suppressed Paragon Emperor Xu significantly.
It was alright if he had a complete body, yet when he shattered, the resistance force between the body particles became weaker, and thus, they dissipated under pressure within the inner hall. Paragon Emperor Xu did not have the time to save him.
'They dare to fight against me head-on.' Xue Ying shook his head and muttered inwardly, 'He had been put to death by the pressure within the hall.'
How would Paragon Emperor Sword know about Xue Ying's strength?
Although Paragon Sword Emperor knew that 'lifting the stone door' required colossal strength, he was unclear exactly how much! Furthermore, Xue Ying had never forced the other party to explode just purely using strength when he fought against Fei Huo Palace Master. He had only pushed Fei Huo Palace Master back. In addition to Paragon Sword Emperor's confidence in his sword techniques, he believed he could coordinate well with his teacher.
However, everything was so wrong! When Xue Ying fought with Fei Huo Palace Master, he had exerted 50% of his strength at most. This time, he had utterly exerted all his power.
'This stone door?'
Xue Ying went back to where he lifted the stone door. He looked up before frowning slightly, 'The stone door is stuck once lifted up. It can't fall any longer.'
If he could close the door, he would be able to acquire that Black Gourd peacefully. After getting it, he would lift the door again.
But in reality, once the stone door was lifted… he could no longer pull it back down.
"Guest Elder Flying Snow." The distant Paragon Emperor Xu was angrily shouting out.
"The stone door will no longer be able to fall back. It seems that I can only kill you so that you will not disturb me any longer." Xue Ying turned into a stream of light as he rushed out. Even though Paragon Emperor Xu and Paragon Emperor Sword had another avatar, they were dispersed at two remote locations to prevent enemies from killing them in one fell swoop. As such, as long as he killed this Paragon Emperor Xu, they would not disturb him for the short moment.
Even Spectre Prefecture Master, with the location he ascertained using karma, teleported over a few times, he would take a period to reach.
"Hong!"
Outside the Ancient Shrine, Xue Ying began fighting with Paragon Emperor Xu once again!
…
"What happened?"
"What exactly happened to create such a huge disturbance?"
The entire Xu Empire had been roused. They could hear the loud booming sounds happening from a specific direction. Many figures were frightened so much that they flew out and looked towards the direction of that Ancient Shrine with unease.
There were currently two figures fighting where the Ancient Shrine was.
Fortunately, their power was suppressed by the laws of the world and the Ancient Shrine. Thus, the aftershock had significantly been reduced. Even still, the remnant waves were crashing against the palace's arrays.
"Paragon Emperor Xu, are you thinking of fleeing? Do you think you could escape?" A cold voice was heard.
"I can't obstruct you. I can't obstruct you!" Paragon Emperor Xu was fleeing back to his palace in fluster. He wanted to rely on his arrays to defend himself.
"Hong hong hong!"
Just after 12 continuous berserk sword streams, it shattered that array.
Xue Ying turned into a dazzling thunder-fire stream as he chased after the fleeing Paragon Emperor Xu. Paragon Emperor Xu was in a difficult situation. He regretted: 'He is so strong.'
The Dao of Slaughter absolute art, "Six Sever Sword Styles" when used with the Dao of Slaughter which Xue Ying opened had greatly boosted the offensive powers of his sword technique. If it was just this, Paragon Emperor Xu would not be afraid, and would still hold the advantage. Nonetheless, the immense power granted by the 'Myriad Devil True Body' enabled Xue Ying to suppress Paragon Emperor Xu completely!
In the Deity world and Abyss even if one was suppressed, he could be good in the 'time-space' aspect or 'boundless' aspect, allowing him a way to flee. He could even ask for help and request a Ruler to save him.
However, in this world…
The suppression of laws was too strong! It significantly reduced everyone's flying speed, thus increasing the difficulty of escaping successfully.
"Pu."
"Chi."
Xue Ying held absolute superiority in speed. He reached the other party before displaying all sword techniques with Dao of Slaughter. A terrifying strength and speed were augmented to the profound mysteries of this sword, causing a freakish strength to be displayed! That 'Protector Huo Zhu' might be stronger than Xue Ying in strength, but he was weaker in terms of the realm. If they were to fight against at this moment, the outcome would be different.
"I don't dare to obstruct you, yet why are you chasing after me without letting me go? Guest Elder Flying Snow, I admit that you are strong. I admit that you are greater than me. From now, let us not be enemies." Paragon Emperor Xu was persuading the other party because he lost all confidence. Even though he had an avatar located far away, the true body situated in Xu Empire had all his important treasures.
His previous opinion was that who could kill him in this world?
It was vigilant of him to leave an avatar at a remote location.
"Previously, why did you not stop? Now that you know you can't win me, you are planning to beg for mercy?" Xue Ying did not stop. Even though the other party's defenses were good, the terrifying strength augmented to each sword of his could injure the other party. "Furthermore, with my power, I don't need you to recognize it!"
"Hong hong hong…"
Move after move employed with all his strength inundated Paragon Emperor Xu.
He spent half the time taken to brew a cup of tea before extinguishing the body of Paragon Emperor Xu. The life force in his body had been used up.
Paragon Emperor Xu died in combat!
…
"Quick, Spectre Prefecture Master, you must bring the four of us together to the Ancient Shrine and stop World Deity Flying Snow. He has killed my disciple already. I can't hold on any longer. He'll be getting that Black Gourd from the Ancient shrine soon. We must think of ways to take it back and not let him snatch away." Paragon Emperor Xu was asking for help during his battle previously.
Spectre Prefecture Master and the two Paragons from Sky Fire Palace were both in a great shock.
One of the Paragons from Xu Empire had died, and even the oldest Paragon Emperor Xu could not hold on any longer? This Guest Elder Flying Snow was too scary already right?
Would he be taking the Black Gourd from the Ancient Shrine?
That was an item of the legend!
For a moment, the three of them had different thoughts, yet Spectre Prefecture Master eventually agreed to bring the four of them towards the Ancient Shrine.

chapters.title: Chapter 692 - Black Gourd and the Voidwalker
chapters.content:
Chapter 692: Black Gourd and the Voidwalker
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying looked around him. The entire Xu Empire was disordered. The laws and the arrays of the empire might have diminished the aftereffects from the battle which happened in the sky, yet many cultivators had personally seen the 'undefeatable and peerless' Paragon Emperor Xu killed by a single sword-wielding black-robed teenager!
'The five of them are quite far from me.' Xue Ying used karma to locate them. The closest Paragon was more than 1.5 trillion kilometers away. With speed they were traveling at, none would be able to disturb him in this short period.
"Sou."
Xue Ying turned into a stream of light. He flew back to the Ancient Shrine and entered the inner hall.
Looking up at the highest spot where the stairs led to, the Black Gourd remained glowing crimson and emitted a wave that warped the surrounding space. The outer perimeter had white fog rolling about. Such power should have persisted for several epochs.
'There are no more Paragons nearby. Even though there are still powerful existences within the Xu Empire, they should not be able to stand straight within the inner hall.' Xue Ying was sure of this since Chong-Shi Forefather was forced to kneel the moment he passed through the entrance boundary. Even if the powerful existences in Xu Empire were stronger, there was a limit to how strong they could get.
"Hu…"
Xue Ying let out a long breath.
He let his true deity heart regain its usual calm and prepared himself mentally for the second round of climb. Previously, he was forced down the stairs. But even if they did not interrupt him, could he reach the end? Even if he climbed to the end, could he take that Black Gourd? He did not have the certainty of accomplishing it.
Extending his senses, 'Spectre Prefecture Master' of the five Paragons was teleporting non-stop as he rushed towards the Sky Fire Palace. He did not rush to the Xu Empire: 'Knowing that their combat power is lacking, they are prepared to work together?'
Xue Ying lightly chuckled. He did not treat them as threats.
Taking a single step.
"Dong!"
When he stood on the first step, it was akin to stepping on his soul. A boom resounded in his true deity heart. Xue Ying who had experienced it before did not panic. After calming the shudder in his true deity heart, he took the second step.
Step by step…
He was moving up continuously.
Indeed, no powerful existences dared to interrupt him. None dared even to enter the Ancient Shrine. They knew that the two Paragons of Xu Empire had died, and that fear sufficed to deter anyone from coming.
…
As he continued climbing higher and higher, he got closer to the Black Gourd. The distorted void ripples were also striking on his body. The heat was growing every moment, and the assault on his soul was getting stronger. In the face of this, Xue Ying gritted his teeth and continued trudging up the stairs. Gradually, Xue Ying began feeling everything was blaring in his senses, yet he was clear that the booming sounds were happening within his soul; it remained peaceful in the actual world.
Incomparable hotness! The booming sounds were endless!
Xue Ying started swaying as he climbed, yet he persevered on. 'Heart like a blade'. His willpower poured through his entire true deity heart, allowing him to continue despite swaying in his steps. He would stop for a respite every once in a while before continuing.
Finally, he reached close to the Black Gourd.
All of a sudden-
The crimson glow on that Black Gourd vanished. The terrifying heatwave also disappeared. Following that, it flew into Xue Ying's embrace.
'This?' Xue Ying was slightly dazed as he hugged that Black Gourd: 'I got it just like this?'
He thought of many possible difficulties.
He was worried that the Black Gourd would be too hot. He was wondering if he could take it from the Mirage.
He was afraid that a more frightening shockwave would emanate from it.
In reality, the Black Gourd had simply flown into his bosom when he walked in front of it.
'This Black Gourd?' Xue Ying hugged the Black Gourd. He tried extending a strand of luminous sun force into it, yet at that juncture when it touched the Black Gourd, the luminous sun force contacted an incomparable blaze that burned the force to nothingness.
"Brat, this Black Gourd isn't something you can control whenever you want." A relatively piercing voice was heard. Even though the voice was higher in pitch, it sounded melodious like a piece of music.
At the same time-
A faint illusory figure appeared in front of Xue Ying.
Xue Ying hugged the gourd while looking at this imaginary figure in alarm. He was a lifeform that had a unique appearance and a unique adornment. Everything about him gave Xue Ying the feeling of extraordinary. He formed a humanoid figure with the robe he was wearing sticking close to his body like skin. The gown was primarily silver and gold.
He had green skin. Even the hands that he revealed were green.
His hair which hung down was silver and were tied in several pigtails. His brows were silver and felt like two swords. Three golden horns were growing from his head. His eyes were gold.
This was a lifeform which Xue Ying had never seen before in his life. It was okay since such appearances would appear in some unique clans.
But this illusory figure gave a unique feeling to Xue Ying. Despite being an illusory figure, an aura was still emitted from him. This aura was different from what he had felt in his life. It was a rare kind of suppression unlike Monarch Green's aura which made others pay allegiance to him, and neither was it Pang Yi's aura which made others feel closer to him. Instead, it was a kind of 'emptiness' that gave him a feeling like he was part of the void-vast and utterly void.
He was akin to the sky, a sky higher and broader than any others.
"The fireball within this Black Gourd is on the same level with the Sun Star of this cosmos regarding power. You can treat it as holding a Sun Star inside." That silver-haired golden-horned man beamed, "And you are trying to control it foolishly? Even your Rulers could not do so."
Xue Ying was stunned.
What?
The terrifying temperature emitted from the Black Gourd previously was because it had a 'fireball' within that was on the same level as the Sun Star?
What was the Sun Star? Every single epoch had a Sun Star and a Moon Star! They were the core of the cosmos, and even Rulers would die if they dared to enter it. Regarding power, the Sun Star and Moon Star far eclipsed that of the Rulers.
"It, it…" Xue Ying hugged the Black Gourd in front of him. He lowered his head and glimpsed at that gourd with disbelief that a terrifying existence on the same level with the Sun Star was hiding within.
"You cannot even control it, so what makes you think you can refine it?" The silver-haired golden-horned man said.
Xue Ying was obediently listening.
So what if his teacher had visited two other cosmos? He had already met such terrifying existence that could place a presence on the level of Sun Star into the Black Gourd.
"I've been forced to leave home and drift across many cosmos." The silver-haired golden-horned male chuckled, "Suddenly, I sensed that I have not a single disciple at all. That is when I decided to accept several of them. Thus, I painstakingly refined six gourds without paying heed to the price. The six gourds had been thrown by me into six different cosmos, with many trials set up by me. Only those who passed all trials can become my disciple and part of the Voidwalker."
"Voidwalker?" Xue Ying felt puzzled at this moment.
"The Voidwalker is a form of unique cultivation system. It is different from your cosmos system. Naturally, you can always cultivate it. Those of the Voidwalker has a harsher time cultivating, which was why I set down many trials. There are very few Voidwalkers in the entire universe, and that is why I left behind six gourds which are meant to be your 'protective treasures'. I hope that they will protect you when you are still weak." The silver-haired golden-horned man shook his head, "But according to my judgment, if there could be even one amongst the six disciples I have chosen reaching my level, I'll be pleased about it."
"Don't be anxious. You aren't a disciple of mine yet."
"I've come to your cosmos during the fifth epoch, discovering that that old man, Tian Yu has created this cosmos. Furthermore, there had been a very talented cultivator which emerged from this cosmos before who could even barge into the Staring Ground left behind by that old man Tian Yu. It seems the cultivators of your cosmos have great potential. That's why I left behind an inheritance too."
"I've placed a star map over the Six Heavenly Wheel which was refined by that 'Ancestor Devil'. Those who could pass through the Three Devil Palaces' trials and are young enough could obtain that star map located in the treasure cove. I've placed a total of 12 star maps within." The silver-haired golden-horned man said, "Only those who got the star map could be allowed into this world."
Xue Ying finally had an answer.
He was puzzled since the absolute arts left behind in the Deity world and Abyss were not many despite having Ancestor Devil and Lake Heart Island master present! Why were there so many in this world?
It seemed Ancestor Devil did not leave the star map.
It was this 'Voidwalker' who placed it in his treasure cove, and it was him that refined one of the six 'Black Gourds' that was so powerful. However, it seemed that this 'Voidwalker' was forced to leave his home? He had even recognized that forefather who created the Starting Ground, 'Forefather Tian Yu'? Forefather Tian Yu was also the creator of this cosmos?
So many secrets made Xue Ying dumbstruck.
"Acquiring the Black Gourd is only the first trial." The silver-haired golden-horned man chuckled, "I will transmit a cultivation technique to you. Relying on this technique, you will be able to control the black Gourd. You have to succeed in five years; that's the second trial! As for the third trial, it will be for you to think of a way… and I say again-you have to think of a way yourself without asking others how to refine this Black Gourd in a million years."
"Once you passed all three trials, you will get to go to the inheritance ground to receive the inheritance."
"If you fail, this Black Gourd will return to its original location and wait for the next brat with great potential. I have left a total of 12 star maps for this!"
The silver-haired golden-horned male smiled.
At the same time, his figure turned into many characters that tunneled through the forehead of Xue Ying.

chapters.title: Chapter 693 - They are here
chapters.content:
Chapter 693: They are here.
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within his consciousness, his true deity heart was seated cross-legged with many golden words appearing around it. Those many words formed a complete set of cultivation technique.
Judging by length, this cultivation technique could not match up to other absolute arts like the "Luminous Sun", "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" and "Six Sever Sword Styles" which contained a huge amount of information. It was a seemingly simple cultivation technique meant to control the 'Black Gourd'. But when Xue Ying started pondering over it carefully, he could not help but start reading it slower and slower because every single character produced a ripple that contained very profound mysteries. When they were placed together, it had many different kinds of reading styles…
As he continued reading and eventually finished it, Xue Ying felt muddled.
'So weird.'
Xue Ying was staring at a loss.
Most techniques were challenging to comprehend in the past, yet it felt like understanding this was easy. Every single character was extremely mysterious, and these profound mysteries formed all sorts of cultivation techniques!
'I've read once and have comprehended 16 different kinds of cultivation techniques.' Xue Ying hugged the Black Gourd in his bosom and tried controlling it.
"Weng!"
Words condensed from luminous sun force began appearing. These words then surged into the Black Gourd as if the clay ox were entering the sea-nothing was left behind. The terrifying flames entirely burned them within the gourd.
'This cultivation technique is wrong.' Xue Ying did not feel shocked. He continued trying with all 16 cultivation techniques.
'I say, that Voidwalker has given me five years to cultivate this technique yet I've comprehended it in a moment; the Voidwalker's trial will be too easy if that's the case.' Xue Ying shook his head. It was within expectations: 'Just that I've never thought this cultivation technique is so weird. It seems that many kinds of interpretations are possible. I've read once through and have comprehended 16 possible techniques. If not for testing it with the Black Gourd, I might not confirm if they were right or wrong.'
The original cultivation technique was in front of him.
However, what he comprehended so far were all wrong!
'Five years.'
Xue Ying had already walked down the stairs. He looked at the highest spot of the stairs and then at the Black Gourd in his bosom. He felt overwhelmed with emotions still.
Even as he had comprehended a cultivation technique, he remained startled.
Since what he had just learned was too unbelievable.
This cosmos where the Deity world and Abyss were had been created by a powerful ancient expert-also the Starting Ground's master, 'Forefather Tian Yu'. No wonder the talisman of the Starting Ground would be so formidable since it could teleport from any location in this cosmos directly to the Starting Ground! And it could also easily arrive at any position from the Starting Ground to the cosmos!
Furthermore, he had gotten a set of opportunity from another existence that seemed quite close to Forefather Tian Yu-the mysterious Voidwalker.
The Voidwalker represented a group of experts who cultivated a set of unique techniques-they were few and far between.
'How big is this universe? I wonder what level I could reach with cultivation?' Xue Ying was still filled with great hope towards getting the cultivation system of the Voidwalker. He had only cultivated the conventional cultivation system-comprehending the laws and profound mysteries before opening his Dao as well as to develop a world within his body.
He had never cultivated other systems before. He had tried learning the cultivation technique Ruler Pang Yi crafted, but to no avail.
The more unique a cultivation method was, the harder it would be to succeed.
The Voidwalker system would most likely be even more challenging to cultivate, or so at least since Xue Ying had to pass two other trials after this. If he failed, the Black Gourd would naturally return to this world, and he would no longer have the opportunity.
"This stone door is stuck and can't come down." Xue Ying stood at the entrance of the Ancient Shrine and stared at the stone door. At the same time, he was sensing as 'Spectre Prefecture Master' had gathered the other four Paragons. Paragon Emperor Xu, Paragon Sword Emperor, and Paragon Fei Huo had all refined an avatar each already since they had long prepared an embryo. Borrowing on time acceleration, they could refine an avatar quickly.
"If only it could fall back. I'll not have any disturbances when I cultivate in the inner hall." Xue Ying frowned.
This world did not have any safe locations for him to cultivate.
If he were to suffer from the attacks of five Paragons all the time, how could he cultivate? Only his true body could do so in the distant Crimson Rock Mountain, while this avatar's cultivation outcome would be almost negligible. It seemed that it would be a trial which he had only used 50% of his effort.
"It'll naturally not fall back…" A clear voice sounded.
Xue Ying was startled.
One could see a plump child appearing on top of the Black Gourd. The child was about the size of a palm, and he was seated on his butt on the Black Gourd while hugging the head of the gourd. This plump child was only wearing red undergarments that were as dazzling as flames, with tender skin showing on other parts.
"You are?" Xue Ying looked at the child on top of the Black Gourd
"Who am I? Do you not know? I am naturally the treasure spirit of your protective treasure, the 'Black Gourd'!" The palm-sized red-undergarment child stood up on the Black Gourd, "Unless you presumed that there is no treasure spirit within?"
Xue Ying shook his head profusely.
Most formidable weapons and arrays could condense a spirit. But it depended on whether the owner was willing to keep it.
"If you passed through the three trials, how would you know where the inheritance ground is if not for a treasure spirit?" The red-undergarment child sat back on his butt and grabbed that tender small foot of his: "Without the treasure spirit, do you think you can use this protective treasure with just a single cultivation technique? Treasures at this level could not be controlled by Rulers if not for special guidance."
"Naturally, this Black Gourd of mine is only temporarily owned by you. If you can't succeed in controlling it within five years or to refine it completely in a million years, then I'll disappear!
