You can't find me at all since you will not be allowed back into this world." The red-undergarment child said.
"I understand." Xue Ying nodded.
A terrifying weapon that was comparable to the 'Sun Star' was one he had to get.
"This stone door not falling is also a trial. You have to get the Black Gourd despite being attacked by other Paragons. Furthermore, you have to cultivate this technique under the influence of other Paragons within five years." The red-undergarment child continued, "Rest assured. This world cannot produce Rulers. Even if in the case a Ruler was to emerge, he would be expelled from this world. Thus, you will only have to suffer from the assaults of Paragons… if you could not even deal with several Paragons or die in their hands, then you have no qualifications to become a Voidwalker."
"I understand that these are all part of the trial."
Xue Ying chuckled.
"Remember, you have five years of time-really five years! Even time acceleration was included. You can't pull a fast one on me." The red-undergarment child reminded him.
Xue Ying nodded. At the same time, his expression turned sour.
He was clear that this cultivation technique was quite strange, and grasping it wasn't easy.
The red-undergarment child laughed giddily, "I'll not accompany you anymore. You deal with it yourself." He then disappeared.
Xue Ying looked at the Black Gourd in his bosom. WIth a thought, "sou", the Black Gourd was kept back into his storage treasure.
He then walked out of the Ancient Shrine.
'They are reaching very soon. If I can't deal with them, then it'll be hard to concentrate on cultivating.' Xue Ying left the Ancient Shrine and shot up into the sky.
…
Paragon Emperor Xu, Golden Fire Palace Master, Fei Huo Palace Master, Spectre Prefecture Master and Paragon Sword Emperor were five Paragons who stood at the peak of this world in the past. They had been fighting each other and maneuvering covertly too. This time although they were teaming up together on the surface, it had been because the legendary 'Black Gourd' of the Ancient Shrine should have landed in the hands of that World Deity Flying Snow.
"Us Paragons can't even get that Black Gourd unless we should let a World Deity obtain it?"
"Relax, the Black Gourd isn't that easy to get."
With the help of Spectre Prefecture Master, they were teleporting forward continuously!
Very soon-
"Sou."
Every time they teleported, they would travel approximately 50 million kilometers. They had already arrived at the Xu Empire capital. The five of them stood in midair, and they soon saw the highest peak of the palace of Xu Empire. There was currently a black teenager standing there. He was also looking towards their direction with a smile, "The five of you are here without one fewer."

chapters.title: Chapter 694 - To Intimidate
chapters.content:
Chapter 694: To Intimidate
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying stood on the rooftop of the palace. His robe was flowing with the wind; he seemed very carefree at this moment.
Seeing the current posture of this 'World Deity Flying Snow' and how confident he was, the five Paragons who each had their concerns, felt their hearts jolting. They became worried.
"World Deity Flying Snow, have you gotten the Black Gourd?" Paragon Emperor Xu asked. Palace Master Fei Huo, Golden Fire Palace Master, and the others were also looking at Xue Ying.
"Right, I've gotten it. You are all too late." Xue Ying nodded with a smile.
"Xiu."
The Spectre Prefecture Master who wore a black robe and revealed only a pair of violet eyes teleported and arrived at where the entrance of the Ancient Shrine was. Following that, he headed in towards where that stone door was opened, and could easily see the highest place where the many steps of stairs led to… had no Black Gourd any longer!
"Hu."
Spectre Prefecture Master returned and left the Ancient Shrine with a single teleport. He came back to where the other four were.
The four looked at him. Spectre Prefecture Master softly nodded, though his gaze remained on Xue Ying: "The Black Gourd has indeed been taken by World Deity Flying Snow."
"What."
"He, he got it?"
"This…"
Their hearts trembled; they were incredibly tense.
Ever since the emergence of this world and the descent of the Ancient Shrine, the one who got the Black Gourd would conquer the world. He could even leave and enter the broader cosmos. This legend had always been a story! Throughout the epochs, there were some who could lift the stone door, yet none had succeeded in taking the Black Gourd away!
Now, it seemed that history was about to be made today. A mysterious World Deity, 'Flying Snow' had taken away the Black Gourd.
'What kind of power does the Black Gourd have? Is the current World Deity Flying Snow much stronger?' Many thoughts flickered across the five of them.
After all, the legend spoke of how one could conquer the entire world if he got the Black Gourd!
How would it be possible without power?
They felt that this 'Black Gourd' must contain a heaven-shattering strength. Now that Guest Elder Flying Snow possessed it, he might be able to conquer the entire world.
"World Deity Flying Snow." The black-haired male Golden Fire Palace Master said, "I've heard that the one who got the Black Gourd can leave this world and enter the vaster cosmos. I wonder if it is true?"
"It is." Xue Ying nodded. He did not hide the fact.
It was true.
Those who failed the trials would be forced out of this world and enter the cosmos where the Deity world and Abyss were.
If he succeeded, he could simply leave this world.
"The external cosmos?" Golden Fire Palace Master and Fei Huo Palace Master held their breaths. They had always been living in this world and desired to see the bigger world outside.
"Can you bring me there? If you could, I'll not stop you." The Golden Fire Palace Master said.
"Can you bring us to the outer cosmos?" Spectre Prefecture Master asked too.
Other Paragons wanted to ask that question too.
"Impossible." Xue Ying shook his head.
The reason why he replied so succinctly was that the treasure spirit had transmitted to him, "You can barely control the Black Gourd after succeeding in cultivating the technique within these five years. You can borrow on the strength of the Black Gourd to leave this world. Of course, if you failed, you will be expelled out. No matter what, you are forbidden to bring any lives out even if it is a beast."
"Naturally, if you succeeded in becoming the new Voidwalker, we can break the rules."
…
"I could not bring the rest of you out. Borrowing on the strength of this Black Gourd, I can only leave myself." Xue Ying answered.
The five Paragons turned taciturn.
Paragon Sword Emperor could not help but blurt out, "World Deity Flying Snow, it seems the power of that black Gourd is tremendous? Can it conquer our entire world?"
"Right, it is tremendous and conquering the world is easily done. Its strength far surpasses your imagination." Xue Ying's voice was filled with rue. That's right, the fireball kept within could match the Sun Star. If its power was released-even if it was just a slight bit from the star-it could kill Rulers.
But it seemed that using it was a challenge. He could only obtain a preliminary control after comprehending that cultivation technique.
"Surpasses our imagination?" The five Paragons felt their hearts itching. How powerful was it?
"The Black Gourd might be very formidable, but if he has truly wielded its strength, he'll not be talking to us." Paragon Emperor Xu deduced, "Shall we kill him right now? The Black Gourd will belong to us after that."
"World Deity Flying Snow." Spectre Prefecture Master lowered his tone, "As long as you are willing to share the strength of Black Gourd with us, we can forget about this."
"No other ways then."
Xue Ying shook his head.
"Then let us attack!"
"Kill!"
"Kill!"
The five Paragons might have other considerations, but it seemed Xue Ying was not willing to cooperate with them. He was not willing to share the gourd either or promise to bring them out to the wider cosmos. They could only team up against him.
"Hu."
Standing at the highest point of the palace, Xue Ying disappeared.
"Mn?" The five Paragons who were about to display their killing moves were startled.
"He has a method similar to my shadow world indeed." Spectre Prefecture Master transmitted over. The other five Paragons had long guessed it since the time taken for Xue Ying to travel to the Xu Empire was too short; it was impossible to do so with normal traveling speed so he must be able to teleport. It's just that they thought it could be achieved using other treasures too.
But it seemed to be a method similar to Spectre Prefecture Master.
"Pu!""Pu!""Pu!""Pu!""Pu!"
Five spear shadows appeared from the void. They suddenly struck the five Paragons almost simultaneously.
Reaching the level of Xue Ying, the speed of his spear technique was so fast that he could piece out five spears at the same time.
This attack which came from the Mirage World was too sudden. 'Paragon Sword Emperor' and 'Fei Huo Palace Master' had only sensed it at the last moment; they did not have the time to defend themselves and were pierced! This was a black spear with crimson patterns on it. It was the True God weapon which held the 'Eternal Dao of Slaughter'! In this world, weaker True God weapons were rarely seen, and there was no 'Eternal Dao of Slaughter' True God weapon at all!
Because that time, 'Voidwalker' had only left behind things like absolute arts. Even though they seemed precious, those who comprehended them could easily craft an original copy and leave behind many more absolute arts for their descendants.
As for weapons, these required materials to refine. The Voidwalker will have to fork a greater price if that's the case.
Thus, there were very few 'True God weapons left in this world.'
The 'Blood Serpent Spear' was the first Eternal Dao True God weapon appearing in this world.
The Dao of Slaughter absolute art accompanied by the Dao of Slaughter which Xue Ying opened and a True God weapon with the 'Eternal Dao of Slaughter' was compatible! It brought Xue Ying' striking power to a new level. He had long cultivated the "Six Sever Sword Styles" and was pondering in the laws and profound mysteries of using them. As of now, he was applying them to the spear techniques.
…
Golden Fire Palace Master's body formed a dazzling golden flame. As the spear pierced through his body, he remained fine, just that the expression on his face shifted as he howled, "There's hex poison!"
Many silk strands were revolving around Paragon Emperor Xu. He tried to defend against this incoming spear. Even though the frightening impact forced him to the extent that he spurted out blood, his injuries were relatively light.
Spectre Prefecture Master had just entered the Shadow World, causing Xue Ying to strike into space.
However-
Paragon Sword Emperor and Fei Huo Palace Master were much more pitiful.
This single strike was a full force attack from Xue Ying. When all the strength from the Myriad Devil True Body was released, coupled with the Blood Serpent Spear, Paragon Sword Emperor directly shattered. As for Palace Master Fei Huo, after his body shattered, the remnant life force had been consumed by the shockwave from the 'Blood Serpent Spear' and 'hex poison', dying in the end.
…
Xue Ying appeared once again. He held onto his black spear and swept his gaze across.
The remaining three Paragons were aghast.
A single move killed two Paragons?
"He has completely suppressed us." Paragon Emperor Xu exchanged glances with Golden Fire Palace Master. Spectre Prefecture Master, though, had a moment of triumph. He felt fortunate that he had hidden in the Shadow World, and was not afraid of being killed.
Xue Ying remained calm though. He had opened the Mirage World; it was inevitable that he would become a terrifying assassin who could employ killing moves abruptly, making it tough for enemies to defend! Those without any defensive abilities would die even if they were Paragons. That was how he could achieve such an outcome too.
"Are you all certain that you still want to compete with me for the Black Gourd?" Xue Ying looked at the three of them; his voice was reverberating in the world.
Looking at the black-robed teenager standing in midair not far away, Paragon Emperor Xu and the other two felt helpless.
At this moment, Xue Ying had become slightly anxious.
He was deliberately hoodwinking the other parties since he did not want them to 'disturb his cultivation' The next five years of time was extremely important to him! With his understanding of the many absolute arts in this world, even if he hid in the Mirage World, they could get an approximate location of him using karma, and to disturb him continuously using their absolute arts.
"You have no hope of getting the Black Gourd. If we fought, it would only end up with the three Holy Grounds being destroyed." Xue Ying continued intimidating the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 695 - Three Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 695: Three Years
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying was most worried that the others would affect and impede his cultivation, preventing him from controlling the Black Gourd in five years. He would be expelled from this world if that's the case; he would regret if that happened.
Fortunately, the three Paragons in front of him-Paragon Emperor Xu, Golden Fire Palace Master and Spectre Prefecture Master did not know of this. They felt what Xue Ying said was logical.
"We do not have any hope at all. He could enter a world he created like the Shadow World. By then, all our attacks could not touch him. Even if we do our best, we could only harass him and not kill him." Golden Fire Palace Master transmitted, "And his frontal combat skill is stronger than Emperor Xu and me. We can't win even if it is a direct battle."
"He can't kill us, and we can't kill him." Spectre Prefecture Master frowned.
"But both Emperor Xu and I will be in danger if we split up." Golden Fire Palace Master added.
Paragon Emperor Xu was silent.
He did not want to admit. Neither could he accept the treasure within the Ancient Shrine being taken away by this World Deity Flying Snow in front of him. But he understood that he had no way of dealing with this 'World Deity Flying Snow'! The five of them had no hopes of snatching the Black Gourd back even when attacking together.
…
"Hmph hmph, I have no interest in conquering this world. If I were, I would have constructed a new Holy Ground a long time ago." Xue Ying casually said. Following which, a look of expectation appeared: "After a while, I'll leave this world into the bigger outer cosmos. That is what I am looking forward to."
The three Paragons felt their hearts easing after hearing that.
He would be leaving soon?
That's good too!
Besides, this World Deity Flying Snow was very secretive. With how powerful he was, he had been willing to be a small guest elder in the Chong-Shi World Clan and had never constructed a Holy Ground. It was clear he had no great ambitions.
The three Paragons were discussing among each other. Even Fei Huo Palace Master and Paragon Sword Emperor who had both lost an avatar each was conversing via karma. Eventually, they made their decisions. Since there was hope, it would be pointless to fight with this World Deity Flying Snow to the death.
"World Deity Flying Snow's power is greater than what we expected. There is indeed no point for us to proceed with this battle." Paragon Emperor Xu said with a clear voice, "But I wonder when will Guest Elder Flying Snow leave?"
"If things are settled quickly, then several years. Otherwise, at most 10,000 years." Xue Ying answered, "I've accepted a disciple previously. I would want to teach him seriously more before leaving this world."
"Mn."
The three Paragons were satisfied.
It would be 10,000 years at most-a short moment to them.
"World Deity Flying Snow." Golden Fire Palace Master chuckled, "I feel like asking you a question. Previously we've heard of the news about how you used the sword as your main weapon. Why are you using a spear now?" The other two Paragons were looking at Xue Ying too. That's right. He had always been using sword technique, and its power was extraordinary. This time, he used a black spear, and his power had become even more tyrannical.
"I have always specialized in the spear." Xue Ying grinned.
"Then previously?" Golden Fire Palace Master felt perplexed.
"For the sake of comprehending the "Six Sever Sword Styles"." Xue Ying answered. Naturally, this wasn't the truth. Previously when Xue Ying came, he was worried that the apex Paragons could see what happened in the outer cosmos and find out about who 'Xue Ying' was. To prevent his identity from leaking, he decided to change his appearance and use a different weapon. In the end, when he got the Black Gourd and understood what had happened, he knew that the Paragons here could not scout what happened in the outside cosmos. Naturally, he would not be worried any longer.
"The Six Sever Sword Styles?" The three Paragons lightly nodded. It's just that they did not understand why he would use sword still if he were comprehending an absolute art using it?
Xue Ying chuckled. At the same time, his appearances changed.
"This…" The three were startled.
"This is my true appearance." Xue Ying laughed, "Previously when I entered the Chong-Shi World Clan, I am worried that someone has seen me before. That's why I changed my appearance."
"So that's the reason. World Deity Flying Snow is too polite to that Chong-Shi World Clan. As long as World Deity Flying Snow displays your power, why would they not offer the absolute art with respect?" Paragon Emperor Xu stated.
"The process is more important." Xue Ying smiled, "Fellow gentlemen, if there are no other matters, then I'll leave first." He then teleported and disappeared.
The three Paragons looked at each other.
They felt pressure when facing this World Deity Flying Snow! He had never used that mysterious 'Black Gourd' at all when fighting them.
"I hope he will leave in 10,000 years." Spectre Prefecture Master prayed.
"We should stay together for the next 10,000 years. Otherwise, he might pick on us one by one." Paragon Emperor Xu suggested.
The three of them were willing to accept this outcome, though they were not feeling good. They came together well-prepared, just that a single move by Xue Ying had frightened all of them-his spear technique was so brutal? At that moment, they had no confidence in their original plan. Besides, Xue Ying was not willing to continue fighting, enabling them to take this opportunity in climbing down the donkey.
******
Deep within the mountainous region, on a mountain peak.
The black-robed Xue Ying appeared here chuckling. He waved his hand, causing many bamboos to fly from the bamboo forest below. They were being cut cleanly in midair, and soon, they weaved together to form a bamboo house.
At the same time, the land deep in the region of more than a billion kilometers was terraformed. A huge array gradually formed, isolating this entire region with the outside world. Whoever dared enter would befall into an illusory realm. With this illusory realm array, he would be alerted whenever those five Paragons enter.
'They did not know that I still have to comprehend the cultivation technique. I am most worried about being disturbed, so I intimidated them to make them give up.' Xue Ying felt good. He could convince the other party to give up. Primarily, it was because he displayed an overwhelming strength right from the start. If not for having a teleportation technique, the other five would certainly use more treasures and stake everything since they still had an avatar.
'This cultivation technique.'
Xue Ying entered the bamboo house. There were a bamboo bed and bamboo tables within the house.
He sat cross-legged, taking out a fruit wine which was fermented. He then gulped a cup ecstatically before placing the black Gourd out onto the bamboo table and resumed his comprehension of the Voidwalker cultivation technique.
Within his consciousness, many golden characters were flashing.
Every single character was forming a mysterious ripple. Xue Ying calmed himself before setting his resolve to succeed this time. The white-robed true body of his located in the distant outer cosmos 'material realm' was also doing his best to comprehend this technique.
…
The overall situation of what was happening in this world changed very quickly. Powerful existences were now looking for sources regarding World Deity Flying Snow's battle with the five Paragons outside the 'Xu Empire Capital'. Many saw it-powerful existences included. Thus, they were able to understand everything after making some inquiries.
One single move killed two Paragons! Golden Fire Palace Master and the other Paragons had to compromise in the end?
Even though the majority of them did not know that the 'Black Gourd' had fallen in Xue Ying's hands, that battle scene had shocked almost all superpowers. Powerful existences were even taking the initiative to seek Xue Ying.
The Chong-Shi World Clan was also transmitting a message to Xue Ying.
And to this, Xue Ying's answer was: "I am not interested in building a Holy Ground. I am currently in closed-door cultivation. Do not disturb me."
…
The sun rose and fell.
The wind blew, and the rain came.
Weeds on the peak of the mountain were turning yellow, and soon, they flourished again.
One year, two years, three years had gone by.
Both his avatar in this world and the true body in his hometown Xia Clan world were both in closed-door cultivation. He had even told his wife Jing Qiu not to disturb him if there were no huge matters.
"Hong ka-"
Lightning struck rampantly in the cloudy sky. Heavy rain poured down.
Xue Ying stood in front of the bamboo house by a mountain cliff. He let the rain pour down on him.
'It has been three years. I have yet to succeed. I've comprehended over a few thousand variations, yet all are wrong! Everything is wrong! No matter what I comprehended, they are all wrong!' Xue Ying looked afar at the thunder striking in the sky. His eyes held some anxiety and tyranny, 'What exactly is happening? Where have I made a mistake?'
This anxious mood and terrifying willpower resulted in the thunder condensing explosively in the sky. Closely following that, it was destroyed and dispelled.
The cloudy sky completely disappeared. The rain disappeared. A typical sunny day reappeared once again.
Xue Ying stood at the mountain peak looking at the sky. He was emotionless.

chapters.title: Chapter 696 - Controlling the Black Gourd
chapters.content:
Chapter 696: Controlling the Black Gourd
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
He would reflect upon every failure before trying once again. After comprehending a variation which he was confident of, he would attempt to control the Black Gourd. In the end, the Black Gourd remained unmoving. The terrifying flames within the gourd had burned the energy he sent through. He failed time after time-and it had been a few thousand failures already. Even Xue Ying with his heart realm was starting to feel frustrated.
He attempted all kinds of different ways and had even summarized his experiences while trying them out. He used a random strategy-whatever laws he comprehended would be taken as the base. He would ponder over it madly before attempting to 'deceive' the gourd. Who knew if he might be right? He spent three months comprehending more than 2,000 variations of cultivation techniques, yet no matter how random the permutation was, they all failed in the end.
"Hu."
Xue Ying let out a long breath. A strong gale blew out and destroyed the mountain opposite him. Hurricanes formed around him. It was fortunate that he had prevented others from interrupting him, and that there were no humans 50,000 kilometers around him. There were some who lived around here in the past, though they had been teleported away by Xue Ying using his Mirage World.
After he calmed himself down slightly, Xue Ying turned around and went back to his bamboo house.
He sat cross-legged and poured an expensive fruit wine for himself before taking a sniff. Only then did his heart realm regain its usual calm.
'I can't go on like this.' Xue Ying thought, 'I've already failed a few thousand times. Even if I continued randomly for the next two years, it'd only end up in more failures.'
'Maybe I've been thinking wrong all the while.'
Xue Ying closed his eyes.
Countless characters were flashing in his consciousness just like before. Those characters constituted the entire technique.
'Every single character is filled with limitless profoundness. If I were to comprehend a single character thoroughly, I might have to spend a long time doing so. Comprehending those characters once might take me more than five years.' Xue Ying reflected, 'Thus, I thought that it was certain that this is not the way. I have always been worried that there isn't enough time-five years is too short. That is why decided to dabble and stop in comprehending each character before trying to understanding the technique as a whole.' Xue Ying extended his senses into those characters, 'Maybe I should be taking it slow and try to understand character by character instead.'
'The first character.'
Xue Ying focused his consciousness on this first character.
The character was glimmering. It was fluctuating and felt genuinely profound.
Xue Ying meticulously pondered the profound mysteries behind the fluctuation. Slowly, he had a deeper understanding of it before it finally became a cultivation technique.
'Thoroughly comprehending a single character conceives a cultivation technique?' Xue Ying was slightly startled as he opened his eyes. Still, it took a long time to comprehend a single character-a full three months! Judging by this speed, coupled with less than two years left, he could grasp seven characters at most.
'Let's see if I can control the Black Gourd.' Xue Ying waved his hand. The Black Gourd appeared on the bamboo table once again.
He extended his thoughts.
At that moment, the luminous sun force produced a white character that flew over. But it was different from the past-instead of a large number of characters, it was just a single character, yet this character was much more profound.
Once this character entered the Black Gourd, it was burned silently by the terrifying flames within.
'Failed?' Xue Ying was stunned.
'No other ways. Continue.' Xue Ying closed his eyes. He had failed a few thousand times previously and was able to persevere on after keeping the Black Gourd.
The second character was flashing. It, too, emitted a mysterious fluctuation.
He meticulously pondered over it.
When he fully understood the character, he realized there were many similarities with the first character since they were of the same type. Thus, the time taken to comprehend it was much faster-he took just a month to understand it fully.
'It seems there are some mistakes with my understanding of the first character?' After Xue Ying thoroughly understood the two characters, he had some suspicions over the first character he comprehended, and immediately amended the original inaccurate cultivation technique to reflect his new understanding.
"Weng."
Displaying this technique, it formed a single white character and entered the Black Gourd to no avail.
…
The first path Xue Ying embarked on was a dead-end. And now, the second path he had decided to walk would be one where he had to walk until the end since he had no other strategies anymore.
The third character took 20 days. He discovered the mistakes he had in what he comprehended previously before amending them. But it was still a failure.
The fourth character took 15 days.
The fifth took 12 days.
The sixth took 11 days.
The seventh took ten days.
The eighth took ten days.
…
Xue Ying would always amend what he had previously comprehended first before forming a white character and attempted at controlling the gourd. Even though they were all failures, he had some sort of weird feeling that it seemed this was the right path; it felt like he was moving closer to success every single time he amended the cultivation technique.
One had to know that during the first three years he started on this journey, he would comprehend a new cultivation technique every single time-he comprehended several thousands of it, and they were all wrong.
However, he was currently studying every single character in detail, and all of them led to the same cultivation technique, albeit there would be some holes here and there which he had to amend.
******
Thick snow had covered the chain of mountains. It had also covered the mountain peak Xue Ying was currently cultivating on.
Xue Ying pushed opened the bamboo door, causing large amounts of accumulated snow to be pushed apart.
Stepping on the thick snow, he left behind many deep footprints. He walked to the edge of the cliff and sat cross-legged down on the soft snow, closing his eyes before continuing his cultivation once again. He was used to pondering over this cultivation technique left behind by the Voidwalker, just that he would change spots frequently. Sometimes, he would go to the lake by the foot of the mountain. Some days he would sit on top of a thick and old tree branch. But most of his time was spent either in front of the bamboo house or by the cliff of the mountain peak.
'The 51st character…'
Many golden characters appeared in the consciousness of Xue Ying. He was comprehending the 51st character currently.
This time, he spent a shorter period-completing it in eight days. He amended the original cultivation technique slightly.
'This is finally correct.'
Xue Ying waved his hand, causing the Black Gourd to appear on the pile of snow. Following which, he condensed the luminous sun force according to the cultivation technique, forming a single character. This character was white, yet under the fluctuations of the character, it changed color rapidly. It first transformed to dull gold before finally turning into genuine gold.
A golden character was floating beside him.
Xue Ying was surprised. He felt his heartbeat racing. It was the first time such a strange scene appeared. It gave him a massive feeling of expectation that things were different this time.
"Hu."
The golden character permeated into the Black Gourd. "Weng~" It felt like a key entering the keyhole. The array within the Black Gourd was being activated, causing immense energy to form. It wrapped around that immensely hot 'fireball' within the Black Gourd. The actual body of this 'fireball' was tremendously huge-the size of the Sun Star. Its power was unparalleled too. The flame it was emitting gave off a feeling that it could annihilate all existences. Nonetheless, the array within the Black Gourd formed an 'empty strength' that completely gobbled up this 'fireball', disallowing it from burning regardless of how strong it was.
'So heavy.' Xue Ying could feel how heavy this fireball was. An unseen pressure had even permeated into his true deity heart, causing it to tremble slightly.
It felt like a weak little child lifting a rock-too heavy.
The gap between them was too huge.
Controlling the Black Gourd was very taxing!
Still, Xue Ying had a feeling that if he were to use all his strength to control the 'fireball', he could activate a strand of it-this was already the limits of what his true deity heart could withstand. Even if it was a strand, it might just burn him to death.
"Congratulations, congratulations for comprehending the cultivation technique to control this protective treasure. I was already feeling quite worried since I would have to wait for many more epochs if you failed before another one with great potential comes." That red-undergarment child appeared on the Black Gourd. It seemed he was genuinely excited at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 697 - Parting
chapters.content:
Chapter 697: Parting
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying grabbed onto the Black Gourd with one hand. He extended his senses on the profound array within. The array had wrapped entirely around the tyrannical fireball: 'The array is the core of the Black Gourd. Just by relying on this array, I could control the Sun Star?' As he sensed it, he began thinking of how mysterious this array was. It was more perplexing than even the laws operating the countless worlds, and more potent than the Meteor Star array located in Lake Heart Island.
It was at such a profound level that he could barely control a strand of its energy using the cultivation technique left behind by Voidwalker.
"Weng~" Xue Ying tried controlling the energy within.
At that moment, a terrifying ripple accumulated. The hidden pressure produced by this 'fireball' on his true deity heart was rapidly growing. It was akin to a piece of large rock placed there-it was okay if he did not carry it, but carrying it was too heavy for him!
"Stop stop stop, hurry up and stop!" The red-undergarment child seated on top of the Black Gourd sensed what was happening. He was so frightened that he yelled at Xue Ying to stop.
"Why?" Xue Ying hurriedly stopped. Beads of sweat had formed on his forehead.
"You are daring." The treasure spirit red-undergarment child said, "You just comprehended the cultivation technique and had not understood the Black Gourd, yet you are trying to control part of its energy?"
"I'm just trying."
Xue Ying felt itchy in his heart. It was the most frightening strength which he had ever controlled to date. Furthermore, Xue Ying had the feeling that using this energy would give him the strength and courage to fight against the 'Ancient Demon' which was seen as overbearing the previous time! He had only controlled a strand of the energy, yet that extent of power made him intoxicated!
"You should listen to me first." The red-undergarment child felt helpless, "You have only passed the second trial, and have yet to complete the third and most important trial-to refine the Black Gourd in a million years! Without refining it, you could not be considered a Voidwalker… do you think that the old man will let you control this Black Gourd so conveniently?"
Xue Ying felt startled.
Only then did he regain his wits. Even though this Black Gourd was in his hand, he had yet to refine it! If he could not do so in a million years, the Black Gourd would still leave him.
"You haven't refined it and are only controlling it using the cultivation technique by force. I bet you felt that it is generating a huge pressure on you despite just trying to feel the energy within! And this pressure is only getting stronger over time right?" The red-undergarment child said.
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
"You haven't truly demonstrated its power yet. The moment you employ it, given how the power of this fireball is beyond yours, even a strand of energy will counteract against your true deity heart! Even with the cultivation technique for controlling it, judging by the how strong your true deity heart is, it'll take 10,000 years of time to recover from any injury after employing the gourd." The red-undergarment child explained, "Use the energy once, and it is 10,000 years of recuperation."
"What kind of injury requires such a long period?" Xue Ying felt puzzled. He had guessed that forcibly controlling the energy in the Black Gourd would inflict self-injury. But even when he refined an avatar using his soul, he could fully recover in a short period. But this injury of the soul caused by the usage of Black Gourd would take 10,000 years?
"Won't you know it when you are leaving this world since you have to operate the energy of the Black Gourd?" The red-undergarment child said, "Fortunately, your cultivation heart realm is not bad. If your cultivation heart realm is lower, your soul might crumble apart if you were to force your way through!"
Xue Ying let out a sigh of relief inwardly.
No wonder he felt a massive pressure on his soul when trying to control the gourd. If he could not withstand this pressure, he would not be able to control it.
"Then in the future when I refine it, the gourd will not rebel against me right?" Xue Ying asked.
"The moment you refined it, you will be the master of the Black Gourd. It'll be your protection treasure, so naturally, it'll not injure you." The red-undergarment child said.
Xue Ying nodded.
That's fine.
If he had to spend 10,000 years recovering after using it once, that would be too pitiful. But thinking of these was still too early since he had to refine the Black Gourd in a million years… that was challenging! Without a specialized cultivation technique, even Rulers could not control it. The difficulty of refining it was apparent.
"There's another million years." Xue Ying was not in a rush.
"When are you ready to leave this world?" The red-undergarment child said, "As long as you employ the power of this Black Gourd, you can leave."
"I've accepted a disciple in this world. I can't just go without caring or telling him." Xue Ying answered.
"Mn. The moment you leave, you will not be able to come back unless you've become a Voidwalker." The red-undergarment child said.
"That's right… it is possible that I'll never see that disciple of mine again." Xue Ying nodded. Little Seven that brat had been in front of him since he was six. He was 1,000 years now, and Xue Ying's affection for him was quite thick.
…
Chong-Shi World Clan.
The current status of the Chong-Shi World Clan was vaguely different. Because the strongest existence in this world-'World Deity Flying Snow'-was a guest elder of their clan! Furthermore, he was also the teacher of Seventh Highness, 'Chong Yan'. Even the three Holy Grounds did not dare to bully the 'Chong-Shi World Clan' for they were afraid of angering that powerful and terrifying World Deity Flying Snow.
"It has been close to five years. Teacher still isn't back yet." Little Chong Seven was seated in front of the study table holding a book on sword technique, yet he could not concentrate.
"I've heard father saying that Teacher will be leaving this world seen and will never come back." Little Chong Seven felt kind of unbearable, "It can't be that we won't see each other again right?"
When he was six, he had been quite immature. Seeing the sword techniques displayed by Xue Ying, he cried and yelled about wanting to take him as a teacher.
In a blink of an eye, 1,000 years had gone by. The time he followed his teacher was much more than the time he spent with his father! Thinking about how his teacher had left without returning made Little Chong Seven unbearable.
"Hu."
A figure appeared in the study room.
Xue Ying looked at that white-robed teenager who was daydreaming in front of the table and could not help chuckling, "Little Seven."
Little Chong Seven turned his head abruptly. He saw the black-robed teenager who remained as nonchalant as ever. Even though his appearance had slightly changed-about 60-70% of the previous appearance-that familiar aura and smile made Little Chong Seven suspect if he was his teacher since experts could easily alter their appearances. He hurriedly placed the book down and rushed over in joy: "Teacher!"
"Mn, prepare yourself. You will follow me as we travel around this world from tomorrow on." Xue Ying said.
Little Chong Seven brightened. He thought his teacher would come and bid him farewell. It seemed he was bringing him to travel around the world?
"Yes!" Little Chong Seven replied with excitement.
…
On the second day, as Chong-Shi Forefather passionately sent them off, Xue Ying brought his disciple to tour this world. After reaching this place, he had not honestly had a good look at this vast world. Moreover, the period of cultivation for Little Chong Seven was short-he lacked experience and had been to very few places.
The teacher and disciple went traveling. Along the way, Xue Ying would guide his disciple in the dark. He even deliberately gave him some missions to do.
Naturally, the time spent teaching was short. Almost all his time was spent on trying to refine the Black Gourd!
As time flowed, it had been 13,000 years.
"Hong~"
A white-robed teenager was seated cross-legged next to the lake. There was a vast ocean illusion appearing in the sky above him. This illusion was more than a hundred million kilometers wide.
Beside him stood a black-robed teenager. He was Xue Ying.
'He has finally become a World Deity.' Xue Ying slightly nodded. Seeing his disciple breaking through to become a World Deity was a load of worry off his mind.
After a while, Little Chong Seven who had finished breaking through showed a happy look.
Xue Ying then pointed his finger out, causing a stream of light to tunnel through Little Chong Seven's forehead. A large amount of information surged in; they were all detailed analysis of the various 'grade one Deity Hearts'. These were some of the comprehensions Xue Ying had on grade one Deity Hearts. He had transmitted them to his disciple.
"Many thanks, teacher." Little Chong Seven said after regaining his consciousness.
"You have comprehended the Creation Deity Heart. I've transmitted some other pointers on the other eight grade one Deity Hearts to you too. From now on, your cultivation will depend solely on yourself." Xue Ying passed a storage wristband over, "This wristband contains some external materials that are of help to your cultivation. Naturally, your Chong-Shi World Clan has a large foundation too. I believe your father will do his utmost to groom you. This little external good is just a slight token of appreciation."
"Yes." Little Chong Seven received the storage wristband. His eyes were glistening with tears because he understood it was time to part with his teacher.
"You are already a World Deity now. If you were to become a powerful existence, you would be able to live for a longer time. In the future, if there is a chance, we might meet again." Xue Ying said, "There's also a matter that I have to tell you before leaving."
Little Chong Seven was surprised.
"Your teacher originates from the outer cosmos." Xue Ying chuckled, "My original name is Dong Bo Xue Ying!"
"From the outer cosmos?" Little Chong Seven felt stunned.
"Let us part from here on." Xue Ying smiled. He then teleported and disappeared from the place.
"Teacher!"
Little Chong Seven could not help but shout. He looked around him and understood that his teacher had indeed left.
"Teacher? Dong Bo Xue Ying?" Little Chong Seven muttered to himself.
…
In the sky, Xue Ying held on to the Black Gourd. He was still trying to refine it.
"You have bid farewell to your disciple already, which means you are ready to go?" The red-undergarment child appeared on top of the Black Gourd.
"There is still another matter." Xue Ying laughed, "With so many absolute arts in this world, if I leave without taking them, I'll regret it."

chapters.title: Chapter 698 - Power and Influence
chapters.content:
Chapter 698: Power and Influence
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The red-undergarment child solemnly said, "I have to remind you. This world has been left behind by that old man Voidwalker. The earliest period of lifeforms in this world came from your cosmos, and it was that old man who sent them in."
Xue Ying nodded.
He had heard of it before. There was a legend circulating about how there had been a group of humans descending during the earliest periods. The Ancient Shrine had appeared along as well. Now that he learned this from the treasure spirit personally, that was indeed the truth.
"That old man Voidwalker came to your cosmos and traveled around the world. He had hidden his power and identity before befriending someone. Their friendship was quite good, yet that old friend of his could not transcend; he stayed at the stage four World Deity realm and eventually died." The red-undergarment child sighed, "Before dying, the Voidwalker revealed his identity to his good friend. He had already tried his best to help but to no avail! His good friend told the Voidwalker his wish of letting those clansmen of his live a peaceful life."
"Thus, the Voidwalker decided to leave behind this world. He brought those clansmen into this world where there were no enemies at all. He also left behind many cultivation techniques and absolute arts." The red-undergarment child said, "At the same time, he gave a command that you can't bring any of the living beings here away. The absolute arts of this world… if they are just one-of-a-kind, you can't bring them away too."
"So it is as such." Xue Ying shook his head and said, "This had happened a few epochs ago. Those clansmen of his good friend should have gone extinct a few epochs ago. Currently, those people living in this world are those of the later generations."
"And that is why if you become a Voidwalker, your arrangement matters more." The red-undergarment child laughed, "Currently, you haven't completed the trials yet. Naturally, you have no power to decide."
Xue Ying was enlightened.
"If I can't bring away those one-of-a-kinds, I should be permitted to bring any absolute arts with a few copies available with me right?" Xue Ying asked.
"Yes." The red-undergarment child nodded.
Xue Ying chuckled. It was not bad because he could always re-create the original copy after completely understanding the absolute arts. Like the "Six Sever Sword Styles", he could always re-create the original copy! After several epochs in this world, it seemed that most absolute arts had several original copies.
…
Sky Fire Palace.
"Hong!"
Xue Ying directly turned into a stream of dazzling light. He flew at high speed. Thunder-fire surrounded his figure as he charged into the main palace of the Sky Fire Palace.
With such huge disturbances caused, those two palace masters of the Sky Fire Palace were naturally alerted of it.
"It's World Deity Flying Snow."
"He is World Deity Flying Snow?"
The entire Sky Fire Palace became nervous. Those powerful existences did not dare to intrude. According to logic, powerful existences were stronger than World Deities. However, this 'World Deity Flying Snow' was exceptional. He was an extremely heaven-shattering World Deity. Fei Huo Palace Master and Paragon Sword Emperor could not withstand a single move in front of him. Even Golden Fire Palace Master was disadvantaged against him.
It was rumored that he could teleport and kill whoever he wanted. Currently, the five Paragons of the three Holy Grounds were staying together precisely because they were worried about being attacked on individually. One could see the threatening power of this World Deity Flying Snow.
"World Deity Flying Snow, I wonder why have you come to my Sky Fire Palace?" Suddenly, two illusory figures appeared. They were Golden Fire Palace Master and Fei Huo Palace Master. But what appeared were just incarnations formed using karma. Their true bodies and avatars were no longer within the Sky Fire Palace. Amongst them, Fei Huo Palace Master's expression was complex since the news of him dying under a single spear by World Deity Flying Snow was being spread.
"Hu hu hu."
Three other illusory figures appeared. They were the other three Paragons. Currently, all five Paragons of this world had arrived with their incarnations.
"World Deity Flying Snow, you said you would leave this world latest by 10,000 years. It has already been 13,000 years now." Paragon Emperor Xu stated.
The five Paragons were staring at Xue Ying.
When would he leave?
"Rest assured. My disciple has become a World Deity. I'll be leaving soon." Xue Ying said, "But before that, there are many absolute arts in this world which I have never seen before. Thus, I am finding the original copy of those absolute arts."
"Are you planning on bringing those absolute arts away?" Golden Fire Palace Master shouted angrily, "The original copies of the absolute arts are meant to be imparted to next generation. If you bring them away, what would the descendants learn?"
The other four Paragons felt frustrated too.
Naturally, they were only displaying it on the surface. It was only Golden Fire Palace Master who felt furious for he was genuinely concerned about the descendants. As for Paragon Emperor Xu, Spectre Prefecture Master, they did not care. As long as they were powerful, who would care about the cultivation of the future disciples? If Xue Ying were to snatch those absolute arts away forcibly, Emperor Xu would not risk his life to obstruct him.
"Relax. If there is just a single original copy, I'll not bring it away." Xue Ying declared.
The Golden Fire Palace Master let out a breath. The other four Paragons felt relieved too.
…
In the following days, Xue Ying went to all three Holy Grounds and the nine Great World Clans. He finished reading every absolute art as an act of broadening his wisdom. It seemed that could only fully cultivate one other absolute art belonging to the Dao of Slaughter-"Mass Extinction Scripture". It was quite impossible to reach large successes in the others! Just like "Luminous Sun" and "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body", he could only achieve small success at most.
With his current combat power, if he did not reach large success, then these absolute arts would not improve his combat power. It would only broaden his horizons.
"Hu."
A figure appeared in a desolate desert. It was the black-robed Xue Ying.
Xue Ying grinned, 'I've learned the "Six Sever Sword Styles" and "Mass Extinction Scripture" while bringing five original absolute arts copy out. Adding them, I have a total of seven full absolute arts! With the "Blood Demon Scripture" upper half, I would have a total of 7.5 absolute arts."
It was truly startling.
Most Rulers would only have a few original copies of absolute arts in the Deity world and Abyss!
But these absolute arts had a glaring problem… they ended at the Paragon realm! One had to know that some absolute arts could be cultivated by Rulers. As for the complete copy of "Myriad Devil True Body", it could be trained to a realm beyond the Ruler level. It was apparent that the Voidwalker might have left behind many absolute arts, but he recognized that the chances of a Ruler emerging in this world were meager. That was why he had only left some basic absolute arts.
'Regardless, I have 7.5 absolute arts.' Xue Ying's mood was superb. In the past, he wanted to give an absolute art to his wife, yet he could not find an appropriate one. Now, he had one!
'Let's begin.'
Xue Ying extended his hand, causing the Black Gourd to appear. The red-undergarment child appeared on top of the Black Gourd: "Are you planning to leave this world now?"
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
"Be careful. It'll take you 10,000 years to recover from the injuries incurred after using it once." The red-undergarment child laughed.
"Let's try."
Xue Ying was looking forward to it. He pulled the cork from the Black Gourd.
"Ba!"
The moment it was pulled, a frightening blaze emitted, causing the desert in front to warp. Countless grits were melting into a stream of particles. The direction where the opening of the gourd faced was entirely distorted. Its power was so immense that weaker Paragons would turn into ashes. The apex Paragons might be able to withstand this force!
'I haven't even utilized the cultivation technique. Just pulling the cork produced such a power?' Xue Ying sighed inwardly. He then began displaying the cultivation technique.
The luminous sun force turned into a white character. The radiance from this character was revolving as it became gold.
This golden character entered the Black Gourd and began activating the colossal array within. Xue Ying was too familiar with this array. During the past 13,000 years, he had been pondering over how to refine it. He had an unknown number of times, yet it was too complicated that he could not make head or tail over it.
"Hong~" He could only activate this array using the crudest manner, gathering the energy coming from that fireball. This produced a significant pressure on Xue Ying's soul.
"Come out!"
He gritted his teeth.
"Hong!"
A faint ripple rushed out from the opening of the gourd. This black ripple was similar to the Sun Ripple within the Sun Star, but it was different since the Sun Ripple had come from deep within the Sun Star. In most cases, only Rulers could withstand the Sun Ripple at the 'Void Black Soil Layer'. Of course, Paragons who specialized in the Fire Dao like Paragon Huo Cheng or terrifying Paragons like Monarch Green could do so. The core of the sun, the 'Sun Star Nucleus', would produce a ripple more terrifying that even Rulers could not survive from.
And now, the ripple produced by the black Gourd was a ripple emanated from the fireball. Despite being released externally, it was bound by the more frightening array and let out from the mouth of the gourd! One had to know that the Sun Ripple which dispersed in all directions had a scary strength. Now, the array focused the ripple in one single direction, causing its might to be greater.
"Hong~"
The black ripple stormed out from the mouth of the gourd, spreading in a fan shape. Its power was huge-one that could even cause the expressions of Rulers to change.
"Si la~"
The frightening power tore apart a hole in this stable world.
"Collect." Xue Ying forced himself to endure the pain in his mind. He did not dare to withstand against it for long periods and had deactivated the array immediately. At that moment, the black ripple disappeared. Xue Ying plugged back the cork. That massive crack in front of him was gradually recovering over time, and Xue Ying could see liquid moving right outside of it.
"Time to leave!"
Grabbing the Black Gourd, Xue Ying charged directly through the hole in the world membrane. By the time this crack was healed, Xue Ying had disappeared entirely from this world.

chapters.title: Chapter 699 - Brother Chen Jiu has come
chapters.content:
Chapter 699: Brother Chen Jiu has come
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
A black-robed figure flew out from one of the rolling rivers amidst the void.
"I'm out." Seeing that void river which was 50 billion kilometers long, Xue Ying felt slightly sorrowful. No matter how he tried sensing using the Mirage World, he could no longer find that hidden world located within the void river!
"You don't have to look anymore. That time, it was because of the star map that gave you the opportunity to enter. Otherwise, you will never find that world even staying here for an epoch." The red-undergarment child's voice sounded in Xue Ying's mind, "You should think of a way to refine that Black Gourd in a million years. Otherwise, I'll have to leave."
"I understand." Xue Ying slightly frowned as he touched his head.
Pain.
Many spells of piercing pain were wrecking his head. The black aura had permeated into his true deity heart. That body which was akin to colored glass had a faint black aura within. It was bringing him pain constantly.
"I can only try to expel this black aura over time. It'll take approximately 10,000 years indeed." Xue Ying felt the speed of the black aura whittling in his true deity heart before making a judgment.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, this is merely a counteracting effect. You better not use it a second time before you fully recovered. That counteracting effect will only add up and become serious. Your soul could collapse once it reaches its limit." The red-undergarment child reminded him.
"You are quite impressive. I've kept you in my Cultivation Eden yet you could still transmit your voice to me." Xue Ying chuckled as he transmitted back.
He was feeling pain constantly. However, he had experienced the torture of the Six Ghost Resentment Hex Poison when he was young; thus, he could still laugh at this moment.
"Hmph, it is only a Cultivation Eden. It could not restrict me at all. Even the famous places in your cosmos like the Lake Heart Island and Six Heavenly Wheel do not restrict me. I can enter any time and leave any time." The red-undergarment child was unbelievably confident of himself, "If you don't refine me in a million years, no matter where you hide me or whoever helps you, I'll still leave easily."
"I believe you." Xue Ying chuckled without saying much.
He believed in not the treasure spirit but that Voidwalker. He was someone who could trap a presence on the same level as 'Sun Star' into the Black Gourd and turn it into a protective treasure. Such means sufficed to make Xue Ying regard him with respect! After all, the legends had spoken how the strongest experts in this cosmos-Lake Heart Island master and Ancestor Devil remained helpless in front of the Sun Star and Moon Star.
"Go."
Xue Ying waved his hand and tore a time-space tunnel out. He stepped on it before returning home.
******
"Sou."
Within the Monarch Residence on the Black Fog Sea land.
"Mn?" Xue Ying appeared in the sky. He was able to cover the entire residence with his senses quickly. He had also gone seeking his wife, Jing Qiu, yet at that moment, he discovered an 'old friend' of his.
"Chen Jiu?"
Xue Ying was surprised.
That time in the Xia Clan World, the Sorcerer God and Great Demonic God wanted to start a war and conquer the entire Xia Clan world behind the scenes to conquer the Cultivation Eden 'Crimson Rock Mountain'. At that time, there were many coveting the treasures left behind by the powerful existence 'Sacred Master Crimson Dust' within the Crimson Rock Mountain. Some World Deities had sent peak Demigods into the Xia Clan World.
There were Lord You Lan, Wu Ma Hai, Chen Jiu, Jian Huang and Meishan Clan Master. All of them proceeded to the Crimson Rock Mountain. Xue Ying was inflicted with the hex poison at that time and had pledged his life in search for an opportunity to live in the Crimson Rock Mountain.
Within the Crimson Rock Mountain, he had been in the same team as Chen Jiu. They experienced life and death together and were very close to each other.
Within the courtyard.
There were several cups of tea placed on the table. The fragrance of the tea was diffusing out. A light-blue-robed Jing Qiu sat cross-legged on the grass. Her hair that was like silk draped across her shoulder. The True God weapon divine sword was placed on her legs as she tried sensing the mysterious 'Dao' within it.
"Hu." Xue Ying appeared by her side. He looked at his wife as she cultivated, and could not help but reveal a grin. However, shortly after that, he felt his heart tightening.
His wife was different from him.
His wife was the eldest daughter of Monarch Mo Xue. She had cultivated for a very long time in her previous life. Even though she awoke her memories after reincarnating, and the memories from the two different lives collided and allowed her to become a stage four World Deity, despite having some slight improvements, she was much slower in advancement as compared to Xue Ying, Chi Qiu Bai, and others. Xue Ying was trying his best yet his wife was improving very slowly.
Xue Ying had always been worried that his wife might not transcend!
Transcending was a breakthrough which none could help. Even Voidwalker with his great power could not help his good friend. He could only produce some external aids. Nonetheless, one still had to comprehend it and depend on oneself to transcend!
'Jing Qiu.' Xue Ying muttered inwardly.
Some stage four World Deities would decide to reincarnate when their true deity hearts were close to crumbling apart! After reincarnating, they would have the memories of a different person, and it would clear their heart realm. But once the memories from the previous life fuse together as one… most could live for a short period of around three to five billion years and even as short as a billion years. It was impossible for them to be like Xue Ying and Chi Qiu Bai who had an abundance of time to cultivate.
'Regardless what, I will do my best.' Xue Ying temporarily hurled those thoughts to the back of his mind. He was still optimistic. As long as he treasured the time together, it was fine. Nothing could ever be perfect in this world.
"Mn?"
Jing Qiu opened her eyes as she felt something. She looked to her side. When she saw the most important man in her life, she could not help but smile: "Xue Ying, you're back. Previously, you still said you are going in closed-door cultivation and that I should not disturb you if there is nothing important. How is it? Did you gain anything?"
"There is." Xue Ying chuckled, "And it is quite big."
It was true that he gained quite a lot this time around.
He got a treasure that gave him the power to match Rulers. It's a pity that he had yet to refine it, and could only utilize it once every 10,000 years.
"Oh right, Jing Qiu, I discovered that Brother Chen Jiu is also in the residence?" Xue Ying asked with slight surprise.
"He has just come for half a year." Jing Qiu kept her divine sword and stood up: "He is here to visit you. Originally when he discovered that you aren't around, he wanted to leave. I know that you are exceptionally close with him, and has harped on to him many times. That was how I made him stay here."
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded, "You've done right."
His rise after leaving the Xia Clan World for the Deity world had been rapid.
After accepting the God Emperor as his teacher, he soon became a stage four World Deity, and then opened two Daos. Now, he was one of the three ancestors. He had been investigating those good friends of his a long time ago, especially on Chen Jiu, Meishan Clan Master, and Jian Huang.
The differences in their power were too significant.
Xue Ying did not know what they could talk about. Purely reminiscing the past? That would only make things awkward between them.
Thus, he could only help them in the dark, especially so when Meishan Clan Master and the others were Reincarnators from the 'Temporal Temple'. Even if he were to help, he could only be careful in doing so.
'Brother Chen Jiu has finally become a World Deity.' Xue Ying understood the reason why Chen Jiu had not come to meet him despite his reputation.
In the past, Chen Jiu was one of the many Deities in the vast Deity world. Thus, he had never come visiting him.
And now, he had broken through to become a World Deity.
World Deities-there were relatively fewer of them. One could count the number of World Deities with one's fingers in every single starfield. Their lifespan would usually reach tens of billion years. Chen jiu's heart realm was different now. That was why he could come and visit him calmly.
"Jing Qiu, I'll meet up with Brother Chen Jiu first. After that, I have a matter which I have to talk to you." Xue Ying said.
"You should hurry and meet your good brother. We have plenty of time to talk." Jing Qiu giggled as she urged Xue Ying.
"Mn."
Xue Ying took a step before disappearing. It was time to meet that good brother of his which he had never met for close to ten million years already.

chapters.title: Chapter 700 - The New Ruler
chapters.content:
Chapter 700: The New Ruler
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within the Monarch Residence, in the cavern courtyard where Chen Jiu stayed, Xue Ying brought a flask of good wine with two to three lovely dishes to eat with Chen Jiu.
"I would never have thought that Monarch is willing to sit and eat with me." Chen Jiu chuckled.
"Still call me Monarch?" Xue Ying frowned.
"Hahaha, Dong Bo." Chen Jiu laughed, "That time when we went to the Xia Clan Crimson Rock Mountain, I was lamenting how you could reach Jian Huang, Meishan Clan Master, Lord You Lan and my standard in just 200 years. If you died in the Crimson Rock Mountain with that power, it'd be truly regretful since your comprehension talent is way much higher than us all."
"Now that I see, it seems that my foresight is accurate. After curing the hex poison, with the cultivation technique guidance left behind by that powerful existence of Crimson Rock Mountain, your improvement surged tremendously, becoming the most heaven-shattering person in your Xis Clan with a single fell swoop during that war. You have even become the disciple of the God-Emperor after entering the Deity world. In just a short 10 million years, you have exceeded most powerful existences in becoming the new ancestor."
Chen Jiu shook his head with melancholy: "If someone dared to tell me that this brat who had been inflicted with hex poison will become the new ancestor, and is much stronger than many powerful existences, I would say that he is mad. Haha…"
Xue Ying chuckled as he listened.
Time passed quickly.
Those matters on the Xia Clan World felt like yesterday. For the sake of that war with Great Demonic God and Sorcerer God, even his wife, Jing Qiu had almost died. Fortunately, Forefather Scarlet Flame was there to help. Even now, Xue Ying was filled with gratitude towards Forefather Scarlet Flame.
"I've returned to the Deity world." Chen Jiu said, "Hearing your matter and how wide the difference in our power is getting, I told myself I would never find you if I do not become a World Deity."
"Why the need?" Xue Ying shook his head.
Chen Jiu chuckled.
"I know that you had a true love when you were a Transcendent. You loved her very much, so if you are willing, I can request for a powerful existence to reincarnate her." Xue Ying said.
Chen Jiu was stunned. There was a slight pain in his eyes.
"There's no need." Chen Jiu shook his head.
"No need?" Xue Ying was surprised. He had been investigating in the dark and helping Chen Jiu behind the scenes. Thus, he was extremely familiar with his circumstances. 'Chen Jiu' could be said to be someone easily infatuated with a person. After his wife died, he had even become slightly deranged. Furthermore, it had always been the case over these years.
Chen Jiu smiled, "That time, I wanted to reincarnate my wife without caring about the price, but I was too weak. How could I find any powerful existence for help? Dong Bo, you were only a supervisor envoy then, and there was no need for me to seek you for help. But… over the years, time is ruthless. I have unknowingly changed over the years."
"I am no longer sad. I only feel that she is by my side, living in my heart for eternity." Chen Jiu chuckled, "I am not in a rush to reincarnate her. I have become a World Deity now, and will reach stage two and then stage three in the future… there might even be hopes of becoming a powerful existence one day. I could always reincarnate my wife when the day comes."
"If I can't do it, I could always request you, Dong Bo, for help." Chen Jiu mentioned, "Dong Bo if you are willing to help me, I'll be thankful for it."
Xue Ying nodded.
He felt that Chen Jiu's character was still somewhat deranged. But it ultimately depended on the other party's decision when helping out in relationship matters.
"Dong Bo, do you know the situation of Jian Huang and Meishan Clan Master currently?" Chen Jiu asked.
"They are Reincarnators from the Temporal Temple. What do you think their circumstances could be?" Xue Ying shook his head, "My relationship with the Temporal Island is dull. If I were to lend a helping hand, I might be harming them instead."
…
Within a vast starry sky.
"Hong~"
There was an incomparably huge array covering a total of five trillion kilometers wide, enshrouding this starry sky. Many veined patterns were swimming away in the starry sky, and these veins were emitting either a frightening flame power or an extremely cold water strength. The water and fire were constantly flowing in the starry sky and clashing against each other time after time.
"Hong hong hong hong hong hong!"
The frightening water and fire powers were clashing against each other, generating void energy. This void energy seemed weak, but it had an extremely destructive nature… even Rulers would not dare to withstand against it with their bodies. The moment they did, Rulers would die instantly. This was the 'Void Twin Extreme Array' constructed by 'Bloodshed God-Emperor' after he reached a higher level without heeding the price. Even the aloof and arrogant Primal Master knew that Bloodshed God-Emperor was very close to stepping across that crucial boundary since he had comprehended this technique.
The void energy was slowly sending ripples out. The ripples were striking at the array covering the vast starry sky. This piece of starry sky was being shattered again and again.
At the core of this huge array, the crimson-robed Bloodshed God-Emperor was seated cross-legged. He was controlling this scary array without being worried if the enemies would come attacking. With the power of the 'Void Twin Extreme Array', even several Rulers would die if they came. It's a pity that this 'Void Twin Extreme Array' had a huge flaw- the movement was slow. Enemies could easily evade it.
There was no choice. He had not stepped across that boundary, and borrowing on external materials to construct this array was surprising enough.
'Even though I have to move the array every single time when searching doing a carpet search, we will find their base in time.' Bloodshed God-Emperor's eyes were cold, 'A few million years of time is enough to search through the entire ten-starfields-big area. Our Cultivator Cosmos will not allow existences from other cosmos to act so rampantly.'
"Hu."
Suddenly outside the vast array, a figure appeared. He was a bald golden-robed barefooted male. The aura he was emitting could faintly cause every existence around him to pay allegiance. Even the world was paying allegiance to him. His eyes were unbelievably serene.
"Mn?" Bloodshed God-Emperor who was located within the Void Twin Extreme Array turned around. He could not help but be startled: "Monarch Green?"
"Teacher." The bald golden-robed male chuckled.
"You, you have?" Bloodshed God-Emperor felt this eldest disciple of his had utterly transformed. The past Monarch Green was reserved and had given an aura that made others have an urge to pay allegiance to him. And the current Monarch Green… was now emitting an oppressive aura which forced everything to give in to him. Even the world was giving in.
Furthermore, the past Monarch Green would wear a gray robe, and his hair was messy.
Now, he was wearing a more luxuriant-looking golden gown, and was even bald?
More importantly…
Bloodshed God-Emperor could feel the aura emanating from his eldest disciple being entirely different. It was much more majestic and grand.
"You have broken through?" Bloodshed God-Emperor asked.
Monarch Green nodded with a smile: "I was lucky to send an avatar into another cosmos. Those living beings on the other cosmos are vastly different. I could not even cultivate their cultivation system. However… examining them in the dark for many years, I was able to gain something eventually before breaking through to the Ruler realm."
"Hahaha, great, great, great!" Bloodshed God-Emperor revealed a joyous look: "Your teacher is currently employing the Void Twin Extreme Array to search through every crook and cranny for the base of the Ancestor Mother Religion. They will eventually retaliate. Thus, for you to become a Ruler at this moment allows for our Cultivator Cosmos to become overall stronger."
"If Teacher has anything you need me to do, just tell me." Monarch Green mentioned.
…
After Xue Ying returned from that world, he told his wife about how he had gotten seven absolute arts. Jing Qiu might be shocked, but she had chosen an absolute art regardless. Absolute arts were beneficial towards transcending!
After examining his disciples, he felt that they should continue to temper themselves further. Thus, he had temporarily not imparted the absolute arts to them.
"What."
Xue Ying who was currently discussing sword techniques with his wife had a considerable change in his expression; he was much shocked.
"What happened?" Jing Qiu was slightly startled too.
"I've just gotten the news." Xue Ying answered, "That my Eldest Disciple Brother Monarch Green has become a Ruler."
Jing Qiu was stunned.
Even though Monarch Green could fight against Rulers as a Paragon, breaking through that final step was tough. Even Pang Yi had broken through only after creating his new cultivation technique! And now, Monarch Green had broken through? Pang Yi and Monarch Green-one after another. That was fast.
"It seems that I'll have to go congratulate him after a few days." Xue Ying sighed while laughing at the same time, "My eldest disciple brother has accumulated a huge foundation, so it is normal for him to break through eventually."
"We will have to prepare a congratulatory gift if that's the case." Jing Qiu mentioned.
The news of Pang Yi breaking through was publicized.
Xue Ying and the others would have to give him a congratulatory gift if they visited him.
Many would congratulate those who became powerful existences. Such a huge matter of becoming a Ruler… was something to be celebrated!
…
After a few days, Monarch Green had sent out invitation letters unbridled-he had given out a letter to all Rulers and powerful existences regardless if they were from the Deity world or Abyss. This way of doing things made Xue Ying gasped, "My eldest disciple brother is usually simple living and low-profile. Why is he so ostentatious this time?"
But he still prepared a gift and brought along his wife and children to attend the feast hosted by Monarch Green.

chapters.title: Chapter 701 - The Concealed Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 701: The Concealed Strength
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"Hu~" Xue Ying, his wife, and his children flew out from the time-space tunnel. They could see that towering Void Mountain located outside the world-this was a huge mountain that was located in the void and emanated light all the time, brightening up a region of few billion kilometers.
Xue Ying noticed something different. He felt the grandeur released by that mountain and could not help speculating, 'My senior disciple brother's territory seems very different. The inner arrays have become much stronger. It seems to be lacking slightly as compared to the Bloodshed God Palace.'
"Father, this is the Starry Mountain. It is extraordinary-so much more oppressive than our Black Fog Sea." Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao commented as they observed.
Places like the Bloodshed God Palace and others were open to the public.
But this territory of Monarch Green was a place that outsiders did not dare intrude. Qing Yao and Dong Bo Yu had never visited before.
Jing Qiu giggled from the side, "Wait until your father becomes a Ruler, by then, he'll turn our Black Fog Sea into something more spectacular."
"Hahaha…" Xue Ying laughed, "Let us enter."
…
Monarch Green was a Ruler now. Thus, he would not be the one receiving the attending guests. Even when Xue Ying arrived, it was the two subordinate powerful existences under Monarch Green who came to welcome him.
"Brother Dong Bo." A very familiar voice sounded.
Xue Ying turned over. He saw a red-haired red-browed red-skinned muscular man walking over.
"Big Brother Huo Cheng." Xue Ying hurried over.
"Teacher." Qing Yao obediently greeted.
"Hahaha… you brought your family along?" Paragon Huo Cheng chuckled, "I truly envy you that you can bring your wife and children. The current me feels lonely."
"Teacher, don't you have this disciple?" Qing Yao quipped.
Paragon Huo Cheng could not help but laugh at seeing this.
Due to the great friendship with Xue Ying, Paragon Huo Cheng pampered this female disciple very much. He was not strict on her unlike towards the other disciples. Instead, he treated her like a daughter.
"Qing Yao, Yu'er, let us have a look around this place." Jing Qiu brought them away first.
Xue Ying was left walking together with Paragon Huo Cheng.
"Brother Dong Bo, have you heard of it?" Paragon Huo Cheng spoke. At the same time, he isolated all voice transmission around him: "Monarch Green has entered another cosmos. He has gained a lot there, which allowed him to break through."
"I've never heard of it." Xue Ying shook his head.
"Both of you are disciples under the same teacher, yet you do not know?" Paragon Huo Cheng was puzzled.
"I've cultivated for a short period… and do not have many friends at the Paragon level. Monarch Green might be my senior disciple brother, but we do not meet often." Xue Ying mentioned. Comparing the network of relationships, he lacked exceedingly as compared to Paragon Huo Cheng who had lived for a long period. Furthermore, Paragon Huo Cheng was someone open and friendly, so it was natural for him to have many friends.
Paragon Huo Cheng nodded. He said, "Although chances of entering another cosmos are rare, there are several among our cultivators who experienced this before, excluding those kept it a secret. Thus, it isn't a huge matter. What is puzzling, however, is that this senior disciple brother of yours has changed greatly in his temperament."
"A great change in his temperament?" Xue Ying was startled.
"Mn." Paragon Huo Cheng lowered his voice, "And it isn't just huge! It is very much prominent! You will understand after seeing him in a moment."
"His temperament has transformed?" Xue Ying was bewildered. According to logic, those who cultivated for a long period would have a profound cultivation heart realm-it was rare for their temperament to transform.
"It seems this temperament transformation is related to his visit of the cosmos." Paragon Huo Cheng shook his head, "I wonder what exactly did he experience that could prompt him to change! But still, becoming a Ruler is a joyful matter."
Xue Ying was curious too.
Gradually…
Many guests came-Paragons, powerful existences and even Rulers.
"Empress Qian He." A luxurious-looking red-robed woman who had a graceful temperament came over as she stepped out of the void.
Finally, Monarch Green appeared. He took the initiative to welcome her.
"Senior Disciple Brother Monarch Green?" Xue Ying was slightly startled as he looked over at Monarch Green. The past Monarch Green had a messy hair, wore a gray robe and was barefooted. His aura in the past was warmer. However, this Monarch Green in front of him was bald. He was wearing a luxurious and dazzling golden robe and was walking barefooted. His entire body was clean without being stained with any dust. That grand and great aura of his was suppressing everything around him. His eyes became more mysterious as if they held endless secrets.
"How is it? Different right?" Paragon Huo Cheng asked.
"Indeed he has transformed-greatly transformed." Xue Ying nodded.
…
This feast was no ordinary feast. Instead, it was a huge occasion for Monarch Green becoming a Ruler. He had even taken the initiative to invite others. Thus, all Rulers would attend no matter what even if it was sending an incarnation.
"Empress Qian He, you are the earliest." Monarch Green chuckled.
Empress Qian He was shocked inwardly.
This Monarch Green seemed calm, yet he gave her an oppressive feeling, causing her to feel an intense threat. She giggled, "Pang Yi has become a Ruler not long ago, and now, you have become one too. It seems that I will be moving another position back on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List again."
"I've broken through very naturally. Brother Pang Yi has created a new cultivation technique and is more amazing." Monarch Green smiled humbly. Suddenly, he turned over.
Empress Qian He looked over too. She said, "Your teacher is here."
"Hu."
A crimson-robed male with a black bird on his shoulder came walking out of the void. He was also the strongest existence in this Cultivator Cosmos-Bloodshed God Emperor.
"Teacher." Monarch Green came immediately to him.
"I thought that I as your teacher will be the first Ruler to reach this place to attend your fast. Who would have thought that Empress Qian He is faster than me."
