Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled before looking at his disciple, "Properly cultivate and reach a higher realm as soon as possible. Suppress Primal and Abyss Primogenitor for me. By then, both you and I, teacher and disciple will be the top two of the Cosmos Deity-Demon List."
"Bloodshed, adding up that talented brat Dong Bo Xue Ying, it seems that both teacher and disciples might just be taking the top three spots of the Cosmos Deity-Demon List." Empress Qian He deliberately said.
"Why not?" Bloodshed God Emperor's eyes brightened.
"You sure are thick-skinned." Empress Qian He shook her head.
The Rulers could sense each other locations via karma. After Empress Qian He and Bloodshed God Emperor arrived, very soon, the others like Primal Master, Temporal Island Lord, Abyss Primogenitor, Purgatory Ruler, Pang Yi and the others came.
…
The Rulers came one after another. In the distant, the Paragons and powerful existences could only watch from afar.
Xue Ying originally wanted to watch from afar.
Suddenly-
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, that Ruler called Bloodshed God Emperor should be your teacher right?" A voice sounded in his mind. It was sharp and clear. It was the voice of the treasure spirit of the 'Black Gourd'.
"Yes, he is my teacher." Xue Ying acknowledged.
"His combat power is huge and powerful. He is remarkably stronger than the other Rulers. It is a fact that he is the strongest expert of your Cultivator Cosmos." The Black Gourd treasure spirit mentioned.
"How do you know?" Xue Ying was shocked and puzzled at the same time.
This Black Gourd treasure spirit had a formidable investigative ability. That was something he knew.
But he could even deduce the other party's combat power?
"I concluded this according to the aura of their souls." The Black Gourd treasure spirit transmitted over, "It is easy for me to check the aura of their souls even if they concealed them! Using the aura of their soul is a more commonly seen method of getting a sensing of the other party's combat power. In most cases, the more profound you comprehended the laws and profound mysteries to, the stronger the true deity heart."

chapters.title: Chapter 702 - Another Kind of Ranking
chapters.content:
Chapter 702: Another Kind of Ranking
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying agreed with this point.
Since the true deity heart was formed by the law and profound mysteries along with the soul, the deeper one's understanding was towards the laws and profound mysteries, the stronger his true deity heart would be.
But the soul was an important area for any cultivators. They would usually conceal it deliberately to prevent others from probing it. At the most, there would only be some aura leaked which could be used for determining the party's identity. Nevertheless, this could be hidden using specific items just like the Bloodshed Tavern robes given by his teacher.
"Even in other cultivation systems, other than a few rare cases, the stronger the cultivator, the stronger his soul will be." The Black Gourd treasure spirit explained.
Xue Ying considered this idea for a moment. Just like those from the Ancestor Mother Religion, the stronger their body, the stronger their soul. At that time when he displayed the illusory realm, Protector Huo Zhu, the strongest Protector of Ancestor Mother Religion who had been dispatched to take care of Xue Ying, could easily break through the illusion cast. This proved that Protector Huo Zhu had a strong soul.
"Your teacher is very powerful, though your Senior Disciple Brother Monarch Green who has just made a breakthrough is formidable as well." The Black Gourd treasure spirit continued, "It seems that he is even stronger than that Primal Master who have a high status, or Abyss Primogenitor."
"What?" Xue Ying was surprised.
The treasure spirit continued with his explanation: "Listening to their conversation, it seems that everyone respected Primal Master and Abyss Primogenitor. Nevertheless, the two aren't as strong."
"Do you mean that Senior Disciple Brother Monarch Green is stronger than both Primal Master and Abyss Primogenitor?" Xue Ying asked through voice transmission.
If this piece of information were spread, it would undoubtedly shock everyone.
Both Primal Master and Abyss Primogenitor had accumulated a broad foundation. Even Pang Yi with his new cultivation technique was ranked lower than the two on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List. Monarch Green had only recently broken through, and he did not create any new cultivation technique yet he had the strength to suppress both Primal Master and Abyss Primogenitor?
'His temperament has undergone a huge change. Perhaps he has been possessed?' Xue Ying muttered inwardly, 'That's not right either. Monarch Green has three avatar bodies in total. It is difficult for anyone to even possess him! Still, nothing is impossible since he has entered another cosmos. There might be some unknown cultivation techniques which we have never heard before, allowing the other party to possess him. This eventually led to a huge transformation in his temperament and a great improvement in his strength.'
'But…'
'If he has really been possessed, shouldn't the other party be doing something to hide his identity more carefully?' Xue Ying pondered.
The verdict given by Black Gourd treasure spirit made Xue Ying suspicious and on alert.
…
"I am just judging based on their souls." The Black Gourd treasure spirit mentioned confidently, "I can easily examine their soul and determine if it is real or not! Based on soul strength, your teacher, Bloodshed God-Emperor is still the strongest. He is truly a pervert for I have never seen a Ruler with such a strong soul."
"Let me clarify with you, is Monarch Green really stronger than Primal Master and the others?" Xue Ying asked again.
"Yes."
The Black Gourd treasure spirit confirmed, "You aren't able to see it, but the soul of your Senior Disciple Brother Monarch Green is just like an incomparably dazzling golden light. He is truly tyrannical and powerful. If he doesn't own any heaven-shattering treasure, your Senior Disciple Brother Monarch Green should be ranked third in terms of power."
"Ranked third?" Xue Ying was stunned. Stronger than Primal Master and Abyss Primogenitor but he was still ranked third?
"My Teacher, Bloodshed God-Emperor, is ranked first. Monarch Green is ranked third. So who is ranked second?" Xue Ying inquired.
"The one called Purgatory Ruler is ranked second." The Black Gourd treasure spirit answered.
Xue Ying became confused.
Purgatory Ruler?
The Dark Abyss had a total of three Rulers. Purgatory Ruler kept a low profile. Between the Rulers from Dark Abyss, Bloody Ruler was the most ostentatious, and Abyss Primogenitor had the greatest status amongst the three. But now, according to the 'Black Gourd treasure spirit', Bloodshed God-Emperor was ranked first, Purgatory Ruler second, and Monarch Green third!
******
Finally, after Bloody Ruler and Myriad God Palace Head arrived, all ten Rulers were gathered. Guided by the attendants, everyone went to their seats.
"Monarch Dong Bo, please." An attendant led Xue Ying to his seat as well.
Xue Ying brought along his wife and children.
One by one, the guest was brought to the pre-arranged place for them, of which there were ten situated at the highest. These were unquestionably reserved for the ten Rulers.
And right below the ten seats, there were thirty seats arranged for the Paragons. Those like Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, Xue Ying, Monarch Destruction and some others were seated right within the section under Bloodshed God-Emperor, while Paragon Huo Cheng was sitting in the section under Primal Master.
Finally, there was a large number of powerful existences who were sitting further down.
"Xue Ying." Bloodshed God-Emperor turned to his disciple. He looked at Xue Ying with doubt and transmitted over, "I can feel that your soul is somewhat unstable. What happened? Are you injured?"
Xue Ying felt surprised that his teacher could detect his injury. He quickly transmitted back, "It is nothing and doesn't have a huge impact on my strength. I reckon I'll be able to fully recover in 10,000 years."
"Mn. Do inform me if you can't resolve it." After that, Bloodshed God-Emperor no longer cared about it. It was normal for his disciples to face setbacks during cultivation. He had merely asked because this injury was related to the soul. But since he disciple mentioned that he could resolve it, Bloodshed God-Emperor would naturally not intervene with it.
"Your senior disciple brother has already become a Ruler. You also need to cultivate properly. You are different from him since it doesn't affect him greatly whether he became a Ruler or not. But for you, if you do not become a Ruler, there is no way for you to transcend from the River of Time." Bloodshed God-Emperor transmitted over, "And I do not hope for us teacher and disciple to be part for eternity."
"Yes, this disciple will definitely be more diligent." Xue Ying could feel the concern his teacher had for him. Xue Ying felt touched.
Following which, along with three opening sentences by Monarch Green, the banquet began officially.
"Xue Ying." Jing Qiu, who sat beside Xue Ying transmitted over, "Why aren't you speaking with the other Paragons around you and are just silently drinking your wine?"
"I am thinking about certain matters." Xue Ying felt chaotic in his heart.
He had just asked the Black Gourd treasure spirit again: "Right now, since the Myriad God Palace Head and Bloody Ruler have arrived, with the ten Rulers present, tell me according to your way of judging their combat power and give me a new updated list of ranking."
The Black Gourd treasure spirit quickly came up with the new list.
The ranking list was as follow:
First, Bloodshed God-Emperor.
Second, Purgatory Ruler.
Third, Monarch Green.
Fourth, Primal Master.
Fifth, Bloody Ruler.
Sixth, Abyss Primogenitor.
Seventh, Pang Yi
Eighth, Myriad God Palace Head.
Ninth, Temporal Island Lord.
Tenth, Empress Qian He.
This updated list dampened the mood of Xue Ying. He no longer felt like chatting with the Paragons around him. His mind was currently filled with an influx of thoughts since this updated ranking list contradicted with the information he had.
'Did they not mention that Bloody Ruler is very weak? And Pang Yi could easily suppress him after becoming a Ruler? Even Monarch Green could fight with Bloody Ruler on equal grounds when he was still a Paragon. But it seems that he is actually stronger than Abyss Primogenitor and the Ruler Pang Yi ?" Xue Ying felt a chill down his spine. He could not help but tremble. After Pang Yi became a Ruler, the aura from his soul was still weaker than that of Bloody Ruler!
This felt extremely abnormal!
'I've heard that during the tussle for treasures previously, my teacher has been schemed by Bloody Ruler, yet Bloody Ruler was killed?" Xue Ying became all the more bewildered.
Firstly, it seemed that Bloody Ruler concealed himself too deeply.
Secondly, Purgatory Ruler and Monarch Green were both hiding deeply too. Purgatory Ruler was actually quite close to that of Bloodshed God-Emperor's.
'Of the three Rulers from the Abyss, I would never have thought that the publicly acknowledged stronger Abyss Primogenitor is instead the weakest of the three?' Xue Ying thought, 'What kind of secret is there behind this?'
He also had his secrets and concealed part of his strength. But he never had thought that the many of the Rulers were also hiding their power and covering it so deeply. Like Bloody Ruler, he did not even care that he was called the weakest. He did not care about respect. He was indeed the one with the deepest secret.
'Empress Qian He is still the weakest among the Rulers.' Xue Ying continued his train of thought, 'That arrogant and treacherous Temporal Island Lord who usually acted so rampantly to his whim and fancy is actually ranked second from the back.'

chapters.title: Chapter 703 - Monarch Green’s Combat Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 703: Monarch Green’s Combat Power
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
This ranking obtained according to the quality of soul gave rise to many thoughts in Xue Ying's heart. He lowered his head and continued drinking. Occasionally, he would exchange a few words with Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master and Monarch Destruction beside him.
The feast continued with jubilation.
The powerful existences were still toasting and exchanging words.
"Almost all the powerful existences in the Deity world and Abyss have gathered. I have not seen such a scene for a long time already."
"That's right. If Monarch Green did not send out the invitation letters to everyone, most of the powerful existences would not even participate."
Some powerful existences had weird tempers.
For instance, there were some who would enter closed-door cultivation for long periods without caring about any matters even if they were huge! They were too lazy to even participate in them. But for a Ruler to personally send out an invitation… not attending would be slapping the face of the Ruler! The Dark Abyss and Deity world were initially isolated. Most powerful existences would rarely visit if a Ruler from the Deity world emerged and vice versa! But since he had personally sent out invitations to everyone, they had to come.
As such, this became a rare occasion where over 300 ordinary powerful existences were present. Some were old people who had hidden for who knew how long.
As for the World Deities like Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, and Qing Yao, they were relatively excited at this scene.
So many powerful existences?
They had never heard before some of the powerful existences here!
"It is rare to see such a grand view."
"It's not only the powerful existences who came. Even the ten Rulers are here! Ten Rulers have emerged… that is marking a new era of our cosmos epoch."
"Mn, we have ten Rulers now."
The cultivators attending this feast felt an uplift in their mood. They thought that it was indeed fortunate for them to see such a scene in their life.
…
At the highest spot, the ten Rulers were seated there. They were chatting especially happy with each other. Naturally, the star this time was 'Ruler Monarch Green'.
"Primal, Monarch Green has become a Ruler already. You should carefully think of how to re-rank the Cosmos Deity-Demon List of yours." Abyss Primogenitor laughed out loud.
"I am feeling headache over this." Primal Master brought up his wine cup. He shook his head and helplessly replied, "The previous time was because Brother Pang Yi had personally attacked when we were dealing with the Ancestor Mother Religion. That was how I could get a better understanding of the power ranking. Now? Monarch Green has not acted, so how should I know the depth of his power? Monarch Green, why not display a move of yours and let us witness it? Either that or we wait until Monarch Green acted."
"Monarch Green, just display your moves." Myriad God Palace Master chuckled.
"Right, let us witness how powerful you are now." Ruler Nile laughed.
"Witness?" Empress Qian He giggled, "If we were to ask him to show his power, then Nile, you will be covering the bottom for us."
Ruler Nile shouted out, "Empress Qian He, you dare to mock me when you are merely a single rank higher."
"A rank higher is still a rank higher." Empress Qian He felt delighted about this.
Ruler Nile could only shut his mouth.
"Since everyone has attended my banquet." Monarch Green who was seated at the center chuckled, "I'll not dampen everyone's mood." He did not hide his voice and had majestically projected to the entire place. For a moment, all the powerful existences and World Deities who were lucky to attend the feast, and even servants standing by the side, turned over.
Xue Ying turned over as well, revealing a look of shock.
Taking the initiative to show his power?
This senior disciple brother of his was more ostentatious than before.
For a moment, the other Rulers were looking forward to it. Bloodshed God Emperor was even beaming. The cultivators below were looking upwards.
Monarch Green extended his palm. It was sparkling like jade. The veined lines on his finger were like canyons. One could see him clenching his fist before punching out towards the void in front.
"Hong!"
A huge golden fist appeared in the distant.
It was dazzling. This fist emitted a power that caused even Xue Ying's heart to twitch. That golden fist had become the most dazzling presence currently-much more than the 'Sun Star'. Of course, this was a misconception since it was too far from here. However, there was no doubt of the power of this fist- genuinely frightening.
The void was shattered and destroyed by his fist.
The power of this golden fist did not leak out. After causing the void to collapse completely, it dissipated soundlessly.
'With such a power, he could even control it to the extent of preventing nothing from leaking? Not even a single strand?' Xue Ying was dumbstruck.
"I hope I did not ridicule myself." Monarch Green smiled.
At this moment, the other Rulers present understood the power of the fist.
"It seems that I have to consider properly over the ranking between you and Pang Yi to determine who is higher." Primal Master gave a sour look.
"Naturally it should be Monarch Green." Pang Yi warmly suggested.
"Ruler Pang Yi has created a new cultivation technique. He has to seek a new path every single step he made. Naturally, his improvement will be slower. At the same time, his power is more stable and formidable." Monarch Green mentioned, "I might be superior now after breaking through, yet over time, relying on the cultivation technique he created, Ruler Pang Yi will far surpass me."
The Rulers were talking amongst each other.
And Bloody Ruler Nile was flattering the others from the side since he was the weakest on the surface, and was always ranked last. Before Pang Yi and Monarch Green became a Ruler, they were not any weaker than him. Thus, he was famous for being the weakest Ruler. Some top Paragons like 'White Sovereign King' and 'Water Devil King' did not care about this ruler at all.
Ruler Nile was flattering them from the side, yet he was stealthily talking to someone else at the same time, "Religious Leader."
…
In the Cultivator Cosmos, within the base of Ancestor Mother Religion, inside an ancient towering palace…
The huge fanged-hunk who was wearing just a few pieces of broken cloth sat within cross-legged. The majority of his skin was revealed. His green-brown skin was just like rocks, and his eyes were so deep it felt like the vast starry sky. That ugly face of his had a pacifying feeling on others, causing everything around him to become more joyous and warm. His vision was looking afar. At that moment, a scene appeared in midair within the palace hall.
It was the scene of the huge 'Void Twin Extreme Array' enveloping the starry sky. The array was currently wantonly inspecting the space, and because this array was too big, the Ancestor Mother Religion could not investigate the insides of it-they could not see the controller of the array, 'Bloodshed God Emperor'.
"Religious Leader." A communication request came.
"Religious Leader Niko." The huge fanged-hunk chuckled as he replied, "You are still participating in the banquet hosted by Monarch Green. Why did you contact me?"
"Monarch Green has just displayed his skills, and it is according to what we expected-he is slightly stronger than Pang Yi, directly reaching to Primal Master and Abyss Primogenitor." Ruler Nile transmitted over, "Furthermore, he has broken through only on a single Dao that reached the eternal realm. Over time, his other two Daos might break through, causing his power to rise even further."
"It is indeed according to our expectations. Which Dao did he break through?" The huge fanged-hunk asked.
"The 'Dao of Mountain'." Ruler Niko transmitted, "His power is vast and great-extraordinary."
"Hahaha, Dao of Mountain? Comparing about clashing of strength, who could compare with us in the Cultivator Cosmos?" The huge fanged-hunk chuckled.
"If comparing strength, I can directly suppress him." Ruler Nile transmitted, "But his capabilities in escaping is formidable. We can't underestimate him."
The huge fanged-hunk said, "Even though he is trouble, the war is starting soon. We no longer have time to let him grow stronger. The biggest calamity for us is still that Bloodshed God Emperor."
Ruler Nile went silent for a moment. He then asked, "So we are finally starting the war?"

chapters.title: Chapter 704 - No Path of Retreat
chapters.content:
Chapter 704: No Path of Retreat
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
There was a slight worry in the eyes of the huge fanged-hunk: "It isn't us who wants to start the war! It is Bloodshed God-Emperor! The Cultivator Cosmos is the one who wants the war to begin! They are forcing us, and now, the Bloodshed God-Emperor is utilizing his void array to scan through every single area. That array is truly powerful, and if he were to continue searching for us, he'd discover our base and that passage to our cosmos."
"This cosmos passage is our lifeline! We must protect it without heeding the price."
"The moment they discovered… we will be forced to start the war." The huge fanged-hunk said.
Ruler Nile was silent.
That's right.
Bloodshed God-Emperor was searching for them continuously. He was doing a carpet search and would find them eventually.
Ruler Nile transmitted, "It is not the right time to start the war now. Our understanding of the Cultivator Cosmos' cultivation system isn't excellent yet. We aren't getting powerful enough. Furthermore, we haven't collected enough precious resources, and there aren't enough Religious Leaders."
"Borrowing on those precious materials from the Cultivator Cosmos, we have acquired three new Religious Leaders." The huge fanged-hunk frowned, "We need to collect more precious resources, but that Bloodshed God-Emperor and the rest are on alert. If we were to do so wantonly, we would reveal ourselves."
"Mn, the Bloodshed God-Emperor has already collected many materials wantonly. It is getting hard for us to collect them now." Ruler Nile said.
"Bloodshed God-Emperor!"
The eyes of that huge fanged-hunk were filled with killing intent.
Being the strongest Religious Leader of the Ancestor Mother Religion, he felt wary towards that Bloodshed God-Emperor still.
"Niko, our hometown cosmos has entered the final stage of the apocalypse. Our clansmen are struggling on while at death's door. They even lack the resources to cultivate. We could have nine more protectors breaking through yet the lack of resources prevented them from reaching the realm of Religious Leader." The huge fanged-hunk shook his head, "Now, they can still rely on the half-collapsed cosmos to survive. But the moment it fully collapses, all lives will go extinct."
"Our Ancestor Mother Religion has not taken that final step."
"Thus-"
"We must conquer this Cultivator Cosmos!"
"Our clansmen could reproduce after entering this cosmos, forming the next generation as part of this cosmos. This cosmos will protect them and aid them in cultivation. As for us who already transcended, we could stay here and obtain the protection of the cosmos." The huge fanged-hunk said.
It was safest within the cosmos.
Outside the cosmos was a terrifying place! It was not appropriate for living, or so at least with their strength.
"This is the passage that we can maintain stable." The huge fanged-hunk said, "And also the last lifeline the Ancestor Mother Religion has given up."
"The lives of our clan and us transcenders will require a new cosmos."
"We have already comprehended their cultivation system, allowing us to improve our understanding of the laws and profound mysteries. We can utilize their resources too to form more Religious Leaders. Over time, we will become stronger and stronger." The huge fanged-hunk said, "But Bloodshed God-Emperor is not allowing us to do so. The cultivators will no longer tolerate us to continue here."
"They are cornering us."
"We have no path of retreat."
"We have to conquer this cosmos, and construct the Ancestor Mother Altar so that this cosmos will turn into one suitable for our cultivation system." The eyes of that huge fanged-hunk were filled with cold killing intent, "We are indeed the invaders, but our hometown is undergoing annihilation. For the sake of survival, we have to conquer their home!"
"I understand." The bloody Ruler Nile transmitted, "That time, I knew the possibility of death was huge, yet I still decided to reincarnate without caring about anything. That is for the continuation of our clan."
"Religious Leader Niko, your sacrifice for this clan is huge." The huge fanged-hunk said, "And now, the Bloodshed God-Emperor is still inspecting the places with his void array. We do not have much time anymore. It is inevitable for us to get on with the final war to determine the victors. But since Monarch Green has become a Ruler, there are no more heaven-shattering existences among their Paragons. Our plans can change. After a while, all Religious Leaders will convene to make the amendment, and we will inform you of it."
"Alright." Bloody Ruler Nile acknowledged.
…
At the peak of the starry mountain, the ten Rulers from the Cultivator Cosmos were all gathered. They were drinking wine and laughing as they chatted. Their mood was good.
Amongst the ten Rulers, Bloody Ruler Nile was drinking. On the surface, he was smiling, but his feelings were complicated.
He was initially a protector from the Ancestor Mother Religion cosmos. After entering this cosmos, he decided to reincarnate along with a group of others in spite of the risk of death. He sealed his memories, leaving behind only a little spirit before reincarnating himself in the laws of this cosmos… some of his clanmates had died without being able to regain their consciousness. It was easy to deduce this judging from the chances of those stage four World Deities surviving after reincarnating.
Some had succeeded though!
They regained their memories completely!
But after reincarnating, they had become lives acknowledged by the laws of this cosmos. They had karma too and could cultivate ordinarily. Even though Ruler Nile was a Paragon previously, he had become a Ruler now!
'I wonder how many of my comrades from the past had survived.' Nile thought.
Some had survived. If they did not contact the Ancestor Mother Religion, then the Ancestor Mother Religion would be ignorant of it.
Because they were considered the lives of this Cultivator Cosmos after they reincarnated successfully, and even the aura form their souls were different! Nobody could discern between them! They could give up their responsibilities: "Since I could cultivate normally, why risk my life for the Ancestor Mother Religion? If I do not say, none will know my identity."
It ultimately depended on how loyal they were!
None would know if they reincarnated as an outsider! That was why some had not revealed their identities. It was natural since the chances of success after reincarnation were low. Many were extremely cunning and would not make such juvenile mistakes. As for those like 'Bamboo Saint', they were originally experts from the Cultivator Cosmos. For the sake of getting stronger, they decided to rely on the Ancestor Mother Religion.
Bamboo Saint and the others did not even know what exactly was the Ancestor Mother Religion seeking for!
******
The banquet was still proceeding.
Bloodshed God-Emperor was discussing with Primal Master.
"The Void Twin Extreme Array is constantly investigating every single area of the starry sky. The Ancestor Mother Religion will be forced out." Bloodshed God-Emperor transmitted, "There are only two outcomes. Either they wage war with us, or they give up and leave our cosmos. What do you think they will do?"
"No matter what they chose, we will proceed according to your previous plan. We will play the consumption game, and let them die from squandering." Primal Master felt confident of himself. Their cosmos held a great advantage. If their avatars died, they could always recreate one!
Bloodshed God-Emperor remained vigilant, "But they have a huge advantage too. They are in the dark and have long understood our cultivation system. Furthermore, they are studying our system behind our backs. If they succeeded in cultivating both systems, they will not only have a powerful physique; they could grasp hold of the laws and profound mysteries too. With the two together, their threat will be extremely great. Thus, we must not waste any time. That is why I thought of ways to use the Void Twin Extreme Array to force them."
"Mn." Primal Master nodded and laughed, "The good news is Monarch Green has broken through before the war begins. We have another Ruler now."
"Right." Bloodshed God-Emperor stared at the distant Monarch Green too.
His eldest disciple brother had become a Ruler, delighting him greatly.
"The war will begin soon after this banquet." Bloodshed God-Emperor looked below, "The ordinary powerful existences and Paragons do not have to participate in the war since it is pointless. Ultimately, there are only ten of us."
"That's right. A huge war. The biggest one ever since the start of this epoch. If they were to leave obediently, it'd be better." Primal Master laughed.
"We can't depend on luck." Bloodshed God-Emperor's eyes were deep and unfathomable.
"Teacher."
Suddenly, a voice transmitted quietly over.
Bloodshed God-Emperor was stunned. This voice came precisely from that disciple of his-Xue Ying.
"Xue Ying, is there any matter?" Bloodshed God-Emperor asked.
"Disciple has something significant to report to you." Xue Ying transmitted.

chapters.title: Chapter 705 - The Difficulty of Refining
chapters.content:
Chapter 705: The Difficulty of Refining
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Bloodshed God-Emperor looked towards his disciple below with shock. Even if Xue Ying had something important to report, he could always wait until the banquet ended. What was the matter that made him so urgent that he had to do so in the middle of the banquet? But still, the Bloodshed God-Emperor was clear that this disciple of his understood propriety. Thus, he replied and asked, "What's the matter?"
"Teacher, is it possible for any nearby Ruler to eavesdrop on us?" Xue Ying transmitted again. He might be careful, but his knowledge of the Rulers was lacking. This matter was too important and could not be leaked.
"Eavesdrop?" Bloodshed God-Emperor became serious this time. An invisible ripple emanated from his body and enveloped Xue Ying: "Alright, it is fine now. There will be absolutely no one who will eavesdrop on us. Xue Ying, what is the matter that compels you to be so careful and solemn?"
"Disciple has gotten something miraculous that could inspect the strength of the soul." Xue Ying transmitted.
"You could inspect the strength of the soul?" Bloodshed God-Emperor was startled.
With his horizons, he experienced much more than Xue Ying and knew even more things. He was clear that the 'strength of soul' could reflect the combat level of a cultivator!
"What level could you inspect until?" Bloodshed God-Emperor continued asking.
"All ten Rulers have attended this banquet. Thus, I was curious and had stealthily inspected all ten of you. I do hope for Teacher to forgive me on this." Xue Ying transmitted.
"You've inspected the ten of us?" Bloodshed God-Emperor felt his heart skipping a bit: "How is it? What did you learn?"
"The inspection has flabbergasted this disciple! This disciple did not dare believe it even until now. The strongest is still Teacher naturally, but the second-ranked is Purgatory Ruler! And the third is senior brother Monarch Green. Primal Master is only the fourth. As for the fifth, it is someone whom nobody could ever expect-Bloody Ruler! The sixth is Abyss Primogenitor! Of the three Rulers from the Dark Abyss, Purgatory Ruler and Bloody Ruler are both beyond the level of Abyss Primogenitor! As for the ranks after, they are Pang Yi, Myriad God Palace Master, Temporal Island Lord and Empress Qian He respectively." Xue Ying transmitted.
"Oh?"
Bloodshed God-Emperor became pensive.
This intelligence given by his disciple had indeed stirred the emotions of Bloodshed God-Emperor. Even though he had some feeling of this, he had never expected Xue Ying could rank the Rulers so clearly according to their soul power! This ranking led Bloodshed God-Emperor to deduce many things.
'They have hidden well.' Bloodshed God-Emperor's eyes squinted. Many thoughts began surfacing in his heart.
And below, after Xue Ying delivered this critical report, he observed his teacher, only to see that he turned pensive and had a slight shift in his expression.
'I've done what I could. The tallest beings prop the sky. My teacher is the tallest one, so everything will depend on him from now.' Xue Ying thought to himself. The Black Gourd treasure spirit had mentioned that 'Bloodshed God-Emperor' was the most terrifying Ruler he had ever seen. Over the years, his teacher was also unquestionably the strongest on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List. None could wrestle that position from him.
If anyone could protect the entire Cultivator Cosmos, it would be his teacher.
"Xue Ying, what do you understand about the Rulers?" Bloodshed God-Emperor asked in transmission.
"I do not know of anything else." Xue Ying hurriedly replied. If not for the Black Gourd treasure spirit, he could not even sense the degree of soul strength since the Rulers had a status beyond his.
"You've done everything you could. Remember, you can inform this to Primal Master and Abyss Primogenitor. As for the other Rulers, you must keep it a secret. You must never leak this to any other cultivators too." Bloodshed God-Emperor reminded him.
"This disciple understands." Xue Ying obediently acknowledged.
…
The reason why he informed his teacher during the banquet was that Xue Ying felt his 'senior disciple brother Monarch Green' had a huge temperament change. He became so strong as well; he even invited all powerful existences to his banquet. Thus, he became worried that he might become a traitor! Naturally, he had to tell his teacher.
After telling him the truth, he began imagining.
This banquet proceeded smoothly. The banquet lasted for a total of three days. During this period, the Rulers had given public lectures on the Dao each, causing all cultivators present to listening seriously. When the banquet ended, the Rulers left. Xue Ying bid his good friends farewell before taking his wife and children home.
And Bloodshed God-Emperor had secretly beckoned for Primal Master and Abyss Primogenitor to a secret discussion.
******
The undercurrent was moving strongly in the entire cosmos. Bloodshed God-Emperor continued sweeping across the starry sky with that terrifying 'Void Twin Extreme Array' of his. The Ancestor mother Religion was also starting to get restless.
Nonetheless, only the Rulers knew of this.
Xue Ying was not too clear. Even the matter of his teacher operating the 'Void Twin Extreme Array' was not made known to him. After all, Paragons were hardly useful if a war erupted. It was still the Rulers who primarily fought. The gap between Paragons and Rulers were too great. Bloodshed God-Emperor could suppress all Paragons with a single avatar.
Thus, it was pointless for Paragons to participate in the battle.
Those Paragons like Monarch Hex Cricket and Water Devil King could only survive in the face of Rulers. They could not retaliate! Those who had the power like Pang Yi and Monarch Green had both become Rulers.
"Hu."
A stream of light arced through the sky. It was Xue Ying moving alone.
He was currently traveling all around the Deity world and Abyss, seeking for opportunities in those ancient historical remains while thinking of ways to refine the Black Gourd!
'The Black Gourd is used to protect me. It contains a fireball on the same level as the Sun Star. It is truly powerful. Refining the Black Gourd is the final trial the Voidwalker left for me. As long as I succeed, I will have an ultimate killing move.' Xue Ying might not understand much, but he was clear that the entire cosmos was becoming tense.
In such situations, it was vital to get stronger.
'But how should I go about refining it?'
'Using the words of Voidwalker, even Rulers could not control the Black Gourd.' Xue Ying flew along the starry sky. He frowned: 'How could I, a Paragon, refine such a protective treasure then? Of course, since the Voidwalker set down such a trial, it means I can succeed.'
'What advantage do I have over Rulers that will allow me to refine it? Mn, firstly, I have grasped the cultivation technique. With this, I can sense that void law within.' Xue Ying thought, 'On another aspect, this is one of the trials given by Voidwalker. He should have left a path of hope for me.'
'There are two ways to refine a treasure.'
'First, force my way through. Using the most tyrannical strength to refine it crudely.' Xue Ying shook his head. He had always been doing that whenever he had to refine something: 'Clearly, only those with superior power could do so. How could I even force my way in refining this Black Gourd? Impossible.'
'Secondly, comprehend the profound mysteries of the internal law and gradually refine it.'
Xue Ying felt his head hurt.
The void array within the Black Gourd meant to bound the Sun Star. How could he refine it given the mysteriousness of such an array?
'But there must be a trick to it since the Voidwalker gave this trial to the juniors. It should be possible to find out what it is after my understanding of the Black Gourd array reached a certain standard.' Xue Ying thought. The refiner of a treasure could always leave behind some methods that allowed anyone to refine it. He could also allow the other party to refine it once his realm reached a certain standard.
Everything would proceed according to the refiner himself.
If the refiner was willing, he could order treasures with a treasure spirit to listen to the orders of those who were weaker.
'It should be as such. That is the only possibility.'
'It's impossible for me to raise my comprehension of the array to a sufficient realm since even Rulers can't do so.' Xue Ying was certain of this. If the demands were that harsh, he would admit his failure: 'There must be a trick that gives me a way of controlling the array at a specific realm attainable by me.'
The internal array was truly too complex.
Even if he spent all his time in closed-door cultivation trying to comprehend the array, he might not succeed. Thus, the true body in the Crimson Rock Mountain would do the comprehension while this avatar would go seeking enlightenment in the many ancient historical remains. After all, any single one of those who could leave a historical remain behind were extraordinary seniors in the epochs before this.

chapters.title: Chapter 706 - Primal Chaos Flying Ship
chapters.content:
Chapter 706: Primal Chaos Flying Ship
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
In the blink of an eye, over 600,000 years had passed. But to Xue Ying who had cultivated for more than 10 million years, this did not feel long. Regardless, it pressurized him since more than half the time he had for completing the third trial of refining the Black Gourd within 'a million years' had passed.
Within the Monarch Dong Bo Residence at Black Fog Sea.
"Very good." Xue Ying laughed cheerfully by the side. He was looking at Dong Bo Yu: "Of the four of you, I have wondered who will be the first to reach stage three. It seems Yu'er is the first. Not bad."
Four people were standing obediently in front of him currently.
They were Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao, and his two disciples Mo Chong Yun and Jia Yun.
Xue Ying's children had long become stage two World Deity. His daughter was even the disciple of Paragon Huo Cheng! As for his son, Yu'er, he would usually cultivate by the side of Xue Ying. With his realm of Paragon, unless a Ruler was willing to accept him as a disciple, it sufficed for him to teach his son.
His disciples Mo Chong Yun and Jia Yun both had more celebrated talents. But they cultivated for a short period. It seemed they would break through to stage three soon.
But who would have thought Dong Bo Yu would be the first among the four to do so.
"You brat has become a World Deity later than me. Eventually, it is fine when you broke through twice to reach stage two. Now? You have become a stage three World Deity even faster than me." Qing Yao ruffled the hair of his little brother. Dong Bo Yu chuckled. They had cultivated for more than 10 million years, and even his parents would not ruffle his hair; only his elder sister would do so, which Dong Bo Yu felt it was natural.
"Sister, it isn't I who is fast but you who cultivates slow." Dong Bo Yu snickered.
"Hmph, I've just praised you slightly, and that delighted you so much. Let us see who becomes a stage four World Deity first." Qing Yao pursed her lips. Their comprehension abilities were quite ample, and they had excellent cultivation environment. Thus, it would not be tough for them to become a stage four World Deity. The only challenge was 'transcending'! Their mother had been stuck here for a long time, and their father was too heaven-shattering-so much that he opened a Dao, requiring Xue Ying to become a Ruler before he could transcend.
"Congratulations, Senior Disciple Brother Yu." The child-like Mo Chang Yu lightly saluted.
"Congratulations, Senior Disciple Brother Yu." Jia Yun said too.
As he taught his disciples, Xue Ying would frequently ponder over the arrays within the Black Gourd.
He admitted that he had put all his effort. He had even visited different places around the Deity world and Abyss, be it the historical remains or the mortal worlds or even the chaotic worlds within the Abyss. He hoped that a different environment would produce a flash of inspiration for him to refine the Black Gourd. He had tried all kinds of method. If not for the Voidwalker forbidding others from helping him, he might even ask his teacher for help. But he did not dare to; he could only think of it personally.
Still, he had only comprehended a minor part of the entire Black Gourd array.
Nevertheless…
Just comprehending this 'minor part' gave rise to a huge increase in Xue Ying's power.
******
Cultivator Cosmos. Within the territory of the Ancestor Mother Religion.
Inside a vast palace hall.
There were many figures seated cross-legged on the ground. These figures were densely located next to each other. They formed a circle, and all their auras were grand. There were primarily three types of beings within this group. One group included huge fanged-hunk and Bloody Ruler Nile-their figures were towering and muscular. Another group included the women. They looked normal. The final was those who were physically weak. From the surface, they seemed sick. There were even some from this group who had wrapped himself completely with his gown and surrounded himself with fog to prevent others from seeing them.
"18 Religious Leaders have gathered here today." The huge fanged-hunk announced with a grand voice. His voice reverberated within the hall, "Within our collapsing hometown, three Religious Leaders have recently emerged. They are unable to come here temporarily. Thus, their thoughts will be conveyed by me."
"This time, Religious Leader Niko has attended the meeting too." The huge fanged-hunk turned towards Bloody Ruler Nile.
Bloody Ruler Nile had only sent an incarnation over. Furthermore, he had transformed his aura and appearance to prevent others from recognizing him as Bloody Ruler Nile.
"Everyone here should know that Religious Niko has once been courageous enough to disregard death and reincarnate when he was a protector. He has not only succeeded, but he has also even become a Ruler using their current cultivation system." The huge fanged-hunk said, "Naturally, I am the only one who knows who he is out of the ten Rulers. I believe that fellow Religious Leaders can understand why I am doing so."
"Mn." All the religious leaders present turned to Bloody Ruler Nile. Their eyes were filled with admiration and passion.
A Ruler who hid among the enemies would be much more useful than an ordinary Ruler!
With the help of Bloody Ruler, they had an easier time collecting the cultivation techniques. Otherwise, the Ancestor Mother Religion would not have such a massive reward within the Cultivator Cosmos. After all, many secrets were not known to Paragons. Only Rulers knew more of them. Relying on Bloody Ruler, the Ancestor Mother Religion had gained a deep understanding of the Cultivator Cosmos.
"I believe fellow Religious Leaders who have gathered here know that the Cultivator Cosmos' Bloodshed God-Emperor is controlling that powerful array of his to sweep through the region we are at. Judging by his speed and direction of the investigation, he will reach our position in about a few hundred thousand years." The huge fanged-hunk mentioned, "We can no longer delay."
"Mn."
"It's a pity…"
"If we had more time, we could get a deeper understanding of their laws and profound mysteries."
"We could also gather more resources to create more Religious Leaders in our hometown! Now that quite a few Paragons over at our hometown have broken through the limits, they just lack the resources to break through. Our cosmos is currently collapsing and could no longer produce any resources."
These Religious Leaders were sighing.
The collapse of their cosmos was the final one. They had no more future epochs.
"Right."
The huge fanged-hunk nodded, "But we have no more time."
"We have to admit that the Rulers of the Cultivator Cosmos are stronger than our Religious Leaders. They control the laws and profound mysteries, giving them the ability to fight unpredictably and mysteriously. We are cruder." The fanged-hunk mentioned, "Naturally, their cosmos is still young. They have few historical remains too. Furthermore, there are very few treasures despite accumulating across the epochs. Compared to them, our cosmos is much older and is entering the final stages of collapse. On the contrary, we have much more treasures in our possession!"
"Yes! Borrowing on these treasures, we can triumph!"
"We must succeed in constructing the Ancestor Mother Altar."
"Even if they could form new avatars rapidly, we can use karma to seek them and kill all of them."
"They are too immature and have far too few treasures."
These Religious Leaders were filled with killing intent.
They no longer had any paths of retreat.
For the sake of their clan or themselves, they had to conquer this cosmos and construct the Ancestor Mother Altar, turning the entire cosmos into one that is suitable for their cultivation system. Even though they were cultivating the 'laws and profound mysteries' currently, they were most skilled in their owns system still. Furthermore, the Cultivator's cultivation system did not have a harsh requirement on the cosmos, and they could similarly cultivate them.
"Their Cultivator Cosmos had two Paragons becoming Rulers previously-both Pang Yi and then Monarch Green. It is good news to us." The huge fanged-hunk chuckled, "I believe fellow Religious Leaders have discovered the most precious treasure in this cosmos."
"Yes."
"The most precious treasure."
"They do not recognize it."
"It's not surprising for this is just the eighth cosmos. They are still young."
These Religious Leaders were releasing light in their eyes.
"Primal Chaos Flying Ship." The huge fanged-hunk lightly mentioned, "The legendary Primal Chaos Flying Ship! This Cultivator Cosmos has even termed it as the third great historical remain! What a joke. That ship is much more precious than their Lake Heart Island historical remain and the Six Heavenly Wheel. We have only seen of it once in the sacred writings. Who would have thought that we could see the actual Primal Chaos Flying Ship in their cosmos."
The five great historical remains of the Cultivator Cosmos were as follow.
One, Lake Heart Island historical remain.
Two, Six Heavenly Wheel.
Three, Arcadia Flying ship
Four, Moon Palace.
Five, Purgatory Drift Hall.
"As long as we could acquire the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, with how mystical it is, we will have won half this war." The huge fanged-hunk chuckled.

chapters.title: Chapter 707 - Convene
chapters.content:
Chapter 707: Convene
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"This Primal Chaos Flying Ship is suppressed by unseen laws. Those at the level of Rulers and Religious Leaders will be rejected from entering." The huge fanged-hunk shook his head, "It's a pity that there aren't many details recorded in the sacred writings. It has only mentioned some simple information about the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. But this simple information along with the fact that none has controlled this flying ship for many epochs meant that it should be ownerless, and we can snatch it away."
"Previously, the Cultivator Cosmos has Pang Yi and Monarch Green. Even though our cosmos has very powerful protectors, we have to admit that they still lack as compared to Pang Yi and Monarch Green! Their control of the laws and profound mysteries is too deep. During a battle, a part of their energy could be divided into ten parts, and every single move of theirs is unpredictable. With them around… it's impossible for our protectors to win."
"But the two of them have both become Rulers!"
"The Cultivator Cosmos no longer have any overwhelmingly strong Paragons. The strongest one is called Great Destruction Heavenly Emperor. Hahaha, even though he is not bad, any of our three Holy Protectors can fight against him single-handedly." The huge fanged-hunk chuckled.
"Right, our protectors could suppress them regardless of numbers or power."
"We have nine protectors who have reached the realm of Religious Leader! They just lack resources to break through."
These Religious Leaders were fully confident.
Their Religious Leaders outnumbered the Rulers in numbers. But if they did not rely on treasures, they had no confidence in a frontal battle because the Rulers of the Cultivator Cosmos could always refine another avatar in a short period after dying in battle! Furthermore, the Rulers were all exquisite in their usage of the laws and profound mysteries. All of them were extremely cunning. Even 'Temporal Island Lord' who was weaker in frontal battle, was famous for his stealth tactics. In terms of the time-space control, he was the strongest across both their cosmos. Other Rulers had comprehended a Dao at the Ruler realm. Thus, they were overall stronger than the Religious Leaders.
They could only rely on numbers and the superiority of treasures to fight!
They always felt that it was too early to spark the war. If they could form more Religious Leaders and continue cultivating the laws and profound mysteries of this cosmos, their combat power would greatly surge.
But they had no choice. The Bloodshed God-Emperor was employing the Void Twin Extreme Array without giving them time at all!
Still-
They were very confident of their protectors!
There were nine whose realm reached the Religious Leader realm without breaking through. It strengthened them spiritually and did not improve their power greatly. On the contrary, if it were those like Xue Ying from this cosmos, the moment their realms broke through, that would be the breakthrough of the 'Dao' and their powers would undergo a qualitative change. The Ancestor Mother Religion was greatly different though. They had to rely on resources to allow their bodies to develop under the guidance of 'Ancestor Mother' after their realms reached a higher level.
Thus, the 'Ancestor Mother Altar' was vital!
Without the Ancestor Mother Altar, they could not improve.
But out of the nine protectors, three were able to blaze a new trail and become stronger. They were called 'Holy Protectors'.
"The Primal Chaos Flying Ship is a treasure recorded in the sacred writing-its power is immense. As long as we control it, we would have won half this war! Furthermore, even if we lost, we can rely on the Primal Chaos Flying Ship to reach another cosmos." The huge fanged-hunk said, "Thus, we must not heed the price. Even if the protectors have to sacrifice themselves, we must get the Primal Chaos Flying Ship!"
"Monarch Green has become a Ruler. They no longer have any powerful Paragons. This is an opportunity given to us by Ancestor Mother." Desire and expectations filled the eyes of that huge fanged-hunk.
"Fight with all our strength!"
"Stake everything without hesitation!"
"Snatch the Primal Chaos Flying Ship and conquer this cosmos before establishing the Ancestor Mother Altar! This will become our cosmos then!"
The 18 silhouettes within this vast palace hall were all resolved to fight without heeding the price of doing so.
They could not afford to lose!
The moment they lost, they would no longer have another cosmos to live on as their hometown was collapsing. Without the Primal Chaos Flying Ship to protect them, they would be exterminated!
…
Over at Monarch Dong Bo residence in the Black Fog Sea.
The snowflakes were floating down, causing a thick layer of snow to accumulate on the residence. Xue Ying was currently boiling wine by himself. Other than the boiling wine on the table, it was just a huge Black Gourd placed there. Xue Ying would occasionally embrace that big Black Gourd before falling into a daze. In reality, he was trying to sense the unfathomable void array within the gourd.
The void array was grand. It was like the star river in the sky. And Xue Ying was just a mortal gazing at the magnificent scene.
The gap in the realm was too huge!
Xue Ying would at times study a part of this void array, and at times try to understand the giant array from the bigger picture-it felt fuzzy. Over these 600,000 years, he had gained some understanding, just that it was still far away from refining the Black Gourd.
"Xue Ying." A voice sounded by his ears suddenly. There was even a strand of anxiety, "Come quickly over to the Arcadia Flying ship!"
"Teacher?" Xue Ying was slightly stunned.
His teacher was usually calm, why would he lose his composure this time?
"Come immediately!" Bloodshed God-Emperor did not explain. He gave his orders.
"Yes."
Xue Ying could not care about any other matters. He immediately grabbed the Black Gourd left on the table before leaving the Monarch Residence hastily. As he left, he transmitted a message: "Jing Qiu, I have something and have to leave."
Jing Qiu teleported over to where Xue Ying was boiling his wine. Seeing the wine flask that was still piping hot, Jing Qiu turned at Xue Ying who was tunneling into a time-space tunnel high up the sky. She could not help but anticipate the day that she could help him. But the difference in their power was too big, and all she could do was to support him from the dark silently.
******
"Hu."
Xue Ying was flying with all his speed. He extended the Mirage World, tearing apart a time-space tunnel continuously. That allowed him to fly at a fast speed.
Just half the time to brew a cup of tea later.
"Hua."
Xue Ying left the time-space tunnel. He saw a flying ship currently floating in the starry sky outside. The flying ship was about 500 kilometers long. It did not look huge in the backdrop of the starry sky, but the reason why it was called the 'Arcadia Flying ship' was that it had a huge Eden within despite the apparent small size as seen from the outside.
"Teacher." Xue Ying soon discovered his teacher. He had also seen the black-robed black-haired Temporal Island Lord who was always cold. The ten Rulers were here too.
Other than the ten Rulers, there were already more than ten Paragons there. Water Devil King, Paragon Huo Cheng, and others had already reached.
"I've always suspected that this Arcadia Flying Ship is unusual, and doesn't seem to be part of our cosmos." Bloodshed God-Emperor explained, "What makes this place puzzling is that Rulers can't even enter! Because we discovered how special it is, we decided to rank it third among the five great historical remains. I've always felt that it could be more formidable than what we presumed it to be. Thus, there's an array planted around this location. Who would have thought the Ancestor Mother Religion would dispatch a huge army-a group of Religious Leaders that rushed over and tear apart my array easily. They have sent a huge group of protectors into this Arcadia Flying Ship."
"With so many Religious Leaders coming together!"
"And so many protectors entering, they must know something which we do not know about-possibly on how to control this Arcadia Flying Ship." Bloodshed God-Emperor frowned. He was worried.

chapters.title: Chapter 708 - 36 Light Streams
chapters.content:
Chapter 708: 36 Light Streams
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The green-robed old man, Primal Master, nodded and said, "When we were Paragons, we had entered the Arcadia Flying Ship, experiencing for ourselves how extraordinary it was within. It has some immeasurability beyond even the Six Heavenly Wheel and Lake Heart Island historical remain! The person who refined this Arcadia Flying Ship is likely to be stronger than the Lake Heart Island master and Ancestor Devil! Thus, we presumed it came from outside the cosmos."
"Right." The black-robed black-haired Temporal Island Lord nodded, "It's a pity that it was hard for us to extract any benefits from it."
The five great historical remains.
The Arcadia Flying Ship that was ranked third was the most stingy place. Those who adventured there did not gain much from it.
On the contrary, the Lake Heart Island historical remain, Six Heavenly Wheel, and Moon Palace contained many treasures, absolute arts, guidance, experiences, and others that had been left especially by the seniors from the earlier epochs. Even the 'Purgatory Drift Hall' was slightly special for it contained an inheritance within.
Only the 'Arcadia Flying Ship' was different.
According to the vestiges left behind-traces left behind from refinement and the arrays, one could perceive that this place was the highest-leveled location in the Cultivator Cosmos. But one could not gain much from it.
"Firstly, there are few benefits. Secondly, Rulers can't enter." Abyss Primogenitor shook his head as well: "Ranking it third is solely because of how extraordinary it is."
The cold Myriad God Palace Head disagreed, however, "We have no rewards because we are unable to discover its true secret! The Ancestor Mother Religion has sent a large group of protectors at this time. They must know what secret this Arcadia Flying Ship hold!"
Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded: "Not just us, even the seniors from the previous epochs have made their conjectures, recognizing that this Arcadia Flying Ship came from outside the cosmos. Since the Ancestor Mother Religion is familiar with its secret, this Arcadia Flying Ship should be very famous. At the current moment, I am employing the Void Twin Extreme Array. The Ancestor Mother Religion should be getting anxious and is compelled to send a large group of protectors in."
"However, this Arcadia Flying Ship is suppressed by the unseen laws, forbidding Rulers from entering." Bloody Ruler Nile anxiously mentioned.
"We have no choice. We can only send our Paragons in." Bloodshed God-Emperor responded.
"We can only watch from afar."
"It all depends on the Paragons from now on."
Primal Master, Abyss Primogenitor, Purgatory Ruler, Empress Qian He and the others felt incapable of helping.
…
The Paragons were rapidly converging.
Many Paragons were looking around in shock. They saw the ten Rulers gathered here, and many more Paragons were still on the way.
"This, what is happening?"
"The Rulers are here. The Paragons are coming too. What exactly is going on?"
All of them were bewildered.
Xue Ying, Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, and Monarch Destruction naturally stuck together.
"Dong Bo, do you know what happened?" Monarch Destruction asked. Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master turned towards him too.
"I don't." Xue Ying was filled with confusion as he shook his head. At the same time, he looked around him. It seemed that everyone was in the dark too.
"I've asked a few old friends of mine, and they don't know what is happening too! Right now, Bloodshed is talking with other Rulers, and it isn't right for me to inquire him at this moment." Monarch Destruction said. He could see that it was a significant matter, and it was not the time for him to posture as the teacher. After all, his disciple 'Bloodshed God-Emperor' was the authentic leading existence in the entire Cultivator Cosmos.
"Wait and see." Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master was very calm, "Since they called us over, they will soon inform what is going on."
"Mn."
Xue Ying nodded and waited by the side.
He could see his good brother Paragon Huo Cheng in the distant. He saw White Sovereign King, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, Monarch Hex Cricket and even Ripple Lady Planet Master who specialized in refining came too. Regardless, all Paragons had gathered as long as they had broken through.
"Mn?" Xue Ying noticed the distant Leaf Saint. He still had some vengeance towards him.
…
Finally, all Paragons from Deity world and Abyss had convened.
The ten Rulers also stopped their conversation. Bloodshed God-Emperor swept his gaze across the Paragons and announced, "I believe most of you should know that there are other cosmos present besides our own Cultivator Cosmos."
The Paragons present were all silent. They were carefully listening.
"Occasionally, our cosmos do discover traces of outsiders entering our cosmos. But these aren't worth mentioning. What is worrying is that there is a power called 'Ancestor Mother Religion' who have sent a large batch of Rulers into our cosmos." Bloodshed God-Emperor said.
"What?"
"A large batch of Rulers?"
Many Paragons felt their hearts tightening after hearing that.
"The Ancestor Mother Religion might wage war with us. In our original plan, the ten of us should be enough to participate in the war since you all will not be of much help towards the outcome of the war. Instead, you might restrict our hands and feet." The Bloodshed God-Emperor said plainly. All Paragons present did not retort. They were clear how big the gap between them and the Rulers was.
"But now, a group of Rulers from the Ancestor Mother Religion have broken my arrays and sent a large group of Paragons into the Arcadia Flying Ship!" Bloodshed God-Emperor said, "It is highly possible that they know some secret regarding the Arcadia Flying Ship."
As he was explaining the situation, Bloodshed God-Emperor was also transmitting every single piece of intelligence he had on the Ancestor Mother Religion and Arcadia Flying Ship to the Paragons. Even though those like Xue Ying knew of many secrets previously, some Paragons knew little about it.
"The intelligence reports have been given. You should know the threat of the Ancestor Mother Religion."
"The war originally doesn't require all of you to participate."
"But things are different now! We will still handle the final battle. And the war within the Arcadia Flying Ship will be handled by all you Paragons!" Bloodshed God-Emperor stated, "We do not know what secrets the Arcadia Flying Ship hold. Thus, what we can do is one thing-to eradicate all of them! After eradicating all their protectors, this plot of theirs will fail."
"The final war will ultimately be us Rulers fighting."
"And the battle within the Arcadia Flying Ship will depend solely on you all. You might die battling, but you could always refine another avatar to enter." The eyes of Bloodshed God-Emperor were filled with killing intent, "We must not heed the price. Even if we were to spend our resources, we would use all of them to stifle them to death!"
The entire place went silent.
Each Paragon standing in the void was filled with fighting spirit.
This was a war between two cosmos!
Initially, they were not needed to get involved with the war. But now, they could lend a helping hand.
"36 Paragons." Bloodshed God-Emperor looked at them, "We Rulers do not know what secrets are hidden in the Arcadia Flying Ship. But we can confirm that the Arcadia Flying Ship is much more terrifying than the Lake Heart Island historical remain and the Six Heavenly Wheel! If you were defeated, it might lead to a final defeat in the war."
"We will win. We will eradicate these outsiders!" There was a muscular man with two black horns and a pair of violet eyes that had some faint lightning movement within declared. He was the strongest among the 36 Paragons, the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction!
"Right, we will eradicate them!"
"This is the Paragons' war."
"We will definitely win."
The fighting spirit in all Paragons rose up into the sky.
And Bloodshed God-Emperor, Primal Master, Temporal Island Lord and all other Rulers were turning energetic. These were all Paragons from their Cultivator Cosmos!
"Go!" Bloodshed God-Emperor ordered.
"Go!"
"Let us go!"
"Let's kill all protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion!"
All Paragons including Xue Ying, Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, Monarch Destruction, Paragon Huo Cheng, Ripple Lady Planet Master, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction and the others flew towards that Arcadia Flying Ship.
The ten Rulers watched as they flew in.
"Will they win?" Empress Qian He felt worried.
"We originally have two strongest Paragons, but both Pang Yi and Monarch Green became Rulers! Currently, there aren't any Paragons that can fight against a Ruler." Myriad God Palace Master coldly stated, "The outcome is somewhat uncertain."
The other Rulers did not add on.
Everyone felt that it wasn't baseless. Monarch Green and Pang Yi could suppress a large group of Paragons by themselves when they were a Paragon. It's a pity that both had become Rulers now.
The ten Rulers looked from afar. The distant 36 streams of light arced through the starry sky and entered the Arcadia Flying Ship!
Those 36 streams of light… were all the Paragons they had in their Cultivator Cosmos.

chapters.title: Chapter 709 - The First Contact
chapters.content:
Chapter 709: The First Contact
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The Arcadia Flying Ship was getting more prominent in their vision. Xue Ying and the other 36 Paragons did not decelerate. When they were about five kilometers to the flying ship, a ripple fluctuated on the surface of the ship. Xue Ying and the others easily crossed through this ripple and entered the ship.
"Hua."
After crossing through the ripple, they saw a calm and peaceful world. This world had grass plains, hills and rivers though it did not contain any birds or land beasts.
"Stop!" Following Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction's shout-'hu hu hu'-the others including Xue Ying stopped immediately.
The 36 Paragons from the Cultivation Cosmos (including Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master and Xue Ying) were all the Paragons they had. Their expressions turned solemn at this moment. Even though there was unseen law suppression within this world of Arcadia Flying Ship, Xue Ying, Mysterious North Imperial Empress, and other experts could still scout from a far distance.
"The Ancestor Mother Religion has so many protectors?"
Xue Ying borrowed the Mirage World to extend his senses. He soon enveloped the group of protectors who were moving in a dazzling rainbow light 30 billion kilometers away! They were different from the Cultivator Cosmos. These protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion were cruder in their usage of laws and profound mysteries. Even though a select few had comprehended the complete 'law of the world', none had opened a 'Dao'! Thus, it was needless to say they could not teleport within the Arcadia Flying Ship world. They could only fly slowly, and it was effortless for Xue Ying and them to chase up to them! They could teleport using the Mirage World for instance!
"Such powerful aura!" Xue Ying's expression had a slight change.
There were a total of 51 protectors. They were currently flying at ultra-high speed. There were three with the most frightening aura traveling in the front-they were a golden-haired monkey, a girl with a venomous tail, and a muscular man holding a wooden pole. The three of them were emitting an unseen fluctuation that enveloped the entire group.
As Xue Ying, White Sovereign King, Mysterious North Imperial Empress, and others scouted them in the dark, these three most terrifying protectors had immediately sensed them.
"Hmph."
The muscular man holding the wooden pole turned glanced at them. His vision passed through the obstacles of void and could see the group of Paragons a tens of billions of kilometers away.
"They are here." The golden-haired monkey turned glanced at them too. His golden eyes had faintly penetrated through the void towards the group of Paragons.
"They are sending themselves to their deaths." The girl with a venomous tail sneered.
"We must not underestimate them. These cultivators have opened a 'Dao', and their usage of the laws and profound mysteries is much higher than ours. They could easily scout us, yet only I and Protector Kui could see them." The golden-haired monkey transmitted a message.
The muscular man holding the wooden pole said, "Thus if we were to play with them and compare skills, we would be the one suffering. It'd be better if we acted together, suppressing them with an absolute superiority in strength… no matter what moves they use against us, we will suppress them in combat and break them into smithereens!"
The venom-tailed woman giggled.
That was a smile originating from confidence! The Ancestor Mother Religion had been observing the entire Cultivation Cosmos. With the large information provided by Bloody Ruler Nile, they were full of understanding towards the power of all 36 Paragons who came. Thus, they were naturally confident that they would win this time!
…
Xue Ying and the other Paragons assembled in midair. Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction had a violet armor on him. The two arms revealed were covered in dragon tattoos. He had two black twisted horns protruding from his head and a pair of violet eyes that contained faint slithering thunder. He shouted, "Fellow Paragons, the Ancestor Mother Religion has suddenly moved! And all 51 protectors are moving as one! Since they dared to do this, they must have some reason!"
The other Paragons looked at Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction. With his power, he was naturally the leader of this group.
The world of cultivators would always be led by the strongest!
"No matter what reliance they had, we must avoid their strengths and attack their weaknesses." The Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction said, "Their cultivation heart realm is much weaker than ours. Thus, the moment the battle begins, Purgatory Great Commander, Nightmare Sovereign and Monarch Dong Bo will be displaying your illusory techniques one after another! Purgatory Great Commander's 'Purgatory Reincarnation' is the most tyrannical and overbearing so he will employ it first! Nightmare Sovereign's 'Nightmare Technique' is relatively bizarre, and Monarch Dong Bo's 'Mirage Illusory Realm' is also extraordinary. Those who have a weaker cultivation realm might withstand it, but after the second and third assault on their heart, they might fall in the end."
None present retorted against his reasoning.
After all, the illusory realm was best used against a large group of people. Those who could resist it were fine. Those who could not resist would die. In such a situation, the effectiveness of such techniques was the highest.
"I'll have to trouble the three of you." Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction turned to Xue Ying and the other two.
"Let us handle it." Purgatory Great Commander who was wearing a red armor said coldly.
Nightmare Sovereign who was shrouded in faint fog and the black-robed Xue Ying both nodded too.
"After the illusory techniques are employed, it'll be time for us to launch a frenzied assault! We will use our domains to suppress all of them." Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction began arranging the attacks. Devil Phoenix was an apex Paragon who originated from the Dark Abyss. Her ranking on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List was behind the top apex Paragons because she specialized more in domains! She was also the strongest domain controller amongst the Paragons.
She was average in direct combat and defense. It was only her domain that was special. Most ordinary Paragons were helpless in front of her. And meeting the apex Paragons, she could always rely on her domain to escape.
Thus, even though she was ranked 20th on the Cosmos Deity-Demon List, her status and influential power were huge-comparable to Water Devil King and the others.
"There's also Mysterious North Imperial Empress…"
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction continued giving out his instructions.
He cultivated for an extended period and was also the leader of this group. Naturally, he had to do his best.
…
Very soon, the battle plan was made. They would be utilizing their strengths. There were also many backup plans.
"Alright, since everyone understands, then let the battle begin." Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction turned towards the green-robed beautiful woman, 'Mysterious North Imperial Empress', "Mysterious North Imperial Empress, let us teleport to the front of them."
Mysterious North Imperial Empress softly nodded.
"Hua."
A huge array illusion appeared in the surrounding void the next moment.
"Weng!"
For a moment, the array illusion covered all 36 Paragons, causing them to disappear.
When they appeared, they were to the flank where the group of protectors was 30 billion kilometers away.
"Hu." The group of protectors from Ancestor Mother Religion was flying at high speed. They formed a vast rainbow stream as they flew. It was akin to a meteor arcing through the sky. And the location where appeared was just a few kilometers away from the group of protectors. To experts of their level, this short distance could be covered by extending their hands!
Amongst the 36 Paragons, Purgatory Great Commander, Nightmare Sovereign, and Xue Ying were all concentrating. Of which the red-armored Purgatory Great Commander led first with his illusory realm technique.
One could see his eyes engulfed in flames.
In his eyes, the burning flames seemed to contain countless souls howling within. This undulation which could not be seen covered all 51 protectors present.

chapters.title: Chapter 710 - Annihilation
chapters.content:
Chapter 710: Annihilation
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"Ah~"
Almost at the next moment, six out of the 51 protectors held on to their heads and howled grievously. Their eyes were burning in flames. This flame represented a burn on their souls. They were unable to resist the 'Purgatory Reincarnation', causing their souls to burn and dissipate directly. The other protectors might reveal a look of agony, but they had barely held on.
"Go." Nightmare Sovereign let out soft laughter. This laughter had somehow transmitting into the mind of every protector.
Out of those protectors who survived through the Purgatory Reincarnation, there were two who formed a strange smile before entering deep sleep.
"Descend."
Xue Ying followed closely with his illusory realm.
Their techniques were disparate. Purgatory Great Commander's 'Purgatory Reincarnation' was a technique based on the 'Dao of Purgatory' meant for offense. It directly targeted one's soul, and the formation of the illusory realm was just a side-effect. Those who could not resist it would have their souls burning into ashes! 'Nightmare Sovereign's technique was a nightmare-related attack. He could control the soul of the enemies.
And Xue Ying's 'illusory realm' formed a world that seemed real! This illusory world and the external world were two types of world. When the illusory realm descended, it would muddle the rationality of those souls, causing them to remain within the Mirage illusion for eternity.
"Hu hu hu~"
As the illusory realm was displayed, five protectors lost their bearings as they entered a deep sleep.
"Mn?"
Those who employed the techniques, Purgatory Great Commander and Nightmare Sovereign glanced at Xue Ying with shock. They were clear that the first use of illusory realm would produce the most significant effect-six protectors fell to the technique. The second time it was employed, the outcome would be worse since six protectors with a weaker cultivation heart had died, leaving those with stronger cultivation hearts-two went into slumber from his technique. When the third illusory realm was displayed, it had, however, caused five to lose their bearings. This outcome startled them since Xue Ying could be the strongest one amongst them if comparing the technique of illusory realm.
Xue Ying was clear about this. He had spent many years cultivating, allowing him to accumulate much wisdom on the 'Dao of Mirage'. Adding up the 600,000 years of comprehending the void array within the Black Gourd, he who was originally skillful with the Dao of Mirage had grasped quite a lot of usage from the 'void array' related to the Dao of Mirage. These gains naturally improved his understanding of the Dao of Mirage, allowing it to reach an apex level.
Purgatory Great Commander's 'illusory realm' was only a side effect from his technique. Nightmare Sovereign was merely an ordinary Paragon! Xue Ying's Dao of Mirage was uniquely designed for the illusory realm. He had also reached the apex realm, so it was nothing surprising for him to be the number one expert in this field.
"Monarch Dong bo acted last, yet he eliminated five protectors."
"His illusory realm is more formidable than we expected."
The Paragons on the side of the Cultivation Cosmos were able to conclude many points from this. It's just that Xue Ying was too young, making everyone assume his illusory realm technique would be ordinary.
"Hong~" Devil Phoenix as part of the 36 Paragons, was currently wearing a luxurious deep violet gown. On her charming appearance, there was a pair of eyes that was presently emitting an air of murder. One could see many violet lights enshrouding the region of five billion kilometers wide. Many violet lights fluctuated within. They were like a violet sea, with every single violet light containing an offense that brought terror into the hearts of others.
But-
All the protectors in the Ancestor Mother Religion had an unseen ripple protecting them. The one who covered them was none other than the golden-haired monkey, the venomous-tailed woman and the muscular man wielding a wooden rod. The 'illusory realm technique' targeted their souls directly. Thus, they could not protect their allies. But this domain attack by Devil Phoenix was easily resisted by them.
"Kill all of them!" The golden-haired monkey roared. He pushed his palm out, bringing a substantial destructive might with it as it swept towards the group of Paragons.
Filled with fury, the golden-haired monkey started sending killing moves almost instantaneously. His body was emitting golden light as his aura surged even fiercer. That palm filled with hair was rapidly becoming bigger. Every single hair on his palm was just like a huge tree. It seemed this palm aspired to smash all Paragons to death. Even the space near this palm was being warped, forming black holes.
The expressions of Xue Ying and the others changed.
Fighting one on 36? That seemed like a joke!
