But Xue Ying and the others conceded that this was not a joke. That attack by the golden-haired monkey could match the might of a Ruler under ordinary circumstances. At this moment, he erupted with a forbidden move without care! That strengthened his power further, allowing it to reach an unfathomable stage. Even though the monkey was weaker regarding laws and profound mysteries, he could still withstand attacks directly such as the illusory realm by Xue Ying. But many ordinary Paragons would be entirely suppressed by the monkey's technique for it had reached the level of Rulers!
He was also the one with the strongest power amongst the three Holy Protectors!
"Scram!" A roar accompanied that.
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction slashed out the black pole in his hand. He would usually not use any weapon to fight. But this time, he had used one. The weapon turned into a violet thunderclap.
"Hong long long~"
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction's strength had reached the Ruler level. Even his grasp of laws and profound mysteries were close to that of the Rulers.
During the days when Pang Yi was low-profile, the public recognized Monarch Green as the strongest! He could genuinely fight against Rulers. Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction was considered second. He was very close to the Ruler realm and could wrestle slightly with the Rulers. But over time, he would still be defeated.
As for the other Paragons? Water Devil King, White Sovereign King, Monarch Hex Cricket and others might be apex Paragons, but they could only survive in front of Rulers; they could not wrestle with them.
"Peng!"
The long black pole tore apart everything and clashed against that hairy palm. The long pole slightly trembled and dissipated off the incoming force. Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction was not disadvantaged. Instead, he continued killing his way over.
"Kill Great Destruction before sweeping off other Paragons." The golden-haired monkey ordered.
"Kill!" The venom-tailed woman and the muscular man wielding pole did not hesitate to team up with the golden-haired monkey-they attacked Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction together! They would at most be comparable with the Heavenly Emperor when fighting one-on-one. But if they were to work together, with how diversified their methods were, and the fact that they had much intelligence on Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction gave them the certainty of killing him.
…
Within the base of Ancestor Mother Religion, inside the vast palace hall, the group of Religious Leaders was seated cross-legged watching the battle happen from a projection.
"They killed 12 protectors instantaneously. Six might have entered deep sleep, but they can't support the rest currently." A thin old man commented. It was tough for those who entered the illusory realm to 'wake'. Religious Leaders who could do this could be counted with one's finger, much less the protectors. They could only search for their real bodies located in their hometown cosmos before asking a Religious Leader to wake them up.
"That Dong Bo Xue Ying is the last to display his illusory technique, yet he caused five protectors to fall to his attack. He wasn't that formidable that time at the Six Heavenly Wheel."
These Religious Leaders were discussing among each other.
Indeed, when Xue Ying was at the Six Heavenly Wheel, he had merely dealt with a single protector using his illusory realm. But that time, he had opened the Dao of Mirage recently.
And now?
It had been close to 10 million years. Adding up his comprehension of the void array from the Black Gourd, and the fact that his Dao of Mirage had reached the limit, he was naturally stronger than the past!
"Everyone."
The huge fanged-hunk said with a low tone, "I've just gotten news that we aren't able to protect the six protectors assaulted by the Purgatory Reincarnation. Their true bodies have died-the souls were all burned to death."
There was silence in that palace hall.
When Xue Ying and Nightmare Sovereign attacked, the actual bodies of the enemies would only enter a deep sleep if they could not withstand their illusory realms. However, when Purgatory Great Commander struck, if the enemies could not resist against it, the soul on both bodies would burn and dissipate.
"They died for their hometown and their race." The huge fanged-hunk said solemnly, "Their death is valuable."
A female Religious Leader said calmly, "This war has only just begun! Everything is for the sake of survival!"

chapters.title: Chapter 711 - The Clash between the Two Parties
chapters.content:
Chapter 711: The Clash between the Two Parties
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
In the starry sky outside the Arcadia Flying Ship.
Bloodshed God-Emperor, Monarch Green, Pang Yi, Abyss Primogenitor, Primal Master and the other Rulers were watching from afar. Those from the Ancestor Mother Religion could permeate through the flying ship and see the battle happening. As the Cultivator Rulers were more erudite in their knowledge of the laws and profound mysteries, they were able to observe what was happening within easily. But 'seeing' was still 'seeing. They were helpless against the law suppression that prevented them from entering.
"The battle has begun." Primal Master stroke his mustache.
"The illusory realm could indeed curb the Ancestor Mother Religion. In an instant, 12 protectors succumbed." Bloody Ruler Nile praised.
"They are only the weaker ones. it isn't easy to deal with the remaining stronger ones." Temporal Island Lord coldly retorted, "I hope they don't lose that badly in this first battle."
Bloodshed God-Emperor was deep in thoughts.
Their judgment was cold-blooded. They could discern the gap in combat power between both parties-it was an apparent, distinct gap!
"Your disciple is not bad." Abyss Primogenitor had laughed, "It seems his improvement in the 'Dao of Mirage' is quite large."
Temporal Island Lord quipped coldly, "It's a pity that the Dao of Mirage is of limited help offensively."
Bloodshed God-Emperor was just spectating. He was carefully collecting more information and analyzing the protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion. After all, they lacked an understanding of the Ancestor Mother Religion. Since this was an actual large-scale battle, it was also the best occasion to gather more information.
…
Within the Arcadia Flying Ship, the Paragons and protectors that originated from the two different cosmos were starting to embroil in a frenzied battle. One was fighting for the sake of survival and wanted to conquer this cosmos. The other side was resisting against these outsiders. They were all fighting with their lives.
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction had struggled with the three Holy Protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion. One could see how tyrannical that golden-haired monkey was. His two hairy palms were wantonly attacking; he was using his superiority of strength to force Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction to resist with all his power too. The muscular man wielding the wooden pole was strong, yet he was somewhat moderate in strength compared to the golden-haired monkey. Still, he was able to suppress the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction. Furthermore, that pole technique of his was strange and unpredictable, inflicting great injuries on the back of Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction when it struck.
A single hit and it injured him-Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction's expression turned ugly.
That venom-tailed girl was more sinister. Her tail rapidly elongated to several kilometers long and was like shackles snaking its way. The tip of the tail had a poison which Heavenly Emperor did not dare to parry with his body.
"Great Destruction." A middle-aged man who was wearing azure green entered the foray. He was none other than 'Monarch Hex Cricket', and someone ranked after the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction.
Monarch Hex Cricket had a layer of faint green light covering his body. He went into the battle without weapons.
"Peng."
That muscular man smashed out his wooden pole with all his strength. Monarch Hex Cricket received the attack using his hands. He was forced two steps back with some black marks forming on his arm. However, following that, a green light appeared on the surface of his body, causing this injury to disappear.
"This Monarch Hex Cricket is weak in offense, but he is known to be undying. The three of us can't injure him at all." The golden-haired monkey transmitted a message, "Let's forget about him. We'll focus on Great Destruction."
The three Holy Protectors were not willing to entangle themselves with Monarch Hex Cricket.
But Monarch Hex Cricket was doing his best to get into a tangle with them. He was trying his best to help Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction.
Monarch Hex Cricket was known to be 'undying'. That was not empty words. He was truly too powerful and heaven-shattering, and he had guarded the 'Black Rain Eden' single-handedly within the Six Heavenly Wheel, ensuing helplessness in the Ancestor Mother Religion! Even if others used all treasures to shatter his body, disintegrating his soul, he could still revive again. Such a life force would make even the Rulers envious.
With the help of Hex Cricket, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction could barely fight evenly with the three Holy Protectors, or at least he would not be downed in a few moves!
…
Kill! Kill! Kill!
The other Paragons were also fighting with the protectors.
There were three categories of protectors from Ancestor Mother Religion. First included those with tyrannical strength and speed. Second included those who could mutate their bodies or certain parts like their hair. They could even turn their hands into sharp weapons, or shoot out light with their eyes-these protectors were hard to deal with. The third type would be those who seemed weak physically, yet their bodies were still stronger than the Cultivator Paragons. All cultivators in the battlefield remained most vigilant against this group: "We must never let them get our fresh blood!"
Bloodshed God-Emperor had transmitted part of the intelligence to them.
It stated that the physically weak protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion specialized in something called 'Curses'. They required a medium like hair or bone to transmit their techniques. The best would naturally be the blood of the target! Do not see how weak they were in battle, the moment they got their hands on the blood of the other party, that was when they became the most significant threat.
On the side of the cultivators, they each had their varied techniques. Some had turned into lightning, some into flame, some into bamboo leaves, and as they battled, there would be arrays forming, domains binding, hex poison sneaking…
Regardless, they had a vast assortment of techniques that were apparently on a higher level.
But-
"Hong hong hong~"
During the few instances they exchanged techniques, the battle outcome had turned in a definite direction.
The cultivators were almost entirely on the losing end!
"Die for me!" A protector from the Ancestor Mother Religion hacked out with the enormous stone ax in his hand. The expression of a cultivator changed as he saw that. He rapidly retreated and tried to defend against the attack, yet with a 'hong', his entire body had been cut by the stone ax. The force transmitted over destroyed his body into nothingness.
"Kill!"
"Die!"
The apex protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion specialized in simple suppressive combat techniques. That time, Xue Ying had been directly suppressed when he fought with Protector Huo Zhu!
Those apex protectors who can mutate their body could contain the Paragons with their strengths too. Furthermore, their attacks were more unpredictable.
More importantly!
Adding up the three Holy Protectors, there were a total of 32 apex protectors! Comparatively, how many apex Paragons did the Cultivator Cosmos have? Not even half of the other party! What was left were the ordinary Paragons, but the gap in power was too enormous. Some who were excellent in survival like 'Leaf Saint' could barely survive. Those who were weaker in survival capabilities were swept off cleanly.
And the apex Paragons like Paragon Huo Cheng, Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, Devil Phoenix, Mysterious North Imperial Empress could each kill an apex protector each, or even aid the other Paragons. But they did not have a clear advantage and were slightly stronger.
The battle between both parties…
Those from the cultivator's side who held a superior advantage included Water Devil King, White Sovereign King, Bitter Cultivator, Purgatory Great Command and Xue Ying who had finally revealed his true strength!
"Kill!" Water Devil King's body condensed into a stream of water. He was fierce and had a venomous trident in his hand.
He was attacking rampantly.
When the protectors struck him, Water Devil King's body could turn into an endless stream of water, dissipating and condensing in another area. He would then attack another protector along the way. His body was one which even 'Primal Master' could not indeed extinguish. He could only imprison Water Devil King. Regarding offense, he was much stronger than Monarch Hex Cricket and was more brutal and vicious. Within a moment, a protector of the Ancestor Mother Religion was yelling for help.
"Hmph."
A layer of blood currently surrounded the silver-white-armored handsome White Sovereign King's body.
"Shua."
His body was like real and unreal. He would turn into a fog of blood, preventing those from the Ancestor Mother Religion to hit him. At the same time, he was displaying that terrifying sword technique of his. Every single strike contained an ultra-strong power. That time, he had heavily injured Xue Ying who had already cultivated the stage four Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor. This sword technique was compelling, mystical and unpredictable at the same time. Those protectors could not defend against him.
"Hmph." Bitter Cultivator was also fighting without weapons. He might seem thin and small, but he was physically strongest amongst Paragons. His strength was not any weaker than the apex protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion. More importantly, every single fist of his contained laws and profound mysteries nearing the Ruler realm.
"Peng."
He punched out. Even those like Protector Huo Zhu who dared to resist his attack with his body would be forced to spurt blood while being pushed back.
One could see how violent he was when fighting. Each of the protectors was being blasted back by his punches, and none could obstruct him!
"Die." A layer of flame covered the body of Purgatory Great Commander's body. He wielded a spear. He had cultivated the Myriad Devil True Body too, and even though he was physically weaker slightly as compared to the apex protectors, the gap wasn't significant. With how cunning his spear technique was, and the profundity of his realm, he had an armor that was strong in defense, preventing the apex protectors from contending against him.
Compared to the four experts mentioned above, Xue Ying who had cultivated the Dao of Mirage to the apex level was the most unpredictable one in the battlefield. His attack would come and go, and it brought great joy to the cultivators.

chapters.title: Chapter 712 - Gratified
chapters.content:
Chapter 712: Gratified
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"Hu." Xue Ying who was in black armor extended the black spear 'Blood Serpent Spear'. He was the most unpredictable Paragon amongst them. Within moments, he disappeared without leaving any traces.
Following that-'pu chi'.
The spear appeared from the void, arriving right before the forehead of an apex protector. Being an apex protector of the Ancestor Mother Religion, there was an unseen ripple covering his body. For Xue Ying to appear right before his forehead was an astounding feat in itself. He had reached an apex level in his 'Dao of Mirage', allowing his attacks to be more covert, unlike that time when he had just opened the Dao of Mirage-the covertness of his attacks was inadequate.
Besides, he had integrated both "Six Sever Sword Style" and "Mass Extinction Scripture" into his spear technique. The power from the Dao of Slaughter naturally become fiercer. At the same time, he had cultivated the Myriad Devil True Body just like Purgatory Great Commander and Bitter Cultivator did-he had overwhelming strength. Thus, this terrifying spear technique coupled with the suddenness of appearance of his spear right before the forehead of the protector ensured the protector could not defend his attack at all.
The spearhead directly pierced through the brain of the protector. Though the obstructive force was stronger and he had to exert an explosive strength to pull his spear out.
Half the mind of that protector was pulverized! Still, the naked eyes could see as his injuries slowly recovered. It was apparent his life force was enormous.
"Brother Dong Bo, you've acted beautifully!" Paragon Huo Cheng might be having a difficult time since three apex protectors were surrounding him, but Xue Ying had assisted him with a single spear strike.
"Sou sou sou…"
Xue Ying would disappear time after time. He would then appear and launch sneak attacks on the protectors, piercing through their bodies. His contribution improved the situation for the cultivators clearly. If not for his help, the current outcome would be much worse.
Even though Devil Phoenix was also teleporting around, her offense was much weaker; she could not break through the skin of the apex protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion!
'Why do I feel that things are awry?' Xue Ying was clear, 'The life force of these apex protectors is too strong. I can only injure them at most with a single strike, and they could recover very quickly! Even the weaker ones-those apex protectors who specialized in using curses, could dissolve their bodies into a fog, making it hard for them to die.'
It was hard to kill those who reached the level of apex Paragon.
Even the degree of threat from the hex poison in the Blood Serpent Spear was meager since apex protectors could force out the hex poison.
'If we fought one-on-one, we can get rid of an apex protector by spending a little more time. But now, they held an overwhelming advantage in numbers over us. Furthermore, they are supporting each other too. The moment an apex protector is injured, the others will help him. They would even keep them back into the Cultivation Eden.' Xue Ying shook his head. Like the Ancestor Mother Religion protectors who had fallen into the illusory realm previously, they had been kept by the other party into the Cultivation Edens.
Thus, it might be easy to injure the apex Paragons but hard to kill them.
One, it was because the other party's life force was too strong.
Two, they had a significant number of allies! It was impossible for them to watch as an apex protector dies in front of them.
"Not good." Monarch Destruction's expression changed. He might be exceptional in surviving, yet he was heavily injured. His blood had landed in the hands of a skinny and shriveled female from the Ancestor Mother Religion. This thin and shriveled female proceeded with using the mysterious 'Curse' by making use of the blood as the medium. The term 'Curse' was also termed by Bloodshed God-Emperor and the others. It was a genuinely mystical power.
It was not something Xue Ying and the others were familiar with.
It was so mysterious that it came down from a higher realm.
"Ah!" Monarch Destruction's face turned red. He lost all control of his body and started rolling and twisting in midair. A protector from the Ancestor Mother Religion immediately went out as he wanted to make use of this opportunity to kill him.
"Sou."
Devil Phoenix suddenly appeared. She grabbed hold of Monarch Destruction with her tender white hands, keeping her into the Cultivation Eden. Xue Ying arrived too, except that he was slower by a beat. He exchanged glances with Devil Phoenix. The two of them had helped many Paragons-they appeared at the crux to lend a helping hand.
'The current situation is too nasty.' Xue Ying thought.
"Withdraw!"
Monarch Hex Cricket suddenly roared.
He had already tried his best to save the heavily-injured Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction. Along with his command, all other Paragons rapidly retreated.
"Go."
Xue Ying entered the Mirage World too. At the same time, he turned his luminous sun force into many white light hands that grabbed the Paragons away. Paragon Huo Cheng and the others did not resist as they were pulled into the Mirage World. Devil Phoenix was similarly helping the other surrounded Paragons before all of them teleported away.
…
The protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion were still standing in midair.
"They escaped really quickly."
"If not for that Devil Phoenix and Dong Bo Xue Ying, we could have killed a few more Paragons."
"The two of them are really slippery."
These protectors were still feeling unreconciled.
If Mysterious North Imperial Empress were said to borrow on the power of array to teleport within the Arcadia Flying Ship, she would have to depend on the array every time she wanted to teleport. That Xue Ying and Devil Phoenix were able to teleport with a single thought for they opened a Dao related to it. Thus, the two of them could appear like ghosts.
"That Dong Bo Xue Ying's offensive power is extremely formidable. Even apex protectors are pierced through by him with a single spear strike." Protector Huo Zhu held onto his chest. The cavity on his chest was currently recovering. He muttered, "His combat power improved too fast. That time in the Six Heavenly Wheel, he could not even break through my skin."
"According to intelligence, he cultivated the Myriad Devil True Body!" The golden-haired monkey said with a gloomy voice, "And it seems that other than the Myriad Devil True Body, his spear techniques are extremely vicious and are filled with the aura of destruction and slaughter."
"Mn, he is indeed a variable, reducing the number of Paragons we killed this time." The venom-tailed girl said.
"How're the losses?" The golden-haired monkey asked.
A violet-robed female protected answered, "Protector Qian, when we were struck by the illusory realm attacks, both true body and avatar of six protectors were extinguished!"
All the protectors present went into silence.
Both true body and avatar were extinguished? That was a complete death.
"If we don't stake it, our entire race will become extinct." The muscular man with a wooden pole said softly, "There could be more comrades dying in the battle following this. That could not be avoided."
"Other than them and the protectors deep in slumber, because Water Devil King, Purgatory Great Commander, and Dong Bo Xue Ying's sneak attacks were too sudden, three more protectors had died here." The violet-robed female protector said, "The other protectors are fine. And for us, we killed a total of eight Paragons."
…
Above a piece of grass plain within the Arcadia Flying Ship.
The group of Paragons was situated here.
All of them were feeling grave.
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction had a cold expression. As proud as he was, if not for Monarch Hex Cricket's timely intervention, he would die!
Many Paragons present had given Xue Ying a gaze of gratitude. This time, he had indeed aided many Paragons. This battle had also culminated in the approvals of Xue Ying by other Paragons: "How is he weak? Being the newest third ancestor of Bloodshed God Palace, everyone said he is the weakest. But he should be the strongest."
Xue Ying was indeed extraordinary.
The 'Dao of Mirage' gave him the qualifications to be called an apex Paragon. Adding his Dao of Slaughter, absolute arts that used the Slaughter Dao, and Myriad True Devil Body, he could be ranked alongside Water Devil King, White Sovereign King, Bitter Cultivator and others. Even 'Paragon Huo Cheng', 'Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master' and 'Mysterious North Imperial Empress' were weaker by an entire level. After all, they all specialized in a single Dao alone.
'The other side is strong.' Xue Ying was contemplating too, 'And they have yet to utilize any important treasure during this first battle. I've heard that they could destroy the body of Monarch Hex Cricket by relying on treasures. It is apparent they did not stake everything this time. That's right too since this is just our first exchange. They understood that even if we die, we can refine more avatars. Thus, they are patient.'
"Fellow Paragons."
Monarch Hex Cricket was chuckling, "We know too little about the Ancestor Mother Religion. According to our plan, this is just the first exchange with them so that we can get a better understanding of how things stand and allow us to formulate a better plan targeted against their weaknesses! We might have lost eight Paragons, but they will soon refine them and return. However, the Ancestor Mother Religion had lost a total of nine protectors! They have no way of replenishing them!"
Everyone felt their moods uplifted slightly after hearing it.
But they were clear of one point-there was no loss to the number of apex protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion.
…
In the starry sky outside the Arcadia Flying Ship, the Rulers who were watching the battle knitted their eyebrows.
The first battle gave them a chance to understand how things stand, but it gave them a feeling of amiss.
Primal Master was smiling to loosen the tense atmosphere: "Bloodshed, your disciple Dong Bo Xue Ying is really quite good. His combat power is absolutely at the apex Paragon level now. Furthermore, his survival capabilities are also at the top. If I were to renew the Cosmos Deity-Demon List, he should be ranked 15th this time."
"If only his combat power is on par with Great Destruction, the overall outcome would have been much better. It's a pity that he still lacks on the offense." Temporal Island Lord shook his head.
He was honest.
If Xue Ying's 'Dao of Slaughter' was trained to the apex level, along with his Myriad Devil True Body, this offensive power of his could give him the strength to fight with those three Holy Protectors. But now? The golden-haired monkey could slap Xue Ying away with a single palm! Bitter Cultivator had enough power to fight against him, but he was lacking in survival abilities and did not dare to rush towards that level of battle.
Only Monarch Hex Cricket and Great Destruction could fight on that level of fighting.
"How long has he cultivated for?" Primal Master shook his head.
"Let's not talk about Xue Ying anymore." Bloodshed God-Emperor chuckled, "It seems that the situation isn't good for us. Even though we haven't put in all our strength, the other party hasn't utilized their formidable treasures too. Just based on the number of apex protectors they have has given them the strength to suppress our Paragons. Truly troublesome."
"If we really can't continue on, then this Arcadia Flying Ship will be a failed battle. But there's still us!" Abyss Primogenitor laughed, "We held an apparent advantage on the Ruler realm."
"We can afford to lose. There's no need to be overly worried." Myriad God Palace Master was quite confident too.
Empress Qian He giggled as well.
"There is still an opportunity in this battle." Bloodshed God-Emperor continued observing the situation within the Arcadia Flying Ship. Although Xue Ying's newly revealed power made him gratified, he was clear that this power of his could not influence the final outcome! In a huge battle, the odds of success on their side was low: "Even if it is lower, we must still grab hold of an opportunity to make a comeback with a single move!"
Bloodshed God-Emperor's eyes were filled with a strand of hope. For the sake of this confrontation, the Ancestor Mother Religion had made adequate preparations. He naturally also had his own strategies.

chapters.title: Chapter 713 - Two Days
chapters.content:
Chapter 713: Two Days
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
After a moment, "Your Majesty God-Emperor." Mysterious North Imperial Empress, Monarch Hex Cricket and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction relied upon the array to teleport out swiftly from the Arcadia Flying Ship. They arrived at where Bloodshed God-Emperor was.
Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded.
Closely following that, this region turned into a piece of primal chaos fuzziness, preventing others from seeing what they were doing.
"Bloodshed is quite careful." Primal Master chuckled.
"He should have an arrangement. After all, the number of moves he had is more than ours." Abyss Primogenitor laughed too. Bloodshed God-Emperor was the number one in direct combat, in refinement, and on arrays within the entire Cultivator Cosmos. He had reached the Ruler realm in all three Daos. He was the most all-rounded and perfect Ruler. Even though Monarch Green had the same demeanor as he did for Monarch Green specialized in three Daos too.
But Monarch Green concentrated more on combat. He lacked too much in terms of refinement and array.
"Hu."
The surrounding scene became clear again.
Bloodshed God-Emperor ordered, "Go."
"Yes."
Mysterious North Imperial Empress, Monarch Hex Cricket and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction all acknowledged before swiftly entering the Arcadia Flying Ship again.
"Bloodshed, you are too careful. It is fine for you to block off those from Ancestor Mother Religion to scout, now you are even preventing us from getting in onto what your plan is?" Temporal Island Lord shook his head.
Bloody Ruler Nile quipped, "That's right. Is there even a need to be on guard against us? Oh right, what plan do you have to deal with the Ancestor Mother Religion? No matter how I think, it just seems like we can't win."
"We might feel like we can't win, but perhaps Bloodshed has his methods." Empress Qian He giggled.
"What could there be? I specialized in the array so we can continue fighting on by relying on arrays." Bloodshed God-Emperor swept his gaze, looking across the few Rulers around. He had also looked across Bloody Ruler Nile. Nevertheless, his expression remained normal as he laughed, "The protectors of Ancestor Mother Religion is weaker regarding laws and profound mysteries. The array I made could be useful."
Monarch Green, Pang Yi, Purgatory Ruler, and others all nodded.
Everyone could vaguely guess that the most effective and formidable mean of turning the tables around now would be to use impressive arrays! Bloodshed God-Emperor specialized in array too, and could easily refine it himself.
…
Within the vast palace hall where the Ancestor Mother Religion was located at.
The many Religious Leaders were found within. They were looking at the scene floating in midair. The view was split into two regions-one was where the many protectors were moving, and the other was where the Paragons of Cultivator Cosmos were discussing amongst each other via voice transmission.
"Previously, what exactly did Bloodshed God-Emperor arranged when he asked Mysterious North Imperial Empress, Monarch Hex Cricket and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction over?"
"He is so careful?"
These Religious Leaders were all paying close notice to this.
Very soon, the huge fanged-hunk said, "Religious Leader Niko transmitted the news over. He said that Bloodshed God-Emperor should have given some arrays to Monarch Hex Cricket and the others. Naturally, there could be some mistake in this information too."
"Arrays?" All of them nodded slightly. They felt their hearts relaxing too since this was within what they expected.
******
The protectors and Paragons from both cosmos were fighting.
They still lacked an understanding of the protectors during the first battle.
However, from the second battle on, the Cultivator Cosmos Paragons were no longer the same. They became more cunning. With the help of the terrifying arrays displayed by Mysterious North Imperial Empress, they would sneak attacks in time after time! Those arrays had been personally refined by Bloodshed God-Emperor and were targeted against the weakness of the protectors. Borrowing upon the power of these arrays, they could separate the protectors apart. The Paragons would then proceed on with their assault.
Naturally, the Ancestor Mother Religion would retaliate.
The three brutal Holy Protectors could break out of the technique with brute force! After all, other than being weaker regarding the usage of laws and profound mysteries, their strength had reached the Ruler level.
For Mysterious North Imperial Empress to restrict, those three Holy Protectors just with the array was something challenging.
Even still, with the random changes of the array and sneaking in many attacks, it had given the cultivators some harvest.
…
Within the blink of an eye, two days passed.
"Hu."
The group of cultivator Paragons was resting on top of a tall mountain.
Xue Ying sat on a piece of large stone. Paragon Huo Cheng, Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, Purgatory Great Commander and the others who were looking around, could not help but sigh, "We had more than 100 skirmishes in just these two days! Most of our Paragons have died before, with some dying more than 10 times!"
Fortunately, they could refine another avatar by relying on their real body. As for the injury on their soul split, they could rapidly recover by depending on time acceleration.
Usually, they would maintain at a hundred-times time acceleration rate. During crucial moments like now, everyone was willing to consume a large number of Deity Crystals to increase the time-acceleration to 10,000 times! That would allow their souls to recover quicker. To this… Bloodshed God-Emperor, Abyss Primogenitor, and the others had conferred a large number of Deity crystals too. None was being the miser.
Naturally-
There were some who had always survived like the undying Monarch Hex Cricket, Water Devil King, White Sovereign King and Xue Ying.
As for Bitter Cultivator, Purgatory Great Commander, Paragon Huo Cheng, and Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master, they had died before. 'Paragon Huo Cheng' was initially unable to refine another avatar since his true body was kept imprisoned in the Destruction Eden of Lake Heart Island. Pang Yi who was currently a Ruler, had even personally set off for the Lake Heart Island. With his identity in the Destruction Legion that was much higher than Xue Ying's, he had personally requested for Paragon Huo Cheng to be released. In addition to the fact that Paragon Huo Cheng was indeed imprisoned for a very long time, the Destruction Legion finally caved in and released him.
"That venom-tailed Holy Protector is very vicious." Xue Ying could not help but caress his chest. After battling for so many times, the only time he was injured was when that venom-tailed girl suddenly assaulted him when she was fighting the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction. That tail of hers could extend like lightning, piercing through the armor on Xue Ying.
Fortunately, Xue Ying's reaction was quick. He immediately moved his body into the Mirage World. This significantly reduced the power of that venomous tail. Thus, it had merely injured him.
As for Bitter Cultivator and Purgatory Great Commander, they all died in the hands of that venom-tailed girl! Her sneak attack was lightning fast! It came abruptly with a great force that even Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction did not dare resist. Bitter Cultivator and Purgatory Great Commander might have cultivated the Myriad Devil True Body, but that girl's venomous tail caused them to lose their lives.
"Even though we died many times, we can refine another body. If those from the Ancestor Mother Religion died, it would be cutting off their forces." Xue Ying saw hopes of victory in this battle.
After the over hundred skirmishes the past two days, there were only 19 protectors left on the side of the Ancestor Mother Religion! They were all apex protectors! As for the ordinary protectors, they had been kept into the Cultivation Eden and would not be participating the battle anymore.
The 19 apex protectors. As for others? They were all killed!
Using the many arrays bestowed by Bloodshed God-Emperor, they were able to trap those protectors within frequently, preventing them from helping each other. That was how they could gradually kill them off.
'The arrays provided by Teacher is truly mystical. But the Ancestor Mother Religion has merely used two slightly more formidable treasures till date. It seems they have yet to erupt with full force.' Xue Ying frowned. The Ancestor Mother Religion had revealed two pieces of formidable treasures. One was used by the golden-haired monkey when he was forced into a dangerous predicament by an array. The venom-tailed girl took out a jade-green crystal rock and directly embed into her forehead! Following that, this venom-tailed girl directly smashed the array with her tail-that was some magnificent power. However, that jade-green crystal rock had clearly become smaller. She then kept it and had not used it since.
The other treasure was used by that muscular man wielding the wooden pole.
For the sake of saving over ten apex Paragons that might be wiped out entirely, he directly opened his mouth wide, spitting out a stream of water that tore apart the array.
They had revealed terrifying methods only during those two times.
As for other times, the apex protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion might be in constant battles, and occasionally losing one. But they would rather watch this happen than to use those secret methods of theirs.
"They are waiting." Xue Ying could see this.
"Sou sou sou."
A vast array illusion suddenly appeared in the sky. Mysterious North Imperial Empress, Monarch Hex Cricket and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction emerged.
All the Paragons turned over. They knew that the Mysterious North Imperial Empress and the rest had gone to see the Bloodshed God-Emperor! After every single skirmish as they were resting, the three would meet the Bloodshed God-Emperor.
"Let's prepare for another operation." Mysterious North Imperial Empress revealed a grin. Clearly, as the number of protectors dwindled, everyone could see the hopes of success.
"This time…" Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction was about to speak when his expression changed. He looked towards the distant.
Xue Ying, Devil Phoenix, Water Devil King and the other Paragons turned towards that direction too because a terrifying aura had surged out from that location!
"Hurry over!" Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction had a huge change in expression.
"Hong-"
Devil Phoenix borrowed on her domain to enshroud all Paragons present. Soon with a 'sou', they were teleported over!

chapters.title: Chapter 714 - The Master of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship is still Alive?
chapters.content:
Chapter 714: The Master of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship is still Alive?
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The 19 protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion were currently flying in the form of rainbow light. Of the three Holy Protectors leading them, the venom-tailed girl was presently looking below. Her eyes had a faint pagoda-like array revolving within. Unsee ripples were emitted from her eyes as they were sent below, sweeping across a considerable region. The places they had been to were all swept across.
"Protector Qian." The muscular man with a wooden pole anxiously transmitted, "We have been to the Primal Chaos Flying Ship for two days, scoured through many regions yet we have yet to find the controlling core of the ship! And those cultivator Paragons had relied on the arrays given by Bloodshed God-Emperor to cause us to suffer, striking away at our combat force. If this continues, it'll be bad for us!"
The golden-haired monkey transmitted back calmly, "Endure! We did not bring many treasures. We must wait until the Primal Chaos Flying Ship core is found before using them since it is the most dangerous during that point!"
"I understand. It's just that we have investigated through more than half the region in the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. According to our original deduction of the most possible places the core is located at, we should have discovered it, yet to no avail." The muscular man with a wooden pole genuinely felt unease. The apex protectors were of great help to the three of them too.
If not for the group of apex protectors covering for them, how would they handle the Paragons with only three?
Xue Ying, White Sovereign King, Water Devil King might not win in a one-on-one battle with them, but they had a large number of Paragons working together. Furthermore, relying on the arrays and many other techniques, adding up Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction and Monarch Hex Cricket, the three Holy Protectors would only be squandered to death. Fortunately, they had many comrades to help them out, but their advantage in numbers was no longer apparent.
"Hu."
The venom-tailed girl continued inspecting the area.
In the distant, there was a towering mountain. The venom-tailed girl and the others were flying above. Her eyes had that faint pagoda-like array revolving within, emitting a ripple that swept across and covered the many mountains.
Suddenly-
"Hong long~"
This unseen ripple seemed to have nudged something.
The chain of mountains started trembling. A terrifying aura shot up into the sky. This grand aura contained a cold feeling, causing all protectors to feel their hearts shaking when it swept past them. They could not help but feel terrified due to the gap in combat level.
"Over here!" The venom-tailed girl, golden-haired monkey, muscular man with a wooden pole and all apex protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion revealed looks of excitement as they turned to the chain of mountains beneath.
"Hu!"
In midair just beside the location, the group of Cultivator Paragons appeared. All of their gazes landed on the chain of mountains. The entire chain of mountains was currently shaking, and that cold aura which shot into the sky startled Xue Ying and the rest.
'Such vile aura.' When this aura swept across his body, Xue Ying could feel the cold and savage feeling within it.
A strong being would be able to imbue his willpower into his aura! Pang Yi could make others feel warm. Monarch Green could oppress others into paying allegiance to him. Xue Ying's aura was reserved yet filled with sharpness. It was unlike the vile offensive feeling coming from those big devils and great demons.
…
"They discovered the core?" That group of Religious Leaders from the Ancestor Mother Religion felt ecstatic. They revealed expectant looks.
The Primal Chaos Flying Ship was a vessel spoken in the legend.
Their sacred writings had merely reported about the presence of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship despite how old their cosmos was-it was starting to collapse. None had ever seen it personally. Thus, they could only use the crudest method of searching for the core.
Fortunately, that understood something at least.
Those of the Cultivator Cosmos like Xue Ying was practically blind. They did not even know of what the Primal Chaos Flying Ship was, and had even given the vessel a name-'Arcadia Flying Ship'.
…
"This is?"
In the starry sky outside the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, the ten Rulers felt shocked as they saw what was happening.
Even though the cultivators had entered the place in search for treasures, they had never discovered such a considerable disturbance.
"Mysterious North, come quickly!" Bloodshed God-Emperor ordered immediately.
Very soon, relying on the array to teleport, Mysterious North Imperial Empress traveled at her fastest speed to meet Bloodshed God-Emperor. The surrounding became blurry once again, preventing other Rulers from discerning what went on.
After a short moment, the space became clear again. That was when Mysterious North Imperial Empress retreated back in!
"Bloodshed, what are you planning to do?" Bloody Ruler Nile asked.
Bloodshed God-Emperor looked inside the Primal Chaos Flying Shop emotionlessly: "What can we do? Of course to use all our force and deal with what comes!" He did not elaborate further. If he had no specks of suspicions at all, then it felt natural for Bloody Ruler to ask about this. But now that he was slightly suspicious about him, Bloodshed God-Emperor was starting to think that this Bloody Ruler Nile might be too spontaneous.
"The crucial moment is here. Whether we win or lose this battle, everything will depend on what happens next." Primal Master looked into the Primal Chaos Flying Ship too, "I would never have thought that we have never discovered how special this Arcadia Flying Ship was despite its existence in our Cultivator Cosmos and the Ancestor Mother Religion could discover it."
******
Within the world of Primal Chaos Flying Ship, the protectors of Ancestor Mother Religion and the Paragons of the Cultivators did not start fighting. They were all looking at the trembling chain of mountains. The Ancestor Mother Religion protectors were conserving their strength. Their purpose here was to control this ship, and if the cultivators did not act, they would naturally not do so! Furthermore, Xue Ying and the others were not in a rush to strike since they knew that this was the crux. They had to ensure everything ended smoothly.
An array illusion flashed before dissipating.
Mysterious North Imperial Empress had returned.
"Hong long long~"
Amidst the trembling chain of mountains, there was an unknown substance that was deep underground rising up currently. It was showing itself bit by bit. This seemed to be a unique substance that Xue Ying and the others could not perceive it unless they used their eyes-including using the Mirage World. As it rose, many rocks and soil began rolling down.
"Sculpture?" Xue Ying was shocked. The other Paragons and those protectors were similarly startled. After all, they did not know much.
What came out from underground the chain of mountains was actually a towering sculpture.
This sculpture had the appearance of a violet-armored silver-bodied male. His body seemed to be cast from metals, and his eyes were like two enormous rubies. He had no eyebrows, and his eyes gave off a calm feeling. But it was this calm feeling that brought a chill up in the hearts of all Paragons and protectors.
They felt that this was an existence that killed countless people. Even if it was just a sculpture, it remained giving them an instinctual fear.
"You have finally awoken me." The sculpture revealed a grin. He was speaking with an unknown language, but reaching his level, language was only an expression. Xue Ying and the others could sense the exact meaning he was conveying.
"I am the seventh sacred son under the Ancestor Bone Throne-Gu Qian Luo." The sculpture's voice boomed and reverberated in the world, "I've suffered from a heavy injury. I was thus forced to stop my Primal Chaos Flying Ship in this cosmos. But all of you are fortunate because I require your help."

chapters.title: Chapter 715 - So it seems
chapters.content:
Chapter 715: So it seems
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying felt his heart swelling. He watched as that enormous sculpture emitting a foul and cold aura appear from underground: 'He said he is injured, but not dead yet? This Arcadia Flying Ship… No, I should call it the Primal Chaos Flying Ship instead! This Primal Chaos Flying Ship has parked in our cosmos for three epochs, yet its owner is heavily injured and alive? The cosmos epoch apocalypse reincarnation cycle did not pull him in at all?'
'Even Lake Heart Island master and Ancestor Devil are no longer around. They should have left our cosmos. But this person has stayed here until now.' Xue Ying felt huge waves rising in his heart.
Other Paragons and protectors were similarly astounded.
Such a conclusion had far exceeded their expectations.
The Ancestor mother Religion assumed that this Primal Chaos Flying Ship was ownerless. Thus, it was easy to gain control over it. Nevertheless, it seemed that its owner was still alive! That would be troublesome. With how impressive this 'Primal Chaos Flying Ship' was, the Ancestor Mother Religion and Cultivator Cosmos could not snatch this ship by force!
"Dong Bo Xue Ying." A voice suddenly resounded in his mind.
"Mn?" Xue Ying immediately reacted. This was the voice of the Black Gourd treasure spirit.
"Don't be alarmed by this person. I've inspected him. He should only be a Ruler." The Black Gourd sneered. He transmitted, "Furthermore, he is heavily wounded. He should have recovered slightly over a long period by relying on his secret technique. But I reckon he will have to continue slumbering not too long later!"
"Ruler realm?" Xue Ying let out a sigh of relief.
It was good.
At least he was at a level the Cultivator Cosmos could still accept.
"Judging by how strong his soul and aura is, even if they were complete, he should be approaching the level of your Bloodshed God-Emperor. In spite of that, he would not be on par with your teacher still!" The Black Gourd said, "Naturally, it will be hard to determine if he possesses any great external treasures! But even if he did, his injuries would prevent him from fighting at his best condition. That is presumably the reason why he forbade Rulers from entering the Primal Chaos Flying Ship."
Xue Ying was enlightened. No wonder Rulers could not enter.
…
There was an uproar amongst the Rulers outside the flying ship.
"He is still alive?"
"The Primal Chaos Flying Ship owner could survive through the cosmos epoch's reincarnation cycle?" Temporal Island Lord, Empress Qian He, and the others were feeling disturbed.
Primal Master said rather calmly, "It might be hard for us to withstand against the reincarnation cycle at the end of each cosmos epoch because this is our hometown. We are given birth from this cosmos so our it will greatly restrain us. Besides, he should have other secrets for being able to resist the cosmos epoch apocalypse reincarnation cycle! That is something we are unaware of."
"Mn."
Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded. He could perceive that sculpture through the flying ship from outside, "I can discern that he should be a Ruler. He should be someone powerful even amongst Rulers since he could possess this mysterious Primal Chaos Flying Ship and withstand the cosmos apocalyptic reincarnation cycle. Furthermore, he even announced his identity as the supposed seventh sacred son of the Ancestor Bone Throne. But this isn't worth being concerned of since he is heavily injured and has slept till now. He has always been hiding in the ship, implying that he is afraid."
"That's right."
"If his injuries aren't heavy, he will not remain so low-profile for three epochs." Bloody Ruler Nile added. All of them agreed unanimously.
…
Within that vast palace hall where the Ancestor Mother Religion was based in, the Religious leaders were frowning.
It seemed that the overall situation had changed.
"It is actually a ship with an owner. I wonder if we could succeed with our plan still." These Religious Leaders were slightly troubled. They were not confident of fighting directly with the Cultivator Rulers. Firstly, the Rulers were stronger than them. Even though they had a numerical advantage, they would only be slightly on the upper hand after relying on treasures. Secondly, the Cultivator Rulers could rapidly refine new avatars.
The battle within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship showed that they could depend on their endless resources to form more avatars, and squander the Ancestor Mother Religion to death!
Thus, they were not confident of a direct confrontation. They would prefer to control this Primal Chaos Flying Ship.
"This expert from outside the cosmos is heavily injured and require our help. It isn't impossible for him to temporarily lend us control of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship." These Religious Leaders were slightly anxious and hopeful because they could not afford to lose.
If they lost, their entire race and all who had transcended would die!
******
The enormous sculpture that was emitting a cold and foul aura grinned. It looked at this group of Paragons and protectors as if they were ants. He continued, "I need your help, so be assured that I'll not harm you. I'll even initiate an ancient oath, and by then, you should understand that this oath isn't easily disobeyed."
"We are willing to provide help." The golden-haired monkey covertly transmitted a message over, "But we will need to use your Primal Chaos Flying Ship temporarily. We don't need to refine it. We just hope that you could let us use it temporarily."
The colossal sculpture glanced at that golden-haired monkey.
"We are willing to help you, but we have to know what you require us to do? Furthermore, you must not assist that group of protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion." Monarch Hex Cricket also transmitted covertly to that sculpture.
Both parties made their decisions at the same time.
Regardless, they would first accept before deciding what to do next.
After all, they had not sworn an oath yet. It would be best if they could take the initiative to grab this power into their hands before deciding the next action.
"Hahaha…"
"I've been to many cosmos, and my cultivation system is far beyond all yours-it is much stronger." The colossal sculpture casually pointed his finger. At that moment, a transparent water droplet appeared and landed on the body of 'Leaf Saint'. Xue Ying and the others turned towards him, and Leaf Saint himself was astonished too. Following that, his expression turned into agony as that water droplet dissolved into his skin and his bone. But soon after, Leaf Saint revealed a look of joy. He lowered his head to give that right arm of his a look. It seemed that it was covered in silver armor. That silver armor contained a terrifying power, and he could use it with a single thought.
"Hong~" Leaf Saint casually chopped down with his hand by the surrounding. The contacted space vibrated, causing the expressions of the protectors to change. This Leaf Saint had a massive increase in power, so much so that he could match that of the ordinary protectors.
One had to know that the Ancestor Mother Religion was most exultant of their strength. Yet now, Leaf Saint had power equivalent to that of ordinary protectors. Also, his advantage in the laws and profound mysteries gave him the chance to fight against apex protectors.
"This, his power increased just like this?"
All the Paragons present including Xue Ying were speechless. It wasn't easy for him to attain the Myriad Devil True Body. However, a single unique water droplet dissolved into the arm of Leaf Saint, forming an armor. That itself boosted his strength tremendously. Even though it was weaker than the Myriad Devil True Body, it was stronger than his previous fifth level of Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body and fifth volume of Luminous Sun.
"I said before, my cultivation system is stronger than all yours." The enormous sculpture chuckled, "I can help you just as you can help me! By then, it isn't just a single drop. It'll be a huge bucket of this liquid which I will give you to immerse yourself in. That will allow you to have complete body armor. Your power will be much stronger than now. This is merely one of the benefits. If you helped me, I'd not mistreat my new-found friends."
Xue Ying and the others held their breath. They were dumbstruck.
"But I only need one person to help me." The enormous sculpture swept its gaze across the Paragons and protectors, "I am feeling anguish. Who should I choose?"
"How about this!"
That huge sculpture laughed even more boisterously, "I can see that this side with a weaker body should be the natives of this cosmos. Your cultivation laws and profound mysteries are the same as how they were when I came! And the other side, the so-called Ancestor Mother Religion should be cultivating the supposed 'Ancestor Mother Cultivation System'."
The protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion were in great alarm.
Xue Ying and the rest were carefully listening. They lacked in an understanding of the Ancestor Mother Religion.
"The Ancestor Mother Religion cultivation system requires the installation of the Ancestor Mother Altar, transforming the entire cosmos. It will cause the cosmos to turn into the Ancestor Mother Cosmos! The moment it is transformed, the many plebians of this cosmos will not be able to adapt to the new environment. They will die. Even the apex cultivators like World Deities and True Gods might be stronger and could survive, yet they will be expelled by the Ancestor Mother Cosmos. Either they throw themselves into believing the Ancestor Mother, or they get forced out of the cosmos!"
"Both of your races aren't able to co-exist!"
The huge sculpture chuckled, "Since that's the case, then fight and kill each other! Fight until there is only a single brat left on this Primal Chaos Flying Ship. I will naturally choose him as my helper."
…
"Install the Ancestor Mother Altar?" Xue Ying and the other Paragons, as well as the group of Rulers outside, were startled. They finally understood what the Ancestor Mother Religion planned!
"So this is the case!" Bloodshed God-Emperor was enlightened. He had a burst of lingering fear after that.

chapters.title: Chapter 716 - Madness
chapters.content:
Chapter 716: Madness
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Bloodshed God-Emperor and the other Rulers felt slightly appreciative towards this mysterious 'Gu Qian Luo'. If not for him, they would not have discovered what the Ancestor Mother Religion was scheming-they would remain ignorant. But now, they understood: "The Ancestor Mother Cultivation System requires the setting up of the Ancestor Mother Altar. It will eventually transform the entire cosmos?"
"They are planning to exterminate all lifeforms of our cosmos. We have yet to take that last step to break through beyond Rulers. Thus, we would die if we were forced out of the cosmos." Bloodshed God-Emperor, Primal Master, and the others began feeling murderous. This killing intent of theirs became denser by a hundred times.
Unknowingly, they had been forced on a path of no retreat! Everything was compelled by the Ancestor Mother Religion!
…
"Damn." In the vast palace hall where that fanged Religious Leader and the others were, these Religious Leaders had a slight change of expression. They were plotting behind the backs of the cultivator, betting on the fact that the cultivators were ignorant. But now, Gu Qian Luo had blown away the fog. The cultivators would definitely fight with them to death!
"Protector Qian, we have to take control of this Primal Chaos Flying Ship no matter what it takes. We have no paths to retreat. The cultivators will definitely fight with us to death. Without the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, our chance of success is low." The fanged Religious Leader transmitted. Having the Primal Chaos Flying Ship would boost their confidence to win the war a hundred times. Without it, their confidence would have a drastic fall.
******
Within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, the group of Paragons-Xue Ying, Monarch Hex Cricket, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction and the rest received a transmission from Bloodshed God-Emperor: "If not for this Gu Qian Luo, we would not have known that the Ancestor Mother Religion is planning to exterminate all lives on our cosmos! This war will determine the life and death of all cultivators, including the weak mortals. This ship must absolutely not land up in the hands of the Ancestor Mother Religion!"
Xue Ying and the others looked downward at that huge sculpture.
The sculpture 'Gu Qian Luo' chuckled. His laughter was wicked. He leaked that bit of information to make both parties crazy. With a rich voice that reverberated around this Eden World: "Kill, kill! The weak will die. The strong will live. The final person alive will be qualified to become my aide!"
"Sir Gu Qian Luo."
On the other side, the leader of the protectors, the golden-haired monkey said, "There are some of us including those from the Paragons who are extremely good at survival. It might be tough to kill until the last man standing."
The sculpture Gu Qian Luo looked up at that golden-haired monkey. He grinned, "What you said make sense. I can see that the venom-tailed girl has an incredible defense. And on the cultivators' side, that person with the green light glowing is also tough."
"The venom-tailed girl?" Xue Ying and the others flinched momentarily before reacting.
Gu Qian Luo should be referring to one of the three Holy Protectors. Her defense was incredibly strong? Even Gu Qian Luo praised her defense for being 'incredibly strong', so how strong was it?
And the protectors felt anguished. Why was this owner of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship revealing all their secrets?
"For the sake of not prolonging the battle, how about this?" The sculpture Gu Qian Luo lowered his head and looked forward. That blood ruby eyes of his shot out a stream of light, forming a region that was faintly covered in dimmed red. It was about 100 meters wide.
"Whoever it is that can stay in this region for more than ten breaths will be my new aide." The sculpture said, "Alright. Don't dawdle anymore! Let's begin!"
The moment he finished speaking, 'sou!' The protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion rushed down towards that red region.
And the Paragons had teleported down with the help of Devil Phoenix, entering directly into that region. Even though it was 100 meters wide, it could fit all of them.
"Kill!" The leading golden-haired monkey's eyes were filled with killing intent. He brought the protectors over.
"Hong long long~"
The cultivators and protectors began slaughtering each other.
Mysterious North Imperial Empress also employed her arrays. Monarch Hex Cricket was defending against the three Holy Protectors. Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction was doing his best too. Xue Ying, White Sovereign King, Purgatory Great Commander, Bitter Cultivator, Paragon Huo Cheng, Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master and other Paragons were staking their lives. Even that fortunate 'Leaf Saint' whose right arm had a huge strength increase, went on to fight with the apex protectors. All were doing their best.
"Die for me!" The golden-haired monkey roared. Both eyes shot out a golden light. The two streams of golden light were like two sharp lofty weapons as they pierced through many Paragons. Because of how sudden it was, it cut through the body of five Paragons almost instantaneously.
Fortunately, Xue Ying had relied on the Mirage World to teleport by the side of that golden-haired monkey. His Blood Serpent Spear reached the eyes of the monkey, disrupting his attack. The golden-haired monkey closed his eyes and waved out his palm carelessly. That palm swept its way over with a heaven-defiant strength. Xue Ying did not wish to parry it. He just teleported away.
The other party's offensive power was too high. He would be forced back if he was hit. That was even when he hid in the Mirage World! Otherwise, he might die from a single strike!
But disrupting the Holy Protector proved Xue Ying's capabilities. After all, only the three of them-he, White Sovereign King and Water Devil King dared to do so.
Naturally, Monarch Hex Cricket and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction were fighting head-on with the Holy Protectors.
…
The battle was bitter.
The Ancestor Mother Religion no longer cared about their lives. They wanted to triumph as fast as possible. Thus, the three Holy Protectors each took out their own treasures. The eyes of the golden-haired monkey emitted golden light. The streams of golden light were outstandingly strong and sharp-they were invincible. The venom-tailed girl brought out the jade-green crystal stone and embed it into her forehead. She would occasionally explode out with an ultra-strength, heavily injuring even Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction in moments.
That muscular man with a wooden pole would sometimes spit out a terrifying stream of water. The flow of water was incomparably heavy. Even Monarch Hex Cricket was forced away by it. He was not able to assist the heavily injured Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction in time!
Just three breaths later from the start of the battle, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction died!
Naturally, his actual body was outside the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. Thus, it would be soon that he would return with an avatar. Nonetheless, refining an avatar took time, and the Ancestor Mother Religion was striving for this slight amount of time. They were clear that they could not fight a lengthy battle! If they did, the cultivators would continuously form more avatars and before pitting the protectors to their deaths.
'When the three Holy Protectors go all out, even Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction could not resist. Do we not have any formidable treasures too?' Xue Ying was feeling anxious too. All he could do was to rely on the Mirage World to teleport and put out the fire around the battlefield. He was trying his best to help Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction.
But now, with the aid of treasures, the three Holy Protectors were each stronger than Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction.
How could he help?
Even Monarch Hex Cricket was forced back.
'We only have the arrays of Mysterious North Imperial Empress left?' Xue Ying was distressed now. As the arrays were given by Bloodshed God-Emperor, they were able to gain the upper hand when fighting the previous two days. But now, when the three Holy Protectors stake their treasures to the battle, they became so strong that the cultivators were absolutely on the losing end.
Actually, Xue Ying understood. To gain the upper hand in this battle, they would have to have a treasure that could increase a Paragon's strength to that of a Ruler!
But how rare was such a treasure?
The Ancestor Mother Religion no longer had any path of retreat. They did not spare at anything to prepare three treasures for the Holy Protectors. Nonetheless, the Cultivator Cosmos was incapable of bringing such treasures out which could tremendously improve the strength of a Paragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 717 - I knew It would be like That
chapters.content:
Chapter 717: I knew It would be like That
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The battle became increasingly intense.
It was clear what the Ancestor Mother Religion was aiming to achieve. They wanted to secure the ten breaths of time by staying within the red light region. The other protectors were also taking the initiative to defend that venom-tailed girl. One could see that venom-tailed girl floating inside that area as she swept her gaze across the battlefield. Her venom tail would occasionally sneak an attack against the Paragons.
She had already stood in the region for more than three breaths of time. None were able to force her out of that location.
"Hu."
The Blood Serpent Spear appeared. It pierced out at the back of that venom-tailed girl. That venom-tailed girl did not evade. Instead, she confronted this fierce strike with her body. The spearhead contained the aura of Dao of Slaughter and with a terrifying strength coming from the Myriad Devil True Body. "Peng~". That venom-tailed girl only took three steps forward before dissipating the incoming force. As for the injuries? Her skin did not even break!
Xue Ying appeared and vanished irregularly. His eyes held a strand of anxiety: 'The defenses of this Holy Protector girl is too robust. I can't even injure her. The other two protectors did not dare to resist my attack like this, and only she dares! Her body is able to dissipate the force tremendously well. My full strength forced her to take three steps, and she succeeded in dissipating all force?'
There were almost none who had a stronger offense than he did amongst the Paragons.
The Purgatory Great Commander and Bitter Cultivator might be more slightly more imposing in their attacks, but they were too weak in survival. If they dared to get close, the three Holy Protectors could easily annihilate them!
Water Devil King and White Sovereign King were far too weak with their offenses.
Monarch Hex Cricket was someone with feeble strength. Only Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction was strong enough, yet he had been ganged upon and killed by the three Holy Protectors right from the start.
"We will win for sure."
The venom-tailed girl coldly stared at the Paragons while standing nonchalantly within the red light region. The golden-haired monkey and muscular man with a wooden pole were assisting each other. Naturally, they were all defending from within the red light region, though they would leave this area to attack frequently albeit leaving the venom-tailed girl inside it still. Her venom tail would occasionally sneak an attack on the Paragons, the golden-haired monkey would wave that palm of his, and the muscular man would smash his wooden pole out.
A complete suppression!
"Kill!" Water Devil King, Xue Ying, and White Sovereign king were still charging against the protectors. Even though they were mad, they felt helpless.
"Are we going to lose just like that?"
Xue Ying and the others stared at the three Holy Protectors and other apex protectors who were seemingly going all out. Their side had lost more than half the combat force, yet they could not see any hope of winning.
…
Time passed. The Cultivator Paragons were getting more anxious.
"You can't win!"
That was accompanied by a roar.
At the moment when six breaths of time had passed since the venom-tailed girl entered that red light region, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction appeared with the help of Mysterious North Imperial Empress using a teleport. The current Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction let out a huge roar. His entire figure turned into a black mud stream. Both his aura of life and karma disappeared. He turned into a rolling black soil stream that blasted towards the venom-tailed girl, the golden-haired monkey and the muscular man with a wooden pole. They were all astounded by him.
"When did Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction possess such a move? Is this his secret to undying?" The golden-haired monkey and the other two were speculating.
One had to know that those ranked in the front amongst the Paragons like Monarch Green in the past, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, Hex Cricket, White Sovereign King, Water Devil King and others could survive in front of Rulers.
Unlike Monarch Green, Hex Cricket and the others who had comprehended a Dao that could improve their survival capabilities, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction was able to survive by turning his body into an enigma. The moment he concealed his real body, none could find him. Thus, he would typically hide his real body and send only avatars out to battle.
The reason why he could conceal his real body was due to a fortune he had when he entered a cosmos filled with death. He found a strange treasure that gave him the ability to transform his body into a black soil. It would hide his aura! It would conceal his karma! Furthermore, this black soil stream had an excellent ability for survival. This was also why Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction did not serve any Rulers despite being a Paragon.
This time!
There was no way out. It was at this final moment that he chose to reveal the most critical treasure he had.
"Kill!" The golden-haired monkey released golden rays from his eyes. He could only employ the move a few times more. But he couldn't care less any longer.
"Hu~" The muscular man shot out the massive water stream too, shooting at that black soil stream.
The venom-tailed girl did not act. That jade green crystal rock had been diminished to a small amount, and thus, she was not in any rush.
No matter how they attacked, that black soil stream remained exalted. Those two golden rays penetrated through the black soil stream, yet the stream was still charging forward! That heavy water flow shot right against the black soil stream, causing part of the stream to vaporize. But soon, it rapidly converged again. It reached the venom-tailed girl within moments-nothing could hinder it. Soon, the black soil condensed back into a black figure. He was the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction.
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction waved the long pole weapon in his hand. His pole technique was profound. The venom-tailed girl might have tried her best to parry against it, but she was smashed on her chest.
"Weng~" She was forced to retreat continuously by the impact.
This attack by the Heavenly Emperor was much fiercer than Xue Ying's.
At this moment!
The jade green crystal stone embedded in the forehead of that venom-tailed girl lit up. She tried her best to stop moving. At the same time, her venom tail wrapped around the golden-haired monkey by the side. The golden-haired monkey was also grabbing her tail. She relied on this pulling force to stop herself from moving.
"Peng!" Yet another pole came with an unpredictable arc.
Even though the golden-haired monkey and the muscular man with a wooden pole were doing their best to defend her, that black soil stream was unblockable. He struck once again on the body of the venom-tailed girl, finally forcing her out of the red light region.
"We can't win if we don't kill him." The venom-tailed girl screeched.
The golden-haired monkey, the muscular man, and all other protectors were getting anxious.
"Kill him!"
An order was sent by the Religious Leaders who were watching the battle.
The venom-tailed girl no longer hesitated. She flipped her hand, causing a bizarre fusiform weapon to appear. This fusiform weapon contained many intricate patterns on it. It was emitting a dark, destructive aura. The venom-tailed girl acted like a madwoman as she grabbed hold of this fusiform weapon, releasing an overwhelming might towards Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction who was in front of her.
The moment he was enshrouded, the surrounding world became sealed.
Xue Ying, Devil Phoenix and the rest revealed looks of anxiety-they were unable to teleport into that region.
"Retreat!" Monarch Hex Cricket had been following along Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction. At this moment, he roared and charged before Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction.
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction dissipated into large amounts of black soil stream. They were currently flowing in all directions in a bid to escape.
"It's futile!" The eyes of that venom-tailed girl were icy-cold.
"Hong~"
The fusiform weapon suddenly emitted endless violet light specks. These violet light specks formed into colossal violet light pillars that struck out against Monarch Hex Cricket first. Even though Monarch Hex Cricket's body was firm and filled with life energy, it was still forced to disintegrate at this moment. He sighed inwardly. That time, his soul was annihilated by the same weapon in the Six Heavenly Wheel. It was fortunate he comprehended the Dao that gave him the ability to survive.
"Hong hong hong~" The violet light pillars then pummeled into the escaping black soil stream. These violet light pillars were extremely intelligent. They split up and enveloped around every single black soil particle.
The black soil stream revealed a faint shape of the face of Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction.
He was sighing too.
Because he knew that despite being able to increase his survival capabilities the moment he used this bizarre treasure, even Monarch Hex Cricket was annihilated by Ancestor Mother Religion using that weapon. Could he withstand by relying on this treasure? For the sake of his race, he had to at least try.
'It failed in the end. I knew this would happen.' Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction sighed. The many black soil stream was being destroyed by the violet light pillars.

chapters.title: Chapter 718 - Tears
chapters.content:
Chapter 718: Tears
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction might have tried to escape after turning into the black soil stream, but he was still annihilated by the few violet light pillars. Finally, there was only a palm-sized black beast sculpture left. The venom-tailed girl used her tail to grab that sculpture away, and only then did the surrounding violet light pillars dissipate. During this process, Xue Ying and the rest were fleeing far away; they were silent.
'It is rumored that others can't find the true body of Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction; it should undoubtedly be due to that treasure.' Xue Ying contemplated. That treasure was able to turn the heavenly emperor into black soil, concealing both his aura and karma and boosting his survival capabilities. It was indeed an unusual and valuable treasure.
Nonetheless, that fusiform weapon was too terrifying. It could even destroy the undying body of Monarch Hex Cricket and this black soil body of Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction. In the end, they had taken that unique treasure away.
"Do we have no other way?" Xue Ying was not willing to see this happen.
"Treasure spirit, if I employ the Black Gourd, will that Gu Qian Luo become stab me in the back?" Xue Ying transmitted.
"You can rest assured on this point. Firstly, that Gu Qian Luo's injuries are severe. After selecting an aide, he will soon enter a deep slumber. Secondly, what existence is the Voidwalker? This protective treasure he refined will not be discovered that easily unless it is by someone on a similar level as the Voidwalker himself. Just this measly Ruler Gu Qian Luo will not be able to determine the true value of the treasure. He will only think that it is a more impressive and unusual treasure. Gu Qian Luo will not regard it as much. Furthermore, even if he wanted to snatch it away, he can't. I will simply teleport back to that world where your disciple 'Little Chong Seven' is located in."
"But I have to remind you, you have yet to refine the Black Gourd. If you use its power, you will be heavily injured…"
"Furthermore, you can only employ it once! You must also find the best opportunity to do so. Otherwise, the price of failure will be tremendous." The treasure spirit reminded him.
Xue Ying understood this point.
"I'll seek for it then." Xue Ying transmitted back, "Do keep a look out for me too."
Since he only had a single chance, he would be cautious.
…
Within the starry sky outside the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, the ten Rulers were watching from afar.
Bloody Ruler Nile said in a downcast manner, "Great Destruction has always been keeping it a secret. But his ability to hide his true body should be because of that strange treasure. It's a pity that he still died despite using it. Even the strange treasure landed in the hands of the Ancestor Mother Religion."
"The Ancestor Mother Religion also used that terrifying weapon of theirs." Primal Master added.
Bloodshed God-Emperor was watching silently.
His judgment was concise.
He could see how sophisticated and mystical the refinement of that weapon was. Furthermore, it required a significant amount of energy. Under ordinary circumstances, it needed Rulers to transmit their power. As for the protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion, the energy they had should be insufficient. Thus, the venom-tailed girl should have used the energy she had in the jade green crystal stone.
Furthermore-
This weapon had not been used despite the death of many apex protectors. Only when they were forced out of the red light region by Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction did they use it since they had no alternative! It was clear this weapon could not be reused temporarily in the short period.
