'It should be temporarily unusable in the short period after being employed once.' Bloodshed God-Emperor thought, 'Furthermore, Great Destruction has tried his best, yet to no avail. We can only rely on the final move.'
'Whether it is victory or defeat, everything will be up to fate.' Bloodshed God-Emperor thought. He then transmitted his orders-
"Mysterious North, use it."
******
The moment Mysterious North Imperial Empress received the transmission, she took in a deep breath. She understood that this was the most critical moment.
"Devil Phoenix, Bamboo Mountain, Huo Cheng, Ripple Lady Planet Master, Brother Cheng Yi…" Mysterious North Imperial Empress transmitted out to eight other Paragons.
And the corresponding Paragons knew that what would be happening next because they had been pre-warned about it.
"Hu!"
With the help of Devil Phoenix, Mysterious North Imperial Empress and the other eight Paragons gathered together. There was also a large piece of a circular stone plate forming underneath their feet. This stone plate contained an incomparably complex marking on it. Mysterious North Imperial Empress was located at the center, and the eight other Paragons were standing on each of the eight directions. They were informed about this circular stone plate array previously and had rehearsed on using it under a 10,000 times time-accelerated environment. The nine chosen were either apex Paragons, or Paragons specialized in using arrays. They were all chosen personally by Bloodshed God-Emperor.
"This is!"
The three Holy Protectors who had returned into the red light region, as well as other protectors, could not help but pay notice to this scene.
In the distant, the nine Paragons were floating in midair. The circular stone plate underneath their feet began lighting up. Golden markings also formed in the void. The markings were connecting to each other, creating a vast black vortex. The nine Paragons stood on the stone plate, and that was also where the eye of the vortex was.
The dark vortex was powerful. It enveloped a broad area and contained a power that displaced the expressions of the protectors.
"Weng!"
With a teleport, the enormous black vortex appeared right where the red light region was located. It completely enveloped the red light region and the surrounding 500 kilometers. The three Holy Protectors and the group of protectors were all within.
"This vortex…" The protectors could feel a terrifying tearing force being exerted on their body by this vortex. The skin of several apex protectors was even being torn apart. They could not help but be horrified.
That black vortex was cruel and emotionless. That circular stone plate was emitting an ancient aura from its core. It was similar to the treasure which Primal Master had, though after being witnessed by Bloodshed God-Emperor, he adapted it into a unique array. After modifying it slightly, this new array could be operated by nine Paragons! As for using this array with a single person? It had a significant requirement on the realm and Paragons could barely do it, or so at least for Mysterious North Imperial Empress who had the highest attainment in arrays-she could not employ it.
Only when nine Paragons operated the array could its power be displayed. This was the most brutal move used by Bloodshed God-Emperor. They had no choice. Who let the foundation of the Cultivator Cosmos be so weak?
"Ah ah~" The apex protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion attempted to escape, but the black vortex force was too strong. Their bodies were being ground. They could not escape from this attractive force.
"Die!"
Mysterious North Imperial Empress was cold. She was the central controller of this black vortex.
"Damn, damn, damn. We just dealt with Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction previously, and that treasure could not be used temporarily." The venom-tailed girl and the other two Holy Protectors were feeling anxious. The three were struggling with all their strength but to no avail.
"Ah." Many apex protectors were being torn apart; their bones were breaking. All of them revealed a look of unwillingness and of anxiety.
"Protector Qian, you must win for us!"
"We must win!"
"For the sake of the entire race, we must win!"
"Kill all these cultivators. Kill them all! Turn this into our cosmos."
Many apex protectors were howling grievously. They were not afraid of death. They were only afraid of failing in the end. Because if they could not obtain the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, the chances of winning the final battle would be minute.
Amidst the howls, many apex protectors started disintegrating. The golden-haired monkey tried to keep them into his Cultivation Eden, yet the black vortex was rending space in the nearby region. Under this horrifying force, the Cultivation Eden could not absorb anything from outside.
…
"We are about to win!" Xue Ying and the rest were watching excitedly. Those apex protectors were dying one by one. Injuries were even gradually appearing on the bodies of golden-haired monkey and the muscular man with a wooden pole. Only the venom-tailed girl remained perfectly fine. However, with her current strength, she was still powerless against this attractive force produced by the black vortex.
"Kill all of them! If there is only a Holy Protector left, us Paragons will have an easier time." Xue Ying and the rest were looking forward to it.
…
At the centermost core of the black vortex, above the stone plate, the nine Paragons were watching this scene.
"We must win!"
"Our people desire to live too! We must not lose." Next came the furious howls from the dying apex protectors.
The roars echoed by their ears.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master heard this voice.
He looked down at the familiar figures.
'Ancestor Mother?' Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master thought.
Deep within his memory, he recalled something beautiful.
He was living with his parents, his little brother and little sister. He was a national hero then. Over time, he grew stronger and stronger. He was a cold, callous and mighty warrior. Over the extended period, he almost climbed to the peak of that cosmos, becoming one of the strongest apex protectors the Ancestor Mother Religion had. Yet the cosmos soon entered its final collapse. For the sake of survival, he decided to follow down this cosmos tunnel and ended up here.
He did not care about the danger and chose to reincarnate.
After reincarnating…
He lived on the mortal world within the material realm. After having a peaceful life with his parents, his teacher, disciple brothers, life and death brothers, he gradually grew up. He comprehended the law of the world. Soon, he regained his memories when he became a Deity. He found out about his previous life as a protector of the Ancestor Mother Religion. That gave him an edge in cultivation, turning it into something special-he was able to open a Dao when he was just a stage four World Deity.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master did not make contact with the Ancestor Mother Religion at all. For a long time, he felt that he was part of this Cultivator Cosmos.
Bloodshed God-Emperor treated him really well. He helped Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master all the way, hoping that he could break through.
Xue Ying, Pang Yi, and the others treated him sincerely. He also had a few other friends like Forefather Fierce Tyrant.
'Your Majesty, Pang Yi, Fierce Tyrant, Dong Bo… I do not have many friends. I am afraid of befriending others because I am afraid this day would come. How I wished I could be part of this cosmos, but-'
'I am ultimately…'
'Part of the Ancestor Mother Religion Cosmos.'
'If, if I had to make a decision.'
'I… will choose to side with the hometown that brought me up!' Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master's eyes formed a bead of crystal tear, but it was evaporated the next moment. He extended his right hand, piercing it as if it was a blade into the body of Ripple Lady Planet Master next to him. Ripple Lady Planet Master who had always concentrated on refining weapons did not have a powerful physique. She could not resist this attack by Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master.
Her chest was directly pierced through.
Ripple Lady Planet Master turned towards Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master with aghast. Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master also looked at her composedly. The destructive thunder directly crushed her body into ashes right in front of his eyes…

chapters.title: Chapter 719 - I must have been Blind!
chapters.content:
Chapter 719: I must have been Blind!
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
In the starry sky outside the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, Bloodshed God-Emperor was filled with expectations as he viewed the battle. He had seen hopes of victory, speaking to the rest, "Fortunately, Great Destruction had not stint. He forced them to use that weapon. Now, we will have the certainty of victory…" Just as he mentioned that his face turned pale.
Bloodshed God-Emperor was looking with disbelief at the scene occurring within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master's right hand mercilessly pierced through the chest of Ripple Lady Planet Master, causing her body to turn into ashes under that destructive thunder of his…
"Damn!" Bloodshed God-Emperor roared out abruptly.
"Traitor!" Primal Master's expression was even redder. He was trembling so much from rage.
At this moment-
Within the Bloodshed God Palace territory in the Violet Bamboo Sea.
It was where Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master cultivated in. The Violet Bamboo Sea contained many bamboos that swayed with the wind. A violet-robed male was currently looking at this sea with his hands behind his back. He was watching silently, and his long narrow eyes were calm.
"Hong!"
A terrifying aura descended.
The violet-robed male 'Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master' turned around. He saw a figure wearing a crimson gown that was flowing like blood cloud-Bloodshed God-Emperor! Bloodshed God-Emperor was currently filled with overwhelming killing intent. Even the entire sky had changed color. This willful killing intent he emitted was beyond the aura manifested by that mysterious owner of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, 'Gu Qian Luo'! This killing intent had inundated the entire Violet Bamboo Sea.
Even Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master could not help but shudder under this killing intent.
"Your Majesty." Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master said.
"I was the one who chose the nine Paragons in controlling that array! Yet who would have thought…" Bloodshed God-Emperor's voice was filled with rage and anguish. He hated this traitor, and hated himself even more!
"I've let down Your Majesty, I've let down…" Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master said.
"Die!"
Bloodshed God-Emperor let out a roar. The killing intent in his eyes was like a blade.
Following his angry roar, "Hong hong hong!"
An unseen strength exploded, causing the entire Violet Bamboo Sea to shake. Soon, the whole place started collapsing. Even 'Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master' who was standing in the midst of the sea, had disintegrated entirely apart.
That moment, the whole region of 500 billion kilometers were annihilated. Nothing was left behind.
"Even if you died 10,000 times, it will not be enough for you to repay your sin." Bloodshed God-Emperor's unseen killing intent remained plunged into the whole place. It spread across 500 billion kilometers, "Betraying the entire race! I've judged you wrongly. I must have been blind!"
…
Bloodshed God-Emperor was raving with madness. He had gone to destroy that body of Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master at the very first moment.
And within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, the Paragons were all stunned. They did not dare believe what they just saw. This was a war between two cosmos. Both parties no longer had any path of retreat. The moment the Ancestor Mother Religion set down their altar, countless mortals and lifeforms would be doomed. Even powerful existences would be forced out of the cosmos-they could not survive outside it!
The cruelest of Paragons from the Dark Abyss had never ever thought of betraying their cosmos!
"Bamboo Mountain!" Mysterious North Imperial Empress, Paragon Huo Cheng, Water Devil King, Purgatory Great Commander and the others were screaming out in anger. Their anger was exploding through the roof.
"Bamboo Mountain!" Xue Ying was also shouting lividly. His eyes were filled with disbelief.
Even though he held some doubts toward Bloody Ruler Nile because of the treasure spirit of the Black Gourd, he really trusted Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master. Nonetheless, who would have thought this proud and aloof male would turn traitor! He and Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master were the only two stage four World Deities who had opened a Dao. The two were extremely close.
Amongst Paragons, those he could count as friends included Paragon Huo Cheng foremost, then Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master next.
"Hahaha…"
The protectors who were deluged by the black vortex-three Holy Protectors and five other apex protectors who had stronger physiques, revealed joyful looks. The golden-haired monkey had even guffawed. Out of the nine Paragons who were controlling the array, one turned traitor, and another died. That resulted in the dissolution of this complex array. The other five apex protectors who were heavily injured were rapidly recovering at this moment.
"Hu!" The embedded jade green crystal rock in the forehead of the venom-tailed girl lit up. Her tail flashed, and within moments, it reached where the ancient circular stone plate was a few hundred kilometers away. At the same time, the tail pierced through another two Paragons. Only then did Devil Phoenix reacted and brought other Paragons away with a teleport.
However, that venom-tailed girl's sneak attack was absurdly swift.
That time, she had injured Xue Ying killed Purgatory Great Commander and Bitter Cultivator with her sneak attacks! And those were just regular ones. At this moment, after activating the jade green crystal rock in her forehead, the attack of hers became faster.
"Hahaha." Even though she had used up all energy in the jade green crystal rock within her forehead, that venom-tailed girl laughed out exuberantly. Her tail had already enveloped that circular stone plate and kept it into her Cultivation Eden.
…
Paragon Devil Phoenix, Mysterious North Imperial Empress, and the other remaining five Paragons appeared by the side of Xue Ying and Water Devil King.
"It's my fault. I was too distracted which led to the Ancestor Mother Religion snatching away the stone plate array." Devil Phoenix had an ugly look on her face.
"We don't blame you. The betrayal of Bamboo Mountain has stunned us all. Furthermore, that female protector's sneak attack was too fast." Mysterious North Imperial Empress said, "Even if they did not snatch it away, we can't find a Paragon to replace Bamboo Mountain in the short period."
This array was incredibly complicated.
It required all the efforts of nine Paragons who grasped the concept. They had been studying this array for an extended period previously, yet now, they had only ten breaths of time before the Ancestor Mother Religion procured a victory. This ten breaths of time would not suffice for a new Paragon to comprehend that array.
"They were in the red light region previously. We are only left with five breaths of time." Water Devil King coldly added.
"Five breaths of time…"
Xue Ying and the rest were looking at the distant. Their gazes landed on Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master who stood at a corner.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master arrived in the midst of the Ancestor Mother Religion protectors.
"Second Sister Chan." Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master greeted, "Senior Brother Qian, Brother Kui."
"You are…"
The golden-haired monkey, venom-tailed girl, and muscular man were looking with a pleasant surprise at Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master. They did not suspect him since they would be defeated if not for Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master's timely assistance. And this familiar greeting had presented them some conclusions about his identity. The golden-haired monkey suddenly yellowed, "Second Plum?"
"That's me." Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master nodded.
"Protector Plum!"
"It's Protector Plum." All the protectors revealed a grin.
"Who would have thought Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master is actually a protector from the Ancestor Mother Religion." Paragon Huo Cheng could not suppress his temper as he yelled.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master turned over. He stared at that group of familiar Paragons. He had drunk with some of them, forming deep friendships with others. At this moment, all were looking at him with contempt.
"Right, I am a protector from the Ancestor Mother Religion right from the start!" Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master nodded, "Ancestor Mother Religion cosmos is where I came from. For the sake of the survival of my people, I had to act."
"Hahaha…" Protector Huo Cheng guffawed. His laughter was filled with madness. He had a rustic look: "You are from the Ancestor Mother Religion cosmos, and your people want to live? Are you saying that we cultivators do not want to? You Bamboo Mountain has cultivated here in our cosmos, receiving the guidance of our cultivators, and now, you are going to bite us back? Saying that it is because your people wanted to live? So you would watch as all of us cultivators are exterminated so that your people can live?"
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master remained indifferent, "Right. I've let down all of you, but this is my decision to make!"
"Let down all of us? Do you think saying that is of any use?" Purgatory Great Commander coldly said, "Do you think everyone will revive and live on with your words of how you've let down all of us?"
"Attack!"
Following a roar by Mysterious North Imperial Empress, all Paragons charged forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 720 - Unplugging the Cork
chapters.content:
Chapter 720: Unplugging the Cork
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
"Bamboo Mountain, die for me!" Paragon Huo Cheng turned into a stream of dazzling flames. He charged directly toward Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master had a cold expression. He was ultimately a Paragon. Even though he had hesitated when making the final decision of betraying the Cultivators, Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master was still wholeheartedly on the side of the Ancestor Mother Religion. Since he had made his decision, he would not regret it! From now on, he would be part of the Ancestor Mother Religion and enemies of the cultivators!
"Just with you?" Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master received Paragon Huo Cheng's attacks emotionlessly.
"Everyone, pay attention and protect Protector Plum! This is his final body. For the sake of concealing his identity, he has yet to return home after reincarnating. His body isn't that robust either." The golden-haired monkey transmitted to all his comrades. Cultivating the Ancestor Mother system required resources and the right environment. Even though Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master understood the Ancestor Mother cultivation system and had the resources, he never went back to the Ancestor Mother cosmos after reincarnating. Thus, his physique could not compare with that of the protectors.
"Rest assured."
"Protector Plum has made a huge contribution." These protectors were all very excited.
"Kill!" Xue Ying, Water Devil King, Purgatory Great Commander and the others were all exasperated. They were doing their best to kill their way forward. Mysterious North Imperial Empress was also assisting them with her arrays.
"Hong long long~"
Both sides became embroiled in another battle.
However, the overall situation was apparent-the cultivators were entirely on the losing end.
That was also because the cultivators had lost all their top combat forces! Great Destruction was killed previously, and had yet to send an avatar in! Monarch Hex Cricket was murdered beforehand, and his new body was still forming. Besides, Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master betrayed the cultivators, causing the other party to gain an apex Paragon combat force and for the cultivators to lose one correspondingly.
Thus…
The gap between the top combat forces was tremendous. The other side had a total of three Holy Protectors.
"Peng." Purgatory Great Commander's body was torn directly by the golden-haired monkey.
Bitter Cultivator's chest was pierced once again by that unpredictable and sneaky tail of the venom-tailed girl.
Paragon Huo Cheng was soon killed by her too.
Xue Ying might be trying his best…
But other than him, Water Devil King and White Sovereign King who were more proficient in survival, the others were slaughtered. The three Holy Protectors were utterly suppressing them! As for the ordinary Paragons, their outcome was even more obvious.
"Even if we lose, we must kill some of them at least." The Paragons were yelling in rage before their deaths. They were all unreconciled for their loss this time was a great injustice. Victory seemed so close to them, yet it had actually been destroyed by the one they trusted-Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master!
"Kill."
Monarch Hex Cricket's body was finally reformed, though he was only good at surviving and could not change the current situation.
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction had finally arrived. But just as he reached, the three Holy Protectors worked together to deal against him. The golden-haired monkey shot out another golden ray from his eyes to heavily injure him. The other two took that opportunity to kill him once again.
There was honestly no hope for the Cultivators anymore!
…
Within the vast palace hall of the Ancestor Mother Religion, the group of Religious Leaders was watching the scene of the battle. They were all ecstatic at this moment.
"Hahaha, who would have thought that Protector Plum is still alive. He has succeeded in reincarnating." The huge fanged-hunk laughed, "And furthermore, he is cautious in not revealing himself. Even I did not know of it. This time, he appeared at the most pivotal moment, resulting in the doom of the cultivators."
"It is time for their race to be exterminated. This cosmos will belong to us."
"With the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, we will have won half the battle. The upcoming battle with the Rulers will be much smoother."
…
Unlike the joyful atmosphere on the side of the Religious Leaders, the atmosphere where the ten Rulers were at was grave.
Bloodshed God-Emperor, Primal Master, Abyss Primogenitor and the others were looking at the scene in the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. They were watching as the Paragons staked their lives. As time passed, even though a breath seemed long to the powerful existences, it was still passing by mercilessly.
"I am the one who determined the nine Paragons. It is my fault to have judged him wrongly." Bloodshed God-Emperor said calmly.
"Bloodshed, let's not talk about you. All of us here have never thought that Bamboo Mountain was from the Ancestor Mother Religion Cosmos. He has clearly been cultivating in our cosmos and has karmic lines attached to his body too. How could he be from the Ancestor Mother Religion? Unless he stole the karma away from someone? Or is it because of other reasons?" Primal Master shook his head lightly.
Temporal Island Lord had a cold expression as he watched nonchalantly, "Defeat. The Paragons have lost. The Ancestor Mother Religion will most likely be utilizing this mysterious Primal Chaos Flying Ship in the future battle. The outcome of the war seems uncertain now."
"Even so, we must fight on." Myriad God Palace Master added.
"Though the Paragons lost, they have done their best." Empress Qian He sighed.
Bloodshed God-Emperor looked calmly. He watched as the Paragons were wildly attacking without regard of anything. They just wanted to kill one more protector. He then said, "They have done well. It is us who will determine our fate next."
******
The Paragons were sending themselves to their deaths. They refined another avatar before sending them into the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. Nonetheless, these avatars were being sent to death.
When Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction appeared, everyone felt hopeful. But the three Holy Protectors dominated and dealt with him. The golden-haired monkey did not care about saving the treasure. He just used the golden ray from his eyes to injure Heavenly Emperor. Following that, the other two teamed up together to kill Great Destruction again! Without the 'strange treasure' at hand, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction became feeble in survival. The moment he died, everyone lost hope.
Eight breaths of time passed, and soon, nine breaths.
There were only five Paragons left in the battlefield-White Sovereign King, Xue Ying, Water Devil King, Monarch Hex Cricket and Devil Phoenix.
Just the five of them!
Even Mysterious North Imperial Empress who was good in arrays had been killed.
"Hmph."
"It is useless for them to struggle. We will win as long as we hold on for another breath of time." The protectors were too lazy to attack anymore. They formed a circle. An unseen ripple emanated by the three Holy Protectors defended everyone within. Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master was located at the center.
Without the help of arrays, Xue Ying and the rest could not even kill a single protector. That unseen ripple could effectively suppress Xue Ying's Mirage World and Devil Phoenix's domain.
"We lost." Water Devil King sat down on his butt; his head was lowered.
"Hahaha, it seems when we were about to win, yet because of Bamboo Mountain… haha…" White Sovereign King stopped too. Even his laughter was filled with mournful desperation.
Devil Phoenix stood on one side without speaking.
Monarch Hex Cricket sat down cross-legged too. He let out a sigh.
All of them were in despair.
Were they about to lose?
If the Ancestor Mother Religion was able to employ the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, could the Rulers confront them? Would the many lives in the entire Cultivation Cosmos be endangered and exterminated? Would even those who transcended die?
'Is it the final round already?' Xue Ying still remained standing. He looked at the Ancestor Mother Religion protectors who came from another cosmos before turning towards the helpless and despondent Paragons. Even his teacher Bloodshed God-Emperor was no longer transmitting any instructions over. Did he give up too?
'I can only contribute what I have.'
Xue Ying walked forward step by step.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying is still walking to us?" The protectors were looking at him with shock. It was like watching a fool walking to them. Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master felt wary.
"He hasn't given up?"
"Who could he kill when the everyone is protected by the domains of the three Holy Protectors?"
The protectors merely treated Xue Ying as a deranged person and someone unwilling to admit defeat.
Xue Ying continued walking forward step by step.
'I can only contribute what I have!'
'I can't afford to lose!'
'I am worried that the Ancestor Mother Religion has some hidden techniques still. That is why I have been waiting for them to finish using them.'
'But… this is the final moment.'
'The Paragons have tried their best.'
'If that's the case-then let us begin the last round!'
'We might lose.'
'Everything is up to fate.'
Xue Ying stopped. He looked at that group of protectors, and also Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master who stood at the center. He took out a Black Gourd with his left hand, and following that, his right hand calmly unplugged the cork.
"Hong!"

chapters.title: Chapter 721 - Sending Themselves to Death First
chapters.content:
Chapter 721: Sending Themselves to Death First
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
The protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion were all eagerly counting down since there was just a single breath of time left.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master saw Xue Ying walking over. He shook his head inwardly: 'You haven't given up yet? Dong Bo Xue Ying. He is indeed a remarkably talented cultivator from this cosmos. He isn't even willing to give up at the very last moment. It's such a pity that the final outcome is fixed.'
All of a sudden-
That Xue Ying who was walking over began raising his left hand. A Black Gourd appeared in it. At the same time, he casually unplugged the cork.
"Not good!" Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master's expression changed.
"Be careful!" The golden-haired monkey, venom-tailed girl, muscular man and other apex protectors might not know what the Black Gourd was, but at this point of the battle, anyone could guess that it should be something extraordinary.
"Hong!"
The Black Gourd released a drizzle of rich and vast ripple from its opening. It was a ripple that could not be stopped.
This sudden drizzle of black ripple was stacked multiple times unto itself. When it sped out of the opening, it went sweeping in a fan shape. This ripple was formed by that terrifying fireball within the gourd. Under the restriction by the void array of the Black Gourd, the ripple flew along this opening. It was not an attack employed by an expert. Instead, it was a devastating ripple formed by a celestial existence on the same level as the 'Sun Star'. One could even reach the Ruler realm if he comprehended the mysteries within this ripple and opened a Dao based on it.
"This is-" All the protectors revealed looks of horror.
Too fast.
They were initially located close to each other. With the speed of this Black Gourd's drizzle of ripple that reached upwards of a few hundred million kilometers in an instance, they could not react in time. This drizzle of black ripple flooded over them!
The grand and mighty drizzle of ripple was akin to black wind storming over them.
"Chi chi chi~" The apex protectors who had strong physiques, were greatly horrified. Under the terrifying ripple, they could not maintain their body at all and soon later, their bodies shattered.
Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master resided at the center of the Ancestor Mother Religion protectors. Even though the three Holy Protectors were shielding him, this ripple was present everywhere! Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master was weak in survival-his physique could hardly compare with those of the apex protectors. His body had been fragmented in a single instance. His true deity heart also burst apart. That long narrow eyes of his gawked at the distant Xue Ying, gaping at the Black Gourd which spurted out such terrifying might.
'I actually perished in the hands of Dong Bo Xue Ying in the end. That's good too, very good…" Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master had just a single thought flashing by before his consciousness dissipated.
"Ah ah ah~" The muscular man with a pole was roaring in pain. He survived for more than a single instance. He was able to perceive as his body, his blood, his muscles, and his bones were torn apart. His cry could not even be heard outside because everything around him was overwhelmed by the ripple! He soon disappeared after resisting for a few moments.
The golden-haired monkey tried to escape, but this drizzle of dark ripple prevented him from moving. His body was rapidly shredded. His hair and skin were ripped; his blood and muscles were destroyed. The ferocious face of his crumbled steadily over time. After enduring for a few moments more than the muscular man with a pole, he was eventually annihilated as well, leaving not a single particle behind.
Finally, only the venom-tailed girl was left! Her body was disintegrating at the slowest pace compared to the others. With every single part of her body being as firm as weapons, the injuries were slow to appear.
She wanted to escape.
But this ripple had permeated through every single part of her body. It was wrecking it within the deepest layer, wrestling away all control she had over it. Over time, that deepest layer of her body underwent destruction and she finally dissipated.
All the protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion had been exterminated under the terrifying drizzle of ripple. None were alive!
After all, the power of this Black Gourd could even tear apart the world membrane where Xue Ying's disciple 'Little Chong Seven' lived. This was a protective treasure bestowed by the Senior Voidwalker. Even though he could only engage this gourd for a short period-his soul would not be able to take it any further-this power was enough to change even the expressions of Rulers, much less these protectors.
…
Water Devil King was seated on his butt with his head lowered. The White Sovereign King was raving in madness. Devil Phoenix stood by herself in desolation. Monarch Hex Cricket remained silent as he sat cross-legged. They were all in despair and had given up the battle. Acute helplessness had already wrapped over them.
They could not see any strands of hope.
At the moment when Xue Ying brought out the Black Gourd, they could not help but look over.
"This is?" Water Devil King, White Sovereign King, Devil Phoenix and Monarch Hex Cricket were subconsciously following this scene as Xue Ying had never brought out the Black Gourd in his battle before. Maybe it was a strange treasure as impressive as the one Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction had?
"Hong-"
That booming black drizzle of ripple which brought them terror abruptly swept across the protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion.
The four of them were staring petrified.
They saw as the protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion were eradicated. Even Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master was similarly destroyed. Those three powerful Holy Protectors might have lasted for a more extended period, but they were annihilated in the end. Furthermore, this black ripple did not end there. Every single area it spread to was destroyed-the land and the mountains. Even the void shattered apart under this force, revealing the gold array markings behind.
This power was beyond the frightening weapon which the Ancestor Mother Religion employed previously.
"Bu!" Xue Ying suddenly stopped using the array of the Black Gourd. At that moment, the black ripple disappeared. He also plugged the cork back.
Surges of pain struck his mind. His true deity heart was shrouded with a black aura-this black aura was malignant to his true deity heart. Despite how strong his deity heart was, he could not cope with the impure aura. He had to expel it slowly over time, and only after it was removed could he recover back to his usual state.
…
In the starry sky outside the Primal Chaos Flying Ship.
The Rulers had initially given up-even Bloodshed God-Emperor was thinking of how to deal with the Religious Leaders who had this mysterious Primal Chaos Flying Ship. He was thinking bitterly about how he should increase their chances of winning. Despite that, due to the lack of knowledge of this flying vessel, he could not think of an appropriate strategy to deal with it.
"That is…" Bloodshed God-Emperor and the other Rulers might have given up, but they were still paying close attention to what was happening within.
Xue Ying had stood up ahead of the rest.
He was not willing to admit defeat; he wanted to continue fighting.
But suddenly, he took out the Black Gourd and unplugged the cork. Everything changed!
The Ancestor Mother Religion protectors were exterminated. Even the three Holy Protectors were killed.
"We won?"
"We have won the battle?"
Temporal Island Lord could not help but exclaim in shock. Empress Qian He could also not believe what just happened, "This, what is this…"
The eyes of Bloodshed God-Emperor brightened. He could not restrain himself from revealing a bright grin, "Who would have thought that Xue Ying will have such a strange treasure. Even though this strange treasure might be crude with its usage, and that it is used for a direct attack without containing any variability, its power is extreme!"
"Mn, its power is indeed extreme. Even we do not dare to resist it with our bodies." Primal Master nodded too. They would be sending themselves to their deaths if they did so!
Even though they were saying how intimidating the gourd was, they were merely words! Instead, they felt ecstatic at this very moment; they were only focusing on how brilliant this strange treasure was and not how threatening it was to them! Because they were Rulers and had grasped hold of a 'Dao' in the Ruler realm. If they could not resist it the power of the Black Gourd, they could always evade! The moment a Dao reached the 'Ruler Realm', it would undergo a qualitative change. Monarch Green's previous three Daos had all reached the limit and could be used in tandem flawlessly, yet he could barely fight Bloody Ruler who was concealing his real power.
A Dao that reached the Ruler realm was a Dao that reached eternity. It had formed its own law and domain, and everything would go according to what the Ruler himself wanted. That was the power of a Ruler.
Thus, it was almost improbable for Paragons to fight against Rulers.
…
The Rulers outside the ship were exceptionally overjoyed. As for the Paragons within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, they were currently shouting out in elation: "Dong Bo…!"
Xue Ying might be feeling tides of pain overwhelming his mind, but he still revealed a grin. They won. There was indeed no unforeseen circumstances.
He immediately collected the treasures left behind by the protectors. After all, the strange treasure of the Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, the ancient stone plate array, and many other treasures were left there.
"Fortunately, we are careful enough." A low voice uttered.
At that moment, four figures emerged.
It was the golden-haired monkey leading them with three other apex protectors behind.
"You all…" Xue Ying was stunned.
"Why, thinking how unexpected this is?" The golden-haired monkey sneered, "This is a war between our two races. We have no path of retreat. If we lose, we will die. Our true bodies will die too. We will naturally not hesitate to stake everything to win this war. Thus, our true bodies have come too! Right now, there are just four of us here. But other protectors are hiding at this moment to prevent you from wiping us with your Black Gourd. The few of us have come to play with you first! We will be here to send ourselves to death before them. I honestly would want to see how many times you can use that gourd in your hand, and how many protectors you can kill!"

chapters.title: Chapter 722 - Totally Worth It
chapters.content:
Chapter 722: Totally Worth It
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying turned pale. Monarch Hex Cricket, White Sovereign King, Water Devil King and Devil Phoenix were all stunned. They turned to Xue Ying, hoping that a miracle could happen! Even though they guessed that a strange treasure like the 'Black Gourd' could be employed by a Paragon, using it a few times more would be very, very difficult!
It was just like the terrifying weapon the Ancestor Mother Religion had. Its power was close to the Black Gourd, and could only be used once and not a second time within a short period!
They might understand this in their hearts, but all were wishing for a miracle. But seeing the pale-white Xue Ying, they immediately recognized.
"It has always been their avatars that were battling. They were having a hard time fighting previously, and we had painstakingly… yet they never revealed their true bodies at all!" Xue Ying felt helpless, "They had concealed their true bodies to give us a fatal blow in the most crucial moment! This time, they did not hesitate in paying all price for the sake of fighting for the Primal Chaos Flying Ship."
"Come, come on."
The golden-haired money roared, "Isn't that gourd of yours powerful? Can't you use it again?"
"The four of us are here to die. If you have the capabilities to take away our lives that is." The three other apex protectors were also staring at Xue Ying.
…
Within the palace hall where the Ancestor Mother Religion was based in, the Religious Leaders were not showing looks of joy. Instead, they were watching everything silently. Even if the previous battle was more intense, other than the six protectors who died initially because of the 'Purgatory Reincarnation' employed by Purgatory Great Commander, and adding on Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master's avatar and true body's death, the other protectors had not genuinely died. Their actual bodies were still alive! But from this moment on…
Every single protector who died would be dead for sure!
The Black Gourd's power was too terrifying. If it could be used again, then all protectors would be sending themselves to death if they went out together! Thus, only four protectors went out this time with the golden-haired monkey leading them! They were the first batch to come seeking death. Those who came had to be strong enough, else the Paragons could simply kill them without using the Black Gourd.
"The previous six deaths and Protector Plum's death for our race…" The eyes of the huge fanged-hunk were filled with sorrow, "There will be even more protectors dying from now on."
"But this time… we must get the Primal Chaos Flying Ship."
"Even if we have to pay a greater price."
The fanged Religious Leader's voice reverberated within the hall. The other Religious Leaders were silent too-they were watching the scene of the battlefield quietly. The golden-haired monkey and the three other protectors were currently provoking Xue Ying as they stood in the red light region.
******
The ten Rulers situated in the starry sky outside the Primal Chaos Flying Ship went taciturn too. When the four protectors appeared once again, they became quiet.
"The most worrying scene has finally appeared." Bloodshed God-Emperor said.
Empress Qian He nodded: "We initially presumed that they wanted to conquer another cosmos and will not put in all their strength-sending even their true bodies! If the true bodies and avatars were sent in, then there will be no path of retreat left. The moment they lose, all these protectors will die! Unless necessary, if not for the final madness right before extinction, they would not do this."
Under ordinary situations, even if the Religious Leaders ordered the protectors to send both 'avatar and true body' in, the protectors would rebel themselves! None were willing to enter a path of no retreat.
Unless…
They no longer had a way to retreat! Only then would they be willing to do so.
"For the sake of victory, they no longer care about the price?" Primal Master shook his head from the side, "It depends on Dong Bo Xue Ying now. If he could use the gourd again, we can still win. Otherwise, then we have no hopes left."
Temporal Island Lord frowned and said coldly, "This strange treasure definitely require a harsh requirement to use it. It is tough for him to use it once again."
"There might be some hope." Purgatory Ruler who was in a silver armor said.
"We shall see. Maybe Dong Bo Xue Ying has gotten himself a formidable strange treasure that could allow him to persist in employing it a few more times as a Paragon." Abyss Primogenitor said.
"We can only hope." Pang Yi softly added.
Monarch Green was silently watching this young junior disciple brother of his.
******
"Ze ze ze, a treasure that could display the power of a Ruler?" The enormous sculpture 'Gu Qian Luo' looked on with interest, "It is not bad, just that the offensive move is too foolish and contain no variations at all. Even an ordinary Ruler can't be killed by it! It will only force him into a retreat…"
Even though he was curious, Gu Qian Luo disdained totally. He was the seventh sacred son of the Ancestor Bone Throne. The value of a single Primal Chaos Flying Ship had far surpassed the imaginations of these Rulers and Religious Leaders.
"If it could be used a few more times, this treasure will be interesting. Otherwise, it is too useless." Gu Qian Luo spectated the battle leisurely. The two great races were fighting each other to their deaths. This was something he did not care-even the apocalypse of this cosmos. He only needed to find an aide.
…
"Why aren't you using the gourd? We are here for you to kill all you want, yet you aren't doing anything at all?" The golden-haired monkey sneered. The other three apex protectors were also satirizing Xue Ying. They were not willing to take the initiative since they merely needed to delay for more time. As long as they remained in this red light region for ten breaths of time, they would win! That's right! They had been exterminated previously, resulting in the restart of time count.
Xue Ying did not use the Black Gourd, allowing the four to let out a sigh of relief inwardly.
Even though they held on the resolution to die for their race, would it not be better if they could live? The three Holy Protectors could long become Religious Leaders, just that they did not have the resources to assist them!
As long as they survived, after they installed the Ancestor Mother Altar into this cosmos, the golden-haired monkey and the others would become Religious Leaders. In the future, they might walk down even further, experiencing all sorts of things…
"So you are just left with this few protectors?" A cold voice sounded. Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, Mysterious North Imperial Empress, and Paragon Huo Cheng appeared once again.
"This isn't enough to kill to our fill." Paragon Huo Cheng sneered.
"Kill."
Xue Ying kept his Black Gourd too. He teamed up together with his other comrades.
"Why are they still fighting?" The golden-haired monkey and others had a slight shift in expression. If they died, it was a true death for them: "They were in despair previously, yet they have somehow gained back their fighting spirit?"
The reason why was due to Xue Ying who transmitted to them: "I can employ the Black Gourd once again. However, the Ancestor Mother Religion protectors could be hiding in their treasure. We must force out more protectors… even if we can't force all of them out, we can kill the majority with my Black Gourd! We will have hopes of killing the remaining few later on. After all, we have more time now-a total of ten breaths."
At that moment, even those who had refined their avatars out and were in despair waiting outside the flying ship-Mysterious North Imperial Empress and the other two rushed in. There were even more Paragons currently refining their avatars and were rushing over.
"Kill!"
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, Monarch Hex Cricket, Water Devil King, White Sovereign King, Devil Phoenix, Purgatory Great Commander and others were currently rushing in and adding up to their total combat force. The Paragons were getting more and more.
The golden-haired monkey and three other apex protectors could not resist any longer. They were unwilling to die like this.
If was fine if they died under the attack of the 'Black Gourd'.
But dying under the group attack of these Paragons were pointless. The moment they died, the other protectors would have to come and continue battling. They would similarly be surrounded.
"Sou sou sou!"
Many apex protectors were forced to appear.
When a total of 16 apex protectors emerged with two Holy Protectors, they succeeded in resisting the assault by the cultivators.
"We aren't able to force my protectors out anymore."
"Dong Bo, it has already been eight breaths of time."
Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, Monarch Hex Cricket and the rest were transmitting their voices to Xue Ying at this moment.
Xue Ying slightly nodded. He wanted to force more protectors out, but the Ancestor Mother Religion was not foolish. They were not willing to send all out since they were afraid of being wiped out by Xue Ying entirely!
Though his head was still in excruciating pain, Xue Ying made his decision already.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, are you really planning to use the Black Gourd again?" The treasure spirit's voice transmitted into his mind, "Don't be foolish. Your soul is heavily injured now. If you were to use it again, your soul might just crumble apart! The moment you die, I'll not stay here anymore. It's impossible to let other Paragons and that Gu Qian Luo control me. I'll directly return to the original world, and you will no longer have any chance of getting the Black Gourd. This would mean you failed in your third trial."
"So what if I failed. Refining the Black Gourd is too difficult for me. I did not have the slightest of hope despite trying for the past 600,000 years. Even if you give me another 400,000 years to reach the total of a million years, I would still fail." Xue Ying transmitted.
"How can you give up now without reaching the final moment? Even if you failed this battle, you could escape easily with your survival capabilities. In the future, after refining the Black Gourd and becoming a Voidwalker, your path of cultivation will be wholly different. This is the biggest opportunity for you." The treasure spirit reminded him.
"This is a war between the two races. I must not shrink back from my duty. Exchanging a treasure which I do not have hopes of refining for the hope of my entire race is definitely worth the price." Xue Ying extended his left hand, causing the Black Gourd to appear once again.
"Hua."
Devil Phoenix had a tacit understanding as she displayed her domain to teleport all Paragons away.
That region was left with only the protectors. They were still releasing their attacks albeit their opponents were no longer there.
"Stop stop stop, stop at this very instant!" The treasure spirit anxiously shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 723 - Dripping Blood
chapters.content:
Chapter 723: Dripping Blood
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
When Xue Ying brought out the Black Gourd, the treasure spirit became anxious. He hurriedly transmitted, "Stop stop stop, stop at this very instant. Hurry up and drip a drop of fresh blood on top of the Black Gourd!"
If the treasure spirit mentioned other stuff, Xue Ying would ignore him. After all, the Ancestor Mother Religion protectors would hide if he delayed a little longer. But what the treasure spirit uttered caused him to halt.
"Drip a drop of fresh blood on the Black Gourd?" Xue Ying let his imaginations run wild.
"You who do not want your life, hurry up and drip a drop of blood on it. Isn't this what you wanted all along?" The treasure spirit urged.
Xue Ying had his views. The left hand which was grabbing the Black Gourd squeezed a drop of blood out. This drop of blood reached the Black Gourd before being absorbed.
"Weng-"
Xue Ying could feel ripples of close, pleasant feeling from the Black Gourd. It felt as if the gourd was his limbs. He could easily sense the entire presence within the gourd-an enormous mystical array that wrapped around a fireball. This fireball contained an infinite strength. That ripple when employed might be just the tip of the iceberg of what power this fireball had, but despite so, it was restrained by the void array!
The fireball was red in color. Endless waves of fire were rolling within. The power it possessed could hardly be conceived.
"This, this…" Xue Ying yearned for this Black Gourd for many years. Even after understanding the cultivation technique, he never had such a distinct and intimate feeling of the fireball.
"Treasure spirit, have I just succeeded in refining the Black Gourd?" Xue Ying could not help but convey a question. He had not understood the cultivation technique, yet he could clearly sense the entire Black Gourd. It was a feeling only the owner who refined it could follow. But what he had done to achieve this was by dripping a drop of blood on it! He had once thought of many methods the past 600,000 years.
He even attempted such a foolish idea of dripping blood on it. But it failed.
"You have already refined the Black Gourd! The Black Gourd has also recognized its owner. Why? Can't you feel it yourself if you have refined it or not?" The treasure spirit snorted with an aloof tone.
"Yes yes yes." Xue Ying was enthralled and unconvinced at the same time, "I feel that I have refined it too, but it was clear I did not do anything. I've done what you asked me to-drip a drop of blood on it and I succeeded in refining it?"
The treasure spirit sneered, "Dong Bo, do you really think that a Paragon will be able to refine a protective treasure such as this Black Gourd? The Black Gourd contains a mystical array within. Can't you feel for it?"
"I've experienced it."
Xue Ying continued, "Spending more than 600,000 years studying this array, all I've comprehended is only a trace and the tip of an iceberg. I have no confidence of completing the trial in a million years!"
"Hmph hmph, this is an array which can suppress the fireball. Even if your teacher Bloodshed God-Emperor is the one refining it, he will not succeed!" The treasure spirit transmitted, "A Paragon, even if he spent 10 billion years in trying to refine it, will only fail in the end if he attempted to do it solely by himself."
"Then why did Senior Voidwalker left behind the third trial that requires the undertaker to refine it within a million years?" Xue Ying was puzzled.
"Very simple."
The treasure spirit explained, "There are three trials. Taking the Black Gourd with your strength during the first trial demonstrated that you have the potential to reach a higher level. The second trial assesses your comprehension ability. After all, few would inherit and take over the Voidwalker mantle. It isn't something everyone is qualified to cultivate on. Your comprehension ability led to your success. As for the third trial, what it tests is your personality!"
"Personality?" Xue Ying felt his heart jolting. He had some guesses.
"If it were a wicked existence, the stronger he is, the more harm he would bring to the many lives. And the pioneer of the Voidwalkers is someone benevolent. He isn't willing to kill an ordinary little ant. He had been to many places and cosmos and had helped many weak little beings. There was a rule which he set a long time ago-those of his lineage, even if he wasn't someone benevolent, must not be someone wicked."
"Thus, the third trial is in reality, a trial of observation by this treasure spirit. I've been observing every single action of yours to scrutinize your personality."
"If your personality is wicked… then I'll naturally disappear after a million years."
"If you succeeded in the personality trial, I'll let you drip a drop of blood to allow the recognition of the new owner after a million years."
"Originally, the length of the trial is a million years. But you, brat, is truly seeking a death road. Regardless of that, I can clearly discern who you are as a person over the past 600,000 years. The treatment of your disciples, the old friends and brothers of yours, and your people… have clearly shown who you are as a person! You have done excellent in this. During your journey across the cosmos in search for an opportunity to refine the Black Gourd, you have not willfully slaughtered the mortals. Living in the mortal realm, you are even respectful and polite to those weak little mortals…"
"Thus, I pronounce you as someone who has passed the personality trial."
Xue Ying finally understood. The last trial ultimately depended on the decision made by this treasure spirit! That's right. Since Senior Voidwalker was no longer around, he would have arranged everything for the treasure spirit to handle.
…
When Xue Ying was conversing with the treasure spirit, it delayed his action.
It gave enough time for the Ancestor Mother Religion protectors to react and hide in their treasures. Thus, only the golden-haired monkey and three other apex protectors were left guarding the place! They were all staring at Xue Ying, or to be more accurate, that Black Gourd in his hand. Their eyes were filled with terror and fury at the same time.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, why did you not attack?" Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction transmitted over.
"What is happening? The previous opportunity was excellent, yet you did not attack them. Now, they have gone back into hiding." White Sovereign King asked through a voice transmission too. He felt that he should not be blaming Xue Ying, but those were things they had planned previously, and Xue Ying had not done so.
"Brother Dong Bo?" Paragon Huo Cheng shouted out too.
As Xue Ying heard the incoming voice transmissions, he finally reacted. He turned around towards that group of Paragons. Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, White Sovereign King, Devil Phoenix, Mysterious North Imperial Empress and others were all staring at Xue Ying at this moment. Ultimately, he was the crux of winning this battle.
"I am ashamed."
Xue Ying continued replying, "It is tough to employ this strange treasure. I was prepared to use it when I had slight enlightenment, boosting my control over the treasure. Now, I could perform the move a few more times. That was why I was delayed."
"Enlightenment? You can use it a few more times?" The crowd of Paragons was startled and overjoyed at the same time.
Previously, they felt that victory was distant.
And now, they suddenly realized that they could win! Though many were feeling slightly guilty. Even Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction transmitted back, "Dong Bo Xue Ying, I apologize. I have never thought that you would be in enlightenment, breaking your trance with my voice transmission!"
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, the rest of us were feeling anxious previously! That's why we broke your enlightenment…" Many Paragons were transmitting to him with guilt.
They were clear how hard it was for enlightenment!
Even if it was a little enlightenment, it had significantly boosted Xue Ying's control over the Black Gourd. What if he could comprehend for a more extended period? That might boost Xue Ying's control even further. But they had broken his enlightenment.
"No worries." Xue Ying felt speechless. He had casually spouted an excuse for he could not tell them this was the third trial set by the Voidwalker which he had succeeded.
And on the other side, the golden-haired monkey and three other apex protectors who were ready to die felt perplexed: "This Dong Bo Xue Ying should have employed that Black Gourd strange treasure previously to wipe us out together. Why did he not employ it? Unless he failed? That's right. It isn't easy for such a great strange treasure to be employed a few times consecutively. Maybe he could no longer use it again! If that's the case, we will win!"

chapters.title: Chapter 724 - The Outcome of the Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 724: The Outcome of the Battle
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
It was normal for the golden-haired monkey and others to have such thoughts. Actually, even the Rulers outside the Primal Chaos Flying Ship were presuming that was the case. Even the large sculpture 'Gu Qian Luo' who was watching the battle, had such speculation. For Xue Ying to suddenly stop using the Black Gourd after taking it out during such a crucial moment? Was it because he could not use it anymore? They could understand how it was unlikely for a Paragon to employ such a formidable and exotic treasure the second time in this short period.
"Bu!" Nevertheless, Xue Ying still unplugged the cork of the Black Gourd without any sign.
"Hong!"
The black drizzle of ripple emerged once again.
The moment it appeared, it brought death and destruction. The golden-haired monkey and three other apex protectors did not have the time to react. This black drizzle of ripple permeated deep into their bodies. The other three apex protectors were relatively weaker and had been exterminated instantly. They only had the time to display a look of shock and agony in their eyes before they disappeared into nothingness.
"He can still use it. But, but why did he not force more of us out before using it again?" The golden-haired monkey felt destruction occurring in the deepest layer of his body. He knew death was imminent. At this juncture, he was feeling grieved and bewildered at the same time, "Unless he can employ the move a few more times?"
The golden-haired monkey had waited in the red light region for close to nine breaths of time. Even though the group of Paragons could always force them away from the area, the other apex protectors could arrive and assist them. The moment they lingered in the region for ten breaths, the Paragons would have lost.
Thus, Xue Ying did not hesitate to act.
Using it one more time was something he did not mind! That's because he would no longer be injured by the Black Gourd from now on.
"This feeling is truly…" Xue Ying grabbed hold of the Black Gourd. He could feel the surging strength within, and that void array was being extremely obedient; he could entirely control every single strand of energy, and this energy would not rebel against him. Furthermore, he had greater control over the drizzle of ripple unlike previously.
If Xue Ying was willing, he could borrow the 'void array' to control how the drizzle of ripple traveled. For instance, he could split it into 18 different ripples to target 18 directions. That was something easily done! He could even form a spherical ripple to protect himself.
This was the benefit of getting recognition as the owner!
'But there is still that mysterious owner of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, Gu Qian Luo. It is better for me to remain low-profile, else he might just yearn over this Black Gourd." Xue Ying stayed alert.
…
"Hong-"
The golden-haired monkey's body was being torn apart. He let out a roar of fury, yet it could not be transmitted out.
Indignance! Unreconciled!
But his body eventually dissipated into nothingness in the end.
A Holy Protector and three apex protectors were gone. Xue Ying stopped the black ripple with a thought before directly commanding, "Move out. Force more protectors out."
"Yes."
"Force them all out."
The many Paragons were spirited. After entering the Primal Chaos Flying Ship for so long, they had never felt so delighted before. The protectors had to come out because if they did not, the treasures they used to hide with would be taken by the cultivators. By then, their fates would be worse.
"Sou sou sou sou sou sou."
A total of nine apex protectors appeared. It was the muscular man with a wooden pole leading them this time. They were filled with indignance and lament. As Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction, White Sovereign King, and the Paragons attacked, more apex protectors were forced out to assist those already present.
"Are we going to be defeated?"
"Could Dong Bo Xue Ying still use that Black Gourd again?"
"How could this be?"
The apex protectors might be in battle, but the anguish was swelling in their hearts since they understood that death was inevitable.
Xue Ying did not participate in the battle. He stood afar and held on to the Black Gourd. He did not unplug the cork. Instead, he was waiting for a ripe moment.
******
The protectors who were fighting felt sorrow.
In the distant palace hall where the Ancestor Mother Religion was based in, the Religious Leaders were currently located there. Their aura was grand and majestic, though their eyes were all filled with pain and bitterness at this moment. How many protectors did the entire Ancestor Mother Religion have? Most had been their disciples. The Religious Leaders watched as they grew up, and now, they were watching as they died-it was a true death this time.
These Religious Leaders felt cold; their hearts iced.
"We no longer have a path of retreat."
"We sent them into the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, and they only have a path of survival-to win. Bloodshed God-Emperor had sealed the exit of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. The moment they are defeated, they could not escape." The fanged Religious Leader said, "We cannot retreat. They must win! And now, we can only gamble on the fact that Dong Bo Xue Ying could not employ that strange Black Gourd of his a few more times. This is the only way for them to live!"
"Yet Dong Bo Xue Ying has used the Black Gourd once earlier to deal with the first four protectors including Protector Qian. Clearly, he is confident." A thin and weak old man said with a grave voice.
The entire hall turned silent.
The other Religious Leaders were deep in thought. They were all watching the scene of the battlefield floating in midair.
It was Xue Ying using the Black Gourd again. That vast drizzle of ripple which made others despair appeared once again. As the Paragons had suddenly disappeared, the remaining 18 protectors did not have the time to escape. They were 'swept' by this drizzle of ripple. Other than the muscular man with a wooden pole, the other 17 apex protectors had dissipated into oblivion. The muscular man withstood for a few moments longer before he disappeared with a soundless roar.
"Sou sou sou sou sou sou!"
This time, the Paragons did not force them. The remaining ten protectors appeared on their own initiative.
The venom-tailed girl was leading nine other apex protectors, and they were all glaring at Xue Ying.
…
Xue Ying was also looking back at them.
"If you could use it once more, then kill us." The venom-tailed girl coldly said. They knew it was pointless to struggle on anymore.
"Come on."
The nine other apex protectors were glaring at Xue Ying too.
They were either kind or brutal, uncaring or cruel. Nevertheless, at this moment, they were all calmly facing death! They were clear that they had no path of retreat. Naturally, they would not act pitiful with their tails shaking and beg for mercy.
Xue Ying looked at them. He could feel the resolution of these protectors to die. He said, "Your race wishes to live. But, the price for your survival is to establish the Ancestor Mother Altar that will transform the entire cosmos, exterminating our entire race! Our race similarly wishes to survive, so you all should die!"
"Hong."
Xue Ying once again employed the Black Gourd.
The venom-tailed girl and nine other apex protectors had a strand of hope in their hearts. They were gambling that Xue Ying might not be able to employ the Black Gourd again. But the moment they were enveloped by the drizzle of ripple, despair inundated their hearts. The nine apex protectors disappeared within an instant. Only the venom-tailed girl was left behind with injuries gradually appearing.
"Weng." Xue Ying suddenly stopped operating the inner array of the Black Gourd. He plugged the cork back onto the gourd.
The venom-tailed girl who was filled with fresh blood and massive injuries fell into a daze as she stared at Xue Ying.
"Capture her!" Xue Ying said.
"Right, capture her alive!" Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction laughed joyously. He immediately rushed forward.
"Onwards!" Monarch Hex Cricket, Water Devil King and the rest were all filled with fighting spirit. Mysterious North Imperial Empress also displayed her arrays. The Paragons were all teaming up together.
The venom-tailed girl looked at this. Her rapidly recovering face revealed a sneer as she screeched, "Want to capture me alive? Even if we are dead, it doesn't mean we are defeated. This cosmos will eventually belong to us. Ours!"
"Hong!"
Her body suddenly exploded.
Monarch Hex Cricket and Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction who rushed at the forefront, began working together to protect their comrades.
Xue Ying turned real and unreal at that moment. He let the explosion shockwave sweep over and watch silently. These protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion were dead. But Xue Ying and the other Cultivators could not take a step back since the Cultivator Cosmos wanted to live too!
"Beautiful, exceptionally beautiful! One side triumphs and the other side is completely wiped!" Gu Qian Luo's voice boomed and reverberated in the world. It was filled with a teasing tone.

chapters.title: Chapter 725 - Selecting an Aide
chapters.content:
Chapter 725: Selecting an Aide
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Xue Ying had just collected the treasures left behind by the protectors when everyone began seeking for their original belongings. Even though these were ownerless treasures, Xue Ying would naturally return them to their original owners, like the strange treasure which Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction initially had. He had also given back the True God weapons to their original owners. As for the remaining treasures that belonged to the Ancestor Mother Religion, they would allow the Rulers to sieve them through according to the initial plan before deciding what to do with them after that.
"Mn?" Hearing the voice of Gu Qian Luo, Xue Ying and the rest turned over.
The huge sculpture 'Gu Qian Luo' was overlooking this group of Paragons: "Even though you haven't persisted in the red light region for ten breaths, your race has already triumphed. It'll be easy to stay in the region for this short period."
All the Paragons were on alert.
Not just them, even the Rulers outside the Primal Chaos Flying Ship were looking at the scene inside solemnly. This was the most crucial moment. In the eyes of Bloodshed God-Emperor and the others, this mysterious owner of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship was a significant variable! Despite the Cultivators winning the battle, this owner could exterminate all Paragons and take the initiative to help the Ancestor Mother Religion.
"This person called Gu Qian Luo should have taken many lives before. He isn't someone we could speak to easily." Temporal Island Lord frowned.
"We have won. Without sufficient reasons, he should not go against his previous words." Pang Yi added.
They were watching nervously.
Even though the group of Religious Leaders from the Ancestor Mother Religion were feeling anguish from the wipeout of all their protectors, it was now that they had a greater apprehension. They were praying for this 'Gu Qian Luo' to have a falling out with the Cultivators!
…
Xue Ying and the others looked up towards that large and towering sculpture, 'Gu Qian Luo'. That cold, foul aura was continually wrapping over them. At the same time, the Paragons got a transmission from Bloodshed God-Emperor: "We must not let emotions affect our decision. This Primal Chaos Flying Ship is a huge influence on the final battle between the Ancestor Mother Religion and us. We will make the decision and inform you all."
All Paragons felt their hearts easing at that moment. It was better for the Rulers to make the final decision.
Gu Qian Luo's voice continued booming: "Since all of you are from the same side, I believe it is impossible for you to kill each other. I am in need of an aide and not an enemy who harbors grudges against me. Thus, I am not forcing you all to kill each other! How about this, I'll select one from amongst you. Don't worry. We will swear an ancient oath that will ensure we both follow what we agreed on. Just like I said before, I'll help that person just as that person will help me. He or she who has been chosen… will obtain a huge opportunity that far transcends your imaginations. The cultivation system I have is definitely much stronger than the one you are currently cultivating with! As long as you do your best to help me, even Paragons could fight against Rulers."
The Paragons present hesitated. They were also feeling hopeful.
An ancient oath?
If Gu Qian Luo was someone who would not stab them behind their backs, everyone was willing to fight for it. Even though it might be slightly dangerous, this was a tremendous opportunity. How would any set of massive opportunity not come accompanied by trials and dangers? It was just a dream if one thought such an immense chance would land in his hand without doing anything.
"Who should I choose?" Gu Qian Luo swept his gaze across the Paragons, "The moment I elected that person, I'll definitely provide a huge benefit that would improve your combat power."
Hope began filling in the eyes of some Paragons.
They were willing to gamble! Some had been stuck in the realm of Paragon for ages. They could not see any possibility of a breakthrough, yet they coveted for one.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying…"
Gu Qian Luo's gaze landed on Xue Ying's figure.
Xue Ying felt his heart tightening.
The surrounding Paragons turned towards Xue Ying too. Some felt helpless, but everyone accepted it wholeheartedly since Xue Ying was the one to turn this entire battle around. He contributed significantly and was the most dazzling one. It was natural for Gu Qian Luo to choose him.
"Is he planning to pick Xue Ying?" The ten Rulers outside and Religious Leaders from the Ancestor Mother Religion were paying close attention to this.
The huge sculpture 'Gu Qian Luo' overlooked down at Xue Ying: "I can discern your soul aura. You are extremely young, yet you are so powerful! You should be the one with the greatest potential in this battlefield, and also the one with the highest comprehension ability."
The Paragons present all agreed.
How long had they cultivated, and how long had Xue Ying cultivated? Even if he did not have the Black Gourd, he still ranked in the forefront amongst Paragons.
"You originally qualify to become my aide, but it's a pity you have yet to transcend!" The huge sculpture Gu Qian Luo shook his head, "If I want to find an aide, he or she must be ready to leave this cosmos with me on a long journey. You have yet to transcend, and if this cosmos epoch ends, all lives in the River of Time will die. You will similarly die. If my Primal Chaos Flying Ship is halfway on a journey and you die, won't I encounter huge trouble?"
"No other choice."
Gu Qian Luo's gaze landed on a beautiful girl: "You are called Mysterious North Imperial Empress?"
"Yes." She nodded.
"Your comprehension ability and potential might be weaker, but you are the one who specialized most in arrays, and have transcended already. Come become my aide." Gu Qian Luo directly said.
Mysterious North Imperial Empress slightly hesitated.
Because she was currently discussing with Bloodshed God-Emperor.
"Alright!" Mysterious North Imperial Empress eventually nodded, "You must ensure my safety."
"Hahaha, relax. Like I've said before, we will swear an ancient oath. The moment that is sworn, you will understand that it is impossible for me to harm you." Gu Qian Luo laughed joyously. He then swept his cold gaze across the other Paragons, "Since I've chosen my aide, the rest of you should leave."
"Weng!"
An unseen ripple engulfed around Xue Ying, Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction as well as other Paragons, teleporting them directly out of the vessel.
Currently, there was only Mysterious North Imperial Empress and Gu Qian Luo left in the ship.
"Even though you have to assist me, this is also a great opportunity for you." Gu Qian Luo's lip edged upwards, "It is rare for me to be so charitable."
…
Xue Ying and the others were thrown out of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. They felt the scene in front of their eyes change. Right beside them were the ten Rulers.
"Fellow Paragons, you have all contributed greatly to our entire cosmos and the countless lifeforms living in it." Bloodshed God-Emperor flew over. The group of Rulers had a look of elation on their faces. No matter what, it was sure the Ancestor Mother Religion would no longer be able to utilize this Primal Chaos Flying Ship.
"It is all due to Monarch Dong Bo." Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction might be someone arrogant, yet he was humble at this moment. A smile was gleaming on his face. Firstly, they had won. Secondly, he was able to take back that strange treasure of his which boosted his survival capabilities. Naturally, he was elated.
The other Paragons were also praising Xue Ying.
Xue Ying had humbly said, "I was lucky to gain enlightenment during the most critical moment. Otherwise, I would not have been able to use the Black Gourd a few more times."
"Your luck is indeed ordinary." Primal Master laughed loudly, "Although you brat has the most dazzling performance-even your comprehension ability and potential are relatively great-Gu Qian Luo did you select you as his aide in the end. It's such a pity that he decided not to pick you solely because you have yet to transcend. No matter if he is someone wicked or not, his background is quite unordinary. Your future will definitely be brighter if you followed him."
"I too thought that he would end up choosing Xue Ying." Empress Qian He giggled, "Yet he decided to forgo him because he hasn't transcended."
Bloody Ruler Nile was also grinning from the side.
Yet deep within the eyes that were currently staring at Xue Ying, great rage and killing intent were concealed. So many people he was close to were dead-the apex protectors had been exterminated. And this defeat had significantly reduced the chances of victory for the Ancestor Mother Religion. If he could, Bloody Ruler Nile would prefer to kill this Xue Ying at this moment.
But he dared not.
Because Bloodshed God-Emperor was beside them. He could only maintain a smile and praise Xue Ying.

chapters.title: Chapter 726 - The Inheritance of the Voidwalker
chapters.content:
Chapter 726: The Inheritance of the Voidwalker
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
After teleporting Xue Ying and the others out, the Primal Chaos Flying Ship remained sealed entirely. Not just the Rulers, even the Religious Leaders could not see what was happening within.
The Rulers, Xue Ying and the rest were waiting in the starry sky outside.
"Dong Bo." Paragon Huo Cheng transmitted his voice over as he stared at the ship by the side, "Do you think that Gu Qian Luo might be scheming something behind our back? Previously, he said that he will swear an oath and properly defend that aide of his. Now, he forced us out, leaving only Mysterious North Imperial Empress within. Will he suddenly employ some underhanded and treacherous methods against her?"
"Hard to say." Xue Ying did not have any confidence.
Judging from his aura, Gu Qian Luo was a cold and wicked existence that killed many beings. Furthermore, the other party had an extraordinary background. It was typical for him to be able to employ in some treacherous and unpredictable method which they did not know of.
Bloodshed God-Emperor and the others were waiting silently.
After half an hour.
"Hu."
Only then did Mysterious North Imperial Empress float out of the flying ship. The ten Rulers and Paragons went over to greet her.
'It seems that this Mysterious North Imperial Empress' aura has become much stronger.' Xue Ying could faintly discern that her physique was somewhat stronger.
"Fellow Rulers." Mysterious North Imperial Empress greeted politely.
"Did that Gu Qian Luo keep his promise?" Bloodshed God-Emperor asked.
Mysterious North Imperial Empress nodded.
"Don't move for now. Let me inspect your soul." Bloodshed God-Emperor extended his hand. Mysterious North Imperial Empress gave the nod. She might not have felt herself being affected during the process, but she was worried that it might be a technique which her current realm could not perceive. Bloodshed God-Emperor was the strongest expert in this cosmos, and with his unfathomable power, it should not be easy to scheme something outside his notice.
Gu Qian Luo had a dominant background. Bloodshed God-Emperor similarly had his miraculous encounters.
Bloodshed God-Emperor placed his palm on her shoulder. Unseen energy permeated through her body. Mysterious North Imperial Empress did not obstruct it. This energy directly entered the consciousness of the Mysterious North Imperial Empress, inspecting her true deity heart.
After a few moments, Bloodshed God-Emperor finally let his hand off. The other Rulers were looking at him. The Paragons including Mysterious North Imperial Empress herself were also staring at Bloodshed God-Emperor. He chuckled, "That Gu Qian Luo has left something behind on Mysterious North's deity heart, but it is meant to protect her."
Everyone let out a sigh of relief.
