"Your Majesty, regarding the Primal Chaos Flying Ship…" Mysterious North Imperial Empress was about to mention it to him.
"Wait a moment. We will continue speaking in detail after reaching my god palace." Bloodshed God-Emperor directly cut her off, "Furthermore, we have to properly go through what you discussed with Gu Qian Luo."
…
Following that, the Rulers began investigating the treasures left behind by the Ancestor Mother Religion protectors. But after a short while, they took away that terrifying weapon, leaving behind the rest for Xue Ying and the other Paragons to split! That terrifying weapon required a Ruler to transmit his energy could energy be stored within. Only then could it be utilized once. When it was placed in the hand of a Ruler, it could be used at any time. In the hands of Paragons, it could only be employed once.
As for the other treasures, they were ordinary. This time, even though the Ancestor Mother Religion had decided to stake all in one throw, they were not too willing to leave too many treasures for the Cultivator if they lost. Thus, most of what they brought was ordinary.
Soon after that, everyone went back to their own places.
The Rulers had brought Mysterious North Imperial Empress away.
******
Black Fog Sea, Monarch Residence, inside the courtyard.
There was a thick layer of accumulated snow piled. After all, the battle at the Primal Chaos Flying Ship had persisted for two days, and the thick snow had yet to melt within the Monarch Residence.
On top of the table, there was wine being boiled. Xue Ying sat opposite Jing Qiu. They were currently chatting to each other idly-mainly about the incident of what just happened.
"So there is such a huge matter which happened the past two short days." Jing Qiu poured wine for Xue Ying. She sighed, "I, Yu'er and Qing Yao felt that the days of cultivation are quite normal as per usual. But we do not know that a calamity is happening in the dark. If you all have lost this time, the Ancestor Mother Religion might defeat us Cultivators with the help of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. They will exterminate countless of lifeforms in our cosmos, and the weak ones like us could hardly survive."
"Jing Qiu, I'll never let such a thing happen. "Xue Ying looked at his wife.
Jing Qiu giggled slightly. She felt sweet in her heart.
She had always felt that reincarnating was the wisest decision she ever made.
"Since this is a war that involved two cosmos, the level of battle is too high. I can only help pour wine for you here." Jing Qiu said.
"Hahaha… I have contributed greatly this time. The battle from now will depend on the Rulers. I am not qualified to participate." Xue Ying shook his head. The Black Gourd power might be enormous, but it was mainly used for 'protecting' him. It gave him the ability to survive in front of powerful Rulers. As for killing Rulers? There was no hope of doing so. The Rulers had a deeper realm compared to him.
The Ancestor Mother Religion would similarly have a qualitative change in power the moment they broke through to the Religious Leader realm! They could fight with the Rulers from the Cultivators side.
"A war between Rulers will be up to Teacher and the rest." Xue Ying said, "We have even gotten the help of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship for this war. Thus, we should have a 99% chance of winning the war!"
Even though that was what he said, Xue Ying still felt his heart tightening slightly! The Ancestor Mother Religion would definitely not give up so quickly. They would struggle on fervently. What if the worst case scenario happened and they lost? Countless lives would be exterminated. That was a scene Xue Ying could not help but feel chill about.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, since you have refined the Black Gourd, it is time for you to receive the inheritance of the Voidwalker." The treasure spirit transmitted.
"The inheritance of the Voidwalker?" Xue Ying's eyes brightened. He then turned towards his wife who accompanied him in drinking, "I am not in a rush. I'll first accompany my wife for a while before leaving."
…
Within the vast palace hall of the Ancestor Mother Religion.
The crowd of Religious Leaders was seated here cross-legged. Their auras were all majestic and grand, yet the current atmosphere was tense.
"After undergoing a discussion, Gu Qian Luo has promised to help the cultivators." Bloody Ruler Nile's incarnation said.
"He actually promised!"
"Damn."
"This is…"
The Religious Leaders felt like they were experiencing a suffocating calamity. Even though each and every one of them was strong and powerful, this feeling they were experiencing was stifling. It was a furor that became more intense the closer they were to their deaths. Naturally, since they could reach their current realm, they would not be willing to just die like this. They would rather have a savage battle and struggle. Who knew if a miracle could happen?
"It's all because of that Dong Bo Xue Ying, burying all prospects of victory when it was so close to us. Otherwise, the Primal Chaos Flying Ship might already be ours."
"It's all because of him."
"Many protectors have died under his hands."
They had emotions. Having lived for an extended period together with those protectors, their relationship was deep. Some even treated the protectors as their family members. For such an event to happen-a large-scale slaughter-the hatred for Xue Ying had long seeped into their bones! Furthermore, they might very well lose the final decisive battle in this war. That meant extinction for their entire race. It caused them to become more frustrated.
"Before the final decisive battle begins, we must kill this Dong Bo Xue Ying to vent our anger. Otherwise, I'll not be at peace!" A muscular man with dark yellow skin growled.
"Kill him." A cold black-armored girl agreed. Her only disciple had been killed by Xue Ying with his Black Gourd.
The fanged Religious Leader looked at the others and nodded: "Even though his strange Black Gourd might be crude, its power is great. Even Rulers do not dare to resist it head-on. Its threat in the hands of Dong Bo Xue Ying is ordinary. But the moment it lands in our hands, we could definitely maximize its usage during the war. That will depend on an opportune moment. We shall wait for him to leave the territory of the Bloodshed God Palace before assassinating him and taking the Black Gourd."
"Mn." Everyone present nodded. They did not dare to act within the Bloodshed God Palace territory since Bloodshed God-Emperor could arrive instantaneously within it.
"Investigate his position." The fanged Religious Leader ordered.
Very soon, an answer came-
"Dong Bo Xue Ying's true body remains in the material realm. However, his avatar has disappeared. His karma is untraceable." The news came back.
"What! His karma disappeared once again?" The fanged Religious Leader and the rest were startled.
They did not know that Xue Ying had entered the inheritance ground of the Voidwalker!

chapters.title: Chapter 727 - 《Walkers Hidden Secret》
chapters.content:
Chapter 727: 《Walker's Hidden Secret》
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within the courtyard covered in snow, Xue Ying accompanied his wife as they chatted and drank wine. He enjoyed and treasured this moment of peace since the entire cosmos would be embroiled in war soon.
"Jing Qiu, I have something on and will have to go out." Xue Ying stood.
"Be careful." Jing Qiu stood up with him.
Xue Ying nodded. Following that, he flew up into the sky, tearing apart a time-space tunnel before entering it.
Jing Qiu looked as the time-space tunnel gradually closed. Turning around, she then disappeared into the cultivation room. Jing Qiu resumed her cultivation. She sought to transcend one day. That way, she could lessen the gap between her and her husband.
"Hu hu hu~"
Xue Ying was flying along the time-space tunnel. He remained on high alert in worry that the Religious Leaders might come. After all, a considerable number of protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion had died in his hand within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. But even if he returned to the past again, Xue Ying would not change his decision! The living beings of this cosmos desired to live too. His friends and his loved ones wanted to survive! Any enemies that came would be exterminated!
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, we are here." The Black Gourd treasure spirit transmitted.
"Yi, they did not actually come after me?" Xue Ying was slightly surprised. He halted and left the time-space tunnel.
It was a starry sky outside.
According to the directions of the treasure spirit, Xue Ying flew along the starry sky. Gradually, space began warping in front of him! The immense starry sky distorted and form a passage. Flying along this tunnel, he could feel space shifting continuously. Since his body could not sense 'karma' any longer, this meant that just like before when he entered the Starting Ground, his karma had disappeared from the cosmos.
"The Voidwalker is very formidable to actually restrict karma from entering this place." Xue Ying concluded, "According to the information I got previously, the Starting Ground should be left behind by the creator of this cosmos. As for the inheritance ground of the Voidwalker, this void tunnel alone sufficed to break all traces of karma from entering."
The hidden treasure of Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction could hide his karma too.
But this was different.
Heavenly Emperor used the treasure to conceal the karma of its owner. As for the inheritance ground and Starting Ground, this was a region that forcibly cut off karma with all living beings in the cosmos. This was a stark contrast.
…
On a piece of vast gray land, many distorted void passages appeared. When Xue Ying descended onto this great land, the passages disappeared.
"We are here." The Black Gourd treasure spirit uttered.
"We are here?" Xue Ying looked around. This gray land was boundless. Furthermore, a limitless power seemed hidden within; one could sense it despite it being hidden. The moment it was unleashed, it would definitely be much more frightening than the Sun Star or Moon Star.
Xue Ying flipped his hand, bringing out the Black Gourd: "There isn't anything around here. How am I going to accept an inheritance?"
A red-undergarment child appeared on the Black Gourd. He swept his gaze across the place before giggling out, "You only have to sit down cross-legged."
"Alright, I'll listen to you."
Xue Ying placed the Black Gourd by the side. He then sat down cross-legged.
The moment he sat down on this gray land, a ripple immediately spread from deep underneath the ground over to him. This ripple tunneled right through his consciousness and into his true deity heart. It was so sudden that it jolted Xue Ying! The 'true deity heart' was spiritual and was extremely important. Both his true body and avatar were linked via the spirit, and the illusory realm attack targeted the spirit. Thus, if one was formidable enough, he could kill the true body via the avatar's soul.
For instance, Purgatory Great Commander's 'Purgatory Reincarnation' had extinguished both real body and avatar of six ordinary protectors!
Naturally, Xue Ying had merely instinctively jolted. Thinking about the heaven-shattering power the Voidwalker had, he then calmed himself down. With the gap in power between them, killing Xue Ying was something easy.
"Weng~" As this ripple tunneled into his true deity heart, it rapidly expanded.
The true deity heart was a smaller version of Xue Ying. Furthermore, it had the appearance of colored glass. Surrounding it, there were many sharp edges. At this moment, however, there was a black aura slowly expanding within.
Suddenly, just when the ripple tunneled into his true deity heart, the black aura was swiftly destroyed. It was like snow melting under intense sunlight. Besides, this smaller Xue Ying with a colored glass appearance became tangled up by many gray silk strands. Those silk strands snaked around every part of his body, forming a stereoscopic humanoid array diagram.
"The first layer of the "Walker's Hidden Secret"?" Xue Ying immediately received the information held within.
Voidwalker…
That was a unique cultivation system.
Just like the Ancestor Mother Religion system, just like the system which focused on grasping the laws and profound mysteries, they were all conventional cultivation systems that the society studied. Most had the chance to cultivate them! Even a mortal could breakthrough and become a Transcendent. Such a system was apt for most beings. Despite being common, these systems had the potential for one to attain an unfathomable strength if he cultivated to a deep and profound level.
And the lineage of Voidwalker was something different. It was extremely challenging compared to the conventional systems! It was rare to even find a cultivator who could cultivate in it within an entire cosmos.
This Senior Voidwalker, the 'silver-haired golden-horned man', had passed by this cosmos when he discovered it was created by 'Forefather Tian Yu'. He also discovered a talented cultivator who emerged from this cosmos before-'Lake Heart Island master'. Thus, with the foresight of that silver-haired golden-horned man, and with how admirable it was for 'Lake Heart Island master' to attain such terrifying combat strength-one that was only a step beneath both Forefather Tian Yu and the golden-horned man despite cultivating for a short period-he naturally concluded that the living beings of this cosmos had quite the potential. Only then did he leave behind a set of inheritance here! That was how Xue Ying could pass through the many trials in obtaining this inheritance.
There were a total of 60 levels in the "Walker's Hidden Secret"!
Every ten levels were classified as one major level.
It did not require laws and profound mysteries. Just like the Ancestor Mother Religion system, those protectors might have a lower realm, but they could fight with the apex Paragons. They could even kill an existence like Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction.
Even with a Paragon realm, by borrowing the "Walker's Hidden Secret", Xue Ying could reach a higher level. The 11th level of the "Walker's Hidden Secret" was comparable to the Ruler realm. By then, he could transcend! It did not require laws and profound mysteries. One could just depend on this Voidwalker system to breakthrough.
Of course, this system had harsh requirements and cultivating it was difficult. But one would naturally become extremely powerful if he succeeded.
According to the information left behind by that silver-haired golden-horned senior, with how heaven-defying he was, he had only reached the 55th level!
"The first level of cultivation."
Xue Ying closed his eyes. He only had the first level of cultivation technique. After all, he would not receive the full inheritance if could not even succeed with cultivating the first level of this technique.
Since the stereoscopic array diagram was within his true deity heart, he could easily sense it. Once his true deity heart started detecting it…
"Hong~"
Isolated by millions and millions of spatial obstacles, that vast, mighty yet cold and lonely primal chaos void which was located beyond this Cultivator Cosmos transmitted power in.
This power seemed to exist for countless ages. It seemed to be something that was there right from the earliest concept of time. It was ancient and cold at the same time. It appeared to be harmless, yet the moment it descended…
It was able to bypass countless obstacles, arriving right within this cosmos. Even though its power had greatly diminished when it reached the inheritance ground, it was able to form a piece of gray energy around the surface of Xue Ying's body. This gray energy seemed cold and desolate, yet it contained an extremely frightening corrosion power! The moment it touched Xue Ying's body, the Myriad Devil True Body could not withstand it. His skin, muscles, and bones were being corroded and broken down…

chapters.title: Chapter 728 - Incarnation
chapters.content:
Chapter 728: Incarnation
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
His body was being corroded, but his soul remained fine. The current physical pain he was feeling was at a level Xue Ying could completely disregard. Regardless, he still took this chance to experience the energy even to the extent of using the 'Mirage World' to thoroughly observe it. Nevertheless, the 'Mirage World' was being corroded by this gray energy as well.
'An extreme cold and other characteristics of destruction.' Xue Ying thought, 'This is even a greatly weakened energy that has descended into the cosmos after bypassing many obstacles.'
This energy originated from the Primal Chaos Void beyond the cosmos. That cold and desolate region seemed harmless, but in reality, it contained all sorts of destructive power. Just the extreme coldness was enough to freeze a Ruler to death! Thus, most Rulers could not survive within. The moment the cosmos epoch ended, they were forced to leave the cosmos. The Rulers would eventually die and turn into nothingness as they were forced into the Primal Chaos Void.
Even that 'Gu Qian Luo' relied on the Primal Chaos Flying Ship to sail through the Primal Chaos Void.
And the 'Voidwalker lineage' borrowed on the energy from the Primal Chaos Void to cultivate!
"Stop."
As his injuries worsened, Xue Ying promptly paused in his cultivation. Without the direction presented by the array diagram in his deity heart, the surrounding gray energy was forced out of the cosmos. This energy should not exist within it!
His bones were rapidly recovering; his body was healing quickly. Nonetheless, Xue Ying was thinking deeply.
"How are you feeling when cultivating it for the first time?" The red-undergarment child who sat on top of the Black Gourd shouted.
"I should have a basic understanding of the diagram. No wonder it has such high requirement on one's physique. Those with a weaker physique would likely be corroded when the Primal Chaos Void energy descends." Xue Ying sighed, "And it is indeed the case that comprehension ability is vital too. The "Walker's Hidden Secret" might not require one to understand the laws and profound mysteries, but just the first level array diagram is complex enough. It seems to contain the Profound Mysteries of Space, Profound Mysteries of Substance…"
"You can use your own system to ponder over this array diagram. At the same time, you should forget about the laws and profound mysteries you have grasped to adopt a new perspective on this array diagram." The red-undergarment child suggested, "These two systems might be similar in some ways, but they aren't totally identical."
Xue Ying was enlightened.
He had tunneled down a rabbit hole and wanted to analyze it thoroughly.
"Alright. I'll attempt again." Xue Ying was not in a rush to guide the Primal Chaos Void energy over. Instead, he concentrated with rapt attention on that array diagram in his true deity heart which was formed from many grayish silk strands.
He forced himself to forget about the laws and profound mysteries.
The Dao of Mirage, the Dao of Slaughter… everything was thrown to the back of his mind!
He took a general viewpoint on perceiving this diagram. Gradually, Xue Ying began to discover the 'beauty' of this diagram. Despite throwing everything related to the laws and profound mysteries to the back of his mind, the strength of his deity heart remained the same. His comprehension ability sufficed, and naturally, he could perceive the beauty in this array diagram. He then started to ponder about this sort of 'beauty'.
Slowly…
Xue Ying discovered that it was similar in many ways to the law of the world, the Dao of Mirage, and the Dao of Slaughter.
When one trained deep in any of the systems, there were many points of similarities. This was also why the Ancestor Mother Religion protectors could rapidly attain the stage four World Deity realm just shortly after interacting with the laws and profound mysteries. As for Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master and Bloody Ruler Nile, they cultivated for a longer period and had attained higher attainments in the realm.
Borrowing on the many points of connections, Xue Ying began to understand the diagram. This was after all just the first level of cultivation technique, and it wasn't hard. It was the simplest and most fundamental array diagram of the "Walker's Hidden Secret".
"I understood it!" Xue Ying thoroughly comprehended the diagram. He felt quite joyous over this matter, yet he could not blurt out his excitement.
"You're quite fast to comprehend it in two years?" The red-undergarment child glanced at him from on top of the Black Gourd. He giggled.
"It has been two years already." Xue Ying shook his head. He had no concept of time during cultivation.
He closed his eyes again, concentrating on cultivation.
"Hong!"
Borrowing the array diagram in his deity heart, he immediately guided the energy from the 'Primal Chaos Void' outside the cosmos in. That desolate and cold energy once again tore through the many obstacles to reach Xue Ying. This gray energy enshrouded his body, and this time, Xue Ying was genuinely absorbing this energy for his use.
One could see Xue Ying's entire figure turning into an array diagram. The gray energy was guided in. The cold it contained, the corrosive and the destructive characteristics remained unyielding as they ate away Xue Ying's body.
"Chi chi chi~"
His body relied on the array diagram to absorb and transform this energy. At the same time, he was suffering from corrosion and destruction albeit the degree of damage was quite light. Thus, his body was able to rapidly recover from it. It was continuously recovering, destroying, recovering, destroying… and his body became stronger as it was tempered under the energy.
"Too chaotic." Xue Ying felt terrified.
This gray energy that bypassed through many obstacles seemed pure, but in reality, it contained many different kinds of mixed destructive forces.
He could still absorb some energy, but those with a great destructive characteristic could not be absorbed. He could only refine them using the array diagram, or to expel them out of his body. Some had even turned into a sharp edge under the gradual refinement of the array diagram! This sharp edge which was condensed after the purification from the destructive energy was also an offensive method the 'Voidwalker' had. It was called 'Termination Energy'.
The Termination Energy had been purified and condensed from the most extreme destructive energy within the Primal Chaos Void. Its offensive and destructive power was tremendous. Imbuing a normal weapon with this energy, it could greatly improve the threat of the weapon. Even if he did not use a weapon, the Termination Energy alone could form a weapon that sufficed.
…
Another two months passed.
Xue Ying let out a long breath. There was some rainbow light being puffed out from his mouth. This light had a frightening power since it was energy that could not be refined by the "Walker's Hidden Secret". They could only be expelled.
"I've finally succeeded." Xue Ying revealed a grin. The "Walker's Hidden Secret" and the system of laws and profound mysteries had a single difference. He had just comprehended the first level, yet he still had to slowly cultivate in it. There was a gradual process in which his body needed to transform. It was relatively fast with the first level-he took just two months to do so before his body was cultivated thoroughly.
In the future, as he became more powerful, the process of absorbing the energy might take a more extended period.
The Voidwalker lineage…
Had very few techniques!
What it was famous for was for its fleeing methods. This lineage relied on the Primal Chaos Void energy to cultivate. The Primal Chaos Void was akin to their homes, and thus, their fleeing ways were innately formidable!
Another plus point about this lineage was a robust body. Just by succeeding in cultivating this technique, Xue Ying's body became much stronger than the Myriad Devil True Body! Clearly, the creator of the Voidwalker was on a higher level than Ancestor Devil.
Finally, the Voidwalker had the 'Termination Energy' which was purified from the extreme destructive energy inherent in the Primal Chaos Void energy.
And that was all they had! These three techniques!
The Voidwalker did not have any other methods, but every single one of the three was tyrannical. Besides, they could always cultivate in other systems as they visited many different cosmos. Naturally, they would become someone outstanding.
"Hahaha, Dong Bo Xue Ying, congratulations for your success. You can receive the full inheritance now." The red-undergarment child suddenly shouted, "Be careful. It's about to begin!"
"Be careful?" Xue Ying was startled.
"Hong long~"
Closely following that, he felt the entire gray land underneath his feet vibrating.
Xue Ying was frightened by that. He hurriedly grabbed hold of the Black Gourd and rapidly flew upwards to evade what was to come. The entire boundless gray land was vibrating, though as Xue Ying quickly retreated by adopting the 'Void Evasive Maneuver', he turned around after thinking that he had withdrawn far enough only to fall into a daze.
Right in front of him, there was an immense gray humanoid being sleeping in the void. Currently, it was gradually getting up. It had opened its eyes. This being had a gargantuan figure that far exceeded any living beings Xue Ying had seen before in his life.
"I was previously on the surface of his body?" Xue Ying could not help but ask.
"Mn." The red-undergarment child nodded as it sat on the Black Gourd Xue Ying was grabbing on.
"Whose body is this?" Xue Ying was surprised.
"Just an incarnation." The red-undergarment child replied.
Xue Ying was watching with slight shock.
The gray humanoid being slowly started standing up. Inspecting its figure closely, it seemed quite similar to the 'silver-haired golden-horned man' he had once seen before. He opened his eyes. That gray eyes of his turned to Xue Ying. He was too big-his gray eyes were bigger than the Sun Star. Such a colossal incarnation brought about an oppressive feeling that induced Xue Ying to hold his breath.
This level of power could destroy an entire cosmos with the flip of his hand.
"This is a small-scaled cosmos space that I opened in your cosmos." The gray humanoid being said, "In a while, after you received the complete inheritance, it will naturally crumble apart."

chapters.title: Chapter 729 - The Only Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 729: The Only Disciple
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
That gray humanoid suddenly turned taciturn. He was staring at Xue Ying, giving him a thorough look.
Having such an enormous being staring at him made Xue Ying feel uneasy.
"I would never have expected that I, Gu Qi, would actually have a disciple." The gray humanoid said, "This feeling of having a disciple is certainly peculiar."
"My name is Gu Qi."
The incomparably large gray humanoid continued, "This is also my first time accepting a disciple, hence I do not know how to go about teaching one. You already have the protective treasure, and soon, you will be receiving the complete version of the"Walker's Hidden Secret". As for your future cultivation, it'll be up to you. However, the cultivation system of your cosmos studies the Laws and Profound Mysteries. At the later stages, your strength will reach a tremendous level. Thus, I suggest you continue cultivating; don't give up your current cultivation system."
Xue Ying obediently nodded.
That's right.
If talking about the art of combat, their system was indeed mighty. However, they were weaker in other aspects, like their physique. They could not compare with that of the Ancestor Mother Religion, much less the 'Voidwalker Lineage'. After cultivating just the first level of the Voidwalker Lineage's "Walker's Hidden Secret", Xue Ying could already feel that his strength had surged greatly, and could even match that of apex protectors. Adding the advantage provided by the Laws and Profound Mysteries, he could definitely fight against the Holy Protectors!
And this was merely the first level! If he were to cultivate the subsequent levels, it would even be possible for him to fight against Rulers as a Paragon!
The Voidwalker cultivation system was indeed complimentary with the system of Laws and Profound Mysteries.
"In the future, as you discover other cultivation systems, you can use them as a reference. If you find something more appropriate, you can simultaneously cultivate in multiple systems." The large humanoid continued its long-winded explanation, "The various cultivation systems were all created by others. However, they all eventually lead to the same destination! Thus, gathering experiences from different systems will be a great aid to you."
"I do not know how to teach a disciple, and can only give you some pointers."
"Oh right, your cosmos is created by that old man Tian Yu. Thus, your world belongs to his sect! Currently, his sect is quite formidable. There are two strong beings, Tian Yu and Lake Heart Island Swordmaster, overseeing the sect. In the future, you can definitely rely on them. It is much better than relying on me, this lone ranger." The colossal humanoid laughed.
Xue Ying understood. This incarnation in front of him should have a link with his true body's memories. Thus, 'Forefather Tian Yu' and 'Lake Heart Island Swordmaster' should be on a similar level.
"Tian Yu's sect is located in the 'Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World'." The gray humanoid continued speaking, "Actually, that old chap Tian Yu is quite concerned over you all. He has left behind some guidance for you. Once you are strong enough, you'll naturally obtain this guidance, and it will point you forward in the Primal Chaos Void towards the distant Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. As for me, my hometown is located in another sacred world."
"I've participated in a great war that involved the entire sacred world. That great war caused the entire sacred world to be fragmented into several pieces. I was heavily injured, and thus fled into the Primal Chaos Void. In that period of time, I felt that I was at death's door, and hence I decided to leave an inheritance. But fortunately, I was able to survive through that period of weakness and keep my life."
"My personality keeps me from settling down in one place, and I drift from places to places. In addition to that, in the previous great war, I formed several blood feuds, and now I'm even more afraid of remaining in a single location."
"Thus, you should not come and seek me! And do not even tell anyone that you are my disciple! The moment this news spreads, your little life will be gone. Those enemies I have aren't any weaker than me."
"If our relationship harms you, and I lose my only disciple, I'll definitely be very sad, and I won't know whether I can bring myself to receive another disciple."
"Also…"
The gray humanoid could not help blurting, "If you truly want to know where I am, find Tian Yu and the Lake Heart Island Swordmaster in the future. You can ask them. They know my whereabouts."
"Alright. I'm done speaking. Brat, prepare to receive my inheritance." The gray humanoid looked at Xue Ying. He still could not help but say a few more sentences, "Right now, you haven't even greeted me as your teacher right? Even though I did not teach you, the "Walker's Hidden Secret"was created by me. I've graced you with the favor of receiving my inheritance, and have even bestowed on you the protection treasure."
Xue Ying felt awkward.
Truth be told, it was because of the previous trial of 'refining the Black Gourd'. If he had not passed the trial, he would not have been qualified to obtain the inheritance. Thus, Xue Ying had never recognized himself as the disciple of this senior! And now, he had come here right after refining the gourd. Thus, he did not have time to adjust his thinking.
No matter what, such a powerful senior, the Voidwalker 'Gu Qi', took him in as his first disciple. He had graced Xue Ying with such kindness, and was also concerned over his safety. Xue Ying was willing to shout out, "Disciple Dong Bo Xue Ying greets Teacher!"
"Mn, you might have a few teachers so far, but I only have you as my only disciple. Remember, keep everything a secret! Don't reveal your identity. Your teacher has a great number of inconveniences and is forced to hide all around the universe." The gray humanoid laughed as he reminded Xue Ying again. Following that, his figure gradually became transparent. On his body, many densely packed silk strands started to appear.
The massive gray humanoid was composed of the many silk strands. In other words, the entire gray humanoid figure was actually an ultra large array diagram! It was so much more complicated than the first level of the"Walker's Hidden Secret"! It was even more mysterious than the Laws of the material realm, the Sun Star, and the Moon Star.
This was left behind by the oldest creator of the Voidwalker Lineage.
Even 'Gu Qi' had only cultivated to the 55th level! Because he was unable to reach the limits, he could not lecture on the Dao. He could only leave behind an incarnation containing a soul strand with the entire "Walker's Hidden Secret" cultivation technique. Only then could he impart this technique!
"Hong~"
The towering gray humanoid was rapidly shrinking, eventually turning into a stream of light that tunneled through the forehead of Xue Ying.
"Weng!"
He could only feel the endless rumbling of his consciousness.
Not just his true body, even his avatar lost consciousness at that moment.
He did not know how much time had passed, but Xue Ying eventually quivered and woke up. He hurriedly looked at his True Deity Heart. His current Deity Heart had the appearance of colored glass. The "Walker's Hidden Secret" had already fused with every single part of his Deity Heart, and he could hardly sense it. When the information was transmitted over, it was only the second level array diagram of the "Walker's Hidden Secret". Naturally, since he had succeeded in cultivating the first level, he could continue with the next level! The"Walker's Hidden Secret" had become one with his soul, and none could snatch it away.
"Mn?" Xue Ying was startled as he looked at the vast world around him. The whole world was gradually crumbling apart. There was just an energy barrier enshrouding him, preventing him from being harmed.
It was like the collapse of a house.
This small-scaled cosmos space was collapsing apart. Many cracks began appearing and spreading. Furthermore, the collapse was getting faster and faster, and eventually, the entire cosmos exploded.
As Xue Ying was protected, he remained uninjured throughout the collapse.
He was surrounded by a starry sky.
'I am within the territory of the Temporal Island.' Xue Ying could use karma to detect his own location.
'Who would have thought that this Voidwalker teacher of mine had participated in a great war, even causing the so-called sacred world to be fragmented. This level is far beyond my current standards.' Xue Ying sighed inwardly. Even though they did not interact for long, Xue Ying had formed a favorable impression towards this teacher of his.
Throughout his cultivation journey, he had only truly accepted the Bloodshed God-Emperor, Sacred Master Crimson Dust and this Voidwalker 'Gu Qi' as his official teachers. Naturally, after becoming a Transcendent, even though Chi Qiu Bai, Gong Yu, and Si Kong Yang gave him some pointers, those pointers were given to a group of Transcendents, and it was unlike formally accepting a teacher.
Amongst the three teachers he had, Bloodshed God-Emperor was unquestionably the closest to him. This Voidwalker Gu Qi was second. Even though they had only interacted for a short period, this great existence, who clearly did not have the experience of teaching a disciple, was quite concerned about his well-being. Instead, it was 'Sacred Master Crimson Dust' whom he was the most estranged with, as by the time Xue Ying entered the Crimson Rock Mountain, Sacred Master Crimson Dust was already dead for a long time.
A teacher-disciple relationship was extremely critical for cultivators!
"No matter what, this teacher is still very concerned of me. Furthermore, I am actually his first disciple. I wonder what background his enemies have, for him to strongly insist that I never reveal our relationship, for fear of implicating me." Xue Ying shook his head. Currently, this matter was beyond his level.
…
Within the vast palace hall of the Ancestor Mother Religion.
The fanged Religious Leader was seated cross-legged by himself. His eyes were closed, and the sound of his heartbeat reverberated throughout the entire hall, causing the hall to vibrate in reaction.
Suddenly-
"Religious Leader, Dong Bo Xue Ying has appeared. He is currently within the territory of the Temporal Island!" A message was transmitted to him.
That heartbeat resounding in the hall disappeared instantly vanished. The fanged Religious Leader opened his eyes. A cold killing intent filled his eyes: "He has finally appeared."

chapters.title: Chapter 730 - Assassination
chapters.content:
Chapter 730: Assassination
Translator: Radiant Translations Editor: Radiant Translations
Within a moment, five Religious Leaders arrived at the fanged Religious Leader's location.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying has appeared." The fanged Religious Leader announced coldly, "He is currently within the territory of the Temporal Island. Thus, our attack must be quick. If we are any slower, the Temporal Island Lord could possibly arrive! If we are talking about time-space travel, the Temporal Island Lord is the most formidable. At the same time, even though Black Gourd attack of Dong Bo Xue Ying might be crude, but its power is immense. The moment he reacts, he could delay for time using the Black Gourd."
"Thus, we must make haste."
"Before the moment he reacts, we must kill him." The fanged Religious Leader said.
"Relax. With the five of us Religious Leaders working together, even if he has his so-called Mirage World or the Myriad Devil True Body, he'll definitely lose his life." A black-armored female Religious Leader coldly said.
"We have long planned for this."
"He'll die in an instant."
The five Religious Leaders were filled with confidence.
With their strength, they could fight evenly against Bloodshed God-Emperor when they worked together. Even though Xue Ying"s survival capabilities were formidable-he could survive even when going up against Rulers-with the five of them working together, they had 100% confidence of killing Xue Ying, based on their analysis of the intelligence provided by Bloody Ruler Nile.
"Let's move out." The fanged Religious Leader said.
"Go."
"Hu."
The five Religious Leaders disappeared.
******
Within the time-space tunnel, Xue Ying was currently flying along at a high speed. Even though he had cultivated the "Walker"s Hidden Secret", allowing his body to be compatible with the Primal Chaos Void and thus be suitable in traveling through the void, that style of travel was too fast, and he would arrive in the Black Fog Sea within moments. If he were to reveal this speed to the world, it would cause shock amongst the Rulers and Religious Leaders.
It was not the right time for him to reveal his ability. He should save all his formidable moves during the crucial moments.
"Mn?" Xue Ying suddenly frowned slightly.
"Hong~"
The surrounding time-space tunnel began to warp.
"Hong!"
A terrifying and undetectable sneak attack came from an exceedingly sublime location. It came from a region beyond his senses.
The attack was insanely quick. Even though Xue Ying"s current life aura was especially powerful, and that the offensive strength of the attack had weakened due to the influence of his life aura, it still penetrated the Xue Ying's True Deity Heart. His True Deity Heart was like colored glass, and contained the complete "Walker"s Hidden Secret". The "Walker"s Hidden Secret" was an outstanding inheritance. Having completely fused with Xue Ying's soul, it was able to provide much protection for his soul.
Previously, when he had suffered the backlash from utilizing the Black Gourd, just the first level of "Walker"s Hidden Secret" was sufficient to dissipate all the black fog in his Deity Heart!
And now, it was the complete "Walker's Hidden Secret" shrouding his Deity Heart. One could say that assassinating a Voidwalker by targeting his soul was practically impossible.
"Hong."
His True Deity Heart merely quivered slightly before dispersing the unseen attack.
Xue Ying looked with shock as the time-space tunnel ahead of him was being completely warped. A sharp saber appeared from within the void, shooting right towards him at a breakneck speed! Furthermore, this saber had green lightning surging across its surface. The lightning contained a genuinely terrifying destructive force that far surpassed the Destructive Lightning that the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master had used. Simultaneously, a strange green fog emerged from the space around him.
The attack came at him too quickly!
According to the original plan, Xue Ying should have lost consciousness after suffering from the "Curse" and should have been completely unable to offer any resistance. However, he was currently fully awake!
Even so, he did not have enough time to bring out the Black Gourd and unplug the cork. The weapon had arrived right before him, and he did not even have time to contemplate on his next action, completely relying on his instincts to survive.
"Hu."
His body suddenly disappeared.
He had entered the Mirage World! Despite entering the Mirage World, his body had become slightly more attuned to the void. This was due to the exquisite control a "Voidwalker" had over the void.
"What? I can"t employ the Void Evasive Maneuver?" Xue Ying was slightly startled. He had originally planned on teleporting a short distance away. But now, he discovered he could not escape through the void.
This was the result of the Ancestor Mother Religion's Religious Leaders suppressing and locking down the surrounding space, to prevent the Temporal Island Lord and the Bloodshed God-Emperor from arriving. Only the Temporal Island Lord", who had grasped the Dao of Time-Space, could possibly teleport into this region. Other Rulers would not be able to do so, even the Bloodshed God-Emperor who had reached eternity with his "Dao of Shadow".
Xue Ying"s Void Evasion originated from the "Primal Chaos Void". Despite being an exceedingly outstanding technique, Xue Ying had only reached the first level of cultivation! His control of the void was still lacking.
"Hong~"
The sharp saber imbued with green lightning hacked into the Mirage World. Despite losing some of its power, the attack still landed on Xue Ying's body!
"Hong long long~" The terrifying power fully impacted against his body. The green fog had also permeated into the Mirage World, completely enshrouding Xue Ying. However, the void-attuned body actually shaved off most of the incoming impact. Those without sufficient power would not be able to harm someone with a Voidwalker body.
Receiving the strike, Xue Ying flew backward at high speed. The black armor on his body was smashed to smithereens, and a vast injury had appeared on his chest. He spurted out a mouthful of fresh blood.
"What!" "What!" "What!"
The five Religious Leaders were stunned.
They had worked together for this attack.
Yet it had merely resulted in a flesh wound?
"Teacher, I am being assassinated by the Ancestor Mother Religion! There should be several Religious Leaders." Xue Ying immediately sent a transmission to his teacher. Before this, it was not that he did not want to send a transmission, but rather, the attack had arrived too quickly. Even now, he did not know how many enemies were present. Flipping his hand, the Black Gourd appeared and he unplugged the cork with indignance.
"Teaming up against me?"
"A group of Religious Leaders is trying to kill me?"
"Die for me!"
Xue Ying grabbed hold of the Black Gourd. "Hong~" The opening of the Black Gourd released many black ripples.
Under Xue Ying's control, the ripples spread in all directions with Xue Ying at the center! Having acknowledged its owner, Xue Ying had an easier time controlling the Black Gourd.
Countless black ripples engulfed a region 50 million kilometers around him.
"Be careful."
"Not good."
The Religious Leaders felt frustrated at this moment. According to their understanding, the Black Gourd's attack was crude and could only be directed in a single direction. Yet at this moment, the ripples were spreading in all directions.
"Quick, quick."
With the help of a Religious Leader who specialized in controlling space, he brought his allies to evade the incoming ripples. Their bodies were stronger than the Holy Protectors, yet they were injured by the black ripples. They did not dare to charge against the black ripples, as the closer they got to the opening of the Black Gourd, the higher the density and the destructive capability of the black ripples!
Conversely, the further they got, the more separated the black ripples became. Consequently, the force of the ripples became weaker.
"What is going on?" The five Religious Leaders were only lightly injured. They could believe their current situation and were at a loss. How could this assassination attempt end up like this?
Had the curse failed?
They merely injured Xue Ying after teaming up together for an attack? Unless this Xue Ying had attained a survival capability comparable to Monarch Hex Cricket?
"Hurry and leave! The Rulers will definitely reach here soon." The five Religious Leaders did not dare to tarry.
…
Xue Ying carried the Black Gourd. The black ripple was fanning out in all directions, causing the surrounding void to disintegrate into particles.
Everything was being destroyed. Nothing could obstruct the power of the ripples.
"Xue Ying."
A voice transmitted over.
"I'll pursue after them first! Those Religious Leaders are truly daring." Bloodshed God-Emperor"s voice contained unbridled fury as it transmitted over to Xue Ying. He did not appear. Instead, he was chasing after the five escaping Religious Leaders.

chapters.title: Chapter 731 - Cosmos Passage
chapters.content:
Chapter 731: Cosmos Passage
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As his teacher, the 'Bloodshed God-Emperor', pursued after those Religious Leaders, Xue Ying heaved a sigh of relief. The drizzles of ripple pouring out from the Black Gourd stopped too. He then plugged the cork back on it and keep the gourd.
'Such a close shave. A group of Religious Leaders came after me this time. It's fortunate that I've just cultivated the "Walker's Hidden Secret", or I would have died in a single move.' Xue Ying stared at his chest. His injury was already healing. As for the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor, he simply shook his head. 'The Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor is becoming less and less useful. After all, what I received back then was merely the soldier-ranked technique.'
With his combat power, he might be able to obtain the captain-ranked technique if he decided to return to the Destruction Eden again.
But Xue Ying no longer cared! After cultivating the "Walker's Hidden Secret", his body was even stronger than the Myriad Devil True Body. The toughness of his skin was not inferior to the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor! Xue Ying believed that after cultivating the "Walker's Hidden Secret" to the fifth, sixth or even higher levels, the Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body armor would be entirely useless.
'Hu.'
His body had become slightly attuned to the void, and it gave off the feeling of translucence.
Xue Ying nodded inwardly. This was a survival technique which the Voidwalker lineage had. By cultivating it to a deeper level, the enemies would be unable to strike him, as they would only feel their weapons piercing the void and not Xue Ying's body.
It's a pity that the first level was still too weak. If he had only relied on the Voidwalker lineage when going up against the five Religious Leaders, he would definitely have died. Fortunately, he reached the peak in the 'Dao of Mirage'. Within the Mirage World, the enemy's attacks would become much weaker, even if they could permeate into the Mirage. By the time the attacks landed on his body, their impact had already diminished greatly. This was the brilliance in utilizing the 'Laws and Profound Mysteries'.
Even 'Gu Qi' had said that this system of comprehending the Laws and Profound Mysteries could allow the user to become extremely powerful in the later stages!
'Hong~'
Suddenly, a frightening ripple faintly spread over from afar.
Xue Ying turned over abruptly: 'Is teacher fighting against those Religious Leaders?'
'Xiu!'
He held onto the Black Gourd as he rushing over stealthily. He did not dare to travel too quickly. Instead, he gradually inched closer. It was impossible for him to intervene in a battle of this level! The reason why he dared to get close was due to his survival capabilities and the Black Gourd, and it might even be possible for him to provide assistance.
'Hong~'
Unseen ripples swept out in all directions.
Many desolate planets trembled before being crushed into nothingness. There was even a planet which contained many mortals and Transcendents living on it, and the strongest beings were merely Demigod Transcendents. The planets contained squeaking little children, old men enjoying their later years, young men who were filled with fighting spirit, and couples who were in love with each other. There were also cultivators who adventured all around the world…
They did not know that a huge calamity had arrived.
'Weng.' A strand of aftershocks swept over from the exchange between Bloodshed God-Emperor and the five Religious Leaders. Despite traveling over a large distance, the aftershocks could still instantly eradicate stage two World Deities, much less the countless lives on this planet.
'Stop.'
Xue Ying suddenly appeared in the starry sky by the planet. His eyes turned towards that unseen aftershock. 'Hong~' Using his willpower, he warped the starry sky and easily dissipated the incoming shockwave. After all, it was a mere aftershock that had spread far and wide. As he was now, Xue Ying could barely wrestle against Rulers. He had even survived the assassination attempt from the five Religious Leaders.
'The exchange has created a huge disturbance.' Xue Ying thought.
'Xue Ying, come over.' A voice sounded.
Xue Ying teleported and rushed over. He was already very close to the battlefield.
The entire void was filled with particle streams. And now, these particle streams were gradually becoming gentler. The starry sky was also regaining its usual appearance. The only difference was that the surroundings no longer contained any impurities, dust or planets. The Bloodshed God-Emperor stood there, garbed in a crimson gown. The air of slaughter he emitted enshrouded the entire void, causing the void to be faintly covered in a blood-colored layer.
Only after seeing Xue Ying being wary of the murderous atmosphere did the Bloodshed God Emperor reacted, retracting his aura.
'Teacher's aura is truly frightening.' Xue Ying muttered inwardly. This was the first time experiencing his teacher's frightening, murderous aura firsthand.
"Not bad. Even after those five Religious Leaders ganged up on you, you are able to survive their attacks." Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled with amazement.
"My combat strength is quite weak-I had to depend on the Black Gourd. However, I am more confident in my ability to survive." Xue Ying said, "It's possible that they have underestimated my abilities."
Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded, "Right. Keep your methods of survival a secret. The fewer people know about it, the better! Only then could you survive, even under such dire predicaments. The moment it is made public, the enemy could set a trap that directly counters your strengths! Even Bamboo Mountain has become a traitor. Now, I would not even trust any of our own people."
Xue Ying nodded in agreement.
The betrayal of the Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master had impacted the cultivators greatly.
Suddenly-
A figure appeared by the side. It was the black-robed, black-haired cold male, 'Temporal Island Lord'. The Temporal Island Lord looked around him. The surrounding scene of the starry sky immediately turned illusory. Scenes from the earlier battle flashed across rapidly, and the Temporal Island Lord stared at the Bloodshed God Emperor: "Bloodshed, the Religious Leaders came to assassinate your disciple? Why did you not tell me since it occurred in my territory?"
"They dared to carry out the assassination in your territory. Naturally, they must have prepared well to counter your specialties." Bloodshed God Emperor mentioned, "And if they had something prepared to deal with you, you might not have been able to save Xue Ying if you had acted alone against the Ancestor Mother Religion."
Temporal Island Lord frowned slightly. He did not respond.
He understood that despite his strength in the Dao of Time-Space, but his weaknesses in other aspects were very clear and apparent.
"You sure have quite a few hidden techniques." Temporal Island Lord turned towards Xue Ying, "For you to survive the assassination attempt by the five Religious Leaders."
"I am slightly capable in survivability." Xue Ying laughed.
"Hahaha… since you could survive the assassination attempt by the five Religious Leaders, it seems no one in our cosmos can triumph against you in a one-on-one battle." Bloodshed God Emperor chuckled.
The Temporal Island Lord turned towards the Bloodshed God Emperor.
Others might not be able to do so, but he believed that the current Bloodshed God Emperor could do so.
He had fought with the Bloodshed God Emperor for so many years, and he was clear that their gap was immense. Furthermore, the Bloodshed God-Emperor had even created the 'Void Twin Extreme Array', achieving an even higher realm. It could be said that he was already half a step through the realm. In the past, the Temporal Island Lord could barely fight against the Bloodshed God-Emperor by relying on his 'Dao of Time-Space'. But now that the other party had reached a higher realm, the Temporal Island Lord was no longer inclined towards pitting himself against the Bloodshed God Emperor. Not just him, even Primal Master and Abyss Primogenitor no longer had the heart to compete with him. They all believed that it was impossible for them to catch up with the Bloodshed God Emperor.
"Mn?" Temporal Island Lord frowned as he looked afar.
"What happened?" Bloodshed God Emperor asked.
"You might be outstanding in other aspects, but when comparing the attainments in time-space, I am the best." Temporal Island Lord coldly commented. He took a step before arriving in another area. Bloodshed God Emperor and Xue Ying rushed over too.
Temporal Island Lord looked at this piece of starry sky. He frowned before waving his hand-
'Rip!'
The starry sky in front was torn apart. Immediately after, with a 'bang', the space became fractured and a pitch black circular hole was revealed. This circular hole was about 100 meters in diameter and led to an unknown place. There was even some grayish fog rolling around it.
"Cosmos passage?" Bloodshed God Emperor was startled.
"After that battle, the surrounding space should have remained empty and peaceful. But I had a feeling that something was amiss. Indeed, that's the case. There is a cosmos passage here." Temporal Island Lord coldly chuckled.

chapters.title: Chapter 732 - Before the Storm (End of Volume 22)
chapters.content:
Chapter 732: Before the Storm (End of Volume 22)
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Temporal Island Lord looked at the pitch-black circular hole in the midst of the starry sky in front of him. He then added, "It might be because your battle with the five Religious Leaders produced a disturbance so great that it created this time-space tunnel. It could also be possible that this time-space tunnel was concealed here all along."
"It seems like a small-scaled cosmos passage." Bloodshed God-Emperor extended his right hand, causing it to stretch in through the passage.
As his right hand entered the passage, the surrounding faint gray fog began trembling. An unseen power was repelling him.
"It is as I expected. Transcended True Gods aren't able to enter." Bloodshed God-Emperor said. He then looked at the confused Xue Ying by his side and laughed, "The stronger the cultivator, the greater the stress placed on the cosmos passage! From my understanding, the scale of cosmos passages can be classified into three categories. The lowest level passages are just like this - to be able to travel through this passage unhindered, the traveler must not have transcended and must still be within the River of Time, and be protected by the cosmos. As for the second level, the ordinary True Gods and Paragons can enter! The third level is the highest level, and even Rulers can enter."
"And this passage in front of us is of the lowest level." Bloodshed God-Emperor shook his head, "It's not worth much to us. If it was a large-scale cosmos passage, it would be more precious because we would have a chance to visit another cosmos, and that is a rare opportunity. Monarch Green, Purgatory Ruler and I have been to other cosmos, and all of us had broken through in the end."
Xue Ying nodded.
His Senior Disciple Brother Monarch Green was said to have broken through and become a Ruler after visiting another cosmos. Furthermore, according to the investigation carried out by the treasure spirit of the Black Gourd, in terms of power, he should be ranked third within the Cultivator Cosmos!
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, you've yet to transcend, maybe you could try it out." Temporal Island Lord suggested from the side.
"Right." Bloodshed God-Emperor agreed, "You can try your luck."
"But the war with the Ancestor Mother Religion…" Xue Ying could not help but ask.
Temporal Island Lord shook his head: "You don't have to participate in this war. With your current strength, you might just lose your life in a large-scale battle. At that time, it wouldn't just be an assassination attempt from a few Religious Leaders, but rather, it would the last struggle of the entire clan of Ancestor Mother Religion!"
Bloodshed God Emperor then added, "You can join us if you want. However, you would have to follow my orders. Xue Ying's Black Gourd could prove helpful."
Temporal Island Lord was stunned. He glanced at Bloodshed God Emperor before pursing his lips: "Alright. He is your disciple. You make the decision."
Saying that, the Temporal Island Lord immediately disappeared.
Bloodshed God Emperor looked at Xue Ying and laughed, "If you want to join the war against the Religious Leaders, you still have a long way to go. Every single Ruler has grasped an eternal Dao. Their Daos have turned into Laws, forming domains. Their words represent the Law itself. The battle with them is unlike that with the Paragons. This time, you should have personally experienced it after this assassination attempt. The Religious Leaders are much cruder than us Rulers in battling, however."
"I understand." Xue Ying answered solemnly.
That's right.
Previously, when he was ambushed, by the time he had discovered the enemies' presence, their weapons had already reached him. Throughout the entire chain of events, he had never found the actual bodies of the other party! Naturally, it was because the other party worked together to assassinate him. But this highlighted the gap in power! The other party had deliberately attempted to assassinate him, yet he could not discover them even with his 'Mirage World'.
'I should not be arrogant. With my current combat power, I might be able to wrestle with the Rulers by relying on the Black Gourd. But I would still lose! There's no need to even think about what would happen, fighting in a race war.' Xue Ying was roused inwardly.
"I'll send you away first to prevent the Ancestor Mother Religion from carrying out these shameless assassinations." Bloodshed God-Emperor said before constructing an array in their surroundings. The array enveloped and hid the cosmos passage: "This is the array for entry and exit! If the Ancestor Mother Religion comes, I'll definitely discover them."
Xue Ying received the method to enter and leave the array via his communication treasure.
Following which, Bloodshed God-Emperor brought Xue Ying and teleported through time-space. He first sent Xue Ying back to the Black Fog Sea before returning to the Bloodshed God Palace.
…
Within the vast hall of the Ancestor Mother Religion.
The fanged Religious Leader sat down cross-legged looking at the five Religious Leaders who appeared. All five of them were injured, with the black-armored female Religious Leader having the heaviest injuries-there was a huge hole in her abdomen that penetrated through her entire body. But it was currently recovering.
"You guys are in such a sorry situation?" The fanged Religious Leader looked at them.
"We met the Bloodshed God-Emperor. He suddenly ambushed us, causing us to suffer."
"And the Black Gourd?"
"Dong Bo Xue Ying is only injured despite being ambushed by the five of us. He then deployed the Black Gourd immediately, forcing the five of us back. We failed to assassinate him, and it was almost certain that we couldn't kill him in that short period. We were also worried that the Bloodshed God-Emperor and other Rulers might arrive. Thus, we had to retreat, but the Bloodshed God-Emperor still caught up to us."
The Religious Leaders were sullen.
They could not even kill a little brat who was only at the Opening realm, despite working together.
The fanged Religious Leader turned silent. He did not continue his questioning.
Since they failed, it meant that Xue Ying's survival capabilities were much more outstanding than stated in the intelligence report.
"Go and have a rest." The fanged Religious Leader indifferently said, "This time, there are two reasons for us to deal against Dong Bo Xue Ying. One, it is to vent our anger. Two, for the sake of the Black Gourd! The Black Gourd might be useful, but it is fine even if we don't obtain it. The Ancestor Mother Religion's plot has already been uncovered by them, so there isn't any need for us to remain hidden. Make use of the time to gather all the resources that we can, before the Void Twin Extreme Array of Bloodshed God-Emperor discovers us, so that we can be amply prepared for the final battle!"
"Mn." The five Religious Leaders nodded.
Previously, they were afraid of revealing their actions. But now? Since both races had entered a conflict, there was naturally no need to hide their collection of resources!
"We must do our best to fight for our lives. Our cosmos has accumulated an endless amount of resource; if all of us were to fight to the death, we definitely have a chance of turning this around. After killing all the Rulers, we will win the war. We will then construct the Ancestor Mother Altar… and this cosmos will belong to us." The fanged Religious Leader's eyes were burning with a mad passion.
'Now, we're just left with the final battle.' The five Religious Leaders were also surging with fighting spirit.
******
Within the courtyard of the wooden house in the Bloodshed God Palace.
Primal Master, Abyss Primogenitor and Bloodshed God Emperor were all present.
"The Ancestor Mother Religion's activities are getting increasingly ruthless. They do not even care about hiding anymore." Primal Master frowned and said in a solemn tone, "In the past, they had been quietly collecting resources. But from now on, they would be taking them wantonly."
"The Bloodshed Tavern and Temporal God Palace are currently collecting the resources now. Furthermore, if any supervisor emissary discovers someone collecting resources in large amounts, they will immediately investigate that person. If he or she is a traitor, they will capture them, dead or alive." Bloodshed God-Emperor said emotionlessly.
Abyss Primogenitor forcefully asked, "Bloodshed, your avatar technique has both been learned by Primal and me. Who do you plan on imparting it next?"
Bloodshed God-Emperor was contemplating over it. He said, "I'll have to think through this. Honestly speaking, ever since Bamboo Mountain turned traitor amongst the Paragons, I became even more worried that there would be Rulers betraying us too. The two of you are the oldest Rulers. It is impossible for you two to be traitors since Ancestor Mother Religion hasn't invaded our cosmos. However, I can't be so certain of the other Rulers."
"Mn." Abyss Primogenitor nodded, "From the cultivation period, on our side of the Dark Abyss, I started the earliest. Next is Purgatory Ruler. Purgatory Ruler is someone I am very close to. I have even watched him grow through his journey, so I trust him very much. And after that is Bloody Ruler Nile. Ruler Nile is the youngest, and is someone you are closest with, Bloodshed."
"It is impossible for Pang Yi to be a traitor too. He is one of the Deity world's Fierce Five, and his cultivation time is quite close to mine." Primal Master said, "Empress Qian He should be clean. I still trust Temporal Island Lord too. Myriad God Palace Master has also cultivated from quite an early period. Instead, it is Monarch Green… this eldest disciple of yours that seems to have a huge change in character. However, it is highly improbable for him to be a traitor, as he could have easily helped the Ancestor Mother Religion obtain the Primal Chaos Flying Ship when he was a Paragon."
"Hearing this, it seems that none are suspicious?" Abyss Primogenitor asked.
"How many people from the Ancestor Mother Religion could reincarnate and reach the Ruler realm? That is an incredibly difficult feat." Bloodshed God Emperor said, "There are two possibilities. One, there are no traitors amongst us. Two, if there is, then it must be Bloody Ruler Nile! As for Monarch Green, I trust him very much! And I have long transmitted the avatar method over to him."
"You suspect Ruler Nile?"
Primal and Abyss Primogenitor felt startled.
"Right." Bloodshed God Emperor nodded. He then chuckled, "Actually, having a traitor is a good thing. We can make use of the traitor to give the Ancestor Mother Religion a huge setback."
The final battle was about to begin, but the Cultivators were all confident.
The Primal Chaos Flying Ship was a trump card they had. Bloodshed God-Emperor's avatar technique was similarly a trump card. By relying on the technique, they could borrow on Bloodshed God-Emperor's 'Cosmos Stone Heart' to cultivate. Each Ruler could then have a total of three bodies! It would drastically increase the overall combat force of the Rulers.
…
The Ancestor Mother Religion and Cultivators were all preparing for the final battle. The moment it began, that would be a battle that determined the fate of the entire cosmos.
And currently, Xue Ying had returned to the Black Fog Sea to accompany his wife.
Jing Qiu walked with her husband by the lake: 'It is a rare opportunity for you to visit another cosmos. Furthermore, you have mentioned that it is best if you improve your combat power before the final battle with the Ancestor Mother Religion begins.'
"This is a small-scaled cosmos passage. I should enter first and scout the place out. By then, I'll bring you in." Xue Ying said.
"Bring Qing Yao and Yu'er along with us too." Jing Qiu added.
"Mn, we'll go together."
Xue Ying laughed. He would never forget his family when coming across such an opportunity.
"Alright. I'll make my move first. It is best if we don't waste any time from now on." Xue Ying stated.
"Take care of yourself." Jing Qiu reminded him.
"Rest assured."
Xue Ying smiled before flying off into the sky. He tore through the time-space tunnel and left the place.
However, Xue Ying was not in a rush to leave. Instead, he returned to the material realm Xia Clan world and left all the important treasures behind, like the 'Black Gourd', the 'Starting Ground talisman' and 'Blood Serpent Spear'. He planned to bring only some commonly used items. Even the weapon he brought was the deep violet spear which he got from the protectors of Ancestor Mother Religion. Even though it could not compare with the Blood Serpent Spear, it was sharp and firm enough.
He dared not bring highly valuable items; after all, there were too many unknown variables in the other cosmos. He was afraid of dying there and losing all the important items he had.
'Hu~'
The starry sky was quiet.
Xue Ying turned into a stream of light. He had easily passed through the array that the Bloodshed God-Emperor had set. Soon after, he arrived at the pitch-black cosmos passage. The gray fog was still rolling around the entrance.
'Let's have a look.' Xue Ying was filled with expectations. Following that, he flew into the cosmos passage.

chapters.title: Chapter 733 - First Visit
chapters.content:
Chapter 733: First Visit
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The pitch-black hole with a diameter of 100 meters had a gray fog rolling within. As Xue Ying flew in, he felt a warm energy embracing him. He understood in his heart, 'Is this the operating law of the cosmos?'
He had yet to transcend.
He was still an existence within the River of Time. The operating law of the cosmos would definitely protect him.
"Xiu."
Flying within the hole, everything ahead was pitch black. There was the occasional distorted bright light. The time-space warping was unbearable for Xue Ying-his senses of the flow of time were being distorted as he traveled through the cosmos passage. A moment seemed very long to him, and a long time might seem fleeting. As he flew with this strange distorted feeling, Xue Ying soon saw the light at the end of the passage. Furthermore, an intangible energy shrouded over him.
A different Cultivator Cosmos contained a different set of operating laws!
'Mn?' Xue Ying was slightly startled.
Before he had left, his teacher, the Bloodshed God Emperor, had transmitted a set of intelligence reports to him, containing some simple information regarding entering another cosmos.
'Usually, one will experience some form of rejection after entering another cosmos! Additionally, one would not be able to absorb the World Energy. In certain cosmoses, the severity of the rejection against outsiders is higher-it would even direct the existences in the cosmos to eliminate the outsider! According to "Gu Qian Luo", it seems the Ancestor Mother Religion Cosmos is one of the more xenophobic ones. The moment they conquer our cosmos, we will be unable to absorb any energy. We would even be unable to hide, and would be constantly surrounded by those of the Ancestor Mother Religion!'
'According to the intelligence I've collected, extremely xenophobic cosmoses are rarer. Most would simply reject the outsiders and prevent them from absorbing the World Energy. According to rumors, there are even some cosmoses which do not reject outsiders."
Bloodshed God Emperor's intelligence report did not contain much detailed information. Regardless, Xue Ying committed it to his memory.
'This cosmos?'
He just felt the operating laws of another cosmos enveloping around him. Xue Ying could even feel an unseen encompassing feeling! He was not rejected by the cosmos!
'I've even brought along many Deity crystals in fear of being unable to absorb the World Energy.' Xue Ying sighed, 'It seems that this cosmos which I've entered isn't a xenophobic one!'
Even if he could not absorb the World Energy, Xue Ying was not worried. Other than his large stash of Deity Crystals, he could mainly rely on the "Walker's Hidden Secret" and his comprehension of Laws and Profound Mysteries. Cultivating the "Walker's Hidden Secret"relied on directing and absorbing Primal Chaos Void Energy. Regardless of the cosmos he was in, he could similarly direct Primal Chaos Void Energy.
After all, the energy did not originate from within a cosmos.
'Hu.'
Xue Ying flew out of the pitch-black hole. This was his first time entering another cosmos, and thus, he had restrained his aura. He was currently hiding in the Mirage World too.
If discussing the abilities to conceal one's aura, the Voidwalkers were exceptionally good at it. They could hide it to the extent that they would practically erase their presence and fade into the void! It was even more formidable than the robe refined by the Bloodshed God Emperor.
'There are other beings in this cosmos.' Xue Ying immediately discovered other lifeforms.
…
Under the starry sky.
There was a single desolate planet. A palace was currently constructed upright in a deserted desert. Within the palace, there was a muscular man drinking and eating alone. His gaze was fixed on the pitch-black hole 100 meters wide, slightly hidden in the distant starry sky. The muscular man was covered in black scales, and thorns protruded from his elbows and knees.
His face was crimson, and the top of his head was similarly covered in black scales. There was a maidservant with a long tail serving him by the side. Currently, he was just enjoying his meals and drinks while observing the distant cosmos passage.
'This cosmos passage has just appeared not long ago. It is a small-scaled cosmos passage, and there should be someone coming from another cosmos.' The black-scaled muscular man muttered, "Unless, the other entrance on the other cosmos did not appear?"
"I'll wait a while longer."
"Since this cosmos passage appeared within my territory and has been discovered by me, it is considered my fortune. If this outsider is slightly special, I might be able to sell it at a high price." The black-scaled muscular man was very patient as he waited silently.
…
'Mn?'
In the Mirage World, Xue Ying looked towards that lone planet. There was a palace on the planet that seemed hidden, but it could not be concealed from the 'Mirage World'! Other than the servants who were around the Deity and World Deity realm, the strongest should be that single True God existence.
'True God?' Xue Ying frowned slightly.
He should not have discovered Xue Ying! He should be weaker in the realm as compared to Xue Ying.
'I wonder how is he in the aspect of Laws and Profound mysteries, and if he could resist my illusory realm." Xue Ying did not dare to act. After all, this was another cosmos, and he was an outsider! Under such an unknown situation, it was better for him not to reveal his methods.
'What!'
Xue Ying was suddenly astonished.
He could not care about that True God who was waiting for his prey. At this moment, a huge wave had formed in the heart of Xue Ying-he was incomparably shocked!
'This, this, this…' Xue Ying was tongue-tied, 'The time flow of this cosmos…'
He could sense his own true body via his soul.
His true body which was located in his original cosmos, and this current body which was in another cosmos… he was comparing the difference in time flow.
"3566 times?" Xue Ying muttered.
'A single day in my hometown cosmos is 10 years in this place?' Xue Ying could not believe it. How could the difference in time flow between the two cosmoses be so extreme?
"Treasure spirit, treasure spirit."
The white-robed true body of Xue Ying which was located in his hometown asked the Black Gourd.
"Treasure spirit, could the time flow differ so much between two cosmoses?" Xue Ying asked.
The Black Gourd treasure spirit had followed by the Voidwalker Gu Qi for some time, and its experience was naturally greater: "There could be a very exaggerated difference between two cosmoses. Sometimes, the operating laws might even be directly opposite of each other. As for the time flow… since all cosmos exist in the Primal Chaos Void, they are all influenced by the Primal Chaos Void. Thus, most time flows would usually not have a large difference. The time flow on your original cosmos is considered one of the more ordinary ones! As for other cosmoses, the difference in their time flow would usually be less than ten times as compared to your original cosmos. Some are slower and some faster."
"Less than ten times? But, but this cosmos which I entered has a time flow 3,566 times faster than that in my hometown cosmos!"
"What? Over 3,000 times? This…"
"Why?" Xue Ying carried on asking.
"Some cosmoses emerged naturally in the Primal Chaos Void, and some are created by terrifying existences! Those who could construct cosmoses are usually at the level of Forefather Tian Yu or Voidwalker Gu Qi." The Black Gourd treasure spirit explained, "If the cosmos was created by someone, then how the cosmos looks like and how it works would be governed by the creator! But to maintain the time flow of a cosmos at such terrifying speed is truly an unfathomable and troublesome matter."
The Black Gourd treasure spirit continued, "Regardless, we can be certain that this cosmos you entered should have been created by an ancient existence! The accelerated time flow must also have been deliberately set by him."
"I understand." Xue Ying muttered.
…
After understanding the circumstances from the treasure spirit, Xue Ying became more vigilant. An existence on the level of Forefather Tian Yu and Gu Qi-someone who could create a cosmos and was willing to accelerate and maintain time at such a high speed meant that this cosmos was exceedingly extraordinary! He had better carefully maintained a low profile.
Naturally, knowing that the time flow difference was over 3,000 times made him thrilled. Just this accelerated time flow alone made his trip worthwhile! He could rely on this time difference to properly cultivate. The war with the Ancestor Mother Religion had progressed very quickly. The accelerated time flow would allow him to have a significant increase in strength.
'I'll hurry up and find someone weak, and control him using my illusory realm to get an approximate understanding of this cosmos.'
'Sou.'
Xue Ying teleported and vanished.
And the black-scaled muscular man remained in wait for his prey. Unbeknownst to him, Xue Ying was long gone.

chapters.title: Chapter 734 - Bloodline Cultivation System
chapters.content:
Chapter 734: Bloodline Cultivation System
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying repeatedly teleported through the void, discovering several planets with life forms along the way. He had even viewed the memories of a Deity! At his level, he would not harm the other party even if they were a Deity. The other party would also be unable to detect his surveillance.
"Sou."
Xue Ying appeared in the starry sky, glancing at a humongous planet in the distance.
"What is happening in this cosmos?" Xue Ying felt even more bewildered as he perused various memories.
"This planet has an existence at approximately the stage three World Deity realm. He is stronger than others, and should know more about this cosmos." Xue Ying stared at the huge planet ahead of him. This planet was about 500,000 kilometers in diameter, and it was enormous relative to the countless other planets in the cosmos. A maze of palaces was laid out on the planet's surface, and many people from this cosmos were living on the planet.
"More than 10,000 people living on this world." Xue Ying shook his head inwardly.
Earlier, he had come across many planets with life. However, life was quite scarce on those planets, with at most a few hundred inhabitants on one planet, and some planets having as few as a dozen inhabitants.
The planet in front of him was considerably huge, and there was a stage three World Deity living on it. There were also more than 10,000 people living on the planet!
However, there was one notable aspect of this planet…
Even newly-born infants were Transcendents!
