"Hu." Xue Ying stealthily entered this planet.
…
On the planet's surface, there was a group of children wearing underpants flying at high speed.
They were playing about in midair, and peals of laughter rang out occasionally.
"Peng."One of the children sent another flying over five kilometers away with a single kick while shouting out, "Haha, have you not eaten your fill? Your strength is lacking!"
Another child took this opportunity to carry out a sneak attack on the first child.
The few children were entangled together, all of them moving as fast as lightning. If the Demigods from Xia Clan World were present, they would probably be trampled by these children.
At that juncture-
The strongest expert on this planet-a green-scaled male-was currently chatting with a green-scaled old man. Their appearance was similar-both had green scales, had spikes protruding from their backs, and had golden eyes too.
"Second Brother." The green-scaled old man said with a grave voice, "I'll be dying soon. This time, I've come to ask you to help me take care of several children from my family."
"Little brother, as long as you're still alive, it is entirely possible for your bloodline to awaken." The green-scaled male said, "Of all our siblings, only you and I are left. Don't give up just yet."
"I know, but we can't deny my age…"
Just as he spoke, an unseen illusory realm suddenly descended.
Both the green-scaled male and the old man immediately fell into a deep sleep, and a black-robed teenager walked over. That was Xue Ying. Walking up to the green-scaled male, he asked: "Tell me who the strongest existence of this cosmos is! Don't say his name lest he senses it."
"The strongest existences are the three Great Emperors!" The green-scaled male murmured as if he was sleep-talking.
"The Great Emperors?" Xue Ying's eyes brightened. Previously, he had sieved through the memories of a little Deity, and his understanding of the True Gods was just bits and pieces.
"Are the Great Emperors True Gods?" Xue Ying asked. He was more concerned about the peak power on this cosmos-was it within the realm of True Gods?
"The Great Emperors are far beyond the True Gods!" The green-scaled male continued.
Xue Ying felt his heart twitching-he felt an unseen pressure pressing down on him. Despite this, he continued his questioning.
******
In another region of this cosmos, a beautiful and peaceful planet hung in the starry sky. On the planet, a figure rushed into the sky. It was a green-scaled male with a grand aura. Although he was wearing a simple silver armor, the scales on his bare arms were etched with mystical patterns. His eyes were faintly emitting a gold light.
"Why is my descendant behaving so strangely?" This silver-armored male waved his hand, and a sleek warship appeared beside him. He took a step and entered the warship.
"Si la~"
The warship tore open a time-space tunnel and charged through.
…
At this moment, Xue Ying was still gathering intelligence from them. The more he understood, the more startled he became. This stage three World Deity clearly had some understanding of the entire cosmos.
"So, this is the situation here."
Xue Ying completely understood now.
The living beings in this cosmos increased their strength by awakening their bloodline.
It was quite similar to the 'Primordial Bloodline Awakening' of the Xia Clan World. After a long period of time and many generations, even the ordinary life forms of this cosmos had a bloodline of the highest level! Thus, all of them had the potential to awaken a very high-level bloodline. If a father was extremely strong, it would be very likely for his offspring to still have a concentrated bloodline. However, the bloodline strength would definitely weaken with each subsequent generation.
An ultra-strong expert would form an ultra ranked clan!
This cosmos was primarily controlled by clans.
The strongest were the three Great Emperor-ranked clans!
Secondary were the King-ranked clans!
And after that were the True God clans! Beneath that? They were not worth mentioning.
The three Great Emperor-ranked clans were precisely because they were each headed by a Great Emperor! And the Great Emperors were a realm beyond the Rulers. They had truly broken through the category of True Gods, attaining an even higher level. From the Voidwalker inheritance Xue Ying received, he understood that one level above the True Gods… was the Void Gods! This was also a publicly-acknowledged term, as those who reached this realm could enter the Primal Chaos Void with their fleshy body.
Three Great Void Gods!
The Rulers were the King-ranked existences, and there seemed to be quite a few of them.
True God Clans… had True Gods. There should be more than 10,000 True Gods.
"Oh wow."
"This cosmos seems to be ten to a hundred times stronger than our cosmos?" Xue Ying was stunned. His cosmos did not have a single Void God, yet this cosmos had three!
They rarely cultivated. Instead, they loved fighting!
It was easier for their bloodline to awaken during battle. Every single bloodline awakening would greatly improve their combat power.
Xue Ying passed on the information to the Black Gourd's treasure spirit and asked for its opinion.
"Bloodline cultivation system?"
The treasure spirit was startled, "A cosmos with such a system has a huge background. It wouldn't be good to offend them."
"Oh?" Xue Ying was puzzled.
"It is very difficult for bloodlines to awaken." The treasure spirit explained.
Xue Ying nodded. That's right. He had spent quite a lot of effort when he was young to awaken his Primordial Bloodline. The lifeforms of this cosmos primarily consisted of Transcendents. There were even more than 10,000 who had become True Gods but compared to the trillions and trillions of living beings, this was but a small number. One had to know that the Cultivator Cosmos had a few hundred powerful existences.
"However, a bloodline must have an origin." The treasure spirit continued. "This origin has to be exceedingly formidable for there to be hope for future generations to have a bloodline awakening. Just like how your Xia Clan world once had Primordial Beings, which is why the Primordial Bloodlines exist!"
"And for there to be someone whose bloodline has become the foundation for the cultivation system of an entire cosmos, even resulting in the appearance of Void Gods… this origin must definitely be an extremely frightening existence." The treasure spirit said. "I suspect that their primogenitor is the one who created this cosmos."
"Thus, the countless living beings in this cosmos have a very firm background, with their primogenitor backing them! And to maintain a time flow that's accelerated over 3000 times, their primogenitor must have done that in the hopes of producing stronger heirs." The treasure spirit told Xue Ying.
Xue Ying nodded as he listened.
The bloodline cultivation system…
Just like his bloodline, his descendants were more formidable because of it. But it was challenging to create an entire cosmos race, and a huge bloodline cultivation system, with just the bloodline of a single person.
Nonetheless, the 'primogenitor' of this cosmos race had done so!
"In this bloodline cultivation system, breaking through is slightly easier as compared to your system of Laws and Profound mysteries. However, there is a huge flaw in this kind of system-it is very difficult to reach the primogenitor's level." The treasure spirit explained. "But according to my observations, their primogenitor is very frightening! Hence, even if one were to cultivate to a level close to that of their primogenitor, he would already be a formidable individual."

chapters.title: Chapter 735 - Invitation to a Void God Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 735: Invitation to a Void God Clan
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As Xue Ying was gathering intelligence via his illusory realm, a warship had arrived outside this planet.
Within the warship, there was a green-scaled male clad in silver armor watching indifferently at the scene of Xue Ying interrogating the people.
"An outsider? What audacious behavior, he dares to do something like this to my descendants?" The man stared on coldly with his golden eyes. However, he habitually probed the other party's combat power before taking any action.
"Weng!"
An unseen ripple swept over from the warship across the planet.
"What?" The silver-armored, green-scaled male was wearing a chilly expression, but it had spontaneously changed into one of shock. "His soul seems to be at the Paragon realm?"
This warship had been bestowed upon him by the Void God whom he followed. This warship excelled at traveling through time-space, and in investigating the soul aura of other parties. Even though it was not as ridiculously powerful as the Black Gourd treasure spirit, who could even discern the strength of one's soul, the warship could at least enable him to get an approximate gauge of the other party's level!
"I would never have expected to encounter a powerful expert of another race on a random excursion, and he's Paragon to boot." The silver-armored green-scaled male nodded slightly.
"Weng."
Xue Ying, who was looking through the intelligence he had gathered and discussed it with the treasure spirit through his true body in his hometown, felt a faint unseen ripple sweeping across him. Although the ripple was extremely faint, Xue Ying was able to detect it due to his MIrage World and his control over the void.
"Mn?" Xue Ying's expression shifted, and couldn't help but look around. His vision penetrated through the walls of the palace hall, spotting the warship floating in the starry sky. Through the void, he also saw the silver-armored, green-scale male located within the warship.
Both parties stared at each other.
"This brother of another race is truly vigilant; you can actually discover me." A voice sounded. The silver-armored, green-scaled male suddenly appeared within this palace hall, "Based on your appearance, I suppose you're not from any of the eight great cosmoses that my race has vanquished, right?"
Xue Ying gave the other party a look-over.
He had just reviewed all the information he had gathered and understood that this cosmos was based on a bloodline cultivation system, and its inhabitants loved to fight! In this cosmos, "cosmos passages" would frequently form, and the inhabitants of this cosmos would use the passages to enter other cosmoses and conquer them. To vanquish another cosmos, they would have to rely on a cosmos passage of the highest level in order to send Rulers over to fight. The cosmos passage that Xue Ying had used to enter this cosmos would only allow entry to life forms that had yet to transcend, and would not allow this cosmos to send a large army through to conquer Xue Ying's cosmos.
Despite having conquered eight other cosmoses, they were much better than the Ancestor Mother Religion.
They would not mistreat the original native lifeforms of other cosmoses. Instead, they would only send their people over to the other cosmoses to reproduce. They treated the other races like their own.
"I am Dong Bo Xue Ying. This is my first time visiting this cosmos." Xue Ying said.
"I am Shan Dan." The silver-armored, green-scaled male glanced at his two descendants, who were stuck in the illusory realm, "And it can be said that I am the ancestor of those two brats. They are descendants of my bloodline."
Xue Ying felt kind of awkward at that moment.
He had utilized the illusory realm, and the ones he had used it on just so happened to be the other party's descendants.
"Hahaha… you might not be aware of this, but we can always sense the reactions from the descendants of our own bloodline, and we would naturally pay more attention to the stronger ones." The silver-armored green-scaled male explained, "I felt that something was off with my descendant's current state, hence I rushed over."
"I am ashamed. This is my first time here, so pardon my ignorance-that was why I had done this." Xue Ying stated. At the same time, he retracted his illusory realm.
The two bloodline descendants who were sleeping immediately woke up. They stared with shock at the two new people who had appeared in the palace hall, especially when they saw that silver-armored, green-scaled man. They hurriedly stood up, shouting with excitement and fervor: "Patriarch!"
Through their bloodlines, they could tell that the man before them was their clan's ancestor.
The creator of a clan, the strongest one in the clan, was known as the patriarch! The patriarch of this clan was this man, Shan Dan!
"Mn." The silver-armored, green-scaled nodded nonchalantly, "I've come this time to meet a good friend of mine. You guys can just carry on with your stuff."
"Brother Dong, where shall we go?" Shan Dan was quite polite.
"Alright. But Brother Shan, you should call me Dong Bo instead." Xue Ying felt apprehensive. Brother Dong? This was the first time someone had addressed him like that.
"Sou sou."
The two soon arrived at the starry sky outside the planet.
"Hahaha, Dong Bo, you have just arrived at our cosmos and should not know many things. But you should know of the three Great Emperor-ranked clans, right? Those are the clans led by the three great Void Gods." Shan Dan said.
"I've just heard of it." Xue Ying replied.
"The clan I am currently serving is none other than one of the three Great Emperor Clans, the "Jiao Yun Clan"." Shan Dan revealed. "Great Emperor Jiao Yun has three children, and their bloodline is extraordinary and highly concentrated. Furthermore, with their noble status, they are able to obtain a large amount of resources. Many experts are willing to follow his children, and the one I am currently serving is the Third Highness, "Jiao Yun Liu"."
Xue Ying nodded after hearing that. He could deduce this.
In the bloodline cultivation system, the children of Void Gods naturally had a respected status. In addition, due to the father-child relationship, the father would focus on grooming his children, with the resources a Void God has, even the relatively small amount passed to the children would be beyond anyone's imagination.
"You should know that our cosmos loves fighting. The weak will be eaten by the strong! The strong survive and the weak die." Shan Dan said, "The battles are very cruel. Even the Highnesses will fight and slaughter each other. As long as their true bodies are not threatened, even the Void Gods will not intervene."
As Xue Ying listened, he understood that Shan Dan polite's demeanor was just an outward appearance. Even though this cosmos was rather inclusive towards everyone, the battles here were extremely cruel. The strong fed on the weak. The weak were disdained, the strong were respected! The weak might even be sold as slaves, or as gladiators in the arena for bloodsport!
Even the highly respected princes might suffer from great setbacks. Their bloodlines may be extraordinary, but nonetheless, they still had to awaken them through tempering!
"Thus, the Third Highness is also hiring more protectors." Shan Dan mentioned, "Dong Bo, with your Paragon realm combat power, you can definitely join the ranks."
"Are there any benefits?" Xue Ying got straight to the point. "And what do I have to do?"
He came to this cosmos primarily to improve his combat power.
"His Highness can easily provide you with benefits that most people would never be able to obtain." Shan Dan said, "His Highness really values his protectors. As for your duties? Nothing much. His Highness will arrange a residence for you, and you just have to focus on your cultivation… only when a dangerous situation arises would the protectors be required to act and protect His Highness."
"Currently, His Highness is at the Paragon realm. Thus, it is quite rare for him to encounter a dangerous situation." Shan Dan mentioned, "The last time he experienced any trouble was about a billion years ago."
"Is it possible to obtain the cultivation system from other cosmoses?" Xue Ying asked.
"Hahaha, this is the easiest thing to do." Shan Dan laughed out loud, "We have too many of them!"
"Alright. I can try taking up this role." Xue Ying nodded.
"Let's go!"
Shan Dan felt overjoyed.
He clearly understood that of the three princes within the Jiao Yun Clan, the second prince had already become a Ruler! The eldest prince had also obtained many benefits since he was the firstborn. Even though he was still a Paragon, he had a large number of experts following him-much more than the third prince.
Thus, within the Jiao Yun Clan, the third prince was the worst off! He was also in great need of people. Paragons were the most important combat forces he could have.
"Hu~"
Shan Dan brought Xue Ying along and set off on his warship.
…
'Such speed.' Xue Ying felt dumbstruck as he watched the vessel speed along, 'Even though it cannot match up with my Void Evasive Maneuver, it is faster than the time-space travel of most Paragons by more than ten times.'
"Look."
Shan Dan pointed forward enthusiastically. Through the warship, they could see a beige-colored planet in the distance. "Third Highness is currently staying there in a cultivation retreat. Many of his protectors are also temporarily staying on this planet for his protection. I've already mentioned your matter to His Highness, so let's hurry up and pay him a visit."
Upon saying that, he kept his warship, before leading Xue Ying towards the beige planet.

chapters.title: Chapter 736 - The Gift by Third Highness
chapters.content:
Chapter 736: The Gift by Third Highness
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
In a secret underground location, the Third Highness 'Jiao Yun Liu' was currently watching a black plant in front of him. This black plant had three dark-green fruits growing on it.
"Hurry up and ripen, I've been waiting for far too long."
Jiao Yun Liu was quite handsome. A scarlet armor covered his entire body, and there was a crimson scale covering his forehead. His face was quite white and tender, and the aura he emitted was gentle and reserved.
At this moment, a burning desire was present, deep in his eyes, as he stared at the black plant.
"Your Highness, it'll be a long time before the fruits ripen. Let the three of us watch over it, please rest assured." A man with vertical eyes and black skin laughed. He was from a different race, and had originated from a different cosmos. However, he was a trusted aide of the Third Highness. There were two other experts by his side.
"Your Highness, Shan Dan mentioned that he is reaching with a Paragon called Dong Bo Xue Ying, who is from a different race." A protector mentioned from behind Jiao Yun Liu.
"Alright. Let us go."
Jiao Yun Liu nodded, before leading his protectors away. Although this location was deep underground, it was tightly protected by many ancient arrays. Jiao Yun Liu inwardly approved as his gaze swept over those arrays. Even though he knew the fruits were far from ripening, he could not resist coming by frequently to have a look at the fruit. He was afraid that an accident would occur. Only by personally verifying that the fruit was still growing, would he be able to appease his worrying heart.
Even though he lived just on the surface of the planet, and the arrays were under his control, he still came by frequently to inspect the plant.
"When the fruit is ripe, I'll be able to become stronger. I could even awaken my bloodline and step into the Ruler realm, and even take over the position as crown prince." Jiao Yun Liu's eyes contained a strand of sharpness. It appeared for just a brief moment, before it was retracted and deeply concealed.
…
Jiao Yun Liu brought his protectors along and arrived on the surface soon after. Another avatar of Shan Dan took the initiative to lead them over to welcome Xue Ying.
"This should be Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying?" Jiao Yun Liu chuckled.
Xue Ying had just arrived on this planet when he met up with Third Highness, who had brought his protectors over to personally welcome him. Shan Dan's true body reminded Xue Ying from beside him, "This is the Third Highness.""
"Greetings, Third Highness." Xue Ying bowed slightly.
"I've always been looking for more protectors. Brother Dong Bo's arrival is a truly joyful event. However, I would like to ascertain Protector Dong Bo's combat power. How about that?" Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu declared. After all, amongst the Paragons, there were the strong and there were the weak. At the very least, he had to have a rough understanding of his protectors" capabilities.
Xue Ying nodded, "Anytime."
"Then, Protector Cong, come forward and exchange some moves with Protector Dong Bo." Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu ordered.
"Alright."
A dark, tall, and muscular male walked over from another group of protectors. His entire body was metallic, and it seemed that he was not a fleshy-type being.
Xue Ying understood that this man was also from a different race. After all, this cosmos was based on the bloodline cultivation system, and the living beings of this cosmos were naturally fleshy-type beings! Earlier, he had heard from Shan Dan that there were a total of 15 protectors under the Third Highness who were native to this cosmos. Another five were from other cosmoses, and he would be the sixth!
"Let us fight in the void." Protector Cong's voice was deep and resounding. He took a step forward and appeared in the starry sky.
Xue Ying similarly followed into the starry sky.
The two faced each other.
"Begin." Third Highness and the other protectors were looking up from beneath. With their vision, they could see the battle clearly.
"Hou~"
Protector Cong suddenly roared.
A ray of white light shot out from his mouth, almost instantaneously arriving before Xue Ying.
The protectors were silently watching from below. They clearly recognised it as one of the killing move originating from the cultivation system of Protector Cong's original cosmos. This ray would be charged up within his body, and its force was tremendous.Most of them did not dare to receive this hit directly with their bodies. They felt that the one called 'Xue Ying' would have to spend quite some effort to defend against this single move alone. It might even be possible for him to lose.
"Hu."
The light ray passed through Xue Ying's body, disappearing into the distant starry sky.
And Xue Ying remained uninjured!
"Mn?" Protector Cong was shocked. Spectating the battle from below, the Third Highness" eyes lit up. The other protectors were also extremely shocked. He actually dared to face this attack head on, yet he remained uninjured, as if his body was like the void?
"It is my turn." Xue Ying chuckled. The move he displayed was none other than the Mirage World. While it seemed as if he was just standing there, but what actually happened was that he had entered the Mirage World. The other party's attack might be able to affect him within the Mirage World, but his body easily withstood the remnant force. He did not have to move at all.
Xue Ying flipped his hand, and darts appeared in his palm.
These darts were his spoils of war from the protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion. There was a total of 12 darts in this set. It had been made from some exotic bones and were not True God weapons. However, their firmness and sharpness were not inferior than True God weapons. Actually, most of the weapons the Ancestor Mother Religion used were weapons like poles and swords, which were more primitive. Even so, most of them could match up against True God Weapons.
"Xiu."
The moment the dart left his hand, it disappeared.
It travelled through the Mirage World and had appeared in front of the enemy.
"Mn? Where is the dart? Where is it?" Protector Cong's golden eyes were wide open as he searched in all directions. Despite his cautious approach, his expression changed when he finally realized the dart had arrived right before his chest.
"Hong!"
He did not have time to defend himself.
The dart had been thrown using Xue Ying's powerful physical strength, and it also contained the Dao of Slaughter. Having travelled through the Mirage World to arrive at its target, the enemy had no way to defend against this attack.
There was a resounding boom.
A huge hole had been carved out of Protector Cong's chest.
Protector Cong lowered his head in a daze. He then looked back up, only to notice that the dart that had injured him had already vanished.
"I've lost." Protector Cong muttered. He clearly understood that he would be unable to defend himself if the dart was used against him again. "Brother Dong Bo is indeed formidable. I am not ashamed of being inferior!"
"Protector Cong's physique is extraordinary too. This attack of mine has only carved out a hole in your body." Xue Ying mentioned. His original intention was to greatly injure the other party, leaving just a strand of life in him. He had never expected that his attack would barely pierce into his opponent's chest before losing all its power. The other party's body was clearly incredibly tough.
…
Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu was very delighted. "Protector Dong Bo's combat power is extraordinary. But from what I see, Protector Dong Bo doesn't have a decent weapon, and you do not even have a True God weapon at all. Does Protector Dong Bo specialize in darts?"
"Nope. I prefer the spear." Xue Ying answered.
"Spear…" Jiao Yun Liu nodded, "I have a spear over here with me that I stole from the treasure trove my father refined."
After saying that, he waved his hand, causing black robes and silvery-white spear to appear. There was even a gray warship which emerged at one side. This warship was similar to the one Shan Dan was using.
Xue Ying was stunned.
"Accept them. Every protector has their own." Jiao Yun Liu stated.
Xue Ying immediately received them. As he took the items, he could feel the terrifying sharpness of the silvery-white spear. In terms of sharpness, this spear was superior to that Blood Serpent Spear. However, the refinement method of this spear was slightly different than most True God weapons, like the Blood Serpent Spear. It did not contain an eternal Dao, nor was it a Dao at the Opening realm. Instead, there were many ancient complex arrays.
'Is this a True God weapon refined using another system?' Xue Ying thought. 'Forefather Tian Yu' had left behind many weapons in the Starting Ground. Forefather Tian Yu was the ancestor of their Cultivator Cosmos, and thus, he also used the same system of Laws and Profound Mysteries. Naturally, the weapons he refined were belonged to the same system.
Different cultivation system would usually have different methods of refining weapons, but the weapons would not necessarily be weak.
Like his Black Gourd, it relied on a terrifying void array, easily controlling an existence on the level of the "Sun Star". It could not be compared to a simple True God Weapon.
"Shan Dan mentioned that you wished to obtain the cultivation techniques of other cultivation systems?" Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu chuckled.
"I am indeed curious to see whether they are beneficial to my cultivation." Xue Ying replied.
"Hahaha, this is very normal. Every cultivation system has its own specialties." Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu flipped his hand, causing many lumps of crystals to appear. "These contain numerous cultivation techniques from the cultivation systems of 18 cosmoses. Some are quite similar to others, and some are very different."
After saying that, he passed the crystals in his hand to Xue Ying.
Xue Ying was astonished.
A total of 18 cosmoses" worth of cultivation systems?
That's right.
Even though this cosmos had conquered eight cosmoses, there were many other small-scaled cosmos passages and medium-scaled cosmos passages connected to other cosmoses. They could gather techniques from other cosmos's cultivation system.
"If there's anything you need, you can just look for me." Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu laughed. "External resources like these are all I can help you with."
Xue Ying held on to the crystals. He sensed the vast amount of information contained within. They represented civilizations of many different cosmoses. Xue Ying could not help but fel deeply moved…
What I needed your help with is none other than these external resources!
"Many thanks, Third Highness." Xue Ying felt delighted. If he had to rely on himself to collect those techniques, he would never be able to collect as many techniques as what the Void God Clan had collected.

chapters.title: Chapter 737 - 18 Different Cosmos Cultivation Systems
chapters.content:
Chapter 737: 18 Different Cosmos Cultivation Systems
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
"The banquet is ready, let's go." The Third Highness led his group of protectors towards the banquet. After the brief exchange, the other protectors were much more welcoming towards Xue Ying.
Xue Ying also joined the banquet, as it was a rare chance to enjoy delicacies from another cosmos. The life forms in this cosmos all had fleshly bodies, hence the local food was still palatable for Xue Ying. However, metallic life forms, like that protector that Xue Ying had just sparred with, only drank wine and did not touch the food at all.
After the banquet, Xue Ying was led to his dwelling.
"Sir Dong Bo, this is your cave dwelling." A servant had been specially sent to lead Xue Ying over, and another group of servants was stationed at the cave entrance to welcome Xue Ying.
"Greetings to master." The servants at the cave entrance greeted respectfully.
All of them knew that from this day onward, their lives belonged to this powerful alien expert! Even if he killed them in a fit of rage, there was nothing they could do about it.
Xue Ying's gaze swept over the group of servants. Amongst them, the strongest was at the stage two World Deity level, while the majority were at the Deity level.
"I will be cultivating. Don't disturb me if there's nothing important," ordered Xue Ying.
"Understood." All of them felt relieved. Fortunately, their master seemed to the type who loved to cultivate and would probably spend long periods of time cultivating.
******
With a loud rumble, the massive door of the cultivation hall in Xue Ying's cave-dwelling closed shut. Waving his hand, a black ring landed on the long table in the hall. His body spontaneously vanished, entering into the Eden world within the black ring.
Within a prairie in the Eden world. Xue Ying was seated cross-legged on this prairie, inspecting the weapon, robe, ship, and other items which were bestowed on him by the Third Highness. He inwardly approved, 'This spear is no less precious than my Blood Serpent Spear, and the ship is another precious treasure. The black robes seem ordinary, yet its material is extremely durable, and it can conceal one's aura… These three treasures will definitely incite envy in many of the Paragons back in my cosmos.'
Just from this inspection, it was obvious that this cosmos had many more treasures than his own.
'Cultivation system.'
He flipped his palm, and the lump of crystal appeared. Xue Ying stared at it with fervor in his eyes. This was what he desired the most.
Any cosmos cultivation system was the crystallization of their cosmos infinite wisdom and their way to strength!
'Let's start on the cultivation system from these 18 cosmoses.' Calming himself, Xue Ying freed himself from all distractions and immersed his consciousness into the crystal. A large volume of information was instantly transmitted into his mind, containing the full extent of the cultivation systems and their corresponding techniques, along with full explanations for all of them! These explanations must have been recorded by the experts from this cosmos who served under the Third Highness.
The bloodline cultivation system relied primarily on awakening the cultivator's bloodline. However, not disregard other methods., incorporating the advantageous aspects of other cultivation systems into their own to further increase their strength.
Time flew by…
Though Xue Ying had a powerful soul, he still had to spend three whole days before he finished looking through all 18 different cultivation systems.
'So it's like this.'
Having looked through all 18 cultivation systems, he made comparisons and drew a conclusion as a result.
'There are two types of cosmoses: those that were naturally formed, and those there were created by ancient existences. Likewise, there are two main types of cultivation systems!' pondered Xue Ying.
'The first type of cultivation system is in the form of a guidance left behind by ancient existences. These cultivation systems are like a broad pavement; practitioners using this cultivation system would have a smoother journey and be able to cultivate to an extremely high level.'
'The second type would be found in those naturally formed cosmoses. Without any guidance, the lifeforms in those cosmoses can only grope on using their own methods. In order to survive, become stronger, and live longer, they would have to figure out and create their own cultivation methods. Over time, the most formidable and easily disseminated method would become the mainstream cultivation method within the cosmos and would be continuously refined by countless individuals throughout the years. However, no matter how perfect it becomes, the cultivation system will ultimately be limited by one's own vision and scope, and will nonetheless contain some imperfections.'
Xue Ying secretly felt grateful.
He was glad that his cosmos had been created by Forefather Tian Yu, and that Xue Ying had received his guidance. Thus, the laws and profound mysteries system had been laid from start to end already.
'Of these 18 cultivation systems, there's actually the Ancestor Mother Religion cultivation system included amongst them.' From this information, Xue Ying understood how the people from the Ancestor Mother Religion cultivate.
Ancestor Mother Religion…
They regarded the world as their cradle with themselves as infants, allowing for the heavens and earth to nurture and nourish them.
Upon possessing enough strength, they were able to use a cosmos as an embryo to nourish their bodies. This required them to need to build the Ancestor Mother Altar to make any cosmos suitable for their cultivation system. The thing they worship wasn't the world nor the cosmos, but an incomparably great existence-the Ancestor Mother! To them, the Ancestor Mother was just like their mother. Just like how any mother would giving birth and raising her child, they would become powerful in a similar fashion. Following the Ancestor Mother system would enable them to attain unimaginable power. Although its initial stage appeared relatively crude, it would get progressively bizarre and weird towards the end.
Even if they entered Primal Chaos Void, they still had ways to modify Primal Chaos Void to their advantage.
Several abilities record and some techniques of Ancestor Mother Religion made Xue Ying expression change.
'What a formidable cultivation system.' Xue Ying's real body in his homeworld immediately transmitted the information to his teacher, Bloodshed God Emperor.
With great surprise, the Bloodshed God-Emperor asked, "Xue Ying, you went to the Ancestor Mother Religion cosmos?"
"No, instead I went into a powerful cosmos! This cosmos has much information on the various cultivation systems. One of it is a piece of information about Ancestor Mother Religion cultivation system." replied Xue Ying.
"Many cultivation systems? Xue Ying, you have to be careful. It's not a good thing to be greedy." The Bloodshed God-Emperor warned.
"I understand." After he attained the "Walker's Hidden Secret", he understood that not every cultivation system could complement each other. Some could even be so different and not be so suitable to be practiced simultaneously. That was why it would be optimal to just practice one or two other systems which complemented the cultivator's original cultivation system.
According to what his Voidwalker master, Gu Qi, said, the Voidwalker system and the Law and Profound Mysteries system were two systems that could be cultivated simultaneously. One cultivated the physical body while the other focused on the comprehension of the laws and profound mysteries.
…
After his initial introduction to the various cultivation systems, Xue Ying tried to practice the cultivation system. Of the 18 cultivation systems, he could only practice eight of them since there were some problems with the other systems. For example, the bloodline cultivation systems required one to possess certain bloodline to cultivate. Since he wasn't a native of this cosmos and did not have its bloodline, he couldn't practice their cultivation system. Lifeforms like Protector Cong possessed metallic bodies. Their cultivation depended mainly on their bodies. Nonetheless, they were unlike from flesh-based lifeforms and could naturally not be able to cultivate any laws and profound mysteries systems.
The Ancestor Mother Religion had harsh demands on the environment the lower the level of cultivation. Xue Ying could not cultivate in this as well.
'Only by truly practicing it would one unravel the marvels of these cultivation systems.' Xue Ying began trying out the eight cultivation systems which he could cultivate in.
******
Of these eight cultivation systems, Xue Ying planned to make some in-depth attempt to cultivate each of them. He planned to practice each cultivation system for a thousand years. With his talent in comprehension, he felt a thousand years was enough time to gain an adequate in-depth understanding of each cultivation system and its essence.
Based on the records present within the crystal, of these eight cultivation systems, two of them could be cultivated all the way to the extreme, while the other six have some defects in them.
Of the 2 that could be practiced till the end, the first was known as the 'Hex'. They studied the myriad objects present in the cosmos, unraveling the deepest level of secrets and mysteries from their research. By using these secrets, Hexers could become powerful! There was only a small channel connecting the Hexer's cosmos to the Third Highness' cosmos. Hexers were curious beings, and they were really enthusiastic to exchange cultivation systems. Other than that, Hexers also had an interest in living beings. Any other cosmos living beings really piqued their curiosity.
There was another cultivation system called the 'strongest warrior cultivation system'. They practiced on remolding their body. From their point of view, what looked like an ordinary drop of blood could be researched as if it was a planet. They treated it like a new continent and would conduct their research all the way from the start. The advanced they were in their cultivation, the deeper they would be able to 'research' they bodies in detail. This allowed them to progressively make adjustments to their bodies. The final goal for this cultivation was to ultimately transform their bodies into something as powerful as a cosmos!
They didn't need any weapons since their bodies were already their strongest weapons. Moreover, it was extremely easy for them to destroy and refine other weapons.
They had no need for armors too as their skin was incomparably tough and resilient.
Xue Ying even had some suspicions on whether the strongest Deity he met at the starting ground had originated from this strongest warrior cultivation system cosmos. After all, that creature could easily eat his flying knife True God weapon, using only a split second to damage his flying knife. That digestive ability was something really terrifying.
'Truly worthy of cultivation systems that have reached the extremities of their cultivation.' Xue Ying recognized that these two cultivation systems were very formidable.
However, enormous amounts of time and effort were needed to cultivate in these 2 cultivation systems.
Researching the myriad of things was in fact much more complicated than comprehending the Profound Mysteries.
As for the Strongest Warrior cultivation system, researching one's body was even more complicated than understanding the laws and mysteries present in a cosmos.
And as for the other six flawed systems…
'Eh?'
After 5,000 years into his cultivation, Xue Ying had sunk into a state of elation.

chapters.title: Chapter 738 - Cultivation for 30 Million Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 738: Cultivation for 30 Million Years
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
This was a cultivation system that contained flaws. It was called the 'Cosmos Emissary Cultivation System'. The many beings in that cosmos had continuously improved and perfected this system for the sake of surviving and becoming stronger, and to achieve their many desires.
This system allowed weaker cultivators to communicate with the world and utilize World Energy to fight! The cultivator could also employ the World Energy to gradually strengthen his body.
When the cultivator becomes stronger, he could communicate with the origin of the cosmos! With continuous strengthening, he could even control a portion of that origin.
They would be able to use the energy from the origin of the cosmos in every action, and they would be exceptionally fearsome in battles.
And in the end, a terrifying existence of this cosmos had actually become one with the origin of the cosmos! His will was the will of the cosmos. He was unparalleled within the cosmos! However, with that cultivation system, that was the end of the path for him. After merging with the cosmos, the cosmos practically became his prison, and he would never be able to leave that cosmos.
Other Cosmos Emissaries could no longer fuse with the origin of the cosmos, as there was already one who did so. Unless they switched to another system, they would be unable to improve their strength.
This cosmos of theirs was truly powerful!
However, it also had obvious flaws. They were incomparably strong within their own cosmos, yet the moment they left their cosmos, they could not utilize the energy from the origin of their cosmos! Thus, they would become drastically weaker.
Of course, there was another issue with this system.
Like Forefather Tian Yu and the 'primogenitor' who created the cosmos with the bloodline cultivation system, being existences who had created a cosmos, they would painstakingly defend the origin of their cosmos! Thus, the origin of created cosmoses would never be controlled by others, much less fusing with others!
…
On the grass plains, Xue Ying was seated cross-legged as he cultivated.
"Hong~"
Xue Ying's realm was extremely high, and his body was overbearing. Hence, merely 100 years had passed before he comprehended this cultivation system and successfully linked up with the origin of this cosmos.
"Hong long long~"
The slaughter force from the origin of the cosmos descended around Xue Ying.
'This, this is truly too awesome!' Xue Ying felt thrilled deep in his heart, 'I originally did not care about this cultivation system, thinking that the flaws were too obvious. But now it seems that I have really belittled it. Any cultivation system that could become the official system of a cosmos is amazing.'
'This…'
'I've just grasped the Laws and Profound Mysteries, yet is it sufficient for the cosmos origin energy to descend?' Xue Ying was both delighted and stunned.
According to the classification of Laws, the Law of the world most commonly seen in the mortal realm was the most basic of Laws. Examples of higher levels were the Laws governing the entire material realm, the Dark Abyss laws, the operating arrays of the Lake Heart Island, the Laws of the Sun Star and the Laws of the Moon Star. These were laws at an extremely profound level.
The highest leveled law was one that governed the operation of an entire cosmos.
For Xue Ying to cause the energy of the cosmos origin to descend around him, it meant that he was directly examining the operating laws of this cosmos! It was extremely beneficial towards cultivating the laws. Xue Ying was primarily studying the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter. Thus, he had first attempted to control the 'slaughter' energy within the cosmos origin.
'Just sensing it isn't enough. I must still cultivate other techniques.'
'The "Dark Ripple Art".' Xue Ying began training in a slaughter-related technique originating from that cosmos. Through the crystals he had obtained from the Third Highness, he could personally experience the understanding the native life forms had towards "slaughter". Every single technique involved the mobilization and control of slaughter energy from the cosmos origin. Once he had thoroughly analyzed and studied these techniques, Xue Ying's understanding towards the Dao of Slaughter would become greater.
How many people had opened the Dao of Slaughter in his hometown?
As for the 'Cosmos Emissary System', there were many more who decided to cultivate the 'energy of the slaughter cosmos" origin'. They sought strength and were naturally willing to set the slaughter energy as their main focus. That led to the proliferation of many slaughter-related techniques.
'Slaughter…'
'My prior understanding of it was too shallow.'
Xue Ying was completely engrossed in it. He could feel his understanding of slaughter deepening every single day.
He was so enraptured with it, he had unabashedly visited the Third Highness, requesting his assistance in collecting all the cultivation techniques and absolute arts in the 'Cosmos Emissary System' which were related to the Dao of Slaughter. The Third Highness immediately agreed to his request and had contacted his own clan to request for all the techniques and absolute arts belonging to the Cosmos Emissary Cultivation System.
"Third Highness, this system has no future. It will only improve your ability to perceive the cosmos origin." The higher-ups in his clan were not pleased and had even reprimanded him. "You should still focus more on tempering yourself by fighting others. As long as you awaken your bloodline, your combat power will naturally see a great improvement."
"Understood. I am only planning to use these as a reference, so Uncle Fu, I'll have to trouble you to hurry up and collect them before passing to me." Third Highness entrusted this to his uncle.
"Alright."
Just half a month later, only two more ordinary cultivation techniques were collected. However, a total of eight absolute arts were collected. Third Highness passed them along to Xue Ying.
This made Xue Ying speechless. No matter what, it seemed that the Third Highness was genuinely conscientious in taking care of the protectors under him.
******
Xue Ying focused on the slaughter-related origin energy cultivation techniques, as well as the absolute arts related to the Slaughter Dao. He did not care about others. The only thing he cared about was to deepen his understanding of slaughter. In a million years time, his understanding of the Dao of Slaughter reached the apex level.
Naturally, other than comprehending other cultivation systems, he did not slack off in his studying of the more important "Walker's Hidden Secret". This was also the reason why he had hidden in the Eden World to cultivate. The "Walker's Hidden Secret" would require him to control the Primal Chaos Void Energy every single time he cultivated it. The moment he was discovered, it would be troublesome! Just by comparing the degree of strength, the "Walker's Hidden Secret" was far beyond other cultivation systems. After all, it was tough to even find an inheritor who could succeed in cultivating it within an entire cosmos.
…
Time passed.
Because the time flow here was over 3,000 times faster than his hometown, less than 10,000 years had passed in his hometown cosmos, yet more than 30 million years had elapsed here in the Devil Mountain Cosmos.
"Very good."
"This is too awesome."
Deep under the surface of the planet Xue Ying was currently inhabiting and cultivating on, the Third Highness 'Jiao Yun Liu' gazed at that black plant with great fervor. The three fruits on the black plant had turned deep black. On the surface, they looked ordinary and did not have any particularly noteworthy characteristics. Suddenly, the leaves of this black plant began to wither.
"Congratulations, congratulations, Your Highness. It seems that the Black Devil Holy Fruits are turning ripe soon. Your Highness will certainly be able to step into the Ruler realm." There were a total of four protectors by his side. All were ecstatic at this moment.
"Hahaha… the moment I become a Ruler, things will be completely different." Jiao Yun Liu could hardly conceal the smile on his face and extended his hand. The arrays that were protecting the black plant gradually dissipated. As the leaves continued withering, he positioned his hands below the fruits. "Pa pa pa." The three fruits finally fell from the tree and landed in his hands.
Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu revealed a happy expression. He retrieved a golden bottle and placed the three black fruits within.
"I've obtained it."
Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu held onto the golden bottle. His eyes were flashing brightly.
After so many years of living in seclusion and protecting this plant, he had truly given up too much for the sake of these Black Devil Sacred Fruits. And now, he had finally obtained the ripe fruits.
"It is time for me to metamorphose!' Jiao Yun Liu thought silently. He then turned around and headed out. "Let's go."
He could no longer wait.
He had to begin his cultivation post-haste.

chapters.title: Chapter 739 - Protect His Highness
chapters.content:
Chapter 739: Protect His Highness
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
'It has been 30 million years.' Xue Ying stood on top of a mountain peak overlooking this vast Eden World.
This Eden World did not have any other living beings. This was a deliberate choice by Xue Ying, as the"Walker's Hidden Secret" had a devastating force, and just the spreading of a slight shockwave would exterminate countless lives. But after cultivating for 30 million years, he had perfected his control over the Primal Chaos Void Energy, ensuring that his use of the Energy would not affect his surroundings at all.
'My current power should far surpass that of the three Holy Protectors, and beyond that of Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction. During the final battle of my Cultivator Cosmos with the Ancestor Mother Religion, I should not be an impedance anymore.' Xue Ying thought.
30 million years was too long.
Before coming to the Devil Mountain Cosmos, he had only cultivated for a total of more than 10 million years, yet he had already obtained outstanding achievements.
Now that 30 million years had passed, with his comprehension ability and him pondering over the void array of the Black Gourd, the 'Dao of Mirage' had reached an extreme bottleneck. Even his understanding of the Primal Chaos Void reached a profound stage-he had trained the "Walker's Hidden Secret" to the sixth level! Only after reaching this level did Xue Ying understand why the selection trials for a Voidwalker would be so prudent.
One important requirement would be the temperament of one's heart, for fear of passing it down to the wrong person! It was truly a heaven-shattering cultivation system, so much more powerful than all 18 cultivation systems, all which had become widely known, in the crystal passed to him by Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu. He had a clear advantage at his current 'Paragon realm'.
In the future, when his cultivation reached the same level as Forefather Tian Yu and Lake Heart Island master, the strength of the Laws and Profound Mysteries system may be comparable with the Voidwalker lineage.
However, before that, at least during the Paragon realm, the Voidwalker system was able to suppress all other systems.
'It is my fortune to have this opportunity to enter this Devil Mountain Cosmos, with its accelerated time flow of more than 3000 times faster than my home cosmos! Before the final battle erupts, I must grasp hold of all opportunities to improve my strength.' Xue Ying felt that even though he was already quite strong, he had yet to reach the limit. He still had space for improvement as a Paragon.
"Hong~"
Suddenly, there was a slight tremor outside the Eden Treasure.
Xue Ying looked up in confusion. 'What is happening?'
"All protectors, hurry and protect His Highness!" An order rapidly transmitted over. It was apparently transmitted to all protectors. As Xue Ying was an expert from another cosmos, and hence did not have any karma in this cosmos, he had to rely on the communication treasure for information.
'Protect His Highness?' Xue Ying was stunned.
"Sou!"
He then disappeared from the Eden World.
******
His Highness Jiao Yun Liu was incomparably excited as he rushed back to the palace on the surface. He then ordered the protectors standing beside him, "I'll be entering closed-door cultivation. Nobody should come to disturb me."
"Yes."
The four protectors said in unison.
Jiao Yun Liu rushed into his own secret palace hall, shutting the door and securing the lock before retrieving the golden bottle. He was just about to remove the Black Devil Sacred Fruits from the bottle when…
Suddenly-
A tremor spread over.
Jiao Yun Liu's expression changed. The core arrays on this planet were personally controlled by him. Thus, he was immediately able to sense that an enemy had barged in.
"Sou."
He hurried out of the palace hall. Just as he reached the palace doors, he saw a group of people standing high up in the sky. They were led by a male in golden armor, who had scarlet red scales covering his body, and a crimson scale on his forehead. He looked quite similar to Jiao Yun Liu, albeit with colder eyes.
"Big Brother?" Jiao Yun Liu's expression turned ashen-gray at that moment.
"My pitiful little brother. Big brother is here again." The golden-armored male teased. "Your luck is quite good, to actually discover a Black Devil Sacred Fruit Tree. Ze ze ze, and it has already ripened. How about giving them to your big brother?"
Jiao Yun Liu swept his gaze across the four protectors around him. He no longer had his usual friendliness. Instead, he was slightly frenzied as he gritted his teeth at them: "Who betrayed me?"
Of these four protectors, two were the ones who found the Black Devil Sacred Fruit Tree, and the other two were the ones he trusted the most; they were always by his side.
But…
The information had been leaked. It was impossible for him to reveal it personally. Thus, it must have been one of the four protectors who knew of the Black Devil Sacred Fruit tree.
"We didn't do it."
"We immediately reported to Your Highness upon finding the Black Devil Sacred Fruit Tree. If we were planning to betray Your Highness, then it would have been pointless for us to inform you about this." The two protectors hurriedly explained themselves.
"My useless little brother, after all this, you still don't know? Cha Yun Nong, your mission is completed! There is no need for you to remain with this little brother of mine." The golden-armored male sneered. At that moment, a tall gray-armored protector flew up towards the group of powerful experts beside the golden-armored male. He respectfully mentioned, "Actually, he did not suspect me at all. I can always remain by his side."
"Cha…"
His Highness Jiao Yun Liu was dumbfounded, staring at the tall gray-armored protector, "You, you betrayed me? Why, why?"
Of all the protectors, he trusted Cha Yun Nong the most.
His wife and Cha Yun Nong were siblings! Thus, he treated Cha Yun Nong especially well. Cha Yun Nong should have been the one with the lowest aptitude amongst his protectors. If not for him spending so much effort to support Cha Yun Nong, he would not be able to reach his current realm.
"Fool." The tall gray-armored protector sneered and was too lazy to speak anymore.
"Little brother, why, are you planning to struggle?" The golden-armored chuckled.
"Third Highness." By the side of the golden-armored male, there was a red-haired single-eyed old man who said with a grand voice, "There is no need to struggle. Hand over the Black Devil Sacred Fruits to the Eldest Prince! Otherwise, you and all your protectors will die!"
Within the Devil Mountain Cosmos, even the children of Void Gods would fight with one another.
As long as their souls did not dissipate, the Void God would not care. Without experiencing setbacks and difficulties, even if one had a precious bloodline, it would be tough for him to become strong. Even the Void God himself was fanning the flames behind the scenes, generating trials and tribulations for his children!
"Red Devil God-Emperor…" Jiao Yun Liu gritted his teeth.
He had fought with the eldest prince for so many years, and had always ended up disadvantaged, all because of this Ruler from another race-Red Devil God-Emperor!
With a Ruler helping his eldest brother, he would definitely end up disadvantaged in terms of combat force, and thus, he had been suffering losses all this while. His eldest brother had a cold and deranged personality-he had been endlessly tormenting the Third Highness. Furthermore, the Jiao Yun Emperor, who was cultivating in the deepest region of the "Primogenitor Devil Mountain", couldn't be bothered with the whole situation and had been watching coldly from the side.
"Hand them over. This time, my mood is quite good so I won't play around with you." The golden-armored male's eyes were fervent and filled with desire. He would never have thought his little brother could have discovered the 'Black Devil Sacred Fruit Tree'. If he weren't afraid of his little brother destroying that tree, he would have acted long ago. Thus, he waited until the fruits were ripe-when the fruits would become incomparably solid and indestructible-before he showed his hand. That way, the fruits would not be damaged. Obtaining this sacred item would raising his chances of awakening his bloodline and allow him to step into the Ruler realm.
"Dream on!" Jiao Yun Liu growled.
"It's a pity that you can't even destroy it. Since you aren't planning to agree to my request, then I can only take action." The golden-armored male softly said. "Kill them all without mercy and take the Black Devil Sacred Fruits."
"Yes." His protectors acknowledged his orders.
The golden-armored male looked towards the Red Devil God-Emperor beside him. He was the biggest reliance he had. He had spent quite an effort just to pull this Ruler to his side. The God-Emperor softly nodded.
"Hong~"
His Highness Jiao Yun Liu stood there, yet many rings of arrays abruptly activated from the palace behind him. There were even arrays situated across the entire planet being activated at this moment. It brought about a huge power.
His Highness Jiao Yun Liu, who was located under the many layers of protective arrays, retreated back into his palace. Looking at the crowd of enemies through the front door, he savagely roared out, "Jiao Yun Teng, carry on with your fantasies. Even if I die, I'll never let you have them."
"Why talk about death? You'll only be losing this avatar of yours. You are still my little brother, how would I dare to truly kill you?" The golden-armored male laughed, "And there's something which you are wrong about. After killing all of you, the Black Devil Sacred Fruits will naturally belong to me. You can't hinder me at all."
"Fellow protectors, hurry up and protect His Highness." A protector, who followed His Highness closely, felt uneasy as he transmitted the message.
"Hu hu hu…"
Instantly, the many protectors who were scattered across the many cave dwellings on the planet came rushing over. The planet was not very large. Hence they could instantly appear right outside His Highness Jiao Yun Liu's palace even just by flying over. Xue Ying was also one of those who rushed over after receiving the information.
The golden-armored male's gaze swept over the protectors who rushed over. He sneered, "A group of trash. Kill them!"

chapters.title: Chapter 740 - Frightening Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 740: Frightening Strength
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
"Yes."
The group of protectors released an overflowing killing intent, especially Cha Yun Nong, who had revealed his true identity and was now getting restless, itching to show his strength. They had the 'Red Devil God-Emperor' on their side, boosting their confidence. After all, the gap between a Paragon and a Ruler was immeasurable. The moment one becomes a Ruler, it would be a qualitative change!
For example, Monarch Green could single-handedly defeat a group of Paragons, yet he had originally reached an extreme bottleneck in all three of his Daos. Despite that, he could barely match up against 'Bloody Ruler Nile', who was deliberately disguising his strength. This clearly demonstrated how massive the gap was between a Paragon and a Ruler.
They would definitely win! This would be a massacre!
"Hong hong hong hong hong hong…"
All of them turned into streams of light as they charged towards Xue Ying's approaching group of protectors.
Xue Ying and the others were rushing over while still feeling puzzled.
"Brother Cong, Brother Shan Dan, what is happening?" Xue Ying did not understand the current situation. He could see that Protector Cong, Protector Shan Dan and the others flying by his side had ugly expressions on their faces. They had been following His Highness for a longer period, and naturally recognized the eldest prince 'Jiao Yun Teng' with a single glance. They also noticed the red-haired, single-eyed old man. That was the Ruler, 'Red Devil God-Emperor'-an existence which they absolutely could not contend against.
"The eldest prince has brought his men here. The one by his side is a Ruler called Red Devil God-Emperor." Shan Dan transmitted over to Xue Ying as he explained the situation.
"With the Red Devil God-Emperor around, we're going to throw our lives away again." Protector Cong remarked bitterly.
Xue Ying immediately understood.
During the past 30 million years, he had occasionally left his seclusion to exchange pointers with the other protectors. He had also received some information over this period, including the fact that the greatest nemesis of His Highness Jiao Yun Liu, whom he was currently serving, was the eldest prince "Jiao Yun Teng".
"They are coming!"
"Let's kill as many as we can before Red Devil God-Emperor acts."
"Go all out!"
This group of protectors who rushed over had swiftly analyzed the situation. They knew that there was absolutely no hope of winning this fight. Every one of them was filled with indignation. They were Paragons, and they had their dignity! They were unwilling to be slaughtered like cattle and wanted to take advantage of Red Devil God-Emperor's arrogance and take down as many of them as possible before he decided to personally take action.
Xue Ying glanced at the incoming hostile light streams, and then at the Red Devil God-Emperor in the distance. His eyes were filled with excitement. "There won't be a better opportunity for me to fight against a Ruler before the final battle with Ancestor Mother Religion begins!'
"Hua."
Xue Ying flipped his hand, and six darts appeared in his palm. Having reached the sixth level of the Voidwalker body, the strength he possessed was genuinely frightening. After all, his current strength was sufficient to kill the three Holy Protectors with a little pinch, and there was simply no need for him to expend much effort to deal with this group of Paragons. Using just a small part of his strength, he threw the darts.
The six darts disappeared as they entered the Mirage World.
Following that, another six darts appeared in Xue Ying's palm, and he also threw them out! This set of darts was obtained from the protectors of the Ancestor Mother Religion, and one set contained 12 darts.
The 12 darts were flying within the Mirage World. Each dart contained a terrifying power. With Xue Ying's control over the Mirage World, he was able to make the 12 darts simultaneously leave the Mirage World, appearing right before the bodies of 12 different protectors. Even in the Cultivator Cosmos, nobody could have sensed his attacks before they reached them.
The 12 protectors were each struck in the chest by a dart. The dart fully penetrated their chest and exited through their back, before vanishing without a trace.
In the instant when the darts penetrated through their chests, an invisible force filled with a frightening killing intent was transmitted into their bodies. Every part of their body trembled slightly.
The 12 protectors were originally flying at high speed, but after the impact, they stared on blankly and continued flying as per inertia, though they became slower. The other protectors glanced over in puzzlement.
"Hua~"
As if they were made of sand and grit, the bodies of the 12 protectors began crumbling apart, before totally disintegrating.
The bodies of the 12 protectors had completely crumbled. The body of one of the protectors appeared from the void, hunched over and garbed in black. Under the black robe, his green eyes stared in shock at Xue Ying in the distance.
The entire battlefield turned silent!
Not just the protectors on Xue Ying's side, even the eldest prince's protectors stopped in their tracks.
…
'Why is it him again? Why? I hate this, I hate it!' His Highness Jiao Yun Liu glared at the distant golden-armored male while trembling. Clearly, his fury had reached the tipping point. 'I discovered the Black Devil Sacred Fruit Tree and endured for such a long period, just so that I could rely on the fruits to break through. But why is he here again? I can't just let my efforts go to waste!'
His Highness Jiao Yun Liu looked at his subordinates fighting against his eldest brother's protectors. He felt pain in his heart.
He was clear that the moment Red Devil God-Emperor made his move, he would wipe out the strongest protectors on his side. The others would eventually be surrounded and killed.
'What should I do, what should I do?' Jiao Yun Liu felt indignation, despair, and unwillingness at the same time. His blood was boiling, and he felt that his head was about to explode.
Suddenly-
Jiao Yun Liu was stunned.
He looked in a daze as the 12 darts disappeared after penetrating through 12 protectors. The bodies of those protectors crumbled directly, leaving only one who had reincarnated from the void.
Jiao Yun Liu's gaze turned towards Xue Ying in the distance. At this moment, the 12 darts had already returned to Xue Ying. He waved his hand and kept them.
"Protector Dong Bo?" Jiao Yun Liu murmured.
…
Dazed.
Stunned silly!
Not just the opposing group of protectors, even Xue Ying's comrades were all appalled at what just happened.
He casually threw out some darts, and 11 Paragons lost their lives? Those protectors even had armor on, yet they were penetrated and killed with a single dart?
How many protectors did the eldest prince have? He only had slightly more than 20! How many times over could Xue Ying kill them?
"Brother Dong Bo?" Shan Dan, Protector Cong, and the others were stunned. They did not dare believe that this comrade of theirs, whom they had sparred with several times, and had a pleasant mood, would be this terrifying.
"Aren't you leaving?"
As Xue Ying spoke, he did not stop his flight towards His Highness Jiao Yun Liu.
"Retreat!" The eldest prince's protectors were all so frightened that they began escaping. They did not harbor any thoughts of fighting back; the current Xue Ying was too powerful. He was even stronger than Monarch Green and Pang Yi from before they became Rulers. It was simply a slaughter.
'The gap is too big. No wonder teacher and the rest did not allow Paragons to participate in the final battle.' Xue Ying thought. His previous strength had been disdained by Rulers. Only the 'Black Gourd' was of help to them.
'But with my current condition, it should suffice.'
Xue Ying glanced at the Red Devil God-Emperor before landing right in front of the palace door. He looked at the slightly stunned Jiao Yun Liu. "Your Highness."
"Protector Dong Bo." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu was genuinely startled. He didn't treat this newly-joined Protector Dong Bo any differently from any other new protector and had not paid much attention to him. Today, Xue Ying's actions stunned him silly. This 'Protector Dong Bo' had far surpassed his imaginations. It was likely that the group of protectors under his eldest brother would be sweep clean.
"Your Highness doesn't have to worry. With me around, none will be able to harm Your Highness." Xue Ying said.
"Good, good, good. You should be wary of that Red Devil God-Emperor. He is a Ruler and is very formidable." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu was honestly still feeling unease. That was a Ruler after all.
Xue Ying chuckled.
He did not have the certainty of winning against a Ruler. But he was fully confident that he could defend His Highness! Having reached the sixth level of the Voidwalker cultivation arts, his control of the void had strengthened enormously. He could bring along His Highness and flee in a single instant.
But he would not simply admit defeat.
"Such a haughty tone." A cold voice transmitted from afar.
Xue Ying turned around.
The golden-armored 'Jiao Yun Teng' wore an extremely furious expression. "You are the new protector hired by that useless little brother of mine? Hmph, you overestimate yourself" He turned towards Red Devil God-Emperor beside him.
The lone eye of that Red Devil God-Emperor remained calm. He even revealed a grin. "Brat, you are quite formidable. You should be unparalleled amongst Paragons. Oh right, what is your name?"
"I am Dong Bo Xue Ying." Xue Ying looked up at the other party.
Red Devil God-Emperor felt his interest peaking. "I am going to kill that Highness of yours while taking away those Black Devil Sacred Fruits with me. Are you certain that you want to fight against me?"
Xue Ying was suppressing his excitement and delight. He did not have an accurate judgment of where he stood in terms of power after 30 million years of cultivation. Furthermore, the final battle which was about to erupt in his hometown made him look forward to fighting with a Ruler. Watching the Red Devil God-Emperor standing high up in the sky, vigor was present in Xue Ying's eyes. He grinned, "I am looking forward to having a battle with you. This is my first time fighting against a Ruler."

chapters.title: Chapter 741 - Dong Bo Xue Ying Taking on a Ruler!
chapters.content:
Chapter 741: Dong Bo Xue Ying Taking on a Ruler!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
High up in the sky, Red Devil God-Emperor was currently staring at Xue Ying. He felt that things were becoming more interesting. "Brat, it is precisely because you haven't fought with Rulers before that you dare to challenge me. In a while, you will understand how foolish it is to challenge a Ruler."
"Red Devil God-Emperor, kill him." The eldest prince Jiao Yun Teng growled by his side.
"Kill him."
"God-Emperor, we must not let him die so easily. See if he dares to be so haughty after this." The traitor Cha Nong Yun, who had decided to rely on the eldest prince, shouted out. The other protectors broke out in murmured voices after hearing this. It was indeed true that they should kill their enemies. However, Xue Ying was such a strong adversary that everyone had to admit that they truly respect him despite having their avatars killed by him.
So what if the other party was haughty? He had the power to do so. The God-Emperor similarly had the qualifications to reprimand him. But as a traitor? What are you harping on about?
"Fight with a Ruler?" Over on Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu's side, they were all feeling nervous. Shan Dan, Protector Cong, and other protectors were watching worriedly. Even though they had just witnessed Xue Ying's display of strength, they were not very confident in his chances of victory.
It was only Xue Ying himself who was filled with fighting spirit.
"Do you know that Rulers could form their own law domains?" As the Red Devil God-Emperor spoke, a faint light began emitting from his body. This light brightened the surrounding and covered about 1,000 meters around him.
"This is my domain…"
His body suddenly moved. He was moving closer to Xue Ying. That lone eye of his was fixed on Xue Ying. As the two got closer, the domain released by the God-Emperor also enveloped Xue Ying, "Domain-decomposition!"
"Chi chi chi~"
Everything within his domain began disintegrating. Not just the soil on the land, even the void was being decomposed.
A force of decomposition that was part of the Laws landed on Xue Ying. Red Devil God-Emperor was grinning as he watched. However, his expression suddenly changed. As the invisible decomposition force landed on Xue Ying's body, it seemed to have uncovered Xue Ying's true capabilities. "Hong!" A frightening aura suddenly exploded from Xue Ying, causing everything around him to warp. Formless gray ripples fluctuated out, and these ripples easily destroyed the decomposition force; the ripples were colliding against the faint light emitted by the Red Devil God Emperor.
"Hong!" "Hong!" "Hong!"
The surface of Xue Ying's body released a gray ripple that fought against the faint light emitted by the Red Devil God-Emperor. Both were clashing against each other, creating a screeching sound. Nevertheless, Xue Ying's domain was currently in a disadvantageous position.
"What!"
"Law domain?"
"He has his law domain too?"
Those watching the battle, including the eldest prince Jiao Yun Teng, third prince Jiao Yun Liu, and other protectors, were stunned. Even Red Devil God-Emperor was aghast.
"He is clearly a Paragon." The protectors from both parties were dazed.
"His body is so strong that it has formed its own natural law domain." The eldest prince Jiao Yun Teng was watching Xue Ying coldly. He continued. "Those with tyrannical bodies like the Ancestor Mother Religion law system or the strongest warrior cultivation system… according to the records, there were some outstanding Paragons whose physique was so strong that they naturally formed law domains."
…
The Red Devil God-Emperor looked at Xue Ying. That single eye of his showed both shocked and surprised. "Paragon realm-your body is actually able to form a law domain despite being at the Paragon realm! Admirable, admirable, it is likely that your body is stronger than mine."
Xue Ying chuckled.
Actually, the Holy Protectors from Ancestor Mother Religion could release unseen ripples. That was only a small-scale law domain. Nevertheless, the Voidwalker system was different. He had cultivated all the way to the sixth level, and his fleshy body was likely to be comparable to those Religious Leaders who had just broken through. Nonetheless, it the control his body had over the void that eventually enabled him to form his law domain! His law domain… was inclined towards the void.
But Xue Ying remained humble.
Like Temporal Island Lord and Empress Qian He, their bodies were probably weaker than the Holy Protectors of Ancestor Mother Religion. However, their advantage in terms of the Laws enabled them to easily kill the holy Protectors.
Similarly, this Red Devil God-Emperor in front of him might be weaker than him in terms of his physique, but the other party did not specialize in his fleshy body. According to the intelligence provided by the Third Highness, the other party's strongest weapon was that one eye of his!
"Red Devil God-Emperor, just this law domain will not affect me at all. Bring out your true strength instead." Xue Ying flipped his hand, causing his silver spear to appear.
"I think highly of you and do not wish to kill you. But since you are taking the initiative of sending yourself to death…" Red Devil God-Emperor shook his head. Someone whose body could form its law domain at the Paragon realm was someone he was willing to befriend. But this time, the Black Devil Sacred Fruits were something he had to take. Since the other party did not know how to give way, "Then you leave me no choice."
"Weng weng weng weng weng weng!"
The Red Devil God-Emperor's lone eye released a light ray. His figure immediately turned illusory. Many figures of Red Devil God-Emperor starting forming in the surrounding.
There was more than a hundred of them scattered across the sky and the land. They surrounded Xue Ying and were looking at him.
"He's making his move."
"Red Devil God-Emperor has displayed his killing move."
"How can we fight against so many incarnations? We can't even find his real body! And every single incarnation is very strong too."
The protectors and two princes watched the battle nervously.
…
"He's coming." Xue Ying was high-spirited. The intelligence report which the Third Highness gave him was clear; Red Devil God-Emperor was most famous for this move-incarnations! His true body was able to switch positions with his incarnations. Furthermore, the combat strength of his incarnations far transcended that of ordinary Paragons. Just the numerical advantage was sufficient to bring despair to the Third Highness" protectors.
"Die!" Xue Ying's figure flashed. The strength and speed of a Voidwalker body had erupted completely, and Red Devil God-Emperor was inwardly shocked. He then calmly sneered, 'Those with a strong body only have a few moves during battle. Their fighting style is cruder, and defeating them is easy.'
"Si la!"
The void was being sliced.
The silver spear left behind many cracks in the void. It was wantonly severing everything and sweeping towards all directions in a frenzy. The incarnations of Red Devil God-Emperor each took out their own large black saber in response.
But 'peng peng peng peng…'
Each and every incarnation was either cut into two, or their bodies were pierced by the spear.
It was total suppression.
"Such a formidable spear technique." The real body of Red Devil God-Emperor was hiding further away from Xue Ying, silently watching on. At the same time, his expression changed, "His combat techniques aren't crude. The mysteriousness of his spear technique is something I can't see through."
In the system of Laws and Profound Mysteries, he had reached the bottleneck and upper limit in the Dao of Slaughter, and he was a mere step away from achieving eternal perfection! How was it easy to defend against spear technique of this level?
Red Devil God-Emperor might have some hope of parrying against those attacks with his real body, but a mere incarnation? The incarnations could deal with ordinary Paragons easily, but they were lacking when dealing with Xue Ying!
"It's a pity that I have more numbers!"
"Whatever. I'm done playing with him. Time to kill him."
As Red Devil God-Emperor's incarnations died, more emerged, and their numbers did not seem to have decreased at all. Suddenly, all the incarnations crazily charged forward. After all, Xue Ying only had a single spear. How could he kill all incarnations by himself?
"Pu."
There were two incarnations which Xue Ying could not defend against. Suddenly, one of them switched positions with Red Devil God-Emperor's real body.
The saber light abruptly turned dense! It flitted across his body like it was cutting through the void.
Xue Ying's expression changed slightly.
"Pu!"
In that critical moment, Xue Ying hid his body in the Mirage World, but he was still cut by that blade, severing the robe which Third Highness had given him. A white scar was left behind on his skin.
"Pu pu pu…"
Many of the incarnations were frenziedly attacking, forcing Xue Ying to be slashed time after time!
And Xue Ying was only killing his incarnations without touching the actual body of Red Devil God-Emperor.
'Every time I attack, he will flee and escape.' Xue Ying muttered inwardly, 'It seems that I am still far from winning this battle just by relying on my body.'
'Time to use my strongest secret technique perfected over the past 30 million years, and let this Ruler have his first taste of it."
