chapters.title: Chapter 742 - Dong Bo Xue Yings Strongest Secret Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 742: Dong Bo Xue Ying's Strongest Secret Technique
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
"Hong~"
As Xue Ying stood there, countless bloody ripples spread out from the surface of his body in all directions. The blood ripples were like waves on the sea, surging and battering against the enemies regardless of whether they were in the sky or on the land!
Many of the Red Devil God-Emperor incarnations, which were originally attacking Xue Ying, trembled after coming into contact with the bloody ripples and subsequently dissipated. The bodies of the incarnations were able to match the strength of apex protectors from the Ancestor Mother Religion, yet against the bloody ripples, they were helpless! The bloody ripples continued rapidly spreading outwards. That scene shocked Red Devil God-Emperor to the core!
"What, this, how could this be possible?" Red Devil God-Emperor was so frightened that he started retreating in a hurry.
"Sou sou sou."
He was swiftly retreating backward.
Xue Ying stood there. The bloody ripples were spreading outwards in all directions. The region it covered was continuously expanding- 500 kilometers, 5,000 kilometers, and more- this had frightened the eldest prince 'Jiao Yun Teng' and his Paragon protectors so much, that they too were retreating as far as they could.
Only after the region spread to a distance of more than a few ten thousands kilometers did Xue Ying temporarily stop expanding it.
""What is this move?"
"Why is it so powerful, that even the incarnations of Red Devil God-Emperor were instantaneously killed?" Third Prince Jiao Yun Liu and other protectors were extremely stunned. Protector Shan Dan did not even dare imagine that this Paragon, whom he had casually pulled over in the past… would be this horrifying! This blood ripple domain he displayed has utterly suppressed all the incarnations of the Red Devil God-Emperor. Such a technique was definitely at the Ruler level.
His Highness Jiao Yun Liu was both surprised and thrilled. "Has the tide really turned in my favor, for an existence like Dong Bo to end up as my protector?"
But he did not know that with Xue Ying's temper, if not for the Third Highness' sincerity towards his protectors, along with Xue Ying's urgent need for references to other cultivation systems, it would not have been so simple to have Xue Ying agree to be his protector.
…
Xue Ying stood high in the sky, looking at that fearful Red Devil God-Emperor, who was hiding beyond the region covered by the bloody ripples.
"What, Red Devil God-Emperor, are you frightened? So frightened that you don't even dare to enter the domain that I released?" Xue Ying chuckled. "If you are afraid, then you will be unable to obtain the Black Devil Sacred Fruits."
In the distance, Eldest Highness Jiao Yun Teng felt anxious.
That's right.
If they did not defeat this terrifying existence 'Protector Dong Bo' who had popped out from nowhere, how could he get those Black Devil Sacred Fruits from his little brother?
"Red Devil God-Emperor." The Eldest Highness Jiao Yun Teng glanced at him.
The Red Devil God-Emperor was instead looking at Xue Ying with his lone eye.
The dignity of being a Ruler did not allow him to tolerate retreating in front of a Paragon.
"I don't believe that the domain of a Paragon can kill me." Red Devil God-Emperor flew towards the blood domain with a look of indifference. As he moved closer, his hand was naturally the first to come into contact with the blood domain.
"Hu!"
The blood domain spontaneously expanded, enveloping Red Devil God-Emperor in the blink of an eye.
Red Devil God-Emperor's expression changed slightly as he looked at Xue Ying, who seemed to be smiling, yet at the same time, not smiling. The God-Emperor did not say anything. He felt the formless bloody ripples corrode his own law domain and permeate into his body, affecting it. Furthermore, the bloody ripples were continuously entangling him, and the strangest thing was, no matter how much Red Devil God-Emperor tried to move of fly around, the restriction on his movement was constantly increasing, and his internal injuries were gradually becoming more severe.
"This…"
The Red Devil God-Emperor immediately recalled an absolute art recorded in one of the cultivation systems which he had once seen.
"Slaughter Domain?" Red Devil God-Emperor stared with shock at Xue Ying in the distance.
"It can't be considered as the true Slaughter Domain. Its power is still lacking." Xue Ying chuckled.
"What, Slaughter Domain?"
"The Cosmos Emissary Cultivation System's Slaughter Domain?"
In the distance, the princes and all the Paragons felt a chill in their hearts.
The Cosmos Emissary Cultivation System enabled the cultivator, upon breaking through the Ruler level, to utilize the cosmos origin energy with every move, to frightening effect. Within this system, the Slaughter lineage had a legend: the legend of the "Slaughter Domain". According to the system, to create the Slaughter Domain, one had to be at least a Ruler, and be able to control the slaughter energy within the cosmos origin.
Within the Slaughter Domain, any enemies would die the moment they entered! Even if extremely powerful enemies could stay alive, their injuries would continuously worsen the moment they entered! At the same time, they would be restricted by the Slaughter Domain, and this restriction would increase over time as well. Furthermore, the one in control of the Slaughter Domain would have an increased combat power within the Domain. With all these factors, even the strongest Rulers would have a guaranteed death!
Naturally, this was just in theory!
Because none were able to control the cosmos origin energy within the 'Devil Mountain Cosmos'.
"How is he able to succeed in using the Slaughter Domain?"
"Our cosmos was created by the primogenitor. Thus, it is impossible to control the cosmos origin energy!" The two princes were filled with disbelief. The protectors were also dazed.
…
However, Xue Ying clearly understood why.
Earlier on, when he discovered the Cosmos Emissary Cultivation System's Slaughter lineage, it was extremely beneficial to him. He then requested for His Highness to collect the absolute arts of a similar type. He continually expanded his knowledge and understanding of the 'Dao of Slaughter' by researching and analyzing other techniques. During this process, Xue Ying was able to analyze these absolute arts from the perspective of the Laws and Profound Mysteries. He was able to discover other Daos encompassed within those arts like the Dao of Ripple, Dao of Flame, Dao of Destruction among others.
Evidently, within the Cosmos Emissary Cultivation System, everything that was beneficial towards Slaughter had been fused together. This was unlike Xue Ying's home cosmos" system of Laws and Profound Mysteries, which had clearly defined categories.
Xue Ying discovered that the 'Slaughter Domain' was actually comprised the Dao of Slaughter and the Dao of Ripple! Within the Cosmos Cultivation system, there were many arts which utilized the Dao of Ripple. He was able to deepen his understanding of the Ripple over time after researching and referencing a multitude of absolute arts.
During the 10 million years he spent in his original cosmos, he had opened the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter.
And in the 30 million years spent in this cosmos, Xue Ying had opened his third Dao-the Dao of Ripple! Furthermore, he had improved his grasp on the Dao of Ripple to the pinnacle and was close to reaching the limiting bottleneck.
The Dao of Slaughter fused with the Dao of Ripple! Using the perspective from the Laws and Profound Mysteries system to dissect and analyze this 'Slaughter Domain' technique, he then completely reconstructed and perfected it! Over the long years, Xue Ying was able to finally create his strongest secret technique in the last 30 million years-Slaughter Domain! Even though it could not compare with the actual version, Xue Ying believed that it was only because his Daos had yet to reach eternity.
The moment he reached eternity in the Daos, his 'Slaughter Domain' would undergo a qualitative change! The Cosmos Emissary system's 'Slaughter Domain' was formidable because the user formed it using cosmos origin energy. However, Xue Ying's 'Slaughter Domain' relied primarily on the laws. The stronger the laws, the stronger the technique.
'Within the Slaughter Domain, my strength is much higher.' Xue Ying chuckled. He carried the spear with one hand and casually waved it.
Cut! Jab! Sweep! Poke! Draw! Coil!
He then displayed his techniques as he wished, resonating with the ripples within the Slaughter Domain to attack Red Devil God-Emperor from all directions! His attacks felt as if they had been released in close range. It was truly unpredictable and mystical.
"I do not believe that as a Ruler, your strength is only as such. Bring out your true strength." Xue Ying coldly declared. In this fight, his victory or defeat was secondary; the most important objective would be to use this match to test his current abilities!
"If you don't bring out something stronger, you will lose." Xue Ying's voice reverberated.
In the distance, the two princes and their protectors were all staring in a daze.
A Paragon dared to act so rampantly? Xue Ying had the upper hand, yet he still wished for the other party to bring out a stronger power? Wasn't that too arrogant of him?
"Very good, very good." The Red Devil God-Emperor was also enraged. He roared, "I came to the Devil Mountain Cosmos for the sake of tempering myself. Who would have thought that you could force me to reveal my strongest power? Very good, very good…"
His single eye suddenly turned snowy-white.
"Hong!"
It was a vast expanse of whiteness!
A severe chill rapidly spread out and covered the entire place. Some of the arrays had even started to break after being frozen by this chill. His Highness Jiao Yun Liu and the other protectors were hiding in his palace, peering at this scene.
The bloody Slaughter Domain was still rolling and fluctuating, albeit at a much slower pace. It had been suppressed.
Xue Ying's body seemed to be corporeal, yet it also seemed to be ethereal. Despite that, he was able to feel that terrifying chill permeating into the Mirage World and into his body.
"It seems that it isn't easy to defeat a Ruler." Xue Ying looked at the distant Red Devil God-Emperor. A layer of white armor had formed around the Red Devil God-Emperor's body, and his aura had become much stronger.
"The last time I unleashed this strongest power of mine was when the Devil Mountain Cosmos conquered my hometown." Red Devil God-Emperor shouted in rage. "Since a Paragon like you wishes to die, then I'll gladly send you to meet your maker!"
Red Devil God-Emperor was truly gone berserk.
Witnessing this scene, however, a smirk formed on Xue Ying's lips.

chapters.title: Chapter 743 - End of Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 743: End of Battle
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The surroundings were filled with a bone-chilling frost. Some of the arrays had frozen and shattered, and many locations on the planet had even started experiencing snowfall. As the eldest prince "Jiao Yun Teng", Cha Yun Nong, and the other protectors watched on from a distance, they were fortunate that Red Devil God-Emperor controlled the frost to avoid them. They were just slightly affected but remained shivering in the cold.
The main target, Xue Ying, had instead revealed a grin. Seeing Red Devil God-Emperor going berserk in rage, "Maybe, it will be me sending you to death!"
"Hahaha…"
"Hong!"
Laughing in rage, Red Devil God-Emperor was garbed in a white armor and wielded a huge saber as he leaped towards Xue Ying.
Xue Ying just stood there, a blood wave rolling around him. In the end, this was just an imitation and not the authentic 'Slaughter Domain', and was formed by combining the Dao of Slaughter and the Dao of Ripple. Furthermore, Xue Ying had not reached eternity in either Dao; the Slaughter Domain was suppressed by the endless frost.
But…
Xue Ying remained standing there with his silver spear. He was chuckling as Red Devil God-Emperor charged over.
The huge saber slashed down like a bolt of lightning, with an even greater force than before.
"Hua." Xue Ying revolved the spear in his hand. He parried against the blade with a profound move. With how strong his physique was, he did not even take a step back from the attack. Instead, it was Red Devil God-Emperor who was forced a few steps back.
"My speed has decreased?" Xue Ying frowned. The surrounding space was filled with an endless frost that could suppress the Slaughter Domain, and could similarly hinder Xue Ying's every action.
"I admit that you are very powerful. But you are still inadequate to challenge a Ruler!" Red Devil God-Emperor's voice boomed and reverberated. At the same time, his figure became unpredictable as he launched assaults on Xue Ying from all directions. With the God-Emperor unleashing his absolute move, his strength and speed were both significantly boosted. Xue Ying remained affected by the God-Emperor's move, and at this moment, was disadvantaged in terms of speed.
But relying on his spear, his defense remained air-tight.
'His body isn't affected by my move at all?' Red Devil God-Emperor might be attacking Xue Ying in a frenzy, but he felt anxiety in his heart. Based on his past experience, an ordinary Ruler would usually be heavily injured upon coming into contact with this frost. Furthermore, their rate of recovery would be significantly reduced under the frost energy. If they were exposed to it for an extended period, it was possible for them to die after expending their life force.
But Xue Ying stood there, unmoving. Even though his speed had decreased, his body did not seem to have any wounds at all!
Red Devil God-Emperor was unaware that having the Dao of Mirage, together with the 'Voidwalker lineage', Xue Ying's survival capabilities was not inferior to Monarch Hex Cricket. Even though he was a Paragon, his survival capabilities could make Rulers who were not as good at surviving to be extremely envious!
"Hu." When Red Devil God-Emperor continued to send attacks at him, Xue Ying suddenly vanished.
"He disappeared?" Red Devil God-Emperor's expression changed. He looked around him as his eye continued to release an endless frost into his surroundings, yet no matter how he tried, he could not sense Xue Ying at all. "I can't even determine his location?"
A faint light was released around Red Devil God-Emperor's figure. It was his law domain.
The law domain only covered a small region, yet his sensory abilities in this region were tremendously powerful.
"There he is!" Red Devil God-Emperor's expression spontaneously changed.
He had discovered Xue Ying, but at that instant, with the speed at which Xue Ying had struck out with his spear, the spear had already reached him.
"Pu." The spearhead contained many circular ripples. Those ripples were like a destructive force that wanted to tear everything apart. Red Devil God-Emperor did not have time to parry against it before the spearhead arrived at his chest.
"Ka-"
His white armor was damaged slightly, but the spearhead could not penetrate it.
Xue Ying immediately retracted his spear before disappearing once again.
"Where did he go now?" Red Devil God-Emperor searched in all directions. He was both anxious and shocked. This Paragon was too exceptional at hiding. Other than using his law domain to discover the enemy, he had no other methods which could detect Xue Ying! Nonetheless, the region of his law domain covered was too small-it was limited to an area 1,000 meters around him. This distance was too short for experts on their level.
…
The Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu, the Eldest Prince Jiao Yun Teng, and their subordinates were watching on nervously.
They would never have thought the battle would have unfolded like this.
Red Devil God-Emperor had unleashed his secret move, which they had never seen before-the terrifying frost had enshrouded all directions. It could both assault the enemy and suppress the enemy. Furthermore, Red Devil God-Emperor's personal strength surged rapidly, and his defense had become very outstanding, thanks to the white armor he wore.
But that mysterious Protector Dong Bo could actually completely disappeared… sending sneak attacks time after time!
"Even Rulers can't discover him at all. If he wanted to sneak up on us, could we still survive?" The spectating protectors were muttering to themselves.
"Sneak attacks? We're so much weaker than him, do you think needs sneak attacks to wipe us out?"
These protectors were utterly stunned. They even held admiration and worship for Xue Ying.
******
In the Mirage World, Xue Ying frowned slightly. He had utilized two evasive maneuvers at the same time-one was the Mirage World, and the other was the Void Evasive Maneuver! His speed of traveling within the Mirage World was much higher, as it was a world he had personally created. Using the Void Concealment within the Mirage World… significantly improved his concealment.
One was a law-related concealing technique, and the other was a concealing technique that the Voidwalker system specialized in. The two techniques worked perfectly together.
It caused a Ruler, the 'Red Devil God-Emperor', to have to rely on his law domain just to detect Xue Ying.
'Just an average Ruler! He is even a Ruler who has become a protector under the eldest prince. This Ruler… is actually so tough to defeat.' Xue Ying inwardly disapproved. 'I'll try utilizing the Termination Energy. If that can't break apart his defense, then it will be impossible for me to win.'
Termination Energy.
That was one of the Voidwalkers" three great techniques. The three techniques were none other than the Voidwalker body, the Void Evasive Maneuver, and Termination Energy.
Termination Energy was obtained from the purification of the incredibly destructive leftover energy that the body could not process when absorbing Primal Chaos Void Energy. This purified energy would eventually condense into a unique energy that held great offensive strength. It was thus called-Termination Energy!
"Termination Energy." Xue Ying grabbed his silver spear. From his palm, a black light film formed, spreading down the shaft of the spear. Soon after, the spear was entirely covered in the black light, and even the spearhead was covered. The black light film was continuously undulating, and it seemed to be continually cutting everything around it.
"Kill."
Spinning the spear, it was like a Flood Dragon had jumped out of the sea. It brought with it a frighteningly murderous aura right from the Mirage World into the ordinary world, penetrating through the law domain and piercing right towards Red Devil God-Emperor.
The spear moved too quickly.
Xue Ying, who was hiding in the Mirage World, wasn't as much influenced by the frost energy. Thus, the influence on his speed was negligible.
"Pu."
Red Devil God-Emperor turned around, only to see the spear and its afterimages arriving in front of him, only that this time, it was slightly strange. Other than the many bloody ripples on the spearhead, it was actually covered by a layer of black light. Even the entire spear was covered by that black light.

chapters.title: Chapter 744 - Helping Others after benefiting from them
chapters.content:
Chapter 744: Helping Others after benefiting from them
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
"What is this?" The Red Devil God-Emperor had never seen that before, but he instinctively felt threatened. Regardless, he did not have the time to defend against the incoming attack.
The spearhead pierced into the pauldrons on his white armor. This time, however, the tip of the spear directly penetrated into the armor and into his body. In this instant, the Termination Energy accumulated on the spearhead spontaneously exploded, and along with ripples of slaughter energy, propagated through Red Devil God-Emperor's entire body.
Red Devil God-Emperor immediately turned flushed. He immediately directed the frost energy to freeze his body, doing his utmost to protect his body and remove the horrifying Termination Energy and Slaughter ripples.
Xue Ying immediately retrieved his spear after his attack, preparing to strike again.
Red Devil God-Emperor's face was pale. Even though he had protected more than half his lifeforce by using his frost energy to freeze his body, he had lost at least 30%. Even though he would definitely be more wary of Xue Ying's subsequent attacks, he would probably die after 10 strikes from Xue Ying.
He had lost.
Red Devil God-Emperor clearly understood this. Even though he still had several unused moves, facing Xue Ying with his superior concealment abilities and his horrifying spear techniques… he knew that defeat was inevitable.
"I would never have thought that I, the Red Devil God-Emperor, will actually lose to a Paragon. Hahaha…" Red Devil God-Emperor laughed heartily. The lone eye of his regained its usual calm, and he retracted his frost energy. However, at the same time, many incarnations began appearing around him. His real body disappeared and hid amongst the incarnations. The incarnations began to escape in all directions.
"Escaping?"
Xue Ying also appeared.
A blood wave suddenly exploded outward from Xue Ying, and his Slaughter Domain crazily expanded in all directions. This time, the speed of the expansion was clearly much faster than before. However, Red Devil God-Emperor was clearly desperate, as all his incarnations were fleeing madly.
"Hong~" The undulating blood wave reached the eldest prince Jiao Yun Teng within moments. Jiao Yun Teng's expression had a massive change as he saw the incoming blood wave. He clearly understood that he could not defend against the power of this Slaughter Domain.
"Don't kill him. Capture him alive!" Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu suddenly shouted.
Immediately after the shout sounded out, the section of the blood wave in front of the eldest prince parted open, avoiding him, continuing in pursuit of the escaping incarnations.
However, the incarnations were too fast, and the range of the protective arrays on the planet was too small. Thus, although a portion of the incarnations belonging to the Red Devil God-Emperor had been 'submerged' by the Slaughter Domain and dissipated, a large number of incarnations had successfully escaped out of the reach of the arrays. Having escaped the arrays, Red Devil God-Emperor immediately vanished. He had no intention of saving the eldest prince, as it was utterly pointless to even try. If he were to push his luck, it might just cost him his life.
Even though it was just an avatar, Red Devil God-Emperor did not wish to die!
Being defeated by a Paragon and being killed by a Paragon were two very different outcomes! Red Devil God-Emperor still had his dignity and wanted to maintain his reputation.
…
"Hu."
Red Devil God-Emperor appeared in the starry sky far away from the scene of the battle. He looked around, and only then did he dare to relax. He felt slightly helpless, and could only sigh.
"Such a disgrace."
"My hometown cosmos has been conquered! Coming to this Devil Mountain Cosmos, I originally wanted to visit the 'Primogenitor Devil Mountain', yet I was utterly crushed to death. For the sake of obtaining enough resources for cultivation, I decided to rely on the eldest prince of a Void God clan. I would never have expected to suffer defeat at the hands of a Paragon." Red Devil God-Emperor shook his head. Even though he did not save the eldest prince, he couldn't care less.
After all, it was the eldest prince who had sought his help!
He was a Ruler. Any of the princes from the three Void God clans, as long as they were not Rulers themselves, would all have a great desire to rope him in.
However, a Ruler becoming the protector of a Paragon was already quite a disgraceful act.
"I've lost a great deal of my reputation this time. Such a huge matter was clearly witnessed by the two princes and many protectors. It will probably spread quickly across the entire Devil Mountain Cosmos! There are also powerful experts from other cosmos. Dong Bo Xue Ying will become famous by destroying my reputation." Red Devil God-Emperor felt anguish. Although this was a bitter pill to swallow, he accepted it wholeheartedly, having responded to Xue Ying's provocations and being forced to display his full strength.
Having been defeated when he was using his full strength, there was nothing he could say.
******
The blood wave rolled out, surrounding the eldest prince Jiao Yun Teng and his subordinates.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying." The eldest prince squeezed out a smile. He offered, "You must have obtained many benefits from my little brother right? Whatever he is giving you, I can definitely give you more!"
"It's too late for that."
Xue Ying answered cooly.
In the past, he needed an opportunity to interact with other cultivation systems. Now that he got whatever he wished for, he could only rely on his own cultivation in the future.
"Protector Dong Bo." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu, Shan Dan, Protector Cong, and the other protectors flew over to where Xue Ying was-along a cleared path within the blood waves. The protectors were looking at Xue Ying with shock and admiration. This was just like how Paragons viewed 'Monarch Green' in the Cultivator Cosmos! And at this moment, Xue Ying's power was even more ridiculous. He had also opened three Daos, and two Daos had already reached the bottleneck. The Dao of Ripple had also reached the pinnacle. More importantly, he had the tremendously strong 'Voidwalker lineage inheritance'. All these made him much stronger than Monarch Green in the past.
""Your Highness." Xue Ying asked. "Who should I kill?"
"Kill all other protectors. Leave only my eldest brother and Cha Yun Nong." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu looked at Xue Ying. "Protector Dong Bo, if you have any opinion about this, please do say."
Xue Ying did not respond.
The surrounding blood wave enshrouded the protectors with a single undulation. Xue Ying did not have any bad blood with the other protectors, although throughout the long competition between the two princes, the Third Highness" protectors had lost their lives many times over. If not for him, his own team would undoubtedly have been massacred. Xue Ying would naturally not be soft in his decision! After all, they were only avatars, and killing them would at most cost them their treasures.
The Slaughter Domain pulsed once again, and the other protectors were instantly eradicated, leaving behind Cha Yun Nong and the eldest prince 'Jiao Yun Teng".
"Jiao Yun Teng, my older brother. Have you ever thought that this day will come for you?" The Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu's body was trembling slightly.
The eldest prince Jiao Yun Teng did not look at his little brother. Instead, he was staring at Xue Ying. "What exactly did my little brother give you?"
"The techniques of other cultivation systems and some absolute arts." Xue Ying answered.
"Just that?" The eldest prince was in disbelief.
The Devil Mountain Cosmos was very encompassing of outsiders and was very easy-going with regards to imparting techniques. Although absolute arts were more precious, to people which statuses such as the eldest and third princes, these arts were not considered much.
"A spear, a robe-armor and a warship." Xue Ying replied.
The eldest prince was speechless.
This was the default set of items every protector serving a prince would receive.
"Nothing else?" The eldest prince looked at Xue Ying before turning to the Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu. "My little brother, your fortune is terribly good."
"I can give you ten or a hundred times more. Are you willing to become my protector?" The eldest prince looked at Xue Ying.
"I can do likewise!" Third Highness shouted out. He was honestly feeling anxious.
"Helping others after receiving favors." Xue Ying simply stated, saying nothing more.
The bones of Xue Ying were filled with the spirit of karma-to take revenge on those who offended him, and to repay kindness to those who treated him well. During the past 30 million years, the Third Highness had provided him quite a lot of help. Thus, he was filled with gratitude towards the Third Highness. Naturally, he would repay this favor.
The eldest prince Jiao Yun Teng knew that it was pointless to persuade Xue Ying. Such a heaven-shattering Paragon would naturally be proud and aloof. Jiao Yun Teng said indistinctly, "My little brother has the Black Devil Sacred Fruits. The Black Devil Sacred Fruits may not be that useful for other cultivation systems, but it is a priceless treasure to those of our bloodline cultivation system. Why not kill my little brother and snatch the Black Devil Sacred Fruits? You could exchange the Black Devil Sacred Fruits could for benefits that will far surpass your imaginations."
Jiao Yun Teng watched as the Third Prince Jiao Yun Liu's expression turn ashen-gray. "Little brother, it is hard to say for certain that who will win or who will lose. The Black Devil Sacred Fruits? If I can't get them, then no one can!"
"Peng!"
Jiao Yun Teng's body suddenly exploded.
However, the rolling blood wave easily covered the explosion, and the shockwaves from the explosion were dissipated by the "Slaughter Domain".
Silence pervaded the area. Shan Dan, Protector Cong, and others turned to the third prince and Xue Ying.
Black Devil Sacred Fruits?
"There remains Cha Yun Nong's true body. Your Highness, you can deal with him yourself." Xue Ying said before causing the endless blood wave to dissipate. There was just a single Cha Yun Nong left behind. It was easy for His Highness and the group of protectors to kill him.
"Protector Dong Bo? Brother Dong Bo?" His Highness Jiao Yun Liu looked at Xue Ying. He could not help but feel emotional and glad at the same time.
"Your Highness." Cha Yun Nong shouted out at this moment.
Jiao Yun Liu's expression shifted. He turned over with a look of indignation. "You still have the cheek to shout for me? I've trusted you for so long. I must have been blind during the past. Kill him."
Instantly, all the protectors were glaring at Cha Yun Nong with surging killing intent.
…
Jiao Yun Liu brought Xue Ying into the palace. He sat down in the hall facing Xue Ying. The maidservants brought wine over for them.
There was still snow left outside-it was snow created by the frost energy from Red Devil God-Emperor.
Jiao Yun Liu personally poured wine for Xue Ying, chuckling, "I would never have expected myself to have the fortune of having Brother Dong Bo become my protector. From this day on, Brother Dong Bo will no longer be my protector. Instead, you will be my brother. If you think I am worthy of being so, then come and drink this cup of wine." He personally placed the cup of wine right in front of Xue Ying.
Xue Ying received the cup of wine. "Many thanks, Your Highness."
The two toasted and downed the wine.
"Hahaha…" Jiao Yun Liu's current mood was terrific. "This time, Brother Dong Bo was able to defeat Red Devil God-Emperor. It is truly amazing for a Paragon to defeat a Ruler. I believe that the news will quickly spread across the entire Devil Mountain Cosmos, and then to many other cosmoses. The moment this news is spread, there will likely be some things happening."
"Some things happening?" Xue Ying revealed a look of surprise. "I hope that Your Highness could advise me on the situation."
Xue Ying had occasionally chatted with the protectors during his extended stay here, allowing him to gain a greater understanding of the Devil Mountain Cosmos. He also understood what defeating Red Devil God-Emperor meant. Naturally, his understanding could not compare to the third prince's knowledge and information.
Furthermore, revealing his power was part of his plan.
His teacher, Bloodshed God-Emperor, had discussed with him long before: "Xue Ying, if you are forced to, you do not have to hide the techniques of our cultivation system from the Devil Mountain Cosmos. The Laws and Profound Mysteries system is not some huge secret within the boundless Primal Chaos Void. What our system emphasizes the most is comprehension ability! Thus, it will not mean anything even if it was spread about. Without having the guidance of seniors, cultivating it will be tough. Your mission is to collect everything that would be of help to our cosmos, whether cultivation systems, magical spells, or other techniques."
Xue Ying had made adequate preparations.
With his current realm, he had long cultivated the avatar technique which his teacher had given him; he had another avatar hiding within the Devil Mountain Cosmos! After all, the flow of time was more than 3,000 faster here, and it would be helpful to his cultivation.
"You could have heard of this from the other protectors, but they do not know much about it." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu poured wine for himself. At the same time, he said rather proudly. "So allow me to explain it to you in detail."

chapters.title: Chapter 745 - The Ultimate Aim
chapters.content:
Chapter 745: The Ultimate Aim
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
"Brother Dong Bo, my Devil Mountain Cosmos treats experts from other races equally. There is no discrimination at all." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu chuckled. "Why do you think we do this?"
"Oh?" Xue Ying was listening carefully.
"It is an order given by the primogenitor. All the descendants of his bloodline, including me, do not dare disobey him." Jiao Yun Liu lowered his voice. "You should have heard this before, that in our bloodline cultivation system, because the many lifeforms of our entire cosmos all originate from the primogenitor, hence the primogenitor himself has an unfathomable strength. In the future, when this cosmos epoch ends, we will leave this cosmos and become the primogenitor's subordinates."
Xue Ying was drinking his wine slowly, but after hearing what the other party said, he could not help but pause.
"I've told you a secret.'
Jiao Yun Liu's voice became even softer. "My clan's primogenitor is in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. The Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World was created by both my clan's primogenitor and another existence on the same level!"
Xue Ying's pupils dilated. He felt a great shock in his heart.
Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World?
This…
Wasn't that the place where Forefather Tian Yu and Lake Heart Island master were at? The cultivators of his own cosmos would also eventually leave for the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World and become subordinates under their forefather.
So the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World was actually created by the primogenitor of the Devil Mountain Cosmos and another existence?
"In the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, my clan's ancestor has a great status." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu said. "There are an innumerable number of living beings who wish to become subordinates of the primogenitor. Furthermore, the primogenitor treats lifeforms from other cosmoses equally. Thus, Brother Dong Bo, with your power, even if your hometown has no Void Gods, our Devil Mountain Cosmos has several! You can definitely bring your people over with us as we set off for the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. However, the time flow in our cosmos is much faster. Thus, the moment a cosmos epoch ends in our cosmos, only a short period would have passed in other cosmoses."
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded. "The time flow difference is truly ridiculous."
"Hahaha… this is also because the primogenitor wanted to have more powerful descendants." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu added.
Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
This Devil Mountain Cosmos honestly had a huge backing! One day, he would seek out Forefather Tian Yu and the Lake Heart Island master. That sacred world was also where the experts of the Devil Mountain Cosmos were located. Thus, it would definitely be advantageous for him to maintain good relationships with them. Who knows if the other party had a more significant influence and power than Forefather Tian Yu?
"Our Devil Mountain Cosmos is easily connected to other cosmoses, forming all sorts of cosmos passages." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu said. "Allowing many different types of cultivation systems to clash with one another is a great boon to our cultivation."
"But…"
"Other than the collision of different systems and a time flow that far surpasses other cosmoses, the primogenitor himself had even left behind a "Primogenitor Devil Mountain"." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu mentioned.
'It's here.'
Xue Ying felt a jolt in his heart.
Even if Red Devil God-Emperor had not charged over, the original plan was for Xue Ying to cultivate the "Walker's Hidden Secret" to the ninth or tenth level and increase his strength, before finding an opportunity to reveal his strength. Now that he had revealed his strength before he intended to… it was not actually a big deal to him! He was confident of his strength, in addition to his advantage in using the laws and profound mysteries.
Arriving at this Devil Mountain Cosmos, other than having a time flow of more than 3,000 times faster than other cosmoses which enabled him to improve his cultivation, the other more important reason was for the so-called legendary 'Primogenitor Devil Mountain'.
As he was chatting with the other protectors, he had naturally heard of how mysterious the Primogenitor Devil Mountain was.
Xue Ying had long mentioned this place to Bloodshed God-Emperor. Naturally, he had some ideas about how he should deal with this matter.
"The Primogenitor Devil Mountain was left behind by the primogenitor. It is a truly mystical cultivation ground." Jiao Yun Liu explained. "Cultivating there will allow your strength to grow even faster. You will understand after visiting it. After all, I have yet to personally experience it."
Having said that, the Jiao Yun Liu's eyes were filled with desire.
He was the son of a Void God and had a similar desire to visit the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. However, no one dared to break a commandment set by the primogenitor.
"The Primogenitor Devil Mountain is extremely mysterious. But how exactly is it mysterious? You will have to enter before you can find out why."
"It is separated into different layers-the core layer, the inner layer, and the outer layer."
"The rules set by the primogenitor… ensured that only the strongest Rulers, and those who reached the Void God realm, could enter the core layer." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu said. "There is only a single Ruler who could enter the core layer, and he is also the strongest amongst the Rulers. It seems that there is very little hope for me to ever enter that place in this life."
"Allegedly, the inner layer is made up by nine array hubs. Every single array hub contains a cavern dwelling where only one can enter. The rule set by the primogenitor is that only the strongest Paragon and eight other Rulers can enter the inner layer."
"As for the outer layer, there are 32 array bases and 32 cavern dwellings! The primogenitor ordered that only 30 Rulers and two strongest Paragons could enter."
Jiao Yun Liu helplessly stated. "Thus, there could be at most 39 Rulers, three Paragons and the Void Gods entering the Primogenitor Devil Mountain."
"And there are more than 200 Rulers in our Devil Mountain Cosmos. Furthermore, adding another 100 Rulers coming from other cosmoses, think how difficult it is to rank in the top 39?" Jiao Yun Liu shook his head.
Xue Ying sighed.
It was indeed challenging.
There were too many Rulers in the Devil Mountain Cosmos. Accounting for Rulers from other cosmoses, there were more than 300 of them! Thus, only one-tenth of the Rulers had the opportunity to enter the place.
"And how many Paragons are there?" Xue Ying asked.
"Our Devil Mountain Cosmos should have more than a thousand Paragons, with a few hundred Paragons originating from other cosmoses. In the end, only three can enter." Jiao Yun Liu sighed. "Out of the three Paragons, two are from other races, and one is from our Devil Mountain Cosmos."
Jiao Yun Liu's eyes brightened as he looked at Xue Ying. "Brother Dong Bo, the reason why I mentioned these to you is that even if there are only three Paragons who could enter the Primogenitor Devil Mountain and that they are all terrifying… only the top two have defeated Rulers before. The third could barely fight to a draw against a Ruler."
"You could defeat Red Devil God-Emperor." Jiao Yun Liu continued. "Red Devil God-Emperor might not be a God-Emperor that is too formidable-he did not have the qualifications to enter the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, but he isn't too weak. Since you could defeat him, you should have the chance of becoming a paragon who could challenge for entry into the Primogenitor Devil Mountain."
"By then, after you enter the Primogenitor Devil Mountain… ze ze, I've dreamt of entering that place. The greatest honor of every single cultivator from our entire Devil Mountain Cosmos would be to enter the Primogenitor Devil Mountain!"
Xue Ying nodded.
It was not too easy to get an opportunity to enter the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. There were already three Paragons inside, so if he wanted to enter, he had to force one out.
One had to know…
Two out of the three current Paragons could defeat a Ruler.
Those from the Cultivator Cosmos like Monarch Green and Pang Yi-Monarch Green had never defeated a Ruler when he was a Paragon. At the very most, he could fight to a standstill with a Ruler. And 'Pang Yi' may have defeated a Ruler when he was a Paragon, but that was against Bloody Ruler who hid his strength.
Thus, based on past incidents, it was challenging for a Paragon to defeat a Ruler.
Amongst all the Paragons from the "Devil Mountain Cosmos" and the many other cosmoses, those were the three most outstanding ones. These were Paragons who had comprehended multiple different kinds of cultivation system, and have emerged as the top three! Furthermore, they had cultivated for a long period in the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, and their combat power was unfathomable! Even Xue Ying did not have confidence in defeating them in a fight. His original plan was to cultivate Walker's Hidden Secret to a more profound stage before entering, but who would have thought that the battle with Red Devil God-Emperor would have occurred!
'Let's just try it out.'
'Even if I fail, I can always attempt it a second time.' Xue Ying did not have any thoughts of backing off. After all, the war in his hometown could erupt at any time. Thus, the earlier he entered the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, the better.
His Highness Jiao Yun Liu spoke to him about some other relevant matters, though he too was not privy to much more information. After all, his strength was too lacking with regards to the entry criteria for the Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
"Alright. I've told you everything I know. Brother Dong Bo, I'll not accompany you any further, and go on to cultivate." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu stood up. He was deeply moved after the earlier incident. "This time, it is all because of Brother Dong Bo that I was able to keep the Black Devil Sacred Fruits. I owe you a great favor."
"Protecting Your Highness is something which I ought to do." Xue Ying stood up too.
"No no no, if you had betrayed me, or snatched the Black Devil Sacred Fruits away from me, I would have no way of resisting." Jiao Yun Liu said. "This favor is something I'll engrave forever in my mind. But for now, I'll enter closed-door cultivation."
"Go on, go on. You don't have to care about me." Xue Ying laughed. He knew that Jiao Yun Liu had waited far too long about going to cultivate.
Jiao Yun Liu laughed back before leaving.
Xue Ying's gaze turned cold. He murmured. "Primogenitor Devil Mountain…"
…
In the Cultivator Cosmos, within the small courtyard located inside the Bloodshed God Palace.
A white-robed teenager appeared. He was an incarnation of Xue Ying.
"Teacher." Xue Ying looked towards Bloodshed God-Emperor, who had just walked out.
"Xue Ying?" Bloodshed God-Emperor asked, "Is there any news?"
"It seems like I'll be entering the Primogenitor Devil Mountain very soon." Xue Ying said, "The matter which Teacher has tasked me with, I'll definitely accomplish it. Are there any other things which Teacher wants me to do?"

chapters.title: Chapter 746 - The Arrival of the Void God
chapters.content:
Chapter 746: The Arrival of the Void God
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
"Just the two things which I mentioned earlier-the catalog and the Thousand-eyed Fire Bug's blood essence." Bloodshed God-Emperor said. "Those are the two most important things which I urgently need. As long as you complete any one of the tasks, it'll be good. And if you can accomplish both matters… then we will have a guaranteed victory in this war."
"I understand." Xue Ying nodded.
He had previously asked the Third Prince Jiao Yun Liu about these two extremely precious items that his teacher urgently required, yet Jiao Yun Liu had never heard of them before.
Clearly, he had to find someone more formidable and with a greater influence in the Devil Mountain Cosmos. With so many Rulers present in the Devil Mountain Cosmos, there would certainly be a higher chance of finding the elusive treasures that the Bloodshed God-Emperor and the others could not find.
"Then disciple will withdraw for now." Xue Ying said.
"You must be careful in every single thing you do. We already have the advantage in this war with the Ancestor Mother Religion. What we are trying to do is to improve our chances of achieving victory. Thus, it is better for you not to stake your life and push too far." Bloodshed God-Emperor reminded him. "Even though you have avatars, and seem to be in a safe situation, the methods of a Void God far transcend your imaginations. Furthermore, that Primogenitor Devil Mountain has an extraordinary origin. Everything must be done according to its rules.""
"I know." Xue Ying laughed. He then bid farewell to his teacher.
Seeing the Xue Ying's incarnation dissipating, Bloodshed God-Emperor's eyes were filled with expectations. The two matters which he had entrusted to Xue Ying were extremely critical.
'Yi? Xue Ying said before that it is tough to enter the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. Does he have the confidence of doing so?' Bloodshed God-Emperor thought. 'Unless that Third Highness has provided some assistance?'
What information he had regarding the Primogenitor Devil Mountain had come from Xue Ying. Naturally, he knew very little about it.
Thus, he did not understand how difficult it was to gain entry into the place.
******
Xue Ying was not in a rush to set off. Instead, he remained on that planet. It was primarily because His Highness Jiao Yun Liu had mentioned that after he finished cultivating, he would personally send Xue Ying over.
He, as an ignorant outsider, would be better off having His Highness Jiao Yun Liu sending him over. Xue Ying was taking this opportunity to reflect over the battle he had with Red Devil God-Emperor, consolidating his experiences.
"Hua hua hua~"
Suddenly, a torrential rain starting pouring down. The entire world was covered in a blanket of rain.
"Hahaha, hahaha…" Accompanying that, a laughter resounded all across the planet, and a terrifying aura abruptly surged.
"Mn?"
The many protectors could sense this terrifying aura. Xue Ying had also exited from his cultivation. They were looking towards to His Highness" palace in the distance.
One could see a figure standing in midair above the palace. It was His Highness Jiao Yun Liu wearing a scarlet armor. At this moment, a red wave was surging across the surface of his body. His terrifying aura rushed up into the sky, causing the entire planet to tremble. It was fortunate that arrays were protecting the planet; otherwise, it would already have been destroyed.
"Congratulations, your highness. Congratulations, your highness." Many shouts immediately sounded out from the protectors.
The other protectors were also rushing over.
"He has already become a Ruler?" Xue Ying felt slightly startled. Even though it was challenging for someone in the bloodline cultivation system to reach the Ruler realm, comparatively speaking, it was easier than that using the Laws and Profound Mysteries system. At least, they could rely on external aids like the 'Black Devil Sacred Fruits' to significantly increase the chances of a breakthrough. And now, His Highness Jiao Yun Liu had succeeded.
The Ruler realm! How difficult was it to reach the Ruler realm using the laws and profound mysteries system? His own Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter had been cultivated to their limits, yet the path to achieving eternity was still muddled and unclear.
Even though he felt slightly disappointed, Xue Ying still flew over. He congratulated the excited and incomparably thrilled prince. "Congratulations, your highness, for breaking through to the Ruler realm."
"Haha."
His Highness Jiao Yun Liu looked towards Xue Ying. The way he interacted with the other protectors would naturally change, as the gap between Rulers and Paragons was ultimately too large. However, Jiao Yun Liu was still relatively polite towards Xue Ying. This was due to his belief that with Protector Dong Bo's talent, he wouldn't have any problems becoming a Ruler. When he did become one, he would definitely be outstanding amongst the Rulers. It was even possible that he would eventually travel to the "Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World", and Jiao Yun Liu would definitely contact him frequently.
"Brother Dong Bo, this would only be possible thanks to you. Without the Black Devil Sacred Fruits, I would have had to rely on myself, and I don't know just how long I would have taken to break through." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu sighed.
"The Black Devil Sacred Fruits are external aids. To break through, you will still have to depend on yourself." Xue Ying added. "Having broken through, it clearly means that Your Highness has built an adequate foundation."
Jiao Yun Liu chuckled.
That's right.
He had felt repressed for far too long! For the sake of breaking through, he had even attempted to cultivate other systems, spending a considerable amount of effort and concentration to do so. His foundation was indeed extremely solid, and he had finally broken through to the next realm! He had reached a higher realm in life. Previously, Xue Ying could have easily killed the third prince. However, if they were to fight now, it would be tough to determine the victor.
Being able to beat Red Devil God-Emperor did not imply that he could also beat the Third Highness as he was now.
"I did say that after I exit from my closed-door cultivation, I'll personally send you to the Primogenitor Devil Mountain." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu laughed. "Even though I am not qualified, I am very familiar with those who protect the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. I know some of the basic regulations of that place too."
"Many thanks, Your Highness." Xue Ying thanked him.
"Haha, now that I am a Ruler, I would want to try my luck in getting into the Primogenitor Devil Mountain after cultivating further for some time." Jiao Yun Liu chuckled. "There are only three Paragons who can get in, so I never harbored that thought. But a total of 39 Rulers can get into the Primogenitor Devil Mountain… with my father's help, I should have a fighting chance after cultivating further for some time."
"Even with my help, you aren't fully confident?" A hoarse voice sounded.
Xue Ying was frightened the moment he heard that voice. Jiao Yun Liu turned over with shock too. The two of them saw a male standing in midair close by. This male was covered entirely in crimson scales, though the scale on his forehead was white. His silver eyes were cold as if he was looking down on everyone else as if they were all ants.
"Father." Jiao Yun Liu hurriedly greeted with a bow.
"Monarch." All the protectors bowed and greeted him too, Xue Ying included.
None of them were fools. They understood that this man was one of the three Great Emperors with the highest status in the Devil Mountain Cosmos, the patriarch of the Jiao Yun Clan-Great Emperor Jiao Yun!
The monarch was a more ordinary form of address within the Cultivator Cosmos.
But in the Devil Mountain Cosmos, 'King' referred to the Rulers! 'Monarch' was a term only Void Gods were qualified to have.
"Quite interesting."" Great Emperor Jiao Yun Liu said coldly.
The third prince Jiao Yun Liu revealed a joyful expression after hearing that. It had been too long since his father praised him. Since his birth, this was only the second time his father had done so.
"You are a Ruler, and also my son. Naturally, you must enter the Primogenitor Devil Mountain." Great Emperor Jiao Yun coldly stated. "Don't be too useless."
"Yes." Jiao Yun Liu obediently responded.
Great Emperor Jiao Yun turned to Xue Ying. That cold and emotionless silver eyes of his caused Xue Ying's heart to tighten. The aura emanating from the Great Emperor Jiao Yun was slightly more unique-it somehow gave off a feeling of being above the operating cosmic laws.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying." Great Emperor Jiao Yun stated. "I've heard of you. You defeated Red Devil. It is rare for a Paragon to be able to defeat a Ruler."
Xue Ying smiled and nodded with his head lowered.
He did not wish to form enemies in the Devil Mountain Cosmos. Naturally, he had to be obedient and respect the rules of this cosmos.
Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu added from the side. "Fortunately, there is Brother Dong Bo. If not, my Black Devil Sacred Fruits would have been snatched away."
Great Emperor Jiao Yun nodded. 'Your eldest brother was able to get the Red Devil to help him, and he achieved it with his own strength! You were able to get Dong Bo Xue Ying to help you, and this shows your worth. Dong Bo Xue Ying, you are strong enough to enter the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. Are you willing to go and fight against the other three Paragons?"
"I am definitely willing to do so." Xue Ying replied.
"Good. Let's go then."
Great Emperor Jiao Yun brought Xue Ying and the third prince along with a 'sou' after finishing his words. They instantaneously disappeared from the place.
At that moment, the other protectors present let out a sigh of relief. They were all feeling excited and shocked, as this was a once in a lifetime chance of meeting a Great Emperor!

chapters.title: Chapter 747 - Primogenitor Devil Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 747: Primogenitor Devil Mountain
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Just a moment later, Xue Ying and the third prince arrived at 'Primogenitor Devil Mountain' with the help of Great Emperor Jiao Yun.
"We are here." Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu looked excitedly in front of him.
Xue Ying also observed the place thoroughly. In the endless starry sky before him, there stood an enormous mountain shrouded in black fog. The mountain has a majestic presence, giving off the feeling that it was the center of this region; no, the center of the entire Devil Mountain Cosmos.
Around this Primogenitor Devil Mountain was a large number of meteorites. Every single meteorite was faintly glowing as it revolved. It was apparent that arrays were connecting all the meteorites together.
"Go." Great Emperor Jiao Yun coldly spoke before bringing the two forward at high speed. They turned into a stream of light before arcing through the sky and landing on one of the meteorites.
There were several stone houses built on the surface of the meteorite. At this moment, there was a gray-robed, black-scaled old man subserviently waiting for them on the surface of the meteorite. When Great Emperor Jiao Yun landed on the meteorite with the two others, he immediately greeted respectfully, "Monarch."
"Mn." Great Emperor Jiao Yun nodded. He then turned behind to face Xue Ying. "Dong Bo Xue Ying, this is Official E. The matter regarding your preparation to challenge the Paragons within the Primogenitor Devil Mountain will be arranged by him."
"Many thanks, Monarch." Xue Ying said. He turned towards that gray-robed, black-scaled old man and bowed slightly in greeting. "I'll have to trouble Ruler Official E."
The old man revealed a grin, though his appearance was ugly and savage. Even as he smiled, it felt quite a scary image. He revealed a mouthful of sharp teeth. "I've heard that Monarch Dong Bo is able to defeat Rulers. I truly admire you. Regarding your challenge with the Paragons currently in the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, all I can do is to guide you there, and that is merely a small matter. The outcome of the challenge lies firmly in your hands, Protector Dong Bo."
"Father, Brother Dong Bo has only spent a short time in our Devil Mountain Cosmos. He doesn't have enough experience fighting experts using other cultivation systems." Third Prince Jiao Yun Liu hurriedly added. He wanted his father to help Xue Ying.
Great Emperor Jiao Yun looked at his son.
He was cold and aloof.
However, he attached great importance to his three children. Allowing them to fight amongst one another was due to his strongly held belief that the weak would always fall prey to the strong, and was not an indication that he did not care about his children.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying." Great Emperor Jiao Yun fixed Xue Ying with a cold-eyed stare. "Tell me, what do you need my help for?"
Xue Ying was startled.
"There is only a single opportunity for you, so you better make the most of it." Great Emperor Jiao Yun coldly said. Just a single heaven-shattering Paragon was not worth his time; he didn't even pay much attention to most Rulers. Between a True God and a Void God… that was a huge barrier. The one line separating the two levels was extremely difficult to cross.
He did not place a heaven-shattering Paragon in his eyes. So what if he was a Ruler? Moving from True God to Void god… that was a huge barrier. It was truly difficult to break through this gap. Great Emperor Jiao Yun was clear also that the moment this cosmos epoch ended, they would be leaving for the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World to become subordinates of the primogenitor.
Those like the third prince and other True Gods wished to befriend Xue Ying.
But Great Emperor Jiao Yun and other Void Gods cast their vision further. They were too lazy to pay heed to those who did not reach the Void God level. But for his son's sake, he would give Xue Ying a chance.
Xue Ying could feel the other party's indifference. But he did not mind. He began stating his request, "This junior is in need of some items, though this junior could never find any traces of them."
For the sake of his hometown.
For the purpose of the final battle-that battle would determine the fate of countless lives. So what if the other party was cold and aloof?
"Carry on." Great Emperor Jiao Yun continued.
"This junior has always wanted to look for two materials. First is the legendary blood essence of a Thousand-eyed Fire Insect. The other is the "Myriad Catalog". This junior does not hope for the complete catalog, just the third volume would be sufficient." Xue Ying finished stating his request before looking at Great Emperor Jiao Yun.
Great Emperor Jiao Yun frowned as he glanced at Xue Ying. He coldly replied, "You are a Paragon, so why do you wish for the blood essence of a Thousand-eyed Fire Insect? Do you know what the Thousand-eyed Fire Insect is?"
"This junior does not know." Xue Ying shook his head.
"You dare to ask for it despite not knowing what it is." Great Emperor Jiao Yun sneered. The blood essence of the Thousand-eyed Fire Insect was so precious that even those at his level treated it as something extraordinary. He had merely seen it mentioned once in the books passed down by the primogenitor.
Xue Ying was not angry. He listened obediently, yet he sighed inwardly. It seemed that there was no hope of getting the blood essence of the Thousand-eyed Fire Insect. He wondered why his teacher Bloodshed God-Emperor wanted these treasures.
"It is impossible for me to help you with the Thousand-eyed Fire Insect blood essence. As for the "Myriad Catalog", I can give you the entire book." Great Emperor Jiao Yun said indifferently. "Someone will send the "Myriad Catalog" over to you soon. You should just wait for it here. Liu'er, let us go."
"Yes, father." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu did not dare to disobey his father. He could only look at Xue Ying and transmit a message. "You will have to depend on yourself from now on."
"I'm truly grateful for Your Highness" assistance." Xue Ying transmitted his reply.
Indeed, he felt genuine gratitude towards His Highness.
From the tone which the Bloodshed God-Emperor had used when entrusting those tasks to Xue Ying, he could tell that this was a matter of the highest importance. To complete one of them was already good news! After all, when he had previously asked the third prince about the items, the third prince had never heard of them. This Void God 'Great Emperor Jiao Yun' actually recognized the two items, though there was no hope of getting the blood essence of the Thousand-eyed Fire Insect. Instead, he had promised to give Xue Ying the complete Myriad Catalog.
"Many thanks, Monarch." Xue Ying respectfully thanked him.
Great Emperor Jiao Yun just brought the third prince and subsequently disappeared.
That 'Ruler Official E' chuckled. "Paragon Dong Bo, I'll have to briefly inform you about the rules before you challenge the Paragons within the Primogenitor Devil Mountain."
"Please do tell, Ruler Official E." Xue Ying replied.
"The three Paragons would not simply accept any challenge they receive. If that were the case, the three of them would probably have no time to cultivate, having to respond to the multitude of challenges." Ruler Official E said. "To challenge them… you must first defeat a puppet at the entrance of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. Only then will you be qualified to challenge them."
"To this date, only 11 Paragons have ever defeated the puppets." Ruler Official E chuckled as he looked at Xue Ying. "It is not an easy task."
"After defeating the puppet, Paragon Dong Bo will be qualified to battle the second and third Paragons within the Primogenitor Devil Mountain." Ruler Official E said. "And after you defeat one of them, their position will be moved back by one… and the fourth-ranking Paragon will naturally be chased out of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain."
"You can continue challenging the next Paragon after winning one battle. At that time, you can challenge the strongest Paragon." Ruler Official E said. "After you win, you will be the strongest Paragon and have the opportunity to enter the inner layer of Primogenitor Devil Mountain!"
"If you are defeated, you will have to wait for a million years before you can rechallenge them!"
Ruler Official E laughed. "Do you understand the rules now?"
"I do." Xue Ying nodded.
The moment he was defeated, he had to wait for a million years before he could rechallenge them. This prevented Paragons from repeatedly challenging the three Paragons within the Mountain. A million years was not too long, but it was also not a short period. It would not have a significant effect on cultivation.
"In a while, the "Myriad Catalog" will be sent over. How about this, you can rest here for a day before entering the Primogenitor Devil Mountain tomorrow. How about that?" Ruler Official E asked.
"Alright." Xue Ying nodded. He had already spent 30 million years waiting for this opportunity, so waiting one day was a small matter.
Ruler Official E smiled before turning into a stream of light, flying towards the Primogenitor Devil Mountain in the distance. Clearly, he was someone qualified to enter the Mountain!
Xue Ying turned around and casually chose a stone house.
The stone house contained operating arrays. It was quite clean, though he was not sure which expert had left this place behind.
Xue Ying sat down and crossed his legs. He waited silently.
Time passed…
After about an hour or so, a sweet-sounding voice came from outside. "Paragon Dong Bo!"
Xue Ying hurriedly exited the house.
There was a violet-scaled girl with a tail, with relatively beautiful features. She smiled, saying, "Paragon Dong Bo, as per the orders of Monarch, I've brought the "Myriad Catalog"." She passed a circular golden plate to Xue Ying.
Xue Ying received it, feeling exceptionally elated. He then replied, "Many thanks, Ruler."
That Great Emperor Jiao Yu's subordinates were all Rulers.
"It's a small matter." The girl chuckled before turning into a stream of light and leaving the meteorite. She soon teleported and disappeared from the vicinity.
Xue Ying lowered his head, looking at the"Myriad Catalog"in his hand. Sensing it lightly, he was able to feel the voluminous information within. Large amounts of information began surging into his mind. Only after the time taken to brew a cup of tea did the flow of information stop. There was apparently more information within the "Myriad Catalog", but he could not take in any more. The catalog contained a mystical array that prevented one from continuing to read on if one could not break it.
"This isn't about the Laws and Profound Mysteries system. Instead, it is a system for studying the 'hex' from the myriad existences?" Xue Ying was dumbstruck.
He currently had an understanding of many systems.
Talking about the degree of mystery, he felt that this 'hex' system was the only one that could compare with the system of the 'Laws and Profound Mysteries'.
"Why exactly does teacher need this for?" Xue Ying did not continue pondering about it after a while.
"Sou."
A figure descended in the distance. It was a red-robed Xue Ying, and that was the avatar which he had cultivated. Relying on the avatar technique his teacher provided, Xue Ying currently had three bodies.
The black-robed Xue Ying passed the circular golden plate to the red-robed Xue Ying.
"Sou." The red-robed Xue Ying rapidly left. He then utilized the Void Evasive Maneuver to proceed back to the cosmos passage at the highest speed. He was prepared to return to his hometown and immediately pass this treasure on to his teacher! Since it was vital to winning the war, the earlier he could get it to his teacher, the better it would be.

chapters.title: Chapter 748 - Entering the Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 748: Entering the Mountain
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
In the Cultivator Cosmos, within the little small wooden courtyard of Bloodshed God Palace.
The red-robed Xue Ying walked into the courtyard. Bloodshed God-Emperor, who had long sensed his presence, rushed out and looked toward his disciple. "Xue Ying, for your avatar to have rushed back from the Devil Mountain Cosmos, is it that you have found something?"
"Mn."
The red-robed Xue Ying nodded. "I've met one of the Void Gods in the Devil Mountain Cosmos fortuitously. Because of the third prince, I was able to try and ask him for help. There is no hope of getting the blood essence of Thousand-eyed Fire Insect. However, he gave me the entire "Myriad Catalog"." Upon saying that, he flipped his hand, causing a circular golden plate to appear, and he passed it to his teacher.
Bloodshed God-Emperor's eyes brightened. He looked at that circular gold plate with much excitement. Extending his hand, he gave it a slight sense before revealing a look of joy. A significant amount of information from the circular plate was rushing into his mind, and it was only after a few breaths did he finally regain his consciousness.
"Good, good, good." Bloodshed God-Emperor was so proud and aloof, yet at this moment, he was revealing a joyful expression. His gaze towards that circular gold plate was filled with great desire.
He had waited for this for far too long.
The two treasures he desired the most were the blood essence of the Thousand-eyed Fire Insect and the"Myriad Catalog". Since he knew the Devil Mountain Cosmos had a higher overall strength, and that it seemed their background was extraordinary-they were able to conquer eight other cosmoses and were linked with several other cosmoses-he had decided to request his own disciple to help him. He did not know how precious the blood essence of the Thousand-eyed Fire Insect would be, as he had only discovered a brief description of it within the inheritances. Instead, he understood more about the "Myriad Catalog".
He was ranked first in the Cultivator Cosmos for refinement, ranked first in attainments of arrays, precisely because he had obtained the first and second volume of the "Myriad Catalog". That was why he had such extraordinary accomplishments.
That's right.
Those two treasures were the reason for his surging strength.
After touching the threshold of the Void Gods, he had become much stronger and was able to fight five other Rulers-he had once injured the five Religious Leaders from the Ancestor Mother Religion. One could see how strong he was. Thus, the stronger he was, the more help he could provide for the cosmos. If he broke through and became a Void God! Then he could simply announce that the war was over.
"Xue Ying, I've sought after the "Myriad Catalog" for so long, and I would never have expected that it would be you who helped me find it." Bloodshed God-Emperor chuckled as he looked at Xue Ying.
"It is fortunate that Temporal Island Lord had discovered this cosmos passage then. Otherwise, it would have been impossible for me to enter the Devil Mountain Cosmos." Xue Ying said. "Thus, it's all thanks to luck."
"Without your strength, you wouldn't have achieved all of this." Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded. "You have to be careful there. Right now, are you going to the Primogenitor Devil Mountain?"
"I'm inside." Xue Ying nodded.
"Always be vigilant!" Bloodshed God-Emperor reminded him once again. He did not wish for this disciple of his to die in the Devil Mountain Cosmos!
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded.
…
In the core of the Devil Mountain Cosmos-'Primogenitor Devil Mountain'.
Within the 32 cavern dwellings in the outer layer of the entire Primogenitor Devil Mountain, there were 32 edges. At the entrance of one of the cavern dwellings, a white-haired girl was seated, enjoying some wine. Her expression was sullen, and her eyes were flashing with frost. "Dong Bo Xue Ying? Where did this Paragon pop up from? I've never heard of him. It seems that he should be from some unknown cosmos, yet he was actually able to defeat Red Devil God-Emperor?"
"A Paragon defeating a Ruler?"The white-haired girl said in a low voice. Her tone was chilly. "And now, he has entered the Primogenitor Devil Mountain and will probably be challenging me soon."
She was one of the three Paragons inside the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. She was the third-ranked 'Paragon Snow Goddess'.
She was cold and aloof, but she was powerful too. For the sake of power, she was ruthless towards everyone. Being able to rank third and enter the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, the price she had paid was far too high. Now, Xue Ying was about to enter, and it felt like dark clouds were enveloping her. She could feel the unseen pressure. After all, Xue Ying was unlike the past challengers-he had defeated Red Devil God-Emperor!
"No. I've forked out so much just to get entry into the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. This is my place, and I will absolutely not allow anyone else to snatch it away." The white-haired girl was anxious and furious at the same time. However, she could not think of a way out.
Because the rules of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain were strict, and no one dared to play with the rules.
"Go, go and scout that Dong Bo Xue Ying who has entered the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. If you discover anything at all, report to me immediately." The white-haired girl looked towards an old servant by her side. The servant was a puppet. Within the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, other than the Void Gods, the 39 Rulers, and three Paragons, there were no other genuine lifeforms. The rest were all puppets.
"Yes, master." The old servant acknowledged respectfully, before heading out of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
The white-haired girl held onto her wine cup. She could not help but smash the wine cup in her hands to smithereens, gritting her teeth. "No one should dare to think about snatching this spot from me. No one!"
******
Xue Ying, on the other hand, was leaving the meteorite, following the lead of 'Ruler Official E' and flying towards the entrance of Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
The two of them were rushed down, landing outside the entrance.
There was a huge platform by the entrance. Located deep beyond the stage was a single entrance. And by the side of the entrance, there were two words-'Devil Mountain'! The two huge words generated a heavy pressure that stifled Xue Ying's thoughts. He muttered inwardly, 'Those two words… were they left behind by the legendary primogenitor?'
There were only two words, yet the pressure he felt was this huge? Just how strong was that primogenitor?
"Hou~"
"Another brat has come?"
Two consecutive sounds seemed to ring out simultaneously.
By the two sides of the entrance, there were two cavern dwellings. A large monstrous puppet was walking out from one of them. This monstrous puppet looked quite like an ape-he had two long arms. However, there were two huge twisted horns on his head. His entire body was refined from a unique metal. As for the other puppet coming from the other cavern, she seemed to be an ordinary old granny leaning on a walking stick.
"Greetings, mountain protectors." Ruler Official E slightly bowed.
Xue Ying similarly greeted too.
"Is he the Paragon you mentioned, who will be taking on the challenge, Dong Bo Xue Ying?" The old granny leaning on a walking stick stared at Xue Ying.
"Yes." Ruler Official E said.
"Let's go." The old granny and the monster headed to one side. Xue Ying and Ruler Official E followed closely behind.
Not far off from the side of the entrance, there was a lake.
After the old granny and the monstrous puppet walked over, the old granny brought up her walking stick and casually waved it in the lake. "Hua~" A stream of water began flying up into the sky. It soon condensed into a silvery-white soldier. He landed on the ground, and confusion was present in his eyes.
"This is a puppet that has just been born. He is more foolish." The old granny casually said. "Even though it might be a puppet at the Ruler realm, but because he has just been born, he isn't that strong in battling, thus, making him appropriate as the target of your Paragon trial."
"Ruler realm puppet?" Xue Ying was slightly dumbstruck as he eyed that lake.
The lake was quiet. There were no ripples on the surface.
But just a stream of water was able to form a Ruler realm puppet? What exactly was this lake?
"Be careful." Ruler Official E said from the side. "Even though he has just been formed, he was created using Devil Lake Water. Within the entire Primogenitor Devil Mountain… according to my knowledge, the most unfathomable place would be this lake. Even Monarchs are helpless against it. A casual stream of water is able to form this small brat. Despite having just been born, he is quite powerful."
"I understand." Xue Ying nodded.
"Little doll." The old granny holding on to the walking stick lightly slapped the silvery-white soldier's shoulder and pointed at Xue Ying. "In a while, follow my orders. I'll let you fight with all your strength to kill him."
At this moment…
At another place above the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, there were other people, like the servant who came under the instructions of the white-haired girl and several other bored Rulers, watching the battle at the entrance. They had all heard of a rising Paragon called 'Xue Ying' who had defeated Red Devil God-Emperor. He was someone with high hopes of succeeding in his entry to the Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
"He is Dong Bo Xue Ying?"
"I've never heard of him before. I am not sure which cosmos he came from either." Those Rulers were all seated in groups or twos and threes. They were enjoying wine and chatting with each other while spectating this battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 749 - Paragon Snow Goddess Battling Style
chapters.content:
Chapter 749: Paragon Snow Goddess Battling Style
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Rulers, who were leisurely watching the battle, suddenly turned shocked as they saw the scene unfolding below-
Xue Ying had held onto the hands of the silvery-white soldier. The silvery-white soldier struggled-"weng weng weng~"-a terrifying force fluctuated in the surroundings. However, Xue Ying's hands remained unmoving as he held firmly onto the silvery-white soldier.
"Hah!" Xue Ying let out a shout and exerted his strength. He abruptly pulled both on both of the soldier's arms.
"Hong~"
The entire body of that silvery-white soldier exploded back into a stream of water. The stream returned back to the peaceful lake without forming a single ripple on the surface of the lake.
"He just won like this?"
"He actually defeated the water puppet soldier by relying solely on his strength? Just a single move?" Some Rulers had even forgotten to swallow the wine in their mouths. This scene was truly too shocking, because they clearly understood the strength of that water puppet soldier. As far as the records go, only 11 Paragons have been able to defeat this water puppet soldier. How difficult was it to rely solely on strength to destroy it? How frightening must his strength be?
"If we're talking about strength, this brat is probably stronger than me." A long-tailed, black-skinned, frail old man shook his head in dismay.
"Us Rulers aren't as good in body cultivation. We probably can't compare to this brat."
"His strength alone has already reached the Ruler realm. If he has other formidable methods, then he'll be even more amazing. In my opinion, he might threaten the strongest Paragon."
"It is indeed possible for him to threaten the top Paragon-Lie Yang."
The Rulers were making their judgments.
They were Rulers who could enter the Primogenitor Devil Mountain and were the top 39. All had extraordinary means and methods. Even though their bodies might be weaker than Xue Ying's, all of them still looked down on Xue Ying! Just like in the Cultivator Cosmos… Primal Master, Purgatory Ruler, and Pang Yi were all cultivating using the Laws and Profound Mysteries system. Although they could not compare with Xue Ying's current condition in terms of bodily strength, they were much more powerful!
…
"You won." The old protector granny looked at Xue Ying with surprise. "Your strength isn't bad at all."
Xue Ying chuckled. If comparing strength, he could match a newly emerged Religious Leader from the Ancestor Mother Religion. If he could not suppress a water puppet soldier used just for the trail by relying solely on his strength, then this trial would be too difficult.
"Let me ask you. Who do wish to challenge?" The mountain protector asked. "You are qualified to challenge both the second and third-ranked Paragon."
"The third rank Paragon will do." Xue Ying responded. No matter if he challenged the second or third-ranked Paragon, he could only enter the outer layer of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain after defeating them. Since that was the case, why not boost his chances by challenging the third-ranked Paragon instead, as the top two Paragons had records of defeating Rulers, and the third-ranked did not.
"Alright. The third-ranking Paragon will come out very soon." The old protector granny nodded. She looked towards the strange monstrous puppet by her side. The monstrous puppet nodded before leaping off the ground with a boom! He rushed into the sky and headed directly to one of the edges of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
******
On top of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, the white-haired girl was still seated there drinking wine in unease. She had not even spectated the match personally.
