"I've spent so much blood and effort before succeeding in gaining entry into the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. Now, a Paragon who could defeat a Ruler pops out from nowhere?" The white-haired girl 'Paragon Snow Goddess' was full of unease.
"Hong!"
The figure of the monstrous puppet landed. It looked at the white-haired girl and said with a rich voice, "Snow Goddess, a Paragon has come to challenge you. Go down and meet him."
The white-haired girl slightly trembled. Her gaze became even more chilly. "In the end… he has still arrived! Don't think it will be easy to defeat me."
"Sou." An old servant rushed over rapidly and informed her, "Master, Dong Bo Xue Ying has won."
The white-haired girl looked at the servant without speaking much, as she understood that this puppet would no longer be her servant if she were defeated. Instead, it would become Xue Ying's servant. Thinking about this, the white-haired girl's eyes grew even frostier. This was a battle she had to win!
"Let's go." The monstrous puppet shouted.
"Go." The white-haired girl stood up. The monstrous puppet and she turned into streams of light and flew towards the entrance of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
…
"Mn?" Xue Ying looked up at the two figures flying down towards them. Other than the monstrous puppet, there was another white-haired girl who was emitting a cold aura.
The old protector granny chuckled instead, as she smashed her walking stick on the ground.
"Hong long long~" At that moment, an ancient arena appeared from the ground. The arena was inscribed with a dense amount of patterns. One could see rays of light moving through the veined patterns, causing a huge black array to appear in the surrounding sky. The black array contained many layers of moving parts, completely enveloping the battle platform.
"The rules are simple." The mountain protector old granny said. "The two of you will battle. If a victor cannot be determined after a period, the battle platform's array will generate all kinds of danger. The first to die will be the loser! The one who lives will be the victor. Do the two of you understand?"
The old granny's seemingly muddied eyes swept across Xue Ying and the white-haired girl.
"I understand." Xue Ying nodded. The white-haired girl acknowledged too.
"Very good. Go onto the battle platform then. We will begin." The protector old granny ordered.
The white-haired girl flew bluntly onto the battle platform. Even though there were many layers of arrays surrounding the battle platform, they did not hinder the white-haired girl from entering it. Xue Ying followed closely behind. He looked at his opponent solemnly. Previously, His Highness Jiao Yun Liu and Ruler Official E had given him intelligence reports on the three strongest Paragons within the Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
This one in front of him was called Paragon Snow Goddess. She was tough to deal with and was someone who could even match up against Rulers. Strictly speaking, she should be comparable to 'Monarch Green' when he had yet to break through. Although, she might be slightly weaker as the battles in the Cultivator Cosmos were much more mystical and unpredictable, and the average strength there was higher.
"I've heard that you were able to defeat a Ruler?" The white-haired girl Paragon Snow Goddess' voice reverberated around the battle platform. "Then do you think you can defeat me?"
Her voice had yet to finish reverberating when many ice crystals began condensing on the surface of her body. Every single ice crystal had 12 sides. Under the reflection of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain and the starry sky, a rainbow was reflected. Countless ice crystals produced a huge sculpture, and this white-haired girl had completely turned into a sculpture. Her original height was close to two meters tall, and after the many ice crystals fortified her body, her height became close to three meters.
She stood there, unmoving. Xue Ying was slightly stunned. "What is this? She became a sculpture and remained unmoving after that?"
"Hong." Xue Ying wielded onto his silver spear. He waved his spear in a probing attack.
The spear arced through the sky, and its body moved in quite a huge revolution. A force exerted with the strength of a Ruler was transmitted down the body to the spearhead. "Peng~" It lashed fiercely against that sculpture. That crystallized ice sculpture was directly slapped away, and it smashed against the floating black array in the sky. However, the black array had prevented that ice sculpture from flying out, causing the sculpture to land back onto the battle platform. It rolled for a considerable distance before finally coming to a stop.
Xue Ying was slightly stunned as he watched this scene.
He could attack as he wished?
"Hahaha, this Paragon Snow Goddess truly do not care about her reputation." The Rulers who were watching the battle above the Primogenitor Devil Mountain could not help but laugh out.
"She knows that she will definitely lose to that Dong Bo Xue Ying in terms of offense. She is worried about accidentally losing her life during the battle. Thus, right from the start of the battle, she decided to use all her strength to protect her life instead."
"Her decision is quite logical. Her defense is impeccable, and as long as Dong Bo Xue Ying can't kill her, the battle platform will soon generate all kinds of dangerous situations… and she will survive those dangerous situations! And as long as Dong Bo Xue Ying dies before her, then she will be the victor." Those Rulers were discussing and laughing.
This was indeed a strategy with a higher chance of victory, but it was truly disgraceful. After all, in a fight, was there anyone who would just stand there and receive a beating? Would one not retaliate after being utterly humiliated? However, Xue Ying could not bring himself to go that far.
"Brother Dong Bo."
A figure rushed over from afar. That was none other than His Highness Jiao Yun Liu, and he shouted out, "What is happening? Why aren't you fighting?" He had rushed over immediately upon hearing of the battle.
"It's nothing much. Instead, I had never thought that the third-ranked Paragon within the Primogenitor Devil Mountain would actually do this…" Xue Ying looked towards the crystallized ice sculpture in front of him. He did not know what to say. However, no matter what, he had to try his best to achieve a victory! The final deciding battle in his hometown would be erupting soon. Thus, the stronger he was, the better it would be. He definitely had to make the most of this opportunity to cultivate in the Primogenitor Devil Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 750 - Unable To Accept A Challenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 750: Unable To Accept A Challenge
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
His Highness Jiao Yun Liu was wearing a luxurious golden robe. When he arrived, Ruler Official E had even politely greeted him from the side, "Your Highness." Although he may have been stronger than the third prince, however, the third prince had already become a Ruler, and he had the Great Emperor Jiao Yun supporting him. Naturally, the third prince could not be treated as any ordinary Ruler.
His Highness Jiao Yun Liu nodded with a smile. At the same time, he was watching the battle unfold. Witnessing the current situation, he exclaimed, "Paragon Snow Goddess has turned into a sculpture. Don't tell me that she plans on toughing it out with her defense?"
"It seems like that is indeed what she's planning on doing." Ruler Official E chuckled, though when he laughed, his appearance was quite frightening. "Paragon Snow Goddess has been cultivating in the Primogenitor Devil Mountain for quite a long period. Her combat power should have improved. Currently, she plans to direct all her strength to defense by turning into a sculpture. It will be tough for Dong Bo Xue Ying to harm her, and if he cannot break her defense, he will probably lose this battle."
Xue Ying was already utilizing his spear techniques on the arena, attacking the sculpture in a frenzy.
"Hong hong hong~"
The sculpture was being battered around, bouncing all over the arena and knocking into the black array surrounding the arena. However, the crystallized ice sculpture was unharmed, with nary a scratch. Every single 12-sided ice crystal on the surface remained pristine, reflecting the light from the surroundings.
"He will probably lose? That is where you are wrong." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu shook his head while he watched the battle, "Previously when Brother Dong Bo fought with Red Devil God-Emperor, you were not there to watch it personally. Even though the news that Brother Dong Bo defeated Red Devil Emperor has been widely spread, few know the exact details of the battle."
"Oh?" Ruler Official E glanced at Jiao Yun Liu in surprise.
"In that fight, Red Devil God-Emperor had utilized a technique that boosted his defense to extreme levels. But what happened in the end?" Jiao Yun Liu laughed. He clearly remembered that when Red Devil God-Emperor had revealed his strongest move, his power had surged greatly. There was even a layer of frost armor covering the surface of his body; his defense was extremely formidable. In the end, he was injured by just a single move from Brother Dong Bo! Brother Dong Bo's offense is just way too frightening."
"Is that so?" Ruler Official E was slightly suspicious. In his opinion, Paragon Snow Goddess' defense seemed pretty impregnable.
However, he was not aware… that the survival capabilities of Red Devil God-Emperor were of an even higher level.
"It's here." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu's eyes brightened. He saw it-the layer of black light enveloping Xue Ying's spear. It was precisely this black light, which had appeared in the last bout against Red Devil God-Emperor, that had ended the battle.
"Hua!"
The spear fiercely struck out, drawing a strange trajectory, and bloody ripples were layered around the spearhead. Evidently, Xue Ying had done more than just adding a layer of Termination Energy onto the spear, going one step further and integrating the 'Dao of Slaughter' and 'Dao of Ripple' into his spear technique. Ever since he had comprehended the 'Slaughter Domain', the fusion of these two Daos gave Xue Ying plenty of ideas in creating different techniques.
"Pu"-the spear stabbed right into the icy crystalized sculpture. The Termination Energy was revolving on the surface, substantially boosting the sharpness of the spearhead. It forcibly pierced through the sculpture, and subsequently, the blood ripple exploded within the sculpture.
"Peng~" The entire sculpture shattered, exploding outwards. Many huge pieces disintegrated in midair before they could land. Nonetheless, there were several remaining pieces of the sculpture, which were able to condense back into that white-haired girl, 'Paragon Snow Goddess'. Paragon Snow Goddess looked towards Xue Ying in disbelief and a strand of helplessness. Watching Xue Ying charged towards her again, her voice reverberated in the surrounding void, "I admit defeat!"
She would not have enough time if she had voiced it out. Instead, she had used the energy in her body to transmit her message to send it out before she got hit.
"Hu."
Xue Ying's spear abruptly stopped. The terrifying turbulence arced by the body of Paragon Snow Goddess like a blade. If she was a stage four World Deity, she might have simply exploded from the shockwave. However, Paragon Snow Goddess was someone who could fight against Rulers! Even though she could not resist the full attack of Xue Ying when he utilized Termination Energy, just the turbulence from his attack could not harm her at all.
"Admirable. I would not have expected that you could damage my Undying Figure." Paragon Snow Goddess coldly said. "Your power might even threaten that monster, Lie Yang. I truly wonder how the battle between the two of you unfold."
Upon saying that, Paragon Snow Goddess turned into a stream of light before leaving the place.
She had lost! Naturally, she was no longer qualified to enter the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. Instead, Xue Ying would be replacing her as the third Paragon.
"Hahaha, Brother Dong Bo, congratulations, congratulations!" His Highness Jiao Yun Liu laughed. "I haven't even entered the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, yet you are already one step ahead of me."
Xue Ying walked down from the arena. He turned towards His Highness Jiao Yun Liu and laughed, "Your Highness should not be teasing me. Your Highness is already a Ruler, and I am just a Paragon. That step isn't that easy to cross."
"It might be tough for other Paragons, but not for you." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu responded.
…
Xue Ying accompanied His Highness Jiao Yun Liu, chatting for a while before entering the Primogenitor Devil Mountain under the guidance of the old servant puppet. Jiao Yun Liu was still temporarily unable to enter.
"Primogenitor Devil Mountain."
Xue Ying walked on this ancient devil mountain. The mountain was surrounded by black fog. He did not know why, but he found his body feeling lighter while on the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. His bones had a faint, comfortable itching, and Xue Ying unconsciously revealed a grin. He understood that this was the effect of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. Otherwise, how could an existence on his level be so easily affected by the environment?
The old puppet servant was leading the way. He pointed to the end of the rugged path ahead, where there was a cavern dwelling that was faintly discernible. "Master, the cavern-dwelling is right ahead."
"That is my cavern dwelling?" Xue Ying nodded.
"Right. It is master's cavern dwelling. WIthout master's permission, none can intrude. Furthermore, this cavern dwelling is placed right on top of the base of Primogenitor Devil Mountain's array. It will be of great help to your cultivation." The old puppet servant said. "Master will understand once you enter."
"Mn."
He soon arrived in front of the cavern-dwelling.
This ancient cavern dwelling seemed slightly spartan, but it occupied was a few kilometers wide. After all, this was where Paragons cultivated; in more extravagant settings, having a stretch of land spanning 500 billion kilometers as their backyard was not out of the ordinary.
Pushing the door, it opened with a 'zhi ya'. It was a pitch-black wooden door, and Xue Ying could not discern what material it was made from.
Just as he walked into the house, there was a green aura, visible to the naked eyes, charging towards him. He took a deep breath-it cooled his entire body, and his mind turned empty. Immediately, he could feel his comprehension speed improving rapidly as if he had eaten some miraculous pill. This treasured cultivation ground was one that even Rulers desired. Naturally, it would be beneficial to Paragons too. Those with a high potential would naturally cultivate faster in a better environment.
"Great." Xue Ying could not help but give praise. Having cultivated for so long in the Cultivator Cosmos, he had never entered such a treasured cultivation ground.
"The Primogenitor Devil Mountain has several places storing precious ancient cultivation books." The old puppet servant said from the side. "They are left behind by the primogenitor and are extremely precious. You can study them, but you can't bring them away from the Primogenitor Devil Mountain."
"Oh?" Xue Ying was startled.
"Master can take your time to experience the benefits of this cavern." The old servant puppet continued. "If there are no other matters, this old servant will first take his leave."
Xue Ying asked. "Are the arrays located in the inner layer and the core of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain better?"
"Those are starkly different." The puppet servant replied. "The inner layer is much better than the outer layer, and the core is beyond your imagination."
Xue Ying nodded. "And there's also a matter. I wish to challenge the strongest Paragon."
"Challenging the strongest Paragon?" The puppet servant was startled for a moment. "Alright master, please wait momentarily. I'll report it immediately."
The puppet servant rapidly withdrew.
Xue Ying began a thorough inspection of his cavern dwelling. He was able to immediately discover the merits of this place. Different regions within the dwelling contained different auras that were suitable for experts cultivating different systems. Xue Ying found that the areas that were apt for cultivating the Dao of Slaughter, Dao of Ripple and Dao of Mirage were all in different regions. Furthermore, the 'Voidwalker system' did not have many requirements for an appropriate environment.
After a moment.
The puppet servant returned.
"Master." The servant puppet respectfully greeted.
"Has a time been set?" Xue Ying asked.
"The strongest Paragon 'Lie Yang' is currently in closed-door cultivation. He will not be accepting challenges." The puppet servant replied.
Xue Ying was astonished. "Closed-door cultivation and not accepting a challenge? Don't tell me that he plans on cultivating forever and not accept any challenges?"
"There is an enormous difference between the inner layer and outer layer of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. In the future, when Master enters, Master will naturally understand. Entering closed-door cultivation in the inner layer is a special type of cultivation. During this process, the user will be unable to accept any challenge. However, after this closed-door cultivation ends, Paragon Lie Yang will not be able to escape from challenges." The puppet servant explained.
"How long will it take?" Xue Ying asked.
"I've heard that Paragon Lie Yang has been in closed-door cultivation for about 500,000 years. He might come out at any time, although in the worst case scenario, he might spend more than 10 million years." The puppet servant replied.
"So long?" Xue Ying felt helpless.
He could only wait.
The time flow in the Devil Mountain Cosmos was much faster than his hometown. Even if 10 million years passed, it was only equivalent to several thousand years in his hometown! The war should not begin so quickly. He could utilize this opportunity to cultivate and become stronger.
"You may take your leave." Xue Ying ordered.
"Yes. If Master has any matter, Master can call for me anytime." The puppet servant left the cavern-dwelling.
After that, the doors to the cavern-dwelling shut with a 'zhi ya'. Xue Ying also began his cultivation on the Primogenitor Devil Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 751 - 《Wind Ripple Path》
chapters.content:
Chapter 751: 《Wind Ripple Path》
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As time passed, the Primogenitor Devil mountain remained relatively uneventful. The black fog remained wrapped around the mountain, and it was always desolate-only several dozens expert cultivated here. The remaining were all puppet, who were there just to serve their masters, and the mountain protectors.
On the peak of the mountain outside a cavern-dwelling.
Xue Ying was seated there flipping through a golden book. This book was made of a particular type of metal with characters inscribed on it. Those characters were of a specific language, and even though Xue Ying did not understand the characters, the characters were able to transmit a vast amount of information into his mind. Over the years, he had already memorized everything within this book. Nevertheless, Xue Ying still brought this book to his cavern-dwelling and flipped through it frequently.
There were many precious books within the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, and he could bring them to his cavern-dwelling for reading. Nonetheless, he was forbidden from carrying them out of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain!
"This senior from another race has reached a level of understanding in the aspect of ripples that I could only aspire to reach. If he were the stars in the sky, then I am merely a mortal staring up into the sky." Every time Xue Ying flipped through the book, he could not help but feel admiration towards the writer. These were precious books left behind by the primogenitor, and the one Xue Ying was reading, only a single copy existed here. Furthermore, the front section and large portions of the back section were missing. Xue Ying did not even know what this book was titled, though he understood that it was someone called 'Heaven Ripple Island Master' who had written this book.
"If not for these books, it would be much harder for me to create my absolute art." Xue Ying shook his head.
He was filled with ambition.
A very lofty ambition.
Just like Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction who had created his own absolute art based on the lower half of the"Blood Demon Scripture", Xue Ying had previously created his own 'Slaughter Domain' by referring to the original version from the Cosmos Emissary cultivation system. He then fused the Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple together to create his own version.
These were created according to the ideology of the seniors.
And because the 'Dao of Ripple' and 'Dao of Slaughter' were extremely appropriate for combat, Xue Ying had wanted to create an absolute art meant for combat by combining these two Daos! The 'Slaughter Domain' tended towards the aspect of domains. What Xue Ying required was an absolute art that was appropriate for his spear techniques!
However, there were no similar books, because no seniors had ever done this before! Or, it may have been done before, but he could not find them amongst the books in the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. After all, it was too difficult to search for something as specific as a combat-inclined absolute art that utilized both the Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple.
Since he had no references to use, the way ahead was unclear. How should he proceed?
Xue Ying had to create it himself. It required his understanding of the slaughter and ripple to reach an even more profound and broader stage. Fortunately, he was in the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, which had a significant amount of precious books for him to peruse. It broadened his perspective and opened his eyes to the many possibilities in cultivation.
The nourishment from different books built his foundation for the Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple. Along with his cultivation within the Primogenitor Devil Mountain cavern dwelling, his efficiency had reached the pinnacle. With his talented comprehension ability, he had finally created the first volume of his absolute art, "Wind Ripple Path". The reason why it was just the first volume, was that both his Daos had yet to reach eternity. According to his thinking, this absolute art could continuously be improved in the future.
Despite it just being a single volume, Xue Ying had put all his effort into it! And he could rely on this to fight against Rulers!
"Hu."
A puppet girl walked over from a distance. Her figure flashed a few times before appearing close to where Xue Ying was.
"Paragon Dong Bo." The puppet girl respectfully greeted. "I came according to the orders of my master, Paragon Lie Yang, to inform Paragon Dong Bo that your challenge will be carried out tomorrow."
"Paragon Lie Yang?" Xue Ying's expression brightened. "Finally! It has been six million years, and Paragon Lie Yang has finally ended his closed-door cultivation."
"Good. Then we will battle tomorrow." Xue Ying revealed a grin.
The puppet girl politely bowed before leaving.
Xue Ying stood up and watched as the puppet girl left. His eyes were filled with expectations. "Letting me wait for six million years. My current power is much stronger than when I first entered the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. Lie Yang, I've heard he defeated Rulers before. I wonder if he can match up against me."
Even though his cultivation had risen tremendously on the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, he had yet to battle others.
On the second day.
"Zhi ya."
The wooden door was pushed open. Xue Ying walked out from within the cavern-dwelling. His eyes were calm. He proceeded along the rugged mountain path, leaving behind several faint afterimages. The old puppet servant was respectfully following behind him.
"Dong Bo, I've heard that you are fighting with Lie Yang?" A girl who was covered in scarlet scales, with golden armor draped over her figure, smiled from another cavern dwelling further away.
"Your Highness." Xue Ying chuckled. "I am currently heading to the arena."
The girl in front of him was the second oldest of the three children the Great Emperor Jiao Yun had-'Jiao Yun Can'. She was also the strongest amongst the three and had left both her older and younger brother far behind. She had entered the Primogenitor Devil Mountain long ago. Even though the third prince Jiao Yun Liu had become a Ruler, compared to his sister, the gap between their power was quite noticeable.
"Since this is a battle to determine the strongest Paragon, I'll come along with you." Jiao Yun Can took a step before appearing by the side of Xue Ying.
"Alright, let's go." Xue Ying traveled alongside Jiao Yun Can.
"Lie Yang is quite powerful. Previously, he had rapidly become the strongest Paragon after appearing and entered the inner layer of Primogenitor Devil Mountain. Even I have never entered that place before. Are you confident of defeating him?" Jiao Yun Can was quite beautiful, and her eyebrows were like sharp swords. She would usually wear golden armor, and one could understand her character from this.
Xue Ying chuckled. "Whether I have the confidence or not, this battle is unavoidable. I want to personally test his strength."
"It seems you are quite confident." Jiao Yun Can giggled.
They traveled together.
There were also other Rulers proceeding along too. After all, the battle to determine the strongest Paragon… other than the ones ranked second and third, and other slightly more boring challenges where the loser re-challenged the winner, a battle where a newcomer fought the strongest Paragon was quite rare.
However, these newcomers actually had a higher chance of defeating the strongest Paragon. Because they suddenly popped out, it was hard to determine their power. Thus, they had higher hopes. As for those who had been defeated several times, expectations of them beating the strongest Paragon were meager.
"Dong Bo, this battle isn't easy."
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, that Lie Yang has been the strongest Paragon for too long. Defeat him."
Once Xue Ying arrived at the arena, several Rulers who had reached earlier shouted out. The majority of them were Rulers situated in the outer layer and were naturally on the side of Xue Ying. During these years, Xue Ying had frequently gone to read books, and had also befriended with several other Rulers who were reading too. Everyone had quite a favorable opinion to this young Paragon with a good temper.
The arena was entirely dark green. It was located within the outer layer of Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
A moment after Xue Ying arrived here, the other participant also arrived.
"Paragon Lie Yang." Xue Ying looked ahead.
Two figures walked out from the fog enshrouding the deeper region of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. The puppet girl was walking in the rear, and the one in front was a male wearing a robe, with both his arms exposed. This male had light brown, seemingly glossy skin. He had silver hair that was tied in many thin plaits. Upon inspection, there seemed to be several dozen plaids.
He was barefooted.
But he had a terrifying aura which came emanated faintly from his body. He was currently walking over with huge steps with a saber kept in the scabbard on his back. Both his eyes were sharp, and they gave off an oppressive feeling.
"Dong Bo, he looked similar to you. Are both of you from the same cosmos?" Her Highness Jiao Yun Can shouted from the side.
"We aren't."
Paragon Lie Yang who walked from afar took the initiative to reply. His eyes were staring at Xue Ying sternly as his lip curled upwards. "I know all Paragons from my hometown cosmos. He is absolutely not one of them! Furthermore, all Paragons from my hometown have plaits, and he doesn't!"
Saying that, he took a step before leaping up to the arena with a 'sou'. He then stared at Xue Ying. "Come on, Paragon Dong Bo. Let me see how powerful you are."
"Alright."
Xue Ying also leaped onto the arena.
When the two of them stepped onto the arena, the many veined patterns on the surface of the dark green arena began lighting up. The light revolved around the patterns, and a dense black array appeared in the air, enveloping the arena within.

chapters.title: Chapter 752 - The Strongest Paragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 752: The Strongest Paragon
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
On top of the simple arena, Xue Ying stood facing Lie Yang.
Xue Ying extended his right hand, and a silver spear appeared. At the same time, "boom~". With Xue Ying as the epicenter, a blood wave surged out, producing shockwaves in all directions, covering every single part of the battle platform. Paragon Lie Yang had no ways of evading this. He was instantly submerged.
Slaughter Domain!
The current Xue Ying's Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple had reached their limits. They were only a single step away from achieving perfect eternity. Of course, that step was like a gulf between heaven and earth! The advancement in his realm, along with his self-created absolute art, "Wind Ripple Path", allowed Xue Ying to further his strength and abilities, and the 'Slaughter Domain' had become more perfect and powerful.
"Mn?" Paragon Lie Yang, who was situated within the blood wave, felt a hidden force continually permeating into his body. It was vibrating at every single part of his body as if it wanted to destroy him. Furthermore, the layers of ripples were like a spider web-it restricted him.
"Such a frightening domain. It could actually harm my body. Furthermore, the longer I remain in this domain, the heavier my injuries will be, and the greater the restrictions I will face." Paragon Lie Yang immediately treated this Xue Ying in front of him as the most terrifying Paragon opponent he had ever faced. "I have to end this battle as fast as possible! I cannot delay it any further!"
Like Red Devil God-Emperor who had his absolute move which could withstand the Slaughter Domain…
However, the current Slaughter Domain was much stronger. Additionally, Paragon Lie Yang was indeed not good at domain-related techniques.
Still, he had other moves!
Paragon Lie Yang suddenly let out a furious roar.
"Hong!"
His aura abruptly surged, and his robe also swelled and expanded. His originally glossy skin formed a leather membrane that was visible to the naked eyes. Even his eyes were covered in a transparent membrane. Apparently, his aura had increased by several times.
"Sou!"
He immediately unsheathed the saber on his back. With a flash, he leaped towards Xue Ying and wildly swung his saber.
"Clang!" Xue Ying originally stood there, though the spear in his hand was like a python. It suddenly jumped out to parry against this incoming blade, and the surging strength in his body was wholly transmitted into the spear.
Paragon Lie Yang could only feel a heaven-shattering mighty force being transmitted over from the spear. Furthermore, this strength contained a mystical ripple that came in waves. He was unable to withstand it, causing the blood in his body to fluctuate along with the flow. In the end, he was forced back, spurting out a mouth of fresh blood.
"He is actually stronger than me?" Paragon Lie Yang could not believe this. His strength was stronger than most Rulers, yet he was still disadvantaged in this fight? He had been injured to the extent of spitting blood?
Paragon Lie Yang may have been pushed back by a single strike, but his braided silver hair suddenly elongated, twisting towards Xue Ying in a frenzy and enveloping him.
Xue Ying's spear might be formidable, but facing a total of 93 thin braids, he had no time to defend himself against each and every soft, unpredictable, and fast braid. Thus, he was bound by those braids and was completely restricted.
"Seems like he's facing some trouble." The Rulers who watching the battle held their breaths. The fight between the two of them was too fast and intense. It was clear that they wanted to quickly determine the victor.
"Hong!" In the instant that Xue Ying was entangled by the silver braids, his two arms trembled explosively. "chi chi chi~" All the silver braids were suddenly stretched taut, but they were still able to resist Xue Ying's strength.
Paragon Lie Yang stopped his backward momentum. His braids had currently elongated to a length of more than 50 kilometers. They covered the skies, thoroughly entangling Xue Ying. He looked at Xue Ying with a shocked expression. "Such strength, I'm barely able to restrain him."
"I can't escape from this?" Xue Ying was also astonished. His speed of cultivation on the Primogenitor Devil Mountain was relatively quick. The effect of cultivating here for just six million years was equivalent to his progress from the previous 30 million years. He had already reached the 8th level in the "Walker's Hidden Secret". Earlier in the fight, he was actually shocked when he could force the other party to spit out blood with a single spear.
But now, the other party's hair had entangled him, yet his strength was insufficient to allow him to escape this bind?
"Break!"
A layer of black light suddenly appeared on the surface of Xue Ying's body. The black light layer was revolving, and every strand of light was like a sharp blade, slicing and destroying everything. It was none other than the Voidwalker lineage most destructive move, 'Termination Energy'.
The Termination Energy enveloped his body. Xue Ying was like a Demonic God who had emerged from the darkness. Every single part of his body, including his black hair, was covered with the terrifying Termination Energy.
He once again erupted with his full force!
"Hong~"
The many silver braids were once again forced to vibrate. However, this time, the sharpness of Termination Energy on Xue Ying's body directly forced the many silver braids to break apart with a 'beng beng beng'.Paragon Lie Yang, who had initially intended to use this opportunity to launch an attack, was extremely shocked. Large numbers of broken hair braids were rapidly retracted, and he glared at Xue Ying. He was famous for being overbearing in his battles, yet in today's fight, he was actually at a disadvantage.
While it seemed slow, in actual fact, Xue Ying had merely struggled twice before succeeding in breaking apart these silver braids.
"Kill." Paragon Lie Yang let out a furious roar. Wielding his blade, he once again charged towards Xue Ying.
Switching to close combat, each and every one of his silver braids was floating around him, shifting around restlessly.
"Hu."
With a flash of his blade, he slashed Xue Ying, and the silver braids were also sinisterly sending sneak attacks.
Facing so many braids along with the saber, Xue Ying felt his face paling.
""Wind Ripple Path"-Twin Ripple Kill!" Xue Ying immediately displayed the absolute art he spent many years to create-"Wind Ripple Path". This was an absolute art used for battling.
"Hua!"
The surface of Xue Ying's body began emitting many strands of black Termination Energy. The Termination Energy could imbue weapons and other items for battle. They could similarly be used for direct combat! The many strands of black Termination Energy had two special blood ripples revolving around each strand, just like the Yin-Yang Fish. The two ripples would generate a frightening, destructive force every single time they came into contact.
"Pu pu pu"… Large amounts of black Termination Energy shot out simultaneously, and Paragon Lie Yang was unable to react in time. He could only rely on his own fleshy body to resist this attack!
"Die for me." His silver braids were still shooting towards Xue Ying. Even if he was going to be injured, he had to eliminate Xue Ying with this single move.
However, the strands of black Termination Energy were like fishes as they tunneled into Paragon Lie Yang's body. The Termination Energy, infused with the profound mysteries contained within the "Wind Ripple Path"- Twin Ripple Kill, had reached a genuinely terrifying level. Paragon Lie Yang was not any weaker than Xue Ying's body when he first entered the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, but he could not defend against this attack. He was directly penetrated by the many strands of energy, and the Termination Energy had already begun destroying his body.
Paragon Lie Yang's body was densely covered in bloody holes, and his face wore an expression of shock. Even his offensive moves had been affected by that attack. After all, his injuries were pretty severe, and the copious amount of Termination Energy that had penetrated through him were still wrecking his body.
Fortunately, his body was strong enough. Weaker Rulers might have already exploded from this technique.
"Hu." Xue Ying's spear pierced forward again.
Xue Ying had used his full strength to stab forward. Termination Energy revolved on the spear while the two bloody ripples continuously intertwined, surging forward towards Paragon Lie Yang. Paragon Lie Yang's body was so heavily injured that his movement was affected, and he was not confident of using his saber to defend against this attack. Many of his silver braids began to rapidly shoot out.
"Pu pu pu~"
As the silver braids were surrounding Xue Ying, his spear forcibly penetrated through Paragon Lie Yang's body. A huge, bloody hole had been torn open in his chest with a violent tremble, and the Termination Energy propagating within his body had become clearly visible, evidently yet to be exhausted.
Additionally, the ripple from the Slaughter Domain was also permeating through him. His already severe injuries were continuously being worsened.
"I admit defeat." Paragon Lie Yang surrendered, his mouth filled with fresh blood.
Everything was silent.
The Slaughter Domain immediately dissipated. Xue Ying, who was just about to launch another attack, retracted his spear. The leftover Termination Energy also rapidly withdrew.
Paragon Lie Yang glanced at Xue Ying. Without the corrosion from the Termination Energy, the wound on his body was gradually recovering. His long braids also shortened, returning to their usual length. He looked at Xue Ying and nodded, "I wholeheartedly accept my loss. I was actually defeated by you in direct combat. You are stronger than me."
"You are also very strong." Xue Ying replied.
The other party was indeed powerful.
If he had not cultivated for six million years on the Primogenitor Devil Mountain and had not created the "Wind Ripple Path", he would not have been able to escape from Paragon Lie Yang's silver braids. He would have been forced into his Mirage World. At that point in time, he could only rely on his Mirage World to carry out sneak attacks on the other party. The other party's body was quite solid. Furthermore, with the support of his many braids, it was tough to say if Xue Ying could succeed with his sneak attacks.
Just that…
After six million years, he had improved holistically. Even if he did not utilize the Mirage World and Void Evasive Maneuver, he could win against the other party in direct combat.
"Formidable."
"Congratulations, Paragon Dong Bo, for becoming the strongest Paragon of Primogenitor Devil Mountain."
"Haha, this battle between Paragon Dong Bo and Paragon Lie Yang is truly a spectacle." The spectating Rulers were all commenting on the recent battle. It was a battle that most new Rulers could not survive.
Both Xue Ying and Paragon Lie Yang admired each other. They both had their fair share of opportunities, and Xue Ying knew that without the 'Voidwalker lineage', he would have had no chances of winning the battle. Paragon Lie Yang sighed as he commented, "I have met many miraculous encounters and cultivated for a long period in the inner layer of Primogenitor Devil Mountain. In the end, I still lost."
…
Xue Ying bid farewell to several Rulers. With a new puppet servant-the one who had previously served under Paragon Lie Yang-the female puppet led him into the inner layer.
"Master, there are a total of nine cavern-dwellings in the inner layer of Primogenitor Devil Mountain. They are located at the nine huge hubs of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain's arrays." The puppet girl proceeded onwards through the black fog, and they entered the depths of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, "The nine cavern-dwellings are being occupied by eight Rulers and one Paragon. Earlier on, there were several Rulers from the inner layer who were spectating the battle."
Xue Ying nodded.
"Look." The puppet girl pointed into the distance.
There was an area enshrouded by rainbow-colored light. A luxurious cavern-dwelling, about 50 kilometers wide, was currently floating in midair in the direction she was pointing. That was the cultivation cavern-dwelling, and one of the nine great hubs of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
"That is Master's cavern-dwelling, and it will be your cultivation ground from now on." The puppet girl said.
Xue Ying walked over.
He swept his gaze around, observing his surroundings. There were faint rainbow lights around him, where other cavern-dwellings were floating about. He understood that these were the other cavern-dwellings within the inner layer.
"Hu."
He flew directly towards his cavern-dwelling. The front door of the dwelling was open, and when Xue Ying flew closer to it, an extremely melodious sound began to play beside his ears. It was resonating with his soul.
"Wu ji la…" The illusory voice sounded within his soul. Xue Ying's eyelids began to droop, and his eyes became smaller and smaller before they eventually closed. He revealed a grin and had completely fallen into a deep sleep.
Not just this avatar of his, even the red-robed Xue Ying, who was cultivating in an Eden treasure on a certain desolate planet in the Devil Mountain Cosmos, had fallen onto the grass and into a deep sleep.
In the Cultivator Cosmos, the Xia Clan world, within the Crimson Rock Mountain world.
Xue Ying, who was originally chatting with his wife Jing Qiu, had suddenly closed his eyes with a grin. He fell onto the ground powerlessly.
"Xue Ying." Jing Qiu was startled, her expression immediately changing, "Xue Ying, what happened to you? Wake up, wake up!"
…
Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
Xue Ying, who had fallen into a deep sleep, still had a smile plastered on his face. His body had subconsciously flown towards the front door of his cavern-dwelling.
"Hahaha, this Paragon Dong Bo has already started his "Dream Cultivation"." Several Rulers within the Primogenitor Devil Mountain had noticed this scene-they saw Xue Ying falling into a deep sleep.
"This is a huge opportunity that one can only gain within the inner layer of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. This Dream Cultivation is something that one can only hope for."
"The moment the Dream Cultivation begins, it cannot be stopped prematurely. Only after the cultivation ends will the person wake up. I wonder how long he will stay asleep."
"Judging from his soul, this Paragon Dong Bo seems to be very young. His comprehension ability is quite high. Adding the fact that this is his first time cultivating in a dream, he will most likely spend a long time cultivating. In my opinion, he should take at least 500 million years."
"500 million years? I think he'll probably take one billion years."
"Regardless, the longer it is, the greater the benefits! Haha…"
The Rulers within the inner layer of Primogenitor Devil Mountain had already experienced many Dream Cultivations. Thus, they were extremely familiar with it. The reason why Paragon Lie Yang could not acknowledge the challenge previously was precisely because he was stuck in a Dream Cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 753 - Deep Sleep
chapters.content:
Chapter 753: Deep Sleep
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Jing Qiu had fallen into a daze. This person, who she truly believed had an unfathomable strength and was one of the three ancestors, 'Xue Ying', actually just fallen down on the ground, unconscious? The laws of the material realm were extremely protective of the lifeforms within the realm. Even Bloodshed God-Emperor, Temporal Island Lord and other Rulers could at most kill a stage three World Deity by relying on the karma formed from oaths.
With Xue Ying's current power? He should be entirely safe in the material realm!
"Xue Ying, Xue Ying, quickly wake up, quickly wake up!" Jing Qiu tried to send a strand of World Deity energy into his body. "Chi chi chi", just as it touched the skin of Xue Ying, it suffered from an unseen repulsion. Even though he had fallen into deep sleep, his fleshly body was something Jing Qiu could not permeate with her strength.
"Mother, what happened? What happened to father?" The Crimson Rock Mountain Crimson Dust Island was only so big. Dong Bo Yu's avatar, who had been cultivating on a mountain peak, could see his fallen father and his mother with a single glance. He too was stunned and had hurriedly teleported over.
Jing Qiu did not care about her son though. She looked at her husband in anxiety.
"Sou."
She lifted Xue Ying up and brought him to the closest house by the side, before gently laying her husband out on the bed.
At this moment, the treasure spirit 'Crimson Rock', Qing Yao and Dong Bo Yu were all anxious and panicking outside the house.
"What happened to master?" The treasure spirit Crimson Rock was in disbelief. "At Master's realm, and adding on the fact that he is within the material realm, how could he enter a deep sleep that all of us can't wake him from?"
"This shouldn't be possible. He should be absolutely safe." Qing Yao was filled with anxiety.
Dong Bo Yu was both worried and nervous.
Precisely because it 'should be absolutely safe', yet Xue Ying had entered a deep sleep, that made the situation all the more serious. The one that struck down Xue Ying… should have far surpassed the level of Bloodshed God-Emperor and Abyss Primogenitor.
Within the house.
Jing Qiu was looking at her husband in a deep sleep on the bed. She became distressed.
"Your Majesty Bloodshed God-Emperor." Jing Qiu directly shouted out. This time, she did not isolate the karma. Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao and the treasure spirit Crimson Rock were all nervous. They understood that she should be asking for the help of 'Bloodshed God-Emperor'.
"Oh, Yu Jing Qiu? What's the matter?" Bloodshed God-Emperor was currently very busy. His avatar was utilizing the Void Twin Extreme Array to force the Ancestor Mother Religion into revealing themselves, while his other two bodies were studying the "Myriad Catalog"that Xue Ying had brought back from the Devil Mountain Cosmos. He could feel his understanding of the myriad existences improving, and naturally, Bloodshed God-Emperor was in a good mood.
If any ordinary cultivator dared to shout the God-Emperor's name, it would be an insult to him.
However, Jing Qiu was Xue Ying's wife, so Bloodshed God-Emperor's tone when speaking to her was quite pleasant.
"Xue Ying has entered a deep sleep and can't be awakened. Jing Qiu hopes for Your Majesty God-Emperor to help save Xue Ying." Jing Qiu explained.
"What? I'll be there immediately!" Bloodshed God-Emperor was startled.
…
Soon after, his incarnation descended directly into the material realm and arrived at the Crimson Rock Mountain world. The Crimson Rock treasure spirit did not obstruct him at all.
The incarnation of Bloodshed God-Emperor who had descended arrived in a loose white robe. As it was just an incarnation, and his power was restricted by the material realm, this incarnation was naturally weaker. Nevertheless, his experience still remained.
"Your Majesty." Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao, and the Crimson Rock treasure spirit respectfully greeted.
"Mn."
Bloodshed God-Emperor glanced at his disciple's wife and children, before casting his gaze on the white-robed teenager who was sleeping on the bed in the house. He could not help but reveal an anxious look, moving in front of the bed.
"What is happening?" Bloodshed God-Emperor looked at his own disciple. He then extended his hand, pointing his finger at Xue Ying's forehead, and unseen energy started permeating into his forehead. Even though he was suffering from the suppression of the material realm, his techniques remained mystical and profound… just like how Forefather Scarlet Flame once helped Xue Ying save Jing Qiu.
"Chi chi chi~" Having reached the 8th level of the Walker's Hidden Secret, his fleshy body contained a horrifying might. It directly exterminated Bloodshed God-Emperor's probe.
"Huh?"
Bloodshed God-Emperor frowned. He attempted to use other methods.
He attempted all sorts of methods. In the end, Bloodshed God-Emperor shot out a ray of light from his eyes. It enveloped Xue Ying, ignoring the obstacles posed by Xue Ying's fleshly body and entering it. "This disciple of mine has such a strong fleshy body. It is likely that about half the Rulers do not even have a body as strong as this disciple of mine. I wonder how he trained it to such an extent."
Bloodshed God-Emperor sighed inwardly. He then thoroughly inspected Xue Ying's soul.
In his consciousness, Xue Ying's True Deity Heart had also entered a deep sleep. Bloodshed God-Emperor attempted to wake him up, but the moment he touched Xue Ying's True Deity Heart, an unseen ripple spread out, overwhelming Bloodshed God-Emperor's consciousness.
"Weng."
Bloodshed God-Emperor felt his deity heart trembling.
Whether it was the avatar controlling the Void Twin Extreme Array or his two other bodies, they all simultaneously suffered from the loss of consciousness.
The incarnation of Bloodshed God-Emperor directly dissipated…
"This, what is happening?" Bloodshed God-Emperor sent another incarnation down. He looked at Xue Ying in great shock. "What exactly is Xue Ying suffering from? Just a slight ripple was enough to cause me to lose my consciousness? If I were directly enveloped by that ripple, I would probably enter a deep sleep too."
Bloodshed God-Emperor clearly understood. Just a little leftover energy was already this frightening, which meant that Xue Ying had suffered from an even more terrifying infliction.
"Your Majesty?" Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao, and the Crimson Rock treasure spirit were watching nervously.
"Very troublesome." Bloodshed God-Emperor frowned. The tension and anger were visible on his face. "I'll ask others to see if they can help."
Soon after, Bloodshed God-Emperor brought several others, who potentially could save Xue Ying. They were Purgatory Ruler, Primal Master, and Pang Yi!
Pang Yi had created a new cultivation technique and was a lone practitioner. His accomplishments in the aspect of the soul were profound. Primal Master was the oldest Ruler and had many methods that were only secondary to the God-Emperor. And 'Purgatory Ruler' was similarly a grandmaster in the aspect of the soul. His subordinate, 'Purgatory Great Commander', was able to use the Purgatory Reincarnation because it had been imparted by him.
Bloodshed God-Emperor, Pang Yi, Primal Master, and Purgatory Ruler. The four were the strongest in the aspect of the soul within this cosmos.
"What happened to Dong Bo Xue Ying?" Primal Master was shocked as he saw the slumbering Xue Ying.
"He has even been forced into a deep sleep within the material realm. What exactly did he encounter?" Pang Yi was startled too.
Purgatory Ruler asked, "Is it the Devil Mountain Cosmos?"
Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded anxiously. "Xue Ying went to the Devil Mountain Cosmos and entered the 'Primogenitor Devil Mountain'. He has obtained the"Myriad Catalog"for me… the origin of that Primogenitor Devil Mountain is extraordinary. It was left behind by the terrifying existence who created the Devil Mountain Cosmos. Now that Xue Ying has entered a deep sleep, if it isn't the three Void Gods who acted, then it should be the danger coming from the Primogenitor Demonic God himself. Ai, if I had known this would happen, I would not have let him take the risk."
Bloodshed God-Emperor felt guilty.
He had received an enormous benefit by obtaining the "Myriad Catalog", yet his disciple had entered a deep sleep, with his life hanging in the balance.
"Let me have a look." Pang Yi and the other three attempted to investigate Xue Ying condition. They also discovered how astonishingly strong his fleshy body was. However, they were ultimately Rulers using the Laws and Profound Mysteries system, and all of specialized in the soul. They were all able to inspect Xue Ying's soul using other means.
But…
When each of them attempted to investigate Xue Ying's soul, they suffered from the same unseen ripple. When they encountered it, their true bodies and avatars all lost consciousness. Their incarnations dissipated, and they had to re-condense an incarnation before returning here. They were unwilling to accept their failure and tried several more times, but in the end, they had to admit-they had no means to wake Xue Ying.
"This has far surpassed our abilities. It isn't something we can awake him from." Purgatory Ruler calmly assessed the situation. "It will depend on Dong Bo Xue Ying's fortune from now."
"We can't even withstand the little bit of leftover energy; how can we save him?" Pang Yi shook his head too.
"Hope he's lucky." Primal Master said.
Bloodshed God-Emperor became silent. He looked at his sleeping disciple before finally sighing.
He could not be awakened!
It was not known if he was dead or alive! Entering a deep sleep meant that his life and death were out of his control.
"Yu Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, Dong Bo Qing Yao, Xue Ying's body will remain here. Don't bring him out of the material realm. If you encounter any issues, you can find me directly." Bloodshed God-Emperor said a few words before letting his incarnation dissipate. The other three Rulers shook their heads slightly before leaving as well.
Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, and Qing Yao, who initially harbored hope, now simply felt despair. If Rulers could not save him, then what could they do?
"Mother." Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao looked towards Jing Qiu.
Jing Qiu was also slightly hesitant. Regardless, she still said, "Let us wait. Maybe your father will wake up after a while."
"Mn." The sister and brother could only wait.
…
One day, two days, three days… Jing Qiu and the others were waiting.
One year, two years, three years, ten years, a hundred years, thousand years, 10,000 years…
Xue Ying remained in his deep sleep.

chapters.title: Chapter 754 - The War Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 754: The War Begins
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xia Clan world, Crimson Rock Mountain world, on Crimson Dust Island.
Jing Qiu was seated on a chair next to the bed. She was currently flipping through a book and would occasionally look at the white-robed teenager lying next to her.
It had been 82,000 years.
With Xue Ying having slept for so long, Jing Qiu had gotten used to the situation. She only believed in a single thing: "Xue Ying has entered deep sleep and isn't dead. It is possible that he isn't in any danger, and will definitely wake up one day." But she was clear that this was just her wishful thinking. After all, exactly what her husband had experiences in the distant Devil Mountain Cosmos" "Primogenitor Devil Mountain" was something she could never guess.
"Sister-in-law." A red-skinned, red-haired male walked into the house. He was none other than Paragon Huo Cheng. This was an incarnation which he had sent down. He was Xue Ying's sworn brother, and also Qing Yao's teacher. During this period, his incarnation had been living on Crimson Dust Island.
Jing Qiu stood up. "Big Brother Huo Cheng."
"Please sit. I am just here to visit my brother." Paragon Huo Cheng walked to the side and sat. He looked at the comatose Xue Ying. This absolutely talented character… a stage four World Deity who could open a Dao. There were only two in this cosmos, and Xue Ying's degree of talent far surpassed that of Bamboo Mountain Prefecture Master. His future was boundless, yet now, he was still stuck in his sleep…
"Brother Dong Bo, I've heard of how most people entering another cosmos will reap a huge harvest. They are extremely careful too. But this is still the first time I've seen someone get into such huge trouble." Paragon Huo Cheng shook his head before emptying the wine flask by his side into his mouth. He finished gulping down before muttering, "You should wake up soon. I do not know when the war with Ancestor Mother Religion will begin. Unless you are planning to sleep through the entire war? Do you know that if you did this, waking up after the war ends, most Paragons of our Cultivator Cosmos would ridicule you? We have been fighting a crazy war with the Ancestor Mother Religion. But now, the final battle is starting. Are you thinking too little of this war if you sleep through it?"
Paragon Huo Cheng continued rambling on.
After being imprisoned in the Destruction Eden for so long, he had developed a habit of talking to himself.
Jing Qiu was silently listening from the side.
All of a sudden-
Their expressions changed. Paragon Huo Cheng had yet to finish his sentence when he stopped too.
"The war has begun?" Jing Qiu was slightly startled.
"It has begun!" Paragon Huo Cheng turned solemn.
They had gained the notice of the migration order to Lake Heart Island! Pang Yi was the captain of the Destruction Legion within the Lake Heart Island, so he could directly teleport everyone into the Lake Heart Island. There was no need to fly slowly across the large water spherical body in the outer perimeter of Lake Heart Island.
Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, and Qing Yao had also received the notice…
…
The entire Deity world and Abyss began their great migration. With the help of Pang Yi, it was absolutely safe to remain in the Lake Heart Island historical remain. And the Eden treasure which everyone would be temporarily staying in was provided by Bloodshed God-Emperor!
They were moving people in large batches.
The most important ones would be moved there first, then the rest would be migrated.
The battle between the Rulers and the Ancestor Mother Religion was also happening! All the accumulated resources and foundation of both cosmos races were being utilized now. They had no paths of retreat.
******
Ever since the war erupted, Bloodshed God-Emperor, who would occasionally come and visit Xue Ying, no longer had the time to come again.
The war had already left huge swathes of destruction across the Deity world and Abyss.
It was still relatively safe in the material realm.
In the Crimson Rock Mountain world on the Crimson Dust Island, it remained as quiet and peaceful as ever. No matter how much the outer world was affected by the war, this place remained unscathed.
"It is truly too crazy. I've heard that almost half the entire starfield has been eradicated into nothingness. Ai, the Deity world and Abyss have countless beings, but how many have been moved into the Lake Heart Island historical remains?" Qing Yao and Dong Bo Yu were both sighing. They were lamenting for the loss of a significant number of lives. Those living in the material realm were still relatively safe, but it was not the same for those living on the Deity world and Abyss.
Both sides were gambling their lives. The Rulers did not care about sacrificing themselves. Bloodshed God-Emperor had even died more than once. He had deliberately sacrificed his life in order to ambush the Ancestor Mother Religion.
Nevertheless, the Ancestor Mother Religion was not a race to be trifled with. Their cosmos had entered its final collapse, and it was clear that too many epochs had passed in their cosmos. And because of that, they had gathered a considerable number of treasures! They were not holding back in utilizing those resources.
"What!"
"Bloody Ruler Nile is actually a traitor?"
"Oh gosh, this, this…"
Being the children of Xue Ying, Qing Yao and Dong Bo Yu stayed relatively up-to-date with the latest information. They had also received some news regarding the war, and hearing that Bloody Ruler Nile was a traitor shocked them.
…
The news was transmitted piece by piece.
Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao, and Jing Qiu frequently obtained news. But the most important person in their lives, 'Xue Ying', remained sleeping on the bed.
******
Devil Mountain Cosmos, Primogenitor Devil Mountain's inner layer.
In one of the nine floating cavern-dwellings, the door to this place was still shut close.
And inside the cavern-dwelling, the black-robed Xue Ying was lying on a stone bed. There was a rainbow light surrounding his body. The puppet girl was seated cross-legged next to him, protecting him silently.
"So tired."
"I've been cultivating and battling for so long, when will I ever get to rest?"
"This is way too tiring."
"I've already become a Ruler, yet why is the end still not in sight? How much longer do I have to cultivate for? Do I still have to continue fighting?"
"I can't endure any longer."
"Too tiring…"
He had slept for far too long, causing his consciousness to exceptionally weary. He began to be expelled from the dream world, and the expulsion gradually forced his consciousness back to the real world.
Just like climbing slowly out from the darkest abyss, he gradually regained his consciousness. His originally blurry memories started bubbling up in his soul.
The black-robed Xue Ying slowly opened his eyes. Confusion was still present within his eyes, similar to what he experienced in his youth, where he would temporarily forget his identity and memories right after waking up. However, his experiences in his dream and his real-life memories were starting to integrate, and he subsequently regained his full consciousness.
"I, am Dong Bo Xue Ying." He was genuinely awake now.
He finally remembered that he had won the battle against Paragon Lie Yang, entering the Primogenitor Devil Mountain's inner layer. He had been flying towards his cavern-dwelling when he heard some melodious sounds, and the last thing he remembered was him falling into a deep sleep…
He had entered a dream world?
"Congratulations Master, congratulations Master, it has been 650 million years. Master is ranked first in this cosmos epoch for your first Dream Cultivation period. Even adding up the Rulers, Master still ranked third." The puppet girl stood up. Her face was filled with excitement and pride.
…
On a desolate planet in Devil Mountain Cosmos, hidden within the Eden Treasure world, the red-robed Xue Ying who was sleeping on the grass was being taken care of by the treasure spirit. There was no dust left on his body at all. At this moment, he was slowly opening his eyes.
…
In Xia Clan world, within the Crimson Rock Mountain world on the Crimson Dust Island.
Inside the house, Jing Qiu was alone, sitting on the chair and flipping through a book. She would occasionally glance at Xue Ying.
The surroundings were quiet. Jing Qiu, as a stage four World Deity who could fight against powerful existences, was extremely sensitive of her surroundings. She was holding on to a book with one hand when suddenly, she turned over with some slight disbelief after sensing something. She saw as the eyebrows above the eyes of the white-robed Xue Ying started twitching.
"Xue Ying." Jing Qiu immediately placed the book down. She looked towards Xue Ying with nervousness and excitement.
The white-robed Xue Ying who lay on the bed was slowly opening his eyes, still looking quite confused.
"Xue Ying, Xue Ying…" Jing Qiu's eyes were filled with tears as she shouted out.
The spirit in the eyes of the white-robed Xue Ying was getting clearer and more distinct. Seeing the tears in the eyes of his wife, he helped wipe them off. "Jing Qiu, I've slept for far too long this time and have made you worried."
"It's nothing much." Jing Qiu smiled and cried at the same time.
"Oh right, the war with the Ancestor Mother Religion should not have begun yet right?" The white-robed Xue Ying asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 755 - Dream Cultivation Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 755: Dream Cultivation Breakthrough
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As the white-robed Xue Ying listened to his wife explaining, he felt kind of astonished.
His wife Jing Qiu was only a stage four World Deity. It was because she had a unique identity that she was able to receive some news on the war. One had to know that the war erupted 82,000 years after Xue Ying fell into deep sleep, and now, it had been more than 100,000 years! This was a war that persisted for more than 100,000 years without stopping. The identity of 'Bloody Ruler' Nile had long been revealed, and he had died ever since. Currently, the Cultivator Cosmos held a firm upper hand in the war, yet they could not wholly exterminate the Ancestor Mother Religion.
"The moment I wake up, it has been more than 100,000 years since the war began." Xue Ying tried extending his senses, "Bloody Ruler Nile's true body and avatar are exterminated. It's good that the other Rulers are still alive."
"Teacher."
Xue Ying directly transmitted a message via karma.
"Xue Ying?" Bloodshed God-Emperor received the voice transmission. He felt both delighted and thrilled. Before the war began, he had visited Xue Ying several times. After the war erupted, even though he was concerned with his disciple, all his concentration was spent dealing against the Ancestor Mother Religion.
"Are you fine now?" Bloodshed God-Emperor asked.
"I'm fine. The slumber did not injure me. Instead, it has helped me a lot." Xue Ying responded, "What is the current situation of the war now? I might need a day or two before I could join in."
"There is slight trouble, but we still hold an absolute advantage against them! It isn't easy trying to exterminate them completely. Ultimately, the foundation of the Ancestor Mother Religion is deeper than ours. If you can participate in the battle, it is naturally a great thing. But it has been 100,000 years, so we aren't in a rush. You should finish settling your matters first." Bloodshed God-Emperor reminded him.
"Alright." Xue Ying felt his heart relaxing.
He indeed needed some time to prepare.
…
Within the inner layer of Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
The floating cavern-dwelling door opened. A black-robed Xue Ying flew out along with that puppet girl.
"A single dream lasted 650 million years." Xue Ying lightly muttered. His figure landed on the mountain road.
"Dream Cultivation? It is indeed beneficial to me, but nevertheless, it has been way too long. How long have I cultivated ever since I was born?" Xue Ying lamented. The days spent in the dream cultivating were very horrifying.
He spent his life living on a piece of empty land. He had forgotten who he was-his memory had been shrouded.
On that great empty land, there was only a single person. There was also an abode and a library hall. The books placed within the library hall were books he had seen before-subjects on the laws and profound mysteries system and cultivation techniques from other systems. It also included the "Luminous Sun", "Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body" and other absolute arts. There was even a book of the "Walker's Hidden Secret" placed within, and all books he once saw on the Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
As long as he had memorized a book before, it would appear on that piece of barren land.
Most of his memories were wiped. Instead, the great void land was his enemy, and he was forced to cultivate and to battle.
Cultivate, battle, cultivate, battle… it lasted forever!
Because he had no memories, he was like a piece of clean sheet. He would not be affected by any prior disturbances! Before dying, he had to continuously cultivate. Even though he had lost his memories, he could still feel instinctively that he preferred the laws and profound mysteries system the most, thus cultivating this system as the main one before opening the Dao of Mirage, Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple… And one of the main reasons why he had opened these Daos was because they were the easiest to comprehend. It was clear Xue Ying had to spend more effort on other systems.
He had also cultivated the "Walker's Hidden Secret"!
Cultivating all the way, even though everything happened in the dreamland, it would also influence reality. Xue Ying would walk down the same Dao path in reality too! But ultimately, the laws and profound mysteries he comprehended and the combat techniques were not entirely the same.
"I've spent 650 million years cultivating in a dream, and actually reached the 11th layer with the "Walker's Hidden Secret", becoming a Ruler." Xue Ying was startled.
There were a total of 60 levels with the "Walker's Hidden Secret".
Every 10 levels constituted a major realm.
Thus, cultivating from the first to 10th level might be tough, but it was still possible as long as one cultivated and accumulated enough experience over time. Nonetheless, to break through the bottleneck from the 10th to 11th level was something extremely difficult. It was just like breaking through using the laws and profound mysteries from the Paragon realm to the Ruler realm. Even though it was a single step, crossing this step felt like crossing the heaven's moat.
One could say that the difficulty of breaking through to the 11th level from the 10th level was much more difficult than cultivating from the 1st to the 10th level. After all, the latter was just deepening one's understanding of the same realm, and the first was a jump in a major realm.
"Ruler."
"And it is even a Ruler of the Voidwalker lineage." Xue Ying was slightly rueful. Even though he had reached that realm in his Dream Cultivation, his body remained the same in reality throughout these years. His soul stayed unchanged too since that was just a 'Dream World'.
"I've deepened my understanding of the laws and profound mysteries system at least; I've also created the third volume for the "Wind Ripple Path"."
"But-"
"The Dao of Mirage, Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple seem to be slightly different from what I comprehended in the real world." Xue Ying could feel it with his heart as a significant amount of laws and profound mysteries started intertwining. His expression changed as he began pondering in bursts.
Because he cultivated in the Dream World, even though it remained that he was still stuck at a bottleneck in these three Daos, he had some understanding as to how to reach the eternal perfection realm.
Adding up the fact that he had comprehended the same three Daos in the real world, as long as he tried comparing them and fusing them together, he should be able to break through to the Ruler realm immediately after comprehending for a short while.
'I'm not in a rush to breakthrough. I'll first return to my hometown.' Xue Ying thought.
"The inner layer of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain…" Xue Ying looked towards the many floating cavern-dwellings in the distance, "I've just arrived at the Primogenitor Devil Mountain inner layer, yet I have to leave now."
He could not stay here!
Because as long as he cultivated, the Primogenitor Devil Mountain would sense that he had reached the Ruler realm and would force him out! He was after all, no longer a Paragon and thus, he could no longer remain in this cavern-dwelling.
Want to enter the Primogenitor Devil Mountain? He had to follow the rules of the Rulers-reaching the top 39 Rulers in power before he could enter the outer layer again.
And only the strongest 9 Rulers could enter the inner layer.
The top Ruler had the chance to enter the core.
Xue Ying understood his own abilities. If he cultivated the "Walker's Hidden Secret" to the 19th or 20th level, bringing the laws and profound mysteries system all to perfect eternity, he might be able to rush to the first few Rulers in rank or even become the top Ruler. But now? He would be lucky to even enter the 'outer layer of Primogenitor Devil Mountain'.
After all, there were more than 300 Rulers after adding the natives of the Devil Mountain Cosmos and other vanquished cosmoses. To rank in the top 39… that was 10% in scale! Even the weakest of these 39 Rulers were apex Rulers.
"I've already broken through." Xue Ying turned over to the puppet girl by his side, "And I will be becoming a Ruler soon. Thus, I can no longer remain here."
The puppet girl was stunned.
Becoming a Ruler?
Paragon Lie Yang had cultivated for so long here without breaking through. This new master of hers had just entered his first Dream Cultivation, yet he had broken through to the Ruler realm already?
"Leave this cavern-dwelling for other Paragons to use." Xue Ying chuckled before leaving the place.
That day, this news had spread across the entire Primogenitor Devil Mountain, and soon, it also spread across to the experts standing at the peak of the Devil Mountain Cosmos and several other cosmos.
The strongest Paragon 'Xue Ying' who had just risen up to power abruptly, entered the inner layer of Primogenitor Devil Mountain and cultivated for more than 600 million years before breaking through to the Ruler realm. He had already left the Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
******
In the starry sky.
Xue Ying met with the Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu.
"I've not entered the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, yet you are out already?" Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu said.
"I will be breaking through to the Ruler realm soon." Xue Ying chuckled, "And my hometown is in a war. I have to go back. Before leaving, there is a small thing which I have to trouble Your Highness."
"We are friends. If you have anything, just tell me directly." Jiao Yun Liu declared.
Xue Ying replied, "The moment I become a Ruler, I'll not be able to come back via the same cosmos passage. By then, I'll send some of my loved ones and disciples over here to cultivate. I might need your assistance to help them at that time. They are just World Deities and are too weak. Without the help of an expert… they will likely encounter many issues in the Devil Mountain Cosmos."
"Rest assured. It's just a small matter. When you send your people over, just send me a message. I'll definitely arrange things properly." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu promised. What identity did he have? He was a Ruler and also the child of a Void God. It was absolutely easy for him to arrange such things.
"Are you still coming in the future?" His Highness Jiao Yun Liu asked.
Xue Ying chuckled, "We will meet again in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World."
"Alright. We'll meet at the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World then." His Highness Jiao Yun Liu said.
…
After bidding farewell to His Highness Jiao Yun Liu, Xue Ying swiftly went on the journey back home. Xue Ying had even deliberately set down a mirage array by the entrance of the cosmos passage at the Devil Mountain Cosmos to hide all traces of it!
"Go."
The black-robed and red-robed Xue Ying looked towards this Devil Mountain Cosmos.
The help which Devil Mountain Cosmos could provide him with would thus end here. Even though the Primogenitor Devil Mountain was very attractive, the inner layer's 'Dream Cultivation' was the most helpful only during the first time. In the future, its effect would only diminish every subsequent time he entered. As for the more mysterious core layer of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain… he had to become the strongest Ruler before he could enter. Xue Ying did not know how long he had to cultivate for to reach that level. But now, he just had to spend some days cultivating before breaking through, and he believed he would rank in the forefront amongst the Rulers back in his hometown. Ultimately, Xue Ying was someone who broke through using the Voidwalker lineage, and that far surpassed the strength of Rulers breaking through using the conventional systems.
'Before breaking through, I have to visit the Starting Ground once more.' Xue Ying thought.
"Hu~"
The black-robed and red-robed Xue Ying flew side by side towards the cosmos passage. They were returning back to the Cultivator Cosmos.

chapters.title: Chapter 756 - Entering the Starting Ground Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 756: Entering the Starting Ground Again
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Crimson Rock Mountain World, on top of Crimson Dust Island.
The white-robed Xue Ying accompanied his wife and children for a while before entering closed-door cultivation. "Sou sou", the black-robed Xue Ying and the red-robed Xue Ying-the two avatars-had also landed in the material realm on the Crimson Dust Island to converge on with the true body.
Actually, there were no differences between the true body and avatars. They were all of the same soul and fleshy body. It was only now that they could maintain in the form of avatars… in the future, the true body and avatars had to reunite as one to reform the soul.
The three bodies were facing each other.
The white-robed Xue Ying flipped his hand before passing the Starting Ground talisman to the black-robed Xue Ying.
"Go." After receiving it, he activated it with a thought.
The energy within the cosmos brought warmth and protected him. In the blink of an eye, the black-robed Xue Ying saw the scene ahead of him changing. He had arrived at the Starting Ground which he once came before.
"The feeling of being mortal." The black-robed Xue Ying revealed a grin. His vision and hearing ability had holistically decreased-he was just like a mortal.
"My current power could match Rulers, yet under the rules of Starting Ground, I still became a mortal." Xue Ying was slightly rueful. He understood that Forefather Tian Yu, the one who created Starting Ground, could do this. If Forefather Tian Yu's true body arrived, he could likely turn Xue Ying into a mortal and take away all the strength he cultivated!
Lake Heart Island Swordmaster had once intruded into this place forcefully. But he wasn't affected by the suppression of the rules on Starting Ground. That was the gap in power. Xue Ying was apparently too weak and was too far off from Forefather Tian Yu.
According to the words left by his teacher, Voidwalker 'Gu Qi', Lake Heart Island Swordmaster was only a step away from Forefather Tian Yu's level. Currently on the 'Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World', Forefather Tian Yu and Lake Heart Island Swordmaster were the two strongest experts protecting the place.
"Hu~"
A gentle wind blew.
The grass was soft, and in the distant, there were several flowerbeds. Xue Ying strolled along the place with familiarity.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, why have you come back so early?" The white-haired old man walked over from a stone house, "Wu? You are currently in the Opening realm. Are you prepared to take the Opening realm's trial?"
"That's right." Xue Ying nodded.
This place was left behind by the creator of the cosmos. It was left behind as 'present' to these descendants, but clearly, it wasn't easy to obtain the gifts by Forefather Tian Yu.
"The previous time you came, you partook the World Deity realm trial and also the lowest leveled trial. One level higher than the World Deity realm is the World realm and subsequently, the Opening realm! The highest is the Ruler realm." The white-haired old man walked with a chuckle, "The trial you are taking this time is two great realms higher than the previous one, so the difficulty will far transcend the previous time. There has never been anyone who succeeded through the Opening realm in this cosmos epoch. Are you fully prepared?"
"I am." Xue Ying nodded.
What a joke.
Before the Dream Cultivation, he had the capabilities to become the strongest Paragon in Primogenitor Devil Mountain! Even though he had not immediately cultivated this time after returning-his body remained at the 8th level of Walker's Hidden Secret, his understanding of the Dao of Slaughter, Dao of Ripple and Dao of Mirage was much more profound than the past, and his combat power was way higher. If he could not pass through the trial, it would be a joke.
"Look."
The white-haired old man pointed afar.
