Xue Ying looked towards the direction he pointed. At the center of this barren land, there were three grass houses.
"Grass houses." The white-haired old man said, "There are three of them. One is a treasure cove, and the other two are meant for those who passed the Opening realm trial and the Ruler realm trial before they are qualified to enter! I hope that you could enter… Master hopes for all you little brats to eventually enter."
"Mn." Xue Ying nodded, "Certainly."
"Seems like you are fully confident, though I hope that you will not be too careless. "The white-haired old man said before walking ahead, "Follow me."
…
Just like the previous time, they walked for half an hour to reach the area 10 kilometers away. There were five gigantic trees. The branch of the trees required several humans pulling one another's hand before they could fully hug it. The white-haired old man directly walked towards the tree at the center: "Coem in." His body contacted that tree before disappearing from the vicinity. Xue Ying similarly walked towards and touched that gigantic tree before entering it.
"Hua."
He got through time-space, appearing at a desolate frost land. The entire place was filled with frost.
Xue Ying flew into the sky, observing the area around him. The frost land extended all the way until the end of this spatial dimension. The white-haired old man stood by a side.
"Who is my opponent this time?" Xue Ying was fully confident.
"Opponent?"
The white-haired old man chuckled. He pointed to around him, "This world is your opponent."
"This world?" Xue Ying was startled.
"All you have to do is survive in this world." The white-haired old man said, "It's either you die and fail, or you survive. Be a little careful. It has begun."
Xue Ying warily extended his senses across this frost world.
"Hu hu hu~"
The temperature of this frost world began decreasing rapidly. Just the temperature alone sufficed to freeze some of the weaker Paragons to death. As the temperature decreased even further, sparkling and pure 'ice crystals' started condensing in midair. Every crystal that condensed was extremely sharp.
"Xiu!" An ice crystal arced through the sky and shot over. It tore through space with a terrifying might.
Xue Ying remained calm as he watched. His right hand casually tapped the void, causing a ripple to form. This ripple fluctuated and easily resonated with the void, causing an area of ripples to appear in the sky. The ripples clashed against the ice crystals, shattering it immediately.
The expression of the white-haired old man brightened as he saw this, "A simple action that produces a great effect. His understanding of the laws and profound mysteries has reached such a formidable stage. He is at least much more formidable than the previous brat who specialized in time-space."
That time, Temporal Island Lord had come. It's a pity that he died and failed the Opening realm trial.
"But this is just the beginning." The white-haired old man muttered, "Don't blame Master. The cosmos origin source will protect everyone within the cosmos. Your current days are considered relatively safe. Wait until you leave the cosmos… that is when all kinds of danger surface. Without sufficient survival capabilities, it is impossible for you to grow, and you will fall prematurely. Naturally, all experts have to be able to survive."
…
As the ice crystal shattered, the temperature continued dropping. One could see more ice crystals condensing rapidly. The moment they finished condensing, they would be shot over to where Xue Ying was. Some of the ice crystals had torn through the body of the 'white-haired old man', though it seemed like he was illusory and wasn't injured at all. Neither would he be a hindrance to the ice crystals.
Xue Ying stood in midair. He casually pointed. It was like plucking the strings of an instrument in the air. This action of his formed many spatial ripples that blasted in all directions. It had even caused the void to vibrate. Those ripples instantaneously appeared in the distant.
Many ripples were shot out in all directions, smashing apart those ice crystals that condensed.
The temperature continued dropping.
Xue Ying frowned slightly. Nonetheless, being a Voidwalker, his body was strong, and he could overlook this coldness. It's just that the ice crystals would form more rapidly in a significant amount as the temperature dipped further. It was increasing in multiples of ten, and soon, over 10 million and beyond 100 million crystals were forming all over the place…
He casually struck with his finger out, causing the void ripple to spread in all directions. But as large amounts of ice crystals were shot, the void ripples were soon consumed.
"You can't forcibly withstand this."
"This trial tests your survival capabilities. This is just the first wave." The white-haired old man shook his head with a smile as he saw this, "It isn't easy to withstand this directly."
Xue Ying no longer hesitated after seeing this, "It is time to rely on my domain."
"Hong~"
With Xue Ying at the center, an overflow of blood wave rolled out in all directions. It was like a vast blood sea that spread and inundated the incoming ice crystals

chapters.title: Chapter 757 - Inside the Grass House
chapters.content:
Chapter 757: Inside the Grass House
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The blood wave rolled out and engulfed the entire frost world. Some ice crystals did not shatter, but after holding up for a while, those crystals broke eventually since the damage to the structure of those crystals would only accumulate over time in the 'Slaughter Domain'. Furthermore, after undergoing the 'Dream Cultivation', Xue Ying had further improved the 'Slaughter Domain' after experiencing many battles.
Xue Ying stood at the center. The surrounding blood sea rolled and spread in all directions. The ice crystals were no longer able to threaten him any longer.
"He… he is actually able to resist the first wave by force?" The white-haired old man was slightly stunned, "The domain he utilized, according to the investigation of laws by the Starting Ground, made use of profound mysteries that are still in the limits of the Opening realm, yet its power has reached such a stage?"
Monarch Green was able to fuse different Daos together, giving him the strength to fight against Rulers.
Xue Ying had similarly grasped three Daos, of which he could use the Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple in tandem perfectly.
"Chi chi chi~"
The temperature was still decreasing.
Amidst the rolling blood wave, some black liquid bodies began condensing. The black liquid bodies appeared within the 'Slaughter Domain', and they did not decompose after that. Instead, the black liquid bodies were able to hold on for a further period! And as the temperature dipped, the number of black liquid droplets increased even further.
"The second wave of survival trial has begun." That white-haired old man looked from afar, "This battle is more dangerous than the previous one."
"Mn?"
Xue Ying frowned.
Currently, the many droplets of black liquid bodies were able to withstand for a breath of time in the Slaughter Domain. Because the black liquid bodies were continuously forming in greater amounts, over time, there became more black liquid droplets in the grand Slaughter Domain. The world had not started releasing its attacks. Clearly, the black liquid bodies were still being accumulated, making Xue Ying feel a faint threat.
"Interesting. Come on! Let's see how formidable you are." Xue Ying was looking forward to this. In the worst case, he would just hide in his Mirage world and depend on the Mirage world or void techniques to hide. Even if some remnant force from the attack reached him, he could easily withstand it with his body.
But still…
Xue Ying was fully confident. He was not cornered to the extent that he had to hide to survive.
"Hong!"
The countless black liquid bodies abruptly moved. They tore through the blood wave Slaughter Domain and surged right towards Xue Ying.
"Wind Ripple Path second technique, domain!" Countless ripples exploded out from the surface of Xue Ying's body. The endless ripples immediately fused together as one with the Slaughter Domain as they charged out in all directions. The moment they touched the black liquid droplets, "peng peng peng"! Every single black liquid droplet directly exploded. Within moments, almost all the black liquid droplets had been exterminated.
This was none other than the second volume of his self-created absolute art, "Wind Ripple Path". It was a killing move used together with the Slaughter Domain.
The Slaughter Domain was a fusion of the Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple!
The absolute art "Wind Ripple Path" was the same.
During the days of Dream Cultivation, Xue Ying had fused the two together, significantly increasing the power of the Slaughter Domain. This was also one of the moves created purely for the Slaughter Domain in the "Wind Ripple Path".
"This, this…" The white-haired old man widened his eyes as he observed this. The countless black liquid exploded in moments, causing him to disbelieve what he just saw, "Master has created this cosmos. This is the eighth cosmos epoch already, and none were able to pass through the Opening trial yet. There might be some who got through the trail in the previous seven epochs, but none was as tyrannical as this."
That's right. The trial itself was very overbearing. It would continuously attack the trial-taker in overwhelming amounts. According to logic, Xue Ying should have hidden himself to survive.
But nevertheless, he was just breaking apart all incoming attacks.
"The third wave and also the final wave." The white-haired old man looked at Xue Ying with expectation.
As the temperature sank further, the frost world's vast frost land had instead started 'thawing'. Xue Ying personally observed as the entire frost land thaw into countless black liquid bodies. They were swiftly converging into a huge monstrous beast. This monstrous black beast was like a black Flood Dragon, albeit its front claws were exceptionally savage.
"Such fearsome beast." Xue Ying looked at the monstrous black beast that was transformed from the colossal frost land. The monstrous black beast glared at Xue Ying, letting out a world-shattering roar.
Following that, it charged over aggressively.
"Hmph."
Xue Ying snorted out first.
Then an unseen ripple which explosively burst out from the surface of his body. The Slaughter Domain also rapidly fluctuated out-inundating over the incoming black monstrous beast. The surface of that monstrous black beast quaked from the domain strike. It was injured by the domain attack, breaking down into many black streams. Regardless, its immensely huge body was still relatively well.
"Wind Ripple Path third technique, Annihilate!" Xue Ying fiercely hacked out with his right hand. His right arm grew explosively. It was so big it covered the entire place. His palm came down like a great ax, and that enormous black monstrous beast also waved its front claws to meet Xue Ying's palm.
"Peng!"
A palm chopping down.
The black, fierce beast suddenly broke down back into the endless black liquid from this strike. Following that, the temperature of the world began rising once again. The black liquid soon scattered and dispelled back into its original endless frost air flow.
Xue Ying kept his Slaughter Domain. He stood at his original position frowning.
"The fourth technique of "Wind Ripple Path"… should be much purer than this." Countless thoughts were clashing in Xue Ying's mind. Ever since waking up, he did not dare to cultivate because he was afraid he might just break through in the laws and profound mysteries to the Ruler realm carelessly! That way, he would no longer be qualified to take part in the Opening realm trial.
And now, because he had displayed "Wind Ripple Path" during the battle, utilizing the laws and profound mysteries of the "Wind Ripple Path" to his cravings, the massive amounts of experience he had during the Dream Cultivation began clashing against each other. Naturally, he had some inkling of what the fourth volume for "Wind Ripple Path" should be.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, congratulations for passing through the trial." The white-haired old man fell into a daze momentarily before giving his congratulations.
"If I break through now into the Ruler realm, I should still be able to get the rewards by Forefather right?" Xue Ying asked.
"Hahaha, you have passed through the trial, so it is no problem for you to break through to the Ruler realm." The white-haired old man said with shock, "Why, are you breaking through? That's right too since the utilization of your laws and profound mysteries have reached this realm, and breaking through will come naturally."
Xue Ying might be chatting with the white-haired old man, but in his mind, many of his ideas were currently clashing with one another. The vast amount of experience and understanding he had gathered from the Dream Cultivation were currently fusing together. One could say that 99% of his concentration was on this.
"Shall we leave?" The white-haired old man suggested.
"Let's." Xue Ying chuckled. The other two avatars of his were also currently immersed in the deep clash of ideas and experiences.
…
The white-haired old man brought Xue Ying out of that frost world. He was still clicking his tone and sighing, "Forefather has left behind this trial to test your survival capabilities, yet you actually destroyed everything in a direct clash. Truly formidable, very formidable, at least much more than the previous brat who specialized in time-space."
"Specialized in time-space? Temporal Island Lord?" Xue Ying could not help but blurt out.
"Mn, let's not mention about him." The white-haired old man pointed to the three grass houses in the distant. His eyes were emitting light, "Your great opportunity has arrived. Let us move quicker."
Xue Ying nodded. He was looking forward to seeing what Forefather Tian Yu leave behind for these descendant disciples of his.
When they got to about 100-200 meters by the grass house, the surrounding world started distorting. Because he had experienced this previously, Xue Ying walked on calmly. He went through many of the distorted layers of world before finally, walking through the protection of the layered world and arriving right in front of the grass house located to the left.
"Go in." The white-haired old man laughed.
"Mn."
Xue Ying nodded.
Of the three grass houses, the left house was meant for those who got through the Opening realm trial. Only those who passed through the Ruler trial were qualified to enter the center house. The right house was a treasure cove.
"Zhi ya", Xue Ying lightly pushed open the ordinary-looking wooden door of the grass house. Inside the grass house, it was a piece of darkness. It seemed like a vortex that made it difficult to perceive.
Stepping in, he walked through this layer of the dark vortex.
"Hu."
Everything changed in front of him.
This was an ordinary house. It had a long narrow table inside and a praying mat. On top of the table, there was a purple gown and a piece of purple talisman.
Suddenly, a figure appeared on top of the praying mat.
That was a slightly-hunchbacked old figure. He had a smile as he looked at Xue Ying: "Descendant, your cosmos is actually created by me. The many living beings within your cosmos is also created by me. For you to pass through the Opening trial and enter this location meant that you are a violet-robed disciple of my 'Great Void Heaven Temple'. Oh, the Great Void Heaven Temple is a sect which is created after I was invited over by the 'Devil Mountain Primogenitor' and 'Jade Light Master' to the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World."

chapters.title: Chapter 758 - Violet-robed Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 758: Violet-robed Disciple
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Devil Mountain Primogenitor, Jade Light Master?” Xue Ying immediately thought of the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu had once told him before that their primogenitor and another existence had inaugurated the ‘Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World’. Now, Forefather Tian Yu said that he created a sect after being invited over by Devil Mountain Primogenitor and Jade Light Master?
‘It seems that the one who created the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World should be Devil Mountain Primogenitor and Jade Light Master. Judging from this, our cosmos’ Forefather Tian Yu has a great relationship with Devil Mountain Primogenitor and the others.’ Xue Ying thought.
If there were a bad relationship, he would not leave behind an image to the descendants mentioning about those two people.
Forefather Tian Yu was slightly hunch-backed. His eyes were quite warm, and his ears drooped down greatly. He continued speaking with a chuckle, “My Great Void Heaven Temple is also one the greatest superpowers within the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. It is famous throughout the place. In the future, if you met any danger when you leave your cosmos towards the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, you can report your identity during a dire situation since anyone who is slightly good with gathering information will know that my Great Void Heaven Temple is extremely protective of the disciples. Those who dare to bully the disciples of the Great Void Heaven Temple meant that they are riding on the head of us! And that is seeking death!”
“Naturally, my Great Void Heaven Temple has enemies too. Thus, it is vital only to report your identity during dire situations, and you might possibly live.”
Xue Ying obediently listened.
He could discern that this Forefather Tian Yu was a kind person. He left behind an image to the descendant disciples, telling them that ‘those who dared to bully and ride on the head of my Great Void Heaven Temple would be seeking death’. Clearly, it was not good to offend disciples of the Great Void Heaven Temple.
But still, Xue Ying liked such a forefather the most!
The other party created the Cultivator Cosmos and was indeed the old ancestor of all living beings within their cosmos.
“Being a violet-robed disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple, you will get this robe and talisman. At the same time, you get to select three primal chaos ranked fundamental absolute arts!” Forefather Tian Yu mentioned, “These are all fundamental absolute arts. I would rather you descendants refer to these absolute arts… and create your own absolute arts eventually! Only those that you create yourself will be the most appropriate for your own.”
“As for weapons and other external materials? You will have to depend on yourself. The path of cultivation ultimately depends on yourself to tread.” Forefather Tian Yu chuckled before his image dissipated.
Xue Ying understood that this was only an image.
Just like the Voidwalker ‘Gu Qi’ who left behind an incarnation especially for the sake of imparting his inheritance.
Due to a difference in the laws and profound mysteries system, this system ultimately required the user to ponder and open his own Dao path and proceed on forward…
“Robe?”
Xue Ying first brought up the violet robe. He sent a ripple of his soul in and easily refined it. After refining the robe, he discovered that this violet robe had naturally recognized him as the master. Other than the master, none could use it. Clearly, the identity of being a violet-robed disciple under the Great Void Heaven Temple… was not something easily forged.
“Such a tough robe. “Xue Ying was slightly speechless. After he refined the robe, he discovered that this robe immediately started transforming and covering him in a full violet suit.
“This robe… I could not damage it at all even with my entire strength.” Xue Ying pointed with his fingertip. The Termination Energy was formed at the fingertip. He attempted damaging the edge of this robe, yet he could not damage it at all.
Xue Ying then casually brought up the violet talisman by the side. He sent his consciousness in.
“Hong~”
Large amounts of information surged into his mind.
All sorts of common knowledge regarding the Great Void Heaven Temple and even the report of Forefather Tian Yu personally refining this extremely tough and firm robe were recorded within. There was also some information regarding the Primal Chaos ranked absolute arts.
The Primal Chaos ranked absolute arts were ranked second even in the Great Void Heaven Temple! Even Ancestor Devil’s “Myriad Devil True Body” was far off from the Primal Chaos ranked absolute arts. One could see how heaven-shaking it was for someone to select three such arts. Even though there was another higher first-grade absolute art… in reality, with the current realm of Xue Ying, there was no difference between the first and second-grade absolute arts. He was too weak.
“Great Void Heaven Temple has a total of 109 Primal Chaos ranked absolute arts.” Xue Ying felt dumbstruck. The talisman had the most basic introductions regarding all the 109 absolute arts.
Why were they fundamental absolute arts?
They were the fundamentals that specialized in just a single Dao! An absolute art would be entirely about a single Dao.
It was unlike Xue Ying’s self-created “Wind Ripple Path” that was formed using two Daos and was more diverse. The rules of the Great Void Heaven Temple dictated that even the violet-robed disciples or the core golden-robed disciples-those who passed through the Ruler realm trials and were fewer in numbers than the Void Gods-would only be imparted with fundamental absolute arts.
The fundamental absolute arts focused on a single Dao and were purer! They were more appropriate for use as references.
If one directly imparted absolute arts which fused together many Daos… it might affect the direction of cultivation for future descendants. It might even destroy their future! One could not interfere with the path of cultivation, especially when it was in the laws and profound mysteries system; this system required descendant disciples to walk by themselves. Thus, by imparting them with the best and most appropriate fundamental absolute arts, the final destination they reached would depend on their talent.
‘Just three types?’ Xue Ying felt that it was too few. He could not help but mutter.
He had comprehended only three Daos.
‘Whatever. It is impossible to disobey the rules set by Forefather Tian Yu.’ Xue Ying thought. He knew that Forefather Tian Yu did not wish for descendant disciples to split their concentration on too many absolute arts. That was why he limited it to just three books.
And it was too few for him. Three Daos. One book per Dao meant three absolute arts. He also had to select the most crucial one on cultivating the true deity heart- totalling four types.
‘I’ll have to give up a Dao.’
‘Mn.’
Xue Ying’s thinking process was swift. He made his decision soon enough.
‘It is more common to find slaughter-related techniques. I have seen many books on those in the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. Let’s give up on the slaughter-related absolute art.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘The remaining three Primal Chaos ranked absolute arts will be “Shadowless Heaven’s Gathering”, “3000 Incarnations” and “God Light Scripture”.”
The “Shadowless Heaven’s Gathering” was a domain-type absolute art related to the ‘Dao of Ripple’!
The “3000 Incarnations” was an absolute art for the ‘Dao of Mirage’!
The “God Light Scripture” was meant to cultivate his soul.
…
Outside the grass house, the white-haired old man was waiting there.
Xue Ying walked out from the grass house in the violet robe. The white-haired old man grinned after seeing this, “Congratulations, congratulations for becoming a violet-robed disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple.”
“I still have to request for senior to help me bring the original absolute arts “Shadowless Heaven’s Gathering”, “3000 Incarnations” and “God Light Scripture”,” Xue Ying said.
“Alright. But I’ll have to remind you in advance that these original copy of absolute arts could not be taken away. There is only a single original copy of each Primal Chaos ranked absolute art within the Starting Ground.” The white-haired old man said.
“I understand.” Xue Ying nodded.
Very soon, the white-haired old man brought out three books from within the grass house treasure cove. The “Shadowless Heaven’s Gathering”‘s book was entirely transparent. The “3000 Incarnations” was an entirely black book. As for the “God Light Scripture”, it was a gold book. Those books were emitting an unseen aura. After all, they were Primal Chaos ranked absolute arts.
…
After receiving the original copies of the three absolute arts, Xue Ying returned back to the grass house. He sat down cross-legged on that praying mat.
This grass house was a cultivation ground left behind by Forefather Tian Yu specifically for violet-robed disciples. The time here could be accelerated to 10,000 times, and even that praying mat was a precious treasure. Sitting on it, the effects of cultivation were actually much better than cultivating in the outer layer of Primogenitor Devil Mountain.
“I’ll cultivate right here.”
‘Mn, I am not in a rush to study the absolute arts. Comprehending and cultivating them will take some time. I’ll first fuse together the comprehensions I had during my Dream Cultivation.’ Xue Ying thought. The time flow within the grass house accelerated to 10,000 times. After all, it was merely just a fusion of comprehension, and he needed not to feel the laws in the outer world.
“Hong~”
In his mind, several disagreements on the Dao of Slaughter, Dao of Ripple, Dao of Mirage, the “Wind Ripple Path” and Slaughter Domain were clashing with each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 759 - Finally Becoming a Ruler
chapters.content:
Chapter 759: Finally Becoming a Ruler
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Before proceeding with the Dream Cultivation, Xue Ying had reached bottleneck in all three Daos of his. Even though there were some differences in the direction he headed during Dream Cultivation, and that there were some slight differences in the comprehension he had, they were still at the bottleneck. It was to the extent that he gained some understanding of the Ruler realm during cultivation.
As the two forms of comprehension clashed, it produced a genuinely mystical feeling.
…
As time flowed, Xue Ying had spent a full 160 years in the grass house before concluding with his cultivation. Only six days had passed in the outer world. This was much longer than the two days which Xue Ying told the Bloodshed God-Emperor about, but the war had lasted for so long, and these few days would not make a significant difference. Xue Ying had reached a critical moment in the creation of the fourth volume for his self-created “Wind Ripple Path”, and he was not willing to stop. He continued consolidating his understanding, causing him to be so engrossed in it that he spent more time than expected in it.
Crimson Rock Mountain world, on the Crimson Dust Island.
“Zhi ya.”
A white-robed Xue Ying pushed open the courtyard door and came out. The surroundings had many large trees with red leaves. The leaves had fallen to the ground.
“The Ruler realm is indeed entirely different.” Xue Ying revealed a grin.
He looked upwards to the distant.
His gaze penetrated through the entire material realm, allowing him to land his sight on the remote Lake Heart Island historical remain. He had even seen deep into the Lake Heart Island, observing the cross-legged seated Rulers like Bloodshed God-Emperor, Pang Yi, Monarch Green, Abyss Primogenitor, Purgatory Ruler, Empress Qian he, Temporal Island Lord, Myriad God Palace Master and Primal Master-the nine of them. The Cultivator Cosmos had trans-migrated almost all their experts into the Lake Heart Island, and these Rulers left a single avatar on the island too.
When Xue Ying looked at the nine Rulers, the nine Rulers had extended their senses and turned over in shock.
“Who?”
“It is impossible for those fools of Ancestor Mother Religion to discover our hiding place.”
Bloodshed God-Emperor, Temporal Island Lord, Monarch Green, Pang Yi and the others extended their senses in reciprocation.
Very soon, as they crossed glances with Xue Ying…
“Junior Disciple Brother Dong Bo?” Monarch Green was genuinely shocked.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying?” Temporal Island Lord did not dare believe, “He, he became a Ruler already?”
Bloodshed God-Emperor revealed a look of delight. He laughed out greatly at that juncture, “Fellow gentlemen, Xue Ying has entered the Devil Mountain Cosmos which has a time flow more than 3,000 times faster than ours. Thus, Xue Ying has already cultivated for several hundred million years there! He had originally reached a bottleneck in his cultivation, and thus, it is normal for him to take that final step to become a Ruler.”
“Normal?” Monarch Green sighed instead, “I’ve trapped in the Paragon realm for far too long.”
“It is only after opening a different Dao and after I created a new cultivation technique that I finally broke through.” Pang Yi sighed too, “With Dong Bo Xue Ying’s talent, he could actually cultivate straight to the Ruler realm.”
Crossing the boundary to become a Ruler from the Paragon realm might seem to be just a single step, but it was indeed challenging.
Even Heavenly Emperor of Great Destruction was stuck there!
“Hahaha, for Xue Ying to become a Ruler, he’ll definitely be of a great help to us.” Bloodshed God-Emperor directly stated, “Xue Ying, come over as soon as possible.”
“Yes, teacher.” Xue Ying acknowledged.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, previously I did not find it puzzling that you are able to reach the limit of the Opening realm. But for you to become a Ruler so quickly… I am filled with admiration for you. This is truly too fast.” Primal Master transmitted with a lament.
Temporal Island Lord had a strange expression.
He disdained and did not care about this Xue Ying in the past. But now, in the blink of an eye, this brat was suddenly standing on equal grounds with him? What kind of joke was this?
‘Hmph hmph, he is just a new Ruler, so he should still be weak.’ Temporal Island Lord consoled himself.
…
Xue Ying could discern the shock the Rulers had of him. Such shock was not unfounded because becoming a Ruler was genuinely tough, at least for those cultivating the laws and profound mysteries system.
‘After fusing my comprehensions, I’ve only broken through in the Dao of Mirage, allowing me to reach the Ruler realm.’ Xue Ying sighed ruefully, ‘I’ve created the fourth volume of “Wind Ripple Path”, allowing my understanding of the Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple to deepen. But I still require a period of time and accumulation before I could break through in those Daos.’
‘If not for the Dream Cultivation, I might be stuck at the bottleneck for a longer period.’ Xue Ying understood this point.
“Xue Ying.”
A voice was heard.
Xue Ying turned upwards. He saw Jing Qiu appearing in front of him with a flash.
“Father, father.” Two other figures also teleported with ‘sou’ and appeared. They were Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao.
“Xue Ying, why could I feel your aura?” Jing Qiu could not help asking. In her senses, the aura Xue Ying was giving off in front of her became all the more unfathomable.
“After entering the Devil Mountain Cosmos, I had some opportunities that allowed me to break through with one fell swoop. I am a Ruler now.” Xue Ying replied.
Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, and Qing Yao were all stunned.
Became a Ruler?
They were proud of Xue Ying and had to admit that he was genuinely outstanding. But becoming a Ruler? Becoming someone that stood at the peak of the entire cosmos? He was standing on an equivalent level with Bloodshed God-Emperor, Temporal Island Lord, Abyss Primogenitor, Myriad God Palace Head and others? This was hard to believe even for Jing Qiu and the rest.
“The time flow in Devil Mountain Cosmos is much faster. I haven’t cultivated for just 10 million years. Instead, it has been over 600 million years.” Xue Ying chuckled, “Wait until the war is over and I’ll send all of you over to the Devil Mountain Cosmos. They have greater resources and more diverse cultivation systems. I’ve also befriended Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu, and have long mentioned about this to him.”
“Ruler ah…” Dong Bo Yu looked towards Qing Yao to his side, “Did you hear that? My father has become a Ruler!”
“My father is also a Ruler!” Qing Yao deliberately curled her lips.
Both brother and sister could hardly conceal their excitement.
Xue Ying chuckled after seeing this, “I’ll transcend first.”
“Transcend?” Jing Qiu and the other two were stunned.
Xue Ying looked to the sky by the side-directly penetrating through the layer of time-space.
“Weng~”
It was like peeling off the skin of tangerine and revealing the flesh inside. One could see the void being peeled away, revealing a deeper level of space inside. There was an incomparably wide river which was gushing across. The river was surging, and it did not contain an origin or an end. It was just moving in every single location of the entire cosmos.
There were many living beings within the river. The lowest creatures were the ants, and the highest were the stage four World Deities.
“River of Time?” Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao, and Jing Qiu were looking at it. Looking at this river, they began feeling complex in their hearts. They were all looking forward to transcending beyond this river one day during cultivation.
“That is-”
Dong Bo Yu and the other two were looking afar with exceptional shock.
There was an incomparably towering giant located in the River of Time! The height of this giant could not be measured. He could not be seen with the naked eyes since he was too tall-it was to the extent that the river water had merely reached the knees of his legs! The width of the legs had almost entirely covered the entire width of the River of Time.
This giant merely took a single step before reaching the shore by the side.
He was out of the river-onto the shore!
This was no ordinary river. It was the River of Time. Walking onto the shore, Xue Ying had become a paramita, a transcendent.
The white-robed Xue Ying also took a step before arriving at the shore of the void. One could see the incomparably towering giant rapidly becoming small. At this point, Dong Bo Yu, Jing Qiu, and Qing Yao could finally see that the towering figure with legs covering almost the entire width of the River of Time, was none other than Xue Ying! After all, Xue Ying had not just become a Ruler using the Dao of Mirage, he had also become a Ruler using the ‘Voidwalker lineage’. His true deity heart was extremely formidable-much stronger than the Rulers. That was why his figure was so exaggerated in the River of Time.
That towering figure became smaller before fusing with the white-robed Xue Ying as one.
“Transcendence, grand perfection.” Xue Ying could feel his soul becoming more perfected, “But only when my true body and avatars merge into one will I truly reach the final perfection.”
In order to become a Void God, he had to fuse his true body and avatars together as one. Only when life reached true perfection could he take that step, crossing from the major realm of True God into Void God. Right now, Xue Ying was still a Ruler, and he did not have to enter the Primal Chaos Void temporarily. Naturally, he did not have to fuse true body with his avatars.
“Father, I’ve heard that one relies on the law of the world to prop himself out of the River of Time during transcendence. You have just taken a step up onto the shore instead? That figure of yours is truly too big already.” Dong Bo Yu was speechless.
“Haha… I’ll not speak with you all anymore. I’ll have to make my move first.” Xue Ying nodded to his wife.
“Be careful.” Jing Qiu reminded him.
Xue Ying smiled before disappearing. He had already left the material realm to meet with the Bloodshed God-Emperor and others.

chapters.title: Chapter 760 - Using Mirage Dao to become a Ruler?
chapters.content:
Chapter 760: Using Mirage Dao to become a Ruler?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
There was an enormous black stone pillar planted amidst the dark starry sky. This black stone pillar had many shackles that extended in all directions surrounding it. Countless veined patterns were moving on those shackles. That enormous stone pillar contained many veined patterns that were similarly moving too, emitting a mighty grandeur that encompassed the nearby 500 billion kilometers.
This grandeur would startle even the Rulers. The peak of the black stone was more than 5,000 kilometers wide. Currently, there were two figures were seated on top of it. One was the crimson-robed Bloodshed God-Emperor, and the other was the graceful and luxurious-looking Empress Qian He.
“Sou.” A figure suddenly appeared. It was none other than the white-robed Xue Ying.
“Yi? This stone pillar array…” Xue Ying could feel many layers of energy stacking and suppressing down on him. He originally wanted to arrive right on the peak of that stone pillar to meet his teacher, but who would have thought that he would be obstructed from a far distance away.
“Haha, even your teacher I can’t force my way in and you are thinking of doing so?” Bloodshed God-Emperor stood up on the peak of the black stone pillar, looking at his disciple who shriveled and laughed, “Come on in. Don’t resist.”
Saying that, he controlled the array.
Energy enveloped Xue Ying and teleported him in.
Xue Ying appeared at the peak of the black stone pillar. He then laughed and bowed, “Greetings, teacher.”
“You don’t have to be too polite with me.” Bloodshed God-Emperor grinned. The path of cultivation was very lonely. And on this lonely path, both his disciples could follow his footsteps, making Bloodshed God-Emperor feel relatively satisfied.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying.” Empress Qian He walked over. Her voice was refreshing, “The first time I met you, you were still a little brat participating in the Myriad Flower Feast. In the blink of an eye, you are now a Ruler already.”
“It’s my luck.”
Xue Ying humbly replied.
“There is no luck involved in cultivation.” Bloodshed God-Emperor answered, “Oh right, which Dao did you break through to the Ruler realm in? Dao of Mirage? Dao of Slaughter?”
Empress Qian He was carefully listening from the side too.
“Dao of Mirage.” Xue Ying said.
Strictly speaking, he had broken through to the Ruler realm in two different systems. One was the ‘Dao of Mirage’ within the laws and profound mysteries system that reached the eternal perfection realm. The other was the Voidwalker system. Comparing the assistance it could bring to combat, the ‘Voidwalker system’ was the greatest. Being a cultivation system that had a harsh requirement, few cultivators were taking this path… and at least in the early stages, it brought the most significant advantages!
“Dao of Mirage?” Bloodshed God-Emperor was stunned, “Then what about the Dao of Slaughter?”
“I feel like I am breaking through soon. I just lack a little accumulation.” Xue Ying responded.
“Many apex Paragons are stuck at this bottleneck, and they felt like they lacked a little, yet they have been trapped for god knows how long.” Empress Qian He shook her head from the side.
Xue Ying frowned, “Empress Qian He, what are you implying with your words?”
How short had he cultivated for?
And how difficult was it to reach the Ruler realm using the laws and profound mysteries system? Being able to break through in the Dao of Mirage was due to the ‘Dream Cultivation’. It was reasonable for him not to break through in the Dao of Slaughter. So what was Empress Qian He implying with her words?
“Haha, Dong Bo Xue Ying, don’t be agitated. I am only lamenting about the fact that your Dao of Slaughter hasn’t broken through.” Empress Qian He added.
“What is there to lament about?” Xue Ying felt puzzled.
“I, too, wished that you had broken through in your Dao of Slaughter. It might be of greater assistance to our war with the Ancestor Mother Religion” Bloodshed God-Emperor explained.
Xue Ying began to understand it a little.
Dao of Mirage…
That was a Dao which specialized more in survival, hiding and illusory techniques. It was very weak in terms of frontal combat. But he had broken through in another more powerful cultivation system to the Ruler realm!
“Hua.” “Hua.” “Hua.” …
Suddenly, many figures appeared in the surrounding. They were none other than Monarch Green who was emitting an endless suppression, the simple-robed Primal Master and incarnations of other Rulers. Other than the traitor ‘Bloody Ruler’ Nile who died already, the other Rulers could be said to be gathered here. Naturally, most were just incarnations.
“Dong Bo, congratulations on becoming a Ruler.”
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, congratulations on becoming a Ruler.”
“For you to become a Ruler so quickly, you will have a greater hope of stepping into the Void God realm. Congratulations.”
Each and every one of them came congratulating him.
Xue Ying also smiled back in acknowledgment.
There were ten Rulers present including Xue Ying, and they were also the strongest ten existences in the Cultivator Cosmos.
“Oh right, Dong Bo Xue Ying, which Dao of yours have broken through to the Ruler realm?” Primal Master then aked.
Xue Ying felt helpless. You as the oldest Ruler, Primal Master, was also asking this?
“Dao of Mirage.” Xue Ying said without hiding it.
“Oh.” Primal Master nodded without adding anything.
“Dao of Mirage.” The other Rulers were slightly quiet. Some had even turned disappointed.
“Why, what exactly is going on?” Xue Ying asked.
Bloodshed God-Emperor explained, “They are concerned about which Dao you broke through in precisely because of the war with Ancestor Mother Religion.”
“What is the current situation now?” Xue Ying was very concerned too. Even though he had once asked his wife Jing Qiu about it, in reality, the current Paragons, ordinary powerful existences and a large number of World Deities and those geniuses worthy of being groomed had all been migrated into the Lake Heart Island historical remain. Like Jing Qiu and Paragon Huo Cheng, they did not participate in the war, but they still understood some fundamental information about the war. Those with lower statuses knew even lesser.
After all, it was impossible for Rulers to publicize any detailed information about the current situation.
One, there were still traitors hiding in the group that might reveal those secrets to the Ancestor Mother Religion. Two, there was no need to speak to those Paragons and powerful existences about the details.
Thus, Xue Ying knew very little about this war.
“Hahaha…” Bloodshed God-Emperor still laughed as he spoke about this, “The Ancestor Mother Religion is quite powerful when they first started the war with us. They even created a really huge disturbance, bring about the destruction of many regions from the collateral shockwaves and causing the death of many beings. But these couldn’t be avoided! In the end, during the most crucial moment, Ancestor Mother Religion has made used of Bloody Ruler Nile to scheme against us. We had then plotted to make use of this scheme, causing them to suffer greatly and lose a great deal! Thus, they lost their momentum in the war.”
“All the way until now!”
“Look over that side.”
Bloodshed God-Emperor pointed to the void on the left, “Just in that direction. Look carefully.”
Xue Ying looked over. His vision crossed through many of the spatial obstacles. Very soon, he could see a strange-looking spherical castle. The castle was simple and ash gray in color. There were some beautiful patterns on the surface, though the complexity and mysticalness of those patterns far lacked as compared to the black pillar beneath them at this moment.
“They could actually isolate me from checking on them?” Xue Ying was slightly astonished. His current vision could not permeate through that castle at all.
“Do you see it? That is the base of the Ancestor Mother Religion.” Bloodshed God-Emperor looked from afar, “They are currently trapped in their base. It’s a pity though that the base is too firm! We have tried many ways and even utilized some taboo moves of ours… yet we could not damage that castle at all.”
“They have too many treasures, or at least much more than us.” Primal Master added, “Fortunately, our cultivation system is overall stronger than theirs. There is also Bloodshed who personally directed everything that allows us to slowly force them into a corner.”
Monarch Green said, “I’ve heard that their cosmos has ended the final stage and is undergoing the final collapse. The entire cosmos might collapse very slowly, but many historical remains will also suffer from destruction. Thus, large amounts of treasures in the historical remains were discovered, allowing them to gather many more treasures than us.”
Xue Ying was enlightened.
Just like the Lake Heart Island historical remain, the Six Heavenly Wheel, and other historical remains, there were many treasures which they could not obtain.
But the moment the cosmos started collapsing, these historical remains would naturally collapse too, causing a large number of treasures to appear.
Furthermore, the Ancestor Mother Religion cosmos had experienced an even longer period of epochs than the Cultivator Cosmos. Thus, how many treasures would they have at now that the entire cosmos was collapsing apart?

chapters.title: Chapter 761 - Protection Mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 761: Protection Mission
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Their advantage is only the treasures they have. At the same time, their weakness is apparent-they are unable to absorb the energy in this world. Thus, they have to depend on Deity crystals to regain energy after consuming them during battle. There might be some strange treasure which allows them to forcefully take in energy, but the rate is extremely slow. If they die in battle, they could refine another avatar out, but the price is higher too.” Pang Yi said, “And in contrast, we are the opposite, we have an endless amount of energy. Even if we die in battles, we could refine another avatar out. Besides, Bloodshed’s technique allows us to refine another avatar… improving the superiority we have in overall power. Thus, they rarely take the initiative to attack us in the war until now.”
Xue Ying nodded.
Bloodshed God-Emperor then said, “Other than this stone pillar, you should be able to carefully observe the other regions using the connection between the arrays.
“Oh?” Xue Ying thoroughly inspected. He was able to discover within moments that this black stone pillar beneath his legs had a grand power that contained many layers of arrays which extended out to 500 billion kilometers away. They had linked to other locations far away. With Xue Ying’s current sensing ability, he was able to discover those places swiftly.
“Two pillars, three, four, five…” Xue Ying soon discovered them.
Surrounding the base of Ancestor Mother Religion, in the world above and the ground below, in regions of differing distances, there were a total of ten black stone pillars currently interconnecting with one another, forming an incomparably colossal array. It contained a grand power. Every single stone pillar had massive amounts of shackles enveloping them. Those shackles were somehow restricting that base of Ancestor Mother Religion through the void.
“According to the “Myriad Catalog” which you provided me, I discovered an array within called the ’12 Primal Pillars’.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said, “I’ve relied on the materials we have to refine these 12 Primal Pillars. Even though the materials we have are slightly lacking, the array refined and other aspects are entirely the same. The power it contained should be about 50% that of the original version.”
12 Primal Pillars? There were apparently 10 stone pillars, yet the array was called the 12 Primal Pillars?
Xue Ying was bewildered.
“The array itself contains 12 Primal Pillars, but the array is extremely complex and planting every single Primal Pillar requires us to spend a huge amount of time.” Bloodshed God-Emperor mentioned, “The Ancestor Mother Religion is not foolish too. They will appear at critical moments to prevent us from constructing the pillar. Currently, we have constructed 10 Primal Pillars in total, and we could not plant the 11th… precisely because we lack manpower. The moment we finished planting the 12 Primal Pillars, it will completely trap the Ancestor Mother Religion, sealing that base of theirs. It will prevent them from coming out ever again. Being trapped within, they aren’t able to obtain any resources or energy and cannot cultivate. Neither can they come out, and it would represent their defeat.”
“Thus, they are doing their utmost to prevent our construction.”
“But before the 12 Primal Pillars have formed the complete array, every single Primal Pillar contain a slightly weaker power. It requires Rulers to protect it could we prevent the offense of Ancestor Mother Religion. Without a Ruler protecting it… the many Religious Leaders from the Ancestor Mother Religion will be able to destroy the arrays within a single Primal Pillar.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said, “Once a part is broken, we can only reconstruct it. Once we lose one of the most important Primal Pillars, it will be very troublesome to refine it again.”
“Thus, we have to have someone protecting it.”
“Currently, Purgatory, Monarch Green and Primal Master have two avatars each. They are defending a total of six Primal Pillars scattered around the place.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said, “Abyss Primogenitor has two avatars protecting a single Primal Pillar, and Pang Yi has two avatars protecting another pillar as well.”
“Temporal Island Lord and Myriad God Palace Head are both teaming together to protect another Primal Pillar.”
“The final tenth Primal Pillar will usually be protected by me.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said, “But since I have to construct the 11th Primal Pillar… my true body and avatars will have to move together. Furthermore, I still require Black Bird to aid me. Only then could we construct the array while under the attack of Ancestor Mother Religion. But at that time, we can only have Empress Qian He alone to defend this tenth Primal Pillar, yet she could not do so herself. Thus, we have been prevented from moving forward with the 11th Primal Pillar.”
Empress Qian He helplessly said, “The protectors of the Primal Pillars are required to fight directly, and have harsh requirements on the protector’s power. My frontal combat is ultimately too weak.”
“Both Temporal Island Lord and I have two avatars each, and we could only protect a single place with four avatars. Empress Qian He, this could not be blamed on you.” Myriad God Palace Master added.
Xue Ying completely understood after hearing it.
Bloodshed God-Emperor’s true body and avatar, adding Black Bird Fifth Uncle Master were required to work together in order to construct a new Primal Pillar…
And thus, it had to be other Rulers protecting the pillars!
Purgatory Ruler, Monarch Green and Primal Master were all very powerful. They could defend two pillars each.
Pang Yi and Abyss Primogenitor were slightly weaker and could only secure a single pillar each.
Temporal Island Lord and Myriad God Palace Head had to work together to defend a pillar.
Empress Qian He was not stronger than Temporal Island Lord and Myriad God Palace Head… thus, she was too lacking in terms of power to protect even a single pillar.
“I originally hoped for you to become a Ruler using the Dao of Slaughter. That way, our overall combat power will be much stronger.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said, “Even though you are a new Ruler, with you teaming with Empress Qian He, and adding the prowess of the Primal Pillar array… you will be able to defend a single pillar still. But now, you became a Ruler using the Dao of Mirage.”
The other Rulers felt slightly regretful too.
Using the Dao of Mirage to become a Ruler gave him powerful survival capabilities, but it was much weaker in terms of frontal combat.
Primal Master chuckled, “How about we try this? Ultimately, there is one more Ruler, and we might just construct the 11th stone pillar.”
“Dong Bo’s combat power is still slightly weaker. but he might succeed with the help of Empress Qian He.” Pang Yi added too, “We do not have to care about the energy inside our body. With the World energy providing us with energy, we can just attempt it anyway.”
“Let’s do it.” Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded too.
Xue Ying felt helpless.
He could feel that the Rulers present were not confident in Xue Ying. Nevertheless, it was pointless even if Xue Ying were to stubbornly declare about how powerful he was. It was better for him to prove his combat prowess through battle.
“When are we starting?” Xue Ying said.
“You seem to be looking forward to it.” Abyss Primogenitor mocked.
“He has quite a lot of fighting spirit.” Primal Master chuckled too.
“Don’t be in a rush. You should have a look at some of the scenes when Ancestor Mother Religion attacked us so that you are mentally prepared.” Bloodshed God-Emperor shook his head. He then waved his hand, causing a projection to appear in the sky.
That was the peak of an enormous Primal Pillar. The barefooted bald Monarch Green was wearing a loose golden robe. He was looking at a wooden warship appearing in front with extreme calm. The warship contained many twisted roots. This wooden warship was enormous, and it was able to let out a tremendous suppressive firing power…
…
All sorts of battle scenes were appearing.
It could be said that Xue Ying was gaining first-hand experience of the battles. The Ancestor Mother Religion was not willing to fight one-on-one with the cultivators. They were instead using the treasures which they accumulated during battles. Those power far outstripped the Ruler realm already. No wonder Bloodshed God-Emperor had even lost his avatars not just once in battle. This ‘Primal Pillar’ was considered extraordinary. Relying on the power of the Primal Pillar, with Monarch Green’s power, he was able to defend a region by himself.
Xue Ying had even asked inquisitively, “Don’t we still have a true body in the Lake Heart Island? If they come to protect the place, we should be able to succeed in setting the arrays quickly right?”
“No matter what! We must never allow our true bodies to participate in the battle!” Bloodshed God-Emperor said extremely strictly.
Pang Yi laughed too, “We do not know if the Ancestor Mother Religion still has some terrifying move. The moment we use our true bodies, we will die for real if both true bodies and avatars die! Previously, we have been so close to victory, only to discover that the Ancestor Mother Religion is alluring us… fortunately, we could prevent ourselves from falling into the allure and have never sent our true bodies out before. Thus, we will always stay in the upper hand. In the end, they will use up the treasures and energy. By then, it is certain they will lose.”
Xue Ying nodded.
The more they felt something was enticing, the more they should not gamble! Because the Cultivator Cosmos could not afford to lose!
******
On the peak of the towering Primal Pillar stood both Xue Ying and Empress Qian He.
“By then, you must definitely defend the pillar well. Use all your strength including your avatar too.” Bloodshed God-Emperor entrusted the task to him.
“Rest assured.” Xue Ying nodded. The other ‘red-robed Xue Ying’ was always with him in his Eden treasure. He could appear anytime.
“Mn. I will also do my best to finish setting this array as fast as possible. As long as you defend the array to the point that I finished constructing it, I can send my other avatar and Black Bird over to support you since I only need one avatar to defend the newly constructed Primal Pillar.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said, “Alright. I’ll begin.”
Xue Ying nodded.
He looked towards other directions. There was at least a Ruler on each Primal Pillar. Monarch green, Pang Yi, Purgatory Ruler, Primal Master and others were smiling at him.
This time, the critical pillar was where Xue Ying was since the Ancestor Mother Religion had not attempted to attack him before. They would definitely direct their offense over here.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, by then, we’ll depend on you. I’ll definitely do my best too.” Empress Qian He said.
“Just act however you see it, Empress Qian He.” Xue Ying looked at the surrounding starry sky.
“Be careful. The moment they discover Bloodshed constructing a new array, they will use the fastest speed to rush their way over.” Empress Qian He reminded him. At the same time, she was looking around her carefully. She was not entirely confident of Xue Ying, and naturally, had to do her best to win this fight.

chapters.title: Chapter 762 - The First Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 762: The First Battle
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was dressed in a white outfit. With a black spear held in one hand, he stood on the peak of the Primal Pillar while waiting silently. The peak of the Primal Pillar contained cold airflows revolving around it, caused by the complete activation of the array of Primal Pillar. The cold air flitted across his robe, causing them to ruffle and flutter about.
At this moment, Empress Qian He was slightly anxious and uneasy. After all, she had attempted this a few times before, and she could not succeed in protecting a single pillar ever.
On the contrary, a serene expression was present on Xue Ying’s face, his eyes were cold and filled with killing intent as he stared away at the starry sky in wait of the enemy.
‘This brat has just become a Ruler recently and haven’t experienced the power level of Rulers, much less the war between two cosmoses. This is no longer a one-on-one battle. Instead, it is a large group of Rulers teaming together and releasing offensive attacks by relying on treasures. Such might is so much more terrifying.’ Empress Qian He muttered inwardly to herself as she saw how Xue Ying was calmer than herself, ‘Without experiencing it, coupled with the short period of time he had cultivated before being a Rule, would be over-confident at this moment. Only after battling will he understand how difficult battles are at this level.’
Even though she hoped that her side would win, Empress Qian He had to admit the prowess of the Ancestor Mother Religion!
“Mn?”
Xue Ying’s eyes suddenly lit up.
Having become a Ruler in the Voidwalker cultivation system and his great awareness of the void, Xue Ying was the first to discover the disturbances amongst the other Rulers. He turned his sight towards the far reaches beyond.
“They are here.” “Dong Bo Xue Ying, be careful. They have arrived.”
The other Rulers had too discovered the incoming enemies. Some of them had even taken the initiative to remind Xue Ying, as the Ancestor Mother Religion appeared in a region closest to Xue Ying… Unquestionably, the Ancestor Mother Religion had chosen the Primal Pillar Xue Ying and Empress Qian He was protecting as their target! After all, they had attempted to break through other areas before to no avail. This was the only pillar which they had hopes of breaching through.
“Hua~” Many circular shaped void ripples started fluctuating in the distant darkness and propagating out in all directions. At this moment, a simple ancient warship that was filled with many twisted roots appeared at the core origin of these void ripples. It spanned than 50 million kilometers long, looking to be only slightly smaller than most planets. Naturally, this was not considered huge at this level of the battle between Rulers.
“Whoosh~”
This simple ancient warship started flying over from the dark void. Due to it appearing at the outermost perimeter covered by the Primal Pillar array, its high speed of traveling resulted in the obstruction from the Primal Pillar. One could see layers of array appearing, which the warship smashed directly clashed into, forming an unceasing shockwave blasting in all directions.
Fortunately, this battlefield had long been barren with the countless planets originally present here exterminated before this battle. Therefore, the shockwaves had merely transmitted out in the dark void before dissipating into nothingness.
The warship continued charging at high speed with an intention to ram through all obstacles! Its flying speed was much faster than the ordinary Rulers.
‘Such a terrifying might.’ could sensing through the void, Xue Ying could not help but be startled inwardly, ‘I could not even force my way through the array of the Primal Pillar, yet this warship was able to do so! Fortunately, we can borrow on the power of the Primal Pillar during battle. Otherwise, it is unlikely for a Ruler to be able to hinder this warship by himself.’
‘But Teacher is able to construct the array under the help of Black Bird Fifth Uncle Master without fearing any sneak attack by the Ancestor Mother Religion. Teacher is indeed formidable too…’ Xue Ying shot a glance towards the far distance. Being able to see through the obstacles present in the void, he could see the array which Bloodshed God-Emperor was currently constructing. At this moment, Black Bird Fifth Uncle Master had turned into a huge beast that covered 500 billion kilometers in the area above Bloodshed God-Emperor, while the Bloodshed God-Emperor’s two bodies were doing their best in constructing the new Primal Pillar at this moment.
…
The simple ancient warship was traveling at extreme speed. However, due to the immense span of are covered by the Primal Pillar, just flying to the front of the pillar had already taken the time taken to brew a cup of tea.
Within the warship.
Many Religious Leaders from the Ancestor Mother Religion were standing. They were looking afar on top of the Primal Pillar at the slightly nervous Empress Qian He and Xue Ying who stood right at the front with a spear in his hand.
“Empress Qian He is the weakest Ruler present there. What’s more, she isn’t good at battles. Therefore she’s no threat to us at all.” These Religious Leaders were clear after experiencing many years of battle. Empress Qian He was slightly stronger in refining treasures, average in arrays too and was quite good in survival. However, she was abysmal in battles.
Even though trump cards the Religious Leaders had might be slightly weaker than Empress Qian He, the Ancestor Mother Religion would never engage in a one-on-one battle. Instead, they will rely on treasures to obtain an advantage!
“It seems like this time, they will be depending on Dong Bo Xue Ying for the protection of this pillar? Who would have thought that this Dong Bo Xue Ying is able to become a Ruler after cultivating for such a short period.” The fanged Religious Leader said with calmness present throughout his eyes, “However, they truly are dreaming if they think a newly promoted Ruler can obstruct us.”
“We should be able to overwhelm them with just a single attack using our Wooden Mustache Sacred Vessel.”
“Start attacking.”
“Hurry up and overwhelm Empress Qian He and Dong Bo Xue Ying. By then, Bloodshed God-Emperor will definitely come and save them! If he doesn’t, we will just break apart this stone pillar array and bring the stone pillar back with us.”
These Religious Leaders exchanged considerably cold gazes, their eyes were all filled with madness.
Although they had expected that the war would reach this eventual outcome, and that defeat was getting closer in their eyes, the heart of every single one the Religious Leaders was pressed down by stone. They were not willing to be defeated like this. They were still seeking… for an opportunity to turn the war around!
******
Xue Ying looked towards the far distance.
That unadorned ancient warship was flying at high speed closer to them.
‘Soon.’
‘They will be reaching the maximum range of my domain.’
Xue Ying waited silently.
Looking into the distance and past through the obstacles present in the void, he was able to see many planets filled with living beings in the distant Deity world. Countless lifeforms were reproducing and living their lives. Not a single one of them knew that the war that would determine their destiny was currently enveloping over their head! If the war were lost, all beings within the Cultivator Cosmos would be exterminated.
Xue Ying proceeded to look towards the direction of Lake Heart Island. There were many powerful existences, World Deities and some of the cultivators with a higher talent situated there. They had been migrated into there and understood that war was happening. Yet, the only thing they could do was to wait uneasily for the final adjudication of their destinies.
‘This is my hometown cosmos. Jing Qiu, Yu’er, Qing Yao… many people are living here. No one will be taking this place away.’
Xue Ying’s eyes were filled with a cold glint.
…
“They are here.”
“Is Dong Bo able to hinder them?”
“Empress Qian He is too weak-she is much weaker than Temporal Island Lord and Myriad God Palace Head! They have to work together to defend a single region. Dong Bo Xue Ying only has the help of Empress Qian He. Are they able to manage it?”
“We can only give them a try. Even if we are defeated, the situation can’t be any worse than it is now.”
The other Rulers-Monarch Green, Pang Yi, Primal Master, Temporal Island Lord, Myriad God Palace Head-were paying close notice to this location. Even Bloodshed God-Emperor who was currently doing his best to construct the array had his true body located in the Lake Heart Island pay notice at the place where Xue Ying was.
Even Black Bird Fifth Uncle Master, who had transformed into a size akin to that of a continent, was also paying attention to where Xue Ying: “Dong Bo brat, you must hold on. Your teacher has spent too much effort and blood for the sake of winning the war. You too should also do your part!”
…
Xue Ying stood there, his eyes looking into the distance.
All of a sudden!
Boom!
Xue Ying’s figure expanded dramatically into the size of a giant. At this moment, he was more than a 50 million kilometers tall, causing even the core of Primal Pillar beneath his legs to appear unassuming in relation to him. His actions startled Empress Qian He, who was standing on top of the Primal Pillar who was on alert and preparing for battle. Looking up at the white-robed teenager in front of her, who was now at a height more than 50 million kilometers, she could not help but transmit her thoughts over: “Dong Bo Xue Ying, defending at the core of the Primal Pillar is easier. Even if you become bigger, it would not help with improving your strength.”
“This will make it easier for me to fight.” Xue Ying’s voice reverberated around the world. He held onto the spear with a single hand, which had also grown to a length spanning over a 50 million kilometers long.
At this moment, blood waves suddenly erupted out from his body.
“Hong long long~”
The blood waves surged out rampantly in all directions, though most of them were directed in the direction where that simple ancient warship was rushing over from. As they continued to propagate out, they extended to more than 50 million kilometers, reaching 100 to 200 million kilometers away. Within the warship, the Religious Leaders located on that warship looked with astonishment as this surging blood sea came rushing over.
“Isn’t he overestimating himself?” The Religious Leaders did not heed this at all.
‘Void!’ Xue Ying silently muttered.
“Weng~”
Being a Voidwalker, he had cultivated using the source energy from outside the cosmos-the Primal Void Void energy, and was an expert in the control of the void. Even though it was not that obvious when he was at the Paragon realm, after becoming a Ruler, the increment in power was tremendous. It was publicly agreed that only Void Gods could travel in the Primal Chaos Void, but those cultivating the Voidwalker system… were the heaven gifted children of the Primal Chaos Void and thus were able to move in the Primal Chaos Void at the Ruler realm.
Upon reaching the realm of a Ruler, their control of the void would also reach an astonishing level! Currently, even though his ‘Dao of Slaughter’ and ‘Dao of Ripple’ had yet to reach perfection eternity realm, in terms of the domain power, his control of the void was far beyond the Slaughter Domain!
It’s just that he had to use all the power he had in this incoming battle.
“Primal Pillar!”
Being a protector, Xue Ying was able to operate the energy from the Primal Pillar array to boost his strength. With his roar, many layers of the array started fluctuating in the sky above the Slaughter Domain.
“Hong long long~” The simple ancient warship continued rumbling forward, finally reaching the boundary of the blood wave.
This was 150 million kilometers away from the core of the Primal Pillar. The power of the array was already enormous at this region-it was able to suppress the incoming might from the warship to a slightly lower stage. At this point, if Monarch Green and Primal Master were here, they would be able to protect this pillar with just a single avatar! At this moment, Xue Ying’s Slaughter Domain and his control of the void had significantly reduced the speed of the simple ancient warship. Its flying speed was not even one-hundredth of its previous speed!
“He has actually suppressed the ship?”
Shock and delight appeared on the face of the Primal Master, Temporal Island Lord, Myriad God Palace Head and other Rulers looking over from a distance. Even the enormous Black Bird Fifth Uncle Master was filled with surprise and disbelief, with an ecstatic expression appearing on the face of the Bloodshed God-Emperor’s true body too.
They had yet to proceed with close combat, and he was able to slow down the speed of that simple ancient warship to this extent just by relying on his domain?
‘With the strength of his domain having progressed to such an extent, he should be able to defeat me just by relying on it?’ Empress Qian He could not help but think about it.

chapters.title: Chapter 763 - The Smile of Bloodshed God-Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 763: The Smile of Bloodshed God-Emperor
Translator:Chaos_Editor:Chaos_
That was indeed the case.
The moment a Voidwalker became a Ruler, it was equivalent to reaching the peak Ruler power of other systems. Just with their ability to control the void would allow them to suppress some weaker Rulers!
And now, that simple ancient warship was close to the core of the Primal Pillar and was also within the area of effect of the array. The power of its flying charge had been suppressed to two-thirds its former might. If one said that its original power was far beyond Xue Ying's, now that it was left with two-thirds of its original strength, it was no longer impossible for Xue Ying to obstruct them.
With the Slaughter Domain and the suppression of the void, even though the warship could still fly at high speed, it was too slow as compared to previously.
"What, its flying speed is so slow? The power of this blood wave is that strong?" The Religious Leaders of Ancestor Mother Religion were all in great shock. They did not dare believe that everything was real.
They were wrong.
On the surface, the 'Slaughter Domain' that seemed to be the most dazzling would only produce some concern to the weaker Rulers. Instead, it was the void suppression which could not be perceived that had a power few times that of the Slaughter Domain. Naturally, if Xue Ying's 'Dao of Slaughter' and 'Dao of Ripple' both reached the Ruler realm, the power of his 'Slaughter Domain' would have a qualitative transformation.
"We haven't fought with this Dong Bo Xue Ying in a close combat battle yet we are already moving so slowly. If he decided to display his spear techniques, it should be a simple task for him to hinder the movement of our Wooden Mustache Sacred Vessel."
"Maybe the Dao he broke through in is stronger in terms of domain but weaker in terms of combat."
"Stop the sacred vessel! Proceed with attacking. Kill this avatar of Dong Bo Xue Ying!"
The Ancestor Mother Religion Religious Leaders swiftly made their decision. They did not waste any time because Bloodshed God-Emperor was currently constructing a new Primal Pillar, and they had to eliminate Xue Ying as fast as possible. Otherwise, they could not reach the core and destroy this array.
"Hu~"
After the ancient warship stopped, a dense amount of roots abruptly untangled from its surface. Those roots rushed out towards Xue Ying in all directions. Every single root was filled with life energy. This was akin to many whips lashing at the same time. Its power made even Xue Ying dumbstruck. Fortunately, the layers of array obstructed and reduced the impact of the incoming attack greatly. Adding on the void suppression and the Slaughter Domain, those roots became very weak. Even still, most Rulers could hardly defend against this numerous attack and would be defeated instantaneously.
This was also why Myriad God Palace Head and Temporal Island Lord had to work together with four avatars in other to defend the pillar.
…
"Could he defend against this attack?"
"Since Dong Bo Xue Ying's domain is so formidable, his frontal combat skills might be formidable too."
"He will definitely be able to defend the pillar. WIth the domain suppressing the attack of the Ancestor Mother Religion, even those slightly weaker in combat have hopes of defending it. Furthermore, he has two avatars and Empress Qian He with him."
Primal Master, Pang Yi, Abyss Primogenitor, and the others were watching nervously.
They were hoping for victory.
But they were afraid that Xue Ying was only strong in his domain, and was weak in combat!
…
"Hmph."
Xue Ying with a height of more than 50 million kilometers stood there. The surface of his body released rays of black film light. Every single black film light was striking out with a strange ripple. They targeted at every single incoming root.
Termination Energy!
Even if he did not use any laws and profound mysteries, the current Termination Energy contained enormous power, especially when Xue Ying was displaying the first volume of "Wind Ripple Path". The first volume was relatively simple-Xue Ying could control more than a thousand strand of Termination Energy at the same time during battle. It was only with the third and fourth volume that he could temporarily not manage more than a thousand Termination Energy strands at the same time.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, let me assist you." Empress Qian He also flew out from the core of the Primal Pillar. She was swiftly flying towards where Xue Ying was.
"Peng peng peng!"
At this point, each black film light ray clashed against the incoming roots. Every single black film light brought a queer ripple that caused the roots to tremble and soften after a single clash.
Looking from afar, the original dense amount of roots had almost instantaneously softened down by the large film light. They had lost their power.
"He actually uprooted this move just like this?" The Religious Leaders were in slight disbelief.
It was okay if he was strong in the domain!
But facing against a wide-range attack, he could release more than a thousand black film light that blocked every single attack head-on?
The most important point was that Xue Ying had not used his spear!
"We can't use a wide-range attack. His black film light is too powerful." The Religious Leaders did not know that the most offensive and destructive attack the Voidwalkers had was the Termination Energy.
"Then we will suppress him directly."
"Attack."
The Religious Leaders were slightly anxious. They felt things were amiss.
…
At this moment, not just Empress Qian He who was rushing over in hopes of assisting Xue Ying or that Black Bird Fifth Uncle Master, even Bloodshed God-Emperor who was constructing the array, Primal Master, Monarch Green, Temporal Island Lord, Myriad God Palace Head and other spectating Rulers were nervously watching. They could feel victory in their grasp! Xue Ying's power had far surpassed their imaginations!
They were all mad with joy!
Even though this was out of expectation, they were looking forward to it! First, Xue Ying's domain contained such terrifying power. Facing such a huge wide-range attack, Xue Ying could easily deal with it as well. His current power might possibly allow him to protect this pillar.
"Hua~"
At the bow of that ancient warship, two of the longest roots were currently arcing through the sky. They tore through the area, and every single region they went through would produce strands of pitch black strange illusions. They were tearing through the layers of array obstacles and were breaking through the void suppression and Slaughter Domain with full force right towards Xue Ying.
"It is here." Monarch Green and the others were nervous.
'Even I will have to rely entirely on the 'Dao of Mountain' to barely defend against this attack.' Monarch Green thought. He was clear how terrifying this attack was.
"Is he able to defend against this suppressive technique?"
All of them were nervously watching.
As long as he could defend this move, even if that warship had other techniques, they were just hard to deal with like the previous wide-range attack. This was the one move with the most tremendous power, and if Xue Ying could defend against it, the threat from other moves would be much lower.
"His spear is out!"
"He finally displays his spear techniques!"
The Rulers were closely observing Xue Ying.
"Such a mystical spear technique. It seems not like a Dao at perfect eternity! It feels more like the fusion of slaughter and ripple, but in terms of the degree of mysticalness, it is extremely profound." Bloodshed God-Emperor and others had very concise judgments. They were able to analyze this.
Indeed.
Just like at the Paragon realm when Monarch Green was able to fight against Rulers, the 'Dao of Ripple' and 'Dao of Slaughter' were both Daos that had yet to reach perfect eternity. But they reached an extreme bottleneck. Under the fusion of both, Xue Ying was able to create the "Wind Ripple Path" with the help of a large number of books from the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. Thus, its degree of mysticalness could compare with that of the Rulers especially when he was utilizing the fourth volume of Wind Ripple Path at this very moment.
"Wind Ripple Path, volume four, Extremity!"
The spear arced through an obscure and mysterious angle. Countless ripples were revolving around the spear and converging right at its head. The spearhead was just like a 'point' that could not be seen.
Xue Ying had also directly termed this strike as 'Extremity'.
"Peng!"
The spearhead pierced and tore through all incoming roots.
The long, tough and ancient root trembled abruptly. The energy within had somehow been wholly dispersed away by the strange ripple. The root soon softened down.
This scene caused the hearts of all Religious Leaders to turn cold.
Comparing power…
Most of the Religious Leaders who specialized in strength could not compare with Xue Ying's! And they were even far worse in terms of the profoundness of the attacks.
"Defeated."
"He is too strong."
"We can't deal with him."
The Religious Leaders all understood this point. The Wooden Mustache Sacred Vessel might have other techniques, but they understood that it was impossible to deal with Xue Ying. What made them feel all the more bitter was-Xue Ying had only used a single avatar from the start of the battle. He had another avatar which did not appear yet!
"Just like Monarch Green, Primal Master, and Purgatory Ruler, he is able to protect a pillar by himself with an avatar." These Religious Leaders felt a chill in their hearts, "He has another avatar which can also persist in protecting another Primal Pillar!"
******
The Ancestor Mother Religion Religious Leaders were feeling unwilling and unreconciled. Comparatively, the cultivators were all genuinely ecstatic. This joy came too sudden that they could not adapt to it.
