"An avatar actually resist against their attacks?"
"He directly withstood against it?"
Even Bloodshed God-Emperor was slightly dazed.
Primal Master just laughed out, "Dong Bo Xue Ying's strength is really unfathomable. In terms of power, he might even be beyond mine! Monarch Green, Purgatory, how do the two of you feel?"
"He should be similar to the two of us." Monarch Green added.
"Mn, his frontal combat skills are stronger." Purgatory Ruler mentioned, "Even though he lacks in terms of laws and profound mysteries, his overall strength is indeed at our level."
Over the long years of fighting, everyone had an excellent understanding of each other's power.
The strongest was Bloodshed God-Emperor, and this superiority was undeniable! Especially when he had the help of the Black Bird which boosted his strength even further.
After that were Purgatory Ruler and Monarch Green.
Primal Master and Pang Yi were ranked closer to the back, but since Primal Master had lived for an extended period, he had many techniques. This was the first time Xue Ying revealed his strength, and it was on a similar level with Purgatory Ruler and Monarch Green already.
"Hahaha, no matter what, he is definitely stronger than me. Dong Bo Xue Ying is able to defend a Primal Pillar with a single avatar. He has another which did not come out yet! He can then defend another pillar. Hahaha, by then, we would have succeeded in constructing all 12 Primal Pillars." Myriad God Palace Head was pleased.
"Mn, this Primal Pillar is about to be completed after a while." Bloodshed God-Emperor was thrilled too.
"Finally, we are about to complete constructing all 12 Primal Pillars."
…
The warship of Ancestor Mother Religion struggled and unleashed more than ten attacks, yet they still gave up in the end. They started retreating.
And the cultivators were all very happy. Bloodshed God-Emperor soon finished setting up the Primal Pillar.
"Sou."
The red-robed Xue Ying had directly used the Void Evasive Maneuvre and rapidly appear at where Bloodshed God-Emperor constructed the array.
"Teacher." The red-robed Xue Ying arrived here.
"Xue Ying." Bloodshed God-Emperor had just successfully constructed the array. Seeing his disciple, he felt delighted.
"Let me be responsible for protecting this Primal Pillar." The red-robed Xue Ying said.
"Alright." Bloodshed God-Emperor laughed out too, "I can no longer remain patient anymore too. Let us just finish constructing the last Primal Pillar in one fell swoop! I've waited for far too long, yet never have I thought that today is the day we finally finish constructing all 12 Primal Pillars."
The red-robed Xue Ying descended at the peak of that Primal Pillar.
Bloodshed God-Emperor looked towards his disciple before turning to the surrounding void. His vision tore through an infinite distance before looking at the many planets and countless cultivators on them.
He revealed a grin. The fatigue in his heart dissipated: "This war is ending soon!"

chapters.title: Chapter 764 - Suppressing Ancestor Mother
chapters.content:
Chapter 764: Suppressing Ancestor Mother
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Xue Ying.”
Bloodshed God Emperor gave a reminder, “Right now, we are constructing the final Primal Pillar. It is at this point when we are so close to success that we should be all the more careful. The Ancestor Mother Religion has never once stopped retaliating against us. Since you need to defend two Primal Pillars at the same time, you must be careful at all times.”
“This disciple understands. It is at this kind of situation that I should be all more careful.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Bloodshed, just relax and leave this task to your disciple. Your disciple is still quite formidable-he will definitely be able to easily defend against the Ancestor Mother Religion. ” The Black Bird on Bloodshed’s shoulder shouted out.
Bloodshed God-Emperor gave a smile before turning and taking a step towards the distance.
“Whoosh.”
He tore through space, arriving at the final construction point for the last and final 12th Primal Pillar.
Dong Bo Xue Ying, Pang Yi, Monarch Green, Purgatory Ruler, Primal Master, Temporal Island Lord, Empress Qian He, and others were watching from a distance. At this moment, they could not help but be nervous. The closer it was to success, the more anxious they would be since they were afraid that the Ancestor Mother Religion. Possessing an extremely deep background, they might utilize some dangerous move to overwhelm them.
“Everyone, stay vigilant. The Ancestor Mother Religion will definitely not be willing to admit defeat just like that.”
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, we have defended the Primal Pillars from many attacks before. You’ve only suffered from a single attack by them. Thus, it is possible that the Ancestor Mother Religion will try to deal against you this time.”
“Right, you should be a little more careful.”
Everyone kept their vigilance up high.
In the distance, Black Bird Fifth Uncle Master had already turned into an incomparably colossal figure, appearing just like a vast land hiding Bloodshed God-Emperor from above. At this moment, both avatars of Bloodshed God-Emperor were doing their best to construct the final Primal Pillar.
“They’re here!”
“The Ancestor Mother Religion is here.”
Xue Ying was the first to discover this. The other Rulers soon discovered that unadorned ancient warship belonging to the Ancestor Mother Religion. However, this time, many peculiar jade green spots appeared to be revolving on the surface of this warship. The warship had appeared at the location where the newest Primal Pillar was constructed at, which was also the area where the red-robed Xue Ying was protecting.
“That Dong Bo Xue Ying has resisted against the attack in a frontal collision during the previous time, so his body strength is certainly great. A body that strong would definitely require the assistance of external materials to temper! Those external materials are scarce, and he might only succeed in cultivating out a single avatar.” The Religious Leaders of the Ancestor Mother Religion were looking at that red-robed teenager standing on the peak of the Primal Pillar from their ancient warship.
His robe was ruffling in the wind, with a deep violet spear held in his hand Dong Bo Xue Ying stared coldly staring at the incoming warship.
There was some logic behind the Ancestor Mother Religion’s guess.
The Ancestor Mother Religion system required large amounts of resources for cultivation. If not, they would not be able to break through even if their realm had broken through. Xue Ying had cultivated the ‘Myriad Devil True Body’ initial scroll before. During that time, he had consumed large amounts of precious materials or the sake of conserving time in his cultivation. Usually, the abrupt strengthening of one’s fleshy body would require the use of external materials as a source for bodily tempering as it would ultimately be too slow to just rely on absorbing the world energy was
Nevertheless, Ancestor Mother Religion’s guess was logically but wrong!
Xue Ying cultivated the “Walker’s Hidden Secret”, which took in the Primal Chaos Void energy as external energy! It could be said that Primal Chaos Void energy was an extremely rare source of energy since most people only enter the Primal Chaos Void upon reaching the realm of Void God. Furthermore, it was difficult for them to make use of this terrifying energy. However, one said that there was an abundance of the energy… since the Primal Chaos Void was boundless. There were many, many cosmos present within the entire Primal Chaos Void. Thus Primal Chaos Void energy was much bigger and stronger than the world energy.
Hence, Xue Ying was easily able to let his true body and two other avatars cultivate Walker’s Hidden Secret to the 11th level.
Naturally…
It was expected how this assault by the Ancestor Mother Religion would end.
“What?”
“”This body of his is as strong as the others?”
“We can’t win at all.”
Even though the Ancestor Mother Religion had used stranger techniques this time around, the red-robed Xue Ying had merely used his spear, the void and Slaughter Domain to completely resist against the Ancestor Mother Religion, and defended the Primal Pillar in this region.
Second after second ticked by.
The red-robed Xue Ying was doing his best to handle against the Ancestor Mother Religion. At this moment, he did not dare to lose a single bit of concentration. And the white-robed Xue Ying and Empress Qian He were both looking at the direction where Bloodshed God-Emperor was. Even other Rulers like Monarch Green, Primal Master, Pang Yi, Temporal Island Lord were nervously watching from afar.
“Soon.”
“Just a little more…”
All of them were nervously watching as Bloodshed God-Emperor constructed the final Primal Pillar.
While the Bloodshed God-Emperor was also doing his best, the humongous Black Bird was sweeping across all directions with a pair of cold eyes. He was always on alert. As everyone knew that this was the final and most crucial moment.
“Hua~”
As the shackles covering the surface of that Primal Pillar began permeating into the void, causing countless Deity imprints to start revolving, “Dong~”, the enormous Primal Pillar let out a booming sound. After all of the many arrays finished interconnecting with one another, this Primal Pillar had finally emerged as a perfected entity.
“Hahaha…” At the moment when Bloodshed God-Emperor succeeded in constructing the array, he could not help but grin, never noticing how wide his smile was.
“The construction is a success!”
“We’ve succeeded.”
“The 12th Primal Pillar has finally been set!”
Xue Ying, Empress Qian He, Pang Yi, Temporal Island Lord and others watching from afar were all thrilled. Previously, all of them could not sense themselves moving any closer to success. However, only at the moment when the final Primal Pillar was constructed did they let out a sigh of relief.
As for the ancient warship, it had already given up and decided to retreat.
…
Surrounding the Ancestor Mother Religion base from all directions, the 12 Primal Pillars had formed an unseen void prison.
Every single Primal Pillar had a Ruler standing on top of the peak, with the Bloodshed God-Emperor standing on the newest Primal Pillar. Looking at each other from a distance, the group of Rulers had smiles of elation present on their faces.
“Bloodshed, activate the array and suppress the base of Ancestor Mother Religion.” Abyss Primogenitor said in a voice brimming with spirit.
“Bloodshed, you can do it now.” Empress Qian He said with a red flush present on her face. Appearing was exceptionally beautiful at this moment, her eyes brimmed with expectations.
“Teacher, you can take action now.” Xue Ying was looking forward to it too.
He had participated in the battle on a later period. During then, the cultivator’s side had obtained an absolute upper hand at that point. Nevertheless, he was still able to help his side with his power, allowing his side to construct the 12 Primal Pillars within a shorter period.
“Alright.”
The other Rulers were looking forward to it. Bloodshed God-Emperor felt his blood boiling too. He immediately began controlling all Primal Pillars.
“Hong long long~”
The many arrays from the 12 Primal Pillars were activated. In the past, due to the absence of sufficient Primal Pillars, it had caused the entire array to break. It was like a damaged prison to which the enemy could naturally enter and leave anytime they wanted! But now… this void prison was utterly perfected leaving no holes in it at all.
“Hua hua hua~” One could see many void shackles forming on the base of Ancestor Mother Religion. The void shackles were transparent, whooshing around as they entangled around the structure of the base. Furthermore, each of the transparent void shackle had countless patterns moving on top. The myriad patterns were intersecting with one another, tightly wrapping up the entire base of Ancestor Mother Religion without revealing any single gap.
At this moment, Xue Ying could not even sense the existence of the Ancestor Mother Religion.
“The base of the Ancestor Mother Religion has completely been sealed.” Bloodshed God-Emperor revealed a grin, “It is impossible for the Ancestor Mother Religion to break through again.”
“We have finally waited for this day.”
The Rulers scattered all around the Primal Pillars were ecstatic.
“We have fought for so long in the past. It felt like we could have won every single time, yet only now did we genuinely trap them completely.” Pang Yi said with a smile.
“The war should come to an end here.” Primal Master nodded.
“It should be.”
“It has been too long. My heart feels fatigued. These 100,000 years feel more tiring than cultivating for 100 million years.”
The other Rulers were speaking with a slightly relaxed tone.
“It is still Disciple Brother Dong Bo who is the most relaxed. He slept all the way until the final moment, participating in the war for the shortest period.” Monarch Green grinned as he looked towards Xue Ying.
“Even though the period is short, if not for Dong Bo, we might have to delay our victory for a longer period.” Myriad God Palace Head added.
“Fellow Rulers.”
Bloodshed God-Emperor announced. He stopped the joyful Rulers from their celebration. Everyone including Xue Ying turned towards Bloodshed God-Emperor, for he was unquestionably their leader! It was his extraordinary attainments in the ‘array’ that enabled them to gain the upper hand many times in this war.
“Right now, it could be said that we have won half the war.” Bloodshed God-Emperor chuckled, “Even though we are sure that they can’t break through the suppression from the 12 Primal Pillars, they might have some other forbidden techniques so we shouldn’t be too happy at this moment.”

chapters.title: Chapter 765 - Has the War Ended?
chapters.content:
Chapter 765: Has the War Ended?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying, Empress Qian He, Monarch Green, Primal Master, Temporal Island Lord, and other Rulers were also looking towards the distant base of Ancestor Mother Religion-that simple ancient and beautiful spherical castle.
“I do want to see if the Ancestor Mother Religion still has any other hidden moves.”
“Currently, they are completely suppressed and sealed by the 12 Primal Pillars, so what can they do? If they have any other dangerous moves, they wouldn’t have let us finish constructing all Primal Pillars.”
“The power of the 12 Primal Pillars should have reached the Void God level. Only after reaching the boundary of the Void God and relying on the refining techniques taken from the “Myriad Catalog”did Bloodshed succeed in refining the pillars. I do not believe they have any way of breaking it.”
The Rulers watched from afar as they chatted idly with one another.
They were waiting for the reaction of the Ancestor Mother Religion!
Second after second ticked by…
Xue Ying and the rest were also very patient. Even if the Ancestor Mother Religion decided to retaliate, they would have to hold an internal discussion that will take some time.
“Mn?” all of a sudden, the Bloodshed God-Emperor exclaimed out in astonishment. Xue Ying and the rest saw it too.
“Hong long long~”
One of the places on the spherical castle had suddenly opened up, forming a cavern hole. Present within was a muscular man with brown skin. Appearing to be barefooted, he only had several pieces of ragged clothes covering his body. His eyes were incomparably calm as if they were a boundless sea. However, due to the void shackles having sealed the castle up completely, that huge fanged hunk wasn’t able to move any further from the cavern hole. He said, “Bloodshed God-Emperor, this is only an incarnation of mine. I did not bring any weapons, storage treasures or any other materials. Even the robes have been condensed by energy. Let me out.”
His words could not be discerned by Xue Ying and other Rulers. Instead, only Bloodshed God-Emperor who controlled the arrays of all 12 Primal Pillars could hear him clearly.
“Weng~”
A ripple permeated through the body of the huge fanged hunk.
Indeed, it was only an incarnation. The robe had been condensed from energy, and he did not have any other materials!
“Come out.” Bloodshed God-Emperor gave out a thought, causing an unseen ripple to engulf the incarnation of that fanged hunk and teleporting him out of the castle into the external world.
…
Xue Ying and the others could not hear what the fanged hunk said. They only saw as that fanged hunk was teleported out. After being brought out, all of them were scouting the other party. Because it was merely an incarnation, he had quickly been inspected by Xue Ying and the rest once through.
“It is only an incarnation.”
“No other treasures. No threat to us.”
The Rulers were all looking at the huge fanged hunk. The gap between their power was relatively big. They were clear of shackles surrounding the huge fanged hunk. At this moment, only the Bloodshed God-Emperor could arrive in front of the hunk. Xue Ying and the others were guarding the pillars and watching from afar.
Protecting the Primal Pillars was still very important. They could not neglect this.
“All Rulers are here?” The fanged Religious Leader looked around him. Even though he could not see the others, he could guess so and said with a chuckle.
“Say, what are you planning?” Bloodshed God-Emperor appeared in front of him and said with a calm tone.
The fanged Religious Leader looked at this white-robed avatar of Bloodshed God-Emperor. He sighed, “Bloodshed God-Emperor, you are truly vigilant. No matter what it is, you will always act with vigilance. Discovering that you are close to victory, the other Rulers are still protecting the Primal Pillars, and their true bodies should still remain in the Lake Heart Island.”
“Yes.” Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded.
“Even if the allure is bigger, none of you are taking any gambles.” The huge fanged hunk lamented, “Previously, we have created many traps. Even though we killed you all time after time, it’s a pity that nothing works in the end.”
Bloodshed God-Emperor said, “During the past 100,000 years, we have indeed faced a huge allure time after time from you people. Nevertheless, I’m clear we might win if we were to charge together with our true bodies! However, the risk of having our true bodies and avatars being exterminated together… is too much. If we do not gamble, our true bodies will be safe forever. We can always refine an inexhaustible number of avatars to keep battling and fight a prolonged battle. Let us not chat about other possibilities because by then, the Deity crystals you have prepared should have almost been consumed entirely and we will definitely win.”
“Since we will win at the end, why the need to take the risk?” Bloodshed God-Emperor coldly said.
“You are very calm.”
The fanged Religious Leader sighed, “However, to many experts, knowing is one thing, while doing is an entirely different matter. Upon seeing that victory is within grasps, it is normal for them to allow blood to rush up their minds. What a pity, what a pity…”
“You came out to say these?” Bloodshed God-Emperor continued. Xue Ying and the other Rulers were watching afar. They were listening.
The fanged Religious Leader shook his head, “I rather admire you. The attainments you’ve included the array are extremely formidable. Relying on this ‘Void Extreme Twin Array’, you’ve managed to sweep across the entire region and force us out. Now, it is this same Primal Pillar array that trapped us too! Everything is due to you! What’s more, you have long discovered that Bloody Ruler is a traitor, and have acted ignorant, scheming against our plot and forcing us to suffer much. I still do not understand, how you discovered that Bloody Ruler is a traitor?”
“That is a secret.” Bloodshed God-Emperor coldly answered.
He might have some suspicions, but it was after Xue Ying informed him about the matter that made Bloodshed God-Emperor sure that Bloody Ruler Nile was a traitor.
“You really are careful. Even till now, you are still keeping it a secret.”
The fanged Religious Leader’s expression was slightly chilly. His eyes were haze, “My race has reproduced for a very long time until now, allowing us to reach a very powerful stage! It is just that our cosmos is entering its final stages of decline, and this cosmos passage linked to your cosmos is our only chance… we can only battle. If we had an endless amount of World energy, we would most likely have won this war.”
Bloodshed God-Emperor sneered, “Let’s not take into account treasures and external power! If we truly fought with our true strength, you all aren’t our opponents.”
The fanged Religious Leader paused.
That’s right.
He had to admit that relying on the avatar techniques, the Rulers of the Cultivator Cosmos each had three bodies! This would overcome their weakness in numbers. If they genuinely started an all-out fight, the cultivators as a whole were stronger than them.
“There’s no point in saying those things now. Our protectors have almost been wiped out, and many Religious Leaders have died in battle too. Over the 100,000 years of slaughter, we still lost in the end.” The fanged Religious Leader said, “The reason I am here today is that I hope for your Cultivator Cosmos to give us a path of survival.”
“A path of survival?” Bloodshed God-Emperor sneered, “And why should we do so? We can imprison you all until the end of our cosmos epoch. By then, you will all be completely wiped! Even if you retreated back to that collapsing cosmos of yours, you all would still die! No matter what, all of you will die!”
“We will indeed die.”
The fanged Religious Leader said, “However, we still have enough energy for one last bout. Even if we have no hopes of victory, we will still force you all to pay a huge price. However, if you all give us a path to survival, we could give you many rewards too like the treasures… and lastly, we are doing this for all for the sake of survival.”
Bloodshed God-Emperor turned taciturn. He was currently discussing with other Rulers in the dark. Xue Ying and the others were also participating in it swiftly.
“Is he for real? Can they still fight for one last time?”
“They have already been trapped by us, and yet they can still force us to pay the price? Are they deliberately frightening us, or do they truly have a hidden technique still?”
“Hmph, they are thinking of occupying our cosmos, and now, they are begging for mercy?”
“I’ll ask him again.”
…
Bloodshed God-Emperor looked at the fanged Religious Leader in front: “You seek a path of survival. What path of survival?”
“Two ways.” The huge fanged hunk answered,” As for the first path of survival, isn’t your relationship with that Gu Qian Luo excellent? He has the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, and thus is able to bring us off in it! The second path of survival will be for you to continue trapping us. When Void God from your Cultivator Cosmos emerges, your Void God can bring those that transcended away before the cosmos epoch ends. You can just bring us along when you plan on leaving.”
“This is our final hope.”
“We have no hope of winning the war! We are only seeking survival.” The huge fanged hunk looked at Bloodshed God-Emperor.
…
The Ancestor Mother Religion was at the end of the road. They had no other paths and could only lower their heads and beg for survival! The final decision laid in the hands of the cultivators.
It felt great to grasp the fate of the other party. Although Xue Ying, Empress Qian He, Pang Yi, Bloodshed God-Emperor and others were contemplating about this, all of them felt thrilled in their hearts.
“Are we going to win like that? Has the war really come to an end?” Xue Ying felt that everything was too fast. He had just awoken, and the war was ending already after he started fighting?
Naturally, Xue Ying was the only one who felt everything was too quick. The feelings present within the hearts of the other Rulers were entirely different from him.
Bloodshed God-Emperor, Primal Master, Abyss Primogenitor, Purgatory Ruler, Pang Yi, Monarch Green, Temporal Island Lord, Myriad God Palace Head and Empress Qian He felt emotions surging through their hearts. The past 100,000 years had been too tiring for them. They didn’t dare to relax and become complacent for the entire time. Facing schemes and life-threatening ordeals for time to time, they had died too many times. Furthermore, they were almost close to victory for many times, only to discover that they were all traps.
Despite being mentally tired and exhausted, hey had to continue battling.
Finally!
Xue Ying brought luck back with him, allowing the war to reach its final stages! At this moment, all of them were feeling relatively relaxed. Even though they were still maintaining a strand of vigilance, their hearts were brimming with joy and elation.
“Fellow Rulers, say, shall we give them a path of survival?” Bloodshed God-Emperor asked the other Rulers.

chapters.title: Chapter 766 - Being Controlled on Ones Palm
chapters.content:
Chapter 766: Being Controlled on One’s Palm
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Standing at the peak of the entire Cultivator Cosmos, the ten Rulers were currently discussing with one another. In reality, deep down within the hearts of Xue Ying and the rest, all of them felt they should just completely exterminate these Religious Leaders from the Ancestor Mother Religion! After all, the effects of the past 100,000 years of war had rippled through the cosmos, where countless locations of the Deity world and Abyss had been completely destroyed, resulting in innumerable lives having perished. Thus, killing intent towards the Ancestor Mother Religion was still present within the hearts of Xue Ying and the others.
Despite that, a clash between the races of two cosmoses could not be decided because of their tempers.
First, the Ancestor Mother Religion might still have certain techniques which could empower them for one last life and death struggle, forcing the cultivators to pay an outrageous price. Secondly, the treasures in the hands of the Ancestor Mother Religion were indeed extremely alluring. Just using them as comprehension aids for the furtherment of the understanding of Dao would be of great help to one’s cultivation.
“Alright. Then we’ll give them a path of survival.”
“We can let them live! However, we must imprison them until the cosmos epoch is about to end. By then, the Void God that appears amongst us would be able to bring them along.”
“I agree. We must absolutely not let them enter the Primal Chaos Flying Ship of Gu Qian Luo.”
“That Gu Qian Luo… is extremely sinister! Allowing him to bring the Ancestor Mother Religion away? Hmph, I’m afraid something might crop up from this.”
The Rulers finally made their decision after discussing it.
Even rabbits would bite when forced into a corner! Since they had reached this stage, then they might as well give the enemies a strand of hope! If they left the enemies with not a single bit of hope, the only thing left for would be for the other party to turn crazy. Leaving them a strand of hope would ensure they wait obediently until the fateful day when they were rescued. If the cultivators were savage enough, it was entirely possible for them to not follow with their promises and leave the Ancestor Mother Religion to die. However, that would make it impossible for them to obtain those treasures from the Ancestor Mother Religion.
“I’ll go and negotiate with them.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said, “We have been very benevolent to give them a chance of survival at this stage of the war. However everyone should maintain their vigilance. It is not worth fully trusting the Ancestor Mother Religion.”
“I understand.”
“Rest assured.”
“We will always have an avatar defending the Primal Pillars at all times.”
In the starry sky, there was at least a single Ruler stationed at every single Primal Pillar to stand guard.
…
And in another starry sky, within the Primal Chaos Flying ship.
A grin appeared on the face of the enormous sculpture ‘Gu Qian Luo’, who was emitting a foul and cold aura. At this moment, he was overlooking the green-skinned teenager who had a horn. This green-skinned teenager’s eyes were filled with pain and unwillingness, while faint trembles shook through his body.
“Isn’t this too overboard?” The green-skinned teenager said with a low tone.
“Tsk tsk tsk, overboard? Not at all! Do you think the cultivators will let your side survive? They might be saying that on their mouths about how they will bring you all away when the cosmos epoch is ending, but they can always just leave you here and let your race be exterminated with the epoch. What can all of you do?” Gu Qian Luo chuckled. His laughter was filled with disdain, “By placing your hopes on the benevolence of those cultivators? That’s being too foolish. In the previous 100,000 years of war, all of you have deliberately let the disturbances caused by the war to spread out, killing countless members of their race. It’s easy to see how thick the hatred those Rulers have towards all of you.”
“I’ll agree to be your servant from now on.” The green-skinned teenager said with a low tone, “However, the treasures my Ancestor Mother Religion will be given to you in two separate parts. We’ll hand over the first batch when you break apart the Primal Pillars to save us out. Only after we constructed the Ancestor Mother Altar and gaining the final victory will we hand over the last batch. That’s the best we can offer.”
“Either you promise us this…”
“Or our Ancestor Mother Religion rather die than to accept less.” The green-skinned teenager looked towards that large sculpture in front of him.
Not long after the war erupted, Gu Qian Luo had taken the initiative to entice one of the Rulers from Ancestor Mother Religion over to his Primal Chaos Flying ship. In the past, he forbade any Rulers from entering because he had entered a deep sleep! Currently, with him being awake, especially while being in Primal Chaos Flying Ship, he did not give a damn about a Ruler.
As the war continued on…
The confidence of the Ancestor Mother Religion became weaker and weaker to the point where they were eventually forced to lower their heads.
‘Do you really need to split them into 2 batches?’ Gu Qian Luo muttered to himself. He was feeling tremendously delighted in his heart.
Even prouder powerful existences would have to obediently lower their heads in the end.
‘Who would have thought that this Ancestor Mother Religion actually have so many treasures. There are even some treasures which would turn the eyes of Void Gods red with envy.’ Gu Qian Luo sighed. In the beginning, he did not care about the Ancestor Mother Religion. However, he had proceeded to spy in the dark since the beginning of the war… with the resulting battles causing his eyes to turn red, as he discovered that there were some treasures the Ancestor Mother Religion had which were at the Void God level. Some of them were even of other cultivation systems, being snatched over by the experts of the Ancestor Mother Religion to give to their descendants.
As of now, the strongest expert of Ancestor Mother Religion was only comparable to a Ruler. What’s more, his control of the treasures was relatively crude. Thus, many amazing treasures were unable to display much of their true power.
‘It’ll be a great steal if I’m able to get them into my hands.” Gu Qian Luo’s eyes were red. He felt thrilled!
In reality, this was due to the collapse of the Ancestor Mother Religion cosmos, allowing many treasures left in the historical remains to propagate to other places. That was also why the Religious Leaders could gather so many treasures. Without having sufficient power, the treasures in the hands were all useless! Instead, it was ‘Bloodshed God-Emperor’, who was one step into the realm of the Void God, and could fully display the potential of the many arrays after he had gotten the “Myriad Catalog”, allowing those arrays to be much more useful than the treasures the Ancestor Mother Religion had, that had prevailed. In reality, most treasures the Ancestor Mother Religion had were beyond the level of the Primal Pillars. However, the stronger it was, the harder it would be to control them!
‘Hmph hmph…’
‘For the sake of survival, they have to lower their heads.’ Gu Qian Luo thought, ‘It’s also worth it for me to take action for the sake of so many treasures.’
Being the seventh sacred son under the Ancestor Bone Throne, he had a higher view of the cultivation realms. Solely relying on the Primal Chaos Flying Ship already gave him the ability to compete against the Void Gods within the Primal Chaos Void. Compared to them, the Primal Chaos Flying Ship was much stronger in the aspects of survival and the ability to escape! Even if he was heavily injured, the assistance of the ‘Primal Chaos Flying Ship’ gave him full-fledged confidence in dealing with the group of Rulers!
…
The green-skinned teenager was very nervous after making all those declarations. He was worried Gu Qian Luo would not accept those terms. Nonetheless, this was the final backing the Ancestor Mother Religion had, as they were afraid that Gu Qian Luo would just take all the treasures and leave after that without caring about their fates.
Therefore, they had to make it into two batches.
What’s more, most of the important treasures would be left for the second batch! He had to aid them in constructing the Ancestor Mother Altar and win the war before they would give the second batch to Gu Qian Luo.
“Alright, Religious Leader Sang Dan, let us swear an oath.” The moment Gu Qian Luo finished speaking, a spatial ripple suddenly fluctuated in front of the green-skinned teenager. A piece of leaf appeared in front of him. The leaf contained the vague illusion of a short and small creature, with a dense amount of characters that none understood, covering its surface. The characters had also transmitted information over to enlighten the green-skinned teenager what it was.
The green-skinned teenager was a relatively younger Religious Leader from the Ancestor Mother Religion, and also one who entered the Primal Chaos Flying Ship during early stages when the war began.
He extended his hand, giving it a light tap. As a wisp of his soul aura touched, this leaf, it was immediately taken away. The massive sculpture of Gu Qian Luo proceeded to let his soul aura land too on the leaf.
“Weng.”
The short and small creature illusion present on the leaf lifted its head up. Looking at Gu Qian Luo and at the green-skinned teenager beside, its mouth started to move, before words reverberated directly inside the minds of Gu Qian Luo and the green-skinned teenager, “The oath has been sworn. Those who break the oath will die!”
The green-skinned teenager felt the formation of an unseen law. This was a very unique oath law that made it certain he would die if he disobeyed it. The strength of the law was relatively significant, or so at least according to his senses, he would not be able to violate it even if he was a hundred or thousand times stronger.
“Master.” The Religious Leader Sang Dan respectfully greeted.
“Very good.” Gu Qian Luo chuckled as he looked at this servant in front, “When I was traveling in the Primal Chaos Void, I had obtained an array set by coincidence. This array set is extremely formidable, and is easily able to defend you all as you construct the altar.”
“We have a total of 6 altars.” Religious Leader Sang Dan said, “The six altars will have to be constructed in six areas of the cosmos before the whole construct is set up.”
“There are a total of nine arrays in this set. It’s a minor issue to lend 6 of them to you.” Gu Qian Luo said nonchalantly. He indeed disdained battles of that level. When he was traveling in the Primal Chaos Void, most enemies he had were Void Gods! Being a sacred son pampered by the Ancestor Bone Throne, his personal strength was first class even amongst Rulers. Upon borrowing on some peak external materials, it was natural for him to compete with Void Gods.
“Many thanks, master.” Religious Leader Sang Dan delightfully answered.
“In a while, I’ll destroy that Primal Pillar array and rescue you all from it. You can then start setting up the altar, and I’ll guard you all! The moment six altars form the final Ancestor Mother Altar and transform the entire cosmos, without having endless World energy while suffering from the rejection of the cosmos, the cultivators will definitely lose.” Gu Qian Luo casually mentioned.
…
At this moment, in the starry sky outside the base of Ancestor Mother Religion, the incarnation of the fanged Religious Leader was proceeding with the final stages of negotiation.
“We no longer have any path of retreat. We only hope for you cultivators to abide by your promise.” The fanged Religious Leader said with a lowered head.
Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded, “I do wish for you all to stay obediently within your base. Do not form another plot. If you decide to deceive us… we will not give you all another opportunity.”
“Please be rest assured.” The fanged Religious Leader chuckled.

chapters.title: Chapter 767 - Gu Qian Luo!!!
chapters.content:
Chapter 767: Gu Qian Luo!!!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The white-robed Xue Ying sat at the edge of the Primal Pillar peak, looking towards the vast starry sky beneath his feet, as well as the many gigantic shackles present there. Chuckling, he brought up a wine flask before starting to drink.
“Disciple Brother Dong Bo, why are you drinking alone? Why not let me try some as well?” A sound resounded by his ears.
Xue Ying turned over, looking through the void to see his Disciple Brother Monarch Green, who was currently located on another Primal Pillar smiling at him and asking for some wine.
“This isn’t good wine, though I quite like it. Here you go.”
Xue Ying casually flipped his hand, taking out another wine flask before throwing it over.
“Xiu!”
The wine flask directly tore through the void, traveling across a far distance before appearing right in front of Monarch Green.
“Oh?” Monarch Green’s eyes brightened. He was sighing inwardly at how formidable the control his disciple brother had over the void. One had to know that he, Monarch Green, specialized in three Daos and one of it was the ‘Dao of Void’.
Receiving it, Monarch Green gulped a mouth: “Mn, not bad. Although the taste is quite light, it has a rich aftertaste. This is good wine.”
Xue Ying chuckled, before starting to chat casually with his disciple brother while they drank along.
The days of protecting the Primal Pillars were indeed lonely.
There were 12 Primal Pillars, and Xue Ying protected two by himself! Furthermore, Empress Qian He had long left the vicinity. She had said straightforwardly, There’s not much I can help even if I stay here. Dong Bo Xue Ying, we will have to depend on you over this location from now on.” giggling as she left.
“Hu hu~”
The wind generated by the arrays stirred and formed ripples in the surroundings, causing Xue Ying’s hair to flutter about. Raising his head, he thought, ‘The feeling of safety is delightful.”
Suddenly-
Under this atmosphere of peace, a flying ship spanning 500 kilometers long appeared. It appeared silently. It had an ordinary look and was much smaller than the Wooden Mustache War Vessel the Ancestor Mother Religion had. It was just 500 kilometers long… and looked truly pitiable amidst the backdrop of the starry sky. Any planet out there would be bigger than it.
However, a huge change had occurred to the expression of Primal Master, who was closest to it as he shouted out: “Primal Chaos Flying ship!”
“Bloodshed, not good, the Primal Chaos Flying Ship has suddenly appeared.” Primal Master immediately transmitted.
At the same time, he said, “Gu Qian Luo, why are you here?”
“I came to have some fun.”
A wicked sound transmitted out from the flying ship.
What followed closely was a violet arc of light that emanated from the top of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. Tearing through all obstacles of space, it smashed against the Primal Pillar seemingly in an instant. “Hong-”. The rigid and seemingly incomparably firm Primal Pillar had unexpectedly started shaking under this inconspicuous violet arc of light. As it spun around, invisible shockwaves swept across the body of Primal Master, causing his expression to change abruptly. Closely following that, his body turned into power and dissipated in the void.
Just a single move destroyed the Primal PIllar array. What’s more, the clone of Primal Master who was responsible for guarding this had perished!
“Hmph, the 12 Primal Pillars which are refined from some extremely crude materials are truly weak.” That colossal sculpture ‘Gu Qian Luo’ sneered from within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship.
The reputation of the “Myriad Catalog” was tremendous.
That terrifying existence who created the “Myriad Catalog” knew that this system of his was extraordinarily complex and difficult to cultivate. Instead, he took the initiative to broadcast the “Myriad Catalog”. It was relatively easy to acquire it. Thus, the ‘Great Emperor Jiao Yun’ from the Devil Mountain Cosmos had given him the original copy without second thoughts. If this book were precious enough, the great emperor would never have given it to Xue Ying.
And Gu Qian Luo was naturally familiar with the 12 Primal Pillars. He was able to promptly destroy the array by relying on his Primal Chaos Flying Ship.
“Alright. I’ve already broken through the 12 Primal Pillars. It is up to you all from now.” Gu Qian Luo looked at Religious Leader Sang Dan in front. At this moment, he was heavily injured, and if he did not have to fight, he would not do so. He had only acted once for the sake of those treasures of Ancestor Mother Religion. From now on, he was too lazy to even move anymore.
Religious Leader Sang Dan’s eyes were excited and blazing with madness. It seemed that this Gu Qian Luo was stronger than he expected!
******
The side of the Ancestor Mother Religion was filled with excitement and frenzy.
The Cultivators were astonished and indignant.
“Gu Qian Luo!” Bloodshed God-Emperor was so furious that the edges of his eyes were about to crack. He glared at the distant Primal Chaos Flying Ship.
“Gu Qian Luo. I’ve been afraid all this while that he will intervene in the war. In the end, he really did.” Temporal Island Lord gritted his teeth.
“Damn.”
“He actually intervened in the war.”
Xue Ying was similarly startled and filled with fury. The power displayed by Gu Qian Luo was genuinely terrifying! He could actually break the 12 Primal Pillars array by relying on the Primal Chaos Flying Ship! His offense was much stronger than what the Ancestor Mother Religion had! And what made him even angrier was… at that time, Gu Qian Luo had explicitly stated that he had chosen Mysterious North Imperial Empress and would help their side.
But now? He actually changed sides just like that!
“Hu.”
With the array being destroyed, the shackles sealing the base of Ancestor Mother Religion naturally started to disappear. That ancient Wooden Mustache War Vessel flew out from the enormous spherical castle once again, and this time, that ‘Primal Chaos Flying Ship’ actually tore through the void to arrive by its side, coming to a stop right beside each other.
“This is the first batch of our gifts.”
“Very good. These are the six arrays. I’ll lend them to you for the time being.”
The Ancestor Mother Religion and Gu Qian Luo rapidly made their trade.
Gu Qian Luo did not allow any other of the Religious Leaders to come in. Only that ‘Religious Leader Sang Dan’ who had sworn an oath with him, was his servant, and therefore he would naturally let him in. As for other Religious Leaders, he had no way of relaxing his guard against.
…
“Hu.” “Hu.”
The Ancestor Mother Religion’s Wooden Mustache War Vessel rapidly tore through the void and left, with the Primal Chaos Flying Ship closely followed behind.
“Chase.”
Bloodshed God-Emperor, Xue Ying, Monarch Green, and the others relied on their perception of the void to follow behind the disturbances generated.
It was exceptionally easy for Xue Ying due to his excellent control towards the void, as he could practically perceive every single location in the entire cosmos. Nevertheless, there were still a few places which he could not detect, like the core ground of the Lake Heart Island historical remain! Or the Starting Ground.
“With Gu Qian Luo helping us, we must hurry up and construct the Ancestor Mother Altar.” The Religious Leaders took action in haste. Tearing through the void to arrive at one of the six locations of this cosmos, the Wooden Mustache War Vessel came to a halt. Religious Leaders flew out of the ship immediately, proceeding to wave their hands before causing a gray altar to appear. After that, a thin old man began chanting in front of it. He was currently activating the altar.
On the other side, two Religious Leaders began constructing one of the six arrays they got from Gu Qian Luo. l
“Hu~”
The Primal Chaos Flying Ship also appeared above, protecting them as they got to work.
“You imbeciles, how long do you need to take to construct a single array! Hurry up!” Gu Qian Luo beckoned them.
“Sou sou sou sou…”
In the distant, many figures started appearing one after another. They were the Rulers from the Cultivator Cosmos.
“Weng~” That gray altar was activated. All of a sudden, an invisible power began transmitting out propagating across the entire cosmos seemingly in an instant, before many other gray altar illusions began appearing in other places of the cosmos too. This unseen energy started to influence the entire cosmos. “Hong hong hong~” The cosmos started trembling as the world energy within began turning chaotic.
“The Ancestor mother Altar is composed of six altars.” Xue Ying said, “This is the first altar. Once the entire altar is constructed, its power will spread across every single location of the cosmos, transforming the entire cosmos into theirs.”
Bloodshed God-Emperor and the others turned ashen-gray. They had once obtained information transmitted over by Xue Ying regarding the Ancestor Mother Religion cultivation system and thus got to know some information about them.
“Take action!” Bloodshed God-Emperor ordered.
At this point, there was no need for words.
What Gu Qian Luo had done clearly represented that he was on the side of the Ancestor Mother Religion.

chapters.title: Chapter 768 - Black Gourd
chapters.content:
Chapter 768: Black Gourd
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Black Bird on the shoulder of Bloodshed God-Emperor suddenly expanded. It covered the upper sky and was more than 10 million times bigger than a planet. Bloodshed God-Emperor’s figure turned illusory before two bodies appeared. These two figures of Bloodshed God-Emperor were employing arrays at this moment… two enormous arrays appeared on the wings of Black Bird Fifth Uncle Master. One was a wing full of flames, and the other was a wing full of frost.
“Hong~” Black Bird Fifth Uncle Master fanned his wing, causing both ice and fire to merge. It released a terrifying destructive force across the region in front. Everywhere the energy passed was destroyed.
The two avatars, arrays, and the black bird released a horrifying force as a whole.
Xue Ying felt astonished. This was the first time he saw his teacher Bloodshed God-Emperor releasing his entire might. Just like himself, Xue Ying had a real body and two avatars, yet all of them were fighting their own individual battles. On the side of Bloodshed God-Emperor, both avatars of his were perfectly controlling two arrays that merged together, allowing their strength to surge explosively.
“Such a powerful Ruler.” In the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, the enormous sculpture ‘Gu Qian Luo’ was watching this scene. His expression slightly changed, “If I did not have the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, I am most likely not his opponent even if I relied on other treasures when I was at my peak! This cosmos could actually create such a frightening Ruler. Such strength should give him the power to resist against several moves by a Void God.”
Gu Qian Luo could not help but feel jealousy in his heart. With his experience, he was able to determine that the ‘Black Bird’ was just a slightly more unique lifeform. It should be a Ruler too.
Being able to get a follower who could unleash such power… if he were in front of Ancestor Bone, this Bloodshed God-Emperor would qualify more than he, Gu Qian Luo, as a sacred son! Naturally, it was because Gu Qian Luo faced an imminent danger in his position. That was why he had to take the risk and go on an adventure outside.
“Hmph.” Even though he was jealous, Gu Qian Luo remained disdainful of this, “Ultimately, he has not left the cosmos. Wait until I get the treasures from the Ancestor Mother Religion and I’ll just eliminate him on the way!”
…
Bloodshed God-Emperor was able to unleash that ultra-strong offense. As for Primal Master, Empress Qian He, Monarch Green, Myriad God Palace Head, and Pang Yi, the five of them immediately controlled an enormous array. Primal Master was acting as the core controller, and the array would form black cracks every time it unleashed an offense. It contained an offensive power that would terrify others.
Other than that, Purgatory Ruler, Xue Ying, Abyss Primogenitor, and Temporal Island Lord were also fighting as individuals.
Ultimately, the cultivators had too few powerful treasures.
“Hong~” Black Bird Fifth Uncle Master would sweep out a horrifying destructive energy every time it flapped its wings.
“Hua!” Primal Master and the other four were quite good with arrays. That was why they were currently controlling one to converge their strength. Every single strike would cause space to crack. Those strikes were done in a bid to tear the Ancestor Mother Religion apart.
Xue Ying, Purgatory Ruler, and the others were also attacking, albeit their offenses were much weaker. Ultimately, they were still within the region of what a Ruler could unleash and could not threaten the Ancestor Mother Religion at all!
The Ancestor Mother Religion had three crucial protections.
One was the Wooden Mustache War Vessel which was located beneath the altar. Large amounts of roots were flying around and revolving by the sides of the altar. They were protecting it.
The second protection was the Primal Chaos Flying Ship which stopped above the altar.
The third was the array given by Gu Qian Luo.
“Hong hong hong~” “Hua hua hua~”
The cultivators were madly attacking, though they were barely destroying the obstacles formed by a large number of roots. The Primal Chaos Flying Ship was merely protecting the space below, easily blocking off all remnant shockwaves.
“I overestimated them too much, and even lent six arrays to the Ancestor Mother Religion.” Gu Qian Luo could not help but sneer from within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. That’s right. The first two protections were enough to defend the altar. The arrays did not suffer from any attack at all.
“Quick.”
“Quickly activate it.”
The Religious Leaders were all very anxious.
And that thin old man was still chanting in front of the altar. Even if he wanted to rush through the procedure, it would be pointless since the process of activation had to be done step by step.
As the thin old man gradually activated the altar, the energy of the altar became all the more disruptive. It began forming a connection with an existence far away whom they worshipped.
“Ancestor Mother.”
A smile bloomed on the face of this thin old man. It was like a baby in the bosom of his mother. He could sense that mighty and boundless energy, and in front of this, he who was a Religious Leader existence was just like an ant in front of the starry sky.
“Hong~”
The altar abruptly unleashed an even stronger power. It resonated with the many grayish altar illusions located at other parts of the cosmos. This sort of resonance gradually turned into a law and began to stabilize. And the world energy pervading the entire Cultivator Cosmos started turning more violent. Several Transcendents located in the Deity world, material realm and Dark Abyss began to discover that they could no longer absorb the world energy because it was too violent.
“Soon.” The other Religious Leaders were revealing joyous looks from within the Wooden Mustache War Vessel.
“What should we do? What can we do if we can’t destroy the altar?” Monarch Green revealed an anxious look.
“That altar is under the protection of that war vessel and Primal Chaos Flying Ship. It even has a strange array defending it. Right now, we can’t even break past the protection of that Primal Chaos Flying Ship.” Primal Master’s expression turned ugly.
Bloodshed God-Emperor was also becoming anxious.
What to do?
The Ancestor Mother Religion had to construct six altars before they succeed in constructing the complete Ancestor Mother Altar which would then start transforming the entire cosmos. Every single altar required someone to protect, and there was only a single Wooden Mustache War Vessel and a single Primal CHaos Flying Ship. This was also the reason why the Ancestor Mother Religion did not construct any other altars before they completed with the first one since they could not defend them!
But with that strange array, Bloodshed God-Emperor who was a grand expert in the aspect of arrays could see with a single glance: “That array defending the altar is extremely mystical and unique. Its defensive strength is even beyond the Wooden Mustache War Vessel and the Primal Chaos Flying Ship.”
The Primal Chaos Flying Ship had a genuinely heaven-shattering defense. But Gu Qian Luo was ultimately heavily injured, so he could only stop above the altar and control the space below to defend the altar. And this simple protection… was far weaker than the array protecting the altar.
“This array has never appeared in this cosmos before.”
“And with how mystical and unique it is, the array should most likely be taken out by Gu Qian Luo since it is of an entirely different system with the Ancestor Mother Religion.” Bloodshed God-Emperor was anxious, “Since he decided to act, he should most likely have the certainty to defend all six altars. What should we do, what should we do?”
…
The cultivators did not have any methods of resolving the crisis. They were weaker than the Ancestor Mother Religion in terms of their foundation, much less as compared to Gu Qian Luo.
“Ancestor Mother?” Xue Ying looked distantly towards the first altar. The first altar contained enough power to engulf the entire cosmos. Many other regions had formed illusions of grayish altars. With his perception of the void, he was able to discover those gray altars, “The Ancestor Mother is truly overbearing.”
Having cultivated Walker’s Hidden Secret to the 11th level, he was able to enter the Primal Chaos Void at the Ruler realm! And Voidwalker Gu Qi had also left behind ample amount of information in the inheritances regarding the Primal Chaos Void including the information on the sacred world.
With the status of the Voidwalker ‘Gu Qi’, the intelligence he provided was extremely vast.
The vast Primal Chaos Void and the five great sacred worlds! And each of the terrifying existences like Forefather Tian Yu, Lake Heart Island Swordmaster, Devil Mountain Primogenitor, and so on. These were existences who had cultivated to an extreme end! Even the Voidwalker’s cultivation system, the “Walker’s Hidden Secret”, would allow him to step into the final realm of cultivation from the 51st level onwards.
That was an unfathomable level. Naturally, there were weak and strong experts in that realm. For instance, the creator of the entire Walker’s Hidden Secret, he was someone terrifying and powerful.
And amongst the existences at the final realm, ‘Ancestor Mother’ was also a truly terrifying and overbearing existence. This cultivation system ultimately relied on the belief for Ancestor Mother while rejecting all other systems! Everything was about honoring the Ancestor Mother! Even the Ancestor Mother Altar could rely on ‘Ancestor Mother’ to transmit energy to transform the cosmos.
According to logic, such existences would suffer from rejection by others in the final realm. But the status of Ancestor Mother remained firm. It was because he was too strong and powerful!
“I still require to use the Black Gourd in the end.” Xue Ying flipped his hand, bringing out a Black Gourd.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, are you thinking of using it?” The treasure spirit transmitted, “I’ll have to remind you once again, you are currently a Ruler, and using the second level of strength from the Black Gourd… will harm the entire cosmos! If you were too frenzy about it, it might even destroy the entire cosmos.”
“I understand. I’ll be careful in controlling the area it’ll affect.” Xue Ying replied.
When he was a Paragon, the energy emitted by the Black Gourd was enough to induce all Rulers to evade it!
And at the Ruler realm, what the Black Gourd release was no longer just ripples. Instead, it was a more terrifying power, one that could force even Void Gods-’Origin Birth realm’-to retreat. Ordinary Void Gods could not withstand against such an attack. One could see how terrifying and savage it was. Only objects that were powerful enough could act as a ‘protector’ and defend Voidwalkers at the Ruler realm!
“Black Gourd?”
Gu Qian Luo who was always observing the cultivators from the Primal Chaos Flying Ship and the other Ancestor Mother Religion Religious Leaders felt slightly disdained.
The power of the Black Gourd had been seen by them before. That black ripple might be powerful and wild, and could barely reach the Void God level. It was not even up to par with Bloodshed God-Emperor’s offense, so what was the point of using it in the battle?
“Pa.” Xue Ying unplugged the cork of the Black Gourd.

chapters.title: Chapter 769 - Golden Flames
chapters.content:
Chapter 769: Golden Flames
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Feeling that mystical void array within the Black Gourd, Xue Ying began activating the arrays within. After reaching the Ruler realm, his soul had become much stronger, allowing him to control a greater portion of the ‘Sun Star’-like fireball’s might present within the Black Gourd. Nevertheless, Xue Ying remained cautious and vigilant, as he was clear that such a power might possibly cause the end of this cosmos if he was to let it run rampant!
Just like the many mortal worlds within the material realm, when met with destruction, they would end up in apocalypse within a shorter period of time before undergoing rebirth.
Every single cosmos epoch had differing lifespans. Over time, as the lifeforms reproduced and Rulers emerged, the number of Void Gods who appeared and consume the World energy at an ever-increasing rate, resulting in the direct destruction towards the cosmos… all sorts of reasons determined the length of a cosmos epoch.
The second level of Black Gourd possessed the might to force Void Gods to retreat. Therefore, its power could naturally harm a cosmos.
If Xue Ying became a Void God and mastered the control of the third level of Black Gourd… it was possible for him to cause the end of a cosmos epoch with just a single move!
In reality, the strength of a Void God was more than sufficient to cause harm to a cosmos. Thus, the three Great Emperors of Devil Mountain Cosmos… would usually only exchange moves within the ‘Primogenitor Devil Mountain’ and not take any action in other regions of the cosmos.
‘Be more careful, control its range.’ Xue Ying told himself, ‘I must stop using the Black Goud after eliminating this altar.’
At this moment, the Ancestor Mother Religion and Gu Qian Luo were focused more on Bloodshed God-Emperor and the others, completely disregarding the existence of Dong Bo Xue Ying. To them, that Black Gourd… although it would be relatively effective when used against two to three Rulers, this was a group level fight. With Ancestor Mother Religion had practically used its entire foundation along with the help of Gu Qian Luo, the Black Gourd was not even worth a mention in such a lineup.
Not just them, even Bloodshed God-Emperor, Monarch Green, Primal Master, and others were secretly shaking their heads while thinking: ‘ Although the power of the Black Gourd might have some use, it can’t change the overall situation of this war.’
On the contrary, Xue Ying was extremely cautious. At this moment, he felt incomparable pressure bearing down on his soul, pressing down with a force that surpassed his current realm of cultivation. Fortunately, he was the master of the Black Gourd. Otherwise, he would have already suffered severe injuries as a result.
“Be destroyed, Ancestor Mother Religion.” Xue Ying’s eyes were filled with a strand of madness.
“Hu~”
Eye piercing brightness
Incomparably eye-piercing brightness.
This eye-piercing brightness caused both parties to turn subconsciously turn their heads over to take a look. Upon doing so, astonishment appeared in the eyes of Gu Qian Luo in the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, the Religious Leaders from the Ancestor Mother Religion and the Rulers from the cultivators, as they stared right a the Black Gourd.
At this moment, an incomparably dazzling golden light was shooting out from the mouth of the Black Gourd. Tearing through space, it rushed straight towards that altar. This ultra-fast golden light appeared to have a liquid-like consistency and was the most dazzling object currently in the entire starry sky-appearing to be much more dazzling than the Sun Star. At the instance of its appearance, the surrounding temperature was rose rapidly, reach levels that cause even the void to become warped and distorted. The temperatures radiating out from it were so high Rulers would be instantly turned into ashes should they even dare to touch it.
“Pu-” Massive amounts of roots that protected the Wooden Mustache War Vessel were smashed apart instantly upon contact with this golden liquid like radiance, turning utterly soft and powerless. The defense space controlled by the Primal Chaos Flying Ship had also been smashed apart by the incoming golden light, unable to block even a sliver of it.
“Block it!” The two Religious Leaders maintaining the array that protected the altar turned anxious, as this protection array was their final line of defense.
“Chi chi chi~” The surging golden liquid light was just like galloping wave-gushing over. However, possessing extreme speed and power, it smashed into the protective array, which released a dazzling light in response. Many veined patterns on the violet array started trembling, while many patterns were being shattered into pieces. In half a breath since the appearance of the golden light, the protective array was completely broken apart. It had also engulfed the three Religious Leaders from the Ancestor Mother Religion-the two Religious Leaders controlling the array and the one activating the altar, while completely inundating the entire altar.
Three Religious Leaders were instantly turned into ashes.
The Wooden Mustache War Vessel and Primal Chaos Flying Ship did not dare to get close to the golden light.
This surging and piercing golden light enveloped the altar, showing no signs of continuing to surge forwards. On the contrary, it appeared extremely docile and under control.
“Golden Sun Flames?”
“That is the Golden Sun Flames?”
Bloodshed God-Emperor, Primal Master, and the others were extremely shocked, as they were too familiar with the Sun Star. The Sun Star was split into six different levels, of which the fifth level ‘Sun Abyss’ contained this sort of liquefied flames-the Golden Sun Flames. It’s said that the so-called ‘Sun Star Nucleus’ existed beneath the layer of Golden Sun Flames. That was the true core of the Sun Star.
This liquid within the Sun Abyss exceedingly potent, causing Rulers to not dare to get close to it as they would feel impending death upon doing so! Many seniors across the epochs like Lake Heart Island master and Ancestor Devil had recorded matters pertaining to the Sun Star down. Rulers who dared to touch the Sun Golden Flames would turn into ashes instantaneously. Even Void Gods were not able to survive for long in the presence of those Sun Golden Flames.
Xue Ying held onto the Black Gourd. The density of the Golden Sun flames was at its highest at the mouth of the gourd, distorting as it squeezed out before surging forwards to engulf the altar at a distance.
“Split up.”
Xue Ying sent out a thought.
These dazzling golden flames formed a passage. Xue Ying took a slow step into the void, while the golden flames to split out and revolved obediently around Xue Ying.
Following the passage formed by the golden flames, Xue Ying walked towards the first altar. Extending his right hand, his palm started to expand rapidly before grabbing hold onto the altar and giving a furious tug! Being a Voidwalker, he possessed extremely terrifying strength, allowing him to forcibly tear the connection between the altar and other large numbers of grayish altars located across the cosmos apart. After pulling it over, he proceeded to forcibly keep the altar into his storage treasure.
Faced with the changes happening to the current situation,, the Ancestor Mother Religion and Gu Qian Luo within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship could only watch on, being completely unable to hinder the movements of Dong Bo Xue Ying.
“We’re doomed.”
The Religious Leaders within the Wooden Mustache War Vessel turned dazed.
“We’re doomed.”
“The first altar has been taken away. How can we find a new first altar within such a short period?”
“And how can we defend the six altars from that terrifying Golden Flames?” These Religious Leaders were completely stunned. The power of the Black Gourd had caused them to feel despair.
…
The cultivators were incomparably shocked by the scene before them. A Ruler could actually control the power of the Golden Flames from the Sun Star, and in such a large scale? Who would dare defend against such an attack?
This made Monarch Green, Primal Master, and the others both joyous and envious at the same time. At this moment, they understood that the ‘Black Gourd’ was not that simple as they once thought it to be. Instead, it was a genuinely unfathomable treasure, and at the very least was more powerful than all of the treasures the Rulers possessed.
‘No wonder he could rise so quickly. His luck is too good.’ Temporal Island Lord thought. Even though they were of the same race, he could not curb his jealousy.
The lowly brat who once wanted to join the Temporal Temple in the past had become the target of jealousy of this Temporal Island Lord. However, if not for Xue Ying’s soaring speed in cultivation and how dazzling he was, it was impossible for him to pass through the trials for the Voidwalker! Like Temporal Island Lord, if he were to participate in the Voidwalker’s trial, he would fail because of his poor comprehension ability and because of his poor heart temperament.
At the moment, within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, the enormous sculpture ‘Gu Qian Luo’ had completely different emotions surging within his heart, while a horrified look had appeared on his face.
“A Ruler that has yet to walk out of this Cosmos is actually able to get his hands on such a treasure?”
“When he was a Paragon, the rippling attacks emitted by the Black Gourd were able to contend against Rulers. Now, it’s capable of releasing this terrifying flames which were sufficient to deal with ordinary Void Gods.”
“Different levels… will result in differing might! What’s more, it seems that there aren’t any retaliatory effects?”
“That treasure is definitely a protective treasure deliberately left behind by some expert for his descendants.” Gu Qian Luo’s horizons and view were vast and wide. After all, he was ultimately the seventh sacred son of Ancestor Bone Throne. Only the first three sacred sons could obtain a protective treasure from Ancestor Bone Throne. Gu Qian Luo was not yet qualified to get one!
“I must get it!”
“That protective treasure is so much more precious than the treasures of the Ancestor Mother Religion. It might even be more valuable of than my Primal Chaos Flying Ship.”
“Although that sort of protective treasure would definitely be meant for the inheritor.,with no other people being able to utilize it … as long as I bring it back plead to my teacher, he would still be willing to help me to do something simple like refining it.” Gu Qian Luo felt disturbances brewing in his heart. If he asked his teacher to painstakingly refine a protective treasure from start to end for him, he would definitely not be willing to do so. However, something simple like refining a complete protective treasure for his disciple was something that could be accomplished with the flip of his hand.
“Snatch it!”
“I must get it!”
At this moment, Gu Qian Luo’s thoughts were extremely clear. The Ancestor Mother Religion had lost the first altar. What’s more, it was impossible for the six altars to resist against that Black Gourd. Therefore, he had long thrown the Ancestor Mother Religion behind the back of his mind.
There was only one thought going through his head-that was to think of any way possible to get the Black Gourd into his hands! The moment he had done so, he might think of spending a little effort to help the Ancestor Mother Religion.
“I must get it! Once I get it in my hands, I’m able to return.” Never in his dreams did Gu Qian Luo thought that he would be so lucky as to be able to see such a protective treasure within a cosmos. If the Black Gourd merely just released the Golden Flames, he would not recognize truly how valuable it was. After all, although the Golden Flames were powerful, they weren’t able to match up to the value of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. However, Xue Ying had used it once in the Paragon realm. It was able to unleash attacks with differing might at when the user was on different realms! Even the method by which it triggered its attacks were different! A treasure like this would most likely continue to become stronger even after he becomes a Void God. By then, the power it could unleash would also undergo a qualitative change!
…
Xue Ying had forcibly taken away the first altar. At this moment, the other grayish altar illusions within the cosmos had utterly dissipated away, and the world energy in the Cultivator Cosmos gradually regained its usual calm and warmth.
“Pa.” Xue Ying severed the activation of the Sun Golden Flame with a single thought while immediately closing the entrance of the Black Gourd. After all, the Sun Golden Flames were too powerful and would be harmful to the cosmos.
“Master, be careful! Be careful of that Gu Qian Luo!” The treasure spirit immediately transmitted a message over.
“Weng-”
An unseen ripple immediately propagated out from the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, surging out in a swift and sinister manner. This was none other than Gu Qian Luo, who was now brimming with killing intent. Madness filled the eyes of Gu Qian Luo. He had to get this protective treasure at all costs!

chapters.title: Chapter 770 - A New World
chapters.content:
Chapter 770: A New World
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
At this moment, Xue Ying was still worried about the harm the Golden Flames would bring to the cosmos. He had just plugged in the cork when the treasure spirit immediately transmitted a message to warn him. Alas, it was too late! Gu Qian Luo’s sudden sneak attack on him was truly unexpected, with the key factor being of his extreme speed in doing so!
“Not good.” Not having enough time to control the Black Gourd, Xue Ying immediately hid into the Mirage World, causing his body to disappear from the place. The current Xue Ying had stepped into the Ruler realm with his Dao of Mirage. Although the Dao of Mirage might be weak in terms of attacking others, it could create a world of its own, boosting the cultivator’s survival capabilities to an extremely formidable level. As such, Rulers with weaker techniques weren’t even able to find the true body of Xue Ying.
“Weng-”
Gu Qian Luo utilized the attack from the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, immediately sending the invisible ripple to sweep across the entire area where Xue Ying had been. Space-time was immediately distorted, causing the figure of Xue Ying, who was hiding in his Mirage World, to faintly appear. That ripple had forcibly penetrated its way into his already complete Mirage World. However, its power had drastically decreased by then, leaving behind only about 20% of its original strength.
“Pu~” This attack struck squarely on the body of Xue Ying. However, with his body was akin to the void, it had easily dissipated more than half the incoming force. The remaining impact merely caused his blood to churn- turning his face red, he did not spurt out any blood at all.
“What, I actually wasn’t able to injure him?” Gu Qian Luo was filled with disbelief as he stared from within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. For the sake of extreme speed and the element of surprise, it had caused that attack to weaken. Nonetheless, it had reached the boundary of Void God and was no weaker than the fusion attack done by Bloodshed God-Emperor’s two avatars and Black Bird Fifth Uncle Master.
Even such power wasn’t able to make Xue Ying spurt blood? His survival capability was indeed extremely ridiculous.
…
However, Gu Qian Luo did not know that the Voidwalker had bodies just like the void, which were completely unaffected by brute force. Coupled with his original tyrannical body, even though he had just reached the 11th level of the Walker’s Hidden Secret, the degree of strength of his body had far surpassed an absolute majority of Religious Leaders from the Ancestor Mother Religion. Just by relying on his body, he was able to match against the peak realm Rulers. Therefore, it was extremely difficult to cause harm to a Voidwalker.
At the same time, Xue Ying’s ‘Dao of Mirage’ was a Dao that was resulted in exceedingly high survival capabilities when cultivated, and would result in the ability to form a Mirage World achieving completion in it. Therefore, it was indeed too, too difficult to kill a “VoidWalker” hiding in his Mirage World.
“Gu Qian Luo!” Xue Ying roared out. Having just suffered from a sneak attack, he turned to look in front, while immediately plugged open the cork to the Black Gourd. “Hong~” Surging golden flames rushed out and descended into the real world, heading straight towards that Primal Chaos Flying Ship.
“Hong hong hong~”
The golden flames overwhelmed the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, yet the ship remained undamaged. At this moment, Gu Qian Luo was pondering at this moment how he should deal with Xue Ying. As for the Golden Flames? He was not afraid of it at all!
What a joke.
By relying on the Primal Chaos Flying Ship and other external treasures while being his peak condition, he was able to match up against Void Gods. Even if he met any danger in the Primal Chaos Void, he could also depend on his ship to defend against it. What’s more, even the great destruction it brought by the end of a cosmos could not damage the ship! Let’s not talk about this Primal Chaos Flying Ship, even the Wooden Mustache War Vessel of the Ancestor Mother Religion would not be damaged by the Golden Flames at all.
Naturally, the only thing Gu Qian Luo and the Religious Leaders could do was to hide within their respective flying ships. No a single one of them dared to head out!
“Dammit.” Xue Ying cursed. However, he could not help but grit his teeth after seeing that the Primal Chaos Flying Ship remained undamaged. Restraining the power of the Black Gourd, he plugged back the cork.
“The Golden Flames you’re unleashing are too overpowering and destructive and would harm your cosmos. I assumed that you’ll continue to use it, all the way until the destruction of this epoch of your cosmos.” Brimming with chilling intent, Gu Qian Luo’s voice reverberated in the void.
“Master, don’t be worried. You had only used the Black Gourd for a rather short amount of time. What’s more, the area filled by the Golden Flames was also rather small. Therefore, the harm it had on the cosmos is still extremely low.” The treasure spirit transmitted over.
“Mn.”
Xue Ying grabbed hold of the Black Gourd. Appearing out of the void, he stared coldly at the Primal Chaos Flying Ship.
Bloodshed God-Emperor, Monarch Green, Primal Master, Abyss Primogenitor, and other Rulers were infuriated. Bloodshed God-Emperor roared out in a cold voice “Gu Qian Luo, you have chosen Mysterious North Imperial Empress in the past and promised to help us! But now, not only have you helped the Ancestor Mother Religion. you’re even attacking Xue Ying after their first altar was taken away by us?”
“Haha… I have chosen that lass Mysterious North Imperial Empress in the past, and she swore an oath with me too. However, I did not disobey it at all! She has always been within my Primal Chaos Flying Ship, and I have never harmed her before.” A voice came out from within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, “As for promising to help you all? Hahaha, do you all still believe in that? What a joke!”
Bloodshed God-Emperor and the others felt extremely indignant. Despite his status and cultivation realm, Gu Qian Luo had unexpectedly not cared about his promises! He did not even care about his own reputation!
…
The enormous sculpture ‘Gu Qian Luo’ spoke out in ridicule from within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship as he continued to observe Xue Ying, thinking how he should deal with him.
He had never given up before!
That Black Gourd was a protective treasure, and he would not mind paying all price just to get it.
“Mn.”
“I’ll bet it and follow along with this plan.” Gu Qian Luo soon arrived at a conclusion in his heart.
…
Although Xue Ying appeared in the real world, he was still in the Mirage World, surveying his surroundings in vigilance.
“Dong!”
A mystical sound reverberated in his soul. However, Xue Ying’s soul had completely integrated with the complete “Walker’s Hidden Secret”, allowing him to easily withstand this attack. Nonetheless, the expression on Xue Ying’s face change as he hurriedly plugged out the cork from the Black Gourd, causing the Golden Flame light to fly out once again. This time, not much of it flew out. Instead, it revolved around Xue Ying, forming a golden sphere with Xue Ying remaining at its center.
The damage done to a cosmos by the Golden Flames depended on its quantity and the area of effect! The greater the quantity, the broader the area…, and so with the resulting harm. Just forming a golden sphere around a single body was only two to three meters in diameter would bring so little harm to the cosmos it even felt pitiful to mention.”呼.””呼.””呼.”…
“Hu.” “Hu.” “Hu.”
Xue Ying was right to be careful.
Other than the starting soul attack, it was closely followed up by a strange wind. This wind appeared from the void, tearing its way right into the Mirage World. Although its power had significantly decreased by then, it was soon engulfed the Golden Flames. Ultimately, it dissipated without succeeding to penetrate through the flames.
“This Gu Qian Luo…” Temporal Island Lord, Primal Master, Abyss Primogenitor, Monarch Green, Empress Qian He and the rest were all in great shock. They were watching as many enormous array diagrams started to take form within the surrounding void around the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. Many strange attacks were displayed by the arrays. There were 3 different types of soul attacks being launched, some using sound waves, curses, and others. There were those targeted the fleshy body too, and those that directly dealt with a region of the world.
Every single array diagram appeared before disappearing.
Gu Qian Luo gritted his teeth. That enormous sculpture was just an appearance he presented to the real world.
