His actual body was seated in a cross-legged manner, concealed within the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. At this moment, he was controlling the Primal Chaos Flying Ship to crazily unleashing attacks with not the slightest bit of restraint! His injuries were originally severe, resulting in them worsening as he continued to activate and unleash such powerful attacks.
“As long as I could get the Black Gourd, everything will be worth it. By then, I’ll immediately leave this cosmos and let Sang Dan drive the flying ship for me. I’ll continue sleeping after that.” Gu Qian Luo had already made his decision of continuing to slumber after that. He was currently madly attacking.
However-
What was a protective treasure? Its offensive techniques were secondary. The crux was that it was built for protection!
The violent Golden Flames turned obedient under the control of the void array, forming a perfect shield around Xue Ying. Many layers of stacked together in an exceedingly mystical manner, with everything being controlled using the void array. Gu Qian Luo’s mad frenzied attacks were indeed horrifying, with some of them that could only be weakened slightly by the Mirage World. However, the Golden Flame sphere was able to resist perfectly resist all of the incoming attacks. What about other kinds of attacks which could penetrate through like the soul attacks? They were utterly useless against Xue Ying! As for all other attacks which could reach Xue Ying after penetrating through the Golden Flames, none of them could injure Xue Ying one bit.
“I can’t kill him? No, no, no…” Gu Qian Luo was turning crazy.
The sacred sons under the Ancestor Bone Throne were all competing against one another, while the strong would feast on the weak.
He had originally fallen into the bottom rankings, forcing him to enter the Primal Chaos Flying Ship and take a gamble with his fate. Although he had experienced many dangers, that ‘Black Gourd’ was ultimately the best treasure that he had Despite being worried about being unable to kill Xue Ying, he still gave his all. Nevertheless, upon seeing the most undesirable outcome appear, he grew even more crazy and mad! He was not willing to accept this outcome!
…
“Mn?”
Watching the Primal Chaos Flying Ship from afar, Bloodshed looked towards the many gigantic array diagrams appearing in the surrounding void. Having exceedingly high attainments in the aspect of arrays, he could even create the ‘Extreme Void Twin Array’ and the 12 Primal Pillars using the strength of a Ruler. At this moment the scene of one mystical array after another being activated in front of his eyes, it brought much inspiration to him. Unlike those recorded in the “Myriad Catalog”, these arrays that activated before his very eyes. His attainments towards arrays were already close to the realm required to operate and activate those arrays, which allowed him to see through many of the truths and falsities present within them.
As time passed, his expression turned blank. All of a sudden, an explosion went off within his mind, before a vague new world had finally begun opening right in front of him.

chapters.title: Chapter 771 - Birth of a Void God
chapters.content:
Chapter 771: Birth of a Void God
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
At this moment, Xue Ying was still within the mirage world. Unleashing the golden flames from the black gourd to surround his body, not a single attack coming from Gu Qian Luo could do any harm to him.
“Master, there’s no need to worry. Gu Qian Luo had previously been heavily injured and was only able to make somewhat of a recovery after slumbering for several epochs. Previously, he had only made a single move to help Ancestor Mother. However, right now, he is going all out to attack you. This is most probably due to him wanting to obtain Black Gourd. After all, you displayed the might of the Black Gourd twice, once when you were a Paragon and now when you’re a Ruler. Although the methods of offense were different, the might you’ve displayed had far exceeded your cultivation realms for both instances. Being a Scared Son of Ancestor Bone Throne Sacred Son, he surely possesses vast knowledge. From that, he should have deduced that this Black Gourd is a kind of protective treasure, which was something that greatly enticed him.” The Treasure Spirit continued, “However, such frantic actions will put an enormous burden on his already injured body. His injuries will continue to worsen, so he can’t sustain this kind of attack for long.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying knew that too.
Upon reaching the 11th level of Walker’s Hidden Secret, many pieces of information had been unveiled to him. Within the five sacred worlds existed many terrifying peak cultivators, of which one of them was Ancestor Bone!
Ancestor Bone was someone that had equal standing with Forefather Tian Yu and Lake Heart Island Swordmaster-Cultivators that had already reached the peak of the realm!
“No, no, no! That Black Gourd is mine! I must have it! I must!!” Gu Qian Luo felt waves of tearing pain radiating out from his soul, causing his face to turn pale. He stared at Xue Ying with his pair of bloodshot eyes and roared out, “Why does a boy, who had yet to leave his cosmos, have this kind of life-saving treasure! Why isn’t this treasure mine? Why is it not mine?”
In the middle of his frenzied rage, he suddenly looked towards another direction. It was the direction where Bloodshed God-Emperor was located.
Previously, all of Gu Qian Luo’s focus was on Xue Ying, completely giving no care to the other Rulers. However, with his ‘Primal Chaos Flying Ship’ being in the void, he was able to feel a strange calmness and stillness from Bloodshed God-Emperor.
“That’s…” Gu Qian Luo expression changed.
…
Yet another body of Bloodshed God-Emperor came over from within the void. This was the body that was previously inside Lake Heart Island. This scene surprised not only Gu Qian Luo but also Xue Ying, Monarch Green, Primal Master, Abyss Primogenitor, and the others. Ever since the start of the war started till now, none of the Rulers went to war with their three bodies. This was the rule made by Bloodshed God-Emperor himself.
However, Bloodshed God-Emperor himself had now gathered his three bodies here.
“Weng.” The three Bloodshed God-Emperor bodies laughed, before merging together into one crimson-robed Bloodshed God-Emperor.
There existed only one body of Bloodshed God-Emperor in this cosmos now.
“Hong~”
A terrifying undulation started to radiate out from Bloodshed God-Emperor, causing the surrounding void to turn dark and gloomy, with dark clouds rolling around within. Countless array patterns began to circulate around, covering the surrounding space. Its vastness made the heart of everyone present palpitate, and everyone to turn sluggish and stunned.
As far as one’s eyes could see, the surrounding void had become dark and gloomy, covering a terrifying area so vast that it surpassed hundreds of millions of kilometers. Xue Ying possessed an extremely formidable control over the void. He was somewhat aware that the undulations radiating out from his teacher covered an area equivalent to a starfield.
“Void God.” Xue Ying fully understood what happened.
“Void God.” Primal Master, Abyss Primogenitor, Pang Yi, Monarch Green, Purgatory Ruler, and the others all understood the reason behind his phenomena. Looking at this kind of might, one could identify that it was way above something a Ruler could pull off.
“Bloodshed has finally taken this step. Although I knew that this day would come, never had I guessed that this will happen at such a moment.” Primal Master let out a laugh.
“Void God, huh. A void god has appeared in our cosmos epoch.” Abyss Primogenitor gave an emotional sigh.
Temporal Island Lord silently watched as the spectacle unfolded around him. Being an arrogant and prideful person, he never wanted to lose, not even in the face of Bloodshed God-Emperor. However, he knew that the difference between them was too big this time-Bloodshed God-Emperor had already walked onto another level. Deity, World Deity, True God, Void God. Although there was only a single realm difference between True God to Void God, it was a massive step with an exceedingly high difficulty to overcome.
“There’s still a long time for our epoch.” Pang Yi revealed a smile and said. “Bloodshed has already become Void God. Perhaps when the time comes for our epoch to end, Bloodshed might be able to reach the same realm as the Devil Ancestor!” They couldn’t place such high hopes for him to be like the Lake Heart Island Master. However, there was still hope for him to aim for someone like Ancestor Devil.
Although all the Rulers present were shocked and emotional, they still felt joy and elation within their hearts!
That’s because a Void God emerged from this cosmos epoch. Even if this epoch came to an end, the Void God could still take them to roam into primal chaos void, and also towards a more vast world than theirs.
…
“What, Void God? He, how could he make a breakthrough to Void God?” Gu Qian Luo was greatly shocked. In his peak condition, he could fight with a Void God with the assistance of his Primal Chaos Flying Ship. However, with his worsening injuries after his fight with Xue Ying, he absolutely could not afford to fight any longer.
“Gu Qian Luo!”
Bloodshed God-Emperor voice resonated in the space, his eyes brimming with an icy cold glint as stared at the distant Primal Chaos Flying Ship
“Hong long long~”
Two huge arrays appeared on top and bottom of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship-one being a dark flame array while the other being ice-cold white. Both arrays started spinning, with their opposing forces taking effect on the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. Bloodshed knew that it would be hard for him if he wanted to take over control of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship. That’s why instead of controlling it, he chose to imprison the other party.
“How can he be that strong just after reaching the realm of Void God?” Feeling the power that approaching his Primal Chaos Flying Ship caused Gu Qian Luo expression to change.
Bloodshed God-Emperor had cultivated in two systems, one being the law and profound mysteries system, with the other being the Hex system that excelled at arrays and refining.
The law and profound mysteries system placed emphasis on the essence of nature and its rules.
On the contrary, the Hex system placed emphasis on the study and research into the myriad of things in existence.
Xue Ying believed that this ‘Hex’ system was no less inferior than their law and profound mysteries system. It was even more complicated and powerful! This time, Bloodshed God-Emperor had managed to breakthrough via the Hex system, with his resulting strength being much more powerful than the simple system used by the followers of Ancestor Mother. If he also broke through via law and profound mysteries system, Bloodshed God-Emperor’s powers would become much more frightening once both systems synergized with one another.
“I have to leave quickly. I can’t fight in such close quarters any longer.” Gu Qian Luo didn’t dare to tarry any longer.
“Hua!”
All of a sudden, the Primal Chaos Flying ship become translucent, flying away into the distance. At a further spot, a stretch of space started to tear apart. Like a curtain, layers were torn apart, revealing a vast and cold chaotic void behind! This chaotic void appeared to be empty; however, it was filled with powerful destructive force.
“He’s fleeing?” Bloodshed God-Emperor and the others knew what Gu Qian Luo wanted to do.
“That Primal Chaos Flying Ship is too formidable. Even after breaking through, I am unable to stop it.” Bloodshed God-Emperor knew his limits.
Within the Ancestor Mother’s Wooden Mustache War Vessel, the group of Religious Leaders watched the scene with complete despair. They were still slightly muddled when Xue Ying took out his Black Gourd and took care of the first altar. However, desperation started to set in within them when Bloodshed God-Emperor became a Void God. They were still able to create another altar if one was taken away. However, when faced with a Void God… they were doomed.
At this moment, they still had a sliver thread of hope, which was for Gu Qian Luo to save them. Nevertheless, with Gu Qian Luo’s current condition, why would he still care for them?
…
“Master, please bring my clansmen along. All of their treasures will be given to you. Everything single bit to you.” Sang Dan pleaded as he looked towards the giant statue of Gu Qian Luo.
“My injuries are too heavy. I can’t afford to stay here any longer.” Gu Qian Luo coldly said.
This time his injuries were indeed too severe. He could feel waves of tearing pain ripping his soul apart, forcing him to the point of needing to fall asleep. The only thing stopping that was him gritting and clenching his teeth as he endured on. At this moment, he had no luxury to care for those people from the Ancestor Mother Religion. As for their treasures? From what he knew, the treasures were still within their fortress, something that he had no time and luxury to retrieve at this moment. He was afraid, afraid that Bloodshed God-Emperor had the means to deal with his soul. Primal Chaos Flying Ship couldn’t protect him from any soul attack. Before launching all those berserk attacks at Xue Ying, he had no worries about any soul attack. However, at this very moment, his soul had become his greatest biggest weakness…with his injuries being too severe, he would soon fall into deep slumber. If he suffered yet another injury, it might spell the end of him.
For the sake of his life, he couldn’t give the slightest care about the folks from the Ancestor Mother Religion!
“I didn’t get my hands on anything, and my injuries have become even more severe. Cultivator Cosmos… don’t think that this is over.” Just as the Primal Chaos Flying Ship was about to pass through the passage, ‘xiu xiu xiu’, nine rays of light flew out from it. These rays brimmed with incomparable power as they flew off in different directions.
“I’ll let you all have a taste of my nine little toys. If you all are just one bit careless, your cosmos epoch could come to an end,” said Gu Qian Luo, his eyes brimming with madness. Having suffered such a loss, he did not want for the cultivators to leave unscathed.
…
Looking at it, Xue Ying, Bloodshed God-Emperor and the others have no way to stop Primal Chaos Flying Ship, but suddenly nine light rays flew out from the ship and flew to nine different directions.
“What are those?” With Xue Ying’s intimacy towards the void, he could easily see every light ray shooting out. In reality, those nine light rays were nine black spheres, with each sphere containing extremely terrifying power within. Although they weren’t as pure as the Sun Golden Flames, their power was way more violent and chaotic. At the moment, their power appeared unstable and could erupt at any moment.
“That power is more violent than Sun Golden Flames. Once it explodes, the damage to this cosmos would be unthinkable.” Xue Ying thought as his face grew pale.
Bloodshed God-Emperor was even more perceptive than Xue Ying.
Upon reaching the realm of Void God, one would be more perceptive to his/her own cosmos. He faintly felt that if those nine spheres explode, the explosion would be enough to end this cosmos epoch. This made Bloodshed God-Emperor feel a chill and fury surge within his heart towards Gu Qian Luo viciousness.
“Xue Ying, use your Black Gourd golden flames to wrap them up and try your best to weaken their power. If not, our era will be finished.” Bloodshed God-Emperor had no confidence to be able to deal with those nine rays of light. At this time, he could only go all out, proceeding to deploy some arrays in hope to weaken the sphere’s power.
Meanwhile, Pang Yi, Monarch Green, Abyss Primogenitor, Primal Master, Empress Qian He, and the others could only look at the nine light rays. Compared to the two, their senses were weaker.
However, all of them could only feel one thing-fear!
It was fear-an absolute despair that came from the bottom of their heart.
“Will this epoch come to an end?” Xue Ying’s heart trembled after hearing his teacher’s voice. He thought about his wife who still only a stage four World Deity and his own daughter and son who were even weaker than her.
“No!” Xue Ying couldn’t care for his killing intent to Gu Qian Luo as he frantically unplugged the black gourd.

chapters.title: Chapter 772 - The Unconscious Gu Qian Luo
chapters.content:
Chapter 772: The Unconscious Gu Qian Luo
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Bloodshed God-Emperor was extremely anxious. He would absolutely not allow his hometown to be destroyed just like that.
Xue Ying was also close to turning crazy due to the impending end of cosmos epoch, which spelled the doom of his parents, his wife, children, and disciples. He would rather die himself than to let his loved ones die together. If he were the only person left alive in this world, what purpose was there in cultivating and becoming stronger?
“No-” Xue Ying felt extreme fury and madness; his eyes were about to fall out of their sockets.
Primal Master, Pang Yi, Monarch Green, and the others could not obstruct it at all. They could only watch as it happened.
“Hahaha, even if we die, this cosmos epoch will also end together with us.” The Religious Leaders within the Wooden Mustache War Vessel had long lost all hope. On the contrary, seeing that nine rays of light and watching the terrifying destructiveness within the nine lights, caused them to feel somewhat thrilled in madness.
Come on, let there be a great apocalypse. Let everything be destroyed.
…
Within the peaceful Starting Ground, there were red flowers and green willows. The grass was swaying in the wind.
A skinny black wild dog was currently lying on the grass. As the wind blew on its hair, it would occasionally shake its tail.
“Truly useless. You have thrown master’s face.” The wild black dog snorted before disappearing.
…
Xue Ying was currently releasing the golden light from the Black Gourd in madness. Bloodshed God-Emperor was doing his utmost in controlling the arrays. Others were just watching on. Gu Qian Luo was currently flying on his Primal Chaos Flying Ship towards the membrane cracks of the cosmos. He was smirking as he looked behind him.
At this very moment-
An incomparably huge black doghead appeared in the void. It’s frame stretched all the way to the endless distances, and even with the realm of Xue Ying and the rest, they could only vaguely see the black dog head. This enormous black doghead appeared to exist in a different plane from them. Even though it had clearly overlapped with Pang Yi, Monarch Green, the other Rulers and the Wooden Mustache War Vessel of the Ancestor Mother Religion, it did not clash right into them.
The immensely huge black dog head opened its blood-filled mouth showing a chaotic maelstrom present within. Its mouth was truly too big, too big, and one could not see the end of it… just by opening its mouth, it had easily enveloped the nine streams of light flying in different directions. Closely following that, this colossal doghead took a sharp breath, causing the Primal Chaos Flying Ship which had sailed out of the membrane crack of this cosmos to drift back, right towards the chaotic maelstrom located in its mouth.
“Those who offend me will have to pay the price.” In the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, Gu Qian Luo had a cold sneer brimming with killing intent on his face, before quickly turning into a blank look.
A gigantic black wild dog appeared.
It was too big.
Fortunately, the Primal Chaos Flying Ship was able to extend its sense out to an immensely colossal area. Thus, by relying on the Primal Chaos Flying Ship, Gu Qian Luo was able to find out that this was a skinny black wild dog. Its figure was incomparably huge, and just its tail alone had crossed through several dozen starfields, while its body length was about one-third that of the Bloodshed God Palace territory. As it extended its mouth, it enveloped countless of starfields. What’s more, there was even a chaotic maelstrom in its mouth that engulfed all nine streams of light into it.
“Quick, quick quick quick!” Gu Qian Luo was had turned deranged, his soul trembling as he understood that this was the most dangerous situation he had ever entered in his entire life. He was controlling the Primal Chaos Flying Ship without any regard to the agonizing pain his soul was suffering from. He had to escape! The speed of the Primal Chaos Flying Ship rapidly increased to its maximum.
The ship had already charged out of the membrane crack of the cosmos, arriving at the Primal Chaos Void outside.
However, at this moment, the immensely huge black wild dog located within the cosmos shot a cold stare at this tiny black flying ship. With a suck from its enormous mouth! “Hu~” A terrifying swallowing force immediately pulled the Primal Chaos Flying Ship back. This force was so great that the ship immediately whooshed back and flew right into the chaotic maelstrom in the mouth of the wild dog.
“NO-” Seeing the Primal Chaos Flying Ship enter, Gu Qian Luo’s eyes were filled with despair, “How could this be? How!”
After being swallowed by the wild black dog, a terrifying ripple engulfed the entire Primal Chaos Flying Ship, permeating right into the vessel. Gu Qian Luo’s hidden body had also suffered from this fluctuating ripple, causing him to feel his soul trembling before losing all consciousness. Even Religious Leader Sang Dan and Mysterious North Imperial Empress who was in the ship had fallen unconsciousness in an instant.
******
Xue Ying, Bloodshed God-Emperor, Monarch Green, Temporal Island Lord, and the others were stunned by the spectacle unfolding before them.
The Religious Leaders on the Wooden Mustache War Vessel were also stunned.
“Hu.”
The originally boundless black wild dog also rapidly became smaller, transforming into a size just 50 kilometers or so. This wild dog was covered with black hair appeared to be so skinny to the point of being able to make out its bones. Standing in the void, it wagged its tail, before speaking out in human tongue, “Hou~ Truly disgraceful. You have thrown the face of my master! You all should have obviously won, yet you have been scammed by that Gu Qian Luo.”
“Senior.” Bloodshed God-Emperor then took the initiative to speak. At this moment, his forehead was filled with sweat. Where did this horrifying black wild dog pop out from?
According to the information he had, after stepping into the realm of the Void God, it was impossible for him to enter the inner sections of other cosmoses. Ultimately, the cosmos would only protect the beings that were born within it, while restricting entry for other existences who were too strong.
Naturally, if one was so strong that it was exaggerated… like the Voidwalker Gu Qi, he was so powerful that he could match Forefather Tian Yu and could easily destroy an entire cosmos. Thus, it was impossible for even the cosmos to obstruct his entry! Bringing the end of a cosmos epoch… and destroying the cosmos were two entirely different matters.
In the cosmos, many epochs would bring about countless reincarnations. Once its internal environment suffered from destruction and was no longer appropriate for cultivation, the cosmos would naturally undergo great destruction at the end of an epoch. Due to it reforming, it would result in a new environment that was conducive for cultivation. The reincarnations of the epochs… was also part of how a cosmos functioned.
By itself, this cosmos was still stable and powerful!
However, how could this wild black dog, who had utterly dwarfed the new Void God him with his strength, remain within this cosmos?
“Many thanks, senior.” Contrary to Bloodshed God-Emperor, Xue Ying and Temporal Island Lord thanked it with gratitude, both of them recognizing the wild black dog.
“I’ve met senior before. However, never have I thought senior is so formidable.” Temporal Island Lord said.
“Mn.”
The wild black dog responded nonchalantly with a somewhat arrogant stance. It proceeded to turn towards Xue Ying and Bloodshed God-Emperor before speaking out in praise, “Not bad, Bloodshed. This cosmos epoch is still quite early within its lifespan, and yet you have reached the Void God realm. You are currently at the Void God Primal Birth realm… before the end of this cosmos epoch, there’s hope for you to reach the unite as one realm. Haha, currently, Ancestor Devil has reached the Void God unite as one realm. As for the swordmaster, he has already reached an even higher realm.”
“Thank you senior for your praise.” Bloodshed God-Emperor felt even more puzzled. It seemed that this wild black dog was very familiar with all the experts in their current cosmos epoch. What’s more, it seemed to also be very familiar with the Lake Heart Island master and Ancestor Devil.
“Dong Bo.” The wild black dog turned to Xue Ying, glancing towards the Black Gourd in his hand, “Who would have thought that despite being a disciple of my Extreme Void Palace and your short span of cultivation, you have managed to obtain yet another powerful inheritance?”
The Voidwalker Gu Qi’s method was genuinely profound.
The wild black dog was unable to perceive that. As for the Black Gourd… in the past, it did not think that it was formidable, albeit this time, it was able to recognize that this a protective treasure! The existence who could refine this protective treasure and allow Xue Ying to use it at the Opening realm must definitely be an amazing one. Even if he could not defeat Forefather Tian Yu, he should be very close to his level.
“I’m just lucky.” Xue Ying replied. He felt both joy and shock surge within his heart. Previously, he knew that the wild black dog had bitten a piece of flesh from the Lake Heart Island Swordmaster! Upon knowing that, Xue Ying only felt that it was powerful, but not how powerful it was.
This time, Xue Ying was genuinely stunned.
But after thinking about it, he felt that it was reasonable. Lake Heart Island Swordmaster was someone who only had a minor gap with Forefather Tian Yu in the past. Being able to injure the former meant that the power of the wild black dog should be very close to the Swordmaster. It might even be stronger than Ancestor Devil!
“Oh right, there’s still that fool.” The wild black dog opened his mouth and spat out three streams of light, of which one was grabbed by its claw. It was the unconscious Gu Qian Luo. As for the other two rays of light, one was Mysterious North Imperial Empress, with the other being the Religious Leader Sang Dan, both of them unconscious at this moment.
“Wake up.”
The wild black dog grabbed hold of Gu Qian Luo with his claws. It shook him, forcing Gu Qian Luo to abruptly wake up from his stupor. Opening his eyes, he found that a wild black dog was standing in front of him, scaring him so much that his face turned deathly pale.

chapters.title: Chapter 773 - One has to depend on Oneself during Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 773: One has to depend on Oneself during Cultivation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Mercy, senior, please spare my life, please spare my life!” Not a single thought of resisting existed within Gu Qian Luo’s mind as he pleaded. He was begging for his life. Even though he felt horrified, there was hope for him. From how he saw it, if the other party wanted to kill him, he would already have been killed. Leaving him alive until now meant that it was possible for him to continue living. There was also the possibility that the other party knew who his teacher ‘Ancestor Bone’ was.
Ancestor Bone was an existence who had cultivated to the final realm, with his influential power and status both being exceptionally significant. This wild black dog in front of him should likely be wary towards his teacher.
“Mercy?”
The wild black dog grabbed hold of Gu Qian Luo with its claws. Shaking its dog head while looking at him, he barked out “Hou~ You are a fool. I could ignore you if you had sleet for several epochs. It’s even fine if you were to escape from the cosmos after fighting with Bloodshed and the others. However, you actually had the thought of destroying the cosmos created by my master and ending this cosmos epoch? You truly had sought your own death!”
Gu Qian Luo felt horror forming in his heart. However, he soon felt puzzled and could not help but blurt out, “Senior, your master created this cosmos?”
Much less Gu Qian Luo, even the Rulers present like Pang Yi, Temporal Island Lord, Myriad God Palace Head, Abyss Primogenitor, Empress Qian He, and others revealed a look of astonishment upon hearing those words.
Xue Ying secretly sighed after seeing their reactions. It seemed that few knew of the fact that ‘Forefather Tian Yu created this cosmos’. As for himself, he had only heard of it from Voidwalker Gu Qi. Even after entering the Starting Ground, he only knew that the master of the Starting Ground was a mysterious expert. Never did it cross his mind of the possibility that the other party was the creator of this cosmos. Only after succeeding through the Opening realm trial and entering the grass house did he finally see the image of Forefather Tian Yu. During that moment, Forefather Tian Yu had told him that he was the one who created this cosmos.
Therefore, there were very, very few who knew that Forefather Tian Yu created this cosmos!
The wild black dog of the Starting Ground and the white-haired old man both knew about this fact. However, they had never told anyone! The Voidwalker Gu Qi knew of it too, though he only told his inheritor about it. Most likely, Lake Heart Island Swordmaster and other people who passed through the Opening trials knew of this too. However, they would also not easily reveal such secrets to their juniors. It was pointless for the weak to know about this!
“Mn?” Xue Ying looked around him, “My teacher and Primal Master appear to know of this?”
Bloodshed God-Emperor looked at Xue Ying. He transmitted with a chuckle, “Xue Ying, I would never have thought that you are a disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple.” Bloodshed God-Emperor was already privy to the fact that this cosmos was created by Forefather Tian Yu. However, he only knew about the ‘Great Void Heaven Temple’ after he became a Void God when the information was transmitted into his mind from the cosmos. Of which, other than the large amounts of information on the Great Void Heaven Temple, there was also information regarding the fifth sacred worlds and the paths to travel towards ‘Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World’.
“Only after succeeding through the Opening realm trial in the Starting Ground did I become a disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple.” Xue Ying transmitted over.
“Forefather is the ancestor of our cosmos. We naturally are also members of the Great Void Heaven Temple.” Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded.
…
Those on their side felt relaxed.
Contrary to them, Gu Qian Luo horrified beyond belief: ‘Master? How would those at your level be willing to be servants of others? And why would you remain in the cosmos for such an extended period? Isn’t this just like a prison for you?’ He was very clear of the power this wild black dog had. He could definitely become the forefather of a territory in the external world, and only those who cultivated to the final realm would have the qualifications of forcing it to lower its head! Even still, experts had their pride. Few were willing to be servants once they reached this level!
Even if there were some miracle that made those at this level of power willing to become servants, they would usually have harsh demands. It was impossible for them to remain within a single cosmos to protect it forever! How would there be such an expert located in the cosmos since they could not tamper their strength, and sitting here was just like being imprisoned?
There was only a single explanation for this.
‘This wild black dog isn’t a true lifeform. It should be a refined puppet.’ Gu Qian Luo thought. Because it was not a true lifeform, that was why it would listen to the orders of the master.
‘But…’ Thinking to this point, Gu Qian Luo felt all the more frightened.
Existences who had reached the final realm and could refine such terrifying puppets could be counted with one’s fingers! After all, it was not anyone who specialized in refining could do so. As for Forefather Tian Yu… he was an existence who truly reached the final realm with the laws and profound mysteries system, and was also specialized in refinement. As for those on the Ancestor Mother Religion system or the Voidwalker system… they were much weaker in terms of refining!
‘Refining a puppet that is close to the void’s ‘Primal Chaos Realm’ was so much more difficult than trying to create a cosmos. What’s more, it’s master actually refined such a puppet after paying a hefty price before throwing it into this cosmos?’ Gu Qian Luo felt about to go crazy.
After entering this cosmos, it turned out that this cosmos was actually created by someone! Ignoring that fact, there was even a terrifying puppet that was refined and left in this cosmos?
‘How could the existence who created this cosmos be willing to do so?’ Gu Qian Luo could not believe this. If his teacher ‘Ancestor Bone’ could have such a powerful subordinate, he would definitely bring it along with him. Any matters he had would be handled by this subordinate as it was absolutely loyal to him! What’s more, it was adequately powerful to do so.
Yet Forefather Tian Yu actually threw this wild black dog here!
…
“Originally, you did not deserve death. Yet, you’ve sought your own death. Naturally, I must grant you your wish. Bloodshed, Dong Bo, I believe the few of you do not have any complaints on this right? No complaints on the fact that I’ll be eating him up.” The wild black dog looked towards Xue Ying and the other Rulers. Xue Ying, Bloodshed God-Emperor, and the others, them shaking their heads in response.
Of course, they had no complaints! All of them wished for Gu Qian Luo to die.
“Eat me?” Gu Qian Luo was struck off from his train of thoughts after hearing this. He was horrified. Looking at the wild black dog, he hurriedly begged, “Senior, senior, please spare my life, spare this life of mine.”
“Hou hou~” The wild black dog snorted twice in response before deliberately baring its teeth-those snowy white teeth. Upon doing so, it slowly brought Gu Qian Luo towards its mouth with its claws.
Gu Qian Luo grew anxious upon seeing that, “I, I’m the sacred son under the sect of Ancestor Bone! I am the seventh sacred son! You can’t kill me! If you kill me, Ancestor Bone will absolutely not let you off!”
“Ancestor Bone?” The wild black dog stopped momentarily. It pursed its lips, “Do you think my Great Void Heaven Temple will be afraid of him, an old bag of bones? If he has the capabilities, he can fight with my master.”
There was a classification of strength even amongst those who cultivated to the final realm.
Forefather Tian Yu was a very terrifying existence. Ancestor Bone? Forefather Tian Yu did not care about him at all.
“Hmph.” Xue Ying nodded inwardly after hearing this. Forefather Tian Yu in the past did not care about Ancestor Bone at all. Currently, his own Great Void Heaven Temple had two existences-Forefather Tian Yu and Lake Heart Island Swordmaster! With how powerful they were, could a measly Ancestor Bone fight against them? What’s more, Forefather Tian Yu was known for being over-protective. It was precisely due to him being over-protective and too concerned over the future descendant disciples that he decided to not heed the price and refine wild black dog to protect this cosmos!
“You, you…” Gu Qian Luo knew of the reputation of the Great Void Heaven Temple. He could not help but become nervous, “You want to kill me? Why did you not kill me directly in the first place? Why did you capture me alive before killing me?”
“I’ve captured you alive just because I wanted to scold you, before allowing you to die in despair.” The wild black dog barked before baring its mouthful of sharp white teeth.
Gu Qian Luo was stunned.
Capturing him alive was because it wanted to scold him? And then let him feel more terrified? This, this…
“Time to die.” The wild black dog remained slowly swallowing Gu Qian Luo. Gu Qian Luo struggled frantically. However, with the unseen power enveloping him, he could not struggle at all, only being able to watch in despair as that enormous mouth grew closer and closer.
“Hu.”
Gu Qian Luo was directly thrown into its mouth.
The enormous wild black dog bit him. Two sounds of ‘ka cha’ rang out before it swallowed him down its stomach. It proceeding to turn its head towards Bloodshed God-Emperor, Xue Ying, and the other Rulers, who were slightly speechless at this moment. This senior wild black dog was quite ‘vivacious’ for he deliberately reprimanding the enemy before eliminating him after that.
“Why are all of you looking at me like that?” The wild black dog opened its eyes, “Could it be you all are thinking of getting that Primal Chaos Flying Ship?”
The eyes of Bloodshed God-Emperor, Xue Ying, Pang Yi, Monarch Green, and others lit up upon hearing that.
With how powerful the wild black dog was, it had no use for Primal Chaos Flying Ship. However, it was an entirely different case to them.
“Don’t even think about it!” The wild black dog sneered, “Master has mentioned that the path of cultivation depends on oneself! There is no such thing as benefits without effort. This Gu Qian Luo is killed by me, and therefore his Primal Chaos Flying Ship is mine for the taking. Naturally, it belongs to me!”
Xue Ying and the others were speechless.
You are so powerful. What’s the use of a Primal Chaos Flying Ship to you?
“The flying ship naturally belongs to senior.” Bloodshed God-Emperor laughed, “We have never thought of that before. Our cosmos is even protected by Senior. Knowing that, we would not have been so mad about fighting this war any longer.”
“Hmph hmph, if not for Gu Qian Luo wanting to destroy this cosmos epoch, I would not have taken any action at all.” The wild black dog snorted, “Master has said that cultivation depends on oneself! The war with the Ancestor Mother Religion is also a tempering for you all. If you die, it means you aren’t strong enough. Only when the Ancestor Mother Religion was about to construct the altars to transform the entire cosmos, would I take action.”
“Hmph hmph, the Ancestor Mother is tyrannical indeed. Fortunately, my mater left behind a backing. Wanting to transform the cosmos created by Master into their Ancestor Mother Religion cosmos? Dream on!” The wild black dog sneered.
In reality, existences who had reached the final realm in cultivation would not leave behind such a terrifying existence that was worth ten times more than a cosmos.
“Cultivate properly.” The wild black dog swept its gaze across Bloodshed God-Emperor and Xue Ying, “This cosmos might be protected. However, it’s so much more dangerous outside. Oh, that’s right, do you need my help to settle that warship of Ancestor Mother Religion?” The wild black dog turned towards the Wooden Mustache War Vessel, a sliver of radiance flashing across its eyes. It loved collecting things the most!
“No need, no need.” Bloodshed God-Emperor profusely declined, “We’ll spend a little more time to settle it.”
“Oh.”
The wild black dog gave a reply before turning around. Taking a step forward, it disappeared into thin air.
Only then did Bloodshed God-Emperor let out a sigh of relief. He still wanted to get the treasures which the Ancestor Mother Religion had. If the wild black dog acted, all treasures would be snatched away by it.
“Bloodshed, what about that Religious Leader?” Abyss Primogenitor pointed to the floating Religious Leader Sang Dan who was unconscious.
“Eliminate him.” Bloodshed God-Emperor nonchalantly replied, turning his gaze towards the distant Wooden Mustache War Vessel.
“Fellow Rulers, I only have a single body at this moment, so I’ll have to trouble you all to bring our people out from the Lake Heart Island historical remain.” Bloodshed God-Emperor chuckled, “The war has ended.”
“Mn.” grins appeared on the faces of Xue Ying and the rest. That’s right, it was time to bring the rest out.
“However, despite experiencing all these, seeing senior take action proved that we are still weak.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said, “After the war, we should properly cultivate. I believe our cosmos epoch will not be any weaker than the third cosmos epoch.”
Monarch Green, Purgatory Ruler, Pang Yi, Primal Master, Temporal Island Lord, and the others were filled with fighting spirit upon hearing those words. They felt the pressure from Xue Ying’s power and the breakthrough of Bloodshed God-Emperor, the danger of the cosmos epoch undergoing destruction as well as how powerful the wild black dog was. All the pressure was giving them the desire to become stronger.

chapters.title: Chapter 774 - Death of Forefather Black Devil
chapters.content:
Chapter 774: Death of Forefather Black Devil
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The true bodies of Pang Yi, Monarch Green, Purgatory Ruler, Temporal Island Lord, Abyss Primogenitor, Empress Qian He, Myriad God Palace Head and Primal Master were deep within Lake Heart Island. With a chuckle, Pang Yi brought up the Eden treasure, and said, “Fellow people, time for us to leave.”
“Wait a moment, Brother Pang Yi.” A voice sounded. The white-robed Xue Ying appeared. As a member of the Destruction Legion, he could directly teleport in from the outer world.
“Dong Bo?”
“Bringing the people out is a small matter, why did you rush over?”
The Rulers said this with a smile. In the cultivator world, respect was given to experts. Xue Ying naturally commanded respect by his terrifying power. The others had a faint understanding that with his fast cultivation speed, Xue Ying was likely the one with the greatest chance of becoming a Void God after Bloodshed God-Emperor.
“There’s a minor matter which I must trouble you with. Could you please release Forefather Black Devil from within the Eden treasure?” Xue Ying requested. Turning to Temporal Island Lord, Xue Ying added “Temporal Island Lord, I still hope to seek your understanding in this. The vengeance of my teacher cannot be left unattended.”
Temporal Island Lord frowned. His expression soured.
Temporal Island Lord was infuriated. Forefather Black Devil had depended on him no matter what. Now that Xue Ying had clearly decided to kill Forefather Black Devil in the open, he was using the reason of ‘resolving vengeance for his teacher’. But he understood too…that it depended ultimately on Bloodshed God-Emperor because the Eden treasure belonged to Bloodshed God-Emperor, and Temporal Island Lord had no say in the matter.
“Hmph.” Temporal Island Lord snorted coldly, “You are a Ruler. Killing a powerful existence is bullying the juniors, isn’t it?”
“I said before that this vengeance which my teacher has must be resolved!” Xue Ying’s voice turned cold too.
He took the initiative to mention this matter. That was giving the other party enough respect.
Could Temporal Island Lord even hinder him if he wanted to kill Forefather Black Devil?
“Hmph hmph.” Temporal Island Lord coldly chuckled, “Ruler Dong Bo’s combat power is higher than I. Within the region of the Lake Heart Island historical remain, you and Pang Yi do not suffer from any obstructions and I can’t protect him at all. But the question is, can you kill him?”
“He has another avatar outside this cosmos?” Xue Ying sneered.
He had long discovered that.
Using karma, he discovered that Forefather Black Devil had just a single body within this cosmos. He could not find any other body of his at all. Either he was hiding in a location similar to the Starting Ground, or that he had left for another cosmos! Oh, there was another possibility-he had no avatar. But that would be a real joke since Forefather Black Devil was only thinking about surviving. If he did not refine one, then it would be death all the same if Xue Ying killed his true body.
“Right, his other avatar is indeed in another cosmos and hasn’t returned at all.” Temporal Island Lord sneered, “Is Ruler Dong Bo still confident of killing him?”
Pang Yi chuckled by the side. With a thought, Forefather Black Devil appeared.
Because Xue Ying had been relying on the laws of domain to forcibly isolate all karmic voice transmissions and communication techniques. Within this domain of his… everything he determined would be the law! Unless other Rulers also used their law domain to resist, nevertheless, everyone understood the request of Xue Ying and they had no reason to go against him at this moment. Temporal Island Lord did not have the chance to remind Forefather Black Devil either.
“Temporal Island.” Forefather Black Devil saw Temporal Island Lord. He then turned towards the group of Rulers and then turned to the white-robed Xue Ying. That caused his heart to jolt. However, since he left an avatar in another cosmos, he could still maintain his calm.
“Forefather Black Devil.” Xue Ying opened his mouth.
The voice fluttered fleetingly in the surroundings. Forefather Black Devil could only see the world in front of him ‘distorting’.
The surrounding Rulers discovered that the eyes of Forefather Black Devil had fallen into a daze. At that moment, they understood Forefather Black Devil had been struck.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying.” Closely following that, it seemed as though Forefather Black Devil had regained his consciousness. He pointed to the void by the side and roared, “You want to kill me? What a pity. My luck is good. I have another avatar which is located outside this cosmos, so you can’t kill me at all. As for this body… haha, so what if you kill me?”
“Hahaha…”
“Hong!”
Following a loud laughter, Forefather Black Devil abruptly exploded.
“Admirable.” Purgatory Ruler said, “You are actually able to force Black Devil to commit suicide despite being separated by a cosmos.”
“Black Devil’s avatar suicided first before this true body of his did so.” Primal Master said with praise, “It is indeed amazing.”
At this point, the expression of Temporal Island Lord turned even uglier.
“It is merely just an illusory realm.” Xue Ying explained.
His Dao of Mirage had reached the Ruler realm. In terms of controlling the illusory realm, he was indisputably the first in the Cultivator Cosmos. Just a mere ordinary powerful existence… with a single move, Xue Ying had caused him to fall into an illusory realm. His true body and avatar were both connected via memories. Hence, both bodies had entered the illusory realm. Xue Ying could then easily guide both the avatar and true body of Forefather Black Devil to suicide one after another. After his avatar suicided, the soul of the true body would become unique, which Primal Master found out using some secret technique. That was how he determined that the avatar suicided first before the true body did so.
“Let’s go. Let us exit.” Temporal Island Lord coldly said.
“Go.”
Pang Yi nodded.
“Hu.”
He then brought everyone with a teleport out of the Lake Heart Island historical remain. Reaching the starry sky in the outer world, Pang Yi began teleporting out large amounts of cultivators from within the Eden treasure. The Paragons, the powerful existences many World Deities and talented youngsters-practically all the strongest geniuses from the Cultivator Cosmos were teleported out.
“Proceed with moving according to the previous plan.” Pang Yi said.
“Yes.” The Paragons and powerful existences all acknowledged. The few hundred experts were responsible for moving the others back, albeit they could not help but turn towards Xue Ying. They were able to sense that…’Monarch Dong Bo’ who was once the three ancestors of Bloodshed God Palace was currently standing with the Rulers. The unseen aura he emanated was not any weaker than the Rulers. This scene startled them slightly.
They did not dare believe that Xue Ying who cultivated for such a short period would have become a Ruler. They could not help but let their minds run wild at what appeared in front of them.
“Monarch Dong Bo has genuinely become a Ruler. If not for Monarch Dong Bo, the war with the Ancestor Mother Religion will not end so quickly.” Pang Yi added.
Monarch Green, Primal Master and the rest nodded.
Silence fell for a moment.
The many powerful existences present, the World Deities of the entire Cultivator Cosmos, and the large batches of young brats had heard it clearly… the legendary Monarch, Dong Bo, had become a Ruler! This startled them; it felt like a miracle!
…
The war had ended. Everyone began moving back to the various locations. The entire Cultivator Cosmos also regained its usual peace. Powerful existences at the apex level also found out that other than Monarch Dong Bo who had become a Ruler, the publicly-acknowledged strongest existence in the Deity world and Abyss, ‘Bloodshed God-Emperor’ had reached a higher realm. Many powerful existences were exclaiming in admiration about this.
When Disciple Brother Hui Ming and Forefather Scarlet Flame found out that Forefather Black Devil had died, they felt all knots in their hearts loosening. Compared to Xue Ying, the two had deeper relations with Sacred Master Crimson Dust.
Xue Ying’s relationship with Sacred Master Crimson Dust was indeed very shallow. While killing Forefather Black Devil was partly to repay the Sacred Master’s kindness, on the other hand, Xue Ying had wanted to kill of his own accord, as Forefather Black Devil had done many evil deeds.
‘I’ve become a Ruler. In the past, I’ve thought of doing many things, and it is time for me to do so now.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘But the retaliation by Temporal Island Lord will be very strong.’

chapters.title: Chapter 775 - This Day has finally arrived
chapters.content:
Chapter 775: This Day has finally arrived
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Master.” A muffled voice sounded.
Temporal Island Lord, seated upon a silvery-white grass mat, opened his eyes. He knew the voice was that of the Temporal Temple treasure spirit which was reporting to him.
“What’s the matter?” Temporal Island Lord asked.
“Several little fellows that were under my control have been taken by Monarch Dong Bo.”, the treasure spirit said with its muffled voice. “He has also removed the imprints I left on them. They are the people that Monarch Dong Bo knew when he was a Transcendent - Jian Huang, Meishan Clan Master, and others.”
“Hmph.” Temporal Island Lord snorted coldly. “Let him bring them away then. There are millions and millions of Reincarnators, losing those few don’t matter much.”
“Alright.” The muffled voice obediently answered.
“Go.” Temporal Island Lord was tired of this conversation.
“This Dong Bo Xue Ying seems to be someone who places great emphasis on relationships.” Temporal Island Lord’s eyes were filled with frost, but a faint figure came into form deep in his heart. It was far, and blurry, but that figure was also the most important person in his life. However, it had become an illusion now. All of it had turned into a joke, no more, no less.
Temporal Island Lord sneered, and muttered to himself, “I’ve previously gotten intelligence saying that he had reincarnated a batch of little fellows from the River of Time - someone named Tong San, a Cheng Ling Shu, and other weaker little juniors. Those should be the people of the Xia Clan world. Who would have thought that he would even save the Reincarnators who had adventured on Crimson Rock Mountain with him before? He is truly tender! It’s a wonder that he became a Ruler in such a short period despite how tender he is!”
As disdainful as he was of the situation, he could do nothing but accept it.
Xue Ying’s power was considered amongst the top of Rulers. Only Monarch Green and Purgatory Ruler could fight with him. If he were to use that Black Gourd… unless Bloodshed God-Emperor acted, he would be invincible! In terms of power, he could entirely suppress the Temporal Island Lord! Thus, Temporal Island Lord could only endure!
Furthermore, the situation was no longer the same. Bloodshed God-Emperor had become a Void God, towering over everyone! None dared to offend him, because when this cosmos reincarnation ended, they needed Bloodshed God-Emperor to bring them all away.
Bloodshed God-Emperor was even also the teacher of Xue Ying!
The Rulers would definitely befriend Xue Ying regardless of his strength or potential for the sake of their future! Thus, as peeved as he was, Temporal Island Lord could only endure for now.
******
With the power he had, he could accomplish anything that he wanted to! Xue Ying had reincarnated a large group of people as easily as lifting his hands. However, this was no light matter for the people who were reincarnated. The moment Meishan Clan Master met with his true love, his face was trickling with tears, while Jian Huang was guffawing so madly that tears had formed in his eyes…
“Teacher.”
Xue Ying arrived at the old base of the Ancestor Mother Religion amidst the starry sky. The spherical castle was currently enveloped by many complex arrays, all of them under the control of Bloodshed God-Emperor, who was standing at a distance as he continued to ponder and comprehend about them. As for the Wooden Mustache War Vessel, it had long been invaded, with all of the Religious Leaders within being annihilated by Bloodshed God-Emperor.
“You’re here, Xue Ying.” chuckled Bloodshed God-Emperor as he looked at his disciple. He then turned towards the ancient spherical castle, and sighed, “This base of the Ancestor Mother Religion contains just two Religious Leaders, and have been tortured to death by me using some secret techniques. Currently, nobody is living in the castle, yet I can’t open it or refine it at all. Xue Ying, do you have any methods?”
Xue Ying sighed inwardly. His teacher had indeed become a Void God. He could actually kill the two Religious Leaders despite being located inside the base of the Ancestor Mother Religion.
“When it comes to arrays or treasures, there is too large a gap between me and you, teacher. Thus, there is little need for Teacher to ask me about this.” Xue Ying answered.
Bloodshed God-Emperor chuckled. Xue Ying was right too. His disciple might be talented, but research on the myriad existences ultimately required one to spend a significant amount of time and effort, with excellent comprehension ability before one could achieve large success. Without sufficient time, it was impossible for one to attain great accomplishments.
“Did you come here just to see me?” Bloodshed God-Emperor chuckled, “Tell me, what’s the matter?”
With his current realm, he was absolutely unparalleled in the cosmos. Currently, he only sought to walk further in his cultivation! Those of the same clan like ‘Ancestor Devil’ and ‘Lake Heart Island Swordmaster’ had all walked ahead.
“There is indeed a matter.” Xue Ying solemnly said, “Teacher, the Temporal Temple has taken root in the Deity world, the Abyss, and even the material realm. It is a malignant tumor to the entire cosmos, for it could forcibly bring grade three True Meaning Transcendents away, controlling their souls, before forcing them to undergo many life-death missions…forcing them to temper themselves between life and death. Many batches of them have died. Only grade two True Meaning Transcendents have the power to decline it; however, how difficult would it be for a grade two True Meaning Transcendent to emerge in a mortal world? One could say that in the countless mortal worlds, the Temporal Temple can grab whoever they wanted, causing millions and millions of lives to be tortured and die. Even if a few became Deities, they are still under their control!”
“The moment they are snatched away, it is too difficult for them to regain their freedom.”
Xue Ying looked at Bloodshed God-Emperor, “Thus, the Temporal Temple should not exist! Even if it remains, it cannot so wantonly take away countless lives within the cosmos.”
Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded after hearing that, “What you said makes sense. I agree with you. You came looking for me because you wanted me to step forward personally?”
“Yes. Temporal Island Lord controls the time-space. It is unlikely for him to lower his head if I were to mention this matter. If it were Teacher, then things will be different.” Xue Ying replied.
Bloodshed God-Emperor lightly nodded, “Some time ago, I, Primal Master, and others were against this as well, but we could not deal with Temporal Island Lord then. We could only negotiate with him to set down several rules to maintain the balance of the cosmos.”
“But now, it is time for things to change.” Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded, “How about this: from now on, the Temporal Temple can only bring away those who have already died! Resculpting their fleshy bodies again before sending them to start on another life journey.”
“Alright.” Xue Ying’s eyes brightened.
By right, dying was the end of one’s life journey,
Giving them a chance for a new journey might be a good thing for them.
“This matter will be as such then.” Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded. With his current status, he could force Temporal Island Lord to obediently listen to him just by speaking. If the other party disagreed with him? He would simply eliminate the Temporal Temple!
“Teacher, I have always wanted to ask you, why did you construct the Bloodshed Tavern in the past?” Xue Ying asked.
Bloodshed God-Emperor raised his eyebrow, and chuckled, “You brat, firstly, I have constructed many Bloodshed Taverns across the Deity world, Abyss, and material realm because it is impossible for assassins to be put to an end. Since that’s the case, I might as well give the assassin profession some rules. Secondly, the primary reason why I created the Bloodshed Tavern is that as the many assassins across the cosmos carry out their killings, I will have part of this karma too… I would let this endless karma inflict on my body day and night - slaughter, blood, vengeance… everything was meant to temper my heart realm and allow me to reach a deeper comprehension in the ‘Dao of Destruction’ and ‘Dao of Bloodshed’.”
Xue Ying was stunned.
For the sake of cultivation?
Letting endless karma inflict on his body day and night, allowing countless blood and howls to surround himself for eternity? Living like that would be akin to torture!
“Carry on.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said.
…
Since the mention came from Bloodshed God-Emperor, Temporal Island Lord could only acknowledge his words obediently. The Temporal Temple could now only bring in souls of those who had died. The many Reincarnators who had once been forcibly kidnapped would be given the opportunity - to decide if they wanted their freedom! Those who chose to remain a Reincarnator would be greatly rewarded.
Time passed by.
Due to the emergence of a Void God, with an unparalleled existence protecting the entire cosmos, the cosmos became more peaceful. Everyone knew that they could leave when this cosmos epoch ended, resulting in the absence of anxiety and urgency. The Rulers had also formed a closer relationship with one another.
Over the years, Xue Ying brought an avatar of ‘Little Chong Seven’ out and allowed him to cultivate and temper himself in a broader world.
As for his wife Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao, his disciple Mo Chong Yun, his disciple Jia Yun and Chi Qiu Bai, he had sent them to the ‘Devil Mountain Cosmos’. However, they only stayed there for less than a million years. The person who stayed there the longest was Mo Chong Yun who stayed for a total of 980,000 years. Naturally… a million years in the Cultivator Cosmos was more than three billion years in the Devil Mountain Cosmos.
With Xue Ying’s good friend ‘Third Highness’ Jiao Yun Liu’s help, Jing Qiu and the others had gotten the best environment for cultivation, allowing them to study other systems and be guided by the experts of other systems within the Devil Mountain Cosmos.
His daughter, ‘Qing Yao’, finally broke through to become a powerful existence after a total of 900 million years or so!
The other one was his eldest disciple, Mo Chong Yun, who took a total of 300 million years or so to breakthrough to Powerful Existence.
As for the others, they were still stuck in the stage four World Deity realm. Jing Qiu had started cultivating in another Dao path of ‘Hex’. However, she unable to breakthrough for the time being.
…
Within the Black Fog, in Monarch Dong Bo Residence.
The white-robed Xue Ying was watching the starry sky by himself before a figure appeared by the side-she was Jing Qiu.
“Xue Ying.” Jing Qiu said with a soft tone, “They can’t hold much longer.”
Xue Ying felt his body trembling.
He had tried all methods to help his father, mother, little brother, Uncle Zong and Uncle Tong, to reach the Deity realm. However, there was a limit to the lifespan of Deities. Most would only live for about 100 million years or so. His parents had virtually reached the end of their lifespans a little while ago; however, they had relied on the Eden treasure to control the time flow, waiting for Uncle Zong, Uncle Tong, and his little brother Qing Shi. This was due to them wanting to leave together. At this moment, their moods were quite good, all of them feeling satisfied with their lives.
“Father, mother, Uncle Zong, Uncle Tong, Little Shi…” Xue Ying felt his heart trembling. These few people were the most important things within his heart. However, all of them were about to leave him. This was a parting for eternity! Xue Ying felt his heart growing empty.
This was a day which Xue Ying had feared for a long time.
However, it still came inevitably!
He once thought that he could accept things calmly. However, when the moment arrived, he discovered that he could barely accept it! It felt as if his life was being severed! His heart was being cut! Pain. Agonizing pain.
“Go, let us go over.” Xue Ying said.

chapters.title: Chapter 776 - Dissipate
chapters.content:
Chapter 776: Dissipate
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Monarch Dong Bo residence occupied an extensive area. Dong Bo Lie, Mo Yang Yu, Qing Shi, Zong Ling, Tong San and the rest were currently living here. After all, they had already become Deities for more than 10,000 years and could no longer return to the Xia Clan world. There was a small region demarcated in the Monarch residence for them to live in next to each other.
“Hu hu”, Xue Ying and Jing Qiu came out from the void. They arrived at where his parents were.
“Brother, sister-in-law, we are just waiting for you all.” Qing Shi stood at the entrance waiting. His eyes brightened after seeing the arrival of them and shouted out.
“Qing Shi.” Xue Ying chuckled.
Both he and his little brother had already lived for far too long. Nevertheless, the memories he had when they were still children were etched in the mind of Xue Ying. That spoilt little child who always let his saliva dribble down from his mouth while lying in his embrace in a deep sleep. When they were in their adolescence, memories of how both he and his little brother relied on each other for survival were remembered clearly, and he could never forget those memories.
“Go.” Xue Ying walked over and embraced his little brother, “Today, you must accompany me and drink to our fill.”
“Definitely.” Qing Shi laughed. He was laughing exceptionally bright.
Both brothers walked shoulder by shoulder into the house. Jing Qiu followed closely behind. She smiled at seeing this scene because she understood what this day meant for her husband.
There were no other servants around!
If the servants were to see a Ruler walking shoulder to shoulder with another person, they would likely be shocked.
…
Within the house.
The muscular lion-headed man, ‘Uncle Tong San’, the six-armed snake man with a snake tail, ‘Zong Ling’, a violet-robed Mo Yang Yu who was as beautiful as ever were chatting together with Dong Bo Lie who was guffawing greatly. They were exceptionally delightful as they talked to each other. After a moment, they felt something in their senses, causing them to turn out and see as Xue Ying and Qing Shi walked in together.
“Haha, Xue Ying is here.” Uncle Tong laughed. His voice was loud.
“We are waiting for you now.” Zong Ling was chuckling too.
“Come come come, we can fit in more people.” Dong Bo Lie beckoned them over. Mo Yang Yu went over to bring more chairs.
Xue Ying gave the place a glance. The arrangement of the furniture within the house was similar to that in the Snowrock Castle. That dining table was a long table, and the group of people was seated around it. Over time as Xue Ying became stronger and stronger, he had no longer ate and drank while surrounding a table.
“Everyone, let’s get seated.” Dong Bo Lie shouted out.
“Xue Ying, Jing Qiu, the two of you should sit here.” Mo Yang Yu also arranged for where they would sit.
Very soon, the group of people was seated.
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu were next to each other. To his left, they were Uncle Zong and Uncle Tong. In front of Uncle Zong and Uncle Tong were Dong Bo Lie and Mo Yang Yu.
Opposite of Xue Ying was his little brother Qing Shi.
Nobody was seated in the head position!
According to the previous tradition, it was usually his father Dong Bo Lie who would sit at the head position. However, this time, his father wanted to sit together with his mother, leaning against each other!
“Today, everything you eat on this table is made by me and Ah Yu (Mo Yang Yu). Let us have a toast first.” Dong Bo Lie chuckled and raised his cup.
“It has been a really long time since I last ate food made by father and mother.” Xue Ying raised his cup too.
All of them toasted and drank.
After Zong Ling finished drinking, he placed the cup down and sighed, “Drinking here reminds me of Snowrock Castle. That time, Tong San and I accompanied Xue Ying and Qing Shi. Qing Shi was still young and only knew how to act willfully. At that time, Xue Ying had been training in spear techniques day in and day out… and every time after he finished his training, he would bathe in a medicinal pool.”
“What do you mean that I only know how to act willfully?” Qing Shi muttered.
“Isn’t that the case?” Tong San pursed his lips from the side, “Your brother has been tiring himself, yet at night when you were going to sleep, you had to have your brother accompany you. Fortunately, Xue Ying’s temper is good. If it were us from the lion man race, we would just throw you to one side.”
Qing Shi himself laughed too.
“I truly did not dare to think about it. That time, I felt that it was amazing for Xue Ying to become a Transcendent, yet who would have thought that things would far transcend my imaginations.” Zong Ling added, “That time, the Sorcerer God and Great Demonic God descended into our Xia Clan World, causing us to lose our lives. But now, Xue Ying is currently one of the peak existences in the entire Deity world and Abyss, becoming one of the Rulers.”
The others nodded.
Prior to their deaths, they could not help but recall this life of theirs. In the past, they thought they were dazzling existences, but now, it seemed they were not worth a mention. The Great Demonic God had long been eliminated. Even the material realm territory lord ‘Sorcerer God’ had cultivated to become a stage two World Deity. After Xue Ying became a Ruler, he had easily killed him via karma!
“If we say that cultivation is difficult, then it is indeed difficult.” Dong Bo Lie said, “That time when Xue Ying guided me into the Crimson Rock Mountain World, only after I obtained the best guidance did I finally become a Transcendent. After that, I underwent plenty of rebirths with many of treasures being used on myself before I could barely step into the boundary of Deities. Ever since then… I have no hopes of becoming a World Deity anymore. Cultivating is truly difficult.”
“If not for Xue Ying, you can’t even become a Transcendent.” Mo Yang Yu added, “In the Crimson Rock Mountain world, you have even shouted your son for help when you fell into despair. Thinking about it, it is truly such a disgrace.”
“What disgrace is that? Am I wrong to shout for Xue Ying’s help when I am in despair?” Dong Bo Lie glared back.
“Come come come, Xue Ying, let us drink.” Uncle Tong San had instead brought up the wine flask and drank with Xue Ying. He shook his lion head in delight, “You were able to make me live again for more than 100 million years. Haha, just by saving me alone, I have actually created the entire lion man race!”
Xue Ying chuckled too, “It is indeed you, Uncle Tong, who is formidable for you to have so many children and grandchildren.”
The lion man race had excellent fertility rates. Because of Tong San alone… the entire lion man race had become stronger! It was a huge race and had spanned across several planets in the Deity world.
…
Everyone was chatting. Xue Ying and Jing Qiu were instead listening and occasionally spoke a few sentences.
They ate for a long time on this table. Xue Ying had also drunk quite a lot of wine. There were many huge wine jars placed on the floor by the side of the table.
“It has been a long time since I drank to my delight. Furthermore, it is drinking with my good brothers, with my good sister, Xue Ying, Qing Shi and Jing Qiu.” Zong Ling’s face was brimming red as he laughed out, “This life of I, Zong Ling, is fulfilling. Very fulfilling! Old brother… I can’t hold on any longer. I’ll be the first to leave now.” Accompanying his laughter, Zong Ling’s body began dissipating. Every Deity energy on his body began crumbling apart. “Hua~” He then disappeared altogether.
“Wait for me.” Tong San shouted out too.
“It is time for us to leave.” Mo Yang Yu placed down her wine cup too.
“Ah Yu.” Dong Bo Lie looked towards his wife by his side, “I am very fortunate to have you accompany me in my life.”
“Me too.” Mo Yang Yu giggled. Her eyes were filled with love.
Qing Shi sat there laughing too, “Father, mother, Uncle Tong, let us leave together. The road will also be a fun and crowded one. Big brother, we will leave first. Don’t be so sad. We are all genuinely happy.”
“Hua hua hua~”
Tong San’s intoxicated body began dissipating. Dong Bo Lie and Mo Yang Yu were holding each other’s hands. They were looking at each other. Qing Shi was also smiling at Xue Ying.
They could no longer suppress the collapse of their soul any longer. Every single part of their Deity energy was crumbling apart, and soon, they dissipated amidst the void.
Xue Ying watched silently while holding on to his wine cup…
Little stone head…
Father, mother…
Uncle Zong, Uncle Tong…
They were leaving! They were truly leaving!
Xue Ying could feel tears glistening in his eyes. He sat there silently without saying anything.
The originally crowded house became exceptionally quiet. The long table which was surrounded by a crowd of people only had two left at this moment-Xue Ying and Jing Qiu. They sat side by side.
Jing Qiu wanted to say something, yet she did not. She only sat silently by the side to accompany Xue Ying.
It was quiet.
Xue Ying sat there quietly for a very long time. He did not know what he was thinking. It felt as if his mind became blank.
Suddenly, a wave of pain engulfed his entire body and his soul. This made Xue Ying feel aching in his heart. But as he experienced this, a hand by the side grabbed his hands tightly. Xue Ying turned around, seeing his wife Jing Qiu looking at him with concern.
“You still have us.” Jing Qiu looked at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 777 - Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 777: Decision
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying held on to his wife’s hand. That’s right. He still had them.
But his wife had spent a very long time cultivating in her previous life. And in this, she had already cultivated for over two billion years in the Devil Mountain Cosmos, yet she could not break through the bottleneck of stage four World Deity! If she could not break through, her soul would dissipate, and she would die eventually.
…
In the following period, Xue Ying’s black-robed avatar remained in the Starting Ground for cultivation. His true body was thinking of ways to help his wife and children. Some of the rarer cultivation books and mystical treasures of the cosmos and even deliberate arrangements were done for his wife and children as they visited several historical remains.
Time passed
It had been one billion years since Xue Ying became a Ruler. In the Cultivator Cosmos, Xue Ying had grown in stature. The current Cosmos Deity-Demon List, released by Primal Master, had Bloodshed God-Emperor ranked as the first and Monarch Dong Bo as the second. The third was Purgatory Ruler, and the fourth was Monarch Green…
“Hahaha, Xue Ying, don’t dream of hurting me with just this move.” On a great land amidst the starry sky, two figures were facing each other.
One was the crimson-robed Bloodshed God-Emperor, and the other was the white-robed Xue Ying.
Bloodshed God-Emperor personally refined this land for his cultivation. Currently, in the entire cosmos, only Xue Ying was able to spar with him. Even if it were a spar, the two would control their strength. Instead, they only utilized the laws and profound mysteries, competing with each other in some moves. They dared not release their full strength.
He had long cultivated the “Walker’s Hidden Secret” to the 20th level. With such strength, Xue Ying did not dare to display it wantonly in the cosmos.
The Bloodshed God-Emperor was even more outstanding. After many years of stepping into the Void God realm, his combat power had become deeper and unfathomable.
“Teacher, don’t be so complacent. I wonder who was the one who got trampled on the previous time.” Xue Ying teased. The two of them were purely sparring and competing on their skillsets. Xue Ying had the three Primal Chaos ranked absolute arts, “Shadowless Heaven’s Gathering”, “3000 Incarnations” and “God Light Scripture”. In addition to the large amounts of precious books which he had once read on the Primogenitor Devil Mountain, Xue Ying’s combative techniques were becoming more mystical and formidable. The previous time, he had relied on his illusory realm and the “3000 Incarnations” to win a bout over Bloodshed God-Emperor!
Naturally, the Bloodshed God-Emperor was forbidden from using all arrays! He was only able to use laws and profound mysteries. That was why he lost the bout.
Bloodshed God-Emperor reacted calmly, “That was just a mere carelessness.”
“Then you should prepare to receive another move from this disciple then.” Xue Ying said, “This is the newly created move from the eighth volume of “Wind Ripple Path” .”
“Oh?” Bloodshed God-Emperor’s eyes lit up.
“Receive it.”
Xue Ying’s body suddenly turned faint. It went through a strange arc before appearing right in front of Bloodshed God-Emperor. There were no other undulations formed. The surrounding wind remained blowing, and the grass and plants remained as per usual. Xue Ying had instead soared at such terrific speed that shocked Bloodshed God-Emperor into preparing a counter-blow, but Xue Ying’s figure had already disappeared yet again.
‘Such speed.’ Bloodshed God-Emperor was inwardly shocked after seeing this. His law domain was extremely huge, and he could easily deduce that Xue Ying did not rely on any strength or speed from his body. Instead, he relied on the laws and profound mysteries to attain such speed.
Suddenly, another Xue Ying appeared in the distance.
Closely following that, another Xue Ying appeared by the rear of Bloodshed God-Emperor. There were a total of three figures at this moment!
They flashed and surrounded Bloodshed God-Emperor at the same time. Each of them had a spear in his hand. The spear moved in a similar manner with his body-it seemed like a simple jab, yet it left behind a strange arc before arriving right in front of Bloodshed God-Emperor.
“Dang dang dang.” Bloodshed God-Emperor used both his hands to parry against the attacks, ‘How did this brat reach such a fast speed? I could almost not parry against his attacks. Initially, I wanted to use my newly comprehended move to startle him, yet it was forced out by him first.’
“Hong~”
Many blood sword edges suddenly flew out from the figure of Bloodshed God-Emperor. They devastated his surroundings. Xue Ying was so frightened by this that he hurriedly retreated.
One could see many blood edges moving about Bloodshed God-Emperor in all directions. It formed a huge sphere and was something that resembled the nature. It gave off a feeling like the operating laws of the Sun Star, astonishing Xue Ying.
“How is it?” Bloodshed God-Emperor chuckled.
“Previously, Teacher did not use this move!” Xue Ying was genuinely startled.
“Previously, I have just reached the Void Origin Birth realm in my Dao of Bloodshed. I have yet to consolidate it. After cultivating for a period, things aren’t naturally the same anymore.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said. He had some lingering fear. By not using the arrays of Void God energy or his bodily strength… when competing on the laws and profound mysteries, he had almost lost to this disciple of his. Xue Ying was indeed incredible.
Xue Ying was lamenting inwardly. Void God was still a Void God. When he did not rely on the “Walker’s Hidden Secret”, it was almost impossible to defeat them! He had three Primal Chaos ranked absolute arts, and naturally, he was able to wield power beyond ordinary Rulers. But it was futile.
Still, he was quite curious about how much pressure he could place on his teacher if he were to use his entire strength. His strongest technique was still the Walker’s Hidden Secret currently. But his teacher was strongest in the ‘hex’ system, and the moment he unleashed his Void God energy, he would be even stronger.
“Teacher.” Xue Ying stated, “There is a matter which I have to request Teacher to do.”
“Haha, currently, other than me, there is nobody who is your opponent. What matter is it that requires my help?” Bloodshed God-Emperor laughed, “Say it.”
“I hope for Teacher to help protect my loved ones.” Xue Ying said.
“For me to protect your loved ones?” Bloodshed God-Emperor felt puzzled, “What about you?” This disciple of his was a Ruler, and he had three avatars too.
“I am prepared to leave the cosmos.” Xue Ying responded, “I am prepared to enter the Primal Chaos Void.”
“Entering the Primal Chaos Void?” Bloodshed God-Emperor was shocked, “How can you enter without becoming a Void God?”
Xue Ying nodded, “I have my ways. Gu Qian Luo depended on the Primal Chaos Flying Ship to travel in the Primal Chaos Void, and I naturally have my ways too.”
He had thought about this for a very long time.
His father, mother Uncle Zong, Uncle Tong and his little brother had left the world. That had stimulated him greatly because they were his loved ones! The recent 100 million years were spent helping his wife Jing Qiu and his son to break through. But ‘transcending’ was ultimately too difficult. Xue Ying could only provide an external stimulus. Ultimately, they had to depend on themselves.
100 million years had passed already, and his wife had yet to break through. Xue Ying was afraid. He was afraid that one day, it would come…
He could not accept that outcome.
Cultivating…
What was it for?
To become stronger? To be unparalleled?
Xue Ying had cultivated for the sake of his loved ones since young. If his loved ones were not around, then so what if he cultivated to become stronger? Living would just be like moving a corpse around.
Maybe other Rulers and powerful existences had once experienced the agony of losing their loved ones, and over time, they had gradually placed all concentration on cultivation. But Xue Ying could not achieve that. If that fateful day arrived, it might be possible that Xue Ying would also focus on his cultivation to forget everything…
