But he did not wish to walk this Dao path.
There were no dangers or tempering chances for him if he remained in the Cultivator Cosmos. There were no miraculous opportunities for him or any powerful experts. His rate of cultivation would become very slow. He could only leave for the wider world! He wanted to grow even faster! After all, only by getting more miraculous treasures or other external stimuli to aid one’s cultivation could he boost Jing Qiu’s chances for a breakthrough.
“You are really thinking of leaving?” Bloodshed God-Emperor asked.
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded.
“To where?” Bloodshed God-Emperor asked.
“Seventh Star Oceanic Sacred World.” Xue Ying said.
“Are you planning on returning?” Bloodshed God-Emperor asked. He was different from Xue Ying. The system ‘hex’ approached power by researching the myriad existences. He had to bury his head and ponder it. He was not in a rush and was planning to patiently cultivate until the end of the cosmos epoch before leaving this place. Furthermore, he had to bring his people with him, together; it was not about leaving whenever he wanted to.
“I’ll definitely return before this cosmos epoch ends.” Xue Ying said.
“There should be a total of 1.36 trillion years in this cosmos epoch according to my senses.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said.
“I’ll definitely return within a trillion years then.” Xue Ying said.
A trillion years.
That was a very long period.
Only with sufficient time could Xue Ying have the confidence to do what he wanted to - seek for treasures that could boost his loved ones’ chances of breaking through! As for the lifespan of his loved ones? They could always enter the Eden treasure world and pass their lives when they no longer had hopes of breaking through. The Eden treasure world was able to maintain time flow at a languid pace, and reaching one-ten-thousandth of normal time wasn’t that difficult. The consumption of energy was a pittance to Xue Ying.
His wife and son had lived for 100 million years within the Eden treasure world, while a billion years had passed in the outside world.
When he returned by then, the situation would likely be different. It would be different from his current view… instead, it would be him watching them helplessly as they reached the end of their life!
“You are just a Ruler, and you are thinking of leaving the cosmos?” Bloodshed God-Emperor shook his head, “The Primal Chaos Void is very dangerous.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying nodded. The Voidwalker inheritance had long informed him about information of the outside world.
“What exactly is it for that you aren’t willing to cultivate within the cosmos until the cosmos epoch ends? With your comprehension ability, you should not be any worse than Ancestor Devil.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said, “At that time when you leave, there are very few who can threaten you.”
“For the sake of my loved ones.” Xue Ying answered simply.
Bloodshed God-Emperor was stunned.
Loved ones?
A figure subconsciously appeared from deep within his memories. That was too long ago! That time, it was because of the love between Xue Ying and his wife that moved him. As a result, he decided to accept Xue Ying as a disciple.
“I understand.” Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded. In the past, he had tried thinking of all ways to make his wife become a stage one World Deity. Eventually, his wife still died with her soul dissipating away. If his wife had become a stage four World Deity, he might also think of all ways to find some ways for his wife to transcend.
He understood Xue Ying’s line of thought and thus made no moves to stop him.

chapters.title: Chapter 778 - Killing a Void God?
chapters.content:
Chapter 778: Killing a Void God?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the Starting Ground’s grass house, a violet-robed Xue Ying opened his eyes. He had constantly been cultivating here during the past billion years. Looking around him, the grass house felt incomparably familiar. Unsurprising, as he had been cultivating there for a long time. He shook his head lightly with a smile. “It’s time for me to leave.”
He stood up, walked to the entrance, and pushed open the wooden door. He saw the white-haired old man sitting there, cross-legged. This made Xue Ying sigh inwardly. The old man had been protecting him, from the outside, for as long as he had been cultivating inside.
“Senior.” Xue Ying stated.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, why did you come out?” The white-haired old man was slightly startled.
“I am prepared to undergo the Ruler realm trial.” Xue Ying mentioned. He wanted to take the final trial before leaving the cosmos. If he passed through the trial, Forefather Tian Yu might give him some surprises in the gifts provided to the descendants. Maybe one of those could help his wife and children.
With shock, the white-haired old man said, “You want to take the Ruler realm trial now? Dong Bo Xue Ying, I have to remind you, the Ruler realm trial is the final one in the Starting Ground and also the most difficult. The moment you pass through it, you will become one of the core golden-robed disciples of the Great Void Heaven Temple. The Great Void Heaven Temple will also do its best to groom you. But comparatively speaking, the trial is extremely difficult. In the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, there are only a fixed number of ten golden-robed disciples in the Great Void Heaven Temple! Every time there is a huge war, large numbers of violet-robed disciples will take the initiative to launch a challenge, and only the strongest ten will become the core golden-robed disciple. Every single golden-robed disciple could kill a Void God by surpassing their current realm as a Ruler.”
“Oh?” Xue Ying was stunned.
Rulers surpassing their current realm to kill a Void God?
One had to know that it was a huge major realm jump from True God to Void God. Xue Ying might think highly of himself, having cultivated the Voidwalker system. But even though the Voidwalkers had an early advantage, being a powerful system, he only felt that he could fight against the new Void Gods! He did not think of killing Void Gods as a Ruler!
“There are too many ordinary Rulers in the Great Void Heaven Temple. There are more than a hundred violet-robed disciples, but only ten golden-robed disciples at any one time! Even if there were a Ruler who was more talented, only the strongest ten would become golden-robed disciples.” The white-haired old man said, “Because you have been born within the cosmos, after getting through the Starting Ground trial, you will become a golden-robed disciple that allows you to attain all sorts of benefits a golden-robed disciple have temporarily. But after reaching the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, there will be an internal challenge once every billion years which you have to attend. If you could not get into the top 10, you will demote back to becoming a violet-robed disciple.”
Xue Ying lightly nodded.
“Also, because this isn’t the Great Void Heaven Temple, even if you became a golden-robed disciple, the benefits you enjoy are only part of what the normal golden-robed disciple will enjoy in the Great Void Heaven Temple.” The white-haired old man said, “Naturally, you can enjoy everything if you visited the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World.”
“Firstly, within the cosmos, the cultivation resources you get will not be as much as what you get in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. Secondly, the benefits you get are relatively less. Thus, the difficulty of the trial is also lower than that in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. The disciples there will compete with one another, but there is a fixed opponent for you to defeat in the Starting Ground. As long as you kill it, you will become a golden-robed disciple.”
“Kill it? Who is it?” Xue Ying asked.
“A Void God that is slightly weaker.” The white-haired old man said, “The golden-robed disciples of Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World are all able to kill ordinary Void Gods. This type of extremely weak Void God… is much easier to kill.”
“But no matter what, it is still a Void God. I urge you to cultivate for a longer period since ultimately, you have cultivated for only a short period.” The white-haired old man urged Xue Ying.
Xue Ying felt uncertain.
Killing a slightly weaker Void God? And the difficulty was also lowered?
He felt that a golden-robed disciple from the Great Void Heaven Temple was much stronger than that ‘Gu Qian Luo’. Gu Qian Luo was one of the sacred sons under the Ancestor Bone Throne. But clearly, he was much weaker. The most dazzling expert cultivating the laws and profound mysteries system… was indeed terrifying.
“I still want to attempt it.” Xue Ying said.
“Attempt it? You only have one single opportunity. If you were defeated, you would be forced out.” The white-haired old man told him once again.
“No need to say anymore.” Xue Ying shook his head.
No matter if he succeeded or not, he would leave this cosmos after the battle.
The white-haired old man felt helpless after seeing that he could not change the mind of Xue Ying: “Alright, I’ll bring you over. You are truly overconfident.”
…
Under the guidance of the white-haired old man, Xue Ying entered a vast space, empty except for the black ground.
“Forefather refined a slightly weaker Void God puppet.” The white-haired old man said, “It is a refinement that completely reflects a genuine Void, God. After killing it, it will go back into incubation mode before reviving once again after three days. Naturally, it is fine after killing it once. It is an organism found in the Primal Chaos Void known as the ‘Hundred Leading Howls’. You should not have heard of it before, but you have to be a little careful. Don’t be defeated the moment you begin the battle. I still look forward to the emergence of a golden-robed disciple.”
Xue Ying’s heart leaped. Hundred Leading Howls? He had seen its records within the vast information provided by the Voidwalker inheritance.
“Then I’ll be releasing it now.” The white-haired old man said. His attitude towards Xue Ying was apparently much closer.
The black land began trembling. An enormous creature emerged suddenly from it. It was colossal, as expected from an organic being that lived in the Primal Chaos Void. It had many multi-colored tentacles, each very long. At the center of its body, there were over a hundred huge brains, each with a single horn protruding from it, with a single eye, and a huge bloody mouth.
“Hou~”
The hundred brains roared simultaneously. The surrounding void trembled violently, and parts of it disintegrated. Many ripples began fluctuating in the distance and swept across Xue Ying too.
It had a preference for howling. But the threat from its howl was insignificant. Even Rulers with a slightly weaker fleshy body could survive it. To Xue Ying, who had cultivated the Hidden Walker’s Secret to the 20th level, it could be completely disregarded. It was clear that the real strength of the ‘Hundred Leading Howls’ had yet to be displayed.
Concluding its howl, the Hundred Leading Howls became more relaxed. Only then did its heads turn towards Xue Ying’s direction. Every single unpaired eye was fixated on Xue Ying, forming an incorporeal spirit suppression on him. However, either due to the complete “Walker’s Hidden Secret” inheritance he had in his soul or the fact that he cultivated the “God Light Scripture”, Xue Ying was able to ignore this type of soul attack.
Forming a soul assault with just its gaze was actually a technique developed naturally by reaching the higher realm of ‘Void God’. This was not the creature’s true inborn technique.
“Hong~”
In an instant, darkness fell across the entire space. The hundred brains of the Hundred Leading Howls opened their mouths at the same time. Every single mouth released a black fog.
In the black space, the black fog began mixing.
“According to the information provided from the Voidwalker inheritance, I should entice it to spill more poisonous gas to weaken it further. Only then will my chance of victory be higher. But I should try to fight and see if I could kill it directly.” Xue Ying knew that the golden-robed disciples of the Great Void Heaven Temple could all kill Void Gods as Rulers. That caused the fighting spirit in him to rise. Since others could do so, he should be able to achieve it too!
“Weng.”
The violet-robed Xue Ying remained standing here. He only had a single incarnation at this moment - his real body stealthily entered the Mirage World using the Void Evasive Maneuver, and traveled directly to where the head of the Void God, ‘Hundred Leading Howls’, was.

chapters.title: Chapter 779 - Leaving
chapters.content:
Chapter 779: Leaving
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Walker’s Hidden Secret 20th level made Xue Ying’s Void Evasive Maneuver extremely formidable. He was able to move stealthily to the side of the enemy. Adding the Mirage World’s concealment, Xue Ying’s movement became undetectable by even the ‘Hundred Leading Howls’.
A silver spear abruptly appeared from the void, going straight towards one of the eyes on one of the Hundred Leading Howls hundred heads. The spear moved like a faint shadow - indescribably fast and sudden! But the ‘Hundred Leading Howls’ was within the Void God realm and reacted instinctively. For all its speed, the spear missed its intended target, the eye, and struck the cheek of that head instead.
The skin of the creature was extremely firm and was covered in thin veined patterns. When Xue Ying struck it, it felt as if he was striking the void. Chaotic energy worked to guide the spear away.
“Pu.” Xue Ying had broken through its skin, leaving a shallow wound. As he pulled the spear out, black blood began spurting.
“Hou~” The Hundred Leading Howls howled with indignance and madness. The bloody mouths on all its hundred heads began spewing out poisonous gas. The poisonous gas fused with the surrounding dark domain, giving it the property to corrode every single substance. Xue Ying’s disguised incarnation could not withstand this and dissipated. This domain’s power had even permeated into the Mirage world.
“Even though there is a major realm gap between a True God and Void God, the Walker’s Hidden Secret at the 20th level gives me enough strength to threaten the life of a Void God. Even though I struck once to determine its strength without using my killing move, even if I did so, I would only injure it at most.” Xue Ying stared at the Hundred Leading Howls from within the Mirage world. He could not help but shake his head inwardly, “The intelligence isn’t wrong. This Hundred Leading Howls might be foolish, but I still have to entice it to spurt more poisonous gas, diminishing its power before I have any chances of killing it.”
The way of killing the Hundred Leading Howls was to exterminate all heads!
This was considered slightly easier already. Some of the stronger Void Gods like ‘Bloodshed God-Emperor’ who specialized in the ‘hex’ system from the myriad existences would usually transform their bodies to attain the so-called undying body. Their survival capabilities were much more terrifying than the Hundred Leading Howls.
…
The world was dark. There was poison pervading through every single corner of this world.
The Hundred Leading Howls was floating in the sky. Its countless tentacles enveloped many different places, and its hundred heads swept across all directions without spurting out any more poison.
Xue Ying appeared at this moment.
But his body was faintly real and unreal at the same time. He could feel the horrifying suppressive force from the dark domain. This suppressive force sufficed to kill Monarch Green and Purgatory Ruler! After all, Monarch Green and the others had a fleshy body weaker than even the body cultivated from the 11th level of Walker’s Hidden Secret.
“Are you thinking of killing me with just these few techniques?” Xue Ying laughed out loud. At the same time, many blood ripples appeared in the surroundings.
The blood ripples were spreading in all directions. Each ripple was akin to a single silk strand, and the many blood ripple silk strands intercrossed each other into a single entity before spreading in all directions.
Slaughter Domain!
He had long cultivated the ‘Dao of Slaughter’ and ‘Dao of Ripple’ in the Ruler realm. Furthermore, he cultivated the Primal Chaos ranked absolute art “Shadowless Heaven’s Gathering”, fusing some methods of utilizing ripples into the Slaughter Domain, boosting its power significantly.
But however strongly the Slaughter Domain tried to charge out, it was suppressed by the dark domain, and remain scattered.
“Void!”
Xue Ying operated the void energy. The power garnered from controlling the void using the 20th level of cultivation technique was similarly horrifying.
“Hong!” The void energy fused perfectly with the Slaughter Domain as they charged out in all directions.
“Hong hong hong~” The blood ripple domain was doing its best to rush out in all directions, yet the dark domain was continually suppressing it, causing the Slaughter Domain to maintain at over 50 kilometers without extending any further.
‘Who would have thought that I remain disadvantaged even after fusing both the Slaughter Domain and Void energy.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘The gap between a Ruler and a Void God is ultimately too big.’
…
The white-haired old man who was spectating the battle felt very shocked. A Ruler was actually able to clash with a Void God in terms of domains? Even though it was a slightly weaker Void God, this was amazing regardless.
“Die for me.” The Hundred Leading Howls roared. It spoke using some unknown language, but Xue Ying was able to understand what the other party meant. The Hundred Leading Howls continued roaring and spurting out the poisonous fog. The dark void fused with the poisonous fog and it seemed that the power of the fog was becoming stronger. It was also giving off sounds of ‘chi chi chi’, unnervingly corroding Xue Ying’s Slaughter Domain.
‘The poisonous fog can corrode away my domain?’ Xue Ying said, with a hint of envy.
“Just this little technique is useless against me.” Xue Ying continued laughing at and provoking his opponent.
Over and over, the Hundred Leading Howls formed an illusion as it charged, throwing many of its tentacles into an assault; but every time Xue Ying borrowed on the Mirage world and the void to teleport and flee. He repeatedly taunted the Hundred Leading Howls, which could not touch him at all. Xue Ying even took opportunities to bring out an incarnation to sneak an attack, or used flying darts. He even used his true body for an assault!
But every single time he snuck an attack, he would direct part of his strength to prevent the Hundred Leading Howls from discovering traces of him.
While these sneak attacks barely broke the skin of the Hundred Leading Howls, their audacity enraged it. This weak little Ruler could escape from it? The Hundred Leading Howls could not reach its enemy? It spewed more poisonous fog in a bid to use its domain to trap this enemy.
******
The white-haired old man was watching this battle from the side. The Hundred Leading Howls was spurting out more poisonous fog while becoming weaker at the same time. While hiding his true strength, Xue Ying had been getting sneak attacks in time after time. When he determined he could kill his opponent, Xue Ying erupted with the “Wind Ripple Path, which boosted his offenses greatly.
With a terrifying close combat strike, he destroyed a head of the Hundred Leading Howls. This roused the Void God.
This damnable Ruler was actually hiding his true strength!
At this moment, its many tentacles were also doing their best to defend itself. But Xue Ying outmaneuvered it at every turn. Even though destroying a head was very difficult, he had succeeded after spending a little more time. One by one, they were exterminated, and when the last head was destroyed, the corpse of the Hundred Leading Howls collapsed onto the ground, and Xue Ying let out a sigh of relief.
This battle had lasted for two full days. 90% of the time was spent killing the heads because it took a very long time to get rid of every single head.
“You won.” The white-haired old man chuckled at Xue Ying, “But you should understand that it only used all its strength to try and kill you because of an order given by Master to this Hundred Leading Howls puppet. During ordinary battles, it would be harder for you to provoke it to spit more poisonous gas. Furthermore, the moment it discovers that things aren’t optimistic, it would escape. This space region is too small so it could not escape.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying nodded.
Because it was a trial, that Hundred Leading Howls puppet had gotten an order to use all its force to kill the Ruler taking the trial. Thus, it made it easier to entice it to spit more poisonous fog.
“Fortunately, I’ve gotten intelligence on it before. Otherwise, it’d have been a slightly more difficult opponent to defeat. It is also a slightly weaker Void God.” Xue Ying had a better understanding of himself, “No matter what, it is still a Void God. Thus, for me to reach this stage meant that I have the power to fight across realms! But in order to reach the power of those golden-robed disciples on the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, I still have to improve myself further.”
He cultivated the Voidwalker system yet he had barely passed the trial. It seemed he still underestimated the other cultivators.
******
The grass house located at the center.
“That is the place where forefather had once stayed for a long period. It is also the place where only Rulers who passed through the trial could enter.” The white-haired old man said.
“Mn.” Xue Ying pushed open the wooden door and entered the place.
He remained for a long time inside before coming out. At the point when he came out, he was wearing a golden robe, albeit with slight disappointment in his eyes.
The benefits which a golden-robed disciple had were genuinely great! It broadened his perspective. The way the forefather treated and cherished the golden-robed disciples… was not any less than how the Voidwalker Gu Qi treated his inheritors. After all, the Voidwalker Gu Qi was a lone ranger and did not know how to teach disciples. Instead, the Great Void Heaven Temple was more holistic.
“It’s a pity that there was nothing that could help Jing Qiu or Yu’er.” Xue Ying was disappointed because of this reason. Actually, after pondering over for a while, he felt that it was right too. The benefits which the Great Void Heaven Temple provided to the golden-robed disciple were naturally to help the golden-robed disciple. Why would it be helping a stage four World Deity transcend?
“What Void God weapon do you need?” The white-haired old man chuckled.
“Spear.” Xue Ying answered.
“There are only two spears. I’ll bring you over to select them.” The white-haired old man said.
Xue Ying nodded.
Weapons were external goods. What was more important had already been obtained in the grass house.
…
Black Fog Sea, Monarch Dong Bo residence.
The matter about Xue Ying leaving the cosmos was not spread to many others. Even his good friend Chi Qiu Bai, Paragon Huo Cheng, Senior Disciple Brother Hui Ming, Forefather Scarlet Flame did not know and Xue Ying only informed them about: “I have some important matters which requires me to travel far away. I’ll only come back after a long time.” As for where he was planning to go, he did not say.
But he had mentioned this to his wife and children.
The family of four was currently walking together within Monarch Dong Bo residence. Towards the matter of Xue Ying leaving the cosmos, his son ‘Dong Bo Yu’ once intensely opposed it, “I can transcend by myself! Father, you don’t have to go out and risk your life.”
Even Jing Qiu opposed him in the beginning, “Xue Ying, we have already spent a long time together. Even if I die, I would still be satisfied with my life. You don’t have to risk your life for the sake of me.”
Xue Ying remained unmoved.
Jing Qiu and Yu’er could calmly face death. They did not wish for him to venture out and take the risk.
Yet how could he watch all these happen with his eyes open without doing his best? That was something he could not do!
Jing Qiu and Dong Bo Yu both knew about the temper of Xue Ying. Since they could not discourage him from doing so, they could only accept it then and cherish the days they had together.
“I’ll definitely return before the end of this cosmos epoch.” Xue Ying chuckled.
Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, and Qing Yao were all worried.
It was countless times more dangerous outside.
“I am a golden-robed disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple. Thus, it isn’t that easy for me to die.” Xue Ying laughed. He had mentioned the matter of the existence of the Great Void Heaven Temple to his wife and children, but he made them swear that they could not spread out to others.
“Alright, it is time for me to leave.” Xue Ying said. At this moment, two other figures appeared. They were his two other bodies. The three bodies instantly fused back as one.
After leaving the cosmos, without the protection of the cosmos, he would suffer from the cleansing by the laws of the entire Primal Chaos Void. Only those beings that were one-whole could survive within the Primal Chaos Void. Thus, when Gu Qian Luo was killed, it was a true death. That was why Gu Qian Luo was so despondent at that moment.
“Hu.”
He took a step before arriving above the Monarch Dong Bo residence.
Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, and Qing Yao looked up. Another figure appeared as well above the sky. It was Bloodshed God-Emperor who had been waiting for a long time in the surroundings.
“Xue Ying, be careful on your journey. Leave the matter within the cosmos for me to handle.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said. He knew the route that headed to the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World was long and dangerous, but knowing that his disciple had become a golden-robed disciple, he had a greater confidence in him.
“Mn.”
Xue Ying waved his hand, forming a crack. This crack led to the wider and vaster Primal Chaos void outside the cosmos.
Xue Ying turned back to his wife, son, and daughter. Whatever he could leave behind had been left behind.
“I’ll definitely return.” Xue Ying muttered to himself. He then smiled towards his family.
Following that with a ‘sou’, he flew out along the cosmos membrane crack. This scene jolted Bloodshed God-Emperor slightly: ‘He could actually enter the Primal Chaos Void using his body? Usually, only most Void Gods could do so. But even a Ruler can do it? This disciple of mine has indeed encountered miraculous encounters.’
Xue Ying entered that vast Primal Chaos Void, and the cosmos membrane was currently closing up.
Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, and Qing Yao looked up. Jing Qiu’s eyes were already filled with tears. She was worried and afraid that Xue Ying might never come back.
“I’ll wait for you. I’ll definitely be waiting for you to come back.” Jing Qiu said softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 780 - The Final Stage of Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 780: The Final Stage of Cultivation
Xue Ying flew into the primal chaos void. He was able to sense an unseen operating law sweeping across him. Xue Ying understood that this was the operating laws of the primal chaos void! After entering this location, he would no longer be under the protection of the cosmos. His soul had to be one-whole before he could even survive in the primal chaos void. Naturally, it was on the premise that he could survive in the hostile environment within the primal chaos void.
“Chi chi chi~” The primal chaos void seemed empty, but in reality, it contained a few types of energy fused together. Some were horrifying, destructive and extremely cold. Just this frigidness could freeze several Rulers to death quickly.
But Xue Ying was like a fish in water within this environment. He was after all a Voidwalker. After cultivating Walker’s Hidden Secret to the 11th level, Xue Ying was able to survive in the primal chaos void. Now that he was at the 20th level, this environment naturally became more comfortable.
“Cosmos.”
Xue Ying turned behind him.
There was a boundless and enormous existence-the cosmos! This was his hometown cosmos. It was big, yet it housed and protected countless beings within. Compared to the primal chaos void, it was much safer to stay within a cosmos.
“It is still difficult to determine my direction in the vast primal chaos void.” Xue Ying looked at this cold and desolate primal chaos void. He released his senses towards the void and spread it further. This distance which he could sense would likely be a hundred times the size of a cosmos.
With such colossal perception region, he could easily detect that unseen energy within the primal chaos void that was moving extremely slowly.
It felt as if there was a core in the primal chaos void.
With that core as the point of origin, the primal chaos void was expanding in all directions! It was continuously growing and expanding.
“The Ancient Sacred World is right there!” Xue Ying softly nodded. According to the direction of expansion of the primal chaos void, he could deduce the direction where the Ancient Sacred World was!
The Ancient Sacred World…
That was one of the five great sacred worlds.
According to the legends, the Ancient Sacred World was where everything began.
After that, a group of strongest existences who reached the final point of cultivation underwent a horrifying great war that caused the entire Ancient Sacred World of the past to explode. The remaining ‘Ancient Sacred World’ was likely only one-hundredth its original size.
Because of that great war, the primal chaos void began expanding in all directions. Of the remnant pieces that exploded from the original Ancient Sacred World, some transformed into cosmos, and some formed primal chaos lands that were smaller than cosmos. There were even smaller pieces which were not suitable for life.
And that group of existence who reached the final stages of cultivation also separated. They began creating their own sacred worlds. But over the extended period, there were more great wars involving existences who reached the final stages of cultivation, causing the destruction of more sacred worlds.
And thus, there were only five sacred worlds left remaining.
The Ancient Sacred World and Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World were two of them.
“The existences who cultivated to the final stage are truly terrifying.” Xue Ying sighed inwardly, “They are people who can destroy an entire sacred world.”
“But I have also gotten an absolute art which can destroy a sacred world.” Currently, there was an absolute art which existed in Xue Ying’s mind. This was the Temple Protection absolute art, one of the three Temple Protection absolute arts which the Great Void Heaven Temple had.
The one Xue Ying chose was called “13 Apocalyptic Swords”.
This was the only one among the three Temple Protection absolute arts which were more suitable to the laws and profound mysteries Xue Ying cultivated because this Temple Protection absolute art belonged to the ‘Dao of Slaughter’.
The “13 Apocalyptic Swords” was created by ‘Forefather Tian Yu’, the temple head of the Great Void Heaven Temple.
It was extremely terrifying and powerful!
The first sword was already extremely mystical and complex. Rulers would become unparalleled after learning it! Only those with outstanding comprehension abilities could learn the first sword. The moment one grasped it… when comparing sword techniques, the user could surpass realms as a Ruler and defeat ordinary Void Gods! In other words, just by relying on sword techniques, one sufficed to match against the current Xue Ying. The reason why Xue Ying was so strong had been because of the Voidwalker system. His self-created “Wind Ripple Path” still lacked compared to this first sword.
The second sword was even more frightening. Most Rulers had no hope of succeeding in cultivating that. There had only been a genius in the Dao of Sword within the history of Great Void Heaven Temple who did so as a Ruler! The others who comprehended this Temple Protection absolute art could not even comprehend it at the ‘Void God Origin Birth realm’. One could see how difficult it was! That genius in Dao of Sword had relied on the second sword… to sweep across all experts at the Void God Origin Birth realm. He could easily kill off ordinary Void Gods, and even fight against those who reached the ‘Void Unity realm’.
Naturally, other than that existence, there had never been a second Ruler who could grasp the second sword.
…
Every subsequent sword of this sword technique was much stronger than the previous one.
The final 13th sword was also why this absolute art was named like this-it could shatter a sacred world into pieces!
Being an existence who reached the final stages of cultivation in the laws and profound mysteries system, Forefather Tian Yu created three great Temple Protection absolute arts. They were all tyrannical in power and were famous across all five great sacred worlds. Those like ‘Ancestor Bone’ who were similarly at the final stages of cultivation, were much weaker by an entire level as compared to him.
Differentiating according to the cultivation realm, there were three minor levels within the Void God realm-the Origin Birth realm, the Unity realm, and the Primal Chaos realm!
When one mentioned Void Gods in the vast primal chaos void and the sacred worlds, they usually refer to those at the ‘Void Origin Birth realm’. The majority of the Void Gods were at this level.
The Unity realm existences were rarer.
As for the Primal Chaos realm?
When existences at the final cultivation stages were not around, they were the most terrifying ones.
The ‘Primal Chaos realm’ was also the realm which Lake Heart Island master had once reached within the cosmos. It was truly unfathomable. Without having formidable enemies around to temper himself or any good guidance, the Lake Heart Island master was able to attain the Primal Chaos realm within the cosmos. Even Voidwalker Gu Qi was dumbstruck by this fact. And even Forefather Tian Yu the creator of this cosmos had never thought that such a thing could happen.
And above that…
It was the final realm of cultivation-the Cosmos God!
The Cosmos God no longer had any differentiation in levels. Those who reached the Cosmos God realm had reached the end of their respective systems. They were akin to a cosmos themselves. Like the laws and profound mysteries system, their inner world could turn into a cosmos! Thus, a single move of theirs could converge the entire cosmic strength and destroying a cosmos was as simple as lifting their hands.
Existences at this level were also known as existences who reached the final stage of cultivation! There were very few of them.
The number of Cosmos God in all five sacred worlds could be counted with one’s fingers. Like the Ancient Sacred World, there were only two Cosmos Gods within! Those who reached this level would rarely act. Because the moment they did so, it would be something phenomenal! And the destruction of a sacred world was something common at their levels.
…
“Hu-” Xue Ying slightly separated a strand of his concentration to control the void and proceed with traveling using the Void Evasive Maneuver.
His entire figure remained in the maneuvering state.
Regardless of the Starting Ground or the inheritance from the Voidwalker, they had all provided him with the complete primal chaos void map! Of which, his hometown cosmos was naturally marked within. Knowing the location of his hometown cosmos and using the ‘Ancient Sacred World’ to determine his bearings, Xue Ying naturally knew where to head!
Moving at ultra-high speed using the maneuver, the rest 99% of Xue Ying’s current concentration was spent on comprehending the “13 Apocalyptic Swords”. After all, this was one of the peak absolute arts within the laws and profound mysteries. He had obtained this absolute art barely, so naturally, he had to do his best in comprehending it. According to estimations, it would still take as long as two billion years if the path to the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred world was very smooth.
This was considered close already!
The Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World was the sacred world which was situated closest to his hometown cosmos. Naturally, the premise was that ‘it was a smooth journey’. This primal chaos void was filled with all sorts of dangers, and even if he could survive, there might be events that would delay him.

chapters.title: Chapter 781 - Void Corridor
chapters.content:
Chapter 781: Void Corridor
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As a Voidwalker, Xue Ying had an easy time traveling in the primal chaos void. He could easily avoid most trouble he met with his acute senses. But his journey was a lonely one; he rarely met any other living beings.
He could perceive some life forms from the distant, but most were ‘void creatures’.
Void creatures were beings born from the primal chaos void. There were all kinds of such creatures, with some being the rarely seen humanoid void creatures. Since these void creatures were born in such a hostile environment, it gave rise to the testament of their great inborn strength! Most would reach the ‘True God Ruler’ power once they were adults. Furthermore, their bodies were exceptionally suited for living in the primal chaos void.
But because they were innately powerful, it was harder for them to become stronger. After all, they depended on their talent to become strong. The majority of them did not know how to cultivate. Even after attaining cultivation techniques, it was still difficult for them to break through.
Like the ‘Hundred Leading Howls’ which he once fought within the Starting Ground, its original form was that of a void creature. The creator of the Voidwalker system, the ‘Voidwalker Primogenitor’ who created the “Walker’s Hidden Secret” had been a lifeform who was born in the primal chaos void too. But his innate talent was much more heaven-shaking, and currently, he was one of the three Cosmos Gods within the ‘Eastern Unicorn Sacred World’. Comparing power and statuses, he was higher as compared to Forefather Tian Yu.
“Hu~”
As Xue Ying persisted on his journey using the Void Evasive Maneuver, most of his concentration was spent studying the “13 Apocalyptic Swords”.
He had left the cosmos immediately after acquiring this Temple Protection Absolute Art. That was why he had only genuinely begun comprehending it at the start of his journey. Initially, he thought that with his experience-he had cultivated for a billion years after becoming a Ruler, accumulating much experience and wisdom, coupled with the comprehension ability of which he felt confident of, learning the first sword wasn’t something complicated.
But in reality…
“I haven’t comprehended it after studying it for about 50 million years.” Xue Ying shook his head in helplessness, “Even though I’ve comprehended the majority half, there are still many perplexities which I could not get through. If only there were an opponent for me to fight with, it might give me greater inspiration and faster comprehension of the profound mysteries in the sword techniques which I discovered.”
Even though it was a sword technique, the inherent Dao could be used across different arts! After grasping the first sword, it would be much simpler to adapt it into a spear technique.
“But it is beneficial to my comprehension of the Dao of Slaughter.” Xue Ying still liked it a lot. Even though he had not fully comprehended the first sword of the “13 Apocalyptic Swords”, it had deepened his understanding of the Dao of Slaughter, making it more incisive and firming his foundation of it.
…
Just as Xue Ying was traveling and studying the Temple Protection absolute art, suddenly, there was a distortion in the primal chaos void ahead.
“Not good.” Xue Ying’s expression changed considerably. He tried his best to use the Void Evasive Maneuver to escape, but the surrounding void energy had utterly distorted, preventing him from controlling it at all. At this moment, he was just like a tiny ant amidst the colossal maelstrom. No matter how he struggled, it was futile.
As for flying? The surrounding void energy was being warped, making movement difficult as well.
“It seems that I have met some trouble.” Xue Ying was not panicking. Just like how the ocean had tides and whirlpools, the primal chaos void would usually have some unique occurrences. Still, most Voidwalkers were able to survive with their great survival capabilities. Only rarely would they fall into some unforeseen plights.
For instance, being swallowed into a specific sealed void region? That was possible as well.
The surrounding region of primal chaos void which covered the area occupied by a hundred cosmoses was being warped. Everything headed towards the point of collapse-the center. At the core, there was a halo of rainbow light.
“That is?” Xue Ying was also moving with the collapse of the primal chaos void. He was being swept along towards the core.
The closer he got, the clearer his vision became.
At the center…
There were many layers of colorful spatial folds. They seemed to be coming from a different space and had layered upon this location.
“Void Corridor?” Xue Ying could recognize it.
The Void Corridor was formed from different regions in the primal chaos void resonating with each other. It would cause the void to start collapsing and interconnecting with each other. It might even be a wormhole that led to a different far away region.
Some of the stronger cultivators could display a similar resonating technique to a distant location by folding space, traveling to another area just by penetrating through the corridor! They could instantaneously arrive at another sacred world from one sacred world despite the considerable distance in between.
But to achieve this, there were demanding requirements on the combat power and cultivation systems. Even the laws and profound mysteries system or the Ancestor Mother Religion system could not achieve this at the final stages of cultivation!
Every system had their specialties. Only some of the unique cultivation systems could accomplish this at the final stages of cultivation. And it was this scene which appeared in the current primal chaos void.
“I would rather hope for it not to appear.” Xue Ying might be stunned, but he felt helpless and uneasy at the same time.
The Void Corridor would bring him directly to the boundary of a sacred world. But at the same time, he might find himself in some predicament! The Void Corridor could even directly send him into a horrifying place.
Everything depended on his luck.
“I hope that my luck isn’t that bad.” Xue Ying held onto a piece of talisman. Being a golden-robed disciple, he had three pieces of survival talisman. The Great Void Heaven Temple attached great importance to the safety of its golden-robed disciples. When they met certain situations which they could not face, the survival talismans would greatly increase their chances of survival.
“Hua.”
The warped and collapsing void swept along the immensely small Xue Ying into the Void Corridor that had rainbow light streaming. Xue Ying only felt the surrounding space being squeezed and pulled continuously. The time flow was also changing randomly. He could see different colors around him, and Xue Ying felt himself being swept along the corridor. He was praying inside: ‘I should not be that unlucky. In most cases, I should arrive at some random location. The chances of falling into a predicament should be meager.’ He was consoling himself.
…
Finally, the journey through the distorting and unstable Void Corridor ended.
Xue Ying who was stuck in one of the regions had also regained his bearings within one of the openings in the void folds. The surrounding void gradually recovered its usual appearance, and the originally distorting primal chaos void was slowly regaining its peace and calm.
Xue Ying looked around him with aghast.
It seemed vast and obscure.
The cosmos which he could barely see in one of the directions was no longer there.
“It seems that I am at a different location from before.” Xue Ying did not find it puzzling. If the Void Corridor did not bring him away from his original position, that would be a wonder!
“The crucial moment now is to get a sensing of where I am currently!” Xue Ying was contemplating it. Even though he could still deduce the direction where the ‘Ancient Sacred World’ was, knowing just a single direction was pointless. He had to find a cross reference point, “Fortunately, my teacher Gu Qi left behind an extremely complete ‘Void map’. All the different landmarks around the five sacred worlds were marked thoroughly.”
“Let’s begin.”
Xue Ying casually chose a direction. He then proceeded on with his Void Evasive Maneuver.
He had long made his plans when he left his hometown. After all, there the journey would be filled with twists and turns. Everything was fine as long as he survived.
“Mn?”
Very soon, Xue Ying discovered that there was a huge land in the distant primal chaos void. His eyes brightened unknowingly: “Primal chaos land?”
The most primitive and oldest Ancient Sacred World had exploded because of a great war. Of its many remnant pieces, some turned into cosmos, and some of the smaller ones turned into primal chaos lands! Naturally, existences at the ‘Void Primal Chaos realm’ had the power to create a primal chaos land themselves. The primal chaos land sufficed to let living beings reproduce and live within, but its protection towards the beings living inside was much weaker.
The cosmos barred everything beyond the level of Void Gods from entering.
But the primal chaos land did not forbid this.
Most of those who travel around the primal chaos void were Void Gods at least, and it was rarer to see those like Xue Ying or Gu Qian Luo with his Primal Chaos Flying Ship. Void Gods could not enter the cosmos… and thus in the vast primal chaos void, since most could not discern the difference between cosmoses, the cosmos would not have a name made for them.
Instead, the primal chaos land being a place where everyone could enter would usually have a name given for it.
“Let’s go and have a look to see what this primal chaos land is called. Once I know its name, I should be able to find where I am and can decide where I will be going next.” Xue Ying rapidly descended onto the land. But being vigilant, he had displayed the “3000 Incarnations” technique, forming an incarnation that would move ahead… as for his real body, it was waiting in the dark.

chapters.title: Chapter 782 - Acting for the First Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 782: Acting for the First Time
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the primal chaos land, many beings were living and cultivating here.
“Quick quick quick.”
“Faster.”
A group of attendants was swiftly entering the dark hall. There was currently a beast that had barely turned into a humanoid appearance seated cross-legged within. He was looking below him. After the group of attendants entered, he hurriedly waved his hand. At that time, several huge cages appeared. Some cages imprisoned humans inside, and some incarcerated beasts. Some were detained with plant lifeforms… and all had a point of similarity-they were all at least at the World Deity level with their power sealed.
“Master, the food is delivered.” These attendants announced with slight terror.
“Mn.”
The monstrous creature opened its large mouth from its high position.
“Hu”, a cage immediately flew over. As it flew in, it was becoming smaller and smaller. Eventually, the cage turned into a single point as it entered the bloody mouth. After devouring it, there was some movement in his abdomen.
“His karma disappeared.” These servants were all at the powerful existences realm. They were able to sense the disappearing karma and could not help but turn sorrowful. However, not a single expression was shown on their face.
The monstrous creature ate the humans, beasts and plant lifeforms with ka cha ka cha’… he was swallowing all sorts of cultivation living beings.
As he was eating halfway through, he suddenly looked upwards: “There is actually an outsider!”
“Sou!”
He immediately teleported into the void and disappeared.
These servants let out a sigh of relief. At the same time, they could not help but turn out and see. Being powerful existences, they were able to see through the void obstacles at what was happening far away. It was a black-robed teenager who landed on this primal chaos land.
“An outsider? A human?” The servants were all excited.
“Those who travel in the primal chaos are usually Void Gods. And seeing his appearance, usually, those monsters would still maintain their ugly heads and scales, but this outsider looked like an ordinary cultivator.”
“We have hope?”
“Is he here to save us?”
These servants looked towards each other. They felt excited and unease at the same time. They were even spreading the news in the dark.
There were many powerful existences amongst the cultivators on this primal chaos land. All of them heard of this news-a powerful cultivator had descended from the primal chaos void and could possibly fight with that group of void creatures. They might be saved.
In their hearts, they understood that the chances of them being saved were very very low. Because powerful existences would not easily risk their lives for strangers! At the same time, they knew that these void monsters were very terrifying in terms of strength. Even if it were a Void God that came, the probability of saving them was very low.
But-
Even if it were lower, it was still hope!
Their days were spent in darkness without hope. And now that a strand of hope appeared, it sufficed to excite them and make them look forward to it.
******
At the moment Xue Ying landed, he discovered an unseen fluctuation.
“Not good. There’s warning array. They should have discovered my presence the moment I entered.” Xue Ying understood this point. Fortunately, it was only an incarnation that he revealed. His true body was also extending his senses towards the void, easily enveloping the entire primal chaos land.
“Mn?” Xue Ying felt puzzled.
There were countless ordinary living beings on this primal chaos void-there were mortals, Transcendents, Deities, World Deities, and True Gods.
But there were actually many World Deities and True Gods being imprisoned! At the same time, the strongest amongst them was a group of void creatures! There were a total of 16 void creatures. Oh, and in the most dazzling and biggest palace, there was a very formidable array which he could not probe even with his current control of the void.
‘The void creatures have actually conquered this place?’ Xue Ying thought, ‘But why did they imprison those cultivators?’
The void creatures had intelligence. It was not puzzling for them to conquer the primal chaos land, but most could co-exist together with the natives.
“Hu, hu, hu.”
The surrounding void fluctuated, and many figures appeared. They were all void creatures who had penetrated through the void. Currently, they were barely in humanoid figures. Some had sharp claws, some with scales, and some still had their ugly heads. They were all staring at Xue Ying with their eyes emitting light.
“I was just traveling around the primal chaos void when I passed through this place and am here to visit it.” Xue Ying chuckled. He was instead turning more vigilant in his heart: ‘After void creatures become more intelligent, they would usually co-exist and live together with cultivators. But from how they look at me, something feels amiss. It feels like they are looking at prey?’
“Oh, coming to visit us?” A total of six void creatures appeared. Of which there was a tall and thin void creature who said, “You are a Ruler yet you dared to travel in the primal chaos void? Did you depend on external materials or some unique traveling method?”
“This is our first time meeting, and it isn’t good to ask about such private matter?” Xue Ying frowned, “I am here only because this is a location which my void map has not marked accurately. That is why I would like to ask where exactly is this place?”
“Just a Ruler brat yet he dares to be so arrogant.”
“Eat him.”
“Whoever kills him first will get to eat him.”
These void creatures were all discussing amongst each other. They did not hide their words at all. If the other party who came was a Void God, they might be more vigilant. As for a Ruler? They were truly not afraid.
Xue Ying felt weird inwardly. Facing these six void creatures, he could determine that they were just True God Rulers. Yet they dared to belittle this incarnation of his! His incarnation was showing power at the Ruler realm. Unless… there were Void Gods around!
Xue Ying immediately thought of the chain of palaces which he could not permeate through with his senses.
“Hu.”
A strange void creature suddenly appeared by his side. It brought out a pair of sharp claws that struck forward, causing the other six void creatures who were still discussing with each other to turn anxious. “You actually dare to snatch our food!” “This is the region we are responsible for.” “This is our prey.”
“It will belong to whoever kills it first.” That strange void creature was entirely black. It had a faintly translucent body, and its translucent claws were very sharp too.
A spear appeared in the hands of the black-robed Xue Ying.
The spearhead contained a black light. Even though this was just an incarnation, Xue Ying had left behind the most destructive force which the ‘Voidwalker’ could use-the Termination Energy! After all, an incarnation was condensed entirely from energy and would not be as powerful as his true body. He could only display some methods utilizing laws and profound mysteries.
“Pu.” He swiftly struck out.
The spear body revolved in an arc before striking out. This translucent void creature felt that the spear in front of it was moving strangely. The spear body was always rolling and revolving about, and the trajectory of the spearhead was ever-changing. This made him temporarily lose his confidence of parrying against this spear.
“Pu.” The spearhead swiftly struck out a total of 125 holes in the body of the void creature. The destructive force and Termination Energy within the spear had heavily injured this translucent void being within moments. It was because this void creature had a powerful lifeforce; otherwise, he would have died.
Xue Ying did not stop. At the same time he pulled out the spear, he jabbed forward once again! That heavily-injured translucent void being could only howl out, “Save me!” Before tunneling into the void.
But comparing the finesse in control of the void…
These void beings that purely relied on their innate talent could not compete against the Voidwalker Xue Ying. The spear directly pierced into the void, jabbing right into the body of this void creature and forming another 125 holes! This time, the void creature died.
This caused the other spectating void creatures to fall into a daze.
Dead?
Had their comrade died just like this?
‘My utilization of the first sword of the 13 Apocalyptic Swords is still too weak. According to logic, I should only pierce out a single hole per strike, but I cannot even stabilize the spearhead at all. At the moment I utilized the technique, I actually pierced out a total of 125 holes.’ Xue Ying glanced at the treasures left behind by the void creature, ‘This is my first battle after entering the primal chaos void.’
The feeling of actually using the first sword of 13 Apocalyptic Swords was much better than just burying his head into cultivating it.
…
Several powerful existences of this primal chaos land were nervously watching. They desired and thirsted for a miracle to happen.
…
Within that chain of palaces which Xue Ying could not probe, in one of the palace halls, there was a black-scaled void creature coiled there. He indignantly snorted out. His cold eyes were watching the outside world as the battle happened. Usually, it was his subordinates that handled the matter of dealing with those outsiders that tripped the warning array. With his status, how could he act so easily?
“Big brother, it seems these brats aren’t able to handle this outsider Ruler. Let me go and deal with him.” This black-scaled void creature said. His voice rumbled and transmitted into a more secretive palace deeper in the chain of palaces.
“Alright.” A low voice responded.
“It has been a long time since I ate a Ruler. There are ultimately too few Rulers existing.” The black-scaled void creature was relatively thrilled as he flew out from his palace hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 783 - Endless Darkness
chapters.content:
Chapter 783: Endless Darkness
The six void creatures which were originally about to surround Xue Ying and assault him were currently in panic. Because that mysterious black-robed teenager had easily disappeared in their vision. He then abruptly appeared and sneaked up on them. Furthermore, the power of his spear was enormous. They tried their best to defend against it but were not his opponent at all.
“Pu pu pu…” The spear body revolved and rolled out. The spearhead rapidly pierced through the bone armor on the chest of a void creature. The bone armor contained a mysterious pattern on it that was innate. It caused the spear to barely pierce through it. This time, a total of 119 holes were pierced out.
‘There is really an improvement.’ Xue Ying felt joy in his heart, ‘The explosiveness force of this spear is too powerful, making it hard for me to converge all my strength perfectly into a single point.’
The scattered power coupled with the spearhead added with ‘Termination Energy’ was barely able to injure the void creature. If he could truly perfect his strike into a single point, even if he did not depend on the Termination Energy, just the strength of his spear technique would surge to a different level, allowing him to fight against Void Gods.
‘Again.’
This incarnation of Xue Ying did not employ any domains because he was training in his spear techniques and wanted to learn the first sword of the Great Void Heaven Temple’s Temple Protection absolute art “13 Apocalyptic Swords” as fast as possible. By then, he would be able to kill ordinary Void Gods easily when he used it with the overwhelming advantage the Voidwalker system had.
Of course, the premise was that he had to grasp the first sword completely!
‘Not good.’ Xue Ying suddenly felt anxiety in his heart. His true body was able to sense the void, discovering a horrifying existence appearing from the chain of palaces which he could not extend his senses into. Following which, the other party traveled through the void before arriving here. That frightening aura was unquestionably at the Void God realm!
“A group of trash.” A voice resounded through the surrounding void. A coiled enormous black-scaled being appeared.
The remaining five void creatures were both shocked and joyous at the same time. One of their leaders had come. They were saved!
The black-robed Xue Ying stood in midair with the spear in his hand. He looked at this coiled black-scaled creature: “Looking at its appearance, I don’t remember reading any reports of such a creature. It should be one of the lower graded void creatures.”
There were millions and millions of void creature species. There were also highs and lows in their grades.
Just like the creator of the Voidwalker… he was amongst the peak-most and leading talent amongst the countless void creatures!
But Xue Ying did not dare be too careless. Because even if their grades were low, the void creatures had advantages over beings from within the cosmos in terms of their fleshy bodies. Furthermore, any creatures that broke through to the ‘Void God’ realm were not easy to push around.
“Ruler?” The black-scaled creature’s cold eyes were filled with a strand of interest. He said with a booming voice, “You are quite strong, at least much stronger than these fools on the primal chaos void. I’ll give you an opportunity. Use your strongest attack against me. If you can surprise me, I might just spare your life.”
“Enslaving the countless beings in the entire primal chaos void and wantonly devouring them, you have all violated the taboo.” Xue Ying’s cold voice retorted, “Do you know what will happen to you all should the powerful experts know of this?”
“Haha, all surrounding regions have been occupied by us, so why would we be afraid of you cultivators?” The black-scaled creature sneered.
Xue Ying felt his heart tightening after hearing it.
Many powerful experts had affirmed that those who wantonly devoured the innocent lives must be killed without hesitation! But there were wicked seniors-’Cosmos Gods’-amongst those with great statuses and were unparalleled. Furthermore, they were not very united with one another. Otherwise, the Ancient Sacred World would not have exploded into pieces because of the great war.
Thus, it was only part of the powerful experts who were handling those who violated the taboo! There were also powerful experts who hated evil patroling around the primal chaos void too.
But now, the surrounding region had been occupied, meaning to say that it was not just a few void creatures which went mad in their actions. Instead, they had formed an organization with a backing behind their backs.
“Brat, come on. If you don’t attack me, you will no longer have the chance to do so.” The black-scaled creature said.
“Hong.”
The black-robed Xue Ying turned ashen. At that moment, he released the ‘Slaughter Domain’ with him at the center. This was a fusion from both Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple. Even though his incarnation could not control the void, the power of the Slaughter Domain sufficed to turn the expression of the remaining few void creatures.
“Peng~” Many circular black ripples suddenly formed on the surface of that black-scaled creature. The black ripples easily obstructed the Slaughter Domain.
“Too weak, too weak. You are still too weak in front of Void Gods. “The black-scaled creature sneered.
Xue Ying was startled inwardly.
Such a powerful law domain!
He had fought with the ‘Hundred Leading Howls’ before, and the Hundred Leading Howls was one of the weaker Void Gods especially chosen by Forefather Tian Yu. Even though he could not control the void, there was no resistance provided just purely with the ‘Slaughter Domain’. If the other party did not conceal his strength, it was likely that he could suppress Xue Ying to death with just a single domain.
‘His power is stronger than the Hundred Leading Howls. This should be considered power which an ordinary Void God have.’ Xue Ying thought.
Xue Ying disappeared into the Mirage. He followed along the Mirage and got closer to the black-scaled creature.
“Over here?” The black-scaled was slightly interested. He was able to use the law domain to discover that in another level of world, that cultivator was getting closer to him, “This sort of concealing method is quite formidable.”
The spear pierced out from nothingness.
The spear body revolved and rolled out. The spearhead was covered with a black film light. To this, the black-scaled creature did not block it. It let the spearhead pierce onto its body. “Pu pu pu~” The spearhead was not controlled well enough. It pierced out a total of 119 times, yet it did not leave behind a single white point on the body of the black-scaled creature.
‘His body is stronger than the Hundred Leading Howls.’ Xue Ying was able to deduce it.
“You are too weak.” The black-scaled creature shook his head.
Despite that, Xue Ying continued to persevere on as he struck out again and again.
118 times, 113 times… it was extremely difficult to pierce through the scales which was covered in mysterious patterns. But this battle gave Xue Ying an opportunity to adjust his spear technique.
The black-scaled creature felt the strikes, yet it shook its head, “Too weak.”
“Hu.”
It suddenly extended its claws.
Every single claw was like a saber. There was black fog revolving the surface of the claws. As it casually clawed out, its claws forced their way into the Mirage world. Even though the power of the claws had diminished after entering the Mirage World, a single strike still landed on the body of the black-robed Xue Ying. Xue Ying tried to use his spear technique to parry against the attack, yet the opposing party was too strong-far beyond the strength his true body even after cultivating the 20th level of Walker’s Hidden Secret; his incarnation wholly shattered. The other party had incredibly perfect control of its strength, and it wanted to capture the soul within the body of Xue Ying.
“Don’t even think about it.” With a single thought, the strand of consciousness in his incarnation took the initiative to suicide! This was after all an incarnation, and if he did not take the initiative to suicide, the other party would be able to see through his disguise.
The moment the incarnation died, all his weapons and treasures were expelled from the Mirage world. These treasures had been given up by Xue Ying as well.
The black-scaled creature shook its head and sneered, “Truly too weak. He can’t even injure me at all.”
“Second Commander, you have already reached the Void God realm. How could a meager Ruler compete against you.” The other five True God Ruler Void creatures were all flattering him. Becoming a Void God was a checkpoint for most void creatures, and it was extremely difficult to get through. After all, they had reached the Ruler realm after being born into the world. And to reach the Void God level, they had to cultivate!
“I originally wanted to eat his soul, yet who would have thought that it took the initiative to suicide.” The black-scaled creature snorted. He then casually traveled through the void and left the place. The only attractive point such a weak little cultivator had for him was his soul.
“Quick quick quick, let us split up the darlings.”
The five void creatures immediately went splitting up the treasures left behind by the incarnation of Xue Ying. Of the treasures, some had been obtained by him after killing the two void creatures.
And to these items, Xue Ying did not care much. He temporarily faked his death to hide from his enemy.
…
But the natives of this primal chaos land-those powerful existences who had transcended, were watching this battle closely. Even though they knew that chances of being saved were minute, they still hoped for it! Because they had been in darkness for too long, and that was a pitch black which held eternal despair for them.
“Doomed.”
“He is ultimately still a Ruler and is too far away from being an opponent of that Void God monster.” These powerful existences had completely fallen into an endless abyss. The strongest amongst them were only Paragons! As for Rulers, they had long been sealed and imprisoned.
Facing this group of void creatures which came from the primal chaos void, they could not resist at all! The weakest amongst the group of void creatures were True God Rulers, and the strongest had reached the Void God realm! Void Gods… could practically massacre True Gods!
One had to know that even after cultivating to the limit of the Ruler realm in the extremely precious Voidwalker system, the ’20th level’, he was unable to defeat a Void God. He was required to cultivate other systems before he had the hope of defeating the Void Gods.
The holy ground of the laws and profound mysteries system, ‘Great Void Heaven Temple’ only had the most dazzling and highest statuses golden-robed disciples who could accomplish the task of killing Void Gods!
Surpassing the realm to kill Void Gods… that was something too rarely seen. Only ten such existences had emerged in a holy ground like the Great Void Heaven Temple.
“This cultivator which came from the primal chaos void is ultimately too weak.”
“It’s a pity that he died.”
“No hope. We are eternally doomed.”
These powerful existences felt sullen and unreconciled. But still, they were enduring it. Those who could not do so had either suicided or sent to death. Those who were left living were silently enduring it. They hoped for a miracle to come in the midst of endless darkness.
…
In the Mirage world.
The white-robed Xue Ying was currently standing here. He was extremely confident of his concealing methods. Other than the ‘Mirage world’ and ‘controlling of the void’, more importantly, he had three pieces of protective talismans which he got from being a golden-robed disciple. One of the talismans concealed his aura! The moment he concealed his aura, in most circumstances, only those at the ‘Primal Chaos realm’ of Void Gods could discover him. Very rarely were there who were at the ‘Unity realm’ could discover him, and these specialized in scouting.
But it was impossible for ordinary Void Gods to discover traces of him unless they had some mysterious treasures! Actually, he could simply rely on his ‘Mirage World’ and of ‘controlling the void’ to hide from these void creatures who were terrible in the realm, much less when he was even using the talisman.
“He is very strong.” Xue Ying muttered to himself, “Much stronger than the Hundred Leading Howls.”
“The body of my incarnation is too weak. If my true body was the one fighting, the gap between strength should not be too exaggerated. With the advantage I have in the realm and adding my Void God weapon.” Xue Ying spoke to himself, “Defeating him should be no issues. And there is a slight probability of killing him.”
“Furthermore, my understanding of them is still too little.”
Xue Ying looked far into a certain direction. Through the void, he was able to see the chain of palaces. This chain of palaces had forbidden his senses from penetrating into it.
“Treasure spirit, I’ll have to depend on you to scout that place.” Xue Ying transmitted over.
“Master, this is a minor matter. Leave it to me.” the Black Gourd treasure spirit was full of confidence, “But you have to get closer to that chain of palaces. As long as they are within the region that I can scout, I will be able to determine their strength clearly.”
Xue Ying revealed a grin. Very good.

chapters.title: Chapter 784 - Hope Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 784: Hope Arrives
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying relied on the survival talisman and void maneuver. Compared to the other void creatures, he was able to display the techniques so stealthily that it felt as if he were one with the void. The primal chaos void land was only this big, and in an instance, Xue Ying was able to reach the outer perimeters of the chain of palaces.
“Treasure spirit, you can probe through the palaces now right?” Xue Ying asked. He did not dare to barge in the place when he did not know anything about the enemies.
“It is enough. The entire chain of palaces is within my covered region.” The treasure spirit transmitted over, “Wu, fortunately, you did not barge in. There are a total of three Void God void creatures within the chain of palaces.”
“Three Void Gods?” Xue Ying felt a twitch in his heart.
“The three of them is discussing your matter currently. I am attentively listening to them now.” The treasure spirit turned silent for a moment before replying, “Oh Master, it was the Second Commander who fought with you earlier! And he should be ranked second in terms of power. The Third Commander and Second Commander are closer in terms of strength. The Great Commander’s soul is much stronger, but he should still be an ordinary Void God!”
Xue Ying turned taciturn as he contemplated.
“The Great Commander seems to be very concerned with your origin. He has already sent an order to investigate the treasures which you left behind.” The Black Gourd treasure spirit answered.
“He is still quite careful.” Xue Ying shook his head with a chuckle, “Have you investigated what this primal chaos land is called?”
Only by knowing its name would he know where this primal chaos void land is and which part it was on the void map.
“They did not discuss that. There are all sorts of structures and items within the chain of palaces, but we aren’t able to deduce the name of this primal chaos void still.” The treasure spirit helplessly said, “Oh right, Master, these three commanders seem to devour several living beings. I can deduce that they should be the crudest ‘devour class’ cultivation system.”
“Devour class?” There was a faint strand of indignance appearing in the eyes of Xue Ying.
Of the five sacred worlds, across the many cosmoses in the vast primal chaos void, there were all sorts of cultivation systems. But there were not many which could lead to the final stages of cultivation!
After all, a cultivation system that could reach the final realm required firstly for there to be seniors who could prove that it was achievable. And in the history, there were so few ‘Cosmos Gods’ that it felt pitiful. Naturally, there were also very few cultivation systems which proceeded on to the final stages of cultivation. Of which the simplest system to achieve this was the ‘devour’ class system.
The devour class system was all about devouring everything into one’s body! They would devour all sorts of living beings and souls. They could even devour an entire cosmos!
There were two crucial points about this system. One was that the more complex the devour technique, the more different it was in devouring ordinary living beings and devouring Void God weapons-one had to obtain different techniques for devouring different objects!
And the other crucial point was that one must be able to absorb and convert the devoured into his own body. This absorption cultivation technique was also different in different realms.
But the most fundamental cultivation techniques could lead directly to the ‘Void God Unity realm’. The devour class technique was extremely easy to obtain. Because the creator of the devour class system ‘World Ancestor’ had taken the initiative to publicize it. But to reach the ‘Primal Chaos realm’, they had to depend on the creator before they could obtain more profound techniques.
Devour…
The easiest way to devour and breakthrough would be unquestionably, to devour other cultivators! Thus, this system had produced many devils that wantonly devoured others. It also incited the fury of the public.
But ‘World Ancestor’ was too powerful.
He was faintly ranked in the top three amongst the existences who reached the final realm. His status could not be moved. Thus, the ‘devour class’ system did not die off. Instead, more and more cultivated this system, especially the ordinary ‘void creatures’.
“The strong feasts on the weak.” Xue Ying shook his head. Still, that level of existences at the final stage of cultivation was still too far off for him. But his fortune was not bad since the Great Void Heaven Temple he was part of was very powerful. Currently, there were two existences at the final stage of cultivation, Forefather Tian Yu and Lake Heart Island Swordmaster protecting it. No matter where reporting the name of the temple sufficed to shock others.
…
“I still hoped for a miracle.” After serving the void creatures, a white-haired teenager attendant sat inside his small courtyard. His heart was, however, filled with agony.
“When will these days last until?” The white-haired teenager attendant muttered to himself. The expression on his face remained calm though. He was afraid that the void creature would discover his expression in the dark.
Suddenly, the space beside distorted. A black-robed teenager appeared in front of him.
The white-haired attendant looked at this person with slight astonishment: “You, you… aren’t you…” The black-robed teenager was none other than the Ruler expert who had fought with the void creatures.
“You thought I genuinely died?” Xue Ying joked, “That is just a way to fool those idiots. The reality here has fused into an illusory world so the void creature which you serve will not be able to discover our existences.”
That void creature was at the Ruler realm, albeit his grasp of the realm was terrible. Xue Ying’s attainment in the Dao of Mirage made it easy for him to deceive a Ruler realm Void creature.
“Oh.” The white-haired teenager nodded a few times. At the same time, his eyes emitted light. He saw hope. He was not afraid that this person was lying to him since their current statuses were slaves and food for the void creatures. Naturally, the void creatures would disdain to even lie to them.
“Let me ask you.” Xue Ying said, “What is the name of this primal chaos void land?”
“What is it called?” The white-haired teenager was startled momentarily before shaking his head, “I do not know. I have never left this place and do not know what the primal chaos void land we are living on… is called in the outside world.”
Xue Ying frowned, “You have never heard of the seniors of your race say that before?”
According to his investigation of the void… the cultivators in the entire primal chaos void land still maintained their freedom. The strongest was only at the Paragon realm! As for the ‘True God Rulers’, he had discovered that they were all sealed and imprisoned.
“I’ve never heard of it before.” The white-haired teenager shook his head. Seeing the frown of this black-robed teenager in front of him, he could not help but say, “I might not know, but the Rulers should know.”
“Nevertheless, the Rulers are all imprisoned, and I do not know where they are locked in.” The white-haired teenager helplessly said.
“The Rulers should know?” Xue Ying lightly nodded.
He then chatted with this white-haired teenager about many matters. Only then did he add in at the end, “Endure for a little longer. I’ll definitely save all of you out, but I’ll need some time.”
“We can wait; we are definitely able to wait.” Hearing the promise of this person in front of him, the white-haired teenager felt like a drowning man hugging onto a piece of log. He hurriedly nodded and acknowledged. As long as there was a strand of hope… they would definitely grab it firmly.
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded. His figure soon disappeared altogether.
The white-haired teenager felt as if he were dreaming. But his expression regained its usual calm swiftly. He remained low-profile and continued doing his tasks as an attendant. But deep in his heart, there was already a flame burning brightly. This was the fire of hope!
…
Within a cold prison.
There was a male with messy black hair being shackled and restricted. Even his backbone was bound and locked to the prison. His soul was sealed too. There were many seals on the shackles he was constrained in, ensuring that his power was completely sealed.
His eyes were bleak. He had lived for far too long in these days of darkness without light.
“Why, why would it be like this?”
“Everything seems perfectly well with our lives on this primal chaos void land. Why would so many void creatures suddenly invade us?”
“Where are the other powerful cultivators? Why did they let all these happen without doing anything?”
The male with messy black hair only had despair in his eyes.
According to his knowledge, void creatures would usually not dare to conduct such an act because they would be quickly discovered the moment they remained for a little longer. There would be powerful cultivators descending to kill these void creatures. However, this group of void creatures had arrived for far too long and never had there been any cultivators passing by asking them what happened. Furthermore, he understood that it was not just his hometown primal chaos land that was occupied. The void creatures had similarly occupied many surrounding regions.
“Becoming their food, acting like slaves for them and when they want to eat us, they will eat us?” The male with messy black hair felt endless sorrow, “Even I as a Ruler has been forced to become a battle reward to a void creature.”
