The majority of the Rulers had been served as food reserves for the three commanders.
There was only an exception. Rulers would be granted to subordinates who had successfully significantly contributed, and this messy-haired male was one of them.
“Who will come and save us?”
“When will these days ever end?” The male with messy black hair was filled with despair in his heart.
“Hu.”
The male with messy black hair suddenly felt the void warping in front of his eyes. A figure had appeared. He was a black-robed teenager. This male with messy black hair felt both stunned and shocked. He tried his best to blink his eyes, and there was indeed a black-robed teenager appearing within the prison and was currently standing in front of him.
“You can feel rest assured. Nobody will know what exactly is happening here.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“Are you here to save us? To save this primal chaos land?” The male with messy black hair hurriedly asked.
“I’ll try my best. If nothing unforeseen happens, I have 80-90% confidence in saving you all.” Xue Ying answered.
The male with messy black hair felt light lighting up in his eyes.
“Do you know what this primal chaos land is called?” Xue Ying asked.
“I know.” The male with messy black hair immediately answered, “I’ve heard the monarch mention it before. This is known as the Chen Tie Great Land.”

chapters.title: Chapter 785 - Spreading the Name of Great Void Heaven Temple
chapters.content:
Chapter 785: Spreading the Name of Great Void Heaven Temple
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying immediately felt joy in his heart. He began comparing with the ‘void map’ he knew in mind.
The ‘Chen Tie Great Land’ was one of the many lands within the primal chaos void. It was closest to the ‘Eastern Unicorn Sacred World’ amongst the five sacred worlds. With his current speed, it should take approximately 100 million years if he were to leave for the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World from here.
‘The Eastern Unicorn Sacred World?’ Xue Ying thought, ‘I would not have thought that falling into the void corridor after entering the primal chaos void, I would have crossed such a great distance, directly arriving near where the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World is. It seems that I have to visit the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World first.”
He did not dare of returning to the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred world temporarily.
Because it was too far away.
The distance between two sacred worlds was originally very far apart. Because the distance was too far, he would face even more dangers on his journey. With Xue Ying’s current strength, even if he were to travel back without encountering any issues, it should take more than a cosmos epoch to travel! Such a long distance journey would have countless dangers that were sufficient to kill him off.
Thus, he would prefer to increase his power peacefully, and the stronger he was, no matter where he goes in the future like the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred world or returning to his hometown cosmos, it would be of a more relaxed journey.
‘The Eastern Unicorn Sacred World contains three Cosmos Gods and a Luo City Lord.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘To me, this is still alright.’
Of the three Cosmos Gods in Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, there was one who could possibly have a slightly worse relationship with Xue Ying. It was the teacher of Gu Qian Luo-Bone Ancestor!
There was also one with a closer relationship with Xue Ying and was also stronger than Bone Ancestor, the creator of the Voidwalker system-the Void Primogenitor! The Void Primogenitor stayed in the ‘Void God Temple’ at the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World for a long period. It was supposed that there were nine million void creatures within the Void God Temple. Of which, they had more than 10,000 Void Gods and were all loyal to the Void Primogenitor. The ‘Void God Temple’ was a power that was slightly more benevolent and a sect that hated evil. There was not a single void creature that could enter the Void God Temple which was wicked. Otherwise, the Void Primogenitor would have killed him first!
Like Xue Ying when he had gotten the Voidwalker inheritance, he had to go through the heart temperament trial.
“Blade Emperor, Ancestor Bone, Void Primogenitor, and Luo City Lord.” Xue Ying actually admired this Luo City Lord the most because the three existences at the forefront were all existences who reached the final stages of cultivation.
And Luo City Lord…
Was the only one amongst the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void that could fight against Cosmos Gods at the Primal Chaos realm according to what he knew and across the countless experts recorded in history.
That’s right.
The Cosmos God was also the final realm. The moment one broke through to this stage, there would be a world-shaking transformation in their power. According to logic, Primal Chaos realm existences that were even more talented would never be able to fight against Cosmos Gods. This was practically an ironclad law. But Luo City Lord had broken apart this ironclad law.
Luo City Lord was an extremely mysterious cultivator. Even though he was at the Primal Chaos realm, he had once fought with Ancestor Bone in a direct frontal battle and forced Ancestor Bone to retreat for his life. Even when he fought with the Void Primogenitor, he could suppress the Void Primogenitor with his strength! One had to know that the Void Primogenitor was the one who created the Walker’s Hidden Secret 60 level existence. Even Forefather Tian Yu was slightly weaker when fighting against him. But Luo City Lord was able to suppress Void Primogenitor.
Clearly, he could similarly suppress Forefather Tian Yu at the Primal Chaos realm level.
This was the only one… who had the status of Cosmos God despite not being one!
That was why the ‘Eastern Unicorn Sacred World’ seemed to only have three final realm existences, yet included Luo City Lord as one too. Even the final realm existences across the five sacred worlds respected this Luo City Lord very much. According to what Voidwalker Gu Qi wrote in his information, Luo City Lord had reached an extremely high realm, but he had somehow committed a taboo that led to him being unable to break through to the Cosmos God realm.
…
Xue Ying understood his position. He had an idea in his heart. He then asked, “Do you know how many primal chaos lands these void creatures have occupied?”
The male with messy black hair answered, “I have only heard from the monarch before. Monarch is the only Void God of this primal chaos great land of ours, and he is the one protecting us! The monarch would frequently go out to visit his friends, and his relationship with other Void Gods in the surrounding primal chaos lands is good. That day, the monarch had obtained news of his good friend saying that the void creatures had occupied more than 200 primal chaos great land nearby. That good friend of his had also escaped into the primal chaos void and was fleeing for his life. He asked him to flee as well.”
Xue Ying could not help but sigh inwardly.
This monarch had a good fortune to actually obtain news from his good friend.
One had to know that communication through the primal chaos void was extremely difficult. The further the distance, the harder it would be! It was to the extent that one had to construct a complex array and consume a significant amount of energy before one could transmit just a single message. For him, after leaving his hometown, he had no ways of contacting his hometown cosmos.
It should be a good friend that did not stay far from this monarch. That was why they could communicate.
“After the monarch received the information, he knew that things were amiss. Originally, he wanted to bring a large group of experts who transcended to escape. But many powerful existences are still gathering when the void creatures arrived.” The male with messy black hair shook his head, “That time, there were even a few Void Gods who came amidst the large group of void creatures. Our monarch was soon surrounded and devoured by them. Some of those void creatures then left, leaving only a few to stay here for a long period and occupy this area.”
“We have become their slaves and their food from then on.”
“Those who aren’t able to endure have died.”
“And it is only us who remain struggling at death’s door and desired for a miracle to happen that survived until now.” The male with messy black hair laughed bitterly, “They would force us to refine an avatar after every period for them to devour. They have treated us like cattle and an endless source of food. If not for harboring a strand of hope, I would have long been unable to withstand any further.”
Xue Ying nodded.
Turning all the living beings on a primal chaos great land into food, one could see how much relatively safer the ‘cosmos’ was. It forbade Void Gods from entering. Even the cosmic operating laws expelled outsiders. It was only places like the Devil Mountain Cosmos which had a protector was it so encompassing towards the outsiders. The Cultivator Cosmos was relatively encompassing too because a wild black dog was protecting it!
“Do you know what the names of the primal chaos great land around are?” Xue Ying asked.
“I only know some of them.” The male with messy black hair reported another 20 or so names. Xue Ying then compared it with his void map and knew that it was indeed the right region.
“Feel rest assured. I can tell you that you will all be saved. It is just that you all might have to endure for a longer period.” Xue Ying said.
“As long as we could be saved, we are willing to wait.” The male with messy black hair nodded.
…
On this primal chaos great land deep within a mountain range, there was a bamboo house. Xue Ying was temporarily staying here. The survival talisman which he brought with him all the time had concealed his aura to prevent any void creatures from discovering him.
“This is the first time using the summoning order.” Xue Ying flipped his hand. He took out a unique translucent triangular item. This was the summoning order which he could get as a disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple. Being a golden-robed disciple, this summoning order was relatively more precious.
In the five great sacred worlds or from practically almost any places in the primal chaos void, he could transmit an order using the summoning order back to the Great Void Heaven Temple!
For instance, asking for help…
Even though he was temporarily unable to return to the Great Void Heaven Temple, Xue Ying was not planning to ask for help. Being a golden-robed disciple, several had even taken the initiative to go out and adventure! Without meeting any dangers and inviting others to bring him back to the Great Void Heaven Temple? That was the real joke!
“Weng.” Xue Ying activated the summoning order, sending a message back to the Great Void Heaven Temple. The energy from this triangular summoning order surged, causing a frightening power to condense within. Following that, a significant amount of energy was consumed soundlessly. The summoning order also resonated with the distant Great Void Heaven Temple as the message was transmitted over.
‘More than 60% of its total energy has been consumed?’ Xue Ying felt startled inwardly, ‘It should take more than a month for me to actually recharge the energy of the summoning order to full right?’
Right now, there were only 40% of the energy left so he could not contact the Great Void Heaven Temple temporarily.
******
Great Void Heaven Temple.
It was located in a slightly unique space. Many mountains were floating within, and many mountain peaks had a cavern palace situated on top. At the center, and also the biggest floating land had a continuous chain of palaces. There was an even bigger palace which emanated light across the entire space.
This was also a place that would shake the world as one of the five sacred worlds, the ‘Great Void Heaven Temple’! One had to know that the number of Cosmos Gods in a sacred world could be counted with one’s fingers. And the Great Void Heaven Temple had two such Cosmos Gods protecting it. One could see how firm its status was, and how huge its reputation was.
Many figures were flying about.
“Great Void Command is also the administration ground of my Great Void Heaven Temple. There is actually someone who dares to mess around in our territory, turning lives on 15 primal chaos great land as tributes to the Ancestor Mother? Hmph, this is the Great Void Command. Even the true body of the Ancestor Mother does not dare to be so rampant in our territory. Hurry and send a disciple over, capture all of them and send them into the ‘Devil Smelting Prison’. If you could not capture them alive, then kill all of them.” The leading figure who was flying had a luxurious black gown on him. His blood-colored hair was fluttering about. His eyes were filled with horrifying cold intent.
“Yes, palace master.” A female behind him acknowledged. This palace hall master in front of her was actually the famous ‘Punishment Hall Palace Master’-Ancestor Devil!
According to rumors, Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster originated from the same cosmos.
But Ancestor Devil was someone who resonated closer with the idea of the strong feasting on the weak. After the Great Void Heaven Temple set up the Sky Temple Legislation, Lake Heart Island master took the initiative to arrange and let Ancestor Devil take up the position as the ‘Punishment Hall Palace Master’! At that time, the cultivators of the Great Void Heaven Temple became much more obedient. There were not too many who dared to disobey the laws of the Great Void Heaven Temple that easily.
“What is going on?” Ancestor Devil looked afar. On a huge crystal wall far away, many cultivators were discussing amongst each other. There was an uproar.
“There is actually a new golden-robed disciple!”
“Who would have thought that outside the ten golden-robed disciples, there would actually be a new golden-robed disciple emerging? He should have passed through the trial left behind by the forefather in the cosmos he created.”
“The Starting Cosmos? This cosmos should be where Swordmaster and Ancestor Devil come from right?”
These cultivators were all discussing.
Ten golden-robed disciples… they were all talented people who could fight with those above their realms. The news of a new golden-robed disciple emerging was soon spread out. Furthermore, he actually came from the same cosmos where Lake Heart Island Swordmaster and Ancestor Devil came from.
“Mn?”
Ancestor Devil obtained the news too.
Taking a step, he arrived right where the crystal wall was. The surrounding cultivators who saw Ancestor Devil felt so frightened that they obediently retreated to the sides. Ancestor Devil had cultivated for a short period, yet he had already stepped into the Primal Chaos realm. He was also a giant figure within the Great Void Heaven Temple. Furthermore, his actions were ruthless, and he was also the Punishment Hall Palace Master. This brought slight terror in the hearts of the cultivators in Great Void Heaven Temple.
Ancestor Devil looked up. There were many missions shown on the crystal wall, of which the three pieces of information ranked at the top three were what he wanted to have a look on. These missions… should be arranged according to the importance and time.
“Chen Tu Great Land and more than 200 primal chaos great lands have been occupied by void creatures. They have treated a large number of cultivators as food. The current mission has already been affirmed by the ‘Inquisition Sky Hall’ and has no mistakes in it. These void creatures can be all directly killed. The receiver of the mission can obtain more detailed information regarding this mission. This mission has been issued by the golden-robed disciple (Starting Cosmos) ‘Dong Bo Xue Ying’.

chapters.title: Chapter 786 - Action
chapters.content:
Chapter 786: Action
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Ancestor Devil saw this mission. His lips edged upwards. The smile he had made the other surrounding cultivators from the Great Void Heaven Temple feel a chill down their spines.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying?” Ancestor Devil muttered to himself, “It seems that a brat who is not bad has finally emerged from our Starting Cosmos. But why would he actually run all the way to Eastern Unicorn Sacred World region?”
“Even though it is far, and rushing over is quite troublesome, it has been a long time since I last went out for a walk. Maybe I should have a nice stroll and a great time massacring others. At the same time, I can take this chance to see this little friend from the same hometown as me.”
Ancestor Devil accepted the mission without second thoughts.
That mission which was originally on the crystal wall disappeared directly. With the power of Ancestor Devil, he had the qualifications to accept this mission. Even though he was one of the youngest existences at the Primal Chaos realm, he was not any weaker than those who cultivated for a long time and were at the Primal Chaos realm. His reputation had been carved out by killing!
“Hu”, Ancestor Devil turned around before leaving the place with a step. Only then did it made other cultivators let out their breath.
******
Chen Tie Great Land.
Xue Ying was cultivating here secretly. Even though he comprehended the Voidwalker system, Dao of Ripple and Dao of Mirage, the majority of his concentration was spent on the Dao of Slaughter-related art-”13 Apocalyptic Swords”. After all, if one said that the Voidwalker system enabled him to have a terrifying body and an ultra-offensive Termination Energy, then the “13 Apocalyptic Swords” was all about the usage of the laws and profound mysteries. After all, there was one point about the laws and profound mysteries which made it very formidable… the moment one comprehended it, even the incarnations could utilize it too.
“Mn?” The incarnation black-robed Xue Ying was training in the first apocalyptic sword deep in a desert. Even though his concealment techniques were great, the moment he began practicing the moves, if the enemies were currently scouting out across a large region, it was quite easy to discover Xue Ying. Thus, Xue Ying had relied on his incarnation to display the techniques. It was impossible for him to reveal his true body.
“I have been drifting across the primal chaos void for over 50 million years. Originally, I comprehended the majority half of the first sword, leaving only some crucial points which I had yet to comprehend. Nevertheless, after fighting with those void creatures, my first apocalyptic sword had consecutively broken through. And now, reflecting over the last battle gave me another huge breakthrough again!” Xue Ying revealed a joyous look, “Currently, I should be able to control my spear to such that only 35 holes are formed.”
Actually, it was normal. Previously, he had cultivated for a long period, allowing him to improve his comprehension of the first apocalyptic sword to a very profound stage and leaving behind only several few which required him to verify them in battles!
…
Time passed.
In one of the cities on the Chen Tie Great Land, there was a blacksmith courtyard with a cold-looking young man pounding on a blade embryo with a giant hammer. Suddenly, unseen strength permeated through the body of this young man and sealed his soul. At this moment, he could not even suicide.
The teenager felt his body tremble slightly. He lightly placed down the giant hammer in his hand.
“World Deity Dong Ye.” Suddenly, a gray-robed old man appeared in the courtyard. His voice was hoarse: “Master has chosen you.”
The young blacksmith calmly turned around to look at the gray-robed old man. He had an expression that did not seem like a smile and a smile: “Chosen me? Chosen me as food?”
“Yes.” The gray-robed old man said with a low voice.
“Hahaha, food, food.” The laughter of the young blacksmith was filled with madness. The surrounding ground was even trembling. Many weapons began floating up, and with ‘peng peng peng’, they started exploding. But even if the power was stronger, it was limited within the courtyard; the shockwave did not affect any of the mortals living outside.
“Cultivated to the stage three World Deity realm only to end up as food.” The young blacksmith looked at the gray-robed old man. His eyes were filled with cold as he chuckled, “You all who have transcended have become the claws and teeth of those void creatures, capturing us for them. Are you sure you are our seniors!”
The gray-robed old man said with a low voice, “Master can cover the entire primal chaos great land with a single thought. Even if he did not send us, Master could easily grab you over with a single thought. Sending me over is just because he is too lazy to act.”
“It is you all who are afraid of death!” The young blacksmith sneered, “We as World Deities have almost been eaten directly, and it is only your avatars which have been eaten. But you could still refine another out.”
“We are just food for a longer period.” The gray-robed old man said coldly.
“Then what are we living for?” The young blacksmith’s eyes were filled with madness, “You are just afraid of dying. I hate this. I hate it so much that I could not see the day that those void creatures die. You all had captured my wife and my teacher. Even my good friend had been taken away by you all. The void creatures ate all of them, and finally, it is my turn. Hahaha…”
“I only hate the fact that I could not see the day they die.” The young blacksmith seemed deranged.
The gray-robed old man only sighed softly.
He extended his hand before grabbing the young blacksmith. Following that, he tore through the void and left. Since he was alive, he would rather wait since he similarly hated those void creatures deep in his bones! How would the feeling of his avatar being eaten alive not be painful? It felt worse than death!
But they were still enduring for the sake of survival! They were waiting for hope to arrive, and deeper in the hearts of many others, they actually wished for the ‘void creatures’ to be killed one day! They wanted revenge!
…
Within the palace hall, a void creature which transformed into a human shape was seated there. His arms were long, and his head was slim. He had a single eye which was flickering with cold jade green light looking at the many cages below. The cages were locked with large amounts of World Deities, and the majority were humans. There were beasts and other lifeforms too, and they were currently revealing looks of terror, indignance, madness, and hatred.
“Heh heh heh.” This tall and thin void creature chuckled wickedly. With a thought, these ‘food’ within the prisons felt that they could speak once again.
“Void monsters, eat us then, we aren’t afraid of you!”
“Void monster, there will be one day when a powerful cultivator descends and kill all of you!”
“We are only leaving one step ahead. They will soon come!”
“Those existences who are high above, I beg of you, hurry and kill these void creatures. I will pledge my loyalty and believe in you for eternal.” These World Deities locked in the prisons were either cursing angrily, remaining silent or turning deranged.
They hated these void monsters. Because these void monsters had turned their entire primal chaos land into hell. They had too many friends whom they knew or true loves, life and death brothers, teachers and disciples being eaten up by these void monsters.
To the powerful existences who transcended, the void creatures had left them a strand of survival because swallowing powerful existences was still slightly useful for them. As for the weak World Deities… they were useless to the void monsters that were at the Ruler realm level.
They would rather enjoy watching the looks of despair on these weak little World Deities.
“Wu.” The tall and thin void creature listened with his eye squinted, “I have heard the terror. I have heard hatred. I have heard despair. This is wondrous and beautiful.”
The attendants by the side remained silent.
They who were powerful existences could survive… but the weaker ones were being eaten batch by batch. There were many more even weaker Deities, Transcendents, and mortals who were being eaten up by cities, or even by nations. It was all for the sake of joy and enjoyment of these void creatures.
“Alright, it is time to enjoy the delicacy.” The tall and thin void creature said. His face was filled with a look of enjoyment. This was his most blissful moment.
“Pu-”
A spear suddenly appeared. This spear rotated and rolled out. The spearhead contained a black film light, causing the tall and thin void creature to reveal horror. He hurriedly waved his arm to parry against the attack, and a layer of scale had appeared on his arm too. But the current spear was much stronger by a few times as compared to the past.
“Pu pu pu pu pu pu”… A total of 26 holes were pierced out in the body of that tall and thin void creature. The reduction of the holes meant an explosion of its power. The countless slaughter energy inherent within had instantly destroyed the body of this tall and thin void creature.
Only at this moment did Xue Ying exit from the Mirage. He held onto the spear and looked around at the throne which had been completely shattered into nothingness. There were only a few treasures left behind.
Just a single strike!
And the void creature was killed.
“I originally wanted to cultivate and become stronger and to endure further without acting. I am just afraid that the moment I acted, it would anger these void creatures which will affect many powerful existences.” Xue Ying’s eyes were filled with biting cold killing intent, “But it’s a pity that I am wrong. If I don’t act, then many batches of World Deities in this primal chaos great land, countless Deities, Transcendents, and mortals… would face doom.”
“For the sake of just a few dozen powerful existences and watch countless lives being eaten continuously…”
“That is something I cannot do.”
“If that’s the case, then I’ll just kill all of them. I’ll do my best to clean all of them out.” Xue Ying’s eyes were filled with a heaven shaking killing intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 787 - Gratitude
chapters.content:
Chapter 787: Gratitude
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The World Deities that were locked in the cages and were about to be eaten included that young blacksmith. They were staring at the void monster that stood high above who had a heaven-shaking power, dying right after receiving a single strike from the spear.
“Dead, he is dead!”
“Finally. Is there finally an expert coming?”
“Has an existence high above heard our pleas?”
These World Deities and the nearby attendants were all feeling extremely excited. The majority of the attendants was powerful existences. Their avatars were being eaten time after time, and they felt pain and despair. Some even felt their mental state turning warped! Some did not mind dying, and were living only to fulfill their desires of the void monster being killed!
And now, that void monster had really died?
Seeing the black-robed teenager walking out from the void with a spear, this single moment made the group of attendants and World Deities cry tears of joy. Some had even etched the appearance of this black-robed teenager in front of their eyes. They were filled with endless gratitude and excitement.
They were even willing to serve the black-robed teenager forever until they die! Eternal loyalty!
“It’s him?” Many of the attendants were able to recognize that this black-robed teenager was the one who had fought with the group of void creatures the previous time and died. But now, it seemed he had survived?
The black-robed teenager turned around, sweeping his gaze across the group of attendants and the World Deities locked in the cages. He stated, “This is the first!”
Saying that Xue Ying took a step and disappeared.
“Hahaha…”
“This day has finally arrived!”
“I’ve dreamed and desired for this day!”
“As long as I could see this day, I would be able to die contently!”
“It’s enough; it’s enough. Seeing the death of the void monster is enough.” Many World Deities being crying.
Even the attendants felt their bodies trembling after seeing this scene.
Furthermore, they soon received karmic transmissions from others: “Brother Qi Yan, the void monster which we served has been killed by a black-robed senior wielding a spear. He is that person who once fought with the group of void monsters.”
“It is the same on our side too.”
“Dead, he is dead. Hahaha, that monster has died. I’ve finally lived to see this day.”
…
Indeed.
Xue Ying had controlled three great incarnations at the same time. This was also the number which he could maintain with his incarnations at their strongest state. When the three great incarnations acted together, they killed three void creatures within the blink of an eye! And it took a single spear every single time.
Closely following that, Xue Ying did not hesitate. He immediately teleported through the void and went on to kill another three void creatures.
One could say that the void creatures did not have the time to react. And it was during this moment of ignorance that Xue Ying had consecutively killed nine void creatures! In addition to the two he killed when he first arrived on the primal chaos great land, he had killed a total of 11…
There were only five void creatures who were Rulers left on this primal chaos great land. And only at this moment did the three commanders receive the transmission from a void creature who was dying: “There’s an enemy!”
But that dead void creature only reported to his commander. The remaining five Ruler void creatures were still in the dark. The three incarnations of Xue Ying relied on the void to teleport and killed another three void creatures again.
Only at this moment did the three commanders come out. Only then did they envelop the entire primal chaos land to probe out what was happening. It was then they discovered that they only had two void creatures left remaining under their command.
“Dead.”
“The void monsters are dead. This day has finally arrived. They are dead.”
“The void creatures on our side is dead too.”
“It is the same on our side too!”
“Here as well! He is killed by a black-robed senior wielding a spear. The void monster is killed in a single move.”
“Hahaha…”
The news spread.
All the powerful existences, World Deities, and Deities on this primal chaos land were thrilled and ecstatic. It first spread to ten, then spread to a hundred, 10,000, a million… the many living beings were excited. Many were so happy that they cried, and some even began to revere the black-robed senior with a spear.
If Xue Ying issued a call for action, it would likely induce all lifeforms on this primal chaos great land to follow him willingly.
“Hold!”
“You are actually still alive!”
The three commanders were all indignant. Even though they discovered the three incarnations of Xue Ying at this moment, but… what was Xue Ying best in? It was assassinating others. Furthermore, he held an advantage in void teleportation, and he was able to use the fastest speed to arrive at the two remaining survival Ruler void creatures and strike at them!
One of the void creatures had roared in horror before dying.
As for the other, Xue Ying met some trouble.
“Hmph.” Following a snort, green lightning struck down at the incarnation of Xue Ying from nothingness. Xue Ying did not manage to strike the enemy when the green lightning struck his body. His spear technique could not obstruct this move at all, and his body was destroyed.
“He is indeed the Great Commander. But, it’s useless.” At the moment Xue Ying’s body dissipated, his eyes remained burning with killing intent.
Because at this moment, three incarnations appeared in the surrounding and attacked that void creature at the same time.
These incarnations were not afraid of being killed. Xue Ying could always form another with a single thought!
“Pu.” The three incarnations attacked at the same time. That void creature lifted his slender neck. His pink head was filled with despair, and the Great Commander only had the time to strike a single incarnation and watch the final Ruler subordinate being killed right in front of his eyes.
As Xue Ying struck on this void creature, his spear technique actually reached a new realm-he was able to control his spear technique to strike out and form only 12 holes!
From this battle when he first began attacking, he struck a total of 16 holes on the first void creature and now, he was able to strike just 12 holes.
Every single one he killed…
These void monsters had all sorts of strange defensive methods. Some depended on their scale armors, and some depended on their skins to shave off the incoming force. Some depended on flame energy, and some depended on dividing their bodies… due to the varying methods of defenses, it gave Xue Ying new understanding of his spear. He originally lacked the combat experience to verify the first apocalyptic sword, and now, he was improving at a rapid pace.
Compared to the over 100 holes he created when he first entered the primal chaos land, he was able to strike out just 12 holes at this moment, allowing the power of the spear technique to increase by more than ten times.
…
All the Ruler void monsters were killed. The attendants who passed by transmitted the news across, and soon, it reached the World Deities and Deities. They were genuinely excited and joyous.
“We are very satisfied to be able to wait and see this day when all of them were killed.”
“Other than the three strongest commanders, the other void monsters have been killed. Reaching this stage is enough for us.”
The attendants began releasing some of the trapped Paragons and Rulers.
They were holding their breaths in anticipation…
Watching the distant void, three black-robed teenagers were facing against the three commanders. Those three were horrifying Void Gods!
“This is all worth it.”
“Even if I die, I am content.”
“But this black-robed senior has encountered danger. The three void creature commanders will certainly not let him off.” All the people were watching this scene through the void. They could not help but feel their hearts tightening.
They had been engulfed in endless darkness.
And this time when a large batch of void monsters was killed, even though the three commanders were still alive, it was an unprecedented victory to the original natives of this primal chaos land! They felt as if their anger and resentment had been vented. They did not dare to hope for more and were very satisfied with what had happened already.
They were now worried for the black-robed senior-worried for his safety.
Many World Deities also understood from the powerful existences that this senior who had saved them was now in danger. Every one of them prayed for the senior to survive, and they were even willing to use their lives to exchange for the safety of that senior.
…
At this moment, Xue Ying did not feel terrified. His three incarnations each held a spear and were respectively situated around the void. Looking at the three Void Gods who appeared in front, their appearances were all unique. The commanding one had a golden wing with a savage head. His pair of yellow eyes were staring at Xue Ying. Beside him was the black armor-scaled monster who had once fought with Xue Ying before. And on the other side, it was a humanoid void creature with the biggest body filled with hair and had three eyes.
“Since you did not die the previous time, you should have just hidden. Never would I have thought that you still dared to come and seek for death.” The black scale-armored creature was slightly furious. He was the one who destroyed the incarnation of Xue Ying the previous time.
The three black-robed Xue Ying said at the same time, “The reason I came today is to kill the three of you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 788 - Cant find the True Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 788: Can’t find the True Body
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“You are just a little True God Ruler, yet you dare to say such big words?” The hairy humanoid creature with three eyes boomed, “There is a gap between a True God Ruler and that of a Void God which could not be reached. Even if there were a dozen or more than hundred Rulers, I can easily swallow them all.”
The black scale-armored monster was also full of disdain. Even as Xue Ying killed the large group of Ruler void creatures one after another, the three commanders did not feel any threat at all.
Because according to their experience, how could a Ruler ever surpass the realm to combat a Void God? What a joke!
Only those from the most apex of superpowers might possibly groom talents, but these geniuses could be counted with one’s fingers. Only then could the Rulers transcend realm and kill Void Gods. But how rare were these talents? Furthermore, they had three Void Gods. Not one but three together… and there was the Great Commander who had cultivated for an extended period-his strength was formidable.
“Big brother?” The hairy three-eyed humanoid creature turned to his Great Commander. That black scale-armored creature turned to the Great Commander as well.
The Great Commander squinted at Xue Ying before giving out his orders: “Move out and Kill him.”
“Yes.”
“Haha, kill.”
After obtaining the permission, both the black scale-armored monster and the humanoid three-eyed creature immediately moved.
One could see the black scale-armored monster release many circular black ripples from the surface of his body. The black corrugation of ripples swept out in all directions. As for the humanoid three-eyed lifeform, he had only released unseen an unseen ripple with his third eye. This ripple swept towards the three incarnations of Xue Ying and out in all directions.
The strangest thing was that their law domains did not interfere with each other.
“Hmph.” The three incarnations of Xue Ying hid into the Mirage World. This act significantly reduced the power of the black ripples. As for the unseen ripple, it was some sort of unique soul attack, and the three incarnations were being controlled by Xue Ying remotely. They were mere descents of his consciousness and could not resist the soul attacks.
‘I killed those Ruler realm void creatures previously, tempering and perfecting my apocalyptic first sword to a more profound stage. Currently, I can restrict it to just 12 holes. The three Void Gods in front are stronger, and fighting them… will definitely be very helpful in tempering and honing my skills. I must definitely make use of this opportunity to comprehend the apocalyptic first sword.’ Xue Ying thought to himself.
He was very clear that trying to kill the three Void Gods without comprehending the apocalyptic first sword was a dream.
Thus, he had to hurry and comprehend it out…
What he currently lacked on the apocalyptic first sword was practical combat experience.
“Hong~” In the Mirage World, one of the black-robed Xue Yings’ had teleported directly to where the humanoid three-eyed creature was. Closely following that, the spear in his hand had pierced out. The spear body rotated and rolled outwards. It was akin to an unseen law wheel rolling outwards and crushing everything. The stability of spearhead was slightly difficult to control as it jabbed out towards the enemy with a slight tremble.
The humanoid three-eyed lifeform directly extended his hand. That big hairy hand of his grabbed hold of the body of Xue Ying’s spear. “Weng~” The spear body was continually turning and rolling, preventing that big hairy hair from actually grabbing it firmly. The spearhead continued in its trajectory towards piercing right into his body; it stabbed through the thick fur and skin layer, piercing slightly into his body.
“You can injure me? Second Brother, did you not mention that his attacks were weak?” The three-eyed humanoid creature roared out with a booming sound.
A total of 11 small holes had formed continuously on the chest scale armor of the black creature as well. These small holes were rapidly recovering. He was also roaring out, “How would I know? It seems the power of his spear technique has greatly increased. He can actually injure me. But this minor injury isn’t much. Let’s hurry and kill him.”
If one said that the two incarnations had some result from their combat with the Second Commander and the Third Commander…
Then the attack sent towards the Great Commander…
The golden wings of the Great Commander folded close and remained there unmoving. That yellow eyes of his swept over the black-robed Xue Ying who leaped over. At that moment, a ‘pa’ was heard, and green lightning struck right into the Mirage and falling on the body of the black-robed Xue Ying. No matter how formidable Xue Ying’s spear techniques were, he could not parry against this strange green lightning, leading to the immediate death of this incarnation.
But it was only the extermination of a single incarnation. In the blink of an eye, another black-robed Xue Ying appeared in the distant void.
He could create an incarnation with a thought merely by relying on the strength of ‘Mirage World’ and the “3000 Incarnations” absolute art technique. Because he could not control much of the energy, the degree of strength each incarnation had was slightly weaker. It was on a similar level with the ordinary bodies of weaker Rulers and was far lacking as compared to Xue Ying’s true body.
Seeing another incarnation appear, the Great Commander squinted his eyes, “Such a formidable True God Ruler. He had never shown his true body right from the start and had only sent incarnations for battles. Furthermore, the technique which was used to condense the incarnation is extremely profound… ordinary condensation of incarnations uses the energy within one’s body to condense. But it seems he had relied on external world energy to form them. That is why we cannot find his true body at all.”
Like Void Gods, they could utilize the Void God energy in their bodies to condense an incarnation to battle. The moment the incarnation died, they had to pull out more Void God energy from their body again. In that case, the enemy could definitely rely on the disturbances created by the condensation of incarnation to seek the position where the true body was.
But it was different with Xue Ying. He relied on the Mirage World energy to condense the incarnation. That was why the enemies could not discover his true body.
‘Being able to form an incarnation with a single thought, his true body must be hiding somewhere nearby.’ The Great Commander thought.
If it was a giant at the Primal Chaos realm, he could condense an incarnation from a further distance forcibly. But the current black-robed Xue Ying was merely a True God Ruler, and being able to condense an incarnation with a thought represented the fact that he must be nearby.
In reality, that was the case. Xue Ying’s true body was within the region where the ‘Mirage World’ was! But the enemies could not find him.
“I must find him. Otherwise, killing more incarnations is useless.” The Great Commander was also very frustrated.
“Hong!”
The Great Commander displayed his law domain. At the same time, countless black thunderbolts in the vast space around. But those black thunderbolts were not as strong as that single ‘green lightning’. Nevertheless, they triumphed in terms of being able to strike across a larger area and were currently sweeping across into the Mirage World.
But after sweeping across the entire place, the Great Commander did not discover any movements at all.
‘How can I find him? Where exactly is he hiding at? He must be hiding nearby.’ The Great Commander became all the more distressed.
He cultivated in a system unlike the ‘hex’ of the myriad existences, and neither did he cultivated in the laws and profound mysteries system which had extremely mysterious methods. He also did not cultivate some of the more unique systems like the Voidwalker system. Instead, he cultivated the most straightforward and most direct-devour class system. This system was all about continuously devouring and transforming the energy towards becoming stronger. But they were clearly cruder when battling.
Thus, it was too difficult for him to discover where Xue Ying was hiding!
The Mirage World, the void concealment technique and the concealment talisman a golden-robed disciple had were three formidable techniques he used. Even if Bloodshed God-Emperor who had really mysterious methods came, it was impossible for him to find out where his disciple was.
…
The enemy could not find Xue Ying, and Xue Ying could completely immerse himself towards comprehending the apocalyptic first sword. He spent the past 50 million years comprehending it and had continuously improved his comprehension time after time when battling. Only through battling could he validate his comprehensions! If he continued burying his head in comprehending it, he might have to spend more than 10 million years before he could gradually succeed. Nonetheless, comprehending and undertaking actual battle would increase the efficiency of learning!
“Big brother, this Ruler is becoming stronger.” The humanoid three-eyed creature howled with a boom. He had three very obvious huge holes in his body, “You should hurry up and act.”
Xue Ying was able to control his spear to gouge out just three holes at this moment. It was clear that he would soon comprehend the first apocalyptic sword.
Since that’s the case, he was not disadvantaged now when facing this Second Commander and Third Commander.
“Killing more incarnations is useless if we can’t find his true body.” The Great Commander coldly shouted out. Saying that his eyes swept out before forming green lightning that rapidly struck at an incarnation. But this time, Xue Ying had actually used his spear technique to parry against the lightning.
The spear revolved and rolled. It contained a unique profoundness as if it could enter a gap when there was no gap. The spearhead held an extremely frightening Dao of Slaughter profound mystery which actually forcibly tore apart the incoming green lightning. Even though a slight remain swept across the incarnation of Xue Ying, it could no longer exterminate his incarnation anymore.
“His combat power has really increased.” The Great Commander was also becoming anxious.
Xue Ying’s true body was still pondering over the experience of using the spear to split apart lightning: “The Dao of Slaughter has become more profound, and I shouldn’t let it be too widespread…” After reflecting over the outcome of the battle, he was able to tweak his spear technique continuously. He was starting to feel that comprehending the first apocalyptic sword was very very close.

chapters.title: Chapter 789 - Apocalyptic First Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 789: Apocalyptic First Sword
The Great Commander was still thinking of ways to find Xue Ying’s true body. As Xue Ying fought with the Second Commander and Third Commander, he gradually understood the technique. It was a type of enlightenment in his mind, and finally, he had a clearer understanding of the first sword of “13 Apocalyptic Swords”.
This apocalyptic first sword did not have the slightest of aesthetic effects. It did not contain the aura of killing. What it had was a beauty that could make others drunk, as if everything was simple and pure.
This sort of extreme beauty had indeed turned Xue Ying drunk. He did not even dare to think how the Dao of Slaughter in the first sword was actually not complex at all! It felt like charcoal undergoing some miraculous transformation into an incomparably beautiful diamond. It was the profound mysteries of this simple Dao of Slaughter that actually fused together to make the ‘apocalyptic first sword’ so horrifying.
‘This is the realm which Forefather Tian Yu had reached. According to rumors, it is possible to cultivate the apocalyptic second sword successfully at the Ruler realm, though only one had ever done this since the ancient times.’ Xue Ying thought. The golden-robed disciples were all very talented, but even if an absolute art was placed in front of them, most could only cultivate the apocalyptic first sword at the Ruler realm. Nevertheless, Forefather Tian Yu was able to craft the stronger second sword for the Ruler realm, which went to say that there would always be someone stronger than others.
“Pu.”
The spear revolved and rolled out in a jabbing motion. This time, the revolution seemed very small, but that was a misconception. In reality, it was extremely quick. The spearhead lightly ‘tapped’ on the chest of the black scale-armored monster before gouging out a huge hole in it. Furthermore, this huge hole was still expanding even further in all directions. It was frantically destroying his body, and only after half his body was destroyed did it stop expanding. This caused terror to form on that black scale-armored monster.
“No!” The three-eyed humanoid creature shouted in terror, “Big Brother, save me!”
“Save me!” The Second Commander black scale-armored monster was not fighting anymore. He was frantically fleeing.
The two did not think that the incarnations who were comparable to them in strength previously had suddenly become so powerful. They could actually suppress them, and they would likely die after suffering from a few more moves.
“What?” The Great Commander who had been searching for the true body of Xue Ying suddenly teleported over with great shock, “Stay your hand!”
“Pu.”
Another spear.
The three-eyed humanoid creature which was heavily injured had completely been exterminated. Before dying, his eyes were filled with despair and disbelief. A Ruler actually killed him! Furthermore, it was merely an incarnation of a Ruler who killed him. But he had to be content as he died since it was a golden-robed disciple from the Great Void Heaven Temple who killed him! And furthermore, it was also a Voidwalker!
The black scale-armored monster had only suffered from the attack by a single incarnation. Thus, the Great Commander was able to save him barely. He directly kept him into his Eden treasure. During the moment he was saved, the black scale-armored monster felt his heart lightening.
In the midair, three similar black-robed teenagers stood surrounding the Great Commander.
The yellow eyes of the Great Commander swept across the three incarnations in front of him. His eyes were full of killing intent, and he said with a low tone, “I’ve long heard of some Rulers in the legends that cultivated several cultivation systems. Some are even within the sects of Cosmos Gods, and they are able to kill Void Gods as a Ruler! Even though I’ve only heard of it, I’ve never seen it before. But this time, I’ve finally seen it. You merely sent an incarnation to kill a Void God. That is truly formidable. I wonder which superpower did you come from? Which of the five sacred worlds?”
“Could you not guess it?” Xue Ying asked back.
“The body of the incarnations is clearly very weak, but your spear techniques are so mystical that they could draw out such horrifying force. You should be of the laws and profound mysteries system?” The Great Commander asked, “I’ve heard that the primogenitor of the laws and profound mysteries have long fallen. And now, the strongest should be the Great Void Heaven Temple in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. Are you from the Great Void Heaven Temple? But you are a Ruler and actually come to the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. Why did you drift so far off from Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World? It seems that I have guessed wrong and that you shouldn’t be from the Great Void Heaven Temple and should have obtained some formidable inheritance fortuitously that is part of the laws and profound mysteries system?”
Xue Ying chuckled, “You do know quite a lot. I still thought that your knowledge of the five sacred worlds is minimal.”
“You should leave. I can let you go without killing you.” The Great Commander coldly said.
“Leave? Not kill me? Why, are you able to find my true body?” Xue Ying sneered, “Since you can’t even find my true body, then don’t say about not killing me. Furthermore, I’m afraid you can’t even kill my three incarnations.”
The Great Commander’s expression changed.
“Die.” Xue Ying roared coldly. His three incarnations began acting at the same time.
He would never be merciful.
This time, the Great Commander had suffered from such great humiliation, and even the Third Commander had died. If Xue Ying left just like this, the Great Commander would likely vent his rage, bringing disaster to countless lives on this primal chaos great land! Thus, he naturally had to act and pull out the roots of the weeds!
…
Both parties began fighting immediately.
The three incarnations traveled in the Mirage World and began surrounding the Great Commander. They sent spear after spear to him, and the Great Commander fanned his golden wings, turning into indistinct lightning. His speed was very fast, and the fanning motion of his wings generated a frightening force. Every single golden hair on his wings was very tough and sharp, and was like a dagger! “Dang dang dang~”
The spear struck on the feather, leaving behind just some white spots and could not pierce through.
“His abdomen seems much weaker.” Xue Ying’s three incarnations acted together.
And the Great Commander released his domain to suppress all directions. He would occasionally release green lightning and strike with his wings and sharp claws. This actually made the three incarnations of Xue Ying to become helpless to it. Just a slight fold of his wings enabled him to protect his abdomen.
“He is much stronger than the Second Commander and the Third Commander. Not only strength or speed, but even his defenses are also more formidable.” Xue Ying remained glad.
Fortunately, he was someone who cultivated the devour class. Thus, he could only rely on some of the most fundamental energy.
If he were a Void God who studied the laws and profound mysteries system, his law domain would be more terrifying. Since those who relied on the laws to become a Void God would be able to form a law domain with the law they are most proficient in! And their combat techniques would become much more mystical.
As for those of the devour class? They were even cruder when fighting as compared to the Ancestor Mother Religion.
Thus, even though he could not injure the other party temporarily, the three incarnations were not worried about their survival because the offense of the other party was too direct. Xue Ying’s incarnations were able to dissolve them easily.
“Damn.”
“Why can’t I kill him. I can’t even kill any of his three incarnations.” The Great Commander was becoming slightly impatient. He recklessly attacked, sending out mighty attacks, but the three incarnations which seemed very weak in front of him, yet his spear techniques were so mysterious that he could dissolve the lightning sent his way easily. The incarnations were also able to dissipate the sweeping force from his wings…
“Pu!”
This was a spear with a violet wooden body. The spear body contained many seemingly ordinary patterns, but these patterns finally converged at the spearhead. Furthermore, the entire spear body was covered in a layer of black film light. It was the Termination Energy.
The spearhead tapped lightly on the other party. It felt like a kiss from a lover, striking out from the void. The Great Commander felt this movement and brought his wings to parry against the attack. But the spearhead had forcibly penetrated through the wings, piercing right through his abdomen and even across his body.
Xue Ying rapidly pulled back his spear.
He then disappeared.
It felt like he had never attacked, and had disappeared entirely.
“True body, that’s his true body.” The Great Commander’s eyes were wide and round. His expression was savage as he turned behind him, but no matter what, he could not find the other party any longer.
“Ah.” That hole which was formed through his wings and on his abdomen was rapidly expanding, eroding away his life force and causing him to reveal anxiety. He felt death was approaching, “Is it not said that those who cultivated in the laws and profound mysteries system specialize only in the laws? Why is the gap between his true body and incarnation so big? Why, why is this… so?”
It was a strength sufficient to fight against ordinary Void Gods!
And the Termination Energy which contained a horrifying destructive force!
Besides, Xue Ying also used the Void God weapon which he obtained as a golden-robed disciple, before using it with the apocalyptic first sword! Naturally, the power far surpassed that coming from his incarnations.
“No.”
He tried teleporting through the void to escape.
“Pu.” How could he rely just purely on his innate teleportation technique through the void to triumph against a Voidwalker who reached the 20th level of the Walker’s Hidden Secret? The spear pierced right out into his body before another merciless spear was sent his way once again.
Just three spears!
The Great Commander who wanted to escape fell back out. His body was rapidly being corroded, and he revealed looks of disbelief as he stared far behind his body. There was a white-robed teenager who walked out from the Mirage at this moment holding on to a violet spear. His eyes were extremely cold, and the three surrounding incarnations soon dissipated.
“True body? I’ve finally seen your true body. Tell me where did you come from?” The body of the Great Commander was rapidly being corroded. It had already corroded to his head, and the moment he finished speaking, his body had completely disintegrated.
“Great Void Heaven Temple, golden-robed disciple, Dong Bo Xue Ying.”
Xue Ying lightly said.
But it’s a pity that the Great Commander could no longer hear it.

chapters.title: Chapter 790 - The Battle During the Journey
chapters.content:
Chapter 790: The Battle During the Journey
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
After the Great Commander died, a large number of items dropped out from him. It floated in the surrounding. Xue Ying did not have the time to keep the items when a black figure suddenly shot out from one of the Eden treasures before starting to flee. He was the Second Commander that appeared previously, the ‘black scale-armored monster’.
“Fleeing?” The white-robed Xue Ying took a step before pursuing after him using the void maneuver. He sent out just a single spear from with a ‘pu’. Regardless of the capabilities in traveling through the void or the profoundness of the spear technique, Xue Ying far transcended these devour class void creatures.
“No, no…” The black scale-armored monster let out an unwilling howl. Nevertheless, he still suffered from direct destruction. That savage expression of his also disappeared as he disintegrated and turned into powder. He left behind some treasures too.
The white-robed Xue Ying coldly snorted. He did not even have the slightest of pity towards these void creatures who treated cultivators as food! Actually, from deep within his inner heart, he had quite a good impression towards the void creatures when he first left his hometown because of the Voidwalker primogenitor who was an extraordinary one. Nevertheless, regardless of whether it was the ‘Voidwalker Primogenitor’ or Xue Ying, they would never be merciful towards creatures like the Great Commander who wantonly devoured others.
Flipping his hand, he kept those treasures. He then refined several of the Eden treasures and storage treasures before looking through them.
‘Indeed, all the treasures are carried by them.’ Xue Ying thought. Previously when he examined the place, he had once let the Black Gourd treasure spirit probe through the chain of palaces. Nonetheless, he did not discover any outstanding treasures. Clearly, these three commanders did not trust their servants and had always brought with them the important ones.
‘Communication treasure?’ Xue Ying flipped his hand before bringing out a unique golden talisman. He frowned slightly, ‘It is tough to transmit a message through the primal chaos void. The further it is, the more difficult it will be. He should only be able to transmit messages to some of the nearby primal chaos lands. I wonder if I have been exposed or not.’
‘My harvest isn’t small this time. Look at how many unique treasures there are!.’ Xue Ying revealed a joyous look. Strictly speaking, he was slightly ‘poorer’. The precious treasures he had with him were all obtained because of his identity as a golden-robed disciple and as a Voidwalker. They were essential, and could not be traded.
Leaving his hometown, he had given almost all that he accumulated in the past to Jing Qiu, Yu’er, and Qing Yao. This time, he earned a big deal after killing the three Void Gods. All sorts of strange playthings, weapons, precious materials, and puppets were obtained. It’s a pity that he was unlike his teacher Bloodshed God-Emperor who studied the myriad existences. Thus, these materials could only be used for trading for other items.
‘Regardless, the more treasures there are, the better it’ll be since I can trade them for materials to help Jing Qiu and the others.’ Xue Ying had a smile on his face.
…
After the time taken to brew a cup of tea passed.
In midair, a large number of cultivators from Chen Tu Great Land gathered. The leading ones were the five Rulers who had been released. There were also a group of Paragons, ordinary powerful existences and a large number of World Deities. They were currently looking with gratitude at the savior of their primal chaos land.
“Senior has saved countless living beings of our entire great land, and yet we do not know how senior is called?” The leading person was a thin black-robed Ruler. He said respectfully and with gratitude.
“I am Dong Bo.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“Senior Dong Bo.”
These Rulers, Paragons, powerful existences and World Deities all shouted out in a chorus. All of them were respectfully saluting. They did this firstly because of Xue Ying’s combat power and secondly, from gratitude.
Xue Ying continued, “It is not the time to relax now. You should all understand that other than killing this batch of void monsters, there are still many others located on other primal chaos lands. If the news here hasn’t been leaked, then the Chen Tu Great Land will be quite safe for a period. But the moment it is leaked, you could all possibly encounter danger. I’ll protect all of you in the dark for 100,000 years. If no enemies come within 100,000 years, I’ll be leaving.”
“Many thanks, senior. “These cultivators were all incredibly grateful.
This Senior Dong Bo had saved them not because of friendship since they did not know each other beforehand. For him to be willing to protect the rest for 100,000 years was considered amazing.
“What I can do is only this. In the future, your destiny depends on yourselves.” Xue Ying said. Saying that, he took a step before tunneling through the void to reach the highest position of the primal chaos land. He then directly broke apart the obstacle and entered the vast primal chaos void.
Sending Xue Ying off with their eyes, this scene made the original natives feel complex in their hearts.
Before Xue Ying came… they had been living in darkness without seeing any hope at all. All of a sudden, this outstanding Senior Dong Bo who was still a Ruler came from the primal chaos void and killed all including the three Void God void creatures.
“Everyone, we must remember with reverence the huge favor granted by Senior Dong Bo to our Chen Tu Great Land.” The thin and wasted away black-robed Ruler said.
“We will always remember.”
These cultivators were never able to forget this day.
The legend of Senior Dong Bo had even spread across the entire Chen Tu Great Land. It was to the extent that in the far future, there was an ultra-strong expert who emerged from this Chen Tu Great Land and thus visited Xue Ying as a result. But that was a story for a long time into the future.
Outside the primal chaos great land, Xue Ying sat cross-legged in the primal chaos void. He relied on his senses towards the void to envelop the surrounding primal chaos land.
‘According to the location of the void map, it should take about 30,000 years to get from the closest batch of primal chaos land to here.’ Xue Ying thought. If there was anyone who rushed over, a protection period of 100,000 years sufficed. After all was said and done, he could not protect this place forever.
He would act according to his heart.
As he maintained alertness on sensing the void, Xue Ying was also cultivating with his eyes closed.
According to the guidance left behind by Forefather Tian Yu, the cultivation of the laws and profound mysteries required comprehending stronger and stronger absolute arts before creating one ultra-strong absolute art! To continuously seeking the pinnacle, one would deepen his understanding of the laws and profound mysteries. Once the cultivator accumulated enough, he would naturally break through.
He had succeeded in cultivating the first sword of “13 Apocalyptic Swords”. It had indeed broadened the perspective of Xue Ying, allowing him to reach a deeper stage with his usage of the laws and profound mysteries. Even as he looked at the 21st level array diagram of the “Walker’s Hidden Secret”, in the past, he could not understand it at all. But now, he could at least understand some points within.
This was actually a gradual upgrade of his realm.
‘I understand my limits. I do not dare to create an absolute art using the Dao of Slaughter that is stronger than the apocalyptic first sword.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘But I can definitely supplement the apocalyptic first sword using the profound mysteries of Dao of Ripple.’
‘Mn, let’s begin.’
The “Wind Ripple Path” was Xue Ying’s self-created absolute art that merged both Dao of Slaughter together with the Dao of Ripple.
The apocalyptic first sword was too profound!
Something perfected could no longer be changed! But using the Dao of Ripple, he could supplement and ‘add flowers on the brocade’. Xue Ying felt that this was something he could attempt. But just supplementing it was complicated since a slight error on his part would turn the supplement into ‘ruining the effect by adding something superfluous’. Still, Xue Ying was an expert who created the Wind Ripple Path himself. He was experienced in this, and that was why he felt confident to attempt it.
…
In the blink of an eye, 100,000 years passed.
The white-robed Xue Ying who was staying outside the primal chaos great land protecting the place opened his eyes. He did not discover any invaders at all.
“It is time for me to leave.” Xue Ying looked at this enormous primal chaos land behind him before using the void maneuver to leave the place.
He continued traveling for an extended period using the void maneuver.
After about 6,000 years or so, Xue Ying saw another primal chaos great land.
‘This should be occupied by the void creatures too.’ Xue Ying’s eyes were cold, ‘These void creatures who devoured and slaughtered countless living beings should all die. Fighting with them is also considered tempering for me.’
“Sou, sou, sou.”
At that moment, three black-robed Xue Yings’ appeared. Each had a strand of Termination Energy as they leaped towards this primal chaos great land at the same time.
Xue Ying was not foolish. Without having inside information of the enemies, he would only dispatch his incarnations over. If there were some ultra-strong terrifying existence within, he would swiftly escape with his true body that was located in the primal chaos land. Still, according to his guesses, meeting an existence at the level of ‘Void God Unity realm’ was slightly less probable.

chapters.title: Chapter 791 - I Am Luo Hai
chapters.content:
Chapter 791: I Am Luo Hai
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Arriving on this primal chaos land, Xue Ying’s three incarnations rapidly hid away within the Mirage World.
“Ripples…”
All three of Xue Ying’s incarnations stood in midair, robed in black. Unseen ripples swiftly enveloped the entirety of the primal chaos land. His true body had undergone purification using the primal chaos void energy and had become a darling of the primal chaos void. His incarnations, condensed from the Mirage World’s energy, had a relatively weaker control of the void. This time, it was more appropriate to use the ‘Dao of Ripples’ to conduct a large-scale investigation!
Ripples filled every corner of his surroundings.
The ripples of life, the ripples in the stones, the ripples in the plants, the ripples in the light… all these endless ripples were probed by Xue Ying.
“There are nine Ruler Realm void creatures, and a single Void God.” Xue Ying immediately discovered. “And the many beings on this primal chaos land that are indiscriminately being consumed as food.”
Through his probing, he discovered many powerful existences that had been locked up, with some even become servants to preserve their lives.
As for the World Deities?
There wasn’t much of any fighting spirit present in them. Instead, they were all filled with despair, with lethargy, madness, and hatred.
“Why are these void creatures so audacious? Why do they dare to be so rampant?” Xue Ying felt his intent to kill rising. His fury rose as he saw the despairing eyes of those lifeforms trapped in prisons, awaiting consumption. “The Void Primogenitor has long decreed an order. Even the Great Void Heaven Temple and Jade Light Sacred Ground have strict orders, so why would these void creatures be so daring to treat those cultivators as food?”
“Kill!”
The three incarnations moved at the same time.
Actually, that Void God had felt Xue Ying using the ripples to investigate, but disregarded it, returning to his slumber, thinking that his subordinates would be able to deal with the brat.
Within moments, this Void God learned he was wrong!
“Save me!”
By the time he stirred, only one of his nine subordinate Ruler void creatures was left. However, he could even save it, Xue Ying ultimately killed him.
“He can actually turn into multiple seed bodies to escape?” The last void creature only held out because of his unique ability. Having the appearance of a nest, it could dissolve himself into over 10,000 seed bodies. However, Xue Ying’s incarnation displayed the Slaughter Domain! With his understanding of the Dao of Slaughter, he had achieved some breakthrough in his Slaughter Domain, allowing him to instantly killing these weakened seed bodies.
“Hu hu hu.”
The three incarnations of Xue Ying soon reached outside the palace of that Void God.
The golden palace was dazzling and resplendent.
A white-furred, four hooved, aberrant beast walked out of the palace door. His white fur looked extremely pure and holy. His hooves traversed the void, step-by-step. His pair of golden eyes turned to Xue Ying: “You are just a little Ruler brat, and I never treated you as a threat. But you killed my nine subordinates in such a short time.”
“You’re next.” The trio of black-robed Xue Yings said at the same time.
“Is that so?” The white-furred four-hooved aberrant beast coldly said, “It doesn’t matter if they die. Being able to meet a Ruler with such combat power makes my dreary life more interesting.”
“You talk a lot of crap, die for me!”
The three black-robed Xue Yings disappeared into the Mirage World at the same time. They were moving closer to assault the enemy.
The white-furred, four-hooved, aberrant beast indifferently uttered: “Fiery Prison!”
“Hua~”
Flames rose in the vast surrounding region. Appearing just like flowers, countless flowers of blue fire easily permeated into the Mirage World, enveloping the three incarnations of Xue Ying. They split the incoming flames using their spear techniques, with the Apocalyptic First Sword being displayed. “Si la~” They had indeed forcefully pierced through the blue colored flames enveloping over.
However, there was still an unseen energy permeating through. It felt icy on the skin, but blazing hot once it entered one’s body.
The three incarnations of Xue Ying trembled as their expressions changed drastically. With a ‘chi chi chi’, their bodies shattered apart.
“Where is he? Where is his true body?” The white-furred, four-hooved, aberrant beast swept the place with his golden eyes. Simultaneously, he sent unseen ripples across the entire primal chaos land, and even beyond the world into the primal chaos void. However, he could not discover Xue Ying.
…
“Sou.”
Xue Ying’s true body had hidden really far away. The moment he discovered that his incarnations had died, he had immediately teleported far away.
“Law domain?” Xue Ying was dumbstruck, “He absolutely isn’t of the devourer cultivation system, he should have cultivated some other systems. He could actually perfect his law domain to such an extent? Such a realm should most likely be at the peak of the Void Origin Birth realm and should be reaching the Unity realm soon.”
Within the law domain, his words were laws.
For instance, he could set the laws-”I want to kill all living beings. All will die!”
Like the Starting Ground in Xue Ying’s hometown cosmos, there was a law set that made everyone who visited effectively mortal! Naturally, those who were strong enough like the ‘Lake Heart Island Swordmaster’ could resist this law with his strength.
That was the strength of the law.
Naturally, the law could not be casually set, requiring the cultivator to be proficient in a specific aspect. This Void God had definitely attained great accomplishments in the flame aspect, and that was why he could utilize the ‘law domain’ to such a degree. According to legends, existences at the ‘Primal Chaos realm’ were able to form an ultra-miniature universe with their law domain.
A domain was an ultra-miniature cosmos.
The ultra-miniature cosmos contained planets, stars, living beings within and the laws they set! If one could not resist the laws, he would die instantly within.
“My true body is stronger, and my survival capabilities are stronger too. I should be able to survive. But suffering from the suppression of the law domain, I should only be able to display 30-40% of my strength.” Xue Ying did not dare to fight as the gap between them was rather obvious.
Despite how talented a golden-robed disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple was, he or she was just a Ruler who could transcend the realm to kill ordinary Void Gods.
There would be no way for him if he met stronger Void Gods at the Origin Birth realm! He needed to comprehend the complex and mystical apocalyptic second sword! However, the difficulty of this apocalyptic second sword was something even those at the Void God Unity realm might not comprehend. There was only a single Ruler in the history of the Great Void Heaven Temple who had achieved it. One could clearly see how difficult it was!
******
This battle also gave Xue Ying new understanding that as of now, he could only bully the ordinary Void Gods or some of the Void Gods who were cruder in their fighting techniques. It would be troublesome if he was to bump into those that were more formidable than those void creatures.
The following period had verified everything too.
Xue Ying continued his journey and cultivation. He had also dispatched his incarnations to kill his way into the primal chaos land and proceeded with battling. He had killed several Void Gods, but somehow it seemed that they were also gradually getting the news, as the Void Gods started hiding and were no longer in the inner sections of the primal chaos great lands.
Those who stayed within the primal chaos lands were the ones that were stronger.
Xue Ying had even bumped into one at the ‘Void Unity realm’. The moment his incarnations had landed, the unseen law domain came and directly captured them alive! Fortunately, they were just incarnations, and with a thought, he was able to dissipate the incarnations. The other party assaulted his incarnations on the soul, but he had the “God Light Scripture” and the Walker’s Hidden Secret which allowed him to resist it.
“Frightening.” Xue Ying understood that even experts at the Void Origin Birth were those he could not fight against. As for those at the Unity realm… much less were needed to say about them.
…
As time flowed, more than three million years had passed. Due to Xue Ying had merely dispatched his incarnations over, he was able to hide far away by depending on the survival talisman. Nonetheless. his reputation was also being spread amongst the superpowers in these primal chaos lands.
“You are that little cultivator who only dares to use his incarnations to battle?” High up the sky in this primal chaos land, three black-robed Xue Yings were surrounding a single humanoid void creature. This humanoid void creature was black in color, appearing like a male, with a set of jade green armor over his body. His control of the void seemed no weaker than the true body of Xue Ying.
This humanoid void creature could not kill Xue Ying within a short period, but the three incarnations of Xue Ying could not injure him at all.
Nonetheless, Xue Ying was happily fighting.
“He is a good opponent. I can temper my spear techniques.” The three incarnations were attacking frantically.
“You can’t kill me. Even a Void God at the Unity realm can’t kill me easily.” The jade-green-armored black-skinned male was willing to battle too, growing in size as he fought with the Ruler in front of him.
“Brat, not bad. You are just a Ruler, and yet you can still fight with a Void God?”
Following that, a sound rang out.
A silver figure descended.
It was a silver-robed male with unique golden boots, with a saber strapped on his back. Making a sudden leap, he grabbed the jade-green-armored Void God without warning. It seemed to be an ordinary grab, but oddly, the jade-green-armored black-skinned male could not dodge it no matter what. He tried to counter-attack, but his head remained firmly in the silver-robed male’s grasp.
“Peng.” “Hong.” “Pu.” The silver-robed male relied on his hands and feet to brawl with the void creature. At times, he would strike with his knees, and at times he would hit with his palm, or even using his elbow. It seemed ordinary, but to Xue Ying, it felt amazingly mysterious. The degree of profoundness in combat had reached beyond the apocalyptic first sword.
Naturally, Xue Ying was able to determine that this silver-robed male was a Void God.
“I actually can’t kill him?” The silver-robed male said with some surprise.
“You can’t kill me. Even Void Gods at the Unity realm can’t easily kill me” The jade-green-armored Void God howled. He was infuriated by the stomping he received. But the silver-robed male’s body technique was bizarre. There were many layers of space within his body, making it such that any incoming attacks were teleported away.
“I still cannot succeed in cultivating this. Whatever.” The silver-robed male suddenly unsheathed the saber on his back.
“Hua!”
The blade flashed in the light.
Too fast.
Too stunning.
The three black-robed Xue Ying by the side widened their eyes. He had even tried his best to rely on the Mirage World in order to feel this blade, but it was too fast. The degree of profoundness made him hyperventilate. But it was not a stage which he could not grasp. He had pondered over the apocalyptic second sword too, and even though he had not comprehended it, he had some understanding of it. Xue Ying felt that this blade should be a level higher than the apocalyptic second sword.
“Qiang.” The silver-robed male sheathed his saber.
“I had to use my blade. A worthy death.” The silver-robed male turned towards Xue Ying, but the jade-green-armored male still stood, sneering. “Your blade did not-” his sentence was cut short. His body turned dark, and he fell, an intact corpse. The aura of his soul had been utterly extinguished. Several treasures floated out.
The silver-robed male waved his hand before collecting these treasures.
