“Brat, you are courageous.” The silver-robed male chuckled as he looked at Xue Ying, “Oh right, I am Luo Hai.”
“I am Dong Bo Xue Ying.” Xue Ying chuckled too. He had a great impression of the other party since he had finally found an expert who was willing to deal against these void creatures.

chapters.title: Chapter 792 - Fury
chapters.content:
Chapter 792: Fury
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“If you don’t mind, let us become brothers.” The silver-robed Luo Hai bluntly said. He had a sense of heroism deep within his bones, but he couldn’t help but wonder if this trait was exploited by his ‘friends’. He was not bothered by this though, because if he were calculative about it, he would also have trouble making friends naturally.
“Brother Luo Hai,” Xue Ying said immediately.
Luo Hai waved his hand to collect the fallen treasures. He raised his eyebrows, “Brother Dong Bo, this Void creature was killed by me. These spoils belong to me.”
“Of course.” smiled Xue Ying.
“Since I am not strong like brother Luo Hai, I did not dare to directly come into Primal Chaos Land with my true body. My true body located within Primal chaos void.” Xue Ying said.
“You are really cautious.” Luo Hai immediately left Primal Chaos Land with the incarnation of Xue Ying. Outside, they met with Xue Ying true body.
Xue Ying trusted Luo Hai. Any cultivator who was willing to come and kill this void creature would be someone he’d admire. Furthermore, he would now have some protection against those at the Void God Origin Birth realm. Golden-robed disciples of Great Void Heaven Temple weren’t that easy to kill.
When Luo Hai saw Xue Ying’s true body, he let out a smile. For a Ruler to show his true body was a great sign of trust.
Friendship was all about the other person as well.
“You…” Luo Hai suddenly stared at Xue Ying. He looked closely, “How come, how come you’re so young?”
When he looked at Xue Ying’s true body, he could guess how long Xue Ying had been cultivating for based on his soul aura. The aura emitted by Xue Ying showed that he was still young and had only cultivated for a comparatively short period.
“What an unfavorable situation, what a loss. I thought you had already cultivated for a long period when I proposed to become brothers with you. But now, looking at your youth, although we cultivators normally don’t care about age, you’re so young, too young. I’ve really lost out in this.” Luo Hai muttered.
“How long has brother Luo Hai been cultivating?” asked Xue Ying with a smile. He couldn’t see Luo Hai’s cultivation years. He only felt some vagueness when he tried.
Black Gourd treasure spirit also said, “This Luo Hai, I could gauge that he is at the Void God Origin Birth realm, but other than that I can’t tell anything. It seems that he has some protective treasure on him.”
“Me?” Luo Hai sheepishly touch his head and smiled mysteriously, “How long I have been cultivating? This is a difficult question. Forget it, don’t ask about it. Amongst other Void Gods, I’m old. Ai, there’s no way for me to compete with talented people like you. Do you know how much hardship and suffering I experienced during my cultivation till I reach this realm? It’s something you can’t imagine.”
Xue Ying grinned. Compared to others, his cultivation period was short. This Luo Hai seemed to belong to those who bitterly cultivated for a long period of time before he became a Void God.
But… Xue Ying still wrong! This brother of his, Luo Hai, had experienced more than what he imagined.
“Let’s go. Let us go to the next Primal Chaos Land and continue to fight. Only by fighting we can hone our strength. Moreover, these Void creatures really deserve to die.” said Luo Hai, filled with fighting spirit.
“Yes.” Xue Ying also agreed.
Luo Hai’s traveling speed in the void surprised Xue Ying. After cultivating the 20th level of Walker’s Hidden Secret, his Void Evasive Maneuver should be better than most of the ordinary Void God. But Luo Hai’s movement was ten times faster than him! Xue Ying calculated, perhaps he needed to cultivate until the 27th level before he could have the same speed with Luo Hai.
This traveling speed was truly frightening.
After 900 years.
Luo Hai and Xue Ying arrived at another Primal Chaos land.
“Brother Dong Bo, go, go and kill.” When he looked at that piece of Primal Chaos land, Luo Hai’s gaze was that of a hunter, eyeing his prey.
“Without doing any investigations?” Xue Ying continued, “How about I first send my incarnation to investigate and gain some intelligence through mirage?”
“You still plan to use your incarnation?” Luo Hai shook his head, “There will be no danger if you use your incarnation to battle. Without any danger, no matter what kind of fighting you get it will not make your blood boil! Moreover, your incarnation power will be vastly different with your true body power. Only by using your true body you will be able to fight with more powerful opponents. Fighting against more powerful opponents will help you a lot more than when you fight against ordinary opponents with your incarnation.”
“But, it will be easy to lose your life if you are using your real body.” Xue Ying was a little speechless. The path of cultivation required to be taken step by step. With such aggressiveness and no regard to danger, how was it that this Luo Hai could survive till now?”
On this path of cultivation, there’s nothing more important than protecting one’s life!
If he were as reckless as that, Xue Ying might even have lost his life in the previous Primal Chaos Land when he encountered that opponent who had reached the ‘Void Unity realm’.
“You need to be careful when you move alone. But now you have me. With me, there’s no need to worry about it.” Luo Hai continued, “This time when I ventured out, I discovered that this large area of Primal Chaos Land was invaded. That’s when I decided to kill all of the invaders. I’m aiming to annihilate them within a million years.”
“Within a million years?” Xue Ying was shocked, “Completely annihilate them?”
When Xue Ying sent his incarnation down, he could only kill weaker Void Gods. There was no hope for him to fight against the stronger ones. As news of his existence spread around, those weaker Void Gods had already run off to hide, while the stronger ones despised the thought of having to deal with him. Not that he had any way to fight against them. Now, Xue Ying could not find the weaker ones, yet he was currently unable to compete against the stronger ones. This made it difficult for Xue Ying to have any progress.
But with Luo Hai making his move, killing all the weaker ones. It would be easy to entice even the strongest one to come out.
“Rest assured, I will protect you.” Luo Hai looked at his newfound brother, Dong Bo, who was overly cautious, and did not dare to be reckless or do as he pleased. With a wave of his hand, Luo Hai took out a special token with the ‘Luo’ character written on it. This token also emitted a terrifying aura.
Looking at the token, Xue Ying felt like he was looking at an incomparably frightening sword glint. He felt it could split myriad things, split everything.
“My father is the Luo City Lord.” Said Luo Hai with a low voice, “You should be able to rest your heart now.”
Xue Ying shockingly looked at Luo Hai.
Luo City Lord?
Within Primal Chaos realm, among those apex final realm existences, Luo City Lord was one of the forefront figures. Of the three Cosmos Gods in ‘Eastern Unicorn Sacred World’-Blade Emperor, Ancestor Bone, and Void Primogenitor, only Blade Emperor was slightly stronger than him while the other two were weaker than Luo City Lord.
And that was because Luo City Lord was at the Primal Chaos realm, yet he could unleash such a power. If they were to compare in terms of their combat realm, then within the information provided by his teacher, the ‘Voidwalker Gu Qi’, he had even vaguely recognized that Luo City Lord was vaguely the expert with the highest realm. That was why his status was quite unique.
His teacher, Gu Qi didn’t leave behind much description about Luo City Lord, but it clear that he highly admired Luo City Lord. Besides, he also heard that Luo City Lord had good relations with Blade Emperor. That’s why in Eastern Unicorn Sacred World not many dared to defy Luo City Lord!
“Luo City Lord is your father?” Xue Ying looked at the silver robed youth who was carrying his sword in front of him. Xue Ying would never have thought that he would ever meet someone with such an impressive background like Luo Hai.
“You can be assured. But unless it’s necessary, I don’t want to ask my father for help.” When he mentioned about his father, his eyes become slightly different.
The other party had revealed such a secret to him, and there was no chance the token was fake with their location so close to the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, and with the fact that Luo Hai could live this long, he surely not that reckless and foolish. All those reasons made Xue Ying lose his inhibitions.
“Sou sou.”
The two of them turned into streams of light and descended into the vast expanse of Primal Chaos land.
…
Xue Ying did really not dare to think that he could be this unbridled-to sweep all enemies in front of him clean. In their usual plan, Xue Ying would attack first. Only if Xue Ying were unable to finish the fight after he went all out then Luo Hai would step in. With his power, Luo Hai could easily kill any ordinary Void God with his bare hands.
Only a handful of opponents with powerful survival abilities or Void Gods that reached Unity realm could force him to draw the saber on his back.
Once he drew his sword, not only he could fight and kill Void God at Unity realm, he even could help Xue Ying to escape without a trace!
On the vast Primal Chaos land, five majestic beings sat across one another. They were all transformed into humanoid figures, albeit with tentacles. Each gripped a wine glass and gulped their wine.
Their powerful auras made their surroundings appear distorted and constantly changing. Sometimes it appeared as black clouds rolling around, sometimes as lightning striking around them, and sometimes as cold frost.
“A silver-robed guest with a blade and a Ruler realm white-robed youth. Only two of them and they dare to be so reckless.” A majestic figure seated over on one side with ten tentacles said. With wine glass in hand, his big head rumbled, “They are killing everyone along their way. Leaving no one behind. According to their trajectory and their killing speed, they will soon arrive here.”
“This time, not to mention these two, even if they were two Void Gods at Unity realm, we must kill them.”
“Don’t kill them so easily. We must let them suffer in pain for a million years as the price of offending us.”
“Dare to provoke us? Humph, hmph.”
Xue Ying and Luo Hai were killing machines.
But this time was different. Group after group of their subordinates were being killed-slaughtered and swept away at high speed. This angered the five who were their leaders. These two daring cultivators needed to be quickly taken care of!

chapters.title: Chapter 793 - They appeared
chapters.content:
Chapter 793: They appeared
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Two figures appeared from nothingness. They were both Xue Ying and Luo Hai who were currently traveling together. The two did not hesitate in rushing towards the huge primal chaos great land ahead.
“Hahaha, you guys are finally here!”
The voice that said it was firm and reverberated in the boundless primal chaos void. Xue Ying’s expression could not help but change. Not good. He and Brother Luo Hai had finally met a true expert after killing their way here. They had not even entered the primal chaos great land when the other party discovered them and was apparently waiting for them.
“Slightly interesting. Brother Dong Bo, don’t be worried. Let us see what experts they have.” Luo Hai said with excitement.
Xue Ying was relatively helpless.
Luo Hai was someone who could transcend realms and fight with a Void God at the Unity realm. But for Xue Ying, he would be wiped out by someone in the Unity realm.
“Mn?” Xue Ying’s expression suddenly changed, “Be careful. They have long constructed an array, and the region it encompasses is extremely vast.”
Luo Hai turned over too.
He saw countless black cloud rolling in the vast, cold and lonely primal chaos void behind him. The black cloud obstructed everything, and its scope was beyond the region which Xue Ying could sense using the void! It sufficed to say that this array occupied an area more than the size of a cosmos.
“There are really few experts who have the specialization to construct such an array.” Luo Hai’s expression slightly changed too, “They have long constructed such a vast array because they are worried that we might teleport and flee. That is why they made it so wide.”
“No, this, this should be an array set by someone at the Primal Chaos realm.” Luo hai’s expression abruptly changed, “At least part of the array could only be refined by a giant at the Primal Chaos realm.”
Xue Ying also saw it.
The rolling black cloud enveloped every single area of the place. The black cloud actually contained lightning snakes swimming in it. Furthermore, beneath the cloud layer, there was rain falling suavely. Xue Ying could smell the ‘air’ despite being in the vast primal chaos void; there were actually rain and air in this region…
This had long reached the realm of one at the Primal Chaos realm. It was undoubtedly a Primal Chaos existence who refined the core of this array.
“It seems we’ve run into huge trouble this time.” Xue Ying began turning flustered.
The survival methods provided for a golden-robed disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple did not plan for him to resist a giant at the Primal Chaos realm.
The Voidwalker’s protective treasure, ‘Black Gourd’, even if he had become a Void God, could only be used to deal with the higher level Unity realm! It could not handle one at the Primal Chaos realm!
What was the Primal Chaos realm?
There were many Void Gods since it was relatively easier to attain the Void God realm using the Ancestor Mother system, the bloodline system, the devour class system and several other cultivation systems! But as for the ‘Primal Chaos realm’, no matter what cultivation system it was, the number of existences at this realm was so few that it felt pitiful. It was to the extent that every single Primal Chaos realm giant was famous across the five great sacred worlds.
Stepping into the Primal Chaos realm from the Unity realm would cause a qualitative change in one’s combat power! For instance, cultivating the laws and profound mystery system, the cultivator would be able to form an ultra-miniature cosmos in his body! Every single action of his contained the convergence of power from an ultra-miniature cosmos.
Cosmos Gods, if they did not use their true bodies and only sent their incarnations, would usually not be able to deal with someone at the Primal Chaos realm!
“There should not be an expert at the Primal Chaos realm personally arriving right?” Xue Ying speculated, “Even if there are over 200 primal chaos great lands, these should not be regarded highly in the eyes of a Primal Chaos existence.”
…
Regardless of his speculation, the surrounding black cloud, lightning, rainwater, and air were already a sort of revolving law coming from an ultra-miniature cosmos. The enormous array produced these. It was extremely difficult to control such an array, and even activating it would require the collective effort of several existences at the Unity realm.
“Are you afraid now that you know this?” A low voice sounded. There were five huge figures faintly appearing amidst the black cloud.
“Afraid? Just with you all?” The silver-robed Luo Hai sneered, “Whatever methods you have, send them over. Let me see your techniques.”
“Truly seeking death.”
A gigantic hairy hoof claw extended out from the black cloud. It was too big, and as it smashed down, it affected both Xue Ying and Luo Hai. Seeing this, Luo Hai pulled out the saber from behind his back. With a flash of his blade, a bright resplendent light was sent towards that gigantic hoof claw.
Xue Ying had already pinched the survival talisman in his hand. Being a golden-robed disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple, he had a total of three pieces of talisman, and they were respectively the concealment talisman, the teleportation talisman, and the defensive talisman. Facing such a terrifying array, it was definitely impossible for him to teleport, and neither was the concealment talisman useful. The only talisman he could use was the defensive talisman.
The defensive talisman could allow him to resist the attack from one at the Unity realm. Of course, it was useless if the other party was at the Primal Chaos realm. But the Black Gourd treasure spirit had already informed him that the five were at the Unity realm.
“Hong~”
The blade light and enormous hoof claw clashed.
Luo Hai’s body was jolted so much that blood leaked from the edge of his mouth. But he was able to resist the attack. He grinned before giving Xue Ying behind him a glance, “Brother Dong Bo, rest assured. As I said, I will protect you. These fools will not be able to injure you or me.”
“Relying on the laws of array yet I can’t smash him to death?”
“Activate the full power of the array.”
“Suppress him to death.”
“Bring it on.”
The enormous hoof claw came once again. But this time, the hoof claw had a world appearing vaguely on it. The world contained the rolling black clouds, thunder, rainwater, and air. It felt like the microcosm of the huge array. The power of this strike had clearly surged too.
Luo Hai coldly snorted after seeing it. The surface of his body released golden light. At the same time, this drizzle of gold light had also enveloped and protected Xue Ying at the same time.
“Hua.” When the hoof claw was slapped down, Luo Hai grabbed his saber with both his hands to resist upward against the incoming strike.
“Hong~”
This time, the incoming impact was clearly stronger. Luo Hai’s body jolted, and blood fog was spurted out from his mouth. The surrounding golden light had trembled, but it remained perfectly well.
“Even someone at the Unity realm can be easily killed by us together. But how is it possible for him at the Origin Birth realm to resist?” The five Unity realm Void Gods were greatly shocked. But they continued sending attacks frantically. “Hong, hong, hong…” The hoof claw kept on bombarding down. It was very taxing for them even to control this array, and supplementing the power of the array on that hoof claw already took their entire strength. Thus, they were only able to attack with just a single hoof claw.
But they were clear that the power of this hoof claw was enough to shatter an entire primal chaos great land!
Nevertheless, this silver-robed teenager was able to resist it! He had endured for more than ten consecutive attacks.
“Hahaha, rest assured.” Luo Hai spurted out blood again after being shaken by the attack. He turned to Xue Ying behind him, “Brother Dong Bo, did you see this? I said before that I’d protect you. They can’t injure you at all.”
After seeing this scene, at this moment, the status of Luo Hai had improved a lot in Xue Ying’s heart.
“Just with these methods?”
“You are still lacking! You’re old decrepit void creatures, I’m an embodied god, I’m so much stronger than you.” Luo Hai guffawed.
“Truly a bunch of trash!”
A cold voice sounded. It reverberated across every single area. It felt like there was a cold wind blowing in his soul. Both Xue Ying and Luo Hai felt their hearts trembling uncontrollably.
The distant five Unity realm experts had shown their true bodies. They were currently standing by the side with fear and trepidation and respectfully welcoming a thin gray-skinned male who had appeared. The entire skin of this male was inlaid with several pieces of bizarre metal, protecting his groin, his chest, and his back properly. He was extremely thin, so thin that one could see the bone on his body. He seemed just like a skeleton.
His eyes, though, was like the void.
Xue Ying’s expression changed. He had only left his hometown for so long, and being a little brat who was not even a Void God. To meet with someone at the Primal Chaos realm? That time, the Lake Heart Island Swordmaster had reached this realm before leaving his hometown cosmos. That was a realm that could contend against the laws in the Starting Ground.
Luo Hai also felt his throat becoming dry, “Did we not just kill a few little fellows? Why would someone at the Primal Chaos realm appear personally? This is trouble! Might I have to ask Father to come?”

chapters.title: Chapter 794 - Ancestor Devil Shows Himself
chapters.content:
Chapter 794: Ancestor Devil Shows Himself
Across the five great sacred worlds and the primal chaos void, there were very few who could reach the ‘Primal Chaos realm’. All those who could were able to become a forefather that occupied a region with countless cultivators pledging their loyalty to them. They even had a working relationship with the ‘Cosmos God’ because the experiences Cosmos Gods had were not very useful for them.
If it were easy, there would not be so few who reached the final realm of ‘Cosmos God’!
Somehow, killing these ‘Origin Birth realm’ void creatures across 200 pieces of primal chaos land had actually riled a Primal Chaos realm existence out. This was something unfathomable.
“Heaven Weeping Sect Master.” Xue Ying was able to recognize this terrifying existence from the accurate intelligence he got. He was one of the three giants under the Bone Ancestor sect, ‘Heaven Weeping Sect Master’. When a sacred son like Gu Qian Luo died, Ancestor Bone would not even blink his eyes. But comparatively, to the ‘Heaven Weeping Sect Master’, Ancestor Bone would smile and treat him politely since he was the left and right arm of Ancestor Bone.
As proud as Luo Hai was, he could not speak temporarily.
…
The Heaven Weeping Sect Master seemed thin, and his bones could be seen, but every bone of his was thick and solid as if it was as firm as some of the Void weapons. Even as he stood there, this skeleton-like person emitted an aura which stifled the five Unity realm void creatures.
From the Unity realm to the Primal Chaos realm was just a single step, but the gap between them was bigger than that between the ‘Paragon’ and ‘Ruler’ realm.
“A bunch of trash. I am cultivating a secret technique and tasked you with guarding this place. You can’t even complete such a minor task.” The Heaven Weeping Sect Master coldly said.
The five subordinates of his nervously acknowledged. They did not even dare to argue back.
And now, the gaze of the Heaven Weeping Sect Master landed on the distant Xue Ying and Luo Hai. Reaching his level, he would not casually kill others so foolishly because he understood that there were some terrifying existences in the five great sacred worlds and the primal chaos void which he could not offend easily. Even Ancestor Bone who was behind his back could not do so.
He had become a great enemy with one of the Cosmos Gods, the Voidwalker Gu Qi. As a result, he was forced to flee and was even injured heavily to the extent he almost died. One could see how much more careful he had to be the stronger he was.
“Mn?” Heaven Weeping Sect Master first looked at Luo Hai because the body of Luo Hai was too tyrannical, “Such a powerful body. Even the ordinary Void Gods under my sect do not have one who could compete against him. The True God Ruler beside him has a slightly more unique body, and it should be related to a formidable void-related secret technique.”
There were many secret techniques which could temper the body in inclining towards the void aspect. Thus, Heaven Weeping Sect Master was unable to affirm if he were a Voidwalker.
“Two brats.”
Heaven Weeping Sect Master extended his hand.
“Hong~”
Countless black rain droplets formed in the surrounding. These black droplets formed a vast hand which grabbed both Xue Ying and Luo Hai within moments. The two did not even have the time to escape. It was too fast that Xue Ying could not even activate the defensive talisman in his hand since an unseen pressure had already caused his soul to slightly stop.
Xue Ying felt the suppression of his willpower. Even breathing was very hard for him. He could not control the True God energy in his body, and everything felt hazy in front of him. His ears were ringing.
Death. The aura of death was incoming.
“Am I going to die just like this?” Xue Ying was utterly unwilling. Even though he had prepared himself mentally to die after leaving his hometown cosmos since the road of cultivation was filled with many dangers, he had never even reached any sacred worlds ever since he left his hometown, and dying like this felt like a great injustice. Furthermore, the reason they acted so rampantly was because of the urging from Luo Hai. Luo Hai was the son of Luo City Lord, and with the status of Luo City Lord in the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, it should have been fine.
“Tell me where you are from! This is your only chance of surviving.” The Heaven Weeping Sect Master’s voice directly transmitted into the soul of Xue Ying.
Xue Ying felt himself saying it uncontrollably, “Great Void Heaven Temple golden-robed disciple, Dong Bo Xue Ying.”
“I, Great Origin Land…” Luo Hai had just started speaking out of his will when a golden light flashed in his eyes before he struggled free from the manipulation.
“Great Origin Land?”
Heaven Weeping Sect Master felt vaguely puzzled after hearing it. He had an inkling that this silver-robed teenager might have a greater background, but he had never heard of the ‘Great Origin Land’ even with his current identity, “Unless, it is the name of an ordinary primal chaos land? There are too many primal chaos lands out there, so it is possible for some to be unknown to others.”
The matter on Great Origin Land fleeted across Heaven Weeping Sect Master’s mind before his gaze landed on Xue Ying. This True God Ruler who did not seem remarkable actually startled him.
“Great Void Heaven Temple golden-robed disciple?” Heaven Weeping Sect Master coldly said, “Such audacity. The Great Void Heaven Temple is at the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, and you, a golden-robed disciple, actually traveled all the way to the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World to destroy my plan. How disrespectful…”
Xue Ying felt helpless. How would he know that a Primal Chaos existence would pop up! He opened his mouth and wanted to speak, but under the unseen pressure, he could not speak at all! Clearly, the Heaven Weeping Sect Master was not willing for him to speak.
Instead, Luo Hai was able to force himself to speak, “Brother Dong Bo, you are quite formidable to become a golden-robed disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple! I’ve heard that the golden-robed disciples are all treated like darlings in the Great Void Heaven Temple, and the temple will selectively groom them. Whoever dares kill one of the golden-robed disciples will incur the wrath of the Great Void Heaven Temple, who will send large numbers of experts over.”
Xue Ying could only squeeze out a grin. He could not speak at all.
Indeed, what Luo Hai said was not wrong.
Golden-robed disciple…
They were the apple of the Great Void Heaven Temple’s eyes. If some of the lower-leveled ordinary disciples died outside while adventuring, it was rare for there to be a large movement even if the temple investigated the reason for the death. Unless of course, the injustice was too high. As for the golden-robed disciple, the moment one was killed, the Great Void Heaven Temple would treat it more seriously. They would not easily let things go since there were only 11 golden-robed disciples currently in the entire Great Void Heaven Temple when Xue Ying was included. These people were the future of the Great Void Heaven Temple!
Thus, if one wanted to kill a golden-robed disciple, he had to weigh and ponder if he could withstand the fury of the Great Void Heaven Temple!
If the Heaven Weeping Sect Master were in the ‘Ancient Sacred World’, he would definitely not be afraid and would kill without a second word! Because the Great Void Heaven Temple would not dare to kill their way into the Ancient Sacred World. However, it was different with the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World as the Great Void Heaven Temple had an excellent relationship with several superpowers in the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, and only had a worse relationship with Ancestor Bone.
Thus, the moment he killed Xue Ying, it was sure that the Great Void Heaven Temple would fight their way over. And it was likely that the Ancestor Bone would not be able to withstand it! Since the current Great Void Heaven Temple was much stronger than before.
“Since you dare to offend me, then just stay within my ‘Ghost Weeping Pagoda’ for 100,000 years. If you were to survive fortuitously, then I’ll let you go for the sake of Great Void Heaven Temple.” The Heaven Weeping Sect Master coldly said. The Ghost Weeping Pagoda was a place which he used to imprison and torture others. Even Void Gods would howl grievously after entering it. That was why it was called ‘Ghost Weeping’.
Most would usually die after being tortured. Under normal circumstances, Xue Ying could indeed not withstand for 100,000 years, but Heaven Weeping Sect Master might be speaking like this-he would savagely torture Xue Ying to vent his anger-but he would let Xue Ying survive with his little life! If the golden-robed disciple did not die, the Great Void Heaven Temple would not make a big fuss over it.
“Ghost Weeping Pagoda?” Xue Ying felt confused. He knew many things, but he did not know what the Ghost Weeping Pagoda was. But hearing from how it was named, it must not be something good.
“Heaven Weeping, how kind of you to allow the golden-robed disciple of my Great Void Heaven Temple to enter your Ghost Weeping Pagoda for 100,000 years.” A cold voice sounded out in the nearby vast void.
One could see a figure appearing from the rolling black cloud. The array could not obstruct him at all. This person was wearing a luxurious black robe, and his blood-colored hair fluttered in the wind. His pair of cold eyes made these void creatures feel cold. They loved killing, but when this existence came, they felt their hearts trembling.
“Why not I bring you over to my Great Void Heaven Temple Punishment Hall’s Devil Smelting Prison and let you have a taste of it?” The black-robed blood-haired person said with cold killing intent. He had even begun letting his aura permeate through the soul of the Heaven Weeping Sect Master-it was of extreme cold, slaughter, and cruelty.
The Heaven Weeping Sect Master felt his expression changing slightly. He coldly snorted before expelling the unseen pressure from the other party,” Great Void Heaven Temple, Ancestor Devil?”
“Peng peng peng peng peng.”
Suddenly, the five Unity realm void creatures by the side all exploded like ice. They exploded into many pieces of dregs before turning into nothingness. At the same time, the black rainwater which originally grabbed hold of Xue Ying and Luo Hai was frozen before it directly shattered.
Xue Ying and Luo Hai were both controlled to fly to the back of Ancestor Devil. Xue Ying looked at Ancestor Devil with joy. Ancestor Devil?
Ancestor Devil stood there. He did not even look at the five Unity realm creatures who died. He coldly said, “289 primal chaos lands. All the void creatures will be killed without pardon. Those five were the first.”

chapters.title: Chapter 795 - Are You Here Yet?
chapters.content:
Chapter 795: Are You Here Yet?
Since the array no longer had someone controlling it, it dissipated too. That was also the array which was bestowed by Heaven Weeping Sect Master to his subordinates. And currently, with Heaven Weeping Sect Master personally acting, he no longer cared about the array!
“Ancestor Devil, I’ve long heard that you are more untamed and unbridled. It is truly the case. You have just entered the Primal Chaos realm recently without cultivating for long yet you dare to challenge me?” Heaven Weeping Sect Master was genuinely indignant. Even though he did not care about them personally, they were still five Unity realm experts under him. Killing them right in front of him truly meant that Ancestor Devil belittled him.
Reaching his level, he would absolutely not let things go after being humiliated. As his anger rose, the surrounding void started crumbling too. Nevertheless, the region surrounding Ancestor Devil remained quiet as he looked toward Heaven Weeping Sect Master.
Ancestor Devil remained cold from start to end. He did not even have a strand of ridicule.
“Ancestor Devil…” In the heart of Heaven Weeping Sect Master, detailed intelligence related to Ancestor Devil started forming.
Ancestor Devil was extremely unbridled.
According to rumors, that time when he arrived at the Great Void Heaven Temple, he did not even regard those from the same sect as him. He had even called himself ‘Ancestor Devil’. One had to know that such a term was slightly egotistical to him when he was still at the peak of Unity realm at that time. After all, a place like the Great Void Heaven Temple was a place none dared to call himself ancestor!
Xue Ying might be called Monarch Dong Bo from those in his hometown cosmos, but if it were in the Great Void Heaven Temple, he did not dare to be so rampant and directly call himself as ‘Monarch Dong Bo’.
When he was weak, he should be low-profile.
But Ancestor Devil was different!
At that time, he actually riled up a group of Unity realm experts in the Great Void Heaven Temple together. The experts of the Great Void Heaven Temple were different from those in the outside world. Firstly, their combat power was stronger as they studied the ‘laws and profound mysteries’-related techniques. Amongst which, the geniuses were even more amazing! But as they challenged Ancestor Devil, none won!
And not long later, Ancestor Devil reached the Primal Chaos realm. With how ambitious he was, he wanted to challenge Lake Heart Island Swordmaster! But what made Ancestor Devil helpless was that the Lake Heart Island Swordmaster who had been in long-term cultivation had already reached the final realm of cultivation-Cosmos God!
Ancestor Devil was undoubtedly an absolute peak grade talent-he was able to attain the peak Unity realm in his hometown cosmos, and entering the Great Void Heaven Temple, he had attained enough resources to undergo a qualitative change to reach the Primal Chaos realm.
But that Lake Heart Island Swordmaster… he was matchless, outstanding across all five sacred worlds. In the Great Void Heaven Temple, after reading through a large number of scriptures, he was able to easily comprehend and break through to the Cosmos God realm.
‘He is the Great Void Heaven Temple Punishment Hall Master. According to hearsay, he had defeated the Sky Water Palace Palace Master from the Great Void Heaven Temple before being trounced by the Inquisitive Sky Palace Palace Master.’ Heaven Weeping Sect Master contemplated silently, ‘He took a shorter period to break through into the Primal Chaos realm, and the gap with the Inquisitive Sky Palace Palace Master is slightly obvious. Mn…’
Actually, Ancestor Devil had reached the Primal Chaos for a very long time, albeit it was short to an existence like Heaven Weeping Sect Master who had lived for a very long period.
…
To speak this description would have taken a long time, but the thoughts occurring in his heart were but a flash.
Heaven Weeping Sect Master decided to act. He did not believe that he could not triumph over a new junior with his extended period of cultivation.
“The laws and profound mysteries only contain flashy moves. I’ll let you know your own stupidity!” Heaven Weeping Sect Master’s voice resounded. At that time, endless primal chaos void in the surrounding began forming rainwater. There was a downpour of this black rainwater.
Xue Ying and Luo Hai both felt how horrifying the surrounding rain was.
Ancestor Devil remained standing there. There was endless cold frost emerging in the surrounding. The frost aura engulfed the entire region, causing an enormous frost land to be formed. And the rainwater that fell there froze.
“Your ultra-miniature cosmos cannot triumph against me.” Ancestor Devil said.
“Hmph.”
Heaven Weeping Sect Master then extended his hand. The skin of his palm was shriveled. His hand which seemed like skeletal claws came grabbing outwards. It seemed very ordinary and everywhere it passed, there was not a strand of ripple. But Ancestor Devil turned solemn. He knew that the Heaven Weeping Sect Master had stepped into the Primal Chaos realm for far too long. Maybe the degree of how he battled might seem ordinary, but his combat power was extremely tyrannical.
Ancestor Devil also sent a palm out. His palm was crystalline and tender. It was faintly transparent. His body had also evolved into an ultra-miniature cosmos, and currently, the power of the cosmos was gathered in his palm. He had even sent the strength of the Primal Chaos realm “Myriad Devil True Body”.
“Dong!”
The two palms clashed. The surrounding space formed many black cracks. The presence of the black cracks caused all energy and space to disappear.
Xue Ying and Luo Hai were watching from the side. They were also being protected by Ancestor Devil, yet they still feel their souls being jolted.
Both Heaven Weeping Sect Master and Ancestor Devil merely trembled from the impact. They took a slight step back.
“What?” Heaven Weeping Sect Master was startled, “The strength of his body seems to not be any weaker than mine? This body of mine has been tempered for a long time, yet, yet…” He could feel that the other party had purely used his strength to fight against him. He did not utilize any soft techniques.
His strength was slightly stronger even amongst the Primal Chaos giants. It was amazing to be ranked above average since every Primal Chaos giants were extraordinary.
“My Myriad Devil True Body is still too weak. Despite fusing strength with the energy from the ultra-miniature cosmos, I can’t even suppress Heaven Weeping Sect Master.” Ancestor Devil slightly frowned, “This Heaven Weeping Sect Master has many wicked techniques. Even if I could hold an upper hand, the advantage I have over him will not be too obvious.”
“He specialized in the laws and profound mysteries. Now that I do not have superiority in strength, it is impossible for me to win even if I used all my other methods.” Heaven Weeping Sect Master was not willing to accept this outcome, but it was the reality.
…
“You guys should leave.” Heaven Weeping Sect Master coldly said.
“Leave?” Ancestor Devil coldly answered, “I’ve said before that I’ll kill every single void creatures across the 289 primal chaos land without pardon.”
“I’ll immediately send an order to let them leave.” Heaven Weeping Sect Master nonchalantly replied, “As for how many you can kill, it’ll depend on your strength.” With the primal chaos lands situated all around, how many could Ancestor Devil kill even after splitting his body apart when all void creatures escape?
“Killing them is a minor matter. You must destroy that robe of yours which you have been refining.” Ancestor Devil continued.
Heaven Weeping Sect Master’s expression had a considerable change.
Robe?
He spent a long period collecting all sorts of materials to refine it. Now, he was also collecting terror across the 200 over primal chaos lands to fuse them into the robe to refine it. He had even added the ‘Heaven Weeping Sacred Robe’ as his name. Adding up his strength, it would suffice to increase his overall combat strength by 50%.
Right now, this robe had already been refined to 90% of completion.
“You actually know of it?” The expression on Heaven Weeping Sect Master was slightly savage, “It seems you have already investigated it.”
“I’ve been investigating for a long period in the dark.” Ancestor Devil coldly said, “With my temper, I do not care if you refine that robe of yours. But the rules of Great Void Heaven Temple stated that any treasure which has used the terror and hatred of countless living beings to nurture must be destroyed!”
“Destroyed? On just your word?” Heaven Weeping Sect Master sneered.
He did not care too much about giving up 200 over primal chaos great lands. He did not care about the death of some of his subordinates. But he had spent too much effort and blood on the ‘Heaven Weeping Sacred Robe’, and even if Ancestor Bone came personally, he would not give it up still! Because to experts, their own combat power was still the most important!
“Right. Just my words.” Ancestor Devil’s eyes turned colder. His killing intent shot into the sky. Even though he was not certain, he still wanted to battle and kill this Heaven Weeping Sect Master.
“Hong long~”
A mysterious aura descended. Endless white bones appeared in the surrounding. The surrounding frost ground and black rainwater all disappeared, leaving behind just a continuous land of white bone which one could not see the end of.
Xue Ying and Luo Hai felt bone stuck in their throat after seeing this boundless white bone great land. They had their own vague guesses.
One could see a figure appearing in the distance.
He had white hair which trailed over his shoulders. Even though he was slightly older, from his facial features, he seemed relatively handsome. He was also wearing a relatively luxurious white robe.
A luxurious white-robed white-haired old man looked towards Ancestor Devil, “Great Void Heaven Temple Ancestor Devil, bring your men away.”
“Oh?”
Fighting spirit rose in the eyes of Ancestor Devil, “Ancestor Bone, an incarnation of yours isn’t able to frighten me. Fighting one on two, hahaha, things are getting interesting.” Saying that, many figures walked out from the body of Ancestor Devil. There was a blood-colored figure, a tall and sturdy figure, a figure filled with scales, a charming figure…
There were a total of six incarnations all located at different places.
The true body was situated at the center!
Ancestor Devil’s laughter was slightly mad, “My Myriad Devil True Body contains six great incarnations. Even though I haven’t truly perfected it to large success, they can still be used to fight this battle. Come on.”
Xue Ying and Luo Hai held their breath behind Ancestor Devil.
It was okay if the two of them offended Heaven Weeping Sect Master. But the appearance of Ancestor Bone, someone at the final realm…
“Dad, have you arrived yet? The battle is escalating. If they were not careful, I’d likely be affected by it.” Luo Hai transmitted a message to his father. During the previous time when the Heaven Weeping Sect Master grabbed him, he had already sent a message for help.
“Hahaha, I’ve long arrived. The Ancestor Devil of Great Void Heaven Temple seems to be quite an interesting person. I’ll have fun watching it first.” A sound resounded in the mind of Luo Hai.

chapters.title: Chapter 796 - Luo City Lord
chapters.content:
Chapter 796: Luo City Lord
Luo Hai let out a sigh of relief at that point. He felt much more relaxed, and somehow, his attitude towards this turned to that of a spectator enjoying the hustle and bustle: “Hmph hmph, Heaven Weeping Sect Master, I’ll let you be delighted for now. Later on this Heaven Weeping Sect Master will become ‘Himself Weeping’ instead.”
However, Xue Ying was unable to relax. Ancestor Devil might be formidable, but he was currently facing the Primal Chaos expert ‘Heaven Weeping Sect Master’ and an incarnation from the legendary Ancestor Bone.
…
Ancestor Devil currently had six great incarnations. His fighting spirit was roaring.
The luxurious white-robed old man shook his head with a smile after seeing this. He casually sat down, and the many white bones behind his back naturally condensed into a throne. Sitting on his throne, his left hand was placed on the glossy white bone armrest as he looked towards Ancestor Devil with a smile that did not seem like a smile: “Ancestor Devil from the Great Void Heaven Temple, I and Tian Yu from your Great Void Heaven Temple have known each other for a long period. I came personally to mediate the conflict, and shouldn’t you respect this old man a little? Isn’t it just collecting some terror and hatred to nourish a treasure? The strong lives and the weak dies.”
“Hmph, if not for the rules, I would be too lazy to care about this either.” Ancestor Devil’s voice reverberated the surrounding endless white bones. He indeed believed more in the ideology of survival of the fittest, with the strong feasting on the weak. That was why he created the Dark Abyss. He continued with a cold tone, “But I am of the Great Void Heaven Temple. The Void God Palace and other superpowers have long set down the rules, and as the Great Void Heaven Temple Punishment Hall Master, I must naturally abide by the rules and the laws. Heaven Weeping Sect Master naturally must suffer the punishment!”
“The rules, those are made by you all, but they aren’t agreed by me.” The luxurious white-robed old man chuckled, “Furthermore, I have given you Great Void Heaven Temple a lot of respect by letting you bring your men away. Otherwise, it is impossible for you to leave after coming here to destroy the matters under my subject.”
“Impossible to leave?” Ancestor Devil swept his gaze across and stared at Heaven Weeping Sect Master.
Heaven Weeping Sect Master sneered, “Right, it is impossible for you to leave if you do not do so now. I urge for you to scram. Otherwise, you can’t even survive.”
“I’ll give you one last chance. Bring your men and scram from here.” The luxurious white-robed old man ordered with a chuckle.
Ancestor Devil’s eyes turned cold: “Oh? Just with you all?”
“Truly seeking death.”
The luxurious white-robed old man’s left hand lightly tapped on the armrest. His body abruptly faded before condensing again. His aura was rapidly rising. The endless bones in the surrounding also gradually started transforming, and every single bone was ‘jade-ified’. One could even feel a grand operating law appearing clearly in the surrounding. This was an operating law that felt extremely cold and tyrannical, and the law seemed majestic. It was not any weaker than the operating laws of a cosmos.
Ancestor Devil’s expression had a huge change as he turned towards the luxurious white-robed old man: “True body?”
With his current realm, he was only able to discover that the aura of Ancestor Bone had wholly transformed. He was no longer an incarnation but was the actual body instead!
“It’s too late!” Ancestor bone nonchalantly extended his hand. A savage-looking black great hatchet appeared in his hand. This great hatchet contained simple-looking golden patterns on it. The edge of the hatchet was faintly cutting the void. He casually threw it, causing the great black hatchet to fly towards Heaven Weeping Sect Master.
“The true body of Ancestor Bone is over here?” Xue Ying might be weak, but he was able to guess that.
His teacher Voidwalker Gu Qi had given great details on every single final realm existence. Ancestor Bone once used two ribs of his as the core, along with many other precious materials to finally refine a horrifying weapon-Black Rattan Hatchet. It seemed tyrannical, but in actuality, it was an extremely sinister final realm weapon.
Final realm weapon was also a Cosmos God weapon! It was a treasure at the highest level.
If talking about strength, Ancestor Bone was considered at the lower rungs among the final realm existence. But this ‘Black Rattan Hatchet’ of his was very famous. It was ranked in the forefront across many final realm weapons because there were two of his own bones included at the core of the weapon. That was also why it could unleash the greatest strength only when the weapon was in his hand.
Ancestor Bone’s most important weapon had even appeared, which naturally meant that his actual body was here too!
“Hold.” Ancestor Devil suddenly shouted.
Heaven Weeping Sect Master who just grabbed hold of the Black Rattan Hatchet felt extremely thrilled. He could feel the unfathomable strength inherent within the Black Rattan Hatchet. It seemed as if he was grabbing the weapon, but in reality, the weapon was being controlled by Ancestor bone. He was merely borrowing the hand of Heaven Weeping Sect Master to use it.
“Previously, I let you go, but you didn’t go. Now, you want to go, but I’m not letting you, so you’re asking me to stop?” Heaven Weeping Sect Master sneered.
Ancestor Devil put his hand to ask the other party to hold while transmitting to Xue Ying at the same time: “Dong Bo Xue Ying, I know that you are from the Starting Cosmos, and also from my old hometown. That is why I accepted this mission to come and have a look at my junior. Yet who would have thought that I have been schemed in the dark by Heaven Weeping Sect Master? Now that we are in a dire situation, with the true body of Ancestor Bone around, it is impossible for me to escape! In a while, I’ll use a secret technique to send you away. Ancestor Bone will definitely deal with me, but he’ll disdain to even act against you.”
“Senior Ancestor Devil.” Xue Ying felt slightly anxious.
“Rest assure. Even if I were captured by him, I would only suffer from some torture at most. Even if that old skeleton has greater guts, he will absolutely not dare to act against the Primal Chaos expert from my Great Void Heaven Temple.” Ancestor Devil transmitted, “Right now, I’ll divert the attention of Heaven Weeping Sect Master before sending you away! Even though Ancestor Bone will disdain to act, Heaven Weeping Sect Master will definitely obstruct me.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying understood how urgent the current situation was.
“This little friend, I’ll send you away with Dong Bo Xue Ying together?” Ancestor Devil turned to Luo Hai.
“You don’t have to care about me. I have my ways of surviving.” Luo hai transmitted confidently.
Ancestor Devil was slightly stunned.
He was still so confident at this moment? What was his origin?
Actually, with the astuteness of Ancestor Devil, he had long discovered that Luo Hai was much calmer than Xue Ying. At this moment, for him to be so calm, either he was truly prepared to die or that he was absolutely confident of himself.
…
Ancestor Devil transmitted a message to Xue Ying on one end, and he was coldly laughing at Heaven Weeping Sect Master on the other hand: “Heaven Weeping, even if you have the Black Rattan Hatchet, you aren’t my opponent still! Defeat my six great incarnations first before speaking!” The moment he finished speaking, the six incarnations around Ancestor Devil turned into streams of light and had practically surrounded Heaven Weeping Sect Master within moments.
Heaven Weeping Sect Master held onto the hatchet. There was a sneer by the edge of his mouth. He only swept the hatchet horizontally.
“Hua.”
A very dull black light swept across all six incarnations of Ancestor Devil. This black light cut across in the shape of a fan, and Ancestor Devil was startled to discover that all six incarnations of his had somehow been restricted. It felt like an invisible shackle was tying all six of his incarnations, making it such that any movements they made were languid.
“Pu~” At that moment, four of the six incarnations had directly dissipated after being cut horizontally, leaving behind two which condensed back successfully.
One was a black shadow incarnation, and another was a black liquid body. These two incarnations were the two with the highest survival capabilities.
“What.” Ancestor Devil was stunned.
Even though Great Void Heaven Temple had final realm weapon too, usually when Forefather Tian Yu and Lake Heart Island Swordmaster sparred with Ancestor Devil, they would control their power and would not use their final realm weapons.
Ancestor Devil might have an opportunity of tasting how it felt like to fight with someone with a final realm weapon, but the ‘Black Rattan Hatchet’ was much more terrifying than he expected.
“You can’t escape. The two brats behind you can’t escape either.” Heaven Weeping Sect Master held onto the Black Rattan Hatchet. He was too lazy to even care about the two incarnations of Ancestor Devil, and had charged right towards the true body of Ancestor Devil, “You and the two brats behind you will soon find out what it means to be in pain so much that you will not want to live.”
Suddenly, time stopped.
Heaven Weeping Sect Master with his Black Rattan Hatchet had stopped in midair. Even Ancestor Devil who was using a secret technique in the dark could not move. The edge of Luo Hai’s mouth was smirking upwards as he watched on, and that expression was frozen. Xue Ying had a nervous look which was completely solidified too.
In reality, within the realm of Heaven Weeping Sect Master and Ancestor Devil, it was extremely difficult to influence them with time flow, and making them stop moving was even more difficult.
Xue Ying and Luo Hai had even stopped thinking. At this moment, time was entirely still for them.
It was better for Heaven Weeping Sect Master and Ancestor Devil since their souls were able to maintain a slightly slower speed of contemplation.
“Who, who exactly is it?”
The two were slightly terrified and shocked.
They were not even afraid of Cosmos Gods if their incarnations came. If the true body of a Cosmos God came, they would only triumph over them because of the gap in their power, unlike this situation which the other party could control time to the extent that they could not even move. This was seriously too horrifying.
One could see a figure appearing in the white bone great land. A young man wearing a loose dark blue robe was strolling slowly over.
“Luo City Lord?” Heaven Weeping Sect Master and Ancestor Devil were both enlightened.
Cosmos Gods were able to become so unparalleled because they were able to wield the strength of a cosmos. And ‘Luo City Lord’ was clearly at the Primal Chaos realm, yet his realm was too high. The laws and profound mysteries he controlled… were much more horrifying than what Forefather Tian Yu and Lake Heart Island Swordmaster did! His realm had simply reached an unfathomable stage.
Comparing realms, even the strongest existence across the five sacred worlds located in the Ancient Sacred World and many other terrifying existences that were either in the dark or not, and even Voidwalker Gu Qi all recognized that the realm of Luo City Lord should be the strongest.
“Old skeleton.” The young man wearing a loose dark blue robe, ‘Luo City Lord’, looked towards Ancestor Bone, seated on his white throne far away.
Ancestor Bone’s expression was slightly ugly. He stood up from his white bone throne with slight awkwardness.
“Say, how would you explain to me.” Luo City Lord stared at Ancestor Bone.

chapters.title: Chapter 797 - Inquiry
chapters.content:
Chapter 797: Inquiry
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Ancestor Devil and Heaven Weeping Sect Master were not even moving. They could not hear anything at all. One could see Ancestor Bone lowering his posture towards Luo City Lord. They knew that the power of Luo City Lord was much higher than Ancestor Bone and even stronger than Forefather Tian Yu of the Voidwalker Primogenitor.
It was just that they were both final realm existences, and he could keep his life even if he could not defeat the other party. So why the need to be so careful?
The two could at least see what was happening. Xue Ying and Luo Hai only felt that time had stopped entirely.
…
Ancestor Bone stood up from his white bone throne. He tried his best to squeeze a smile out: “Haha, Luo City Lord, such a coincidence. Who would have thought that I will meet Luo City Lord at such a desolate place? What exactly is it that attracted Luo City Lord over? Is it Ancestor Devil? Is it the two brats? It can’t be that you are observing me and Heaven Weeping right?”
“I am asking you to give me an explanation for this!” Luo City Lord looked at him.
Ancestor Bone’s expression became uglier.
“That time I allowed to let you enter the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World and receive protection from the sacred world was based on your agreement to the conditions.” Luo City Lord continued, “If not for Yuan requesting me for help, how could you even enter the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World? Right now, you have entered the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, yet you aren’t abiding by the rules which I set?”
“Luo City Lord.” Ancestor Bone continued, “Firstly, I did not violate your rules. These 200 over primal chaos lands are occupied by the void creatures, devouring them, killing them, and inciting terror and hatred… They are totally unrelated to me! You can even use time-space to investigate that this is something I truly do not know of. It is a matter which Heaven Weeping Sect Master personally did.”
“Secondly, Heaven Weeping Sect Master might have done such matters, but these primal chaos lands are amidst the primal chaos void and isn’t located within the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World! You can forbid others from violently massacring within the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, but in other sacred worlds and even the primal chaos void… it is too difficult for you to ban.”
Luo City Lord looked at Ancestor Bone and said indifferently, “Alright. I admit that you do not know of what happened, but previously when Heaven Weeping Sect Master asked you for help, the moment your incarnation descends, you should know of this matter already right?”
“But since you became aware of it, you haven’t done anything about it, but rather, you are aiding Heaven Weeping?” Luo City Lord’s eyes were cold, “Since you are getting protection from within the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, you should be more obedient and forget about those wicked actions you had done in the past.”
Ancestor Bone felt slightly awkward.
Even Cosmos Gods were not absolutely safe.
The Voidwalker Gu Qi was once chased for many days, and even the ‘Void Primogenitor’ could not protect him at all! One had to know that the origin of everything, the Ancient Sacred World, had become big enough, yet it remained just a hundredth of what it was in its original state.”
That Ancient Sacred World was so stable and had such powerful laws, yet it was still eventually broken into pieces!
The primogenitor of the laws and profound mysteries system had long died.
Like Ancestor Bone who propped the bottom amongst Cosmos Gods, he had once riled a huge enemy, and for him to receive protection in the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World was really his good fortune.
“I only knew of it.” Ancestor Bone said directly.
He felt slightly indignant.
Heaven Weeping Sect Master was truly a fool. Since his subordinates could not kill these two brats, why was there a need for him to appear personally? Why not let those two brats escape! Yet Heaven Weeping Sect Master wanted to personally act, and it was okay if he could resolve the matter. But he had offended Ancestor Devil from the Great Void Heaven Temple!
Letting Ancestor Devil leave, yet Ancestor Devil did not wish to! Eventually, Heaven Weeping Sect Master had to ask Ancestor Bone for help. Since Ancestor Bone cultivated in closed-door within the primal chaos void just outside the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, it was not too far away from this location. That was also why Heaven Weeping Sect Master chose this region.
Ancestor Bone was someone who placed great importance upon his subordinates, and also thought he would get lucky, feeling that it was impossible for Luo City Lord to know what happened here. As long as Ancestor Bone covered all traces of what occurred here, then nobody would be able to validate the scene.
But-
Luo City Lord actually appeared just like this!
With how vast the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World was, why would Luo City Lord appear so coincidentally right here after a short period?
“I’ve just known of it recently and did not think too much about it. I only naturally protected my subordinate.” Ancestor Bone said.
“How do you think we should resolve this?” Luo City Lord looked at him.
Ancestor Bone looked at Luo City Lord. His mind was filled with the reminder of what ‘Yuan’ had once told him before: “You better not become enemies with Luo City Lord. But, you don’t have to be too afraid since he will not easily kill you. He has the power to kill a Cosmos God, but he has to pay a huge price the moment he killed one! As long as you don’t truly infuriate him, he will not act against you.”
To Yuan…
Ancestor Bone held absolute trust.
“I am willing to pay 1,000 Origin World Rocks and also that robe which Heaven Weeping Sect Master refined.” Ancestor Bone said.
“5,000 Origin World Rocks and that robe of his and we will end this matter.” Luo City Lord said.
Ancestor Bone felt heartache.
In the past when the Ancient Sacred World first exploded after the horrifying war, its most primitive energy had been scattered in all directions. Some turned into Origin World Rocks, and every single piece of this Origin World Rock was very precious! Like Xue Ying’s Black Gourd protective treasure, its value far transcend an ordinary Primal Chaos Flying Ship, and 500 Origin World Rocks would suffice to get it!
That time, Gu Qi had a hard time trying to refine the protective treasure. The inner controlling mechanism was meant to control a celestial body at an equivalent level with the Sun Star.
And Luo City Lord currently directly asked for 5,000 Origin World Rocks! That was equivalent to ten protective treasures, and even if he were a Cosmos God, Ancestor Bone still feel the pain.
“Alright.” Ancestor Bone promised.
…
Very soon, the time stop was canceled.
Xue Ying, Luo Hai, Ancestor Bone, and Heaven Weeping Sect Master all regained their freedom.
“Pass your Heaven Weeping Sacred Robe to Luo City Lord.” Ancestor Bone took the initiative to say. As for the 5,000 Origin World Rocks, he wants it given in the dark. He would not do so openly since it would be too disgraceful.
Heaven Weeping Sect Master widened his eyes. He felt anxious, “Forefather!”
He transmitted a message and asked anxiously, “Forefather, why do we have to be afraid of Luo City Lord? With you around, even if we could not defeat him, we can always escape.”
“I can escape, but him killing you is just a single thought. I cannot even save you at all! For him to not kill you and let you bring out the Heaven Weeping Sacred Robe which you refined has been negotiated after I’ve laid down myself.” Ancestor Bone transmitted.
Heaven Weeping Sect Master felt it was logical. After all, with Luo City Lord being personally there, Heaven Weeping Sect Master could not even move at all.
“But, but I’ve contributed…” Heaven Weeping Sect Master was reluctant.
“I’ve long reminded you for you to do things further away from the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. Who asked you to do your things so close to it.” Ancestor Bone transmitted, “And allowing Luo City to see it. You can only blame your misfortune.”
Heaven Weeping Sect Master felt helpless.
Why would they meet him?
He had sent his subordinates over to do these things, and he had concealed himself to prevent others from finding out! Ancestor Devil had spent a long time investigating before he finally discovered what was happening.
But this time, he had just shown himself when Luo City Lord appeared too?
“Alright, surviving is most important. I’ll help you refine some treasures after that. In the future, if you planned on doing these things again, do it as far as possible from the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World.” Ancestor Bone told him via voice transmission.
“Alright.” Heaven Weeping Sect Master could only nod. He was once afraid that someone might destroy his things, and felt that with the forefather close to him, at least he had a backing. Who would have thought that Luo City Lord would come? Even though Ancestor Bone was able to keep him alive, he had to pay a huge price too.
…
Very soon, Heaven Weeping Sect Master handed out that grayish robe which was filled with an endless aura of hatred and terror before leaving with Ancestor Bone from the place.
Luo City Lord causally kept that robe after taking it.
“You brat actually asked for me to act so soon?” Luo City Lord chuckled as he looked at Luo Hai, “Alright, let us leave.”
“So he is a descendant of Luo City Lord.” Only then was Ancestor Devil enlightened, “No wonder Luo City Lord appeared here so coincidentally.”
Luo Hai merely smiled at Xue Ying, “I did not lie right? He is my father! I have long transmitted to him, and he has long arrived, albeit he hasn’t acted.”
“I originally wanted to see the power of the new Punishment Hall Palace Master, who would have thought that Ancestor Bone will lend his Black Rattan Hatchet to his subordinate.” Luo City Lord shook his head, “The previous time the Great Void Heaven Temple Swordmaster came, he had even praised you before.”
Ancestor Devil merely gave a smile without saying anything.
Swordmaster?
That was his rival for life.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, let us return to the Great Void Heaven Temple.” Ancestor Devil said.
“Senior Ancestor Devil, I have a matter I would like to ask Luo City Lord.” Xue Ying added.
Luo City Lord was startled as he turned to the white-robed young man.
“Oh, what’s the matter?” Luo City Lord asked.
“I would like to ask if there are any treasures which could allow stage four World Deities to transcend!” Xue Ying then asked. Luo City Lord’ status was extraordinary, and his realm was extremely high too. Thus, his horizon was utterly beyond his! He was not that thick-skinned to ask for treasures, but trying to get some information… with Brother Luo Hai around, Luo City Lord should be able to answer him.
Even if he disdained from responding, Xue Ying would not be in a loss.
“Transcend?” Luo City Lord was momentarily stunned before he grinned at Xue Ying, “For your loved ones?”
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 798 - Too High To Reach
chapters.content:
Chapter 798: Too High To Reach
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Hearing the question by Xue Ying, Ancestor Devil could not help but shake his head. Luo Hai also frowned.
Instead, Luo City Lord looked up towards the vast and boundless primal chaos void: “Mortals live and die. Transcendents also have a limit to their lifespans. Even Deities and World Deities who could not transcend from the River of Time will eventually extinguish. Only those who transcend from the River of Time will truly attain an eternal life. But even if they did, they might not be able to resist the power from the primal chaos void… other than several few who had some secret techniques surrounding their bodies, or unique treasures, most had to become Void Gods before they could survive in the primal chaos void!”
“Void Gods might make many enemies too.”
“Even those at the ‘Origin Birth realm’, ‘Unity realm’, ‘Primal Chaos realm’ or those who broke through to the final realm, the Cosmos Gods, will similarly fight with each other. They will also be limited by the laws.” Luo City Lord looked at Xue Ying, “That is why there were Cosmos Gods who had fallen in history.”
Xue Ying was stunned.
He was asking if he could allow a stage four World Deity to transcend, yet why was Luo City Lord saying these?
“This is the law!” Luo City Lord looked at Xue Ying, “The highest law that exists everywhere. If not for the law, all living beings will be able to live for a long time, but how can the world withstand it?”
“For stage four World Deities to transcend, most will have to cultivate and comprehend themselves!”
“Even treasures can only aid in their cultivation. It will allow their souls to be more empty during cultivation, allowing the effects of cultivation to be better.” Luo City Lord said, “You are just a brat who hasn’t even become a Void God and yet you wish to help your loved ones transcend. You are thinking too much. It is better for you to cultivate properly!”
Ancestor Devil added from the side, “Life and death are normal. Haven’t you accepted that throughout your years of cultivation?”
“I have, and am making my utmost effort too.” Xue Ying said.
“Old Brother Dong Bo, it is too difficult to depend on external strength to transcend.” Luo Hai muttered.
Xue Ying’s eyes brightened.
Too difficult? It meant that there was hope!
Luo City Lord looked towards this young man and said, “All law will leave behind a strand of opportunity. According to my understanding, there are three ways for you to let a stage four World Deity transcend by depending on external forces.”
“Three ways?” Xue Ying felt slightly excited.
“Firstly, from the Ancestor Mother World of the five sacred worlds, during cultivation, the Ancestor Mother will breed an embryo. Before the embryo is fully given birth, you can send the soul within and rely on the embryo to break the shell before coming out from it. The moment the soul did so, he or she will directly transcend. But the disadvantage to this is… he or she will remain absolutely loyal to the Ancestor Mother! If the Ancestor Mother wanted the party to commit suicide, the party would not have any ways of going against it.” Luo City Lord said.
Xue Ying felt flabbergasted.
This way might seem like transcending, but in reality, it was becoming an eternal servant loyal only to the Ancestor Mother.
“Secondly, it is by finding the ‘Ancestor Sorcerer’ in the Great Ancient Sacred World. The Ancestor Sorcerer researches on the myriad existences, and has also created the ‘eternal heart’. As long as the eternal heart is used to fuse into one’s soul, the eternal heart will aid the soul and allow the party to transcend the River of Time by force.” Luo City Lord said.
Xue Ying felt excited after hearing it.
“Thirdly, it is the ‘Sacred Master’ of the Ancient Sacred World. The Sacred Master has a unique fruit tree called the ‘Origin World Fruit Tree’. The ‘Origin World Fruits’ grown are all very unique, and one can transcend after eating a single fruit.”
Luo City Lord said, “There are no consequences from using the Eternal Heart and the Origin World Fruits.”
Hearing this, Xue Ying felt an intense desire rising from inside him.
“It is very difficult even for the Ancestor Sorcerer to refine the Eternal Heart. According to my knowledge, he has only refined three pieces over the long period, of which two are saved for his loved one and a good friend. There is also a piece which he used to exchange with the Blade Emperor.” Luo City Lord chuckled, “For the sake of getting that Eternal Heart, Blade Emperor, and Ancestor Sorcerer once worked together to kill a Cosmos God, and wanting to ask Sorcerer God to refine another piece? I can’t even imagine the price you have to pay for it!”
“There are very few Origin World Fruits, and with how proud the Sacred Master is, he isn’t willing to give any to outsiders. He will at most bestow it to his subordinates who have contributed greatly! From what I know, the Sacred Master had only exchanged two Origin World Fruits with other Cosmos Gods before.” Luo City Lord looked at Xue Ying, “Thus, even if you are a Cosmos God, wanting to get an Origin World Fruit is something you can beg for but can’t get!”
Xue Ying felt his face turning pale after hearing it.
He knew…
The Sacred Master occupied the Ancient Sacred World, and he was also indistinctly the strongest existence across all five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void! Wanting to get that Origin World Fruit from him?
The Ancestor Mother is very powerful. The Ancestor Mother and the Ancestor World were second only to the Sacred Master, and they could be called the top three existences.
The Ancestor Sorcerer was similarly ranked in the front and was an existence close to the Ancestor Mother and Ancestor World.
These were all famous but terrifying existences.
“Several Cosmos Gods had sealed their loved ones and close friends as they got close to the end of their lifespans, stopping time completely.” Ancestor Devil coldly said, “They desired to let the most important people in their lives transcend too! But it is tough.”
Xue Ying felt a sense of helpless pressure. Even an existence who cultivated to the final realm had such a hard time achieving it?
“Other than that, there are treasures which can help aid cultivation.” Luo City Lord said, “You don’t have to ask about these since your Great Void Heaven Temple will definitely have recorded information on these. Some are treasures which help cultivation and are considered precious. Some are really helpful to cultivation, but even if the party had a remarkable comprehension ability, it could only lend them a helping hand to transcend.”
Xue Ying nodded.
He also knew many of the treasures which could aid in cultivation. The more mystical it was, the pricier it would be. It was something he as a little Ruler could not dare covet.
“Luo Hai, let us leave.” Luo City Lord looked towards his son.
“Brother Dong Bo, the things you mentioned are very troublesome even to me so I can’t help you.” Luo Hai walked towards Xue Ying, “In the future, you can visit the ‘Stars City’ to find me.”
“Definitely.” Xue Ying said.
Luo City Lord chuckled before bringing his son away via teleportation through space. Even though he felt this ‘Xue Ying’ was relatively talented, with his current horizons, he would not mind this brat who had not even reached the Void God realm.
…
The primal chaos void was extremely cold. Xue Ying had never once felt that before, but now, he could not help but feel the strand of cold. It was cold right in his heart.
Eternal Heart, Origin World Fruit, those were treasures which were too high for him to reach!
Wanting to rely on external forces to transcend was too challenging.
“Once your loved ones die along with the Cosmos Reincarnation, you will get used to it over time.” Ancestor Devil commented in a cold voice.
Xue Ying frowned at that point.
No matter what, he would definitely try his best! Right now, there was still a long period before the cosmos epoch ended. It was sufficient for him to grow during this period. Even if he did not obtain the Eternal Heart or Origin World Fruit, he had to try his best to find some precious treasures which could aid in cultivation.
After all, his wife and son had quite a remarkable comprehension ability and had long reached the stage four World Deity realm.
Maybe…
The day he returned, both his wife and son would have transcended by relying on their own strength!
“Go, let us first have a slaughter across the surrounding primal chaos land.” Ancestor Devil brought Xue Ying along as they tore through the void.
His speed was much much faster.
He had only spent about 30 years to step across all 200 over primal chaos lands. Even though Heaven Weeping Sect Master had sent the orders, he only told the core Unity realm experts for the sake of concealing his identity before letting them pass down further orders. Furthermore, due to the distance between the primal chaos lands, it was one transmitting to another…
Because they had killed five Unity realm experts before this, and Xue Ying and Luo Hai had also killed several Void Gods, the information transmission was cut off halfway through. In addition, there were even void creatures stuck in deep in slumber.
Thus, when Ancestor Devil swept his way across, he actually discovered more than 60 Void Gods and even more Rulers. Naturally, he killed every single one of them!
“Hu.”
Ancestor Devil brought Xue Ying along the primal chaos land.
“It is the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World right in front.” Ancestor Devil stopped too. There was an incomparably colossal land right ahead. It was so big that one could not see its boundary. It was much bigger than the cosmos. This boundless land even had layers of cloud at its outermost layer. The cloud layer was moving, and there would be occasional seven-colored thunder creatures swimming across.
Just by getting close to it, Xue Ying could feel his flying speed being affected. If he were to enter this sacred world, his speed would likely become very slow.
“The Eastern Unicorn Sacred World is too far away from the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. We can’t possibly travel through the primal chaos void over. That will take too much time.” Ancestor Devil said, “We will first enter the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World and find a Primal Chaos realm expert for his help. He will then send us back to the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World.”
Xue Ying nodded. Most Cosmos Gods could not even send people off a far distance! Instead, there were a few Primal Chaos Giants who cultivated specific unique systems that could achieve it. Naturally, they would have to pay a considerable price just to ask them for their help.
These Primal Chaos Giants were able to become the wealthiest bunch of people across those at the Primal Chaos realm just by collecting the travel fee!

chapters.title: Chapter 799 - Ancestor Desert Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 799: Ancestor Desert Palace
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“You haven’t entered the five great sacred worlds before right?” Ancestor Devil suddenly thought of it before looking towards Xue Ying.
“Mn, after leaving my hometown cosmos, I have always been traveling along the primal chaos void.” Xue Ying said.
Ancestor Devil nodded.
“Sou.”
He directly brought Xue Ying in a stream of light and rushed towards the surface level of the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. There were many cloud layers which contained several thunder creatures. There were even extremely horrifying creatures hidden within. But Ancestor Devil was a Primal Chaos realm giant and did not care about everything at all. He took just a single breath of time to travel through the many cloud layers and saw a boundless, undulating land.
The current sky was dim, and there was a huge sun slowly rising.
That’s right.
The sun and moon were not unique to his hometown cosmos! According to legends, there were already an incomparably blazing hot and explosive ‘Sun Star’ and the incredibly cold and sinister ‘Moon Star’ revolving around the most primitive Ancient Sacred World. Ever since the most primitive Ancient Sacred World exploded, the several sacred worlds which were created thereafter… would have a sun and moon revolving around and brightening the place.
Just like in Xue Ying’s hometown cosmos, Forefather Tian Yu had also created a smaller version of Sun Star and Moon Star while making the cosmos.
Clearly, the sun and the moon’s reflections made reproduction and survival possible for lifeforms.
‘Such a huge Sun Star.’ Xue Ying felt stunned. The Sun Star which rose from the easternmost location was tremendously huge and vast. The Sun Star in his hometown cosmos could not compare with this at all.
‘The laws here are too strong already.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
The sacred world was extremely stable. The operating laws were even stronger too. Only those who reached the final realm, the Cosmos Gods, could possibly have the power to destroy it. And it was merely ‘possible’ since it wasn’t easy for Cosmos Gods to actually destroy a sacred world. Just like the final 13th sword from the “13 Apocalyptic Swords”, it might be able to injure a sacred world, and by utilizing a few more swords, it could even cause the entire sacred world to be destroyed. But that was already the most terrifying and most forbidden move which Forefather Tian Yu had, and he would definitely not display such a forbidden move unless in a dire situation.
This move took too much toll on the cosmos within his body.
‘The law is too powerful. The pressure on me is too strong as well.’ Xue Ying had experienced the suppression the moment he got close to the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, and now that he entered the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, the law suppression became all the stronger. Even his vision and hearing abilities were suppressed.
“Hu.” Xue Ying tried flying before flashing back to his original position, “So slow!”
