Right now, his speed was so slow that he could only fly for up to three kilometers in the blink of an eye.
“Mirage World? Void teleportation? I really could not teleport any longer?” Xue Ying felt helpless.
These were things he knew before coming.
The law of sacred world was too strong since there were as many experts as clouds over here. The number of True Gods was innumerable, and there were even plenty of Void Gods. There were even a bunch of Primal Chaos realm giants and several Cosmos Gods who stood at the peak!
According to what he knew…
Those like Voidwalkers, who specialized in traveling, had to become a Void God before they could even do a ‘short distance void travel’ which was similar to teleportation. As for those who did not specialize in it, they would have to reach the ‘Unity realm’ before they could even teleport.
And those ultra-long distance void teleportation meant for those who were traveling to other parts could only be achieved by Primal Chaos realm giants. Several at the ‘Unity realm’ could do so too.
As for True God Rulers?
Never had he heard of anyone who could tear through the void within the sacred world! The law here was too strong.
“True Gods still can fly, yet World Deities could no longer do so.” Xue Ying looked beneath him. There was a city beneath in the distance. Many civilians were living within. Currently, the region which his Mirage World covered was too small—just 1,000 meters! Relying on his senses of the void, he could barely feel the aura given by the people living within this city.
The civilians in the city…
The weakest were all Transcendents! And those were squeaky children or toddlers who were shouting and screaming. They were all Transcendents.
And most adults or some of the slightly stronger teenagers were Deities.
Clearly in the sacred world… most would become Deities after they grew up! But under the strong law suppression, their destructive abilities were extremely small.
And there were very few ‘World Deities’ within. There were about a million civilians in the city, yet only a few dozen World Deities who could not fly yet.
“Even though they suffer from the law suppression, at least they are Transcendents the moment they are born, and Deities after they grew up. Their lives are very long.” Xue Ying said, “It is so much longer than the many mortals in my hometown cosmos.”
“They are stronger by much, but they also have many difficulties.” Ancestor Devil looked beneath him and spoke nonchalantly, “The devour class cultivation system is the easiest and simplest of all. It is also the most widely spread cultivation technique, so it is likely that some cultivators who got their hands on something related to devour will devour a large number of lifeforms. It is too common to see an entire city being devoured.”
“Thus…”
“Most living beings within the sacred world will live up to 100 million ordinarily, provided other deaths do not befall them before that day!” Ancestor Devil said, “Alright. Have you felt enough and gotten enough understanding of the sacred world?”
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Let’s go.”
Ancestor Devil brought Xue Ying along as they forced through the void.
Previously, they had been traveling in the primal chaos void, and Ancestor Devil did not create many disturbances as he had an easy time. But within the sacred world, the disturbance created was much bigger.
“Si la~” A distorting time-space vortex of 330 meters wide appeared in front. Ancestor Devil brought Xue Ying in directly.
At about 500 kilometers away from Ancestor Devil and Xue Ying.
There was a tall and sturdy man with a huge mustache flying up from a mansion house before observing the time-space vortex which formed. This tall and sturdy man with a huge mustache had golden eyes. He said with slight shock, “Is this traveling using the time-space vortex? Is it an existence at the Primal Chaos realm? I, I actually missed such a huge opportunity!”
The sacred world was too big.
Flying slowly…many cultivators including Void Gods would never get the opportunity to see a Primal Chaos realm giant!
******
The days of traveling were extremely mundane.
Advancing continuously using the time-space vortex, Xue Ying could not help but focus most of his concentration towards pondering the “Wind Ripple Path”.
About 30,000 years later.
“We are here.” Ancestor Devil who had been silent all the while as they traveled, suddenly said. He woke Xue Ying from his stupor.
“We are finally here.” Xue Ying felt awkward inwardly. Being a Primal Chaos realm giant, he could easily travel through long distance within the sacred world. Such a speed of traveling actually took 30,000 years or so before they arrived at the friend Ancestor Devil wanted to see! If not for long-distance traveling techniques, traveling in the sacred world would make others feel despair.
Naturally, the weak could travel through many teleportation arrays, but it would require treasures as the fee!
Flying through the time-space tunnel, Ancestor Devil and Xue Ying appeared right in front of a majestic black palace.
“It is forbidden to fly around the palace of Ancestor Desert.” At that moment, two protectors wearing simple armor rushed over. They were giving off a horrifying and sharp killing intent. The armor they were wearing contained lightning which was continuously moving.
Xue Ying could not help but feel his heart jolting. He could feel the threat from these two protectors.
“Mn?” Xue Ying was slightly stunned. He could determine that the two protectors were actually puppets!
“Great Void Heaven Temple Ancestor Devil.” Ancestor Devil nonchalantly answered, “Tell your house master that I am here to visit him.”
The two protectors were momentarily stunned.
“Yes.” The two of them bowed before leaving. Even though it was forbidden to fly around the palace of Ancestor Desert, those at the same level as their house master, the Primal Chaos realm existences, would clearly not suffer from the same restriction.
Beneath him, there was a congregation of many cultivators, of which the majority were True Gods, and some were Void Gods. They were all seated cross-legged in twos and threes.
There were some cultivators who came and were not informed yet, “It isn’t time. The recruitment of disciples for the Ancestor Desert Palace will only start 16 days later. This time, they are only recruiting 100 disciples, 10 being Void Gods and 90 being True Gods. Nevertheless, there are more than 10,000 True Gods and Void Gods I know who came already.”
“So many?”
“I’ve experienced so many bitter times and put in so much effort. I’ve almost even lost my life, spending a total of 1.03 billion years and spending so many treasures while relying on the time-space teleportation array before arriving here. It is hearsay that getting into the Ancestor Desert Palace is relatively easier, but who would have thought that there are so many cultivators vying for the 100 spots.”
These cultivators were all sighing. They could only wait casually on the ground. Nonetheless, there was a benefit in waiting outside the Ancestor Desert Palace—it was safe! None dared to rush over here and devour the living beings rampantly.
Naturally, only when the Ancestor Desert Palace is recruiting for disciples will they allow outsiders to gather here. During ordinary times, they were all forbidden from coming over.

chapters.title: Chapter 800 - Finally Arriving at Great Void Heaven Temple
chapters.content:
Chapter 800: Finally Arriving at Great Void Heaven Temple
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
At that point, on a wasteland outside the Ancestor Desert Palace, these cultivators who were gathered here discovered the two figures flying in the sky.
“Quickly look.”
“There are actually people who dare to fly around the Ancestor Desert Palace?”
These cultivators looked up at Ancestor Devil and Xue Ying. At that moment, Ancestor Devil slightly frowned as he let out an unseen pressure, preventing the cultivators from opening their eyes. They could only feel a horrifying suppression in their souls, and could not help but lower their heads after that.
Not just the True Gods, even the Void Gods all lowered their heads.
But they felt even more astonished in their hearts.
“His strength is unfathomable.”
“Ancestor Desert is someone at the legendary Primal Chaos realm. Even his disciples and subordinates will have to land from far away before walking in obediently to the Ancestor Desert Palace. Those who dare to fly high in the Ancestor Desert Palace… should likely be Primal Chaos existences.”
“Primal Chaos realm?”
“That is someone at the Primal Chaos realm?”
Some of the True Gods who were a little more naive felt a huge impact on their souls as they tried looking upwards, yet they were still trying their best to open their eyes. Closely following that, a horrifying suppression made them lower their heads unknowingly.
“Primal Chaos realm. I would never have thought that I can see an expert at the Primal Chaos realm in my life.” Some True Gods could hardly control their excitement.
Those at the Primal Chaos realm would usually be a giant of an area in the sacred world.
There were too few of them!
Even those who arrived outside the Ancestor Desert Palace would hardly get the chance to become a disciple of the Ancestor Desert Palace since only 100 of them would be selected with the majority being eliminated! Even if they become a disciple, it was uncertain if they would see the highest status of Ancestor Desert Palace, the ‘Ancestor Desert’ himself.
…
High above the Ancestor Desert Palace, Ancestor Devil remained cold as he stood there. Xue Ying stood by his side.
Hearing the voices from below, Xue Ying could not help but ask, “Is it so difficult to join a superpower within the sacred world?”
“Those who can truly set up a superpower in a region have at least reached the Primal Chaos realm.” Ancestor Devil said indifferently, “As for the ordinary Void Gods, or those at the Unity realm… they might just be killed on a certain day. They aren’t able to truly remain firm. Without power and without a strong backing, it is impossible for them to set up a superpower in an area.”
Xue Ying could not help but nod.
“For instance, the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World have three superpowers with Cosmos Gods propping them up. They are Ancestor bone, Blade Emperor, and Void Primogenitor respectively.” Ancestor Devil said, “And the Void Primogenitor is only willing to protect some void creatures as well as few who have truly gotten his inheritance as a Voidwalker! Thus, it is just a dream for any cultivators to join the sect under the Void Primogenitor.”
“Luo City Lord is more transcendental. He isn’t weaker than the Cosmos Gods, yet he is not recruiting any disciples at all.” Ancestor Devil said.
“Thus…”
“There are only Blade Emperor, Ancestor bone and the dozens of Primal Chaos realm existences who are truly recruiting disciples in the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World.” Ancestor Devil said, “And every superpower will only recruit a few disciple. Considering how big the sacred world is, those who could truly join the sects are few and far between.”
“Why don’t they recruit more?” Xue Ying asked, “By recruiting more disciples, the superpowers will become stronger, and it will also be helpful to the cultivators around the sacred world.”
Ancestor Devil gave Xue Ying a look: “Naive.”
Xue Ying was stunned.
“What is the reason for them to rely on a superpower? Some of the cultivation techniques have long been spread out so why do they still want to join the superpowers?” Ancestor Devil said, “It’s all for the sake of resources!”
“Resources?” Xue Ying looked pensive.
“Like the Ancestor Mother Religion system or the bloodline cultivation system, both require external materials for breakthroughs! The strongest warrior type usually requires external materials to tamper their bodies.” Ancestor Devil said, “Even the ‘hex’ or the ‘laws and profound mysteries’ systems which heavily emphasize on cultivation require help from others. Hex is all about researching the myriad existences, and cultivators of this system require the scriptures from seniors to help them and all sorts of precious materials for research… and it is very hard to break through in the laws and profound mysteries system since it requires a large number of scriptures from seniors too. The deeper the understanding towards the laws and profound mysteries, the easier it will be to cultivate.”
“Furthermore, the hex and laws and profound mysteries systems which focus heavily on comprehension ability could utilize external materials for help. Without depending on external materials, one might only reach the Unity realm for instance, and with precious materials aiding their cultivations, the party might possibly reach the Primal Chaos realm.” Ancestor Devil looked at Xue Ying, “This is the case for those that heavily emphasized comprehension ability. It is impossible to break through for other systems without sufficient resources.”
“And how much resources can you get if you go on an adventure by yourself in the sacred world?”
“If one depended on a superpower, the superpower will naturally help the disciples in his sect, ensuring he receives the most fundamental resources at least.” Ancestor Devil said, “Because they had to provide the resources, any superpowers will limit the number of slots for recruitment.”
Xue Ying nodded.
Right.
Resources! He was also seeking ways to help Jing Qiu and Yu’er by finding precious materials that would help in cultivation!
“And they have to be alert when recruiting disciples too.” Ancestor Devil overlooked beneath him, “The five sacred worlds and primal chaos void aren’t peaceful at all! The various superpowers are fighting in the dark, and even Cosmos Gods might fall! It is normal to dispatch some spies to join the enemy’s superpowers. Thus, it is vital for superpowers to remain alert when recruiting disciples.”
Xue Ying was stunned.
“You are still fortunate. Coming from our hometown cosmos, and you have also passed through the Starting Ground trials, allowing you to directly become a golden-robed disciple of our Great Void Heaven Temple.” Ancestor Devil said, “There are many cultivators who actually envy you in the sacred world. Naturally, those of us who come out from the cosmos will be lacking in techniques too. The difficulty of cultivation is even higher. Toddlers in the sacred world start from the Transcendent realm, and they will become Deities when they are adults. They have a relatively easier time during cultivation. There is also an innumerable amount of cultivation techniques for them to learn. It is just that the competition for resources is very intense. Naturally, it isn’t easy to learn the apex, or highest leveled absolute arts since they can’t be spread outside.”
Xue Ying nodded in understanding.
“Hahaha, Ancestor Devil, you have previously just left this place of mine not too long ago, and yet you are here again?” A clear and bright voice sounded. A plump figure flew over from afar. He had six arms, green skin and was brimming from ear to ear.
“After completing the task, I will naturally have to return. I’ll have to trouble Ancestor Desert to send me back to the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World.” Ancestor Devil said.
“Alright, alright, alright. I am naturally delighted to do so. You came here just for this little brat?” The plump Ancestor Desert looked towards Xue Ying.
“He is a golden-robed disciple of my Great Void Heaven Temple.” Ancestor Devil nodded.
“I’ll not charge you to bring an additional True God Ruler.” Ancestor Desert chuckled, “I’m sure you know the rules. You should not bring too many beings in your Eden treasures. Otherwise, if it exceeds my controlling limit, the transmission will fail.”
“I understand. There is only one more person compared to coming here.” Ancestor Devil nodded.
“Alright, the old price then. 15 Origin World Rocks.” Ancestor Devil chuckled.
Xue Ying was inwardly dumbstruck after hearing it.
Truly ruthless!
Coming back and forth cost a total of 30 Origin World Rocks. According to his understanding, ordinary Primal Chaos Flying Ships cost only about 50 Origin World Rocks. But ancestor Devil should have gotten many treasures from killing across the 200 over lands. This time was definitely a great earn for him.
“Let’s hurry off.” Ancestor Devil waved his hand, causing many rocks that were emitting special colors to fly over. These rocks contained a power that would jolt the hearts of others who saw it. They could even feel their souls trembling with a strong impulse to eat them.
Origin World Rocks…
Those were pieces exploded out from the earliest primitive Ancient Sacred World, and were formed from the origin energy. It was said that Origin World Rocks were very important even to Cosmos Gods.
“Come with me.” Ancestor Devil laughed voraciously. He really cordial. Such teleportation business targeted these experts since the weaker ones could not even bring out sufficient Origin World Rocks. Either that or they were not willing to spend, or even afford it!
…
Ancestor Desert brought Xue Ying and Ancestor Devil into an empty palace hall. There was an array situated at the center of this palace hall.
Ancestor Devil brought Xue Ying with great familiarity into the array.
“Weng.” Two light pillars shot out from the eyes of Ancestor Desert, enveloping the array wholly. A unique strength descended here.
Xue Ying held his breath.
Ancestor Desert belonged to the ‘Ancient Cultivation’ system.
The ancient cultivation came from the primitive Ancient Sacred World, and was the earliest cultivation system. There were strong and weak amongst those studying the ‘ancient cultivation system’, and they specialized in all sorts of methods too! Some were able to scout what happened very far away, and some could easily travel to different sacred worlds. Some were able to ‘prophesize’, and the degree of accuracy was over 80%!
Regardless, these sorts of weird capabilities all belonged under the ancient cultivation.
Like currently, the faintly strongest existence, that ‘Sacred Master’ who occupied the ‘Ancient Sacred World’ belonged to the ancient cultivation system.
“Weng!”
Xue Ying saw it. He saw the surrounding space distorting and collapsing. Another space far away was similarly collapsing too. The two began connecting with each other, forming an extremely short void corridor.
An unseen strength engulfed Ancestor Devil and Xue Ying, bringing them into the void corridor. The surrounding space might seem to be squeezing and pulling at the same time, but in the blink of an eye, the scene in front changed.
“Hong long~” The surrounding space regained its usual shape.
Ancestor Devil and Xue Ying appeared in midair.
Ancestor Devil swept around him before snorting, “He has transported us slightly off from our location. We still have to travel.”
Because the distance was too far, teleportation was not absolutely accurate.
“Si la~” A time-space vortex tunnel was torn out. Ancestor Devil brought Xue Ying in. This time, it was quick. It took just half a day before they exited the time-space vortex. They were still situated in midair.
Ancestor Devil brought Xue Ying along as they flew. Suddenly, they clashed against something, causing unseen ripples to form in the surrounding void. The two soon penetrated through it and disappeared.
…
Xue Ying only felt his surroundings change. He knew he had entered the special space.
In the distance, there were many floating towering mountains. These mountains all contained cavern palaces on them. Many floating mountains surrounded the center which contained a huge floating land! This land had a chain of palaces on it. At the very center, there was an incomparably dazzling palace.
The palace was majestic, and its radiance covered every single inch of this space.
‘I am here, Great Void Heaven Temple.’ Xue Ying thought. A grin appeared on his face.
In the distance, there were still cultivators flying. They were all part of the Great Void Heaven Temple. Some of them had turned over, only to see the Punishment Hall Palace Master ‘Ancestor Devil’. They were so frightened that they no longer dared to look back. But still, they were muttering inwardly, “There seems to be a True God Ruler beside the Punishment Hall Palace Master? Who is he? I’ve never seen him before.”

chapters.title: Chapter 801 - First Time Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 801: First Time Here
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying followed along Ancestor Devil. At the same time, he looked towards some of the cultivators far away. Looking over, they were almost all True Gods.
‘According to what I know, there is very few Void Gods within the Great Void Heaven Temple. There aren’t even as many Void Gods here as compared to how many there were across the over 200 primal chaos lands.’ Xue Ying thought. In the vast primal chaos void, across the many cosmos and many primal chaos lands, the number of Void Gods added up to a huge amount.
Within the sacred world alone, there were so many Void Gods it could frighten others!
But there were very few Void Gods within the Great Void Heaven Temple. Even if True God disciples became Void Gods, if they did not reach a sufficient level, they would be placed outside of the Great Void Heaven Temple in the ‘primal chaos cities’. One had to know that the Great Void Heaven Temple was one of the three holy grounds of the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. Many living beings were crying and shouting about wanting to join the Great Void Heaven Temple. For the sake of improving the goevrning power, they had even constructed 12 primal chaos cities in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World.
Every single primal chaos city would awe a region.
Some would supervise the sacred world, recruit disciples, make traveling convenient and conduct other things. The weaker Void Gods would be placed outside the primal chaos cities.
But even the weaker Void Gods had become one through the laws and profound mysteries system. They had gotten guidance from the Great Void Heaven Temple, and their combative strength far surpassed ordinary Void Gods in the outer world.
“Look.” Ancestor Devil brought Xue Ying towards a floating island. There were 12 cavern-dwellings on this floating dwelling, and each dwelling had different sizes.
“This is also the ‘Yu Xing Island’,” Ancestor Devil pointed to those cavern-dwellings, “According to the locations of the cavern-dwellings, the highest cavern-dwelling to the ranked one golden-robed disciple. The subsequent ones are for the currently ranked second… and so on until the tenth ranked disciple. The remaining two empty cavern-dwellings are meant for golden-robed disciples who emerges within the cosmos just like you, Xue Ying, who had experienced the trials in your hometown cosmos. It is very much easier than the challenges within the Great Void Heaven Temple so you will obtain comparatively lesser benefits.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Palace Master.”
A voice came from afar. There was a gray-robed middle-aged man who came with a respectful greet. But this was just a puppet lifeform which reached the Void God realm.
“This is the golden-robed disciple Dong Bo Xue Ying.” Ancestor Devil looked beneath and ordered, “He will be your master from today onwards!”
“This old servant greets master.” The gray-robed middle-aged man immediately saluted.
“Xue Ying, he will tell you all the rules within the Great Void Heaven Temple.” Ancestor Devil said, “Swordmaster originally would be seeing you since you came from the same hometown as us, but he and forefather are currently in closed-door, and it is estimated that both of them will come out during the ranking battle of your golden-robed disciples. It is very soon since there are only about 30 million years or so before the next ranking battle.”
“30 million years?” Xue Ying felt slightly anxious.
“Even if you lose this time, you can always win the next time.” Ancestor Devil indifferently said, “There’s no need to feel like you have lost face. The most heaven-shaking talents of Great Void Heaven Temple are all amazing. This time, ranking in the top 20 is a success for you already.”
After Ancestor Devil finished saying, he smiled, “Alright, cultivate properly. Our hometown cosmos, other than Swordmaster and me, it’ll be you who has the highest innate talent. This lineage of ours is ultimately too weak.”
“I’ll definitely do my best.” Xue Ying said.
Ancestor Devil nodded.
He then took a step before turning into a stream of light that disappeared far away.
Only then did Xue Ying mutter to himself, “Top 20 is considered a success?”
“Master.” The servant said from the side, “I’ll pass all the information regarding the Great Void Heaven Temple to master.”
Very soon, Xue Ying’s communication talisman received a large amount of information. Even though he had also received a large amount of information when he was at his hometown cosmos, firstly, it was not detailed enough and secondly, the information left behind by Forefather Tian Yu at the point when the cosmos was created had been outdated. For instance, it did not include any information regarding this generation of True God disciples.
“Oh?” Xue Ying first looked through the information regarding the True God disciples. The moment he did so, he felt speechless.
Across the five sacred worlds and the vast primal chaos void, when comparing combat techniques and the degree of the profoundness of moves, the Great Void Heaven Temple ranked in the top two. Thus, other than large batches of True Gods who desired to enter, even those that the Great Void Heaven Temple had great relations with, the ‘Primogenitor Island’ and ‘Jade Light Sacred Territory’ had sent people to join. There were also some Primal Chaos realm giants who sent their own disciples into the Great Void Heaven Temple.
The Great Void Heaven Temple also released a very few number of slots for these group of talents to enter.
Thus, the competition between True God disciples was extremely intense.
“10 great golden-robed disciples, in addition to those who had become golden-robed disciples in the past before dropping back to the violet-robed disciples… there are a total of 19 of them.” Xue Ying was slightly speechless, “And there are some who haven’t become a golden-robed disciple before but are close to the power of golden-robed disciples. There is a total of approximately 10 who had the hope of rushing into the top 10.”
Those who once become a golden-robed disciple had fought their way into the top 10 before attaining the cosmos ranked absolute arts! After reaching top 10, they would have gotten the cosmos ranked absolute arts along with all sorts of resources to help them grow.
It’s just that the cultivators who came later, like certain talented people, would eventually kick the golden-robed disciples in front out of their positions!
These 19 cultivators…
Adding the latter 10 cultivators could easily transcend realm and kill Void Gods.
And Xue Ying had merely gotten through the simpler trial in his hometown cosmos. This degree of difficulty should be easily triumphed over by more than 100 True God disciples in the Great Void Heaven Temple. Hence, with how harsh the judgment of Ancestor Devil was, he felt that Xue Ying reaching the top 20 was a large success already!
After all, 19 had once become golden-robed disciples! And the top 20 was truly frightening.
“I might have cultivated the first apocalyptic sword, but those who can become golden-robed disciples should have their own cosmos absolute arts too and should have cultivated in them. Currently, I do not have the certainty of reaching the top 10 with my current power.” A sharp edge flashed through Xue Ying’s eyes, “But I still have to do so.”
Because only when he got into the top 10 during the internal challenges could he obtain the ‘Supplementary Spiritual Fruit’ given by the Great Void Heaven Temple. This was a precious item used to aid in cultivation and was worth 50 Origin World Rocks.
One had to know that even though he killed many void creatures and even killed a few Void Gods, the total number of treasures he collected could barely reach one Origin World Rock!
Naturally, being a golden-robed disciple, the defensive talisman, and the Void God weapon were worth much more. The protective treasure Black Gourd was very precious too, but it was impossible for him to sell them.
More importantly…
The Supplementary Spiritual Fruit was something only the Great Void Heaven Temple had. Usually, they would bestow them on new golden-robed disciples, and even though there was a price, none could buy them!
“I must get it. Even if I could not use it, I could give Jing Qiu and Yu’er.” Xue Ying felt the need to get this fruit.
…
“Hong long long~”
The cavern-dwelling door was pushed open.
This cavern-dwelling was slightly smaller. There was only a single courtyard. Inside it was a three-room flat. This belonged to the lowest ranking cavern-dwelling amongst golden-robed disciples, yet it sufficed to make many True God disciples red with envy.
Xue Ying entered his cavern-dwelling before carefully looking at the place he would be living from now.
******
At the moment Xue Ying pushed open the cavern-dwelling door, there were several other True God disciples who saw it as they were flying.
“Golden-robed island?”
“Another golden-robed disciple?”
Even though the island where the golden-robed disciples lived on was called ‘Yu Xing Island’, many ordinary True God disciples were used to calling it the ‘golden-robed island’ since that was where they desired to go.
“Why did another golden-robed disciple appear outside the 10 great golden-robed disciples?”
“Oh right, isn’t there someone called Dong Bo Xue Ying who appeared previously as someone who originated from the Starting Cosmos?”
“He is Dong Bo Xue Ying?”
These disciples were all discussing among each other. Some even began to go find out more about him since the Great Void Heaven Temple had recorded much information regarding Xue Ying the moment he arrived. For instance, the aura of his soul, his identity as a golden-robed disciple and the power he had… thus, those True God disciples who had some background were able to investigate on Xue Ying quickly.
“He is Dong Bo Xue Ying. I’ve heard that Ancestor Devil personally went to bring him here.”
“A brat who came out from the cosmos is very lucky to become a golden-robed disciple.” Many True God disciples felt relatively envious and unconvinced. Many of them had grown up in the sacred world, and they belittled those who came from the many cosmos within the primal chaos void.
“It’s nothing much. The upcoming challenge is coming soon, and by then, I’ll just challenge him.” At that point, there were True God disciples declaring it.
…
After Xue Ying understood his own cavern-dwelling, he left his house and directly flew towards the biggest floating land situated at the center of the place. He was clearly not wasting any time and wanted to head to the ‘Myriad Elephant Palace Hall’. That time when Swordmaster left his hometown cosmos and entered the Great Void Heaven Temple, he had entered closed-door cultivation after entering the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall’. The moment he left, he had become a Cosmos God.
Ancestor Devil had similarly entered the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall’ after reaching here, reading through the countless books within.
To them who came from the cosmos, the ‘Myriad Elephant Palace Hall’ was the most important location. Here stored all books which the Great Void Heaven Temple collected for a long period of time.
“Is this Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying?” A voice came over.
Xue Ying was slightly astonished. He stopped, only to see a relatively handsome violet-robed male standing there.

chapters.title: Chapter 802 - Reading Through
chapters.content:
Chapter 802: Reading Through
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“That’s me. Is there any reason why you are obstructing me, Dong Bo Xue Ying?” Xue Ying asked.
The violet-robed male chuckled, “I am Ming Yu. I’ve just heard that a new golden-robed senior disciple brother came, which is also why I especially rushed here. Since senior disciple brother is a golden-robed disciple, so why don’t you wear it? In the Great Void Heaven Temple, the golden-robed disciples, the violet-robed disciples, and the inner hall elders would wear robes with color associated with their status. ”
“Oh, that’s right too. I did not pay much notice to it after arriving here at the Great Void Heaven Temple.” Xue Ying casually replied. The white robe he was wearing immediately transformed color, revealing the true appearance of a golden robe.
This was merely due to him previously trying to keep a low profile.
He was not too willing to display his identity as a golden-robed disciple, as it would attract too much attention. However, since he had been asked to do so, it would be better to show it now.
Seeing the golden robe on Xue Ying, the violet-robed disciple could not help but reveal an envious look: “This junior disciple brother has experienced many True God disciple challenges, yet I am always lacking in power and do not have any fate with the top ten. I’ve heard that Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying, the Punishment Hall Master, and the Swordmaster all originated from the same cosmos. With you being a golden-robed disciple, your combat power must be extraordinary. I wonder if Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying would like to have a spar with me?”
“Spar?” Xue Ying revealed a grin, “That’s a minor matter. Do we do it now?”
This junior disciple brother was quite polite. Sparring was not too difficult for him. What’s more, he could also experience the standards of the True God disciples from the Great Void Heaven Temple.
The violet-robed disciple continued, “Over at my Great Void Heaven Temple, it is common for those who go on the battle platform for a spar to have a bet. I am willing to stake 10 pieces of Origin World Rocks.”
“10 pieces of Origin World Rocks?” Xue Ying felt a strand of ill will from the other party. Usually, most Void Gods would not have that many treasures. However, this junior disciple brother in front of him was a True God Ruler, yet he was richer than most Void Gods. Xue Ying immediately replied, “Junior disciple brother is truly rich. It’s a pity that I do not have that many Origin World Rocks.”
“Haha, senior disciple brother is a golden-robed disciple, so how can you not have sufficient treasures?” The violet-robed disciple Ming Yu chuckled, “Senior disciple brother should certainly have a Void God weapon. It should be of sufficient value.”
“You want me to stake my Void God weapon?” Xue Ying was calm as he spoke, “This Void God weapon of mine is worth more than 10 Origin World Rocks.”
The violet-robed disciple chuckled, “I know. The Void God weapons golden-robed disciples got are worth usually around 20 to 30 Origin World Rocks. Even though it is higher than what I betted, in our Great Void Heaven Temple… those with greater power will usually put in a greater stake when fighting with those weaker! After all, the probability of me losing in such a battle is much greater.”
“Why, senior disciple brother comes from the same cosmos as Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster. This junior disciple brother, I, have the courage to gamble, yet senior disciple brother does not have the guts to do so?” The violet-robed disciple continued.
Xue Ying looked at this junior disciple brother in front of him.
Being a golden-robed disciple that came from a cosmos, other than the protective treasure Black Gourd, he could not sell other treasures like the defensive talisman he had. His Void God weapon was the only object he had which he could and exchange for a high value. That weapon of his was an upper-grade Void God weapon, with its value being close to 30 pieces of Origin World Rocks.”
On the surface, it was his most valuable treasure! Yet who would have thought that it would be stared at by others just after coming here?
“Junior Disciple Brother Ming Yu.” Xue Ying looked at him, “According to what I know, you are ranked 26th in the previous True God disciple challenge.”
The violet-robed disciple was stunned momentarily before he nodded, “Right. I am still very far away from the top 10.”
“I have also fortuitously become a golden-robed disciple from my hometown cosmos. Competing with junior disciple brother, it is likely for me to lose to you.” Xue Ying shook his head and sighed, “Let’s just drop this matter of sparring.”
“Senior disciple brother, you are a golden-robed disciple and also came from the same cosmos as Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster. You must definitely be amazing. Aren’t you that confident of yourself at the very least?” The violet-robed disciple continued, “If that’s the case, then you are truly looking down on me, and also looking down on other disciples.”
Xue Ying’s expression turned cold.
“Looking down on you?” Xue Ying stared at him with a cold expression, “You are merely using 10 Origin World Rocks to gamble with my piece of upper-grade Void God weapon? I say that you are dreaming! If you want to gamble with me, you better prepare 25 Origin World Rocks at least! At that moment when we have the True God disciple inner challenge, we can also make use of that chance to see who wins the bet.”
“If you are too poor and can’t bring out the 25 Origin World Rocks, then you better make use of this chance to scram further away.” Xue Ying sneered before turning into a stream of light and disappeared. He did not even care about giving this violet-robed disciple a look. That violet-robed disciple also watched as Xue Ying flew away expressionlessly.
“Hahaha, Brother Ming Yu, it seems that this Dong Bo Xue Ying isn’t that easy to deceive.” The other violet-robed disciples came flying over from afar.
“I assumed that he will be overconfident and arrogant and would be dying to compete with me.” Ming Yu lightly shook his head, “It seems that he is very vigilant.”
“Let’s not talk about this Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying anymore. Can’t you just take out 25 Origin World Rocks to compete with him? Is there a problem with that? Is Senior Disciple Brother Ming Yu not confident about defeating him?”
“Unless Disciple Brother Ming Yu can’t take out 25 Origin World Rocks? How many are you lacking? I can lend you, though it will be a loan.”
These violet-robed disciples were saying.
“Oh, I guess if you all go and challenge Dong Bo Xue Ying, he should likely agree to it.” Ming Yu indifferently said, “You all can prepare the 25 Origin World Rocks. By then during the ranking battle, you can definitely challenge Dong Bo Xue Ying then. As for me, there is no point.”
“Whoosh.” Ming Yu flew away after saying that.
The other violet-robed disciples were started sneering after seeing it.
“What a pity. We’ve failed to receive this golden-robed disciple that comes from the cosmos.”
“This Ming Yu is still so cunning.”
These violet-robed disciples were speaking casually.
“Fellow gentlemen, who here dares to challenge him?”
“He is someone who came from the same cosmos as Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster. I might still be confident if I had engaged in a duel with him now. However, it’s a pity that he wants to delay until the ranking battle… everyone knows that Swordmaster and Ancestor Devil have become extremely powerful after reading through the many books in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall. They were able to correct their weaknesses of being inexperienced, while Swordmaster was even able to break through to the final realm after entering closed-door cultivation. This Dong Bo Xue Ying might have very few experiences towards the laws and profound mysteries, but now that he will be entering the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall to read, he will rapidly make up for his weaknesses. During the ranking battle itself, it is likely that he will become much more powerful! Who knows if he might even get into the top 20! I am not confident of fighting this kind of expert.”
“Mn, I’m afraid that he would be able to improve greatly after doing so.”
These violet-robed disciples came from different places.
Some came from the Primogenitor Island, while some were sent over from the Jade Light Sacred Territory. Some had even undergone many selections in the sacred world before finally getting the opportunity to enter the Great Void Heaven Temple. The competition outside the Great Void Heaven Temple was especially intense because the Great Void Heaven Temple believed in quality and elites, with no care about quantity at all.
After all, just sending an incarnation of a single palace hall master was more than sufficient to slaughter large amounts of Void Gods.
Thus, those who could become violet-robed disciples and enter here were all extraordinary, with all of them being cunning and astute.
Even though they disdained upon this brat who came from within a cosmos, it was merely caused by the reason they were born from, with them hailing from the sacred worlds,. Even Ancestor Devil and Xue Ying loved their own hometown cosmos and were protective of it! Nevertheless, these violet-robed disciples did not dare to underestimate the potential of Xue Ying.
Right now if they were to compete, there were quite a few violet-robed disciples would dare to do so!
However, if it was delayed to the True God disciple ranking battle, they were no longer confident. After all, ‘Ancestor Devil’, ‘Swordmaster’ and Xue Ying all passed through the golden-robed disciple trial when they were back at their cosmos. In the end, due to his great potential, at the moment when he corrects the lack of experience, he would definitely improve drastically.
…
“Whoosh.”
Xue Ying flew towards the central floating great land and towards the ‘Myriad Elephant Palace Hall’.
“Mn?” Xue Ying could not help but be attracted to a tall pagoda behind the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall. This pagoda was constructed there. It was majestic, and its height could almost match that of the Great Void Palace Hall.
‘Star Pagoda.’ Xue Ying thought.
Star Pagoda.
The introduction given to it as referenced from the information provided by Great Void Heaven Temple was quite brief. Instead, it was more detailed in the information given by the Voidwalker Gu Qi.
There were six Star Pagodas in total.
They were respectively located in the Great Void Heaven Temple, Primogenitor Island, Jade Light Sacred Territory, Void God Temple, Blade Emperor’s ‘Blade Emperor City and Luo City Lord’s ‘Stars City’.
Which meant that there were three holy grounds within Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World and three holy grounds within Eastern Unicorn Sacred World.
These six Star Pagodas were also personally refined and gifted by Luo City Lord. From this, one could see that the relationship between Eastern Unicorn Sacred World and Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World was relatively good.
“Let’s go to the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall.” Xue Ying did not think much and flew directly to the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall.
The Myriad Elephant Palace Hall was completely made of wood and occupied a very big area. It wasn’t considered tall, standing at only about 20% the height of the Star Pagoda and the Great Void Palace Hall.
There was a black cat currently lying at the front door of the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall.
‘A black cat? According to the information, this should be a puppet lifeform at the Primal Chaos realm and not any weaker than the black wild dog back in my hometown.’ Xue Ying thought. Forefather Tian Yu’s refining skill must be absolutely wondrous to refine a puppet lifeform with the power of the primal chaos realm. The value of these puppet lifeforms was extremely high and far beyond that of the Black Gourd and even a cosmos.
Thus, to leave behind a black wild dog back in his hometown cosmos as a protector meant that Forefather Tian Yu must be extremely wealthy. During that time, the dog had completely hoodwinked Gu Qian Luo.
“Meow~” The black cat gave Xue Ying a look, before speaking out with a gentle voice, “Brat, don’t go to the fourth floor. You can casually read in the first three levels.”
“Yes, senior.” Xue Ying acknowledged with a smile.
The black cat soon went back to sleep lazily. Xue Ying instead entered the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall.
The Myriad Elephant Palace Hall was really vast and huge.
There were many books placed within. All of the books here very precious, and god knows how many more are there here as compared to the Devil Mountain Cosmos! After all, this was the core of a holy ground. The Great Void Heaven Temple had placed its collection of books over the years here.
Xue Ying was filled with desire. He understood that the best teacher in the Great Void Heaven Temple were the many books within the ‘Myriad Elephant Palace Hall’. Many books were very expensive, and some only had a single book! For instance, after the fall of the primogenitor for the laws and profound mysteries system, he left behind several lone books.
Calming himself, Xue Ying soon found a book detailing the types of Mirages. He immediately picked it up and started reading…

chapters.title: Chapter 803 - Accumulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 803: Accumulation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
There were many characters on the book Xue Ying was reading, which each of the words and pictures transforming into many different illusory worlds. Xue Ying stood before the simple bookshelf as he read the book. Every time he flipped through a page, there would information transmitted into his mind. These were the comprehension experiences which the seniors who had walked further down the ‘Dao of Mirage’ had recorded.
Imparting the Dao was very, very difficult.
Due to the Dao being extremely vague and elusive, it was difficult to illustrate it! Thus, there was a huge difference between taking a powerful existence as a teacher to taking a Paragon or a Ruler as a teacher. The higher the realm, the clearer it would be when the expert illustrated the Dao, allowing the younger generation to gain a clearer understanding.
Of the books here, some of them were penned down by Void Gods. Only after going through a large number of thorough checks by the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall would those books be able to be qualified in being placed within the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall. There were even some that had been written by those at the Unity realm and even the Primal Chaos realm. There were even many books left behind by those experts in the laws and profound mysteries such as those by ‘Forefather Tian Yu’ or ‘Swordmaster’ or others not from the Great Void Heaven Temple.
The books were arranged into different floors in accordance to how precious they were.
Xue Ying was not arrogant nor impatient. Instead, he remained calm as he read and pondered over the information.
…
Time flowed like water.
As a golden-robed disciple who came from a specific cosmos in the primal chaos void, Xue Ying had stayed in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall ever since the moment he arrived at the holy ground ‘Great Void Heaven Temple’, flipping through the books as if he had run amok.
“That Dong Bo Xue Ying brat who came from the same cosmos as Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster has remained all the while in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall?”
A couple was conversing as they flew in midair.
“That’s right, he has stayed inside for the whole time! I guess it due to he never seeing so many books on the laws and profound mysteries before. The moment he saw the many books in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall, he naturally entered a state of madness. Senior Disciple Sister Feng Yun, are you curious about him too? Haha, right now, many True God disciples from the Great Void Heaven Temple are talking about him.”
“Hmph, I want to spar with him and see how strong this brat who came from the same cosmos as Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster could be. A golden-robed disciple? Hmph!” That violet-robed silver-eyed girl snorted.
“Senior Disciple Sister Feng Yun,, other than Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster, there are no longer any outstanding cultivators in the Starting Cosmos. It isn’t worth mentioning. Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster both came from the same cosmos epoch, and it the competition and rivalry between them that had enabled them to become so dazzling. How can this Dong Bo Xue Ying match up to both of them?”
“Help me invite him to a challenge and think of ways to make him accept it.” The silver-eyed girl said.
“Senior Disciple Sister, please don’t make life difficult for me! Over the past 100,000 years, many disciples have wanted to challenge him. However, that Dong Bo Xue Ying has remained buried in reading through books. He only answered with-bring out 25 pieces of Origin World Rocks before challenging him during the True God disciple ranking battle! Right now, he isn’t willing to accept any form of challenges, and it is likely that we have to wait until the True God disciple battle.”
“Even you can’t move him?”
“Impossible. He is extremely obstinate.”
The silver-eyed girl nodded, though a strand of anxiety could be seen vaguely in her eyes.
She was ranked 15 the previous time. Thus, her status amongst the True God disciples was relatively high. However, she was not fortunate enough and had never entered the top 10 rank ever!
‘I must get into the top 10 and obtain many treasures. I have to get the cosmos ranked absolute arts too.’ The silver-haired girl told herself. The cosmos ranked absolute art was also the temple protection absolute art. Its value was boundless as it represented the peak most attainment in the laws and profound mysteries system.
‘I do not have the confidence to get into the top 10 with my current power!’
‘However, if I can obtain the Void God weapon from Dong Bo Xue Ying, that is worth around 20-30 Origin World Rocks, and I can exchange it for some precious treasures which will aid in cultivation. It might allow my power to improve to another level.’ The silver-haired girl gritted her teeth, ‘Damn, these golden-robed disciples all have gotten the temple protection absolute art, yet I don’t. Wanting to win against them is too difficult!’
This was also the biggest problem for every True God disciples wanting to get into the top 10!
The golden-robed disciples were all very talented. Furthermore, they cultivated in the temple protection absolute arts too.
As for the violet-robed disciples, they did not have any temple protection absolute arts. Thus, for them to defeat the golden-robed disciples and get into the top 10… was incomparably difficult. However, it was precisely due to this that any new golden-robed disciple would be someone more dazzling.
Naturally, there was a way… for an original golden-robed disciple to break through into the Void God realm. By then, there would be an empty slot, and it would be easier for them.
…
“Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying, I’ve heard that Senior Disciple Brother is very amazing. Why not fight a battle with this junior brother? We will not have any bet.” A voice sounded by his ears.
Seated cross-legged at a corner, Xue Ying who had a flask of wine placed by his side looked over. He saw a white tender young man with a smile on his face. This young man had a red horn protruding from his forehead, and his eyes were glowing red. He spoke out in an extremely polite manner: “There is no need for us to gamble. This is only a spar.”
“If you want to fight, just wait until the True God disciple battle.” Xue Ying responded, “I have no time to do so now.”
Finishing his words, Xue Ying resumed reading, occasionally drinking a mouth from the wine flask by his side why doing so.
This young man stood by the side for a moment before leaving helplessly with slight awkwardness.
…
There were very few Void Gods in the Great Void Heaven Temple. Furthermore, the slightly weaker ones were chased out into the primal chaos city in the outer world.
Instead, there were many True God disciples within. Even though the selection was extremely harsh, but the sacred world was vast. On another aspect, one could determine the future potential of the disciples when they were at the True God Ruler realm. Thus, the Great Void Heaven Temple was willing to accept a few of them while letting them undergo an extremely severe competition.
And now, the True God disciple battle was looming close.
‘Even without any bet, it is likely the case that they want to determine my power.’ Xue Ying thought. Know thy enemies, and it would be helpful during the challenge! Everyone felt that Xue Ying was not qualified to match against the true top 10 golden-robed disciples. However, they also felt that after reading through many books in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall, Xue Ying’s combat power would improve and he might even kill his way into the top 20 to 30 rank.
He had already become an opponent they could not underestimate! Thus, they had arranged some of the weaker ones to come and determine his baseline!
‘It’s a pity.’
‘My target isn’t 20 or 30. Instead, I must get into the top 10’ Xue Ying thought, ‘I must get the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit !’
For the sake of victory, Xue Ying would naturally not be so foolish as to reveal his combative techniques before the battle and allow the other party to have time to think of ways to deal against him! In the future during the True God disciple battle would he reveal his techniques, making it difficult even for the very talented ones to find some ways to counter him.
Other than a select few extremely talented ones, the ones closer to the top have extremely small gaps between their strength. One might even win because his techniques were able to curb the other party.
******
Xue Ying did not return to his cavern-dwelling, had not befriended anyone, and had stayed in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall reading through the books all the time.
Currently, he was primarily reading through books related to the Dao of Mirage, Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple!
At times, he would reveal looks of joy and began drinking wine happily.
At times, he would feel bewildered and had to rack his brains.
At times, he would have a great enlightenment.
His understanding of the laws was improving and expanding at a frightening speed!
Indeed!
They who had come from the cosmos lacked a great deal of understanding towards the Dao. This was due to there being no Void Gods in most cosmos epochs and no experts at the Unity realm or Primal Chaos realm. There were also no Cosmos Gods guiding them! At that time when Xue Ying was in his hometown cosmos, the strongest and most formidable one was Bloodshed God-Emperor. Bloodshed God-Emperor specialized in the ‘Dao of Bloodshed’, ‘Dao of Shadow’ and ‘Dao of Destruction’ which were entirely different from what Xue Ying comprehended!
Thus, when he was cultivating in the cosmos, he could still obtain guidance when he was a World Deity. After becoming a powerful existence, he had to depend on himself, probing his way blindly.
It was extremely normal to be stuck at the ordinary True God realm for 100 billion or one trillion years!
Paragon, Ruler… it was very normal to be stuck eternally without moving a single inch at any of these realms.
All of that was due to the fact that they could only depend on themselves!
But similarly, precisely due to that, every single step taken would be firm and stable. An example would be ‘Swordmaster’, who had cultivated to the Primal Chaos realm within the cosmos was something truly unfathomable. After arriving at the Great Void Heaven Temple and reading through the many books, many of the questions which he had were resolved he when he studied and contemplated by himself. Couple with the inspiration gained by clashing with others, he was able to break through and reach the final realm after exiting from closed-door cultivation.
Ancestor Devil had also reached the peak of Unity realm at first before entering the Great Void Heaven Temple and breaking through to the Primal Chaos realm.
Naturally, the majority of cultivators who depended on themselves would get stuck at the True God, Paragon or Ruler realm.
‘It is time for me to stop.’
Such a day suddenly appeared.
Xue Ying closed the book before placing the book back to its original position on the simple bookshelf. He felt that there was too much knowledge in his mind regarding the Dao of Mirage, Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple. Some had even been understood by his seniors. However, at the same time, he felt that there were conflicting points from what he understood against what was recorded by the seniors.
‘I have to sort out these comprehensions I have, consolidating them before fusing them into my own Dao.’ Xue Ying understood this point, even though he had yet to finish reading through the books, it was temporarily enough.
He brought over the wine flask from his side before walking out of the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall.
It had already been 3.23 million years since he arrived at the Great Void Heaven Temple… and he had only been reading through the books appropriate for him!
‘Time to visit the Palace Hall of Time.’ Xue Ying understood that the Palace Hall of Time was now the most appropriate place for him to improve his cultivation.
“Hu.”
He turned into a stream of light before flying out of the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall towards the Palace Hall of Time.

chapters.title: Chapter 804 - Time, Transformation
chapters.content:
Chapter 804: Time, Transformation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Palace Hall of Time, a relatively individual black triangular pagoda building, was also located on the colossal floating land of Great Void Heaven Temple. When Xue Ying got close to it, he could feel the faint warping of time-space.
Xue Ying flew to the entrance of the Palace Hall of Time.
Beyond the entrance of the palace hall was a stretch of empty darkness. Xue Ying respectfully said, “Senior, I require for time to be accelerated by a hundred times.”
“Alright.” A grand voice rang out. At the same time, a swallowing force engulfed Xue Ying from within the palace doors. “Sou”, it pulled Xue Ying in.
…
Xue Ying felt the world in front of his eyes change.
“Planets.” Xue Ying looked at this planet which he was located on. This planet was overgrown, and it was frigid. The entire planet seemed to be composed of glacial ice. The surface of the planet was floating with snowflakes too. This planet that was about 4,000 kilometers in diameter was indeed too small to Xue Ying.
This planet of similar size when placed in his hometown cosmos, Monarch Dong Bo residence, could only be taken as a decoration.
Xue Ying looked upwards.
In the dark void, there were many other planets. These planets were continually revolving along an ancient and mysterious array, while invisible energy was being guided and converged onto every single planet. Being the only lifeform on the planet he was on, Xue Ying could too feel the unseen energy converging towards him.
“This truly feels peculiar.” Xue Ying felt his body relaxing. While his soul appearing to become much emptier.
“No wonder it has such a high price. Cultivating here is quite a few times more effective than doing so in that golden-robed disciple cavern-dwelling of mine.” Xue Ying praised.
The Palace Hall of Time was a cultivation ground within the Great Void Heaven Temple with a time-accelerated environment. It was extremely difficult for experts to stay within this time-accelerated environment space without affecting the stability of the surrounding laws and profound mysteries. If Xue Ying was to do so in his hometown, the time-acceleration would influence the laws and profound mysteries.
As for the ‘Devil Mountain Cosmos’, it was able to maintain the stability of laws. However, that was because it was an enormous cosmos which had been refined at a huge price by the primogenitor. Even Void Gods would have stay within the inner section of the ‘Primogenitor Devil Mountain’, as the higher the level of life, the higher the burden they would cause to the Devil Mountain Cosmos.
The ‘Palace Hall of Time’ was a treasure refined by Forefather Tian Yu.
The price required to operate it was great. Thus, he had to pay the equivalent treasures to use it for cultivation.
When cultivating in a hundred times time-accelerated environment, True God Rulers would require a single Origin World Rock every 100 million years! Naturally, this 100 million years of time was the outside world time. A total of 10 billion years would have passed by then in the Palace Hall of Time.
Void Gods would require five Origin World Rocks for a 100 times time-accelerated environment for 100 million years.
Unity realm would have to pay 25 Origin World Rocks for the same amount of time.
As for those at the Primal Chaos realm, they would have to pay 100 Origin World Rocks!
This was merely for a hundred times time-accelerated environment. By increasing the time acceleration to a thousand times, the price would multiply by a hundred times!
As for time-accelerated environment at 10,000 times… the price required was extremely terrifying. ‘Primal Chaos realm’ existences were forbidden from using it at 10,000 times, as the burden they caused on the ‘Palace Hall of Time’ would be too great. The ‘Devil Mountain Cosmos’ was much weaker than the Palace Hall of Time, and yet, Void Gods would require to live within the Primogenitor Devil Mountain. As for Unity realm existences, they either had to stay in it or leave the cosmos! Primal Chaos existences were most certainly required to leave the cosmos.
Naturally-
It was stated ‘100 million years’ here. To most experts, they would only enter the Palace Hall of Time during more critical moments for a shorter period to improve their combat power! For instance, just cultivating here for a million years cost much less.
‘Being a golden-robed disciple, I have a total of 1,000 contribution points. I can cultivate here for a maximum of 10 million years.’ Xue Ying thought.
Contribution points…
Within the Great Void Heaven Temple, he could accept missions or contribute books that were qualified to be placed in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall. All these would reward him with contribution points! Those with higher statuses like the golden-robed disciples, the inner hall elders or the hall masters would be rewarded with contribution points every one billion years.
10,000 contribution points were equivalent to a single Origin World Rock! One could purchase many materials within the Great Void Heaven Temple.
However, there was one point…
Origin World Rocks could be used to exchange for contribution points within the Great Void Heaven Temple, but the contribution points could not be exchanged for the Origin World Rocks! The Great Void Heaven Temple would usually reward treasures and contribution points, but would never give out Origin World Rocks.
******
Every second of Xue Ying’s time was very precious, as he had to make Jing Qiu and Yu’er transcend before the cosmos epoch ended.
Thus, he treasured every single moment of his time. He would certainly frequent the ‘Palace Hall of Time’, thus driving him to get more treasures.
“Hua~”
Xue Ying sat cross-legged on the frost ice layer. This planet was desolate, with him being the only living being on it.
Within the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall, the knowledge which he gained through reading the many books began flashing through his mind as he contemplated over them. He would even validate his understanding from time to time. Having gotten a tremendous amount of information after reading for over three million years, he proceeded to derive further conjectures and throw those that were irrelevant and inappropriate for him to one side!
This validation and derivation process was much slower than comprehending and reading.
He spent a total of 800,000 years or so before finally consolidating his knowledge.
“Dao…”
Xue Ying stood on the planet. He looked at the surrounding planets, he couldn’t help but grin, “If I don’t understand, then I don’t understand. Even if I were stuck there, I would not comprehend it even after millions and millions of years. However, after understanding it, it will be much simpler from now on.”
After becoming a Ruler in his hometown cosmos, he cultivated for yet another billion years!
He had even comprehended the apocalyptic first sword as he drifted in the primal chaos void after leaving his hometown cosmos! Without anyone guiding him, he had already achieved greatly purely depended on his cursory expansion of understanding.
Now, after reading through many books and consolidated his knowledge, he no longer felt perplexed about reaching the ‘Void God’ from ‘Ruler realm’.
“Ruler, is all about ‘purity’! The heart is pure, while the Dao is pure. Only when the Dao is perfect enough will one be able to reach eternity.” Xue Ying murmured to himself, “As for the Void God, it is all about ‘broadness’, all about ‘encompassing’, and all about ‘balance’. It belongs to the law system.”
For instance, the Dao of Mirage was just a single Dao.
For him to rely on the Dao of Mirage to become a ‘Void God’, he had to use the Dao of Mirage to obtain other laws and profound mysteries before turning into a ‘law system’ by itself, with the Dao of Mirage at its core.
One had to know that the operating laws of a cosmos were manifested from many perfected laws fused into a single entity. It was not just a sole Dao.
Thus, to become Void God, he had to use the ‘Dao of Mirage’ as the core and perfectly fuse in other laws and profound mysteries to form a law system. A chopstick by itself was easily broken, but a bundle of chopsticks was much firmer. The moment it formed a law system, the ‘law domain’ it generated would be more perfected and stronger.
There was not a high requirement on other laws. For instance, the ‘Dao of Time-Space’ or ‘Dao of Extremity’ were like tiles and bricks, fusing into the core ‘Dao of Mirage’ to form a complete law system.
Of the three Daos Xue Ying had, the ‘Dao of Mirage’ was the most encompassing one. In addition to Xue Ying’s current experiences, if he were to conscientiously comprehend along this path, he was confident of breaking through after spending a little more time! However, at the very moment when he breaks through, he would become a Void God and would lose the qualifications of attending the True God disciple challenge. He would also lose the opportunity to get the ‘Supplementary Spiritual Fruit’ This lost opportunity was extremely harsh since it was only attainable by those who became golden-robed disciples during their first ranking match.
“I’ll focus first on cultivating my absolute arts.” Xue Ying was not in a rush to break through. Using a weaker version of laws and profound mysteries in the lower levels to comprehend a stronger absolute art was a kind of tempering for him towards his comprehension ability.
One’s comprehension ability would also change according to one’s encounter and refinement.
…
Xue Ying was currently concentrated on the “Shadowless Heaven’s Gathering”, the “3000 Incarnations”, the “God Light Scripture”, and the strongest “13 Apocalyptic Swords”. Naturally, he wanted to fuse in the profound mysteries of the Dao of Ripple with the apocalyptic first sword to create a new volume for the “Wind Ripple Path”.
After deriving the essence from the many books, his grasp towards the Dao of Mirage, Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple became more profound. He was even confident of reaching the Void God realm. And now, Xue Ying had partly understood the ideology and usage behind why Forefather Tian Yu created the ‘Apocalyptic First Sword’.
In the past, he only learned and used skills and arts, and not learned much about creation.
Now, with his horizons been broadened by a few times, he had some understanding of it. Thus, he was more confident about ‘mending it fully’.
…
TIme passed in the Palace Hall of TIme, before Xue Ying spent a total of 320 million years on this desolate planet, with a total of about 3 million years passing in the outer world. After spending so much time here, he had used up a total of 320 contribution points!
‘Who would have thought that I’ve comprehended the 21st level array diagram of “Walker’s Hidden Secret” despite not wanting to become a Void God.” The golden-robed Xue Ying chuckled with a shake of his head. It was fortunate that the Walker’s Hidden Secret was different from the laws and profound mysteries. After comprehending it, he would still procure sufficient primal chaos void energy and refine his body before he could break through to become a Void God.
As for the laws and profound mysteries, he would break through the moment he comprehended them.
Therefore, as long as he did not cultivate in it temporarily, he would continue to remain as a Ruler.
“I’ve comprehended the new volume for my Wind Ripple Path. However, I am unable to improve any further for the moment. If I was to cultivate the Dao of Mirage, Dao of Slaughter or Dao of Ripple, and accidentally broke through in the process, it is impossible for me to hide from the treasure spirit of this Palace Hall of Time.” Xue Ying shook his head, “Time to leave. I’ve only seen a small section of the books in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall. Time to continue reading!”
“Senior.”
Xue Ying announced, “I want to leave the Palace Hall of Time.”
“Hong~”
An unseen spatial energy engulfed Xue Ying and teleported him out.
Xue Ying felt his surroundings changing before realizing that he was outside the door of the Palace Hall of Time. Adding up the time he had been here to the Great Void Heaven Temple, it was only about six million years or so. There was still 2.8 million years before the True God disciple battle began, and he had quite an ample time.
Since he could no longer improve his combat power, and he could also not comprehend the Apocalyptic Second Sword, Xue Ying decided to enter the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall once again. He would continue drinking while flipping through the books in contention. These books were the crystallization of wisdom left behind by countless generations of experts that were either alive or dead. As he read, it was akin to listening to the guidance and pointers given by the experts. Such a reward had left Xue Ying intoxicated.

chapters.title: Chapter 805 - First Time Meeting the Swordmaster
chapters.content:
Chapter 805: First Time Meeting the Swordmaster
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The holy ground ‘Great Void Heaven Temple’ was exceptionally crowded today. The ‘inner hall elders’ who were usually rarely seen-they were either conducting missions outside or in closed-door cultivation-had actually appeared today. Even the highest two palace masters, ‘Forefather Tian Yu’ and ‘Swordmaster’ had exited from closed-door cultivation.
The True God disciple ranking battle was a large-scale internal battle across the entire Great Void Heaven Temple. It was basically a large-scale gathering!
“Golden-robed disciple Dong Bo Xue Ying, please come to the ‘Hidden World Field’.” A communication order was sent out.
Within the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall Xue YIng was slightly startled by the announcement. He casually placed the book in his hand back on the bookshelf as he thought, “This day has finally arrived.”
All of the more important books have already been browsed through by him already. During this period, he had been reading other books related to other systems like the ‘hex’ or the ‘ancient cultivation’. This broadened his horizons, allowing him to be more prepared when facing any future enemies.
“The “Apocalyptic 13 Swords” is truly difficult.” Xue Ying muttered to himself, “I had assumed that I can succeed in cultivating the second sword at the Ruler realm. However, it seems that I am still lacking.”
During the first time he when he had obtained the “Apocalyptic 13 Swords”, the first sword had caused a change in his expression. Therefore, he did not have much hopes in him being able to cultivate the second sword at the Ruler realm.
However, after flipping through the many books, which had improved his horizons and foundation,couple with the 300 million or so years he spent in the ‘Palace Hall of Time’, he had succeeded in fusing the ‘Apocalyptic First Sword’ with the profound mysteries from the Dao of Ripple. Furthermore, he understood how the Apocalyptic First Sword was constructed better as well.
As his realm deepened, the Apocalyptic Second Sword was no longer something unreachable. Causing hope and expectations to arise in him! During this 2.8 million years, as he browsed through the books in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall, he had always been pondering over the Apocalyptic Second Sword, and would occasionally visit the ‘Palace Hall of Time’ to further his comprehensions.
As of now, he barely had 500 contribution points left.What’s more, It’s a pity that he had yet to grasp the Apocalyptic Second Sword…
“Sou.” Xue Ying left the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall, turning into a stream of light as he flew towards the Hidden World Field.
…
“Xiu xiu xiu…”
In the space where the Great Void Heaven Temple was, there were many streams of light arcing through the skies.True God disciples had popped out from everywhere, all of them rushing straight towards the Hidden World Field.
“I’ve arrived.” Xue Ying looked afar.
The Hidden World Field was constructed for the sake of the ranking battle.
One could see the vast Hidden World Field being covered by an aura of slaughter. The Hidden World Field had more than a thousand stone pillars situated on top! They were arranged in a row, with the front few stone pillars being occupied by several golden-robed disciples and violet-robed disciples.
“Sou.” Xue Ying also went down, descending on the 11th stone pillar.
Every disciple was arranged to a stone pillar that was corresponded to the rankings they had achieved in the previous True God disciple battle! Naturally, after becoming a Void God, the rankings of the disciple behind would progress gradually. Howevering,since Xue Ying popped out as a golden-robed disciple, he was given the 11th rank, with every disciple behind him being moved back by a position.
“Sou sou…”
At this moment, there were still disciples coming.
Ten towering stone pillars were present to the left of Xue Ying. They were those ranked in the top 10. Currently, six golden-robed disciples had already arrived. As for the disciples to his right… they were naturally all violet-robed disciples. However, Xue Ying understood too that some of those ranked in the top 20 had once been golden-robed disciples, a clear indication of the strength they possess!
“Junior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying?”
“I’ve long heard of Junior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying, but this is still our first time meeting.”
Some of the golden-robed disciples started speaking. They usually were either friendly or proud as they seated cross-legged on the stone pillar with their eyes closed, giving no care about any other people.
Xue Ying also chuckled as he acknowledged back, “This is my first time coming to the Great Void Heaven Temple, so I’ve practically spent all my time in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall. Greetings, senior disciple brothers.”
“He’s Dong Bo Xue Ying?”
“Hmph, he is actually ranked in front of me.”
“You don’t have to care that much. He has become a golden-robed disciple via the trials within the cosmos. Naturally, he is ranked 11th. However, he should be much weaker than the golden-robed disciples who got their positions through the internal competition of Great Void Heaven Temple.”
“I’ve heard that many disciple brothers and sisters had challenged him before, but he did not accept any of them. He had even mentioned that he would accept them during the ranking battle.”
“Hmph hmph…”
“Soon, he will have to reveal his combat power.”
The violet-robed disciples by the side were chatting with each other through voice transmissions. Even though they were ranked close to the front, and some of them had even been golden-robed disciples before. Therefore, they did not place Xue Ying in their eyes. Nonetheless, these words were only spoken through voice transmissions.
Very soon, the top 100 disciples had all arrived on the stone pillars. As for the disciples ranked further behind? They were not qualified to come directly to the Hidden World Field. They had to pass through the qualification trials in order to do so. There were many violet-robed disciples did not even have the qualification to attend the True God disciple battle.
Since they were not qualified, there was no need for them to participate in the ranking battles.
“The two strongest golden-robed disciples.” Xue Ying looked towards the first and second golden-robed disciples, “According to the information, there is an extremely obvious gap between the two of them and golden-robed disciples ranked further behind.”
The golden-robed disciples ranking.
First, Rain Sword Guest.
Second, Old Devil Needle.
Most of the golden-robed disciples were closer in terms of the degree of their talent. However, two ranked in the front had an absolute superiority when facing those ranked beyond third.
“Old Devil Needle?” Xue Ying glanced at the former, a green-browed thin and weakly-looking male with a lone black horn. His eyes were also green, while he was emitting a wicked aura that made others jittery. According to the intelligence report, this Old Devil Needle had originally called himself ‘Forefather Old Needle’. However, after entering the Great Void Heaven Temple, regardless of his ostentatiousness, he was forced to change his name to ‘Old Devil Needle’.
Forefather…
Usually, only those who cultivated to the highest realm in any cultivation system would be called forefather, as contained the respect and admiration of a ‘primogenitor’. Therefore, within the holy ground, those who were weak would not dare to call themselves ancestor. ‘Ancestor Devil’ was able to maintain his own moniker firstly due to him already at the peak of Unity realm. Furthermore, no other Unity realm experts in the Great Void Heaven Temple was his opponent, while those at the Primal Chaos realm would not act. Thus, he was able to keep his moniker.
As for a little True God Ruler, how would he dare to call himself ancestor?
The Outer Hall Elders and Inner Hall Elders would ruthlessly teach him a lesson! It was fine to be called ancestor in some of the more rural areas. However, being called ancestor in the holy ground was practically seeking for trouble to come knocking.
“Rain Sword Guest?” Xue Ying looked at the Rain Sword Guest.
Rain Sword Guest was a sloppy male who sat cross-legged with a smile as he drank wine, while carrying a sword behind his back.
As Xue Ying was observing these two, the other golden-robed disciples and violet-robed disciples also turned towards the two of them. After all, being able to display such terrifying combative strength using the laws and profound mysteries at the Ruler realm was something everyone felt admiration for.
“Sou sou sou…” Suddenly, a large number of violet-robed disciples flew over.
“They are out.”
“The qualification trials have ended. This time, there are a total of 623 who passed through the trials. With the 100 of us, there is a total of 723 True God disciples participating in the battle.”
“They aren’t worth mentioning. Our opponents are still those ranked in the top 20.”
“This is hard to say. Of the batch of True God disciples, there are some who had just entered the Great Void Heaven Temple. Who knows if there might be some heaven-shattering newcomer present within their ranks.”
…
Suddenly, Xue Ying looked up after he feeling something.
One could see a group of figures flying over, with two at the lead. One was a hunchbacked old man, while the other was a white-haired male. The two of them were flying at the forefront and were casually chatting with each other happily. Even though they did not deliberately release their aura, just the level of life force they possessed created an enormous gulf between them and the rest.
