Xue Ying could even feel the terror coming from his own soul.
They were too high above!
Even flying through the primal chaos void, or facing an enormous cosmos would not produce a suppressive feeling that could match up with the ‘hunchbacked old man’ and the ‘white-haired male’.
That’s right. The two existences in front… were existences who could destroy a cosmos with a flip of their hands. If they were willing, they could even wield the power of destroying a ‘sacred world’! They were also the only two existences in the current five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void who had reached the final realm-Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster!
Behind the two, there were many other Primal Chaos existences-a total of 9. Ancestor Devil did not seem brilliant among them since he had, after all, cultivated for a shorter period. At this moment, he was ranked in the middle across the Great Void Heaven Temple’s palace masters.
‘According to the information, there are a total of 12 Primal Chaos realm experts in the Great Void Heaven Temple. It seems that three of them aren’t around.’ Xue Ying thought. Even though True God disciple battle was a distinguished meeting, not all the Primal Chaos experts would participate. Even ‘Swordmaster’ would frequently be in closed-door cultivation, and he might not always participate. Naturally, Swordmaster had came this time.
Behind them…
were the Inner Hall Elders.
“Hong long long~” High up in the sky, the cloud converged to form many thrones.
Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster sat at the highest location.
The nine Primal Chaos experts and 31 Inner Hall Elders then sat down, their gazes shooting down beneath them.
“Swordmaster, that brat is Dong Bo Xue Ying.” Ancestor Devil transmitted over. Even though they had fought for long periods in their hometown, with him treating Swordmaster as his target, Ancestor Devil understood the huge gap between him and the latter.
The white-haired male ‘Swordmaster’ looked beneath, and his gaze soon landed on the ranked 11th Xue Ying.

chapters.title: Chapter 806 - Invitation to a Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 806: Invitation to a Battle
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“He is quite young.” The white-haired male Swordmaster looked below him. He revealed a grin.
Forefather Tian Yu who sat beside also noticed Xue Ying. He chuckled, “Of the five cosmos that I’ve created, it really amazing for you and Ancestor Devil to appear from the Starting Cosmos! However, the future generations after you two were all extremely ordinary. Being able to get through the golden-robed disciple trial means that this Dong Bo Xue Ying has quite the potential.”
Swordmaster nodded.
Towards the junior brat who came from his hometown cosmos, Swordmaster and Ancestor Devil naturally felt partial towards Xue Ying. Therefore, Swordmaster also came to participate in the gathering this time to see how strong this junior of his was.
“Begin!” Forefather Tian Yu suddenly spoke out, his grand voice reverberating throughout the entire Hidden World Field.
He, Swordmaster, the Primal Chaos Palace Masters and other Inner Hall Elders began drinking and chatting idly. To them, this was just a gathering. Usually, the majority of them would have their own matters to do, and they could use this gathering as a way to catch up while see which juniors have potential.
And below, on the many stone pillars, the True God disciples were already bursting with expectations.
“Senior Disciple Brother Chen Tao, please.” A figure flew into the midair from the stone pillar and directly took the initiative to send a challenge.
“Hmph.”
The other violet-robed disciple who was offered a challenge snorted before flying out to accept the challenge.
…
There were rules for the True God disciple ranking battle.
Every disciple could only challenge someone at most 20 ranks above their current rank! The was no limit in the number of times one could battle. However, if one lost three times, one would no longer be qualified to challenge others.
What’s more, losing after ‘being challenged’ was not within the ‘losing three times’ count.
If one won, one would take over the position of the defeated.
As for the defeated, he or she would move back one position.
…
Like those ranked beyond 700, they would have to challenge someone 20 ranks above them, which went to say that they had to challenge over 30 rounds of battle before they could kill their way to the first. And now with so many True God disciples who could challenge each other, the number of battles was numerous. A single ‘True God disciple ranking battle’ could last for ten years or so.
Naturally, just ten years to those who were observing the battle like Forefather Tian Yu, Swordmaster, the many Primal Chaos Palace Masters, the Inner Hall Elders, and other Outer Hall Elders or True God disciples who did not qualify to battle was not worth mentioning.
******
“Senior Disciple Brother Chi, please.” A cold voice followed.
At that moment, the many disciples, Inner and Outer Hall Elders, the golden-robed disciples on the stone pillars, the violet-robed disciples and many other turned and looked over. That’s was due to the fact that ‘Senior Disciple Brother Chi’ was the 9th ranking golden-robed disciple. He was also the very first golden-robed disciple to be challenged during this True God disciple ranking battle.
If she wins, the other party would take over the ninth position!
“Junior Disciple Sister Feng Yun, you came to challenge me again?” A majestic laughter accompanied. A tall and sturdy scarlet-skinned bald golden-robed disciple male flew out. He extended his hand, causing a great black hammer to appear.
“You better be careful.” The silver-eyed girl’s eyes were filled with sky-shattering fighting spirit.
The moment she finished speaking, the silver-eyed girl turned into a huge red bird. This bird had a pair of silver eyes too, while its wings were engulfed in flames. “Hong~” The surging flames immediately enveloped the surrounding and the distant ‘Senior Disciple Brother Chi’. Seeing that, Senior Disciple Brother Chi merely grinned at that as he brought out the great hammer in his hand.
His arms started to grow bigger, while the great hammer pressed down just like an enormous mountain. Despite appearing like an ordinary move, it contained an extremely profound feeling. At this moment, the surrounding space and everything converged onto that great hammer.
…
The ninth-ranked Senior Disciple Brother Chi displayed the cosmos ranked absolute art “World Guard”. This was an absolute art geared towards defense, and was one of the three great cosmos ranked absolute arts created by Forefather Tian Yu! However, by using it on the great hammer, Senior Disciple Brother Chi had used it to conduct his offensive.
Senior Disciple Brother Chi had even fused the “World Guard” into his body refining technique, allowing him to own a powerful fleshy body. From what Xue Ying had deduced, its should like be similar to the 16th or 17th level of the ‘Walker’s Hidden Secret’. The body of Senior Disciple Brother Scarlet specialized most in defense.
As for Junior Disciple Sister Feng Yun, she was ranked 15th during the previous time. Being a void creature with an amazing talent, she comprehended an absolute art after entering the Great Void Heaven Temple, allowing her to become powerful. Nonetheless, she was not lucky enough to never enter the top 10.
This battle lasted a full three hours. Junior Disciple Sister relied on her advantage in speed to continuously attack. Nevertheless, Senior Disciple Brother Chi still won!
…
The battles continued.
Xue Ying sat cross-legged on the stone pillar watching the battle. He was relatively excited as he watched on, because every single disciple had become a True God Ruler using the laws and profound mysteries system, and was able to exert a transcendental strength! With so many different usages of the laws and profound mysteries, it had lit up the eyes of Xue Ying. He saw some who specialized in the Dao of Slaughter, some in the Dao of Ripple and some in the Dao of Mirage…
Even though Xue Ying was confident of winning, he was currently learning from the strengths and experiences of others.
In the blink of an eye, this gathering had lasted for half a year.
Xue Ying had not even battled once!
Firstly, there were too many True God disciples-more than 700 of them. Secondly, those who were ranked further in front would directly be challenging those in the top ten! Because only when they defeat those in the top ten could they become a golden-robed disciple. As for Xue Ying, even though he was a golden-robed disciple, he was ranked 11th. After the ranking battle ended, this 11th position would become a violet-robed disciple.
Under ordinary circumstances, there would only be ten golden-robed disciples.
Naturally, there was also another reason… and that was because Xue Ying was enjoying himself as he watched the battles in excitement!
It was truly an eye-opening experience!
Even though he flipped through many books, only when he was genuinely watching the Rulers with exceptional attainments in the laws and profound mysteries fighting would he able to have great gains in his comprehension. This made his understanding of the Dao of Slaughter, Dao of Ripple, and Dao of Mirage had become even more profound. What’s more, he could even feel some of his perplexity over the second sword of “13 Apocalyptic Swords” being resolved.
Cultivation was all about accumulating experiences and understanding. Once it reached a sufficient extent, the cultivator would break through! And now, spectating the battles was a form of accumulation for Xue Ying! After all, the Rulers here were all outstanding.
Even if his teacher, ‘Bloodshed God-Emperor’, a Ruler was to came to participate the battles, he might not even enter the top 100!
One could easily fathom the degree of talent the True God disciples had in Great Void Heaven Temple.
“Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying, please!” Suddenly, a voice sounded.
“Wu…”
Xue Ying who was currently watching another battle with rapt attention, could not help but turn towards the black-skinned teenager who was looking at him while standing in midair.
Inviting him to a battle?
Someone was asking him for a battle?
Xue Ying felt relatively delighted, though after winning him, the other party would only move to the 11th rank.
“This junior disciple brother, please.” Xue Ying flew over.
“Mn?”
“Dong Bo Xue Ying?”
“He is the golden-robed disciple Dong Bo Xue Ying who came from that cosmos?”
“The same cosmos where Swordmaster and Ancestor Devil came from.”
This battle had instantly attracted the attention of a considerable number of disciples as the other ten golden-robed disciples have yet to battle. After all, only those that were ranked in the top 30 were able to challenge the top. Therefore, the golden-robed disciples would rarely be challenged.
“This brat Dong Bo Xue Ying.” Ancestor Devil also looked downwards, with the highest located white-haired male Swordmaster also turning over.
To the two of them, they were quite interested in the battle of a junior from their hometown.
…
The black-skinned teenager stood in midair, saying: “Bao Xiao greets Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying. Senior disciple brother mentioned this before that we can have a gamble during the True God disciple ranking battle right?”
Xue Ying was stunned. His expression had a slight change.
Gamble?
He felt puzzled why someone would invite him for a battle! If they won, they would still not enter the top ten. So it was because of the gamble!
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded.
“The stake is on senior disciple brother’s Void God weapon?” The black-skinned teenager continued.
At this moment, the other disciples began to feel excited. It was a bet. That time, this golden-robed disciple had arrived in the Great Void Heaven Temple from his cosmos, and many wanted to have a wager with him! But it had already been over 30 million years, and this golden-robed disciple had read through many books in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall. And now, it seemed hard to estimate his power. Furthermore, the stake was significant as well; thus nobody was willing to wager with him.
“Bao Xiao was ranked 16th in the previous ranking battle. He had once been a golden-robed disciple.”
“He was once a golden-robed disciple, yet he wanted to wager with this Dong Bo Xue Ying. Isn’t that bullying?”
“Truly sinister.”
“This Dong Bo Xue Ying should not be that foolish to accept it, right?”
The many disciples were discussing in secret.
Although Bao Xiao was ranked 16th previously, it was not indicative that he was weaker than the 15 cultivators ranked above him! That was because those who had never entered the top ten would not care much about the ranking outside the top ten. Being a former golden-robed disciple, so he should be very powerful.
“You want to wager on my Void God weapon?” Xue Ying looked at him, “Then you should bring out 25 Origin World Rocks or treasures of equivalent value?”
“Naturally I’ll bring them out.” The black-skinned teenager looked at Xue Ying, “Is senior disciple brother willing to have a wager? Currently, all the disciple brothers and sisters are around. Even the two palace masters and hall masters are all around. The moment you speak out this time, it is impossible for you to go against your words!”
“Then we will proceed with it.” Xue Ying nodded.
The black-skinned teenager was startled. He then felt an intense joy erupting from deep his heart.
He was after all a golden-robed disciple in the past. Thus, the desire to get into the top ten wasn’t that intense since he had already gotten the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit and the cosmos ranked absolute art before. Instead… he coveted the wager with Xue Ying since it was a piece of upper graded Void God weapon! He would be bringing out 25 Origin World Rocks which was also his entire savings. This time, he had really struck big!
Those former golden-robed disciples had either wanted to protect their reputations or did not think Xue Ying was so foolish to accept the challenge. Regardless of their reasons, they did not challenge him at all.
Yet he had initiated the bet!
And Xue Ying actually accepted it! This made the others who had once been golden-robed disciples cry secretly in anguish. Why was this Xue Ying so confident of himself? Why did they not take the initiative to ask him for a challenge?
“Are you reneging?” The black-skinned teenager asked again.
“Naturally I will not renege.” Xue Ying said.
At this moment, the absolute majority of people present had come turned towards Xue Ying and the other. Even Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster were all watching excitedly. They did not hinder the battle at all! Xue Ying who had cultivated to this realm was no longer an immature child, and any decisions he made had to be assumed by him.

chapters.title: Chapter 807 - Confrontation
chapters.content:
Chapter 807: Confrontation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The moment Xue Ying just finished replying, the eyes of the other black-skinned teenager brightened as he shouted, “Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying is really straightforward. Receive my move!” The moment he finished speaking, many green thunder snakes shot out from the surface of his body. These thunder were just like huge living snakes that rampantly swam across the void with terrifying destructive energy.
In an instant, there were more than a hundred big thunder snakes that came over.
Xue Ying stood at his original spot, holding onto a deep violet spear with his right hand. Unseen ripples started spreading out with him as the center, forming a vast spherical domain. As the unseen ripples spread out, they started warping turning his surroundings into something akin to a world within a lake that rippled and undulated.
Those big thunder snakes that swam appeared to have fallen into the web, suffering severe restrictions, resulting in their power being drastically reduced. These big thunder snakes had yet to reach the side of Xue Ying before all of them were destroyed.
“”Shadowless Heaven’s Gathering”!”
“This Dong Bo Xue Ying has such a formidable domain technique. He has actually utilized the “Shadowless Heaven’s Gathering” to such an extent that it actually destroyed the thunder snakes.”
All the spectating disciples were startled.
They were all too familiar with the absolute arts of the Great Void Heaven Temple. The “Shadowless Heaven’s Gathering” was a Primal Chaos ranked absolute art, and violet-robed disciples were all qualified to select them. There were too many cultivators who had trained in this! There were even many of this current generation of True God Rulers who had cultivated the “Shadowless Heaven’s Gathering”. Thus, they were able to determine the attainments of Xue Ying’s “Shadowless Heaven’s Gathering” had reached a level that they felt admirable about.
“The “9 Thunder Snake Swords” might be a final realm cosmos ranked absolute art, but it is a sword technique used for offense. Using it as a large-scale attack and sending out a horde of thunder snakes is comparatively weaker to its original form! Even though the “Shadowless Heaven’s Gathering” might be a primal chaos ranked absolute art, it is a purely domain-related absolute art. Thus, in this aspect of the domain, it is able to parry against those thunder snakes.”
“Bao Xiao hasn’t truly revealed his power! The moment he fully erupts, Dong Bo Xue Ying might still lose.”
“Mn, regardless of whether it is on experiences of accumulations, Dong Bo Xue Ying suffers greatly!”
“And it is even a wager battle! It’s an upper-graded Void God weapon!”
These disciples were all discussing among themselves.
Even though Xue Ying vaguely held the upper hand after they exchanged moves, the majority still thought that ‘Bao Xiao’ had a better chance because he did not specialize in domain-related arts anyway.
…
The large thunder snakes which Bao Xiao released had been worn down. He could not help but chuckle, “Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying is indeed quite powerful.” The moment he finished speaking, his body turned into a dazzling violet thunder. This violet thunder rapidly arced through the void. He used a horrifying speed to charge over, causing the face of Xue Ying to change.
So fast!
He had seen many battles over the past half a year. There were quite a few golden-robed disciples who had battled too, but the speed of this Bao Xiao remained the fastest he had ever seen! He might have the power of a Voidwalker, but in terms of flying speed, Xue Ying him likely to be weaker by an entire level.
“Hong.” Xue Ying suddenly retreated. He was not in a rush to clash against the other party since this concerned a large bet!
He wanted to carefully determine where the baseline of the other party was.
In the sacred world, they could not teleport. Although Xue Ying might not be able to match his opponent in speed, his was able to rank in the top ten amongst all the True God disciples in terms of speed -that was an extremely fast speed. Furthermore, he had released countless ripples around him, forming a spherical ripple domain, while many blood silk strands began forming within,
The blood silk strands started to warp and weft every single area of the spherical domain.
Xue Ying had long reached an all new level in his ‘Slaughter Domain’ after spending so long in the Great Void Heaven Temple.
“The Dong Bo Xue Ying is really fast! I have cultivated the absolute art which Swordmaster created that specializes in speed, the “9 Thunder Snake Swords”, that allowed me to travel this fast. But why is his speed so fast too-just slightly slower than mine?” Bao Xiao was still astonished at the speed of Xue Ying. But closely following that, his expression changed since many blood silk strands appeared in the surrounding domain.
These blood silk strands were akin to the veins of a ripple domain, causing the restriction and corrosive power in entire ripple domain to surge. Furthermore, these blood silk strands were as destructive as the edges of swords.
In the Slaughter Domain, the speed of Bao Xiao had reduced too as if he was flying in an inescapable net.
“Damn, want to stop me?”
“Open for me!”
Bao Xiao originally had a smile on his face. But at this moment, he felt the threat. His expression could not help but become savage. There was a killing intent as sharp as blade forming in his eyes, “I must win this battle!”
“Hong!”
The black divine sword light in the hands of Bao Xiao suddenly grew.
“Si la~” with the divine sword in hand, Bao Xiao brought along a frightening sharpness as he tore through the Slaughter Domain towards Xue Ying.
“Come.” Xue Ying also went on to meet the incoming attack. Regardless of whether he wanted to save time by visiting the Palace Hall of Time to cultivate or to get precious cultivation materials, everything required Origin World Rocks! Therefore, he had to win this battle.
The violet spear body revolved and rolled out before its spearhead pierced straight at Bao Xiao.
“The Apocalyptic First Sword!” The expression of bao Xiao slightly changed, “He actually cultivated the Apocalyptic First Sword. This is getting troublesome.”
…
Seated at the highest, Swordmaster and Forefather Tian Yu were both watching this battle.
“Hahaha.” Forefather Tian Yu chuckled, “Swordmaster, you and that brat from the same hometown actually cultivated my 13 Apocalyptic Swords. And now, his opponent is using your 9 Thunder Snake Swords.”
“Forefather.” The white-haired Swordmaster looked at the battle below and casually mentioned, “You have left behind three cosmos ranked absolute arts that you’ve created in the Starting Cosmos. The cosmos ranked absolute arts which I created weren’t left in my hometown cosmos at all. How could this Dong Bo Xue Ying brat learn my absolute art if he could not even select it after the trial in my hometown cosmos?”
“Haha, no matter what, what he learned is my absolute art.” Forefather Tian Yu was relatively delighted.
The Swordmaster had created a total of four cosmos ranked absolute arts.
Of which three were sword techniques!
“Oh right, you have always been in closed-door cultivation. Are you confident now?” Forefather Tian Yu suddenly turned to Swordmaster. His eyes were filled with a strand of expectation.
“I am only 50% confident.” Swordmaster’s expression turned slightly solemn, “This matter is extremely important. If we aren’t careful, it’ll be a great war, and Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World might even be destroyed. Therefore, only when I am 100% confident… I still have to prepare myself well at that time.”
Forefather Tian Yu slowly nodded, “I’ve waited for this day for too long, so I am not in a rush. Let us wait since you don’t have a 100% certainty yet. There is already no hope for me since I can’t progress after cultivating for such a long period. It is different for you, as you have a greater hope than I do.”
The eyes of Swordmaster were filled with a strand of desire too. He then chuckled and turned back to the battle below, “Let’s not mention that anymore and enjoy the battle.”
“Mn, let’s enjoy the battle.” Forefather Tian Yu lowered his head and continued watching the battle.
…
“Dang dang dang~”
The weapons from the two parties clashed as fast as lightning. The black-skinned Junior Disciple Brother Bao Xiao had currently transformed completely into lightning, using his fastest speed to send sword after sword frantically. Despite that, Xue Ying could entirely parry against them by using both ‘Slaughter Domain’ and the Apocalyptic First Sword.
“Hou~” Bao Xiao was utterly enraged now. He howled furiously, before a golden eye split open right on his forehead. Frightening lightning arcs were present in this golden eye. A golden bolt of lightning was pulled out into the divine sword in his hand causing its power was rapidly increasing. This was the strongest technique he had as a golden-robed disciple.
“Ancient cultivator?”
Xue Ying was long prepared. The elites of the laws and profound mystery lineage would usually cultivate other systems to cover up for some of their weaknesses. Most could display a stronger power by cultivating the additional system! This Junior Disciple Brother Bao Xiao had once been a golden-robed disciple precisely due to him having he cultivated an ancient cultivation system which specialized most in controlling thunder.
The ancient cultivation had some very strong and some very weak methods. Some were mysterious and strange. These were all part of the cultivation systems in the most primitive Ancient Sacred World. During the point when one became a Deity, someone cultivating the laws and profound mysteries system would open a ‘Deity Sea’ before condensing the true deity heart. As for the ancient cultivation system, one would have to form a ‘true life core’ and fuse one’s soul into it. This true life core would usually be a specific organ on the body.
For instance, the eyes? Or the ears? Or the heart? Or the skin? Or the brain?
Different true life cores would allow their potential to be different. They would reveal all sorts of weird methods when they became Deities. And as they reached the True God Ruler realm, like Bao Xiao, he had a golden eye thunder right in his forehead. Even if it was a very crude move, it was sufficient to be an apex Ruler skill. The weaker Rulers would be killed directly from it! Furthermore, Junior Disciple Brother Bao Xiao had fused the power into the 9 Thunder Snake Swords, allowing it to become more terrifying.
“Hmph.” Facing the mad Bao Xiao, surging energy from within Xue Ying’s body moved onto the spear body. The power of the 20th level of Voidwalker was unleashed in its entirety!

chapters.title: Chapter 808 - Dumbstruck
chapters.content:
Chapter 808: Dumbstruck
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Hong~” The weapons clashed, before Bao Xiao was forced backward by the impact. Trembling, a mouth of blood spurted out from him… That mouthful of blood sprayed into mid-air, before being easily dissipated apart by the countless blood silk strands.
“What!”
“How can this be possible?”
“He actually has the upper hand?”
Previously, many of the spectators who were calmly watching, were now greatly shocked. Bao Xiao had used both the ancient cultivation technique with the ‘9 Thunder Snake Swords’, boosting his strength greatly. This was the true power of Bao Xiao! They felt that it sufficed to suppress Xue Ying. However, the result of them clashing showed that the strengthened Bao Xiao was completely suppressed!
“Junior Disciple Brother Bao Xiao, come and receive some moves of mine too!” Xue Ying guffawed. He held onto the spear and directly charged over.
“How is this possible? No, no, it shouldn’t be.” Bao Xiao was flustered as he hurriedly utilize his sword techniques to parry against the attack. Nevertheless, other than being unpredictable and mysterious, every single spear of Xue Ying was back by a terrifying might behind them. They appeared like surging waves charging over, resulting in Bao Xiao being completely unable to defend against them. Every time he received a move, Bao Xiao would be forced to fly backward.
Xue Ying became increasingly berserk. The Slaughter Domain was entangling and restricting the enemy, while his spear chase after the enemy for the kill!
The difference in might between a weak body and a Voidwalker using the Apocalyptic First Sword was like heaven and earth. The Walker’s Hidden Secret 20th level… enabled Xue Ying to attain the strength a Voidwalker had just with his body. Previously, he had completely concealed his strength. Otherwise, when the enemy utilized the 9 Thunder Snake Swords, how would it be possible for him to fight until now if he had used the 13 Apocalyptic Swords?
The body at the level of a Voidwalker was augmented onto the Apocalyptic First Sword. This was way more terrifying than the other party using the golden-eye thunder to augment his 9 Thunder Snake Swords.
“Hong hong hong…”
Xue Ying did not show any mercy, continuing chasing and pursuing Bao Xiao.
“Pu~” Finally, a spear had pushed away the divine sword in Bao Xiao’s hand, piercing through his body. Although the violet robe on Bao Xiao was very firm, the destructive force of the spear still pierced over, causing his body to immediately shatter and destroy.
All of a sudden!
An unseen force enveloped Bao Xiao. Even though part of the body of Bao Xiao had started disintegrating, his head remained perfectly well.
Feeling the eruption of this energy, Xue Ying revealed a grin, before back a step.
He had won!
The ‘Hidden World Field’ was a truly mysterious array. The power of the Hidden World Field reached every single section of the entire place. The moment any fighting disciple was met with a fatalistic danger, the power of the Hidden World Field would protect them instantly! After all, these were mere battles between ‘True God Ruler’ realm. It was too easy for Forefather Tian Yu to personally refine a Hidden World Field that could protect them.
Over the long years, countless True God disciples fought and battled in the Hidden World Field, though none had truly died in it before!
“Hu~” The body of Bao Xiao was recovering, albeit his expression was slightly pale. At this moment, his eyes were glazed over. Lost? He lost?
“Junior Disciple Brother Bao Xiao, please remember about the wager.” Xue Ying chuckled.
Bao Xiao looked towards the teenager holding on to a spear. He lost truly pitifully to a golden-robed disciple who came from the cosmos that had less experience in battling as compared to the talented Rulers in the sacred world. Bao Xiao originally thought this was a chance for him to benefit at the other party’s expense!
However, since this was a wager battle, he had to admit defeat after losing!
Today, ‘Forefather Tian Yu’ and ‘Swordmaster’ were both spectating the battle. There were also other hall masters, so Bao Xiao did not dare to go against his words. Previously, he still wanted to make use of this chance to ensure Xue Ying keep his words as long as he won the battle, yet who would have thought that Bao Xiao was facing this situation on himself.
“Alright.” Bao Xiao flipped his hand, causing a wristband to appear. The muscles on his face twitched a few moments, though he still threw it over in the end.
Catching the wristband, Xue Ying He immediately refined it and investigated what was inside.
Furthermore, he obtained the information from his communication talisman-contribution points increased by 30,000!
“Mn?” Xue Ying checked through the treasures within the wristband. The most dazzling amongst the contents were the many rocks present with. The rocks were revolving in some mysterious color appearing truly beautiful and dazzling. One would feel one’s heart pumping and soul trembling from the allure. It was like how a hungry person wanted to eat something, though in this case, it was the soul that was ‘hungry’ and wanted to consume this Origin World Rock.
Xue Ying checked through the Origin World Rocks and other treasures before keeping it after that. The hunger his soul was feeling disappeared after that.
“Hu.” Xue Ying sighed, “The Origin World Rocks are truly too alluring. According to hearsay, even those at the Primal Chaos realm and Cosmos Gods pay a lot of attention to the Origin World Rocks. I am just a True God Ruler, therefore it will be too much of a waste to absorb Origin World Rocks.”
The Origin World Rocks were mysterious.
It was useful to any living beings-even Cosmos Gods.
And some precious materials had weaker effects on those who were stronger. For instance, the ‘Supplementary Spiritual Fruit’ had mystical effects on Rulers. But to Cosmos Gods? It was useless to even eat it!
Thus, the Origin World Rock was more suitable for experts to use. To the weak, they would be used for exchanging for treasures, and that would be something more worthwhile.
“There’s only 12 pieces of Origin World Rocks.” Xue Ying transmitted over to Bao Xiao.
Bao Xiao had some awkwardness on his face. He transmitted back, “12 Origin World Rocks. The other materials and the contribution points could barely be used to match the value of 13 Origin World Rocks.”
Xue Ying looked at him.
Just three pieces of Origin World Rocks could be exchanged for 30,000 contribution points! But nobody would be willing to exchange 30,000 contribution points using Origin World Rocks.
“These 12 pieces of Origin World Rocks have been what I accumulated over many years.” Bao Xiao transmitted.
“Alright.” Xue Ying chuckled, “If Junior Disciple Brother Bao Xiao wanted to have another gamble match, I will definitely comply with you anytime.”
Right, he would comply with him anytime.
That was because after the True God disciple battle ended, he would break through to become a Void God.
…
This battle made many disciples dumbstruck. ‘Bao Xiao’ who was once a golden-robed disciple, had actually lost in the wager battle to Xue Ying!
“This Dong Bo Xue Ying is quite formidable.”
“His body seems to be exceptionally powerful.”
The hall masters watching the battle were shocked.
Ancestor Devil’s cold expression finally revealed a grin. Whenever Xue Ying was mentioned in the Great Void Heaven Temple, they would also speak about how Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster came from the same cosmos too! Thus, the more dazzling Xue Ying was, the more Ancestor Devil felt proud. Ancestor Devil was different from Swordmaster. Swordmaster was incomparably more brilliant, though Ancestor Devil paid more attention to his reputation.
“He actually won.” Forefather Tian Yu looked below with shock, “His body is so strong. He should be ranked second among the True God disciples in terms of his body. It seems his body is geared towards the void. I wonder what miraculous opportunity he had encountered.”
There were many possibilities to why a body was strong.
There were many kinds of ancient cultivation techniques, and even the strongest warrior system also contained many terrifying inheritances. The laws and profound mysteries system also had many absolute arts meant for cultivating one’s body, just like how there was one amongst the Great Void Heaven Temple True God disciples who was extremely talented in the ‘Strongest Warrior system’. His body was extremely strong and was just slightly stronger than this Voidwalker 20th level of Xue Ying.
This was also the reason why Xue Ying did not display the ‘Termination Energy’. There were many reasons why his body could be strong. However at the very instant, he displayed the Termination Energy, those at the Primal Chaos realm and the two Palace Masters would definitely recognize his technique.
It was fine if Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster found out the secret of him being a Voidwalker. However, it would be troublesome if he was to reveal himself in this gathering amongst so many experts! Because his own teacher ‘Gu Qi’ had somehow offended a very terrifying enemy. Even though the Great Void Heaven Temple could protect himself, it was definitely better for there to be less trouble!
Even if he did not use the Termination Energy, he could definitely still enter top 10!
“Senior Disciple Brother Qi Yun.” Xue Ying did not fly back to his stone pillar. Instead, he faced the golden-robed disciple who was ranked seventh, “Please!”
That slightly thin golden-eyed male was stunned for a moment. A grin subsequently appeared on his face before flew out.
At this moment, silence filled the surrounding area!
Another battle?
Xue Ying had not acted at all in the past half year. And now after defeating Bao Xiao, he actually decided to challenge the 7th ranking ‘Qi Yun’?
“Junior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying has shown off your ability and dares to wager on a battle. And now, you have asked me for a battle after that.” The golden-eyed male laughed, “Are you planning to have a wager on this battle too?”
“25 pieces of Origin World Rocks or any treasures of equivalent value. “Xue Ying laughed, “Just like previously, if Senior Disciple Brother Qi Yun is willing to bet, I’ll naturally be happy to comply.”
The golden-eyed male was stunned momentarily.
The surrounding turned into an uproar.
“Haha, I’ll just forgo it. I can’t take out so many treasures for a period.” The golden-eyed male rejected with a loud laughter, though he felt his heart tightening inwardly. He did not dare to take out so many treasures to gamble in a situation he wasn’t confident it! Even being a golden-robed disciple, it was hard for him to accumulate so many treasures.
“Senior Disciple Brother Qi Yun, please be careful.” The moment Xue Ying finished speaking, unseen ripples started forming in the surrounding. At the same time, many blood silk strands proceeded to propagate out.
A pair of golden wings suddenly opened up at the back of the golden-eyed male. His body turned illusory before three bodies appeared.
Xue Ying grinned, as three incarnations also appeared around him. Including his body, he had four bodies.
“Not good.” The golden-eyed male Qi Yun felt his heart turning cold.
…
Xue Ying’s domain suppression and his incarnations had restrained Senior Disciple Brother Qi Yun’s incarnation technique. Without the advantage of his incarnations, Qi Yun was slightly weaker than even Bao Xiao!
The victor of this battle went to Xue Ying! He had taken over the seventh ranking position as a golden-robed disciple, and was officially in the top ten!
“My defeat.”
Qi Yun did not feel so bad. After all, seeing how formidable the other party’s incarnation technique was, he had already prepared himself mentally for this to happen. Nonetheless, he felt quite joyous as he thought, ‘Fortunately, I did not wager with him.’ Ultimately even if he lost, he would drop to the eighth position only.
All of the True God disciples and the higher-ups of Great Void Heaven Temple were all relatively shocked.
A new golden-robed disciple that emerged from a cosmos had shoved his way into the top ten? This was the holy ground Great Void Heaven Temple! Furthermore, judging by the aura of his soul, Xue Ying was currently the youngest golden-robed disciple ranked in the top ten!

chapters.title: Chapter 809 - Dazzling
chapters.content:
Chapter 809: Dazzling
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Ancestor Devil, this Dong Bo Xue Ying came from the same cosmos as you, right? This brat seems quite formidable. He is actually able to get into the top ten of the True God disciples despite having only been Great Void Heaven Temple for a while.”
“Swordmaster has broken through to the final realm, and you, Ancestor Devil has long reached the Primal Chaos realm. I wonder what realm will this brat from your same cosmos will reach in the future.”
The hall masters around were praising him too.
Ancestor Devil might have some slight praise and satisfaction, but he still said: “He is just a True God disciple. It is still too early to say if he would become an Inner Hall Elder in the future.”
“Inner Hall Elder?”
The other Hall Masters chuckled and did not continue speaking anymore.
What a joke!
How difficult was it to become an Inner Hall Elder?
According to the statuses of the inner Great Void Heaven Temple, the subsequent rank after the Palace Master and the Hall Master would be the Inner Hall Elders! And thereafter the Outer Hall Elders.
Even if golden-robed disciples broke through to become Void God, the majority would end up as Outer Hall Elders. It was too difficult to become an Inner Hall Elder. Those who could become on within the Great Void Heaven Temple would shock an entire region! Even the Primal Chaos realm giants would attach importance to them.
…
Although Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster seated at the highest area were praising Xue Ying, they remained calm inside their hearts. The things that could rifle them at their level were too few and far between.
The challenges within the Hidden World Field continued.
After Xue Ying attained the seventh rank, he returned back to seat on his designated stone pillar. He kept an extremely low profile while watching the battles. Unlike from the other True God disciples. Xue Ying watched every single battle seriously and had even analyzed the profound mysteries used by the other disciples. Even though some disciple brothers and sisters were weaker than him, their usage of the laws and profound mysteries still made Xue Ying’s eyes light up.
As he understood more and more, he would occasionally have some new understanding of the second sword of ’13 Apocalyptic Swords’.
To other disciples… this ranking battle would determine their statuses!
In contrast, this was an area for Xue yING where he could gather insights! That’s because he had too few experiences of watching battle using other laws and profound mysteries! He would not be able to understand and comprehend if it were a battle between Primal Chaos giants, On the contrary, this ranking battle was the most appropriate for him.
…
Years flew by.
The 700 over disciples had challenged one after another. The battles between them were either so close that they determined life and death, or resulted in one side admitting defeat. If a victor could not be determined in the battle, the ‘Hidden World Field treasure spirit’ would naturally intervene and judge who the victor was! For instance, if one side had great escaping capabilities and kept escaping whereas the other kept pursuing after him, then the treasure spirit would determine the party escaping as the loser!
If one had great survival capabilities and was completely on the disadvantaged side, depending on his survival capabilities to hold on further without ways of retaliating, he would eventually be judged as the loser too.
The battles were very intense.
Despite that, Xue Ying did not challenge others; He was focusing earnestly as he observed the battles. There were other disciples who took the initiative to challenge him, with Xue Ying winning all of them. Thus, his power was recognized publicly too.
“This ranking battle has persisted for eight years already. Mn, it’s time to challenge the others.” Xue Ying stood up, “I have three chances of being defeated. I should treasure this opportunity.”
Ranking battle.
Xue Ying had temporarily achieved his first goal of getting into the top ten so as to obtain the treasures.! Being currently ranked at seventh, it was a relatively safe position since he would only move back by a single position if he was to suffer a defeat.
Secondly, it was for the sake of gaining experiences so that he could grow!
In order to help his wife Jing Qiu and Yu’er, he had to grow and become stronger! The stronger he was, the better it would be since it would be easier to obtain some precious materials that could aid in cultivation.
Watching the countless battles was really helpful for him!
The effects were even better in actual combat!
“Sou.”
Xue Ying suddenly flew out.
“It’s Dong Bo Xue Ying.”
“He is out again.”
The attention of all disciples was jolted, as battles between golden-robed disciples had a great attraction to them.
“Junior Disciple Brother Flood Dragon, please.” Xue Ying held onto the spear, looking at the distant golden-robed disciple. He was none other than the current ranked eighth golden-robed disciple.
“Challenging me?” Junior Disciple Brother Flood Dragon was an expert with a scale on the crown of his head. Originally a mutated beast, he had managed turned into a human. Nonetheless, he always felt that the head of his actual body was the most beautiful part. This result in him keeping the scaled head of his. A rich voice rang out from him, “Hahaha, Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying, you are ranked seventh, yet you are challenging me, the eighth-ranked. If you were to win, you would still be ranked seventh. But if you were defeated, you would drop to the eighth-ranked. This battle has no benefits for you unless you want to make it a wager? I will not gamble with you!”
“It’s not a wager battle. It’s just that Junior Disciple Brother Flood Dragon has cultivated the 13 Apocalyptic Swords as well. This made my hands feel itchy.” Xue Ying mentioned.
“Alright. I’ll joyfully accept it then.” Junior Disciple Brother Flood Dragon guffawed.
He loved such battles the most.
If he lost, it would not affect his ranking. This battle with Xue Ying was purely for the sake of competing on their usage of the 13 Apocalyptic Swords.
“Sou.”
Flood Dragon immediately arced through the sky, the saber in his hand traveling in a strange crescent arc. The crescent arc presented a violet color, and it was misty and beautiful. At the same time, it brought with it a horrifying cruelty.
He and Xue Ying were the same. Even though they both cultivated the “13 Apocalyptic Swords”, they both fused them into their own respective techniques. Ultimately, learning absolute arts was about the utilization of the ‘Dao of Slaughter’ contained within them.
“Hong hong hong~”
The surrounding void vibrated and exploded time after time.
Xue Ying competed with Flood Dragon again and again. Excitement filled the two as they continued to exchange moves. Flood Dragon had even transformed back to his original body, while Xue Ying also unleashed the strength of the Voidwalker body. In the end, Flood Dragon ended up being injured. Despite that, he shouted out delightedly, “Hahaha, I don’t want to fight anymore. I admit defeat!”
Xue Ying then turned to the sixth-ranked golden-robed disciple: “Senior Disciple Sister Qian Que, please!”
“He is continuing on?”
The many spectating disciples were shocked.
Senior Disciple Sister Qian Que wore a gorgeous and radiant yellow robe, with her golden hair reaching her shoulders. At this moment, her eyes were looked at Xue Ying in the distance. Despite, her cold expression, a guqin appeared in her hands.
…
Relying on the Slaughter Domain to reduce the domain suppression of the other party before relying on the Dao of Mirage to increase his survival capabilities, Xue Ying managed to inch a victory over sixth-ranked Senior Disciple Sister Qian Que.
…
He then proceeded to challenge the fifth-ranked golden-robed disciple! Using both Slaughter Domain and his incarnation technique, he frantically attacked and barely won the battle.
…
He issued yet another challenge to the fourth-ranked disciple.
“Senior Disciple Brother Zhe Que Yong, please.” Xue Ying announced. His voice reverberated across the entire Hidden World Field.
At this moment, all other battles in the Hidden World Field had temporarily come to a halt, as all of the True God disciples were staring at Xue Ying. Even the Outer Hall Elders, Inner Hall Elders, Hall Masters and both ‘Forefather Tian Yu’ and ‘Swordmaster’ were no longer chatting idly. They were instead watching the battle with great interest. That was because Xue Ying actually challenged the golden-robed disciples in succession!
“He actually challenged the fourth-ranked Senior Disciple Brother Zhe Que Yong.”
“Senior Disciple Brother Zhe Que Yong is extraordinary. It isn’t easy to defeat him.”
Even though the gap between golden-robed disciples was small, one who was ranked fourth compared to those ranked eighth and ninth had a clearer and more distinct superiority.
“Hong~”
The battle proceeded.
Zhe Que Yong turned back into his original appearance. He was a rarely seen void creature that appeared to be a chrysalis lifeform, with a head that was much smaller than its body. Despite that, he possessed countless densely pack claws… Flying at a high speed, he chased after Xue Ying! Even though there was the ‘Slaughter Domain’ restricting and entangling the other party, the many claws on the surface of Zhe Que Yong’s body tore apart the Slaughter Domain as he flew about, resulting in not much of a drop in his speed.
All of a sudden, he lowered his head and knocked towards an empty space! A spearhead also appeared from the empty space and clashed against his head.
“Hong~”
This clash contained the profound mystery from the cosmos ranked absolute art “World Guard”.
“Pu.” Xue Ying appeared from nothingness, before spurting out a mouthful of blood.
“Senior Disciple Brother Zhe Que Yong is really formidable. Receive this spear of mine.” Xue Ying felt that he battled enough. He had already felt the power from the innate talent of this rarely seen void creature lifeform accompanied with the cosmos ranked absolute art. The spear in Xue Ying’s hand moved.
The spear rotated and rolled outwards, revolving just like an eternal maelstrom with no end. Swirling the ripples formed by the Slaughter Domain, all of the Slaughter Domain ripples were being absorbed by this spear body. At this moment, terrifying power proceeded to accumulate in the spear and to coil around this spear.
Xue Ying felt the spear in his hand getting heavier and heavier, while its power growing increasingly terrifying.
When he first entered closed-door cultivation in the ‘Palace Hall of Time’, he had already succeeded in fusing the Apocalyptic First Sword with the Dao of Ripple! However, in the years after that, as he comprehended the Apocalyptic Second Sword, as his realms improved. This allowed him to perfect the fusion between the Dao of Ripple with the Apocalyptic First Sword. Despite that, Xue Ying felt that it was not perfect enough!
After all, the gap between his attainments in the Dao of Ripple was too big from that of the Apocalyptic First Sword. This resulted in him only being able to perfect it step by step.
“Mn?”
The eyes of Forefather Tian Yu, Swordmaster and the group of Hall Master who was watching from above lit up. They were carefully watching the spear which Xue Ying was displaying at the current moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 810 - Old Devil Needle
chapters.content:
Chapter 810: Old Devil Needle
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Apocalyptic First Sword was not flashy, appearing just like a very simple move.
However, the Apocalyptic First Sword fused together with the Dao of Ripple produced an extremely huge disturbance. The entire Slaughter Domain had formed a huge maelstrom, with a spear present right at its eye! Xue Ying had superiority in his speed and as he pierced directly towards Senior Disciple Brother Zhe Qu Yong. Even though this enormous incoming threat loom upon Zhe Qu Yong , he was still confident of himself and continued onward with his head lowered. This clash felt like a meteorite smashing down.
“Hong~”
The spearhead rotated, causing a depression to appear on the head of Zhe Qu Yong. However, due to the protection of the golden robe on his body, the spearhead could not pierce through. Nevertheless, the terrifying power was continuously permeating through it, causing his head to directly cave in and very soon, his neck was directly destroyed.
However, with a twist, his enormous body retreated rapidly, before yet another head grew out. Shock filled the small eyes of his as he stared at Xue Ying. Giving a slight nod, he said: “I admit defeat, and I wholeheartedly accept losing to this spear technique of yours!” Even though the life force on his body was extremely strong, he would most likely die after eight to ten moves.
…
The spectators were all shocked.
“He won?”
“The Apocalyptic First Sword is unexpectedly not the strongest killing move of Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying? He actually has a stronger spear technique?”
“That’s the 4th rank.”
It was an uproar. After all, the strength of Senior Disciple Brother Zhe Qu Yong was publicly recognized. Nonetheless, he was defeated, with this victory being sufficient for other True God disciples to start admiring Xue Ying. Even the eyes of the Outer Hall Elders were bright as they looked at Xue Ying with delight.
But Forefather Tian Yu, Swordmaster, the Hall Masters and some of the Inner Hall Elders, Outer Hall Elders and disciples who had done some research into the “13 Apocalyptic Swords” realized that the stronger spear technique which Xue Ying displayed had used the ‘Apocalyptic First Sword’ as base before fusing in other laws and profound mysteries!
Only who had reached sufficient profoundness in the realm or to have sufficient research into the 13 Apocalyptic Swords would be able to determine this point.
As for Hall Masters and those with higher realm, they were able to see even more!
“He is actually able to tweak the Apocalyptic First Sword? Fusing the Dao of Ripple with the Apocalyptic First Sword?” There were Hall Masters who felt astonished by the side.
“The Apocalyptic First Sword is extremely perfect. It is pretty incredible if the True God Ruler disciples are able to learn it. However, it is nigh impossible for them to tweak it! But this Dong Bo Xue Ying is able to alter the Apocalyptic First Sword, fusing in the Dao of Ripple. This, this is too amazing.”
“He has indeed altered the Apocalyptic First Sword!”
These Hall Masters had extremely astute visions.
They were able to determine that the spear technique displayed by Xue Ying after that was not just the Apocalyptic First Sword, but one that was fused with other Daos. Instead, he even had made some minute tweaks to the Apocalyptic First Sword, making the fusion with the Dao of Ripple even more perfect!
If it was merely supplementing the technique, it would not be enough to startle these Hall Masters despite how formidable one would need to do so.
Instead, he was actually able to tweak it… this was indicative that Xue Ying had reached the stage where he could determine the usage of how Forefather Tian Yu had in mind when he first created the ‘Apocalyptic First Sword’! Furthermore, he even dared to tweak it and even improve its power!
“To dare attempt to tweak the Apocalyptic First Sword and even managing to succeed.” Seated at the highest area, the white-haired male ‘Swordmaster’ said, “He is still so young. It seems that he has hopes of cultivating the ‘Apocalyptic Second Sword’ while still in the Ruler realm.”
In the entire history of Great Void Heaven Temple, there was only one person who cultivated the Apocalyptic Second Sword as a Ruler! One could see how difficult it was.
Forefather Tian Yu looked beneath. He chuckled heartily as he replied: “Haha, he is indeed the person who came from the same cosmos as you and Ancestor Devil. Very amazing indeed! Within this batch of True God disciples, only Dong Bo Xue Ying and the first-ranked Rain Sword Guest have the capability of tweaking a cosmos ranked absolute art. However, Rain Sword Guest has cultivated for a much longer period, though his comprehension capabilities are much worse than Dong Bo Xue Ying’s.”
“Mn, comparing potential, huh. Dong Bo Xue Ying is absolutely the first in this batch of True God disciples.” The Swordmaster replied in agreement.
Potential.
It depended on combat power, the age, and experiences of the user.
Xue Ying had reached such a deep attainment in the laws and profound mysteries that it was comparable to the first-ranked ‘Rain Sword Guest’! Furthermore, he cultivated for a much shorter period, cultivating in the Starting Cosmos for the majority of his life before arriving in the sacred world not too long ago.
******
Only the strongest ten existences in the Great Void Heaven Temple were able to determine that Xue Ying had tweaked the Apocalyptic First Sword.
Those disciples and elders who had cultivated the “13 Apocalyptic Swords” before could only see that this move used the Apocalyptic First Sword as the base. As for the subtle tweaks?
This judgment skills had too great of a requirement on one’s realm!
“Hmph.”
As the nine Hall Masters, Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster were discussing above, the expression of praise on their faces, made one of the golden-robed disciples unhappy.
“Isn’t it just defeating that fool Zhe Qu Yong? Yet, why are the Hall Masters so approving of it?” The second-ranked green-browed thin male, ‘Old Devil Needle’ turned to Xue Ying coldly with his eyes, “I’ll just trample him beneath my feet! Let’s see if the Hall Masters still praise him or not!” He did not cultivate the 13 Apocalyptic Swords, thus he could not see how profound that spear technique Xue Ying had displayed, even less about why the Hall Masters were praising Xue Ying! That was precisely due to the latter having tweaked a cosmos ranked absolute art!
Old Devil Needle.
He was originally called ‘Forefather Needle’, yet he was forced to change his name. Clearly, the deranged temperament of his was clearly stuck deep in his bones.
Fortunately, the Great Void Heaven Temple was willing to receive all kinds of people. As long as the disciples did not disobey the rules of the Heaven Temple, they would accept even these slightly wicked cultivators.
“Sou.” Old Devil Needle directly flew out.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, you are truly insolent to challenge all the golden-robed disciples one after another. I’ll let you know how far off that your little combat power is!” Old Devil Needle flew out in mid-air, directly announcing out, causing his voice to reverberate in the surroundings.
Floating midair, the golden-robed disciple Xue Ying looked towards Old Devil Needle with slight astonishment.
Insolent?
He was challenging the golden-robed disciples. Even though he won, he did not lose his composure. Furthermore, his challenge to others was compliant to the rules of the ranking battle. So, how was he being insolent?
This was ultimately the first time Xue Ying visited the Great Void Heaven Temple. Even though he had obtained a large amount of information-knowing about the combat power of Old Devil Needle-he did not understand the temper of ‘Old Devil Needle’.
“Senior Disciple Brother Old Devil Needle wants to challenge me to a battle? I am more than happy to do so.” Xue Ying chuckled, “Please.”
“Then I’ll take this chance to teach you properly.” Old Devil Needle remained as arrogant as ever. Despite that, being ranked second just after Rain Sword Guest, he possessed the qualifications to do so. Compared to other golden-robed disciples, there was a very huge disparity between their power! Rain Sword Guest was able to stand out as he had created his killing move after altering a cosmos ranked absolute art.
As for Old Devil Needle, he had cultivated an extremely ancient and terrifying ancient cultivation technique!
“Go.”
Old Devil Needle immediately took action, with the black lone horn on his forehead abruptly lighting up.
“Hong hong hong!”
More than a hundred black streams of light suddenly appeared in the world, before proceeding to charge right towards Xue Ying. These black streams of light moved a such a speed that was the fastest Xue Ying had ever experienced amongst the True God Rulers. Seemingly in an instant, all of them had arrived before him.
Xue Ying originally wanted to hide into his Mirage World, while displaying his spear techniques and also the Slaughter Domain!
Nonetheless, those black stream lights were too fast. More than a hundred black stream lights had traveled right into the Mirage World seemingly in the blink of an eye. Their power had merely been slightly affected, dropping to 80-90% of their original force.
“Dang dang dang.” Xue Ying did not have sufficient time to parry against those attacks with his spear technique, as those stream of lights were all exquisite and very fast. At this very moment, they starting bombarding his body.
Nonetheless, the golden robe remained as firm as ever.
Being a Voidwalker, Xue Ying’s body turned illusory as he tried his best to divert the incoming impact into the void. What’s left of the force that had impacted against his Void God level body wasn’t able to threaten him at all.
” Indeed, the apex of the strongest ancient cultivation techniques are formidable.” Xue Ying sighed.
The ancient cultivation had all sorts of specialties. Some were very powerful and defiant. Old Devil Needle did not really utilize any formidable techniques. He was purely relying on his talent on the ancient cultivation before being able to attack Xue Ying’s body!
“Junior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying, with this bit of combat power, I suggest that you continue training on.” Old Devil Needle sneered. His eyes which were glowing in green turned towards the distant void. He was able to sense Xue Ying who was currently hiding in the Mirage World.

chapters.title: Chapter 811 - Ancient Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 811: Ancient Cultivation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
All of a sudden, the expression of Old Devil Needle changed: “Mn? I did not injure him? Not even a single injury?”
He did not have the time to display a stronger technique before Xue Ying’s strikes had arrived. Three black-robed Xue Ying appeared around Old Devil Needle, each one holding onto a spear as they used their strongest killing move. Every spear formed a horrifying ripple maelstrom, turning into three great maelstroms filled with Slaughter Domain.
The three spears struck down at the same time.
Old Devil Needle’s expression changed, before savagely roaring out: “Scram!”
That black lone horn on his forehead flew out, bringing a powerful might that swept across the surrounding while forming many circular ripples. It actually swept across the spears which the three great incarnations had! Because the attacks sent by Xue Ying’s incarnations were too fast, Old Devil Needle had completely erupted with his strongest move. He used his true life core-the lone horn-to display the cosmos ranked absolute art, “Waning Moon Sword Scripture”. One could only hear the consecutive booms before the three great incarnations were forced back.
Even though the body of the incarnations was weaker, their spear techniques were amazing. They had unleashed the killing move that was formed by tweaking the Apocalyptic First Sword and fusing it with the Dao of Ripple. Only the current first-ranked ‘Rain Sword Guest’ could compare with Xue Ying in this aspect. Even though the incarnations were weaker, each incarnation had a strength that could rank in the top 20. Therefore, three incarnations working together had brought a huge pressure on Old Devil Needle.
“Hong~” The true body of Xue Ying in the distant erupted with force. Not caring about the incoming black streams of light that bombarded his body since they could not injure him at all, Xue Ying went charging towards Old Devil Needle.
“The bodily defense of this brat is extremely formidable. His spear technique is also amazing.” The pupils of Old Devil Needle dilated, as never did he expect for the incarnations to be able threaten him.
“Die for me!” Old Devil Needle turned crazy.
The more than a 100 black streams of light were rapidly collected back. Furthermore, every single stream of light was imbued with thunder and lightning. With their power greatly boosted, the streams bombarded the three incarnations of Xue Ying. These black streams of light had targeted Xue Ying’s true body earlier. However, the streams were now utilizing another Primal Chaos ranked absolute art. Even though it could not threaten the true body of Xue Ying, it was very effective against his incarnations.
This was already the full force of Old Devil Needle. He could no longer let the black stream lights unleash the cosmos ranked absolute art.
Using cosmos ranked absolute art on more than 100 streams of light?
That would be too great a burden on his soul!
Why did Xue Ying only form three incarnations? That was due to his soul only being able to temporarily allow three incarnations to be at their strongest state.
“Not good. They have become faster.” The three incarnations were shocked. Even though their spear techniques were amazing, the now much faster black light streams had penetrated through their bodies, directly extinguishing the three incarnations.
‘Hmph, incarnations? Leaving behind 50 needles will suffice to protect myself.’ Old Devil Needle thought.
50 black light streams revolved around his body.
The other 50 black light streams and the ‘black lone horn’ were currently striking out at Xue Ying’s true body. Xue Ying’s true body was incomparably valiant as he forced his way over. Erupting with his entire strength, the spear in Xue Ying’s hand started to display the ninth volume of Wind Ripple Path. For a moment, an enormous ripple maelstrom formed once again in his surroundings, clashing against those streams of light.
“Hong hong hong~”
Xue Ying could personally feel the power of that black lone horn. The black lone horn displayed the absolute art created by Swordmaster, “Waning Moon Sword Scripture”causing it be fast and unpredictable. Fortunately, there was only one horn, allowing for Xue Ying to barely defend himself with his spear technique. Nonetheless, the fierce strength of its blows forced him to retreat time after time. At the same time, the other black light streams were also hitting his body.
“Die, die for me.” Old Devil Needle was truly mad.
…
Old Devil Needle’s attack was filled with violence. The attacks which covered everywhere forced Xue Ying’s true body to be unable to proceed further-he was completely surrounded! Even though Xue Ying had tried forming incarnations to deal with Old Devil Needle, the 50 black light streams were too fast. They did not care about the spear techniques utilized by the incarnations, only caring about attacking at the same time. Their might was easily able to extinguish the newly formed incarnations of Xue Ying.
“The strength of Old Devil Needle is clearly stronger than the other golden-robed disciples. He has a clear superiority.” Xue Ying understood this battle was one he could not win, “I can’t destroy his encircling attacks. His true life core lone horn is also extremely powerful. By using the “Waning Moon Sword Scripture”, he can completely suppress me.”
His spear technique was much more profound than the other party’s “Waning Moon Sword Scripture”.
He was also at the 20th level realm of Voidwalker. However, he was still being suppressed!
Why?
That’s because the core of Old Devil Needle’s ancient cultivation, the ‘lone horn’, was too strong! This was the terrifying point of ancient cultivation! Even though the majority of the ancient cultivators had hopes of gaining some weird power, their average strength was more balanced. However, across the many ancient cultivators… there would be several extremely frightening existences emerging from them that were more heaven-shattering than all other cultivation systems!
Thus, the Ancient Sacred World’s ‘Sacred Master’ was the so-called strongest amongst all final realm existences! He was publicly recognized as the strongest! If one said that the ‘Ancestor Mother’ had many enemies, then almost all final realm existences had enmity with that Sacred Master. Despite that, he had managed to continue occupying the Ancient Sacred World.
“”Waning Moon Sword Scripture”. This cosmos ranked absolute art created by Swordmaster is indeed formidable.” Xue Ying was enjoying the battle while gaining experience at the same time.
Time elapsed by.
Old Devil Needle was frantically attacking and completely suppressing Xue Ying. On the other hand, Xue Ying was just treating this battle as a form of experience.
“Hong~”
An unseen energy descended, forcing the originally fast-flying lone horn and the many black light streams to come to a halt. Those black light streams were actually formed from many huge needles! Every needle contained some weird black patterns on it. These needles were not refined weapons, and were instead, the true life auxiliary weapons of Old Devil Needle’s ancient cultivation.
After all, being an ancient cultivator, his true life core was very important, so he would rarely use it for battle.
The battle was forced to stop.
Old Devil Needle looked at Xue Ying with his glowing green eyes with derangement still present in them. As for Xue Ying, he had proceeded to keep his spear.
“Old Devil Needle, victory.” The voice of the Hidden World Field treasure spirit rang out.
“Admirable.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“Brat, go and cultivate more! It’s best for you to not be too arrogant with the little power you possess.” Old Devil Needle sneered.
Xue Ying was slightly startled before subsequently turning speechless.
It was just a spar!
Why the need to pour cold water over him?
True God disciples were considered to still very tender amongst the many experts in the five sacred worlds and primal chaos void. Sparring and fighting with other disciple brothers under the same sect was all good, yet why was there a need to act so aggressive and offend others? Furthermore, if they were to truly compare their realm, Old Devil Needle’s realm should most likely be ranked beyond the tenth position. It was only due to the heaven-shattering ancient cultivation techniques he had that gave him the prowess to be ranked second.
…
The Inner Hall Elders high above and the Hall Masters were able to see that Xue Ying’s realm was higher than Old Devil Needle. It was likely that Xue Ying could even compare with Rain Sword Guest! It’s only due to the ancient cultivation technique being too formidable that Xue Ying wasn’t able to win.
“What a truly stupid fool.” Ancestor Devil looked below sneering, “The ancient cultivation techniques can only be used to bully those on the same level. Dong Bo Xue Ying’s potential is so much higher than his. Very soon, there will be a gap in their combat power, and the laws and profound mysteries system will only get stronger the further one goes. With this little ancient cultivation talent of his, he can only act that unbridled towards those the little brats.”
Ancestor Devil was very clear about this. The distant ‘Ancient Sacred World’ was the place where true ancient cultivators gathered. Under His Majesty ‘Sacred Master’, there were so many more ancient cultivators with greater talents than Old Devil Needle. However, many experts of the ancient cultivation were not willing to depend on Sacred Master because they had to pay too much a price, with them rather dying than to fork out the price.
…
After Xue Ying had suffered his loss, he remained smiling as he turned towards the third-ranked golden-robed fatty and spoke out: “Senior Disciple Brother Xue Chen, please.”
“Haha, I have guessed that Junior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying will be challenging me next, only for that fool of a needle to snatch my turn away.” replied the golden-robed fatty as he flew out.
“Xue Chen!.” Old Devil Needle instantly turned angry.
“Don’t care about him. There’s also no need for you to be too polite to him.”
The golden-robed fatty looked at Xue Ying with a chuckle, “He is a madman. The more polite you are to him, the more unbridled he becomes.”
Xue Ying laughed, “That sounds logical!”
Old Devil Needle instantly became more deranged. Nonetheless, there was nothing he could do. One had to challenge others in the Hidden World Field, and even if he took the initiative in doing so, ‘Xue Chen’ would merely say that he ‘admitted defeat’. And in ordinary circumstances, the disciples in Great Void Heaven Temple were forbidden from killing each other.
Thus, even if he was being scolded, Old Devil Needle had no ways of dealing with it!
“Hmph hmph…”
“Haha.”
Several disciples also chortled at that.
Old Devil Needle swept his gaze across. Those who dared to sneer at him were not afraid of Old Devil Needle at all! The majority of the disciples were still more reserved as the road of cultivation was still way too long, while the potential of Old Devil Needle was relatively high. It was for the best to not offend him due to the possibility of him becoming someone in the higher places! Naturally, those like ‘Xue Chen’ and Xue Ying did not place Old Devil Needle in their eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 812 - End of Battle, Reporting Upwards
chapters.content:
Chapter 812: End of Battle, Reporting Upwards
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying proceeded to challenge the third-ranked Xue Chen. After fighting for a very long time, he had finally secured his victory! Xue Ying was fighting primarily for the sake of getting experience and improve himself. That was why he only utilized his full strength at the end of his challenges. Xue Chen was also extremely carefree about this, as Xue Ying had reached an extremely profound stage with his spear techniques, something that was very helpful for him to cross hands with
After defeating Xue Chen, Xue Ying was promoted to the 3rd rank.
He proceeded on to challenge the first-ranked ‘Rain Sword Guest’.
Rain Sword Guest had similarly altered the cosmos ranked absolute art and created a sword technique that suited him. His sword technique was meant towards group battles, where countless rain droplets were sprayed around, with terrifying power present within every single water droplet. Therefore, he was just like Old Devil Needle who specialized in targeting groups. However, he excelled even more so in this aspect than the latter! This resulted in Xue Ying being completely suppressed.
The sequence of this battle was same as the one with Old Devil Needle, with Xue Ying being suppressed. However, by relying on his Dao of Mirage, the ‘void-ification’ of Voidwalker and his formidable body, he was able to hold his ground against Rain Sword Guest.
Eventually, the treasure spirit judged Xue Ying to have lost!
…
“It has ended.” Forefather Tian Yu sat at the highest location looking downwards. The ranking battle lasted for a total of 12 years before it finally coming to an end. Currently, the ‘Punishment Hall Hall Master’, Ancestor Devil was personally giving out the treasures to some of the golden-robed disciples.
And the golden-robed disciples who dropped out of the top ten ranks had to give back their ‘golden robes’ and the ‘golden disciple command talisman’, before being given ‘violet robes’ and the ‘violet-robed disciple command talismans’ in return.
“Forefather, there aren’t many Inner Hall Elders that have come to watch this ranking battle.” The white-haired male ‘Swordmaster’, said, “Why is that so? Has the situation of our current territory turned for the worse, so they can’t leave? Do you need me to send my incarnation over?”
“Relax.”
Forefather Tian Yu chuckled, “Our lineage specializes in the laws and profound mysteries, and our incarnations are powerful enough, so everything is under control. Just focus on cultivating. The stronger you are, the greater the help you will provide to our Great Void Heaven Temple.”
Swordmaster nodded.
Although their Great Void Heaven Temple was one of the peak powers, they similarly had they own troubles.
“I hope that there will be some who grow up from these bunch of fellows.” Forefather Tian Yu looked beneath, “As long as there are a few more Primal Chaos realm, our Great Void Heaven Temple will have an easier time. With more Primal Chaos realm experts, there might even be someone that is able to reach the final step, That way, the foundation of our Great Void Heaven Temple will be more stable.”
The two proceeded casually chat on.
Only after the items were issued and with the Punishment Hall Hall Master Ancestor Devil announcing the official end of the True God disciple ranking battle did Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster leave.
At that moment…
The Hall Masters started to leave, with the Inner Hall Elders and the Outer Hall Elders following suit.
They came to watch the ranking battle primarily due to it being a gathering that happened only once every billion years for the entire Great Void Heaven Temple. What’s more, it was also an opportunity for the experts to meet each other. Truthfully speaking, they did not care much about those True God level battles. At the very most, they would be able to see which brat participating in this ranking battle possessed great potential.
******
“I’ve gotten it.” Xue Ying felt his mood being uplifted. Of the things that he had obtained as a golden-robed disciple from Ancestor Devil, he had too obtained the most important ‘Supplementary Spiritual Fruit’. Other than that, there were also some of the other slightly less valuable materials which aided cultivation, though they could still be considered precious to him.
“Hmph, Dong Bo Xue Ying, look at how excited you are. You are only ranked third now. If you’ve become the 1st or 2nd rank, won’t you be so emotional to the point of shouting out loud?” Old Devil Needle sneered as he flew by the side.
“Fool Needle, Dong Bo had only lost to you only due the rules of the Hidden World Field. If you were to truly fight with him outside of there, you wouldn’t be able to even injure him. So why the need to gloat about it?” The plump Xue Chen sneered back. He was the one who targeted against Old Devil Needle the most.
Hearing Xue Chen’s reply, Old Devil Needle stared right back at the former as his eyes flashed with a murderous glint.
“What’s the matter, are you thinking of taking action against me? Come come come, do it! It seems that you want to have a taste of Ancestor Devil’s ‘Smelting Devil Prison’.” said Xue Chen in delight. With his strength, Old Devil Needle could not kill him within a short period, much less when he had his protection talismans and other items. At the instant Old Devil Needle made his move, he would have disobeyed the rules of the Heaven Temple, landing him into hot soup.
“Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo, do want to come over to my cavern-dwelling and have a drink? The other junior disciple brothers and sisters will also be coming over.” Xue Chen passionately invited.
“Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo, come along with us.” Zhe Qu Yong, Disciple Sister Qian Que, Flood Dragon, and others sent out their invitations.
This group of disciples ranked at the peak of True Gods had an extremely good relationship with one another.
“Alright.” Xue Ying nodded too.
…
The group of disciples proceeded to drink and chat along. Among them, the weakest was already ranked in the top 30. From this, one could see that the cultivators still attached great importance to combat power.
As everyone chatted along, they had even touched on some secrets.
These were secrets which Xue Ying had never heard before from his teacher ‘Gu Qi’. Primarily, Gu Qi was a final realm existence and his status was too high, resulting in the intelligence he provided being of more importance. On the contrary, those small and minute secrets were more trivial. Nonetheless, they were still important to Xue Ying at his current level.
After the gathering ended, Xue Ying had become much closer other disciples of their sect.
Xue Ying proceeded to head straight to the Palace Hall of Time, immediately selecting the hundred-times time-accelerated environment as he restarted his cultivation
“Hu hu hu~”
This time, Xue Ying arrived on a planet filled with countless howling gales. The wind appeared like a knife as they blew along, though with his realm of cultivation, there was no need for Xue Ying to pay any heed to them.
There was just him on this planet.
He was not in a rush to break through to the Void God realm. Instead, he was currently cultivating and comprehending the Apocalyptic Second Sword!
Due to him having seen too many battles during the past 12 years of the True God disciple battle, and even personally fighting for more than a dozen matches, it had allowed him to gain new inspirations towards the laws and profound mysteries. This resulted in him having a much deeper comprehension of the ‘Apocalyptic Second Sword’. He felt that he should not be too far away from learning the ‘Apocalyptic Second Sword’. Since that’s the case, there was no need for him to rush and breakthrough.
It was possible for Rulers to learn the Apocalyptic Second Sword, and was also form of tempering for him.
A treasured sword had to be tempered to become sharper.
Jade had to be polished to become a treasure.
Even cultivators with great talent had to undergo many setbacks in order to increase their comprehension become higher. The level of comprehension Xue Ying possessed when he was in his youth was naturally different to when he comprehended the grade one True Meaning ‘True Meaning of World’. It was even less similar to the current Xue Ying who was about to become a Void God.
