Yet. this was still not enough! The stronger the better! If he became stronger, it would be easier for him to get his hands on precious materials that would aid in his, Jing Qiu’s and Yu’er’s cultivation.
His teacher Voidwalker Gu Qi had previously offered his help to his good friend, a stage four World Deity. Yet, Gu Qi had failed in the end! Naturally, one reason was that Gu Qi was heavily injured and was fleeing for his life, resulting in him not bringing along any suitable materials that were apt for a ‘stage four World Deity’ to use. Secondly, the materials which aided cultivation were ultimately still external materials, as one had to still depend on oneself when transcending.
Due to the failure his teacher Gu Qi, this brought about greater pressure on Xue Ying.
“At least, I’ve gotten the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit.” Xue Ying calmed himself down as he started his cultivation.
…
Time passed.
He had cultivated on the planet for 190 million years, whereas just 1.9 million years had passed outside.
At the floating island located in the center, there was a continuous chain of structures. They were all made from elegant wood or stone. The sculptures were crafted with conscientiousness, appearing magnificent and brimming with aesthetic appeal.There were even many flowers around the place.
Located in one of the pavilions, a hunchbacked Forefather Tian Yu and white-haired Swordmaster were both seated cross-legged face to face with each other. Present before them was a table with wine on it. There were also joss sticks burning beside them, their fragrance suffusing the entire place.
The two seemed very calm.
In reality, their incarnations had descended and entered the primal chaos void and were currently exchanging moves with one another. Being final realm existences of the laws and profound mystery system, it was difficult for them to find opponents whom they could spar against. There, the two were the most appropriate partners each other.
“Palace Master.”
Suddenly, a voice sounded by the ears of Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster. The two of them were both Palace Masters.
“Golden-robed disciple Dong Bo Xue Ying has comprehended the Apocalyptic Second Sword as a Ruler.” The voice of the treasure spirit for the Palace of Time rang out in their ears.

chapters.title: Chapter 813 - Void God
chapters.content:
Chapter 813: Void God
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Both Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster were immediately startled. Looking at each other. They could see the sliver of happiness present in each other’s eyes. They were extremely clear what it meant for a ‘Ruler to comprehend the Apocalyptic Second Sword’! This meant that there was a possible future Primal Chaos realm existence!
The Rulers were ultimately very weak in their understanding of the laws and profound mysteries. For a cultivator to comprehend the Apocalyptic Second Sword while having such a weak foundation in the laws and profound mysteries required an extremely frightening ‘comprehension ability’!
The previous one who did this had become the current Great Void Heaven Temple, ‘Myriad Elephant Palace Hall’ Hall Master. The Myriad Elephant Palace Hall Hall Master kept an extremely low profile, and only focused on cultivation. However, could very well be ranked in the top three amongst all the Hall Masters of Great Void Heaven Temple, even being on a level as compared to Ancestor Devil.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying is very young.” Forefather Tian Yu was beaming from ear to ear, “For him to already have such a comprehension ability, haha, it’s truly, truly rare.”
Of the many, many generations of True God disciples, those who became golden-robed disciples were all outstanding cultivators; becoming Void Gods wasn’t a hard matter for them. Of this generation of True God disciples, most could not enter the eyes of Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster! However, it was truly too rare for a True God disciple like Xue Ying to comprehend the Apocalyptic Second Sword! He basically was an unpolished jade! As long as he was slightly polished, he would definitely be able to shine!
“He is even younger than Myriad Elephant Hall Master then.” Swordmaster said, “With such comprehension ability, it is very possible for him to reach the Primal Chaos realm.”
“Secretly protect and groom him.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “Also, give him more chances to temper himself.”
The moment he finished speaking, the sound of the Palace Hall of Time treasure spirit rang out once again, “Palace Master, the golden-robed disciple Dong Bo Xue Ying is currently breaking through to become a Void God. He is currently guiding the Primal Chaos Void Energy in and is breaking through via Voidwalker lineage. I can ascertain that he is a Voidwalker.”
“Voidwalker?” Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster looked towards each other with slight astonishment.
“This brat is actually also cultivated in the Voidwalker lineage?” Forefather Tian Yu exclaimed in shock, “Who is his teacher?”
The Voidwalker lineage belonged to a very unique cultivation system. Unlike the laws and profound mysteries, the bloodline cultivation, the Ancestor Mother Religion or the ancient cultivation, they were rarely seen. Across the five great sacred worlds and the primal chaos void, the number of Voidwalkers was so small it felt pitiful. It could not even compare to the number of final realm existences!
Nevertheless, there were two Cosmos Gods in the Voidwalker lineage, showing that it was relatively strong.
“No wonder I felt that his body was quite tyrannical during the True God disciple battle.” Swordmaster chuckled, “So it seems that he is a Voidwalker. However, he was quite careful too to not utilize the Termination Energy.”
“The inheritance of Voidwalker has harsh requirements. There are few of them, yet this brat is able to obtain a set of inheritance.” Forefather Tian Yu sighed.
As one deepens one’s cultivation in the Hidden Secret of the Voidwalker lineage, their evasive maneuverability and survival capabilities would become stronger. Their bodies would gradually become more perfect in their fusion with the void, allowing them to stealthily rely on the void to travel to where the enemy was before assassinating him. What’s more, they were also quick in escaping.
…
On the planet with gusting wind within the Palace Hall of Time, Xue Ying was seated cross-legged while he was in the midst of breaking through. Since he had comprehended the Apocalyptic Second Sword, he had decided to break through to the Void God realm! Having already comprehended the 21st level of Walker’s Hidden Secret, he was currently guiding the Primal Chaos Void energy into his body. His body was also undergoing a qualitative transformation using the Primal Chaos Void energy as its source.
“Hong hong hong~” Even though it was only a single level jump from the 20th level to the 21st level, this was a breakthrough from True God to the Void God realm. This would result in a qualitative transformation in life force, with his body also becoming extremely strong and powerful. Every single fiber of his muscles and bones were relying on the array diagram to absorb the Primal Chaos Void energy. Even the most minute particles in his body were also transforming towards the direction of becoming like the primal chaos void, while his body was now much more in unison to the primal chaos void than several void creatures.
The process of breaking through was extremely long.
A ‘Termination Energy’ that was filled with a stronger sharpness started to form in his body. As the Termination Energy proceeded to be concealed up, Xue Ying opened his eyes. He could feel himself being one with the void. He was the void and the void was he! His overall combat power had increased once again to a whole new level.
He was a member of the Great Void Heaven Temple, and he would eventually have to cultivate the Walker’s Hidden Secret; it was impossible for him to hide it forever! During the ‘True God disciple battle’ where countless people were spectating his battle, it was not appropriate for him to reveal his skills. However, only the treasure spirit would find out when he was in the Palace Hall of Time. When that happens, the treasure spirit would only report upwards …
Thus, those who were qualified to know could be counted with one’s fingers!
His teacher ‘Gu Qi’ mentioned before that he could ask Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster in the future if Xue Ying really wanted to find out who Gu Qi had become enemies with. Clearly, Gu Qi trusted Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster! Thus, Xue Ying felt that it wasn’t that much of a deal if his identity as a Voidwalker was revealed to the highest level in the Great Void Heaven Temple.
‘Teacher, who exactly did you offend in the past?’ Xue Ying murmured inwardly. After leaving his hometown cosmos and coming to the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, he finally understood what status his teacher Gu Qi had. He was one of the few final realm existences! Since he was heavily injured and almost lost his life, he had also made Xue Ying promise to never publicize that Xue Ying was the disciple of Gu Qi, else Xue Ying might just lose his life.
Clearly knowing that Xue Ying was a disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple yet his teacher still reminded him.
So who exactly was it that he offended?
“Little doll Dong Bo Xue Ying.” A joyous laughter sounded.
“Forefather.” Xue Ying could recognize that voice the moment he heard it. He respectfully replied.
“Who is your teacher of the Voidwalker lineage?” Forefather Tian Yu continued asking.
Gusting winds continued to howl around his surroundings.
Xue Ying could not see Forefather Tian Yu, but he still respectfully answered, “Gu Qi.”
“It’s him? Oh, it’s actually him? Things are a little troublesome. You must remember that you should never tell others that you are the disciple of Gu Qi. Mn, how about this, I’ll send a transmission to the Void Primogenitor telling your matter to him. If anyone discovers your identity as a Voidwalker in the future, you should just say you are the disciple of the Void Primogenitor.” Forefather Tian Yu reminded, “Remember, never tell others that you are the disciple of Gu Qi.”
“Yes.” Xue Ying responded. He then could not help but ask, “Forefather, does my teacher have a great enemy?”
“Hehe… Gu Qi quite crazy, as he dares to do everything.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “Regardless of that, don’t publicize your relationship with him Otherwise, you can only stay in the Great Void Heaven Temple without exiting. The moment you leave, you will suffer from all sorts of assassinations.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying was inwardly shocked.
“Also, you should not flaunt your comprehension the Apocalyptic Second Sword as a Ruler and maintain a low profile. Both I and Swordmaster regard you highly.” Forefather Tian Yu reminded him.
“I understand.” Xue Ying acknowledged. There were no benefits in flaunting.
“Since you have become a Voidwalker, then hurry up and become an Inner Hall Elder.” Forefather Tian Yu added.
“Yes.”
…
Inner Hall Elder. That was an extremely high status in the Great Void Heaven Temple. Those with this status were famous across the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void.
It was due to them having the combat power that corresponds to their fame and reputation!
At the entrance of the ‘Palace Hall of Time’, time-space was distorted, before a figure warped and appeared out of it. He was none other than the white-robed Xue Ying.
He stood there, looking at the towering Star Pagoda in the distance.
The Star Pagoda was the only building that was as high as the Great Void Palace Hall and had extremely a unique importance in the Great Void Heaven Temple. However, he would have to become a Void God at least to enter it.
‘I’ve heard that the Star Pagoda was refined by Luo City Lord. There is one pagoda located in each of the six holy grounds.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘According to hearsay, the Star Pagoda is involved to a huge secret. I must get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda before I can know of it.’
There were rules in the Great Void Heaven Temple.
Void God ‘Origin Birth realm’ experts were required to get through the third level of Star Pagoda within 10 billion years before they could become Inner Hall Elders. And now, there was only a single Origin Birth realm Inner Hall Elder in the entire Great Void Heaven Temple, as such a requirement was too difficult to fulfill! The others were all Unity realm Inner Hall Elders.
Unity realm existences had to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda to become Inner Hall Elders!
“I’ll enter and have a look to see what great secret it is, such that even my teacher Gu Qi wasn’t able to tell me.” Xue Ying turned into a stream before flying towards the Star Pagoda.

chapters.title: Chapter 814 - Entering the Star Pagoda for the First Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 814: Entering the Star Pagoda for the First Time
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The towering Star Pagoda did not have any protectors guarding the place. It did not require any protectors too since any Void Gods in the Great Void Heaven Temple was qualified to enter.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying turned into a stream of light, flying into the entrance of the Star Pagoda.
“Look, isn’t that Dong Bo Xue Ying?”
“It is Senior Disciple Brother Dong Bo Xue Ying. He, he actually flew into the Star Pagoda?”
“He has actually entered the Star Pagoda!”
Several True God disciples who were flying within the Great Void Heaven Temple were startled when they saw Xue Ying flying into the Star Pagoda from the distant. Due to the suppression of the sacred world, they could not easily probe the aura of Xue Ying from such a distance. However, only those that have reached the Void God realm were able to enter the Star Pagoda. This could not be violated.
“He has already become a Void God?” Many True God disciples were somewhat speechless. He had only entered the Great Void Heaven Temple for not too long and had participated in the most recent True God disciple battle. However, he had proceeded to breakthrough into the Void God Realm? Nonetheless, there were many disciples who were celebrating, as they now have a greater chance of entering the top ten with a golden-robed disciple breaking through to the Void God realm.
It would be best if eight out of ten broke through! However, it was not that easy to break through in the ‘laws and profound mystery lineage’.
******
“Hong.”
Xue Ying entered the Star Pagoda. The pagoda door was always open, with the interior being dark and murky.
As he entered, Xue Ying could feel many layers of space around him. Only after flying for a moment was he finally able to see a vast desolate land.
“That is?” Xue Ying saw a relatively eye-catching mountain peak on this desolate land. The peak had been cut evenly, with three unfamiliar characters imprinted on it. Nonetheless, Xue Ying was able to experience the meaning imbued in the characters. It was precisely the ‘Star Pagoda’.
There was also a sculpture by the edge of the mountain. It was of a humanoid sculpture, appearing slightly thin, small, and with armor worn above chainmail. He was currently coldly looking at ‘Xue Ying’ who was outside.
“Hong~”
And at the moment the eyes of the sculpture crossed paths with Xue Ying’s, Xue Ying felt his heart suddenly starting to pound in terror. Although he had experienced the feeling of boundless suppression when he seen Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster, at the very least, Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster did not deliberately do. However, the feeling of suppression coming from them was due to the huge disparity between himself and them in terms of life force.
But at this moment!
Xue Ying was trembling, being unable to stop himself from doing so. That sculpture on the stone wall seemed alive, while the unseen aura emitted by it made Xue Ying see a startling scene-
This was a thin and small life form wearing a skin-tight armor. It had a bald head, and there was a large group of cultivators around it. There were auras of varying strength coming from the cultivators, with the weakest being from the Unity realm, while the strongest two were emitting the aura of Primal Chaos realm.
“Hou~” The mere 1.5m tall thin and small lifeform roared out savagely. All of a sudden, its body transformed into a clump of black light, shooting out in all directions, instantly engulfing everything.
All the cultivators including the two Primal Chaos realm giants were struck by the black light, which each of them shattering into pieces. Not only did they shatter apart, even their weapons and armors had also completely disintegrated away.
The boundless black light soon converged again.
They formed back into the thin and small lifeform. Coldly sweeping his gaze across the entire place, and there seem to be not a trace of emotions within his eyes.
Closely following that, this scene dissipated away!
‘This, this…’ Xue Ying looked at the thin and small lifeform sculpture by the side of the ‘Star Pagoda’ words on the mountain wall, ‘The previous battle scene showed countless cultivators being massacred. Even the two Primal Chaos realm giants were massacred. Their panic felt so real! It should not be fake.’
This Star Pagoda was refined by Luo City Lord. There was no reason for him to leave behind a fake scene.
“Seemingly all of the Primal Chaos existences across the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void have extremely huge fame and reputation. As long as I carefully collect the intelligence, I might be able to discover the identity of those two Primal Chaos giants.’ Xue Ying vaguely guessed. Although his teacher Gu Qi had given him the intelligence, they were news on the living Primal Chaos realm existences. The two who were massacred in this scene… Xue Ying did not have any intelligence whatsoever on them since they were already dead.
‘Who exactly is this thin and small lifeform? Could he be the huge secret which teacher Gu Qi mentioned before?’
‘However, I have to pass through the fifth level of Star Pagoda before I get to know it.’ Xue Ying understood that he was still too weak. His teacher Gu Qi might have informed of many things but had also concealed those that were too secretive. Clearly, he did not wish to disturb the heart realm of Xue Ying.
For instance, the ‘Sacred Master’ of the Ancient Sacred World had enmity with all other final realm existences! Or for instance, the most primitive Ancient Sacred World had been shattered once before, or the fact that there were final realm existences who died before…
All these secrets were not meant for those at Xue Ying’s level to know.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying continued proceeding forward, flying through the walls as he observed this piece of vast desolate land.
countless gray lights started to out from the ground of this vast desolate land. They condensed into a blurred figure, before finally turning distinct! This was a gray-armored warrior of about three meters tall. On unique twisted horn embedded on the shoulder pad of his armor. At this moment, this blue-skinned warrior had focused its eyes at Xue Ying.
“Kill him and you will be able to proceed to the second level.” The treasure spirit of the Star Pagoda sounded by the ears of Xue Ying.
“Is this a trial?”
Xue Ying carefully observed his opponent, and could not help but feel a chill down his heart.
This gray-armored warrior stood there coldly, emitting an aura which seemed inharmonious with the surrounding law of the world. Like Xue Ying and the others, or those from the Ancestor Mother Religion, Ancient Cultivation and Bloodline cultivation, all of these cultivations were all harmonious with the operating law of the world.
However, this gray-armored warrior in front of Xue Ying had an aura which caused the surrounding void to warp. That was due to disturbance formed in the law of the world.
“Mn, you are my opponent this time?” The gray-armored warrior looked at Xue Ying. With his innate talent, he could determine the aura of Xue Ying’s soul, “So weak. A trash who is worse than a denigrate!”
Xue Ying observed for a moment before acting taking action.
He did not display any domain-related moves like his Slaughter Domain. Although he had become a Void God, he had broken through via the Voidwalker lineage. Right now, he had not improved on his laws. Although the ‘Slaughter Domain’ was a great help in the True God disciple battle, Xue Ying could vaguely feel that it was useless in dealing with this opponent in front of him!
“Up.”
With a thought, “sou sou sou”, three black-robed ‘Xue Ying’s appeared by the side of that distant gray-armored warrior. All of them were holding on to a spear as they immediately displayed the strongest killing move which Xue Ying grasped currently, the Apocalyptic Second Sword.
“Hu hu hu…”
At that moment, a dense amount of spear shadows flashed. Every single spear had consecutively pierced out 81 times. The 81 spear shadows vaguely formed a huge array diagram, before three spear array diagrams enveloped that gray-armored warrior.
The gray-armored warrior stood there unmoving. He let the three great spear array diagrams bombard him on his body, with the result merely leaving behind some white spots.
“So weak.” The gray-armored warrior said.
Xue Ying’s expression changed.
“Sou.”
The gray-armored warrior started moving. Unexpectedly disappearing from his original location, he appeared right by side of Xue Ying in the next instant, before his right hand explosively. His two arms appeared like sabers as the movement of his right hand caused a destructive force that swept across the body of Xue Ying.
Xue Ying’s body also dissipated.
Reappearing in the distance, Xue Ying looked with solemn at that gray-armored warrior. ” Teleportation?”
The suppression of the sacred world was extremely strong.
Ordinary Void Gods at the Origin Birth realm could not teleport at all! Being a ‘Voidwalker’ who stepped into the Origin Birth realm, Xue Ying could teleport. However, he had never expected that his opponent could do so as well.
“He actually can teleport ?” At the moment the gray-robed warrior waved his blade, he discovered that his attack had merely struck an after-image.
“Hmph.” Xue Ying also understood that the other party’s body was too strong. His own incarnations could not threaten the other party at all. Therefore, he brought out his violet spear and directly proceeded on with close combat.
“Shua shua shua…”
The gray-armored warrior flashed continuously alongside the figure of Xue Ying. They were fighting in close combat at this moment. Due to the strength of his body, Xue Ying would only be in a slightly disadvantageous state every time their weapons clashed.
‘Although the aura of his soul feels weak, his power is actually comparable to mine. This cultivator from the Great Void Heaven Temple can indeed fight across realms.’ The gray-armored warrior thought while killing intent in his heart became even more concentrated.

chapters.title: Chapter 815 - Evolution of the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 815: Evolution of the World
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Half an hour later.
The door of the Star Pagoda opened before Xue Ying appeared from within. He was slightly pale as savage energy was being expelled from his body. The moment he entered the external world, that greyish savage energy roared out before disappearing into nothingness.
“Despite going all out without any qualms of my injuries, the best that I can do is to injure him. I’m definitely unable to kill him.” Xue Ying looked at the entrance in front of him, “The first level of Star Pagoda is already that tough?”
The Apocalyptic Second Sword was said to be able to allow a Ruler to be able to escape with their life from a Unity realm expert.
Despite using the Apocalyptic Second Sword, his three incarnations could not injure the other party despite using!
‘According to the information I know, in order to get through the first level of Star Pagoda, I must possess the power of an ordinary Unity realm. To get through the second level, I must possess the power of a peak Unity realm. As for the third level, it is at the highest apex of the Unity realm level.’ Xue Ying pondered over it, ‘Even though I grasped the Apocalyptic Second Sword, I am still slightly lacking as compared to ordinary Unity realm experts.’
‘To reach the apex Unity realm power at the realm of an ordinary Void God.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
It was very challenging.
Even in the Great Void Heaven Temple, only a fewUnity realm experts could only get through the third or fourth level, thereby taking on the responsibility as Outer Hall Elders.
Unity realm experts had to get through the fifth level before they could take on the position as Inner Hall Elders. Clearing the fifth level meant that one had reached the ‘boundary of Primal Chaos realm’ in combat power! They also had to reach great attainments in certain aspects, so that they could survive and escape after fighting against Primal Chaos realm giants! Thus, those ‘Inner Hall Elders’ of the Great Void Heaven Temple had really high statuses.
Being an existence who got through the fifth level, they could easily kill other Unity realm experts even if there were hundred or more than thousands of them! They could no longer be treated as ordinary Unity realm experts.
According to the legends…
Unity realm experts could even get through the sixth level! That was actually someone that could fight against a Primal Chaos realm giant! However, they were an absolute rarity. There seemed to be no one of such that have ever existed in the Great void Heaven Temple, though there were in the annals of history!
Naturally, there were more heaven-shattering experts who could get through the seventh level as a Unity realm expert. This were legends about them across the five sacred worlds, with two such existences in the long span of history! Those two had long reached the Primal Chaos realm and, were truly frightening experts even amongst other Primal Chaos realm experts.
…
Returning to the Palace Hall of Time.
Xue Ying was seated on a planet covered in beautiful plains, having resumed his closed-door cultivation.
‘According to the rules of the Great Void Heaven Temple, I have to get through the third level within 10 billion years after becoming a Void God to become an Inner Hall Elder. Otherwise, I will have to take on the responsibility of being an Outer Hall Elder and will be forced to enter the ‘primal chaos cities’.’ Xue Ying thought. This 10 billion years was the time passed in the outer world. If he had sufficient Origin World Rocks, he could accelerate to 1,000 or even 10,000 times in the Palace Hall of Time. The Great Void Heaven Temple would certainly be willing to see through this deal if Xue Ying could bring out that many Origin World Rocks.
Void Gods had to spend five Origin World Rocks for every 100 million years they spent in the Palace Hall of Time at a time-acceleration rate of hundred times! If he cultivated here for 10 billion years, that would mean 500 pieces of Origin World Rocks, not a number he could afford.
“I should be able to do it.”
“Currently, there is only an ordinary Void God Inner Hall Elder in this generation. Adding up those who have done so in history, there are quite a few actually.”
Xue Ying continued cultivating.
After becoming a Void God, he naturally had to cultivate properly! Previously, he had merely entered the Star Pagoda to have a look.
Due to his body having broken through to the Void God level, his fleshy body had nourished his soul, allowing it to become gradually grow stronger. The level of his soul would improve qualitatively, allowing for Xue Ying’s comprehension speed to soar. Currently, he was focusing on the Dao of Mirage, Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple. Naturally, his previous comprehensions in the ‘Dao of Mirage’, and the Dao of Slaughter would allow him to break through in them.
Time passed.
On this grass plain planet, the weeds were continuously growing taller and taller, now being even taller than Xue Ying who was seated cross-legged. Eventually, they would dry and wither, and the grassy plain on the planet would turn desolate. The desolate planet would soon have newer grass growing and repeating the cycle.
Growing, withering…
This was a reincarnation, one that would time and time again. Over a million years, more than 100 million years have passed. To mortals, this was an incomparably long time. But to the current Xue Ying, it was a mere ‘short’ period that was sufficient for him to perfectly evolve his Dao of Mirage.
After 230 million years, Xue Ying had finally reached the Void God level in his soul.
The cross-legged Xue Ying opened his eyes. His eyes had an enormous celestial entity revolving about.
“Hong long long~”
The world within his body was also undergoing great changes. The originally vast land inner world was currently being distorted. The entire inner world, under the influence of unseen laws, had transformed from the shape of a great land towards the appearance of a ‘cosmic spherical entity’.
Spherical.
The Sun Star was spherical. The Moon Star was spherical. The cosmos was spherical.
The sphere contained perfection in every part of its surface. The radius from the center of the sphere to the surface was equal. This was a very perfected and complete shape. When one entered the ‘Void God realm’ from being a ‘True God Ruler’, there would be a huge qualitative transformation in the inner world when breaking through using the laws and profound mysteries system.
And the outcome of this transformation would be related to the comprehended law system.
The Dao of Mirage… would evolve into a ‘Mirage Law System’.
Some broke through to Void God, forming an inner world that was akin to that of the ‘material realm’, transforming an enormous land into a world with a large number of continents existing together! The countless continents would exist together as one whole entity. This was also a form of evolution.
There were also some whose inner world would transform into a ‘Dark Abyss’, forming many land worlds stacked on top of each other. Continuously building level by level, they would for the same the shape of intestines.
The material realm, Dark Abyss, Sun Star, Moon Star… these were all existences at the same level. Nonetheless, they represented different directions.
Xue Ying’s current inner world had evolved towards the direction of the Sun-Star and Moon Star.
“Hong long long~”
Finally.
The inner world had transformed into a huge planet. It was truly huge and was about the size of a Sun Star. However, when comparing its power, this inner world was much weaker. The volume of soil and the same volume of metal were also naturally different.
And the current enormous planet was merely at the ‘Origin Birth realm’.
‘The Mirage Planet.’ Xue Ying could sense this enormous planet in his body. This enormous planet contained the revolving law of what Xue Ying recently comprehended-’Mirage Law System’. This system took the Dao of Mirage as its core while fusing in other profound mysteries with it. For instance, the profound mysteries from the Dao of Slaughter or that of the Dao of Ripple were partly infused within.
The same Dao would end up differently for different people.
Thus, one would be required to create a complete law system to become a Void God!
Following that, Xue Ying’s soul started improving by using the ‘Mirage Law System’ as the base.
…
Time passed.
After about 200 million years since the breakthrough of his Dao of Mirage, due to him having previously comprehended the Apocalyptic Second Sword and also had the experience of breaking through the Dao of Mirage, Xue Ying soon broke through in his Dao of Slaughter within just 150 million years! Nonetheless, the final ‘Dao of Ripple’ took a relatively long time and effort.
Xue Ying was not in a rush.
Like his teacher Bloodshed God-Emperor, it was really taxing for him to break through in the laws and profound mysteries too.
He spent most of his effort on the “13 Apocalyptic Swords”. Being a Ruler who comprehended the Apocalyptic Second Sword, with his Dao of Slaughter broken through, it allowed him to start comprehending the third sword… these gave Xue Ying frequent harvest. He was also deepening his understanding of the ‘Dao of Ripple’. After all, which such a high horizon and realm, the difficulty of comprehending would naturally decrease.
He was not in a rush.
The time in the Palace Hall of Time was kept at a hundred-times time acceleration, allowing him to cultivation at an unhurried pace.

chapters.title: Chapter 816 - Dong Bo Yus Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 816: Dong Bo Yu’s Breakthrough
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Afte having cultivated for 1.60 billion years, his ‘Dao of Ripple’ had broken through to the Void God realm and naturally formed its own law system.
When he cultivated for 2.3 billion years, Xue Ying finally grasped hold of the Apocalyptic Third Sword! This astonished Xue Ying greatly. He had grasped the Apocalyptic Second Sword when he was a Ruler, and then he grasped hold of the Slaughter Law System. Who would have thought that he spent such a long time before finally comprehending the ‘Apocalyptic Third Sword’!
After grasping the Apocalyptic Third Sword…
Xue Ying decided to leave his closed-door cultivation and enter the Star Pagoda, all for the sake of gaining experience!
This time, he had cultivated his Hidden’s Walker Secret to the 26th level. Accompanied by the Apocalyptic Third Sword, Xue Ying was able to easily kill the enemy on the first level of Star Pagoda. That gray-armored life form eventually dissipated and turned back into gray light that fused back to the great land. A passage proceeded to open in the Star Pagoda leading to a higher level space. Xue Ying entered the second level.
Xue Ying was able to secure his victory in the second level too! And after proceeding to the third level… he failed!
Xue Ying could only go to the ‘Myriad Elephant Palace Hall’ to read through the books at the Void God level. He comprehended and pondered before cultivating in the Palace Hall of Time again, doing his best to improve himself. Clearly, it was much harder to improve after comprehending the Apocalyptic Third Sword… even if his “Slaughter Domain” became more perfected, it was of limited help to the battle in the third level of Star Pagoda.
Clearly, it was extremely difficult for someone at the ‘Origin Birth realm’ to become an Inner Hall Elder.
…
In the holy ground ‘Great Void Heaven Temple’, while Xue Ying was reading through the books and cultivating, back at his hometown cosmos.
The Ancestor Mother Religion had long been exterminated. Bloodshed God-Emperor was a Void God, being unparalleled across the entire cosmos, causing it to become much more peaceful.
In the starry sky, there was a young man seated cross-legged on top of a broken meteorite. Dressed in tattered clothing, with a messy head of hair. At this moment, he was practicing with his finger, causing the deity runes to form in the surroundings. He was also a famous person who had a status and power secondary only to ‘Bloodshed God-Emperor’, the son of Monarch Dong Bo-Dong Bo Yu!
“Hong~”
This broken-clothed young man trembled lightly. The deity runes in the surrounding had formed an extremely beautiful picture. It looked so perfect.
“The law of the world! The law of the world!” Dong Bo Yu’s voice was slightly trembling. His eyes were filled with surprise and disbelief, “I’ve finally comprehended it. I’ve comprehended it, father. I’ve comprehended the law of the world! Father, I’ve comprehended it!”
At this moment, Dong Bo Yu’s eyes were filled with tears.
He was Dong Bo Yu, a proud son of heaven.
From birth, he had a giant who propped his entire world behind his back-Xue Ying! In the material realm, Xia Clan world, when he was born, his father was the strongest expert in history across the entire Xia Clan. Xue Ying was an absolute hero who saved the entire Xia Clan, and was also the territory lord of the Xia Clan world! He, Dong Bo Yu, had the greatest of mountains to depend on when he entered this world.
He and his sister were carefree and without worries. Even though his parents had harsh requests on them, they did not feel suppressed at all deep in their hearts.
In the Xia Clan world, they lived through days of carefreeness in the Crimson Rock Mountain World. His father had caused huge waves when he went to the Deity world and Abyss-he continued becoming even stronger…
Even though he inherited the outstanding qualities from his parents, and the best resources and even guidance from his parents, he was still stuck at the limits of Deity. It was due to a relationship setback that made him finally undergo a transformation to become a World Deity.
After that, his speed of cultivation became much slower…
His father became the third ancestor! And he even went on to become a Ruler, possessing an extremely high status and was second only to Bloodshed God-Emperor. Even Bloodshed God-Emperor became the grand teacher of Dong Bo Yu! With such great conditions, and that he had the opportunity to enter the ‘Devil Mountain Cosmos’ to cultivate, even the Third Highness Jiao Yun Liu who had great status in Devil Mountain Cosmos had groomed Dong Bo Yu under respect for his father.
Over billions of years, he was still stuck at the stage four World Deity realm.
Originally, His father ‘Dong Bo Xue Ying’ had a boundless future, and was the most heaven-defying cultivator in the entire cosmos-his cultivation speed was much faster than Bloodshed God-Emperor and the others. This cosmos epoch had still a long period before it would end. As long as he continued cultivating in the usual routine, with the qualities of his father, by the time this epoch ended, it would not be tough for his father to reach the Void God Unity realm. By then, he could proceed to the holy ground Great Void Heaven Temple and might even improve further, with great chances of becoming a Primal Chaos giant.
However!
For the sake of Dong Bo Yu, for the sake of his mother Jing Qiu, his father Xue Ying could not afford to watch as the souls of his loved ones reach the brink of their existences. Thus, Xue Ying had chosen to leave the cosmos and enter the vast primal chaos void!
Jing Qiu was not willing!
He, Dong Bo Yu, was not willing too!
They were able to accept death, but his father was not willing to watch and be helpless. Therefore, his father did not hesitate to brave all dangers and enter the primal chaos void and entered a vast journey towards the sacred world.
That journey was extremely far. Was his father able to arrive at the sacred world safely?
And after arriving at the sacred world, it was said that the sacred world was stronger by 10,000 times than inside the cosmos. There were many experts and many dangers. Could his father remain safe for the whole time as he fought for Dong Bo Yu and his mother Jing Qiu?
He was afraid!
Afraid that his father would die!
He was afraid his father would die in the primal chaos void, or die in the sacred world. There were too many possibilities. Everything was making Dong Bo Yu afraid!
He had never given any thought about this while his father was braving the wind and rain for him, as he was long used how majestic his dad was ever since he was born. However, after his father had left the cosmos and entered the journey filled with danger, Dong Bo Yu was truly afraid and regretful why he had not transcended.
Thus…
He became all the crazier in his cultivation. He did not wish to disappoint his father.
“Hua~”
In the vast River of Time, there was a figure located in one of it-Dong Bo Yu. Under the help of the law of the world, that figure directly flew up. Even though the river pulled him backward, Dong Bo Yu was still able to escape from the restriction, causing slight waves to form. Dong Bo Yu had finally left the River of Time.
‘I’ve transcended, father.’ Dong Bo Yu sat on the meteorite thinking about it.
…
Within the Monarch Dong Bo residence.
Dong Bo Yu saw his mother Jing Qiu.
“Yu’er.” looking at her son, Jing Qiu revealed a joyous look on her face. She was able to discern with a single glance that her son had achieved what her father, Monarch Mo Xue desired, and what she herself desired after reincarnating-to transcend!
“Mother.” Dong Bo Yu revealed a small grin. Soon, that smile disappeared.
He did not have that much happiness in his heart now.
Because he wanted to let his father know of this moment!
“Alright, alright.” Jing Qiu’s face was filled with joy. She cultivated for a longer period than her son and was reaching the brink of despair with regards to transcending. However, seeing her son transcending filled her with endless happiness, “This is great! If your father knows this, he will certainly be happy.”
“But Father is not here.” Dong Bo Yu said.
Jing Qiu was startled momentarily. She could feel the mood her son had. She then turned towards the starry sky above the Monarch Dong Bo residence.
In the starry sky, outside the cosmos, where could her husband be?
Was he still fine?
“I wonder where Father is, and how he has been.” Dong Bo Yu softly muttered.

chapters.title: Chapter 817 - Inner Hall Elder
chapters.content:
Chapter 817: Inner Hall Elder
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
A white-robed Xue Ying looked up at the towering and majestic Star Pagoda. The Star Pagoda was currently emitting a grandeur that spread in all directions.
Xue Ying took a step before entering the spatial passage by the entrance of the Star Pagoda.
The space folded and warped.
This time, the degree of spatial distortion in this passage became more extreme as Xue Ying flew in. Once Xue Ying entered the passageway, he saw a vast desert world. This was the third level of the Star Pagoda.
“Hua hua hua~” Deep in this desert, there was boundless gray light surging out continuously and condensing into many figures. In the blink of an eye, more than 100 gray-armored life forms were standing there. Some were tall and sturdy, some were thin, some had six arms, and all of them were carrying different types of weapon. Nonetheless, all of them were similarly wearing a gray armor, with a twisted horn was imbued by the shoulder armors.
The more than 100 gray-armored life forms were staring at Xue Ying.
Xue Ying in his white robe stared back at his opponents. If it was just a single single gray-armored life form, he could easily eliminate it. However, the moment ten of them gathered together, they were able to indistinctly fight in a formation, allowing their overall power to increase. Once 100 of them gathered, the power of every individual would increase even further
What’s more, they had this wicked energy which was rejected by the operating laws. As long as their attacks landed, this energy would invade into Xue Ying’s body. Xue Ying was able to get rid of the energy rapidly if it was just a few hits. However, they would create addition trouble for him if they were to increase.
Previously, it was fortunate the treasure spirit of Star Pagoda help him suppress the other party, otherwise, every time he was defeated, the voluminous wicked energy would be sufficient to kill him.
“It’s different this time.”
The white-robed Xue Ying did not bring his Void God weapon out this time. Instead, he was standing on this desert.
“Go!”
He pointed out.
A large amount of Termination Energy from within his body flew out. A dense amount of violet Termination Energy left the surface of his body. Under the strong willpower of Xue Ying, he directly guided the energy of the laws, allowing every single strand of violet Termination Energy to turn into many violet fishes. Thousands of violet fishes covered the world, leaping straight towards those gray-armored lifeforms.
“Kill!” The 100 over gray-armored lifeforms began generating wicked gray energy on their body. This energy fused together as one entity, causing their individual auras to strengthen by quite a bit.
They all disappeared in the blink of an eye, blinking and winking as they teleported around.
Xue Ying also teleported and disappeared.
“Hua hua hua~”
More than 1,000 violet fishes directly tunneled into the void as they proceeded to send out a void bombardment. Having reached the 28th level of the Walker’s Hidden Secret, Xue Ying had attained more exquisite control in the void as compared to these gray-armored lifeforms. Many of the violet fishes were pursuing those teleporting gray-armored lifeforms.
These gray-armored lifeforms emotionlessly parried the incoming assault. Nonetheless, the violet fishes were extremely flexible and fierce. The lifeforms were barely able to parry a few of them before even more instantly pieced into their bodies.
In the past, due to their resilient bodies, they had rendered Xue Ying’s group attacks useless.
But this time, their bodies were pierced through like sacks. “Xiu xiu xiu”, the dense number of violet fishes frantically penetrated through their bodies, continuously piercing in and out. Even if some completely consumed their energy out, Xue Ying proceeded to release more Termination Energy, which condensed into more violet fishes. Under this frenzied attack, these gray-armored lifeforms had all howled in indignation, as they were completely suppressed.
And just like this, their injuries worsened. After ten breaths, they finally dissipated, with the gray light fusing back into the great land.
“I’ve won.” Xue Ying revealed a grin.
He had finally won.
He had gotten through the third level of Star Pagoda as a Void God Origin Birth realm expert.
It really was too, too difficult.
Ever since the end of the True God disciple battle, he had entered closed-door cultivation for close to 5.8 billion years. Truth to be told, he had already grasped hold of the Apocalyptic Third Sword at 2.3 billion years of training. He originally wanted to fuse the Apocalyptic Third Sword into his Dao of Ripple to create the tenth volume of “Wind Ripple Path”. However, he discovered that it was too challenging after attempting it.
As he tempered himself along the way, he had attempted to simplify the ‘Apocalyptic Third Sword’, and use it as a group attacking move!
He was indeed weak in group combat. Furthermore, due to him having to control a large amount of Termination Energy while unleashing a killing move at the same time, using the ‘Apocalyptic Third Sword’ required a huge amount of concentration. At the very most, he could display the Apocalyptic Third Sword along with five Termination Energy simultaneously. However, this was entirely insufficient! It was too few. His enemies would definitely be able to resist this. Even if he had attacked a single enemy using a mass attack like this, that gray-armored lifeform could just revolve its energy and recover from its injuries.
Therefore, if he wanted to kill, he had to kill all of his enemies, requiring him to unleash an ultra-large-scale move.
And that was why he had simplified the ‘Apocalyptic Third Sword’.
Simplifying it was much easier than altering it and fusing the Dao of Ripple into it. However, Xue Ying still needed to relax when using this move, as the large its scale, the better it would be. This made this task a hard one.
Trying time and time after again to simplify it, with the Apocalyptic Third Sword as the base, he continued his attempts. Focusing on making it simple, while working hard to increase its might.
Finally-
He created this group killing move-’Fish Dragon Kill’.
“Let’s go and have a look at the fourth level.” The white-robed Xue Ying flew up into the sky. He flew along the huge hole in the sky and entered the fourth level of the Star Pagoda. That was a vast world with a continuous mountain chain. There was only a single lifeform wearing blood armor inside. This time, Xue Ying tried his best to use the ‘Fish Dragon Kill’ against the enemy while using the Void God energy to attack. He could barely injure the other party, and he himself suffered from injuries from that wicked blood energy. Fortunately, the Star Pagoda treasure spirit had suppressed the other party and allow him to leave alive.
“I am still too weak.”
Xue Ying understood this. Being a Void God Origin Birth realm expert, it was amazing that he could kill his way to the third level. Ultimately, he was still lacking if he wanted to reach the fourth level.
“Time to have a walk outside.” Xue Ying knew that he had reached a bottleneck. It was very difficult for him further progress himself for the upcoming few billion years, unless he used an extremely long time, or a ten times time-accelerated environment to further his comprehension. However, such ‘time’ was too extravagant for him. Even though the Palace Hall of Time could accelerate time, the corresponding price was huge.
Training as an Origin Birth realm expert for 5.8 billion years was equivalent to about 58 million years in the outside world. However, he had spent close to 29,000 contribution points, which were equivalent to close to 3 pieces of Origin World Rocks!
Only possessing a few treasures, he could not spend much time in waste.
…
“Dang~Dang~Dang~”
The clock in the Great Void Palace Hall sounded, reverberating across the entire Great Void holy ground.
As long as they were in the Great Void Heaven Temple, all of the Inner Hall Elders and Hall Masters all started to rush towards the Great Void Palace Hall. Many other Outer Hall Elder and True God disciples who were not qualified to do so were all looking towards the Great Void Palace Hall with puzzlement.
What was happening?
Did something huge happen? Every time the clock bell of the Great Void Palace Hall rang, it signified something important had happened.
Within the Great Void Palace Hall.
Located in the highest area, Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster were seated next to each other.
By the side of the platform were the seats of the eight Hall Masters.
Located at the two ends of the great hall, there were many Inner Hall Elders standing there. At this moment, their vision landed on a white-robed young man standing right at the center of the great hall.
He was Xue Ying.
“Today, I’ve gathered all of you here due to a joyous matter that has happened in our Great Void Heaven Temple.” Forefather Tian Yu who was seated at the highest place chuckled, “Dong Bo Xue Ying has already gotten through the third level of Star Pagoda, and from today onwards, he will be the 39th Inner Hall Elder of my Great Void Heaven Temple.”
“Inner Hall Elder?”
All the higher-ups in the Great Void Heaven Temple present, including the Hall Masters, were looking at Xue Ying with astonishment.
How long had it been?
The True God disciple battle ended just 58 million years ago. During then, Xue Ying was merely a True God Ruler, and now, he had already become an Inner Hall Elder? Even though they could determine that Xue Ying cultivated for more than 5.8 billion years, probably relying on the Palace Hall of Time to do so, it was still an extremely short amount of time.
Furthermore, the Great Void Heaven Temple had a rule that stated a Void God Origin Birth realm expert had to pass through the third level of Star Pagoda within 10 billion years to become an Inner Hall Elder. However, seemingly everyone continued spending a longer period in the Palace Hall of Time for this.
What’s more, it was unquestionable-
The difficulty of passing through the third level as an Origin Birth realm was much harder than getting through the fifth level as a Unity realm expert! Previously there was only a single Origin Birth realm expert in the Great Void Heaven Temple who had become an Inner Hall Elder. One could ascertain that those who got through the third level as an Origin Birth realm expert would definitely have an easy time getting through the fifth level of Star Pagoda the moment they reached the Unity realm.
“Finally, we have one more comrade.”
“Elder Dong Bo.” They were all looking at Xue Ying. Being a holy ground that has spanned over the vast annals of history, there were 38 Inner Hall Elders present in the Great Void Heaven Temple! Naturally, those who died in battle were excluded.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, from today onwards, you will be an Inner Hall Elder of my Great Void Heaven Temple. I hope that you will protect the sovereignty of my Great Void Heaven Temple like the rest, and to protect all holy grounds where the lineages of my laws and profound mysteries are located.” Forefather Tian Yu chuckled as he looked below. At the same time, he waved his hand, causing three golden lights to fly towards Xue Ying.
Xue Ying waved his hand before collecting them. He respectfully answered, “I, Dong Bo Xue Ying will definitely do my best.”

chapters.title: Chapter 818 - Plate Ripple Diagram
chapters.content:
Chapter 818: Plate Ripple Diagram
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Many True God disciples and Outer Hall Elders from the Great Void Heaven Temple looked towards the furthest peak. They were looking with great curiosity at the highest peak where the chain of palaces that shone across the entire holy ground. All of them wondered what had happened that so many higher echelon members of the holy ground had to be summoned at this moment. A piece of news soon spread around: “Dong Bo Xue Ying has become an Inner Hall Elder?”
News spread like wildfire. At the same time, some Inner Hall Elders and Hall Masters were also spreading the news to their own subordinates and disciples.
“How long has he been cultivating?”
“He has just arrived at the Great Void Heaven Temple quite recently. The True God disciple battle also ended less than a 100 million years ago, and he has already become an Inner Hall Elder?”
“He is truly someone who originated from the same cosmos as Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster. Just a short period after he read through the countless books from the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall, he was able to transform and become an Inner Hall Elder.”
“Formidable, amazing.”
“He passed the Star Pagoda third level when he was only a Void God of the Origin Birth realm! It was said that Outer Hall Elders at the Unity realm had to cultivate for a period of time before they could even pass the third level.”
This piece of news shocked many True God disciples and Outer Hall Elders. This kind of achievement was something that they could only hope for.
On ‘Yu Xing Island’.
Some golden-robed disciples also came out of their cavern-dwelling with puzzlement. They looked in the direction of the Great Void Palace Hall, wondering about what had happened. Soon, they also received the news.
“Senior Disciple Dong Bo become Inner Hall Elder?”
“So fast?”
As people who previously fought with Xue Ying, this batch of golden-robed disciples was surprised and envious.
“Previously I thought that Senior Disciple Dong Bo was quite amazing. When he first arrived at the Great Void Heaven Temple, he was closely matched in power with Senior Disciple Rain Sword Guest already.” Disciple Sister Qian Que chuckled, “It was only a short time ago that Senior Disciple Dong Bo became a Void God, and now, he is already an Inner Hall Elder?”
“Disciple Sister Qian Que, I was previously hoping for you to get closer with Dong Bo. You must be regretting now right?” The plump Xue Chen laughed out loud.
Stood there with her long trail of golden hair and bright yellow robe, the elegant and poised Qian Que could only smile as she listened to Xue Chen teasing her.
Xue Chen turned towards Old Devil Needle and shouted out: “Old Devil Needle, weren’t you so arrogant during the True God Disciple battle? How is it? Senior Disciple Dong Bo had never placed you in his eyes. Right now, he has not only become a Void God, he has also become an Inner Hall Elder. I see that it is impossible for you to become one in your entire life.”
Old Devil Needle only snorted before turning and entering his dwelling.
“Haha, he is entirely speechless.” Xue Chen laughed voraciously.
“Quickly look over.”
“Senior Disciple Dong Bo is coming out.”
Many True Gods disciples and Outer Hall Elders of could see figures flying out one by one from Great Void Palace Hall. They also saw a white-robed Xue Ying as he calmly flew out just as how he flew in. He left the Great Void Palace Hall while flying and chatting with other Inner Hall Elders.
“Inner Hall Elder. In this lifetime, when will I ever become one?” Xue Chen muttered. He was looking at Xue Ying and that group from afar; his voice was filled with admiration and envy.
It was truly hard.
Crossing the third level of Star Pagoda at the Origin Birth realm was nearly impossible for most.
And to cross the fifth level at the Unity realm? What did passing the fifth level represent?
It was even more significant than passing the sixth. Usually, only Primal Chaos giants could pass the sixth level. That was also why passing the fifth level indicated that they had already reached the boundary of the Primal Chaos realm. It was rare even amongst Unity experts who were nurtured by the Great Void Heaven Temple to pass the fifth level. In the entire Great Void Heaven Temple, there was only a handful of them that had achieved this, with the majority of them becoming Outer Hall Elders.
******
When Xue Ying first became an Inner Hall Elder, many other Inner Hall Elders invited him over to gatherings. Nevertheless, as he attended those gatherings, he felt that the others were hiding something from him.
‘What are the Inner Hall Elders hiding from me?’
‘When I asked them, they merely replied to me that I would understand only after passing the fifth level of Star Pagoda.’
Xue Ying pondered in frustration.
After the gatherings ended, Xue Ying returned the robe and token he got as a golden-robed disciple. As an Inner Hall Elder, Xue Ying was bestowed three objects when he was at the Great Void Palace Hall by Forefather Tian Yu-a robe, token and a communication talisman. The token represented his status as an Inner Hall Elder, and also acted as a life-saving treasure. As a result, it was worth much more than his Black Gourd.
Other than that, as soon as he became an Inner Hall Elder, Xue Ying also received a million contribution points. This contribution points could be used to exchange with all kind of treasure that could help in his cultivation.
And if he wanted to obtain more contribution points? He would have to complete more missions!
In the future, if he wanted to refine powerful weapons or to request others to do things, Xue Ying would have to fight for himself and earn them.
“Mn?”
Inside the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall, Xue Ying was currently flipping through some books on the fourth floor. It was only after he became an Inner Hall Elder could he enter the fourth floor.
The fourth floor was significantly more important than the three lower floors. Many books were kept on this level, and each book was priceless. Many original copies of cosmos ranked absolute arts were placed there. As an Inner Hall Elder, he could choose any cosmos ranked absolute art for himself.
“Meow.” A black cat up onto the shelf with a leap. It looked downwards at Xue Ying, “Dong Bo Xue Ying, don’t be too greedy. It takes a lot of energy to study a single cosmos ranked absolute art. If you’re too greedy, it might backfire and influence your cultivation.”
“Thank you.” Xue Ying smiled back.
He also discovered it too. There were nine original copies of cosmos ranked absolute arts. Among them, there were two that contained the Dao of Slaughter-the “13 Apocalyptic Swords” and the “Waning Moon Sword Scripture”. When he first looked through the two, he found that there were many contradictions between them. He knew that it was possible for him to learn both of them if his realm was adequate. But having just reached the Origin Birth Realm, it would be hard for him to confront even a single absolute art created by Cosmos God.
“I will just take these two then.” Xue Ying took another blue stone book. There was some kind of ripple emanating on the bluestone surface.
He decided to focus on these two arts. One was the “13 Apocalyptic Swords” which he had already spent time and effort to cultivate. The other was an absolute art that belonged to the Dao of Ripple. This absolute art was created by ‘Ancestor Cang’, also the primogenitor of the laws and profound mysteries system. This was also the only absolute art left behind by him!
Xue Ying wanted to seek for other cosmos ranked absolute arts pertaining to the Dao of Void, but to no avail. Ever since the ancient times, there were only three who had reached the final realm cultivating the laws and profound mysteries system-’Ancestor Cang’, ForefatherTian Yu and Swordmaster. None of them had cultivated the Dao of Void.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, come over to my place.” Xue Ying heard a cold voice resounding by his ears.
“Ancestor Devil?” Xue Ying put down the bluestone book that was emanating ripples in his hand and quickly headed downstairs.
The black cat that was still located on the bookshelf watched Xue Ying leave. There was a hint of expectation in its eyes: ‘Such a young Inner Hall Elder. It is worth properly observing him.’
…
Punishment Hall. This palace hall was located by itself on a floating island. This hall emitted a chilling murderous air that steered ordinary disciples from coming close to it.
Xue Ying turned into a stream of light as he flew descended on the island before entering the Punishment Hall.
Inside the Punishment hall, there was a male wearing a gorgeous black robe seated in the highest position. His expression remained cold as he opened his eye at Xue Ying.
“Ancestor Devil.” Xue Ying greeted politely after he entered.
“When cultivating, you should also temper yourself well. Do you have any plans to go out?” Ancestor Devil asked.
“I haven’t thought about it yet.” Xue Ying replied.
Ancestor Devil acknowledged, “Our Great Heaven Void Temple has some conflict with the Ancient Sacred World and the Ancestor Mother World. It would be best for you not to leave the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World before reaching the Unity realm. How about this, within Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World itself, our Great Void Heaven Temple has control over a total of 12 primal chaos cities. We manage those cities, and there are people from our sect stationed there. You can pay one of those cities a visit. Although there are incarnations of hall masters and elders situated there, it is still quite dnagerous. There might be someone in those cities who harbors ill intention and would want to kill you. This could be a good opportunity for you to temper yourself.”
“Alright. I’ll select a city to be stationed at.” Xue Ying replied. Actually, he was also considering this issue.
Ancestor Devil took the initiative to discuss it with him. This could be because the position of Swordmaster was too high within the Great Void Heaven Temple to be in charge of Xue Ying’s affair. Xue Ying could also be counted as a member of the Ancestor Devil faction! A lone wolf like Ancestor Devil, added with his comparatively short time since he joined Great Void Heaven Temple, made other Inner Hall Elders reluctant to get close with him. Amongst his subordinate, there were only some Outer Hall Elders, and currently, Xue Ying was the only Inner Hall Elder.
Of course, he had his own principles and bottom line. But since the Great Void Heaven Temple had stringent rules, Ancestor Devil became much more disciplined than previously when he was back at his hometown cosmos.

chapters.title: Chapter 819 - Celestial Water City
chapters.content:
Chapter 819: Celestial Water City
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Even though he would be protecting a primal chaos city, Xue Ying was not in a rush to leave. After all, he had just become an Inner Hall Elder, and there were many precious books in the ‘fourth level of Myriad Elephant Palace Hall’ which he had yet to read. The moment he was stationed in the primal chaos city, he would likely not be coming back for a long time.
Thus…
Xue Ying spent another 20 million years in the Great Void Heaven Temple. Other than reading in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall, he spent the majority of his remaining time cultivating in the ‘Palace Hall of Time’. The time spent in the Palace Hall of Time had reached close to two billion years, costing him 10,000 contribution points which were equivalent to a single Origin World Rock. This caused several other Inner Hall Elders comment: “Elder Dong Bo, you have a long life ahead. Why the need to cultivate in the Palace Hall of Time? The one million contribution points you get after becoming an Inner Hall Elder is a one-off thing. In the future, you will have to think of ways to get more. Resources are precious, and it isn’t worth spending them carelessly.”
Xue Ying laughed and did not explain.
Time?
He had spent most of his time in the Palace Hall of Time, and currently, he had reached bottleneck in both “13 Apocalyptic Swords” and “Plate Ripple Diagram”. The reason why he spent close to two billion years in the Palace Hall of Time was primarily that he had just gotten the cosmos ranked absolute art “Plate Ripple Diagram”. Fortunately, his realm was quite profound, allowing him to grasp a deep comprehension about it in a short time.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying turned into a stream of light as he flew towards the central floating island. Very soon, he entered an ancient and old palace which occupied a huge area, the ‘Primal Chaos Palace Hall’.
A female Void God was welcoming him by the entrance of the Primal Chaos Palace Hall.
“Elder Dong Bo.” This female Void God politely greeted.
Xue Ying softly nodded.
Void Gods who could spend long periods in the Great Void Heaven Temple, other than the Hall Masters and Inner Hall Elders, were the ones responsible for the miscellaneous tasks. After all, these tasks could not be handled personally by the Inner Hall Elders right? The Inner Hall Elders had high statuses and were strong. They disdained from doing these trifle tasks. Most who handled these tasks were the Outer Hall Elders heavily utilized by the Hall Masters, and they had another title-’Inner Hall Deacon’.
Deacon meant they would be handling tasks.
Inner Hall… represented that they could stay within the Great Void Heaven Temple.
And the Outer Hall Elders, as long as they wanted to enter the ‘Star Pagoda’ or cultivate in the ‘Palace Hall of Time’ or to send the next batch of True God disciples, would be able to return. Most of the time, however, they were unable to stay within the Great Void Heaven Temple because there were no cavern-dwellings left for them.
Within the Great Void Heaven Temple… there was only more than 100 Inner Hall Void Gods.
“Mn, I want to go to the Celestial Water City.” Xue Ying said.
“Elder Dong Bo, please.” The female Void God hurriedly guided him along. Flying along the distant bent corridor, they soon arrived at a vast and immense primal chaos vortex passage. This primal chaos vortex passage also had another Void God and two puppets guarding it.
“This is the passage entrance leading to the Celestial Water City.” The female Void God said.
Xue Ying nodded before flying towards the passage.
“Hong~”
The female Void God and the other Void God were both looking at Xue Ying with envy as he entered. Being Inner Hall Deacons, they could head to other primal chaos cities only when they were performing specific tasks. Otherwise, they had to pay a high price if they were visiting for personal matters. It was different for Inner Hall Elders. They had much higher power and privileges.
“Elder Dong Bo has only arrived recently at our Great Void Heaven Temple, yet he is an Inner Hall Elder already.” The female Void God murmured.
“How can we compare to him? He has become an Inner Hall Elder at the Origin Birth realm and is truly formidable. Furthermore, he has Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster behind his back.” The Void God said from the side.
Being strong, having great potential accompanied by the support of Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster, these Inner Hall Deacons could only look up to those in their dreams.
…
“Hong long long~”
Xue Ying was flying continuously within the primal chaos vortex. This primal chaos vortex passage seemed quite similar to the cosmos passage.
‘The 12 primal chaos cities constructed by the Great Void Heaven Temple are scattered across one-third of the region of the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. The distances apart are remarkably far. Even Primal Chaos realm giants have to spend about 100,000 years if they were to rush their way through tearing space from a primal chaos city to another.’ Xue Ying sighed.
The sacred world was too big.
The law suppression was too strong too. That made traveling really tough. The Great Void Heaven Temple, for the sake of increasing its controlling and governing power, did not stint on constructing 12 stable primal chaos passages connecting the primal chaos cities to the Great Void Heaven Temple!
After flying for the time taken to brew a cup of tea, Xue Ying finally saw the exit to the passage.
“Hong.”
Flying out of the primal chaos vortex, Xue Ying could see an enormous palace hall with a large number of Void Gods gathered there. Looking over, there were more than a thousand of them, and some had exceptionally strong aura too.
“Greetings, Elder Dong Bo.” The leading two with extraordinary aura bowed politely. Those behind followed their actions orderly.
“Is this Elder Chun Wu and Elder Qian Yu?” Xue Ying chuckled.
Elder Chun Wu was a male who had a tall hat and was dressed in a loose green gown.
Elder Qian Yu was a white-haired old man wearing casually.
Xue Ying being an Inner Hall Elder had gathered a large amount of information via his communication talisman before coming here. Naturally, he had obtained news on the Celestial Water City.
The Celestial Water City was one of the twelve primal chaos cities.
The person with the highest status was the one responsible for guarding the place, the incarnation of ‘Celestial Water Hall Master’. But with the identity of Celestial Water Hall Master, he would only be conducting the more important matters, and his incarnation would usually be sleeping! Only during crucial moments would the willpower of Celestial Water Hall Master descend, and his incarnation awake. Thus, even though on the surface, the incarnation of Celestial Water Hall Master was the highest, he would not appear for most of the time.
The subsequent one was the Society of Elders!
The Society of Elders was the one handling all sorts of tasks in the Celestial Water City.
The Society of Elders included all Outer Hall Elders! Those who could become Outer Hall Elders, even though they were not the core group of elites in the Great Void Heaven Temple, they were still people the Great Void Heaven Temple trusted. Furthermore, they were strong enough to the outer world.
And beneath the Society of Elders… they were the Society of Deacons and included the Outer Hall Deacons. In other words, they were the ‘hired thugs’! Many Void Gods who wanted to grab on the huge thigh of ‘Great Void Heaven Temple’ were willing to become deacons because deacons would earn ‘contribution points’ too. In the future, they had the chance of flipping through many precious books and exchange for treasures. But the contribution points earned by deacons were very little because in most of the situations, the ‘Outer Hall Elders’ would be the one taking charge of handling matters. All the missions would first be taken by the Outer Hall Elders, leaving behind several trifle tasks for the others to do.
But even still, there was a large group of Outer Hall Deacons.
There were a total of 61 Outer Hall Elders in the Celestial Water City, and two at the Unity realm! In other words, there were 59 Origin Birth realm elders.
The Origin Birth realm Outer Hall Elders usually only had ordinary Unity realm combative strength.
As for the two Outer Hall Elders at the Unity realm, Elder Chun Wu was someone who got through the fourth level of Star Pagoda and was practically unparalleled across all Unity realm experts! After all, those who could get through the Star Pagoda fifth level were heaven-shattering existences that had reached the boundary of Primal Chaos realm, and most could not reach that. As for ‘Elder Qian Yu’, he had reached the third level of Star Pagoda and was also at the peak of Unity realm. He could easily kill a large group of Unity realm experts.
In the Great Void Heaven Temple… Void Gods at the Unity realm would usually be at the third or fourth level in combat strength. It was too difficult for them to get through the fifth level. The moment they got through, they would soar into the sky with a single step and become Inner Hall Elders!
“Elder Dong Bo actually knows our name. This is truly our honor.” The white-haired old man ‘Elder Qian Yu’ immediately laughed.
“Knowing that Elder Dong Bo is stationed at our Celestial Water City, Brother Qian Yu and I are very delighted and have already prepared a feast. We hope for Elder Dong Bo to show up during the feast.” Elder Chun Wu also said.
Even though Xue Ying’s arrival brought an additional person above the two people with the ‘highest statuses’ in the Celestial Water City, they were not angry at all! Instead, both Elder Chun Wu and Elder Qian Yu were both happy since they were clear that someone who could get through the third level Star Pagoda would easily get through the fifth level once they became Unity realm expert. Furthermore, Xue Ying cultivated for a short period… and he had hopes of becoming a Hall Master in the future!
Such an existence was actually willing to protect the Celestial Water City for a period. As a result, it would be the best chance for the two of them to befriend Xue Ying during this period!
The two of them had reached an awkward stage regarding cultivation.
They had cultivated for a few trillion years, and it was tough for them to improve even further. They could not even find an opportunity to hug on to a huge thigh! But Xue Ying’s arrival meant a chance for them. These old people who had lived for god know how long would never let this opportunity go!
“Alright, then I’ll have to trouble Elder Chun Wu and Elder Qian Yu.” Xue Ying said. He felt satisfied with how polite these two elders were. Even if Xue Ying treated them coldly, both elders could only tolerate. As for the other Outer Hall Elders and Deacons, he did not care that much about them.

chapters.title: Chapter 820 - Golden Wing Nation
chapters.content:
Chapter 820: Golden Wing Nation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Celestial Water City occupied a region of 50 million kilometers. This was one of the 12 primal chaos cities which was under the protection of the Great Void Heaven Temple. It was extremely safe, and there were many cultivators living within. There were even many cities in the wilderness outside the primal chaos city that other beings stayed since being close to the ‘Celestial Water City’ signified safety and security.
The reason why the Celestial Water City was only just 50 million kilometers in range was that this was the region which the incarnation of a primal chaos realm expert could protect. Under the law suppression of the sacred world, the Primal Chaos realm incarnation would not have sufficient time to save someone else if it was too far away.
Xue Ying’s residence occupied a full 500 kilometers; it was considered quite extravagant in the Celestial Water City.
…
Time passed.
Xue Ying would occasionally walk alone in the Celestial Water City. He would visit some taverns or restaurants to eat the local delicacies and hear discussions going on around the surrounding cultivators.
‘This taste not bad.’ Xue Ying drank the wine and ate the delicacies. He was enjoying himself here. In the 50 million kilometers in range of area that the Celestial Water City occupied, this was considered a small distance to most expert cultivators. But in reality, there were many restaurants and taverns which had opened up their businesses in the Celestial Water City, attracting cultivators to come and taste the food. It was filled with uniqueness.
Despite spending a full three months eating, Xue Ying had only tasted a tiny part of all the taverns and restaurants in the entire Celestial Water City.
“Dang~”
A sound came from his communication talisman.
Xue Ying immediately checked through it-
“B29 City, West, Golden Wing Nation King is requesting for help. They are suffering from a large-scale devour by at least ten ordinary Void Gods.”
This was a request for help.
Xue Ying immediately stood up. He placed down a violet metal piece on the table before leaving the tavern. The restaurants and taverns in Celestial Water City were usually willing to accept precious materials since they were all Deity crystals too! But if they accepted Deity crystals, it would be too much of them-at least in terms of several million units per transaction. An attendant of the tavern saw Xue Ying placing that violet gold piece on the table before hurrying over. He was relatively happy as he received it, “Violet Snow Stone? He is indeed a Void God to give such an item.”
Xue Ying had gotten a Violet Snow Vein as he was killing the void creatures across the 200 over primal chaos lands in the past.
“Sou!”
Xue Ying soon disappeared in the Celestial Water City. He proceeded to travel in the void. As he had reached the 28th level of Walker’s Hidden Secret, this maneuver of his became much faster. It took him several breaths before arriving at the spatial teleportation array in the Celestial Water City.
He waited for quite a while.
Two Outer Hall Elders and 30 over Outer Hall Deacons soon appeared here. They were the team on duty currently accepting the mission to proceed to Golden Wing Nation.
“Elder Dong Bo.” These two Outer Hall Elders and 30 over Outer Hall Deacons were startled. They immediately greeted with a bow.
Xue Ying nodded, “You all are heading to the Golden Wing Nation?”
“Replying to Elder Dong Bo, we are indeed going to the Golden Wing Nation.” One of the young men with a jade horn replied respectfully.
“I’ll go with you all. Let’s set off.” Xue Ying ordered, “Rest assured. I do not care about this bit of contribution points.”
“An Inner Hall Elder is planning to undertake this mission too?”
“As long as he doesn’t take away our contribution points, it’ll be fine.”
The two Outer Hall Elders and a large group of Outer Hall Deacons were thinking about it. This was a slightly more common mission, and the total reward was only just ‘one single contribution point’. This one contribution point would be split 0.3 points per Outer Hall Elder, leaving behind the remaining to be divided by a large number of Outer Hall Deacons! Even though it might seem little, accumulating over the long period would allow Outer Hall Elders to reach 10,000 contribution points easily.
“Hong~”
Xue Ying and this team entered the spatial teleportation array.
The spatial teleportation array would usually only teleport people once every year unless there was someone who was willing to pay a higher price to teleport by himself! But Xue Ying and the others were undertaking a mission, so they had to teleport over for free.
…
Under the law suppression of the sacred world, even though the spatial teleportation array was refined by the collective effort of the Palace Masters and Hall Masters, they could only send the people for a certain distance.
“Elder Dong bo, this is the B26 city.” They arrived at a city of just 50,000 kilometers wide. This city contained many arrays too that enveloped the entire place constantly. Its power was grand, and there were even Outer Hall Elders and their subordinates patrolling around the area.
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded.
The sacred world was too big.
The region in which the ‘Celestial Water City’ could influence was covered using the teleportation array. Even if there were 100 cities in both sectors A and B, this was still just a small region.
