Further beyond this region was desolateness… with the wealth and strength of Great Void Heaven Temple, they were only willing to cover a small area using the teleportation arrays.
And even beyond that contained several places which were occupied by the Primal Chaos realm giants!
Traveling in the sacred world was not easy. The weaker cultivators would usually choose to visit to the closest superpower.
B26 City, B27 City, B28 City… they finally arrived at B29 City.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying and the group of people flew out into the B29 city. It was hazy.
Even though there was a huge population in a sacred world, compared to how vast the sacred world was, it remained sparse. Many living beings would usually congregate under experts for the sake of survival!
“Elder Dong Bo, even though the Golden Wing Nation might be within the region of control of B29 City, and it is very close to it, we still have to travel via the void. It will likely take about a year or so to reach Golden Wing Nation.” An Outer Hall Elder said, “Our Deacon called Jiu Qi is at the Unity realm. He is the one who can travel the fastest across the void, and he’ll bring us along as we travel.”
Deacon Jiu Qi was originally a mutated beast that had changed into a human. He had nine heads, and at this moment, he was politely bowing.
Xue Ying looked over before nodding, “Alright, let’s move off then.”
It was considered close already for them to reach their destination in a single year! It was after all, extremely tough to travel in the sacred world.
“Hong~”
Deacon Jiu Qi bowed respectfully before controlling the void to envelop all people present. He then proceeded with penetrating through the void…
“Hu hu hu…”
They traveled across the void without stopping.
“Stop.” Xue Ying suddenly ordered.
At that moment, the team appeared from the void. The two Outer Hall Elders looked at Xue Ying bewilderedly. That Deacon Jiu Qi was at a loss too.
“I think it’ll be better if I bring you all along.” Xue Ying said. He then took the initiative to control the void and bring along everyone. He then proceeded with traveling across the void.
“Sou-”
Traveling through the void, the two Outer Hall Elders and the group of Outer Hall Deacons were shocked. It was too fast! This ‘Inner Hall Elder’ might just be at the Origin Birth realm, but this void traveling speed was more than ten times faster that of Deacon Jiu Qi.
“He is indeed an Inner Hall Elder.”
“I still believed that an Inner Hall Elder who is at the Origin Birth realm will have weaker void traveling skills. Who would have thought it will be so terrifying.” All of them were dumbstruck.
Xue Ying was looking through the intelligence at this moment using his communication talisman. He was checking for the position where the Golden Wing Nation was! Even though he had already gotten the introduction of the approximate maps of the five great sacred worlds, small nations like the Golden Wing Nation might just be exterminated at any time and thus, weren’t recorded in the map at all. Only by using his communication talisman could he locate the position of this nation. Furthermore, should the nation fall, the communication talisman would alter the map after receiving the relevant information.
‘I still believed that the deacon could travel faster than me, yet he is merely slightly faster than ordinary Unity realm experts.’ Xue Ying thought.
Being a Voidwalker, he could teleport at speed comparable to a Unity realm expert after cultivating the 21st level of Walker’s Hidden Secret.
And now, he had reached the 28th level!
Even amongst Unity experts, his void maneuver was considered very formidable. But there would always be those who were stronger. Xue Ying understood that several heaven-shattering Unity experts like the Inner Hall Elders could directly tear through time-space to travel. That speed was much faster than Xue Ying’s current one.
‘It should take us a month to arrive at Golden Wing Nation.’ Xue Ying made his deduction after calculating the distance.
…
Golden Wing Nation.
That was a nation which occupied an area of about five million kilometers. The entire nation was just a huge city with a Unity expert commanding it. But with how big this nation was, those Void Gods could easily devour and assault the people in the dark, and could even directly fight against the king when they worked together. This caused the Golden Wing Nation King to feel a headache.
Currently, the entire Golden Wing Nation was a piece of mess. After all, many cultivators would be devoured time after time. Who would not panic?
Located in one of the courtyards in the Golden Wing Nation.
A violet-haired black-robed male sat there. There was even a mutated beast lying in his embrace. He nonchalantly said, “The Celestial Water City’s team should take about a year to rush over! I’ll continue creating more hysteria in the place before making use of this opportunity to spread my ancient sacred religion! Those who believe in my ancient sacred religion will be protected. I’ll make it half a year.”
“Half a year later, you all must remember to conceal yourself. Only until the Celestial Water City team retreat can you continue to operate in the Golden Wing Nation again.” The violet-haired black-robed male ordered.
“Yes.”
The three Void Gods acknowledged solemnly.

chapters.title: Chapter 821 - Believing in the Ancient Sacred Religion
chapters.content:
Chapter 821: Believing in the Ancient Sacred Religion
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
After his three subordinates withdrew, this courtyard was left with that violet-haired black-robed male sitting by himself. He was gently caressing the hair of the mutated beast in his embrace. This mutated beast was enjoying with its eyes closed.
“They must be panicking. The more they panic, the better it’ll be.” The violet-haired black-robed male muttered, “Either die amidst the panic or become a member of the Ancient Sacred Religion. It is your fortune to be qualified in becoming a follower of the magnificent Sacred Master.”
He did not put the Golden Wing Nation King in his eyes.
Currently, the strength their side had was utterly beyond that of the Golden Wing Nation King. If they wanted to devour the entire Golden Wing Nation, there would not be a single person alive now! But they did not do so for the sake of devouring. Instead, they were doing so to recruit more members into the Ancient Sacred Religion.
“Hu.”
A black figure suddenly appeared by the side of many residences along the street. It let out screeching laughter, and closely following that, a horrifying devouring force enveloped the residences beneath him. One could see the many residences and cultivators in the enveloped region drifting over towards that black figure.
“No!”
“It’s a demon!”
“It’s a big devouring demon!”
Many living beings in these five residences were panicking. They were already living in anxiety these days-afraid that they would be devoured by a demon the next day. Still, they consoled themselves, thinking that the Golden Wing Nation City was five million kilometers long, and under the law suppression of the sacred world, a big demon could only devour a small region. The people felt they should not be so unfortunate.
But this nightmare eventually descended regardless.
“Ah!”
“No-”
“No!”
Mournful voices spread, causing many others to panic. Many had long reported upwards to the Golden Wing Nation royal family, but in a few breaths of time, the black figure in midair had disappeared and left stealthily.
After a while, when two protector elders reached the location, they only saw that the aftermath of that region-with the tiles and bricks devoured, and the civilians in panic.
“Damn.”
“He escaped really fast.” The two protector elders gritted their teeth in anger.
…
A group of demons was hiding across the Golden Wing Nation, sneaking attacks time after time. They would devour a small region every time before leaving! Cultivators were being devoured every moment, resulting in general anxiety across the civilians. Nevertheless, none dared to escape the Golden Wing Nation because the moment they did so, they would die even faster without the protection of the king.
And at this moment, a mysterious religion was also spreading.
As long as they believed in the Ancient Sacred Religion, they would receive their protection! These demons did not dare to offend the Ancient Sacred Religion.
The peak level of the Golden Wing Nation, the ‘True God Rulers’, was being converted. Some who were more obstinate had been directly captured away. They had to believe in the Ancient Sacred Religion. Those who did not convert their belief would die.
In an area containing many cages.
Every single cage was locked with a cultivator. The lowest was at the True God Ruler, and there were even two Void Gods being locked.
“Weng weng~” The surface of the cage diffused black light. Many secretive veins were moving on the cage. An unseen wave was continuously tunneling into the mind of the locked cultivators.
“Ah ah ah.” Those cultivators who were locked felt agony. They were struggling.
Some who had been painfully struggling, gradually reveal a cheerful look. They opened their eyes with a smile, and there was a slight fervor in their eyes. There was even a black deity imprint appearing indistinctly on their forehead.
“We have another brother. Let him out.” The guard by the side immediately let those with a black deity imprint on the forehead of those people.
‘What exactly is this religion? Why is it so frightening that even Rulers are forced to serve their allegiance?’ In one of the cages, there was a muscular male gritting his teeth as he held on. Unseen wave was continuously tunneling into his soul, making him feel unbearable. It felt like a black vortex devouring his soul. As long as he did not resist, his soul would sink into oblivion, and he would be free of the pain.
But-
Was it easy for them to fall into oblivion after cultivating to become a Ruler?
‘No.’ This muscular man was holding on.
‘This Ancient Sacred Religion is too strong. They have some secret techniques which can follow and connect to our souls, extinguishing other avatars of ours.’ The more this muscular male thought, the more depressed he got. He was originally a genius in the Golden Wing Nation-he was able to become a Ruler after cultivating for a short period. He had planned to leave for the Celestial Water City with his wife in hopes of entering the Great Void Heaven Temple.
Who would have thought that they would meet this terrifying Ancient Sacred Religion before they even left?
‘I wonder how Qing Ruo is right now. She is more intelligent than me, and she shouldn’t be so unlucky to be captured right?’ The muscular man thought. He continued holding on while gritting his teeth. Clearly, his cultivation heart was much stronger than the other Rulers around him-he was able to withstand further.
******
Xue Ying brought along the two Outer Hall Elders and the group of Outer Hall Deacons as they traveled through the void at high speed.
“We are reaching soon.” Xue Ying transmitted and ordered, “Prepare yourselves.”
“Yes.”
All of them acknowledged. This time, it was an Inner Hall Elder leading them and they did not dare to be lackadaisical.
“Hu.”
They finally arrived within the Golden Wing Nation City. Very soon, Xue Ying and the group of people arrived above the Golden Wing Nation Royal Palace. There was a total of 33 of them, and all were Void Gods. Of which, there were two Unity realm experts. When their aura was released at this important ground of the royal palace, the Golden Wing Nation King immediately discovered them. He was elated.
“Sou.” The Golden Wing Nation King brought along the three protector elders and flew into the sky. He was extremely respectful, “Greetings, emissaries.”
He was slightly curious.
He could determine from their clothes that 30 of them who came were deacons, and two were Outer Hall Elders. What about the white-robed young man leading them?
“Activate the Golden Wing Nation protective array. Forbid anyone from leaving from now onwards. Inform me the moment anybody rushes out.” Xue Ying ordered.
“Yes.” The Golden Wing Nation King acknowledged respectfully.
“How you handled those demons in the past will be how you handle them now. Go.” Xue Ying ordered.
“Yes.”
The two Outer Hall Elders and 30 Outer Hall Deacons immediately went to do their tasks.
Closely following that, they divided themselves into four teams. Each team was either led by an Outer Hall Elder or a Unity realm Deacon. They swiftly rushed out in different directions seeking for traces of the enemies.
‘What identity does this white-robed teenager has that all of them are listening to his orders?’ The Golden Wing Nation King thought.
Xue Ying stood above the royal palace without caring about the Golden Wing Nation King. Instead, he unleashed his cosmos ranked absolute art, the “Plate Ripple Diagram”. Having cultivated it for close to two billion years in the Palace Hall of Time, his attainment in the “Plate Ripple Diagram” was not any weaker than that of the “13 Apocalyptic Swords”.
“Weng~”
Unseen ripples began spreading out with Xue Ying at the center.
It was extremely difficult to scout in the sacred world, especially when the more cunning enemies would conceal their aura. Thus, most simple scouting methods were deemed useless. Most ordinary methods depended on the ‘law domain’. Under the suppression of the sacred world… Unity realm experts could only cover at most 5,000 kilometers with their law domains. Even Primal Chaos realm giants could cover up to 500,000 kilometers with their law domains at most.
This was their ordinary region of scouting. Unless they knew some very formidable scouting techniques! And the cosmos ranked absolute art “Plate Ripple Diagram” was the only cosmos ranked absolute art belonging to the Dao of Ripple which the Great Void Heaven Temple had. It was unquestionably the best technique the Great Void Heaven Temple had for scouting.
“What is he doing?” The Golden Wing Nation King felt puzzled. He did not even discover the scouting method of Xue Ying.
The unseen ripples were practically one entity with the ordinary ripples. The ripples were stealthily being sent out to scout for enemies, and in an instant, it had covered an area of close to 250,000 kilometers. This was also his current limit.
The white-robed Xue Ying stood there. He was investigating every single aura across the region of 250,000 kilometers in range. Those who thought they could hide from the “Plate Ripple Diagram” must be dreaming.

chapters.title: Chapter 822 - Kill Without Pardon
chapters.content:
Chapter 822: Kill Without Pardon
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Outer Hall Elder and also sent him the location on the map where that Void God was at.
Xue Ying then teleported directly.
There were not many Void Gods in the entire Golden Wing Nation. Whenever there was an unfamiliar Void God that was not recorded in the intelligence report, he would capture him! As for whether he had arrested him wrongly? Well, he could always find out after apprehending all the Void Gods.
Xue Ying could only scout through a region of about 250,000 kilometers wide every time. He would then teleport to other areas before resuming his search. The entire Golden Wing Nation was a total of five million kilometers wide, and Xue Ying had to utilize the Plate Ripple Diagram a few hundred times to comb through the entire place once. Furthermore, he had to be very careful and thorough with all his investigation, and it should take about half an hour!
“Hong~” A rope descended and tied around that ugly male who kept his aura. The ugly male was startled seeing the descending rope. He did not care about other things and tried to escape.
The rope warped and wafted across the 500 kilometers void. It swiftly entangled around that ugly male, tightly restricting him.
The eight special emissaries from Celestial Water City watched as this happened.
“He is really a Void God hiding.”
“Too formidable.”
“Elder Dong Bo is too formidable.”
“His scouting secret technique is more profound than ours.” The special emissary team formed by the two Outer Hall Elders and 30 Deacons were initially doubtful about the skill of Xue Ying, but they did not dare to disobey the Inner Hall Elder’s order. Only when they started moving did they discover that every single person they captured was a Void God!
…
Within that secretive courtyard.
The violet-haired black-robed male was still hugging that mutated beast as he sat there. Suddenly, his expression changed.
“Sacred Emissary, there is a low-level sacred follower who is captured. He should be captured by the Celestial Water City team.”
This was the first piece of news that came.
The violet-haired black-robed male had just received the piece of news. He did not dare believe it, “Impossible. We have just started moving for a month or so, and it is impossible for that team to reach here from the ‘Celestial Water City’. Even if Elder Qian Yu brought the team here personally, it should not be that quick. Unless, it is the top expert from the Celestial Water City’s Society of Elder, ‘Elder Chun Wu’ who came personally? But how is it possible? Such a small matter isn’t something he will personally set off for.”
He was very clear.
The two figures with the highest statuses in the Society of Elder of Celestial Water City, one was Elder Chun Wu, and he was an unparalleled existence amongst all Unity realm experts. The other was Elder Qian Yu who was secondary to him, and also someone very frightening.
But thinking about how they spent just a month to reach Golden Wing Nation, only Elder Chun Wu could travel through the void at such a fast speed! But it should not be the case that the top expert from the Society of Elder would leave the Celestial Water City for such a trifle situation.
“Sacred Emissary, another two low-leveled sacred followers are captured. It must be the Celestial Water City team. There is a Unity realm existence, and they are very formidable when working together.”
“Sacred Emissary, there is another low-leveled sacred follower who is captured…”
“There has already been nine low-leveled sacred followers who are captured.”
The news kept coming.
The expression of that violet-haired black-robed male changed. It was too fast. All the low-leveled sacred followers were Void Gods, and all had learned the secret technique to hide their auras from the Ancient Sacred Religion. It was not easy for others to discover them if they were to hide. Currently, the Celestial Water City team had just arrived, yet they actually found out where all the sacred followers were hiding across the Golden Wing Nation? This, this was absolutely not the usual team from Celestial Water City.
“Not good.” Even though he could not think of any reasons and that it was impossible for Elder Chun Wu to come personally, he understood that things were amiss!
“Hear my orders. All the sacred followers should form three teams. Converge and escape at this moment.” The black-robed male ordered.
Along with his orders, all the sacred follower experts within the Golden Wing Nation started moving. Of which three sacred followers who knew how to teleport had moved separately. They rapidly teleported to other allies of theirs so that they could gather everyone with the fastest speed. The reason why they formed three teams… was because only three sacred followers knew how to teleport.
They established three gathering points before rapidly gathering other experts to those points.
And the point where the black-robed male was at was the core location. There were eight Void Gods stationed here, and even more Void Gods wanted to come here! Because following the ‘Sacred Emissary’ during a life and death situation would be the safest bet for them.
…
Night. In the skies of Golden Wing Nation.
Xue Ying was releasing the unseen ripple as he stood in the air. He was investigating all disturbances.
Suddenly, a figure tore through the void and entered into the region he was checking.
“Mn?” Xue Ying’s eyes brightened, “Void penetration?”
He immediately pursued after that person stealthily.
This figure tore through the void to reach an area before keeping his comrade into the Eden treasure. Following that, he continued rushing and brought along another comrade.
‘They are prepared to escape?’ Xue Ying could feel that something was amiss. Usually, the demons of devour class were selfish. They would not care about their comrades when they escaped.
‘They are gathering before escaping… Aren’t they afraid of being killed in one fell swoop?’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Or are they confident?’
Relying on the Plate Ripple Diagram, he followed behind them stealthily.
Very soon.
The other party entered a courtyard. The moment he came, he immediately let out the three Void Gods he saved. Checking through that courtyard, it made the eyelids of Xue Ying jump because there were a total of 15 ordinary Void Gods located inside this courtyard. There were even two Unity realm experts! There was also a large number of Rulers being locked in the cages.
“Mn?” As Xue Ying was checking, the mutated beast in the embrace of that black-robed violet-haired male looked up. It let out a ‘gu’ ear-piercing scream.
“Not good.” The black-robed male’s expression changed considerably.
He knew that a terrifying enemy was checking them in the dark. Being a Sacred Emissary, he did not notice that, which meant that this investigative method was too horrifying.
“Destroy the array and hurry off.” The black-robed male immediately ordered.
“Yes.”
“Hong~”
An eye-piercing black light suddenly shot up from within the courtyard into the sky. It directly charged into the enormous array located high above the Golden Wing Nation. But Xue Ying had already given orders to maintain the nation protection array at full force. For a moment, the black-robed male and the others could not directly break the array and escape. But with such a frightening disturbance, it had alarmed the entire Golden Wing Nation.
Not far away, the team led by ‘Deacon Jiu Qi’ discovered this location. He immediately tore through the void and arrived here. Just a blink of an eye later, they arrived.
“So many of them?” Deacon Jiu Qi was slightly excited. He did not have to scout for the enemies when a large group of Void Gods appeared below. These Void Gods did not hide their auras at all. Clearly, they wanted to team up to destroy the array.
“Kill!”
Deacon Jiu Qi ordered.
“Hong!”
He and the seven deacons behind him turned into an enormous, dazzling sword light that charged downwards.
“Celestial Water City team.” The black-robed male was currently leading his subordinates to break the array. After all, this nation protection array had been operating for many years in the Golden Wing Nation, and it was fortified many times over. With their current strength, it would take about eight to ten attacks before they could break through it. But who would have thought that the team from Celestial Water City would arrive so soon?
“Kill them first.” The eyes of the black-robed male immediately turned cold.
A dazzling black light clashed with the large sword light.
Xue Ying was instead watching in the dark using the Plate Ripple Diagram. His scouting method was able to deduce the power of the other party’s attack-he knew that it would not threaten the lives of Deacon Jiu Qi and the others. After all, Deacon Jiu Qi and the others had grasped hold of a coordination array which the Great Void Heaven Temple passed down. It was meant for combat and was formidable. Deacon Jiu Qi was at the Unity realm, and he was not someone easily beaten.
“Hong~”
The two forces clashed. For a moment, it swept across the surrounding, causing many walls to collapse. The cages also appeared by then. The cages were originally well-protected, and with Xue Ying’s help in the dark, the prisoners within were not injured. As for the place around the courtyard… they were also under the control of Xue Ying. He had easily utilized the ripples to push off the debris, preventing the shockwave from causing any collateral damage.
Deacon Jiu Qi and the other seven flew back into the sky. Their expressions were slightly ugly: “So powerful. It seems that they are slightly stronger than us.”
And on the other side, the black-robed male brought along the group of Void Gods behind. He also looked around him. The shockwaves from the battle had affected the surrounding of the courtyard, yet they were being controlled in the dark. This made that black-robed male feel the pressure. He knew that an expert was watching all these in the dark.
“Come out. You can’t deal with us just with your subordinates alone.” The black-robed male coldly laughed.
A white-robed Xue Ying appeared in the distant sky.
Deacon Jiu Qi and the other seven flew over and greeted respectfully: “Elder Dong Bo.”
The white-robed Xue Ying also looked downwards, “You dare to be so unbridled in the Golden Wing Nation? Such guts.”
The black-robed male heaved a sigh of relief after seeing this. He was able to determine that the white-robed teenager was merely at the Origin Birth realm, “You should likely be a certain Outer Hall Elder and must have cultivated some formidable scouting secret techniques from the Great Void Heaven Temple.”
He was not afraid of an Origin Birth expert.
“You all must have made a mistake.” The black-robed male laughed, “Those demons aren’t related to us. If I were really to devour the others wantonly, can the Golden Wing Nation hinder me?”
“It can’t hinder you indeed.” The white-robed Xue Ying nodded in the sky.
“Right. So you should not accuse me too.” The black-robed male said, “Why not let me leave? I am not willing to enter muddied waters.”
“Those demons should die. You all should die as well.” Xue Ying said.
The expression of that black-robed male changed. He muttered, “What, are we really going to continue fighting? I’m afraid the entire Golden Wing Nation will turn into ruins. It is likely most of your subordinates will die too.”
The entire place turned silent.
Deacon Jiu Qi and the others turned to Xue Ying as well.
They could see that this was not an ordinary team of demons. It should likely be from an organization. Furthermore, they had formed some conjectures after seeing those cages.
It’s merely that they closed an eye and opened another. Were they really going to continue fighting?
This time, they came thinking that they would only be dealing against ordinary demons who were not so strong. They would likely end up miserable if they were to continue fighting.
…
Within the cages, those who were fortunate to live were watching this. They saw that large group of Void Gods and the black-robed male. They also saw the white-robed young man with the eight Void Gods facing each other.
“Unless they are afraid of the Ancient Sacred Religion? Are they not going to act?” They felt anxious and did not dare to speak.
Because it was not right for existences at their level to comment about these things.
“Act.”
“Kill them.”
Those cultivators who were caged felt incredibly anxious. They knew that the calamity which the Golden Wing Nation was facing now all originated from this group of existences from the Ancient Sacred Religion.
…
“How about this, you guys can continue killing those demons, and we will leave?” The black-robed male said with a smile.
Xue Ying looked thoroughly over in the sky, “If I am not wrong, you should be from the Ancient Sacred Religion.”
The expression of that black-robed male changed.
The expressions of his subordinates behind also changed. Even Deacon Jiu Qi and the others felt their hearts tightening.
He actually said it out? Once he spoke about it, then there would be no room of salvaging the situation anymore.
“We have our rules at the Great Void Heaven Temple. All followers of the Ancient Sacred Religion must be killed without pardon.” The white-robed Xue Ying said. His mighty voice sounded across the heaven.
“Kill.” The black-robed male angrily howled. His subordinates also charged into the sky.
The white-robed Xue Ying looked downwards.
He pointed out.
“Shua shua shua…”
More than thousand strands of Termination Energy turned into violet fishes that leaped overwhelmingly towards the black-robed male and his subordinates.
Those cultivators who were caged looked upwards, watching as that white-robed teenager pointed out. After which, a vast number of violet fishes bringing a destructive aura engulfed around that group of experts from the Ancient Sacred Religion. They were all excitedly watching it and hoping for a miracle to happen.

chapters.title: Chapter 823 - Escaping without Trace
chapters.content:
Chapter 823: Escaping without Trace
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The black-robed male and his subordinates were looking in panic as more than a thousand violet fishes came towards them. “Shua shua shua”, it was like arrows arcing through the sky; it happened too fast. Even though those fishes had not reached them, these subordinates could feel their souls trembling. The gap in level was truly too big.
These fishes could kill Unity realm experts like cutting melons and vegetables, much less them.
“Ah.”
“No-”
“Sacred Master.”
All of them were in despair. The voluminous violet fishes passed through their bodies with sounds of ‘shua shua shua’. Imbued with the profound mysteries of Dao of Slaughter, those fishes easily destroyed their bodies. It was practically a single strike kill, and other than the black-robed male and the mutated beast in his embrace, the other subordinates had been exterminated into nothingness, leaving behind their weapons and some treasures.
The black-robed male could not help but feel the chill down his spine. He was so frightened that he immediately teleported: “He is just an Origin Birth realm Void God yet he is so strong?”
As he teleported, more than 100 violet fishes also immediately pursued after him via the void. “Pu pu pu pu”… The black-robed male did not have the time to dodge. As he teleported through the void, those violet fishes bombarded on his body, though a faint black layer appeared on him which stopped the incoming attacks.
The black-robed male could feel those violet fishes continuously bombarding outside his protective god light; he could not help but feel terror.
‘Fortunately, fortunately, elder brother gave me this protective treasure. Otherwise, I would have died previously.’ The face of that black-robed male was filled with ugliness. He appeared from the void, staring at the distant Xue Ying.
“Oh? He did not actually die?” The white-robed Xue Ying looked from afar. He was slightly shocked.
“Go, kill him!” The black-robed male threw out the mutated beast in his embrace. He was filled with savageness. His eyes were full of indignance. He had actually almost died!
After that mutated beast flew out, it let out an ear-piercing sound of ‘gu’. Its eyes were staring at Xue Ying, and one could see many strands of thunder clapping in the surrounding void. The power of these thunder had turned the hearts of Deacon Jiu Qi and the other experts cold. For it to display such power under the law suppression of the sacred world, this mutated beast was terrifying even amongst Unity realm experts.
And the white-robed Xue Ying was calmly watching these.
The mutated beast had a smooth body of black fur. Its four hooves suddenly stepped on the void and disappeared as it charged over.
“Stop.”
Xue Ying lightly commanded.
“Chi chi chi~”
Countless delicate strand ripples which the naked eyes could see tunneled into the void. At the same time, the dense violet fishes also disappeared into the void. At that moment, a mutated beast appeared from the void. It was being entangled by countless translucent thin ripple strands. Simultaneously, the dense violet fishes were frenziedly tunneling into its body; they were destroying its body. It tried its best to struggle out, causing many of the thin ripple strands to be destroyed. Nevertheless, more thin ripple strands were restricting it, preventing it from exerting its full strength against the incoming Termination Energy fishes. This resulted in more Termination Energy fishes tunneling into its body.
Under the group attack of more than a thousand violet fish, its struggle became weaker and weaker before it eventually stopped moving.
It had already turned into nothingness, leaving behind just a storage ring and several other remnant treasures.
‘Such a formidable mutated beast. It should be at the peak of the Unity realm.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘If I had not cultivated the “Plate Ripple Diagram”, I can defeat it only after engaging in close combat.’
The Plate Ripple Diagram was a cosmos ranked absolute art belonging to the Dao of Ripple.
It was unquestionably the strongest art in terms of domain aspect within Great Void Heaven Temple! Being the strongest domain absolute art added with Xue Ying’s ‘Fish Dragon Kill’ that he used to get through the third level of Star Pagoda, they were able to create a miraculous effect. And that peak Unity mutated beast had died just like that.
“Too terrifying. So this is Elder Dong Bo’s combat power?” Deacon Jiu Qi and the other deacons were all looking as the countless violet fishes tunneled into the mutated beast and causing it to disintegrate. They were able to determine the power of that mutated beast. When that mutated beast erupted with its strength, they felt a dense threat. And they knew that the strongest expert in this group of people from the Ancient Sacred Religion was that mutated beast.
But in the end?
Elder Dong Bo stood there without moving. He easily snuffed his enemy.
“Even if he were at the Origin Birth realm, Elder Dong Bo is still an Inner Hall Elder. It’ll likely be easy for him to kill us in a single breath of time.” Deacon Jiu Qi and the others were startled and admirable at the same time. Cultivators respected the strongest.
…
Amidst the ruins, within the many cages, the cultivators who were caged up were filled with resentment towards the Ancient Sacred Religion. But they knew that the group of experts from the Ancient Sacred Religion was very strong. Nevertheless, that white-robed young man who did not seem strong from his aura had actually pointed out, causing many fishes to engulf…
And all the experts from the Ancient Sacred Religion were killed.
Even that mutated beast which appeared after that-even though it seemed more terrifying than the Golden Wing Nation King-it was easily snuffed by that white-robed teenager.
This unfathomable strength made them sigh and excite. It was too overwhelming!
“No!” The black-robed male was stunned after seeing this.
This mutated beast had been sent by his elder brother to follow him. It might seem like a pet, but it was meant to protect him! Its strength was definitely at the peak of the Unity realm, and ordinary Unity realm experts would easily be devoured by this mutated beast with just a gulp. Of everyone he knew across the entire Celestial Water City, there was only ‘Elder Chun Wu’ who could easily kill this mutated beast.
When ‘Elder Qian Yu’ personally acted, the mutated beast was able to resist one or two moves.
But this white-robed teenager in front of their eyes was so terrifying despite being at the Origin Birth realm?
“He, he is an Inner Hall Elder of the Great Void Heaven Temple.” The black-robed male was able to make his guesses. Being so terrifying despite being an Origin Birth realm, he must definitely be an Inner Hall Elder!
Saying it was slow.
But it was a flash across the mind of the black-robed male. He then roared out, “Who are you?”
The white-robed Xue Ying looked at that black-robed male, seeing the black light on the surface of his body, “You should have some sort of protective talisman or item. But the moment its energy is depleted, it will no longer be able to protect you any longer.” With a thought, the dense amount of fishes went assaulting the black-robed male.
The black-robed male gritted his teeth after seeing this. He gave Xue Ying a brutal look.
“Weng!”
A terrifying spatial ripple swept him along.
“Sou!”
As that black-robed male teleported away, he was still filled with hatred as he glared at Xue Ying.
“Disappeared?” Xue Ying frowned. This spatial ripple had utterly disappeared. Furthermore, the location it vanished to was exceptionally distant. It far surpassed the region he could sense.
‘I actually let the biggest fish escape.’ Xue Ying was able to guess that being able to lead so many subordinates, this black-robed male should be at least a ‘Sacred Emissary’ of the Ancient Sacred Religion. But now, he actually escaped?
‘He has protective treasures, and also an escaping treasure. This isn’t an ordinary sacred emissary.’ Xue Ying felt slightly irritated. Killing a sacred emissary meant he would get some ‘contribution points’ as a reward. The higher the status of the sacred emissary, the higher the reward! Regardless of whether it was to exchange for treasures meant to aid in cultivation or to cultivate in the Palace Hall of Time, Xue Ying required a large number of contribution points.
But it’s a pity that he led a sacred emissary escape.
Nonetheless, he had no choice. His ‘Fish Dragon Kill’ could not even damage that protective god light of the other party, and the other party had escaped beyond his senses. This sort of sacred emissary should have high status with extremely formidable methods of surviving. Thus, killing him would be extremely tough.
“Hu.” Xue Ying descended. He waved his hand before keeping the treasures left behind by those dead Void Gods. At the same time, he turned around and ordered, “Deacon Jiu Qi, protect this place well. Forbid anyone from entering the ruined region. Wait until I am back for a thorough investigation.”
“Yes.” Deacon Jiu Qi respectfully acknowledged.
He knew that this was a matter that concerned the Ancient Sacred Religion and did not dare to be careless.
Xue Ying then looked towards the two other directions. The battles over at the other two places had not ended, though, though his side had already practically won the battle in one of the locations. Xue Ying’s figure flashed and he tunneled through the void.

chapters.title: Chapter 824 - Greetings Elder Dong Bo
chapters.content:
Chapter 824: Greetings Elder Dong Bo
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The members of the Ancient Sacred Religion were gathered in three different locations, of which the location where this black-robed man was at had the strongest experts. Nevertheless, they had been exterminated by Xue Ying. The other two locations contained weaker experts-there was not a single Unity realm expert in those two gathering points! Even though they a coordination array imparted by the Ancient Sacred Religion, the coordination array passed down by the Great Void Heaven Temple was not any weaker. Furthermore, the team from the Great Void Heaven Temple was stronger.
The reason why the battle lasted until now was because they had learned from the people who fought where Xue Ying was that the enemies were members of the Ancient Sacred Religion. Thus, they decided to capture the enemies alive!
“Hu—”
Xue Ying utilized his void maneuver, swiftly traveling from a point to another point of gathering.
Over there, the team from the Celestial Water City had besieged nine Void Gods from the Ancient Sacred Religion. But to capture them alive required a longer time.
“We can’t escape.”
“What should we do?”
“Let’s stake it all. If we can kill one, it’ll be one dead. For the sake of Sacred Master, we kill.” These Void Gods were turning crazy.
Xue Ying then stealthily appeared. He immediately unleashed the “Plate Ripple Diagram”. For a moment, many thin silk strands appeared from nothingness and entangled around all the Void Gods. Furthermore, these strands had permeated through and started sealing the souls of the enemies. Still, these Void Gods remained extremely vigilant. The moment they felt the energy entering their bodies, they actually decided to just suicide!
“Hong hong hong~”
Six out of the nine Void Gods did not hesitate to self-explode, causing a frightening force to engulf in all directions. The shockwave was suppressed by the ripples. The remaining three Void Gods that were slightly slower in reaction had been contained by Xue Ying with their souls sealed.
‘They are all madman.’ Xue Ying frowned after seeing this, ‘Those from the Ancient Sacred Religion and the Ancestor Mother Religion.’
Ancient Sacred Religion and Ancestor Mother Religion…
They had spread across all five great sacred worlds and the primal chaos void. These were two extremely frightening superpowers. Behind the back of the Ancient Sacred Religion was the strongest final realm existence, and also the one who occupied the Ancient Sacred World, ‘Sacred Master’. As for the Ancestor Mother Religion, it was straightforward to guess that they believed in Ancestor Mother who conquered the ‘Ancestor Mother World’ of the five great sacred worlds. These two religions were like two malignant tumors.
The moment one entered the religion and believed in either the Sacred Master or Ancestor Mother, they would be eternally loyal to them!
For instance, after entering the Ancient Sacred Religion, the follower would remain under control by the will of the Sacred Master. For the sake of the Sacred Master, the follower would be willing to die. Even if the other party were his or her true love or good friend, they would not hesitate to kill the other party for the Sacred Master! They would even unhesitantly suicide!
This was a truly lamentable matter.
Cultivators who had some slight ambition would not be willing to join the Ancient Sacred Religion or the Ancestor Mother Religion. Nevertheless, the methods of spreading religion by the Ancient Sacred Religion and Ancestor Mother Religion were too formidable.
The other three great sacred worlds did not hesitate at all—the moment someone discovered anyone from the Ancient Sacred Religion or the Ancestor Mother Religion, he or she must kill them! Naturally, the relationship of the cultivation system and the follower system was not good. For instance, the Ancient Cultivation system was spread across the world. Even the ‘Ancestor Mother Religion cultivation system’ would not influence other systems during the early stages. It was to the extent that the cultivator could even give up on cultivating the Ancestor Mother Religion and choose to cultivate other systems.
However, the moment one’s soul was imprinted with the Ancient Sacred imprint, or the Ancestor Mother imprint, that would be the end! Want to save them? It was possible. The operating laws had left behind a strand of survival opportunity. For instance, the Sacred Master could take the initiative to collect back the imprint or if an extremely heaven-shattering ancient cultivator utilized a method to ‘reverse time’ and alter the imprint!
Changing the past was a frightening matter, and one could usually only do minute adjusts! The affected area must be small as well, and the weaker the cultivators being affected, the better it would be.
Regardless, the moment one was branded with an imprint, it spelled doom for the other party. Even Cosmos Gods had a hard time saving them.
“Elder Dong Bo.”
The eight special emissaries from the Celestial Water City respectfully greeted.
“They are really prepared to suicide.” Xue Ying looked at the ruin below. He waved his hand and collected the treasures left behind by those who suicided. Even the three who had been captured alive were captured.
…
The battle at the final location had ended too.
Xue Ying and the others had already returned to the ruined courtyard where the black-robed male was previously. This was, after all, the core location of the enemy.
“Hmph.”
Xue Ying looked at the five Void Gods whom he had captured and sealed. The items they had were all taken away. Xue Ying immediately ordered, “Bring out five of the captured ones and all Void Gods who have been taken away previously and send them to Celestial Water City.”
“Yes.” The two Outer Hall Elders and 30 Deacons acknowledged.
Golden Wing Nation King added from the side, “This Ancient Sacred Religion actually dared to spread their religion in my Golden Wing Nation. Elder Dong Bo, may I ask if you have any orders? I’ll definitely do my best to accomplish them.”
Xue Ying gave him a look.
The Golden Wing Nation King felt his heart trembling.
Over this month, he had actually gradually known that it was the Ancient Sacred Religion which permeated into his nation. But he had pretended that he was unaware of this matter! The Ancient Sacred Religion and the Ancestor Mother Religion were two superpowers which could fight head-on against the other three great sacred worlds! Casually sending a claw or tooth could easily exterminate their Golden Wing Nation. How would he dare to intervene? As long as the Ancient Sacred Religion was not too rampant, he would act as if he did not see anything.
“Search through the area thoroughly. I want to see if I can find any further traces of this Ancient Sacred Religion.” Xue Ying ordered. He casually entered the closest courtyard. This was a courtyard located next to the base of the Ancient Sacred Religion and was naturally extravagant. But currently, the Golden Wing Nation King had temporarily arranged for the owner of the courtyard to temporarily leave the place and allow the special emissary team to rest there.
Xue Ying entered the house. He waved his hand before letting out all the treasures he had gotten from the Ancient Sacred Religion members. He then started refining them one by one, investigating through them in search for any clues.
‘I hope I can find some traces that will lead me to an important base of the Ancient Sacred Religion.’ Xue Ying thought.
This base at the Golden Wing Nation belonged to just a small scale base.
There must definitely be a more important base! As long as he finds it, he would have significantly contributed, and Xue Ying would definitely be earning more contribution points as a result! Having more treasures was always good.
…
Those caged cultivators were being released one by one. They were interrogated after that. These cultivators were relatively well-known in the Golden Wing Nation. Besides, they had suffered within the cages and were definitely worth trusting. After interrogating them, they were then released from their seals. Nevertheless, they could not temporarily leave. They had to stay within the royal palace of the Golden Wing Nation until all investigations had been done.
“Too formidable.”
“Even our king is wary towards that one who is called Elder Dong Bo.”
“He is so formidable that it feels terrifying. Shua shua shua, as those fishes flew over, so many Void Gods were just killed instantly.”
The cultivators who had been released were much more casual now. They could not go anywhere temporarily and were chatting to each other.
Of which there was a muscular male looking around at that moment. He had a trace of anxiety on his face: ‘Qing Ruo is not around! She should not have been captured.’
Because previously, the communication treasure has been taken away so he had no way of contacting her.
“Weng.”
Because the muscular male had regained his power after being released from the seal, he began utilizing his secret technique. Being a genius of the Golden Wing Nation, and his wife was someone much more dazzling than him. Other than tampering themselves, the two had met some miraculous opportunities before which allowed their souls to undergo a transformation. But at the same time, it generated a link between their souls.
He utilized a secret technique, and his soul was trying to sense the other party distantly.
“Not good.” The muscular man’s expression changed.
Relying on soul sensing…
He was able to detect that the soul of his wife was very far away from here. She was somewhere far away from the Golden Wing Nation and was even moving further at a breakneck speed. Moving at such a fast speed meant that she should be penetrating through the void… but his wife was a Ruler and could not travel through the void.
‘Unless…’ The muscular man had his guesses. He turned pale.
He immediately walked towards the two Outer Hall Elders who seemed to be leading that group of Void Gods from the Celestial Water City. He then respectfully mentioned to one of them, “Senior, I would like to see Elder Dong Bo.”
“You want to see Elder Dong Bo?” The two Outer Hall Elders looked towards this muscular male who had just been saved, “Not anyone is qualified to see Elder Dong Bo.”
What a joke.
That was an Inner Hall Elder from the Great Void Heaven Temple! He had a high status even across the five great sacred worlds. Even Primal Chaos realm giants attached importance to them.
“It’s related to the Ancient Sacred Religion.” The muscular male transmitted.
The two Outer Hall Elders looked towards each other.
“I’ll bring him over to see Elder Dong bo. You, come with me!” The Outer Hall Elder who had a jade horn on his head said. He brought the muscular male rapidly towards where Xue Ying was. He was not worried since a True God Ruler without any treasures would not threaten them at all.
Within a nearby courtyard.
Within the hall.
The white-robed Xue Yin was seated by the side. There were many materials placed right in front of him at this moment. The articles were floating off the ground. Xue Ying was thoroughly checking through the items, yet he frowned. It seemed that he could not find any leads! The base where the Ancient Sacred Religion intruded in was kept extraordinarily secretive, and it was not easily leaked.
“Mn?” Xue Ying looked up outside the hall. Currently, the lone horned Outer Hall Elder was bringing a muscular male over.
That muscular male directly stated, “Elder Dong Bo, I know where that leader ‘black-robed man’ of the Ancient Sacred Religion is!”
Xue Ying’s eyes brightened.

chapters.title: Chapter 825 - The Chase
chapters.content:
Chapter 825: The Chase
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The single-horned Outer Hall Elder looked towards that muscular male with slight dissatisfaction. This little Ruler had just spoken when he had not.
“Reporting to Elder Dong Bo, he is called Lei Chen and is one of the cultivators captured and caged here by the Ancient Sacred Religion. He is one of the more famous geniuses in Golden Wing Nation. It is said that his wife has a higher cultivation talent than he.” The single-horned Outer Hall Elder respectfully mentioned. Previously, he was in charge of investigating the people. His memory was perfect so he could remember everything clearly.
Xue Ying nodded. He looked at this relatively muscular True God Ruler.
A cultivation genius?
His wife had an innate talent beyond his?
“You know where that Sacred Emissary from the Ancient Sacred Religion went?” Xue Ying asked, “Are you certain? He is currently fleeing in dread, and it is likely that other than him, nobody will be able to ascertain where he will be heading.”
“I am more than 90% sure!” The muscular male Lei Chen said.
“Elaborate.” Xue Ying added.
As Lei Chen faced the white-robed male, he could not help but feel a strand of nervousness and anxiety. He was clear that with his current strength, it was impossible for him to save his wife! And the Ancient Sacred Religion… was rumored to have some connections with the Sacred Master who was so high up in the Ancient Sacred World. In front of such huge and horrifying giant, he was a mere ant. Much less he, even Golden Wing Nation King who was a thousand and 10,000 times stronger was an ant to the Sacred Master as well!
And this white-robed young man in front of him had a really high status. He was an expert from the holy ground Great Void Heaven Temple! Even other special emissaries from the Celestial Water City and the Golden Wing Nation King had to be very respectful to him. Only he had the capabilities to save his wife!
Thus, Lei Chen would not let this opportunity go.
For the sake of rescuing his wife, he would not hesitate to do anything!
“Elder Dong Bo.” Lei Chen respectfully said, “My wife Qing Ruo and I have cultivated step by step until now. We have also experienced many dangers, and have encountered miraculous encounters too! We once experienced an encounter that transformed both our souls. Since then, we are able to sense each other’s soul. If we were to employ a secret technique and focus on sensing the other party, we are able to perceive each other even if we are far apart. Ever since I’ve been saved by Elder Dong Bo from the Ancient Sacred Religion, I was able to use my secret technique in finding out where my wife is. That was when I discovered that my wife is very far away from the Golden Wing Nation! Furthermore, she is traveling at an extremely fast speed. With such a fast speed, the party should be penetrating through the void! Qing Ruo is only a Ruler and could not teleport. Thus, there must be an expert bringing her away.”
“Are there anyone from the Golden Wing Nation who would bring her away and can teleport? Furthermore, she is very far away from the Golden Wing Nation.” Lei Chen continued, “I can only think of a single possibility! After I was captured, given that my wife Qing Ruo has talent beyond mine and is famous in the Golden Wing Nation, it is unlikely that the Ancient Sacred Religion would let her go. She should have been captured. Furthermore, that Sacred Emissary should value my wife greatly that she was kept in his Eden treasure.”
Lei Chen finished speaking before turning to Xue Ying.
He was nervous.
Would the other party save her? Everything would be decided by this Elder Dong Bo from the Great Void Heaven Temple.
Would he agree? Would he face the possible danger and save her? Would Elder Dong Bo be willing to take the risk?
“Very far away from the Golden Wing Nation, void penetration…” Xue Ying was deliberating over it.
In the entire Golden WIng Nation, the number of people who could teleport count be counted with one’s fingers! The others had either died or were still within Golden Wing Nation. Only the black-robed male escaped!
It was impossible to appear at a location very far away from the Golden Wing Nation if one were to penetrate through the void because Xue Ying personally spent a month trying to rush over from B29 City! That black-robed male displayed a long-distance void teleportation escaping technique, which was in accordance with this deduction.
Furthermore, when Lei Chen sensed the other party, the other party was still moving!
Besides…
The Ancient Sacred Religion emphasized those who were strong or those with extremely high potential. They wanted to make these parties believe in the Ancient Sacred Religion! Thus, that Sacred Emissary had captured the incredibly talented ‘Qing Ruo’ and personally tried to control her. This was typical.
“Oh?” Xue Ying looked at Lei Chen with a chuckle, “How do I know what you are saying is real?”
“Everything I said is true.” Lei Chen felt anxious, “Elder Dong Bo, I…”
His original anxious and surging expression suddenly transformed.
Because Xue Ying had stealthily brought Lei Chen’s soul into an illusory realm. Xue Ying had long grasped hold of the ‘Mirage Law System’. Furthermore, he had reached really high attainments in this aspect. Even some of the slightly weaker Void God level void creatures would fall for this technique, much less Lei Chen who was just a Ruler.
“Let me ask you. Your and your wife…” Xue Ying continued speaking.
The single-horned Outer Hall Elder felt puzzled. But following that, he discovered startingly that this Ruler called Lei Chen was replying continuously in an apathetic manner.
After a while, Lei Chen discovered a jolt on his soul. He was completely awake now. But as Lei Chen thought back, he realized that everything which happened previously appeared really vague and hazy in his mind. He looked towards this white-robed teenager with shock. Lei Chen was not too clear about what happened earlier, but he was clear-this white-robed young man must have done something. But for the sake of saving his wife, he did not feel resentment at all.
“Alright. You can refine an avatar. After refining one, we will set off immediately.” The white-robed Xue Ying said.
“No need. We must make full use of the time.” Lei Chen said impatiently.
“We will need time to travel over, and this little bit of time isn’t worth mentioning.” Xue Ying frowned and said displeasedly, “Go.”
Lei Chen could only acknowledge and withdraw despite his anxiety.
Following that, he soon gave birth to a fleshy embryo. He split his soul into two. Furthermore, under a time-accelerated environment, he soon came over half an hour later under the guidance of the lone horned Outer Hall Elder to where Xue Ying was.
“I am going to track after the Ancient Sacred Religion.” Xue Ying looked at the single-horned Outer Hall Elder and ordered, “You guys will be in charge of cleaning up this matter. I’ll directly return to the Celestial Water City after this.”
“Yes.” The single-horned Outer Hall Elder might be slightly worried, but he did not dare retort; he accepted the orders.
“We will leave now.”
Xue Ying brought Lei Chen and set off that night.
In the sacred world, the moon was hanging high up in the night sky. Xue Ying brought along Lei Chen as they rushed over Golden Wing Nation. The city of Golden Wing Nation was still being protected by the nation protection array.
“Which direction did that black-robed Sacred Emissary go? And how far is it approximately?” Xue Ying asked.
“Reporting to Elder Dong Bo.” Lei Chen waved his hand before bringing a huge map out in front. This map marked out a region. He said in a low voice, “Because it is too far away, I cannot really sense where the other party is. I can only confirm approximately where he is.”
“Your location is too vague.” Xue Ying shook his head. That region was too big.
But Xue Ying was slightly stunned.
He was stunned over the fact that he black-robed Sacred Emissary could teleport so far away!
‘His protection teleportation treasure seems to be more effective than the teleportation talisman which we get as golden-robed disciples of the Great Void Heaven Temple.’ Xue Ying thought.
“As long as we get closer, I’ll be able to get a clearer positioning.” Lei Chen replied.
“Let’s go.”
Xue Ying brought him along as they maneuvered through the void.
Even though he still kept the teleportation talisman which he got as a golden-robed disciple with him, the destination location was too far away, and the application of the laws and profound mysteries was way beyond what he could control. Most likely, it should be refined by a Primal Chaos realm giant or Forefather Tian Yu himself. There was also powerful energy inside it, and the moment it was consumed, the energy of the talisman would have to be replenished.
Even though he had another treasure which was better at long-range traveling, he would not use it during the non-critical moments.
After all, his goal now was pursuing the black-robed Sacred Emissary and to find the important base of the Ancient Sacred Religion!
…
They were pursuing after the Sacred Emissary.
Other than using that teleportation treasure at the start, the black-robed Sacred Emissary was just tearing through the void after that. Being a powerful cultivator, he did not care much about the flow of time.
He had even spent about over 600 years, skipping the closest B29 City and deliberately proceeded to the relatively further ‘A29 City’.
The protectors of the A29 City did not know that this black-robed male was part of the Ancient Sacred Religion. Hence, he was able to enter without being stopped.
Xue Ying was afraid of mishaps happening, and he was forced to use the teleportation treasure all the way to A29 City.
…
Using the teleportation array across cities, the black-robed male eventually arrived at A35 City. The final journey through the void lasted 19 years in total.
“I’m here finally.” The black-robed Sacred Emissary looked towards the black city which did not seem remarkable. The entire city occupied an area of just 50,000 kilometers. It did not seem like a small superpower! But in reality, this was a relatively significant base of the Ancient Sacred Religion.
“This time, my subordinates have all died.” The black-robed Sacred Emissary felt slightly annoyed, “Initially, I thought that I would be able to promote to an upper-ranked Sacred Emissary after completing so many missions, yet who would have thought that all my subordinates have died this time. It seems that I will have to wait even longer for that promotion to happen.”
The Ancient Sacred Religion had a very strict hierarchy.
It was extremely difficult to even get promoted by one rank.
“That person called Elder Dong Bo?” The eyes of the black-robed Sacred Emissary were filled with fury. But he knew too that even though the ‘Ancient Sacred World’ superpower was stronger than the Great Void Heaven Temple, this was a territory under the Great Void Heaven Temple! If he really wanted to battle, it was impossible for him to defeat Elder Dong Bo. He could only endure.
“Sou.”
The black-robed Sacred Emissary turned into a stream of light as he entered that black city.
After the time taken to brew a cup of tea, two figures appeared in the dark sky. They were Xue Ying and Lei Chen.
‘After chasing after him for more than 600 years. I’ve finally discovered this place.’ Xue Ying revealed a grin as he looked at the distant black city.

chapters.title: Chapter 826 - Revealed
chapters.content:
Chapter 826: Revealed
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying knew that the Ancient Sacred Religion had a total of 90 bases within the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. The Great Void Heaven Temple occupied one-third the entire Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. Based on this calculation, the Ancient Sacred Religion had roughly about 30 bases within the territory under the Great Void Heaven Temple. These bases were usually equally essential and had direct connections with Ancient Sacred World.
Often, members of a base would have practically no knowledge of the other bases.
That was why the uncovering of one base would not cause the destruction and revealing of other bases. But given that there were only 30 bases in the territory of Great Void Heaven Temple, the discovery and eradication of one base was still counted as a great contribution!
Xue Ying looked at Lei Chen beside him: ‘It was all due to him and his soul connection with his wife that enabled us to locate their base.’
“Elder Dong Bo, please help me save my wife. I can feel that the soul of my wife is still sealed. Thus, it is unlikely for her to have pledge her allegiance to the religion.” Lei Chen requested.
Xue Ying agreed. Since the black-robed Sacred Emissary was still on the run, he would not have the time to forcefully control his prisoner.
“We will be acting soon. It is best if you stay inside my Eden treasure.” As Xue Ying spoke, he waved his hand and collected Lei Chen. Lei Chen did not resist and obediently entered the Eden treasure. At this moment, he could only wait and hope for Elder Dong Bo to save his wife. He was ultimately too weak, and all he could do was to point out the direction.
After Xue Ying collected Lei Chen into his Eden treasure, he turned back at the black city.
******
Inside the black city, in a dark hall, a man and a woman were sitting opposite each other. They were not ordinary humans. The cold male was covered in a layer of frost armor, and his face was covered with white scales. The woman had six arms and was enchanting in nature. Both of their auras permeated and enveloped the entire hall.
“Sacred Emissary Chi Yun will arrive shortly.” The cold male was holding a wine glass with amber colored wine inside. The aroma from the wind had long diffused to the surrounding.
“This time, Sacred Emissary Chi Yun is really miserable.” The eyes of the six-armed enchantress contained a flow of lightning, “He painstakingly led his subordinates to spread the religion. His elder brother also lent him a beast to help him. Over this long period, he had contributed greatly, allowing him to quickly rise and become a Sacred Emissary. It’s a pity that he met with such a setback this time that caused him almost all of his subordinates! It was fine even if the mutated beast died since it did not belong to him originally, but to lose so many followers who were groomed according to the religious standard would cost him greatly. His contribution this time will surely be reduced to compensate that. In the end, it might just result in the loss of his current position. Perhaps he might need more time and help from his brother if he wanted to become a High Sacred Emissary again.”
“Don’t be such a schadenfreude. He is ultimately still the little brother of Saint Wang Ming.” The cold male warned.
“Hmph hmph.” The six-armed enchantress giggled.
The rules of the Ancient Sacred Religion were stringent.
If one wanted to become a High Sacred Emissary, he would have to be at the peak of the Unity realm! It was also possible for the cultivator to become one by contributing enough to the religion!
Though the black-robed man was weak, he had the help of his elder brother. Adding several capable subordinates, he was able to contribute plenty to the religion, allowing him to be just a step away from becoming a High Sacred Emissary. Furthermore, with the help of his elder brother, he would be able to secure many benefits and obtain a greater power after he became a High Sacred Emissary.
Though they felt envious, the cold male and the six-armed enchantress could only watch as things happened. They did not dare to scheme against him. They could only watch with their eyes open as the black-robed man continued piling up more contribution for the religion. Now that the other party had met with such a setback, they couldn’t help but feel happy in their hearts.
But they could be delighted inwardly.
They did not dare to show it openly.
Saint Wang Ming… why was he a Saint? In the Ancient Sacred Religion, only those who could transcend realms and fight against Primal Chaos experts as a Unity realm expert were entitled to be called a Saint. Using the Star Pagoda as a form of standard, one would require to pass the sixth level of Star Pagoda before they could be called a saint! But this was very difficult since there were no Unity realm experts even in the Great Void Heaven Temple-well-known for having experts that could fight against those on a higher realm-who had actually crossed through the sixth level Star Pagoda.
But for a Unity realm expert to compete even against the weakest primal Chaos giant was something unfathomable.
“Hu.”
A figure flew out from afar into the hall. It was precisely the black-robed man they were talking about. This made their expression unsightly. The cold male and the six-armed woman quickly got up to welcome him.
“Brother Chi Yun.” The cold male said with a pained expression on his white-scaled face, “How could you be so unlucky? You are just so close to becoming a High Sacred Emissary, yet all these happened.”
The six-armed woman chirped in, “Brother Chi Yun, don’t be so anxious. Although you have suffered a great loss this time, losing much of your contribution to the religion, we should take it easy. This sister will definitely do my best to help you.”
Although the two of them were grinning at the misfortune of the other party, they had to wholeheartedly assist this black-robed man at this current moment.
“Damn that Elder Dong Bo.” The black-robed man directly sat down. He took the flask beside him and started drinking. After thoroughly venting his feelings by drinking, he forcefully placed the flask down. With a ‘peng’, the flask smashed on the table. He gritted his teeth, “It is all because of this Elder Dong Bo that destroyed my affair. I have just started my operation a month in when he actually arrived!”
The cold male who sat nearby added, “I have already investigated this matter. Inside our internal system, this Elder Dong Bo is also called Dong Bo Xue Ying! It is said that he is an unparalleled talent, and has originated from a certain cosmos in the primal chaos void. He was able to become a golden-robed disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple when he was still in the cosmos. The report also mentioned that both Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster originated from the same cosmos.”
“Ancestor Devil, SwordMaster?” The black-robed man snorted inwardly.
Ancestor Devil was a hall master of the Great Void Heaven Temple.
Swordmaster… was even a final realm existence.
“Furthermore, it has not been 100 million years since he arrived at the Great Void Heaven Temple before he was able to become a Void God and passed through the third level of the Star Pagoda, becoming an Inner Hall Elder as a result.” The cold male said helplessly, “As an Origin Birth realm Inner Hall Elder, the Great Void Heaven Temple will definitely treasure him! This is also the territory of the Great Void Heaven Temple, and it is impossible for us to defeat him. During crucial moments, Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster, these two final realm existences could simply send their incarnations down.”
The black-robed male was becoming even more frustrated. He knew that given his strength, it was impossible for him to confront Xue Ying. Even the people behind his back could not compete with those behind Xue Ying.
Although the Ancient Sacred Religion was strong, this as ultimately the territory belonging to the Great Void Heaven Temple. They could only develop secretly under the surface without being able to confront openly.
Flustered and angered, there was nothing he could do but to endure and keep his indignance within himself!
‘Let us wait and see. There will be a day…’ The black-robed man silently vowed. Although he was howling and shouting deep in his heart, he could not express it since it would incur the ridicule of his companions. Even he knew that the chances of his revenge succeeding were almost zilch.
“Brother Chi Yun, just rest and take it easy. The matter regarding spreading religion isn’t urgent at all.” The cold male said.
That black-robed male nodded.
He also needed to contact his elder brother. Since the mutated beast died, he had no other capable subordinates. If he only relied on those sacred disciples… it would be hard for him to progress quickly. Only when he had an adequate and powerful expert could the speed of conducting his mission of spreading religion be much faster.
“Come, accompany me to a drink.” The black-robed Chi Yun said.
“Alright.”
“Here, this sister has plenty of good wine.” The two of them were clearly the two highest existences in this base-High Sacred Emissaries-but they had to remain polite in front of this lower-ranked Sacred Emissary; they did not dare to offend him at all.
They had only started drinking for a short moment. when the expression of the six-armed woman changed. She transmitted, “Be careful, the warning array has detected a Void God and a True God Ruler outside the city. They are currently watching over this city in the dark. Oh, that True God Ruler had gone into the Eden treasure of that Void God. Judging from his appearance… he should be Elder Dong Bo whom we previously investigated.”
“Elder Dong Bo? That Origin Birth Realm Inner Hall Elder?” The expression of the cold male changed, though there was killing intent which abruptly burst forth from his eyes.
Although Xue Ying remained highly vigilant, he had too little interactions with the Ancient Sacred Religion. This was ultimately the strongest superpower across the five great sacred worlds! The Sacred Master was someone who was enemy with practically almost all other final realm existences! During the moment he arrived, the warning array of this black city had already detected him.

chapters.title: Chapter 827 - Crush
chapters.content:
Chapter 827: Crush
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The expressions on both the six-armed girl and cold male were unpleasant; they were looking at the black-robed male with indignance.
“Our base is essential. There are only 90 bases across the entire Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, and they are crucial for us to spread our religion.” The cold male said solemnly, “Now that the Inner Hall Elder from the Great Void Heaven Temple is here, it is highly likely that this base has been revealed. What we can do now is to reduce our losses.”
The black-robed male gritted his teeth. He transmitted back in a low voice, “This is unrelated to me!”
He wanted to push away all responsibility at the first instance.
The six-armed girl and cold male gave him a glance. They did not say anything because the final punishment… would be judged fairly by the higher-ups from the Ancient Sacred Religion! The black-robed male ‘Sacred Emissary Chi Yun’ was spreading the religion in the Golden Wing Nation and had offended the Inner Hall Elder Xue Ying from the Great Void Heaven Temple. Sacred Emissary Chi Yun then escaped all the way to this base, leading Xue Ying along the way here!
Anyone who wasn’t a fool could guess that Xue Ying must have pursued behind in the dark. Maybe he had left some sort of tracking imprint on Sacred Emissary Chi Yun.
“Immediately lead other Sacred Emissaries to the underground sacred palace hall.” The cold male ordered, “Use your fastest speed to move the Sacred Master sculpture away. After bringing it away successfully, immediately teleport away after that.”
“Yes.” The six-armed girl and black-robed male, Sacred Emissary Chi Yun, acknowledged.
Why did they only have just 90 bases in such a vast area within the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World?
Precisely because every single base required a ‘Sacred Master sculpture’. It was meant for communicating with the distant Ancient Sacred World and to control the cultivators. These actions required the aid of the ‘Sacred Master sculpture’.
Just like in the Golden Wing Nation, the controlling method done on the cultivators was of a lower level-it could only control the weaker cultivators, and most True God Rulers could resist against it!
But once the cultivator was sent to the Sacred Master sculpture…
Relying on this sculpture, even those with powerful spirit amongst True God Rulers, Origin Birth experts, and even the slightly weaker Unity experts would be forcibly controlled! By marking an imprint on their souls, these cultivators would remain absolutely loyal to the Sacred Master.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying might be here, but he might not be certain that this place is where our base is.” The cold male said, “I’ll handle him and try to delay for as much time as possible.”
“If you can kill him, that’ll be great too.” The black-robed male Sacred Emissary Chi Yun said.
“Killing an Inner Hall Elder? Their survival capabilities are too formidable.” The cold male felt genuinely incensed in his heart. Even if they successfully bring the Sacred Master sculpture away, they had to give up this base. The Ancient Sacred Religion would unquestionably punish them! Nevertheless, if they could not even secure the Sacred Master sculpture, then the punishments would be even direr.
“Sou!”
The cold male immediately flew out of the dark palace hall.
The six-armed girl and black-robed male, Sacred Emissary Chi Yun, were also moving. They transmitted to other sacred emissaries for them to proceed towards the underground sacred palace hall, and to use the fastest speed in moving the Sacred Master sculpture away.
…
A white-robed Xue Ying stood in the air. He was looking at this black city. He directly employed the Plate Ripple Diagram, spreading unseen ripples over the place. Nevertheless, the black city contained arrays that prevented it from permeating in.
“Who dares to trespass my Black Mountain City.” A figure flew out. He was none other than that cold male. He was emitting a majestic aura that caused icy snowflakes to fly in the surrounding void. This cold male frowned and shouted, “Who are you?”
The white-robed Xue Ying was too lazy to reply. He knew the other party was delaying for time.
Xue Ying was clear that the most important object in the base of the Ancient Sacred Religion was the Sacred Master sculpture. It required them time to move the sculpture away, though this period was not long.
“Hong.”
Xue Ying extended his hand, causing a talisman to appear. It was the talisman that an Inner Hall Elder could get. This talisman emitted a horrifying aura, and it had even formed a towering and huge dazzling palace hall illusion behind Xue Ying. The aura of this illusion was filled with suppression, and it could match the aura of Primal Chaos realm experts.
This was precisely the illusion of the Great Void Heaven Temple! It could not be forged!
“I am an Inner Hall Elder from the Great Void Heaven Temple.” Xue Ying shouted out, “Hurry up and disable the array of your Black Mountain City. If you dare resist, you are offending my Great Void Heaven Temple. All of you will be treated as part of the Ancient Sacred Religion, and all will be killed without pardon!”
“Inner Hall Elder of the Great Void Heaven Temple?” The cold male paled after seeing it. He replied with reverence and panic, “This Sir Elder, I have been staying here for a long time, why would this Sir Elder…”
“Stop your nonsense.”
Xue Ying frowned. He was like a sword edge currently. Xue Ying was preventing this cold male from delaying for more time, “Disable you array now.”
“I am refining an important treasure, and have spent long time and effort trying to do so. Why not…” The cold male was still trying to dawdle.
“Kill!”
Xue Ying’s eyes flashed with coldness.
Even though he was not entirely certain that this black city was an important base of the Ancient Sacred Religion, he was 70-80% certain. Furthermore, that black-robed male had entered the place as he was escaping. Right now, even after flashing his identity to the other party, he was not willing to let him in! That meant that something was wrong.
“Xiu xiu xiu~” Following the shout, a total of 300 violet fishes went flying out from the surface of Xue Ying. They targeted at the cold male. At the same time, many thin transparent ripple strands had entangled around that cold male. The cold male shouted out, “Sir Elder, I am really refining an important treasure. My incarnation is currently in front of the furnace and cannot be disturbed.”
Even though he was shouting out, the cold male had begun resisting against the attack. A crystalline armor condensed on his body, and at the same time, an icy sword appeared in his hand.
Even though his body was entangled by countless ripples, he was able to brandish his sword out.
“Shua.”
Space began to freeze. It started restricting and influencing the surrounding thin ripple strands. It also influenced the Termination Energy that was flying over, greatly diminishing the speed of the incoming Termination Energy. At the same time, the dazzling sword light directly clashed against those Termination Energy.
The 300 violet fishes were just like a school of fish charging forward. They clashed against that ice sword’s sword light within that moment. The Termination Energy which had originally become really slow in speed had been destroyed by the sword light.
But there were still four violet fishes that surged in power.
“Xiu! Xiu! Xiu! Xiu!”
They were like four God Dragons that arced through the sky towards the cold male. The cold male might have been entangled by the thin ripple strands, causing his speed to be significantly impacted, but his heaven-shaking strength enabled him to brazenly brandish the ice sword in his hand to parry against the four fearsome God Dragon-like Termination Energy. These four strands of Termination Energy had precisely displayed the third sword from the “13 Apocalyptic Swords”!
