This was also the reason why there were only 300 fishes. Because if he unleashed too much Termination Energy, it would be an enormous burden on his heart energy. He would not be able to fuse the Apocalyptic Third Sword into the technique.
“Peng peng peng peng.”
The icy cold sword light was refracted time after time.
The sword light coming from the cold male was truly strange. It was actually able to parry against the incoming strike from the four strands of Termination Energy. Even though the other fishes had also charged towards him, they could not break the icy armor he had. They had merely affected his speed. Even after being struck by one occasional ‘Apocalyptic Third Sword’, it had merely caused a hole to form on his body.
Suddenly, the fishes all disappeared.
There were only four God Dragon-like Termination Energy strand which attacked fiercely. And the distant Xue Ying also disappeared
“Shua!”
Xue Ying immediately appeared by the side of the cold male. He sent a fierce strike with his spear out.
“Teleport?” The cold male sneered inwardly. Without the influence of the fishes, and under the circumstance of still parrying against the four strands of Termination Energy, he was still able to repel against the spear from Xue Ying with a flash of his sword.
“Hong~”
At that moment when he parried against the attack, another spear came out from the void! It was too sudden. The cold male who had previously tried his best to parry against the spear and to deal with the four strands of Termination Energy did not have time to react against this spear that appeared so close to him. Nevertheless, the cold male remained calm as he let his body handle the attack because he had once survived against the Apocalyptic Third Sword strike formed using the Termination Energy.
“Hong~” The spear pierced through the cold male body, causing his expression to change abruptly.
He was wrong.
He was totally wrong!
This spear was an upper graded Void God weapon! The spearhead was imbued with Termination Energy! Xue Ying had utterly instilled the strength from the 28th level of Walker’s Hidden Secret into this spear while displaying the skill of the Apocalyptic Third Sword as well… It was so much stronger than a standard Apocalyptic Third Sword manifested using the Termination Energy. His body was ripped entirely, and the destructive energy engulfed his entire body.
“Peng peng peng~” As the body of the other party was being ripped at this moment, Xue Ying released yet another strand of Termination Energy onto his spear. Countless Termination Energy fishes were also frantically destroying the body of the other party. In the next moment, Xue Ying sent out three spears as fast as lightning.
After the third spear was sent out, the body of that cold male shattered and dissipated. As he died, there was still a look of disbelief and despair on his face.
He did not dare believe that he would lose to an Origin Birth realm Void God. Even if the other party were an Inner Hall Elder from the Great Void Heaven Temple, he was still at the Origin Birth realm.
“Hmph.” Xue Ying coldly looked at this. Even without cultivating the Plate Ripple Diagram, he could get through the third level of Star Pagoda. And now, with the Plate Ripple Diagram restricting the other party during the battle, the other party could only display part of his strength. Thus, it was normal for the other party to die.
…
Saying it was slow, but in reality, the battle between Xue Ying and the cold male happened exceptionally quickly. First, it was a group attack, followed by close combat. Not even a breath had passed when the other party died in battle.
“Not good.” The expression of the six-armed girl who was within the sacred palace hall underneath the black city changed abruptly. She relied on the monitoring array to ‘see’ that the cold male had already died in battle!

chapters.title: Chapter 828 - Unplugging the Cork of the Black Gourd
chapters.content:
Chapter 828: Unplugging the Cork of the Black Gourd
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
There was a huge palace within the underground sacred palace hall.
A towering sculpture was located at the center of the hall. There were many other sculpture illusions around it and on the hall walls-a total of eight sculpture illusions. As long as one entered the underground sacred palace hall, he would be surrounded by towering sculpture illusions. He would feel an unseen energy which pervaded the entire place too.
At this moment, a total of ten sacred emissaries were gathered. They were currently dismantling the whole sacred palace hall with their fastest speed!
For the sake of allowing the Sacred Master sculpture display sufficient power to control stronger cultivators, they had to construct the sacred palace hall together with the sculpture as one entity. As a result, they had to dismantle the whole thing now or they could not bring the Sacred Master sculpture away.
“The Great City Master is dead?”
These sacred emissaries were all slightly startled. It happened too fast. The death of the Great City Master happened too quickly.
The black-robed male Sacred Emissary Chi Yun looked towards the six-armed girl by the side, coldly snorting, ‘If you went to deal with that Dong Bo Xue Ying from the Great Void Heaven Temple, we would not have been defeated so quickly.”
The six-armed girl was genuinely furious now.
She had always been tolerating how he behaved for a long time in the past. This time, it was because of Sacred Emissary Chi Yun that this base was revealed. Now, he was still blaming herself for not engaging with the enemy?
“You fool, if I were to go battle as well, any idiot would be able to guess that this is an important location due to the appearance of two peak Unity realm experts.” The six-armed girl angrily shouted out. If just a single expert went out, they could still explain the fact that he was just an expert living in seclusion here. But if there were two peak Unity realm experts… when was it that Unity realm experts were so commonly seen?
“You dare!” The black-robed male Sacred Emissary Chi Yun angrily shouted back.
“Stop with your nonsense. Hurry up and bring this Sacred Master sculpture away!” The six-armed girl angrily shouted back. She no longer bothered to hide her emotions.
Because the death of her comrade was too fast and he did not secure them much time. This made the six-armed girl vaguely understand… that the possibility of moving the Sacred Master sculpture away was really low. Even if she could escape alive, the destruction of the base and the loss of the Sacred Master sculpture meant that the punishment from the Ancient Sacred Religion would be worse than death. She would have to live through even more tragic days.
And her soul that pledged eternal loyalty, it was impossible for her to ever leave the Ancient Sacred Religion. Despite being in despair, she was willing to receive the punishment.
Nevertheless, she only had anger towards ‘Sacred Emissary Chi Yun’!
“Quick quick quick!”
The six-armed girl angrily shouted out. She had a fierce expression on her.
All the sacred emissaries were trying their best to dismantle this place. They had even formed incarnations to carry out this. Nevertheless, the construct of the sacred palace hall was too complicated, and Unity realm experts could barely have the abilities to dismantle it. Furthermore, they required some time to do so.
“Block him. We must delay for more time. I hope that he is greedy and had not reported to the Great Void Heaven Temple.” The six-armed girl hoped for it.
…
In the night sky.
“Treasure spirit, are you able to discover what is happening now within the black city?” Xue Ying asked.
“Impossible. There is an unseen ripple obstructing me from scouting.” The Black Gourd treasure spirit’s scouting methods were extremely formidable, but it was helpless when facing this important base of the Ancient Sacred Religion.
Xue Ying kept the treasures left behind by the cold male. He did not hesitate to release his full force in attacking the place. “Hong hong hong~” One could see many dense violet fishes directly attacking the same point. Ripples immediately formed on the black city. Many hidden arrays were revealed as they withstood against the attack by the violet fishes.
“Hong.” Xue Ying also displayed his spear techniques. Under the attack from the violet spear, it could only make the ripples fluctuate on the array. He was unable to destroy it.
‘The defenses are quite formidable.’ Xue Ying frowned.
‘I’ll use my final killing technique. If everything fails, I can only report upwards.’
He was not fully confident himself since he could not see what was happening inside. Thus, Xue Ying was not too willing to report upwards.
But the base of Ancient Sacred Religion was quite important. The Great Void Heaven Temple would reward him with a million contribution points just by destroying it! It was equivalent to 100 pieces of Origin World Rocks. It was said that the Ancient Sacred Religion had to pay a price ten times that of ‘100 Origin World Rocks’ for the sake of constructing a base. It was said that the most precious object was that Sacred Master sculpture.
Xue Ying flipped his hand, causing a Black Gourd to appear.
******
Within the underground sacred palace hall.
The six-armed girl might be swiftly dismantling the sacred palace hall, but she was also multi-tasking by relying on the monitoring array to check what was happening in the outer world. That Origin Birth realm Inner Hall Elder ‘Xue Ying’ from the Great Void Heaven Temple had attacked the array twice before deciding to give up and take out a Black Gourd.
‘Black Gourd?’ The six-armed girl was slightly suspicious, ‘What kind of treasure is it?’
‘Fortunately, he hasn’t reported upwards. This gives us hope.’ The six-armed girl was looking forward to bring the sculpture away.
Following that, she discovered that Xue Ying pulling open the cork of the Black Gourd.
…
“Pa!”
The cork was pulled open.
Xue Ying revealed an expectant look. “Hong~” A finger-sized fiery red crystal ball flew out from the mouth of the Black Gourd. At that moment when it flew out, it rapidly surged and became bigger. Almost instantaneously, it had turned into a huge fireball with a diameter of 5,000 kilometers! And Xue Ying had already entered the inner core of that big fireball.
The huge fireball illuminated the world, causing the black sky to turn resplendent. Countless dim ripples were moving about. There were even liquefied flames rolling about.
On its surface, countless void god runes were moving.
The void god runes were densely located and had covered the entire fireball! It caused the actual power of this brutal fireball to be suppressed and controlled. The degree of the profoundness of the void god imprints was beyond that of the fireball.
“Weng~”
At this moment, the void god runes were fluctuating. Closely following that, they permeated the array beneath and spread into the underground sacred palace hall.
Furthermore, its area of influence was huge; it was constantly expanding, and the entire region of five million kilometers was under its control.
‘Void array.’ Xue Ying was located within the inside of that fireball. Feeling this immensely huge void array, he could not help but sigh in admiration.
It was precisely this void array that controlled this fireball entity that was on the same level as the Sun Star in his hometown!
Being a Voidwalker who had reached the final realm, ‘Gu Qi’s had reached an unfathomable stage in the void. Relying on the ‘void array’, Xue Ying was able to control everything within the distance of five million kilometers. Furthermore, he could also proceed with an ultra long distance ‘void great teleportation’. That was a solid move which he could use to escape.
Relying on this fireball, he could even control the void array to escape!
The fireball could protect him. The array could also allow him to escape. Unless the true body of a Primal Chaos realm giant appears, otherwise, it was almost impossible to deal against him.
“This-”
“No-”
Within the underground sacred palace hall.
The six-armed girl and black-robed male both revealed looks of terror and despair. They felt the complete solidification of the surrounding space-the void was suppressed.
“Teleport. Hurry and teleport away!” The black-robed male immediately utilized the teleportation treasure which his elder brother game him, but he discovered he could not teleport after attempting to activate it!
The Black Gourd was a protective treasure. When Xue Ying became a Void God, he could display its third level power, and also the limit of what the gourd could unleash! He could now command the full power of the fireball, and also activate the complete void array. The void array which Gu Qi personally constructed was something that even Primal Chaos realm giants had to depend on their strength to tear the void and escape. It was impossible for them to compete in their control of the void with this array!
“We can’t escape.” The six-armed girl was filled with despair.
This void suppression was too strong.
“Hong~”
The white-robed Xue Ying was still within the immensely huge fireball of 5,000 kilometers in diameter. He was controlling this horrifying fireball that came so suddenly! This was practically a hard blow from the entire Sun Star. Furthermore, the power of the Sun Star was too dispersed, but not for this fireball. Its power was completely compressed as one entity under the control of the void array; it had even reached the power at the Primal Chaos realm.
However, it was too lacking in terms of its profound usage. The fireball was only being controlled most crudely. Hence, there was no chance for the fireball to overwhelm the true body of a Primal Chaos realm giant.
Regardless, it could easily sweep across all existences at the Unity realm!
“Pu~” The array of the black city might be firm, but under the overwhelming strength of the fireball, it shattered directly. The entire black city trembled under this power.

chapters.title: Chapter 829 - Annihilated
chapters.content:
Chapter 829: Annihilated
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Many sacred followers were living within the black city. They flew out like locusts and looked up at that immensely huge fireball emitting an endless blaze; they were all shocked and stunned! After all, the strength of the sacred followers was much weaker-the strongest was only ordinary Void Gods, and many of them were still True Gods-facing a frightening suppression of power from something at the ‘Primal Chaos realm’…
They could not help but feel despondence arising deep in their hearts.
“This is more frightening than the sun in the sky.”
“Too horrifying.”
These sacred followers did not have any thoughts of resisting.
“Hu.”
That immensely huge fireball suddenly shrank. It turned into a dazzling multi-colored light that smashed against the core of the entire black city.
“Sacred palace hall!”
“That’s the sacred palace hall. Quickly, stop him!”
The eyes of these sacred followers turned red. The loyalty which originated from their soul made them disregard all terror and rushed in the direction of the underground sacred palace hall. In their subconsciousness… even if they died, they had to protect the sacred palace hall!
“Hu~”
Xue Ying easily perceived everything happening in the region of five million kilometers using the void array. Naturally, he discovered the underground sacred palace hall. That immensely huge fireball rapidly shrank as it dived down abruptly. It broke apart many of the traps and forbidden areas before moving into the palace hall! The final level of power the Black Gourd had was about hiding in the fireball for defense, and attacking by relying on the fireball to smash against all obstacles!
It might seem like a simple ‘smash’, but its power was horrifying.
A fireball which matched the might of the Sun Star was condensed into one single point before it was used to smash against everything! In terms of tyranny, it was absolutely comparable to a Primal Chaos realm giant.
Within the underground sacred palace hall.
“Not good, he is here.” The six-armed girl was trembling as she looked outside the hall entrance. The black-robed male, Sacred Emissary Chi Yun, and other sacred emissaries could feel as a frightening power broke through all obstacles and headed down into the underground sacred palace hall. “Hong long long”, the fireball which shrank to a diameter of just 100 meters had appeared right at the entrance of the sacred palace hall. It rolled in.
This fireball was resplendent. Even this group of sacred emissaries felt how eye-piercing it was. There seemed to be a fuzzy figure located within it.
“We’re doomed.” The six-armed girl did not even have the thought of resisting.
Just like someone at the peak Unity realm who got through the third level of Star Pagoda facing against an ordinary Unity realm who just passed through the first level of Star Pagoda, this gap was absolutely huge!
Facing those who passed through the fifth level of Star Pagoda, a level that reached the boundary of Primal Chaos realm as a peak Unity realm was also similar-the Unity expert would just get slaughtered. Nevertheless, it was possible for the Unity realm experts to escape from a true Primal Chaos realm expert. The Black Gourd fireball had a pure power which reached that of an expert at the sixth level. But due to the weakness in how crude the technique was, it could only achieve the fifth level Star Pagoda power.
Relying on the Black Gourd!
As long as the true body of a Primal Chaos realm expert did not come, Xue Ying could defend himself for sure. One could see that the final realm existence ‘Gu Qi’ had protected his disciple really well.
“Big brother, big brother.” The black-robed male, Sacred Emissary Chi Yun, rapidly sent a transmission asking for help. His elder brother was located far away in the Ancient Sacred World. It was extremely difficult trying to send a voice transmission across such vast distance, and usually, members of the Ancient Sacred Religion located at the base would communicate via the Sacred Master sculpture. As for those who had their own communication treasure that could contact the Ancient Sacred World, there were only three people here.
They were the cold male, the six-armed girl and Sacred Emissary Chi Yun. His communication treasure had been bestowed on him by his elder brother.
“Big brother, big brother, save me, save me!” Sacred Emissary Chi Yun was filled with despair and terror at this moment. He did not know how to react. He did not see any hopes of escaping alive.
The void was completely suppressed. He could not teleport and could only fly slowly.
Fly?
Escaping from this horrifying moving fireball which was under the control of Elder Dong Bo?
The six-armed girl stared at Sacred Emissary Chi Yun. Seeing his anxiety, she could not help but sneer and transmitted over angrily: “Fool, we can’t escape from this. Even if your elder brother wishes to save you, he is too far away in the Ancient Sacred World.”
“Hong!” The immensely huge fireball rapidly rolled over. It directly smashed against the bodies of the sacred emissaries.
It was not about how hot the fireball was. Instead, it was the smashing force which was the main driving strength.
“Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng!”
The fireball directly clashed against everything like an apparition. Xue Ying smashed his way over. As long as the sacred emissary was smashed, their bodies would instantly turn into smithereens. Nonetheless, the treasures they brought along had been kept untouched by Xue Ying as he relied on the void array.
“Peng.” The black-robed male Sacred Emissary Chi Yun was the third sacred emissary to be smashed. There was a protective glow which appeared on his body, but the very first moment when the colossal fireball clashed against him, it had broken the protective black film on the black-robed male. The fireball stopped momentarily before continuing its motion. That black-robed male could only open his eyes wide and watch as the fireball smashed into him. His eyes were filled with despair.
Following that, the fireball smashed the black-robed male into smithereens. His treasures flew directly into the fireball as Xue Ying kept them by controlling the void array.
Xue Ying was within the fireball. He did not suffer from any injuries. He was only collecting the treasures left behind.
The six-armed girl still madly rushed forward as she faced the suppression from the fireball. Her six arms were carrying a saber each, and for a moment, she turned into an enchanting blood light. But after being smashed by the fireball, her body exploded into pieces too…
None could resist against it!
The black-robed male Sacred Emissary Chi Yun’s protective treasure could only stop the fireball momentarily only.
…
Not a breath of time had passed when all sacred emissaries were dead.
Xue Ying stood within the fireball looking at that Sacred Master sculpture.
The Sacred Master sculpture was entirely black and made of jade rock. It had a cotton shirt on, and its eyes were calm and filled with endless profound mysteries. Looking at this Sacred Master sculpture, it would make any others want to be subservient to it.
‘Sacred Master?’ Xue Ying thought, ‘The sole ruler of the Ancient Sacred World, and unquestionably the strongest expert at the final realm?’
“Hong.”
Xue Ying did not hesitate in controlling his fireball to smash against that sculpture. “Hong~” The fireball directly clashed against the Sacred Master sculpture. The Sacred Master sculpture was constructed together as one single entity with the sacred palace hall. It could not be moved. But since the sacred emissaries had already dismantled part of the sacred palace hall previously, this full-powered smash smacked the Sacred Master sculpture away, causing it to smash against the distant hall wall. The two legs of the sculpture were still stuck to the black metal of the floor, though its chest had caved in slightly.
‘According to the intelligence, the Sacred Master sculpture must be destroyed after acquiring it.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘But the sculpture is quite tough; I can only cause slight caving in with my full force?’
“Sou.”
Xue Ying controlled the void to store this Sacred Master sculpture into a new Eden treasure of his. It was the only item located within the Eden treasure now.
‘I think I should send it back to the Great Void Heaven Temple and let the Sky Palace destroy it…’ Xue Ying thought.
After briefly observing this broken underground sacred palace hall, Xue Ying then rode on the fireball with a ‘sou’, and flew out of the place. He shot into the sky before flying along the passage he came from.
In the outer world.
Many of the sacred followers located in the black city were rushing in his direction. But seeing the Sacred Master sculpture flying after being smashed, they stopped. They revealed looks of despair.
“Sacred Master.”
“Sacred Master.”
All the sacred followers immediately stood tall and majestically. Their hands were cupped together as they shouted ‘Sacred Master’.
Closely following that, their bodies all turned into nothingness. When Xue Ying had just flown out after keeping the Sacred Master sculpture, he saw many sacred followers standing within the black city with their bodies dissipating.
Xue Ying watched this happen silently.
All the sacred followers within the black city had died. All had turned into nothingness. Currently, there was only Xue Ying left in this black city.
The fireball floated in the black city.
Xue Ying observed this desolate place.
“Everyone believing the Ancient Sacred Religion and Ancestor Mother Religion must be killed.” Xue Ying could not help but mutter to himself. Those religions were wantonly preaching out and were even forcing their control on the cultivators. From then on, these cultivators would remain eternally loyal to the Sacred Master and Ancestor Mother. If they were not controlled, why would they perish after the Sacred Master sculpture had been seized?

chapters.title: Chapter 830 - The Reunion within the City
chapters.content:
Chapter 830: The Reunion within the City
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the Eden treasure.
There were dozens of cages locked with cultivators inside. More than half of them were True God Rulers, while the rest were Void Gods. They were people whom the black-robed Sacred Emissary Chi Yun feel that their talents were high enough and could not be controlled using the cage. Thus, they were temporarily placed by his side as he planned to bring them back to the underground sacred palace hall to control them.
Instead, this time as he was escaping back to the base miserably, Xue Ying suddenly assaulted the base! Eventually, the black-robed Sacred Emissary Chi Yun died…
He was only thinking of teleporting the Sacred Master sculpture hastily, and then he was facing the despair of death; he had forgotten entirely about the cultivators caged within his Eden treasure. In his heart, those were just ants, and he had brought them deliberately for the sake of earning some contribution points.
“Fortunately, they are still alive.” Xue Ying let out a breath of relief after refining this Eden treasure and sending his consciousness in.
“Qing Ruo is alive too.”
Because of that muscular man Lei Chen, Xue Ying deliberately collected intelligence regarding the other party’s wife. Hence, he knew how she looked like and could instantly recognize Qing Ruo amongst the caged cultivators.
“Ka ka ka~” Xue Ying’s energy entered and unlocked the cages. The cultivators whose souls were sealed had been released as well.
“What is happening?”
“Why are we being let out?”
These cultivators were slightly stunned.
The Ancient Sacred Religion was always vigilant. It was impossible for them to release the seal on their souls because the moment they did so, these cultivators could suicide at any time. And now, they actually took the initiative to release their soul seals? This made the cultivators guess that it was possible that they were being saved.
“I’ll be bringing everyone over to the Celestial Water City in a while. By then, everyone will be regaining your freedom.” Xue Ying’s voice reverberated in the Eden treasure.
“We are being saved!”
“Celestial Water City? It must be a special emissary from the Celestial Water City.”
“Haha…”
All of them were extremely excited and joyful.
These cultivators who lived in the sacred world had long known of how terrifying the ‘Ancient Sacred Religion’ and the ‘Ancestor Mother Religion’ were. The moment they were controlled, they would remain loyal for eternal. Being a cultivator who reached their current standards as a True God Ruler or a Void God, they naturally had great talents. As such, they would rather persevere on and were not willing to lose themselves.
And now, they were finally saved!
“Hu.” Amidst the excited fervor of the cultivators, Qing Ruo had disappeared. She was directly teleported out.
…
Qing Ruo only felt her surroundings changed before discovering that she had appeared in a slightly broken-looking black city.
A white-robed young man was standing by the side.
‘Who is he?’ Qing Ruo felt suspicious.
The white-robed Xue Ying stood by the side. He waved his hand before releasing Lei Chen.
The muscular man Lei Chen had always been anxious. He was afraid that the Great Void Heaven Temple Elder Dong Bo could not destroy this place! He was also fearful that his wife might have been affected by the shockwaves during the battle and die. Regardless, Lei Chen was in emotional turmoil previously, but now that Xue Ying released him, and he had seen that green-robed girl in front of him, he felt tremble in his soul.
“Qing Ruo!” Lei Chen rushed over excitedly.
“Ah Chen!” Qing Ruo was excited too.
The two had always been together since young. They had climbed up together step by step, going on adventures and experienced many dangers together. They even also experienced similar miraculous encounters and had long become the most important person for each other-more so than their own lives.
The two could not help but rush towards each other. They hugged.
Not far away, Xue Ying revealed a grin as he saw this.
Even though the sacred followers within the city had already been annihilated, he had at least saved several people including this couple. Watching this couple embracing each other… Xue Ying could not help but think of his wife back at his hometown cosmos.
‘Jing Qiu, are you, Yu’er and Qing Yao still doing well? Rest assured, I’ll bring back the best cultivation treasures back for you all.’ Xue Ying thought to himself. He was already an Inner Hall Elder currently, and he felt confident for the future.
He would definitely become stronger on this path of cultivation! None could obstruct his path!
Only those who were strong enough could obtain more precious materials. Once he was strong enough, Xue Ying could definitely bring such materials to his wife.
Xue Ying flipped his hand and brought out a communication talisman. He directly contacted the other party: “Ancestor Devil, this is Dong Bo Xue Ying.”
“What’s the matter?” Ancestor Devil replied.
“I’ve assaulted an important base of the Ancient Sacred Religion.” Xue Ying answered, “This is the location.” He directly transmitted the location on the map over.
“An important base of the Ancient Sacred Religion? Is it a base with the Sacred Master sculpture or just an ordinary gathering point?” Ancestor Devil asked. There were only a total of 90 major bases across the entire Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, and now, Xue Ying was saying that he actually got rid of one of it? According to what he knew, the array protecting the base was relatively formidable, and with Xue Ying’s current power, he could actually assault and destroy it? That made Ancestor Devil suspect that this was merely a minor gathering point.
“I’ve already gotten the Sacred Master sculpture.” Xue Ying said.
“Alright. I’ll come over now.”
Ancestor Devil no longer suspected Xue Ying. It was impossible for the Sacred Master sculpture to be forged.
Xue Ying kept his communication talisman.
Watching this quiet black city, the eastern end of this city had already turned marble white as the sky started brightening.
“Hong long long~”
Soon, a terrifying willpower came down directly in the distant sky. It began controlling the surrounding World Energy. This surging World Energy eventually condensed into a colossal maelstrom. Such a huge disturbance had prompted both the joyous Lei Chen and his wife Qing Ruo to look up in the distant. That maelstrom was too prominent, and its power was horrifying.
“Elder Dong Bo.” Lei Chen pulled his wife Qing Ruo over. He was slightly guilty, “Thank you Elder Dong Bo for saving my wife and me. This gratitude is something the two of us will never forget in our life.”
“Thank you Elder Dong Bo for saving us.” Qing Ruo showed her gratitude too.
Xue Ying chuckled as he replied to this couple, “It is just a small thing. Saying that, I do have to thank Lei Chen for leading me over here.”
The Ancient Sacred Religion was extremely careful.
Finding a base was difficult. Fortunately, Lei Chen was able to sense the soul of his wife. Such a technique was too mystical that it was likely even Sacred Emissary Chi Yun would never have thought that it could exist! That was why Xue Ying could follow him in the dark.
“That is…” Lei Chen and Qing Ruo were both looking at the maelstrom with astonishment. They did not dare ask further.
Xue Ying looked over.
The maelstrom was rapidly condensing and turning into a black luxurious-robed handsome male. He had long blood hair, and his eyes swept across the surrounding, causing both Lei Chen and Qing Ruo to look down with their spirits trembling.
Nevertheless, Xue Ying in his white robe flew over to welcome him.
“Ancestor Devil.” Xue Ying said.
Because they were within the territory of Great Void Heaven Temple, any Primal Chaos realm giant could send their incarnations over. But the incarnation had to be condensed from the World Energy, and that would create a relatively great disturbance! The process of descending took some time as well, which was why every city had to have a Primal Chaos realm giant incarnation stationed for long periods.
By stationing there, they could immediately react to any emergencies.
And descending from an ultra-far distance required the gathering of World Energy to condense an incarnation. That would take some time. To true experts, this short period sufficed for them to kill everyone and escape.
Thus, being an Inner Hall Elder, Xue Ying also had a talisman meant for protecting himself. During critical moments, he had to survive first before asking for help!
And the incarnations of Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster could descend too. Their speed of descending was comparatively faster.
This was also why… the Ancient Sacred Religion could only hide in the dark without daring to fight in the light within the territory of the Great Void Heaven Temple.
“Quite powerful eh.” Ancestor Devil looked at Xue Ying. The edge of his lip moved upwards, “You actually destroyed an important base of the Ancient Sacred Religion?”
“It’s just luck.” Xue Ying answered. He waved his hand before taking out the Sacred Master sculpture.
“This is the Sacred Master sculpture. It is harder to destroy.” Xue Ying said.
Ancestor Devil saw the caving in of the chest of the Sacred Master. He could not help but be astonished and stared at Xue Ying. It seemed that this brat from his old hometown still had some hidden techniques! Otherwise, how could he break into this base and even damage the Sacred Master sculpture?
“If only we could sell the Sacred Master sculpture to the Ancient Sacred World, it would be a huge gain for us. What a pity we can’t sell it.” Ancestor Devil said, “We must bring it back and destroy it. Its degree of firmness is comparable to middle-grade Void God weapons, and destroying it isn’t easy. At least this incarnation of mine can’t do so.”
Ancestor Devil then turned to both Lei Chen and Qing Ruo within the black city.
“Ask them over. I’ll destroy this city.” Ancestor Devil said.
Xue Ying nodded.
He then directly flew over and asked: “Lei Chen, do the two of you want to return to the Golden Wing Nation or come with us to the Celestial Water City?” Because of Lei Chen, Xue Ying was able to contribute greatly. That was why he was willing to help Lei Chen carve his path!
Lei Chen and Qing Ruo exchanged a glance. Lei Chen did not hesitate in replying, “Elder Dong Bo, we would like to go to the Celestial Water City.”
They had already decided to go there.
Furthermore, they experienced a great deal of hardship this time. A small place like the Golden Wing Nation was ultimately too dangerous, and if they had the chance to travel to the Celestial Water City, they would naturally do so! Furthermore, they need not pay the price of using the teleportation array if they were to go with Xue Ying.
“Alright. Both of you should wait temporarily in my Eden treasure.” Xue Ying kept them into the Eden treasure before returning to Ancestor Devil.
Ancestor Devil looked beneath. He extended his right hand before engulfing the city.
“Hong long long~”
Endless frost emerged from the void. It rapidly froze the entire black city. Under the control of Ancestor Devil, the black city also released sounds of ‘ka ka ka’; many places started crumbling apart. Just a moment later, the old underground sacred palace hall and the black city and even a large amount of ground surrounding this city had been completely exterminated. They turned into nothingness.
Only an ultra huge gouge was left behind.
“Let’s go.” Ancestor Devil brought along Xue Ying, tearing apart the time-space tunnel before entering it.

chapters.title: Chapter 831 - Myriad World Tavern
chapters.content:
Chapter 831: Myriad World Tavern
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Ancient Sacred World.
The primitive Ancient Sacred World eventually shattered into pieces because of a horrifying great war. The remaining Ancient Sacred World was only about one-hundredth that of the previous size, yet it remained the biggest as compared to the five sacred worlds.
There were many beings living in the Ancient Sacred World. It was said that this was the most peaceful world to live in, and cultivators would not kill each other at all. No matter how long it was, over 10,000 years, a million years or more than 100 million years, it was impossible to find any cultivators within the entire Ancient Sacred World killing each other. Everyone coexisted peacefully as if they were one big family.
“Hua~”
Even though the Sun Star hung high up in the sky, there were still black light rays emitting from the center of the Ancient Sacred World spreading in all directions, encompassing the entire world. Even the light from the Sun Star could not suppress these black rays.
If one said that the Sacred Master sculpture could control cultivators, then the black light rays emitted from the center of the Ancient Sacred World had a power that was not any weaker than the Sacred Master sculpture and was much broader in terms of area. Every single part of the Ancient Sacred World was covered by this black light, and every cultivator regardless of whether they were weak or strong like the Primal Chaos realm giants would be filled with loyalty to the Sacred Master.
In the outer world, the Ancient Sacred Religion had to be low-profile with their actions of spreading the religion.
But in the Ancient Sacred World, every single cultivator was a follower of the Sacred Master!
In the Ancient Sacred World, a ripple formed on a peaceful lake. A figure flew out from deep underneath this lake. He had violet hair that flowed down onto his shoulder. He was wearing a green robe with a strange pattern, and his eyes were filled with agonizing pain.
“My little brother.” The violet-haired male muttered.
He had just obtained the request for help from his little brother-
“Big brother, big brother, save me, save me!”
“Big brother, save me!”
His little brother’s call for help made him anxious. He thought of possible means to help save him, but closely following that, he discovered that his little brother had already died. That base where his little brother was located at had been destroyed.
The eyes of the violet-haired male could hardly hide the pain he was feeling. Cultivating until now, he only had a single family member-his little brother. When they were young, he and his little brother were both proud sons of heaven. But as their realms became more profound, his little brother was gradually flung away. Currently, he had already reached the Primal Chaos realm and was ranked as a Saint in the Ancient Sacred Religion… and his little brother remained just a Void God.
His little brother was a little too eager as well; he went to dangerous places to temper himself.
He could not stop his little brother. All he could do was provide some protective treasures so that his little brother could better survive. But what happened now had frozen his whole heart.
“My little brother…! No matter who was it that killed you, he must die. He must definitely accompany you with your death.” The violet-haired male muttered.
…
In another location within the Ancient Sacred World, above the continuous chain of towering black palaces, the surrounding World Energy began gathering into a maelstrom and eventually condensed into a figure. He was that violet-haired male.
“Sou.”
Another figure flew out from within the chain of black palaces too. That was a golden-armored male.
“Saint Wang Ming, why did you come over to my place?” The golden-armored male asked.
“My little brother has died. The base he was in had been destroyed. The person who acted is the Inner Hall Elder of Great Void Heaven Temple, ‘Dong Bo Xue Ying.'” The violet-haired male said, “I wish for the religion to send a team of sacred enforcers over to the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World to seek for an opportunity and eradicate Dong Bo Xue Ying. Other than wanting to take revenge for my little brother, this Dong Bo Xue Ying has great innate talent and being able to eliminate him as early as possible will be a good thing too. Furthermore, the base has been destroyed, and we should retaliate.”
The golden-armored male frowned slightly after hearing it: “A little Origin Birth realm Inner Hall Elder isn’t worth overthinking over. It will only be the birth of an additional Primal Chaos realm expert at most, and that is someone not worth mentioning in front of the Sacred Master.”
What level was the Sacred Master at?
He was the strongest expert amongst final realm existences! None of the other four great sacred worlds could suppress him at all.
The violet-haired male continued, “The base has been destroyed and are we to treat this as nothing has happened?”
“That is the territory of Great Void Heaven Temple. It isn’t appropriate for us to compete with them. We can only spread our religion in the dark, and for them to destroy our base meant that we aren’t careful enough.” The golden-armored male said, “In the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, the more we fight, the greater our losses. Their experts could easily send incarnations down easily on any location there.”
The violet-haired male understood this point too.
Unless he had to personally kill his way over? He was not confident of killing the other party without using his true body. And if his true body went over, even if he succeeded in killing Xue Ying, the incarnations of Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster would arrive, and it was impossible for his true body to escape-he would die.
“Saint Wang Ming.” The golden-armored male said, “The rules within the religion are strict. I can’t disobey it. You should think of other ways to settle this matter yourself.”
The violet-haired male frowned.
“For instance, going to the Myriad World Tavern. I’m sure they will satisfy you.” The golden-armored male chuckled.
“Myriad World Tavern?” The violet-haired male was still frowning.
…
The Myriad World Tavern was genuinely mysterious.
Those who knew about it were few and far between. Usually, only those at the truly high level in the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void would know of their existence. Xue Ying had also heard from his teacher ‘Gu Qi’ about this place called ‘Myriad World Tavern’.
Since the entire Ancient Sacred World was covered by the Sacred Master light, there were no Myriad World Tavern within this place. Not far away outside the Ancient Sacred World, on a primal chaos land, there was a flourishing city meant for trading and conducting businesses. Many cultivators from the Ancient Sacred World would come to conduct trades. Thus, this place was called the ‘Myriad World Tavern’.
“Hu.”
The violet-haired male walked within the city, and he soon arrived at a relatively old tavern.
The tavern was simple-looking, and the two characters on it gave off a tyrannical feeling-’Myriad World’.
It was empty within the Myriad World Tavern-not a single person at all!
The violet-haired male entered, gazing across his surroundings before landing his vision on an old man currently half-sleeping by the table in the corner. This old man was also the owner of this place.
“Myriad World Tavern Master.” The violet-haired male said.
The old man slowly opened his eyes, glancing towards that violet-haired male. He revealed a grin, “This place of mine is costly. A table on the lower floor costs a piece of Origin World rock, and a table on the upper floor costs 10 Origin World Rocks.”
That was a really frightening price.
One had to know that Ancestor Desert only collected 30 pieces of Origin World Rocks from Ancestor Devil that time for transporting both him and Xue Ying from the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World to the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. Purchasing an ordinary Primal Chaos Flying Ship costs only 50 Origin World Rocks. That upper-graded Void God weapon of Xue Ying also required close to 30 Origin World Rocks. But here, just having a simple meal cost a single Origin World Rock on the lower floor and 10 pieces on the upper level?
None of the Primal Chaos realm giants was that willing to eat so often!
“Upper level.” The violet-haired male said.
The old man chuckled as he stood up and ambled up the tavern stairs.
The violet-haired male did not dare belittle this old man. Across the five sacred worlds and primal chaos void, there were more than a thousand Myriad World Taverns, and every single Myriad World Tavern contained an avatar of this old man! The violet-haired male knew that these old men were all the same person; the final realm existence ‘Myriad World Tavern Master’ was someone mysterious.
At the second level of the Myriad World Tavern.
“Come come come, have a seat quickly. It has been a long time since I last received a guest.” The Myriad World Tavern Master was beaming. He waved his hand before bringing a flask of wine and a plate of fruits out.
The wine was an ordinary fruit wine.
The fruits were also those that were commonly seen, and even Transcendents could eat them casually.
But these two types of food… cost 10 Origin World Rocks!
The violet-haired male sat down by the table and watched as that old man sit and casually take a fruit from the plate. The old man bit on the fruit while saying at the same time, “Tell me, who do you want to kill?”
“Great Void Heaven Temple, Inner Hall Elder, Dong Bo Xue Ying.” The violet-haired male said.
The old man nodded.
“A very young brat. His talent is very high. Both Tian Yu and Swordmaster regard him highly. Being an Inner Hall Elder, his survival treasures are extraordinary!”
“800 Origin World Rocks and I can send someone to act. But I dare not ascertain that it’ll absolutely succeed. Even if we fail, we will continue to assassinate him for at most three times. If all three times fail, the mission will thus end.”
“The other type of mission costs 5,000 Origin World Rocks. Dong Bo Xue Ying will die for certain.” The old man looked at the violet-haired male.
The face of the violet-haired male twitched.
Why did he originally want to ask his religion to send a small team of sacred enforcers over? That’s because the price quoted of the Myriad World Tavern was too ruthless!
Being a Primal Chaos realm existence, even if he brought out all his treasures, he could only bring out 2,000 over Origin World Rocks at most! Even if he sold the weapon he used for battle, he would amass 6,000 Origin World Rocks at most!
5,000 Origin World Rocks?
Even final realm existences, the Cosmos Gods, would feel their hearts aching from this price. But they could still afford it.
As for Primal Chaos realm existences, they had to give up all their treasures.
“After all, he is an Inner Hall Elder, and to ensure his death, this price is reasonable.” The old man laughed, “This brat has many people behind him. From how I see it, when he destroyed that base of yours, he should have another superpower not any weaker than the Great Void Heaven Temple supporting him. Thus, the price of 5,000 Origin World Rocks isn’t that costly at all.”

chapters.title: Chapter 832 - Harvest
chapters.content:
Chapter 832: Harvest
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The violet-haired male hesitated for a moment. He asked, “What is the success rate if I were to pay 800 Origin World Rocks?”
“There should be at least 50% certainty every single time we act.” The old man said, “After three consecutive failures, the mission will end. Also, if he entered closed-door cultivation or return back to the Great Void Heaven Temple, we will not be able to assassinate him.”
“Mn.” The violet-haired male nodded.
He knew too.
Xue Ying was practically someone with the highest status within the Celestial Water City. There was only that incarnation of the ‘Celestial Water Hall Master’ with a higher rank than him there! Thus, Xue Ying would definitely be staying at the central core of the entire Celestial Water City array, and if he did not leave that region, it was impossible for them to assassinate him.
“800 Origin World Rocks. I want him to die.” The violet-haired male said.
Even though he had a deep relationship with his little brother, his personal cultivation was essential too. If he were to sell even his weapon just to raise 5,000 Origin World Rocks, he would feel strongly against in his heart. After all, he spent countless time and effort just for the sake of refining this weapon which was most appropriate for himself.
******
Celestial Water City.
Within the residence of Xue Ying.
The white-robed Xue Ying stood there. He waved his hand, causing many cultivators to appear by the side. These were all the cultivators he had saved.
“This is the Celestial Water City.” Xue Ying looked over and declared, “You are all safe now. Currently, you are all free.”
“Many thanks, senior.”
This group of cultivators including the couple Lei Chen and Qing Ruo was respectfully thanking him.
“Send them away.” Xue Ying looked at the green-robed female attendant by his side.
“Yes.” The green-robed female attendant acknowledged.
“You all should come with me. Do not veer off from my lead.” The green-robed female attendant shouted out. She might be a female attendant, but she was a Void God and was part of the Celestial Water City deacons. This time, she was arranged by the Society of Elder over.
The green-robed female attendant brought them out.
Lei Chen and Qing Ruo even bowed towards Xue Ying.
Xue Ying chuckled at them. He transmitted over, “Go. In the future, if you meet any trouble, you can come to find me.”
This time, Lei Chen had contributed to the operation of attacking the base. Xue Ying would naturally remember it.
“Thank you, senior.” Lei Chen and Qing Ruo were both filled with joy.
The two had reunited and succeeded in arriving at the Celestial Water City. Towards this Elder Dong Bo, they were filled with gratitude! If not for him, the two of them would eventually fall under the control and serve the Sacred Master eternally.
Only after seeing the two of them leave did Xue Ying turn around and enter the cultivation room.
…
Within the cultivation room.
It was quiet. There was a joss stick emitting a fragrance around the place. Xue Ying sat down cross-legged on a silver icy-silk praying mat. He waved his hand, causing many treasures to appear on the ground. This was the harvest he had reaped from dealing against the Ancient Sacred Religion. After those sacred disciples died, the treasures would naturally be taken away by Xue Ying! This was also another harvest he got alongside the massive reward from the Great Void Heaven Temple after assaulting a base of the Ancient Sacred Religion! Furthermore, the harvest he got from the battle would even be more than what he would be receiving from the Great Void Heaven Temple.
There were many different kinds of treasures, and Xue Ying was differentiating them one by one-he was valuing them.
‘The treasures left behind by the two strongest experts at the base, the two peak Unity experts, and that black-robed Sacred Emissary, were the most.’ Xue Ying revealed a joyful look.
The cold male had died in battle, leaving behind treasures worth about 60 Origin World Rocks.
The six-armed girl left behind treasures worth about 50 Origin World Rocks.
As for the black-robed sacred emissary… he left behind the most treasures! Other than the treasures like the teleportation talisman which was prohibited for only the black-robed sacred emissary to use, other treasures added up to a total value of close to 200 Origin World Rocks!
The other sacred emissaries left behind treasures worth fewer, adding up to a total of at most 50 over Origin World Rocks.
As for the sacred disciples, they had many treasures, though the total worth barely reached 20 Origin World Rocks.
In total—
He had reaped a total value of about 380 Origin World Rocks of treasures! This did not include the one million contribution points which he would be getting from the Great Void Heaven Temple too.
‘Destroying a base of the Ancient Sacred Religion is indeed very profitable.’ Xue Ying was really ecstatic. Even though the price of his Black Gourd was higher, that protective treasure was refined by Gu Qi only for his inheritor to use, and could not be sold. Being an Inner Hall Elder, he had a talisman that boosted his survival capabilities too, and that talisman was more precious than the Black Gourd. But the Inner Hall Elder talisman could not be sold! Even if someone else obtained it, they could not use it.
Thus, this was the first time that Xue Ying had obtained treasures which he could sell.
‘Killing that black-robed sacred emissary got me a total of close to 200 Origin World Rocks. I reckon he should have some special background.’ Xue Ying made his guesses.
He waved his hand, collecting the treasures laid on the ground. That joss stick was also extinguished. Xue Ying then left the cultivation room.
There were female attendants and servants within the residence.
“Master.” A green-robed female attendant walked over. Her voice was clear and respectful, “The Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion sent an invitation card over.”
“Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion?” Xue Ying was slightly startled.
The Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion was the most prominent merchant organization in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. The Great Void Heaven Temple, Primogenitor Island, and Jade Light Sacred Territory were supporting it.
One had to know…
Cultivators needed resources. Those cultivating the laws and profound mysteries were relatively better as they did not need as many resources for cultivation. As for those cultivating the ancient cultivation system, bloodline cultivation system and the strongest warrior system, they coveted resources and all sorts of precious materials greatly since they required many resources to cultivate. Thus, the three great holy grounds had also created the ‘Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion’ meant to specially buy and sell resources! Many cultivators were willing to trade with the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion because they were fair.
The Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion could be found throughout the big cities. Celestial Water City naturally had a Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion too.
‘Invited me?’ Xue Ying looked at the invitation card, ‘3,000 years later?’
One could directly buy and sell ordinary treasures from the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion.
And the more precious ones where only a single set existed across the five sacred world and primal chaos void could not be casually sold. Instead, the pavilion would hold special conventions and inform the various experts from all over the region for an auction. Those who called out the highest price would get the item!
Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion could be found in the big cities across the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. The cultivators could attend the convention from any big city, but they would merely see the ‘illusion’ of the treasure. Only after they bought the item would it be sent over! If all the treasures existed in a single big city, it might just attract the attention of experts to attack and steal those items away! Thus, the whereabouts of those treasures were kept unknown.
After buying it, the three great holy grounds would send experts to deliver the treasures.
And this time, the convention which the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion was hosting, had the name of ‘Cheng Qun Convention.
Because the most important treasure this time was also called ‘Cheng Qun’. There were no other explanations, only that the starting bid for this treasure was at 1,000 Origin World Rocks!
‘What treasure is it that has such a high starting bid?’ Xue Ying was slightly surprised, ‘Such a treasure should be at a level only Primal Chaos realm giants are willing to purchase. I wonder what it is used for? I have never heard of this treasure before.’
Invitations to this Convention would be sent out several thousand years in advance.
The earlier the invitations were sent, the more precious the convention.
And in history…
There was a Cosmos God ranked weapon which was sold during a convention once in the past. Invitations had been sent out a full 100 million years in advance. Invitations had even been sent out to the Ancient Sacred World.
‘I’ll go over and have a look by then.’ Xue Ying was quite interested. This ‘Cheng Qun’ treasure which he had never heard before was something he could not afford. But a convention would still contain many other treasures and rare items.

chapters.title: Chapter 833 - The Pitiful Primal Chaos Expert
chapters.content:
Chapter 833: The Pitiful Primal Chaos Expert
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was quite interested in the treasure convention of the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion.
In the following days, he had always remained within the residence. He would either be cultivating within the cultivation room, or he would go to the palace hall meant for experimenting his techniques. Under a calm state of mind, his understanding of both the “13 Apocalyptic Swords” and “Plate Ripple Diagram” had gradually deepened. He felt like he could grasp the Apocalyptic Fourth Sword too. This was primarily because it had been more than seven billion years since he cultivated as a Void God within the Palace Hall of Time when he was at the Great Void Heaven Temple.
During this past seven billion years, it enabled Xue Ying to accumulate a strong foundation. He had even simplified the Apocalyptic Third Sword into the ‘Fish Dragon Kill’. This simplification represented Xue Ying’s current realm.
And now that he had successfully broken into the base of the Ancient Sacred Religion, his mood was delightful. He was able to improve himself leisurely, gaining a more distinct understanding of the ‘Apocalyptic Fourth Sword’. As long as he spent a little more time, Xue Ying believed he could comprehend the fourth sword.
‘Mn, after the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion convention ends, I’ll return to the Great Void Heaven Temple and enter closed-door cultivation in the Palace Hall of Time to comprehend the Apocalyptic Fourth Sword.’ Xue Ying thought.
…
Xue Ying was cultivating leisurely, yet another person was having a hard time.
‘This Dong Bo Xue Ying is actually staying in the residence without coming out?’ Within a restaurant, a short and plump male who ordered a table of delicacies and was slowly drinking and eating frowned. He glanced far away through the window of the restaurant. Even though the distance was more than 5,000 kilometers away, he could still clearly discern the residence.
That was where Xue Ying stayed!
The short and plump male wore simply. There were some black patterns on his face, and those golden eyes of his contained a strand of impatience.
He concealed his aura, and from the surface, he seemed like an ordinary Void God!
But in reality… he was a Primal Chaos realm giant, ‘Forefather Black Loathe’. He was famous during the early periods when the Ancient Sacred World was still complete. An absolute majority of final realm existences had not lived as long as he did. In terms of power, across the Primal Chaos realm giants, he was ranked in the front. He was an entire level higher than Ancestor Devil and Heaven Weeping Sect Master. Furthermore, his personality was much wicked, and he did not rely on any Cosmos Gods and had always been independent. He was known for assassinating others.
Naturally.
What came over to the Celestial Water City was only an incarnation because the moment he killed Xue Ying-who was also an Inner Hall Elder of the Great Void Heaven Temple-within one of the 12 Primal Chaos cities under the Great Void Heaven Temple, the ‘Celestial Water City’, the Great Void Heaven Temple would undoubtedly be angered. It was impossible for him to escape, so naturally, he would not bring his true body over.
His incarnation could conceal and transform his aura. The moment he succeeded in assassinating the other party, his incarnation would take the initiative to dissipate! As long as he did not leave behind any traces, the Great Void Heaven Temple would not be able to probe him out.
‘According to intelligence, when Dong Bo Xue Ying first arrived in Celestial Water City, he would usually visit the restaurants and taverns and roam around the city almost every single day. Why did he remain in his residence now after he exterminated a base of the Ancient Sacred Religion?’ The short and plump male, ‘Forefather Black Loathe’ was slightly speechless. He used his fastest speed to rush over in the hope of killing Xue Ying when he was roaming outside. The moment he succeeded in assassinating him, he could leave this place leisurely. But now that Xue Ying did not come out, he had no other choice but to wait.
******
In the blink of an eye, 3,000 years had passed.
Within the cultivation room of the residence.
The joss stick fragrance was permeating through the place. Xue Ying was seated cross-legged on the praying mat. The surface of his skin was covered by a layer of pitch black energy. This energy had descended from the distant primal chaos void! It was also the primal chaos energy that was guided and condensed using the “Walker’s Hidden Secret”. Because it was being refined by the cultivation technique, it turned into a black color, and was extremely cold and filled with destructiveness…
“Pu.” Xue Ying opened his mouth, spitting out a strand of a rainbow ray which dissipated gradually within the cultivation room.
This rainbow ray was part of the primal chaos void energy which Xue Ying could not absorb.
‘Who would have thought that I could reach this stage in Walker’s Hidden Secret over the past 3,000 years.’ Xue Ying revealed a joyful look. He did not have any distinct improvements in other areas, but the Walker’s Hidden Secret had reached the 29th level!
‘Mn, there is still half a month before the convention happens.’ Xue Ying’s current mood was relatively pleasant. After breaking through, he wanted to continue comprehending the Walker’s Hidden Secret as soon as possible to the 31st level. By then, he would have reached the Unity realm in the system of Voidwalker. Not just his body of Termination Energy, even his control of the void would undergo a qualitative change.
Half a month flashed by. Xue Ying stood up, “Hong long!” The door of the cultivation room opened.
‘I hope that this convention will provide me with some surprises.’ Xue Ying was quite looking forward to it. This was his first time attending the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion convention.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying walked to the courtyard of his residence before disappearing.
He had directly utilized the void maneuver to rush towards Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion. After all, there was a distance of 150,000 kilometers to the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion, and he had no mood to fly there slowly.
…
‘Mn?’
‘Forefather Black Loathe’ had bought a small courtyard and was displaying his secret technique all the time. He was carefully probing the area around Xue Ying’s residence because Xue Ying was located at one of the core areas within the entire Celestial Water City array. As a result, he dared not permeate into this residence with his secret technique, and could only do so in the region outside.
Forefather Black Loathe had made adequate preparations of being on guard for 3,000 years. Being a Primal Chaos realm giant, even 100 million years was not worth mentioning to him.
Suddenly, Forefather Black Loathe opened his eyes. That dark gold eyes of his were filled with shock!
Because the region his secret technique was monitoring…
Felt the presence of void penetration, and with a ‘shua’, that figure had arrived in the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion 150,000 kilometers away.
It happened too fast!
Even if Xue Ying were to teleport currently under the law suppression of the sacred world, he would be able to traverse a distance of more than 75,000 kilometers every single teleport. The distance of just 150,000 kilometers required just a moment for him to cross!
The moment Forefather Black Loathe discovered Xue Ying… Xue Ying had already arrived at the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion.
‘Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion?’ Forefather Black Loathe felt frustrated.
‘Can’t you fly slowly?’
‘Can’t you just go out and have a walk? Don’t you feel stifled after staying in closed-door for 3,000 years?’ Forefather Black Loathe felt frustrated, but he understood that it was normal for experts to enter closed-door cultivation for even ten billion years in one ago. Why would the other party go for a walk just after cultivating for 3,000 years?
Forefather Black Loathe could only feel sullen.
He had just discovered Xue Ying, and Xue Ying had already arrived at the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion already.
‘Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion, damn.’ Forefather Black Loathe muttered, ‘The Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion is also a place constructed by the three great holy grounds of the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. This place is being guarded really tightly and is far beyond that of Dong Bo Xue Ying’s residence. The moment I try probing it, I’ll be discovered. It is impossible for me to assassinate him within the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion.
“Wait.’
“I can only wait for him to come out.” Forefather Black Loathe muttered to himself, “This time, I must prepare myself such that even if he penetrated the void from the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion directly, I’d be able to obstruct him.”
He decided to maintain his alertness at the highest possible state.
The moment he discovered Xue Ying, he would immediately come out and obstruct him! Because Xue Ying’s void penetration speed required just a single instance for him to travel from the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion to his residence. The time was so short that he could not be distracted.
This sort of highest alert… was very tiring to maintain. But doing so just for a short one to two days was something Forefather Black Loathe was willing to do so. The moment he succeeded, he would obtain a reward of 560 Origin World Rocks!
…
“Sou.”
By the entrance of the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion, a white-robed teenager appeared. He was Xue Ying.
“Elder Dong Bo.” Just a breath later, the manager of Celestial Water City’s Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion came out to welcome him passionately.

chapters.title: Chapter 834 - Convention
chapters.content:
Chapter 834: Convention
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The manager was in a golden robe. He laughed and said, “I am Yu Qi, and is also the pavilion master of this Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion in Celestial Water City. Even though I am a pavilion master, I am also a disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple.”
“Oh?” Xue Ying nodded slightly.
He did not find it puzzling. After all, behind the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion were the three holy grounds Great Void Heaven Temple, Primogenitor Island, and Jade Light Sacred Territory. The important members should likely be from either of the three holy grounds.
Every big city would have a Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion and also a pavilion master.
“Elder Dong Bo, please come with me.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi was extremely passionate. He was leading the way while explaining at the same time, “Only 15 people are participating in the convention here at our Celestial Water City this time. By then, everyone will be competing for treasures with other pavilions all over the place. The competition will be much more intense. I’ve heard that many Primal Chaos realm existences are coming this time, and there are even those who are coming from places like Eastern Unicorn Sacred World.”
Xue Ying was quite curious.
Competing for the same treasures over at different pavilions. That was really interesting.
“Please.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi led Xue Ying into a house. The house already had maidservants waiting for the guests and had prepared wine for them. The house contained a huge window, and one could see the distant high platform through this window.
“This time, the treasure convention is also called ‘Cheng Qun Convention’ because the most valuable treasure is called ‘Cheng Qun’. Actually, I’ve never heard of it before. According to hearsay, many Primal Chaos realm existences came from other sacred worlds all for the sake of it.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi said, “Oh right, before this, I do still have to see what treasures Elder Dong Bo have so that I can determine the calling limit for Elder Dong Bo.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying waved his hand.
“Hua!”
Many treasures were soon brought out, filling up a small part of the house. These treasures were also what Xue Ying intended to sell.
“So many?” Pavilion Master Yu Qi was slightly startled. He immediately began thoroughly inspecting through the treasures. This was the most fundamental skill a pavilion master should have, and his speed of distinguishing through the treasures was much faster than Xue Ying’s.
“These treasures can be exchanged for a total of 385 Origin World Rocks.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi chuckled, “With so many Origin World Rocks, it is sufficient for you to buy some precious materials.”
Time passed.
Pavilion Master Yu Qi spent his days chatting with Xue Ying. In the blink of an eye, an hour passed. Finally, a violet-robed girl appeared on the high platform just outside the window. This violet-robed girl had an extraordinary temperament. She smiled as she looked around her: “I am Ming Yu, and is also one of the elders of Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion. Today’s Cheng Qun Convention will be hosted by me!”
Xue Ying was startled. Ming Yu Pavilion Master? She was a Primal Chaos realm existence from the Jade Light Sacred Territory.
Pavilion Master Yu Qi also added from the side, “It is only Ming Yu Planet Master’s illusion that appeared here. Currently, she is hosting the convention from the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion in a huge city within the Jade Light Sacred Territory.”
“Let us begin right now.” The violet-robed girl was very familiar with this. She extended her hand, causing a red flower to appear on her palm. Every single petal of this flower looked bright and glistening. There were even dews condensing on the surface of it. She waved her palm, causing this red flower petal to suddenly change shape and turn into a red-armored girl.
“This is a puppet lifeform at the Unity realm which could get through the third level of Star Pagoda.” The violet-robed girl chuckled, “The starting bid is 100 Origin World Rocks.”
“110 Origin World Rocks.”
“111 Origin World Rocks.”
One could see voice coming from different directions.
Pavilion Master Yu Qi was explaining from the side, “These voices are being called out from different pavilions. Elder Dong Bo, the moment you call out a price, your voice will also resound in the different pavilions.”
Xue Ying was watching from the side. He was not interested in this Unity realm puppet lifeform. He did not have many treasures, and he had to use on something important.
Those who bid in this convention were all vigilant. Those who called out prices at the later stage would usually increase the bid one Origin World Rock by one! There were even times when some might hesitate for a long time, and only when the violet-robed girl was announcing the end of bid did they finally shout out their prices.
…
“36 Origin World Rocks.” Xue Ying said as he stood by the window. His voice reverberated around the high platform.
The violet-robed girl was currently holding on to a jade bottle with a smile.
“37 Origin World Rocks.”
“38 Origin World Rocks.”
The price was continuously increasing.
Very soon, Xue Ying shook his head. The jade bottle contained a refined pill that aided in cultivation! Xue Ying attached quite a great importance to this type of treasures since he could buy them for his wife and son, or for him to use it. But it all depended on whether the price was appropriate! If the price were too high, he would instead give it up.
Because he was still young, and his hometown cosmos still had quite a long period before the epoch ended. As he grew stronger, he could obtain better treasures that aided in cultivation! He was not in a rush at all currently.
…
The cheapest of these treasures exceeded the price of 30 Origin World Rocks. Some even cost several hundred Origin World Rocks! But the highlight treasure, ‘Cheng Qun’ had not appeared at all. That had a starting bid of 1,000 Origin World Rocks, and according to the rules of coming out with prices, Xue Ying would likely have to pay an amount of a few times that of the starting price if he wanted an item.
Finally, it was the 22nd treasure.
The violet-robed girl extended her hand on the high platform. A black book appeared on her palm. This book looked like a black metallic cast, with a vague dark aura surrounding it.
“This is also another great treasure.” The violet-robed girl mentioned.
Xue Ying knew the moment he heard her speak, that this item would be worth several hundred Origin World Rocks since it was a great treasure.
“There was once an outstanding ancient cultivator in the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World known as the ‘Dark World Master’.” The violet-robed girl said, “I believe many cultivators present should know of him.”
Xue Ying was stunned.
Knew of him?
He had never heard of him.
“He might be at the Unity realm, but he had gotten through the sixth level of Star Pagoda.” The violet-robed girl said, “His power is comparable to Primal Chaos realm experts!”
Xue Ying was stunned. Gotten through the sixth level of Star Pagoda? Currently, in this generation of Great Void Heaven Temple, there was not a single Inner Hall Elder in the Great Void Heaven Temple who had gotten through the sixth level successfully.
“The absolute art which he created is known as “Dark World”.” The violet-robed girl looked at the black book in her hand before sighing out, “It’s a pity that he eventually died at the Unity realm. Otherwise, with his potential, the moment he reaches the Primal Chaos realm, he will be much stronger than me. He should likely be able to get through the eighth level of Star Pagoda, though not the ninth level.”
“Being an ancient cultivator, he specialized most in controlling the illusory realm world. The illusory realm world is originally good in trapping and confusing the enemies. It is weaker in terms of offense. But nevertheless, he had blazed a new trial and created a new world for the sake of making it a killing move. And this world is created for killing.”
“The enemies could not get close to him when the energy of the world condenses into a killing move with an extremely horrifying offense.”
The violet-robed girl was still explaining this absolute art. After all, she wanted to attract cultivators to buy it. As long as others understood what absolute art it was, and how formidable it was in a certain aspect, everyone would judge for themselves if it was appropriate.
Xue Ying felt turmoil in his mind.
It was like a thunder splitting apart the darkness, brightening the place.
“A world created purely for the sake of forming a killing move?”
“A world all for the sake of a single killing move?”
“Condensing the world energy into a single killing move?”
A miraculous column of light immediately flashed in Xue Ying’s mind. Sometimes, a person lacked just that single idea. And the direction of how the “Dark World” absolute art was created made Xue Ying discover startingly, that he specialized most in the ‘Dao of Mirage’. Even though he had no cosmos ranked absolute arts specializing in the Dao of Mirage, he was still able to step into the Void God level.
But the Dao of Mirage was not specialized in combat. Thus, Xue Ying could not make heads or tails of it.
But now, it seemed he was enlightened in the direction.
“Killing move. Creating a world for the sake of forming a killing move.”
Xue Ying felt many ideas forming in his mind. But he understood himself that it was challenging despite having the idea to actually creating a preliminary prototype, test it, refine it and altering it. Creating an extremely horrifying absolute art was much more difficult.
His Wind Ripple Path and Fish Dragon Kill were both based on cosmos ranked absolute arts. Otherwise, he would spend a very long time trying to create something from nothing.
‘This absolute art is something I must get!’ Xue Ying immediately decided there and then.
“There is only a single copy of the original book of this “Dark World”. Since it is a lone book, the starting bid is 150 Origin World Rocks.” The violet-robed girl declared.
The surrounding turned silent.
Nobody called out a price.
“151 Origin World Rocks.” Xue Ying stood by the window. He held himself back momentarily before shouting out. His voice reverberated around the high platform and also across all pavilions in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World.

chapters.title: Chapter 835 - Dark World
chapters.content:
Chapter 835: Dark World
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the house, Pavilion Master Yu Qi stood by the side chuckling: “Elder Dong Bo wishes to learn this absolute art? Usually, such absolute arts are precious, and it is likely that the final price will be high. Those who do not wish to learn this absolute art would not be willing to bid at all. Looking at the situation this time, it seems that there aren’t many who wants this book, which is a good thing since the final price would not be that high.”
Xue Ying nodded.
He himself had a massive talent in the aspect of Mirage. In the Great Void Heaven Temple Myriad Elephant Palace Hall, he had read through many books, but in the end, he did not attain great accomplishments in many aspects! There were just three who had reached the final realm in the laws and profound mysteries system, including the primogenitor, ‘Ancestor Cang’! There were not many who had entered the Primal Chaos realm as well… thus there were very few books written at a genuinely deep level. There were even fewer books in terms of the Mirage, and all of them were lacking in offense.
There was only the “Dark World” which made Xue Ying saw some light.
Even without a cosmos ranked absolute art, Xue Ying was able to improve his Dao of Mirage at a much faster speed than the Dao of Ripple and Dao of Slaughter. If he were to obtain an appropriate absolute art, allowing him to study in it, he might even improve faster in this field!
Mirage…
He had once comprehended the True Meaning of Mirage as a Transcendent, and that was also the first Dao he had opened! Now that he found an appropriate absolute art, he would naturally not miss this opportunity!
‘I wish there aren’t any competitors.’ Xue Ying looked forward to it. One less Origin World Rock he spent would be one more Origin World Rock he saved.
“152 Origin World Rocks.” A slightly cold voice came from another direction in the high platform.
Xue Ying frowned.
There were actually competitors.
“153 Origin World Rocks.” Xue Ying announced.
“200 Origin World Rocks.” That cold voice continued.
Xue Ying felt paralyzed momentarily. Something felt wrong. According to his previous experience of watching others call out the price, few would increase the bid by such a large amount unless the other party was someone who needed the item.
“201 Origin World Rocks.” Xue Ying continued.
“250 Origin World Rocks.” That cold voice continued.
“Brother Quan Miao, you are really determined to get it. 251 Origin World Rocks.” An old voice sounded.
Xue Ying felt his heart tightening.
Quan Miao?
That was one of the Primal Chaos realm giant living within the Primal Chaos void. He was called ‘Forefather Quan Miao’, and was someone who specialized in the illusory realm.
‘He is a Primal Chaos realm giant, yet he wishes to own the original copy of this absolute art? This is an absolute art created by a Unity realm expert, and to Forefather Quan Miao, its level seems too low.’ Xue Ying frowned. To Forefather Quan Miao, this absolute art would not improve his combat power. After all, even after cultivating this absolute art to grand perfection, the cultivator would at the most cross through the sixth level of Star Pagoda.
