This absolute art would only provide some inspiration for Forefather Quan Miao or maybe allow him to create some new moves.
But being inspired to create a new move was something originally difficult already.
“300 Origin World Rocks.” The cold voice continued.
“301 Origin World Rocks.” Xue Ying calmly said.
“I wonder what friend is this who wants to compete with me?” The cold voice said, “350 Origin World Rocks.”
Xue Ying felt slightly anxious. He was not afraid of Forefather Quan Miao since he was a member of the Great Void Heaven Temple, and there were no reasons for him to be fearful of a roaming Primal Chaos existence
But.
He had too few treasures. Those treasures which he could sell had already been valued by Pavilion Master Yu Qi previously-at a total of 385 Origin World Rocks. And now, that Forefather Quan Miao had already called out a price of 350 pieces. The moment it exceeded his limit, what should he do?
“Pavilion Master Yu Qi, I have a matter which I have to trouble you for.” Xue Ying said to Pavilion Master Yu Qi who was by his side, “Can you contact that Forefather Quan Miao, telling him that I am willing to use a price of 150 Origin World Rocks to learn this “Dark World” once? The moment I finished learning, the original copy will be returned to him. I’ll not compete with him after that.”
“Impossible.”
Pavilion Master Yu Qi shook his head, “The rules of the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion state that the highest bid will win. It is impossible for us to allow you to negotiate with the other party. Furthermore, even if you negotiate with Forefather Quan Miao in public right before the window, the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion will isolate your voice.”
Xue Ying frowned.
Truly…
The Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion was all about selling at the highest price.
After Forefather Quan Miao reported the price of 350 Origin World Rocks, the other aged voice no longer continued. He was purely deliberately teasing this Forefather Quan Miao and was not willing to smash himself with his actions.
“351 Origin World Rocks.” Xue Ying continued.
Forefather Quan Miao went taciturn for a moment.
The violet-robed girl had already started saying, “351 Origin World Rocks. Fellow gentlemen, if there aren’t any more bids, then this absolute art will belong to-”
“400 Origin World Rocks.” Forefather Quan Miao once again stated a higher price.
Xue Ying’s expression changed.
400 pieces…
What should he do?
“Elder Dong Bo, you aren’t able to bid anymore.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi reminded him by the side, “Your limit of bidding is only 385 Origin World Rocks. Unless you bring out more treasures.”
Xue Ying frowned. He might have other great treasures, but the majority of them could not be sold. All he could sell is his own weapon! And also that ‘Supplementary Spiritual Fruit’. In his heart, this ‘Supplementary Spiritual Fruit’ was not something that could not be sold too since the stronger he was, it would be easier for him to obtain treasures that would be more helpful in cultivation than this fruit.
Furthermore, if he got the original copy of the book, he could always sell it in the future!
“Are you able to temporarily lend me some Origin World Rocks?” Xue Ying asked. He was an Inner Hall Elder of Great Void Heaven Temple, and what did it mean with his identity to owe someone Origin World Rocks?
Pavilion Master Yu Qi could see that this item was something Elder Dong Bo really wanted. But he still shook his head: “The rules can’t be disobeyed unless Elder Dong Bo brings out treasures as collateral! Only then are we willing to lend some Origin World Rocks to Elder Dong Bo, and the item you put as collateral will be temporarily kept by us.”
Xue Ying continued, “I have two million contribution points, are those able to be put up as collateral?”
“The contribution points of the Great Void Heaven Temple can be put up as collateral.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi continued. After all, the contribution points of the Great Void Heaven Temple could be used to exchange for many treasures, “But the two million contribution points could at most be used to lend you 160 Origin World Rocks.”
“Alright.” Xue Ying nodded.
“I’ve already checked. Elder Dong Bo has two million contribution points. You can now continue to call out higher prices.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi said.
“401 Origin World Rocks.” Xue Ying continued speaking.
…
This time, it was Forefather Quan Miao who felt frustrated. Forefather Quan Miao sat there sullenly. He held onto a cup of wine placed on the table in front of him and lightly sipped: ‘Who is it that is fighting with me? Every time I call out a price, he’ll increase the bid by one. I’ve always been searching for this original copy of “Dark World”, and it might be helpful to my cultivation. But now, it seems a competitor has appeared.’
The price had increased to this stage. He felt hesitant.
After all, a Primal Chaos realm giant did not have that many Origin World Rocks too, and this was merely an absolute art created by a Unity realm expert. To him as a Primal Chaos realm existence, its value was limited-it would at most enlighten him in a new direction of cultivation. And it would no longer be helpful after that.
“500 Origin World Rocks.” Forefather Quan Miao directly uttered coldly. His cold voice transmitted out through the window. At the same time, it resounded in the distant Celestial Water City Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion too.
“Almost there.”
Forefather Quan Miao made his decision in his heart, ‘This is the limit of what I would fork out for the “Dark World”. If it is any higher, I’ll just give it up. Mn, with such a high price, the other party should be feeling heartache too.’
He was waiting.
Waiting for the other party to call out a price.
“501 Origin World Rocks.” That voice remained as calm as ever.
It seemed that he would always add one more Origin World Rock no matter how much Forefather Quan Miao bid.
Forefather Quan Miao snorted indignantly. The wine cup held in his right hand had been smashed into smithereens. Very soon, along with the reminder of the violet-robed girl, since there were no longer any new bids, she finally announced: “The “Dark World” is sold at 501 Origin World Rocks. And now, the next treasure…”
Forefather Quan Miao turned to the pavilion master who was here accompanying him, ordering to him: “The contest for the original copy of “Dark World” has ended. Your Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion should be able to contact that person who got the “Dark World”. Tell him that I am willing to fork out 150 Origin World Rocks to learn this “Dark World” once.”

chapters.title: Chapter 836 - Breathtaking
chapters.content:
Chapter 836: Breathtaking
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Over at the side of Celestial Water City.
Xue Ying felt really nervous. This was the first time he thought he had ever gotten an appropriate absolute art for his Dao of Mirage system. For the creator to get through the sixth level of Star Pagoda at the Unity realm, it meant this absolute art was indeed formidable and was close in rank to a cosmos-ranked absolute art! Even the Inner Hell Elders in Great Void Heaven Temple who cultivated in cosmos-ranked absolute arts, could not get through the sixth level of Star Pagoda. Naturally, it was also because of their weak comprehension ability.
For instance, theoretically speaking, an expert at the Unity realm could comprehend the sixth sword of the “13 Apocalyptic Swords”. The moment he grasped that, the cultivator would have a 100% certainty in getting through the sixth level of Star Pagoda.
But none had achieved that at least in this generation of Inner Hall Elder!
‘It can’t be higher anymore, it can’t be higher anymore.’ Xue Ying was genuinely nervous. Previously, he only had 385 Origin World Rocks, and after putting aside his contribution points as collateral, he was able to loan another 160 Origin World Rocks. Even though he had some scattered pieces of treasures, he was very close to his upper spending limit.
When that violet-robed girl finally announced the result, Xue Ying revealed a joyous look.
“Congratulations, Elder Dong Bo.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi said.
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded, “It’s a pity that the price is slightly high.”
“Elder Dong Bo, after learning this original copy of “Dark World”, you can always sell it away.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi said, “You can also ask the Great Void Heaven Temple and see what price they are willing to buy it for, though this will likely not be any higher than the price you paid this time.”
Xue Ying nodded.
That’s right.
The starting bid was only 150 Origin World Rocks. He had competed with that Forefather Quan Miao all the way to 501 Origin World Rocks! This price was truly exorbitant. If not for him assaulting that base of Ancient Sacred Religion, it was impossible for Xue Ying to call out such an amount.
“Elder Dong Bo, there is good news.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi suddenly revealed a joyous look, “Don’t you feel that you purchased the book at such a high price? Forefather Quan Miao has just contacted you through my Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion. He says he is willing to fork out 150 Origin World Rocks for the sake of learning this absolute art once. The original copy will still belong to you.”
“Forefather Quan Miao?” Xue Ying had long guessed the other party wanted to contact him, just like how he wanted to contact him previously.
It’s only that all forms of communication were forbidden during the contest of treasure. Now that the contest for the treasure had ended, they could talk to each other.
“Tell him, 300 Origin World Rocks.” Xue Ying said.
“300 Origin World Rocks just to learn it once?” Pavilion Master Yu Qi was slightly speechless.
“Just pass this on to him.” Xue Ying said.
“Alright.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi nodded.
Xue Ying turned silent as he looked at Ming Yu Planet Master continuing her task of selling other treasures on the high platform. He had his reasons for asking 300 Origin World Rocks. Since the other party was willing to fight for the absolute art until the price of 500 Origin World Rocks, in addition to his own estimation, the other party should be acquiring this for the sake of gaining some inspiration. Thus, learning it once was fine, and the original copy wasn’t that important to the other party.
The original book had its value, but its value was limited. It should be at most 200 to 300 Origin World Rocks.
Learning it once for 300 Origin World Rocks… should be the limit of what the other party could bear. And since he now had the initiative as the seller, he might as well ask for a higher price. He would try to earn as many Origin World Rocks as he could.
“Forefather Quan Miao has replied.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi looked at Xue Ying, “He said that it is too high. He will pay 220 Origin World Rocks at most.”
“Tell him, I bought the original copy at a higher price. The lowest price I am willing to accept would be 280 Origin World Rocks.” Xue Ying replied.
The two might be saying that this was the highest and lowest price, yet they were still bargaining over it.
One party was a Primal Chaos realm giant, and the other party was an Inner Hall Elder of the Great Void Heaven Temple. They were continuously competing for either more or less Origin World Rocks depending on whether they were a buyer or seller.
Because everyone understood!
These were all for cultivation. It would suffice as long as both parties agreed with the final price. To Xue Ying, there were not too many who were willing to pay a high price for the “Dark World”. It seemed the contest for this absolute art was only between him and Forefather Quan Miao. Secondly, those who could afford it were even fewer. Thus, it was hard to meet someone who was willing to pay a high price even if it was just to learn the absolute art once.
He had to secure a high price now that he met one!
Eventually, both parties agreed at 235 Origin World Rocks! Forefather Quan Miao would be learning it once.
…
The entire convention persisted for half a day before finally, the most important highlight of the convention, the great treasure ‘Cheng Qun’ was revealed. It was a peculiar leather skirt and seemed to be some sort of living being. The violet-robed girl introduced the treasure vaguely, but those who bid for it were crazy. In the end, the final selling price reached a sky-high 3,982 Origin World Rocks! This price made even Xue Ying dumbstruck.
“It seems to be some kind of outer skin of a living being?” Xue Ying muttered, “For it to be sold at such a high price, is it the outer skin of a Cosmos God?”
Even though he felt astonishment in his heart, he was still feeling relatively good as he returned to the secretive underground palace hall within this Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion.
At the center of the underground palace hall, there was an array of about 100 meters in diameter.
Pavilion Master Yu Qi stood side by side with Xue Ying. He pointed at the array in front: “This array is meant for marking a location accurately. Very soon, the expert on the other side will send the original copy of “Dark World” over.”
Xue Ying nodded.
Ultra-long distance teleportation…
It was hardest to teleport a living being. Sending treasures was relatively much easier. Like previously, Ancestor Desert had sent both him and Ancestor Devil to the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. Ancestor Desert only asked if Ancestor Devil had brought along any other subordinates of it without asking about his treasures. This was because treasures were dead, and they were relatively easy to send over.
“The original copy of “Dark World”, as agreed upon by you and Forefather Quan Miao, has been learned by Forefather Quan Miao already. That party had also forked out the 235 Origin World Rocks. You still have to pay 266 Origin World Rocks on your end.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi said.
“I’ll sell all these treasures away.” Xue Ying said before passing the storage wristband over to Pavilion Master Yu Qi.
Pavilion Master Yu Qi inspected it after taking: “Alright, in a while, I’ll pass to Elder Dong Bo 119 Origin World Rocks in a bit.”
“Weng.”
A warped spatial passage suddenly appeared in front of them.
A black book flew out from the passage. It gradually landed in the array before the passage soon dissipated.
Xue Ying’s eyes brightened and went up to take this book immediately. This black metallic cast book had two distorted words on its surface. They meant ‘Dark World’, and naturally, it contained an illusory realm. The book even had black fog rolling about, and those with weaker souls might just be immersed into it.
He slowly read through the book.
“Weng!”
The words on the book immediately turned into seals that flew towards Xue Ying. They were entering the mind of Xue Ying.
Dark World.
This was an absolute art which had not been completed. That outstanding Unity realm expert had clearly illustrated ‘Dark World’ from the beginning. He wanted to create three great killing moves for the “Dark World”. The first style allowed the user to pass through the fifth level Star Pagoda, and the second to pass through the sixth. According to plan, there should be a third style which allowed the cultivator to get through the seventh level of Star Pagoda.
With the pride of the Dark World Master, he wanted to reach the limits of Unity realm in history-to get through the seventh level Star Pagoda as a Unity realm expert!
And the first two styles had been completed and recorded in the book. But the third style had not been recorded. That year, the creator had not created an even more formidable killing move before dying.
The first style of “Dark World” was ‘Dark Bubble’. It created a world that engulfed the enemy before swiftly turning small. It would turn small instantaneously. A huge world with the enemy encompassed within before turning small was just like a bubble trapping the enemy. But this bubble contained the energy of a world, and a world created for the sake of explosion. With a thought, this world would soon explode! With the destruction of the entire world, all living beings within the world would be exterminated too. Its power was extremely horrifying.
And the second style of the “Dark World” was the ‘Sky Punishment Edge’. This world was created in the form of a ‘blade edge’. The Sky Punishment Edge would descend from the illusory realm abruptly. Most enemies could barely dodge it and would be killed by this blade! The Dark World Master would stand at his original position before sending a ‘Sky Punishment Edge’ down from nothingness! It would be used against the enemy, and with just this move, he had become famous across the five great sacred worlds, allowing him to be comparable with Primal Chaos realm giants at the Unity realm level.
It’s a pity he did not have the time to create the third style before dying.

chapters.title: Chapter 837 - Qi Ya Incense Wood Cultivation Room
chapters.content:
Chapter 837: Qi Ya Incense Wood Cultivation Room
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As Xue Ying might seem to be grabbing on to the black book, yet in reality, he was already entirely immersed in this unfathomable illusory realm world absolute art created by Dark World Master. Creating an immense world for the sake of a killing move—such an idea was novel. He even created an absolute art based on this idea. This ‘Dark World Master’ was absolutely a talented person.
There were many outstanding talents across the hunmongous population living in the five great sacred worlds and the primal chaos void. There were even several Unity realm experts who had gotten through the seventh level of Star Pagoda. Some had even broken through to the final realm after entering closed-door cultivation in the sacred world for the first time-Swordmaster from the Great Void Heaven Temple!
To these geniuses, Xue Ying had great respect for them.
‘Dark World…’ Xue Ying’s had just received the detailed information of this absolute art in his mind when he felt himself becoming absorbed into it.
It was the indubitably true that the easiest way to alter or create a world would be to use the illusory realm!
Because illusions were easy to alter.
Xue Ying’s ‘Dao of Mirage’ was similar. Changing the real world was extremely difficult, but he could arrange how the Mirage would turn out to be. First, Xue Ying would create the Mirage World! Then, he would turn the ‘Mirage into reality’. After all, the Mirage encompassed reality, and turning it into reality… was something Xue Ying could easily accomplish at his current realm. He could already convert part of the Mirage into reality when he was at the Opening realm, much less now!
Creating a Mirage first before constructing a perfect world as a killing move. After that, turn it into reality! And the killing move would descend!
‘Dark Bubble.’ Revelations began flashing across the mind of Xue Ying.
Of the three Daos, Xue Ying’s talent in the Dao of Mirage was the highest. At this moment as he was studying this Dark World absolute art, all sorts of revelations and insights had formed immediately.
“Pavilion Master Yu Qi.” Xue Ying suddenly opened his eyes and turned to Pavilion Master Yu Qi by the side.
“Elder Dong Bo.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi said. He looked at this Elder Dong Bo who had become engrossed in the absolute art the moment Xue Ying received it, causing him to feel slightly puzzled. After all, it was a Unity realm genius who wrote this absolute art, and there should not be many pieces of information provided within. Receiving this inheritance should be quick, yet why was Elder Dong Bo stuck there immersed in this art for so long? Nevertheless, he did not dare disturb Xue Ying.
“Quickly bring me over to the best cultivation room in your Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion.” Xue Ying ordered immediately, “Remember, the best one.”
“Yes.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi’s eyes brightened, “Please follow me.”
“Sou.”
Even though the cultivation room in his courtyard was not bad, compared to the best cultivation room in Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion which specialized in trading, it was way too lacking!
“Origin ranked cultivation room.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi introduced the place as he brought Xue Ying over, “This is the best cultivation room in our Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion. This cultivation room is made using the ‘Qi Ya Incense Wood’. The Qi Ya Incense Wood will persistently release a fragrance that is really helpful to cultivation. A complete Qi Ya Incense Wood will emit fragrance for a total of 300 million years before it finishes and turns into trash. One will have to replace it with a new Qi Ya Incense Wood.”
“Thus, during most circumstances, the time in this origin ranked cultivation room is stopped.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi said, “Once a cultivator enters, time will regain its usual flow. The price of cultivating within… is 1,000 Origin World Rocks every 100 million years, and also one Origin World Rock per 100,000 years.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying nodded.
He had never considered cultivating for an extended period inside. If he were doing so, he would definitely return to the ‘Palace Hall of Time’. After all, Xue Ying would not waste so much of his time.
What he planned was to undergo a short period of cultivation!
Because this was his first time viewing the ‘Dark World’, Xue Ying had gained many flashes of inspiration. This was also the best chance for him to enter closed-door cultivation. Furthermore, Xue Ying decided to select the best cultivation room so as to turn these flashes of inspiration into comprehension and combat power!
One Origin World Rock for every 100,000 years was truly extravagant. But Xue Ying was willing to spend this amount.
“Is it possible for me to practice in the cultivation room too?” Xue Ying asked.
“As long as the power of the attack doesn’t surpass the Primal Chaos realm level, it’ll be fine.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi said, “The array in this cultivation room has been personally set by someone at the level of a Hall Master.”
“Mn.”
Within the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion, there was a vast expanse of lake and a wooden cultivation room. It was just that time was stopped in the region where the room was located at.
“Please.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi said.
Xue Ying directly pushed the wooden door open. At that moment, the flow of time in the room regained its usual speed. After Xue Ying entered the room, the wooden door automatically closed up!
An extremely insipid fragrance pervaded the cultivation room, though it sufficed in letting Xue Ying feel comfortable. He immediately sat down cross-legged and began cultivating on the ‘Dark World’; he did not waste any time. With a ‘hua’, an illusory realm appeared in midair of this cultivation room. This world was entirely dark, and it contained countless mysterious patterns moving on it. The entire world was continuously changing.
Day passed by day.
In a restaurant not far away from Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion, there was a short and plump male who stayed here for a long period. The expression of ‘Forefather Black Loathe’s changed over time.
‘Why is he not coming out?’
‘According to what I know, the treasure convention should have ended half a month ago!’ Forefather Black Loathe felt anxious. Because Xue Ying’s void penetration was too fast, and he could travel to his residence from the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion in the blink of an eye. As a result, Forefather Black Loathe had to maintain the highest form of alert since there was only an instance for him to intervene Xue Ying before he penetrated through the void!
But he had been maintaining this state of highest alert for one day, and then two days. Before he knew it, half a month had passed.
He did not dare to relax in this period of half a month, and Forefather Black Loathe was a Primal Chaos realm giant who had emerged at the earliest period before the destruction of the primitive Ancient Sacred World. Being forced to keep on guard for so long with this identity, he was full of grievances.
‘Return.’
Forefather Black Loathe did not stay in the restaurant anymore. He went back to the little courtyard he bought.
He no longer had the mood to maintain this highest state of alert. Instead, he just formed a strand of thought to envelop the surrounding of the region outside Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion and Xue Ying’s residence.
‘I don’t believe that he’ll stay inside forever.’ Forefather Black Loathe decided to wait until the moment Xue Ying goes out for a walk before acting. Time? He had plenty of it!
******
Xue Ying was indeed inspired by the “Dark World”. If one said that he had to spend quite an effort in training the Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple, then he was cultivating the Dao of Mirage to his heart’s content!
Within the Qi Ya Incense Wood cultivation room.
Xue Ying who was seated cross-legged. There was a half-translucent dark world in the surrounding void. It was currently emitting a terrifying aura. Countless enigmatic imprints were revolving in this dark world.
‘I’m almost there.’
Xue Ying opened his eyes frowning.
He had already spent 70,000 years in this cultivation room, and had already comprehended the first style of the Dark World, the ‘Dark Bubble’. But as he comprehended more and more, he realized an issue! The Dark World he created must be one perfect entity to turn it into the ‘Dark Bubble’.
In order to reach a grand perfection entity, it would not be appropriate for him to use the ‘Mirage Law System’-based on the Dao of Mirage-to guide the other laws in forming a system.
He had to take an additional step!
He had to evolve the Mirage Law System into the ‘Mirage Origin’! Only when the Dao of Mirage had reached the ‘Mirage Origin’ level could his control of the Mirage reach grand perfection, and only then could he unleash the Dark Bubble.
Thus, it was a pre-requisite for him to reach the Unity realm in the Dao of Mirage to display the first style of the Dark World!
During this 70,000 years of cultivating the ‘Dark World’, he had comprehended many things which allowed him to inch closer to the ‘Mirage Origin’ level. He wanted to reach perfection and unity in one fell swoop! He desired to turn his Dao of Mirage into a Mirage Origin, yet he felt that he lacked that final bit which frustrated Xue Ying. How could he take that last step?
‘This final bottleneck.’ Xue Ying gritted his teeth.
‘I must try to break through it.’
Xue Ying flipped his hand, causing a crystal box to appear. This box was translucent, and he was able to see a violet fruit within. It was none other than the most precious material meant for aiding in cultivation, the ‘Supplementary Spiritual Fruit’.
In his original plan, he would first reach Unity realm in the Voidwalker system! Nevertheless, he had a newfound opportunity, when he got his hands on the “Dark World” absolute art. But to control the first style of the Dark World, the ‘Dark Bubble’, he had to reach unity in the Dao of Mirage. During cultivation, he would naturally inch closer to the Unity realm, and now, he had reached the final bottleneck stage.
This absolute art Dark World was beneficial and critical in improving his combat power.
He also had a great talent in the Mirage! There was also the ‘Qi Ya Incense Wood cultivation room’ which gave him the best environment for cultivation.
Now that he had reached the bottleneck, it was possible that Xue Ying might be stuck here for a long time before breaking through.
‘Time to use the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit.’ Xue Ying looked at the fruit in the crystal box in his hands.
The Supplementary Spiritual Fruit was extremely precious. Usually, only new golden-robed disciple would get it. It could not be bought.
But the highest level in the Great Void Heaven Temple had the qualifications to get it. Like the two Palace Masters, the Hall Masters and Inner Hall Elders, if they truly wanted it, they could get it. After becoming an Inner Hall Elder, Xue Ying had casually flipped through the cosmos ranked absolute arts, and many precious treasures could actually be exchanged with contribution points. A golden-robed disciple could only exchange for a limited range of treasures.
An Inner Hall Elder could trade for three Supplementary Spiritual Fruits at most in their entire life. Each required 600,000 contribution points.
They could even exchange for treasures that were better than the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit in aiding cultivation, and the price was naturally higher.
But precisely because of this, Xue Ying decided to use the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit! The stronger he was, the more treasures he had, and he would be able to acquire better materials than the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit.
‘Let me first sample it and feel the effects. Just this piece costs about 50 Origin World Rocks.’ Xue Ying opened the crystal box, bringing out the violet fruit. He bit off a mouth, and his eyes brightened. He continued biting a few times with sounds of ‘ka cha ka cha’ before entirely consuming this fruit.

chapters.title: Chapter 838 - Unity
chapters.content:
Chapter 838: Unity
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the Qi Ya Incense Wood cultivation room, after the cross-legged Xue Ying bit on the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit, he felt a cool feeling streaming down his throat before coursing through his entire body. It had transmitted to his soul as well, allowing his soul to feel icy-cool. He could even observe revelations forming in his mind regarding perplexities he had with the Dao of Mirage, and also many ideas of breaking through his limits.
This brought him great joy. He hurriedly finished eating the entire Supplementary Spiritual Fruit so that he could fully concentrate on the Dao of Mirage.
An icy-cool soul accelerated his thinking and allowed many revelations to appear…
It was dull when one had a bottleneck because it would cause the cultivator to feel helpless at that stage; the cultivator’s mind would feel blank, and he would not know how to break through! That was why cultivators chose to go out on adventures and to battle or train in other absolute arts. They had to think of different methods to break through amidst their vast accumulation of experiences!
Flashes of Inspiration were naturally very precious.
Xue Ying had only utilized his ‘Dao of Mirage’ as a way of forming incarnations; it was never really fully utilized. After viewing the “Dark World” absolute art for the first time, he felt flashes of inspiration gushing out like spring water. That was why Xue Ying immediately chose to enter closed-door cultivation and had even extravagantly spent his time in the most precious cultivation room of Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion, the ‘Qi Ya Incense Wood cultivation room’. He had indeed gained greatly during his cultivation there for 70,000 years, allowing him to reach an extremely high comprehension stage of the first style of Dark World, the ‘Dark Bubble’. He had even reached the limit of the Origin Birth realm in his Dao of Mirage.
But over the 70,000 years, he could feel a dwindle in the revelations he was getting, and eventually, Xue Ying met a bottleneck.
From then on, Xue Ying would have to push apart this bottleneck according to the usual rule! For instance, cultivating for ten to twenty billion years within the ‘Palace Hall of Time’. That might enable him to break through into the Unity realm. This time period was calculated after taking into account his great comprehension abilities.
Another way would be for Xue Ying to seek for opportunities and to battle others.
Other than that, there was another very extravagant idea! That was to rely on materials that aided cultivation!
Items like the ‘Supplementary Spiritual Fruit’ were things Xue Ying had never used before. This was his first time. The reason why he elected to use it this time was because this pertained his own cultivation. The other reason was that he had to first see how the effects were before giving it to his wife Jing Qiu or son Yu’er to use!
And the results were tremendously good!
‘For the Mirage Law System to reach unity, everything has to return back to the single origin.’ Xue Ying felt many flashes of inspiration in his mind. He immediately began to ponder over them. At this moment, his efficiency of comprehension was extremely quick…
Unity realm.
Experts at this realm were considered at the lead across the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void. They would have different strengths according to the difficulty of cultivating the systems. Like the bloodline cultivation system, Ancestor Mother Religion system and the Devour class system, those at the Unity realm were relatively weaker! And those who cultivated the ‘hex’ system and ‘laws and profound mysteries’ system would be much stronger.
The Unity realm experts at the laws and profound mysteries had to cultivate for a very long period. It was not hard for them to get through the third level of Star Pagoda. Of which, the more formidable ones could get through the fourth level, and the talented ones could get through the fifth.
Xue Ying belonged to the incredibly talented category. He could get through the third level of Star Pagoda at the Origin Birth realm!
Seated cross-legged over there, Xue Ying suddenly opened his eyes. His pupils were pitch black and were filled with life. This was the aura of extreme grand perfection. He felt as if he was a god weapon which had been reforged countless time. His aura was extremely condensed, and the illusory realm world which appeared in the surrounding had abruptly shrunk and condensed into a small point.
This point was tiny.
It was extremely condensed and pure! It was much more stable than the illusory realm world previously.
“Unity realm.”
Xue Ying muttered softly.
…
His inner world.
“Hong long long~” The large planet which was initially as big as the Sun-Star, had been operating according to the previous ‘Mirage Law System’. At this moment, the planet converged into a single point after reaching unity—this was the new ‘Mirage Origin’ of the Dao of Mirage when it reached a new level. Everything was united as one, and it also formed the ultimate origin of the Mirage.
The huge planet was rumbling with ‘hong long long’. It rotated and was continuously collapsing and turning small.
The originally large planet on the size of the Sun-Star turned smaller by ten times, hundred times, thousand times, ten thousand times, a million times, trillion times… it was even smaller than an ordinary planet. It had a diameter smaller than 100 meters, and was even smaller than a human’s fist… during this process of collapse, its density was also rapidly increasing to an unfathomable stage.
Experts at the Unity realm, such as those who cultivated the ‘strongest warrior system’ would usually increase the density of their body. They would increase it to a horrifying stage, and their body would become very tough. Their bodies might even match the might of Void God weapons. Thus, in the ‘strongest warrior system’, Unity realm experts usually had great combative standards, and it wasn’t tough for them to get through the third level of Star Pagoda. The more heaven-shaking ones could even get through the fifth level. In history, there was one who got through the seventh level, and he cultivated the strongest warrior system. That time, his body had reached an exaggerated stage that was comparable to an upper-graded Void God weapon!
“Hu~”
The planet which was originally as big as the Sun-Star had been shrunken to an extreme and turned into a black point. It was hard to perceive given how small it was. It could no longer be judged according to the ideology of physics. Instead, it was purely a single ‘point’ of energy.
The space surrounding it was collapsing and warping.
The ‘Mirage Origin’s law had turned into its survival core. Without the Mirage Origin law, its terrifying energy would likely explode apart. Xue Ying’s body would also explode and turn into pieces.
‘Mirage Origin’
‘That is also the origin of everything.’
‘And also the origin for the cosmos in the future.’
Xue Ying understood this point. This single point of origin was the true origin of the final realm in the laws and profound mysteries system.
It was only from this point would it eventually form the final miniature primal chaos cosmos. That was the true embryonic form of the cosmos. Having this cosmos in the body, the Primal Chaos realm giants at the laws and profound mysteries system would be more powerful. Naturally, as long as one reached the Primal Chaos realm, cultivators who trained in other systems would become more powerful! And if they were to create a world within the primal chaos void, they could even form a cosmos within.
And therein they would reach the final realm—Cosmos God!
That was built from the transformation of the source to cosmos, and also the ultimate origin which was formed at the Unity realm.
“Weng.” Within his mind, his true deity heart immediately began linking and consolidating the law of the newly comprehended ‘Mirage Origin’ in his soul. He could see his soul turning bright and reserved. His soul had undergone qualitative changes and became much more condensed. His comprehension and deduction speed had also rapidly increased! The higher his realm, the faster his speed of comprehension. Thus, those at the Cosmos God level could create a cosmos and even comprehend many terrifying absolute arts that could destroy sacred worlds.
That was a strength which many desired.
…
After opening his eyes, Xue Ying revealed a joyous look. He had used the Dao of Mirage to step into the Unity realm. Xue Ying was unexpectedly surprised that he could actually reach this realm in such a short period. He was for the first time, stronger in his laws and profound mysteries system than that of the Voidwalker system, breaking through a major realm in it first!
‘I’ve spent about 2,300 years after eating the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit. And now, I’ve broken to the Unity realm.’ Xue Ying felt the coldness still in his soul, ‘The mystical energy inherent in the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit hasn’t been fully consumed. Continue cultivating!’
He did not want to waste it the effects of the fruit.
The Supplementary Spiritual Fruit would usually persist for a period after eating it. During this period, Xue Ying would be able to cultivate at an optimal level.
‘Dark World!’ Xue Ying continued cultivating this absolute art. He had just grasped the Mirage Origin recently, and the previous first style of the ‘Dark World, Dark Bubble’ was already in his grasp, albeit he was stuck previously because his own realm was not profound enough. Now that his Dao of Mirage had broken through, he had reached the Mirage Origin level. This realm sufficed for him to easily comprehend the first style of Dark World, Dark Bubble. Previously, what he could not see through could be seen through now. Many perplexities he had were rapidly solved. Flashes of Inspiration continued forming in his mind…

chapters.title: Chapter 839 - Going out for a Walk
chapters.content:
Chapter 839: Going out for a Walk
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was seated cross-legged. The illusory Dark World appeared again and again in his surroundings. At times, this world would shake unstably.
But gradually, this ‘Dark World’ became more stable.
‘It is really complex.’
‘The closer I am to success, the more mystical the structure of this Dark World becomes.’ Xue Ying praised this absolute art in his heart. This Dark World was created for the sake of being annihilated. The more stable it was, the stronger the energy it could contain and thus, the more destructive it would be during the final annihilation! Xue Ying was pondering over the perplexities he had, and gradually…
He began clearing up his doubts about this style!
In the end, Xue Ying was finally enlightened. He had grasped the Dark World’s first style, ‘Dark Bubble’ clearly without having any confusion about it!
‘I’ve succeeded?’ Xue Ying looked towards the wall of the Qi Ya Incense Wood cultivation room with shock. The insipid fragrance was still drifting across his nose.
‘Just like this, I succeeded in cultivating the first style of the Dark World?’ Xue Ying was still slightly apprehensive.
Although Xue Ying knew he would comprehend the technique sooner or later after grasping the Mirage Origin and stepping into the Unity realm, he still felt complicated after fully understanding the first style.
Because he knew what this represented!
This absolute art had two styles in total.
After grasping the first style, Xue Ying would be able to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda. He would be considered a genuinely heaven-shaking expert amongst those at the Unity realm. Even when he faced the true body of a Primal Chaos realm giant, it was possible for him to survive. Across the five great sacred worlds, Xue Ying could be considered an expert within a region. Facing any other Unity realm experts even if they were at the peak, he could sweep across them regardless.
The fifth level meant that he had reached the boundary of Primal Chaos realm, and was much closer to the strength of a true Primal Chaos realm giant.
‘Previously, I might have the Black Gourd, but firstly, to activate the Black Gourd, I would have to unplug the cork and release the fireball. This requires a short period that I might not have in response to when an assassination happens.’ Xue Ying was clear of this point. The protective treasure was ultimately an external strength, and it was slightly lacking, ‘Although it might have great power, it is too crude with how it is utilized. It is purely about ‘smashing’ things. If I meet a true expert who got through the fifth level of Star Pagoda, he can easily make fun of me.’
That was his previous weakness-having great power but weak realm! It was only because the strongest sacred emissary in the base of Ancient Sacred Religion was at the peak of Unity realm, which gave him the chance to completely unleash the full strength of the Black Gourd fireball.
If he met someone stronger, the fireball of the Black Gourd would unlikely be able to touch the enemy.
‘Right now, my weakness in terms of the realm has been covered.’ Xue Ying revealed a grin.
Xue Ying’s finger lightly tapped out.
“Hu!”
Over at his fingertip, an illusory Dark Bubble appeared. This Dark Bubble was a few meters in diameter, and closely following that, the ‘illusory turned into reality’. During this process, it absorbed the surrounding World Energy. Closely following that, it rapidly shrank and abruptly exploded with a ‘peng’. But the explosion only happened in the space within the bubble. The destroyed void formed a piece of blackness. This was still a sacred world, and how stable was the void? Regardless, the void still shattered from the strike!
‘Even though the World Energy engulfed is small, by relying on the degree of profoundness the Dark Bubble has, this explosion power is much stronger than my previous spear technique.’ Xue Ying was merely practicing the technique and did not unleash it at its strongest.
If he were to display it at its full force, this technique would take in a much more considerable amount of World Energy and creating a tremendous disturbance!
‘There are still 8,000 years of effects from the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit.’ Xue Ying could still feel the coolness of his soul. The miraculous effect of this fruit had yet to diminish.
‘Hurry up and comprehend the Walker’s Hidden Secret!’ Xue Ying was not willing to waste any remaining energy this fruit had. He still had a long way to go before reaching Unity realm in his Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple. Comparatively speaking, he was close to breaking through with his ‘Walker’s Hidden Secret’!
Indeed.
Currently, his soul in the Unity realm was much stronger than previously. He had also eaten the fruit coupled with the aid from the Qi Ya Incense Wood cultivation room, allowing him to cultivate really quickly.
Just 300 years later, Xue Ying had broken through to the 30th level of Walker’s Hidden Secret!
And another 600 years passed…
“Ah.”
Xue Ying abruptly opened his eyes. He revealed a helpless look of regret, ‘The effects have desisted! There is no more energy left in the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit. Those days of high-speed cultivation have ended.’
At that moment when the cool feeling disappeared, Xue Ying felt the comprehension speed of his soul drastically reducing. This feeling of loss was unbearable.
‘Not bad. The effect of this fruit is really wondrous.’ Xue Ying was quite pleased with it, ‘I’ve used it for a total of 9,000 years. Previously, I was at the Origin Birth realm, and now, I am at the Unity realm! The effect from this fruit will naturally be consumed at an even faster pace. If it were Jing Qiu or Yu’er who ate it, their soul is much weaker than mine so the rate of consumption would be much slower. Furthermore, the effects on their cultivation would be better!’
Summarizing everything, materials used to aid in cultivation could indeed improve one’s comprehension power. The only flaw was its short duration.
But during this 9,000 years of cultivation, if Xue Ying were to spend them in the Palace Hall of Time, he would likely take about one to two billion years before breaking through to the Unity realm in his Dao of Mirage. And then he would spend another billion years before grasping the ‘Dark Bubble’.
After tasting the feeling of using a material meant for aiding cultivation, Xue Ying felt like he could not adapt to the usual slow cultivation speed temporarily.
‘The stronger I am, the weaker the effects of materials meant to aid in cultivation.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Eating the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit as an Origin Birth realm has provided me with really great help. But after stepping into the Unity realm, during my comprehension of the Dark Bubble, I could feel that the assistance the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit has provided me became weaker.”
‘I believe if I were to reach the Primal Chaos realm, its effect would be feeble.’
This fruit would be somewhat useful for Primal Chaos realm experts, but to Cosmos Gods, it would be utterly useless. Eating it was pointless.
Furthermore, such materials meant for aiding cultivation were too expensive and valuable. Thus, it was natural for cultivators to spend a long time cultivating. Only during crucial moments, like when they met some bottlenecks in a certain absolute art, would a Primal Chaos realm giant be willing to spend a few hundred Origin World Rocks to buy precious materials to facilitate their cultivation. But it would only aid in their cultivation, and they might end up remaining stuck at their bottlenecks!
These materials used for assisting cultivation were not miracle medicines! Xue Ying originally had a great talent in the Dao of Mirage, thus allowing him to attain such optimal effects. If not for eating the fruit, he would still succeed after spending a longer period!
…
Outside the Qi Ya Incense Wood cultivation room.
“Zhi ya.”
The door was pushed open. Xue Ying walked out of the room. Pavilion Master Yu Qi was currently waiting for him outside.
“It has been exactly 100,000 years. Elder Dong Bo should likely have a great harvest from closed-door cultivation… wu…” Pavilion Master Yu Qi was still passionately praising the other party when suddenly, he felt his expression stiffening. He said with shock, “Elder Dong Bo, you have reached the Unity realm?”
“Mn.” Xue Ying revealed a grin. He had come out after a full 100,000 years because he had to spend a single Origin World Rock even if he spent less than the period.
“Congratulations, congratulations.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi added, “Congratulations Elder Dong Bo. For you to step into the Unity realm so quickly, I believe you should be able to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda very soon.”
But he did not know that the current Xue Ying had enough power to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda.
Xue Ying’s talent on the Dao of Mirage was much higher than that on the Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple. He had grasped the True Meaning of Mirage at a very young age and had even grasped the ‘True Meaning of World’ as the first grade one True Meaning when he was a Transcendent. Clearly, his talent in the construct of a world was extremely great. That was why this ‘Dark World’ absolute art was incomparably suitable for him.
“After subtracting the one Origin World Rock used for this cultivation room, here is the remaining 118 Origin World Rocks for Elder.” Pavilion Master Yu Qi respectfully passed over a storage wristband.
Xue Ying checked through once after receiving it. Within the wristband contained many rocks emitting all sorts of color. Even with his current realm, he had an intense urge on his soul to eat these rocks.
“Many thanks.”
Xue Ying turned around and went in the direction out of the pavilion. Pavilion Master Yu Qi was also sending him off all the way to the front entrance of the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying looked at the sun high above the sky. This was the sun of the sacred world.
‘It has been a long time since I last saw the sun.’ Xue Ying’s current mood was excellent. The soar in his strength made him feel much broad-minded. With his current power, it would be much easier to obtain better materials for cultivation.
‘Let me go out and have a walk. Let’s go and find a good restaurant to have some good food.’ Xue Ying walked out of the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion with an uplift mood. He was strolling along the streets of the Celestial Water City and was going to find a good restaurant to enjoy himself!
…
‘Mn? He is out?’ Within a little courtyard, the plump and short male, ‘Forefather Black Loathe’ who had been seated cross-legged and was constantly releasing his senses, had suddenly opened his eyes. His golden eyes were filled with coldness, ‘He has made me, forefather, wait for long enough!’

chapters.title: Chapter 840 - Domain
chapters.content:
Chapter 840: Domain
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The short, plump male ‘Forefather Black Loathe’ could clearly sense Xue Ying leaving the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion and was currently strolling idly on the streets. He was not that anxious since he, Forefather Black Loathe, would be able to unleash his strongest power just by preparing slightly.
‘Mn?’
‘Unity realm?’
Forefather Black Loathe frowned after that, ‘No wonder he spent 100,000 years in the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion. So he has gotten some enlightenment and broken through to the Unity realm. This Dong Bo Xue Ying is considered to be a talent. His cultivation speed is quite fast. If I were to give him some more time, he might just consolidate his realm and improve his strength after comprehending the absolute art and would likely be able to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda. That will make things troublesome.’
‘But now?”‘Forefather Black Loathe’s eyes were filled with coldness.
The other party had just broken through, and his realm had not been converted into strength. Forefather Black Loathe did not mind it that much.
It was merely 100,00 years… the time period was too short! There was no place like the ‘Palace Hall of Time’ in the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion which could accelerate time constantly. Even if he ate some precious materials which aided his cultivation, a short 100,000 years would usually not allow him to improve greatly! But Forefather Black Loathe had never thought that Xue Ying’s talent in the Dao of Mirage was extremely great. He comprehended the ‘Dark World’ absolute art at an alarming speed and had eaten the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit. Xue Ying had already comprehended the first style of the Dark World.
‘He is an Inner Hall Elder and should have some protective treasures! The protective treasures which an Inner Hall Elder of the Great Void Heaven Temple has should be sufficient for him to defend against Primal Chaos realm experts. I must be fast! My attack must be so fast that he could not react in time to activate the protective treasures.’ Forefather Black Loathe was very clear of the difficulty of this assassination.
The moment the other party activated his treasures, even if his true body came, killing Xue Ying would take some time. By then, Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster of the Great Void Heaven Temple could likely descend!
‘I have a 50% certainty.’ Forefather Black Loathe turned solemn.
He was extremely confident of himself.
But to kill Xue Ying without letting the other party react in time to activate his protective treasure, Forefather Black Loathe could only dare to say that he was 50% sure!
…
On the streets, Xue Ying who had just become a Unity realm expert and grasped the absolute art felt really good. He was strolling along and watching the bustling of activities of the crowd around. There were many Deities and World Deities around, and even children at the Transcendent level. And the people he met on the streets had naturally avoided Xue Ying since the aura of a ‘Unity realm’ expert was different! It sufficed to make them feel reverence!
A Unity realm expert would be considered an expert no matter where he was placed. He could easily enter the Society of Deacons in the Celestial Water City! In the Ancient Sacred Religion, he could easily become a ‘Sacred Emissary’.
“Hong.”
The white-robed Xue Ying was originally smiling as he strolled, suddenly changed expressions.
“Who!”
A roar suddenly transmitted out.
The surrounding 500 kilometers of space had turned entirely silent. The crowd of people on the streets and the residents living in nearby places, no matter if they were weak Transcendents or the strong Unity experts! At this moment, everything had fallen into stillness. None of them were moving.
The region of 500 kilometers plunged into darkness.
This dark world enveloped the area of 500 kilometers and suppressed everything. Xue Ying was the emperor of this 500 kilometers region! The eyes of the white-robed Xue Ying were filled with killing intent as he turned to one of the areas in the dark world. Over there, a figure had appeared. This figure was the only one that could move within the entire dark world excluding Xue Ying.
He had a short and plump figure. He seemed ordinary, though his pair of golden eyes were looking at Xue Ying with shock.
‘So powerful!’ Xue Ying could feel the suppression coming from the other party after he revealed himself on his own law domain.
That’s right, law domain.
After becoming a True God Ruler, the cultivator would have attained an eternal law to form a domain. This domain would always be emitted around the cultivator, and in this region, Rulers could ‘turn words into law’. The moment enemies enter this region, they would immediately be discovered, unless their realm had reached an extremely high stage.
At the Void God stage, there was the Origin Birth realm, Unity realm, and Primal Chaos realm. As the realm of the cultivator increased, their law domains would gradually become bigger.
Of which—
In the same major realm, the differing profoundness of using the law would also alter the cultivator’s law domain, making them more perfect. And Xue Ying had reached the Unity realm in his Dao of Mirage and also grasped the ‘Dark World first style, Dark Bubble’. That allowed the operating laws of his law domain to reflect the method of ‘Dark Bubble’. And that was why his law domain was extremely mystical and powerful!
For him to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda at the Unity realm, the profoundness of this ‘Dark Bubble’ was quite extraordinary in its profoundness even to Primal Chaos realm experts!
Forefather Black Loathe, this ancient Primal Chaos realm expert might be able to sneak into ordinary Unity realm experts’ law domain. But Xue Ying was someone who could get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda. It was a dream if Forefather Black Loathe could sneak into Xue Ying’s law domain unnoticed.
…
Within the region of 500 kilometers, the piece of darkness was quiet.
The white-robed Xue Ying faced Forefather Black Loathe in the distant.
“Hong.” On the surface of Xue Ying’s body, many layers of golden light were emitted. It was the survival talisman which he got as an Inner Hall Elder.
During the moment he activated the protective treasure, with a thought, ‘hua~’ the illusory realm dark world of Xue Ying had descended into reality from nothingness. It immediately devoured the world energy, causing the energy across the entire Celestial Water City to vibrate. This dark world rapidly turned small and evaded all other cultivators. It had surrounded Forefather Black Loathe who stood at the center.
Forefather Black Loathe watched on. His golden eyes were looking at Xue Ying, though there was a smile on the edge of his mouth.
“You have just reached the Unity realm, yet the mysteriousness of your law domain had already become close to that of a miniature cosmos. It seems that you should be able to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda already. I am satisfied with my failure.” Forefather Black Loathe transmitted over directly. Closely following that, the dark world became so small like a bubble and enveloped around Forefather Black Loathe.
“Pa!”
The dark bubble suddenly exploded. Everything within was annihilated and turned into smithereens.
Forefather Black Loathe had a smile as he remained within the dark bubble. He looked at Xue Ying with rapt interest before he dissipated soundless.
Everything regained back its calmness.
The white-robed Xue Ying stood on the streets. The surface of his body was emitting a dazzling golden light. The surrounding dark world pervaded the place still, and Xue Ying was deliberately displaying his technique, expanding this dark world to a full five million kilometers in the region! In the sacred world, most Unity realm experts could only cover a distance of 500 kilometers with their law domain, and this ‘Dark Bubble’ move could maintain a span of five million kilometers if its full strength were to be displayed!
‘He really dissipated?’ Xue Ying frowned, ‘It seems he took the initiative to dissipate?’
The destructive strength of the dark bubble was indeed powerful, but Xue Ying did not feel any obstruction as the bubble went off. It seemed the other party did not resist and took the initiative to dissipate.
‘There aren’t any other suspicious people in the region of five million kilometers.’ Xue Ying was inspecting the place.
“Hong!”
The great protective array in the entire Celestial Water City was activated. Its colorful light was dazzling and resplendent, causing many inhabitants to look up with shock. The great protective array contained a power that caused the world to tremble.
And in the dark world of five million kilometers in range, the many inhabitants were shocked and doubtful as well. They could see the sun in the sky through this dark world, and they did not feel themselves being harmed.
“Sou.”
A figure teleported suddenly and appeared in midair. He was a male wearing a deep blue gown.
“Elder Dong Bo, what’s the matter?” The male in dark blue gown asked, “It seems that there was a powerful disturbance created here recently.”
It was the Dark Bubble being destroyed. Even though the destruction was kept within the inner section of the Dark Bubble, this degree of disturbance remained huge, causing the array spirit of the entire Celestial Water City array to be so frightened that he informed the sleeping incarnation of Celestial Water Hall Master.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying kept his Dark World. He also flew up to the side of the incarnation of Celestial Water Hall Master, albeit the protective golden light on his body was maintained. Xue Ying did not dare to be too careless.
“I’ve just encountered an assassination…” Xue Ying solemnly answered, “It should be an incarnation of some Primal Chaos expert.”

chapters.title: Chapter 841 - Traces
chapters.content:
Chapter 841: Traces
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Celestial Water City’s great protection array was completely activated, preventing any living being from escaping this place. This array was much stronger than the national protection array of a small nation like the Golden Wing Nation. This array had been personally refined by Forefather Tian Yu, and even Primal Chaos realm experts could not escape from it.
In the sky.
The Celestial Water Hall Master garbed in a blue gown was standing next to the white-robed Xue Ying.
“Assassination?” The expression of Celestial Water Hall Master changed, “You were assassinated?”
“Mn, he is very formidable. Fortunately, I’ve broken through to the Unity realm before this. Otherwise, I would have been in real danger.” Xue Ying solemnly stated. The other party was really stealthy. Fortunately, he had reconstructed his law domain according to the ‘Dark Bubble’, allowing him to discover the enemy.
If it were before he broke through, by relying on a law domain which he constructed according to the “Plate Ripple Diagram”, he would only be at the strength of someone who got through the third level of Star Pagoda. Xue Ying would not be sure he could discover the enemy.
If he could not do so…
Then the attacks of the enemy would have landed on him before he could notice the other party! If he were lucky, he might be able to activate his protective treasures before dying. If he wasn’t, he might just die!
“Who, who dares to assassinate an Inner Hall Elder of my Great Void Heaven Temple?” Celestial Water Hall Master looked down at the vast Celestial Water City below, “And he had done it in our primal chaos city.”
The Celestial Water Hall Master’s gaze landed on the area where the previous disturbances were created. That was where Xue Ying had utilized the Dark Bubble destruction.
“Hua~”
The surrounding scene went back in time.
Celestial Water Hall Master was checking through what had happened in the past. The white-robed Xue Ying appeared on the streets, and the surrounding was entirely dark. Following that, the scene of time reversal trembled and collapse.
“I am unable to investigate what had happened?” Celestial Water Hall Master gritted his teeth, “The other party is truly vigilant. He has prevented me from examining what had happened in the past.”
“Elder Dong Bo, were you able to recognize who the other party is?” Celestial Water Hall Master asked despite knowing that it was almost hopeless.
“No, I don’t. Amongst the Primal Chaos experts and Chaos Gods I know, he isn’t included.” Xue Ying said, “He should have changed his appearances.”
“Cosmos God? Haha, those with such a status would not come and assassinate you. It is too disgraceful for them.” Celestial Water Hall Master shook his head, “I wonder which Primal Chaos expert is so daring.”
This was an act that would make the Great Void Heaven Temple furious. It was normal for the other party to change his appearances and aura when assassinating others.
“Hurry back to the Great Void Heaven Temple. I’ve already reported this matter upwards. The Sky Palace Hall should be investigating on this matter as we speak. My Great Void Heaven Temple will definitely let this matter rest!” Celestial Water Hall Master said, “When searching for traces, other than using his body appearance and aura, there are many other methods. The other party believes he can escape from us? It isn’t that easy!”
“Mn.”
Xue Ying nodded. He had just broken through to the Unity realm and wanted to return to the Great Void Heaven Temple. Furthermore, the assassination this time had increased his alertness. Who was it that wanted to kill him? He should not have formed any huge enmity in the five great sacred worlds. His teacher ‘Gu Qi’ might have offended someone big, but Xue Ying had never revealed his identity.
******
At the next moment, Xue Ying immediately returned back to the Great Void Heaven Temple from the Celestial Water City.
Within the Great Void Palace Hall.
Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster were both seated at the highest area.
Below them were the other six hall masters. And by the two ends of the palace hall, there were the Inner Hall Elders. Xue Ying stood amongst them.
“Someone actually dares to assassinate an Inner Hall Elder of my Great Void Heaven Temple.” Forefather Tian Yu sat there coldly speaking, “Inquisitive Sky Hall Master, we’ll have to trouble you this time.”
“Alright. I am quite curious to see who is it that is so daring.”
One of the six hall masters stood up. He had a long silvery hair, and his skin was black. He was one of the more slightly unique hall masters in the Great Void Heaven Temple, the ‘Inquisitive Sky Hall Master’. The Inquisitive Sky Hall Master… could easily scout any location across the great five sacred worlds and primal chaos void even from within the Great Void Heaven Temple.
“Weng.”
The Inquisitive Sky Hall Master’s pair of black eyes were looking at the void ahead. A scene projection also appeared in the void. It was of the street in Celestial Water City. Xue Ying was currently strolling on this street when suddenly, an assassination descended.
The entire region of 500 kilometers became quiet.
Nobody was moving within that region of 500 kilometers. Only Xue Ying and that enemy of his could move.
“Mn?” Forefather Tian Yu, Swordmaster and the many Hall Masters and Inner Hall Elders were shocked. Such a formidable law domain!
Xue Ying was startled too. The Inquisitive Sky Hall Master was amazing. That assassin had messed up the time-space in that location, preventing the Celestial Water Hall Master from probing the past. But the Inquisitive Sky Hall Master could easily determine what happened.
“This short and plump male doesn’t look like any expert that I know. He must have changed his appearance and aura.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master said coldly, “As long as he acted, we can determine his identity from the moves he revealed.”
“He should be very vigilant, displaying some moves which he hasn’t publicized before.” The other hall masters added.
The experts across the five great sacred worlds specialized in different techniques.
According to their techniques, it was possible to accurately determine the possible identity of the murderer.
“Mn?”
The expressions of everyone present changed.
Because the scene of the void showed a protective golden light appearing on the surface of Xue Ying’s body before proceeding to the shrinkage of the dark world. It had turned into a dark bubble which directly annihilated that plump and short male. But Forefather Tian Yu, Swordmaster and the others had a high perception, and they could see that the plump and short fellow did not resist. He had taken the initiative to dissipate that incarnation of his.
But what made their expression change… was the power of this dark bubble!
Their expressions turned towards Xue Ying. Their eyes were filled with either shock, surprise, admiration, and bewilderment.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “You should be able to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda now right?”
“Reporting to Forefather.”
Xue Ying respectfully answered, “I’ve bought a lone copy of absolute art, the “Dark World” during the treasure convention of Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion. This absolute art is very appropriate for me, allowing me to break through to the Unity realm. Furthermore, I was able to grasp the first style of the Dark World, the ‘Dark Bubble’ in one fell swoop. Naturally, there is the help from the Supplementary Spiritual Fruit too.”
“I can discern that it is one of the moves which the Dark World Master became famous for in the past.” Of the six Hall Masters seated there, there was a black-haired old man who laughed out, “Previously, Elder Dong Bo was still at the Origin Birth realm. It has just been over 100,000 years which you spent in the Celestial Water City and now, you are at the Unity realm and have even grasped such a formidable absolute art. Seeing you all made me think of how old I am.”
“Primal Chaos Hall Master has overpraised me.” Xue Ying immediately responded humbly.
This black-haired old man was faintly ranked first in the Great Void Heaven Temple, the ‘Primal Chaos Hall Master’. His strength was unfathomable.
“I was only able to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda after bitterly cultivating for 100 billion years since I stepped into the Unity realm. Compared to Elder Dong Bo, I feel ashamed.”
“For you to attain such strength after reaching the Unity realm, it is truly admirable.”
This group of Inner Hall Elders was all praising him.
They felt admiration from deep in their hearts!
The current generation of Inner Hall Elders from the Great Void Heaven Temple were all at level five combat power of the Star Pagoda, and Xue Ying was too talented that he could also reach a similar level with them. It was likely that he could get through the sixth level in the future. With his current comprehension ability, the possibility of him breaking through to the Primal Chaos realm was huge too. In addition to how strict the rules of the Great Void Heaven Temple were, the inner sect was quite united, and they were quite happy to see the rise of Xue Ying.
“Inquisitive Sky Hall Master, are you able to investigate who the other party is?” Forefather Tian Yu asked.
“He took the initiative to dissipate without leaving behind any traces. It is quite impossible for me to search for his identity after that.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master shook his head before returning back to his position.
“Let me try.”
Suddenly, a voice sounded.
All of them turned over. It was none other than Swordmaster.
Swordmaster’s eyes were deep and unfathomable. Many deity runes were revolving in the void ahead of him. They formed a haze figure of Xue Ying, and at the same time, they were also trying to condense into another figure.
That blurred figure suddenly transformed into an old man. That old man grinned, “Haha, Myriad World Tavern. Fair transactions take place here, and I do hope for you all to understand that.”
And that figure soon dissipated.
The expressions on both Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster changed.
“Old Ghost Myriad World!” Swordmaster coldly snorted. Forefather Tian Yu also understood that this vengeance was one they could not take.
“Myriad World Tavern?” Xue Ying also understood. There was someone who hired the Myriad World Tavern to assassinate him, “Who exactly is it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 842 - Curiosity
chapters.content:
Chapter 842: Curiosity
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Who exactly is the enemy?” Both Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster frowned.
With the hindrance of Myriad World Tavern Master, it was impossible for them to find out who the enemy was no matter what kind of secret technique they employed. Even though they were unhappy with Myriad World Tavern Master, they still felt helpless about it.
Myriad World Tavern Master…
He was unquestionably ranked first in terms of survival capabilities across all Cosmos Gods because he specialized in an avatar technique! He was able to form avatars and not incarnations. One had to know that cultivators at the Primal Chaos realm or Cosmos Gods could usually have a single true body at most! They could produce many incarnations, and the dissipation these incarnations was a minor matter. Only when their true bodies were killed would it mean death for them!
Even those ranked at the forefront like Sacred Master, Ancestor Mother, and Ancestor Sorcerer had one body at most!
But ‘Myriad World Tavern Master’ was the only exception amongst the final realm existences!
Every single avatar of his was considered a true body! And he had a few thousand avatars that were scattered across the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void within all the Myriad World Taverns.
As long as a single avatar of his survived, Myriad World Tavern Master would never die!
Thus, even though he was rather unbridled when he created the ‘Myriad World Tavern’-creating many incidents like the assassination of Xue Ying, thus offending many superpowers-the others could only endure and control their anger. Even though Myriad World Tavern Master was just one person, and he had not created a sect-every single Myriad World Tavern was handled by him alone…
He was practically undying…
And he had no concerns at all…
He was strong, and had many avatars and could appear from anywhere! Thus, all superpowers would rather fight against Sacred Master than to battle with Myriad World Tavern Master. Consequently, the status of Myriad World Tavern Master became somewhat unique.
“Dong Bo, can you guess who the enemy?” Amongst the hall masters, Ancestor Devil asked, “For someone to pay such a huge price in asking the Myriad World Tavern to act, he must be someone with an extraordinary background.”
Xue Ying felt skeptical too: “Ever since I left my hometown cosmos, I have only ever offended the Heaven Weeping Sect Master.”
“He doesn’t dare, and neither does Ancestor Bone too.” Ancestor Devil added immediately after.
“After that, I’ve been cultivating in the Sky Palace Hall before traveling to the Celestial Water City. I’ve destroyed a base of the Ancient Sacred Religion there.” Xue Ying thought back and described, “The time I’ve stayed in the sacred world is short, so the possibility of me entering a conflict with someone else is much lower too. That time when I killed the followers of Ancient Sacred Religion, there was one with a slightly more unique identity. He was an ordinary Unity realm expert, yet he had a peak Unity realm mutated beast following him. Furthermore, I found many treasures from him.”
Saying that, Xue Ying waved his hand, forming the figure of the black-robed male, Sacred Emissary Chi Yun.
Because he had few enmities, Xue Ying was able to recall that black-robed male Sacred Emissary Chi Yun immediately.
“A member of the Ancient Sacred Religion?”
“An ordinary Unity realm expert yet he has a peak Unity realm mutated beast following him?”
The higher-ups of the Great Void Heaven Palace had some guesses.
“It is possible that his origin is unique.” Forefather Tian Yu shook his head, “But it’s a pity that we can’t probe the Ancient Sacred World at all.”
The Ancient Sacred World was forbidden ground for many superpowers.
All the cultivators in the Ancient Sacred World believed in the Sacred Master. The light from the Sacred Master was able to shine across every single location on the Ancient Sacred World too. Thus, anything happening within the Ancient Sacred World like which expert had what relationship and so on would be kept a secret to the outer world unless they publicized it.
Even Cosmos Gods dared not barge in since the Sacred Master would immediately appear after that. With the unparalleled strength of the Sacred Master, Cosmos Gods could only escape the moment he came!
“With the great increase of Dong Bo’s strength, it is quite impossible for others to assassinate him.” Ancestor Devil said, “Since that’s the case, let us temporarily put this matter aside. Dong Bo, you should be careful of those from the Ancient Sacred Religion in the future.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded.
Since they had guessed the enemies were from the Ancient Sacred Religion, there was nothing much they had to speak about after that.
Because the Great Void Heaven Temple and the Ancient Sacred Religion were originally great enemies, thus both sides desired for each other to be doomed, and they would not take things lightly if they had an opportunity. But the Ancient Sacred Religion was careful too. It was practically impossible to kill a Primal Chaos realm expert from the Ancient Sacred Religion.
…
After the gathering, everyone left the Great Void Palace Hall.
As they were leaving, “Elder Dong Bo.” A black-haired old man flew over.
Xue Ying immediately replied as he saw it, “Primal Chaos Hall Master!” This was someone with an unfathomable strength. Even though the intelligence report did not state it, Xue Ying had gotten news from his teacher Gu Qi that this hall master was an existence who had long reached the ninth level of Star Pagoda strength.
“There’s a matter I will have to ask Elder Dong Bo for help.” The black-haired old man said.
“If there’s any matter, hall master can just tell me straight. I’ll definitely do my best to help.” Xue Ying answered.
The black-haired old man softly nodded, “I am quite interested in the Dark World actually. Is it alright if you let me have a look through? I know that you have paid a great deal for it, and naturally, I am willing to pay 1.5 million contribution points to you to have a look, is it fine?”
“Definitely! I’m definitely happy to do so! I’ve cultivated for a short period, and have practically sold all my treasures for the sake of this Dark World absolute art. To get 1.5 million contribution points for a look of the absolute art is something I feel delighted of.” Xue Ying replied.
Primal Chaos Hall Master was different from Forefather Quan Miao.
Forefather Quan Miao specialized in the illusory realm and desired the Dark World quite a lot!
But for Primal Chaos Hall Master, Xue Ying had never heard of him specializing in the illusory realm. It was likely that the other party wanted to have a look because of some slight interest. It’s just that the other party was so much stronger than Forefather Quan Miao and Saint Wang Ming, and even Ancestor Devil was quite lacking as compared to him. Naturally, the other party would have a lot of treasures and would disdain from taking advantage of Xue Ying. The other party was willing to pay more than a million contribution points, and this amount was measly to the Primal Chaos Hall Master.
“Alright.” The black-haired old man chuckled and nodded. At the same time, Xue Ying had gotten news on his communication talisman that his contribution points had increased by 1.5 million points.
Xue Ying was astonished at how direct Primal Chaos Hall Master was. He immediately brought out the “Dark World” book.
The black-haired old man flipped through it rapidly before receiving the inheritance.
“Slightly interesting.”
The black-haired old man chuckled, “It’s a pity that this brat, Dark World Master, has died too prematurely. Elder Dong Bo, it is quite rare for you to finish cultivating this in such a short period as well.”
He was quite interested in this absolute art.
Because Xue Ying has grasped the first style so quickly, it made Primal Chaos Hall Master all the more curious… was it that easy to cultivate in an absolute art that could give the user the strength to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda? That was why he decided to look through it. If Xue Ying had spent a longer period to cultivate in this absolute art, Primal Chaos Hall Master would not have been so interested in it.
“I might be able to produce an absolute art after deliberating over it for a while.” The black-haired old man chuckled. At his realm, he had seen through all sorts of unique cultivation directions, and he would always ponder and research over new ways to enlighten himself so that he could take the final step and enter the final realm! After all, he could faintly see the ‘final destination’ yet he could not break through at all.
“It is good that hall master is able to glean something from it.” Xue Ying said.
“Are you planning to keep the news about you succeeding in cultivating the “Dark World” absolute art within 100,000 years?” The black-haired old man asked, “If not, I can help you out a bit. Who knows if there might be some experts who are willing to pay the price to learn the dark world as well.”
“There’s naturally no need to keep it a secret.” Xue Ying said.
In the history, there was a large batch of absolute talented Unity realm experts.
And many had gotten through the sixth level of Star Pagoda, with several passing through the seventh level! The current Xue Ying was at such a level already, so there was no point for him to conceal his strength. Because he was confident that even if the true body of a Primal Chaos realm expert came, it was impossible for the other party to assassinate him soundlessly. Xue Ying would be able to activate his protective talisman when he discovered traces of the enemy.
