The current Xue Ying had the confidence in dealing with all sorts of possible danger he might face currently.
“Knowing that you were able to cultivate it so quickly, I believe that this would garner some interest in several old men, and they might just buy the chance to flip through the Dark World.” The black-haired old man laughed, “Remember, you must keep the price to 150 Origin World Rocks. If you charge too little, you will lose out, and any more than that will make these old chaps heartache.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying nodded.
Primal Chaos Hall Master had lived for far too long. He was very strong too, and the old men he was speaking of… should likely be other Primal Chaos realm giants who had similarly lived for a long time as he did and were stuck at the final bottleneck. They were all rich and imposing, and only because they lacked that last bit of inspiration to break through would they be interested in paying more than 100 Origin World Rocks for this absolute art.
Those like Ancestor Devil would not be so extravagant in their spending.
“Mn.” The black-haired old man chuckled. He was very willing to help those from his own sect cheat some money from the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 843 - Business Transaction
chapters.content:
Chapter 843: Business Transaction
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
In the vast primal chaos void, there was a primal chaos land which was filled with many strands of flame patterns. At a certain location in the center of the land, there was an expert with a magma body standing in midair. His eyes were closed, and many fire dragons were flying out from the surface of his body and into the array of this primal chaos land.
The expert with a magma body was covered in dark armor. Only his hands, head and certain parts of his body were revealed.
“Mo Huo.” A voice sounded.
The magma male standing in midair slowly opened his eyes. His eyelids and pupils were all made from magma, only that flames were moving at the center of his eyes. The magma boy looked by his side, only to see a blurred illusion appearing. That was a black-haired old man.
“Primal Chaos, what’s the matter?” The edge of the magma boy’s mouth curled upwards. He was an old man who had lived ever since the earliest Ancient Sacred World era with Primal Chaos Hall Mater. The two had not only lived for a long period, but they were also very powerful too. There were not many people who could treat him, Mo Huo, as a friend. Most were old men who had lived since the same era, or that they had to be powerful enough for him to recognize.
“Naturally there’s a good matter I came to find you for.” The illusion of Primal Chaos Hall Master said, “I have a young brat in my Great Void Heaven Temple called Dong Bo Xue Ying. He has gotten an absolute art called “Dark World”. After obtaining it, he had reached the Unity realm in 100,000 years and have also reached the fifth level of Star Pagoda strength.”
“What?” The magma boy was slightly shocked, “He has gotten the absolute art and reached the fifth level of Star Pagoda combat power as a Unity realm expert all within 100,000 years? Did he accelerate time?”
“No, he didn’t! It is easy for you to investigate and affirm this matter, so why would I lie to you?” Primal Chaos Hall Master said.
“The Dark World is an absolute art created by that little brat called Dark World Master?” The magma male asked.
“Yes.”
The illusion of the Primal Chaos Hall Master continued, “I’ve seen through this absolute art as well. It is fascinating-Creating an incomparably mystical world just for the sake of generating a killing move. Currently, both you and I are stuck at the last bottleneck which is to open a cosmos from the primal chaos. I feel that this absolute art’s ‘world composition’ is something you can try and take reference from. It might be useful for you.”
“Alright. If you want to learn, then hurry over to the Great Void Heaven Temple. There will not be any bargaining. 150 Origin World Rocks to learn it once.” Primal Chaos Hall Master said, “After coming, you can accompany me with a good chat and drink too. We haven’t met for a long time.”
The magma male contemplated for a moment before chuckling, “Alright. I’ll hurry over now.”
He believed that with the identity of Primal Chaos Hall Master, he would disdain to lie for the sake of such few Origin World Rocks.
If Primal Chaos Hall Master’s words were not false, then he was really interested in it!
The absolute art Dark World was created by a Unity realm expert.
And now, another genius had gotten it. He had relied on this absolute art to reach Unity realm and attain the fifth level Star Pagoda strength within 100,000 years. Was it that easy to learn this absolute art?
Furthermore, if the composition of this world was really unique… he might be able to gain inspiration from it and open a cosmos from the primal chaos. Even if it were just a slight help, it would still be worth the price.
…
Within the Great Void Heaven Temple Myriad Elephant Palace Hall.
Xue Ying who had reached the Unity realm had returned to the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall once again to peruse through the books. Flipping through these books personally written by the experts, other than collecting information, just by interacting with the aura left behind by the writers benefited Xue Ying.
“Elder Dong Bo, come over to my place.” Primal Chaos Hall Master transmitted, “And bring along your original copy of Dark World.”
“Alright.” The eyes of Xue Ying brightened. He immediately hurried out of the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall.
Very soon.
He reached the Primal Chaos Palace Hall, which was also where the hall master was currently staying at. Within a courtyard, there were two figures seated opposite of each other. In front of them was a table with great wine placed on it. The two figures were drinking and chatting happily.
“Elder Dong Bo.” Primal Chaos Hall Master looked at Xue Ying before asking him over.
Xue Ying immediately went over. At the same time, he noted the male opposite Primal Chaos Hall Master. This was a relatively thin and white male. Other than two fangs being revealed, his aura was kept concealed.
“General Hatchet Palace Master.” Xue Ying immediately recognized the other party.
General Hatchet.
He was the strongest descendant of Devil Mountain Primogenitor, and also currently the strongest Primal Chaos expert of the ‘Primogenitor Island’. He relied on the bloodline cultivation system to reach the final point of the Primal Chaos realm. This General Hatchet Palace Master had also cultivated in the strongest warrior system. Do not see how thin and tender he was, even though on the surface he might seem weak, his body was much stronger than Xue Ying’s upper-graded Void God weapon.
This was an old man who had comparable strength with Primal Chaos Hall Master.
“Here is 150 Origin World Rocks.” General Hatchet Palace Master was very direct. He waved his hand and threw the pile of Origin World Rocks over.
And to this, Xue Ying was naturally straightforward too.
He took out and threw the “Dark World” original copy over to General Hatchet Palace Master.
General Hatchet Palace Master flipped through the book after receiving it before closing the book after that.
“Mn, this is slightly interesting.” General Hatchet Palace Master threw the book back to Xue Ying. At the same time, he shook his head at Primal Chaos Hall Master, “Primal Chaos, even though this absolute art has an interesting style regarding its world composition, its difficulty doesn’t seem any lower.”
“I have never said that the difficulty is any lower.” Primal Chaos Hall Master retorted.
“You haven’t said that indeed, but you did say that he has reached the Unity realm and fifth level of Star Pagoda after 100,000 years, deliberately making me think that… this absolute art is unique and easy to grasp hold as well.” General Hatchet Palace Master said.
“That is your supposition. You can’t blame me on this.” Primal Chaos Hall Master said.
General Hatchet Palace Master might be complaining to Primal Chaos Hall Master, but he wasn’t angry at all. This ‘Dark World’ absolute art might be created by a Unity realm expert, but its composition of the world was indeed unique in its style. It had been designed from a different perspective and contained both the first and second style. Following this direction, they could always continue researching in this direction with their strength…
And it would be related to the eventual creation of cosmos within the primal chaos.
“Two seniors, I’ll be withdrawing now then.” Xue Ying saw that General Hatchet Palace Master no longer had any interest in speaking with him. Naturally, Xue Ying would not obstruct the two. He had gotten the Origin World Rocks already anyway.
…
Time passed.
Even though Primal Chaos Hall Master had helped Xue Ying spread the news, telling the other existences at the final peak of Primal Chaos realm, and in addition to the reputation and friendship with Primal Chaos Hall Master, there were five Primal Chaos realm giant who came to learn this absolute art within the past 1,000 years or so.
They discovered the absolute art because firstly, Primal Chaos Hall Master was the one who recommended it. They trusted Primal Chaos Hall Master. Secondly, this book was on the composition of a world, and it was similar to reaching the final breakthrough for them. Thirdly, Xue Ying had indeed cultivated really quickly. He had grasped hold of the absolute art after 100,000 years as a Unity realm expert. It sufficed to make them curious since this was an absolute art created by another Unity realm expert, so how could another Unity realm expert succeed in cultivating it so quickly? What exactly was so unique about it?
These three reasons had brought several Primal Chaos giants over to learn it!
Naturally, there were just these few giants and 150 Origin World Rocks from each of them… was not considered much or little.
“Those who would come have come. The others did not say if they would be coming.” Primal Chaos Hall Master transmitted a voice message to Xue Ying, “I believe that this business transaction of your Dark World absolute art is over.”
“It is enough, and all thanks to hall master.” Xue Ying answered.
“Haha, go back then.” Primal Chaos Hall Master chuckled before telling him.
He was currently accompanying his four good friends.
The five existences who had reached the limits of Primal Chaos realm were presently enjoying themselves chatting with one another.
Xue Ying instead left happily with his newly-earned Origin World Rocks.
“I’ve earned big this time.” After leaving the Primal Chaos Palace Hall, Xue Ying calculated the rocks he had earned, “Even though I bought this absolute art at 501 Origin World Rocks, Forefather Quan Miao has forked out 235 Origin World Rocks, and the four Primal Chaos realm experts have spent a total of 600 Origin World Rocks. Furthermore, Primal Chaos Hall Master has given me 1.5 million contribution points too… adding them up, I’ve earned about 334 Origin World Rocks and 1.5 million contribution points, and there’s still this absolute art original copy.”
Xue Ying was clear too.
The reason why he could be earning despite purchasing the absolute art was primarily with the help of Primal Chaos Hall Master. If Xue Ying were to take the initiative in releasing the news of carrying out this business, having one out of the four Primal Chaos realm giants come and learn this art was considered a good deal already.
“Time to visit the Star Pagoda.”
Xue Ying lifted his head at the towering Star Pagoda.
The fifth level of Star Pagoda concerned a huge secret. Even his teacher Gu Qi did not tell him what secret it was. Xue Ying had to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda before he was qualified from knowing it! Previously, he had been reading through the books while waiting for the Primal Chaos giants to come. To take precautions of the fact that Xue Ying might be not rush to meet the Primal Chaos giants in time, he decided to just wait for them while reading as a result, and not head to the Star Pagoda first.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying turned into a stream of light before flying to the Star Pagoda.

chapters.title: Chapter 844 - Star Pagoda Fifth Level
chapters.content:
Chapter 844: Star Pagoda Fifth Level
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The mountains were chained in an undulating fashion; the trees were flourishing.
Xue Ying appeared in the world at this level. He stood at the peak of a mountain and observed the world. This was the fourth level world in the Star Pagoda. Xue Ying had once failed to get past this level when he was in the Origin Birth realm.
“I am here.” Xue Ying’s gaze landed midair in the distance.
“Chi chi chi~” Deep within the mountain range, many blood light strands were rushing out before gathering at a point far away. Eventually, the strands of light transformed into a living creature of some other race wearing blood armor. His skin was dark, and it felt like he was made of a black metallic cast. He also had black hair which was tied into hundreds of little pigtails.
The blood-armored living creature tilted his head slightly. That lone gray eye of his was observing Xue Ying: “Have you become stronger? Are you finally here to re-challenge me?”
He was emitting an aura which caused the world laws to slightly distort. It seemed he was born to destroy everything.
“Can I ask where you originated from?” Xue Ying asked.
“You aren’t qualified to know.” The blood-armored creature gave a wicked laughter, “It is better for you to die now.”
“Hong!”
He suddenly let out terrifying ripples. These ripples swept across in all directions. Every single ripple contained an ominous aura, and every location which was swept across by the ripples-even though they seemed to be unaffected by any destruction, the flowers and grasses on the mountain had withered, and the leaves on the trees swiftly turned yellow before falling. The world at this level rapidly turned into a desolate and harsh environment.
As the ripples swept towards Xue Ying, it stopped moving just beyond 500 kilometers away. Xue Ying’s law domain had become much stronger now.
“Interesting. Things are getting more interesting.” The blood-armored creature knew that his original plan was ineffective, and decided to give it up. He decided to just engage in a direct combat with Xue Ying!
“Sou.”
He immediately disappeared.
Xue Ying calmly stood where he was on the mountain peak. Nevertheless, the 500 kilometers region around him had fallen into silent darkness. Xue Ying then turned to a direction where a figure had appeared. It was the figure of that blood-armored living creature-he had teleported over. Currently, that creature could still move within Xue Ying’s law domain, but it was at speed much slower than before. Under the suppression of the law domain, the other party could barely display 10% of his strength.
“Die.” Xue Ying let out a thought.
“Hu.”
A dark world with a diameter of 5,000 kilometers descended from nothingness. It turned from illusion into reality and was rapidly absorbing the world energy around it.
The blood-armored creature looked at the descending dark world. This pitch black world was desolate, yet the blood-armored being could feel that behind this silent fermenting world was incomparably horrifying destruction. This caused his expression to change. He originally thought that this brat had just stepped into the Unity realm, and it would not be that difficult to defeat him. But apparently, he was way off the mark.
‘The previous time I saw him, he was still at the Origin Birth realm. How long had it been since he broke through? And now, he can easily kill me already? An Elder of the Great Void Heaven Temple should not be able to cultivate that fast right?’ The blood-armored creature contained some slight unwillingness as he rushed towards Xue Ying with great effort. Nevertheless, he was traveling really slowly at this moment.
The dark world wrapped around this blood-armored creature. It soon began shrinking! At the moment it shrank to a diameter of 100 meters, it was like a massive bubble with the blood-armored creature trapped at its center trying to fly away.
“Pa!”
The explosion of the dark bubble caused the entire energy of the world destruction to land on the blood-armored creature. The blood-armored creature could only stare at Xue Ying before it collapsed and disappeared. During that explosion, the creature returned back into its original form of blood strands that tunneled back into the mountains.
“Time to go to the fifth level.” Xue Ying did not find it puzzling. After all, from the experiences of Dark World Master, the first style-Dark Bubble-sufficed for Xue Ying to get through even the fifth level Star Pagoda. Naturally, it was quite simple to get through the fourth level.
…
Getting through the fifth level of Star Pagoda meant many things. Getting through it indicated that Xue Ying would have reached the boundary of a Primal Chaos realm expert. It represented that he would be unparalleled amongst those at the Unity realm! As for getting through the sixth and seventh level? That had happened in history, and in the current era, there was none at the Unity realm who could get through the seventh level. And those who got through the sixth level could be counted with one’s fingers! To meet one such existence was even harder than meeting a Cosmos God!
In the Great Void Heaven Temple, anybody who got through this level was an Inner Hall Elder.
“Getting through this level will allow me to find out the hidden secret within.” Xue Ying appeared in a desolate wilderness. This wilderness contained many thunder snakes striking down on the surface with sounds of ‘pi li pa la’. The thunder was gathering in a distant region, and it was comparatively much more peaceful where Xue Ying was at.
“What secret is it that even my teacher Gu Qi isn’t willing to tell me?” Xue Ying felt stifled.
“Soon.”
“I’ll be able to unravel the truth after I defeat my opponent on this level.” Xue Ying was looking forward to it.
“Chi chi chi~”
In the distant, within the region which contained countless thunder, many blood rays started surging from the ground and started condensing into a single blood-armored expert. He had four arms and a silvery-white skin. He was tall and big, and he was looking at Xue Ying with a cold expression.
“Just one?” Xue Ying was looking at this scene with slight shock.
According to his previous experiences, the first level of Star Pagoda contained a gray-armored living creature, and the second level included ten of them. The third level had a hundred of them! And since the fourth level had just a single blood-armored enemy, should there just be a single blood-armored enemy on the fifth level as well? Nevertheless, the enemies on the two levels looked different.
“Unity realm? Kill!” This blood-armored silvery-white-skinned four-armed expert was too lazy to talk. He had brazenly acted.
“Xiu.”
He directly teleported to the region of 500 kilometers around Xue Ying, and at the same time, he was forced to reveal himself due to Xue Ying’s law domain. Within the silent dark law domain, this four-armed expert’s expression did not change. He remained flying at high speed! And his rate of flying was so fast that he was able to rush to where Xue Ying was in the blink of an eye despite being suppressed by the law domain.
“Xiu.” Xue Ying felt nearly dumbstruck by this. He hurriedly teleported away. Xue Ying’s flying speed was not as fast as the other party’s despite the other party being suppressed by his law domain! He could only teleport and evade the attack.
As for engaging in close combat?
His current close combat skills were far weaker than the “Dark World”. Not just the Voidwalker system or his Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple, they were not yet at the Unity realm. He would definitely lose quickly if he engaged in close combat.
“Si la~” During the moment when the blood-armored four-armed expert rushed to the side of Xue Ying, his four arms rapidly shot out and tore apart space. Xue Ying’s remnant illusory image had been shattered by it.
As for his true body, Xue Ying was currently teleporting through the Mirage World. Furthermore, he also displayed the first style of ‘Dark Bubble’.
“Hua!”
The Dark Bubble descended. A Dark World came from the illusion. Furthermore, it had turned into reality before rapidly shrinking. The World Energy was rapidly focalizing into it. Even though the blood-armored four-armed expert was pursuing Xue Ying, this ‘Dark Bubble’ closely followed behind the other party. Furthermore, it exploded after rapidly shrinking, ‘peng’! A destructive energy rapidly let loose on the enemy within the bubble.
The blood-armored four-armed expert was stunned momentarily as injuries formed on his body from this explosion. But under the revolution of the blood light, his injuries gradually recovered.
“You are able to injure me?” The blood-armored four-armed expert roared out indignantly. He swiftly teleported to the region of 500 kilometers around Xue Ying. His speed had suddenly surged. Now, he could teleport to where Xue Ying was despite being hindered by Xue Ying’s law domain. Speaking about teleportation… Xue Ying’s Voidwalker system had yet to break through, so he was far weaker in this aspect as compared to his opponent.
“I have only injured him?” Xue Ying was very shocked. He was clear of the power of this first style’Dark Bubble’.
“If that’s the case, time for me to use the move again.” Xue Ying’s eyes turned cold. He could finally display the full move of this absolute art after succeeding in cultivating it.
“Hong hong hong hong hong hong!”
A Dark World descended from illusion, and then a bigger Dark World enveloped the previous layer of the world. A third Dark World and then a fourth world…
There were a total of six Dark Worlds with one enveloping the other.
They turned into reality before frantically absorbing the World Energy. At the same time, they were rapidly turning small. Eventually, all six of the bubbles from small to big encircled the enemy.
“Pa!””Pa!””Pa!””Pa!””Pa!””Pa!”
Six Dark Bubbles exploded one after another.
With the current strength of Xue Ying’s soul, he could at construct six Dark Worlds at most while controlling them. Any more and it would surpass his own limits. The six Dark Bubbles exploded one after another, inflicting its power one after another on the blood-armored enemy of this fifth level Star Pagoda…

chapters.title: Chapter 845 - Secret
chapters.content:
Chapter 845: Secret
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Ah~” The blood-armored four-armed expert let out a painful roar. After the six Dark Bubbles exploded, his four arms were left with only two, and there were many brutal injuries on his body. Half of his head was gone as he stared at the distant Xue Ying. His eye was filled with indignance, though his heart was filled with dismal since he knew he would die in the hands of this white-robed young man.
Xue Ying was traveling through the void in the Mirage. He was doing his best to maintain a distance from the other party.
“Again.”
Xue Ying was startled at how strong the body of the other party was. Nevertheless, he began constructing the Dark Worlds once again-six Dark Worlds descended and wrapped around the enemy.
“Pa pa pa…”
The worlds rapidly shrank, and six Dark Bubbles exploded after that. It might seem fun, but in reality, it contained a frightening power.
‘”Dark World”-this absolute art is indeed powerful. The enemy can’t get close to me before dying.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly, ‘But its flaw is obvious too. The moment an enemy gets close to me, things will become troublesome. Both the first style ‘Dark Bubble’ and second style ‘Sky Punishment Edge’ are both specialized in long-range battles.’
‘That Dark World Master should likely have died due to his weakness in close combat.’ Xue Ying made his guesses.
The Dark World Master definitely wanted to cover up this weakness of his.
He was trying to make his body stronger so that his close combat prowess would be more formidable! But ultimately, if he weren’t specialized in certain aspects of cultivation, he would not be even if he cultivated for an extended period in them! Being an ‘Ancient Cultivator’, the Dark World Master had a heaven-shaking talent in the illusory realm. But he did not specialize in other aspects. Even if he wanted to reach large successes in other systems, it would not be easy for him.
‘I’ve been doing my best to cultivate in both the Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple, I do not lack effort in cultivating the Voidwalker system too.’ Xue Ying thought.
Even though his talent in both Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple were weaker than his talent in Dao of Mirage—both had not reached the Unity realm, and he had yet to grasp the Apocalyptic Fourth Sword-it was fine.
He had perceived the Apocalyptic Second Sword at the Ruler realm still!
‘I must focus on improving my close combat skills-the Voidwalker system can strengthen me physically and boost my survival skills too. I would then have covered up the greatest weakness of “Dark World”.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘By then, I would have many different techniques which would make me so much stronger than now.’
Even though he was thinking of these, Xue Ying was still continuously unleashing the six Dark Worlds, infuriating the blood-armored enemy. Despite that, the enemy could only remain sullen as he could not touch Xue Ying at all; Xue Ying was attacking him from afar.
The injuries on the blood-armored creature were getting heavier and heavier.
When 60 consecutive Dark Worlds were constructed and exploded on the enemy, Xue Ying was able to finally exterminate him. The remnant blood light soon fused back into the land.
“I’ve finally won.” Xue Ying let out a breath.
The enemy could not reach him at all.
He had squandered the enemy to death using his Dark Bubbles! The enemy had a strong physical body and horrifying speed which would definitely give Xue Ying great pressure if he were to engage in close combat with him.
…
At the fifth level of Star Pagoda, in the distant region of thunder, a figure suddenly appeared. He was none other than the hunchbacked ‘Forefather Tian Yu’.
“Forefather.” Xue Ying was still recollecting the previous battle when he saw Forefather Tian Yu appearing from afar. He immediately went over to greet him respectfully.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying.” Forefather Tian Yu nodded. Watching the scene of how Xue Ying reacted to the assassination, he long understood that this brat had would certainly be able to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda.
“It has long been circulating around within the inner section of the Great Void Heaven Temple, that those who got through the fifth level of Star Pagoda will be able to know a huge secret.” Forefather Tian Yu laughed.
“Yes.” Xue Ying replied, “Whenever I am with the other Inner Hall Elders, they would occasionally mention about this matter, yet they would stop talking about it immediately because of my presence.”
“This is the rule. Not just in my Great Void Heaven Temple, the Primogenitor Island or the Jade Light Sacred Territory, as long as it is within the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World or in the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World—in all six great holy grounds, every expert had to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda to know this secret.” Forefather Tian Yu said.
Xue Ying nodded.
“But prior to mentioning this matter to you…”
“I still have to talk about the primitive Ancient Sacred World first.” Forefather Tian Yu’s eyes were faintly discernible. He began explaining slowly, “A very long time ago, at that time when the Ancient Sacred World was still one whole, the laws on the primitive Ancient Sacred World were much stronger than that on any of the current sacred worlds. It had a stronger suppression on everyone’s combat power. But nevertheless, countless beings were reproducing and cultivating.”
Xue Ying sighed. Stronger laws and suppression than the current five great sacred worlds?
“The primitive Ancient Sacred World gave birth to many experts, and many had eventually reached the final realm.”
“Usually, Cosmos Gods battling each other will affect a region of over 50 million kilometers, but it wasn’t much as compared to the size of the primitive Ancient Sacred World.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “That time, the group of Cosmos Gods did not care about this at all. But over time as more and more final realm existences emerged, the current ones became stronger as well, and the affected region of their battles became bigger.”
Xue Ying was quietly listening. He knew that there were strong and weak even amongst final realm existences.
The weaker ones included those like Ancestor Bone who was practically cushioning the floor.
And the middle leveled ones included Forefather Tian Yu, Swordmaster and Void Primogenitor. Luo City Lord was also approximately at this level.
The high leveled ones included the unparalleled Sacred Master, Ancestor Mother as well as Ancestor Sorcerer.
“That final battle was too overpowering that even the laws of the primitive Ancient Sacred World could not suppress it. Peng! The primitive Ancient Sacred World shattered as a result.” Forefather Tian Yu shook his head, “That was a catastrophe which was unprecedented. That time, the final realm existences who participated in the battle did not know that their battle would cause the primitive Ancient Sacred World to break apart. Thus, they were not prepared for it at all.”
“This eventually led to countless living beings dying from the destruction. Only those who were strong could survive.”
“That time, I was still at the Primal Chaos realm. I only had the time to save several beings surrounding me. To the countless beings on the primitive Ancient Sacred World, it was like a drop in the ocean.” Forefather Tian Yu sighed.
Xue Ying could not help but feel a chill.
Almost all the living beings on the primitive Ancient Sacred World had been exterminated? That was so much more living beings than a single cosmos. This was indeed an unprecedented calamity.
“The shatter of the primitive Ancient Sacred World caused the primal chaos void to expand in all directions. Even now, it is still expanding.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “The region of the primal chaos void is becoming bigger at all times.”
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, have you wondered what the eventual outcome is if the primal chaos void continuously become bigger and bigger?” Forefather Tian Yu asked.
Xue Ying was stunned.
A bubble would eventually pop if it continuously became bigger.
A cosmos, if it grew bigger and bigger, would also have the same issue.
“We do not know what the outcome would be because we haven’t seen it yet.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “But we can sense that it isn’t something good.”
“Furthermore.”
“After the shatter of the primitive Ancient Sacred World, a group of unique living beings has emerged from the boundary of the primal chaos void.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “They existed for the sake of destruction. We call them the ‘Destruction Devils’.”
“They exist for the sake of destruction?” Xue Ying felt puzzled, “They only appeared after the shatter of the primitive Ancient Sacred World?”
Forefather Tian Yu nodded: “Right. Their aura completely overthrows us ordinary living beings. They did not seem to have any other desires than to destroy! To slaughter everything. We even suspect that after the shatter of the primitive Ancient Sacred World, the operating laws have naturally formed this living being which could be there to destroy us, or to reduce the pressure on the operating laws. It could also be there to let the boundless primal chaos void return back to nothingness.”
“These are all conjectures.”
“Even if the primal chaos void is to return to nothingness and that a new primitive Ancient Sacred World can be formed, this is unrelated to us.”
“Hence, we can’t be judged to death just like this.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “At the end of the void, there are also a few final realm existences protecting the place. There is also a large batch of primal chaos realm existences and Unity realm existences proceeding ahead for the sake of killing these Destruction Devil Race.”
“The enemies you meet in the Star Pagoda are of the Destruction Devil Race. Naturally, we have refined them to become puppet beings.” Forefather Tian Yu explained, “From the first level to the ninth level, they are all of the Destruction Devil Race. There might even be those of the Destruction Devil Race with power outstripping the ninth level, and also comparable to Cosmos God existences.”
Xue Ying was speechless.
There were actually existences comparable to Cosmos Gods. No wonder part of the final realm existences had to be stationed at the boundary! If they did not defend well, then the five great sacred worlds in the primal chaos void could be completely exterminated.
“This is the price.”
“The price of the war in the past!” Forefather Tian Yu sneered, “But it’s a pity that Sacred Master and Ancestor Mother are too selfish! The two have never been to the boundary of the void to battle before. They aren’t even willing to send their subordinates there. In the end, it is only the other three great sacred worlds who are actively resisting the Destruction Devils. The Sacred Master, he has forgotten… that the battle in the past has been started by him!”
Xue Ying was shocked. Sacred Master and Ancestor Mother were not willing to act against the Destruction Devil Race which emerged at the boundary of the void?

chapters.title: Chapter 846 - Top Ten Materials
chapters.content:
Chapter 846: Top Ten Materials
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Forefather Tian Yu looked at Xue Ying before chuckling, “You do not have to be in a hurry to go to the boundary of the void. It is too dangerous there. Most will pay a visit only when they reach a bottleneck in their combat power, or when they wanted to temper themselves. Fighting with the Destruction Devil Race is also beneficial since killing the Destruction Devils will actually prompt them to emit unique energy opposite that of ours. The moment we absorb such energy, it’ll nourish our soul. This mystical feeling is quite similar to absorbing Origin World Rocks.”
“Absorbing Origin World Rocks?” Xue Ying was startled.
Origin World Rocks. Those were condensed from the scattered energy after the primitive Ancient Sacred World shattered. It was genuinely mystical and incomparably precious. Even Cosmos Gods had use of it.
“Right. Even though its quality is totally different, it is equally beneficial to our souls.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “The stronger the member of the Destruction Devil Race, the more it’ll nourish our soul after killing it! Furthermore, the materials left behind by the body of the Destruction Devil Race are rare and highly valuable. ‘Cheng Qun’ that was previously auctioned as the most precious item of the Cheng Qun Convention you attended previously is actually the skin of a ninth level Destruction Devil.”
Xue Ying nodded.
The Destruction Devils were very dangerous, but they were treasures as well! Nevertheless, one had to survive to enjoy the riches. After all, that place was highly dangerous.
“The reason why we only reveal this after the cultivator got through the fifth level is that we are worried some of the weaker ones might just pay the boundary of the void a visit. Those who are weak will only be sending themselves to their deaths if they go!” Forefather Tian Yu shook his head, “Even though the Star Pagoda contains some extremely weak Destruction Devils, in the boundary of the void, the weaker Destruction Devils would usually team up together.”
“You are still young.”
“You have cultivated for only a short period so you shouldn’t be visiting that place for now.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “Properly cultivate, and it’ll be best for you to visit only after you reach the Primal Chaos realm! By then, the chances of you dying will be low.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying acknowledged.
What a joke.
He did not even have the slightest of thought of visiting that place. It was too dangerous. At the fifth level combat power in the Great Void Heaven Temple, that was merely the lowest level of combat power! Even though he desired for a challenge to temper himself, he did not want to die. If he died, then what about his children and wife located in his hometown cosmos? He still had to send materials for cultivation over. Before helping his wife and children settle down… he would never consider visiting these places of extreme danger!
“Forefather.” Xue Ying said, “I would like to ask if there are any special materials for cultivation with great effect to stage four World Deities?”
Not all materials with the highest value would be suitable.
Because stage four World Deities were comparatively weaker, their souls were weaker too. Some of the materials which were too powerful would be beyond what the souls of stage four World Deities could handle. It would only cause their souls to shatter! Thus, he had to find something comfortable and apt for stage four World Deities.
“Oh? Appropriate for stage four World Deities?” Forefather Tian Yu pondered momentarily before replying, “If mentioning about support, then the Eternal Heart and Origin World Fruit are the most useful. It’s a pity that those are priceless. I can’t even get them! How about this, I’ll send you information regarding the ten most appropriate materials which is helpful for cultivation to you, but they are quite expensive.”
“Mn.”
Xue Ying received a set of information in his communication talisman.
First: Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core. Priced at about 6,000 Origin World Rocks.
Second: Ancient Sacred Nine Rock. Priced at about 3,500 Origin World Rocks. This was also ranked among the top ten most expensive materials. Actually, most Cosmos Gods would use it and letting a stage four World Deity use it would be slightly wasteful.
Third: Desert Fire Ancestral Tree Leaf. Priced at about 5,000 Origin World Rocks.
…
Tenth: Destruction Devil Spider Gold Silk. Priced at about 2,000 Origin World Rocks per strand.
‘Truly expensive.’
Xue Ying felt the pressure after perusing through. Those that were ranked at the top ten were priced above 2,000 Origin World Rocks.
‘I’ll set the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core as my number one target.’ Xue Ying thought. He knew the pressure was tremendous because he wanted to buy two sets. That would add up to a price of more than 10,000 Origin World Rocks! To Primal Chaos realm giants, they had to practically sell all their treasures for this. Naturally, some of the Primal Chaos giants who stood at the peak like ‘Ancestor Desert’ who specialized in earning Origin World Rocks would not be included in this.
But to Xue Ying who was just at the Unity realm, it was a price so high he could not reach.
During this short period, he had earned quite a lot. But the business transaction of “Dark World” was something he could no longer conduct. This business had also succeeded because of Primal Chaos Hall Master’s help! As for destroying the base of Ancient Sacred Religion, it was fortunate for him to do it once. The Ancient Sacred Religion would be all the more careful after suffering from a loss. Thus, the difficulty of finding their base a second time would rapidly increase.
‘How should I earn that amount?’ Xue Ying felt the pressure. Actually, this was a pressure all experts would face. Even the Cosmos Gods would find that they did not have enough Origin World Rocks! They were willing to use these primitive Ancient Sacred Religion source energy and wanted to become stronger. Like his teacher Gu Qi… he had not even cultivated Walker’s Hidden Secret to the final grand perfection. He was still slightly lacking compared to the void Primogenitor.
“How, is it costly? Why not find those that are cheaper?” Forefather Tian Yu had a smile on his face. He could guess that with how young Xue Ying was, he would still have living family members. Searching for appropriate materials to aid cultivation proper for a stage four World Deity would likely be so for his family members.
“Forefather.” Xue Ying asked, “Previously when I bought the lone book of Dark World absolute art, I’ve heard that the Great Void Heaven Temple is willing to buy it as well?”
“Naturally.” Forefather Tian Yu nodded, “But since it had been sold more than once, the Great Void Heaven Temple can only buy it with 1.5 million contribution points.”
“1.5 million contribution points?” Xue Ying muttered inwardly.
Too little.
He had once slaughtered a few of those primal chaos realm giants standing at the peak with each paying 150 Origin World Rocks each! Naturally, such a good deal could no longer happen.
“I’ll contemplate over it a little longer.” Xue Ying replied.
“No rush. You can sell to the Sky Palace Hall at any time. It’ll be at this price.” Forefather Tian Yu said. There were rules within the inner section of the Great Void Heaven Temple. They could not casually give a high price because their contribution points could be exchanged for many precious treasures.
“The Destruction Devil Spider Gold Silk is not bad. But for you to get one is very difficult already.” Forefather Tian Yu said before his figure dissipated. He had left the Star Pagoda.
Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
The Destruction Devil Spider Gold Silk was something that was in stock because they were materials from the Destruction Devils! Things like the ‘Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core’ was something extremely difficult to search for. Even the price it was valued at had been an approximate valuation in the past.
‘Even two sets of the Destruction Devil Spider Gold Silk costs 4,000 Origin World Rocks.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Let’s take it slow.’
‘Before helping Jing Qiu and the others settle down… I will not risk my life at the boundary of the void.’
‘Then the only way for me to earn more Origin World Rocks is to battle with the Ancient Sacred Religion and the Ancestor Mother Religion.’ Xue Ying searched through the many missions within the Great Void Heaven Temple on his communication talisman.
Battling with the Ancient Sacred Religion and Ancestor Mother Religion…
Was an eternal topic!
In history, most Cosmos Gods died because of the battle with the two great religions.
‘The Ancient sacred World and the Ancestor Mother World are the two primary bases of the enemies. Going there means sending myself to death! Those locations are ten to a hundred times more dangerous than going to the boundary of the void.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘And the other three sacred worlds belong to the territory of our side. The Ancient Sacred Religion and Ancestor Mother Religion are stealthily permeating into our territory, and are being completely suppressed… it is too difficult to contribute greatly. Even destroying a base gives such little contribution points.’
‘Thus, I still have to go to the primal chaos void.’
Xue Ying thought.
The primal chaos void was a place where both parties did not have absolute control of.
‘Over here.’ Xue Ying got fixated on the largest piece of land in the primal chaos void—’Nine Cloud Great Land’.
The Nine Cloud Great Land was a slightly bigger remnant piece left behind after the primitive Ancient Sacred World had shattered. It covered an area one-twentieth that of the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World! One had to know that the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World was boundless, and even one-twentieth of it meant that this ‘Nine Cloud Great Land’ was massive. There were countless living beings within and was a place where battles between the religions and the three great sacred worlds happened most intensely.
The more intense it was, the more opportunity Xue Ying had to gain more contribution points!
And if one day… if he could exterminate the two other great religions from the Nine Cloud Great Land, much less the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core, even Ancestor Sorcerer would be willing to help him refine an ‘Eternal Heart’!

chapters.title: Chapter 847 - A Far Journey
chapters.content:
Chapter 847: A Far Journey
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
There were some final realm existences who were not too willing to participate in the conflict between the two superpowers. For instance, Myriad World Tavern Master. The few of them would usually live within the primal chaos void. That time when the primitive Ancient Sacred World first shattered, certain unique remnant pieces belonging to the primitive Ancient Sacred World drifted into the primal chaos void. As a result, in the vast primal chaos void, other than the ordinary lands and cosmos, there were also unique places that Cosmos Gods were willing to make their home at.
The Nine Cloud Great Land, other than the original ‘Ancient Sacred World’, was was the biggest remnant piece that originated from the primitive Ancient Sacred World. This land was also where a Cosmos God, ‘Ancestor Pure One’ stayed at.
Ancestor Pure One might be staying here, but he was relatively transcendental and did not participate in the battle between the two superpowers.
In addition, there were few final realm existences. Either they were required to protect the sacred worlds or that they would stand guard at the boundary of the void. The ‘Nine Cloud Great Land’ which was one-twentieth the size of Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World would thus only see battles happening between Primal Chaos experts at most! And Xue Ying being an Inner Hall Elder had his own protective treasures. The moment he activated them, he would be able to survive against Primal Chaos realm giants for a period.
As long as he was careful, Nine Cloud Great Land was a place entirely appropriate for him to adventure in!
‘But I do not have many combat techniques-just the ‘Dark Bubble’ at the current moment. Furthermore, the enemy will be able to identify me the moment I used it.’ Xue Ying thought. Because of the assassination matter which involved the Ancient Sacred Religion, the other party could easily rewind back to the scene of the battle in the past. He could easily find out about the ‘Dark Bubble’.
If there were really an expert assassin sent by the Myriad World Tavern to deal with him!
Then it might lead to other Primal XChaos realm experts being assigned by the Ancient Sacred Religion to deal against him if he were to reveal himself on the Nine Cloud Great Land.
‘It is best if I don’t reveal myself.’ Xue Ying pondered. If danger arose within the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster could descend with their incarnations. But in the distant Nine Cloud Great Land… that location was deep in the primal chaos void, and it would require some time for the two palace masters to arrive.
‘Let’s attempt the sixth level Star Pagoda.’
Xue Ying shot up into the sky; he followed along the spatial vortex located above before entering the sixth level.
The Star Pagoda sixth level was of a desolate desert. There were fragments of green plants with tenacious vitality growing in it. Suddenly, blood light surged out from within the desert. This blood light converged into a blood-armored enchantress.
‘Just one enemy again?’ Xue Ying muttered inwardly.
The fourth to sixth level contained just a single blood-armored enemy. But after chatting with Forefather Tian Yu, he understood that the Destruction Devils had differing power-from the first level of Star Pagoda to the Cosmos God level!
“A Unity realm brat?” The blood-armored enchantress lightly chuckled. At that time, a vast enchanting pink aura began spreading out. It almost overwhelmed the entire sixth level of the Star Pagoda. Even if all the green plants had a more tenacious vitality in the desert, they began withering within moments. This pink aura made Xue Ying feel his life being threatened.
His law domain might be able to withstand against it, but Xue Ying was clearly having a hard time.
“Hua.” The blood-armored enchantress giggled. Her figure turned into nine, and with a flash, those figures tunneled into the law domain of Xue Ying. The nine blood figures charged right against him.
…
Xue Ying was defeated very quickly.
Even though he could hardly discern the enemy’s actual body, he still unleashed six Dark Bubbles. Each Dark Bubble could envelop around two bodies of the enemy, and naturally, he could extinguish eight incarnations of the enemy at once, leaving behind her true body that wasn’t injured from the attack at all. At that time, however, the enemy had already reached Xue Ying.
Xue Ying was not confident of his own teleportation. Instead, he hurriedly activated the protective treasure and admitted defeat!
He had no choice.
The absolute art Dark World was like this. Usually, he could still kill the enemy from afar, but if the enemy reached close to him, he would be defeated soon after.
…
Xue Ying flew out of the Star Pagoda.
‘I should properly cultivate and improve other aspects of my cultivation as soon as possible. If I were to visit the Nine Cloud Great Land with just this technique, I’ll be suffering big time. Furthermore, this move is too easily recognizable.’ Xue Ying thought. The 13 Apocalyptic Swords was a move which could turn into various close combat killing moves, making it hard for the other party to discern what technique it was. But this ‘Dark Bubble’ move could easily be discerned with a single glance!
******
Xue Ying was not anxious either. He spent the following days frequently reading in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall. Even though he had read through them before and even memorized the content, reading the original copy was different. The original copy contained vestiges left behind by the expert writers themselves and was more appropriate for Xue Ying to experience them. He would occasionally discuss Dao and spar with other Inner Hall Elders too.
After about 2,000 years or so since he visited the Star Pagoda, Xue Ying had prepared himself well. He once again entered the Palace Hall of Time to cultivate.
Unity realm experts would have to fork out a higher price when spending time in the Palace Hall of Time. Accelerating time at hundred times for 100 million years cost a total of 25 Origin World Rocks. Fortunately, he could use 250,000 contribution points to pay for this. Xue Ying was clearly fussing over these minor matters because he had to earn enough Origin World Rocks to achieve his goal of getting the ‘Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core’.
Time passed.
Currently, he was at the Unity realm and thus, his soul was much stronger than when it was at the Origin Birth realm. Xue Ying’s speed of comprehension was extremely quick too. During the starting days of entering the Palace Hall of Time, Xue Ying primarily focused on cultivating the Walker’s Hidden Secret.
The reason was that he was that he was close to breaking through ever since he cultivated it at Celestial Water City’s ‘Qi Ya Incense Wood cultivation room’.
Everything went as expected. After cultivating for 66,000 years in the Palace Hall of Time, he had broken through to the 31st level of Walker’s Hidden Secret! He had finally entered the Unity realm in the Voidwalker system.
“Hong~”
Within the Palace Hall of Time, on a planet with a green plain, Xue Ying was seated cross-legged on it. There was a layer of pitch black primal chaos void energy surrounding the surface of his body. His body was currently undergoing a qualitative transformation towards a higher major realm.
‘Breaking through different realms feels differently indeed.’ Xue Ying opened his mouth, spitting out a ray of rainbow light. The rainbow light soon dissipated.
‘Right now, I should peacefully comprehend the laws and profound mysteries.’
Previously, the reason why he decided to improve in the Voidwalker system was first, he was about to break through in this system, and secondly, this transformation would be helpful to his soul. A stronger soul meant he could cultivate faster as well.
Xue Ying was confident of himself.
Even though his talent on the Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple was weaker than that of the Dao of Mirage, he could reach the Star Pagoda fifth level in both these aspects by spending a little more time on them! After all, he had depended on the 13 Apocalyptic Swords to get through the third level at the Origin Birth realm.
…
Time passed.
Every 100 million years, the Great Void Heaven Temple would accept disciples across the 12 primal chaos cities. After approximately 90 million years since Xue Ying entered closed-door cultivation, the new batch of disciples had entered.
“Great Void Heaven Temple.”
This group of True God disciples was looking at the many floating mountains with shock and astonishment, especially at the towering palace located on the biggest land-that palace was emitting a light which reflected across the entire space. As that light shone over these True God disciples, it made them feel nervous and excited at the same time.
They were here.
They had finally succeeded in entering the holy ground ‘Great Void Heaven Temple’! How difficult was it to join a holy ground? All of them had great talent and had passed through many trials.
“You all have just entered the Sky Palace Hall. It is forbidden for you to enter into certain areas. Some are places where the violet-robed disciples live in, and some are for the golden-robed disciples, and even the Inner Hall Elders and Hall Masters. You would be punished for your actions if you were to intrude into those places.” The leading Outer Hall Elder explained, “Follow me.”
Within this large group of disciples, there was a couple which came from the Celestial Water City-Lei Chen and Qing Ruo.
“I wonder where is Elder Dong Bo?” The relatively muscular Lei Chen said. The husband and wife had crossed through many bumpy roads, finally passing through the trials to become the newest ordinary disciples within the Great Void Heaven Temple.
“Elder Dong Bo? The two of you know Elder Dong Bo?” Another True God disciple asked from the side.
“Elder Dong Bo has a great favor for us.” Lei Chen and Qing Ruo said.
“You all are quite fortunate to get to know Elder Dong Bo.” This True God disciple said, “Elder Dong Bo is an Inner Hall Elder of the Great Void Heaven Temple, and is able to get through the fifth level of Star Pagoda after reaching the Unity realm. He is talented… and will likely become a hall master in the future of our Great Void Heaven Temple. I, Yan Qiong’s goal is to become someone like Elder Dong Bo in the future.”
“You still dare to say it.”
“Truly arrogant.”
There were quite a few True God disciples who had a powerful background. After all, only with this could they have a good cultivation environment, and only then would it increase their chances of getting through the trials of Great Void Heaven Temple. Naturally, many had heard of Elder Dong Bo as someone extremely talented! And there were quite a few disciples that desired to become as dazzling as Elder Dong Bo.
But they were just thinking in their hearts. To say their dreams out in public would only invite public ridicule.
For instance, ever since the creation of Great Void Heaven Temple, the number of geniuses who could compare with Elder Dong Bo could be counted with one’s fingers.
After Lei Chen and Qing Ruo found their places in the Great Void Heaven Temple, they had gone to pay Xue Ying a visit, but it’s a pity that Xue Ying had always been in closed-door cultivation!
…
This closed-door cultivation was very long.
Xue Ying spent a total of 180 million years-the total time in the outside world-cultivating. Within the Palace Hall of Time, Xue Ying had spent a total of 180 billion years. All of this was done in preparations of his upcoming journey to the Nine Cloud Great Land! Currently, he was at a bottleneck and could no longer improve. That was also the reason why he chose to exit cultivation now.
“Hu.”
Outside the Palace Hall of Time, a white-robed Xue Ying appeared in midair.

chapters.title: Chapter 848 - Sky Sword Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 848: Sky Sword Mountain
Great Void Heaven Temple, Ling Yun Peak.
Ling Yun Peak was one of the many floating mountain peaks. It was chosen by Xue Ying as his place of stay. The entire mountain peak only had a single cavern-dwelling and a single puppet servant.
Xue Ying turned into a stream of light, descending by the entrance of the cavern-dwelling located in the midway point of the Ling Yun Peak.
“Master.” A green-robed female servant respectfully greeted. She was looking with curiosity at her own master since he was very unique.
Most Inner Hall Elders would usually go out on adventures, or spend most of their time cultivating in their own cavern-dwellings. Yet her master had practically spent most of his time cultivating in the Palace Hall of Time. That place was costly, and cultivating for a total of 180 million years there meant that Xue Ying had spent 450,000 contribution points. That was way too extravagant. The other Inner Hall Elders would only occasionally visit the Palace Hall of Time. They would not dare to be so wasteful!
“Mn.”
Xue Ying entered his cavern-dwelling. He directly searched for a pavilion to sit and enjoy his wine while silently waiting. The green-robed female servant was puzzled, though she stood by the side waiting on him.
Just a moment later.
“Elder Dong Bo.” A voice was heard from outside.
“Let him in.” Xue Ying ordered. The green-robed female servant acknowledged and went to guide the other party in. This being the cavern-dwelling of an Inner Hall Elder, without the permission of the elder, none would be able to barge in.
Very soon, a young man walked in. He respectfully passed an ordinary storage wristband over: “Elder Dong Bo, these are the materials which the hall master ordered me to pass to you.”
Xue Ying extended his hand. The storage wristband flew onto his palm. He simply refined it before checking through its content. Within the storage wristband contained many daggers-a total of 3,600 of them. This was an entire set of offensive flying daggers, and was called ‘Frost Shadow’. These flying daggers contained an array which could be used to attack the enemy as one entity.
But Xue Ying did not care since what he liked about this set of flying dagger weapons was its quantity! It was appropriate for him in perfecting one of his absolute moves, the “Fish Dragon Kill”. This set of upper-graded Void God weapon might be in a large quantity, but every dagger required little materials to refine. Thus, Xue Ying had only spent a total of 600,000 contribution points for it. Xue Ying was still quite pleased with this weapon.
After all, when he imbued the Termination Energy on a powerful weapon, he could unleash a stronger power! Just by relying on Termination Energy itself was slightly too weak.
Other than the daggers within the storage wristband, there were several other items. Adding up the flying daggers, he had spent a total of 1.5 million contribution points! Even though it might seem expensive, these were precious treasures, and he could always sell them in the future! He would not lose out at all.
“Withdraw.” Xue Ying ordered.
“Yes.” The young male respectfully withdrew.
“Nine Cloud Great Land.” Xue Ying then went on to receive missions from the communication talisman. The missions on Nine Cloud Great Land could be accepted by experts from the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, and Myriad Ancient Sacred World. They would usually visit the Nine Cloud Great Land, with the Ancient Sacred Religion and Ancestor Mother Religion permeating within.
After receiving the mission, Xue Ying familiarized himself with the flying dagger weapon. He rested for a moment and finished drinking a flask of wine before standing up.
“If any friends come seeking me, tell them that I’ve left and will not be returning for a while.” Xue Ying said.
“Yes.” The green-robed female servant respectfully acknowledged. At the same time, she felt apprehensive. It seemed that this owner of hers would not stop cultivating! After coming out from closed-door cultivation, he was leaving again. Other Inner Hall Elders were comparatively much more carefree.
“Hu.”
The green-robed female servant sent Xue Ying off with her eyes. She did not know that other experts were not urgent, but Xue Ying was trying to save time by going to the Palace Hall of Time for cultivation. He could not afford to waste time!
This time when Xue Ying left his closed-door cultivation, many True God disciples had seen him leaving. Naturally, several Inner Hall Elders invited Xue Ying over for a meeting. Even ‘Lei Chen and Qing Ruo’ both came to visit him… but it’s a pity that when they came, Xue Ying had already left, and would not be returning for a while! To many cultivators, when they mentioned ‘a long time’, it would usually be very exaggerated,
Nine Cloud Great Land. This was a vast place with countless experts on it. Even Primal Chaos giants would spend a very long time traveling from one end to another end as they tear through time-space passages.
And that essentially strongest expert living on the Nine Cloud Great Land-Cosmos God ‘Ancestor Pure One’ had sent down the orders forbidding any spatial transportation arrays! Within the five great sacred worlds, despite the presence of many teleportation arrays, it was tough trying to travel already. Now that Nine Cloud Great Land had no teleportation arrays, it was even harder to travel. This was also because Ancestor Pure One increased the difficulty of the two opposing superpowers in permeating the Nine Cloud Great Land!
Without teleportation arrays, there were very few true peak experts who were dispatched over by the two ends. As for the ordinary experts… they could not shake the overall outcome of the entire Nine Cloud Great Land. After all, there were countless experts at the same level and even Primal Chaos realm experts around.
“Hong long long~”
A white-robed white-haired male appeared from a distorted space. Closely following that, space began closing up.
“Nine Cloud Great Land?” This white-robed white-haired male was wearing a silver mask. By changing his hair to white, and wearing a mask, Xue Ying wanted to prevent others from recognizing him. He was really on guard against the Ancient Sacred Religion. Looking around him, the law suppression of this world was quite strong, and it was only slightly weaker than that on the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. Nevertheless, the vast aura of this world felt more comfortable.
‘It is indeed a remnant piece from the Ancient Sacred World. Even though it is slightly smaller than a sacred world, the aura here seems to be quite nourishing to my soul. It will be even more helpful to the weaker lifeforms. The help it’ll provide to most Void Gods is negligible though.’ Xue Ying vaguely deduced this. The lower leveled cultivators here on the Nine Cloud Great Land were stronger than those in the sacred worlds.
‘Arriving on the Nine Cloud Great Land is very easy-Inquisitive Sky Hall Master was able to help send me directly over. However, going back is troublesome.’ Xue Ying felt helpless.
The entire Nine Cloud Great Land had very few Primal Chaos realm giants.
And he knew that there were no long-ranged teleportation arrays! Ancestor Pure One might be a Cosmos God, but he could not do so. He himself could only travel slowly through the primal chaos void if he wanted to return to the Great Void Heaven Temple.
‘Mn.’
‘The Nine Cloud Great Land…’
‘It is not as dangerous here as compared to the boundary of the void! This is an appropriate place for me to do my best and earn as many Origin World Rocks as possible.’ Xue Ying thought.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying’s figure disappeared from the place. He began manoeuvering through the void.
Even though Xue Ying’s Voidwalker lineage allowed him to tear through time-space passages, he would have to carefully observe by discerning the surrounding position first. Inquisitive Sky Hall Master sending him over a considerable distance would usually have a large degree of error. Furthermore, the map of the Nine Cloud Great Land given by the Great Void Heaven Temple was too simplistic. It only recorded some of the more important places and the superpowers! As for the weaker ones? The changes were too frequent.
“Hu.”
A luxurious big ship was flying in the sky. There were also many protectors on board the vessel itself. These protectors were at the True God level, and furthermore, the captain of the guards standing by the railings was at the Void God level.
‘Mn? This flying ship has a total of nine Void Gods, and one at the Unity realm? It must be some superpower.’ Xue Ying who was trying to check and ascertain his current location saw this flying ship through the void immediately. Unity realm cultivators were experts across the five great sacred worlds, and they were naturally experts on the Nine Cloud Great Land too.
If it were in other primal chaos lands or smaller places within the cosmos, they could be considered unparalleled overlords.
“How impudent!”
When Xue Ying appeared in front of the flying ship, the protectors on the flying ship shouted out angrily. As they shouted, they also understood that this white-robed white-haired male in front of them was not to be trifled with. Most could only teleport at the Unity realm. Naturally, some of the Origin Birth experts who specialized in the void aspect were able to do so, but no matter what, they were all experts.
Very soon, a large group of people came out from within the ship. The leading one was a red-robed girl. Her eyes were bright and beautiful. She looked at the white-robed white-haired male standing outside the big ship.
“Who are you? You dare to obstruct a battleship belonging to my Sky Sword Mountain?” The red-robed girl stated.

chapters.title: Chapter 849 - Hand Over your Treasures
chapters.content:
Chapter 849: Hand Over your Treasures
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Sky Sword Mountain?” Xue Ying was struck with a thought. Even though Inquisitive Sky Hall Master sent him to a place that strayed from the target location, Xue Ying could still discern where he was approximately located since the region he was currently at contained a superpower called ‘Sky Sword Mountain’. The leader of this superpower ‘Sky Sword Mountain Sect Leader’ was a Unity realm expert who cultivated for a very long time. In the intelligence collected by the Great Void Heaven Temple, it was recorded that the Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master was at the fourth level of Star Pagoda power. Usually, most who could get through the third level was at the peak of the Unity realm, and they could easily slaughter a large group of ordinary Unity realm expert. This person who could get to the fourth level… if they were not facing unparalleled Unity existences like those of the Great Void Heaven Temple Inner Hall Elders, they would be an overlord of a region.
That was the reason why the Sky Sword Mountain was recorded within the intelligence of Great Void Heaven Temple.
Xue Ying stood in front of the big ship and asked, “May I inquire which direction is the Rosy Clouds Great Lake at?”
Rosy Clouds Great Lake was also located in this region! Since the other party was from a superpower, the Sky Sword Mountain, it was not right for him to directly ask where the Sky Sword Mountain was.
“You actually do not know where the Rosy Clouds Great Lake is at?” An old man howled out haughtily from the side of the red-robed girl, “You are also an expert at the Unity realm. Do you not have a map of the surrounding region? Or are you just playing with us?”
Being a higher-up of the Sky Sword Mountain, he had the qualifications to shout back.
The Sky Sword Mountain was after all an overlord of this region.
“I’ve been in closed-door cultivation for a long time and have just broken through. Since I rarely traveled, I indeed do not know where it is.” Xue Ying chuckled before asking again, “Is it possible for me to find out which direction is the Rosy Clouds Great Lake at?”
“Hmph.” The old man stared at Xue Ying with suspicion.
“Uncle Chuan, he is only asking us for directions.” The red-robed girl smiled before pointing to a direction southwest of her, “The Rosy Clouds Great Lake is in that direction. Most Unity realm experts will spend a month traveling through the void to reach there.”
Xue Ying nodded: “Many thanks.”
“Sou”. He disappeared.
The red-robed girl looked at the white-robed white-haired male with a silver mask disappearing just like that; she could not help but feel astonished.
“He is really just asking for directions?” The old man felt skeptical. He was currently carefully inspecting his surroundings.
“Maybe he is a newly emerged Unity realm expert who has genuinely left closed-door cultivation. He might be too weak previously, which explains why he rarely went out. That is something normal.” The red-robed girl said, “Let us go. We are reaching the Sky Sword Mountain soon. It has been a long time since I last saw father.”
“Sou.”
The big ship continued traveling. It rapidly tunneled through the void and was moving at high speed forward.
Xue Ying appeared at his original position.
‘Mn? The direction they are heading should be the Sky Sword Mountain.’ Xue Ying thought. Even though the big ship was traveling forward through the void, Xue Ying could clearly sense the traces left behind by the ship as it tore through the void, ‘The Rosy Clouds Great Lake is indeed in that direction. That red-robed girl did not lie at all.’
Taking the position of the sun in the sky as a reference in addition to the direction of where the Rosy Clouds Great Lake was, Xue Ying could determine his current location. Naturally, he could deduce where the Sky Sword Mountain was.
Looking at the direction where the big ship was traveling in… it was where the Sky Sword Mountain was at.
‘Let’s pay the Sky Sword Mountain a visit.’ Xue Ying thought.
‘The Sky Sword Mountain is practically the strongest sect in this region. The Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master is quite formidable. I have to think of ways to determine if he is a follower of the two great religions.’ Xue Ying thought. If he determined that the other party was a follower of the two great religions-his soul contained an imprint-Xue Ying would naturally kill him without pardon! Nevertheless, it was a challenging task to identify it without alerting the other party because the soul imprint would usually be hidden.
Even though the three great sacred worlds had researched and created a secret technique which allowed cultivators to inspect the soul of another cultivator, learning this technique was not easy. Xue Ying took more than 100 million years in the Palace Hall of Time with his comprehension ability to learn it!
It was much easier to check the identity of the followers of the Ancestor Mother.
And it was harder to inspect the identity of followers of the Sacred Master. The techniques of the Sacred Master were very profound, and the imprint on the souls of his followers was concealed really well. Most required their power to be completely sealed before their souls could be inspected thoroughly.
******
As the big ship was traveling through the void.
The red-robed girl stood on the deck of the big ship. She was looking at the warping void around her with a smile on her face: “We are reaching the Sky Sword Mountain soon.”
“The Sect Master will definitely be happy if he knows that you have succeeded in breaking through to the Void God realm.” The old man chuckled from the side.
“Mn.” The red-robed girl nodded.
Suddenly, the void warped in front of them. A huge hand grabbed hold of the big ship, causing it to jerk and stop.
“What is happening?” The red-robed girl and old man were shocked. The surrounding protectors were all startled too.
If one said that Xue Ying obstructing them through the void was considered quite gentle, then the current party was much more overbearing. He had pulled the big ship out from the void into the real world.
The big ship stopped in midair.
Three figures were standing in front of them. They were all at the Unity realm.
“They are elders from the Blaze Valley.” The old man was shocked as he saw the three elders ahead. He hurriedly transmitted to the red-robed girl beside him, “The elders of the Blaze Valley are actually guarding the entrance of our Sky Sword Mountain. Something must be wrong. In a while, you should hurry up and escape. I’ll hold them back.”
The old man announced, “These three gentlemen, why are you blocking the warship of my Sky Sword Mountain?”
“Haha, Sky Sword Mountain. Very soon, there will be no more Sky Sword Mountain.”
“I was wondering who is it that tripped our warning array. So it appears that the darling daughter of that old ghost Sky Sword has arrived.”
“Haha, capture her alive!”
The three elders of Blaze Valley were delighted. Their words were still reverberating when a vast red web appeared in the surrounding. This web covered the entire big ship and had even sealed the void. Clearly, they were very cunning and had already started acting even as they were speaking.
The old man roared out as he turned into a strand of thunder, striking against the incoming web. Nevertheless, the fiery-red web was robust, and this thunderclap could not break it at all.
“None of you can escape from this.” One of the three elders from the Blaze Valley opened his mouth, spitting out a rolling black fog. This black fog was not obstructed by the web and easily permeated through it. It directly headed towards that red-robed girl. Clearly, this black fog was unleashed to capture her. Even though it might seem slow when narrating, everything happened as fast as lightning.
Only that old man had the capabilities to clash against the incoming black fog. He turned into thunder once again, but he could not move that fog at all.
“How could this be?” The red-robed girl felt uneasy in her heart. She remembered the other party’s words-’Very soon, there will be no more Sky Sword Mountain’. They were still at the outer perimeter of the Sky Sword Mountain, yet the other party had succeeded in constructing a warning array. Clearly, the situation within the Sky Sword Mountain was disastrous.
The thunder tangled with the black fog. Nevertheless, the black fog seemed overpowering the thunder it continued drifting towards the red-robed girl.
Suddenly-
“Hua!”
A dazzling sword light arced through the sky, breaking apart the fiery-red web and also broke through the black fog. The sword light contained a terrifying profound mystery that easily dissipated the black fog.
The sky regained its usual brightness.
A white-haired white-robed masked male walked out from the void. He was looking at the three elders from Blaze Valley.
“It’s him?” The formerly despondent red-robed girl, the old man and other protectors were looking with shock at this white-haired white-robed male. They recognized him as the one who asked them for directions previously.
“We, we are the elders of the Blaze Valley.” The three elders felt the surrounding void being restricted by an unseen suppression. Furthermore, the power of the previous sword light had made them feel a chill down their spines. They understood that this person should be at the very least, a peak Unity expert, and was someone they could not contend against.
“I wish for you to kill them. They are the arch enemies of my Sky Sword Mountain!” The old man on the big ship said.
The Sky Sword Mountain and the Blaze Valley were both arch enemies.
“Please have mercy. We did not mean to offend this senior.” The three elders hurriedly begged. Their postures had been placed very low because if that previous sword light came once again, they would die.
“Hand over all your treasures, and I’ll spare you.” Xue Ying said.
The three elders were stunned.
Closely following that, they did not hesitate in bringing all their treasures out. They even passed their storage wristbands and weapons over. Even their robes had been condensed from their own Void God energy as they no longer had them.
“We have given all our treasures.” The three elders said. As long as they could survive, they did not care about what treasures they had. Without a life, they would lose everything regardless.
“Go.” Xue Ying felt the three elders were quite tactful. He flipped his hands before keeping all those treasures.
The Sky Sword Mountain and the Blaze Valley were arch enemies?
That was unrelated to him!
Previously, he asked them for directions, and saving their lives was considered quite good already. As for the battle between the Sky Sword Mountain and the Blaze Valley, he could hardly care about it! It was only the followers of the two religions and several devilish cultivators whom he would directly kill. He would also kill anyone who was hostile to him. As for these matters of dispute… unless it concerned himself, Xue Ying would not truly tangle himself on such issues.
‘As long as I can get some treasures, it’ll be all good.’ Xue Ying chuckled. Coming to Nine Cloud Great Land, his aim was to get rich.

chapters.title: Chapter 850 - Start Moving
chapters.content:
Chapter 850: Start Moving
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“He actually let them off?” The old man felt slightly anxious after seeing that. The red-robed girl sighed inwardly too. According to their initial speculation, it was expected for the elders of Blaze Valley be killed. But clearly, this mysterious expert did not have the desire to kill those elders from the Blaze Valley.
“Father.”
This red-robed girl contacted her father through the communication treasure, “What happened to the Sky Sword Mountain?”
“Yi Zi, you should not return temporarily! The Sky Sword Mountain had just suffered from a sneak attack by Blaze Valley. I am currently dealing with the Blaze Valley Master.” Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master transmitted back before cutting off the connection. He could not lose focus on his current battle. Actually, the current situation was worse than what he mentioned. The Blaze Valley had clearly planned everything a long time ago, sending people into the Sky Sword Mountain with concealed identities and the purpose of ‘enshrining and worshipping’ the sect. They had even utilized the ‘Silver Silk Soul-Leading Poison’ against him before starting the battle!
The Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master was comparable to the Blaze Valley Master in terms of strength. At present, the Blaze Valley Master had prepared for this battle a long time ago—he paid a great price to buy the ‘Silver Silk Soul-Leading Poison’, applying it successfully on the Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master before starting the battle. Currently, the Blaze Valley held an absolute advantage. The Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master was trying his best to resist against the enemy, but ultimately, he was on the disadvantaged side.
“Hu.” The distant Xue Ying kept the treasures.
The red-robed girl then stated, “Senior, this junior Yi Zi is the daughter of the current Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master. Currently, my Sky Sword Mountain is in danger, and this junior is shamelessly requesting for senior’s help to aid my Sky Sword Mountain in crossing this difficult ordeal.”
She felt that this mysterious expert had a favorable opinion of her still. That was why she decided to thicken her skin and request the other party for help.
“Asking me for help? Based on what?” Xue Ying said.
The red-robed girl was slightly awkward. She added, “After the matter has ended, my father will definitely thank you gratuitously.”
“If senior could help us, this huge favor is something we will never dare forget. Currently, our Sky Sword Mountain is suffering from an ordeal, and the rest of us are feeling anxious, yet we are helpless and could only request this senior for help.” The old man was respectfully and earnestly asking for help. His expression was filled with anxiety, though he was remarkably calm in his heart. How could an old man who could cultivate to the Unity realm be a fool?
