He had determined the other party’s personality, and thus, was using ‘favor and friendship’ as conditions to invite the other party to help them.
“In other words, you want me to risk my life, hahaha…” Xue Ying casually laughed, “May I offer a bit of advice. Your Sky Sword Mountain is on the disadvantaged side. It will soon be exterminated. With your little power, you are just sending yourselves to your death!”
Saying that, Xue Ying disappeared.
“What… he left just like that?”
“He actually left?”
“He said that my Sky Sword Mountain will soon be exterminated?” Yi Zi felt slightly flustered. At this moment, they did not dare to contact the sect master because the sect master was fighting with Blaze Valley Master. They could only contact other higher-ups of the Sky Sword Mountain.
Very soon, news came back.
The situation was extremely bitter! The battle might have just begun recently, but the Sky Sword Mountain was on the disadvantaged side right from the start. Several worshippers and elders were thinking of ways to escape with their lives.
…
Mirage World.
Xue Ying was hiding in the void. He was strolling about. With his current attainments in the Mirage and his concealment technique from the Voidwalker lineage, the two experts battling above Sky Sword Mountain could not discover him at all.
“Hu hu~”
Unseen ripples enveloped the entire Sky Sword Mountain.
It was the strongest domain-based absolute art of the Great Void Heaven Temple-the “Plate Ripple Diagram”. Being the only ripple-related cosmos ranked absolute art, this domain was able to spread out to an incredibly vast region. Besides, the law suppression on ‘Nine Cloud Great Land’ was much weaker than that in the sacred world. Xue Ying’s current Plate Ripple Diagram domain had covered a total of 150 million kilometers! All the experts within Sky Sword Mountain were within his probing region.
Previously, he relied on this domain to ascertain the current situation and had suggested for that little lass to escape.
The reason why he did not promise to save the Sky Sword Mountain was that in Xue Ying’s eyes, the Sky Sword Mountain and Blaze Valley were both parties which he had to investigate. Only after he confirmed that a sect was part of the two great religion would he exterminate them! And with his current power, it was not too suitable to bring along the little lass and the others along.
‘The Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master seems to have some injuries on his body? He is completely suppressed. It seems he can’t hold on for long.’ Xue Ying was observing from a far distance using the ripples, ‘Hmm? There seems to be a peak Unity realm expert located here? It seems that he is from the Blaze Valley.’
“Sou.”
Xue Ying went over with a single teleport.
******
Within an old palace hall belonging to the Sky Sword Mountain, a group of cultivators was gathered here. There were five Unity realm experts amongst them working together, and one could see an array encapsulating this region above with a black snake swimming away continuously. There was even a dazzling light emanating from one of the Unity realm experts brightening the surrounding place.
“These three peak masters are still quite able to resist. But it’s a pity that your Daoist Elder has died! Your sect master is even inflicted with the Silver Silk Soul-Leading Poison. In a while, our Blaze Valley Master will smash all of you to death.” A black-robed cow-headed expert boomed out with his voice. He was relatively delighted. He would occasionally glance at those escaping Sky Sword Mountain disciples, to which he waved his hand, sending a black flame over that enveloped around the distant disciple, causing that disciple to let out howls of agony before turning into ashes.
“Hong, hong…”
There would be the occasional explosions in different regions of Sky Sword Mountain. This was, after all, the base of Sky Sword Mountain, and there were many other arrays around. Clearly, the disciples of the Sky Sword Mountain were fighting according to where they were stationed! The Blaze Valley also suffered from losses.
“It’s a pity that the Daoist Elder has been killed by them, and the sect master has suffered from a soul poison.” The three peak masters, two elders and the group of disciples were doing their best to hold on; they were feeling a chill in their hearts.
“Mn?” The black-robed cow-headed expert looked towards the distant. Even though his side had prepared sufficiently, the losses they faced this time were quite large still, “Gong Yu wanted to exterminate the Sky Sword Mountain, but it isn’t easy for us to exterminate them for the Sky Sword Mountain has been passed down from generations to generations. The price we have to pay is not small either.”
He would occasionally unleash some black flames which arced through the sky and assaulted on the disciples of Sky Sword Mountain!
This scene made the trapped peak masters and other experts of Sky Sword Mountain indignant. Their sect which they treated as their home was currently being wrecked, and many disciples were being slaughtered.
“Damn.”
“What should we do? What should we do?” All of them were extremely anxious and helpless. They could barely survive by focusing entirely on defending themselves. If they were to escape, the Blaze Valley Vice-Master in front of them could easily take the chance to kill all of them.
Suddenly-
They were startled to see a white-robed white-haired male walking out of nothingness. He was wearing a mask and was holding on to a sword. He easily hacked at the black-robed cow-headed expert with his sword, causing that black-robed cow-headed expert to feel his entire body entering a quagmire. Many restrictions were entangling him, greatly reducing his movement speed. One could then see a sword light directly slashing down on his body.
“Peng~”
His entire body was hacked away. He crashed against the old wall of the palace hall.
“What, he is defeated in a single move?” The three peak masters and other cultivators of the Sky Sword Mountain saw what happened, and they felt hope appearing in their hearts.
“What, what is happening…” The black-robed cow-headed expert was still slightly stunned. He did not know that with Xue Ying’s current attainments in the Plate Ripple Diagram-it was at the fifth level Star Pagoda standard. If Xue Ying wanted to suppress the other party, the black-robed cow-headed expert could not even move, and would be pressured to death!
The gap between an expert who crossed the third level and one who crossed the fifth level of Star Pagoda… was just like a peak Unity realm slaughtering an ordinary Unity realm expert. The gap was humongous. This Plate Ripple Diagram was also the strongest domain-related aboslute art, and by relying on this, Xue Ying had reached the boundary of Primal Chaos realm. This black-robed cow-headed expert was naturally being tossed around by Xue Ying.
But Xue Ying had to remain reserved. He did not want the two big religions to recognize him.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying sent another sword over to the black-robed cow-headed expert. He then saw that the eyes of that expert were slightly beguiled. Clearly, he had fallen for Xue Ying’s Mirage illusory techniques!
After being inflicted from the illusory technique, at this moment, the other party no longer had any resistance. Only then could Xue Ying display his secret technique to investigate the other party.
‘Let me see if he is a follower of the two great religions.’ Xue Ying thought. He stealthily displayed his secret technique, directly allowing it to tunnel into the body of the black-robed cow-headed expert. Under the circumstance of no resistance, it easily pierced into the soul of the other party!

chapters.title: Chapter 851 - Greed?
chapters.content:
Chapter 851: Greed?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
A mark glowing with green light surfaced on the soul of black-robed cow-headed expert present within his body. This caused a knot to surface within Xue Ying’s heart: ‘Follower of the Ancestor Mother? The first person I inspected after coming to the Nine Cloud Great Land is actually a follower of the Ancestor Mother Religion?’ According to the information he collected previously, the natives of the Nine Cloud Great Land were the stronger power present here, while the two great religions and three great sacred worlds had merely influenced a small section of the place. After all, the experts they sent over were too few.
“Hong.”
In the eyes of the surrounding people, after Xue Ying bombarded the black-robed cow-headed expert with his sword, he had followed suit with sending out arc after arc of sword lights. They flew through the sky, enveloping black-robed cow-headed expert before directly turning him into pieces, causing him to die right there and then!
“Good.”
“He indeed is extremely powerful.” The three peak masters, two elders, and other disciples from the Sky Sword Mountain watched in excitement as emotions filled their hearts. The one who died was the vice-master of Blaze Valley, who was the Blazing Valley’s second strongest person. Despite that, he had been instantly suppressed and killed.
“Many thanks, senior for saving us.”
“Many thanks, senior.”
All of them were filled with gratitude as they thanked Xue Ying Their despair had abruptly been reversed, causing them to feel extremely grateful to Xue Ying. What’s more, they could discern that this mysterious expert was standing on their side.
Xue Ying nodded, before waving his hand to collect the treasures left behind by the black-robed cow-headed expert. He thought: ‘This is the one ranked second in terms of strength within Blaze Valley, and is even a follower of the Ancestor Mother Religion. If that’s the case, then their strongest person, their Valley Master might very well be one too.’
According to his understanding, there were two types of situations as to how religions spread their beliefs.
The first was when they had the absolute superiority in strength in an area they occupy. They would preach religion without any restraint, with even the weaker Transcendents being forced to believe in the Sacred Master (or Ancestor Mother).
The second scenario would be when the religion did not hold superiority in strength and thus did not dare to act in such an open fashion. Otherwise, it would be easy for the followers of the religion ranking from the weaker Transcendents to the stronger Void Gods of a sect to be revealed. The moment they were revealed, the three great sacred worlds would certainly send experts over to exterminate the entire sect. Thus, during the circumstance when they did not hold absolute superiority in power… they would generally be careful in concealing their traces. For instance, they would let the higher-up of a certain sect become a follower! Although there would be fewer higher-ups, they would have the greatest influence.
The vice-valley master was a follower!
The valley master would possibly be one too!
“Senior, my Sky Sword Mountain is suffering from a huge calamity, while our Sect Master being in a perilous state. Would it be possible for senior could help our sect master out?” One of the peak masters requested towards Xue Ying for help, with the others following suit. As someone who could defeat the Blaze Valley vice-master with such ease, his strength should likely be on the same level as the sect master and the Blaze Valley Master. Even if he were weaker than the Valley Master, it would not be by much.
Although the vice-valley master was killed, the Blaze Valley Master was still the strongest. If he did not die, the Sky Sword Mountain possibly exterminated in the future.
“Blaze Valley Valley Master? I’ve heard that he is very strong.” Xue Ying revealed a hesitant look before saying, “Go, let us have a look first.”
“Go.”
“Quick quick quick.”
Those present did not dare to hold any hopes for this mysterious expert would accept their requests. It was already pretty good for him to take a look.
Very quickly.
Xue Ying and the others traveled through the sky, arriving at the area of Sky Sword Mountain where the most intense battle was taking place. In the distant sky, Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master was currently engaged in a life and death battle with Blaze Valley Master.
Even though they flew over, Xue Ying was, in fact, using his Mirage illusory techniques to casually deal with the two Unity experts from the Blaze Valley closest to him. During the moment the other parties fell into the illusory realm, Xue Ying began permeating through their souls using the secret technique.
‘They aren’t followers.’ only after affirming that the other parties were not followers did he let them exit their illusory realm, allowing those two Unity realm experts to feel panic upon releasing m j.
“Not good.”
“The sect master is in danger.” During the moment when Xue Ying was secretly inspecting the other two parties stealthily, the three peak masters beside him were anxiously watching the battle happening afar. They could determine that their sect master was in a dire situation!
“Uncle Teacher has died?” The Blaze Valley Master who was engaged in battle had the appearance of red-haired big and tall young man, with his body entire body clad in flames. He swept his gaze across Xue Ying, “Is it this silver-masked male who killed Uncle Teacher? Nonetheless, there is no need for me to provoke this mysterious expert. At this moment, should focus my entire strength to get rid of Old Ghost Sky Sword first!”
“Hong~ Hong~” clad in flames, theBlaze Valley Master appeared just like a miniature Sun Star, his every action brimming with terrifying power.
Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master was a black-robed middle-aged male. With much more experience in combat under his belt, he would not care about Blaze Valley Master in normal circumstances. However, …
“Ah.” Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master could sense a few silvery silk strands tunneling into his soul. Those strands were continuously ‘tunneling’ in, causing his soul to feel intense pain. Furthermore, he would have several fainting spells from time to time, preventing the sect master from being able to fight with his full strength, as he would require a considerable amount of focus when using his most profound moves.
He had become completely defensive, and would only occasionally launch an attack.
The situation was still alright at the beginning. However, after fighting for a while… the ‘Silver Silk Soul-Leading Poison’ was permeating deeper and deeper into his soul, causing the frequency of fainting spells to increase.
“Sect master, there is a silver-masked white-haired white-robed expert that has appeared. He has defeated that fool of a cow from the Blaze Valley with a single move, before proceeding to kill him.” The Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master was extremely excited when he received this piece of news. Due to the continuously intensifying poison, he felt that it was hard for him to escape this time, with the possibility of the entire Sky Sword Mountain Sect being completely exterminated.
However, hope has appeared.
“It’s him?” Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master noticed a white-robed white-haired male standing in mid-air far away with three of his own sect peak masters.
“Ask him to take action. You all must hurry and ask him for help, regardless of the price.” Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master sent a voice transmission over.
…
Xue Ying stood there, listening three peak masters urging him for help. He frowned before shaking his head: “This Blaze Valley Master is quite powerful. Furthermore, watch him fight will enable me to better understand his techniques .”
“We can’t wait any longer. Our sect master is unable to hold on any further.” The three peak masters were very anxious. They knew of the idiom ‘know thy enemies and you would win a hundred wars’. By observing the techniques of the Blaze Valley Master, the mysterious expert would have a greater chance of triumphing over the other party. However, no one would be able to guarantee that their sect master would survive until then!
The Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master in the distant was also extremely anxious.
He could not help but feel dizzy time after time, with him struggling to release sword lights from his body to parry against the claws from the Blaze Valley Master! That claw caused many sword lights to dissipate, while Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master felt his chest being torn off. Nonetheless, he was still able to keep his life.
“I’m simply unable to suppress this soul poison while fighting with my full strength.” Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master felt the silver silk tunneling in deeper within his soul.
“Father, father, I’ve heard that a white-robed white-haired expert with a silver mask had killed the Blaze Valley Vice-Master? This expert is the one who saved me previously. I feel that the only thing we can do is to bring out treasures if we want his help! He has a weakness… and that is he is slightly greedy. Previously, he dealt with the three elders of the Blaze Valley and let them off, yet he snatched away the treasures from the three of them, even their robes and weapons.” His daughter Yi Zi transmitted over.
This made Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master feel a chill down his spine.
Greedy?
That was good! He was only afraid the other party was not greedy!
“This friend, so it was you had previously saved my daughter and even saved these peak masters. Today, my Sky Sword Mountain is facing a calamity and I still request for you to help. When the matter ends, I am willing to give you treasures as thanks. The worth of the treasures is not any less than 80 Origin World Rocks.” Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master announced loudly.
In the distant, Xue Ying who was originally hesitating immediately replied: “If that’s the case then, I’ll risk my life!”

chapters.title: Chapter 852 - Pursuit
chapters.content:
Chapter 852: Pursuit
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying immediately charged out. The god sword in his hand produced a dazzling sword light which went directly towards the Blaze Valley Master.
The expression of the Blaze Valley Master changed at that moment. Cultivators had a long lifespan precisely because the majority of them was cautious. Under circumstances when they had no confidence of, they would not easily intervene in battles unrelated to them. Otherwise, they might just lose their lives if they were not careful. That would mean doom, and even if they had more treasures, it would be pointless!
“You want treasures? But you can’t enjoy them without your life!” At the moment when Blaze Valley Master sent Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master back with a fist, he flipped his hand before surging in another direction with killing intent.
“Hong~”
Xue Ying only felt the world brightening up in front of him. Amidst a dazzling and eye-piercing flame, there were shadows of fists bearing with them endless might. Some of the weaker Unity experts, even if there were a hundred of them, would be smashed into fine powders by this fist. And Xue Ying was greatly shocked too. The sword lights he formed traveled through an arc to parry against this continuous fist shadows.
As they clashed with booms, Xue Ying was forced backward. His body clashed against one of the mountain peaks. “Peng.” Half the mountain had collapsed from this impact, and Xue Ying spurted out a mouth of fresh blood.
“Not good.” The three peak masters were anxious as they watched this, “The combat power of this expert seems slightly weaker than the Blaze Valley Master.”
“You think of spoiling my business just with these puny abilities of yours? Leave behind your little life!” Blaze Valley Master’s aura shot into the sky.
And Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master who was originally taking use of this chance to suppress the ‘Silver Silk Soul-Leading Poison’ in his soul, turned anxious and had hurriedly transmitted over: “Be careful. The offense of this Blaze Valley Master is extremely tyrannical. But he lacks in body cultivation and profoundness. You cannot clash head-on against him.”
Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master was unmoving. His sword techniques and defenses were formidable, and that was why he dared to clash head-on against the Blaze Valley Master.
Thus, one could not see how violent their fight was on the surface just by watching the fight between the Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master and Blaze Valley Master.
“I’ll have to team up with you to eliminate him as soon as possible.” Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master also realized that it was hard for this mysterious expert to triumph over the other party in a one-on-one fight. He could only grit his teeth and persevere on.
“Alright.”
Xue Ying transmitted back.
He was deliberately concealing his identity. Xue Ying already had long given himself a new identity-as a swordmaster who specialized in domain and body cultivation. His power was set at the fourth level of Star Pagoda! Because there were still quite a lot of cultivators at this level of the Nine Cloud Great Land. If he revealed himself as someone at the fifth level Pagoda strength, Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master and the rest would have long spread this to others!
Any expert at the fifth level of Star Pagoda would draw the attention of the three great sacred worlds and the two religions!
Because there were few at this level across the entire Nine Cloud Great Land! The appearance of any one of them would generate suspicion. Unless he was a native expert with a growth history to back him up, otherwise, any unfamiliar expert was someone the two great religions, and three great sacred worlds would not let loose of.
‘I am merely trying to determine his power.’ Xue Ying came killing his way over again. This time, unseen ripples began spreading out rapidly and engulfed the Blaze Valley Master, causing his expression to change because the other party realized that his flying speed had immediately reduced greatly. This was even when Xue Ying had deliberately ‘concealed’ his strength. He was only revealing part of the full power of the Plate Ripple Diagram.
“Hua hua hua.”
Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master killed his way over. One could see many sword lights coming down like a chain of mountains.
Blaze Valley felt his movements being restricted. He could only face the incoming strikes with his palm, but the power of this palm was significantly reduced. As the incoming sword lights that were like a chain of mountains swept over, Blaze Valley Master was forced back off. Fresh blood formed on the injuries on his chest.
“Mn?” Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master was slightly shocked. He was actually on the upper hand in a frontal collision? Closely following that, he felt himself becoming dizzy again, though he gritted his teeth and continued displaying his sword techniques again.
“Xiu.”
And in the distant, Xue Ying’s figure flashed and appeared right where the Blaze Valley Master was.
‘Such powerful domain restriction. Is it from this mysterious expert?’ Blaze Valley Master felt himself turning anxious. He was facing the incoming assault by Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master, yet Xue Ying’s sword light had arced over in a flash. Blaze Valley Master did not specialize in body cultivation and was also being restricted. He had to multitask and parry against the Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master. Even though he was using a single palm to parry against that sword light from Xue Ying, that sword light continued hacking down onto his body, causing half his body to be destroyed. But the flames on his body burned and he grew back his parts again.
‘Not good.’ Blaze Valley Master’s expression had a huge shift.
“Take good use of this opportunity to kill him.” Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master was slightly excited.
“Alright.” Xue Ying seemed to be soaring with killing intent.
‘This mysterious expert might be weaker in a frontal offense, but his domain is very formidable, and his sword techniques are relatively profound.’ Blaze Valley Master felt anxious.
“This friend, aren’t you doing it for treasures? This Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master has already been inflicted with a strong poison. As long as you work together with me to kill him off, by then, his treasures will belong to you. I am willing to give you treasures worth more than 80 Origin World Rocks too.” Blaze Valley Master hurriedly mentioned it.
Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master felt his heart tightening.
The distant three peak masters felt anxious too.
This mysterious expert was greedy. For the sake of treasures, he would be willing to engage himself in a life and death battle of experts on the same level as him. And Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master was absolutely disadvantaged when fighting one-on-one against Blaze Valley Master. If the expert had helped Blaze Valley Master… then the outcome of the battle would be unquestionable. It would even be easier for the mysterious expert.
“You underestimate me too much.” Xue Ying’s voice reverberated. The sharp sword in his hand did not stop.
“Treasures worth 100 Origin World Rocks. These are all the treasures I have. I give them to you.” Blaze Valley Master shouted out.
Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master who felt his heart relaxing, began turning anxious once again.
Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master was troubled because he did not have treasures worth a total of 100 Origin World Rocks!
“Si la.”
Another sword light came. Under the teamwork with Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master, they heavily injured the Blaze Valley Master once again, causing half his body to be overwhelmed. This time, his recovery was much slower.
“Retreat! Everyone retreat now!” Blaze Valley Master felt really unwilling, but he still gave out the order to retreat to his subordinates. He was suffering from Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master’s offense and had hurriedly retreated. As he left the law domain region, he immediately teleported.
“Sou.”
He was escaping.
“Escaping?” Xue Ying followed along the void arc of the other party.
If comparing void travel, being a Voidwalker, he was absolutely unparalleled amongst those at the Unity realm. He could even compare to the standards of many Primal Chaos realm giants.
“Hu, hu.” Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master stopped, and with a flash, he landed on top of a mountain peak. He was doing all he could to suppress the Silver Silk Soul-Leading Poison in his body. Currently, the sect master did not dare to pursue after the other party again because he was barely holding on to his dear life now given how heavy his injuries were! He might just faint if he were to continue fighting with his condition.
The moment he fainted, he would not be able to suppress the poison anymore, and this soul poison would permeate deeper. By then, he would definitely die!
He did not wish to die!”
“Protect me.” Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master ordered the other three peak masters.
“Yes.” Three protectors immediately surrounded him. Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master did not care about anything happening in the outside world anymore. He was pouring all his attention to try and curb this soul poison.
And across the entire Sky Sword Mountain, the disciples of Sky Sword Mountain who were entirely on the disadvantaged side and could only rely on terrain to hold on discovered with slight astonishment. The experts of the Blaze Valley were actually retreating in large amounts at this moment. They were converging with a Unity realm expert batch by batch before rapidly teleporting away.
“Escaping?”
The Sky Sword Mountain Sect which thought they were going to be exterminated, realized that the enemies were actually escaping now.
…
“I hate this. I hate this!”
Blaze Valley Master was overwhelming with fury and unwillingness as he escaped.
Because he had prepared for a very long time just for this battle!
Ever since his teacher had been schemed to death by the Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master, he had always wanted to take revenge. He took the risk to adventure outside, and only after he gained strength comparable with the Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master did he come back. Only then did he re-create the Blaze Valley! He had spent much effort to acquire the ‘Silver Silk Soul-Leading Poison’, arranging unknown experts who he recruited in the outside world to enter the Sky Sword Mountain using identities as worshippers, slowly permeating into the Sky Sword Mountain…
Step by step, it eventually led to today when everything erupted!
For the sake of vengeance and to eradicate the entire Sky Sword Mountain, he paid too much!
And to complete the mission handed down by the Ancestor Mother Religion, he had to eradicate the Sky Sword mountain. But now, everything ended up in failure all because of that mysterious expert.
“Hong.” The void fluctuated.
‘Not good.’ Blaze Valley Master felt his expression changed. He was being forced out of the void. Soon after, he realized that the white-robed white-haired silver-masked male was in front of him.
‘His void penetration is so much more formidable than mine?’ Blaze Valley Master was appalled. If their skill of teleportation were comparable, it would be hard for the other party to obstruct him. Nevertheless, it was clear that the other party had a considerable advantage over him. But thinking of how the other party specialized in domain and also body techniques… it was normal for the other party to be superior in terms of the void. But he did not know that if not for concealing his strength, Xue Ying could ensure Blaze Valley Master could not even teleport!
“Die for me.” Xue Ying unleashed the Plate Ripple Diagram to suppress the other party. He then hurriedly came killing his way over.
Blaze Valley Master was originally moving slow, and now that he was restricted, he soon suffered from another strike.
‘So he is originally stronger than me. He only suffered some slight losses during the start of the battle when he fought head-on against me.’ Blaze Valley Master was enlightened. He did not dare to continue fighting and wanted to escape from the law domain. But soon, he was being hindered by Xue Ying again.
“I’ll give you all my treasures. Please just spare my life!” Blaze Valley Master began begging for mercy once despair inundated him. The other party was greedy and might just spare him.
“Hmph.”
Xue Ying did not seem to stop.
“Hong~” Another sword light broke apart the flustered defenses of Blaze Valley Master, rapidly destroying his body. But Xue Ying’s control of the sword light was extremely exquisite-it enveloped around the soul of the other party.
“Seal.”
Blaze Valley Master’s entire body was destroyed, leaving behind only his soul which was sealed. Xue Ying waved his hand before keeping the treasures of Blaze Valley Master.
“Mercy, mercy!” The soul of Blaze Valley Master was still begging for mercy.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying looked at him coldly. He began utilizing the secret technique to inspect the other party’s soul.
At that moment, a green marking began floating on the soul of Blaze Valley Master.
“You, you are…” Blaze Valley Master felt shocked. He finally understood that the party in front should be an expert from one of the three great sacred worlds which were enemies with the Ancestor Mother Religion and Ancient Sacred Religion. Previously, all his disguises were fake. Only now did he reveal his true self!
“You are indeed a follower of the Ancestor Mother.” Xue Ying coldly stated.
He had to be careful when inspecting the other party because the other party would immediately report upwards using the communication treasure the moment he discovered this!
Thus, Xue Ying had to seal the other party’s soul to prevent him from reporting upwards. Furthermore, Xue Ying had kept the treasures of the other party already.
“Hong.” Xue Ying flipped his hand, causing an unseen ripple to sweep across the soul of Blaze Valley Master and extinguishing his soul directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 853 - The Treasure Cove of Monarch Nine Cloud
chapters.content:
Chapter 853: The Treasure Cove of Monarch Nine Cloud
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was not in a rush. He tore through the void and returned back leisurely.
‘Sky Sword Mountain.’ Xue Ying appeared from nothingness. Right in front of him was the Sky Sword Mountain. Currently, the entire place looked ravaged. Many places were still burning with flames. Even though the war had ended, Sky Sword Mountain still suffered from huge losses. Even their Daoist Elder had died, along with many peak masters, worshippers, elders, and disciples.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying’s figure flashed. He arrived at the peak of a mountain. Here gathered a group of experts. They were currently protecting that black-robed middle-aged male seated cross-legged in the center.
“Senior.” A sweet-sounding voice was heard.
Xue Ying looked over. It was that red-robed girl.
“Many thanks, senior for acting.” This red-robed girl Yi Zi thanked him profusely, “This junior still believed that senior would not act after leaving us. Now that I think back… it should be that senior isn’t willing to bring us along since we will only encumber senior.”
“No need for thanks. Your sect master has agreed to give me treasures. It is perfectly logical for me to act.” Xue Ying casually replied.
Many of those present were still filled with gratitude to him.
Treasures? Even if they were more precious, they were still external materials! If they died, the treasures would be useless even if they had more. For Xue Ying to save their Sky Sword Mountain during that circumstance was not about saving their sect master, but saving the entire sect!
“This junior is called Violet Rain, and how should we call senior?” Yi Zi asked. Violet Rain was her title, and Yi Zi was her actual name. Usually, only those close to her would call her by her actual name.
“Flying Snow.” Xue Ying casually answered.
“Senior Flying Snow, this junior wonders if Flying Snow has succeeded in pursuing that Blaze Valley Master?” Yi Zi asked.
“He is already dead.” Xue Ying directly commented.
All the higher-ups of Sky Sword Mountain felt excited when they heard that. Blaze Valley Master was dead? The valley master of the Blaze Valley and vice-valley master were both dead. The remaining few were not worthy of being worried of. Most likely, the escaping disciples of Blaze Valley would not dare to stay in their old base and would be swiftly escaping for their lives. It seemed that the ‘Blaze Valley’ which had been fighting with their Sky Sword Mountain for years had been exterminated!
“Senior is really amazing to kill the Blaze Valley Master. This junior believes that senior’s name will soon spread across the land.” Yi Zi flattered him. Her eyes brightened. This senior in front of her was at the same level as her father. With his ability, he could become an overlord in the Nine Cloud Great Land. Such a great expert must be pulled closer.
For instance, they could join his sect and for her to acknowledge him as her teacher. That would be even better!
Right as many thoughts formed in the mind of Yi Zi, the black-robed middle-aged man who was busy suppressing the soul poison opened his eyes. He looked towards Xue Ying saying, “Brother Flying Snow, are you able to help me remove this soul poison?”
Xue Ying was stunned. He answered, “Sky Sword Sect Master, aren’t you worried that I might make use of the opportunity to scheme against you?”
“With Brother Flying Snow’s power, who here can block you from killing me?” Sky Sword Sect Master added, “This Silver Silk Soul-Leading Poison is too ruthless. Previously, for the sake of battling, I’ve let the poison penetrate deeper into my soul. Currently, I no longer have the confidence of suppressing it. Thus, I do hope to ask Brother Flying Snow for help.”
“I’ll attempt it.” Xue Ying nodded. The other people immediately let way.
Xue Ying walked over to the side of the Sky Sword Sect Master before sitting down cross-legged. He extended his hand onto the shoulder of the Sky Sword Sect Master. At that moment, he sent many ripples into his body. Sky Sword Sect Master did not stop them at all.
These ripples permeated into the consciousness of Sky Sword Sect Master and enveloped around the soul of Sky Sword Sect Master.
“So severe?” Xue Ying was slightly astonished.
The soul of Sky Sword Sect Master had already been permeated by large amounts of Silver Silk Soul-Leading Poison. They were so dense that it looked akin to arteries and veins, covering the soul. Without Xue Ying, the Sky Sword Sect Master could indeed not suppress the poison… besides, it was too difficult to travel on the Nine Cloud Great Land. He would not have the time to find an appropriate antidote and would thus die.
“Brother Flying Snow can act regardless you want.” Sky Sword Sect Master added.
“Mn.” Xue Ying was cautious. He sent many strands of ripples into the soul of the other party.
Reaching the realm of Sky Sword Sect Master, his soul was extremely powerful. Even if it were cut into ten parts with nine being extinguished, he would only suffer from a minor injury! Thus, the ripples permeating into the soul of Sky Sword Sect Master did not inflict great wounds on him. It was only that the ‘Silver Silk Soul-Leading Poison’ had entirely penetrated into his soul, and expelling it was extremely arduous.
“Chi chi chi.” Xue Ying’s Plate Ripple Diagram gave him precise control over the ripples. He began restricting the silver silk.
As he was helping the other party expel the soul poison, Xue Ying was also stealthily displaying his secret technique.
“Weng.”
Because he had large amounts of ripples permeating into the soul of Sky Sword Sect Master, the other party did not suspect him at all. His soul did not have any reaction.
‘He isn’t a follower of the two great religions.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘But that’s right too. According to the intelligence reports, there should be very few followers of the two religion amongst native experts. For me to discover Blaze Valley Valley Master and the vice-master to be followers is a great fortune for me. If the Sky Sword Mountain Sect Master is a follower too, then things will be too coincidental.’
Searching for followers was a very troublesome task.
Firstly, those at the level of Blaze Valley Master and Sky Sword Sect Master were at the fourth level Star Pagoda level. It was impossible for him to inspect their souls stealthily! He had to injure the other party heavily and seal the other party’s power completely, and only when the other party could not retaliate could he utilize the secret technique on him! But this way, if an expert suddenly popped out on the Nine Cloud Great Land acting against all the overlord across the different regions… it would arouse suspicion on his identity! Once the two great religions noticed him, he would not be able to stay on the Nine Cloud Great Land anymore.
Secondly, if such important followers died, the religion would immediately know! They would check out what had happened.
Like the current event where Blaze Valley Master took the initiative to attack the Sky Sword Mountain, and for Sky Sword Mountain to have an expert helping them to kill Blaze Valley Master made it look normal.
If an unfamiliar expert suddenly attacked Blaze Valley, killing the Blaze Valley Master…
Killing one was fine. But if there were a day when he killed another important follower, the religion would certainly suspect him since they had to pay a great deal of price to bring a follower up to the fourth level Star Pagoda strength. If a follower at the lower level died, it did not matter much. But at the fourth level Star Pagoda strength, each and every one of such followers was important, and even beyond normal sacred emissaries.
‘I have to be careful when dealing with the battle between the two great religions and the three great sacred worlds.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘I can’t be too brazen. Instead, I must act according to the circumstances.’
Like this time, he had eliminated Blaze Valley Master according to the circumstances.
…
The soul poison of Sky Sword Sect Master was very troublesome, but Xue Ying cultivated the strongest domain absolute art of the Great Void Heaven Temple. If he were to put all his strength in, he could expel the poison in the time taken to brew a cup of tea. But he was very patient in spending half a month to slowly completely expel the soul poison from the body of Sky Sword Sect Master.
“Hong long~”
As they left the cultivation room, there was a group of Sky Sword Mountain higher-ups waiting outside. That young woman Yi Zi was also standing outside.
“Hahaha, with Brother Flying Snow’s help, I’ve already completely expelled that soul poison, hahaha…” Sky Sword Sect Master let out peals of laughter.
“Congratulations sect master, congratulations sect master.” All the higher-ups of Sky Sword Sect present were extremely excited because the Sky Sword Sect Master was the central pillar of the entire sect. That time, he was the one who created this sect. Furthermore, the Dao Elder had died in battle. If the sect master died because of the soul poison, the sect would not have a single expert at the peak Unity realm. That would mean the division of the Sky Sword Sect.
“Congratulations father, many thanks Senior Flying Snow.” Miss Yi Zi said.
“Haha, everyone, please withdraw now. I have some matter to talk to Brother Flying Snow. Yi Zi, prepare some good food.” Sky Sword Sect Master ordered. Letting the daughter of the sect master to personally prepare the food and serve Xue Ying shows how much importance the sect master was paying Xue Ying.
Very soon, the other people had retreated from the courtyard.
Xue Ying was seated opposite the Sky Sword Sect Master.
“Brother Flying Snow, this saving grace is something which I could hardly repay.” Sky Sword Sect Master sighed with sorrow. This time, their sect had almost reached its doom when everything had been transformed.
“I might be able to help Brother Flying Snow only with the treasure cove of Monarch Nine Cloud.” Sky Sword Sect Master continued.
“Monarch Nine Cloud’s treasure cove?” Xue Ying was startled.
“You haven’t checked through the treasures left behind by Blaze Valley Master?” Sky Sword Sect Master felt suspicious.
“After killing him, I had been helping you expel the soul poison, so I did not have the time to inspect through his items.” Xue Ying said. Saying that, he brought out a storage wristband and directly refined it. There were many items within it, and Xue Ying soon found something which he wanted to-that was a very unique gold hairpin.
Xue Ying flipped his hand, causing this gold hairpin to appear in it.
‘The treasure cove of Monarch Nine Cloud.’ Xue Ying thought. His eyes brightened.
Monarch Nine Cloud.
He was a very famous Cosmos God from the primitive Ancient Sacred World. His power was ranked even at the front of the final realm existences. But during the final battle which led to the breakdown of the primitive Ancient Sacred World, Monarch Nine Cloud had been grievously injured, and he died soon after. Clearly, his injuries were too heavy and strictly speaking, he had died in the hands of the sacred master.
That time when the primitive Ancient Sacred World had shattered, Monarch Nine Cloud’s injuries were too heavy, and he knew he would die.
Thus, before dying, he had flown deep into the primal chaos void and arrived at this Nine Cloud Great Land. He then constructed a total of 16 treasure coves on this land! Furthermore, he threw out 30 gold hairpins on the Nine Cloud Great Land and publicized the information-
As long as one got five gold hairpins, he could activate the array and be teleported into one of the treasure coves!
But…
Only Void Gods could enter, and only five could enter at once!
After every teleportation, the gold hairpins would be dispersed back to the Nine Cloud Great Land.
…
Hence, over the long period, because there were a total of 30 gold hairpins and many had gathered five gold hairpins, quite a few experts were entering. There were even Primal Chaos realm experts who entered. But even with 16 treasure coves, it was tough to completely gather all treasures from any one of them. Usually, most could only acquire part of the treasures. Over the long period of entering time after time, the majority half of the 16 treasure coves should have been emptied, but the gold hairpins were still around, representing the fact that there were still treasures!
This was ultimately a final realm existence who ranked in the forefront during the early period of the primitive Ancient Sacred World.
Comparing strength, he was much stronger than even the Void Primogenitor and Forefather Tian Yu.
“You actually knew that the Blaze Valley Master has a gold hairpin too?” Xue Ying was shocked as he looked at Sky Sword Sect Master.
“That year, the previous Blaze Valley Master and I discovered two gold hairpins at the same time.” Sky Sword Sect Master said, “We agreed to each take one hairpin. But just after dividing them, he suddenly ambushed me. Even though I did not have the intention to do so, I was still on guard! That battle eventually led to his death, though it was a fierce battle. During the process of escaping, he had hidden that gold hairpin. Even though I was able to kill him eventually, I did not find the gold hairpin. I’m guessing that he should have hidden it in a location before informing his disciple. After the previous Blaze Valley Master died, the Blaze Valley became an arch enemy of the Sky Sword Mountain.”
“These are just two hairpins. I would need five before they could allow me to activate the teleportation isn’t it.” Xue Ying said. He naturally desired to have the treasure cove too!
What was the reason for coming to the Nine Cloud Great Land? Naturally for the treasures! For the sake of exchanging a ‘Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core’ to help Jing Qiu and Yu’er, it should suffice if he would acquire part of the treasures left behind by a Cosmos God.

chapters.title: Chapter 854 - Can’t Unleash It?
chapters.content:
Chapter 854: Can’t Unleash It?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
he Sky Sword Sect Master was about to speak when young lady Yi Zi came over with delicious food and good wine. She had even personally poured the wine for Xue Ying: “Senior Flying Snow, this is wine which I personally brewed, called ‘Sword Rain’. Usually, I would only let father enjoy it.” Saying that, she passed a glass to Xue Ying.
Xue Ying chuckled as he took a sip. He knew after drinking that the value of this wine was not that high since he had tasted many top-graded wines before at the Great Void Heaven Temple.
But the taste of this wine was relatively rich, and it would cause the drinker to feel a warmth in their bodies; he even had the feeling of entering an illusory realm.
“Interesting.” Xue Ying praised.
“My daughter is quite talented in brewing wine. It is just that her cultivation talent is slightly weaker and has barely entered the Void God level after crossing through many bumpy roads.” The Sky Sword Sect Master mentioned.
Xue Ying softly nodded after hearing that: “She is not bad already. Those who could become True Gods will have eternal life and can stay forever with her partners. That will suffice.” Xue Ying’s own wife and son were stuck at the stage four World Deity realm and were not even True Gods. That was also the biggest knot in his heart currently.
“That’s right. It is sufficient for them to live eternally with their companions.” The Sky Sword Sect Master sighed as he spoke. After cultivating for a long period, he only had his daughter left with him.
“Yi Zi, you should go back first.” The Sky Sword Sect Master ordered.
“Yes, father.” The young woman Yi Zi obediently left.
The courtyard was left with just the two of them. Only then did Sky Sword Sect Master say: “In order to enter the treasure coves of Monarch Nine Cloud, there is a need to gather five gold hairpins. You and I have a total of two only… I have a good friend who told me that he knows a cultivator with the third gold hairpin. Naturally, he did not tell me who that cultivator is. But as long as we are able to get two more hairpins, it is possible for us to team up with him.”
“Team up?” Xue Ying frowned, “Will we be backstabbed if we meet? Who knows if any Primal Chaos realm giant are searching for the gold hairpin as well in the dark.”
“Rest assured.”
Sky Sword Sect Master chuckled, “If we meet, we will definitely meet in the city constructed by Ancestor Pure One. The closest one from here is called the ‘Pure Resistance City’. Within Pure Resistance City, even Primal Chaos realm existences would not dare to act wantonly. Even the Primal Chaos realm giants from the three great sacred worlds and two great religions would not dare to offend Ancestor Pure One.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded.
The Nine Cloud Great Land…
The true owner of this land was ultimately Ancestor Pure One! He might not be willing to enter the war between the two superpowers, but he wasn’t too willing to watch this ‘Nine Cloud Great Land’ where he was staying at be destroyed by the two superpowers. That was why he set down so many rules.
For instance, it was forbidden to construct any spatial arrays at all! That made communication across various places on Nine Cloud Great Land difficult.
And also, he had built a total of 12 cities dispersed across the Nine Cloud Great Land. Every city contained an array which he constructed personally and an incarnation which he left there to guard the place! The incarnation of a Cosmos God… under most circumstances, would not be able to kill the true body of a Primal Chaos realm giant. But with the help of the arrays, things would be different.
These 12 cities all contained arrays constructed by the ancestor. And thus, the incarnation of Ancestor Pure One was unparalleled within.
Furthermore, he had also set a strict rule-forbidding Primal Chaos realm existences from entering the cities!
The purpose of constructing the cities was to leave behind a pure land to allow experts who were not willing to fight to cultivate peacefully.
“If you are willing, how about I inform that good friend of mine?” Sky Sword Sect Master said.
“Alright. I’ll naturally be going to the treasure coves of Monarch Nine Cloud if I could.” Xue Ying said.
“Haha, this is something all cultivators on our Nine Cloud Great Land desire.” Sky Sword Sect Master chuckled before sending his transmission. Just a while later, he added, “The other side has agreed. We will meet at Pure Resistance City! Some amongst them stay within the city itself, and some lives quite close. It is estimated that the furthest cultivator would reach in about 50 million years. We would spend slightly longer-about 80 million years to reach. Brother Flying Snow… for the sake of safety, we should travel there separately. This way, it’ll be safer for both you and me.”
“Alright.” Xue Ying nodded.
He understood the vigilance of the other party.
As long as they travel to their destinations separately, then only they knew what paths they took to get there. It would be impossible for the enemies to plan and ambush them.
“The journey is far. I’ll set off tomorrow.” Xue Ying said.
“I would take about 80 million years to reach, so you don’t have to be in such a hurry.” Sky Sword Sect Master said. He still wanted his daughter to get closer to this expert. If she could join the sect of the other party, it would be even better. After all, hearing from her daughter, the other party had just left closed-door cultivation after breaking through. Who knew if the other party could still improve further, reaching the stage where he would be unparalleled across all Unity realm experts.
That was at the fifth level of Star Pagoda level, and also an absolutely high level of power in the holy grounds of the three great sacred worlds. They would be able to sweep their way across all existences Even in the Nine Cloud Great Land as long as no Primal Chaos giant came.
Even if he did not improve further, he was comparable in strength to Sky Sword Sect Master and had also saved him before.
“I’ve just exited closed-door cultivation not too long ago, so I would like to make good use of this chance to have a walk.” Xue Ying said.
“So it is like this. That’s good too. Then I’ll not hold Brother Flying Snow back any longer.” Sky Sword Sect Master chuckled, “By then, we will meet at the Pure Resistance City and enter the treasure coves of Monarch Nine Cloud together.”
…
On the next day, Xue Ying bid farewell and left. Miss Yi Zi was slightly unwilling to part as she stood on the Sky Sword Mountain. She admired and was grateful to Xue Ying, and wanted to take him as a teacher. It’s a pity that Xue Ying left too quickly.
In the following days, Xue Ying traveled around many places on the Nine Cloud Great Land.
He was enjoying the scenery left on the remnant piece of the ‘primitive Ancient Sacred World’. He would occasionally sit down cross-legged on the desolate plain to cultivate. When he met certain evil, like a devil who devoured an entire village, Xue Ying would unhesitantly act. He would check the soul of the other party before killing him! And if he felt like it… he would give the occasional pointers to the brats living here.
In the blink of an eye, 50 million years had passed.
On top of a group of mountains.
The white-robed Xue Ying walked out from a wooden house. He frowned: ‘I’ve grasped the all the profoundness of the second style of “Dark World”, but I just can’t unleash the move. Why is that so?’
He cultivated for a total of 18 billion years within the Palace Hall of Time. He had cultivated both the “13 Apocalyptic Swords ” and “Plate Ripple Diagram” to the fifth Star Pagoda level combat power. He had even reached the fifth apocalyptic sword, simplifying it to create the new version of “Fish Dragon Kill”… as for the Dao of Mirage which he had the greatest talent in, Xue Ying had long comprehended all the profound mysteries behind the second style of Dark World, the ‘Sky Punishment Edge’. But he just could not unleash the technique.
He had even altered and perfected the first style ‘Dark Bubble’ to make it more appropriate for himself.
Currently, he had spent 50 million years traveling around this Nine Cloud Great Land, yet he did not relax in his cultivation.
‘What is happening?’
‘I’ve clear comprehended the Sky Punishment Edge move. I no longer have any perplexities in it, yet I just can’t display it. ‘Xue Ying felt uncomfortable, ‘I’ve simplified the fifth apocalyptic sword and also comprehended quite a few parts of the sixth apocalyptic sword. Judging by this speed, I might comprehend the sixth apocalyptic sword before even unleashing the ‘Sky Punishment Edge’.’
Like the absolute arts of Great Void Heaven Temple, he could use the move the moment he comprehended it!
But despite understanding the second style of Dark World, he could not unleash the technique. That Dark World Master did not explain why this is so in the absolute art he left behind.
‘Unless I misunderstood something? Impossible. With my attainments in the Dao of Mirage, it is impossible for me to make such a low-level mistake.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘There must be a certain issue somewhere.’
‘Time for me to travel.’
‘To the Pure Resistance City.’
Xue Ying extended his senses. There were no other cultivators within the 150 million kilometers around him.
“Hua.”
He waved his hand.
A huge 33-meters diameter distorting time-space maelstrom formed in front of him. Xue Ying took a step before entering it. He entered the time-space vortex and went on his journey!
The Nine Cloud Great Land was ultimately too big. The ‘Sky Sword Mountain’ which the Sky Sword Sect Master chose to set would naturally be closer to one of the cities constructed by Ancestor Pure One. It was really considered quite close already since Sky Sword Sect Master could reach the Pure Resistance City in 80 million years.
But Xue Ying was traveling using the time-space vortex. That was entirely different.
Just 300 years later.
Xue Ying appeared in a place of desolate land stealthily. He then tore through the void and flew for the time taken to a cup of tea before seeing a majestic and ancient city. This city was covered in rainbow lights above it-that was the light formed from the array covering it.
“Sou.” Xue Ying turned into a stream of light before flying through the city doors. He took a few steps after landing by the city doors and entered through the revolving array. Being a Unity realm expert, he was not denied by this array constructed by the Cosmos God from entering.

chapters.title: Chapter 855 - Treasure Cove God Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 855: Treasure Cove God Pagoda
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Pure Resistance City was a city created by the Cosmos God ‘Ancestor Pure One’. The quantity and quality of the cultivators gathered in this city were higher as compared to those in the primal chaos cities under the Great Void Heaven Temple because the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World was much safer-the two religions would only dispatch incarnations of Primal Chaos realm expert into the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World at most. Furthermore, those with sufficient statuses in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World could directly report upwards to those like Forefather Tian Yu and Devil Mountain Primogenitor for them to send their incarnations down.
Thus, some of those experts who could reach the fifth level Star Pagoda could easily occupy a region within the three great sacred worlds and did not have to fear the two religions.
But it was different on the ‘Nine Cloud Great Land’!
The two great religions had stationed Primal Chaos experts here for long periods, resulting in a more dangerous location. Those who wanted to cultivate in peace were more willing to remain within the cities created by Ancestor Pure One and receive his protection.
“Zhi ya.”
After pushing open the courtyard door, the white-robed Xue Ying left the place, ‘Sky Sword Sect Master who is the slowest has finally arrived.’
He had just received information sent by Sky Sword Sect Master that they would be gathering at the assembly point. It was time for them to head to the treasure cove of Monarch Nine Cloud.
‘There isn’t a single person at the fifth level Star Pagoda strength in Celestial Water City, with only three at the fourth level strength.’ Xue Ying could see from the aura of the experts in this city. He felt slightly rueful. After 30 million years, he was quite familiar with the Pure Resistance City, ‘And there are only one at the fifth level Star Pagoda strength in this city, 12 at the fourth level strength and so many at the third level strength that it could frighten others…’
The sacred worlds naturally had more experts, but they were scattered across the sacred world. Excluding the Primal Chaos giants belonging to the Great Void Heaven Temple, the Primogenitor Island, and the Jade Light Sacred Territory in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, given how vast the sacred world was, many other Primal Chaos superpowers were living in more remote areas… with more than half these giants being unwilling to join the holy grounds. They would rather form their own territory so that none would be commanding them.
For instance, the ‘Ancestor Desert Palace’ of Eastern Unicorn Sacred World did not depend on any Cosmos Gods at all.
…
Xue Ying was tearing through the void within the city. He soon arrived outside a courtyard.
There was already a True God puppet lifeform serving outside the courtyard. That puppet lifeform extended his hand and stopped Xue Ying: “Please stop.”
“Five people.” Xue Ying said. This was the secret signal told to him by Sky Sword Sect Master.
“Please.” The puppet lifeform no longer obstructed him.
Xue Ying entered.
This courtyard wasn’t too big. After crossing through the frontcourt, he soon arrived at an inner palace hall where there were three other figures gathered. Xue Ying did not recognize any of them.
“Brother Flying Snow.” Sky Sword Sect Master transmitted over, “I’m already here. The one wearing a golden robe on the left is me. Why did you not change your appearance?”
Xue Ying remained white-robed and white-haired with a silver mask on his face.
“The others will change their aura, appearances and try to conceal their identities this time. Otherwise, after the matter ends… once the information about them getting the treasure is spread, it’ll attract countless troubles.” Sky Sword Sect Master transmitted over, “After the matter ends if I successfully got the treasures, I would even remain in Pure Resistance City for a long period. I would at most send my incarnation back to Sky Sword Mountain. You should be vigilant too and not reveal your identity.”
“Brother Sky Sword, don’t misunderstand things. My current appearance isn’t my true appearance. After all, I am not fully confident of the previous matter of intervening between you and the Blaze Valley Master. I do not wish to fail and even offend a huge enemy like Blaze Valley Master.” Xue Ying transmitted over.
At this moment, the gold-robed Sky Sword Sect Master became slightly astonished.
What a guy…
This Flying Snow wasn’t showing his true appearance at all.
“The fourth person is here.” There were three seated in the palace hall. Other than a gold-robed Sky Sword Sect Master, there was one in a black robe and covered in mild black fog. It was hard to discern if he was a male or a female. The third was a massive hunk with a big body and exceptionally huge arms. His thighs were of average thickness, though his arms were bigger than his thighs. He was emitting a savage aura.
“Sit.” This muscular male said, “We are waiting for the last person.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying did not reply. He just chose a position and sat down.
The four figures were situated in the palace hall. It was quiet. Everyone knew that they gathered this time because of using each other’s gold hairpin. Once they entered the treasure cove, they might just become competitors. For the sake of treasures, they would kill each other… that was something which happened frequently. Thus, everyone had to maintain vigilance and not even reveal their identities at all.
Just a moment later, a woman wearing a loose gray gown came. This woman had an ordinary appearance, though her eyes were filled with an unseen pressure.
‘Mn?’ Xue Ying looked at the other party’s eyes and could not help but feel a jolt in his heart, ‘Third level of the heart realm?’
The heart realm was split into three major levels.
His hometown cosmos might have given birth to several Void Gods, but currently, only the Swordmaster and Ancestor Devil had reached the third level of heart realm. Xue Ying might have a great comprehension ability, but after coming to the holy ground Great Void Heaven Temple, he experienced too few things. The majority of the time was spent in closed-door cultivating, and he did not have many breakthroughs in his heart realm.
Just like Ancestor Devil and Swordmaster, they were once rivals. During the earlier period, Ancestor Devil was stronger. But eventually, Swordmaster became even more overwhelming and profound in his strength and had completely flung Ancestor Devil aside! Ancestor Devil treated Swordmaster as his rival and eventually broke through in his heart realm too.
The two were competing with each other. As for Xue Ying, he experienced much too few things as compared to the two of them.
‘This girl seems to have reached the third level of heart realm, yet she did not plan on hiding it? Is it because she has absolute confidence in herself?’ Xue Ying was inwardly shocked. If the other party deliberately kept her aura, he would not discover how frightening her willpower was.
“Alright, everyone is here.” The muscular man stood up. He merely glanced at the girl who came last without minding her too much.
Because a profound heart realm did not mean she would be powerful. Some cultivation systems focused more on the heart realm like hex and the laws and profound mysteries system. Some did not care about it at all like the devour class system and the bloodline system…
“Everyone did not bring any other lifeforms in your Eden treasure right?” The muscular male said in a low voice. His voice had a suppressive characteristic within, “The gold hairpin teleportation could only send five living beings in. The moment we bring any other living beings with us in our Eden treasure, the teleportation will fail.”
“No.”
“Naturally I did not.”
“This point is something I know.”
All of them acknowledged.
The golden-robed Sky Sword Sect Master then said, “Let us take out our gold hairpin.”
“Mn.” Everyone present did not hesitate. With a flip of their hands, the five experts brought out a gold hairpin each in their hands. This made everyone present relaxed. Even though they had only contacted each other through a single line, and had vaguely admitted that they had a gold hairpin each, it was much better seeing it with their eyes.
“Activate.”
The five of them immediately activated the gold hairpin in their hands with their Void God energy.
“Weng!””Weng!””Weng!””Weng!””Weng!”
After the five gold hairpins were activated, at that point, mysterious golden patterns were floating on the surface of the hairpins. Xue Ying could no longer feel the hairpin in his hand being controlled by himself. A horrifying spatial power forced the hairpin out of it. The five gold hairpins flew together, and as they flew into midair of the palace hall, their golden patterns began producing a frightening spatial array.
“Hua~”
Space was like water flowing at this moment. Xue Ying could feel his body comfortably going through the water-like space, and when the scene ahead of him became clear, he had already arrived at another location.
This location was already somewhere far from where the Pure Resistance City was.
Xue Ying and the other four figures landed on a stone beach. Behind them was a piece of white distorted space.
And ahead of them, there was a towering golden pagoda!
“Treasure Cove God Pagoda.” That muscular male with thick arms could not help but blurt out in excitement.
“It is the Treasure Cove God Palace. We are finally here.” The figure who was enveloped faintly in black fog said as well. His voice seemed slightly sharp.
Xue Ying’s eyes brightened as well as he looked at that god pagoda which towered close to 330 meters in height.
Treasure Cove God Pagoda!
That time right before the Cosmos God ‘Monarch Nine Cloud’ died, he left behind 16 treasure coves, and they were 16 Treasure Cove God Pagodas!
The Treasure Cove God Pagodas were hidden in unique spaces within different regions of the Nine Cloud Great Land. With Monarch Nine Cloud’s strength, if he decided to construct a location with all his power, the other Cosmos Gods would not be able to find them. Destroying the entire Nine Cloud Great Land was pointless because these 16 Treasure Cove God Pagodas… were not located within the ordinary Nine Cloud Great Land world.
This was a space entirely white in color with a diameter of several dozen kilometers. At the center of this space was a god pagoda.
Many information floated in the mind of Xue Ying.
Want to leave?
There were two ways. First was to directly fly out towards the distant white boundary and contact directly with the distorted space at the end. One would be teleported out into the ordinary Nine Cloud Great Land world.
The other method was to stay within this space for three days. At the end of three days, even if one weren’t willing to leave, he would still be forced out of this place.
‘I must gather sufficient treasures within the next three days.’ Xue Ying looked at the Treasure Cove God Pagoda in front of him. His eyes turned sharp. As long as he earned a great deal this time, then he could gather sufficient materials to aid the cultivation of Jing Qiu and Yu’er. This time, none should dare obstruct his path!
Xue Ying’s desire was the same as the other four. This was a treasure cove of a Cosmos God!
“Sou sou sou sou sou!”
Along with the girl in a loose gray gown who flew out first, the others also turned into streams of light as they flew towards the central Treasure Cove God Pagoda with an already opened door.

chapters.title: Chapter 856 - Within the Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 856: Within the Pagoda
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The pagoda door of the Treasure Cove God Pagoda was ancient. At this moment, it was fully opened. The door was about 33 meters tall.
Xue Ying and the other four directly entered the Treasure Cove God Pagoda one after another.
‘I am in. The treasure cove of the final realm existence, Monarch Nine Cloud.’ Xue Ying stood on the black floor. It was pitch black above with many twinkling stars scattered around. Xue Ying was clear that those twinkling stars… were also treasures of this place. There were even more treasures hidden within that were located on other floors.
The Treasure Cove God Pagoda was split into three levels. There would usually only be two to three treasures found on the third level. Nevertheless, these treasures were significant even to Monarch Nine Cloud and were worth a lot. Any of those treasures would suffice to make Primal Chaos realm giants red with greed.
“Hua.”
Suddenly, a flight of void stairs formed within the treasure pagoda. This void stair led up all the way and soon reached the dark sky at the highest spot. Furthermore, there was a simple ancient stone door appearing at the end of the stairs.
There were a total of five void stairs which led to five sets of stone doors.
“Up.”
“Sou.”
Xue Ying, Sky Sword Sect Master, the muscular man, the black-fogged figure and the girl in loose gray gown both took a set of stairs each and climbing up the void stairs.
‘The law suppression here is extremely great.’ Xue Ying tried floating in the air as he walked up the void stairs. But he was being forced down by the unseen law, ensuring that he had to take step by step.
Looking at the Treasure Cove God Pagoda from outside, it was merely 330 meters tall. But the space within was humongous. Just the height of the void stairs in the first level space was already 50 kilometers long!
“Weng.”
Xue Ying’s speed of climbing was very quickly. He had even formed afterimages from his speed. In the blink of an eye, he traveled 15 to 20 kilometers, and ‘peng’, he charged right into the void barrier.
“There are a total of three barriers on the stairs. Even if you broke through all three barriers, you still have to smash apart the stone door only could you reach the second level. Why the rush?” The sharp pitch voice came from the black-fogged figure on another set of stairs.
Xue Ying was too lazy to care about that person.
He had gotten detailed information from the Great Void Heaven Temple. Naturally, he knew what the other party said. He had just smashed apart the barrier previously in order to determine how tough it was, and whether it could be directly broken. That way, he could continue breaking through all barriers on his way.
“Break.” A god sword appeared in Xue Ying’s hand. With a flash of sword light, ‘pu pu pu’, he sent three strikes on the void barrier. “Hua~” It broke the void barrier.
At this moment, the other four were also striking the void barriers. Very soon, they had broken through the first layer of barrier.
“Sou.”
Within the dark sky of the Treasure Cove God Pagoda’s first level, there were many bright resplendent stars. Suddenly, one of the stars fell.
Xue Ying’s eyes brightened. His arms elongated as he grabbed at that falling star. But as his arms extended to just five kilometers away, he encountered an unseen obstacle.
“This is mine.” The thick arms of the muscular man expanded similarly. When his arms extended to a few kilometers long, he grabbed hold of that falling star. At the moment he touched the star, the glowing light on the surface shattered, showing a piece of broken blade edge within. It was silver white, and anyone who saw it would feel their hearts trembling. It’s a pity that this was only a remnant piece.
‘It should be the remnant piece from a top-grade Void God weapon.’ Xue Ying made his judgment, ‘It should be valued at around 30 to 50 Origin World Rocks.’
…
Xue Ying and the other four continued moving forward.
Within the sparkling stars in the dark sky, there would be the occasional stars falling down. As long as one contacted it with one’s fingers, the star would dissipate to reveal the treasure within. The treasures would have differing values. Some might be worth just a few Origin World Rocks, and some might be worth close to 100 Origin World Rocks.
“Pu.””Pu.”
Xue Ying did not care much about these treasures.
Because these treasures were just from the first level. Only those weaker cultivators who occasionally come would remain for a long period in the first level.
“Hua.”
He sent another three consecutive sword lights on the void barrier. The final void barrier on the third floor had also crumbled apart. Xue Ying formed an afterimage as he rushed to the end of the stairs. The end of the stairs connected into the sky, and there was an ancient stone door located there.
“Hong!” Xue Ying was the first to charge to where the stone door was out of the five of them. He slashed down with the sharp sword in his hand, turning into a sword light that smashed against the stone door in front. ‘Hong long long’, under the fierce strike, the stone door trembled and boomed. Large amounts of stone pieces flew apart, revealing bits and pieces of cracks.
Just at this moment when Xue Ying struck the stone door, one of the brightest stars in the dark sky suddenly dropped. It turned into a dazzling meteor which flew towards Xue Ying.
At this moment, even though Xue Ying was slashing on the stone door, he noticed that incoming star. Even the other four located within the entire Treasure Cove God Pagoda were staring at that star.
After getting the gold hairpins, they would naturally collect all sorts of related intelligence regarding the treasure coves of Monarch Nine Cloud. They also knew that in the first level of the Treasure Cove God Pagoda… once the first cultivator out of the five struck the stone door, it would immediately cause a star to fall. The treasure contained in this star would also be the most precious one amongst all the stars in the first level!
“Truly arrogant.”
“This treasure is too precious. Isn’t he afraid that he can’t bring it out alive?” The muscular man and others were watching on thinking about that. They were clear that all other cultivators would be their competitors after entering the treasure cove! Thus, they would rather remain low-profile and not be the first to take the most precious treasure in the first level of the Treasure Cove God Pagoda.
Because the most precious treasure on the first level was considered high grade even on the second floor! If a horrifying expert was hiding among the five of them, he might just act.
This time, they would be spending three days within the Treasure Cove God Pagoda. They were patient. If they were arrogant right from the start, they would reveal their skills and most of these people would not live for long!
“Hu.” The white-robed Xue Ying stared at the falling star with his eyes behind the silver mask. He extended his left hand, and at the moment when the large falling star touched Xue Ying’s finger, the star began evaporating like a bubble, revealing the treasure within-this was a dead wood about the size of an arm. There were also many golden woolen whiskers on top of it.
The deadwood emitted an aura.
The location where it was located would be filled with endless life energy.
‘Golden Whisker Sky Thunder Wood.’ The eyes of Xue Ying brightened. His heart began jumping faster. The other four cultivators also held back their breaths. They were watching dumbstruck at this piece of deadwood.
The Golden Whisker Sky Thunder Wood…
During the earliest period of primitive Ancient Sacred World, it was worth about 1,000 Origin World Rocks. It required the descent of the operating law from the primitive Ancient Sacred World, the ‘Sky Thunder’ to strike on a ‘Golden Whisker God Tree’. Most Golden Whisker God Trees would be struck and turned into ashes, and only very few would leave a deadwood behind that was filled with life energy.
But!
Ever since the shatter of the primitive Ancient Sacred World, there would no longer be any more Golden Whisker Sky Thunder Wood. Many Cosmos Gods had even wanted to acquire this wood.
This Golden Whisker Sky Thunder Wood could be used to refine weapons or to create a new world. It could be used to refine medicines too…
Ever since the destruction of the primitive Ancient Sacred World until now, this chunk of ‘Golden Whisker Sky Thunder Wood’ had increased in its valuation to 3,000 Origin World Rocks! That time, Monarch Nine Cloud thought that it was worth 1,000 Origin World Rocks and had placed it as one of the most important two to three treasures on the first level. That was normal. But nevertheless, its value had soared way beyond that what it was when Monarch Nine Cloud was still alive.
‘It is worth so much?’ Xue Ying felt his heart racing. A treasure worth 3,000 Origin World Rocks was considered an outstanding one even when placed at the second level of the Treasure Cove Star Pagoda! It would even make the eyes of Primal Chaos realm giants blaze with fervor.
This deadwood was worth way beyond what he had all together!
The treasure cove of a Cosmos God was indeed different.
Xue Ying extended his hand to grab. He was clutching this Golden Whisker Sky Thunder Wood tightly in his hand, and with a thought, he kept it into his storage treasure.

chapters.title: Chapter 857 - Flying Dagger
chapters.content:
Chapter 857: Flying Dagger
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Since even Primal Chaos realm giants would thirst for such an item, Xue Ying being an Inner Hall Elder of Great Void Heaven Temple could feel his heart racing, much less the other four cultivators.
‘It is worth 3,000 Origin World Rocks! 3,000 Origin World Rocks!’ Sky Sword Sect Master felt his eyes turning red. Even though he knew Xue Ying had saved him once before, he still felt an intense impulse to kill the other party and snatch the treasure since the value had turned him slightly mad. Nevertheless, firstly, he still has a bottom line that prevented him from acting against his savior; he could suppress the impulse. Secondly, even if he acted, he was not confident of succeeding-he understood his limits.
A treasure worth 3,000 Origin World Rocks had caused the hearts of the other four cultivators to tremble.
What did this mean?
A protective treasure like the Black Gourd was worth 500 Origin World Rocks at most! A treasure worth 3,000 Origin World Rocks could be exchanged for even better protective treasures than the Black Gourd. No matter what, one could improve his power or survival capabilities significantly. To Sky Sword Sect Master and the others, if they could afford to buy a treasure stronger than the Black Gourd, they would be practically unparalleled underneath the Primal Chaos realm.
Even if they were extravagant to purchase some puppet lifeform, 3,000 Origin World Rocks could allow them to buy a puppet lifeform which had the combat strength at the fifth level Star Pagoda. Furthermore, the puppet lifeform had an overwhelming advantage as compared to cultivators-it had a practically undying body and would remain eternally loyal. It would not complain about working hard, and the cultivator could also select different kinds of puppet lifeforms. Some specialized in escaping, some were good at attacking…
The muscular male, black-fogged figure and gray-gowned girl were all staring at Xue Ying as if he were prey.
‘Hmph hmph hmph… he is fortunate to get such a marvelous treasure on the first level.’ The eyes of the muscular male dilated. They were flashing with a faint cold light, ‘I am instead at a fork road. I did not care about the first level since the more valuable treasures would only appear at the second level. Who would have thought that I would miss out on such a treasure? Now, I just have to snatch it from his hands.’
The gray-gowned girl was not in a rush to act as she watched.
