Of which there was someone with a slightly unique position, and that was Myriad World Tavern Master! Because he had many avatars, none could kill him. None was willing to become enemies with him, and he was considered a unique Cosmos God.
“Do you know why I told you these?” The black-robed male with a stooped body stared at Xue Ying with his clear cold eyes. His hoarse voice was filled with hatred and killing intent, “Because master hates Sacred Master to the core. Even after he died, he still wanted to deal with Sacred Master.”
Xue Ying could hazily discern this black-robed male as a puppet lifeform.
For a puppet lifeform to be filled with so much hatred and killing intent showed how much anger his master Monarch Nine Cloud had towards Sacred Master.
“After Master died, he wanted any future juniors coming over to help him.” The black-robed male said, “And you are one of them.”
“Me?” Xue Ying was stunned, “Asking me to deal against Sacred Master? Senior, aren’t you regarding me too highly?”
That was Sacred Master!
Almost all final realm existences had enmity with him. Despite that, he was able to live as the most dazzling existence. Even if Xue Ying was confident of himself, and had once thought of becoming a final realm existence in the future, he did not dare to say that he could deal with Sacred Master! After all, Ancestor Mother, World Ancestor, Ancestor Sorcerer, and the others could not do so.
“It is natural that you can’t do it yourself. You are just one of the many.”
The black-robed male’s chuckled and continued with his hoarse voice, “What do you think Master left behind so many treasure coves for? Do you really think he wanted to distribute them away? You are wrong! The first and second level of the Treasure Cove God Pagodas contain very ordinary treasures and aren’t worth anything to Master. They are meant to attract experts from the outer world.”
“Only the treasures in the third level are the significant ones. Reaching the third level of any treasure cove will actually bring you here.” The black-robed male casually mentioned, “And it is just one of the 16 palace halls which Master has within this entire Cultivation Palace.’
“16 palace halls contain extremely precious treasures.”
“Most Primal chaos realm experts could enter, but almost none can take the treasures away! Only those extremely powerful Primal Chaos realm experts or those with extremely high attainment in certain aspects…” The black-robed male said, “Could take the treasures away from the third level. They are also chosen as ‘aides’ for Master. As for you? You are also one of the aides.”
Xue Ying felt puzzled, “Previously, I can’t even take a single treasure away in the palace hall. Yet I am qualified to be chosen as an ‘aide’?”
“I chose you for your potential.” The black-robed male looked at Xue Ying grinning. It’s only that his laughter seemed horrifying, “You are currently the one with the highest comprehension ability and potential amongst those who entered my master’s treasure coves! It is highly unlikely for those Primal Chaos realm experts to improve themselves further. Some could not even take away the treasures in the third level and are too weak, so they aren’t qualified to become an aide. Only those who could take them away are slightly useful.”
“As for you? Your potential and comprehension ability are extremely high. That is why I chose you to be an aide too.”
The black-robed male coldly said, “All those aides who are chosen will be given the same conditions.”
“Kill a ‘Saint’ from the Ancient Sacred Religion, and you are able to get a treasure worth 10,000 Origin World Rocks from here. The more you kill, the more treasures you will acquire.”
“Killing 50 ‘Saints’ from the Ancient Sacred Religion or a Cosmos God and you will get all the treasures Master left behind.”
Xue Ying was stunned.
He felt helpless.
Killing Saints? Who were the Saints? They were Primal Chaos giants!
Like in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, there were a total of 12 Primal Chaos realm giants in the Great Void Heaven Temple. There were also quite a few of these existences in the Primogenitor Devil Mountain and Jade Light Sacred Territory. There were even more Primal Chaos realm giants who were not willing to join the holy grounds and would rather remain free. Adding up, there would only be a few dozen Primal Chaos giants across the entire Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World but not reaching 100.
’50 of such existences will be a heavy loss even to Ancient Sacred Religion.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘As for a Cosmos God? Sacred Master has offended too many final realm existences, so only one Cosmos God has decided to rely on him.’
If anyone got rid of this Cosmos God, it was, in essence, breaking an arm of the Sacred Master.
“I can’t kill Sacred Master now.” Xue Ying said.
“You might not be able to do so now, but maybe you could in the future.” The black-robed male said, “According to the appraisal of your outer world, you can kill those of the ‘fifth level Star Pagoda’ from Ancient Sacred Religion. Ten of them would be equivalent to a Saints! And a hundred of those at the fourth level Star Pagoda would be equivalent to a single Saints. By killing more and more, you are able to obtain millions and millions of Origin World Rocks.”
“The more you kill, the more you get.”
The eyes of the black-robed male were filled with madness, “And even at the end, if you killed 50 Saints or that Cosmos God, this Third Fire Prison Realm Cauldron and all other treasures could possibly belong to you.’
“Do you believe in me so much that I’ll definitely help Monarch Nine Cloud?” Xue Ying asked.
“I’ve checked using the secret technique. You aren’t a follower of Ancient Sacred Religion.” The black-robed male calmly mentioned, “And almost all of those who aren’t part of the Ancient Sacred Religion are enemies with Sacred Master! Furthermore, I am only taking the treasures out for you to execute the tasks. It is a fair trade.”
“Alright.”
Xue Ying understood slightly in his heart.
The treasures at the third level of the treasure coves were very hard to get! Because if they were, how easy would it be to attract ‘aides’ to attack the Ancient Sacred Religion?

chapters.title: Chapter 866 - Casual Graffiti
chapters.content:
Chapter 866: Casual Graffiti
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The black-robed stooped male waved his hand before passing a talisman to Xue Ying: “Refine this talisman. Only you can use it. Whenever you killed someone from the Ancient Sacred Religion with sufficiently high status, you can activate this talisman anywhere within the region of Nine Cloud Great Land. This will teleport you directly to this palace for you to collect treasures of relevant value.”
Xue Ying refined it after receiving.
“Follow me.” The black-robed male turned around and went ahead. He proceeded deeper along the palace hall. Xue Ying followed behind him.
When they reached a hidden staircase within the palace hall, they went down the stairs before entering a secretive cultivation room.
“This is master’s cultivation room.”
The black-robed male entered the cultivation room with Xue Ying.
Glancing over, this room was huge. It was practically the size of the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall in Great Void Heaven Temple. Actually, located at the front most of the cultivation room were many bookshelves and a large number of original ancient books. These bookshelves occupied about 30% of the entire room.
At the back was an empty space.
There was only a praying mat placed there.
“The bookshelves contained books Master collected or created.” The black-robed male pointed at the praying mat, “And Master would usually cultivate here.”
“You can read all the books within the cultivation room. If you are able to thoroughly grasp them, it is fine for you to impart them to the others.” The black-robed male said, “This is a benefit all ‘aides’ will have. Once you are done and that you plan to leave, just shout for me. I’ll send you away from here.” Saying that, the black-robed male turned around and left.
“I can hear you whenever you speak within the palace.” The black-robed male added before walking out of the room.
And now, only Xue Ying was left in the place.
Xue Ying did not hesitate to walk directly to the bookshelf. He began reading through those books. They were the crystallization of the wisdom of the senior cultivators, and books that could be collected by Monarch Nine Cloud would certainly not be mediocre.
‘Wu?’ Xue Ying looked at the first book in his hand.
This was an ancient cultivation-related book called “Eye of Split Dissolution”.
If the ancient cultivator awakened a talent in something eye-related geared towards offense, they could cultivate along the direction of “Eye of Split Dissolution”. Some ancient cultivation depended purely on luck, and some of the more formidable ones would guide the cultivator to evolve certain parts of his body…’innate’ talent was essential, and guidance after ‘awakening’ was similarly important.
This Eye of Split Dissolution referred to one of the systems at the Cosmos God level within ancient cultivation.
Both eyes would emit the light of split dissolution. Just by staring at a certain place, the entire cosmos could be dissolved and destroyed. Even Cosmos Gods would not dare to use their bodies to withstand against such attacks.
…
Xue Ying carefully read through the books.
Almost half of the books here were related to ancient cultivation. At the least, they could be cultivated to the Primal Chaos level. Some could be cultivated to the Cosmos God level. In terms of strength, the innate talent was essential and guidance after ‘awakening’ was important too. Only when both factors were perfect could one reach large success. The Sacred Master was the strongest ancient cultivator to date.
‘Maybe I can cultivate in ancient cultivation too?’ Xue Ying could not help but have this thought after reading through many of the books on ancient cultivation.
Cultivating multiple systems was considered normal for experts.
Like the bloodline cultivation system, once they reached the peak, they would merely be at the Primal Chaos realm and have to cultivate other systems. Most would choose a system that covered their weaknesses.
Xue Ying did not think of this previously, but now that he had obtained so many different cultivation techniques of the ancient cultivation system… if his luck was excellent, with his high talent, it was possible for him to spend some effort in this.
‘No rush.’
‘I should wait until I’ve settled the matter regarding Jing Qiu and the others. Only then would I have enough time and concentration to cultivate this.’ Xue Ying thought. There were quite a few in Great Void Heaven Temple who cultivated in ancient cultivation too. There was no need to mention about True God disciples, but at least for the Primal Chaos realm giants… like Inquisitive Sky Hall Master, he cultivated in the ancient cultivation, allowing him to easily discover matters happening in the past across a vast region. Furthermore, he could teleport Xue Ying to the Nine Cloud Great Land easily.
This was a talent geared towards supplementary ancient cultivation. It was heaven-defying too. After all, the primal chaos void was too big. For instance, the distance between the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World and the Nine Cloud Great Land was immense. Even Cosmos Gods had a hard time trying to travel across this distance, yet Inquisitive Sky Hall Master could easily send other people over.
The techniques of the ancient cultivation would sometimes make others envious.
******
After spending half a year, Xue Ying finished reading through all the books. There were only a few that were helpful to his cultivation. After all, it was too difficult at his current realm to find books related to his path. But reading through the books broadened his horizons. At least he had some guesses as to the reason why he could not display the second style of Dark World, the ‘Sky Punishment Edge’.
‘It is most likely related to my heart realm.’ Xue Ying vaguely guessed.
Because in some of the books on absolute art he had read, there were related illustrations: ‘Third boundary: Nirvana Fire, if one has yet to reach the third heart realm, even if one comprehended all the fundamental laws, he would still be unable to display the Nirvana Fire. One has to reach the third heart realm and experience the meaning of nirvana before he can succeed.’
This absolute art had something similar. If Xue Ying did not reach the requisite heart realm, he could not display the technique despite comprehending it.
Just like a mortal drawing, his technique would depend on a particular heart realm. Otherwise, he could not produce drawings of that level.
‘I have to reach the third heart realm…’ Xue Ying was also pondering over it. He was even thinking over all the nirvana meaning illustrated in that absolute art.
According to the illustration of that absolute art, once the cultivator reached a stage of being benevolent and was willing to sacrifice for the public without any complex thoughts, then could he comprehend the meaning of nirvana in the midst of altruism, reincarnating through death. This was also the pre-requisite of achieving the heart realm for the Nirvana Fire.
Xue Ying sat there comprehending for a long time but to no avail. He shook his head. It seemed that the third level of heart realm was something he could not force.
‘Time to leave.’
Xue Ying stood up.
Since he had read through all the books, it was time for him to leave.
Xue Ying looked around the cultivation room. He carefully looked at every single location and landed on certain vestiges of drawings. Many of the drawings had been stopped halfway through, and there was not a single completed drawing!
‘Monarch Nine Cloud cultivated here, and these should be his comprehensions. He then casually drew on the walls.’ Xue Ying guessed. It was normal for experts to draw on the walls casually like graffiti during their cultivation.
‘Some of the absolute arts which have been completed are written into books. Those that aren’t were left on the walls.’
‘Before leaving, I should take a look on these vestiges of drawing. Who knows if I might get something out of it.’
Xue Ying thoroughly looked through them.
But as he inspected, he frowned because it was too complex! Even the absolute arts which Monarch Nine Cloud had yet to complete were extraordinary.
There were certain parts which he could understand as he observed, but he only comprehended a little.
As Xue Ying watched, he would walk along the walls. Suddenly, when he reached a corner, he saw the continuous drawings on the wall. There were a total of four drawings, and the first three were completed, with the fourth being unfinished. Clearly, this was a certain absolute art which had yet to be completed.
These four drawings which Xue Ying was inspecting…
“Weng~’
Suddenly, many silk strands appeared in front of Xue Ying. They formed a hazy complex but substantial array diagram. Clearly, Xue Ying was attempting to ponder over it.
Xue Ying remained very calm, but as he continued thinking and researching about it, his face gradually revealed an astonished look.
‘This, this is…’
Xue Ying waved his hand, causing the praying mat from afar to fly beneath his body. He sat down cross-legged and began putting all his concentration into comprehending, ‘This seems to be somewhat related to my Voidwalker lineage system?’

chapters.title: Chapter 867 - The Composition of the Void
chapters.content:
Chapter 867: The Composition of the Void
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Of the four drawings located in the corner of this cultivation room, three were completed, and one was unfinished. At the same time, they were of different complexity. Xue Ying naturally chose to study the easiest diagram which he could vaguely understand.
‘This uncompleted absolute art belongs to the void aspect.’ Xue Ying looked at the substantial array diagram which contained countless strands dancing about. The array diagram became more complex and exquisite at certain areas, ‘This first drawing… requires deep knowledge and understanding of the void. Fortunately, I am a Voidwalker. Even the majority of Primal Chaos realm giants can’t beat me in this aspect.’
That was the truth.
Several Primal Chaos realm giants cultivated the devour-class system. Some reached their realms using the bloodline cultivation system, and some belonged to the ancient cultivation system. Their understanding of the void was shallow. The reason why they could tear through the void in the sacred world and form a time-space tunnel was that their law domain could form a miniature cosmos! Under the domain of this ‘miniature cosmos’, they were able to grasp the void pretty well, allowing them to achieve this step. It was not because of their deep understanding of the void.
But it was different for the ‘Voidwalkers’. This lineage cultivated and absorbed the primal chaos void energy. The “Walker’s Hidden Secret” was also a cultivation technique that had a deep perception of the void. The more one cultivated in it, the deeper one’s understanding of the void and the higher his control over it.
Thus—
These four drawings which Monarch Nine Cloud left behind might have a huge requirement, but Xue Ying was able to understand them.
‘This?’
‘It perceives the void from a different direction?’
Xue Ying felt astounded the more he perceived it, ‘It looks at the void from an entirely opposite perspective from the Voidwalker system?’
The Voidwalker system took on a holistic approach and control towards the void.
And the diagram in front… was about dissecting the void and to research into the ‘smallest’ part of what the void is composed of.
‘The smallest component of the void?’ Xue Ying pondered.
“Weng!”
He was also observing the void.
A seemingly empty space in front of his eyes was being magnified under the observation of his eyes. Gradually, moving energy particles started forming in the void. This was the World Energy which pervaded all spaces. This energy was constituted from minute particles just like rice that made up of porridge. They were densely located at every single part of the void.
‘Magnify.’ Xue Ying began scrutinizing even deeper in the structure.
“Hua.”
The particles that were previously densely populated had become as big as planets in his eyes. There was a considerable distance between each particle.
‘Even bigger.’ Xue Ying stared at that empty space between the particles. According to the profound mystery of the first diagram left behind by Monarch Nine Cloud, it was all about studying the smallest composition that made up the void.
‘Mn?’ Xue Ying was doing his best to scrutinize, yet he could no longer permeate deeper than this point. If not for his extremely high attainment in the void, he would not even have reached this stage.
‘It seems that I still have to rely on the profound mystery of this diagram.’ Xue Ying conscientiously started comprehending this diagram.
…
Time seemed to pass really quickly as he studied the picture.
Xue Ying did not know how long, but many array diagrams were starting to float in his eyes. They were growing more mystical.
“Hua.”
Through the observation of Xue Ying’s eyes, the space between the many particles representing the World Energy might seem huge and seem empty, but at this moment, this hollow region was being magnified. Actually, instead of saying that it was his eyes that were observing it, one could say that after comprehending the diagram, the senses of his soul had become sharper. Using his soul to scrutinize was similar to using his eyes to see.
At this moment, the space between the particles felt boundless. Xue Ying could faintly discern a blurred existence in between them.
It was like a great black cloth!
The essence of the void was this piece of black fabric?
‘Not right.’
‘I haven’t comprehended deeply into this diagram. Clearly, my dissection of the void isn’t thorough enough.’ Xue Ying continued studying. At this moment, he felt excited because he could faintly feel that he was touching on something which he had never known before.
He felt enthusiastic.
Xue Ying was putting all his effort into researching and comprehending this.
He did not know how long it had been…
And how many times he had reached a bottleneck. Xue Ying had decided to study the Walker’s Hidden Secret and further his understanding of the void before continuing his study of this first diagram. Unknown to him, he had already reached the 40th level realm of Walker’s Hidden Secret, and any further improvement from this point was tough. Breaking through the 40th level to the 41st level… was a qualitative transformation into the Primal Chaos realm. Thus, the array diagram of the Walker’s Hidden Secret had a leap in the degree of profoundness too.
“Hong~”
Because his understanding of the void was deep enough, coupled with his great comprehension ability and the first diagram from Monarch Nine Cloud guiding him along with his surging enthusiasm, Xue Ying had finally done it. He had fully comprehended this first diagram.
“Hong.” Just like an ordinary mortal who had gotten binoculars that enabled him to see further, Xue Ying’s control of dissection towards the void had become deeper after he comprehended the first diagram.
“Hua—”
The minute particles of the void contained a space in between that felt blurred and seemed to be like a great black cloth. At this moment, under Xue Ying’s observation, this black cloth was rapidly becoming clearer. Furthermore, it had been magnified by more than 100 million times. Soon, Xue Ying was able to discern many black particles. These black particles formed layers of the great ‘black cloth’.
The layers of great black cloth were stacked on top, forming the core of the void.
‘Mn?’ Xue Ying vaguely understood with a single glance.
The technique of teleportation and tearing out a time-space tunnel actually relied on these innermost ‘black cloth’. It’s just that in the past, Xue Ying did not know the intrinsic reason why he could do so. Just like those Primal Chaos realm giants, they were purely relying on their ‘miniature cosmos domain’ to force their way through the void. Even Xue Ying previously had relied on his holistic control of the void to teleport through it. Even if one comprehended the void passage using the laws and profound mysteries, it was merely understanding how to control the laws and profound mysteries. But they had never truly discovered—the so-called laws and profound mysteries were actually activating these ‘black cloth’.
‘These black particles.’ Xue Ying was observing the black particles which formed the black cloth.
Under his observation, every single black particle was many times bigger than a watermelon in the ordinary mortal eyes.
These black particles were not solid. Instead, they were spherically condensed from a black fog. At the center of the black fog contained a pitch black hole that was like a passage leading to an unknown place.
‘Where does the hole in these miniature black particles of the void lead to?’ Xue Ying felt suspicious and nervous at the same time. He was clear how difficult it was to actually observe these ‘black particle holes’. The difficulty of this first diagram left behind by Monarch Nine Cloud was not any less than the Dark World’s second style ‘Sky Punishment Edge’.
Voidwalkers had excellent control and understanding of the void, yet Xue Ying was forced to use the 40th level of Walker’s Hidden Secret as the foundation! Furthermore, only after the monarch left behind a complete diagram cultivation technique was Xue Ying able to comprehend it after more than 60 million years.
‘Let’s have a look where this leads me to.’
Xue Ying extended his senses into the hole of the black particles.

chapters.title: Chapter 868 - I see It!
chapters.content:
Chapter 868: I see It!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The center of the black fog-condensed sphere contained a pitch-black hole that seemed like a passage. As Xue Ying extended his senses in, his entire figure trembled.
‘Oh god!’ Xue Ying muttered to himself.
He was stunned.
He had truly fallen into a stupor!
Even with his current heart realm, he was still greatly astounded. It was to the extent that even if he saw Monarch Nine Cloud reincarnating or Sacred Master dying, he would only be startled but not completely stunned. What he ‘saw’ after permeating through the hole of the black particles was truly extraordinary.
This was an existence which could hardly be illustrated.
Xue Ying barely observed ‘it’ through the hole. At the same time when he was observing ‘it’, because his senses had touched a certain region, he had naturally seen the vast region! He saw countless other holes leading to this location, and through those holes, Xue Ying saw other regions of this palace.
Many palace halls and the treasures within.
There was even the place where the stooped puppet lifeform was located at.
Furthermore—
Outside the palace!
The vast Nine Cloud Great Land. Xue Ying’s senses had extended through a region which could not be described. Through the many holes, he could see the cities spanning across the Nine Cloud Great Land and even the endless primal chaos void beyond the Nine Cloud Great Land!
The further it was, the further were holes to him. At that point, he could barely see what was beyond a certain distance.
‘Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World.’ Xue Ying was able to see it too. Even though the distance of Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World was very far, because the sacred world was vast, many holes had led him there. He could see a faint picture of that vast world through the holes.
Xue Ying understood in his heart.
As long as he linked two of the holes together into a passage, he would be able to arrive at the other location!
For instance, he could directly enter the faraway Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World from the Nine Cloud Great Land!
‘I, I have reached this stage too?’ Xue Ying was truly dumbfounded.
Penetrating through such a far distance was something even most Cosmos Gods could not do so. Usually, only a certain minority of the ancient cultivators could do it like ‘Inquisitive Sky hall Master’ or ‘Ancestor Desert’. This was usually an innate talent of the ancient cultivation! It was something that would make others envious.
Nevertheless, Xue Ying had achieved what the ancient cultivators, Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and Ancestor Desert, could do. He could directly link two particles to form a passage to a far region.
‘But there is an unseen barrier covering this cavern-dwelling of Monarch Nine Cloud.’ Xue Ying discovered.
The invisible barrier enveloped all the corresponding black particles of this cavern-dwelling.
He was within the cavern-dwelling, and could not connect the particles in the outside region… this also meant that even with the methods of Ancestor Desert and Inquisitive Sky Hall Master, they could not penetrate into this cavern-dwelling of Monarch Nine Cloud! Within this cavern-dwelling of Monarch Nine Cloud, if that puppet lifeform did not initiate to send someone out, he would get stuck here forever.
‘That’s right too.’
‘I can do such a thing also because I comprehended the first diagram out of the four. Monarch Nine Cloud’s attainment in the void has far outstripped mine.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘His cavern-dwelling hides the Third Fire Prison Realm Cauldron, and even Sacred Master could not infiltrate and bring it away! Clearly, it is tough even to find and enter this place.’
Xue Ying’s guesses were indeed the truth.
Monarch Nine Cloud was at the second level amongst final realm existences. Regarding his attainments in the void, he was far beyond that of the Sacred Master! The Sacred Master might be the strongest expert, but it did not represent that he was strong in every aspect. At least in the void aspect, Monarch Nine Cloud surpassed him. He was even stronger than the current Void Primogenitor.
Nevertheless, Void Primogenitor was only at the third level. Forefather Tian yu and Swordmaster, as well as the majority of other Cosmos Gods, were also at the third level.
…
‘But what region is it that the holes of the black particles lead to?’ Xue Ying felt too astonished.
Even when he first saw that location, he fell into a daze.
Because when his senses arrived at that region, he was even relying on it to observe how many other holes were also leading there. Through this, he could see the distant Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World!
‘I do not know what kind of luck is this that allowed me to learn this absolute art which Monarch Nine Cloud has yet to complete. But it has enabled me to see a region that could hardly be described…’ Xue Ying sighed.
This feeling.
It was like a lifeform living on a two-dimensional world looking into a three-dimensional one.
A paper was like a two-dimensional world. Existences like ‘circles’, ‘triangles’ or ‘squares’ living in this two-dimensional world only contained length and width without height! Thus, they could only see other two-dimensional lifeforms by their sides. The moment their forward direction is obstructed, they could no longer see any other two-dimensional lifeforms living behind that obstruction.
But if a third dimension, height, were included, they would have broken through the two-dimensional world to enter the three-dimensional world. They had height, and those with great heights could see the entire piece of paper and every single part of it! The further the object, the more blurred it would be.
What Xue Ying felt now was exactly the same!
He could see every region through the black particle holes.
This region to the world Xue Ying was at felt like a three-dimensional world… to his two-dimensional world.
Once Xue Ying’s senses permeate into this world, he was able to see every single part of the entire world! Like the Nine Cloud Great Land, primal chaos void, the distant Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, he could ‘see’ them all. This was because he was located high above the entire surface of the world.
Even the powerful Cosmos Gods and some unfathomable ones like ‘Ancestor Desert’ or ‘Inquisitive Sky Hall Master’ who could send others through a far distance might be considered incomparably strong beings in this world, but they remained living in it! They could not enter the higher dimensional of the world.
Xue Ying might be weak and small, but he was able to see the world from this higher dimension at the current moment.
It was just like being in a two-dimensional world, and suddenly looking up only to find a three-dimensional world!
…
Xue Ying had achieved it. Even amongst the ancient cultivators, there was a group of experts with talent in this like ‘Ancestor Desert’ who had done so.
But they could only look up at the higher dimension world. Even though they discovered it, they could still only look up at it hopefully.
‘I’ve seen it.’
‘I’ve seen the higher dimension world.’
‘I truly do not know when I could enter that higher dimension world.’ Xue Ying thought. He could barely enter with his current perception. His body was utterly repelled from it. If he wanted to arrive at another location, he had to connect two holes and follow through the passage formed to another position.
But he could not enter the higher dimension world from start to end.
‘The ancient cultivation is indeed formidable.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
With his foundation of the Voidwalker system, the guidance of Monarch Nine Cloud’s absolute art, and his current comprehension ability, it was really fortunate that he could reach this stage to look up at the higher dimension world.
There was also a group amongst the ancient cultivators who could do so.
Even some amongst the ancient cultivators could see part of the future. Some could even alter parts of it. These techniques were what Cosmos Gods could not achieve! Thus, the ancient cultivation was something very unique, and experts in this system were very heaven-shaking.
‘I haven’t cultivated in the ancient cultivation system yet I could achieve it already. I must really thank this unfinished absolute art created by Monarch Nine Cloud.’ Xue Ying looked at the four pictures on the wall in front. He was very clear that the biggest reward he had this time when he came to the cavern-dwelling of Monarch Nine Cloud was these four diagrams.
“I’ll have to trouble senior to send me out.” Xue Ying suddenly announced.
“Alright. After you’ve killed enough high-leveled experts from the Ancient Sacred Religion, you can come here. The treasures of the monarch are waiting to be collected anytime.” The puppet lifeform sounded.
Following that—
“Weng.” A spatial fluctuation descended.
Xue Ying was teleported out.
…
“Hua.”
In a vast desolate land, Xue Ying appeared.
He stood in this desolate land grinning. He then immediately tried ‘seeing’ that mysterious region before connecting two holes into a passage. If he sent someone else, it would be slightly more troublesome. But traveling himself through this passage was something easily accomplished.
“Hu.” The space in front became distorted. Xue Ying took a step before entering. The warped space soon recovered.
And in another location of Nine Cloud Great Land half the distance of the entire land.
Xue Ying appeared from the distorted sky.
‘It is indeed mysterious.’ Xue Ying praised.
‘But I can’t find the cavern-dwelling of Monarch Nine Cloud any longer.’ Xue Ying tried to search for the cavern-dwelling through the mysterious region before when he was within the dwelling and knew of its position.
But when he tried seeking for it again, Xue Ying realized he could no longer find it!
“Hu.”
Xue Ying took a step. The space warped and then he disappeared.
He once again appeared at a region even further away from the Nine Cloud Great Land amidst the primal chaos void. Xue Ying stood within. He understood that his harvest this time was huge. It enabled him to become one of the small group envied by countless cultivators just like Ancestor Desert and Inquisitive Sky Hall Master.
For them, they would usually stay at their territory for long periods, yet many experts would come to seek their help in sending them somewhere far away. Every time they sent an expert over, they would earn quite a bit too, so these cultivators were rich.
Secondly.
Using this technique to escape was truly defying as well. If they wanted to leave, none could obstruct them.
‘Let’s go back to my hometown and have a look.’ With the ability to arrive at any location, Xue Ying wanted to go back to his hometown cosmos to see his loved ones.
“Hu.” Xue Ying took a step into the distorted void before disappearing.

chapters.title: Chapter 869 - Returning to His Hometown
chapters.content:
Chapter 869: Returning to His Hometown
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Nine Cloud Great Land was extremely far from his hometown cosmos. Primal chaos realm giants would usually have to spend 10 million years traveling to reach there.
“Hu.” In the blink of an eye, Xue Ying walked out of a certain region within the primal chaos void.
“My hometown.”
Xue Ying looked at a certain direction. Because the distance was too far, he had some deviation during the teleportation. But it was much faster using ‘void penetration’ in the primal chaos void rather than in the sacred world.
“Hu hu.”
A breath later, Xue Ying arrived in front of an incomparably colossal cosmos.
Usually, outsiders above the Ruler realm were prohibited from entering the cosmos. As for Void Gods? They had to be natives! Powerful beings born outside could not enter the cosmos unless they were like Voidwalker Gu Qi and others who had the power to destroy a cosmos, which also meant that the cosmos could not hinder them at all. They could enter whenever they wanted. But to easily annihilate a cosmos was something the current Xue Ying could not do yet.
“Si~’ there was a crack appearing on the cosmos membrane wall. Xue Ying easily flew into it.
His hometown cosmos was still at the current epoch. Thus, he was not barred from entrance yet.
******
Within his hometown cosmos, that wild black dog who was lying in the Starting Ground with his eyes drooping down looked far away. Its dog face revealed a look of astonishment as it spat out in human language: “This Dong Bo Xue Ying brat has just left not so long ago, yet he is at the Unity realm already?”
“He is not just at the Unity realm, he is even an Inner Hall Elder.” The white-haired old man appeared and mentioned. This was the Starting Ground which Forefather Tian Yu created. Any members of the Great Void Heaven Temple who came into this cosmos could easily be sensed from the Starting Ground, including their identity.
“Inner Hall Elder? Doesn’t that mean that he is close to me in terms of strength already?” The wild black dog was startled.
Strictly speaking, it was at the sixth level Star Pagoda power.
But it was able to have an advantage within the Starting Ground since Forefather Tian Yu created an array using an extremely formidable law and profound mystery. The wild black dog was able to rely on this array to strengthen itself, allowing it to unleash a power at the seventh level Star Pagoda strength! Even so, he was still suppressed by Swordmaster in the past.
“He cultivated so quickly, and should be able to become a hall master of my Great Void Heaven Temple in the future.” The white-haired old man sighed in praise.
…
Xue Ying looked towards a vast starfield region that was emitting a great destructive aura. Not a single weed or grass could grow in the entire starfield, and there were no weak living beings within. There was only a crimson-robed male within. Currently, that crimson-robed male felt something and looked over. He was able to see the white-robed young man standing outside the star field through the spatial distance.
“Xue Ying?” Bloodshed God-Emperor who was cultivating felt shocked. He stopped his cultivation and took a step before arriving where Xue Ying was.
“Xue Ying, you returned?” Bloodshed God-Emperor was slightly in disbelief.
Because it was too fast.
Rushing over from his hometown cosmos to Seven Star Oceanic Sacred world was very long.
“I’ve returned.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“It has only been several hundred million years, yet you returned. Now, I can’t even see through your strength.” Bloodshed God-Emperor was really shocked.
Xue Ying laughed, “Teacher, my luck was good. Not long after I left my hometown cosmos, I’ve encountered a void corridor, allowing me to meet Ancestor Devil from the Great Void Heaven Temple who helped me reach the Great Void Heaven temple early on. Even though it has been several hundred million years… in reality, I’ve depended on the Palace hall of Time in the Great Void Heaven Temple to cultivate for tens of billions of years, allowing me to attain my current strength. With your comprehension ability and potential, Teacher, you will definitely surge in strength after entering the Great Void Heaven Temple.”
“Void corridor?” Bloodshed God-Emperor was startled, “You actually encountered one?”
He knew that it was highly possible to meet some unforeseen dangers on the way to Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World.
The void corridor was something Bloodshed God-Emperor felt a headache for and was fearful of.
Because the moment he entered…
Even though the possibility of dying directly was slightly lower, it was possible for him to be brought somewhere far away from the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. His hometown cosmos was already very far from the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World! Going through the void corridor… who knew if the distance might be ten or a hundred times further! By then, it was impossible for him to reach his destination.
That was the reality.
Xue Ying had actually arrived at somewhere near the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World.
“Isn’t that the case which led me to meet Ancestor Devil?” Xue Ying chuckled.
“Fortunately, fortunately.” Bloodshed God-Emperor sighed, “After leaving our hometown, it is hazardous to travel within the primal chaos void.”
“To the current me, it has become effortless.” Xue Ying said, “Teacher, in the future, I’ll personally send you over to the Great Void Heaven Temple.”
Bloodshed God-Emperor laughed before nodding, “Haha, it seems that you have cultivated for tens of billions of years and are much stronger than in the past. Are you prepared to guide the other Rulers? They have been stuck at the bottleneck without being able to proceed on in becoming Void Gods.”
“One month later. I will invite everyone to my Black Fog Sea Monarch Dong Bo residence.” Xue Ying said.
“Alright.” Bloodshed God-Emperor felt relatively happy. He was in a good mood.
Actually, when Xue Ying left the hometown cosmos, he felt perturbed because Xue Ying was ultimately too weak. He was much weaker than even he, Bloodshed God-Emperor. But now, Xue Ying was stronger than him.
Still, Bloodshed God-Emperor was calm.
Firstly, this disciple of his had a higher potential and comprehension ability than him. Secondly, Bloodshed God-Emperor felt that after entering the Great Void Heaven Temple, he would be able to have a qualitative change.
…
After Xue Ying parted with his teacher, he took a step before arriving in front of a vast starry land.
Rolling red light was being emitted from this great starry land. There was also a continuous chain of palaces on it with many cultivators within.
“Hahaha…” Xue Ying looked down and could not help but laugh.
On top of this great starry land.
There was currently a teenager seated cross-legged at the highest position of the palace hall. Many disciples were listening to him.
“Yu’er, this brat is not bad. He actually took in so many disciples.” Xue Ying chuckled until his mouth was going to break. After returning to his hometown cosmos, he felt great. Since Xue Ying was able to envelop every single part of his hometown cosmos with his current strength, he was able to discover at the first moment that his son, ‘Dong Bo Yu’, had transcended.
And now, it seemed that his son had become a forefather for a particular region and was even teaching others.
Seeing his son like this, Xue Ying was much happier than when his cultivation broke through.
“Yu’er.” Xue Ying said.
Dong Bo Yu who was situated high up in the palace hall, became startled for a moment. He could not help but tremble unconsciously. He gave down the order: “Everyone retreat.” Saying that, he disappeared.
The disciples who were within the hall felt puzzled. But they still obediently withdrew.
Within the void.
Dong Bo Yu penetrated and appeared. Looking at the person in front, he could not help but feel exuberant: “Father!, you, you are back?”
It was too quick.
Faster than what he initially presumed. He thought his father would only return when this epoch was ending.
“Not bad.” Xue Ying praised him with a smile.
Dong Bo Yu grinned after hearing his father praise him.
“Where’s your mother?” Xue Ying asked, “Has she already gone to sleep?”
“It has only been several hundred millions of years, so mother hasn’t gone to sleep. But she spent the majority of her time in the Eden World.” Dong Bo Yu said, “She would occasionally come out, but after a few more years, Mother will be going to sleep. Both mother and sister are currently within the Monarch Residence.”
Xue Ying softly nodded.
Preparing to sleep?
Jing Qiu had indeed not transcended.
“Go, let us go see your mother and sister.” Xue Ying said.

chapters.title: Chapter 870 - Creating Absolute Arts
chapters.content:
Chapter 870: Creating Absolute Arts
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying brought Dong Bo Yu along. In the blink of an eye, he arrived above the Black Fog Sea.
The current Monarch Residence was usually governed by Qing Yao.
“Xue Ying?”
Jing Qiu who was invited over by her daughter out of the Eden World saw Xue Ying. She was filled with incomparable joy, and all her worries had disappeared instantaneously.
Xue Ying faced his wife.
As they saw this, both Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao looked at each other. Qing Yao had even added, “Father and mother, both of you should have a talk. Little brother and I will go prepare something to eat.” Saying that, the two siblings left.
It was just husband and wife left within the hall.
“I am back.” Xue Ying softly uttered, “My luck is quite good. I was able to get the treasures I wanted very quickly. That is why I decided to come back and have a look.”
Jing Qiu walked over, “Let us walk outside.”
“Mn.”
The husband and wife strolled within the Monarch Dong Bo residence hand in hand. Everything seemed tranquil. The two had cultivated for a long time, and their emotions were concealed deep inside their hearts.
“That time when you wanted to go travel out in the primal chaos void… I, Yu’er and Qing Yao were worried for you, but we couldn’t convince you at all.” Jing Qiu said.
“I’m sure you know this temperament of mine.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“It’s good that you are back.” Jing Qiu added.
“How is your cultivation now?” Xue Ying asked, “Tell me more about it.”
…
Both husband and wife discussed various issues regarding cultivation. The current Xue Ying had a much higher realm, and even if he was compared to the past Swordmaster who had yet to leave the hometown cosmos, even though Swordmaster was at the Primal Chaos realm, in terms of experience… the current Xue Ying was wealthier in it. He had, after all, read through many books in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall and the books kept by Monarch Nine Cloud. His guidance would frequently inspire Jing Qiu.
“I require a set of Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core. Anyone who has it can contact me.” Xue Ying released the message within Great Void Heaven Temple. At the same time, he also released this message within the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion.
Naturally, Xue Ying concealed his identity.
The others only knew that this was something sent from within the Great Void Heaven Temple.
‘I hope I could get it as soon as possible.’ Xue Ying thought.
Because his son Yu’er had transcended, he only needed to prepare a set of Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core. It was sufficient with the current treasure he had collected from Monarch Nine Cloud’s treasure cove! Right now, the only issue was… there must be a market for this item! A precious treasure valued at about 6,000 Origin World Rocks was something scarce, and it was not something he could buy whenever he wanted.
It was really hard to seek for this item within the Great Void Heaven Temple.
Nevertheless, the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion was an organization that bought and sold stuff. Once he released this news, he should be able to find a seller.
‘My first choice is to get a Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core. If I could not find one, then I can only thicken my face and ask Forefather Tian Yu for help. If nothing really works… then I’ll seek for other alternatives.’ Xue Ying thought.
What was better than the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core?
There were some.
Like the ‘Eternal Heart’ or the ‘Origin World Fruit’ which could allow one to directly transcend. That was something even Cosmos Gods could not acquire easily because an Eternal Heart was something which Blade Emperor and Ancestor Sorcerer got after they teamed up to kill a Cosmos God. Blade Emperor and Ancestor Sorcerer were both at the second level of final realm existences.
Thus, with his current combat power, Xue Ying did not dare to hope for too much.
******
“Oh, I’ll try again.”
Jing Qiu discovered that her husband’s current guidance would usually come from different angles at targeting the problem. It would inspire her time after time, allowing Jing Qiu to have the impulse to cultivate again.
“Jing Qiu.” Xue Ying flipped his hand, bringing out a total of 100 Origin World Rocks.
Seeing so many stones that were sparkling in all sorts of different color, Jing Qiu felt a strong urge in her soul to consume them. She could not really suppress her desire.
“There’s no need to suppress your impulse. Let your soul absorb its energy.” Xue Ying said, “The moment you consume them, slowly absorb. After you finish absorbing a rock, you can continue absorbing another.”
Jing Qiu did not decline.
She trusted her husband absolutely.
Each Origin World Rock was consumed before the energy entered her body. After being absorbed, Jing Qiu felt drunk. This feeling was indeed wonderful. 100 Origin World Rocks took her a total of over three days to finish. It was primarily because her soul was weaker, so it took a longer period for her to finish consuming them.
Xue Ying watched on from the side. He had never consumed an Origin World Rock before.
“How is it?” Xue Ying waited until his wife fully absorbed the 100 Origin World Rocks before asking her.
“My soul has become stronger and more stable by a few times.” Jing Qiu was very shocked, “I reckon I should be able to hold on for at least 500 million years more. Furthermore, the feeling of my soul is really wonderful. This should be very beneficial to my cultivation.”
Xue Ying nodded.
Letting a stage four World Deity consume Origin World Rocks was something extravagant.
Because Origin World Rocks were meant for Cosmos Gods to use! The reason why Xue Ying let his wife use was because the Origin World rocks were comparatively the most gentle of materials to be consumed, and the most holistic in terms of support to one’s soul. It had increased the lifespan of his wife by quite a bit.
“You should continue cultivating and see if you can transcend after that.” Xue Ying said.
Otherwise, he would still have to procure the ‘Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core’ which was much more helpful to aiding cultivation. The Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core was worth 6,000 Origin World Rocks, and its help to stage four World Deities could be comparable to using over 100,000 Origin World Rocks! It was the most heaven-shaking material that could help stage four World Deities in their cultivation.
6,000 Origin World Rocks to some of the weaker Primal Chaos realm giants, could only be obtained after they pawned all their treasures.
…
As Xue Ying helped his wife, he was also organizing his cultivation comprehensions and penning them down onto various absolute arts.
The absolute arts which he wrote were all from the World Deity level all the way to the void God level!
What realm was Xue Ying currently at?
Comparing strength, he was not any weaker than Ancestor Devil from his hometown cosmos. In terms of horizons, he had far outstripped him! Xue Ying had even created his own absolute art like the “Fish Dragon Kill”. Currently, what he wanted was to create absolute arts at the World Deity and True God level… and that was something he could casually create. In terms of power, they were much stronger than the “Luminous Sun” and “Extreme Annihilation Mysterious Body”.
Some were even stronger than Ancestor Devil’s “Myriad Devil True Body”!
Naturally, after Ancestor Devil entered Great Void Heaven Temple, his current Myriad Devil True Body had become all the more amazing. But the Myriad Devil True Body he left in the hometown cosmos in the past… was not in the eyes of the current Xue Ying. He usually cultivated the “13 Apocalyptic swords”, “Plate Ripple Diagram” and “Dark World”. These were all cosmos-ranked absolute arts. Even though there were only two styles of “Dark World”, these two styles were absolutely at the cosmos-ranked absolute art level. It was only that the later styles had not been created.
Xue Ying was doing so purely for the descendants of his hometown.
Swordmaster and Ancestor Devil might be more amazing after entering the Great Void Heaven Temple, but they did not return.
This time when Xue Ying came back, he had organized many laws and profound mysteries he comprehended and craft them into various absolute arts so as to guide everyone in their cultivation.
Just half a month later, Xue Ying had easily created 28 absolute arts, with the majority half being stronger than the Myriad Devil True Body!
And it was finally the day of the grand feast for Monarch Residence.
This time he did not invite everyone. there were not many who were qualified to attend this grand feast. Only Monarch Green, Purgatory Ruler, Pang Yi, Primal Master, Temporal Island Lord, Abyss Primogenitor, and other Rulers as well as Paragon Huo Cheng, Senior Brother Hui Ming, Forefather Scarlet Flame and others whom Xue Ying was much closer with were invited. Naturally, Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao had some good friends were also invited.

chapters.title: Chapter 871 - Requesting For Help
chapters.content:
Chapter 871: Requesting For Help
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Something huge happened during the feast that Xue Ying hosted.
Primal Master had broken through to the Void God realm!
“Congratulations, congratulations.”
“Congratulations, Brother Primal.”
“I have never thought that you would be able to take this step as well.”
Abyss Primogenitor, Temporal Island Lord, Empress Qian He, Purgatory Ruler, Monarch Green, Pang Yi, and the others were congratulating him. The soul of Primal Master had instantaneously undergone a qualitative change. His aura had become much more majestic. At this moment, Primal Master turned towards Xue Ying with a bow: “It’s all thanks to Brother Dong Bo. If not for Brother Dong Bo’s guidance, I would not have known when I can break through.”
“I have merely mentioned a few things. Primal Master, for you to break through, it’s more because of your own accumulations.” Xue Ying said.
“Dong Bo.” Monarch Green could not help but ask, “You have stopped halfway through when speaking about the theory on the void…”
“These are what I have comprehended so far. I’ll speak, and you shall listen.” Xue Ying continued illustrating the laws and profound mysteries with Monarch Green listening attentively.
…
Xue Ying was questioned by the group of Rulers during this feast. After all, Xue Ying specialized most in three aspects-ripple, slaughter, and mirage. He even had his own special understanding of the Mirage. As for the other aspects, since he had read through the books within Great Void Heaven Temple, and the books collected by Monarch Nine Cloud, Xue Ying was able to briefly explain the crucial features on other aspects.
But these were treated as treasures by the Rulers who cultivated within the cosmos. They could see a door opening right in front of their eyes.
******
After the feast, Xue Ying accompanied his wife Jing Qiu and was doing his best to guide her. At the same time, he was also creating more absolute arts, and in the blink of an eye, over 1,000 years had passed.
“Xue Ying, you actually wrote so many absolute arts?” Bloodshed God-Emperor exclaimed in admiration as he saw many new books within the library, “And all of them could be cultivated directly to the Void God realm. I myself have created several absolute arts, but compared to the ones you created, they are way too lacking. With so many absolute arts… it’ll be beneficial to all the cultivators within the cosmos.”
“Some were written by me, and some were acquired fortuitously by me.” Xue Ying said.
He had brought along many absolute arts after fighting and killing others in the sacred world and the Nine Cloud Great Land. For instance, Xue Ying collected many books from the Blaze Valley after he killed the Blaze Valley Valley Master died.
Within the Monarch treasure cove, he had also forced the enemies to hand over all their treasures! There were naturally absolute arts included within.
He had too many books. Some were on the laws and profound mysteries system, and others belonged to different cultivation systems.
Xue Ying placed all these books into the library.
“In the beginning, my inspiration is like a waterfall gushing down. I was able to write a pile of absolute arts. Nevertheless, over the long period, my inspirations had almost all been penned down, so it is tough for me to write anymore.” Xue Ying shook his head, “Teacher, help me have a look through these books. Also, help me suggest how we should impart them to the cultivators too.”
“Alright, after reading through them, I’ll suggest something.” Bloodshed God-Emperor was obsessed as he entered. He could not help but sigh as this disciple of his had long surpassed him.
“Zhi ya.”
Xue Ying watched as Bloodshed God-Emperor became immersed in reading the books. He then pushed open the door and left the library. As Xue Ying walked along the courtyard, he was able to spot his wife Jing Qiu training in sword far away.
The sword lights were emitting a frost aura. In the region where his wife was displaying her sword techniques, everywhere was covered in ice.
‘She hasn’t transcended yet.’ Xue Ying shook his head, ‘It seems that my guidance and the 100 Origin World Rocks aren’t enough. I still have to acquire a ‘Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core’. It’s a pity that they haven’t found one yet.’
The Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core was a miraculous treasure.
In the entire five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void, there were few of these cores! Those who had one might be in closed-door cultivation and did not know of the information that someone was buying one.
‘Let’s continue waiting. It has only been 1,000 years. To the Primal Chaos realm giants and Cosmos Gods, this period is too short!’ Xue Ying thought, ‘If there is no news regarding the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core after 100 million years, I’ll just thicken my face and ask Forefather Tian Yu for help.’
Forefather Tian Yu was a palace master.
If there were no need, Xue Ying would not be willing to seek his help.
100 million years… was an appropriate period. If he could not find the core within this long period, it would be very hard for him to seek for one using ordinary methods. Thus, he had to ask Forefather and rely on his great identity to reduce the difficulty of finding the core.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying’s expression suddenly changed. Flipping his hand, the communication talisman appeared.
There was a piece of information which was suddenly transmitted over-
“Nine Cloud Great Land, Devil Sword Guest is being pursued by ‘Qi Wu Palace Master’, and is hanging on a thread of life and death. Mission reward: 3,000,000 contribution points…” This information had also pointed out the precise location where Devil Sword Guest was at.
‘Asking for help?’ Xue Ying was surprised.
In the Nine Cloud Great Land, battles were waged between the three great sacred worlds and the two great religions.
Of which the three great sacred worlds would help one another. Clearly, under the confirmation of the internal intelligence system of Great Void Heaven Temple, Xue Ying was at the Nine Cloud Great Land, thus sending this information to him.
‘Devil Sword Guest is at the commander level of Blade Emperor City. He is an expert who got through the fifth level Star Pagoda.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Qi Wu Palace Master is a famous expert from the Ancient Sacred World and specialized in using poison. He is also at the fifth level Star Pagoda level. Devil Sword Guest is actually being pursued to the extent that he is asking for help?’
‘Receive the mission.’
Xue Ying immediately accepted it. At the same time, he also sent a piece of information over, “I am close to where their battle is. I am currently in closed-door cultivation, and it should take the time to brew a cup of tea to arrive.”
This information was first received by the intelligence system of the Great Void Heaven Temple before it was altered slightly and sent to Devil Sword Guest.
…
Nine Cloud Great Land.
In one of the mountainous forest, there was a tribe of people living here. With their cultivation, they had a hard time surviving through all the dangers until now.
“Haha, come come come, come and attack me.” In one of the empty land, a green-robed man was guiding a group of teenagers. These teenagers were almost all at the Transcendent level. There were the occasional Deities, and that green-robed male was at the World Deity level.
Suddenly-
“Hu hu.”
Two figures flashed and appeared above the wild forest.
“Devil Sword Guest, you can’t escape from me.” A cold voice reverberated in the sky. At the same time, an unseen aura naturally spread outwards across the trees below. It also swept across the tribe of people living here.
The trees immediately lost their lifeforce and began withering. Some trees had even started bending downwards.
And that tribe of several thousand people remained unmoving. They maintained their original appearance, though their eyes had turn dim without containing any spirit.
It was clearly just a moment, yet these several thousand race men had been annihilated. This was only coming from the shockwave of a strand of poison cloud from ‘Qi Wu Palace Master’.
‘What should I do?’
Devil Sword Guest was a cold and handsome young man who had a black sword on his back. He was trying his best to escape, but there was ‘Qi Wu Palace Master’ chasing after him using the disturbances left behind in the void. This made Devil Sword Guest feel despair in his heart: ‘I’ve already asked for help from the Blade Emperor City. General has been teleported over to the Nine Cloud Great Land, but he is still too far away from me. Even if he rushed over using the time-space tunnel, it would take close to a day.’
Devil Sword Guest felt sullen.
He was first ambushed, inflicted by poison before being pursued all the way.
Ask for help from his allies! But ultra long distance teleportation would usually contain some deviation, and allowing a Primal Chaos realm giant rush over would take a day for him to reach… such a deviation was normal given how far the Nine Cloud Great Land was to the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World.
‘A day of time? How can I survive for a day?’ Devil Sword Guest felt anxious.
Because he was anxious, he decided to ask for help through the internal system of the three great holy grounds. This request would also be forwarded to any who could save him-for instance, Primal Chaos realm giants or several experts on the Nine Cloud Great Land who could get through the fifth level Star Pagoda.
‘What?’
Devil Sword Guest who was originally in despair, suddenly revealed looks of joy. He had just gotten information from the Great Void Heaven Temple-after the time taken for a cup of tea, an expert from the Great Void Heaven Temple would arrive where Devil Sword Guest was.
And to Devil Sword Guest, he was confident of surviving for this period.

chapters.title: Chapter 872 - Killing
chapters.content:
Chapter 872: Killing
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Jing Qiu, I’ll go out and have a stroll. I’ll be back soon later.” Xue Ying said.
Jing Qiu was unleashing her sword techniques. She gave her husband a smile with her eyes. Ever since her husband came back, she felt delightful. In the following months with her husband accompanying her, she felt content even if she could not transcend. She giggled, “Alright.”
Taking a step, space was distorted, and Xue Ying disappeared after entering it.
…
The next time he appeared, Xue Ying was already at the Nine Cloud Great Land. To him who grasped the power of ultra long distance teleportation, the vast primal chaos void, the five great sacred worlds… were places he could arrive instantaneously! This made Xue Ying sigh subconsciously… even ‘Monarch Nine Cloud’ who was considered the strongest in terms of attainments in the void, and was even better than Void Primogenitor in it, could not complete the fourth diagram absolute art. What exactly was this absolute art?
Monarch Nine Cloud could only formulate a crude fourth diagram despite his realm.
One had to know that the cavern-dwelling array he constructed was something none could break apart over such a long period.
Xue Ying stood in midair looking at the sun in the sky. He was able to determine where he was: ‘There’s some slight deviation. If I were to travel using the time-space tunnel, it’d take me two hours.’ Xue Ying took another step, causing space to distort. He directly traveled and arrived at a grassland very close to Devil Sword Guest.
‘I am very close already.’
‘If I am willing, I could reach in a shorter period.’ Xue Ying felt helpless, ‘But it is quite good for me to reach in the time taken to brew a cup of tea.’
Xue Ying did not dare to overexpose himself.
Ultimately, few Primal Chaos realm giants could teleport through ultra-long distance. As for ‘Unity realm experts’ having this skill, Xue Ying had never heard of such a person before! Maybe because he had not experienced enough things? But he was still the Inner Hall Elder of Great Void Heaven Temple, and Xue Ying had never heard of such a matter before. So it was still better for him to temporarily keep it a secret.
Wait until he is a Primal Chaos realm giant, by then nobody would dare to suspect him should he publicize this technique. Others would naturally think that Xue Ying had cultivated the ancient cultivation system!
…
Xue Ying swayed here and there, delaying for ‘the time taken to brew a cup of tea’ before finally arriving where Devil Sword Guest was according to the constant stream of new information.
“Devil Sword Guest, it is pointless for you to struggle any longer. This time, you are dead for sure.” Qi Wu Palace Master was in a purple robe. His long and narrow eyes were filled with a faint tyranny. He once again formed an all-encompassing array from a far distance above where Devil Sword Guest was. And Devil Sword Guest was doing his best to escape through the void, and he would occasionally pull out the black sword from his back.
After pulling out the sword, he would continually sheathe the black sword into scabbard again.
Every time he pulled out the sword… it would generate vast power.
‘Cough, cough, why isn’t he here yet? Where is the expert from the Great Void Heaven Temple?’ Devil Sword Guest was becoming anxious.
“Oh, Qi Wu Palace Master?” A cold voice sounded.
A white-robed teenager appeared after tearing through the void. This time, Xue Ying did not mask his appearance because he would usually remain within his hometown cosmos, and only when there were important matters would he come out for a walk. Since he would not be staying for long periods in the Nine Cloud Great Land… there was no need for him to conceal his identity.
Qi Wu Palace Master’s expression changed: “Dong Bo Xue Ying? Why are you here so fast? Even if Inquisitive Sky Hall Master from the Great Void Heaven Temple send you here personally, there should be a huge deviation due to such a long distance…”
“Hmph.”
Xue Ying’s eyes flashed with coldness.
“Hua hua hua!”
Many layers of Dark World descended and enveloped Qi Wu Palace Master. The layers of Dark World became real as they fell, and Qi Wu Palace Master did not have the time to even dodge.
“Not good.” Qi Wu Palace Master howled out furiously. He turned into a lizard-type mutated beast that was covered in scales.
“Peng~”
The 120 layers of Dark World exploded at the same time. Qi Wu Palace Master also let out a painful howl as his body was injured and became ridden with injuries. Nevertheless, he was still alive. The pair of violet eyes of Qi Wu Palace Master stared at Xue Ying, and he immediately tore through the void without hesitation in a bid to escape: ‘This Dong Bo Xue Ying has cultivated for how long? Yet he can injure this body of mine that is constructed from many different hex poisons?’
Qi Wu Palace Master felt the danger, so he immediately chose to escape.
“Fleeing?” Xue Ying immediately pursued after him through the trajectory left in the void.
How could he escape from a Voidwalker who had the skill to travel through an ultra long distance? If he could escape, that would be Xue Ying’s greatest humiliation!
******
Only then did Devil Sword Guest let out a sigh of relief. He immediately landed on the surface and sat cross-legged; he began to expel the poison! Previously, he had been pursued and did not have the luxury to expel the poison, but now, the hex poison was being expelled.
‘How did Ancestor Sorcerer create this ‘hex’ system? That its poison is so formidable?’ Devil Sword Guest mumbled inwardly.
Before the emergence of the hex system, it was all about using poison.
But using poison then wasn’t as formidable as how it was used nowadays! Ever since the emergence of Ancestor Sorcerer, the ‘hex’ system he created had reached an unfathomable stage regarding the usage of the myriad existences. Arrays, refinements, hex poison, puppets… he had reached extremely high attainment in all kinds of different aspects. The other systems that utilized poison would also take reference from the hex system’s ‘hex poison’ usage, making ‘hex poison’ something frequently heard about nowadays.
Some of the weaker cultivators did not understand what ‘hex poison’ meant. They delved into poison and immediately named it ‘hex poison’.
“Hu.” Devil Sword Guest opened his mouth, causing a gray fog to be spurt out and dissipate along with the wind.
Devil Sword Guest’s expression became much more pleasant. The remnant poison in his body was no longer a concern.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying’s figure appeared from the void.
“Brother Dong Bo.” Devil Sword Guest hurriedly stood up. He said with gratitude, “This time it is all due to Brother Dong Bo. Otherwise, this life of mine will be ended in the hands of Qi Wu Palace Master. Hmph hmph, this time, I’d suffered from his schemes. In the future, I’ll certainly find a way to eliminate him.”
“Qi Wu Palace Master is already dead.” Xue Ying answered.
Devil Sword Guest was stunned: “He, he is dead”?”
He was very familiar with Qi Wu Palace Master.
This was an extremely cunning expert from the Ancient Sacred Religion with a very formidable lifeforce. He had many ways to survive and cultivated in both hex and ancient cultivation system. He thought that the reason why Xue Ying returned so quickly was that Qi Wu Palace Master had escaped! But who would have believed that he was killed? How long had it been? He, Devil Sword Guest, was able to survive for this long under the hands of Qi Wu Palace Master.
‘He is too powerful already right?’ Devil Sword Guest was filled with slight disbelief. It was such a fleeting moment yet this famous expert, Qi Wu Palace Master, died here like this?
“I relied on external strength.” Xue Ying explained.
He had indeed depended on external strength.
Qi Wu Palace Master’s survival capabilities were too formidable. If he depended on his strength, he would only be able to kill the other party after pursuing him for half a day! Xue Ying did not wish to waste his time. Thus, he utilized the Black Gourd. Under the Black Gourd fireball which had reached the sixth level Star Pagoda strength in addition to his own ‘Plate Ripple Diagram’ domain suppression and the help of the ‘Multi-Layered Dark World’, he was able to kill Qi Wu Palace Master at such a fast speed.
“There is no such thing as external strength in life and death battles.” Devil Sword Guest said, “Brother Dong Bo, I truly admire you and your strength. This time, Brother Dong Bo has saved my life. How about coming over to my place? I live quite close, and we should be able to reach my place fast enough. By then, I’ll definitely receive Brother Dong Bo well. Brother Dong Bo must not reject me since it would mean you are looking down on me.”
“Alright.” Xue Ying acknowledged after seeing how passionate the other party was.
The two of them immediately penetrated through the void and traveled ahead.
Just a moment later.
“Wait a moment.”
Xue Ying and Devil Sword Guest appeared from the void. Devil Sword Guest looked at Xue Ying in befuddlement: “What’s the matter, Brother Dong Bo?”
Xue Ying frowned and looked beneath him. His current expression was ugly.

chapters.title: Chapter 873 - Being Weak is a Crime?
chapters.content:
Chapter 873: Being Weak is a Crime?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Beneath was a tribe that lived amidst the mountain valleys. There were several tens of thousands of people in the tribe, with a total of three True Gods, and more than a thousand World Deities. The others were all Deities and Transcendents.
This was a remarkably ordinary tribe living on the Nine Cloud Great Land, but at this moment, the entire tribe was in deathly stillness. All the living beings were either standing or sitting. Some were even clutching on to roasted meat… it did not seem like there were any injuries on them, but their eyes were dimmed; their souls had been extinguished.
Xue Ying’s perception of the surrounding was truly acute. He was able to sense the strands of hex poison aura permeating in the surrounding. This was the hex poison which ‘Qi Wu Palace Master’ specialized in.
Even though it was only a slight aura, True God Rulers would die immediately from it. If Qi Wu Palace Master deliberately released the hex poison, even ordinary Void God Unity realm experts could not survive.
“Brother Dong Bo, are you pitying them?” Devil Sword Guest stared at the tribe and casually laughed, “It was all because of Qi Wu Palace Master when he acted against me without controlling the hex poison aura. As a result, it affected this tribe. That’s the woe of being weak. Just a single aftershock from the poison and all of them died! But since Qi Wu Palace Master is dead, it could be said that this tribe has been avenged.”
Xue Ying looked at the laughter on Devil Sword Guest, yet he felt uneasy.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying could even perceive the signs of battle left behind in the void. Following along the signs: “Let us go to another location and have a look.” Saying that, he brought Devil Sword Guest in direct teleportation.
Over at another location.
There was a village which was located by the side of a lake. This village was hidden amongst lush vegetation, and one could not spot it from afar. This peaceful and quiet village contained many living beings, yet all of them had lost their aura.
Xue Ying looked below coldly.
“This is also another village being affected.” Devil Sword Guest shook his head, “To Qi Wu Palace Master, he would not care about other lives.”
“Hu.”
Xue Ying brought Devil Sword Guest, following along the vestiges towards another location.
Over at another location…
It was another gathering point that had been affected by the aftermath of the battle.
Looking through many of the other locations…
Devil Sword Guest was still explaining at the start, but over time, he began frowning and felt unpleasant: ‘What is this Elder Dong Bo Xue Ying of Great Void Heaven Temple trying to do? He is bringing me along teleporting to the different regions where the weak little ants were affected by the battle? Hmph.’
Because Xue Ying had saved his life, and secondly, Xue Ying killed Qi Wu Palace Master in such a short period, showing that he had a combat strength which made him wary.
Thus, Devil Sword Guest could only endure the resentment in his heart.
“Devil Sword Guest.” Xue Ying stood in midair looking down at the tribes living in the mountain beneath him. He coldly said, “Do you not have anything to say?”
“What do I have to say?” Devil Sword Guest chuckled, “Ai, it is indeed pitiable that they died. Qi Wu Palace Master is savage enough. But since he has died, it is quite worth it for these tribes to die along with someone at the higher up of Ancient Sacred Religion.”
“Worth it?” Xue Ying looked at Devil Sword Guest, “To those who died, it was in vain.”
Devil Sword Guest frowned: “Elder Dong Bo, what are you implying?”
Xue Ying said with a low voice, “Qi Wu Palace Master pursued after you. You have been fleeing all along… the world is big, and there are big swathes of desolate wilderness, mountains, and lakes. You could have escaped to many other places, so why not avoid these tribes?”
Devil Sword Guest could not tear through a space passage. He could only teleport through short distances.
Every time he teleported, he could easily perceive what was happening on the other end of his destination.
“As long as you slightly take the effort to avoid those tribes, the battle would not have affected them.” Xue Ying asked, “But you did not do such a thing.”
Devil Sword Guest was stunned. His frowning expression turned even uglier: “Elder Dong Bo, you have saved me, but it is because I brought out Origin World Rocks for it. I believe that the Great Void Heaven Temple will also reward you with contribution points. Aren’t they just ants who have been affected by the battle? And it is also because of Qi Wu Palace Master! You, are you targeting me now and deliberately embarrassing me?”
Xue Ying heard the word ‘ants’, and could not help but understand what the other party thought of.
“The world is big, and there are few places where people live in.” Xue Ying continued, “But you have seemingly chosen those gathering places of the tribes as you are escaping.”
Devil Sword Guest’s expression turned sullen. He sneered: “I was escaping, and trying to survive. Why would I still have the energy to care about these ants? Alright. I no longer have the mood to continue quibbling with you. Many thanks for saving me this time. But I think we should part here right now!”
“Sou.”
Devil Sword Guest directly teleported away.
Xue Ying watched as Devil Sword Guest disappeared.
No energy to care about these ants?
Xue Ying could deduce right from the start that Devil Sword Guest did not care about the beings of these tribes. He did not care even if they died! But since so many tribes had been affected by the battle, Devil Sword Guest must have been doing it on purpose! It might be because he hoped to meet some expert living within the tribes. Since the hex poison aura of Qi Wu Palace Master had affected these weaker beings, if there were indeed an expert staying within, he would come out and stop Qi Wu Palace Master. By then, Devil Sword Guest would have hopes of surviving!
“Being weak is a crime?” Xue Ying muttered to himself.
To the experts like Devil Sword Guest, those weaker ones were ants. He did not care about them.
‘Even though I pity them, and am angry towards Devil Guest Sword, I do not feel murderous.’ Xue Ying thought.
Devil Sword Guest was a member of the Blade Emperor City.
Of the five great sacred worlds! Even though the three great sacred worlds were faintly teaming up against the two great religions, the three great sacred worlds were not really united.
Firstly, the ‘Myriad Ancient Sacred World’ was being governed by Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor. Both Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor were both ranked at the front of the final realm existences. They belittled the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World and Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. And the relationship between Eastern Unicorn Sacred World and Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World was excellent. Luo City Lord had only constructed a total of six Star Pagodas which were given to the six holy grounds within the two sacred worlds. Naturally, only ‘Ancestor Bone’ did not get the Star Pagoda. One could see that he was being ostracised within the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World.
Thus…
The relationship between the six holy grounds of Eastern Unicorn Sacred World and Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World was like one block of iron plate! Of which the strongest amongst them would be the Blade Emperor! Blade Emperor was on a comparable level with Ancestor Sorcerer, World Ancestor, and Ancestor Mother.
‘Devil Sword Guest is, after all, a core member of the Blade Emperor City.’
‘If they were from the Ancient Sacred Religion or Ancestor Mother Religion, it would be fine for me to kill them. But Devil Sword Guest is someone I can’t easily act against.’
Just like Xue Ying who was an Inner Hall Elder of the Great Void Heaven Temple, Blade Emperor City and other similar organization would not act against Xue Ying even if they were angry towards him. Otherwise, it would be slapping the face of the Great Void Heaven Temple! Usually for great feuds, one would have to report upwards and let the highest level of the organization handle the punishments.
‘Furthermore, deep in my heart, I only feel that Devil Sword Guest is too cold and cruel, and not that he should die.’ Xue Ying sighed. That was the reality.
