The powerful cultivators had cultivated for many billions of years.
He, Xue Ying, had cultivated for only tens of billions of years and was considered quite young.
Over a long period, many loved ones and relatives would no longer exist. Thus, during cultivation, some might be extreme, callous and ruthless. If one had a great demand on the conduct of cultivators, more than half of the cultivators in the three sacred worlds would likely be pushed onto the opposing end, and by then, the ‘Sacred Master’ of Ancient Sacred Religion could have won the war easily!
Going against the Ancient Sacred Religion should be the most important task! The moment Sacred Master ruled over a region, everyone would have to have absolute loyalty to him. This ‘belief’ was unlike the one within Xue Ying’s hometown cosmos which was considered to be free-will belief. It was unlike a belief that came from the soul of weaker followers of the Ancestor Mother Religion. Instead, it was an imprint on the soul, ensuring absolute loyalty to Sacred Master!
For the sake of Sacred Master, it was possible for one to sacrifice himself. He could even sacrifice his loved ones and friends and would no longer have an independent will. This was something powerful cultivators could not accept.
‘Great Void Heaven Temple, Blade Emperor City, and other super organizations have their own rules. The wicked associations who massacred others will have to be killed without pardon. As for those like Devil Sword Guest, he has merely caused the deaths of others via the shockwaves from the battle… and it is still far from violating the rules.’ Xue Ying shook his head. Even final realm existences had set down strict rules for the sake of ensuring fairness across all parties. And that was within the acceptable region of experts like Ancestor Devil.
Xue Ying teleported once again.
“Sou sou sou.”
He teleported time after time, following along the vestiges of the void to visit other places affected by the battle. All areas where Qi Wu Palace Master and Devil Sword Guest had been to during the pursuit did not have any fortuitous being who survived.

chapters.title: Chapter 874 - My Heart as the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 874: My Heart as the World
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was traveling around the Nine Cloud Great Land. His domain covered a sufficiently large area as he observed all sorts of gratitude and grudges happening.
For instance, two tribes were fighting each other for the sake of a precious treasure which formed recently.
There were also devils who massacred millions gathered at certain regions to cultivate a wicked art. Xue Ying had spotted a single devil seated on top of countless corpses with resentment gathered in the region. When Xue Ying discovered this as he traveled along the spatial passage, he did not hesitate to enclose the other party with his Plate Ripple Diagram.
Under the Plate Ripple Diagram domain, that devil swung his hand in panic and wanted to escape. But he was barely at the second level Star Pagoda strength, and he could not retaliate against Xue Ying.
He was eventually suppressed to death by the many ripples.
“Hmph.” Xue Ying continued traveling along the Nine Cloud Great Land.
…
Seeing many of the scenes made Xue Ying feel an emotional turmoil.
“Ah, Young Master Fu Yi?”
“Young Master, you are back?”
“Void God? Young Master has become a Void God?”
Xue Ying stood high in the sky watching the imperial cities below. The person with the highest status within this city was at the Unity realm. Anyone who was a Void God would be someone with a high status in this nation. The return of this teenager made the entire clan restless. The emergence of a Void God had significantly boosted the standing of this clan.
Xue Ying watched silently. He observed for a total of three days.
He saw how this young master became one of the National Protection Elders under the ‘king’, and how the status of his clan had been significantly boosted. The clan also occupied a territory ten times bigger than previously; the resources the members of the clan got also increased considerably.
“One person protects a race.” Xue Ying softly muttered, “Killing others for the sake of treasures, killing others for the sake of vengeance, killing others for the sake of cultivation. The devils kill because they are in a good mood. If they are in a bad mood, they kill others too… and the most unfortunate ones are always the weak. Even a strand of the shockwave from the battle between experts could easily snuff them off.”
“If the experts were willing, one person could easily protect the entire race.”
“If one only cared about oneself, coldly observing as the weak got massacred… allowing the devils to act wantonly, allowing the cultivators cultivating the devour-class system to devour others, all the weaker cultivators across the primal chaos void and five great sacred worlds would likely face extinction.” Xue Ying muttered.
If everyone were to watch with their arms folded, caring only about themselves, the outcome would be the extinction of the weak.
Xue Ying continued visiting various places.
He spent a total of about three years traveling through the Nine Cloud Great Land.
“Hua.”
Space began distorting. Xue Ying took a step before entering this distorted void. He had left the Nine Cloud Great Land.
…
Over at his hometown cosmos.
Xue Ying appeared outside the Black Fog Sea Monarch Dong Bo residence.
He saw his wife within the residence enjoying tea by herself. There was a sharp god sword placed on the table too. Jing Qiu was frequently cultivating sword nowadays.
Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao were both within the residence as well. They were currently tampering themselves in their respective cultivation rooms.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying’s consciousness covered every single part of the entire cosmos.
The material realm, the Dark Abyss, the Deity World, and countless beings were under the observation of Xue Ying. He was familiar with some of them, and some were even good friends. But many more were strangers.
There were squeaking children, teenagers who were cultivating diligently since young, licentious rich princes and white-haired old men and granny. Other than these ordinary mortals, there were many more cultivators… they comprehended the laws of the world and their profound mysteries. They were moving forward on the road of cultivation…
‘None should dare think of destroying all these.’ Xue Ying thought.
During the three years of thoughtful observation at the Nine Cloud Great Land, Xue Ying had even rushed over along the fluctuations formed by ripples. He had seen too many battles, with large numbers of tribes being exterminated… some of these battles had already reached the end when he arrived.
Thus, when he returned to his hometown, he was also worried that his hometown would encounter such situations.
Even though the cosmos was stable, it could also be destroyed. For instance, Primal Chaos realm giants who were slightly stronger than usual could easily destroy a cosmos.
There were all sorts of danger present…
Even the primitive Ancient Sacred World had once been destroyed. That caused the extinction of almost all beings living in the primitive Ancient Sacred World.
‘Those who have the strength should step out.’ The eyes of Xue Ying let out a light.
‘Even if the weak is guilty, it shouldn’t be punishable by death!’
‘Because every expert had once been weak. They also had to grow up step by step.’
‘The weak has to be protected.’
‘And the experts must step out for this purpose.’ Xue Ying looked at the vast starry sky. His consciousness enveloped the countless beings, ‘If the experts do not step out? Then who will?’
‘Those with strength are responsible.’
‘They are responsible for protecting the weak.’
Xue Ying’s current heart realm was undergoing a transformation.
In the past, he felt that it was right to be independent and care only about himself. But now, his thinking had changed. When he saw the predetermined path taken by Devil Sword Guest as he escaped, leading to the death of countless beings, and how Devil Sword Guest did not care about that, Xue Ying felt emotionally moved. During the past three years of observation, it made his heart more resolute. He was more assured of his own beliefs and values!
If the experts cared only about themselves, the world would be doomed!
Those who were strong… had a great responsibility of stepping out!
‘Maybe my strength might be limited, but there will also be a day when I can raise the heaven by myself. For now, this heaven is quite small, but it is sufficient for me to protect many beings.’ Xue Ying thought.
“Weng…”
Above the sky of Black Fog Sea.
Xue Ying stood there watching the starry sky. The surface of his body began emitting light. This was a light originating from his soul.
A layer of golden robe gradually condensed out. This robe was condensed naturally from the soul light. The surface of the robe contained many patterns, and profound mysteries were inherent within. This robe was also called the ‘Daoist Robe’, a robe that was condensed from an extremely high law.
“This is?”
Those located in the Monarch residence-Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao, and even those who were temporarily staying here reading through the books like Bloodshed God-Emperor, Chi Qiu Bai, Paragon Huo Cheng and others could not help but look upwards. Even though there was some hindrance from the structures, they could still see that figure which appeared in the starry sky without having to utilize any techniques.
There was a figure garbed in a Daoist Robe emanating a warm light on the surface of his body.
The light was not as dazzling, yet it existed everywhere! It reflected across all the souls of every single being. Bloodshed God-Emperor and others had seen it too.
“Father?” Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao, and others had clearly perceived the appearance of this figure.
“This is…”
Monarch Green, Primal Master, Purgatory Ruler, Temporal Island Lord, and others might be at their territory, and were located very far away; nonetheless, they were able to perceive that figure situated in the starry sky emitting a dazzling light.
Powerful existences.
World Deities, Deities, Transcendents, ordinary mortals and even those from the Beast Clan. Every single living being across the entire cosmos had seen that figure situated in the starry sky. That figure seemed to be emanating boundless light with a Daoist Robe covering his body. The weaker the being, the harder it was for them to perceive the appearance of Xue Ying.
“Garbed in a Daoist Robe, emitting boundless light.” Bloodshed God-Emperor looked upwards. He mumbled with slight shock, “This is the so-called third level of heart realm, ‘My Heart as the World’?”
That was a legend.
Across many epochs of this cosmos, there had only been two who had achieved this realm. One was Swordmaster, and the other was Ancestor Devil. But now, there was finally a third being who had achieved it.

chapters.title: Chapter 875 - Star Pagoda Sixth Level
chapters.content:
Chapter 875: Star Pagoda Sixth Level
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Bloodshed God-Emperor, Monarch Green, Primal Master, Pang Yi, and others were watching the figure standing amidst the starry sky emitting a dazzling light. They felt a thousand emotions stirring within their hearts. With their strength, they had long heard of this legend-’Gowned in a Daoist Robe, emanating boundless light, all living beings would be able to see that dazzling figure’. But this was ultimately a legend, and none had ever seen it before.
Until today!
They had all cultivated for quite a long period, yet everyone was stuck at the second level of heart realm. None was able to step into the third level.
To be ‘not perplexed, without worries, without fear, empty heart, moving forward without looking back, heart and thought as one’, only then could the cultivator reach the first level of heart realm, the ‘Heart as a Colored Glass’. Reaching this first level was considered fundamental for all training in the laws and profound mysteries system.
Once the heart became like a blade, they could cut through all obstacles with a thought just like how a blade cut through everything. On the path of cultivation, none would change the cultivator’s will! Reaching this second level meant that one would have the qualities of an ultra-strong expert. Even those of the devour-class system that did not have a high requirement for one’s heart realm could reach this level at the Primal Chaos realm.
But the third level of heart realm, ‘My Heart as the World’.
When the cultivator reached this stage…
There were many reasons which enabled him to reach this stage. For instance, Ancestor Devil was someone with a firm belief. He had created the Dark Abyss, driving demons to kill one another… and even with such a temperament, Ancestor Devil was able to reach the third level of heart realm as well.
And another example was Voidwalker ‘Gu Qi’. He wasn’t willing to be restricted. He had to remain free and easy, traveling everywhere he wanted. He had similarly reached the third level of heart realm with his character.
As for Xue Ying, he wished to prop the heavens by himself and protect everyone. He had similarly broken through.
‘This feeling…’ Xue Ying looked at his body which was currently gowned in a Daoist Robe and emanating endless light. With a single thought in his heart, the light was completely kept into his body. His Daoist Robe had disappeared too.
He inspected his sea of consciousness, looking at his soul.
His current soul was emanating light that shone across his entire sea of consciousness. His soul was also covered in a layer of Daoist Robe. The power his soul had was greatly boosted, and even the ‘willpower’ it contained was much stronger than before.
Strictly speaking, the previous Xue Ying had reached a great realm; he was a Unity realm expert, reaching a profound stage in all three Daos of his. He also reached the 40th level in the Voidwalker lineage. The degree of strength his soul reached was considered peak amongst the Unity realm experts. But because his heart realm had yet to break through, the willpower of his soul could not be condensed, and its power was insufficient.
But now, his heart realm had transformed! Even though his comprehension of the Dao and of the Voidwalker lineage did not change, his soul had somehow metamorphosed from the ‘relaxed and loose’ state to one of a ‘condensed’ state. His willpower had condensed, allowing it to become much stronger.
The efficiency of deducing and comprehending in his mind had improved considerably. It was akin to consuming cultivation materials that improved his overall cultivation speed.
“Jing Qiu.” Xue Ying looked beneath, seeing his wife who was looking upwards.
He took a step.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying landed by the side of his wife Jing Qiu. At this moment, Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao also rushed over: “Father, father, have you just reached the legendary third level of heart realm just now?”
“Brother Dong Bo.”
“Xue Ying.”
Chi Qiu Bai, Paragon Huo Cheng, Forefather Scarlet Flame and others who were located within the Monarch Residence also rushed over without being able to hide the shock they felt in their hearts. Much less them, even Bloodshed God-Emperor was astounded. He had even personally asked, “Xue Ying, how did you break through in your heart realm? Are there any tricks?” When God-Emperor talked, none dared to interrupt.
Bloodshed God-Emperor was indeed feeling stifled because he had yet to break through in his heart realm.
“How did I break through?” Xue Ying was astonished, “Primarily it is about understanding one’s heart and soul. After seeing many weaker cultivators dying from the shockwaves of battles by the other experts, or even because of the anger from certain experts which resulted in the massacre of countless weaker cultivators… I thought of how these experts had once been weak too. If the experts cared only about themselves, wantonly slaughtering others, in addition to the existence of the devour-class cultivators, then how could the weak survive?”
Xue Ying illustrated his understanding to his teacher thoroughly.
Bloodshed God-Emperor frowned as he heard. He understood as he listened! But it did not enlighten him whatsoever. In his eyes, if the sky fell, it would be up to the tallest to prop it upwards! In the past, he was the strongest in the cosmos. When the Ancestor Mother Religion invaded, for the sake of ensuring the safety of the cosmos and to ensure the continuation of his own race, he had done his best to battle and not retreat.
But to protect the weak? Bloodshed God-Emperor asked himself. He was only an ordinary Void God. There was still the Unity realm, Primal Chaos realm and even the so-called final realm existences above him.
If the sky fell, it was not up to him to prop it up!
He would occasionally feel pity, but if his cultivation could increase, even if he let a large group of weaker beings die, he would not blink at all. As long as his entire race wasn’t exterminated, so what if a batch died?
“Wuu…” Xue Ying said after seeing this, “Teacher, I’ve once read through many books in the Great Void Heaven Temple. The breakthrough of the heart realm depends solely on your own comprehension! It is pointless for others to say about it.”
“Mn.” Bloodshed God-Emperor nodded.
He believed it too since there were many ways to increase the heart realm. Even someone like Ancestor Devil could reach the third level of the heart realm, so he similarly had hopes of doing so.
“Xue Ying, you shouldn’t risk your entire life for the sake of the weaker cultivators too. That will be too tiring, and you might even lose your life in the process.” Bloodshed God-Emperor said, “Cultivators should be vigilant, and should try to steer clear away from dangers.”
Xue Ying nodded and chuckled, “Teacher, I understand. The stronger the cultivator, the greater the responsibility. Those who are weaker will naturally take on lesser responsibility. If I were to send myself to death blindly, and I couldn’t even protect my own life, it would be harder for me to protect others too.”
…
The breakthrough of the heart realm could not be explained with words.
Like telling others to be ‘not perplexed, without worries, without fear, empty heart, moving forward without looking back, heart and thought as one’, could it result in cultivators reaching the first level ‘Heart like a Colored Glass’ so easily?
Ultimately, one had to experience it himself. Only when he gathered enough inspiration about the world could he undergo a transformation from the deepest level of his heart a
It was to the extent that if certain things were to go against one’s heart, then words and explanations would be all the more useless. Because the moment something went against one’s beliefs… the heart realm could hardly maintain ‘heart and thought as one’. It was hard to even reach the first level since one’s intrinsic self would directly reject the statement.
Thus, it was pointless to explain using words.
The books within the Great Void Heaven Temple did not mention anything on improving one’s heart realm. It wanted the cultivators to experience it themselves.
******
One day later, after receiving a group of good cultivator friends, Xue Ying finally arrived at the ‘primal chaos void’ outside his cosmos. On the day before, those good friends who visited him had come sincerely to ‘ask him about Dao’. Xue Ying was readily explaining to them certain points at the start, but he understood later that it was pointless even if he spoke more. Since the more he spoke… the more it would confuse the other party. Sometimes, if the other party’s heart realm collapse, that would be dangerous.
Thus, Xue Ying decided to not explain anymore. He only stated for ‘the other party to experience it himself’.
“Hu.”
The white-robed Xue Ying stood within the vast primal chaos void, ‘It is time to see how much stronger I have become.’
After the breakthrough of his heart realm, he never had the time to practice his moves. The environment within the cosmos was more fragile; that was a place more appropriate for the mortals and Transcendents to live in. Those who were stronger would greatly affect the inner part of the cosmos. For instance, those at the Void God level could easily harm the cosmos, bringing the end of epoch closer, and causing the eventual apocalypse to arrive much earlier.
Xue Ying’s current strength had reached the boundary of the Primal Chaos realm. If he were to practice certain techniques inside the cosmos, even if he were to carefully isolate the shockwaves, it would still harm the place.
‘Multi-Layered Dark World.’
With a thought, Xue Ying displayed this self-created simplified version secret technique.
“Hua hua hua~”
In the distant, many layers of Dark World appeared stacked on top of one another. There were a total of 600 layers as judged from the membranes of the world! He then transformed these dark world layers from illusion into reality, letting them frantically absorb the surrounding energy. It had created a huge vortical disturbance in the surrounding primal chaos void. After that, accompanied with a resounding boom, the 600 layers of Dark World exploded at the same time. This power was stacked, reaching a stage that made Xue Ying feel startled: ‘This power is comparable to the fireball of the Black Gourd already!’ Strictly speaking, the strengthening of his heart strength had increased his combat power significantly. He was able to barely reach the sixth level of Star Pagoda strength.
Previously, he could only display 120 layers of Dark World at one time.
The breakthrough of his heart realm had significantly strengthened his heart power, allowing him to unleash 600 layers at once. That was exactly five times stronger! It was not much, but it was coincidentally a nice number.
‘There is also the Sky Punishment Edge.’
Xue Ying began concentrating. He had already comprehended the profound mysteries of the second style of Dark World, the ‘Sky Punishment Edge’, a long time ago before he entered closed-door cultivation in the Great Void Heaven Temple given his talent in the Dao of Mirage. But even until now, he had yet to unleash this move. It was only after Xue Ying flipped through the books collected by Monarch Nine Cloud did he vaguely understood that the issue lay with his heart realm.
Even though he was 70-80% sure, he had to attempt it before concluding this matter!
‘Descend.’ Xue Ying thought with his heart. He was currently trying out this move of his.

chapters.title: Chapter 876 - Sky Punishment
chapters.content:
Chapter 876: Sky Punishment
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The illusory world contained a faint strand of light. It was purely formed and did not seem remarkable. Yet this light was the core of the entire illusory world. Within the blink of an eye, this light brightened up and turned into a dazzling blade edge! The entire illusory world dissipated, yet this blade edge descended from illusion into reality.
‘My Heart as the World. When the heart of the world is mad, it will form a sky punishment.’ Xue Ying fully understood the meaning behind this move.
Sky Punishment Edge!
In the past, even though he had comprehended the profound mysteries behind this move, he lacked the core heart realm that accompanied with it! It was like drawing an art… even if he were familiar with the techniques, without the ’emotion’ that came from his inner heart, it was hard for him to complete a magnificent piece of art!
The second style of the Dark World, ‘Sky Punishment Edge’. Other than it encompassing all profound mysteries, it required a strong heart realm to control everything. Only then could the ‘Sky Punishment’ be qualified to descend!
“Hong~”
This blade edge descended from illusion. After absorbing the surrounding energy, it was eventually condensed. The formerly surging primal chaos void had solidified entirely, and the vast primal chaos energy resumed its normalcy.
The entire primal chaos void had seemingly stopped.
The Sky Punishment Edge suppressed everything! It had contained the operating laws within a particular region. If one mentioned that the 600 layers of Dark World depended on stacking up to create a qualitative change in power, allowing it to wield strength comparable to Primal Chaos realm experts, then the ‘Sky Punishment Edge’ was a move that reached the standards of what some Primal Chaos realm giants could use in terms of its profoundness.
Its emergence was solely for Sky Punishment.
“Si-”
The blade light hacked outwards. It reached a far distance of billions and billions of kilometers. Even Xue Ying could hardly see the end of where the blade light reached. He could only sense the far distance via his perception towards the void.
‘This move is much stronger than the 600 layers of Dark World. It is even stronger than the fireball of the Black Gourd.’ Xue Ying praised, ‘This isn’t just strong in terms of power. Even it has reached a high degree of profoundness. This is the true power of the sixth level of Star Pagoda.’
He could not help but feel admiration for that Dark World Master who had fallen.
For him to create such a move proved that he was someone impressive.
Like the Black Gourd fireball, even though it was formidable, it was too crude. Even if Xue Ying utilized that move, he had to use it with the Plate Ripple Diagram. With the Plate Ripple Diagram suppressing the enemy, only then could the Black Gourd fireball kill the enemy… that was how he quickly killed ‘Qi Wu Palace Master’.
But it was different with the Sky Punishment Edge!
It descended from nothingness. It could directly land by the side of the enemy, and the other party could not even defend himself from it.
‘The weakness of the Dark World Master is still because his self-protection means are too weak.’ Xue Ying thought. The Sky Punishment Edge was a move used purely for offense. The Dark World Master had reached this level in terms of his offense, but his defenses could only be compared to those at the fifth level Star Pagoda.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying thought with his heart.
Three huge illusory worlds appeared in the primal chaos void ahead once again. Every single world contained a Sky Punishment Edge within it.
‘Mn, I could unleash three Sky Punishment Edges at the same time. This is my limit already.’ Xue Ying thought. He might still have some energy left, but it was insufficient to form a fourth Sky Punishment Edge. The power of the Sky Punishment Edge was great, and it consumed too much of his heart energy.
‘Primal Chaos realm.’ Xue Ying thought.
As he displayed the Sky Punishment Edge, Xue Ying finally had some understanding of the last major realm of Void Gods-Primal Chaos realm.
It was extremely arduous to step into the Primal Chaos realm from the Unity realm. It was even harder than stepping into the Void God realm as a True God!
The biggest difficulty in the path of cultivation was stepping into the final realm from the Primal Chaos realm! Second to that was to reach the Primal Chaos realm from the Unity realm. Many had reached the fifth level Star Pagoda strength, yet they were still unsure of how to enter the Primal Chaos realm. But now that Xue Ying had gained some understanding of it, and this was amazing as it is.
‘Primal Chaos.’
‘It encomapsses endless possibilities.’
‘My illusory world could encompass and condense the Sky Punishment, and it could similarly encompass all other possibilities… once everything becomes muddled up, I would have reached the Primal Chaos realm.’ Xue Ying thought.
Life.
Starting from having nothing at all, one would slowly cultivate step by step and become stronger and stronger. One would also grasp more and more complex concepts. But this sort of complexity could possibly become an obstacle in cultivation. That was why these complexities would gradually consolidate into the complete law system as one reached ‘Unity’. But even at the Unity realm, it was only reaching the limits of a particular Dao in the path of cultivation.
To break through again? That was breaking through the limits! It was allowing one to be filled with endless possibilities. That was reaching the Primal Chaos.
Only at the Primal Chaos… could on eventually create a perfected cosmos! And that was the final realm of cultivation.
‘My Dao of Mirage is already condensed to its utmost limit, turning into a Mirage Origin.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘To break through the Mirage Origin and turn it into primal chaos…’
He grasped the illusory world which produced the Sky Punishment. Only then was he able to have some fuzzy understanding of the Primal Chaos realm.
But to truly take that final step… it was too difficult!
‘Maybe the Voidwalker lineage might be easier.’ Xue Ying thought.
To break through in the laws and profound mysteries system, one had to comprehend thoroughly. Currently, Xue Ying was unable to view the profoundness at the Primal Chaos realm in both the Ripple and Slaughter Daos. He was able to see it in the Dao of Mirage which he was most talented in. One had to know… it was not something he could achieve in the shortest period of time.
Comparatively.
He had already reached the 40th level in the Voidwalker system! Taking one more step and he would have reached the 41st level. That was at the Primal Chaos level.
The reason why he was able to reach the 40th level so quickly had been because of the set of four diagrams absolute art Monarch Nine Cloud left behind that had yet to be completed. Precisely during the process of pondering over the first diagram with the aid of Walker’s Hidden Secret allowed him to break through in the Voidwalker system.
‘I am currently comprehending the second diagram, and who knows I might just step into the Primal Chaos realm with my Voidwalker system first.’ Xue Ying thought.
‘Time to return.’ Xue Ying took a step before stepping through the distant cosmos membrane. He had returned to his Black Fog Sea Monarch Residence.
With his current strength, he was able to fight against some of the weaker Primal Chaos giants. There were those like Heaven Weeping Sect Master who was considered someone with greater experiences and could get through the seventh level Star Pagoda. There were also the weaker ones like the Primal Chaos giants who cultivated the devour-class system who were stuck at the sixth Star Pagoda level. Xue Ying currently stood on an equal level with these weaker ones.
Even so, there were very few of such experts in the sacred worlds, and all of them was definitely a giant of a region.
There were only so many Inner Hall Elders within Great Void Heaven Temple, yet none could get through the sixth level Star Pagoda! One could see how great Xue Ying’s talent in the Dao of Mirage was. Naturally, it was all due to this absolute art which Dark World Master created.
…
Time was merciless. In the blink of an eye, 80 million years had passed.
Within Monarch Residence.
A white-robed Xue Ying was seated there drinking wine. In the distant, Jing Qiu was currently training in her sword techniques. They were all techniques from the books which Xue Ying collected from the outer world all these years. Some even included information of guidance left behind by the seniors, and Jing Qiu naturally loved cultivating these formidable sword techniques.
‘It’s a pity that she hasn’t transcended yet.’ Xue Ying was starting to feel the pressure.
So what if he were strong?
Even though he felt shocked at his ability of grasping an ultra long distance teleportation, and that he had seen the higher dimensional world, even as he comprehended the ‘My Heart as the World’, enabling him to unleash the Sky Punishment Edge which gave him the ability to stand on equal grounds with the giants amongst the five great sacred worlds, none could beat the desire to help his wife transcend!
‘Why can’t I find the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core?’ Xue Ying started feeling anxious, ‘Let me wait a while longer. If I still can’t find it, I could only thicken my face and ask Forefather for help.’
Forefather was after all a Cosmos God.
Unless the situation called for it, Xue Ying was not willing to ask a Cosmos God for help.
“Elder Dong Bo, the Eastern Unicorn Hall located in ‘Qu Mu City’ at Eastern Unicorn Sacred World has sent a message regarding someone willing to trade a set of Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core.” A piece of information came into his communication talisman.
Xue Ying could not help but reveal delight. Under such excitement, he could not help but smash the wine glass in his heart with a ‘pa’.
This made Jing Qiu who was training in her sword far away stop. She looked toward her husband in puzzlement. With how powerful her husband was, how could he not control his strength which resulted in the breaking of the wine glass?
“Xue Ying, what happened?” Jing Qiu hurriedly asked, “Is there something big which had happened?”
“Haha, right, a great joyous matter has just happened. A really happy occasion.” Xue Ying laughed ecstatically, “I’ll go out right at this moment. Wait for me. When I return, you will know.”

chapters.title: Chapter 877 - Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core
chapters.content:
Chapter 877: Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying did not hesitate. He immediately flew into the sky. The void above became distorted, and Xue Ying disappeared after entering it.
At the next moment.
Over at the distant Eastern Unicorn Sacred World above the sky of a desolate wilderness, space here was suddenly distorted. Xue Ying walked out of it. He looked up at the sun to determine his current location: ‘I’ve deviated quite far away.’ There would usually be a deviation from traveling through a huge distance, unless he left behind an extremely accurate spatial marking.
But to Xue Ying, there was no need for him to construct such a spatial marking when he was traveling by himself.
Because he could just use another ultra long distance teleportation even if his destination were further away. The first time he used the teleportation, he would arrive somewhere closer! The second time he used it, since he was quite close to his destination already, Xue Ying would be able to reach where he wanted to go accurately.
“Hu.”
The next time he appeared, Xue Ying had arrived by the city door of the Qu Mu City. He stepped through the doors before taking another step to where the Eastern Unicorn Hall was.
******
The Eastern Unicorn Hall was similar to the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion. They welcomed all cultivators and specialized in conducting trades.
At this moment, within a pavilion in Qu Mu City’s Eastern Unicorn Hall.
There was a scarlet-horned decadent middleaged man seated cross-legged by himself. He was drinking wine with a slight frown, clearly showing that he was quite frustrated about something in his mind.
‘Since an expert from the Great Void Heaven Temple wishes to purchase the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core, he must really covet it. Furthermore, those who seek to purchase such treasures are usually Primal Chaos realm giants.’ The scarlet-horned middleaged man thought, ‘With his strength, I believe he should easily agree to my requests.’
‘Otherwise…’
‘I can only spend more Origin World Rocks to invite other experts for help.’ The scarlet-horned middleaged man thought.
An attendant walked over from outside the hall.
The single-horned middleaged man asked as he saw him: “Has the guest arrived?”
“The guest from the Great Void Heaven Temple has arrived.” The attendant respectfully replied.
“So fast?” The single-horned middleaged man’s eyes brightened, “It seems that he should have engaged in the help of an expert to directly send him over through a long distance.”
He had spent 10 Origin World Rocks from the Myriad Ancient Sacred World for the sake of safety, engaging the help of a Primal Chaos realm giant who specialized in ultra long distance teleportation, sending him directly to the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World.
The single-horned middleaged man stood up. He ordered: “Lead me on.”
“Yes.” The attendant obediently led him.
Very soon.
Within a palace hall, the branch hall master of the Eastern Unicorn Hall was seated accompanying the guest personally. The single-horned middleaged man saw the white-robed young man at the first instance sitting by the side of a table. Currently, Xue Ying had kept his aura and changed his appearances. The other could not recognize who he was. After all, the treasure he was purchasing this time was too valuable, and even Primal Chaos realm giants would feel their eyes turning red from it.
‘He? He doesn’t seem to be in the Primal Chaos realm.’ The single-horned middleaged man felt his heart swelling.
“Please have a seat.” Xue Ying said from afar.
The single-horned middleaged man still walked over and sat down regardless. No matter what, those who could afford the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core were extraordinary.
“I’ve heard you have a set of Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core? I have always been searching for one. Tell me, what’s the price.” Xue Ying directly stated. It was not a secret that he was urgently needing the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core.
“The price isn’t high. 5,000 Origin World Rocks.” The single-horned middleaged man said.
Xue Ying was stunned.
The Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core was usually sold at 6,000 Origin World Rocks. For him to take the initiative in purchasing the material, most would also sell it at higher prices. But this person had even reduced the price?
“But on some conditions.” The single-horned middleaged man stared at Xue Ying.
“Say.” Xue Ying was calm. This was within his expectations.
“Other than the 5,000 Origin World Rocks, I wish for you to help me complete three tasks.” The single-horned middleaged man said, “The first matter, I need you to bring a youngster from the Myriad Ancient Sacred World. He has just become a True God! I need you to accept him as your disciple and ensure his safety for one trillion years. Furthermore, you must provide him with sufficient resources to cultivate. Naturally, it’ll only be up until he reaches the Unity realm! If he hasn’t become a Void God within the trillion years, the resources you have to pay is much less. I’ll bring him away after the time period is up.”
“But you must ensure his safety for the trillion years.”
“The second task. You have to go to the Myriad Ancient Sacred World and destroy a superpower called the ‘Chief Devil Cliff’. The two commanders of the Chief Devil Cliff must die. The two of them are good at surviving, so I wish for you to get rid of them within 100 billion years. I believe this should be quite ample.”
“The third matter is about a sect in the Myriad Ancient Sacred World called ‘Green Peng Sect’. The youngster I need you to save is also a disciple of this Green Peng Sect. I hope for you to protect this Green Peng Sect for a trillion years! Within the trillion years, the Green Peng Sect must not be destroyed.”
Xue Ying immediately began searching for relevant information via the communication talisman.
The Myriad Ancient Sacred World.
That was a world split into two, governed by both Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor respectively.
And the region which World Ancestor oversaw was known for being chaotic. Over there, the devour-class cultivation was openly promulgated. Countless experts would kill and devour others wantonly. It was even more chaotic than the ‘Dark Abyss’ back at his hometown.
Of which the ‘Chief Devil Cliff’ was a well-known brutal superpower. The Green Peng Sect was comparatively weaker, and these two superpowers were located in the region governed by World Ancestor.
The two commanders of Chief Devil Cliff were at the fifth level Star Pagoda Strength. They devoured countless and were infamous…
The Green Peng Sect was instead, an ancient cultivation sect. They had a formidable ‘Green Peng inheritance’ which was cultivated by many.
One had to know that inheritance was essential in the ancient cultivation system! Resources were naturally important too. Without a corresponding inheritance, one had to ponder over how to cultivate by himself. It might be possible for him to become stronger, but it would be almost impossible to dig up the potential of the cultivator.
An equivalent starting point… but different inheritances would result in a sky-wide gap between their power in the future. Xue Ying had once obtained a large number of ancient cultivation inheritances when he was in the secret room of Monarch Nine Cloud. It’s a pity that even though Xue Ying had remembered many of them, they were too complicated, and if Xue Ying did not comprehend them thoroughly, he could not impart to others.
“My conditions are these.” The single-horned middleaged man looked at Xue Ying, “If you are willing to promise me, then this transaction will be made. Naturally, if any of the three matters wasn’t handled properly, you must fork out 1,000 Origin World Rocks as compensation. If all three matters were not handled well, then it would be 3,000 Origin World Rocks! The Eastern Unicorn Hall will be the witness.”
Xue Ying looked at the single-horned middleaged man: “Who is the youngster you want me to bring away?”
“Once you promise me, I’ll naturally tell you who he is.” The single-horned middleaged man said.
“I do have to rush to the Myriad Ancient Sacred World, and it will take me some time to reach the Green Peng Sect. If the youngster I have to bring dies during my journey there, or if the Green Peng Sect is exterminated, are you going to blame me as well?” Xue Ying asked.
“Everything will begin when the transaction is made! You must reach Green Peng Sect within 1,000 years. If that youngster died within 1,000 years or the Green Peng Sect is exterminated, then I’ll naturally not blame you for this.” The single-horned middleaged man coldly sneered, “But you shouldn’t send someone to destroy the Green Peng Sect within the 1,000 years. If you did this, then I’ll definitely fight you to death.”
Xue Ying chuckled.
He did not place the person in front of him in his eyes. Nevertheless, since Xue Ying was in the Eastern Unicorn Hall, he could not carelessly do things! Even though he had the strength to destroy everything, killing a guest within the Eastern Unicorn Hall would be offending many holy grounds of the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World! Even Primal Chaos realm giants could not bear the consequences from this.
“Rest assured. I disdain from doing such acts.” Xue Ying said.
“I’ll reach the Green Peng Sect within one year.” Xue Ying said, “And I’ll do my best with what you told me. As for the Green Peng Sect, if no Primal Chaos realm giants come and attack personally, I can naturally ensure its safety.”
“Alright.” The eyes of the single-horned middleaged man brightened.
Reaching the place in one year?
The two sacred worlds were very far away, and one had to pay a considerable price to reach Green Peng Sect in one year.
“So does this mean that you agree to the conditions?” The single-horned middleaged man said.
“Yes, I agree.” Xue Ying nodded.
These were not difficult for him.
Ensuring the safety of a youngster?
He could just bring someone who had just become a True God into his hometown cosmos!
As for killing the two commanders of the Chief Devil Cliff? Xue Ying did not care about the other party’s strength. He cared more about their characters. Since they were two devils who had devoured countless others, Xue Ying would not mind killing them!
Protecting a sect? He had an idea what to do after slightly thinking about it.
“Hahaha, with the Eastern Unicorn Hall as the witness, I trust you will be able to achieve this.” The single-horned middleaged man flipped his hand, causing a jade container to appear, “Inside is your Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core.”
Xue Ying revealed a grin. He had finally gotten it.

chapters.title: Chapter 878 - Investigation
chapters.content:
Chapter 878: Investigation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
With the Eastern Unicorn Hall as a witness, this trade was conducted successfully. Only then did the single-horned middleaged man relax. He was too nervous. Ever since he had miraculously gotten the ‘Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core’, he was always apprehensive. He even felt that ‘Myriad Ancient Sacred World’ was too dangerous since killings were too common. He did not mind paying the price, spending more than a million years to travel to the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World.
The Eastern Unicorn Sacred World was a more orderly place than the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World.
Before the transaction succeeded, he was really nervous. Even though he asked for a price of ‘5,000 Origin World Rocks’, in reality, he had never seen 100 Origin World Rocks before in his life!
‘With these Origin World Rocks, I can start implementing my plan. By then, I should be able to grow stronger swiftly.’ The single-horned middleaged man thought. He had many plans, ‘Peng’er, your uncle teacher will have to spend some time to cultivate. I’ll definitely come back… within one trillion years to the Green Peng Sect! By then, I’ll become the strongest expert in Green Peng Sect and control it!’
Myriad Ancient Sacred World, especially in the region governed by World Ancestor, was too dangerous. It was not appropriate for him to cultivate and grow.
“Yun Peng?”
After Xue Ying got the news of that brat, he could not help but ask, “How long have you been away from the Green Peng Sect?”
“A couple of millions of years.” The single-horned middleaged man said.
“Are you certain Yun Peng is still at the Green Peng Sect?” Xue Ying asked.
The single-horned middleaged man was stunned momentarily: “He should be.”
“I think you should investigate a little.” Xue Ying chuckled as he looked towards the branch hall master over at the Eastern Unicorn Hall, “Qi Fu Hall Master, I believe investigating the whereabouts of this brat called Yun Peng shouldn’t be something hard for your Eastern Unicorn Hall right?”
“One Origin World Rock.” This Qi Fu Hall Master beamed.
“Alright.” The single-horned middleaged man immediately replied.
Just one Origin World Rock>
He was currently wealthy, so he did not care about this little amount.
Xue Ying accompanied the single-horned middleaged man in drinking. They were waiting for news coming from the side of Eastern Unicorn Hall. Behind the Eastern Unicorn Hall were the Blade Emperor City, the Void God Palace, Stars City, Ancestor Bone Palace, of which there should be some ancient cultivators who could easily investigate the situation of Green Peng Sect located far away in the Myriad Ancient Sacred World.
After a moment later.
“The brat called Yun Peng isn’t within the Green Peng Sect.” Qi Fu Hall Master said, “I will even give you a piece of information for free. During the investigation of the Green Peng Sect, we discovered that disciples were talking about a group of disciples being kidnapped. Yun Peng was one of them.”
The single-horned middleaged man felt his heart hanging in worry. After hearing that he had been kidnapped did he breath out a sigh of relief since he was still alive. He added: “Where is he located now?”
“How would I know?” Qi Fu Hall Master shook his head, “I do not know his exact location. It isn’t that easy to ascertain it.”
“It is possible.” Xue Ying mentioned.
Just like in the Great Void Heaven Temple, as they were trying to investigate who the assassin was that attacked Xue Ying, if not for the Myriad World Tavern Master hindering them, they should be able to find out who the perpetrator was.
Qi Fu Hall Master glanced at Xue Ying before nodding, “Right. It is possible for us to investigate it, but it is comparatively more troublesome. It will cost 200 Origin World Rocks per investigation.”
“200 Origin World Rocks?” The single-horned middleaged man widened his eyes.
He spent just 10 Origin World Rocks to travel from the Myriad Ancient Sacred World to here! Those experts who passed through the fourth level Star Pagoda would usually not have more than 200 Origin World Rocks including all the treasures they had, and this was the cost of just finding the whereabouts of a cultivator?
“You can certainly decline.” Qi Fu Hall Master chuckled.
“Investigate!” The single-horned middleaged man gritted his teeth.
This was the person he cared the most. He must investigate it.
This time, they waited for a long time.
Two hours later, Qi Fu Hall Master finally replied: “We’ve checked things through. The brat called Yun Peng is currently a slave within Ancient Myriad Sacred World’s ‘Golden Eclipse Nation’s Devil Eye God Prefecture residence.”
“Golden Eclipse Nation? Slave?” The single-horned middleaged man felt his expression turning slightly pale.
The Golden Eclipse Nation.
That was a superpower within the domain governed by World Ancestor in the Myriad Ancient Sacred World. The Golden Eclipse King was even one of the personal disciples of ‘World Ancestor’.
“I’ll be able to arrive at Golden Eclipse Nation and save this brat called Yun Peng within one year.” Xue Ying said.
“You are ?onfident of it?” The single-horned middleaged man looked towards Xue Ying with excitement. From how he sees it, with the identity of the Golden Eclipse King as a ‘personal disciple of the World Ancestor’, he would be able to sweep his way across the Myriad Ancient Sacred World.
Xue Ying chuckled.
This brat might be lucky to get such a good treasure, but his understanding of the higher-ups in the three great sacred worlds was too lacking.
“I am confident.” Xue Ying replied.
…
Once the transaction is settled, Xue Ying personally left the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World and went back to his hometown cosmos.
Within his hometown cosmos, inside the Black Fog Sea Monarch residence.
“Jing Qiu, Jing Qiu.” Xue Ying immediately shouted to his wife when he returned.
Jing Qiu turned around with a smile, “Xue Ying, you came back so quickly? I heard you mention that is is something joyous. Previously, you did not explain to me what exactly is this joyous matter?”
“Hahaha…” Xue Ying could not help but laugh.
It was a momentous matter.
Acquiring this Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core was not an easy task!
Firstly, it was because he had reached a certain level of combat power. On the other aspect, he was fortunate to enter the treasure cove of Monarch Nine Cloud! If not for the treasure cove, how was he able to afford the Scarlet Cloud Pomengranate Core? If he depended on himself to save up this amount, Xue Ying did not know when he would have enough.
“What exactly is this joyous matter? Quickly tell me!” Jing Qiu could not help but probe him.
Xue Ying smiled. He flipped his hand, causing a palace hall to appear from nothingness. It landed on the grass and occupied an area of 50 kilometers.
Jing Qiu felt that the aura emanating from this palace hall was extraordinary. Just the unseen aura ripples stifled her.
“Come in with me.” Xue Ying brought his wife into this palace hall.
“From today on, you will be cultivating inside.” Xue Ying chuckled. He flipped his hand, bringing out a black jade bottle. He then hurled it right into a cavity within the hall wall. It was jammed exactly right in that hole. “Weng”, the surface of the black jade bottle started forming golden patterns, causing veined lines to extend across the entire hall. Soon after, a mild fragrance began pervading the place.
When one inhaled this fragrance, his soul would become incomparably calm.
“This fragrance will be able to persist for 380 million years.” Xue Ying said before flipping his hand once again, bringing out the jade container. Opening it up, this container directly let out a sweet scent that resembled that of a tender ‘green bamboo shoot’. Even though it might seem like bamboo, one would be able to spot the difference after thoroughly inspecting it. There were many clear patterns stacked on top of its surface.
“Eat it.” Xue Ying looked towards his wife.
Jing Qiu had just breathed in the sweet scent coming from within the jade container when she felt chiming in her soul. At that moment, her comprehension and pondering abilities had reached an exaggerated stage. It was practically similar to the past when she had enlightenment flashes.
She knew that her husband had left his hometown cosmos for the sake of finding treasures so that they could transcend. And now, Qing Yao and Dong Bo Yu had both transcended by themselves, leaving only her!
The joyous matter mentioned by her husband should likely be referring to this treasure.
“Mn.” Jing Qiu picked it up. She lightly bit on the fruit. It was crunchy, and the moment it entered her mouth, it immediately transformed into green energy that fused into her body. She felt an even more soul-provoking feeling than before when he had smelled the sweet scent, causing her soul to tremble.
“Quickly, finish eating it.” Xue Ying urged her.
Jing Qiu took two mouthfuls to finish the fruit.
She did not know how precious this treasure was that she ate! If one had gone to exchange this Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core… it was possible to trade it with a puppet lifeform comparable in strength with the ‘Black Wild Dog’ from the Starting Ground. Creating a cosmos might not even be as pricey as this Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core! Some of the newer Primal Chaos realm giants could not afford this even if they were to sell all their treasures.

chapters.title: Chapter 879 - Yun Peng
chapters.content:
Chapter 879: Yun Peng
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Not just this.
Even the black jade bottle contained the ‘Qian Yi Water Spiritual Liquid’, a liquid that could be maintained for a total of 380 million years. It cost Xue Ying a total of 1,200 Origin World Rocks.
This god palace was even personally refined by a Cosmos God and cost 900 Origin World Rocks.
Adding the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core, Xue Ying had forked out a total of 7,100 Origin World Rocks. Even so, he still had to complete the three matters brought forward by the single-horned middleaged man.
‘This is the limit as to what I can do.’ Xue Ying thought. Because in history, there were Cosmos Gods and Primal Chaos realm giants who had provided the best conditions to aid the cultivation of their loved ones at the stage four World Deity realm-and it was what Xue Ying was doing currently.
“After consuming the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core, you should be able to maintain it for about 300 million years.” Xue Ying said, “Jing Qiu, during this 300 million years, you must treasure every moment and use them for cultivation.”
“Mn.” Jing Qiu nodded. She could almost no longer suppress herself.
At this moment, many halos were forming within her soul. Just by diverting part of her heart energy to deduce on those halos, she was able to attain colossal comprehension…
All sorts of enlightenment started appearing, and it so much more exaggerated than having sudden enlightenment!
This was normal too.
Xue Ying himself had merely consumed a Supplementary Spiritual Fruit worth 50 Origin World Rocks in his life. Furthermore, he was much stronger than Jing Qiu. Jing Qiu was not even a True God, and was merely a stage four World Deity… using these precious materials on her had induced a considerable increase in her comprehension efficiency. Furthermore, because her soul was weak, the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core could last for more than 300 million years.
“Hurry out, I’ll be entering closed-door cultivation now.” Jing Qiu urged. Any cultivator understood that such a state of mind was something they desired in their dreams.
Xue Ying chuckled before leaving.
“Hong long~”
The hall doors were shut close.
Jing Qiu immediately began her closed-door cultivation!
Xue Ying could not help but grin after seeing this palace hall which was shut close. He could completely understand the current condition his wife was in: “A cultivation state which is much more efficient than sudden enlightenment. Furthermore, it can persist for 300 million years… if she could not transcend despite having such cultivation conditions, then I have nothing to say.”
The five great sacred worlds.
To many stage four World Deities, this was already considered the best form of cultivation condition. As for the ‘Eternal Heart’ or ‘Origin World Fruit’, those did not assist in their cultivation. Instead, they would force the realm of the cultivator to transcend into eternity!
‘It is time for me to complete the three matters which I promised.’ Xue Ying thought. This palace hall had been refined by a Cosmos God. He did not have to worry about any disturbances on his wife since even he could not break apart the building when his wife was controlling it!
“Yu’er, Qing Yao, your mother is currently in closed-door cultivation. You must not disturb her.” Xue Ying transmitted to his children, barring them from worrying about their mother.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying then shot into the sky. The sky in midair warped, and he directly flew into this distorted space. When he appeared, he was in the Myriad Ancient Sacred World already.
…
Myriad Ancient Sacred World
This was quite a unique world. When facing against the two great religions, it was on the side of Eastern Unicorn Sacred World and Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. But in terms of strength, it was ranked second in the five great sacred worlds. Naturally, it was qualified to be arrogant. ‘World Ancestor’, was someone not any weaker than Ancestor Mother! As for the mysterious ‘Ancestor Sorcerer’, he was known for having many techniques and was comparable to Ancestor Mother as well.
Both World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer were truly proud.
They had decided to split this sacred world into two segments, with both of them governing one part without disturbing the other.
Within the region governed by Ancestor Sorcerer, the ‘hex’ cultivation system flourished in this region. Many hex cultivators stayed here. Most of those cultivating the hex system preferred staying in their room for long periods researching, and all of them had many different weird techniques! One had to affirm that at least in this generation, the hex cultivation system had a superior advantage in terms of overall combat strength against the laws and profound mysteries system whether it was in the highest realm, the Primal Chaos realm or the Unity realm.
The reason why the laws and profound mysteries system was weaker had been due to a break in inheritance midway through. The one who created this system, ‘Ancestor Cang’, had fallen. For a long period, the laws and profound mysteries system declined. It was only with the rise of Forefather Tian Yu that eventually led to the creation of the Great Void Heaven Temple.
But comparing strength…
Both Forefather Tian Yu and the current Swordmaster were both at the third level of the final realm. As a result, the reputation of the laws and profound mysteries system was weaker than that of the hex system.
Within the Golden Eclipse Nation, Devil Eye God Prefecture.
“Pa! Pa! Pa!”
In a small courtyard of a luxurious residence, there was a big green-skinned hunk furiously whipping a young man. The young man did not dare to retaliate. Naturally, he was seeking trouble if he decided to resist. He could only continue enduring as the whip lashed against his body, causing him to roll on the ground in agony. Over time, many ugly wounds were formed on his body before recovering rapidly.
“Master.” The huge green-skinned hunk respectfully said to the leader of a group, a female: “100 whips have been lashed.”
“Hmph.”
This girl with a violet marking left on her forehead coldly laughed at this young man, “In the future, remember this. If you see me coming over, you must not only kneel down, you must also touch the ground with your face. Do you understand? You are just a slave. Remember your own identity.”
“Yes.” The young man knelt down with his face entirely touching the ground.
“Mn.”
Only then did the girl hummed out a response. She turned around and left. The group of subordinates was escorting her from behind.
The surroundings regained its silence. Only then did the young man stand. He wiped off the dirt on his face. His body was faintly trembling from the pain. The injuries inflicted by the whips were actually a minor matter. More importantly, it was the agonizing pain that felt unbearable. This was a punishment which the God Prefecture had against these servants, and every lash felt worse than death.
‘Slave?’ The young man Yun Peng thought. He felt cold in his heart, ‘The Golden Eclipse Nation, Devil Eye God Prefecture. It is impossible for me to escape from here.’
There were eight experts under the Golden Eclipse King, and each had constructed a god prefecture.
The status of the Devil Eye God Prefecture was something everyone acknowledged within the Golden Eclipse Nation, and the Golden Eclipse King was a personal disciple of World Ancestor…
‘Slave? Am I going to be a slave for eternity?’ Yun Peng lowered his head and began tidying up the courtyard according to the procedures. Being a slave, he did not have the qualifications to raise his head, ‘If I can’t escape, then I must cultivate if I want my future days to be better. As long as I become a Void God, I would be able to regain my freedom. But there is still quite a distance for me to the Void God realm from where I am currently.’
‘I do not have sufficient resources, and even the time span I can cultivate is limited.’ Yun Peng felt more and more despondent over time. But the temperament of a cultivator did not allow him to give up so easily.
…
In the sky outside Golden Eclipse Nation.
The winds were calmly blowing. Suddenly, space here distorted, and a figure walked out of it slowly. It was a white-robed young man. He was currently staring ahead at the towering Golden Eclipse Nation. There were not many who knew that a Unity realm expert who wielded power comparable to new Primal Chaos realm giants had arrived outside the city.
The sixth level of Star Pagoda-having this strength was sufficient for the cultivator to leave his mark in the history of the five great sacred worlds.
‘Golden Eclipse Nation.’ Xue Ying faintly probed the location. He was able to discover that this nation city was being supported by a vast array. He could not permeate his senses in.
He then took a step before arriving right outside the city doors.
The guards outside the city doors did not treat this as something huge since experts who could teleport were quite commonly seen.
Xue Ying traveled within the Golden Eclipse Nation. It might seem like he took a few ordinary steps, but every single step Xue Ying took brought him more than five million kilometers away, to which others thought it was merely some short distant teleportations. After a few steps, Xue Ying arrived right before a luxurious residence. This was none other than the ‘Devil Eye God Palace’, one of the eight god palaces within the Golden Eclipse Nation.

chapters.title: Chapter 880 - Teacher Meets Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 880: Teacher Meets Disciple
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying might be looking at the Devil Eye God Prefecture in front of him, but in reality, he had already enveloped this vast residence using his Plate Ripple Diagram. He had long discovered the brat called ‘Yun Peng’ whom he would be taking as a disciple.
‘He is actually so obediently kneeling down and placing his head on the ground?’ Xue Ying frowned. Suddenly, he decided not to rush over.
The other party had been captured to become a slave.
That was absolutely the lowest point of a person’s life. Under normal circumstances, there were no opportunities for a slave to get out of his predicament.
As a result, he decided to make use of this chance to observe his future disciple.
“Sou.” Xue Ying turned around and took a step. He found a restaurant nearby to sit down. After ordering some great delicacies and wine, Xue Ying began consuming it. At the same time, he was observing all actions taken by this future disciple of his. Xue Ying dared not be too careless. After becoming a slave, the other party might just lose his life anytime, and Xue Ying still had to ensure the safety of this disciple.
Day passed by day.
Xue Ying was in no hurry. The Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core energy could be maintained for more than 300 million years, and he was not in a rush to go back to his hometown.
‘It seems he hasn’t given up.’ Xue Ying revealed a grin, ‘He is actually making use of every single bit of time he has to cultivate. Even as he is laboring, being reprimanded or whipped… he would also be partially cultivating.’
‘Mn? It is time for me to act. Otherwise, this disciple of mine will die.’
Xue Ying nonchalantly stood up. He took a step before disappearing.
This was a region governed by World Ancestor. Over here, murders were frequently seen. It was normal for cultivators to devour batches of living beings. Slavery, punishment, torture, slaughter… a devil might just devour a large group of living beings on his whim and fancy. Many ‘punishments’ would occur with devouring as well! This was much ‘darker’ than the Dark Abyss.
…
Devil Eye God Prefecture. Within a punishment room.
The young man Yun Peng had been tied up with his power sealed. There was another person in the punishment room. It was a tall, thin, white and tender male. He looked relatively handsome. He had long and narrow crimson eyes with a very long tongue that was currently licking his lips. As he extended his tongue, it was able to reach a distance of two to three meters, licking on the wound of Yun Peng’s skin, and at the same time, causing a piece of meat to be devoured.
‘Ah.’ Yun Peng was forcibly enduring the pain, ‘Am I going to die now? I actually caught the attention of the most terrifying ‘Paragon Blood Insect’ within the Devil Eye God Prefecture?’
Paragon Blood Eye was the favorite disciple of the Devil Eye God Prefecture Prefecture Master, ‘Devil Eye Nefarious Lord’.
He had great potential in the devour-class’ cultivation system. Currently, he had already reached the Unity realm and was considered an expert even amongst those at his realm. Paragon Blood Insect was known as the one within the prefecture who loved devouring others the most. He would usually travel all around devouring countless beings. Whenever he returned to the Golden Eclipse Nation City, he dared not casually devour others due to the existence of rules within the city.
As a result, Paragon Blood Insect would usually meditate within the city. He would only select a few targets occasionally to enjoy himself.
This time, ‘Yun Peng’ had been selected.
“Green Peng Sect lineage? Your body actually has the Green Peng blood already.” The eyes of Paragon Blood Insect were emitting light. He extended his tongue before eating another piece of flesh. As he ate, his mouth was filled with blood. He gulped down every single drop of blood, “Such wonderful taste. I’ve heard that those who cultivated the inheritance of Green Peng Sect to the limit will be able to transform their body into a Green Peng? And then step into the Primal Chaos realm?”
“Boo hoo, looking through the newly captured slaves within the prefecture, I see that all are disciples from the Green Peng Sect. After thoroughly checking, your aura seems the most enticing to me, and that is indeed the case.”
Whenever Paragon Blood Insect feasted on another party, countless small insects within his body would absorb the blood and flesh of the other party. During absorbance, he was able to discern the Green Peng blood… and he would then try to fuse it into himself.
‘The Green Peng blood is quite beneficial to my body.’ Paragon Blood Insect thought.
The devour-class cultivation system.
Even though it was well-known to be weak, for instance, most Unity realm experts would be at the first level Star Pagoda strength, there would occasionally be some terrifying existences emerging from this system! Like ‘World Ancestor’ who was high up had actually proven this point. Those whom he chose as personal disciples were absolutely talented cultivators amongst those in the devour-class cultivation system.
They were able to absorb the essence of beings whom they devoured into themselves, absorbing the strengths of the other party’s blood, flesh, and soul, allowing their own life to become more perfect!
Like World Ancestor…
The strength of his body was much stronger than even Blade Emperor and others who cultivated the ‘strongest warrior cultivation system’. World Ancestor’s body was considered the most perfected body, and even his soul was similarly strong and perfect. As a result, despite ‘Ancestor Sorcerer’ wielding many techniques, he could not triumph over World Ancestor.
It was publicly acknowledged.
Sacred Master was ranked first. Second were Ancestor Mother, World Ancestor, and Ancestor Sorcerer, though the gap between them was small. After that was Blade Emperor! Devil Mountain Primogenitor and Jade Light Master were ranked even further behind.
“Mn.” Paragon Blood Insect was immersed in his enjoyment when his expression suddenly changed. Because a white-robed teenager suddenly appeared within the punishment room.
“Who are you?” Paragon Blood Insect shouted out coldly with some vigilance.
“I am his teacher.” Xue Ying pointed to Yun Peng who was bound. He casually pointed his fingers out before causing the shackles on him to shatter. Yun Peng was looking at this unfamiliar white-robed teenager with shock.
He could confirm that he did not recognize this mysterious expert who had appeared.
“Teacher.” Yun Peng did not hesitate to kneel down and kowtow to him.
Even though he did not recognize him.
He was very clear that this was the only hope for him to survive.
“His teacher?” Paragon Blood Insect stared at Xue Ying, “You are from the Green Peng Sect?”
“You can say so.” Xue Ying said. He would be protecting the Green Peng Sect for one trillion years and could be considered to be part of it.
“You from the Green Peng Sect, you dare to sneak into the Devil Eye God Prefecture? You are quite daring.” Paragon Blood Insect coldly laughed.
“Hong long—”
The punishment door suddenly opened. A person entered. He was a wicked-looking male wearing a violet robe. There was a marking on his forehead, and the moment he came, his eyes swept across the place before landing on Xue Ying.
“Teacher.” Paragon Blood Insect said, “This person from the Green Peng Sect dares to sneak into our Devil Eye God Prefecture.” He discovered that Xue Ying had suddenly appeared, and dared not be too careless about it. He immediately reported upwards.
This wicked male looked at Xue Ying. He examined him closely before sneering out, “There is no expert like you within the Green Peng Sect. But since you dare to barge into my territory, you are truly seeking death. I’ll let you become my food.” Saying that he began opening his mouth to start devouring the other party.
“Devil Eye!”
A mighty voice sounded.
The wicked male was startled.
One could see a muscular male figure appearing within the punishment room. He had a golden hair, and his skin was shining in dazzling golden luster. He had a big bloody mouth and a nose that edged upwards to the sky. His eyes were emitting a genuinely majestic and tyrannical aura.
“King.” The wicked male did not hesitate in bowing his body respectfully to greet this person.
“King.” Paragon Blood Insect was so frightened that he hurriedly bowed as well.
The one in front of them was the existence who created the Golden Eclipse Nation-the Golden Eclipse King. That was someone whom the World Ancestor appreciated and selected to become his personal disciple. It was said that he also cultivated an ancient cultivation system, though just his devour-class cultivation system had reached the fifth level Star Pagoda strength. The moment he unleashed his ancient cultivation strength… he should be an apex expert even amongst those of the fifth level Star Pagoda strength.
It was quite similar to Xue Ying who had yet to comprehend the ‘My Heart as the World’.
Golden Eclipse King had then revealed a grin at Xue Ying.
Because when Xue Ying came, he transmitted a message to Golden Eclipse King, and making the king rush over. After all, the three great sacred worlds were working closely against the two great religions. The higher-ups of the three great sacred worlds would frequently work together too, and Xue Ying did not dare to act against this personal disciple of World Ancestor. Similarly, Golden Eclipse King did not dare to move against an Inner Hall Elder of the Great Void Heaven Temple too.
They paid great importance to each other.
Xue Ying did not dare underestimate the other party because he might have determined the other party as someone at the peak fifth level Star Pagoda strength, but Golden Eclipse King had not acted for a long time as a king.
And Golden Eclipse King understood too… that this Elder Dong Bo had cultivated for a very short period, yet he had such a strength already. In the future, it was hard to predict how strong he might become.
“Golden Eclipse King.” Xue Ying said.
“Elder Dong Bo.” Golden Eclipse King chuckled.
The expressions on both Devil Eye Nefarious Lord and Paragon Blood Insect changed.
“Elder Dong bo, why would you be in the mood to come to my Golden Eclipse Nation?” Golden Eclipse King chuckled.
“My disciple has been captured by this Devil Eye God Prefecture as a slave. Naturally, I have to come over. If I were slow, he might have been devoured.” Xue Ying said before glancing at Yun Peng by the side.
Yun Peng who had just escaped into the sky felt dim-witted still.
Even the high-up Golden Eclipse King was so polite to this mysterious expert, and it seemed that he would be his teacher?
“What happened?” Golden Eclipse King’s expression turned sullen. He swept his gaze across to Devil Eye Nefarious Lord by the side, “Devil Eye, why would the disciple of Elder Dong Bo be captured as a slave? Make yourself clear to Elder Dong Bo.”
“Yes.” The forehead of Devil Eye Nefarious Lord suddenly shot out a dim violet light which landed on the body of Paragon Blood Insect. At that moment, Paragon Blood Insect was stunned. He could not move. Devil Eye Nefarious Lord opened his mouth, turning it extremely big before devouring the other party in one mouth.
Devil Eye Nefarious Lord was very clear of the temper of his own king. That was why he did not hesitate to devour this disciple of his as an apology! The world was rigorous and cruel in this region governed by World Ancestor.
“Elder Dong Bo, Devil Eye might be slightly stingy, but let us put this matter pass us, alright?” Golden Eclipse King beamed at Xue Ying, “Go go go, let us go have a seat at my place. This punishment room isn’t somewhere nice to be.”
“Alright.” Xue Ying nodded. In his heart, he was quite startled at how Devil Eye Nefarious Lord actually devoured Paragon Blood Insect in one mouth.
Even though Xue Ying had heard before that the region governed by World Ancestor was cruel and cold, hearing it was different from actually seeing it.

chapters.title: Chapter 881 - A Safe Place
chapters.content:
Chapter 881: A Safe Place
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the palace of Golden Eclipse Nation.
Many plates of delicacies were sent over. The Golden Eclipse King was seated opposite of Xue Ying. Behind Xue Ying located Yun Peng.
Yun Peng was at this moment feeling terrified and uneasy. Because the majestic aura emitting by Golden Eclipse King was too terrifying for him. This was not an aura he had deliberately emitted. Instead, it was something natural. Furthermore, Yun Peng was feeling really uncertain too: ‘Who exactly is this Elder Dong Bo? It seems that even Golden Eclipse King respects him a lot. That Devil Eye Nefarious Lord actually devoured his disciple Paragon Blood Insect in a mouth as a form of apology. I have absolutely not seen him in the past before! Amongst all the powerful experts which I know, there should be none who is qualified to be friends with Elder Dong Bo.’
He was feeling uneasy.
But he did not know that it was his teacher uncle, the one who was most concerned about him that had gone lucky! He got the ‘Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core’ and was able to invite Xue Ying over!
“Please. Even though my Golden Eclipse Nation might be ordinary in other aspects, in terms of food, haha, there aren’t many places in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World that can compare with my place.” Golden Eclipse King boasted. Amongst those of the devour-class cultivation system, the higher their talent, the harsher the demands on whom they devoured would be! As a result, even though the region governed by World Ancestor was violent and chaotic, the delicacies here were incredibly amazing.
Many weaker cultivators had been forced to research into delicious food.
“It is indeed not bad.” Xue Ying would occasionally eat a bit.
“I’ve heard that Elder Dong Bo’s attainment in the Dark World is amazing. Is it possible for this one to have a look at it?” Golden Eclipse King laughed as he said.
Xue Ying did not mind. He knew the other party had no evil intention. It was the custom here in the region governed by World Ancestor. They nakedly believed in strength.
“Golden Eclipse King, the array incorporated in this palace hall of yours is quite stable.” Xue Ying looked towards an enormous stone sculpture outside. That sculpture was made from ordinary materials, but under the protection of the palace array, it was hard even for experts at the fifth level Star Pagoda to break it. Xue Ying casually waved his hands, “Hua hua hua~”
The Dark World appeared from illusory into reality, wrapping around that sculpture. Multiple layers of Dark World began absorbing the surrounding World Energy, forming a huge vortex in its presence.
The eyelids of Golden Eclipse King twitched.
He could feel how terrifying the Dark World was.
“Peng!”
This Dark World contained a total of 360 layers. When they exploded at once, there was a qualitative transformation in its strength due to the numbers. It contained a destructive force that destroyed the stone sculpture protected by the array.
One could hear a low booming sound before the entire stone sculpture vanished.
Golden Eclipse King felt his heart tightening.
Such an amazing Xue Ying. Even though there were not many array experts in the region governed by World Ancestor, his palace was a place he usually rests, so he would have invited a huge group of hex cultivators over to help him construct an array! In this aspect of array construction… an expert of the laws and profound mysteries system might be formidable, but they were still ranked behind those who cultivated the hex. In the aspects of arrays and weapon refinements, the hex cultivators ranked first.
This was a place he usually rested. Even though it was not as highly guarded as the place he cultivated, he still had to put in all his strength to barely pierce through the array!
But previously, the array which enveloped the region where the stone sculpture was had been destroyed by violent energy. The stone sculpture had been entirely annihilated.
‘This move of his is slightly stronger than my absolute move?’ Golden Eclipse King was inwardly startled.
This was normal.
600 layers of Dark World sufficed to reach the sixth level Star Pagoda strength. These 360 layers might be weaker, but it had reached the boundaries of sixth level Star Pagoda strength, and it was enough to alarm everyone.
“Admirable, admirable.” Golden Eclipse King added, “Elder Dong Bo has cultivated for a shorter period than me, but it is likely that I am not a match for Elder Dong Bo anymore.”
“A combat involves many aspects. It isn’t merely about offensive might.” Xue Ying chuckled, “Golden Eclipse King has an illustrated battle record. It is the true proof of your strength evidenced by many battles.”
Golden Eclipse King laughed.
But he was clear that even though the two of them were comparable in strength, with the cultivation speed of this Xue Ying, Xue Ying would likely hurl him far beyond.
…
