After that, the atmosphere between the two became less hostile. Golden Eclipse King became more passionate as he sent up many delicacies continuously. Clearly, he wanted to befriend this Xue Ying! After all, those who reached the strength of Golden Eclipse King would not just rest his vision on Myriad Ancient Sacred World alone. He would set his horizons across the five great sacred worlds and the primal chaos void.
“Golden Eclipse King doesn’t have to send any more food.” Xue Ying chuckled, “If you are free in the future, and will be going by Green Peng Sect, you can always find me there.”
“You are truly related to the Green Peng Sect?” Golden Eclipse King who personally sent Xue Ying off felt astonished.
Yun Peng who was silently following behind looked at Xue Ying with shock.
“Mn, I have an agreement with an expert from the Green Peng Sect, that I will need to defend Green Peng Sect for a period.” Xue Ying said.
“No wonder.” Golden Eclipse King nodded, “If there’s an opportunity, I’ll definitely pay a visit.”
It was too troublesome to travel within the sacred world.
Even as the Golden Eclipse King, if not for special reasons, he would not travel all the way to the Green Peng Sect just for the sake of discussing Dao with Xue Ying. After all, with the speed of he, Golden Eclipse King would have to spend several hundred million years traveling from the Golden Eclipse Nation to the Green Peng Sect!
“Alright.”
Xue Ying nodded.
“Si la~” Xue Ying waved his hand before directly tearing apart a spatial passage. He directly took Yun Peng in.
Seeing the spatial passage gradually closing up, Golden Eclipse King blinked a few times: “This Dong Bo Xue Ying seems to have reached a high profound stage in terms of space. He could actually tear out a spatial passage?”
Usually, only Primal Chaos realm giants could do so.
Naturally, some who specialized in the void could do it at the Unity realm too! But Golden Eclipse King was not one of them. He might be strong, but towards the complex laws and profound mysteries or the Dao of myriad existences which the hex cultivation focused on… he felt headache thinking of these. It was still better for him to devour to improve his strength. That was the easiest and also the most delightful joy to him.
…
In his hometown ‘Starting Cosmos’, within a hall in the Black Fog Sea Monarch Residence.
Xue Ying sat down on a chair. There was also Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao who were feeling puzzled and weird by the side.
“Kneel down.” Xue Ying looked at Yun Peng in front and ordered.
Yun Peng did not hesitate to kneel down.
This was a genuinely thick leg for him to hug! Even Golden Eclipse King as such an arrogant person had to acknowledge this person.
“Because of an agreement, I have to accept you as a disciple.” Xue Ying indifferently stated, “But I, Dong Bo Xue Ying, will not accept a disciple that easily. From today on, you will be an honorary disciple under me!”
“Yes, teacher.” Yun Peng immediately kowtowed to his teacher.
Xue Ying watched this calmly. Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao were both very shocked… this, this was a Paragon! His father took him as a disciple, but only as an honorary one? But this pair of siblings did not know that with Xue Ying’s current strength if he were willing to accept disciples, even Void Gods would kneel down and shout out to him.
Xue Ying did not care about these. After all, he was someone with the strength of a Primal Chaos realm expert. His current goal was to step into the Primal Chaos realm!
“Weng.” Xue Ying pointed out, causing a stream of light to enter the mind of Yun Peng.
“These are the rules under my sect. You must not violate it. Those who violate it will face severe punishments.” Xue Ying said.
Yun Peng felt his heart turning bitter the moment he read through it.
The rule was quite strict.
It was not easy for a cultivator that lived in the region governed by World Ancestor to adapt to Xue Ying’s rule! After all, the rules set by Xue Ying were stricter than that of the Great Void Heaven Temple.
“Relax, this isn’t the Myriad Ancient Sacred World. This is in a cosmos. It is much safer and peaceful by more than a thousand times as compared to the Myriad Ancient Sacred World.” Xue Ying said, “As long as you do not create trouble, none will come and kill you.”
Who would dare act against the disciple of Xue Ying in his hometown cosmos?
Furthermore, Yun Peng was a Paragon himself!
“Ah?” Yun Peng was slightly stunned. None would kill him if he did not create any trouble? Such a good matter?
“Yu’er, Qing Yao, introduce our cosmos properly to this junior disciple brother.” Xue Ying ordered.
“Yes, father.” Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao were both excited. They had heard that this new disciple brother came from the ‘Myriad Ancient Sacred World’! Even though they understood something about the outside world from their father, they understood too little about it.
“Junior disciple brother, quickly come and follow us.”
“I’ll treat you to some drinks.”
Qing Yao and Dong Bo Yu were all passionate.
Yun Peng felt weird. He could not adapt to this temporarily since he was in such a safe place with such passionate senior disciple brother and sister? That felt so different from what Yun Peng usually experienced! He did not even dare to dream of it! Even though the senior disciple brother and sister in front of him were weaker…
Watching them leave, Xue Ying silently nodded: ‘It is time to handle the matter regarding Green Peng Sect.’
Since Yun Peng would be safe, he did not have to worry about him any longer. Instead, he had to protect the Green Peng Sect… this was also one of the three matters. Xue Ying was not in the mind to waste too much time and effort on such issues. He would rather handle them as soon as possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 882 - Daoist Elder Dong Bo Xue Ying
chapters.content:
Chapter 882: Daoist Elder Dong Bo Xue Ying
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying once again came to the Myriad Ancient Sacred World. To him, traveling anywhere was as easy as breathing.
“Green Peng Sect.”
Standing on the desolate wilderness, he was looking at the undulating mountain chain. The undulating mountain chain in front was also the Green Peng Mountain Range, and where the ‘Green Peng Sect’ was at! The powerful disciples under the Green Peng Sect would usually have a slightly special body. They would progress towards the final evolution as a ‘Green Peng’! Thus, it was normal for them to attract the desire of many devour-class cultivators. They would frequently be ambushed upon and devoured!
For the sake of not being devoured, Green Peng Sect had to become stronger!
Fortunately, the inheritance of Green Peng Sect was imprinted on the Green Peng Mountain Range. Even though this sect had been exterminated many times in history, there would be new cultivators arriving at this mountain, receiving the inheritance before restarting the Green Peng Sect!
Xue Ying directly moved forward.
“Hua.”
Taking step by step, Xue Ying would traverse more than 5,000 kilometers every time. Furthermore, he would move higher and higher up the mountain, directly heading to this Green Peng Mountain Range ahead.
“Who?”
“This is the Green Peng Sect. If you want to go on the mountain, you must start from the bottom.”
The disciples guarding the Green Peng Sect looked from afar as a figure teleported with each step. As Xue Ying came closer, even though he was releasing an unseen pressure, the guarding disciples still roared out.
Because they understood this point over a long period-
They had to use strength to conquer the enemies! This was the iron-clad law over this vast land.
“Hmph.”
Xue Ying extended his right hand, causing a Black Gourd to appear. He unplugged the cork.
“Sou.”
A fireball flew out with a ‘sou’. It rapidly turned big after coming out, transforming into an enormous fireball star of half a million kilometers in diameter! The flames on it were rolling, and its power was majestic. It caused all the experts cultivating within the Green Peng Sect to flinch. They rushed out rapidly.
“What is happening?”
“Why did such a big disturbance appear?”
“This power…”
All the experts of Green Peng Sect came out from where they stayed and cultivated. They looked up into the sky.
The enormous fireball star was emitting a rolling wave of flame that caused the expression of everyone to change. It was even more dazzling than the sun in the sky. Its existence had even started influencing the surrounding laws. On the surface of the fireball star that contained the flame waves, there were even some faint ripples. Many Void God imprints were also fluctuating out as they headed towards the entire mountain range beneath.
The fireball star started descending slowly, causing the sect protection law of the entire mountain range to start vibrating and distort. “Pu”, “pa”, the array of the Green Peng Sect was far weaker than that of the Golden Eclipse Nation. It should only be able to resist against a level four Star Pagoda expert. Under the power of this Black Gourd fireball, even if the fireball released some force, it was able to crumble these arrays.
This made the experts of Green Peng Sect anxious.
Suddenly, the Black Gourd fireball stopped abruptly. One could see a white-robed teenager walking over. With a wave of his hand, the huge fireball rapidly turned small; it turned into a fireball the size of an egg. At this moment, it was revolving above the palm of this white-robed young man.
“Who is that?” The others felt terrified.
Xue Ying looked below.
His Plate Ripple Diagram enclosed the area beneath. Within moments, he had shackled all the experts from Green Peng Sect including the expert who seemed to low-profile and unremarkable, yet he was easily the strongest at the Star Pagoda fourth level strength. That yellow messy-haired old man was struggling as his expression changed, yet under the Plate Ripple Diagram, his struggles seemed taxing. He understood that even if he could barely move, he would only be able to display 20% of his strength. The other party could easily kill him.
After he unleashed the Plate Ripple Diagram to suppress and shackle everyone for a while, Xue Ying let them off.
When the experts of Green Peng Sect felt the disappearing of the terrifying shackles, they became shocked.
“Everyone, listen well.”
Xue Ying looked across the entire Green Peng Mountain Range beneath him, “From today on, I’ll be the Daoist Elder of Green Peng Sect. None of you should have any opposition to this right?”
His voice was resounding. It reverberated across the world and across all the ears of the disciples from Green Peng Sect.
All the disciples from Green Peng Sect were stunned.
Following that, they revealed an expression of ecstasy!
“Greetings, Daoist Elder.” Some disciples directly knelt.
Very soon.
Many disciples across the entire Green Peng Mountain Range were kneeling on the ground: “Greetings Daoist Elder.”
All the experts from Green Peng Sect were excited.
Xue Ying sighed inwardly after seeing this. If this were in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, there would likely be some disciples who would rather risk their lives and fight against this change. But in the region of governed by World Ancestor within Myriad Ancient Sacred World, the people here nakedly believed in strength! Furthermore, even though many cultivated in the Green Peng inheritance within the ‘Green Peng Sect’, more cultivated other ancient cultivation inheritances.
After all, ancient cultivation depended on innate skills, and not everyone was appropriate to cultivate the Green Peng inheritance.
Besides, this region was too chaotic, resulting in all the ancient cultivators to hug amongst themselves! In reality, the ‘Green Peng Sect’ was based on the green peng inheritors as the core group before a large number of other ancient cultivators were attracted over. The reason why they gathered was primarily because of survival!
If an ultra-strong expert arrived who was willing to become their Daoist Elder, they would even smile in their dreams.
Because this meant safety!
Safety… that was what countless cultivators desired in this region.
And was Xue Ying someone with malice? They did not care! Because Xue Ying had just displayed his technique previously, proving a point that he could easily destroy the entire Green Peng Sect with a single move. He could treat the sect however he wanted, or tease it however he wanted.
This was the reason why Xue Ying displayed his strength at the first moment when he arrived! Otherwise, why would the Green Peng Sect respect Xue Ying as their Daoist Elder so obediently?
…
Within the main palace of Green Peng Sect.
Xue Ying sat at the highest location of the hall. Even the sect master had to sit by his side. There were many other disciples located below.
“The array of Green Peng Sect is too weak.” Xue Ying coldly mentioned, “From today on, I’ll reconstruct the array and operate it. Gu Shang, Bei Zhou, I’ll impart the array to you so that both of you could control one part of the protection array.”
“Yes.”
Gu Shang was the sect master of Green Peng Sect. He had a third level Star Pagoda strength and had immediately acknowledged the orders given.
And the other was a yellow messy-haired old man who was called Bei Zhou. He was someone with a low-profile within the Green Peng Sect, and also the strongest expert within the sect. He had obediently acknowledged the orders at this moment too.
“If there is anyone who can break apart the array, immediately inform me about this situation.” Xue Ying ordered, “I will be in closed-door cultivation for most of the time, and will occasionally come out to have a walk. If nothing huge happens, don’t come and disturb me.”
Finishing his words, Xue Ying stood up and left.
The experts within the Green Peng Sect were slightly stunned…
In the following days…
Xue Ying was doing his best to construct the array. One array was something that ordinary disciple guards could sense-that was a monitoring array which was built using the profound mysteries from the Plate Ripple Diagram as the core. Another array was the Mirage array that would cause the enemies to fall into an illusory realm. The final array… was a slaughter array. It was created according to the Fifth Apocalyptic Sword.
If that array could not hold on, Xue Ying would personally appear!
“What is happening?”
“This Daoist Elder has such a weird temper?”
Gu Shang and Bei Zhou were standing outside a cavern-dwelling in befuddlement. Xue Ying would usually cultivate within this cavern-dwelling and forbade other disciples from disturbing him.
“Who cares.” Sect Master Gu Shang grinned, “This Daoist Elder seemed to have chosen our Green Peng Sect as his place of accommodation and did not care about the miscellaneous tasks. As long as nothing huge happens, we will not disturb him! With such an ultra-strong expert present, hahaha, the days in the future our Green Peng Sect will be much better. I am really looking forward to when those devils will come and offend our Green Peng Sect. I can even turn crazy by then using the slaughter array.”
He controlled the slaughter array out of the three great arrays. The moment it was activated, a sword light would descend. The power of this sword light was horrifying.
The eyes of the yellow-haired old man contained many circular pupils. He nodded too: “There are truly many weird experts. Our Green Peng Sect has gone lucky this time. You must instruct the others properly, asking the surrounding disciples to not offend the Daoist Elder.”
“That is natural.” Sect Master Gu Shang nodded. At the same time, he was thinking in his heart.
This expert was willing to become the Daoist Elder of Green Peng Sect, was it because of the inheritance marked on the Green Peng Mountain Range?
The Green Peng inheritance might be mysterious and was imprinted on the mountain range, and even if the mountain range were destroyed, it would appear once again from the ground. The inheritance would never be destroyed! In history, there had been several Primal Chaos realm giants who came over to observe and study this inheritance. But few became the Daoist Elder because of this reason. After all, with such horrifying power, none dared to obstruct Xue Ying if he wanted to look at the inheritance.

chapters.title: Chapter 883 - Chief Devil Cliff Commander
chapters.content:
Chapter 883: Chief Devil Cliff Commander
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The experts of the Green Peng Sect thought that this horrifying Daoist Elder was in closed-door cultivation but in reality…
Xue Ying had already left for his hometown secretly from the Green Peng Sect.
‘With the three arrays I’ve constructed, the Green Peng Sect should be able to remain fine. If there are any issues, I can rush back instantaneously.’ Xue Ying nodded inwardly, ‘That time I promised to do three things. I’ve accepted ‘Yun Peng’ as a disciple, and he is safe now. I am protecting the Green Peng Sect too. These are very simple tasks and can be completed by spending some time. The only slightly troublesome task is the third one…!’
‘The two commanders of Chief Devil Cliff.’ Xue Ying pondered.
Chief Devil Cliff.
That was a sect that did not have a weaker reputation than the Golden Eclipse Nation within Myriad Ancient Sacred World. The two commanders of Chief Devil Cliff were recorded explicitly in the intelligence reports of Great Void Heaven Temple-they were at the fifth level Star Pagoda strength.
Such strength meant the territory they usually cultivated at would be protected by many techniques; these places would be able to withstand against attacks from a Primal Chaos realm giant since they did not fear experts at the fifth level Star Pagoda strength when they worked together. This base was meant more for defending against experts and to survive and escape. Even though Xue Ying might be confident of himself, he was not certain that he could get rid of the two fifth level Star Pagoda experts when they were located in their territory. Xue Ying would only trap himself in the arrays constructed within the other party’s base, and even if the other party could not kill him, they could easily escape!
It would then be harder to find another opportunity to assassinate them after the first failure.
His arrays that were constructed in Green Peng Sect were quite strong already. For the sake of survival, the two commanders of Chief Devil Cliff would have invited Primal Chaos realm giants over to construct arrays to protect their base. But with the treasures they had, they should only be able to afford a set of static arrays that was of a lower standard.
‘Dynamic Arrays’ would be much more expensive than static arrays, and the difficulty of refining them was much higher.
Static arrays that could resist against sixth level Star Pagoda experts would usually cost around 300 Origin World Rocks, but arrays that could be brought around dynamically would likely cost 3,000 Origin World Rocks!
‘The transaction that time requires me to kill the two commanders of Chief Devil Cliff within a time period of 100 billion years. I have sufficient time. Only a fool would force his way into the base of the other party.’ Xue Ying already had made his plans.
Like previously when he met the opponent ‘Undying City Master’ within the Monarch Nine Cloud’s treasure cove.
It was fortunate that they met in the treasure cove, and Undying City Master could not escape. Otherwise, the other party could depend on his body division technique and directly tear through the void to flee in different directions… Xue Ying could only pursue after the enemy in a single direction without being able to kill him.
Naturally.
The current Xue Ying had reached the ‘My Heart as the World’ realm. He was stronger by an entire level as compared to when he was at the Monarch Nine Cloud treasure cove. Even if it were a desolate and vast space, he was confident of killing the two commanders from Chief Devil Cliff despite fighting against two by himself!
…
Xue Ying had set an alert via the ‘Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion’-when the two commanders of Chief Devil Cliff leave their base, they are to inform him.
Xue Ying was confident of killing the commanders if the other party did not have the terrain advantage of their base.
‘Hmph, the laws and profound mysteries expert will usually enter closed-door cultivation for more than 10 billion years every single time. As for hex cultivators, they would enter for an even longer period of up to 100 billion years when they enter closed-door cultivation for research… but the two commanders of Chief Devil Cliff love devouring and killing others. They do not have the patience to stay in a spot for too long.’ After Xue Ying understood the relevant intelligence, he knew that it was likely that the two commanders of Chief Devil Cliff would not stay in their base for too long before going out to devour and kill others.
Time passed year by year.
“Hu.”
The wind blew, and the flowers fell. The ground was filled with beautiful purple and brilliant red petals.
Xue Ying sat by the side of the tree. He was looking at a piece of petal as it floated down onto his legs. He could not help but look at the palace hall afar. That was where his wife entered closed-door cultivation. It had been a total of over seven million years yet his wife had yet to transcend.
‘Transcending either happens instantaneously, or the cultivator would get stuck for a long time.’
‘But my wife has consumed the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core and should be in the best state of cultivation. It is even more optimal than sudden enlightenment. Why would she not have broken through after such a long time?’ Xue Ying thought. He then casually gulped down another cup of wine. The restlessness in his heart once again regained its usual calm. With his cultivation heart… few things could make his inner heart restless.
But anything concerning the transcend of his wife would always make him emotionally chaotic.
“Elder Dong Bo, the two commanders of Chief Devil Cliff have set off. We are 90% sure that their destination should be the ‘Resistance Wind City’.” A report from the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion transmitted over.
The eyes of Xue Ying brightened. Even though prices of acquiring intelligence from Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion were high, their efficiency was excellent.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying took a step before arriving right where the distant starry sky was. With a distortion of the starry sky, he disappeared.
…
Myriad Ancient Sacred World, Resistance Wind City.
The Resistance Wind City was a slightly more peaceful city. Even though the Resistance Wind City Master was just at the fourth level Star Pagoda strength, he was well-known for his ability to survive, and had called himself ‘Resistance Wind’. The moment his body turned into wind… even fifth level Star Pagoda experts could not injure him at all.
Because he was quite hard to deal with, few came to offend the Resistance Wind City he created.
Within one of the courtyards located in the Resistance Wind City, Xue Ying was seated on a praying mat there with his eyes closed. He was comprehending.
‘They are finally here.’ Xue Ying suddenly opened his eyes and looked up into the sky, ‘I’ve been in the Resistance Wind City waiting for 30,000 years.’
The other party was relatively quick with their speed of travel.
Because the second commander from Chief Devil Cliff could tear through a spatial passage to travel.
“Hong!”
Very soon, a spatial vortex appeared, and two figures flew out from within.
One was in full black armor with a muscular body. The surface of his armor was rolling in a wicked black aura. His blood-colored eyes were staring below, causing an unseen pressure to form. Many cultivators directly dissolved from this aura, and even houses had disintegrated into powder.
Within a region of 500 kilometers beneath the black-armored figure, everything turned into nothingness. Outside this region, many beings had died too. He was the great commander of Chief Devil Cliff called ‘Black Chief Devil’. He was also the creator of Chief Devil Cliff. Other than his own infamy, 80% of the infamous reputation Chief Devil Cliff had was because of him.
The other was a figure who seemed unremarkable. He was the second commander ‘Monarch Qi Hu’. Monarch Qi hu’s figure was blurred as if he was a shadow within the world.
“Black Chief Devil, Monarch Qi Hu!”
At that point, ten figures flew out one after another from the City Master Mansion within Resistance Wind City. The one leading was a handsome violet-robed young man. He was Resistance Wind City Master. Currently, there was anger on his face which could not be concealed, “You started killing in my city? Why, are you planning to enter a war with me?”
He might be weak, but his survival capabilities and escaping techniques were formidable. He was not someone to offend easily!
“Hmph hmph hmph… ” Accompanying the sharp pitch of Monarch Qi Hu, “Resistance Wind, if it were during the regular occasions, my big brother and I would be too lazy to come over to your place. You are just a little ghost who would escape if you can’t win. And then you might even take revenge in madness. But now? Hmph hmph, my big brother and I are very patient to play with you. We give you two options now, one, hand over the ‘Stone Mirror’. Two, we kill you to get the Stone Mirror.”
Resistance Wind City Master’s expression had a slight change. He replied, “What Stone Mirror? Who did you all hear from? I do not know what this Stone Mirror is.”
He might be speaking on his mouth, in the dark, he had long activated the great array around the entire Resistance Wind City.
“Hong~”
Dazzling golden light rays started rushing into the sky from various places.
‘Devils from the Chief Devil Cliff have come. Everyone, escape.” The voice of Resistance Wind City Master sounded in every part of the city. But he had rapidly escaped soundlessly in the next moment like a wind. He did not hold any thoughts of miracles since the other party had even mentioned the words ‘Stone Mirror’, and they clearly knew he had this treasure.
This treasure was crucial to his ancient cultivation. How could he be willing to give it away?
As for the city, it was not worth one-ten-thousandth or the ‘Stone Mirror’ in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 884 - Accident
chapters.content:
Chapter 884: Accident
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Run!”
“Chief Devil Cliff?”
“Run, flee for your life…”
The entire Resistance Wind City had fallen into a panic. The two commanders from Chief Devil Cliff might be strong, but the law suppression of the five great sacred worlds was too great. Most experts could not discern what happened once the distance was far. But the voice transmission of the city master which was amplified by the array had spread across every single area of the city, informing every one of their plight.
The Chief Devil Cliff was too infamous.
Amongst the cultivators who were escaping, Xue Ying stood amidst the city bathed in a golden light just 5,000 kilometers away from the two commanders of Chief Devil Cliff on the street. His gaze landed on that ‘Black Chief Devil’. With a thought, the Dark World had descended from illusory and completely wrapped around that Black Chief Devil.
…
Black Chief Devil and Monarch Qi Hu did not place the other cultivators in this Resistance Wind City in their eyes. Their only target was Resistance Wind City Master.
“Escaping by penetrating through the void?” The array of the entire city was activated. The void shook, and aura became chaotic. Resistance Wind City Master took this opportunity to escape, though Monarch Qi Hu coldly laughed. He was a Unity realm expert who could tear through a spatial passage, and could easily reach the escaping city master! Furthermore, they had prepared several treasures just for the operation this time.
Previously as they were speaking, the two of them had already unleashed their treasures, placing an imprint on the body of Resistance Wind City Master!
No matter how Resistance Wind City Master escaped, the two of them would be able to find him.
“We must get the Stone Mirror.”
“Chase.”
As Black Chief Devil and Monarch Qi Hu were about to act.
Suddenly-
“Weng!”
The surroundings quietened down. The Dark World began appearing from illusion into reality, enveloping around Black Chief Devil! This dark world contained a total of 600 layers of membrane, and with so many layers stacked on top of one another, it had begun influencing the surrounding law. Black Chief Devil and Monarch Qi Hu both revealed a startled expression. Black Chief Devil’s pair of blood-colored eyes even showed slight hesitant.
“Peng~”
600 layers of Dark World exploded. Black Chief Devil had entirely borne the terrifying might of this attack.
“It’s him?” Monarch Qi Hu had long probed his surrounding. His vision landed on a white-robed teenager located on the street just 5,000 kilometers away. Xue Ying was also staring at Monarch Qi Hu, though a chuckle appeared on Xue Ying’s face: “I’ve long heard that the two commanders of Chief Devil Cliff are quite powerful and have killed countless of beings. Today, I’ve come to personally experience it and also to send the two of you to death!”
Following a ringing sound, more than half the body of Black Chief Devil was destroyed. His armor was also damaged. But at this moment, his body was rapidly reforming. It was his head that first reformed finish, and his blood-colored eyes stared at Xue Ying filled with lingering fear: “We are too careless, too careless! This attack should be able to kill me when it strikes a few times.”
‘Mn? He actually did not die?’ Xue Ying slightly frowned. For the sake of preventing the enemy from evading him, he did not display the Sky Punishment Edge. Instead, he unleashed the Many-Layered Dark World! Because the Many-Layered Dark World could directly wrap around the enemy after descending, and it was a technique that could not be evaded. As for the Sky Punishment Edge… its power was much stronger, and Xue Ying could utilize three Daos at the same time. But the Sky Punishment Edge could be parried and dodged against.
According to his own estimation, he should be able to kill Black Chief Devil in a single move using his Many-Layered Dark World.
But in reality, the other party’s defenses were stronger than he expected.
“Second Brother, team up!” Black Chief Devil was utterly indignant.
“Alright, kill!” Monarch Qi Hu’s eyes were filled with killing intent too. They were not in a rush to pursue after Resistance Wind City because there was an imprint on his body already. They could reach him even if they started chasing later. They had to eliminate this person in front first.
Many strands began flying out from the surface of Monarch Qi Hu. These translucent strands immediately wrapped around Xue Ying. As for Black Chief Devil, a great saber appeared in his hands before he rushed over in a fury! Since Black Chief Devil was able to survive the attack of 600 layers of Dark World, his close combat skill should be formidable too. With the domain of Monarch Qi Hu corresponding to him…
Most experts at the fifth level Star Pagoda strength could not survive.
“Hmph.”
The distant Xue Ying coldly snorted. The incoming strands met with a sudden obstruction. In terms of domain, Monarch Qi Hu’s belonged to the ancient cultivation system. As for Xue Ying, the “Plate Ripple Diagram” was one he personally cultivated and grasped. Under the competition of the two, the strength of Xue Ying’s Plate Ripple Diagram was one level higher.
Black Chief Devil was slightly startled: “How could this be?”
Usually, with the aid of the domain, the two could kill their way through all opponents. But now, his second brother’s domain was being suppressed?
“Hong hong hong~” Endless surging ripples obstructed those silk strands while at the same time, spread out to suppress Black Chief Devil, making it seem like he had entered quagmire.
“Black Chief Devil, it is still better for you to die.” Xue Ying coldly looked at the other party.
“Hua! Hua! Hua!”
Three huge illusory worlds dissipated before forming three dazzling blade edges. These three dazzling blade edges had descended into reality, causing a huge vortex to develop from the fluctuations of absorbing world energy. But at the moment when the blade edges were fully condensed, the surrounding abruptly turned silent. The energy ripples of the space had stopped entirely.
The suppression felt by Monarch Qi Hu on his silk strands became even stronger!
Sky Punishment Edge!
Three Sky Punishment Edges came down simultaneously from three different directions towards Black Chief Devil. The expression of Black Chief Devil completely shifted. Monarch Qi Hu who stood by the side felt his heart trembling too. The two could feel the threat each ‘Sky Punishment Edge’ brought. They understood that it would be hard to dodge this attack, and it was even harder to survive after being struck by it.
‘My body will definitely not be able to withstand this strike.’ Black Chief Devil understood this point. That was why he did not hesitate. He gritted his teeth and activated the protective treasure he had.
“Weng!”
One could see a faint white light covering his body.
“Hong hong hong.” Three Sky Punishment Edges began bombarding Black Chief Devil, though the white light on the surface of his body had merely fluctuated before regaining its usual calm. He stood completely uninjured in midair though Black Chief Devil did not have any joy on his face. His eyes were currently filled with unwillingness and indignance.
‘I’ve finally exposed my move.’ Black Chief Devil sighed inwardly.
‘What?’
Xue Ying who had been fully confident of himself as he stood on the street had a look of shock that could not be concealed at this moment. If the ‘Dark Bubble’ had an effect of restricting the other party, then the ‘Sky Punishment Edge’ was purely offensive. Its power was stronger by a few as compared to the Black Gourd fireball! A total of three Sky Punishment Edges… even if he had cultivated to the 40th level of Voidwalker system, he would still die despite relying on the Mirage to survive too.
But the other party had forcibly resisted against this attack?
Seeing the faint white light on the surface of the other party, a huge wave emerged in Xue Ying’s heart: ‘Protective treasure?’
He also had one!
It was because he was an Inner Hall Elder of Great Void Heaven Temple that the sect bestowed him with a protective talisman. This was personally refined by Forefather Tian Yu, and the moment it was activated, Xue Ying could withstand for a period even against Primal Chaos realm giants! This time sufficed for experts from Great Void Heaven Temple to arrive and save him, but such treasures were very precious. After all, its defensive strength was formidable, and if Xue Ying wanted to buy another, they would usually cost 2-3,000 Origin World Rocks!
But how could ordinary level five Star Pagoda experts afford it?
Thus, those who had such treasures would have a huge superpower backing them!
‘Black Chief Devil isn’t under the World Ancestor.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘On the surface, he did not seem to belong to any superpower.’
There were two possibilities.
Firstly, Black Chief Devil was lucky enough to get this protective treasure. Or that he spent a significant amount of Origin World Rocks to purchase it.
Secondly, Black Chief Devil belonged to a huge superpower in the dark! He had been bestowed this treasure. But for him to not reveal his identity, he should likely be from the two great religions.
Thus…
In the three great sacred worlds, the moment such experts were discovered, others would immediately dispatch experts to use secret techniques to investigate this matter! They would check their souls to see if any imprints existed. If none existed, then it was fine! But the moment they were discovered to be experts from the two great religions, most would kill without pardon!

chapters.title: Chapter 885: The Pleasant Surprise of Great Void Heaven Temple
chapters.content:
Chapter 885: The Pleasant Surprise of Great Void Heaven Temple
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying promised to kill the two commanders from Chief Devil Cliff because these two parties did not belong any superpowers according to the intelligence reports.
Under the holy ground sects…
Like Great Void Heaven Temple, Primogenitor Island, Jade Light Sacred Territory, Blade Emperor City…
Firstly, these holy grounds would bestow protective treasures to their disciples, making it impossible for Xue Ying to kill them instantaneously since the other party could always activate the protective treasures. During this short period of where the treasure was activated, the superpower would definitely dispatch experts over from an ultra-long distance! Xue Ying might even infuriate the superpower with his actions, resulting in final realm existences to personally kill their way over.
Secondly, if he really succeeded in killing those with a huge background, the other party would not let things go so easily!
Like previously when Xue Ying suffered from assassination, the Great Void Heaven Temple immediately went straight to investigating the matter. It was because of Myriad World Tavern Master’s strength that hindered the investigation, forcing the Great Void Heaven Temple to let the matter rest.
‘Even my Great Void Heaven Temple did not discover any superpower behind Black Chief Devil and his brother! They did not discover them having any protective treasures too.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Now, Black Chief Devil actually brought out a protective treasure. More importantly, he did not bring it out when he was facing me the first time as the 600 layers of Dark World descend. He had actually used his body to resist against it.’
Anybody who was not weak could easily see the horrifying might inherent within the 600 layers of Dark World.
But Black Chief Devil did not unleash his protective treasure during the first moment.
Why?
‘If the origin of the protective treasure is gotten honestly, why did he not use it the first time?’ Xue Ying thought, ‘For him to conceal his techniques, there is at least 80-90% chance that the other party is from one of the two religions.’
‘Who would have thought that I could meet such a huge fish this time!’ The eyes of Xue Ying brightened.
By the side, Monarch Qi Hu suddenly fell into a daze.
He was looking at Black Chief Devil who was covered in a layer of faint light with shock. This was his life and death brother, but he had never known that Black Chief Devil would have a protective treasure!
‘He has even concealed this from me? Furthermore, he would rather use his body to withstand against the attack during the first strike and not use the protective treasure? This time knowing that he will die if he doesn’t do anything, he thus decided to activate the protective treasure? Is he from the two great religions given how careful he is?’ Monarch Qi Hu felt his heart turning cold. Even though he was infamous outside, and was recognized as a huge devil within Myriad Ancient Sacred World…
He felt terrified about things involving the two great religions.
Because World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer did not care about them. World Ancestor might allow his subordinates to indulge in battle within his territory, but whenever followers of the two great religions were discovered, World Ancestor would not relent and let things off so easily.
The three great sacred worlds were absolutely united against the two great religions!
“Sou.”
Monarch Qi Hu no longer had the will to fight. He did not hesitate to escape, but this place was under the suppression of Plate Ripple Diagram, and Xue Ying discovered his movement at the first moment.
“Hu hu hu.” With a thought, Xue Ying sent another three Sky Punishment Edges. They came in different directions at Monarch Qi Hu.
“Hua~”
Monarch Qi Hu’s blurred figure that was like a shadow had suddenly transformed with a ‘hua’ into a rolling stream of water. “Hong, hong, hong.” The three Sky Punishment Edges cut through the rolling flow of water, yet the stream of water was able to escape easily despite being intercepted.
This scene made the pupils of Xue dilate: ‘Such formidable survival technique!’
He was too low-profile.
Of the two commanders from Chief Devil Cliff, the great commander was infamous, though the second commander was much more low-profile. Usually, the second commander would only display his domain techniques to support the great commander. Even though it was stated in the intelligence report that Monarch Qi Hu was stronger in surviving, but how much more formidable… was not exactly recorded. Because Monarch Qi Hu had not met someone on the level of Xue Ying before.
Hence, his survival abilities had never been displayed.
‘He could actually survive against the full brunt of my Sky Punishment Edge. This survival capability is stronger than mine.’ Xue Ying sighed. As a Voidwalker who specialized in ‘void-ifying’ his body, it was absolutely impossible for him to survive against three Sky Punishment Edges still!
“Hu.”
Monarch Qi Hu’s speed was great.
He flew further away before tearing out a spatial passage. Xue Ying watched from afar without acting to destroy the spatial passage because he knew the other party could still escape after that. Instead, Xue Ying chose to concentrate on ‘Black Chief Devil’.
‘With such formidable survival capabilities, it should be impossible for the two great religions to control this second commander right?’ Xue Ying guessed.
The stronger the cultivator, the stronger he would reject being under control of the two great religions.
After all, it was being controlled from their souls! The cultivator would lose their sense of self and become a loyal soldier of the two great religions. It was still quite easy for the Ancient Sacred Religion and Ancestor Mother Religion to control Black Chief Devil from the dark since his battling techniques were more direct. But with ‘Monarch Qi Hu’ and his domain, his survival and escaping capabilities being so strong, it was much harder trying to control him.
‘Besides, some experts under the World Ancestor will likely investigate Monarch Qi Hu.’ Xue Ying thought.
Even though he had many thoughts, everything happened in a flash.
Xue Ying cast his gaze on Black Chief Devil. Black Chief Devil was still struggling to escape, yet under the influence of the Plate Ripple Diagram, he was hurled out after tunneling into the void.
‘Protective treasure? Let’s see how long this treasure will last.’ Xue Ying coldly chuckled. The Sky Punishment Edges descended once again before bombarding on his body.
…
In the distant Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, within the Great Void Heaven Temple.
“Inquisitive Sky Hall Master, this is Dong Bo Xue Ying. I have discovered an expert in Myriad Ancient Sacred World called Black Chief Devil! I suspect he is a member of the two great religions.” Xue Ying transmitted over, “I am currently at Resistance Wind City.”
A silver-haired Inquisitive Sky Hall Master was seated on his throne.
His black eyes stared into the void. Despite being separated by a large distance, he was able to observe the battle happening in Myriad Ancient Sacred World, Resistance Wind City.
“You suspect he is a member of the two great religions because of his protective treasure? Is it possible that he found it incidentally, or purchased it himself?” Inquisitive sky Hall Master was carefully inspecting that Black Chief Devil. At the same time, he was able to check through the identity of Black Chief Devil through the inner intelligence reports of Great Void Heaven Temple. The other party was an expert at the fifth level Star Pagoda strength.
“In the past, he did not reveal himself, and I did not discover the existence of this protective treasure even in the reports of Great Void Heaven Temple. This is not ordinary already! Previously, he has even taken the risk to use his body and resist against my strike. I am over 80-90% certain that he is a member of the two great religions.” Xue Ying transmitted back his explanation.
Inquisitive Sky Hall Master was observing Black Chief Devil.
But closely following that, he discovered those Sky Punishment Edges which struck on him!
“This is?”
With the perception of Inquisitive Sky Hall Master, despite being isolated by a far distance, and that he was unable to feel the true power of the Sky Punishment Edges. But the technique could force Black Chief Devil to activate his protective treasure and to cause the surrounding space energy to fortify time after time. Inquisitive Sky Hall Master was able to deduce the conclusion easily, knowing that Xue Ying had cultivated the “Dark World”.
That was the second style of “Dark World” called ‘Sky Punishment Edge’!
Xue Ying had grasped the Sky Punishment Edge?
He was at the sixth level Star Pagoda strength?
Xue Ying had reached the sixth level Star Pagoda strength?
Inquisitive Sky Hall Master felt his heart booming. From how he sees, this was much more joyful than discovering a spy from the two great religions. After all, even though there were several formidable experts which were found by the Great Void Heaven Temple in history, and although some had fallen, some had reached the hall master position. But currently in this batch of Inner Hall Elders, all of them were at the fifth level Star Pagoda strength, and that was a regret of the Great Void Heaven Temple.
Yet now, there was someone of the sixth level Star Pagoda strength emerging?
‘That is the Sky Punishment Edge. No doubt about that. This level of power is unquestionable.’ Inquisitive Sky Hall Master’s eyes become brighter and brighter as he observed the battle from afar.

chapters.title: Chapter 886 - Threaten
chapters.content:
Chapter 886: Threaten
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Forefather, Elder Dong Bo has reached the sixth level Star Pagoda strength.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master immediately reported this matter upwards. Furthermore, he also reported the issue about intelligence on ‘Black Chief Devil’ being suspected of being a member of the two great religions to the side of World Ancestor. After all, the three great sacred worlds were quite united in their actions against anything concerning the two religions.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying?” Forefather Tian Yu was slightly startled.
“Right. He is currently at Myriad Ancient Sacred World…” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master described the whole matter in detail.
“Hahaha, that time he has grasped the Apocalyptic 2nd Sword at the True God Ruler realm, and I knew he would have a great future. Currently, he has obtained such an accomplishment. His comprehension talent on the Dao of Mirage is still one level higher than that on the Dao of Slaughter.” Forefather Tian Yu’s current mood was incredibly delightful. He created the Great Void Heaven Temple to groom the disciples under his sect.
Meeting a genius with sufficient talent would delight him greatly. For the other party to reach such strength at the Unity realm, he should be able to grasp the eighth level Star Pagoda strength in the future when he stepped into the Primal Chaos realm. He might even have hopes of reaching the ninth level strength too.
There was a massive gap between the Primal Chaos realm giants.
The weaker ones would merely be at the sixth level. Those with extremely deep foundations like Heaven Weeping Sect Master would be at the seventh level.
Experts like Inquisitive Sky Hall Master would reach the eighth level.
The eighth level… was also the limit ordinary Primal Chaos realm experts could reach. To reach the ninth level, the difficulty was as hard as reaching the ‘seventh level at the Unity realm’.
Within the Great Void Heaven Temple, there was only a single Primal Chaos expert who reached the ninth level-’Primal Chaos Hall Master’. He had even reached the final realm existence level in his offense. This was something some Cosmos Gods could not attain. If he were to deal with Heaven Weeping Sect Master, he would be able to kill the other party in a single second.
Different levels of Star Pagoda represented a gap where one at the higher level could slaughter the one at the lower level!
Naturally-
There was another Primal Chaos realm giant who transcended beyond normal means-Luo City Lord! The Star Pagoda was personally created by Luo City Lord. A large group of Cosmos Gods was suppressed by this Primal Chaos giant. Naturally, there were a few like Blade Emperor, Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor who could still overpower Luo City Lord.
“I wonder when this brat will reach the Primal Chaos realm.” Forefather Tian Yu’s incarnation appeared by the side. He was also watching the battle through the scene shown by Inquisitive Sky Hall Master.
“With his speed, I believe it will be soon.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master replied.
“It isn’t that easy either. It is originally difficult to break through in the realm. The difficulty of stepping into Primal Chaos realm is much harder than any previous bottlenecks.” Forefather Tian Yu said.
Those stronger Unity realm experts might reach the sixth level and get stuck there forever.
There were even those who eventually fell here!
One could see how difficult it was to step into the Primal Chaos realm.
But in the entire history of the two great sacred worlds, there were only two who reached the Unity realm seventh level, and both had broken through into the Primal Chaos realm. Clearly, to this level of genius, breaking through wasn’t difficult at all.
…
The people of the Great Void Heaven Temple was watching from afar. And those under the World ancestor who had gotten the news were also observing silently. They were not in a rush to act.
They were waiting…
To see if the two great religions would send anyone to save Black Chief Devil.
…
Above the sky of Resistance Wind City.
The cultivators who were originally escaping in a panic stopped. They were watching the battle from afar. A white-robed teenager was standing in midair, causing many blade edges to appear from the void to strike the body of Black Chief Devil who was currently wrapped in a faint light. The power, despite watching from afar, had made them tremble deep in their hearts. This was an instinctive tremble of life.
But Xue Ying was relying on the Plate Ripple Diagram to protect the Resistance Wind City beneath, and he did not let the shockwaves from the battle affect it.
At this moment, even though Black Chief Devil had a protective treasure with him, he could not escape.
‘I could not hold on any longer.’ Black Chief Devil could sense the energy of the protective treasure on him being consumed. There was a gradual look of freedom appearing on his face. Even though he understood that the Ancient Sacred Religion did not send any experts to save him, he did not resent. It was a huge glory for him to sacrifice for the Sacred Master.
“Sacred Master.”
The hands of Black Chief Devil formed a seal. He was mumbling out ‘Sacred Master’ on his mouth, and his expression contained purity and holiness. His body began taking the initiative to dissipate into nothingness.
Xue Ying watched this by the side. He waved his hand to collect the remnant treasure left by the other party: ‘So he is from the Ancient Sacred Religion. I wonder when was it that his soul had been controlled.’
******
Far away in the Ancient Sacred World.
There were also Primal Chaos realm ‘Saints’ watching this scene from afar. They did not send any experts over because they were clear that behind Xue Ying’s back, the Great Void Heaven Temple and World Ancestor would be focusing on this location. At this moment, sending experts over would mean death! After all, that was the territory of World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer.
Unless Sacred Master personally descended, otherwise, none from the Ancient Sacred Religion could save ‘Black Chief Devil’.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying of the Great Void Heaven Temple has reached the sixth level Star Pagoda strength. But it seems to be the technique from Dark World Master in the past. Its offense is truly great, but it is normal in other aspects.” These Saints from the Ancient Sacred Religion did not regard the current Xue Ying as a threat. They only felt that given his growth, the Great Void Heaven Temple might have another Primal Chaos giant.
This sort of matter was something the aloof and remote Sacred Master did not care.
But these Saints still paid notice to it.
“His growth is so fast?”
Within the palace under the lake, the green-robed Saint Wang Ming was seated cross-legged in a cultivation room. Surrounding him were many floating water droplets. There was a smile on his face, “Very good. This should let a few Saints within the religion feel the threat already right? Fifth level Star Pagoda Inner Hall Elders are very commonly seen and aren’t worth a mention. But reaching the sixth level… in the future, he would become the eighth level at the very least once he steps into the Primal Chaos realm, and will become a huge enemy of our Sacred Master!”
The Ancient Sacred World was the largest amongst the five great sacred worlds, and there were many Primal Chaos giants.
But there were naturally strong ones and weak ones amongst them. Saint Wang Ming was one of the weaker ones. In terms of strength, he was only at the sixth level Star Pagoda and compared to Xue Ying, there was a limit in how much stronger he was.
“It should be possible for me to find some old men to help scheme and eradicate this Dong Bo Xue Ying.” Saint Wang Ming had always been thinking of ways to deal against Xue Ying. His little brother was the most important person to him over the long period, but he had been killed by the enemy. How could he not take this revenge?
As a result, Saint Wang Ming began visiting various Saints within the Ancient Sacred Religion. He was finding ways to manipulate them. He had no choice since it was impossible for him to kill someone like Xue Ying by himself.
Because Xue Ying could activate his protective treasure the moment he suffered from an attack. He would then report upwards! Forefather Tian Yu might even come.
Thus, they had to have a good plan the moment they acted. Kill him in one fell swoop!
In history, how did some of the geniuses who reached the sixth level Star Pagoda die? Many had been schemed against by the two great religions!
…
“Hong long long~”
Outside Resistance Wind City, a figure appeared in the distorted sky. It was none other than the silver-haired black-skinned male ‘Inquisitive Sky Hall Master’. But it was merely an incarnation.
“Inquisitive Sky Hall Master.” Xue Ying spotted him from afar and flew over immediately, “Hall master, why did you come personally?”
“You’ve stirred up the world. The Ancient Sacred Religion might not have come to save Black Chief Devil, but they are definitely watching from afar. They should have also noticed your strength! Even though it is not certain that they will deal against you, my Great Void Heaven Temple has to do something and protect you still.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master said, “In history, there are some cultivators with great potential from our three great sacred worlds who were killed by Ancient Sacred Religion.”
Xue Ying felt his heart tightening.
Indeed, he had to be careful.
Even though he recognized his survival capabilities, there were a large number of Saints in the Ancient Sacred Religion. If they sent someone like Primal Chaos Hall Master, he could kill Xue Ying in a single move. Any protective treasures were useless!
The protective treasures could only resist against ordinary Primal Chaos giants, but using it to face someone on the level of Primal Chaos Hall Master was a total joke. After all, Cosmos Gods were only limited in how much stronger they were over Primal Chaos Hall Master.

chapters.title: Chapter 887 - Starting Ancient Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 887: Starting Ancient Cultivation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Inquisitive Sky Hall Master directly threw a storage wristband over. He transmitted: “This is what Forefather asked me to send over. It is good for you to roam around the Myriad Ancient Sacred World since Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor are both here, making this a relatively safe place. It is fine as long as you remain wary of possible plots happening… the treasures that Forefather asked me to send over are meant for you to protect yourself. You can temper yourself properly here.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying did not reject. He received the treasures.
“Oh right, the subordinates under World Ancestor also transmitted over a piece of news. They have investigated the other commander of Chief Devil Cliff, ‘Monarch Qi Hu’, confirming that he isn’t part of the two religions. After interrogating him, nothing seems to be wrong.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master said.
“What happened after the interrogation? Did they kill him? Or let him off?” Xue Ying hurriedly asked.
“They let him off.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master chuckled, “Why, do you think Monarch Qi Hu should be killed because he slaughtered others? It’s a pity that this is the territory of World Ancestor, and it is common for cultivators to devour and slaughter. They naturally let Monarch Qi Hu off after finding nothing wrong with him.”
Xue Ying frowned inwardly.
If Monarch Qi Hu were killed, then his promises on the transaction would have been considered complete. But it’s a pity that he was let off… Xue Ying would have to find another opportune moment to deal against Monarch Qi Hu! With his strength, it wasn’t an easy task for Xue Ying to kill the other party.
…
Of the three matters regarding the transaction, there was only the task of killing Monarch Qi Hu left, though the target is currently hiding in the Chief Devil Cliff. He would likely hide for the near future after experiencing such a traumatic battle.
Xue Ying instead spent his time roaming around the Myriad Ancient Sacred World. He was not in a rush to hurry back to his hometown cosmos as there was no point for Xue Ying to wait at home foolishly while his wife was in closed-door cultivation. Xue Ying decided to initiate his path to ancient cultivation. With his current strength, it would create a considerable disturbance when he trained.
His hometown cosmos was ultimately too fragile, and if Xue Ying were not careful, he might cause the cosmos epoch to end.
Thus, it was vital for Xue Ying to train outside the cosmos.
‘Ancient cultivation.’
Xue Ying pondered.
This was the oldest cultivation system. During the primitive Ancient Sacred World era, when the weak beings wanted to become stronger, they would usually make use of the World Energy present in the primitive Ancient Sacred World to nourish their bodies, gradually taking on the great Dao of the ancient cultivation! Eventually, more and more outstanding cultivators started creating other systems, spreading them in public. These included systems such as the bloodline cultivation system, the Ancient Mother cultivation system, the hex cultivation system, the strongest warrior cultivation system…
But none could hide how breathtaking ancient cultivation was.
Ultra-long distance teleportation!
Observing any location within the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void!
Being able to perform avatar techniques after becoming a Void God!
Prophecy!
Body transformation!
Changing the past!
Reincarnating!
…
All kinds of unfathomable techniques could be accomplished using ancient cultivation but not for other cultivation systems! As a result, many powerful experts would cultivate in ancient cultivation too, though ‘talent’ was critical in this system. Without a good talent, it was limited as to where the cultivator could reach in the future. If Xue Ying were lucky and obtained a powerful innate skill, he would naturally place an effort to cultivate it.
‘It all starts when I was a Transcendent as I awakened my talent.’ Xue Ying constructed an alert array deep within the mountains. The array composed of the Mirage, Plate Ripple Diagram, and the profound mysteries of the void. Those Primal Chaos giants who were stronger than Xue Ying might not reach his degree of comprehension in the Dao of Ripple and Mirage. In terms of the void, Xue Ying was able to teleport through an ultra-long distance. As a result, Xue Ying was able to construct an alert array that permeated deep within the core composition of the void. It was tough for anyone to get through the array without tripping it.
He then began attempting the cultivation.
Those who were weaker would have an easier time taking the first step of ancient cultivation.
Xue Ying’s current strength was too great. His soul and body were powerful too, so it was instead harder for him to awaken his talent.
“Hong!”
Xue Ying sat cross-legged. Suddenly, a vast World Energy began streaming into his body. He relaxed his entire self-even his soul was completely relaxed. He was allowing the World Energy fuse into his body under the ‘Soul Initiation Technique’.
The Soul Initiation Technique was also known as the ‘Awakening Technique’, or ‘Creation Technique’. It was the most mature version after the earliest predecessors of ancient cultivation perfected this technique through countless failures. Under the guidance of this Soul Initiation technique, only then could the cultivator dig out the potential of the body and of the soul, eventually awakening the strongest innate skill one had!
Naturally, it was possible for one to awaken multiple innate skills too.
Nonetheless, it did not mean that the more skills one had, the stronger he would be. More importantly, it depended on how far one could walk in the Dao of his innate skill.
Without any frustration… without any worry…
A piece of emptiness…
Xue Ying could no longer feel his body. His soul was incomparably relaxed at this moment. The distance of his perception region was continuously expanding. He was able to perceive an old forest deep within the mountain, and also the vast grassland outside the deep mountains. The perception of his soul was continuously spreading out in all directions… and currently, it had reached a region that far outstripped the distance he could achieve with any of his secret techniques.
Even using the Plate Ripple Diagram would not allow him to reach one-ten-thousandth the current region.
But using the Soul Initiation technique meant completely immersing oneself into digging the potential of his soul. At this moment, it was akin to the soul fusing as one with the world. Only then could the cultivator perceive an incomparably colossal region. Nevertheless, this was not appropriate to use during battles.
“Hua.”
It was like a desolate desert. Suddenly, spring water began gushing out.
It was also similar to having an oil lamp lighting up in an endless expanse of darkness.
The potential hidden within Xue Ying’s body and soul were dug out, forming a complete talent.
“Hu~”
Within the wooden house deep in the mountains, Xue Ying who was seated there for more than 10,000 years, suddenly began emanating a dull red aura. It spread out in all directions. This aura brought along a strong, enticing energy. The weaker ones would just fall into an illusory realm unknowingly the moment they smelled this.
Xue Ying slowly opened his eyes.
‘I’ve awakened.’ Xue Ying immediately inspected his soul and body to see if there were any transformations. He felt shocked the next moment: ‘Nightmare technique?’
There were very few changes that happened to his soul and body. The aura that his body emitted was filled with an enticing energy. The aura his soul released could even guide others into an illusory realm!
There were no direct combat capabilities. This was purely an illusory realm technique.
‘Haha.’ Xue Ying could not help but shake his head and laugh, ‘It seems that I am indeed talented in this aspect of the Mirage. Even after entering ancient cultivation, the talent I awakened, in the end, is also of this sort.’
‘Mn, how should I cultivate next?’
Xue Ying pondered.
Once he had ascertained his talent, the next step would be to think of which path he should take. There were many possible paths, and the better he cultivated his talent, the stronger he would be.
‘This talent specializes in controlling illusory realm. As a result, my soul will be stronger than those at the same level.’ Xue Ying nodded inwardly, ‘Then I shall choose the ‘Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance’.’
Vermillion Nightmare was the name of a mutated beast.
It was a mutated beast that specialized in controlling the illusory realm. The Vermillion Nightmare inheritance had been discovered by Xue Ying from the countless books left behind by Monarch Nine Cloud. Even though it was considered middle-grade amongst the other inheritances, it was the most appropriate for him. This inheritance could be cultivated until the Primal Chaos realm! As for the higher realm, ‘Cosmos God’? How many Cosmos Gods were there since the primitive Ancient Sacred World era until now?
And how many had cultivated in ancient cultivation? Few of the ancient cultivation inheritances could directly be trained to the Cosmos God realm. He only knew of three of them, and none were appropriate for himself.
‘There are many Cosmos Gods who actually started their own Dao path. Like Ancestor Sorcerer and Ancestor Cang. Even though the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance is a Primal Chaos realm inheritance, I can similarly initiate my own Dao in the future and bring it to the Cosmos God level.’ Xue Ying thought.
He was still quite satisfied with this inheritance.
It was the most appropriate for him, and the most helpful one out of all.

chapters.title: Chapter 888 - Transcend, eternity
chapters.content:
Chapter 888: Transcend, eternity
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Vermillion Nightmare was a mutated beast from the primitive Ancient Sacred World. It was fiery red in color and had the shape of a bird. It ruled the void. With every flap of its wings, it would release an aura that could easily cause those weaker ones to sink into endless dreams. Every time it rested at a particular location, all beings inside a vast region around it would enter the illusory realm. If it were in a good mood, those who fell into the illusory realm would be let out. But those who were unfortunate might have their souls trapped in endless illusory realms without being able to get out of it.
‘This inheritance releases an illusory realm that affects a huge region.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘And similarly, this is also the inheritance that has the greatest nourishment to my soul.’
One’s soul must be strong enough for the illusory realm to affect a considerable region!
Xue Ying did not pursue after the degree of the mysteriousness of the illusory realm, and neither did he seek after the augmentation it would bring to his physical body. He was only chasing after a single aspect-to make his soul as strong as possible! The stronger his soul, the more helpful it would be to his cultivation. For instance, Xue Ying could unleash three Sky Punishment Edges currently during battles. If his soul were stronger, he might be able to send more Sky Punishment Edges at the enemies. This would drastically improve his strength.
The weaker ones would seek to improve ‘observable’ combat strength.
Xue Ying was more mindful of how much support this inheritance could bring to him holistically.
…
In the following periods, Xue Ying began collecting some helpful resources using the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion. They were resources required for Xue Ying to cultivate the ‘Vermillion Nightmare inheritance’ to the Unity realm. He spent a total of 900 Origin World Rocks. It was no wonder ancient cultivators paid huge importance on resources since they without sufficient resources, it was impossible for them to break through despite comprehending the technique.
Within the rear mountain of the Green Peng Sect inside the cultivation room of the Daoist Elder’s cavern-dwelling.
Xue Ying was currently cultivating here. It was not appropriate for him to cultivate in his hometown cosmos. Furthermore, if he were to cultivate next to his wife, he would be distracted and overly concerned for her. Why not just remain in the Myriad Ancient Sacred World and wait for news from his wife? His wife had a communication treasure with her that could be used to transmit messages to him-Xue Ying had killed quite a few experts, so he had collected many communication treasures.
A red aura covered the surface of Xue Ying’s body.
There was currently a bird that was covered entirely in fiery red feathers appearing faintly behind him. It was presently spreading its wings. This was none other than the totemic image of the ‘Vermillion Nightmare’.
‘I’ve reached the True God Ruler level in my ancient cultivation.’ Xue Ying opened his eyes in delight. The bird with fiery red feathers behind him fused swiftly into his body, ‘My cultivation speed is quite good-I was able to reach True God Ruler in ten years. Things will only be more troublesome from now on.’
The Vermillion Nightmare inheritance might still be at a low level…
But Xue Ying could feel his soul strengthening by 10%. He believed that cultivating in this technique from now on would result in a more visible improvement of his soul.
“Chi chi chi~” Xue Ying relaxed his right hand. A large amount of powder fell from his right hand: ‘This is really nourishing my body by consuming rare materials from the world.’
Why would the talents of ancient cultivation become so heaven-shaking as one cultivated further? It was due to the absorption of the precious and rare materials from the outside world.
“Xue Ying, when are you coming back?” Suddenly, a voice message came from the communication talisman.
Xue Ying abruptly quivered: “I’ll come back right at this instance!”
…
In his hometown cosmos, within the Black Fog Sea, Monarch Dong Bo residence.
In the palace hall.
Jing Qiu who was garbed in a dark-blue robe stood up. Even though multiple comprehensions towards the Dao were still appearing with every single thought, she no longer had the mood to continue cultivating. The current Jing Qiu was able to see the most fundamental operating law of the world. She understood what this meant.
‘I can transcend now.’ Jing Qiu understood this point.
Transcending?
That was too difficult.
Her father Monarch Mo Xue eventually failed and died. For herself, Jing Qiu had experienced a reincarnation before. With the help of her husband, Xue Ying, she was still previously stuck at a bottleneck. In the end, it was because her husband weathered all sorts of danger by entering the primal chaos void to procure extremely precious materials for her that she was able to finally break through. Just as her husband had mentioned, she could cultivate for 300 million years in total under this miraculous state.
Eventually, Jing Qiu had broken through in just eight million years.
“Transcend, eternity.” Jing Qiu walked to the front of the hall doors. The hall doors automatically opened by itself.
Jing Qiu looked at the entire monarch residence. She observed the grass before taking out the communication talisman and transmitted: “Xue Ying, when are you coming back?”
It was almost a blink of an eye when the distant starry sky distorted and a figure appeared out of it. It was Xue Ying.
“Jing Qiu.” Xue Ying hurriedly walked out. She carefully looked at his wife.
“I’ve finally grasped the law of the world.” Jing Qiu merely said a single sentence before softly embracing Xue Ying. Her head lay on his chest.
She felt herself trembling from her current emotion.
She could not feel calm.
All sorts of emotions began swelling within her… transcending eternity. That was what all cultivators sought because it represented their life! Even Cosmos Gods had sought ways to find treasures that would allow their loved ones and close friends to transcend. Such treasures were usually priceless and were more precious than the life of Primal Chaos giants.
“Father.” Jing Qiu muttered.
She cultivated so many times only to face despair all the time.
It was the same as her father. But now, she had finally achieved it, yet her father was no longer around.
Time passed…
The distant Qing Yao and Dong Bo Yu saw the scene of their parents nestled against each other and did not come disturbing them.
Only after a long period did Jing Qiu recover her state of mind. She let go of Xue Ying.
“Still feeling alright?” Xue Ying chuckled as he looked at his wife. At this moment, he felt the color of the world around him becoming more vibrant. Even the starry sky became beautiful.
“Mn.” Jing Qiu answered, “I haven’t jump out from the River of Time.”
Saying that, she looked to the side.
“Weng!”
A vast River of Time appeared in the air in front hidden beneath the ordinary world. There were many living beings currently within the River of Time, and even more situated deep within.
Currently, there was a huge female figure amidst the many beings. This was also the most significant being within this section of the River of Time. That was none other than Jing Qiu with an exact same appearance.
“Come out.” Jing Qiu thought.
Under the aid of the law of the world, that colossal woman figure flew out. Even though the river water from the River of Time tried pulling her back, it was unable to hold her at all. With a splash, that figure, Jing Qiu, flew out of it and fused into Jing Qiu’s actual body.
From now on, she had genuinely transcended beyond the River of Time. It could no longer restrict her. She had transcended and attained eternity.
Xue Ying looked from the side at this scene. There was a grin appearing on his face without him knowing it. This was the scene he had always dreamt of. During the time when his parents, little brother, Uncle Zong and Uncle Tong left the world, he understood that he could not tolerate the scene of his wife and children leaving him forever. What was the meaning of living if that happened? Life was too lonely. His daughter Qing Yao had long transcended. And he had already entered the primal chaos void by then.
But his luck was good. Xue Ying did not lose his life in the primal chaos void. He was able to even reach Great Void Heaven Temple at an early period, cultivating all the way until now, thus allowing him to achieve what he had currently.
At this moment.
Xue Ying felt much more satisfied than ever becoming a Cosmos God. Because no matter what, he would have his true love accompanying him in the future.
“Xue Ying, I haven’t asked you before, but what is the value of that Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core which I ate?” Jing Qiu turned around and asked. She was quite sure that the price was extraordinary. But now that she had transcended, she wanted to ask him about it.
“You make a guess.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“It must definitely be exorbitant.”
“Not more than what you are to me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 889 - Vermillion Nightmare Eight Transformations
chapters.content:
Chapter 889: Vermillion Nightmare Eight Transformations
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
In the blink of an eye, it had been 300,000 years since Jing Qiu transcended.
Myriad Ancient Sacred World, within the rear mountain of Green Peng Sect inside the cavern-dwelling cultivation room of Daoist Elder.
There was an incense lighted. The fragrance pervaded within the cultivation room. Xue Ying sat cross-legged on a praying mat in his white robe. He was currently cultivating the ancient cultivation ‘Vermillion Nightmare inheritance’. A fiery red bird illusion bore out from Xue Ying’s body before spreading its wings apart. The fiery red aura spread out in all directions, and there was an indistinct world appearing amidst this aura.
Suddenly, a resounding cry sounded within the cultivation room. It had even transmitted out of the room, easily reaching out to the entire Green Peng Sect. All the cultivators within Green Peng Sect felt their souls fluctuating slightly before turning back to normal.
“What is happening?”
“It seems like it came from the cavern-dwelling of the Daoist Elder.” Some of the Unity realm experts in the Green Peng Sect could barely determine it. But they merely watched from afar and discussed amongst themselves. They dared not disturb that mysterious Daoist Elder.
And within this cultivation room, accompanied by the first cry from this Vermillion Nightmare illusion, the Vermillion Nightmare illusion became more corporeal. Xue Ying opened his eyes too. The eyes of the Vermillion Nightmare behind him had an almost exact same spirit as the eyes of Xue Ying.
‘Vermillion Nightmare Eight Transformations. I’ve finally reached the fourth transformation, attaining the Unity realm.’ Xue Ying revealed a grin.
Even though it was because his current realm was profound, this horrifying speed of cultivation sufficed to make others dumbstruck should it be leaked.
Xue Ying was clear though that this was all because of his great talent in the Dao of Mirage. Even though the ‘Nightmare Vermillion’ pertained to many different profound mysteries of the illusory realm and were slightly more unique, Xue Ying could easily comprehend them after slightly pondering over it. If a Primal Chaos giant who studied the ‘Dao of Mirage’ cultivated the Voidwalker lineage, his speed of cultivation would similarly be very fast too.
‘Unity realm.’
‘I’ve reached this stage. It could be said that I have fully condensed out the complete Vermillion NIghtmare.’ Xue Ying pondered, ‘After that is the fifth transformation and the sixth transformation… these are meant to dig out all the potential of the Vermillion Nightmare. And beyond that will be the Primal Chaos realm!’
Vermillion Nightmare inheritance.
It was elementary in the first few stages, and what came in the later stages included the “Vermillion Nightmare Eight Transformations”.
The first transformation would be stepping into the Void God realm!
The first three transformations… belonged to the Origin Birth realm.
The middle three transformations… belonged to the Unity realm.
And the seventh and eighth transformations belonged to the Primal Chaos realm.
When one cultivated to the limit, according to the illustration of the inheritance, the cultivator would be considered an expert even amongst Primal Chaos giants. But Xue Ying was still a distance away from the limit. The unknown creator of the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance seemed to have tried creating the ninth transformation too but to no avail.
‘Vermillion Nightmare Eight Transformations. The first six transformations aim dig out all potential of the ‘Vermillion Nightmare’. As for the seventh transformation… it is altering the Vermillion Nightmare from its core, allowing the Vermillion Nightmare to transform.’ Xue Ying revealed a grin, ‘Very good. That is what I am looking forward to.’
A core qualitative transformation.
That was actually altering the composition of the Vermillion Nightmare. The Vermillion Nightmare was strong in two aspects. One was that its natural aura could cause others to unknowingly lose themselves. The other aspect was the natural illusory realm that it contained. Xue Ying was not too satisfied with the illusory realm structure inherent within. He himself was an expert that reached the sixth level Star Pagoda in terms of the Dao of Mirage.
When the potential of this ‘Vermillion Nightmare’ was dug to its limit, it would only reach the fifth level Star Pagoda strength. This was also due to its aura. To an expert like Xue Ying, he could definitely improve the structure of its illusory realm!
As he altered it…
The Vermillion Nightmare would transform accordingly. Once a qualitative transformation happened, it would have stepped into the Primal Chaos realm! Xue Ying’s attainments in the Dao of Mirage had actually touched on the boundaries of the Primal Chaos realm. He vaguely understood what it means to be one.
‘But the ancient cultivation is indeed mysterious.’ Xue Ying praised.
He was merely altering the core illusory realm within the Vermillion Nightmare. As for other structures, they remained unchanged.
