These were naturally formed when he cultivated the ancient cultivation. The most special part about ancient cultivation… was that it would improve according to his talent. It was unlike the hex cultivation or the laws and profound mysteries system where one could just ponder and comprehend all the way. Because many aspects about ancient cultivation could not be pondered upon.
Like Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and the others, they were able to teleport through an ultra-long distance. They could even scout through a vast distance. The laws and profound mysteries inherent within was something they were unable to understand.
One might be able to alter small sections of the technique, but he could not research on it.
It was the same with Xue Ying. He was only altering the illusory world. As for the fundamental appearance structure of the Vermillion Nightmare, and the aura that it emitted… these were natural ocurring. Because the illusory realm it emitted was vast enough, it would be very beneficial to his soul when Xue Ying cultivated this inheritance. That was the main reason he chose this inheritance.
‘My current soul strength is stronger by 60% than without the ancient cultivation.’ Xue Ying was startled.
His soul became stronger.
Thus, he was able to unleash more Sky Punishment Edges. At this moment, he was able to unleash five of them!
‘Haha, all the precious treasures required have been prepared. There should not be any bottleneck for me to cultivate to the sixth transformation.’ Xue Ying was looking forward to that day because his soul would become much stronger than now. And furthermore, at that moment, he was able to transform the illusory realm world construct within the Vermillion Nightmare. Because he had absolutely dug out all potential of the Vermillion Nightmare, and thus, he would be able to transform the core illusory realm world structure.
‘Time to go back.’
Xue Ying stood up. The void in front warped directly, and Xue Ying took a step and entered.
…
When he appeared, Xue Ying was already at the Black Fog Sea Monarch residence.
He had deliberately marked down the spatial coordinates of the Daoist Elder cavern-dwelling in Green Peng Sect, so he could directly teleport over! With how strong he was, his cultivation and training would usually harm and create a huge pressure on the cosmos. That was why it would be better to proceed with his training outside in the sacred world! As for when he was comprehending, he could do it back in his hometown cosmos.
“Father.” Dong Bo Yu who was currently cultivating looked up. He saw Xue Ying who stood in midair.
“Properly cultivate. Your mother has already opened her Dao path.” Xue Ying chuckled.
Even after Jing Qiu transcended, the energy from the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core could still be maintained for more than 100 million years. She had already opened the ‘Dao of Time-Space’ just 100,000 years after she transcended. As she was cultivating under a state of ultra-comprehension, it was not unexpected for his wife to open her dao. But Xue Ying thought his wife would open a Dao related to frost… and not that of the Dao of Time-Space!
******
The days of Xue Ying were spent in a carefree manner. He was cultivating and comprehending as and when he wanted. He remained patient and not arrogant on his cultivation. When he had some attainments, he would proceed to the Myriad Ancient Sacred World Green Peng Sect to test out his techniques, or to break through in his ancient cultivation. He would occasionally spend some time accompanying his wife who left closed-door cultivation, and also guided his children and disciples. He would even give public lectures on Daos where Rulers and Paragons would attend.
With how carefree he was, Xue Ying was also spending his time observing the conflict and battles happening within the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void.
Even though he wanted to remain carefree, several experts in the dark did not wish for him to remain so.
…
In the Ancient Sacred World.
Within a dark palace hall, Saint Wang Ming stood there in his purple robe. The lakewater further away gradually condensed into a figure.
“Wang Ming, what’s the matter?” This figure formed from water contained silver light flowing on his body. He emitted an unseen pressure. Even though it was an incarnation, Saint Wang Ming felt the threat from him. This was an expert at the ‘limit of Primal Chaos realm’. During the era of primitive Ancient Sacred World, the description of the strength of Primal Chaos giants was slightly blurred. The peak Primal Chaos realm… was an extremely horrifying level. It meant that the cultivator had reached the final realm in certain aspects. This was also the ninth level Star Pagoda strength.
The Star Pagoda level divided the strength of cultivators very accurately. It was considered a universe standard now.
“Master Jia Ming.” Saint Wang Ming was being extremely polite, “I wish to know the current location of the Inner Hall Elder ‘Dong Bo Xue Ying’ of Great Void Heaven Temple. I do hope to seek the help of Master Jia Ming. This is 100 Origin World Rocks.”
Saying that, he obediently handed over the Origin World Rocks!
In the entire Ancient Sacred World, other than the Sacred Master who stood high above everyone, Master Jia Ming was ranked second in terms of his ability to seek traces of a cultivator! This was an extremely horrifying expert, and he could even see the ‘future’. Naturally, it was limited in how far he could see!
“I can try.”
Master Jia Ming lightly nodded.
“Weng.”
The entire pitch black palace hall contained an unseen distorted energy. Saint Wang Ming obediently watched on. He knew this was the true body of Master Jia Ming unleashing his secret technique. This was the location where Master Jia Ming cultivated, albeit he would usually only send his incarnations to appear.
“Hua~” There was a blurred scene gradually appearing in midair. It showed the scene of a huge residence.
Suddenly-
This blurred figure turned into a hunchbacked old man.
The hunchbacked old man coldly stared back: “Hmph, indeed as I expected. You fools from the Ancient Sacred World still dare to think of scheming against an elder of my Great Void Heaven Temple. Fortunately, I have made my preparations.”
“Peng.”
The scene suddenly shattered and dissipated.
The water figure which contained silver light flowing amidst the river had a strand of cold intent in his eyes. He growled: “Tian Yu!”

chapters.title: Chapter 890 - Satisfied Days
chapters.content:
Chapter 890: Satisfied Days
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
When comparing techniques of searching for traces of a person within the Ancient Sacred Religion, Master Jia Ming was second only to the Sacred Master! By specializing in a single aspect, one would become proficient in it. In terms of searching for traces, more than half the Cosmos Gods in the world could not compare with this ninth level Star Pagoda expert, ‘Master Jia Ming’! But the leading character of the current laws and profound mysteries system ‘Forefather Tian Yu’ was not included within.
The leader of the hex cultivation, ‘Ancestor Sorcerer’ was well-known for having many methods like arrays, refinements, and using poison… he was ranked first in many of these aspects even amongst Cosmos Gods.
Forefather Tian Yu might not be as good as Ancestor Sorcerer, but he was still the current leader of the current laws and profound mysteries system. He had reached great attainments with regards to refinements, arrays and other aspects too. Things like searching for traces were what Forefather Tian Yu could easily obstruct the other party from.
“Master Jia Ming?” Saint Wang Ming could not help but lightly asked. A Cosmos God had just appeared, making him feel a huge pressure. The current Saint Wang Ming ranked at the bottom of all the Primal Chaos giants.
“Hmph, Tian Yu this old man is just at the third level of Cosmos God. He can’t break through at all. Instead, he has dabbled into many other miscellaneous techniques.” Master Jia Ming’s water incarnation said in a cold voice, “He was prepared to prevent others from finding traces of Dong Bo Xue Ying by giving a treasure to him. Furthermore, Dong Bo Xue Ying should be bringing this treasure with him all the while! As such, I was easily discovered by Forefather Tian Yu when I use my secret technique.”
“What should we do now?” Saint Wang Ming said, “What should I do to find the location of Dong Bo Xue Ying?”
“You want to find his location? If you are daring enough, you can find the Sacred Master and ask him for help.” Master Jia Ming glanced at him.
Saint Wang Ming immediately revealed an embarrassed look.
Sacred Master?
Even though he was loyal to him from deep in his heart, he felt reverence at the same time.
The Sacred Master was someone so high up, and he hated subordinates disturbing him! Just a small brat at the Unity realm… and he was to seek the Sacred Master for this matter? Saint Wang Ming felt fearful the moment he thought about it. He dared not imagine how Sacred Master would react.
“How would I dare to trouble the Sacred Master for such a small issue?” Saint Wang Ming replied.
“Then you have no other ways.” Master Jia Ming indifferently answered.
The Ancient Sacred Religion had many enemies. The other superpower would not help the Ancient Sacred Religion seek for traces of Xue Ying!
Even the other religion, the’ Ancestor Mother Religion’, did not get along well with Ancient Sacred Religion despite how the three great sacred worlds were united and filled with killing intent towards the two great religions. The Ancestor Mother was also hoping for the Sacred Master to die!
Even if they decided to conceal their identities, and spent a huge amount of Origin World Rocks to seek the help of ‘Ancestor Sorcerer’ or ‘Jade Light Master’ for help in search of traces of Xue Ying, the moment they discovered Forefather Tian Yu hiding Xue Ying’s whereabouts, they would also respect his decision.
“Actually, this Dong Bo Xue Ying is only a Unity realm expert. Why do you care that much?” Master Jia Ming indifferently responded, “It isn’t easy to enter the Primal Chaos realm from the Unity realm. Even if he breaks through, he would only be at the eighth level Star Pagoda strength in the future.”
Master Jia Ming was one of the few ninth level Star Pagoda experts.
Naturally, he was qualified to belittle others.
“His cultivation speed is extremely fast. We can’t look down on him. If he were to reach the Primal Chaos realm, he would be at the very least, an eighth level Star Pagoda expert. He might even be stronger. In the future, he would become a huge enemy of many Saints in our Ancient Sacred Religion! After all, of the many Saints… there are few who can reach up to where Master Jia Ming is at.” Saint Wang Ming said.
“Mn.”
Master Jia Ming nonchalantly replied, “Alright. Let me remind you all. Even if that Forefather Tian Yu is prepared, especially when he had discovered me unleashing my secret technique this time… that Dong Bo Xue Ying will become more careful! It is unlikely for your plans to be realized. I think you should change your initial plans.”
“We understand.” Saint Wang Ming nodded.
“Go.” Master Jia Ming indifferently ordered.
Along that, his water-condensed figure dissipated. The water flow fell back into the lake.
Saint Wang Ming respectfully bowed before retreating. He felt relatively unreconciled since he had spent Origin World Rocks to ask Master Jia Ming for help… and it failed in the end. Even though the secret technique failed, the Origin World Rocks would still be kept by Master Jia Ming!
******
Hometown Cosmos, within the Black Fog Sea Monarch Residence.
Xue Ying sat high up watching the group of disciples sparring with one another. Suddenly, his communication talisman received a message. It was sent by Forefather Tian Yu.
He read the message.
‘Ancient Sacred Religion?’ Xue Ying muttered inwardly, ‘There are actually searching for my traces? Fortunately, that day when I was dealing against the great commander of the Chief Devil Cliff, Inquisitive Sky Hall Master had personally sent me some protective treasures.’
These protective treasures were temporarily bestowed on him. He had to return them in the future when he reached the Primal Chaos realm.
Because the value of these treasures added up to more than 5,000 Origin World Rocks. It wasn’t easy to refine them again. To the current him, it was extremely useful. But once he reached the Primal Chaos realm, it was no longer useful! The rules of the Great Void Heaven Temple were-treasures had to be earned by himself. Hence, he was only ‘temporarily’ using them now.
“Many thanks Forefather, I’ll definitely be careful.” Xue Ying replied through the talisman.
Xue Ying no longer cared about it.
He was absolutely confident of himself.
Other than the precious protective treasures Forefather Tian Yu bestowed upon him, his ultra-long distance teleportation was instantaneous! This sort of fleeing technique was something even most Cosmos Gods could not hinder.
‘With the treasures given by Forefather and with my ultra-long distance teleportation! Unless Cosmos Gods personally came, otherwise, it is impossible for others to deal against me.’ Xue Ying was fully confident of his abilities, ‘But I have to be a little more careful. It isn’t appropriate for me to reveal my techniques of ultra-long distance teleportation.’
Being able to utilize this technique at the Unity realm?
That was something unheard of, at least in the reports publicly announced! The moment Xue Ying’s ultra-long distant teleportation technique was revealed, it would attract the attention of Cosmos Gods. They might even capture him directly before scouring through the memories of his soul!
…
Year passed by year.
The days were spent in utmost satisfaction. In the past, he felt really pressured for the sake of letting his wife transcend. He had even gone to the ‘Palace Hall of Time’ to cultivate. A period had been converted into hundred periods for him to cultivate! Now that his wife had transcended, Xue Ying became really carefree. His heart realm was no longer the same. He would frequently guide his children and disciples, research and study the Dao of Mirage, Walker’s Hidden Secret, Plate Ripple Diagram, the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance…
Now that he was no longer urgent, Xue Ying spent his days in bliss.
Ever since the Ancient Sacred Religion failed to find traces of him, there were no longer any movements from them.
In the blink of an eye, about five million years or so passed.
‘Wu? I’ve finally comprehended the sixth transformation of this Vermillion Nightmare Eight Transformations.’ Xue Ying who was located in the Black Fog Sea Monarch Residence suddenly felt understanding dawning on him. He revealed a joyous look before taking a step and proceeded with an ultra-long distance teleportation. He directly teleported to the Daoist Elder cavern dwelling cultivation room in Myriad Ancient Sacred World.
His stealthy movements were things the disciples of Green Peng Sect did not know of.
“Hua~”
Within the cultivation room.
A large amount of red crystals and several black wood blocks were placed around Xue Ying. The energy from these materials was being absorbed into the body of Xue Ying strand by strand. Behind Xue Ying, the aura coming from that huge fiery red divine bird, ‘Vermillion Nightmare’ which had spread out its huge wings, was becoming stronger and stronger. Eventually, all the red crystals and black wood blocks turned into powder. The powder contained leftover impurities.
Very soon.
The fiery red divine bird, ‘Vermillion Nightmare’, behind Xue Ying let out a resounding cry. Its wings began flapping, causing a red aura to start spreading out in all directions.
“Keep.” This Vermillion Nightmare totemic image fused back into the body of Xue Ying.
The next moment, a fiery red Vermillion Nightmare marking appeared on the forehead of Xue Ying. And when Xue Ying opened his eyes, this marking gradually disappeared into his skin.
‘I’ve finally cultivated the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance to the limits of the Unity realm, and have completely dug out its potential.’ Xue Ying revealed a grin, ‘After this, I can finally start altering the core of the Vermillion Nightmare, allowing it to metamorphose.’

chapters.title: Chapter 891 - Black Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 891: Black Emperor
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was clear that with his attainments in the Dao of Mirage and the ‘Vermillion Nightmare inheritance’ which a senior had created, only then could he reach the Vermillion Nightmare sixth transformation so easily. Even though he spent over five million years pushing another cultivation system all the way to the ‘fifth level Star Pagoda strength’, this short period was not worth mentioning against the eternal life of cultivators.
‘It’ll be very hard for me to improve further.’ Xue Ying thought.
He was at a huge bottleneck-from the Unity realm to the Primal Chaos realm. Even the Voidwalker system or the ‘Dao of Mirage’ which he had the greatest hope of breaking through would require him to cultivate for a very long period, much less the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance.
He was merely temporarily altering the inner illusory world structure of the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance. For him to raise the Vermillion Nightmare to the sixth level Star Pagoda strength was considered a huge success already.
Naturally-
Xue Ying’s current mood remained perfectly fine.
Because he had already reached his target for this ancient cultivation! Reaching the sixth transformation of the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance, the degree of strength his soul had reached was three times that before he cultivated this inheritance. If he were to use the Sky Punishment Edge… he could unleash ten of them!
…
At this moment when Xue Ying cultivated the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance to the sixth realm-
Over at another location in the Myriad Ancient Sacred World.
At a very far location from the Green Peng Sect-approximately more than half the entire span of Myriad Ancient Sacred World, there was a towering black palace located high in the cloud layer. This black palace which occupied a region of over 500,000 kilometers in distance had an exquisite gold sculpture constructed on its surface. There were many guards and servants within the palace too. All the servants were being extremely obedient and respectful.
Positioned below this black palace above the cloud layer, there was a city which occupied an area of more than 100 million kilometers in distance. There were many cultivators living within. This location was incomparably safe, and no devils dared to create trouble here.
And this city was also known as the ‘Black Emperor City’.
The palace on the upper end of the cloud layer was called the ‘Black Emperor Palace’, and its creator was a legendary existence-the ‘Black Emperor’!
Black Emperor was a Primal Chaos giant that was famous even during the era of the primitive Ancient Sacred World!
He was supposedly a life and death friend with ‘World Ancestor’ when they were small and weak.
He had even fought with the true body of a Cosmos God and easily escaped from him.
His strength was unquestionably at the ninth level of Star Pagoda! Being invited by his good friend, the ‘World Ancestor’, he decided to stay within the territory of Myriad Ancient Sacred World. Nevertheless, he was not a devour-class cultivator. Instead, he was an ancient cultivator. That was why the ‘Black Emperor City’ he created forbade those devils from devouring and slaughtering others.
“Hu.”
Deep within the Black Emperor Palace.
This male who was covered in scales sat there cross-legged. He had a long tail that seemed to be that of a dragon tail curling and occupying the majority half of the palace hall.
There were four different auras shown on top of this male.
There was a scarlet red, an azure green, a resplendent white and a mysterious black aura revolving around his head. Only the mysterious black aura remained slightly chaotic and unstable.
This male slowly opened his eyes. The four auras above his head fused back into his body.
‘I’ve completed the other three inheritances during the era of primitive Ancient Sacred World, leaving just the final inheritance which I had yet to achieve perfection.’ This male stood up. The scales on his body were exquisite, and his eyes were faintly slitted, ‘That time, I still called myself Black Emperor because I feel that I could complete this final inheritance.’
‘How long has it been?’
‘I’ve always been lacking by that final step. The other three inheritances would always disrupt this final one.’ Black Emperor sighed.
If not for cultivating the other three inheritances, it would naturally be easy to cultivate just one of them to perfection.
And to succeed in all four techniques, one had to complete the other three before completing the final one. The final technique would suffer from the greatest interference from the other three.
‘As long as I succeed, the four great inheritances would perfectly fuse into one entity just like the revolution of a cosmos.’ Black Emperor thought, ‘By then, I would become a Cosmos God! But I have been stuck at this final step for so long. Unless I chose the wrong path in the past?’
He was filled with ambition.
That time, World Ancestor was merely comparable to him.
World Ancestor chose to focus on a single Dao path. He decided to focus on the devour-class system. Even though it was not strong across those at the same level, World Ancestor had still cultivated to where he stood currently.
As for Black Emperor, he sought to reach the highest limits. At the same time, he cultivated four different supportive inheritances. When he was at the Origin Birth realm, he could transcend realm and slaughter all Unity experts… and at the Unity realm, he had attained the seventh level Star Pagoda strength. Now at the Primal Chaos realm, he had reached the ninth level Star Pagoda stage! In the future when he became a Cosmos God, he would similarly become someone extraordinary. But it’s a pity that he remained stuck at this bottleneck!
Stepping to the Cosmos God realm from Primal Chaos realm was the final breakthrough and also the hardest step.
Even though he was somewhat frustrated, Black Emperor remained calm. After all, he was already used to it.
‘Mn?’
Black Emperor suddenly sensed something. He turned towards a distance, ‘There is actually someone who cultivated the “Vermillion Nightmare inheritance”? And he has reached the sixth transformation?’
Only eight transformations of the “Vermillion Nightmare inheritance” were spread outside.
In reality, Black Emperor was clear.
The Vermillion Nightmare inheritance had nine transformations! But for the sake of keeping it a secret, he did not spread it outside.
Of the four great inheritances he cultivated… the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance was one which he had cultivated to large success a long time ago.
‘This is rare.’ Black Emperor revealed a grin, ‘For there to be another brat in this lineage of mine? Let me see who it is and how his potential is.’
“Sou.”
Black Emperor rapidly left the palace. He tore out a spatial passage in the void.
Black Emperor’s speed of traveling through the time-space passage was extremely fast. He was much faster than Ancestor Devil and the others. He merely took 30,000 years to cover a majority half of the Myriad Ancient Sacred World, arriving right outside the Green Peng Sect.
…
In midair.
Black Emperor in his black robe watched this Green Peng Sect from afar. His robe was flowing with the wind.
‘Yi?’
‘I was clearly able to sense the location where this person who cultivated the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance is at right within the Green Peng Sect.’ The Black Emperor revealed a doubtful look, ‘But why can’t I perceive the other party now? Is it possible for a Unity brat to escape from my senses?’
But he did not know.
Currently, Xue Ying had a treasure bestowed by Forefather Tian Yu. It was created by the comprehension of laws and profound mysteries wielded by a Cosmos God. It was impossible for Black Emperor to see through it. He had to depend on his discernment of the inheritance to determine where Xue Ying was.
With a wave of his hand.
“Sou!”
A Unity realm expert within the Green Peng Sect was forcefully teleported to the front of Black Emperor. The eyes of this expert were currently lost.
“Who is the strongest person in your Green Peng Sect?” Black Emperor asked.
“Daoist Elder.” This expert answered numbly.
“Is the biggest cavern-dwelling in your sect where the Daoist Elder stays?” Black Emperor continued asking.
“Yes.”
“What is he called?”
“I do not know.”
Black Emperor no longer asked. He threw this expert back where he was previously. That expert regained his consciousness muddleheadedly. He did not know what had just happened.
‘Daoist Elder?’ Black Emperor immediately began investigating through the intelligence system under World Ancestor. With his identity, he could rely on this intelligence system and was able to easily procure the piece of information-that time, Xue Ying had displayed the Black Gourd fireball which stunned the entire Green Peng Sect. The sect under World Ancestor had already confirmed the identity of Xue Ying.
‘Dong Bo Xue Ying? He is from the Great Void Heaven Temple?’ Black Emperor revealed a grin, ‘Who would have thought that the third junior of this lineage of mine is actually a disciple of the Great Void Heaven Temple.’
There were few who could even obtain this inheritance of his.
To cultivate to the limits of Unity realm, there were only three including Xue Ying.
‘Let me see what realm he has cultivated the inheritance to and if he is qualified to obtain the other three inheritances.’ Black Emperor took a step before arriving on top of a mountain. A wooden house appeared on this mountain peak which Black Emperor stayed at. In the Green Peng Sect beside this wooden house, nobody including Xue Ying had noticed the presence of Black Emperor.
To Black Emperor who had lived for far too long, it was loneliness that he was used to.

chapters.title: Chapter 892 - Great Improvement in Combat Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 892: Great Improvement in Combat Strength
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Even though Black Emperor stayed close to the Green Peng Sect, and that Xue Ying had the treasure bestowed by Forefather Tian Yu, making it hard for Black Emperor to perceive him, because Black Emperor was able to ascertain the location of Xue Ying through the ‘Vermillion Nightmare inheritance’, he was able to deduce the attainments of Xue Ying on the ‘Vermillion Nightmare inheritance’.
‘Those who cultivated the lineage of World Ancestor is usually weaker. But it triumphs in its ease of cultivation.’ Black Emperor thought, ‘And this lineage of mine is extremely powerful, but cultivating it is challenging.’
He was a life and death brother of World Ancestor. They both grew up step by step since they were weak.
Both of them were still fighting and competing as rivals at the Primal Chaos realm.
But after that…
Black Emperor remained stuck at the Primal Chaos realm for a long time, and World Ancestor eventually stepped into the final realm. He had even become one of the top three rankers amongst the final realm existences. The devour-class cultivation system was the most straightforward system to cultivate and was spread across a vast region. Many void creatures with a weaker comprehension ability would usually learn the devour-class cultivation system, devouring others recklessly and thus, enabling them to become stronger.
But Black Emperor felt slightly disdainful from doing this!
Because the devour-class cultivators were usually at the rock bottom amongst Origin Birth experts and even at the Unity realm! The devour-class cultivators at the Unity realm would often be at the first or second level Star Pagoda strength. Those of the laws and profound mysteries system or hex cultivation system would usually reach the third level Star Pagoda strength. Some of these elites could even reach the fourth or even fifth level!
And Black Emperor had an ancient cultivation inheritance which made him more exaggeratedly powerful!
Just a single inheritance enabled Unity experts to reach the fifth level Star Pagoda strength. With four inheritances fusing as one… one could achieve seventh level Star Pagoda strength at the Unity realm.
That is to say…
Black Emperor and World Ancestor chose different Dao paths because of fate. And the outcome was entirely different.
‘This path of mine is challenging to cultivate. It is rare for someone to cultivate the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance to the limits of Unity realm.’ Black Emperor thought, ‘I should thoroughly observe this cultivator. If I find him not bad, I can impart another or two inheritances to him.’
He would not impart all four inheritances at once.
Even if he spread out the four great inheritances in the past, he kept the final absolute move a secret too. One could see the personality of Black Emperor from thus.
‘But it seems with how highly the Great Void Heaven Temple regards him, it will be quite difficult for me to take him as my disciple.’ Black Emperor thought. Other than Xue Ying, only two other juniors were cultivating in this lineage of his. One had an incredibly unique status which he could not accept as a disciple, and the other was his disciple! That was also his only personal disciple.
The remaining few were all honorary disciples.
…
Black Emperor lived beside the Green Peng Sect in concealment for about one million years, when he suddenly exhibited an expression of shock. He looked towards the direction where the back mountain of Green Peng Sect was at.
A resounding cry reverberated across the entire Green Peng Sect.
Others did not know, but Black Emperor could sense via the inheritance that a ‘Vermillion Nightmare’ was undergoing metamorphosis in the direction where the back mountain of Green Peng Sect was. It became much stronger than before, and this rise in power was not just a single level.
‘He actually raised the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance to the sixth level Star Pagoda strength? And he has done it so quickly?’ Black Emperor was truly astounded.
The other two juniors in his lineage had only reached the fifth level Star Pagoda strength in this inheritance. After that, they stepped into the Primal Chaos realm and had directly trained the inheritance to a deeper level.
Black Emperor was different.
He had gotten all four inheritances a long time ago. He spent quite a lot of attention and energy on all four inheritances. When he was at the Unity realm, any single one of the inheritances was at the fifth level Star Pagoda strength. With the four supporting one another… his power had explosively increased, reaching the seventh level Star Pagoda strength. He did not think of altering the core of the Vermillion Nightmare before because the four inheritances supported each other, and by modifying one, he had to change the other three. He still had to ensure all four of them were able to perfectly fuse together… this was something Black Emperor did not dare think of doing!
And Xue Ying had received just a single inheritance. That was why he had taken the initiative to modify it and raise it to the sixth level.
‘The other two youngsters have obtained a single inheritance in the past as well, yet they have never proceeded this far.’ Black Emperor felt startled, ‘And everything happened too quickly.’
This innate talent and comprehension ability truly startled the Black Emperor.
‘The talent of this Dong Bo brat is absolutely beyond the other two! He isn’t any weaker than me.’ Black Emperor was still confident of himself. He felt that the reason why he did not alter the inheritances was that he had the four complete inheritances.
******
In the back mountain of Green Peng Sect, within the cavern-dwelling cultivation room of the Daoist Elder.
Accompanying that cry let out by the metamorphosizing Vermillion Nightmare, Xue Ying opened his eyes. The Vermillion Nightmare totem behind him spread out its wings and fanned out slightly. It caused a fiery red aura to spread out in all directions.
‘The Dao of Mirage and Vermillion Nightmare inheritance is indeed absolutely compatible. I’ve spent just one million years before fusing both moves. It has also greatly improved my strength!’ Xue Ying chuckled. These few years, he had altered the core illusory realm world structure of the Vermillion Nightmare many times. Previously, there was only a minor improvement, and the Vermillion Nightmare itself did not undergo a metamorphosis. But this time…
The Vermillion Nightmare had utterly transformed.
Even his soul got nourished from this transformation. The modification of the illusory world structure and the metamorphosis of the Vermillion Nightmare gave birth to an improvement of his soul. It became more than four times as strong as before.
“Hua.”
Xue Ying let out a thought. Many miniature illusory realm worlds appeared in the surrounding. A total of 15 miniature illusory worlds were currently fermenting a strand of sharp edge each, but everything looked illusory. Xue Ying forced them to dissipate with a thought.
’15 Sky Punishment Edges.’ Xue Ying revealed a grin, ‘My current strength might allow me to reach the seventh level Star Pagoda strength.’
Three Sky Punishment Edges were considered at the sixth level Star Pagoda strength.
And now, he could unleash a total of 15 of them…
He might be qualified to try and charge through the seventh level, though he still had to attempt it himself within the Star Pagoda.
There were only two experts in the entire history of the six great holy grounds that reached the seventh level of Star Pagoda. It was tough. Xue Ying felt himself becoming much stronger as compared to when he first entered the sixth level of Star Pagoda. Maybe he might be qualified to charge through the seventh level, though he was not sure.
‘My current strength reached this stage due to the support of ancient cultivation.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Since I’ve cultivated the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance to this stage already, it’ll be hard for me to improve it further unless I improve it to the Primal Chaos realm.’
He was able to reach this step in the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance all because of his experiences in the Dao of Mirage.
And his Dao of Mirage had currently touched the boundaries of the Primal Chaos realm. It would be difficult to break through from now on!
Carefully thinking about it… it was hard even if he wanted to improve his strength just by a bit. He could no longer deepen his understanding of the ‘Dao of Mirage’, and he had cultivated the ‘Voidwalker system’ to the 40th level. Any discernible improvement would require him to step into the next realm. As for the ‘Dao of Slaughter’, so what if he improved in that? The apocalyptic sixth sword was merely at the sixth level Star Pagoda strength.
The Sky Punishment Edge was originally an entirely offensive move. Thus, grasping the Apocalyptic Sixth Sword would not improve his strength further.
Only the ‘Dao of Ripple’ which belonged to the domain aspect could make him stronger. It was clearly effective for him to use the ‘Dao of Ripple’ in suppressing the other party during battles while unleashing the Sky Punishment edges at the same time.
‘I require quite a lot of time to break through in the Dao of Ripple. But that should indeed be my next step currently. I should spare some time on the Dao of Ripple.’ Xue Ying understood.
He had touched the boundaries of Primal Chaos realm in a single Dao.
And if he were to touch the boundaries of the Primal Chaos realm in two Daos…
Or even more Daos, then he would have a deeper understanding of the Primal Chaos realm. His certainty of breaking through would naturally be greater! This was also the reason why in history, many experts at the sixth level Star Pagoda strength did not step into the Primal Chaos realm. But those who reached the seventh level would certainly become a Primal Chaos expert. The reason was… to reach the seventh level of Star Pagoda, one had to cultivate in many Dao paths.
‘I should also cultivate other Daos and attempt to improve them to the Primal Chaos realm. Fusing them together, I believe that this should greatly improve my chances of stepping into the Primal Chaos realm.’ Xue Ying thought. Reaching his stage, the next target would naturally be the Primal Chaos realm.
…
His wife had long transcended, and Xue Ying no longer had any troubling issues holding him back. Naturally, he was putting all his concentration on cultivation. Xue Ying would frequently ponder over the ‘Walker’s Hidden Secret’ and ‘Dao of Mirage’ since these two paths had touched on the Primal Chaos realm. Once he felt himself becoming frustrated over those two paths, he would turn to the ‘Dao of Ripple’.
A period of time passed yet again.
Suddenly, on a particular day.
A violet-robed figure appeared in midair outside Green Peng Sect. He was looking at Green Peng Sect with cold intent.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying. You are protecting the Green Peng Sect. If I were to attack it, you would likely rush over to protect it right?” Saint Wang Ming watched from afar. But he had merely sent an incarnation this time with its appearances and aura modified.

chapters.title: Chapter 893 - Little Friend Dong Bo
chapters.content:
Chapter 893: Little Friend Dong Bo
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Saint Wang Ming’s eyes contained killing intent as he stared at the Green Peng Sect distantly. He did not care about the threat Xue Ying would bring to the other Saints from the Ancient Sacred Religion in the future since the Ancient sacred Religion was already enemy with the three great sacred worlds; there were too many enemies, and an additional Primal Chaos expert was not worth mentioning! Instead, he hated Xue Ying intensely because the other party had killed his little brother.
As a result, he decided to manipulate others. But many Saints from the Ancient Sacred Religion were not too willing to do so since they genuinely did not care much about Xue Ying! So what if there was an additional Cosmos God? The Ancient Sacred Religion would still remain the strongest!
Previously, he had requested ‘Master Jia Ming’ to find out the location of Xue Ying, and it failed. He was forced to give up on the first plan!
Saint Wang Ming thought of other methods once again. He spent a few million years, pleading to meet the higher-ups within the Ancient Sacred Religion before finally coming out with the second plan! Actually, the Ancient Sacred Religion did not have to invest as much in the second plan.
“Wang Ming, since the search for traces failed, the Great Void Heaven Temple will definitely be alerted. Even though we are sure that Dong Bo Xue Ying is protecting the Green Peng Sect, but for the sake of his own safety, he can easily give up the sect. It is also very possible for the Great Void Heaven Temple to plan and set a trap where the Green Peng Sect is at, waiting for us to fall into it. This is already the limit as to what we can promise you.” Someone higher from the religion answered Saint Wang Ming.
Even though Saint Wang Might felt helpless, he knew that this was indeed what the religion could do for him already.
Would the Ancient Sacred Religion invest so much energy to kill a Unity expert without having a sure-proof plan? Impossible!
‘As long as he is slightly careless.’
‘This second plan could succeed.’
‘I would be able to kill him in one fell swoop.’
Saint Wang Ming thought to himself.
This was the only opportunity he had. The Ancient Sacred Religion also collected all sorts of information. Xue Ying had publicly oppressed the Green Peng Sect and became its Daoist Elder. He had even used the Black Gourd fireball! The Ancient Sacred Religion was able to ascertain Xue Ying’s identity the moment they got news of this because Xue Ying had similarly used the Black Gourd fireball in the past when he eliminated a base of the Ancient Sacred Religion.
Even though they knew that Xue Ying was protecting the Green Peng Sect, the Ancient Sacred Religion was not confident that Xue Ying would still help the Green Peng Sect under the circumstance that he knew the ‘Ancient Sacred Religion was seeking for his traces’.
“Sou.”
Saint Wang Ming turned into a stream of light as he directly charged towards the Green Peng Sect. At the same time, he shouted out with a resounding voice filled with killing intent: “Old Thief Bei Zhou, hurry out and die for me!”
…
Bei Zhou was the strongest expert of Green Peng Sect before Xue Ying came.
“Old Thief Bei Zhou, hurry out and die for me!”
That murderous voice resounded across the entire Green Peng Sect, causing many other disciples to turn over. Even Elder Bei Zhou with his messy yellow hair turned around in doubt. He saw a violet-robed figure in the distant. Elder Bei Zhou felt bewildered: “Who is it that has vengeance with me? I cannot recognize him at all.”
“Elder Bei Zhou, is he your enemy?”
“Elder Bei Zhou…” All of them were asking.
Elder Bei Zhou felt disconcerted. Was it an enemy he offended over the long life of his? This was common because the Myriad Ancient Sacred World was just too chaotic. As one killed others, it was possible that he might offend the junior disciple of that particular expert, and that junior would come over in search of revenge after cultivating to a specific realm!
“Hong! Hong! Hong!”
That violet-robed figure situated in the sky directly moved. He waved his hand, causing many violet claps of thunder to strike down from the sky. It struck heavily on the Green Peng Sect. “Hong hong hong~” The power was immense. Xue Ying had constructed arrays to protect the place-an illusory array and an alert array, both of which were not offensive in nature. There was only the slaughter array which created sword lights that barely defended against those thunderclaps.
In just a short moment, the arrays were on the verge of collapse!
“Quickly ask the Daoist Elder for help.”
“It can’t hold on any longer.”
The higher-ups of the Green Peng Sect immediately understood this point. The Green Peng Sect Sectmaster Shang Liang personally went to report.
******
At this moment, Xue Ying was cultivating within his cavern-dwelling cultivation room. The cultivation room did not entirely isolate the sounds from the outer world. Xue Ying had heard the loud shout ‘Old Thief Bei Zhou, hurry out and die’. Xue Ying thought that the other party was an enemy of Elder Bei Zhou, yet the disturbances produced after that was tremendous. The booming shockwaves forced Xue Ying to stop his cultivation.
‘Judging from this power, it should be an expert of at least the fifth level Star Pagoda strength?’ Xue Ying thought, ‘It might even be higher.’
He did not know.
That the incarnation of Saint Wang Ming had already used his entire strength! After all, it was only an incarnation, and the gap with his true body was too significant. There was a limit to the willpower his true body could exert from this distance.
‘Such an expert should know that I am protecting the Green Peng Sect right? Why did he come so rashly? Is it that he does not know my identity?’ Xue Ying thought. He indeed did not publicize his identity. Only the highest superpowers were able to deduce who Xue Ying was. Most experts without great background would not find out about this.
Even though he had many thoughts, Xue Ying still became alert. A layer of dull white robe was put over the surface of his soul. This was one of the treasures given by Forefather Tian Yu.
Only then did he open the cultivation door.
“Sou.”
After coming out, Xue Ying flew into the sky. He looked at this violet-robed figure from afar.
At this moment-
A black light appeared from nothingness. It arrived right in front of him.
Xue Ying was astonished. He felt an intense threat: ‘What, I did not actually discover him invading into my domain? I did not discover him at all?’
There was someone who could stealthily enter his law domain?
“Weng-”
A frightening fluctuation formed.
The sky that originally contained a sun remodeled. It was swallowed by primal chaos. A horrifying force enveloped the entire Green Peng Sect. All the disciples of Green Peng Sect felt that they could not move; they were all horrified after coming to that realization! Even Saint Wang Ming who disguised himself as an ordinary expert of the Myriad Ancient Sacred World felt terror from this. Even though his incarnation was weaker, his willpower which controlled the incarnation also felt the terror…
That represented that even if his true body came, it would similarly be terrified: ‘Who? Who is it?’
This region of primal chaos brought a frightening suppression that astonished even Xue Ying. This was ten to a hundred times stronger than the threat the previous black light brought to him.
Under this suppression, a figure appeared in midair to the distant. It was a black-robed girl. Her eyes were dead, and she stared at Xue Ying coldly. She then turned to the distance.
Xue Ying similarly looked to the distance.
There…
A black-robed male walked out. His black robe was rolling, and his unseen aura covered the sky.
“Black emperor.” The black-robed girl that was emitting a deathly aura coldly said.
“So it is Master Yellow River.” Black Emperor indifferently answered.
Xue Ying was inwardly shocked the moment he heard that. Master Yellow River?
That was an existence who stood at the apex of many Saints in the Ancient Sacred Religion. She was a great expert at the ninth level Star Pagoda strength, and was famous for assassination! But Xue Ying could see that this was merely an incarnation of Master Yellow River. If her true body came, she would not be so easily suppressed by ‘Black Emperor’.
But why was Black Emperor helping him?
“Who would have thought that Black Emperor is here too. If not for you, he will likely die today.” The black-robed girl coldly mentioned.
Xue Ying pursed his lips inwardly.
What a joke.
He was covered entirely in the protective treasures given by Forefather Tian Yu. Even if the true body of Master Yellow River came, he could still survive for a moment or two! By then, he would have long teleported far away and escaped with his life!
“This is the Myriad Ancient Sacred World and not a territory of your Ancient Sacred Religion.” Black Emperor indifferently said, “Also, with me around, you should not think of harming Little Friend Dong Bo at all.”
The black-robed girl and the distant Saint Wang Ming felt astounded.
The transcendental Black Emperor had decided to protect Xue Ying?
“Just two incarnations? The Ancient Sacred Religion is indeed becoming petty.” Black Emperor shook his head. “Peng! Peng!” The body of the distant Saint Wang Ming exploded and dissipated. As for the black-robed girl’s body, she suffered from the suppression of the primal chaos before similarly shattering into nothingness.
Xue Ying was watching as things happen in a daze.
With me around? You should not think of harming Little Friend Dong Bo at all?
Little Friend Dong Bo?
When did I become so close with Black Emperor? We have never seen each other before today!
“Little Friend Dong Bo.” Black Emperor revealed a grin as he turned around and look at Xue Ying.

chapters.title: Chapter 894 - To Recuperate
chapters.content:
Chapter 894: To Recuperate
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Senior Black Emperor.” Xue Ying said, “Many thanks senior for the help. If not for senior, this junior would have encountered huge trouble.”
“Hahaha…” Black Emperor’s laughter was clear and bright, “Previously, Little Friend Dong Bo wasn’t panicking when the sneak attack came. You should have some methods of surviving against it right? The Great Void Heaven Temple is a holy ground for the laws and profound mysteries system, and they specialize in refining all sorts of unique treasures. Forefather Tian Yu is also extremely overprotective of his disciples, so he should have bestowed upon you some marvelous protective treasures. I am only taking this opportunity to act so that I can meet you, little friend. I have actually been staying by the side of Green Peng Sect for a long time, and it is time for me to meet you.”
“Meet me?” Xue Ying was puzzled. He laughed, “I have never thought that senior is living by the side of Green Peng Sect. Things are quite coincidental.”
Previously, he felt perplexed.
Ultra-long distance teleportation was something most of the final realm existences could not employ, and there were even fewer Primal Chaos ancient cultivators who could do so.
Naturally.
He had to rely on the four-diagrams cultivation technique that Monarch Nine Cloud created for his ultra-long distance teleportation! Black Emperor might be formidable, but Xue Ying had never heard that he knew how to teleport through an ultra-long distance. Why would Black Emperor suddenly appear when ‘Master Yellow Spring’ suddenly attacked him? So he had been living close by.
“It isn’t coincidental.” Black Emperor chuckled, “The reason why I am living beside the Green Peng Sect is all because of you.”
“Because of me?” Xue Ying became all the more bewildered.
“Hahaha, are you planning to let me stand here and talk to you?” Black Emperor asked.
Xue Ying hurriedly replied, “I apologize for that! Senior Black Emperor, please come in.”
After which, the two of them entered the cavern-dwelling together.
…
There were many other disciples within Green Peng Sect too. They were watching in dumbstricken fashion at how things progressed. First, it was a violet-robed male who came seeking for ‘Elder Bei Zhou’ for vengeance. Following that, the world became like the primal chaos… an unfathomable ‘black-robed male’ that caused everyone to feel terror stepped on the void and came.
That power far transcended beyond what Xue Ying could display with his Black Gourd fireball.
Terror, trembling…
The black-robed male merely stared at that violet-robed male before he exploded and turned into nothingness.
Currently, this black-robed male and their Daoist Elder entered together into the cavern-dwelling side by side.
“Who is he?”
“It seems even Daoist Elder is very respectful to him.”
“This power is too horrifying. It should be at the Primal Chaos realm right?”
All of them were discussing about this matter in hushed tones.
And some of the higher-ups of Green Peng Sect who were experienced enough felt their faces turning. They at the very least recognized some of the famous characters living in the Myriad Ancient Sacred World. Black Emperor disdained from concealing his identity and altering his appearance. Hence, those higher-ups of Green Peng Sect could easily recognize his identity. They felt their hearts trembling and were all dumbfounded.
“Black Emperor?”
“It is actually Black Emperor!”
“Our Daoist Elder seems to know Black Emperor?” They were looking at each other; they felt their hearts racing.
Even though there were few Primal Chaos giants in the Myriad Ancient Sacred World, Black Emperor was someone so famous that he transcended beyond others. He was someone who could call the World Ancestor his brother.
******
In the distant Ancient Sacred World.
Within a palace under the lake.
Saint Wang Ming sat on his throne. His expression was ugly. The servants around him stopped breathing as they perceived that their current master was in a miserable mood.
“Everyone scram now.” Saint Wang Ming coldly ordered.
“Yes.”
All the servants swiftly withdrew.
Saint Wang Ming sat there in taciturn. Only after a long time did he murmur to himself: “Black Emperor actually intervened. I’ve spent so much effort before being able to persuade some of the higher-ups within the religion, and asking them to let ‘Master Yellow Spring’ act once! If not for him, we might have succeeded!”
Because Master Yellow Spring merely sent an incarnation out to act. Thus, even if she dissipated, there were no significant losses.
But to make someone with the status of Master Yellow Spring act once… It was not easy. If Saint Wang Ming had to ask her for help again, he would have to fork at least 1,000 to 2,000 Origin World Rocks, and this was something he could not accept.
“Ai.”
“Those within the religion aren’t willing to put in too much effort since they feel that the success rate is quite low.”
Saint Wang Ming gritted his teeth, “If only the war had started, I could easily activate and bring a team to eliminate Dong Bo Xue Ying!”
The Ancient Sacred Religion was currently within the period of ‘recuperation’.
It was a long period.
Usually, the Sacred Master was the one who started the war. Every war would cause blood to rain. The fall of Cosmos Gods during wars was even commonly seen. There had been existences on the second level of the final realm like ‘Monarch Nine Cloud’ and ‘Ancestor Cang’ who had died during this war, and many more at the third level perishing. Actually, the war did not involve just the five sacred worlds. Instead, when such a large-scale war began, even sacred worlds could possibly shatter from the destruction.
For instance, Gu Qi had dared to disrupt the affairs of Sacred Master, offending him as a result. Thus, Sacred Master decided to pursue after him without heeding the price! Even the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World did not dare defend him as it was impossible for ordinary sacred worlds to hinder the Sacred Master’s offense.
As for the Ancestor Mother Sacred world and Myriad Ancient Sacred World, they might have a chance of resisting against the Sacred Master, and Gu Qi personally was a Voidwalker who reached the final realm. His means of escaping were formidable, allowing him to survive until now despite inciting the indignance of the Sacred Master. Nevertheless, Gu Qi had given the orders…
To forbid Xue Ying from mentioning that he was Gu Qi’s disciple since it might implicate Xue Ying.
Actually, let’s not talk about someone at the Unity realm. Even a Primal Chaos expert could not survive under the fury of the Sacred Master.
‘It’s a pity that the war has ended.’ Saint Wang Ming sighed inwardly.
During the period of war, death and injuries were common on both sides. And when the war ended, both parties would recuperate. They would only engage in small-scale skirmishes at most. Even the fall of Primal Chaos giants was rarely seen, much less Cosmos Gods.
‘Right now, many old men within the religion is cultivating. I should wait for an opportunity to come.’ Saint Wang Ming thought. As long as he waited for an opportunity such as the war erupting, then he would be able to activate some power in the religion as a saint to smash Xue Ying to death. After all, countless people were dying at that time.
But now? Saint Wang Ming could only wait!
…
At the back mountain of Green Peng Sect within Xue Ying’s cavern-dwelling.
Xue Ying brought some delicious wine and said at the same time: “Senior Black Emperor is staying by the side of Green Peng Sect because of me? Is it possible for this junior to ask what is it for?”
“You cultivated the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance?” Black Emperor lightly drank a mouth of the wine before asking with a smile.
“Yes.”
Xue Ying continued in surprise, “How does Senior Black Emperor know about it? Oh, is it because of the disturbance I created during my breakthrough?”
Black Emperor lightly shook his head.
“Hong!”
A fiery-red bird appeared behind his back. The feathers on the enormous bird could clearly be seen. Its eyes were filled with emotions, and it was currently fanning its enormous wings, producing a fiery-red stream of air. Every single strand of airstream was akin to the rise of a miniature cosmos. Xue Ying was startled as he saw this. The allure generated by this ‘Vermillion Nightmare totem’ was much stronger than his. Fortunately, Black Emperor kept back its power. Otherwise, Xue Ying might be influenced by the illusory realm.
“This junior has never thought that Senior Black Emperor would cultivate the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance as well and to such a realm.” Xue Ying exclaimed in admiration.
Within the publicly-available intelligence reports.
Black Emperor was well-known for being tyrannical. His battles always happened with an overwhelming suppression of the other party! Xue Ying had never heard of him specializing in the illusory realm.
“The “Vermillion Nightmare” is actually propagated by me.” Black Emperor chuckled, “That time, I’ve sent out a total of 30 original copies. Some might be obtained by a few Cosmos Gods or superpowers. Some might even be lost.”
“Senior is the one who propagated this technique?” Xue Ying answered, “It is truly admirable for senior to be able to create such an amazing ancient cultivation technique!”
He really admired the other party.
The ‘illusory realm’ effect was only part of what this ancient cultivation inheritance had. There was also the alluring aura, and the nourishment it had towards one’s soul…
“No no no.”
Black Emperor shook his head, “It is impossible for me to create such an inheritance. It is due to fate that I was able to acquire this unique inheritance. According to what the inheritance recorded in the past, mine is also the only copy! After I succeeded did I disseminate it around.”
Xue Ying was enlightened.
“But I do not wish for my methods to be made known in the outer world. Thus, I’ve only released eight transformations for inheritances like the “Vermillion Nightmare inheritance”! In reality, there are nine.” Black Emperor chuckled.
“There are nine transformations?” Xue Ying’s eyes brightened. He felt himself desiring it, but he did not know how to bring this topic out.
“I can impart this ninth transformation to you.” Black Emperor nodded, “The reason why I disseminated the inheritance is that I hope for an expert to emerge within my lineage. I have not reached the final realm after so long, and now, I wished there was someone who could achieve it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 895 - Imperial Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 895: Imperial Dragon
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Four inheritances?” Xue Ying felt puzzled.
Black Emperor nodded: “That time when I first acquired this unique inheritance, it was made of four individual inheritances. They complement one another, allowing one to obtain unfathomable strength! I’ve yet to cultivate all four inheritances to grand perfection, yet I am able to become so strong. The moment I reach perfection… that would be when I step into the final realm. This time I came to find you so as to determine if you have the talent and comprehension ability to cultivate this technique. Now that I affirmed your potential, I am certainly willing to impart another part of the inheritance to you.”
“It isn’t that I am petty! But learning any of these four inheritances is very difficult. Furthermore, these inheritances focus on different directions. For you to succeed in cultivating the “Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance” does not mean you would succeed in learning others. It’ll be better for you to concentrate on learning one inheritance at a time.”
“If you were able to reach a profound realm in these two inheritances, you could find me again, and I’ll impart to you the third inheritance.” Black Emperor said.
Xue Ying listened before replying, “The fact that senior is willing to impart the inheritance shows your benevolence.”
The other party did not ask anything from him. He was simply imparting the inheritances to Xue Ying.
That was indeed benevolence!
“Hahaha…” Black Emperor shook his head, “This is also because I have been trapped at the final bottleneck for far too long, and am losing confidence in myself. That is why I hope for someone to attain what I could not succeed in this lineage of mine.”
He indeed did not have any requests.
Because it was not needed! With his current identity, was he lacking treasures? Did he lack backing? He wasn’t! It was merely an ambition of his since he was clear how unique this lineage of inheritance was. It should not be weaker than the World Ancestor lineage because they had once obtained an excellent opportunity of which they chose different paths at that time.
“Other than the “Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance”, the other three inheritances are known as the “Nine Serpents Inheritance”, the “Imperial Dragon Inheritance”, and the “Mountainous Beast Inheritance”.” Black Emperor lightly pointed before causing streams of light to fly towards Xue Ying.
Xue Ying’s law domain was able to deduce that these streams of light contained just information. He did not obstruct them and took the initiative to perceive them.
“You should have some understanding of the other three inheritances. Select one yourself.” Black Emperor said.
Only after Xue Ying read through the introductions of the other three inheritances did he become genuinely astonished. That time he chose the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance because it was able to strengthen his soul. He did not regard other aspects of the technique. As for the inner ‘illusory world structure’, he felt that it was too ordinary since he had learned the “Plate Ripple Diagram”, the “13 Apocalyptic Swords” and the “Dark World”. Any of them were able to reach the sixth level Star Pagoda strength.
That was why he felt slightly disdainful of the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance.
After that, he relied on his accomplishments in the Dao of Mirage and took the initiative to alter the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance at the Unity realm, allowing it to improve despite its original form being at the fifth level Star Pagoda strength! Xue Ying felt quite accomplished in his heart after doing so.
‘So it seems…’
‘These four inheritances are actually one entity.’
Xue Ying was dumbstruck.
This was truly a perfect inheritance!
If he cultivated in all four inheritances, he would be able to attain the seventh level Star Pagoda combat strength at the Unity realm. More importantly, any of those Unity experts in the history of the six great holy grounds who had reached the seventh level Star Pagoda strength were usually extremely strong in certain aspects! They would be weak in a few areas. Like Xue Ying, he was extremely strong in terms of offense.
But it was different for this ancient inheritance!
Learning all four inheritances and one would no longer have any flaws!
His soul would be strong! His lifeforce would be strong! His combat strength would be strong! His physical strength would be strong! And even his escaping techniques would be strong too!
It was simply perfect!
“It is a perfect inheritance.” Xue Ying murmured.
Black Emperor heard him speak from the side and could not help but feel a strand of bitterness rising deep in his heart.
That’s right.
Perfect!
That time he chose this path because of this point. The World Ancestor decided to select another seemingly ordinary path.
“It is too perfect.” Xue Ying did not dare believe that such an ancient inheritance exists. He cultivated the Dao of Mirage, Dao of Ripple and Dao of Slaughter. He also cultivated the Voidwalker system! He had even gotten the technique of ultra-long distance teleportation and was considered to have many techniques. But he was still far from reaching perfection in everything.
And each of these four inheritances had a focus area.
The moment he fused them together, there would even be a qualitative transformation.
A perfect fleshy body! A perfect soul! A perfect combative style!
‘There is actually such an inheritance? I’ve never heard of it despite reading through so many books in the Great Void Heaven Temple.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Is this an ancient cultivation? For the Sacred Master to become the strongest expert amongst the final realm existences and become unparalleled, is it because he had gotten a similar ancient cultivation inheritance that might be stronger?’
“The more perfect it is, the harder it’ll be to cultivate them.” Black Emperor said, “Brat, have you chosen?”
“I’ve chosen.” Xue Ying nodded, “I shall select the “Imperial Dragon Inheritance”.”
The “Nine Serpents Inheritance” contained ultra-strong life energy and was geared towards the life aspect.
As for the “Mountainous Beast Inheritance”, it contained an extreme defense and was geared towards the world aspect.
These were not what he specialized in.
The “Imperial Dragon Inheritance” was geared towards slaughter!
And the “Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance” was on the illusory realm. It pertained to his soul. WIth the four great inheritances fusing as one, there were many other mystical effects such as allowing him to become better at escaping, to have a more powerful domain… that was why Xue Ying felt dumbstruck at how perfect this inheritance was. The person who could create this inheritance should have so many techniques that far transcended his imaginations. It seemed that those ranked at the front of final realm existences should have an unfathomable strength.
The Void Primogenitor was merely at the third level, but the Voidwalker system was quite mystical already. It was outstanding in escaping and surviving.
Even though Monarch Nine Cloud had died, his attainments in the void were beyond that of the Void Primogenitor! He had yet to complete the four-diagrams absolute art, and Xue Ying understood how amazing it was already currently.
The more he understood, the more he realized how frightening those standing at the peak were.
‘There is still him.’ Xue Ying thought of another person-Luo City Lord!
The other Primal Chaos experts could not escape with their lives in front of final realm existences!
Only Luo City Lord who was at the Primal Chaos realm contained a power that could suppress an absolute majority of other final realm existences including the laws and profound mysteries system Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster, Void Primogenitor… one had to know that Forefather Tian Yu had the reliance of a cosmos in his body. Even so, he could not defeat Luo City Lord! Luo City Lord’s realm was so extraordinary that it could not be conceived.
But it seemed he had violated certain unknown taboo that prevented him from being able to break through to the Cosmos God realm.
‘The more I cultivate, the more I realized how small I am.’ Xue Ying thought.
And Black Emperor had just brought out two books before placing them in front of Xue Ying. One was a fiery-red book which had vaguely formed an illusory realm on the surrounding of the book. The other was a book containing a black killing aura. The book was faintly emitting a roar of fury that was full of killing intent.
******
He had gotten the ninth transformation of the “Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance”, and the complete book of the “Imperial Dragon Inheritance”. Only then did Black Emperor left.
In the following period, Xue Ying had also collected various treasures via the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion required to cultivate the “Imperial Dragon Inheritance”. By then, he had practically finished spending what he gained from Monarch Nine Cloud’s treasure cove. Fortunately, he had some earnings after killing the great commander of Chief Devil Cliff and several other experts.
‘It indeed feels smooth.’
Xue Ying felt truly carefree as he cultivated the “Imperial Dragon Inheritance”.
Because this time, he had deliberately chosen an inheritance geared towards slaughter. Since his attainments in the Dao of Slaughter was high, and he just lacked a gap before being able to unleash the Apocalyptic Sixth Sword, researching the “Imperial Dragon Inheritance” was naturally smooth-sailing for him. Nevertheless, he spent a little longer as compared to the time he used to comprehend the “Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance”-about eight million years before attaining the Unity realm in the “Imperial Dragon Inheritance”.
But after cultivating this inheritance, Xue Ying did not find it helpful in improving his overall combat strength.
“Hou~”
Within the cultivation room.
Xue Ying sat there cross-legged. There was a black-scaled mutated beast illusion that formed behind him. Its pair of rear clawed-hoofs supported its entire body, and its pair of enormous front claws were emitting a savage and heaven-shaking aura… and at this moment, black scales were forming on the palms of Xue Ying. They were similarly emitting a slaughter aura.
‘My hands might be strong, but they can’t triumph over my Sky Punishment Edges.’ Xue Ying sighed, ‘Still, this Imperial Dragon inheritance tempers my body, strengthening even my Voidwalker body by a few times.’
With a thought.
His body was covered in a layer of black scales. It was like a layer of armor! Only his face remained its original appearance.
‘There is still a protective armor, and this protective armor is comparable to lower-grade Void God weapons.’ Xue Ying slightly nodded. Even though it did not improve his offensive strength, his physical strength had become stronger, and the defense of the armor was quite formidable. It’s a pity that he could not cultivate all four inheritances to an extremely high realm and fuse them together. Only that newly-emerged body could be called terrifying! By then, he should be able to withstand against the offense of Primal Chaos giants.
‘Time for me to go out.’
‘The second commander ‘Monarch Qi Hu’ of the Chief Devil Cliff is still alive. It is time for me to kill him and complete my promise.’ Xue Ying calmly thought. After which, he stealthily left the Green Peng Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 896 - To have a Lucky Break
chapters.content:
Chapter 896: To have a Lucky Break
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Myriad Ancient Sacred World, there was a palace hidden within Lan Cang Mountain Range. Many arrays were constructed around this palace, making it hard for ordinary Unity experts to discover this place.
This was where the second commander, ‘Monarch Qi Hu’ of the Chief Devil Cliff currently stayed.
‘This luck of mine has previously fallen to rock-bottom, but now, it seems to have reversed!’ Within a little courtyard inside the palace, Monarch Qi Hu dismissed his attendants. He was left alone with a mystical mirror in his hand. This mirror seemed like an ordinary stone from its surfaces, but it was really smooth, and one could faintly see his own reflection on it.
Thus, it could be considered a mirror, though this ‘Stone Mirror’ was truly mystical.
‘That time I noticed that Black Chief Devil was strong enough and he specialized in abilities that complemented mine. That was why I decided to join the Chief Devil Cliff.’ Monarch Qi Hu caressed the stone mirror in his hand, ‘Teaming up with him has indeed made us stronger. Even fifth level Star Pagoda experts couldn’t defeat the two of us together… slaughter, plunder, those days were awesome. It had given me the chance to gather quite a lot of resources.’
‘But…’
‘Who would have thought that he is actually a follower of the two great religions.’ Monarch Qi Hu’s eyes were cold, ‘And he almost got me implicated. I had been captured by the experts under His Highness World Ancestor!’
He was directly captured, locked and interrogated…
Monarch Qi Hu was honestly panicking at that time!
Who was World Ancestor? He was someone standing practically at the highest spot amongst final realm existences. Only Sacred Master had enough strength to suppress World Ancestor. That time, Monarch Qi Hu felt despair. He thought he would die from being implicated. Fortunately, after going through many interrogations with the final conclusion being that he was not related to the two great religions, he was eventually released and regained his freedom!
‘Damn, damn that Black Chief Devil!’ Monarch Qi Hu felt incensed the more he thought about it, ‘You can rely on the two great religions all you want, but don’t pull me into this!’
‘At least my luck has become better now that you are dead!’
Monarch Qi Hu could not help but look down at the stone mirror in his hand. He subconsciously caressed it.
After being released, he went back to the Chief Devil Cliff and plundered the whole place clean-things like the protection arrays and others. That time, the two had forked out a considerable price for them. As he left the sect, Chief Devil Cliff soon collapsed. ‘The Inner Hall Elder Dong Bo Xue Ying of Great Void Heaven Temple has actually come to deal with Black Chief Devil and me. It seems that I’ve killed too many people these few days and have offended certain experts that brought this Dong Bo Xue Ying over.’
‘Whatever. Even though I do not kill and plunder as frequently nowadays, reducing the rate of accumulation of resources, it is better for me to remain discreet.’
Monarch Qi Hu decided since then to remain low-profile.
But he still eventually found ‘Resistance Wind City Master’ through the imprint he left. Resistance Wind City Master did not notice it at all. Monarch Qi Hu was someone who far transcended the abilities of Resistance Wind City Master in areas like void penetration… and thus was able to kill Resistance Wind City Master without the other party escaping from him. The stone mirror thus landed in the hands of Monarch Qi Hu.
‘I indeed have a fortune reversal. The stone mirror is more mystical than how I thought it to be.’ Monarch Qi Hu was incomparably excited, ‘By relying on the stone mirror, it is possible for me to create an all-new ancient cultivation path belonging to me alone! I would be able to reach the sixth level Star Pagoda strength, or even step into the Primal Chaos realm.’
It had been a few million years since he got the stone mirror.
The more he comprehended over it, the more magical the stone mirror was to him. It was the most mystical treasure he had ever gotten in his entire life.
Henceforth…
Monarch Qi Hu who was originally living in seclusion with slight unwillingness decided to temporarily let go of his cravings to kill and plunder others. Instead, he concentrated solely on researching the stone mirror: ‘Hmph hmph, wait until I become stronger and step into the Primal Chaos realm. By then, I would be able to lord over all regions! What can a little Inner Hall Elder of the Great Void Heaven Temple do to me?’
Even if an Inner Hall Elder were stronger, he would still be at the Unity realm.
As long as he stepped into the Primal Chaos realm, his status would be entirely different. He would be the giant of a region and an overlord.
Like Unity experts, they would usually take the initiative to join a holy ground, yet the holy ground might not accept him! Especially Cosmos Gods like World Ancestor who disdained accepting Unity experts into his sect.
But it was different for Primal Chaos giants. If they were willing to join a holy ground, any holy ground would happily accept them!
There were even more Primal Chaos giants who were not too willing to join a sect because although it might be helpful to them, they had greater responsibilities too. For instance, they might be arranged to head to the boundary of the void and battle with the Destruction Devils! And the stronger an expert was, the more arrogant he would be. Thus, many Primal Chaos giants decided to set up their own organizations and sects.
Black Emperor and Ancestor Desert were two such examples.
Reaching their level, unless the true body of a Cosmos God killed his way over, nobody else would be able to threaten them at all! And Cosmos Gods would not become enemies with these giants for no reason at all.
‘Things would be entirely different when I step into the Primal Chaos realm.’ Monarch Qi Hu was filled with expectations towards that day. He then lowered his head and looked at the stone mirror in his hand.
Previously, he was not confident at all in entering the Primal Chaos realm because he did not even have a sliver of understanding towards the Primal Chaos realm. But now that he had this stone mirror, during the past few million years, he was able to vaguely see himself stepping on the Dao path towards the Primal Chaos realm. Naturally, he regained his confidence.
…
“Hu.”
The clouds were like silk traces. Xue Ying walked out from the distorted void. He stood above the cloud layer looking down at the vast continuous mountain range.
“Lan Cang Mountain Range.” Xue Ying muttered to himself, “He has hidden really deep. This devil head Monarch Qi Hu could actually endure and control his impulse not to kill and remain low-profile. That is honestly puzzling. Is he still frightened after being captured by the subordinates of World Ancestor?”
Xue Ying definitely did not believe that this was the case.
It was impossible for such a huge devil to go against his cultivation heart realm. The other party had reached the ‘heart as blade’ level at least, and it was impossible for those at this realm to have such a huge personality change. Xue Ying reckoned that Monarch Qi Hu should be lying low for a short period. That devilish personality in the other party’s heart would ultimately surface after a period, urging him to go out and kill again.
But Xue Ying was wrong! Monarch Qi Hu was not holding his desires back. Instead, he was crazily immersed in comprehending the stone mirror.
‘According to the intelligence of Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion, the location of Monarch Qi Hu’s palace should be there.’ Xue Ying took a step. “Shua shua shua”-a few teleportations led him deep into the Cang Lang Mountain Range.
The mountain below had an enormous jadeite lake. Surrounding the lake was many trees and flowers. This place was beautiful. No traces of human activities could be seen.
“Weng.”
The fiery-red Vermillion Nightmare imprint lighted up on Xue Ying’s forehead. A huge fiery-red god bird, Vermillion Nightmare, had appeared behind his body fanning its wings. As the Vermillion Nightmare slowly fanned its wings, a fiery-red stream of air began spreading out, and Xue Ying’s aura also began pervading the place.
Vermillion Nightmare illusory technique.
The red stream of air which could be seen with the naked eyes contained fluctuations of the soul too.
The fluctuations of the soul were able to easily bypass many of the hidden arrays beneath. Even though the arrays were strong, they could not obstruct the assault of the soul! As for the illusory technique… it was clearly a soul attack.
Many servants located within the hidden palace became muddleheaded. They were completely pulled into the illusory realm. Xue Ying had improved the Vermillion Nightmare illusory technique to the sixth level Star Pagoda strength, and even Inner Hall Elders of the Great Void Heaven Temple would be affected, much less these servants.

chapters.title: Chapter 897 - Stone Mirror
chapters.content:
Chapter 897: Stone Mirror
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Not just these servants, even Monarch Qi Hu who was currently within the small courtyard was influenced too.
And the huge Vermillion Nightmare God Bird fanned its wings behind Xue Ying, bringing down the cultivator controlling the protection array from within the palace. Monarch Qi Hu was struggling to stay awake, making it hard for him to direct any array at all. As a result, Xue Ying was able to easily break apart the arrays by controlling the void, causing the palace to appear from nothingness.
Xue Ying stepped on the void. With a step, he appeared right in front of Monarch Qi Hu who was located in a small courtyard deep in the palace.
“Damn, break for me, break for me…”
Monarch Qi Hu was currently feeling uneasy.
The illusory technique had arrived so suddenly, engulfing him entirely before he knew it. It felt similar to having nightmares when he was young. He had barely opened his eyes before falling yet into another nightmare. He struggled out before falling in, struggled out… Monarch Qi Hu honestly felt like he had returned back to the past even though he was stronger than even Black Chief Devil in terms of soul and heart realm.
Facing this illusory realm, he had not fallen into oblivion entirely. He was still conscious enough to know that he currently was immersed in an illusory realm and was trying to get out of it!
Indeed.
