He had broken out of the illusory realm and could vaguely sense the surrounding courtyard. But closely following that, he fell into yet another illusory realm! He was doing his best to break out of it, but another would arrive shortly after. This made him transfer back and fro between reality and illusion.
“Hu hu hu~” The fiery-red airstream pervaded within the courtyard and also affected Monarch Qi Hu. He was pulled back into the illusory realm time after time.
That was how impressive the Vermillion Nightmare illusory realm was.
It was unlike the illusory realm unleashed using the laws and profound mysteries system. The illusory realm unleashed by the Vermillion Nightmare was a side-effect of its presence, and Xue Ying did not have to control it. Along with its presence, it would create an alluring aura that encompassed all enemies, pulling them into the illusory realm time after time. Even if Monarch Qi Hu had reached the higher ‘Heart as the World’ realm, he could only barely utilize 50-60% his full heart strength!
But Monarch Qi Hu’s current heart realm was only at the ‘Heart as Blade’ realm and was struggling to even get out of the illusory realm. He could barely ‘sense’ that there was an enemy within the courtyard-the white-robed teenager Xue Ying!
But the scene in the courtyard and the scene in the illusory realm was starting to fuse in his consciousness.
“No, no, how could this be? How…” Monarch Qi Hu felt unreconciled. Nevertheless, he felt cold in his heart since he understood that this was a dangerous predicament he had never encountered before.
In the past, he could still display his strength and resist against possible dangers while escaping with his life.
But at this moment, he was embroiled in a battle with the illusory realm and could not focus on the enemy at all.
‘Is it Dong Bo Xue Ying?’
‘He, how did he become so strong?’ Monarch Qi Hu did not dare believe, ‘The previous time we fought, he did not have such a frightening illusory realm technique.’
…
Within the courtyard.
Xue Ying watched as how Monarch Qi Hu was continuously trembling. He could not help but sigh inwardly: ‘The illusory realm technique might sometimes be inadequate, and yet it might be mighty at times.’
Facing cultivators with a weaker heart realm, the effects of the illusory realm were outstanding! It was much better than engaging in direct combat.
But its effects towards those with a stronger heart realm were weak.
And the ‘Vermillion Nightmare illusory realm’ was an ancient cultivation technique. It was stronger than just solely using illusory techniques. It could forcefully pull the enemies into the illusory realm continuously, influencing the strength of the enemies. Thus, just this technique alone could reach the sixth level Star Pagoda strength. Even those who could maintain awareness would be forced to multitask and fight against the illusory realm. They would naturally become weaker when engaging in combat!
‘Monarch Qi Hu is no longer able to resist.’ Xue Ying shook his head.
“Mercy, mercy…” Monarch Qi Hu barely shouted out. He could not even open his eyes. Clearly, he was still struggling in the illusory realm.
“Descend.”
Xue Ying did not show any mercy.
If it were an ordinary cultivator, it was impossible for Xue Ying to even agree to the transaction in the past. But because the two commanders of Chief Devil Cliff were infamous for being devils, Xue Ying chose to accept the conditions. Killing these huge devils would mean saving many weaker ones. The rules of the Great Void Heaven Temple also encouraged disciples to kill these devils. It was only within the region that World Ancestor governed that other holy grounds did not impose this rule on killing all devils.
Cultivators like Xue Ying who came fighting alone was not considered a huge matter.
Instead, if a large batch of experts were led by the Great Void Heaven Temple Palace Master in to kill all devils within the Myriad Ancient Sacred World, it would naturally rile the World Ancestor!
“Multi-Layered Dark World.”
“Hong~”
Multiple layers of Dark World descended and envelop around the body of the trembling Monarch Qi Hu. The illusory realm descended and turned into reality. It also began absorbing the surrounding World Energy greedily, forming waves of movement and causing the surrounding to fluctuate. There was a staggering total of 2,500 layers that could be perceived at the membrane of this dark world!
If one said that the power of 600 layers of Dark World was comparable to the Sky Punishment Edge, then a staggering 2,500 layers of Dark World far transcended a single Sky Punishment Edge! The reason why Xue Ying unleashed so many layers of Dark World was that he could completely converge the power of this move inside the Dark World without letting it spill over to the surroundings. If he threw in too many Sky Punishment Edges, it would affect a considerable area around him.
This palace contained many other servants, though they were forcefully captured by Monarch Qi Hu. They were just some of the weaker cultivators, and there was no point letting this battle affect them.
“Hong!”
At the same time when he displayed the Vermillion Nightmare illusory realm, 2,500 layers of Dark World was the limit of what Xue Ying could unleash.
This Dark World rapidly shrunk onto Monarch Qi Hu and soon exploded. Everything within the Dark World was annihilated. The body of Monarch Qi Hu had turned into a stream of water amidst the explosion.
The surroundings regained its usual peace after that.
But the distorting flow of water soon turned back into Monarch Qi Hu’s original humanoid appearance. His aura was clearly much weaker.
That time he had withstood three Sky Punishment Edges, but firstly, the Sky Punishment Edges bombarded on him individually. This time, the power of the Multi-Layered Dark World far transcended even the power of the Sky Punishment Edges. It also converged onto one point. Secondly, Monarch Qi Hu could teleport and shave off the incoming impact, but now, he no longer had the concentration to resist against the attack.
Naturally, this strike greatly injured him.
“I, I am unreconciled…” Monarch Qi Hu let out a sound. His eyes could no longer open.
“Hong.”
Xue Ying once again sent down multiple layers of Dark World.
One time, two times, three times.
Every time Xue Ying would send a total of 2,500 layers of Dark World. Once he unleashed the attack five times later, the body of Monarch Qi Hu was utterly destroyed.
‘Such a powerful body. If not for the illusory realm, he could unleash his full potential… even if he stands there and let me attack, as long as he takes the initiative to dissipate the incoming force, he should be able to resist a few dozen of my technique.’ Xue Ying felt dumbstruck. Xue Ying himself would likely die from a single strike if he did not control his body and let it be struck by it.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying waved his hand, causing the treasures left behind by Monarch Qi Hu to fly into his hand. His vision unknowingly landed on a piece of stone mirror. Even as Monarch Qi Hu fell into the illusory realm, he was still grabbing hold of this stone mirror tightly.
‘Stone mirror?’ Xue Ying faintly felt that it was something unique and could not help but begin to scrutinize it thoroughly.
…
Myriad Ancient Sacred World, within the World Ancestor palace.
It was located in a hidden location. Finding it without someone pointing the way was impossible. There were currently two figures standing within the World Ancestor Palace. One of them was Black Emperor, and the other was a thin and small male wearing an azure robe. His eyes contained some slight innocence, and his mouth was huge. When he smiled, it was exceptionally bright.
But there was nobody who thought that he was an amusing person.
Because this was an existence whom countless cultivators across the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void actually looked up to! His strength was only secondary to Sacred Master! He might not have as many techniques as Ancestor Sorcerer, and neither was he someone like Ancestor Mother who only hid in his turtle shell back at his territory. He was someone who dared to fight head-on with the Sacred Master. His physique was so powerful that it reached an unfathomable stage.
He was the World Ancestor!
He was the person who spread the devour-class cultivation system around the world. Countless devils were wantonly devouring other beings, and the absolute majority of them did so because of this devour-class system!
However, none dared to criticize ‘World Ancestor’, since those who dared to do so would suffer from a mad pursuit by World Ancestor himself!
“Interesting, interesting.” The thin World Ancestor chuckled with an ear-piercing screech. There was a scene which twisted and formed in the space ahead showing Xue Ying checking out the stone mirror.
“Such coincidence?” Black Emperor was slightly startled. He then chuckled, “Senior Disciple Brother, it seems that the fate of this Dong Bo brat is intertwined quite closely with our lineage. After cultivating the inheritance I left, he has even gotten the treasure you left to the world.”
If the conversation between the two of them were publicized, it would absolutely incur a huge sensation.
Because Black Emperor had never shouted World Ancestor as ‘Senior Disciple Brother’ before.
“Since it landed in his hands, we should see how he fares in the future.” The thin and small World Ancestor laughed mischievously.
This treasure.
It had many names. ‘Stone Heart’, ‘Brutal Shield’, ‘Scale’, ‘Ancient Armor’… the names might seem ordinary, though it had appeared in the hands of many ancient cultivators before. Many had discovered how unique this treasure was, allowing it to become famous over time. There were even many bloody fights which started between cultivators vying for this object! After that, World Ancestor stealthily took it away, changed its appearance before sending it stealthily into the hands of a few ancient cultivators.
It would usually be passed on from cultivator to cultivator over the years. After a period, World Ancestor would transform its appearance before sending it back circulating between more cultivators.
This time, the treasure was changed into the shape of a ‘stone mirror’. It had only been circulated around five Unity realm experts, so it had not gained its reputation in this current timeline yet. At this moment, this stone mirror landed in the hands of Xue Ying.
“Our lineage has two branches. He had gotten my branch of inheritance before obtaining the treasure that Senior Disciple Brother passed on. With his comprehension ability, it is likely that he would walk far in this path of ancient cultivation.” Black Emperor chuckled, “He might even be qualified to join our sect.”
“Hmph, this darling treasure of mine has been passed on for so long, yet there are only three of us including the Little Disciple Brother of ours.” The thin and small World Ancestor sneered, “Just based on this brat?”
“It is hard to say.” Black Emperor felt smug.
The thin and small World Ancestor sneered before shaking his head. He waved his hand before causing the scene ahead to disappear.

chapters.title: Chapter 898 - Mysterious
chapters.content:
Chapter 898: Mysterious
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within Cang Lang Mountain Range inside the hidden palace where Monarch Qi Hu lived.
Many of the servants were gradually regaining their consciousness. Some of them were lying on the ground, and some were leaning against the walls. When they woke up, they were so frightened that they got up immediately! Because the rules within the palace were strict, and they were actually lying on the ground sleeping. According to the rules of the palace, such acts were punishable by death. They were all feeling horrified and uneasy.
“The palace arrays are gone!”
“All the arrays are gone.”
The attendants and servants soon discovered the changes.
The powerful arrays which were originally present across the palace had suddenly disappeared. Even the protective array located in the outer perimeter of the palace disappeared too.
“What is happening? Why did all the arrays disappear? I am responsible for controlling the monitoring array, but the array plate has disappeared.” Many servants felt weird. They were even discussing between themselves softly.
“Previously, I suddenly fell into deep sleep. When I wake up, I saw quite a few others were sleeping too.”
“You slept too? I did as well.”
As they continued conversing through voice transmissions, they discovered startingly that not too long ago, all of them had actually entered into a deep sleep. It was primarily because their realms were too low that they could not recall what happened after entering the illusory realm.
Suddenly, a voice reverberated across the entire palace.
“The master of this palace ‘Monarch Qi Hu’ has died. You are all free from now on.” A cold voice echoed across the hall, causing the servants to first stare blankly before turning into joy. They were clear that if their master was still alive, it was impossible for him to not react to this mysterious, powerful voice reverberating across the entire palace.
“We are free?”
The guards located at the outer perimeters started trying to fly further from the palace. In the past, they could not escape due to the presence of the arrays.
But now, they were not hindered at all as they flew out.
“Hahaha…”
“We are free to leave. We can leave now!”
“Finally, we are finally free.”
All the servants and attendants within the palace were feeling the incomparable excitement. Some had even knelt down and bawled out loud. Because ever since they were captured here, the past few million years were a nightmare to them! Ever since they were caught over, they had to serve Monarch Qi Hu cautiously and solemnly. Monarch Qi Hu had always been living in seclusion and did not go out to kill and devour others. Thus, the moment he could not endure the itchiness of his mouth, he would simply swallow a servant!
Their days were spent in darkness. They could not see any hope-they only saw as their comrades were occasionally devoured…
Monarch Qi Hu’s horrifying strength deterred these servants from having any thoughts of rebelling. They could only endure in agony, hoping that the next unlucky person to be eaten would not be him. After all, Monarch Qi Hu required a large batch of subordinates serving him, and it was impossible for him to devour everyone.
“Many thanks, senior.”
“Many thanks, senior for saving us.”
Many of the servants could not help but shout out.
“This favor is something I will remember for eternity.” Some had even resolved to escape as far as possible. They were afraid of being captured once again.
…
Above the cloud layer in the distance.
Xue Ying glanced at that palace. He saw how many servants and attendants were flying away in all directions and could not help but chuckle. The feeling of saving others was quite lovely.
My Heart as the World…
Many ancient and powerful cultivators had reached this heart realm. They called it ‘My Heart as the World’ too, though they comprehended different kinds of heart realm.
For instance, the ‘Sacred Master’, My Heart as the World. He treated all lives as dogs. Many beings were subservient to him and were willing to die for him. His gaze… was considered as the greatest glory to these subordinates. Even Primal Chaos giants and Cosmos Gods had to be subservient to him-a subservience from the core of their souls!
Or ‘Ancestor Sorcerer’, My Heart as the World. His world heart transcended everything, and he controlled the operation of the primitive Ancient Sacred World and the operation of the primal chaos void. He sought to exceed the myriad existences, and on this path of his, everything was his tool. That was why he dissected and researched the myriad existences. Everything he could use would be used, and in the end, he stepped on a Dao path belonging to him alone.
As for Forefather Tian Yu, Jade Light Master, Void Primogenitor, and others, their hearts were compassionate. The Voidwalker lineage system that Void Primogenitor imparted down had an even harsher requirement on the cultivator’s personality.
Xue Ying was similar!
Strictly speaking, of the five great sacred worlds, the Ancient Sacred World and Ancestor Mother World belonged to the two great religions. The Sacred Master and Ancestor Mother were quite similar. Only Sacred Master was much stronger. The Myriad Ancient Sacred World’s World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer were quite similar-they only cared about themselves. They would passively look on as others die. And the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World and Eastern Unicorn Sacred World paid attention to the lives of countless weaker beings. They would try their best to protect the weak and feeble, allowing them to grow. Those who dared to slaughter wantonly would be killed by their experts!
Thus, Luo City Lord also stood on the side of these two sacred worlds. He painstakingly refined six Star Pagodas and gave them to the six great holy grounds.
Naturally, ‘Ancestor Bone’ did not have this compassionate heart.
The heart personality of Ancestor Bone was slightly more special in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World and Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. Naturally, he suffered from ostracization. Ancestor Bone was not really too willing to rely on the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, but it’s a pity that he was too weak. He was even ranked at the bottom amongst the third level of final realm existences. World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer from the Myriad Ancient Sacred World truly disdained him. It was only Luo City Lord who was willing to accept him as a form of respect to ‘Yuan’, allowing him to stay within the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World.
******
On the beach, Xue Ying was seated cross-legged there. He was currently holding on to a stone mirror.
‘This stone mirror is actually so mysterious.’
Xue Ying had not thought that he would be able to reap such a massive harvest after eliminating Monarch Qi Hu. This seemed to be a piece of mirror ground from ancient stone. Furthermore, the reflection of human on it was very fuzzy. Nevertheless, its mysteriousness had frightened Xue Ying the moment he held it. He had even left Cang Lang Mountain Range to a beach far away to start inspecting this item thoroughly.
On the stone mirror, many dense, colorful patterns appeared. To the left, the designs had formed the shape of a bright flower. To the right, the designs had formed a war flag. Closely following that, both these pictures gradually intermixed at the center of the stone mirror surface… forming a wicked black flower.
‘This is truly mysterious.’
Xue Ying lowered his head. The more he scrutinized the object, the more he got engrossed into it.
That colorful flower… after being evolved by many times according to his current realm of “Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance” eventually formed a composition that was entirely at the profound level of Primal Chaos realm.
That war flag… when it was evolved according to his understanding of the “Imperial Dragon inheritance” had similarly reached the Primal Chaos level. This process of deduction was actually a gradual one. It enabled him to have a better understanding.
And at the center when the two intermixed…
It was the fusion of two ancient cultivation inheritances, fusing two different inheritances into one entity that was stronger!
‘I’ve cultivated these two ancient cultivation inheritances. It was able to guide me along cultivating these two inheritances and to fuse them perfectly as well?’ Xue Ying felt startled and stunned, ‘If Black Emperor cultivated the four inheritances of his, wouldn’t it be that this mirror could deduce all four inheritances and aid in the fusion of them?’
‘But it seems to only guide ancient cultivation techniques.’
Xue Ying discovered that.
He had currently cultivated three huge systems! The laws and profound mysteries system, the Voidwalker system and the ancient cultivation system. And this mysterious stone mirror only guided and deduced techniques in the ancient cultivation system.
‘Fortunately, I chose two ancient cultivation inheritances that are currently targeted at the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter. My gradual understanding of these two ancient cultivation techniques would also support in my understanding of both Daos.’ Xue Ying was an expert close to the seventh level Star Pagoda strength, and he already had a slightly clear knowledge of what the Primal Chaos realm encompassed.
Currently, with the stone mirror gradually guiding him deeper…
It was like a street lamp lighting up the path.
‘With this huge support, my journey towards the Primal Chaos realm will be much simpler.’ Xue Ying revealed a grin. Naturally, it was only on the Dao of Mirage. He had not even touched the boundary of Primal Chaos realm on the Dao of Slaughter. Even if he saw how the stone mirror guided him, Xue Ying would still have to spend a long time studying it.
The stone mirror might be mysterious, but it was only guiding the cultivator. If the cultivator did not have a broad foundation, it was impossible for him to breakthrough too.
‘Even guiding me is a miraculous effect already.’
‘There are even some incomplete ancient cultivation techniques that I deduce using the guidance from the stone mirror, allowing me to create entirely new techniques.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Why did I never hear before such a mysterious treasure? And why is it not as famous?’

chapters.title: Chapter 899 - Offending Whom?
chapters.content:
Chapter 899: Offending Whom?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
But Xue Ying was wrong.
The stone mirror actually existed in all sorts of appearances in the past. It landed in the hands of many ancient cultivators and had caused blood to rain. The moment it became too famous or if it had stayed in the hands of an ancient cultivator for too long, World Ancestor would unleash certain techniques making the stone mirror disappear. And after that, It would land in the hands of some other ancient cultivators.
As the stone mirror was passed down, many ancient cultivation inheritances had been created because of it. Many experts actually interacted with the stone mirror-more than half of the Primal Chaos ancient cultivators in Myriad Ancient Sacred World actually used it before! Comparatively, Primal Chaos ancient cultivators outside the Myriad Ancient Sacred World who got it were relatively fewer-about 10%.
Even still, the rate of propagation for this stone mirror was quite horrifying.
‘No matter what, since this opportunity has arrived in my hands, I should properly utilize it to improve my strength. It’ll be better if I could step into the Primal Chaos realm in one fell swoop.’ Xue Ying was looking forward to the day he could step into the Primal Chaos realm since his body and soul would undergo a transformation. His current strength might be comparable to some of the weaker Primal Chaos experts, but he lacked in many aspects still.
For instance, the souls of Primal Chaos experts were far stronger than his! They could easily send their incarnations to other sacred worlds despite placing their true bodies in another.
Xue Ying was a Unity expert. His incarnation could not travel too far from his true body. Once it reached a certain distance, his willpower would no longer be able to maintain the incarnation, causing it to dissipate!
One could easily see the difference from the distance that one could send their incarnations to.
Like ‘Ancestor Devil’, his true body was in the Great Void Heaven Temple. But that time when Xue Ying attacked the base of the Ancient Sacred Religion, Ancestor Devil could directly send his incarnation over after a single voice transmission! This was practically 10-20% the distance of the span of a sacred world. Unity experts could not send their incarnations so far even if they were stronger. They could not even do so at 100 millionths of this distance.
That was the qualitative difference!
The transformation of the soul, and the change of the body. That was what Xue Ying immensely looked forward to.
…
Walking on the Myriad Ancient Sacred World, seeing an enormous and dark valley that spanned across trillions of kilometers, stepping across many vast lakes, walking across with his fleshy body through the Flame God Mountain…
There were all sorts of unique places here. Xue Ying would observe how the operating laws had shown itself in nature before experiencing the guidance by the stone mirror. Xue Ying’s realm gradually deepened. He had already simplified the Apocalyptic Fifth Sword and cultivated the “Imperial Dragon Inheritance”. In addition to the guidance by the stone mirror, Xue Ying first broke through in the Dao of Slaughter and finally grasped the Apocalyptic Sixth Sword.
Naturally, he had already grasped hold of the Sky Punishment Edge. Thus, learning the Apocalyptic Sixth Sword did not improve his strength at all. It was only his close combat strength that multiplied. He improved the “Imperial Dragon Inheritance” to a stage that matched that of the “Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance”, allowing Xue Ying’s body to become even stronger. The scale on his body had a solid defense, and his palms were abnormally strong.
‘I’ve covered up my weaknesses.’ Xue Ying appreciated this ancient cultivation technique.
He was not anxious.
The Apocalyptic Sixth Sword would eventually come, and breaking through was naturally easy for him. Only stepping into the Primal Chaos realm would be much harder for him! But he had touched the boundaries of the Primal Chaos realm in both the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter, of which he had accumulated more experiences in the Dao of Mirage.
******
Within a vast desert in the Myriad Ancient Sacred World, there was an oasis filled with vibrant life.
On the oasis, there was a tribe flourishing there with a population of about several hundred thousand in number. There were weak children amongst them who were Transcendents when they were born. But under the law suppression of the sacred world, they could not run fast. At the same time, they were practically the weakest life forms in the sacred world, and had to depend on the tribe to survive.
It might be possible for an ultra-strong expert to emerge amongst them in the future, but for now, these children required the protection of the tribe.
Within the tribe, there were also powerful warriors. The strongest leader of the tribe was even a ‘Void God Unity realm’ expert! He had painstakingly constructed different arrays to allow the tribe to survive until now.
“Hua.”
A huge crimson vessel appeared above the tribe from the void. Many figures flew out immediately from the vessel. Almost all of them were in a black robe. Only the commander who was a thin old man was wearing a crimson gown. His eyes were faintly burning in cold flames. Those who were stared by him would feel a chill deep down their hearts.
“Start moving. Be quick.” The crimson-robed old man coldly ordered.
“Yes.” This group of black-robed subordinates was all at the Unity realm. They practically flashed at the same time before landing in different places of the tribe. All of them brought out a piece of black talisman, and for a moment, these 12 black talismans were activated at the same time. “Hong~” The terrifying array was displaced by the 12 pieces of talisman, causing black clouds to form above the tribe.
As the dark clouds covered the entire sky, it made the tribe people feel a sense of unease.
“Mother, what is happening?” A child was so frightened that he hid in the embrace of his mother. His mother was a World Deity, yet she was similarly nervous and uneasy as she stared at the dark clouds that formed in the sky, “Relax child. Nothing will happen. The tribe master will definitely protect us.”
Nevertheless, the tribe master who was like the god of protection for the entire tribe was also feeling uneasy.
He had already controlled the array of the entire tribe to deal against the incoming invaders, but the other parties moved too quickly. It was almost the next instant when these dark clouds formed.
“I wonder who this senior is. If there is anything we can do, we will definitely not dare to disobey against this senior.” The tribe master announced loudly. His voice crossed through the array and transmitted into the outer world.
“I want all of you to die. Can you not disobey it?” The cold voice reverberated in the world.
The tribe master was stunned.
The countless tribe people felt their hearts trembling too.
“A group of ants.” The cold voice was filled with disdain.
“Hong.”
The rolling dark clouds in the sky suddenly descended. The arrays within the tribe were a joke. These dark clouds had easily bypassed the arrays like illusions, enveloping the entire tribe. It invaded into the bodies of every single person, including the only Unity realm expert.
“We can’t move. Why can’t we move!” Everyone within the tribe discovered this point. The energy within their body had been sealed. Even the movement of their bodies was affected. Even though they could still hear with their ears and see with their eyes or move with their mouth, their bodies remained unmoving.
Following that, the rolling dark cloud dissipated completely.
The 12 black-robed men gathered together and said respectfully to that crimson-robed old man: “Sir, everyone has been captured alive.”
“Mn.” The red-robed old man’s thin and skeletal expression looked downwards. He nonchalantly said, “The numbers we captured this time is enough. The Palace Master requires 300,000 living experiments. You all should begin selecting them according to the requests of the Palace Master. As for the remaining ones, lock them up and give them to me. I hope that the remaining few experimental bodies would suffice to help me with cultivating my secret technique.”
“Sir will definitely succeed.”
“Sir, why not let me go capture more living experiment bodies? The more, the better.” A black-robed man was trying to fawn on their master.
The crimson-robed old man looked at him before revealing a grin. Though his grin was frightening: “I’ll first bring all these experimental beings of this tribe back. You bring two other people to capture more.”
“Yes yes.”
As they discussed, they did not keep it under cover. Instead, they were speaking with their voices loudly.
All the people within the tribe might not be able to move, but there were some Void God experts with excellent hearing abilities. They were able to clearly listen to the discussion, causing all their expressions to change the moment they heard ‘experiment bodies’.
“It is the hex cultivation, and a wicked one. They plan to capture us and use us for all sorts of wicked experiments.” The experts within the tribe were terrified. They would rather be killed than to be used as bodies for experiments in wicked hex cultivation. The hex cultivation researched the myriad existences, and naturally, they would also study the body and soul. Of which the wicked cultivators might even treat countless cultivators as experiment materials.
“We are doomed.”
“The tribe is doomed.”
The experts within the tribe who could listen to what the discussion was felt terrified and desperate. They hated the fact that they could not escape. It’s a pity that there was a gap in strength, preventing them to even be qualified in fighting for their lives.
“Hex cultivation?”
A cold voice sounded.
A white-robed teenager appeared. His expression was filled with fury. He looked at all the tribe people who had been inflicted with the secret technique and those black-robed men and the leading crimson-robed man in the sky.
“Who are you?” The crimson-robed man’s cold eyes were staring at Xue Ying. He coldly mentioned.
“Who is your Palace Master? I would like to know which hex cultivator is so sinister.” Xue Ying said. He had a favorable impression of the hex cultivation because his wife cultivated that, and even his teacher Bloodshed God-Emperor cultivated it!
The crimson-robed old man chuckled after seeing it: “It seems we have encountered someone who wishes to save the weak. Since that’s the case, let’s capture him and offer him to the Palace Master! A Unity realm experiment body is not bad.”
“Yes.”
The 12 black-robed men acknowledged the orders immediately.
“Hong.”
Xue Ying unleashed his Plate Ripple Diagram domain. The ripples rapidly invaded through the bodies of the black-robed men. These black-robed men were considered the lowest ranking errand men and were only at the first or second level Star Pagoda strength. They were strong only after relying on the talismans bestowed by the Palace Master. That crimson-robed old man might be an expert, but he was merely at the third level Star Pagoda strength! Under the entanglement of the thin ripple strands, all of them were restricted.
The expression of the crimson-robed man shifted significantly. He tried struggling, but could not get out.
Xue Ying coldly looked at him. The 12 black-robed men and the crimson-robed man were entangled. The crimson-robed man was even roaring out: “You have brought yourself a disaster! Do you know who you offended? Ah?”
Disaster?
Xue Ying calmly watched. He was close to the seventh level Star Pagoda strength. Even if terrifying existences like Primal Chaos Hall Master or Black Emperor acted, relying on the treasures given by Forefather Tian Yu worth several thousand Origin World Rocks would give him the ability to withstand for a moment or two. By then, he would have long escaped using his ultra-long distance teleportation! As for those who were not at the level of Black Emperor, he had no need to even worry.
Xue Ying did not believe that the other party was a Cosmos God.
Because there were only two within the entire Myriad Ancient Sacred World-Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor!
“You are seeking death.” The crimson-robed man was becoming madder. He roared, “Hurry up and let us off. I have already reported to the Palace Master. When he is here, it’ll be too late even if you were to regret. By then, you would be begging to die!”
“Oh? It seems your Palace Master is quite capable of making me beg to die?” Xue Ying coldly sneered.

chapters.title: Chapter 900 - Wicked-Eyed Palace Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 900: Wicked-Eyed Palace Master
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Hurry up and let us off. You can still live if you flee with your life now. Otherwise-” The crimson-robed old man was thinking of intimidating the other party, but closely following that, he opened his eyes wide since he could not even utter a single word.
Xue Ying coldly glanced at him.
He had already sealed their strength. It was naturally easy for him to stop them from speaking. According to his temper, Xue Ying would have killed these devils who captured countless living beings without pardon. Those black-robed men had even wanted to fawn on this crimson-robed old man, taking the initiative of going out to capture more innocent beings.
They should all die! But now, he was not in a rush to kill them. Instead, he wanted them to lead the ‘Palace Master’ who was backing them over!
‘I would like to see what is your identity.’
Xue Ying thought with his heart, directly guiding those 12 black-robed men into an illusory world. Within the illusory world, he had easily led them to mention who that Palace Master was! Because this was not an important secret, and that Palace Master hadn’t implemented any forbidding techniques. Thus, the black-robed men obediently told him everything within the illusory world.
‘So it is him?’ Xue Ying coldly snorted, ‘He is still considered an expert.’
…
After a moment.
The 12 black-robed men and the red-robed man fell onto the ground unmoving. All sorts of weapons which they brought were snatched over by Xue Ying. The crimson-robed man felt incensed after seeing it, yet he could not speak. He could only think inwardly: ‘When Palace Master arrives, he will have to spit all the things he stole anyway. Furthermore, he would also die!”
Xue Ying merely waved his hand, refining all the storage treasures. Following which, many pieces of black talisman flew out.
’12 pieces of command talisman.’ Xue Ying nodded. The several hundred thousand people of this tribe had been schemed against. The soul of every single person within had been permeated by the black fog. Using ordinary methods, Xue Ying had to expel the black fog out from the soul of every tribesman one by one, and that took too much effort. Furthermore, how long would he have to spend trying to expel the fog from several hundred thousand tribesmen?
After checking through, he immediately understood that these 12 black-robed men had the method of controlling this black fog.
‘There are really many kinds of weird methods in the hex cultivation system.’ Xue Ying split his attention into 12 pieces and controlled all 12 of the black talismans at the same time.
“Hong~”
The 12 pieces of black talisman immediately activated an array, resonating with the black fog located within the bodies of those several hundred thousand tribesmen.
‘Everything, come out now.’ Xue Ying thought. At this moment, the black fog began floating out from the surface of the body of the tribesmen. The black fog soon converged into a vast dark cloud and this dark cloud soon dissipated.
“We can move.”
“We can move.” The tribesmen began standing up. Even the children and teenager began climbing up.
These tribesmen felt beyond excitement. But they were still nervously watching in the direction of Xue Ying. Previously, they saw everything that had happened and knew that it was this white-robed teenager expert who saved them. But they had heard of the crazed shoutings by the crimson-robed old man… and clearly, there was a formidable expert behind him.
“Sou sou sou.”
Over ten figures flew over and landed in front of Xue Ying. They respectfully bowed to him.
“Senior has saved our tribe, and this great favor is something we do not know how to repay.” The leading tribe leader was filled with tears. He did not dare think of what would happen if this white-robed teenager had not appeared. Everyone in his own clan would become experiment bodies for the wicked hex cultivation, and that was genuinely horrifying. Being experimented on, they might not die and would instead be used for all sorts of experiments. It would be more painful than death.
Xue Ying indifferently chuckled, “Just a minor effort.’
Since he was strong, he had to take on more responsibility. To him, this was merely as simple as lifting his hands. But to the tribe, it was allowing them to escape from a huge calamity.
The more beings he saved, the more Xue Ying would experience this.
“That senior saved our entire tribe?”
“Yes. If not for that senior, our tribe will be doomed.” In the distant, a young man was asking his mother about this. The young man soon gave Xue Ying a look of worship.
This scene happened in many areas within the tribe.
Many children and young men were at this moment, looking at that white-robed teenager with utmost admiration. In the future, they would still remember this scene and that ultra-strong expert who had saved their tribe. They were looking forward to a day when they could become an expert as well, and become qualified to stand in front of the savior of their tribe. That would be their ultimate glory.
‘These brats.’ Xue Ying chuckled. Some of the adults who were experienced did not dare to look him directly in the eyes since they were afraid of offending Xue Ying. But those children and young men did not know too much.
“Senior.”
The tribe leader looked at the crimson-robed old man and the 12 black-robed men who were lying on the ground unmoving and said, “There seems to be a more formidable expert behind the back of these wicked hex cultivators. Senior should still be careful.”
“Rest assured.” Xue Ying answered, “I am naturally confident. Also, you should bring your entire tribe away. I am afraid that the one backing them dare not appear. He might even vent his anger on you guys after I leave.”
“Yes.”
The tribe leader became shocked the moment he heard it. He knew that this place would be turning into a battlefield soon. He no longer dared to let his tribe remain here. He added, “Senior must really be careful. Hex cultivators have all sorts of weird methods, and it is hard to defend against all of them. I’ll shamelessly leave first.”
“Go.” Xue Ying nodded.
It was quick bringing away the tribe. As a cultivator, he could simply place his tribesmen into his Eden treasure, and the tribe leader would then directly teleport away by himself.
Strictly speaking, the Eden treasure was considered quite safe since that was a little inner world created within. To cultivators, it would not be as helpful as a cosmos, much less the sacred world! Within the Eden world, it was quite unusual for a World Deity to emerge. As for ‘True Gods’, it was almost impossible for cultivators inside it to reach that realm! But in a sacred world, True Gods were everywhere. Void Gods were barely considered experts.
…
Within the desert oasis, the tribe was no longer there.
Xue Ying sat by himself cross-legged on the floor. The 12 black-robed men and crimson-robed man were unmoving by the side.
“They are here.” Xue Ying opened his eyes and looked forward.
“Hong long~”
A Primal Chaos Flying Ship tore through the spatial passage and flew out. Following that, the smooth and glossy external wall of the vessel formed a cabin door where two figures flew out at the same time. One of them was a cold male with a gray robe over him. He could not control that evil aura which emitted from his body. At the same time, he looked at Xue Ying-it felt as if a horrifying monster probing Xue Ying.
‘He has re-created his entire body and soul using this wicked hex cultivation. He should be quite strong.’ Xue Ying thought.
This cold male was called ‘Wicked-Eyed Palace Master’.
He was at the fifth level Star Pagoda strength and was even a well-known figure. Being a wicked hex cultivator, he delved into the research of body and soul and had also altered his own body and soul. He was not someone easy to handle. Dealing with the two commanders of the Chief Devil Cliff would not be as hard as dealing with this person!
But Xue Ying did not place him in his eyes. Even Monarch Qi Hu of the two commanders from Chief Devil Cliff who had an extremely powerful survival ability remained helpless in front of Xue Ying.
‘And this person beside…’ Xue Ying saw an old man who walked over with the gray-robed cold male.
This was a white-haired old man. He seemed gentle and had a simple robe over him. He kept his aura entirely within.
As Xue Ying observed these two people, they were similarly observing Xue Ying. They were more well-informed than the previous few subordinates and were able to recognize Xue Ying who did not disguise himself at all.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying from the Great Void Heaven Temple.” The white-haired unadorned old man continued, “Junior Disciple Brother, I’ve heard that he is already at the sixth level Star Pagoda strength, and specialized most in the ‘Sky Punishment Edge’ created by Dark World Master.”
“Senior Disciple Brother Lei.” The Wicked-Eyed Palace Master instead said unpretentiously, “A battle isn’t about seeing the strongest aspect. It is also about the weakness of the other party. This Dong Bo Xue Ying has merely gotten the absolute art of Dark World Master. He is able to win when facing against fools like Black Chief Devil. But in front of me, hmph hmph, Senior Disciple Brother Lei should just wait for a moment. Since he dares to disrupt my affairs, I’ll naturally teach him a lesson.”

chapters.title: Chapter 901 - Weakness
chapters.content:
Chapter 901: Weakness
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The crimson-robed old man and the 12 black-robed men lying on the ground were anxiously looking forward to being saved by their master. They wanted to see this white-robed expert beg for mercy in regret too!
“Dong Bo Xue Ying.”
Wicked-Eyed Palace Master stepped on the void. He stared at Xue Ying from afar. A sinister aura emanated from his body which billowed in all directions, “This is the Myriad Ancient Sacred World. You are from the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, yet you dare to be so unbridled here in the Myriad Ancient Sacred World? And even dare to disrupt my affair? You are quite daring.”
“The Myriad Ancient Sacred World is split into two. This is the region under World Ancestor and not Ancestor Sorcerer. Do you think you are qualified to say these?” Xue Ying shook his head.
“Hmph. Do you think I do not dare to kill you because you are an Inner Hall Elder from the Great Void Heaven Temple?” Wicked-Eyed Palace Master coldly laughed, “Right, I will not kill you. I can pardon you the crime of dying, but I will just take away all your treasures before allowing you to have a taste of some punishments which I have researched. In the end, I will send you completely intact to the Great Void Heaven Temple. I believe that the Great Void Heaven Temple will have nothing to say about this.”
“You seem to be very confident.” Xue Ying nodded, “Let me see if you have the ability to do so. Oh, I should eliminate them first. There is no reason for them to live since you are here.”
The moment he finished speaking…
“Pu pu pu…”
The red-robed old man and 12 black-robed men all opened their eyes wide in dread. Closely following that, their aura turned dark, and their souls that were sealed soon dissipated. The remnant energy from the Plate Ripple Diagram on their bodies even caused them to turn into powder.
The pupils of Wicked-Eyed Palace Master dilated as he saw this. His expression became even more savage. He glared at Xue Ying, letting out sinister laughter: “Very good. Very good. It seems that a young brat who has just learned the absolute art of Dark World Master dares to act so rampantly in front of me. I’ll let you know… hex cultivation isn’t something those Destruction Devils from the Star Pagoda could compete with.”
“Hua hua hua.”
The eyes of the Wicked-Eyed Palace Master abruptly emitted a terrifying suppression. His eyes shot out two black streams. If one carefully scrutinized them, he would discover that within these two black streams contained tiny black-carapaced insects. There were a total of 100 black-carapaced that flew out of the eyes of Wicked-Eyed Palace Master towards Xue Ying.
Closely following that, the body of Wicked-Eyed Palace Master suddenly expanded. He grew out six arms, and his skin turned gray. There were even all sorts of weird ‘eye’ diagrams on his naked gray skin. These diagrams of ‘eye’ were all over his body, and they emitted a black savage aura which the naked eyes could see.
“Die.” Wicked-Eyed Palace Master moved, turning into a stream of light as he charged at Xue Ying.
More than 100 black insects also charged forward in front of Wicked-Eyed Palace Master. Nevertheless, Xue Ying was calmly watching-he did not defend himself at all.
“Mn?”
Wicked-Eyed Palace Master began to doubt himself after seeing this.
Initially, he had made other preparations meant to deal against Xue Ying. Even though he might be arrogant on the surface, deep in his heart, he was solemn since Xue Ying’s ‘Sky Punishment Edge’ was genuinely powerful! But the other party did not seem to do anything against his incoming assault. That made Wicked-Eyed Palace Master suspect: ‘Too arrogant. Hmph hmph, if he doesn’t try his best during battle, then it’ll be easier for me to win.’
According to the intelligence he collected, he had already long prepared a plan to defeat Xue Ying. From how he sees, Xue Ying might be strong in the offense, but because he was too young, he did not have time to cover his weaknesses, and his body was much weaker. This weakness in his body was present when compared to others like Wicked-Eyed Palace Master, Black Chief Devil, and other experts.
In reality…
Before cultivating the “Imperial Dragon Inheritance”, just by relying on the augmentation the Voidwalker system had on his body, Xue Ying’s body was indeed his weakness because the Voidwalker system did not have too great of an advantage once it reached the Unity and Primal Chaos realm.
The Voidwalkers had an overwhelming advantage during earlier stages. Once it reached the later stages of cultivation, it was no longer as strong as other systems. Instead, it was the ‘void-ification’ and control towards the void that a Voidwalker excelled in. Even his skills in escaping and survival were very formidable!
But what about his physique?
Usually, it was those who cultivated the ancient cultivation, the strongest warrior system and the hex cultivation system that outshined in this. They could refine their bodies to a horrifying stage. Xue Ying cultivated the “Imperial Dragon Inheritance”, improving it to the sixth level Star Pagoda strength, and naturally, his physical body had also become much stronger. Furthermore, he could even cover himself with a plate of armor that was comparable to the toughness of middle-grade Void God weapons!
The Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance was primarily about the illusory realm. It nourished his soul.
The Imperial Dragon Inheritance was all about slaughter, and it augmented his fleshy body.
‘He isn’t even doing his best during battle. Truly a fool.’ The many eye diagrams on the body of Wicked-Eyed Palace Master gradually lit up.
Suddenly-
Closely following a resounding cry, a red aura began spreading in all directions. It naturally covered those insects and Wicked-Eyed Palace Mater who were killing their way over.
“Mn?” The simple-looking old man who was watching the battle from afar became startled. He carefully looked over.
At this moment, there was a fiery-red bird that appeared behind the body of Xue Ying. It spread out its enormous wings and emitted a fiery-red aura.
‘Vermillion Nightmare inheritance? Illusory technique?’ The white-haired simple-looking old man felt his heart relaxing. It was not easy to make an illusory technique heaven-shaking. Trying to use it to deal against experts like Wicked-Eyed Palace Master was even harder, ‘According to my understanding, the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance at the Unity realm could barely affect experts at the fifth level Star Pagoda strength with slightly weaker heart realm.’
…
Yet the reality was completely different.
Wicked-Eyed Palace Master immediately fell into the illusory realm. He was having a hard time struggling out of it. When he was able to barely struggle out, he would once again be pulled into the illusory realm. Monarch Qi Hu did not have any ability to resist Xue Ying’s Vermillion Nightmare inheritance, and Wicked-Eyed Palace Master was not any superior to Monarch Qi Hu in his heart realm! He was even slightly weaker.
After falling into the illusory realm, he could no longer control those venomous insects since they had no sentience! If they had sentience, it was easy for the enemy to deal against them.
“Chi chi chi~” Countless ripples restricted those venomous insects easily. At the same time, they also restricted Wicked-Eyed Palace Master, sealing his soul.
Closely following that, Xue Ying kept his aura. The god bird Vermillion Nightmare behind his back fused into his body too.
Wicked-Eyed Palace Master was directly thrown onto the grass beside him by Xue Ying. Once he woke up, he widened his eyes in disbelief.
Defeated?
I was really defeated just like this? There were many other methods I have yet to display! I had yet to let this Xue Ying have a taste of my hex poison, but I was defeated already?
“Battle isn’t about seeing the strongest aspect. It is also about the weakness of the other party.” Xue Ying mocked, “To me, your heart realm is your weakness!”
Strictly speaking, the heart realm of Wicked-Eyed Palace Master was not really a weakness of his. It was considered average amongst fifth level Star Pagoda experts. But facing against Xue Ying who had great talent in the Dao of Mirage, and had improved the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance to the sixth level Star Pagoda strength, he who could not resist against the illusory realm would indeed be weak in his heart realm!
Illusory realm…
That targeted the other party’s soul directly. No matter how many techniques you had, or how strong your fleshy body was, or how many killing moves you had, if you could not resist against the illusory realm, your life and death would be controlled by Xue Ying.
“Illusory technique, how can it be.” Wicked-Eyed Palace Master did not even dare believe it that he would be defeated under the illusory technique. And the other party was similarly at the Unity realm too.
“Admirable, admirable.” The distant white-haired simple-looking old man said, “The Vermillion Nightmare inheritance shouldn’t be so strong at the Unity realm. You could actually improve the power of the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance, and talking about illusory techniques… you should be the first amongst the Unity realm experts across the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void.”
Unity realm experts at the sixth level Star Pagoda…
Were originally very few in number.
Before the rise of Xue Ying, there was not a single one at this level within the Great Void Heaven Temple of this generation. Currently, adding up all the sixth level Star Pagoda Unity realm experts across the five great sacred worlds and the primal chaos void, there were not more than 10 of them to his knowledge! Xue Ying was superbly strong in his illusory realm across them. Indeed, he was qualified to be ranked first in his illusory technique amongst Unity realm experts.
“In front of Thunder Pagoda Master, this minor technique isn’t worth mentioning.” Xue Ying chuckled.
Thunder Pagoda Master.
His true name was ‘Lei Yan’ and was more famous than Xue Ying across the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void. There were a total of five sixth level Star Pagoda experts including Xue Ying within the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, and the Myriad Ancient Sacred World. And Lei Yan was publicly acknowledged the strongest Unity realm expert for a long time within these three great sacred worlds. He had fought with Primal Chaos giants before, and it had long proven his strength.
“This isn’t any minor technique. Even I do not have the time to save this junior disciple brother of mine.” Thunder Pagoda Master shook his head, “But my junior disciple brother is also under the sect of Ancestor Sorcerer. So Elder Dong Bo can’t kill him.”
“I naturally know that.” Xue Ying nodded.
There were agreements within the three great sacred worlds as they teamed up against the two great religions. Even if the higher levels of the superpowers within the three great sacred worlds commit a crime, they could not be directly killed. Instead, they would be punished by fighting against the two great religions.
Others did not dare to directly kill Xue Ying, and Xue Ying did not dare to kill this Wicked-Eyed Palace Master too.
If he really did that…
It would be violating against the hidden rules of the three great sacred worlds, and the Great Void Heaven Temple could not protect him. He would have to die as well! Xue Ying was not that foolish.
“I will not kill him. Just like what he said.” Xue Ying grinned, “I can pardon you the crime of dying, but I will just take away all your treasures before allowing you to have a taste of some punishments by the my Great Void Heaven Temple, before sending you completely intact.”

chapters.title: Chapter 902 - Thunder Pagoda Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 902: Thunder Pagoda Master
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The expression of Wicked-Eyed Palace Master whose power was sealed and lying on the ground changed. He angrily shouted out: “Dong Bo Xue Ying, don’t go overboard!” Being an expert, he did not fear being punished. He would frequently experiment on himself when he was cultivating the hex cultivation, altering his body and even his soul! Even though he was not fearful of it, the act of taking all his treasures had turned Wicked-Eyed Palace Master crazy. Being a hex cultivator, he naturally paid great importance to resources. Many precious materials were collected over a long period, and for them to be snatched away at once was just like losing half his life.
Xue Ying glanced at him. He was too lazy to even speak. Instead, he merely waved his hand.
“Sou.”
The Wicked-Eyed Palace Master lying on the ground disappeared. He was kept into Xue Ying’s Eden treasure.
“Elder Dong Bo.” The white-haired simple-looking old man felt helpless as he stood in midair. He said, “Our hex cultivation requires plenty of resources for experiments. It isn’t easy to collect them. If you were to take all of his treasures, even though you did not kill this Junior Disciple Brother of mine, it is practically taking half his life away. Why not take a step back?”
“Take a step back? Thunder Pagoda Master, I might respect you, but previously, Wicked-Eyed Palace Master had acted against me, saying how he wanted to snatch all my treasures and even employ certain techniques to torture me, yet you did not react.” Xue Ying sneered, “Why? Now that your Junior Disciple Brother has been defeated and is in my hands, you are becoming anxious when I employ the same methods against him?”
Thunder Pagoda Master slightly frowned.
Xue Ying was ultimately an outsider. He did not care if Xue Ying suffered from any hardships or tortures. Now that his own junior disciple brother had suffered from such a huge loss, more importantly, he, Lei Yan, was still present here! The moment this matter was spread… many other experts under the sect of Ancestor Sorcerer would think that he, Lei Yan, was useless. He had simply let Xue Ying capture Wicked-Eyed Palace Master alive.
‘Who would have thought that his illusory technique is so formidable that even Wicked-Eyed could not resist against it.’ Thunder Pagoda Master thought.
Even if he personally acted, Wicked-Eyed Palace Master could employ different techniques and even resist using several survival treasures of his. To capture him alive? That was practically impossible!
Yet…
Wicked-Eyed Palace Master had actually encountered the number one illusionist amongst Unity realm experts of this generation-Xue Ying.
‘He had actually improved the illusory realm to this stage?’ Thunder Pagoda Master shook his head, ‘I’ve never heard of it previously. The Vermillion Nightmare inheritance is indeed an extremely formidable ancient cultivation technique specializing in illusory realms. But it is far from how effective Dong Bo Xue Ying actually used it. The ‘Dark World Master’ is indeed a genius expert within the ancient cultivation, but he merely relied on his talent in it to produce a Sky Punishment Edge.’
A Unity realm expert capturing someone like Wicked-Eyed Palace Master alive just using illusory realm solely was something unfathomable!
How would he know…
That Xue Ying was also talented in both the Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple. He had even made both Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster regard him as a vital disciple. Nevertheless, his talent in the Dao of Mirage was even greater! After obtaining the ancient cultivation “Vermillion Nightmare inheritance”, his means of employing the illusory realms had reached a genuinely frightening realm.
…
Even though Thunder Pagoda Master had complex feelings, he still blurted out: “Elder Dong Bo, you are making my life difficult. He is after all my junior disciple brother.”
“Who can he blame since he is weaker. This can’t be considered as bullying the weak.” Xue Ying responded.
If it were a Primal Chaos giant dealing against a Unity realm expert or a Cosmos God fighting against a Primal Chaos expert… then that was the strong bullying the weak!
If both parties were at the Unity realm, even the higher-ups under the sect of Ancestor Sorcerer would not find any good excuses to say anything about it.
“Since that’s the case.”
The expression of Thunder Pagoda Master turned frigid, “Then let me see how formidable Elder Dong Bo’s illusory realm is!”
“Haha, good. I also wish to compete with Thunder Pagoda Master.” The eyes of Xue Ying were filled with expectations too.
Lei Yan, Thunder Pagoda Master.
He was publicly acknowledged as the strongest Unity realm experts within the three great sacred worlds. He was absolutely at the sixth level Star Pagoda strength. It was said that when he attempted crossing the seventh level, he had killed more than half the Destruction Devils before failing at the final part. Besides, being a hex cultivator, he had many combat techniques. Even though there were a few other Unity realm experts who crossed through the sixth level Star Pagoda too in the three great sacred worlds, they were weaker by an entire level.
Xue Ying was quite curious about his own strength too. After cultivating the ancient cultivation, his soul had become stronger. Currently, he was able to unleash 15 Sky Punishment Edges with his full power! Xue Ying felt that he was entirely qualified to charge through the seventh level.
Thunder Pagoda Master was coincidentally here for him to measure his strength!
“Very good.”
The white-haired Thunder Pagoda Master who wore simply replied indifferently, “It has been a long time since I fought with a Unity realm expert too.” With his pride, he usually only fought against Primal Chaos giants.
Thunder Pagoda Master extended his hand. There was a black flame which gave birth on his palm. The flame was burning with ‘chi chi’, warping the surrounding void. He indifferently said: “I might be a hex cultivator, but I do not specialize in many things…’
“Hong.”
Xue Ying was too lazy to reply. The first technique he exerted was a brutal one.
One could see a vast Dark World descending from nothingness. It completely enveloped around Thunder Pagoda Master. Thunder Pagoda Master also looked up as the Dark World surrounded him, though he was calm: ‘The absolute art of Dark World Master?’ But there were a total of 2,700 layers as judged from the membrane. Clearly, Xue Ying had fully unleashed his Many-Layered Dark World.
This was his current limit-2,700 layers!
Xue Ying was not afraid of getting rid of the other party in a single move because he understood how strong this ‘Thunder Pagoda Master’ was. The fleshy body of Thunder Pagoda Master was publicly acknowledged as the strongest amongst Unity realm experts! This included those from the other two sacred worlds, ‘Ancient Sacred World’ and the ‘Ancestor Mother World’. In terms of overall strength, Thunder Pagoda Master was first in the three great sacred worlds, but concerning his fleshy body, he was the strongest in the five great sacred worlds amongst Unity realm experts!
Xue Ying wanted to find out how formidable the other party’s fleshy body was using 2,700 layers of Dark World.
“Hong~”
In the hazy sky, the World Energy was wildly surging.
At the moment when the 2,700 layers of Dark World appeared, they directly exploded, producing a world destructive energy that completely engulfed Thunder Pagoda Master himself.
Following that, after the Dark World exploded, it revealed the appearance of Thunder Pagoda Master. The robe on his body remained perfectly fine, though there were some damages on the flesh of his face, exposing his bones. The injuries on his body were rapidly recovering.
“Quite formidable.” Thunder Pagoda Master stared at Xue Ying. One of his two eyes was damaged, though it was recovering too, “The Dark World Master wasn’t as strong as you are if he were alive. This move has reached the seventh level standard in its pure offensive strength, but it is impossible for you to survive against the collective assault by those 10 Destructive Devils within the seventh level.”
“Your body is solid too.” A huge fiery-red god bird, Vermillion Nightmare, appeared abruptly behind the back of Xue Ying. It immediately began flapping its wings that practically covered half the sky. A fiery-red airstream started diffusing over to where Thunder Pagoda Master was.
The illusory realm started assailing Thunder Pagoda Master.
But Thunder Pagoda Master was unlike Wicked-Eyed Palace Master or Monarch Qi Hu. For him to obtain such accomplishments, he naturally had reached the third level in his heart realm-My Heart as the World.
‘Such a formidable illusory realm. No wonder Wicked-Eyed would fall for it.’ Thunder Pagoda Master slightly frowned. He could feel waves and waves of illusory realm charging onto him. Even though he was able to rapidly break through them with his soul and willpower, his heart energy was still being influenced, ‘It actually requires me to use 30% of my heart energy to resist against it. That’s fine too. I can simply use moves that consume less heart energy.’
“Elder Dong Bo, you receive a move by me too.” Thunder Pagoda Master grinned.
“Hong, hong, hong, hong.”
One could see large pieces of flesh flying out from his body. After flying out, they swiftly condensed into many naked giants. Each giant contained a rock skin, though their faces looked like that of Thunder Pagoda Master. There were a total of four giants, and all of them let out a sky-piercing roar into the sky. This roar actually created a shockwave that affected more than 500 kilometers in area. The entire region had been razed to the ground by this shockwave.
This was a sacred world, yet his roar had attained such a strength.
Xue Ying also understood this technique the other party had. The fleshy body of Thunder Pagoda Master had been refined to an unfathomable stage. Even a section of his fleshy body could form four giants. These giants might be weaker in defense as compared to his actual body, but they were stronger. Each giant was constructed by Thunder Pagoda Master with the idea of maximizing their close combat skills. Every one of them had reached the sixth level Star Pagoda strength.
And this was merely one of the techniques the famous Thunder Pagoda Master had.

chapters.title: Chapter 903 - Gu Qi
chapters.content:
Chapter 903: Gu Qi
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
After the four giants roared, they stared at the distant Xue Ying. Following that, with a ‘sou’, they disappeared, leaving behind only afterimages.
Even though their speed was slower than the true body, it sufficed in making Xue Ying speechless: ‘The fleshy body of Lei Yan is indeed the strongest across the five great sacred worlds. Even the giants who were formed from part of his fleshy body are fast to this extent.’
“Hong~”
The four giants moved through different routes and attacked Xue Ying at the same time. Their palms were akin to stone sculptures, and they would either send their palms over, try grabbing Xue Ying like claws, or chopped at Xue Ying… even though the attacks had yet to reach Xue Ying, its power caused the surrounding space to break like mirrors, emitting sounds of ‘pu pu pu’.
This was tyrannical strength! All of them were being controlled by Thunder Pagoda Master who did not care about the illusory realm.
“Hmph.” With a thought, Xue Ying let out many ripple strands into the void. They rapidly entangled around the four giants, thus diminishing their speed slightly. This made Xue Ying shook his head inwardly. The power of the Plate Ripple Diagram was not enough. If he could improve it to the sixth level Star Pagoda strength, it would be more useful.
But the ripple domain was merely used as assistance. Xue Ying’s killing move was still the Sky Punishment Edges.
One could see 12 illusory worlds forming jade green light simultaneously.
“Xiu, xiu, xiu…” 12 Sky Punishment Edges descended from illusory. When they appeared, they were right where the four giants were heading to. Furthermore, three Sky Punishment Edges targeted a giant each.
“12 Sky Punishment Edges?” Thunder Pagoda Master who was always confident of himself, had a change in expression.
“Hong hong hong…”
The 12 Sky Punishment Edges clashed against the four giants. These four giants let out a furious roar as they received the incoming edges with their palms.
One party included four huge bodies that the Thunder Pagoda Master refined with the idea of making them extremely powerful in close combat.
The other side was purely 12 Sky Punishment Edges that were meant to attack!
When both sides clashed, it let out a world-shaking boom.
The shockwave from a single Sky Punishment Edge swept out for more than 5,000 kilometers. As for the palm, the shockwave emitted from the clash had swept across a massive area of even more than 50,000 kilometers! This was not because the palms of the giants were strong. Instead, the strength from the Sky Punishment Edges was more condensed.
When the Sky Punishment Edges dissipated, the four giants stood on the great land with savage injuries on their bodies. Some of them were practically cut into two, though their wounds were recovering rapidly.
And this great land…
The surrounding area spanning hundreds of thousands of kilometers had turned into ruins. Half the oasis which was initially filled with life energy had been destroyed.
This was a sacred world, and for the shockwaves from a battle to destroy a region of several hundred thousand kilometers represented a fight between those at the level of Primal Chaos giants. Naturally, it was between the weaker Primal Chaos giants! Those with a slightly deeper foundation might even affect a region of a few million kilometers as they battled!
“For you to resist my four diagram-collection giants, you are worthy for me to use my full strength.” The true body of Thunder Pagoda Master who stood far away finally started moving.
“Sou!”
He did not display the domain technique which he was more famous for since he was clear that Xue Ying was unquestionably the strongest Unity realm expert he had ever met. Ordinary techniques were a waste of time.
“This is my strongest killing move. Receive it.”
His voice transmitted to the ears of Xue Ying.
By then, Thunder Pagoda Master had turned into a strand of thunder before arriving by the side of Xue Ying. It was too fast. The distance between the two wasn’t far, though in front of the horrifying speed Thunder Pagoda Master had, it was not any weaker than teleportation. If one said that the speed of the giants far transcended his, then this speed that Thunder Pagoda Master revealed had sufficiently startled Xue Ying. The gap in was too big.
Being the expert with the strongest body within the Unity realm, for the sake of survival, the true body of Thunder Pagoda Master was extremely formidable in his speed and defenses!
“Hu.””Hu.”
Thunder Pagoda Master’s hands were white and tender. They slapped towards Xue Ying like how a mortal would, though there was some faint thunder surrounding one palm, and flames surging on the other. They might seem like regular slaps-it was much weaker than the giants when comparing how loud these attacks were. But this was the most terrifying move Thunder Pagoda Master had.
The absolute art “Thunder Fire” was also what others called it.
It was said that when he was weak, Lei Yan was utterly obsessed with thunder and flames. He did not delve into other areas of the hex cultivation. Thunder Pagoda Master had already primarily researched into both thunder and flames. It was only later on that he began to research into the fleshy body. He fused both thunder and flames to form a fusion absolute art, the “Thunder Fire” which brought him where he was now.
His true body proceeded with attacking, and the other four gigantic bodies similarly roared out and once again charged forward.
“Hong hong hong…” Xue Ying split his attention, forming 12 Sky Punishment Edges and sent them to obstruct the four giants. At the same time, the surface of Xue Ying’s hands was abruptly covered in black scales. His hands had transformed into an exceptionally terrifying beast, emitting an aura of slaughter. Closely following that, his palms pierced out just like two swords.
“Si la-”
His scaled-palms directly met against the palms of Thunder Pagoda Master. The lips of Thunder Pagoda Master edged upwards. He had deliberately met Xue Ying’s palms too. He was an extremely proud son of the generation, so why would he evade it?
During the juncture when they clashed, the palms of Thunder Pagoda Master-the thunder on his left hand suddenly changed into flames, and his right hand suddenly formed thunder from flames. This sudden transformation also caused a frightening might to erupt.
And Xue Ying’s palms were as valiant as a hegemon. At that moment, there was a pair of sharp claw illusions which appeared by his palms. They were sent piercing out along with Xue Ying’s palms.
“Peng~”
The two sides clashed.
Xue Ying was forced to take six steps back. Every single step caused the ground to tremble. And Thunder Pagoda Master had merely taken a single step back. He was looking at Xue Ying with shock: ‘He could actually receive my Thunder Fire killing move directly?’
At this moment, Xue Ying stood there. His scaled black hands were faintly covered by a pair of enormous scaled front claws. They were emitting a horrifying killing intent.
‘Even when I display the Apocalyptic Sixth Sword with my Imperial Dragon claws, I am still on the disadvantaged end.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
The most terrifying part of the Imperial Dragon inheritance was its hands!
If one said that the body armor was as tough as a middle-grade Void God weapon, then the palms which were used as weapons would be comparable to an upper-grade Void God weapon. Furthermore, they contained all sorts of bizarre effects. Using it to unleash the Apocalyptic Sixth Sword was much stronger than using a weapon to display the strike. One could say that Xue Ying also held an advantage in close combat battles. He would definitely be able to tear apart a giant if he fought against it alone. But it’s a pity that he was still on the disadvantaged end when facing the strongest killing move of Thunder Pagoda Master.
But Xue Ying did not have any injuries!
“Again.” Thunder Pagoda Master did not want to believe it. He roared.
“Hong!”
His true body struck out once again. The four giants also roared and charged over. An ultra-strong true body along with four huge giants. Even though he had few moves in the hex cultivation, Thunder Pagoda Master was able to suppress all other Unity realm experts with this. After all, there had yet to be a Unity realm expert who could cross through the seventh level Star Pagoda in the three great sacred worlds! Xue Ying felt that his strikes were insufficient in enabling him to get through the seventh level as well.
“You came at the right time.” Xue Ying was in a frenzy too.
His black-scaled palms which contained a slaughter and destructive aura went over directly to receive the attack. He sent Sky Punishment Edges from the illusion as well-an occasional four to five Sky Punishment Edges to attack the true body of Thunder Pagoda Master! After all, Xue Ying only needed to use eight Sky Punishment Edges to suppress the four giants.
Accompanied by the Sky Punishment Edges and his true body’s close combat attacks, Xue Ying had the upper hand.
“What.”
Thunder Pagoda Master was truly infuriated.
Even though his body was strong enough to resist against the Sky Punishment Edges, but the power of the edges was too strong. It would force him to retreat after withstanding against it. His combat movements would be affected too. In terms of techniques, Xue Ying who cultivated the laws and profound mysteries system still held an upper hand. His palms frequently landed on the body of Thunder Pagoda Master.
“Peng peng peng…”
Thunder Pagoda Master might be unafraid, though he kept getting struck by the attacks.
“Hmph.” Thunder Pagoda Master suddenly retreated. He directly moved back to a far distance. The fleshy bodies from the four giants also rapidly flew towards him and fused into his body. He coldly glanced at Xue Ying and was too lazy to speak. After waving his hand, he caused a thunder fire to flash. He tore apart a spatial passage before leaving the vicinity with a single step.
Thunder Pagoda Master was indeed sullen.
His attacks were wild and brutal. Even the four giants had a great offense too. When all of them worked together, it was usually he who suppressed other Unity realm experts!
But this time, Xue Ying was the one attacking him wildly, and he could only resist against it with his body!
“He left just like that?” Xue Ying still admired the other party. He had not won the battle and only had a slight upper hand. The other party’s body was indeed horrifying.
‘It seems my strength isn’t enough for me to get through the seventh level Star Pagoda.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Maybe according to my plan, I should research that strongest killing move before I could be absolutely certain I can get through the seventh level.’
He had already attained a great accomplishment in both the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance and the Imperial Dragon inheritance.
With the guidance by the ‘stone mirror’, Xue Ying also fused both these inheritances, allowing them to form a sinister black flower.
Xue Ying was studying the fusion of the profound mysteries of ‘Dao of Mirage’ and ‘Dao of Slaughter’ from this sinister black flower. If he could fuse these two Daos together, he might be able to come out with a move stronger than even the Apocalyptic Sixth Sword and the Sky Punishment Edge!
…
At that time, there were no spectators on this battle.
But Wicked-Eyed Palace Master was actually captured alive. The disciples under the Ancestor Sorcerer sect soon sent people to investigate. Naturally, they were able to observe the scene of what happened. This scene had startled them.
“What?”
“Dong Bo Xue Ying isn’t any weaker than Lei Yan?”
“Such a horrifying illusory technique, Sky Punishment Edge and even close combat skills?”
“Lei Yan is forced to use his body to resist against the attacks. How, how can this be?”
Once many people knew of it, the information also spread like wildfire.
Xue Ying also reported upwards regarding the news. After all, he had captured an expert of the Ancestor Sorcerer alive, and the Great Void Heaven Temple was similarly shocked when they investigated what had happened.
…
Lei Yan was previously publicly acknowledged as the strongest Unity realm expert in this generation across the three great sacred worlds. Nevertheless, after this battle, it was not the case anymore! Naturally, Xue Ying was not recognized as the strongest too since both parties did not have a clear advantage over the other.
“Hahaha…” Within Myriad Ancient Sacred World, in a small courtyard deep in the mountain, there were many overgrown weeds.
Within this place.
There was a silver-haired golden-horned male who sat on a stone stool. His silver eyebrows which were like swords raised upwards. He could not help but chuckle in delight. His laughter reverberated within the small courtyard. A scene had appeared in midair ahead. It was the battle between Xue Ying and Thunder Pagoda Master.
“He is indeed the disciple of me, Gu Qi. Even though I have only accepted a single disciple, he is actually the current strongest Unity expert in the three great sacred worlds. My eyesight for accepting disciples is really awesome.” The silver-haired golden-horned male was relatively delighted.

chapters.title: Chapter 904 - A Gift by His Teacher
chapters.content:
Chapter 904: A Gift by His Teacher
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
There were very few who could reach the final realm ‘Cosmos God’ in cultivation. The number of Cosmos Gods within any of the sacred worlds could be counted with one’s fingers. There were even places like in the Ancestor Mother World where there was just Ancestor Mother alone. As for the silver-haired golden-horned male, he was one of the two Voidwalker Cosmos Gods, ‘Gu Qi’. The other would be the creator of the entire Voidwalker lineage, ‘Void Primogenitor’.
