Gu Qi had once left behind his inheritance within the hometown cosmos of Xue Ying, and Xue Ying had passed through the trials before starting his journey of cultivating this Voidwalker lineage.
It was precisely because of his accomplishments in the Voidwalker lineage that gave him the foundation to comprehend the four diagrams left behind by Monarch Nine Cloud, allowing him to vaguely interact with the higher leveled world. Furthermore, Xue Ying had grasped the ultra-long distance teleportation technique too!
‘He has cultivated for a relatively short period, yet he could suppress Lei Yan already, haha…’ The silver-haired golden-horned man was genuinely delighted. Nevertheless, he could not find anybody to brag about this.
“Teacher.”
The silver-haired golden-horned male directly transmitted a message.
“Weng.”
A figure directly condensed and turned into a black-robed green-haired male. This green-haired male had a pair of beautiful purple eyes. His entire person was like the void-being one with it. He walked to a stone stool by the side and sat down: “Gu Qi, what’s the matter?”
This green-haired male was none other than Void Primogenitor, someone who sincerely pitied the weak. He hated devils the most.
“You should know that my disciple is Dong Bo Xue Ying…” The silver-haired golden-horned male said.
“You asked me over just for this?” Void Primogenitor was slightly startled.
“This is a huge matter. He is my only disciple!” Gu Qi stared back.
Void Primogenitor felt slightly helpless: “Gu Qi, the Sacred Master is currently finding ways to kill you currently. It is fortunate that you are being protected by Ancestor Sorcerer with his entire strength. Otherwise, you would still be running for your life.”
The fury of Sacred Master swelled up towards the heavens. He wanted to kill Gu Qi no matter the cost!
The Eastern Unicorn Sacred World and Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World could not protect Gu Qi from the Sacred Master at all. Even though the World Ancestor was strong, unless Gu Qi followed behind the World Ancestor all the while, otherwise, there was only ‘Ancestor Sorcerer’ who could help him. Ancestor Sorcerer was indubitably number one regarding his attainments of arrays across final realm existences. With his help, he was able to allow Gu Qi to live days of peace.
Naturally, Gu Qi had paid the equivalent price. He had to coordinate with Ancestor Sorcerer in some of his experiments regarding the void aspect.
“What can I do if he wants to pursue after me?” Gu Qi leisurely poured wine for his teacher and himself, “I would just lose my little life at most. I have been to many places in this life of mine, seen through all sorts of happenings and countless experts. I’ve even made the Sacred Master suffer. Haha, right now, I even have a disciple who is the strongest Unity realm expert within the three great sacred worlds. Tsk tsk, I am quite happy with this life of mine already.”
“Your disciple and Lei Yan are equally matched. His attacks are quite strong, and the advantage of Lei Yan’s body is huge as well. Currently, he can’t be considered as the strongest Unity realm expert amongst the three great sacred worlds.” Void Primogenitor casually replied.
“How long has he cultivated for? I’m sure he will soon become the strongest Unity cultivator sooner or later.” Gu Qi delightfully commented.
Void Primogenitor could not help but sigh inwardly after seeing how happy Gu Qi was. This disciple of his did not really care about angering Sacred Master at all.
‘If only I could take another step, by then, Gu Qi would not have to run for his life anymore. In the end, it is because I, his teacher, is too weak.’ Void Primogenitor thought. His attainments in the void were great. After Monarch Nine Cloud died, he was currently the cultivator with the highest attainment in the void. If he could take another step and reach the second level, he would be able to fight against the Sacred Master by relying on his attainment in the void.
Just like how Sacred Master killed Monarch Nine Cloud in the past, he had invested countless time and effort to do so and was only able to bring about the fall of Monarch Nine Cloud during the final battle which led to the shatter of the primitive Ancient Sacred World.
And even now, Sacred Master was able to guess that the treasure cove of Monarch Nine Cloud was hidden in a specific time-space surrounding the ‘Nine Cloud Great Land’, but he could not find it at all!
“If there’s nothing else, I will be leaving.” Void Primogenitor said.
“Teacher, come on… Accompany me for a drink.” Gu Qi helplessly said, “My only disciple has become someone formidable. This is a rare moment of joy in this life of escapism. It’s a pity that I do not dare to talk to others since I am afraid of revealing Xue Ying as my only disciple, implicating him and bringing the wrath of the Sacred Master onto him. Thus, I can only find you, teacher.”
“Alright alright, since you are happy, I will accompany you to drink a few more cups.” Void Primogenitor shook his head.
…
Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, Great Void Heaven Temple.
Xue Ying had already returned to the Great Void Heaven Temple. That ‘Wicked-Eyed Palace Master’ had been handed to Ancestor Devil for punishments. After that, the negotiation would happen between the sect under Ancestor Sorcerer and the higher-ups of Great Void Heaven Temple.
Due to possible conflicts and grievances, cases of tortures and punishments had happened many times. The three great sacred worlds would always stand on the same side due to their battle against the two great religions. They had their bottom line in dealing with things. Cultivators like the Void Primogenitor and Jade Light Master treated evil as their enemies, and they could only tolerate against those huge devils under the World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer. At the most, they would merely punish them severely and cause them to suffer.
“Hong~”
Xue Ying flew backward and clashed against many mountains behind, causing many of the mountains to boom and collapse.
There were currently eight blood-armored Destruction Devils standing in midair.
‘I’ve heard that Lei Yan is able to kill the majority half of the Destruction Devils as he tried crossing through the seventh level of the Star Pagoda. However, I can only kill two before finding it hard to carry on.’ There was a huge amount of blood energy which pervaded through the body of Xue Ying. The black armor on his body had been penetrated. He stared at the distant eight Destruction Devils, ‘I am not on par with Lei Yan concerning the breaking through of the Star Pagoda.’
‘That’s right too.’
‘The body of Lei Yan is extremely formidable. He is able to hold on for a longer period after being corroded by the ‘Destruction Energy’ from the Destruction Devils, thus, allowing him to fight and squander more Destruction Devils to their deaths!’
Xue Ying understood this point.
Actually, in terms of offense, his Sky Punishment Edge was slightly weaker and crafted less profoundly as compared to Thunder Pagoda Master’s absolute art, the Thunder Fire. But Xue Ying had cultivated the ‘Vermillion Nightmare inheritance’, allowing his soul to become strong. That was why he could unleash more than ten Sky Punishment Edges at once. In this case, quantity had covered up the lack of quality! It enabled him to triumph the other party with his offense.
If not for his much stronger soul, Xue Ying would not only be weaker in terms of his fleshy body than the other party, even his offense was weaker.
‘To get through the seventh level, I must become stronger.’ Xue Ying was slightly astonished. In history, there had been two experts who crossed through the seventh level within the six great holy grounds. Black Emperor had even said that he was able to reach the seventh level strength by fusing four of his inheritances together. Those who could get through the seventh level Star Pagoda were indeed talented.
One had to know, an expert at the seventh level Star Pagoda strength was considered strong even amongst Primal Chaos giants. For instance, Heaven Weeping Sect Master was classified in this category of strength.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, hurry over.” Forefather Tian Yu’s voice reverberated within the space of the seventh level.
“Yes, Forefather.” Xue Ying replied.
…
With the help of the Star Pagoda treasure spirit, Xue Ying attempted to expel all the destruction energy left within his body. He then hurried off to where Forefather Tian Yu usually stayed. It was a slightly ordinary courtyard.
“Forefather.” Xue Ying was not obstructed during his way here.
Forefather Tian Yu was currently fishing. The lake within the courtyard was only about 33 meters long, though one could see many fish swimming within with their own naked eyes.
“For you to kill part of the Destruction Devils within the seventh level Star Pagoda is not bad already.” Forefather Tian Yu praised Xue Ying with a smile.
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded.
He understood the meaning of the Forefather.
The seventh level originally had ten Destruction Devils teaming up together. They were like one entity and attacked as one. Even their defenses were together. Thus, they had excellent combat power. If one did not have sufficient offense, it was impossible to break through the teamwork of the ten Destruction Devils. For Xue Ying to force his way through and kill two Destruction Devils represented that he had touched the boundary of the seventh level Star Pagoda strength. He would soon be able to kill all the Destruction Devils.
“Take your time slowly and remember not to be arrogant or impatient.” Forefather Tian Yu was honestly looking forward to the future of Xue Ying. He continued, “Oh right, I asked you over because that teacher of yours has prepared a gift for you.”
“Oh?” Xue Ying was startled, “Teacher?”
“Gu Qi.” Forefather Tian Yu said.

chapters.title: Chapter 905 - Convention
chapters.content:
Chapter 905: Convention
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As Forefather Tian Yu spoke, he waved his hand, causing a silver ring to appear in front that flew towards Xue Ying. Currently, Xue Ying was feeling really complicated.
Ever since he had gotten the Voidwalker inheritance after accepting Gu Qi as his teacher, even though Xue Ying had arrived at the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World… he had never seen his teacher before. Even Forefather Tian Yu did not wish for Xue Ying to contact Gu Qi to prevent the Sacred Master finding any relationship between Xue Ying and Gu Qi.
“Weng.” After Xue Ying refined the ring, the inner array was naturally activated.
An illusory scene appeared by the side of this ring.
A silver-haired golden-horned male was seen.
“Haha, I, Gu Qi’s only disciple is so formidable. I truly wanted to brag about it with several other old men, but it’s a pity that this disciple of mine has to be kept a secret. It isn’t appropriate for me to see you as well in case I implicate you. In the future, if we, teacher and disciple should meet, we should have a few drinks together. Properly cultivate and remember not to slack off! Alright, I shall not babble on anymore.” The silver-haired golden-horned male Gu Qi chuckled as he said. Closely following that, his illusion disappeared.
Xue Ying knew that this was a recorded image. It would broadcast once before being dissipated so that no traces were left behind. Gu Qi was clearly careful.
After checking what was inside the ring.
“This is?” Xue Ying was startled. Precious materials piled up within the ring. Xue Ying could easily recognize the value to be more than 6,000 Origin World Rocks.
“Gu Qi saw the battle between you and Lei Yan. He was able to easily deduce that you have cultivated Black Emperor’s “Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance” and “Imperial Dragon Inheritance”. That is why he bought all the required external materials for you to cultivate these two inheritances to the Primal Chaos realm.” Forefather Tian yu explained, “Or more accurately speaking, he provided the Origin World Rocks while I bought these materials. He has to be careful since the Sacred Master might suspect you if he carelessly revealed his actions. You are after all a Voidwalker too.”
Xue Ying nodded.
He could deduce that these precious materials were meant for him to cultivate the Vermillion Nightmare and Imperial Dragon inheritances to the eighth transformation.
With the identity of his teacher Gu Qi, he should have seen those two inheritances before. That was why he knew which resources were required. But Black Emperor had not spread the ninth transformation of both the Vermillion Nightmare and Imperial Dragon inheritances. Only those who were recognized by Black Emperor would receive the last part of the inheritances. Both Gu Qi and Forefather Tian Yu had once gotten the opportunity to look through the inheritances, but they did not have the talent to cultivate them.
Ancient cultivation required innate talent.
And according to one’s talent, the cultivator would select the most appropriate inheritances.
“So much.” Xue Ying held on to the ring. He felt that it was heavy. His teacher had bestowed upon him treasures worth 6,000 Origin World Rocks in a single go.
“In my Great Void Heaven Temple, it is impossible for us to directly bestow upon the disciples with so many treasures. We would rather let the disciples fight for it themselves.” Forefather Tian Yu shook his head, “Gu Qi only has you as his only disciple. He doesn’t know how to teach as well. Since he decided to give you, I can only follow through it! You must treasure these resources since it isn’t easy for you to vie for them yourself.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying said, “Forefather, I would like to ask where my teacher is at currently?”
He truly wanted to meet him once.
“In the Myriad Ancient Sacred World.” Forefather Tian Yu replied.
“Myriad Ancient Sacred World?” Xue Ying was startled. He had stayed on the Myriad Ancient Sacred World for a long time, yet he did not know that his teacher was there too.
“He has incurred huge trouble, and it is fortunate that Ancestor Sorcerer is willing to protect him.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “You brat should not go and meet him. Even if you want to meet him, Gu Qi isn’t willing to meet you either because he is afraid of causing trouble for you. After all, the Sacred Master is always thinking of ways to deal against Gu Qi. If you were to go, he might be able to identify traces of you.”
Xue Ying obediently nodded.
Even though he wanted to meet, this was not the right time.
…
The following days were spent in the Palace Hall of Time. Xue Ying maintained a time acceleration of a hundred times that of the normal time flow. After all, it was not too expensive to cultivate within as a Unity realm expert. Nevertheless, if he were to reach the Primal Chaos realm, Xue Ying would never enter the Palace Hall of Time unless he had an urgent need.
At the same time, he was purchasing several materials meant to aid his cultivation.
In the future, as he grew stronger, these materials would have weaker effects. Currently, as he was still at the Unity realm, it was entirely appropriate for him to use these materials. He wanted to fuse both the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter according to that sinister black flower formed on the ‘stone mirror’. Naturally, even if he could not create anything, he might be able to break through to the Primal Chaos realm in one fell swoop which was perfect too.
Time passed.
…
“Cough cough cough.”
Above a desolate mountain range, Xue Ying stood there. He was pale. A large amount of blood-colored malicious energy had pervaded into his body. There were still two blood-armored Destruction Devils standing in the distance. They were looking with slight terror at Xue Ying.
“You only know how to run. If you are capable, come and fight with me.” Xue Ying said.
“Haha, you are suffering from the corrosion of our destruction energy. Over time, your injuries will only get heavier. Why do we even have to fight to the death with you?” Those two blood-armored Destruction Devils were genuinely cunning. The fleshy body of a devil was indistinct, and the other would always hide in the distance. They were truly great at survival and escaping, and that was how they survived until now.
The other eight had been killed by Xue Ying.
‘I’ve improved the Plate Ripple Diagram to the sixth level Star Pagoda strength, yet I still could not get through the seventh level.’ Xue Ying felt the injuries on his body getting heavier. He shook his head inwardly. He had to rely on the Star Pagoda’s help to suppress and expel the malicious energy. It was unlikely for him to hold on any longer.
The sudden breakthrough of the Plate Ripple Diagram resulted in a distinct increase of his overall strength. If he fought with Thunder Pagoda Master again, Xue Ying felt that he would obtain a more noticeable advantage against him.
Plate Ripple Diagram was a domain!
After increasing the suppressive effects of the domain, it would affect even the combat power of the Destruction Devils. Their escaping abilities were affected too, causing their overall strength to decrease. That was why Xue Ying could kill eight of them, but it’s a pity he could not kill the remaining two tricky ones.
******
The five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void had always remained calm. Even though killings and battles were happening in various places, the higher-ups were at least still maintaining their calm.
The final realm existences were all hiding.
And in a slightly mystical palace hall.
This palace hall was as secretive as the treasure cove of Monarch Nine Cloud. Currently, there were many figures here.
An enormous black circular table was placed at the center.
Surrounding them, there were many figures seated around the table. There were Void Primogenitor, Blade Emperor, Forefather Tian Yu, Devil Mountain Primogenitor and a male who had a huge serpent coiling around his body.
This male with a huge serpent coiling around his body, had his chest revealed. He was quite handsome. He chuckled: “My sister is still in closed-door cultivation, so this time, I’ll be the one attending it instead.” Jade Light Sacred Territory had two Cosmos Gods. One was Jade Light Master, and the other was her brother, the ‘Great Emperor Cloud Serpent’.
“Luo City Lord doesn’t like to attend trifle matters, so he is not attending this gathering as well.” Blade Emperor was a male garbed in gold. As he stood there, others could feel a sharp suppression coming from him. He was also the strongest expert within the six great holy grounds, “The Star Palace Hall Convention this time will be hosted by me.”
The other four were listening to him.
Of the two great sacred worlds, after excluding Ancestor Bone, there were a total of six great holy grounds. According to logic, there should be six Cosmos Gods attending this meeting, just that Luo City Lord would usually not attend it.

chapters.title: Chapter 906 - Star Convention
chapters.content:
Chapter 906: Star Convention
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“The rules are as per usual for the Star Convention this time.” Blade Emperor indifferently swept his gaze across the other four figures, “The job now is for the five of us to nominate one person each. This person must obtain the approval of more than half the people present since he will be a genius cultivator representing our holy ground.”
The Star Convention.
That was a grand gathering hosted by both the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World and the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. It would be held once every trillion years! Those who cultivated for less than a trillion years and had reached the Unity realm would be qualified to participate.
The reason why they hosted this…
Was to unearth the hidden talents from the vast sacred worlds. Even though the holy grounds would usually accept disciples as well, but firstly, the qualification threshold was high and secondly, the sacred worlds were honestly too vast. Many weaker cultivators would not have the opportunity to travel through the huge distance to reach where the holy grounds were. There were sometimes talented and outstanding cultivators amongst these people.
Like Swordmaster, he no longer had the chance of being groomed since he had reached the Primal Chaos realm within a single cosmos epoch in his hometown cosmos! By the time he entered the Great Void Heaven Temple, he was able to step into the Cosmos God realm after reading through many books.
There were many similar cases.
These geniuses that were scattered across the places would still be able to cultivate to the Unity realm despite not having good conditions and were not properly groomed. But if they were able to reach where they were, the moment they entered the holy grounds, it was likely that they would improve greatly! As for those who ‘cultivated for two trillion years yet could not reach the Unity realm’, despite having a poor cultivation environment, they were not qualified as geniuses and could not participate in the Star Convention!
There were two types of selection criteria in the Star Convention.
The first was competing using one’s strength and get ranked. This was showing one’s abilities through strength.
The other would be to get chosen by the five experts arranged by the convention. These experts would observe the cultivators, and they would then select those worthy of being nurtured.
After all, the convention was about unearthing talents. For instance, those who cultivated for ten billion years fighting against those who cultivated for a trillion years. Even if they were weaker, those who cultivated for ten billion years would have a higher potential.
And the selections of these unranked cultivators would be purely determined by the five nominated experts. As a result, these appointed experts held great power in their hands, and the five great holy grounds would have to select the right person with the approval from the majority of the Cosmos Gods.
“Haha, this brat General Hatchet has traveled to many places. I’ve asked him before, and he mentioned that he is willing to take on the role as a teacher of the Star Convention this time.” Devil Mountain Primogenitor was the biggest person present in the place. His body was covered in a pitch black outer shell. His eyes were blood red. “Everyone should have no objections right?”
“General Hatchet Palace Master?”
“Naturally I do not have any objections.”
“No objections here.”
“It is rare for him to come.”
Great Emperor Cloud Serpent, Void Primogenitor, Forefather Tian Yu, and Blade Emperor all smiled and nodded.
Few experts could cross the ninth level Star Pagoda within the six great holy grounds. In Great Void Heaven Temple, there was only the Primal Chaos Hall Master, and in the Primogenitor Island, there was only General Hatchet Palace Master alone! For those at the Primal Chaos realm expert to reach the ninth level Star Pagoda, the difficulty was not any less than a Unity realm expert crossing through the seventh level… they had to unleash a power close to that of Cosmos Gods at the Primal Chaos realm. Clearly, they would have to be more accomplished in certain aspects than even Cosmos Gods.
Even Cosmos Gods respected these Primal Chaos experts who could cross the ninth level Star Pagoda.
The Star Convention might be important, but to have General Hatchet Palace Master take on the role as one of the five teachers was rare too.
“This disciple Qing Qu of mine is also quite interested in becoming one of the teachers for the Star Convention this time.” Great Emperor Cloud Serpent said.
“Qing Qu? She is quite weak.” Blade Emperor frowned, “I would rather have another person come.”
“Qing Qu Island Master has quite a good reputation. She is at least fair.” Void Primogenitor added.
“Her judgment doesn’t seem good enough.” Forefather Tian Yu added.
“Change another.” Devil Mountain Primogenitor shook his head.
Three present out of the five had objected to it. Clearly, this person wasn’t chosen.
Qing Qu Island Master was a disciple of Great Emperor Cloud Serpent and was a Primal Chaos giant who specialized in sounds. Her strength was at the seventh level Star Pagoda.
Great Emperor Cloud Serpent was stunned momentarily before he continued helplessly, “Then Violet Slaughter Island Master will be it.”
“Mn.” Forefather Tian Yu nodded.
“Alright.” Devil Mountain Primogenitor was straightforward.
“Violet Slaughter Island Master is not bad.”
“Sounds good.”
…
The nomination happened really quickly. Primogenitor Island recommended ‘General Hatchet Palace Master’, and Void God Palace recommended ‘Five Luster Serpent Ancestor’. Blade Emperor City recommended ‘General Heaven Light’, and Great Emperor Cloud Serpent recommended ‘Violet Slaughter Island Master’.
Of which, General Hatchet Palace Master was at the ninth level Star Pagoda strength, and the others were at the eighth level!
Usually, the teachers chosen for conventions would be at the eighth level Star Pagoda strength! This time for them to have ‘General Hatchet Palace Master’ participating in the convention was really rare.
“Tian Yu, who will be stepping forward for your Great Void Heaven Temple this time?” All of them were looking at Great Void Heaven Temple.
“I have someone in mind.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “But he might be weaker. Still, I find him to be quite appropriate.”
“Who is it?”
“Quickly tell us.”
“Why are you still acting mysterious at this time?” All of them were urging him on.
Forefather Tian Yu said, “The strongest Inner Hall Elder in my Great Void Heaven Temple… Dong Bo Xue Ying. He has killed eight Destruction Devils when trying to cross the seventh level Star Pagoda, and is only just a gap away from crossing it.”
“Dong Bo Xue Ying? A Unity realm expert?” Blade Emperor slightly frowned, “Isn’t he too weak? The Star Convention is a huge affair, and those who participated in it are all at the Unity realm. The five convention teachers have great authority, and can a Unity realm expert take on the responsibility? I find that he is lacking.”
“I think he is appropriate.” Devil Mountain Primogenitor’s huge body sat there. His blood-red eyes looked at Blade Emperor, “This Dong Bo Xue Ying has this power and is considered half a step into the seventh level Star Pagoda already. Talking about his understanding of the Unity realm, not even the Primal Chaos giants at the eighth level Star Pagoda strength could be better than him. His foresight is absolutely sufficient. Furthermore, it is said that he has only cultivated for a few tens of billions of years. Being a genius cultivator, he might be able to unearth some genius cultivator too.”
“Half step into the seventh level Star Pagoda? He has ultimately not succeeded in it!” Great Emperor Cloud Serpent shook his head, “If he could get through the seventh level with his Unity realm, then none would object. But he has ultimately not broken through it. He is quite lacking in the foundation when taking on the mantle as a teacher. There might be some Unity geniuses attending the Star Convention who seem to be deferential, but they would not respect Dong Bo Xue Ying deep in their hearts. Void Primogenitor, what do you think?”
Currently, there were two who disagreed with it-Blade Emperor and Great Emperor Cloud Serpent.
There were also two who agreed-Forefather Tian Yu and Devil Mountain Primogenitor.
The final decision would depend on Void Primogenitor!
“His foresight is sufficient. He has cultivated for quite a long time and understood quite enough of the various great cultivation systems. I find him qualified.” Void Primogenitor added. He would still be willing to help his own disciple’s disciple.
Great Emperor Cloud Serpent was stunned.
He got through?
“Alright. Since the majority has chosen him, then it’ll be decided.” Blade Emperor slightly frowned, “But I am afraid that there will be many who would not accept this outcome.”
“So what if they can’t accept this outcome which we decided upon?” Devil Mountain Primogenitor coldly snorted.
“Alright. The five teachers have been selected.” Blade Emperor nodded. He did not speak anymore. Even though he felt that it would create some dissent, the Star Convention would be held once every trillion years. Currently, they had hosted it many times, and this was merely a single convention. Since three of the five great holy grounds had decided upon it, then there was no reason to continue refuting it.
Thus, the name register of the five teachers responsible for the Star Convention this time was as followed-General Hatchet Palace Master, Violet Slaughter Island Master, Five Luster Serpent Ancestor, General Heaven Light, Dong Bo Xue Ying.
Forefather Tian Yu revealed a grin at this: ‘It is different when one cultivates and when one becomes a teacher. This would be a rare opportunity for that Dong Bo brat to temper himself.’ He paid great importance on Xue Ying. After all, he was one step into the seventh level Star Pagoda already. Forefather Tian Yu fought with all his strength to obtain this opportunity for Xue Ying since it would undoubtedly be helpful to his growth.
…
The news soon spread out.
Blade Emperor City.
Within a palace that was entirely gold, in the most dazzling palace hall.
A male was wearing gray robe seated cross-legged on a stone bed within a huge hall. His entire body was emitting a dim gold light as if he were a gold structure. Currently, he was looking downwards while describing some of his experiences on cultivation. Several other disciples were listening attentively below. He was General Heaven Light and had quite a high status within the Blade Emperor City.
“Mn?”
General Heaven Light frowned.
He was informed about the five nominated teachers for the Star Convention this time. The reason why he took the initiative to attend was that he wanted to receive a disciple or two during this convention.
‘Someone at the Unity realm is actually being placed on the same level as us?’ The eyes of General Heaven Light held a strand of anger. Deep in his heart, the genius cultivators nominated by the two sacred worlds to attend such an important convention would be on the same level. Nevertheless, for a Unity realm expert to accept the position as a teacher that was placed on the same level as him and others made him feel unhappy. It’s a pity that this was chosen by the highest level-the Cosmos Gods, and he was not qualified to retort against it.

chapters.title: Chapter 907 - Cultivation Accumulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 907: Cultivation Accumulation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the Palace Hall of Time in the holy ground Great Void Heaven Temple.
Xue Ying was seated cross-legged on top of a tall mountain peak. The wind was blowing harshly on his robe. He looked down at this great land, and also at the vast starry sky.
Throughout these years, he had been using several materials to aid in his cultivation in the Palace Hall of time as he tried fusing both ‘Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter’. It’s a pity he did not create a new fusion move. Instead, his understanding of the Primal Chaos realm became deeper. Everything he knew in the past became much clearer now, and Xue Ying could ascertain that he was actually nailing on the board of Primal Chaos realm with every moment his understanding deepened. All he needed was time before he could break through!
‘Primal Chaos realm is just a stop.’ Xue Ying thought.
Primal Chaos realm.
It was all about breaking the original limits of the Unity realm! What Primal Chaos realm engendered was in opening up limitless possibilities in the Dao path. As one proceeded further, he would then nurture this Dao path into a cosmos. That represented the final realm-Cosmos God!
Actually, the essence of the Primal Chaos realm was just like a piece of white paper!
And the realm of Cosmos God was like a drawing on top!
This white paper was initially clean and empty. What this represented were many different possibilities where one could draw! Naturally, it was tough to create the most exquisite of artwork. That was also the final and most significant checkpoint within cultivation. Only when the ‘art was at perfection’ could it turn into a cosmos.
In any case, it was hard to even compose this piece of white paper.
Usually, one would be left with many scars as he cultivated from young to now. Like previously, in the Void God ‘Origin Birth realm’, there were impurities from other profound mysteries, making it even harder to form a piece of white paper. Only when one sought after the absolute limits, completely purifying Unity into a single point. Only when there was this foundation could the cultivator actually break through the Unity and transform it into a clean white piece of paper-Primal Chaos.
One had to have a deep understanding of his body, soul, realm, and cultivation. That was why a high number of cultivation systems had strong requirements on the soul. It was impossible to produce this piece of white paper ‘Primal Chaos’ without sufficient soul strength.
‘With sufficient determination and perseverance, with a deeper understanding of the Dao, only then can I abandon the influence of the past.’ Xue Ying thought.
To abandon the influences did not represent throwing them away.
If one did not require comprehensions, then did that not mean that a mortal who had never cultivated before would be able to step into the Primal Chaos realm more easily?
That was clearly wrong!
Instead, one had to first comprehend and break through its influences, transcending beyond it before discovering that only that piece of white paper existed-Primal Chaos! No matter which law and profound mystery it was, no matter which cultivation system it was, everything would eventually lead to that white piece of paper at the Primal Chaos realm.
It was hard to grasp ‘Primal Chaos’.
Either one broke through with comprehension, understanding what was behind the Unity realm-the Primal Chaos realm.
Or one became strong enough, accumulating enough experiences that deepened his understanding of his path of cultivation. Xue Ying was precisely on this second path. His Dao of Slaughter, Dao of Ripple and Dao of Mirage had all touched the boundaries of Primal Chaos realm. He had also touched on the periphery of the Primal Chaos realm in his Walker’s Hidden Secret. All his Daos had already reached this stage, and Xue Ying was even trying to fuse multiple Daos together, experiencing more on the profound mysteries of his Daos. Naturally, Xue Ying’s understanding of everything on his Dao would become deeper.
‘Mn?’ A message was transmitted over that startled Xue Ying.
‘Star Convention? I am one of the five teachers?’ Xue Ying was astonished.
The war between the three great sacred worlds and two great religions was fought by experts. As a result, Eastern Unicorn Sacred World and Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World decided to work together and host a gathering called the Star Convention. They sought to unearth some of the more talented cultivators that were dispersed all over the places, pulling them into their faction before nurturing them wholeheartedly! These cultivators who did not have a good environment in cultivating and could attain great accomplishments within two trillion years would definitely achieve greater things if they were nurtured. There might even be some who could step into the Primal Chaos realm.
If there were at least a cultivator entering the Primal Chaos realm during every Star Convention, it would be worth it!
‘Of the teachers of the convention, there are General Hatchet Palace Master, General Heaven Light, Five Luster Serpent Ancestor, and Violet Slaughter Island Master who are at the Primal Chaos realm. Only I am at the Unity realm?’ Xue Ying was clear that the status of a teacher of the convention was high. More importantly, more than half of the selected cultivators within the Star Convention would depend on the foresight of the teachers as they unearth those weaker juniors with sufficient potential. Thus, the actions of the teacher would significantly affect the destiny of a Unity genius!
“Dong Bo Xue Ying.” Forefather Tian Yu’s voice reverberated in the surrounding.
“Forefather.” Xue Ying respectfully replied.
“You will be taking on this opportunity as a teacher during the Star Convention. It is a good experience for you. By then, there would be many talents at the Unity realm seeking you for help. If the cultivators you chose performed badly, it would signify that your foresight is weak.” Forefather Tian Yu explained, “Not just selecting the right people or to guide these cultivators, it is good training for you in many other aspects too. This is a hard-earned opportunity so you must grasp it well. Furthermore, you are representing my Great Void Heaven Temple this time, so do not throw the reputation of my Great void Heaven Temple away.”
“Yes.” Xue Ying immediately answered.
The five teachers came from five holy grounds.
This time, he would be representing the Great Void Heaven Temple! Every single action of his represented his holy ground, so he had to perform beautifully.
…
Now it was just the start of the preparations. There was still a million years before the convention begin.
Actually, before the selection of the teachers of convention happened, many talented cultivators from all over the two great sacred worlds had started preparing for the ‘Star Convention’ this time since each convention would be held at a fixed time-once every trillion years! Some of the weaker ones who did not have the opportunity to enter the holy grounds would hurry in their cultivation to reach the Unity realm in a bid to enter the holy grounds via the Star Convention.
Participating in the convention was easy.
As long as one was qualified, he could visit any main cities within the two great sacred worlds. They could then register themselves with the ‘Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion’ or the ‘Eastern Unicorn Palace Hall’. By then, the holy grounds would arrange everything well.
…
As time passed, many young Unity realm cultivators who were filled with hope began registering themselves to attend that Star Convention! The Star Convention was also hosted by the six great holy grounds, and even Cosmos Gods would focus on this convention.
But there was an underlying rule…
The disciples of holy grounds were forbidden from participating in it! After all, this convention was meant to unearth talented cultivators from those scattered around different places and was not appropriately nurtured.
Some of them had horrible cultivating conditions, and could at most obtain some ancient absolute arts or those related to it.
There might be some who entered the sect under a Primal Chaos giant. Nevertheless, the sect under a Primal Chaos giant would definitely be far weaker than any of the holy grounds. For instance, the ‘Black Emperor Palace’ might have a great expert propping the sect, but he could at most teach others what he was good at. There were many other areas where he could only guide based on the books he collected. But how could he ever compare with the number of books collected to the Great Void Heaven Temple, Primogenitor Island and other holy grounds?
Furthermore, the holy grounds had Cosmos Gods and a group of Primal Chaos giants. They far outstripped the Primal Chaos superpowers regarding cultivation guidance, ancient absolute art options, treasures, and resources.
Naturally.
The disciples sent over by Primal Chaos superpowers to participate in the battle would certainly be better than those who cultivated by themselves. It’s a pity that Xue Ying and the others would prefer to select loose cultivators if both parties were similar in strength and age.
“Hong~”
There was a black flower which vaguely formed within a huge illusory world in the void ahead. But it had barely formed before falling apart.
‘I still can’t do it.’
Xue Ying who was seated cross-legged on the mountain peak lightly shook his head, ‘It is impossible for me to get through the seventh level Star Pagoda if I do not create this technique.’
He had attained the sixth level Star Pagoda in all three Daos of his. The Vermillion Nightmare inheritance had enabled his soul to become stronger too, allowing him to display more Sky Punishment Edges which allowed his combat strength to soar! The Imperial Dragon inheritance had strengthened his physical body, allowing him to resist the destructive energy from the Destruction Devils better…
Even still, Xue Ying could kill eight of the ten Destruction Devils on the seventh level at most. He could not improve any further.
Xue Ying was extremely clear.
To get through the seventh level, the first breakpoint would be to disrupt the team effort by the ten Destruction Devils. A cultivator would have touched on the boundaries of seventh level strength if he could break through the teamwork of the ten Destruction Devils. After that, the cultivator would have to kill them one after another… and it was easier to kill those with weaker survival capabilities.
As a result, one, two, three… the more one killed, the harder it would be.
Xue Ying might have just killed eight of them, leaving behind just two devils alive. But the difficulty had become extremely high. He had to improve his strength to a whole new level before he could even kill the final two. A small increment would not change the outcome.
‘No wonder all cultivators at the Unity realm who could get through the seventh level are highly respected.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly, ‘It is indeed difficult.’
For a Primal Chaos realm expert to get through the seventh level, that was considered an ordinary standard!
But for a Unity realm expert to get through the seventh level meant that they were abnormal! It was certain that they would step into the Primal Chaos realm, and the moment they broke through, they would reach the eighth level standard. Over time, they would become apex experts amongst those of the eighth level. There was even a huge possibility for them to enter the ninth level. As for reaching the final realm ‘Cosmos God’? That was something ultimately hard to predict.
‘Time for me to set off.’
Xue Ying who was seated cross-legged on the mountain peak stood up.
The Star Convention would be starting soon. He was one of the five teachers of the convention, and it was time for him to set off for where the convention would be held at-the ‘Blade Emperor City’.

chapters.title: Chapter 908 - Young Master Xing Huo
chapters.content:
Chapter 908: Young Master Xing Huo
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Hong long long~” Space itself warped and collapsed. The disturbance created was immense.
Two figures walked out side by side. One was Xue Ying and the other was a silver-haired silver-robed black-skinned Inquisitive Sky Hall Master. Inquisitive Sky Hall Master concealed his aura, but those with acute perception like Primal Chaos giants would notice that this was merely an incarnation.
During most Star Conventions, there would be at least one Primal Chaos giant from each holy ground attending the convention. But this time, since Xue Ying was at the Unity realm, and he was taking the responsibility as a teacher of the convention, representing the Great Void Heaven Temple, another person was dispatched as well-the incarnation of Inquisitive Sky Hall Master.
Actually, most would only send their incarnations to attend the convention! Reaching the level of Primal Chaos realm, unless there were important matters that required them to kill extremely powerful enemies, they would usually send their incarnations. Even when they met with their friends or to attend certain ceremonies and gatherings-things that did not require fighting-it sufficed for them to send their incarnations!
‘This is my first time coming to the Blade Emperor City.’ Xue Ying looked afar.
In the distance, there was a colossal city. Under the law suppression of the sacred world, it was hard even with the current strength of Xue Ying to perceive the outline of the entire city. According to the intelligence report, Blade Emperor City was 3.4 trillion kilometers long. Cities spanning this length was quite common in the primal chaos void, though it was a horrifyingly large city when placed within a sacred world. This was practically the biggest city within the two great sacred worlds.
“Hong hong hong~”
There were many layers of array revolving above the Blade Emperor City. These arrays were constantly arousing the World Energy, causing it to surge up violently like tides. Rainbow light rays spread in all directions.
Under the sun high in the sky, Blade Emperor City became all the more dazzling.
“This place feels extraordinary isn’t it?” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master chuckled, “Blade Emperor has paid a huge price in creating this Blade Emperor City. It is said that even Ancestor Sorcerer and Luo City Lord had contributed to its construction. Unique treasures are protecting this place. Even if Sacred Master killed his way over, causing the entire Eastern Unicorn Sacred World to split, the Blade Emperor City would likely remain stable since it belongs to the strongest holy ground in our two great sacred worlds!”
Xue Ying nodded. Even though the foundation of Great Void Heaven Temple was deep, compared to the Blade Emperor City, it was truly lacking!
“Go, let us enter.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master said.
The two of them teleported before arriving at the eastern entrance of the city. They then entered the place. After a moment, experts were coming over to welcome them, arranging a location for Xue Ying and Inquisitive Sky Hall Master to stay.
…
Two relatively luxurious cavern-dwelling were where Xue Ying and Inquisitive Sky Hall Master would be staying during the period of the Star Convention.
“Inquisitive Sky Hall Master, Elder Dong Bo, we have arranged for several attendants in these cavern-dwellings. If there are any minor matters, you can just order them.” A violet metallic-bodied male carrying three blades on his back said, “As for urgent and important matters, you can directly send a message to me.”
“We’ve troubled you, Commander Qiu Blade.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master indifferently responded.
“It is my job.” This Commander Qiu Blade chuckled, “Then I shall not disturb the two of you anymore.” Commander Qiu Blade turned around and left. He soon teleported away.
Inquisitive Sky Hall Master watched as Commander Qiu Blade teleported and disappeared before saying: “Dong Bo, this time, you are one of the five teachers of the convention. This itself has brought about protests and disagreements. As a result, it is crucial for you to make your decision wisely during your selection of the talented cultivators. After all, you aren’t just representing yourself. Instead, you are repsenting our Great Void Heaven Temple too.”
“I undertstand.” Xue Ying nodded.
Forefather let him take on this responsibility as a form of training for Xue Ying. Xue Ying would naturally not do things that would harm the reputation of the Great Void Heaven Temple!
…
There were just three more months before the start of the convention. Xue Ying had already received the name register and relevant information regarding those who were attending the Star Convention this time! All registrations would stop one year before the start of the convention, and experts had been arranged long ago to ‘sweep’ across all experts from the various cities across the two great sacred worlds, bringing them to the Blade Emperor City.
‘Over 16,000 cultivators.’ Xue Ying read through the name register. He calmly pondered over it while walking across the Blade Emperor City.
Xue Ying was currently sight-seeing this ancient city while enjoying some of the more famous delicacies here.
On this day.
The Snow Dragon Restaurant was a very famous restaurant within Blade Emperor City. Its unique method of rearing ‘Snow Dragons’ along with the use of Snow Dragon blood to brew Snow Dragon wine, Snow Dragon meat, Snow Dragon tongue, Snow Dragon liver and various delicacies cooked in different methods made it famous. Even with how big Blade Emperor City was, and how many restaurants there were, this restaurant was still ranked in the top 1,000.
Cultivators required resources, but where did they come from? Other than going out on adventures, killing and fighting others, opening restaurants was another method of earning resouces. Many unique ancient cultivations excelled in the culinary aspect.
“Mn.”
Xue Ying tasted the Snow Dragon meat that looked half-translucent and emitted a light fragrance. As he ate the meat, Xue Ying’s eyes squinted in pleasure, ‘This is absolutely ranked in the top 100 best delicacies that I ever had. Mn mn, in the future when I step into the Primal Chaos realm, when I can publicize my ability of ultra-long distance teleportation, I should bring Jing Qiu, Yu’er, and Qing Yao over to have a taste of this. Wuu, so delicious! Let me try the Snow Dragon liver too. Mn, this Snow Dragon liver is really soft, so soft that it struck a chord in my heart. Truly magnificent.’
The stronger the cultivator, the more sceneries he could experience and see. Of which, eating more delicacies were considered a sort of ‘scenery’.
“Pa.”
A wine flask smashed on the ground, causing the wine to splash. The flask rolled to the side.
Xue Ying who was seated at the corner could not help but look up. Not far away, there were three cultivators, and it was rare for them to all be at the Unity realm. Of which, there was a simple green-robed male who stood up with a pale expression. Seated next to him were a golden-robed young man and a beautiful woman. The woman was vaguely giving off an alluring charm.
“Being at the Unity realm, you actually let the wine flask drop on the table?” The golden-robed young man shook his head and said, “Brother Fu Jun, can’t you even bear such a shock? How did you cultivate to the Unity realm given how weak this heart realm of yours is?”
The simple green-robed male was pale. He stared at the golden-robed young man and the beautiful woman. His eyes were filled with disbelief as he said with a shaky voice: “Yan’er, why, why did it end up this way?”
The girl in front of him…
Was his supposed true love. He was certain that she was the one he wanted to walk hand in hand for the rest of his life. He was willing to sacrifice his life for her, and living with her was pure bliss.
“Fu Jun, pardon me, but after meeting Xun Yi, I’ve decided that he is my true love instead.” The red-robed beautiful girl said with a soft voice, “You and I are both cultivators, and should know that love isn’t something that can be forced. When it is time for us to part, we should. I believe that with your cultivation heart realm, you should be able to adapt to it soon enough.”
“Adapt?”
The simple green-robed male looked at the girl, “In what aspect aren’t I as good as he is? I’ve cultivated for a shorter period, yet I am already stronger than him! I am certain that I will be able to enter a holy ground during this Star Convention, and we have known each other for a long period. What about you and him? Both of you have met for just a thousand years. Unless this happened because his father is that ‘Monarch Xing Huo’?”
“This is unrelated to Monarch Xing Huo. When we meet our true love, much less 1,000 years, one year is sufficient.” The red-robed beautiful girl shook her head.
The simple green-robed male looked at the golden-robed young man: “Xing Huo Xun Yi, I treated you as my brother ever since that time, yet I would never have thought that you are so ruthless! Whatever, whatever, I wish for you not to disappoint Yan’er. If you were to do so, I would never forgive you.”
“Brother Fu Jun.”
The golden-robed young man shook his head, “Firstly, it is your wife who seduced me.”
Fu Jun was stunned. The red-robed beautiful girl by the side was similarly startled. She had even used her magic power to isolate the surrounding. Xue Ying who sat by the side began feeling interested in the matter. Within his law domain, it was impossible for this girl to obstruct his probe at her current strength.
“Secondly, after being seduced by her, I immediately went to investigate the matter through the Xing Huo God Palace and had even checked about her past. Adding you, she already had three companions including you. If I were added, I would be the fourth!”
The red-robed beautiful girl was appalled.
Fu Jun was in disbelief: “How could this be?”
The heart realm of powerful cultivators was usually extraordinary. The moment they found a companion whom they would stay with till death, should their partner die, they would rather live alone! It was possible for them to fall in love with a second person due to unique circumstances, but never had there been a situation where a cultivator would have four companions in total! That represented a change of heart three times! The conclusion for this was undoubted that the party was harboring some hidden motives.
Indeed, such cultivators would deliberately entice others to become their companions so that the other parties would treat them well!
After all, one’s companion would usually stay unchanged. Like Xue Ying, he would stake his life for his wife, and would never regret in forking out large amounts of Origin World Rocks for his wife.
And those who deliberately deceive the other party into becoming his or her companion… would be able to cheat them for large amounts of resources.
“Yan’er, you, you…” Jun Fu looked at the red-robed beautiful girl in front of him.
“Don’t listen to his rubbish.” The red-robed beautiful girl hurriedly answered. She felt regretful in her heart though. In the past, she had chosen ‘Jun Fu’ because of his potential and had decided to think of ways to hook up with him. But in the end, she met the young master of ‘Xing Huo God Palace’ who would be participating in the Star Convention this time. Knowing that Monarch Xing Huo was someone famous, and a massive expert at the ninth level Star Pagoda strength, even the holy grounds would not dare to mistreat such a person.
How much resources would the young master of Xing Huo God Palace have? It far outstripped that of what Jun Fu could own.
“Ni Yan, are you thinking of quibbling even in front of me? Why, I’ve arranged experts over to investigate through your past. What about it?” The golden-robed young man indifferent stated as he held on to his wine cup.
The red-robed beautiful girl turned pale after hearing that.
“You are indeed Young Master Xing Huo and is truly ruthless. For me to fail in your hands, I accept it wholeheartedly.” The red-robed beautiful girl immediately stood up. She turned around and left. She did not care about giving these two males a second glance.
The golden-robed young man instead chuckled at Jun Fu: “Brother Jun Fu, you should be thanking me instead.”

chapters.title: Chapter 909 - Real and Fake
chapters.content:
Chapter 909: Real and Fake
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The plain-robed Fu Jun watched in a daze as the red-robed beautiful girl left the restaurant. He was still filled with disbelief: ‘Why would this be, why…’
‘I’ve failed big time!’ The red-robed beautiful girl headed out. She felt sullen in her heart. She had been extremely careful in her attempt to seduce Young Master Xing Huo. In the beginning, she merely hinted to him without leaving behind any information that could be used against her. As a result, she took 1,000 years before she was quite certain that the Young Master Xing Huo had been hooked. Only then did she kick Fu Jun away.
She even deliberately mentioned for him not to hurt Fu Jun too much, and how she was deliberately delaying time until now.
‘Who would have thought that the Young Master Xing Huo is also acting, and he has acted better than I did.’ The red-robed beautiful girl thought. She was an old hand at this, yet she did not see through that Young Master Xing Huo at all. There were even rumors saying that Young Master Xing Huo was someone who had never fallen in love, and only knew how to cultivate. Who would have thought that he was more formidable than she is in terms of disguising emotions?
‘Hmph, it is fine if I failed. Let me see if I could enter the holy ground this time during the Star Convention. If I were to fail, then it is time for me to change my identity.’ The red-robed beautiful girl Ni Yan planned. She was quite decisive. To her, seducing others was merely a method for her to obtain sufficient resources for cultivation.
…
Within the restaurant.
Fu Jun had suffered from a huge shock this time. Previously, he thought that it was only his companion who changed her heart. Who would have thought that it was all fake? She had been deceiving him throughout these years!
“Brother Fu Jun, she is deliberately deceiving you. Why the need to dwell on it?” The golden-robed young man chuckled and poured some wine, “Come come come, let us have some wine.”
“Now that I know that she has been lying about her feelings for me in the past, but the issue is could I forget about it so easily?” Fu Jun bitterly laughed, “Brother Xun Yi, I know that you have good intentions and have indeed helped me to prevent an even bigger issue from happening. But… somehow in my heart, I would prefer for you not to break my illusion.”
The golden-robed young man was stunned momentarily.
“If only it were true, how good it will be.” Fu Jun turned around and left.
The golden-robed young man sat there by himself. He poured a cup for himself while gazing out. He muttered softly to himself: “If only it were true…”
He drank by himself. One cup, and another cup. He continued drinking until he finished the wine before leaving.
Within the corner, Xue Ying was observing things happening. Being one of the five teachers of the convention, he had long obtained the name register and information on those participating in this Star Convention. He naturally recognized those three.
Fu Jun: Cultivated for 320 billion years. A loose cultivator. While adventuring outside, he met ‘Ni Yan’ not long after stepping into the Unity realm, became a couple with her.
Ni Yan: Cultivated for 1.1 trillion years, and also a loose cultivator. It seemed that she was a cunning cultivator, and would frequently seduce other experts to become her companion. From there, she would deceive the other party for resources. Amongst cultivators, there were all sorts of devils, and this kind of schemes was naturally normal.
Xing Huo Xun Yi: Cultivated for 530 billion years. He had a huge background! The previous two were loose cultivators, yet Xing Huo Xun Yi had a famous reputation outside as the seed of ‘Monarch Xing Huo’. Because of the bloodline from his father, Xun Yi was able to cultivate really quickly during the early stages. He entered the Unity realm at a faster speed than Xue Ying did-just within 1.8 billion years. But after that, his strength increment became extremely slow. His father was after all a Primal Chaos giant, and Xun Yi could depend on the bloodline cultivation system to reach the Unity realm at most.
As the other party had high status, there was quite a lot of information on Xing Huo Xun Yi regarding his growth from young to now.
According to the intelligence reports, he never had any companions before! One had to know that he had been cultivating diligently in the Xing Huo God Palace, yet it’s a pity that he remained quite ordinary.
‘Interesting. Truly interesting.’ Xue Ying looked at the back of the departing golden-robed young man, ‘Someone who has never had a companion and only knows about cultivating would actually cause that person called Ni Yan to eat a loss. It seems that there are many things about him which had not been revealed.’
Xue Ying began feeling interested in that young master.
Naturally, nobody present was able to recognize Xue Ying’s identity. Being a teacher of the convention, some of those with a great background would have been told about the selected teachers. The moment he was recognized, Xue Ying would be in trouble. As a result, he had to change his appearances and aura when moving within the Blade Emperor City.
******
Blade Emperor City, in one of the many cavern-dwellings meant for receiving guests.
“Father.”
Xun Yi returned back to the cavern-dwelling.
There was a black curly-haired male seated within by himself. He was extremely muscular, and despite seated, he was still taller than Xun Yi by a head! He was emitting a faint aura, though the operating laws of the sacred world were being affected. In this place, it seemed that the operating laws had to give way to a more powerful aura. Monarch Xing Huo was known for being tyrannical and cruel. But in front of his son, this tyranny and cruelness had become milder.
“Xun Yi.” Monarch Xing Huo said, “You are the son of I, Xing Huo. This time, I wish for you not to disgrace me when you participate in the Star Convention! That big brother of yours has already gotten through the fifth level Star Pagoda. I do not have a high demand for you-just get through the third level will be fine.”
“I can’t do it.” Xing Huo Xun Yi calmly replied.
“You can’t even do this? I’ve already given you whatever cultivation resources you need, yet you can’t do it?” Monarch Xing Huo was slightly incensed, “Unless you still can’t forget that illusory wife of yours until today?”
“How? How can I forget her?”
Xing Huo Xun Yi glared at his father, “I can’t forget it. If you feel that I would disgrace you, I would rather give up now then to participate in the Star Convention.”
Monarch Xing Huo was stunned.
He was indeed helpless. He had forced his son over to participate in the Star Convention, hoping that his son would still fight for himself in this gathering of many experts.
“Go.” Monarch Xing Huo had nothing to say.
Xing Huo Xun Yi turned around and left.
Monarch Xing Huo sat there quietly. He felt regretful, extremely regretful.
He had two sons. The youngest one originally had an extremely high talent. Even though he cultivated the bloodline cultivation system, he had similarly cultivated the ancient cultivation system! The youngest son specialized most in the illusory realm under the ancient cultivation system. When he trained in both great systems, he cultivated just slightly slower in the ancient cultivation system than the bloodline cultivation system; he spent 300 million years to step into the Void God level with his ancient cultivation system, causing Monarch Xing Huo to be rapt with joy at that time!
The bloodline cultivation system depended on his father, but the ancient cultivation system had a huge demand on one’s comprehension ability. Even though most children would not lack in their comprehension ability when their father is formidable, the children would still have to depend on themselves for their cultivation.
But his son had become a Void God in just 300 million years. He immediately went on to search for a precious treasure which was meant for cultivating illusory realm. It was worth more than 10,000 Origin World Rocks, and was known as the ‘Boundary Stone’. The Boundary Stone would naturally give rise to an illusory realm, and was truly exquisite. The illusory realm formed every time would be different.
Researching and experiencing it within would allow the cultivator to experience the different profound mysteries regarding the illusory realm.
After his son obtained it, he would frequently send his consciousness within the ‘Boundary Stone’, experiencing different kinds of illusory worlds! Those illusory worlds were extremely mystical. The inner law system was comparable to that of a miniature cosmos, and it would be different every single time.
That was why his son Xing Huo Xun Yi was able to promote his ancient cultivation system to the Unity realm in just 2.6 billion years. But after that, something happened…
The Boundary Stone.
The illusory world was seriously too real! The worlds which were formed within contained many beings that felt like real people. They had spirit, emotions, gratitude, and grudges. Precisely because it was real enough that such illusory realms contained operating laws comparable to those in a miniature cosmos.
But his son, ‘Xing Huo Xun Yi’ had fallen in love with a girl within the illusory world.
As he knew she was fake, Xing Huo Xun Yi only harbored an attitude of playing with her since he experienced too many illusory worlds before and had experienced the entire spectrum of emotions. This was also the reason why he was so good at ‘disguising’ himself. But despite knowing that she was fake, over time, Xing Huo Xun Yi still began immersing himself in this world.
Because everything was too real, it had truly touched the inner heart of Xing Huo Xun Yi.
In the end, he had fallen into it.
He did not wish for it to end! He had spent his life living with that girl in the illusory world. They had even become companions. Xing Huo Xun Yi had even thought of ways to let his wife live longer.
Within the ‘illusory world’, his wife indeed became someone powerful and was able to live for a long time. But ultimately, this was still an illusory realm. This illusory realm eventually crumbled apart. The ‘Boundary Stone’ took the initiative to form a new illusory world again.
“No-” At the point when the illusory world crumbled, his wife disappeared in front of him.
Even though he told his wife everything, his wife understood that she was part of the illusory realm and had accepted it wholeheartedly.
But Xing Huo Xun Yi could not accept it.
The world in front crumbled. The myriad existences were destroyed. All living beings were annihilated, and his wife was included amongst these people.
“No, no-”
Xing Huo Xun Yi had turned entirely crazy.

chapters.title: Chapter 910 - The Unity Realm Dong Bo Xue Ying
chapters.content:
Chapter 910: The Unity Realm Dong Bo Xue Ying
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Ai.” Monarch Xing Huo sighed as he sat in the courtyard, “If only I had not given the Boundary Stone to Xun Yi, how good would things be.”
This son of his had almost become trash.
He had thought of many ways, yet none worked for him. This grief had already pervaded into the essence of ‘Xing Huo Xun Yi’s soul, and even if he sealed the memories of his son, his son would still hate cultivating-he was no longer willing. Monarch Xing Huo had even invited several Primal Chaos giants who specialized in the illusory realm for help to weave an illusory realm for his son! He wanted them to guide Xing Huo Xun Yi through the illusory realm and cure his grief but to no avail. Even though Monarch Xing Huo tried ‘using medicine for the heart to cure the sickness of the heart’, it was almost impossible for other experts to replicate that particular illusory world formed from the Boundary Stone.
Monarch Xing Huo even went to ask several Cosmos Gods for help. Their answers were exactly the same-his emotional injury had penetrated deep into the essence of his soul, and it was too difficult for him to recover.
For instance, Transcendents had been unable to rise again after stumbling down.
And Xing Huo Xun Yi was originally a genius at the Unity realm. He was very powerful and was proficient in the illusory realm too. Such an expert would not easily get affected in his heart realm. But the moment he became hurt emotionally, it was a trillion times harder to recover from it. External factors were practically impossible to help him recover from this wound.
The only way to save Xing Huo Xun Yi would for him to cure himself! But how difficult was it for him to take the initiative and struggle out of this quagmire?
‘I’ve always been by his side. Maybe I am wrong. I should rely on this Star Convention and let him go out to explore the world. Who knows there might even be miracles.’ Monarch Xing Huo thought. He had a heaven-defying power, but he was helpless when dealing with this situation.
******
In the blink of an eye, it was the official day of the Star Convention.
“Sou, sou.”
Xue Ying flew over together with Inquisitive Sky Hall Master through the sky in the city. They saw many other figures flying in the same direction as them! Within the Blade Emperor City, under the unseen array suppression, only those above the Unity realm could fly.
‘The gathering place where the Star Convention is at has been constructed really well.’ Xue Ying saw the enormous gathering place which was chosen to be next to the Star Pagoda. This location was chosen because the Star Pagoda was a fixed landmark, and Blade Emperor City only had few slightly wider regions which they could use to build the gathering place. This area originally occupied a length of 500 kilometers, but as they flew, the cultivators would discover a distortion in this gathering location, expanding it into a region of half a million kilometers wide.
“Inquisitive Sky Hall Master, Elder Dong Bo, please.” Experts immediately arrived to guide them along.
Once they got closer to the gathering place, most people would be forced to descend. They had to walk orderly in a line.
But this was not the case for Xue Ying and Inquisitive Sky Hall Master. They were guided directly to a distant towering high platform. There were a total of 11 seats at the center of the platform, with more seats by the side.
“Elder Dong Bo, please.” Everyone’s seat was appropriately allocated.
The middle of the 11 central seats was given to the most important person attending the Star Convention-the host, ‘Heart Imitation Religious Master’. There were only two ninth level Star Pagoda experts in the entire Blade Emperor City, and Heart Imitation Religious Master was one of them. Strictly speaking, it was rare for someone like him to host the Star Convention which happened once every trillion years.
And furthermore, there was another ninth level Star Pagoda expert taking on the role of a teacher of the convention this time-’General Hatchet Palace Master’.
Since General Hatchet Palace Master would be coming, Blade Emperor City as the host would naturally not disrespect the other party by sending a host with a lower level. That was why Heart Imitation Religious Master had personally come to host the convention.
To the left where Heart Imitation Religious Master was seated, they would be the five teachers of this convention. They were General Hatchet Palace Master, Violet Slaughter Island Master, Five Luster Serpent Ancestor, General Heaven Light, and Xue Ying.
And to the right, the other five were Primal Chaos guests originating from other holy grounds such as Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and other experts such as from the Star City…
Other than the middle 11 seats, there were several other seats located by the side. They were for Primal Chaos giants coming from non-holy ground superpowers! And there would be about ten of them attending this time. Even someone strong like ‘Monarch Xing Huo’ had to sit by the side because he was not part of the holy ground! This was the rule of the Star Convention. Only experts from the six great holy grounds could take the middle seats.
“General Hatchet, I would not have thought that you will take on the role as a teacher of the convention this time.” Heart Imitation Religious Master laughed. The external appearance of Heart Imitation Religious Master was weird. He had a thin and long face, and his five sense organs were quite ugly. Nevertheless, his aura was warm, and even those who were picky about appearances would feel joy when looking at him.
“It is time for me to have a walk outside. If I were to stay in closed-door cultivation forever, it is impossible for me to seek opportunities to breakthrough as well.” General Hatchet said.
“This last step is genuinely tough.” Heart Imitation Religious Master shook his head. He was once outstanding and the most dazzling cultivator for an era-being one of the two experts from the six great holy grounds who had crossed the seventh level Star Pagoda at the Unity realm. He had continued soaring after reaching the Primal Chaos realm and had even started his own religion with great self-confidence, publicly spreading his Dao.
Many cultivators joined his religion and abided by his order.
Nevertheless, this cultivator who reached the limit of Primal Chaos realm-the ninth level of Star Pagoda, had stopped here without improving any further. Even though he questioned himself and understood that he was not any weaker than Cosmos Gods in certain aspects, he still could not take that last step. As such, there was still an intrinsic difference between him and other Cosmos Gods.
…
On the high platform of the Star Convention, the Primal Chaos giants were chatting with each other. Many of them had known one another before this.
As for Xue Ying, he sat at the side of the middle seats by himself. ‘General Heaven Light’ was seated beside him, and there was a faint golden light revolving on his body which formed a slight power that suppressed on Xue Ying. This caused the expression of Xue Ying to shift: ‘He isn’t even keeping his aura? Is he deliberately suppressing me?’
General Heaven Light was at the eighth level Star Pagoda strength, so his power was relatively overbearing. Xue Ying decided to just apply his law domain and forcibly resist the other party’s power.
One was pressing down and one resisting.
The relationship between the two became even more frigid.
‘A Unity realm brat dares to be on the same level as us?’ General Heaven Light swept the corner of his eyes at Xue Ying. He was too lazy to even glance at him and too lazy to talk to him. He was famous for being tyrannical amongst the Primal Chaos giants, and he would even berate and put down the weaker Primal Chaos experts, much less someone at the Unity realm.
In his eyes, those at the Unity realm were ants! Even disciples of his own Blade Emperor City were filled with fear and trepidation for him.
Who would have thought that someone at the Unity realm would be standing on an equal level with him? General Heaven Light could not accept it. It’s a pity that this was determined by the Cosmos Gods, and he had no choice but to accept. But asking him to smile amiably at Xue Ying? Impossible!
“Everyone.”
A warm voice reverberated throughout the entire gathering place. It appeared as if the sound came from everyone’s soul.
Heart Imitation Religious Master chuckled as he began introducing the origin of the Star Convention and the rules for it.
The process for the Star Convention was straightforward.
First was the preliminary selections!
The 16,000 cultivators who were participating in the Star Convention would all try crossing through the Star Pagoda. The treasure spirit of the Star Pagoda would then determine the strongest top 100 according to the results of how far they went in the Star Pagoda! The treasure spirit was absolutely fair. It was still complete a task like ranking the cultivators based on their strength.
And the teachers of the convention would also spend 1,000 years to observe these talented cultivators. The talented cultivators could come and consult the teachers of the convention. Within the 1,000 years, the teachers of the convention would thoroughly observe before selecting those who were weaker, yet had great potential. Everyone could choose 20 cultivators! Adding up to a total of 100 as well.
Thus, there would be a total of 200 cultivators chosen!
These 200 were qualified to enter the holy grounds. But they would only become ordinary disciples under such situation.
After the preliminary selections ended, the 200 cultivators would obtain resources, absolute art books and guidance from experts by the six great holy grounds. They would cultivate for 10,000 years. Naturally, they would be cultivating in an environment where time was accelerated. In reality, only 100 years had passed. Even though it was slightly short, if they did not obtain sufficient resources and proper guidance in the past, this short period of 100 years was enough for their power to surge!
And whether it would increase would depend on their potential.
…
After the preliminary selections, they would cultivate for 10,000 years.
After cultivating, these 200 would then battle with one another to determine the top five!
And after the battle ended, they were still required to attempt the Star Pagoda in a bid to rank these cultivators again. This time, the teachers of the convention would have a total of 10,000 years for close observation. They would even personally guide them before choosing another five after this period.
A total of 10 cultivators! These 10 would be the most outstanding talents. They would be bestowed with resources and would be nurtured with a full effort by the holy grounds. Furthermore, they could choose the holy ground they wanted to join.
Finally-
The five teachers of the convention would give lectures about the Dao to participating cultivators.
After all, such a convention where many talented cultivators participated in would have many cultivators spectating. Such a public lecture would be very helpful to these cultivators, of which most of them were loose cultivators!
And the convention would finally end after the public lectures were done.
******
Located in the gathering place of the Star Convention, there were a total of slightly more than 16,000 talented cultivators. They came from different places around the sacred worlds and the primal chaos void.
Other than them.
There were also a large number of cultivators spectating the battles-more than those participating in it. Just the residents of Blade Emperor City counted to a few hundred million people. There were also some who came especially just for this. There were so many people that it felt like an ocean. These spectators had occupied 90% of the space within the entire gathering place.
“Look, there is actually someone at the Unity realm above.”
“That’s weird.”
“It should all be Primal Chaos giants. Why would there be someone at the Unity realm?” The spectators were looking at the high platform. The location of Xue Ying was extremely conspicuous!
“I’ve heard that there is someone at the Unity realm amongst the teachers of the convention this time.” At that time, those who were well-informed began talking about what they heard.

chapters.title: Chapter 911 - Preliminary Ranking
chapters.content:
Chapter 911: Preliminary Ranking
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Unity realm? Don’t spout nonsense. I’ve seen many Star Conventions held in the Blade Emperor City, and the teachers of the convention would all be Primal Chaos giants. When was it that someone at the Unity realm could become a teacher of the convention? You should know that all the participants are at the Unity realm-talented ones too! Letting someone at the Unity realm be their teacher?”
“Right, right, I’ve never heard of it before too.”
“That restaurant of mine has a frequent customer who is a disciple of the Blade Emperor City. It is he who told me about someone called Dong Bo Xue Ying from the Great Void Heaven Temple who will be taking the responsibility as a teacher of the convention this time. He is merely at the Unity realm.”
“Dong Bo Xue Ying from the Great Void Heaven Temple?”
…
Cultivators at different locations began gossiping.
After all, these were ordinary cultivators. Their sources of information were inferior. They would only hear of experts who had cultivated long enough and were famous enough. Cultivators like Xue Ying who rose too quickly were entirely unheard of amongst these lower-runged cultivators. Only those who had good friends that were disciples of the Blade Emperor City would get to know of this news.
As they gossiped, one spread to ten. Ten spread to 100. Gradually, everyone knew of it.
“It is said that this Elder Dong Bo is the strongest Unity realm across the six great holy grounds in this generation. So he is still qualified to be a teacher of the convention.”
“The strongest Unity realm in the six great holy grounds? So what! Most teachers of the convention are Primal Chaos giants.
