According to what I know, most Primal Chaos experts can’t even take on the role as a teacher of the convention-it must be those who were strong enough could they be qualified to take on the responsibility! He as a Unity realm expert is taking the responsibility? Isn’t that a joke? Can his foresight match up to the other four teachers?”
“It is indeed weaker by a bit.”
“Why are we talking about these useless things?”
These ordinary cultivators were gossiping amongst each other. If they said that they revered Primal Chaos giants quite a lot, then to someone at the Unity realm, they did not have any admiration at all since they were quite commonly seen. These ordinary cultivators did not find it convincing for someone at the Unity realm to take on the responsibility as a teacher of the convention.
******
The ‘preliminary selection’ of the Star Convention would be starting soon.
Xue Ying and the others were seated high above. There were good food and good wine. As for the 16,000 talented cultivators below, they were lining up in an orderly manner. All of them would be entering the Star Pagoda in succession.
The Star Pagoda would control the time flow to allow the battles to proceed more quickly. But even if it was accelerated at a hundred times the regular time flow, only a few thousand had attempted the Star Pagoda within a day. After all, the cultivators would be thinking of ways to kill as many Destruction Devils as possible so that they would rank higher after by performing better in the Star Pagoda.
“1st, Fire Horn Ku Mu”
“2nd, Ka Sen.”
Many names started appearing in the void next to the Star Pagoda. The list was continuously being added with names, and the ranking was continually changing. Clearly, the treasure spirit of the Star Pagoda was ranking the cultivators and refreshing the list after every new cultivator entered. The rankings were entirely public! Firstly, it was for fairness. Secondly, it would stimulate those talented cultivators. Thirdly, those who were ranked behind would understand how much worse off they were! Ultimately, these cultivators who were qualified were all talented people. In the past, they had seen few cultivators with similar or better talent and were thus proud of themselves. This time participating in the Star Convention was definitely an excellent stimulation for them.
Five days later.
The Star Pagoda preliminary selection of the Star Convention had finally ended! The list of ranking was fixed.
‘Mn?’ Xue Ying looked up at the densely written register located high above the sky beside the Star Pagoda, ‘Of the three brats I’ve seen previously, hmm, that son of Monarch Xing Huo seems quite ordinary.’
That person called ‘Fu Jun’ ranked relatively high-he was 126th! But he lacked the fortune to enter the top 100. Otherwise, he would have directly passed the selection without having to be selected by the teachers of the convention.
Ni Yan, ranked 1,932.
Xing Huo Xun Yi, ranked 3,613.
‘He is ranked beyond 3,000?’ Xue Ying shook his head inwardly. That time, of the three Unity realm brats he met, he was the most interested in Young Master Xing Huo, though this ranking of his was too ordinary, ‘He is ranked so low, yet only 200 can be chosen for the preliminary selection. The possibility of him getting through the selection is negligible.’
There would be 100 cultivators chosen from the Star Pagoda, and the five teachers of the convention would select another 100. Only a total of 200 would pass through the first round of selections.
‘3,613th?’ Monarch Xing Huo who came this time to observe the convention frowned. He sighed inwardly. This ranking was truly low! One had to know that the disciples who participated in the convention were not disciples from the holy grounds. They were all loose cultivators from everywhere, and there were few with a huge background. This son of his had excellent cultivation conditions and resources, yet he had merely gotten this rank.
As a result, being the son of Monarch Xing Huo would instead lower his evaluation by the teachers of the convention.
The Star Pagoda selection had ended.
Many ordinary cultivators who came to watch the battle left in large amounts. After all, the selection by the teachers of the convention would take 1,000 years, and cultivating required 10,000 years. In other words, the next public matches would happen 11,000 years later from now.
…
Many figures on the high platform began standing and leaving the vicinity.
“Five teachers.”
Heart Imitation Religious Master took the initiative to speak to the five teachers, “The Star Pagoda selection has ended. We have the preliminary ranking out. In a while, the combat recordings of those cultivators would be sent to you. All of you should consider well who you should choose since your decision would determine the fate of these talents.”
“Heart Imitation Religious Master, please be rest assured. All of us will definitely choose those with great potential.” General Heaven Light said.
“Elder Dong Bo, do remember not to disgrace the reputation of Great Void Heaven Temple.” Five Luster Serpent Ancestor coldly said. Five Luster Serpent Ancestor was covered in a black robe, and the aura he emitted was icy and sinister. Even his voice was biting cold.
General Hatchet Palace Master was startled momentarily. Even Violet Slaughter Island Master was quite shocked. That was kind of excessive.
Xue Ying’s expression had a slight change. Honestly speaking, he initially had a favorable impression of Five Luster Serpent Ancestor because the other party was a member of the Void God Palace, and the Void Primogenitor was his own grand teacher! It was okay if General Heaven Light was not kind to him, but Five Luster Serpent Ancestor had to say such ugly words to him when the other Primal Chaos giants were present!
If he disclosed his identity as a Voidwalker, the attitude of Five Luster Serpent Ancestor might change.
But because his teacher ‘Gu Qi’ was being pursued after by the Sacred Master, Xue Ying would not deliberately publicize his identity as a Voidwalker.
“There’s no need for Five Luster Serpent Ancestor to trouble over my matters.” Xue Ying answered, “Since the Cosmos Gods have chosen me, they would naturally have their reasons of doing so.”
“Hmph.” Five Luster Serpent Ancestor snorted before leaving.
Actually, the reputation of Five Luster Serpent Ancestor was quite good outside-he was considered someone who ‘hated the evil’. And was someone quite cold. But being a void creature, he was naturally used to the hierarchy of strong and weak. In his opinion, the Unity realm Xue Ying was not on the same level as they at the Primal Chaos realm. He naturally did not like him and was too lazy to even be polite to Xue Ying.
“Since the Cosmos Gods have chosen you, you should not disappoint them.” General Heaven Light gave Xue Ying a smile that did not seem like one. He then left the place as well.
Xue Ying did not say much.
Suddenly, a hand landed on his shoulder. This jolted Xue Ying. He hurriedly turned around, only to see the thin and white hand of General Hatchet Palace Master. Even though he had two fangs revealed outside his mouth, he gave off the feeling that his body was weak. He chuckled, “Cultivators have all sorts of temperament. Don’t mind them too much.”
“General Hatchet Palace Master.” Xue Ying immediately bowed. This was not the first time he met with General Hatchet Palace Master. The other party was someone on the same level as Black Emperor and Primal Chaos Hall Master.
“Dong Bo brat, I am on your side too.” An absolutely stunning violet-robed ‘Violet Slaughter Island Master’ giggled. Her voice was enchanting, “I do not like that Heaven Light too. In the future when you become stronger than him, you must teach him a good lesson and help me vent my anger too.”
Heart Imitation Religious Master was still present by the side. He felt awkward after hearing it since General Heaven Light was ultimately part of their Blade Emperor City.
“Everyone, let us return.” Heart Imitation Religious Master chuckled. He also smiled kindly at Xue Ying.

chapters.title: Chapter 912 - Visiting
chapters.content:
Chapter 912: Visiting
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Night.
Xue Ying sat by himself within the courtyard. There was currently a projection of battles in midair ahead of him-scenes of battles happening within the Star Pagoda by the talented cultivators. There was also a female attendant warming wine and pouring wine for Xue Ying by the side.
As he held on to the wine glass, he lightly sipped.
‘His body is quite strong. He should be training in the strongest warrior cultivation system.’ Xue Ying swiftly made his judgment after observing it, ‘It isn’t easy being a teacher of the convention.’
Just solely analyzing the more than 10,000 talented cultivators through their battle scenes was not an easy task already, much less taking into account their background origins and age. Even though the majority had been eliminated, there were still more than a thousand cultivators he had to consider. They had their own cultivation experiences, and different strength and specializations.
‘This cultivator could only get through the first level of Star Pagoda? Too weak!’ Xue Ying immediately eliminated him. Even if the cultivator had a poorer cultivating condition, or that they had no absolute art techniques, as long as they had a good comprehension ability, it was impossible for them to stop at the first level strength.
This time, there was just one talented cultivator who got through the fourth level! He was called ‘Cang Qiong Tian Yun’ and had cultivated for just 1.2 trillion years. He was purely a loose cultivator and had never obtained the guidance of any experts before! He had long aroused the interest of all six great holy grounds. After all, if not for the books and resources provided by the Great Void Heaven Temple, it was not certain that Xue Ying could achieve what he had within a trillion years! Naturally, he might even produce better results than Cang Qiong Tian Yun!
There were 392 who got through the third level of Star Pagoda!
And 4,018 who actually got through the second level of Star Pagoda!
The remaining few had all gotten through the first level of Star Pagoda. They were at the very least still Unity realm experts so they could get through the first level.
“Elder.” A protector walked in from outside the courtyard. He respectfully said, “Monarch Hidden Dragon is currently outside the courtyard requesting to meet you.”
“Quickly let him in.” Xue Ying hurriedly said.
Xue Ying stood up quickly before taking the initiative to walk out. In his heart, he was muttering: ‘This is the biggest headache of selecting the talented cultivators.’
The six great holy grounds were prudent in their selections of the disciples. It was a rare opportunity for those who could enter the six great holy grounds through the ‘Star Convention’. The moment they succeeded, even if they did not obtain any resources, they would still be able to get unseen protection! After all, the moment the enemies hear that they were disciples from the six great holy grounds, they would feel wary in their hearts. Those with sufficient statuses were people even Cosmos Gods could not easily kill, much less the Primal Chaos realm experts.
And the five teachers of the convention.
What identity did General Hatchet Palace Master have? Even General Heaven Light, Five Luster Serpent Ancestor, and Violet Slaughter Island Master were eighth level Star Pagoda experts in the Primal Chaos realm. Seeking their help was difficult.
There was only Xue Ying at the Unity realm who seemed the easiest to ‘overcome’ from the surface.
‘I have given the orders that I will not be meeting any Unity realm experts.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘But a Primal Chaos realm expert is someone I have to meet.’
He was the strongest Unity realm expert in the six great holy grounds! Xue Ying would not see anybody at the Unity realm. He was not targeting someone, but instead, Xue Ying was not meeting all of them! Since that’s the case, those Unity realm experts would not feel left out or indignant that Xue Ying did not want to meet them.
But it was different for Primal Chaos giants! It was a great respect for them to come personally and visit Xue Ying. If Xue Ying declined to meet these giants, he would be going way overboard.
‘Fortunately! There are very few talented geniuses participating in the Star Convention with a Primal Chaos giant behind their backs. There are even fewer who would come seeking me, and could be counted with one’s fingers.’ Xue Ying thought. It was easier for him to deal with them since fewer giants were meeting him.
Outside the courtyard, there was a male who seemed dimwitted. He looked like an ordinary person who had kept all his aura. If not for recognizing him, Xue Ying would not know that this person was the famous Monarch Hidden Dragon! Monarch Hidden Dragon had not relied on any other superpowers. Instead, he took the initiative to head towards the boundary of the void. He had killed many Destruction Devils and was extremely valiant. He had thus obtained the admiration of many other Primal Chaos giants.
He was an outspoken and straightforward person who emphasized loyalty and self-sacrifice. He risked his life for the sake of others, and Xue Ying also admired him a lot.
“Monarch Hidden Dragon.” Xue Ying hurriedly greeted.
“Pardon me for disturbing Elder. Who would have thought that Elder has even taken the initiative to welcome me in.” Monarch Hidden Dragon chuckled.
“It is my honor for Monarch to come and meet me. How can I take it slowly? Monarch, please.” The other party was treating him politely, so Xue Ying naturally had to return the basic courtesy.
He led Monarch Hidden Dragon into the cavern-dwelling.
The two of them then sat down within the courtyard. The female attendant also prepared some wine glasses and poured wine for Monarch Hidden Dragon too.
“Withdraw from here first.” Xue Ying ordered.
“Yes.” The female attendant retreated.
Monarch Hidden Dragon chuckled, “Knowing that elder is very busy today, I do not want to waste your time either. This time I came to seek elder for your help.”
‘It is here.’ Xue Ying grumbled inwardly.
“Please tell me.” Xue Ying said it outwardly. This time, there was indeed a disciple under Monarch Hidden Dragon who participated in the Star Convention. He was ranked at about over 600, though he cultivated for far too long-a total of 1.8 trillion years. And he was just ranked beyond 600 after personally guided by Monarch Hidden Dragon. Those who were ranked in the front would naturally be more qualified for Xue Ying to select.
“He is called ‘Chen Qiong’.” Monarch Hidden Dragon said.
“Ah.” Xue Ying was startled.
Chen Qiong?
This wasn’t a disciple of Monarch Hidden Dragon. Instead, he was a loose cultivator without any background.
“He is the personal disciple of an old friend of mine.” Monarch Hidden Dragon sighed, “My old friend is only at the Unity realm. This time as I brought my disciples over, seeing that little brat Chen Qiong… I could discern that he is related to my good friend. It’s a pity that my good friend has already died. He is also the disciple that my good friend accepted before dying. When my good friend died, this brat has just become a True God and has always stayed independent until now. I’ve taught him before, and his comprehension ability and potential are beyond that of my disciples. Hence, I’ve come with a thick-skin, hoping for you to give this little brat a chance.”
“Chen Qiong?” Xue Ying naturally remembered this brat.
He was ranked really low-at 2,001th. But he cultivated for a really short period-only 80 billion years! Being a loose cultivator, he was considered outstanding given that he had not even cultivated for 100 billion years.
“He cultivated for a very short period. This time participating in the Star Convention, if mentioning the length of cultivation, he is the second youngest.” Xue Ying said, “Even though he is ranked slightly worse, his potential is actually really high. Even if Monarch Hidden Dragon did not come and find me, he would likely be chosen by the five teachers of the convention.”
“I know. If his potential isn’t sufficient, I wouldn’t have come.” Monarch Hidden Dragon said, “I am only afraid of accidents happening since there are many talents here.”
“I’ll thoroughly look into it. If I can help, I’ll naturally do my best.” Xue Ying did not say ‘die’ in his words. After all, he had never seen through the combat battles of the majority of cultivators.
“Alright.”
Monarch Hidden Dragon stood up. He chuckled, “Then I shall not disturb you any longer.”
Xue Ying immediately sent Monarch Hidden Dragon off.
‘Whew, it is indeed nice to talk to this Monarch Hidden Dragon.’ When the other party left, Xue Ying resumed watching the many combat scenes, ‘I still thought he would come and persuade me to accept his own disciple. So it is a disciple of an old friend of his, and he has great potential too.’
…
Because there was a total of 1,000 years, some who wanted to act as a go-between was not in a rush. Instead, Monarch Hidden Dragon had gone visiting the five teachers of convention and asking them to pay notice to ‘Chen Qiong’. And the last teacher he went to, ‘General Hatchet Palace Master’ had even directly said: “Hahaha, Brother Hidden Dragon, be rest assured. I will definitely be choosing this brat Chen Qiong. This time, I took the initiative to become a teacher of the convention because I wanted to find a disciple or two for myself. I quite like Chen Qiong this brat. If we are fated, he might become my personal disciple.”
Monarch Hidden Dragon was in rapt ecstasy at that point: “Haha, if that’s the case, there will be no need for me to seek the other four teachers of the convention already.”
But after thoroughly thinking about it, he discovered that the combat style of Chen Qiong was indeed quite similar to that of General Hatchet Palace Master.
“You don’t have to be worried about Chen Qiong. Instead, you should be worried about your own disciples since they are quite ordinary in potential.” General Hatchet Palace Master shook his head.
“How is it possible for everyone to be amazing.” Monarch Hidden Dragon did not seem to mind his comment.
…
And in the following days, two consecutive Primal Chaos giants visited Xue Ying. They wanted to seek his help, though those cultivators were far off from the potential ‘Chen Qiong’ had. Furthermore, in the judgment by Xue Ying, they could not even enter his top 300 selections! He might have eliminated them, but he did not say that he would be giving them out. Instead, he did not promise them.
A month after the Star Convention started.
“Elder, Monarch Xing Huo is here to visit you.” The protector did not even dare to say that the other party was ‘requesting a visit’.
“Monarch Xing Huo?” Xue Ying was in great shock. This was an existence at the ninth level Star Pagoda strength, and even Cosmos Gods were respectful to them.
‘What bitterness! That son of his has cultivated for a slightly longer period, yet he is ranked too poorly.’ Xue Ying was whining in his heart. He originally had a favorable impression of Xing Huo Xun Yi before the convention began, it was just that the other party performed too ordinary. Regarding potential, he was judged to be outside the top 1,000!

chapters.title: Chapter 913 - The Request of Monarch Xing Huo
chapters.content:
Chapter 913: The Request of Monarch Xing Huo
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was complaining in his heart. Nevertheless, he still went out of the cavern-dwelling to receive the guest.
“Greetings Monarch.” Xue Ying said. He was clear that even Heaven Weeping Sect Master and the other Primal Chaos giants would have to be respectful to Monarch Xing Huo since the other party could kill ordinary Primal Chaos experts with a single move just like how Xue Ying could slaughter Unity realm experts.
“Elder Dong Bo, there’s no need to be so polite.” It was rare for Monarch Xing Huo to be so courteous. He was known for being overbearing and cruel.
“Monarch, please.”
The two entered the courtyard and sat down.
Monarch Xing Huo said with a frown: “This time I have indeed an issue which I have to trouble Elder Dong bo for.”
Xue Ying muttered inwardly.
What kind of identity did you, Monarch Xing Huo, have?
If he was willing, he could easily push his son into a certain holy ground superpower. No matter which holy ground it was, Great Void Heaven Temple, Primogenitor Island, Blade Emperor City or others, they were willing to fawn on Monarch Xing Huo. Why the need to participate in the Star Convention and find him for help? The Star Convention was a publicized convention, and the name register that Xue Ying submitted would be broadcast too.
Xing Huo Xun Yi cultivated for more than 500 billion years! He was still ranked over 3,600 and was the son of Monarch Xing Huo. Regarding potential, he was unquestionably ranked outside the top 1,000. Strictly speaking, he would be ranked even outside the top 5,000 cultivators! If his potential was ranked in the top 1,000, it was barely okay for Xue Ying to push him on to the next round.
But this person was ranked beyond 5,000 taking into account his potential! If Xue Ying were to select Xing Huo Xun Yi, he would undoubtedly suffer from criticism by others, and this was something he was not willing to do.
‘Is it because I am the easiest to be persuaded amongst the five teachers?’ Xue Ying felt helpless. Nevertheless, he did not lose his decorum on the surface.
“I wish for this matter to be kept a secret, Elder Dong Bo since it is a disgraceful ugly affair.” Monarch Xing Huo said.
Xue Ying thought.
You also know that it is disgraceful, and an ugly affair? You still wish for me to not spread it to others? If I were to choose him, it is likely for others to know about the affair anyway.
“Hear me say first.” Monarch Xing Huo’s voice became more muffled, “My son Xun Yi, other than cultivating in the bloodline system, he has cultivated the ancient cultivation as well! After all, I am merely at the Primal Chaos realm, and my son would reach the Unity realm at most if he were to cultivate in just the bloodline system. As a result, he is quite diligent in cultivating the ancient cultivation system as well. He spent just 300 million years to reach the Void God level in the ancient cultivation system.”
“What?” Xue Ying was stunned.
300 million years?
Even if a formidable teacher were guiding him, this speed was insane! Those golden-robed disciples of Great Void Heaven Temple had been stuck at the True God Ruler realm for really long! Even though the laws and profound mysteries system was harder to cultivate, pushing to the Void God level in just 300 million years was too frightening.
“That time, I was really excited since I felt that my son would likely reach the Primal Chaos realm in the future. Haha, both father and son are at the Primal Chaos realm, and that will be a story which would spread far and out.” Monarch Xing Huo laughed at himself, “That time, I did not care about the price, and had traded some treasures for unique one called the Boundary Stone.”
“Boundary Stone?” Xue Ying felt his heart moving.
This was a treasure meant to cultivate in the illusory realm. He wanted to obtain it, yet this unique treasure was too expensive, and it was unique.
“I almost forgot to tell you, but my son specialized in the illusory realm with his ancient cultivation system.” Monarch Xing Huo began carefully describing it, “He relied on the Boundary Stone, allowing his speed of cultivation to soar. He spent just a short 2.6 billion years to enter the Unity realm in the ancient cultivation, yet…”
Xue Ying was carefully listening.
The more he listened, the more dumbstruck he became.
So…
So the other party actually fell in love with a girl within the illusory realm and had become wholly engrossed into it. The two had even become Dao companions.
Hearing the description by Monarch Xing Huo, Xue Ying could imagine how that girl knew she was part of the illusory world and was calmly facing death. But ‘Xing Huo Xun Yi’ was in extreme agony. When the illusory world collapsed, everything within disappeared. Even his true love was no more, causing Xing Huo Xun Yi to turn mad.
“I’ve asked Cosmos Gods before, yet they said how the emotional pain has pervaded into the soul of my son. It is extremely difficult to save him with external strength. He has to depend on himself.” Monarch Xing Huo said, “This time I came to find Elder Dong Bo because I know that you are the most talented person in the illusory realm since the Primitive Ancient Sacred Worl era until now. That is why I wish to ask Elder Dong Bo for help in saving my son.”
He was the strongest talent in the illusory realm since the era of the primitive Ancient Sacred World.
With the status of Monarch Xing Huo, the words he spoke were quite logical too.
Until now, the number of people who could match Xue Ying at the Unity realm in the art of illusory realm could be counted with one’s fingers. But the others were all ancient cultivators, and they depended on their talents! As for Xue Ying, before he had gotten the ‘Vermillion Nightmare inheritance’, he was merely cultivating in the laws and profound mysteries system. He had pushed the Dao of Mirage all the way until his current level, and after obtaining the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance, he had easily altered the inheritance!
Was altering a technique easy?
Not easy!
Why could Xue Ying do it? That’s because the difficulty of reaching the sixth level Star Pagoda strength by relying on the talent of ancient cultivation was vastly different from reaching the sixth level in the Dao of Mirage! The laws and profound mysteries system required one to research in the essence of the operating laws. The cultivator had to completely grasp it. By then, he would be able to create all sorts of absolute art by relying on the Dao of Mirage.
But it was different with the ancient cultivation.
The ancient cultivation did not require one to completely comprehend it. It sufficed if he could display the technique! There was no need to study all profound mysteries behind the technique.
As a result, the laws and profound mysteries system and the hex cultivation system were famous for being difficult to train in. But they were also renowned for being powerful. It was usual for those at the Unity realm cultivating in these systems to reach the third level Star Pagoda strength.
As for the ancient cultivation, it depended more on talent and inheritance! The truly heaven-defying ones were really heaven-defying, and the truly weak ones were very weak too.
As a result-
In history, there was only Xue Ying who had researched the illusory realm profound mysteries to this extent at the Unity realm. He had even cultivated for a short period only-at tens of billions of years! Monarch Xing Huo said that he was the strongest talent in history ever since the primitive Ancient Sacred World in the illusory realm was quite logical. If he knew that Xue Ying was about to step into the Primal Chaos realm in his Dao of Mirage, the other party would likely become more excited. Xue Ying’s accomplishment in the Dao of Mirage was distinctly higher than that of Monarch Xing Huo already.
“You are a cultivator of the laws and profound mysteries system, and also specialized in the illusory realm.” Monarch Xing Huo looked at Xue Ying, “I am also in desperate need to seek any ‘doctors’ I can find. I have no other choices, so I have to ask if Elder Dong Bo has any idea.”
“Boundary Stone.”
Xue Ying softly shook his head, “How can it be so casually used? Even though it allows the cultivator to research in different types of illusory realms with the user being the master of the illusory realm, allowing him to study all relevant laws. This is exceptionally helpful to cultivation. But! The stronger the illusory realm, the more real it would be. And Xing Huo Xun Yi personally has not accumulated enough experiences in this aspect. Even though he can easily escape from the illusory realm for he is the master, it is possible that he might just become immersed in it over time. And once that happens, it will be troublesome.”
If an enemy fell into the illusory realm, that would be for eternal, and his life and death would be determined by other people.
But being the master of the illusory realm, if he fell into the realm personally, it would affect his heart realm really significantly. The power of the heart realm… was mysterious. A cultivator who believed that he was dead in his heart would really cause his soul to crumble and die. This was the same with relationships. If one fell for another party in the illusory realm, if someone knew about it and forced the other party awake, it was fine.
But if nobody was there to hinder the user like Xing Huo Xun Yi, then he would just fall deeper and deeper into it. It was possible for him to maintain this state until the entire illusory realm entered the great apocalypse.
“I am too confident of my son.” Monarch Xing Huo felt regretful.
He knew too few about the training of illusory realm. Also, it was because he personally treated himself ruthlessly. He felt that to accomplish something huge, he had to be ruthless with his son too!
“Is there any methods though?” Monarch Xing Huo asked.
“No other ways. I’ve never encountered such a situation before.” Xue Ying shook his head. He had a Dao companion himself, and it was considered good already if he did not turn mad should he encounter a similar severer emotional situation like Xing Huo Xun Yi.
“Let’s just try.” Monarch Xing Huo added.
He was genuinely desperate to seek a doctor. Even though he had attempted seeking for help many times-he had even asked those who were extremely powerful-from his opinion, Xue Ying was the greatest genius in history on the illusory realm. If his Dao of Mirage had reached the Primal Chaos realm, then Xue Ying would be the only Dao of Mirage, laws and profound mysteries system Primal Chaos giant. His understanding of the illusory realm would be much deeper.
“No matter what, you should meet up with him and see if there are any methods you could employ.” Monarch Xing Huo said.
Xue Ying could only nod.
For Monarch Xing Huo to ask him to help his son, what else could Xue Ying do?
“Alright. Let Xing Huo Xun Yi hurry over. I’ll have a good chat with him. I am not certain, though I will try my best.” Xue Ying said.
“I’ll have to trouble you then.” Monarch Xing Huo was being incredibly polite.
He had already prepared himself mentally. Even if Xue Ying could not help him this time, he would wait until Xue Ying reached higher attainment in the Dao of Mirage in the future before asking for his help. Naturally, he had to maintain a good relationship with the other party.
As for entering the holy ground?
Monarch Xing Huo did not really care. What he hoped most was for his son to recover from his emotional wound, and to metamorphose and soar to the sky! That was a day he dreamed of seeing.

chapters.title: Chapter 914 - True Lifeform?
chapters.content:
Chapter 914: True Lifeform?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Early the next day, as the sun rose, the sun ray penetrated through the arrays of Blade Emperor City, causing them to turn gentle as they shone down on the many structures.
“Xun Yi.”
Just as he was prepared to leave his courtyard, Xing Huo Xun Yi saw that muscular figure seated inside. Xing Huo Xun Yi greeted: “Father.”
Monarch Xing Huo said, “I’ve gone to meet Elder Dong Bo the previous day. His attainment in the Dao of Mirage is the highest across cultivators cultivating in the laws and profound mysteries system. He cultivated the “Dark World” and Vermillion Nightmare inheritance and had reached the sixth level Star Pagoda strength. He had even altered the original limit of the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance at the Unity realm! And now, he is half a foot into the seventh level. Furthermore, he has cultivated for tens of billions of years currently, and there is no other talent as capable as he is in the illusory realm since the primitive Ancient Sacred World era.”
“You should go and find him. He might be able to help you.” Monarch Xing Huo said.
“He might be able to help me?” Xing Huo Xun Yi frowned, “I’ve met those Primal Chaos giants who specialized in the illusory realm, yet they are helpless for my case. Does Dong Bo Xue Ying have any idea as to how to solve my issue?”
“Those Primal Chaos giants you met previously were all ancient cultivators!” Monarch Xing Huo coldly said, “The ancient cultivation system is utterly different from the laws and profound mysteries system. In the ancient cultivation system, it is counted as a success when the user is able to unleash the technique. As for the laws and profound mysteries system, the cultivator would have to research in the underlying profound mysteries. They have to truly grasp hold of the most essential profound mysteries and thus, would have to have a deeper understanding of the illusory realm.”
Xing Huo Xun Yi was startled. He then slightly nodded.
He agreed on this point.
Different cultivation system would head in different directions.
Like the devour class cultivation system, they did not have to use their brains even in the early stages. They only needed to ‘devour devour devour’, and they would grow stronger over time.
As for the laws and profound mysteries system, they were required to research into the laws and profound mysteries system even at the Transcendent stage. They were expected to grasp hold of the complete law of the world before they could transcend into the True God realm! Subsequently, they had to grasp hold of the complete ‘law system’ before even stepping into the Void God realm. Thus, the difficulty for the laws and profound mysteries system was much higher than that for the devour-class cultivation system when entering the Void God realm.
Even the hex cultivation system which was known to be of equivalent difficulty took on a different direction as compared to the laws and profound mysteries system.
The laws and profound mysteries system targeted the essence directly! It was about researching the core of the world-the laws and profound mysteries.
The hex cultivation sought to understand the essence of the world through the ‘myriad existences’. As the world developed, many laws would also show up on the myriad existences. They felt that the ‘laws and profound mysteries system’ was too empty, and only by researching the myriad existences could they dissect the world and accumulate sufficient understanding of it. Once they gathered enough experiences and knowledge, they would be able to strengthen their body, their soul, and could even attain an extremely high realm in arrays, refinements, and others.
“Alright, I’ll go.” Xing Huo Xun Yi replied.
Even though he could never forget his true love, Xing Huo Xun Yi was clear in his heart that everything was ultimately an illusion. He understood that he had to wake up from his dream and should focus on his cultivation.
But…
Currently, he was entirely lethargic of cultivation; he felt sick and tired of it. The moment he started cultivating, he would think of his time in the illusory realm, bringing about the memories of his wife who had been destroyed along with the illusory realm. This emotional injury originated from the illusory realm, seeping deep into his heart and causing him to dislike everything related to the illusory realm. This was something entirely out of his control.
“You shouldn’t neglect this.” Monarch Xing Huo said, “Even if he can’t help you this time, being the person with the highest attainment in the Dao of Mirage, Dong Bo Xue Ying might be able to help you in the future as he grows stronger.”
“Mn.” Xing Huo Xun Yi headed out.
…
At the same time when Xing Huo Xun Yi went out, Xue Ying had already gone out to enjoy some delicacies. There were many restaurants within the Blade Emperor City. Those ancient cultivators who were talented in culinary arts would make food that was so delicious that it could cause experts like Xue Ying to exclaim in admiration. Naturally, he would frequently go out to savor the good food.
“Ah.” Xue Ying could see with a glance that a golden-robed young man was waiting silently by the courtyard entrance.
Being a teacher of the convention, many talented cultivators would frequently come and seek to meet him. It was normal for others to seek his guidance, and to this, the teachers of the convention would not reject them. Instead, they would take this opportunity to guide them which gave them a chance to better understand the talented cultivators.
But this time, it was Xing Huo Xun Yi who came?
“Greetings Elder.” The golden-robed young man respectfully bowed.
“Xing Huo Xun Yi? Come in.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“Yes.” The golden-robed young man was obedient and polite. He did not seem to be someone with an issue from the surface.
After the two entered, Xue Ying sat down within the courtyard, while Xing Huo Xun Yi stood by the side.
“Your father has already told me about your matter.” Xue Ying directly said.
“Does elder have any ways of solving it?” Xing Huo Xun Yi looked at Xue Ying.
“Let’s try first.”
Xue Ying chuckled.
Xing Huo Xun Yi felt that the smile of Xue Ying became exceptionally huge… and after that, he felt himself being brought out of reality.
He entered the ‘Boundary Stone’ world as the master of the illusory realm, which was why he could maintain consciousness within. But currently, it was Xue Ying who pulled him into the illusory realm, causing Xing Huo Xun Yi to lose himself immediately.
‘Let’s see if I can treat him using the illusory realm.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Even though some Primal Chaos giants who specialized in the illusory realm have tried before, those Primal Chaos giants are all ancient cultivators, and their control of the illusory realm isn’t as exquisite as mine.’
He had similarly cultivated in the ancient cultivation system.
Like the ‘Vermillion Nightmare inheritance’, the illusory realm came along with the technique, and thus, the inheritance could allow the cultivator to unleash this technique continuously. Nevertheless, the profoundness in its control of the illusory realm was weaker.
…
Xue Ying sat there. He enjoyed his fruit wine with Xing Huo Xun Yi sitting next to him petrified. He was wholly immersed in the illusory realm.
In the blink of an eye, an hour had passed.
An hour had passed in the real world, but Xue Ying had let the other party experience a total of 1,000 reincarnations in the illusory realm. Of which, a few hundred times contained emotional calamities. There was also righteousness for the nation and the race, a relationship between disciple and the sect, the close familial relationship between parents and children… all sorts of jarring emotional situations were used to influence him.
Xing Huo Xun Yi’s eyesight gradually regained its consciousness.
“Are you better?” Xue Ying asked.
“Elder Dong Bo’s technique is indeed amazing.” Xing Huo Xun Yi lightly shook his head, “I’ve forgotten about the past in the illusory realm, but that is an entirely new experience, and it feels like a dream! After dreaming a thousand times, I’ve woken up from all my dreams! The encounter with my wife is absolutely the moment when I was conscious. Every single moment had been carved on my soul using a blade.”
Xue Ying’s expression slightly changed.
That’s right.
He would forget about the past in the illusory realm. It was like dreaming. But after waking up, when there was a clash between the memories of the dream and memories of his true self, the dreams would have a weaker influence as compared to what the one experienced when he was absolutely conscious.
“I know that every moment I had with my wife occurred in the illusory realm. I also feel that this is ridiculous. There are even times when experts have come to seal my memories, and I would rather have these memories completely sealed, yet to no avail. The memories can be sealed, but the influence of the emotions on my soul can’t be treated. I still find cultivating a chore! The Cosmos Gods have all said before that it is better if I have my memories with me. As long as I face this period and recover from it, I would have succeeded.” Xing Huo Xun Yi’s voice was soft. There was a gentle smile appearing on his face, “Even though others feel that it is ridiculous, I still feel that the time with my wife in the illusory realm is the most beautiful memory I ever had.”
“I can’t forget it.”
“Even though rationality is telling me that I should not let such an experience affect me and that I’ve promised my wife to not let her past existence confuse me, and that I want to try my best to cultivate again…” Xing Huo Xun Yi shook his head, “Nothing works. It’s useless. Everything is useless.”
Xue Ying stood by the side looking at this young man in front.
This young man was unquestionably talented. Nevertheless, this talent was plundered from him.
“Reality and illusion. Fake and truth.” Xue Ying chuckled, “We think that everything in the illusory realm is false. But what exactly constitutes reality? The living beings in the illusory realm have parents, are of a race and belong to a nation. They experience love and vengeance and know how to cultivate as well. To them, they feel that they are absolutely real. Are they right?”
Xing Huo Xun Yi was startled.
Right.
Even to the end as he explained to his wife about everything, it was only after he controlled the world as the master of the illusory realm did his wife finally believed in him. So it seemed that this vast world was all an illusion. She was part of the illusion. Previously, all the beings were ordinarily evolving. The weak would grow old and die. The strong would cultivate and fight.
“They are independent living entities. They have memories and emotions.” Xue Ying said, “Actually, they can be considered as a form of unique real being, albeit they are living within the illusory realm.”
“Real? Real?” Xing Huo Xun Yi’s eyes brightened. His face was slightly red, “My wife is a real being?”
Including his father and other Primal Chaos giants who specialized in the illusory realm, none had ever mentioned about this point. Xing Huo Xun Yi also thought that it was just an illusory world.
“Life. What is considered a true lifeform? Isn’t an independent entity that contains memories, emotions, gratitude, and grudges a true lifeform?” Xue Ying said, “Must it really have a soul? What about those metallic lifeforms and the more unique beings? They do not have souls! They have other life cores. And your wife is similarly a soul light formed by the illusory realm-that is their life core.”
Only with a life core could the existence have their own independent memories and emotions. They could also cultivate and do other things.
Most illusory realms would naturally not be so formidable. The illusory realm developed by the Boundary Stone was much more exquisite than what Xue Ying could unleash currently. Its constitutional operating laws were considered to be at the level of a miniature cosmos and was lacking by a strand as compared to an actual cosmos. It was able to give birth to many living beings within, and all of them were incredibly real.
“That’s right. With a life core, independence, with memories, emotions, gratitude, and grudges, and if they can cultivate, right, they are considered a true lifeform.” Xing Huo Xun Yi nodded. His voice was slightly vibrating, “My wife is real. She is a real existence!”

chapters.title: Chapter 915 - Supreme Law
chapters.content:
Chapter 915: Supreme Law
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
At this moment after Xing Huo Xun Yi recognized that his wife was real, he felt motivated.
Xue Ying continued: “Once the Dao of Mirage reaches the Primal Chaos level, the illusory world that is presented is comparable to the inner world of the Boundary Stone. Once it reaches the Cosmos God level, it can even be used to form illusory cosmos! It is entirely possible for the illusory cosmos to be transformed into a real cosmos. Furthermore, it is possible to improve the Dao of Mirage to an even higher level. What would happen then?”
“An even higher level?” Xing Huo Xun Yi felt puzzled. Cosmos God? Wasn’t that the final realm?
“In my laws and profound mysteries system, the true destination isn’t the Cosmos God. Instead, it is the supreme operating law.” Xue Ying said. This was also what he gradually understood as his realm became deeper.
The goal of the laws and profound mysteries system was about understanding the essence of the world and to grasp the operating laws.
The supreme law was the final goal.
Were cosmos laws supreme? No!
The law of the ‘primitive Ancient Sacred World’ was supreme. The current ‘primal chaos void law’ was supreme too.
The primal chaos void encompassed many cosmos, primal chaos lands, and the five great sacred worlds! The five great sacred worlds might sound good, but in reality, other than the ‘Ancient Sacred World’ being a remnant piece the size of one-hundredth that the ‘primitive Ancient Sacred World’, the other four great sacred worlds were created by Cosmos Gods. The operating laws could never compare with that of the ‘primal chaos void law’.
Becoming a Cosmos God was the end point of many systems, and also the publicly acknowledged final realm.
But in the laws and profound mysteries system, it treated the supreme law-the primal chaos void law as the ultimate goal.
Like the hex cultivation system, it was about researching in the myriad existences in search for their core essence. Like Ancestor Sorcerer, despite reaching his current realm, he was still researching.
“The supreme operating law?” Xing Huo Xun Yi was slightly startled.
“What Cosmos Gods grasped is merely the operating laws of a cosmos. How can they compete with the primal chaos void laws.” Xue Ying said, “These are the supreme laws which encompass everything. If the operating laws for the Dao of Mirage reach the supreme level! One could grasp hold of the entire primal chaos void. By then, everything in the primal chaos void would be controlled by the supreme law controller, and he could even create the entire void.” Xue Ying chuckled, “Allowing the illusion to turn into reality. It isn’t impossible to let your wife live again.”
“Right, right, yes, yes…”
Xing Huo Xun Yi’s eyes were completely bright now.
What kind of realm was that?
The operating laws of the Dao of Mirage could reach the supreme law level! Such a Mirage was actually at the level of the primitive Ancient Sacred World (primal chaos void). Being its master, a thought could form a life. Everything within was absolutely real.
“Actually.”
Xue Ying smiled. He pointed forward, causing an illusory world to emerge ahead. Gold and silver, stone, soil, and other commonly seen materials were condensed within. Closely following that, these materials started turning real from illusion.
“Turning illusion into reality isn’t difficult to me with my current realm.” Xue Ying said, “It’s only that I need to reach a higher realm if I wanted to allow a being to live again. Who knows, I could possibly achieve it without having to reach the supreme law level; instead, reaching the ‘Cosmos God’ level in the Dao of Mirage would suffice.”
“Mn, mn.” Xing Huo Xun Yi nodded. His eyes were emitting light.
He felt his entire body burning. His soul was blazing.
Surging excitement. He felt his fighting spirit shooting to the sky!
In the past, he wanted to suppress the memories of that period which he felt emotionally wounded, stirring himself up again. But those were beautiful memories that etched themselves in his heart.
Now, he knew that his wife was real! No matter how other people see it, at least under the theory by Xue Ying, Xing Huo Xun Yi believed his wife could completely become real!
Furthermore, he had seen hope.
Maybe once the ‘Dao of Mirage’ reached the Cosmos God level, he might possibly transform illusion into reality, allowing his wife to live again!
“Plop!” Xing Huo Xun Yi immediately knelt down: “Many thanks Elder Dong Bo for your guidance. I do hope for Elder to take me as your disciple, imparting to me your Dao of Mirage.”
He understood that just purely relying on ancient cultivation would not allow him to grasp the laws of the illusory realm. Only when he directly understood the Dao of Mirage which targeted its essence would he achieve what he wanted to do. As for the Dao of Mirage… naturally, Xue Ying was the one who reached the highest attainment in this area for the laws and profound mysteries system in history. He was thus the most appropriate person to be his teacher.
“It is still too early for you to become my disciple.” Xue Ying chuckled. He flipped his hand, bringing out a half-translucent book that was glowing in gold before passing it to Xing Huo Xun Yi, “This is a Dao of Mirage absolute art which I created, the “Mirage”. There are currently only three styles within. You should cultivate it first and allow mt to see how high your potential is before I decide whether to take you in as my disciple.”
The experts of the Great void Heaven Temple would usually leave behind their self-created absolute arts in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall.
Xue Ying had gradually developed this uncomplete absolute art “Mirage” as he cultivated.
The first style of “Mirage”: World Prison. All cultivators at the Void God Origin Birth realm could succeed in grasping it, but it was challenging to do so. This technique contained a third level Star Pagoda strength.
The second style: Mirage Annihilation, with a fourth level Star Pagoda strength. One had to reach the Unity realm before completing it.
The third style: Dark Bubble, fifth level Star Pagoda strength. It was also the move created by the Dark World Master. Xue Ying had merely altered it slightly and simplified it. Xue Ying felt that this move was not bad. As for the second style, the ‘Sky Punishment Edge’, Xue Ying was not too satisfied with it since the enemy could easily dodge this move. Comparatively, the Dark Bubble would descend directly around the enemies, making it such that they could not dodge it.
Going along this line of thought, Xue Ying was thinking of creating a move that had strength at the sixth level where the enemies could not dodge. The ‘Multi-Layered Dark World’ could barely pass as a sixth level technique, but it had a great demand on one’s heart energy which Xue Ying was unsatisfied with.
“Many thanks, elder.” After learning this absolute art, Xing Huo Xun Yi was filled with gratitude.
“When you are cultivating your Dao of Mirage, you must not slack on cultivating your original ancient cultivation.” Xue Ying said, “The power of ancient cultivation is huge, and you can rely on it to understand the laws. They are able to support each other.”
“If I encounter any issues, is it possible for me to come and ask Elder for help?” Xing Huo Xun Yi asked.
“Naturally you can. All the talented cultivators participating in the Star Convention can do so.” Xue Ying said.
Xing Huo Xun Yi felt helpless at that moment.
He understood.
That the moment the convention ended, Xue Ying would have his own matters to do. Finding him for guidance after that was difficult.
“Then if Elder is satisfied with my potential, will Elder be willing to receive me as your disciple?” Xing Huo Xun Yi said. A good teacher would significantly improve his rate of cultivation.
“This Star Convention will be the event when I can determine your potential.” Xue Ying smiled.
Xing Huo Xun Yi was enlightened. He immediately bowed respectfully, “Then junior will first retreat.”
“Go.” Xue Ying nodded.
Xing Huo Xun Yi soon left the place.
Xue Ying watched as this golden-robed young man left. He felt that Xing Huo Xun Yi was burning with fighting spirit. With how severe his emotional wound was, by turning them into fighting spirit, it had thus given birth to such a blazing-hot madness at this moment!
‘If he is not bad, I can still accept him as a disciple.’ Xue Ying chuckled, ‘Who would have thought that this time, I can re-ignite his fighting spirit.’
The experts standing at the higher level of the laws and profound mysteries system also faintly understood that the ‘supreme operating law’ was their final goal.
Xue Ying specialized most in the Dao of Mirage. Naturally, he had pondered over it before. If the Dao of Mirage reached the supreme level, how strong would it be? It should not be too difficult in allowing a being to live again.
Since he had thought of it before, he naturally mentioned this point.
Xing Huo Xun Yi might have met Primal Chaos giants who specialized in the illusory realm before, but they were all ancient cultivators. They would never have this thought which Xue Ying had. Naturally, they would not mention these.
…
Monarch Xing Huo sat by himself in the courtyard. He was currently feeling depressed and was waiting for his son to return.
Nevertheless, he did not harbor too much hope! He was clear that this problem his son had could only be resolved by himself. He had to get over it utterly right from his inner heart, and it was almost impossible for others to help him.
‘He is back.’ Monarch Xing Huo felt his son returning. Turning over, the golden-robed young man entered the courtyard. His father remained seated at where he was earlier in the morning.
‘Mn?’ Monarch Xing Huo was startled.
He felt that things were different.
In the past, Xing Huo Xun Yi might remain his calmness, and it was hard to discern from his outer appearance what he was feeling.
But the eyes of the current Xing Huo Xun Yi were emitting light. It gave off the feeling of sharpness, and a fighting spirit which shot into the sky was something that anyone could feel.
“You…” Monarch Xing Huo was filled with slight disbelief.
“Father, help me find a cultivation ground that allows for time to be accelerated.” Xing Huo Xun Yi stated, “I must make use of all the time I have to cultivate.” He had to make use of the short time he had. He had to improve his strength really quickly and allow Elder Dong Bo to see his potential so that he could be accepted as the elder’s disciple. He had to reach an ultra-high attainment in the Dao of Mirage.
“Cultivation ground?” Monarch Xing Huo’s mouth opened wide.
How long?
How long had it been that his son took the initiative to ask for a cultivation ground that could be accelerated?
“Quick, there isn’t enough time to waste anymore.” Xing Huo Xun Yi urged his father.

chapters.title: Chapter 916 - Great Talent
chapters.content:
Chapter 916: Great Talent
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Many cultivators in the Blade Emperor City were paying attention to the Star Convention. Xue Ying who was one of the teachers of convention was quite busy. Even though the number of Primal Chaos giants visiting him could be counted with one’s fingers, there were nevertheless too many ‘talented cultivators’.
“I hope that Senior Dong Bo could guide me.” A black-robed old man respectfully mentioned. There were some tyrannical ripples left in the surroundings.
Xue Ying sat there. He placed down the wine cup in his hand, and the female attendant by his side quietly poured more wine for him, causing the fragrance from the wine to diffuse out.
“Even though the determining factor of life and death during a battle is one’s weaknesses.” Xue Ying chuckled, “And it is fair that you wish to make up for your weaknesses, you are ultimately still at the second level Star Pagoda strength and is considered weak in the world of cultivators. I recommend for you to spend more time and effort focusing on what you are good at and improving your strengths to a whole new level.”
“Once you are incredibly strong in any aspect, you can similarly suppress the other party.” Xue Ying said.
“Yes, this junior understands.” The black-robed old man said.
The age of cultivators could not be discerned by one’s appearances. Even though many cultivated slowly at the Transcendent realm, causing them to look older, great talents were not built overnight. They might rise up after becoming Deities or World Deities.
This old man in front was one of the talented cultivators participating in the Star Convention. He had cultivated for about 200 billion years and was considered young.
“Then is it possible for this junior to be selected by senior into the next round?” The black-robed old man could not help but ask.
“You are one of those who cultivated for a shorter period as compared to the others and is a loose cultivator too. Thus, I am sure you haven’t gotten a proper teacher before.” Xue Ying chuckled, “The only thing you lack now is your slightly low rank-at about 3,000th. If you could rank in the top 1,000, then your chances of getting chosen are much higher. Alright, go and properly cultivate. Take good use of these 1,000 years to break through. Even if I do not select you, I believe it is possible others might select you into the next round. Alright then, go back.”
“Yes, senior.”
The black-robed old man obediently bowed. He did not dare to disrespect the other party and retreated from the place.
“Elder, these cultivators come seeking for elder frequently, but Elder doesn’t have to meet them immediately when they come.” The female attendant stated from the side of Xue Ying, “Allowing them to wait for half a day isn’t considered a long time for them. I’ve heard that the other teachers of the convention will usually let the talented cultivators wait for a few days outside their residences before these cultivators are even allowed entrance.”
“These 1,000 years are relatively important to these cultivators. Most of them are quite talented, and they only lacked proper guidance. I believe that it is possible for them to transform qualitatively within 1,000 years if they were to get proper guidance, and If this increase in strength is remarkable, these cultivators might just be chosen on to the next stage.” Xue Ying said, “So there is no need to waste their time.”
Without sufficient foresight, it would be hard to discern through if the other party was sincere in seeking the help of the teacher. As a result, it would be harder for them to guide the other party properly.
Xue Ying’s understanding of the Unity realm would never be as good as the other teachers like General Heaven Light, Five Luster Serpent Ancestor, Violet Slaughter Island Master.
…
The years passed.
Many talented cultivators were originally unconvinced with Xue Ying deep in their hearts: “We are also at the Unity realm. Even though he is stronger than us, how can he be a teacher of the convention?”
But after the majority went to visit him and ask for guidance, they discovered that Xue Ying’s attitude was clearly better, bringing about a change of heart towards Xue Ying. Nevertheless, there were still several cultivators participating in the convention who murmured inwardly: “Hmph, he is ultimately at the Unity realm. The other four teachers of the convention are Primal Chaos realm giants and have a completely different status. Naturally, it is right for them to have such an attitude.”
Different cultivators had different temperaments.
Some were just ruthless, and had warped personalities and were incredibly selfish.
******
In the blink of an eye, 300 years passed. Xue Ying’s understanding for these talented cultivators and their potential became deeper. Regardless, he would only make his decision at the very last moment! That’s because the teachers of the convention would eventually have to send in their selected name registers without having any clashes in their choices.
On this day as the sun set down the west.
Xue Ying sat by himself in his cavern-dwelling beside the lake. He was cultivating silently. In his mind, Xue Ying was deducing the move that fused both Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter together. With his pride, he definitely aimed to reach the seventh level Star Pagoda at the Unity realm. Xue Ying was challenging himself to achieve his utmost limits at every level, and it would be helpful for him in accumulating experiences and strengthening his foundation too. After all, one’s comprehension ability would never be fixed innately when he was born. Instead, it would gradually change over time. If Xue Ying could charge through the seventh level at the Unity realm, it would be easy for him to step into the eighth level Star Pagoda after becoming a Primal Chaos expert. The ninth level would not be too far away for him as well.
This was due to the improvement of his comprehension ability.
Why was Swordmaster so heaven-defying? That’s because he did not obtain proper guidance in his hometown cosmos, and had comprehended everything entirely by himself. This forced him to temper himself harshly, and after breaking through to the Primal Chaos realm, Swordmaster would have built a deep foundation. As he read through the huge collection of books in the Great Void Heaven Temple, after consolidating the wisdom from the seniors, Swordmaster was able to break through to the Cosmos God realm in one fell swoop.
Xue Ying currently had obtained fantastic guidance from many good teachers, and he had many absolute arts, the stone mirror and other treasures for him to peruse. Naturally, his demands were higher!
Being satisfied just to get through with life would only cause one to become ordinary.
“Elder, Xing Huo Xun Yi requests to meet you.” A protector walked in and respectfully announced.
“Let him in.” Xue Ying ordered.
Very soon.
A golden-robed young man entered. He was high-spirited and was distinctly different from the first time they met.
“Greetings elder.” Xing Huo Xun Yi gave a traditional bow. He was filled with admiration and gratitude from deep his heart.
“I thought that you will return soon to ask for my help after leaving. Who would have thought that you came back only after 300 years.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“My father said before that if I were to ask my teacher for every matter, then when my teacher could no longer teach me anything and I have to depend on myself, it would unlikely for me to have huge breakthroughs. Thus, even though I am filled with certain difficulties, I still have to depend on myself first to solve them.” Xing Huo Xun Yi said.
Xue Ying revealed a grin.
Just like the Great Void Heaven Temple, the disciples would have to depend on themselves to comprehend and write books which would otherwise be placed in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall. Juniors would then be read these books and comprehend them without much help from others. Whatever Dao path they walked on would ultimately be dependent on themselves. If they were to ask their teachers after meeting a slight problem, it was impossible for them to have a great future.
“This junior has some slight attainments in the cultivation of the Dao of Mirage, and is here to ask Elder for guidance.” Xing Huo Xun Yi slightly pointed forward.
A void world appeared in midair by the side. This world then descended from illusion and turned real. It absorbed the world energy around before turning small like a sphere after that.
Xue Ying’s eyes dilated. He could not help but blurt out: “World Prison?”
“You actually succeeded in forming the World Prison? You have reached the Origin Birth realm in the Dao of Mirage?” Xue Ying was startled.
How long had it been!
It was only 300 years.
Xing Huo Xun Yi revealed a grin and nodded: “This junior has started researching in the laws and profound mysteries ‘Dao of Mirage’ after returning. With the absolute art bestowed upon by senior, and in addition to my great foundation in the illusory realm accumulated in the past-my ancient cultivation had reached the Unity realm, and also some cultivation materials given by my father, I was able to cultivate to this stage.”
“But 300 years…” Xue Ying remained filled with disbelief.
“Oh, I cultivated within the Time Pagoda in Blade Emperor City. In reality, I’ve cultivated for three million years already.” Xing Huo Xun Yi said.
Only then was Xue Ying enlightened.
That should be right.
Someone who had not cultivated in the Dao of Mirage, even if he had a strong foundation built using the ancient cultivation illusory realm, this was still the laws and profound mysteries system and required complete control of the Mirage. To reach the ‘Void God Origin Birth realm’ in a short 300 years was an unfathomable matter.
If it were three million years, it was more acceptable.
…
Something that Xue Ying felt that was acceptable would startle many cultivators should it be spread out to the world. Because using the Dao of Mirage to cultivate the ‘ancient cultivation illusory realm’ was very easy since the ancient cultivator would not need to have a deep understanding of the illusory realm. On the contrary, to cultivate the ancient cultivation illusory realm before cultivating the Dao of Mirage would be very difficult.
A period of three million years was considered ordinary in Xue Ying’s opinion. It was because his own cultivation speed was ultra fast. Compared to Xue Ying, Xing Huo Xun Yi had gotten cultivation materials and a strong foundation in ancient cultivation. Thus, to reach this stage in three million years was acceptable.
But it was frightening as compared to other cultivators in the outer world.
After all, they had spent millions of years…
To improve from the second level to third level Star Pagoda strength!
“It is extremely difficult to grasp the ‘World Prison’ using the Void God Origin Birth realm.” Xing Huo Xun Yi said, “I could barely achieve it because I had experience in comprehending the structure of the illusory worlds formed within the Boundary Stone. But the second style ‘Mirage Annihilation’ requires me to reach the Unity realm in Dao of Mirage. I feel that it is much more difficult. Currently, I am facing many difficulties. No matter what, I just can’t comprehend it.”
Xue Ying chuckled.
He still thought that this brat could reach the Unity realm in the Dao of Mirage just by relying on his experiences of the ancient cultivation!
“You tell me.” Xue Ying said.
Xing Huo Xun Yi nodded. He then started displaying his understanding while clearing his doubt with Xue Ying.
Xue Ying was smoothly guiding the other party as he listened. He would directly target the core nature of the problem everything. If he were teaching things he did not specialize in, Xue Ying could only depend on his own experiences and the books he read in the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall without giving much in-depth guidance. But for matters regarding the Dao of Mirage, Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple as well as on the void aspect, Xue Ying would have an easy time teaching them.
Xing Huo Xun Yi brightened as he listened. He was filled with radiant delight as he became excited since several matters had troubled him for a very long time, yet they were explained easily by some mystical method Xue Ying used. And it seemed that many new ideas were forming in his mind.
This guidance continued for a full ten days.
Xue Ying sat cross-legged by the lake, yet the night sky had passed, and the sun rose.
“Many thanks, Elder, for your guidance these few days.” Xing Huo Xun Yi was filled with gratitude.
“Your comprehension skills are not bad.” Xue Ying smiled. No wonder Xing Huo Xun Yi was able to improve so quickly in the ancient cultivation illusory realm. He was indeed someone with a great comprehension ability. He was absolutely the best amongst all the talented cultivated he had ever taught.
“Then is it time for junior to pay respect to Elder as my teacher?” Xing Huo Xun Yi could not help but ask.
“It is still early. Let us talk about this matter after the Star Convention ends.” Xue Ying said.
Xing Huo Xun Yi was slightly disappointed.
But he still respectfully said: “Then junior will go back and continue cultivating. Elder, these ten days of guidance would require junior to spend many days of cultivation trying to comprehend them.”
“Go then.” Xue Ying said.
Xing Huo Xun Yi immediately left after giving an obedient bow.
Xue Ying watched the figure of Xing Huo Xun Yi left while thinking to himself: ‘Currently, he has the third level Star Pagoda strength. It should be possible for him to have further improvements in the future. Amongst the cultivators of Star Convention this time, his comprehension ability is absolutely top-rated. I can indeed leave a spot for him in my register.’
He quite liked Xing Huo Xun Yi because the other party specialized precisely in what Xue Ying was the most capable of-the Dao of Mirage.
Meeting a great talent who was suited to inherit his arts was truly rare.

chapters.title: Chapter 917 - Reputation
chapters.content:
Chapter 917: Reputation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
It was getting closer and closer to the limit of a thousand years. Xue Ying was also becoming freer over time since almost all the talented cultivators had visited him before. Before they had a definite improvement of their strength, they would not pay Xue Ying a visit the second time.
On this day.
There was a thin male who arrived outside of Xue Ying’s cavern-dwelling. He was vaguely emitting an aura that startled two of the protectors. Even though it was only part of his full aura, just a touch caused the protectors to feel an all-encompassing slaughter aura permeating into their souls. They had seen before many Unity realm experts, and they understood that this person in front should be way stronger than the Unity realm. He should be a Primal Chaos giant. Thus, they did not dare to be disrespectful.
“Go tell Elder Dong Bo. Just say that Ba Sun is here to visit him.” The thin male coldly said.
“Yes, senior, please wait momentarily.” The protector immediately went to report his words.
“Brother Ba Yun?”
Xue Ying took the initiative to welcome him in passionately.
The thin male was no longer cold anymore. Instead, he revealed a smile: “Haha, Brother Dong Bo, I know that you are quite busy, and that is why I only visited you now.”
“Brother Ba Yun is being too polite. You can visit me anytime. Come come come, please enter.” Xue Ying was much more polite. It was logical. Even though this Ba Yun Palace Master was a Primal Chaos giant, according to the intelligence reports, he was barely at the seventh level Star Pagoda strength only. This was slightly stronger than he. Xue Ying was polite because the other party was the only disciple of Black Emperor.
Black Emperor was someone who transmitted Dao to him!
The two sat down.
Xue Ying also brought out some precious wine and personally poured for Ba Yun.
“Brother Ba Yun, why have you come to see me?” Xue Ying smiled, “If there are any matters, do tell me directly.”
“Haha, I came this time because of the Star Convention.” Ba Yun Palace Master said, “I have a descendant who participated in the Star Convention, and he is quite strong, ranking above 500th. But alas, he wasn’t selected in the first round. He felt uncertain, which was why he asked me for help. I quite like this brat, and that is also why I came this time to ask Brother Dong Bo for help.”
Hearing that the other party was ranked above 500th, Xue Ying felt his heart relaxing.
He was someone flexible. As long as the other party had high potential, under the situation that it was uncertain for the other party to be chosen, Xue Ying would still give the other person respect since Ba Yun Palace Master had come personally.
After all, selecting juniors who had potential…
Ultimately depended on the inner heart of the teachers of the convention to judge. They experienced different things, and their judgment of the junior’s potential would certainly be different as well. For instance, a specific junior might be determined by Xue Ying to rank at 150th regarding his potential, but General Heaven Light might feel that it was ranked at 100th. It might even be ranked at 200th by General Hatchet Palace Master.
There would be a degree of uncertainty and not an absolute ranking.
But all of them were experts. Xue Ying’s understanding of the Unity realm was high as well. His determination of potential would not be so bad that it was beyond reasonable limits.
As long as the other party had sufficient potential, and Xue Ying recognized the other party as someone whom he was on the fence on, he could simply just let him go on! It would not make others feel that Xue Ying was messing things up. But if the other party had a potential judged to be beyond 1,000th, even if there were some slight discrepancies over at the side of General Hatchet Palace Master, General Heaven Light and the others, they would similarly be ranked beyond 900th. This cultivator was someone Xue Ying would definitely not choose.
If he selected this cultivator, it would be slapping his own face.
“Oh, if his potential is sufficient, I would naturally do my best to help.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“His potential is still alright. I believe that he will become more extraordinary after entering the holy ground.” Ba Yun Palace Master said.
“I wonder what is he called?” Xue Ying asked.
“He is Tie Tu.” Ba Yun Palace Master chuckled, “He is ranked at 406th during the Star Pagoda preliminary selections.”
Xue Ying’s original smile turned stiff.
Tie Tu?
Tie Tu was a loose cultivator. But he cultivated for more than 1.6 trillion years. More importantly, the scenes of his battle in the Star Pagoda were seen clearly by Xue Ying. It might be nice on the ears that he was ranked at 406th, but in reality, he had not crossed the third level. He was merely ranked at the peak of the second level. And he was ranked at the peak only because his body had been altered!
After seeing the scenes of battle, Xue Ying was able to deduce: ‘This Tie Tu must have many treasures. His realm seems ordinary, and it is likely only at the first level Star Pagoda strength, yet he has altered his body! He relied on his strong body to get to the third level barely. He is a devour-class cultivator, but his body had been altered to that of a hex cultivator. Clearly, he had sought the help of other experts to alter it.”
Indeed, he could simply ask other experts to alter his body.
And if he had sufficient Origin World Rocks, he could seek the help of ‘Ancestor Sorcerer’, strengthening his body to a stage that even Primal Chaos giants could barely destroy! But the more defiant the body alteration was, the more inflated the price would be. It was more worthwhile to purchase a puppet instead.
This Tie Tu was clearly trying to improve his ranking by altering his body. But it’s a pity that the foresight of Xue Ying, General Hatchet Palace Master, and the others were all extremely acute. They could discern with a glance-that the body transformation was done by others. If not for this body transformation, he would likely rank beyond 10,000th. Even though he was a loose cultivator, he had cultivated for far too long, and his potential was unquestionably ranked beyond 3000th!
Someone who was unquestionably ranked beyond 3000th…
Wanted to be chosen by him?
Xue Ying looked up at Ba Yun Palace Master in front. Ba Yun Palace Master still had a beaming smile: “Brother Dong Bo, he is a loose cultivator who is ranked 400th, showing that his potential is not bad.”
“It is because he has asked other experts to alter his body, and that is why he is ranked at around 400th.” Xue Ying shook his head, “We select based on potential. If his body is altered by other experts, it isn’t considered his potential.”
“Brother Dong Bo, you could select 20 cultivators in total. Every teacher of the convention has differing views on the potential of the cultivators. It is normal for you with your unique foresight to see his unique potential.” Ba Yun Palace Master continued laughing.
Xue Ying frowned.
Why was this disciple of Senior Black Emperor forcing himself despite Xue Ying giving the other party an explanation already?
“I’ll try my best. I have other matters which I have to do.” Xue Ying stood up.
“Brother Dong Bo, you better give me your word. That way I’ll feel rest assured.” Ba Yun Palace Master said.
“I’ll try my best.” Xue Ying said.
“How about this, if you select him, I am willing to give Brother Dong Bo 200 Origin World Rocks.” Ba Yun Palace Master chuckled. That Tie Tu had indeed obtained many treasures. He had not just altered his body and also understood the teachers of the convention through intelligence reports. That was why he asked Ba Yun Palace Master for help to come to ask Xue Ying, with a down payment of 100 Origin World Rocks and 500 Origin World Rocks after the matter was settled.
A total of 600 Origin World Rocks was used to ensure he could enter the holy ground!
“Brother Ba Yun.” Xue Ying helplessly replied, “You should understand that a teacher of the convention like me who is still at the Unity realm is a highly controversial topic. I am here representing not only myself but more importantly, I am representing my Great Void Heaven Temple. It is impossible for me to slap my Great Void Heaven Temple in the face. Thus, I have truly no other means to help you with your matter. His potential is likely ranked beyond 3000th.”
Xue Ying honestly told him as he hoped the other party would understand.
“This is merely a minor matter only. How would it even affect the reputation of the Great Void Heaven Temple?” Ba Yun Palace Master frowned, “Alright. This is the first time we met, and I do not want for our relationship to become ugly. Give me some respect. It is just a slot.”
Xue Ying’s expression slightly changed. He stood up: “Brother Ba Yun, I have some other matter and will not accompany you anymore. Please leave.”
Ba Yun Palace Master’s expression immediately turned cold: “You are truly not promising me?”
“No.” Xue Ying straightforwardly answered.
“Hmph hmph.”
Ba Yun Palace Master felt so angry he began laughing, “You are just a little Unity realm who obtained the inheritance of my teacher. It is fine if you aren’t grateful, but for me to personally come and seek your help, you actually do not give me any respect. Also, you better not call me Brother Ba Yun or what. You are just a Unity realm and aren’t qualified to be my Dao brother.”
He was outraged.
Being a Primal Chaos giant, and also the only disciple of Black Emperor, who would not respect him? He usually disdained to talk to those at the Unity realm, and in his heart, he did not care about Xue Ying. So what if the other party had a sixth level Star Pagoda strength? In history, many were stuck at the sixth level Star Pagoda strength without stepping into the Primal Chaos realm. Like Lei Yan Pagoda Master, he was held there forever. And even genius cultivators like Dark World Master had fallen.
Ba Yun Palace Master indeed despised Xue Ying in his heart. Even calling him Dao brother made him uncomfortable. It was only because he was here asking the other party for help, that was why he had to maintain a smile and talk about matters passionately. Who would have thought that this Xue Ying as a Unity realm expert did not respect him at all? He was planning to give the other party 200 Origin World Rocks, yet the other party did not give him his promise? How many treasures could Xue Ying have in total? Treasures worth about 1,000 Origin World Rocks at most? 200 Origin World Rocks was a huge amount for him.
“Calling Dao brothers? It seems I am climbing connections with you then.” Xue Ying also coldly stated.
Since they had reached this stage, there was no need for him to maintain any decorum of respect for the other party.
“Protectors, send the guest off.” Xue Ying transmitted out.
A female attendant came in immediately from outside the courtyard. The female attendant walked to the side of Ba Yun Palace Master with some slight anxiety, though she still uttered: “Please!”
Even if Ba Yun Palace Master were more arrogant, he would not dare to act rampantly in the territory of Blade Emperor City.
“Hmph hmph, you are quite daring.” Ba Yun Palace Master coldly laughed.
