“Why, aren’t you leaving? Do you need me to expel you personally?” Xue Ying coldly said.
“Good, very good.” Ba Yun Palace Master sneered before turning and leaving. With just three steps, he swiftly left the place.
Xue Ying coldly snorted.
So what if the other party was a Primal Chaos giant? He was barely at the seventh level Star Pagoda strength and was just a strand higher than him. Even if he fought with Xue Ying, he was not fearful of the other party, much less since Xue Ying was close to breaking through to the Primal Chaos realm. The moment he stepped in, he would easily trample the other party underneath his feet. The reason why he was so polite had been because of courtesy, and respect for Black Emperor.
Nevertheless, Xue Ying still respected Black Emperor, and that did not translate to respect for his disciple.
Since the other party did not respect him at all, Xue Ying could only force him out.

chapters.title: Chapter 918 - Name Register
chapters.content:
Chapter 918: Name Register
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
After walking out of the residence, Ba Yun Palace Master glared back with gloominess. Those two protectors by the entrance of the residence did not dare to breathe under such heavy atmosphere.
“A puny Unity realm dares to be so egotistical and ignorant!” Ba Yun Palace Master coldly stated before leaving.
Those two protectors looked at each other.
“He is saying that Elder Dong Bo is egotistical and ignorant?’
“It seems that he has fallen out with Elder Dong Bo during their conversation? But speaking about Elder Dong Bo, even if he is rejecting a Primal Chaos giant, he should also not make it so ugly.” These two protectors continued speaking to each other through voice transmission. They had even begun spreading this matter to some of their good friends.
They as protectors and attendants were all arranged by the Blade Emperor City. They were considered members of the lower level of Blade Emperor City and were temporarily serving Xue Ying during this period of Star Convention. The moment the Star Convention ended, they were too lazy to even care about an Inner Hall Elder of the Great Void Heaven Temple. Hence, they were extremely delighted to gossip about the secrets of these ‘great characters’.
Very soon.
Those who were well-informed soon heard of Ba Yun Palace Master calling Xue Ying ‘egotistical and ignorant’. And the majority of those who knew of this stood on the side of Ba Yun Palace Master.
Because in the primal chaos void and five great sacred worlds, they were used to the higher statuses of Primal Chaos giants. A Unity realm expert should always respect a Primal Chaos giant when facing them!
******
Xue Ying was too lazy to even care about what the others were gossiping about. Only the weak would focus on the actions of the experts. The true experts did not have the time to care about such minor affairs of the ‘weak’. Before breaking through to the Primal Chaos realm, he would not easily offend those at the Primal Chaos realm. He would rather tolerate. But under the premise that he was absolutely sure he would break through, even though Xue Ying was still polite, he would absolutely not tolerate the other party strutting his nose on him. So what if they have an acrimonious falling out? Not too long later, Xue Ying would easily surpass the other party.
“Mn?”
During these days as Xue Ying was meditating by the side of the lake in his cavern-dwelling, he suddenly received a piece of news.
It was news from the host for this Star Convention, ‘Heart Imitation Religious Master’.
“There is still half a year before the period of 1,000 years is up, yet General Hatchet Palace Master has given his selected name register to Heart Imitation Religious Master already?” Xue Ying felt shocked. This news which Heart Imitation Religious Master sent was precisely the 20 names chosen by General Hatchet Palace Master.
“Mn, he has chosen well.”
After Xue Ying browsed through the name register given by Heart Imitation Religious Master, Xue Ying was able to ascertain that all of them had potential ranking in the top 300.
“Chen Qiong.” Xue Ying chuckled. He discovered this name, “Monarch Hidden Dragon should have gone off to find General Hatchet Palace Master as well. I originally planned on choosing him.”
This brat called Chen Qiong had cultivated for a short period. During this 1,000 years, he had come seeking his guidance three times. His improvement was relatively clear, and regarding potential, he would rank in the top 20.
…
Day passed by day.
The entire Star Convention began flaring up in the dark. Those who were well-informed had known that the names of the Star convention were gradually being handed in.
General Hatchet Palace Master had the highest status and was the first to hand in the name register.
Half a month later, Violet Slaughter Island Master being the only female had handed in the second name register.
And another month later, Five Luster Serpent Ancestor also handed in his name register.
A month later, the Primal Chaos existence who belonged to the hosting Blade Emperor City for this time’s Star Convention, ‘General Heaven Light’ also handed in his name register.
Xue Ying being a Unity realm naturally knew what he should do. He was the final one to hand in the name register.
“Please send word that Dong Bo Xue Ying is planning to meet Heart Imitation Religious Master.” Xue Ying stood before a large residence. The place Heart Imitation Religious Master stayed at was naturally his own residence in the Blade Emperor City.
“It is Dong Bo Xue Ying.”
“Dong Bo Xue Ying who is one of the five teachers of the convention.”
“He is here to hand in his name register.”
Many people were keeping a watch outside the front entrance of Heart Imitation Religious Master’s large residence, especially some of the talented geniuses who were paid extremely close attention to this. They were thinking of ways to know who was chosen by the previous four teachers of the convention, and now, it was only Xue Ying left. The secrecy of the registers was not kept since Heart Imitation Religious Master, the other five teachers of the convention and many Primal Chaos giants who came for the convention would be able to obtain a set of the names.
After all, those names would eventually be publicized, and there was no need for them to be kept a secret.
“The final set.”
“I hope that I am included in this final set of 20 people.”
“This is the final chance.”
Some of the talented cultivators who were already standing by the residence of Heart Imitation Religious Master were extremely nervous. They were hoping for it. In the previous 1,000 years, many had come to visit Xue Ying, though Xue Ying had never given his word.
Within the residence.
Xue Ying walked on under the lead by the servant. He walked through a few bent corridors before entering a huge plaza and finally into a towering black palace hall. This palace hall was truly majestic. It occupied about one-tenth the entire residence and spanned 5,000 kilometers in range of area. It was also the most dazzling structure in the whole palace.
This was the famous ‘Heart Imitation Palace Hall’.
‘Heart Imitation Palace Hall.’ Xue Ying thought. He knew that Heart Imitation Religious Master would usually cultivate within the Heart Imitation Palace Hall, and he had created this unique palace hall for the sake of cultivation.
“Elder Dong Bo, Religious Master is inside.” The servant stopped just outside the palace hall.
Xue Ying nodded and entered the place.
The enormous Heart Imitation Palace Hall was tall and spacious. The colossal palace hall which spanned over 5,000 kilometers was quite empty without having any decorations. There was only a single figure seated cross-legged in this dark enormous palace hall. He was Heart Imitation Religious Master. Heart Imitation Religious Master was currently wearing a loose robe, with his robe spreading out on the floor. His back was slightly hunched, and he was looking at Xue Ying with a smile.
Even though he did not emit any aura at all, Xue Ying could feel the entire Heart Imitation Palace Hall becoming bigger and bigger in his senses…
It felt endless. The darkness did not have any limit. It felt like the entire Heart Imitation Palace Hall was like the vast cosmos.
And Heart Imitation Religious Master was at the center of this cosmos. He sat there as if he were the owner of the cosmos.
‘Indeed, as they say, those Primal Chaos giants who reached the ninth level Star Pagoda strength aren’t any weaker than Cosmos Gods in certain areas.’ Xue Ying saw this scene. Even though Heart Imitation Religious Master did not emit any aura, and wasn’t displaying any techniques, just sitting there allowed Xue Ying understand how frightening the other party was.
At least for now, the other party could kill him easily.
Even with the protective treasure bestowed by Forefather Tian Yu, he could only withstand for a move or two.
“Elder Dong Bo.” The ugly face of Heart Imitation Religious Master was filled with a heart-warming force. His voice was gentle too, “The previous four teachers have already fixed their name registers. Once you send in your name register, the 100 cultivators will be selected, and we can publicize the chosen cultivators.”
“I’ve already chosen.” Xue Ying nodded. He waved his hand, causing a golden scroll to appear. This scroll flew towards Heart Imitation Religious Master.
Heart Imitation Religious Master received it before casually reading through. Suddenly, he frowned slightly. His vision landed on one of the 20 names-Xing Huo Xun Yi!
Heart Imitation Religious Master looked up at Xue Yin.
Xing Huo Xun Yi?
Being the host for the Star Convention this time, Heart Imitation Religious Master naturally understood all the talented cultivators participating in it. He paid exceptionally close notice to Xing Huo Xun Yi naturally because he was the son of an ultra-strong expert on the same level as he is-’Monarch Xing Huo’. With such a huge background, he had cultivated for over 500 billion years, yet was merely ranked at 3,600th. His potential should be ranked beyond 5,000th amongst all the talented cultivators.
Speaking from his inner heart, Heart Imitation Religious Master had a favorable opinion of Xue Ying since he was the strongest Unity realm expert arising in this generation. He could even compete with Lei Yan from the Myriad Ancient Sacred World.
“Are you certain that this is your final name register?” Heart Imitation Religious Master looked at Xue Ying, “Right now I have yet to publicize the register to everyone. You can still alter it.”
“There’s no need to change.” Xue Ying shook his head.
Heart Imitation Religious Master hesitated for a while, though he still continued: “Elder Dong Bo, I’ve heard that Forefather Tian Yu is the one who recommended you as the teacher for this convention. Of the five Cosmos Gods, there were two who objected to it. You had barely passed through their selections. Your decision doesn’t merely concern you. It also represents your Great Void Heaven Temple.”
The name register would be released to the public.
Even though some experts could be selfish and be shameless, the holy ground would still want to keep their reputation. If the teacher were ridiculed by many cultivators, in the end, it would be the Great Void Heaven Temple who lost its prestige.
“Many thanks, Heart Imitation Religious Master for your good intention. I’ve decided as it is.” Xue Ying smiled.
Heart Imitation Religious Master shook his head inwardly. It was rare for him to even give a sentence or two of advice. He then nodded: “Alright, then the name register will be fixed as it is.”
Following that, Heart Imitation Religious Master began reading out the selected names on the register. At the same time, he began arranging for the name register to be publicized!

chapters.title: Chapter 919 - The Fury of Inquisitive Sky Hall Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 919: The Fury of Inquisitive Sky Hall Master
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Elder Dong Bo who is one of the teachers of the convention has handed in his name register.” This piece of news rapidly spread across the talented cultivators. At that moment, all the talented cultivators hurried over to the Star Convention. According to the rules of the convention, when all five teachers handed in their name registers, the Star Convention would publicize the selected cultivators who would be proceeding to the next round.
“I hope that I one of the selected ones.”
“I must be one of them!”
Many talented cultivators headed to the gathering location of the Star Convention. They were looking in the direction of the Star Pagoda. Currently, they were waiting for the compiled list of names to be released. Many were waiting anxiously since this would determine their fates if they would continue being a mediocre member of the cultivators in the vast sacred worlds or to step into heaven and enter the holy grounds! As for those who had not cultivated for a trillion years, they would still be qualified to participate in the next Star Convention.
As for those who cultivated for a longer period, they would no longer have any chances in the future!
It was too difficult to step into the Primal Chaos realm if they were to depend solely on tempering themselves through adventuring. How many Primal Chaos giants were there in a sacred world over this long period? For instance, in the two great sacred worlds, more than half the Primal Chaos giants belonged to a holy ground superpower. Of the remaining few, some were originally from the holy grounds, though with the fall of the Cosmos Gods, these holy ground superpowers disbanded, leaving them to fend for themselves.
Strictly speaking, 70-80% of the Primal Chaos giants were nurtured from Cosmos God superpowers. The remaining 20-30% reached where they were usually because of some miraculous encounters.
Without sufficient luck, it was too difficult to step into the Primal Chaos realm by relying on themselves.
Even if they adventured outside, none of them dared to kill disciples who were part of the holy ground superpowers. As for those without sufficient backgrounds, many had died due to various reasons.
“I must enter.”
“My name must be in the publicized name list. It must!” These cultivators were looking upward with rapt expectation.
“Hong!”
Following a vast aura.
Five ranking lists began appearing beside the Star Pagoda.
At the front of each ranking list, there were names of the teachers.
Like the name register Xue Ying handed in, it was the fifth one-”Elder Dong Bo: Sword Guest Yun Chen, Xing Huo Xun Yi, Mou Jia…”
“My name, that’s my name!” Those talented cultivators were thoroughly looking through the lists.
High in the sky, there were the names of the five teachers of convention and 100 talented cultivator names. Each teacher would select 20 names.
“No…” Some cultivators were staring blankly. They did not dare believe their eyes and began reading through again and again.
“It’s me!” Some who were chosen revealed excited look. Some were able to remain calm after being selected, though the edge of their lips moved upwards, revealing what they were currently feeling.
These cultivators who were genuinely excited and happy were the minority.
The teachers of the convention selected only 100 cultivators. Adding up the previous 100 cultivators who got through the Star Pagoda selections, there were only 200 in total! And the number of participants for the Star Convention reached up to 16,000 cultivators, with the rest failing the selections.
‘I’ve been chosen by General Hatchet Palace Master.’ The simple-robed Fu Jun looked up. His eyes were emitting a dazzling light. He turned around towards the distant red-robed girl who was once his companion, ‘Who would have thought that Xing Huo Xun Yi has been selected too. With his strength, and with the guidance of Monarch Xing Huo, all his potential should be dug out, yet he was chosen regardless?’
Fu Jun watched as how Xing Huo Xun Yi’s name was amongst those gigantic names. He could not help but sneer inwardly.
When Xing Huo Xun Yi exposed his wife who was actually disguising and deceiving him, Fu Jun did not feel grateful to him. Neither did he have any thoughts of vengeance. It was merely that he did not wish to see Xing Huo Xun Yi anymore! The moment he saw the name register, Fu Jun felt slightly disdained since he was sure the other party was able to get his name on the name register by depending on his father.
‘It is useless. Ultimately, the path of cultivation depends on oneself. Even if he gets to enter a holy ground, he will not have any bright future.’ Fu Jun glanced at the golden-robed young man before becoming too lazy to look at him anymore.
He did not wish to see his ex-wife Ni Yan, and neither did he wish to see that Xing Huo Xun Yi.
…
Xing Huo Xun Yi looked up at the names in the sky, and with a glance, he knew Xue Ying had chosen him.
‘Elder Dong Bo has recognized my potential?’ Xing Huo Xun Yi was slightly excited, ‘No rush. He said that he wanted to see my potential throughout the entire Star Convention, and by the time this convention ends, I might be able to accept him as my teacher.’
…
The red-robed Ni Yan looked up. It was unquestionable since her ranking was ordinary, and she had cultivated for a long time, so her name was not included. But the two who were close to her previously, ‘Fu Jun’ and ‘Xing Huo Xun Yi’ were both included in the name registers.
‘Fu Jun’s potential is indeed extraordinary, and the background of Xing Huo Xun Yi is amazing too. Even if he is ranked beneath me, he has been chosen. It’s a pity that I have been exposed in his hands.’ Ni Yan coldly chuckled. She turned around and left the gathering point of the Star Convention. This time, she had suffered from a great loss.
******
The gigantic names appearing by the towering Star Pagoda could be seen even by those located far away.
In a cavern-dwelling, General Hatchet Palace Master was enjoying a scarlet-red wine by himself. He who seemed weak and was white and tender, looked up, easily discerning the names floating beside the Star Pagoda. His vision landed on the name register handed in by Xue Ying.
‘Weird. This Dong Bo Xue Ying doesn’t seem like a silly cultivator, yet why would he choose the son of Xing Huo? Is it for the sake of getting into the good graces of Xing Huo?’ General Hatchet Palace Master shook his head slightly.
…
‘He chose Xing Huo Xun Yi?’ Violet Slaughter Island Master walked out of the palace hall, looking at the names appearing in the distant. She revealed a surprised look, ‘Monarch Xing Huo should not have forced him. He would have many other ways of getting his son into a holy ground, so why the need to do something so ugly? Unless Dong Bo Xue Ying is deliberately doing this to obtain a favor from Monarch Xing Huo?’
Monarch Xing Huo might have other methods to ensure his son could enter the holy ground, but that would require him to use up his favor with others.
If Xue Ying did so, Monarch Xing Huo would have to repay him.
‘He is ultimately a Unity realm.’ Violet Slaughter Island Master shook her head and pursed her lips. She was too lazy to care.
…
General Heaven Light remained seated while meditating. Once he knew of the name register, he merely sneered: ‘What a joke.’
…
‘I knew he would disgrace the Great Void Heaven Temple right from the start when he became a teacher of the convention.’ The cold Five Luster Serpent Ancestor who hated evil as if they were his enemies glanced at the names high in the sky. He then turned his head down and continued drinking his wine.
…
Xing Huo Xun Yi had focused entirely on the Dao of Mirage. Thus, other than asking Xue Ying for guidance, he did not seek any other teachers for help. General Hatchet Palace Master and the other three teachers of the convention naturally judged the potential of Xing Huo Xun Yi to be ranked beyond 5,000th. They also felt that what Xue Ying did was too unpleasant.
‘Haha, he was so arrogant in front of me. So in actual fact, it is because I am giving him too little.’ Ba Yun Palace Master was in the cavern-dwelling arranged by Blade Emperor City. It was very close to the Star Pagoda, and he could easily see those names after looking up. He sneered, ‘With the identity of Monarch Xing Huo, he will disdain from doing such things. It seems that this son of his should have taken out some treasures to buy in Dong Bo Xue Ying.’
For instance, taking out 1,000 to 2,000 Origin World Rocks would suffice to move the hearts of ordinary Primal Chaos experts, and Xue Ying would definitely be moved as well.
With the identity of Xing Huo Xun Yi, he could grit his teeth and take out treasures worth this value!
After all, with Monarch Xing Huo’s identity, he was someone who completely looked down on most Primal Chaos realm, and could easily kill these experts. Naturally, he had treasures outstripping what Ba Yu Palace Master and the others had.
…
Actually, after looking at this name register, the other people were still finding it alright. They would at most feel that Xue Ying had ‘poor manners’ and was doing such an unpleasant action that disgraced the Great Void Heaven Temple.
But the other person who came from the Great Void Heaven Temple, ‘Inquisitive Sky Hall Master’ was truly furious!
‘Dong Bo Xue Ying, he, why would he…’ After Inquisitive Sky Hall Master received the name register, he was filled with disbelief. Looking at the names appearing beside the Star Pagoda, he read through again and again. Behind the 20 names chosen by ‘Elder Dong Bo’, there was indeed Xing Huo Xun Yi!
‘Why would he be like that! Forefather trusted him, regarded him highly, and let him become the teacher of this convention while representing our Great Void Heaven Temple.’ Inquisitive Sky Hall Master’s expression became ugly. Even though he did not really understand what happened during the selections by the Cosmos Gods, Forefather Tian Yu should have spent quite a lot of effort trying to let someone at the Unity realm take on the role as a teacher.
‘But he repaid Forefather’s effort like that? It is fine if he doesn’t care about his reputation, but my Great Void Heaven Temple still wants it!’ Inquisitive Sky Hall Master’s expression became uglier by the moment.
He originally had a favorable impression of Xue Ying.
This was the strongest expert who rose in the juniors of Great Void Heaven Temple. Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and the others harbored great expectations and were thinking of ways to protect him. Knowing that Xue Ying was in danger, he had personally teleported through an ultra-long distance, sending his incarnation rushing down to protect him. Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and the others were looking forward to the day that Xue Ying breakthrough and become a hall master on the same level as them.
But this time, what Xue Ying did had genuinely infuriated Inquisitive Sky Hall Master.
Your most significant reliance is my Great Void Heaven Temple! Why the need to curry favor with Monarch Xing Huo? Is my Great Void Heaven Temple not stronger than Monarch Xing Huo by ten to a hundred times?

chapters.title: Chapter 920 - Foresight
chapters.content:
Chapter 920: Foresight
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying returned to his cavern-dwelling after submitting in his name register to Heart Imitation Palace Master. Just as he sat down and took out a flask of precious wine, before even pouring it, the protector entered and said: “Elder, Inquisitive Sky Hall Master is here to visit you.”
“Inquisitive Sky Hall Master?” Xue Ying was surprised. He immediately stood up. After taking a few steps, he arrived at the main entrance of the cavern-dwelling.
“Inquisitive Sky Hall Master can just send down someone to tell me if you are planning to look for me. I’ll definitely rush over.” Just as Xue Ying wanted to say a few more words, he noticed that there was currently no sliver of a smile on the black-skinned face of Inquisitive Sky Hall Master. He was calmly and coldly looking at Xue Ying. He headed directly: “Let us talk more inside.”
Xue Ying was slightly stunned. It seemed that Inquisitive Sky Hall Master was acting weirdly today.
Following Inquisitive Sky Hall Master in, Xue Ying was still enthusiastically saying: “Even though the mission of selecting the talented cultivators for the Star Convention seem easy, I did not dare rest on my laurels. After all, it is publicized, and the matter has to be done beautifully. Now that the name register is fixed, I feel more relaxed now. I was just about to drink a wine brewed using the ‘Barley Maple Leaf’ from the era of primitive Ancient Sacred World when hall master came. Does hall master want to accompany me to drink a few cups?”
“Now that the matter has been executed beautifully, you are relaxed?” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master stopped and turned around to look at Xue Ying.
Xue Ying was stunned.
“You feel that this is done really beautifully?” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master asked again.
“Because the previous four teachers of the convention handed in their name register first, I can’t select the cultivators they have chosen. That is why I had to adjust the selected names a few times, though the cultivators I have chosen are not bad.” Xue Ying answered.
“Not bad?”
Inquisitive Sky Hall Master nodded, “Then how do you see Xing Hou Xun Yi?”
“He is excellent, the best cultivator I have chosen in my name register.” Xue Ying looked at the expression on Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and was enlightened at that moment. He chuckled, “Haha, hall master is furious because I selected that Xing Huo Xun Yi? Are you worried that I do not care about my reputation and wants to curry favor from Monarch Xing Huo? How am I such a person? Hall master should feel rest assured. You aren’t a teacher of the convention so you would not know how frightening the improvement was with Xing Huo Xun Yi during this 1,000 years of time.”
“Frightening?” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master was startled. He could see how Xue Ying had a card up his sleeves. The initial fury soon turned into suspicion, “How much improvement can he make? He has been cultivating under such stellar condition for the past 500 billion years-he has all kinds of precious materials and guidance from experts. Now in this 1,000 years, how much improvement can he make?”
It was not just Inquisitive Sky Hall Master thinking about this. Many other Primal Chaos giants were also pondering over this after looking at the list.
Cultivation required one to slowly accumulate. Even if Xue Ying were outstanding, once he reached the fifth level Star Pagoda strength, he had to train slowly and cultivate for a long time before eventually stepping into the sixth level once his heart realm reached the ‘My Heart as the World’ realm!
These talented cultivators had cultivated for a few tens of billions of years at the minimum, and the longest had even cultivated for more than a trillion years.
Over such a long period… 1,000 years was not worth mentioning!
Like Xing Huo Xun Yi and others with a huge background, they had resources and guidance. So this 1,000 years would not allow them to improve a lot.
Only those loose cultivator who had to grope blindly during cultivation with difficulties would be able to drastically improve after obtaining guidance from existences like General Hatchet Palace Master. Xue Ying was also the strongest Unity realm expert in the two great sacred worlds, so his advice was similarly precious!
Usually, only loose cultivators would have a drastic improvement during this 1,000 years.
General Hatchet Palace Master, Violet Slaughter Island Master, General Heaven Light, Five Luster Serpent Ancestor, and the others did not think that Xing Huo Xun Yi would have a huge improvement. Ultimately, one had to build a strong foundation before he could improve further. Unless Xing Huo Xun Yi had encountered many difficulties in the past with his cultivation? Did he not have the guidance of peak experts? No! The father of Xing Huo Xun Yi was a ninth level Star Pagoda existence. Relying on the relationship with his father, he could easily invite other Primal Chaos giants for help, so his cultivation conditions would be much better than even seeking the help of the five teachers of the convention.
“His improvement is extremely huge.” Xue Ying chuckled, “The other four teachers of the convention should know it right?”
“General Heaven Light has sent a message to me. It might sound good on the surface, but he is ridiculing me.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master shook his head, “If that Xing Huo Xun Yi really has a huge improvement, he should not have gone to find General Heaven Light for help.”
Xue Ying was stunned momentarily.
“Wait a moment.”
Xue Ying immediately transmitted a message over to Monarch Xing Huo. As Monarch Xing Huo intended to befriend him, the two had naturally exchanged their communication imprints.
“Monarch, Xing Huo Xun Yi has never sought the help of other teachers of the convention?” Xue Ying transmitted and asked.
“Haha, Elder Dong Bo, I saw the name register you submitted. The other four teachers of the convention have never selected my son, with only you choosing him. I had even asked this son of mine, and he said that since the other four teachers do not understand the Dao of Mirage, there is no need to waste his time.” Monarch Xing Huo transmitted back. Indeed, Xing Huo Xun Yi was unlike the other loose cultivators. His horizons were set really high, and he did not find seeking the guidance of other four teachers of the convention as an excellent opportunity for him. He was even too lazy to do so.
During the past 1,000 years, Xing Huo Xun Yi concentrated entirely on the Dao of Mirage! And the person with the highest attainment in the Dao of Mirage under the laws and profound mysteries system in the five great sacred worlds was none other than Xue Ying! The moment Xue Ying’s Dao of Mirage reached the Primal Chaos realm, he would be the only one in history who had done so.
No wonder. After all, there were only a total of 20 cultivators who reached the Primal Chaos realm in the laws and profound mysteries system. The Dao of Mirage belonged to the slightly ‘less popular’ Dao in the laws and profound mysteries system, unlike the Dao of Slaughter which was more commonly seen.
“You saved my son and this huge favor… haha, this favor will be etched in my heart.” Monarch Xing Huo transmitted back without going into details.
Saying this, it meant the other party was extremely thankful to Xue Ying.
For the sake of saving his son, he had even gone asking the help of Cosmos Gods. Currently, the fighting spirit in his son had been reignited. Monarch Xing Huo was naturally pleased. Furthermore, his son had said that he wanted to take Xue Ying as his teacher, so their relationship in the future would naturally become closer.
…
Xue Ying finished communicating with Monarch Xing Huo before telling Inquisitive Sky Hall Master: “I’ve just talked to Monarch Xing Huo. It seems that this brat Xing Huo Xun Yi has just come asking me for guidance. He hasn’t gone seeking the other four teachers of the convention.”
“His improvement is really huge?” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master could not help but ask.
“Really. Do I have to lie about this? 10,000 years from now, Xing Huo Xun Yi will have to battle in public as well. If I were to lie, won’t I be exposed by then?” Xue Ying chuckled.
“But, but how would he be able to improve so suddenly as you said in this short period despite not growing in the past 500 billion years?” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master was bewildered.
Xue Ying hesitated.
The matter about the emotional injury…
It was considered a disgraceful affair. Previously when Monarch Xing Huo came to him for help, he asked Xue Ying to keep it a secret.
After all, this was a matter about becoming companions with an illusory girl. The other party was even thus wounded emotionally, which made this affair something disgraceful in the world of cultivators! There were even no records of this matter regarding Xing Huo Xun Yi becoming ’emotionally hurt’ in the intelligence Xue Ying obtained.
It was unquestionable that despite Monarch Xing Huo asking the help of several other Primal Chaos giants who specialized in the illusory realm, he requested for others to keep this under wrap! With the identity of those Monarch Xing Huo sought help from, there was no reason for them to broadcast this matter to the public.
“There are some minor reasons.” Xue Ying did not explain in detail. He smiled, “But his improvement is indeed huge. How about this, Inquisitive Sky Hall Master can check the scenes of what happened tens of years ago when he came over to ask me for help.”
“Oh?”
Inquisitive Sky Hall Master nodded.
Even though he felt that Xue Ying was speaking earnestly, and this matter should not be fake, since reaching this point, there was no need for Xue Ying to lie. But Inquisitive Sky Hall Master was still filled with disbelief. How could Xing Huo Xun Yi with his huge background have such a massive improvement in this 1,000 years despite not doing so in the past 500 billion years?
The eyes of Inquisitive Sky Hall Master looked forward. A serene light shot out from his eyes, causing the scene ahead to distort.
“Shua.”
Very soon, the scene warped to what happened tens of years ago. It was also the most recent time when Xing Huo Xun Yi had come seeking the help of Xue Ying.
Watching that scene, Inquisitive Sky Hall Master revealed a look of shock. He was filled with disbelief.
“Dao of Mirage?” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master said with shock, “He, he actually brought the Dao of Mirage up to the Unity realm? And this strength seems to be at the fourth level Star Pagoda stage?”
Xue Ying nodded with a chuckle.
Over 900 years, under the help of Monarch Xing Huo, Xing Huo Xun Yi had been cultivated at 10,000 times that of regular time flow in the ‘Time Pagoda’ within Blade Emperor City. Even though it would require about 200,000 Origin World Rocks for a Unity realm expert to cultivate for 100 million years, and Cosmos Gods would not be so extravagant, but since it was only a short 1,000 years, he would merely have to fork out 2 Origin World Rocks.
Cultivating for over nine million years and with the best cultivation condition and treasure that would help cultivation, in addition to his own experiences and guidance by Xue Ying, Xing Huo Xun Yi had indeed reached the Unity realm in the Dao of Mirage.
That time when Xue Ying reached the Unity realm in his Dao of Mirage, he was able to quickly grasp the ‘Dark Bubble’ and directly reach the fifth level Star Pagoda strength!
But-
Even though Xing Huo Xun Yi might be formidable, he was clearly weaker than Xue Ying in terms of his talent in the Dao of Mirage. Nevertheless, he had grasped the second style ‘Mirage Annihilation’ of the absolute art Xue Ying created, “Mirage”.
As Inquisitive Sky Hall Master watched the scene of Xing Huo Xun Yi seeking the help of Xue Ying, he became joyful.
“If I remembered correctly, there was only one person who got through the fourth level Star Pagoda during the Star Pagoda selections.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master said, “And now, Xing Huo Xun Yi wields this similar power as well, and in other words, he is likely ranked in the top three positions.”
Xue Ying nodded with a smile, “As I said before, he is the best cultivator I have chosen in my name register. Since he has never gone seeking the help of the other four teachers of the convention, then some ugly gossips would also gradually circulate in the outer world. Should we tell this to the other four teachers?”
“You must not tell them.”
Inquisitive Sky Hall Master shook his head. He was clearly delighted, “That General Heaven Light has even deliberately transmitted a message to me, ridiculing me in the dark. Hmph hmph, let the gossips be gossips. Let them circulate all they want! 10,000 years later, it’ll be time for the public battle. By then, Xing Huo Xun Yi would just dazzle the world! I am looking forward to the moment when all their expressions are filled with shock. Furthermore, by then, many cultivators paying notice to the Star Convention will know that the ‘Great Void Heaven Temple’ which cultivated the laws and profound mysteries lineage have sent out a teacher with the highest foresight in selecting talented cultivators!”

chapters.title: Chapter 921 - Astounding the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 921: Astounding the World
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Since Inquisitive Sky Hall Master was not too willing to tell the other four teachers of the convention, Xue Ying would naturally not oppose him.
Even though there were rumors about this, firstly, rumors were rumors and would only be temporary and secondly, it was the minority who felt that Xue Ying’s decision of selecting Xing Huo Xun Yi was unfair!
The talented cultivators who participated in the convention would usually be concerned about this and would tend to collect information about it. They would understand that Xing Huo Xun Yi was the son of ‘Monarch Xing Huo’, and had cultivated for more than 500 billion years. He was merely ranked at about 3,600th, and they would feel that it wasn’t fair… there were also some of the higher-ups from the six great holy grounds who were concerned about this convention who would try to understand the matter.
But many ordinary cultivators did not have a detailed intelligence of Xing Huo Xun Yi. They even thought that ‘Xing Huo Xun Yi’ was a loose cultivator!
As a result, it was only the minority who felt that what Xue Ying did was ugly. Primarily, they were just a small part of the talented cultivators as well as members of the six great holy grounds.
…
After the 200 cultivators were selected from the Star Pagoda selection and by the teachers of the convention, they would be qualified to enter the ‘Time Pagoda’ of Blade Emperor City to undergo training at a hundred-times time-accelerated environment. In reality, it would be a total of one million years of cultivation period. Furthermore, they could read many books at any time-these books were some of the more fundamental ones provided by the six great holy grounds.
Since these 200 cultivators would eventually enter the six great holy grounds, they were still willing to share some fundamental cultivation scriptures.
Other than that, the holy grounds would also provide precious materials.
Cultivating for a million years with many books and teachers to ask for help… this period was a dream come true for many loose cultivators. These loose cultivators would usually have to risk their lives and depend on luck to even get an absolute formidable art! But now, a large number of absolute arts were placed in front of them.
Xing Huo Xun Yi also had to obediently follow the rules. He would similarly be cultivating under a hundred-times time-accelerated environment along with the other selected cultivators.
******
Ont his day.
Xue Ying watched as the sun rose: ‘10,000 years have passed. Today is the day of battle for these brats.’ 10,000 years was considered short to them. If not for the occasional talented cultivators coming to seek for his help, if Xue Ying were to really concentrate on cultivating, he would feel that these 10,000 years passed like a flash.
“Sou.”
After exiting the cavern-dwelling, Xue Ying traveled through the sky. Inquisitive Sky Hall Master flew over as well.
“Dong Bo.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master flew alongside Xue Ying, “This 10,000 years might be short, but there are really some chaps gossiping about this matter still, especially that cultivator called Ba Yun Palace Master. I heard that he was idly chatting with several other Primal Chaos giants, saying that they should wait and see how you become a joke during the ranking battle this time.”
“Ba Yun?” Xue Ying shook his head.
The other party was really narrow-minded and selfish.
But there were all kinds of cultivators. Those who were extremely selfish were common too. There were also those who followed the ideology of ‘submit to me and prosper, or oppose me and perish’. It was normal for Ba Yun Palace Master to hate Xue Ying because of this matter as well.
“See how I become a joke?” Xue Ying chuckled, “He will not have a chance at all.”
“Right.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master revealed a grin too.
“Sou sou.”
The two of them flew over to the gathering field of the Star Convention. The seating arrangements were the same as during the start of the convention. Xue Ying was seated on the corner of the five seats to the left of Heart Imitation Religious Master.
Primal Chaos giants were coming one after another. As for the talented cultivators who were participating in the convention this time, they had long arrived. Even though they were not chosen, they wanted to come and observe the battle too and see how wide the gap in their strengths was! There were also many cultivators living within the Blade Emperor City and children who came to watch the battles.
“The five teachers of the convention have chosen 100 cultivators. The other 99 are fine, but that Xing Huo Xun Yi should have depended on his background, and is the one with the least qualifications.” Many talented cultivators felt all the more unfair after understanding the selections.
“I’ve long said before that he should not a teacher of the convention. After all, his foresight is far weaker than the other four teachers.”
“It isn’t his foresight, but he is more easily bought over.”
Many talented cultivators were surreptitiously discussing with one another through voice transmissions. Many of them were filled with resentment.
If that Xing Huo Xun Yi weren’t chosen, one lucky cultivator among them would be selected into the next round.
“Let’s see.”
“In a while, the true strength of Xing Huo Xun Yi who was ranked at 3,600th in the Star Pagoda selection will be revealed.”
…
Heart Imitation Religious Master projected his majestic voice. It reverberated by the ears of every single cultivator across the entire Star Convention place, and even in their hearts: “At this moment, the 200 selected cultivators will be split into five groups. Every group will have two winners, and the ten winners will proceed into the final one-on-one duels… according to the battle results, the top five would be chosen. This top five cultivators could select any of the six great holy grounds they want to enter. They would naturally become the core members of the holy grounds and would be nurtured well. For now, the first group will begin its battle.”
Heart Imitation Religious Master’s voice was gentle, yet it was enough to cause all spectators to quieten down.
Their gazes landed on the battle platform spanning a full 50,000 kilometers long. At this moment ‘sou sou sou’, many figures flew up to the battle platform. There were a total of 40 of them. They belonged to the first group.
As for the arrangement of the battles…
Heart Imitation Religious Master was responsible for it. He would usually separate the extremely strong cultivators apart into five different groups. Even so, every group would only have two final winners.
And even if many talented cultivators were congregated in a particular group, all 200 cultivators would still have to go through the Star Pagoda trial, and the teachers of the convention would select another five out of them!
Regardless, there would be a total of ten talented cultivators who would be nurtured greatly by the holy grounds.
“Hong.”
“Hua.”
The 40 talented cultivators proceeded with a free-for-all battle on the battle platform. Some were forced out of the platform, and some immediately activated their protective treasures.
All of them had temporarily obtained a set of protective treasure which could be activated any time. But activating it meant that they lost their qualification! And they had to leave the platform obediently. Being forced out of the stage represented defeat as well. The two remaining cultivators would eventually be crowned the winners.
In just a few breaths of time, there were only eight talented cultivators who were still battling. The others had been eliminated.
And after two breaths later, there were just three talented cultivators.
“Hong.”
Black cloud began rolling out onto the body of a cultivator, causing him to spurt blood and fly out of the platform. As he flew out, he stared at the tall and huge teenager on the platform while thinking: ‘Cang Qiong Tian Yun, consider yourself ruthless.’
In the first group, there was Cang Qiong Tian Yun. He was the only expert who crossed the fourth level Star Pagoda during the preliminary Star Pagoda selections. He was clearly stronger than the others.
Previously, there were just three left behind. Cang Qiong Tian Yun was the strongest, and the other two were about the same. This cultivator who was struck out had even requested Cang Qiong Tian Yun for help, bribing him with 20 Origin World Rocks at the end.
Who would have thought…
Cang Qiong Tian Yun had simply blasted him down.
“Cang Qiong Tian Yun is truly formidable.”
“The advantage is huge.”
“The first group is unquestionably the strongest one.” Even though the battle happened extremely quick, everyone could perceive the strength of Cang Qiong Tian Yun.
…
“Second group.”
…
“Third group.”
The filtering of cultivators in each group happened really quickly. Soon, it was the third group. The 40 cultivators of the third group flew up the battle platform, and amongst them included a golden-robed young man, ‘Xing Huo Xun Yi’. Just by depending on his appearance and temperament, he was clearly the most dazzling amongst them.
“Xing Huo Xun Yi has come.”
“Let us pay close attention to him. In a while, his skills will be exposed to the rest.” Those talented cultivators who weren’t chosen felt that things were unfair. They wanted that unjust teacher of the convention, ‘Xue Ying’ to lose his face. If the one he chose, Xing Huo Xun Yi lost terribly, it would naturally testify to his unfairness and poor judgment skills.
Not just those below were paying close notice to the battle.
Even many Primal Chaos giants situated in the high platform were paying close notice to this. They had long heard of many rumors and had subconsciously glanced at ‘Xue Ying’ who was seated by the boundary of the five teachers of the convention.
Yet Xue Ying was calmly seated there watching as the battle was about to begin.
General Heaven Light glanced at Xue Ying who was by his side for a moment before turning back to the battle that was about to begin.
“Hong~”
The battle immediately erupted.
The golden-robed young man, Xing Huo Xun Yi, suddenly let out a layer of dimmed white light. This white light illusory realm enveloped the other 39 experts on the battle platform. This was none other than Xing Huo Xun Yi’s ancient cultivation illusory realm! After he had improved his attainments in the Dao of Mirage-grasping the ‘Mirage Annihilation’ created by Xue Ying-he had naturally brought his original ancient cultivation illusory realm to a whole new level. This horrifying illusory realm had felled close to half the talented cultivators on the platform. A minority was struggling to maintain consciousness, and even fewer were able to maintain full awareness.
At the same time he displayed the illusory realm, Xing Huo Xun Yi waved his hands.
“Hong~”
A fiery light rushed out on all the talented cultivators. The Dao of Mirage contained a fourth level Star Pagoda strength, and his bloodline cultivation had also become much stronger, though it was only at the third level strength. Nevertheless, currently, as he unleashed his group attack, those who were struggling to stay awake could hardly defend against his attack.
The fiery impact blasted out, throwing many talented cultivators out of the battle platform. There were only eight left who could still defend themselves. They were either strong, or that their cultivation hearts were formidable. But all eight were looking with shock and disbelief at Xing Huo Xun Yi.
Not just them.
Many others who wished to see Xing Huo Xun Yi’s poor performance to validate the unfairness of ‘Xue Ying’ as a teacher of the convention, were at this moment looking with their mouths wide open.
This, this, this?
Was this a cultivator ranked at 3,600th in the Star Pagoda selection? Why did he seem more tyrannical than the first ranked Cang Qiong Tian Yun?
…
And on the high platform, many Primal Chaos giants felt their mind trembling. Many were shocked and had even turned towards that white-robed teenager.
“Congratulations Monarch Xing Huo, congratulations!” Some of the Primal Chaos giants had begun chatting with Monarch Xing Huo. They had great foresight and knew that this control of the illusory realm was absolutely the strength of the user. It did not belong to something external.
And over at the side of the five teachers of the convention.
General Hatchet Palace Master looked at the leftmost Xue Ying with interest. He revealed a strand of a grin while thinking: ‘Interesting. Xing Huo Xun Yi is able to improve so much within 10,000 years. And it is even in the illusory realm? Dong Bo Xue Ying is most famous for his illusory realm.’
“Elder Dong Bo.”
Violet Slaughter Palace Master’s smile was absolutely beautiful. It contained a frightening charm, “Truly formidable. No wonder you have chosen that Xing Huo Xun Yi. In my opinion, he might even be stronger than Cang Qiong Tian Yun.”
Xue Ying merely stated: “The illusory realm is specialized in dealing against a group of enemies. Ultimately, it is still up to the final duel between Xun Yi this brat with Cang Qiong Tian Yun to determine who is the victor.”

chapters.title: Chapter 922 - Deciding Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 922: Deciding Battle
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“I am very curious.” General Hatchet Palace Master turned over and chuckled, “That Xing Huo Xun Yi has only that sort of strength after cultivating for 500 billion years. But now, how long has it been yet his illusory realm became so formidable. Is it because Xing Huo did not find a good teacher for his son in the past? For him to improve so much in such a short period, his comprehension ability must be high. But even if he did not have a good teacher, with sufficient comprehension ability, he should not be so weak even if he cultivated by himself… Elder Dong Bo, can you enlighten me?”
“Haha.”
Monarch Xing Huo was just laughing by the side, “General Hatchet, you can only say that Elder Dong Bo is indeed the cultivator who has the highest attainment in the laws and profound mysteries Dao of Mirage in history! His understanding of the illusory realm is extremely amazing. Under his guidance, my son’s understanding of the illusory realm has soared! I am really grateful to Elder Dong Bo for him to dig out the potential of my son in this field. Haha, it is the right decision for me to come to this Star Convention!”
General Hatchet Palace Master was clearly asking Xue Ying, yet Monarch Xing Huo took the initiative to intervene.
But the other Primal Chaos giants were going along with it.
What a joke.
Heart Imitation Religious Master, General Hatchet Palace Master, Monarch Xing Huo… they were the strongest three present at the scene and stood at the limit of Primal Chaos realm. They could easily slaughter those at the seventh level Star Pagoda strength! And even when fighting against those at the eighth level Star Pagoda strength, they could utterly suppress them. Most would die after a few moves. Their statuses were comparable to a seventh level Star Pagoda Unity expert.
As a result, even the highly arrogant General Heaven Light and others did not cut in. They just smiled.
‘This Unity brat has actually gotten the favor of Monarch Xing Huo for him to protect this brat so much.’ Different conjectures were forming in General Heaven Light’s heart. He could feel that Monarch Xing Huo was genuinely grateful to Xue Ying, and how Monarch Xing Huo was filled with endless delight!
‘Is it really the case that the potential of Xing Huo Xun Yi is dug out by Dong Bo Xue Ying?’ General Heaven Light was filled with some disbelief.
Since Monarch Xing Huo had stated it, what could General Heaven Light do even if he did not believe in it?
…
Within the world of cultivators, it was ingrained in everyone’s bone that the strong was respected.
Other than Xue Ying who was at the Unity realm, the rest who were seated at the high platform watching the battle were Primal Chaos experts! But it was normal since Primal Chaos giants could easily reach the seventh level Star Pagoda strength after accumulating enough experiences. And in the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void, there was not a single seventh level Star Pagoda Unity expert in this era!
Primal Chaos giants naturally looked down from a high position when facing a Unity expert. They could casually dispatch an incarnation that would be at the fifth or sixth level Star Pagoda strength. They could easily slaughter a large group of Unity experts.
They who were initially disdainful of Xue Ying due to his weak strength became disgusted with Xue Ying after his disgraceful action of selecting ‘Xing Huo Xun Yi’! Nevertheless, everything is different now!
Firstly, Xing Huo Xun Yi’s strength was terrifying. More importantly, he was very weak during the preliminary selections, and clearly, he had improved dramatically during this short period. The other four teachers of the convention did not select him because they did not know Xing Huo Xun Yi’s improvement would be so frightening. If they knew, General Hatchet Palace Master and the others would definitely select him.
Only Xue Ying knew about him, and chose him! Furthermore, he specialized in the illusory realm as well. They might not know how Xue Ying did it-how he made Xing Huo Xun Yi so formidable-but it sufficed to make them admire this Unity teacher of the convention.
Secondly and more importantly, they could feel that Monarch Xing Huo was really grateful and protective of Xue Ying. Just this point alone made deterred them from having contempt for Xue Ying.
******
The battle of the five groups ended really quickly. Two cultivators would move on from each group, adding up to a total of ten!
These 10 talented cultivators began their duels. Each of them would have to fight nine battles, and the top five cultivators would thus be determined!
At this moment…
Each battle was significant!
The 200 chosen from the Star Convention preliminary selections would not be considered as core members despite joining the six great holy grounds. They would at most be treated as ordinary disciples. Only the final ten would become the core and be nurtured with full efforts by the holy grounds.
“Hong~”
The ripples from the battles fluctuated within the 50,000 kilometers long battle platform.
“Victory to Cang Qiong Tian Yun!”
…
Since everyone would fight nine battles, there would be a total of 45 battles. These battles were comparatively more exciting since everyone had high talent and comprehension abilities. Many of their techniques were quite profound, causing those spectators to watch with rapt excitement.
“Xing Huo Xun Yi, victory.”
Xing Huo Xun Yi stood on the battle platform. He did not move. As of now, he had won five battles.
His battles were the most brilliant of all since he would stand at his original position every single battle, and would simply unleash his illusory realm first! Even those who could resist against the illusory realm would be weakened from it. If he were to display the ‘World Prison’, with a total of six layers of World Prison descending and stacking up on the enemy, most opponents could not struggle out of this restriction and were easily forced out of the battle platform.
He had easily won all his five battles just like this.
“Such a terrifying illusory realm.”
“His restrictive techniques are more horrifying. Even those at the third level Star Pagoda strength could not struggle out from his restrictions.” Those talented cultivators who were not chosen watched the battle with incomparable shock.
“He was merely at the second level Star Pagoda strength 10,000 years in the past, yet in the blink of an eye, he became so formidable?”
“Elder Dong Bo is so amazing at teaching disciples?”
Those talented cultivators who felt Xue Ying was unfair in his selection previously, felt now that his methods of teaching were too unbelievable.
“I’ve gone seeking his help before, yet why did I not improve so much?”
“Who can you blame since you aren’t someone cultivating in the illusory realm?”
“Right, Elder Dong Bo specializes in the illusory realm most right? We aren’t experts in the illusory realm at all.”
“Are you all the son of Monarch Xing Huo? Why would Elder Dong Bo do his best when guiding you all?”
Many cultivators were discussing amongst each other.
Envy, jealousy, no matter what, they had to accept Xue Ying’s great foresight and his amazing capabilities of teaching disciples.
…
Xing Huo Xun Yi finally moved.
He was now facing someone called ‘Kang Yong’, a void lifeform expert. He displayed the second style of Xue Ying’s created absolute art, the ‘Mirage Annihilation’. He was even forced to unleash three consecutive Mirage Annihilation at the same time before heavily injuring Kang Yong, forcing the other party to admit defeat.
…
The 45 battles proceeded without stopping.
It was the final battle. The Star Convention had pre-arranged the battles long beforehand, deliberately placing the battle between ‘Cang Qiong Tian Yun’ and “Xing Huo Xun Yi’ as the final one. The two of them had won all their previous eight battles, and the victor of this battle would be the winner of all nine matches, and also unquestionably the first ranker in this Star Convention deciding battles.
Actually, the two of them would undoubtedly be placed in the top five and would definitely be nurtured as core members. Nevertheless, they were filled with fighting spirit.
“Hong~” Cang Qiong Tian Yu stood there. His body was muscular, and rolling black clouds moved around his body. Clearly, one could see how powerful his body was.
The young man Xing Huo Xun Yi stood on the other side of the battle platform. His aura was concealed, making him seem like an ordinary young man without threat. Suddenly, a layer of dimmed white light appeared from the surface of his body. This dimmed white light enveloped the entire battle platform within moments.
“It’s starting.”
Heart Imitation Religious Master, General Hatchet Palace Master, Monarch Xing Huo, General Heaven Light, Five Luster Serpent Ancestor, Xue Ying and the others situated on the high platform were also paying close attention to this battle. They did not care much about those battles before this, but this final battle was the most important one in the entire Star Convention.

chapters.title: Chapter 923 - Sacred Master and Gu Qi
chapters.content:
Chapter 923: Sacred Master and Gu Qi
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
This was a bitter battle between Cang Qiong Tian Yun and Xing Huo Xun Yi. Both of them did not have it hard when fighting in the previous eight battles.
Cang Qiong Tian Yun’s body was tyrannical. It was considered rare amongst those on the same level. His close combat offensive skills were similarly fierce and ruthless, and after being guided by General Hatchet Palace Master and the others, his body and close combat offensive skills were comparable to that of a fifth level Star Pagoda expert. But at the same time, he had a glaring weakness-that was his body movement skills were weak. In the previous battles, many cultivators could surpass him in speed. And it was because of this glaring weakness that made his overall strength stay at the fourth level standard.
When facing other opponents, Cang Qiong Tian Yun had an easy time-just directly attack from far.
He would send his fist out. Even if it was a far-range attack, it sufficed in defeating the opponent.
But it’s a pity that this was useless against Xing Huo Xun Yi.
Xing Huo Xun Yi’s ancient cultivation illusory realm was extremely extraordinary. Cang Qiong Tian Yun might be able to resist against it, but he would be distracted, causing his strength to suffer a decline. More importantly, the ‘Mirage Annihilation’ was extremely powerful. Three stacked Mirage Annihilations sufficed to damage the lifeforce of Cang Qiong Tian Yun. Many Mirages would envelop around Cang Qiong Tian Yun, forcing him to furiously break them apart. But even as he pushed the mirages apart, it would still damage him.
More importantly, the mirages were able to restrict him.
His far range attacks could not break apart the ‘mirages’, and his close combat skills did not let him get close to Xing Huo Xun Yi. As a result, he was ‘consumed’ by the other party during this battle.
“Break, break.” Cang Qiong Tian Yun fiercely roared. He was madly attacking the restrictive mirages. The World Mirages came endlessly, giving Cang Qiong Tian Yun a hard time. He would occasionally send an attack out, extending his arms to strike at Xing Huo Xun Yi, yet by then, a new mirage would have descended.
Xing Huo Xun Yi was cautious.
Under the frenetic offense, Cang Qiong Tian Yu could easily force him to activate his protective treasure with just a single strike. He would have lost then.
‘His body is too strong.’ Xing Huo Xun Yi was also finding it taxing. The ‘Mirage Annihilation’ was his strongest move, and he could only form three of such world mirages at most. Only then could it barely injure the other party! That body was genuinely heaven-defying.
As such, Xing Huo Xun Yi maintained alert throughout the battle. He did not let Cang Qiong Tian Yun get close to him.
Cang Qiong Tian Yun was akin to a fierce beast. He did not dare let his body become too big since it would reduce his defenses. His defenses were the strongest only when it is maintained at the usual body shape. He would also extend his arms occasionally to try and sneak in some attacks.
After the time taken to brew a cup of tea.
Cang Qiong Tian Yun’s lifeforce had been depleted, forcing him to unwillingly admit defeat.
‘I’ve lost.’ Cang Qiong Tian Yun thought, ‘In the future, I must think of ways to improve my speed.’
In the past, he had focused all his attention on the absolute art “12 Calamity Cosmos Body”. This was an absolute art belonging to the strongest warrior cultivation system. This absolute art aimed at obtaining the strongest defensive body that would not be destroyed after suffering from 10,000 calamities. The more extreme he tempered his body, the stronger his defenses would be. Even a casual swing of his hand would generate a vast force. It was only his speed that was lacking.
‘General Hatchet Palace Master, General Heaven Light, Elder Dong Bo, and the others have said before that cultivating other systems would enable me to cover up this weakness.’ Cang Qiong Tian Yun thought. The 10,000 years period was too short. He needed a longer time to cultivate. As long as he could cover up this weakness of his, he would be able to reach the fifth level Star Pagoda strength.
“Cang Qiong Tian Yun, I would not have thought that your body is able to reach such a formidable stage. Admirable.” Xing Huo Xun Yi was indeed admirable of the other party. His father, ‘Monarch Xing Huo’, other than being famous for his flames, was also well-known for his fleshy body amongst those at the ninth level. As a result, his body was also slightly stronger than usual because of his bloodline cultivation system.
But compared to Cang Qiong Tian Yun, he was far lacking.
He knew Cang Qiong Tian Yun must undoubtedly have a formidable absolute art, but so what? He, Xing Huo Xun Yi, could easily obtain many absolute arts. The core members of the holy grounds could even obtain cosmos ranked absolute arts, but what happened to them in the end? They still had to cultivate in these arts themselves.
“I admire you more for you to improve so much in this short 10,000 years. I accept this loss wholeheartedly.” Cang Qiong Tian Yun said.
…
As the two most dazzling talented cultivators of this Star Convention Xing Huo Xun Yi and Cang Qiong Tian Yun talked to each other, they were also walking down the battle platform.
At the same time, on the high platform, the Primal Chaos giants were unknowingly turning over to the white-robed teenager who was seated by the edge where the five teachers of the convention sat. They knew that this time, Xue Ying’s name would definitely be spread between the Primal Chaos giants since his performance was brilliant.
There were many unanswered questions still.
How was Xue Ying able to make Xing Huo Xun Yi improve so fast in the short 10,000 years with that great background of his? Improving his rank from 3,600th in the Star Pagoda preliminary selections to the eventual first rank during the decisive battle! That was truly unfathomable!
“Dong Bo Xue Ying.” A cold voice came from the side.
Xue Ying turned towards it.
Five Luster Serpent Ancestor remained cold, though his gaze towards Xue Ying was slightly different: “Congratulations. The Xing Huo Xun Yi you chose has become the top-ranked this time.”
“It is all due to his great comprehension ability.” Xue Ying chuckled immediately. He understood that it was rare for Five Luster Serpent Ancestor to take the initiative of ‘congratulating’ him.
After Five Luster Serpent Ancestor finished speaking, he continued looking downwards.
The over 200 talented cultivators were currently recovering. Some of the more heavily injured ones were being healed by the experts who were invited over by the organization of the Star Convention.
Very soon.
They began entering the Star Pagoda one after another. The Star Pagoda trials would be starting.
The performance of the ‘decisive battle’ and the two performances of attempting the Star Pagoda as well as their own performance throughout the 10,000 years of seeking help from the teachers of the convention, and many other reasons would be used by the five teachers of the convention as factors. The teachers would use these factors to select five cultivators. These five along with the top five ranked cultivators during the ranking battles would add up to a total of ten cultivators. These ten could decide which holy ground they want to enter. Furthermore, they would become core members of the holy grounds too.
Since there were just 200 cultivators, the time taken for all of them to cross the Star Pagoda was short.
There were only three cultivators who got through the fourth level Star Pagoda this time: Xing Huo Xun Yi, Cang Qiong Tian Yun, and Kang Yong.
There were 169 who got through the third level Star Pagoda. The remaining 28 had gotten through the second level.
“Dong Bo, prepare yourself properly. In 10,000 years, all of you will have to give a Dao lecture.” As everyone began leaving, Monarch Xing Huo, Xue Ying, and Inquisitive Sky Hall Master flew side by side.
“Mn.”
Xue Ying also felt quite carefree.
In the following 10,000 years, he just had to select one person. Even though this name register was significant, the difficulty wasn’t huge. By then, he would be giving a public Dao lecture along with the other four teachers of the convention. This was considered a massive opportunity for the weaker cultivators. After the Dao lectures were given, the convention would officially end.
‘At least I did not disgrace my Great Void Heaven Temple during this convention.’ Xue Ying thought. He had a smile on his face.
******
The Star Convention was already at its final stages. Xue Ying of the Great Void Heaven Temple was also being mentioned by many Primal Chaos giants. And at this point, there was a startling matter which happened in the Myriad Ancient Sacred World.
Located in an area deep in the mountains, within a courtyard.
“Weng~”
A profound fluctuation came from deep in the courtyard. It did not seem conspicuous.
Nevertheless, the entire courtyard had transformed into ruins soundlessly. Some of the surrounding mountainous rocks and plants had similarly collapsed and withered. The disturbances created were small, but this only represented that the force had been remarkably restrained.
The silver-haired golden-horned man, ‘Gu Qi’, stood within the ruined courtyard. His current figure had split into a hundred pieces. These pieces had already fused back into a humanoid, albeit there was black light over his cracked body. This black light was spreading out continuously. There was also a glaring hole in his chest.
Gu Qi held onto the hole of his chest while staring forward.
There was currently a figure ahead.
He stood there, though the surrounding space had become quiet and docile. The surrounding world was completely subservient in front of him. Even though the Myriad Ancient Sacred World was created by both Ancestor Sorcerer and the World Ancestor together, with him here, the surrounding world still became subservient to him.
His skin was white and tender. His face was gentle and soft. Even though he did not seem attractive when comparing him with any other handsome male or beautiful girl… his appearances gave off the feeling that he contained part of the primal chaos void supreme law. Seeing his face was akin to observing a supreme law. Even most Cosmos Gods would unknowingly have the feeling of a child looking at their parents.
There was a gentle smile on his face. His eyes seemed sincere too, just like how husband looked into the eyes of his dear wife.
“Sacred Master!” Gu Qi painstakingly opened his mouth. His voice was hoarse, and there was a faint black light pervading by his throat, “For the sake of killing me, you have truly spent a lot of effort.”
“I merely forced you back to the primal chaos.” Sacred Master said warmly and sincerely, “Those who hinder me will be forced back to the primal chaos. Those who comply with me will remain eternally loyal to me. In the future when I control the entire primal chaos void, I’ll similarly call you back again, and you will be loyal to me forever. By then, all living beings in the primal chaos void would be as close as family members. Everything will be peaceful. How good is it?”
Sacred Master walked over and extended his hand. His palm was white and soft. He caressed the throat of Gu Qi: “I do not have any enmity with you, neither do I have any hatred. It’s only because you obstructed me, so I can only temporarily let you return to the primal chaos. Go, it’ll be like a sleep. When I call you back, you will be awakened.”
Gu Qi wanted to retreat, but the black light had already wrapped around his body. His body began solidifying, and even his mouth could no longer move.
“Call me? Just based on you and you wished to control the entire primal chaos void?” Gu Qi controlled the void to let out a sound. His entire skin was gradually transforming into black jade. His eyes glared at Sacred Master regardless.
“Nobody is able to obstruct me. You will see that day coming. By then, you will also be my child.” Sacred Master turned around to the distant.
There was already a figure appearing there.
Ancestor Sorcerer stood there. Many black shackles were surrounding his body. Clearly, he was extremely vigilant as he stared at Sacred Master to the distant.
“Nobody can stop me from doing the things I want to do. You can’t stop me either.” Sacred Master looked at Ancestor Sorcerer, “Those who stop me, even if I might not have the heart the do so, I can only make them return to the primal chaos temporarily.”
Sacred Master chuckled.
He then disappeared from the Myriad Ancient Sacred World just like this as if he had never appeared before.
The expression of Ancestor Sorcerer was ugly. He turned towards Gu Qi who was gradually turning into a black jade sculpture, sighing in a low voice: “Gu Qi, I am unable to protect you.”
The soul of Gu Qi had similarly solidified just like his body. His thinking was moving really slowly.
‘Fortunately, I still have a disciple.’
‘It’s just that disciple, I am not able to meet you in time.’
The thinking of Gu Qi began slower and slower.
And eventually, it completely stopped.
The black jade sculpture no longer moved. It was like a dead object standing there silently and looking afar.
…
Gu Qi was still killed by the Sacred Master.
Ancestor Sorcerer first mentioned this news to Gu Qi’s teacher, ‘Void Primogenitor’. When Void Primogenitor heard the news, he was utterly stunned. He sat there by himself for a long time. In his heart, he felt heartache and self-reproach. He felt heartache because he could not forget those times when he taught Gu Qi, that unfettered disciple of his and also the most outstanding one. Self-reproach because he was too weak and could not protect him. Closely following that, the information naturally spread across all the final realm existences.
Even though Ancestor Sorcerer tried obstructing it, Sacred Master was able to kill another Cosmos God, and this time, he was called ‘Gu Qi’.

chapters.title: Chapter 924 - Death of Gu Qi
chapters.content:
Chapter 924: Death of Gu Qi
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within Blade Emperor City, Xue Ying was still guiding the talented cultivators who visited him.
“Unity realm, as the name implies, is about uniting everything as one, and turning into the ‘one’. This ‘one’ represents the limit, and is just like the point of extremity, the origin! What you need to do now is to walk down to the extreme!” Xue Ying looked at a female cultivator who had scales and a tail. He chuckled, “Do not think about ‘surpassing the extreme’. Your current realm is still too low, so don’t set your sights too far.”
“Seek to reach the extreme limit, and attain the fifth level Star Pagoda strength. Only then are you qualified to learn how to surpass the limits.” Xue Ying explained. He was also gesturing with his hands, “Look at this. Your move can be unleashed more extremely just like this…”
The eyes of this female cultivator brightened as she watched.
She was ranked in the top 100 during the preliminary selections and had never sought Xue Ying’s help before. She felt that it was not worth asking the help of a Unity realm expert. But the performance of Xing Huo Xun Yi made her think twice. It influenced her to ask Xue Ying for help. In the end, she discovered that Xue Ying’s guidance on the ‘slaughter’ aspect might be simple, but it targeted the essence of the Dao. Only those who reached a deep realm could guide others better.
“Dong Bo, come over at once!” A voice sounded by the ears of Xue Ying.
Xue Ying was startled.
Inquisitive Sky Hall Master?
“We will temporarily stop here. I have some matter so you should withdraw for now.” Xue Ying stood up.
“Yes.” The female cultivator did not dare to speak. She obediently acknowledged.
Xue Ying immediately walked out of the cavern-dwelling.
Outside the front entrance of the cavern-dwelling, Xue Ying saw Inquisitive Sky Hall Master. He transmitted: “Go, Forefather asked me to bring you back to the Great Void Heaven Temple. I’ll bring you at this moment.”
“So urgent?” Xue Ying was astonished.
The Star Convention had not ended!
“Go.” In the end, Xue Ying still obediently stood up. He was having an easy time guiding those talented cultivators since there were only a total of 200 who got through. There would only be the occasional one coming to ask him for help.
******
The two of them left Blade Emperor City. Closely following that, Inquisitive Sky Hall Master directly teleported them through an ultra long distance, arriving at Great Void Heaven Temple.
Great Void Heaven Temple.
Within the place where Forefather Tian Yu lived, he summoned Xue Ying in alone.
‘This is truly weird. The Star Convention has yet to end but Forefather is summoning me over?’ Xue Ying felt puzzled. Walking along Forefather Tian Yu’s courtyard, no attendants stopped him and he soon arrived beside a towering tree. The hunchbacked ‘Forefather Tian Yu’ was currently seated cross-legged underneath the tree.
“Forefather.” Xue Ying greeted with a bow.
Forefather Tian Yu looked at Xue Ying. He went taciturn for a moment before stating: “There is a matter which I have to tell you. Your teacher Gu Qi is dead.”
Xue Ying was stunned. He stood at his original position in a daze.
His current mind was ringing.
His teacher Gu Qi was dead?
“This, how did this…” Xue Ying could not help but ask.
“He was killed by Sacred Master. I believe soon later, the higher-ups of every holy ground superpowers would pass down this information.” Forefather Tian Yu said.
Xue Ying was currently feeling complex.
That time when his parents, brother, Uncle Zong and Uncle Tong left the world, he felt agony. When the soul of his wife crumbled and dissipated, he felt the world losing its color. In his heart, Xue Ying’s feelings towards this teacher who he had never truly meet or chatted before were much weaker.
But he still respected this teacher very much.
Strictly speaking, he had only talked to his teacher Gu Qi that time when he received the inheritance in his hometown cosmos. At that time, the incarnation of his teacher was there.
The incomparably huge Cosmos God incarnation had been long-winded then.
“I would never have expected that I, Gu Qi, would actually have a disciple.”
“This feeling of having a disciple is certainly peculiar.”
“This is also my first time accepting a disciple. Hence I do not know how to go about teaching one.”
“Right now, you haven’t even greeted me as your teacher, right? Even though I did not teach you, the “Walker’s Hidden Secret”was created by me. I’ve graced you with the favor of receiving my inheritance, and have even bestowed on you the protection treasure.”
At that time when the incomparably huge Cosmos God incarnation stared at his own disciple.
“Disciple Dong Bo Xue Ying greets Teacher!” Xue Ying had accepted him as teacher formally.
And the colossal incarnation smiled.
As a result…
Xue Yin had an additional teacher on his path of cultivation known as Gu Qi. He had never seen the true body of this teacher before.
And Gu Qi also finally had a disciple. This was also his only one.
Previously when Xue Ying fought with Lei Yan and became famous, his teacher Gu Qi knew of it too. His teacher had even understood through the combat scenes that Xue Ying was cultivating the Imperial Dragon and Vermillion Nightmare inheritance. As a result, he sent over all the external materials required to cultivate these two inheritances.
He had merely left behind a recording then.
“Haha, my Gu Qi’s only disciple is so formidable. I truly wanted to brag about it with several other old men, but it’s a pity that this disciple of mine has to be kept a secret. It isn’t appropriate for me to see you as well in case my trouble is brought onto you. In the future, if we, teacher and disciple should meet, we should have a few drinks. Properly cultivate and never slack off! Alright, I shall not speak much anymore.”
This recording left behind was simple.
Xue Ying had even planned to visit his teacher once he became stronger, and that the secret of him being the disciple of Gu Qi no longer had to be kept. Xue Ying would have a good chat and drink a few cups with his teacher.
…
Xue Ying stood there. He felt pain in his heart. He could feel that his teacher Gu Qi was truly protective and concerned over him, and had even been afraid of implicating Xue Ying, which forced him to keep this teacher-disciple relation a secret.
This world was vast and boundless.
But how many were there who would want to protect him from deep his inner heart like a loved one?
And now, one such person was gone!
“Ai.”
Forefather Tian Yu sighed.
There were only these few Cosmos Gods who had emerged since the primitive Ancient Sacred World era until now. Even though a few had died, the fall of every Cosmos God was a huge affair. Although Forefather Tian Yu might be stronger than Gu Qi, he was still at the third level. The two had been good friends over a long period, and the death of Gu Qi had brought sorrow to him as well.
