“Weng.” Forefather Tian Yu flipped his hand, causing a golden square seal to appear.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “Your teacher knows that he has truly offended Sacred Master. With the personality of the Sacred Master, it was impossible for him to let things go. Even though Gu Qi had thought of ways to survive, it was hard for him to do so once the Sacred Master goes crazy. As a result, he had left behind the treasures he accumulated over at his teacher, Void Primogenitor’s side. Even after he died, he would not want them to end up in Sacred Master’s hands.”
“He has you as his only disciple. Thus, he entrusted for all his treasures to be inherited by you should he die.”
“The Void Primogenitor has sent them over.”
“And now, it belongs to you.” Forefather Tian Yu said.
Xue Ying looked at that golden square seal in the hands of Forefather Tian Yu. He felt even more agony. His teacher Gu Qi clearly treated him as a loved one.
“It should not be…”
Xue Ying shook his head, “It should not be. That time teacher has been escaping with his life, drifting around the primal chaos void. He wasn’t protected by Ancestor Sorcerer, yet he was able to survive from the clutches of Sacred Master by himself for so long! How would he die instead now that he has the help of Ancestor Sorcerer?”

chapters.title: Chapter 925 - The Ancient Sacred Incarnation
chapters.content:
Chapter 925: The Ancient Sacred Incarnation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
He was able to survive after escaping for so long by himself, yet he died under the protection of Ancestor Sorcerer?
“This is the truth.” Forefather Tian Yu softly shook his head, “Ai, your teacher was heavily injured then and was escaping for his life. Sacred Master pursued after your teacher multiple times, yet he failed to kill your teacher. At that time, Sacred Master thought that your teacher would die given how heavy his injuries were. He wasn’t willing to pay too huge a price. Nevertheless, your teacher is a Voidwalker and had a great life force. Thus, he recovered over time.”
“There are a total of three Cosmos Gods belonging to the two great religions, but it was only Sacred Master who could genuinely threaten the life of your teacher. Your teacher wasn’t willing to remain on alert all the time, and that was why he finally asked Ancestor Sorcerer for help.”
Xue Ying was carefully listening.
Of the two great religions, the Ancestor Mother Religion only had a single Cosmos God, ‘Ancestor Mother’. But that was an existence secondary to Sacred Master and could directly fight against him.
The Ancient Sacred Religion had another Cosmos God, ‘Thunder God Master’. Thunder God Master was eternally loyal to the Sacred Master and was also the only one amongst many cultivators to become a Cosmos God. Of course, he was merely at the third level, and his threat to other Cosmos Gods was low.
“At that time when your teacher was fleeing for his life, he had to maintain alert all the time.”
“The moment he felt he was being attacked, he would immediately activate his protective treasure before using an ultra-long distance void teleportation.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “Even though there was a huge gap between his strength and the Sacred Master’s, Cosmos Gods usually had two protective treasures. Those who did not have could ask Ancestor Sorcerer for help to refine it. Hence, it was possible for most Cosmos Gods to withstand for a few instances.”
“He had become a Cosmos God in the Voidwalker lineage, and regarding his control of the void, only Void Primogenitor is better than him. Naturally, it was beyond Sacred Master’s.”
“Thus, your teacher was able to resist against multiple ambushes by Sacred Master before escaping by teleporting through an ultra-long distance. He was considered quite formidable in escaping.”
“But not being able to relax all the time was too tiring.” Forefather Tian Yu sighed.
“He eventually decided to ask Ancestor Sorcerer for help.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “Ancestor Sorcerer is the number one array specialist in the world. He had constructed an array for your teacher, and even if Sacred Master wanted to break through it, he would have to spend a few breaths of time. And the Myriad Ancient Sacred World was created by Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor, which meant that Ancestor Sorcerer could immediately arrive if the array were being attacked. With the help of Ancestor Sorcerer, it was presumed that Sacred Master could no longer kill your teacher.”
“According to this logic, your teacher should be very safe.”
“It’s a pity…”
“That your teacher had greatly offended the Sacred Master. Sacred Master did not mind paying the price, consuming the origin source energy of his ‘Ancient Sacred Incarnation’ to refine an ‘Underworld Jade Pike’. The Underworld Jade Pike could immediately pierce through the array constructed by Ancestor Sorcerer, easily penetrating into the body of your teacher.” Forefather Tian Yu shook his head, “Everything happened in an instance. Even the protective treasure your teacher activated had been pierced, and he died at that time.”
“Ancient Sacred Incarnation, Underworld Jade Pike?” Xue Ying asked.
“These things involve something secretive. Only some Primal Chaos experts know about it. “Forefather Tian Yu said, “You should have heard that Sacred Master started several wars before, but he had to defend his own territory, the ‘Ancient Sacred World’ since Thunder God Master could not defend it by himself. If his true body was fighting outside, who do you reckon is the one defending the Ancient Sacred World?”
Xue Ying was startled.
That’s right.
With the enmity between the three great sacred worlds and the two great religions, if the Ancient Sacred World were not defended by an expert, it would have been exterminated.
“We will be talking about the ancient cultivation technique the Sacred Master has.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “There are strong and weak innate skills amongst ancient cultivators. The innate skill of Sacred Master enables him to turn an incarnation into the core object for the entire religion to believe in. It is able to convert belief energy into primal chaos void origin source energy. The origin source energy is an energy more frightening than the cosmos god energy. Over the long years, he had converted many belief energy to strengthen that incarnation of his. His true body would also become stronger as a result. According to our judgment, that incarnation of his is comparable to the strength of his true body.”
“This incarnation is condensed from a huge amount of origin source energy. It is also the core object of belief for the entire Ancient Sacred Religion, and is known as the Ancient Sacred incarnation by us.”
“The Ancient Sacred incarnation would always be emitting light and illuminating the entire Ancient Sacred World, forcing all beings living in the world to believe in the religion. He has even practically become one with the Ancient Sacred World, becoming stronger inside. We can’t destroy the Ancient Sacred World as a result.”
Xue Ying nodded.
“And the Sacred Master has an extremely formidable move which is to utilize the accumulated origin source energy from the Ancient Sacred incarnation to refine weapons and treasures. Naturally, these weapons and treasures are one-use items. Using them once will consume all origin source energy within.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “The Underworld Jade Pike is also a famous technique. A single Underworld Jade Pike would easily consume 10% to 20% of an Ancient Sacred incarnation. You must know that the Ancient Sacred incarnation must maintain at least half its origin source energy, else its strength would deplete.”
“This 10% to 20% origin source energy has been accumulated by the Sacred Master for a long time.”
“He had no other ways too, and truly hated your teacher to the core. That was why he chose to do this.” Forefather Tian Yu shook his head.
“Why so?” Xue Ying could not help but ask.
Forefather Tian Yu hesitated for a while because this involved too many secrets. He still said vaguely: “This involves too many things. You should know that he has completely destroyed the scheme of Sacred Master. In the past, Sacred Master wasn’t too willing to use his origin source energy, but after the failure of his scheme, he decided to vent his anger by using the Underworld Jade Pike, destroying the array of Ancestor Sorcerer just to kill Gu Qi. Clearly, Sacred Master was no longer that patient anymore.”
“Alright, I’ll not talk about this anymore. This is what your teacher left behind for you. You should keep it well.” Forefather Tian Yu caused the golden seal to fly towards Xue Ying with a thought.
As Xue Ying saw this golden seal coming, he took it and refined it immediately.
As he refined, he heard a voice by his ears.
“Disciple, this time, I should really be dead. You shouldn’t be too sad either. I’d always been hiding in the array constructed by Ancestor Sorcerer, and the Sacred Master would have to pay a huge price just to kill me.”
“And you should remember, you must never think of trying to avenge me or what. With your little strength, the Sacred Master is able to exterminate you with a single puff.”
“I, Gu Qi, only has you as the only disciple. You should properly cultivate and help me gain some respect. Wait until you become a Cosmos God, and when you are at the second level. By then, you can announce to the world that you are the disciple of me, Gu Qi!”
“Before this, you must remember to keep the whole matter about being my disciple a secret.”
His voice dissipated.
Xue Ying held onto the golden seal for a very long time.
‘There will be a day when all cultivators in the five great sacred world and primal chaos void know that I, Dong Bo Xue Ying, is the disciple of Voidwalker Gu Qi!’ Xue Ying declared in his heart, ‘Also, I will definitely avenge you. I understand that my current strength is weak, but there will be a day I become strong, and that will be the day that I fight against the Sacred Master.’
He checked through the golden seal.
The golden seal was originally a cosmos-graded Eden treasure. There were many precious materials placed within. After all, these were treasures left behind by a Cosmos God. Even though Gu Qi was a third level Cosmos God, and was weaker regarding strength and foundation as compared to Forefather Tian Yu and Void Primogenitor, his treasures still added up to a total of 360,000 Origin World Rocks according to Xue Ying’s judgment.
That was a genuinely frightening figure.
“Forefather.” Xue Ying waved his hand, causing a glossy black stone and a fiery-red armor to fly out. The glossy black stone was the size of a palm. Its appearance caused the surrounding space to collapse immediately. At the same time, the scale of the collapse was still extending in all directions. Xue Ying immediately controlled his law domain to suppress the power emitted by this piece of stone.
And after the fiery-red armor appeared, Xue Ying extended his hands to catch it. This armor seemed ordinary, but it was cumbersome. With Xue Ying’s strength as a Voidwalker and someone who cultivated the Imperial Dragon inheritance, his arms were shaking after grabbing it. If this armor were any heavier, he would likely not be able to hold it.
“These two treasures are the most precious ones. I do wish for Forefather to help me keep them. If I, Dong Bo Xue Ying, were to lose my life carelessly, I do not wish to let my enemies get these treasures.” Xue Ying said. These items were what Cosmos Gods used. It was pointless for him to bring them along.
“Alright.”
Forefather Tian Yu nodded, “How about this, I’ll help you keep these. These two items are worth about 300,000 Origin World Rocks. In the future when you purchase treasures that are too expensive, and it isn’t appropriate for you to be present, you can directly approach me to purchase it. These will be pawned for 300,000 Origin World Rocks.”
“Many thanks Forefather.” Xue Ying immediately answered.
…
That day.
Inquisitive Sky Hall Master brought Xue Ying back to the Blade Emperor City. Being a teacher of the convention, he still had a responsibility to fulfill.
Within Blade Emperor City.
There were many cavern-dwellings. These were places where Blade Emperor City reserved especially for the important guests to stay at. Primal Chaos giants usually lived around this place too. Xue Ying also stayed here.
When Xue Ying returned with Inquisitive Sky Hall Master.
“Inquisitive Sky Hall Master, Elder Dong Bo, quickly come over.”
There were three Primal Chaos giants currently drinking on top of a small mountain peak. As they saw Xue Ying and Inquisitive Sky Hall Master flying over, they immediately called them over. Xue Ying and Inquisitive Sky Hall Master naturally could not treat it like they saw nothing, and descended over.
“Inquisitive Sky Hall Master, have you heard about it? There was a huge matter which happened earlier on. Senior Voidwalker Gu Qi is dead. He is killed by Sacred Master.”
“What? Senior Gu Qi is dead?” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master was shocked. Even though he brought Xue Ying back, he did not know about this matter.
“Senior Gu Qi was protected by Ancestor Sorcerer in the Myriad Ancient Sacred World. Why would he die?”
“I do not know about many things now. I just heard of Senior Gu Qi being killed. As for how Sacred Master killed him, I am unsure as of now. He should have paid a huge price.”
Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and these three Primal Chaos giants were discussing amongst each other.
They were making all sorts of guesses.
Xue Ying stood by the side without intervening. He only listened on silently. The four Primal Chaos giants did not really mind about it since they felt that Xue Ying who was at the Unity realm and had cultivated for a short period understood too little about battles between the final realm existences.
But what they did not know…
Was that this Xue Ying who stood beside them was the only disciple of Gu Qi.

chapters.title: Chapter 926 - The Black Flower Bud
chapters.content:
Chapter 926: The Black Flower Bud
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Gu Qi was a Cosmos God with a high status across the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void. His fall had greatly startled these Primal Chaos existences.
They had even gotten a sniff of the incoming ‘war’.
“Senior Gu Qi is a Voidwalker. He is extremely good at escaping, yet he is still killed. The Sacred Master is so crazy. Do you think he is going to start another war?”
“The boundary of the void is constantly forming Destruction Devils. Others have already said that our primal chaos void is getting closer to destruction. Is the patience of Sacred Master also waning?”
“This madman! Everything is being stirred up by him!”
The four Primal Chaos giants including Inquisitive Sky Hall Master were chatting. As they mentioned the Sacred Master, they would grit their teeth.
Even though there were several huge devils other than Sacred Master like Ancestor Mother, the threat from the other devils was limited. ‘Sacred Master’ was affirmed to be at the first level of Cosmos God realm. He surpassed all other Cosmos Gods! If the three great sacred worlds were not united in their resistance, the entire primal chaos void might possibly be conquered by Sacred Master already.
A very long time ago, during the era of the primitive Ancient Sacred World, the Sacred Master had instigated several wars. He had almost conquered the entire primitive Ancient Sacred World. But in the end, the primitive Ancient Sacred World shattered from the war. Even though many Cosmos Gods had fallen, Sacred Master remained standing at the peak.
“Not just in the era of primitive Ancient Sacred World or the primal chaos void era, even though he, Sacred Master, has instigated many wars before, he still failed all the time. Clearly, we still have the upper hand in terms of overall strength.”
As they discussed.
Inquisitive Sky Hall Master turned towards Xue Ying by the side: “Dong Bo, you should return first. Who would have thought that I will hear such worrying news after returning to the Blade Emperor City.”
The other three Primal Chaos experts also said:
“Elder Dong Bo, you should return first and have a rest.”
“You shouldn’t worry too much since any Cosmos Gods have reached the final realm in a certain aspect. Even if the Sacred Master wanted to kill any of them, it isn’t easy to do so.”
“If the sky collapses, the Cosmos Gods would naturally be the ones to react and deal against it.”
In their eyes, Xue Ying was ultimately still at the Unity realm. Furthermore, he had cultivated only for a short while, and should barely understand battles happening at the highest level. As such, they mentioned a few consoling words to him. It was different for the Primal CHaos existences though since they were the closest bunch of cultivators to the Cosmos God realm. They knew many secrets at the highest level.
“Fellow cultivators, I’ll first return then.” Xue Ying immediately left, leaving behind the four Primal Chaos giants to continue their discussion.
“Sou.”
Arcing through the sky, Xue Ying soon flew down into his cavern-dwelling.
The two protectors by the entrance of the cavern-dwelling saw Xue Ying landing. They immediately bowed and greeted: “Elder.”
“Mn.”
Xue Ying calmly entered the cavern-dwelling.
“It seems that elder is behaving differently? Is he not feeling well?” The two protectors looked towards each other, muttering inwardly.
Xue Ying entered the cavern-dwelling. On the way, many of the female attendants bowed and greeted him.
“Elder.” A female attendant immediately stopped and greeted when she saw Xue Ying from afar.
“I will be entering closed-door cultivation for a few days. If there aren’t any issues, don’t disturb me.” Xue Ying coldly ordered.
“Yes.” The female attendant acknowledged.
Xue Ying turned around and entered the cultivation room by the side.
…
“Hong long long.” The cultivation room was shut close. An incense was lighted, causing its fragrance to diffuse in the room.
Xue Ying waved his hand, causing a silvery-silk praying mat to appear by the side. He then sat on top of it. An unseen chill washed through his body from the praying mat, and the lighted incense in the cultivation room calmed him slightly.
“Hu.” Xue Ying let out a long breath.
Extending his left hand, a golden seal appeared. As Xue Ying looked at this golden seal, a concentrated killing intent began gathering on his forehead.
‘What a joke.’
‘So what if I am frustrated. In front of Sacred Master, I am currently only an ant.’ Xue Ying kept the golden seal. He was trying his best to calm his heart. With his current cultivation heart realm, Xue Ying could not easily dissipate this intense anger and killing intent he was feeling. He had to force it down and gradually regain his calmness.
Suppress, and suppress even more! He was crushing the anger deep in his heart since this matter about avenging his teacher would be destined to happen far in the future.
‘Teacher, I am your only disciple. How can I not avenge you?’ Xue Ying thought.
His grand-teacher, ‘Void Primogenitor’ was likely infuriated too. But Void Primogenitor was ultimately only at the third level Cosmos God realm, and could barely survive! Without reaching the second level strength… it was impossible to fight directly against the Sacred Master.
‘The journey is far. I have to walk step by step.’
Xue Ying was becoming calmer and calmer.
And then, he began cultivating. Gu Qi’s death made Xue Ying understand that he must not slack. Even though there were only 10,000 years to the end of the Star Convention, and he was prepared to reserve the final few hundred years to guide the cultivation of the junior cultivators, Xue Ying chose to fully concentrate on his cultivation during this period! He did not hesitate to pour all his concentration into comprehending the killing move that fused both ‘Dao of Mirage’ and ‘Dao of Slaughter’ together. He had to step into the seventh level Star Pagoda strength.
To fight on equal grounds with Sacred Master and threaten him, Xue Ying had to be more ruthless to himself.
Even though his Dao of Mirage was extremely close to breaking through to the ‘Primal Chaos realm’, and Xue Ying would likely comprehend it after spending a little more time, he still desired to step into the seventh level at the Unity realm. It would definitely be beneficial for him to temper his own comprehension ability and other aspects before entering the Primal Chaos realm. This would significantly increase his chances of breaking through to the Cosmos God realm in the future.
His target was not just the Primal Chaos realm, but the final realm-the Cosmos God realm! Only then would he be able to threaten the existence of the Sacred Master. Naturally, ‘grasping the supreme law’, was the true final destination for the laws and profound mysteries system. But that was too unreal, and Xue Ying only remembered it deep in his heart. He dared not to overthink about it for now.
It was better for him to walk along the path underneath his feet. Maybe when he reached the Cosmos God realm, by then, he would understand the supreme law better.
“Hong~”
Xue Ying sat cross-legged. He was pouring all his attention to researching this absolute move.
Just the Dao of Mirage alone and the Dao of Slaughter alone had reached the limit of the sixth level Star Pagoda strength. Only by fusing both together could he increase their power further.
‘Mn, it is different from the path taken by Dark World Master.’
‘I should proceed according to my own comprehension method. I should divide the destructive slaughter into three.’
All sorts of ideas were popping in the mind of Xue Ying.
He had already researched this move to a very high realm, and was just slightly lacking before reaching true perfection! Just like ‘Sky Punishment Edge’, if not for reaching the ‘My Heart as the World’ heart realm, it was impossible for Xue Ying to unleash this move. The same logic, to create a heaven-defying technique at the seventh level strength at the Unity realm, even though he had researched everything and accumulated enough experiences, Xue Ying had to reach absolute perfection stage before this technique could be unleashed. Not even a strand of imperfection could exist!
‘Maybe it should be like this.’
Xue Ying tried once again. At this moment, the killing intent suppressed deep in his heart made him alter this move by a bit, making the slaughter aspect more dominating, and making the whole technique more reserved.
It was like a peerless artist who was able to draw a famous piece of art under a particular heart realm.
The current heart realm of Xue Ying made him alter this move by a bit, but it was this bit that enabled the technique to reach an entirely new stage-an absolute perfection stage. Creating such world-dominating techniques, other than having sufficient comprehension ability and accumulation of experiences, sometimes, what one required was an opportunity! Clearly, the current heart realm Xue Ying had, even though he was suppressing his killing intent deep in his heart and was remarkably calm while cultivating…
It was this state of heart that enabled him to perfect fusing this move.
“Hua!”
The illusory world appeared unreal and real at the same time. At the center of this illusory world, there was a black flower bud. It seemed tender with three leaves. The leaves were still filled with dew drops. When Xue Ying constructed the illusory world to produce this black flower bud, this flower bud did not collapse. Instead, it was able to form an ineffable natural concept.
Even though it had yet to turn real from illusion, just being produced in the illusory realm caused unseen laws to spread and spill over into reality.
In the cultivation room, the original operating laws of the sacred world were forced to retreat in front of it.
It was similar to how Cosmos Gods could unleash moves that could destroy sacred worlds. Even though Primal Chaos giants could not do so at their realm, it sufficed to cause part of the sacred world laws to retreat in a small region! In this region, I am the master. All laws of the sacred world would have to withdraw from it. And clearly, this ‘black flower bud’ had reached this stage of extent.
‘Descend into reality.’ Xue Ying’s eyes brightened.
The black flower bud turned real from illusion. Furthermore, under the control of Xue Ying, it was devouring the world energy slowly. After all, he was just testing this technique and wasn’t using it for a battle. During a battle, he would simply force the flower bud to absorb energy at a faster rate. Nevertheless, this would form a strong and violent vortex around his cavern-dwelling, which was uncalled for currently.
As it gradually absorbed the world energy, it became more and more real. Its three leaves, the surface of the flower bud and the rolling dewdrops on the leaves became very real. Furthermore, the surrounding temperature rapidly dropped. Within moments, the temperature had dropped to a stage that would make others tremble. This temperature was enough to freeze ordinary Unity realm experts to death. Cold, an absolute coldness…
This was merely it descending into reality. Xue Ying had yet to unleash the slightest of its true power.

chapters.title: Chapter 927 - Accepting Teacher?
chapters.content:
Chapter 927: Accepting Teacher?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The black flower bud was fully formed after ten breaths of time.
The temperature inside the whole room dropped to an unfathomable stage. But other than that, nothing happened! The black flower bud suspended in mid-air, and it seemed that there it had no other power other than being frigid. Even though a Unity realm expert could resist this cold when facing the black flower bud even, they would tremble in fear uncontrollably due to the threat inherent within.
‘It’s finally done.’ Xue Ying walked up to the floating black flower bud and looked at the three leaves on it. There was some dew on the leaves which gave off the feeling of ‘beauty’ in the laws and profound mysteries system.
“Perfect fusion between slaughter and mirage. They blend together perfectly.” Xue Ying muttered.
“Bloom! Destruction Flower!”
There was some kind of expectation in Xue Ying’s eyes as he stared at the black flower bud in front of him.
Finally, the flower bud bloomed. A flower would be the most beautiful when it was blooming. As it bloomed, the three leaves and three back petals began collapsing, turning into a black fog that rotated and converged into its center. Every single leaf and petal converged into a strand of black fog. Three strands of black fog revolved about the center, cutting and destroying everything including the void. Everything in its surrounding was annihilated.
It seemed ordinary, though it was because its power was reserved. Someone located at the center of the fog would feel the might of this flower.
‘Great destruction.’ As Xue Ying looked at it, some thread of obssession started forming in his eyes. Only when he fully understood and comprehended this technique did he finally know how beautiful it was!
“Unexpectedly, even I could create such a technique.” Xue Ying murmured to himself.
The shock was more prominent since this technique had been created by him. Xue Ying never thought he could create something this beautiful. Both the Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Mirage had reached their pinnacle, and this fusion brought it to a new peak.
Like the “13 Apocalyptic Swords”, in its ultimate stage, someone at the Unity realm could triumph through the sixth level Star Pagoda. Of course, this technique was created by Forefather Tian Yu using only the Dao of Slaughter. But even for Forefather Tian Yu, it was difficult for him to make another absolute art that could enable someone at the Unity realm to pass through the seventh level Star Pagoda. Evidently, Forefather Tian Yu had no plans of spending so much effort on this matter.
Moreover, a Unity realm expert had inferior soul strength and deduction ability compared to a Cosmos God. Other than one’s capability, it required luck to create an art that enabled someone at the Unity realm to pass through the seventh level Star Pagoda.
Yes, luck. For Xue Ying to create this technique, it was somewhat because he had luck.
It was all thanks to the ‘Stone Mirror’. This strange treasure was able to deduce some kind of fusion from “Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance” and “Imperial Dragon Inheritance”, giving form to this evil flower. It provided Xue Ying with a direction and guidance. Other than that, the death of his teacher, Gu Qi, also affected his mood and became the trigger for him to create this technique. Nevertheless, Xue Ying would rather choose for his teacher to remain alive than to craft this technique. He had hoped to visit his teacher one day, paying his respect and accompany Gu Qi to drink and chat.
‘Seventh level Star Pagoda, in the entire history of the two sacred worlds, there had only been two people who reached this stage.’ Xue Ying sighed.
Although he had luck, Xue Ying still had to accumulate more experience!
He needed to accumulate enough so as to let his realm reach the peak of sixth level Star Pagoda. In addition, it was because of luck and some miraculous encounter that enabled him to reach this step too.
When he finally reached this step, Xue Ying felt an unprecedented sense of achievement, and he could appreciate the ‘beauty’ of the laws and profound mysteries better. Improvement in comprehension ability was just like this-the creation of this technique had transformed him qualitatively. In the future, Xue Ying would also pursue this kind of ‘beauty’ whenever he sought to create a new move, something that had attained perfection.
As he had once experienced it, Xue Ying would know what to look out for in the future! That was why it would be easy for him to reach the eighth level when he broke through to the Primal Chaos realm. After that, it was highly possible for Xue Ying to reach the ninth level once he accumulated enough foundation and experience.
‘This flower, let’s call it the Destruction Flower.’ Xue Ying thought.
An absolute art he created.
In total, Xue Ying had created two absolute arts-one that was purely geared towards the Dao of Mirage,”Mirage”, and another that was the fusion between the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter, “Destruction Flower”. He believed that when he reached the Primal Chaos Realm, alongside with the improvement in both the Dao of slaughter and Dao of Mirage, the absolute art ‘Destruction Flower’ would be improved further, allowing Xue Ying to reach the eighth level easily.
That was the gap.
Even for Ancestor Devil who had long reached the Primal Chaos realm, he could only barely reach the eighth level with his six great incarnations. As for Heaven Weeping Sect Master, he could only reach the peak of seventh level.
Xue Ying merely needed to make a breakthrough to get through the eighth level, and even reaching the peak after accumulating enough experience! That was the reason why Xue Ying strived so hard to reach the seventh level at the Unity realm.
‘I need to spend some time in deducing the fourth style of “Mirage”.” Xue Ying thought. Similar to the Sky Punishment Edge, the fourth style of the Mirage would be a sixth level technique. What differed between the two was that the Mirage would have a greater restraining ability! It was hard to create a technique that could restrain using other Daos, but not for the Dao of Mirage as it was primarily a world in itself, so it would be good at restraining or hindering others.
The reason why Xue Ying had not accomplished this was that he had been placing his focus in the fusion of both Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter previously. When he created the Destruction Flower, this technique contained some restraining power too. Hence, it would be easy for him to deduce another move using just the Dao of Mirage that reached the sixth level in strength.
******
During this period when Xue Ying underwent closed-door cultivation, all of the other talented cultivators were rejected without exception.
‘I never thought it would be this hard to get guidance from Elder Dong Bo.’ Some of the talented cultivators sighed inwardly.
Previously, General Hatchet Palace Master, Violet Slaughter Island Master, General Heaven Light, and Five Luster Serpent Ancestor also did as they pleased. Whenever they wanted to meet their friends or enter closed-door cultivation, they would simply reject all guests. It was an excellent opportunity for any talented cultivators if they could receive guidance from them. Xue Ying was too welcoming previously, though right now after experiencing the death of Gu Qi, he decided to place more importance on himself and less on others. Ultimately, what was fundamental would be his own strength. As for guiding others? He could do it in the passing.
At this moment, nobody in the five great Sacred Worlds knew that yet another Unity expert who had reached the seventh level strength had emerged in this generation.
…
Blade Emperor City, within Monarch Xing Huo’s allocated residence, Xing Huo Xun Yi was also residing here.
“Greetings to both Heart Imitation Religious Master and General Heaven Light.” Xing Huo Xun Yi obediently paid his respect.
“You don’t have to be so polite.” Heart Imitation Religious Master chuckled.
After that, Xing Huo Xun Yi retreated and stood behind his father quietly.
Monarch Xing Huo, Heart Imitation Religious Master, and General Heaven Light were all seated before a long table each. Monarch Xing Huo personally waved his hand and offered wine jars to them. Many female attendants also came to serve famous dishes from Blade Emperor City.
Both parties drank and chatted. They chatted about many topics before eventually arriving at the death of Gu Qi.
When the wine was nearly finished and the sky became dark, only then did Heart Imitation Religious Master mentioned about his intention for coming, “Brother Xing Huo, Heaven Light and I came today for your son. My Blade Emperor City is impressed at his great talent. In this short period of the Star Convention, his strength had improved by leaps and bounds. I think he is suited to become a disciple of my Blade Emperor City.”
The top ten participants of the Star Convention could freely choose between the six holy grounds.
But the six holy grounds would not be passively waiting for the participants to choose them either. They would take the initiative to invite those with bright potential. In their view, Xing Huo Xun Yi had the highest potential amongst all participants in this Star Convention! He could improve so drastically over a short period, reaching the first rank during the decisive battle. As time passed, they believed that Xun Yi would have another drastic improvement. Although Cang Qiong Tian Yun had similar power too, he was at the fourth level at the beginning of Star Convention already and did not have any great improvement over time.
Of course, General Heaven Light would naturally invite Cang Qiong Tian Yun as well, though Heart Imitation Religious Master would not be coming along.
Heart Imitation Religious Master only came personally this time Xing Huo Xun Yi!
“Xun Yi, what do you think?” Monarch Xing Huo looked at his son.
“I have no plans of joining the Blade Emperor City.” Xing Huo Xun Yi replied directly.
Monarch Xing Huo could not help but lose his smile.
This son of his…
If it was a loose cultivator, they would respond with a ‘Let me think about it before deciding’ if they planned on rejecting. They would never outright reject the other party like what Xing Huo Xun Yi did. After all Heart Imitation Religious Master and one of the teacher of the convention, General Heaven Light, came personally to invite them. It was ugly for the other party to be rejected so directly too, and being tactful was something Heart Imitation Religious Master and the others could understand.
After this short and direct reply of his, Xing Huo Xun Yi went standing beside his father obediently. With Monarch Xing Huo as his father, Xun Yi was accustomed to such ‘straightforwardness’.
“Hahahaha.” Heart Imitation Religious Master shook his head, “There is no holy ground more powerful than our Blade Emperor City out of the six great holy grounds regarding strength and foundation. If you are not planning to join my Blade Emperor City, which holy ground are you planning to go?”
“Great Void Heaven Temple!” Xing Huo Xun Yi answered without any hesitation.
General Heaven Light sneered by the side, “Great Void Heaven Temple? Little brat, you’re too young. Even though both the Primogenitor Island and Jade Light Sacred Territory contain an existence at the second level, our Blade Emperor city is the holy ground with the deepest foundation. We are also the strongest one out of the six holy grounds. If we talk about power, Great Void Heaven Temple is ranked merely fourth out of the six holy grounds. If Luo City Lord was willing to accept disciples and was willing to expand their power and influence, the Great Void Heaven Temple would be relinquished to the fifth rank.”
“Luo City Lord is an enigma at the Primal Chaos realm. It is a pity that he hasn’t accepted any disciples. The Star City also has the least experts across the six great holy grounds. Those who join them will not receive personal guidance from Luo City Lord, so it would be better to join other holy grounds.”
“I plan to join the Great Void Heaven Temple and accept Elder Dong Bo as my teacher.” Xing Huo Xun Yi said.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying?” Heart Imitation Religious Master had some understanding, “Because of the Dao of Mirage?”
“Yes.”
Xing Huo Xun Yi nodded, “I wish to pursue the Dao of Mirage and illusory realm.”
“Haha.” General Heaven Light laughed, “If it’s like this, then there’s no need for you to join them. All six great holy grounds have foundation scriptures about it. As for the Great Void Heaven Temple, they do not have any Primal Chaos realm expert in the Dao of Mirage to this date! Their foundation scriptures are the more common ones, and what they have is what we have. Everything will be made available for you. Right now, you are already at the fourth level strength. With some effort, it’ll be easy for you to reach the fifth level. By then, there will no longer be any huge difference between you and Dong Bo Xue Ying. Is there a need to become his disciple then? It is also possible for you to break through to the Primal Chaos realm while he is still at the sixth level.”
“If you are joining the Great Void Heaven Temple just for Dong Bo Xue Ying, then there’s no point.” Heart Imitation Religious Master, “One has to depend on yourself during the path of cultivation! Your gap with him isn’t that great. Thus, why not study by yourself? You will be able to walk further.”
“As for Dong Bo Xue Ying, he is indeed an outstanding cultivator, but what Heaven Light said is also true. He is still lingering at the sixth level and has no indication of improving further. This is normal, so there’s no need for you to take him as your teacher. If you are willing, I can accept you as my disciple.” Heart Imitation Religious Master chuckled.
When Monarch Xing Huo heard that, he became stunned.
The disciple of Heart Imitation Religious Master?
He was someone who had passed through the seventh level Star Pagoda at the Unity realm. Now the other party was an existence at the ninth level. Even though he did not cultivate the Dao of Mirage, his experience was sufficient to guide his son.
“What do you think?” Heart Imitation Religious Master looked at Xing Huo Xun Yi. That was the reason why he came personally.
“Many thanks, senior for your kind intention, but I have already decided to take Elder Dong Bo as my teacher.” Xing Huo Xun Yi shook his head. His eyes were filled with firm determination.
This rejection shocked Heart Imitation Religious Master.

chapters.title: Chapter 928 - Exiting Closed-Door Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 928: Exiting Closed-Door Cultivation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Heart Imitation Religious Master fancied Xing Huo Xun Yi, not because of his background, but because of his great improvement during the Star Convention. He thus incurred the curiosity of Heart Imitation Religious Master who did not believe that Xue Ying was the one to ‘dig his potential’; he believed there should be some other particular reasons.
For instance, ‘heart devil’, or ‘heart calamity’.
It was impossible for Xing Huo Xun Yi with his enormous talent and background to be in low spirits for so long. Heart Imitation Religious Master was sure that there must be some particular reasons, and it was highly possible that the affair was something related to the heart.
‘He has reached the Unity realm, yet he suffered from a huge setback in his heart realm?’ Heart Imitation Religious Master was looking forward to it, ‘He might be suited to learn the Heart Imitation technique that I created.’
That time Heart Imitation Religious Master was similarly a supreme talent. He was one of the two Unity realm experts who reached the seventh level Star Pagoda in the history of the two great sacred worlds. The technique he created directly targeted one’s soul. Hence, it was required for the cultivator to suffer from more setbacks in his ‘heart realm’. Every time the cultivator rose from his setbacks, his heart realm would become stronger. That was why he favored upon Xing Huo Xun Yi!
“Haha, you should properly think over it. You can always join my sect anytime before the end of Star Convention.” Heart Imitation Religious Master stood up. General Heaven Light similarly stood up as well.
Monarch Xing Huo stood and said: “Brother Heart Imitation, this brat Xun Yi is a little prejudiced, so I do hope that you will not overthink.”
“Cultivation is also about cultivating the heart. It is good to be dedicated too.” Heart Imitation Religious Master smiled nonchalantly. He was quite open about things. He felt that this was a good seedling, but if the other party weren’t too willing to accept him as a teacher, he would not force the other party! After all, in the eyes of such peerless experts, disciples were only inheritors of their absolute arts. It was the fortune of disciples for them to obtain his inheritance.
If they couldn’t, then it was because the juniors did not have such a fortune!
“Xing Huo Xun Yi.” General Heaven Light instead snorted coldly, “You should properly think things through. It is rare for Heart Imitation Religious Master to accept disciples. If you don’t take Heart Imitation Religious Master as a teacher, and decided to take what Dong Bo Xue Ying as your teacher, it’ll be too late for you to regret if he were to get stuck at the Unity realm forever.”
Xing Huo Xun Yi became silent.
“Hmph.”
General Heaven Light followed behind Heart Imitation Religious Master and left the place.
Very soon.
Within the courtyard, Monarch Xing Huo and his son Xing Huo Xun Yi returned.
“You sit down.” Monarch Xing Huo sat there and poured wine for himself. There was a rare smile on his face.
“Father.” Xing Huo Xun Yi obediently sat by the side.
“I would never have thought that there is a day that my son would make Heart Imitation Religious Master take the initiative to take you as his disciple.” Monarch Xing Huo said, “I am quite pleased with how determined you are. But I have to tell you, Heart Imitation is someone really talented and heaven-defying. The ‘Heart Imitation lineage’ he created belongs to the more unique kind of cultivation system.”
“Unique cultivation system?” Xing Huo Xun Yi felt puzzled.
Other than the ancient cultivation system, laws and profound mysteries system, strongest warrior system, hex cultivation system, Ancestor Mother cultivation system, devour-class system, and other commonly seen ones, there were still a few cultivators like the Voidwalkers. There were even some systems where the number of cultivators training in them in the entire primal chaos void could be counted with one’s fingers.
The more unique the system, the harder it would be to succeed in training it.
“Mn, his Heart Imitation lineage is considered a unique system. According to my understanding, there are only two cultivators in the entire primal chaos void training in this system-he and his disciple ‘Great Emperor Nine Dragon’.” Monarch Xing Huo said.
Xing Huo Xun Yi was stunned after hearing that.
Great Emperor Nine Dragon? He was a famous expert in the Blade Emperor City, and was an existence at the peak of eighth level!
“This lineage directly cultivates the soul.” Monarch Xing Huo said, “That is why it is so difficult to cultivate it. Those who succeeded can jump right to the Primal Chaos realm. Like Heart Imitation Religious Master and Great Emperor Nine Dragon, they have a bunch of disciples under them, yet none were able to succeed. For Heart Imitation Religious Master to be willing to take you as a disciple, it should be because he feels you have the potential of succeeding.”
“From my opinion, you should try joining his sect and attempt cultivating the Heart Imitation lineage. At the same time, you can cultivate the Dao of Mirage. It might be better for you.” Monarch Xing Huo looked at his son. The Blade Emperor City was ultimately the leader of the six great holy grounds. If any war occurred, the Blade Emperor City was much safer than the Great Void Heaven Temple.
“I am still adamant about joining the sect under Elder Dong Bo.” Xing Huo Xun Yi said.
“Why?” Monarch Xing Huo felt puzzled.
“In this life of mine, I have decided on this Dao of Mirage! And Elder Dong Bo is the best teacher for me if I am walking down this path.” Xing Huo Xun Yi said.
…
It wasn’t just the Blade Emperor City who invited him to join their holy ground, even Jade Light Sacred Territory and Primogenitor Island sent people over to invite him too. Naturally, they were rejected.
“What? Heart Imitation Religious Master came personally to take him in as a disciple, yet he rejected him?”
“He wants to take Dong Bo Xue Ying as his teacher?”
Everyone who came was rejected. This news naturally spread across the Primal Chaos giants who participated in the convention. When General Heaven Light and the other Primal Chaos existences were together, he had even asserted: “Hmph, that brat isn’t willing to take on Heart Imitation Religious Master as his teacher, yet he wants to take a Unity realm cultivator as a teacher? Is that not a joke?”
The Primal Chaos giants recognized that Xing Huo Xun Yi’s nature was quite resolute, yet the majority felt that it was quite hilarious.
That was Heart Imitation Religious Master!
Only after stepping into the Primal Chaos realm would one understand how frightening Heart Imitation Religious Master was. He was someone who created an entirely new cultivation system and was someone who could fight against Cosmos Gods directly before elegantly retreating.
Some had even taken the initiative to persuade Monarch Xing Huo when they met him. Nevertheless, Monarch Xing Huo merely shook his head with a smile: “He is resolute, and it is pointless trying to persuade him. I shall let him be.”
******
Within the cultivation room.
Xue Ying was seated cross-legged over here. The law domain enveloped the entire cultivation room. The current him had long re-constructed his law domain using the newly created move, ‘Destruction Flower’. Its power was naturally extraordinary. The law domains of some Primal Chaos giants might not even be able to stand up to Xue Ying’s. The laws of the sacred world were utterly forced out of this cultivation room.
“Hu.”
Gradually, Xue Ying opened his eyes.
He had already created the fourth style of his absolute art “Mirage”, called ‘Frost Underworld’. Because it was close to the end of the Star Convention, he was not in a hurry to break through. Even though he understood that he would be able to break through after a short period of studying into the Primal Chaos realm, he still had to consolidate his foundations after breaking through. He had to perfect the ancient cultivation inheritance, absolute arts, and other aspects. And this period was something he did not have.
Instead, he spent more time delving into the ‘Voidwalker system’ and Plate Ripple Diagram.
‘It is only 300 years before the end of Star Convention. Time for me to exit.’ Xue Ying stood up, ‘And when the convention ends, I’ll break through to the Primal Chaos realm after returning to the Great Void Heaven Temple.’
“Hong long long~”
The cultivation room doors were opened, and Xue Ying left the place.
“Elder.” There would always be a female attendant waiting for him outside the cultivation room.
“If any cultivators are coming to see me, bring them over.” Xue Ying said. He came out 300 years before the end of the convention to give those talented cultivators preparation.
“Yes.” The female attendant responded.
Xue Ying also informed Inquisitive Sky Hall Master that he is currently out.
“You are finally out? Do you know that many holy grounds have taken the initiative to invite that Xing Huo Xun Yi? Even Heart Imitation Religious Master took the initiative to take him as a disciple, but it’s a pity that everything is useless!” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master transmitted over, “He has resolved to only take you as his teacher. Several other Primal Chaos giants went to visit Monarch Xing Huo, telling him to persuade that brat, though it is futile.”
“Ah?”
Xue Ying was startled.
Many cultivators wished to become a disciple of Heart Imitation Religious Master.
‘This brat. He is quite resolute and crazy about the Dao of Mirage. Furthermore, he is quite talented too.’ Xue Ying chuckled, ‘And is a good disciple nonetheless.’
Xue Ying immediately went out of his cavern-dwelling and headed to the cavern-dwelling of Monarch Xing Huo.
…
Within the courtyard of Monarch Xing Huo’s cavern-dwelling.
“Elder Dong Bo, it is rare for you to come over to my place.” Monarch Xing Huo chuckled before sitting down. By the side, Xing Huo Xun Yi looked at Xue Ying with his eyes brightening.
“Previously, I have been in closed-door cultivation. Only after I left did I find out what has happened.” Xue Ying looked towards Xing Huo Xun Yi by the side, “Xing Huo Xun Yi is quite talented as well. Since the other holy grounds have taken the initiative to invite him, I came this time to also invite Xing Huo Xun Yi to my Great Void Heaven Temple. If he is willing, he can become my disciple too.”
Xing Huo Xun Yi immediately went forward and knelt down respectfully: “Disciple greets teacher.” He then kowtowed three times.
“Good.” Xue Ying chuckled and nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 929 - Public Dao Lecture
chapters.content:
Chapter 929: Public Dao Lecture
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
If he did not accept him as disciple directly after exiting from closed-door cultivation, Xing Huo Xun Yi would likely take the initiative to come and request for him to be his teacher once news spread! By then, things would be awkward since other holy grounds had taken action to invite him. Even Heart Imitation Religious Master had gone personally to ask Xing Huo Xun Yi if he wanted to become his disciple. If Xue Ying were to wait like a boss for Xing Huo Xun Yi to run over to his place, then would this not be slapping the faces of Heart Imitation Religious Master and the others?
He had to come over just like other holy grounds so that nobody would babble about Xing Huo Xun Yi’s decision of joining the Great Void Heaven Temple.
“Xun Yi this brat is too rude and impetuous. He has given you a hard time, Elder Dong Bo.” Monarch Xing Huo said.
“It is a minor matter.” Xue Ying was quite casual about it. He then began asking Xing Huo Xun Yi about his cultivation these few years. Both teacher and disciple started discussing the Dao of Mirage.
Monarch Xing Huo was inwardly startled as he watched from the side.
If it were any other Unity cultivators, they would not dare accept Xing Huo Xun Yi as a disciple after he had rejected Heart Imitation Religious Master. But Xue Ying had calmly received him. He wasn’t excited or nervous. Instead, he treated it like an ordinary matter.
For him to be so calm, there were two reasons. One, he was madly suppressing his arrogance in his heart or two, he had the qualifications to do so!
‘This Elder Dong Bo doesn’t seem like someone arrogant. Then it should be because he has the confidence. Is he already confident of stepping into the Primal Chaos realm?’ Monarch Xing Huo made his guesses, ‘If he could break through to the Primal Chaos realm in such a short period, that’ll be amazing. How long has he cultivated for?’
But what he did not know was that Xue Ying had reached the seventh level Star Pagoda strength at the Unity realm. As a result, he had no difficulty of entering the Primal Chaos realm. Not long later, Xue Ying would reach the peak amongst those at the Primal Chaos realm. Even though he was still weaker than ninth level cultivators like Monarch Xing Huo and the others, the gap would not be too big.
******
Xue Ying took the initiative to accept Xing Huo Xun Yi as a disciple, and Xing Huo Xun Yi had agreed to join the Great Void Heaven Temple, taking Xue Ying as his teacher. This news had spread out as well.
“He has really become the disciple of that Unity brat.”
“This Xing Huo Xun Yi, I really do not know how he thinks. He chose not to become a disciple of Heart Imitation Religious Master, and would rather become a disciple of a Unity cultivator.”
Cang Qiong Tian Yu and the other top five cultivators were filled with envy and jealousy because Heart Imitation Religious Master did not ask if they wanted to become his disciple. Even as they entered the six great holy grounds, Heart Imitation Religious Master had to accept them if they wanted to become his disciple!
In the blink of an eye.
It was the final segment of the Star Convention. Many cultivators poured in from various places. This time, the number of cultivators who came was way more than those who participated at the start! Because today was a day specially prepared for all of them-the ‘Public Dao Lecture’. Many ordinary cultivators would hardly have the chance of getting guidance by someone at the level of the teachers of the convention.
For them to listen to the teachers lecturing about the Dao was a huge opportunity! It might possibly give them inspirations, allowing the True Gods to break through to Void Gods, and those at the Origin Birth realm to enter the Unity realm!
“Hong long long~”
There were a total of ten huge names appearing beside the Star Pagoda. They were the ten disciples chosen in this Star Convention and could join any holy grounds they wanted. Furthermore, they would become core members of the holy grounds.
On the huge battle platform with a diameter of 50,000 kilometers, Xing Huo Xun Yi and the other nine were standing side by side.
“The ten of you may make your decision.” Heart Imitation Religious Master said from the high platform.
“I am willing to join the Great Void Heaven Temple.”
“I am willing to join the Blade Emperor City.”
“I am willing to join the Void God Palace.”
“I am willing to join the Blade Emperor City.”
…
Many cultivators were watching from afar with jealousy. Xing Huo Xun Yi and the other nine cultivators were reporting their choices, of which three of them had already received an invitation before this. Nevertheless, it was a procedure of the Star Convention for them to publicly announce where they would be joining.
“Sou sou sou…” The ten of them turned into streams of light as they flew onto the high platform. They would stand behind the teachers of the convention whom they chose accordingly.
Only Xing Huo Xun Yi stood behind Xue Ying.
As for General Heaven Light, there were three people behind him, including Cang Qiong Tian Yun. Being the strongest holy ground out of the six, most cultivators would join them during the Star Convention. It was typical for three out of ten to join them. There were even extreme cases where five had chosen to join the Blade Emperor City.
Behind General Hatchet Palace Master were three people. Clearly, the influential power of General Hatchet Palace Master was tremendous this time when he personally came.
There was just a single person behind Violet Slaughter Island Master.
And there were two behind Five Luster Serpent Ancestor. Those two were void creatures; void creatures would usually choose to join the Void God Palace!
As for Star City, none chose to join them! This was the most unique holy ground amongst the six since they would usually not send any teachers to the convention. As such, there were only five teachers in total! Even if someone chose to join the Star City, they would regret it since there were too few experts within the Star City, and it was hard for them to get proper guidance. Trying to obtain the help of the legendary Luo City Lord was practically an extravagant hope.
“Five of you.”
Heart Imitation Religious Master looked towards General Hatchet Palace Master and the other four, “The next segment will belong to you all as you lecture about Dao. Once the lectures finish, the convention will end. The previous competition held during this convention was between talented cultivators! And this public lecture about Dao… is desired by many ordinary cultivators. Everyone must do your job properly. According to past experience, each Dao lecture will last more than three days.”
“Mn.” General Hatchet Palace Master nodded.
“That is natural.” General Heaven Light nodded.
Violet Slaughter Island Master, Five Luster Serpent Ancestor, and Xue Ying had made their preparations.
“Then shall we start with Elder Dong Bo?” Heart Imitation Religious Master said.
Xue Ying chuckled and stood up.
It was reasonable.
The order of public lecture was based on the combat strength of the teachers. The strongest one, General Hatchet Palace Master, would naturally be the last! Existences of the ninth level Star Pagoda strength would usually lecture about Daos that directly led all the way to the Cosmos God level. And since there was Xue Ying at the Unity realm, he would naturally be the first to lecture.
“Hu.” After Xue Ying stood, his figure flashed and appeared in midair. After which, he walked step by step onto the battle platform.
At this moment.
The gazes of many cultivators landed on the figure of Xue Ying.
“I do want to see how capable this Dong Bo Xue Ying is.”
“Xing Huo Xun Yi isn’t willing to become a disciple of Heart Imitation Religious Master, and instead chose to take him as his teacher?”
Many Primal Chaos giants who were located above were prepared to listen attentively. Many cultivators had even held their breaths as they paid attention.
Xue Ying was garbed in a white robe. He sat down cross-legged, sweeping his gaze across the many cultivators. Xue Ying began: “This time, I’ll be primarily speaking about the Dao on illusory realm and slaughter.”
Xue Ying had not only reached the sixth level of Star Pagoda in his attainments of the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter but also even fused the slaughter perfectly into the Mirage, forming a technique that reached the seventh level Star Pagoda strength! Thus, Xue Ying was naturally confident in his understanding of these two Daos. Even though strictly speaking, he was most proud of his Dao of Mirage, few cultivators specialized in the illusory realm. As for the ‘slaughter’, it was researched by many cultivators.
After all, fighting and killing was something hard to avoid when adventuring outside.
“Illusory realm, slaughter?”
Many talented cultivators felt their emotions being stirred up. They were really interested in ‘slaughter’! Most of them would want to listen to the lecture on ‘illusory realm’ even though it would cause their heads to ache. Even if they could not grasp it, it would be good for them to at least understand part of it.
Amongst the Primal Chaos giants located above, the thin male ‘Ba Yun Palace Master’ coldly laughed: ‘Slaughter? He dares to talk about slaughter? Very good. By then, don’t blame me for disgracing you.’
Lecturing about Dao was not about one person.
In the process, many cultivators would come and ask Xue Ying regarding their perplexities, and Xue Ying would choose to guide them on parts of it.
There were occasions when experts call into question what the lecturer spoke.
‘I cultivate the Imperial Dragon inheritance which specialized in Slaughter.’ The eyes of Ba Yun Palace Master were filled with coldness. Previously, he was rejected and directly ousted by Xue Ying. Ba Yun Palace Master was not someone with a good temper. During this period, Xue Ying had always been dazzling. Firstly it was Xing Huo Xun Yi who took the first rank. After that, Xing Huo Xun Yi had rejected the other teachers despite them taking the initiative of inviting him over, before accepting Xue Ying as his formal teacher.
Ba Yun Palace Master naturally felt unhappy after seeing how well-regarded Xue Ying was.
And this time, Xue Ying would actually be talking about ‘Slaughter’?
He primarily cultivated the Imperial Dragon inheritance, becoming a Primal Chaos giant from it!
“Hmph hmph hmph.” Ba Yun Palace Master immediately began listening carefully-so much more attentive than any others.

chapters.title: Chapter 930 - Dao Discussion
chapters.content:
Chapter 930: Dao Discussion
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was by himself on the towering battle platform. He sat cross-legged and began talking about Dao to the cultivators situated below him.
The cultivators understood basic courtesy too. They sat down cross-legged. Some of the mutated beasts also lay down on the ground. None of them let out any sound and were obediently listening! At this moment, anyone who dared to talk would be offending the crowd. Even if cultivators spoke to each other, they would do so via voice transmission.
Xue Ying would first be talking about ‘slaughter’ because many cultivators trained in this. Xue Ying began talking about Dao from the Transcendent stage. He would continue his lecture branching out to many other categories within the slaughter lineage! Xue Ying would eventually reach the Void God realm in the branches of slaughter, and with his great understanding of the realm, he was able to target those branches swiftly, exciting many of the weaker listening cultivators. Even some of the weaker Deities and World Deities who had the opportunity to come became intoxicated from the lecture.
Cultivators who had reached the Void God level were astonished too as this lecture gave them many flashes of inspiration.
“Formidable.”
“I’ve long reached the Void God realm, yet I would not have thought that there are so many other use cases at the True God realm.” Those who were listening had a newfound understanding of their cultivation.
There were the occasional aura fluctuations from breakthroughs in the crowd.
This was normal. Those listening to the teachers of convention talking about Dao would encounter breakthroughs as they listened since these cultivators of a lower status could rarely have the chance of being guided by the genuine higher-ups in the cultivation world.
Xue Ying spent a total of 18 hours speaking about different branches within the Dao of Slaughter from ‘Transcendent until the Void God realm’.
After that, Xue Ying began lecturing about the illusory realm.
The explanation of the illusory realm similarly began from the Transcendent realm until the Void God realm. He spent a total of 18 hours talking about this too.
Once the first segment of the public Dao lecture ended, it was time for these cultivators to ask questions.
“Those with perplexities can come now and clarify your doubts.” Xue Ying chuckled; his voice reverberated around the entire gathering place.
“Senior.”
“Senior Dong Bo.”
A few dozen cultivators who were originally seated cross-legged or laying on the floor hurriedly stood up. According to the rules of the Star Convention, those who stood up represented that they needed direct guidance.
Those who stood up were practically all beneath the Void God level. Only about ten of them were Void Gods since this first segment of Dao lecture was primarily targeted at the lower realm.
“All of you come up.” Xue Ying controlled the void, immediately controlling the 300 cultivators, of which the weakest was a Transcendent realm child, and the strongest was at the Void God Origin Birth realm. It was impossible for Xue Ying to give consultation to everyone since the time limit for this Dao lecture was limited. He would only provide consultation to part of the crowd!
Actually, it was enough to guide several of them since many cultivators had similar issues.
“Sou sou sou.”
The 300 cultivators were controlled by Xue Ying, flying directly onto the battle platform. All of them were excited as they were so lucky to get this opportunity to consult a teacher.
“Senior Dong Bo.” The 300 cultivators, regardless of their races, respectfully bowed.
“One by one.” Xue Ying chuckled. His gaze landed on the weakest child. This was a girl who was slightly plump.
This girl became slightly nervous. Her father was an attendant within one of the restaurants in Blade Emperor City. She was given birth within this city, giving her the opportunity to attend this public lecture. In the sacred world, she was a Transcendent the moment she came to this world, and her intelligence was naturally high. Nevertheless, when Xue Ying lectured about the Dao, she could only understand minimal parts of it; she did not understand the latter part of the lecture.
“Senior.” The girl’s voice was clear and sweet-sounding. She obediently bowed and began asking her questions.
…
Time passed.
Xue Ying spent a total of 36 hours in the first segment of his Dao lecture. After that, he spent close to 20 hours guiding the 300 cultivators.
Only then did he begin the second segment of his Dao lecture which targeted the ‘Void God Origin Birth realm’. He began talking about slaughter first before illusory realm. But this time, he spent 24 hours in total lecturing about the Dao, and 40 hours guiding the 300 cultivators.
The third segment about the Dao targeted the ‘Void God Unity realm’…
Many cultivators beneath were exhilarated from what Xue Ying lectured about. They admired Xue Ying even more over time. In order to give a lecture about Dao, one had to have the foundation and capabilities. It was clear that this senior Dong Bo, despite being the only teacher of the convention at the Unity realm, was able to lecture about Dao extremely well, enlightening the cultivators as they listened.
And the Primal Chaos giants above were patiently listening since this Dao lecture was specially prepared for the ordinary cultivators by the six great holy grounds.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying is indeed the strongest Unity expert in the two great sacred worlds. He also cultivates the laws and profound mysteries system, allowing him to speak about Dao in detail which targets the essence.” The Primal Chaos giants were talking to each other via voice transmissions. Indeed, when ‘discussing Dao’, usually those studying the laws and profound mysteries and hex cultivation system would do best in this. They were able to explain more clearly.
“Not bad.”
“Even most Primal Chaos existences aren’t better than this Dong Bo Xue Ying when guiding the ordinary cultivators.”
They were making their own judgments.
As for Ba Yun Palace Master who was trying to pick a fault with Xue Ying, he calmly watched on with an unpleasant feeling in his heart. Even if he weren’t willing to recognize the other party, he understood in his heart that many aspects which Xue Ying guided those at the lower level on were areas Ba Yun Palace Master had never thought of! Because ‘Ancient Cultivation’ merely needed the constant improvement of the Imperial Dragon inheritance.
‘It is finally the lecture on Unity realm. The more profound the realm, the easier it is for him to make a mistake in his lecture.’ Ba Yun Palace Master was selfish. He only cared about himself. Seeing how outstanding Xue Ying had performed during the Star Convention made him unhappy.
Many cultivators did not care about the disputes amongst the higher-ups. They only knew listening to Senior Dong Bo lecture about Dao would be extremely helpful to them. They were entirely immersed in it.
Even those who did not understand would memorize everything.
It’s just that when Xue Ying spoke about Dao, some of the practice scenes which he portrayed were too mystical that these cultivators could not remember. Nevertheless, they might be able to recognize the content and recall it in the future.
Finally-
Xue Ying began talking about the more profound areas of the Daos, he was currently talking about the Unity realm ‘Dao of Slaughter’ at the sixth level Star Pagoda stage. This was also the highest level he would be talking about.
‘Mn?’ The eyes of Ba Yun Palace Master suddenly brightened, ‘What a joke. Those who are strong will naturally have an easy time talking about the Dao since they have a strong foundation. He himself is merely at the sixth level Star Pagoda strength yet he dares to talk about Dao at this level? Indeed, I’ve discovered certain problems with it.’
******
The Unity realm was much more complex. Xue Ying spoke for a total of 60 hours before stopping.
“Those with perplexities can come and seek me for help.” Xue Ying stated.
Several tens of thousands of cultivators immediately stood. They were at the Unity realm! One had to know that other than the Blade Emperor City, it was not easy for others to rush over from outside this place-just the fees spent on spatial teleportation were quite high. As a result, usually, those at the Unity realm could rush over.
Shortly after, Xue Ying was about to select 300 cultivators. After he finished guiding these 300, his part on the Dao lecture would end.
“Elder Dong bo, I have some understanding of the Dao of Slaughter too, and I do wish for Elder Dong Bo to guide me along.” A voice sounded.
Xue Ying who was seated cross-legged on the battle platform looked over. He only saw as a thin male stepped on the void and walked over, descending on the battle platform. This startled Xue Ying momentarily. It’s him? Ba Yun Palace Master?
“Mn?”
“Primal Chaos realm!”
Many of the cultivators below became excited.
When talking about Dao during Star Convention, usually those lecturers were Primal Chaos giants! They would mention some parts on ‘breaking through to the Primal Chaos’, and at this moment, it would attract the suspicions of other Primal Chaos giants. These two Primal Chaos existences would stand on the platform disputing one another. They would even validate their theories through practical means.
And this was a great occasion! Each Primal Chaos giant had a different understanding of the Dao. When they argued against each other, it would be valuable for some of the Unity experts in their future endeavor as they attempted to break through to the Primal Chaos realm.
It’s only…
Xue Ying was just a Unity realm. When he spoke about Dao, there should be no Primal Chaos giants who would lower their status to call into questions the authenticity of what Xue Ying spoke about. After all, it was unfair for a Primal Chaos giant to suspect a Unity expert. This was kind of ‘slapping the face’.
“Ba Yun Palace Master.” Xue Ying stood up immediately. When facing a Primal Chaos realm, it was not good for him to sit.
“I do not have other reasons, just that I wish to refute what you mentioned in front of all the cultivators.” Ba Yun Palace Master postured his attitude of doing this for the sake of everyone present.
“Please.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Previously, you spoke about the Dao of Slaughter, thinking that the essence of the Dao of Slaughter is more of ‘storing’ before ‘releasing’. right?” Ba Yun Palace Master asked.
Xue Ying nodded: “I dare not say about what happens at the Primal Chaos realm. But at the Unity realm, I think ‘storing’ is more important.”
“You only have to act against me. I will display strength at the sixth level Star Pagoda in correspondence.” Ba Yun Palace Master chuckled, “In a bit, you will understand which area is more important.”
“Alright.” Xue Ying nodded.
When disputing about Dao, most would validate their theory by action when words could not achieve the purpose.
“Hong~” Heart Imitation Religious Master began controlling the battle platform from the high platform, causing an array to envelop around the entire platform. This prevented the release of shockwaves from the exchange of moves that might affect the cultivators spectating.
“Senior Dong Bo is about to validate their opinions on the Dao by fighting.”
Many cultivators were anxiously watching.
This was the highest level of battle ever since the start of Star Convention.
“Be careful.”
With a thought, Xue Ying formed many black shuttles which floated around him. The shuttles were sharp on both ends. On the other side, Ba Yun Palace Master merely chuckled and extended his right hand. He did not even cover it with scales, showing how disdainful he was of the other party.

chapters.title: Chapter 931 - Witnessing the Making of History!
chapters.content:
Chapter 931: Witnessing the Making of History!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Attack me however you like.” Ba Yun Palace Master said in the manner of a senior.
Xue Ying merely chuckled. He brushed away his sleeves.
“Xiu xiu xiu…” A total of 16 black shuttles shot towards Ba Yun Palace Master, arriving in front of him within moments. At this moment, every single black shuttle was emitting a frightening might. Each shuttle had formed a faint illusion with a black hole building within. Even under the laws of the sacred world, this shuttle still caused the void to collapse and turn into a black hole, showing how powerful it is.
“Aren’t you saying that the essence of the Dao of Slaughter should be in its storage? This should be considered as ‘unleashing’ right.” Ba Yun Palace Master merely slapped out his palm. This palm had formed many illusions, parrying against the attacks of the 16 black shuttles.
Xue Ying shook his head inwardly after seeing this.
This Ba Yun Palace Master said he would only display the strength at the sixth level Star Pagoda, yet in reality, it was the peak of the sixth level Star Pagoda! Since each black shuttle of his was a peak Void God weapon, as he unleashed the Apocalyptic Sixth Sword, with 16 swords coming at once, even that Lei Yan Pagoda Master would not have an easy time defending against this.
Ba Yun Palace Master cultivated the ‘Imperial Dragon inheritance’. His body was extremely formidable. If scales were to form on his body, its degree of hardness was comparable to upper-graded Void God weapons. And his palms were strong as well-scales formed on his palm would be comparable to the strength of peak grade Void God weapons. No matter the strength or speed of his palm, they reached terrifying stages. And now, even though no scales were covering his palms, the speed and strength of his palms easily outstripped that of Thunder Fire Pagoda Master. He specialized in palm arts too, so Ba Yun Palace Master could easily parry against Xue Ying’s moves.
“Ba Yun Palace Master, you will understand in a while.” Xue Ying said.
“Then I will see how strong Elder Dong Bo’s techniques are.” Ba Yun Palace Master remained smiling. He did not seem to lose composure. At the same time, he continued defending against the incoming black shuttles.
“Xiu xiu xiu…”
The 16 black shuttles surrounded Ba Yun Palace Master, assaulting him like illusions. As they struck, shockwaves would form and blast on the light cover by the boundaries of the platform.
“Mn?” Ba Yun Palace Master’s expression gradually changed, “Why would it…”
“Interesting.” Those who were watching the battle above-Heart Imitation Religious Master, General Hatchet Palace Master, Monarch Xing Huo, and other Primal Chaos giants had discovered how unique Xue Ying’s moves were.
“He has improved again ever since the previous battle with Lei Yan.” Heart Imitation Religious Master praised.
Indeed.
If it were the Xue Ying then who fought with Thunder Fire Pagoda Master, he could only frantically attack by unleashing his Apocalyptic Sixth Sword.
And now, after creating the ‘Destruction Flower’, Xue Ying’s understanding of the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter had deepened. When using them, these moves became more exquisite. One could see 16 black shuttles striking Ba Yun Palace Master at the center continuously. Every time the attacks were parried, those shuttles would gather strength before circling back again. Furthermore, the 16 black shuttles had surrounded Ba Yun Palace Master in a sphere, akin to forming a world.
It came continuously, and its power was gradually increasing. Furthermore, these shuttles were able to coordinate with each other amazingly. Ba Yun Palace Master was unknowingly being forced to use both his palms to defend against the attacks. He was also having a hard time doing so.
‘How could this be?’ Ba Yun Palace Master did not dare believe it, ‘His Dao of Slaughter has reached this stage despite being at the Unity realm?’
It was too exquisite.
The original ruthless Dao of Slaughter had somehow become musical notes in the hands of Xue Ying, producing an enigmatic beauty! This beauty gave off a feeling that was similar to his ‘Destruction Flower’. If Xue Ying were to use his full force, he would likely be able to send 30 black shuttles with each using the profound mysteries from the Apocalyptic Sixth Sword.
Xue Ying smiled.
The higher the realm, the easier it was for him to display moves at the lower level. In the past, he could unleash 15 Sky Punishment Edges at most simultaneously! And now, he could trigger 25 of them! This was because of his more profound understanding of the Dao of Mirage. Hence, he no longer had to spend as much heart power in performing this move! The Dao of Slaughter was currently still lacking slightly as compared to the Dao of Mirage. Thus, he could form 20 shuttles using the Apocalyptic Sixth Sword at most!
The reason why he unleashed 16 shuttles though was for the sake of keeping some of his heart energy in reserve so that he would be prepared for any unforeseen circumstances.
‘This is too exquisite. If this continues, I might not be able to defend myself!’ Ba Yun Palace Master became slightly anxious. Under the observation of many cultivators, and even more Primal Chaos giants above, how could he lose to a Unity realm? Ba Yun Palace Master could not accept this just by the thought of it.
“These weapons of Elder Dong Bo are peak graded Void God weapons. My palms aren’t able to withstand them any longer.”
Ba Yun Palace Master announced with a smile. Black scales began forming over his palms. And now, each slap by him gave off a mysterious, horrifying power. “Peng peng peng”, the black shuttles were slapped far away. Currently, the gap in strength between them was too huge. Those black shuttles could no longer redirect the force, causing the previous chain of attacks to be broken.
“He has exerted strength beyond the original limit.” Heart Imitation Religious Master, General Hatchet Palace Master, and the others frowned, “This Ba Yun has displayed strength at the seventh level.”
They could conclude from pure observation. The majority of Primal Chaos giants could see it.
Nevertheless, most of the ordinary cultivators could not determine the strength of Ba Yun Palace Master since their realms were too low. To Ba Yun Palace Master, his reputation amongst those at the Primal Chaos realm was initially ordinary. He would rather be ridiculed by them then to lose to someone at the Unity realm!
‘Mn, he is actually so shameless.’ Xue Ying’s expressions changed after seeing this.
“Haha, Elder Dong Bo, did you say that the Dao of Slaughter belongs to storing? With my palms, those shuttles of yours are flung aside.” Ba Yun Palace Master chuckled.
