“Ba Yun Palace Master, then you should try breaking this move with your palms again.” The white-robed Xue Ying stood there. His voice became frigid.
“Hua~”
The illusory world appeared real and unreal. At the center of this illusory world, there was a black flower bud with three leaves. Some dewdrops were rolling on each leaf. The entire illusory world seemed to be there just for the existence of this black flower bud. Closely following that, the black flower bud turned real from illusory. This time, it instantly turned real, emitting a booming sound as it absorbed the world energy frantically. A World energy vortex formed in the inner space of the battle platform, causing the center space to collapse.
The black flower bud appeared and completely enveloped Ba Yun Palace Master.
The flower bud petal was black and faintly transparent. One could see the figure of Ba Yun Palace Master trapped inside.
“Just this move? Break for me.” Ba Yun Palace Master laughed out loud.
Xue Ying coldly watched. Since the other party was so shameless, then there was no need for Xue Ying to respect him. He did not plan on hiding his seventh level Star Pagoda strength too. This was the ripe opportunity for him to display it too.
“Hong hong hong hong…”
Consecutive black flower buds appeared one after another, with the bigger one enclosing the smaller one; a total of seven black flower buds appeared, and Ba Yun Palace Master was trapped inside the innermost flower.
“Break for me.” Ba Yun Palace Master remained full of confidence. His understanding of the Dao of Mirage was shallow. He did not perceive how frightening the ‘Destruction Flower’ was. Maybe only after the flower bud unleashed its power would he understand how scary this move was.
“Hong!” Ba Yun Palace Master fiercely pierced out with his palms.
The black flower buds were extremely tough. Even as they had not bloomed, they were able to easily restrict Ba Yun Palace Master. Under his furious stabs, Ba Yun Palace Master was only able to destroy the innermost black flower bud, and with the blossoming of the petals, closely following that, the leaves turned into black aura and began undergoing destruction. Ba Yun Palace Master who broke apart the first black flower bud with his hands did not have the time to be excited when he felt a horrifying power engulfing him. The arrogant him remained uncovered in scales, yet under this power, his body was torn, causing fresh blood to drip from his injuries.
This was even when Xue Ying was showing mercy. He merely exploded the first black flower bud. If all seven flower buds were erupted at once, the other party would likely die from massive injuries if he had not protected himself with scales.
“What!” Ba Yun Palace Master’s expression changed. He had only broken a single flower bud when the force came on him. He no longer cared about being arrogant. As his body recovered rapidly, black scales started forming over his body.
Every part of his body was covered in a layer of black scales, increasing his defensive strength to an extreme limit. This was the prowess of the Imperial Dragon inheritance.
“Break for me!” A totem appeared behind Ba Yun Palace Master. There was an immensely huge black-scaled mutated beast, and this beast had even left the region of the black flower buds. The mutated creature was ultimately an illusion, so the black flower buds did not hinder it at all.
Many Primal Chaos giants were watching things happening with shock at this moment.
Ba Yun Palace Master was using his full force!
“Break!” A pair of enormous black claws slashed out. They coincided with the palms of Ba Yun Palace Master, blasting at the black flower bud. “Peng peng peng.” At the same time as he broke the black flower buds, the other undamaged flower buds had already blossomed one after another! Even though destructive shockwaves landed on his body, Ba Yun Palace Master remained fine as he withstood the blast with a savage expression.
In a single breath, he forcefully broke through five black flower buds. Closely following that, he unleashed his strength to break the outermost flower bud.
Seven flower buds from the start to end had been broken apart!
But what a pity!
At the moment he was freed, another seven black flower buds descended! It absorbed the surrounding world energy, forming a vortex with space at its center collapsing. World energy was continuously gushing in at this hole of collapse.
“Hong hong hong~” Ba Yun Palace Master was madly breaking the buds.
And Xue Ying merely stood to the distant. He let more black flower buds descend, preventing Ba Yun Palace Master from charging out at all.
If not for the nourishing effects of the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance on his soul, Xue Ying could merely unleash a single black flower bud at most! But by training in this inheritance, Xue Ying’s soul strengthened to the point that he could form seven flowers at once! With seven black flower buds… it was clearly enough to suppress Ba Yun Palace Master. But since the surface scales covering Ba Yun Palace Master were comparable to upper-graded Void God weapons, he was able to barely survive.
“This, this, this…” After being bombarded consecutively, Ba Yun Palace Master finally stopped. He was looking at the enormous black flower petals in a daze.
Seven black flower buds, one encompassed the other, and he was remained trapped within.
So what if his body defenses were strong? He could not even kill his way out.
He was a Primal Chaos giant with a seventh level Star Pagoda strength, yet he was trapped by these seven flowers! Even after using all his strength, he was still disadvantaged? And he could only survive by relying on his scales?
‘He, has he reached the seventh level Star Pagoda strength?’ Ba Yun Palace Master hazily saw that figure standing outside the battle platform through the translucent enormous black petal. He remained filled with disbelief.
…
On the high platform.
As Xue Ying displayed the black flower buds, General Hatchet Palace Master whose heart was hanging in suspense abruptly stood up. He stared at the seven black flower buds below.
“That is…” It wasn’t just him. At this moment, eight Primal Chaos giants could not help but stand as they stared down with shock.
Those like Heart Imitation Religious Master did not stand, though huge waves had formed in their hearts.
Seventh level?
For him to completely suppress Ba Yun Palace Master while having a superior advantage, Xue Ying was unquestionably at the seventh level strength!
In history, there had only been two Unity expert at the seventh level strength in the two great sacred worlds. Adding up all such experts since the primitive Ancient Sacred World until now and adding those who had fallen, there were only eight of them, of which seven had reached the ninth level Star Pagoda strength, and one at the peak of the eighth level Star Pagoda strength! Naturally, three amongst them had fallen.
As a result, those who reached the seventh level Star Pagoda strength would definitely be able to climb to the peak of the eighth level in a short period! There was a huge chance for them to reach the ninth level in the future too.
“Unity realm, seventh level!” The eight Primal Chaos giants stood up. The other Primal Chaos giants were also staring below.
At this moment…
All of them understood that they were witnessing the making of history. They were observing the emergence of a new Unity expert who had reached the seventh level Star Pagoda strength. He was also the third person to emerge in the history of the two great sacred worlds, and the ninth person to reach this stage ever since the primitive Ancient Sacred World era.
And this person was none other than Dong Bo Xue Ying from the Great Void Heaven Temple!

chapters.title: Chapter 932 - Capturing the Attention of Others
chapters.content:
Chapter 932: Capturing the Attention of Others
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
On the battle platform.
Xue Ying had suddenly dissipated all seven Destruction Flowers, causing Ba Yun Palace Master who had been trapped to turn absentminded for a while. Initially, the world seen from inside the translucent black petals were blurred, but now, the world became clear. The white-robed teenager stood afar, saying out: “Ba Yun Palace Master, do you want to continue validating my theory?” His voice warmly sounded by the ears of Ba Yun Palace Master.
Ba Yun Palace Master looked at Xue Ying with complex emotions. He then turned around and flew back as a stream of light to the high platform. He went back to his own seat and sat down without letting out a sound.
He was very clear…
There might be very few Primal Chaos giants across the five great sacred worlds and the vast primal chaos void. But adding everyone, there were quite a few of them too. There were 12 in the Great Void Heaven Temple, and the foundation of both Primogenitor Island and Jade Light Sacred Territory were not any worse off than the Great Void Heaven Temple. Many other Primal Chaos existences did not join the holy grounds too. A simple calculation totaled to close to a hundred Primal Chaos existences in just Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, and this was a sacred world on an equal level with Eastern Unicorn Sacred World and Ancestor Mother World. The Myriad Ancient Sacred World was even stronger than them, with the Ancient Sacred World being the biggest and strongest.
Furthermore, due to many wars that occurred in the past, there had been many cases of sacred worlds shattering apart. Many dejected Primal Chaos giants decided to disperse and live in the primal chaos void from then on. There were even a few Cosmos Gods who also choose to stay across the primal chaos void.
As a result, Primal Chaos giants had differing statuses too.
Just being at the Primal Chaos realm with a sixth level Star Pagoda strength would make others look down upon you. This was the lowest of the lowest level, and most at this level was not too willing to go out. They would either live in seclusion or become an overlord of some desolate area.
Those at the seventh level like Ba Yun Palace Master and Clear Song Island Master were the most commonly seen. More than half the Primal Chaos existences were at this level. Those with a slightly deeper foundation like Heaven Weeping Sect Master was considered to be at the peak of the seventh level. Overall speaking, those at this level were not bad. They could at least travel to different places without being discriminated.
Nevertheless, only after reaching the eighth level would one becoming an outstanding expert. There were much fewer of them at this level, and all of them were hugely respected. Five Luster Serpent Ancestor, Violet Slaughter Island Master, General Heaven Light, and Ancestor Devil were all at this level. Even Cosmos Gods felt that they were alright choices in representing their holy grounds as teachers of the Star Convention this time.
Naturally, there were some who were very powerful like Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and Great Emperor Nine Dragon who were peak eighth level existences. Ancestor Devil once challenged Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and was easily defeated.
The ninth level? Their strength had already reached the Cosmos God level. They were able to survive when facing most Cosmos Gods, and Cosmos Gods would treat them equally.
‘He is at the seventh level despite being in the Unity realm.’ Ba Yun Palace Master felt jealousy and envious in his heart, ‘This Dong Bo Xue Ying can easily reach the peak of the eighth level after stepping into the Primal Chaos realm. It is highly possible for him to reach the ninth level too.’
In history, there were only eight of such existences previously, with seven reaching the ninth level. Naturally, there were some who had fallen, and some who had become Cosmos Gods.
‘This time, he has truly become famous across the primal chaos void. Many cultivators will remember his name. As for I, I have instead become his stepping stone.’ Ba Yun Palace Master felt his heart being bitten. But he did not have the slightest of thoughts of becoming enemies with the other party since the gap was too huge. Those at the peak eighth level could easily kill the ordinary seventh level existences.
…
Xue Ying watched as Ba Yun Palace Master retreated without saying a word. After that, voices could be heard by his ears.
“Elder Dong Bo, congratulations for stepping into the seventh level at the Unity realm. I really look forward to when you step into the ninth level Primal Chaos realm.”
“Elder Dong Bo is indeed amazing. You have not only stepped into the seventh level, but you are also even capable of suppressing Ba Yun Palace Master. Admirable.”
“I am actually fortunate enough to see the battle that made history. Really lucky of me.”
Many Primal Chaos giants transmitted their voices over.
They were extremely passionate. Some had even placed their postures lower as if they were willing to lower their heads when facing Xue Ying! Those at the Primal Chaos realm similarly had all sorts of trials and crises. They were extremely willing to befriend Xue Ying. Before this, some looked down upon Xue Ying and were too lazy to talk to him.
They originally reckoned that Xue Ying was on a different level-a lower level than them-and felt that it was possible for Xue Ying to get stuck at the Unity realm forever.
But clearly, things were no longer the same.
Furthermore, the majority of these Primal Chaos giants were only at the seventh level; they were not any stronger than Ba Yun Palace Master.
“I have to continue my Dao lecture now, and I do hope to seek everyone’s understanding in this.” Xue Ying replied.
He then turned back to the cultivators below.
Many of them were already excited. A Unity realm existence actually directly suppressed someone at the Primal Chaos realm? Some of those who were more experienced had begun explaining to their friends. Many of them understood that reaching the seventh level at the Unity realm was something miraculous.
“I will be resuming my Dao lecture.” Xue Ying’s voice transmitted across the ears of all the cultivators. At the same time, he had teleported the 300 Unity realm cultivators up.
“Hu hu hu…”
All 300 Unity cultivators landed on the battle platform. They were extremely delighted since they were chosen and could consult a Unity realm seventh level existence. It could be said that with Xue Ying being someone who cultivated the laws and profound mysteries system should be the person with the best understanding of the Unity realm amongst those present in the place.
“Senior Dong Bo.” The 300 Unity realm existences bowed respectfully. This was respect for their senior.
“One by one.” Xue Ying began guiding them.
…
It was not only the many cultivators below or the Primal Chaos giants above, even Heart Imitation Religious Master, Monarch Xing Huo, General Hatchet Palace Master, and others were carefully listening.
After a total of 18 hours, Xue Ying finally finished guiding all 300 Unity realm cultivators.
Xue Ying then controlled the void to send all 300 back down.
“And now, I end my Dao lecture. It is time for other teachers to take the stage.” Xue Ying announced with a smile. He then turned into a stream of light and flew up to the high platform back to his original seat.
The teachers would give their Dao lecture accordingly.
General Heaven Light stood up next. He glanced at Xue Ying by the side. In the past, he did not care about hiding his feelings since his superiority over those at the Unity realm was rooted in his bones. He felt that for someone to be standing on an equal level with him yet be at the Unity realm was a humiliation to him. But now, there was a rare smile. He had even smiled at Xue Ying, greatly horrifying Xue Ying.
This General Heaven Light was bald. His entire figure emitted a dim golden light. For his attitude to have such a massive transformation and smile at him was something Xue Ying could not adapt to temporarily.
General Heaven Light chuckled and announced: “Elder Dong Bo’s Dao lecture has given me a huge pressure. My lecture of the Dao isn’t up to the standard of Elder Dong Bo’s, but I’ll still try my best.” His voice reverberated across the entire ground.
“General Heaven Light has overpraised me.” Xue Ying replied.
“It isn’t overpraising you. I am merely speaking the truth. There aren’t many under the Primal Chaos realm who dares to say they can lecture about the Dao as good as Elder Dong Bo.” General Heaven Light chuckled. He then took a step and appeared on the battle platform below. With a gray robe over him, he sat on the battle platform. His entire figure was emitting a dim golden light, and he started lecturing about Dao with his loud majestic voice.
…
The five teachers of convention lectured about Dao successively: Xue Ying, General Heaven Light, Five Luster Serpent Ancestor, Violet Slaughter Island Master and finally, General Hatchet Palace Master.
And Xue Ying who was seated at the high platform did not relax at all despite being able to do so.
It was fine for the Primal Chaos existences to transmit their voices to each other.
But now, experts from all across the three great sacred worlds reaching the Primal Chaos realm had begun sending transmissions to him. Some had even sent transmissions through the Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion, and would at least congratulate him once! Clearly, his status had become higher. The majority of those Primal Chaos giants did not lack in manners, and Xue Ying would respond with courtesy, acknowledging them simply. Nevertheless, those with a really high status like the hall masters in his Great Void Heaven Temple were people he had to take seriously.
Xue Ying spent nine days speaking about the Dao, and the other Primal Chaos existences spent less than that-most spent only five to six days. As for General Hatchet Palace Master, he had kept it to the minimum three days.
It was primarily those who studied the laws and profound mysteries who could really lecture about ‘Dao’! The majority of other systems was more about ‘using’, and less about theoretical.
“The Star Convention has officially come to an end.” Heart Imitation Religious Master announced.
Many cultivators were still pondering over what they experienced and heard in the ‘Dao lecture’, and were slightly in a daze. Nevertheless, they began leaving in large batches.
High up in the platform.
Most of them also started standing up to leave.
“Elder Dong Bo.”
“Elder Dong Bo.” Several Primal Chaos existences came directly, sending an invitation for Xue Ying to their gathering.
“Your son’s foresight is not bad.” General Hatchet Palace Master walked next to Monarch Xing Huo, “For him to take Dong Bo Xue Ying as his teacher in the Dao of Mirage is absolutely the best choice for him since Dong Bo Xue Ying is a great teacher.”
“Hahaha.” Monarch Xing Huo laughed.
Seeing how dazzling Xue Ying was, Monarch Xing Huo was genuinely happy.
At this moment-
Heart Imitation Religious Master walked to the side of Xue Ying. The other Primal Chaos existences who were extending their invitation to him stood to the side. Ninth level existences like Heart Imitation Religious Master were people who would still make them feel pressurized.
“Dong Bo.” Heart Imitation Religious Master chuckled. He then transmitted over, “Blade Emperor asked me to pass on the message for you to attempt the Star Pagoda now! And it isn’t Blade Emperor alone, there are also other Cosmos Gods who will be watching you attempt the Star Pagoda.”
“Several Cosmos Gods?” Xue Ying was stunned. This time, several Cosmos Gods were paying close notice to him.
In the past, it was only Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster from his Great Void Heaven Temple who would pay slight attention to him since they recognized that he could become a hall master in the future. Nevertheless, this time, the strongest ‘Blade Emperor’ out of the six great holy grounds and several other Cosmos Gods would be observing his trial through the Star Pagoda. It was evident that Xue Ying had caught the attention of the highest echelon across the six great holy grounds. This was normal since according to past experiences, the chances of Xue Ying stepping into the ninth level Star Pagoda were high.
“Alright, I’ll go and attempt the Star Pagoda at this moment.” Xue Ying transmitted.
Heart Imitation Religious Master nodded with a smile: “I’ll send you over.”

chapters.title: Chapter 933 - Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, Great Void Heaven Temple
chapters.content:
Chapter 933: Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, Great Void Heaven Temple
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Forefather Tian Yu was seated next to Swordmaster. They were chatting and drinking while watching the scene in front of them-Xue Ying being accompanied by Heart Imitation Religious Master down to the entrance of the Star Pagoda. As it had been more than half a month since Xue Ying lectured about the Dao, both Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster had long prepared themselves to watch Xue Ying attempt the Star Pagoda.
The six great holy grounds were so close that they were like a single entity. As such, the other Cosmos Gods were also paying close notice to Xue Ying.
“I once considered that the potential of this brat is quite high, and it is possible for him to step into the Primal Chaos realm.” Forefather Tian Yu chuckled, “Who would have thought that I still underestimated his potential for he has reached the seventh level so quickly despite being at the Unity realm. I believe there might be another expert at the ninth level in my Great Void Heaven Temple shortly. By then, my Great Void Heaven Temple will be the same as Blade Emperor City out of the six great holy grounds, with two experts at the ninth level.”
Currently, out of the six great holy grounds, only Blade Emperor City contained two ninth level experts.
The Great Void Heaven Temple had just a single Primal Chaos Hall Master.
And the Primogenitor Island only had General Hatchet Palace Master. As such, it was quite rare for him to take on the responsibility as a teacher of the convention, resulting in Blade Emperor City sending ‘Heart Imitation Religious Master’ as the host. Furthermore, Monarch Xing Huo went to participate in the Star Convention for his son. As such, there were a total of three ninth level existences participating in the convention, and this was rare! There was even a Unity realm seventh level emerging in this Star Convention, which was something more unusual.
“He might even become a Cosmos God in the future.” Swordmaster laughed.
“Cosmos God? That is difficult.” Forefather Tian Yu sighed, “The emergence of Cosmos God happens when they find their own Dao path. It’s only you Swordmaster who was so outstanding that you could cultivate by yourself in the cosmos and reach the Primal Chaos realm. After coming to the Great Void Heaven Temple, you were able to break through to the Cosmos God realm after entering closed-door cultivation.”
Swordmaster was indeed a legend.
How many Cosmos Gods had experienced and tempered themselves many times before becoming one? Before Swordmaster became a Cosmos God, he was not that famous in the entire primal chaos void. Others only knew that there was a new Primal Chaos existence in the ‘Great Void Heaven Temple’ called Swordmaster, though not long later, he became a Cosmos God. Naturally, the shock it incited was stronger than the one induced by Xue Ying this time.
It had made countless experts fall into a daze.
…
Several Cosmos Gods were watching this from several places. Because everyone came from the six great holy grounds, the Star Pagoda permitted them to observe what was happening within.
“Several Cosmos Gods are watching you, so you must do your best.” Heart Imitation Religious Master said.
“That is natural.” Xue Ying flew into the Star Pagoda. Even though this was the Star Pagoda located in Blade Emperor City, it was similar in its way of refinement to the Great Void Heaven Temple; Xue Ying was familiar with it.
“Hu.”
Seventh level of the Star Pagoda. A blood-colored stream of light flew out from within the mountain range, condensing into ten figures. They were none other than the Destructive Devils who were in blood-colored armor. They were slightly different from the opponents located in the Star Pagoda within Great Void Heaven Temple, though Xue Ying knew that the degree of difficulty was the same.
‘Go.’ Xue Ying sent out a thought.
The black flower buds appeared from nothingness. It caused the world energy to surge horrifyingly, enveloping over the ten Destruction Devils. With a thought, many flowers appeared continuously-a total of seven black flowers with one encompassing another. The innermost layer wrapped around the ten shocked Destruction Devils! After all, Xue Ying’s technique came from the illusion, and those devils could not evade even if they wanted to.
The surrounding World Energy vortex had yet to dissipate when Xue Ying hollered: “Extinguish!”
He was not merciful. He erupted all seven Destruction Flowers at the same time.
“Hong hong hong~”
When facing Ba Yun Palace Master, Xue Ying was not as ruthless to blossom all seven black flowers at the same time. The blossoming of the flower was also when it revealed its destructive might. The ten Destructive Devils let out ear-piercing screeches.
Once the shockwave cleared, there were two heavily-injured Destruction Devils left behind.
Just a single full-powered move by Xue Ying caused the death of eight Destruction Devils and two heavily-injured ones. These two devils had the strongest defenses and were able to survive primarily because Xue Ying scattered the power from the seven Destruction Flowers across the ten Destruction Devils.
The remaining two Destruction Devils were convulsing in fear. They tried escaping.
Alas, it was too late!
“Extinguish!” Xue Ying unleashed seven more black Destruction Flowers again. Once those flowers blossomed, the remaining two Destruction Devils were killed.
‘That time I displayed my domain and illusory realm as well as the Sky Punishment Edges and tried my best. I relied on my strong defenses to hold on as well. Only after spending a long time were I able to kill eight of the Destruction Devils. Nevertheless, I am able to kill all of them instantaneously now.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly. He knew that he should be quite strong amongst those at the seventh level strength.
After all, according to his deduction, just a single Destruction Flower contained sufficient force that touched the boundary of the seventh level. With seven flowers being unleashed simultaneously, how much stronger was it?
‘Let’s attempt the eighth level.’ Xue Ying wanted to experience how it was at the eighth level.
“Xiu.”
He shot into the sky, flying through the vortex passage.
The eighth level of Star Pagoda consisted of an enormous battle platform. There was a golden light rising on the surface of the platform, condensing into an alien wearing golden armor. That golden armor seemed like skin which stuck to his entire body. He had three thin tails with exceptional sharpness at their end. He had two arms too that reached his knees.
‘Golden-armored Destruction Devil.’ Xue Ying thought. He understood quite a lot about the Destruction Devils.
The Destruction Devils were categorized according to their armor-gray, blood and gold. The weakest of the golden-armored Destruction Devils had a seventh level Star Pagoda strength, and the strongest reached the ninth level strength.
And beyond that…
There were Destruction Devils who were comparable to Cosmos Gods. They did not have any specific appearances. They could even conceal their destructive aura, making it hard for Primal Chaos existences to discern them.
“Unity realm?” This golden-armored Destruction Devil was shocked as he stared at Xue Ying in front.
“Extinguish.” Xue Ying did not hesitate. He unleashed all seven Destruction Flowers!
Under the power of the seven Destruction Flowers, there were only some slight damages on the skin-armor of this golden-armored Destruction Devil. He was able to instantly recover from it.
“Die.” He immediately rushed into the 500-kilometers region around Xue Ying. As this region was where Xue Ying’s law domain persisted, one that was reconstructed according to the structure of the ‘Destruction Flower’, this Destruction Devil was unable to teleport in and had to rely on his speed to travel in.
‘Too fast.’ Xue Ying hurriedly unleashed his Destruction Flowers, yet he was still slow. Xue Ying was forced to teleport and evade against the attack. Even when one or two flowers had just wrapped around the enemy, the other party was able to tear out of them easily.
The Destruction Devil was too fast.
Xue Ying was unable to handle the other party with his offense. He was forced to give up in the end after a few bouts.
‘It seems I am still quite far away from the eighth level.’ Xue Ying sighed, ‘Even my strongest offensive technique is still far off. I must reach the Primal Chaos realm before attempting this again.’
…
The Cosmos Gods who were watching the battle from afar were rather proud of Xue Ying since even though there had only been two Unity realm existences who attempted the eighth level Star Pagoda, one of them-’Heart Imitation Religious Master’-had almost admitted defeat the next moment! The other was someone from the Jade Light Sacred Territory called ‘Great Emperor Jin Yi’ who was able to rely on his transcendental domain and defense to hold on for a longer period.
As for Xue Ying, he relied on his offense to hold on for a few bouts. The seven Destruction Flowers were able to influence the speed of the other party.
Within Blade Emperor City.
In a small house beside the lake. There were two figures walking side by side. One was the golden-robed Blade Emperor, and the other was a male wearing a loose dull-gray gown. He was Luo City Lord.
“Teacher, how do you find this Dong Bo Xue Ying?” Blade Emperor laughed. He was humble.
If this were to spread out, it would likely startle the entire primal chaos void.
Because…
Nobody knew that the strongest ‘Blade Emperor’ of the six great holy grounds would be the disciple of Luo City Lord! Blade Emperor with a high status would actually be the disciple of a Primal Chaos existence?
“He has quite a potential. Place him in the preparatory list.” Luo City Lord chuckled, “He is still too tender. It is too early for him.”
“Mn.” Blade Emperor obediently nodded.
“Actually, instead of talking about his strength, I am more astounded at how calm he is.” Luo City Lord said, “He has revealed his strength during the Star Convention, allowing his name to spread across the primal chaos void with many Primal Chaos existences fawning on him. That is his glory. According to logic, even those who reached a profound stage in heart realm would feel their blood boiling! Yet he can remain calm. I cannot feel how excited he is from my perspective.”
Blade Emperor was startled. He nodded: “Right. That’s the case.”
“Interesting.” A smile appeared on the face of Luo City Lord.
The two of them did not know that in the heart of Xue Ying, the existence he wanted to deal against was the strongest expert in the current primal chaos void, ‘Sacred Master’. Even his teacher Gu Qi had died in the hands of the other party. Xue Ying had questioned himself-although this little achievement was worth celebrating for, there was no point being too excited over it since he was still too far away on his Dao journey to where Sacred Master was at.
…
Void God Temple
Void Primogenitor sat by himself. He was able to gaze across every single part of the primal chaos void. Even though the void was vast and boundless with many living beings within, it no longer contained his disciple Gu Qi.
Seeing how dazzling this grand-student Xue Ying was, he felt joyful.
But Gu Qi could no longer see it.
He could never forget about how Gu Qi was so excited after Xue Ying’s battle with Lei Yan, yet Gu Qi had nobody to talk to. He had pulled Void Primogenitor over instead to brag about it.
“Gu Qi.” Void Primogenitor muttered, “Your disciple Dong Bo Xue Ying is now the strongest Unity realm across the five great sacred worlds. If you know about this, you would be very happy about it right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 934 - Enduring Silently
chapters.content:
Chapter 934: Enduring Silently
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Outside Blade Emperor City.
“Xun Yi, it is a great opportunity for you to become a disciple under Elder Dong Bo. This time, you must properly cultivate. In the future when you step into the Primal Chaos realm as well, both son and father will be at the Primal Chaos realm. This is something that will spread across the world.” Monarch Xing Huo stood there. Even though only a little of his aura was released, its cruelty and overbearingness made other cultivators feel the pressure. Don’t think how he treated Xue Ying politely because of his son, he is ultimately someone who stands at the peak of the Primal Chaos realm, and is someone who could compare with Cosmos Gods.
“Yes, father.” The golden-robed young man Xing Huo Xun Yi solemnly replied. He was filled with fighting spirit.
“Go.” Monarch Xing Huo nodded.
“Sou.”
Xing Huo Xun Yi immediately flew towards Xue Ying, Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and several dozens of disciples nearby. In this Star Convention, other than 10 cultivators who would become the core members, there were still 190 other who got through the selections. They would be able to choose which holy ground to join. Quite a few joined Great Void Heaven Temple, but they would only be nurtured as ordinary disciples.
“Monarch, we will be leaving first.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and Xue Ying announced. They then directly formed a distorted passage by the side.
Inquisitive Sky Hall Master brought along Xue Ying and the others in.
Monarch Xing Huo stood there watching them until they were gone.
‘It is good for this brat to regain his fighting spirit. I hope that there the guidance of that Elder Dong Bo could bring miracles.’ Monarch Xing Huo thought. His youngest son was different from his eldest son in that he experienced too few setbacks as Monarch Xing Huo was already at the ninth level Star Pagoda strength when he came into this world. The youngest son Xun Yi was much more immature as he grew up under the protection of the monarch.
Monarch Xing Huo waved his sleeves back.
“Si la~”
A pitch black spatial passage formed ahead of him. Monarch Xing Huo took a step in before disappearing from the vicinity.
…
“This is the Great Void Heaven Temple?”
Xue Ying and Inquisitive Sky Hall Master watched as the disciples entered Great Void Heaven Temple for the first time. They exclaimed in curiosity at the vast space ahead.
In the distant, there was a gigantic floating land with a towering ‘Great Void Palace Hall’ emitting a light which spanned across a lofty distance, illuminating every single part of this space. It was able to form a layer of light over the structures on many of the surrounding floating islands.
“Xiu.”
A figure flew over from afar. He was a green-robed male. That male respectfully bowed: “Greetings Inquisitive Sky Hall Master, Elder Dong Bo.”
“Mn. You will be helping these newly-joined disciples settle down.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master ordered.
“Yes.” The green-robed male respectfully acknowledged. He then turned towards Xing Huo Xun Yi and the others, “Fellow disciples, come with me.”
Thus, Xing Huo Xun Yi and the rest obediently followed. They would find a place to settle down before starting their cultivation lives in the Great Void Heaven Temple.
“Go go go, many hall masters have already prepared a feast and are just waiting for you.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master urged.
“Oh?” Xue Ying was startled.
“Haha, many of them have come personally with their true bodies. Even two of the hall masters who were fighting and resisting against the Destruction Devils at the boundary of the void rushed over.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master chuckled, “You sure are honored.”
Xue Ying hurried: “Let’s hurry on then! We shouldn’t let them wait.”
“Go.”
Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and Xue Ying immediately turned into streams of light as they flew towards the ‘Primal Chaos Palace Hall’ situated at the enormous central land.
The Primal Chaos Palace Hall was huge. Currently, within one of the elegant reception halls, a grand feast was organized.
“Sou sou!”
Xue Ying and Inquisitive Sky Hall Master landed outside the hall. They opened the door before entering it. The seats inside were placed in twos and threes without any order. Some of the attendees were already drinking and chatting with those beside them.
“Dong Bo is here, quick quick quick.”
“We are just missing you.”
These hall masters noticed Xue Ying entering; they immediately urged him on with waves of laughter.
Xue Ying also discovered that only a seat was left. As for Inquisitive Sky Hall Master? His true body had long come, and that incarnation of his had dissipated like an illusion.
“Dong Bo, you have greatly bolstered the reputation of our Great Void Heaven Temple. Seventh level Unity realm… haha, our Great Void Heaven Temple finally has a peerless Unity realm existence emerging who reached the seventh level power.” Celestial Water Hall Master chuckled.
“Dong Bo, quickly have a seat.” Ancestor Devil said too, “Those hall masters who can rush over have come. The others who sent their incarnations are busy with other stuff. The majority of them are still fighting with the Destruction Devils at the boundary of the void, and aren’t able to leave.”
Ancestor Devil was also slightly rueful.
At his hometown cosmos, during his era, he met a peerless existence like Swordmaster. Even though he was filled with a fighting spirit, he understood that the gap was huge! During the earliest period, he was absolutely the overlord of the era. It was after a while did Swordmaster slowly rose. Nevertheless, his cultivation speed was extremely fast. Once he surpassed Ancestor Devil, Ancestor Devil could only feel the gap between them widening. And when Swordmaster arrived at the Great Void Heaven Temple, he had broken through to become a Cosmos God. The gap between the two had thus grown even bigger.
It was okay if there were only Swordmaster. Now, another ‘Xue Ying’ emerged in the era after theirs from his hometown cosmos.
He had reached the seventh level while being at the Unity realm! It was unquestionable that he could reach the peak of the eighth level after cultivating for a period. By then, he would be able to suppress Ancestor Devil.
Xue Ying sat down and exclaimed with shock: “Resisting against the Destruction Devils? Why is the situation so dire?”
“Ever since the destruction of the primitive Ancient Sacred World, many Destruction Devils have appeared in the boundary of the void. Over time, the Destruction Devils multiplied and become greater in numbers. Our Great Void Heaven Temple is responsibility of a region. It is fortunate that Forefather is there guarding the place for long periods, and that is why we could frequently return with the help of Inquisitive Sky Hall Master.” Leading Wing Hall Master flapped his wings before slightly nodding.
“Forefather guarding the place for long periods?” Xue Ying was astounded.
“Right. The Forefather in the Great Void Heaven Temple is merely an incarnation. Haha, Forefather’s realm is extremely high. You aren’t able to discern that right?”
…
This gathering was held with the hall masters of Great Void Heaven Temple treating Xue Ying as their peer. They were clear that Xue Ying would soon become the 13th hall master of Great Void Heaven Temple.
Ling Yun Peak.
In the cultivation room of Xue Ying’s cavern-dwelling.
After the gathering ended, Xue Ying went back to his cultivation room. He first lighted the incense before sitting down on the silvery-silk praying mat to start his meditation.
‘It is time to properly cultivate.’ Xue Ying felt that he should be able to break through to the Primal Chaos realm in one fell swoop after this meditation.
He then closed his eyes.
He no longer cared about any disturbances in the outer world. All his concentration was placed on the Dao of Mirage as he comprehended the profound mysteries of this Dao meticulously. Ever since he created the ‘Destruction Flower’, Xue Ying had not gotten the chance to experience and consolidate his comprehension of the Dao of Mirage. That was why many flashes of realizations began appearing in his heart at this moment…
******
“Dong Bo Xue Ying has entered closed-door cultivation. By the time he exits, he should be at the Primal Chaos realm.” Over at another location in the Great Void Heaven Temple, the hunchbacked old man ‘Forefather Tian Yu’ guffawed, “Our Great Void Heaven Temple has another Primal Chaos realm now. He specialized in the illusory ream. By the time he exits, I can tell him about several matters that would need his help on for our Great Void Heaven Temple.”
Swordmaster nodded.
Most Unity realm expert would travel and take on missions around the place. Tempering themselves and cultivation were the most important task for them! Once they reached the fifth level Star Pagoda strength, becoming an Inner Hall Elder, that was when they were allowed to proceed to the boundary of the void to battle. In reality, those battles happening at the border of the void depended more on Forefather Tian Yu and the Primal Chaos giants. Inner Hall Elders going there were firstly, for resources and secondly, to train themselves.
Primal Chaos existences were the true combative force, and only they were qualified to know more secrets.
“This Dong Bo Xue Ying is indeed extraordinary. He isn’t arrogant at all despite achieving what he has.” Swordmaster praised.
“Maybe this brat is thinking of dealing against the Sacred Master.” Forefather Tian Yu chuckled.
“Haha, ignorance is bliss. This is a good matter.” Swordmaster shook his head, “I am preparing to enter another closed-door cultivation.”
“Mn, you don’t have to care about other matters. I can handle them. You should only concentrate on cultivating. Once you are 100% certain, it will be the time for you to act.” Forefather Tian Yu’s eyes were filled with cold intent, “By then, the other five great holy grounds would not hesitate to support our Great Void Heaven Temple. Even if the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World collapse, it is worth the price. At the worse, we can create another sacred world.”
Swordmaster solemnly nodded: “I will definitely not disappoint everyone.”

chapters.title: Chapter 935 - Finally reaching the Primal Chaos Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 935: Finally reaching the Primal Chaos Realm
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Great Void Heaven Temple, Ling Yun Peak, within the cultivation room inside the cavern-dwelling.
Xue Ying was cultivating by himself. He had built a great foundation. Before creating the “Destruction Flower”, Xue Ying was already 100% confident of stepping into the Primal Chaos realm. Now that he had established the Destruction Flower, many flashes of comprehensions began surging in his mind just as he started meditating. His understanding in the Dao of Mirage was continually deepening.
“Mn?”
Just a month or so after Xue Ying entered closed-door cultivation.
He slowly opened his eyes: ‘Who would have thought that I will step into the Primal Chaos realm in my Ancient Cultivation first.’
That’s right.
Even though he concentrated fully on the Dao of Mirage, Xue Ying had yet to grasp hold of the complete Dao of Mirage at the Primal Chaos realm. Instead, he had reached the seventh transformation in the ancient cultivation inheritance “Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance”. Because the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance was illusory realm related, the seventh transformation represented the lowest level of power at the Primal Chaos realm-it was merely at the sixth level Star Pagoda strength!
The sixth transformation was at the fifth level strength. The seventh transformation was at the lowest level of Primal Chaos realm, the ‘sixth level strength’. As for the eighth transformation, it would be at the seventh level strength, with the final ninth transformation at the ‘eighth level strength’.
The eighth level strength was not easy to attain. As for the legendary ninth level? It was not enough just relying on the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance. Black Emperor cultivated four great inheritances at the same time, of which he reached perfection in three of them.
‘Time to break through.’ Xue Ying inwardly shook his head.
The profound mysteries inherent in the seventh transformation of Vermillion Nightmare were shallow. After all, Xue Ying was able to reach this strength after altering the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance. He did not have to grasp hold of the Dao of Mirage to reach the Primal Chaos realm in ancient cultivation. It was only the laws and profound mysteries system that had high requirements, and it needed Xue Ying to completely grasp the complete law. The ancient cultivation system required one to merely display the skill. And currently, Xue Ying was able to do so.
‘I’ve broken through. My soul has become stronger too, allowing me to cultivate faster.’ Xue Ying no longer hesitated. He waved his hand, bringing out some of the precious resources he prepared. One had to rely on resources in order to step into the Primal Chaos realm using the ancient cultivation system.
…
It was natural for Xue Ying to break through easily just like how a canal would form when water flowed. The seventh transformation of the Vermillion Nightmare was milder than its previous transformations, and it provided more significant assistance to his soul. Suddenly-
“Hong long long~”
A quantity change led to a qualitative transformation.
Xue Ying’s soul immediately started metamorphosing. This was a transformation that any Unity realm expert would experience as they step into the Primal Chaos realm. In the sacred world, the incarnations of Unity realm experts could not travel too far away from his true body. But Primal Chaos giants were able to send their incarnation down millions and millions of kilometers away with a single thought. Their incarnations could even take the initiative to roam around the primal chaos void and travel to other sacred worlds!
Like many of the hall masters in Great Void Heaven Temple, when they came to congratulate Xue Ying, their true bodies were still in the distant boundary of the void, yet their incarnations came back!
Could this be done at the Unity realm?
Those at the Unity realm could not even travel one-ten-thousandth that of the distance a Primal Chaos existence could reach.
Was the gap in their spiritual energy so big? Clearly, it wasn’t!
Strictly speaking.
This was more of a ‘qualitative’ problem. A kilogram of water and a kilogram of steel weighed the same, but when both clashed, under ordinary circumstances, the steel would triumph. And it was a suppressive victory. This was the difference in quality. Naturally, if ‘a kilogram of water’ were to form a high-pressure water blade, it might be able to cut the steel! Those who were talented at the Unity realm could defeat those at the Primal Chaos realm. But once Primal Chaos existences became stronger, molding the steel into various weapons, their power would naturally become more terrifying.
‘This feeling is too wonderful.’ Xue Ying perceived the senses his soul had to the surrounding. With a single thought, his senses could cover the entire great void space. It could even penetrate out of the great void space.
“Xiu-”
His senses immediately spread out. This was much faster than any teleportation. In just the time taken to ‘think’, he had covered the majority half of the sacred world.
That’s right. The majority half of the sacred world. Xue Ying could even vaguely sense the ‘Primogenitor Island’, though it was too hazy just like a mortal looking far beyond, where everything was indistinct to them. These mortals were only able to approximate the shape and appearances of mountains and silhouettes of landscapes. But even so, Xue Ying was able to send an incarnation with a thought within this region he could perceive!
Once he deliberately released his senses, because this sort of feeling was too indistinct just like mortals looking far away, another mortal would not be able to perceive it.
Similarly, the majority of the Primal Chaos giants could not sense this faint feeling of long-distance perception. Only a select few might be able to do so. Nevertheless, it was different for Cosmos Gods! The law domain of Cosmos Gods was a self-formed cosmos system. Their senses were extremely acute.
“Mn?” Within his own courtyard in the Great Void Heaven Temple, Forefather Tian Yu was able to perceive this. He revealed a look of shock. He then laughed in the direction of Ling Yun Peak, “Dong Bo, congratulations for stepping into the Primal Chaos realm.”
“Forefather.” Xue Ying immediately replied.
“Haha, you have broken through after entering closed-door for a month or so. That is fast enough. When are you planning to open the 13th palace hall in the Great void Heaven Temple?” Forefather Tian Yu asked.
“No rush. Let me consolidate everything first.” Xue Ying transmitted back.
“Alright.” Forefather Tian Yu understood this. Typically, there was a period after breaking through where the cultivator could still consolidate his strength and become stronger. During this stage, most cultivators would not want to be bothered by any external matters.
…
Primogenitor Island, the true body of Devil Mountain Primogenitor was a black mountain.
Two eyes opened on this mountain wall.
“Haha, Dong Bo Xue Ying, congratulations for entering the Primal Chaos realm.” Devil Mountain Primogenitor directly transmitted over. The distance of Xue Ying’s senses had enveloped the Primogenitor Island. Even though this was fleeting, allowing Xue Ying to barely discern the outer appearances of Primogenitor Island, Devil Mountain Primogenitor could easily perceive him.
…
“Mn?”
There were quite many Myriad World Taverns in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World.
Within every Myriad World Tavern, there would be a master. They were all avatars of Myriad World Tavern Master. They raised their heads almost at the same time towards the Great Void Heaven Temple.
‘Another Primal Chaos realm?’ Myriad World Tavern Master chuckled, ‘Dong Bo Xue Ying? It seems another formidable small brat has emerged in this five great sacred worlds.’
…
“Dong Bo, congratulations. Properly cultivate so that our Great Void Heaven Temple will have another expert at the ninth level strength.” Primal Chaos Hall Master was able to sense it too. Of those at the same level, General Hatchet Palace Master specialized in the strongest warrior system, and could not detect Xue Ying at all. But Primal Chaos Hall Master’s control of the surrounding was much more acute by a few times. It was comparable to Cosmos Gods.
“Ninth level Star Pagoda strength? It is temporarily out of reach for me.” Xue Ying smiled.
The more he understood, the more Xue Ying revered those who reached the ninth level Star Pagoda strength. The difficulty of reaching this level was comparable to reaching the seventh level at the Unity realm.
But there were comparatively more who reached the ninth level strength. Why is that so?
Because many Primal Chaos giants had broken through to the Primal Chaos realm just after reaching the fifth level Star Pagoda strength. Some broke through after entering the sixth level. After all, there were not many who were deadset about reaching the seventh level strength at the Unity realm. Even if they wanted to do so, they would discover that it was too difficult to do so, and would give up and break through to the Primal Chaos realm first!
Xue Ying accumulated quite a large foundation, and under the influence brought by the death of his teacher, Xue Ying was able to create a new move in one fell swoop.
But it was different for those at the Primal Chaos realm. They all wanted to reach the Cosmos God realm, which was essentially the final and hardest stage for all cultivators! Countless peerless cultivators were stuck at this final stage. They could only temper themselves and seek for the limits. That was how these ninth level Star Pagoda Primal Chaos experts emerged. Even so, there were fewer experts at the Primal Chaos ninth level than the Cosmos Gods.
******
After Xue Ying broke through in the ancient cultivation ‘Vermillion Nightmare inheritance’, Xue Ying’s soul became stronger. Furthermore, there was a qualitative change. His cultivation and deduction speed had clearly improved.
This time, he did not experience any setbacks. Xue Ying had broken through very naturally after 300 years or so to the Primal Chaos realm in his ‘Dao of Mirage’.
“Hong.”
The ‘Mirage Origin’ in his body had finally exploded. It was developing towards the primal chaos cosmos. This represented stepping into the Primal Chaos realm in the laws and profound mysteries system.

chapters.title: Chapter 936 - Jing Qiu Exiting Closed-door Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 936: Jing Qiu Exiting Closed-door Cultivation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Primal chaos cosmos. That was the most primitive state the cosmos existed. Currently, the myriad existences had yet to emerge, and what it represented was boundless possibilities.
But for it to transform into an authentic cosmos was something difficult as the laws of the operating cosmos were much more complicated. This complexity was not disordered. Instead, it comprised of a perfected entity. As a result, many of the talented Primal Chaos existences were able to reach the ninth level Star Pagoda strength yet they could not break through.
The difficulty of breakthrough was too high.
According to history, those who broke through to the Cosmos God realm were at the very least at the eighth level strength! Even though no Star Pagoda existed during the primitive Ancient Sacred World era-and many experts from the Ancient Sacred World and Ancestor Mother world did not attempt the Star Pagoda before, their strength could be compared and judged. And it was determined that those who broke through to the Cosmos God realm were at the least peak eighth level existences with a strong foundation.
“Hong long long~” Within the cultivation room, a world energy vortex was formed. This vortex began collapsing with a voluminous amount of world energy surging right into this point. Endless energy was being absorbed into the cosmos inside Xue Ying’s body, causing the cosmos inside him to grow. This disturbance was relatively huge, incurring others within the Great Void Heaven Temple to guess what was happening.
With such a huge disturbance happening and the origin of it was at the Ling Yun peak? Did Elder Dong Bo break through to the Primal Chaos realm?
Some were saying: “He has only entered closed-door cultivation for 300 years. How can it be so fast! The Mirage technique displayed by Elder Dong Bo absorbs a huge amount of world energy too so it might be him practicing his technique.”
“Elder Dong Bo is at the seventh level strength. Isn’t it normal for him to reach the Primal Chaos realm in just 300 years?”
Many were discussing.
Though Xue Ying was in closed-door cultivation without being influenced by the discussions happening. Forefather Tian Yu and Primal Chaos Hall Master did not leak what happened as well.
…
After a long period.
Only then did the world energy vortex subside. The Primal Chaos Cosmos in his body was fully grown and completed.
‘Primal Chaos Cosmos is also called a miniature cosmos.’ Xue Ying could feel the cosmos created transformed from the Mirage Origin.’
This miniature cosmos was actually relatively vast.
The primal chaos energy movement within caused the rise and fall of many weaker illusory realms. This was ultimately a cosmos transformed using the Dao of Mirage as the origin. It was otherwise known as a ‘Mirage Miniature Cosmos’.
‘Now that the foundation is built, I hope I can succeed in growing this miniature cosmos, forming the myriad existences and turn it into a cosmos.’ Xue Ying thought. He then began augmenting his soul using the structural law of the newly comprehended ‘Mirage Miniature Cosmos’, though because Xue Ying had broken through in his ancient cultivation before this, the benefit it had to his soul was minimal-about 20 to 30%.
Cultivating other systems was like this.
The first breakthrough assisted his soul the most. Advances of any other systems would only be adding flowers to the brocade-the assistance other systems would have on the cultivator would become weaker and weaker.
Xue Ying then calmed himself down and continued comprehending the Dao of Mirage…
“Hua hua hua…”
After breaking through, Xue Ying began having many ideas regarding the operation of the Mirage Miniature Cosmos. He had once created the ‘Destruction Flower’ and experienced that sort of grand perfection ‘amazing feeling’. Naturally, Xue Ying sought to achieve that feeling on his Mirage Miniature Cosmos laws! This was the difference in those who reached the seventh level. Once the cultivator experienced this feeling, he would have a greater reason to pursue after it again.
With a clear direction and target, the Dao of Mirage was becoming more and more profound and mysterious.
“Hong.” After cultivating for about five million years or so, Xue Ying finally succeeded in cultivating the eighth transformation of the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance! This represented the seventh level strength in the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance. It was not an arduous task. Even those ordinary Primal Chaos existences could achieve this after cultivating for some time. Ba Yun Palace Master’s ‘Imperial Dragon inheritance’ had reached the seventh level strength as well.
But Ba Yun Palace Master no longer had any improvements after so long.
As for Xue Ying, he merely cultivated for just five million years! This was a frighteningly short period. One could foresee that the ninth transformation of Vermillion Nightmare inheritance was not difficult for Xue Ying to achieve.
‘It is getting slower.’
‘The more profound it is, the harder it is for me to comprehend the Dao of Mirage. The ninth transformation of Vermillion Nightmare inheritance will likely require me to spend a longer time.’ Xue Ying spent a total of 10 million years on the Dao of Mirage alone. He finally understood that he would have to spend ‘billions of years’ to comprehend the ninth transformation.
But if this were to be leaked, it sufficed to incur the jealousy and envy of many other Primal Chaos existences.
One had to know that Ancestor Devil cultivated for a very long time, relying on his six great incarnation techniques to attain the eighth level strength. One could see how difficult it was.
Nevertheless, Xue Ying did not have to go out and temper himself. He merely had to cultivate and spend a little more time deducing it just after entering closed-door cultivation for the first time after breaking through to reach the ninth transformation!
‘Time to train in the Dao of Slaughter first.’ Xue Ying felt that the improvements in the Dao of Mirage were becoming slower. Thus, he began training in another area he specialized in-Dao of Slaughter.
During the process of creating the “Destruction Flower”, Xue Ying had fused both Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter. He had experienced that feeling of grand perfection in the Dao of Slaughter before as well-this was something beneficial to his cultivation of the Dao of Slaughter.
After cultivating for half a month.
The Imperial Dragon inheritance reached the seventh transformation!
After cultivating for another 36 million years, Xue Ying reached the eighth transformation in the Imperial Dragon inheritance!
‘My talent in the Dao of Slaughter is indeed weaker than that of the Dao of Mirage.’ Xue Ying could make this judgment.
‘Time to begin.’
‘The current Vermillion Nightmare inheritance and Imperial Dragon inheritance are both at the eighth transformation… it is time for me to create the second style of “Destruction Flower”.’ Xue Ying’s eyes were filled with high expectations.
The Destruction Flower.
Being the creator, Xue Ying understood that the inherent Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Mirage had to reach an equilibrium. This was the premise of creating this technique.
“Hu hu…”
As a result.
In the cultivation room, many illusory worlds began appearing. But every time the world tried to grow a Destruction Flower, it would collapse. The current Xue Ying wielded the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter that was more profound than when he was at the Unity realm, and thus, the difficulty of re-creating the Destruction Flower had reduced. The reason was that creating the seventh level Destruction Flower at the Unity realm required an absolute grand perfection which represented the pinnacle. Currently, it was different. He could still deepen his understanding of the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter and was far from reaching the pinnacle. Thus, whenever he felt that the ‘Destruction Flower’ was lacking something, Xue Ying could always improve his understanding of both the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter to cover this weakness.
As a result, after just 38 million years later.
“Hua.”
A black flower bud floated within the cultivation room. Xue Ying emitted a happy look as he observed this flower. This black flower bud had a total of six black leaves, and six black petals too. Its structure was much more complicated.
‘Blossom.’ Xue Ying smiled.
The black flower bud blossomed, forming six petals.
The six black petals and black leaves directly crumbled apart to form six black airstreams crisscrossing one another. The entire inner section became pitch black, and everything was exterminated.
‘This move has become much stronger. It is so much stronger than the force exerted by seven Destruction Flowers stacked on one another.’ Xue Ying made his judgment, ‘Maybe it is at the eighth level strength?’ This was merely conjecture. Xue Ying had after all not gone off to the Star Pagoda to affirm it.
“Hu, hu, hu.”
The surrounding three illusory worlds formed a six-petal black flower each.
A total of three flowers were formed.
‘Its burden on my heart energy is too great. I can only unleash three flowers at the same time.’ Xue Ying thought, If I did not train in the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance, I should only be able to form a single flower.’
The Vermillion Nightmare inheritance had strengthened his soul to three or four times stronger than Primal Chaos existences at the same level.
Even though it had significantly strengthened his soul at the Unity realm, but it was because his soul was at the Unity level that made the effect so obvious. If a Primal Chaos giant were to train in the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance, with how strong his soul was, the assistance of the sixth transformation of Vermillion Nightmare inheritance would likely be less than two-folds! Thus, the strengthening of Xue Ying’s soul was not as evident when he reached the Primal Chaos realm.
But three to four times… was frightening enough!
******
Time passed.
It had been 190 million years since Xue Ying entered closed-door cultivation.
“Xue Ying, I am out.”
A message came.
Xue Ying who was currently cultivating opened his eyes with great joy and delight. His communication treasure spirit had long received the order to not disturb him unless something huge happened! But the message from his wife Jing Qiu was not blocked.
‘Jing Qiu is out?’ Xue Ying is full of joy.
“Hua.”
With a thought, space beside was torn. Xue Ying took a step before arriving at the distant hometown cosmos.
…
“Master, there is a lifeform who suddenly left the Great Void Heaven Temple.” A deep voice sounded within the courtyard. Forefather Tian Yu who seemed to be sleeping suddenly opened his eyes. He revealed a calm look, “Are there any special reasons why you are informing this to me?”
“Yes. I am unable to perceive the way he left the place. I can only ascertain that there was just a single being who left from the region I am supervising.” The treasure spirit’s deep voice continued.
Forefather Tian Yu’s expression turned solemn.
This treasure spirit was the most secretive and concealed protective array treasure spirit in the Great Void Heaven Temple. It had been refined by the collective effort of both Luo City Lord and Ancestor Sorcerer. With this protective array, the Great Void Heaven Temple was considered fortified and invulnerable to attacks. This protective array might not be able to prevent others from conducting the mysterious ‘ultra-long distance teleportation’, though it was able to supervise all beings within.
Any outsiders would immediately be discovered.
“Who?” Forefather Tian Yu asked. If it were Inquisitive Sky Hall Master who teleported someone away, the treasure spirit would not inform him.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying.” The treasure spirit said.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying?” Forefather Tian Yu was stunned. Closely following that, he asked, “Is it he who left by himself, or that he asked some other expert to bring him away?”
“It is he who left by himself.” The treasure spirit said.
Forefather Tian Yu was startled.
He left by himself?
The ultra-long distance teleportation was something extremely mysterious. Those of the Voidwalker lineage who specialized in controlling the void could achieve this after reaching the Cosmos God realm. Those of the Myriad World Tavern Master’s lineage could do it too. But there were only so few people who could achieve this. Furthermore, the rest and most commonly seen cultivators who could do this depended on ancient cultivation! There were all sorts of innate skills the ancient cultivators had, and one included ultra-long distance teleportation.
“He left himself? He can teleport through an ultra-long distance?” Forefather Tian Yu did not dare believe it.
Ultra-long distance teleportation was something essential.
The majority of Cosmos Gods could not do so. As a result, most would find someone who specialized in doing so within their organization to help them. Otherwise, they could only request a Primal Chaos giant who specialized in doing so to join their organization! Like the Great Void Heaven Temple, they had Inquisitive Sky Hall Master who specialized in doing this. That was how experts within the Great Void Heaven Temple could easily proceed to various places and even reach the boundary of the void swiftly.
Without him? The entire Great Void Heaven Temple would be hoodwinked!
“Isn’t Dong Bo Xue Ying’s ancient cultivation lineage the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance and the Imperial Dragon inheritance? Unless it is some innate skill or his talent in the void? Mn, he is a Voidwalker so it might really be related to his talent in something related to the void.” Forefather Tian Yu could not help but reveal a grin.

chapters.title: Chapter 937 - Bloodshed God-Emperor and the Others
chapters.content:
Chapter 937: Bloodshed God-Emperor and the Others
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Hometown Cosmos.
Black Fog Sea, inside Monarch Dong Bo residence.
“Sou.” The space distorted. Xue Ying walked out from it. He swept his gaze across the place and was able to see the deep-blue-robed girl standing beside the lake. With his strength, Xue Ying was able to easily discern that his wife had reached the True God Ruler realm. This was expected too since he had provided excellent scriptures and provided sufficient cultivation resources that could only be afforded by those weaker Primal Chaos existences after they sell all their belongings. But all the resources were merely used to promote someone to the True God Ruler realm. If this were leaked out, many would feel that it was a waste.
Jing Qiu felt the ripples. She turned over and revealed a joyous look: “Xue Ying!”
“Jing Qiu.” Xue Ying went over with a smile, “Not bad. You have reached the Ruler realm.”
“I was practically at the best cultivation state all the time, and have cultivated for a full 200 million years. By now, I do not feel that becoming a Ruler is something great anymore.” Jing Qiu could not help but ask, “Oh right, Xue Ying, you should be able to tell me what kind of treasure it is that is so mystical alright?”
At this moment, Jing Qiu did not discover that her husband had already become much stronger than previously. After all, the gap between the two was too huge. When Xue Ying kept his aura, Jing Qiu could not sense it at all.
“It is the Scarlet Cloud Pomegranate Core.” Xue Ying did not hide it from Jing Qiu. Instead, he began describing this item as well as the palace hall which was refined especially for cultivation to Jing Qiu.
Jing Qiu widened her eyes. She stuttered: “This, this… it can be used to purchase an existence comparable to the black god dog?”
The Wild Black Dog…
That time when it revealed its power, Jing Qiu knew about it. After hearing from Xue Ying, she knew that this was a Primal Chaos realm puppet which cost more than making a cosmos.
“It is at the lowest Primal Chaos realm level. With the arrays in the Starting Ground augmenting it, it has become slightly stronger.” Xue Ying said.
“Primal Chaos realm…” Jing Qiu remained astounded. She could guess that the treasures she was using were mystical, but the price was so huge that it astonished her. She went on saying: “Xue Ying, with how precious it is, it is certainly difficult for you to obtain it at the Unity realm right?”
Xue Ying chuckled, “I have already reached the Primal Chaos realm.”
Jing Qiu looked at her husband in surprise.
“Haha.” Xue Ying laughed.
Jing Qiu no longer said anything. She only embraced her husband.
In her heart, she understood that her husband had reached the Primal Chaos realm now, but was at the Unity realm in the past. He should have encountered countless dangers for the sake of seeking treasures which only ordinary Primal Chaos existences could afford after selling all their belongings.
“Everything is worth it.” Xue Ying felt warmth and calm in his heart. That time when he left his hometown cosmos, he was only at the True God Ruler, and Xue Ying spent it roaming in the primal chaos void. Even though he encountered many dangers, his fortune was good!
…
After Jing Qiu left her closed-door cultivation, and Xue Ying had stepped into the Primal Chaos realm, he understood that the Great Void Heaven Temple should have possibly discovered him taking the initiative to utilize the ultra-long distance teleportation right from within the palace! But this was because he took the initiative to reveal it. Reaching the Primal Chaos realm, there was no longer the need for him to hide it from the world. There were quite a few Primal Chaos giants in the primal chaos void and five great sacred worlds who specialized in the ultra-long distance teleportation.
“Teacher and Primal Master, the two of you are at the Void God level. Cultivating within the cosmos just by relying on those books aren’t that helpful. How about I bring you all to the Great Void Heaven Temple?” Xue Ying asked Bloodshed God-Emperor and Primal Master.
Previously, he had not done so because he wanted to hide his capabilities of ultra-long distance teleportation.
“Of course.” The eyes of Bloodshed God-Emperor were emitting light.
“Yes.” Primal Master was filled with expectations too.
The two were long interested in the holy ground for the laws and profound mysteries lineage, ‘Great Void Heaven Temple.’
“Go.”
Xue Ying left behind an incarnation in his hometown. He then used his true body to bring both Bloodshed God-Emperor and Primal Master to the Great Void Heaven Temple. The Great Void Heaven Temple paid quite a considerable importance to Bloodshed God-Emperor and Primal Master too! Because Swordmaster who came from this cosmos was too heaven-defying. Xue Ying was also quite dazzling. As such, they attached quite an importance on Bloodshed God-Emperor and Primal Master and were worth grooming. When Bloodshed God-Emperor reached there, he had completely immersed himself in reading the books. There were quite a few books on the hex cultivation lineage.
******
Hometown cosmos.
Study room.
The black-robed Xue Ying sat before his study table. He began writing many books that directly targeted the ‘Void God realm’. With his realm, it was quite easy for him to write these fundamental books, though he only specialized in several aspects, so the books were relatively lacking.
“Xue Ying.” Jing Qiu walked over.
“Jing Qiu.” Xue Ying place down the pen in his hands.
“Previously, you publicized the fact that those who reached the Void God level will be sent to the Great Void Heaven Temple. Unless you really plan to only send Yu’er, Qing Yao and your disciples once they become Void Gods too?” Jing Qiu asked.
Xue Ying nodded: “Mn, actually, it isn’t that safe in the holy grounds within the primal chaos void and the five great sacred worlds.”
He could not help but think about his teacher Gu Qi. That was a Cosmos God who was protected with the help of Ancestor Sorcerer…
Sacred Master did not heed the price and could kill his teacher. And according to his understanding, Sacred Master had done this to vent his anger. Clearly, he no longer had any patience, and might possibly incite a war at any time! The moment a war began, it was common for sacred worlds to shatter and Cosmos Gods to fall. As a result, Xue Ying was not in a rush to send the juniors over.
“Furthermore, there are fewer books and training in the hometown cosmos. There is less competition on the same level with them.” Xue Ying chuckled, “Even though the cultivation environment here is worse than within the holy ground, it is instead an opportunity for them to temper themselves.”
Tempering oneself in a worse environment might be able to improve one’s future potential. Naturally, there was another possibility-tempering for too long might cause one to lose his acute determination to improve. Many transcended True Gods were as such within the hometown cosmos-they lost their confidence. Even if they knew about the Great Void Heaven Temple, it was hard for them to completely change their attitude.
But Xue Ying would still guide his children and disciples, letting them understand that it was much better to cultivate within the Great Void Heaven Temple so as to maintain their fighting spirit.
“Let them properly cultivate within the hometown cosmos. Once this cosmos epoch is about to end, I will send them all away.” Xue Ying said.
“We will do according to what you said.” Jing Qiu similarly agreed after hearing Xue Ying’s plans.
…
Currently, being a Primal Chaos existence, the incarnation ‘black-robed Xue Ying’ could naturally stay for long periods in the hometown cosmos. His true body remained within the Great Void Heaven Temple cultivating.
He would occasionally come out of closed-door cultivation to meet with his teacher Bloodshed God-Emperor and Primal Master. He would also give some pointers to his disciple Xing Huo Xun Yi.
Bloodshed God-Emperor had been flipping through a voluminous amount of books after entering the Great Void Heaven Temple within the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall. After 300 million years, he stepped into the Unity realm, directly reaching the third level Star Pagoda strength. Nevertheless, after 10 billion years, Bloodshed God-Emperor remained at the peak of fourth level Star Pagoda strength. He still lacked by a strand from the ‘fifth level strength’! It was primarily because he cultivated the hex cultivation lineage, and was more talented in it than the laws and profound mysteries system.
Once the 10 billion years time limit was up, he could no longer stay within the Great Void Heaven Temple. He had to leave the Great Void Heaven Temple and take on the responsibility as an Outer Hall Elder. As for Primal Master? He remained at the Origin Birth realm. Even though in these 10 billion years, ‘Pang Yi’, ‘Monarch Green’, and ‘Purgatory Monarch’ had stepped into the Void God realm one after another and were sent over by Xue Ying, all of them were temporarily stuck at the Origin Birth realm. It was very difficult to break through in the laws and profound mysteries lineage.
Bloodshed God-Emperor stood in midair. He stared at the Great Void Heaven Temple, and also the cavern-dwelling of Xue Ying. He did not bid farewell. Being a teacher, he had his pride. Clearly, Bloodshed God-Emperor was filling unreconciled for not stepping into the fifth level Star Pagoda strength within the 10 billion years.
“I will be back.” Bloodshed God-Emperor turned around and left the Primal Chaos God Palace. He was sent to be stationed at one of the primal chaos cities.

chapters.title: Chapter 938 - Monarch Nine Cloud’s Four Diagrams
chapters.content:
Chapter 938: Monarch Nine Cloud’s Four Diagrams
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying stood within his cavern-dwelling courtyard. He was drinking by himself. Even though his teacher did not find him, Xue Ying was able to sense that his teacher had gone to the Primal Chaos God Palace.
‘It is too difficult to break through in the laws and profound mysteries system.’ Xue Ying thought.
Most cultivators in the laws and profound mysteries lineage would reach the third level Star Pagoda stage once they breakthrough to the Unity realm! The difficulty of becoming a ‘Void God’ was really high too as many golden-robed disciples were stuck at this bottleneck for a long period.
Pang Yi, Monarch Green and Purgatory Monarch were able to reach the Void God realm firstly because they cultivated for a sufficiently long period and secondly, it was because all their comprehension abilities were high. But it was not easy to reach the Unity realm. In this era of his hometown cosmos, other than Xue Ying, only Bloodshed God-Emperor had stepped into the Unity realm.
‘Teacher seems to specialize more in the hex cultivation.’ Xue Ying shook his head. He took a step before entering the cultivation room to continue his cultivation.
Their hometown cosmos had two dazzling eras. First was during the Swordmaster era and the other was this era of theirs. They were both relatively dazzling! But comparatively speaking, his era was still weaker since he was much weaker than Swordmaster, and his teacher Bloodshed God-Emperor was much weaker than Ancestor Devil. Ancestor Devil had reached the Unity realm in the hometown cosmos and was able to sweep across all Unity realm experts after entering the Great Void Heaven Temple. He then broke through to the Primal Chaos realm shortly after.
Compared to this, his teacher Bloodshed God-Emperor’s comprehension abilities were slightly weaker. And Xue Ying could still find reasons for why he was weaker than Swordmaster-he did not cultivate for long! But thinking about Swordmaster who could reach the Primal Chaos realm while still cultivating by himself in the hometown cosmos, he had broken through to the Cosmos God after arriving at the Great Void Heaven Temple without encountering any setbacks!
Even a peerless existence at the seventh level Unity realm would feel the chasm after looking at ‘Swordmaster’.
******
This time, Xue Ying had entered closed-door cultivation for the longest period. Even though he would occasionally come out and go to the Myriad Elephant Palace Hall to read books, he still cultivated in the Great Void Heaven Temple for 30 billion years or so.
Within the cultivation room.
The white-robed Xue Ying sat cross-legged there. His body was untainted by dust and was gradually becoming more transparent. As he became more and more transparent, Xue Ying eventually disappeared. But after a moment, the half-translucent white-robed Xue Ying appeared once again on the silvery-silk praying mat. He became more corporeal before finally regained his normal self.
‘The four diagram techniques of Monarch Nine Cloud are too difficult.’ Xue Ying frowned after opening his eyes. He shook his head.
Monarch Nine Cloud left behind four diagrams. The first three were completed, and the fourth was not.
