The first diagram made him grasp the essence of the structure of the void. Xue Ying had even peeped on the higher dimensional ‘world’, allowing him to comprehend the ability of ultra-long distance teleportation.
Hence, during long periods of cultivation, Xue Ying would naturally conscientiously cultivate in the “Walker’s Hidden Secret”. The “Walker’s Hidden Secret” was created by the Void Primogenitor and made use of the Primal Chaos void energy to evolve the body. It took a different route but would eventually lead to the same destination as what was provided by Monarch Nine Cloud, the strongest expert in the void aspect during the primitive Ancient Sacred World era. Even though the path taken by Monarch Nine Cloud was different from that taken by the Void Primogenitor, the improvement of his comprehension in the Walker’s Hidden Secret had deepened the understanding of those four profound diagrams.
Cultivating the four diagrams were similarly helpful to comprehending the “Walker’s Hidden Secret”.
Currently, Xue Ying had reached the 46th level in the “Walker’s Hidden Secret”! Nevertheless, the 41st level to the 50th level represented the Primal Chaos realm, and it would only become harder during the later levels.
‘This second and third diagram is too difficult.’ Xue Ying shook his head, ‘Maybe I might be able to comprehend them only after becoming a Cosmos God.’
The second diagram sought to ‘void-ify’ one’s body. As the Voidwalker become stronger, his body would also become more effective in ‘void-ification’. It could dissipate more force from enemy attacks. According to the final goal of the Voidwalker lineage, one would seek to void-ify his body to the limit and to become one entity with the primal chaos void. The Voidwalker would naturally be part of the primal chaos void.
This was not referring to the ordinary void, but it was referring to the essence of the entire primal chaos void, a ‘hidden existence’.
When experts fought and fought, everything happened within the primal chaos void. None were able to fight beyond the primal chaos void and touch the ‘higher dimensional world’. As a result, to become one with the essence of the primal chaos void through void-ification meant that the enemy could not kill him!
‘But my teacher is still killed by the Sacred Master.’ Xue Ying shook his head, ‘The attack by the Sacred Master can tear through the other party even after fusing one with the essence of the primal chaos void?’
Being the strongest expert, the strength of the Sacred Master was beyond his imaginations. He only knew that Monarch Nine Cloud was heavily injured and eventually fell despite reaching large success in both the second and third diagrams.
The third diagram…
That sought the control of the void. Voidwalkers specialized in controlling the void too. They could even ultra-long distance great teleportation after reaching the Cosmos God level! But this third diagram sought something different. It sought to reach the pinnacle of the miniature aspect, to control the essence of the primal chaos void, the hidden existence which was in the shape of ‘black fog spheres’. When the cultivator was able to control and dissect them apart, it would no longer cause any obstructions. The cultivator would then be able to understand the ‘higher dimensional world’ more deeply.
‘The two diagrams represented two directions. Void-ifying to the limit and controlling the void to the limit.’ Xue Ying being a Voidwalker at the Primal Chaos realm understood part of these two diagrams. But to reach ‘large success’, he asked himself and knew he had to reach the Cosmos God realm.
It was difficult!
As for the fourth diagram… Monarch Nine Cloud had not finished it! He merely left behind a partially completed diagram which Xue Ying did not even understand.
If someone merely cultivated the “Walker’s Hidden Secret” to the 46th level, he would be much weaker in terms of controlling the void and body void-ification as compared to Xue Ying. One could see how amazing this incomplete absolute art created by Monarch Nine Cloud was.
…
“Hong long long~”
The stone door opened. Xue Ying walked out of the cultivation room. At the same time, he sent a message to Forefather Tian Yu: “Forefather, I am ready to start the 13th palace hall.”
“Alright.” Forefather Tian Yu guffawed.
Xue Ying spent about 30 billion years after breaking through to the Primal Chaos realm to consolidate his foundation. This was considered short amongst many Primal Chaos existences.
…
“Dang~ Dang~ Dang~”
The bell of the Great Void Palace Hall sounded across the entire Great Void holy ground.
Many disciples could guess that it was the celebration of Elder Dong Bo promoting to the ‘Primal Chaos realm’ this time. The ceremony of reaching the Primal Chaos realm would merely be held internally. If he were to become a Cosmos God, the celebration would be arranged on a grander scale, with many holy grounds dispatching their experts over to attend and congratulate the cultivator.
Very soon, this news spread out.
The 13th palace hall has been created in the Great Void Heaven Temple, and was called the ‘Mirage Palace Hall’. The hall master was Xue Ying! Furthermore, the Great Void Heaven Temple would also create a 13th ‘Primal Chaos city’-the ‘Mirage City’. It would also be constructed such that it was linked directly to other cities. This was a colossal engineering process, and the moment it was completed, Xue Ying would also send his incarnation down to the Mirage City to protect it. The incarnation would usually be spent sleeping.
During sleeping, Xue Ying would practically not be spending any heart energy.
“Brother Dong Bo, look at you!”
“We have been waiting for this for a long time. Brother Dong Bo has cultivated for tens of billions of years after reaching the Primal Chaos realm. I wonder how strong are you now.”
“Right right right, let us see how amazing a seventh level Unity Realm expert is.”
“My Great Void Heaven Temple has never had someone reaching the seventh level at the Unity realm before you. I’ve heard how the Jade Light Sacred Territory and Blade Emperor City would frequently brag about it.”
The majority of the hall masters were incarnations. They flew with Xue Ying across the sky towards the Star Pagoda. The true bodies of the hall masters did not dare leave the boundary of the void.
“Rest assured. I will try my best.” Xue Ying said.
“The Heart Imitation Religious Master has entered closed-door cultivation for 130 billion years after reaching the Primal Chaos realm, and after coming out, he is at the peak of the eighth level. Jade Light Sacred Territory’s Great Emperor Jin Yi is even more dazzling. He spent a mere 8 billion years or so to reach the peak of the eighth level. Currently, the two of them are at the ninth level Star Pagoda strength.”
“Right right, you must not lose out to them.”
The other hall masters were saying.
“Alright, fellow hall masters, then I’ll first enter.” Xue Ying was located far away from the Star Pagoda. He then turned into a stream of light and rushed right through the entrance of the pagoda.

chapters.title: Chapter 939 - Ninth Level Star Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 939: Ninth Level Star Pagoda
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The cold wind was blowing as Forefather Tian Yu enjoyed his wine with his eyes closed. He revealed a look of bliss.
‘This old man only wishes to drink a few more cups of wine and live through such carefree days. After that, I can teach some junior disciples when I am free. But it is impossible for that to happen now. Sacred Master wants to control the entire primal chaos void and even wants me to become his puppet? To serve him loyally for eternity? He is truly a madman! Those Destruction Devils are also appearing endlessly, and the current situation is becoming worse. Ai, what a headache, a headache! Ancestor Sorcerer, World Ancestor, Blade Emperor, other Cosmos Gods and those who are plotting in the dark, why can’t you strive to get rid of the Sacred Master? By then, everyone will be able to live freely.’ Forefather Tian Yu shook his head.
‘There is only Swordmaster who emerged in my laws and profound mysteries lineage who is much more formidable than me.’ Forefather Tian Yu lamented, ‘That Dong Bo Xue Ying specialized in ultra-long distance teleportation too, and can help put out fire across the world. He is able to provide a great helping hand.’
Between experts who were at the ninth level Star Pagoda, those who could teleport through an ultra-long distance were much more useful!
When they encountered dangers, they could swiftly escape! After all, asking someone for help to teleport would take too much time.
‘This brat has started the trials in the Star Pagoda.’ Forefather Tian Yu chuckled. He was enjoying his wine while watching a projection in front. It was none other than Xue Ying entering the eighth level of the Star Pagoda.
‘I hope he can break through to the ninth level Star Pagoda in one fell swoop.’ Forefather Tian Yu looked forward to it. Closely following that, he chuckled because he knew even though Xue Ying was talented-a seventh level Unity realm expert, and that it was highly possible for him to reach the ninth level in the future, most would still require some time to train and grow.
‘Maybe there might be some miracle?’ Forefather Tian Yu thought. With the miracle of Swordmaster breaking through to the Cosmos God after entering closed-door cultivation happening once, Forefather Tian Yu could easily accept any other miracles happening a second time.
And in that projection in front of him, Xue Ying began his battle.
…
Within the space at the eighth level of Star Pagoda.
There was similarly a huge battle platform just as the Star Pagoda in Blade Emperor City. A golden light began appearing across the veined patterns on the surface of the battle platform. The golden light soon condensed and turned into a golden-armored Destruction Devil. This was a Destruction Devil who had a total of hundred metallic pigtails, with each braid causing the surrounding void to distort.
“Primal Chaos existence from the Great Void Heaven Temple? Someone who just broke through? I’ve never seen you before in the past.” This golden-armored Destruction Devil had six eyes in total, with two on a row. The three rows of eyes were emitting golden light constantly.
Suddenly, an enormous fiery red bird appeared behind Xue Ying. It spread out its enormous wings. The red airstream began dispersing in waves, enclosing around the entire battle platform causing this golden-armored Destruction Devil to sway. He would shake his head at times, and fall into a daze at times.
‘Indeed, the rumors are true. These Destruction Devils are much weaker than ordinary cultivators in resisting against the illusory realm. Even if I reach the ninth transformation in my Vermillion Nightmare inheritance, it will only be comparable to the eighth level Star Pagoda strength! To the ordinary eighth level Star Pagoda expert, it will merely influence them and not bring about a decisive change to the outcome.’ Xue Ying thought.
But it was clear that the Destruction Devil in front had been significantly affected by his technique. It was likely that he could only exert 10% to 20% of his original strength.
“Damn, damn.” The golden-armored Destruction Devil was shaking his head from time to time as he sought to maintain consciousness.
But the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance was different from the Dao of Mirage. With the fusion of that red stream of air, its power became stronger and could propel the other party into the illusory realm continuously.
‘Let me try this.’
With a thought, a black flower bud emerged from the illusory world into reality. It enveloped the golden-armored Destruction Devil. It was none other than the six-petaled Destruction Flower. The golden-armored Destruction Devil felt himself being wrapped by the black flower bud and was barely able to send a fist out as he tried maintaining his consciousness. “Boom”, it blasted on the black flower bud. But at the same time, the flower bud began blossoming and started to explode.
“Hong long~” The destructive power cut through a massive wound on the body of the golden-armored Destruction Devil.
‘It can injure him.’ Xue Ying considered, ‘But to win, I would have to unleash a single six-petal Destruction Flower many times.’
‘That is just wasting time.’
‘Three flowers!’
Xue Ying tried again.
This time, three ‘six-petal boundary’ Destruction Flowers appeared, genuinely injuring this golden-armored Destruction Devil. The golden armor on him almost shattered, revealing a savage and unpleasant-looking injury. Nevertheless, its hundred metallic pigtails frantically fused into his body, allowing him to hold on further. There were streams of golden light flowing on the surface of his body, allowing him to recover.
‘Six flowers.’
“Boom~”
Six ‘six-petal boundary’ Destruction Flowers came stacked on top of one another. The bigger flowers enveloped around the smaller ones. Eventually, they all erupted, blasting on the body of the golden-armored Destruction Devil such that there were only several metallic pigtails left behind covering its bones. Closely following that, the golden light surged and began healing the devil again. Xue Ying was not in a rush. Instead, he let it continued recovering until it was perfectly well again.
‘Nine flowers!’
Now, a total of nine ‘six-petal boundary’ Destruction Flowers came stacked on top of one another. Their power was frightening. If one said that a single flower could merely injure the golden-armored Destruction Devil, then nine flowers were beyond what this Destruction Devil could withstand. After the disturbance created by the destruction, those firm metallic pigtails were utterly shattered. This time, the golden light tunneled back underneath the battle platform.
Xue Ying had clearly won!
‘Nine flowers enabled me to win in just a single strike?’ Xue Ying softly nodded.
…
Forefather Tian Yu was watching the battle. He nodded slightly before revealing a grin: ‘This flower technique Dong Bo created is indeed an amazing move. With nine flowers used together, it has barely touched upon the peak of the eighth level standard. Now, it is time for us to see what happens on the ninth level…’
…
Xue Ying looked up at the enormous vortex which appeared in the sky. He turned into a stream of light before charging up through that gigantic maelstrom, arriving at the final level of the Star Pagoda-the ninth level!
There was a god palace ahead.
And within the god palace stood a throne with a sculpture seated on it. Beside him were eight other sculptures. All were in the shape of Destruction Devils, albeit they were in the appearances of gray sculptures without having any aura whatsoever.
The sculpture at the throne was able to see Xue Ying who stood at the public square just outside the god palace doors with a single glance.
“Kill!”
An unseen voice reverberated across the entire ninth level Star Pagoda. It seemed to come from the sculpture, and from the world.
“Hua hua hua hua…”
On the public square, many veined patterns began lighting up in golden. The golden light soon condensed over at various locations into golden-armored Destruction Devils. A total of nine golden-armored Destruction Devils appeared. They were in all shapes and sizes. Some were tall and big, some were small and thin. Some were charming, some were like shadows.
What was common would be that they gave off stronger aura than the single golden-armored Destruction Devil Xue Ying met on the eighth level.
‘I have to kill all of them to qualify for the ninth level strength.’ Xue Ying was clear that the opponents in front were hard to deal with. If he could sweep them all clean, it would represent that he had reached the Cosmos God level regarding combat skills. Even though he would still be weaker than any Cosmos Gods, Xue Ying would have stepped into that level.
‘I must do my best.’ Xue Ying’s eyes were blazing with fervor. Previously, he had casually dealt with the opponent on the eighth level. But this level did not allow him to be careless at all.
“There is actually another formidable brat from the Great Void Heaven Temple who reached the ninth level.”
“Move.”
“Kill him.”
The nine golden-armored Destruction Devils moved at the same time.
“Xiu.”
Xue Ying moved too. His movement led to his disappearance from the battle platform. Xue Ying had begun to show his horrifying control of the void.

chapters.title: Chapter 940 - Endurance Match
chapters.content:
Chapter 940: Endurance Match
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Fix!” One of the thin and small Destruction Devils let out a faint light from his single eye. It illuminated the entire battle platform. The space within the platform became like a swamp. One could even see Xue Ying’s blurred figure with the naked eyes, though in this congealed swamp-like space, Xue Ying could still travel several tens of thousands of kilometers with a flash. He had easily encircled around the nine Destruction Devils in search of an opportunity.
“His control of the space is extremely formidable. We aren’t able to teleport yet he could.” The nine Destruction Devils looked towards each other, knowing that things were awry.
One side could teleport.
And the other could not. Hence, it was impossible for them to take the initiative in attacking the other party!
This was normal since Xue Ying was a Voidwalker who reached the 46th level. Furthermore, he cultivated in the four-diagrams absolute art created by Monarch Nine Cloud. Monarch Nine Cloud was the strongest expert during the primitive Ancient Sacred World era in the control of the void and specialized more in the utilization and control of the void. And Void Primogenitor was the current strongest expert in the current era of primal chaos void. He specialized more in using the primal chaos void energy to metamorphose the body. Both cultivated in different directions.
Xue Ying as someone who cultivated both techniques became more amazing in all aspects of the void.
“Exterminate.”
Xue Ying began acting.
He used all his strength the moment he acted.
“Hua, hua, hua.” Many beautiful black flower buds began appearing, causing a horrifying world energy vortex to appear in this ninth level Star Pagoda space. The collapsing area within the vortex formed a point where energy frantically congregated. A total of 19 six-petaled black flower buds appeared, with one enveloping the other. The innermost flower wrapped around the thin and small Destruction Devil who was trying to control the space.
19 flowers!
This was the current limit of Xue Ying.
That time when he reached the eighth transformation realm in the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance and the Imperial Dragon inheritance, and when he just created the six-petal boundary Destruction Flower, he could only form three flowers at once! But in the 30 billion years of cultivation after that, given how high his talent in the Dao of Mirage was, Xue Ying had reached the ninth transformation realm in the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance in one fell swoop.
Though he did not advance as much in the Imperial Dragon inheritance. Even though Xue Ying had improved his understanding of the Dao of Slaughter, he had not reached large success in the ‘ninth transformation of Imperial Dragon’!
Since Xue Ying had not reached large success, he could not create a Destruction Flower of a higher level. Actually, Xue Ying understood too that even if he reached the ninth transformation in the Imperial Dragon inheritance, trying to create a more perfected third style of Destruction Flower was seeking absolute grand perfection. The difficulty of creation was extremely high.
And now?
Firstly, because he had grasped the ninth transformation of Vermillion Nightmare inheritance and the peak of the eighth transformation in the Imperial Dragon inheritance, his realm had reached a deeper stage. Thus, he was able to slightly alter the ‘six-petal boundary Destruction Flower’, making it more concise. And when a cultivator with a more profound realm utilized this move, Xue Ying did not have to spend much heart energy. He only needed one-third of the energy required to create the six-petaled Destruction Flower in the past.
Secondly, the ninth transformation of Vermillion Nightmare had multiplied the strength of Xue Ying’s soul by two times as compared to when he was at the eighth transformation!
These two reasons sufficed to allow Xue Ying in reaching the new upper limit of 19 six-petal boundary Destruction Flowers. This was also his reason for trying out the ninth level Star Pagoda. After all, it was vital to have sufficient offensive power. Otherwise, it was impossible to break through the most fundamental defenses of the Destruction Devils. Everything would become a joke by then.
“Hong~” The 19 six-petal boundary Destruction Flowers blossomed at the same time.
That thin and small Destruction Devil could not dodge at all. He could only withstand this move. Nevertheless, his strength was connected to the other eight Destruction Devils as if they were one entity-their defenses were considered one entity too.
This was the frightening aspect of the Destruction Devils.
With defenses as one entity…
If Xue Ying could not break the defenses of the other party, he could not injure them.
“Hua~” That thin and small Destruction Devil had a faint gold light circulating on the surface of his body. It was able to resist the destructive power from the 19 blossoming Destruction Flowers momentarily before collapsing apart. The surface armor of that Destruction Devil had also torn apart, with his muscles and bones breaking from the force. But under the golden light, he recovered swiftly.
“He could actually break our defenses, and do not have to engage in close combat with us?”
The nine Destruction Devils immediately understood.
This Primal Chaos existence could depend on teleportation to force them in consuming their energy away.
“Kill.”
“Kill.”
The nine Destruction Devils began displaying their berserk moves.
“Hong, hong, hong…”
The nine Destruction Devils exploded open. They formed a golden light that charged out in all directions. Almost instantaneously, the entire battle platform was covered by the dense golden light. Xue Ying was naturally covered by it. A large amount of golden light encircled around Xue Ying.
‘This damnable destructive energy.’ A black armor immediately appeared on the body of Xue Ying. He completely unleashed his Imperial Dragon inheritance. Furthermore, his body began to void-ify as well as he tried to dissipate the corrosive energy from this destructive energy.
“Die for me, die, die!”
Xue Ying was frantically throwing the 19 Destruction Flowers time after time. “Boom~””Boom~””Boom~” Often times, there would be dissipation in the dense golden light across the entire battle platform.
…
“Not bad, not bad.” Forefather Tian Yu’s eyes were emitting light as he spectated the match.
This was the final move which the Destruction Devils would usually exert-to release their body into golden light! Because this golden light was their core foundation, and they would depend on it to recover as they got injured. Should their body decompose completely into golden light, they would no longer have any protection.
The golden light could be used to escape in all directions! Every single part of the light contained sentience that knew how to teleport and escape.
That was why it would not be that easy to kill the Destruction Devils if they were not in this sealed environment. The moment they felt things were awry, they would decompose their bodies and escape in all directions! Cultivators could not do so.
Another…
Was when they turning mad!
The ‘destructive energy’ which the Destruction Devils had could corrode common materials within the primal chaos void. Even stronger experts could be corroded to death if there was sufficient destructive energy! Thus, when the Destruction Devils turned into its essence origin, the destructive golden energy which was used to corrode the other experts, it would only happen when they no longer had any means of winning. They were throwing their lives just to try and kill the other party.
…
‘This corrosion energy.’
Xue Ying might be physically strong, but the scaled-armor had merely reached the level of upper-graded Void God weapon. His fleshy body was comparatively weaker. Fortunately, his ‘void-ification’ capabilities were high. Furthermore, he was hiding in the Mirage World too, allowing him to hold on for a more extended period. For those like Ba Yun Palace Master who could merely depend on his body to withstand against the attack, it was unlikely for him to hold on for as long as Xue Ying could.
‘Kill, kill, kill…’ Xue Ying was frantically sending down his Destruction Flowers. The dense golden light present on the battle platform was becoming weaker steadily.
This was a battle of endurance.
The Destruction Devils did not have any defenses. They used their organic life destructive energy to try and fight against Xue Ying to see who lasts longer!
Just after ten breaths of time or so, the expression of Xue Ying changed.
‘I can’t hold on any longer.’ Xue Ying did not dare to take the risk.
“I admit defeat.”
Very soon, he was teleported out by the treasure spirit of the Star Pagoda.
And the remaining golden light soon condensed back into six golden-armored Destruction Devils. But their auras were weak. It seemed there were six… but in reality, all of them were heavily injured. The other three had already died! More than 70% of their overall destructive energy had been consumed by Xue Ying’s techniques, and if Xue Ying could hold on for another seven breaths of time, he would likely win.
It’s a pity that the destructive energy corroding his body became more concentrated over time, making it harder for Xue Ying to persist.
‘I am still ultimately defeated.’ Xue Ying was expelling the destructive energy in his body with the help of the treasure spirit of Star Pagoda. It was only after a long period did he finally completely discharge the energy. His face remained pale.
‘At least I forced them to give up their bodies, and for them to use their origin energy to fight a battle of endurance with me! Ultimately, I did not win.’ Xue Ying shook his head.
He left the Star Pagoda.
Outside the Star Pagoda, there were many hall masters from the Great Void Heaven Temple waiting.
“Dong Bo is out. How is it?”
“How is it?”
All of them turned towards Xue Ying.
“Should be considered the peak of the eighth level. The ninth level is too difficult.” Xue Ying shook his head.
“The peak of the eighth level? Amazing.”
“You have only broken through to the Primal Chaos realm and consolidated once. It is amazing already.” Many of the hall masters felt that Xue Ying was formidable, though this was normal since the other party had reached the seventh level of strength without becoming a Primal Chaos expert.
Xue Ying’s expression suddenly changed. He then said: “Forefather summoned me over. I’ll have to make a move first.”
“Go, go.”
“You will no longer be so carefree from now on.” The hall masters were teasing.
…
Xue Ying arrived at where Forefather Tian Yu stayed. Within the courtyard, he saw Forefather Tian Yu who was leisurely drinking his wine.
“Forefather.” Xue Ying greeted.
“Not bad, not bad, I thought you would have to spend a long time before reaching the ninth level Star Pagoda strength. But it seems that you can easily reach the ninth level after cultivating for a while and going out to temper yourself once.” Forefather Tian Yu praised.
Nevertheless, Xue Ying understood the gap between his current self and the ninth level.
To reach the ninth level?
His offense had to become stronger! If his offense became stronger, he could consume all those destructive energies in a shorter period. But those like ‘Monarch Xing Huo’ and Primal Chaos Hall Master were excellent in close combat. They could get rid of all the Destruction Devils in direct combat at the ninth level. Their offense was much stronger than his 19 Destruction Flowers.
As for Xue Ying’s, he could not significantly improve it in a short period unless he came out with the third style.
To him…
The only way to improve quickly was to strengthen his defenses! If his Imperial Dragon inheritance were to reach the ninth transformation large success, the surface scaled-armor of his would be comparable to peak-graded Void God weapons. That would allow him to last for a more extended period. Besides with his more profound ‘void-ification’ and the illusory world, his defenses would enable him to look down on all other Primal Chaos experts.
With a stronger defense, he could last a longer period and consume all those Destruction Devils to death.
‘This path might seem relatively easier, but I am still weak amongst those at the ninth level Star Pagoda strength. Only experts like Black Emperor are considered strong.’ Xue Ying thought. The Black Emperor was truly sick. All his techniques had reached an ultimate level. Even Cosmos Gods could hardly deal against him.
“Right now, what you need to do is to temper yourself.” Forefather Tian Yu chuckled, “And it is appropriate for you to visit the boundary of the void now, fighting countless battles to temper yourself. Wait until you reach the ninth level strength, and I will have an important matter that I can entrust to you. You are the most appropriate person for this job. By then, the six great holy grounds will hold an important rite for you.”
“Oh?” Xue Ying felt puzzled, “An important matter?”

chapters.title: Chapter 941 - Hiding
chapters.content:
Chapter 941: Hiding
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Yes, an important matter.” Forefather Tian Yu nodded, “Ever since the primitive Ancient Sacred World shattered, the primal chaos void is continuously expanding. There are also Destruction Devils emerging from the boundary of the void. During this period, there are more and more Destruction Devils appearing, and the pressure we currently face in resisting against them is becoming greater. They are here for destruction. Maybe this vast primal chaos void desires to destroy us and re-create an entirely new world. Even though we might be strong, in front of the supreme law, we are as strong as ants.”
Xue Ying was startled.
He thought about how he had once perceived the higher dimensional world through the holes within the ‘black fog spheres’.
“Even though the number of Destruction Devils is growing, we believe that we are able to defend ourselves well and prevent them from breaking through us.” Forefather Tian Yu solemnly said, “Not too long after I’ve roamed around the primal chaos void and created a few cosmos, at the time approximately during the fifth epoch of your hometown cosmos, we discovered that Destruction Devils are hiding within the five great sacred worlds!”
“What!” Xue Ying was startled, “The Destruction Devils have entered the five great sacred worlds? Aren’t we always intercepting them before they enter our primal chaos void?”
Even he had only heard that the Destruction Devils were entirely resisted by the perfect defenses without any breaking into this place!
“We thought we did a good job defending the void, but reality showed otherwise. This is unquestionable. There are indeed Destruction Devils who have entered and hide among us.” Forefather Tian Yu shook his head, “After thinking thoroughly, we merely assumed that we had been able to defend against the Destruction Devils perfectly despite them killing their way to the final spatial barrier. Nevertheless, there should be at least once when the net had broken, allowing those fishes to bypass the final spatial barrier.”
“As of now, we have discovered more than a hundred traces of the Destruction Devils. They are all golden-armored Destruction Devils. We can ascertain that there are at least 15 different golden-armored Destruction Devils, and they are extremely cunning and vigilant. Furthermore, they have the capabilities of altering their auras. Usually, they would be disguising themselves as ordinary cultivators. Only when they massacred us, cultivators, would they reveal themselves to the world. Thus, as of now, we have not been able to capture any single one of them.”
“They come to this world for the sake of destruction. Thus, it is impossible for them not to grab hold of every single opportunity to start a large-scale massacre.”
“To this, we have been telling others that it has been some huge devour-class devil killing wantonly! We have never told the public that these incidents have been caused by the Destruction Devils.”
Forefather Tian Yu shook his head, “Furthermore, the more Destruction Devils there are at the boundary of the void, the greater the number of large-scale assaults they would incite, allowing them to kill their way to the final spatial barrier more frequently. In the end, we were able to discover traces of the Destruction Devils more regularly in large-scale massacres within the five great sacred worlds and the primal chaos void.”
“Everyone understood.”
“That currently, we still have the upper hand. But the longer we wait, the fewer advantages we will have, until a certain point in time which we might just be on the disadvantaged end, and lose to the assault by the Destruction Devils.”
“It’s a pity that the Sacred Master isn’t willing to help. If he were, we would have an easier time.”
Xue Ying turned silent.
Even if Sacred Master helped, he would merely delay the final outcome of destruction.
“Maybe the Sacred Master understood this, that the Destruction Devils will become wilder in the future. And he no longer has his previous patience any longer.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “The Sacred Master during the early period is extremely patient. For the sake of certain goals, he would hide for a very long time. But this time, he had chosen to sacrifice part of his origin source energy which he accumulated for a long time to kill your teacher Gu Qi. It was not for the sake of obtaining some benefits, but just because he wanted to vent his anger? This was something the Sacred Master would definitely not do in the past.”
“Trouble internally and aggression from the outside.”
Forefather Tian Yu shook his head, “Naturally, we aren’t worried about the Sacred Master since he can’t change the final outcome of this situation! In the end, it is the Destruction Devils who are the most threatening ones. There might be a day when this primal chaos void is destroyed, and we are merely delaying it. The longer we delay, the better since it is possible for miracles to happen after a longer period.”
“We are already doing our best in the defense against the Destruction Devils at the boundary of the void.”
“Currently, we are only worried about the Destruction Devils who are hiding amongst us. They are extremely careful. Even when the Cosmos Gods chased after them in the dark, they seemed to be able to perceive them, and would not show their true selves at all! And it is impossible for Primal Chaos experts to triumph against them. If these giants are not careful, they might even lose their lives. Of the 10 Primal Chaos existences which died the most recently, two died at the boundary of the void fighting the war. Another two died due to internal conflict. As for the final six, they had been assassinated by the Destruction Devils who hid amongst us.”
“Ah.” Xue Ying was shocked. In his heart, the names of the ten Primal Chaos experts who died most recently appeared.
“We have always been hiding this secret because we are worried about causing terror and panic amongst the cultivators.” Forefather Tian Yu said.
“Ai…”
“When Cosmos Gods come close, they will not dare to show themselves.”
“And it is not certain that the Primal Chaos giants could kill them. Even though there are some who had ninth level combat power, they did not dare to take the risk.” Forefather Tian Yu shook his head, “After all, there are two peak eighth level experts who died.”
“Thus, we have always been hoping to find a cultivator with ninth level combat power who had the escaping capability of ‘ultra-long distance teleportation’ to chase after the Destruction Devils.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “But there are ultimately too few experts at the ninth level combat power. As for those who had ultra-long distance teleportation, there are only three in total before you.”
Xue Ying knew this too.
There were very few who could do ultra-long distance teleportation. Cosmos Gods who could do this could be counted with one’s fingers. Because there were more Primal Chaos existences, there was a batch of them, though only three were at the ‘ninth level Star Pagoda strength’.
“One is from the Ancient Sacred Religion, and one is from the Ancestor Mother Religion. The final one belongs to the Myriad Realm Tavern Master lineage.” Forefather Tian Yu felt helpless, “And there are actually none within the six great holy grounds and the Myriad Ancient Sacred World.”
“But now, you are our hope.” Forefather Tian Yu looked at Xue Ying.
“You know ultra-long distance teleportation, and has reached the peak of eighth level currently! The moment you reached the ninth level, you will be the best person for this.” Forefather Tian Yu said.
Xue Ying nodded. But he could not help but ask: “There are even two peak eighth level experts who died, and we do not even have the time to go save them. Is it possible for those hiding Destruction Devils to be at the Cosmos God level?”
“This is also why we felt that the ninth level expert must know ultra-long distance teleportation for him to be the optimal person of choice.” Forefather Tian Yu said solemnly, “Even though we do not have the evidence, we suspect that there might possibly be Cosmos God Destruction Devils hiding amongst us! And those who reached the ninth level will at least be able to survive for a while and hold his ground against the enemies. He could depend on the ultra-long distance teleportation to survive better.”
“Naturally, we will also prepare a huge gift for you! With this huge gift, in addition to your own strength, you will naturally be in good hands.” Forefather Tian Yu said.
“After that… you should focus on survival during your cultivation, strengthening this aspect as much as you could.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “Your current survival capabilities are ranked in the top 30 amongst those at the Primal Chaos realm, but if you were to train the “Imperial Dragon inheritance” to the ninth transformation, along with your ‘void-fication’ capabilities and your true body hiding in the Mirage, you should be ranked in the top 10 with your survival capabilities.”
Xue Ying understood.
There were only about 20 Primal Chaos giants at the ninth level, yet there was a huge bunch of those at the peak of the eighth level! If he were to train his Imperial Dragon inheritance to the eighth transformation, his bodily defenses would be ranked beyond 100. After all, the fleshy body of those devour-class cultivators was quite powerful too. There are even the strongest warrior system and the hex cultivation… with those ancient cultivators with a unique talent, there would thus be quite a few who were great with their survival capabilities.
Xue Ying’s bodily defenses were ranked in the top 30, and that was terrifying. If he were ranked in the top 10, Xue Ying would likely be able to resist against the attacks of Cosmos Gods.
“By then, accompanied with this huge gift prepared by us, you should be safer.” Forefather Tian Yu chuckled, “Naturally, you are still slightly weaker concerning your offense. Currently, you are ranked at the top 50 amongst those at the Primal Chaos realm! In the future, we do hope for you to deal with those extremely powerful Destruction Devils who hide amongst us. If you could not kill them in a short period, they would definitely escape after splitting up their body.”
“Understood.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Go to the boundary of the void. Properly cultivate. Many of those who reached the ninth level strength have achieved it because they underwent many battles, tempering themselves at the boundary of the void.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying was looking forward to it too.
Fighting with the Destruction Devils at the boundary of the void… tempering himself was one aspect. The other aspect was that after killing the Destruction Devils, they would vaporize and form some unique energy that was similar to that of the Origin World Rock energy. Absorbing it would be helpful to his soul. Furthermore, the stronger the Destruction Devil he killed, the greater this nourishment would be to his soul. Ordinary gray-armored ‘Destruction Devils’ would only give off energy comparable to an ordinary Origin World Rock. The blood-armored Destruction Devils would give an effect much better than an Origin World Rock. As for the golden-armored Destruction Devils, they were even more amazing since it was nourishment for the essence of their souls.
As a result, gaining combat experience was one thing. Xue Ying would also be raising the quality of his soul by battling there. That was why the majority of the ninth level Star Pagoda Primal Chaos existences appeared after tempering themselves there.

chapters.title: Chapter 942 - Eating the Origin World Rock
chapters.content:
Chapter 942: Eating the Origin World Rock
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Oh right, do you need any preparations this time before you go to the boundary of the void?” Forefather Tian Yu chuckled, “Your teacher has left behind quite a few treasures for you. There is no point not using them.”
His teacher had prepared all the necessary resources to cultivate in both Vermillion Nightmare and Imperial Dragon inheritances. But to Gu Qi, this was just a paltry amount compared to the treasures he left behind.
“I indeed need to make some preparations.” Xue Ying said, “I require 100,000 Origin World Rocks.”
“100,000 Origin World Rocks?” Forefather Tian Yu was startled, “To eat them?”
“Right.” Xue Ying nodded.
Forefather Tian Yu chuckled: “Alright. There should most likely be few in history who can afford to eat 100,000 Origin World Rocks at the Primal Chaos realm willingly. At least I only know two of them.”
Some were able to obtain a huge harvest due to certain miraculous encounters. They would not publicize this fact after eating them.
“100,000 Origin World Rocks should be quite helpful to a Primal Chaos realm. If a Cosmos God were to eat it, it would not be as helpful.” Xue Ying said.
“Alright, I will help you prepare it.” Forefather Tian Yu chuckled and nodded, “We will subtract from the balance of 300,000 Origin World Rock you have.”
“Other than this, I need a secret treasure too that can dissipate off any incoming impact.” Xue Ying said.
The void boundary…
Xue Ying was confident of his own strength, but it was better to be prudent!
“Value?” Forefather Tian Yu asked.
“Between 50,000 to 100,000 Origin World Rocks.” Xue Ying asked. He still had to leave behind some treasures since Xue Ying did not know when he could ever obtain such voluminous wealth. In the future, he might have some urgent need for treasures.
“Indeed we can exchange an adequate secret treasure with this amount.” Forefather Tian Yu nodded after hearing the value, “There aren’t many secret treasures originally. The only that I think is most appropriate for you is something called ‘Three-Colored Heavy Cloud’, and is currently with Ancestor Sorcerer. I’ll try and ask him if we can buy it.”
Xue Ying immediately nodded.
Ordinary Void God weapons no longer assisted him much. Only a secret treasure would be helpful to him.
What were secret treasures? Cosmos-ranked treasures were considered one! Some were unique treasures formed in the primitive Ancient Sacred World and the primal chaos void before they were altered into powerful treasures. Or they might be treasures with a mysterious origin, like that ‘Third Fire Prison Realm Cauldron’. But its value was so great that even the Sacred Master desired it. He schemed against Monarch Nine Cloud time after time.
As a result, cosmos-ranked treasures were of the lowest level amongst secret treasures.
“Ancestor Sorcerer replied. It will cost 80,000 Origin World Rocks.” Forefather Tian Yu looked towards Xue Ying.
“Alright.” Xue Ying nodded without hesitation. The items produced by Ancestor Sorcerer were definitely extraordinary.
“Haha, I’ve spoken with Ancestor Sorcerer already. He will send someone to send the item over later. Oh, this is information regarding the secret treasure which he just sent regarding the ‘Three-Colored Heavy Cloud’.” Forefather Tian Yu passed down a set of information to Xue Ying. Precisely because he bought the item, that was why he could obtain the relevant information. Otherwise, Forefather Tian Yu and the others would only know part of its properties.
Xue Ying looked through it.
This ‘Three-Colored Heavy Cloud’ was a cloud that Ancestor Sorcerer discovered amidst the vast primal chaos void. He followed along the flow of time, watching the entire process as the Three-Colored Heavy Cloud emerged. This was originally a unique cloud that was given birth during the primitive Ancient Sacred World era. After its destruction, this cloud had undergone some mutation. It was after Ancestor Sorcerer studied many of its mutated properties that he was able to refine this secret treasure according to the cloud.
…
Ancestor Sorcerer sent someone to bring the Three-Colored Heavy Cloud over. Forefather Tian Yu personally received it before passing it over to Xue Ying.
Clearly, the whole process of how this secret treasure landed in the hands of Xue Ying was kept a secret. Only Forefather Tian Yu, Ancestor Sorcerer, and few others knew about it.
‘Three-Colored Heavy Cloud.’ Xue Ying held onto a pile of soft white clouds in his hand. This pile of soft white clouds was pried open. Xue Ying was able to see the bluish cloud layer and golden cloud layer within it. White, blue and gold… this was how the name ‘three-coloured’ came about.
‘This secret treasure is best used as a robe.’ Xue Ying sat cross-legged on the silvery-silk praying mat within the cultivation room. He was extremely patient as he gradually refined the secret treasure. As the usage of secret treasures was extremely complex, Xue Ying had to truly understand the treasure before he could really use it. Fortunately, the Three-Colored Heavy Cloud was refined by Ancestor Sorcerer, and Xue Ying bought it from it. Naturally, he was told in detail how to refine it.
The method of refining was not difficult. It only required time.
During this process of refinement, Xue Ying would occasionally bring out several pieces of Origin World Rocks and throw them into his mouth. The Origin World Rocks would rapidly turn small and be swallowed into his stomach. It was like eating some kind of tidbits, consuming several pieces in each mouth. After all, the soul of Xue Ying was much stronger than Jing Qiu’s in the past. Thus, eating this much Origin World Rocks did not create great pressure on him.
If he was willing, he could even eat up to a thousand of them.
But Xue Ying wanted to experience the minute changes of his soul.
‘It is indeed Origin World Rocks, the rumored origin energy from the primitive Ancient Sacred World.’ Xue Ying thought. The primitive Ancient Sacred World was comparable to the current primal chaos void. This origin energy would bring about a holistic improvement to his soul.
The effects on his soul after killing Destruction Devils might be better, but how many Destruction Devils would he have to kill to acquire enough energy equivalent to 100,000 Origin World Rocks? One had to know that the Destruction Devils were extremely cunning too. They would not casually send themselves to death. Even those ninth level Primal Chaos existences would only acquire enough unique energy over long periods of killing to match 20,000 to 30,000 Origin World Rocks.
Day passed by day.
Xue Ying’s soul was gradually transforming. It was becoming bigger, allowing his deduction and comprehension skills to accelerate.
In the blink of an eye, 19 years had passed.
Xue Ying might not be in a rush as he consumed the Origin World Rocks, but he still finished devouring all 100,000 Origin World Rocks. On this day, it was coincidentally the moment he completely refined the ‘Three-Colored Heavy Cloud’.
‘This feeling is absurdly great.’ Xue Ying felt that these 19 years were enjoyment to him. The feeling of absorbing the energy was truly mystical.
‘After eating 100,000 Origin World Rocks, my soul has strengthened by 30%.’ Xue Ying felt joy inwardly.
It might not be much.
But in reality, an increase in his foundation by 30% was significant. After all, his soul had reached an extremely strong stage after cultivating the ninth transformation of Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance, and to improve it by the slightest was already very difficult. In the future when he became a Cosmos God, the improvement to his soul would not be too great. Hence, Xue Ying was satisfied with a 30% improvement already.
‘Three-Colored Heavy Cloud…’ Xue Ying thought.
“Hua.”
The soft white cloud lump was expanding quickly over the surface of Xue Ying’s body. It eventually formed into a set of a thick snowy-white robe. The robe looked as clean as snow.
‘It is quite thick and feels warm.’ Xue Ying chuckled. With the snowy-white robe worn over his body, Xue Ying felt really comfortable, ‘According to what Forefather mentioned, with this secret treasure, my body should be qualified to be comparable to those in the top 10 of Primal Chaos existences.’
After all, how many Primal Chaos existences were willing to spend eight million Origin World Rocks just for the sake of getting a protective secret treasure?
To Xue Ying, this was not considered much. His target was Sacred Master, and before becoming as strong as him, Xue Ying had to remain alert and vigilant, else he might just fall early. Since he had sufficient Origin World Rocks, he might as well utilize them. In the future should he become a Cosmos God, Xue Ying could easily earn more Origin World Rocks. Otherwise… this secret treasure would be worth the price if he were to remain at the Primal Chaos realm.
‘Time for me to pay the boundary of the void a visit.’ Xue Ying thought.
“Hua.”
An incarnation appeared by his side.
Usually, this incarnation of his would be responsible for many of the miscellaneous tasks within the Great Void Heaven Temple like guiding disciples or to attend some critical meeting within the temple. If Xue Ying did not battle, the daily tasks conducted would consume very little of his heart energy. And when there was nothing important, his incarnation could simply sleep. That way, the energy consumption would remain negligible.
‘Go.’
The void by the side of the cultivation room warped. Xue Ying who was in his thick white robe took a step into the distorted space before disappearing directly from the vicinity.

chapters.title: Chapter 943 - Void Castle
chapters.content:
Chapter 943: Void Castle
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The distance from Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World to the boundary of the void might be far, but Xue Ying was able to travel there in an instant. Garbed in a thick white robe, Xue Ying glanced over the region, spotting a tiny castle in the distant void. That was none other than the castle constructed after the cultivators at the boundary of the void paid a considerable price—the Void Castle.
The experts gathered at the Void Castle far exceeded that on any single sacred world.
There would at least be three true bodies of Cosmos Gods stationed here all year round. As for incarnations? More than 10 Cosmos God incarnations were here. Even the free and easy ‘Luo City Lord’ had an incarnation placed here for long periods. The number of true bodies of Primal Chaos giants situated here numbered more than 200, and even more of their incarnations were here. There was still a large number of Unity realm experts who came to risk their lives.
This was the frontmost line of the cultivators’ resistance against the ‘Destruction Devils’. And currently, the new Primal Chaos expert ‘Xue Ying’ had arrived here.
‘Void Castle.’ Xue Ying glanced at that miniature castle before entering it with a step.
“Xiu.”
In reality, the Void Castle was massive—it occupied more than 50 million kilometers in diameter, of which most of the space was occupied by array structures. In one of the palace halls, more than 200 Primal Chaos experts were discussing with each other here. They looked delighted as they chatted. “Weng”, accompanied by the distortion of space, Xue Ying appeared within the hall.
“Dong Bo Hall Master?” Those Primal Chaos cultivators who were drinking and discussing Daos turned over. The moment they saw Xue Ying, many began brimming in happiness.
“Heart Imitation Religious Master…” Xue Ying chuckled and acknowledged them briefly. He then walked towards five of the Primal Chaos experts under the Great Void Heaven Temple.
“Who would have thought that Dong Bo Xue Ying will arrive so quickly in the Void Castle.” Other Primal Chaos experts were also discussing quietly.
“It seems he has met some bottleneck after exiting from closed-door cultivation. He should likely reach the peak of eighth level Star Pagoda strength now.”
“Truly making the few of us guilty. Even after cultivating for so long, I could not get through the eighth level.”
The Primal Chaos experts were idly chatting with one another.
Most who were present were incarnations. They were resting here and were prepared to go for battles at any time.
And in another corner, Xue Ying met with five of the Primal Chaos experts from the Great Void Heaven Temple.
“Are all those within this hall incarnations? Are the five of you incarnations too?” Xue Ying asked curiously with a smile.
“In a while, the Void Castle will also arrange a miniature cavern-dwelling for you.” Primal Chaos Hall Master held onto a simple wine cup and smiled back, “During most of the ordinary battles, our incarnations are the one fighting outside. It is only during urgent situations when we would move with our true bodies.”
“You should know about the rule that we must stay only in the inner region when we move out with our true bodies, right?” Leading Wing Hall Master asked from the side.
“Mn, this I know.” Xue Ying nodded.
The Destruction Devils emerged from the inner section of ‘Lost World Corridor’ within the boundary of the void. The space within the Lost World Corridor was chaotic; it was like a maze. Even Cosmos Gods would get lost inside! According to legends, there were many ‘lairs’ within the Lost World Corridor, and those were where the Destruction Devils came from. Naturally, the lairs were split into different levels. The most ordinary ones would form ‘gray-armored ranked Destruction Devils’, and the rarest ones would form blood-armored Destruction Devils! And according to rumors… there were even unique lairs where golden-armored Destruction Devils would appear!
As such, the cultivators had constructed a colossal monitoring array around the outer perimeter of the Lost World Corridor.
The moment any Destruction Devil appear, they would be discovered through the monitoring array!
This monitoring array region was termed as ‘outer region’.
And in a smaller region right behind this region of monitoring array, the cultivators completely sealed the void in this area! The strength of the seal far outstripped that of a sacred world, and even Cosmos God Destruction Devils could not teleport within; they could only fly within!
Thus, when Destruction Devils came out from the Lost World Corridor, they would be noticed in the ‘outer region’. The moment they entered the inner region, they could only fly slowly. Even though this region was small, if they had to slowly fly, they would spend a considerable amount of time doing so! By then, the cultivators would have sufficient time to get rid of them.
Only after passing through the inner region, at the very end, would be where the spatial barrier was located at!
This was also the final layer of protection.
If the enemies charged through the inner region and attacked the spatial barrier, they would be able to break through the obstacles and enter the vast primal chaos void. By then, the Destruction Devils would be able to invade the five great sacred worlds, the many cosmos, and primal chaos lands whenever they wanted.
“They can only fly within the inner region. Although they aren’t able to discover our locations, we are able to trace theirs. Thus, we can easily corner them.” Leading Wing Hall Master had a peal of mischievous laughter, “And even if Cosmos God Destruction Devils conceal their auras and intrude upon this area, the moment he displays his power, we are able to easily teleport through a long distance. By then, a group of Cosmos Gods will handle them.”
Xue Ying nodded.
Even though the seals within the inner region were extremely formidable, they were unable to hinder ‘ultra-long distance teleportation’. Such experts were still able to force their ways through, including the Lost World Corridor! Cultivators depended on ultra-long distance teleportation to scout through the Lost World Corridor. The moment they discovered any traces of lairs, they would send a large group of Cosmos Gods over to kill it after locking upon their positions. And then, they would rely on ultra-long distance teleportation to escape!
Thus, the cultivators wielded the decisive opportunities if they relied on ‘ultra-long distance teleportations’.
As for the Destruction Devils… at least until now, there were no traces of them having the skill of ultra-long distance teleportation.
Naturally, those who were able to unravel ultra-long distance teleportation and ascertain this fact included only the fallen ‘Monarch Nine Cloud’. He had already begun finding ways to seal ultra-long distance teleportation using arrays.
“Fellow cultivators, do tell me what I should take note of when I go out to battle?” Xue Ying went on asking. Even though he had researched on specific information regarding this, finding out from those present would be better since they had experienced it first hand.
“Previously, Primal Chaos Hall Master mentioned about how incarnations are the ones mainly battling, and only during urgent situations would our true bodies move.” Celestial Water Hall Master shook his head, “That is because the incarnation of Primal chaos Hall Master is at the peak of the seventh level. We are much weaker. For example, my true body is only at the peak of the seventh level, and my incarnation is much weaker! Just by relying on my incarnation, I would not be able to gain anything. Thus, our true bodies would frequently pay the inner region a visit. We would first use our incarnations to scout the way ahead to probe the degree of danger before our true bodies proceed on! Only when we kill some of the stronger Destruction Devils would it be beneficial to our souls.”
Xue Ying nodded.
“The stronger the Destruction Devil, the more probable it is for it to leave behind some important and precious materials.” Leading Wing Hall Master added.
Precious materials…
Xue Ying knew about this too. It was unlike battling in the Star Pagoda where there would be no benefits at all.
Fighting with the Destruction Devils, other than tempering himself, one would able to absorb the unique energy beneficial to the soul. Furthermore, some parts of those Destruction Devils were exceptional, and they would leave part of their bodies behind after they died in battle. These were extremely precious materials that could be used to refine cosmos-ranked treasures and other secret treasures.
For instance, the ‘Cheng Qun’ in the past was material from the body of a Destruction Devil.
Or the hair of a particular golden-armored Destruction Devil could be treated as a weapon. Its hair was just like an actual weapon that could not be easily damaged. Then if he died in battle, its hair would be left behind and used to refine into a secret treasure. Its value might be worth several thousand to even tens of thousands of Origin World Rocks!
Everything required luck! The Destruction Devil had to have certain parts of its body reaching a specific strength since most would still be entirely extinguished after dying in battles.
“I’ve stuck at this bottleneck for far too long. The help Destruction Devils bring to me can be ignored.” Primal Chaos Hall Master chuckled, “Dong Bo, you have just broken through not too long ago, so you should take this chance to temper yourself.”
“Understood.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Also, you can try and scout out the Lost World Corridor.” Primal Chaos Hall Master smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 944 - Myriad Realm Tavern Master lineage
chapters.content:
Chapter 944: Myriad Realm Tavern Master lineage
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Right, scout the Lost World Corridor. Only by discovering their lairs and directly destroying them can we truly cut them off by their roots.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master said, “The majority of Cosmos Gods have sent their incarnations in, and I will also send my incarnation along with them. The moment we discover any lairs, I can easily ascertain its position, and the true bodies of Cosmos Gods can kill their way over.”
Xue Ying nodded.
The Lost World Corridor gave birth to batches of Destruction Devils. Only by destroying their lairs would they be uprooting the devils.
But it was difficult! Traveling within the Lost World Corridor was intrinsically dangerous. Furthermore, the more critical the lair was, the more Destruction Devil experts there would be. Only Cosmos Gods had sufficient realm to produce results by sending their incarnations to scout. Most incarnations of Primal Chaos experts would rarely find anything if they entered.
“Dong Bo, with your ability to teleport through an ultra-long distance, you can just send your incarnations in when you are free. Who knows if you might just discover some important lairs.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master added too. It was disclosed across the inner section of Great Void Heaven Temple that Xue Ying could travel through an ultra-long distance.
“I might just get lost if I were careless in the Lost World Corridor. Furthermore, many protectors are guarding the important lairs.” Xue Ying shook his head.
“That’s right. Even incarnations of Cosmos Gods get lost frequently.” Inquisitive Sky Hall Master sighed, “The most appropriate ones amongst Primal Chaos experts for this scouting mission should be Myriad Realm Tavern Master and the other cultivator of his lineage, ‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’. Myriad Realm Tavern Master has many avatars and can easily travel through an ultra-long distance. If his avatars entered the Lost World corridor, even if he got lost, he could readily leave.”
Celestial Water Hall Master, Leading Wing Hall Master, and the others agreed.
Xue Ying nodded too.
There were two great dangers of the ‘Lost World Corridor’. One, it was quite easy to get lost. Two, many Destruction Devils guarded the inner section of the place.
Lost? One could easily leave by with ultra-long distance teleportation.
Guards? One could easily bypass the guards through ultra-long distance teleportation and enter the lair directly too.
Nevertheless, most only sent their incarnations to scout the place. Like Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and the others, their methods were ancient cultivation methods. Their true bodies could employ the ultra-long distance teleportation method but not their incarnations! Their incarnations could only ‘mark the spatial coordinates’, and even if their true bodies formed a passage, it was merely connecting between the incarnation with the external world. They were unable to teleport as they wished within the ‘Lost World Corridor’.
Gu Qi of the past and Void Primogenitor could easily teleport through ultra-long distance after becoming Cosmos Gods, but their techniques were considered brutal spatial teleportation and had a substantial demand on their heart energy.
Their incarnations could not employ the ‘ultra-long distance teleportation’ at all.
Only those of the Myriad Realm Tavern Master lineage could!
It was said that cultivating the Myriad Realm Tavern Master lineage was very difficult. There were only two who had truly reached successes in it-one was Myriad Realm Tavern Master himself, and the other was the ninth level expert, ‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’.
Myriad Realm Tavern Master had countless avatars and could easily appear anywhere.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was slightly weaker. He only had another avatar other than his true body! But his incarnations could similarly teleport through an ultra-long distance. Clearly, their lineage was not categorized as ancient cultivation, and after grasping the skill of ultra-long distance teleportation, their incarnations could teleport too since the consumption of heart energy wasn’t significant.
“Cosmos Gods have also requested Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master for help to scout the place. They are willing to pay a huge price for their help.” Primal Chaos Hall Master shook his head, “But it’s a pity that the two proposed an even greater price. Actually, according to logic, every cultivator who is strong enough should do their part in resisting against the Destruction Devils since this is for the survival of the entire primal chaos void, and we are trying to save ourselves.”
“But the Sacred Master and Ancestor Mother are both madmen. Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master only recognize benefits, and aren’t willing to help for free.”
“The price proposed by Myriad Realm Tavern Master is truly exaggerated that even Cosmos Gods can’t accept it.”
“Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master is ultimately a Primal Chaos expert, and his calling price is much lower. But it is similarly exorbitant. He asked for 10,000 Origin World Rocks just to scout for a period of ‘100 million years’. If he were to discover a ‘blood-armored Destruction Devil lair’, he would ask for another 10,000 Origin World Rocks. If he were to discover a ‘golden-armored Destruction Devil lair’, it would be 200,000 Origin World Rocks.” Primal Chaos Hall Master sighed, “This is too pricey.”
Xue Ying sighed too.
That was ruthless.
Without any benefits, he asked for 10,000 Origin World Rocks every 100 million years. What if he spent three billion years? One had to know that the treasures Cosmos God Senior Gu Qi left behind to Xue Ying added up to approximately 360,000 Origin World Rocks only. By selling all the treasures a Cosmos God had, it would only allow for Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master to work 3.6 billion years?
“The conditions might be high, but Ancestor Sorcerer and the others have once asked Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master for help.” Primal Chaos Hall Master said, “But in just mere one billion years, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master has discovered five ‘blood-armored Destruction Devil lairs’, and the Cosmos Gods have to pay a total of 150,000 Origin World Rocks. Ever since then, the Cosmos Gods no longer asked Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master for help.”
“I’ve heard that Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master is willing to reduce his calling price by half, but the Cosmos Gods did not agree to it. The price is still too high, and it isn’t worth for them to conduct this transaction.”
“Even though the efficiency of searching is much lower when the incarnations of the Cosmos Gods went, Ancestor Sorcerer with his various methods were still able to discover several dozen blood-armored Destruction Devil lairs through the long ages. They had discovered two golden-armored Destruction Devil lairs too.” Primal Chaos Hall Master said, “It is so irritating that the two most qualified experts in scouting are asking for such a huge price. So what if the two of them could live after the Great Army of the Destruction Devils broke through our vanguard and sweep through the entire primal chaos void? What is the meaning in that? If what we guessed is right, by then, the primal chaos void would form an entirely new world and they would similarly die.”
Xue Ying slightly nodded.
That’s right.
It was fine if the other weaker Primal Chaos experts did not help. But those who could truly change the outcome like the strongest’ Sacred Master’ and the other similarly strong ‘Ancestor Mother’ were not willing to come and help.
Even Myriad World Tavern Master and the other of his lineage, ‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’ asked for a truly inflated price despite not being in danger when lending a helping hand.
“How spiteful.” Celestial Water Hall Master snorted coldly, “If we could kill them, the Cosmos Gods would have long forced them to act.”
“Myriad Realm Tavern Master has countless avatars, and it isn’t easy to search for the avatar of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master if he were to hide.” Primal Chaos Hall Master shook his head, “Those of their lineage is really great in surviving.”
Xue Ying agreed.
Xue Ying even felt that there were similarities in the four-diagrams absolute art he procured from Monarch Nine Cloud and the Myriad Realm Tavern Master lineage.
For instance, they both grasped the ultra-long distance teleportation as their own technique and could utilize them at the Unity realm. Now that he reached the Primal Chaos realm, the incarnations formed could easily use the technique too.
It was only their lineage that seemed more formidable since they could refine avatars. One had to know that other than their lineage, only the more unique ancient cultivators could create avatars.
“None of us can deal against those of their lineage. Even Sacred Master and the rest aren’t willing to treat them as enemies. Our three great sacred worlds aren’t too willing to do so either.” Primal Chaos Hall Master shook his head, “Since an enemy that we can’t kill or trap is the most frustrating enemy.”
‘They…’
Xue Ying felt puzzled inwardly.
Why would Sacred Master, Ancestor Mother and those of the Myriad Realm Tavern Master lineage not lend a helping hand when facing a threat from the Destruction Devils?
Xue Ying could not help but think about the most essential part of the void which he once peered, the ‘black fog spherical holes’, allowing him to glance at a higher dimensional world: ‘Is it because they are aware of more secrets? Otherwise, they should not remain so passive in front of death.’
This was merely conjecture.
Even though he had already trained in both the second and third diagrams, Xue Ying’s understanding of the higher dimensional world was too little. Xue Ying even felt that there were some similarities between the lineage of Myriad Realm Tavern Master and that four-diagrams absolute art of his. Maybe they might allow him to understand more of the higher dimension.
“Those who specialized in this aren’t helping, so we can only rely on quantity to cover up this gap. Most of the time, Cosmos Gods will be the one searching for the lairs. At times, we at the ninth level will also send our incarnations to support them.” Primal Chaos Hall Master said.
“Mn, I also plan on going over to search for the lairs.” Xue Ying said.
In the primal chaos void and five great sacred worlds, other than the two who were of Myriad Realm Tavern Master’s lineage, Xue Ying could similarly utilize ultra-long distance teleportation using his incarnations.
But he had to keep it a secret.
Cultivators like ‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’ had cultivated an avatar technique such that Cosmos Gods could not find him if he decided on hiding. As such, nobody could deal against him. Behind him, there was even Myriad Realm Tavern Master who had countless avatars.
Xue Ying did not have any avatars. The moment he revealed the fact that his incarnations could undergo ultra-long distance teleportation, he would likely face some issues.
‘I should scout for the lairs surreptitiously. When I discover any blood-armored rank lairs, I should just leave behind a spatial marking and keep it a secret temporarily since it would incur suspicion if I coincidentally find several important lairs one after another. I should wait until I find a golden-armored lair before publicizing it.’ Xue Ying thought to himself. He was on guard against Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Sacred Master.
After all, who did not want to acquire the technique of ultra-long distance teleportation?
Sacred Master was helpless against those of the Myriad Realm Tavern Master lineage, but what about him?

chapters.title: Chapter 945 - Lost World Corridor
chapters.content:
Chapter 945: Lost World Corridor
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
There were many miniature cavern-dwellings within the Void Corridor. Xue Ying was also allocated to one that was just half a kilometer wide. It was quite rare for Primal Chaos cultivators to have such a small cavern-dwelling, but this was ultimately the forward base of the resistance against the Destruction Devils, and those at the Unity realm were given an even smaller courtyard.
Within this miniature cavern-dwelling in a cultivation room.
Xue Ying who was in his thick white robe sat cross-legged with his eyes closed. He was starting his observation of the smallest particle of the void, the ‘Black Fog Spherical holes’. As he surveyed the higher dimensional world, Xue Ying immediately found many other holes connected to this place. Through those holes, Xue Ying was able to uncover many other regions. The further the area from where he was, the further the holes were situated, and the less distinct the image he perceived.
‘Lost World corridor.’ Xue Ying began observing. He saw the ‘final spatial barrier’ at the front of the Void Corridor and also the inner region within, and the outer region beyond that. He also saw the ‘Lost World Corridor’ with many Destruction Devils emerging from within.
‘This is so mystical.’
Xue Ying was too far from the boundary of the void so he could not see the Lost World Corridor clearly.
One had to know that this distance was indeed far. Even the deviation of ultra-long distance teleportation was huge. For instance, Ancestor Desert had once sent Xue Ying and the others from the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World to the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, and the deviation from the ‘Great Void Heaven Temple’ cost Ancestor Devil half a day of travel using spatial passages. One could see how significant the error was! The reason why such an error existed was due to weak perception.
‘The Void Castle is comparatively closer to the Lost World Corridor.’ Xue Ying could barely perceive some network within the corridor.
The entire Lost World Corridor was under his observation. It felt like Xue Ying had somehow entered a huge ‘beehive’ by the boundary of the entire primal chaos void. Inside this beehive, many networks were interconnecting one another. It was honestly too intricate. Xue Ying was still studying the bigger networks, and there were countless smaller ones which he might just get lost if he were not careful.
‘The Lost World Corridor should be the most mysterious spatial location. Even Cosmos Gods could get lost inside.’ Xue Ying sighed in admiration.
‘Time to leave.’
With a thought, a black-robed man was condensed by the side. Being covered in a black robe, his appearance felt blurred. There was even a single horn protruding from his forehead! Xue Ying had to be extremely careful when proceeding with his investigation within the ‘Lost World Corridor’. He had to keep the capabilities which his incarnations could utilize ultra-long distance teleportation a secret.
Naturally, even if someone were observing the distorted space around Xue Ying and how someone was entering it, others would guess that it was his true body opening a passage linking to his incarnation.
In reality…
Concealing from his own people was easy. What Xue Ying was afraid of were the Destruction Devils instead! If he were to be discovered by the Destruction Devils several times, the Destruction Devils would likely pass down the information regarding how this ‘Xue Ying’ appeared at many essential grounds, and that would likely incite much trouble.
Xue Ying did not dare to be the slightest careless in underestimating the intelligence of the Destruction Devils. He had to be extremely careful. The path of cultivation should be taken with care, and Xue Ying decided not to use his original appearance when entering the Lost World Corridor. Even his aura was altered. Being the greatest expert in the Dao of Mirage, it was simply too easy for him to slightly change his aura. To him, ‘turning illusion into reality’ was something as natural as breathing.
“Xiu.”
The space by his side warped. The black-robed Xue Ying entered before disappearing from the vicinity.
…
Lost World Corridor.
In this most mysterious spatial ground where Destruction Devils formed, in a particular region.
“Hua.” The space distorted, and a black-robed Xue Ying walked out of it.
‘Mn?’
Xue Ying looked around him. He felt slightly stunned, ‘This is…’
This was a space that occupied approximately a few billion kilometers in range. The void here seemed like a distorted fruit with membranous walls stacked on top of one another. Furthermore, many regions within folded on top of one another. It was genuinely mysterious and strange. As Xue Ying traveled, he would cover a distance of several tens of thousands of kilometers with a single step. Naturally, there were other regions which could directly shatter living beings.
‘It is actually a completely sealed space.’ Xue Ying shook his head. If it were other people, the teleportation here would be a failure! Because he would be trapped in this sealed space without being able to leave this region. Others would usually let their true bodies send another incarnation in once more.
‘This sealed space seems to still be growing and transforming.’ Xue Ying could vaguely feel the movement of space here, ‘And this distorted folded space is quite stable.’
It was indeed an eye-opener for him.
Even though he was a Voidwalker at the Primal Chaos realm, and had cultivated the four-diagrams absolute art created by Monarch Nine Cloud, this ‘Lost World Corridor’ which operated on a supreme law still gave Xue Ying a great shock. Just a space that was sealed and still growing was so mysterious already. It broadened the perspective and understanding of Xue Ying towards space. That was truly an ‘eye-opener’.
Without personally seeing it, Xue Ying would not dare to think that it was possible for the structure of the void to change so irregularly.
‘I think I should hurry up and find a passage to travel in.’ Xue Ying’s incarnation immediately began looking through the most essential particle of the void, the ‘Black Fog Spherical hole’. Since his incarnation was in the Lost World Corridor, he could easily observe his nearby region with greater clarity through the holes.
The law suppression within the Lost World Corridor was beyond that of the Sacred World!
The region which he could distinctly perceive was tiny too; it was merely just a small corner of this massive space several billion kilometers in length.
‘There is a corridor over there.’ Xue Ying rapidly discovered what he sought.
The space distorted.
The black-robed Xue Ying took a step. Following that, when he appeared once again in a distant region. There was a bright, colorful spatial corridor.
‘Corridor.’ The black-robed Xue Ying stood in this spatial corridor. The width of this spatial corridor was not even. Some parts were more extensive and some narrower. Most were in the numerical of hundreds of kilometers! It meandered across the place, linking to many regions within.
It was easier to travel using this Lost World Corridor.
Why was it formidable that his incarnation could utilize ultra-long distance teleportation? That’s because his body could easily scout the surrounding region while it was still inside the ‘Lost World Corridor’.
