It was much easier this way when searching for lairs of the Destruction Devils as compared to the incarnations of Cosmos Gods who had to travel along the corridors while keeping a lookout for those lairs. That was why the Cosmos Gods were willing to pay a huge price in inviting Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master for help.
“Sou…”
Xue Ying walked along the spatial corridor. Every single step was short teleportation.
‘This is truly mystical. The structure of this void corridor is even more amazing.’ Xue Ying praised. Compared to the sealed corridor that was still growing, this Lost World Corridor which was a crucial spatial passage had a structure more complicated by a thousand to ten thousand times.
It was not a corridor formed in a short period.
Instead, this was a corridor with an extremely stable structure.
‘An intersection.’ Xue Ying looked ahead. The corridor was split into nine different pathways. This was very normal since he would definitely meet intersections on his journey.
‘The void is akin to pieces of brick being used to construct a stable passage.’ Xue Ying was constantly having flashes of inspiration. He felt that being the most unique space in the world, the ‘Lost World Corridor’ was absolutely a holy ground for comprehending the void!
Xue Ying had seen before many scenes of void ever since he started cultivating, but never was it as unique as this Lost World Corridor.
‘Mn?’
Xue Ying observed to the side. At the same time, he was peering through the black fog spherical holes. He wanted to unravel the mystery of this Lost World Corridor while searching for the lairs at the same time.
‘A lair? That should be a lair right?’ Xue Ying carefully walked for half an hour in the Lost World Corridor before finding a region which he could barely discern. There was a small recess there which was vaguely emitting a savage, destructive aura.
‘Time to go and have a look.’
Since this was just his incarnation, Xue Ying was naturally daring. He directly teleported over and entered that small little region which was emitting a foul, destructive aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 946 - Void Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 946: Void Cultivation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying entered that region which was pervaded with a destructive aura. Just as he walked out from the distorted void, he was able to discern the appearance of this space.
‘A lair!’
This was a unique space. The void within was twisted into the shape of a gigantic tree. On this void tree, there were many ‘eggs’ being grown on it. Their shell was gray in color, and they had differing sizes. With a glance, there were several hundred eggs, and the biggest one was already split open with many babies of Destruction Devils within that were covered in liquid. These babies were currently eating the shell.
‘Mn?’
Two mature gray-armored Destructive Devil soldiers were guarding this lair too. The two of them felt a spatial movement and had turned over. But it was just an empty space without anyone there.
“There are cultivators.” Even though they could not see nor sense it, they were quite sure that there were already cultivators who had invaded into their lair.
Because this lair was entirely filled with savage, destructive aura, and Xue Ying’s energy was utterly inharmonious with that aura.
‘I was discovered.’
Xue Ying watched that huge void tree, ‘The void actually formed a huge tree with eggs sprouting from it, and Destruction Devils are hatching from the eggs? Truly enigmatic.’ If Xue Ying had time to observe the process, he would be delighted. Nevertheless, he understood according to the information provided that he could no longer delay anymore.
“Hong-”
Many delicate ripple strands descended. Those two gray-armored Destruction Devils were instantly smashed into smithereens. That huge distorted void tree was also being wrung apart. All of the eggs including those that had given birth to Destruction Devils were exterminated in an instant.
This incarnation of his might be weak, and his soul was controlling it from a very far distance, so it was taxing on him when using moves. Xue Ying could only form three flowers at most when utilizing the first style of “Destructive Flower”. This was considered to be at the seventh Star Pagoda strength! Yet it was unusual for a single incarnation to wield such power.
Previously, he unleashed his Plate Ripple Diagram domain across a large distance to extinguish these Destruction Devils. Ultimately, they were mere gray-armored soldiers, and Xue Ying could easily slaughter them.
“Xiu.” Xue Ying took a step before arriving at the spatial door. He then scuttled out.
Outside the space, there was a colorful brightly-lit spatial corridor.
“Kill.”
“Chase him.” A golden-armored Destruction Devil was leading the rest. A group of blood-armored Destruction Devils was following behind them. They were currently flying along the Lost World Corridor as streams of light. This dangerous spatial corridor where one could easily get lost was actually the home of the Destruction Devils. It was easy for them to travel within, and they were not worried about getting lost inside.
‘They came really quickly.’ Xue Ying was slightly stunned. He was rapidly fleeing from them.
“Xiu xiu xiu…”
As he escaped at high speed, even though the enemies were getting closer to him, Xue Ying would only be giving up an incarnation. Nevertheless, if he could survive, it would be good.
The spatial corridor was fundamentally dangerous. Even though it might seem gorgeous and dazzling, there were many hidden traps within. If he were careless, he might just be teleported into a specific danger area within. Xue Ying as an expert of the void was carefully proceeding ahead. He had discovered many traps, but since he was being chased from behind, he had no time to examine through all the traps carefully.
The dazzling passage was filled with many colorful ripples. They seemed the same.
“Hu.”
When Xue Ying teleported once again, the stream of light here suddenly trembled, and Xue Ying disappeared.
“Xiu~” The light behind flashed, and a golden-armored Destruction Devil brought his group of blood-armored Destruction Devil to a standstill. He looked ahead: “That cultivator is got himself lost. He was quite lucky to discover a lair.”
“It is merely a low graded lair.” The other blood-armored Destruction Devils were saying.
…
Three known grades were distinguishing the lairs. They would give birth to gray-armored rank, blood-armored rank and golden-armored rank Destruction Devils! Clearly, the value of a ‘golden-armored Destruction Devil lair’ was the highest because any golden-armored Destruction Devil would wield at the very least, a seventh level strength. There were even some amongst them who reached the ninth level strength-these were the apex experts.
Thus, if the cultivators could destroy a golden-armored graded lair, that would be an enormous victory. There was a reason for why Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master proposed such demanding price-10,000 Origin World Rocks for every 100 million years of work should he not find anything. Every blood-armored graded lair would earn him 10,000 Origin World Rocks, yet he asked for a full 200,000 Origin World Rocks for the discovery of a golden-armored graded lair.
Actually, gray-armored graded lairs were not worth mentioning. To Cosmos Gods, the lowest class Destruction Devils were all cannon fodder. Any single incarnation of theirs could slaughter them!
Even though the blood-armored graded lairs were paid more importance, in the eyes of Cosmos Gods, their value was not worth much either.
The reason why they invited Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master for help… was more to deal against the golden-armored graded lairs! They were willing to pay this 200,000 Origin World Rocks, but its a pity Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master did not find any. Instead, he discovered five blood-armored rank lairs… and the Cosmos Gods had to fork a price of 150,000 Origin World Rocks. Even Cosmos Gods were not so extravagant.
To these Destruction Devils, it was the same. They did not really care about those lower graded lairs.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying felt the space ahead of him become distorted before arriving in a region of chaotic space. The surrounding space was stacked on top of another, and there were many shattered pieces with all sorts of color. It was an incomparably dazzling world.
‘I’m lost?’ Xue Ying understood the moment he saw this scene. Even Cosmos Gods could not walk out of this place.
Unless they could rely on ultra-long distance teleportation!
“Xiu.”
After observing momentarily, Xue Ying stepped into a distorted space by the side and left the place directly.
Xue Ying then appeared on a piece of stable spatial passage. This time, he was carefully proceeding ahead. Five days later, he discovered yet another lair. This time, Xue Ying did not enter the lair impetuously. Instead, he went towards a dull and desolate space closer to the lair.
This space here was still growing, and there were no living beings within.
‘Mn?’ Xue Ying peered through the black fog spherical holes. Because the lair was just next door, Xue Ying was able to discern the place exceptionally clearly.
‘Yet another gray-armored rank lair.’ Xue Ying shook his head. It was not worth much trying to exterminate lairs of this rank.
…
Time passed. Xue Ying’s incarnation was proceeding stealthily within the Lost World Corridor. Other than to settle his curiosity the first time which he entered the lair directly, he merely proceeded to a space on the outskirts of those lairs the subsequent times, ‘observing’ the lair from a close distance. Eventually, he finally understood that the Lost World Corridor was ultimately about half that of an ordinary sacred world. In order to find a low-graded lair, one would usually take several days. It was much harder to find a blood-armored lair. Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master with his techniques had merely found five of them.
It was ultimately an arduous task finding a lair.
Instead, Xue Ying was spending more of his concentration on cultivation. The search for lairs was only a subtask. As he proceeded, he would be scrutinizing all sorts of uniqueness the void had, deepening his understanding of the void. His knowledge of the “Walker’s Hidden Secret” was also broadening.
******
It was destined for Xue Ying to spend a very long time searching for traces of the lairs within the Lost World Corridor.
And in the Void Castle, within the huge palace hall, there were many Primal Chaos experts gathered in groups of two and three. Almost every all of them was incarnations.
Xue Ying had also left an incarnation here. As long as the incarnation did not battle, it was not intensive to the consumption of his heart energy in maintaining it.
“These Destruction Devils are quite vigilant. Most of them only acted in the outer region, and none dared to enter the inner region.”
“They aren’t foolish. Knowing that they can fly slowly in the inner region, they would naturally not dare to easily barge into it.”
There was a huge projection hanging in the corner of the palace hall.
This projection portrayed the entire inner and outer region. Many Destruction Devils were moving about in the outer region, and only an extreme few had entered the inner region-approximately a dozen teams. Furthermore, they were only traveling along the boundary of the outer region. It was clear that they would escape back to the outer region should things become amiss.
“Xiu xiu xiu…”
Somehow they had all obtained the same unseen order, a total of 12 Destruction Devil teams entered the inner region at the same time. They were all located near the boundary.
“Another 12 teams have entered the inner region. Who is going this time?” At that moment, Primal Chaos cultivators were saying.
“Me.”
“One here too.”
“I’ll go.”
At that point, many Primal Chaos experts began standing. They started interacting with the Void Castle using their communication talisman.
“I have been here at the Void Castle for several days already. It is time for me to fight with these Destruction Devils.” Xue Ying stood up as well. They took the initiative to fight with the Destruction Devils, and the Destruction Devils deliberately remained at the boundary. Clearly, they wanted to grapple with the cultivators. According to the observations of the cultivators, it was beneficial for the Destruction Devils to kill the cultivators as well as it would improve their strengths.
Very soon, the Void Castle proceeded with an arrangement-12 Primal Chaos cultivators would be respectively arranged to deal against the 12 teams. The incarnations were merely used for scouting the other party’s actual power. Eventually, they still had to rely on their true bodies to exterminate the other party. To not depend on their true bodies? Even the incarnations of Cosmos Gods could not deal against some of the powerful golden-armored Destruction Devils.

chapters.title: Chapter 947 - Ninth level
chapters.content:
Chapter 947: Ninth level
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
In the inner region by the boundary of the void, it was vast, desolate and empty.
“Sou.”
A team of blood-armored Destruction Devils was flying at high speed. They were looking vigilantly around them.
“Be careful. There is a cultivator currently moving towards us.” Within this group of Destruction Devils, a thin, small and unremarkable Destruction Devil transmitted to the rest.
“Yes, general.” The other Destruction Devils felt their hearts tightening. They did not question their general at all. Unless a ‘King’ ordered them, otherwise, general existences disdained from bringing these soldiers into battles.
Not too far away, Xue Ying’s incarnation was currently observing this team of Destruction Devils through his control of the void: ‘100 blood-armored Destruction Devils? Hmph, the Destruction Devils aren’t foolish, so how can they send 100 blood-armored Destruction Devils to their deaths?’
The strength of blood-armored Destruction Devils ranged from the fourth to sixth level strength. If they really sent just 100 blood-armored Destruction Devils over… the true body of Xue Ying could simply wipe them out! During the past few days that Xue Ying spent chatting with other Primal Chaos existences, he learned a lot more of the Destruction Devils and how cunning they were.
Their wisdom was not any worse off than cultivators. It was indeed tough trying to wipe them out.
“Descend.” Xue Ying’s incarnation was rapidly moving closer. Following that, he did not hesitate to unleash the Destruction Flowers.
“Hua~””Hua~””Hua~”
Three Destructive Flowers came down in the same instance. Each flower bud wrapped around another, and they completely enclosed around one of the blood-armored Destruction Devil that stood at the front. In this team of Destruction Devils, that unremarkable, thin and small-looking Destruction Devil was sneering instead: ‘He is here. Cultivator, I shall let you go crazy for a while.’
…
From the start when Xue Ying’s incarnation entered battle until the end when his true body appeared, it took approximately the time taken to brew a cup of tea.
Within the Void Castle in the huge palace hall.
Xue Ying walked out with Primal Chaos Hall Master from the distorted space. Xue Ying still had a look of unwillingness.
“These Destruction Devils are really cunning. The moment you acted, Primal Chaos Hall Master, they did not hesitate to flee.” Xue Ying shook his head with helplessness. He had carefully prepared and even displayed all kinds of techniques and even deliberately asked Primal Chaos Hall Master to act at the same time. Primal Chaos Hall Master gladfully agreed. According to the plan, Primal Chaos Hall Master would hide within the Eden Treasure when Xue Ying acted, and would only sneak an attack at the most crucial moment.
Who would have thought…
Their plan could not adapt to the changes fast enough. Instead, the Destruction Devils acted first and forced Xue Ying into a predicament, forcing Primal Chaos Hall Master to appear.
“I’ve just killed two blood-armored Destruction Devils when they turned crazy.” Xue Ying sighed, “I knew that there must be someone powerful amongst them, yet who would have thought that there are three golden-armored Destruction Devils.”
Three golden-armored Destruction Devils with one more ruthless than the other.
The strongest golden-armored Destruction Devil should be at the ninth level strength. The single horn on his forehead shot out a rolling black flame star which tore through the void. Xue Ying had to use his full strength, unleashing a total of 25 ‘six-petal realm’ Destructive Flowers on top of one another, yet that black star generated from that single horn had easily shattered all his flowers. Of course, because his true body was hiding in the illusory world, the black star was affected. In the end, the surface of Xue Ying’s body let out a golden light. Furthermore, he had a blue light film protecting his body. The power of the ‘Three-Colored Layered Cloud’ was extraordinary.
Under the towering might of the golden light and the distortion of a blue light film domain, Xue Ying was able to repel that significantly weakened incoming black fire star. That black star then returned after that.
This also gave Xue Ying a new understanding of the combat power of a ninth level Destruction Devil. His Destructive Flowers were still too weak.
If there were merely a single golden-armored Destruction Devil, he would not have fallen into such a predicament! But dealing with two more Destruction Devils who should be at the eighth level, and the three of them perfectly coordinating with each other made it seem like fighting against three experts at the ninth level strength. Thus, they were able to force Xue Ying into a predicament in just a single instance. It seemed Xue Ying could only rely on his defenses to resist against the enemies.
At this moment, Primal Chaos Hall Master who was hiding in Xue Ying’s Eden treasure came out.
The moment he acted…
It shocked the world!
Primal Chaos Hall Master was extremely famous. Amongst those at the ninth level Star Pagoda strength, he was someone who lived for an extremely long time. He was respected by many, and his combative strength was exceptionally horrifying. Xue Ying had long understood that Primal Chaos Hall Master had reached the pinnacle of Primal Chaos realm. Only someone like Black Emperor could fight against him. He was known as ‘Primal Chaos’, and many cultivators believed in his strength without exception. It was the first time Xue Ying experienced the true strength of the other party.
This was when the other party had truly displayed strength that could fight against a Cosmos God and live to tell the tale.
If one mentioned that the ‘black star’ unleashed by the golden-armored Destruction Devil was genuinely at the ninth level strength, then the gigantic palms released by Primal Chaos Hall Master which easily tore the void into primal chaos and caused even the black star to shatter was something otherworldly. That black star turned back to a single horn which turned into golden light and escaped in full force from Primal Chaos Hall Master.
“Primal Chaos!” The three golden-armored Destruction Devil saw him and became greatly shocked. They did not hesitate to escape.
Within the huge palace hall.
Xue Ying was walking along Primal Chaos Hall Master. Primal Chaos Hall Master chuckled: “This team is considered to be quite strong. They have three golden-armored Destruction Devils, one at the ninth level and two at the peak eighth level strength. When they worked up, they became even stronger. If they were lucky, they might possibly kill a Primal Chaos expert with their scheme.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying agreed.
It was extremely difficult to kill a Primal Chaos giant.
Xue Ying was confident of his strength in addition to the help provided by Primal Chaos Hall Master. The two of them sufficed to wipe the other party out.
If it were some of the weaker Primal Chaos giants, usually seven to eight of them would work together. They might even bring out arrays to coordinate their strength. They would also bring some survival treasures so that they could slightly survive for a longer period in case of danger, allowing the Void Castle to send stronger experts to aid them.
Thus, the other party must be fortunate despite having a stronger team to scheme a Primal Chaos expert to death.
“The moment you appear, all of them escaped immediately.” Xue Ying laughed. He had already reached where the group of experts from the Great Void Heaven Temple gathered.
“Haha, Dong Bo.” Seated there, Inquisitive Sky Hall Master said, “Primal Chaos Hall Master has been fighting against the Destruction Devils for a long period. They have already become frightened by Primal Chaos Hall Master for a long time! The moment they see him, they would escape. Even though there was even a golden-armored Destruction Devil who was at the ninth level, none of them could defeat Primal Chaos Hall Master. Even if their Cosmos Gods appear, Primal Chaos Hall Master could still survive for some periods.”
“The moment they see me, they escaped. They are very good at escaping too. It is too difficult to even kill a single golden-armored Destruction Devil.” Primal Chaos Hall Master shook his head.
“Mn, this time, I have only killed two blood-armored Destruction Devils.” Xue Ying nodded in agreement.
“You killed two? And they are at the blood-armored rank?”
“That’s formidable already.”
Many other Primal Chaos cultivators listening from the side including these from the Great Void Heaven Temple agreed.
It was very rare for cultivators to fall when both parties fought since the ‘inner region’ was ultimately their home ground. But the Destruction Devils had similarly became experienced over time. It was comparatively easier to kill those gray-armored Destruction Devils. It was also possible for the cultivators to meet them when adventuring in the ‘outer region’ with their incarnations. But it was much harder for blood-armored Destruction Devils to be killed since they would usually work in a team. It was quite impossible for incarnations to kill them.
“The three golden-armored Destruction Devils led a group of blood-armored Destruction Devils. Actually, it is primarily because they wanted to temper those blood-armored Destruction Devils.” Primal Chaos Hall Master said, “By fighting more and experiencing some dangers, it is helpful to the Destruction Devils. If they killed us, cultivators, it would be helpful to them as their strength will gradually improve.”
“Dong Bo, your illusory realm is formidable, causing one of the golden-armored ranker to fall into it and forcing him to make a mistake in the process of saving the blood-armored Destruction Devil. That was why you could kill two of them.” Primal Chaos Hall Master said, “I think they would likely be more prepared against you after this, and trying to kill two more blood-armored Destruction Devils will become much harder now.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded.
When he killed those devils, Xue Ying was able to absorb some of the unseen unique energy. The effects were quite similar to consuming Origin World Rocks, though much better than them. It was approximately equivalent to absorbing 100 rocks.
…
“Xiu.”
The three golden-armored Destruction Devils directly entered the Lost World Corridor. They were walking in one of the spatial corridors with great familiarity. The three of them were walking side by side, and the leading one was the silver-eyed Destruction Devil with a lone horn. He muttered: “This time, the cultivator we met should be that genius cultivator recorded in the intelligence, Dong Bo Xue Ying who reached the seventh level strength at the Unity realm. He should be the Mirage Palace Hall Master from the Great Void Heaven Temple. He is currently very powerful already, especially that illusory technique of his. Those who are weaker are easily affected by it. Ci Ya, this time you have been affected by it.”
“Mn, it is I who was slow by a single step, causing us to suffer a loss.” A relatively ugly golden-armored Destruction Devil with a huge head and a huge bloody mouth with rows of teeth muttered back.
“His offense is ordinary, and it isn’t that threatening to us. But with this illusory technique… his degree of threat could be determined to reach the ‘primary ninth level’.” The single-horned silver-eyed devil said. If not for the illusory technique, according to their judgment, the threat of Xue Ying would not have entered the ninth level.
“If not for that Primal Chaos, we might have gotten rid of that Hall Master Dong Bo.”
“That’s right. Primal Chaos is someone with a degree of threat ‘beyond ninth level’. He is indeed terrifying. This is my second time meeting him.”
“There are a total of five cultivators ranked beyond the ninth level. This also includes two of the Cosmos Gods, yet we have met one of them this time.”
The three of them were walking on a path in the Lost World Corridor. They were all currently feeling unpleasant.
The Destruction Devils also had their own appraisal criterion.

chapters.title: Chapter 948 - Innate Talent
chapters.content:
Chapter 948: Innate Talent
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Deep within the Lost World Corridor, in a concealed room.
There was a quiet icy-snow palace hall with six figures currently seated inside. Their auras were all hidden. Some were wearing black armor, and some in violet armor. Some were even wearing robes that cultivators usually wear. There were even two who had humanoid appearances.
“Little Sister Xue Yong, what’s the matter that made you call us over?”
“Those fools have let Little Sister Xue Yong command them. You can just make your own decision for most of the matters, and there’s no need to come and find us.” The other five figures were all very casual. They did not give out the ordinary wicked aura standard Destruction Devils should have. It was to the extent that most cultivators could not discern their unique background should they change their appearances.
A girl wearing a full-body snow-white armor giggled: “Little sister knows that all my brothers are fully concentrated on cultivating, and do not really care about matters of those fools. But there is indeed a huge matter that little sister has to tell brothers.”
“Oh?”
The five other turned and looked at this white-armored girl.
“Brothers should know that our eighth golden-armored lair is the newest grown lair. Currently, the first batch of ‘golden-armored Destruction Devils’ is being nurtured now.” The snow-white-armored girl said.
“Mn. But there isn’t anything noteworthy to mention regarding those fools who have yet to transcend beyond the control of the supreme laws, and are frequently controlled by the desires of slaughter.” A black-robed young man sneered while casually fanning himself.
“In the first batch of golden-armored Destruction Devils nurtured in the eighth golden-armored lair, there is a very unique talent, which I determined to be the ‘shadowless’ talent.” The snow-white-armored girl giggled. She casually swept her gaze across the other five. It was as she expected. The other five Destruction Devils who reached the Cosmos God level became quiet.
“Shadowless talent?”
They were all looking at this snow-white-armored girl.
“Quick quick quick, let’s go.”
“It is actually the shadowless talent. Quick.”
“Little Sister Xue Yong, you better not lie to us.”
They were all being very excited.
“How could I lie about such a huge matter? Go go go, fellow brothers, let’s go and have a look.” The snow-white-armored girl giggled.
The six figures flashed before forming a faint light. They rapidly left this space. Even though they were crossing through the spatial corridor, they would occasionally disappear after entering certain fluctuations within the spatial corridor. Although one might get lost in the ‘spatial corridor’ easily, and that they might even be teleported into a lost zone…
There were some fluctuations where one could use to teleport further amidst the countless dangers.
The Destruction Devils were too familiar with the ‘Lost World Corridor’. This was their home, and they could easily discern which was for teleportation.
Just half a day later.
The six Cosmos God realm Destruction Devils arrived at a particular spatial lair. This lair had many blood-armored Destruction Devils patrolling it. There were even many golden-armored Destruction Devils patrolling this place with their power hidden. Even if the incarnations of Cosmos Gods arrived here, it was hard for them to get close to this ‘golden-armored graded lair’ without being discovered! Furthermore, the entrance to this golden-armored lair was disguised as a sealed space, making it harder to be found.
To discover a golden-armored graded lair, firstly, one had to be lucky. It was not easy to locate a golden-armored graded lair numbered less than ten in the vast Lost World Corridor. Secondly, one had to be powerful. He had to evade the patrol of the surrounding blood-armored Destruction Devils and golden-armored Destruction Devils. Thirdly, one had to perceive the queerness of space and to force his way through the hidden entrance of the lair.
Only by achieving these three could the party discover a golden-armored graded lair.
Naturally, this was under normal circumstances. If it were Myriad Realm Tavern Master, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master or Xue Ying, their incarnations could just proceed with ultra-long distance teleportation. Even if they did not enter the lair, they could still peer through the black fog spherical ‘holes’.
“Sou.”
The six ‘kings’ entered.
Within the lair.
A golden-armored Destruction Devil was guarding the place. He was solemnly standing on top of a peak just like a sculpture. Suddenly, he opened his eyes and turned to the distance. He saw the six incoming ‘kings’.
“Kings.” This golden-armored Destruction Devil immediately flew over and bowed respectfully.
They came to this world for the sake of destroying things.
Not just the lowest graded gray-armored rank, or the powerful golden-armored rank, all of them were filled with the cravings of destruction. One could say that ‘golden-armored rankers’ had better control, and they could stop their desires to destroy.
Only those who truly broke through the bottleneck of life out of their prisons, reaching the Cosmos God realm could they transcend beyond this control of desire. At this level, they were called by many Destruction Devils as King!
“Mn.”
The six ‘kings’ arrived in front of the ancient void tree.
The entire lair had condensed to form an ancient void tree. Being the highest graded Destruction Devil lair, this ‘ancient void tree’ was also exceptionally beautiful. Each branch of it was crystalline, and every branch was constructed from different spaces. Its spatial structure was truly mystical. Even Void Primogenitor and Monarch Nine cloud would find it startling.
The six kings looked up.
There were currently nine golden eggs on this ancient void tree. Some of them were located on the main branch of the ancient tree, and some were on the branches. They were of differing sizes. The nine golden eggs contained different appearances. Some had flames soaring on the surface, and some carried violet fog which appeared and permeated into the egg.
And the smallest egg was located at the center of the main branch of the tree. This smallest ‘golden egg’ was instead occasionally turning translucent and occasionally disappearing completely.
When it disappeared, even the six ‘kings’ with their amazing techniques could not discover traces of the golden eggs.
“This, this…”
“Shadowless?”
“This is the shadowless talent?”
The snow-white-armored girl giggled. The other five were watching with shock and joy.
The Destruction Devils were different from the cultivators. The cultivators had to cultivate step by step from a low level. Even the strongest of the void creatures would start from the Void God Origin Birth realm.
But for the Destruction Devils, even the lowest graded gray-armored rank would emerge as one ranging from first to third level standard. They could compete against those at the Unity realm. As for the highest golden-armored rank, they would start from the seventh to ninth level standard. This was unquestionably at the Primal Chaos level. They would have this strength the moment they entered this world.
Where did it come from? It was purely their talent!
They had all sorts of different talents. Some were strange and abnormal. But all of them had a single similarity… they were influenced by the desire to kill! Without breaking through the ceiling of life, they would forever be controlled by the desire to slaughter.
But amongst the talents that emerged in the Destruction Devils, there was yet to be one with the capability for ‘ultra-long distance teleportation’. There was neither one with the ability for ‘predicting the future’ or ‘changing the past’, some of the more heaven-defying talents.
But there was one which had never appeared in the cultivators and appeared only in the Destruction Devils.
That was the ‘shadowless talent’.
The shadowless talent… was about becoming one entity with the void. This meant fusing with the most intrinsic ‘black fog sphere’ of the void. At this moment, they would be part of the primal chaos void, and under normal circumstances, their bodies could not be destroyed! If they were to hide, it was hard for others to find traces of them.
If Xue Ying were around, he would understand that this was achieving the final perfection of Monarch Nine Cloud’s second diagram, the ‘void-ification’ theory.
In reality, one who reached this state did not mean he would be unparalleled.
If a party cultivated the third diagram, ‘controlling the void’ to perfection, or even breaking through the cage and touch on the higher dimension, he should be able to unravel ‘void-ification’.
That time, Monarch Nine Cloud had reached perfection in his void-ification skills, and also reached perfection in his control of the void. As for the fourth diagram, he had yet to complete it. Even so, Sacred Master failed many times in his endeavor of killing him. He had long employed the ‘origin energy’, yet he failed nonetheless. It was only during the final battle where Sacred Master became truly crazy. He fought until the entire primitive Ancient Sacred World was even shattered. That time, Monarch Nine Cloud was heavily injured, and he was able to escape still by using some heaven-defying void techniques.
He even left behind his treasure cove and cavern-dwelling which nobody could snatch away.
Xue Ying could not even enter that place with his ultra-long distance teleportation! One could see how formidable Monarch Nine Cloud was. But he eventually died due to his heavy injuries.
But in reality-
It was still difficult trying to unravel those who reached grand perfection in void-ification.
Monarch Nine Cloud was already dead! And ‘Void Primogenitor’ who walked on another path of the Dao of Void might be quite formidable in his body void-ification too, but he was comparatively weaker in his control of the void. He was lacking in his understanding of the ‘miniature aspect’, and could not even undergo ultra-long distance teleportation. What he could do was ‘ultra-long spatial great movement’, so there was no need to talk about them breaking out of the void prison.
The Sacred Master could have broken out of it, but he was not willing to participate in the battle.
After a moment-
That tiny golden egg appeared once again. It gradually became concrete from half-translucent.
“This is the last egg to appear in this first batch.” The snow-white-armored girl said, “For the sake of nurturing the egg, the tree has redirected much energy into it. The growth of the other eight eggs has been affected as a result. But currently, this egg is about to fully form. After that, its growth will be much faster. It should take less than five billion years. By then, we will have the second Destruction Devil with the shadowless talent.”

chapters.title: Chapter 949 - Imperial Dragon Ninth Transformation
chapters.content:
Chapter 949: Imperial Dragon Ninth Transformation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
It was hardest forming something from nothing. The moment the egg was formed, it would be much easier for it to hatch.
“With two devils having the shadowless talent, we will have an easier time.”
“Previously, we were able to send the ‘kings’ out all because of General Fu Qian’s help. There is currently only General Fu Qian with the shadowless talent. The moment he dies, we will be doomed. But now that we have two devils having the shadowless talent, and the chance of one of them dying is meager, we don’t have to worry much anymore.” The present six ‘kings’ were all watching that egg joyously as it gradually turned half-translucent again.
General Fu Qian also had the shadowless talent.
The monitoring of the cultivators in the outer region void and the inner region void was useless against General Fu Qian. He could easily reach the final ‘spatial barrier ‘stealthily.
Alas, that ‘spatial barrier’ was also the final level of resistance of the cultivators. The cultivators augmented it with all sorts of techniques, and even Cosmos Gods would take a long time trying to break through it. General Fu Qian depended on his talent to permeate through the spatial barrier. But this period of crossing through it would create some minute disturbances.
Clearly, the augmenting techniques placed in the spatial barrier had some trivial influence on General Fu Qian still.
This ‘minute disturbance’ would alarm the cultivators if it appeared during ordinary times! Even though the ‘shadowless talent’ was very formidable, the cultivators had fought with the Sacred Master until now, making them very experienced in dealing against the Destruction Devils even if it was a new talent. Furthermore, given that this was merely a devil at the ‘Primal Chaos strength’, the cultivators would likely have some ways of dealing against it.
This was not something the Destruction Devils could afford to lose!
Previously, they did not mind paying the price to kill their way to the spatial barrier. During this attack, it created a brutal fluctuation that made it hard for the minute disturbances to be discovered.
“Wait until this little chap is given birth and for his strength to be consolidated. By then, we can begin the next war.” A violet-armored male with wings said, “Currently, eight kings have left the void before, and the three of us haven’t. The few of us do want to have a look at the world of the cultivators while learning and absorbing from some of the cultivators’ techniques. It might be possible for us to have another breakthrough like ‘Emperor Jun’.”
“Mn.”
“It is time for us to leave. We have been staying in the Lost World Corridor, and they have merely sent some techniques over. We have yet to genuinely experience the world of the cultivators. When can we breakthrough if that’s the case?”
“With two devils having the shadowless talent, we will have an easier time leaving.”
Currently, 15 ‘kings’ have emerged on the side of the Destruction Devils. During the early period, they were overall weaker and had suffered from losses and death frequently. A total of four ‘kings’ died across battles. Over time, they became stronger and began working together. It became much harder for the cultivators to kill another ‘king’ after that.
11 ‘kings’.
Currently, five of them were outside disguised and traveling around the world. They were even learning all sorts of cultivation techniques.
The other six remained within the Lost World Corridor! This was because they had to maintain a minimum strength back at their world.
Unless a new ‘king’ appeared, otherwise, for a ‘king’ to go out, another ‘king’ outside had to return, ensuring the safety of the Lost World Corridor. That was the consensus reached. Even though they felt that those Destruction Devils who were controlled by the desire to kill were fools, ‘kings’ were ultimately grown from them.
Being a king, their desires were different from those fools.
They had broken through the impulse, regaining control of themselves. They sought to become stronger! Much stronger! And to become the strongest existence in this primal chaos void! Even though being a king, they would frequently kill too, they were not killing others because of ‘impulse’. Instead, they sought to kill to acquire more ‘unique energy’ and become stronger.
“From now on, we will guard the eighth golden-armored lair until this new fellow appears. We must ensure the safety of this lair.”
“Right.”
“We must not let the past repeat-two golden-armored lairs have been destroyed.”
The six ‘kings’ agreed on this unanimously.
If there was merely a ‘king’ protecting the place, it was impossible for him to defend this place against the onslaught of a group of Cosmos Gods from the cultivators’ side! But with six of them working together, even though they might not obtain victory, they were 100% certain of protecting this place.
…
They were also interacting with the five Kings in the outside world, proceeding with negotiation.
Very soon, everything was arranged.
After cultivating for an extended period in the outside world, other than the tremendous initial results, it would become much harder for the Destruction Devils to grow after that. These kings were willing to return to the Lost World Corridor occasionally.
******
Time passed.
The second Destruction Devil with the ‘shadowless talent’ was gradually coming to life. The six ‘kings’ protected the lair silently.
The cultivators continued fighting and killing the Destruction Devils just like always!
The Destruction Devils were also frequently provoking the cultivators. They did not care about suffering from losses since their goals were to become stronger. Their current goal was to break through the desire to slaughter and become ‘kings’. The stronger the Destruction Devil, the more he hated being controlled by this impulse. It was just that the impulse was terrifyingly strong that even golden-armored Destruction Devils at the ninth level strength could merely control this impulse temporarily and prevent it from bursting out.
Fighting, slaughter…
There were many deaths, but many more were growing stronger over the years.
…
In the blink of an eye, it had been close to 10 billion years since Xue Ying arrived at the Void Castle.
His illusory technique was indeed formidable. During this period of 10 billion years, there were a total of five ‘golden-armored Destruction Devils’ and more than 100 blood-armored Destruction Devils dying in his hands. Ultimately, those Destruction Devils that entered the inner region to battle, even if they were golden-armored rank, not all of them were as strong as those Xue Ying met during his first time.
Xue Ying met three golden-armored Destruction Devils during his first battle, with one at the ninth level and two at the peak eighth level. This was considered a powerful lineup.
Most golden-armored Destruction Devils Xue Ying met, though, would not be as strong-he only met some at the seventh level or eighth level.
Xue Ying’s illusory technique was able to slightly influence devils at the peak of the eighth level. Thus, he was able to succeed in killing five golden-armored Destruction Devils. During the fall of the golden-armored Destruction Devils, the fate of the blood-armored Destruction Devils need not be mentioned. Even though the ‘Destruction Devils’ remained alert against Xue Ying’s illusory realm technique, they still had to go out and temper themselves. They were able to tolerate some sacrifices. What they could do is to be more alert, and coordinate with those Destruction Devils that were stronger in the spiritual aspect.
Killing so many Destruction Devils…
Xue Ying was able to absorb their unique energy. The effect was equivalent to consuming 20,000 Origin World Rocks.
It’s a pity that this unique energy could not be sold.
Xue Ying was still quite satisfied with his harvest. He felt that over time, Xue Ying would definitely be able to hunt more devils down! Furthermore, over time, being the strongest expert in the Dao of Mirage across the history of cultivators, Xue Ying’s understanding of the ‘Dao of Mirage’ was deepening too. He had altered the ‘illusory world structure’ of his ninth transformation of Vermillion Nightmare inheritance multiple times.
Because this Vermillion Nightmare inheritance would firstly, strengthen his soul and secondly, it was to allow it to fuse with three other inheritances more perfectly.
Just the inheritance’s illusory world structure was not perfect; it was merely at the ‘eighth level Star Pagoda strength’.
One had to know… that the ninth sword of the ’13 Apocalyptic Swords’ was also the last sword at the Primal Chaos realm. It was a move at the ninth level. Of course, this sword had already enhanced part of the Great Dao of Cosmos.
Actually.
His Dao of Mirage was improving towards the ‘Mirage Cosmos’. Every single step was arduous. The illusory world of the ‘Vermillion Nightmare inheritance’ which Xue Ying modified multiple times had improved the power of the illusory realm, but it was not a qualitative transformation.
‘It is still too difficult for me to rely on just the Dao of Mirage alone to grasp a move at the ninth level Star Pagoda strength.’ Xue Ying understood this point, ‘Comparatively speaking, it is better for me to come out with the third style of the Destruction Flower.’
Within the cultivation room.
Xue Ying was entirely covered in a layer of black-plated armor. His hands were also encased in black scales emitting some faint light. The killing aura was wholly retained in his body. Xue Ying had finally reached great perfection in his ‘Imperial Dragon inheritance’ after fighting for close to 10 billion years in this Void Castle-the ninth transformation realm.
Xue Ying had the foundation to create the ‘third style of Destruction Flower’ with his current realm of the Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter.
But to succeed in creating it? That was extremely difficult.
As for the ninth level move made purely from the Dao of Mirage or the ‘Apocalyptic Ninth Sword’ from the Dao of Slaughter, those were much more difficult. Actually, speaking from its essence, the difficulty of creating them was similar to creating the third style of the Destruction Flower. But Xue Ying had the experience of forming the first style of Destruction Flower when he was at the Unity realm. After experiencing this ‘absolute perfection’, in addition to the guidance of the ‘stone mirror’, it had drastically reduced the difficulty of forming the third style of Destruction Flower.

chapters.title: Chapter 950 - Gold Color
chapters.content:
Chapter 950: Gold Color
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Void Castle. Inside the cultivation room located at the miniature cavern-dwelling belonging to Xue Ying.
‘Nope.’
‘It still doesn’t work.’
The illusory world looked beautiful. Inside it, there was a nine-petal black flower bud forming. Many veins could be seen on every leaf and petal. Each vein was being altered slightly at this moment. Xue Ying was trying his best to maintain the black flower bud, yet it still collapsed in the end.
‘I have yet to obtain that feeling of grand perfection; I am quite far from it’ Xue Ying immediately understood the difficulty after attempting to create the third style of Destruction Flower. Even though he created the Destruction Flower when he was at the Unity realm, and that difficulty was similar to creating the ‘third style of Destruction Flower’ at the Primal Chaos realm, his current realm was much higher and profound as compared to when he was at the Unity realm.
In order to perfectly fuse both Daos together and reach absolute perfection, the technique had to be combined perfectly without anything more and anything less. Only then could Xue Ying create a killing technique at the ninth level strength!
The current him…
If he attempted the ninth level of Star Pagoda, he could get through it without relying on the Three-Colored Layered Cloud. What he depended is on his own defenses. Firstly, he had cultivated the Imperial Dragon inheritance to great perfection. Secondly, he had the help of ‘void-ification’, and he was able to hide in the Mirage too… only with the three factors was he able to qualify as someone at the ninth level power given his defensive techniques. If Xue Ying included his secret treasure, his defenses could reach top five amongst all Primal Chaos cultivators.
But he was much weaker in his offense.
Xue Ying could currently unleash 30 Destruction Flowers of the second style at the same time. Compared to golden-armored Destruction Devils at the ninth level, he was quite lacking, much less against those like ‘Primal Chaos Hall Master’ and ‘Monarch Xing Huo’. Monarch Xing Huo was most well known for his offensive techniques. The two words ‘Xing Huo’ made it easy for others to guess what he specialized-brutality and tyranny!
‘The feeling is too disordered. Every time I try fusing in a more profound Dao, the difficulty will greatly increase.’ Xue Ying felt frustrated in his heart.
Because he was not able to touch even a single ‘corner’ of the technique he sought to create.
He was only able to feel that the move he thought of did not give off any wonderful feeling. It was a failure on all ends.
“Hu…”
Xue Ying closed his eyes, calming himself down gradually.
‘No rush. I must not be overly anxious.’
‘Currently, I do not have any idea of how to create a ninth level move belonging to the Dao of Mirage due to a lack of foundation… as for the third style of Destruction Flower, my foundation is sufficient, and I have many opinions on how to proceed.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘As for the consecutive failures, it is because this is a ninth level move ultimately, and even geniuses have to take a long time trying to create a ninth level move.’
Of the two Unity realm experts in the six great holy grounds who reached the seventh level strength, the cultivation speed of Core Imitation Religious Master was slow. It was because he created his own ‘Core Imitation’ system. As for ‘Great Emperor Jin Yi’, his cultivation speed was relatively fast-he reached the peak of the eighth level in just about eight billion years or so! He then experienced further refinements through battles, entering the ninth level power after 50 billion years. He was frighteningly outstanding.
And Great Emperor Jin Yi was someone who genuinely created a domain move at the ninth level. It was hard for others at the ninth level to touch him within his domain.
Naturally, Great Emperor Jin Yi was an ‘ancient cultivator’. Ancient cultivators did not seek comprehension. Instead, the ancient cultivator only had to unleash the move! It was much easier to cultivate in that system as compared to Xue Ying’s law and profound mysteries system. But one had to admit that it was amazing for the other party to take just 50 billion years at the Primal Chaos realm to create a ninth level move.
Great Emperor Jin Yi…
With that cultivation speed of his in the past, Cosmos Gods felt that it might be possible for him to enter the final realm.
Nevertheless, he remained at the ninth level after so long.
In history, there was only ‘Swordmaster’ from the Great Void Heaven Temple who was as talented as he, soaring through the path of cultivation.
‘I do not have to compare myself with Great Emperor Jin Yi.’
‘After all, there are many ninth level experts like Monarch Xing Huo who only reached the ninth level strength after cultivating for a long period.’ Xue Ying calmed himself down. He then continued pondering and finding ways to create a new move.
******
The cultivators were facing the Destruction Devils from afar. Both parties clashed with each other many times in the inner region.
“Kill.”
Another battle started and ended by the boundary of the inner region.
The Destruction Devils lost and escaped in a sorry state.
“General Mo Gu, when will be the next time we act?” The escaping team returned to the Lost World Corridor. The three golden-armored Destruction Devils were walking side by side. Of which, there was one who was high and thin. The golden-plated armor on his body was exquisite. His head was covered in fine golden armor. Three black twisted horns protruded from his head and the scaled-skin of his contained faint lines of light circulating through. It appeared and disappeared occasionally. He was General Mo Gu.
“Retreat first. I’ll let other teams move with me the next time.” General Mo Gu’s violet eyes swept across the two by his side.
“Yes.”
Of these two golden-armored Destruction Devils, one was at the ninth level, and the other was at the peak of the eighth level. General Mo Gu was clearly only at the peak of the seventh level, but the two of them were extremely respectful to him.
Because the ‘kings’ had sent a strict order.
General Mo Gu… had a status equivalent to ‘General Fu Qian’, riding above all other golden-armored Destruction Devils! Only the ‘kings’ had the authority to order them.
“Sou sou.”
General Mo Gu walked within the Lost World Corridor. His speed was breakneck. He would tear through space time after time.
Nevertheless, as he traveled, there was a violet-armored winged male following him silently from behind. He was one of the six ‘kings’, and this king specialized most in escaping. During this period, he had always been protecting General Mo Gu in the dark.
“Mo Gu…” The eyes of the violet-armored winged male were filled with expectations, “It is about time. I only require him to send us out. He doesn’t have to be too strong. After tempering him for a while more, it will be time for us to leave for the cultivator’s world. I am really looking forward to it.’
To the ‘kings’, General Mo Gu and General Fu Qian were extremely useful. That was why they were exceptionally favored upon and were being protected in the dark by the kings.
As for other Destruction Devils? These kings were indifferent. They still favored upon the ‘golden-armored Destruction Devils’ since they were at least the primary strength in the future battle with the cultivators. Furthermore, there could be new ‘kings’ emerging from them. As for those at a lower level? They were ants! These kings did not care about them even if more of such existences died.
‘Currently, eight golden-armored graded lairs have emerged. With two destroyed by the cultivators, there are six remaining.’
‘These six lairs have given birth to two with the shadowless talent. They are also giving birth to more golden-armored ranked Destruction Devils.’ The violet-armored winged male attached great importance to golden-armored graded lairs because he came from one.
‘In the space of golden-armored graded lairs, the patrols and guards are denser. It is much harder for these lairs to be discovered. As long as we have more golden-armored graded lairs, us Destruction Devils will only become stronger and give birth to more with the shadowless talent and more golden-armored devils. There will also be more ‘kings’ emerging.’ The violet-armored winged male thought.
Compared to the cultivators, they were ultimately still on the weaker end-there was still a gap in their overall strength. Even if they entered the cultivators’ world, they had to do things stealthily and did not dare to battle with them openly. Fortunately, they were innately good at surviving. If they could not win, they could still escape. All the cultivators could only watch as they become stronger over time.
…
Lost World Corridor.
The black-robed Xue Ying was currently walking in a bright spatial corridor. In his eyes, everything around him was displaying all sorts of profound mysteries of the void. It was indeed a holy ground for those cultivating the void.
‘Mn?’
The black-robed Xue Ying suddenly stopped. He could scout his surroundings through the most fundamental particle of the void, the ‘black fog spherical holes’. Xue Ying did not have to deal against those patrolling Destruction Devils and did not have to break apart those methods concealing the entrances to the lairs. He merely had to peer through the black fog spherical holes. But the Lost World Corridor was ultimately too big, and in 10 billion years, Xue Ying had merely found 26 blood-armored graded lairs. He was conducting his search with a much lower efficiency as compared to what Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master did in the past.
That was right too.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master had the complete inheritance. It was not just his incarnation that could teleport through an ultra-long distance, he even had an avatar technique that made him better than Xue Ying at scouting.
‘This is?’ The black-robed Xue Ying was filled with disbelief.
“Hu.”
He took a step before entering the warped space ahead. Xue Ying was directly brought to a sealed area very close to what he saw.
As he checked the area at an extremely close distance, through the many black fog spherical holes, Xue Ying was able to see that not far away, there was a space of lair with an incomparably beautiful ancient void tree, and a total of nine golden eggs.
‘Golden-armored graded lair?’ The heart of Xue Ying could not help but accelerate. He thoroughly inspected the place. He did not see wrongly. The color of those eggs… were gold!

chapters.title: Chapter 951 - Attacking the Castle
chapters.content:
Chapter 951: Attacking the Castle
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying hyperventilated. He was carefully checking through everything within the space of the ‘golden-armored graded lair’. A golden-armored graded lair represented a continuous supply of ‘golden-armored ranked Destruction Devils’. Over an extended period, the number of golden-armored Destruction Devils that would emerge from a lair would only increase. The cultivators even suspected that Destruction Devils at the Cosmos God realm should have once been golden-armored ranked Destruction Devils!
In reality, there were 15 ‘kings’ that emerged in total.
Other than two golden-armored lairs which were destroyed earlier, there were still six left in existence! One could deduce how many ‘kings’ would appear relative to the number of golden-armored graded lairs. Furthermore, over time, the golden-armored graded lairs would nurture more of them.
In other words—
A golden-armored graded lair would at least nurture two ‘kings’ in the large batches of golden-armored Destruction Devils. There might be even more.
Hence, there would only be more ‘kings’ on the side of the Destruction Devils as time passed. The number of Destruction Devils would also increase to a horrifying stage, and the cultivators would lose without a doubt!
‘I’ve finally found a golden-armored graded lair.’ Xue Ying felt both moved and excited.
Even though the cultivators might not be sure of how much a golden-armored lair was worth, they had still publicized the bounty for finding one. The incarnations of cultivators that came to the Lost World Corridor, should they discover a ‘golden-armored graded lair’ and reported upwards, would be rewarded with a huge amount of ‘100,000 Origin World Rocks’! Hence, many cultivators would try their luck by venturing in the Lost World Corridor with their incarnations.
Even ‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’s proposed price was something the cultivators were willing to accept. It was primarily because they wanted to destroy the golden-armored graded lairs.
But it’s a pity that Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was too greedy.
He wanted ‘10,000 Origin World Rocks’ for every 100 million years spent on searching for lairs. He wanted so much despite not discovering a single golden-armored graded lair. If he spent 10 billion years searching… that would be equivalent to one million Origin World Rocks already. It was okay if he could discover something, but if he did not, then the Cosmos Gods could not afford it either.
‘Mn?’
Xue Ying’s attention was soon attracted by that ancient void tree. He was able to observe the structure with exceptional clarity through the black fog spherical holes at a close distance.
‘Its utilization of the void is too perfect.’ Xue Ying praised, ‘The Lost World Corridor is indeed the holy ground for those cultivating in the void. And this ‘golden-armored graded lair’ is the holy ground of the holy grounds.’
“Sou.”
That day, Xue Ying sent out the second incarnation into the Lost World Corridor to continue searching for other Destruction Devil lairs. And the first incarnation remained in that sealed space cultivating by himself to observe the ‘golden-armored graded lair ancient void tree’.
Actually, strictly speaking, the four-diagrams absolute art created by Monarch Nine Cloud, the “Walker’s Hidden Secret” and the structure of the ancient void tree headed in different directions. But they could be cross-referenced.
‘I am not in a rush to report upwards. I should wait until this ancient void tree is no longer useful to me before I report upwards.’ Xue Ying thought. Even though the ancient void tree was nurturing Destruction Devils, it took a long time to even nourish a single golden-armored Destruction Devil. Every batch would have nine eggs at most, and after the nine eggs were hatched, the next batch of golden eggs would take at the shortest, 10 billion years to form, and at the longest, a trillion years. Forming devils with greater talent would require a longer time.
******
Time passed.
In the blink of an eye, it had already been 2.1 billion years that Xue Ying had been to the Void Castle. Within the huge palace hall of the Void Castle.
“Mn?”
“What!”
The incarnations of the Primal Chaos cultivators who were discussing Dao or be by themselves suddenly stood up. They were looking at the enormous scene showing in midair by the boundary of the hall. That was a projection showing the disturbances made in the outer region and the inner region by the Destruction Devils. At this moment—
There were many spots of light appearing at the same time by the boundary. They were also entering the inner region one after another while rushing in the direction of the ‘spatial barrier’.
Xue Ying and the others had powerful vision. With just a glance at those dense light spots, they were able to discern a total of 3,000 devils incoming.
“They are attacking the spatial barrier again?”
All the Primal Chaos cultivators felt their hearts tightening. Usually, when the devils provoked the cultivators, they would remain at the boundary. But now, they were venturing deep into the inner region. It was clear that their target was the ‘final spatial barrier’.
“Sou sou sou sou sou sou…”
Many figures started appearing one after another in the huge palace hall. It was to the extent that the surrounding space began warping and distorting. Many terrifying existences were coming out from within. Its power was so great that Xue Ying and the others felt aghast.
Other than the Void Castle, it was too difficult to even see so many Cosmos Gods at once, and this being their true bodies!
Just a breath of time later.
A total of 12 Cosmos Gods appeared. They came over from different places. One had to know that the majority of them did not know how to teleport through an ultra-long distance. They had to ask their subordinates to construct an ultra-long distance passage for them to come. Even so, it took a breath of time for them to rush over.
Xue Ying carefully looked. There were many Cosmos Gods whom he had never seen before.
His grand-teacher, ‘Void Primogenitor’ was a black-robed green-haired male. His eyes were gentle, and he seemed to adore all beings. He glanced at Xue Ying before turning back to other Cosmos Gods.
“They are going to attack the spatial barrier once again.” More than half the final realm existences from the five great sacred worlds and primal chaos void were gathered here. Their auras were vast and unfathomable. There was a male who had many shackles surrounding him—’Ancestor Sorcerer’. Ancestor Sorcerer was currently speaking solemnly, “Even though they have been defeated many times, we can’t be too careless as things will be disastrous as long as we were defeated once, and for the spatial barrier to be broken through.”
“Mn, then we will go according to the old plan?” A giant with an enormous body that seemed to be made from black magma rock stood there stating coldly.
Nobody present disagreed with him.
“Then let’s proceed.” Ancestor Sorcerer who had a thin and small body wearing a green robe declared.
…
In the Ancient Sacred World.
Within an enormous inner bath, piping hot steam was rising.
Sacred Master was immersed in this lake water. He sat beside the lake when suddenly, he turned over towards the distant ‘Lost World Corridor’. Even though the Ancient Sacred World was boundlessly far away from the Lost World Corridor, Sacred Master was able to observe what was happening. A strange, weird smile appearing on his face: “These Destruction Devils are thinking of sneaking into the five great sacred worlds once again?”
“As their number increases, there will be more kings emerging too. I currently do not have much time, and there are also those old men giving me problems.” Sacred Master shook his head softly. He then closed his eyes and continued enjoying himself in the bath.
…
Within the primal chaos void, Heaven Green World.
Heaven Green World was one of the small remnant piece left behind after the primitive Ancient Sacred World shattered. It was much smaller than the Nine Cloud Great Land; it was at most one-hundredth that of the Nine Cloud Great Land.
And the Heaven Green World was dominated by ‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’.
‘Hmph hmph hmph, they are about to attack the spatial barrier again?’
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master stood there on the mountain peak. He had a pair of scarlet red eyebrows, and his eyes were icy.
He was the proudest and most aloof expert amongst those at the ninth level strength. He even looked down on several Cosmos Gods because they had the risk of dying when facing the Sacred Master. But he was different. He had an avatar that could travel through ultra-long distance. Nobody had discovered his avatar at least until now.
Even Sacred Master wasn’t too willing to become enemies with those of the Myriad Realm Tavern Master lineage.
An enemy that could not be killed was the hardest enemy.
‘Very good. With those Destruction Devils attacking the Void Castle time after time, the Cosmos Gods will begin to feel the threat.’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master thought, ‘They will become more anxious over time, and there will finally be a day that they promise to my conditions.’
The Cosmos Gods requested him to help them.
And Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’s request was relatively expensive, so both parties did not come to an agreement.
‘This is a rare opportunity for me. I can earn a huge amount of Origin World Rocks.’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was not anxious. He believed that the Cosmos Gods would eventually give in to his conditions. As for offending those Cosmos Gods? He did not care at all!

chapters.title: Chapter 952 - Cosmos Gods
chapters.content:
Chapter 952: Cosmos Gods
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
At the boundary of the void, within the inner region.
“Xiu.”
A Destruction Devil that was originally flying at high speed suddenly turned into hundred blood light streams. They sped away in different directions, and the majority of the light streams headed in the general direction towards the spatial barrier.
“Die!” A cold voice berated out and reverberated in the void. Streams of water surged out everywhere in the void, clashing against blood light streams. They were rapidly extinguishing those blood light streams. Nevertheless, the blood light streams had long scattered into a hundred different streams and were far apart. Such a huge area move could merely block off the nearest ten blood light streams only.
“Damn.” A silver-robed male stood in midair frowning, “These Destruction Devils aren’t willing to battle us. Instead, they are escaping in all directions. Unless we extinguish all the streams of light, it is impossible to kill him. If we can’t kill him, then it is impossible to ascertain if he carries other Cosmos Gods!”
The same situation was happening in other places too.
The incarnations of the Primal Chaos cultivators were proceeding ahead. There were even some of the stronger ones like Primal Chaos Hall Master who had dispatched not just a single incarnation.
The Destruction Devils were all moving by themselves. Even though they were weaker, they had transformed themselves into more than a hundred stream of light. It was not an easy task extinguishing all streams.
…
“Descend.”
The white-robed Xue Ying stood amidst the primal chaos void. He was looking at the flying streams of blood light ahead of him. At the same time, the illusory realm began descending, causing that blood-colored light stream to stop.
The illusory realm targeted the soul directly! Even if the Destruction Devil split into a hundred different streams, as long as one stream fell into the illusory realm, it would be equivalent to his soul entering it! These were merely cannon fodders that were chosen because they were faster. Even though this was an incarnation of Xue Ying, it sufficed for him to unleash his illusory realm.
‘This isn’t it.’ While wholly immersed in the illusory realm, Xue Ying smoothly guided the other party into dissipating his soul, resulting in the death of this Destruction Devil.
…
“Die.”
On another location, Monarch Xing Huo was sending out fireballs after fireballs. This scarlet red fireball needed only to touch one of the flying streams, and that stream would stop and condense back into its original appearance-a blood-armored Destruction Devil. The devil would howl grievously with flames burning even in his eyes. In the blink of an eye, he would die.
…
There were only a few dozens amongst Primal Chaos giants who could deal against these escaping streams of light with their incarnations. Mixed within these giants, the Cosmos Gods were also doing their best.
Nevertheless, most of these Destruction Devils were at the sixth level strength. The illusory realm displayed by Xue Ying’s incarnation was too weak, and he had a hard time trying to exterminate those with sufficient heart strength. There were even some golden-armored Destruction Devils disguised in this group! Those were Destruction Devils whom Monarch Xing Huo and Heart Imitation Religious Master could not kill with their incarnations.
As for their true bodies?
The Cosmos Gods had sent a strict order—the true bodies of Primal Chaos giants were forbidden from entering the battle! Ultimately, the core power of the Destruction Devils was also hidden within this group of Destruction Devils, and that core power would be at the level of Cosmos God. Furthermore, there were multiple of these Destruction Devils! If the Primal Chaos giants were to send their true bodies, they might die.
“We are really helpless against them.”
The white-robed Xue Ying stood in the void. There were fewer and fewer cannon fodders left, but it was also becoming harder to handle the remaining few.
Especially the dozen of golden-armored Destruction Devils. Because they were escaping in different directions, it was exceptionally hard for the true bodies of Cosmos Gods to kill all of them together. Only ‘Ancestor Sorcerer’ and ‘Jade Light Master’, a few of the Cosmos Gods had ways of achieving this.
“Hong~”
A horrifying tremor came that made Xue Ying shudder. He hurriedly turned over.
Over there, a black thunder tore apart an area of a trillion kilometers. It was brutal and ugly and contained a horrifying destructive aura.
‘It is a Cosmos God Destruction Devil.’ Xue Ying was able to deduce it immediately.
“Hong.””Hong.””Hong.”
The experts were clashing in the distant.
Xue Ying felt his heart relaxing. Clearly, the Cosmos Gods from his side had discovered a core power of the Destruction Devils! They had begun fighting against them. There were usually a few Cosmos Gods forming the core power on the side of the Destruction Devils because if there were merely two, they would easily be killed by the cultivators. Only when there was this number of Destruction Devils… could they resist against the cultivators by teaming together!
‘So strong.’
The shockwaves coming from the battle made Xue Ying dumbstruck.
A dazzling sword of light could be seen extending across a trillion kilometers. Xue Ying was able to discern it as the final sword of the “13 Apocalyptic Swords”.
A heaven-shaking howl made Xue Ying’s soul tremble. He had a feeling that even if he used his current body—of which he was proud of—to defend, he would likely die in an instant! This roar gave him a feeling of a threat beyond that of the 13th Apocalyptic Sword!
“Ding dang~” A sweet-sounding tune reverberated in the void.
An enormous bird screamed in a fury.
Many shackles that represented evil were moving like dragon snakes.
’12 Cosmos Gods.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Of which there are Ancestor Sorcerer, Blade Emperor, World Ancestor and several others who are only secondary to the Sacred Master. They are working together. This power should likely be similar to that battle which caused the primitive Ancient Sacred World in the past.’
His own survival capabilities were not bad, and he might survive when facing Cosmos Gods at the third level. Nevertheless, if Xue Ying were to face Ancestor Sorcerer, Blade Emperor, World Ancestor, Jade Light Master, and the others, it would likely end up in slaughter, much less when they were working together. If Xue Ying’s true body were to go over now, the shockwaves from the battle would likely extinguish him.
…
Within the Void Castle, in an enormous palace hall.
Xue Ying, Monarch Xing Huo, Primal Chaos Hall Master, Heart Imitation Religious Master, and several hundred Primal Chaos cultivators were currently here. Even if they were located within the Void Castle, they could clearly feel the frightening disturbances created in the distance from the battle.
“If it were one on one, I can still manage some of the weaker Cosmos Gods.” Primal Chaos Hall Master was feeling the battle from afar. He shook his head and continued, “Ancestor Sorcerer and the others are indeed experts who can resist against the Sacred Master. I only need to experience the shockwaves coming from this battle, and it will snuff any thoughts of fighting against them.”
“We are ultimately still at the Primal Chaos realm.” Monarch Xing Huo said.
“Indeed. Those standing at the highest spots will still be the ones to determine the fate of all cultivators.” Heart Imitation Religious Master said.
They were currently speaking.
Though deep in their hearts, they desired to step into the level of Cosmos God too.
Even though Xue Ying stood there, he was watching the battle through the black fog spherical holes in reality. As this battle was too chaotic, and the core region where the battle was happening had become so distorted that he could not see clearly, Xue Ying could only observe the battle from far away. The most dazzling one in the battlefield was none other than ‘Ancestor Sorcerer’. Ancestor Sorcerer had divided into a total of nine terrifying incarnations, and his true body was even more frightening. Every single roar shook the world.
World Ancestor was different. He looked thin and small, yet with each grab, he would take some scales or flesh and threw them into his mouth.
Jade Light Master was the most beautiful when fighting-playing the qin in the battlefield, emitting a beautiful sound that reverberated in the void.
From this battle, it seemed the cultivators held an absolute advantage. They were completely suppressing the Destruction Devils. The Destruction Devils would have the occasional malicious thunder forming or some venomous snakes that struck out to bite at the cultivators’ Cosmos Gods. But any of Ancestor Sorcerer’s nine incarnations had easily grabbed the venomous snake before eating them.

chapters.title: Chapter 953 - The Slaughter of the Destruction Devils (1
chapters.content:
Chapter 953: The Slaughter of the Destruction Devils (1)
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Primal Chaos existences could only wait within the Void Castle.
Xue Ying was also silently waiting in the enormous palace hall watching the blurred image being projected on the smooth wall next to him. He shook his head softly. No matter the battle that brought the primitive Ancient Sacred World to ruin or the subsequent wars that Sacred Master incited, or this resistance against the Destruction Devils, the final decisive battles were always dependent on the Cosmos Gods. They as Primal Chaos existences could only spectate from the side.
One Blade Emperor or Ancestor Sorcerer sufficed to exterminate all of them.
This was the gap in quality.
“Sou.”
A total of several hundred Primal Chaos existences including Xue Ying, Monarch Xing Huo, and Heart Imitation Religious Master suddenly turned over at the same time. There was a hunchbacked old man who appeared in the palace hall. He was none other than Forefather Tian Yu.
Forefather Tian Yu swept his gaze across the Primal Chaos existences before chuckling: “Alright, those Destruction Devils have either died in battle or have fled. There are no longer any Destruction Devil in the inner region. The danger this time has been resolved.”
“Ha.”
“I knew it.”
“It will always be a joke no matter how those Destruction Devils struggle.”
The whole hall burst into noise all of a sudden; laughter filled the place.
Forefather Tian Yu softly nodded before his figure turned blurred and he disappeared.
Xue Ying was merely watching everything. It was hard for him to relax.
“Dong Bo, go, let us go drink a few cups.” Monarch Xing Huo walked over with a smile, “The matter has been resolved, yet why are you still frowning? What is on your mind?”
“Nothing much. Come, let us go have some drinks.” Xue Ying immediately revealed a smile. But he was sighing in his heart-
Attack? The Destruction Devils took the initiative to attack them.
Retreat? It was similarly the Destruction Devils who were in control when they retreated.
…
Within the Void Castle, in another quiet palace hall, the 12 Cosmos Gods were seated here. Their expressions were ugly.
“The final one who called himself ‘Emperor Jun’ seems to be comparable with me in strength.” Blade Emperor sat there commenting with a cold voice.
“The survival capabilities of those Destruction Devils are innately great. These Cosmos Gods devils working together might be far from our overall combat strength, but none of them died after fighting with us for four hours.” Devil Mountain Primogenitor sighed with a deep tone, “We can’t kill them, and there will only be more Cosmos Gods appearing over time. Furthermore, that Destruction Devil Emperor Jun has reached the second level of Cosmos God realm. It seems the situation is worsening.”
“Mn.”
“The situation is indeed getting bleak.”
Those present were all the Cosmos Gods that would determine the fate of the entire primal chaos void with their actions. Nevertheless, they felt helpless at this moment.
Kill?
They could not kill the other party!
The Destruction Devils were clearly becoming stronger at a faster rate. Even though the cultivators would also nurture more experts over time, they were nurturing them using ordinary methods. As for the Destruction Devils, with an increase in the number of lairs, many more powerful Destruction Devils would emerge every period. They would only become stronger, catching up to where the cultivators were, and even surpass them!
These Cosmos Gods were watching as things happened while remaining helpless about it.
“It is still quite early. They want to grow and reach our strength?
