It will require quite a long time.” Ancestor Sorcerer said nonchalantly, “During this period, we can also do our best to reduce the growth of the Destruction Devils. As long as we have sufficient time, a miracle might happen. Even if we lost in the final struggle, it isn’t a big deal since we will just be destroyed along with the primal chaos void.”
“Haha, indeed, it’ll be a case of a great apocalypse at the end at worst.”
“There is still sufficient time.”
For these cultivators to reach where they were, everyone had the fortitude to accept the proceedings calmly.
“These Destruction Devils have attacked the spatial barrier many times already.” World Ancestor caressed his thin, small and sharp jaw while muttering, “And they did not exert their true genuine strength every single time.”
“Mn.”
“Right, they did not exert all their strength at all.”
“Just like that Emperor Jun, he did not act at the start. He only started striking us at the end.”
“They did not send out many of the weaker Destruction Devils as well. If they were to throw in their true strength, they could definitely send out ten times or even more Destruction Devils to beguile us, making it hard for us to discover their core power. They can then easily arrive at our spatial barrier.”
Everyone present agreed. The Destruction Devils had not used their full strength.
World Ancestor continued: “Why are they doing this? Why are they attacking the spatial barrier time after time without sending their full force? I’ve long guessed that they are scouting the actual situation of the spatial barrier, but is it the case everytime they attacked us? Furthermore, we have even discovered traces of the Destruction Devils hiding in the primal chaos void and the five great sacred worlds. Clearly, the Destruction Devils have crossed through the spatial barrier and proceeded onto the five great sacred worlds. But how did they achieve that? I guess it should be at the point of time when they attacked the spatial barrier.”
“I suspect that too.” Ancestor Sorcerer added, “But I’ve examined the spatial barrier many times before, and have never discovered any disturbances of them crossing it.”
“Unless they have someone who can teleport through an ultra-long distance too?” Ancestor Bone muttered.
“Impossible.”
“If they could do so, there is no point for them to waste their time with us here. They would have long killed their way to the five great sacred worlds.”
“Mn, they should have some special ways of crossing the spatial barrier.”
They were also thinking about it.
******
The mood of the cultivators was slightly worse. They had already discovered that there were some ‘issues’ with the Destruction Devils attacking the spatial barrier time after time. And within the Lost World Corridor.
“Haha…”
The five ‘kings’ were currently within a luxurious-looking palace and were drinking and chatting happily.
Seated at the most center was a thin male with a long, scaled tail. His tail was subdivided into many parts, and his tail had encircled around his own seat twice. He was currently the strongest expert of the current Destruction Devil, ‘Emperor Jun’.
“Those cultivators are still foolishly fighting with us, yet they do not know that we have already sent three kings out when we are attacking the spatial barrier.”
“The shadowless talent is indeed formidable.”
“This palm of mine has created a shockwave that reached General Mo Gu, but he isn’t injured at all.”
They were both praising and envying those with great innate talent.
The ‘shadowless’ talent represented the limit of the void-ification theory. One could practically bypass all forbidding techniques, barriers, seals, and other experts’ offense could hardly injure them too. The moment they void-ified, others could not see him.
“Who would have thought that Emperor Jun has returned this time too.”
“Haha, with Big Brother Emperor Jun around, we will have an easier time dealing against those cultivators.”
Emperor Jun who was seated there with his long tails moving slightly chuckled: “This time, the other three kings have left too. All the ‘kings’ have been out before, and we aren’t in a rush to start another battle for a longer period. Everyone should calm yourself down and properly cultivate. We need sufficient time and patience to accumulate the strength of our Destruction Devils.”
“Mn.” The other four present nodded and agreed with him.
…
In the period after that, things returned to normal. Xue Ying spent the majority of his concentration on cultivation and seeking new golden-armored graded lairs. He would occasionally get embroiled in battles within the inner region.
In the blink of an eye, another 300 million years had passed.
In the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, within a slightly more isolated region, there was an extravagant city. This was the territory of the Primal Chaos giant, ‘Jade Light Empress’. Jade Light Empress opened her own religion here, imparting it to her disciples. She had even constructed a colossal city that could protect many cultivators. During this period, Jade Light Empress was absolutely the ancestor of this region, and many nations had decided to rely on her. Of which only the most talented cultivators were qualified to become her disciple.
“Empress.”
“Empress.”
Within the god palace, everyone who saw Jade Light Empress would respectfully greet her.
Jade Light Empress was in a pristine white robe. She walked within the palace hall barefooted, and there was a strand of frown on her brows. She was initially in closed-door cultivation when suddenly, she felt that things were amiss.
“What happened?” Jade Light Empress stood before the railings at the top level of the god palace. She grabbed on the railings while looking down at the huge city.
And at this moment.
There were six figures situated high in the sky. The leading one was a golden-robed man. The golden-robed man was tall and thin, and his triangular eyes were looking down at the entire nation. There was a wicked look on his face.
“Capture Jade Light Empress alive for me. I want to personally swallow her.” The thin golden-robed man ordered coldly, “I want to devour all cultivators in the entire city as well.”
“Yes, yes General Mo Gu.” The five subordinates behind him acknowledged.
The golden-robed thin male revealed a smile of excitement and expectation. He was none other than General Mo Gu who had the ‘shadowless talent’. The other three ‘kings’ had long separated away from him and went hiding in the cultivator’s world with concealed identities. As for these five subordinates… they were all golden-armored ranked Destruction Devils, with two reaching the ninth level strength, and the other three reaching the peak of the eighth level.
These five were selected exceptionally and were brought out together previously! Their mission was to protect ‘General Mo Gu’.
“It has been too long. Previously, you all prevented me from devouring the cultivators, but this time, I must eat to my pleasure.” The golden-robed thin male extended his tongue and licked his lips.

chapters.title: Chapter 954 - The Slaughter of the Destruction Devils (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 954: The Slaughter of the Destruction Devils (2)
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
In terms of heart temperament, General Mo Gu who was still very young was considered the weakest amongst those who came to the five great sacred worlds. The others that had been brought over by him had solid control. General Mo Gu was only at the ‘peak seventh level’ if his heaven-defying talent, the ‘void-ification’ method, was excluded. He was still frequently influenced by the desire for destruction.
Previously when he wanted to kill, he had been forcefully discouraged by the surrounding five subordinates. They mentioned: “We have to be careful. If you want to kill, slaughtering once is enough. Instead, you should spend most of the time concealing so that you reveal fewer traces. If you were to irritate a Cosmos God over, things would be troublesome.”
Ultimately, he was still a golden-armored Destruction Devil, and his temperament was poor. At least he had some slight control of himself and could endure until today.
“Prepare well.”
“Start moving.”
Jade Light Empress who was chosen as their target was merely at the peak of the seventh level. She did not have any means of retaliating against the five terrifying golden-armored graded Destruction Devils.
“Hong.” Jade Light Empress who stood by the railings suddenly changed expression. She turned over, only to see countless silk strands wrapping around her. With a thought, a green light surged out from her body, yet it was easily cut by those silk strands. The silk strands permeated into her body, easily sealing her strength. This brought a chill down the heart of Jade Light Empress.
A single move? She was captured alive? This, unless it was a terrifying existence at the ninth level Star Pagoda strength?
“General.” The five black-robed men bowed respectfully by the side.
The golden-robed thin male, General Mo Gu walked over. He was looking at Jade Light Empress with rapt excitement.
“Who are you?” Jade Light Empress asked.
“Who am I? Hahaha… the person who will devour you soon.” General Mo Gu extended his hand, pinching on the white, tender neck of Jade Light Empress. He directly lifted her, opened his mouth and extended his tongue. His tongue extended to over several meters long before wrapping it around the Empress. “Sou.” He directly swallowed Jade Light Empress.
The golden-armored General Mo Gu felt so excited that he was trembling.
This was the first time he devoured a Primal Chaos cultivator alive. This had practically satisfied his desire to slaughter and nourished his soul; It intoxicated him.
“Hou~”
The golden-armored General Mo Gu opened his mouth. Suddenly, a horrifying fluctuation covered the entire city. It was not just the guests living in the city or the cultivators living in the courtyards, a dense number of cultivators flew up uncontrollably.
The entire city spanned a total of five million kilometers long, and a trillion cultivators were living within. Nevertheless, to the Primal Chaos existences, it was typical for a single move of theirs to cover several million kilometers, much less the five black-robed men behind General Mo Gu-two were at the ninth level strength, and three at the peak of the eighth level. With a thought, they were able to bring the entire city under their control.
“Ah.”
“What happened?”
“No.”
Even the disciples living within this god palace were similarly flying out uncontrollably. The closer they flew towards the golden-robed General Mo Gu, the smaller they became. In the end, all of them were swallowed into his stomach! The five black-robed men by the side were also utilizing some techniques by the side, shackling those who could resist the attraction from afar before sending them into the mouth of General Mo Gu.
Regardless if it was a human or a being of another race, if they were weak or strong, all of them were devoured by him.
With the help of the five of them and General Mo Gu’s personal strength, this city’s trillion living beings were all devoured. General Mo Gu was so excited that his eyes turned red. It was truly an enjoyment to any Destruction Devil to consume these many cultivators. He fell in love with the taste instantly.
******
Lost World Corridor.
One of Xue Ying’s incarnation was researching the ancient void tree located in the golden-armored graded lair, while another incarnation of his was traveling within the corridor seeking for more lairs.
‘Mn?’
Being a cultivator who had been selected to search for those Destruction Devils hiding within the five great sacred worlds as cultivators, Xue Ying had received a piece of information immediately after the incident which happened earlier. This was information pertaining to traces of Destruction Devils within the primal chaos void.
‘What?’ Xue Ying’s expression changed.
Jade Light Empress and the entire Jade Light City’s 5.3 trillion cultivators…
Had been completely eaten!
And the murderer was indeed the Destruction Devils!
‘5.3 trillion cultivators?’ Xue Ying did not dare believe it. A city that could house so many cultivators was considered a huge city even in the five great sacred worlds. This was the territory of a Primal Chaos giant, and even ‘Jade Light Empress’ was personally eaten?
‘Damn, damn.” Xue Ying felt his killing intent soaring.
It was long said that the Destruction Devils existed to destroy.
Since they were resisting them at the boundary of the void, the cultivators could not feel how intense the existence of Destruction Devils was to the cultivators. But this time, the scale of cultivators being devoured had been so great that Xue Ying could not help but shudder.
‘Is this the supreme law? The supreme law has actually given birth to such wicked Destruction Devils?’ Xue Ying gritted his teeth, ‘Or is it the case that we are mere ants in front of the supreme law?’
‘Damn.’
…
In the Void Castle, there was a group of Cosmos Gods living here. Of course, they were mostly incarnations.
Since Xue Ying had obtained the information, the various Cosmos Gods would naturally have received it.
‘They actually devoured so many cultivators in one fell swoop. The Destruction Devils have truly turned mad after entering the five great sacred worlds.’
‘Jade Light, she…’ Jade Light Master softly sighed. There was a surge of killing intent emanating from her. She remembered that she had once guided that lass before while traveling in the sacred world. That little lass soon rose up and became a Primal Chaos existence. Jade Light Master was relatively joyful for her, albeit she would not have thought that this would be Jade Light Empress’ outcome in the end.
Jade Light Master turned to Forefather Tian Yu: “Tian Yu, you said before that Dong Bo Xue Ying’s method is relatively formidable, and he should be able to handle all kinds of situations. Furthermore, he is able to escape with his life by teleporting through an ultra-long distance. When will he be searching for traces of those Destruction Devils?”
“He has just reached the Primal Chaos realm, and I am unsure to what extent he has cultivated the Imperial Dragon inheritance to. I did not ask him either.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “How about this, I’ll go and ask him later on. If he has cultivated the inheritance to large success, we can let him start searching for the lairs. Oh right, Ancestor Sorcerer, it is very possible for him to meet Cosmos God Destruction Devils while searching for traces of the lairs, what about the gift that we have discussed earlier on?”
“I’ve prepared it already-the gift that will protect him.” Ancestor Sorcerer nodded.
Suddenly-
Forefather Tian Yu turned shocked. Suddenly, he revealed a look of excitement. He waved his hand in a hurry.
“Hu.”
A thick white-robed Xue Ying appeared. This was his true body. Forefather Tian Yu was one of the three Cosmos Gods stationed at the Void Castle protecting it. It was his true body stationed here, and he could control part of the Void Castle too. Naturally, he could teleport Xue Ying’s true body over easily.
“What happened?”
“Tian Yu?”
The others felt shocked and suspicious.
“Dong Bo has teleported through an ultra-long distance, sending his incarnation into the Lost World Corridor. And the location which he has teleported in is actually a golden-armored graded lair.” Forefather Tian Yu did not dare to delay. He immediately transmitted the news to others.
“What!”
“Golden-armored graded lair?”
Everyone present was shocked.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, quickly open up a passage!” Ancestor Sorcerer stared at Xue Ying. His eyes formed an unprecedented sharpness which Xue Ying had never seen before.
“Yes!”
Xue Ying did not dare delay. He immediately extended his hand and pointed forward. “Hong long~” Suddenly, the void ahead distorted, showing another region right ahead.
“I’ll enter first.” Jade Light Master immediately mentioned. She was one of the three Cosmos Gods protecting the Void Castle, and also the only one out of the three who had reached the second level of Cosmos God realm.
“Hu.”
The space to the side fluctuated, and then the true body of a green-robed Void Primogenitor appeared: “I’ll accompany you.”
With Void Primogenitor who was the number one expert in the void going as well, the two of them would not have to fear even if all the kings worked together.
“Go.”
Jade Light Master and Void Primogenitor directly traveled along the passage opened by Xue Ying. They took a step and entered another region.

chapters.title: Chapter 955 - Breaking the Foundation
chapters.content:
Chapter 955: Breaking the Foundation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The golden-armored graded space was essential to the Destruction Devils. It was heavily guarded and patrolled, and even its entrance was disguised. Nevertheless, only a single golden-armored Destruction Devil was defending the inner section of this vast space.
The Destruction Devils were clear that the moment the cultivators were able to enter the inner region of the lair, it was pointless even if they arranged more golden-armored Destruction Devils.
Suddenly, the space within distorted. A black-robed Xue Ying appeared within this lair. Looking at the scene within, he revealed a look of delight.
“Who?” The golden-armored Destruction Devil guard abruptly turned over. With a glance, he saw the distant black-robed cultivator, causing his expression to change immediately! They were discovered?
“King! The third golden-armored graded lair has been discovered. The incarnation of a cultivator has appeared inside.” The golden-armored Destruction Devil reported immediately.
“Kill him!”
The ‘kings’ who obtained the news were aghast. None of them had the ultra-long distance teleportation technique, and it would require some time for them to travel over.
“Die for me!” While this golden-armored Destruction Devil guard communicated to the kings, without waiting for an order, he took the initiative to act. One could see a huge black cloud surrounding the distant Xue Ying to which Xue Ying reacted with a teleport. It was clear Xue Ying had reached such high level in the void that he could easily pull apart the distance between him and the golden-armored Destruction Devil. The Destruction Devil could momentarily not reach up to him.
Being a Voidwalker and someone who cultivated in the four-diagrams absolute art of Monarch Nine Cloud, Xue Ying was someone who reached high attainments in the void. Furthermore, he had even been training bitterly for 20 billion years within the Lost World Corridor. Many Cosmos Gods could not reach up to his current control of the void. Even an incarnation of his could arrogantly look down on many other Primal Chaos existences in this aspect.
Closely following that, the inner space of the golden-armored lair warped, and two figures came walking out.
One was a beautiful and classy girl-she was Jade Light Master. Jade Light Master’s beautiful eyes swept across the region. Her vision landed on that distant ancient void tree. Seeing the few golden eggs that were formed on the ancient void tree, her eyes revealed a dazzle. With a wave of her hands, a qin appeared. She then plucked on the strings…
A musical composition formed from it. It had even created fluctuations that the naked eyes could see, spreading out in all directions.
By the side of Jade Light Master, there was the green-haired Void Primogenitor. Void Primogenitor coldly glanced around him, though seeing the ancient void tree made him excited.
‘It is too late!’ That golden-armored Destruction Devil guard who was chasing after Xue Ying’s incarnation felt despair after seeing Jade Light Master and Void Primogenitor arriving.
The moment the Cosmos Gods from the cultivators arrived, they would no longer have any hopes of salvaging the situation!
“Hong~”
Being a golden-armored graded ancient void tree that was of the highest grade, even though it was firm and stable, when Jade Light Master personally acted, those golden eggs turned into powder under the power of the musical composition. As for the ancient void tree, it began warping. After withstanding for two breaths of time, the entire ancient void tree collapsed, and this space also started collapsing.
As for that golden-armored Destruction Devil guard, he was similarly destroyed under the fluctuation from the musical composition.
“Go.”
As space collapsed, Jade Light Master and Void Primogenitor directly teleported away. As for Xue Ying’s disguised incarnation, he had long taken the initiative to dissipate.
…
Lost World Corridor.
The five ‘kings’ of the Destruction Devils gathered.
“Damn.”
“How could this be?”
“We have guarded the place really strictly. There are also many patrols protecting the place. We have even disguised the entrance, so how could it still be discovered by the cultivators?”
The five kings were furious.
They did not care even if they lost a hundred lower graded lairs. Even if they lost more than half their ‘blood-armored graded lairs’, they could face it calmly. Nevertheless, every single ‘golden-armored graded lair’ was vital to them! This was the true foundation of their Destruction Devils, and the current 15 ‘kings’ that had emerged since the start were golden-armored Destruction Devils previously. Everything originated from golden-armored graded lairs!
The golden-armored graded lairs could nurture many batches of golden-armored Destruction Devils, and there could be ‘kings’ emerging from within.
They had felt heartache from the loss of two golden-armored graded lairs in the past, but at that time, they were too weak and had no choice. Over time as they grew stronger, the defenses and patrols were fortified. It had been a long time since the last golden-armored graded lair had been discovered.
“Currently, we only have six golden-armored graded lairs. Another one has been discovered.” Emperor Jun sat there. His long tail circled around the place, and his eyes were emitting a blood-colored light amidst his thin face.
Even if more than a hundred golden-armored Destruction Devils died, they could be replaced over time.
But the destruction of the lairs meant breaking their foundation!
“According to the intelligence, the cultivators did not come from the entrance. Instead, they appeared directly from within.”
“It should be ultra-long distance teleportation.”
“Right, it should be a cultivator who was teleporting through ultra-long distance, and an incarnation of his has coincidentally landed in the golden-armored graded lair.”
The other kings could only sigh.
Even though they could not teleport through an ultra-long distance, they still had relevant information regarding the cultivators after living with them. They knew that the further the distance of ‘ultra-long distance teleportation’, the greater the deviation! It was impossible for them to have a ‘spatial marking’ on the golden-armored graded lair. Instead, it should be a huge deviation when the cultivator teleported through an ultra-long distance.
And this deviation had led him directly into the golden-armored graded lair.
After all, over the long periods when the cultivators came in seeking for traces of the lairs, it would undoubtedly be probable for them to coincidentally end up in a golden-armored graded lair.
“Their luck is truly too good.”
“He actually coincidentally teleported into our golden-armored graded lair?”
They felt sullen.
Emperor Jun’s eyes remained cold. After remaining silent for a while, did he finally speak: “Investigate. Think of ways to find out who is the one that discovered the golden-armored graded lair! We must ascertain that it is because he is lucky, and not because he has some unique cultivation technique.”
If it were just luck, then the threat would not be significant.
But if the other party had a technique to investigate them, then the Destruction Devils would be in for huge trouble!
******
Within the Void Castle, it was filled with hurrays.
“Hahaha, this time after we destroyed another golden-armored graded lair, we have greatly reduced the rise of their power. It has been a long time since we last had such a huge victory.” Forefather Tian Yu said while beaming from ear to ear. The other Cosmos Gods present including Ancestor Sorcerer, World Ancestor, and others also had a rare smile on their face. It had indeed been a long time since they last had such a huge victory.
In the early periods, when they faced the Destruction Devils, they could suppress them totally. They had killed four ‘kings’ one after another and even destroyed two golden-armored graded lairs.
But nowadays, those ‘kings’ dared to kill their way to the spatial barrier before retreating safely! The cultivators might still have an absolute advantage over the Destruction Devils, but they could no longer kill the Destruction Devils. It had also been a long time since they last discovered traces of the golden-armored graded lairs. They even invited ‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’, spending a considerable amount of Origin World Rocks yet to no avail.
“The lairs are their foundation. After cutting part of their roots, we have more time to grow stronger.” Ancestor Sorcerer chuckled and nodded.
“Judging by what we guessed earlier-kings originate from the golden-armored graded lairs-it is crucial for us to destroy their golden-armored graded lairs. It is highly possible that the Destruction Devils are turning mad now. Regardless, many of their members have invaded and hidden in our five great sacred worlds.” Void Primogenitor looked towards Xue Ying who stood by the side, “The moment news about Dong Bo Xue Ying discovering the golden-armored graded lairs is spread, the Destruction Devils who have hidden in our world will likely bring trouble to him.”
“Mn.” The other Cosmos Gods nodded too.
“This matter has to be kept a secret.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “It must not be leaked.”
“Indeed it cannot be leaked.” Ancestor Sorcerer nodded too. His gaze landed on Xue Ying before mentioning with a peal of laughter, “Hall Master Dong Bo, did you discover this golden-armored graded lair by chance, or do you truly have some unique cultivation technique?”

chapters.title: Chapter 956 - Dong Bo Xue Ying’s Mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 956: Dong Bo Xue Ying’s Mission
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
At that moment, the other Cosmos Gods turned towards Xue Ying. Was it luck? Or was it a scouting technique? If it were a scouting technique, then it would be of great help to all the cultivators.
“You should feel rest assured. The Cosmos Gods present will not leak this news outside.” Ancestor Sorcerer mentioned to Xue Ying.
“I relied on ultra-long distance teleportation.” Xue Ying said, “After reaching the Primal Chaos realm, I have grasped the ability to teleport through an ultra-long distance. It was luck that I coincidentally ended up in the golden-armored graded lair after sending myself into the Lost World Corridor. As for the scouting technique you mentioned, how is it possible for me to have a technique that specializes in finding golden-armored lairs?”
Ancestor Sorcerer, World Ancestor, and the others looked at each other.
They sighed inwardly.
That’s right too.
The Lost World Corridor had a unique environment. All kinds of danger existed within, and it was possible for true bodies to fall when they enter the place. Only ‘Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’ could proceed with scouting for lairs by sending their incarnations in, yet it’s a pity they raised such exaggerated prices.
It was quite good for Xue Ying to discover a lair with his luck. The Cosmos Gods should not hope for too much.
“It is indeed too difficult to find traces of a golden-armored graded lair. You are also sending your incarnation frequently while praying for good fortune. This might be the only way we have of finding golden-armored graded lairs.” Ancestor Sorcerer said. They would definitely not agree to the demands of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master until the very last moment because they did not have much Origin World Rocks either.
“Yes.” Xue Ying said.
By the side, Blade Emperor waved his hands, causing a silver band to fly over: “This is 100,000 Origin World Rocks. It is from the common fund provided by all of us. Since you discovered a golden-armored graded lair, this is yours.”
The Cosmos Gods had long publicized the rewards.
Xue Ying accepted it delightfully. He made his resolve inwardly-he would definitely consume this 100,000 Origin World Rocks! After all, Xue Ying believed that with sufficient time, his incarnation would be able to discover a second or third golden-armored graded lair. Nevertheless, it would be a long time before he would release the location of the next lair since discovering two lairs consecutively in a short period made it hard for him to use luck as his reason of explanation. It was highly possible that others would suspect him.
Regardless, he was not that poor. His teacher Gu Qi left behind quite a few treasures for him. Thus, Xue Ying would gladfully consume this 100,000 Origin World Rocks since it would be greatly nourishing to his soul, and would have holistic support to his cultivation too.
“Oh right, Dong Bo.” Forefather Tian Yu chuckled, “Have you cultivated that Imperial Dragon inheritance to the ninth transformation realm already?”
“I’ve achieved it already!” Xue Ying said.
With his strength and the secret treasure, Three-Colored Layered Cloud, even though Xue Ying had fought many times with the golden-armored Destruction Devils, none was qualified to force him to use his Imperial Dragon inheritance.
“Haha…” Devil Mountain Primogenitor loudly exclaimed, “Good. Hearing from Tian Yu, this technique of yours is great at defending. Since you have cultivated the Imperial Dragon inheritance to the ninth transformation, it should be even more amazing. You should know that we have a mission for you.”
“I know-it is searching for the Destruction Devils who have hidden in our world.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Right.” Jade Light Master’s voice was enchanting. She added, “These Destruction Devils are extremely cunning. Furthermore, they have some techniques which we do not know of yet. They are able to escape through our seals without alerting us. Furthermore… we Cosmos Gods have chased after their tracks many times, but they are able to sense the techniques of us cultivators. When we Cosmos Gods chased after them, they aren’t willing to show themselves. As for Primal Chaos existences, it is highly possible for them to fall from the search.”
Xue Ying nodded.
Previously, he had obtained the information…
Jade Light Empress did not have the time to escape; she was devoured. Those Destruction Devils that had hidden were very powerful. Previously, there had been two peak eighth level Primal Chaos giants dying in their hands. This was also the reason why the Cosmos Gods were willing to wait until Xue Ying’s defensive techniques became more formidable before releasing the mission despite their anxiety. Furthermore, Xue Ying had the technique of ‘ultra-long distance teleportation’, and they were even giving him a protection gift. Only then would they feel assured enough to send Xue Ying in search of traces of the hiding Destruction Devils.
Moreover, according to their estimations, it was highly possible that those who invaded into their world were Cosmos Gods.
By then, Xue Ying would have to face enemies at the Cosmos God level!
“This is the gift which we have prepare for you.” Ancestor Sorcerer extended his hand, causing a black bracelet to appear. This black bracelet was made of 12 beads chained together. Every single bead contained a three-dimensional array that was indistinct. This black bracelet then flew over to Xue Ying.
Xue Ying received it. The moment the bracelet ended up in his hands, he felt a horrifying weight coming down on his hands. With his strength, he had felt his palm sinking a bit.
Every single bead was heavier than even the Sun-Star.
“12 primal beads. They are mystical treasures formed naturally in the boundless world during the early period of the primitive Ancient Sacred World. Furthermore, they appeared at the same time.” Ancestor Sorcerer said, “Cosmos Gods usually have a secret survival treasure which they prepared for themselves, but that secret treasure is something that could not be activated at the Primal Chaos realm! Thus, taking into account the limitation of your power, this 12 primal beads is your best bet.”
“After refining them, the moment you activated it, there would be 12 layers of protective god light defending you at the same time. Even those at World Ancestor’s, Blade Emperor’s or my level would take one or two instances to destroy it at our full power. This bit of time is sufficient for you to escape for your life with ultra-long distance teleportation.” Ancestor Sorcerer said, “There is only one person who could destroy it instantaneously-Sacred Master.”
Xue Ying nodded.
He was ultimately at the Primal Chaos realm, and it was quite heaven-defying for him to rely on this secret treasure to remain alive under the hands of World Ancestor, Ancestor Sorcerer, and others at their level. As for Sacred Master? The gap between him and Sacred Master was ultimately too big.
“There are no Destruction Devils at the level of Sacred Master.” Forefather Tian Yu chuckled, “This secret treasure is sufficient for you, Dong Bo, though you should be careful. Don’t get ambushed by the devils since you will get killed if you do not have the time to activate the treasure. Then you can only blame yourself for being weak.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying was quite confident of himself.
The ‘law domain’ existed naturally. Being a Primal Chaos giant, his law domain could extend to a region of 50,000 kilometers around him. Whoever entered this region would be discovered by Xue Ying. It was too difficult for someone to invade into his law domain without alerting Xue Ying. Xue Ying as the only expert who reached the Primal Chaos realm in the Dao of Mirage would have an even more mystical law domain.
Actually, experts cultivating the laws and profound mysteries system were famous for their law domains-it was difficult for others to intrude into their domains. That’s because this path they took focused on the essence. Unlike those of the devour-class system or ancient cultivation system, their law domains were formed naturally, and those of the laws and profound mysteries system had deliberately constructed their own law domains personally.
Other than the law domain, Xue Ying’s perception of the void was acute too. After training in the Lost World Corridor for 20 billion years, he had cultivated the “Walker’s Hidden Secret” to the 49th level and both the second and third diagram created by Monarch Nine Cloud…
Hence, Xue Ying’s control of the void was extremely high.
Besides, his law domain and senses of the void would remain present all the time.
…
“These Destruction Devils who invaded into our world are becoming powerful. There have even been two peak eighth level existences who died without being able to escape in time. One must know that they are capable of surviving even when a ninth level existence attacked them.” Devil Mountain Primogenitor’s voice was somber. He stared at Xue Ying, “Thus, we have always suspected that there are Cosmos Gods who entered our world stealthily. There aren’t many cultivators at the ninth level, and there are only four who can teleport through an ultra-long distance. One belongs to the Ancient Sacred World, and one is Ancestor Mother’s subordinate. There is also that selfish Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master. Thus, we can only leave this mission to you, Dong Bo, who is the most appropriate person.”
Xue Ying nodded.
“There is only you who can accomplish it. Thus, you should be all the more careful.” Devil Mountain Primogenitor said.
“You are the best person to seek for their traces.” Blade Emperor added, “But your safety is still paramount.”
Usually, such huge affairs were handled personally by Cosmos Gods.
Nevertheless, those hiding Destruction Devils could easily sense the strength of cultivators. They would definitely not appear if a Cosmos God came. As for those Primal Chaos existences, those who were weaker would be sending themselves to their deaths!
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Hurry up and refine this treasure. After refining it, you should go on and carry out your mission.” Blade Emperor said strictly, “Our intelligence network will be passing relevant and important information to you. As for how you should go about searching for their traces, you decide it yourself.”
…
Within the Void Castle.
Xue Ying entered closed-door cultivation for nine years before finally refining the ’12 Primal Beads’ completely. Naturally, he had also finished consuming the 100,000 Origin World Rocks during this nine years.
“Time to go.” Xue Ying bade farewell with some of his good friends on that day. They were familiar people whom he befriended during these 20 billion years.
Xue Ying soon teleported through an ultra-long distance and left the Void Castle. He began traveling in the primal chaos void and the three great sacred worlds in search of those Destruction Devils who hid amidst these places. This mission had no time limit. It was likely that Xue Ying would be spending a long time searching and pursuing after those Destruction Devils! He could kill those weaker ones, but the stronger ones would have to be executed by the Cosmos Gods after he informed them.
Naturally, Xue Ying also arranged two great incarnations to continue searching for traces of the golden-armored graded lairs in the Lost World Corridor.

chapters.title: Chapter 957 - Investigation
chapters.content:
Chapter 957: Investigation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Myriad Ancient Sacred World, within the extravagant ancient city ‘River Mountain City’. Many cultivators were living in this city. This was also the place where ‘Forefather River Mountain’ started his sect. Many cultivators dreamed of joining his sect. This city was under his protection, and many cultivators were willing to live in it.
At a particular restaurant.
Xue Ying who was in his thick white gown sat by a corner. He occupied a table to himself. On the table, there were famous delicacies and wines that the restaurant was famous for. As Xue Ying ate, he suddenly frowned. This caused the attendant by the side to come over and ask: “Are the dishes not up to your liking, sir?”
“You should go back.” Xue Ying simply directed.
The restaurant attendant naturally withdrew. He no longer asked any further questions.
Xue Ying remained frowning: ‘How should I investigate? How am I going to search for traces of the Destruction Devils?’
With the full support of the three great sacred worlds, a vast amount of relevant information had been sent over to Xue Ying. As he perused through this sea of information, it gave Xue Ying a new realization-it was tough trying to unearth those hiding Destruction Devils! The Cosmos Gods had attempted all kinds of methods. Even though their subordinates were strong and were scattered across different locations, they were still unable to capture any Destruction Devil that had hidden in the primal chaos void.
Not even once!
Currently, as he perused through the information, Xue Ying understood the reason.
‘The Destruction Devils are too vigilant. Moreover, they are too strong.’ Xue Ying thought.
Within the information, there were nine ‘Primal Chaos giants’ whom the cultivators were certain, had been killed by the hiding Destruction Devils. Estimating on average, a Primal Chaos giant would die every trillion years. Those Destruction Devils usually targeted the weaker organizations especially those governed by a ‘Unity realm expert’.
The number of such organizations was innumerable. It was common for them to be destroyed by ‘devour-class devils’. Thus, the actions of the Destruction Devils were not exceptionally eye-catching.
The smaller organizations were devoured and exterminated, and the cultivators could ascertain that the Destruction Devils had been the culprit for more than hundred of the incidents! In addition to how vast the primal chaos void was, it was indeed too common for smaller organizations to be engulfed. And there should be many more of such incidents happening that nobody found out-probably several thousand times.
Nevertheless, there had only been nine times when such incident happened to those at the ‘Primal Chaos realm’!
The fall of a Primal Chaos giant was an incredibly huge affair, and each death would incur a thorough investigation by the Cosmos Gods; such incidents could not be hidden. On the contrary, the extermination of smaller organizations was too commonly seen that it was like a stone sinking in the sea.
‘The Destruction Devils only dealt against Primal Chaos giants once every trillion years on average. That is far too long. I think it’ll be more appropriate for me to conduct my investigation on the smaller organizations.’ Xue Ying contemplated, ‘Furthermore, the security of the territories guarded by Primal Chaos giants is strict. Destruction Devils would be easily discovered if they were the slightest careless! Thus, it is more probable that these Destruction Devils will stay in desolate areas.’
‘Mn…’
‘Destruction Devils seem to understand the techniques and strength of us cultivators. They should be able to perceive the auras of Cosmos Gods even when they concealed them.’
‘Since I’ll be investigating them, I shall just use the crudest method then.’
Xue Ying felt that this was the best strategy he could employ based on his strengths.
His defensive capabilities, secret treasures and ultra-long distance teleportation easily ensured his safety when investigating the Destruction Devils. As for finding traces of those devils, it would be better for him to employ a strategy. Otherwise, finding those Destruction Devils who excelled in hiding their strength and aura amidst the vast primal chaos void was like finding a needle in the haystack!
…
Once he had decided on the strategy, Xue Ying revealed a smile. He began enjoying his meal. Only after finishing the food and wine he ordered did he foot the bill and leave the restaurant.
After leaving the restaurant, Xue Ying headed towards a wider street.
“Weng.”
The edge of Xue Ying’s mouth lifted. An immense illusory world immediately engulfed this large city spanning five kilometers. All domestic animals, the trillion cultivators, and even that ‘Forefather River Mountain’ had fallen into his illusory realm. Forefather River Mountain was ultimately an expert at the seventh level strength. His realm wasn’t profound enough, and his heart temperament was ordinary. Nevertheless, he was able to maintain a strand of clarity-he still knew who he was! Forefather River Mountain was not completely hoodwinked, yet he was immersed in the environment without being able to struggle out of it.
At this moment, this massive city was utterly engulfed in an illusory realm.
There was only one person who remained fully awake.
The thick-white-gowned Xue Ying traversed on the streets. He softly shook his head: ‘Everyone in the River Mountain City has fallen into the illusory realm. According to the intelligence, those hiding Destruction Devils should be extremely powerful. They should not have fallen into it so easily! Even if they were immersed in the illusory realm, they should have some reaction to words like the ‘Lost World Corridor’ or ‘Destruction Devils’.’
Hence, Xue Ying easily deduced that no Destruction Devils existed in the River Mountain City currently!
‘Time to continue to the next place.’
Xue Ying walked on. The void ahead of him distorted. He took a step in and disappeared from the vicinity.
The illusory realm that engulfed the River Mountain City disappeared altogether after that. Everyone regained their consciousness. Those who had fallen into the illusory realm forgot everything they experienced after waking up. Only ‘Forefather River Mountain’ was able to maintain memories of what had happened in the illusory realm.
‘Illusory realm? I’ve fallen into an illusory realm for a breath of time?’ Forefather River Mountain could not help but feel a chill down his spine. He shuddered. He hurriedly checked through the entire River Mountain City while still feeling uneasy. Nevertheless, he could not find out who was the culprit.
After all, for the other party to completely cause him to fall into an illusory realm, and for him to be unable to struggle out of it, would mean killing him was as easy as lifting one’s hand.
…
This was the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. In one of the nations located on a vast area, many cultivators were living within the city of this nation.
At this moment.
An illusory realm engulfed the entire nation.
A white-gowned male walked out from within the illusory realm: ‘There are no Destruction Devils here as well. But there are quite a few members from the Ancient Sacred Religion.’
Very soon after this information was reported upwards, the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World would send experts over to handle the issue.
…
That’s right.
This was Xue Ying’s strategy.
It might seem crude and foolish-for Xue Ying had to investigate every single area in a random manner! Xue Ying would rely on ultra-long distance teleportation to proceed to every part of the three great sacred worlds. He would even move to some of the primal chaos great land located amidst the vast primal chaos void and directly engulf the entire area! In his opinion, the powerful Destruction Devils should be able to escape from the illusory realm.
Furthermore, Xue Ying would subtly guide the proceedings in the illusory realm, letting out information regarding the Destruction Devils. If the victim were a Destruction Devil, the other party would reveal his actual identity!
It’s a pity that Xue Ying had not succeeded a single time yet…
Ultimately, there were too few Destruction Devils hiding in the three great sacred worlds and primal chaos void. Furthermore, the area Xue Ying had to cover was huge. Hence, it was reasonable for Xue Ying not to discover any single Destruction Devil after scouring through so many cities.
Instead, Xue Ying had detected more members from the ‘Ancient Sacred Religion’ and ‘Ancestor Mother Religion’ ever since he started combing through every single part of the world. Xue Ying would even take a detour to visit some of the more desolate areas and discover members from the two religions. In the end, Xue Ying was able to locate several bases belonging to the two religions, causing them to suffer from losses consecutively.
“What is happening?”
“Why are we discovered yet again?”
The two great religions felt puzzled.
Nevertheless, Xue Ying continued his diligent mission scouring through the primal chaos void without many people being aware of it. After all, the strongest expert of the smaller organizations had only reached the Unity realm, and how was it possible for them to maintain their consciousness under Xue Ying’s illusory realm? Furthermore, they would lose memory of everything that had happened in the illusory realm after the whole event. Thus, the two great religions could not find out why their bases were being broken into time after time.
In the blink of an eye, it had been about two billion years since Xue Ying began his investigation on the Destruction Devils.

chapters.title: Chapter 958 - Discovered!
chapters.content:
Chapter 958: Discovered!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was like an ascetic monk traveling across the world, executing his illusory realm every now and then. In reality, given how strong his soul was, and how deep his realm reached, Xue Ying merely needed to use one-hundredth of his total heart energy to execute his illusory realm across a vast region. Hence, Xue Ying was actually concentrating more on cultivation instead. Every time he brought the illusory realm down on an area, causing a trillion beings to fall into it, it would bring about different changes, and allow Xue Ying to gain a newfound understanding of the ‘Dao of Mirage’.
Living like an ascetic monk was also a kind of cultivation.
…
Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, Moon Phoenix Nation.
The Moon Phoenix Nation was a nation with quite a rich history. The previous king was ruthless and unpopular. Many cultivators were unhappy with him inwardly. Nevertheless, strength was respected in the world of the cultivators. The cultivators could only endure it in their hearts. After that when the current king appeared, because he had some enmity with the previous king, he directly killed his way into the palace, bringing down the previous king before taking on the mantle as the new and current king.
Ever since then, life in the Moon Phoenix Nation was much better.
Firstly, this new king was stronger. He had supposedly, strength at the peak of the fourth level-that was sufficient to frighten the whole region.
Secondly, the temper of the king was good. He preferred cultivating. If there were nothing significant, he would remain in closed-door cultivation. The civilians naturally fancied this king.
“Hong long.”
The cultivation room opened.
The current Moon Phoenix King had a long body. He looked quite handsome, and his eyes were long and narrow-they were slightly charming like a fox. Even though he was a male, he gave off quite an enchanting feeling.
“Your Majesty.”
“Your Majesty.” The female attendants within the palace naturally bowed respectfully after seeing him.
Moon Phoenix King smiled and nodded. He ordered: “Go and prepare. I am planning to take a bath.”
“Yes.” The female attendants within the palace liked this life of theirs because the current king had an excellent temper. He treated these female attendants very gently as well.
The Moon Phoenix King walked on personally, arriving at a high spot within the palace. He leaned against the railings while looking at the waning moon in the sky. There was a gentle smile on his face.
“Xiu.”
He then flew up into the sky in an instant, disappearing from the place.
In a desolate little kingdom quite far away from the Moon Phoenix Nation, this city occupied an area spanning just 2.5 million kilometers long. This did not represent that it was weak. There were Unity experts who started a nation, expanding it across a region more than five kilometers long. Nevertheless, if a city was too big, the Unity realm expert would be hard-pressed from defending it when a devil assaulted his territory.
For instance, each of the 13 primal chaos cities under the Great Void Heaven Temple occupied an area spanning only a hundred million kilometers. This was a city created by a holy ground, yet they did not dare to make it too big since it would be a joke if they could not defend the place.
To cultivators, it was not hard for them to build a bigger city. The difficulty was more of ensuring its safety.
‘Mn?’
The Moon Phoenix King appeared above this nation looking downwards.
The city occupying an area spanning 2.5 million kilometers did not contain many civilians. They numbered just a third of the Moon Phoenix Nation, though it still numbered in ‘hundreds of millions’.
‘It has been a long time since I last had such delicious food.’ Moon Phoenix King chuckled.
An unseen fluctuation expanded. It covered the entire nation beneath within an instant.
The next moment, all civilians within the city had their power sealed. They could not speak, nor could they transmit messages out of the city.
‘Come on.’ Moon Phoenix King extended his hand, “xiu xiu xiu”, many civilians began flying over. They flew over into the sleeves of Moon Phoenix King. Very soon, the entire nation became empty without a single being left within. It became a deserted city after that.
…
About an hour later.
Moon Phoenix King returned to his palace. The water for the bath had already been warmed.
“Everyone retreat.”
“Yes.”
The female attendants went out.
The Moon Phoenix King lay in the bath water by himself. He was enjoying the water with a smile. He felt carefree: ‘Being the king in a nation within the cultivator’s world is truly comfortable. Ah…, there are also delicious meals here.’ Waving his hand, many ‘tiny man’ began appearing in midair. He then opened his mouth and sucked. A horrifying devour force appeared, causing these tiny men to fly into his mouth without resistance. Many of the ‘tiny men’ revealed expressions of horror and wanted to shout in despair, yet they could not make any sound at all.
“Pu pu pu…”
The Moon Phoenix King casually chewed. He was revealing expressions of bliss.
‘Even though I’ve transcended beyond the control of my desires to slaughter, ultimately, I am still a Destruction Devil. The feeling of swallowing the cultivators is honestly too enjoyable.’ Moon Phoenix King was feeling incomparable joy. He was as such-he would occasionally go out and capture all residents of a nation while occasionally devouring bit by bit. Once he finished his collection, he would go out and capture more cultivators again.
With his strength, it was impossible for him to leave behind any traces.
On the side of the cultivators, they were unable to ascertain whether it was the Destruction Devils who committed the deed, or a huge wicked devil cultivating the devour-class cultivation system.
After all, he was a ‘king’ within the Destruction Devil race, and to those small desolate nations, he was too powerful! It was to the extent that the opposing party could not resist at all.
‘That hex cultivation scripture is too complex. The devour-class cultivation system is much easier. What a pity that it isn’t suitable for our Destruction Devils to cultivate it.’ Moon Phoenix King shook his head inwardly. He would ponder through the scriptures which he read previously. To the Destruction Devils, the laws and profound mysteries system and hex cultivation system were of great help. They could even evolve their own talents, but cultivating them was not easy.
…
Moon Phoenix Nation.
Xue Ying first depended on ultra-long distance teleportation to arrive at a location slightly closer to the Moon Phoenix Nation. He then proceeded with teleporting towards his destination. Every time he moved closer, Xue Ying would probe his surroundings! He did not dare to ‘teleport’ directly to his final destination because the moment he was discovered by the Destruction Devils, they would be frightened to the point of fleeing.
Ordinary teleportation was more commonly seen.
‘Moon Phoenix Nation?’
Xue Ying was able to see this city already. He did not attach much importance to it since he had been seeking for traces of Destruction Devils the past over two billion years to no avail! The world was too big, and there were ultimately too few Destruction Devils hiding within. Hence, it was very difficult for Xue Ying to find these devils. Xue Ying might be rushing, but 99% of his concentration was spent on cultivation.
“Weng~”
Taking a step, Xue Ying arrived right above the Moon Phoenix Nation. At the same time, he released a huge illusory realm with great familiarity.
The illusory realm covered a huge area, and easily covered the entire nation.
At this moment, many residents of the Moon Phoenix Nation had fallen into an illusory realm. Even those domesticated animals had fallen into it. The entire Moon Phoenix Nation fell into extreme silence an instant later. Even the ‘Moon Phoenix Palace’ which was guarded extremely strictly-the palace guards and female attendants had fallen into an illusory realm.
It was quiet.
Only the Moon Phoenix King remained there lying back. He who was previously being fed good wine and fruits leisurely by the female attendants serving him had suddenly changed expression when he realized all the female attendants had fallen into an illusory realm. He immediately looked ahead. His gaze crossed through the obstacles of the wall, landing on that white-robed teenager standing in midair outside the palace.
Similarly-
Xue Ying also discovered the Moon Phoenix King because he was the only person who did not fell for his illusory realm within the entire nation.
‘Who is he? According to the intelligence, the Moon Phoenix King is merely at the Unity realm. He hasn’t even reached the fifth level Star Pagoda strength. How can he remain totally unaffected by my illusory realm?’ Xue Ying revealed a joyful look. It might be possible that he had finally discovered a Destruction Devil.
“Hahaha…”
The laughter boomed.
A huge black mouth appeared high above the Moon Phoenix Nation. This mouth was much bigger than the entire city of the nation, and it was so deep that one could not see the depth. It enveloped the whole city including Xue Ying.
“Discovered me already? Cultivator, I truly congratulate you.” The laughter reverberated by the ears of Xue Ying.
“Absorb!”
Xue Ying saw that incomparably huge ‘mouth’ hanging high in the sky. He could not help but change expression. That incomparably huge mouth suddenly breathed in fiercely in the direction downwards. The entire city distorted and shattered. The many beings within also disintegrated alongside it. That horrifying devouring force had clearly affected Xue Ying.
‘Not good, it is a Cosmos God!’ Xue Ying was extremely frightened.
Who would have thought that the first hiding Destruction Devil he discovered would be a Cosmos God!

chapters.title: Chapter 959 - Cosmos God
chapters.content:
Chapter 959: Cosmos God
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The mouth hanging in the sky which spanned beyond the city merely took in a breath. The target was Xue Ying, but still, the entire Moon Phoenix Nation had been entirely destroyed. Many of the beings within the Moon Phoenix Nation were still trapped in the illusory realm of Xue Ying. Hence, at this moment when they were killed, they did not feel any pain.
“Weng.” Xue Ying was so frightened that his heart started palpitating. He did not hesitate to activate his two great secret treasures.
The 12 Primal Beads Bracelet and Three-Colored Layered Cloud were both activated at the same time.
One could see many layers of dimmed light covering Xue Ying-a total of 12 layers! There was also golden light emanating from the surface of his body. Furthermore, a layer of blue light was protecting his body too. Clearly, Xue Ying had utilized all available techniques he had to survive.
“Pu pu pu-”
The enormous ‘mouth’ was still sucking in on the surface, yet in reality, two huge hands silvery-white in color were currently reaching out from the void.
Nevertheless, Xue Ying seemed to be standing still in midair with his body hiding within the Mirage world. Those two silvery-white hands had to force their way into the Mirage World. The moment they contacted the 12 layers of light film, this killing move had only destroyed the surface most layer of light film.
“Die!”
Those two hands that were covered in silvery-white scales furiously slapped out again.
“Go.”
Xue Ying did not hesitate. His perception of the void was extremely formidable. That was why he could easily ‘discover’ an immensely huge monster currently hiding within the void. It had the appearance of a silkworm cocoon and revealed only a large mouth in midair. As for the two silvery-white-scaled hands of it, they were the two frontmost hands out of a total of 12 hands.
This was a hideous monster. The moment Xue Ying saw it, he felt terror birthing right from his instinctual self. He vaguely understood that this terror signified absolute danger as he faced this monster with his current strength!
Fortunately, he had two external ‘secret treasures’ at hand! The treasures gave him the ability to withstand for one or two instants when facing World Ancestor or Ancestor Sorcerer. Hence, he could hold on for a longer period when facing this monster.
‘Who would have thought that I would meet a Cosmos God. But it is honestly too huge a fish that I have reeled.’ Xue Ying did not hesitate. With a thought, the void beside his body began distorting. He then took a step and disappeared within the distorting void.
“Ultra-long distance teleportation?”
The huge monster was furious, yet he left the place stealthily because he was clear that his identity had been revealed. He believed that there would be cultivator Cosmos Gods rushing over very soon.
Not a breath of time later.
The surrounding void fluctuated and warped. A black-robed green-haired male appeared. He was calmly sweeping his gaze across his surroundings. He was none other than Void Primogenitor who rushed over after receiving Xue Ying’s transmission.
He was the Cosmos God who could rush over the fastest!
The other Cosmos Gods would have to ask some Primal Chaos existences they knew to teleport them through an ultra-long distance. The ‘Moon Phoenix Nation’ was also not some special landmark, so neither would those Primal Chaos existences mark the coordinate of this space. Hence, there would be a huge deviation when the Primal Chaos existences teleported them over. After ‘transmitting the news’, ‘asking someone to teleport them over’, and ‘rushing over due to a huge deviation’, the time taken to travel would be longer.
Void Primogenitor was someone who knew ‘ultra-long distance great movement’, and he had arrived the earliest. Regardless, the enemy had escaped by then.
Actually, Void Primogenitor understood that with the escaping capabilities of the Destruction Devil ‘kings’, even if he could reach here in time, it was impossible for him to stop the ‘kings’ from leaving.
“Damn.”
Void Primogenitor looked downwards. The vast land beneath spanning hundreds of millions of kilometers had been affected by the shockwave. No living beings remained alive within this region. Watching that desolate, broken land, Void Primogenitor felt pity for these beings and his heart ached over the whole affair.
“Damn those Destruction Devils.” The eyes of Void Primogenitor were filled with killing intent.
…
In a vast land, there was a mountain range in the distance with sects staying there.
Moon Phoenix King appeared on this piece of great land walking by himself. He slightly frowned while muttering to himself: “I was discovered?”
The ‘kings’ who permeated into the lands of cultivators while hiding within.
This was the first time they were discovered!
‘How could it be so coincidental? That Dong Bo Xue Ying suddenly utilized his illusory realm, engulfing the entire Moon Phoenix Nation and coincidentally engulfed me too?’ Moon Phoenix King muttered inwardly. The arrival of Xue Ying was too sudden. He had unleashed his illusory realm the moment he arrived, and Moon Phoenix King did not even have time to evade it. Furthermore, he also disdained these Primal Chaos existences in any kind of situations.
He believed that it was unlikely for him to be discovered with his technique of hiding his aura!
But Xue Ying had unleashed the illusory realm! The weaker beings had all fallen into it, and he as a Cosmos God would naturally not fall into it. And that was thus the reason that his identity was revealed!
‘Suddenly unleashing the illusory realm on me, is it because I have revealed some suspicious gaps in my behavior, causing him to come specially to investigate me? Not right! If that was the case, it shouldn’t be him coming to investigate me. Instead, there would be a group of Cosmos Gods forming an inescapable net around me.’ Moon Phoenix King shook his head.
‘But why would he unleash his illusory realm if he did not know that I am here?’
‘Unless this Dong Bo Xue Ying is cultivating? He is testing his technique?’ Moon Phoenix King guessed.
He felt that this was probable.
Because it was normal for cultivators to comprehend his ‘Dao’ while traveling around the place. It was nothing extraordinary for Xue Ying to suddenly unleash his illusory realm on all beings living in a nation to test his technique.
‘I am truly too unlucky to be discovered by him just like this.’ Moon Phoenix King felt unhappy. All the ‘kings’ had been to the cultivator’s world, and he was the first to be discovered by the cultivators.
******
Void Castle, within a secretive palace hall.
The Cosmos Gods from the side of the cultivators were located here. But the majority present was their incarnations. At this moment, they were all looking at Xue Ying.
“A Destruction Devil at the Cosmos God realm? Are you certain?” Blade Emperor looked at Xue Ying.
Even though many Cosmos Gods had been to the Moon Phoenix Nation for investigation, and knew that there had indeed been a horrifying battle which occurred there before, due to the disturbance on the flow of time, it prevented them from finding out what had happened during the battle. They could only direct the questions toward Xue Ying.
“It is absolutely a Cosmos God.”
Xue Ying solemnly confirmed.
The other party was so strong.
Even Black Emperor and Primal Chaos Hall Master could not give him such huge pressure. Yet Xue Ying felt the threat of death when facing that horrifying monster.
“This is the true appearance of that monster.” Xue Ying waved his hand, causing a scene to form in midair beside him. It was none other than the appearance of the ugly monster which Xue Ying had encountered previously-the body that seemed to of a silkworm cocoon. It had a nasty head and 12 hands. Its entire body including those two huge hands was covered in silvery scales.
“This was the appearance which Moon Phoenix King transformed into.” Xue Ying explained. Another humanoid figure appeared by the side.
“It’s him?”
“He appeared the previous time when they assaulted the spatial barrier.”
The expression of Blade Emperor, Devil Mountain Primogenitor, and others changed at that moment.
They had once fought before and were clear that this Cosmos God had been one of the ‘kings’ assaulting the spatial barrier. After that, ‘Emperor Jun’ who had an extremely formidable strength appeared. The other kings no longer had to do anything much after that. They would only help occasionally before retreating back easily.
“During the process of retreating, he had no longer acted.”
“As they retreated, that one called Emperor Jun appeared, and quite a few kings no longer came out.”
“And now, he was discovered in the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World?”
The Cosmos Gods present turned solemn.
Indeed, there were Destruction Devils at the Cosmos God realm who intruded into the world of cultivators. Still, this discovery was still a harvest. After all, they had only conjectured previously, and were certain o this fact now! But what made them unwilling was that one of the ‘kings’ who assaulted the spatial barrier previously actually appeared within the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World.
This proved one thing-the other party had capabilities of crossing through the spatial barrier without alerting the cultivators.

chapters.title: Chapter 960 - The Swaying Flower
chapters.content:
Chapter 960: The Swaying Flower
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“How could this be?” The Cosmos Gods present felt a thousand emotions crossing through their hearts. Even though they had various guesses, now that the truth came clear, they were sure that the Destruction Devils had escaped previously when they assaulted the spatial barrier! The ‘spatial barrier’ could not obstruct the other party. This made it hard for the Cosmos Gods to accept since they thought that the spatial barrier was perfect.
“Dong Bo, you’ve done well this time. You have proved the point that there are indeed Cosmos God Destruction Devils hiding within our world and that there exists a hole within the spatial barrier.” Ancestor Sorcerer turned to Xue Ying, “Do you still have any other discoveries?”
“No more.” Xue Ying shook his head, “That time, I did not dare to linger on, and had fled immediately.”
“Mn, it is not bad for you to produce such a result within that short period. Continue your investigation.” Ancestor Sorcerer said.
Xue Ying knew that the Cosmos Gods would be discussing how to cover up the hole, and how they should be dealing with the ‘kings’ of the Destruction Devils. This was something Xue Ying could not assist since he could only escape whenever he encountered the kings from the Destruction Devil race! Such existences that came to being only for destruction were extremely frightening, especially their ‘kings’. Their destructive techniques were more formidable than any ordinary Cosmos Gods, and they were capable in fleeing too.
The other ninth level Star Pagoda existences might not be able to escape from such beings, and it was because Xue Ying could utilize ultra-long distance teleportation, that was why he was chosen to conduct this mission.
“Xiu.”
The space beside Xue Ying distorted. He took a step before entering it.
And within this palace hall, the incarnations of the Cosmos Gods began discussing various strategies to rectify this issue.
******
To the ancient cultivators, 100 million years was a brief period. It was normal for them to enter closed-door cultivation for up to 10 billion years in a single period. After all, destroying a cosmos wasn’t something difficult for them.
Xue Ying continued moving across various places. He was using the ‘crudest’ of methods to conduct his mission.
There were indeed few Destruction Devils who had hidden within the world.
Because those that came in, other than the two generals with the ‘shadowless ‘talent’, the other were either Cosmos Gods with extremely high status or powerful golden-armored Destruction Devils with a steady heart temperament at the peak of eighth level or ninth level strength! Ultimately, those with slightly weaker heart temperament would not be able to resist the craving to slaughter and destroy.
Their identities would easily be revealed should they kill too many beings and destroy too many places. Furthermore, it was unlikely for those with weaker heart temperaments to break through into ‘kings’.
As such, those who were selected to come into the cultivator’s world were absolutely the elites and geniuses. The majority of them was chosen only after they had the qualifications to become ‘kings’.
There were few!
And all were vigilant.
It was indeed arduous for Xue Ying to find traces of them.
…
In the blink of an eye, another 20 over billion years passed.
This was a sect that occupied quite a vast area. There were many disciples of this sect, and the sect master was a great expert at the fifth level Star Pagoda strength.
On this day.
As the sun rose, its rays covered this sect. Nevertheless, there was a huge black flower bud that appeared above this sect. Layers of black flower bud were stacked on top of one another, and many petals were present-a total of 38 Destruction Flowers had been formed. Xue Ying was able to unleash so many flowers firstly because of his strong soul, and secondly because of the improvement of his realm.
“Wanting to escape?” A white-robed Xue Ying stood in midair looking at the layers of black flower bud trapped a being within-this being had revealed his true appearance as a golden-armored Destruction Devil.
“Break, break, break!” That golden-armored Destruction Devil was holding onto a sharp blade hacking on the black flower bud. He could only cut apart about a dozen before newer Destruction Flowers started forming again-another 38 flowers.
“Hong.”
A crimson red stream of light suddenly cut through the layers of flower buds before arriving at its innermost layer. It was a golden-armored Destruction Devil who was shrouded in a crimson glow. With a wave of his hand, he easily kept his comrade within his Eden treasure.
Following that.
“Xiu-”
His body formed a crimson stream of light; his body was like a weapon which forcibly tore through the Destruction Flower. Xue Ying might have attempted to establish more Destruction Flowers, but the other party was too quick. Within the blink of an eye, he charged his way out through the layers of obstacles. With a rush, he arrived far away, and his body began dividing into many pieces that escaped in all directions as golden light.
Xue Ying did not know which light to chase after. By then, those golden streams of light had teleported away through the void.
‘I’ve let them escaped.’
Xue Ying felt slightly frustrated.
All the cultivators from the sect beneath had fallen into an illusory realm. Even though there were some disturbances created during the battle previously, everything was still under the control of Xue Ying. He did not let the shockwaves of the battle affect these cultivators.
‘I’ve discovered two golden-armored Destruction Devils this time. One should be at the ninth level, and the other weaker one should be at the peak of the eighth level.’ Xue Ying deduced, ‘I was unable to restrain that ninth level right from the start, and have given him up. I’d only focused on trying to capture the weaker golden-armored Destruction Devil, yet he was easily saved by his comrade.’
‘Ai…’
‘I can only say that this Destruction Flower is still lacking in power.’
Xue Ying shook his head.
Even though his soul became stronger, and his realm had reached a more profound level-he was able to unleash 38 Destruction Flowers at once, if one mentioned that 19 Destruction Flowers had barely touched the boundary of the ninth level, then 38 Destruction Flowers was hardly at the ninth level. This was only taking into account its offensive power. In terms of its restrictive ability, it was unable to restrict ninth level golden-armored Destruction Devils as of now.
‘I have yet to create the third style of the Destruction Flower.’ Xue Ying shook his head. He felt slightly unwilling. After all, Xue Ying had left the Void Castle for 20 over billion years already. Even though he spent the majority of his concentration on trying to create the third style of the Destruction Flower, it was to no avail. It was only after Xue Ying created the third style would this move be genuinely considered at the ninth level. And only then would Xue Ying no longer remain helpless when facing against those golden-armored Destruction Devils at the ninth level.
It’s a pity that he could not create the third style.
‘Go.’
Xue Ying looked down at this sect that was bathed in the morning fog. Many of the cultivators within were still trapped in the illusory realm. It was only after Xue Ying kept it did he disappear from the vicinity.
The cultivators within the sect gradually regained their consciousness, yet they did not know what had happened. It was merely the disciples that discovered they were missing two sect mates!
…
In the following years of investigation, the situation had clearly worsened.
A ‘king’ had been discovered. Two other golden-armored Destruction Devils were found out too-everyone had been unearthed by Xue Ying using his illusory realm! The Destruction Devils were not foolish. They were easily able to guess that this cultivator ‘Xue Ying’ who could unleash the illusory realm and teleport through ultra-long distance teleportation to escape was chasing after them. Naturally, the highest level ‘kings’ had sent a new order to the other hiding golden-armored Destruction Devils.
This also resulted in a period of stagnating yield as Xue Ying could not even find traces of a single hiding golden-armored Destruction Devil.
…
A long time passed.
Xue Ying traveled across the three great sacred worlds and the primal chaos void. Even though he could no longer discover any traces of the Destruction Devils, Xue Ying was gradually building up his foundation. On this day, he arrived at a primal chaos land, easily exterminating a huge devil that brought calamity across this place. Just as he was enjoying the unique delicacies of this land in bliss…
Xue Ying casually waved his hand, causing a Mirage to appear indistinctly by the side. A nine-petaled flower was condensed. Xue Ying traveled across the various places, and would frequently attempt to formulate the flower using what he had comprehended. He had experimented it countless time during the long period before this, and it was only today when Xue Ying unleashed it did he feel a shudder in his soul. This was a feeling of beauty, of perfection that was similar to when he created the Destruction Flower at the Unity realm.
This time, Xue Ying understood when he unleashed the Destruction Flower without even needing to see… that he succeeded!
Xue Ying turned over. Within the Mirage world by the side, a nine-petaled flower was swaying within. It was stunning and seemed like a fantasy. It had reached grand perfection, and no flaws could be discovered within.

chapters.title: Chapter 961 - Blood Cloud Pagoda Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 961: Blood Cloud Pagoda Master
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
At the peak of an icy mountain.
There was a spread of delicious food placed on top of a table cut from ice. They were food that Xue Ying had ‘teleported’ over from several cities within the primal chaos land. Naturally, he would leave behind some treasures to those restaurants providing the food. Xue Ying would definitely not let those restaurants suffer a loss.
“Tsk tsk tsk.” Placing down the crystalline cup, Xue Ying looked at the space by his side. There was a delicate nine-petaled flower forming in the Mirage. Compared to the three-petaled and six-petaled flowers, the destructive power inherent within was distinctly different. This nine-petaled flower seemed more ordinary.
If one thoroughly examined it…
He would be able to perceive that this nine-petaled flower seemed to encompass an infinite region just like a vast cosmos. That’s right. According to Xue Ying’s estimation, the third style of Xue Ying’s absolute art “Destruction Flower” and also the final style, the ‘nine-petaled flower’ had reached the Cosmos God level in certain aspects.
‘A flower is like a cosmos. If one continued walking down this path, I’d be able to genuinely break through into the Cosmos God realm.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘But it’s clear that this path is likely to be a dead end.’
Because this flower fused both Dao of Mirage and Dao of Slaughter together.
To become a Cosmos God using this path, one had to have a deep foundation and understanding of both Daos! It was way harder as compared to researching in just a single Dao.
The Dao gave birth to one. One gave birth to two. Two gave birth to three. Three gave birth to myriad existences.
Everything had a point of origin. Researching along this Dao path, for instance, in Xue Ying’s plan of comprehending the ‘Dao of Mirage’ which he specialized in, the core of the Dao of Mirage would be the ‘Dao’. It would give birth to one and eventually, myriad existences. If Xue Ying cultivated several different mixtures of Dao, it would be difficult for him to fuse them together and break through to the Cosmos God realm.
Forefather Tian Yu, Swordmaster, Void Primogenitor, Blade Emperor, and others had walked down a single Dao path with great difficulties, walking to the furthest distance.
Thus, comparatively speaking, creating the ‘nine-petaled flower’ was creating a formidable killing move and allow Xue Ying’s combat strength to improve. After all, cultivators could protect himself better if he became stronger, and only then could he walk further down the Dao path. Secondly, it was tempering himself. This entire process was also a form of refinement for Xue Ying’s heart temperament, his soul and personality. It deepened Xue Ying’s understanding of the Dao of Mirage too, and allow his foundation to become more stable.
‘I have cultivated about 100 billion years and have finally comprehended a ninth level move.’ There was a strand of complex expression appearing on Xue Ying’s youthful look.
A ninth level move.
This was the true reliance he had, and a move which Xue Ying could use to fight against Cosmos Gods.
Likely previously, Xue Ying could stack more flowers to improve his offensive strength.
