When talking about defense, he had cultivated the Imperial Dragon inheritance to the ninth transformation realm accompanied by his ‘void-ification’ ability and his body hiding in the Mirage world. Only with so many techniques supporting each other was Xue Ying able to form a ninth level move. He also had two great secret treasures protecting him. That was why he was considered stronger in defenses. When facing some of the stronger golden-armored Destruction Devils, or previously exchanging moves with a Cosmos God, he could simply escape by relying on his secret treasure. Nevertheless, he could not resist at all.
‘It is truly different.’
Xue Ying extended his right hand. The nine-petaled flower descended from nothingness and became real. It descended extremely slowly; it was turning illusion into real inch by inch. The surrounding world energy was rushing over, causing many cultivators on this primal chaos land to feel puzzled. Was something dangerous breeding?
After all, Xue Ying had just killed a huge devil and saved the entire primal chaos land.
Many cultivators began rushing over to the origin of where the world energy was attracted to. They tore through the void and rushed over, but as they got closer, they fell into an illusory realm and went back once again. They could not get close to the origin where the world energy was attracted to.
After half a day later.
For the sake of preventing the energy from affecting the great land, Xue Ying took half a day to finally bring the nine-petaled flower from illusion to real.
“Truly gorgeous.” Xue Ying looked at the nine-petaled flower in his hand. The petals and buds were all delicate and glistening. The beads of water were dripping on them. Each droplet of water contained a world within.
‘Only by relying on this will I be qualified to compete against Monarch Xing Huo, Heart Imitation Religious Master, and the others.’ Xue Ying waved his hand, causing the inner section of the nine-petaled flower to collapse. A distorting black hole vaguely appeared before disappearing.
Xue Ying then continued enjoying the excellent food before leaving this primal chaos land.
…
After grasping the nine-petaled flower, Xue Ying continued traveling to all places. The devils of the many regions were really unlucky for they were killed unknowingly while still in closed-door cultivation and immersing themselves with beauties. Xue Ying was clearly exterminating the devils along the way whenever he saw immoral acts happening.
His personality was as such-if he did not see those devils, he would not care about them. But the moment he saw one, Xue Ying would naturally take on the responsibility of handling them!
Hence, even if discovering the Destruction Devils were rare, Xue Ying was able to kill quite a few of those wicked devils.
‘It is genuinely hard to find them.’
‘Where exactly have these Destruction Devils hidden at?’
It had been more than 80 billion years since he left the Void Castle. Other than the initial period of discovering traces of a Cosmos God and traces of golden-armored Destruction Devils, he was no longer able to find any more hints of these Destruction Devils!
‘Unless they have hidden in some desolate corner of the world? And that they no longer dare to appear in some of the bigger organizations?’ Xue Ying vaguely guessed. And that was why he began traveling to those primal chaos lands that were more desolate and deep in the mountain ranges. The moment he found any region where quite a few beings converged at via the black fog spherical holes, he would directly appear and unleash his illusory realm.
If it were merely targeting the more prominent organizations, it would not be difficult for Xue Ying. But if Xue Ying were to search through every nook and cranny of primal chaos void, then he would only be able to scour through a small part despite spending a trillion years.
‘This is?’
Myriad Ancient Sacred World.
On this vast desert, a white-robed teenager was walking on it. He was probing through a wide area in his surroundings through the black fog spherical holes. He was able to immediately discover that there was a seemingly ordinary castle palace located deep within a bare mountain range. With a glance, it seemed to be the cavern-dwelling of a cultivator.
But after Xue Ying probed deeper…
He discovered that underneath the castle, there was a deep and wide area. It was a relatively huge organization.
‘Let’s go and have a look.’ Xue Ying took a step and teleported over directly.
His teleportation was silent. By the time others discovered him, Xue Ying had arrived.
The mechanism of ultra-long distance teleportation usually first started with the forming of a passage. Others would first discover a distorting void passage before the user traveled over. To the true experts, they had enough time from the point of perceiving the disturbances created by the ‘ultra-long distance teleportation’ to escape before the user even arrived.
******
Underneath this seemingly ordinary castle, it was a completely different world.
There were towering buildings scattered within. At the center of the many buildings, there was a black pagoda. This black pagoda directly connected to the palace-castle located on the surface.
“Hahaha, Brother Qu, how do you find this Life-Death Pagoda of mine?” A bald-headed hunk delightfully said. He was currently seated opposite an old man, and both of them were drinking with a group of beauties serving them.
The two of them could easily see through what was happening within the pagoda through the walls of the black pagoda.
The inner section of this pagoda was immense-it contained 18 levels in total.
The first level was also the lowest level. Several billion cultivators were imprisoned within. World energy was isolated from this place, thus preventing these cultivators from being able to absorb any energy at all. Over time, they would gradually become weaker. But it was possible for them to have a ‘life-death battle’, fighting with another expert of a similar realm to death. When one died, the victor could proceed to the second level.
There were comparatively fewer cultivators located on the second level. They arrived here after experiencing the life-death battle. Wanting to get to the third level? They similarly had to fight another life-death battle on this level.
This process would repeat similarly.
One level by one level up.
A total of 18 levels.
Those cultivators who survived and reached the 18th level would proceed with another life-death battle, with the victor permitted to leave the Life-Death Pagoda. This was the favor given by the ‘Blood Cloud Pagoda Master’.
“Interesting. Haha, this is truly interesting.” The old man by the side laughed voraciously, “Brother Blood Cloud, you are truly benevolent. You do not kill these cultivators who offended you. Instead, you have given them a route to survival.”
“Going by the workings of the world, there should always be a path to survival. I naturally am following it, and leaving them with a way to survive too.” The bald-headed hunk chuckled.
The old man felt apprehensive inwardly though.
Blood Cloud Pagoda Master was a devour-class devil, yet he deliberately left behind a chance at survival for the other cultivators?

chapters.title: Chapter 962 - Still Thinking of Stopping Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 962: Still Thinking of Stopping Me?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Brother Blood Cloud, I’ve heard that there is a ‘Golden Sand Venomous Frog’ here? I study the hex poison, and currently, require this Golden Sand Venomous Frog.” The old man chuckled.
“Alright, alright, let’s discuss the price.” The bald-headed hunk chuckled while scratching his head, “50 Origin World Rocks and you can take it away.”
The two began bargaining.
Finally, the old man paid the price of 32 Origin World Rocks before leaving the place with the Golden Sand Venomous Frog.
The bald-headed hunk stood up and sent the other party away passionately. Only after sending him to the grand entrance of the surface palace did he return to the underground world.
“Big brother, that hex cultivator actually dares to come to our territory?” A black-robed girl went forward and said with a cold voice, “If not for hiding my identity, I would have long devoured him.”
“You only know how to eat, eat, and eat! It isn’t easy trying to obtain a good identity.” The bald-headed hunk roared, “Right now, that cultivator called Dong Bo Xue Ying is searching for us. The three great sacred worlds are throwing in all effort to support him. If we were to reveal any gaps and get suspected by the three great sacred worlds, once we are reported to that Dong Bo Xue Ying, it is likely that he will come over to our place to check on us. Even though that Dong Bo Xue Ying is ordinary in power and can’t threaten us, the moment he discovers us, our leisure days here will be no more. You must endure more, and follow my command. If you were to disrupt my affairs, hmph hmph, you should find other generals to help you then.”
“Yes yes yes, I understand, big brother.” The black-robed girl accompanied his words with a giggle.
The kings had already given the orders.
All the golden-armored Destruction Devils at the peak of the eighth level must move together with a ninth level Destruction Devil because according to Xue Ying’s strength, he could not obstruct those at the ninth level from leaving. And this bald-headed hunk was transformed from a ninth level golden-armored Destruction Devil.
“Haha.” The bald-headed hunk suddenly turned back to that Life-Death Pagoda by the side, “There is another life-death battle happening on the 18th level again? It seems that there will be another fortunate brat who can leave this place.”
…
Within the Life-Death Pagoda.
On the 18th level.
There was a teenager embroiled in a frenzied battle with another old man. Both of them were at the Void God Origin Birth level.
“Die for me!” Accompanied with a roar, the young man finally punched through the chest of the old man, shattering his body. Following that, he continued punching out, causing the void at this region to tremble before that old man turned into pieces.
“I’ve won.”
Only then did the young man sat down on his butt. He was too tired.
“I finally, finally, finally am leaving this Life-Death Pagoda alive.” The young man clenched his fist, “Father, big brother, I am coming home. I am coming back to see you guys again.”
This period was like a nightmare to him.
He left his home to temper himself. Who would have thought that as he bought some goods from a tribe, the tribe would offend the ‘Blood Cloud Pagoda Master’, resulting in everyone within the tribe to be captured alive and thrown into the Life-Death Pagoda? They had to fight their way one level by one level up. A total of 18 levels and only one cultivator would be able to leave this place alive out of many others.
As for this young man, he indeed had a great talent. He could break through to the Unity realm a long time ago, yet he did not dare to do so.
Because battles within the Life-Death Pagoda would happen between those of the same major realm! An expert at the Origin Birth realm would fight with another at the Origin Birth realm. Someone at the Unity realm would battle with another at the Unity realm. And there were only a few at the Unity realm in the entire Life-Death Pagoda. Hence, he would definitely die for sure if he were to break through to the Unity realm.
“Weng.”
A spatial fluctuation descended, covering that young man.
That young man revealed a joyous look.
Home…
Father, big brother, and that girl whom he had been chasing after. Even though he had been chasing after the other party for a long time, the other party only treated him as her little brother.
But if he were to meet her again, this young man would feel incomparably joyful.
“Hu.”
The space transformed.
He had finally left the Life-Death Pagoda. There was a gigantic palace hall in front of him.
This young man looked at the palace hall in front. There was currently a bald-headed hunk seated on the throne of this hall. That hunk said with a lopsided grin: “Little brat, congratulations for charging through the Life-Death Pagoda alive. Once you push the palace door open, you will regain your freedom.”
“Many thanks, Blood Cloud Pagoda Master.” The young man respectfully bowed.
Even though everyone who was imprisoned within had an utter hatred towards Blood Cloud Pagoda Master, this was ultimately the Myriad Ancient Sacred World where the strong feasted on the weak. Thus, this young man did not dare to be disrespectful in fear of losing his life.
“It’s a pity that you do not have the chance to push this door open.” The bald-headed hunk began laughing even happier.
The young man was startled.
“Let me tell you a secret.”
The bald-headed hunk delightfully giggled, “Every single cultivator who leaves the Life-Death Pagoda only have one outcome in the end-devoured by me!”
The young man’s expression suddenly turned pale.
No, no…
His own family, that red-gowned figure whom he wanted to see again…
“Hahaha…” The bald-headed hunk began laughing even giddier. He loved watching the expression of cultivators who thought they were about to escape, only to fall into another despair.
“No.”
The aura of that young man abruptly exploded. He directly broke through to the Unity realm and was rushing right out of the place.
“Do you think you can escape?” The bald-headed hunk chuckled. He was a ninth level Destruction Devil! Even other Primal Chaos giants would be sending themselves to their death in front of him.
Suddenly, the entire place turned silent.
That young man who was flying banged onto the palace door like a fool. The palace door rumbled with a resounding boom, yet the young man fell onto the ground completely unconscious.
It was not just this young man. Many of the cultivators who were imprisoned within the Life-Death Pagoda and the crowd of emissaries and attendants had fallen into an illusory realm.
There were only two who could maintain their consciousness.
One was the bald-headed hunk, and the other was the black-robed girl.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying!” The expression of the bald-headed hunk changed greatly.
“Big brother!”
The black-robed girl rushed into the palace hall, “We have been discovered. Hurry up, let’s leave!”
“Go!” The bald-headed hunk might be furious and sullen since he did not put Xue Ying in his eyes, but he knew that this cultivator called Xue Ying had the treasures bestowed upon by the three great sacred worlds; his survival capabilities were extremely formidable. Any Destruction Devil who was discovered by him was equivalent to being found by the three great sacred worlds.
He had to leave!
“Sou!”
The bald-headed hunk brought the black-robed girl and charged out of the palace hall.
There was an enormous nine-petaled black flower bud which suddenly appeared and wrapped around the entire palace-castle. When the bald-headed hunk was about to charge out of the palace with the black-robed girl, he realized he was already trapped within this enormous flower. Each of the black petals was sparkling and translucent, and they could see what was happening outside.
There was currently a white-robed teenager standing outside. He was none other than Xue Ying.
“Hua hua hua.” The black flower buds were stacked on top of one another. A bigger nine-petaled flower encompassed a smaller nine-petaled flower-a total of seven nine-petaled flowers had descended in this fashion.
The reason why Xue Ying could unleash a total of seven nine-petaled flowers was that he had great nourishment of his soul from the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance, and had eaten a total of 300,000 Origin World Rocks.
“You are still thinking of stopping me?” The bald-headed hunk sneered before charging against the crystalline black petal right ahead of him. With a punch, he formed a colorful maelstrom that struck against the black petal. Nevertheless, he had a hard time trying to tear apart the petal and was barely able to pry open the first layer. But the moment he reached the second layer, he no longer had power.
With a thought, Xue Ying condensed yet another nine-petaled flower wrapping around the outermost layer using the World Energy. There remained seven flowers as initially.
“How could this be?” The bald-headed hunk did not dare believe. He could barely break a petal layer with his full strength?
He stared at the white-robed teenager outside.
It should not be.
This Xue Ying was only formidable in his survival capabilities. How was Xue Ying his opponent in direct combat? He should be able to break apart the flowers easily. Why would he be trapped in this black flower? What was more fatal would be that this black flower bud had utterly sealed the entire space, preventing him from escaping even if he divided his body into multiple golden streams of light.
“Big brother.” The black-robed girl had fallen into a daze by the side. A ninth level golden-armored Destruction Devil could not escape from this as well?
“He, he has gotten stronger.” The bald-headed hunk felt his heart tightening. He vaguely understood that it was very hard for him to escape this time.
And in the midair located just outside the black flower bud, Xue Ying stood there contacting the other Cosmos Gods about the situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 963 - Energy
chapters.content:
Chapter 963: Energy
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Hong.””Hong.””Hong.”…
The bald-headed hunk had already transformed back to his true appearance-a tall and sturdy golden-armored Destruction Devil with a pair of horns. He was frantically bombarding on the large crystalline black petals. Under his offense, the black petals were being destroyed, but only one layer was destroyed. By then, Xue Ying had condensed another layer over that. He was able to maintain seven layers of nine-petaled flowers almost all the time, bringing despair to the two golden-armored Destruction Devils. As for the black-robed girl, she had turned into a sweet and fair golden-armored Destruction Devil, yet as she struck the petals, she could not even move it at all.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying was able to perceive that not far away from him, the air was being distorted.
‘They are here.’ Xue Ying thought.
“Not good.” That horned golden-armored Destruction Devil revealed a furious look when he saw that. He raised his head up before roaring. “Hong~” Closely following that, his body was utterly destroyed. And that seductive female golden-armored Destruction Devil by the side had similarly destroyed herself, albeit with slight unwillingness. Both their souls were completely exterminated.
Xue Ying’s expression changed after seeing this: ‘They actually suicided!’
With his current strength, even though he could trap the other party, it was still hard for Xue Ying to capture them. Who would have thought that the two golden-armored Destruction Devils would unhesitantly suicide after seeing some fluctuations from the ultra-long distance teleportation by the side?
“Weng.”
A thin and small male walked out from within the distorted spatial passage. He might seem small, but his body was so strong that he could resist the assault by Sacred Master! Ancestor Sorcerer depended on many different techniques before he could barely match up to World Ancestor. World Ancestor and Ancestor Mother were two of the existences closest to Sacred Master in strength. Furthermore, World Ancestor’s style of combat was straightforward. He relied entirely on his physical body and even dared to devour the weapons of his enemies.
One could say that the Destruction Devils might seem savage and represented destruction, but compared to ‘World Ancestor’, he was so much fiercer and tyrannical compared to other ‘kings’ and was much stronger.
Fortunately, he was rational.
He stood on the side of the three great sacred worlds and took the Sacred Master as an enemy. He was similarly fighting against the Destruction Devils. Otherwise, the World Ancestor was practically a calamity to the cultivators.
“Suicided?” The thin and small World Ancestor who was garbed in loose green gown shook his head after seeing it, “These children are quite decisive in suiciding. Mn? Dong Bo Xue Ying, the dispelled energy from the death of Destruction Devils is quite nourishing right?”
Xue Ying was currently feeling waves of impact on his soul. At the moment when the two golden-armored Destruction Devils suicided, the dispelled unique energy was naturally absorbed by him. Saying it, Xue Ying felt quite ashamed. He had stayed in the Void Castle for so long and killed quite a few golden-armored Destruction Devils, yet the total energy he had absorbed then could not compare with this single absorption over here.
The unique energy was separated into two parts. One was considered quite pure, and the other had made his soul tremble in bursts. That feeling was too comfortable.
“Greetings World Ancestor. It’s a pity that the two of them have suicided, and I could not capture them alive.” Xue Ying held back the excitement of his soul. The reward this time was comparable to devouring 50,000 Origin World Rocks. That effect of absorbing the energy from that peak eighth level golden-armored Destruction Devil was estimated to be equivalent slightly more than ten thousand Origin World Rocks, with the remaining energy coming from the ninth level golden-armored Destruction Devil.
‘It’s a pity that they did not leave behind any materials.’ Xue Ying thought.
He had killed so many golden-armored Destruction Devils and had merely gotten two materials in total. One was left behind by a seventh level golden-armored Destruction Devil, and other by one at the eighth level. Their added valuation was slightly more than 10,000 Origin World Rocks.
“Capturing them alive isn’t that easy.” The thin and small World Ancestor chuckled.
Suddenly, the space by the side was once again distorted, forming a passage that a figure came out from. He was Ancestor Sorcerer. Ancestor Sorcerer nodded to World Ancestor before looking at his surroundings.
“You came late.” The thin and small World Ancestor said.
“I am slightly delayed. It seems that the two golden-armored Destruction Devils have suicided.” Ancestor Sorcerer merely glanced, and he was able to investigate through what had happened. After all, this wasn’t a battleground between experts of the ‘king’ level, and it was quite easy for him to examine. “Not bad, you are able to kill two at a single instance. It seems one of them is even at the ninth level, and the numbers of ninth level Destruction Devils are quite limited still-about a dozen at most.”
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, this nine-petaled flower is your new creation?” Ancestor Sorcerer turned to Xue Ying, praising him, “It is relatively interesting. With this technique, you are able to be ranked in top ten amongst Primal Chaos existences in terms of offense.”
“It is indeed my new creation.” Xue Ying replied.
He understood what Ancestor Sorcerer said, and it was true. After all, Xue Ying had personally seen Primal Chaos Hall Master, Monarch Xing Huo and other ninth level experts acting in the Void Castle. And those who still held an obvious upper hand against his offensive power currently could be counted with one’s fingers, and Primal Chaos Hall Master was one of them. Before creating the nine-petaled flower, his offensive power should only be equivalent to some of the peak eighth level Primal Chaos experts who specialized in the offense.
…
During this period that Xue Ying accompanied Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor, the suicide of the two golden-armored Destruction Devils had incurred the shock of the higher-ups of Destruction Devils!
Before the two suicided, they had naturally provided information to the ‘kings’.
One had to know…
Any Destruction Devils who were chosen to be brought into the cultivator’s world, other than the two with the ‘shadowless talent’, the others were recognized to have quite a good heart temperament and potential. Nevertheless, they had lost two such seedlings in an instance, and one of them was even at the ninth level.
“Damn.”
“This Dong Bo Xue Ying has become stronger. His newly created move is able to trap even the strongest golden-armored general.” These ‘kings’ were infuriated.
“I really wish to kill this Dong Bo Xue Ying.”
“It’s a pity that his movement is unpredictable, and he is traveling all across the world. It is hard to predict where he will be going next. Furthermore, even if we were to encounter him by chance, he has secret treasures protecting him and could escape using ultra-long distance teleportation. We can’t kill him at all.”
The kings were filled with killing intent towards Xue Ying.
One had to know…
That it was extremely difficult to search for traces of Destruction Devils.
Even Cosmos Gods had their own specialized Daos! For instance, Forefather Tian Yu specialized in ‘slaughter’, and Blade Emperor also specialized in frontal combat. As for Devil Mountain Primogenitor, he relied on his body to battle bluntly! These crude methods that the Cosmos Gods specialized in were useless in discerning those hidden Destruction Devils who concealed their auras, mimicking that of the cultivators.
They could slaughter countless cultivators, or suppress a vast region. Destruction Devils could similarly disguise and mimic these actions of the cultivators.
In order to search for traces of Destruction Devils, one had to have a technique that covered a considerable region that would not harm the weaker cultivators. This technique had to be able to differentiate the Destruction Devils from cultivators too!
‘Heart Imitation Religious Master’ was one who had such a technique.
And Xue Ying’s attainments in the illusory realm could achieve this too. The number of ninth level Primal Chaos existences who had similar techniques could be counted with one’s fingers, yet only Xue Ying was able to teleport through an ultra-long distance.
Most of the Cosmos Gods engaged in direct battle, and only two had such techniques. One was World Ancestor, but his time was too precious since many territories depended on him, and he was not so free to do a carpet-search for Destruction Devils. If Ancestor Sorcerer were to do this, then those Destruction Devils would hide even deeper. As for the other party, it was ‘Jade Light Master’, and her status was similarly high.
Thus, the existence of Xue Ying conducting his mission would likely cause the Destruction Devils to feel a ‘threat’, making them hide even deeper and be more careful.
…
And the reality was as such.
After those Destruction Devils who permeated into the world of cultivators suffered from losses the first time, the ‘kings’ sent down an order immediately.
All golden-armored Destruction Devils were to hide. They had to hide in some desolate land where there was nobody at all. They were permitted to act only when they ‘hunted for preys’, and they were to hide again after finishing their hunt. Those extremely desolate places, if Xue Ying were to do a carpet search through them, with how vast the primal chaos void was, there would be no end to when he could complete his search.

chapters.title: Chapter 964 - The Day before the Eruption
chapters.content:
Chapter 964: The Day before the Eruption
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
In one of the primal chaos lands within the vast primal chaos void, six Destruction Devils were hiding here. The leading commander was ‘General Mo Gu’.
“General Mo Gu, the kings have strict orders for you to hide in an extremely desolate land.” His five subordinates urged him.
“We are already hiding in a primal chaos land, yet this is still not enough?” General Mo Gu who was tall and thin and had a pair of triangular eyes gritted his teeth, “Just because of that cultivator called Dong Bo Xue Ying? What is so frightening about him? Even if several Cosmos Gods came, I could simply void-ify all of you and penetrate through the void to escape, much less a mere Primal Chaos cultivator.”
He had his confidence.
Other than the fact that he had a slightly less refined heart temperament and poorer direct combat skills, his ‘shadowless’ talent was indeed terrifying. Even Cosmos Gods could not say for certain they could destroy the primal chaos void imprisonment. If General Mo Gu were to void-ify, even the ‘nine-petaled flower’ could not stop him from escaping.
The nine-petaled flower was ultimately still within the confines of the void.
Even if several Cosmos Gods worked together, spending time and effort to construct a spatial barrier, General Mo Gu could simply penetrate through it. What could the nine-petaled flower be compared to this?
“General Mo Gu, you have a unique identity. No accidents must happen to you. The kings have strict orders, and we can only abide by them.” The other five kings looked at General Mo Gu.
General Mo Gu gritted his teeth.
Regardless, his instincts prevented him from going against those kings who were so high up.
“Alright alright, let’s hide even deeper. But, when can I go out and have a nice meal again?” General Mo Gu’s eyes were brimming red. His soul desired for more living beings. That time when he devoured Jade Light Empress and the city of living beings, it was one of the most pleasurable moments in his entire life. And even after several dozens of billions of years, he had yet to forget that feeling.
“According to the kings, those cities where Primal Chaos giants existed in have strict security. The death of every Primal Chaos existence would likely irritate the Cosmos Gods even more. It is only due to General Mo Gu’s unique status, and this being your first time here that they allowed you to target a Primal Chaos giant once. If you want to do it again? The kings ordered for General Mo Gu to first reach the peak eighth level combat power.” The other five subordinates explained by the side.
“Peak of the eighth level?”
General Mo Gu muttered to himself.
How was this easy? He had eaten Jade Light Empress and countless other beings, greatly nourishing him and allowing his strength to reach close to that of the eighth level. From now on, it would be hard for him to raise his strength even further.
“Go go go.” General Mo Gu was currently in a luxurious palace. His gaze swept across the entire primal chaos land in front of him through the palace, “Before leaving, let me devour all living beings on this primal chaos land.”
“This is a minor matter.”
The other five did not obstruct him at all.
After all, this was merely a primal chaos land. There were frequently dangerous void creatures invading it and devouring all beings on it. All they had to do was keep their aura and disguise their strengths. Even if a cultivator came and revert the time flow to investigate what happened, they could only see their disguised appearances. It was impossible for them to know that everything had been committed by the Destruction Devils.
Very soon.
The trillion beings on the entire primal chaos land flew up in despair. The void was distorted, and all beings were sucked through the void right into the mouth of General Mo Gu.
After enjoying a sumptuous meal, General Mo Gu and the other five left stealthily. This time, they were finding an even more desolate place to hide.
…
Ever since the previous harvest-the suicide of the two Destruction Devils without being able to capture them alive, the investigation after that by Xue Ying no longer produced any results! Actually, he could guess so. The primal chaos land was ultimately too big, and traveling from a sacred world to another was far. A normal Void God would have to spend 100 billion years if he moved continuously through time-space passages.
For Xue Ying to scour through the entire place? That would be an inexhaustible area.
The Cosmos Gods from the three great sacred worlds understood this too. The moment the Destruction Devils wanted to hide, then there was practically no hope for them of being found. It appeared that Xue Ying’s mission was almost completed in the opinions of the Cosmos Gods.
They let Xue Ying investigate the activities of Destruction Devils…
Not for him to discover every single one of them-that was impossible.
Instead, their previous motive was to affirm if any Destruction Devil ‘kings’ had invaded their land and if the spatial barrier actually obstructed the Destruction Devils from penetrating through it. It was definitely best if Xue Ying could capture one alive so that the Cosmos Gods could interrogate them through their souls! Nevertheless, it was too difficult to capture one alive and search through their soul. Even Cosmos Gods did not have the certainty of doing so.
For instance, Jade Light Master might be able to search through a large area, yet she could not control the soul of a golden-armored Destruction Devil.
Xue Ying’s illusory realm might be formidable, but those Destruction Devils had amazing heart temperament. It was too hard to cause them to lose awareness of themselves. Furthermore, the weaker peak eighth level golden-armored Destruction Devils were moving along with those at the ninth level.
******
Time passed. Xue Ying remained traveling around the world.
This time, he spent an even longer period without finding anything. Xue Ying gradually treated cultivation as his prime motive for traveling, and he no longer harbored any hopes of finding the Destruction Devils.
“Dong Bo, hurry up and return.”
One day.
As Xue Ying was traveling outside in the world, he received the transmission from Forefather Tian Yu. Xue Ying did not follow up with more questions. Instead, he immediately teleported back to the Great Void Heaven Temple.
‘What happened?’ Xue Ying waited until all the hall masters arrived. All 13 hall masters were here. Other than eight hall masters who had their true bodies remain in the Void Castle, the other five had returned to the inner section of Great Void Heaven Temple with their true bodies. None were left outside!
“Either our true body is located in the Void Castle, or that they have to be returned here. What is going on? Forefather, is there something huge happening that requires our true body to return?”
The hall masters had gathered in the palace of Primal Chaos Hall Master since he was their unspoken leader.
…
The hall masters and inner hall elders had all gathered. And in another courtyard within Great Void Heaven Temple, there were three Cosmos Gods here-Forefather Tian Yu, Swordmaster, and Blade Emperor.
“This time, I will have to trouble Blade Emperor, letting Blade Emperor protect my Great Void Heaven Temple.” Forefather Tian Yu spoke with gratitude.
“Even though Ancestor Sorcerer and Luo City Lord have already agreed to help your Great Void Heaven Temple, with me protecting it, it’ll be safer.” Blade Emperor chuckled, “With me and the support from the Great Void Heaven Temple… even if Sacred Master personally came, using the secret treasure refined from the Origin Energy, even if the entire Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World is shattered, none should dare to think of destroying the Great Void Heaven Temple during this period. In the worst case scenario should Sacred Master decide to use all his strength, Devil Mountain Primogenitor, Jade Light Master, Ancestor Sorcerer, and others would similarly act against him too.”
“Mn.” Forefather Tian Yu nodded.
For the sake of this day, the six great holy grounds had prepared for a long time. Even the Myriad Ancient Sacred World was willing to lend a helping hand to them.
“Swordmaster, everything depends on you now.” Blade Emperor looked at the white-haired male by the side, “Everything has been prepared. We have also prepared ourselves mentally to engage in another war, so its best if you do not make any mistake this time.”
Swordmaster chuckled: “I’ve troubled everyone, and do really appreciate that. As for my task… feel rest assured. As long as we delay for a slightly longer period, I will be 100% certain!”
Hearing that he was 100% certain, Blade Emperor could not help but brighten up. He slightly nodded and sighed inwardly.
Indeed, Swordmaster was someone his teacher fancied.
He was amazing.
“Everything will depend on you now.” Forefather Tian Yu laughed, “Right now, all the hall masters, inner hall elders of my Great Void Heaven Temple are here. Either they are in the Void Castle, or they have returned to the Great Void Heaven Palace. Everything has been prepared. You can start at any time.”
“Since everything has been prepared, there is no longer a need to delay any further. Let us begin now.” Swordmaster said.
“Alright.” Blade Emperor and Forefather Tian Yu were both looking forward to seeing that scene.
This was something all six great holy grounds and the Myriad Ancient Sacred World desired to see too.

chapters.title: Chapter 965 - Draw into Movement
chapters.content:
Chapter 965: Draw into Movement
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The ordinary disciples within the Great Void Heaven Temple were unaware of what was happening, though all the inner hall elders and the 13 hall masters were able to feel that ‘a storm was brewing’. They had asked Forefather Tian Yu regarding this, yet he did not explain to them in detail. He merely ordered: “From now on, all of you should either stay within the Void Castle or inside the Great Void Heaven Temple. Do not ever go out! Without my permission, you aren’t allowed to travel outside these two places.”
Once the orders were given, Xue Ying and the other 12 hall masters began drinking and discussing this topic.
“This is truly puzzling. Forefather has never ever given such an order before ever since the start of Great Void Heaven Temple.”
“The Void Castle is the most important location meant for resisting against the Destruction Devils and is absolutely a safe place. The Great Void Heaven Temple is extremely safe too, and Forefather has allowed us only to stay in these two locations… What exactly is happening?”
“I can’t think of any huge matter as well.”
The hall masters were quite knowledgeable, yet none of them could explain this phenomenon, including Primal Chaos Hall Master.
Xue Ying was frowning and thinking deeply about this too.
“Mn?”
Suddenly, all 13 hall masters looked up. Even the inner hall elders and the many disciples within the Great Void Heaven Temple turned towards the sky.
“Hong long long~”
The Great Void Heaven Temple had always been a sealed space. Nevertheless, a lump of heart-palpitating black light appeared from the center of the temple. One could vaguely sense strands of bloodiness coming from the black light. Even cultivators at the level of Xue Ying could feel their hearts trembling at seeing this light with their naked eyes, much less those who were weaker.
“This is?” Xue Ying could faintly perceive that this enormous lump of black light was implicitly at the level of the primal chaos supreme law.
Terrifying.
Extremely terrifying.
He was a ninth level expert. After grasping the nine-petaled flower, his combat power had barely reached the Cosmos God level. He had once fought with a ‘king’ from the Destruction Devil race that existed for destruction and had also gotten a glimpse of the battles at the level of Ancestor Sorcerer, Jade Light Master, and other Cosmos Gods. Nevertheless, none of those could surpass the suppressive feeling Xue Ying was currently getting from this enormous black light hanging in the sky.
That was at the supreme law of the primal chaos void, and Cosmos Gods were akin to trapped ants in front of it.
‘What exactly is my Great Void Heaven Temple plotting?’ Xue Ying felt shocked, ‘For such a horrifying disturbance to descend?’
…
“It has begun.”
Forefather Tian Yu and Blade Emperor looked upwards at that dense lump of black light. They revealed a smile.
“Swordmaster is indeed 100% certain. He has just entered closed-door once to draw it into movement, and has succeeded after that.” Blade Emperor was full of praise for Swordmaster in his heart.
“From now on, everything will depend on Blade Emperor and the fellow Cosmos Gods.” Forefather Tian Yu mentioned, “My strength is too weak, and I can only assist from the side.”
“Haha… be rest assured.” Blade Emperor chuckled. At this moment, he was carefully controlling the entire Great Void Heaven Temple. The current Great Void Heaven Temple had been augmented with energy from some treasures, allowing it to reach a higher and more powerful stage. Anybody who had just formed an ‘ultra-long distance teleportation passage’ would find the passage destroyed immediately. The current Great Void Heaven Temple could be said to be ‘as secure as a city protected by a wall of metal and a moat of boiling water’.
…
Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World. Within the sky just outside the Great Void Heaven Temple space.
Two figures were standing side by side.
One was Ancestor Sorcerer who had many black shackles dancing around him. The other was the thin and small World Ancestor. The two of them were watching silently. As for ‘Devil Mountain Primogenitor’ and ‘Jade Light Master’ who were both from the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World, they were hiding by the side and were prepared to move any moment from now.
“Mn?”
Ancestor Sorcerer and the thin and small World Ancestor turned over at the same time.
Behind them, a lump of black light could be seen faintly forming. It emanated a horrifying power that came clearly from within the Great Void Heaven Temple. This bit of ‘black light’ brought smiles on both Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor.
“This Swordmaster is indeed talented. He has actually succeeded in activating it.” The thin and small World Ancestor shook his head in praise, “Talking about this, that Swordmaster has not experienced any huge wars and has never been to the Void Castle. He has practically been in closed-door cultivation all the time! It hasn’t been long since he became a Cosmos God too right? Yet he could reach this step. Who knows, he might just surpass us and compete with the Sacred Master.”
“The Destruction Devils are getting stronger day by day. The threat of Sacred Master is also increasing over time. If Swordmaster were to be able to fight against Sacred Master, it’d be a joyous matter to us too.” Ancestor Sorcerer answered.
“Let us see how far this outstanding talent could walk till.” World Ancestor chuckled, “In a while, Sacred Master will be coming. He is definitely going to turn mad with fury.”
Ancestor Sorcerer chuckled too.
That’s right.
The other party would definitely be turning mad with fury.
“We do not have to fight to the death with him. What we need to do is just to obstruct him and restrict his movements, preventing him from disturbing Swordmaster.” Ancestor Sorcerer said.
******
In the distant Ancient Sacred World.
Within a palace, on a crystalline black stone bed, Sacred Master was seated on it with a peaceful expression.
The servants serving him below were all respectful. Even just catching a glimpse of the Sacred Master within their periphery vision would cause them to feel satisfaction deep from their hearts. This was the Sacred Master, and his appearances contained a vague sense of the supreme law from the primal chaos void. His expression, his aura, his every movement were akin to the display of the supreme law.
His appearance gave off the feeling of someone pure and holy. His aura would cause others to feel intoxicated, and his voice was melodious.
“Mn?”
Sacred Master who had been seated cross-legged for an indeterminate time suddenly turned towards the distant void with that pair of eyes that seemed to see through everything.
His expression slightly changed.
With that change, the atmosphere in the entire palace hall became heavier. Those servants started hyperventilating and became anxious because it was rare for the Sacred Master to become infuriated. When he was truly furious, it would be heaven-shaking.
“What gall! You dare come and take my things?!” The eyes of Sacred Master were filled with coldness and solemness. At this moment, he was not hiding his killing intent at all.
Very soon, he relied on an ultra-long distance teleportation passage opened by his subordinates to arrive close to the Great Void Heaven Temple.
…
“Hua~”
In the midair just outside Great Void Heaven Temple, Sacred Master who was barefooted walked out from the distorted spatial passage. Just by taking a step from within it, he had arrived right outside the Great Void Heaven Temple. This distance would take ordinary Primal Chaos giants the time taken to brew a cup of tea if they tore through the spatial passage.
Sacred Master might not know how to teleport through an ultra-long distance, but reaching his realm, he naturally possessed many techniques. This distance of void teleportation could only be surpassed by Void Primogenitor currently! Even Xue Ying was much weaker in his void teleportation despite cultivating in many aspects of the Dao of Void.
“It has been a long time.” Wearing a loose green robe, the thin and small World Ancestor was full of smiles. His huge mouth became more prominent as he beamed.
The shackles surrounding the surface of Ancestor Sorcerer were flying more vigorously as his aura rose.
“Those who obstruct me will return to primal chaos.” Sacred Master extended his right hand, causing a multi-colored lance to appear.
“We have fought each other for so many times, and you dare to spout such big words?” The laughter of World Ancestor became even more splendid.

chapters.title: Chapter 966 - Getting a Glimpse of Sacred Master’s power
chapters.content:
Chapter 966: Getting a Glimpse of Sacred Master’s power
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The multi-colored lance in Sacred Master’s hand was flung out as quick as thunder. The moment it was thrown, it disappeared.
“Pu!”
Ripples formed by the entrance of the distant Great Void Heaven Temple. The multi-colored lance brought with it a horrifying strength, bombarding where the entry was. But it merely produced some ripples, and there were still strands of blade light appearing which prevented the lance from proceeding forward.
“Sacred Master, the Great Void Heaven Temple doesn’t welcome you.” A cold voice came from another space.
“Blade Emperor is here too.” Sacred Master understood that the situation was not in his favor this time. Clearly, the other party had prepared themselves for his arrival-extremely well-prepared. With both Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor restraining him, he could not easily destroy the Great Void Heaven Temple that was under the protection of Blade Emperor.
Sacred Master extended his hand, causing the multi-colored lance to return into his hand.
“You all trust that Swordmaster too much. Snatching my things isn’t that easy.” The tsunami of killing intent emanating from Sacred Master became more concentrated over time.
“We will see.” World Ancestor beamed from ear to ear.
Ancestor Sorcerer stood by the side silently.
“So stubborn.” The aura on Sacred Master grew stronger.
“Hong!”
Thunder appeared above the sacred world. Those gray thunder were akin to enormous thunder snakes swimming away. They would also strike down on the ground occasionally. These thunderclaps were like strange berserk beasts moving around ‘Sacred Master’. Sacred Master’s skin became slightly transparent, and there was even thunder swimming within his skin.
The lance he was holding on was also wrapped with gray thunder.
“Ancestor Sorcerer, be careful. This Sacred Master is turning mad.” World Ancestor remained smiling. Ancestor Sorcerer who was by his side became solemn. The black shackles surrounding his body expanded in length. Each shackle had even caused the surrounding space to collapse and fall. It was like the life and death of cosmos, and Ancestor Sorcerer was clearly on high alert.
“Hong.”
Sacred Master acted. He took a step. That lance seemed ordinary, yet as it propelled forward towards Ancestor Sorcerer, it gave off an exotic feeling. Clearly, Sacred Master felt that Ancestor Sorcerer was comparatively easier to deal with.
“Hua hua hua~” Nine black shackles were dancing in the air. Every shackle was mysterious in its own way, causing the surrounding space to shrink abruptly. The space that was originally 500 kilometers long had been forced into just half a kilometers, making it such that Sacred Master’s lance could not evade at all. In this region spanning half a kilometers, the nine black shackles had practically covered every inch of space and clashed with the lance.
“Dang~”
Sounds of clashing boomed. Ancestor Sorcerer was forced to retreat.
“Haha, come play with me instead!” World Ancestor laughed and rushed over.
“Scram.” Sacred Master waved the lance in his hand. Even though he wasn’t part of the laws and profound mysteries lineage, his combat realm was incredibly profound. The usage of the lance was formidable.
Nevertheless, World Ancestor did not care about it. He waved both his fists and rushed over. He was fast. That lance immediately lashed on the thin and small World Ancestor’s head, causing his head to cave in. But World Ancestor was still full of smiles. Not a single strand of hair had dropped, and his skin did not break. That distorted caved-in skull of his soon regained back to its original form.
“Pu!””Xiu!””Hong!”
Sacred Master had practically struck on the body of World Ancestor using his lance a dozen times. Concerning power and the profundity of moves, Sacred Master was completely beyond that of World Ancestor, and World Ancestor could not retaliate at all.
Nevertheless…
World Ancestor remained uninjured.
His body could become big anytime he wanted, and small anytime he wanted. The toughness of his body was comparable to that of a cosmos ranked secret treasure, and it was as supple as a moving river. If he wanted, he could disperse his body, and condense it back. Facing this enemy that could not die, Sacred Master felt helpless.
“Go.” Many black shackles flew out from the surface of Ancestor Sorcerer’s body. They were densely located. Each shackle was very small, but as it flew out, it became bigger and bigger. Soon, more than 10,000 black shackles had appeared, causing the entire sacred world to tremble.
“The two of them.” Sacred Master felt infuriated.
Ancestor Sorcerer was the existence who created the hex cultivation system. If he were given enough time, he could produce several horrifying moves.
Clearly, this forefather of hex cultivation had extremely cunning and savage moves.
If it was a one on one battle…
Sacred Master would not give Ancestor Sorcerer any time at all. Nevertheless, now that World Ancestor was helping from the side, Ancestor Sorcerer had sufficient time to display his moves.
“Hong~”
As Sacred Master fought with Ancestor Sorcerer, the entire sacred world trembled. Many cracks appeared in the world and then recovered time after time.
…
Within the Great Void Heaven Temple.
Xue Ying and the rest could feel the frightening disturbance outside the world.
‘What is happening?’ Xue Ying immediately peered through the black fog spherical holes to see what was happening outside. As the battlefield was just outside the Great Void Heaven Temple, Xue Ying was able to see what was happening exceptionally clearly.
‘Sacred Master!’
Xue Ying saw him. He saw that figure who had an almost exact same appearance as the Ancient Sacred sculpture. His appearance tended to be neutral. If he decided to dress as a woman, he would be a beauty. His presence was holy and pure, bringing with it an appeal from the supreme law of the primal chaos void. His every action would result in a scary suppression.
‘Sacred Master, it is him. It is him.’ Xue Ying felt a killing intent erupting from his heart which he could not suppress.
His teacher Gu Qi had died in this person’s hands. Xue Ying did not even have the time to see his teacher once at all.
This madman.
This person who wanted to conquer all living beings and make them loyal to him, removing all freedom of souls.
‘Is this his true power?’ This was the first time Xue Ying saw Sacred Master in action.
Too powerful.
That horrifying thunder surrounded Sacred Master. He held on to that simple mystical lance, and every action of his caused the entire sacred world to shake. His speed had surpassed what Xue Ying could see. Xue Ying could merely see… World Ancestor being struck on his body under the assault of Sacred Master! And Ancestor Sorcerer was casting one terrifying after another technique by the side.
Nevertheless, Sacred Master could break the horrifying techniques Ancestor Sorcerer cast.
Even when he was fighting against two, Sacred Master still held a clear advantage.
The entire Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World was shaking from the battle. Many cracks were appearing.
‘Too strong.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
One had to know that Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor were two existences standing closest to the Sacred Master. For instance, the previous secret treasure of his, the ’12 Primal Beads Bracelet’ could merely withstand one to two instances of the attacks by Ancestor Sorcerer and others! Currently, Ancestor Sorcerer is spending a huge amount of time casting various great techniques, and just a single technique of his would break apart Xue Ying’s two great secret treasures. Xue Ying would thus die from it.
But Sacred Master could casually break apart these moves that could exterminate Xue Ying.
It was truly a destructive battle.
Annihilating a sacred world wasn’t something different to him.
‘The gap between us is too big.’ Only after Xue Ying witnessed it personally did he understand how big the gap was. No wonder the Sacred Master who stood so high up would disdain from caring about any Primal Chaos giants. After all, even those who entered the Cosmos God realm could barely survive by relying on treasures in front of Sacred Master. They were not qualified to even fight against him.
There were only a few who could truly fight with him, and they were all second level Cosmos Gods.
‘In order to become an enemy of his, I must step into the Cosmos God realm first.’ Xue Ying could not help but feel his soul tremble. He desired to become stronger.
Ninth level?
It was considered strong amongst Primal Chaos existences, but in front of the Sacred Master, it was like an ant! Even by relying on secret treasures, he would still be an ant!

chapters.title: Chapter 967 - The Dust has Settled
chapters.content:
Chapter 967: The Dust has Settled
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying carefully peered at this ‘peak battle’. It was rare for battles of this level to occur.
Even though it was taxing for him, and most of the combat techniques were too quick and blurred, Xue Ying had gradually deduced and understood some parts of the battle.
Xue Ying was able to discern from the combat moves of Sacred Master that they contained the profound mysteries of slaughter, destruction, light, thunder… many profound mysteries were inherent within his moves. Nevertheless, these profound mysteries had a single origin-the ‘grayish thunder’. Sacred Master’s combat energy source originated from that thunder.
Thunder contained an apocalyptic power.
Thunder was also filled with destructiveness…
‘Sacred Master is very similar to World Ancestor. They specialized in a single source of power.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘All the power of Sacred Master seems to originate from thunder, yet it suffices for him to suppress both Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor.’
‘World Ancestor focused on his body! He has refined his body to an unfathomable stage. The strength of his body is even more horrifying than several other secret treasures, and the attacks by Sacred Master could not injure a single hair of his at all.’ Xue Ying could not help but lament over this fact. He understood Black Emperor’s four great inheritances which seemed to temper one’s fleshy body to an unfathomable extent.
But after seeing this battle, he finally understood what a horrifying fleshy body meant.
‘If one said that Sacred Master focused on ‘thunder’, and World Ancestor specialized in his ‘fleshy body’, then Ancestor Sorcerer has no specialties.’ Xue Ying thought.
Ancestor Sorcerer had many formidable techniques despite being ‘mixed’. He could even fuse some of the very formidable moves together, allowing him to unleash killing moves that were formidable, forcing Sacred Master to treat them carefully. But the only weakness he had was that Ancestor Sorcerer required time to cast his horrifying moves. Hence, in a short battle, Ancestor Sorcerer could never win World Ancestor.
‘No wonder World Ancestor and Ancestor Mother are publicly acknowledged to be the two existences closest to the Sacred Master. Ancestor Sorcerer could barely compete with World Ancestor and the others by relying on his techniques, but he is still quite lacking.’ Xue Ying nodded inwardly.
Ancestor Mother and World Ancestor were publicly acknowledged to be of one minor level amongst Cosmos Gods at the second level. Ancestor Sorcerer and Blade Emperor were of another minor level!
‘But despite both World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer working together against Sacred Master, they can’t injure Sacred Master at all.’ Xue Ying felt heaviness in his heart. Sacred Master still had the upper hand despite fighting against two at once. He was indeed an existence who could become enemies with all Cosmos Gods by himself! It was very difficult trying to kill him.
‘I should work hard to become a Cosmos God first.’
Xue Ying thought.
He knew himself that despite being at the ninth level currently, it was hard for him to compare with Cosmos Gods still. Xue Ying still lacked understanding in the Dao of Mirage which he specialized most.
…
As Xue Ying was thoroughly observing the battle, he suddenly felt his senses tingling and looked upwards.
In the distant, high above the Great Void Heaven Temple, that lump of rolling enormous black light suddenly fell downwards into the cavern-dwelling where Swordmaster stayed. It fused into the insides of that cavern-dwelling before disappearing.
‘What happened?’ Xue Ying, Primal Chaos Hall Master, Inquisitive Sky Hall Master, Celestial Water Hall Master, and others were watching with rapt attention. That terrifying black light actually fell into the cavern-dwelling of Swordmaster?
“Hahaha…”
Forefather Tian Yu and Blade Emperor who had always been responsible for protecting the place revealed a joyous expression after seeing this scene.
“He is quite fast.” Blade Emperor praised, “He has succeeded in controlling it so quickly. This has just been the time taken to brew a cup of tea. It seems that Swordmaster is quite adept in controlling it.”
“Haha, it is much faster than I expected.” Forefather Tian Yu was delighted too.
He knew that the Great Void Heaven Temple would become much stronger from now on.
******
The battle between Sacred Master and World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer persisted for just the time taken to brew a cup of tea.
“Sacred Master, receive a sword from me!” A roar came.
Two figures walked out from nothingness side by side. One was Blade Emperor, and the other was the white-haired male ‘Swordmaster’. Swordmaster carried a sword behind his back as he pointed at the Sacred Master from afar.
“Qiang!”
The sword left its scabbard.
A heart-palpitating sword light suddenly swept out. It brought with it a power that caused the entire sacred world to shake. This sword light directly slashed towards the distant Swordmaster, causing him to flinch momentarily before receiving this attack with the motley pike in his hand. At that moment, “hong hong hong…” Many booming sounds were heard, causing the surrounding space to shatter and distort. Even the flow of time was influenced.
In that short moment, both parties had fought for tens of bouts, and Sacred Master could not secure a victory during that period. World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer retreated with a smile as they saw this.
“Xiu.”
The sword light rapidly returned, falling back into the scabbard on Swordmaster’s back.
Sacred Master also stopped. The pike in his hand disappeared. He stood there inspecting Swordmaster thoroughly.
“I only felt that you are extraordinary previously, but it seems that I have still underestimated you.” Sacred Master chuckled with praise, “You have soundlessly reached the second level after entering the Cosmos God realm. Currently, your action has succeeded in taking away part of my strength. From your actions previously, you aren’t any weaker than the Blade Emperor. It is possible for you to surpass both World Ancestor and Ancestor Mother after some time.”
“Sacred Master has overpraised me.” Swordmaster calmly answered.
He remained low-profile for several epochs.
And in a single day, he erupted with his entire strength…
Allowing him to reach the standard of being able to fight with Sacred Master directly.
“Your talent and comprehension ability is indeed the first since the primitive Ancient Sacred World emerged.” Sacred Master laughed, “In the future, you might be qualified to become my opponent.”
Blade Emperor, Ancestor Sorcerer, and World Ancestor felt rueful in their hearts. They admitted that ‘Swordmaster’ was indeed outstanding. His strength had exploded with such speed, and more importantly, Swordmaster had not experienced any huge setbacks before and was able to reach his current realm in one fell swoop.
“The only pitiful thing is that you came into this world too late.” Sacred Master chuckled calmly without feeling anguished at all, “The Destruction Devils are only becoming stronger, and the time you have isn’t much either.”
“I hope that you will be able to reach the final third level before the final limit of this primal chaos void. By then, this world will be more interesting.” Sacred Master laughed at Swordmaster before disappearing.
“He left just like that?” Ancestor Sorcerer felt puzzled.
“He is quite direct with his departure. Despite having part of his strength snatched away by Swordmaster, he is able to remain calm.” The thin and small World Ancestor said, “It seems that ever since his affair has been broken by Gu Qi, in addition to the Destruction Devils getting stronger, Sacred Master should have given up all other schemes of his.”
Ancestor Sorcerer nodded: “Mn, previously, for the sake of venting his anger, he has utilized part of his origin energy to kill Gu Qi! This time, another part of his energy has been snatched by Swordmaster, yet he is able to remain nonchalant. It seems that he should have given up his schemes of the past.”
“We must always remain vigilant when fighting against Sacred Master.” Blade Emperor added, “Who knows if he might just paralyze us once he sees that things aren’t going well.”
Swordmaster nodded too.
…
Ancient Sacred World.
The Sacred Master sat cross-legged on his black stone bed. There was calm on his face: ‘This Swordmaster has improved truly quickly. It has only been a while yet he is able to fight against me directly. His growth is too smooth, and he hasn’t met any setbacks at all.’
‘Is it because he has once gotten the ‘Realm Heart Order?’ Sacred Master murmured inwardly, ‘It’s a pity that I have only heard of this Realm Heart Order before, yet have never obtained it.’

chapters.title: Chapter 968 - Realm Heart Order
chapters.content:
Chapter 968: Realm Heart Order
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. Within a restaurant.
Blade Emperor was seated opposite a male garbed in azure robes.
“Realm Heart Order?” Blade Emperor felt surprised, “Teacher, you mean Swordmaster could have gotten the Realm Heart Order? What is the Realm Heart Order? Why have I never heard of it before?”
“Mn.”
Luo City Lord sat there pouring wine and drinking it. He chuckled, “It is natural for you not to hear of it before. The number of cultivators in the primal chaos void who knows about the Realm Heart Order could be counted with one’s fingers. The Swordmaster should have gotten it and used it before! That is why he could advance in leaps and bounds. Naturally, this is merely my conjecture. Who knows if it might be because he has a heaven-defying talent, and was able to reach this stage just by entering closed-door cultivation.”
“Teacher, what exactly is the Realm Heart Order?” Blade Emperor asked.
“It is a unique secret treasure.” Luo City Lord chuckled, “In order to obtain and use it, one could only rely on fate. Even cultivators with extremely high comprehension abilities and talent must obtain the approval of the Realm Heart Order before they could obtain it. Otherwise, it is impossible for the cultivator to see this order even if it is right in front of them.”
“Impossible for the cultivator to see this order even if it is right in front of them?” Blade Emperor City felt even more bewildered.
A secret treasure.
There were several unique secret treasures like the motley pike which Sacred Master wielded, its origin was unknown! And the ‘Third Fire Prison Realm Cauldron’, its origin was unknown too.
The ‘Realm Heart Order’ that was a unique secret treasure? This was something Blade Emperor had never heard of before.
“Time for you to go back. Remember to properly cultivate. You are my disciple, so do not get outdone by Swordmaster.” Luo City Lord chuckled.
“Yes, this disciple will retreat now.” Blade Emperor stood up.
He was indeed feeling pressured.
He was the highest commander of the six great holy grounds! His teacher ‘Luo City Lord’ might have been stuck at the Primal Chaos realm, but his realm had reached an unfathomable stage. His teacher created the ‘Star Palace’ and was willing to guide other Cosmos Gods. Even Devil Mountain Primogenitor, Jade Light Master, Forefather Tian Yu, Void Primogenitor, Great Emperor Cloud Serpent, and others were willing to consult him humbly.
After all, Luo City Lord had reached a strength vaguely equivalent to that of the second level of Cosmos God despite being at the Primal Chaos realm.
In terms of his realm!
He was likely even higher than what the Sacred Master reached. Even though Luo City Lord had invoked some unknown taboo, preventing him from becoming a Cosmos God, his realm was too high that many wanted to take him as a teacher. It was only Luo City Lord who was the one that disdained from accepting these students. He was only willing to guide a few Cosmos Gods, and that was how the alliance of the ‘six holy grounds’ came about.
The true tie between the six holy grounds was Luo City Lord.
Swordmaster was a member of the Great Void Heaven Temple, and he could similarly obtain the guidance by Luo City Lord. Furthermore, Swordmaster was favored upon by Luo City Lord. Nevertheless, Blade Emperor was his personal disciple, and Luo City Lord would definitely focus more on him.
Blade Emperor left.
Luo City Lord remained there enjoying his wine in satisfaction.
‘Good wine. The wine fermented by this restaurant could be ranked in the top 600 across the primal chaos void.’ Luo City Lord praised. At the same time, he contemplated, ‘When the old man Yuan left, there aren’t many Realm Heart Order left behind. He mentioned that there were only five pieces left behind! Currently, there should be even fewer, yet one piece ended up in the hands of Swordmaster?’
******
Xue Ying and the others were forbidden from leaving the Great Void Heaven Temple and Void Castle.
But they could still use their incarnations to travel out of the Great Void Heaven Temple and see the vestiges left behind by the massive battle with Sacred Master.
“Hmm.”
“The battlefield left behind by the battle between Sacred Master with Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor?”
The group of hall masters was looking around them with astonishment.
The surrounding area spanning several hundred billion kilometers was a piece of chaos. Many void gorges were left behind in the space. The world had been torn apart with several ripples left behind! There were many cracks left in midair-these were scars from the damage of the sacred world. Destruction, slaughter, thunder, hex poison… all sorts of energy were chaotically mixed on this battlefield.
Forefather Tian Yu said from the side: “The shockwave from this battle has harmed the sacred world. It is easy destroying it, but very difficult trying to repair it! This region has almost been turned into ruins. In order to repair this… Devil Mountain Primogenitor, Jade Light Master, and the others would have to spend some time doing so.”
“Forefather, this battlefield seems quite small compared to the past.”
“I’ve heard that battles involving the Sacred Master could possibly cause a sacred world to shatter.”
The many hall masters were asking questions.
Forefather Tian Yu shook his head with a smile: “This battle was quite short, so the damages inflicted to the sacred world aren’t that serious. If the battle were to proceed for a longer period, the surrounding region spanning more than a trillion kilometers would be destroyed, and the injuries of the sacred world would be heavier! More importantly, Sacred Master did not go mad in this battle. In addition to how sudden the battle started, he was not as prepared.”
“The battle was too sudden?”
“Forefather, why did this battle happen in the first place?”
“What was that black light which entered the Great Void Heaven Temple?” The various hall masters felt puzzled. They could not fathom why this battle began!
Swordmaster acted too sudden this time.
And Sacred Master was not prepared at all. After all, it would require some time for him to fully refine his origin energy into a secret treasure. On another aspect, Sacred Master remained relatively calm this time and did not go mad.
“Swordmaster has broken through during this period, greatly becoming stronger. Currently, he is on the same level with Blade Emperor and Ancestor Sorcerer.” Forefather Tian Yu mentioned with delight. He did not hide this since this news would likely spread sooner or later.
******
The news had indeed spread across the entire primal chaos void. Cultivators across the world felt astounded at the current strength Swordmaster wielded.
In the following days, the Great Void Heaven Temple remained careful. The three great sacred worlds had made their preparations. If Sacred Master were to turn crazy, and if the Ancient Sacred religion were to incite a war with them, then they would confront it willingly!
But everything remained peaceful.
And after several billion years later, Forefather Tian Yu retreated the order that forbade Xue Ying and the hall masters from leaving the Great Void Heaven Temple or Void Castle. Only then did Xue Ying resume his travel around the world once again in search of traces for the ‘Destruction Devils’.
…
“Hong~”
Within the primal chaos void, two figures were battling, causing the entire void to solidify. Every boom brought distortion to the stable void.
“General Mo Gu, your utilization of the void is formidable. Truly admirable. But you still lack somewhat if you think of defeating me.” The green-robed male chuckled.
“Then take my final move. If you can easily resist this move of mine, it’ll be my loss.” The golden-robed triangular-eyed male coldly laughed.
A light ray that was as delicate as cicada’s wings cut through immediately, tearing through the congealed space as if it were beancurd. Furthermore, the light ray continued cutting through everything including that distant male.
The body of that male was immediately cut into two. Following that, both parts of his body fused back again, though it was extremely hard for him to recover from his wounds.
“What?” That green-robed male was startled.
“How is it?” The golden-robed male was relatively delighted, “According to what you said previously, my current strength in direct combat notwithstanding my shadowless talent should have reached the peak of the eighth level already right?”
“Yes, it has.”
Four other figures who were standing far away flew over together.
“General Mo Gu is formidable indeed. It has not been a trillion years since you left the Lost World Corridor and come to the cultivator’s world, but you have reached the peak of the eighth level already.”
“This final move is indeed formidable.”
The other four praised him too.
The golden-robed male, ‘General Mo Gu’s triangular eyes revealed greed. He burst into mischievous laughter: “The Kings have said before that the moment I’ve reached the peak of the eighth level, I am allowed to devour another Primal Chaos cultivator.”
“Rest assure General Mo Gu. We will definitely arrange everything properly.” The five subordinates said.
‘I’ll get to taste another Primal Chaos cultivator and countless cultivators again!’ General Mo Gu trembled. He was craving this for a long time.

chapters.title: Chapter 969 - Spoils of War
chapters.content:
Chapter 969: Spoils of War
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
In the primal chaos void, on a particular huge land with various nations and cities. This land was host to a huge number of beings, yet currently, the entire place had turned silent. Not a single sound could be heard.
“Hua.”
A thick-white-robed teenager appeared from the distorted void. He was Xue Ying.
‘Everyone on the Lu Ming Great Land is dead?’ Xue Ying appeared in one of the cities. This city was ruined, and not a single lifeform could be found in it.
Xue Ying walked step by step, flashing across the cities, plains, deserts, villages, icefields… he remained calm as he visited these places. The only change was his eyes as they became colder by the second. Even though he had been chasing after the Destruction Devils, and discovered beings from many places being devoured…
This was the first time Xue Ying had encountered such large-scale destruction where the entire ‘Lu Ming Great Land’ was wiped out!
Lu Ming Great Land was incredibly huge. It was much bigger than a cosmos, and was governed by the Primal Chaos giant, ‘Forefather Lu Ming’. Naturally, many beings were willing to stay here.
‘Are the Destruction Devils formed by the supreme law?’ Xue Ying looked up at the vast void, ‘Even if the supreme law destroyed all living beings, bringing them back into the primal chaos, it is fine if they destroyed them. Why the need to give birth to Destruction Devils who are murdering these people so cruelly instead…’
Maybe to the cold and callous supreme law that looked down upon all existences, there was no need for mercy. But Xue Ying was ultimately a cultivator, and seeing such an incident happening had ignited the wrath in his heart.
Even the most chaotic place, the ‘Myriad Ancient Sacred World’ contained many hex cultivators, devour-class cultivators, and ancient cultivators protecting their own territories. It wasn’t an easy task devouring an entire land. Those devils were weaker, and their destructive power was ordinary.
But all the Destruction Devils that entered the world of cultivators were either peak eighth level or ninth level! They were considered overlord existences even amongst Primal Chaos existences, and the threat from them was too significant.
‘I must get rid of all of you.’ The killing intent in Xue Ying’s eyes became heavier.
“Sou.”
He continued traveling.
Xue Ying continued his mission to search for more Destruction Devils. Currently, even the extremely desolate places that contained just two cultivators in closed-door cultivation were places that Xue Ying would scour. He would send his illusory realm over these regions.
The primal chaos void was too big, and if Xue Ying searched through the entire void so thoroughly, he would merely be covering the tip of an iceberg despite spending a trillion years. Nevertheless, Xue Ying remained diligent in his search.
‘There are also golden-armored ranked lairs. I must do my best to uncover all of them.’
Two of his incarnations were still searching for the lairs in the Lost World Corridor.
Ever since Xue Ying left the Void Castle, he had discovered two golden-armored ranked lair spaces. Though it was becoming harder to find them from then on.
…
On a piece of floating fiery-red massive stone within the primal chaos void.
This fiery-red massive stone was a remnant piece left from the destruction of the primitive Ancient Sacred World, and it spanned several thousand kilometers. It was considered notably small in the primal chaos void. Currently, there was a cavern-dwelling on this stone.
Within the cavern-dwelling lived ‘General Mo Gu’ and his five subordinates.
“Hu, hu…”
General Mo Gu sat there. He was so excited that he swayed about, “It is truly too delightful. This is awesome!”
“Hahaha, I believe those cultivator higher-ups will become greatly infuriated when they know about this. It’s a pity that the vast primal chaos void is boundless. It is practically impossible for them to find us. I do not believe that they will luck out either.”
“This time, the few of us have devoured some cultivators too. It is rare for life to be so enjoyable.”
“General Mo Gu has regained his calm now.”
The other five subordinates were laughing.
General Mo Gu had devoured that Forefather Lu Ming and 99% of the living beings on the land, leaving behind some for the other five subordinates. Naturally, because there was genuinely too many living beings on this land, even if the five subordinates ate just a minority of them, they still relished in it. ‘General Mo Gu’ had even turned slightly mad from his devour.
“This sort of feeling is too wonderful. I wonder when I can go out and devour again.” General Mo Gu’s eyes were emitting light.
“General Mo Gu, the kings have said that the next time you want to enjoy another huge meal, you must reach the ninth level.” The other five said.
When one walked by the river, his shoes would indubitably become wet!
There were only this few Primal Chaos giants!
If they frequently went out to eat, the Cosmos Gods would likely become more alert, and they would probably fall into the traps of the Cosmos Gods.
It was only because General Mo Gu’s status was unique that he could act against the Primal Chaos cultivators. Ordinary golden-armored ranked Destruction Devils could not do so.
“Ninth level?” General Mo Gu felt helpless, “This is too difficult.”
The golden-armored Destruction Devils.
The weakest of them were at the seventh level, and there were fewer of them at the eighth level. As for the ninth level?
Not just the cultivators or the Destruction Devils, it was genuinely too difficult to reach the ninth level. General Mo Gu felt that even if he had ten or a hundred times more time in his hand, he would not have much chance.
“This is the order given by the kings.”
General Mo Gu could only accept it. The Destruction Devils were originally given birth to battle and kill. The gray-armored ranked Destruction Devils would obey the orders of the blood-armored Destruction Devils. The blood-armored Destruction Devils could not disobey the orders of the golden-armored Destruction Devils. Similar logic, all the Destruction Devils would not dare to disobey the orders of the ‘kings’. This was imbued in their blood and soul.
“Hu…” General Mo Gu opened his mouth.
At that time, a large number of materials flew out.
All sorts of weapons, storage treasures, scriptures had piled up by the side into a small mountain.
“These are items that I can’t digest.” General Mo Gu said, “Hurry up and flip through them to see what are useful especially the cultivator’s scriptures.”
“Alright.”
“We’ll do it right now.” The five subordinates said.
To the Destruction Devils, what attracted them most in the cultivator’s world was firstly, slaughter and devouring the cultivators. This originated from their desires. Secondly would be the cultivation scriptures! They wanted to gain experience from the cultivators’ inheritances so that they could improve further. Every golden-armored Destruction Devil sought to transcend beyond the control of their desire and become ‘kings’.
And it was relatively difficult for them to search for these scriptures.
The more precious the scripture, the more heavily guarded it would be located at!
