Thus, I think that the trillion beings within the illusory realm are real.” Xue Ying answered, “Currently, I lack just half a step before making my illusory realm comparable to a real world. Furthermore, every time after performing the illusory realm, I am merely stopping the time in the illusory realm for the trillion beings within temporarily. When I perform my illusory realm again, these beings would continue living once again.”
If he were to let the illusory realm be shattered, it would be like killing all trillion beings within. Xue Ying was not willing to do such an act.
He was not foolish.
Instead, there was no longer any difference between the people living in the real world and in the illusory realm at his current realm. The beings in both worlds had identities, had emotions, and could cultivate… Hence, the illusory realm that was unleashed by Xue Ying would be the same one all the time, albeit every single time he performed it again, there would be more living beings within.
“They are all real? After you finish performing it, you will only be stopping the time within the illusory realm temporarily?” The thin old man went into deep thoughts after listening to that. He then shook his head and chuckled, “Sometimes, spiritual energy is significant in cultivation. If you believe in it, you will succeed. If you don’t, you will naturally not succeed.”
“Alright, I am full now. Time to leave.” The thin old man stood up. He looked at Xue Ying in all smiles, “We might meet again in the future if we are fated.”
Saying that, the thin old man stood up shakingly. He clutched on his walking stick before walking away slowly, and soon, his figure disappeared.
Xue Ying did not even perceive how the other party left.
‘So formidable.’ Xue Ying was inwardly startled, ‘I have always thought that Monarch Nine Cloud was the strongest in the void aspect, and now, Void Primogenitor is the first! But it seems that this mysterious and unfathomable ‘Senior Stone’ is similarly baffling. Just his technique of leaving has transcended beyond Void Primogenitor’s.”
…
Over at another location, in Great Void Heaven Temple.
Xue Ying’s incarnation immediately came over to see Forefather Tian Yu.
“Forefather.” Xue Ying greeted.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, what is it that made you come to see me personally?” Forefather Tian Yu asked with slight surprise.
“Forefather, do you recognize this person?” Saying that, Xue Ying waved his hand before projecting the appearance of Senior Stone-an old man who looked like a bag of bones and was holding on to a walking stick, “He is extremely powerful, and his utilization of the void, in my opinion, is beyond that of Void Primogenitor! According to my deduction, he is definitely a Cosmos God and should be ranked in the forefront. I dare not say he can stand side by side with Sacred Master, but he should at least be on the same level with World Ancestor and Ancestor Mother.”
“Oh?” Forefather Tian Yu looked with astonishment. He thoroughly scrutinized the figure that appeared in midair before shaking his head, “I do not know him. I’ve never seen him before.”
Xue Ying felt puzzled.
Even though Swordmaster might be strong, Forefather Tian Yu was still someone who far outstripped him in terms of age and wisdom. But Forefather Tian Yu said he had never seen before this Senior Stone?
“A Cosmos God who is at least on the level of World Ancestor and Ancestor Mother?” Forefather Tian Yu shook his head, “How is it possible for someone at this strength not to create any activity? Dong Bo Xue Ying, are you sure you have seen him before? And he is truly that strong? Are you not being hoodwinked?”
Xue Ying shook his head: “Impossible.”
“That’s right too. With your attainments in the illusory realm, who could hoodwink you in your law domain? That is practically too difficult.” Forefather Tian Yu felt perplexed and suspicious, “But this is still the first time I hear from you regarding a Cosmos God at this level whom I have never seen before. This is truly weird.”
******
After asking Forefather Tian Yu, Xue Ying went on to ask Swordmaster, yet he got the same answer.
Xue Ying could only temporarily leave it aside. No matter what, that mysterious thin small old man did not have any malicious intent against him. It’s just that his identity was more mysterious!
…
Within Eastern Unicorn Sacred World.
At the peak of a desolate mountain, the wind was biting cold, and a thin small old man carrying a walking stick stood right on top of it. Suddenly, another figure appeared by his side. He was another thin and small person garbed in loose green robe-World Ancestor. World Ancestor’s countenance gave off a natural tyrannical aura. After all, even Sacred Master could not injure his fleshy body at all. If World Ancestor decided to turn to the dark side, he would become a great devil.
Nevertheless, World Ancestor who was usually tyrannical was being respectful in front of this thin small old man. He bowed and greeted the other party: “Teacher, you have awakened. This disciple thought that it’ll be hard for me to see teacher again.” At this moment, World Ancestor could not hide his feelings at all. He was apparently extremely excited.
The thin small old man smiled as he stroked the head of World Ancestor.
The two of them were relatively similar in height. The thin and small old man chuckled: “You little devil. You are currently the famous World Ancestor, yet you are still acting like a child.”
“I am forever a disciple of Teacher.” World Ancestor was not recalcitrant or tyrannical at all. Instead, he was obedient. He did not have any livings relatives at all. They were all dead, and the only one alive was this teacher of his!
“Teacher, how did you suddenly wake up?” World Ancestor asked again. He was clear that his teacher was usually cultivating in his dream. According to logic, he should not be too willing to wake up if there were nothing remarkable.
“Because of that chap called Dong Bo Xue Ying.” The thin small old man said.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying?” World Ancestor was startled, “His talent is not bad.”
“That time, the other lineage inheritance of mine, the ‘four extreme inheritances’ are made purely to be fused into one. For the sake of allowing the body to fuse perfectly with the soul, that was why I created the ‘Vermillion Nightmare inheritance’ according to the Vermillion Nightmare mutated beast. Actually, I am not good at it.” The thin and small old man sighed, “Who would have that that this Dong Bo Xue Ying could actually create an unprecedented tenth transformation after cultivating this Vermillion Nightmare inheritance of mine.”
World Ancestor nodded softly after listening: “Mn, his illusory realm is quite formidable. Furthermore, he has contributed greatly, and has obtained quite a few pieces of information regarding the Destruction Devils.”
“The few of you all specialized in fleshy bodies.”
The thin small old man looked afar into the void. He was currently observing Xue Ying who was still seeking for Destruction Devils, “And he, he is the only one who specialized in the soul.”
“Teacher, are you prepared to receive him as a disciple and nurture him?” World Ancestor asked.
“I have this consideration.” The thin small old man giggled, “But I am not in a rush. I have just met him for the first time after waking up, and do not really know him well yet. I shall give him a few trials and put him under observation before I make my decision.”

chapters.title: Chapter 979 - Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 979: Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
World Ancestor was inwardly shocked because he was clear of his teacher’s temperament. His teacher had been relatively apathetic when he first imparted the inheritances to World Ancestor and Black Emperor. It was after living together in the days after did their relationship gradually deepened.
‘With teacher’s personality that is carefree, he did not object even when I publicized the devour-class lineage, producing many devils in the world. Even when he decided to select disciples, he would usually just impart some inheritances to them because of fate. Yet this time, he is being extremely prudent, and wants to conduct several trials for the other party?’ World Ancestor was inwardly shocked. The more serious his teacher was, the more he emphasized and favored Xue Ying.
The thin small old man looked afar: “Little devil, Dong Bo Xue Ying this young fellow is unique. I’ve met before many fellows, and have imparted to quite a few disciples… but you know that I ultimately specialized in the fleshy body. Those who are fated with me are usually those with strong fleshy bodies. This is still a first that the other party has such great attainments in the soul! Furthermore, his understanding of the illusory realm is beyond mine so I can’t help him much. Even if I were to accept him as a disciple, I am merely giving him an opportunity for him to grow.”
World Ancestor felt his heart leaping as he listened.
Opportunity…
It was indeed a great opportunity. His second disciple brother, ‘Black Emperor’, as well as their youngest junior brother had never gotten it before. Only World Ancestor with his highest potential had once been nurtured fully by his teacher.
Currently, his teacher had prepared ‘some’ opportunities for Xue Ying. It was clear there would not be just a single opportunity prepared for Xue Ying. Naturally, it was because his teacher could not guide Xue Ying in the aspect of the illusory realm; he could only provide opportunities to aid the other party.
“If he were to succeed, I as his teacher could have the chance of learning from him in the future.” The thin small old man chuckled and sighed, “I’ve trapped at this final step for so long. Somehow, I always feel I lack in the soul aspect. Even though I’ve created the ‘Dreamland Cultivation Technique’, and I haven’t gotten weary of it yet, that is to say, it could continue digging more potential from my body and allow me to cultivate and deduce for eternity, I still haven’t broken through.”
“Little Devil.”
The thin small old man looked at World Ancestor. His eyes were filled with complexities, “Many young fellows have been fated to meet me, yet each of them eventually returned back to nothingness. The Destruction Devils of this primal chaos void are becoming stronger too. The primal chaos void is also expanding continuously. Even though there is still a slightly longer period, the final apocalypse would still arrive, and everything will have to return back to nothingness. You should properly cultivate and take another step. Only then could you survive the great apocalypse.”
“This disciple will definitely do his best.” World Ancestor said solemnly.
“Reaching your current stage, all external strength is fabricated and useless. Ultimately, you can only depend on yourself.” The thin small old man shook his head. His body soon disappeared.
World Ancestor stood there silently.
He then took a step before leaving the vicinity.
******
Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World.
In ‘Azure Lightning City’ which spanned half a million kilometers, even though this was a relatively desolate city, the master was an expert at the fourth level and sufficed in lording a territory. Many cultivators had rushed into this city as a result, causing it to flourish.
Within a private room inside a luxurious restaurant.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was currently half-lying there. There were all sorts of delicacies and wine placed on the table in front of him. There were four elegant and refined beauties serving him. Some were massaging him, some were feeding him wine, and some were plucking fruits for him. And in front of him, there were musicians and dancers too. All of them were doing their best to serve this mysterious expert and did not dare to slight him at all.
Because…
During the earliest periods, two major killings by this expert generated terror across the highest layer of cultivators in this ‘Azure Lightning City’ towards Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.
‘It is too difficult to become a Cosmos God.’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master had a pair of scarlet eyebrows, and he gave off a murderous aura.
He would occasionally travel around the world in search of an opportunity to break through.
After all, he, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, had many treasures. Cosmos Gods were not willing to incur hatred with this undying Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master either. His days were spent quite comfortably, yet being stuck at the pinnacle of Primal Chaos realm made him unbearable.
‘Hmph hmph, when the number of Destruction Devils increased, by then, they will definitely come and seek me for help in searching for golden-armored graded Destruction Devils.’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master thought, ‘This is a rare chance for me to slaughter them and earn a huge amount of Origin World Rocks. By then after consuming half the amount, it will nourish my soul and possibly allow me to become a Cosmos God.’
Suddenly-
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master turned over. His gaze viewed through the obstacles of the room. His vision arrived at a white-robed teenager that teleported here. That white-robed teenager directly utilized a huge illusory realm! It was extremely sudden.
“Hong~”
The illusory realm covered an immense area. Furthermore, it was genuinely mysterious and unfathomable. In an instant, all beings within the entire city fell into the illusory realm. The beauties, the musicians and the dancers who were originally serving Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master had fallen into it too. This illusory realm naturally covered Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.
‘This is?’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’s expression slightly changed.
The terrifying illusory realm invaded him.
The world in front had warped and changed. The horrifying energy hauled his soul and tried dragging it into another illusory realm. The moment he fell into it, his life and death would fall under the control of the other party.
“Hmph.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master gritted his teeth. His willpower was like a blade as it tore through the illusory realm. But for the sake of resisting against it, he had to spend 70% of his heart energy.
“Mn?” And Xue Ying who had been searching for the Destruction Devils found out a person who could escape from his illusory realm. Nevertheless, he was able to recognize the other party with a glance.
“Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, please forgive me. I am currently…” Xue Ying had just finished transmitting his message.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying!”
When a roar came.
“Peng!”
The entire 50,000 kilometers around that restaurant exploded and turned into nothingness. This was the law domain of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.
The 50,000 kilometers area had entirely been destroyed, and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master stood in midair. Under that pair of scarlet eyebrowed, his cold eyes were staring at the distant Xue Ying: “You are truly arrogant to dare to act against me?”
Xue Ying’s expression changed. It seemed as if a layer of frost had covered his face and Xue Ying stared over at that region of 50,000 kilometers in length.
All living beings within this area had died.
“Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, aren’t you being too ruthless?” Xue Ying stared at the distant Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.
“I am here drinking yet you suddenly employed your illusory realm against me?” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master indignantly roared.
Xue Ying calmly replied: “I am currently conducting the mission assigned by the Cosmos Gods, searching for traces of the Destruction Devils within various places of the primal chaos void. For the sake of preventing the Destruction Devils from escaping after discovering me, I would be employing my illusory realm instantly after appearing at a location. Currently, with your strength, you are able to resist against me illusory realm easily, so there hasn’t been any damage down to you, why the need to kill all these innocent ordinary cultivators?”
“I want to kill them, so I killed them. Why? Feeling angry?” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master coldly laughed, “Then let Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster come and find me!”
Xue Ying was becoming angrier as he listened.
He always hated this Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master…
The other party was strong, yet he demanded a massive sum of Origin World Rocks just to search for Destruction Devils. Otherwise, he was not willing to do anything. One had to know that the Destruction Devils sought to annihilate the entire world, and according to logic, every single cultivator should be doing their part in dealing against this.
He, Xue Ying, might have cultivated for only a short period, but more than 99% of his time was spent searching for the Destruction Devils. He would occasionally meet Cosmos Gods when employing his illusory realm, yet none of them would blame him. Instead, they understood what Xue Ying was doing.
‘This Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.’ Xue Ying disliked the other party in the past, but now, just because of this minor matter, even after Xue Ying explained to him what had happened, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master had decided to kill all beings within the region of 50,000 kilometers.
Such violence.
He was entirely a huge devil. Xue Ying would undoubtedly kill the other party if he could!
It’s a pity that Xue Ying could not do so. Even Cosmos Gods could not because there were only two cultivators who succeeded in cultivating the Myriad Realm Tavern Master lineage. One was Myriad Realm Tavern Master, and the other was Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master. None was able to find where his avatars were. This enemy who was unkillable was someone Xue Ying felt helpless about too.
“You offended me, yet you do not know how to pay me for it.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master coldly laughed. His killing intent was becoming thicker.
“Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, I was ignorant, and do seek your forgiveness.” Xue Ying was enduring the fire in his heart. Even though he despised the other party, he decided to remain peaceful with him. After all, there was no point in becoming enemies with an undying madman.
“You think just by saying a sentence and everything will be fine?” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master coldly laughed, “You either take out 10,000 Origin World Rocks as an offer of apology, and we will let this matter be bygones. Otherwise, hmph hmph…”

chapters.title: Chapter 980 - Fight Hand in Hand
chapters.content:
Chapter 980: Fight Hand in Hand
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was stupified.
Even though he knew Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master had a peevish and tyrannical personality-the other party would even roar like a lion against a crowd of Cosmos Gods-this matter where the other party forced him to pay 10,000 Origin World Rocks just because of a minor affair was going overboard.
“Hmph.” Xue Ying couldn’t be bothered about this madman. He casually replied: “Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, I am still searching for Destruction Devils, so I’ll no longer accompany you.”
Saying that.
“You want to leave?” Following a roar of anger, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master turned into a blurred stream of blood light and shot towards Xue Ying. This puzzled Xue Ying. It seemed this Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master wanted to act against him?
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was currently filled with killing intent. He deliberately challenged the other party and asked for 10,000 Origin World Rocks actually because he wanted to fight with Xue Ying. He was even worried that Xue Ying would not use his full strength and thus continued challenging the other party: ‘This Dong Bo Xue Ying, I’ve heard that his Destruction Flower is very powerful. Furthermore, his illusory realm required me to redirect 70% of my heart energy to resist. He will definitely be a good training partner!’
‘I need this kind of life-threatening feeling. Who knows if I might gain some enlightenment under this pressure, allowing me to break through the last bottleneck and become a Cosmos God!’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’s eyes were brimming red.
At his current stage, becoming a Cosmos God was his strongest wish.
Want to become a Cosmos God? Fighting under sufficient threat would be the best tempering for him.
“Xiu.”
Xue Ying wanted to teleport away, yet he felt the surrounding space was congealed and he could not do so. He could only fly back rapidly: ‘This Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’s attainments in the void is so high that it is comparable to mine!’
As he flew back at high speed, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master leaped towards him as a stream of blood light.
One side was chasing the other, and the other was escaping. In the blink of an eye, they traveled across several ten million kilometers. Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was even inching closer to Xue Ying.
‘It seems he is slightly faster than me?’ Xue Ying was becoming more alert. Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’s figure was like a blood shadow-it appeared at times and disappeared at times. It was very similar to the ‘void-ification’ state.
“Hong!”
Xue Ying who was initially running stopped. An enormous fiery-red god bird, the ‘Vermillion Nightmare’ appeared behind his back. Its enormous wings covered the world, and countless scarlet aura began spreading out and covered that Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master. The illusory realm was continuously invading into the soul of the other party, causing Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master to frown slightly. By relying on ancient cultivation, this illusory realm would consistently strike out at the other party, and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master had to spend a huge amount of his heart energy to resist against it.
“No longer running?” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master stopped in midair, “Then receive my move.”
A strange circular wheel suddenly appeared in his hands. The wheel was translucent, and it was very thin, so thin that Xue Ying could not accurately determine its thickness, though he could deduce that it should be similar in scale to that of the black fog spherical hole.
This shocked Xue Ying; he began looking forward to it.
How strong was Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master? He was unquestionably at the ninth level. His combative techniques were unique too-the other party could escape anytime he wanted. None could obstruct him. He also had his mysterious avatars that others could not find traces of. Hence, his status was transcendental.
“Go.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master hurled out the circular wheel in his hand.
The translucent circular wheel arced through the sky.
It was incredibly thin.
This thinness was on the scale of the black fog spherical hole, causing it to become amazingly sharp, much more than many secret treasures. Everywhere it got through-even void-was cut. Xue Ying could ‘perceive’ that some of the black fog spherical bodies were being cut too. This was an extremely formidable technique that had reached the ninth level strength.
With a thought, Xue Ying made the nine-petaled flower descend.
The huge black flower bud descended and easily wrapped around that circular wheel. Many nine-petaled flowers directly enveloped that wheel. “Pu”, the circular wheel stealthily cut through a nine-petaled flower. As the flower was cut, it collapsed and exploded. This horrifying power shook the circular wheel, drastically reducing its strength. Just after cutting part of the second nine-petaled flower and the force of the circular wheel was dissipated entirely.
‘If not for his illusory realm, I would be able to employ multiple void wheels at the same time.’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master extended his two hands, causing a wheel weapon to appear in it. Both weapons were similarly thin. It seemed they were a pair of precious secret treasures which allowed Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master to exert a formidable force. During ordinary occasions when he fought against the enemies, he would usually be able to deal against them after employing multiple Void Wheels. But this time, due to the suppression from the tenth transformation of Vermillion Nightmare inheritance, 80% of his heart energy was suppressed, and he had to spend all his heart energy to maintain his close combat skills.
“Kill.”
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master continued flying towards Xue Ying.
Xue Ying waved his hands, causing a nine-petaled flower to directly descend over the other party. Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was extremely tyrannical. The wheel weapons in his hands rampantly struck out, easily cutting through the nine-petaled flowers.
‘The nine-petaled flowers could restrict the enemy, but it is still best in terms of destruction. The flowers are able to restrict those ninth level Destruction Devils, but they are too weak when facing Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.’ Xue Ying thought. The Void Wheels employed by Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master were ninth level techniques. Currently, by relying on his pair of secret wheel treasures, he became stronger.
“Destroy.”
Xue Ying let out a thought.
“Hong!””Hong!””Hong!””Hong!””Hong!””Hong!”
One after another brilliant nine-petaled flower began blossoming before exploding. Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master could not help but roar indignantly. He was continuously rushing out and withstanding against the power of the destruction. He was even forced to use his weapons to defend against them.
Xue Ying’s nine-petaled flowers were endless. During their destruction, new ones would descend again.
‘I could not win?’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master felt helpless. Even though he wanted to temper himself by fighting with Xue Ying, he similarly wanted to win! He had never been defeated for a long time. He naturally recognized that he had great talent, and he had never placed any Primal Chaos giants in his eyes before. Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master even belittled the Cosmos Gods.
In his opinion, they were all fools who would die in the great apocalypse.
He was proud of this lineage inheritance of his! And he felt that he was powerful. Nevertheless, he could not win this battle today.
‘If not for 80% of my heart energy being influenced, how would I not be able to destroy these petals.’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master gritted his teeth. Closely following that, he looked at the white-robed teenager just outside the many rotating translucent black flower petals.
He was defeated.
Even though he was not willing to accept it, he understood deep in his heart that the illusory realm was also part of Xue Ying’s strength. The other party did not rely on any secret treasures at all!
‘He is indeed amazing.’ Xue Ying looked afar and could not help but praise the other party, ‘He might be completely suppressed by me, and even though he could not kill his way out of the nine-petaled flowers, the destruction of the nine-petaled flowers could not injure him at all. His pair of weapons are great at defending, and his attainments in void-ification are quite high too-it seems much higher than mine?’
Xue Ying felt that his void-ification methods were quite formidable already.
After all, he had reached the 50th level of Walker’s Hidden Secret and also studied the inheritance left behind by Monarch Nine Cloud and the scaled armor left behind by General Mo Gu, allowing Xue Ying’s current void-ification technique to be quite formidable. But it seemed he was still slightly weaker than Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.

chapters.title: Chapter 981 - Shocking
chapters.content:
Chapter 981: Shocking
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master stopped. He stared coldly at the distant Xue Ying and occasionally used the wheels in his hands to resist against the destructive power. He did not attack the other party. He might remain cold and calm on the outside, though he was contemplating over the previous battle in his heart: ‘My capabilities of using the Void Wheels haven’t reached the limit. Otherwise, those black flower buds of his would not be able to withstand it. During the collapse and explosion of the flowers, the energy spreads out in all directions, preventing me from evading it at all. I must at least withstand this impact using my Void Wheels.’
There was also detailed information on the inheritance he got racing through his brain.
He was continually cross-referencing, and gradually, he was getting some understanding.
Xue Ying stopped after seeing this. Many Destruction Flowers began dissipating and returned to the world.
“You are indeed the strongest cultivator in the illusory realm. Very formidable. If not for your illusory realm technique, I could easily defeat you.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master coldly said.
“Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’s void techniques are quite formidable too.” Xue Ying praised a sentence before looking at his surroundings. He had just rapidly traveled tens of millions of kilometers away to prevent the battle from affecting the innocent cultivators living in the city. Only those beings at the earliest period where Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master erupted in anger were killed.
“I still have some urgent matters and will no longer accompany you.” Xue Ying said. At the same time, the space beside distorted. He took a step before leaving.
It was best if he distanced himself from this madman.
An undying madman, if he was unpleased, Xue Ying could only temporarily cast it aside.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was initially talking to Xue Ying while recounting the previous battle, yet when he saw Xue Ying leaving with his ultra-long distance teleportation, his expression changed.
He looked at the void in front with disbelief.
That void had already regained its usual peace. But his perception of the void was extremely formidable; he distinctly remembered the fluctuations formed when Xue Ying employed the ultra-long distance teleportation.
“This, this is…” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was filled with disbelief, “This is the teleportation technique belonging to our lineage. He, how could he use it?”
He was too familiar with it.
Their lineage inheritance was extremely secretive.
In the entire primal chaos void, there were only two who had this inheritance. One was Myriad Realm Tavern Master, and the other was Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master! Hence, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master naturally was proud of it. He even disdained upon those Cosmos Gods who were stronger than him. His pride naturally originated from this inheritance he had. In his eyes, his inheritance transcended beyond all cultivation systems!
What ancient cultivation, laws and profound mysteries system, hex cultivation, devour-class system, strongest warrior system, …
They were far outclassed from his inheritance.
His inheritance suppressed all other inheritances!
This inheritance enabled him, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master to have a unique teleportation technique, and could even form incarnations easily! He could easily appear at any location in the primal chaos void. Furthermore, he had his avatars too. His avatars could hide, and no tracing techniques could find them. His combat strength was similarly horrifying, and he was ranked at the forefront amongst those of the ninth level.
He and Myriad Realm Tavern Master both had unique statuses.
But now when he discovered Xue Ying employing the teleportation technique of their lineage…!
‘How could he have learned it? Impossible! Teacher isn’t in this primal chaos void at all. Our lineage only consists of Disciple Brother Myriad Tavern and me. Even though we will also impart to other disciples, we only impart the most fundamental techniques, and those who haven’t cultivated to a sufficient level and without teacher’s agreement will never learn the core inheritance. How did he learn the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique ?’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master became slightly panicked. He was outraged too.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was clear.
Those ancient cultivators might be able to teleport through ultra-long distance, but it seemed similar to how the Lost World Corridor was built. Hence, not just the ancient cultivators, even Void Primogenitors had to use their true bodies to employ this technique within the Lost World Corridor! Because the consumption of their techniques was too high, their incarnations could not employ it.
But this lineage that Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master belonged to had the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique. When one comprehended it, its consumption of heart energy was minimal, and even his incarnations could easily use it.
‘If his incarnations could use it, then doesn’t that mean that his incarnations could find the golden-armored graded lairs already?’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was infuriated. He was even becoming slightly anxious.
From his opinion.
As the threat from the Destruction Devils became greater, those Cosmos Gods would eventually lower their hearts in front of him, and ask him to search for those Destruction Devils! Because his senior disciple brother ‘Myriad Realm Tavern Master’ was already a Cosmos God and was not in a rush. He had discussed with his senior disciple brother before, and Myriad Realm Tavern Master agreed not to snatch away this massive chance at the business of his. He had already sharpened his sword and was ready to slaughter the Cosmos Gods ruthlessly.
How could he let things go without getting a few million to 10 million Origin World Rocks?
But now that Xue Ying could similarly employ this technique, and given his personality of searching for Destruction Devils diligently across the primal chaos void, would he not be willing to find the golden-armored graded lairs willingly without wanting any Origin World Rocks?
‘No, this matter must never happen.’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’s eyes were filled with a murderous light. If he deliberately challenged the other party purely for a battle, then now, he was genuinely anxious and was filled with killing intent.
The void distorted by the side.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master took a step in before disappearing from the place.
His ultra-long distance teleportation was precisely the same as Xue Ying’s!
…
Within the closest megacity, there was a Myriad Tavern.
The Myriad Tavern was spread across many regions in the primal chaos void. Every single Myriad Tavern had an old man situated within, and all these old men looked exactly the same. Their aura was the same too, and were avatars of the Cosmos God ‘Myriad Realm Tavern Master’. None was able to find out how many avatars he had.
“Sou.”
Because the distance was close, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master could directly teleport into this tavern. Other than the old man who was lying on the chair sleeping, there was not a single guest. Because the price of eating at the ‘Myriad Tavern’ was too exaggerated, and even the food ‘bought’ was poor, none would enter without ‘special reasons’.
“Mn?” The old man who was deep in sleep gradually opened his eyes. He glanced at Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master who appeared before chuckling: “Isn’t this Scarlet-Browed? Why did you appear at my place so suddenly?”
“Senior Disciple Brother, there is trouble.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master said.
“Trouble? What trouble?” The old man sat up as if he wasn’t too mindful of it. He was different from his junior disciple brother Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master and had long become a Cosmos God. He could watch this world enter apocalypse calmly. His junior disciple brother ‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’ was comparatively more anxious.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master said: “You did not impart the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique which is part of our lineage’s core inheritance to any other disciples right?”
“How would I dare to impart the core inheritance without teacher’s agreement?” The old man shook his head.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master solemnly said: “Neither did I. But, it seemed that Dong Bo Xue Ying from Great Void Heaven Temple knows how to employ this Destructive Realm Teleportation technique of ours.”
“What?”
The old man was shocked.
This Destructive Realm Teleportation technique belonged to the most commonly seen technique of this core lineage inheritance of theirs.
For instance, even though both he and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master belonged to the same lineage, in reality, they went in two different directions! Just like how ‘Black Emperor’ and World Ancestor were also cultivated in two different directions.
Nevertheless, this Destructive Realm Teleportation technique was something both of them knew. This was the most fundamental technique meant for traveling.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying?” The old man did not dare believe, “He is at the Primal Chaos realm so how did he learn this Destructive Realm Teleportation technique? It is impossible for Teacher to be in our primal chaos void. If Teacher were to come, I’d be able to sense it at the first instance!”
“Right. I suspect that he has relied on his illusory realm to obtain the most fundamental cultivation technique from our disciples. According to our fundamental cultivation technique… he has deduced this Destructive Realm Teleportation technique of ours.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was filled with killing intent, “There are too many superpowers in this primal chaos void who wanted to learn this lineage inheritance of ours. Those Cosmos Gods coveted this lineage inheritance of ours, and this Dong Bo Xue Ying actually has such a comprehension ability to steal our fundamental technique and deduce the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique out. We must absolutely not allow him to live through! If he were to live, there would likely be more people learning it. We must kill him!”

chapters.title: Chapter 982 - Interrogation
chapters.content:
Chapter 982: Interrogation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The old man frowned before softly nodding: “I’ve heard that Dong Bo Xue Ying has become the cultivator with the strongest illusory realm technique. By relying on that, he can easily interrogate and obtain the fundamental cultivation technique from our lineage… this is something I believe in! But just by relying on the fundamental technique, how is it possible to deduce our Destructive Realm Teleportation technique from it? That time, my realm has reached a sufficient stage, and only after being imparted the technique by Teacher was I able to learn it. How could he rely on himself to deduce it?”
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master anxiously responded: “That Dong Bo Xue Ying has an extremely high talent. How long has he cultivated to reach his current realm? With his comprehension ability, it isn’t entirely impossible for him to deduce everything.”
“Mn. Indeed, he has a great talent.” Myriad Realm Tavern Master remained doubtful.
Depending on himself to deduce the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique?
According to his understanding, only their teacher could rely on himself to create this Destructive Realm Teleportation technique. His teacher was an outstanding cultivator. The other cultivator who could achieve this would be Monarch Nine Cloud, though he had died. Monarch Nine Cloud was the only Cosmos God at that time to break through using the Dao of Void. Furthermore, he had reached the second level of Cosmos God. With such a thick foundation and experience, Myriad Tavern Realm Tavern Master believed it was possible for the other party to deduce this Destructive Realm Teleportation technique from scratch.
But just a mere Primal Chaos Xue Ying could deduce it? That was too unfathomable!
Learning a secret technique was comparatively easy. After all, the precedents would employ this technique in public! But it was far too hard trying to re-create this Destructive Realm Teleportation technique.
“According to my knowledge, Monarch Nine Cloud could employ it in the past too.” Myriad Realm Tavern Master said, “Is it possible for him to learn from Monarch Nine Cloud?”
“Hmph.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master coldly snorted, “Is it important where he learned it from? No! More importantly, after Monarch Nine Cloud died, the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique is something only our lineage has! Now that Dong Bo Xue Ying has it, it is no longer a unique technique for our lineage. If Teacher is around, he would likely desire to exterminate this Dong bo Xue Ying too.”
Myriad Realm Tavern Master nodded.
He agreed with what his junior disciple brother said.
Of the three of them, teacher and disciples, Myriad Realm Tavern Master had the best personality. But he still created the ‘Myriad Realm Tavern Master’ regardless, letting countless cultivators take on missions as assassins and go around killing others. His personality was cold, though he had transcended beyond that. He wasn’t too willing to argue and fight with the various superpowers. But this ‘Destructive Realm Teleportation technique’, with his teacher’s temper, he would similarly want to exterminate Xue Ying. Being his disciple, it would be his obligation to follow through with it.
“Mn, I’ll have a look later on and determine if he knows the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique. Once it is confirmed, I’ll definitely find an opportunity to eliminate him.” Myriad Realm Tavern Master said.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master revealed a sinister grin.
Once Xue Ying was eliminated, the Cosmos Gods could only come and beg him for help!
…
After a moment.
Myriad Realm Tavern Master soon found where Xue Ying was. By relying on his avatars, he could easily spy on Xue Ying from afar.
“Hu.”
A white-robed Xue Ying was currently in a secretive cavern-dwelling inside the primal chaos void. He was presently unleashing his illusory realm to scout the region. After he ascertained that there were no Destruction Devils, Xue Ying began searching his surroundings for the next destination. Once he found out where it was, Xue Ying would use ultra-long distance teleportation to travel closer to his target. One could see the void distorting before Xue Ying disappeared.
Xue Ying was still chasing after the devils blindly.
And Myriad Realm Tavern Master’s avatar was stealthily spying at Xue Ying.
“Destructive Realm Teleportation technique.” Myriad Realm Tavern Master’s old expression was becoming colder as he observed, “It is indeed the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique.” He was 100% certain.
Myriad Realm Tavern Master opened his eyes and looked towards Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.
“Senior disciple brother, how is it?” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master asked.
“He is indeed employing the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique. We should eliminate him.” Myriad Realm Tavern Master continued, “But you should interrogate him face to face and determine if he had deduced the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique from the fundamental techniques which he obtained using his illusory realm, or that he learned it from Monarch Nine Cloud. We will try our best to eliminate that inheritance of theirs. Even though Xue Ying had grasped part of it, it’ll be good if we could eliminate it as soon as possible.”
“Mn.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master nodded. Xue Ying was indeed proceeding along an actual Dao path. Given enough time, Xue Ying might be able to create an inheritance similar to this lineage of theirs.
******
In the blink of an eye, several days passed.
In a desolate wilderness.
Xue Ying appeared here. He directly brought his illusory realm down, enveloping over the concealed underground cavern-dwelling located in the distant.
“Mn?” Xue Ying’s expression suddenly changed as he turned towards a location not far away. There, a figure appeared from a warped space. He was Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master who was currently emanating a cold murderous aura. Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master stood in mid-air staring at Xue Ying coldly. He shouted: “Palace Master Dong Bo, you are too shameless.”
“Shameless?” Xue Ying was startled.
“Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, you say that I am shameless?” Xue Ying felt puzzled, “What did I do? Just because I used the illusory realm against you the previous time?”
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master carefully observed Xue Ying’s expression. If he were to procure the fundamental techniques by relying on his illusory realm on the ordinary disciples, at this moment when Xue Ying was being questioned, he should have fallen into the pit trap. Naturally, he did not exclude the possibility of Xue Ying being able to disguise his expressions.
“I am not talking about this matter. I can’t even be bothered about how you are using your illusory realm in search of the Destruction Devils. But, do you think nobody knows about what you did?” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master sneered, “Previously, I’ve teleported over through an ultra-long distance. Seeing my teleportation technique, unless you are still trying to justify yourself?”
Xue Ying was stunned.
Teleportation?
That’s right.
His memory was perfect. Previously when Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master teleported over, the distorting void indeed left behind the exact same impression as the ultra-long distance teleportation which Xue Ying employed. Both relied on the black fog spherical holes to teleport, thus producing a relatively small disturbance in the surroundings.
“I believe many people in the primal chaos void and five great sacred worlds knows this ultra-long distance teleportation of mine too.” Xue Ying shook his head, “I have been using it many times in the Void Castle too. This is a technique of talent which I learned through ancient cultivation after breaking through to the Primal Chaos realm. Why, are you questioning my talent in the ancient cultivation?”
“Ancient cultivation talent? What a joke!” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master pointed at Xue Ying and roared, “This is the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique which is unique to our lineage inheritance. The ancient cultivation talent is bestowed upon by the supreme law, and what it bestows are within the boundary of the supreme law. The Destructive Realm Teleportation technique is created using laws beyond the primal chaos void, so how can it be bestowed by the supreme law? What rubbish are you spouting?”
Xue Ying shook his head: “This is something I do not know. There are all kinds of bizarre ancient cultivation talents. Even talents that could minutely alter the past have appeared! And there are even talents that could prophesize the future. So what about this teleportation talent of mine? As for what Destructive Realm Teleportation technique you mentioned? This is the first time I heard of it.”
“So are you implying that you did not steal our teleportation technique by relying on your illusory realm?” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master sneered.
“Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, I do not have time to chat with you.” Xue Ying immediately prepared to leave. There was no point replying.
“Did you learn this teleportation technique from Monarch Nine Cloud?” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master suddenly asked.
Xue Ying’s figure did not stop. He directly teleported away.
Xue Ying first traveled across a far distance to hide. He stood in the vast wilderness. Many thoughts began brewing in his heart: ‘I thought that I will no longer leave behind gaps as to where I learned this technique after reaching the Primal Chaos realm. But those belonging to the lineage of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master seems to have a deeper understanding of this. He even mentioned about how the ancient cultivation talent is bestowed by the supreme law, and this technique is based on laws beyond the primal chaos void, which meant that it is impossible for the supreme law to bestow it? It seems that the inheritance belonging to his lineage inheritance has a deep understanding of the primal chaos void.’
Even though it was slightly troublesome, Xue Ying did not fear it either.
Reaching his level, there were not many things that would make him afraid.
Just when Xue Ying was about to teleport through an ultra-long distance, he felt a strand of killing intent entering his law domain, causing his heart to tighten.

chapters.title: Chapter 983 - Myriad Tavern Master’s Assassination
chapters.content:
Chapter 983: Myriad Tavern Master’s Assassination
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying’s law domain was established using the structure from the illusory realm. Being the strongest expert in the illusory realm within the primal chaos void, few could permeate into his law domain stealthily! The region surrounding Xue Ying at a distance of 50,000 kilometers would have an unseen law domain covering it just like a real world being wrapped with a layer of illusory realm.
“Hua~” During the moment the enemy struck, Xue Ying’s law domain was also activated.
The surrounding region of 50,000 kilometers immediately became grotesque and variegated. Many layers became distorted. Xue Ying was located at the deepest region with many layers of world stacked on top of one another.
On the surface of the formerly peaceful wilderness, an old man warped out. A wild beast that was initially flying far away had distorted into an old man too. A short tree amidst the desolate wild had also become an old man. Another old man had also appeared from deep underground. Many old men were emerging, with a total of more than a thousand old men killing their way into the law domain.
Their appearances were precisely the same. It seemed as if he did not have a single real body.
“Myriad Tavern Master!” Xue Ying was much shocked.
“I was actually discovered.” Myriad Tavern Master was slightly astonished too. This inheritance belonging to his teacher’s lineage was geared towards the fleshy body. As a result, he could form many avatars, though his attainments in the void were weaker, and had not reached the ‘pinnacle of void-ification’. If he had achieved that, it would be similar to the Destruction Devils that had the shadowless talent, and he could stealthily appear by the side of Xue Ying without the other party discovering him.
There would be losses when there were gains.
He chose this road of owning many avatars, allowing him to not fear for the great apocalypse of the primal chaos void. He was not even afraid when facing a horrifying existence like Sacred Master.
Nevertheless, he was slightly weaker in combat. His junior disciple brother ‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’ chose a path that was stronger in battle, though he was stuck at the Primal Chaos realm.
“Hong.”
As Xue Ying discovered the other party, an enormous fiery-red god bird, Vermillion Nightmare, appeared. It began flapping its wings, causing a fiery-red airstream to diffuse around the surrounding. Many illusory realms started descending down the whole region, with every single avatar of Myriad Tavern Master being affected.
‘Even though he has more than a thousand avatars, it seems that every one of them is weak? Even weaker than me?’ Xue Ying muttered inwardly. That’s right too. If every single avatar contained an ordinary Cosmos God power, then Myriad Tavern Master would be unparalleled. In reality, he was never known for his combat power. Even World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer were stronger than him.
His illusory realm might be strong, but Myriad Tavern Master could easily resist against it. Naturally, he had to fork out part of his heart energy to resist against it.
“Kill.” The more than a thousand old men began invading the region of 50,000 kilometers from different positions. Suddenly, every single old man became distorted and blurred.
A huge head that covered the world appeared. It spanned a total of five million kilometers and also enveloped Xue Ying’s illusory realm domain. As he opened his mouth, endless darkness appeared as it sucked in Xue Ying.
“Hua hua hua~”
Many huge black flower buds appeared.
Because Xue Ying had previously absorbed the energy from quite a few dead Destruction Devils-significantly nourishing his soul-he could now unleash eight nine-petaled flowers while maintaining the tenth transformation of Vermillion Nightmare.
Each nine-petaled flower wrapped around another and the white-robed Xue Ying was located at its innermost. Xue Ying had also activated the two secret treasures he had. As the 12 Primal Beads Bracelet was activated, many layers of light stacked around his body. At the same time, the white robe Xue Ying was wearing had emitted a golden light too. There was even blue light on the surface of his body.
Myriad Tavern Master’s enormous head merely sucked in, causing everything in half a million kilometers region to be devoured. The surroundings of Xue Ying fell into darkness, though he was not panicking at all.
He was still under the protection of the two great secret treasures. Furthermore, Xue Ying’s law domain had been entirely activated.
And even under the envelopment of the illusory realm, eight flowers were protecting him too.
“Chi chi chi~” Many strands of white light appeared amidst the darkness as they dealt against the nine-petaled flowers that were protecting Xue Ying. As those strands of white land forced their way over, they penetrated through the layers of world membranes, with 30% of its original might being consumed. Even though the nine-petaled flowers were firm, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master could easily cut through it, much less this killing move of Myriad Tavern Master who was the leader of the biggest assassination organization in the primal chaos void.
The strands of white light rapidly crossed through the petals of the nine-petaled flowers, causing those flowers to collapse. But at the same time when they collapsed, new nine-petaled flowers were constantly appearing around Xue Ying. Nevertheless, those strands of white light traversed at such rapid speed that in the blink of an eye, it crossed through 11 layers of nine-petaled flowers (with three layers being formed after that).
“Weng.” Xue Ying remained standing there calmly. The 12 layers of light stood firm. Under the assault of the white light, just two layers of light were broken through before the white light dissipated.
“Just with these techniques?” Xue Ying looked at the endless darkness around him.
Even though describing this technique was slow, it happened within an instance.
But Xue Ying had sufficient time to leave with his ultra-long distance teleportation since this killing move could not eliminate him from the start. Hence, Xue Ying was relaxed.
‘The protective secret treasure bestowed by Ancestor Sorcerer and the others is extraordinary.’ Xue Ying thought.
Ancestor Sorcerer and the others had mentioned before.
Only Sacred Master could rapidly break through the protection of the 12 Primal Beads Bracelet.
As for Myriad Tavern Master? Xue Ying felt that he could still survive from this wave of killing move even if he did not rely on his secret treasures! Naturally, believing it was one thing. He would not remain so foolish to not use the two secret treasures.
“Hua.” An old man appeared amidst the surrounding endless darkness. He was Myriad Tavern Master.
“This is the secret treasure newly refined by Ancestor Sorcerer?” Myriad Tavern Master looked at the 12 layers of light on the surface of Xue Ying. After crossing through the illusory realm worlds and the nine-petaled flowers, only 60% of the original strength of his killing move was left! Myriad Tavern Master understood that he would take some time trying to break through the light films after feeling its strength. Furthermore, this killing move of his required time to store. He had already stored enough energy when he was hiding in the dark to unleash this single wave of assassination move.
Xue Ying would have long used his Destructive Realm Teleportation technique to escape when Myriad Tavern Master charged up his attack after the first failure of the assassination.
Hence… Myriad Tavern Master understood that he failed.
“Right.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Seems like Ancestor Sorcerer and the others favor you a lot.” Myriad Tavern Master said, “Let me ask you, where did you learn this Destructive Realm Teleportation technique of yours?”
“Ancient cultivation talent.” Xue Ying said.
“Impossible.” Myriad Tavern Master shook his head, It is impossible for this talent to be bestowed by the supreme law.”
“Oh? Is that so? Unless you all have grasped the supreme law and are so certain of it?” Xue Ying retorted.
Myriad Tavern Master was startled.
Grasped the supreme law?
Let’s not talk about him, even his teacher, the creator of this lineage had not reached that stage. It was too difficult trying to grasp the supreme law.
‘What this Dong Bo Xue Ying said is logical too. Without grasping the supreme law, maybe what teacher deduced is not right too? Unless there is really an ancient cultivation talent that has this Destructive Realm Teleportation technique?’ Myriad Tavern Master thought, ‘But the possibility of deducing something wrong is very low once one cultivated to where Teacher is.’
Previously, he felt that Xue Ying could have deduced this teleportation technique after stealing the fundamental technique from their lineage. Or he might have learned it from Monarch Nine Cloud. But now, he felt that there existed a tiny possibility-that it was indeed from an ancient cultivation talent!
The supreme law was ultimately too hard to comprehend.
“Many thanks to Myriad Tavern Master for letting me experience your assassination.” Xue Ying chuckled. The void by the side distorted and he disappeared after taking a step through.
…
Within the wilderness.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was watching everything from afar. Following that, the disturbances had died down, and an old man appeared by his side.
“Senior disciple brother.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master looked at the old man.
“Failed.” The old man shook his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 984 - Borrowing a Blade
chapters.content:
Chapter 984: Borrowing a Blade
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“How could you fail? Senior disciple brother, you aren’t able to eliminate Dong Bo Xue Ying?” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master anxiously asked. His senior disciple brother cultivated in the direction towards strengthening the fleshy body. He had many avatars and had heaven-defying survival capabilities. Nonetheless, his assassination technique should still be considered at the peak of the first level of Cosmos God, yet he could not eliminate this Primal Chaos existence?
Myriad Realm Tavern Master shook his head: “Scarlet-Browed, this Dong Bo Xue Ying has two great secret treasures. In addition to his illusory realm technique, it is too difficult trying to assassinate him. Even World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer could not do it. I am different from you. You specialized more in void-ification and close combat. If you could become a Cosmos God, you should be able to get close and assassinate him before he became aware.”
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master felt frustrated and helpless as he heard that.
In his opinion, his senior disciple brother was truly trash! In the past, his senior disciple brother had chosen the path with the strongest survival capabilities, and it was practically impossible to kill him.
But this lineage of theirs had sufficient basic survival techniques. He, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master might be weaker in his survival capabilities, but if he were to become a Cosmos God, he would reach the pinnacle of void-ification! Furthermore, he had his avatar techniques too and could create nine great avatars at once. By then, he would be able to threaten several second-level Cosmos Gods with his assassination techniques.
Nevertheless, these nine great avatars with the pinnacle of void-ification would still die in front of the ‘great apocalypse of primal chaos void’! But with his teacher’s help, he could avoid from that final calamity.
‘Truly trash. He only knows how to survive, and is so weak. Isn’t it fine if I asked my teacher for help during the great apocalypse of the primal chaos void?’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master thought.
Myriad Realm Tavern Master’s actions had given a clear conclusion-Scarlet-Browed had to rely on himself.
Myriad Realm Tavern Master might be cold and selfish, but he wasn’t too ambitious.
‘It is fine if you are afraid of death. But now, you are even disrupting my affair.’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master felt slightly anxious.
If Xue Ying did not die, would the Cosmos Gods ever find him to seek for golden-armored graded lairs?
“Senior disciple brother, I want to contact Teacher.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master said.
“Contact teacher?” Myriad Realm Tavern Master felt astonished.
“Mn.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master nodded, “We cannot let this Dong Bo Xue Ying live as he wants. If he lives, there will be more people knowing the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique. Who knows if there might be a day that he could research the avatar technique out too.”
“Then you contact.” Myriad Realm Tavern Master said. He understood what his junior disciple brother was thinking-he was doing all these for Origin World Rocks. He knew his junior disciple brother was proud and was entirely different from him who was not as ambitious.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master nodded.
“Weng-”
Both disciple brothers had a way of contacting their teacher, and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master remained relatively respectful when he was facing his teacher.
Because he was vastly different from his senior disciple brother. His senior disciple brother could remain free and unfettered even if he did not rely on his teacher. He, on the other hand, had to depend on his teacher for help. Naturally, he would try to pamper to his wishes.
“Hua~”
An unseen fluctuation descended in the surroundings, causing the supreme law to withdraw.
A transparent figure appeared. It was a bird-headed humanoid figure. His voice resounded in the surroundings: “Myriad Realm, Scarlet-Browed, the two of you are finding me for?”
“Teacher.” Myriad Realm Tavern Master greeted relatively politely. This gratitude towards his teacher for guiding him was something he naturally respected.
“Teacher, we have a cultivator in our primal chaos void called Dong Bo Xue Ying. He is actually able to employ the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique. I suspect that he has obtained the fundamental techniques of our lineage by relying on his illusory realm to interrogate our disciples. After that…” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master immediately began illustrating the situation.
After listening to the explanation, the transparent figure replied nonchalantly: “Kill? If you all want to kill, then just kill! There is no need to ask me for permission.”
“Senior disciple brother has failed in assassinating the other party. We are temporarily out of ideas.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master said.
“This primal chaos void of yours would curb my strength, and there is no way for me to help. If there are no other matters, I’ll leave first.” The transparent figure coldly said.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master hesitated momentarily. He did not dare to ask any further.
He was clear of his teacher’s temper. Since his teacher did not promise him, then persuading his teacher would only make the other party unhappy. He naturally was clear of his teacher’s temper since he could coax his teacher happy.
“My senior disciple brother and I will think of more ways. May we bid teacher farewell.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master politely bowed. In the end, he had pulled his senior disciple brother in, expressing that this was the idea of the two of them.
“May we bid teacher farewell.” Myriad Realm Tavern Master went along. He was quite indifferent towards being used by his junior disciple brother.
Since his strength was different, his attitude was different too.
Myriad Realm Tavern Master was someone who could watch the primal chaos void get destroyed indifferently. Hence, he had once chuckled about those minor thoughts of his junior disciple brother.
“Properly cultivate. It’ll be good for you to become a Cosmos God as soon as possible.” The transparent figure stated before disappearing.
And this piece of desolate wilderness was left with just Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.
“Junior disciple brother, Teacher would be suppressed in this primal chaos void and could not help us at all. I can’t kill Dong Bo Xue Ying either.” After Myriad Realm Tavern Master finished saying that, he disappeared.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was left alone in the desolate wilderness. His expression was cold and solemn.
‘Couldn’t help me? Suppressed by the primal chaos void? Old man! You are too stingy! Why not just bestow upon me a piece of formidable void-related secret treasure. I do not believe I can’t kill that Dong Bo Xue Ying with it.’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master felt frustrated. He was clear how deep the foundations of his teacher was. It was assured that he had many ways of killing Xue Ying despite being suppressed by the primal chaos void.
It was only his teacher was not willing to pay the sufficient price.
Clearly, his teacher was too lazy to spare the effort and energy for just a brat at the Primal Chaos realm. Furthermore, his teacher was too proud and aloof. Regardless of how much Xue Ying had learned from Monarch Nine Cloud, it was merely deduction based on the fundamental techniques, and he could not care less about it.
Because this lineage of his was wide-ranging and profound. He did not believe that Xue Ying could deduce many theories out without getting the actual inheritance! After all, when Monarch Nine Cloud died, he was still unable to deduce the avatar technique! One had to know that the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique and the avatar technique were merely the fundamentals of this lineage of his! Even Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master knew the avatar technique.
…
After Xue Ying suffered from assassination, he directly teleported back to the Great Void Heaven Temple.
Within the Great Void Heaven Temple, both Void Primogenitor and Ancestor Sorcerer had their incarnations staying here at Xue Ying’s place. They were both researching that scaled-armor left behind by General Mo Gu. Using the words of Void Primogenitor: “It is truly mystical! The void-ification inherent in this scaled armor is very simplistic. If I were to research its method out, I might be able to improve my control of the void.” He was clearly engrossed in it.
As for Ancestor Sorcerer? He was someone who loved researching all mysterious items. ‘Pinnacle of void-ification’? Ancestor Sorcerer also coveted it, and also wished to imprint the mysterious veins on this scaled armor onto his body, allowing him to gain this technique. By then, he would be confident of fighting against Sacred Master.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, how is your research coming along?” Ancestor Sorcerer’s incarnation walked towards Xue Ying passionately shouting out.
“I have gained some understanding of it.” Xue Ying walked over.
Ancestor Sorcerer was extremely delighted to discuss with Xue Ying on that.
This assassination had forced Xue Ying to reflect on many things. He had even sent the orders for his wife and children not to leave the Great Void Heaven Temple temporarily without his permission.
…
Time passed.
The Heaven Green World of the primal chaos void, also the territory of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.
There was a cold, lonely palace constructed on top of the mountain peak.
There were only about a dozen female attendants within. It was considered very few. Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was seated by himself on top of the throne. His vision cast through the palace doors and into the vast primal chaos void.
‘Dong Bo Xue Ying.’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master had been thinking of ways.
He had to eliminate the other party.
Otherwise, his plan would fail. And that voluminous amount of Origin World Rocks would be no more!
‘He has two protective secret treasures? Senior disciple brother said that even World Ancestor and Ancestor Mother could hardly kill him. There is only Sacred Master who could kill him?’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master did not dare believe it, ‘That group of Cosmos Gods actually favored this Dong Bo Xue Ying so much that they treated him so well?’
He did not know…
That of the many ‘kings’ suspected to be hiding within the world of the cultivators, Xue Ying was the one risking his life in search of them. They would naturally provide these survival treasures to Xue Ying. That time when Xue Ying found a golden-armored graded lair, it had increased Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor’s favorability towards him. Naturally, they would take out the most appropriate survival treasures for a Primal Chaos existence out.
‘What should I do?’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was deep in thoughts.
He always had a way, just that he was hesitating because it would involve riling an extremely horrifying existence.
‘I can’t think of any other methods. The best idea would be to make use of Sacred Master to kill Dong Bo Xue Ying.’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’s eyes were cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 985 - This Blade called ‘Sacred Master’
chapters.content:
Chapter 985: This Blade called ‘Sacred Master’
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
It was too easy for him to make use of Sacred Master because all Cosmos Gods coveted this inheritance of theirs. And the strongest expert in the primal chaos void, ‘Sacred Master’, was the most greedy of them all. He once tried all kinds of ways. That time, he would either threaten or entice and even personally killed Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master before.
Nonetheless, it’s a pity for Sacred Master since those who could obtain the core inheritance of this lineage would have to first train the ‘avatar technique’. Hence, it was near impossible for Sacred Master to obtain their true core inheritance.
Even Sacred Master who was powerful did not specialize in everything. He could not even unravel the techniques left behind by Monarch Nine Cloud.
‘Sacred Master. He has always desired to acquire our lineage. If he knows that Dong Bo Xue Ying has deduced part of the inheritance…’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master coldly laughed, ‘He would likely act.’
It’s just that because he had been killed by the Sacred Master before, that was why he wasn’t too willing to rile up the other party.
But this time, he no longer cared. He had to borrow this ‘blade’ known as Sacred Master.
…
In the dark palace hall.
The calm lake water gradually coagulated and turned into a watery figure. There was silver light revolving about its surface. He was none other than ‘Master Jia Ming’ who had an extremely high status within the Ancient Sacred Religion. Master Jia Ming was someone at the ninth level strength and specialized in searching for traces. Furthermore, he could prophesize the future, earning the great favorability of Sacred Master, and for him to be entrusted with great responsibility.
“Master Jia Ming.” A black-robed Primal Chaos expert greeted him politely from within the palace hall, “There is news from the Heaven Green World.”
“Oh? What is it?” Master Jia Ming’s watery incarnation asked.
“We’ve gotten information regarding part of their lineage’s core inheritance.” This Primal Chaos expert said.
Master Jia Ming was astonished.
The Sacred Master did not desire many things. Other than the most essential goal of ‘grasping the supreme law’, the importance regarding the inheritance of Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’s lineage was ranked in the top three. Sacred Master had personally acted many times before. He even disguised his identity and concealed his aura in an attempt to acquire the inheritance. One could see how important this task was to him.
It’s a pity that the core inheritance of that lineage was tightly secured and he could not obtain it! Sacred Master could only order his subordinates to find some cultivators who did not have any soul imprints yet would believe fervently in Sacred Master to become spies.
Of which there were some that joined the sect under Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.
There were even servants and female attendants that the Ancient Sacred Religion had infiltrated in.
“Our spy has found out a critical piece of news. Part of their lineage’s core inheritance has been grasped by Dong Bo Xue Ying of the Great Void Heaven Temple.” The black-robed Primal Chaos expert respectfully reported.
“How did he found out? Tell me in detail.”
“Yes. That time…”
Master Jia Ming was silently listening.
His true body then began scouring through the past according to this piece of information. He was able to prophesize the future, and thus could naturally view the past. The past had already happened, and it was relatively easy for him to inquire through it. That was also the reason why Master Jia Ming was responsible for this affair.
While he listened, he was investigating the matter as well. Master Jia Ming began to have some deductions in his heart.
“Sou.”
Just a moment later.
The true body of Master Jia Ming arrived right before ‘Sacred Master’.
******
Within the most dazzling palace of Ancient Sacred world.
On a crystalline black stone bed, Sacred Master was currently seated cross-legged on top of it. He was dressed in a black cotton clothing and had a calm and warm expression on his face. Judging by his demeanor of sitting there, others would get the feeling that he was akin to an eternal existence, someone who would live through the apocalypse of the primal chaos void. Nothing could threaten him at all, including the supreme law that was so high above… Because his current existence had given off a flavor of the supreme law already.
“Hu.”
A figure came in from outside. It was a white-robed male. He walked in barefooted, and the servants within the palace hall did not stop him at all.
“Sacred Master.” The eyes of the white-robed male were filled with wisdom; those eyes felt like they could see through everything. He respectfully bowed.
The Sacred Master opened his eyes and looked at this white-robed male.
Even if he could see part of the future, the white-robed barefooted ‘Master Jia Ming’ was still very respectful when facing Sacred Master because the more he could see the future, the more he perceived how powerful Sacred Master was. Basing on all timelines he could observe, Sacred Master would remain as a powerful existence that stood high above everyone else. Furthermore, the moment he tried observing ‘Sacred Master’ in the future, he would suffer from a slight backlash that prevented him from being able to prophesize the future of the other party.
He understood that Sacred Master was so powerful that he had faintly surpassed the limits of what the supreme law could control. The future Sacred Master was someone even he could not observe with his great talent.
Furthermore, even if he could prophesize the future, existences like the Sacred Master could alter it easily.
“I’ve gotten a piece of news.” The white-robed barefooted male, Master Jia Ming said with a warm voice, “It was transmitted over by a hidden disciple under Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master regarding that Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master. Apparently, he has been in an unpleasant mood due to Dong Bo Xue Ying. He even mentioned about ‘the other party stealing his technique’… I’ve investigated the past and found out that Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was thinking of ways to deal against Dong Bo Xue Ying. I even suspect that Myriad Realm Tavern Master had once acted to assassinate Dong Bo Xue Ying, though I could not look through the scenes of the battle which he fought.”
“According to my investigation, it can be deduced that the part about Dong Bo Xue Ying grasping part of their core inheritance should be true, and Myriad Realm Tavern Master has both attempted to kill Dong Bo Xue Ying with Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master one after another.” Master Jia Ming said, “Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master has even revealed the information, which I suspect he is deliberately doing so as to lead us into killing that Dong Bo Xue Ying.”
“I also viewed the scene and understood from the conversation he had with Dong Bo Xue Ying-he has already grasped the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique… Thus, Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor would not waste any Origin World Rocks to invite Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master. This could be the reason why he sought to use us to kill Dong Bo Xue Ying.”
Master Jia Ming calmly stated his deduction.
And Sacred Master was listening from above.
Deliberately spreading the information?
It did not matter if the other party was deliberately spreading the information at all. To Sacred Master, what was important would be if Xue Ying had really gotten part of the core inheritance.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying?” Sacred Master lightly uttered.
The first time.
This was the first time that he truly paid attention to Xue Ying. Even though he had once intelligence on the cultivators, and had cast them to the back of his mind, other than ‘Black Emperor’ and ‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’ whom he slightly paid more importance to amongst those at the Primal Chaos realm, he did not care about the others. Now, he was paying attention to Xue Ying.
“Weng.”
The eyes of the Sacred Master were watching calmly.
The rise and fall of shadow could be seen faintly shuttling through his eyes. In terms of searching for traces, Master Jia Ming might be formidable, but he was far inferior as compared to Sacred Master! Even Myriad Realm Tavern Master’s battle could be easily scoured by Sacred Master.
Only the conversation happening between Myriad Realm Tavern Master, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, and their teacher was completely disordered, preventing Sacred Master from viewing it.
“That old man has even entered this place?” The edge of the mouth of Sacred Master moved upwards.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, has he deduced part of their core inheritance, or has he gotten it from Monarch Nine Cloud?” Sacred Master could determine it very quickly.
No matter what the outcome was.
He felt pleased.
Because Monarch Nine Cloud also had an important secret treasure which he coveted, the ‘Third Fire Prison Realm Cauldron’. That foolish Monarch Nine Cloud, even when he died, he still could not understand at his realm how to use that item.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying? Time for me to go out and have a walk.” Sacred Master left his black stone bed.
All the servants below and Master Jia Ming felt their hearts tightening. They respectfully bowed.

chapters.title: Chapter 986 - The Sudden Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 986: The Sudden Arrival
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The vast illusory realm enveloped this small city in front of him. All living beings within this small city had fallen prey to it. Everyone had their own experiences in the illusory realm, and there was only a white-robed teenager who maintained his consciousness walking on this street. He could easily control the fate of what the cultivators were experiencing in the illusory realm. Those who he appreciated might be even given favorable opportunities.
As for those who committed all kinds of evil, their souls were exterminated in the illusory realm.
‘Ever since I discovered that batch of Destruction Devils and killed someone who had the shadowless talent, I no longer have any result.’ Xue Ying softly shook his head. He knew he would not find anything this time too.
And he was accustomed to it.
Xue Ying was treating this journey more as a part of his cultivation.
‘Mn? The wine shop in this little city seems to be popular.’ Xue Ying discovered a food shop in this city.
“Hua.”
With a thought, the illusory realm dissipated.
The entire small city regained its normalcy. All living beings regained their consciousness. Other than the select few who had some exceptional opportunities, the others did not even remember what had happened.
‘Mn, there is actually such nice delicacies in this little city. The culinary art used might be ordinary, but the food made tasted exceptionally well.’ Many dishes were placed in front of Xue Ying. He was enjoying himself as he ate them. Xue Ying had been to many desolate places, meeting many ancient cultivators who specialized in the culinary arts. Eating was indeed a form of enjoyment.
