Even his soul felt incomparably comfortable. This wonderful feeling even surpassed that of eating Origin World Rocks.
Sitting at a corner of this wine shop, Xue Ying took in great mouthfuls of the food and drank the wine he brought himself. He was having a splendid time.
…
Sacred Master was dressed in black cotton clothing. He was currently walking barefooted and was moving closer to Xue Ying using ultra-long distance teleportation. He soon arrived at the same little city where Xue Ying was without revealing his presence.
As Sacred Master walked in through the city doors, even though many pedestrians were walking on the streets, they subconsciously evaded him. None could perceive this frightening existence at all.
Sacred Master stood at one end of the small city, looking towards that wine shop a few hundred thousand kilometers away. Even though there were many customers in the wine shop, only one was being focused in the eyes of Sacred Master-that white-robed teenager who was devouring food.
Sacred Master took another step before crossing through the distance and arriving close to this wine shop.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying was relaxed initially and enjoying himself, yet suddenly, his expression had a massive transformation.
Danger!
The law domain was immediately activated once it detected an extremely horrifying existence. Xue Ying’s instincts had given him great warning-danger! Extreme danger! That sort of danger and terror had engulfed Xue Ying instantaneously. This feeling of threat which came from his life made Xue Ying tremble.
With a glance, he was able to see a barefooted male walking on the street dressed in black cotton clothing. His eyes were warm, and he was benevolently looking at Xue Ying.
At this moment.
The world had somehow disappeared.
The surrounding city had disappeared. All living beings had withdrawn, leaving behind just him and Sacred Master who stood not far away! The revolving supreme law had already retreated. The law domain which the Sacred Master radiated destroyed his illusory realm within an instant, causing him to fall entirely into the domain of the other party. Even though his soul was strong, and he could barely activate the two protective secret treasures…
“Hong!””Hong!”
The 12 Primal Beads Bracelet was activated, producing 12 layers of light to cover his body.
The Three-Colored Layered Cloud robes had also emitted a golden light. There was even a blue light wrapping around his body.
‘Sacred Master? Why would it be Sacred Master?’ Xue Ying felt a great shock in his heart. What kind of identity did the Sacred Master have? Why would he act against a Primal Chaos existence? Furthermore, there was a tacit understanding across the three great sacred worlds and the two great religions, that during this period of recuperation, unless the Primal Chaos expert offended the Cosmos God, the Cosmos Gods should not act against the Primal Chaos existences.
Otherwise, with the strong bullying the weak? It would just incur a war!
The moment a war began, both parties would suffer from grave losses. Even Sacred Master would not incite such a fight so easily.
‘Why would he act against me?’ Xue Ying’s thoughts were still flashing when an unseen energy rapidly cut through the 12 dimmed films of light. As for the protection by the Three-Colored Layered Cloud? It was even more useless! Even if Xue Ying’s current void-ification was formidable, this unseen energy had rapidly wrapped around Xue Ying’s body.
He felt absolute coldness.
His soul had frozen-it was completely sealed!
Everything happened in just an instant.
Xue Ying could merely activate the two secret treasures, yet he did not have the time to stand up! One could see how fast and ruthless the other party was.
The protection of the 12 Primal Beads Bracelet might be formidable, and World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer had to spend one to two instants to destroy it, but Sacred Master could easily suppress this protection with a raise of his hand. Currently, he wanted to capture Xue Ying alive and would not allow any sorts of accidents to happen. Hence, he came in with his thunder technique and rapidly sealed Xue Ying’s soul.
‘So weak.’ Xue Ying felt ice-cold in his heart. This was even when he had the secret treasures protecting him. Otherwise, the law domain of Sacred Master could easily trample upon him.
Sacred Master walked over. It might seem slow and unhurried, but it took just a step for him to arrive by Xue Ying. He casually grabbed onto Xue Ying’s body.
“Hong~”
The surrounding space started distorting and stacked on top of one another. He could faintly see an enormous palace on the other side.
The Sacred Master carried Xue Ying’s body before walking through the distorted spatial passage to arrive at the Ancient Sacred World.
******
Everything happened too quickly. Xue Ying first fell into a daze before he felt biting cold in his heart.
He knew he was doomed!
Who could save him from Sacred Master? Furthermore, he was even brought into the territory of the Sacred Master, the ‘Ancient Sacred World’. The Ancient Sacred world contained the ‘Ancient Sacred religion’ guarding it. It was really well fortified. Even if all other Cosmos Gods teamed up together against him, and even if they provoked a war, Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor would still choose not to attack the Ancient Sacred Religion since it was foolish to fight here with the Sacred Master.
‘Why did he act against me? I am merely a Primal Chaos existence, so what is it that I have that would make it worth his time acting against me? Unless he knows I am the disciple of Gu Qi? Impossible. If he knows, he would have killed me immediately. After all, my teacher Gu Qi has been directly killed by him, so there is no point for him to capture me alive.’ Xue Ying was pondering over it.
‘There must be a reason why he captured me alive.’
‘He is on the side of the Destruction Devils? It shouldn’t be! He is already an absolute overlord during the early period of the primitive Ancient Sacred world.’
‘Because of Monarch Nine Cloud? That time he sought to kill Monarch Nine Cloud and knew that I have gotten something from Monarch Nine Cloud?’
‘Or is it because of Myriad Tavern Realm Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master? They have just failed to assassinate me, so now they are thinking of ways to make the Sacred Master act instead?’
Xue Ying had many conjectures at this moment, but they were mere conjectures.
‘At this time, I should be doomed.’
‘I can’t escape from him.’
Xue Ying felt helpless. The attack came too quickly, and he did not even have the time to react.
‘Right now I am sealed. Can that Realm Heart Order help me?’ Xue Ying felt the energy of that Realm Heart Order within his soul. Xue Ying could not dispel the Realm Heart Order from his soul regardless of how hard he tried in the past. At this moment, Xue Ying attempted to extend a strand of his true soul into it.

chapters.title: Chapter 987 - Coercion
chapters.content:
Chapter 987: Coercion
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The scarlet energy that was condensed from the Realm Heart Order had always been lying dormant deep in Xue Ying’s soul. He could not expel it. At this moment, Xue Ying sent a strand of his true soul into this scarlet energy, easily fusing into it. Furthermore, it gave off an ‘eager feeling’ that made Xue Ying sense the world beyond the primal chaos void.
It was like how he could peer into the higher dimensional world through the black fog spherical hole. But what he saw was just the tip of an iceberg.
Currently as his strand of true soul entered the Realm Heart Order energy, he was able to sense how vast the world beyond the primal chaos void was. Furthermore, he could even feel a horrifying fluctuation coming from a world not any weaker than the ‘primal chaos void’.
‘I can activate it with just a single thought?’ Xue Ying understood after fusing in.
The Realm Heart Order had been refined by a mysterious ancient existence called ‘Yuan’. He did it to help cultivators reincarnate and proceed into another huge world not weaker than the primal chaos void-Realm Heart Great Land!
In order to protect the true soul, penetrate from the primal chaos void into the Realm Heart Great Land and reincarnate there… all it required was by consuming the energy from the Realm Heart Order! As for the energy within Xue Ying’s body, it was useless. He could not achieve this at all with his current level.
Under normal circumstances…
Only cultivators who had been stuck in a bottleneck for far too long and were in despair would they be willing to forgo their fleshy body and soul, deciding to send a strand of true spirit into another world.
Want to come back?
One had to become a Cosmos God before he could activate the Realm Heart Order energy once again. Without breaking through, the user would either die in the Realm Heart Great Land or stay there forever.
‘Who would have thought that I, Dong Bo Xue Ying, would have been forced to this stage.’ Xue Ying felt bitter in his heart.
“Peng.”
Xue Ying’s body had been thrown down within the palace hall, smashing into a pillar by the side. He slowly brought himself up by with support from the pillar. Having his energy and even his soul sealed, he could only exert the most fundamental fleshy body strength of his. It was near impossible for him to suicide using this energy. After all, his level of existence was too high, and this fleshy body energy could not harm his soul. But by relying on the ‘Realm Heart Order’, Xue Ying was able to reincarnate, and that was considered suicide from another point of view.
Everything was silent within the palace hall. The servants did not even dare to let out a sound.
Sacred Master was casually walking back to his black stone bed before sitting down cross-legged over there. He looked down at Xue Ying, saying: “Dong Bo Xue Ying, I can promise that you will live if you obediently listen to me. This is my promise, and I will not go against it for the sake of a little fellow like you.”
“Sacred Master regards me highly already for you to act personally against me.” Xue Ying calmly said.
“Of the five great sacred worlds in the primal chaos void, few can be qualified to be my opponent. The one with the greatest potential of all is that Swordmaster from your Great Void Heaven Temple. He actually made me suffer from a loss.” Sacred Master sat there, “I’ve heard your talent is not bad. You were able to cultivate quite quickly. Who knows if you might just become a Cosmos God some day. If you die like this, it won’t be worth it at all.”
“If Sacred Master has a request, just tell me directly.” Xue Ying said.
“I’ve heard that you grasped part of the core inheritance belonging to the lineage of Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master?” Sacred Master said, “I am interested in it.”
‘Part of the core inheritance? In the end, it’s still them.’ Xue Ying felt relatively furious in his heart.
That was just too ruthless.
He did not learn any cultivation technique belonging to their lineage before. They merely discovered that his ultra-long distance teleportation was similar to theirs, and judged that he had stolen from them. It was okay if they failed to assassinate him, yet now, they even leaked the news to Sacred Master, causing him to personally act.
‘Damn.’ Even though he felt frustrated and disgusted regarding those in the Myriad Realm Tavern Master’s lineage, he had no choice since Myriad Realm Tavern Master had too many avatars, and the avatar of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master could not be found. Nobody could kill them at all! Facing an enemy that could not die, Xue Ying felt angry yet helpless at the same time.
‘Who would have thought that this ultra-long distance teleportation belonging to Monarch Nine Cloud would bring such a great calamity.’ Xue Ying felt feeble. He had been quite careful.
But he could not just learn this teleportation technique and not use it at all, right?
Xue Ying even endured until the Primal Chaos realm before using it in public, disguising it as an ancient cultivation talent. Nobody suspected him for this before in the past. Many Cosmos Gods personally saw him employing it. Even the cultivators staying in the Void Castle saw him using it.
Instead, it was Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master who determined that it could not be an ancient cultivation talent and should be a teleportation technique belonging to their lineage.
“What kind of status does Sacred Master has? For you to actually help Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master?” Xue Ying shook his head.
“I am not helping them. Instead, I want this inheritance.” Sacred Master looked at Xue Ying, “Tell me everything you know and I promise I’ll let you off.”
The reason why he was speaking so nicely…
Was because it was pointless relying on using illusory realm to make Xue Ying illustrate the art to him. After all, Xue Ying’s control of the illusory realm was more formidable than Sacred Master. He was the strongest cultivator in this aspect.
Directly scouring through his memories by targeting Xue Ying’s soul? That was too barbaric. If the gap in their strength was huge, this could be done. Nevertheless, Xue Ying specialized in the illusory realm. His Vermillion Nightmare inheritance targeted the soul too-Xue Ying even reached the unprecedented tenth transformation. The degree of his soul strength was far beyond what other ninth level Primal Chaos giants had… it was too difficult to search through his soul since it was practically comparable to that of Cosmos Gods!
Want to search through his soul? It would only cause Xue Ying’s soul to dissipate, and in the end, Sacred Master would merely obtain bits and pieces of the technique. He could not search through Xue Ying’s entire memory.
That was why Sacred Master decided to take the initiative and ask him nicely. He also promised to let Xue Ying off. Only when he had no other choices would he choose to ‘search the soul’ of Xue Ying.
…
As Xue Ying ‘negotiated’ with Sacred Master, he was also deliberately delaying for more time.
Because he had already decided! It was impossible for Xue Ying to give the inheritance from Monarch Nine Cloud to Sacred Master. With how strong Sacred Master was, why would he give him more techniques? Even if he did not have the Realm Heart Order, Xue Ying would not agree to the other party either.
He was currently delaying for time…
Merely because he wanted to arrange everything before his death.
‘I no longer have sufficient time. I have always wanted to find another golden-armored graded lair, but I have no time left.’ The incarnation of Xue Ying within the Great Void Heaven Temple Mirage Palace Hall would dissipate as long as Xue Ying chose to reincarnate.
‘Fortunately, I have left behind spatial markings on the three golden-armored graded lair that I found.’ Xue Ying thought. Previously, he merely dispatched two incarnations into the Lost World Corridor in search of more golden-armored graded lairs. It was impossible for them to always remain there. Hence, he left behind spatial markings at a relatively common sealed space close to the golden-armored graded lairs.
‘Adding up the other golden-armored graded lair which I reported to Ancestor Sorcerer and the others, I, Dong Bo Xue Ying, has found four golden-armored graded lairs in total. It’s a pity that I do not have enough time. If only I have enough time, with my scouting technique… I would be able to search through the entire Lost World Corridor once.’ Xue Ying thought.
More than a trillion years.
Xue Ying had merely searched through the tip of an iceberg within the primal chaos void for the Destruction Devils.
But the Lost World Corridor was much smaller than the primal chaos void. He had already searched through approximately 60-70% of the total area. If he had another trillion years, Xue Ying would be able to search through the entire place without leaving any place uncovered!
“Xue Ying, you aren’t cultivating?” Jing Qiu appeared outside the palace. She revealed a joyous look.
Because this incarnation of Xue Ying would usually be cultivating by observing the scaled-armor left behind by General Mo Gu.
“Jing Qiu.” Xue Ying looked at his wife. He felt his heart trembling.
“Jing Qiu, get Qing Yao, and Yu’er to come back as soon as possible. This is urgent.” Xue Ying said.
“Why the rush?” Jing Qiu felt puzzled, “Yu’er is still in closed-door cultivation.”

chapters.title: Chapter 988 - Arrangements
chapters.content:
Chapter 988: Arrangements
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying’s arrangement was something his children, Dong Bo Yu, and Qing Yao did not dare disobey against. They immediately rushed back home. Both siblings felt puzzled. What was it that made their father rush them back? When they saw Xue Ying, they felt even more perplexed.
Xue Ying merely spoke to them briefly, telling them some stuff before asking them to withdraw.
“I still have things to tell your mother. Go back home first.” Xue Ying smiled as he looked at his children.
“Yes, father.” Both of them were filled with doubt though they did not question any further. After all, this image of an imposing and dignified father had long been imprinted in their hearts.
“Xue Ying, you are behaving weirdly today. Yu’er was even in closed-door cultivation, yet you summoned him over. It is fine for you to summon them over as their father, but you spoke to them briefly before asking them to leave?” Jing Qiu felt disconcerted.
Xue Ying nodded: “I indeed do not have much time.”
“You do not have much time?” Jing Qiu felt even more bewildered.
“Jing Qiu.” Xue Ying smiled, “Ever since we met in the Azure River County, we have experienced many setbacks and difficulties together. We have even both cultivated to this realm, encountering many things along the way. I have no regrets spending my life with you.”
“Why are you suddenly saying these?” Jing Qiu smiled.
“My soul will soon dissipate.” Xue Ying answered via voice transmission.
Jing Qiu became dumbfounded: “What! Why…?” She looked at her husband. After all, they had experienced many things before and cultivated for too long. Their heart temperaments had both reached an extraordinary stage. Even though Jing Qiu felt stunned and agitated, she was able to suppress her panic and look at her husband calmly. Her husband had a serene smile, though Jing Qiu was able to conclude that he was not lying.
“My true self has fallen into the hands of Sacred Master.” Xue Ying transmitted, “I will soon be taking the initiative to dissipate my soul. Otherwise, I could not die even if I wanted to.”
“Sacred Master?” Jing Qiu felt her entire body quivering.
That was the most horrifying existence in the primal chaos void! Many Cosmos Gods had fallen in the hands of Sacred Master. With his strength, it was possible for him to exterminate all Primal Chaos giants with a single glance.
Even though her husband was outstanding, and had relatively high status-he was treated as a peer by the Cosmos Gods…
But falling into the hands of Sacred Master…
“Why would he act against you? He is the Sacred Master!” Jing Qiu anxiously asked.
“It is involved with something huge. It isn’t the right time for me to explain them to you for now.” Xue Ying shook his head. Flipping his hand, a storage wristband appeared in it. Within this placed several items which he had just refined, for instance, the first diagram of Monarch Nine Cloud’s four-diagrams inheritance! As he had only succeeded in cultivating the first diagram, Xue Ying could not pen the second to fourth diagrams down.
It also included the absolute art which he created, the “Mirage”.
These absolute art scriptures were all just information so he could write down them with a thought. It’s a pity that his true body had fallen into the hands of Sacred Master, and his treasures were all there. Fortunately, he still had many Origin World Rocks that were kept with the Forefather. Furthermore, he would soon be informing the spatial markings leading to the other three ‘golden-armored graded lairs’ to the Cosmos Gods.
He believed that they would definitely treat his wife and children well after he passed away.
“Pass this storage wristband after my incarnation dissipates to Forefather and the rest.” Xue Ying ordered, “I’ve already placed several seals on it that few Primal Chaos giants could dismantle. There is no need for you to look through it either.” It would only harm Jing Qiu if she browsed through it.
Jing Qiu took it.
“Why would things end up like that?” Jing Qiu asked.
“This matter is related to the Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.” Xue Ying did not hide the reason from his wife. He swiftly explained everything, “You must remember not to tell this to Yu’er and Qing Yao. It would only harm them. Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master has the avatar technique and could not be killed.”
Jing Qiu felt furious after hearing that.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, Sacred Master…
It’s a pity that she could not deal against these existences.
“I understand. I’ll not tell Yu’er and Qing Yao about this.” Jing Qiu nodded.
“Also, even though my soul might dissipate, I would not truly die.” Xue Ying continued telling. He knew of techniques that could check through the past. That was why Xue Ying did not disclose the secret regarding his reincarnation to the public. He did not even tell the Cosmos Gods since they could not help him at all.
“You would not truly die?” Jing Qiu looked at her husband with some hope.
“I’ve gotten a unique secret treasure.” Xue Ying transmitted, “This unique secret treasure is called the Realm Heart Order. Relying on it, I can reincarnate into another vast world that is comparable to the primal chaos void. Rest assured. In the future, I’ll definitely come back from that vast world, though it would take a relatively long time. This news must be kept a secret. If need be, you may tell Forefather in the future. But there is no need to tell him about this for now.”
Xue Ying still trusted Forefather Tian Yu a lot.
Even his teacher Gu Qi trusted him. Forefather Tian Yu was the one who passed down the treasures after Gu Qi died to Xue Ying.
“Mn.” Jing Qiu transmitted back, “I promise I’ll not inform Yu’er and Qing Yao about this for now. It is definitely not a good thing for them to learn of this either. And, you aren’t lying right?”
“Haha, both you and I have seen through life and death. Why the need to lie?” Xue Ying transmitted back.
Jing Qiu nodded: “Xue Ying, what I hate the most is that I can’t avenge you.”
“I’ll avenge myself after I come back.” Xue Ying transmitted back with a smile.
…
Ancient Sacred World.
Sacred Master who was seated on the crystalline black stone bed looked down at Xue Ying. He said with slight startle: “You actually deduced it yourself?”
“Yes.”
Xue Ying sat there drinking wine, nodding: “Sacred Master has to know that I specialized in the illusory realm. I have always been curious about the lineage of Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master! Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master is merely at the Primal Chaos realm, yet he has an avatar that could not be found at all. According to rumors, even you, Sacred Master, can’t truly kill him.”
Sacred Master nodded.
“That is why I decided to focus on their disciples instead. I relied on my illusory realm to procure their fundamental cultivation techniques.” Xue Ying said, “And then, I went into closed-door cultivation in an attempt to deduce some technique. Who would have thought that I will comprehend the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique from it? This Destructive Realm Teleportation technique seems to be quite mystical, and it doesn’t have a strict requirement on one’s cultivation realm.”
Sacred Master was inwardly shocked. He knew that the technique did not have a great requirement in one’s realm. Otherwise, why could the Primal Chaos realm Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master be able to employ it? Even his incarnations could use it too! The avatar technique did not have a great requirement either.
But, cultivating still depended on the cultivator himself. Without supreme talent, it was hard to open unfathomable Dao paths like those.
Sacred Master had to admit after hearing this that Xue Ying had indeed deduced this Destructive Realm Teleportation technique himself. This comprehension ability was truly outstanding! But thinking about the cultivation speed Xue Ying had, he was indeed a genius. If given sufficient time to grow, he might just become another Sacred Master.
“I will not hide this from Sacred Master. I have merely deduced the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique and has obtained some understanding regarding the void-ification. As for the avatar technique, even though I know bits and pieces of it, it will require a long time for me to deduce it.” Xue Ying said. He could boast about it however he wanted. He was currently only delaying for time to arrange things properly before his ‘death’.
‘It is about time.’ Xue Ying thought. He felt quite lighthearted. After all, Xue Ying had finished settling his matters.

chapters.title: Chapter 989  This Blade called ‘Sacred Master’
chapters.content:
Chapter 989  This Blade called ‘Sacred Master’
It was too easy for him to make use of Sacred Master because all Cosmos Gods coveted this inheritance of theirs. And the strongest expert in the primal chaos void, 'Sacred Master', was the most greedy of them all. He once tried all kinds of ways. That time, he would either threaten or entice and even personally killed Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master before.
Nonetheless, it's a pity for Sacred Master since those who could obtain the core inheritance of this lineage would have to first train the 'avatar technique'. Hence, it was near impossible for Sacred Master to obtain their true core inheritance.
Even Sacred Master who was powerful did not specialize in everything. He could not even unravel the techniques left behind by Monarch Nine Cloud.
'Sacred Master. He has always desired to acquire our lineage. If he knows that Dong Bo Xue Ying has deduced part of the inheritance…' Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master coldly laughed, 'He would likely act.'
It's just that because he had been killed by the Sacred Master before, that was why he wasn't too willing to rile up the other party.
But this time, he no longer cared. He had to borrow this 'blade' known as Sacred Master.
...
In the dark palace hall.
The calm lake water gradually coagulated and turned into a watery figure. There was silver light revolving about its surface. He was none other than 'Master Jia Ming' who had an extremely high status within the Ancient Sacred Religion. Master Jia Ming was someone at the ninth level strength and specialized in searching for traces. Furthermore, he could prophesize the future, earning the great favorability of Sacred Master, and for him to be entrusted with great responsibility.
"Master Jia Ming." A black-robed Primal Chaos expert greeted him politely from within the palace hall, "There is news from the Heaven Green World."
"Oh? What is it?" Master Jia Ming's watery incarnation asked.
"We've gotten information regarding part of their lineage's core inheritance." This Primal Chaos expert said.
Master Jia Ming was astonished.
The Sacred Master did not desire many things. Other than the most essential goal of 'grasping the supreme law', the importance regarding the inheritance of Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master's lineage was ranked in the top three. Sacred Master had personally acted many times before. He even disguised his identity and concealed his aura in an attempt to acquire the inheritance. One could see how important this task was to him.
It's a pity that the core inheritance of that lineage was tightly secured and he could not obtain it! Sacred Master could only order his subordinates to find some cultivators who did not have any soul imprints yet would believe fervently in Sacred Master to become spies.
Of which there were some that joined the sect under Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.
There were even servants and female attendants that the Ancient Sacred Religion had infiltrated in.
"Our spy has found out a critical piece of news. Part of their lineage's core inheritance has been grasped by Dong Bo Xue Ying of the Great Void Heaven Temple." The black-robed Primal Chaos expert respectfully reported.
"How did he found out? Tell me in detail."
"Yes. That time…"
Master Jia Ming was silently listening.
His true body then began scouring through the past according to this piece of information. He was able to prophesize the future, and thus could naturally view the past. The past had already happened, and it was relatively easy for him to inquire through it. That was also the reason why Master Jia Ming was responsible for this affair.
While he listened, he was investigating the matter as well. Master Jia Ming began to have some deductions in his heart.
"Sou."
Just a moment later.
The true body of Master Jia Ming arrived right before 'Sacred Master'.
******
Within the most dazzling palace of Ancient Sacred world.
On a crystalline black stone bed, Sacred Master was currently seated cross-legged on top of it. He was dressed in a black cotton clothing and had a calm and warm expression on his face. Judging by his demeanor of sitting there, others would get the feeling that he was akin to an eternal existence, someone who would live through the apocalypse of the primal chaos void. Nothing could threaten him at all, including the supreme law that was so high above… Because his current existence had given off a flavor of the supreme law already.
"Sacred Master." The eyes of the white-robed male were filled with wisdom; those eyes felt like they could see through everything. He respectfully bowed.
The Sacred Master opened his eyes and looked at this white-robed male.
"Hu."
A figure came in from outside. It was a white-robed male. He walked in barefooted, and the servants within the palace hall did not stop him at all.
"Sacred Master." The eyes of the white-robed male were filled with wisdom; those eyes felt like they could see through everything. He respectfully bowed.
The Sacred Master opened his eyes and looked at this white-robed male.
Even if he could see part of the future, the white-robed barefooted 'Master Jia Ming' was still very respectful when facing Sacred Master because the more he could see the future, the more he perceived how powerful Sacred Master was. Basing on all timelines he could observe, Sacred Master would remain as a powerful existence that stood high above everyone else. Furthermore, the moment he tried observing 'Sacred Master' in the future, he would suffer from a slight backlash that prevented him from being able to prophesize the future of the other party.
He understood that Sacred Master was so powerful that he had faintly surpassed the limits of what the supreme law could control. The future Sacred Master was someone even he could not observe with his great talent.
Furthermore, even if he could prophesize the future, existences like the Sacred Master could alter it easily.
"I've gotten a piece of news." The white-robed barefooted male, Master Jia Ming said with a warm voice, "It was transmitted over by a hidden disciple under Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master regarding that Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master. Apparently, he has been in an unpleasant mood due to Dong Bo Xue Ying. He even mentioned about 'the other party stealing his technique'... I've investigated the past and found out that Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was thinking of ways to deal against Dong Bo Xue Ying. I even suspect that Myriad Realm Tavern Master had once acted to assassinate Dong Bo Xue Ying, though I could not look through the scenes of the battle which he fought."
"According to my investigation, it can be deduced that the part about Dong Bo Xue Ying grasping part of their core inheritance should be true, and Myriad Realm Tavern Master has both attempted to kill Dong Bo Xue Ying with Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master one after another." Master Jia Ming said, "Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master has even revealed the information, which I suspect he is deliberately doing so as to lead us into killing that Dong Bo Xue Ying."
"I also viewed the scene and understood from the conversation he had with Dong Bo Xue Ying–he has already grasped the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique… Thus, Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor would not waste any Origin World Rocks to invite Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master. This could be the reason why he sought to use us to kill Dong Bo Xue Ying."
Master Jia Ming calmly stated his deduction.
And Sacred Master was listening from above.
Deliberately spreading the information?
It did not matter if the other party was deliberately spreading the information at all. To Sacred Master, what was important would be if Xue Ying had really gotten part of the core inheritance.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying?" Sacred Master lightly uttered.
The first time.
This was the first time that he truly paid attention to Xue Ying. Even though he had once intelligence on the cultivators, and had cast them to the back of his mind, other than 'Black Emperor' and 'Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master' whom he slightly paid more importance to amongst those at the Primal Chaos realm, he did not care about the others. Now, he was paying attention to Xue Ying.
"Weng."
The eyes of the Sacred Master were watching calmly.
The rise and fall of shadow could be seen faintly shuttling through his eyes. In terms of searching for traces, Master Jia Ming might be formidable, but he was far inferior as compared to Sacred Master! Even Myriad Realm Tavern Master's battle could be easily scoured by Sacred Master.
Only the conversation happening between Myriad Realm Tavern Master, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, and their teacher was completely disordered, preventing Sacred Master from viewing it.
"That old man has even entered this place?" The edge of the mouth of Sacred Master moved upwards.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying, has he deduced part of their core inheritance, or has he gotten it from Monarch Nine Cloud?" Sacred Master could determine it very quickly.
No matter what the outcome was.
He felt pleased.
Because Monarch Nine Cloud also had an important secret treasure which he coveted, the 'Third Fire Prison Realm Cauldron'. That foolish Monarch Nine Cloud, even when he died, he still could not understand at his realm how to use that item.
"Dong Bo Xue Ying? Time for me to go out and have a walk." Sacred Master left his black stone bed.
All the servants below and Master Jia Ming felt their hearts tightening. They respectfully bowed.

chapters.title: Chapter 990 - The Death of Dong Bo Xue Ying
chapters.content:
Chapter 990: The Death of Dong Bo Xue Ying
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Lost World Corridor.
Within a bright space inside it, all kinds of color could be seen streaming within, creating a spectacular scene of a rainbow. Xue Ying’s incarnation stood here watching: ‘This is truly beautiful. Even after roaming around the Lost World Corridor for more than a trillion years, I still find this void to be dazzling.’ After that, this incarnation of his stealthily dissipated. His energy returned to the world. And the incarnation that was seated cross-legged in another sealed place similarly dispersed without alerting anyone.
…
The Mirage City that was one of the 13 primal chaos cities of the Great Void Heaven Temple had been constructed after Xue Ying broke through to the Primal Chaos realm.
This place was had tight security; Xue Ying’s incarnation would remain here in sleep while being prepared to awake and protect this place should an emergency happen.
Nonetheless, at this moment, that slumbering incarnation dissipated. It turned into many spots of light before returning to the world.
“The incarnation of Dong Bo Palace Master has dissipated!”
“The incarnation of Dong Bo Palace Master has dissipated!”
The protective array spirit within Mirage City was startled. He hurriedly reported upwards.
The dissipation of the incarnation of a hall master was a huge matter. This news immediately reached the two palace masters of the Great Void Heaven Temple-Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster.
“What?”
Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster both teleported into the cavern-dwelling of Xue Ying almost simultaneously. They arrived by the side of Jing Qiu. Jing Qiu was currently looking ahead in a daze. Moments ago, Xue Ying was still smiling at her, yet he soon dissipated, turning into spots of light. Even though she had cultivated for a very long period, Jing Qiu still felt her heart being torn apart.
The dissipation of soul…
Even Cosmos Gods would die without a doubt. Her husband had mentioned that the Realm Heart Order would allow him to reincarnate into another colossal world. Was it real? Would he come back? Jing Qiu felt chaotic. Tears could not help but form in her eyes.
“Yu Jing Qiu, where is Xue Ying?” Forefather Tian Yu hurriedly asked. Swordmaster was similarly anxious.
“He died.” Jing Qiu said.
“What happened? What exactly happened?” Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster did not dare believe it. Actually, they had some conjectures after seeing the dissipation of the incarnation protecting the Mirage City. But Xue Ying was strong, and had the protection from his secret treasures, so how did he die? In the eyes of the two Cosmos Gods, Xue Ying had the highest potential amongst the hall masters of the Great Void Heaven Temple. He cultivated for a short period before grasping two ninth level techniques. They were certain Xue Ying would be the third Cosmos God in the near future! And that was a day both of them looked forward to.
But everything happened too quickly! The two of them did not even know what to do.
“He has been captured alive by Sacred Master, who forced Xue Ying to do something. Xue Ying had a secret soul technique and chose to suicide, resulting in the dissipation of his soul.” Jing Qiu flipped her hand and passed the storage wristband which appeared there to Forefather Tian Yu, “Forefather, this was what Xue Ying left for you.”
Forefather Tian Yu received it over. He rapidly checked through.
In the wristband, there was information attached to it. Forefather Tian Yu immediately received the message after receiving it, and soon understood everything that had happened.
“… as long as you rely on the treasures, you would be able to sense the spatial markings as you get close to it. You would be able to find three golden-armored graded lairs that are marked by me. I still hope for Forefather to forgive Xue Ying for being selfish. Previously, I hadn’t spread this Destructive Realm Teleportation technique and had kept it a secret. It’s just that Xue Ying’s comprehension ability wasn’t sufficient, and had only grasped the first diagram out of the four-diagrams absolute art of Monarch Nine Cloud. The other three diagrams could temporarily not be imparted. This ‘Destructive Realm Teleportation technique’ must never be passed down. Sacred Master has always sought to have this secret technique…”
The message left behind made Forefather Tian Yu heartache.
Selfish?
Dao could not be imparted so easily to others. Did the lineage of Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master not regard this inheritance as highly, and kept it a secret without spreading it? Xue Ying did not grasp many absolute arts, and even if he were unparalleled, he would not spread them so easily either.
Much less how vital this ‘Destructive Realm Teleportation technique’ was. If it were spread out, even if it were spread to three to five people, the news would easily be leaked, and the moment Sacred Master knew about it, Xue Ying would die.
Despite how vigilant Xue Ying was, he still died because of this Destructive Realm Teleportation technique in the end!
“So it seems it was not a coincidence that you discovered the golden-armored graded lair in the past, and you had been searching for it all the time. Currently, you had traveled more than half the entire Lost World Corridor and found another three golden-armored graded lairs?” Forefather Tian Yu felt real pain in his heart.
He really liked this junior descendent Xue Ying.
There were all sorts of cultivators.
Like Ancestor Devil who originated from the same hometown as Xue Ying, he had constructed the Dark Abyss and believed absolutely in the strong feasting on the weak. If not for the restriction of the Great Void Heaven Temple, he would undoubtedly become someone even more wicked! As for the other cultivator, ‘Swordmaster’, he might be better, but he was still too proud and aloof. He belonged to the same era as Ancestor Devil, and in the end, he merely restricted Ancestor Devil and not killed him.
Swordmaster had always remained in closed-door cultivation after coming to the Great Void Heaven Temple. He focused more on getting stronger!
But Xue Ying was different. He had a similar personality with Void Primogenitor.
Ever since he reached the ‘My Heart as the World’ realm, Xue Ying had never retreated from his responsibility.
He could always focus entirely on his cultivation, yet he had arranged his incarnations to seek for golden-armored graded lairs and arranged incarnations to pursue the Destruction Devils. This had indeed affected the efficiency of his cultivation, and there weren’t many who were willing to conduct such miscellaneous tasks. How long had Xue Ying cultivated for? He spent practically 99% of his time doing these minor tasks.
If…
If Xue Ying had not done these, he would not be employing the illusory realm over at many locations nor teleport using his ultra-long distance teleportation! He would not be discovered by ‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’. With how vast the primal chaos void was when Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master discovered Xue Ying, he might just have become a Cosmos God!
“Have a look.” Forefather Tian Yu passed the wristband to Swordmaster, allowing him to examine it too.
******
And in another location.
Within an extremely secretive void gap within the primal chaos void, there was a relatively unique mountain peak. The body of the mountain was filled with golden lights streaming here and there.
A thin small old man was standing on a piece of great rock. Around this rock was flowing with dull green liquid. This stone gently rose and fell along with the wave.
“I finally found this God Peak. I still thought that it would have been destroyed after the previous apocalypse of the origin world.” This thin small old man held onto a walking stick. He was thin like a bag of bones, and at this moment, he was smiling so much that his eyes were shining, “The God Peak. It is one of the most appropriate opportunities that I plan to give that Dong Bo brat. He specializes in the illusory realm extremely much, and this God Peak will definitely be a place for him to grow greatly!”
“Now that I have arranged the God Peak, the next place will be the ‘Origin Dreamland’. That time I had created the dreamland cultivation technique. But ever since the shatter of the primitive Ancient Sacred World, it became tough to enter the Origin Dreamland. But I still have to think of ways.” This thin small old man was pondering. He then chuckled, “Hmph hmph, for the sake of this disciple, I have spent quite a lot of effort. I would like to see how you return the gratitude in the future, Dong Bo brat.”
This thin small old man immensely appreciated Xue Ying.
In the past, he had put Xue Ying to test several times in the dark. Even though he felt that this young fellow was too benevolent to the weaker cultivators, causing himself to suffer, overall, the old man was still quite satisfied with Xue Ying! Xue Ying was definitely not an ingrate and would respect his teacher. One had to know that he did not have high demands for his disciples. He did not even care that World Ancestor had spread the Dao, causing many devouring devils to appear.
Of course, he did not have any strong opinion regarding Xue Ying’s attitude towards the weak. He only felt that this disciple whom he was about to take in would live a bitter life.
This was the only disciple whom he would be receiving that had the highest accomplishment in the ‘Vermillion Nightmare inheritance’, and the only disciple who specialized in the soul aspect. He was quite serious about receiving Xue Ying as a disciple. In the past, he was quite carefree about taking Black Emperor and World Ancestor as disciples since he personally had reached a profound realm in the fleshy body aspect. But now, given that the soul aspect was his weakness, he began harboring hope for himself in this ‘disciple-to-be’ of his.
“Mn?” Suddenly, the expression of that thin small old man changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 991 - Old Monster Stone fighting against the Sacred Master!
chapters.content:
Chapter 991: Old Monster Stone fighting against the Sacred Master!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Because Xue Ying had created the tenth transformation of the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance, this thin small old man was able to feel the presence of the other party.
The thin small old man was used to this feeling.
But at this moment…
That feeling disappeared!
Disappeared? The thin small old man was clear what this meant. Hence, he felt his heart turning cold.
‘Why would this be?’ The thin small old man looked afar. Many scenes began floating in his eyes… Sacred Master waving his hand and destroying the fleshy body of Xue Ying… the dissipation of Xue Ying’s aura, and the fleshy body seated within the palace hall of the Ancient Sacred World… Xue Ying conversing with the Sacred Master while drinking… Sacred Master capturing Xue Ying alive…
Many scenes began appearing. Even if the Sacred Master was included, this thin small old man was able to investigate through.
“He…”
“He actually dared! Dared to kill my disciple!” The eyes of this thin and small old man began releasing a horrifying murderous aura.
“Hong~” An incomparably horrifying black aura blasted out from the surface of his body. It rapidly engulfed the entire mountain body of this God Peak, causing this ancient, mysterious God Peak to tremble.
Even though he had not taken Xue Ying as a disciple, he had already treated him like one.
“Hua.”
The walking stick in the hands of the thin small old man disappeared. He took a step before disappearing from the vicinity.
…
When he appeared once again, he was within the core of the Ancient Sacred World, right before that towering palace hall.
The Ancient Sacred World was where the Ancient Sacred Incarnation sat for long periods. The Ancient Sacred Incarnation was practically an entity with the ‘Ancient Sacred World’. Over here, the Sacred Master was virtually unparalleled! Even though the Sacred Master had started many wars with the Cosmos Gods, the Cosmos Gods never dared to kill their way into the Ancient Sacred World.
Until today…
This thin and small old man stood right in the core of the Ancient Sacred world just outside the Sacred Palace.
“Young Child Mo, scram out for me!” The thin small old man fiercely roared out. “Hong-” A terrifying wave of energy rushed out from the mouth of this old man. One could see it moving with naked eyes towards the Sacred Palace. Even though the Sacred Palace stood incomparably firm for eons, at this moment, it directly exploded apart. Furthermore, the surrounding area spanning several hundred billion kilometers was warped, causing many cracks to form.
An unseen energy came out to stabilize the entire Ancient Sacred World.
Otherwise, this roar would have destroyed the entire Ancient Sacred World.
“Hu.” Sacred Master who was dressed in his black cotton clothing walked out from the Sacred Palace. He did not have time to protect his servants. He was only able to protect Master Jia Ming. With a wave of his hand, he had teleported the other party away. Currently, he was looking at the thin small old man with a frown.
“Old Monster Stone, aren’t you sleeping on the primitive Sun Star? Why did you come here for?” Sacred Master frowned.
Even though his territory was attacked and his Sacred Palace destroyed, the Sacred Master wasn’t willing to fight against the other party despite his temper. He wanted to keep peace with this thin small old man precisely because he understood how frightening the other party was.
“What am I here for?”
The black aura that was released from the surface of the thin small old man rose. His eyes were glowing in dark yellow. Amidst the rolling black aura, that dark yellow glow of his eyes became all the more distinct. He growled, “Young Child Mo, I am too lazy to deal against you, yet who would have thought that you dared to kill my disciple?”
“Killed your disciple? Aren’t your disciple just World Ancestor and the other two?” Sacred Master felt puzzled.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying!” The thin small old man angrily spouted out.
“He, he is your disciple?” The expression of Sacred Master turned slightly.
“Did you not see that he has reached the tenth transformation of the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance?” The thin small old man gritted his teeth. Even though he had ascertained that Xue Ying would become his disciple, in reality, he had not taken the other party officially! Hence, the Sacred Master did not discover any uniqueness when facing Xue Ying. As for the Vermillion Nightmare inheritance? Black Emperor had spread the four inheritances out, so many had learned it.
Those were not qualified to be Old Monster Stone’s disciple.
“Even though this disciple of mine is slightly foolish and is too benevolent, working so bitterly, and if I were him, I would definitely not put myself into such exhausting situation, I am still extremely satisfied with this disciple of mine.” The thin small old man growled, “Young Child Mo, very good. Since you have killed him, let me see how the cultivation of yours has improved.”
“You better not turn mad.” The expression of Sacred Master changed.
An incomparably huge illusory figure floating behind that thin small old man. It had a large tortoise shell and was covered in pieces of stone scales. It also had a huge tyrannical head.
At this moment, Old Monster Stone was angry.
That young fellow who had cultivated for only a short period had died before Old Monster Stone could even show his power in front of Xue Ying and take the initiative to accept him as a disciple! Since he died like this, Old Monster Stone was truly infuriated and wanted to avenge for this disciple of his!
“Hong long long~”
The Ancient Sacred Incarnation which was entirely in black appeared. It fused with Sacred Master almost instantaneously.
Clearly, the Sacred Master had to exert his full strength when facing this frenzied Old Monster Stone because he was clear he could be killed if he did not use his full power! Sacred Master felt slightly bitter in his heart. He captured that Xue Ying, prepared some excellent wine for him, yet in the end, he ended up empty-handed. Xue Ying would rather die than to promise him.
It was okay if he died. Even though Sacred Master was frustrated, he had let the bygones be bygones.
It’s just that this frightening ‘Old Monster Stone’ had popped up! There was only one existence in the entire primal chaos void that would give him a headache and cause him to feel fear, and he was this Old Monster Stone who was frequently asleep. Ever since the emergence of the Ancient Sacred World to the destruction of the primal chaos void, that Old Monster Stone would only wake up a few times.
He would always be slumbering in other periods.
But Sacred Master had always been most afraid of this existence! Like the teacher of Myriad Tavern Realm Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, and also that mysterious Luo City Lord… in the heart of Sacred Master, their degree of threat was not as much as this Old Monster Stone.
But now, Old Monster Stone was clearly infuriated!
Regret, bitter, helpless. Sacred Master had to accept the battle even if he was not willing to! He did not wish to just be beaten to his death because of his carelessness!
…
And at this moment within the Great Void Heaven Temple.
Forefather Tian Yu, Swordmaster and Void Primogenitor met up. Void Primogenitor also received that storage wristband of his.
“Xue Ying has said before, that this secret technique must not be spread easily. He only trusted the three of us.” Forefather Tian Yu said, “Both Swordmaster and I have seen through it. But we have not delved deep into the void, and could not learn it during this short period.”
Void Primogenitor felt agony in his heart as he took the wristband.
How deep were his attainments in the void aspect? He was able to learn it with a single glance. This Destructive Realm Teleportation technique had also opened another door for him in his study of the void.
But at this moment, he did not feel happy. He only felt sad and agonized.
‘Disciple Gu Qi, your teacher is helpless and could not protect you. And now, your disciple Dong Bo Xue Ying has died in the hands of Sacred Master again!’ Void Primogenitor felt self-reproach, ‘This teacher of yours is useless! Useless! I swear… that I’ll definitely use my life to kill Sacred Master. I will not care about what it takes.’
Void Primogenitor was someone who was passionate about all living beings. He was instinctively infuriated with how Sacred Master was controlling the lives of the people. Currently, his disciple and the most outstanding grand-disciple of his had both died in the hands of Sacred Master.
“We must not delay any further. We must not waste the effort of Xue Ying.” Void Primogenitor said solemnly, “This secret technique must not be spread outside. Nevertheless, we should still ask Ancestor Sorcerer, Blade Emperor, and the others to come as soon as possible. We will be destroying all the three newly-discovered golden-armored graded lairs at this moment.”
“Mn.” Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster both nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 992 - Bitterness
chapters.content:
Chapter 992: Bitterness
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Very soon, Ancestor Sorcerer, World Ancestor and Blade Emperor got the news. They were all shocked, shocked that the young fellow called ‘Xue Ying’ died just like this! Especially World Ancestor as he was clear his teacher wanted to take Xue Ying as a disciple.
Xue Ying had scoured through more than half the entire Lost World Corridor. Other than the previous golden-armored graded lair, he discovered yet another three more, bringing joy and lament to Ancestor Sorcerer, Blade Emperor, and others.
They did not dare delay any further and waste the effort of Xue Ying.
Ancestor Sorcerer, Void Primogenitor and Blade Emperor immediately teamed up and headed to the Lost World Corridor.
“Hua.”
Within the Lost World Corridor.
Void Primogenitor was someone that specialized in ultra-long distance great teleportation. Currently, he had also learned the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique and was naturally having an easier time. Furthermore, his soul and realm was more profound than Xue Ying and was able to ‘see’ a greater area.
“It is over here.” Void Primogenitor personally carried a piece of talisman left behind by Xue Ying which enabled him to easily sense any spatial markings. Using the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique several times, he brought along Ancestor Sorcerer and Blade Emperor along until they arrived at a sealed space.
Within this sealed space.
Void Primogenitor found the spatial marking left behind by Xue Ying.
‘This is the marked space. The golden-armored graded lair is somewhere near here.’ Void Primogenitor began probing around. He sighed. Even though his ultra-long distance great teleportation was able to let him perceive his surroundings, it was too blurred. This ‘Destructive Realm Teleportation technique’ was not only easy to use, but its ability to see the surrounding was also a thousand to ten thousand times better.
Especially when it was at a close distance. The perception was similar to being present at the scene.
“I’ve seen it. But we aren’t in a rush. Let me find the other two spatial markings first.” Void Primogenitor said, “We will act after I confirmed the positions of the three golden-armored graded lairs. The moment we move, we must destroy all three lairs using the fastest speed.”
“Alright.” Ancestor Sorcerer and Blade Emperor both agreed.
Xue Ying spent a trillion years to leave behind these spatial markings. With this guidance, Void Primogenitor had an easier time searching for the lairs. Soon, he confirmed the locations.
“Start moving.”
Within a golden-armored graded lair, the Destruction Devil who was responsibility guarding the place looked with astonishment as three figures appeared. He had just informed the ‘kings’ when that golden-robed cultivator exploded with endless blade rays. The surging blade rays whistled and destroyed the entire lair space.
In terms of destructive strength, Blade Emperor was the strongest of the three. Naturally, the current Swordmaster could compete with him.
“Time to go to the next one.”
Their speed was rapid. Actually, the reason why Ancestor Sorcerer came along was to prevent the group of ‘kings’ from interfering. Actually, Ancestor Sorcerer and Blade Emperor were sufficient to fight on equal grounds with the ‘kings’ of the Destruction Devils.
“Hua hua hua~” The blade light whistled, striking and destroying the entire lair like a tsunami.
‘It is easy for us to find these places, yet for Xue Ying, he must have been spending his time scouring through the entire corridor. That Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master did not find a single golden-armored graded lair, yet Xue Ying found four one in total. It isn’t easy at all.” Void Primogenitor discovered that despite his high realm, he could only probe around him at a particular distance. Despite his realm, he would have to spend a long time before he could discover all the lairs given how vast the Lost World Corridor was.
If he rested and cultivated after searching for a while, he would have to take an even longer period. For instance, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master once accepted to be paid a considerable price for this task of searching, yet he wasn’t as conscientious as Xue Ying.
Investigating once per breath was also called investigating. Investigating once every time a cup of tea was brewed would also be called investigating, yet the efficiency was much worse.
…
“What?”
“They are destroyed? Three golden-armored graded lairs are destroyed?”
The kings who soon obtained the news fell into a daze. Even the strongest ‘Emperor Jun’ was extremely startled. They had rushed over to one of the golden-armored graded lairs, only to see the entire space destroyed. They looked at it in shock. The surroundings contained shockwaves of the sharp blade light.
“It is Blade Emperor.” Emperor Jun muttered.
“What is going on? What exactly happened to the Cosmos Gods of the cultivators? How were they able to destroy three golden-armored graded lairs consecutively?”
The kings were all shocked. They felt their hearts turning cold.
Because they were clear that the Destruction Devils were absolutely weaker than the cultivators in terms of their peak combative strength. Currently, they only had the strength to ‘protect’, and even if they infiltrated into the world of cultivators, they had to sneak around. They did not have the strength to face the cultivators head-on. The only advantage they had was that their numbers would increase at a faster rate over time.
The lairs would continuously form more Destruction Devils, increasing the chances of ‘kings’ appearing too.
Previously, the destruction of a single golden-armored graded lair made them feel heartache. This time, another three was destroyed.
“We are only left with the final two.”
“With only two golden-armored graded lairs left behind, the emergence of golden-armored Destruction Devils will be much slower. I truly do not know when the third of the fourth lair would appear…” The present kings were starting to panic, “We are most afraid that they might just find out the final two lairs given that they destroyed three consecutive lairs today.”
“Don’t fret so much. The speed of lairs forming will only increase over time.” Emperor Jun muttered, “Currently, they have merely throttled the rate of our emergence, but they can’t block us permanently especially so when the emergence of lairs become so exaggerated that they don’t even have the time to kill us.”
******
Ancestor Sorcerer, Blade Emperor, and Void Primogenitor all returned. They were currently feeling relaxed as they succeeded in their mission.
“Succeeded?” Forefather Tian Yu and Swordmaster saw the three Cosmos Gods coming back from the distorted void.
“Adding up the three golden-armored graded lairs we found, we still owe Dong Bo Xue Ying 300,000 Origin World rocks right?” Ancestor Sorcerer sighed, “It’s a pity that he has died. But we can’t make use of him unfairly. Everything will be given to his loved ones instead.”
“No rush. They are still quite weak. Giving them too many treasures isn’t a good thing. I’ll arrange everything properly.” Forefather Tian Yu said.
“Mn.”
Everyone present nodded.
The stronger the expert, the more they were not willing to owe someone. They felt that they could repay what they owed Xue Ying by directing the rewards to his wife and children instead.
“Mn?” The expressions of Ancestor Sorcerer, World Ancestor, Swordmaster, Blade Emperor, and Forefather Tian Yu changed abruptly. They turned their heads over towards one single direction.
That was where the Ancient Sacred World was located at.
And they had just felt an incomparably horrifying fluctuation.
One had to know how far they were from the target world, yet they could feel the fluctuation from here. What kind of level was this fluctuation at? They felt the shivers thinking about it.
…
Ancient Sacred World.
Old Monster Stone and Sacred Master had fought to the extent that a massive area around them was shattered. The entire Ancient Sacred World was maintained by an unseen energy. If not for Sacred Master doing his best to protect it, the world would have long been shattered.
“Hong!”
A huge black monster was lying in midair. It was the true body of Old Monster Stone.
Currently, a black pillar had penetrated through the scaled abdomen of the black monster, and it came out from the back of his tortoise shell, leaving behind a huge hole.
“Hu.”
The huge black figure disappeared, turning into a thin small old man. And in the distant, the black light pillar had condensed into Sacred Master who currently was wearing his black cotton clothing. Sacred Master’s current expression was ugly, and the aura of the thin small old man was slightly weaker.
“You are mad. Truly mad.” The Sacred Master gritted his teeth.
“You have accumulated quite a lot of origin energy for you to injure my origin by burning your Ancient Sacred Incarnation.” The thin small old man muttered.
Sacred Master felt both angry and frustrated. The origin energy of his Ancient Sacred Incarnation had completely been burned. And the result? Just an injury on this old man! “Old Monster Stone, you are currently heavily injured and should only be at about 40-50% of your original condition. You can’t deal against me. Also, this time, even though I might be the one who captured that Dong Bo Xue Ying alive, it is still that little fellow Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master who deliberately leaked the news to me.”
“Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master?” Many scenes floated in the eyes of the thin small old man, ‘Old Monster Stone.
“Right, it is him. How can he be so careless? He must have deliberately leaked the news to me.” Sacred Master said. Previously, he did not mind being made use of. But that was no longer the case. He had suffered from such a significant loss. The biggest trump card he had, the Ancient Sacred Incarnation had been entirely consumed. So how was Sacred Master happy?
He could not kill the other party…
But Old Monster Stone could!

chapters.title: Chapter 993 Dissipation of Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 993  Dissipation of Soul
Xue Ying was afraid the other party would search his soul directly. That would mean he no longer had sufficient time to properly arrange everything. Regardless of what matter it was–leaving behind a diagram of Monarch Nine Cloud's absolute art or informing the Cosmos Gods about the spatial markings leading to the golden-armored graded lairs, everything required time. Fortunately, Sacred Master was extremely patient.
"How is this wine of mine?" Sacred Master chuckled as he sat cross-legged on the black stone bed.
"It is good wine. I have drunk many good wines in my life, but this wine by Sacred Master is absolutely qualified to be the first." Xue Ying said. He was not lying.
Sacred Master smiled: "This wine can only be drunk from my place. It was available during the earliest period in the primitive Ancient Sacred World, and now, it has fallen into my hands. Every cup I drank is one cup less. Alright, now that you have drunk the wine, it is time for you to speak."
He had already obtained the fundamental cultivation techniques belonging to the lineage of Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.
But he could not deduce the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique, the avatar or void-ification technique at all. He even knew that their lineage had a 'Great Destructive Realm Teleportation technique', and those techniques were making him green with envy! He felt that this junior cultivator, Xue Ying, had a talent so great that he could deduce the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique. The moment he learned it, with his current realm and/or by following down the direction what the other party thought, Sacred Master was confident he could deduce other techniques himself too.
"Sacred Master is quite sincere." Xue Ying said, "But Sacred Master must remember your promise."
"Rest assured. Your life isn't worth me going against my promise. I will not only let you off, but I will also even bestow upon you with a secret treasure that is much better than the one you currently have." Sacred Master chuckled, "Perhaps these secret treasures might be significant to other Cosmos Gods, but they aren't worth much to me."
"I naturally believe it." Xue Ying said.
At the same time, within the soul in his body.
A scarlet energy that was condensed from the Realm Heart Order existed. It was truly mysterious and unfathomable. Xue Ying could not expel it from his soul at all. Just this minor technique the other party left behind had rendered Xue Ying entirely helpless. One could see how powerful that mysterious existence 'Yuan' was.
'Time to activate it.' Xue Ying had mixed feelings about this.
He cultivated for just a short trillion years before grasping two ninth level techniques. If he could, Xue Ying would definitely not choose this path of reincarnation.
This path…
The future was hard to predict. Even though Xue Ying told his wife that he would certainly be coming back, would this 'Realm Heart Order' be a scheme? Would there be an issue during the process of transporting from this primal chaos void into the other vast world? How was the current situation over in the supposed 'Realm Heart Great Land'? Xue Ying was ignorant of everything. If the Realm Heart Order were a scheme, he would be sending himself to the hands of the other party.
But now, he no longer had the choice!
After all, this was the best option for him–at least better than leaving his fate in the hands of Sacred Master.
'Jing Qiu, I'll definitely be back. Yu'er, Qing Yao, I wonder how much change I would see in the two of you when I return.'
'Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, Myriad Realm Tavern Master, was it the two of you who plotted against me this time?'
'Sacred Master… the vengeance of my teacher hasn't been avenged!'
Xue Ying thought.
Actually, he had another harsher path which he could take, and that would be to pass the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique to Sacred Master! Xue Ying believed that with the status of Sacred Master, he would really just send Xue Ying off and even bestow upon Xue Ying with a huge treasure. It's a pity that Xue Ying would never select this path.
"Weng."
With a thought.
...
Sacred Master was looking forward to it as he sat on his black stone bed. Previously, Even though the scarlet energy could not be expelled, a single thought was all it took to activate it. It went along the wishes of Xue Ying, tunneling into his soul all for the sake of this moment of 'activation'.
"Hong~"
The scarlet energy wrapped around a strand of pure true spirit, dying it red. Xue Ying's humanoid soul soon began dissipating away like sand.
And the original scarlet energy similarly disappeared.
...
Sacred Master was looking forward to it as he sat on his black stone bed. Previously, he was afraid that Xue Ying would rather die than to speak. But now, it seemed that the other party's attitude was not bad. He had sealed the soul of Xue Ying so the other party could not suicide. Sacred Master was waiting confidently for Xue Ying to reveal the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique to him.
"Mn?" Sacred Master's expression slightly changed. That expression which was always warm had suddenly turned solemn and cold.
The energy which he used to seal Xue Ying's soul gave him the feeling of a brilliant red light emitting from within. This was a mysterious energy that he had never seen before. And closely following that, Xue Ying's soul completely dissipated.
It was an absolute dissipation of soul, leaving nothing behind.
And the fleshy body of Xue Ying that was seated there drinking still had a smile attached to his face. He still held on to the cup of wine, though not a single wisp of aura could be felt from his soul.
'How could this be? How did he die?' Sacred Master felt his heart surging with rage. He did not dare believe it.
Despite sealing Xue Ying's soul personally, the other party could still suicide in front of his eyes?
Sacred Master had initially planned for the situation should Xue Ying become rebellious; he would apply all kinds of torture that would make the other party beg for death. If this did not work, he would then employ the crudest method–to search the soul! Even Sacred Master could not gain the complete core inheritance with this method, though it was better than getting nothing.
'Dissipation of the soul? How, how did he achieve that? Could he have some unique soul secret technique?' Sacred Master felt both anxious and furious. The Destructive Realm Teleportation technique which seemed so close had just flown away! And this aspect, allowing him to suicide even after his soul was sealed by me.' Sacred Master could only make his conjecture.
Xue Ying had even deliberately cooperated with him, discussing how good the wine was. This entertainment the other party provided infuriated him instead.
'That's right. He is currently the strongest cultivator in the illusory realm. Hence, it should be expected that he commands some unique secret technique in the soul aspect, allowing him to suicide even after his soul was sealed by me.' Sacred Master could only make his conjecture.
After all, he had never seen the Realm Heart Order personally, much less the entire process of its activation.
He still thought that the brilliant red light was a disturbance formed during the utilization of the secret technique.
'He actually…' The servants in the palace hall and Master Jia Ming all felt shocked. They were able to see that Xue Ying's fleshy body was an empty shell. His soul was no longer present.
At this moment, the atmosphere in the palace hall turned oppressive. None dared to speak.
"Hong."
Sacred Master waved his hand.
A gray and dull thunder landed and destroyed the fleshy body of Xue Ying, causing it to dissipate after turn into ashes. Only the 12 Primal Beads Bracelet and several secret treasures were left behind.
"These cultivators, why are they all so foolish. They would rather die and hinder my path. Wait until I control the primal chaos void, by then, I'll definitely summon all of them again from the primal chaos void and send them to an eternity of torture.." Sacred Master coldly declared.
...
Outside the Ancient Sacred World, on a sheet of floating stone rubble, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master's incarnation was located here. It was currently relying on the black fog spherical holes to spy on the Ancient Sacred world! This scouting technique was something the Sacred Master could not sense.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master had been observing the scene within the palace hall of Sacred Master.
'He actually lowered his head and admitted his defeat and is taking the initiative to hand over the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique? Damn!' Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master felt indignant after seeing Xue Ying giving in, 'Truly too soft! And groveling!'
But as he watched on…
His indignance turned into shock.
'Suicided? He actually succeeded to suicide? Hahaha, it is good that he suicided too. Even though he died without suffering, it is still good that he died!' Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master revealed a grin. Following that, this incarnation of his stealthily dissipated. Watching the death of Xue Ying's true body, and how the other party's fleshy body was struck into ashes, was indeed thrilling for Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master. He felt satisfied.

chapters.title: Chapter 994 - The Death of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 994: The Death of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Many scenes floated in the eyes of the thin small old man… The incarnation of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master observing from outside the Ancient Sacred World before becoming delighted due to the death of Xue Ying… Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master deliberately revealing the information… Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master requesting his teacher for help… Myriad Realm Tavern Master assassinating Xue Ying… Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master urging Myriad Realm Tavern Master to act…
Following along this path where Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master had been to, the old man unraveled a tremendous amount of information that the incarnation and true body experienced recently.
Clearly, this old man was more formidable than the Sacred Master in the scouting aspect.
And the outcome of the investigation was clear-Sacred Master did not lie! Everything had been instigated by Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, though Myriad Realm Tavern Master wasn’t committed to it.
“Hu.”
The thin small old man glanced at Sacred Master before disappearing from the place.
Sacred Master stood there. His eyes were cold: “Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master? Hmph, thinking of making use of me?” It was okay if he did not suffer from any losses, and he would not care that Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master had made use of him. Nevertheless, the loss he sustained this time was too high. Naturally, he had to pull Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master into this whole scheme as well. He could not kill the other party, which was why he thought of Old Monster Stone who was at the same level as him.
Old Monster Stone had similarly reached the last final realm. Comparatively, Old Monster Stone focused on internal cultivation. ‘Developing the inner self to bring external strength’-it was not just his fleshy body’s cultivation, even his body control towards the entire primal chaos void had reached a profound level.
With a thought, his fleshy body could appear at any location within the primal chaos void.
His powerful willpower could forcibly investigate through everything that happened in the past!
His strength was utterly his own.
What he sought… was to reach an ultimate stage in his body, and to break through of the confinement of the entire primal chaos void.
And what Sacred Master sought was to control the entire primal chaos void and become its owner! By then, he would naturally leap out of this prison. Since they walked different paths, their techniques were naturally different.
Old Monster Stone cultivated his body to an extreme stage. Just by imparting part of his techniques to ‘World Ancestor’, Sacred Master could not harm a single strand of hair of World Ancestor.
Even though Old Monster Stone was heavily injured during the previous fight, that deciding strike actually came from the strongest technique Sacred Master had-to burn the energy of the entire Ancient Sacred Incarnation and charge them into one single move. After that, Sacred Master could no longer be able to use that technique temporarily and could thus not threaten Old Monster Stone at all. But after the drastic reduction of Old Monster Stone’s strength, he could not harm Sacred Master too. After all, Sacred Master had merely lost his Ancient Sacred Incarnation; his true body remained perfectly fine.
…
Primal chaos void, Heaven Green World.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was currently enjoying himself as beautiful women served him. He was drinking in contentment. His current mood was splendid.
‘Fight with me?’
‘He died so simply without suffering from any pain. This is making it too easy for him.’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master drank and sneered. To kill that Dong Bo brat by making use of Sacred Master who had high status, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master felt satisfied. After all, it wasn’t everyone who could make use of the Sacred Master. Furthermore, Sacred Master remained seated there acting like nothing had happened despite being made use of.
It was due to the presence of his avatar that prevented the other party from killing him.
“Mn?” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master frowned as he looked ahead.
A thin small old man clutching a walking stick crossed right through the door in front. The guards outside the palace hall somehow froze, and the entire space seemed congealed.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master felt his heart trembling. He felt a horrifying threat at this moment.
“Senior is?” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master immediately stood up with respect. He knew when to lower his head. This existence in front of him had given him an unprecedented feeling of threat. He felt that he was not any worse off than Sacred Master. He had experienced being killed once by the Sacred Master, though he survived due to his avatar technique.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying has not offended you. You want to kill him just because he is able to employ the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique?” The thin small old man looked at this scarlet-browed male in front. He had investigated the past of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master and discovered that this person was incredibly selfish. Furthermore, Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was someone that made use of his teacher. With the temper of the old man, he hated such cultivators the most, and would never be willing to accept him as a disciple.
And it was precisely this fool that made use of the greed of Sacred Master to harm his disciple.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying? I, I did not kill him. I can’t kill him either.” Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master hurriedly added, “Senior, please look at this objectively. This matter is really unrelated to me. My senior disciple brother has indeed acted before, but he can’t deal against Dong Bo Xue Ying either. Dong Bo Xue Ying is too strong, and he has his secret protective treasures and Destructive Realm Teleportation technique. Only the Sacred Master is able to kill him.”
From how Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master sees it, he had done everything really cleanly, and would naturally not admit to the whole affair.
“You aren’t planning to admit to it?” The thin small old man, Old Monster Stone, began chuckling. His laughter made Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master feel a chill down his spine, “Do you think you can hide from me about what you have done? Alright, just die obediently.”
The entire place was somehow frozen in place.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master felt his heart trembling. He could not move.
