‘Everything is fine. So what if he is strong? I have my avatar technique, and even Sacred Master can’t kill me at all.’ Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master thought. He merely felt heartache, ‘The treasures and weapons I have on me will be lost. What a pity.’
“Hua.”
The thin small old man in front gave a cold chuckle. He was able to perceive the other avatar of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master using his true body. Even though that avatar was heavily protected-filled with many beguiling and interference techniques, this old man cultivated on the path of internal cultivation and could easily suppress the primal chaos void and break through all disturbances. Hence, he was able to discover the body that was seated in a cavern-dwelling deep within a concealed space of the primal chaos void.
The thin small old man suddenly disappeared.
Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was stunned.
He disappeared for a moment! Following that, the thin small old man was grabbing another Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master in his hands.
‘This, how could this be possible…’ The eyes of that avatar which had just been captured were filled with panic. The Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master standing behind the long table was similarly shocked.
Those of their lineage had reached a deep understanding in the void aspect. The cavern-dwelling where his avatar was hiding in had been protected by an array constructed personally by his teacher. He felt that it was impossible for anyone to discover that avatar of his! But now, reality showed otherwise. This mysterious old man actually captured his avatar alive.
“Teacher.” The two great avatars of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master hurriedly called for help.
“Mercy, I plead senior to spare my life.” The two avatars were begging.
Suddenly, an unseen fluctuation descended.
The thin small old man, Old Monster Stone, lifted one avatar of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master. He chuckled coldly at this scene. He was not in a rush to kill Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master. Instead, he was watching that unseen fluctuation condense.
Closely following that, a transparent figure appeared. It was a bird-headed human.
“Teacher, save me!” The two avatars of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master were shouting for help.
The bird-headed humanoid figure turned towards that thin small old man, Old Monster Stone. Those slightly transparent eyebrows of his frowned somewhat. For a moment, he could not recognize the identity of this thin small old man. He felt somewhat suspicious. Other than that Sacred Master in this primal chaos void, it seemed there was another formidable existence as well?
“You are the one that entered our primal chaos void sneakily?” The thin small old man, Old Monster Stone gave an uncanny sneer, “I have always been sleeping and am too lazy to acknowledge you. Such dare.”
“This Dao friend, how about giving me some respect and spare the life of this disciple of mine?” The bird-headed transparent figure stated.
“Give you some respect? Just because it’s you?”
The moment he finished speaking.
“Peng!”
The body of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master that was in the hands of the thin and small old man exploded. The Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master that was standing behind the table similarly blew. Both of them shattered into nothingness, and he directly died!

chapters.title: Chapter 995 - Another World
chapters.content:
Chapter 995: Another World
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The transparent bird-headed humanoid figure felt frustrated at that juncture. This thin small old man in front of him was not in a rush. Instead, this old man waited for him to appear before killing his disciple. Clearly, the other party was deliberately slapping him in the face. And he had only accepted two disciples in total within this primal chaos void. He quite liked this little disciple, ‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’ of his since this disciple understood his temper really well.
“You are just an outsider. Even if you are stronger, your strength will be suppressed to the Primal Chaos realm in this primal chaos void. Someone at that realm wishes for me to give you respect?” The thin small old man, Old Monster Stone sneered, “If Yuan or Luo City Lord came and ask me, I will naturally respect them. But you are asking me to give you one?”
“Hmph.” The transparent bird-like humanoid figure felt indignant, “Even if you are stronger, you are merely stuck in this origin world and can’t come out. Belittling me?”
He felt furious.
He grasped the Great Destructive Realm Teleportation technique and could travel to other origin worlds. Naturally, his horizons were broad, and he had learned many secret techniques. Under normal circumstances, those who were at a lower level would fawn upon him and exchange with his absolute arts. Who would have thought that this old man would not give him respect at all?
“Scram!” The thin small old man roared out suddenly.
“Hong!”
A horrifying black aura exploded from his body and suppressed down on the transparent bird-headed humanoid figure. The other party could not escape in time and was struck down into pieces. But it was merely an avatar. Being the teacher of Myriad Realm Tavern Master, he similarly had many avatars.
“Acting ostentatiously in my place? You are merely an outsider.” The eyes of the thin small old man were cold.
Both Sacred Master and he were inner lifeforms of this primal chaos void.
The two of them could perfectly unleash their strength. An outsider, even if their realms were comparable, would be very small and weak in this world.
“Ai.”
After fighting and venting the fury in his heart, the thin small old man, ‘Old Monster Stone’ sighed. No matter what, that disciple Xue Ying whom he favored a lot had died. The opportunities which he had prepared for Xue Ying previously had become useless. Everything was a wasted effort.
“Time to sleep, time to sleep. I’ll come out again when this primal chaos void is about to be destroyed.” The Old Monster Stone felt his enthusiasm waning.
“Cough cough.”
He coughed twice. Sacred Master had used its entire strength to strike his origin.
“That Young Child Mo is quite ruthless. Furthermore, his true body isn’t injured at all. But still, the energy which he accumulated in the Ancient Sacred Incarnation has been fully consumed. He would likely be preserving his energy until the period that the primal chaos void is about to enter its apocalypse.” Old Monster Stone shook his head. He took a step before disappearing.
On the primitive Sun Star.
On this incomparably colossal fireball, a towering black figure appeared. This large black figure slowly tunneled into the Sun Star before beginning his slumber. He was cultivating in his sleep and was also nursing his wound in sleep.
…
Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao sat there in a daze.
They only found out recently, and could not accept the truth. Their father was so strong and had entered the primal chaos void at the True God Ruler realm without dying. Currently, he had reached such a profound realm that he could fight against Cosmos Gods directly, yet he died? And he died in the hands of Sacred Master? That was Sacred Master, someone who could fight against multiple other Cosmos Gods by himself.
Even though they felt hatred boiling in their hearts, both siblings remained helpless. They were not as outstanding as Xue Ying; they were not even confident of reaching the Primal Chaos realm.
“The path of cultivation is as such. There are all sorts of hardships and obstacles. Your father was not able to overcome them, that’s all.” Jing Qiu said, “But I am still proud of him. He did not lower his head even as he faced Sacred Master. The two of you should properly cultivate because nobody will be there to shelter you in the future.”
“Mn.”
Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao both nodded.
Suddenly, Jing Qiu stiffened. A figure had appeared in his mind. It was in the figure of World Ancestor: “Yu Jing Qiu, your husband Dong Bo Xue Ying should have become my junior disciple brother. It’s a pity he died. Nevertheless, my teacher fought with the Sacred Master and heavily injured him. Furthermore, my teacher has also acted and killed Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master. In the future, you should take good care of the children of Dong Bo Xue Ying. If you find any trouble, you can come and find me.” Saying that, the illusory figure of World Ancestor disappeared from her mind.
“Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master died?” Jing Qiu felt shocked.
Sacred Master could not kill him, but the teacher of World Ancestor could?
World Ancestor had a teacher? And he even heavily injured Sacred Master? Many questions appeared in the mind of Jing Qiu. At the same time, World Ancestor promised that she could find him if she had any troubles. This made Jing Qiu taste how great the influential power her husband had.
But what Jing Qiu did not know…
Was that even Sacred Master felt regretful after the entire event since his loss this time was too high! He had to spend a long time hibernating.
******
No matter what, that person called Xue Ying had disappeared in this primal chaos void. This stage no longer had his figure anymore.
…
“Hong.”
Even though Xue Ying deduced from the technique of Yuan that he should be someone that disdained from scheming against Xue Ying, Xue Ying could not feel secure until the very last moment.
After activating the energy of the Realm Heart Order.
The strand of Xue Ying’s true spirit was wrapped around by the energy, easily bypassing and leaving the primal chaos void. Currently, because Xue Ying no longer had his soul, his perception of the external world was very very weak. Even as he left the primal chaos void and arrived at an external world, he could barely sense the chaotic energy moving outside.
That was a suppressive energy movement. What made him feel terror was that he understood that Xue Ying would be destroyed the moment he entered the outer world even though he had a body!
“Hu.”
Under the protection from the Realm Heart Order energy, Xue Ying felt like he was proceeding along a unique passage at high speed.
Time passed just like that. Seconds… Minutes… And only two days had passed after a long time. Or was it a year and a half? Proceeding through this strange passage had weakened Xue Ying’s true spirit strand’s perception of time. He could not accurately discern the time. Or maybe time had lost its meaning in this place.
Xue Ying would occasionally feel an incomparably large fluctuation. That was a fluctuation comparable to one formed by the primal chaos void. Following that, it rapidly flitted across.
Very long… It had been very long…
Xue Ying remained moving forward.
The energy of the Realm Heart Order was continuously consumed as Xue Ying proceed ahead. There was just 90% of its energy left, 80%, 70%, 60%…
‘Mn? This is!’ Xue Ying suddenly felt excited. Because he could clearly sense a considerable movement. This time, it was not flitting across him. Instead, it was moving closer to him!
‘Close to half the energy has been consumed. It seems that I have really arrived at the Realm Heart Great Land. That mysterious Senior ‘Yuan’ much be very powerful for him to be able to send me here.’ Xue Ying was becoming more confident that what Yuan said was true.
“Hong!”
As that horrifying movement got closer, in the end, a human head tunneled out. Under the protection of the Realm Heart Order energy, Xue Ying’s true spirit had entered into this vast world. Furthermore, it had tunneled into an embryo that was still being nurtured inside the mother’s womb. Xue Ying felt the huge lifeforce currently inherent within this embryo.
‘An embryo that is still being nurtured has such terrifying lifeforce?’ Xue Ying’s consciousness soon fused into the embryo. This strand of true spirit soon let out a wave of ringing sound before Xue Ying lost his consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 996 - Ardent Fire Marquisdom
chapters.content:
Chapter 996: Ardent Fire Marquisdom
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
In the vast Realm Heart Great Land, there was a relatively huge country called Southern Cloud Nation located next to the ‘Black Prison Moon Lake’.
Southern Cloud Nation, Ardent Fire City.
The Ardent Fire City occupied an area spanning billions of kilometers. There were numerous cultivators and sects within. The city was even protected by a hibernating incarnation of a Cosmos God. The master of the city was none other than Marquis Ardent Fire, a Primal Chaos Realm giant.
At this moment…
Inside the estate of Marquis Ardent Fire, within an ordinary courtyard, there were many soldiers, servants and followers gathered here.
“Mother, just lie down and relax. There is no need to get so angry over a small maidservant.” A green-robed woman carefully helped the madam onto a recliner.
The madam slightly nodded as she rested on the recliner. She looked tired and sleepy while gently caressing her belly. Her belly looked somewhat protruding.
Inside her belly.
There was a consciousness gradually waking up.
‘I successfully reincarnated in another world?’ Xue Ying’s consciousness woke up. Although his soul was extremely weak, it had already attained the ‘My Heart as the World’ realm. That meant his soul was no ordinary weak soul in terms of quality. Usually, when one stepped into the third level of the heart realm from the second level, it would produce some disturbances, forming fluctuations in the surrounding. Others would notice this advancement.
Nevertheless, Xue Ying had an excellent grasp over the soul. Not a single shred of aura was leaked. He was currently observing himself with great scrutiny.
‘Mn, previously under the guidance of the supreme law of Realm Heart Great Land, my strand of true spirit reincarnated into this world and was able to perfectly integrate with this soul.’ Xue Ying felt content. Although his current soul was weak and incomparable to his previous soul, it was still at the peak of the Deity realm. Furthermore, qualitatively, it was at the third heart realm.
“This body?”
Xue Ying observed his own embryonic body. Currently, his legs and hands had already developed. As he saw the fifth limb, he felt relieved: ‘It is fortunate that I am still a male.’
Based on his memory, there was a possibility of being reincarnated into a girl. If that happened, he was not sure if he could hold on to without changing his gender. Nevertheless, it was possible for some powerful cultivators to look into the womb and get a view of the baby’s gender. They would be suspicious if a baby girl suddenly became a baby boy.
‘This body has strong vitality. It might only be an embryo, yet its vitality is comparable to a World Deity.’ Xue Ying was surprised. Even though the vitality was strong, it was only in the Deity realm. But Xue Ying believed it would become stronger over time.
‘There is still a long time to birth. With this vitality, would it continue to grow until the True God realm or be stuck at the World Deity realm?” Xue Ying did not dare believe it.
True God?
Over at his previous world, a newly born baby would only reach the Transcendent level even in the Sacred World. Even the offsprings of Cosmos Gods could not be a True God at birth.
‘Based on Yuan’s explanation, The Realm Heart Great Land has a much deeper foundation as compared to the primal chaos void.’ Xue Ying pondered. A male offspring was already so powerful in the womb. Other than the bloodline, there must be some other factors. Bloodlines alone could not allow the baby to reach such power since offsprings of Cosmos Gods in the primal chaos void had to cultivate to where they were after their birth. Perhaps there were some secrets behind this.
Just like the Void Creatures, some special ones were Void God at birth, and the weaker ones might even be a True God Ruler at birth!
There were already cultivators researching on this topic a long time ago. Could it be possible to let their own children be True Gods or even Void Gods upon birth just like those void creature?
‘Could it be that the Realm Heart Great Land discovered and developed some secret techniques?’ Although Xue Ying could not believe it, he could only wait until his birth before uncovering this mystery.
‘Time to observe myself.’
Xue Ying began to check his own body rigorously.
With his soul already at the ‘My Heart as the World’ level, as long as he wanted, Xue Ying could simply kill a True God Ruler with his gaze. That’s why it was a piece of cake for him to scrutinize his own body and constitution.
‘The blood flowing within my body?’ With his detailed analysis, Xue Ying quickly found out something.
The particles of the blood flowing in his body had a complex structure.
It was as if many strange three-dimensional patterns were fused together into one. Some were unnecessary, and some belonged to the core of the structure.
Of these three-dimensional patterns, some were large and clear, while others were small and weak. There were even some patterns that contained flavor from an ancient concept-one that was deeper and more profound than the Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance tenth transformation or the nine-petaled Destruction Flower. Although the most massive three-dimensional pattern looked extremely clear, it contained a weak concept, and Xue Ying could deduce that this should be at the Void God or Unity level.
But that was mere deductions. Xue Ying’s understanding of the laws and profound mysteries on the Realm Heart Great Land was still lacking. His inference was solely based on his own experience and perception.
‘This should be my bloodline. Furthermore, it contains many other dormant bloodlines.’ Xue Ying was once again surprised.
The bloodline cultivation system was also one of the largest systems from where he came from! He studied it a little in the past, and understood that this fleshy body of his contained many bloodlines.
Based on his deductions, the ancient and perfect concepts that existed in his blood should be beyond the ninth level and were likely Cosmos God bloodlines. There were a total of eight in his body! But they were extremely diluted and seemed to come from many generations in the past.
On the contrary, the most concentrated bloodlines were the weaker ones.
‘This body of mine is suitable for the bloodline cultivation system.’ Xue Ying felt happy. It was easy cultivating in this system. Just like his disciple, Xing Huo Xun Yi who had easily reached the Unity realm, the main reason was that his father, Monarch Xing Huo, had given birth to him at the Primal Chaos realm. As his father’s son, his body contained a powerful bloodline that enabled him to cultivate so fast.
As for himself…
Xue Ying preferred to develop the Cosmos God bloodline he had. Although it was weak, Xue Ying had already attained a high realm! Even though the law and profound mysteries system of this world differed from his previous one, it was still easy for him. Breaking through in the laws and profound mysteries system was tough, though it was not the same for the bloodline cultivation system.
‘Let’s cultivate using bloodline cultivation system first. As I get stronger, my soul will also become stronger! That would allow my deduction and comprehension skills to improve.’ Xue Ying thought.
Xue Ying was already used to the speed of thought of a soul at the Primal Chaos realm. His current soul that was only at the peak of the Deity realm (with quality at the third heart realm) was comparatively slower.
Sharpening an ax would not interfere with the cutting of firewood. Preparing for greater progress in the future is always a good thing to do.
For him, the bloodline cultivation system is the ax! After all, the Primal Chaos realm was the highest level he could get from cultivating bloodline cultivation system.
‘Let’s first determine what the differences in the laws and profound mysteries within this Realm Heart Great Land and where I came from are.’ Xue Ying carefully perceived his surroundings.
The supreme law existed everywhere. Naturally, fluctuations of the law could be felt from within the embryo.
Xue Ying began extending his senses. Despite reaching a high realm previously, he was entirely ignorant of the laws and profound mysteries here in the Realm Heart Great Land and had to start from scratch.
‘Mirage, void, ripple, massacre… ‘ Xue Ying began sensing the more familiar laws first.
In his previous life, he cultivated mainly in the Dao of Mirage, Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple.
But because of the Walker’s Hidden Secret, Monarch Nine Cloud four-diagrams absolute art, General Mo Gu’s scaled armor, a trillion years of practice in the Lost World Corridor, Xue Ying had accumulated a deep understanding towards the void. Strictly speaking, his attainments in the Mirage was ranked first followed by the Void, the Slaughter and the Ripple.
“Wu…”
Xue Ying spent more than half of a month carefully perceiving the supreme law with rapt attention. Over time, he began having a greater understanding of the laws in this world.

chapters.title: Chapter 997 - Unborn Child
chapters.content:
Chapter 997: Unborn Child
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
‘This is troublesome.’
‘What Yuan said isn’t wrong. The supreme law in the Realm Heart Great Land is different here compared to the law of where I came from! Hence, many of the laws and profound mysteries under this supreme law are different too.’ Xue Ying was annoyed, but he was not worried. Ultimately, all paths would lead to the same destination. Even though the profound mysteries were different, most of their general structures remained similar. There was the supreme law, cosmos laws and Primal Chaos level laws here too…
He still had his bountiful experience, giving him the confidence of his future in cultivation.
‘And this is also a tempering for me. Cultivating using different supreme laws would refine my capabilities. It should greatly increase the chance of me breaking through to the Cosmos God realm.’ Xue Ying thought. The information within the ‘Realm Heart Order’-Yuan had said before, that the foundation was deeper here in the Realm Heart Great Land. Furthermore, cultivating under a different supreme law would be beneficial towards breaking through to the Cosmos God realm.
‘What I specialized is in four Dao paths. The Dao of Mirage, Slaughter, and Ripple have a huge difference in its Dao path here. Only the ‘Void’ Dao remained similar.’ Xue Ying let out a sigh of relief. He believed he would be able to progress in the Dao of Void the fastest, ‘No matter if it is the primal chaos void or the Realm Heart Great Land, the ‘void’ is still an essential component of the two origin worlds. Hence, it is quite logical for the Dao of Void to be similar in both places.’
After perceiving for half a month.
He had raised his comprehension of the void to the Deity realm. This was also because his soul was too weak, considerably slowing his comprehension rate.
‘Time for me to perceive the external world.’ Xue Ying did not dare to spread the fluctuations from his soul out. After all, it would definitely mean his origin was extraordinary given the bloodline of this fleshy body of his.
He merely perceived his surroundings with rapt attention, carefully listening to the sounds in the external world.
“Mother, you should cool down yourself.”
“Is this female servant even here to serve me? She is here to annoy me!”
In the external world within the house.
There was a madam bound in thick gown half-laying there. She could not help but say: “I have declined several times in the past that I do not want a female servant! Yet in the end, the Marquisdom still arranged this female servant over.”
“This is the rules of the Marquisdom. Mother, since you are pregnant, they will naturally send a female servant over. Both our identities are quite low in the Marquisdom, and this female servant will definitely listen to the words from the eldest madam if she is not foolish. Let us endure more and not create a huge affair over this which might rile up the eldest madam. By then, we would be suffering even more. It’s a pity that I am useless, and have barely reached the True God realm, which was why my status is merely slightly better than that of the female servant.” A green-robed girl muttered by the side.
“It isn’t your fault. In the end, it is because I am too weak, and your father is too ruthless.” The madam sighed.
“Father he…” The green-robed girl shook her head too.
These children were very disappointed with their father. Maybe their father might notice them from afar, yet he would definitely not choose not to acknowledge them. After all, these children had never seen their father before.
“Zhi ya.”
The courtyard door was suddenly pushed open.
This made both mother and daughter turn their heads over. A female servant was carrying a wooden tray in. She spoke coolly: “Madam, this is the ‘Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea’.”
Both mother and daughter stood up immediately because they were able to see with a single glance-an old man standing outside the courtyard. He was looking coldly into the courtyard.
The madam immediately walked over and received this Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea and drank it with a gulp. This Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea… was something she could never afford to buy even if she saved for her entire life in this Marquisdom. It was specially prepared by the Ardent Fire Marquisdom for every unborn child currently still being nurtured in the womb so that it would become stronger.
“Mn.” Only after the old man saw the madam drink, did he turn around and left.
Only then did both mother and daughter return to the house. The female servant outside the courtyard sneered before leaving; she was too lazy to serve the madam, and totally disdained her since if the other party were not pregnant, this madam’s status would be incredibly low within the Ardent Fire Marquisdom-much lower than the female servants. She wasn’t qualified to be served by servants as such madams were too commonly seen in this vast Marquisdom.
Any son of the Marquis Ardent Fire would have a dozen to several hundred women.
And currently, Marquis Ardent Fire had a total of 36 children. There were even many more grandsons and descendants beneath the family tree. Hence, the direct bloodline under Marquis Ardent Fire was not considered noble. Only those who could reach the Void God realm would have a slightly higher status. As for the many ‘madams’ within, their ranks were naturally much lower. Unless they gave birth to very formidable children-the status of these madams was determined by the sons they gave birth to!
“Yue’er, I find that this ‘Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea’ has a much weaker medicinal efficiency as compared to what the rumors spoke.” Within the house, the madam transmitted, “Ai, your little brother in my stomach is innately weaker, and if the help from the Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea isn’t great, he might not even become a True God after being born! With a weak bloodline, his cultivation in the future will be much weaker.”
“Mother, Eldest Madam will not dare to prevent you from having the Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea, but it is quite easy for her to scheme something else.” The green-robed girl transmitted back.
These words were what she did not dare to speak in public.
“Your little brother should be the 340th child of your father. He is innately weaker, and would likely not have a bright future. Your father would disdain to even give him a look.” The madam shook his head. That time, she was an ordinary girl within the Ardent Fire City. It was only because of appearances that brought her into the Marquisdom. That husband of hers then copulated with her before throwing her aside.
…
On another side.
“That lowly woman has already drunk the Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea.” The old man respectfully said.
Seated there was a red-robed girl. Her aura was vast, and she was at the Void God Unity realm.
“Mn, this lowly woman is quite fertile. Previously, she gave birth to a daughter, and now, that trash has given birth to another one, and a boy this time.” The red-robed girl coldly chuckled, “But it’s useless. Even if these lowly women gave birth to more, everything would be pointless.”
“Madam, madam.”
A shout came from outside.
A middle-aged man ran over with a mischievous smile. He bowed: “Madam, I am currently penniless; I do not have even a single Cosmos Crystal with me.”
“Ying Shan Lie Hu, you only know how to drink and enjoy yourself. You have already spent finished the resources allocated by Marquis Grandpa for you. This is the final bit, so don’t come to seek me for more. There will be no more.” The red-robed girl waved her hand in frustration. A storage wristband was thrown over. After the middle-aged man took it and refined it, he checked through the wristband before walking off with a mischievous smile: “Many thanks, madam.”
“This trash.”
That red-robed girl felt angry after looking at her husband.
Her husband was merely at the True God Ruler! He was not even a Void God. It was fortunate that he had been one of few personal sons of Marquis Ardent Fire, and was the second child. Marquis Ardent Fire gave birth to this child when he was slightly weaker, and hence, had quite the sentiments for him. That was why Marquis Ardent Flame arranged a somewhat massive resource for this second son of his.
Marquis Ardent Fire, being a City Master, owned a vast territory, many cavern-dwellings, and shops within the Ardent Fire City.
Furthermore, Marquis Ardent Fire had constructed nine great cities, with each city containing an incarnation of his guarding it! Naturally, the majority of the resources were kept by Marquis Ardent Fire, and he had arranged for part of it to be given away.
“My clan actually made me marry to such trash.” The red-robed girl felt frustrated. She originated from an aristocratic clan, and had a precious status, and was even at the Unity realm! Her bloodline was naturally much purer. Marquis Ardent Fire was clearly sentimental to his second child. He was personally involved in the discussion for this marriage, hoping for someone formidable in the children of the second son to appear.
‘But it is fortunate that he is trashy enough.’ The red-robed girl coldly laughed after that.
Under her husband’s name, there were many shops and territories. He had many resources, which naturally fell into her control after she was married into the family. Furthermore, she had used various ostensible purposes, for instance, father bestowing upon his son, to transfer the resources to her son.
It was only that she was afraid of the sentiment Marquis Ardent Fire had towards her husband, which made her follow along with her husband on the surface.
…
Within the stomach of the mother.
Xue Ying was concentrating on listening to the voices outside. Hearing the discontent complaints from both his mother and sister, he was able to get some understanding: ‘What, I am the 340th child of my father? A cultivator could actually have so many children?’ Over at his hometown, the stronger the cultivator, the harder it would be to have children. For instance, both he and his wife Jing Qiu had merely given birth to Yu’er and Qing Yao when they were weaker and were still in the material realm. After that, they no longer were able to give birth to any children.
340 children?
That was kind of mad right?
‘It seems that mother’s status is quite low in this Marquisdom.’ Xue Ying thought. He personally did not mind. Xue Ying was currently controlling his body to absorb the nourishment coming from that Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea. Even though he could slightly move his limbs, and the medicinal efficiency was much weaker, every part he could absorb was one more part. To Xue Ying, it was not difficult for him to become stronger even if there were no external assistance.
‘I should slowly accumulate. I do not know how long I’ll stay in the womb.’ Xue Ying could vaguely feel that he still had quite a long period before being given birth.

chapters.title: Chapter 998 - Activating the Bloodline
chapters.content:
Chapter 998: Activating the Bloodline
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Being someone who personally created two techniques at the ninth level, and an expert who could fight with Cosmos Gods, Xue Ying had made his decision after feeling the laws and profound mysteries present in the Realm Heart Great Land.
‘I’ve heard from my mother saying that the talent of the infant currently in her stomach is weaker?’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly, ‘Who would have thought that my current lifeforce that is comparable to World Deities as an unborn child is considered weak? Furthermore, this mother has a meager status in the Marquisdom, and she is weak too. Her scope of experience should be quite limited. Since she mentioned about the unborn child in her stomach is weak, then it is truly weak.’
‘Mn.’
‘This Marquisdom actually prepared some spiritual medicine for every unborn child. Clearly, they pay a lot of attention on the bloodline of infants given birth. Since that’s the case, I must be outstanding enough when I am given birth! I should become a ‘child of the heaven’ when I come to this world, attracting enough attention such that the Marquisdom will nurture me with its entire strength. After that, they should be able to understand when I become talented enough in the future.’ Xue Ying made his decision.
He had to make himself become a ‘child of the heaven’.
‘Out of the four Dao paths which I am most familiar with, the most similar path is the ‘Void’ between the primal chaos void and the Realm Heart Great Land. Cultivating the Void would be ten or a hundred times simpler.’ Xue Ying nodded inwardly, ‘I shall choose it then.’
Furthermore, Xue Ying had discovered one point. He had many hidden bloodlines within his body, and each had their own specialties. Clearly, they were all passed down from his ancestors. There were even a total of 11 void-related bloodlines, though they seemed quite weak. The most formidable bloodline within these 11 was actually bloodline belonging to a Cosmos God.
Even though it was slightly weaker, it was not a problem to Xue Ying at all!
‘Judging by the bloodline in my body, it seems the forefather of this lineage of mine should gear towards fire.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘It’s a pity that I am not good at the Dao of fire. I shall choose the void bloodline of that Cosmos God ancestor then!’
‘It is decided.’
Xue Ying made his decision. According to his bloodline, it seemed that he was separated by a few generations from this Cosmos God, resulting in a diluted bloodline left in his body.
Over time.
Day passed by day. Month passed by month.
The unborn child in the stomach gradually became stronger. Naturally, he had broken through the World Deity realm. His soul became stronger, allowing Xue Ying to cultivate faster and allowing his comprehension of the void bloodline to grow deeper. Xue Ying’s realm was ultimately too profound. Hence, he could cultivate with blazing speed. Nevertheless, he was absorbing the world energy outside very gently. Even though it was gentle, Xue Ying was absorbing it constantly, perfectly fusing the incoming world energy into his body and allowing it to grow stronger.
‘It has been three years. Why do I find that it is still too early before I will be given birth?’ Xue Ying felt puzzled, ‘How long do I have to stay in my mother’s stomach?’
…
Within a desolate courtyard inside the Ardent Fire Marquisdom.
There was only a disobedient female servant serving her madam. Rong Xing Lan was feeling quite delighted recently because she saw hope.
“It seems that my child is growing very quickly.” Rong Xing Lan caressed her stomach. She could feel the aura of the unborn child becoming stronger, “He should be a stage three World Deity currently.”
“Mother, that time, I was only given birth after 15 years in your stomach. It seems the talent of my little brother is much higher, and he should stay in it for a longer period.” The green-robed girl by her side was filled with expectations. Every disciple with a high status within the Ardent Fire Marquisdom would have a bunch of madams, and the disciples were even brothers and sisters related by blood, yet none would greet each other when they met. There was not really any strong relationship between them.
Instead, it was the children that belonged to the same mother that had a stronger relationship. Due to the presence of a secret technique, it was considered normal for a woman to give birth to two to three powerful children in her lifetime.
“Mn, from how I see, your little brother might stay in my stomach for more than 50 years or even 80 years.” The eyes of Rong Xing Lan were bright. She could see hope in her future after living half a life in mediocrity, “He will be nourished and become more perfect. I can even drink more Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea.”
A bowl of Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea would be sent every year.
The longer the unborn child stayed in the mother’s stomach, the more Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea he would drink. The Marquisdom would be delighted to provide more since the longer the child remained in the stomach, the higher his potential and bloodline. Those who were given birth as True God in the history of the Ardent Fire Marquisdom had been nourished in the stomach for 100-200 years. They came out as Rulers.
Within Southern Cloud Nation, in other aristocratic clans, some infants remained in the stomach of the mother for several hundred years before coming into this world as Void Gods! Only the most talented Void Creatures in the primal chaos void where Xue Ying originated from would be given birth as Void Gods.
‘The moment your little brother comes out, he should be a True God. He would be able to cultivate even faster.” The madam ‘Rong Xing Lan’ caressed her stomach. Currently, her face was brimming in brightness.
…
During the ninth year.
Rong Xing Lan was shocked as she noticed the aura in her stomach grew to another level-True God realm!
“He became a True God?” Rong Xing Lan felt exceptionally excited, “It seems that the bloodline in my son is extremely formidable.”
Even though his father, Ying Shan Lie Hu was trash, being the son of Marquis Ardent Fire, he was only at the True God Ruler realm. Nevertheless, the mother Rong Xing Lan was weaker-just a World Deity.
According to logic, their children would be weak. But sometimes, there might be an era transcendent appearing since it was possible for bloodlines to be activated after being passed down.
From how Rong Xing Lan sees, her son should clearly have an extraordinary bloodline.
“Madam, this is the Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea sent over by the Marquisdom.” It was another year, and the Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea was sent over by the female servant. The female servant carried a wooden tray over, and a cold old man was standing outside the courtyard doors.
“My mother is slightly weaker, so please send it in.” The green-robed girl went out and shouted.
“Drink it outside the courtyard” The cold old man ordered. The Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea had to be drunk by any madams conceiving a child. That was the rule of the Marquisdom! As the statuses of the girls in the Marquisdom were very low, they could never afford to purchase a bowl of Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea even if they saved up for their entire life. If these Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea were not drunk by the madams, they might just sell it instead.
Hence, the elders must see them drink the tea personally!
“Yes.”
Even though Rong Xing Lan was not willing, she still came out. Furthermore, she had swiftly come out to gulp down the Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea before immediately entering the house after that.
“Stand still.” The cold old man shouted.
Rong Xing Lan trembled.
The expression of that cold old man changed slightly before he turned and left.
Rong Xing Lan and the green-robed girl were standing side by side as they watched the cold old man leave. Anxiety had appeared on their faces.
“Things are slightly troublesome. They have discovered it.” The green-robed girl transmitted.
“I knew I could not hide it the moment I come out. That old man will definitely discover it.” Rong Xing Lan gritted her teeth. The difference in aura between a World Deity and a True God was huge. Furthermore, the unborn baby in her stomach had reached the True God realm, and Rong Xing Lan was merely a World Deity! It was impossible for her to conceal the aura at all.
“Would eldest madam act?” The green-robed girl felt worried.
“I am not afraid! The Marquisdom pays huge attention to every single infant under the direct bloodline. The moment she acts, it will be a great offense!” Rong Xing Lan gritted, “Furthermore, I will protect my son even if I die.”
She was Rong Xing Lan. Half her life was spent as a commoner.
Previously, she was an ordinary weak little girl within the Ardent Fire City. After being captured away by that disciple of an aristocratic clan with high status, she could only endure and swallow her grievances. She had to tolerate even if she was bullied by the eldest madam. Nevertheless, this was the first time she revealed her weak little fangs in her life all for the sake of protecting this child of hers which had a bright future. None was permitted to destroy her child!

chapters.title: Chapter 999 - Shocking the World with his Birth
chapters.content:
Chapter 999: Shocking the World with his Birth
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the hall, the red-robed girl sat there staring at the polite old man.
“You say that the unborn child in that lowly woman Rong Xing Lan has become a True God?” The eyes of the red-robed girl were cold. The temperature within the hall had drastically reduced. That old man felt his heart trembling. He might be a Void God at the Origin Birth realm, but the eldest madam had long reached the Unity realm; she was much stronger and could kill him with a flip of her hands.
“Yes.” The old man felt his heart shaking, “I am absolutely sure.”
“If I am not wrong, she has only been pregnant for nine years.” The red-robed girl indifferently stated.
“Yes.” The old man nodded.
“It seems that she is quite fortunate to conceive such an infant with Lie Hu, for it to have such great innate talent. She has indeed contributed greatly to our Marquisdom.” The red-robed girl chuckled, “You go over and help me send these gifts so that she could properly nurture her baby. Currently, that infant in her stomach is extremely important. No matter what, he is still the child of Lie Hu.”
The old man felt puzzled.
Send some gifts?
…
Year passed by year. The eldest madam was indeed kind. She had arranged for gifts to be sent to Rong Xing Lan almost every single month. Rong Xing Lan was cautious too and would not touch anything sent over by the eldest madam! But she eventually discovered that those gifts were all treasures after asking her daughter to sell them-which she sold at a high price. It seemed that the eldest madam did not have any vicious intention.
In the blink of an eye, Rong Xing Lan had been pregnant for 15 years, and the aura in the stomach had reached the Paragon realm.
“Reporting to madam, the Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea for this year has been ingested by Rong Xing Lan.” The old man came back.
“Is the baby in Little Sister Xing Lan still alright?” The red-robed girl chuckled.
“He is fine. It is still at the Paragon realm.” The old man said.
“Mn, go over to the 2nd affair management to get some gifts and send over.” The red-robed girl laughed. At the same time, her voice directly sounded in the soul of that old man, “Remember, this time, the bottle of spiritual medicine must be drunk by that lowly woman Rong Xing Lan! She must drink it.”
The old man felt his heart trembling.
Not good.
Previously, even though she had sent many gifts, she did not force the other party to drink it. As for the ‘Seventh Dawn Spirit Scented Tea’, it was a rule for all pregnant madams to drink in the Marquisdom! Right now, he was asked to force Rong Xing Lan to consume the gift sent by eldest madam, and the old man was not foolish at all.
“Madam, you can’t do this. The rules of the Ying Shan Clan are strict. This is a huge offense. The moment we are discovered, we would be killed.” The old man replied via his soul too. He did not dare to say it out loud in fear of being killed by the eldest madam after angering her. After all, the eldest madam had merely transmitted a message to him via soul and did not leave behind any pieces of evidence.
“Manager Tian, it is either your entire family dies with you, or you listen to me obediently. Rest assured. There will not be anything happening to that infant in the stomach of Rong Xing Lan after drinking it. It would merely result in a baby with a more ordinary talent.” The red-robed girl transmitted, “There are currently too many ordinary disciples within the Ardent Fire Marquisdom, and no one will care about him. Furthermore, I have arranged for a treasure that would influence the time-space for you, so that nobody would discover that it has been committed by you through the reversal of time flow. Alright, you decide if you are going to do it or not.”
The old man felt his heart turning bitter.
Would he dare to reject now that he knew what the eldest madam wanted to do? If he refused, his entire family would be killed. Even though he had committed many vile acts in the past, going against the ‘Ying Shan Clan’s rules was a capital offense and would be punishable by death. He still felt his heart trembling from the thought of it.
“Yes, this old servant will definitely not disappoint madam.” The old man transmitted back.
“Go.” The red-robed girl chuckled, “Help me ask if Little Sister Xing Lan is doing fine.”
“Yes.” The old man said too. He immediately left.
The red-robed girl watched silently. The killing intent in her heart was surging: ‘Hmph, such a lowly woman. I do not take her as a threat, yet that infant in her stomach is quite amazing. The moment he is given birth, he will definitely take up a large portion of the resources in my lineage.”
She had long treated the resources under her husband’s name as hers! Indeed, many shops, cavern-dwellings, and territories were all governed by her people. If she wanted to distribute the resources, they could only be given to her own child!
Other threats? They had long been eliminated.
‘Once that infant in the stomach of that lowly woman grows up, I will find a chance to make him die soundlessly. There is also the matter of Manager Tian. After this matter is done, he will die first.’ The red-robed girl thought.
******
The old man came over to the little courtyard of Rong Xing Lan.
“Manager Tian.” Rong Xing Lan brought her daughter and came along with the female servant to greet him.
“Haha, I came upon orders by the eldest madam to send you some gifts.” The old man laughed before waving his hand, causing a basket to appear. The basket was placed with several gifts, and they were all sent over. Rong Xing Lan received them with a smile. Over the past few years, this Manager Tian had sent many gifts over, and there were no issues with them at all.
When the old man passed the basket over, he flipped his hand before causing a black jade bottle to appear. He chuckled, “This jade bottle is an extremely precious spiritual liquid that madam has prepared for you. Come, drink it.”
“Please pass my thanks to madam.” Rong Xing Lan took it over.
“Since it is a precious spiritual liquid, you shouldn’t sell it outside. Many of the gifts that had been sent by the madam in the past were sold by you all.” The old man chuckled, “So you should still drink it directly.” Saying that, an unseen energy restricted Rong Xing Lan and forced her to drink the liquid.
Rong Xing Lan was much astonished.
So…
The dagger was finally revealed after six years?
“No, no.” Rong Xing Lan struggled. She could feel the infant in her stomach getting stronger and had dreamt of how her son would become bright and dazzling in the future. Right now, how could she drink this strange spiritual liquid that was in the black jade bottle?
“Stop!” The green-robed girl Ying Shan Xi Yue was greatly startled. Even though she knew there were many dark and cruel things happening within the aristocratic clans, she would not have thought that it would implicate an infant under the direct bloodline. This was an ironclad rule of the whole Ying Shan Clan, that those who dared to act against an infant of the direct bloodline would be punishable by death. She who was slightly cowardly had directly moved to stop the old man.
“Hong.”
The old man casually waved his hand, causing the green-robed girl Ying Shan Xi Yue to fall heavily onto the ground. Under the unseen energy, she was suppressed to the extent that she could not move. Ying Shan Xi Yue coldly shouted: “What you are doing is a capital offense! A capital offense! If you want, come and deal against me.”
“Don’t touch my child. He hasn’t been given birth!” Rong Xing Lan felt terrified. Her eyes were filled with misery as she begged the old man.
The old man remained emotionless.
Don’t blame me… I want to live. My family wants to live too. If you’re going to blame, go blame the eldest madam!
“Gu gu gu.” The spiritual liquid in the black bottle had been directly poured into the mouth of Rong Xing Lan. Rong Xing Lan’s mouth had been pried open by an unseen energy, and the liquid was controlled to enter her body. Rong Xing Lan felt despair. Tears were flowing down her face. Why… she was even filled with the resolution to protect her son with her life, yet it was futile as she struggled.
The servant beside trembled as she watched this scene personally. It terrified her.
This was a huge offense!
“Don’t be worried.” The old man looked at the female servant. He transmitted over, “Just act as if you had not seen it. The time-space here is distorted, making it pointless for the reversal of time flow to work.”
After drinking it, the old man kept the black jade bottle before leaving.
Rong Xing Lan fell down softly onto the ground. Her face was filled with tears. Her eyes were filled with despair: “Why, why? If you want to do anything, just deal against me. Why are you acting against my child.”
“Mother.” Ying Shan Xi Yue hurried over and embrace her mother, “Is it possible for you to expel that poisonous liquid?”
“It is useless, useless.” Rong Xing Lan shook her head, “The moment I drank it, it’ll rapidly permeate through my body. I cannot resist it at all.”
“Not good.” Rong Xing Lan held her stomach, “I feel that I am about to give birth!”
Ying Shan Xi Yue felt greatly shocked. Her mother was about to give birth?
“What kind of vile poison is this that actually forced her to give birth?” Ying Shan Xi Yue immediately brought her mother back to her house, closed the door and prepared for conception.
…
That’s right. He was about to undergo a premature birth.
But Rong Xing Lan and her daughter had blamed the eldest madam wrongly. The poisonous liquid arranged by the eldest madam was meant to injure the innate talent of the infant, and not for the infant to come out immediately. It was Xue Ying who decided to come out immediately instead.
‘Damn.’ Xue Ying was cultivating on the void within the stomach of his mother. He could vaguely feel everything that happened in the outer world, and felt anger striking his eyes, ‘I can’t stay on like this. I do not know what would happen if I were to remain within.’
Even though the venomous liquid was about to permeate into the infant body of his…
Xue Ying’s body rapidly withdrew. It immediately turned small. After all, as a True God, he could easily change the size of his body and easily cut himself off the embryo, preventing the poisonous liquid from transmitting into his body.
‘Time to leave.’ He controlled the void and forced the embryo to exit.
Rong Xing Lan also felt her stomach getting painful.
Lying on her bed, Rong Xing Lan tried enduring it and wanted her child to stay for a longer period in her stomach.
“Ah, he has to be given birth now.” Rong Xing Lan’s face was filled with tears. Her hair was even soaking from her tears.
“That eldest madam is too venomous.” Ying Shan Xi Yue felt anxious.
“Come out.”
Rong Xing Lan extended her hand into her stomach. “Hu”, following that, she directly grabbed a fleshy sphere out. A round fleshy body fell directly onto the bed. It was relatively easy for a World Deity to let her child out.
That red round fleshy ball contained some secretive golden patterns revolving on it. This was also a secret technique used for nurturing an infant to make it stronger.
“Activate.”
Xue Ying who was currently within the round fleshy ball activated the bloodline in his body once again. His realm had already reached a sufficient stage. Previously, it was because he did not want to create a massive disturbance and was merely gently absorbing the world energy in the outer world. Now that he was given birth… his motive was to shock the whole world. Naturally, he completely activated the void bloodline in his body. It’s a pity that he had cultivated for just ten years or more, and could only enable part of the void bloodline in his body.
“Hong!”
One could see the golden veins on the round rolling red fleshy ball being activated. It abruptly let out a dazzling light and at the same time, caused the world energy to rush over, creating a massive maelstrom of a light pillar. Everything rushed into the round rolling fleshy ball.
The old man who just left the small courtyard to report to the eldest madam suddenly turned over. He watched with shock as the sky formed a world energy maelstrom: ‘Who dares to be so daring to dare absorb the world energy from within the Marquisdom? Even if he is cultivating, he should be cultivating in closed doors.”
“Hong.”
“That is-”
“That golden light?”
The Ardent Fire Marquisdom was incomparably vast. There were many experts within. Currently, they extended their senses over to this location and were able to see the maelstrom of the light pillar with golden light shooting in all directions: “That is the golden light given out by the descent of an infant. It is so intense?”
The array spirit within the Ardent Fire Marquisdom perceived the disturbance. It naturally controlled the arrays and descended in this small courtyard to examine what had happened. After understanding the situation, it immediately went to report to all higher-ups within the entire Ardent Fire Marquisdom-
“Ying Shan Lie Hu’s son has been given birth! He is a Void God at birth, and his mother is Rong Xing Lan!”
The moment this information was released, the entire Ardent Fire Marquisdom shook.
At the same time, this information was spread at the fastest pace towards all the Ying Shan clansmen. There was merely a branch within the Ardent Fire Marquisdom, and for such outstanding disciple to be given birth, it sufficed to startle the entire clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1000 - Movement from all Places
chapters.content:
Chapter 1000: Movement from all Places
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
More than a trillion people lived in the Ardent Fire Marquisdom. Experts numbered as many as the clouds in the sky. Nevertheless, those who were qualified to be in the highest level of the entire Marquisdom included only ‘Marquis Ardent Fire’ and several other elders.
In other to become an elder of the Ardent Fire Marquisdom, the requirements were harsh.
Under normal circumstances, only disciples from the Ying Shan clan wielding strength at the ‘God Yuan Palace fifth level’ would be qualified to become an elder! Naturally, there were exceptions like the 36 children of Ardent Fire Marquisdom. They were after all the children of Marquis Ardent Fire and had a slightly more unique status. For instance, ‘Ying Shan Lie Hu’ was merely a True God Ruler yet he was allocated a huge amount of resources! The direct children of Marquis Ardent Fire only had to reach the ‘Unity realm’ before they could become elders.
Also…
Honored Guests from the outside had to be completely loyal to the Ardent Fire Marquisdom before the Marquisdom would even nurture them. In other words, they had to reach the ‘God Yuan Palace sixth level’ strength before they could become an elder.
“What? He is a Void God at birth?”
“This, this…”
“This is the only child who was born as a Void God ever since the start of our Ardent Fire Marquisdom right? And hearsay his father is Ying Shan Lie Hu?”
“Ying Shan Lie Hu? He is the second son of Grandpa Marquis? How could he give birth to such a formidable child?”
The elders were all very shocked.
They held derision for Ying Shan Lie Hu since ultimately, cultivators emphasized greatly on strength, and he was merely trash at the True God Ruler. As for Rong Xing Lan? They had never heard of her before. Right now, such trash and an unknown girl actually gave birth to a Void God child?
“Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou!”
Many streams of light shot into the sky from various locations within the Ardent Fire Marquisdom. They flew at high speed towards this desolate little courtyard. Because the Ardent Fire Marquisdom occupied a considerable area, and there were arrays which prevented anyone from teleporting, flying required time! Actually, there were very few Unity experts who could teleport even if the arrays did not exist since the suppression of the Realm Heart Great Land was much stronger than that of the primal chaos void.
The five great sacred worlds were either remnant pieces left behind after the original world shattered, or they were created by Cosmos Gods. It was impossible for those worlds to compare to the Realm Heart Great Land.
“This is that child?” Those who were originally slightly closer to this desolate little courtyard took just a breath to reach. There was a round and red fleshy ball floating within that small courtyard. It stirred up a massive maelstrom of world energy. Furthermore, there were many golden veins lighted up on this fleshy ball that emitted a splendid light.
The two elders who first reached and other experts who were attracted by the creation of such huge disturbances and were not too clear of what happened came to spectate that red round fleshy ball with slight astonishment. That golden light emanating from the ball had practically blinded them.
This might be the only chance in their life that they would see such huge disturbance created from the birth of a baby!
The house had long been destroyed by the surging world energy. Primarily, it was because Rong Xing Lan’s status was too low, so the house she lived in was ordinary too. At this moment, Rong Xing Lan and her daughter, Ying Shan Xi Yue and that female servant were looking in a daze at the maelstrom light pillar formed by the attraction of world energy, and that round red fleshy ball emanating golden light.
Such a huge disturbance had frightened them.
“Mn?”
There was a lake located lake inside the Marquisdom with many dragon beasts swimming. By its bank, a red-haired male sat there fishing. Concentric circles of fluctuation were being formed underneath the fishing rod which lured those dragon beasts over. Suddenly, he revealed a joyous look and fiercely pulled up the rod. “Hua-”, an enormous violet dragon beast was fished up by him. This violet dragon beast struggled violently in horror.
“Bring this violet-blooded dragon beast and make it into a great dish for me.” The red-haired male laughed voraciously. Suddenly, he turned his head slightly towards a corner of the entire Ardent Fire Marquisdom. That was a slightly more desolate area, though a dazzling maelstrom light pillar formed from world energy and a vague golden light could be seen. This made that red-haired male reveal a happy look. Following that, he got the news from the array spirit-”The child of Ying Shan Lie Hu has been born! He is a Void God at birth, and his mother is Rong Xing Lan!”
The red-haired male laughed happily at that moment.
“Hahaha…”
His laughter was light a racing thunder, rumbling in the sky.
‘Lie Hu that child is not bad. He has actually produced a Void God child for me, and that has never happened before!’ The red-haired male, Marquis Ardent Fire, felt extremely delighted. He casually swung the fishing rod in his hand before letting that horrified violet dragon beast off into the lake. Clearly, this marquis was feeling great, so he decided to let that violet-blooded dragon beast off.
“Go.”
The red-haired male directly disappeared from the vicinity.
Being the highest overlord in the entire Marquisdom, even though the array forbade others from teleporting, he could easily control the array to prevent himself from being affected. And as a Primal Chaos giant, each and every one of them could easily teleport and had rushed over to his destination in a flash.
“Hu.”
The red-haired male Marquis Ardent Fire arrived in the air above that desolate little courtyard. He looked down at the red round fleshy ball that was emanating golden light before looking at the house that was destroyed from the maelstrom light pillar. Marquis Ardent Fire then looked towards Xong Xing Lan and the female servant who was standing there foolishly: ‘It seems that the mother of this little prince of my Ardent Fire Marquisdom is quite ordinary.’
“Grandpa Marquis.” The two elders who had rushed over already greeted with a bow. The other experts who were around the vicinity were shocked too. They immediately greeted with respect: “Grandpa Marquis.”
“Grandpa Marquis?”
Rong Xing Lan who was still slightly in befuddlement, Ying Shan Xi Yue and that female servant all turned towards who rushed over, and that red-haired male. They heard as everyone greeted ‘Grandpa Marquis’ respectfully… Rong Xing Lan could naturally guess that this was the legendary existence within the Ardent Fire Marquisdom, a Primal Chaos existence whom they have never seen before-Marquis Ardent Fire!
…
The elders were all rushing over. They had also spread this crucial news down. Such a huge affair-a miraculous birth of a Void God child within Ardent Fire Marquisdom-naturally spread like wildfire.
The eldest madam, Chan Yu Yan Zhen, had a status that was slightly higher than her husband within the Marquisdom. After all, she had a God Yuan Palace fourth level strength, and also came from an aristocratic family. Her eldest son was currently at the Unity realm. She was naturally able to obtain the news very quickly.
“Little Sister Yan Zhen, congratulations, I hear that this child who is a Void God at birth is the child of your man, Ying Shan Lie Hu.”
“Little Sister Yan Zhen…”
“Yan Zhen, it is the child of both Ying Shan Lie Hu and Rong Xing Lan. He is even a Void God at birth.”
With her network of connection, she was able to obtain the information from three different sources.
This caused the expression on the eldest madam, ‘Chan Yu Yan Zhen’ to change instantaneously. She was still waiting for a report from Manager Tian in the palace hall quietly.
‘What? Did Manager Tian not go and send the medicine? Why did that lowly woman give birth immediately, and even giving birth to a Void God? Was he not just a Paragon previously?” The red-robed girl ‘Chan Yu Yan Zhen’ was honestly panicking at this moment. With her heart realm, she could not control her emotions, causing the expression on her face to transform. One could see how terrified she was.
She knew that a Void God child at birth was unprecedented in the Ardent Fire Marquisdom! Grandpa Marquis would most likely be paying close attention to this. It was possible for Ying Shan Clan ancestral family to send someone of the high level over. This was a huge affair for the entire Ying Shan clan.
The moment they discovered her vicious acts…
Wanted to act against the infant?
She was dead for sure.
The red-robed girl gritted her teeth. She rapidly headed out. Her figure had even formed afterimages. After all, those under the lineage of her husband Ying Shan Lie Hu stayed around this region! She was able to easily guess the path that Manager Tian would take.
Very soon, just about ten breaths of time later.
The red-robed girl saw Manager Tian walking over.
“Madam.” Manager Tian saw the madam before greeted immediately, “The gift has been sent.” His identity was low. Even though he was a manager, he was still a servant. Hence, he did not know of the fact that the child in Rong Xing Lan’s stomach had already been given birth, and was even a Void God.
“Oh?” The red-robed girl slightly chuckled, “I’ll go over to Little Sister Xing Lan to have a look.”
Saying that, she walked past the shoulder of Manager Tian.
Manager Tian stood blankly at his original position.
And after that, his body began breaking apart silently, turning into nothingness. There were only his belongings left behind.
“Hmph, you dare to disobey me? And even scheme against me!” The red-robed girl sneered. But everything was merely an act. She wanted to prevent some ultra expert from investigating everything, and hence, had begun to eliminate all evidence.
‘This trash has even said that the gift was sent? Then how did that Rong Xing Lan give birth to that child who is so formidable? That lowly woman is too lucky. But with her lowly identity, she would definitely not dare to inform Grandpa Marquis and the elders regarding what had happened.’ The red-robed girl was looking forward to it, hoping that this matter would not be revealed. But hope could never be entrusted on others.
‘How could I, Chan Yu Yan Zhen, be doomed just like this?’ The red-robed girl felt proud and arrogant. After all, she was just a step away from becoming an elder of the Marquisdom. She had always been slightly careful whenever conducting something huge. At this moment, she was doing her best to cover up all the gaps in her actions.
Naturally, the biggest flaw in her scheme, Manager Tian, had been eliminated!

chapters.title: Chapter 1001 - Fury
chapters.content:
Chapter 1001: Fury
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As the eldest madam, Chan Yu Yan Zhen was doing her best to remove all evidence, within a huge array teleportation inside the Ardent Fire City.
“Weng.”
A distorted blackhole-alike maelstrom appeared within the teleportation array. Two figures walked out of it. They were both wearing golden-rimmed black robes and were looking towards the Marquisdom.
“Who would have thought that a Void God child has emerged even in the lineage of Marquis Ardent Fire. This is truly rare.”
“There have only been two such geniuses being born in our Ying Shan clan, and they were both able to reach the Unity realm very quickly. One of them has even reached the Primal Chaos realm, establishing the ‘Nine Dragon Marquisdom’. The other is weaker, though he still reached the God Yuan Palace sixth level.” These two elders that came from the Ying Shan Clan chatted delightfully.
They were quite envious.
Those who were born with such incredible strength meant that they had powerful bloodlines. The stronger their bloodlines, the easier it would be for them to cultivate. Those with weaker and diluted bloodlines… when they checked their own bloodline internally, it was akin to looking at a flower amidst the fog—blurry and vague! And those with a strong bloodline would be able to feel their bloodline easily. The difficulty of cultivation was much easier by a hundred to a thousand time.
“Sou.”
The two of them directly teleported away. The Ardent Fire City was too big, and flying was too slow. Both of them were elders sent over by the ancestral family, and one knew how to teleport.
They were able to rush to the Ardent Fire Marquisdom very quickly.
“Two elders of the ancestral family, please come over.” A voice sounded by their ears. The array of Ardent Fire Marquisdom suppressing both elders temporarily withdrew.
“Grandpa Marquis.” The two ancestral family elders immediately teleported over. They knew where to head towards to as that maelstrom light pillar was dazzling, and there was even golden light emanating from that region.
…
As the two elders of the ancestral family reached, Marquis Ardent Fire, the elders of the Marquisdom, other Ying Shan Clan disciples with sufficiently high statuses, and honored guest experts were watching this scene. The courtyard below was honestly too small, and they could not even descend.
“Fellow elders of the ancestral family that came from afar, please wait momentarily as this child will soon come out.” The red-haired male Marquis Ardent Fire stood by the side with a smile.
Many people had already gathered by the surroundings. They were all people with sufficiently high statuses. Those with lower status did not dare to get close. The eldest madam ‘Chan Yu Yan Zhen’ was also amongst those that were further behind. She was able to see the elders from the ancestral family and Grandpa Marquis watching at that round fleshy body emitting golden light with high expectations. She could not help but grit her teeth: ‘The final evidence must be removed too.’
“Weng.”
Her expression turned blank slightly, and her face soon regained its normalcy.
Time passed. It seemed to move really slowly.
At this moment, all the higher-ups within the Ardent Fire Marquisdom were looking downwards with rapt attention. Rong Xing Lan had already regained her wits, and she along with her daughter Ying Shan Xi Yue was looking at the fleshy ball with hope.
“Hua—” The red and round fleshy body suddenly split open. A boy with tender skin and red lips appeared. He was currently wearing skin-tight clothing.
This child emitted an aura that was at the Void God realm.
The next moment, this boy who was barefooted leaped and directly knelt down in front of Rong Xing Lan, stating: “This child greets mother!”
Xue Ying was kneeling down with sincerity and willingness. He was able to sense what had happened outside through the void while still in his mother’s stomach and knew what happened regarding Manager Tian. He was able to see the appearances of both his mother and sister doing their best to save him and also the expression of despair and tears his mother had. Xue Ying could sense that his mother was treating him with greater importance than her own life, and this feeling was mutual. Xue Ying similarly respected and loved his mother.
As for that father of his in this life? Hmph hmph, Xue Ying had been in the stomach for 15 years, yet he had never seen that father of his even once! Xue Ying currently did not recognize his father, much less having feelings for him.
“Good, good.” Rong Xing Lan excitedly pulled her son up. The fleshy little arms melted the heart of Rong Xing Lan. Her face was filled with bliss, and that came from deep her heart.
“Haha… this child is really filial.” An elder from the ancestral family laughed from midair. Marquis Ardent Fire nodded with a smile too. The experts around Marquisdom all began praising him at that moment.
They were not puzzled about Xue Ying’s intelligence.
Even those slightly more ordinary infants from Ying Shan Clan would have stayed in the womb for dozens of years before being born, and their intelligence was extraordinary.
Marquis Ardent Fire announced with a smile: “Rong Xing Lan, have you thought of a name for this child of yours?”
“Not yet.” Rong Xing Lan replied.
Her status was low, and previously, she did not even have the qualifications to name her child. Usually, it would be Ying Shan Lie Hu who named the child.
“I’ll give myself a name.” The child that was in her embrace jumped out. Facing the cultivators standing in midair, he was not afraid at all. Instead, his voice clearly resounded in the surroundings: “Xue Ying!”
“Xue Ying? Ying Shan Xue Ying?” Marquis Ardent Fire chuckled, “This little fellow is quite extraordinary to know that he should give himself a name after coming to birth.”
“His temperament is extraordinary, so naturally, he is different from the commoners.” The tall and thin elder from the ancestral family praised him. Another slightly plump ancestral family elder was also laughing as he brought out a bizarre palm-sized golden bent hook and directly threw it towards Xue Ying, “Little Fellow Ying Shan Xue Ying, the two of us has come under order to pass you this Ying Shan Golden Order.”
The child extended his hand before grabbing that Ying Shan Golden Order. He felt curious and puzzled over it.
“This Ying Shan Golden Order is only given to the most important disciples of my Ying Shan Clan, and it is personally bestowed by the Ancestor herself.” Marquis Ardent Fire smiled, “Those who are bestowed this order talisman will have a status similar to the elders within my Marquisdom. Furthermore, you can also proceed to the ancestral family and peruse through the books within. The ancestral family will also send many treasures to you.”
The people present felt envious as they listened.
The Marquisdom was ultimately too big, and there were many cultivators. Naturally, they were divided into different levels. There were a total of six grades in the Marquisdom.
Most of the servants were practically at the lowest rank, the sixth grade.
Some of ‘madams’ who had never given birth before were also of the lowest sixth grade. As for Rong Xing Lan, because she had given birth to a child before, Ying Shan Xi Yue who was of direct bloodline, the two of them were grade five.
Grade five… was ultimately still a low grade. After all, the head of a servant was already at the grade five rank. The two of them might be higher in class as compared to the ordinary servants, but they did not have any power, and could not control the servants. That was why the female servant disdained them.
Grade four was considered very high amongst servants. For instance, Manager Tian was at grade four.
These classes, grade four to six were considered the lower three grades.
As for those of class grade three to grade one, they were considered the upper three grades! Only those of the upper three grades were qualified to represent the Ardent Fire Marquisdom. And only those of the upper three grades from the Ardent Fire Marquisdom were qualified to say they were ‘aristocratic clan disciples’. Ying Shan Xi Yue who was merely at the True God strength, could only be considered a commoner when she traveled outside and was not qualified to call herself a disciple from an aristocratic clan.
After all…
The aristocratic clans had multiplied over the years, and they had many bloodlines. Those who were not outstanding enough could not represent the aristocratic clan.
The disciples from the aristocratic clan had many privileges. These privileges were governed by the laws of the Southern Cloud Nation.
“Ying Shan Golden Order? Grade equivalent to an elder? Furthermore, he has many privileges even in the ancestral family?” Many people were filled with jealousy. The eldest madam Chan Yu Yan Zhen felt even complex. She was a disciple of an aristocratic clan and was personally at the God Yuan Palace fourth level strength. She had also married into the Ying Shan Clan, yet she was only promoted to grade two after working for many years!
She still lacked a grade as compared to this child who was given birth… but this grade was incredibly huge.
Because in the entire Marquisdom, other than Grandpa Marquis, there were only a total of 15 elders! In other words, there were just these 15 elders who were of an equivalent grade in status with this child.
“Rong Xing Lan, you have contributed greatly, and you will be promoted to grade two within the Marquisdom right at this moment.” Marquis Ardent Fire said with a smile. Mothers were respected only when they had powerful sons. This was the rule of the Marquisdom.
“Many thanks, Grandpa Marquis.” Rong Xing Lan felt genuinely excited. In the blink of an eye, she had actually leaped towards heaven? From now on, she would have many servants, and would be protected by a large number of guards whenever she left her house?
A hunchbacked elder then said: “Rong Xing Lan, how long have you been pregnant for?”
“Pregnant for 15 years.” Rong Xing Lan immediately answered. The period of pregnancy for an infant would be recorded, especially for a genius son of heaven like Xue Ying.
“15 years?” Marquis Ardent Fire was shocked.
“Why would it be so short?” The two elders of the ancestral family were puzzled too.
“That’s too short, only for 15 years?” Practically almost all the experts surrounding the place were all startled. This child that was given birth had been so outstanding, and should have stayed in the womb for a long period! That was common knowledge. If Xue Ying remained in the womb for more than 300-400 years, they would not be shocked. Nevertheless, since he stayed for just 15 years, they were all shocked.
“I should not have come out so quickly.” A bright crisp voice was heard.
At that moment, all the gazes landed on Xue Ying. Watching this red-lipped boy who was chubby and barefooted, this child then said with slight indignance: “I had been comfortable in my mother’s stomach, yet I heard someone called Manager Tian who actually forced a poisonous liquid down the mouth of my mother. My mother has tried her best, yet she could not resist. I felt everything that happened in the external world and knew something was amiss. That was why I decided to cut off my connection to the embryo, and had to come out prematurely. If you all do not believe my words, you could investigate this matter. You will surely discover that poison.” Saying that he pointed towards that opened fleshy ball.
“What?””
“He was forced into birth prematurely?”
“Poisonous liquid?”
Everyone present was greatly startled, especially Marquis Ardent Fire who was ashen-gray. The elders had even reversed time practically at the same time. Even though the time-space was distorted, and they could not see Manager Tian at all, it was precisely this fact that it was interfered… that things were amiss! Furthermore, they were able to ascertain that Xue Ying had indeed been given birth after 15 years!
“Indeed, it has only been 15 years, yet he was able to have such a talent. Under normal circumstances, he might be able to stay in the stomach for a hundred to a thousand years, and his bloodline would be much more concentrated. By then, he could come out at the Unity realm.” All those present felt their hearts trembling. They could not help but grit their teeth.
Come out at the Unity realm?
In the entire Southern Cloud Nation, the number of cultivators who were Unity realm at birth could be counted with one’s finger. They would all be nurtured and protected with full power from the nation. All of them were able to reach the Primal Chaos realm easily and were all extraordinary. There were even as many as two Conferred Kings!
“How audacious!” The tall and thin elder from the ancestral family roared indignantly, “Such a proud son of the heaven coming from my Ying Shan clan is actually forced into the world after just 15 years? Otherwise, this little fellow Ying Shan Xue Ying would have a brighter future! Marquis Ardent Fire, there is actually someone from your Marquisdom that dares to go against the rule of my Ying Shan clan!”
Marquis Ardent Fire felt his rage shooting through the roof as well.
“Where is Ying Shan Lie Hu? Where is that person who is the father?” Marquis Ardent Fire roared. He swept his gaze across the surroundings, yet he could not see his son at all.
“He, he should still be at the Misty Cloud Pavilion.” An old man muttered from the side.
Ying Shan Lie Hu was weak, and would usually loiter around those entertainment parlors. The real elite higher level cultivators disdained from interacting with him. Naturally, none would specially transmit this news that his child was given birth. Hence, the father was still enjoying himself within the Misty Cloud Pavilion, and that was indeed a joke. But he had 300 to 400 children, and Ying Shan Lie Hu did not care about it at all.
“Investigate everything for me, investigate and find out who exactly was the one that acted. Also, capture that useless fool Ying Shan Lie Hu back at this moment.” Marquis Ardent Fire’s voice resounded across the world.
