None present dared to speak, and even Chan Yu Yan Zhen felt her heart trembling from the scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 1002 - Father Ying Shan Lie Hu
chapters.content:
Chapter 1002: Father Ying Shan Lie Hu
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Misty Cloud Pavilion was also the biggest money squandering establishment within Ardent Fire City. Many aristocratic clan disciples and cultivators loved coming here. As long as they had sufficient cosmos crystals, even the rarest treasure could be found here.
On a sealed battle platform, two True God Rulers were currently fighting madly. They were extremely powerful and could transcend beyond their realms to fight against Void Gods.
And around the battle platform, there were several aristocratic clan disciples and powerful cultivators scattered around the place. Almost all of them had brought along their servants and beautiful attendants. Even those powerful cultivators who came alone would have one or two beauties from the Misty Cloud Pavilion pouring wine and serving them.
Very soon, the battle ended.
One triumphed, and the other dissipated from the battle; the one who dispersed could no longer condense into being.
True Gods were considered ordinary in this place. Even ‘Ying Shan Xi Yue’ who had an aristocratic bloodline, was considered a commoner all because she was a True God. Less need to be described of True Gods with a weaker background-these people were of the lowest class, and if they were fortunate, they could leave peacefully. Otherwise, if they offended some huge character, they would likely lose their life.
Hence, those who had ambition would do their best to become experts.
And even though the risk of entering the ‘life-death battle platform’ was huge, they could earn a great deal from it. There would be one party dying during each battle, and the victor would gain a considerable amount of Origin World Rocks. Only by earning these resources could they cultivate at a faster speed.
“Truly trash! I spent so much effort yet he was so useless.” Ying Shan Lie Hu hurled the cup in his hand furiously. He gritted his teeth angrily.
“Prince Lie Hu, don’t be so mad. In a while, I’ll find a better guest for you. He’ll definitely not be so incompetent like this trash.” A beauty softly said by the side while feeding him wine.
“Fu’er, you said this the previous time too. Do you think I still dare to trust you?” Ying Shan Lie Hu turned around before stroking the jaw of this beauty. Almost all the beauties serving in the Misty Cloud Pavilion cultivated in some enchantment sorcery. Even powerful cultivators would see themselves falling unknowingly into a soft and warm dream. It felt truly comfortable.
“Prince Lie Hu, please feel rest assured. Fu’er will first go and find one. After finding one, you can have a look at the guest after that. It saddens Fu’er to hear you not believe in her.”
Just as Ying Shan Lie Hu was flirting with the beauty, suddenly, a plump male came over via the cloud path.
This plump male laughed from quite a distance away: “Hahaha, Prince Ying Shan Lie Hu, congratulations, congratulations.”
“Congratulations?” Ying Shan Lie Hu felt startled. He was overwhelmed by surprise.
Some of the aristocratic clan disciples and powerful experts present were shocked. They were able to recognize this plump male as the master of Misty Cloud Pavilion. He was someone famous in Ardent Fire City—’Chun Yu Feng’. The elder brother of Chun Yu Feng, ‘Chun Yu Wei Yi’ was also one of the two huge giants in the entire Ardent Fire City.
The other giant was naturally Marquis Ardent Fire.
Chun Yu Wei Yi was the owner of the ‘Southern Cloud Sacred Palace’, a place where experts numbered as many as the cloud in the sky. There were more experts in the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace than the Ardent Fire Marquisdom because the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace represented the ‘king’. More importantly, that slumbering incarnation of a Cosmos God protecting the Ardent Fire City was also the ancestor of the Chun Yu Clan—Monarch Chun Yu! That’s right, the Chun Yu Clan was one of the four greatest clans in the Southern Cloud Nation and was a clan that had a Cosmos God.
The royal family and the three great emperor graded clans formed up the four great clans in the nation.
Comparatively speaking, the Ying Shi Clan was weaker by a level since ‘Old Mother Ying Shan’ was merely a Conferred King.
Hence…
Being the little brother of Chun Yu Wei Yi, ‘Chun Yu Feng’ who governed the biggest money squandering establishment in the entire Ardent Fire City, the Misty Cloud Pavilion, his status was extremely high. He could sit on an equal level with those elders from the Ardent Fire Marquisdom. Ying Shan Lie Hu who was merely a True God Ruler… was someone that the owner of the Misty Cloud Pavilion, ‘Chun Yu Feng’, did not have to care.
“Chun Yu Pavilion Master, you are congratulating me?” Ying Shan Lie Hu immediately stood up. He was slightly startled.
“Unless you do not know?” The plump Chun Yu Pavilion Master stared with puzzlement, “A joyous occasion has happened in your Ardent Fire Marquisdom. The madam of yours, ‘Rong Xing Lan’ gave birth to a child that is a Void God at birth.”
Ying Shan Lie Hu did not care about the news when he first heard that he had a child. But hearing the two words, ‘Void God’, he was stunned to a daze.
Void Gods did not represent much.
But an infant that was just given birth and was a Void God was a horrifying thing. That represented a strong bloodline!
“My child?” Ying Shan Lie Hu’s eyes opened widely.
“What? The child of yours, Ying Shan Lie Hu, is a Void God at birth?”
“Is that real or fake?”
“How could that be?”
The aristocratic clan disciples around created an uproar the moment they heard that. The majority of them were sent over by aristocratic clans into Ardent Fire City to take responsibility of some businesses. Hence, their statuses within their own clans were not high. But still, they were not any worse off than Ying Shan Lie Hu! Now that they heard of the news, that trash Ying Shan Lie Hu actually gave birth to a Void God child, all of them became hoodwinked.
“My, my child is a Void God at birth? I, he is my, Ying Shan Lie Hu’s child?” Ying Shan Lie Hu felt incredibly excited.
He once dreamed of becoming a father to such an expert!
But he did not have sufficient resources or comprehension capabilities. He was also a child that his father had when his father was weaker; thus, his bloodline was weaker too. He honestly could not break through to become a Void God. That was why he decided to give up and just rely on his identity to enjoy his life.
“Rong Xing Lan?” When Ying Shan Lie Hu thought back, that girl was someone he directly captured and brought back to the Marquisdom because she was quite beautiful. After that, she had given birth to a daughter named Ying Shan Xi Yue whom he had never seen before.
He wanted to contact Rong Xing Lan.
But he eventually discovered that he did not record the communication imprint of Rong Xing Lan.
“Madam, madam.” Ying Shan Lie Hu immediately contacted his eldest madam Chan Yu Yan Zhen, “Rong Xing Lan gave birth to a child that is a Void God?”
“Yes, you better come back. Grandpa Marquis is angry.” Chan Yu Yan Zhen briefly replied. At that moment, she did not have the mood to say more to her husband.
“Hahaha, hahaha…”
Ying Shan Lie Hu suddenly laughed out loud. His laughter resounded in this huge palace, “The son of my, Ying Shan Lie Hu, is actually a Void God at birth. Hahaha…”
“Brother Lie Hu, congratulations.”
“Brother Lie Hu, truly admirable.”
Some of the pack of scoundrel friends of Ying Shan Lie Hu and even those who held Ying Shan Lie Hu in derision were letting out sounds of congratulations at this moment!
Ying Shan Lie Hu continued laughing. He then turned around, hurled his robe before saying: “Go, time to return to the Marquisdom.”
“Yes, master.” The group of servants behind him acknowledged. Their voices were all louder than before. Clearly, these servants felt excited too.
“Hu.”
Leaving the Misty Cloud Pavilion.
Ying Shan Lie Hu sat on his carriage with arrogance. The servants were also serving him on it. The mutated beasts were pulling the carriages arcing through the sky at high speed. They were heading back to the Marquisdom.
Just the time taken to brew a cup of tea later.
“Sou.”
A gray-robed old man appeared in midair. Clearly, he was teleporting and rushing his way to his destination. The moment he saw Ying Shan Lie Hu, he shouted out: “Ying Shan Lie Hu, Grandpa Marquis has urged you back to see him at this moment. Follow me.”
“It is Elder Tian? Good good good.” Ying Shan Lie Hu was extremely passionate.
The gray-robed old man instead grabbed Ying Shan Lie Hu with a cold and solemn look. He directly teleported away. Before Ying Shan Lie Hu was grabbed, he even ordered his subordinates: “Bring this treasured carriage back. No, this carriage has to be traded for a better one after we return!” Ying Shan Lie Hu was already thinking of the beautiful life he would be having in the future.
“Sou sou…”
Very soon, the gray-robed old man was able to bring Ying Shan Lie Hu back to the Marquisdom using teleportation. They arrived at the core area where Marquis Grandpa stayed.
“Wait here.” The gray-robed old man descended down with Ying Shan Lie Hu.
“What happened?” Ying Shan Lie Hu looked around him. The surrounding protectors were all cold. Their aura was even slightly suppressed. That gray-robed old man did not have a smile at all.
“Isn’t this a joyous occasion? What happened that brought the mood down?” Ying Shan Lie Hu looked around him like a fool. He rarely came over to the place of his father since he was not qualified to come when his father did not summon him.
“Elder Tian, where is that son of mine?” Ying Shan Lie Hu could not help but ask. He was a Void God at birth, and now, he felt vexed that he had not gone to see his son in the past. No matter what, that was still his son!
“Prince Xue Ying is currently with Grandpa Marquis.” The gray-robed old man said.
Suddenly, a roar came from within the palace hall: “Go grab that venomous woman, Chan Yu Yan Zhen back.”
Ying Shan Lie Hu felt so frightened that his legs turned soft when he heard this. Chan Yu Yan Zhen? Wasn’t that his wife?

chapters.title: Chapter 1003 - Little Prince Xue Ying
chapters.content:
Chapter 1003: Little Prince Xue Ying
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the palace hall.
The red-robed male Marquis Ardent Fire sat at the head position. Beside him were the two elders from the ancestral family as well as the elders of the Marquisdom. Naturally, by the tail of the place sat Rong Xing Lan who was embracing her son. Rong Xing Lan was filled with fear and trepidation. After all, this was her first time seated together with Grandpa Marquis and the elders; she could feel her legs turning soft. As for Xue Ying, he could only control his behavior. With his current heart realm, it wasn’t easy to act like a child. It felt awkward.
‘I’ll just bear through this period.’ Xue Ying thought.
“Let that useless fool in.” Marquis Ardent Fire could see with a single glance Ying Shan Lie Hu waiting obediently outside the palace. Even though this son was quite trashy, he was still a child Marquis Ardent Fire had when he was weaker. The marquis had genuine feelings for this child and even personally arranged a marriage for him. The marquis had also allocated many resources to the name of this child. Even though the bloodline of this son was weak, as his father, he hoped to see his son rising one day.
Nevertheless, it’s a pity that this son chose to enjoy life, causing Marquis Ardent Fire to feel slight disappointment for him.
‘Mn, this is that father of mine?’ Xue Ying was able to see that middle-aged man who came in. Facing the atmosphere within the palace hall, the other party unknowingly bent his back slightly.
“Stand there!” Marquis Ardent Fire roared.
“Yes.”
Ying Shan Lie Hu did not dare to disobey his father. He stood there obediently without letting out a sound. But he still could not help but turn towards the girl who sat by the edge and the child in her embrace. That child was currently observing him without showing any respect at all.
‘I am his father, yet he dares to stare at me like that? I must teach him a good lesson. No, I can’t win him. He is a Void God at birth!’ Ying Shan Lie Hu felt his heart turning bitter, ‘The Marquisdom would likely arrange a group of protectors and servants that are much stronger than mine for this child of mine.’
‘But he is still a little child. I am ultimately his father. In the future, I will just pamper him more, and we will definitely become closer.’ Ying Shan Lie Hu was planning what to do, ‘The treasures he is bestowed with is surely more than what I get. By then, as long as he let just a slight amount of treasures as much as the gap between his fingers over to me and I would be able to enjoy my life even more.’ If it were earlier on, Ying Shan Lie Hu was still filled with fighting spirit towards cultivation.
But this ambition of his had been eroded by entertainment over the long period, and he no longer was filled with any zeal.
“Hu.”
A figure was thrown down within the palace hall. She was the red-robed girl Chan Yu Yan Zhen. Chan Yu Yan Zhen fell down onto the floor gracelessly in the hall. She looked upwards and saw Marquis Ardent Fire who sat high above, and the elders from the ancestral family and elders from the Marquisdom, as well as that lowly woman Rong Xing Lan who currently hugged her child.
“Grandpa Marquis.” Chan Yu Yan Zhen immediately climbed up. She was filled with respect. Even if she was an arrogant person, she had to follow the rules.
“You are quite bold to disobey the rules of the Ying Shan Clan!” Marquis Ardent Fire coldly declared, “You actually dared to poison a pregnant woman of my Ying Shan clan, bringing about a premature birth of the most extraordinary child ever since the creation of Ying Shan Clan by ancestor herself! He was given birth in just 15 years! Since he was a Void God in just 15 years of conception, what do you think he would reach if given sufficient time…”
Not just him, even the two elders from the ancestral family and the surrounding elders from the Marquisdom were looking with fury at Chan Yu Yan Zhen.
When a clan grew stronger, all members within the clan would similarly improve in status! This Chan Yu Yan Zhen, for selfish reasons, had drastically cut down the time the outstanding talented ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying’ had in conception. If Xue Ying were to stay in the womb for several hundred years, his bloodline would become more concentrated, allowing his potential to be even greater. But everything came to naught all because of this venomous madam!
“Poisonous medicinal liquid? Given birth after 15 years?” Ying Shan Lie Hu stared at Chan Yu Yan Zhen with wide eyes.
How could this be?
How could this madam of his be so bold? Even though he, Ying Shan Lie Hu had many women, strictly speaking, he only had a wife—Chan Yu Yan Zhen. This was a marriage which his father discussed for his sake. Even betrothal gifts were given for this wedding, and the marriage ceremony was witnessed by many. Chan Yu Yan Zhen was an aristocratic clan disciple and was also a Unity realm expert. Hence, he would usually be short-breathed when facing his wife.
As for other women? Most of them were snatched over by him. Their statuses were all very low. Those women within the Marquisdom were usually at the lowest ‘sixth grade’, and were of equivalent level with the female servants. Only after they gave birth could their statuses be promoted.
Hence, Ying Shan Lie Hu felt disdained over those girls. They were merely used for him to vent himself on. He did not have any feelings for those women… and they were most likely not as good as Fu’er from the Misty Cloud Pavilion. Fu’er was someone he would frequently pamper.
But back to the topic-his wife actually dared to do such a thing? Ying Shan Lie Hu did not dare believe it.
“No, I did not do it.” Chan Yu Yan Zhen hurriedly retorted, “Grandpa Marquis, please investigate the better clearly. Yan Zhen has always been careful ever since I left the Chan Yu Clan and is married into the Ying Shan Clan, much less disobeying the rules of the clan. The affair over the poisonous medicinal liquid is unrelated to me! It must be someone who sought to eliminate a future genius disciple of my Ying Shan Clan, hence dispatching that Manager Tian before framing me. I am wronged!”
“I reckon Manager Tian is killed by you.” Marquis Ardent Fire looked downwards at Chan Yu Yan Zhen.
“I discovered that a servant like him actually dared to scheme against me. That was why I killed him in indignance.” Chan Yu Yan Zhen hurriedly added. This was the only matter which she had committed that wasn’t clean. After all, the duration of time was too short, and she had to personally act.
“Your hands are quite clean. Those who are related to this matter are either dead or ignorant.” Marquis Ardent Fire looked at Chan Yu Yan Zhen, “And right now, you are still rebutting.”
“There must be someone scheming from the back before framing it on me.” Chan Yu Yan Zhen added.
Marquis Ardent Fire looked coldly at her.
He had already investigated everything that could be done long ago. Even though there was a treasure which could distort time-space, there were experts within the Marquisdom who could disregard the distortion and see through the past. It’s a pity that all lines of evidence had been destroyed. They were either dead or missing. Nevertheless, every single piece of evidence led directly back to Chan Yu Yan Zhen. There was only the matter regarding ‘Manager Tian’ which was done most directly—he was killed directly by Chan Yu Yan Zhen.
If a weak and small disciple emerged, and he did not attract the attention of Marquis Ardent Fire, this matter would have likely been covered. But the one who emerged this time was ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying’, an outstanding talent.
“Fellow elders from the ancestral family.” Marquis Ardent Fire looked at the two elders beside him, “This venomous woman isn’t willing to admit to her crimes. It is fine. I’ll have to trouble the two elders to bring her back to the ancestral family and do a search through her soul.”
“Alright.” The two elders nodded.
Chan Yu Yan Zhen’s expression turned pale.
“Hu.”
The tall and thin elder extended his hand, directly wrapping Chan Yu Yan Zhen with an unseen energy and directly kept her into his Eden Treasure.
Ying Shan Lie Hu was looking at everything happening by the side with astonishment. He did not dare speak.
“Xue Ying ah.” Marquis Ardent Fire then turned back towards Xue Ying. He gave him a grin.
“Grandpa Marquis.”
Xue Ying immediately jumped down from his mother’s thigh. His voice was clear.
Seeing this chubby little boy, Marquis Ardent Fire felt really pleasant. He chuckled: “I’ll arrange a protector commander for you. He’ll definitely protect you properly.” Saying that, Marquis Ardent Fire looked out of the palace. A gray-robed old man immediately came in.
“This is Tian Yi Zhi, also called Elder Tian. Other than me, he’ll only listen to you.” Marquis Ardent Fire said.
“Prince Xue Ying.” The gray-robed old man smiled with respect.
“Are you powerful?”
“Still alright.”
The gray-robed old man wasn’t arrogant at all. He had taken entirely on the role as a protector commander.
Marquis Ardent Fire waved his hand, causing two black streams of light to fly out. They landed on the ground before forming two mutated black beasts. The hair on their body was smooth and glossy. Their eyes were blood-red in color. They emitted an aura at the Unity realm: “This pair of animals is known as the ‘Black Stream Cloud Wolf’.”
This pair of Black Stream Cloud Wolves then turned into humans. Both of them bowed simultaneously: “Greetings master.”
…
After a period when all the arrangements were made.
“Alright, go, go and have a look at the house which I arranged for you all. Also, you must remember to pay the Book Repository Pavilion a visit often. Once you have decided on your path of cultivation, come and inform me.” Marquis Ardent Fire said.
“Yes, Grandpa Marquis.” Xue Ying replied with a bright voice, “Then I’ll go first. Let us set off.”
Saying that, he shouted at his mother before riding off on a Black Stream Cloud Wolf. Elder Tian and the other Black Stream Cloud Wolf followed behind.
“You should go back and properly reflect too.” Only then did Marquis Ardent Fire reprimand Ying Shan Lie Hu. Ying Shan Lie Hu could only obediently acknowledge. He felt helpless in his heart. Coming here, all he got was a reprimand.
The two elders from the ancestral family stood up as well.
“It is time for us to leave. The potential of that little fellow Xue Ying is extraordinary. This time, he is forced to be given birth prematurely, and that is truly heart-breaking. Nevertheless, this represents that he still has an extremely high potential. I’ll inform this matter to the Old Ancestor. By then, she would bestow more precious treasures and could even nurture his bloodline further.” The tall and thin elder said.
“Mn, I’ll properly guide him.” Marquis Ardent Fire nodded.
******
The Ardent Fire Marquisdom occupied a huge area. It was like a city within a city.
Grandpa Marquis, the elders and also trillions of disciples all lived within this Marquisdom. Inside it, there were many houses, and the residence arranged for Xue Ying was not any worse than those organised for the elders.
“Wa.”
This little prince Xue Ying who was adored by many was currently sprinting into the residence barefooted.
There was a large group of servants within the residence, and many protectors protecting the place. His mother Rong Xing Lan and sister Ying Shan Xi Yue had also moved here. This residence was so big that it was bigger than the apartment which Ying Shan Lie Hu and Chan Yu Yan Zhen had previously.
“Go go go, Marquis Grandpa let me visit the Book Repository Pavilion, and mentioned about how big it is. I haven’t pay it a visit yet. Go, go, go!” Xue Ying directly leaped into the sky. He rode on a Black Stream Cloud Wolf, “Let’s go!”
The two Black Stream Cloud Wolves rushed into the sky at that moment. Elder Tian was easily following behind. There was also a nine-man protector team guarding Xue Ying. These nine people were the personal guards of Xue Ying, and they were all at the Unity realm.
“Hu hu.”
As they traveled above the Marquisdom, several other disciples who saw them coming immediately stood aside.
“That is Little Prince Xue Ying.”
“It is he?”
“He is a Void God at birth. Look, even Elder Tian has become his protector.”
Many other discussions were happening afar.
Xue Ying did not care about it. At this moment, he was riding the Black Stream Cloud Wolf in contentment, yet his gaze was stuck on a towering high pavilion in the distance-the Book Repository Pavilion! There were many absolute art scriptures within the Book Repository Pavilion. The requirements of entering the higher level of the pavilion were harsh and demanding, and the number of visits one could have was limited too. As for Xue Ying, he could casually look through all books within the entire Book Repository Pavilion and stay there for however long he wanted.
‘That is my current destination.’ Xue Ying’s inner heart was not as casual as what he displayed on the surface. He attached great importance to this Book Repository Pavilion, ‘By relying on this Book Repository Pavilion, only then can I truly understand the power distribution in the Realm Heart Great Land, and the levels the experts are divided into… only after I thoroughly understand that could I ascertain an appropriate path for me to grow in the future.’
“Go, quick!”
The Black Stream Cloud Wolf directly rushed into the Book Repository Pavilion.
The guards by the Book Repository Pavilion saw someone coming.
“The Black Stream Cloud Wolf? Elder Tian? That should be Little Prince Xue Ying.” The guards by the entrance and even those hidden experts did not dare to obstruct Xue Ying. They merely shouted from afar, “Prince Xue Ying, you may enter. But your protectors aren’t allowed to follow.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1004 - The Foundation of Realm Heart Great Land
chapters.content:
Chapter 1004: The Foundation of Realm Heart Great Land
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Those protectors of the Book Repository Pavilion and the hidden experts heaved a sigh of relief as Little Prince Xue Ying did not create a din. He directly leaped down from the Black Stream Cloud Wolf and entered the Book Repository Pavilion. As for Elder Tian, the two Black Stream Cloud Wolves, and the nine personal protectors, they waited outside. They felt assured since the ‘Book Repository Pavilion’ was an extremely safe place.
‘Time to go find the books.’
After coming in, Xue Ying saw many rows of shelves. Most books placed on the shelves were unique scriptures that were emanating mysterious auras.
The moment Xue Ying entered, he casually flipped through several books, and continued flipping through more books after that…
Xue Ying read through books here and there, and it seemed he merely read through each book for a short moment.
“Look, that is Little Prince Xue Ying.”
“He is a Void God at birth.”
“Even though all the information from the book is transmitted into his soul after just flipping through them, and that he will understand everything immediately, the books on this first level are the most ordinary books, so why is he wasting his time here?” Some of the disciples from the Marquisdom noticed this scene. They were transmitting messages between each other. They did not dare to speak out loud since they might just offend this Little Prince who just came into this world and is still quite ignorant.
They then continued flipping through the books. The books on the first level were miscellaneous books and were worth very little. They were flipping through merely to find clues leading to ancient remnants.
“Prince Xue Ying, if you want to find books on cultivation, you can head to the second or third floor. The books on the higher levels are more precious.” At that moment, a disciple from the Marquisdom came over. He wanted to get acquainted with Xue Ying.
“Thank you.” Xue Ying did not look up. He casually waved his hand, causing that disciple to awkwardly retreat.
Xue Ying continued flipping through the books here and there.
He did not look like someone reading. Even though some disciples felt speechless as they observed Xue Ying’s actions, gradually, they became too lazy to care about it.
‘There are too many books.’
‘And they are all miscellaneous books. There are even some scattered and incomplete cultivation techniques.’ Xue Ying felt slightly speechless. After all, this was a Marquisdom, and the number of books collected in this repository was like a sea. Even with Xue Ying’s fast pace of perusing through them, it took him more than two hours to find the book he wanted.
‘Finally.’
Xue Ying flipped through a thick and gray book; his eyes could not help but brighten. The first page he flipped to had made his eyes glimmer.
This book introduced the various nations within the Realm Heart Great Land. After all, the Realm Heart Great Land was too big, and there were many nations. Most Primal Chaos giants had not visited many of the mentioned places, and it was the determination of several powerful cultivators who wanted to record every single location within the entire Realm Heart Great Land for his descendants did this book came about.
‘Good fellow.’
As he flipped through, Xue Ying took in a mouth of cold air.
The cultivation aspect for the Realm Heart Great Land far outstripped that of the primal chaos void as a whole.
The ‘bloodline cultivation system’ was the number one greatest system across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. There were many cultivators, and they were able to ensure their children became extremely strong the moment they were given birth. The most outstanding ones had reached Unity realm at birth. A Cosmos God could similarly give birth to several hundred to a thousand children… during cultivation, these children were also given many absolute arts that would match their bloodline.
As for the laws and profound mysteries system, the hex cultivation, the ancient cultivation, and other systems, they already existed here for a long time and were much more developed.
There were even cultivation techniques similar to those that Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master had-methods that could cultivate avatars! But it seemed they were similarly spread secretly.
‘This, is too overpowered already right?’ Xue Ying felt startled as he read through it.
The Realm Heart Great Land existed for a period much longer than the primal chaos void did. It naturally had a deeper foundation. Furthermore, Xue Ying did not read about the ‘great apocalypse’ in this place. The period it had existed for could not be calculated too!
Xue Ying could only confirm that there had only been two ‘War of the Ancient Nations’. During the war, many nations were exterminated, and the world had become chaotic. Many experts fell, and even large batches of Cosmos Gods died…
Currently…
There were more than 150 nations in the Realm Heart Great Land. This book did not accurately specify the number of people it had because some of the tiny nations would occasionally emerge or be extinguished! Hence, the number of nations would rarely fluctuate.
‘Reasoning from this book, the number of Cosmos Gods which the Realm Heart Great Land have should be close to a thousand!’ Xue Ying was astonished.
The primal chaos void only had a total of slightly more than 30 Cosmos Gods including those that had fallen!
The Realm Heart Great Land had an approximate 30 times more than that of the primal chaos void!
It was normal too…
‘The strongest six nations have a long and rich history. There exist several tens of Cosmos Gods minimally, even reaching up to a hundred or so in a single nation.’ Xue Ying sighed.
The six great ancient nations should have more than 500 Cosmos Gods in total.
The other hundred nations were comparatively weaker.
For instance, the Southern Cloud Nation was a ‘second tier nation’, and it had four Cosmos Gods in total. The Southern Cloud King was also a famous person across the Realm Heart Great Land. Those genuinely weak nations would only have one or two weaker Cosmos Gods, and their nation might just crumble apart because of karma relating to a Cosmos God.
‘Yuan?’
Xue Ying also saw the book talking about ‘Yuan’. Xue Ying could not help but be startled.
Yuan…
He was publicly acknowledged as the number one expert across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
The first and second War of the Ancient Nations had been stopped only after the intervention by Yuan.
Yuan constructed many ‘God Yuan Palaces’ that were scattered across the entire great land.
The God Yuan Palace was divided into ten levels.
‘It seems the God Yuan Palace is similar to the Star Pagoda?’ Xue Ying could vaguely deduce this from the explanation, ‘The God Yuan Palace and Star Pagoda seem to categorize the strength of cultivators in the same manner? Though the Star Pagoda only has nine levels, and the God Yuan Palace has ten levels.’
‘And the research the Realm Heart Great Land has towards the cultivation techniques far surpassed that of the primal chaos void.’ Xue Ying felt restraining fear.
According to what was illustrated by the book, a Unity realm expert could reach the God Yuan Palace seventh level after researching the laws and profound mysteries system to its limit! But by relying on external strength and secret techniques, a Unity realm expert could unleash a power at the eighth level!
As for Primal Chaos experts, under normal circumstances, they could reach the God Yuan Palace ninth level strength at most. By relying on external force and secret techniques, they could reach the tenth level in power, suppressing the new Cosmos Gods.
‘Someone at the Primal Chaos realm could directly suppress a new Cosmos God?’ Xue Ying sighed in admiration.
From where he came from, the limit of Primal Chaos experts was at the ninth level. It was amazing for them to survive when facing Cosmos Gods. Want to suppress the other party? Or heavily injure the other party? That was practically a dream. But it was achievable in the Realm Heart Great Land.
…
This book might have introduced the various nations, but one-third of it was on praising the Southern Cloud Nation.
The Southern Cloud Nation naturally had its own pride. Even though it was a second-tier nation, the religion started by the Southern Cloud King, the ‘Southern Cloud Sacred Religion’ was one of the ten great religions in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, and also most widely spread religion across the cultivators! This also made the reputation of Southern Cloud King famous. There were many cultivators from the six great ancient nations that rushed over and were willing to listen to the guidance by Southern Cloud King.
‘So strong.’ Xue Ying felt his heart trembling as he read through the introductions of those absolute arts.
These absolute arts had radically reduced the difficulty of cultivation.
To spread his religion, the cultivator would have to ensure the difficulty of cultivation is reduced for others, ensuring that they would become stronger in the future! As the competition was intense, some of the more complex and challenging absolute arts created by Cosmos Gods could not be learned by everyone.
As for the ‘Southern Cloud Sacred Religion’, it was famous for allowing one to cultivate and get stronger quickly. It had become one of the ten great religions in the Realm Heart Great Land.
‘This is mad. This is truly mad.’ Only then did Xue Ying finally understand what it was meant by the supposed ‘deeper foundation’, and how deep it was.
His hometown was cruder by much in this cultivation aspect.

chapters.title: Chapter 1005 - 《Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles》
chapters.content:
Chapter 1005: 《Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles》
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was currently reading through all types of books within the Book Repository Pavilion. He continued reading for half a month before stopping.
During this half a month, Xue Ying read many books that recorded clues to the ancient remnants like “Relics of the Ancient Remnants”, “Scarlet Bull Palace Hidden Treasures” and many others. Xue Ying could interpret that most were useless, and what was recorded were already known by everyone. During the two terrifying Wars of the Ancient Nations, many cultivators fell. Even Cosmos Gods died in batches. ‘Scarlet Bull Palace Master’ was one of the few famous Cosmos Gods that killed more than a dozen Cosmos Gods. Xue Ying could deduce that this cultivator should be of a similar realm with Sacred Master.
This gave Xue Ying a new understanding. In the Realm Heart Great Land, quite a few at the level of Sacred Master had fallen in history.
There were even more who were still alive!
‘Such a terrifying place.’ Xue Ying muttered inwardly.
Even though both places were origin worlds, the Realm Heart Great Land had a much deeper foundation. No wonder ‘Yuan’ left behind an opportunity for descendants to enter this origin world.
‘There should be quite a few like me who reincarnated into this Realm Heart Great Land.’ Xue Ying sighed.
‘And it seems the smaller nations aren’t safe at all.’ Xue Ying discovered how dangerous this place was.
The Southern Cloud Nation was located south of ‘Summer Wind Ancient Nation’. In the region south of this ancient nation all the way until the ‘Black Prison Yin Sea’, there were a total of four nations and a huge lake.
This huge lake was a famous perilous area in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. The space here was deranged. One might travel a few trillion kilometers with a single step. Hence, this was a place where the majority of devils hid in! Many devils who escaped from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, as well as other areas, had gathered in this location.
Hence, this was also called the ‘Black Devil Great Lake’, and the four nations surrounding it were called the Black Devil Four Nations.
The Black Devil Great Lake spanned over a considerable area not any smaller than a nation. There were countless devils and close to ten Cosmos Gods at this place. It was one of the few famous gathering locations of devils, and it was hard for the six ancient nations to eradicate them.
Like the Southern Cloud Nation, there was the Southern Cloud King. Quite a few famous devils were also located in the Black Devil Great Lake.
The ‘Fiery Zhao Nation’ which was one of the Black Devil Four Nations might have three Cosmos Gods, yet none of them could compare to how intimidating the Southern Cloud King was. The Fiery Zhao Nation had practically become a back garden for the Black Devil Great Lake, and devils frequently acted rampantly there. It was common for cities to be overwhelmed, and the Fiery Zhao King could only endure… because the previous Fiery Zhao King had died precisely in the hands of the devils from the Black Devil Great Lake.
Even though the Southern Cloud Nation was in a much better situation, it was still a place where devils from the Black Devil Great Lake frequented for slaughtering, though Cosmos Gods would not easily act there.
‘Danger lurks in all places.’ Xue Ying softly shook his head.
Nations relied on strength to stand firm.
For instance, ‘Snow Hook Nation’ which was also one of the Black Devil Four Nations had a total of five Cosmos Gods and had extremely powerful experts. The Snow Hook King was someone known to be crazy and was not willing to be deferential towards the ancient nations. He had fought with three great ancient nations before! Even though many died and were injured in his own nation, the Snow Hook King was quite capable of surviving and was able to remain alive even now.
‘Truly competent. He fought with three great ancient nations before, yet this tier two Snow Hook Nation stands firm until now.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly in admiration.
Both Southern Cloud King and Snow Hook King were absolutely overlords.
Nevertheless, Southern Cloud King had a warmer personality. He befriended quite a few other states and spread his own absolute art. He had many disciples within the six great ancient nations. Hence, the Southern Cloud Nation was comparatively the most stable nation.
…
Xue Ying placed down the book in his hand. He made his resolution in his heart: ‘According to the books that I read these few days, the most appropriate absolute art for me is the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”.’
The Southern Cloud Sacred Religion was one of the ten great religions in the Realm Heart Great Land.
One had to know that there existed quite a few Cosmos Gods on the same level with the Sacred Master, yet the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion was able to be ranked in the top ten. It was naturally amazing.
The primary reason why the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion was so famous was due to the absolute art created by Southern Cloud King-the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”. This absolute art was so well-known across the world that practically almost all experts who reached a certain standard in the Realm Heart Great Land would know of it. And in the Southern Cloud Nation, there was virtually nobody who did not know of this art.
‘The bloodline I activated belongs to the void. My experience with the void is considered to be deep too.’ Xue Ying chuckled, ‘This “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” is precisely a void-related absolute art.’
Void.
Time and space. That was something that any cultivator would be able to perceive when they started cultivating. As long as a cultivator reached the True God realm, they could control time and space to a certain extent. Hence, it was quite easy for most True Gods in the Realm Heart Great Land to grasp a void-related absolute art, and the stronger they got, the deeper their control of it.
That was why the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” was well known for its great innate potential for cultivators to train in.
Naturally, there were many other void-related absolute arts too. But for this absolute art to become so famous was due to its relative ease of cultivation.
…
By the lake, Marquis Ardent Fire was currently fishing.
Xue Ying rode on the Black Stream Cloud Wolf arriving where Marquis Ardent Fire was. Elder Tian and the other personal protectors stood afar watching Xue Ying as he leaped down and shouted: “Grandpa Marquis, I have read quite a few books in the Book Repository Pavilion, and have decided what I want to cultivate.”
“Oh? What are you planning to cultivate?” the red-haired male Marquis Ardent Fire looked at Xue Ying with a smile.
“The “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”!” Xue Ying did not hesitate.
“This is the absolute art most famous in my Southern Cloud Nation and is also created personally by the king. It is most apt for those with talent in the void aspect.” Marquis Ardent Fire looked at Xue Ying.
The surface of Xue Ying’s body suddenly fluctuated with the void. Many void ripples appeared.
Marquis Ardent Fire’s eyes sparkled the moment he saw that: “Ha, the bloodline you activated is related to the void! Then it is fine for you to cultivate it. Honestly speaking, there are quite a few cultivators in my Southern Cloud Nation that cultivates the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”, though it is quite hard to reach a profound realm in it. You have the potential to cultivate in the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”, and it is quite fortunate that my Marquisdom has quite a few cultivators training in this art.”
Xue Ying naturally knew of it.
He was a citizen of the Southern Cloud Nation and was also someone who activated a void bloodline. Furthermore, Xue Ying had great prior experience in the void. All these reasons were factored into his decision of choosing this absolute art! Even though cultivating this absolute art was relatively easy, it was only comparative. The path of cultivation was ultimately a bumpy road. The difficulty of reaching the eighth level at Unity realm should be as difficult as reaching the seventh level of Unity realm in the primal chaos realm where he came from. Nevertheless, Xue Ying did not mind. Even if he walked down the path of the laws and profound mysteries system, he was confident of creating a ninth level move.
“Do you want to go and learn it now?” Marquis Ardent Fire asked.
“Definitely!” Xue Ying responded.
“Alright. Go, I’ll bring you to the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace.” Marquis Ardent Fire said.
Marquis Ardent Fire turned to Elder Tian and the others, giving out an order: “You all should return to the residence of Xue Ying first. I’ll send him over in a while.”
“Yes, Grandpa Marquis.” They acknowledged.
“Let us set off.”
Marquis Ardent Fire brought Xue Ying along.
A red-haired male bringing a young fellow directly proceeding through the void. They arrived soon at the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace within the Ardent Fire City.
The Southern Cloud Sacred Palace existed even within some cities in the six great ancient nations. They received cultivators from all over the place. Nevertheless, to cultivate this absolute art to the most profound stage, most had to pay the Southern Cloud Nation a visit.
And within ‘Southern Cloud Nation’, other than guiding disciples within the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace, they also took in powerful cultivators, forming some unique organizations. Those who joined the sacred palace would become subordinates of the king, and they would acquire various benefits too.
And the master of the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace inside the Ardent Fire City was also one of the two giants, ‘Chun Yu Wei Yi’.
“Hu.”
A red-haired male and a little fellow stood by the entrance of the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace.
“Grandpa Marquis came personally?” A tall and thin male equipped with gray armor walked over. As he traveled, his entire person felt akin to a blade cutting through the void. Everywhere he moved left behind ripples by the sides of the void. His vision landed on Xue Ying as he chuckled, “This should be Little Prince Ying Shan Xue Ying right? He is quite talented. After all, he was a Void God at birth. In any case, Grandpa Marquis, why did you bring him over to my place?”
“Xue Ying has decided to join the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.” Marquis Ardent Fire chuckled.
“Good good good. Come over and tell me more.” Chun Yu excitedly brought both of them in.

chapters.title: Chapter 1006 - Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1006: Cultivation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Ardent Fire City. Within a slightly more desolate hall in the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace.
Chun Yu Wei Yi was currently seated opposite of Marquis Ardent Fire. Each had a long table in front of them. Xue Ying was now still a child, so he remained by the side of Marquis Ardent Fire.
“Little Prince Xue Ying, I might be the hall master of the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace in this Ardent Fire City, but I have to pre-warn you in advance. There are many cultivation techniques in this world. For instance, some very formidable inheritances originated from the six great ancient nations which exist in my Southern Cloud King too. Even though it might be hard to find them in the Ardent Fire City, it is quite easy to search for those cultivation techniques in the nation.” Chun Yu Wei Yi chuckled, “Just the same Dao of Void path alone consists of several other absolute arts created by the six great ancient nations. I urge you to consider this properly before deciding on what should be your main cultivation technique. After all, cultivation is mentally-draining, and most only cultivate a single absolute art.”
“Little Brother Wei Yi, Ying Shan Xue Ying has activated the void bloodline.” Marquis Ardent Fire chuckled, “He has done that previously in front of me. I could vaguely sense that the bloodline has an ancient and unfathomable aura. It should be a Cosmos God level bloodline. Haha, Xue Ying is a disciple of my Ying Shan Clan, and his body contains a void bloodline on the level of the Cosmos God realm. That bloodline could only come from the king, which meant that the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” is most apt for Xue Ying.”
“Cosmos God level bloodline?” Chun Yu Wei Yi was stunned after hearing it.
Southern Cloud Nation had a total of four Cosmos Gods. All of them cultivated in different directions.
As for the void bloodline… only the king has it.
As the four great clans and those from the aristocratic clan frequently inter-married, even though there were the occasional few who married with those from the neighboring nations, the only one with a void bloodline is Southern Cloud King. After several generations of reproduction, as long as one were not from the same generation as those old men, the current aristocratic clan disciples would usually have Cosmos God bloodlines in their bodies.
It was only that these bloodlines were too diluted, and activating it was extremely difficult.
The Cosmos God bloodline in Xue Ying’s body was actually diluted as well! But his realm was high, and Xue Ying was confident of reaching the limit of Primal Chaos realm even without the bloodline.
“Since he has the void bloodline of the king, cultivating the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” will indeed produce great results with half the effort.” Chun Yu Wei Yi nodded. Saying that, he flipped his hand before bringing out a black book.
This black book flew directly to Xue Ying, descending right before him.
Xue Ying looked at this black book in front. It was entirely pitch black and gave off a feeling similar to when Xue Ying observed the essence of the void, the ‘black fog spherical bodies’.
“The entire scroll?” Marquis Ardent Fire felt slightly startled by the side, “It would cost 100,000 cosmos crystals right?”
“No need.” Chun Yu Wei Yi smiled and shook his head, “Little Prince Xue Ying has an amazing talent. He is a Void God at birth and has activated the void bloodline of the king. He is completely qualified to cultivate the entire scroll of “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” for free. I merely have to report this upwards.”
Xue Ying understood after hearing it.
He had seen many books and knew that there were rules and limitations for spreading of the absolute art of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.
The Southern Cloud Sacred Religion was so famous and could become one of the top ten great religions in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Most who decided to join this religion to learn the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” would have to cultivate the first scroll first. Only when they reached the Unity realm would they be qualified to cultivate the second scroll! And cultivating it required ‘expenses’.
Why would those religions be so enthusiastic about spreading their absolute arts? It was all for the sake of earning cosmos crystals! A complete “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” cost 100,000 cosmos crystals in total.
Being one of the ten great religions in the Realm Heart Great Land, how many cultivators had chosen to learn it? The wealth generated would make Cosmos Gods mad. The Southern Cloud Nation relied on it to obtain a horrifying wealth, and this meant resources! In terms of wealth, the Southern Cloud King could be ranked in the frontmost across all Cosmos Gods in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. He was envied by many other Cosmos Gods, and other Cosmos Gods were doing their best to create absolute arts that were easy to cultivate and powerful. But it was honestly too tricky. Furthermore, proper operation of business must be conducted for the religion to spread to this stage.
For instance, there were leeways given to some when learning the absolute art; those who were very talented could acquire it for free! Because ultimately, when a genius became strong using the absolute art from the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, it would only make the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion more famous.
But this condition for cultivating the absolute art for free was harsh. Xue Ying was an aristocratic disciple within the Southern Cloud Nation and had great talent. The bloodline he awakened was also the king’s bloodline. That was why Chun Yu Wei Yi had been so confident of applying for a waiver.
“Hua.”
Xue Ying flipped through the black book in his hand.
Just as he flipped open, a massive amount of dimmed light shot out from the black book directly into the forehead of Xue Ying.
“Hong!”
Xue Ying’s mind rang for a moment.
He could vaguely see a scene in his mind.
There was a piece of primal chaos, and he stood there without knowing time and space. That small little figure stood there, yet it produced a terrifying suppression on Xue Ying. This suppression far surpassed that which Xue Ying felt from World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer. It seemed to be vaguely above the vast aura given out by Sacred Master.
This thin and small figure had an erected nose. His eyes were dark, and he then began displaying a technique.
His entire body was like a weapon. His legs, elbow, back, head, palm, fist, fingers… regardless, every part of his body was a frightening weapon. The techniques he unleashed was were becoming more mysterious over time. In the end, the power he released reached an unfathomable stage.
“Hua.” The thin and small figure hacked his palm out. One could see many planets and cultivators in the distant. There were also many flying ships… yet everything was transformed into a piece of art! Those planets, cultivators and flying ships became part of the art.
“Hong.”
Following that, this small figure pointed out his finger one last time.
“Hong-”
The moment he tapped his finger out, everything was destroyed. At the moment of shatter, Xue Ying even saw a colossal horror! That aura was something which he had discovered once before only in the higher dimension that he peered through the black fog spherical bodies.
Following that, everything disappeared.
That small thin figure turned into streams of information that entered the soul of Xue Ying. It was the specific cultivation technique for the complete “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”, though the method was being suppressed by an unseen force. Xue Ying understood that he could not break apart this shackles to impart this technique to others.
‘Such terrifying absolute art. A single palm caused the entire world to become a piece of art? A single tap destroyed the prison of the void, enabling one to see the higher dimensional world?’ Xue Ying was astonished. This was something that the Southern Cloud King imparted to others, so to what extent has his personal strength reached?
No wonder he could create this religion and turn it into one of the top ten great religions.
Truly unfathomable!
…
Within the palace hall, Marquis Ardent Fire and Chun Yu Wei Yi were currently chatting and drinking. They did not disturb Xue Ying at all and knew that Xue Ying was receiving the impartation.
“Hu.” Xue Ying placed down the black book. Shock was painted on his face. This absolute art was something he would definitely cultivate properly.
“Little Prince Xue Ying, you have learned this absolute art.” Chun Yu Wei Yi laughed, “Only during this impartation will you be able to see the complete training scene of the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” by the king. After that, it’ll be hard for you to earn this opportunity again. You should experience it properly.”
Xue Ying nodded, “Hall Master, I’ve heard that the”Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” which is spread to the public isn’t the complete version?”
“Yes.”
Chun Yu Wei Yi nodded, “The practice scene which you just saw by the king is the complete one, and the absolute art you learned is a simplified version. After all, an absolute art that is propagated and spread across the world should be cheap and easy enough. This simplified version is enough for the cultivator to reach the seventh level of Unity realm, and ninth level of Primal Chaos realm.”
Xue Ying nodded. From the place he came from, reaching the seventh level at Unity realm and ninth level at Primal Chaos realm was the limit. Yet this was merely a simplified version of the absolute art here.
“If you were to reach the fifth level strength at the Unity realm, I can apply for you to become an inner disciple. By then when you visit the capital, and when your Ying Shan Clan exert a little strength, it shouldn’t be hard for you to become an inner disciple. By then, you will be able to get the complete “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”.” Chun Yu Wei Yi laughed, “Actually, many cultivators are ambitious. They obtained the complete “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”, and guess what? How many of them could exert the eighth level strength at the Unity realm? And how many could reach the God Yuan Palace tenth level strength at Primal Chaos realm and suppress the new Cosmos Gods? If you could reach that stage, the king would definitely take the initiative in taking you as his personal disciple, and you will thus be imparted with other secret inheritances!”
…
Very soon, Xue Ying and Marquis Ardent Fire left the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace back to the Marquisdom.
After returning back to his own residence, Xue Ying immediately began his study of this “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”.

chapters.title: Chapter 1007 - Old Mother Ying Shan
chapters.content:
Chapter 1007: Old Mother Ying Shan
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Ying Shan City was one of the few grandest cities in the entire Southern Cloud Nation. It was vast and was also the hometown of the Ying Shan ancestral family.
Within the ancestral family, there was a lofty snow mountain. At the peak of this mountain were ten over houses. It was peaceful. This was the residence of the Ying Shan Clan ancestor, ‘Old Mother Ying Shan’.
“Ancestor.” An elder stood there respectfully.
Old Mother Ying Shan sat cross-legged on a huge rock looking down the enormous Ying Shan Clan mansion. She shook her head, saying: “That little fellow called Xue Ying has such a great innate talent. It’s a pity that he was forced to be given birth in just 15 short years. Otherwise, if he could be nurtured for several hundred more years, the bloodline in his body would likely be stronger. What a pity. Oh right, regarding that Chan Yu Yan Zhen which you reported earlier, were you able to confirm that she is the murderer?”
“Not yet.”
This white-haired ancestral family elder responded politely, “We have utilized the illusory realm array to bring her into an illusory realm. Any target would have to obediently answer the truth in the illusory realm. However, she said she wasn’t the murderer in the illusory realm and was framed by someone else.”
“Oh?” Old Mother Ying Shan’s face which was filled with wrinkles remained emotionless.
“There are two possibilities. One, she was indeed framed by someone else. Two, she should have altered part of her memories.” This ancestral family elder said, “Since her memories were wiped clean, there is no way we could investigate it.”
To the expert cultivators, it wasn’t difficult to wipe off one’s memories. But it would mean a complete loss of memories on one part. The target would even think that his memories after the alter were real.
“We have tried our best to check into other possible trails, yet all of them were cut. Other than a small section that we could not confirm, what we could investigate included evidence that was destroyed by Chan Yu Yan Zhen.” The ancestral family elder said, “Right now, since we do not have any evidence, we can only deduce that Chan Yu Yan Zhen had committed the act and altered her memories.”
“She is a disciple from the aristocratic clan. In order to kill her, we must have the evidence. Otherwise, we can only wait for the king to act.” The ancestral family elder said.
The disciples of an aristocratic clan had special rights.
The Southern Cloud Nation had its own laws. Aristocratic clan disciples could not be casually killed. Naturally, people like Marquis Ardent Fire and Old Mother Ying Shan who were conferred marquis and conferred king had greater power. They could kill the other party directly.
“This young fellow Ardent Fire has actually caused such a thing to happen in the Marquisdom that he governed.” Old Mother Ying Shan frowned.
That time, this marriage was personally asked for by Marquis Ardent Fire-the marriage with Chan Yu Clan.
One had to know there were only three female conferred kings within the Southern Cloud Nation. The relationship between Old Mother Ying Shan and the ancestor of Chan Yu Clan, ‘Granny Chan Yu’ was excellent; they were practically sisters. This marriage was even brought up by Old Mother Ying Shan to Granny Chan Yu.
“The discipline of Chan Yu Yan Zhen isn’t strict enough. Retract all her identity from the Marquisdom and expel her from the place.” Old Mother Ying Shan casually said.
Looking at this from the marriage and how she was the one that mentioned this to Granny Chan Yu, Old Mother Ying Shan would be merciful to the other party.
But after retracting her identity and expelling her from the Marquisdom meant that Chan Yu Yan Zhen would no longer be an aristocratic clan disciple. Even though she was a Unity realm with a fourth level power, she would still be a commoner. It was a minor matter for aristocratic clan disciples to kill her. She could also no longer be able to touch the territory, cavern-dwellings, shops and all resources under Ying Shan Lie Hu’s name.
“This is something that I personally prepared for that little fellow Xue Ying to nurture his bloodline. He should still have great potential, and whatever we can dig should be dug.” Old Mother Ying Shan threw out a storage wristband, “As for other resources and treasures, everything should be arranged according to the identity as a golden order disciple. Alright, hurry up and send it over.”
“Yes.” This elder acknowledged.
Old Mother Ying Shan’s eyes were filled with hope. This was the one with the strongest bloodline coming from the Ying Shan clan since the start. She harbored great hope for him. After all, only cultivators within a clan were truly united on the Realm Heart Great Land.
It was common for a clan to escape to another nation once they could no longer exist in the former nation they were in.
Strictly speaking…
The Black Devil Four Nations were part of one of the six great ancient nations, ‘Summer Wind Ancient Nation’ during the early days. Over the long years, and after the consecutive Wars of the Ancient Nations, some clans decided to leave Summer Wind Ancient Nation and occupy a territory before building up their own nation. Some clans were even forced to escape because they offended someone, changing their loyalty to another nation.
Hence, when a genius popped up in a clan, the clan would definitely nurture him with all its strength. It would also nurture every single infant conscientiously. It was only due to the enormous size of the clan that made the existence of black sheeps unavoidable.
‘Let’s see.’
‘Let’s have a look when this little fellow Xue Ying reaches the Unity realm.’ Old Mother Ying Shan thought, ‘We would be able to deduce the potential of his bloodline through the period he takes to reach the Unity realm.’
…
“Scram.”
“In the future, if you dare to take half a step into the Marquisdom, you will be killed immediately.”
Chan Yu Yan Zhen stood outside the gates to the Marquisdom in a daze. Her eyes were filled with despair. Ever since she joined the Ying Shan Clan, she was no longer a member of the Chan Yu Clan and was part of the Ying Shan Clan. Now that she was expelled from the Marquisdom, she would become a commoner from now on.
Everything was gone. No more.
“I did not do it. I really did not do it.” Chan Yu Yan Zhen muttered, “I am framed.”
She wiped and altered her own memories to escape from death punishment. Until now, she did not even recognize that she had been the one who committed the crime; she still believed she was framed.
“Mother.”
Two males brought along several servants and protectors outside the Marquisdom entrance.
Chan Yu Yan Zhen looked over: “My son, I, I am really framed.”
“Mother, I and little brother know that you have been framed. But now, that Ying Shan Xue Ying is being doted by the entire Ying Shan Clan. Grandpa Marquis is also standing on his side, making that hybrid delighted. So what if his bloodline is strong? He might not become strong in the future. I’ll also become a conferred Marquis in the future and could kill him then to take revenge for you, mom.” The eldest son gritted his teeth. The second son was slightly quieter.
After all, the eldest son had long reached the Unity realm and also had a fourth level strength. He was qualified to mention these things. The second son remained at the Void God Origin Birth realm currently, and did not have the foundation.
“Mother, let me arrange a place for you to live in. Go go go, we can only endure it for now. Let’s see how the future of that hybrid will fare? He might even have to spend a long time before breaking through to the Unity realm.” The eldest son angrily said.
“Zhong Fu, I, I, ai… I am really framed. Whatever, let’s go. The whole Ying Shan Clan is currently doting on that Ying Shan Xue Ying.” Chan Yu Yan Zhen felt anger brewing in her heart, yet she was clear that she had to be much more vigilant since her identity as an aristocratic clan disciple was robbed.
******
Time passed. Xue Ying did not place that Chan Yu Yan Zhen in his eyes. After all, it was quite easy for him to reach the conferred king stage. His target was to become a Cosmos God.
Cultivation was still the most important for him.
In the blink of an eye, it had been 1,500 years later. During this cultivation, it was akin to ten days or half a month for mortals.
…
Within the Ardent Fire Marquisdom.
Xue Ying was currently seated in the courtyard on a beautiful spring day. He held onto a book and was feeling quite warm in his body: ‘This spiritual liquid sent over by this ancestor of Ying Shan Clan is extremely good in nurturing my bloodline. The concentration of this void bloodline of mine has become several dozen times denser now, allowing me to cultivate more easily.’
It was primarily due to his bloodline being too diluted previously. Furthermore, under normal circumstances, there was no point nurturing someone with such a diluted bloodline.
But…
The ‘void’ in the Realm Heart Great Land and the ‘void’ in the primal chaos void had many similarities. Cultivation naturally became much easier. The soul at the Void God level had quickened the pace of Xue Ying’s cultivation as compared to when he was in the womb. Furthermore, he even had the void bloodline aiding him, and also “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”. In reality, Xue Ying had cultivated the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” to the third style during these 1,500 years, acquiring a fifth level strength which he had in the past.
Such strength naturally allowed him to awaken and step into the Unity realm.
‘No rush no rush.’
‘Even though I want to sculpt myself as an absolute talent, even though there was the situation of ‘being forced into this world prematurely’, reaching the Unity realm in just 1,000 years or so is too fast. Mn, it’ll be better for me to break through when it is closer to 10,000 years.’ Xue Ying contemplated, ‘8,000 years it is!’
He had seen through many different books and had planned for himself according to some examples of other absolute talents.
He did not want to become too dazzling. It might just cause undue suspicions on him as ‘someone who reincarnated’, resulting in a powerful expert to come and check through his memories using the illusory realm.
“My son, my son.”
A loud shout came from outside. One could see a male filled with smile rushing over. He seemed passionate and joyous.
Xue Ying subconsciously grabbed his head.
Oh my gawd! This father of his, ‘Ying Shan Lie Hu’, was truly something.

chapters.title: Chapter 1008 - 8,000 Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 1008: 8,000 Years
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“My son is reading? Being your father, I naturally brought something you like to eat.” Ying Shan Lie Hu flipped his hand. He supported a wooden tray with a hand, and on this wooden tray placed some wooden steamer and jade plates with delicious food placed in them. The sweet smell diffused out of the food.
That time when Xue Ying chased after the Destruction Devils, he had tasted all kinds of delicious food across the primal chaos void. Now that he was reincarnated into the Realm Heart Great Land, other than reading books, he frequented all the famous restaurants in Ardent Fire City. He had also eaten many nice snacks from the road stalls. And now, quite a lot of aristocratic clan disciples knew that this Little Prince Xue Ying was someone who liked good food.
“Elder Tian, I am entering closed-door cultivation. Ensure nobody come and disturbs me.” Xue Ying turned around and slipped away.
“My son, my son.” Ying Shan Lie Hu walked over.
Elder Tian stood right in front of Ying Shan Lie Hu, blocking him from proceeding on: “Prince Xue Ying is going to enter closed-door cultivation. You can’t disturb him.”
“Ai.”
Ying Shan Lie Hu could only purse his lips helplessly after seeing this. He then casually brought some delicacies from one of the wooden steamers into his mouth, “Such good food yet he doesn’t want to eat. Truly… oh, I’ll just let Xing Lan eat them.”
Ying Shan Lie Hu turned around and went to find Rong Xing Lan next.
Elder Tian saw this and muttered to himself, “This Ying Shan Lie Hu has a really thick skin.”
The two Black Stream Cloud Wolves that were lying on the ground glanced at the leaving Ying Shan Lie Hu before closing their eyes and went back to deep sleep.
…
“Hu, I can’t even beat him or expel him away. His skin is so thick too. He is giving me a huge headache.” Xue Ying hid into a tall pagoda. The pagoda contained bursts of distorted spatial flow. At its center, there was a huge stone about 3.3cm in diameter floating. Xue Ying immediately sat down cross-legged on this stone the moment he entered.
Some of the distorted spatial flow continued streaming in the surrounding, while some permeated into the body of Xue Ying.
This was a Void God Pagoda bought specially from the Ardent Fire Marquisdom for Xue Ying to cultivate the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”.
“My father of this life?” Xue Ying shook his head.
He did not like this Ying Shan Lie Hu in his heart.
After all, before his startling birth, Ying Shan Lie Hu did not care about the lives of his children. He only knew how to enjoy! He did not have the slightest feeling towards Rong Xing Lan in the past. Just this reason alone led Xue Ying to resent him.
It’s only…
His birth was too dazzling. Ying Shan Lie Hu had come here once every few days with a smile and full of passion. Xue Ying ignored him, yet Ying Shan Lie Hu would turn around to coax Rong Xing Lan. Rong Xing Lan discovered that her husband was treating her well. Even though she knew the other party was deliberately fawning on her, she gradually forgave him.
The relationship between Rong Xing Lan and Ying Shan Lie Hu became well after that. Xue Ying could only try his best to avoid the other party: “Whatever, as long as Mother is happy, and for him not to make disasters, I’ll just treat him as an amusing person.”
“Since I’ve entered closed-door cultivation, I should properly cultivate.”
Xue Ying looked at the book in his hand. He then kept it. This book introduced the Southern Cloud King.
These few years…
Xue Ying collected quite a few books describing the Southern Cloud King. He also collected some intelligence, and from hence he discovered that the Southern Cloud King had long reached the ‘pinnacle of void-ification’, and even had avatars! This gave Xue Ying the feeling that he had a bright future within the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, and it was worth him spending the effort to cultivate this.
******
After keeping the book, Xue Ying began his cultivation on the floating rock.
Xue Ying was different from others. He did not have any bottlenecks when he cultivated the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”. After all, the highest level of this simplified version would only enable the cultivator to reach the God Yuan Palace ninth level strength. In addition to how strong the Southern Cloud King was, the art he created was even easier to learn, and its difficulty was equivalent to reaching the Star Pagoda eighth level in his previous life.
Adding up to how similar the void between both origin worlds was, it was natural for Xue Ying not to have any bottlenecks in cultivating.
As for the other main cultivation path he planned on taking, the ‘Dao of Mirage’, due to the drastic differences between the laws and profound mysteries here, cultivating it was much slower. This was also the reason why Xue Ying decided to first reach the Primal Chaos realm using the Dao of Void. With a stronger soul, his cultivation of the Dao of Mirage would become much faster.
“Hong long long~” His body rumbled.
A total of eight crystal pillars were embedded within the Void God Pagoda. The distorted spatial streams that were generated were permeating into the body of Xue Ying continuously. This caused the precious medicines that were applied on the body of Xue Ying to seep into his muscles, bones and blood vessels, making the bloodline in it more concentrated. Actually, this Void God Pagoda was meant primarily for refining the Southern Cloud Sacred Body.
“Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” contained an important refining cultivation technique, the ‘Southern Cloud Sacred Body’.
Cultivating the Southern Cloud Sacred Body required even more precious and expensive treasures the further one progressed in it, absorbing all sorts of essence into the body to refine it. In reality, this was akin to transforming the body into a ‘secret treasure weapon’, cultivating it to a limit. By then, any part of the body could be used as a weapon to battle.
An indestructible body coupled with the effect of ‘void-ification’. Cultivators who cultivated in the void were exceptionally good at using the void to escape too.
Hence, this ‘Southern Cloud Sacred Body’ was practically the most perfect survival technique. This was one of the reasons why the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, a religion that came from a tier two nation could become one of the top ten greatest religions across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
…
Time passed.
“Mn?” Xue Ying suddenly gained some feeling in his heart. He abruptly stopped cultivating.
‘It has been 8,000 years?’ Xue Ying softly nodded. He planned to break through to the Unity realm in 8,000 years after being birthed. Even though time passed relatively quickly and soundlessly during cultivation, Xue Ying knew deep in his heart that it was time.
‘I’ve cultivated the fourth and fifth style of the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”.’
Xue Ying sat cross-legged there.
“Hong.”
Many unseen void spatial edges appeared from his body suddenly, flying out in all directions. Everywhere it passed, the void was cut, causing ripples to appear. Their power was strong and had given off the manner which Chun Yu Wei Yi had.
“Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou!”
Suddenly, Xue Ying’s body began flashing rapidly. He teleported multiple times within this Void God Pagoda. Closely following that, he went back to his original position above the rock.
‘I can also teleport now.’ Xue Ying nodded slightly.
The fourth and fifth styles of the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” were moves at the God Yuan Palace sixth level.
The sixth and seventh styles were at the seventh level.
And the eighth style was at the Primal Chaos realm seventh level. Some Primal Chaos giants might not be able to reach the seventh level strength just by using the profound mysteries at the Unity realm. Hence, the eighth style utilized profound mysteries at the Primal Chaos realm, allowing Primal Chaos giants to reach seventh level strength. A cultivator at the seventh level could be qualified to become a conferred marquis!
The ninth and tenth style were at the eighth level strength.
And the final 11th and 12th styles pertained to the ninth level strength.
‘Time to go out and have a walk. I’ll return to break through to the Unity realm after that.’ Xue Ying stood up. He was nonchalant despite reaching this strength.
God Yuan Palace sixth level…
One had to know that disciples at the God Yuan Palace fifth level within the Marquisdom could become elders. Any outsiders who had reached the sixth level, as long as they were loyal to the Marquisdom, they could become elders too. Such great experts would have special rights when they joined any random Southern Cloud Sacred Palace. In the primal chaos void of the other origin world, new Primal Chaos giants were merely at the sixth level strength.
Xue Ying left the Void God Pagoda.
“Sou, sou.”
The two Black Stream Cloud Wolves that were outside guarding the pagoda rushed over. In reality, this pagoda had protectors guarding it. When Xue Ying was in closed-door cultivation, other than Grandpa Marquis, none dared to barge in.
“Let’s go out and have a walk.” Xue Ying had grown taller. He gave off the feeling of a handsome young man.
…
Very soon, a carriage that was pulled by two dragon beasts were pulled. A handsome young man sat on the carriage with two Black Stream Cloud Wolves in front of him. And beside him stood Elder Tian. The nine personal guards all stood behind the carriage.
“Hu.”
The carriage was being pulled across the sky. It headed in the direction outside the Marquisdom.
“Prince, where should we go first?” Elder Tian asked.
“Let’s pay the Liu Zhen restaurant first. It has been a long time since I last ate. My stomach is already rumbling.” Xue Ying said. The two Black Stream Cloud Wolves beneath his legs howled with joy. Clearly, the two of them liked the food served from that Liu Zhen restaurant too.

chapters.title: Chapter 1009 - Meeting
chapters.content:
Chapter 1009: Meeting
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Liu Zhen Restaurant spanned along the street for up to two kilometers long. Pavilion by pavilion lined up the entire place in neat, orderly rows. Over here, throngs of customers could be found flooding the area-the atmosphere was truly bustling with excitement.
“Prince Xue Ying, you haven’t come for a long time. Come in quickly. Shall I arrange for the Auxiliary Gentleman Pavilion?” A manager of the restaurant immediately went forward to receive Xue Ying. After all, in terms of identity, this Little Prince Ying Shan Xue Ying was ranked at the frontmost across the entire Ardent Fire City. If he were to offend this little prince, the whole restaurant might have to shut down.
Within one of the pavilions in the entire restaurant, the ‘Auxiliary Gentleman Pavilion’, the carriages and dragon beasts were arranged to wait there. Xue Ying had also bought large buckets filled with fruits and meat for the creatures to eat.
Above the Auxiliary Gentleman Pavilion.
Xue Ying sat with Elder Tian, and the nine personal guards were split evenly across two tables by the side. The two Black Stream Cloud Wolves similarly had delicious food to enjoy.
“This Liu Zhen Restaurant is barely ranked in the top hundred, yet I like them the most.” Xue Ying ate to his heart’s content. A powerful cultivator ate purely to enjoy its taste. After all, it was a minor matter for a cultivator not to eat for trillions of years.
The female attendants were like clouds; they sent up the dishes one after another.
These female attendants were usually World Deities or True Gods. It was not easy for them to find a job with their strength in the Ardent Fire City; they could merely act as servants. Only after they broke through to the Void God realm could they barely do some of the ‘harder’ tasks.
…
After eating for an hour, Xue Ying’s entire body oozed of sweat. He felt blissful. Xue Ying gradually stopped and began enjoying sips of wine instead. He was also enjoying the scenery of the streets through the windows.
“Mn?” Xue Ying suddenly looked up and stared at a distant location. This was an area about a dozen kilometers away. At that moment, Xue Ying frowned slightly.
“Prince?” Elder Tian asked.
“I’ve finished eating. It is time to leave.” Xue Ying stood up.
Elder Tian, the two Black Stream Cloud Wolves, and his personal guards had already eaten to their fill; they all stood up on Xue Ying’s signal for departure.
******
At a street about a dozen kilometers away.
There was a luxurious carriage arcing through the sky. This carriage was pulled by a total of eight violet-gold dragon beasts. There were even a dozen beautiful female attendants surrounding the carriage. Everywhere it passed, cultivators would move away for this carriage. None dared to look up because those who lived in the Ardent Fire City for a slightly longer period would know this was the carriage of ‘Chun Yu Feng’, the master of the Misty Cloud Pavilion.
Being the master of the most significant squandering establishment in the entire Ardent Fire City, Chun Yu Feng naturally had a high status. He was absolutely someone famous in the Ardent Fire City, and a majority of the aristocratic clan disciples did not even dare to offend him, much less the commoners.
Within the luxurious carriage.
The carriage was merely a few meters as seen from outside, yet it was tens of meters within.
Two plump males were seated next to each other. They were being served by beauties. One of them was naturally Chun Yu Feng. His face was filled with smiles, causing others to feel as if they were bathed by the spring wind. On the other side, the plump male was quite tall and big, and he emitted a terrifying somber aura. There was black aura coming out from his nose between his breaths. The beauties by his side were all slightly trembling with fear.
