“Brother Qian, this time, I’ll have to trouble you to send me more commodities.” Chun Yu Feng bitterly said, “I do not have enough commodities, which would make my business really tough to operate in the future.”
“There isn’t enough commodities to be distributed according to everyone’s wishes. This allocation will naturally offend everyone.” That plump gigantic male nonchalantly said.
“I know Brother Qian is having a hard time too, and I naturally will not let Brother Qian suffer from losses.” Chun Yu Feng passionately said.
“No rush.” That plump gigantic male remained indifferent.
“Yes yes yes, come, come and have a taste of this Heavenly Dawn Spiritual Wine. This is a really fragrant wine which our king brewed after leaving the Realm Heart Great Land and discovering the ‘Heavenly God Dawn Tree’ from the neighboring primal chaos void. I had a hard time trying to get this amount.” Chun Yu Feng waved his hand. A half-translucent wine flask appeared in front. One could see the wine glowing in green swishing about through the flask. This flask directly flew onto the table in front of that plump gigantic male.
“Oh, Heavenly Dawn Spiritual Wine?” Only then did this plump male reveal a grin.
“Good wine, good wine.” That plump male seemed to be delighted. As he drank, he would look out at the streets. Even though this carriage was sealed, and outside couldn’t see through the walls, it was possible for those inside to see the scenery outside.
Enjoying beauties serving him while drinking wine, this plump male felt in bliss. Suddenly, his expression slightly changed.
“That is-”
That plump male saw a pair of commoners by the side of the streets. That girl was just a True God, but red divine imprints were starting to rotate in the eyes of that plump male. He could not help but feel delight racing through his heart, ‘This spiritual light emitted by the soul is so concentrated. It is truly a good medicinal lure! Tsk tsk, and it got discovered by me.’
“Stop.” The plump male said.
“Quickly stop the carriage.” Chun Yu Feng immediately announced with a loud voice. The carriage stopped rapidly, and only then did Chun Yu Feng accompany with a laugh: “Brother Qian, what’s the matter?”
“That girl.” The plump male pointed out to the distant streets, “That one who wears a violet gown with a jade hairpin on her head.” He did not wait to condense an illusionary figure of that girl.
“I want this girl.” The plump male said.
Chun Yu Feng looked afar. His information network within the Ardent Fire City was fast. Even though there were not that few aristocratic clan disciples, there were not too many of them either. He recognized all of them and knew with a glance that this girl came from a common background. Even if she was from an aristocratic clan, her status as a True God must be low.
“Brother Qian, rest assured, I’ll immediately grab her over.” Chun Yu Feng chuckled.
That plump male nodded.
He was an outsider, and it was not appropriate for him to conduct such acts. But it was simple for Chun Yu Feng to do so.
…
Yan Wen and his daughter had seen that luxurious carriage in midair a long time ago and recognized that it belonged to the Misty Cloud Pavilion Master. They naturally evaded to the side.
Nevertheless, that carriage sped downwards, stopping not far away from this pair of father and daughter.
The door to the carriage was lifted open, revealing two plump males being served by beauties within. Of which, the Misty Cloud Pavilion Master Chun Yu Feng looked downwards. That pair of small eyes were extremely cold and had landed on the figures of Yan Wen and his daughter: “Bring that girl over.”
“Yes.” The female attendants outside the carriage all had extraordinary strength.
At that moment, two Unity realm attendant female rushed down.
“Mercy! Misty Cloud Pavilion Master, please spare this little girl.” That middleaged male, ‘Yan Wen’, immediately knelt down to beg, “I am a pill alchemist from the medicinal hall of Yan Clan, and do hope for sirs to spare this girl.” The girl by the side, Yan Yu, knelt down in terror similarly.
“Hmph,” Chun Yu Feng coldly snorted. He swept his cold gaze across the two father and daughter and was too lazy to speak.
Yan Wen felt panicked, and his heart was in a mess.
He was clear that even if he was the master of the medicinal hall, that identity was insufficient when compared to this Misty Cloud Pavilion Master, much less when he was merely a pill alchemist.
“Father.” Yan Yu was also incredibly anxious. What would the outcome be if she were to fall in the hands of the Misty Cloud Pavilion Master? If she was lucky, she might just be toyed with by the guests of the Misty Cloud Pavilion. If she wasn’t, she might just be ravaged to death.
“Shua.”
A figure suddenly appeared in midair. He was a gray-robed old man. The gray-robed old man appeared in front of the kneeling father and daughter. With a wave of his hand, ‘hong-’a void fluctuation struck the two Unity realm female attendants who were rushing down.
“Tian Yi Zhi?” The Misty Cloud Pavilion Master Chun Yu Feng looked down with his cold glance. He saw that gray-robed old man and could not help but frown. He recognized this person as an honored guest of Marquis Ardent Fire.
At this moment.
A carriage arced through the sky over. A handsome young man was seated on it. Two Black Stream Cloud Wolves were lying by his side with nine solemn personal guards emitting a grim and cold aura.
“Pavilion Master Chun Yu, why, are you thinking of snatching my servant too?” That handsome male sat there. He lightly caressed the glossy and smooth back hair of the Black Stream Cloud Wolf and nonchalantly said. His voice reverberated in midair, and many cultivators who stood around the street did not dare to speak.
“Prince Xue Ying?” A smile appeared on the face of Pavilion Master Chun Yu, though he was slightly frowning at the plump male by his side.
That plump male stared back at the distant Xue Ying with a cold gaze.
Xue Ying was similarly staring at that plump male.

chapters.title: Chapter 1010 - Weapon–Spear
chapters.content:
Chapter 1010: Weapon-Spear
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Yan Wen and his daughter both knelt there. Their hearts were palpitating. They were both excited and quaking in fear too.
They could not help but look at the two carriages being pulled by dragon beasts. One of them was luxurious and contained both Pavilion Master Chun Yu Feng and a mysterious plump male. The other carriage carried Little Prince Xue Ying who was currently caressing the glossy hair of his Black Stream Cloud Wolf.”
“Father.” Yan Yu transmitted to her father.
“Relax, relax, the identity of Prince Xue Ying is extraordinary. Since he declared it openly, that Pavilion Master Chun Yu will definitely give him some respect.” Yan Wen transmitted words of consolation to his daughter. His heart remained anxious though.
The cultivators in the vicinity had long moved further away from the street. Even though they did not dare to shout and speak, they were all watching the events proceed.
The conflict of both parties above…
Was absolutely between the most prominent characters in the entire Ardent Fire City. One wielded the most significant money squandering establishment and had many subordinates; he had great influencing power too. The other was Little Prince Xue Ying who was being pampered by the whole Ying Shan Clan-even Old Mother Ying Shan regarded him highly.
“Prince Xue Ying, would it be possible for you to part with this female attendant of yours?” Chun Yu Feng chuckled. He was cordial, “I’ll naturally not let you, Prince Xue Ying, suffer.”
“Since you know she is my subordinate, you still want to snatch her away?” Xue Ying sat there casually speaking.
Chun Yu Feng’s expression turned frigid.
It was just a little girl, yet the other party did not show any qualms of giving in. If this Prince Xue Ying were deliberately doing it to obtain benefits from him, Chun Yu Feng would gladly give way and take it as an opportunity of improving their relationship. Who would have thought that this Little Prince Xue Ying was a fool and wanted to help that weak little girl out of her predicament!
Chun Yu Feng glanced at that plump male by his side.
“I do hope that you could help and take down this woman. I’ll definitely remember this favor of yours, Brother Chun Yu. The matter regarding the commodities can be discussed too.” The plump male transmitted back.
Chun Yu Feng felt his heart turning bitter. Brother Qian was clearly not willing to give her up.
“Brother Qian, this Little Prince Ying Shan Xue Ying is too young and innocent. It is the hardest to deal against such an innocent fellow.” Chun Yu Feng transmitted back.
“With the identity of Brother Chun Yu in Ardent Fire City, you can’t even accomplish this minor task?” The plump male replied.
“Ai, this is ultimately the Ardent Fire City, and the status of Marquis Ardent Fire cannot be moved. Furthermore, this Little Prince Xue Ying has said it before that she is really his attendant! If I were to snatch her away, it’d be my fault. Once the affair is made huge, I could not even gain any advantages.” Chun Yu Feng answered.
Snatching away a commoner, killing a pair of commoners…
With how vast the Ardent Fire City was, given that there were several trillions of cultivators living within, this was indeed a minor matter. But speaking from the side of the law, an aristocratic clan disciple would only be fined cosmos crystals when he committed the act.
In reality, as long as the matter was not made prominent, and one did not kill or snatch too many commoners away, there would not be any huge punishments!
But if one were to snatch or kill thousands of commoners, then, strictly speaking, even an aristocratic clan disciple could not be forgiven.
“Why aren’t you coming up? Let your father return first.” Xue Ying was too lazy to even care about delaying for more time. He gave an order.
Elder Tian pulled that girl. At the same time, he transmitted to this pair of father and daughter: “Follow along with prince first. As for you who is the father, if you want to see your daughter in the future, you can visit the Marquisdom.”
“Go, go! Why are you standing here for? Hurry over!” Yan Wen urged her.
“Mn.” The daughter Yan Yu nodded.
“Sou.”
Elder Tian directly pulled this girl over and flew to the side of Xue Ying’s carriage. She stood there beside Xue Ying as if she was really an attendant.
“Let’s go.” Xue Ying was too lazy to even glance at the opposite Pavilion Master Chun Yu Feng.
The two dragon beasts let out a howl. They immediately pulled the carriage and flew across the sky at high speed, leaving behind just Misty Cloud Pavilion Master’s carriage.
“Hua.”
Pavilion Master Chun Yu Feng closed the curtains. He looked towards the currently sullen plump male before saying: “This little prince is too young, and he does things really rudely and unreasonably. But we are originally in the wrong in this affair and could never win against him. It is useless even if I snatched her away. If I were to dare and move, the army from the Ardent Fire Marquisdom would directly kill their way over.”
Pavilion Master Chun Yu Feng also let out a sigh of relief.
Since Xue Ying left so unhesitantly, he actually gave Pavilion Master Chun Yu Feng the excuse of being helpless.
“Hmph.” That plump male’s expression remained sullen. The black aura moved slowly over his body. He stated coldly, “Go to the Misty Cloud Pavilion first.”
“Alright alright.” Chun Yu Feng answered.
“Hua-”
Very soon, this carriage flew at high speed towards the Misty Cloud Pavilion.
The father of that daughter, ‘Yan Wen’, let out a breath of relief. He had guessed that this matter would not implicate him even if the perpetrators did not succeed in kidnapping his daughter away. After all, Pavilion Master Chun Yu Feng would not want to tear apart all relation with Little Prince Xue Ying.
‘Fortunately, Prince Xue Ying acted. Otherwise, this would be a dire situation.’ He sighed inwardly. Even though there were many cultivators within the Ardent Fire City, in addition to the presence of ‘fine’ as a punishment, drastically reducing the killing and snatching by aristocratic clan disciples, when the matter ended up on him, he still felt the despair. Nevertheless, living within the city was better than living out of it.
The world outside the city was truly a chaotic one where killings ran rampant. True Gods like him and ordinary void Gods would get killed without living for too long outside the city.
“Little Prince Xue Ying is really amazing.”
“He actually did not give that Misty Cloud Pavilion Master any respect.”
“Why would Little Prince Xue Ying regard that Misty Cloud Pavilion Master at all? After all, the talent of Little Prince Xue Ying ensures his future is bright. He would likely become a Conferred Marquis in the future!”
“Right right, that is a Conferred Marquis, and he naturally is different from other aristocratic clan disciples.”
The dense cultivators around the place continued their businesses. They were discussing in twos and threes, sighing about the whole affair that happened. To them, this was practically a clash between two huge characters who were almost at the top layer in the entire Ardent Fire City. One level higher? That would be between Marquis Ardent Fire and Chun Yu Wei Yi.
…
On the carriage.
Xue Ying sat there. The female attendant Yan Yu who stood by the side said with gratitude: “Many thanks Prince Xue Ying for saving my life.”
“Despite saying it personally, that Misty Cloud Pavilion Master seems to still want to kidnap you away. It seems that this is the idea of that companion of his-he has a huge desire for you.” Xue Ying said with apathy, “You should just remain as my attendant temporarily for now. Without this identity to protect you, you would likely be kidnapped away.”
“Yes.” Yan Yu said.
She also discovered that it was the plump male by the side of Chun Yu Feng who had a cold and greedy gaze.
“Elder Tian, investigate for me who is that person together with Pavilion Chun Yu Feng today.” Xue Ying said.
“It should not be a person from Ardent Fire City. I’ll immediately investigate everything properly once I return to the Marquisdom.” Tian Yi Zhi said too.
Xue Ying nodded.
He was able to see with a single glance that the aura from that plump male was vile. It seemed he did not care about Chun Yu Feng either. But he was ultimately just a cultivator at the Unity realm, and Xue Ying did not place him in his eyes. He was someone who had cultivated the fourth and fifth style of the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”, and those two moves were sixth level techniques.
As for the stronger seventh level strength? If he had a seventh level strength, he could directly become a Conferred Marquis! Hence, Xue Ying would have reached an extremely high status within the Ardent Fire City in just 8,000 years of cultivation.
Very soon.
The carriage arrived ‘Treasured Goods Market’ region. The entire Treasured Goods Market was filled with shops that either sold pills, materials, weapons and all sorts of unique items. There were low to high grades of item existing within. For instance, in the five great sacred worlds where Xue Ying originated from, such trades were usually conducted only by the holy grounds. But it was different in the Realm Heart Great Land. The transactions conducted here flourished more and varied greatly. The entire ‘Treasured Goods Market’ even had a vast array operating that prevented anyone from stealing away the items from any shops within.
“Prince Xue Ying, you haven’t come for a long time.”
“Prince Xue Ying, hurry up in.”
As Xue Ying came, many managers of the shops became passionate.
Because during the 1,000 years or so after Xue Ying came into this world, other than going out to eat all sorts of delicacies, the other activity which Xue Ying liked to do was to stroll around the Treasured Goods Market in many of the shops within. He would browse through the different weapon refinements and even some items that originated from the ancient remnants. Xue Ying was able to discover different mysteries from them.
Xue Ying entered a huge shop. Just as he came in, he was able to spot a spear floating right at the center of the entire shop; this spear was emitting an ancient murderous aura.
“Mn?” When Xue Ying saw that spear, he felt the aura coming from it, causing his eyes to brighten.
“Prince Xue Ying, you have good eyesight.” The manager by the side enthusiastically greeted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1011 - Using the Spear in this Life again
chapters.content:
Chapter 1011: Using the Spear in this Life again
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“I’ll have a look.” Xue Ying directly responded. He cut off the lengthy introduction which the manager was about to give.
“Please, please.” The manager immediately replied.
Only then did Xue Ying extend his hand to grab this spear. The surface of the spear contained many veined patterns, and it was comfortable to hold the spear body.
With a pull, the spear moved like a dragon. At the same time, it gave off a faint wail.
The manager muttered softly after seeing it: “This Little Prince Xue Ying, it seems you know spear techniques?”
Xue Ying grabbed on to the tip of the spear body with his left hand while caressing the spear body with his right. A familiar feeling was gnawing on his heart. Before reincarnating, Xue Ying primarily cultivated the Dao of Mirage. It was not appropriate for him to use the spear and engage in close combat while using the illusory realm. Hence, Xue Ying had directly given up using the spear for close combat in the future despite using it frequently during the early stages.
But after coming to the Realm Heart Great Land, Xue Ying had decided to cultivate in two main paths. The Dao of Mirage still remained as one of it since he had a high talent in it. The other was the Dao of Void! After all, he already accumulated great experience and understanding in it. Xue Ying obtained the inheritances from Void Primogenitor, Monarch Nine Cloud before getting the chance to study the scaled armor left behind by General Mo Gu. Xue Ying even comprehended the void for a trillion years in the Lost World Corridor. These foundational comprehensions coupled with his perception of another way of using the void during the process of transfer when using the Realm Heart Order and the fact that he joined the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion meant that Xue Ying would have a bright future in the void.
Hence, it was natural for Xue Ying to cultivate in these two Dao paths!
And the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” was a close combat absolute art! Most would usually use their bodies as a weapon, but it was possible for the cultivator to use other weapons too.
‘In this life, I’ll be using the spear again.’ Xue Ying thought.
“Weng.”
He then sent his consciousness into the spear. Previously, it was the aura of this spear that attracted him over. This time, he wanted to thoroughly examine it.
“Hong~” As his consciousness permeated into it, Xue Ying could vaguely see a huge dark maelstrom stairway. The stairway led deeper and deeper, and space became more mysterious. After all, the void in the Realm Heart Great Land was quite similar to the void in the origin world he came from, Xue Ying was thus able to understand part of this profundity.
As Xue Ying inspected further, he continued moving deeper along the maelstrom stairway. It got faster and faster, and the veined pattern son the spear body lit up.
Suddenly, everything shattered.
Xue Ying frowned as he looked at the spearhead of the spear. The spear body was a dull gray, yet its spearhead was emanating a bloody murderous aura and was deep violet in color.
“It seems this spearhead isn’t one entity with the spear body?” Xue Ying asked.
“Prince Xue Ying has good eyesight.” The manager answered from the side, “We have requested an expert over to inspect through this weapon before. It should be refined by a Cosmos God, and the spearhead was added after that. The spearhead is quite murderous and tyrannical as you can feel.”
Xue Ying shook his head softly.
Murderous and tyrannical?
The original spearhead of this spear body should allow the cultivator to unleash an extremely horrifying void killing move! And it was absolutely at the Cosmos God level. Furthermore, this usage of the void was something Xue Ying had never seen before. If he had the whole spear, Xue Ying felt that it would be worth it even if he used the entire Ardent Fire Marquisdom to exchange for it.
It’s a pity that there was only the spear body left, causing its value to depreciate significantly. Even though the spearhead was added after that, it was quite ordinary.
“Prince Xue Ying.” The manager added, “This secret treasure weapon is missing its spearhead, yet the spearhead added after that had been used for a trillion years. Its power is extraordinary. More importantly, it is cheap. You only need to pay 12 million cosmos crystals for it!”
He stared at Xue Ying.
12 million cosmos crystals… the number of people who could afford it in the entire Ardent Fire City could not be more than what could be counted using two hands! This so-called Little Prince Xue Ying who was favored by Old Mother Ying Shan should be able to afford it.
“12 million cosmos crystals?” Elder Tian Yi Zhi roared from the side, “Do you know how much is 12 million cosmos crystals? It can even buy a complete secret treasure weapon!”
There were many Cosmos Gods in the Realm Heart Great Land. Hence, it was more common to find secret treasure weapons here as compared to in the primal chaos void five great sacred worlds.
Xue Ying was watching from the side.
It’s value?
With his previous attainments in the void, Xue Ying could deduce the origin of this spear was extraordinary. Just the value of its spear body should be worth beyond 100 million cosmos crystals! It seemed this shop should never have invited a Primal Chaos Giant who cultivated in the Dao of Void over. Otherwise, they would not have stated this price.
But Xue Ying would not readily agree to the price reported by the other party because he only had a total of 15 million cosmos crystals with him! He should be ranked in the top three within the entire Ardent Fire Marquisdom in terms of wealth.
Of which eight million cosmos crystals had been bestowed by Old Mother Ying Shan! Two million cosmos crystals were given by Marquis Ardent Fire. Marquis Ardent Fire had also given him cavern-dwellings, shops, and many territories. Xue Ying was able to collect rental fees from those cavern-dwellings and shops. The reason why some of the aristocratic clan disciples could live so extravagantly was that they owned multiple cavern-dwellings and shops, allowing them to earn cosmos crystals continually. Even though it was few, one had to know that a single cosmos crystal was worth more than 10,000 upper graded primal rocks. One could live in luxury.
Xue Ying was fully confident of himself. He did not have to depend on the cavern-dwellings and shops for a living. Hence, he had long sold those to the Marquisdom, obtaining five million cosmos crystals in total.
Currently, he had a total of 15 million cosmos crystals!
Hw was more wealthy than even the elders of the Marquisdom!
“Elder Tian, you don’t have to say anymore. 10 million cosmos crystals. This is the utmost limit of our master.” The manager helplessly said, “Prince Xue Ying, honestly speaking, this spear body was discovered 15 years ago by a group of cultivators adventuring in some ancient remnants. They were very fortunate to obtain this spear body amidst a round of killings. In the end, two cultivators who survived brought this spear body over to me! We had even suffered from the assassinations by the companions of those who went to the ancient remnant. At that time, this matter had been made huge, and Prince Xue Ying could find out more about this easily. My master has already planned to return to his clan’s ‘Celestial Yin City’ several hundred years later if he could not sell this spear. By then, there would be many more experts who could afford it.”
Xue Ying slightly nodded as he listened. He believed this story should not be fake since an event which happened just 15 years ago should easily be investigated by him.
“Alright. I’ll buy it for 10 million cosmos crystals.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Alright, alright!” The manager was in great joy.
His master was only a disciple from one of the four great clans, the ‘Celestial Yin Clan’. He had been arranged here to take charge of the business here. If he sold the spear, his master would have greater benefits from then on. If he were to sell the spear in the Celestial Yin City, his master would definitely be exploited by the clan.
‘We’ve earned great! I thought this spear would not be sold even after master set the lower limit of 10 million cosmos crystals! Previously, we only spent three million cosmos crystals to buy it.’ This manager felt joyful. Actually, those who risked their lives in acquiring this spear body from the ancient remnant was very satisfied with earning the three million cosmos crystals.
But he did not know.
This secret treasure weapon which seemed lacking the spearhead was in reality worth more than 100 million cosmos crystals! This was ultimately a small place, and even if Marquis Ardent Fire came personally, he who did not specialize in the void could only deduce it was refined by a Cosmos God. He could not verify how precious it is.
Very soon, that Celestial Yin clan disciple ‘Celestial Yin Flowing Jade’ rushed over personally to complete this transaction.
“Haha, Prince Xue Ying, I’ll be returning to the Celestial Yin City in a few days. If you were to pay the Celestial Yin City a visit, you must tell me. I’ll definitely receive you well.” Celestial Yin Flowing Jade was extremely delighted. This shop was property under his name. Previously, he spent three million cosmos crystals to purchase this spear, which cost him almost all his treasures. Furthermore, he even pawned some merchandise from his shop for cosmos crystals.
Currently, he had earned seven million cosmos crystals in a single instant. Celestial Yin Flowing Jade felt he no longer needed to stay in the Ardent Fire City anymore. It was fine for his subordinates to stay here, and he could return to the Celestial Yin City then.
The Celestial Yin City was protected by a Cosmos God and was much more flourishing than this place.
…
Xue Ying’s mood was good as he brought this spear back to the cavern-dwelling. He directly entered closed-door cultivation in the Void God Pagoda.
Within the Void God Pagoda.
Xue Ying sat on the floating great rock, caressing this ancient spear which emitted a murderous aura. Nevertheless, he felt satisfied. He reminisced back to those days when he trained in the spear.
‘This is a secret treasure weapon, and I could use it even after reaching the Cosmos God realm.’ Xue Ying chuckled, ‘You will be accompanying me for a very long time.’
“Weng.”
The spear let out a ringing sound. Being a secret treasure, it naturally had spirit.
Xue Ying chuckled. Using the spear once again made him feel happy. He then began concentrating once again: ‘It is time for me to break through to the Unity realm.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1012 - Ecstasy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1012: Ecstasy
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was meditating calmly on a great floating stone with distorted spatial stream revolving around him.
With many precious bloodline-nourishing treasures provided by Old Mother Ying Shan and Marquis Ardent Fire, Xue Ying’s void bloodline that was originally diluted had become more concentrated. But it remained ‘thin’. Nevertheless, Xue Ying’s realm had reached a profound stage, and he was able to activate the hiding void bloodline in his body easily.
“Hong~”
The void bloodline became activated on a deeper level. At that moment, it enabled a qualitative transformation across every single particle. They were changes happening within the structure of the particle. This happened when the cultivator upgraded from Origin Birth realm to the Unity realm. With this upgrade in the level of his body, it was natural for a phenomenon to be created where the surrounding world energy was frantically being absorbed. The Void God Pagoda was built for cultivation, yet a deep black hole in the form of a maelstrom had formed within. All the incoming world energy was then released from the black hole before ending up being absorbed into the body of Xue Ying.
After a moment later, his body broke through to the Unity realm.
‘I can start cultivating the “Southern Cloud Sacred Body”.’ Xue Ying revealed a look of ecstasy. The “Southern Cloud Sacred Body” was a body-cultivation technique accompanied by the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”. Xue Ying did not dare to cultivate previously when he first trained in the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” because he would have to step into the Unity realm immediately after that.
“Hua, hua, hua…”
Waving his hand, a pile of dark green soil was placed on the great stone in front of him.
Xue Ying began unleashing the Southern Cloud Sacred Body cultivation technique. The moment it was operated, this dark green soil began emitting green light spots that entered Xue Ying’s body…
This Southern Cloud Sacred Body was considered an apex body refining technique even in the six great ancient nations. The only flaw it had was its extravagance! To train in this technique, it was required for the cultivator to absorb many precious essences. The idea behind it was to treat the body like a ‘secret treasure weapon’ and refine it. It was comparatively easier to perfect a secret treasure weapon since the soul would be implicated when honing the body, making it vital for one to be careful when doing so. The required materials were much more demanding, and their value would naturally be more expensive.
‘Wait until I become stronger. By then, I can depend on myself to earn more cosmos crystals. Relying on Marquis Ardent Fire and Old Mother Ying Shan is not enough.’ Xue Ying understood this point. Marquis Ardent Fire was only an ordinary Primal Chaos giant, so how much treasures could he have? Old Mother Ying Shan had more riches, but how much could she earn after bestowing them to her descendants?
Ultimately, Xue Ying had to depend on himself.
Of course, it would be sufficient to rely on the help of Ying Shan Clan during the early stages. This was the benefit of being part of a clan. Those without a good background would have to risk their lives to earn sufficient resources. Without enough resources, cultivation would be a hundred to a thousand times harder, especially when cultivating those harsh systems like the ‘laws and profound mysteries system’.
…
Half a month later.
Xue Ying left the Void God Pagoda. He looked up, only to see the snowflakes floating down.
“It’s snowing?” Xue Ying felt startled.
“What!?” Tian Yi Zhi looked at their clan prince with shock. This handsome young man was currently emitting an aura that was shockingly at the Unity realm.
“Unity realm? It has been 8, 8,000 years? Just 8,000 years?” Tian Yi Zhi did not dare believe. To Void Gods, 8,000 years was merely a nap.
“It has been a while since I accompanied mother. Elder Tian, let’s go.” Xue Ying said.
“Ai.” Tian Yi Zhi hurriedly answered. The two Black Stream Cloud Wolves by the side were also in a daze, though they soon rushed up to Xue Ying.
“Weng.”
The array that enveloped the huge Marquisdom also sensed Xue Ying’s aura, of which the array spirit reported this upwards to Marquis Ardent Fire.
******
Marquis Ardent Fire was enjoying wine by himself next to the lake.
The snowflakes were seen falling from the sky.
“Grandpa Marquis.” A girl politely said from the side.
“How is the matter regarding the secret treasure weapon?” Marquis Ardent Fire indifferently said, “He did not get scammed right?”
Previously, he was informed about how Xue Ying spent a total of 10 million cosmos crystals to buy a secret treasure. At that instant, he felt that Xue Ying was definitely cheated.
Only secret treasures qualified as upper graded would be worth above 10 million cosmos crystals!
What would a young fellow who was only 8,000 years old know about secret treasures? Marquis Ardent Fire was indignant at that moment. He felt that the other party had set a trap to scheme on Xue Ying because he had the cosmos crystals.
But knowing that it was a shop under the name of a disciple from the Celestial Yin Clan, ‘Celestial Yin Flowing Jade’, Marquis Ardent Fire was not in a rush to flare up. Instead, he dispatched someone to investigate the whole matter clearly.
The girl respectfully answered: “That weapon is a spear. It was discovered by several Unity experts 15 years ago when they were outside adventuring in an ancient remnant. They even fought and killed each other. In the end, they finally returned to the city and sold that spear to that shop owned by Celestial Yin Flowing Jade at three million cosmos crystals. At that time, the shop even suffered from assassination by other fellows, though they were fortunate to survive. At that time, our Ardent Fire Army had even dispatched soldiers out to capture them and interrogate what happened.”
Marquis Ardent Fire’s frown let off after hearing it.
The shops located in the Treasured Goods Market were all petty. For them to be willing to purchase this spear at three million cosmos crystals, and for Xue Ying to buy it at 10 million cosmos crystals, would not result in Xue Ying losing much.
As long as it was not a scheme, Marquis Ardent Fire would never intervene.
“The spear body is extraordinary. It’s a pity the spearhead is missing and added after that.” The girl said, “That is why it was sold at this price. Prince Xue Ying should not have suffered from a loss.”
“Mn.” Marquis Ardent Fire nodded.
“Also, we have investigated the identity of the guest with Pavilion Master Chun Yu Feng that had a conflict with Prince Xue Ying on the street.” The girl said, “He is called Qian Gan Xue and is not someone famous. He is just a person that commits shady businesses.”
Marquis Ardent Fire softly nodded.
The Misty Cloud Pavilion was the most significant money squandering establishment. It naturally conducted business transactions beyond the law.
“Continue observing him.” Marquis Ardent Fire coldly ordered. Being the person who wielded the greatest authority in Ardent Fire City, he would definitely send people to pay attention to experts that had some exceptional backgrounds.
“Yes.” The girl acknowledged.
Marquis Ardent Fire held onto his wine cup. He drank another cup before his expression changed.
“Master, Prince Ying Shan Xue Ying has broken through to the Unity realm.” A voice directly sounded by his ears.
“Hu!”
Marquis Ardent Fire abruptly stood up, causing the girl beside to look with shock at her clan’s Grandpa Marquis.
“Unity realm? He entered the Unity realm?” Marquis Ardent Fire was both shocked and joyful. He excitedly murmured to himself, “It has only been 8,000 years yet he broke through to the Unity realm?”
That was a horrifying speed.
Under normal circumstances, those who were given birth to Origin Birth realm would have to spend 10 million years before they stepped into the Unity realm.
“Old Ancestor wasn’t wrong in her words.” The eyes of Marquis Ardent Fire lit up. He was ecstatic, “This Prince Xue Ying was forced into birth prematurely, yet his potential remains huge. It is entirely possible for more potential to be dug out from him! Bestowing him those bloodline-nourishing treasures is indeed the right choice! Even if Xue Ying remained in conception, he would remain in the mother’s womb for several hundred to thousands of years before coming out at the Unity realm. The difference now was that he spent just ten times the time to reach the Unity realm.”
Marquis Ardent Fire felt satisfied.
The number of people who were at the Unity realm during birth could be counted with one’s fingers in the history of Southern Cloud Nation. All of them easily broke through to the Primal Chaos realm! And two had even become Conferred Kings!
Even if Xue Ying was prematurely given birth, he reached the Unity realm in 8,000 years…
This period that was ten times longer did not matter much.
“Nevertheless, he is still slightly affected by the premature birth.” Marquis Ardent Fire could not help but beam, “But the impact isn’t huge. Hahaha, it seems that I will have another Primal Chaos expert in my Ardent Fire Marquisdom.”
Even though Xue Ying would definitely become a Conferred Marquis in the future and open a Marquisdom himself, his relationship with Marquis Ardent Fire would never change.
After all, Xue Ying belonged to the lineage of Marquis Ardent Fire! Strictly speaking, Marquis Ardent Fire was his grandpa!
“I must immediately report this to the Old Ancestor.” Marquis Ardent Fire hurriedly transmitted this news to Old Mother Ying Shan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1013 - Eliminate him
chapters.content:
Chapter 1013: Eliminate him
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was currently accompanying his mother Rong Xing Lan and sister. They were presently chatting while eating.
Rong Xing Lan felt joyful because her son had finally left closed-door cultivation after more than 6,000 years; she had not seen her son ever since then. Currently, she was a noble, so it was logical that she could order the servants with a command, asking them to serve delicious food for them to enjoy.
“Even though cultivating is important, my son, there is no need to exhaust yourself so much.” Rong Xing Lan smiled, “Mother might not understand many things, but I have read quite a few books these years and understand that cultivating the heart is important towards securing a bright future. Ultimately, son, you have experienced too few things.”
“This son understands.” Xue Ying obediently answered.
Rong Xing Lan giggled even more brilliantly. She liked her son a lot, yet did not dare to disturb him in fear of affecting his future. She could only watch from the side. But her current identity was no longer the same. She had many treasures now, and by relying on the bloodline cultivation system, she quickly broke through to the True God realm. Without having a limit to her lifespan, she naturally became calmer and more tranquil.
“Xue Ying.” A voice sounded throughout the place.
Rong Xing Lan and Ying Shan Xi Yue were all shocked. Who dared to intrude Xue Ying’s cavern-dwelling?
Xue Ying turned his head over too.
Only to see two figures currently flying over. One of them was naturally Marquis Ardent Fire. He stood obediently behind an old granny. That old granny was currently smiling at Xue Ying. Marquis Ardent Fire roared out: “Why aren’t you greeting the Old Ancestor?”
“Xue Ying greets Old Ancestor.” Xue Ying immediately bowed politely.
Rong Xing Lan and Ying Shan Xi Yue were both greatly startled. There was only one person in the whole Ying Shan Clan who was qualified to be called the Old Ancestor, and that was the legendary Old Mother Ying Shan! The two of them immediately stood up from their chair and knelt by the side.
“Stand up.” Old Mother Ying Shan waved her hand. Rong Xing Lan and Ying Shan Xi Yue both stood up.
Old Mother Ying Shan then walked to a stool and sat down. Marquis Ardent Fire stood by her side. Old Mother Ying Shan then began scrutinizing Xue Ying.
This young fellow…
Was still young, yet he had broken through to the Unity realm.
“Ardent Fire did not govern his Marquisdom well, leading to you being forced into birth prematurely.” Old Mother Ying Shan chuckled, “It is fortunate that you could reach the Unity realm in 8,000 years. Even though your premature birth might have influenced your potential, it isn’t huge.”
“I am thankful for those treasures bestowed by Old Ancestor and Grandpa Marquis.” Xue Ying replied.
“Those are just external materials. What matters more is your extraordinary potential.” Old Mother Ying Shan waved her hand, causing a wristband to fly over, “Properly cultivate. With your talent, it isn’t hard for you to reach the Primal Chaos realm. I hope that the King could personally make you a Conferred King one day. It isn’t enough to reach that standard just by relying on your bloodline. What you need more is to cultivate your heart, gain more experience and temper yourself well.”
Marquis Ardent Fire was startled when he heard that.
Conferred King?
One had to cross through the God Yuan Pagoda ninth level to be qualified for that.
Old Mother Ying Shan nodded. She was only proposing an ambitious request. In her opinion, Xue Ying would likely reach the Primal Chaos realm after cultivating for a period. But it was hard to reach the ‘Conferred King’ position. One had to have a profound heart realm. Even if the bloodline was more precious, it was entirely unrelated to the cultivation heart. One still had to temper himself.
Xue Ying reached the ‘My Heart as the World’ realm level in his previous life, and it wasn’t easy.
“Xue Ying will definitely do his best.” Xue Ying nodded. He took over the wristband, refined it and checked through the content. His heart could not help but jump at the next moment!
There was a pile of cosmos crystals within, and after sweeping through it, Xue Ying ascertained that there were 50 million cosmos crystals! Such a tremendous amount!
“Cultivate well. Also, cosmos crystals are precious. You must think through in the future when you purchase things.” Marquis Ardent Fire threw over a storage treasure too. Xue Ying naturally received it and checked through it. There were eight million cosmos crystals placed inside. Adding them up, Marquis Ardent Fire had given him a total of 10 million cosmos crystals in total. That was a considerable burden to Marquis Ardent Fire.
Xue Ying naturally accepted them. Being a disciple of the Ying Shan Clan, he was willing to receive these benefits. In the future, he would undoubtedly take up a role with a massive responsibility for the clan. This was something Old Mother Ying Shan and Marquis Ardent Fire looked forward to.
…
“What?”
“Old Mother Ying Shan has such luck? One of her descendants actually broke through to the Unity realm in just 8,000 years after birth?”
“Teacher, I’ve heard that the cultivator called Ying Shan Xue Ying was forced into birth after just spending 15 years in the womb. The Ying Shan Clan has immediately provided a large amount of bloodline-nourishing treasures for that young fellow to use. Only then did he break through to the Unity realm in 8,000 years.”
…
“It seems there will be another Marquis in the Ying Shan Clan in the future.”
…
“That old granny of Ying Shan Clan is most likely grinning until her mouth is twisted.”
…
This news spread like wildfire across all the powerful organizations within Southern Cloud Nation. They also etched this name-Ying Shan Xue Ying-in their mind because it was certain for him to become a Conferred Marquis in the future.
And within Ardent Fire City, ‘Chan Yu Yan Zhen’ who had been hiding in the house arranged by her son, fell into a daze once she received the news: “What? The son of that lowly woman broke through to the Unity realm in just 8,000 years? It is almost certain for him to become a Conferred Marquis in the future? What should I do? What should I do? Will he remember this enmity and kill me in the future once he becomes a Conferred Marquis?”
******
Amidst the vast rolling black cloud, an ancient palace could be seen faintly within.
Within the palace.
A massive figure with a black twisted horn sat cross-legged within. His body was surrounded by a cold black aura.
“You say that young fellow called Ying Shan Xue Ying is a disciple of the Ying Shan Clan, Ardent Fire Marquisdom?” That muscular male with black twisted horn said with a deep tone. His blood-colored eyes looked downwards.
“Teacher, this disciple is sure. Strictly speaking, Ying Shan Xue Ying is the son of the second son of Marquis Ardent Fire, ‘Ying Shan Lie Hu’.” A red-robed male beneath respectfully answered.
“Marquis Ardent Fire?”
The tall, muscular male continued speaking with a deep tone, “Who would have thought that he will be so lucky!”
The red-robed male obediently remained quiet.
He was clear of how thick the enmity his teacher had with Marquis Ardent Fire. He was even responsible for collecting all intelligence regarding the Maruiqs Ardent Fire.
…
Within the Ardent Fire City inside the Misty Cloud Pavilion.
The Misty Cloud Pavilion spanned across a considerable area, and it was covered in fog. This place was like a fantasy. In one of the slightly more concealed residence.
“Who would have thought that Prince Xue Ying has broken through to the Unity realm in just 8,000 years.” The plump male sat there. He was letting the beauties serving him and feeding him fruits. His expression was grave.
He had never given up his thoughts of snatching that girl called ‘Yan Yu’. That was a pill lure which he had always dreamt of getting.
“Chun Yu Feng that trash.” The plump male gritted his teeth.
Chun Yu Feng had even agreed to his proposal previously, but after Xue Ying broke through to the Unity realm, Chun Yu Feng immediately rejected him. It represented that he would no longer be participating in this affair. After all, why would the other party offend an existence who would definitely become a Conferred Marquis in the future? Chun Yu Feng was not that foolish.
“Mn?” The plump male became startled.
“Everyone withdraw.” The plump male stood up.
“Yes.” The surrounding beauties all obediently went out.
The plump male then rapidly entered the cultivation room in this residence. It was absolutely safe within and had isolated all scouting techniques from the external world. The plump male even brought along treasures that could block off such methods.
“Weng.”
At that moment, an illusory figure appeared by the side of the plump male. He was none other than the tall figure with a twisted black horn. This figure was currently covered in black fog.
“Qian Gan Xue greets master.” The plump male immediately knelt. He prostate to the other party in worship.
“Do you know that one called Ying Shan Xue Ying? That Ying Shan Clan disciple who broke through to the Unity realm in just 8,000 years after birth?” The tall figure with black twisted horn said with a cold voice.
“I know him.” The plump male immediately answered.
“I permit you to mobilize the manpower from the 12th city. You can use all the cosmos crystals at hand. Kill that Ying Shan Xue Ying for me with the fastest speed.” The tall figure with black twisted horn coldly stated.
“Kill Ying Shan Xue Ying?” The plump male was slightly stunned.
The tall figure with black twisted horn looked at him.
The plump male immediately answered, “Yes, yes, master, please feel rest assured. I’ll definitely do my best.”
“Don’t disappoint me. Otherwise, you know the consequences.” The voice of that tall figure with the black twisted horn was soft, yet it made the plump male tremble in fear. That was fear originating from the heart.
“Yes, yes, I’ll definitely kill him.” The plump male added.
“Marquis Ardent Fire…” The blood-colored eyes of the tall figure with black twisted horn were filled with full killing intent, “Since I can’t kill you, I’ll first eliminate the future Primal Chaos existence in your Marquisdom. You will definitely turn mad from it, haha…”
That figure gradually dissipated.
Only then did the plump male stand up. He gulped down and suppressed his racing heart. Thoughts started racing through his mind. He understood it was impossible for him to disobey his master. Just thinking of the consequences of doing so made a chill run down his spine.
‘Fortunately, that Ying Shan Xue Ying has just broken through to the Unity realm. Right now, he should only be able to exert a force at the God Yuan Palace first or the second level. The only troublesome point of killing him though is the fact that the Ardent Fire Marquisdom would definitely put his best resources to protect him.” The plump male gritted his teeth, “Master has also permitted me to mobilize the manpower from the 12th city, and to use all the allowance given to me? Mn, I must think of a way that would not fail. The moment we act, we must not give him an opportunity. Otherwise, if that Prince Xue Ying did not die, I’ll be the one dying.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1014 - Graceful Rain by the Lakeside
chapters.content:
Chapter 1014: Graceful Rain by the Lakeside
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
For the sake of surviving, the plump male ‘Qian Gan Xue’ began preparing for the assassination. He did not even care about how much cosmos crystals it took. He purchased poison and even invited the killers from ‘Dark Devil Great Lake’… Qian Gan Xue even prepared multiple backup plans, but what stunned him was…
That little prince Xue Ying from Ardent Fire Marquisdom actually remained in his residence after purchasing that secret treasure spear!
“I do not believe it!”
“He is just a young fellow who was given birth not long ago. Hence, with his heart temperament, how could it be possible for him to calm his heart down to cultivate for so long? He will definitely come out.” Qian Gan Xue anxiously awaited.
Ten years, hundred years, thousand years, 10,000 years, 100,000 years…
Qian Gan Xue fell in a daze.
The ‘master’ behind him was similarly shocked. Because in their opinion, even if one had a more precious bloodline, the heart temperament would still have to be tempered through multiple occasions. Only then was it possible for the other party to cultivate in closed-door across a million years or longer. Who would have thought this young fellow could enclose himself for so long?
“Master, he, he isn’t coming out. What should we do?” Qian Gan Xue reported to his master in a panic.
“Wait! Unless your patience can’t even be compared to a young fellow?”
“Yes.”
Qian Gan Xue also let out a breath of relief.
His master was sensible and did not force him to assassinate Xue Ying within the Marquisdom. After all, the array security within was strict, and his master would fail the assassination even if he went personally.
******
Marquis Ardent Fire and Mother Rong Xing Lan both persuaded Xue Ying that cultivating the heart was important, and there was no need to bury one’s head into cultivating for a long period. Xue Ying might have acknowledged them using words, but in reality, he continued ‘cultivating like a madman’, entering closed-door cultivation for several hundred thousand years to a million years. After exiting for a few days, he would return back to cultivating.
He had no choice.
Xue Ying was ultimately not a young fellow. His true spirit reincarnated into this body, and his heart realm had reached the ‘My Heart as the World’. Furthermore, he was even a great expert that created two ninth level techniques within the laws and profound mysteries system that was known to be tough! With his current heart temperament, it was quite simple to enter closed-door cultivation for 10 billion years in one ago. As for tempering his heart?
Unless he needed another entanglement with love? Or some inconsolable heartbreak to temper his heart temperament?
Xue Ying was not in that mood to stay idle! Many other cultivators did likewise, and so he could similarly act like he was mad for cultivation.
In the blink of an eye, it had been five million years.
Ardent Fire Marquisdom, within the residence of Prince Xue Ying.
“Hong long~”
The Void God Pagoda’s door opened.
A white-robed handsome young man came out. Fine rain drizzled across the world, though when this young man came out, the rain made way a foot away from his body.
“Prince.”
“Prince.”
Many of the protectors and servants standing guard outside greeted respectfully. The entire residence soon became bustling. Tian Yi Zhi, the two Black Stream Cloud Wolves, and nine personal guards all rushed over. As they came, Xue Ying had already reached one of the nearby lakes.
Beside a lake was a pavilion.
A praying mat was placed within this pavilion. Xue Ying sat there cross-legged. The female servant Yan Yu had respectfully placed a wine flask on the table while warming it up. She looked curiously at her house prince: ‘Prince has an extraordinary birth, though I’ve never seen him like any girls or see him visiting the Misty Cloud Pavilion for fun. He treats everyone equally, and is always cultivating.’
‘No wonder. No wonder some cultivators are so powerful that it feels otherworldly. My birth cannot compare with the prince, yet I only wanted to enjoy life. Prince is so diligent.’ Yan Yu thought.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying extended his right hand. A spear appeared in it. It was placed horizontally on his legs. Being a secret treasure weapon, just the murderous aura inherent within the spearhead made the heart of Yan Yu stopped momentarily.
“Weng!”
An unseen ripple extended out from this spear body. It was like throwing a piece of rock into a calm lake, causing ripples to spread outwards.
The ripples spread out from the spear body were subtle. They easily permeated in the surrounding void. The void was under the total control of Xue Ying. As the distant Tian Yi Zhi, Black Stream Cloud Wolves and personal guards rushed over-Tian Yi Zhi was even an expert at the God Yuan Palace fifth level strength, he could teleport and had a keen perception on the void, yet he did not discover the surrounding void being controlled by someone.
Xue Ying sat there cross-legged. It felt like a spider controlling the spiderweb. All void near Xue Ying was under his control, and sections of void around him started distorting and changing.
The distortions and transformations were all subtle.
Even if it occurred so close to the cultivator, it was hard for him to perceive it unless his body interacted with the web.
“Hua hua hua~”
Countless rain droplets began moving gracefully.
Many tiny distorted spatial pockets transferred the rain droplets into an area several kilometers away, before moving them to another location. The water droplets were teleported away because of the distortion of the void. Furthermore, as the rain droplets were teleported, a seamless connection remained between them as if it was still raining.
“Prince.” Tian Yi Zhi, the two Black Stream Cloud Wolves, and the nine personal guards arrived by the side of the pavilion. Xue Ying controlled the void to open a path for them, which as a result, Tian Yi Zhi and the others did not feel any difference despite the web being so close.
Such minute control was something even other Primal Chaos giants would feel startled about.
Xue Ying continued drinking his wine.
At the same time, he was controlling the void distortions. The more he commanded it, the more satisfied he got: ‘I am so glad that I bought this spear.’
During the past five million years…
Xue Ying was also single-mindedly cultivating. Because the Dao of Void in the two origin worlds was relatively similar, speaking from the laws and profound mysteries system, Xue Ying’s Dao of Void had already reached the Primal Chaos realm not too long ago! As for the bloodline breakthrough, Xue Ying had even entered the Primal Chaos realm at an earlier period. It was only that such speed would shock the entire world. Even a genius should cultivate with speed classified under an ‘ordinary category’.
Even though Xue Ying was stuck at the Unity realm on the surface, his research and comprehension of the Void did not stop. Over time as his realm deepened, he began researching on this spear.
Exploring the spear body of this spear was just like observing a black maelstrom stair that was distorted. It continued deeper and deeper, and every level was an intersection of different kinds of the void. Ever since Xue Ying started cultivating this Dao, he realized that his body was like the core of this maelstrom, and it was possible for him to influence the surrounding crisscrossing void.
And that was the technique which this spear body had.
Even though the spearhead was lacking, causing part of the profound mysteries inherent within this secret treasure to be lost, it was sufficient for Xue Ying.
With his solid experience, he was able to comprehend some domain control technique. Once he had done so, the technique was qualified to be a ‘God Yuan Palace seventh level technique’. More importantly, if Xue Ying relied on the spear body to employ this technique, even though he had not comprehended many of the profound mysteries, making it taxing for him to use the technique, Xue Ying’s strength would nevertheless explode and allow the technique to reach ‘God Yuan Palace eighth level’.
A domain technique at the eighth level.
‘More importantly, the technique inherent within this spear body is at the Cosmos God level. Right now, I have merely understood a piece of it.’ Xue Ying felt satisfied because the void technique inherent within this spear body was of a different direction with the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”.
‘It’s a pity I lack the spearhead, making it much harder for me to comprehend this technique.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
Within the Void God Pagoda, he could utilize the wild side of this domain all he wanted.
But now that he was within the pavilion by the lake, Xue Ying was only employing the most subtle side of this domain-stealthily permeating into his surroundings.
‘The Realm Heart Great Land has a foundation much stronger than that of the primal chaos void. Over there, the Dao of Void only had Monarch Nine Cloud, Void Primogenitor and the mysterious Myriad Realm Tavern Master’s lineage that are considered as formidable. Yet in the Realm Heart Great Land, in my Southern Cloud Nation, I’d interacted with two horrifying techniques left behind by experts.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
One was created by the Southern Cloud King, and the other was a spear refined by an expert of the Dao of Void.
‘Keep.’
Xue Ying’s heart moved.
The domain completely dissipated. All the rain remained gracefully falling just like before, and the nearby Tian Yi Zhi, the female servant Yan Yu, and all the protectors did not discover anything amiss at all.
Xue Ying was not worried about being discovered. Even Marquis Ardent Fire had to rely on his own law domain to perceive this technique. Otherwise, with the control Marquis Ardent Fire had of the void, it was impossible for him to sense it from such a considerable distance. Strictly speaking, Xue Ying was no longer weaker than the great expert Marquis Ardent Fire.
Only when both parties fought would the victor be decided.

chapters.title: Chapter 1015 - Entering the Misty Cloud Pavilion for the First Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 1015: Entering the Misty Cloud Pavilion for the First Time
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
‘It has been five million years. I can now publicize the fact that I have reached the God Yuan Palace fifth level strength. By relying on this, I could visit the Southern Cloud Capital and acquire the complete “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”.’ Xue Ying thought.
Xue Ying still desired the complete version of the absolute art that could allow him to exert eighth level strength at Unity realm and tenth level strength at Primal Chaos realm.
To others, it was a waste even acquiring this book since they could not even reach the ninth level strength at Primal Chaos realm.
But Xue Ying was different. He had to obtain this absolute art that could allow him to unleash the tenth level strength at Primal Chaos realm! This absolute art was something he admitted could not be created when he was at the Primal Chaos realm. Actually, an absolute art that could unleash a tenth level strength was something the majority of Cosmos Gods could not create. Those who could produce it were few and far between even within the Realm Heart Great Land.
“My son!” A passionate shout was heard.
Xue Ying turned over. It was both Ying Shan Lie Hu and Rong Xing Lan who came together. Ying Shan Lie Hu was enthusiastically shouting out at this moment.
Even though he did not have any favorable impression towards this father of his, Xue Ying still respected this Ying Shan Lie Hu. During the past five million years, Ying Shan Lie Hu had to coax Rong Xing Lan and make her happy. Even if he was deliberately disguising it, coaxing the other party for five million years could mean that it had possibly become genuine. At least Rong Xing Lan’s feelings for her husband had become much deeper.
“Father, mother.” Xue Ying stood up.
“My son is cultivating too bitterly. Your father I felt heartache seeing that.” Ying Shan Lie Hu sighed. These words of his came from his heart. Currently, was there someone who did not regard him, Ying Shan Lie Hu highly? Why? Obviously, it was because he had this talented son who would undoubtedly become a Conferred Marquis when he reached the Primal Chaos realm! Ying Shan Lie Hu felt proud for his son too.
Thinking about how he was enjoying himself and looking at how frequent his son entered closed-door cultivation, Ying Shan Lie Hu felt heartache for his son. His son was really staking almost all his time on cultivation.
“Xue Ying, what your father said is right. You should go out more frequently. Don’t always stay in your room and cultivate.” Rong Xing Lan added. She was genuinely worried about her son.
It had been five million years.
Her son had not liked a single girl!
That was not normal! Did he like a guy? That wasn’t true either!
“Alright alright, let’s go out and have a walk. I’ll definitely be doing so.” Xue Ying said. He was indeed going out for a walk, and would be visiting the biggest city in Southern Cloud Nation that was far away-the capital! He wanted to seek for the complete “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”.
“You better not lie. Previously, you said that as well, yet in the end? You turned and went back cultivating again.” Rong Xing Lan said, “Lie Hu, you should bring Xue Ying out and have a walk.”
“Alright.” Ying Shan Lie Hu immediately nodded.
Ever since his son reached the Unity realm, his name had spread across the entire Southern Cloud Nation. Many aristocratic clans within the Southern Cloud Nation knew that the Ying Shan Clan had another talented young fellow. But after breaking through to the Unity realm, Xue Ying no longer left his residence. If he were to bring his son with him to the streets, it would surely put the spotlight on him!
And Ying Shan Lie Hu was someone who liked the attention.
…
Very soon, Ying Shan Lie Hu brought Xue Ying out of the residence. They even sat on Ying Shan Lie Hu’s very ‘extravagant’ carriage. Xue Ying’s carriage was not as frivolous. Ying Shan Lie Hu was indeed an overbearing person, and that carriage of his was so dazzling that it made many cultivators on the street look away in fear of it. There were even eight dragon beasts in total.
“Father, you changed this carriage of yours?” Xue Ying boarded the carriage with Ying Shan Lie Hu sitting beside him.
The carriage was huge. There was ample space for two to sit. Tian Yi Zhi, the nine personal guards, the two Black Stream Cloud Wolves, the female attendant Yan Yu as well as Ying Shan Lie Hu and his servants and protectors were all on the carriage.
“Haha, my son is none other than the great Ying Shan Xue Ying. How could I stick to an ordinary carriage?” Ying Shan Lie Hu delightfully winked at Xue Ying, “I even owed quite a few cosmos crystals after purchasing this carriage. But it is fine. I can slowly return them and am not in a rush. Naturally, if my son is willing to help me pay, then it’ll be all for the better.”
Xue Ying caressed the lying Black Stream Cloud Wolves and no longer looked at his father.
Ying Shan Lie Hu did not mind after seeing that. He laughed voraciously: “Go go, let us set off for Misty Cloud Pavilion!”
“Hou~”
The eight dragon beasts roared. The luxurious carriage arced through the sky and headed towards the Misty Cloud Pavilion.
“The Misty Cloud Pavilion?” Xue Ying was startled. Those beside him-Tian Yi Zhi, the female servant Yan Yu and other personal guards could not help but turn to Ying Shan Lie Hu.
He was bringing his son to roam the Misty Cloud Pavilion?
“Just to broaden your experience.” Ying Shan Lie Hu answered, “My son hasn’t been there before right? That is the biggest entertainment ground in the Ardent Fire City. And my son has cultivated for five million years, so it is time for you to experience the world.”
Xue Ying smiled and no longer responded.
“Hu…”
“Prince Xue Ying?”
“The Black Stream Cloud Wolves? It must be Prince Xue Ying up there?”
“That lucky Ying Shan Lie Hu is bringing Prince Xue Ying out?”
Everywhere they passed through would incite discussions to start.
Some who were knowledgeable could still recognize Xue Ying.
Hearing the ongoing discussions, Ying Shan Lie Hu began smiling even more widely. This was fame. He was indeed at the center of attention.
…
Very soon, they arrived at the Misty Cloud Pavilion.
“Sir Lie Hu.” The servants within the Misty Cloud Pavilion welcomed Ying Shan Lie Hu with great familiarity. At the next moment, they saw the white-robed handsome young man seated beside Ying Shan Lie Hu.
That handsome young man was as gentle as jade, though when they saw him, they could not help but feel their hearts tremble.
“Prince Xue Ying?” They were all stunned.
“Prince Xue Ying is here!”
“Quick quick! Prince Xue Ying has come!”
The news soon spread within the entire Misty Cloud Pavilion. It was a total uproar. This was an amazingly huge affair. Even though the Misty Cloud Pavilion was extraordinary, what status did the current ‘Prince Xue Ying’ have? He was someone certain of becoming a Conferred Marquis and was ranked top three in terms of status across the entire Ardent Fire City! The Southern Cloud Sacred Palace Hall Master ‘Chun Yu Wei Yi’ did not even dare to slight him. After all, Chun Yu Wei Yi was merely someone relying on his clan and was still at the Unity realm. Who would dare to move slowly when facing against someone who would surely become a Conferred Marquis?
“This one has been waiting for thousands and thousands of years that even my eyes are starting to get tired. Regardless, this one has finally seen Prince Xue Ying.” The plump Pavilion Master Chun Yu Feng flew over like wind. He was very enthusiastic in welcoming the other party.
“Chun Yu Feng, today, my son has come over, so the expense will be all on you!” Ying Shan Lie Hu said with a loud voice.
“Rest assured, everything will be on me.” Chun Yu Feng smiled so much that the flesh hanging over his jaw was shaking.
Xue Ying responded with a few sentences and a smile.
The group of people was brought personally by Pavilion Master Chun Yu Feng into a huge hall. This hall was arranged by Chun Yu Feng himself. Many top-graded beauties that were enchanting, talented and were never tainted by a male began entering the hall to dance and sing.
“Follow me. I’ll definitely not mistreat you. Wait, hold this first.”
Within that huge hall, there were already many aristocratic clan disciples within. One of the disciples was currently throwing a bag of cosmos crystals to an armored girl in front. That cold girl took over that bag of cosmos crystals and began feeling relatively delighted in her heart. She had finally succeeded in becoming a guest under an aristocratic clan disciple. In the future, her days would be much better, and her children would have resources to cultivate.
“Congratulations, prince. You have once again received another formidable female guest.” The beauties beside praised him.
“Haha…” This aristocratic clan disciple was laughing out loud. Suddenly, he looked to the distant with shock.
At the entrance to the hall, Pavilion Master Chun Yu Feng was currently enthusiastically guiding the way for several guests, and Ying Shan Lie Hu was moving like a big boss. Behind Ying Shan Lie Hu was a handsome white-robed young man with two Black Stream Cloud Wolves and a gray-robed old man coldly following.
“Prince Xue Ying?”
This aristocratic clan disciple felt his heart thumping. He even became reserved with his seating posture.
“Everyone be careful. Don’t offend that white-robed young man.” This aristocratic clan disciple muttered an order to his servants and protectors. If his subordinates offended that man, he would definitely be doomed.
“Master, who is he?” One of the pampered female attendants asked with a soft voice.
The female guest was curious too because she discovered many of the aristocratic clan disciples who were unbridled in the past had become quite reserved at this moment.
“That is Prince Xue Ying. You heard of him before right? He is different from us. We aristocratic clan disciples are only idling our lives away, yet he is someone who will become a Conferred Marquis.”
“Prince Xue Ying?”
The female attendants, servants and that female guest immediately understood. That handsome young man was the legendary Prince Xue Ying.
Under Chun Yu Feng’s escort, and the invite of several other aristocratic clan disciples with slightly higher statuses, Xue Ying and his father finally took the central position of the entire hall.
…
Misty Cloud Pavilion. Within a residence.
The plump male Qian Gan Xue had always been staying here. Currently, his most important mission was to assassinate that Prince Xue Ying. If Prince Xue Ying does not come out, he could only wait. After waiting for five million years, he was starting to feel at a loss. How long would this Prince Xue Ying take before he finally exits? Unless he planned on cultivating all the way?
“Sir, Prince Xue Ying is currently here at the Misty Cloud Pavilion!”
There was a subordinate transmitting the news to him at that instant.
“What!?”
Qian Gan Xue was hugely astonished.
He came out and was even here at the Misty Cloud Pavilion?
“I must quickly act!” Qian gan Xue felt his heart racing. Thoughts began flashing through his mind. Qian Gan Xue knew this opportunity was one he must grab hold of. Otherwise, who knew when this Prince Xue Ying might come out again after returning to his residence?
“I must not panic. This assassination must succeed.” Qian Gan Xue’s gaze turned cold. If he failed, he would have a horrible death.
Hence, even if he were more anxious, he had to calm himself down and think things through. He must plan for all contingencies.
Fortunately, he had amply prepared for this. After pondering for a moment, he immediately began giving down the orders and mobilized his subordinates to act!

chapters.title: Chapter 1016 - The Assassination outside Misty Cloud Pavilion
chapters.content:
Chapter 1016: The Assassination outside Misty Cloud Pavilion
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within a two-story private pavilion slightly closer to the Misty Cloud Pavilion, there was a table with wine and food placed on it. Currently, there was only Qian Gan Xue seated here.
His plump body sat on a stool. It was rare that he was not accompanied by any beauty or female servant. As he drank, he would look outside the window absentmindedly. His gaze was cast in the direction of the distant Misty Cloud Pavilion. He was clear how important the assassination plan this time was, at least for him since his life was at stake! Failure was not an option.
‘I only have a single chance. If I fail, the entire Ying Shan Clan will be infuriated, and it is impossible for me to find a second chance. My master will no longer give me another opportunity either.’ Qian Gan Xue thought.
“Zhi ya.”
The door to the private room was pushed open. A slim teenager entered. This thin teenager seemed to give off a Unity realm aura. He was carrying a short blade to which he casually waved it in the air.
The eyes of Qian Gan Xue brightened when he saw the person. He immediately stood up and began fawning on the other party: “Brother Nian!”
“Mn.” The teenager found a random place to sit, “Are we starting the operation soon? I have stayed here in the Ardent Fire City for five million years ever since I accepted this mission of yours.”
“It has been tough on Brother Nian. Right now, that child is within the Misty Cloud Pavilion.” Qian Gan Xue said, “Chun Yu Feng, Ying Shan Lie Hu and the rest are all accompanying that child right now. In a while when he exits, that’ll be the time we act.”
The surrounding location was isolated from the external world. It was impossible for others to spy on this conversation.
The thin teenager nodded: “Rest assured. By then, I’ll simply kill off that one called Ying Shan Xue Ying.”
“Brother Nian, this matter relates to the life of this little brother, so everything will have to depend on Brother Nian.” Qian Gan Xue could not help but blurt out.
“Hmph, I do not care about your life. It is fine as long as you remember to pay me another 12 million cosmos crystals after the operation.” The thin teenager said.
Qian Gan Xue nodded: “Definitely.”
This time, the crux of his plan lay in this terrifying assassin ‘Nian Jiu’ whom he hired from the Black Devil Great Lake Nian Jiu. He had to pay a total of eight million cosmos crystals when he first employed the other party. If the assassination failed, the matter would end as it is. If the mission succeeded, he would have to fork out another 12 million cosmos crystals! In other words, it cost a total of 20 million cosmos crystals just to hire this single person if the assassination succeeded.
Yet in reality, Qian Gan Xue only had a total of 15 million cosmos crystals with him.
For the sake of this assassination plan.
He had spent finished all cosmos crystals he had with him which he earned as payment for goods. Everything was spent clean just by spending eight million cosmos crystals on hiring the assassin and on other preparations! Even some of his earnings had been used. If the mission succeeded, he still had to save more over a period to get back what he used. He even had to borrow more cosmos crystals from the other fellows within the sect of his master.
‘As long as this assassination plan succeeds, everything will be worth it. Master might even greatly bestow me with more treasures in his delight.’ Qian Gan Xue thought.
Time passed.
Two hours, four hours.
The sky started darkening.
Qian Gan Xue accompanied Nian Jiu to drink. The two of them did not really speak during this period.
“Mn?” Nian Jiu looked outside.
‘He is out.’ Qian Gan Xue felt his body shivering. There was a crowd of people coming out from the Misty Cloud Pavilion, of which most of them were escorting that white-robed handsome young man.
“He is truly a handsome young fellow, though there is no point mentioning about his strength. I can simply stomp him to death. I am only afraid of Marquis Ardent Fire who should have prepared many methods to protect him. It’s a pity that he’ll die for certain when I act.” Nian Jiu took a step before arriving on the streets outside the window. He walked on the streets casually, becoming one of the ordinary members amidst the cultivators.
Qian Gan Xue held his breath. He was really nervous.
The moment that would determine his fate had arrived!
“Everything has been prepared. The moment he arrives at the checkpoint, act directly.” Qian Gan Xue transmitted.
…
The eight dragon beasts pulled along the carriage across the sky. Ying Shan Lie Hu brought along his son on his carriage with great delight and grandeur. As for Tian Yi Zhi, the female servant Yan Yu and others, they were standing by the side. Even more protectors and attendants were waiting around the place.
The carriage was moving at a rapid pace.
“My son, the Misty Cloud Pavilion is unlike others right? Haha, this is also the first time bringing you here. There are many more tastes which I have yet to bring you over to try.” Ying Shan Lie Hu giggled, “In the future, my son can also come here yourself. We are cultivators! We should experience all kinds of things including the fairer sex! This is also cultivating the heart.”
“Sir Lie Hu.” Tian Yi Zhi said gravely from the side.
Ying Shan Lie Hu was slightly startled. He awkwardly responded to Tian Yi Zhi: “Elder Tian, I am merely saying it. Those are just words. But it isn’t wrong to say that one could temper one’s heart in the world of mortals.” Ying Shan Lie Hu immediately felt regretful after that and wanted to hit his mouth. Because the words he mentioned would likely be reported to Grandpa Marquis by Tian Yi Zhi.
Xue Ying merely listened from the side. He remained nonchalant.
Suddenly, he glanced to a distant pavilion with slight shock. Ever since he started comprehending the profound mysteries from that spear body and came up with the domain technique, his grasp of the void became really amazing. Even during regular occasions, everything within this region would be within his perception. Xue Ying discovered someone familiar within.
‘Qian Gan Xue?’ Xue Ying saw that plump male seated by the window of that pavilion. The stout male was also looking in his direction. When Xue Ying looked over, Qian Gan Xue even revealed a grin.
“Hmph.” Xue Ying no longer cared about him.
Because of the matter regarding the female attendant Yan Yu, he had ordered someone to investigate the other party before and knew this Qian Gan Xue was someone who conducted shameful businesses. Xue Ying would definitely disregard such character.
Suddenly-
“Weng.”
The surrounding void shook. The vast region was being suppressed.
“Not good.” Tian Yi Zhi felt astonished. He immediately transmitted to everyone, “Be careful. The surrounding void is being suppressed. We can’t teleport away.”
“What!” Ying Shan Lie Hu began panicking at that moment.
“Xiu!””Xiu!”
Two streams of light immediately shot out from the crowd of cultivators located down the streets. Tian Yi Zhi and the nine personal guards began condensing silver armor over their bodies with great familiarity. The light of the armor fluctuated, causing a silver glow to flash out. It turned into an enormous silver sphere that covered the carriage where Xue Ying was at. No matter what technique the assassins threw-the two streams of light or the diffusing fog of poison, Tian Yi Zhi and the others were resisting against them.
“Hong~”
“Break!”
The void shook.
“Assassination? Someone actually dared to assassinate my son?” Ying Shan Lie Hu lost color on his face. He was even panicking at that moment. Even though he had protectors, they were far inferior to those protecting Xue Ying.
“Father, father, assassins are trying to kill Xue Ying!” It was rare for Ying Shan Lie Hu to contact Marquis Ardent Fire personally. During ordinary occasions, he would not dare to disturb Marquis Ardent Fire. Nevertheless, Marquis Ardent Fire had already obtained the transmission from Tian Yi Zhi. Even though he was much shocked, the distance here from the Marquisdom was far, Even if he could teleport, there was a limit to the distance he could do so, and rushing over would take the time taken to brew a cup of tea.
Even if he rushed over to the vicinity, teleportation had been locked down in the surrounding, forcing him to fly over. Hence, it would be hard for him to save them.
“What audacity!”
A furious roar reverberated in the world.
World energy began surging in the place. It rapidly condensed and formed a figure. This was the incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire, though he was merely forming it by relying on the World Energy and it would take some time.
“Marquis Ardent Fire, it is pointless for you to send your incarnation over.”
A thin teenager flew over and clashed against that huge silvery-white sphere formed by Tian Yi Zhi and the nine personal guards. During the clash, the skinny teenager divided into six bodies. Each of them unleashed a frightening aura that was not any weaker than the incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire. Within the blink of an eye, the combat array formed by Tian Yi Zhi and the rest were shattered.
“Prince, be careful!” Tian Yi Zhi anxiously shouted.
