“Good!” Not too far away, that plump male ‘Qian Gan Xue’ who was watching the battle from above the pavilion clenched his fist excitedly. His fingernail had pierced into his flesh, though he did not care about it. He was on cloud nine, “He is indeed Old Devil Nian!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1017 - There is actually an Expert?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1017: There is actually an Expert?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“It is Nian Jiu?” The currently condensing incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire trembled. He could not help but grit his teeth, “Who is so daring to oppose my Ying Shan Clan?”
Assassinating the outstanding talent Prince Xue Ying was equivalent to slapping the Ying Shan Clan on the face!
The Ying Shan Clan would certainly not let things rest!
Under normal circumstances, there were not many organizations that dared to be so foolish. Nevertheless, an assassination still happened today, and there was even this devil called Nian Jiu.
Nian Jiu was originally a nine-headed venomous snake that was born as a native from the Black Devil Great Lake. As he began training in ancient cultivation, Nian Jiu discovered that he had talent in forming avatars, and could produce nine in total! As long as one survived, the other eight avatars could easily be refined back over time. Hence, by relying on this talent, Nian Jiu was not afraid of risking his life as an assassin.
After all, there were not many assassins who would kill without paying heed to one’s own life. Either they were death warriors, or they were experts like Nian Jiu who had unique techniques.
“Protect the prince!”
The two Black Stream Cloud Wolves turned into humans. Furthermore, a total of 98 black-armored soldiers appeared in the surrounding too. These two Black Stream Cloud Wolves-one was in black armor, and the other with a dark gold armor forming over his body. They totaled a hundred and soon established an enormous combat formation. “Hong long long~”
Black clouds formed and wrapped around the carriage. And these hundred soldiers were scattered amidst the black darkness. Their armor grew brighter, and soon, this energy became interconnected and formed an entity.
“You dare to assassinate Prince Xue Ying? What gall!” The leading dark-gold-armored captain revealed a pair of sharp-clawed weapons. He angrily roared; his voice reverberated through the world.
“Ardent Fire Army Hidden Guards? Haha, who would have thought that one of the three Hidden Guards from the Ardent Fire Army would be protecting this child.” The six thin teenagers laughed. They continued advancing, “Let me see how formidable all of you are.”
“Kill!”
The dark-gold-armored captain shouted. The rolling black cloud congealed into an enormous four-hooved mutated beast. The captain acted as the claws of this beast, and every attack was struck out frantically.
“What? There is actually a team of Ardent Fire Army Hidden Guards keeping close to that Ying Shan Xue Ying all the while?” Qian Gan Xue who was watching the battle from the distant pavilion turned pale after seeing that, “He is honestly too biased to keep a group of Hidden Guards in the Eden Treasure just to protect that child.”
This was indeed the worst situation ever.
A team of Hidden Guards.
The captain of the Hidden Guards was at God Yuan Palace fifth level strength. The other members were all at the Unity realm too. The complete combat array when they worked together would allow them to erupt with a God Yuan Palace seventh level strength-that was sufficient for them to fight against a Primal Chaos giant.
…
Ying Shan Lie Hu felt his legs turning soft. He was still consoling Xue Ying who sat beside him: “My son, don’t worry too much. They can’t harm you at all.”
The female attendant Yan Yu was also clenching her fist by the side. She was prepared to protect her prince with her life.
In reality, they were only True Gods and facing against a battle at this level, they were entirely useless.
Actually.
No matter who it was, the assassin Old Devil Nian Jiu, the team led by the Black Stream Cloud Wolf captain, Tian Yi Zhi or even Marquis Ardent Fire and the master of that devil who was being kept aware of the proceedings of this assassination were concerned about the whole affair. They felt their hearts tightening as things unfold.
Only one person! He might be nervous on the surface, yet he remained remarkably calm inside.
That was Xue Ying.
‘Assassination?’ Xue Ying sat on the carriage watching the battle, ‘Oh, this assassin could form six avatars. But he is merely at the Unity realm yet he could form avatars already? It should not be an avatar technique belonging to the void lineage. Thus, it must be an ancient cultivation talent.’
‘But he is quite astounding. Each of the avatars seems to contain power at the God Yuan Palace sixth level. The six avatars even have a combined technique that enabled them to erupt with power at the God Yuan Palace seventh level.’
‘Wuu…’
‘So it seems the two Black Stream Cloud Wolves of mine, one is the captain of the Hidden Guards and the other an ordinary Hidden Guard? There are also 98 other Hidden Guards that remain in the Eden Treasure waiting for orders? It seems Marquis Ardent Fire really favor me a lot.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly, ‘I always thought Elder Tian and the others are my main protectors. Who would have thought that there are guards in the light just as guards are hiding in the dark? The nine personal guards led by Elder Tian seems to unleash strength at the God Yuan Palace sixth level. And the entire team of Hidden Guards is much stronger than them.’
One guarding him in the light and the other defending him in the dark.
Xue Ying continued watching the battle between the Hidden Guards with Old Devil Nian Jiu. Both parties were fighting extremely frantically. Old Devil Nian Jiu could not break through for a moment too: ‘It seems that the techniques in the Realm Heart Great Land are more profound than those in the primal chaos void. Just this combat array is much more efficient.’
In the primal chaos void, a fifth level Unity expert working together with 99 other Unity experts could not unleash power at the seventh level.
But it was possible here on the Realm Heart Great Land. These combat formation techniques seemed to be even more profound than the innate combat arrays utilized by the Destruction Devils.
…
“Qian Gan Xue, who would have thought that there is a team of Hidden Guards protecting that child constantly. I can’t break through it, so this mission will likely end up as a failure.” Nian Jiu communicated to Qian Gan Xue.
“No!”
The eyes of Qian Gan Xue turned red.
He mobilized the death warriors under his master, yet in reality, he did not mind paying a greater price to find Old Devil Nian Jiu and invited him to act. This was his most crucial trump card, yet Old Devil Nian Jiu who could unleash a power at the seventh level, could still not break through the defenses of the other party.
‘This Old Devil Nian Jiu is too cowardly. Hearsay he has nine avatars in total, yet he only uses six avatars at most for each assassination. The other three avatars are hidden at some unknown places.’ The eyes of Qian Gan Xue were brimming with madness.
‘I couldn’t care less.’
‘If I fail, I’ll have to die.’
‘Time to stake it all.’
Even though most of Qian Gan Xue’s hope had been placed on the powerful Old Devil Nian Jiu, he would still die if the mission ended up as a failure. Hence, he had prepared another killing move-one which he spent over two million years in search of a Primal Chaos giant to help him refine a poisonous fluid. For the sake of this poisonous fluid, he spent a total of six million cosmos crystals. One must know some ordinary secret treasure weapons cost merely ten million cosmos crystals.
Spending this massive amount of cosmos crystals, there were almost no existences at the Unity realm who could survive from it!
“Old Devil Nian Jiu, I have another method, though it might affect you. But since you have your avatars, it isn’t much.” Qian Gan Xue took out a black bamboo flute and lightly blew in it.
“Weng-”
An unseen sound ripple spread in the direction of Xue Ying.
This sound ripple was of a strange insipid green color. This poisonous fluid could be seen even with the naked eyes. He had no choice. If he wanted to acquire a poison that was sufficiently strong and could not be perceived at all, that paltry amount of cosmos crystals which he prepared was not enough.
“What?” The incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire that had just formed successfully and was teaming up with the hidden guards against Old Devil Nian Jiu saw that strand of an insipid green sound ripple of poisonous fluid coming over. His expression could not help but change.
The incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire did not have any treasures or weapons. It was only at the God Yuan sixth level strength and could barely fight against an avatar of Old Devil Nian Jiu. It could not change the overall situation.
“Poisonous fluid?” Old Devil Nian Jiu revealed a joyous look after seeing that.
“Not good.” The Hidden Guards were startled by this. They could feel a considerable threat from this rapidly incoming insipid green sound ripple. If they were contacted by this poisonous fluid, they would die unquestionably.
“Hong~””Pu~”
The surroundings boomed. The incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire and the Hidden Guards were spreading part of their concentration resisting against that poisonous fluid. Nevertheless, they could not isolate it at all. The poisonous fluid continued unhindered. After all, this was a poisonous fluid that was worth six million cosmos crystals.
“What should we do?”
The sound ripple poisonous fluid was moving too quickly. They could not teleport either. Unless they escaped and leave the prince alone?
“Hahaha…” Old Devil Nian Jiu wantonly struck against the Hidden Guards. He laughed madly. From his viewpoint, without the obstruction from this Hidden Guard team, that Prince Xue Ying who was incomparably weak and small would die easily to him.
‘What should I do? What should I do?’ The incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire was extremely anxious. He had already contacted Old Mother Ying Shan, yet the other party could not arrive in this short time and had to find a Primal Chaos giant for help to teleport her through an ultra-long distance. All sort of unforeseen circumstances would require time to solve. Nevertheless, battles at this level would be over within the blink of an eye.
“Stake everything and try to delay for more time. Once we have more time, there will be more hope.” The incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire transmitted the order to the Hidden Guards.
“Yes.” All the Hidden Guards, some were willing, and others were not, yet they still acknowledged the orders.
They did not dare to disobey the orders of Grandpa Marquis.
They had to use their lives and fight against this strange poisonous fluid, and to try and delay for as much time as possible!
…
On the carriage, both Ying Shan Lie Hu and the female attendant Yan Yu were slightly hoodwinked. They did not understand the overall situation and only knew that the incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire was fighting together with the Hidden Guards. The Hidden Guards seemed mad, and there was a sort of dismal atmosphere spreading.
Xue Ying was the only calm person amongst them. He looked into the distance and saw Qian Gan Xue who blew that black bamboo flute.
‘This poisonous fluid seems interesting. It seems its power is quite great, and ordinary attacks can’t disperse it at all.’ Xue Ying thought. A spear appeared in his hand. It was that secret treasure weapon.
Following that, an unseen ripple spread out.
This ripple was minute and permeated everywhere.
‘Go.’
All spaces where the insipid green sound ripple of poisonous fluid existed in began distorting. They were clearly moving in the direction of Xue Ying, yet in the blink of an eye, they flew over to where Qian Gan Xue was.
“What!” Qian Gan Xue was startled as he watched at the insipid green poisonous fluid appearing right in front of him. This poisonous fluid did not distinguish between enemies and allies. He could only control the direction using the flute.
“Hu.”
Under the influence of the poisonous fluid, Qian Gan Xue’s body was rapidly corroded. He turned into a puddle of green water and died right at that moment.
The poisonous fluid might have spread across the surrounding, yet it was fortunate nobody was around. Those cultivators, guests, and attendants had long run far away. After all, with battles of this level happening, all cultivators would run as far as possible. They would not even feel safe despite fleeing several hundred thousand kilometers away.
…
In an area quite far away on a broad street, a black-robed man was watching the proceedings of the mission. He was the incarnation of the master of that devil. By relying on a treasure, he was able to conceal his aura and stay for long periods within the Ardent Fire City. Given his great hatred for Marquis Ardent Fire, he had long planned for his incarnation to remain here in search of opportunities to deal against Marquis Ardent Fire.
‘It seems this Qian Gan Xue is quite resourceful that he knows to prepare this poisonous fluid.’ The edges of that black-robed man’s mouth lifted. But closely following that, his expression changed.
That insipid green sound ripple of poisonous fluid had strangely turned to where Qian Gan Xue was, killing him directly.
The black-robed man could not even feel any abnormalities of the space in the surrounding.
‘There is actually another expert protecting that Prince Xue Ying? Isn’t the Ying Shan Clan spending too much effort trying to protect him?’ The black-robed man could not help but grit his teeth after seeing this.

chapters.title: Chapter 1018 - Madness
chapters.content:
Chapter 1018: Madness
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The black-robed devil master gritted his teeth. His eyes were ice-cold. Seeing how anxious the incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire was, he was sure the other party would definitely be deranged if they succeeded in killing that young child.
‘Someone who is able to dissolve the poisonous fluid secretly and protect Ying Shan Xue Ying? This expert is formidable. Or could it be someone who knows how to curb this poisonous fluid?’ Many thoughts flashed through the mind of the black-robed devil master, ‘I should go according to the initial plan first.’
“Ah Da, move out.”
“Yes.”
The black-robed devil master gave his orders behind the scene.
He coldly looked to the distance. Even though he gave Qian Gan Xue the mission to plan, he had never placed all hopes on Qian Gan Xue before. He even personally prepared a final trump card for this mission.
‘Let me see who exactly is the one protecting him.’ The black-robed devil master gave a cold chuckle, ‘It is impossible for Marquis Ardent Fire’s true body to reach in time. Let me see who else is there in Ardent Fire City that could obstruct my magic servant?’
…
And in the carriage floating in midair, Ying Shan Lie Hu was trembling slightly. Tian Yi Zhi who retreated to the side even transmitted a message to Xue Ying in anxiety: “Prince, this poisonous fluid is very frightening. If the Hidden Guards could not resist against the poison, I’ll immediately keep you into my Eden Treasure and try escaping from the assassins. I’ll try my best to escape for as long as I could, and hopefully, Old Mother Ying Shan would have dispatched an expert over. In a while, you must not resist-”
As he was transmitting his voice, Tian Yi Zhi suddenly looked with shock into the distance.
Not just him.
All the Hidden Guards and protectors had come to a realization that they would be going all out at the risk of their lives for their prince! Even though they had their own loved ones whom they were concerned of, and thus did not wish to die, they chose to join Marquis Ardent Fire ultimately and had obtained great support in terms of resources from the Marquis! Encountering such dangerous situations was a rare thing for them too.
Hence, when the time came, they had to stand out! Those who dared run would definitely face the wrath of the Ying Shan Clan,
The atmosphere on the battlefield soon turned dismal and exasperated at the same time. Every one gritted their teeth as they watched the insipid green sound ripple of poisonous fluid fly rapidly over.
“Come on!”
“Let us fight with our lives!”
“My obedient daughter, I no longer will be able to accompany you any longer.” These Hidden Guards were fighting with Old Devil Nian Jiu while paying close notice to the poisonous fluid at the same time. Nevertheless, the poisonous fluid suddenly appeared by the side of Qian Gan Xue, causing Qian Gan Xue to die instantaneously.
“This, this…”
“Why would it…”
All present who just escaped from the clutches of death was soon filled with ecstasy and disbelief.
The incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire was also looking at the scene with disbelief. As Xue Ying controlled the minute spatial distortions merely over at the regions where the poisonous fluid existed at and not over at the side where the incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire was, the other party did not discover anything strange.
“Hahaha, my son, an expert is actually protecting you in the dark! I never knew so many experts exist in my Ying Shan Clan!” Ying Shan Lie Hu shouted in glee after seeing that.
“Yes, another mysterious expert is protecting us!” Tian Yi Zhi was feeling excited too.
“We have an expert behind our backs!” All Hidden Guards and protectors present felt their fighting spirit reignite.
Xue Ying also revealed a surprised look: “Such a formidable expert. I wonder who he is.”
No other choice.
Someone who was only five million years old yet could display strength at the God Yuan Palace eighth level? After all, just that domain technique had reached the eighth level. This completely transcended beyond the category of ‘genius’. If this was revealed, Xue Ying was worried it might attract the attention of some horrifying old fellows in the Realm Heart Great Land. Xue Ying suspected that he was not the only one who reincarnated in this place.
Thus, it was better to be prudent.
This distorted void technique was like a passageway. Space was originally straight. Xue Ying merely distorted this passage and linked it to another passage. As the poisonous fluid entered the passage, it naturally went according to the newly bent passage into the interconnected passage.
The same logic.
Since the surrounding void was distorted by Xue Ying, proceeding forward from here would naturally lead the traveler into another location. It might seem like teleportation, yet in reality, this was entirely different! Teleportation relied on the transmission of spatial fluctuations. And this was terraforming the structure of space. This technique was extremely formidable. Xue Ying might have just learned it, yet it was already a move at the Primal Chaos level.
Naturally, it was due to his vast experience. Xue Ying had reached the Primal Chaos realm in the Dao of Void in the laws and profound mysteries system. Furthermore, his wisdom was still present. That was why he could comprehend this technique quickly from the incomplete secret treasure weapon, the spear body.
Others might have a difficult time trying to comprehend this technique even if he was an expert that relied on his void bloodline to cultivate to the Primal Chaos realm.
Naturally, Xue Ying did not become arrogant. He only became more respectful of the refiner for this spear body.
‘What I comprehended is merely the tip of an iceberg. Furthermore, the spear body is not the complete secret treasure either.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘I really wonder who the original owner of this spear body is.’
…
Saying it was slow, though the words spoken in Xue Ying’s heart happened in the blink of an eye.
All the protectors in the vicinity including the incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire felt delighted. And right at this moment-
“Hong.”
A pavilion not too far away exploded. A humanoid being turned into a stream of light as it rushed over. It had kept its previous aura completely, and others could not perceive it at all. But now when it released its aura, it easily formed the strongest presence in the battlefield-even stronger than the combined aura from the Hidden Guards. It was even stronger than Old Devil Nian Jiu when he used his combined technique.
It had a pair of legs that were connected via reverse joints, and two long arms akin to those of apes. It was completely covered in scales and only had a single azure eye.
“Nian Jiu, team up with my magic servant to kill that Prince Xue Ying. Once the matter ends, the remaining 12 million cosmos crystals will be forked out by me.” A voice transmission was sent to Old Devil Nian Jiu.
“Hahaha…” Old Devil Nian Jiu was in great joy. Only then did he understand that it was this huge devil behind Qian Gan Xue’s back.
“Palace Master, please feel rest assured.” Old Devil Nian Jiu’s fighting spirit shot to the sky. Being a relatively famous assassin from within the Black Devil Great Lake, he naturally knew this huge devil. Even though the gap between their statuses was huge, he was not afraid of the other party since he had his avatar technique.
“Not good!”
The expression of Marquis Ardent Fire’s incarnation shifted considerably. He saw that humanoid creature rushing over.
“Magic Servant Chao Qing?” Marquis Ardent Fire was able to recognize the other party immediately.
“Hong!”
With a frenzied charge by this magic servant, it was able to produce an impact far beyond what Old Devil Nian Jiu could. With it working together with Old Devil Nian Jiu, they had practically blasted apart the combat array formed by the Hidden Guards. The Hidden Guards flew in all directions as they could not hinder them at all.
Not just Old Devil Nian Jiu or the Magic Servant Chao Qing. They did not chase after the Hidden Guards. They only had a single target-that Prince Xue Ying!
“Magic Servant Chao Qing? He is really willing to pay the price.” The incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire was rushing forward in madness.
“Scram!”
The magic servant growled and blast out with its claw. The nearby void exploded, and the incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire shattered apart. At that moment, the eyes of Marquis Ardent Fire’s incarnation were still filled with unwillingness and indignance. They were also filled with apology towards ‘Xue Ying who could not retaliate at all’.
“Xue Ying ah, it is I, Marquis Ardent Fire, who is useless.” Marquis Ardent Fire felt really sorrowful at that moment.
“Hu, hu.”
The Magic Servant Chao Qing and six avatars of Old Devil Nian Jiu rushed forward at the same time.
Xue Ying remained calm as he sat on the carriage holding onto the spear: Magic servant? According to the records, it should be the Magic Servant ‘Chao Qing’ right?’
The accomplishments of puppetry refinements in the Realm Heart Great Land were much more profound.
Magic Servant Chao Qing was a puppet made from fleshy lifeform. It was utmost loyal and devoted to its owner. Being a puppet, if the owner wanted it to die, it would kill itself. Magic Servant Chao Qing was considered one of the lower leveled fleshy life puppet at the Primal Chaos realm. It could already be massed-produced by some powerful Cosmos Gods and were sold outside.
Magic Servant Chao Qing had a God Yuan Palace sixth level strength during regular occasions. When it burnt the accumulated energy inside its body, it would be able to erupt with a God Yuan Palace seventh level strength! But whenever it exploded with its power, it would suffer from significant injuries. After that, it would require to consume some precious treasures to regain its energy. Furthermore, it could even self-detonated with power several times greater!
Because it was ultimately a magic servant, it lacked in terms of the realm, though it specialized more in pure offensive strength. Magic Servant Chao Qing working together with Old Devil Nian Jiu were able to break through the obstruction by the Hidden Guards immediately.
“Prince, you should run first. I’ll block them.” Tian Yi Zhi and the nine personal guards had already arranged themselves into a combat array.
“My son, my son, quickly escape! I, I’ll fight with him too!” Ying Shan Lie Hu’s eyes were filled with madness.
Xue Ying was slightly startled as he looked at the appearance of his father.
He never had good feelings for this father of his, yet this moment made him shocked!
But how could he understand the thinking of Ying Shan Lie Hu? Ying Shan Lie Hu was indeed angry and mad at this moment, yet he was the second son of Marquis Ardent Fire. When Marquis Ardent Fire had him, the other party was still weak, resulting in a weaker bloodline in Ying Shan Lie Hu’s body. He once tried his best to cultivate, yet it was hard for him to improve any further, resulting in despair. That was why he instead chose to immerse himself in enjoyment.
Marquis Ardent Fire had even arranged a marriage for him which he accepted with a laugh. That wife of his, ‘Chan Yu Yan Zhen’ had inserted her people right from the beginning to control the resources under his name. How could he not know? But he still accepted it with a laugh.
He was too lazy to care about many things, and would rather enjoy his life. Even though he had many women, and had 300 over children, he never cared about them either. Only with this child that was powerful and had high talent which led him to pay greater attention to. In his heart, he hoped for this child to rise up and dazzle the world.
Over so many years…
Even though he, Ying Shan Lie Hu, led a befuddled existence outside, he understood that many aristocratic clan disciples looked down on him! Because he was too weak and was only a True God. If not for the son of Marquis Ardent Fire, he would remain a commoner.
He had always been looked down by others.
And then the fateful day came. His son Xue Ying was birthed. His birth shocked the entire world! Marquis Ardent Fire and Old Mother Ying Shan immediately paid close attention to Xue Ying.
Countless people were shocked across the entire Ardent Fire City. From henceforth, nobody dared to look at Ying Shan Lie Hu with disrespect. This feeling of respect was something he, Ying Shan Lie Hu, liked. Even though he felt that his son disliked him a lot, and did not even give him any cosmos crystals before, he did not mind.
“I, Ying Shan Lie Hu, has a son called Ying Shan Xue Ying! I can die but my son must not!” Ying Shan Lie Hu seemed crazy at that moment.
Xue Ying sat there.
He looked as Old Devil Nian Jiu and Magic Servant Chao Qing charged over in streams of light.
The gaze of Xue Ying turned cold.
“Hong~”
The surrounding void suddenly distorted. It was a scene of an apocalypse. This distorted void naturally encompassed everyone present in the battlefield, including Magic Servant Chao Qing and the six avatars of Old Devil Nian Jiu.

chapters.title: Chapter 1019 - Mysterious Expert?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1019: Mysterious Expert?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Magic Servant Chao Qing and Old Devil Nian Jiu both worked together. They charged forward with full strength mainly because they were on guard against that mysterious expert. After all, they had witnessed personally how the poisonous fluid was directed away.
“Moving so surreptitiously, he might not be as strong as we thought.” The two of them were unafraid. One was a magic servant, and the other had six avatars. Was there even a need for them to be afraid? As long as they succeeded in their assassination, losing a few avatars was a minor matter.
“Hong~”
The surrounding void spanning across half a million kilometers became distorted. Magic Servant Chao Qing and Old Devil Nian Jiu both looked around with astonishment. Now the void had been twisted, they could no longer see Prince Xue Ying. Their direction had been disordered.
Old Devil Nian Jiu had six avatars, and their positions were continually changing. As a result, the two of them could no longer utilize their combined techniques.
“Chi chi chi-” Suddenly, cracks started appearing on the six bodies of Old Devil Nian Jiu. He had a look of disbelief.
“I, how did I die? Where is the enemy? Where is he?!”
“Hua.”
The six bodies shattered the next moment. Even when Old Devil Nian Jiu died, he did not locate the enemy.
If one said that re-directing the poisonous fluid was the most subtle control Xue Ying had on his domain technique, then now, he was exerting the complete power of the domain technique! This was the first time Xue Ying used this technique to kill an enemy. In the past, he had only been practicing within the Void God Pagoda.
When two parts of space a target occupied were in disorder, it would move the upper half of his body to the north and the bottom half to the south. The conclusion of this-”Pu chi”-the body would be cut into two. In just an instant, the six avatars of Old Devil Nian Jiu had been cut into more than a thousand pieces-the result? All of them perished!
In another location.
Magic Servant Chao Qing also suffered from more than a thousand cuts. But being a puppet with a fleshy body at the Primal Chaos level, despite lacking in the realm, his fleshy body was sufficiently strong. This move of Xue Ying might be an eighth level move, but it was ultimately a domain technique. The distortion of the void could not completely tear Magic Servant Chao Qing’s body apart.
“Come out!” Magic Servant Chao Qing let out a furious roar. He could not see the enemy at all.
“His body is quite strong.”
Xue Ying who was seated on the carriage with his spear placed on his legs merely wiggled his right finger.
Even though he was still seated there, and was seemingly quite far away from Magic Servant Chao Qing.
Yet this fingernail…
Had somehow appeared in the position of Magic Servant Chao Qing’s head. It was clear that Xue Ying had connected the space of his finger attack to where Magic Servant Chao Qing’s head was.
“Pu!”
The fingernail pierced through the forehead of the magic servant.
There was no resistance at all. Magic Servant Chao Qing suffered from the full brunt of this finger-it widened its eyes, yet closely following that, its body decomposed. This decomposition was happening on the level of particles, and its existence was utterly wiped out from the world.
A finger had wiped out Magic Servant Chao Qing just like smoke and dust.
Xue Ying remained seated there without even moving at all.
This was the tenth style of “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”-’Smoke and Dust Scatter’.
Unlike the secret treasure-the spear body-where Xue Ying had to painstakingly comprehend and ponder over before he grasped the domain technique at God Yuan palace seventh level strength, and relying on the spear body to reach the eighth level strength, it was different with the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”. This was a well-detailed absolute art. Xue Ying could even comprehend it according to the void bloodline in his body. That was why he had grasped the styles at God Yuan Palace eighth level strength-the ninth and tenth styles.
The tenth style, ‘Smoke and Dust Scatter’, was widely known for its frightening power. But this technique could easily be broken apart. The ninth style was comparatively more unpredictable and harder to be blocked, though its strength was weaker.
Nevertheless…
By relying on his domain, Xue Ying could ensure that the enemy could not block his move at all. Magic Servant Chao Qing was facing from the full power of the Smoke and Dust Scatter technique. Those two moves were absolutely compatible, allowing the combined technique to reach a strength at the peak of the eighth level! As a result, Magic Servant Chao Qing’s entire body was exterminated under a single strike.
…
“What?”
Booms could be heard from the distorted void. All the Hidden Guards present felt confused. They even saw many pavilions and residences being teleported away-they were floating in midair.
“Hu.”
Soon, the dust settled down.
The original space spanning half a million kilometer-including those pavilions and residences that were teleported soon appeared back at their original positions once again.
Some of the cultivators who were teleported away by the void also appeared back where they were originally. They were looking around them in bewilderment.
“Such a formidable expert.” Tian Yi Zhi looked excitedly around him. He announced with a loud voice, “Many thanks senior for saving the prince of my clan!”
“Many thanks, senior.” The female servant Yan Yu also stated with gratitude.
Ying Shan Lie Hu though was seated on the carriage. He stroked his head and let out a breath of relief. He had suffered from a shock, so much so that his legs had turned wobbly. He then turned to Xue Ying who was beside him: “My son, you can relax. The foundation of my Ying Shan Clan is really deep. They have surely arranged an ultra expert to protect you. How could those assassins succeed?” Ying Shan Lie Hu was both weak and had poor eyesight. He was not clear how horrifying the enemies were this time.
“Many thanks, senior for saving me.” Xue Ying said with a loud voice too.
Even though he had merely wriggled his finger just now, and even if others could see through the distorted void, they would only see him seated there. They could not see the small motion of his finger.
And since he acted, Xue Ying would naturally not leave any gaps behind.
******
To the distant, the black-robed devil master spectated the distorted void. When the void regained its calm, both Old Devil Nian Jiu and Magic Servant Chao Qing had disappeared.
To cause two experts that had erupted with strength at the God Yuan Palace seventh level disappear in an instant? What strength was that?
“Even if Marquis Ardent Fire acted, it would not end so quickly.” The expression of the black-robed devil master turned cold. After all, it was impossible for one to teleport in a suppressed void. One had to fly forward to kill the enemy, yet Old Devil Nian Jiu had six avatars, and the fleshy body of Magic Servant Chao Qing was terrifically strong too. To kill both of them in an instant?
“The surrounding void is suppressed, even time-space was obscured? Who could kill both of them in that single instant?”
“Does Ying Shan Clan have such an expert?”
The black-robed devil master pondered for a while.
It was only possible for that unfathomable ‘Old Mother Ying Shan’ who could do this. But what identity did she have? She was undoubtedly protecting the Ying Shan City. The Ying Shan City was much bigger than this Ardent Fire City and was more important too. It was impossible for the other party to rush over across such a long distance without utilizing a spatial ultra-long distance teleportation technique.
“Who is it?”
“Unless there is an expert who is living in seclusion within Ardent Fire City? Seeing that the talent of that young fellow Xue Ying is so high, that was why he acted to protect him?” The black-robed devil master could only think of this point.
“Consider him fortunate.” The black-robed devil master turned around and left.
…
The carriage was still in midair; the eight dragon beasts were feeling slight unease.
The Hidden Guards, Tian Yi Zhi, the nine personal guards, female attendant Yan Yu, Ying Shan Lie Hu and his servants and protectors were all astonished. For a moment, they could not remain calm.
“Prince, just now I saw many pavilions and houses floating by the distant sky!” The female attendant Yan Yu was slightly excited, “In the blink of an eye, everything returned back to their original positions again!”
“I wonder who that senior is.” Xue Ying sighed, “Really formidable.”
“This senior helped prince, possibly because he had ties with our Ying Shan Clan. But it is important for Prince to remember this favor.” Tian Yi Zhi chuckled. He even felt envy for their clan prince since he could befriend which that great expert by relying on this.
“Hu.”
The incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire appeared once again in midair.
Marquis Ardent Fire saw that everything was fine. He noticed Xue Ying had no injuries too before heaving a sigh of relief. Only then did he start investigating what had happened previously.
Just as they were chatting…
“Hu.”
Two figures appeared here.
One was a green-pupiled old man, and the other was Old Mother Ying Shan.
“Old Ancestor, Marquis Floating Dust.” The incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire went forward to greet them.
“We came late.” Old Mother Ying Shan looked around her before smiling, “But it is still fortunate that nothing bad happened. How did you all defend against that Magic Servant Chao Qing?”
The incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire shook his head: “I do not know either. It seems to be an expert who passed by Ardent Fire City.”
Old Mother Ying Shan looked into empty space.
The void gradually distorted and fleeted with the scenes of what happened previously, though they were soon disrupted.
“The assassin has even disrupted the time-space.” Old Mother Ying Shan looked towards the green-pupiled old man by the side, “Floating Dust, I”ll have to ask you to investigate things.”
“Alright.”
The green-pupiled old man nodded. His eyes then shot out a faint green light. One could see many projections started appearing in the air to the distance. It began showing what happened previously from start to end, though during the moment the void was distorted, it remained disordered. They were only able to see some regions that Xue Ying did not deliberately conceal.
“Such a formidable domain technique.” The green-pupiled old man commented with astonishment, “That Old Devil Nian Jiu and Magic Servant Chao Qing both perished in an instant. Magic Servant Chao Qing is able to unleash strength at the God Yuan Palace seventh level. Furthermore, his fleshy body is strong. It is very difficult to kill such an existence instantly.”
“I can’t do it.” Marquis Ardent Fire added.
His combat style was quite tyrannical, though the magic servant was not foolish. He could parry and escape too.
“The actor should have a ninth level strength.” Old Mother Ying Shan chuckled, ‘The puzzling thing is that he acted to save this young fellow Xue Ying, yet did not come out to speak to this old granny. Unless he did not do so because of me?”
If the other party acted for her sake, he should have spoken to her at least.
“It could be someone who lives in seclusion within Ardent Fire City, or he might just be passing by this area.” Old Mother Ying Shan shook her head with a smile, “No matter what, this expert should not have any vile intention. We could still thank him for his help.”
“Mn.” Marquis Ardent Fire nodded.
Old Mother Ying Shan and Marquis Ardent Fire could not think of who had helped them during this period. At least nobody within the Southern Cloud Nation corresponded with the profile of this expert. Nevertheless, the Realm Heart Great Land was massive, and there were many nations. There were even six great ancient nations where experts numbered like clouds! Hence, it was natural for many experts to exist that did not know of Old Mother Ying Shan.
“Little fellow Xue Ying.” Old Mother Ying Shan turned to him, “That expert must be fond of you, which was why he acted. It might be possible to meet him in the future. You must remember to befriend that expert by then.”
After all, according to their deduction, that should be at least a Conferred King.
In the entire Southern Cloud Nation, there were only 21 Conferred Kings in the total! None had such a horrifying technique that could distort the void like this.
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded.
“For you to remain calm without panicking shows that your heart temperament is quite good.” The incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire praised Xue Ying too.
As Old Mother Ying Shan spoke, she was also pondering who this mysterious expert was. Firstly, she had excluded all those who lived within the Southern Cloud Nation. It should be someone outside of it. She was quite familiar with the entire Black Devil Four Nations too, and some devils within the Black Devil Great Lake. There were only two who could achieve this at the Primal Chaos realm. But many more of such experts existed in the vaster world outside the Black Devil Four Nations.
“That is an opportunity for Xue Ying. Furthermore, Xue Ying is talented in the void too, which is the same as what this expert specializes in. Since he acted, their destiny has been connected. Who knows if he might come and meet Xue Ying because of fate.” Old Mother Ying Shan chuckled. Following that, her expression turned cold. She was currently pondering over who arranged the assassination.
Who was it that wanted to reap the life of her Ying Shan Clan’s disciple, ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying’, who had the highest talent in the history of her clan!

chapters.title: Chapter 1020 - The Fury of the Ying Shan Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 1020: The Fury of the Ying Shan Clan
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Ardent Fire.”
Old Mother Ying Shan’s voice remained calm, “Your governance of Ardent Fire City is too lax, allowing so many experts to enter.”
“It is I who is incompetent.” Marquis Ardent Fire lowered his head and replied.
“There is even a Magic Servant Chao Qing!” Old Mother Ying Shan nonchalantly stated, “For someone to send Devil Nian Jiu and a magic servant as an assassin, this person should have an exceptional identity.”
Marquis Ardent Fire obediently nodded.
He was a Grandpa Marquis, yet was not willing to buy a magic servant. Of course, he could still afford the ‘Magic Servant Chao Qing’ which was the cheapest and weakest puppet in the Primal Chaos realm. Nevertheless, as he would be staying at the Ardent Fire City to protect it for long periods, he felt that there was no need to purchase one! It was too extravagant and wasteful.
“Investigate.” Old Mother Ying Shan coldly ordered, “Dig out everything. Floating Dust, you should accompany me and stay for three days in the Ardent Fire City. Help me investigate this matter too. The subordinates of Ardent Fire are likely weaker than you in terms of their searching capabilities.”
“Alright.” The green-pupiled old man chuckled.
Old Mother Ying Shan was an extremely ancient Conferred King within Southern Cloud Nation. Her strength was ranked in the front too. When Floating Dust was weak, he had gotten an enormous favor from Old Mother Ying Shan. After that, the two became closer over time.
Xue Ying and Ying Shan Lie Hu had both stood up a long time ago from the carriage.
“Little fellow Xue Ying.” Old Mother Ying Shan laughed as she looked at Xue Ying, “Why are you holding on to a spear? Are you thinking of personally fighting against the enemy?”
“Old Ancestor.” Xue Ying unraveled his aura abruptly. He confidently stated, “I currently wield a God Yuan Palace fifth level strength. It is still possible for me to fight a round or two with the enemy. Naturally, I am unwilling to be captured just like this.”
The eyes of Old Mother Ying Shan sparkled at that instant.
“You’ve reached the fifth level in the “Southern Cloud Sacred Body”?” The incarnation of Marquis Ardent Fire was stunned.
“This is rare. Prince Xue Ying has only cultivated for five million years, yet you have reached the God Yuan Palace fifth level strength.” Floating Dust sighed, “It is possible to reach the Unity realm by depending on your bloodline, yet cultivating the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” require good comprehension ability. For you to reach this realm in just five million years show you have an amazing talent.”
Old Mother Ying Shan might be happy, though she still reminded: “Don’t praise this young fellow too much. His bloodline is extraordinary, and it originates from the king’s ‘void bloodline’ as well. It is natural that the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” will come easier for him. His speed of cultivation merely is above average that he could reach this stage in five million years.”
She was afraid that Xue Ying might get complacent.
After all, he was the one with the greatest innate talent within the history of Ying Shan Clan. If Xue Ying became too complacent and lost seriousness in cultivation, it would significantly affect his future.
“Little Fellow Xue Ying,” Old Mother Ying Shan smiled, “You might have reached the God Yuan Palace fifth level strength, but regardless of that magic servant or Old Devil Nian Jiu, both of them have reached the seventh level strength. Killing you is as simple as flipping their hands.”
“I know. But I can’t just sit still and let them kill me without retaliating.” Xue Ying answered, “Old Ancestor, I have already acquired this strength, so it is time for me to pay the capital a visit right? I would like to go to the main religion headquarters of Southern Cloud Sacred Religion to learn the complete “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”.”
“Mn.”
Both Old Mother Ying Shan and Marquis Ardent Fire could not help but nod.
“You should indeed go, and should go there as soon as possible.” Marquis Ardent Fire added.
“The experts in the main religion headquarters of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion are like clouds-there are many of them. Going there will aid in your cultivation.” Old Mother Ying Shan said, “You should stay there and cultivate for a period. With your talent, it should be easy for me to find my old friend and make you become an inner disciple of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.”
“Many thanks, Ancestor.” Xue Ying thanked.
“You should go back and rest first. After a few days, I’ll arrange for you to set off.” Old Mother Ying Shan said. With a wave of his hand, she enveloped Xue Ying, Ying Shan Lie Hu, Tian Yi Zhi and the group of protectors and attendants with her energy. “Hong-,” she forcefully teleported them into the Ardent Fire Marquisdom. Clearly, it was an easy task given Old Mother Ying Shan’s strength to teleport them when the void was not suppressed.
Naturally, she could not achieve ‘ultra-long distance teleportation’.
“Hmph.” The expression of Old Mother Ying Shan became colder after that, “I would like to find out who exactly was the one that started this whole affair.”
The eyes of Marquis Ardent Fire flashed with a frosty intent too. His fury had clearly reached the tipping point.
…
The entire Ardent Fire City was jittery.
“Hua hua hua.”
Practically the entire Ardent Fire Army came out from its nest. Many teams of soldiers flew above Ardent Fire City and went to various places to conduct the investigation.
Old Mother Ying Shan merely left an incarnation here. But with her protecting this region with Marquis Floating Dust, both of them would personally go investigating suspicious point that came up.
WIth her around…
Even the other giant of Ardent Fire City, Chun Yu Wei Yi who controlled the Southern Cloud Sacred Hall here temporarily ordered his subordinates to return to their positions. They were temporarily under strict orders not to move about.
“Tell me.”
The plump Chun Yu Feng knelt there. His face was filled with sweat.
Marquis Ardent Fire sat there. The entire place was surrounded by soldiers. Marquis Ardent Fire was currently looking at Chun Yu Feng coldly.
“Yes yes, I’ve said everything already, but Grandpa Marquis, this affair is honestly unrelated to me.” Pavilion Master Chun Yu Feng shouted out anxiously. He was also asking his clan for help, though the clan merely gave him an answer-coordinate with the Ying Shan Clan!
The fury of Old Mother Ying Shan!
Chun Yu Clan might be one of the three Great Emperor realm clans, yet it was impossible for them to offend Old Mother Ying Shan for this little fellow!
Being a Conferred King, Old Mother Ying Shan could casually wipe out the existence of Chun Yu Feng, and she would not suffer from any aggression at all,
…
Many chains of dubious businesses conducted in the past were being pulled out. Many aristocratic clan disciples were also captured for interrogation. These aristocratic clan disciples did not have any potential and naturally wanted to earn more ‘resources’. Hence, some of them would have partaken in those dubious businesses before. And now, disaster was brought down upon them by that Qian Gan Xue.
“Qian Gan Xue, it is fortunate that you died early. Otherwise, I’ll never forgive you.” Chun Yu Feng gritted as he was locked in prison. During these two short days, he suffered from many interrogations and punishments. He had even been sent over to the Ying Shan Clan for interrogation under the illusory realm. Even still, Marquis Ardent Fire kept him imprisoned.
He, Chun Yu Feng, was still a disciple of the Chun Yu Clan. He had relatively high status, and could barely keep his life.
This time, during the wholesome interrogation by the Ying Shan Clan, all aristocratic clan disciples that had helped contacted Old Devil Nian Jiu were all killed! Many of those who did not have high statuses and conducted those dubious businesses, as long as they were suspected of being a subordinate of Qian Gan Xue, would either end up being imprisoned or sentenced to death.
During these three days, many aristocratic clan disciples living in Ardent Fire City had kept a low profile.
When they faced ordinary commoners, they would usually act recklessly and ostentatiously. They would only be fined for killing the commoners. Nevertheless, Old Mother Ying Shan would not be punished for killing them! Naturally, Old Mother Ying Shan would not randomly kill. There were some underlying rules between the Conferred Kings of Southern Cloud Nation.
“Hmph hmph.”
Within Ardent Fire City, inside an underground cultivation room within an ordinary residence.
The black-robed devil master was currently seated cross-legged here. With how vast the Ardent Fire City was, it was impossible for every residence to be checked. And this place where the incarnation of the devil master hid had no contact with his servants at all.
“Becoming anxious? Turning crazy?”
“Why the need to become so furious over a single failed assassination?” The edges of his lips curled up, “Marquis Ardent Fire, you truly cannot control your temper.”
He closed his eyes and remained seated cross-legged until he fell asleep.
To him… this was merely him greeting Marquis Ardent Fire.

chapters.title: Chapter 1021 - Southern Cloud Capital
chapters.content:
Chapter 1021: Southern Cloud Capital
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Three days later at a location with foggy weather.
Xue Ying was seen enjoying wine by himself in a pavilion next to the lake. A spear was placed on his knees. As the incarnation of Old Mother Ying Shan was currently still in the Ardent Fire City, Xue Ying did not practice in any techniques at all. Instead, he was merely comprehending the profound mysteries from the spear body.
As he enjoyed the wine, the female attendant Yan Yu was constantly refilling it for him.
“Xue Ying.” A voice was heard.
A red-haired male-Marquis Ardent Fire, flew over with a black-robed demonic teenager.
Xue Ying kept his spear and stood up immediately.
“Grandpa Marquis.” Xue Ying greeted. His gaze soon landed on that black-robed demonic teenager. That teenager was currently holding on to a fan fanning himself. His aura was relatively demonic too.
“This one is Magic Servant Blood Rain.” The black-robed demonic teenager kept his fan. He bowed, “Old Mother has bestowed me with the name ‘Ying Shan Zi Bai’. In the future, this one will be Prince’s protector. The day Prince breaks through to the Primal Chaos realm is also the day I return to the ancestral family.”
Xue Ying was startled.
Magic Servant ‘Blood Rain’?
It was rare for fleshy puppets to wield strength at the Primal Chaos realm. There were even fewer with the ability to generate energy. Magic Servant ‘Chao Qing’ was considered to be the lowest graded amongst them and also the cheapest. Nevertheless, it required 50 million cosmos crystals to purchase, though there were quite a few Cosmos Gods who could refine it. But Magic Servant Blood Rain was different. Only the ‘Summer Wind Ancient Nation’ out of the six great ancient nations could refine it. It could maintain an underlying strength of God Yuan Palace seventh level and persist for quite an extended period. During the most crucial moments, it could refine its body to unleash a force at the God Yuan Palace eighth level. After the battle, a massive amount of external materials would be required to restore its energy back.
A magic servant that could unleash power at the God Yuan Palace eighth level… the price to purchase it was quite horrifying-equivalent to about six Chao Qings’ price. Marquis Ardent Fire could not afford this magic servant even if he sold all his belongings. Only Old Mother Ying Shan could afford it, to which she bestowed it with the name Ying Shan Zi Bai.
“I’ll have to trouble Zi Bai in the future.” Xue Ying immediately said.
“It is my honor to be a protector of Prince.” Zi Bai held onto the fan and gave an elegant salute.
“Xue Ying, the old ancestor is afraid that the mastermind of this assassination would not give up just like this. Hence, she sent Zi Bai over.” Marquis Ardent Fire explained.
“The mastermind hasn’t been found?” Xue Ying followed with a question.
“We can only deduce that it should be a devil from the Black Devil Great Lake.” Marquis Ardent Fire shook his head.
Xue Ying felt his heart tightening.
Black Devil Great Lake?
Including the Southern Cloud Nation, the four nations around the lake were known as the Black Devil Four Nations. Why? Precisely because they were located next to the ‘Black Devil Great Lake’, and that location was a famous gathering place for devils across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Horrifying devils that were placed on the wanted list by the six great ancient nations were mostly hiding in the Black Devil Great Lake.
And since these devils could escape from the six great ancient nations, much less was needed to say about other second-tier nations like Southern Cloud Nation. They had a hard time facing the Black Devil Great Lake. After all, there were more than ten Cosmos Gods that were deduced to be staying within the lake, and included amongst them included those great devils that had once brought disaster to the six great ancient nations.
“A devil from the Black Devil Great Lake has sent someone to assassinate me?” Xue Ying felt puzzled.
“It should be an enemy of my Ying Shan Clan.” Marquis Ardent Fire said, “This cannot be avoided. Over the long years, the Ying Shan Clan had dealings with the devils from the Black Devil Great Lake. Naturally, our Ying Shan Clan would not be willing to be humiliated by them. There were even times when we began a huge massacre of those devils!”
“To have dealings with the devils?” Xue Ying felt puzzled.
Why would the Conferred King families within the Southern Cloud Nation have a deal with the devils?
“You will naturally understand these when you reach the Primal Chaos realm.” Marquis Ardent Fire said, “Alright, let’s not waste any more time. You should hurry to the capital.”
“Okay. I have prepared everything and could set off anytime.” Xue Ying grinned.
At that moment, Zi Bai whipped open his fan and continued fanning himself. He chuckled: “It has been a long time since I last visited the capital.”
******
That day.
Xue Ying brought along the Magic Servant Zi Bai, Tian Yi Zhi, the two Black Stream Cloud Wolves, nine personal guards and a female attendant Yan Yu. Even though his mother Rong Xing Lan asked him to bring more female attendants over, Xue Ying was used to cultivating alone in his previous life. Bringing a female attendant was already the limit of which he did to cope with his mother.
“Hu.”
They first proceeded to the teleportation array in Ardent Fire City in the direction of one of the three Great Emperor ranked cities, ‘Chun Yu City’.
Following that, they went to another teleportation array within the Chun Yu City which led them towards the capital!
“Hua~”
The space regained its usual calm.
A white-robed handsome young man with a female attendant by his side, a gray-robed old man, a black-robed demonic male fanning himself and two Black Stream Cloud Wolves were looking around with wary. Those wolves were letting out soft growls, and the nine personal guards remained solemn.
“The Southern Cloud Capital” Xue Ying watched on.
The sky was filled with magnificent light beams moving about. The city was so big that one could not see its end.
Being the biggest city in the Southern Cloud Nation, this was a place that Southern Cloud King personally protected. This was also where one of the ten great religions across the entire Realm Heart Great Land, ‘Southern Cloud Sacred Religion’, was located. The Southern Cloud Capital was even a famous place across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Over here, experts from other nations could be seen frequently. There were also many organizations from the six great ancient nations opening branches in this city.
As for the cultivators who came to join the headquarters of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, their number was shocking.
‘This Southern Cloud Capital feels more powerful and stable by ten to a hundred times as compared to one of the holy grounds in the Primal Chaos Void, ‘Blade Emperor City.’ Xue Ying was inwardly shocked.
It was inevitable. The Realm Heart Great Land had too many Cosmos Gods, which led to a more profound stage of research on arrays. It was highly probable for experts who had surpassed Ancestor Sorcerer in the attainments of Arrays to exist here. Furthermore, the ‘Southern Cloud King’ was the head for one of the top ten great religions. He was considered very rich when compared to his peers. Hence, he could easily afford several powerful arrays.
The Southern Cloud King had quite an intimidating strength. Few could compete with him when he was in the Southern Cloud Capital.
“Prince, our Ying Shan Clan also has a courtyard here.” Magic Servant Zi Bai chuckled, “We should go there first for a respite. Old Mother has already sent someone to arrange for your matter at the headquarters of Southern Cloud Sacred Religion. Prince can visit the headquarters after that.”
“Alright.” Xue Ying nodded.
…
Southern Cloud Capital, Ying Shan Courtyard.
There were many Ying Shan Clan disciples here. Some came to cultivate, and some were responsible for businesses. But when Xue Ying came, he naturally became the person with the highest status within the Ying Shan Courtyard.
“It is that Prince Xue Ying.”
“He has come to the capital.”
Even though three ancestral family elders were presiding over this place, Xue Ying had Magic Servant Zi Bai as his personal protector, so the three elders naturally had to lower their heads. They did not mind too since this Prince Xue Ying was destined to become a Conferred Marquis at the Primal Chaos realm.
They held a welcome reception for Xue Ying and enthusiastically received him.
“Prince Xue Ying, this isn’t the Ying Shan City, and neither is it the Ardent Fire City. There are as many experts as there are clouds, and many even have great statuses. For instance, there are disciples from the royal family, or geniuses from Emperor ranked clans. But you should pay more attention to disciples coming from huge clans of the six great ancient nations, and disciples from the royal families of the six great ancient nations. They are people even the most domineering crown prince of our Southern Cloud Nation could not afford to offend.”
“Yes, Prince Xue Ying, it is better to remain low profile here.”
The ancestral family elders and some disciples were advising him.
Xue Ying sighed inwardly after hearing it.
Magic Servant Zi Bai continued fanning himself while nonchalantly saying: “Prince, there is no need to be overly worried. Old Mother has made me bring along a Southern Cloud Sacred Token! As long as you don’t take the initiative to offend someone, there is no need for you to care about even disciples from the six great ancient nations. Actually, there are differing statuses amongst the disciples from the six great ancient nations too, and few could actually force us to take a step back.”
“Southern Cloud Order Token?” The three ancestral family elders were astonished.
The Southern Cloud Order Token was bestowed by the king himself. Old Mother Ying Shan only had one single token herself. Naturally, with her strength, this sacred token was merely for show. Only when it was with Xue Ying could it display its protective effect.
“Old Mother really favors upon Prince Xue Ying.” The three ancestral family elders and other disciples could not help but feel envy for him.
…
Xue Ying wasn’t also a cultivation maniac who knew nothing but cultivation. He would never offend a huge enemy for no reason. On the second day after he arrived at the capital, he left for the ‘Treasured Goods Market’.
There was a Treasured Goods Market in any city across the origin world.
The Southern Cloud Capital was even a famous big city within the Realm Heart Great Land. Hence, the Treasured Goods Market here was even more flourishing than that in the Ardent Fire City. Furthermore, one could feel the splendor of treasures despite being quite a distance away from the market. There were shops opened by the royal family, and even by disciples from huge clans of the six great ancient nations.
There were all sorts of treasures here, so many that they could not be counted.
“Amazing.”
“This is spectacular!”
Xue Ying visited many places. This was truly an eye-opening experience for him!
“Mn?”
While walking on the street, Xue Ying suddenly frowned. Flipping his hand, a spear appeared. He could feel the faint feeling of a struggle coming from the spear body. It seemed something was attracting it, ‘What is attracting it?’
At the next moment, Xue Ying had an idea.
He sped off in that direction. Those following behind him, Magic Servant Zi Bai, Tian Yi Zhi, and others felt bewildered, though they followed closely behind.
‘It is there!’ Xue Ying soon found a shop with a sharp hemispherical roof. Xue Ying’s gaze crossed through the void obstacle and soon saw a particular object floating on the third floor amongst 12 treasures. That was a spearhead.

chapters.title: Chapter 1022 - The Origin of the Spear
chapters.content:
Chapter 1022: The Origin of the Spear
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
There was a spearhead floating. It seemed ordinary, yet one could feel fluctuations of folded space coming from it. At the same time, there were many layers of arrays which covered over this spearhead as if eggshells wrapping around it. This was done to prevent thoughts of snatching it away from forming in the head of guests despite the presence of many arrays covering the entire ‘Treasured Goods Market’, and the fact that stealing something was a foolish act in the Southern Cloud Capital.
But there were the occasional few who could not hold themselves back and thought they were pretty good at fleeing. Hence, by establishing up a forbidding array, this prevented anyone from touching the secret treasure in the first place.
“Let us visit that shop.” Xue Ying said.
The group of subordinates followed closely to the shop where Xue Ying directed. The shop occupied a huge area, and there was a simple yet unique seal imprinted at the front of the shop-’Fan’.
“Fan Clan?” Magic Servant Zi Bai lightly fanned himself from the side. He added, “The Fan Clan is one of the biggest three clans from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. It is even a clan ranked across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.”
Xue Ying nodded after hearing that.
The ‘Fan Clan’ was a huge famous clan in the Realm Heart Great Land and was even one of the three great clans within the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. There were dozens of Cosmos Gods in the Fan Clan. Just this Fan Clan alone had sufficient strength to suppress one of the six great ancient nations, the ‘Towering Sky Ancient Nation’. Clearly, there were differing statuses between the six great ancient nations too.
And the Towering Sky Ancient Nation was the weakest of them all.
‘The Fan Clan is extremely powerful.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly. A clan could suppress Towering Sky Ancient Nation by itself.
“Welcome, Prince! This way please!” Beautiful female attendants were coming over at that instance to welcome Xue Ying.
Xue Ying brought his subordinates in.
The first level of the shop might be huge, and it contained many winding corridors too, though Xue Ying’s gaze could easily bypass the obstacle of the void-he could see all treasures located on the first level.
‘Not a single secret treasure here.’ Xue Ying shook his head inwardly.
“Let’s go to the second floor.”
Xue Ying directly proceeded on to the next floor. The second floor had some secret treasures, though with Xue Ying’s judgment, he could determine that they were all slightly weaker secret treasures and were mainly meant for Primal Chaos giants to use.
…
Very soon, Xue Ying arrived at the third floor.
“This Prince, the third floor only allow for two subordinates to be brought.” An emissary was obstructing his way on the stairway leading to the third floor. Clearly, the third floor of this shop was extraordinary. If one brought all his subordinates in, what would the situation of the third floor end up in?
“Zi Bai, Elder Tian, follow me up.” Xue Ying ordered.
“Yes.”
Magic Servant Zi Bai and Tian Yi Zhi followed closely behind.
The three of them arrived at the third floor of this shop belonging to Fan Clan. Even though the third floor was about as big as the second floor, there were only 12 floating secret treasures here, and every treasure had a female attendant stationed beside it.
“This Prince, are you here to see our secret treasures? The Fan Clan branch located here in the Southern Cloud Capital is also ranked in the top 100 in the Realm Heart Great Land.” A plump old man came over with a smile. The aura emitting from his body had reached the Primal Chaos stage.
Magic Servant Zi Bai shook his fan and transmitted to Xue Ying: “Prince, this old man should be a magic servant too, though I can’t see what kind of magic servant is he.”
Xue Ying softly nodded.
Primal Chaos realm Magic Servants…
An apex clan like the Fan Clan was even more willing to let the magic servant be in charge of several businesses! Because the magic servants were all absolutely loyal, and would not be greedy.
“Prince should come and see this secret treasure, ‘Cloud Sky Hammer’.” The plump old man pointed to an enormous black great hammer floating by the side. This hammer was even bigger than a human, “This is the secret treasure used by the famous ‘Paragon Matron Slave’ from Towering Sky Ancient Nation during the first War of the Ancient Nations. After that, Paragon Matron Slave has refined a secret treasure that is even more suited for herself, and thus, sold this Cloud Sky Hammer. After going through many rounds of transactions, it ended up in the hands of my Fan Clan and is placed here temporarily. It is considered a clan protection treasure of the branch here in the Southern Cloud Capital. Oh right, this secret treasure also contains a set of absolute art created by Paragon Matron Slave called “Cloud Sky Hammer Technique”.”
Xue Ying saw a hill-like black great hammer floating there. He felt a strong suppression coming from this weapon and knew that it was more horrifying than the 12 Primal Beads Bracelet which he once owned.
“What is the price like?” Xue Ying asked.
The plump male grinned: “Eight billion cosmos crystals.”
Xue Ying felt his eyelids twitching after hearing that.
Eight billion cosmos crystals…
Could Old Mother Ying Shan even afford it?
“This was after all the weapon used by Paragon Matron Slave during the first War of the Ancient Nations. There are several Cosmos Gods who died under this weapon.” The plump old man said, “It is worth a Cosmos God selling all of his treasures to purchase it.”
Xue Ying also understood that this Clan Protection Treasure was deliberately placed here to show off how dazzling the foundation of Fan Clan was! How could anyone afford such a treasure?
Such a fantastic secret treasure would only be willingly bought by some powerful cultivators that met it by chance and fell in love with it.
“Amazing, amazing.”
Xue Ying merely praised it before continuing to look at other secret treasures.
He walked and stopped. And soon, he arrived at the spearhead which was also the reason why he came.
“This spearhead has an interesting origin.” The plump male chuckled, “Its owner is even someone who had some slight relationship with my Fan Clan.”
Xue Ying felt his heart thumping.
Its owner?
It seemed that the Fan Clan knew the exact origin of this spearhead.
“A very long time ago, at an era before the first War of the Ancient Nations, that time, the Realm Heart Great Land was more chaotic, unlike the current world which is comparatively more orderly. At that time, the Summer Wind Ancient Nation hasn’t been built.” The plump old man said, “‘Great Paragon Lu Tian’ from my Fan Clan has once befriended someone as he traveled across the Realm Heart Great Land, someone known as ‘Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master’. That was a horrifying existence who wasn’t any weaker than Great Paragon Lu Tian himself, yet that Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master was too overly arrogant and ostentatious. He was obstinate and unyielding, which cost him his life in the end. Of course, that was something which happened before the first War of the Ancient Nations, and I only know bits and pieces of it.”
“But this spearhead was the one Great Paragon Lu Tian saw in the past. It is indeed the spearhead of the ‘Scarlet Cloud Magic Spear’ which belongs to Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master.”
“It’s a pity that over the years as the spear was circulated around, only this spearhead is left behind.” The plump old man shook his head.
Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
Something that happened before the first War of the Ancient Nations? That was indeed a period where even history was scarcely recorded. After all, many ancient nations had yet to be built then.
Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master?
“I wonder what is the price like?” Xue Ying asked.
“As it is missing a piece, and only its spearhead is left behind, it is deemed cheaper.” The plump old man chuckled, “500 million cosmos crystals.”
“500 million?”
Xue Ying felt stunned.
And that was considered cheap?
As cultivating the “Southern Cloud Sacred Body” required precious materials, he only had a total of 50 over million cosmos crystals. This was even given to him by Old Mother Ying Shan when he reached the Unity realm.
500 million cosmos crystals. That was a really horrifying price. It cost even more than Magic Servant Zi Bai!
“It isn’t costly. Any formidable Primal Chaos giant could buy it after selling all his belongings.” The plump old man said, “After all, this was a weapon of Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master. If it was the complete treasure, its price might not be any less than that ‘Cloud Sky Hammer’! But now, 500 million cosmos crystals is really just a pittance.”
Xue Ying could not afford it at all.
Even if he displayed his strength and became a powerful Primal Chaos giant, he needed time to accumulate treasures. And to do that, most would have to risk their lives and go on a campaign to kill.
‘500 million cosmos crystals.’ Xue Ying felt his heart trembling.
No other choice.
In a tiny area like the Ardent Fire City, nobody was able to recognize the origin of the spear body. After all, the imprints on the spear body were lacking. Xue Ying was able to buy it at a low price.
This spearhead was different. The spearhead was mainly used to attack and kill. During ordinary times, the spearhead would cause the surrounding void to fluctuate, forming many void ripples. One glance and it sufficed to show that this was an extraordinary item. Furthermore, Great Paragon Lu Tian had ascertained its origin, which was why its price naturally went up.
“After all, this is only a spearhead.” The plump male saw the appearance of Xue Ying and felt that this young man seemed interested in the item. He added, “If you are really interested in buying it, I can reduce the price slightly.”
It could indeed be reduced to a lower price.
Even though it had a great origin, it was ultimately an incomplete weapon. The Fan Clan had fixed the lowest price it could be sold at 300 million cosmos crystals.
“How much cheaper can it be? Is it possible to buy it below 100 million cosmos crystals?” Xue Ying asked.
The plump male shook his head profusely: “Impossible. Absolutely impossible. It can only be slightly cheaper.”
“Oh.”
Xue Ying felt slightly disappointed.
He did not have any choice. He could not afford this weapon!
But even if he could not afford it, if Xue Ying could hold onto this spearhead and personally observe through the operation of the internal imprints! He would be able to memorize part of it. Fusing it with the profound mysteries within the spear body would be of great help. It would certainly reduce the difficulty of comprehending the profound mysteries within the spear body by three to five times.
“Can I see it?” Xue Ying turned to the plump old man in front. This spearhead was wrapped around by many layers of forbidding arrays. Clearly, it was meant to make it difficult for guests to view it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1023 - Just a Little Fellow
chapters.content:
Chapter 1023: Just a Little Fellow
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Have a look?” The plump old man chuckled, “Aren’t you currently looking at it?”
“Can I hold it with my hands?” Xue Ying followed up with the next question, “As there is a forbidding array, I can’t view it clearly, and can only look at its external appearance. Who knows how formidable this spearhead is? And if it is appropriate for me?”
He had already reached the Primal CHaos realm in the Dao of Void, yet when comprehending the spear body, Xue Ying still had many queries. As long as he viewed part of the profound mysteries within the spearhead, it would be equivalent to seeing the entire appearance of the spear which would certainly clear away many of his previous doubts.
“Only when a person views it thoroughly can he understand if it is suitable or not.” Magic Servant Zi Bai fanned himself and added from the side.
“Take it out for a look?” The plump old man chuckled. He pointed to the spearhead that was wrapped by layers of forbidding array, “Many arrays are protecting it. If anyone can have a look at it, why is there a need for the arrays to be present?”
As the plump old man talked to Xue Ying, he was also sending orders to his subordinates to gather information on this guest.
“Great manager, this young prince is Ying Shan Xue Ying and is a genius disciple of the Ying Shan Clan. He is a Void God at birth and was able to reach the Unity realm in 8,000 years. The magic servant by the side was a Magic Servant Blood Rain purchased in the past by Old Mother Ying Shan because this Prince Xue Ying suffered from assassination in the past.” The Fan Clan was originally good at gathering information, and Xue Ying was also quite famous within the Southern Cloud Nation.
“Oh? Such a small clan like the Ying Shan Clan?” The plump old male was enlightened.
In his heart, the entire Ying Shan Clan was a small clan.
There was only a single Old Mother Ying Shan whom he had to pay more attention to! As for other people, he could ignore them.
Actually, to the ‘Fan Clan’, they only paid attention to the royal family from the Southern Cloud Nation. After all, the Southern Cloud royal family had an amazing king who was admired even by the six great ancient nations. The other three Great Emperor ranked clans were considered small to them!
…
Xue Ying looked at the plump old man with anticipation. He did not know that the other party’s view of Xue Ying had changed for Xue Ying was merely a disciple from a small clan.
“Indeed, only when you look at it thoroughly could you know if it is suitable or not.” The plump old man chuckled, “But with the arrays protecting it, not anyone can see it.”
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded.
“My Fan Clan has its rules too.” The plump old man continued, “If you want to see it, either you have the strength or the status that we approved of. Or that you can bring out sufficient treasures that would verify you have the purchasing power.”
“Strength and status?” Xue Ying felt puzzled.
He definitely could not purchase it.
“Strength that is at least on the level of a Conferred King within the Southern Cloud Nation.” The plump old man answered, “Ordinary Primal Chaos giants do not have the qualifications to have a look at this spearhead. Status of someone who is at least a prince of the royal family in the Southern Cloud Nation, or a high-status disciple from the six great ancient nation. Or you could be a personal disciple of some existence who could shock the entire Realm Heart Great Land.”
“As for purchasing power, it is simple. Bring out treasures worth 500 million cosmos crystals, and you can view it.” The plump old man looked at Xue Ying.
Xue Ying was stunned.
He did not have treasures!
As for strength? He was only at the peak of the eighth level currently when he used his full force. Naturally, Xue Ying did not dare to reveal his strength since he merely cultivated for just five million years.
Status? Did he not hear what the other party said? Only the princes from the entire royal family were qualified!
“My apologies for disturbing you.” Xue Ying said, “We will leave now.”
“Have a nice day.” The plump old man remained smiling. Even though he held such a small clan like the Ying Shan Clan in contempt, he still had to follow the basic courtesy as a businessman!
******
They left the shop.
“He actually did not allow Prince to see it.” Tian Yi Zhi shook his head.
“Did the other party not say it? Either we show that we have the power, the status, or that we have the purchasing power.” Magic Servant Zi Bai fanned himself while curling his lips, “Clearly, the Ying Shan Clan is not worth a mention in the eyes of the other party.”
“Let’s go back.”
Xue Ying nonchalantly said.
He wasn’t angry at all. It was all about the strong feasting on the weak between cultivators. Naturally, the rules were strict. Since Xue Ying did not have the strength, the status or the purchasing power, it was normal for the other party not to let him see the spearhead.
‘I’ll wait. When I am strong enough and have earned sufficient cosmos crystals, I can come and buy it then. I do not believe it is that easy for them to sell treasures of this level.’ Xue Ying thought. For instance, the ‘Cloud Sky Hammer’ was a shop protection treasure, and would likely be placed here for god knew how long. That spearhead was, after all, an incomplete weapon, and it was harder for them to sell it.
‘My luck this time is not bad for me to discover this spearhead.’ Xue Ying thought.
Actually, it was normal for him to discover the spear.
Because the Southern Cloud Capital was the biggest city in the entire Southern Cloud Nation, and also the safest city. Organizations like the Fan Clan that were considered an apex power even in the entire Realm Heart Great Land could only be found in the Southern Cloud Capital! Even some of the organizations within the Southern Cloud Nation would only be placing their more important treasures within the capital and sell it.
Because the Southern Cloud Capital had many experts coming in and out! There was even the ‘Southern Cloud King’ protecting this place.
If one placed a fantastic treasure in a small little city, would it not be snatched away should a Cosmos God decide to attack it?
Hence, more than 90% of the treasures within the Southern Cloud Nation were gathered at the capital. As for the apex secret treasures, more than 99% of them were in the capital. Xue Ying came here relying on the attraction by the spear body to discover the spearhead… this was nothing special.
…
In the following days, Xue Ying traveled across various places in the Southern Cloud Capital. More than half his time was spent in the Treasured Goods Market. Other than that, he would be expanding his horizons by checking out some historical remnants and to ‘feast’.
