Xue Ying as a foodie had naturally discovered many top-graded delicacies and wine within the Southern Cloud Capital.
In the blink of an eye, more than half a month had passed.
“Xue Ying, the Old Ancestor has finished arranging things on her side. Tomorrow, you will be proceeding with Magic Servant Zi Bai to the headquarters of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.” Marquis Ardent Fire sent the message down to inform Xue Ying.
“Alright.”
Xue Ying was in great joy.
The headquarters of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion was a place Xue Ying looked forward to going. Because it was one of the ten great religions in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, it should have collected many absolute art scriptures within.
One had to know that Xue Ying would only cultivate in two Dao paths at most according to his plan in this world-one was the Dao of Void, and the other was the Dao of Mirage! Xue Ying sought to obtain the highest-graded absolute art Mirage illusory realm scripture, and the best bet for him would be to search for it within the headquarters of Southern Cloud Sacred Religion!
In terms of absolute art scriptures…
Even if all the clans within the Southern Cloud Nation added their books, they could not compare to the tip of what the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion had. The foundation of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion was honestly horrifying.
“Prince, the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion has many rules. It is impossible for you to bring all your subordinates in. Today, let just the two of us go.” Magic Servant Zi Bai said, “In a while, after you become an inner disciple, the headquarters should arrange an accommodation for you to stay in. By then, you can bring in all your subordinates.”
“Let’s go.” Xue Ying said.
The two of them sauntered in midair. Every step they took saw them crossing through a vast distance. The entire capital was huge, and even after teleporting many times, they had to spend an hour before Magic Servant Zi Bai and Xue Ying arrive at the headquarters of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.
“Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.”
Xue Ying looked at it from afar.
In the distance, one could see chains of mountains. The mountain range contained several pavilions on them. The entire continuous chain of the mountain range was protected by an array, and here was the headquarters for the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion. There was currently a vast number of cultivators flying in through the mountain entrance.
The mountain entrance could only be reached after walking through tens of thousands of kilometers along the path within the mountain. By the side of the mountain entrance, there were characters imprinted on the cliff-Southern Cloud.
“Hua.”
When Xue Ying first saw those two characters, they seemed ordinary and were only slightly more overbearing.
Nevertheless, when he thoroughly extended his senses over the two characters, he would feel endless void aura coming from them. This was a vast aura that was beyond the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”. It was akin to looking at an interminable towering void in reverence.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying?” A golden-robed male was standing by the entrance of the mountain. When he saw Xue Ying, he immediately came over and greeted him.
“Prince, this is Marquis Cheng Deng.” The Magic Servant Zi Bai introduced.
“Greetings Marquis Cheng Deng.” Xue Ying immediately bowed, “This time, I’ll have to trouble Marquis Cheng Deng for your help.”
“It is a minor matter. Many blockages within have been settled by Old Mother. Today, we will only be briefly walking through the process. After that, you will become an inner disciple.” Marquis Cheng Deng smiled, “Alright, let’s not waste any more time. Come on with me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1024 - Becoming an Inner Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 1024: Becoming an Inner Disciple
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Southern Cloud Sacred Religion was one of the ten great religions in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. It was incredibly difficult to become an inner disciple of this religion!
Nevertheless, the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion was biased to citizens of the Southern Cloud Nation. After all, wars between nations were frequent, and the civilians of one’s own country would definitely be more trustworthy!
“Ying Shan Xue Ying, a disciple of the Ying Shan Clan. He was given birth as a disciple belonging to a Southern Cloud aristocratic clan.” A total of 15 Primal Chaos experts were gathered in a palace hall. At the center, there was a projection depicting a handsome white-robed young man entering the God Yuan Palace.
“He has outstanding innate talent. Judging by his aura and soul, he hasn’t cultivated in a time-accelerated environment, and has merely cultivated for five million years.”
“Haha, he has already succeeded in crossing the God Yuan Palace fifth level.”
“Fellow cultivators… there should be no disagreements to let him in, right?”
“None at all.”
“He is a pass for me.”
“That is a young fellow belonging to the clan of Old Mother Ying Shan. Pass for me too.”
The 15 Primal Chaos experts said with smiles. The atmosphere was relaxing. A long time ago, Old Mother Ying Shan had already resolved all possible blockages, so everyone present was quite agreeable to it.
They were less stringent on the investigation and appraisal of their own citizens. If it were a cultivator from another nation, the interrogation would be much stricter. Even if a cultivator were not any weaker than Xue Ying in terms of talent, the demand for his strength would be harder, and they had to complete ‘certain missions’ to test the loyalty of that incoming disciple.
After all, outer disciples did not have to be loyal. They were free to choose other religions.
But the moment they succeeded in becoming an inner disciple of the religion, without the agreement of the Southern Cloud King personally, they were absolutely forbidden from joining other religions. If they dared to do so, it would be betraying the religion! And these traitors would be pursued and killed!
Naturally…
With such harsh requirements, there would be many benefits should one passed the checks and become an inner disciple.
…
Xue Ying exited from the God Yuan Palace.
‘In the primal chaos void, the opponents we had within the Star Pagoda were all Destruction Devils. Nevertheless, the trials within the God Yuan Palace were of different kinds of opponents.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly. Even though there was more variety in the God Yuan Palace, the level of combat demarcation was precisely the same as that of the Star Pagoda. Naturally, the God Yuan Palace had an additional tenth level.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying, congratulations to you!” Marquis Cheng Deng was waiting outside the God Yuan Palace. He laughed, “I have already gotten the news that your appraisal has passed. You are now an inner disciple of our Southern Cloud Sacred Religion. Oh, in a while, we will bring you to collect your personal inner disciple token, your robes, and other items. As for the cavern-dwelling you are living in, you can choose one yourself.”
“Many thanks, Marquis Cheng Deng.” Xue Ying said.
“It is just a minor matter. Let’s go and collect the token first.”
Marquis Cheng Deng was very enthusiastic.
Within the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, in the elder’s hall.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying, you are now the 3392nd disciple of our Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.” A silver-haired old man said. That old man was giving off a grand aura. He was currently passing over a robe solemnly to Xue Ying. The robe had a token pinned on to it, “In the future, you are not just a disciple of the Ying Shan Clan. You are also a disciple ‘Southern Cloud Sacred Religion’, one of the ten great religions in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Focus on cultivating and break through to the Primal Chaos realm soon. As a disciple of our Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, it is a humiliation not to reach the Primal Chaos realm.”
“This disciple understands.” Xue Ying respectfully received the robe.
He naturally understood it.
The conditions of joining the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion as an inner disciple were harsh. As a civilian of the Southern Cloud Nation, most could join only after they obtained power at the seventh level as a Unity realm! Hence, it wasn’t empty words to say that ‘it is a humiliation not to reach the Primal Chaos realm as an inner disciple of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion’.
There were more than 3,000 disciples in the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, and that was the total number of disciples ever since its creation.
Many had fallen over the long years too. Currently, only several hundred inner disciples were alive! Of course, these several hundred inner disciples were sufficient to bring up the reputation of Southern Cloud Sacred Religion. Of these several hundred disciples, very few were from the Southern Cloud Nation. The majority came from other nations. Even though the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion had harsher requirements for them to join it, there was ultimately too many talented outsiders applying. Clearly, having an identity as one of the top ten religions in the great land boosted its attraction.
It might seem relatively easy for Xue Ying to become an inner disciple of the religion.
In reality, his talent was ranked in the top ten within the history of Southern Cloud Nation.
In terms of comprehension ability, he had reached the Unity realm fifth level within five million years.
Only with such great talent and comprehension ability, coupled with being one of their own people, made it easy for him to join the religion.
******
Even though many cultivators came to visit the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, almost all of them were outer disciples that wanted to get better guidance at the headquarters!
“Inner disciple.”
Xue Ying stood on a mountain peak. There was a cavern-dwelling behind him. His subordinates-Magic Servant Zi Bai, Tian Yi Zhi, the female attendant Yan Yu, his two Black Stream Cloud Wolves, and personal guards had settled down too.
‘In the future, my fate will be tied together to the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.’ Xue Ying thought.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying arced through the sky. He flew towards the distant.
The rules within the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion were strict. Outer disciples could only traverse within the outer region. The innermost core religion of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion was meant just for the inner disciples and their servants. Even the servants of these inner disciples had a predetermined region of movement.
Hence, it was clearly more desolate within this inner core region.
“The Book Repository Realm.”
As Xue Ying flew across the sky, he arrived on a mountain peak floating within the clouds. The summit had a vast cave that spanned over ten meters tall. There were two characters ‘Book Repository’ imprinted on the cave. It was also the most critical place which Xue Ying paid attention to after joining the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.
As he stepped into the cave, the surrounding space started turning illusory.
“Mn?” Xue Ying looked around him. He had entered an enormous space.
Many bookshelves floated within the space.
There were different books and many more that were absolute art scriptures. Many of these books were also personal insights seniors had left behind regarding cultivation. For instance, insights on the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”. Amidst many of the books, the complete “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” could be seen.
With a glance, this vast space contained just a dozen other figures flipping through the books of comprehending. Those who could enter were at least inner disciples.
‘Let’s have a look at those rumored books.’
Xue Ying felt his heart itch. He rapidly flew towards the center of the space. There was a sky pillar extending all the way to the top. Many rows of characters were also imprinted on this pillar.
“”Third Realm Technique”, requires 500,000 contribution points to exchange.”
“”Avatar Technique”, requires 300,000 contribution points to exchange.”
“”Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique”, requires 300,000 contribution points to exchange.”
“”Five Phase Sealing Technique”, requires 200,000 contribution points to exchange.”
“”Star God Body”, requires 200,000 contribution points to exchange.”
“”External Incarnation Technique”, requires 100,000 contribution points to exchange.”
“”Void-ification Undying Technique”, requires 100,000 contribution points to exchange.”
…
There were rows and rows of words which caused Xue Ying’s eyes to brighten.
The “Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique” could be found here. There was also the ordinary “Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique”. The “Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique” should be Xue Ying’s own ultra-long distance teleportation technique. It merely required 50,000 contribution points to exchange.
‘These are the legendary absolute art scriptures.’ Xue Ying praised. He already knew some of them through the different books he read.
The Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, being one of the ten great religions, had collected many scriptures. Some originated from before the first War of the Ancient Nations. Some were even unique across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. There were cultivators from the six great ancient nations who came here just to have a look at it. Naturally, they had to fork out a huge price. Of course, the foundation of the six great ancient nations was thicker than the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion. They, too, had their own unique, powerful absolute art scriptures. Nevertheless, it was extremely difficult to join an ultra-strong religion within the six great ancient nations as an outsider from a different nation. Most outsiders even suffered from discrimination.
The Southern Cloud Sacred Religion was still a religion located within his own home nation, and it was sufficient for it to be ranked as top ten in the Realm Heart Great Land.
‘It’s a pity that the scriptures imprinted on the Sky Pillar require contribution points to be exchanged. But this is quite a good deal since I could exchange for them as an inner disciple. Outer disciples can’t even learn them.’ Xue Ying sighed. He swept across many of the books within the vast space. As for those books located here, they were free for anyone to peruse.

chapters.title: Chapter 1025 - Stunned
chapters.content:
Chapter 1025: Stunned
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
‘With these books, the possibility of me breaking through to the Cosmos God realm would be much higher!’
Xue Ying’s eyes were sparkling as he stared at the books floating across the vast space.
What about those books imprinted on the Sky Pillar?
He temporarily did not need to care about them since they required contribution points to be exchanged. Currently, Xue Ying could only accept Unity realm level missions with the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, and he would only be getting hundreds of contribution points every task. Furthermore, these missions were extremely complex. The slightly easier ones had already been snatched away by other inner disciples!
Inner disciples were practically all at the Primal Chaos realm and could send their incarnations an ultra-long distance away. They could thus efficiently complete these missions.
‘In order to earn contribution points, I should wait until the time that I can show my strength to the public-about ninth or tenth level. By then, earning points should be much faster.’ Xue Ying thought.
‘As for now?’
‘I should build a strong foundation first.’ Xue Ying started his reading.
…
The Book Repository within the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion was quite scary. The rare scriptures located on the ‘Sky Pillar’ were ultimately few in number-fewer than 100. But the other books found here were free to read! There were even absolute art scriptures that directly led to the Cosmos God realm available for everyone to browse through.
‘By learning from the crystallization of wisdom and experience of others, this would widen my path of cultivation.’ Xue Ying did not mind learning from others. By doing so, it would broaden his perspective. Just like how his talent on the Dao of Void initially could not compare to the ‘Dao of Mirage illusory realm’, after learning from the inheritances by Void Primogenitor, Monarch Nine Cloud, and comprehending the scaled armor left behind by General Mo Gu that contained the ‘shadowless talent’, coupled with observing the Lost World Corridor for a trillion years… Xue Ying’s attainment in the Dao of Void continually rose. It had even surpassed his comprehensions on the Dao of Slaughter and Dao of Ripple.
And in this life.
He joined the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion which specialized in the void aspect. The religion even had the “Avatar Technique”, “Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique”, and “Void-ification Undying Technique”.
Maybe his attainments on the void in this life might be higher than the Mirage and illusory realm. That was entirely possible!
Cultivating with reference from many seniors versus slowly cultivating alone was very different.
‘So many books.’
Xue Ying first spent a total of two days sweeping through all the books.
His accomplishments in the void aspect were originally high so few could catch his notice-only a total of 195 books on the void element! As for books written by other seniors regarding the tricks to cultivating the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”, Xue Ying disdained from reading those since few of those seniors had reached the tenth level power at Primal Chaos realm.
Xue Ying naturally wasn’t willing to waste too much of his time.
‘195 books.’ Xue Ying softly nodded. More than 30 of these 195 books were written personally by ‘Southern Cloud King’ himself! Others were either books that were written directly to the Cosmos God realm or they were some ancient and queer books.
‘There are actually good books on the Mirage and illusory realm too.’ Xue Ying felt pleasant.
There were even fewer books that were noticed by Xue Ying on the Mirage and illusory realm aspect. Primarily it was because there were not too many books on this aspect across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Hence, fewer existed in the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion. Only a total of 18 books were noticed by Xue Ying! And only two books could be cultivated to the Cosmos God realm. And there were no books at all that gave one the ability to exhibit a tenth level strength at the Primal Chaos realm.
This was normal too. Exhibiting strength at the tenth level was equivalent to having the ability to fight against Cosmos Gods. It was absolutely not a technique that a sect would easily publicize.
Like the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, only after becoming an inner disciple could he learn it. Otherwise, non-inner disciples would have to fork out a huge price.
‘This is enough.’
‘This is sufficient.’ Xue Ying felt contended. These 18 books on the Mirage and illusory realm had significantly opened his eyes. He was ultimately a great expert in the Mirage and illusory realm, and someone who created a ninth level move at the Primal Chaos realm.
‘These books all represent different cultivation directions. They have greatly improved my confidence in breaking through to the Cosmos God realm.’
Joining the religion?
He did not care about treasures! Neither did Xue Ying care about the backings!
Instead, what he paid greater importance to was the absolute art scriptures left behind by many experts across the generations in the Realm Heart Great Land. As the saying went, ‘Dao isn’t easily imparted to others’. It wasn’t easy for Southern Cloud King with his strength to collect so many books either. And it was impossible for a cultivator to access these books if he was not willing to join the religion altogether. Furthermore, it was impossible for the Southern Cloud King to accept cultivators without the required strength or talent either.
******
After obtaining these books, Xue Ying first memorized them.
Only after that did he continue cultivating with a low profile within the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion. He would occasionally flip through different books to broaden his perspective. Over time, it had been three million years after Xue Ying joined the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.
In a desert.
A white-robed young figure was flying through the sky. He was killing his way towards the nine armored soldiers ahead. These armored soldiers had different weapons-some were holding on to a saber, some were holding on to a shield, and some to bow and arrows…
“Hu.”
That white-robed young man flashed. Many figures appeared in the surrounding. It was as if eight to nine figures had appeared within an instant.
His speed was so fast, and his movement was unpredictable. Discerning the real from the fake was hard.
“Pu.”
Xue Ying pointed his finger to the back of one soldier. “Peng”, the back of that soldier immediately exploded, leaving a huge hole behind and causing fresh blood to spurt. That soldier rapidly reacted, turning back and hacking down his ax. Nevertheless, Xue Ying was no longer there. Ten strange figures appeared at different places charged towards that soldier holding on to a shield next.
…
By relying on this frightening body cultivation technique, Xue Ying easily trampled on these soldiers. Just a few moments later, those nine armored soldiers were utterly spent. They dissipated from the scene.
“I’ve succeeded.”
Xue Ying revealed a grin. Pagoda-Shaped stairs appeared to the distance that led to the higher seventh level of the God Yuan Palace.
Xue Ying naturally ‘lost’ this level.
“What?”
“This Ying Shan Xue Ying has just entered the sacred religion not too long ago, yet he has succeeded in crossing through the God Yuan Palace sixth level?”
“So fast?”
Many elders within the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion received the news. They felt bewildered. It was normal for cultivators to break through rapidly after entering the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion. But after considering the age of Xue Ying, things felt quite exaggerated-he cultivated for just five million years!
“Did he enter the ‘Time-Space Realm’ to cultivate? He might have cultivated for hundred to a thousand times the period over these three million years.”
“He didn’t.”
“He did not enter a time-accelerated environment. Judging from the aura of his soul, he seems to be slightly older than five million years.”
“I’ve asked the array spirit before. Other than cultivating in his own cavern-dwelling, Ying Shan Xue Ying has practically spent other time reading in the Book Repository Realm. He hasn’t entered a time-accelerated environment.”
“Reading books? Oh, that’s right too. The Book Repository Realm contains many books. There are also many books left behind by the seniors regarding their experience in cultivating the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”. This fellow Ying Shan Xue Ying should not have a teacher before. He should have been cultivating by himself in that tiny area Ardent Fire City. Now that he has read through so many books, acquiring the experience of the seniors, he should have gained some enlightenment, directly jumping to the God Yuan Palace sixth level strength. That is normal too.”
“Mn, it should be like this.”
The elders were discussing this matter.
Even though they understood it was normal for a genius who had never been adequately guided before to break through at a rapid pace after acquiring the experience and guidance of the seniors, it was still quite horrifying since the other party had merely cultivated for five million years.
…
Southern Cloud Capital.
Within an extremely luxurious residence, there was a bamboo house surrounded by flowing water. A beautiful violet-robed girl sat cross-legged within this house. Her robe was long and had practically occupied half the entire surface of the bamboo house.
She was currently holding on to a needle doing embroidery.
“Master.” A male respectfully reported from outside the bamboo curtain, “A piece of news has come from the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.”
“What’s the matter?” This girl indifferently responded. There was no voice coming from her. It directly permeated into the other party’s soul.
The male could not help but feel his heart tightening. He understood how frightening his mater was, and immediately answered with respect: “The newest inner disciple from the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying’, has just gotten through the God Yuan Palace sixth level. He has cultivated only for 5.5 million years.”
“Oh? Send an invitation to my banquet over to him.” The girl’s voice contained a strand of delight.

chapters.title: Chapter 1026 - Qian Yi Clan and Fan Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 1026: Qian Yi Clan and Fan Clan
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Master, he is called Ying Shan Xue Ying, and is a disciple from the Southern Cloud Nation, Ying Shan Clan.” The male kneeling outside reminded, “Old Mother Ying Shan is an enemy of our Qian Yi Clan.”
“Hmph, my Qian Yi Clan has never placed that Old Mother Ying Shan in our eyes before. It is merely Old Mother Ying Shan who keeps holding on to the vengeance.” That violet-robed girl within the bamboo house sneered, “There is no need to bother about that old granny. Just send my invitation to that Ying Shan Xue Ying. As for whether he wants to come or not? That is none of my business.”
“Yes.” The male respectfully acknowledged.
…
Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, Xue Ying was currently seated cross-legged before his own cavern-dwelling. He sat on a mountain peak beside the coast breathing in the beautiful breeze of the world. He was presently focusing on deducing his own cultivation technique.
There was no other way.
He did not dare to try out moves that were too profound within the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion. One must know that he had finished training the first ten styles of the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”, leaving just the final two styles left incomplete. He was trying to grasp those two final styles currently, and the moment he attempted to practice those moves, Xue Ying was sure it would be perceived by the array spirit established by the Southern Cloud King!
Both the Southern Cloud Capital and the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion were essential to the king. It was the territory where he spent a long time building.
This place had stringent security. No holes in it would be left open.
Even the cultivation rooms of disciples were monitored by the array spirit. The moment any ‘holes’ were left open, enemies would definitely make use of them and utilize it to assault the entire Southern Cloud Capital. Given how formidable the Southern Cloud King was, it was impossible for him to leave behind such gaps. One must know that the Great Void Heaven Temple had no place left unmonitored too!
Under normal circumstances, when disciples cultivated within their cultivation room, the Southern Cloud King would not care.
Unless unforeseen circumstances happened!
A young fellow of just five million years old could actually start practicing a technique at the God Yuan Palace ninth level? That was too strange! His actions would definitely be reported upwards by the array spirit.
‘With the status of Southern Cloud King, he should know that there are outsiders who reincarnated into this origin world right?’ Xue Ying thought, ‘I wonder what attitude the king has.’
Was it goodwill?
Or malicious intention?
And whether the number one expert of the primal chaos void, ‘Sacred Master’ had relations with the Realm Heart Great Land?
Currently, Xue Ying’s status had not reached that level yet. He knew too little, and hence, wasn’t willing to gamble! He dared not leave his fate in the hands of someone else. Thus, the most rational decision would be to act as if he was a real talent! Xue Ying would grow according to the category of era geniuses within the Realm Heart Great Land.
He would not be considered as the most talented one in the six great ancient nations, but it was okay if he was the most talented cultivator within the Southern Cloud Nation!
‘I’ve learned quite a few precious techniques within the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, which means I could simply return back to Ardent Fire City now.’ Xue Ying thought. The tiny area, Ardent Fire City, was a much safer place. The security measures there were not as strict as that within the Southern Cloud Capital! With his current realm, it was impossible for Marquis Ardent Fire to discover his secrets.
Only in the Ardent Fire City would it be most appropriate for him to cultivate all he wanted, and practice the powerful moves.
“Hu.”
A figure flew over from the distant.
‘He is here.’ Xue Ying felt a jolt of joy in his heart.
He was not in a rush to leave after learning all the techniques precisely because he was waiting for this day!
“Junior Disciple Brother Xue Ying.” A black-robed male smiled from outside, “I am Tian Chun Xue, a disciple who joined the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion earlier than you did.”
“Senior Disciple Brother Tian.” Xue Ying greeted.
“I came according to my master’s order to invite junior disciple brother over for a banquet.” The black-robed male waved his hand. A dull violet invitation letter flew over.
Xue Ying received it. The moment he saw the two words ‘Qian Yi’, he frowned. After that, his expression became much colder. He flipped through the invitation letter, reading through the content before casually throwing back: “Bring it back with you.”
The black-robed male frowned: “Why? Are you thinking of not showing respect for my master?”
“That time, your Qian Yi Clan has schemed against my Old Ancestor. Have you all forgotten it?” Xue Ying gave a cold snort.
“Good.”
The black-robed male snorted back before turning and left-rather hastily at that.
Xue Ying silently watched on.
Actually, he stayed in the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion precisely because he was waiting for someone. But that person was not from the Qian Yi Clan.
Within the Southern Cloud Capital, three organizations existed that loved befriending experts. One was in the faction under the crown prince! The crown prince was a child that the Southern Cloud King had when he was weak. Even though his talent was slightly weaker, the Southern Cloud King pampered him a lot. This instead resulted in a bossy temperament which the crown prince had! He was someone who exceptionally liked befriending experts from all over the place.
But his scope of view was slightly higher-he would only invite those who were at least at the Primal Chaos realm! And only those who were powerful or had a huge background. He would disdain those who were weaker on either.
Xue Ying came from the Ying Shan Clan and was only a Unity realm expert. It was likely that he would not fall into the scope of view of that bossy ‘crown prince’.
As for the other two organizations that loved befriending experts, both came from the six great ancient nations.
One was Qian Yi Clan from the Moonflower Ancient Nation. The Moonflower Ancient Nation was practically at the bottom amongst the six great ancient nations and was comparable to the Towering Sky Ancient Nation! Nevertheless, it was different from the low-profile Towering Sky Ancient Nation that always remained in hibernation. The Moonflower Ancient Nation focused more on transacting businesses. One could find experts from this nation practically across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. They permeated into various places in search of many ancient remnants left behind by powerful experts; they sought for treasures, absolute arts, and others.
The Qian Yi Clan was a colossal clan with a total of eight Cosmos Gods backing it!
‘Qian Yi Xiao’ was the chief manager of the Qian Yi Clan situated in the Southern Cloud Nation. She was a huge expert at the ninth level and liked befriending with everyone. At the same time, she was increasing the influencing power of the Moonflower Ancient Nation within the Southern Cloud Nation subtly.
It’s a pity…
The Qian Yi Clan had schemed against Old Mother Ying Shan during an adventure to an ancient remnant for the sake of treasures. With the violent temper which Old Mother Ying Shan had, both parties fiercely fought with each other. Nevertheless, the Moonflower Ancient Nation was ultimately one of the six great ancient nations-they surpassed the Southern Cloud Nation in power. A Qian Yi Clan alone had a total of eight Cosmos Gods, of which the Southern Cloud King intervened in the end. Old Mother Ying Shan could only bear this loss she suffered.
‘She is here.’
Xue Ying saw a female figure flying over from afar.
That was a girl garbed in a light blue gown. As she flew over, she smiled: “Junior Disciple Brother Xue Ying, I am Fan Fei Qi and is your Senior Disciple Sister! I came here under orders from my elder brother to invite you over for a banquet.” Saying that a black-gold invitation letter flew over.
Xue Ying received it.
The letter had a single character-’Fan’-on it.
Fan Clan…
That was the clan he wanted to meet!
Other than the faction under the crown prince, ‘Qian Yi Xiao’ from the Qian Yi Clan of Moonflower Ancient Nation, the other organization was led by ‘Fan Tian Chong’, also from the Fan Clan of Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
The crown prince was slightly more domineering. He did things primarily for his reputation and would take rash actions.
Only Qian Yi Xiao and Fan Tian Chong were genuinely befriending all experts with potential. Xue Ying had reached the God Yuan Palace sixth level within five million years. He was clearly spotted by both and were recognized as a huge and upcoming character within the Southern Cloud Nation.
‘Fan Tian Chong.’ Xue Ying thought.
Fan Tian Chong, being the chief manager of the Fan Clan branch in the Southern Cloud Nation, as long as he befriended the other party, by then, it was possible for him to show the spearhead to Xue Ying. It was merely a look, and Xue Ying believed Fan Tian Chong would not reject.
‘I’ve stayed in the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion until now all for the sake of thoroughly looking at that spearhead and view its profound mysteries.’ Xue Ying thought. Even though he had would only be looking through it once, he would remember most of the profound mysteries inherent. Xue Ying was confident of comprehending more of the Dao of Void according to the profound mysteries in the complete spear belonging to ‘Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master’. Even though Xue Ying had comprehended just part of it, he was confident that the complete absolute art was not any weaker than the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”.
Of course, the Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles was easier to learn since it was a complete absolute art.
The difficulty of learning the profound mysteries within the spear would likely be ten to a hundred times harder. It required him to ponder over it carefully. But with his foundation, Xue Ying was still confident of doing so. Furthermore, by relying on this spear, he would be able to unleash a stronger power!
“Alright. I’ll definitely attend the banquet tonight.” Xue Ying smiled.
“Junior Disciple Brother Xue Ying, I’ll come and pick you up tonight then.” The light-blue-gowned girl, Fan Fei Qi giggled. She had a relatively good impression of this young man in front of her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1027 - Banquet
chapters.content:
Chapter 1027: Banquet
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Night had descended.
On the carriage, Fan Fei Qi and Xue Ying were both seated next to each other. Other protectors and servants stood by the side. Xue Ying merely brought Magic Servant Zi Bai with him.
“Junior Disciple Brother Xue Ying, we have arrived.” Fan Fei Qi pointed ahead.
‘The Fan Clan is indeed powerful.’ Xue Ying looked afar. The mansion in the distance was huge and spanned across the horizon, ‘The official residence of the Fan Clan in the Southern Cloud Nation is even bigger than the Ardent Fire Marquisdom.’
The Fan Clan was one of the three great clans from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
The two other great clans from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation were more aloof. They disdained other nations, and were not willing to set up branches in other countries! Only the ‘Fan Clan’ crazily permeated its web of power across every single part of the Realm Heart Great Land.
In reality, the ultra-huge clans that could rank in the top ten within the Realm Heart Great Land were all filled with pride and arrogance. That was normal. After all, they were all too powerful and were disdainful of befriending some small little nations! In their opinions, they would instead focus their attention on meditating and cultivation to become even more powerful!
There were very few ultra-huge clans that would be so crazy in permeating their forces throughout the origin world.
‘A clan with the power to suppress the Towering Sky Ancient Nation. If they are willing, they could easily annihilate the entire Southern Cloud Nation. Most likely only the king could escape.’ Xue Ying muttered inwardly.
The Fan Clan…
Was too powerful. He had read through many different books in the Book Repository Realm within the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, and understood quite a lot on the ‘Fan Clan’.
The Fan Clan represented ‘tyranny’, ‘savage’, ‘ruthless’, and ‘slaughter’. It was the only great clan out of the three within the Summer Wind Ancient Nation that liked waging war outside the nation. Even Southern Cloud King who was an absolute hero of the era had to smile and welcome the Fan Clan politely.
Many genius talents were willing to join the Fan Clan and become their honored guests. They would thus be loyal and fight for the Fan Clan!
…
Within the towering and luxurious palace hall.
It was already filled with many cultivators. They were scattered around talking to each other. A tall and plump male sat on the head position.
“Big Brother Tian Chong.” Fan Fei Qi loudly shouted the moment she entered, “My Junior Disciple Brother Xue Ying has arrived.”
Fan Tian Chong sat there smiling at Xue Ying. He said with a loud voice and a smile: “Prince Xue Ying, I’ve long heard of an era transcendent emerging from the Southern Cloud Nation. If you respect me, you can just call me Big Brother Tian Chong. That’ll be fine. Come! Hurry up and go to your seat. In a while, the ‘Flying Lip Beast Banquet’ will start. The meat from the Flying Lip Beast will be eaten as it is made. The moment we delay a little, its taste would deteriorate.”
“Many thanks, Big Brother Tian Chong.” Xue Ying bowed humbly.
Since the other party was polite, Xue Ying would not hesitate to reciprocate.
He was clear…
Fan Tian Chong was the chief manager of the Fan Clan’s branch in Southern Cloud Nation. Being the highest commander here, he had reached the Primal Chaos tenth level power, and could fight against Cosmos Gods! More importantly, he could mobilize a vast power belonging to the Fan Clan. If one said that the ‘Southern Cloud King’ was unquestionably the strongest power in the Southern Cloud Nation, the Fan Clan would be ranked second.
Fan Tian Chong was vaguely known to be the second person in power within the entire Southern Cloud Nation.
‘Fan Tian Chong cultivates the “Sky-Rending Great Magic Sutra” which is kept confidential within the Fan Clan. He has endless power, and his body is so strong that it matches a secret treasure weapon.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly. According to the intelligence which he gathered, the fleshy body of Fan Tian Chong was one level higher than that of reaching the tenth level great perfection in “Southern Cloud Sacred Body”. It’s a pity this “Sky-Rending Great Magic Sutra” was kept confidential within the Fan Clan out of reach from the public.
‘He is powerful, and according to rumors, he is the favorite disciple of ‘Sky-Rending Great Paragon’. That was why he could take charge of a slightly more important country like the Southern Cloud Nation.’ Xue Ying thought.
“Haha…”
The hall was filled with loud and bright touches of laughter. Those who participated in the banquet were chatting with each other.
“That is also because of that old fool from the Snow Hook Nation. He relied on the fact that he was a Cosmos God, and thus underestimated me who is a Primal Chaos giant. He actually fought against me head-on, and that was why I could smash him into heavy injuries.” Fan Tian Chong laughed, “It’s a pity that he escaped pretty quick. Otherwise, I might just smash him to death.”
“He is indeed foolish to dare fight against Big Brother Tian Chong. He could blame no one but himself.”
“So what if he is a Cosmos God? Isn’t it the same that he was forced into escape after being beaten by Big Brother Tian Chong?”
“That madman from the Snow Hook Nation is also seeking for death. He only knows how to disrupt our affair.”
There was quite a few cultivators present that liked boasting.
Fan Tian Chong sneered: “Snow Hook Nation? Of the Black Devil Four Nations, the Snow Hook Nation always overestimates their capabilities. They keep going against my Summer Wind Ancient Nation and set themselves against my Fan Clan! Hmph, there would be one day when we give them a severe lesson.”
“Eh.”
Fan Tian Chong suddenly revealed a grin. He looked towards the distance.
An enormous cooking cauldron was being carried out currently. Within this cooking cauldron, there was a mutated beast within that was about to be cooked. The main chef himself was cutting the meat and was sending out several other accompanying beverages together with it.
“Quickly come and have a taste. Prince Xue Ying, this is your first time coming to my place. This Flying Lip Beast is what I liked to eat the most. It’s a pity that capturing it is too hard.” Fan Tian Chong grinned, “Almost half the Flying Lip Beasts discovered in the Black Devil Four Nations had landed up over here with me, but I can only occasionally enjoy it.”
Saying that Fan Tian Chong waved his hand, sending the first plate of Flying Lip Beast meat that was cut over to where Xue Ying was.
Even though there were quite a few guests present here today, this banquet had been prepared primarily to welcome Xue Ying! As this was Xue Ying’s first time here, even though Fan Tian Chong had the highest status, he remained delighted in befriending those with potential. In his opinion, it should be fine for Xue Ying to reach the ninth level with his potential.
As for the tenth level?
That was too difficult to say! Just speaking from the difficulty of cultivation alone, it was similar to creating a ninth level move at the Primal Chaos realm by the cultivator himself. Furthermore, it had to be accompanied by some secret technique and a secret treasure accompanying this technique, before one could unleash a tenth level power.
“Many thanks, Big Brother Tian Chong.” Xue Ying received the plate.
The banquet proceeded.
There were also music and performances by the side. As everyone chatted, Fan Tian Chong would also occasionally speak with Xue Ying.
“Prince Xue Ying, I’ve heard that you have already reached the God Yuan Palace sixth level strength. I am also at the God Yuan Palace sixth level strength. How do you think of exchanging moves with me?” A teenaged protector standing beside a guest announced.
“How audacious! Do you think this is a place for you to shout?” That guest who sat there enjoying the Flying Lip Beast meat turned sullen at that instant as he roared.
Fan Tian Chong merely laughed: “Brother Pang Bo, today is a happy day, and it is always exciting to have some fights. It is now whether Prince Xue Ying is interested in it or not?”
Xue Ying understood as he listened.
This challenge should be arranged by Fan Tian Chong. He wanted to understand if Xue Ying’s strength was real or fake.
“Those who dare to challenge others here should have the power to hold his words up. But still, it will only make things interesting to fight in front of the fellow cultivators here.” Xue Ying stood and said with a smile. Magic Servant Zi Bai transmitted by his side: “Prince, I’ve observed that cultivator. He should specialize in the blade technique. Blade techniques are usually savage and ruthless, so prince must remember to be careful.”
Xue Ying merely smiled.
His eye of discerning was so much more profound than Magic Servant Zi Bai. With a step, he arrived at the center of the hall.
“Good.” Fan Tian Chong and others roared in excitement as they spectated from the side.
“Prince Xue Ying, you must be careful.” That teenaged protector also took a step to reach the center of the hall enthusiastically. He stood facing Xue Ying.
“Go on and make your move.” Xue Ying announced.
“Aren’t you using a weapon?” The teenaged protector asked.
“I temporarily do not plan on using one. But if you are able to force me to use my weapon, I’ll naturally use it.” Xue Ying said.
“Good.”
The pupils of the teenaged protector dilated. He was actually a named disciple under the honored guest of Fan Clan, ‘Pang Bo’. As his strength was apt, Pang Bo had chosen him to challenge Prince Xue Ying this time.
This was also a rare chance for him to display his power in front of the Fan Clan who was part of the higher society within the Southern Cloud.
“Receive my move.” The teenaged protector shouted.
“Xiu.”
His figure flashed. He formed a blood afterimage as he leaped towards Xue Ying. Within that blood afterimage, a blood-colored blade light could be seen.
“Brother Pang Bo, this young fellow has cultivated to quite an amazing stage in your Blood Shadow Blade.”
“Slightly interesting.”
The guests present chatted and praised.
“Peng.”
Xue Ying remained standing at his original position. He extended his finger and tapped out in space. That blade light immediately froze. Xue Ying’s finger had coincidentally tapped on the sharpest point of the blade, and also the convergence of all the force. “Hong~” A ringing sound could be heard as the blade was forced to vibrate. In the end, that teenaged protector flew back from the impact out of his control.
‘How can this be? How could he coincidentally tap at the strongest point in my shadow blade technique?’ The teenaged protector felt startled in his heart, ‘Impossible. It must be luck.’
The shadow blade was known for being unpredictable. Being an expert at the God Yuan Palace sixth level, he did not dare believe that his opponent could easily break apart the illusion of his blade technique.
“Hu.”
The teenaged protector once again charged forward after forming images. This time, his figure moved in an even more unpredictable motion, and the blade light let out a greater whistling sound. It drove like a wave, and many blade lights came continuously-it felt illusory.
Xue Ying remained at his original position. When the blade light converged on him, he merely tapped out with a finger yet again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1028 - Body Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 1028: Body Technique
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As his fingertip pointed on the sharpest point of the blade, everything seemed to freeze. The point where Xue Ying tapped on shattered apart! This power from the void exploding forced that teenaged protector to fly backward.
For the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion to rely on “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” to become famous across the Realm Heart Great Land and become one of the top ten great religions, this absolute art was naturally powerful.
‘How? How could it be?” His move seems so simple and straightforward, yet it easily broke apart my shadow blade?’ That teenaged protector did not dare believe it as he continued flying forward. Nevertheless, Xue Ying merely tapped out with his fingertip time after time. No matter how the other party attacked, he would be forced back by Xue Ying. This continued for a total of nine times.
“This Prince Xue Ying is indeed formidable. He has reached the God Yuan Palace sixth level in his realm genuinely without relying on the “Southern Cloud Sacred Body”.”
“Yes, it seems his control of the void is amazing. He can easily break apart the shadow blade technique.”
“He is more powerful than expected.”
Everyone continued chatting through voice transmissions.
This banquet was held for the sake of Xue Ying. It was also organized for others to determine the potential of this Prince Xue Ying.
There were two ways of using the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”. One was relying purely on the realm. Even without cultivating the sacred body, the cultivator could still unleash a powerful move! The other relied entirely on the sacred body as a result of a weaker realm.
For instance, a Unity realm eighth level move.
In theory, a Unity expert could only exert seventh level force and comparable with a Primal Chaos expert!
But by relying on the ‘”Southern Cloud Sacred Body” that reached the eighth level’, it would be much easier to unleash techniques at that level-one merely had to comprehend a small section of it!
Similar logic!
To wield a force at the tenth level, one had to rely on the tenth level grand perfection “Southern Cloud Sacred Body”. It was impossible to reach this strength just by relying on the realm solely. Because a technique with a tenth level force contained the profound mysteries at the level of Cosmos God. But by relying on the tenth level grand perfection “Southern Cloud Sacred Body”, it would be much easier to utilize moves at the tenth level-one just had to comprehend part of the profound mysteries.
Both “Southern Cloud Sacred Body” and the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” supported each other. A different body cultivation technique would be useless towards enhancing the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”.
…
“Just these few techniques? You should receive some moves of mine too.” Xue Ying announced with a smile. He finally began killing his way over.
He deliberately broke apart the techniques of the other party nine times to show his capabilities to Fan Tian Chong and the others!
The real motive of him joining this banquet this time was all because of earning a chance to view that spearhead!
“Hu.”
Xue Ying’s figure suddenly rushed out, yet it strangely turned into nine figures. All these figures charged out in different directions at the teenaged protector.
“What?” The teenaged protector was slightly panicking. In his perception, all nine figures were real.
In reality.
The nine figures were all real. Xue Ying’s speed was so fast that his ‘body’ had simultaneously cut the void nine times, and thus forming nine bodies.
Using his body to cut the void, that was using an offensive technique within the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” as a body technique.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying flitted past the teenaged protector. With a wave of his hand, all nine figures swept past and caused the body of the protector to be cut nine times. But closely following that, his body completely recovered.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying had already returned back to his original position. He then looked back at that teenaged protector.
That protector’s expression was slightly pale and red. The Fan Clan was originally a tyrannical and ruthless clan. His teacher, ‘Pang Bo’ relied on the Fan Clan and had followed the principle of the strong feasting on the weak even when guiding his disciples. The weak died, and the strong survived. This selection went on continuously. It was rare for him to get the chance to fight for some respect for his teacher, yet he lost so bitterly.
“Why aren’t you withdrawing!” Pang Bo roared out from the side.
“Yes.” The teenaged protector immediately retreated.
“This comprehension capability of yours is extraordinary, Prince Xue Ying.” Pang Bo praised, “You have not only perfectly utilized the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”, but you have also even deduced a body technique from the offensive technique of the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”. This has transcended beyond the absolute art. Truly a genius.”
Pang Bo felt appreciative of Xue Ying.
He had many disciples and had quite a few personal ones. But none of them had a comprehension ability comparable to this Prince Xue Ying.
It’s a pity…
That this Prince Xue Ying was too dazzling. He, Pang Bo, was just an honored guest and was not qualified to receive this genius as a disciple.
“For you to turn an offensive technique into a body technique. That is amazing indeed.” Fan Tian Chong praised him too.
“Beautiful.”
“Watching Prince Xue Ying reminds me of those days when I just cultivated for five million years. I still recalled that time, I was still an ordinary disciple in a little religion in Summer Wind Ancient Nation.” Many guests gave their praises too.
They understood.
That for Xue Ying to reach this realm in just five million years without being restricted by the original technique, and to procure the essence of the method and transform into a new technique himself, meant that he had a fantastic talent that dumbstruck all of them! As long as he did not fall, it was certain for Xue Ying to reach the ninth level in the future.
One had to know that the strongest amongst them-honored guests and guests, was only at the ninth level.
As for reaching the tenth level?
Fan Tian Chong would not randomly invite them over. He was after all holding this banquet just to welcome Xue Ying.
…
The banquet finally ended.
The guests started leaving one by one. Fan Tian Chong and Fan Fei Qi personally went to send Xue Ying off.
“Prince Xue Ying, if you have any matter in the future, you can come and find me. No matter if it is within the Southern Cloud Nation or other nations, there are few matters which my Fan Clan cannot resolve.” Fan Tian Chong smiled.
“Big Brother Tian Chong.” Xue Ying immediately started, “Talking about that, I do have a matter which I would like to ask Big Brother Tian Chong for help.”
Fan Fei Qi was startled from the side.
Fan Tian Chong was also slightly stunned.
He had just finished telling the other party that ‘he could come and find me in the future’, yet this Prince Xue Ying immediately requested him the next moment. It was honestly ‘thick-skinned’. One had to know that even when the Fan Clan went to conduct something, they had to fork out an equivalent price too.
“You say.” Fan Tian Chong continued maintaining his smile.
Even though he felt displeased in his heart, it was because Prince Xue Ying was too young.
“I feel kind of shameful to ask this.” Xue Ying said, “That time, I actually saw a spearhead in one of the shops within Southern Cloud Capital that are owned by the Fan Clan. I heard that it was a spearhead left behind by Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master. That spear seems to be a void-related secret treasure, which garnered my interest. That time, I wanted to personally have a more thorough look, yet it was a pity that the manager did not allow me to have a look. That was why I had to shamelessly ask Big Brother Tian Chong for help. Is it possible for me to have a closer look at that spearhead?”
“Just this matter?” Fan Tian Chong began laughing involuntarily.
He thought the other party wanted to ask for something huge.
But it was merely getting a closer look at a secret treasure that was sold in a shop owned by his clan? He knew of that spearhead too. Even though it was formidable, the spearhead was incomplete and could not be sold at a high price. The bottom limit of the clan was just 300 million cosmos crystals.
“Haha, why the need to ask me about such a small matter.” Fan Tian Chong felt that this Prince Xue Ying was slightly cute. He was ‘shamelessly asking him’ about such a small matter.
“You are currently a good friend of I, Fan Tian Chong. From now on, you will be a VIP in all the shops owned by my Fan Clan. It is fine for you to have a look even at that Cloud Great Hammer which is ten times more expensive.” Fan Tian Chong said, “Just go over and take a look. That manager will not dare to hinder you.”
Xue Ying felt his heart relaxing.
He was not interested in the Shop Protection Treasure at all! He desired that spearhead the most. Even though he could not afford it, he would not be so foolish to beg the other party for it. Even though Fan Tian Chong paid importance to him, a treasure worth a few hundred million cosmos crystals would only be given to him if he sold himself to the Fan Clan.
Even though he could not afford it now, it was okay to just comprehend the profound mysteries in the spearhead.
“Many thanks, Big Brother Tian Chong. I’ll go over at this moment.” Xue Ying felt slightly impatient.
“You ah, you ah, hahaha, just go.” Fan Tian Chong laughed. This Prince Xue Ying was truly interesting.

chapters.title: Chapter 1029 - Returning to Ardent Fire City
chapters.content:
Chapter 1029: Returning to Ardent Fire City
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
An hour later.
Xue Ying had already brought Magic Servant Zi Bai to the Fan Clan shop. Even though it was late at night, the entire Treasured Goods Market was still bright and bustling with activity.
“Prince Xue Ying, my clan master has already given orders for me to wait for you.” There was already a plump old man standing outside by the door of the Fan Clan shop. He welcomed Xue Ying with a smile. If this was a cultivator at similar power, he would definitely pay greater regard to his reputation, and would definitely not be waiting outside the shop so enthusiastically for a Unity realm genius.
But this plump old man was a magic servant and had to completely follow the orders of his master.
“I apologize for the trouble, manager.” Xue Ying mentioned.
“Prince Xue Ying, this way please.” The plump old man enthusiastically guided the way. The party soon arrived on the third floor. Currently, since it was late at night, there were not many guests in the shop. The third floor was empty without a single soul on it.
Xue Ying did not waste time. He directly walked to that spearhead. This spearhead was floating in midair, and it was emitting spatial fluctuations that caused space to fold. Many levels of forbidding arrays wrapped around this spearhead like how a shell would wrap around the yolk.
“Please wait a moment.”
The plump old man said. He then began controlling the array. One could see the layers of forbidding array expanding to a size just enough to wrap around Xue Ying within. A breath later, the layers of egg-shell-like forbidding array expanded a to a few meters long with Xue Ying situated entirely inside.
“Prince Xue Ying, you may proceed now.” The plump old man smiled.
“Many thanks.”
Xue Ying thanked the old man before turning back to the floating spearhead in front. The original owner of this spearhead, the ‘Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master’ had already fallen during the first War of the Ancient Nations. In other words, the existence of this spear had been there even longer than the six great ancient nations! It was hard to find out if there were any more stories behind this spear that made it break into two.
“Chi chi chi”, the spearhead was always causing the surrounding space to fold. Many spatial fluctuations could be seen with the naked eyes.
Xue Ying then extended his hand onto this spearhead.
The spearhead felt cold. It was vaguely giving off an endless sharpness that felt like tearing his hand apart. But Xue Ying had ultimately cultivated the “Southern Cloud Sacred Body” to the sixth level. How could he be injured by this incomplete weapon? Much less Xue Ying had a formidable control of the void.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying closed his eyes. He sent his consciousness in.
“Hong!”
There was a wave of ringing in his mind. Xue Ying could clearly perceive the elaborate and dark, unpredictable maelstrom stairways rapidly converging at its core. That time when Xue Ying was merely comprehending the spear body, he was looking at it with blurred vision! Currently, after scrutinizing at the spearhead, he discovered that the elaborate maelstrom stairway could be divided into three sections. The three parts eventually converged into a single point.
That point was the final limit of the maelstrom stairway, and it seemed to be a new beginning!
Xue Ying could sense that after the final point of convergence, things would soon explode! The spearhead’s tip was currently not being controlled by an owner; nobody was activating the mystical imprints on it, yet it could cause the void to fold and produce many fluctuations. Clearly, this final convergence point contained a horrifying destructive power on the void.
‘If I fuse it with the mystical imprints on the spear body…’
Xue Ying was rapidly deducing it in his mind.
He was currently piecing both the mystical imprints he discovered on the spear body with what he now found out.
And it came out as the complete secret treasure mystical imprint.
‘I am the core, and also the origin of space! Everything will be controlled by me.’
‘A spear piercing out onto a single point of convergence will produce a power that I dare not imagine.’
The more Xue Ying deduced, the more he felt how vast and unfathomable the imprint was.
With his current realm, he could deduce that the imprints should have incorporated two great moves. One was turning the self into the origin of space and relying on it to control the surrounding void. This was a domain technique. The other method was to converge within a chaotic space. When the convergence reached its primal point, it would produce a destructive power that Xue Ying did not dare imagine.
Even though he had obtained the complete version of “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” currently which contained two imparted techniques at the tenth level power.
These two techniques that were imparted privately…
In terms of the realm, they were far weaker than the tyrannical concept within the spear. Even though Xue Ying had not grasped the concept, his current realm had reached quite a high level, and for the latter to give off a threatening suppressive sensation was something he could reason from.
‘Amazing.’
‘The mystical imprints within the spear aren’t merely at the tenth level of Primal Chaos realm. They should be higher.’ Xue Ying understood this point. The Fan Clan’s Great Paragon Lu Tian had even admitted that this Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master wasn’t any weaker than him. One could see how extraordinary it was.
Great Paragon Lu Tian…
Xue Ying was clear that this was an existence ranked at the front amidst the Cosmos Gods in the Fan Clan.
‘Remember it.’
‘I must try my best to remember this concept.’ Xue Ying began memorizing it.
Nevertheless, the mystical imprints within this spearhead were too complicated and profound. After all, how could this weapon that Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master used to move unhindered in the Realm Heart Great Land be something Xue Ying at his current ninth level comprehend?
He could barely remember part of the profound mysteries.
Only by diligently pondering and understanding a little more could he memorize the more profound mysteries.
…
The plump old man stood by the side waiting exceptionally patiently. It was just over time, other guests came to visit the third floor, which the stout old man had to go and receive them.
‘It has been four hours, yet he is still looking at it?’ The plump old male felt puzzled. He looked at the white-robed young man grabbing the spearhead, ‘This Prince Xue Ying likes that incomplete secret treasure so much that he is holding it for so long? Even so, what can he see from it?’
Comprehending the secret treasure and understanding the absolute art from therein?
The plump old male did not care about that before because comprehending the absolute art within the secret treasure was a task ten to a hundred times harder than learning from absolute art scriptures! Furthermore, it required the cultivator to comprehend in periods of hundreds of million years. So what if the other party scrutinized the weapon for a day within the shop? It was impossible for the other party to memorize the mystical imprints; he could barely learn part of it.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying finally opened his eyes. His eyes were filled with a strand of regret as he placed down the spearhead unwillingly.
“Many thanks, manager.” Xue Ying let go of the spearhead, causing it to regain its state of floating.
“Haha, this is just a minor matter.” The plump old male immediately controlled the layers of forbidding arrays, bringing it back to its original size in a few breaths of time.
Xue Ying glanced at that spearhead.
The domain technique could be comprehended by relying on the spear body. This time, he had even seen through the complete imprint. Xue Ying believed that it wasn’t hard creating a domain technique at the eighth level himself. By relying on the spear body, he could even reach the ninth level.
But offense wise?
Xue Ying understood that the offense of this spear went in a different direction from what the “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles” had. Furthermore, its offensive strength was genuinely frightening.
It’s a pity that he merely had a spear body. Xue Ying could temporarily not memorize everything from the spearhead in this short fleeting period. It was not bad for him to comprehend a technique at the sixth or seventh level power.
‘No matter what, I’ve currently seen the complete mystical imprints of the spear. From now on, I should have a clearer direction of where I should comprehend.’ Xue Ying thought. For instance, he already had a vague concept of ’emitting self as the point of origin’ for the domain technique. If not for seeing the spearhead, Xue Ying would have to take an indeterminate time before he could reach that concept.
“Zi Bai, let us leave.” Xue Ying ordered.
“Yes, Prince.” Magic Servant Zi Bai glanced at the spear. He murmured inwardly-why did this prince of his like that incomplete secret treasure spearhead so much?
…
Early the next day.
Xue Ying brought Magic Servant Zi Bai, Tian Yi Zhi, his female attendant Yan Yu and others away from the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion and set off back to the Ardent Fire City!
The many absolute art scriptures he desired to acquire had been gotten. He even comprehended part of the imprints in the spearhead.
Since he could not use all his strength to practice his techniques, it would be better for him to return back to the Ardent Fire City!
‘The next time I come to the capital will be the day I buy that spearhead.’ Xue Ying thought. Whether it was for getting an appropriate secret treasure weapon or to comprehend the absolute art belonging to Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master, Xue Ying wanted that spearhead!

chapters.title: Chapter 1030 - Dong Bo Xue Ying’s shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 1030: Dong Bo Xue Ying’s shock
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Ardent Fire City. The Ardent Fire Marquisdom was crowded today. They had gotten news that Prince Xue Ying would be returning!
“Prince Xue Ying has already left from the teleportation array. He’ll be reaching the Marquisdom soon.”
The news passed really quickly.
By the entrance of the Marquisdom, all the elders had already arrived including Ying Shang Lie Hu and Rong Xing Lan. All of them were looking forward with excitement. Marquis Ardent Fire had even appeared personally by the entrance of the Marquisdom. As for other disciples within the Marquisdom, they were here even earlier-even ‘Ying Shan Zhong Fu’, the son of Chan Yu Yan Zhen, had come.
“Lie Hu, this son of yours is extraordinary. I’ve heard that he has already crossed through the God Yuan Palace sixth level. How long has he entered the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion for?”
“This comprehension ability and talent… he is really amazing. Truly astounding. In the future, he might even become a Conferred King. By then, our Ying Shan Clan would have two Conferred Kings.”
The elders who were usually haughty were currently conversing enthusiastically with Ying Shan Lie Hu.
Ying Shan Lie Hu merely grinned. He bit his lips.
Delightful! Exhilarating!
This feeling of being respected satisfied Ying Shan Lie Hu.
“He is back.”
The surrounding suddenly became quiet. Nobody dared to chat or make a din. They were watching as a handsome white-robed young man flew over with a black-robed male fanning himself. Tian Yi Zhi, the female attendant Yan Yu, two Black Stream Cloud Wolves, and other subordinates were also following closely behind them.
They had already heard of who that black-robed male fanning himself was-the famous ‘Senior Zi Bai’ that came from the ancestral family, also rumored to be a powerful Primal Chaos realm magic servant. His status was higher than the ordinary clan elders.
“He is indeed Prince Xue Ying to make a Primal Chaos Magic Servant be his protector.”
“When will it be that I can have one be my protector too? To be treated so grandly by everyone is something that I don’t mind dying for.”
All of them were watching with sheer envy.
…
When Xue Ying saw the crowd of people welcoming him by the entrance of the Marquisdom, he immediately rushed over and shouted: “Grandpa Marquis, mother, father.”
“Hahaha, Xue Ying, you have greatly boosted the reputation of our Ying Shan Clan. I have already gotten transmissions from quite a few friends of mine, telling me that you have already succeeded in crossing through the sixth level of God Yuan Palace!” Marquis Ardent Fire said with great gusto. He was delighted, “Those old friends of mine have mentioned that it is possible for you to become a Conferred King in the future with your comprehension abilities. But you must remember not to be complacent. After all, you haven’t reached the Primal Chaos realm now.”
“Xue Ying understands.” Xue Ying replied.
“Mn.” Marquis Ardent Fire nodded with a smile, “Let’s go! We have prepared a banquet within the Marquisdom to congratulate you in becoming an inner disciple as well as crossing through the sixth level. Talking about that, I aren’t even a disciple of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.”
There were very few official disciples of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.
Even fewer disciples came from within the nation.
Usually, they would either be some huge genius, or a Primal Chaos giant with a void lineage. Naturally, those powerful like ‘Old Mother Ying Shan’ had been invited over to become an elder of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion! As for Marquis Ardent Fire, with his power, he was not qualified to become an elder.
The Southern Cloud Sacred Religion… in reality, was also the nation protecting religion for the Southern Cloud Nation. With the three Cosmos Gods and many Conferred Kings, they were considered part of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.
******
While Xue Ying was participating in the Marquisdom’s celebratory banquet, within the Ying Shan ancestral family.
“Hu hu…”
The gale was blowing harshly.
On top of a snowy mountain peak.
Old Mother Ying Shan sat cross-legged on a huge stone. Her consciousness had fused in one entity with the whole Ying Shan Clan-her breaths were one with it. At this moment, the Ying Shan Clan was in her senses.
“Old Mother, Prince has returned to the Marquisdom. Yesterday night, he attended the banquet prepared by the Fan Clan’s ‘Fan Tian Chong’.” Magic Servant Zi Bai reported everything that happened recently.
“Tell me in detail, and I’ll listen to them.”
“Yes. During the banquet, there was a protector who challenged Prince…”
Old Mother Ying Shan was listening to Magic Servant Zi Bai’s report. Hearing how Xue Ying revealed Xue Ying’s great combat skills made her reveal a grin. Good! He did not rely on the Southern Cloud Sacred Body. Instead, his realm had reached a sufficient stage. Furthermore, he had adapted the Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles into his own body technique. This comprehension skill was really terrifying. But the more frightening it was, the happier Old Mother Ying Shan would be since he was a disciple from the Ying Shan Clan.
“My Ying Shan Clan has finally seen an absolute genius appearing.” Old Mother Ying Shan was ecstatic.
But what she did not know.
Was that in Xue Ying’s plan, he wanted to sculpt himself as the most exceptional talent across the entire Southern Cloud Nation. He had no choice. Xue Ying did not wish to restrain himself and not reveal his skills. But he had to take it easy as well-to remain weaker than the most heaven-defying talents in the six great ancient nations.
There were absolutely some geniuses who came from the six great ancient nations who seemed more exaggerated than Xue Ying. But Xue Ying suspected that those geniuses might be reincarnated. Hence, it was better for him to control himself slightly-it sufficed to be the top genius within Southern Cloud Nation.
“After the banquet, he asked Fan Tian Chong for help. He sought to see an incomplete secret treasure spearhead within the Fan Clan’s shop.” Magic Servant Zi Bai continued.
“An incomplete secret treasure spearhead?” Old Mother Ying Shan felt puzzled.
“Yes. The Prince likes that secret treasure spearhead a lot. When he first came to the Southern Cloud Nation, he fell in love with it! I’ve heard that the incomplete secret treasure was left behind by a powerful expert from before the first War of the Ancient Nations, ‘Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master’. That time, the Fan Clan’s shop manager did not permit Prince from scrutinizing that spearhead.”
“This time, Prince actually held onto the spearhead for four full hours before letting it go in the end. On the second day, he returned to the Ardent Fire City.”
Old Mother Ying Shan felt really puzzled now: “He likes that incomplete secret treasure that much?”
“Yes. When he was touring the Southern Cloud Nation Treasured Goods Market, Prince remained looking at that spearhead the longest! In my opinion, the reason why Prince participated in the Fan Clan’s banquet and defeated that protector while revealing his skills was all for the sake of gaining the favor of Fan Tian Chong. After that when Fan Tian Chong permitted Prince to look for him if Prince has any trouble, Prince immediately asked him for a favor to see that spearhead.” Magic Servant Zi Bai had always been following Xue Ying. Hence, he was able to observe the other party’s actions and behavior distinctly. He could sense that Xue Ying desired that incomplete secret treasure spearhead from deep his heart.
“Oh?” Old Mother Ying Shan was deep in thoughts.
…
Southern Cloud Capital, Treasured Goods Market, before the Fan Clan shop.
An old granny arrived.
“It is rare for Old Mother to come to our place.” That plump old male came out personally just to welcome her. There were differing levels in power between Conferred Kings, and Old Mother Ying Shan was clearly considered strong at her level.
“Mn.” Old Mother Ying Shan nodded. She directly entered the shop.
Very soon, they arrived at the third floor.
Old Mother Ying Shan arrived before that floating incomplete secret treasure spearhead. The past scenes were faintly flashing within her eyes. She saw how in the night before, that white-robed young man had held onto the spearhead for an extended period, causing the edge of Old Mother Ying Shan’s lip to show signs of a grin.
“This is the incomplete secret treasure left behind by Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master?” Old Mother Ying Shan said.
“Yes, Old Mother, Prince Xue Ying from your Ying Shan Clan has come and seen it before.” The plump old male chuckled.
“Price.” Old Mother Ying Shan said.
“500 million cosmos crystals.” The plump old male raised five fingers and grinned.
“The lowest price.” Old Mother Ying Shan said.
“Old Mother is a VIP of my Fan Clan, and my clan master has given orders before, so naturally I’ll not dare to bully Old Mother. The clan has given orders that the lowest price is 300 million cosmos crystals. It isn’t possible for me to go any longer than that.” The plump old male said.
Old Mother Ying Shan softly nodded.
She was clear.
Most of the secret treasures sold in the Fan Clan shop had a lower limit price that differed from the reported amount. Some were 80-90% of its reported price, and it was rare for a treasure to reach 60% of its stated price. This incomplete secret treasure had thus achieved the 60% limit price.
“Good. I want it.” Old Mother Ying Shan nodded.
“Good good good.” The plump old male said, “I wonder if you are planning to buy using cosmos crystals or treasures?”
“Treasures.” Old Mother Ying Shan said.
Being an expert, after adventuring outside and killing others, most of the treasures and materials had been used on herself. Who would really hold on to several hundred million cosmos crystals with him? Maybe some powerful Cosmos Gods might do so, but Old Mother Ying Shan did not dare to be so luxurious.
“Hu.” Old Mother Ying Shan waved her hand, causing a black shuttle weapon to appear.
The plump old male took it and carefully scrutinized. He then looked up: “It can be sold for 210 million cosmos crystals at most.”
Old Mother Ying Shan frowned before waving her hands, causing many fragments of precious materials to appear-there were a total of ten of them.
The plump old male carefully looked through and calculated before looking up: “You still lack 20 million cosmos crystals.”
“Still lack?”
Old Mother Ying Shan frowned.
“We still have to sell them after buying them over! We do not know how long it’ll remain in our hands, so the purchasing price will naturally be lower than the selling price.” The plump old male chuckled.
Old Mother Ying Shan waved her hand again, causing a total of 20 million cosmos crystals to fly out. She did not have too many useless treasures with her. The most expensive ones had been used on herself. This time, she was still able to fork the amount out after collecting many treasures she had.
“Good good good.” The plump old male received them and smiled, “This secret treasure spearhead will belong to Old Mother from now.”
“Hu.”
The plump old male kept all the treasures. At the same time, he released the forbidding array. That secret treasure spearhead also flew over to Old Mother Ying Shan. Old Mother Ying Shan extended her hand and grab it. Only then did a smile appear on her face. Even though she had paid so much, and Old Mother Ying Shan had gritted her teeth while doing so, selling even her weapon, the ‘Flying Cloud Shuttle’, Old Mother Ying Shan still felt relatively contended.
Because it was rare for the Ying Shan Clan to have such an outstanding disciple appearing. All sorts of resources would have long streamed onto Xue Ying with his talent if he were a disciple of a terrifying clan like the Fan Clan.
‘It is impossible for me, an old granny, to compare with those huge clans. I must also try my best to do something for this little fellow. It is entirely possible for Xue Ying to become a Conferred King in the future.’ Old Mother Ying Shan looked forward to it.
…
Ardent Fire City, Marquisdom.
The banquet that was held currently in the Marquisdom was bustling with activity.
Marquis Ardent Fire sat at the head position, and Xue Ying sat one spot down his left. On his right sat Chun Yu Wei Yi who took the initiative to rush over.
“Hu.”
An old granny figure condensed out from illusion, appearing within the palace hall. All the elders in the palace hall including the disciples stood up. Marquis Ardent Fire who sat at the head position was the first to stand. He came down bowing: “Old Ancestor.”
“Old Mother.” Chun Yu Wei Yi also bowed.
“Old Ancestor.” Xue Ying shouted out. The entire place was filled with respectful greetings of ‘Old Ancestor’. All the elders, disciples, Ying Shan Lie Hu, Rong Xing Lan, and others were really polite.
Old Mother Ying Shan was the root foundation of the Ying Shan Clan.
She chuckled as she walked towards Xue Ying: “Little Fellow Xue Ying, it is quite good for you to cross through the sixth level of God Yuan Palace so fast. But you still have to properly cultivate. After visiting the capital, you should know that your little strength is still far too lacking.”
“Xue Ying understands.” Xue Ying replied.
“Mn.” Old Mother Ying Shan threw out a wristband, “Properly cultivate then. I’ll wait for the day you become a Conferred King.” Saying that Old Mother Ying Shan turned and left.
Xue Ying received the storage treasure.
When he checked through it…
There was the simple spearhead floating within. The spearhead had caused many spatial ripples to form within the storage treasure space.
