“This is?” Xue Ying looked up with shock. He only saw the figure of Old Mother Ying Shan gradually disappearing.

chapters.title: Chapter 1031 - Breakthrough, Primal Chaos Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 1031: Breakthrough, Primal Chaos Realm
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Sensing that spearhead floating within the storage treasure, Xue Ying felt complex at this moment.
Even though he had reincarnated into the Realm Heart Great Land, Xue Ying was still more worried about his wife and children back at the Primal Chaos Void. In his heart, the Primal Chaos Void was his root! Xue Ying had always been thinking of rising his strength quickly. No matter if it was sculpting himself as an absolute genius or joining the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, everything was done so that he could improve his foundation and increase his certainty of becoming a Cosmos God.
Precisely because…
He could return to his hometown after becoming a Cosmos God.
In Xue Ying’s plan, when he learned the ‘avatar technique’ in the future, part of them would return to his hometown, leaving behind just an avatar in the ‘Realm Heart Great Land’ that would seek for more opportunities to improve his strength. That was to allow himself to better deal with the Destruction Devils and to gain a better chance of killing that Sacred Master. Xue Ying sought to find ways to deal against the calamity of the great apocalypse within the primal chaos void.
As for the ‘Realm Heart Great Land’, he originally thought it was merely a place of opportunity for him to grow stronger. It was fine for him to slightly help out the Ying Shan Clan, mother, and sister and it would be fine.
But at this moment…
‘Old Mother Ying Shan.’ Xue Ying thought.
Old Mother Ying Shan was ranked in the front amongst the Conferred Kings in Southern Cloud Nation. That was unquestionably an existence with tenth level strength and someone who could fight against Cosmos Gods! Hence, she dared to fight head-on against the Qian Yi Clan from the Moonflower Ancient Nation. In addition to the vital protection rendered by the Southern Cloud King to his principal aides, the Qian Yi Clan could not deal with Old Mother Ying Shan.
‘Reaching the level of Old Mother, she shouldn’t have thought of how I could help her in the future right?’ Xue Ying thought.
After all, by deducing from his potential, others would only think that he could become a ninth level Conferred King, and that would be amazing already.
As for the tenth level?
Too difficult.
Only himself understood that he had a considerable chance of reaching the Primal Chaos tenth level. Even still, it would merely be comparable to Old Mother Ying Shan. As for becoming a Cosmos God? Xue Ying was clear that it was not an easy task even in the Realm Heart Great Land. The history of the Realm Heart Great Land was longer than the Primal Chaos Void, yet it only had these few Cosmos Gods.
Fan Tian Chong from the Fan Clan was considered an absolute genius and was significantly nurtured by the clan. Yet he only ended up at the tenth level.
‘Is she doing this merely because I am a disciple from the Ying Shan clan?’ Xue Ying thought.
The restraints of her bloodline.
Love and concern for all descendants in the clan.
Xue Ying could sense the concern and love Old Mother Ying Shan showed without expecting reciprocation from the descendants, as well as the hope she had for the juniors turning into dragons in the future.
‘I’ll naturally not disappoint you.’ Xue Ying thought. This emotion was something he could only etch in his heart.
******
After the banquet, Xue Ying returned to his cavern-dwelling.
Ying Shan Lie Hu and Rong Xing Lan were high-spirited.
“Father, Mother.” Xue Ying said, “I am preparing to enter closed-door cultivation today. I have obtained many scriptures within the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, and do want to calm myself and properly cultivate. This time, I might stay in closed-door for a very long time.”
“We understand.” Ying Shan Lie Hu nodded profusely.
The other party was about to become a Conferred Marquis.
“Mn.” Rong Xing Lan nodded too. Her son had already crossed the sixth level of God Yuan Palace. According to the laws of the Southern Cloud Nation, passing through the seventh level meant one would be a Conferred Marquis!
“Zi Bai, Elder Tian.” Xue Ying turned to the protectors and gave his orders, “If there aren’t any important things, don’t bother me.”
“Alright.”
Magic Servant Zi Bai and Tian Yi Zhi acknowledged.
“Mn.”
Xue Ying then entered the Void God Pagoda.
Looking at the white-robed young man entering the Void God Pagoda entrance, those protectors and attendants felt rueful. It was likely that their prince would be a Conferred Marquis when he left closed-door cultivation. That was horrifying… Conferred Marquis. It was something easily achievable by their prince. Maybe those sayings might be true, that their prince would possibly become a Conferred King in the future too.
…
Within the Void God Pagoda.
Xue Ying sat cross-legged on the great floating rock.
‘Let’s have a good look at this spear.’ Xue Ying was slightly excited as he flipped his hand, bringing that spear out. With a thought, the spear body and spearhead began rotating together. Many forbidding arrays within were activated, and the spear body and spearhead were soon separated.
With a flip of his hand, he kept that violet spearhead which was emanating a bloody savage aura. The demeanor emitted by this spearhead was great, but in reality, it was not placed in Xue Ying’s eyes.
In his opinion, this simple-looking grayish spear body was much more precious than the violet spearhead.
“Hu.”
With a flip of his hand, he took out that spearhead given to him by Old Mother Ying Shan.
‘It isn’t easy getting this.’ Xue Ying looked at this seemingly simple spearhead. Only through the multiple distorted void ripples emitted from the spearhead could its extraordinariness be exemplified.
‘If not for Old Mother, I would have to spend a long time earning the several hundred million cosmos crystals.’ Xue Ying then let out a thought.
“Weng.”
This simple spearhead and simple spear body began fusing as one. At the point where they connected, many mystical imprints were activated. “Weng”, the two naturally combined as one. Following that, all the mystical imprints on the spear lit up, causing the surrounding void to ripple. A huge ringing sound was let out in the Void God Pagoda. This spear which accompanied Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master in his journey across the Realm Heart Great Land had once again regained its original appearance.
‘Since it is Senior Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master’s weapon, let’s call it the Scarlet Cloud God Spear.’ Xue Ying thought.
His consciousness then began permeating to check the entire spear.
“Hong-”
A substantial black maelstrom stairway spiraled downwards. This sophisticated and profound maelstrom stairway could be divided into three sections, and the three parts eventually converged at a single point.
Previously, Xue Ying had comprehended both the spear body and spearhead separately. He merely deduced what the complete imprint would be. Now that he had seen its ‘full appearance’, he discovered that it was more perfect than what he imagined it to be.
‘Haha, time to break through first.’ Xue Ying laughed out loud. With a thought.
“Hong!”
The void bloodline within his body was activated. It directly broke through to the Primal Chaos realm. At that moment, a vast World Energy Maelstrom was formed. It was akin to a black hole where world energy came gushing into the body of Xue Ying! It caused his body to undergo a qualitative change. The bloodline in his body was becoming more concentrated alongside. From thus, his bloodline was now at the Primal Chaos realm. Even the Cosmos God void bloodline in his body had been used to nourish his own bloodline, though it also meant that his bloodline cultivation path had ended here.
Cosmos Gods, according to the laws and profound mysteries system, could control the entire cosmic law!
Every Cosmos God would have different attainments even if they progressed using the same Dao path.
For instance, Monarch Nine Cloud and Void Primogenitor both progressed using the Dao of the Void. Nevertheless, the gap in both of them was extremely huge. Even the Dao of the Void between ‘Southern Cloud King’ and ‘Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master’ were vastly different. And all four of them had differing paths.
Hence, one could only absorb the crystallization of the senior’s wisdom. The final step would still have to be taken by the cultivator himself.
The cosmic law.
It was no longer influenced by the supreme law. The complete cosmic law was one with the myriad existences. Hence, the cosmic law he comprehended would be applicable in both the Realm Heart Great Land and primal chaos void.
Unlike the lower levels like his Mirage and illusory realm or void comprehensions, they originated from different origin worlds and were heavily influenced. Henceforth, Xue Ying had to cultivate from scratch.
The lower the level, the greater the Dao would be influenced by the supreme law.
The cosmic law could stand independent beyond the supreme law.
As for those at the level of Sacred Master, they sought an even higher target.
“Hong~”
Xue Ying’s body broke through. His soul was rapidly turning great under this nourishment. He lowered his head and switched to the spear.
Even though he broke through to the Primal Chaos realm, he did not plan on publicizing it!
In his plan, Xue Ying would be in closed-door for a very long time. When he exited, he would say that he had reached the Primal Chaos realm after cultivating for hundreds of millions of years. At least then he would be classified as within the boundary of an absolute genius! To reach the ‘Primal Chaos realm in just five million years’ was ultimately too heaven-defying.
As long as he did not go out, none would be the wiser!
Xue Ying broke through first to strengthen his soul. The soul at the Primal Chaos realm would allow him to cultivate at a faster pace than that with a Unity realm soul.
‘When I go out, I’ll be able to display my strength and not conceal myself just like what I have been doing.’ Xue Ying thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 1032 - The Blood Sacrifice of Black Devil Great Lake
chapters.content:
Chapter 1032: The Blood Sacrifice of Black Devil Great Lake
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
With a soul at the Primal Chaos Realm, Xue Ying’s speed of cultivation surged. After calming himself, he began researching on this newly-acquired Scarlet Cloud God Spear. The Scarlet Cloud God Spear was the weapon Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master used at his peak. It did not lack in power. This completed god spear was valued at a price not any lower than the ‘Cloud Sky Hammer’. Furthermore, as the Cloud Sky Hammer was given up by ‘Paragon Matron Slave’ personally as she customized a better weapon for herself, the price of the spear would hence be slightly higher than the hammer.
Regardless, this was a weapon that a Cosmos God had to sell all his treasures before he could afford it. Xue Ying lucked out this time. Naturally, it was by relying on his realm that he could obtain the spear body in a small area like the Ardent Fire City.
By relying on the spear body, he then discovered the spearhead in the capital. The spearhead was even bought by Old Mother Ying Shan.
That was how the whole spear landed in his hands.
Actually…
The history of the Realm Heart Great Land was far too long. Many ancient remnants existed around the origin world. There had been plenty of experts who died during the first and second War of the Ancient Nations, so much so that the number could frighten the world. Hence, top-graded treasures were lost everywhere, and some depended on the cultivator’s luck to obtain while others depended on his judgment.
“Hu hu.”
Xue Ying was doing his best to practice the spear in the Void God Pagoda. He would occasionally meditate and consolidate his comprehensions.
As time passed, Xue Ying became even more astonished by the spear.
‘I am so wrong. I originally thought that the mystical inscriptions within the Scarlet Cloud God Spear could allow me to deduce two great techniques-one a domain and the other an offensive killing move. Actually, that conclusion was obtained during my preliminary findings under the condition that both parts of the spear had not been fused together. Now that I began studying the spear thoroughly… it isn’t just two techniques!’ Xue Ying felt excited.
In reality, being a weapon that Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master used for battle, it naturally would be imbued with all techniques the owner specialized in aiding the owner.
One could say that the majority of Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master’s techniques was incorporated in this weapon.
But a weapon was different from an absolute art. It was refined for the sake of fighting, and not for imparting them to disciples. Hence, learning it was much harder than learning an absolute art.
‘Haha, truly a great opportunity for me!’ Xue Ying
Even the complete Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles only had primarily two combat techniques.
Nevertheless, Xue Ying discovered three types in this Scarlet Cloud God Spear.
Clearly, the <Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles> was what the Southern Cloud King prepared to impart to others. All inner disciples could learn it. Even the simplified version was spread across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. It was possible to get it just by spending a little cosmos crystals. As for the complete version, it was possible to get it without joining the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion as long as one was willing to spend a large sum.
Such kind of open impartation was something the Southern Cloud King naturally would not put all his techniques into.
For instance, the <Avatar Technique>, the <Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique> or the <Third Realm Technique>, which of these were not more precious than the Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles?
Hence, in other words-
The <Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles> was merely imparted to the public, and this version contained two powerful techniques. Adding up the refining technique-’Southern Cloud Sacred Body’-there were three methods.
As for the Scarlet Cloud God Spear, it encompassed more than half the combat techniques of Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master. One could see the gap between the two just by thinking along this line of thought.
As Xue Ying cultivated madly, time passed mercilessly.
He had indeed become entirely engrossed. Back at his hometown, Xue Ying could create two great ninth level moves and had long reached the bottleneck. It was hard for him to get any results despite 100 billion years of mundane cultivation. But now, not just the <Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles> or the Scarlet Cloud God Spear, or even the many absolute art scriptures which he got from the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion enabled Xue Ying to continually improve.
This feeling of improvement made him obsessed with cultivation.
‘Amazing.’
The more he cultivated, the more Xue Ying felt how deep the foundation of the Realm Heart Great Land was. In the Primal Chaos Void, Xue Ying had already reached the number one rank in terms of his control of the Mirage and illusory realm; Xue Ying could not learn from other people. Instead, he had to probe his way in darkness. Nevertheless, there were two scriptures within the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion on the Mirage and illusory realm paving the way to the Cosmos God realm. There were even 16 other books that aided him in his research.
…
Xue Ying told the outside world that he would be in closed-door cultivation for a very long time.
In reality, this period had exceeded the expectations of Marquis Ardent Fire, Ying Shan Lie Hu, Rong Xing Lan, and others. To other ancient and old cultivators, this period of closed-door cultivation was not considered much. Nevertheless, to a young cultivator who had merely cultivated for five million years, it was honestly too long.
…
In the blink of an eye, 1.5 billion years had passed.
Black Devil Great Lake.
The lake was vast, and it wasn’t any smaller than a nation. This location was even filled with many devils. In terms of strength, the Black Devil Great Lake was stronger than any of the Black Devil Four Nations. Even the six great ancient nations had a hard time eliminating them. This place was also known as the best place for devils to gather across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
At this moment, deep within the Black Devil Great Lake, in an extravagant palace.
A morbid-looking pale green-robed male sat on top of the throne. Surrounding the throne were meandering blood illusory figures. These figures had practically occupied close to half the entire hall. They were emitting an aura that felt abnormally horrifying, causing the surrounding time-space to tremble.
On the sides below the throne seated two figures.
One was a huge magma giant that a pair of burning fiery sphere eyes. Each of his eyes was like a blazing star.
And on the other side, there was a thin green-haired old man. This thin green-haired old man had a smile on the edge of his lips. There was also a tiny black snake wrapped around his body.
“According to the rules, the location of blood sacrifice this time should be the Southern Cloud Nation.” That green-robed male seated at the head position said with a cold voice.
“It isn’t fun to provoke the Southern Cloud King.” The magma giant’s voice rumbled.
“Hmph. So what if it isn’t fun to provoke him? The Blood Sacrifice is something nobody could stop. We must let the Black Devil Four Nations understand that we, the Black Devil Great Lake, is ultimately the rule-maker!” The thin green-haired old man gave a cold laugh, “Just like how we frequently pay the Fiery Zhao Nation a visit for slaughter and annihilate many cities. Or even the Southern Cloud Nation where we would occasionally act, and that is considered giving the Southern Cloud King a lot of respect already.”
The magma giant said with a deep voice: “I know we should act, just that what I am saying is it isn’t fun to provoke the other party. We should just choose a smaller city and prove our point.”
“Mn.” The thin green-haired old man also nodded, “A small city will be fine. The Southern Cloud King would likely turn crazy if we chose to sacrifice a big city.”
“Also, whenever those of our lineage act, we must perform it spectacularly.” The green-robed male mentioned.
There were many devils within the Black Devil Great Lake. They could be categorized under different sects too.
The Blood Sacrifice was also alternated between the three most prominent sects.
“Since we must do things spectacularly, and we are going to choose a little city.” The green-haired thin old man continued, “Then that little city must be slightly special. I feel that the small city called ‘Ardent Fire City’ is not bad. There is a relatively amazing genius who emerged recently from this place. He is quite amazing within the Southern Cloud Nation. Eliminating this small city where that absolute genius came from would be considered intimidating the Southern Cloud Nation! We must let the entire Southern Cloud Nation know the notoriety of our Black Devil Great Lake!”
“Mn, alright.” The magma giant agreed too.
“Then it’ll be the Ardent Fire City. The two of you will be in charge of arranging the entire matter. Remember, you must do things beautifully and eliminate the entire Ardent Fire City during the Blood Sacrifice.” The green-robed male ordered. His two subordinates both agreed. He would naturally not obstruct the arrangement of matters like the Blood Sacrifice.
…
“Old Ancestor.”
A black-horned muscular figure looked respectfully at the thin green-haired old man who sat cross-legged in front. The thin green-haired old man had a slender black snake which wrapped around him. This snake made the muscular male feel a strand of fear.
“Relax. The matter you asked of me has been arranged.” The thin green-haired old man said, “It is rare for our Black Devil Great Lake to act once against the Southern Cloud Nation during the Blood Sacrifice. This time, it is the turn of our lineage, and that gave me the chance to help you. We have agreed on the matter-the place of sacrifice will be Ardent Fire City. Your enmity can be avenged during this sacrifice.”
“Many thanks, Ancestor.” The black-horned muscular figure trembled in excitement.
He had always been trying his best to earn the favor from the ancestor and spent more than half his earnings to purchase the poison that his ancestor liked. Only then did the ancestor promised him.
After all, it was too hard for him to take revenge by himself.
The city of Southern Cloud Nation was not somewhere anyone dared to attack. It was much harder trying to succeed in destroying a city. They had to mobilize the entire Black Devil Great Lake! For the Black Devil Great Lake to annihilate a city, one was doing so to intimidate everyone, and second, was for the sake of the ‘Blood Sacrifice’.
“Chen Niu, you will be participating in the battle this time. Don’t disappoint me.” The thin green-haired old man said, “The entire Ardent Fire City must be offered for the Blood Sacrifice. Not a single one must remain.”
“Yes.” The black-horned muscular figure felt incredibly excited at this moment. His eyes were filled with expectations and fighting spirit. He had been waiting a long time for this day. He sought to see the despair and the fear from the eyes of Marquis Ardent Fire watching as he personally killed the other party.

chapters.title: Chapter 1033 - Blood Sacrifice–Ardent Fire City
chapters.content:
Chapter 1033: Blood Sacrifice-Ardent Fire City
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
At dawn, outside Ardent Fire City.
Two figures were standing on the land looking distantly at the magnificent Ardent Fire City. Even though this city was considered small in the Southern Cloud Nation, it was still protected by the incarnation of a Cosmos God and several Primal Chaos giants. It was a city where many cultivators converged and occupied an area spanning across 50 billion kilometers. The number of cultivators living inside numbered in trillions.
“The cities under the Southern Cloud Nation are constructed quite extravagantly.” The thin green-haired old man looked at this city and apathetically chuckled, “What a pity that it’ll be turning into a dead city soon.”
“It is their fortune to be chosen as the city for Blood Sacrifice by our Black Devil Great Lake.” A pure and holy white-robed male smiled. His smile was vibrant, and it gave off a warm feeling. His eyes were even filled with a fatalistic inducement. It felt like he was the most beautiful thing in this world, that would turn the eyes of everyone else to him.
“White Cloud Devil Master, this time, we’ll have to trouble you.”
“Haha, this is a minor matter. Since religious master has given the order personally, I’ll naturally not neglect this mission.” The pure and holy white-robed male smiled.
“Mn.” The thin green-haired old man waved his hand.
“Sou.”
Many experts appeared by the side. There were a total of 20 Primal Chaos giants and more than 10,000 Unity realm experts. Once an army numbered in tens of thousands, it would give off a feeling of suppression. These Unity realm experts were all wearing armor. Clearly, they were in a combat formation.
“Greetings, Old Ancestor. Greetings, White Cloud Devil Master.” The 20 Primal Chaos giants all respectfully greeted. Following that, the more than 10,000 Unity soldiers also greeted orderly. They were clear of the statuses these two people in front had-they were from the higher level within the religion. There was no need to mention the Old Ancestor since he was a Cosmos God. As for ‘White Cloud Devil Master’ who stood beside him, he was one of the many devil masters within the religion. Those who could be called ‘devil master’ were all at the Primal Chaos Realm tenth level and could fight against a Cosmos God.
Like on the Realm Heart Great Land, some of the tier three nations only had one Cosmos God guarding it. The Black Devil Great Lake could send a devil master, and that would be sufficient to destroy that nation.
“Mn.”
The thin green-haired old man nodded, “The Blood Sacrifice this time will be led by you, White Cloud Devil Master. You must remember to perform splendidly during this Blood Sacrifice of the city belonging to Southern Cloud Nation to intimidate them and everyone else!”
“Yes.” Everyone answered confidently.
Even that black-horned muscular expert ‘Chen Niu’ was excited: ‘The Southern Cloud Nation is slightly stronger. It is paid more attention to by the Black Devil Great Lake. Unlike when we were destroying cities within the Fiery Zhao Nation where just one or two Primal Chaos giants was sent, this time, White Cloud Devil Master would be personally leading the legion with 20 other Primal Chaos giants. Five out of the 20 of us have already reached the ninth level! Very good, fabulous. We must ensure that the Ardent Fire City is powerless to resist and trample over them. Marquis Ardent Fire, I’ve been waiting for this day for far too long. Soon, my revenge will be taken! I truly desire to see the look of despair on your face!’
“Mn.”
The pure and holy white-robed male nonchalantly ordered, “According to the intelligence, there are only two experts within the Ardent Fire City-Marquis Ardent Fire and the incarnation of Monarch Chun Yu.”
“Marquis Ardent Fire is at the Marquisdom, and the incarnation of Monarch Chun Yu is at the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace.
“Xue Fu, Chen Niu, the two of you shall lead the Primal Chaos giants and attack Marquis Ardent Fire. Kill him as fast as possible.”
“The remaining Primal Chaos giants will attack the incarnation of Monarch Chun Yu! Once any of you succeeded, you all should hurry and aid the other party.”
“As for the other Unity experts… scatter and wipe out the entire Ardent Fire City.”
“As for me, I’ll host the Blood Sacrifice.”
The pure and holy white-robed male said.
Given his high status, he was disdained of acting personally. According to logic, there was no need for such a strong legion to be dispatched in sending a city for Blood Sacrifice. This was primarily done to ‘display their strength’ and to make the surrounding four nations more obedient. It was also done to prevent any unforeseen circumstances from happening. That was why a devil master personally led the team. Clearly, the Black Devil Great Lake did not permit any accidents from happening.
“Yes.” Everyone present acknowledged in an orderly manner.
“Haha, then I’ll begin now?” The thin green-haired old man chuckled. That pure and holy white-robed male nodded too.
The thin green-haired old man flipped his hand, causing a picture scroll to appear. He waved it.
“Hu.”
The picture scroll suddenly disappeared. When it appeared again, it had already transformed into a vast manuscript right above the Ardent Fire City. Furthermore, an unseen energy was released from it, engulfing the entire Ardent Fire City. Naturally, the thin green-haired old man and his subordinates were precisely located within it.
This was a spatial seal!
By relying on a secret treasure, the current Ardent Fire City had its space wholly sealed. Even the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique could not break through this seal.
The large picture scroll gradually disappeared into nothingness. This space where the Ardent Fire City was located in disappeared. From this moment on, the Ardent Fire City could not be seen, touched, or entered! The entire place was in another unique space entirely independent from the Realm Heart Great Land, somewhat similar to the cavern-dwelling of Monarch Nine Cloud-to which Sacred Master could not even find it.
And currently within the sealed space…
Just outside the city, the pure and holy white-robed male indifferently gave the order: “Begin the sacrifice.”
“Sou sou sou…”
Many teams began teleporting in, of which the strongest two Primal Chaos teams proceeded respectively to the Ardent Fire Marquisdom and Southern Cloud Sacred Palace.
******
Within the Southern Cloud Capital, inside the palace, there was a dimmed palace hall.
“Sou sou sou sou…”
Many figures rapidly appeared within this hall. After entering it, they sat.
Seated at the throne position was a thin male wearing a beige robe. His nose was straight, and his eyes were deep. Even though he was thin and small, his body felt like it had become one entity with the surrounding void. He was the void, and the void was him. As a result, he gave off an unseen suppression that caused other experts present at the scene to hold their breath. He was none other than the religious master of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, one of the top ten great religions in the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
“King.”
The atmosphere present was quite oppressive. Everyone turned to the king.
The eyes of the Southern Cloud King were looking far away. Waving his hand, a complete circular projection floated in the air. It faintly reflected the endless time-space continuum, and soon, the scene of Ardent Fire City appeared within.
“Blood Sacrifice.”
“That is the Blood Sacrifice of Black Devil Great Lake.”
The expressions of the three monarchs and five Conferred Kings present turned ugly. The five Conferred Kings who came… were all at the tenth level strength.
“No!”
Old Mother Ying Shan spent most of her time stationed in the capital. At this moment, she was anxiously looking at the scene projected on the circular mirror. This circular mirror was known as the ‘Heaven Observation Mirror’ One could rely on it to observe any place across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. There were very few places that could evade being watched by this mirror. Even those sealed places where ultra-long distance teleportation could not reach could similarly be observed.
This was a precious secret treasure.
“King.” Old Mother Ying Shan immediately stood up and exclaimed anxiously, “This is the Ardent Fire City, my Ying Shan Clan’s Ardent Fire City. We absolutely must not watch…”
Southern Cloud King turned taciturn. His deep eyes merely stared at the Heaven Observation Mirror.
“My Ying Shan Clan disciple ‘, Ying Shan Xue Ying,’ is also in the Ardent Fire City. His talent is extremely huge, and it is certain that he’ll become a Conferred King.” Old Mother Ying Shan hurriedly added.
“And? What can we do?”
Southern Cloud King finally responded. His voice was solemn and cold, “Can we act? If I were to break the tacit understanding, that’d be equivalent to slapping the faces of the three religious masters of the Black Devil Great Lake! The three of them from the Black Devil Great Lake might just act after that, and by then, this will be a huge war that engulfs the entire Southern Cloud Nation. The number of deaths and injuries would be indeterminate.”
Old Mother Ying Shan did not respond at that moment.
She knew.
She also understood it.
Even though the Southern Cloud King had governed the entire Southern Cloud Nation well, allowing it to flourish the entire Realm Heart Great Land was still based entirely on the theory of strength being prime! The three religious masters of the ‘Black Devil Great Lake’ were all huge devils that brought disasters across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Even the six great ancient nations could not get rid of them. As for the Black Devil Four Nations, they were covered in their shadows!
Comparatively speaking, the Southern Cloud Nation was in the best condition.
Fiery Zhao Nation had the most occurrences of being attacked. Of course, the Black Devil Great Lake would not ‘kill the goose that lay the golden eggs’. Naturally, the Cosmos Gods from Fiery Zhao Nation did not dare resist.
As for the Snow Hook Nation, that was a nation that dared to compete directly with the six great ancient nations. The king had an explosive temper too, and would similarly dare to risk it all with the Black Devil Great Lake. Nevertheless, the faces of the six great ancient nations and the Black Devil Great Lake were not fun to slap. Hence, the Snow Hook Nation had suffered from several huge calamities in its history. Nevertheless, the Black Devil Great Lake similarly felt their heads aching because the bones of the Snow Hook Nation were not easy to be gnawed. Hence, they would not usually act, but the moment they did so, they would ruthlessly give Snow Hook Nation a severe lesson.
As for the Maple Nest Nation, it was closest to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. In reality, it had already decided to rely on the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, and with the protection from the ancient nation, it was in a much better condition. Even though it was rare for the Black Devil Great Lake to bring disaster to the Maple Nest Nation, it still occurred.
After all…
The Black Devil Great Lake was not afraid of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. They even dared to cause trouble to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
Only the ‘Southern Cloud Nation’ was being affected the least since Southern Cloud King himself was strong, and had befriended many other experts across the world. In the dark, he similarly made friends with the three religious masters from Black Devil Great Lake! But no matter what, the Black Devil Great Lake would still hold a Blood Sacrifice occasionally, and they would only choose some of the smaller cities within the Southern Cloud Nation.
This was the hidden rule.
Both parties were abiding by it too! When the Black Devil Great Lake had its reputation protected, the Southern Cloud Nation could similarly maintain its overall stability and prosperity.
“But, but…” Old Mother Ying Shan looked at the mirror floating in the air, watching as to how there was a pure and holy white-robed male sitting cross-legged in front of a floating black bottle. Old Mother Ying Shan was able to recognize him with a glance that this was a devil master existence from the Black Devil Great Lake-White Cloud Devil Master, “But the disciples of my Ying Shan Clan, and that Little Fellow Xue Ying, he…”
Old Mother Ying Shan felt her heart aching.
Other than the ancestral family, the Ying Shan Clan had a total of six branches. One of them was located here at the Ardent Fire City! So many Ying Shan clan disciples and that outstanding Little Fellow Xue Ying…
‘Why would this be? Why?’ Old Mother Ying Shan felt angry and agonized. She truly wanted to kill her way over.
But she knew…
That with the spatial seal present, she could not find Ardent Fire City at all! There was only one existence across the entire Southern Cloud Nation who had the strength to enter-Southern Cloud King when he utilized the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’. But it was impossible for the Southern Cloud King to lose all decorum with the three religious masters from Black Devil Great Lake because of this matter.
‘Damn, damn.’ The eyes of the Southern Cloud King remained deep and calm. It seemed as if this event was just a small rising wave in the vast sea. Nevertheless, in reality, he was keeping the anger in himself.
The city of his subordinate.
His civilians.
They were currently being massacred and sent for a Blood Sacrifice.
How could he not be angry?
It’s just that… at times, he had to endure! When facing the Black Devil Great Lake, he had to endure! When facing the six great ancient nations, he also had to endure!

chapters.title: Chapter 1034 - Discovered Ying Shan Xue Ying!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1034: Discovered Ying Shan Xue Ying!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Of the ten great religions in Realm Heart Great Land, eight came from the six great ancient nations!
The Southern Cloud King had personally started a religion that could be ranked in the top ten. One could see how powerful and resourceful this king is. He held the Snow Hook King in contempt. Even though the other party was powerful, the king cared only about himself. Whenever he was angered, he would actually fight head-on with the six great ancient nations and the Black Devil Great Lake. Every time he did so, a vast calamity would arise that resulted in countless deaths and injuries across the country.
As for the Southern Cloud Nation, it was the most prosperous and stable nation out of the Black Devil Four Nations.
‘Black Devil Great Lake, I do not know when it is that I can completely destroy it.’ Southern Cloud King thought.
He contemplated while watching the floating Heaven Observation Mirror.
The three Monarchs and five Conferred Kings were also watching it.
“My incarnation has suffered from a joint attack by 12 Primal Chaos experts, of which three of them have reached the ninth level strength.” Monarch Chun Yu’s expression was cold and sour. He said, “I don’t think my incarnation can last for long.”
His incarnation remained deep in sleep for long periods as a means to guard the place.
By relying on his incarnation, his consciousness could still be maintained.
Once this incarnation was destroyed! Monarch Chun Yu could no longer sense the space-sealed Ardent Fire City. Hence, he could no longer send his incarnations in!
Under ordinary occasions, when a city was attacked, the Cosmos Gods could easily send their incarnations in. Large batches of experts could also be teleported in to provide aid to the nation too. Hence, few dared to wantonly massacre within cities belonging to powerful countries. But this was an operation started by the Black Devil Great Lake. Before acting, they actually sealed the space.
‘Why, why? So many disciples from my Ying Shan Clan and that Little Fellow Xue Ying… why can’t we give him a little more time to grow?’ Old Mother Ying Shan felt agonizing pain in her heart. She was indignant and mad. Given her temper, she would have killed her way over, yet it’s a pity she could not find the place.
“Old Mother…” Empress Ghost Li transmitted a voice message by the side and consoled her.
******
And in the Black Devil Great Lake, within a huge grand palace, there were all sorts of precious gems inlaid in this interior space. There were even many arrays covering the walls.
A faint boundless might could be sensed permeating the entire hall.
At this moment, there were three existences seated at the highest position. The one sitting at the center was a middle-aged male garbed in a black robe. A huge strange six-ringed diagram had appeared behind him. This six-ringed diagram was constantly revolving about. Within this diagram contained an endless death aura. Even Cosmos Gods present did not dare to look at that diagram since they would feel dread and their mind being displaced once they did so.
To the left was a cheerful old man. One would feel pleasant when looking at him. He did not seem to release any suppressive aura.
And to the right, there was a green-robed male who had a pale, sickly expression. Huge blood-colored meandering void figures could be seen around him.
The three of them…
Were the three religious masters from the Black Devil Great Lake. They were famous huge devils across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Many clans from the six great ancient nations would feel alarming fear when they hear their names.
“Haha, it is rare for us to make a move against the Southern Cloud Nation. I believe when the operation begins, many nations will pay attention to the scene of the Blood Sacrifice.” There was a total of seven Cosmos Gods seated below and many other devil masters. Only about 20 or so figures were qualified to sit within this palace hall.
Of course, the majority of them were incarnations.
“If it is a Blood Sacrifice of some small little nations, it isn’t worth mentioning at all. But a Blood Sacrifice on a city under the Southern Cloud Nation is huge news. The Black Devil Four Nations would definitely pay close attention to it. Some of the nations around would likely turn their attention to this place too.”
“We must turn the city into a spectacular sacrifice.”
They were all chatting with smiles.
Those present were all devils!
Speaking from the inner hearts, they preferred living in prosperous places. Who would ever like hiding in such a strange place like the ‘Black Devil Great Lake’ where space was unpredictable? But they had no choice. The six great ancient nations needed stability and to reproduce many more cultivators. Hence, these devils would frequently be chased and pursued after! Some of the stronger ones would join the prominent clans as Honored Guests.
And some who committed grievous offenses and were rejected by the more prominent clans could only flee! They would escape to the gathering places of devils since only such sites were where these devils could unite.
It was during the Blood Sacrifices that would satisfy these devils the most. They had been escaping and hiding for far too long. Only during the occasional times would they turn back to these nations to bare their fangs!
“Hmph hmph… so what if it is the Southern Cloud Nation? We should find an opportunity to send a city from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation for a Blood Sacrifice. Only then would it feel more satisfying.”
“No rush, no rush. There will be an opportunity in the future.”
“Come come come, let us have a drink.”
The Cosmos Gods and devil masters were all chatting with smiles.
And the three religious masters seated at the highest positions would occasionally speak too. The current atmosphere within the entire palace hall was extremely joyous.
…
Ardent Fire City, Marquisdom, inside the Void God Pagoda that was situated in Xue Ying’s cavern-dwelling.
There was a great floating stone.
And a handsome white-robed young man sitting on it. A spear was placed on his knees.
“Hong long long~”
The space within the Void God Pagoda was like billowing waves surging. The spatial waves would occasionally tear apart many of the undercurrents within. This tearing force was abnormally horrifying. Ordinary Primal Chaos giants who dare to appear here would likely be torn apart into smithereens and die instantly at that moment.
Xue Ying was ultimately used to cultivating. It was not considered long for him to enter closed-door cultivation for 10 billion years in one go. Currently, it had only been 1.5 billion years, and he was still wholly immersed within.
According to the habit from his previous life, most would only leave closed-door cultivation after entering a bottleneck. Right now, he was happily comprehending and was not in a rush to go.
“Xue Ying, quickly come out! Come out now!” Marquis Ardent Fire anxiously transmitted over.
“Prince, prince, hurry out!” Magic Servant Zi Bai transmitted too.
“Prince, hurry out now! Hurry hurry, we don’t have enough time!” Tian Yi Zhi anxiously transmitted over as well.
“Let Magic Servant Zi Bai. I have some trouble over here. It is unlikely for me to defend myself so don’t come over to where I am.” Marquis Ardent Fire hurriedly followed up after that.
There was a continuous chain of voice transmissions.
It forced Xue Ying to stop his cultivation. He was feeling slightly shocked as this chain of voice transmissions had caused his heart to tighten.
“Even Grandpa Marquis is having a hard time surviving?” Xue Ying felt startled.
He did not care about other matters.
“Sou.”
Grabbing the Scarlet Cloud God Spear, Xue Ying took a step before arriving at the entrance of the Void Pagoda. “Hong long long”, the sealed doors began opening. Just as a small gap was formed, Xue Ying rushed out with a “sou”.
“Hu.”
As he arrived outside the Void Pagoda, Xue Ying saw how Magic Servant Zi Bai was no longer his usual carefree self. The fan in his hand was not being fanned, and instead, he was anxiously saying: “Don’t resist. I’ll bring you away.” Saying that as he was prepared to keep Xue Ying into his Eden treasure, Magic Servant Zi Bai suddenly stopped as he looked at Xue Ying with shock.
How come the aura of his prince had changed…?
Primal Chaos Realm?
“Prince, you broke through to the Primal Chaos Realm?” Magic Servant Zi Bai was shocked. His clan’s prince had a void bloodline. If he broke through to the Primal Chaos Realm, he would undoubtedly be better than a magic servant in escaping.
“Mn.”
Xue Ying casually answered. His attention was placed more on the distant.
Currently, his gaze crossed through the obstacles of space. Xue Ying was able to see that at the highest location in the center of the Ardent Fire City, there was a holy and pure white-robed male seated in midair. A black bottle was floating in front of him. This bottle diffused out some faint ripples that covered the entire Ardent Fire City.
‘What ripples are those? What function does it contain?’ Xue Ying felt puzzled. This ripple did not seem to be dangerous at all.
But closely following that, he understood.
“Kill.”
With his current realm, Xue Ying was able to clearly perceive the entire Ardent Fire City. Many armored soldiers were slaughtering the people. They were a team formed by Unity realm experts, and any one team had the strength at God Yuan Palace sixth level. How could the civilians within Ardent Fire City resist against it? They were easily killed.
As they were killed, unseen energy was produced that moved with the ripples into the black bottle.
‘Blood Sacrifice?’ Xue Ying understood there and then.
He had read many different books at the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion and understood that this was the Blood Sacrifice conducted by Black Devil Great Lake.
Just like the Primal Chaos Void, after the Destruction Devils were killed, the cultivators could absorb the dispersed energy from them to nourish their souls! And it was likewise for the Destruction Devils. They would similarly grow stronger after killing the cultivators.
Hence, when cultivators died, their soul would leave behind unique energy. It was impossible for cultivators to absorb them within the Primal Chaos Void-only the Destruction Devils could.
But on the ‘Realm Heart Great Land’.
It was discovered a long time ago that the unique energy within the soul of each being actually came from the most essential part of the Origin World. It could even be collected.
‘Blood Sacrifice’ was done to collect this essence energy of the soul of cultivators. And the core of the entire Blood Sacrifice was that one single Blood Sacrifice Magic Bottle. Cosmos Gods who knew how to refine treasures for Blood Sacrifice could be counted with one’s fingers in the entire Realm Heart Great Land! And only three out of the six great ancient nations knew how to refine this Blood Sacrifice treasure. One could see how difficult it was to cultivate this technique!
And it was ‘Yama Religious Master’ of the three religious masters from the Black Devil Great Lake who knew how to refine it.
‘Blood Sacrifice?’
‘Ardent Fire City is being used as a Blood Sacrifice?’ Xue Ying felt startled. Following that, fury began filling his chest. His eyes turned red the next moment.
Saying it was slow, though everything happened quickly within the hearts of Xue Ying. In reality, it had only been a blink of time.
“Prince, we should leave now. Madam and Ying Shan Lie Hu have both been brought into my Eden treasure. As for prince’s father, Ying Shan Lie Hu, he should still be at the Misty Cloud Pavilion. It is too far, and we don’t have sufficient time to save him.” Magic Servant Zi Bai anxiously urged.
“We have discovered Ying Shan Xue Ying!” A joyous sound was transmitted from afar.

chapters.title: Chapter 1035 - Preliminary Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 1035: Preliminary Battle
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Being one of the branches of Ying Shan Clan that reproduced for trillions of years, countless disciples lived in the Marquisdom. It occupied a vast area. At this moment, there were teams of Unity Realm devils wreaking havoc. Each group contained a hundred people and could burst out with a God Yuan Palace seventh level strength. While they were massacring the civilians, and under the situation that the strongest power of the Marquisdom-Marquis Ardent Fire-was suffering from a joint attack by eight Primal Chaos experts, these devils had no foes at all.
“We discovered Ying Shan Xue Ying!” A team of devils became joyous at that moment. They were able to spot a white-robed young man who flew out from the Void God Pagoda.
This white-robed young man turned with a cold expression towards that team of devils.
“Don’t resist.” Xue Ying waved his hand before keeping Magic Servant Zi Bai into his Eden treasure.
“Prince!” Magic Servant Zi Bai forcibly resisted. He anxiously transmitted over, “I can help you, Prince!” He could at least exert power at the eighth level.
Yet Xue Ying frowned slightly at Magic Servant Zi Bai beside him.
“Hu.”
Following that, he cast his gaze at the team of devils closest to him. That team was currently chasing after the escaping Ying Shan clan disciples. Even though they discovered Xue Ying, they did not act. Instead, they reported upwards. After all, they could ascertain with a glance that Prince Xue Ying had reached the Primal Chaos realm, and they as a team of Unity experts had no confidence in dealing against him.
“Die.” Xue Ying coldly uttered.
“Hua!” The void where that team of devils existed in abruptly distort. Many cracks appeared on every Unity devil.
In a single instance, the team of a hundred devils turned into dust. They disappeared from the world.
“No!”
“Quick, quickly run! I’ll block them for us.”
Those Ying Shan Clan disciples who were being chased after, some were escaping, and some were holding back the devils for their loved ones. But suddenly, they discovered that many cracks had appeared on the hundred devils that were pursuing after them. Following that, they disappeared.
“What?” Magic Servant Zi Bai watched this scene happen with shock, “Prince could actually kill them instantaneously at a distance 5,000 kilometers away?”
In any case, the team of devils could still unleash a combat formation at the God Yuan Palace seventh level strength. Even if he was the one fighting against this team of devils, he had to use several techniques before being able to get rid of this team. His prince, nevertheless, could easily extinguish the group of devils despite being 5,000 kilometers away. This, what strength had his prince reached?
“Don’t resist.” Xue Ying said once again. He waved his hand, engulfing Magic Servant Zi Bai with his energy.
“If you need me, Prince can give the order anytime.” Magic Servant Zi Bai transmitted hurriedly. This time, he did not resist.
Xue Ying kept Magic Servant Zi Bai. With a thought, he was able to confirm that his mother and sister had been held by Magic Servant Zi Bai. That was why he wanted to keep Magic Servant Zi Bai in his Eden treasure. As for aiding him? With the strength Magic Servant Zi Bai had, he was of no help to Xue Ying-he would only be a distraction.
‘Even though Grandpa Marquis is in danger, he should be able to sustain for a breath or two.’ Xue Ying looked towards the distance.
Marquis Ardent Fire led the most elite 5,000 Ardent Fire Soldiers. Furthermore, he was being strengthened by the array from the Marquisdom.
Even though he was on the disadvantaged end as he suffered from a joint attack by eight Primal Chaos experts together, he should be able to maintain for a while.
“Save me!”
Currently, in the entire Marquisdom, there were still seven teams of devils attacking the civilians. Each group consisted of a hundred people, and they were killing thousands of Ying Shan Clan people every instance. Xue Ying had to eliminate them first. In order to deal against them, he had to teleport before displaying his ‘Scarlet Cloud Domain’ to eradicate the devils. And killing the seven teams was something doable within a breath of time!
…
Southern Cloud Nation, within the royal palace.
The King, three Monarchs and five Conferred Kings were all watching the projection on the round mirror.
“Little Fellow Xue Ying.” Old Mother Ying Shan saw that white-robed young man appearing in the round mirror and could not help but feel her heart tightening.
Nonetheless, closely following that, the white-robed young man simply shouted a ‘die’, and the team of hundred devils 5,000 kilometers away turned into nothingness.
“This Little Fellow Xue Ying has reached the Primal Chaos realm, and has even trained in such a formidable domain technique?” Old Mother Ying Shan felt both joyous and sorrowful. She felt joyous because Xue Ying had not failed to live up to her expectations. But killing this team of tiny Unity realm experts meant nothing at all! This domain technique was only at the eighth level strength. Even if Xue Ying was at the peak of eighth level or the ninth level, so what?
At this moment, there were 20 Primal Chaos devils on the enemy side, of which five were at the ninth level. Also, they were not fighting alone. Instead, they had formed combat formations!
Did they not see Monarch Chun Yu’s incarnation that had reached the ninth level strength after being strengthened by the array, yet he was still dying off soon?
Marquis Ardent Fire had a total of 5,000 elite Ardent Fire soldiers, forming a huge formation array. He was even strengthened by arrays too, yet he was similarly being suppressed.
So what could this Little Fellow Xue Ying do?
Furthermore, there was still a mighty boss on the enemy side-the tenth level White Cloud Devil Master! That was someone who could fight against Cosmos Gods. Furthermore, some of the new Cosmos Gods would even be suppressed entirely and defeated by White Cloud Devil Master. Could this strength be resisted by a little fellow?
“He is a genius. This domain technique of his should be at least the eighth level standard.” Monarch Sky Yin muttered.
“What a pity.” Monarch Greedy Peng softly shook his head.
Only Southern Cloud King remained watching it emotionlessly and calmly at the round mirror. If this was an ordinary occasion, he might reveal a smile when such an outstanding young genius emerged. But now, the king only felt humiliation! Because he as the King could not do anything at all. He could only stand by the side and watch as the entire Ardent Fire City got massacred and used as a Blood Sacrifice. He had to personally witness as this young genius dies in the hands of a Primal Chaos Devil led by White Cloud Devil Master.
…
In another location within the Southern Cloud Capital, within the residence of the Fan Clan.
There were also ten experts seated in the palace hall observing the battle. A Heaven Observation Mirror similarly floated within. It was naturally that tall and plump male ‘Fan Tian Chong’ who was seated at the throne position.
“The Black Devil Great Lake remains unbridled and arrogant as always.” Fan Tian Chong muttered, “My Summer Wind Ancient Nation has also battled the Black Devil Great Lake multiple times. What a pity that even though our Summer Wind Ancient Nation has the occasional rewards, the devils of the Black Devil Great Lake could rely on geography to make our Summer Wind Ancient Nation suffer from huge losses too. Let’s not mention the Black Devil Four Nations. The Southern Cloud Nation has it best, but they would still occasionally see a city being sent for Blood Sacrifice. Yi? Ying Shan Xue Ying?”
“It is that Ying Shan Xue Ying.”
“His potential is great. It is certain for him to become a Conferred King. It isn’t hard for him to reach the ninth level strength too.”
“What a pity.”
Other observers within the palace hall said.
Fan Tian Chong nodded: “It is indeed a pity. The group of Primal Chaos devils led by White Cloud Devil Master is something Ying Shan Xue Ying could not resist.” Fan Tian Chong softly shook his head. It was regretful watching the fall of a young genius, but he did not care much. In the vast Realm Heart Great Land, many geniuses had fallen before reaching absolute experts.
…
Within a bamboo house that was surrounded by flowing water.
A beautiful violet-robed girl sat on the ground. She was currently embroidering.
“The Ardent Fire City is currently suffering from the Blood Sacrifice of the Black Devil Great Lake. Monarch Chun Yu’s incarnation is about to dissipate, and the 5,000 elite Ardent Fire soldiers led by Marquis Ardent Fire are currently doing their best to resist, yet they can’t last long. Ying Shan Xue Ying has left closed-door cultivation. He has broken through to the Primal Chaos realm, and has killed a team of Unity realm devils with his domain technique.” Many reports were rapidly transmitted to Qian Yi Xiao.
Qian Yi Xiao was the manager of the Moonflower Ancient Nation’s Qian Yi Clan branch in Southern Cloud Nation. She could naturally easily obtain detailed information from various sources.
But she wasn’t watching the Heaven Observation Mirror. That was too extravagant, and in the entire Southern Cloud Nation, only the Southern Cloud King and Fan Clan owned them! At this moment, the information was being sent from within the Qian Yi Clan located in the Moonflower Ancient Nation.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying has left closed-door cultivation? What a pitiful fellow. How lamentable.” The violet-robed girl Qian Yi Xiao lightly giggled.
She did not care anyway.
Even the matter of the Ardent Fire City did not affect her mood on embroidery.
******
Ardent Fire City.
“Sou.”
With a teleport, Xue Ying appeared not far away from another team of Unity realm devils. That team formed a combat formation, and their members were currently wantonly killing the civilians. With their strength, even if they met the Marquisdom elders or Honored Guests, they could easily kill them off. They were currently wreaking havoc in the place-whatever powerful moves that had a massive area of effect were utilized.
“Hong long long~”
Many places beneath were scattered and smashed. The Ying Shan Clan disciples were spreading in all directions. Nevertheless, large batches of them were still dying every moment.
“Die.” Xue Ying felt anxious. But he knew that by relying on incarnations, these incarnations could not rely on the power from the Scarlet Cloud God Spear. Hence, killing a team would be tough.
“Hu.”
The surrounding void rippled. The hundred Unity devils suddenly shattered apart and turned into dust.
“Dead? They are all dead?”
“They are dead!”
Those Ying Shan Clan disciples who were escaping in despair suddenly stopped. They watched in astonishment as those devils turned into dust. But soon later, they discovered that white-robed young man who was emitting a Primal Chaos aura.
“It is Prince Xue Ying.”
“Prince Xue Ying is the one that killed those devils.” The Ying Shan Clan disciples felt extreme joy! The pride of their Ying Shan Clan was this legendary genius disciple from their clan-Ying Shan Xue Ying. And this legendary man had become a Primal Chaos giant and was currently killing those devils.
“Prince Xue Ying will definitely be able to wipe out all those devils.”
“Too amazing.”
The Ying Shan Clan disciples saw hope. They were looking forward to when all enemies were wiped out. Nevertheless, these ordinary clan members were not clear how frightening the enemies were this time!
“The next place.” After Xue Ying killed the enemies, he did not stop. He immediately teleported to another location.
…
The black twisted-horn muscular man, ‘Chen Niu’ was currently leading three Primal Chaos devils. The surrounding space had vaguely formed a huge dark cloud. They were like a single entity, and Chen Niu being the commander, had become even more abnormally strength. After all, he was primarily a ninth level expert and was leading three other Primal Chaos experts, forming a combat array that boosted his power. This single team had already gained the upper hand when facing Marquis Ardent Fire, much less when there was a second team dealing against the Marquis too.
‘Xue Fu’ was a cold old man, and he was the one leading the other three Primal Chaos experts in a combat formation.
One could see a huge black ‘Xue Fu mutated beast’ illusion forming in midair. The surrounding temperature had drastically dropped. There were even some icy snowflakes appearing in the vicinity.
“Brother Xue Fu.” Chen Niu might be filled with killing intent, but he was still paying close notice to the things happening around him-that white-robed young man, “It is that Little Prince Xue Ying. He is currently killing our subordinates. You should go. Your team will be able to eliminate him with the fastest speed.”
“Alright.” The cold old man was also able to spot Xue Ying with a single glance. Their team specialized more in dealing against the weak, and could rapidly wipe them out.
“Let us leave at this moment.” The cold old man ordered through voice transmission.

chapters.title: Chapter 1036 - Killing Four!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1036: Killing Four!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Xue Ying, hurry up and run! Escape at this moment!” Marquis Ardent Fire was anxiously shouting over through voice transmissions. He was currently so angry that his eyes were about to pop out from his sockets. Leading a total of 5,000 elite Ardent Fire soldiers in a combat formation, they had formed a fiery-red gigantic dragon that fought furiously against the enemies. Every soldier was also doing his or her best. They were clear that it was impossible for them to be spared given the character of those devils if they were to lose the battle.
Without having a path of retreat, these soldiers could only stake their lives.
“Feeling anxious? Turning mad? It’s useless! Hahaha, Marquis Ardent Fire, that time when our tribe was struggling at death’s door within the wilderness and lived carefully, even though survival was hard, we were quite united. That was our home! But you were the one that sent down a fire dragon on us as you pursued after a devil! That devil might have evaded this move of yours, but our tribe had been exterminated as a result! Only ten or so members survived. We had to travel around homelessly, seeking means to survive. Nonetheless, we could only watch as one member died after another. In the end, I was forced to enter the Black Devil Great Lake.”
“Out of the millions of insects that faced the calamity, I was one of the ten kings that survived. Only then was I qualified to become a member of the lowest society in the Black Devil Great Lake.”
“I struggled amidst the many of the newcomers, and eventually succeeded in becoming a subordinate of a Primal Chaos expert.”
“But they were all devils. My disciple brothers had killed each other in cold blood!”
“Only the survival would triumph as the strongest. I was able to break through to the Primal Chaos realm and reach the ninth level, and now, I am much stronger than you! What a pity that you are being protected by the Ying Shan Clan and the Southern Cloud Nation.
“That time, why can’t you control your actions slightly and allow my tribe to survive?”
“All it required was a thought, and none of us would die! But you did not do that. That’s right, we were ants. Ants! The weak are ants and should die. They should all die.”
The eyes of the black twisted-horned muscular male were filled with madness. At the same time, continuous voice transmissions sounded in the mind of Marquis Ardent Fire.
This was the Devil ‘Chen Niu’s greatest desire.
This desire of his pushed him on through the nightmare-like society in the Black Devil Great Lake as part of the lowest ranking of devil until where he currently was. At this moment, he was about to execute his revenge, so naturally, he told the other party everything. He wanted Marquis Ardent Fire to understand! The death of Marquis Ardent Fire and the annihilation of the entire Ardent Fire City was all because of his actions which implicated a tribe in the past.
“Do you know that the Southern Cloud Nation have many cities? Originally, it wasn’t your Ardent Fire City that would be chosen as the location for Blood Sacrifice. But it had been because of I! I was the one that thought of ways to make the Old Ancestor and others choose the Ardent Fire City as the place for Blood Sacrifice.”
“Haha…”
“You destroyed my tribe. Today, I’ll be killing you, exterminate your clan and your city. In the future, the whole Ying Shan Clan will also be extinguished. Hahaha…”
The voice transmissions continued sounded on in the mind of Marquis Ardent Fire.
Marquis Ardent Fire gritted his teeth.
He was a cold, emotionless person. Thus, why would he care about his actions as he fought outside even if they might implicate the weak? At this moment, he was still furiously staring at that black twisted-horned muscular male in front of him.
“Xue Ying, hurry up and run! Flee at this moment. They are too formidable, too powerful! As long as you hold on for a day, they will retreat.” Marquis Ardent Fire was currently transmitting his voice to Xue Ying. He knew it was impossible for him to survive. All he wanted was for Xue Ying to live on. Being a Primal Chaos expert from the void lineage, Xue Ying was good at escaping. He might be able to grasp that tiny chance of surviving for a day within the vast Ardent Fire City.
A day.
This was also the tacit understanding between the Black Devil Great Lake and Southern Cloud King. The Blood Sacrifice would last for a day at most. No matter if they succeeded or fail, they had to withdraw!
But when facing the team led by White Cloud Devil Master, it was likely that an hour was all it took for the entire Ardent Fire City to be annihilated and used as a Blood Sacrifice. This was primarily because the Ardent Fire City as a whole was too big, and there were too many civilians. As for Marquis Ardent Fire and the incarnation of Monarch Chun Yu, and Xue Ying, they could easily be settled within a short period in the plans of Black Devil Great Lake.
…
Even though Marquis Ardent Fire was anxiously urging Xue Ying to flee, Xue Ying remained teleporting about.
“Die.” He was coldly looking at the closest team of hundred Unity realm devils. Many cracks appeared on the body of those devils, and they soon turned into dust.
“Prince Xue Ying!”
“Prince Xue Ying has saved us!”
“We are saved!”
“Our Marquisdom can be saved! There is hope for the Ardent Fire City!”
The Ying Shan Clan disciples who were saved finally saw the light at the end of the tunnel. In their opinion, Prince Xue Ying who was currently emanating a Primal Chaos realm aura was originally powerful. But after killing those devils in a single instance, they felt that a miracle had dawned on Ardent Fire City.
No other choice. Each and every Primal Chaos giant was a great existence in the eyes of these ordinary civilians.
“I am not willing! I am unreconciled to just die like that after breaking through to the Void God realm and am finally qualified to be a disciple of the Ying Shan Clan. I can allow my mom to live a better life from now, yet why, why must we die just like that? No…” A disciple of Ying Shan Clan had broken through to the Unity realm amidst a crisis of death. But facing the incoming team of devils, he was filled with despair.
“Hong.”
As he escaped, he was continually looking at the team of devils behind. But suddenly, many cracks appeared on the body of those devils, and they soon turned into dust after.
This Ying Shan Clan disciple stopped in a daze abruptly. He then turned to the white-robed young man standing afar.
That white-robed young man stood in midair. His Primal Chaos aura had produced a suppressive feeling that made him look up to him unknowingly.
“Prince Xue Ying?” This Ying Shan Clan disciple recognized him with a glance.
That was the pride of the Marquis Ardent Fire lineage.
He was the pride of the whole Ying Shan Clan, and was a legendary genius!
“It is Prince Xue Ying!” This Ying Shan Clan disciple suddenly burst into extreme excitement. He had never worshipped Prince Xue Ying as much as this moment! Currently, Prince Xue Ying was like a spot of light in his heart-the status of this prince had transcended beyond Marquis Ardent Fire’s, and was merely secondary to Old Mother Ying Shan.
…
Xue Ying could not tolerate the scene of the weak being massacred, much less when these people were of his clan.
“You teleported quite quickly!”
“Hu.”
At the same time when Xue Ying utilized his domain technique to kill the fourth team of devils, four Primal Chaos giants appeared. The leading devil was a cold old man. As this old man appeared, an unseen law domain descended in the surrounding, causing time-space to be faintly locked in this location. This law domain had come from a ninth level expert, and was in a sense, quite perfect.
The law domain of Primal Chaos experts, even if they were constructed based from a miniature cosmic law, was intrinsically powerful. This cold old man ‘Xue Fu’ was also an expert at the ninth level. With his law domain suppression, even Cosmos Gods had a hard time barging in.
With his law domain suppression, nobody could teleport out.
“Hmph.” Xue Ying turned to the four Primal Chaos devils in front.
His current attainments of the void enabled him to perceive the moment the other party teleported over. Logically speaking, Xue Ying could simply teleport away with sufficient time.
But he did not. Instead, Xue Ying wanted to kill that team of Unity realm devils.
“Xue Ying, you, why did you not escape?” The distant Marquis Ardent Fire who observed this scene felt even more distressed. “You should use all your understanding of the void to escape! Don’t care about other clanmates anymore. You should be the only one who could barely escape alive in the entire Ardent Fire City. Others have no hopes of surviving.”
Marquis Ardent Fire felt both moved and restless at Xue Ying’s decision to save the clan members at this crucial moment.
“Hua hua hua~”
A cold gale formed.
The surrounding temperature started dropping drastically. Icy slags and snowflakes began falling in the sky. This cold old man ‘Xue Fu’ and his three other subordinates remained in a combat formation. One could see an enormous black-colored Xue Fu illusion appear in the location. This Xue Fu figure was covered in blood-colored veins. His eyes were blood-colored too. The current temperature of the surrounding could freeze ordinary Unity realm experts to death.
The cold wind blew on his face. Yet Xue Ying merely tightened his grip on the Scarlet Cloud God Spear.
“What a pity.”
“You are a genius. If you were given sufficient time, you could have reached my level. What a pity that today is the day you die.” The cold old man Xue Fu said with a crisp voice.
The three Primal Chaos devils were also looking at Xue Ying with pity.
“Kill him.” The cold old man stated.
“Move.”
“Kill.”
They were all being casual. Nevertheless, when the killing began, they would not be merciful. After all, they were huge devils at the Primal Chaos realm, and they still wanted to go team up with the other team after killing this prince to exterminate Marquis Ardent Fire.
“Weng!”
A strange sound was heard.
“What is that sound?” One of the four Primal Chaos existences, a golden-clothed demonic teenager, became startled. Closely following that, he discovered a huge hole appearing on his chest.
Accompanied by this strange sound, the ripple had unknowingly transmitted across his body.
The body of this golden-robed young man soon shattered. He turned into powder and was dispersed into nothingness.
“Weng!””Weng!””Weng!”
The three Primal Chaos existences felt a blurred spear shadow flashing by. The next moment, gaping holes appeared on their chest. Their body soon shattered and turned into powder.
“Hong hong hong.” Only the cold old man ‘Xue Fu’ remained alive as he roared out in shock: “Chen Niu!”
He tried his best to block the incoming attacks.
But this seemingly ordinary spearhead appeared behind him with a horrifying force. It pierced through his body, causing part of it to burst immediately. That was an instant kill. The cold old man panicked in his heart: ‘”Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”, Void Shatter? But when did the Void Shatter become so unpredictable? I can’t even block it!” Even though he tried his best, the surrounding void warped in an odd manner, causing three consecutive spears to pierced through his body and causing his body to shatter.
The final strike shot through his throat.
His head soon disappeared.
He was staring wide-eyed at the cold white-robed young man standing in front with a spear in his hand.
He dared not believe-he did not want to believe-that he died in the hands of a young man.
“How can this be?” Following that, his consciousness was gone entirely.
Silence.
Previously when the Unity realm devils were massacred, other teams above the Marquisdom were paying close notice to this location. Even the black twisted-horned muscular male ‘Chen Niu’ and his three Primal Chaos subordinates that were fighting with Marquis Ardent Fire were paying close notice to the proceedings here. Marquis Ardent Fire himself was included, albeit he was more anxious.
But at this moment, the whole place became quiet.
No matter who it was, none had thought that such an outcome would happen.
A ninth level Primal Chaos expert leading three other Primal Chaos experts in a combat formation had lost. The three subordinates died under one single strike, and the only ninth level expert ‘Xue Fu’ died in three. None was able to obstruct the spear at all!
…
Southern Cloud Nation, within the royal palace.
Within the palace hall that contained a congealed atmosphere, Old Mother Ying Shan, Empress Ghost Li, Gong Liang Yi-the five Conferred Kings, as well as Monarch Sky Yin, Monarch Chun Yu, and Monarch Greedy Peng were watching the scene projected on the round mirror with astonishment. Originally, they did not wish to see this absolute genius being killed. Nevertheless, when they saw what happened next, all of them were stunned momentarily. They did not know what to say.
Southern Cloud King who was originally watching calmly expressionlessly, suddenly broke out in a grin. His eyes sparkled at that moment as he roared: “Great!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1037 - The Fame of Ying Shan Xue Ying
chapters.content:
Chapter 1037: The Fame of Ying Shan Xue Ying
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Following Southern Cloud King’s exclamation of a single word, ‘good’, the group of cultivators within the palace hall reacted. One could not blame them. The scene that appeared within the round mirror was too shocking.
“Formidable. Truly formidable. The combat formation formed by four Primal Chaos existences has been broken by him just like that?” Monarch Sky Yin sighed with shock.
“That’s right. And it is even a combat formation led by Old Devil Xue Fu. In terms of power, it should be at the peak of the ninth level. Even if I acted, it isn’t that easy to break it.” Monarch Chun Yu exclaimed with admiration from the side. A truly powerful combat formation could easily defend itself against even a soul attack-the strongest expert within the combat formation could protect the team.
Hence, attacking the weakest link in the combat formation was practically equivalent to attacking its strongest expert.
Of course, in the long history of Realm Heart Great Land, several unique methods could target one of the members situated in the formation, rendering the formation entirely useless. For instance, some kind of ‘curse’ or ‘prophecy method’. Or a ‘karma attack’, ‘Yin-Yang Reincarnation Attack’, etc.
“He has employed two types of spear techniques in total.” Monarch Greedy Peng praised, “The first spear technique is bizarre. It did not pierce apart the combat formation, yet the spear shadows have pierced through the chest of the Primal Chaos experts. When a bloody hole formed on each opponent’s chest, their body soon turned into particles and disappeared from existence. Those three Primal Chaos experts died like that.”
“Mn, that’s right.”
“Indeed, his spear did not pierce apart the combat formation. Yet the spear shadows have somehow flashed, piercing through the chests of the three Primal Chaos experts and causing their bodies to shatter.”
Those present had extraordinary strength.
Not just Cosmos Gods, even the tenth level existences could make an accurate judgment.
“The second spear technique is the 12th style of our “Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles”, the ‘Void Shatter’. Three consecutive spears blasted out on the body of Old Devil Xue Fu.” Monarch Greedy Peng said, “The Void Shatter was merely an attack at the God Yuan Palace ninth level strength. Even though its power might be stronger, it is quite crude and easily defended! But in the hands of this Prince Xue Ying, when the spear appeared, it had reached the side of Old Devil Xue Fu, preventing the other party from blocking it at all. Hence, causing all three moves to connect.”
“Even though ‘Void Shatter’ has huge power, and Old Devil Xue Fu did have a firm body refining cultivation, three spears sufficed to cause his death. This spear in Prince Xue Ying’s hand… must be an outstanding secret treasure! It enabled the ‘Void Shatter’ to unleash a greater force.” Monarch Greedy Peng explained.
Those present nodded.
Breaking the combat formation first by bringing down the members.
Without protection from the combat formation, Old Devil Xue Fu’s survival abilities would drastically reduce. But three spears sufficed to kill the other party? That felt too exaggerated. There was only one explanation-the spear was a horrifying secret treasure.
“These aren’t the most amazing.”
A smile also appeared on Southern Cloud King. He chuckled, “Breaking the combat formation or the secret spear treasure in his hand, these are secondary. What is most amazing about this little fellow Ying Shan Xue Ying is his domain technique! The law domain of Old Devil Xue Fu was quite perfected. It suppressed all ripples in the vicinity. But Ying Shan Xue Ying could still control the void and cause his spear to easily appear by the side of Old Devil Xue Fu. It is fine to reach this stage since according to logic, Old Devil Xue Fu should be able to react in time by sensing the changes in the void around him! But in reality, he a ninth level expert, someone who excels in close combat too, could not block a single move! Clearly, this void control method of Ying Shan Xue Ying has reached a profound stage that it was instantaneous and signless!”
“Mn.”
“Yes.”
All those present turned solemn.
That’s right.
A domain technique that could render a ninth level expert helpless was indeed frightening.
Precisely because of this horrifying domain that it gave rise to a miraculous effect on using the crude and direct technique ‘Void Shatter’!
“Those attacks could not even be blocked. Really frightening.” Those present were overwhelmed with aghast.
“Old Mother, congratulations to you.” Empress Ghost Li commended.
“Hahaha, Old Mother, it seems an amazing young fellow has appeared from your Ying Shan Clan.” Monarch Sky Yin chuckled.
Old Mother Ying Shan was full of smiles too. Though she had some deductions in her heart. She had read before some of the scattered and broken records regarding the earliest period of Realm Heart Great Land on ‘Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master’. That was someone famous for his void domain and fearless of group battles. Even Great Paragon Lu Tian who had an extremely high status in Fan Clan mentioned that Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master was not any weaker than him. Nevertheless, that era was before even the first War of the Ancient Nations. Many cultivation techniques were not created yet, and Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master died in the end due to his excessive stubbornness. If it were this era, it would be harder for him to die since many more survival secret techniques existed. Otherwise, how could even Snow Hook King with his arrogance survive?
‘Little Fellow Xue Ying, is the reason why you sought to obtain this spearhead because of this?’ Old Mother Ying Shan made her conjecture. The smile on her old face became more vibrant. It was merely 300 million cosmos crystals, yet it enabled her clan disciple ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying’ to learn such a fantastic cultivation technique and to reach such a strength. That was totally worth the price!
…
Southern Cloud Capita, within the residence of Fan Clan.
