This was also because the various powers had apprehension over this, causing the unspoken rules to arise. If they were really bullying a small organization, it was fine to just sweep them away. How would they be qualified to talk to the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation and other similar organizations about the ‘unspoken rules’?
Those who were qualified to talk about these rules were already proud sons of heaven.
Naturally, the Southern Cloud King had to obey these rules too.
“Hong~”
The shockwave from the battle blasted in all directions.
Many strands of light descended from the sky. This was light from the operating nation protecting arrays which the Fiery Zhao Capital had. They were able to withstand against those shockwaves.
“Cough, cough.” Xue Ying spat out more blood again. He flew out from the deep gouge and floated in midair while looking at his surroundings. The shockwave from the battle did not affect a considerable area. But it was still inevitable for several residences belonging to some cultivators to be destroyed.
“They dare to act in the capital without planning to hide their aura at all?” Xue Ying felt himself turning more furious as he saw what had happened.
He felt really sullen this time.
From the start to end, Xue Ying could not retaliate at all. Of course, everything happened too quickly too. Each of the assassins was a tenth level expert, and they only released three moves in total. How fast was that? Furthermore, Xue Ying was trapped in a Time Domain, making his reaction even slower.
“Xue Ying, you should return and take a rest first. This time, the Sky Sword Sect actually dispatched so many experts to deal against you. Very good. If I did not retaliate, I would be looked down upon.” The voice of Southern Cloud King sounded by the ears of Xue Ying at that moment-his voice was filled with rage.
“Teacher, I’ll naturally find them after a few days.” Xue Ying added.
“This you don’t have to care anymore. Just have a good rest.” Southern Cloud King was naturally prepared to handle things himself since he was able to position himself amongst the peak across the Realm Heart Great Land.
Just as the other party finished speaking, Xue Ying could feel an unseen aura leaving.
‘It seems teacher is going to act personally.’ Xue Ying thought. Facing the matter of the Sky Sword Sect advancing into the Fiery Zhao Nation, Xue Ying had always been the one dealing with it. It had been several hundred thousand years, yet the Southern Cloud King remained nonchalant as he watched things progress. Nevertheless, the moment the King suffered from a loss, he would definitely retaliate! Clearly, he felt that just his disciple alone was insufficient from dealing against the entire Sky Sword Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 1058 - Say That Again?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1058: Say That Again?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Fiery Zhao Capital, outside the main entrance of the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace. Marquis Qu Ming and several other disciples were here waiting a while ago.
Because the battlefield had been completely isolated, the shockwave did not leak out to the surroundings. But when the enemies left, the shockwaves were released and had alarmed more than half the experts in the city.
“Senior Disciple Brother Xue Ying.” The group of disciples was all being respectful.
Marquis Qu Ming was even looking at Xue Ying with concern.
“I’m fine.”
Xue Ying said before entering the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace. Watching the back of the leaving Xue Ying, Marquis Qu Ming and the others dared not say anything. They could feel that the current mood of this era genius ‘Xue Ying’ was not good.
Within the cultivation room, Xue Ying sat alone.
Even though the five great experts who assaulted Xue Ying were greatly startled from the fact that they did not kill Xue Ying, and felt that Xue Ying was too enduring, Xue Ying himself felt sullen. From the start to end, he was beaten. Xue Ying wanted to unleash an ‘Arch Destruction’ or a ‘Piercing Void’ at the enemy, yet he did not have the time due to being affected by the flow of time.
‘With my strength, I was actually trapped in the Time Domain without being able to break out of it.’ Xue Ying was greatly shocked. Most tenth level experts cultivating the Time Dao were not so heaven-defying, ‘His Highness Blaze Wind is a core disciple from the ‘Blaze Clan’, one of the two great clans in the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation?’
Xue Ying could naturally recognize that resplendent red-haired teen. The strand of flame rising on his forehead was too eye-catching.
Core disciples from the Blaze Clan with sufficiently concentrated bloodline were able to awaken their heaven-defying talent. Accompanied by an appropriate absolute art scripture, they were naturally strong in combat.
As for those who could not awaken? They would not be core disciples.
The reason why they could have such heaven-defying innate talent was because of the Patriarch from the Blaze Clan. He was one of the five ancestors in Myriad Realms Ancient Nation who refined his body to an unparalleled realm.
‘Hundred-Battle Devil God? Rain Dust Walker?”
Only then did Xue Ying feel the threat of death.
Every round of attack diminished close to 10% of his body lifeforce. An estimated 12 rounds of attack would suffice to cause his death! The other two who specialized in water and fire seemed weakest, but their combination had instead reduced the strength of Xue Ying’s Southern Cloud Sacred Body. Just like how a weapon would become weak when being inflicted with both water and fire simultaneously, the logic here was similar-his body would collapse more quickly.
Even though he did not lose any lifeforce from the water-fire joint attack, his body became weaker, allowing the effects of the attacks by Hundred-Battle Devil God and Rain Dust Walker to be better.
Every attack gave him the ‘smell’ of death. It also forced him to do his best to ‘void-ify’, diverting more force into the void. If Xue Ying had reached the pinnacle of void-ification, his body would be one with the void, and these attacks could not injure him at all.
‘I just lack by a bit before becoming one with the void?’
Xue Ying began concentrating.
…
His teacher Southern Cloud King moved really quickly. On the second day after Xue Ying suffered from an assassination, a group of expert had killed their way into the Sky Sword Sect Palace.
As His Highness Blaze Wind, Rain Dust Walker and the others were clear that they might suffer from retaliation, they had all hidden within the Sky Sword Sect Palace! If not for the superpowers behind them ordering for them to aid the Sky Sword Sect, they would have long fled.
“What is the outcome?” Xue Ying even came out especially to ask this.
“They battled really fiercely. It has alarmed the entire capital. The royal family and those devils from the Black Devil Great Lake were all watching from afar. After the battle, more than half the Sky Sword Sect Palace has been destroyed.” Marquis Qu Ming said.
Xue Ying felt slightly shocked.
Since the Sky Sword Sect dared to advance into the Fiery Zhao Nation, the arrays constructed in this sacred palace of theirs in the capital should be extremely formidable-likely on the same level with the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace. Ordinary tenth level experts could not break through it, yet more than half the entire palace had been destroyed. It was unquestionable that the arrays were damaged. Otherwise, the palace would be standing upright still.
‘The experts dispatched by Teacher are really amazing for them to destroy the array of the palace.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly. He understood that after knowing the strength from the Sky Sword Sect, the experts the Southern Cloud King sent would likely be stronger than the five experts. Otherwise, the King would be slapping his face by sending these experts over.
Even though the hidden powers were strong.
The Southern Cloud King himself also had some hidden powers. He could also ‘borrow soldiers’ from others. It’s only that these were experts not from the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, and they could not publicize their identities. Furthermore, some defeated the Sky Sword Sect using techniques not from the religion. Hence, this could not prove that the cultivation techniques of Southern Cloud Sacred Religion were superior! Instead, this was merely a fight in the dark between the two great religions.
On the surface, they still required disciples like Thunder King Mo Chao, Gong Liang Yi, and Xue Ying to fight.
******
After he slightly understood the outcome of that battle, Xue Ying went back to closed-door cultivation.
Xue Ying’s understanding of the essence of the void became more profound over time. He lacked by a strand before reaching the pinnacle of ‘void-ification’. But this strand was not any less difficult than breaking through to the Cosmos God Realm! Xue Ying had not taken this step yet. He had no choice. It was too hard to achieve ‘void-ification’ at the Primal Chaos Realm. Fortunately, he had seen before the scaled-armor of General Mo Gu. Otherwise, achieving this step at the Primal Chaos Realm was just a pipe dream since Xue Ying had no point of reference.
After all, there were only two great cultivation techniques in the Realm Heart Great Land that could allow a Primal Chaos expert to achieve the pinnacle of void-ification.
One was with the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation.
And the other with the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
The other ancient nations including those who had reached an extremely high realm in the void aspect like Southern Cloud King could not create such a cultivation technique at all.
…
Even though Xue Ying could not improve further in void-ification, he had met quite a huge improvement in his ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’.
After all, he merely had to reach small success.
Three months after suffering from the assassination.
“Origin Phase.”
Xue Ying looked at the void in front of him. He lightly brushed his hand on the void, causing many black fog spherical particles to move according to his control-they actually started moving. Everything was done according to Xue Ying’s wishes. One of the many layers of ‘black cloth’ actually formed into a large sphere, before turning into a substantial corporeal entity.
“I’ve finally reached this stage.” Xue Ying revealed a grin. The black fog spherical bodies were ultimately too small. Interacting with them was tough. Even by relying on the Southern Cloud Sacred Body, Xue Ying could only destroy several black fog spherical particles after using the ‘Arch Destruction’. How hard was it to control them? He had to rely on the Profound Mysteries of Void to ‘guide’ them. Once he succeeded in this guiding technique, it would mean small success in the ‘Origin Phase’. This was already a ninth level move.
It had reached the pinnacle of Primal Chaos Realm without relying on any external materials.
“Hu! Hu! Hu! Hu! Hu!”
Xue Ying thought.
Five strands of light appeared directly above the sky. They represented control towards five types of the void. One of the light strands was an incomparably massive black primal chaos, and one was incorporeal and seemed fleeting. One was surging and galloping like a tsunami in the void, and one would sometimes be pulled into a threat, and at times transformed into a fog. The final strand of light just gave off a dim glow.
“Five Phases Sealing Technique!” Xue Ying revealed a joyous look, “If I had succeeded in grasping this, how would I be afraid of his Time Domain?”
The Time Domain would suffer from a greater backlash when a more powerful cultivator was trapped within.
Five Phases Sealing Technique
This was the strongest void absolute art that the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion had, and also the most overbearing one. If Xue Ying had the ‘Five Phases Beads’, he could unleash five tenth level techniques at the same time. They could be fused together to form the ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’ that had unfathomable power.
“Teacher.” Xue Ying immediately contacted the Southern Cloud King.
“What’s the matter, Xue Ying?” Southern Cloud King asked.
“I’ve grasped the Five Phases Sealing Technique.” Xue Ying said.
“What? Say that again?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1059 - Seize!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1059: Seize!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Closely following that.
“Si la~”
A figure walked out of the cultivation room where Xue Ying was meditating at. It was Southern Cloud King garbed in a black robe.
‘Black robe? This is Teacher’s avatar?’ Xue Ying guessed. Since Southern Cloud King could create the avatar technique, his mastery in it should be transcendental.
“You’ve grasped the Five Phases Sealing Technique? Quickly! Show it to me!” Southern Cloud King urged.
“Yes, Teacher.”
Xue Ying nodded. At that moment, five strands of light appeared above them. It covered almost the entire cultivation room.
Southern Cloud King looked up at the five strands of light. At that moment, his eyes were somehow filled with obsession. He muttered: “Five Phases Seal, Five Phases Seal, my disciple has actually grasped it at the Primal Chaos Realm?”
He knew his disciple wasn’t someone to lie. But after hearing the voice transmission coming from Xue Ying, he could not help but think if he might have misheard it.
Because the <Five Phases Sealing Technique> was the strongest combat secret impartation technique he had in the void lineage. This secret impartation technique was owned by four out of the six great ancient nations. In those ancient nations, there were many secret impartation techniques, so they did not care much about this. Nevertheless, in the Southern Cloud Nation-ultimately still a tier two nation-the meaning of <Five Phases Sealing Technique> was naturally different. Furthermore, this cultivation technique was extremely difficult to grasp.
“It is hard to reach the pinnacle of a single Dao path at the Primal Chaos Realm. To reach the pinnacle in five different Dao paths…” Southern Cloud King was currently feeling waves of emotions. He had only obtained the Five Phases Sealing Technique after reaching the peak. After that did he train it to grand perfection.
He questioned himself once and knew that it was unlikely for him to grasp it at the Primal Chaos Realm.
According to what he knew, there was once an absolute genius from the Towering Sky Ancient Nation that actually grasped the Five Phases Sealing Technique at the Primal Chaos Realm. But that was just a single cultivator!
“Good, good!” Southern Cloud King looked at Xue Ying with praise.
“This is the Five Phase Beads.” Southern Cloud King took out a bracelet. There were five black beads inlaid on the bracelet. Every bead was faintly emitting light and were all emanating different aura. The Southern Cloud King let out a sigh of sorrow, “Not long after I got the <Five Phases Sealing Technique>, I had refined this ‘Five Phase Beads’. I always wanted to bestow this secret treasure away, yet I could only wait, and wait until today when the beads have finally found its owner.”
The Five Phase Beads were floating in front of Xue Ying.
Xue Ying extended his head and took it.
He extended his senses.
“Weng.”
Every bead contained a world inside. They correspond to one of the ‘phases’.
After perceiving the mysterious inscriptions inherent within the Five Phase Beads, Xue Ying suddenly looked up with startlement: “Teacher, this, this…”
He originally thought that this should be a tenth level secret treasure. But shortly after extending his senses into it, he discovered that the profound mysteries in this ‘Five Phase Beads’ was beyond that at the tenth level. Its preciousness wasn’t any lesser than the Scarlet Cloud God Spear, and might even be worth more! Because every bead of the Five Phase Beads was similar to a powerful secret treasure.
One had to know that ordinary tenth level secret treasures were worth between 500 million to a billion cosmos crystals.
Cosmos God graded secret treasures were usually priced from five to 10 billion cosmos crystals.
‘Five Phase Beads’-every bead was a secret treasure itself. If this were a tenth level secret treasure, given that his teacher was the one refining it and only required materials to cover the cost, it would cost about two billion cosmos crystals.
But currently, Xue Ying discovered that the Five Phase Beads wasn’t a tenth level graded treasure. Its value would likely be ten times more.
“Haha…” Southern Cloud King laughed, “I would never have thought that the first cultivator to succeed in grasping the Five Phases Sealing Technique is a disciple at the Primal Chaos Realm.”
Xue Ying was enlightened.
To comprehend five Dao paths to the pinnacle, this should be something a Cosmos God could grasp more easily.
“But it is too precious!” Xue Ying could not help but blurt out.
“Hold on to it. You are my disciple.” Southern Cloud King smiled, “The stronger you are, the powerful my Southern Cloud Sacred Religion is. Furthermore… you could reach this realm in five different Dao paths, which means that there is a great chance for you to break through to the Cosmos God Realm too.”
Xue Ying nodded and received it.
“Also, since you grasped the Five Phases Sealing Technique, The matter regarding Sky Sword Sect intruding into my Black Devil Four Nations will all be given to you to handle.” Southern Cloud King laughed, “Just do what you think is right. There is me supporting you from behind.”
“Yes, Teacher.” Xue Ying nodded.
******
On the next day.
“Hou~”
The Magic Dragon that was covered entirely in black scales roared. It coiled itself above the Southern Cloud Sacred Palace. And on top of this vast Magic Dragon stood a white-robed young man.
“Go, let us pay the Sky Sword Sect Palace a visit.” Xue Ying said.
“Sou.”
The Magic Dragon swam away and rapidly tunneled into the void.
Very soon.
In another location within the Fiery Zhao Capital near the Sky Sword Sect Palace, a vast coiling Magic Dragon tunneled out of the void. It floated in the sky. And that white-robed young man stood on top of the dragon looking down at the palace.
“They are still reconstructing?” Xue Ying looked downwards. The entire Sky Sword Sect Palace seemed utterly undamaged. But Xue Ying could see quite a few cultivators scattered across the place. They were currently carving array inscriptions on the area. One had to know that being a sacred palace in the capital, the arrays required that it had to withstand against tenth level experts. In terms of power, it was comparable to the ‘Flying Snow City’ which Xue Ying had.
The Flying Snow City took close to 100 million years to construct in the past primarily because of the array.
The Sky Sword Sect Palace itself was easy to construct. Given what Primal Chaos experts could not, they were able to easily finish building the entire palace in a single night. Only the array required a large number of materials and effort to inscribe!
“Who is that?”
“To dare to stand above the Sky Sword Sect Palace?”
“Do you know that Magic Dragon is worth more than a billion cosmos crystals? That white-robed young man should be the absolute genius from Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying’.”
The moment Xue Ying appeared, he attracted the attention of many cultivators. Several carriages stopped in the distance just to watch the spectacle. Fortunately, these cultivators had excellent ‘vision’.
“Hong~”
Xue Ying who stood on top of the back of the huge magic dragon seemed tiny. He looked downwards, and his voice reverberated around the world spanning more than 50 million kilometers: “I, Ying Shan Xue Ying, is here to challenge the experts from the Sky Sword Sect. During this period, I do hope for nobody to enter or exit the Sky Sword Sect Palace to prevent yourself from being implicated.” As he spoke, a surging spatial ripple had already engulfed the entire outer perimeter of the Sky Sword Sect Palace.
The void tsunami blasted out. Most eighth level experts would simply be killed by this ‘Scarlet Cloud Domain’ if they entered it.
Saying it sounded good-’to prevent yourself from being implicated’.
But in reality, this was really a matter of a ‘blockade’!
The underlying message was simple.
If you have the ability, defeat me. Otherwise, do not think of accepting or teaching any disciples. Under this horrifying void tsunami, there was nobody who dared to mix in! Xue Ying was really benevolent already. Unlike how Chang Su Wang and the others did-they did not unleash a domain before the blockade. Instead, they waited for disciples to enter the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion before directly killing them! It caused some of the ignorant outer disciples from Southern Cloud Sacred Palace to lose their lives.
“Wa.”
“Its a blockade.”
“Ying Shan Xue Ying has blockaded the entrance to Sky Sword Sect Palace. How overbearing.”
“Quickly come and have a look!”
“Ying Shan Xue Ying sat on the Magic Dragon and came to blockade the entrance to the Sky Sword Sect Palace!” Many cultivators who stood far away were currently transmitting messages to their friends. “Hua hua hua”, large batches of experts rushed over from all directions. Some disciples from the royal clans and aristocratic marquises had also rushed over on their luxurious carriages. They were all excitedly watching the spectacle.
Chang Su Wang blockaded the entrance merely to challenge the other religion. After all, that was a ninth level expert.
As for Xue Ying blockading the Sky Sword Sect! That was a clash between both parties.
…
It was bustling with activity outside. Many cultivators were here to see the spectacle. They wanted to see the clash between Sky Sword Sect and Southern Cloud Sacred Religion! After all, these were two of the top ten great religions in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, and they were both fighting for their sects in a direct battle. For the sake of their own reputation, each faction would definitely be sending out the most powerful experts. After all, if one were defeated, they would be losing their reputation including their sect’s reputation.
“How dare he? How could he be so daring to do this?” The violet-robed ‘Thunder King’ Mo Chao looked up into the sky with fury, “So what if he has grasped the Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique?”
“Hu hu hu.”
Many other figures started appearing by the side. They were none other than His Highness Blaze Wind, Rain Dust Walker, the black-robed expert, the Hundred-Battle Devil God ‘Fan Chu Hu’, the water-fire envoys and others were all looking upwards.
“Fellow cultivators, what should we do?” Thunder King Mo Chao looked towards the side.
“Don’t ask us.” His Highness Blaze Wind shook his head and lightly chuckled, “We aren’t disciples of the Sky Sword Sect. Since the others are challenging the experts from the Sky Sword Sect, it isn’t good for us to act.”
“We do not have any chance of moving out. I am an expert from the Fan Clan, so what if I acted?” Fan Chu Hu shook his head too.
“We can’t either.” The water-fire envoys shook their head too. They were subordinates of the Sky Sword King yet what they cultivated was not part of the Sky Sword Sect lineage.
The battle between sects.
A direct challenge was something the disciples had to take responsibility for. If outsiders barged in, the sect would only be mocked for lacking experts.
“His survival capabilities are powerful, and his body techniques are amazing too. I can’t defeat him.” Thunder King Mo Chao frowned. He was one of the two protectors Sky Sword Sect had. He was quite famous amongst tenth level experts and was an honorary disciple of an ancestor within the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation. But with his arrogance, he would either not act, or he would acquire victory when he fought.
The other party had grasped the Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique and was someone who could make his presence untraceable-he was already at an invincible position. If Mo Chao went, he might not lose, but he would be teased, and it wouldn’t look good in public.
“King.” Mo Chao contacted the Sky Sword King.
“Since our sect is blockaded, then we can only face him in battle. You go. Even though you might not win, make sure you make it a spectacular battle. It is fine for you not to lose the face of the sect.” Sky Sword King transmitted back.
“Yes.”
Mo Chao understood.
He had no choice.
There were only so many tenth level disciples which the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion had on the surface including those outside the nation-about ten or so. This was the same as the
Sky Sword Sect. There were some who could fight with Xue Ying without losing out. But none could really defeat Xue Ying at all! The <Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique> was a secret cultivation technique of the Fan Clan. There was naturally reasons for this being the case.
…
The huge magic dragon coiled in midair. The surrounding void tsunami was rolling out. On the back of the magic dragon, the white-robed young man ‘Xue Ying’ looked down roaring out: “Unless there is nobody in the Sky Sword Sect who dares to meet my challenge?” His voice boomed across the world.
The entire sect became quiet.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying, you are too egotistical!” Finally, a roar was heard.
A violet-robed male flew up. He had a cold look on his face as he stood in midair. Mo Chao was currently facing against the white-robed young man.
“He is here!”
“They are about to fight!”
“It is Thunder King Mo Chao.”
“Mo Chao is also one of the two great protectors of the Sky Sword Sect. He has once defeated the ‘Stone Jade Devil King’. I’ve heard that he has even crossed the ‘Ten Calamity Bridge’ from the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation and had obtained an enormous opportunity.”
Various sides were discussing with each other.
For him to take on the role as the chief manager for Sky Sword Sect’s advancement into the Black Devil Four Nations, Thunder King Mo Chao was indeed famous. Even His Highness Blaze Wind and others had to show him some respect.
“You are Mo Chao?” Xue Ying said.
“You actually dared to blockade the entrance of my Sky Sword Sect Palace! What gall! Let’s not spout any more rubbish. Receive my move.” Mo Chao suddenly roared. At the same time, he turned into a rolling thunder stream, forming an illusory liquefied figure. He held onto a similar liquid-like god sword and leaped over at Xue Ying in a flash.
“You are overestimating yourself.” Xue Ying’s voice boomed. He flipped his hand.
His palm suddenly expanded. Five faint light strands appeared on the surface of his fingers before they were used to directly grab Mo Chao!
Mo Chao who had turned himself into an electrified liquid figure felt his heart trembling. He tried escaping.
But the heaven-defying palm came down at once!
Five Phases Sealing Technique!
Space, sealed!
Even ultra-long distance teleportation techniques could not be used to escape. Any kinds of fleeing methods were futile. That large palm which was emitting light grabbed Mo Chao.
“No, no-!” Mo Chao struggled in despair, only to see countless thunder flashing by the gaps of the fingers.
“Break apart for me!”
A thunderclap flashed out from the sword.
Xue Ying’s seemingly huge palm had many gaps between his fingers. But in reality, the Five Phases Sealing Technique sealed every part of space itself, revealing no holes open. This was the perfect fusion of five tenth level moves, and its power sufficed to bring despair to other tenth level experts! There might be some Primal Chaos experts who existed in the entire Realm Heart Great Land that could break this move, but Mo Chao was still quite lacking.
“Sou.”
In front of the many cultivators who fell into a daze, Xue Ying kept his palm. The Five Phase Beads had already floated on the bracelet which he wore on his right hand. The Five Phase Beads were all currently emitting light. At the next moment, a fist-sized space flew towards one of the beads. That fist-sized space contained a thunder figure within that was holding on to a sword and struggling to free himself. The sword techniques were horrifying and strange, yet that figure was still kept into one of the Five Phase Beads.
The Five Phase Beads, any of the bead held a void world within. They were the most appropriate places to imprison the enemies.
Xue Ying felt that capturing the other party was much more beneficial to him than killing him.
“This, this…”
In the distance, there were many disciples from the royal family and the aristocratic Marquis clans. All of them, including the other cultivators, were stunned. Many of them were powerful or had high statuses, and were clear how formidable Thunder King Mo Chao was.
He defeated Stone Jade Devil King with his sword, crossed the Ten Calamity Bridge, and was one of the two protectors for the Sky Sword Sect!
But he was simply grabbed by a palm just like that?
“Five Phases Sealing Technique?” His Highness Blaze Wind situated in the Sky Sword Sect Palace felt his expression shifting, “The Five Phases Sealing Technique? How could this be? The Five Phases Sealing Technique has appeared again?”
“He actually succeeded in grasping the Five Phases Sealing Technique? A Primal Chaos expert actually succeeded in training the Five Phases Sealing Technique?” The Hundred-Battle Devil God Fan Chu Hu also looked upwards. The previous time he saw this secret cultivation technique was during the second War of the Ancient Nations.

chapters.title: Chapter 1060 - Redeeming?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1060: Redeeming?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Your Highness Blaze Wind?” Rain Dust Walker who remained quiet by the side actually reminded the other party-something that was seldom, “Hurry up and seal the space.”
“Alright.”
A scroll appeared in the hands of His Highness Blaze Wind. As he activated it, it immediately produced a dimmed spatial barrier to encircle around the Sky Sword Sect Palace. Those present-Hundred-Battle Devil God Fan Chu Hu, the black-robed expert, Rain Dust Walker, and the water-fire envoys were all sure that if Xue Ying were to unleash the Five Phases Sealing Technique against all of them, they could resist against it easily.
But what they were afraid was for Xue Ying to be quick enough and deal against a single person!
They had to admit that they, those tenth level experts who were present here, were all not an opponent of that Xue Ying. The gap was too big!
“This is truly terrifying. He actually grasped the Five Phases Sealing Technique at the Primal Chaos Realm.” Rain Dust Walker might be proud and aloof, but he still exclaimed in admiration at this moment.
“It is indeed terrifying.” The arrogant His Highness Blaze Wind looked downwards at the gigantic magic dragon which was coiling in midair, and that white-robed young man standing on its back. This was the first time he had reverence for this Xue Ying! The world of cultivation worked in simple ways. Even though having a strong background was worth being proud of, ‘strength is root’! When a cultivator was entirely transcended by another in terms of strength, he would only respect and admire the other party.
This was respect for strength!
‘Five Phases Sealing Technique, only when I fully grasped the <Three Realms Technique> would it be possible for me to ride above him.’ His Highness Blaze Wind thought, ‘But I’ve cultivated bitterly for so long to grasp the Scripture of the Past from the <Three Realms Technique>. That elder clan brother of mine with that pride and confidence has cultivated the Scripture of the Past before training in the Scripture of the Future… yet he lost himself in the future and became mad.’
The Scripture of the Past was the easiest to train.
As for the Scripture of the Future, it was possible to lose oneself within it. And that would cause the cultivator to become mad.
The hardest was the ‘Scripture of the Present’. And to fuse the three realms as one was something difficult. In history, there were quite a few who had turned mad from cultivating it. There were some who suicided too. Hence, most cultivators would pale when facing the <Three Realms Technique>. Most would only start cultivating it after becoming a Cosmos God. Some even held off training in the ‘Scripture of the Present’ until they were second level Cosmos Gods. The moment the three realms were fused as one…
The strength of the cultivator would become horrifying.
He would not be in the past, the future or the present. The attacks from the enemy could not touch the user at all. Such techniques were not any worse than the grand perfection of void-ification. Furthermore, it was more amazing in its combat power.
“Usually, only Cosmos Gods dared to train in such horrifying secret cultivation technique.” His Highness Blaze Wind sighed.
Five Phases Sealing Technique!
Three Realm Technique!
And many other horrifying secret impartation techniques would allow the cultivator to reach an ‘unparalleled’ realm. Like Ancestor Fan and several other existences, they had already reached the pinnacle before turning back to research their own Dao path and deduce some powerful techniques at the Primal Chaos Realm. This was theoretically possible.
Like the ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’, in theory, it was possible to grasp it at the Primal Chaos Realm. But how many Primal Chaos experts could reach the peak in five different Dao Paths?
It was possible in ‘theory’, yet the possibility of achieving it, in reality, was low.
And those who stood unparalleled at the apex in the Realm Heart Great Land did not really care if the juniors could grasp the techniques or not! No matter what, they would just create the method! Only those with the capabilities could understand them.
‘How powerful a cultivator is could be determined by how much effort and difficulties he has triumphed over.’ His Highness Blaze Wind felt admiration. Even though it was hard to grasp such an absolute art, the cultivator could sweep across those on the same level once he succeeded.
…
Xue Ying looked downwards at the crowd of tenth level experts within the Sky Sword Sect Palace-they frightened so much that they actually utilized a secret treasure to isolate the space. This brought a grin on Xue Ying. He then announced: “I, Ying Shan Xue Ying, is currently challenging all experts from the Sky Sword Sect. This Mo Chao is only so average that he couldn’t even resist against a single move of mine. Unless the Sky Sword Sect is this weak?”
His voice was like a wave rolling out in all directions.
Challenge!
Slapping the face!
Xue Ying was currently relying on this to give a tight slap on the reputation of Sky Sword Sect.
…
Sky Sword Sect Palace.
His Highness Blaze Wind and the others would not feel embarrassed since they weren’t disciples of the Sky Sword Sect.
“Using the Five Phases Sealing Technique to challenge the disciples of Sky Sword Sect openly? Who could be his opponent?” Hundred-Battle Devil God Fan Chu Hu shook his head.
“Don’t say openly challenging the others. Even if we seek for experts across the entire Realm Heart Great Land, those who could defeat this Ying Shan Xue Ying at the Primal Chaos Realm could be counted with one’s fingers, and all of them are favored cultivators of every great organization. It is impossible for the Sky Sword Sect to invite them at all.” His Highness Blaze Wind muttered.
In terms of cultivation technique.
The Five Phases Sealing Technique was not the strongest art at the Primal Chaos Realm. There were only about a dozen techniques that were stronger than it.
But the strongest the absolute art, the higher the difficulty of cultivating them.
There were so few in history that succeeded in grasping these techniques, much less ‘in this current era’. After all, most who cultivated that sort of heaven-defying secret impartation techniques would have a great foundation or horrifying talent. They would step into the Cosmos God Realm not too long after grasping such techniques. Just like Xue Ying, he had grasped the Five Phases Sealing Technique, and that was equivalent to taking one step through the doors to the Cosmos God Realm.
Hence, practically almost all cultivators who grasped these terrifying secret impartation techniques had become Cosmos God already.
As a result, those who were still at the Primal Chaos realm and could defeat Xue Ying were very few. They were all darlings of the big organizations! Furthermore, disciples not from the Sky Sword Sect were qualified to battle in this open challenge by Xue Ying.
******
“He can’t even withstand a single move?”
“This strength is way too frightening. I think some new Cosmos Gods might not even be able to survive.”
“Mn, Cosmos Gods also have to cultivate for a long time and gain sufficient experience before they could triumph over this Ying Shan Xue Ying! Those newly emerged Cosmos Gods? They are only at the tenth level power and aren’t opponents of this Ying Shan Xue Ying.”
Many cultivators were watching this battle from across the world.
Many carriages were floating in midair, and experts were gossiping with each other. Even Primal Chaos experts held admiration for this white-robed young man who stood on the back of the enormous magic dragon! This power was honestly frightening. The moment the ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’ was released, even tenth level experts could not escape from it. New Cosmos Gods would be captured too. They, ordinary Primal Chaos experts, would simply be swept away by Xue Ying like ants.
“This power is at the top few even within the six great ancient nations.” One of them praised.
“Such an abnormal expert actually came from our Black Devil Four Nations.”
“Amazing.”
“His name will likely be heard across the Realm Heart Great Land.”
Many people felt honored just by thinking about it.
No matter what, they were all from the Black Devil Four Nations, and this was simply a small edge in the vast Realm Heart Great Land! This was an unremarkable region, and powerful organizations like the Summer Wind Ancient Nation disdained them the most. There was the natural contempt for these weaklings. Nevertheless, an expert like ‘Xue Ying’ actually came out from this region, grasping an absolute art like the Five Phases Sealing Technique. Even Primal Chaos experts from the ancient nations would not dare to look down on him.
…
Even though there were many observing the spectacle and were discussing with each other.
In reality, quite a few Cosmos Gods were watching this battle too. After all, this was a confrontation between the Sky Sword Sect and Southern Cloud Sacred Religion! Especially the two great heroes, ‘Sky Sword King’ and ‘Southern Cloud King’, they were also watching the battle in the dark.
“Xue Ying.”
The voice of his teacher sounded.
“Teacher.” Xue Ying replied.
“Capture that one called Mo Chao alive. If you are okay with it, I’ll let the Sky Sword King redeem him.” Southern Cloud King transmitted.
“I am naturally not against it.” Xue Ying captured him alive precisely because of this reason.
If he killed the other party, he would only be earning some secret treasures.
Letting the other party redeem him!
He could earn a considerable sum of cosmos crystals! Xue Ying did not treat this Thunder King Mo Chao as his opponent. He did not have hatred for him either. After all, they were both doing these for their religions.
“Alright. Continue with your current stance and blockade them!” Southern Cloud King ordered.
“Yes.”
Xue Ying understood too. Given his current strength, the Sky Sword Sect’s plan to advance into the Black Devil Four Nations had been impaired significantly. Clearly, both parties were commencing their negotiations.
“The Sky Sword Sect has dispatched Chang Su Wang and others in the past to blockade my Southern Cloud Sacred Palace. They even killed quite a few disciples of ours, and are ruthless.” Xue Ying continued shouting out from the top of his magic dragon, “I still thought many formidable experts exist in the Sky Sword Sect. This Mo Chao is still quite courageous, albeit a little too weak. Right now, is there still anyone who dares to fight against me, Ying Shan Xue Ying?”
The surging void tsunami had already wrapped the entire Sky Sword Sect Palace.
He would continue the blockade of the sect.
And he would be blockading it for more than a hundred million years. Even though many experts from the Sky Sword Sect felt frustrated and angry, none dared to act. They held both respect and terror for the strength this ‘Xue Ying’ had!

chapters.title: Chapter 1061 - Earning a Huge Sum of Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 1061: Earning a Huge Sum of Money
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
A huge magic dragon coiled in midair. That pair of eyes which was as clear as lake cast its gaze across a huge area. It was currently in glee. In the past, it spent most of its time as a domesticated animal responsible only for pulling the carriages for His Highness Southern Cloud King. Notwithstanding, as it followed its new owner, Xue Ying, it could enjoy this magnificent view from the top!
Xue Ying sat cross-legged on the vast back of the magic dragon. He pondered: ‘There exist Primal Chaos experts who are stronger than me in the Realm Heart Great Land, though it is impossible for them to exist in the Sky Sword Sect! Furthermore, those stronger than me in the same realm could only defeat me and not kill me.’ Xue Ying was filled with confidence. His strength and the fact that he had reached the pinnacle of Primal Chaos Realm in the Mirage and Illusory Realm meant that his soul was equally strong.
‘If we continued fighting, the Sky Sword Sect would likely admit defeat sooner or later.’
‘I wonder… how much could Thunder King Mo Chao be redeemed for.’ Xue Ying thought. He wanted to rely on this to buy some Mirage and Illusory Realm treasures!
Even though it was likely that his teacher Southern Cloud King would lend him this sum of money if he asked.
But…
Xue Ying was not a ‘shameless’ person, asking for one thing before requesting for another again. The Southern Cloud King would only become furious from it. The ‘Five Phase Beads’ was given willingly by his teacher, and that was considered a huge favor already-the ‘Five Phase Beads’ was worth around 20 million cosmos crystals. This was because the Five Phase Beads had been refined a long time ago, and the Southern Cloud King did not have anyone to bestow it to. That was why he gave it to Xue Ying. Since Xue Ying had gotten such a huge gift, he dared not ‘open his mouth like a lion’.
“Weng.”
With a thought, Xue Ying sent his consciousness down into one of the Five Phase Beads where Thunder King Mo Chao was locked in.
…
This was a sealed world. Being a top-graded secret treasure, it was extremely stable. Most Cosmos Gods would not be able to escape from it either.
“I’m doomed.”
The violet-robed male Mo Chao sat cross-legged in the void looking around him. It was a piece of sealed space.
Mo Chao’s eyes were filled with despair. He was no longer struggling. He tried thinking of ways to escape, yet to no avail-he could not shake this sealed space at all.
“Am I, Mo Chao, going to be doomed like this? No, no, Ying Shan Xue Ying did not kill me. It might be possible for me to live!” Mo Chao’s heart was in a mess. Battles were frequent between organizations in the Realm Heart Great Land, and it was normal for experts to fall. Quite a few Cosmos Gods had died during these battles, so what if a tenth level expert died? It would not cause any wave at all.
“I’ve experienced so many difficulties in my life. I had even headed to the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation by myself, crossing through the Ten Calamity Bridges despite the pessimism of others. Only then did I reach my current stage.” Mo Chao gritted his teeth.
He felt unwilling.
Really unwilling.
The path of cultivation was so hard, and it was not easy for him to reach where he is. Nevertheless, a failure could possibly spell an end to his journey!
“Hu.” A blurred figure started condensing. It was none other than the white-robed Xue Ying.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying.” Mo Chao hurriedly stood up. He stared at Xue Ying with preparedness in his eyes.
“Let me see all the treasures you have.” Xue Ying said.
“What do you want to do?” Mo Chao became both nervous and alert.
“Haha, why? Are you still thinking of resisting despite where you are now? If I wanted to kill you, I could simply smash you to death using the Five Phases Seal.” Xue Ying said.
Mo Chao understood this point. He personally experienced how powerful the Five Phases Sealing Technique was. That time, it was merely used to bind him, yet that vast power was something Mo Chao could not resist. No matter how much he struggled, he could not withstand against the ‘spatial restriction suppressive power’. It made him understand that if the other seal pressed down on him, he would die!
Even if he had trained the Sky Sword Undying Body to the grand perfection, he could merely survive for a few moves.
“Here.” Mo Chao waved his hand.
At that time, many weapons and treasures flew out from the storage treasure.
Xue Ying then pointed forward, causing a thread of ripple to enter Mo Chao’s body. Even though Mo Chao wanted to defend himself, he did not do so and allow Xue Ying to probe through his body.
“At least you aren’t hiding anything.” Only then did Xue Ying took over the treasures and check them once through.
Mo Chao had a total of two formidable secret treasures. It’s a pity both were only at the tenth level grade! Actually, this was normal. To most Primal Chaos experts, powerful Cosmos God secret treasures were useless since they did not have the energy or realm to utilize them. They might even be coveted by other Cosmos Gods! Hence, it was normal for experts to be like Mo Chao. Nevertheless, those who were like Xue Ying were exceptional ones.
He owned a Scarlet Cloud God Spear, which he discovered. The Fan Clan had even wanted to buy it over from him.
And the Five Phase Beads was something his teacher, the Southern Cloud King refined. His teacher trusted his disciple to secure this secret treasure since Xue Ying had grasped the Five Phases Sealing Technique. As such, it was directly given. And the stuff which the Southern Cloud King gave his disciple, was something the King believed no other Cosmos Gods dared to snatch it away! After all, the King had once fought with several unparalleled existences in the past for the sake of building the foundation of Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.
“I’ll be taking away the treasures. As for your little life, it’ll depend on whether the Sky Sword King is willing to redeem it or not.” Xue Ying said, “If the price is too low, I can only kill you when my teacher gives the order.”
“I understand.” Mo Chao nodded. He understood that his little life was being negotiated by the Sky Sword King and Southern Cloud King now.
If the redeeming price is too high and Sky Sword King wasn’t willing to pay? He would die!
And if the Sky Sword Sect wasn’t willing to cower back between the negotiation of the two religions? He would die!
…
Seated on the back of the magic dragon, Xue Ying sealed the entire Sky Sword Sect. That was how he blockaded the place. He did not care about how many cultivators were looking over from afar.
The sky turned from day to night.
And finally, from night to day again.
…
“Hahaha, Brother Sky Sword, you can’t be blamed this time, and can only blame your luck. The fortune dawns in my favor, and it isn’t an injustice for you to be defeated.”
“I am not angry at all. After all, nobody has a say for such an amazing little fellow to appear.”
The two colossal consciousness were clashing and discussing from afar.
They had almost finished the negotiation.
The advancement into the Black Devil Four Nations which the Sky Sword Sect prepared for a long time would be ended shortly after it began! Even though the ‘Southern Cloud King’ was powerful, the Sky Sword King wasn’t any weaker either. Furthermore, he had many experts supporting him behind his back. This time, he prepared quite amply and even sent out ‘His Highness Blaze Wind, Fan Chu Hu, Rain Dust Walker’ and other experts. This was merely the beginning.
The Sky Sword Sect had prepared for a long war between both parties.
Because under normal circumstances, it was too hard for tenth level experts to have a considerable gap, and they had to rely on their experiences to fight different kinds of battle.
But, this time when ‘Xue Ying’ came out! He openly challenged the other party. And many of the supporters behind the Sky Sword Sect’s back could not replace its disciples from taking the challenge. Hence, the Sky Sword King could only admit defeat!
Not just admit defeat.
Furthermore, the Sky Sword King had made quite a huge sacrifice in the confrontation within the realm of ‘Towering Sky Ancient Nation’! He had no choice. If he did not lower his head, Xue Ying would likely continue blockading other cities in the Realm Heart Great Land and continue blockading his sect.
And ‘Southern Cloud King’ was clear that he could not force the other party too far either!
There existed an unspoken rule whereby only disciples at the Primal Chaos Realm would fight between each other instead of those at the highest level. Nevertheless, if one party was pushed to the extent that its foundation was threatened, then the king himself and other more horrifying existences behind his back might just act and break all cordialness.
Hence…
One should not be too greedy and push beyond the boundaries of the other party!
******
The sky had gradually brightened.
Xue Ying who sat on the back of the magic dragon looked up across the horizons: ‘It’s the second day. I wonder how is negotiation?’
Just a moment later.
“Xue Ying, everything has been completed. The Sky Sword King is willing to use eight billion cosmos crystals and two tenth level secret treasures which Mo Chao has to redeem his life. Let him off now. Also, your mission is completed. You can come back now. There is no need to stay at the Fiery Zhao Nation any longer.” Southern Cloud King transmitted.
“Yes, teacher.” Xue Ying then sent out a thought.
He waved his hand.
That violet-robed male Mo Chao appeared by the side. Mo Chao looked at the surrounding void, the huge black dragon in front and Xue Ying who was looking at him now.
“These are your secret treasures.” Xue Ying waved his hand before throwing out those two tenth level secret treasures.
Those two secret treasures were worth between 1.5 billion cosmos crystals.
In other words…
The life of Mo Chao was exchanged for a total of 6.5 billion cosmos crystals! This was the benefit of capturing the other party alive. Of course, it was because the wealth of Sky Sword King was quite average. If it were someone as rich as the ‘Southern Cloud King’, the enemies would likely ask for a higher price just to redeem a tenth level expert! After all, the Southern Cloud King is that rich!
As for the Sky Sword King, he had been squeezed dry by two great ancient nations and was comparatively less wealthy.
“Go.”
Xue Ying sat on the back of the magic dragon. With an order, the magic dragon swam away and tunneled into the void.
Mo Chao sighed inwardly as he watched. This time, the Sky Sword Sect had lost big time. But he was celebrating internally since he had survived at least.
“This time, the mission of Sky Sword Sect to advance into the Black Devil Four Nations has failed shortly after it began.” His Highness Blaze Wind and the others within the Sky Sword Sect Palace understood after seeing Mo Chao being released alive-the Sky Sword Sect had finished negotiating with the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.
“We had no choice. Who would have thought that Ying Shan Xue Ying would appear, and he has even grasped the Five Phases Sealing Technique.”
They all sighed.
…
Xue Ying merely transmitted a message to Marquis Qu Ming before returning to the Southern Cloud Capital.
Within the meditation ground of the royal palace.
Southern Cloud King sat cross-legged on the black grass. Behind him was a deep lake covered in a white fog. He was currently smiling at the white-robed young man who came down from a magic dragon. He felt pleased. He could even deduce that his disciple Xue Ying had taken on step into the Cosmos God Realm. Once Xue Ying entered the Cosmos God Realm, it was likely for him to reach large success in the Five Phases Sealing Technique. By then, this disciple of his would become the second strongest expert in the Southern Cloud Nation, and a dependable aide of his!
After all, he did not have many powerful experts by his side. Those who were truly strong would usually join an ancient nation!
“Mn?”
Xue Ying flew down from the magic dragon. He was able to see with a glance that there was a group of people standing beside his teacher-Monarch Chun Yu, Monarch Greedy Peng and the rest. There were also several other tenth level Conferred Kings and personal disciples. They were all waiting here for Xue Ying. Old Mother Ying Shan even grinned-she was clearly delighted. And Fourth Disciple Brother Fu Ling Yun, Fifth Disciple Brother Fu Ling Xiao were no longer envious. They were clear that they would merely remain at the ninth level strength even after their teacher did his best to nurture them.
And currently, this junior disciple brother of theirs had reached a strength that far transcended Senior Disciple Brother Gong Liang Yi and Senior Disciple Sister Ghost Li who they worshipped in the past.
On this day, Xue Ying’s name had spread across the entire higher level of Realm Heart Great Land, causing many experts to direct their attention to this small region south of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. As for the Southern Cloud Nation, it had become a hot topic already.
“Disciple greets Teacher.” Xue Ying walked up and gave a respectful bow.

chapters.title: Chapter 1062 - Seeking for Treasures
chapters.content:
Chapter 1062: Seeking for Treasures
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Good.” Southern Cloud King looked at Xue Ying with a look filled with praise. He nodded, “My Southern Cloud Sacred Religion has fought for eons with the Sky Sword Sect and has always been disadvantaged. This time, they advanced into the Fiery Zhao Nation like a torrential wave, but Xue Ying has grasped the ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’, forcing them to retreat and admit defeat, causing them to suffer from losses. Haha, Xue Ying, your contribution this time is huge so I will award you with 60,000 contribution points.”
Strictly speaking.
What the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion gained this time is far beyond the value of ‘60,000 contribution points’. But as the King had previously given Xue Ying the ‘Five Phase Beads’, it was considered making up for the difference in effort. That was a Cosmos God top-graded secret treasure.
“Many thanks, Teacher.” Xue Ying said.
“Congratulations Junior Disciple Brother, congratulations to you.” Monarch Greedy Peng smiled, “The first time you conducted a mission for Teacher, and you have earned a total of 60,000 contribution points. Adding up what I have earned, I only acquired 60,000 contribution points after becoming a Cosmos God.”
“Eldest Disciple Brother, both Senior DIsciple Brother Gong Liang and I have not reached that amount even until now!” Empress Ghost Li added. At the same time, her gaze towards Xue Ying brightened. Pride filled her bones. Even though there were a few who had been taken for her to seek pleasure, they were all considered her playthings! She had never genuinely considered them as her target for a companion. Currently, she actually felt that it was quite pleasant to entwine her life with this little disciple brother of his as Dao companions!
Gong Liang Yi watched Xue Ying. He sighed inwardly.
He had always thought that he was the most outstanding disciple his teacher had.
As for Eldest Disciple Brother Greedy Peng? Greedy Peng was originally the follower of the Southern Cloud King. When the King was in miserable straits, Greedy Peng did not leave the King, and the King was someone who treated camaraderie as something important. That was why he spent a large number of resources to nurture Greedy Peng. In reality, Monarch Greedy Peng cultivated in an art that wasn’t of the void lineage! And what Gong Liang Yi cultivated was of the void lineage, and was also the most outstanding one.
‘This Little Disciple Brother rises really quickly, so fast that it makes other speechless.’ Gong Liang Yi sighed.
“Junior Disciple Brother Xue Ying, we know that you have captured that protector from the Sky Sword Sect with a single move after using the Five Phases Sealing Technique. Everyone likes that scene a lot. Even though we all know that our Southern Cloud Sacred Religion has that absolute art, we have never seen before someone using it.” Fu Ling Xiao spoke.
“Junior Disciple Brother Xue Ying, hopefully, you can broaden our perspective when the time comes.”
All of them were saying it.
“Alright, alright, in a while, all you disciple brothers, do note that there will be a banquet held later. You can chat again later on.” Southern Cloud King laughed.
“Yes.”
Monarch Greedy Peng, Xue Ying, Gong Liang Yi, Empress Ghost Li, Fu Ling Yun, and Fu Ling Xiao acknowledged in an orderly manner.
The crowd then left to participate in the banquet that was about to begin. This was a massive victory for the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion as they had even gotten great benefits in the Towering Sky Ancient Nation. Naturally, they had to celebrate.
“Xue Ying, stay behind.” Southern Cloud King ordered.
Xue Ying was left alone with his teacher after that.
“This is the eight billion cosmos crystals which Sky Sword King gave.” Southern Cloud King threw out a wristband over to Xue Ying.
Xue Ying took it and checked through. There were cosmos crystals piled up like a mountain. He then said: “Teacher, help me exchange for another three more billion cosmos crystals from the 60,000 contribution points that I have.”
As a personal disciple, 10,000 contribution points could be exchanged for a billion cosmos crystal worth of precious materials or treasures. They could even be used directly to exchange for cosmos crystals.
“Oh? You need so many cosmos crystals?” Southern Cloud King felt startled. Nonetheless, he flipped his hand and threw over another storage treasure. The cosmos crystals gotten from the various palaces across the entire Realm Heart Great Land were eventually gathered in the hands of the Southern Cloud King. Hence, he had so many cosmos crystals that it would frighten others.
“Disciple is thinking of buying a Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasure.” Xue Ying said. After all, he was planning to purchase it, and there was no need to conceal this from his teacher.
“Oh?” Southern Cloud King’s eyes brightened, “You specialize in the Mirage and Illusory Realm. That time when you dealt against that Chang Su Wang, what you used is the Mirage and Illusory Realm?”
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Has it reached the pinnacle?” Southern Cloud King asked.
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded again.
Southern Cloud King felt his eyes widening. His heart beat even began quickening. Only after a while did he gradually calm down. He understood that he was really underestimating this disciple of his.
It was very hard to train in the Five Phases Sealing Technique already.
And techniques on the soul aspect were known for being difficult too. Just trying to grasp the Mirage and Illusory realm at the ninth level wasn’t any less difficult than grasping the Five Phases Sealing Technique. Because techniques dealing against the soul were all abstract and hardest to interact with. Just like how when Xue Ying created the ‘Illusory Realm World’, it was an entirely new world by itself with many living beings inside. All of them were beings whom Xue Ying felt were real. Each creature had his or her own personality, and their personal journey…
Such a technique was extremely frightening. Xue Ying was also the most heaven-defying talent in the Mirage and Illusory Realm within the Primal Chaos Void origin world!
He had cultivated for long periods, and after creating the ‘nine-petaled Destruction Flower’, accumulating experience and wisdom for a trillion years, only then did Xue Ying finally create the ninth level technique, the ‘Illusory Realm World’. Even with his massive talent in this aspect, it still took so long. One could see how difficult it was.
“You have such a great talent in the Mirage and Illusory realm.” Southern Cloud King sighed.
It was fortunate.
There had been quite a few cultivators who reincarnated from other Origin World into the Realm Heart Great Land. Hence, there were many more with talents higher than Xue Ying! Besides, given how deep the foundation the Realm Heart Great Land had, many unparalleled existences spent time and effort in nurturing these talented cultivators, reducing the difficulty of grasping the ninth level in Mirage and Illusory Realm than that in the Primal Chaos Void.
In the Primal Chaos Void, there had been no scriptures written by any predecessors! Xue Ying had to open up the path all by himself.
And here, he had found a total of 18 scriptures just in the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion alone on Mirage and Illusory Realm. There were even more ninth level scriptures and two that reached the Cosmos God realm! If these scriptures existed in the Primal Chaos Void, Xue Ying questioned himself—he knew that he could create the Illusory Realm World ten times faster!
Opening the path himself and being guided by the predecessors naturally two different things.
But by entirely relying on himself, even though he suffered from more difficulties during the journey, it strengthened the foundation Xue Ying had in the Mirage and Illusory Realm.
“When are you prepared to go buy the Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasure?” Southern Cloud King questioned with a smile.
“After the banquet. I’d like to leave a little earlier since this disciple is feeling slightly impatient already.” Xue Ying laughed.
Southern Cloud King nodded with a smile. He understood too that this disciple of his had already reached the pinnacle of Mirage and Illusory Realm when he killed Chang Su Wang. It’s just that he had never borrowed any cosmos crystals from the King, significantly increasing the favor the Southern Cloud King had on this disciple. The King also understood that this disciple had great talent in two lineages—the Void lineage and the Mirage and Illusory realm lineage. If this were the past, there would still be several heaven-defying disciples nurtured by the six great ancient nations who could defeat his disciple. But now? Cultivating in both lineages, the Southern Cloud King felt that in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, his disciple would be hard-pressed to find an enemy who could defeat him!
“But remember not to be complacent.” Southern Cloud King could not help but remind his disciple, “Those who are truly talented have all become Cosmos Gods. Like Paragon Jia Luo from the ‘Towering Sky Ancient Nation’, he was the only one before you that succeeded in grasping the Five Phases Sealing Technique at the Primal Chaos Realm. Currently, he is already a paragon in the Towering Sky Ancient Nation.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying nodded.
He always cast his gaze towards becoming a Cosmos God, and even sought to reach the height where ‘Sacred Master’ was!
…
After the banquet.
Xue Ying kept his aura and left the Southern Cloud Ancient Nation alone. He was currently visiting different places in search of more Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasures.
In the entire Realm Heart Great Land, there were eight pieces of Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasures at the tenth level grade that were sold to the public! The publicly acknowledged price was between 12 billion to 20 billion cosmos crystals, and Xue Ying wanted to personally check through the items before finding out if they suited him or not!
Because to him, this Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasure could not only improve his strength, it could also allow him to unleash a tenth level technique earlier. This was a Cosmos God level technique, and by using it at the Primal Chaos Realm, Xue Ying could feel how it is to utilize the move. This would be hugely helpful to his breakthrough to the Cosmos God Realm! He always sought to become a Cosmos God in the Void Dao, and he was similarly placing all his effort in this Mirage and Illusory Realm Dao path too.
He went to various places to check the items.
In the blink of an eye, Xue Ying arrived at the Black Prison Yin Sea. There was island country formed by several hundred thousand islands together, known as the ‘Thistle Flower Nation’. This was also the place that held the third Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasure.

chapters.title: Chapter 1063 - Thistle Flower Nation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1063: Thistle Flower Nation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The majority of the tenth level graded Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasures were consigned in shops owned by the apex organizations in the world like the Fan Clan.
Because if they sold to the shops directly, the purchase price would be meager! Secret treasures were much desired by experts, yet to those who did not require it, they would be useless! The Dao of ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’ was one of the rarer few Dao paths cultivated by cultivators. There were very few who actually reached the ninth level without relying on external materials!
Hence, it was hard to find ‘interested customers’ in treasures of this Dao.
When these secret treasures were sold to the shops, the shops would naturally lower the price.
Those who owned the treasures were not too willing to suffer from the loss. They rather consign it and wait for a ‘buyer’ to appear.
“Thistle Flower Nation.”
A white-robed young man nimbly appeared in midair. He looked at the distant beautiful city. That was the capital of the Thistle Flower Nation.
‘The Thistle Flower Nation is also a tier three little nation. They have just a single Cosmos God and two tenth level experts protecting it.’ Xue Ying thought. In the Realm Heart Great Land, there were quite a lot of tier three nations. Many great organizations disdained from developing in those desolate and dangerous places. Like the Thistle Flower Nation which was located by the dangerous Black Prison Yin Sea, and was a country formed from several hundred thousand islands.
Do not ever belittle a tier three nation!
Even though they might be small, those who dared to start a nation were Cosmos Gods with a solid foundation. Furthermore, these nations would usually help each other, forming a union.
Like the Thistle Flower Nation, it was part of a union located south of the Black Prison Yin Sea formed by many nations, the ‘United Star Union’!
…
The Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasures were all waiting for buyers who required them. Hence, it was not that important where they were consigned to.
Those who truly seek them would rapidly rush over to another place in the Realm Heart Great Land.
“The food here in the Thistle Flower Nation is quite good.”
Xue Ying enjoyed himself by a pub along the street.
“Sir Xue Ying, the owner of the secret treasure has stated his price. The lowest is 11.5 billion cosmos crystals.” There was a sudden transmission.
“11.5 billion cosmos crystals? That is still too expensive. I’ll have a look at it first. There are eight Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasures in total after all. I shall find the most appropriate and cheapest one out of them.” Xue Ying transmitted back.
“Alright. I’ll continue to negotiate with the owner of the secret treasure.”
Xue Ying smiled.
The reason why he was enjoying the delicacies and strolled around looking at the secret treasures exasperatingly was all because he wanted to delay and lower the price!
If one said that shops owned by those apex organizations like Fan Clan would always have a bottom line in the price and could not lower it any further, it was different for those who ‘consigned’ the items since it was all an elaborate and refined bargain with the owner of the secret treasure! The appearance of a ‘buyer’ was not often. Xue Ying naturally wanted to lower the price as much as he could. By slightly delaying for a little more time, he might reduce it by a billion cosmos crystals!
‘They are really risking their lives. Most of these are fishes from the Black Prison Yin Sea.’ As Xue Ying enjoyed the delicacies, he was able to make a conjecture that quite a few cultivators actually sacrificed their lives to fish up these fishes.
But for the sake of earning resources and cultivating, they had to risk their lives. Nothing would ever drop down freely from the sky.
‘Of the first two secret treasures, the lowest for one was at 15.6 billion and the other at 11.5 billion cosmos crystals.’ Xue Ying was calculating it. Even if it was appropriate, he wanted to get it at a lower price.
“Wheeze~”
The pub was very crowded.
There were many guests here too. Xue Ying sat by the corner in his white robe. With his void-ification capabilities in hiding his aura, other Primal Chaos experts would have a hard time discerning his real strength.
“Mn?” Xue Ying looked up. His gaze was filled with a strand of astonishment, ‘They said that the United Star Union is very chaotic, and killing is normal. But who would have thought that I would actually meet a huge scene of slaughter here at the Thistle Flower Nation capital.’
United Star Union was formed by many tier three nations, and some of them were utterly controlled by devils behind the scenes!
Killing, chaos…
Those were too frequent in the United Star Union.
Simply speaking, the stronger the country, the more stable it would be. For instance, Summer Wind Ancient Nation and other five great ancient nations, they were much more stable overall! As for the United Star Union? It would depend on the strength of the king. Some were more stable, and some were so messy that it was similar to the Black Devil Great Lake.
“Sou sou sou.”
Even though Xue Ying perceived it, other guests in the pub did not.
Many soldiers stealthily appeared around the pub, forming a vast array as they came. This array had entrapped the entire place.
“Shua.”
An enchanting green-gowned woman brought two subordinates with her and flew over from amidst the army. At this moment, she did not hide her aura at all. That enchanting and cold aura of hers spread over.
“My beloved husband, I have searched for you for a long time.” The enchanting green-gowned woman’s voice reverberated in the world. Her eyes stared at an attendant within the pub.
The moment she finished speaking.
“Hong!”
The surrounding combat array of the army was activated. “Hong~” A huge piece of the region had been covered by it. The army even produced a two-headed mutated beast figure, frightening many other cultivators to feel on the street and in the pub.
“We are doomed! It’s that ‘Demoness Xia Yin’ from the Sky Pillar Clan!”
“Teacher, are we going to be implicated?”
“See our fate!”
“Don’t let out any sound.”
Many cultivators in the surrounding including the attendants of some shops, the managers and even the guests were all scared witless. Living in the Thistle Flower Nation, they were accustomed to the occasional killings within, albeit they never have thought they would actually experience one happening. They only hoped they would not be implicated.
“Xia’er, both of us had bonded together as companions. How about living me a path to live, alright?” The attendant looked up.
“Hahaha, husband, you are really innocent. Have you never heard of the term cutting the weeds and eliminating the roots? How can I spare you? You are the final core disciple the Ba Tuo Clan has.” The enchanting green-gowned woman laughed, “Naturally if you are willing to hand over the aura-concealing cultivation technique you have over, I might be able to promise you that I’ll spare the lives of all those lowest ranking disciples the Ba Tuo Clan has, and allow them to live.”
Ba Tuo Clan was once a Conferred King Clan in the Thistle Flower Nation. They had many disciples and only after reaching the Void God level would the disciple be considered a core disciple. The majority of the others were lower leveled civilians, and most were simply released into the wild. Their number could not be counted.
Even though they wanted to massacre the entire clan, it was impossible to slaughter clean all descendants from the Ba Tuo Clan that had reproduced across the many generations.
“You are ruthless.” The eyes of the emissary ‘Ba Tuo Chen’ were filled with great hatred.
He hated his fate.
He was originally from a Conferred King clan, yet it was exterminated overnight. His father, his mother, his brothers and good friends, and many other clanmates of his… the entire Ba Tuo Residence was wiped clean.
“Hahaha, ruthless? Did you think I was infatuated with you in the past? Alright, just obediently hand that aura-concealing technique you have over, and I might just leave some of the descendants from your Ba Tuo Clan alive considering that we were once Dao companions. Otherwise, I’ll scour through the entire United Star Union and completely wipe out your bloodline!” The enchanting green-gowned woman coldly uttered.
“You think I would believe you? Go on, kill me! Kill all of us! It is impossible for you to wipe us clean. There will be a day when an expert emerges from my Ba Tuo Clan before coming back to the Thistle Flower Nation again.” Emissary Ba Tuo Chen growled.
“Hmph.”
The eyes of the enchanting green-gowned woman were filled with a savage aura, “You aren’t willing to hand it over? Seeing that you decided to conceal your identity as an attendant, the people of this pub must be helping you. Leave none alive. Also, the surrounding people will accompany in the burial too.”
The managers and guests within the pub revealed looks of horror. The cultivators nearby also felt their hearts trembling.
“You—” The emissary Ba Tuo Chen roared, “Xia Yin, why the need to implicate the innocent? Let me tell you honestly, I have gotten this cultivation technique due to my fortune, but this cultivation technique is forbidden from being spread outwards.”
“You did not obtain the original copy?” The green-gowned girl sighed after hearing that.
Most amazing cultivation techniques were forbidden from being spread outwards.
“Ai, truly a regret.”
The green-gowned woman waved her hands, “Kill all of them. Leave none alive.”
“No—”
“General Xia Yin!”
“Mercy! Spare us!”
“You are the from the Sky Pillar ‘Yang Clan’ which is also one of Sky Pillar Clans of our Thistle Flower Nation! You can’t do this!”
“General Xia Yin!”
Many sounds of mercy sounded. There were even cultivators kneeling down when they saw how things progressed.
“Wipe them out!” The green-gowned woman did not acquire the cultivation technique. She was feeling really unpleasant and murderous now as that savage eyes of hers wiped around the place.
“Yes.” The army hesitated momentarily, yet could only acknowledge the orders.
“Sigh.”
Seated at a corner within the pub, the white-robed young man who had been watching everything calmly gave out a light sigh. The strange thing was that his sigh sounded by the ears of everyone around the place. It reverberated by the ears of every single soldier, causing everyone to feel terror! The soldiers who were originally about to carry out the orders realized shortly that they could no longer move.
Not even an inch!
The green-gowned woman turned to that white-robed young man with terror. She also discovered that she could no longer move. The surrounding void had completely suppressed her, restricting her motion.
That white-robed young man sat there ordering: “Manager, bring more wine over.”
“Ai, ai!” That manager of the pub who was initially filled with despair, felt his heart trembling and hurriedly bring the wine over. He did not seem to be affected and could still move.
“This great sir, this is a matter between our Sky Pillar’ Yang Clan’ and the Ba Tuo Clan. I do sincerely request for great sir not to intervene.” The green-gowned woman shouted out in a loud voice despite not being able to move. She exceptionally pronounced the two words ‘Sky Pillar’.
Sky Pillar.
These were words that held a unique meaning within the United Star Union. It represented a Sky Pillar ranked clan within a single nation, and most usually had tenth level experts within. This was an existence that could fight against Cosmos Gods, and it was logical for this green-gowned woman to be arrogant.
“Sky Pillar Yang Clan?” Xue Ying softly nodded, “Originally, I am too lazy to intervene in this hatred and revenge of yours. It’s just that killing them all and leaving none alive… doesn’t seem right. These ordinary cultivators aren’t enemies of your Yang Clan isn’t it?”
The expression of that green-gowned woman turned ugly.
So what if she killed these ants?
“Why? In your eyes, they are merely ants?” Xue Ying shook his head, “What a pity. In my eyes, you are an ant too.”
“Peng!”
The moment he finished speaking, the green-gowned woman revealed a look of terror. Her body had exploded entirely and dissipated from the world.
The surrounding place was quiet.
All the soldiers and cultivators remained quiet out of fear. The daughter of Sky Pillar Yang Clan’s patriarch died just like that?
Xue Ying’s eyes were filled with coldness. His heart temperament had determined that he would never tolerate acts of the strong bullying the weak! Maybe when he was weak, he could not influence the Realm Heart Great Land at all. But whenever he met such a situation, he would definitely intervene if he could!
“Things are getting troublesome.”
“He killed the patriarch’s daughter, General Xia Yin.”
“Not good!”
Many other cultivators were panicking. Yet Xue Ying remained seated there continuing drinking.
“Hong~”
In the distant, a horrifying and dazzling aura descended. He was akin to a lump of eye-striking light. Endless light surged out and condensed into a human. At the same time, his furious roar sounded across the world: “Who dares to kill my daughter Xia Yin?”
“Me.” Xue Ying remained seated there pouring wine for himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1064 - A Change of Attitude
chapters.content:
Chapter 1064: A Change of Attitude
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The endless light condensed into a human. It was a furious bald-headed old man. He was emanating light, so much so that he felt akin to a ruler of all life.
“Who dares to kill my daughter Xia Yin?” His furious roar shook the entire world. At the same time, his killing intent started engulfing the whole place, chilling the hearts of those who were at the street—those cultivators felt their soul freezing temporarily and their hearts palpitating. They looked in terror at that figure. All the guests within the pub including that manager who just brought wine for Xue Ying stared with wide eyes at this new light-emitting figure that appeared in the midair.
Which civilian of the Thistle Flower Nation did not know of that terrifying existence?
“Sky Pillar King! Sky Pillar King!”
“It is the Sky Pillar King!”
“The Sky Pillar King has arrived. We are doomed. We are really doomed.”
In the entire Thistle Flower Nation, there were a total of two Sky Pillar Kings-both were tenth level experts. Their statuses were much higher than other Conferred Kings.
The person with the highest status in Thistle Flower Nation was the king. Closely following him were the two Sky Pillar Kings. The moment they were angered, many beings would die! But the civilians were relatively filled with reverence and admiration for the ‘Sky Pillar Kings’ since with them and the king around, their ‘Thistle Flower Nation’ could resist against outside enemies and devils.
If the Thistle Flower Nation did not have sufficiently strong experts, the country would have been wiped by devils.
But even if they revered them, at this moment, these cultivators felt the threat of death arriving. They were horrified, and none of them wanted to die! They even felt injustice as they had been implicated!
“I do not want to die! I haven’t even found a Dao companion!”
“No, no…”
