“I only wanted to earn more cosmos crystals and send my son to the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion and let him learn the <Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles>! But everything has come to an end. Given how angry the Sky Pillar King is, he would likely extinguish all of us with a single thought.”
The cultivators were either filled with despair and unwillingness, or they were calmly treating it.
Naturally, the soldiers were feeling incredibly joyous at this moment!
Regardless, there were practically none who harbored hope for Xue Ying since the influence of the ‘Sky Pillar King’ was too great. In the eyes of the civilians from the Thistle Flower Nation, the Sky Pillar Kings were existences that could fight against Cosmos Gods! If Cosmos Gods did not appear, then the Sky Pillar King could wipe all Primal Chaos existences. That ‘white-robed young man’ might be formidable, but he was merely emitting an aura at the Primal Chaos Realm and wasn’t as dazzling or tyrannical as what the Sky Pillar King was currently emanating.
“It is me.” Xue Ying stood there. He continued pouring wine for himself while glancing at that bald-headed old man who was currently emitting a bright light in all directions. Feeling the anger and dense killing intent from the other party, Xue Ying continued with an indifferent tone, “Why? Are you thinking of killing me?”
That bald-headed old man turned towards this ‘white-robed young man’ who just killed his daughter. What gall! He even dared to drink at this moment!
“Mn?”
All of a sudden, that bald-headed old man quivered. The dense killing intent in his heart had instantly been extinguished. Instead, he felt his body turning cold. He looked at that white-robed young man with a slight tremble. Xue Ying might have kept his aura when traveling outside the world, but he did not change his appearance at all! After all, he was located at an extremely faraway place, the Thistle Flower Nation. Xue Ying was just a newly emerged absolute expert from a small region south of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, one of the ‘Black Devil Four Nations’. Few knew of him in the Thistle Flower Nation. Usually, only most Primal Chaos experts and some aristocratic clan disciples who exceptionally paid attention to outside information knew about him.
In reality, even Xue Ying would not care to collect information on experts from the tiny nations around the faraway Myriad Realms Ancient Nation or Primogenitor Ancient Nation. Only when these experts had sufficient identity would the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion naturally transmit the latest intelligence to him.
And the aristocratic clan disciples within the Thistle Flower Nation had to collect the information by themselves.
Hence, not many knew of Xue Ying!
And being one of the two Sky Pillars of the Thistle Flower Nation-’Yang Xiong’, the old ancestor from the Yang Clan, he had naturally collected information regarding Xue Ying.
‘It is him? Ying Shan Xue Ying?’ The bald-headed old man felt his body turning cold, and his heart trembling, ‘The protector of the Sky Sword Sect, Thunder King Mo Chao, could not resist a single move in front of him. He had been captured alive directly by the Five Phases Sealing Technique! At the most, I am comparable to Thunder King Mo Chao in terms of strength! I might even lose out to him on certain aspects.’
‘The moment the Five Phases Sealing Technique appears, I’ll be doomed.’
The bald-headed old man was very clear of this point.
He lived for far too long. He was originally an ordinary civilian from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Step by step, he climbed and finally reached where he was currently. He outwitted many others, lived between life and death, and experienced far too much! Given his current strength, he had never thought of returning to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Because he was considered average in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, unlike in the Thistle Flower Nation where he could live so freely!
As for the fury and killing intent he originally had, they had disappeared totally into thin air.
For the sake of his life, he would not care about all his children at all! He had a total of 256 children, so what if a daughter died?
…
“I dare not, I dare not.”
The bald-headed old man immediately kept his aura. He descended down onto the ground and put on a face filled with enthusiasm. He even started flattering the other party! After taking a few steps, he appeared by the side of the pub and gave Xue Ying a bow with a laugh: “I do hope for you to pardon me for my actions. That lowly s**t has offended Sir Xue Ying and should naturally die! Even if Sir Xue Ying did not act, I would do so since this s**t did not even know her status.”
His voice merely sounded in the vicinity.
Only him and Xue Ying could hear it. As for the other pub guests and cultivators, they could hear nothing at all!
He might be willing to flatter Xue Ying, though he did not wish for other guests to hear what he was saying.
“What is happening?”
“The Sky Pillar King, what? Why did it seem like…”
Even though they could not hear anything, they could still see it!
Seeing that passionate smile on the face of the Sky Pillar King, ‘Yang Xiong’, and how he was even bowing as an apology to that white-robed young man.
“Wah.”
“Have we met a big character?”
“Who is he?”
“For him to make the Sky Pillar King revere him, is it a Cosmos God?”
“He should be!”
The surrounding pub manager, guests, and cultivators were all feeling delight. They could see the light at the end of the tunnel! The hope of survival!
Xue Ying continued drinking. He casually spoke: “Yang Xiong, other than this attendant, the other cultivators did not offend your daughter at all, yet your daughter Xia Yin wanted to kill all of them. This is no different from those devils from the Black Devil Great Lake. Since she so casually kills other cultivators, I can only return the favor onto her.”
“What? She actually dares to commit such acts? Previously, she was already quite ruthless, yet I’d not thought that she dared to do it.” Yang Xiong revealed a look of fury. In reality, he had already known of the savage personality his daughter had.
“Hu.”
In the distant, a figure appeared. It was a plump male. When that male appeared, many illusory flowers seemed to blossom in the surrounding. The cultivators present felt joy in their heart.
“King.” Everyone present felt truly respectful.
The incomer was none other than the Thistle Flower King.
“So it appears that Ying Shan Xue Ying has paid my Thistle Flower Nation a visit. Why did you not inform me regarding that?” Thistle Flower King smiled. At the same time, he glanced to the bald-headed old man, “Yang Xiong, since your daughter has offended Ying Shan Xue Ying, you must remember to make amendments with him during the banquet in a while’s time.”
“Definitely, definitely.” The bald-headed old man answered.
“Greetings, King.” Xue Ying stood up. He could disregard Yang Xiong, though he still had to treat Thistle Flower King with respect.
“Haha… I’ve long heard of your name, Ying Shan Xue Ying. Who would have thought that we would meet so soon? It seems Brother Xue Ying and I are fated to meet.” Thistle Flower King enthusiastically said. Just a few words and he was calling the other party ‘brother’.
This was normal too.
After all, the gap in strength between them was small. But given that Xue Ying had grasped the Five Phases Sealing Technique, it could be foreseen that Xue Ying would become a Cosmos God in the ‘Void Lineage’ sooner or later. By then, Xue Ying would be far stronger than the Thistle Flower King. After all, there was an even more horrifying existence behind the back of Xue Ying-the Southern Cloud King!
The Southern Cloud King was someone even the unparalleled existences from the six great ancient nations had to swallow their anger. Nevertheless, facing a king from this tier three nation, the Southern Cloud King could simply oppress him.
“It’s him, Yang Xiong.” The attendant by the side, ‘Ba Tuo Chen’, first felt despair when he saw Yang Xiong. After that, Yang Xiong actually postured himself lowly in front of the white-robed young man. After the death of his daughter, the other party did not even dare to fart in front of this white-robed young man!
“King.”
Following that, he saw how enthusiastic the strongest expert in the Thistle Flower Nation, the ‘Thistle Flower King’ was to the white-robed young man, chatting with him with smiles.
“Brother Xue Ying, let’s go! Come visit my palace. I have plenty of good food and drinks at my place.” The Thistle Flower King said.
“There is no need for King to be so polite.” Xue Ying said, “I still have something on and will not be tarrying here anymore.”
“Senior!”
Ba Tuo Chen by the side suddenly shouted out.
At this moment, everyone present fell into silence. The Thistle Flower King and Yang Xiong were treating that white-robed young man with such passion, so how would they dare to shout? But this shout had attracted the attention of many people, and even the focus of Thistle Flower King, Yang Xiong and Xue Ying.
This was still the first time Ba Tuo Chen was stared at by the King.
“Senior.” Ba Tuo Chen was instead looking at Xue Ying. With a ‘peng’, he knelt down heavily on the ground.
He knew that if he missed this chance, he would be consigned to eternal damnation!

chapters.title: Chapter 1065 - Primogenitor Ancient Nation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1065: Primogenitor Ancient Nation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Senior.” Ba Tuo Chen knelt, appealing to the white-robed young man in front of him. He continued, “My Ba Tuo Clan was originally a Conferred King Clan within the Thistle Flower Nation. It’s just that my Ba Tuo Clan was coveted by Sky Pillar King Yang Xiong. He even personally came over to wipe out my clan. I was fortunate to be out of the residence in the past, which allowed me to survive until now.”
“Shut up!” Yang Xiong roared out from the side, “The old ancestor of your Ba Tuo Clan plotted to poison me using an array that time when he requested to meet me! And that resulted in my action of wiping out your clan!”
“But the remaining core disciples of my clan that survived are still pursued and killed.” Even though Ba Tuo Chen felt a huge pressure pressing down on him, he still struggled to get the words out, “It is highly probable that only I am alive, and have survived until now by relying on the aura-concealing cultivation technique.”
Yang Xiong indifferently said: “After killing Ba Tuo, do you think the remaining disciples of yours are still placed in my eyes? Most likely, it is my men who felt the need to cut the weed and eliminate the root of any possible enemies! Furthermore, there isn’t anything wrong with this! It’s just that Xia Yin was too foolish in slaughtering the innocents, hence offending Sir Xue Ying. If Sir Xue Ying did not kill her, I would.”
“Alright, that’s enough.” Thistle Flower King said from the side, “Let this matter rest for now. Yang Xiong, just let this fellow off.”
“Since the King has said, I’ll naturally not pursue after this matter. Furthermore, I have never placed this fellow in my eyes before.” Yang Xiong added.
How low was the probability of a tenth level expert emerging?
How many of such experts appeared within the history of Thistle Flower Nation?
Yang Xiong had actually ordered to ‘cut the weeds and eliminate the root of the problem’ before. But in his heart, he did not care about this matter. He did not think it was possible for a powerful existence to emerge from the remaining few young disciples that would threaten his existence!
‘It is he who actually caused the death of my daughter and caused me to offend Ying Shan Xue Ying.’ Yang Xiong thought frustratedly, ‘After letting him off, I’ll just wipe him away from existence once the matter ends.’
“Senior, my Ba Tuo Clan…” Ba Tuo Chen looked at Xue Ying while begging.
“Alright.”
Xue Ying said, “Since the King mentioned for this matter to be let to rest, then let it be. It isn’t appropriate for you to remain in this Thistle Flower Nation either. I’ll be leaving in a while, and you can just follow me along.”
“Yes.” Ba Tuo Chen felt that he had at least ensured the safety of his life.
But he knew once this Sir Xue Ying left, the Sky Pillar Yang Clan would undoubtedly have ways to kill him surreptitiously.
“King, I have some other matter and will be making my move first. Many thanks for your good intention to invite me over.” Xue Ying smiled.
“Hahaha, since Brother Xue Ying has something on, I’ll not stop him then. In the future when you are free, remember to come by and visit me.” Thistle Flower King laughed back, “My Thistle Flower Nation might not be as wealthy as the Southern Cloud Nation, but it at least has some specialties and good food and drinks.”
“Definitely.” Xue Ying nodded.
“I originally wanted to hold a banquet as a form of apology. But since Sir Xue Ying is leaving now, I’d have really offended Sir Xue Ying, and hope Sir Xue Ying does not mind it too much.” Yang Xiong added.
Xue Ying chuckled.
“Hua.”
The space beside them became distorted. Xue Ying brought along Ba Tuo Chen and disappeared from the vicinity.
“Destructive Realm Teleportation Technique.” Thistle Flower King looked on while mumbling to himself. Even he as the King did not know how to utilize this technique.
“Hu, he has at least left.” Yang Xiong let out a breath of relief.
“It is fine if this daughter of yours acts cruelly outside, but she is like that within the capital too? Your Yang Clan is ultimately a Sky Pillar Clan of my Thistle Flower Nation too.” The Thistle Flower King frowned.
“It is I who did not teach her well.” Yang Xiong replied, “I’ll certainly handle this matter cleanly, and immediately prepare a huge gift to send to the Flying Snow City.”
“Mn.” Thistle Flower King softly nodded.
They had no other choices.
As a small nation, they did not dare to offend any large organizations! Behind Xue Ying was the Southern Cloud King, and that was a massive threat to the entire Thistle Flower Nation. Just Xue Ying could simply sweep the entire Thistle Flower Nation to death once he became a Cosmos God. They could not handle this matter lightly. To the weak cultivators, the rules might still be relevant within the nation.
But reaching the level of Thistle Flower King, they were the one who formulated the laws and decrees! And what did they rely on? Naturally, their strength! Experts like Xue Ying could definitely wipe out an entire nation.
…
This was a vast and boundless city. The aura coming from the array protecting it was grand, and even Xue Ying felt the pressure.
“This is?” Ba Tuo Chen looked at the city in front.
“Summer Wind Capital.” Xue Ying said, “It is one of the few biggest cities in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. This capital has a population more than the whole of my Southern Cloud Nation, much less that Thistle Flower nation! There are many experts here, and even a bunch of Cosmos Gods. There are all sorts of religions too. The Yang Clan certainly will not dare to come here and find you, and neither would they dare to act rampantly here.”
The rules of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation were strict.
Being the capital, even the three religious masters from that Black Devil Great Lake dared not come here. Even if they wanted to bring disorder to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, they would merely do it in some of the smaller cities. Even so, they had to be careful. This was the grandeur of power the Summer Wind Ancient Nation had!
Ba Tuo Chen looked at the city in front. His eyes were emitting light.
Summer Wind Capital?
This was the city spoken in the legends! How many teleportation arrays would he have to take for him to rush over? He would spend so much cosmos crystals only to despair thinking about the implausibility of the idea. The Summer Wind Capital was filled with endless possibilities!
“Alright, properly cultivate here. Your future is up to you to take.” Xue Ying stated.
“Many thanks, senior. This kindness senior has provided to junior is something junior will never dare forget.” Ba Tuo Chen knelt down in gratitude. The other party gave him a future even though they did not know each other! He was filled with incomparable gratitude for Xue Ying.
“May this junior find out what is senior’s name?” Ba Tuo Chen asked. The King might have mentioned Xue Ying’s name earlier on, but that voice had been kept under cover, and they were not something these ordinary cultivators could listen to.
“I am Ying Shan Xue Ying.” Xue Ying said. He then casually took a step into the distorting void and disappeared from the vicinity.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying. Ying Shan Xue Ying.”
Ba Tuo Chen was firmly etching this name in his mind.
It was this white-robed young man called Xue Ying that actually gave him a future.
‘There will be a day when I kill that Yang Xiong and stand in front of Senior Ying Shan Xue Ying.’ Ba Tuo Chen immediately headed towards the city entrance of the Summer Wind Capital in front. A vast sea was where fishes could leap freely, just like how the vast sky could allow birds to soar! Even though the hope of him rising was small, but this vengeance was something he would never forget. Naturally, he had to grasp every opportunity he had to cultivate within the Summer Wind Capital.
******
“Hu hu hu~”
The wind was whistling.
There were a total of 15 bright stars in the sky. Regardless if it were day or night, the ‘Extreme Night City’ in the Primogenitor Ancient Nation would forever be lit up by these 15 bright stars.
“Extreme Night City.” The white-robed Xue Ying stood in midair.
There was originally a Mirage and Illusory realm secret treasure over at the Thistle Flower Nation. But since his identity had been revealed, it was not appropriate for him to go there and have a look at that secret treasure anymore.
Because by then when he asked for a price and negotiated with the owner of the secret treasure through the shop, the owner of the secret treasure could likely guess his identity! Xue Ying did not wish for the matter of him purchasing the Mirage and Illusory realm secret treasure to be publicized! Even though the managers of the large shops that were consigned with the goods would know of his identity, the ‘reputation’ of these shops were too essential for them to jeopardize.
Since the customer did not wish for his identity to be made public, the shop would naturally keep it a secret.
To that ‘Yang Xiong’, Xue Ying did harbor any killing intent at all because Yang Xiong was an old ancestor of a Sky Pillar Clan in the Thistle Flower Nation. He was practically a local tyrant there. Several tens of thousands of islands were controlled entirely by him. Furthermore, Yang Xiong would also do his utmost to protect these islands. With his existence, the civilians under him would be safe.
That person wasn’t a devil that loved to kill as well. Hence Xue Ying would not act against him.
Looking across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
Which expert wasn’t ruthless? As long as it wasn’t a devil who killed randomly, Xue Ying could put up with these people. After all, cultivators who took pity on the weak cultivators were few and far between. Instead, existences like Yang Xiong and the Thistle Flower King were more commonly seen. Even his teacher, the ‘Southern Cloud King’, might pay close attention to his citizens, but he wasn’t someone that took pity on the weak.
According to the intelligence he knew, his teacher, the Southern Cloud King, also had a side that was cruel and overbearing!
This type of people was something Xue Ying could tolerate! Only those devils that casually killed others and even sent trillions of lives to a Blood Sacrifice were devils Xue Ying had to remove.
‘I’ve acted in the Thistle Flower Nation. Since that’s the case, the secret treasure consigned in the Thistle Flower Capital will be the final one I’d pay a visit to.’ Xue Ying walked towards the Extreme Night City in front of him, ‘Let’s go and have a look at this secret treasure consigned here in the Extreme Night City.’
The Primogenitor Ancient Nation had two’ primogenitors’. They were both unparalleled existences.
One was called the ‘Eternal Night Primogenitor’, and the other called ‘Extreme Night Primogenitor’.
The Eternal Night Primogenitor was known for his ability to refine magic servants. His attainment in this aspect was unquestionably the strongest across the entire Realm Heart Great Land! It was fine for others to refine large batches of Primal Chaos Realm magic servants as these were commonly seen in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation too. More importantly, the Eternal Night Primogenitor could refine ‘magic servants’ with combat power at the Cosmos God level. He had refined a total of nine great Cosmos God magic servants, and they were known as the ‘Nine Eternal Night Walkers’.
Every walker was absolutely loyal to the Eternal Night Primogenitor and represented the will of the Eternal Night Primogenitor. There was differing strength amongst the nine of them, yet the weakest was already stronger than Thistle Flower King. The strongest had part of the power the Eternal Night Primogenitor had, and could even fight against the Southern Cloud King!o
With these nine walkers under him…
The Eternal Night Primogenitor had incredible governing power.
As for the ‘Extreme Night Primogenitor’, it was rumored that his body had come from a blood sea in the Realm Heart Great Land. One day, he gained spirituality and sentience. He then continued to cultivate until this level. His research on blood was also the strongest in the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
A single ‘blood essence’ of his could cause a cultivator to transform qualitatively and greatly become more powerful! For instance, if a tenth level expert absorbed this blood essence, it would greatly increase the chances of him breaking through to the Cosmos God Realm. But the moment he absorbed the blood essence, the cultivator would remain loyal eternally to the Extreme Night Primogenitor. All those who absorbed the blood essence had to call the Extreme Night Primogenitor as ‘primogenitor’.
Thus.
Of the six great ancient nations, the Primogenitor Ancient Nation was the strongest in ruling strength and had the strongest cohesiveness! Yet in terms of military power, the Primogenitor Ancient Nation was ranked in the middle amongst the nations.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying walked along the vast and flourishing Extreme Night City. Experts were numerous here. ‘I’ve heard that the Extreme Night Primogenitor had a total of 15 subordinates who eventually broke through to the Cosmos God Realm after absorbing his blood essence! At the same time, there were several Cosmos Gods who wanted to research in the blood essence of the Extreme Night Primogenitor and decided to join His Highness too. Hence, His Highness has quite a few Cosmos Gods under him.’
Other than directly absorbing the blood essence of the Extreme Night Primogenitor, the essence could also be used for other purposes like nurturing insects or altering one’s fleshy body. It was even sold outside for 10 billion cosmos crystals, a frightening price.
‘I’ve reached.’
Xue Ying looked at the bright dazzling golden construct in front of him. This golden construct had a symbol showing 15 stars. This was the ‘Extreme Night Palace’, a place not inferior to the Fan Clan’s shop.

chapters.title: Chapter 1066 - Eight Secret Treasures
chapters.content:
Chapter 1066: Eight Secret Treasures
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Extreme Night Palace was a commerce power ranked in the top five across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
And within one of the two great sacred cities in the Primogenitor Ancient Nation, the ‘Extreme Night City’s Extreme Night Palace, this was the main headquarters and was thriving with business.
“Sir Ying Shan Xue Ying, please come in.” As Xue Ying arrived at the Extreme Night Palace, there was a Primal Chaos Realm manager who came to guide him. The other party already knew of Xue Ying’s identity without asking Xue Ying.
“I want to see the ‘Heart of Desire’ without letting others know about it.” Xue Ying directly transmitted.
This manager had a calm expression. He transmitted back: “Sir Xue Ying can feel rest assured. Ever since the emergence of my Extreme Night Palace, we have never leaked out a single secret!”
Xue Ying nodded.
In terms of influencing power.
The Extreme Night Palace was considered top five among commerce groups. But in terms of prestige, it was ranked first with the Fan Clan’s shop, and was the most perfect commerce business! It had never leaked out the secrets of its customers!
Leaks had occurred in the history of other commerce superpowers. After all, even the most stringent rules would not affect some of the powerful Cosmos Gods that were the ones controlling the businesses. Due to selfishness, these Cosmos Gods would naturally make use of some secrets acquired from the commerce group.
But it was different for the Fan Clan shop and the Extreme Night Palace.
Their prestige was absolutely perfect! One could see how formidable the owners behind these two commerce groups, ‘Extreme Night Primogenitor’ and ‘Ancestor Fan’ were in controlling their subordinates! Many overbearing overlords like Sky-Rending Great Paragon or Great Paragon Lu Tian could only remain obedient in front of Ancestor Fan. Much less was needed to speak about Extreme Night Primogenitor for those who absorbed his blood essence would remain eternally loyal to him.
“Sir Ying Shan Xue Ying, please wait here momentarily.” The manager led Xue Ying into a resting hall, “In a while, the Heart of Desire will be sent over.”
“Alright.” Xue Ying sat down cross-legged. He was enjoying the excellent wine that was warmed to the right temperature in front of him.
Just a moment later.
The black-robed manager entered once again. He flipped his hand, causing a wooden cane to appear in front of Xue Ying. This wooden cane was embedded with a palm-sized black stone.
“Can I have a closer look at it?” Xue Ying asked.
“Naturally.” The black-robed manager smiled. Ordinary Primal Chaos experts were not qualified to take a closer look at treasures worth over 10 billion cosmos crystals, but Xue Ying was absolutely not categorized in the former.
Xue Ying held onto this seemingly ordinary cane. Xue Ying then turned is attention to that black stone embedded on it. Just merely gazing at it, Xue Ying could feel a strong, alluring power coming from the ‘black stone’, forcing him to stare at it unknowingly. It felt as if the stone wanted to pull him into a dream, though Xue Ying was an expert that reached the ninth level realm in the Mirage and Illusory realm Dao, and was able to easily maintain his consciousness.
“Weng.”
He permeated his consciousness into it.
The black stone was the true ‘Heart of Desire’. The wooden cane was meant to protect this black stone.
“Dong dong…”
At that moment when Xue Ying cast his consciousness into that black stone, he felt the stone expanding and contracting at the same time. It felt like a heartbeat. Xue Ying remained unmoved. Gradually, he ‘saw’ it. In that vast world filled with endless pink fog, many beings were reproducing and living within. Nevertheless, the desire of the creatures within this world was intense.
For the sake of love, hatred, greed, lust, pleasure, fright, happiness… all sorts of emotional desires caused the world to be filled with endless war.
“World.”
“Desire.”
Xue Ying revealed a joyous look.
After reaching the pinnacle of Primal Chaos Realm, there were only several paths in the Void Lineage which led to the Cosmos God Realm. Xue Ying had grasped the Five Phases Sealing Technique, and that was practically half of all available Dao paths.
Similar logic.
The Mirage and Illusory Realm had several branches too. Xue Ying primarily cultivated the branch of the ‘world’ and was also relatively good in the ‘slaughter’ path. After all, his ‘Nine-petaled Flower’ was a horrifying killing move condensed directly from the Mirage and Illusory Realm world with part of the profound mysteries from the Dao of Slaughter being added to it.
‘There are primarily two branches in the Heart of Desire. One is on the Path of the World and the other on the Path of Desire.’ Xue Ying thought.
‘Desire’ was also another commonly seen branch in the aspect of Mirage and Illusory realm.
By immersing into one’s desire, one would similarly be falling deep into an illusion…
‘This treasure is not bad.’ Xue Ying felt relatively joyful, ‘There is the Path of World inherent within. I believe that I should be able to improve to the tenth level power shortly after comprehending it for a while. Furthermore, this treasure even guides me on my journey to the Cosmos God Realm! And the ‘Path of Desire’… is something which I can cultivate after becoming a Cosmos God.”
“Dong.”
Xue Ying placed the wooden cane on the table.
“Sir Ying Shan Xue Ying, how is it?” The manager chuckled and asked, albeit he was shocked inwardly. Xue Ying seemed not to be affected at all despite sending his consciousness in? Those with slightly weaker souls might be able to resist against the treasure, but they would still be influenced to a certain extent.
“Does Sir Ying Shan Xue Ying like this Heart of Desire?” The manager laughed.
Of course!
He liked it! This was a treasure that could allow him to rapidly grasp a tenth level Mirage and Illusory Realm technique, and it could similarly broaden his perspective by cultivating the ‘Path of Desire’.
“How much?” Xue Ying asked.
The black-robed manager grinned, “20 billion cosmos crystals.”
“Don’t state the calling price. What is the lowest possible price?” Xue Ying asked directly.
“This is a weapon that contains two tenth level techniques.” The black-robed manager said, “One is on desire, and the other is on the world. Using both profound mysteries together, even ordinary Cosmos Gods will find it hard to resist against this move. Even if they could, their strength would be greatly affected.”
Xue Ying had to admit.
Both paths supported each other pretty well.
With the ‘world’, it was able to lure in the other party’s soul, engulfing it into a world. For instance, Xue Ying’s illusory realm could easily engulf those with weaker souls into it.
And with a similarly strong ‘desire’ technique, under the guidance of desire, it would greatly diminish the enemies’ resisting power, causing them to fall deeper into the illusory realm. It would be a multitude times harder to struggle out of it then.
“Even though there are two tenth level techniques, one must be able to use them before it is even useful.” Xue Ying said, “It is hard to grasp a single technique, what about two? Maybe a genius might have reached the pinnacle in both Dao paths in the ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’ Lineage! But what are the possibilities of a genius popping up who reached the pinnacle in these two paths coincidentally?”
“As for those who broke through to the Cosmos Gods in the Mirage and Illusory Realm Lineage, they would not care that much about a tenth level grade secret treasure. After all, they could directly unleash tenth level move without relying on it.” Xue Ying indifferently spoke, “However, given such a high price, there is no point in discussing further.”
“The consignee has mentioned that the lowest price he could accept is 16 billion cosmos crystals.” The black-robed manager answered.
“Then let him continue waiting further.”
Xue Ying stood up.
“Rest assure, I’ll ask the consignee again.” The black-robed manager said.
“The secret treasure is not bad, just that its price is too much. There are a total of eight pieces sold to the public in the Realm Heart Great Land currently, and some are much cheaper than this. I’ll go and have a look at the others.” Xue Ying stood up and left. He did not wish to discuss further with the black-robed manager since the manager did not have the power to call the price. He was merely a middleman, and everything was determined by that consignee of the secret treasure.
…
Xue Ying traveled across the Realm Heart Great Land. At the same time when he visited different places to have a closer look at the Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasures, he was also widening his experiences.
He had even paid a visit to Icy Snow Ancient Nation to see the gigantic cultivators there. In terms of ‘body refining cultivation system’, the Icy Snow Ancient Nation was unquestionably the strongest! Because the Icy Snow Ancient Nation had three old ancestors who reached the unparalleled realm. Those three old ancestors had reached the pinnacle in body cultivation, and hence, if one sought to cultivate a robust fleshy body, the religions from Icy Snow Ancient Nation would be the best bet. What a pity that the Icy Snow Ancient Nation was slightly more discriminatory to those from outside the nation.
‘There is just one last piece left.’
Slightly more than two months later.
Xue Ying arrived at the Thistle Flower Nation once again. That secret treasure in the capital of the Thistle Flower Nation had become the final one which he would be checking out.
Of all the secret treasures which he inspected, the cheapest cost 8.5 billion cosmos crystals and the most expensive reached a high of 16 billion cosmos crystals. Currently, Xue Ying felt the most tempted with that ‘Heart of Desire’, yet it’s a pity that the price of that treasure was lowered only to 15 billion cosmos crystals currently. This price was a great burden to him. Xue Ying could barely afford it only after exchanging all the ‘60,000 contribution points’ his teacher gave him into cosmos crystals.
By then, his avatar could no longer cultivate the Southern Cloud Sacred Body.
“Sir Xue Ying.” Within the Fan Clan shop in Thistle Flower Nation, under Xue Ying’s request to keep his identity a secret, the manager brought him into a hall.
“This is the ‘Devil Heart Bell’.” The manager smiled as he placed a golden bell in front of Xue Ying.
Xue Ying stared at this golden bell in front of him. This was the final piece. After perusing through all the secret treasures sold to the public, he would soon be choosing the right one to buy.
He then casually took up this Devil Heart Bell.

chapters.title: Chapter 1067 - A Change of Attitude
chapters.content:
1067  A Change of Attitude
The endless light condensed into a human. It was a furious bald-headed old man. He was emanating light, so much so that he felt akin to a ruler of all life.
"Who dares to kill my daughter Xia Yin?" His furious roar shook the entire world. At the same time, his killing intent started engulfing the whole place, chilling the hearts of those who were at the street—
those cultivators felt their soul freezing temporarily and their hearts palpitating. They looked in terror at that figure. All the guests within the pub including that manager who just brought wine for Xue Ying stared with wide eyes at this new light-emitting figure that appeared in the midair.
Which civilian of the Thistle Flower Nation did not know of that terrifying existence?
"Sky Pillar King! Sky Pillar King!"
"It is the Sky Pillar King!"
"The Sky Pillar King has arrived. We are doomed. We are really doomed."
In the entire Thistle Flower Nation, there were a total of two Sky Pillar Kings–both were tenth level experts. Their statuses were much higher than other Conferred Kings.
The person with the highest status in Thistle Flower Nation was the king. Closely following him were the two Sky Pillar Kings. The moment they were angered, many beings would die! But the civilians were relatively filled with reverence and admiration for the 'Sky Pillar Kings' since with them and the king around, their 'Thistle Flower Nation' could resist against outside enemies and devils.
If the Thistle Flower Nation did not have sufficiently strong experts, the country would have been wiped by devils.
But even if they revered them, at this moment, these cultivators felt the threat of death arriving. They were horrified, and none of them wanted to die! They even felt injustice as they had been implicated!
"I do not want to die! I haven't even found a Dao companion!"
"No, no…"
"I only wanted to earn more cosmos crystals and send my son to the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion and let him learn the <Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles>! But everything has come to an end. Given how angry the Sky Pillar King is, he would likely extinguish all of us with a single thought."
The cultivators were either filled with despair and unwillingness, or they were calmly treating it.
Naturally, the soldiers were feeling incredibly joyous at this moment!
Regardless, there were practically none who harbored hope for Xue Ying since the influence of the 'Sky Pillar King' was too great. In the eyes of the civilians from the Thistle Flower Nation, the Sky Pillar Kings were existences that could fight against Cosmos Gods! If Cosmos Gods did not appear, then the Sky Pillar King could wipe all Primal Chaos existences. That 'white-robed young man' might be formidable, but he was merely emitting an aura at the Primal Chaos Realm and wasn't as dazzling or tyrannical as what the Sky Pillar King was currently emanating.
"It is me." Xue Ying stood there. He continued pouring wine for himself while glancing at that bald-headed old man who was currently emitting a bright light in all directions. Feeling the anger and dense killing intent from the other party, Xue Ying continued with an indifferent tone, "Why? Are you thinking of killing me?"
That bald-headed old man turned towards this 'white-robed young man' who just killed his daughter. What gall! He even dared to drink at this moment!
"Mn?"
All of a sudden, that bald-headed old man quivered. The dense killing intent in his heart had instantly been extinguished. Instead, he felt his body turning cold. He looked at that white-robed young man with a slight tremble. Xue Ying might have kept his aura when traveling outside the world, but he did not change his appearance at all! After all, he was located at an extremely faraway place, the Thistle Flower Nation. Xue Ying was just a newly emerged absolute expert from a small region south of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, one of the 'Black Devil Four Nations'. Few knew of him in the Thistle Flower Nation. Usually, only most Primal Chaos experts and some aristocratic clan disciples who exceptionally paid attention to outside information knew about him.
In reality, even Xue Ying would not care to collect information on experts from the tiny nations around the faraway Myriad Realms Ancient Nation or Primogenitor Ancient Nation. Only when these experts had sufficient identity would the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion naturally transmit the latest intelligence to him.
And the aristocratic clan disciples within the Thistle Flower Nation had to collect the information by themselves.
Hence, not many knew of Xue Ying!
And being one of the two Sky Pillars of the Thistle Flower Nation–'Yang Xiong', the old ancestor from the Yang Clan, he had naturally collected information regarding Xue Ying.
'It is him? Ying Shan Xue Ying?' The bald-headed old man felt his body turning cold, and his heart trembling, 'The protector of the Sky Sword Sect, Thunder King Mo Chao, could not resist a single move in front of him. He had been captured alive directly by the Five Phases Sealing Technique! At the most, I am comparable to Thunder King Mo Chao in terms of strength! I might even lose out to him on certain aspects.'
'The moment the Five Phases Sealing Technique appears, I'll be doomed.'
The bald-headed old man was very clear of this point.
He lived for far too long. He was originally an ordinary civilian from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Step by step, he climbed and finally reached where he was currently. He outwitted many others, lived between life and death, and experienced far too much! Given his current strength, he had never thought of returning to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Because he was considered average in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, unlike in the Thistle Flower Nation where he could live so freely!
As for the fury and killing intent he originally had, they had disappeared totally into thin air.
For the sake of his life, he would not care about all his children at all! He had a total of 256 children, so what if a daughter died?
...
"I dare not, I dare not."
The bald-headed old man immediately kept his aura. He descended down onto the ground and put on a face filled with enthusiasm. He even started flattering the other party! After taking a few steps, he appeared by the side of the pub and gave Xue Ying a bow with a laugh: "I do hope for you to pardon me for my actions. That lowly s**t has offended Sir Xue Ying and should naturally die! Even if Sir Xue Ying did not act, I would do so since this s**t did not even know her status."
His voice merely sounded in the vicinity.
Only him and Xue Ying could hear it. As for the other pub guests and cultivators, they could hear nothing at all!
He might be willing to flatter Xue Ying, though he did not wish for other guests to hear what he was saying.
"What is happening?"
"The Sky Pillar King, what? Why did it seem like…"
Even though they could not hear anything, they could still see it!
Seeing that passionate smile on the face of the Sky Pillar King, 'Yang Xiong', and how he was even bowing as an apology to that white-robed young man.
"Wah."
"Have we met a big character?"
"Who is he?"
"For him to make the Sky Pillar King revere him, is it a Cosmos God?"
"He should be!"
The surrounding pub manager, guests, and cultivators were all feeling delight. They could see the light at the end of the tunnel! The hope of survival!
Xue Ying continued drinking. He casually spoke: "Yang Xiong, other than this attendant, the other cultivators did not offend your daughter at all, yet your daughter Xia Yin wanted to kill all of them. This is no different from those devils from the Black Devil Great Lake. Since she so casually kills other cultivators, I can only return the favor onto her."
"What? She actually dares to commit such acts? Previously, she was already quite ruthless, yet I'd not thought that she dared to do it." Yang Xiong revealed a look of fury. In reality, he had already known of the savage personality his daughter had.
"Hu."
In the distant, a figure appeared. It was a plump male. When that male appeared, many illusory flowers seemed to blossom in the surrounding. The cultivators present felt joy in their heart.
"King." Everyone present felt truly respectful.
The incomer was none other than the Thistle Flower King.
"So it appears that Ying Shan Xue Ying has paid my Thistle Flower Nation a visit. Why did you not inform me regarding that?" Thistle Flower King smiled. At the same time, he glanced to the bald-headed old man, "Yang Xiong, since your daughter has offended Ying Shan Xue Ying, you must remember to make amendments with him during the banquet in a while's time."
"Definitely, definitely." The bald-headed old man answered.
"Greetings, King." Xue Ying stood up. He could disregard Yang Xiong, though he still had to treat Thistle Flower King with respect.
"Haha… I've long heard of your name, Ying Shan Xue Ying. Who would have thought that we would meet so soon? It seems Brother Xue Ying and I are fated to meet." Thistle Flower King enthusiastically said. Just a few words and he was calling the other party 'brother'.
This was normal too.
After all, the gap in strength between them was small. But given that Xue Ying had grasped the Five Phases Sealing Technique, it could be foreseen that Xue Ying would become a Cosmos God in the 'Void Lineage' sooner or later. By then, Xue Ying would be far stronger than the Thistle Flower King. After all, there was an even more horrifying existence behind the back of Xue Ying–the Southern Cloud King!
The Southern Cloud King was someone even the unparalleled existences from the six great ancient nations had to swallow their anger. Nevertheless, facing a king from this tier three nation, the Southern Cloud King could simply oppress him.
"It's him, Yang Xiong." The attendant by the side, 'Ba Tuo Chen', first felt despair when he saw Yang Xiong. After that, Yang Xiong actually postured himself lowly in front of the white-robed young man. After the death of his daughter, the other party did not even dare to fart in front of this white-robed young man!
"King."
Following that, he saw how enthusiastic the strongest expert in the Thistle Flower Nation, the 'Thistle Flower King' was to the white-robed young man, chatting with him with smiles.
"Brother Xue Ying, let's go! Come visit my palace. I have plenty of good food and drinks at my place." The Thistle Flower King said.
"There is no need for King to be so polite." Xue Ying said, "I still have something on and will not be tarrying here anymore."
"Senior!"
Ba Tuo Chen by the side suddenly shouted out.
At this moment, everyone present fell into silence. The Thistle Flower King and Yang Xiong were treating that white-robed young man with such passion, so how would they dare to shout? But this shout had attracted the attention of many people, and even the focus of Thistle Flower King, Yang Xiong and Xue Ying.
This was still the first time Ba Tuo Chen was stared at by the King.
"Senior." Ba Tuo Chen was instead looking at Xue Ying. With a 'peng', he knelt down heavily on the ground.
He knew that if he missed this chance, he would be consigned to eternal damnation!

chapters.title: Chapter 1068 - Primogenitor Ancient Nation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1068: Primogenitor Ancient Nation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Senior.” Ba Tuo Chen knelt, appealing to the white-robed young man in front of him. He continued, “My Ba Tuo Clan was originally a Conferred King Clan within the Thistle Flower Nation. It’s just that my Ba Tuo Clan was coveted by Sky Pillar King Yang Xiong. He even personally came over to wipe out my clan. I was fortunate to be out of the residence in the past, which allowed me to survive until now.”
“Shut up!” Yang Xiong roared out from the side, “The old ancestor of your Ba Tuo Clan plotted to poison me using an array that time when he requested to meet me! And that resulted in my action of wiping out your clan!”
“But the remaining core disciples of my clan that survived are still pursued and killed.” Even though Ba Tuo Chen felt a huge pressure pressing down on him, he still struggled to get the words out, “It is highly probable that only I am alive, and have survived until now by relying on the aura-concealing cultivation technique.”
Yang Xiong indifferently said: “After killing Ba Tuo, do you think the remaining disciples of yours are still placed in my eyes? Most likely, it is my men who felt the need to cut the weed and eliminate the root of any possible enemies! Furthermore, there isn’t anything wrong with this! It’s just that Xia Yin was too foolish in slaughtering the innocents, hence offending Sir Xue Ying. If Sir Xue Ying did not kill her, I would.”
“Alright, that’s enough.” Thistle Flower King said from the side, “Let this matter rest for now. Yang Xiong, just let this fellow off.”
“Since the King has said, I’ll naturally not pursue after this matter. Furthermore, I have never placed this fellow in my eyes before.” Yang Xiong added.
How low was the probability of a tenth level expert emerging?
How many of such experts appeared within the history of Thistle Flower Nation?
Yang Xiong had actually ordered to ‘cut the weeds and eliminate the root of the problem’ before. But in his heart, he did not care about this matter. He did not think it was possible for a powerful existence to emerge from the remaining few young disciples that would threaten his existence!
‘It is he who actually caused the death of my daughter and caused me to offend Ying Shan Xue Ying.’ Yang Xiong thought frustratedly, ‘After letting him off, I’ll just wipe him away from existence once the matter ends.’
“Senior, my Ba Tuo Clan…” Ba Tuo Chen looked at Xue Ying while begging.
“Alright.”
Xue Ying said, “Since the King mentioned for this matter to be let to rest, then let it be. It isn’t appropriate for you to remain in this Thistle Flower Nation either. I’ll be leaving in a while, and you can just follow me along.”
“Yes.” Ba Tuo Chen felt that he had at least ensured the safety of his life.
But he knew once this Sir Xue Ying left, the Sky Pillar Yang Clan would undoubtedly have ways to kill him surreptitiously.
“King, I have some other matter and will be making my move first. Many thanks for your good intention to invite me over.” Xue Ying smiled.
“Hahaha, since Brother Xue Ying has something on, I’ll not stop him then. In the future when you are free, remember to come by and visit me.” Thistle Flower King laughed back, “My Thistle Flower Nation might not be as wealthy as the Southern Cloud Nation, but it at least has some specialties and good food and drinks.”
“Definitely.” Xue Ying nodded.
“I originally wanted to hold a banquet as a form of apology. But since Sir Xue Ying is leaving now, I’d have really offended Sir Xue Ying, and hope Sir Xue Ying does not mind it too much.” Yang Xiong added.
Xue Ying chuckled.
“Hua.”
The space beside them became distorted. Xue Ying brought along Ba Tuo Chen and disappeared from the vicinity.
“Destructive Realm Teleportation Technique.” Thistle Flower King looked on while mumbling to himself. Even he as the King did not know how to utilize this technique.
“Hu, he has at least left.” Yang Xiong let out a breath of relief.
“It is fine if this daughter of yours acts cruelly outside, but she is like that within the capital too? Your Yang Clan is ultimately a Sky Pillar Clan of my Thistle Flower Nation too.” The Thistle Flower King frowned.
“It is I who did not teach her well.” Yang Xiong replied, “I’ll certainly handle this matter cleanly, and immediately prepare a huge gift to send to the Flying Snow City.”
“Mn.” Thistle Flower King softly nodded.
They had no other choices.
As a small nation, they did not dare to offend any large organizations! Behind Xue Ying was the Southern Cloud King, and that was a massive threat to the entire Thistle Flower Nation. Just Xue Ying could simply sweep the entire Thistle Flower Nation to death once he became a Cosmos God. They could not handle this matter lightly. To the weak cultivators, the rules might still be relevant within the nation.
But reaching the level of Thistle Flower King, they were the one who formulated the laws and decrees! And what did they rely on? Naturally, their strength! Experts like Xue Ying could definitely wipe out an entire nation.
…
This was a vast and boundless city. The aura coming from the array protecting it was grand, and even Xue Ying felt the pressure.
“This is?” Ba Tuo Chen looked at the city in front.
“Summer Wind Capital.” Xue Ying said, “It is one of the few biggest cities in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. This capital has a population more than the whole of my Southern Cloud Nation, much less that Thistle Flower nation! There are many experts here, and even a bunch of Cosmos Gods. There are all sorts of religions too. The Yang Clan certainly will not dare to come here and find you, and neither would they dare to act rampantly here.”
The rules of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation were strict.
Being the capital, even the three religious masters from that Black Devil Great Lake dared not come here. Even if they wanted to bring disorder to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, they would merely do it in some of the smaller cities. Even so, they had to be careful. This was the grandeur of power the Summer Wind Ancient Nation had!
Ba Tuo Chen looked at the city in front. His eyes were emitting light.
Summer Wind Capital?
This was the city spoken in the legends! How many teleportation arrays would he have to take for him to rush over? He would spend so much cosmos crystals only to despair thinking about the implausibility of the idea. The Summer Wind Capital was filled with endless possibilities!
“Alright, properly cultivate here. Your future is up to you to take.” Xue Ying stated.
“Many thanks, senior. This kindness senior has provided to junior is something junior will never dare forget.” Ba Tuo Chen knelt down in gratitude. The other party gave him a future even though they did not know each other! He was filled with incomparable gratitude for Xue Ying.
“May this junior find out what is senior’s name?” Ba Tuo Chen asked. The King might have mentioned Xue Ying’s name earlier on, but that voice had been kept under cover, and they were not something these ordinary cultivators could listen to.
“I am Ying Shan Xue Ying.” Xue Ying said. He then casually took a step into the distorting void and disappeared from the vicinity.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying. Ying Shan Xue Ying.”
Ba Tuo Chen was firmly etching this name in his mind.
It was this white-robed young man called Xue Ying that actually gave him a future.
‘There will be a day when I kill that Yang Xiong and stand in front of Senior Ying Shan Xue Ying.’ Ba Tuo Chen immediately headed towards the city entrance of the Summer Wind Capital in front. A vast sea was where fishes could leap freely, just like how the vast sky could allow birds to soar! Even though the hope of him rising was small, but this vengeance was something he would never forget. Naturally, he had to grasp every opportunity he had to cultivate within the Summer Wind Capital.
******
“Hu hu hu~”
The wind was whistling.
There were a total of 15 bright stars in the sky. Regardless if it were day or night, the ‘Extreme Night City’ in the Primogenitor Ancient Nation would forever be lit up by these 15 bright stars.
“Extreme Night City.” The white-robed Xue Ying stood in midair.
There was originally a Mirage and Illusory realm secret treasure over at the Thistle Flower Nation. But since his identity had been revealed, it was not appropriate for him to go there and have a look at that secret treasure anymore.
Because by then when he asked for a price and negotiated with the owner of the secret treasure through the shop, the owner of the secret treasure could likely guess his identity! Xue Ying did not wish for the matter of him purchasing the Mirage and Illusory realm secret treasure to be publicized! Even though the managers of the large shops that were consigned with the goods would know of his identity, the ‘reputation’ of these shops were too essential for them to jeopardize.
Since the customer did not wish for his identity to be made public, the shop would naturally keep it a secret.
To that ‘Yang Xiong’, Xue Ying did harbor any killing intent at all because Yang Xiong was an old ancestor of a Sky Pillar Clan in the Thistle Flower Nation. He was practically a local tyrant there. Several tens of thousands of islands were controlled entirely by him. Furthermore, Yang Xiong would also do his utmost to protect these islands. With his existence, the civilians under him would be safe.
That person wasn’t a devil that loved to kill as well. Hence Xue Ying would not act against him.
Looking across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
Which expert wasn’t ruthless? As long as it wasn’t a devil who killed randomly, Xue Ying could put up with these people. After all, cultivators who took pity on the weak cultivators were few and far between. Instead, existences like Yang Xiong and the Thistle Flower King were more commonly seen. Even his teacher, the ‘Southern Cloud King’, might pay close attention to his citizens, but he wasn’t someone that took pity on the weak.
According to the intelligence he knew, his teacher, the Southern Cloud King, also had a side that was cruel and overbearing!
This type of people was something Xue Ying could tolerate! Only those devils that casually killed others and even sent trillions of lives to a Blood Sacrifice were devils Xue Ying had to remove.
‘I’ve acted in the Thistle Flower Nation. Since that’s the case, the secret treasure consigned in the Thistle Flower Capital will be the final one I’d pay a visit to.’ Xue Ying walked towards the Extreme Night City in front of him, ‘Let’s go and have a look at this secret treasure consigned here in the Extreme Night City.’
The Primogenitor Ancient Nation had two’ primogenitors’. They were both unparalleled existences.
One was called the ‘Eternal Night Primogenitor’, and the other called ‘Extreme Night Primogenitor’.
The Eternal Night Primogenitor was known for his ability to refine magic servants. His attainment in this aspect was unquestionably the strongest across the entire Realm Heart Great Land! It was fine for others to refine large batches of Primal Chaos Realm magic servants as these were commonly seen in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation too. More importantly, the Eternal Night Primogenitor could refine ‘magic servants’ with combat power at the Cosmos God level. He had refined a total of nine great Cosmos God magic servants, and they were known as the ‘Nine Eternal Night Walkers’.
Every walker was absolutely loyal to the Eternal Night Primogenitor and represented the will of the Eternal Night Primogenitor. There was differing strength amongst the nine of them, yet the weakest was already stronger than Thistle Flower King. The strongest had part of the power the Eternal Night Primogenitor had, and could even fight against the Southern Cloud King!o
With these nine walkers under him…
The Eternal Night Primogenitor had incredible governing power.
As for the ‘Extreme Night Primogenitor’, it was rumored that his body had come from a blood sea in the Realm Heart Great Land. One day, he gained spirituality and sentience. He then continued to cultivate until this level. His research on blood was also the strongest in the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
A single ‘blood essence’ of his could cause a cultivator to transform qualitatively and greatly become more powerful! For instance, if a tenth level expert absorbed this blood essence, it would greatly increase the chances of him breaking through to the Cosmos God Realm. But the moment he absorbed the blood essence, the cultivator would remain loyal eternally to the Extreme Night Primogenitor. All those who absorbed the blood essence had to call the Extreme Night Primogenitor as ‘primogenitor’.
Thus.
Of the six great ancient nations, the Primogenitor Ancient Nation was the strongest in ruling strength and had the strongest cohesiveness! Yet in terms of military power, the Primogenitor Ancient Nation was ranked in the middle amongst the nations.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying walked along the vast and flourishing Extreme Night City. Experts were numerous here. ‘I’ve heard that the Extreme Night Primogenitor had a total of 15 subordinates who eventually broke through to the Cosmos God Realm after absorbing his blood essence! At the same time, there were several Cosmos Gods who wanted to research in the blood essence of the Extreme Night Primogenitor and decided to join His Highness too. Hence, His Highness has quite a few Cosmos Gods under him.’
Other than directly absorbing the blood essence of the Extreme Night Primogenitor, the essence could also be used for other purposes like nurturing insects or altering one’s fleshy body. It was even sold outside for 10 billion cosmos crystals, a frightening price.
‘I’ve reached.’
Xue Ying looked at the bright dazzling golden construct in front of him. This golden construct had a symbol showing 15 stars. This was the ‘Extreme Night Palace’, a place not inferior to the Fan Clan’s shop.

chapters.title: Chapter 1069 - Eight Secret Treasures
chapters.content:
Chapter 1069: Eight Secret Treasures
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Extreme Night Palace was a commerce power ranked in the top five across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
And within one of the two great sacred cities in the Primogenitor Ancient Nation, the ‘Extreme Night City’s Extreme Night Palace, this was the main headquarters and was thriving with business.
“Sir Ying Shan Xue Ying, please come in.” As Xue Ying arrived at the Extreme Night Palace, there was a Primal Chaos Realm manager who came to guide him. The other party already knew of Xue Ying’s identity without asking Xue Ying.
“I want to see the ‘Heart of Desire’ without letting others know about it.” Xue Ying directly transmitted.
This manager had a calm expression. He transmitted back: “Sir Xue Ying can feel rest assured. Ever since the emergence of my Extreme Night Palace, we have never leaked out a single secret!”
Xue Ying nodded.
In terms of influencing power.
The Extreme Night Palace was considered top five among commerce groups. But in terms of prestige, it was ranked first with the Fan Clan’s shop, and was the most perfect commerce business! It had never leaked out the secrets of its customers!
Leaks had occurred in the history of other commerce superpowers. After all, even the most stringent rules would not affect some of the powerful Cosmos Gods that were the ones controlling the businesses. Due to selfishness, these Cosmos Gods would naturally make use of some secrets acquired from the commerce group.
But it was different for the Fan Clan shop and the Extreme Night Palace.
Their prestige was absolutely perfect! One could see how formidable the owners behind these two commerce groups, ‘Extreme Night Primogenitor’ and ‘Ancestor Fan’ were in controlling their subordinates! Many overbearing overlords like Sky-Rending Great Paragon or Great Paragon Lu Tian could only remain obedient in front of Ancestor Fan. Much less was needed to speak about Extreme Night Primogenitor for those who absorbed his blood essence would remain eternally loyal to him.
“Sir Ying Shan Xue Ying, please wait here momentarily.” The manager led Xue Ying into a resting hall, “In a while, the Heart of Desire will be sent over.”
“Alright.” Xue Ying sat down cross-legged. He was enjoying the excellent wine that was warmed to the right temperature in front of him.
Just a moment later.
The black-robed manager entered once again. He flipped his hand, causing a wooden cane to appear in front of Xue Ying. This wooden cane was embedded with a palm-sized black stone.
“Can I have a closer look at it?” Xue Ying asked.
“Naturally.” The black-robed manager smiled. Ordinary Primal Chaos experts were not qualified to take a closer look at treasures worth over 10 billion cosmos crystals, but Xue Ying was absolutely not categorized in the former.
Xue Ying held onto this seemingly ordinary cane. Xue Ying then turned is attention to that black stone embedded on it. Just merely gazing at it, Xue Ying could feel a strong, alluring power coming from the ‘black stone’, forcing him to stare at it unknowingly. It felt as if the stone wanted to pull him into a dream, though Xue Ying was an expert that reached the ninth level realm in the Mirage and Illusory realm Dao, and was able to easily maintain his consciousness.
“Weng.”
He permeated his consciousness into it.
The black stone was the true ‘Heart of Desire’. The wooden cane was meant to protect this black stone.
“Dong dong…”
At that moment when Xue Ying cast his consciousness into that black stone, he felt the stone expanding and contracting at the same time. It felt like a heartbeat. Xue Ying remained unmoved. Gradually, he ‘saw’ it. In that vast world filled with endless pink fog, many beings were reproducing and living within. Nevertheless, the desire of the creatures within this world was intense.
For the sake of love, hatred, greed, lust, pleasure, fright, happiness… all sorts of emotional desires caused the world to be filled with endless war.
“World.”
“Desire.”
Xue Ying revealed a joyous look.
After reaching the pinnacle of Primal Chaos Realm, there were only several paths in the Void Lineage which led to the Cosmos God Realm. Xue Ying had grasped the Five Phases Sealing Technique, and that was practically half of all available Dao paths.
Similar logic.
The Mirage and Illusory Realm had several branches too. Xue Ying primarily cultivated the branch of the ‘world’ and was also relatively good in the ‘slaughter’ path. After all, his ‘Nine-petaled Flower’ was a horrifying killing move condensed directly from the Mirage and Illusory Realm world with part of the profound mysteries from the Dao of Slaughter being added to it.
‘There are primarily two branches in the Heart of Desire. One is on the Path of the World and the other on the Path of Desire.’ Xue Ying thought.
‘Desire’ was also another commonly seen branch in the aspect of Mirage and Illusory realm.
By immersing into one’s desire, one would similarly be falling deep into an illusion…
‘This treasure is not bad.’ Xue Ying felt relatively joyful, ‘There is the Path of World inherent within. I believe that I should be able to improve to the tenth level power shortly after comprehending it for a while. Furthermore, this treasure even guides me on my journey to the Cosmos God Realm! And the ‘Path of Desire’… is something which I can cultivate after becoming a Cosmos God.”
“Dong.”
Xue Ying placed the wooden cane on the table.
“Sir Ying Shan Xue Ying, how is it?” The manager chuckled and asked, albeit he was shocked inwardly. Xue Ying seemed not to be affected at all despite sending his consciousness in? Those with slightly weaker souls might be able to resist against the treasure, but they would still be influenced to a certain extent.
“Does Sir Ying Shan Xue Ying like this Heart of Desire?” The manager laughed.
Of course!
He liked it! This was a treasure that could allow him to rapidly grasp a tenth level Mirage and Illusory Realm technique, and it could similarly broaden his perspective by cultivating the ‘Path of Desire’.
“How much?” Xue Ying asked.
The black-robed manager grinned, “20 billion cosmos crystals.”
“Don’t state the calling price. What is the lowest possible price?” Xue Ying asked directly.
“This is a weapon that contains two tenth level techniques.” The black-robed manager said, “One is on desire, and the other is on the world. Using both profound mysteries together, even ordinary Cosmos Gods will find it hard to resist against this move. Even if they could, their strength would be greatly affected.”
Xue Ying had to admit.
Both paths supported each other pretty well.
With the ‘world’, it was able to lure in the other party’s soul, engulfing it into a world. For instance, Xue Ying’s illusory realm could easily engulf those with weaker souls into it.
And with a similarly strong ‘desire’ technique, under the guidance of desire, it would greatly diminish the enemies’ resisting power, causing them to fall deeper into the illusory realm. It would be a multitude times harder to struggle out of it then.
“Even though there are two tenth level techniques, one must be able to use them before it is even useful.” Xue Ying said, “It is hard to grasp a single technique, what about two? Maybe a genius might have reached the pinnacle in both Dao paths in the ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’ Lineage! But what are the possibilities of a genius popping up who reached the pinnacle in these two paths coincidentally?”
“As for those who broke through to the Cosmos Gods in the Mirage and Illusory Realm Lineage, they would not care that much about a tenth level grade secret treasure. After all, they could directly unleash tenth level move without relying on it.” Xue Ying indifferently spoke, “However, given such a high price, there is no point in discussing further.”
“The consignee has mentioned that the lowest price he could accept is 16 billion cosmos crystals.” The black-robed manager answered.
“Then let him continue waiting further.”
Xue Ying stood up.
“Rest assure, I’ll ask the consignee again.” The black-robed manager said.
“The secret treasure is not bad, just that its price is too much. There are a total of eight pieces sold to the public in the Realm Heart Great Land currently, and some are much cheaper than this. I’ll go and have a look at the others.” Xue Ying stood up and left. He did not wish to discuss further with the black-robed manager since the manager did not have the power to call the price. He was merely a middleman, and everything was determined by that consignee of the secret treasure.
…
Xue Ying traveled across the Realm Heart Great Land. At the same time when he visited different places to have a closer look at the Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasures, he was also widening his experiences.
He had even paid a visit to Icy Snow Ancient Nation to see the gigantic cultivators there. In terms of ‘body refining cultivation system’, the Icy Snow Ancient Nation was unquestionably the strongest! Because the Icy Snow Ancient Nation had three old ancestors who reached the unparalleled realm. Those three old ancestors had reached the pinnacle in body cultivation, and hence, if one sought to cultivate a robust fleshy body, the religions from Icy Snow Ancient Nation would be the best bet. What a pity that the Icy Snow Ancient Nation was slightly more discriminatory to those from outside the nation.
‘There is just one last piece left.’
Slightly more than two months later.
Xue Ying arrived at the Thistle Flower Nation once again. That secret treasure in the capital of the Thistle Flower Nation had become the final one which he would be checking out.
Of all the secret treasures which he inspected, the cheapest cost 8.5 billion cosmos crystals and the most expensive reached a high of 16 billion cosmos crystals. Currently, Xue Ying felt the most tempted with that ‘Heart of Desire’, yet it’s a pity that the price of that treasure was lowered only to 15 billion cosmos crystals currently. This price was a great burden to him. Xue Ying could barely afford it only after exchanging all the ‘60,000 contribution points’ his teacher gave him into cosmos crystals.
By then, his avatar could no longer cultivate the Southern Cloud Sacred Body.
“Sir Xue Ying.” Within the Fan Clan shop in Thistle Flower Nation, under Xue Ying’s request to keep his identity a secret, the manager brought him into a hall.
“This is the ‘Devil Heart Bell’.” The manager smiled as he placed a golden bell in front of Xue Ying.
Xue Ying stared at this golden bell in front of him. This was the final piece. After perusing through all the secret treasures sold to the public, he would soon be choosing the right one to buy.
He then casually took up this Devil Heart Bell.

chapters.title: Chapter 1070 - Getting The Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 1070: Getting The Treasure
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Calmly sitting there, Xue Ying took over the Devil Heart Bell and sent his consciousness into it.
“Ding ding~”
The sweet-sounding ringing sound suddenly echoed in the mind of Xue Ying, causing him to feel a jolt in his concentration. He felt bliss in his soul. Even as an expert who cultivated the Mirage and Illusory Realm to the pinnacle of Primal Chaos realm, he could not help but feel himself relaxing slightly.
Following that, his consciousness began permeating deeper into the bell.
Within the little bell, there was a huge vast world. The surface of this world was covered in white fog, with many scenes emerging and vanishing within. It caused Xue Ying to feel the desire to jump into them. Xue Ying even saw his wife ‘Jing Qiu’ within the scenes that were emerging and vanishing. He saw his daughter and his teacher Gu Qi who died…
Accompanied by some of the white fog that enticed Xue Ying, the vast world deep in the Devil Heart Bell was also evolving. It developed and formed Jing Qiu, Dong Bo Yu, Qing Yao, Chi Qiu Bai, his teacher Bloodshed God Emperor, Gu Qi, and others.
‘This treasure is so formidable!’ Xue Ying might feel his heart desire deepening over time, but his realm was extraordinary too. This Devil Heart Bell was not being controlled by an owner, so Xue Ying could still maintain control of himself.
‘This is also a treasure with two Dao paths.’
‘One is on ‘Bewilderment’, and the other is on the ‘world’.’
Xue Ying felt delighted in his heart.
The Mirage and Illusory Realm had several Dao paths. He had inspected a total of eight secret treasures one after another, with half of them on the ‘world’ aspect. After all, for an illusory realm to be sufficiently effective, it had to form a world that seemed real! Illusions that were not ‘sufficiently real’, would not be able to effectively engulf ultra-strong experts within.
As for other Dao paths, like the ‘Bewilderment’, ‘Desire’, ‘Slaughter’ and ‘Fantasy’, they represented different directions of the Mirage and Illusory Realm.
There were a total of two that contained the ‘world’ path and another Dao path—Devil Heart Bell and the Heart of Desire.
‘Both the Devil Heart Bell and Heart of Desire are appropriate for me.’ Xue Ying made his decision.
Of the eight secret treasures, both the Devil Heart Bell and the Heart of Desire were ranked first.
“Sir Xue Ying, how is it?” That manager saw Xue Ying placing the Devil Heart Bell down before asking it with a smile.
“This secret treasure is not bad. How is the price?” Xue Ying asked.
“16 billion cosmos crystals!” The manager said.
Xue Ying made his decision there and then.
He had decided almost instantaneously that the treasure he would be purchasing would be this Heart of Desire! As for that Devil Heart Bell, despite negotiating several times, the price was still fixed at 15 billion cosmos crystals, and that was too high.
“It’s too expensive.” Xue Ying shook his head, “Even though it has two Dao paths, how many cultivators are there who could utilize them fully?”
“There are ultimately some.” The manager grinned.
“If this is the price, then we can just let the owner of the secret treasure wait for the appropriate customer.” Xue Ying stood up.
The manager immediately chuckled after seeing that: “Sir Xue Ying doesn’t have to be overly anxious. The lowest price over at our side is 15 billion cosmos crystals, and Sir Xue Ying still thinks of negotiating it further. That would depend on the consignee then.”
“The price is still relatively on the higher side. I’ll have a look at other secret treasures since there are a total of eight pieces.” Xue Ying smiled, “Even though I need the treasure, the price is a critical consideration too.”
“Relax, relax, I’ll definitely help SIr Xue Ying and lower the price to the furthest.” The manager added.
It would be hugely beneficial to him if he could sell a piece.
After all, 10 billion cosmos crystals were something this shop earned after so many years because this price was something only that ‘Thistle Flower King’ from the Thistle Flower Nation could afford.
After all, this manager was not sure how much Xue Ying liked this secret treasure.
…
After finishing checking out all eight secret treasures, Xue Ying continued strolling around the Realm Heart Great Land. He would travel around and enjoy the delicacies and drinks from all over the place. He would continue to negotiate further with the owner of that secret treasure.
“I’ve already chosen the other secret treasure that I would be buying if this price isn’t lowered further.”
“Three days! I’ll decide after three days to purchase it.”
“No other choice. It seems I have no fate with this secret treasure.”
Xue Ying continued negotiating with the owners of the secret treasures through the managers from the eight different locations.
He was continuing to give them pressure.
Three months after finishing inspecting all secret treasures, Xue Ying finally made his final decision. He even returned to the Southern Cloud Nation again to exchange 10,000 contribution points for one billion cosmos crystals.
“Hu.”
Thistle Flower Capital.
A white-robed young man was walking in the Thistle Flower Capital. He felt casual at this moment.
‘I am really fated with this Thistle Flower Nation. It seems I am back here again. That time, I had decided that the third secret treasure I would be inspecting is the Devil Heart Bell, yet I revealed my identity because of my actions, causing me to delay it until it became the last treasure I inspected. Nevertheless, I still chose it in the end.’ Xue Ying chuckled. His figure suddenly turned illusory, and he disappeared. The next moment, he arrived within the Fan Clan shop in the Thistle Flower Capital.
“Are the 13.6 billion cosmos crystals accounted for?” Xue Ying sat there looking at the manager.
“They are, they are!” The eyes of the manager were filled with great enthusiasm. He passed the Devil Heart Bell over to Xue Ying, “Right now, this secret treasure is Sir Xue Ying’s.”
“Mn.”
Xue Ying suppressed his excitement. He took over this piece of Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasure.
For the 13.6 billion cosmos crystals…
He spent almost all his effort.
The Sky Sword Dao redeemed Thunder King Mo Chao and his two secret treasures for eight billion cosmos crystals. He had exchanged his contribution points for another four billion cosmos crystals. As for the remaining, one part had come from Thunder King Mo Chaos’ storage treasure which he saved up for many years. All those precious materials added up to a total of about one billion cosmos crystals. And the final part was when Xue Ying killed Chang Su Wang and those Primal Chaos Devils who ran rampant in the Ardent Fire City. These treasures added up to about one billion cosmos crystals too.
After gathering all his riches, he was able to finally gather 13.6 billion cosmos crystals. Xue Ying even mortgaged those Void Lineage inspect corpses of his for a price 85% that of what he bought them for!
Currently, Xue Ying had barely 300 million cosmos crystals at hand.
‘I’ve practically spent finished all my savings.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
To this, he still felt relatively satisfied.
After all, those treasures and cosmos crystals could not transform into strength! This Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasure could instead greatly improve his strength! By then, he would stand unparalleled across all tenth level experts. Even when facing against Cosmos Gods, a tenth level Mirage and Illusory Realm technique would greatly reduce their strength! When those Cosmos Gods faced with another horrifying ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’, they would likely be suppressed.
The usage of these two great techniques had greatly improved Xue Ying’s strength.
Furthermore, he still had another 20,000 contribution points which were enough to train the Southern Cloud Sacred Body to the pinnacle for his other avatar, increasing his survivability. In Xue Ying’s plan, it was okay if the avatar of his was good at surviving.
Below the Cosmos God Realm, the Southern Cloud Sacred Body could reach tenth level grand perfection at most.
If he succeeded to become a Cosmos God, there was still an 11th and 12th level! These were body cultivation techniques that the Southern Cloud Sacred Master personally created. It was considered quite an incredibly strong survival cultivation technique in tier two and three nations. Of course, compared to the six great ancient nations, it was still slightly lacking.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying felt joyous. He casually returned to the Southern Cloud Nation. But just before he even entered his Flying Snow City, he received the voice transmission from his teacher.
“Xue Ying.” The voice sounded by Xue Ying’s ears, “Remember, if the Fan Clan comes to find your help, you must not accept it directly.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1071 - Upper Honored Guest
chapters.content:
Chapter 1071: Upper Honored Guest
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was momentarily stunned. He stepped on the void and looked down at the Flying Snow City. At the same time, he asked: “Teacher, why should I not promise them directly?”
Just like previously when he wanted to inspect the Scarlet Cloud God Spear spearhead, a single word from Fan Tian Chong permitted Xue Ying to view it. Even though the spearhead merely cost a few hundred million cosmos crystals, just ‘observing’ it once did not require much favor! But no matter what, the other party allowed Xue Ying to inspect it due to friendship. If others asked Xue Ying for help, and the benefits were sufficiently high, he had no reasons to decline them.
