After all, he was just an outsider Honored Guest in the Fan Clan.
“Hmph, don’t you even have the courage to battle?” Fan Yi Qian sneered. He held on to a bronze pole smashing down heavily on the ground and roared: “If you don’t want to fight, I’ll just stay here forever and see when such a coward can endure for.”
“How dare…” The magic dragon could not tolerate and shout out.
“Shut up!” Fan Yi Qian roared. A frightening thunder exploded from his body, enveloping over that magic dragon, causing him to feel the threat of death. Fan Yi Qian revealed his white teeth with a smirk: “If you aren’t the servant of an Upper Honored Guest invited by my Fan Clan, I would have long eaten you the moment you dare to be so unbridled!”
Xue Ying slightly frowned. He stood.
Fan Yi Qian revealed a joyful look at Xue Ying: “Why? You finally dare to fight with me?”
“Please.” Xue Ying stood there.
“I’ll let you strike first!” Fan Yi Qian held onto the bronze pole. He was fully confident and prepared for the moment when the Five Phases Sealing Technique. He would simply smash it apart the moment it came!
“Alright.”
Xue Ying nodded. A golden bell appeared by his waist. That bell shook and let out a ringing sound.
“Ding ding ding ding dang~”
A soft ringing sound sounded in the mind of Fan Yi Qian. It had a dangerous enticing effect to it.
Fan Yi Qian stood there as a foolish smile started appearing on his face.
No other way.
Of the two great techniques of ‘Devil Heart Bell’, Xue Ying could only display the ninth level strength in the ‘Beguiling Sound’ technique. This was merely used as an auxiliary skill. Instead, the internal illusory realm was a tenth level move. With these two great techniques supporting one another, Fan Yi Qian who was known for his strength had been extremely weak in the soul aspect. He was also the one lacking in the soul aspect most out of the three core disciples chosen by the Fan Clan and had been struck in an instant.
“Sigh…” Xue Ying shook his head, waving his hand.
“Peng.”
An unseen ripple directly slapped on the body of Fan Yi Qian, causing him to fly back and smash face down onto the ground. His mouth was even filled with a mouthful of soil, and that bronze pole in his hand hit the back of his head.
Only then did Fan Yi Qian begin to wake up in a daze. This was also because Xue Ying kept his illusory realm technique. Otherwise, the other party would still be deep within.
“I, why would I?” Fan Yi Qian was still slightly confused. Seeing that he was lying on the ground with his bronze pole by the side, he realized his mouth was full of soil.
“I lost? Pu pu pu!” Fan Yi Qian spat out the soil in his mouth. He felt shocked in his heart though and looked at that white-robed young man who seemed to be still standing at his original position with slight alarm. He remembered hearing a sweet ringing sound, and the next thing he knew, he was lying flat on the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 1078 - Pinnacle of Void-ification
chapters.content:
Chapter 1078: Pinnacle of Void-ification
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Zhi ya.” the courtyard door opened.
Fan San Yuan and Fan Mo Zhu both looked inside the courtyard, only to see a green-armored and seemingly sluggish ‘Fan Yi Qian’ swaying out. A blank look still hung on his face. Following that, the door to the courtyard behind shut close.
“Why did you leave?” Fan San Yuan felt puzzled, “Did I not ask you to stay in his courtyard if he did not want to battle until he caves in?”
Fan Mo Zhu also added from the side: “If he forced you out, you could make use of that opportunity to fight against him.”
“We fought.” Fan Yi Qian looked ahead in a daze, muttering out.
“Fought?”
Fan San Yuan and Fan Mo Zhu felt their hearts trembling. They turned towards each other. Both of them were just outside the courtyard. Even though this courtyard contained arrays protecting it, isolating all sound and most disturbances, how could a battle between two tenth level experts not produce anything? It was entirely possible that people outside the place could feel it, much less when Fan Yi Qian specialized most in using strength to break techniques!
But they did not feel anything just now, and Fan Yi Qian came out too quickly!
He just entered recently, and should have only spoken a few words before coming out already?
And according to him, they already fought?
“What is going on?” Fan San Yuan asked.
“I lost.” Fan Yi Qian mumbled, “Lost wholeheartedly. Let’s go, we aren’t his opponent at all.”
Saying that, Fan Yi Qian turned around and left. He headed towards his courtyard.
“What exactly happened that made him like that?” Fan San Yuan and Fan Mo Zhu were both bewildered.
“Yi Qian has an extremely overbearing and unreasonable personality. He is extremely proud in his heart too.” The eyes of Fan Mo Zhu had a weird color as she looked at Xue Ying’s courtyard that was by her side, “But if he were to lose the battle to someone at the same level pitifully, it might just impact him a lot. There is only big brother within the Primal Chaos experts in our Fan Clan who could barely suppress him. But this time, no disturbances were created during the battle, yet he came out shortly after. That means Ying Shan Xue Ying should have defeated him in one or two moves effortlessly! And it was truly a miserable defeat.”
Fan San Yuan softly nodded.
Fan Yi Qian’s strength was extremely frightening, especially after using his forbidden techniques! But Xue Ying actually defeated him soundlessly?
“It isn’t the Five Phases Sealing Technique.” Fan Mo Zhu said, “It should be some other secret technique that gave him the ability to easily defeat Yi Qian! And it should not be any weaker than the Five Phases Sealing Technique.”
Fan San Yuan softly nodded.
There were still techniques that were not any weaker than the Five Phases Sealing Technique and were soundless. For instance, curses, prophecies, Mirage and Illusory Realm, and others. Even the extremely complex Array Lineage could generate a frightening secret technique that was entirely removed from the flow of time. These were all soundless. If one did not include soundless techniques, then there were even more secret techniques that could defeat Fan Yi Qian.
Ancestor Fan, Emperor Summer, and many other unparalleled existences had created such secret techniques! That mysterious and transcendental ‘Yuan’ left behind even more frightening secret techniques! But all these were theoretical, of course.
Like the ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’, other than the genius from Towering Sky Ancient Nation, there was only Xue Ying who grasped it. Just these two existences!
Fan Yi Qian had not cultivated his chosen technique to the pinnacle; currently, he could only use one of the three forbidden techniques.
“It seems within reason that the Great Paragons all agreed to make Ying Shan Xue Ying an Upper Honored Guest of our Fan Clan.” Fan San Yuan said. He no longer had the thought to battle with the other party.
“We’ll find out how powerful he is when the competition between the three clans begin.” Fan Mo Zhu chuckled.
“Mn, regardless, it is good that he is strong for our Fan Clan.” Fan San Yuan softly nodded. Even though he was prideful, if he were surpassed greatly by someone like Xue Ying, he would merely admire the other party and become more motivated.
That’s the world of cultivators. The Summer Wind Ancient Nation held many other nations in disdain, but there were a minority few who could still win their admiration and respect! Like ‘Southern Cloud King’ for instance.
******
“At least I have peace now.”
Xue Ying softly nodded. He did not wish to make too many enemies within the Fan Clan.
Because during his plan of cultivation, the Fan Clan was an essential part of it! When he became a Cosmos God, Xue Ying would naturally send out an avatar back to his hometown Primal Chaos Void, understanding everything which happened there in his hometown. But no matter if it were the ‘Destruction Devils’ who were getting stronger or ‘Sacred Master’, they were all forcing Xue Ying to become strong as fast as possible.
One had to know that the secret treasures in his hometown Primal Chaos Void were refined more crudely! It was impossible for those back at his hometown reach his current level of combat power.
Primal Chaos Realm… could only achieve the ninth level in combat power.
It was tough to battle against those of a higher realm at the Cosmos God Realm in his hometown too.
‘It is very difficult to deal against Sacred Master. I have to rely on the scriptures which the Fan Clan has. Only then could I grow stronger faster. The opportunity placed in front of me this time to earn contribution points is a rare chance. I must complete the task beautifully.’ Xue Ying sat within the courtyard. After waiting for a moment, and knowing that nobody was knocking his door anymore, Xue Ying knew that the three core disciples would not be coming to disturb him anymore.
He immediately stood.
“Magic Dragon, if there aren’t any important matters, don’t disturb me.” Xue Ying ordered.
“Yes, master.” The magic dragon’s gaze towards Xue Ying was filled with worship. That Fan Clan core disciple who defeated King Sauron was actually easily defeated by his master in a single move. His master was too amazing!
…
Xue Ying instead entered the cultivation room of this courtyard and began his meditation and cultivation.
The Fan Clan provided the best meditation rooms to these five experts who would be participating in the competition between the three clans. When Xue Ying sat cross-legged within, he could feel the energy from the surrounding array revolving about and nourishing his fleshy body and soul. This effect was tremendously good. It was much better than the Void God Pagoda constructed in Flying Snow City.
There was no choice. The Fan Clan naturally produced stellar things.
What a pity that he would not be staying here for long!
“Weng.”
Xue Ying closed his eyes. He began recollecting some of the reflections he had of the past battles.
Naturally, it excluded the battle with Fan Yi Qian as it was too simplistic! Instead, it was the battle with the incarnation of Great Paragon Devouring Cloud, especially during the eighth time when Xue Ying defeated the other party only after six consecutive strikes. Facing the technique which Great Paragon Devouring Cloud used to defend himself, Xue Ying’s Five Phases Sealing Technique also change accordingly. With the Five Phases operating together, Xue Ying sought to find the weakness of the enemy.
And these six consecutive palms, each was performed in a slightly different manner.
“Five Phases rotation…” Xue Ying recalled the battle, absorbing some comprehensions he had.
Suddenly, he thought of the void-ification technique.
“Rotation?”
Xue Ying felt his heart moving.
At that moment, he was enlightened! Xue Ying had after all researched in the void-ification technique for far too long. In his previous life, he had reached the 50th level in the Walker’s Hidden Secret! Xue Ying even studied Monarch Nine Cloud’s four-diagrams absolute art inheritance until he could no longer improve further. He also remained comprehending and pondering over the scaled-armor of General Mo Gu. After reincarnating into the Realm Heart Great Land, he first reached the tenth level grand perfection stage in his Southern Cloud Sacred Body! After grasping the ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’, this enabled Xue Ying to reach the pinnacle of Primal Chaos Realm in five Dao paths of the Void Lineage. Xue Ying even researched the profound mysteries behind the void-ification talents of the Void Lineage insects…
Constant accumulations had long enabled Xue Ying to use the mysterious inscriptions of General Mo Gu’s scaled-armor as the core and fuse his understanding of many techniques into it like ingredients in a furnace. Xue Ying merely lacked that final ‘spark’ to combine them together.
At this moment!
Within the cultivation room when he recalled the Five Phases Rotation, Xue Ying actually comprehended where the spark was.
‘Why the need to forcibly fuse them? I should just rotate and allow the strong or weak to change according to circumstances.’
Xue Ying thought in his heart.
“Weng!”
As he sat there cross-legged, the void around him abruptly distort. Many strands of colorful light warped, fusing together into a black hole. At the center of the black hole sat Xue Ying.
‘I will not be extinguished even if the world is annihilated. Unless there is a force which could break apart the cage of the Origin World, harming the Origin World along the way, otherwise, no attacks could injure me.’ Xue Ying chuckled. That time, Sacred Master sought to deal against Monarch Nine Cloud and shattering the primitive Ancient Sacred World during the final battle, yet all he could do was to heavily injure Monarch Nine Cloud, allowing the other party to escape. In the end, Sacred Master could not acquire the Third Fire Prison Realm Cauldron.
The reason Monarch Nine Cloud survived was due to how frightening the pinnacle of void-ification was!
Only when a technique could break apart the Origin World could it injure the expert who cultivated to the pinnacle of void-ification! But it would only ‘injure’ the other party! Killing the one who reached this degree was too hard!
Like Xue Ying when he used the Arch Destruction, he could only shatter a few Black Fog Spherical Particles. Such move, if it were dealt against Xue Ying, would only barely destroy a single cell! Hence, ‘Pinnacle of Void-ification’ was something many experts sought after. Even Xue Ying’s teacher Gu Qi had not attained the pinnacle of void-ification. Instead, it was the creator of the Voidwalker Lineage, ‘Void Primogenitor’ who achieved it.
This not an easy step to take.
Some Cosmos Gods of the Void Lineage could not even create it when they did not have the secret technique!
But for a Primal Chaos expert to create this! It was truly unfathomable!
In the Primal Chaos void, the Destruction Devils could stealthily permeate through the Void Castle constructed by the cultivators precisely because they had the ‘shadowless talent’. It incurred many disasters. Hence, attaining the ‘pinnacle of void-ification’ was akin to enabling a qualitative transformation!
‘Since this is an undying technique produced by nine Daos rotating, I shall call this void-ification technique, the <Nine Rotation Undying Technique>.’ Xue Ying smiled, ‘Who would have thought that after bitterly cultivating for so many years ever since I reincarnated until now, it is here at the Fan Clan Magic Mountain that I finally comprehended it.’
At the same time when he understood the ‘Nine Rotation Undying Technique’.
Xue Ying immediately felt that if he continued researching down this ‘Dao of Void’ path, he would be able to break through to the Cosmos God Realm.
His accumulation was honestly too broad!
The ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’ and the more challenging ‘Nine Rotation Undying Technique’! Furthermore, the Nine Rotation Undying Technique was created by himself!
With such a deep foundation, as long as Xue Ying cultivated slightly longer, he would easily break through to the Cosmos God Realm in the Dao of Void.
‘No rush.’
‘I still want to participate in the Fan Clan’s competition between the three clans. If I were to break through to the Cosmos God Realm now, I would be disqualified.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Let’s wait a bit more. In any case, the competition will be starting soon. I can simply break through after the competition ends. By then, I can send my avatar back to my hometown! Jing Qiu, Yu’er, Qing Yao…’
Currently, Xue Ying was reminiscing back to the past, thinking about his wife and children.
Were they still good after Xue Ying left for so long?
‘I’ll wait. Wait a little longer…’ Xue Ying encouraged himself silently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1079 - The competition of the three clans
chapters.content:
Chapter 1079: The competition of the three clans
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Just a month or so after he created the ‘Nine Revolution Undying Technique’.
“Fellow cultivators, it is time to set off.” A voice sounded across the five courtyards. Within the five courtyards, Fan San Yuan, Fan Mo Zhu, Fan Yi Qian, King Sauron, and Xue Ying came out.
‘Finally, the competition of the three clans will be starting soon.’ Xue Ying smiled. To Xue Ying, the competition of the three clans was primarily for the 10,000 contribution points! Once the mission ended, he would immediately enter closed-door cultivation and break through to the Cosmos God Realm so that he could send an avatar back to his hometown ‘Primal Chaos Void’.
At this moment, Fan San Yuan and others including King Sauron, looked at Xue Ying.
Because all of them knew…
Fan Yi Qian had been defeated by Xue Ying in a single move.
“Hahaha, no matter how strong you are, you should wait a while before displaying it.” Monarch Andromeda laughed, “Only when you can defeat the Cang Clan and Summer Clan would it be called strength.”
“Yes.” Fan San Yuan softly nodded.
“This time, we will win!” The thin Fan Yi Qian had already regained his fighting spirit. He mumbled to himself as thunder flashed through his eyes.
“Come on up.” There was a luxurious carriage by the side of Monarch Andromeda. It was relatively big. Monarch Andromeda first took a step and entered the carriage. At the same time, he was inviting the rest over.
Xue Ying and the others immediately flew up to it.
From the outside, the carriage was merely several dozen meters wide. But it was actually close to a hundred meters within.
They all sat cross-legged at their chosen spots within.
“Set off.” Monarch Andromeda also sat cross-legged and gave his orders.
“Yes.”
The servant outside the carriage respectfully replied.
“Hou~”
The mutated beasts arced through the sky, pulling the carriage away from the Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
…
Xue Ying also looked out of the carriage. This carriage had arrived above some flourishing streets above the Summer Wind Capital.
“The competition of the three clans has always happened within the royal palace.” Monarch Andromeda explained, “By then, Ancestor Fan, Emperor Summer, and Emperor Cang will be personally watching the battle. Furthermore, many Great Paragons from the three great clans and other powerful experts within other clans in my Summer Wind Ancient Nation will also come to spectate the battle. This is already the highest level of competition between the three great clans in my Summer Wind Ancient Nation.”
The three clans were ultimately part of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
Sending the most outstanding Primal Chaos experts to compete in this ancient nation was practically a battle at the highest level.
What about one level higher?
A battle between Cosmos Gods? One had to know that Cosmos Gods specialized in all sorts of profound mysteries. Some Cosmos Gods could unleash techniques that even unparalleled existences did not have the time to hinder and save the losing party, making it easy for cases of ‘losing control’ to occur! Furthermore, it was already so hard for unparalleled existences, or those at the Great Paragon level to appear. If they were always the ones battling, then there would be no meaning in the competition.
Instead, many junior experts might pop out at the Primal Chaos Realm, ensuring some ‘variable’ existed during competition.
‘Seems like this competition is perceived with great importance. Even the three unparalleled existences are personally there to spectate the battle. Many other Great Paragons will be coming too.’ Xue Ying was inwardly shocked. It seemed this was a complete gathering between the highest level in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
Summer Wind Ancient Nation, the royal palace.
Within a vast palace hall. This hall was covered in fog. It was hard for the naked eyes to see the roof as if it was boundless.
Currently, there sat a black-clothed male on the throne. As he sat there, no aura could be felt from him. He looked down as if a ‘firmament’ looking at the commoners! Even the surrounding Cosmos Gods dared not be disrespectful since this was His Majesty Emperor of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, someone with the capability to make both Ancestor Fan and Emperor Cang willing to reign themselves to him.
In the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, there were five ancestors! But they refused to comply with one another, making it such that no highest leader existed.
But the Summer Wind Ancient Nation was comparatively more united. The highest leader in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation was none other than the emperor of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation—Emperor Summer!
“Haha, Brother Fan, your Fan Clan has lost five consecutive times. If you were to lose again, that’d be the sixth time. Ever since the second War of the Ancient Nation when we first obtained the ‘Origin Realm God Palace’, your Fan Clan hasn’t lost six times consecutively before, right?” Emperor Summer chuckled at a blurred figure to his left. Ancestor Fan’s appearance was ever-changing. He existed differently to different people.
“Emperor Summer, it might not be the case this time around.” Ancestor Fan indifferently answered.
“Younger Brother Fan, you should know that there are two absolute geniuses in the Summer Clan during this era. They are so much stronger than the five previous times. Tsk tsk, my Cang Clan was able to win twice at least, yet even still, my clan has no confidence for the competition this time.” Emperor Cang added by the side. Even though Emperor Cang sat there, his surroundings felt vast and obscure. One could faintly see worlds emerging and collapsing on the surface of his body. It made even the hearts of Cosmos Gods palpitate, “It is fine for us to lose in this competition since my Cang Clan has won twice in the previous five competitions.”
“And my Summer Clan has won three times.” Emperor Summer deliberately teased.
Ancestor Fan coldly snorted.
Even though the three old men were bickering, in reality, they were extremely close like brothers. After all, there were too few who could discuss Dao with them in this path of cultivation.
“This time, we have to win.” Ancestor Fan looked downwards at several Great Paragons the Fan Clan had like Sky-Rending Great Paragon, Great Paragon Blood Lotus and others, “My Fan Clan hasn’t sent any Great Paragons into the ‘Origin Realm God Palace’ for too long. They should be getting anxious by now.”
The Origin Realm God Palace was left behind by ‘Yuan’.
It was also the most critical treasure being contested during the second War of the Ancient Nations. That time, the war caused heaven to fall and earth to rend. Even unparalleled existences were not spared from death! There were many more who had been heavily injured, like the two existences from the Primogenitor Ancient Nation, they once tried attacking Summer Wind Ancient Nation together. In the end, ‘Extreme Night Primogenitor’ had been heavily injured, and quite a few droplets of his Origin Blood was stolen. Even ‘Eternal Night Primogenitor’ had been heavily wounded and forced to escape…
During the battle, the two strongest ancient nations—Myriad Realms Ancient Nation and Summer Wind Ancient Nation reaped great harvests.
The Summer Wind Ancient Nation acquired the ‘Origin Realm God Palace’.
In the early periods, Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang, and Ancestor Fan both took turns to enter the Origin Realm God Palace. But they had to wait for an extended period before they could enter again. As time passed, the three discovered that improvement was becoming hard. Hence, they gave this opportunity to their juniors.
Even though these were ‘juniors’, in reality, they were Great Paragons from the three great clans…
How would the arrangement for entering the palace be handled?
After all, the Summer Clan was the strongest and had nine Great Paragons in total! If all three great clans entered one after another, it seemed unfair to the Summer Clan since Emperor Summer had the most significant contribution towards acquiring the ‘Origin Realm God Palace’ in the past!
In the end, the three old ancestors decided to have a ‘competition between the three clans’.
Whichever clan won would get an opportunity to enter.
Hence…
Over the long years, generation after generation, the Summer Clan usually triumphed over the other two clans, and the Cang Clan and Fan Clan were relatively equal.
It’s just that Fan Clan had lost all recent five competitions! It felt quite disgraceful to them. Those Great Paragons from the Fan Clan desired to enter, yet to no avail.
“The young fellows from the Summer Clan has arrived.”
Six figures descended down from afar. One of them was a Cosmos God.
“Greetings, Your Majesties.” All of them bowed.
“Enter.” Emperor Summer said.
That Cosmos God from the Summer Clan naturally went to his position. As for the other five Primal Chaos experts from the Summer Clan, they were led by the female attendants to their seats. They were all keeping a low-profile since they were the only five Primal Chaos experts who were qualified to sit here currently.
Very soon.
“The young fellows from Fan Clan have arrived too.” At that moment, this scene attracted the attention of many people. The Cosmos Gods of Summer Wind Ancient Nation present also knew about the fact that the Fan Clan had not won any of the five competitions before this.
Under the guidance of Monarch Andromeda, Xue Ying and the other four arrived. They landed before giving their respect: “Greetings, Your Majesties.”
And seated at the highest position.
Ancestor Fan who sat beside Emperor Summer glanced at that white-robed young man with interest: ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying? Let’s see how capable this Ying Shan Xue Ying is!’ This Xue Ying was someone who rejected his invitation to become his disciple. Even if he reincarnated, as someone who could reject becoming his disciple, Ancestor Fan was naturally curious about him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1080 - Falling One after Another
chapters.content:
Chapter 1080: Falling One after Another
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying went to his assigned seat. As he sat there, he drank wine and ate all sorts of different fruits placed in front of him. At the same time, Xue Ying was silently observing his surroundings.
‘There are so many Cosmos Gods here.’ More than a hundred guests participated in the banquet this time. Those who could attend, excluding Xue Ying and other young fellows at the Primal Chaos Realm who would be competing between the three clans, were existences at the level or stronger than Fiery Zhao King or Maple Nest King. Some of the weaker and more ordinary Cosmos Gods were not qualified to attend!
For instance, Monarch Andromeda, who brought them over could merely sit by the edge.
‘Great Paragons?’
Xue Ying noticed the Great Paragons that were currently emanating auras that were either overbearing, transcendental or queer.
Those who could be called ‘Great Paragon’ had reached a level second only to the unparalleled existences! In terms of power, they were comparable to that of Southern Cloud King. Even though the Southern Cloud King was wealthier, the treasures, absolute art scriptures, and resources which the Summer Wind Ancient Nation had were something Southern Cloud King could not compare. But since the Southern Cloud King had the capabilities to create the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’, he dared to challenge against the unparalleled existences!
‘The feeling these Great Paragons give me is close to that of Sacred Master.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘As for the three unparalleled existences, they seem stronger than the Sacred Master!’
No other way.
There were too few powerful secret treasures over at the side of Primal Chaos Void! They had never seen before a secret treasure that could be used to battle against those of a higher realm. Clearly, the art of refinement was much cruder than that in the Realm Heart Great Land.
Even when comparing scriptures purely… brought about a gulf of difference between both Origin Worlds! A single ‘Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ was sufficient to make Sacred Master desire for it so much.
‘The Primal Chaos experts from Cang Clan has arrived.’
Xue Ying turned over.
A total of five experts and a Cosmos God came from the Cang Clan. Those five might be bowing politely, but the ‘freedom’ and ‘unrestrained’ personality in these experts were clearest. This temperament had been naturally formed when the Cang Clan nurtured their disciples. Such form of ‘nurturing them naturally’ might produce some useless cultivators, but those who rose were more outstanding. The Cang Clan similarly did not accept outsiders in their clan, yet their overall strength remained comparable to the Fan Clan. Clearly, there were merits in this form of nurturing.
‘Summer Clan, Cang Clan, and the Fan Clan.’ Xue Ying observed, ‘The disciples from the Summer Clan are well-mannered. Those from the Cang Clan are more self-centered. As for those from the Fan Clan, they are colder and have stronger killing intent.’
Speaking from his heart, he liked those from the Summer Clan most.
They were those who were most restrained, and according to the intelligence, the disciples from the Summer Clan hated devils the most too!
…
Xue Ying had finished more than half the flask of wine placed in front of him. He also finished almost all the fruits. At this moment, beneath Emperor Summer, a white-robed male stood up and announced: “I am Great Paragon Imperial Wind, also the host for this competition between the three clans. The competition between the three clans will be held between Primal Chaos disciples from my Summer Clan, the Fan Clan, and Cang Clan. It will be held over three different rounds of competition before finally determining the winner.”
Xue Ying carefully listened.
It might sound like this was a competition between disciples from the three clans, but strictly speaking, they were not all from the three great clans!
The Summer Clan and Cang Clan might not accept outsiders, but they still take those from within the nation. Many experts joined their clans and were directly bestowed with the surname from the clan!
The Fan Clan did accept outsiders. For instance, if Xue Ying were to take Ancestor Fan as his teacher in the past, he would instantaneously become a core member of the Fan Clan! If he were willing to accept the change in name, Xue Ying would become ‘Fan Xue Ying’, significantly increasing the benefits which he would be receiving in the Fan Clan. Nonetheless, Xue Ying chose to take Southern Cloud King as his teacher instead for the sake of learning the ‘avatar technique’ so that he could return to his hometown.
If this was in the Fan Clan, even if he had a more exceptional talent, it was impossible for precious secret treasures like ‘Five Phase Beads’ to be directly given to him! Instead, Xue Ying had to fork out the corresponding contribution points to exchange for it. After all, there were many experts in the Fan Clan, and the rules were naturally stricter.
“During each round of competition, golden cauldrons will be given as points.” The white-robed Great Paragon Imperial Wind smiled as he explained, “After the three rounds, the clan who owns the most golden cauldrons will be the winner.”
At that moment, Xue Ying and the other 14 Primal Chaos existences held their breaths.
“The first round of battle is a competition of the soul, and also of the willpower.” The white-robed Great Paragon Imperial Wind announced, “The further you walk on the path of cultivation, the more important it is to have a strong soul and willpower. The 15 of you will withstand from the same strength of soul attack simultaneously at the same time. The longer you resist, the better. The one who lasts the longest will be awarded three golden cauldrons. The second with two and the third with one. As for others? Everyone else will get nothing.”
Xue Ying felt confident at that moment.
Competing the soul and willpower?
He is a great expert who cultivated in the Mirage and Illusory Realm. Why would he still be afraid of this?
15 Primal Chaos experts and only the top three would be rewarded with ‘golden cauldrons’. This was just the first round, and there were three in total! The host had mentioned that they would be differing competitions too.
“The first round is the easiest. Alright, everyone, stand to the middle of the hall.” Great Paragon Imperial Wind ordered.
“Yes.”
They stood in an orderly manner. The Summer Clan, the Cang Clan, and the Fan Clan. A total of three teams and 15 tenth level experts were there. They had been chosen very carefully! Of which 13 were natives of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation! Actually, the Summer Wind Ancient Nation was too big, and the competition within was much more intense than the wars that happened outside the nation.
“Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow, in a while, we’ll be seeing your strength.” Fan San Yuan transmitted with a smile.
“I’ve heard that Un-Phase Mystical Technique focuses relatively strongly on the soul.” Xue Ying replied.
Fan San Yuan, Xue Ying, Fan Yi Qian, Fan Mo Zhu, and King Sauron. The five of them stood near the center of the hall. At the very center stood the team of five from Summer Clan, and on the right were the five experts from Cang Clan.
“Hahaha…”
Within the great hall, waves of laughter could be heard first.
Closely following that, sounds from the Pipa could be heard.
Finally, faint illusory realms descended. One could see with the naked eyes many distorted scenes within these realms that tempted one with his deepest desire.
Clearly, the experts from all three great clans had started utilizing the illusory realm technique.
“Shua shua shua…”
Close to a breath of time later, six Primal Chaos experts immediately fell from the 15 standing in the great hall. Fan Yi Qian was the only one from the Fan clan that fell.
“It seems that the standard this time is quite similar to the past? Six has fallen just as the competition started. Yi, the Fan Clan seems quite good for there to only be one to fall?”
“It seems that the participants from the Fan Clan this time aren’t easy.”
“Fan Yi Qian?”
The guests were all discussing amongst each other.
And the higher-ups from the Fan Clan were all shaking their heads inwardly when they saw Fan Yi Qian standing there with a goofy smile. Of the three core disciples chosen by the Fan Clan, the other two were relatively okay. Only this ‘Fan Yi Qian’ had slightly more apparent strengths and weaknesses. His soul and willpower were weak, and he had a more brutal and ruthless personality. Nevertheless, because of this, he was able to resonate with an absolute art scripture that ‘Yuan’ created, boosting his strength to a frightening stage.
‘I knew it. He will be the first to fall this time.’ Sky-Rending Great Paragon softly shook his head. He brought up the wine cup, ‘But we have San Yuan who cultivated the Un-Phase Mystical Technique this time and Ying Shan Xue Ying. So it seems we should have some assurance in this first round.’
After that, as time progressed, almost all the Primal Chaos experts started falling one after another.
The young woman-like Fan Mo Zhu revealed a bitter look on her face. It seemed filled with a strand of hatred and slight agony. Following that, she softened down and fell onto the ground.
King Sauron had a ferocious look. His body trembled.
“No, no—”
He still continued murmuring to himself. He was clearly doing his best to resist against it.
But gradually, as the techniques unleashed by the three great Cosmos Gods became stronger, King Sauron also began falling. At this moment, there were just five who were left standing! Xue Ying and Fan San Yuan were both still standing well. It seemed they were quite calm still.

chapters.title: Chapter 1081 - Absolute geniuses
chapters.content:
Chapter 1081: Absolute geniuses
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“There are still five of them. It seems they have specially trained their soul and willpower.” The higher-ups of Summer Wind Ancient Nation were currently transmitting between each other, “There are two young fellows who remain standing in the Fan Clan. One is Fan San Yuan who cultivated in the Un-Phase Mystical Technique. The other is puzzling. It is actually Ying Shan Xue Ying who trained in the Five Phases Sealing Technique! When did it occur that a Void Lineage expert could remain so sturdy against soul assaults?”
“It seems the Fan Clan has put in much effort this time.”
“The other two absolute geniuses from the Summer Clan, ‘Xia Wu Hua’ and ‘Xia Fa Yang’ as well as General Xuan from the Cang Clan are still holding on?”
They were discussing among each other.
Over time.
Of the two geniuses from the Summer Clan, the most handsome cultivator present, ‘Xia Wu Hua’s expression gradually changed. The aura on his body also started turning cold.
“It seems Wu Hua can’t hold on any longer.”
“Indeed, he is about to collapse.”
“He specialized in the Dao of Sword. Even though he placed himself in the world of mortals to temper his heart before, ultimately, he is still lacking compared to the other four in terms of resisting against soul techniques.”
The Great Paragons continued talking.
Xia Wu Hua was an absolute genius ranked in the top three within the history of Summer Wind Ancient Nation. His speed of cultivation was beyond that of Xue Ying! Currently, he had cultivated for just slightly more than a billion years. That time when Xue Ying shocked the world in the Ardent Fire City, Xia Wu Hua had yet to born. He had incredibly great talent on the ‘Dao of Sword’, so much so that ‘Emperor Summer’ personally took him as a disciple to guide him.
“Dong.” Xia Wu Hua finally wobbled and fell.
And the remaining four experts were still staying strong.
The expression of Xue Ying, another absolute genius from the Summer Clan, ‘Xia Fa Yang’ and General Xuan from the Cang Clan remained unchanged. Nonetheless, it was Fan San Yuan whose expression became distorted over time.
“What?”
“I don’t find it puzzling that Xia Fa Yang could easily resist against this soul assault! But General Xuan is so formidable? Very much so compared to the past! There is also that Ying Shan Xue Ying. It seems quite easy for him? Instead, it is Fan San Yuan who trained in the Un-Phase Mystical Technique that could no longer hold on.”
“This is weird.”
The Cosmos Gods were discussing among each other.
Even the higher-ups in the Fan Clan felt their expressions turning slightly. In their opinion, Fan San Yuan should be ranked in the top three for the first round! Yet he could not?
‘Fortunately, we have Ying Shan Xue Ying. Otherwise, all the spotlight will be stolen from us during the first round.’ Sky-Rending Great Paragon felt startled inwardly, ‘We are helpless against those two absolute geniuses from the Summer Clan. But when did that General Xuan become so formidable too?’
Fan San Yuan finally softened down onto the ground!
Leaving behind three standing. They were respectively from the three great clans, Xue Ying, General Xuan, and Xia Fa Yang.
“Mn?”
Over time.
The three Cosmos Gods who were displaying the techniques turned to each other.
“Let’s focus on dealing against these three young fellows. It seems we can’t take any of them down if we don’t put in all our strength. It seems the young fellows this time are much stronger in the soul and willpower aspect than the past.” A bald-headed male said. He continued sending in drizzles of illusory realms.
“Alright.” The girl who was strumming the pipa giggled too.
“These three young fellows are quite amazing. They should have reached the pinnacle of Primal Chaos Realm in the soul aspect.” A male who seemed like a direct person guffawed. As he spoke, ripples were still being produced by him.
The three of them were currently concentrating their strength on dealing against the three remaining survivors. And now, the other 12 Primal Chaos experts who had fallen onto the ground were fully awake.
They opened their eyes.
Looking around, it seemed there were only three left currently suffering from the brunt of attacks—Xue Ying, Xia Fa Yang, and General Xuan.
“We lost.”
“They are the top three.”
‘I, Sauron, has been unparalleled in the Icy Plains Tribe. I do not place other Primal Chaos experts in my eyes, and have succeeded in walking through the ‘Ten Corridors of Life and Death’, yet I am not ranked in the top three.’ King Sauron’s eyes were blank. His proud and aloof heart of the past had suffered from a shock. Indeed, there were so many more talented people out there in the world!
Fan San Yuan’s expression also changed slightly.
Un-Phase Mystical Technique was created by Ancestor Fan! Of which this absolute art specialized in dealing against the soul aspect. Yet he was not ranked in the top three.
‘I lost?’ Xia Wu Hua was slightly startled, ‘I was a Cosmos God back in my hometown. Due to luck, I was able to reincarnate into this Realm Heart Great Land that had an incredibly deep and unfathomable foundation. Emperor Summer even personally guided me. Even though my soul isn’t as strong as that of a Cosmos God, I could not hold on just by purely relying on willpower?’
He was very confident of his willpower. In his hometown, his willpower was known as undying! Currently, he even experienced and tempered his heart within the Summer Clan, yet he still could not hold on as long as others.
…
Other Primal Chaos disciples retreated, leaving just Xue Ying, General Xuan, and Xia Fa Yang.
“Fellow brothers, how do you reckon the ranking would be like?” Emperor Summer chuckled at the two other unparalleled existences next to him.
Emperor Cang looked down at the three young fellows, replying: “This young fellow Cang Xuan has given me a huge astonishment. His cultivation was originally slow, and it was not bad for him to be qualified in representing my Cang Clan in the competition between the three clans. But his soul and willpower had always been ordinary. This time, it is quite amazing that I can’t determine it accurately anymore! And that Ying Shan Xue Ying, his cultivation speed is so fast that it is frightening. Younger Brother Fan, you even took the initiative to accept him as a disciple? Unless you suspected him of being a reincarnator? As for Xia Fa Yang, he is a genius. In my opinion, his previous life is more extraordinary than that of Xia Wu Hua.”
“Mn, the Origin World where Xia Wu Hua was in had been too weak. He cultivated for so many years already, so much so that it is hard to change his understanding of cultivation.” Emperor Summer nodded, “Even though his cultivation is extremely fast, it’ll be hard for him to improve further after becoming a Cosmos God.”
There were pros and cons to reincarnating from a previous life.
The pros included being able to perceive and comprehend two Origin Worlds, which was very helpful to cultivation! Furthermore, with a strong foundation from a previous life, the cultivation speed of the reincarnator would be quick during the early stages.
The cons included being influenced by what the reincarnator comprehended in his previous life!
It was easier to draw on a piece of white paper! And reincarnators were already a piece of art when they reincarnated over!
“Many reincarnators have reached a bottleneck during their previous life in cultivation. That was why they chose to reincarnate.” Ancestor Fan said, “Like the five ancestors from the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, they had all reached the pinnacle and wanted to broaden their perspectives. That was why they reincarnated. Ultimately, few could be so fortunate in getting the Realm Heart Order.”
Xue Ying was an absolute genius in his previous life.
Furthermore, despite spending a trillion years chasing after the Destruction Devils, his attainments were still shocking. It was because of Sacred Master that forced Xue Ying to reincarnate.
******
“Mn?”
“This is truly unbearable.”
Xue Ying felt uncomfortable.
Three types of soul attacks.
That illusory realm technique was quite ineffective against him because he was an expert in that aspect. Instead, it was the ‘melody of Pipa’ that made him sleepy. The melody from the Pipa directly permeated into his soul. He felt exasperated and wanted to sleep… as for that laughter, it made his soul irritable and chaotic. It was hard to ‘quieten his heart down’.
Having a calm heart was fundamental. Otherwise, it would be easier to suffer from the brunt of the attacks.
These three great techniques came engulfing down at the same time! It was indeed frightening when all techniques supported one another.
“Wake up, wake up!” Xue Ying tried his best to hold on.
But he began feeling more and more unbearable. Xue Ying felt muddleheaded, and it became harder to control the irritation and fatigue in his heart. He felt tired and drained. The illusory realm was also pulling him in. What a wonderful world! Xue Ying really desired to enter this imaginary realm and have a good rest.
“Dong.”
Following that, a vague sound was transmitted.
“Someone fell down?” With this thought, as the power from the three powerful soul assaults increased yet again, it seemed to break apart what little resolve Xue Ying had. “Hong—”
He felt his world turning dark.
And lost consciousness after that.

chapters.title: Chapter 1082: Xia Won
chapters.content:
Chapter 1082: Xia Won
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Victory of Summer Clan
Xue Ying regained consciousness. He first saw ‘Xia Fa Yang’ from the Summer Clan who just similarly regained consciousness as with Cang Clan’s ‘General Xuan’.
“Who is first? Who is second?”
They immediately stood up and felt puzzled as well.
Because previously, they were focusing entirely on resisting against the soul assault and did not have the heart to care about the outer world. Hence, they did not know what the ranking was.
“Brother Flying Snow, you are second.” Fan San Yuan transmitted over, “What a pity that you almost got first! The three of you held on for a long time. In the end, all three of you fell down one after another, and the gap in between was small.”
Xue Ying was momentarily startled.
Second?
Xue Ying was an absolute genius in the Mirage and Illusory Realm. He also cultivated the avatar technique and broke apart the cage before absorbing the mysterious aura to nourish his soul. He was confident of getting first, yet he got second in the end! Furthermore, the gap between the top three was small, showing that the difference between them in this aspect was small.
‘I barely got first?’ Xia Fa Yang also got transmissions from his clan. He could not help but turn to the other two, feeling shocked inwardly, ‘I’ve already reached the pinnacle of Primal Chaos Realm in the Dao of Heart, and also specialized in the Dao of Array! For the sake of researching in arrays, I paid a hefty price to absorb ‘Essence of Chaotic Origin’ worth a total value of 20 billion cosmos crystals. I thought that nobody should be able to surpass me amongst those at the Primal Chaos Realm in resisting against soul techniques. Who would have thought that the two of them are comparable to me.’
Xia Fa Yang was the one that the Summer Clan favored the most.
Dao of Heart, Dao of Array…
It was very hard to reach the Cosmos God Realm in these two Dao paths! Studying in the Dao of Array was time-consuming and required much effort too! Of course, a stronger soul would naturally hasten the speed of researching on arrays. That was why Xia Fa Yang chose to disregard the price and borrowed cosmos crystals from others in the clan to absorb so much ‘Essence of Chaotic Origin’ that he spend such a hefty sum.
‘I am third?’ General Xuan frowned, ‘I finally succeeded in grasping the cultivation bestowed upon by ‘Teacher Yuan’ before breaking through to the Cosmos God Realm! Only then was I qualified to become a disciple of ‘Teacher Yuan’. My soul has reached grand perfection, yet it still lacks compared to these two. But that’s right too. In the eyes of Teacher Yuan, I barely succeeded.’
But he did not know.
Xue Ying and Xia Fa Yang. One cultivated the Mirage and Illusory Realm to the pinnacle of Primal Chaos Realm. The other developed the Dao of Heart to the pinnacle of Primal Chaos Realm. One nourished his soul by absorbing the mysterious energy from beyond the Origin World, and the other consumed a large amount of Essence of Chaotic Origin! He, General Xuan, had never deliberately cultivated in a soul-related technique, yet he could reach this stage. That’s quite unfathomable.
…
These three absolute geniuses had different thoughts.
And ‘Great Paragon Imperial Wind’, the host of this competition between the three clans announced with a smile: “The first round has ended. The winner is Xia Fa Yang from Summer Clan, second is Ying Shan Xue Ying from Fan Clan, and third is Cang Xuan from Cang Clan.
Summer Clan has now temporarily scored three golden cauldrons, the Fan Clan two golden cauldrons and Cang Clan with one golden cauldron… Haha, the next round will begin shortly.”
“The second round is a contest between the overall disciple nurturing capabilities of the three clans. 15 Primal Chaos experts from the three clans will be divided into three teams accordingly. Each group will contain one member from Summer Clan, Fan Clan, and the Cang Clan. Every group will fight within themselves, and the final victor will earn one golden cauldron. A total of five groups means five golden cauldrons.”
“Everyone should make your preparations now.”
Great Paragon Imperial Wind finished speaking.
After which, he began discussing with the two Great Paragons from Cang Clan and Fan Clan.
Each clan would be sending in an arranged list of names. Nobody knew who the other chose! Once the names are submitted, the positions would be respectively grouped accordingly—the first name would be in the first group, second in the second group and so on.
Xue Ying went back to his seat.
“Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow, you have done very well in the first round.” Monarch Andromeda said, “Currently, we are just slightly losing behind the Summer Clan. There is still the second and third round. Regardless, we have a high chance of winning. Fellow cultivators must do your utmost.”
“Yes.” Those present acknowledged.
Very soon, the name list was publicized.
“The second round will begin now.” Great Paragon Imperial Wind announced to the public. His voice sounded out within the vast palace hall, “The first group consists of Xia Wu Hua, Sauron, Cang Qing Lei. The rules are as follow: those who are thrown out of the platform will lose. Those who are saved by Emperor Summer will also lose.”
Xue Ying sat there.
The appearance order for Fan Clan is as follows: King Sauron, Fan San Yuan, Ying Shan Xue Ying, Fan Yi Qian, and Fan Mo Zhu.
“Xia Wu Hua?”
“It seems we are troubled this time.”
“The possibility of Xia Wu Hua winning this round is much higher.” Various guests were discussing. Xia Wu Hua was famous here, and King Sauron was ultimately from a distant Icy Plains tribe that originated from outside the nation. As for Cang Qing Lei, he wasn’t considered bright in the Cang Clan at all.
At the center of the palace hall.
A huge silvery-white circular battle platform had appeared there. Xia Wu Hua, Sauron, and Cang Qing Lei were all on the platform inspecting each other. There could only be a single victor from the three of them!
“Begin.” Great Paragon Imperial Wind announced. The moment he finished speaking, the three Primal Chaos experts immediately crossed paths. They were not merciful at all, and were not worried about anything since three unparalleled existences were present here! Under the scrutiny of Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan and Emperor Cang, there had never been any deaths happening within the competition between the three clans! After all, the gap was too vast, and Emperor Summer could undoubtedly save the losing party at the final moment.
“Hong~”
Cang Qing Lei transformed into a giant. His skin was deep green in color. Thunder could be seen swimming away from the surface of his body. He held onto two great hammers and were incredibly overbearing.
As for ‘King Sauron’ who was already tyrannical, he currently emanated ripples and started entering close combat. King Sauron cultivated in two Dao paths and was extremely strong. After all, that time when he battled ‘Fan Yi Qian’, the other party was forced to utilize his forbidden technique. Adding up the fact that the space was too small and King Sauron could not dodge, that was why he lost. Currently, this battle platform might not seem huge, but in reality, it was a thousand times bigger than that of the tiny courtyard. There was sufficient space for him to dodge.
“It seems this fellow from the Icy Plains Tribe is quite good.”
“Dao of Ripple, Dao of Slaughter? He cultivated in both Dao paths? They seem to support each other? Xia Wu Hua seems to have met some trouble this time!”
“It is hard to determine the outcome.”
Xia Wu Hua merely had a single sword.
He placed everything on his sword. He was loyal to it.
After a short moment of frenzied battle.
Cang Qing Lei was clearly weaker by a level among the three of them. But his body was quite strong. Besides, King Sauron was relying on him to attack Xia Wu Hua! Hence, he was forced out of the battle platform after a long period by Xia Wu Hua.
And that was when the battle between King Sauron and Xia Wu Hua became more brutal.
“Hua hua hua.”
Dazzling sword lights were like a celestial river. They poured down on the body of King Sauron.
Many injuries were also strangely appearing on the body of Xia Wu Hua.
“Hu.”
Finally, Emperor Summer acted and teleported King Sauron out of the platform. After all, King Sauron consumed too much life force of his body, leaving just 10% remaining while Xia Wu Hua still had more than 50% his original life force!
‘I lost again.’ King Sauron returned to his position deep in thoughts.
That time when he was chosen by Fan Clan, he felt relatively proud in his heart.
After all, he was chosen amongst many Primal Chaos experts across many nations. King Sauron had a feeling that the Fan Clan was asking for his help, making him feel that he was more amazing than core disciples from the Fan Clan. But it was during the competition between the three clans that he experienced how lacking he was compared to the top three. He lost yet again in the second round.
“The Summer Clan has won the first group. Let’s not be overly anxious. The second group of battle is about to begin, and we’ll have to rely on you, San Yuan.” Monarch Andromeda looked towards Fan San Yuan.
Fan San Yuan nodded and stood.
…
In this group of battle.
They consisted of Fan San Yuan, Xia Cheng Yuan, and Cang Zhe Yong.
“What?”
The battle happened in a way that startled many guests. Xue Ying felt shocked too.
Even though he knew soul and willpower did not represent a strong combat ability! That Cang Clan’s ‘Cang Zhe Yong’ was the most dazzling cultivator before General Xuan revealed his splendor. This time, he was quite formidable during the battle too. Nevertheless, when faced against the Fan San Yuan with the ‘Un-Phase Mystical Technique’, he was disadvantaged. However, who would have thought that it was ‘Xia Cheng Yuan’ from the Summer Clan, a jovial young man to reveal such frightening strength.
He began singing.
“Weng, Hua, Fu…”
Many characters were shouted out from his mouth. This unseen ripple engulfed and restricted both Cang Zhe Yong and Fan San Yuan at the same time.
In the end, Cang Zhe Yong and Fan San Yuan were both restricted by many layers of force. They could not resist and were sent out of the platform.
“The <Great Dao Song> created by Emperor Summer? He, he actually grasped it?”
“He succeeded in training in the <Great Dao Song>?”
Too horrifying.
Xia Wu Hua and Xia Fa Yang were both termed as absolute geniuses of this era in Summer Clan. And Xia Cheng Yuan was a low-profile young fellow. Even though he was a core disciple, he still lacked in ways compared to those two.
But the <Great Dao Song> was just like the <Five Phases Sealing Technique>, a horrifying cultivation technique that was extremely hard to train in. But the moment one grasped it, he would be abnormally strong! Clearly, this Xia Cheng Yuan was extremely low-profile and had only revealed his strength during this competition between the three clans.
“The five experts from the Summer Clan. It seems Xia Cheng Yuan is quite close in strength to Xia Fa Yang.” Everyone praised.
A single cultivation technique that allowed him to sweep across those at the same level.
Just like the Five Phases Sealing Technique, the moment it appeared, it would suppress others. Even core disciples from the Fan Clan felt apprehensive in front of it. Only Fan Yi Qian was confident in fighting against it.
It was the same as the <Great Dao Song>. One would be defeated if he could not resist it!
‘The legendary <Great Dao Song>?’ Xue Ying felt astonished inwardly, ‘If I merely grasped the Five Phases Sealing Technique, chances are I would not fare well in this competition between the three clans.’
If Xue Ying relied purely on the Five Phases Sealing Technique and opened his mouth wide like a lion, demanding for higher rewards, the Fan Clan would likely switch him with another one.
But he grasped a tenth level technique in the Mirage and Illusory Realm. That accompanied with Five Phases Sealing Technique! Xue Ying could win any single person present here! After all, even this ‘Xia Cheng Yuan’ wasn’t ranked in the top three within the first round of battle. He might not be able to resist against Xue Ying when he utilized the ‘Devil Heart Bell’. Even if he could, the other party could barely maintain his consciousness. The moment Xue Ying displayed his frightening strength, the other party would lose undoubtedly.
“Things are really getting bad.”
“Is the Summer Clan about to win again?”
“Xia Wu Hua and Xia Cheng Yuan. There are only five groups in the second round. The first two groups are won by the Summer Clan already? The Summer Clan has also gained the advantage in the first round… unless my Fan Clan is about to lose this competition between the three clans again?”
The higher-ups of the Fan Clan were starting to panic.
The gap in strength with the Summer Clan was honestly too significant! It was okay if there were two absolute geniuses. This low-profile Xia Cheng Yuan popped out yet again!
“The third group.” Great Paragon Imperial Wind chuckled. He was feeling good, “Xia Fa Yang, Ying Shan Xue Ying and Cang Ying.”
“Xia Fa Yang!”
“That is the strongest fellow in the Summer Clan for this era, right? Previously, he got first during the first round of soul and willpower competition. According to rumors, he has cultivated the Dao of Heart to the pinnacle of Primal Chaos Realm, and also specialized in the Dao of Array. It seems the Summer Clan is going to win this round yet again. They are dominating this competition, and with so many outstanding experts, the Summer Clan will have a huge advantage in the third round too.”
“It seems hope of the other two clans winning this competition between the three clans has been extinguished.”
“That’s right. The superiority is overwhelming.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1083 - Bullying Others
chapters.content:
Chapter 1083: Bullying Others
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Fa Yang, win another round!”
“Brother Fa Yang, we’ll depend on you next.”
The Summer Clan was swelling in confidence. Even though Xia Cheng Yuan who grasped the <Great Dao Song> was outstanding too, it could be said that he was close to Xia Fa Yang in strength. Xia Fa Yang specialized and cultivated two Dao paths. The Dao of Array was terrific by itself. Furthermore, he also developed in the ‘Heart of Dao’ which dealt in the soul. Any target who could not oppose a soul attack could be killed easily.
And those who could resist against the soul attack would become significantly weakened!
“Rest assured.”
Xia Fa Yang stood up and smiled before moving over to the circular battle platform located at the center of the palace hall.
Cang Clan’s Cang Ying was a cold old man. He was extremely low-profile: ‘What dumb luck to actually meet the strongest two cultivators in soul and willpower.’
Those with weak soul and willpower did not mean poor combat strength.
But those who could rank in first or second in soul and willpower would similarly have a horrifying strength! Either they specialized in soul techniques, or they cultivated in some horrific cultivation techniques that resulted in a heaven-defying soul strength.
‘Xia Fa Yang is the strongest cultivator on the side of the Summer Clan. And Ying Shan Xue Ying… could possibly also be the strongest from the Fan Clan. Ai, why must it be so coincidental to meet the two of them?’ Cang Ying felt helpless.
…
Xue Ying calmly stood.
“Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow, you must win this group. We must not lose anymore.” Monarch Andromeda transmitted.
“Brother Flying Snow, I lost. It is up to you now.” Fan San Yuan transmitted over too.
Everyone looked at Xue Ying.
Even as he was scrutinized and had voice messages being transmitted to him, Xue Ying walked to the circular battle platform calmly! On the platform, Cang Ying, Xia Fa Yang, and Xue Ying all stood there prepared for battle.
The surrounding guests were also watching on. They became quiet and continued their discussions through voice transmissions.
Great Paragon Imperial Wind, the host of this competition between the three clans announced: “Begin.”
The moment he finished speaking.
“Weng.”
A green lotus flower-like array started revolving. It practically occupied the entire battle platform and came down from the top!
That array came instantaneously. It was impossible to be dodged. Unleashing that technique was as quick as a single thought! This technique that could be activated so quickly seemed to be similar to the illusory realm, which could be sent with a single thought as well!
Even though Xue Ying’s ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’ could not be dodged, he had to first fuse the five phases into one single entity.
“Break for me.”
Cang Ying who was situated within the simple-looking lotus flower roared. An enormous black mamba appeared behind his back. At this moment—
“Hua.”
His soul and willpower seemed to be engulfed by an even greater ‘world’ instantaneously. That was a colossal soul realm.
“Ding ding ding ding dang~” At the same moment when the soul and willpower of Cang Ying were engulfed, he vaguely heard another ringing sound, causing him to lose himself before he had the time to retaliate.
Poor pitiful Cang Ying.
Suffering from soul attacks by Xue Ying and Xia Fa Yang at the same time—even if he suffered from the attack by a single person, he would lose himself, much less from two at the same time. There were ultimately only two outcomes when facing such techniques, either you resisted it or not!
“Hua.” The simple-looking green lotus flower rotated. It easily pushed Cang Ying off the circular platform. Xia Fa Yang only glanced at Cang Ying from the edge of his vision. He did not seem to regard him at all.
Instead, he focused on the white-robed young man in front.
At this moment, there was a green lotus flower secret treasure about a dozen meters long underneath the feet of Xia Fa Yang. There was also a red pearl on his forehead. These two great secret treasures, one was for array and the other for the heart. Xia Fa Yang was currently using them to their fullest power.
“Ding ding ding dang~” A golden bell appeared by the waist of Xue Ying. It let out a clear sound, pulling the consciousness of the enemy using both profound mysteries of Beguiling Sound and Illusory Realm.
Both of them were great experts that had reached the pinnacle of Primal Chaos Realm in the soul aspect.
Even when they faced techniques at the 11th level, they could still barely maintain their consciousness! As for meeting soul techniques at the tenth level, only 20-30% of their concentration would be spent on resisting them. They could still display their formidable combat power.
“Dao of Array?” Xue Ying stood there. There was a bracelet on his right hand containing the Five Phase Bead. The beads currently let out a light. As Xue Ying moved his right hand down slightly, the space in the surrounding was suppressed, preventing that green lotus flower array from moving a single inch more.
“You still lack in your attainments of the array.”
Xue Ying softly shook his head.
He extended his hand.
Five strands of dimmed light revolved around his fingers. His right hand expanded, turning into a palm of several hundred meters in diameter. Wherever his palm crossed cut and tore apart the lotus flower array! The ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’ had formed an independent space. Even Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique could not be used to escape from it. Part of this green lotus flower array was situated within the ‘Five Phases Sealed Space’, and part of it outside. This prevented the arrays from interoperating, hence causing it to break apart.
If the array was formidable enough, it was impossible for the Five Phases Sealed Space to break it apart.
Clearly, Xia Fa Yang might be formidable in the Dao of Array, but it was far inferior compared to the power of the ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’.
“Not good.” Xia Fa Yang’s expression hugely transformed.
“Hu.”
Even though he was anxious and despondent, Xia Fa Yang was at his wit’s end. He tried his best to form more arrays, yet when the huge hand came, it suppressed everything and grabbed him in it.
“Go out.”
With a wave of his hand.
The huge palm casually threw Xia Fa Yang out of the platform.
When the palm disappeared, Xia Fa Yang was already out of the platform.
“I lost.” Xia Fa Yang stood there in a daze.
He was thrown out by a large hand.
He was absolutely talented to be capable of unleashing a tenth level soul technique. Furthermore, his attainment in the Dao of Array was relatively profound too! He was unquestionably the strongest in the Summer Clan amongst those at the Primal Chaos Realm. He was considered extremely outstanding in the history of the Summer Clan too! And the higher-ups from the Summer Clan favored him a lot!
But he was still defeated.
“What? This Ying Shan Xue Ying actually won?”
“That is a secret treasure of the Mirage and Illusory Realm?”
Many guests present were dumbstruck. A young fellow who came from the Southern Cloud Nation was someone the experts from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation belittled originally. Nonetheless, the most outstanding genius from the Summer Clan in this era actually lost to this young fellow?
‘I thought that his heart would be greatly affected by my heart assault, preventing him from being able to utilize the Five Phases Sealing Technique. Who would have thought that he is a great expert in the Mirage and Illusory Realm, and his foundation of the soul is incredibly strong too? Despite being interfered with, he could still unleash the Five Phases Sealing Technique.’
The Five Phases Sealing Technique was a technique fused from five different tenth level techniques. It had a massive burden on his heart.
Nevertheless, Xue Ying’s soul was strong enough!
Furthermore, after creating the ‘Nine Rotation Undying Technique’, he had a perception that he could simply break through to the Cosmos God Realm in the Void Lineage after some slight meditation. He temporarily decided not to cultivate in this Dao! Hence, given how strong his foundation was, using the Five Phases Sealing Technique was as simple as lifting his hand, significantly reducing the heart force required to utilize it.
…
‘It isn’t a grievance for me to lose.’ Xia Fa Yang regained his calmness. He did not place Cang Ying in his eyes during the battle of this group. He only focused on Xue Ying right from the start.
Because he knew that Xue Ying had grasped the famous ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’.
Hence, he wanted to rely on the ‘Heart of Dao’ to influence the heart force of the other party! Preventing him from utilizing the Five Phases Sealing Technique.
‘He is truly an absolute expert in the Dao of Soul.’ Xia Fa Yang shook his head inwardly, ‘I am inferior to him.’
He directly headed back to his position.
Xue Ying also went down the platform.
“Great job, Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow.” Monarch Andromeda was joyous.
“Such an amazing young fellow from the Southern Cloud Nation.” Many guests present etched this cultivator in their mind.
Tenth level soul techniques allowed one to be practically unparalleled at the Primal Chaos Realm.
And adding another ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’, the cultivator would be genuinely unparalleled!
Nobody present other than Xue Ying was so fierce.
“Amazing.” King Sauron was exclaimed in admiration after seeing it.
“Brother Flying Snow, you are truly amazing. You defeated Xia Fa Yang so much that he is not frustrated at all about the loss.” Fan San Yuan smiled and transmitted over.
“I accept my loss, wholeheartedly.” The thin Fan Yi Qian also stated.
“It is nothing much.” Xue Ying smiled. He then returned to his position and sat cross-legged.
It was indeed nothing much.
His strongest technique was the ‘Nine Rotation Undying Technique’. If he were to utilize it, Xia Fa Yang could not injure him at all even as he stands there! The other party could not touch him either. Without having a technique that could break apart the cage of the Origin World, it was impossible to injure Xue Ying. Hence, Xue Ying could easily deal against any enemies.
If one mentioned that with the two techniques, Xue Ying was unparalleled amongst those at the Primal Chaos Realm in this era…
Then after comprehending the ‘Nine Rotation Undying Technique’ to deal against Xia Fa Yang and the others, it gave the feeling of bullying the juniors. The gap in strength was too obvious.
This was also the group battle in this ‘competition between the three clans’.
If Xue Ying could choose a group of cultivators to battle against, he could easily sweep across everyone! But Xue Ying had to do things slowly according to the rules of the competition between the three clans. Regardless, he would be earning 10,000 contribution points when the mission ended!

chapters.title: Chapter 1084 - The Final Round
chapters.content:
Chapter 1084: The Final Round
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“The fourth group, Xia Jing Zhi, Fan Yi Qian, Cang Xuan!” Great Paragon Imperial Wind announced with a smile.
“It’s my turn!” Fan Yi Qian felt his fighting spirit soaring to the sky. On the surface of his body, thunder could be seen swimming away.
Xia Jing Zhi was a beautiful girl. Her aura felt amiable, and anyone would likely garner a pleasant feeling towards her.
Cang Xuan… that was General Xuan.
Xue Ying sat there silently as he watched. He was paying more attention to General Xuan: ‘During the first round when we had to resist against the soul and willpower assaults, he, I and Xia Fa Yang all fell down practically at the same time. I wonder if he specialized in some soul assault technique.’
Those with an incredibly strong soul and willpower might specialize in the soul aspect. They might have a cultivation technique meant for protecting the soul, though it did not mean they must specialize in a soul assault technique! Those with strong soul and willpower had many different Dao paths they could take. Only great experts who specialized in soul and willpower assault would definitely be powerful in their soul and willpower too!
“Hong~”
The battle immediately started.
Very soon, the guests spectating the battle felt startled. The standard of this battle seemed to be quite similar to that between ‘Xue Ying and Xia Fa Yang’s group! It was more spectacular than the first and second round.
“Die, die for me, everyone, die!” Fan Yi Qian had turned entirely mad. His eyes were like thunder. He had clearly activated his forbidden technique.
A bronze pole swept across grandly. With a body imbued in thunder, every move seemed to produce a thunderclap. His speed was outstanding, and in the blink of an eye, Fan Yi Qian had exerted a hundred to a thousand moves! He was not just fast, his power was tremendous and frightening too!
‘How amazing!’ Xue Ying was inwardly shocked as he watched, ‘Such frightening strength. It seems doubtful if my Five Phases Sealing Technique could even withstand against such berserk strikes.’
Xia Jing Zhi also used her technique. Her Dao of Sword was Yin and soft in nature. She could still hold on under the violent attacks by Fan Yi Qian.
But what startled Xue Ying most was that ‘General Xuan’.
“Peng peng peng.”
The body of General Xuan seemed to let out a violet splendor. The violet brilliance shone across the platform and also engulfed Xia Jing Zhi and Fan Yi Qian. General Xuan personally dealt against ‘Fan Yi Qian’ using a great hammer.
The great hammer and bronze pole.
The great hammer seemed to be fleeting and light. But General Xuan did not seem to be disadvantaged. He could withstand against the strikes from the pole. Furthermore, over time as the violet brilliance entangled and restricted the other party, Fan Yi Qian felt his body becoming sluggish as if he was moving through a quagmire. Even as he let out a frustrated shout, the strength which he could utilize seemed to drop continually until eventually, General Xuan casually smashed his hammer down.
“Peng.” He easily smashed the significantly weakened Fan Yi Qian out of the battle platform.
General Xuan then turned to Xia Jing Zhi.
Xia Jing Zhi was originally weaker in her body cultivation. As the restriction from the violet brilliance became heavier and heavier, any tenth level expert could easily defeat her. General Xuan merely went over and send out a smash, blasting Xia Jing Zhi away.
‘The moment he activated his domain, it is at the peak of the tenth level power. Furthermore, it is also strengthening over time. At least I have yet to witness the limit of the domain before the battle ended. What exactly is this cultivation technique?’ Xue Ying lamented in his heart. Given his wisdom, he could not discern what this technique was. But it was clearly strong.
…
In the fourth group, General Xuan won. The Cang Clan had at least won a group battle.
Fifth group…
“Ah?”
Xue Ying watched in shock at the green-robed young woman who was the only one standing in the circular battle platform.
‘Fan Mo Zhu? She won?’ Xue Ying was shocked. One of the reasons why Fan Mo Zhu won was because her two opponents were slightly weaker. More importantly, Fan Mo Zhu was very strong, ‘Fan San Yuan, Fan Mo Zhu, and Fan Yi Qian… the three of them should be at the same level in strength. The gap isn’t huge at all. Fan Yi Qian is berserk and strong, Fan San Yuan is more balanced. As for Fan Mo Zhu… what an amazing Dao of Sword. It seems to be close in level to that of Xia Wu Hua.’
The people in the hall were currently discussing among each other.
Because the second round had already ended. Of the five grouped battle, the Summer Clan won two, the Fan Clan won two and Cang Clan won one.
“Haha, both the Summer Clan and Fan Clan won two groups each, and the Cang Clan won one. Hence, currently, the Summer Clan has accumulated five golden cauldrons, the Fan Clan with four golden cauldrons and the Cang Clan with two golden cauldrons.” Great Paragon Imperial Wind announced.
Cang Clan’s two golden cauldrons were acquired by General Xuan!
As for the Fan Clan, Xue Ying had contributed more than half the cauldrons.
The Summer Clan… was overall too strong.
“After a slight respite, when everyone regains your strength, we will begin the third round and also the final round.” Great Paragon Imperial Wind said. There were quite a few who were heavily injured during the battle previously, or that they spent too much heart force. Hence, there was a need to give them a period to rest.
******
Above the great hall.
Emperor Summer looked towards Ancestor Fan with a grin: “Brother Fan, according to the rules of the competition between the three clans, this third round would allow these young fellows to use all their techniques. My Summer Clan has not just two geniuses, Xia Fa Yang and Xia Wu Hua in this era. I did not know that Cheng Yuan, this child, has grasped the <Great Dao Song>. Even though your Fan Clan has that Ying Shan Xue Ying, and Cang Xuan from the Cang Clan, they are both merely one person! And my Summer Clan has three juniors who are extremely powerful. By then, their results will accumulate. In addition to the fact that my Summer Clan got an advantage during the first two rounds, I am 80-90% confident that my Summer Clan will win this competition.”
With the humble attitude of Emperor Summer, even though he mentioned 80-90% confidence, in reality, the outcome was final.
“Young Brother Fan, your Fan Clan has lost five times. It seems you will be losing the sixth time as well.” Emperor Cang chuckled.
“Hmph, six times… this time, three young geniuses emerged from the Summer Clan that is stronger than the previous five competitions.” Ancestor Fan frowned.
He was very confident of Xue Ying.
He would absolutely sweep across all opponents in a one-on-one battle!
But he was just by himself! Fan San Yuan and the others were quite outstanding, yet compared to ‘Xia Fa Yang’ and ‘Xia Cheng Yuan’, they were still lacking.
“No matter what, if your clan lost, your clan lost. It would be the sixth consecutive time.” Emperor Summer chuckled.
They did not really care much about winning or losing.
To them, unparalleled existences, they were not many things that felt entertaining. To make their old friend ‘break the record’ again was something that Emperor Summer and Emperor Cang felt interesting.
“No rush. It is not yet final!” Ancestor Fan nonchalantly replied. On the surface, he seemed calm. Nevertheless, he understood in his heart that there appeared to be no hope in this competition between the three clans.
…
As they rested, all sorts of rare wine were brought over. After drinking the wine, it would warm the spirit and nourish the body. After two hours, everyone’s state had regained its peak.
“This is also the final round for this generation’s competition between the three clans.” Great Paragon Imperial Wind chuckled, “The first round is a competition between the soul and willpower. The second round is a competition between the overall disciple nurturing capabilities of each clan. But ultimately, as cultivators, our individual skills are still the most fundamental! It is common for a powerful expert to sweep across a group of other cultivators. Hence, the final round will be the one that allows all you Primal Chaos experts from the three great clans to unleash all your strength.”
“Hua.”
Great Paragon Imperial Wind waved his hand.
Immediately, a chain of 15 Eden Worlds appeared in the center of the palace hall, “In a while, the 15 of you will enter an Eden World each. His Majesty Emperor Summer will personally form many waves of enemies.”
“When a wave of enemies is defeated, that disciple will earn a golden cauldron for his clan. Two waves of enemies and it’ll be two golden cauldrons… this will continue until the end when all nine waves of enemies are defeated. That’ll be nine golden cauldrons in total!” Great Paragon Imperial Wind laughed, “The golden cauldrons earned by all disciples sent from the three great clans will add up and determine the final outcome.”
“I remembered during the previous competition between the three clans, there were only six who could defeat the first wave of enemies, and two who could defeat the second wave.” Great Paragon Imperial Wind chuckled.
The disciples from the Summer Clan, Fan Clan, and Cang Clan already knew before this.
The final round of the trial was challenging.
Those who were chosen to participate in the competition between the three clans were extremely formidable. But the majority could not win the first wave! As for the second wave? Only the most talented ones in each generation could triumph over the second wave!
And what the Great Paragon Imperial Wind mentioned regarding ‘defeating nine waves of enemies’?
