That had never happened in history!
Ever since the competition between the three clans started, the most fantastic disciple only defeated four waves!
“Everyone must stake it all.” Monarch Andromeda anxiously transmitted, “The four of you must at least win the first wave of enemy. And Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow… hopefully, you could win three waves at least!”
Fan Yi Qian, Fan San Yuan, King Sauron, and others were solemn.
The three of them had yet to earn a single golden cauldron for the Fan Clan. Being proud disciples, they were naturally feeling stifled.
‘I could move unhindered across the Icy Plains Tribe. Unless I am going to fail again after coming over to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation? No!’ King Sauron felt unwilling to let things be. Fan San Yuan and Fan Yi Qian were both filled with fighting spirit too. As for Fan Mo Zhu, she sat there silently, and Xue Ying remained calm as usual.
“Alright, time for everyone to enter the Eden World.” Great Paragon Imperial Wind announced.
They moved in an orderly manner.
The 15 Primal Chaos experts stood up. They did not snatch for positions either. The Summer Clan took the center, and the Fan Clan and Cang Clan took the two sides. The 15 Primal Chaos experts entered their own respective Eden Worlds!

chapters.title: Chapter 1085 - Teleported
chapters.content:
Chapter 1085: Teleported
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying entered a vast Eden World. This Eden World only had a piece of land.
‘Interesting.’
Looking afar.
His gaze crossed through the membrane of the Eden World to the external world. He saw many other Eden Worlds outside, and also enormous figures of the guests situated in the palace hall!
‘They haven’t become bigger at all. Instead, it should be me who shrank after entering this Eden World?’ Xue Ying immediately understood this point.
“Hong long long~”
Suddenly, energy began gathering in the Eden World.
Xue Ying decided to forgo observing his surroundings. The other 14 Primal Chaos experts also became alert.
“Hua! Hua! Hua!” Three strands of silver-armored soldiers condensed one after another. They were all emanating an energy equivalent to that of Cosmos Gods and should be at least God Yuan Palace tenth level strength.
“Kill!”
They were about to display their techniques when at this moment—
“Ding ding ding ding dang~” A sweet ringing sound echoed. That golden bell by Xue Ying’s waist lightly swayed. The three silver-armored soldiers did not have sufficient time to display their techniques when they softened down and fell onto the ground. As their consciousness died, their bodies began crumbling apart and dissipated like grits.
They were ultimately not real sentient beings and were created by Emperor Summer with a thought.
Even though their consciousness was created, it was feeble. Their styles of combat were directly implemented by Emperor Summer himself. In terms of resisting against soul assault, it was Emperor Summer who applied a layer of protection! As this was merely the first level of trial, the soul protections they had were slightly weaker.
‘The first wave isn’t that hard either.’ Xue Ying thought. If the first wave of enemies could resist against a tenth level Illusory Realm technique, that would be truly frightening.
Xue Ying looked out to the external world after that, inspecting other Eden Worlds and witnessing the techniques these ‘silver-armored soldiers’ had.
…
“Hmph.”
Many ripples were released from the surface of King Sauron’s body. They spread out in all directions, influencing the three silver-armored soldiers around him. At the same time, he also focused on frantically attacking a silver-armored soldier that was blazing in flames.
“Hua.” ONe other silver-armored soldier was like black fog, dissipating and condensing occasionally! When it condensed into being, it would entangle and try restricting King Sauron.
The final silver-armored soldier would generate a long shuttle in its hand whenever it attacked. When the shuttle was thrown, it would form lightning and fly like an inundating wave! Those attacks made King Sauron feel headache.
At this moment, the silver-armored soldier that gave the most significant threat was the one he currently fought. The entire body of this silver-armored soldier could form a two-colored toroidal flame. This toroidal flame was the only one that could heavily injure his fleshy body in a single strike! King Sauron was powerful. Ordinary tenth level techniques could not harm him. He could rely on his domain to resist against attacks by the other two soldiers, ensuring the maximum ensuing damage was just some light wounds.
“Break.”
King Sauron had a hard time fighting against that blazing silver-armored soldier, finally scattering his body. But the other party condensed yet again, albeit with a weaker lifeforce.
“Pu.” A lightning shuttle pierced through King Sauron’s body. Following that, the lightning shuttle dissipated.
Black fog rose and came over to restrict King Sauron’s movement.
“Kill, kill, kill!” King Sauron did not care about anything. He was madly focusing on the attacks by the blazing silver-armored soldier and did his utmost to tear down the energy of his target.
“Chi chi chi—”
The two-colored toroidal flames appeared. With two fire rings, one above and one below, they looped around King Sauron, inciting pain and significant injuries on King Sauron. After all, the two vastly different flames supported each other when used together. The damage caused was much more significant than when 10 or 20 lightning shuttles struck him.
‘I must eliminate it as soon as possible!’ King Sauron did not dare let this soldier who controlled the two-colored flames survive all the way.
After ten breaths of time.
It might seem short, yet to King Sauron, who was madly attacking, it felt like ages!
He only had 30% of his original lifeforce left! When he finally consumed away all energy of that blazing silver-armored soldier, causing it to eventually dissipate.
“There are still the two of you left.” King Sauron was fully confident.
And indeed.
When he had just 20% of his life force left, he finally succeeded in defeating all three opponents!
“Finally, at least I survived through the first wave and won a golden cauldron.” King Sauron sighed inwardly. It would be a great humiliation if he did not earn a single golden cauldron after being invited by the Fan Clan.
“But it really isn’t easy winning the first wave.” King Sauron felt really tired. The three soldiers were all formidable and specialized in vastly different abilities. It’s just that his primary body cultivation technique was the <Icy Underworld Scripture>, and fire was incredibly effective against him.
King Sauron then turned to look around him.
With the first glance, he saw the outsider who was similarly invited over by the Fan Clan next to him. The white-robed young man Xue Ying stood there, and his aura seemed just as in the past. That Eden World did not seem to have any scars of battle.
“He defeated the first wave instantaneously?” King Sauron mumbled to himself, “There is always someone better than you! I still lack in skills greatly.”
“Hu.”
“No—”
The battles happening in all 15 Eden Worlds seemed to be entering the final stages. King Sauron was one of those who actually fought for a long time. Three breaths of time after his battle ended, the entire place became quiet.
Four Primal Chaos experts had been teleported out. It was impossible for Emperor Summer to watch them battle to their deaths.
“There are actually 11 disciples this time who survived the first wave of enemies?”
“It seems the overall strength of disciples in this competition between the three clans is quite high.”
“11? I remember the previous time, there was only six, right!”
The guests were all clicking their tongues and exclaiming in surprise.
With 11 disciples surviving through the first wave, it meant the overall strength of this generation had reached an extremely high stage.
“Hahaha, look at the Fan Clan! The entire Fan Clan has actually survived through the first wave, and there are four from the Summer Clan and two from the Cang Clan!”
“It seems the five cultivators sent by Fan Clan this time are quite powerful.”
“No other ways. The Fan Clan can’t afford to lose. Naturally, they had to think of everything to win!”
The guests were discussing.
Indeed, all the disciples sent by Fan Clan had crossed the first wave. Previously, they lost five consecutive competitions already, and this time, after selecting ‘Fan San Yuan, Fan Yi Qian and Fan Mo Zhu’, they felt that the strength of other Fan Clan disciples was slightly too weak. They might not even survive the first wave of enemies in the Eden World. Given that the Fan Clan was not willing to lose, they found cultivators who were sufficiently outstanding from outside the nation.
How hard was it to find a cultivator who was as strong as they when there were no good teachers or proper cultivation techniques outside?
But they barely found two. One was King Sauron from the Icy Plains Tribe, and the other was Xue Ying from the Southern Cloud Nation! And the Southern Cloud King had negotiated with Sky-Rending Great Paragon, allowing the Fan Clan to know that this Xue Ying was much more heaven-defying than what they expected. Even though they gave him the ‘Upper Honored Guest’ benefits, they still quite liked this young fellow.
He was their trump card after all.
Indeed, Xue Ying did not disappoint them! In the first round, Xue Ying got second, earning two golden cauldrons. He even defeated Xia Fan Yang in the second round and got another golden cauldron.
“Hong long long~”
Under the scrutiny of many guests, the Primal Chaos experts in all the 11 Eden Worlds were shrunk. They met another wave of enemies, and this time, there were only two silver-armored soldiers.
These two silver-armored soldiers were much more brutal. One soldier transformed into a cloud lump. This cloud pervaded the entire Eden World, restricting the cultivator. The other was the true testament of brutality.
“Hong.”
It directly transformed into many horrific bolts of lightning. Large amounts of thunderclap were sent out in berserk. ‘Xia Jing Zhi’ from the Summer Clan could not even withstand for a breath of time under the restriction by the lump of cloud and the thunderclaps and was teleported out by Emperor Summer shortly after.
The attacks came abruptly and brutally. It was truly tyrannical.
One by one, the cultivators were teleported out. “Shua shua shua…”
King Sauron, Fan Mo Zhu, and Fan San Yuan were amongst those who were teleported out. The second wave of enemies was too terrifying! Just like in previous competitions between the three clans, only two to three could usually survive through the second wave.

chapters.title: Chapter 1086 - Ancestor Fans Voice Transmission
chapters.content:
Chapter 1086: Ancestor Fan’s Voice Transmission
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“I lost.” Fan San Yuan walked back to his seat and sat down. He felt complicated.
He knew that his journey in the competition between the three clans had thus ended!
He did not get into the top three during the first round, and neither did he win the second round. It was only during the final round did he barely earn a golden cauldron-similar to that of King Sauron! Even Fan Mo Zhu received two golden cauldrons! As for ‘Fan Yi Qian’, he was still battling in the Eden World currently, and much less was needed to speak about Xue Ying.
‘I originally thought I could display my abilities during the competition between the three clans. What a pity that I could not even rank top five in this group of Primal Chaos experts.’ Fan San Yuan softly shook his head. Currently, he continued watching the battles happening within the Eden Worlds.
…
Xue Ying continued to have an easy time in his battle.
The Devil Heart Bell by his waist let out a sweet ringing sound which reverberated in the entire Eden World. This influenced both silver-armored soldiers, greatly diminishing the strength which they could display.
“Hong!”
The lump of cloud moved in turbulence, and lightning was fiercely discharging out.
The presence of both cloud and lightning even brought about some vague transformations. When the lightning struck out, even though every bolt was filled with destructive power, it was similarly filled with the aura of life…
Xue Ying even vaguely saw life forming in a cosmos when lightning struck…
‘Lightning can destroy worlds, yet it could create them too?’ Xue Ying chuckled. Even though this lightning was powerful, the Five Phases Sealing Technique easily resisted these bolts of lightning! After all, under the influence of the Devil Heart Bell, the two silver-armored soldiers could not fully unleash their strength.
“Destroy.”
Xue Ying extended his right hand.
The Five Phase Beads on his bracelet let out light. Xue Ying’s right hand expanded and covered the entire Eden World. Despite the seeming existence of gaps between his fingers, no holes could be found in space! It completely trapped and restricted all the lumps of cloud and lightning! Closely following that, Xue Ying’s large palm shrunk, suppressing the space within.
“Hong! Hong!”
As the two silver-armored soldiers struggled amidst the peals of ringing sound from the Devil Heart Bell and the illusory realm, it was near impossible for them to destabilize the Five Phases Sealed Space. They eventually dissipated from the incredible force.
After Xue Ying eliminated the second wave of enemies, he turned and looked out of the world.
‘Mn? It appears that Fan San Yuan and the others have been teleported out?’ Xue Ying discovered that amongst the Primal Chaos cultivators sent by the Fan Clan this time, other than himself, Fan Yi Qian was the only one left barely holding on.
As for the Cang Clan…
There was only General Xuan! Nevertheless, General Xuan remained unhurried. His violet brilliance shone across the Eden World, allowing his strength to grow indefinitely.
And the Summer Clan
Had three survivors still! Xia Fa Yang, Xia Cheng Yuan, and Xia Wu Hua.
Xia Fa Yang relied on his two great techniques on Heart and Array. He still had it relatively easily. After spending a little more time, he would eventually win.
And Xia Cheng Yuan continued singing his <Great Dao Song> and seemed to still have the upper hand.
Only Xia Wu Hua was having a hard time holding on amidst the berserk lightning.
‘Seems like both Fan Yi Qian and Xia Wu Hua are having a hard time.’ Xue Ying watched, ‘It is unknown if they could survive through the second round!’
“Yi Qian!”
Fan San Yuan and Fan Mo Zhu who were both teleported out watched nervously.
“Disappear! Dissipate!”
Fan Yi Qian was already in a frenzy. His bronze pole was imbued with destructive energy. Everywhere it passed produced lightning that exterminated the myriad existences! His pole could injure the two silver-armored soldiers that transformed into lightning and cloud. Nevertheless, when the cloud and lightning co-existed, Fan Yi Qian was the one who got hurt. Blood began trickling down the edge of his mouth, and his injuries were getting more substantial over time.
At this moment, Fan Yi Qian felt his ears ringing. He could only see bolts of lightning striking down in front of him.
‘No, I am unwilling! I am unreconciled…!’ Fan Yi Qian felt like he was a small boat amidst the storm, a feeling of helplessness which infuriated him!
“Sou.”
Suddenly, a strand of energy descended and engulfed Fan Yi Qian. It teleported him out.
Fan Yi Qian stood there by his table. There were no longer lightning surrounding him. He was still holding on to his bronze pole.
“I wasn’t able to win.” Fan Yi Qian lightly trembled. In the past, he was blindly confident of his incredible strength; he felt like he could sweep across the world! But just now, he experienced being amidst bolts of lightning that were more brutal, causing him to be utterly defeated.
‘Mn?’
At the highest position, Ancestor Fan looked down with a slight frown.
Of the five disciples from the Fan Clan, four had been teleported out. They each earned just a single golden cauldron! It seemed the Summer Clan’s overwhelming advantage was becoming more significant as ‘Xia Cheng Yuan’ and ‘Xia Fa Yang’ had both won!
…
Fan Yi Qian’s battle was ultimately very long. Other than ‘Xia Wu Hua’ who was seemingly having a hard time and was still battling, Xue Ying, General Xuan, Xia Fa Yang, and Xia Cheng Yuan had won.
‘I was a Cosmos God in my previous life! Even though I would lose my qualifications to participate in the competition between the three clans if I were to break through, but I actually lost to four juniors at the Primal Chaos Realm?’ Xia Wu Hua tried his best to fight on. If one said that Fan Yi Qian only knew brutal and oppressive attacks, Xia Wu Hua was more graceful and swam about as a ray of sword amidst the lightning.
Even though the whole world was filled with lightning strikes, they could not touch Xia Wu Hua at all!
And some thunderclaps were guided away by Xia Wu Hua with his sword techniques.
“Hua~”
The sword rays were like a celestial river. They wreaked havoc in the cloud lump. Xia Wu Hua did not care about those rays produced by the sword. Instead, he concentrated on striking the cloud that permeated across the entire world.
‘My body cultivation is not strong enough. I have to do my best and evade from the incoming attacks.’ Xia Wu Hua exerted his body cultivation to the limit. He tried his best to dodge the incoming lightning, yet there were too many bolts, and those bolts were too violent. The power reached an exaggerated stage that despite trying his best to defend himself using the sword lights, Xia Wu Hua’s body was still corroded from the attacks.
“Hong!”
Eventually, the cloud withdrew and transformed back into a silver-armored soldier. Its aura had become relatively feeble. Clearly, it no longer dared to resist against the sword rays directly.
Without its help, the power of the thunder became weaker-about 20-30% its original strength.
“Good.”
“What a beautiful execution.”
“We are about to win.” Many Cosmos Gods from the Summer Clan were shouting out praises.
The Cang Clan was still relatively calm since the gap between Cang Clan and Summer Clan was too big, and they no longer had any hope. Instead, the majority of Cosmos Gods from the Fan Clan were ugly. Before Xia Wu Hua won, the Fan Clan could still hope extravagantly. But now? It seemed they no longer had any hope!
Even though Xia Wu Hua was already heavily injured, he could still easily defeat the silver-armored soldiers.
“The cultivators participating in this competition between the three clans are powerful.”
“There are actually five who won the second wave. Previously, there was only two right? It has been a long time since so many formidable juniors appear in the same generation.”
The Cosmos Gods were exclaiming in admiration.
It was typical for two to three cultivators to succeed through the second wave. There were even the occasional extreme geniuses that emerged in an era’s competition between the three clans who could win four waves at the Primal Chaos Realm.
…
Xue Ying solemnly looked in front as the third wave of enemies had descended.
The surging aura condensed into a single silver-armored soldier. That soldier stood there, though many rings of flames could be seen forming behind him-seven to be exact. They were of varying color and appearance.
‘<Seven-Colored Fire>?’ Xue Ying’s pupils dilated.
Amidst the famous defying cultivation techniques at the Primal Chaos Realm, the <Five Phases Sealing Technique> was ranked extremely high. But there existed some horrifying cultivation techniques that were stronger like the <Three Realms Technique>, <Seven-Colored Fire>, <Eternal Night World>… these techniques were extreme cultivation techniques created by unparalleled existences that could no longer improve further. They had turned back to the Primal Chaos Realm, relied on some secret treasures for research before coming crafting them.
The difficulty of grasping the Seven-Colored Fire was beyond that of understanding the Five Phases Sealing Technique. But there were still some heaven-defying existences that had perceived it in the history of this Origin World. That was a heaven-defying monster from the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation.
Grasping the Eternal Night World was even harder! According to rumors, it required the execution of five types of tenth level soul techniques. Only then could it form the ‘Eternal Night World’.
Eternal Night World…
Everything would be returned to the eternal night. It would cause all existences to enter darkness indefinitely.
‘The Seven-Colored Fire is actually the third wave of trial?’ Xue Ying felt speechless.
“Ding ding ding dang dang~”
The soft sound from the Devil Heart Bell made that silver-armored soldier shake softly. But he was still able to wave his hand and cause a strand of Seven-Colored Flame to emerge.
‘Fortunately, his power has been greatly diminished after suffering from the influence of the illusory realm. It seems like he could no longer establish the complete ring of flames?’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly. If the seven-colored ring of flames came, Xue Ying could not dodge from it at all after being trapped. Once that happened, the seven flames that reached grand perfection would unleash a practically unblockable power! Xue Ying was not confident of resisting against it even with the Five Phases Sealing Technique. He had to rely on the ‘Nine Rotation Undying Technique’ by then.
Currently, it was merely just seven-colored flames. Hence, Xue Ying was still confident of battling the other party using his Five Phases Sealing Technique.
“Exterminate.”
He extended his right hand, causing it to expand to a size covering more than half the Eden World. It slapped down on the surging seven-colored flames. As the seven-colored flames clashed with the large palm, sounds of ‘chi chi chi’ immediately formed, causing the palm to quiver. Holes were formed as the palm burned, though it was rapidly restoring by relying on the transformation of the five phases.
“Hmph.” Seeing this happening, the silver-armored soldier immediately brought out a silver spear and killed its way over. The spear also had seven-colored flames surrounding it.
“Oh? You use spear?” Xue Ying chuckled.
…
At the center of the palace hall, the five geniuses were still fighting.
Xue Ying, who came from the Southern Cloud Nation, could still battle with the silver-armored soldier. As for General Xuan, he was having a hard time running about and doing his best to delay for more time. As for Xia Fa Yang, Xia Cheng Yuan, and Xia Wu Hua, they were having an even more miserable time.
Xia Wu Hua had practically been teleported out at the first moment!
Under the formation of the ‘Seven-Colored Fire’ rings of flames, Xia Cheng Yuan’s Great Dao Song could not resist it at all. He was similarly teleported out after a breath by Emperor Summer.
Xia Fa Yang displayed his Heart Technique, causing the strength of the silver-armored soldier to diminish significantly. But it’s a pity that the power of his array was scattered and smashed after being weakened by the ‘Seven-Colored Fire’. Xia Fa Yang merely delayed for several breaths of time before being teleported out! If it continued on, he would be burned alive. After all, the power of the significantly weakened Seven-Colored Fire was equivalent to Xue Ying’s Five Phases Sealing Technique.
“The Summer Clan is done.” Those guests present made their judgment, “It is likely for the Summer Clan to win this competition between the three clans. There aren’t any variable left!”
And high above the great palace hall.
The three unparalleled existences were similarly watching the battle proceed.
“Haha, my Summer Clan has three fellows winning the second wave in this third round. There is also Xia Jing Zhi who won the first wave! Adding up, that’s a total of seven golden cauldrons. With the five golden cauldrons from the previous rounds, my Summer Clan has acquired a total of 12 golden cauldrons this time.” Emperor Summer smiled at Ancestor Fan, “Brother Fan, the other four fellows from your Fan Clan are quite good, but they only won the first wave, totaling four golden cauldrons! Your clan also won four golden cauldrons previously. This Ying Shan Xue Ying has to win the fourth wave before he could equalize the count at 12 golden cauldrons!”
Xue Ying had to win the fourth wave before allowing the Fan Clan to draw with the Summer Clan!
And winning the fourth wave was considered extremely outstanding in the history of the competitions between the three clans!
Emperor Cang just chuckled from the side: “Even if it ended in a draw, the odds of success in the additional battle aren’t high either.”
“The final outcome hasn’t been fixed in place.” Ancestor Fan continued looking downwards.
Emperor Cang also looked down. Currently, only Xue Ying and General Xuan were fighting, albeit they were having a hard time.
“Seeing that they are having such a hard time fighting the third wave of enemy, there is practically no hope in triumphing the fourth wave of enemies.” Emperor Cang mocked.
…
If Xue Ying wanted to win, he could simply rely on the pinnacle of void-ification to sneak attacks on the enemies. Reaching the pinnacle of void-ification, that was something even the ‘Void Castle’ created by the collective effort of many Cosmos Gods in the Primal Chaos Void could not perceive. At the final moment when Xue Ying reached the side of the enemy, the Five Phases Sealing Technique could directly blast that silver-armored soldier to death. After all, few could resist the full brunt of power from the Five Phases Sealing Technique.
Even if a palm could not kill the enemy, three or four palms would suffice.
It’s just that Xue Ying wasn’t willing to display that technique until the crucial moment. He wanted to thoroughly inspect the legendary <Seven-Colored Fire>! Even though this was considered a legend at the Primal Chaos Realm, there were quite a few Cosmos Gods in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation and Myriad Realms Ancient Nation who specialized in this cultivation technique. After this competition between the three clans ended, he would soon break through to the Cosmos God Realm. By then, his opponents were no longer Xia Fa Yang and the others. Instead, it would be the more powerful Cosmos Gods.
‘What an amazing Seven-Colored Fire. It seems to have reached a new limit in destruction. This was even under the condition of not forming the ring of flames.’ Xue Ying felt astonished inwardly. He was watching the incredibly beautiful Seven-Colored Fire burning his Five Phases Sealed Space.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying.”
Suddenly, a minute change by his side made Xue Ying perceive a frightening sound. In the mind of Xue Ying, including the avatar that was located in the distant Southern Cloud Nation, a sound echoed at the same time.
“If you were to win the fourth wave of enemies, I’ll increase your reward by another 10,000 contribution points! If you were to win the fifth wave of enemies, it’d be an additional 20,000 contribution points!”
Xue Ying sensed something in his heart. After which, he looked up.
His gaze crossed through the membrane of the Eden World, looking at the blurred figure situated at the highest spot in the palace hall outside, ‘Ancestor Fan’. In the past, he could not see him clearly, but this time, Xue Ying could spot the eyes of that blurred figure.
That pair of eyes met with Xue Ying’s gaze.
Xue Ying immediately understood!
“Hehe…” Even though Emperor Cang did not sense it, but Emperor Summer, who was controlling the Eden World and sending in enemies, grinned and glanced at Ancestor Fan to his side. Ancestor Fan remained calmly looking down as if he had not done anything at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 1087 - The End of the Competition (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1087: The End of the Competition (1)
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Facing the third wave of enemies.
Being an expert who grasped both ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’ and the tenth level Illusory Realm, it was expected Xue Ying to win!
“What!”
“This Cang Xuan?”
“He won as well?”
Fan Yi Qian, Fan San Yuan, and the others were startled. There were even several Cosmos God guests who were shocked by the result.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying relied on his Mirage and Illusory Realm, preventing the enemy from unleashing the complete Seven-Colored Fire! That was how he barely won. But this Cang Xuan actually fought with an enemy that could produce the complete Seven-Colored Fire Ring! Nevertheless, he diminished the lifeforce of the enemy and won in the end?” Many guests and even some Great Paragons who had high statuses were ineffably astonished.
Even though the Seven-Colored Fire Ring had already engulfed General Cang Xuan, many rings of violet light similarly surfaced on the body of Cang Xuan, protecting him. Even though the bottom part of his body had started turning into ashes, there was another part which rapidly restored. During this process of ‘being incinerated and reborn’, his lifeforce would still diminish.
Nevertheless, the magnificent violet splendor shone across the entire Eden World, engulfing that silver-armored soldier. As the violet light grew intense, in the end, it was like a horrifying tsunami that charged down on the silver-armored soldier, gravely injuring it.
Finally, Cang Xuan was able to dissipate the lifeforce of the enemy with 20-30% of his original lifeforce left!
“What exactly is this cultivation technique? I believe the Cang Clan does not own such a technique, right?” The higher-ups from the Fan Clan and Summer Clan looked towards the Cang Clan in suspicion. Those Summer Wind Ancient Nation experts who were not part of the three great clans were also bewildered.
They had never seen before such a domain in their life.
Violet?
A domain that grew increasingly strong? Furthermore, it had extremely powerful protective capabilities! One had to know that the Five Phases Sealing Technique would still suffer from damages under an incomplete Seven-Colored Fire. When the Seven-Colored Fire Ring was produced, an absolute majority of Cosmos Gods would end up being incinerated into ashes! Even Xue Ying dared not resist against it directly. He had to rely on the Nine Rotation Undying Technique to prevent the flames from reaching his body!
“What a formidable protective cultivation technique that allows him to take on the Seven-Colored Fire directly?”
“It seems to be the strongest known protective cultivation technique at the Primal Chaos Realm up to date.” Many guests present looked at that General Cang Xuan with varying thoughts. Even ordinary Cosmos Gods that specialized in body cultivation could not reach the standards provided by this technique. This cultivation technique had reached an extraordinary stage and was never seen before in history.
Of course, the happiest cultivators were the higher-ups from the Cang Clan.
The stronger the disciples from the Cang Clan, the happier they would be!
…
And the Fan Clan was the one with the most unpleasant mood!
The six Great Paragons from the Fan Clan sat there. Many other Great Paragons from the Summer Clan and Cang Clan were even laughing and chatting with them.
“Red Lotus Religious Master, this Ying Shan Xue Ying is quite amazing. Who knows, he might win the fourth wave! By then, it is possible for your Fan Clan to win.” An old man filled with golden scales and golden beard laughed.
“There is some hope for the Fan Clan.”
“Mn, that young fellow Ying Shan Xue Ying is quite amazing.”
“The lot of you are truly… Ying Shan Xue Ying has had a hard time winning the third wave. It is certainly impossible for him to win the fourth wave. The more you guys comfort Lu Tian and the others, the more unhappy they will get. Hahaha… But I am thrilled.” An innocent white child from the Cang Clan giggled and began jumping with joy. As he laughed, great billows of sound could be heard echoing in the surroundings.
“Hmph!” The muscular and massive Great Paragon Lu Tian coldly glared at that child who was dancing with joy, “Holy Child, you got so happy just over such a minor affair?”
“Are you feeling disappointed? This is the sixth time already!” That child sneered, “I feel happy just seeing your Fan Clan losing face.”
The face of Great Paragon Lu Tian turned black.
“Haha…” That child remained laughing and giggling.
The other Great Paragons present did not speak.
Everyone had some understanding of the entanglement between Cang Clan’s ‘Bitter Sea Holy Child’ and ‘Great Paragon Lu Tian’. The two of them had a friendship that could last through life and death, yet they were absolutely irreconcilable enemies, resulting in the present outcome. There was once when ‘Bitter Sea Holy Child’ was weaker and had met with a dangerous situation, to which Great Paragon Lu Tian killed his way over in a fury.
The gratitude and grudges between the two could not be dissolved even by Emperor Summer and the other unparalleled existences.
“My Fan Clan hasn’t lost.” Great Paragon Lu Tian swept his gaze across Bitter Sea Holy Child, “So don’t overly delighted, Holy Child.”
“Oh, then I would like to have a look first before becoming even happier in a while!” The child giggled.
The other Great Paragons from the Fan Clan looked in silence at the remaining two Eden Worlds located at the center of the palace hall.
If they lost this competition, firstly, they would be losing face. Secondly, they would miss the chance to enter the Origin Realm God Palace! According to the rules of the Fan Clan, the weaker Cosmos Gods were not qualified to enter as it would be a waste! And those at the level of ‘Ancestor Fan’ had entered so many times that he no longer desired to enter the Origin Realm God Palace any longer. Most of the time, the opportunity was given to Great Paragons.
They wanted to enter!
“Origin Realm God Palace. No matter how much we worked, we aren’t qualified to enter.” Many other invited guests not from the three great clans in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation were absolute experts. Some might even be as strong as the Southern Cloud King, yet they could only sigh inwardly.
They had no choice.
The best resources were saved for the three great clans. Just by slightly ‘leaking some benefits’ to the rest and they were willing to always be at the beck and call of the three great clans!
This was considered excellent already! The Summer Clan and Cang Clan disdained from caring about those from outside the nation. Even though Fan Clan had Honored Guests from outside the nation, any missions they posted were challenging. Hence, the three great clans were considered benevolent when treating civilians within the nation.
…
Within the two Eden Worlds.
Xue Ying and Cang Xuan both waited. “Hong long long”-energy began swirling and condensing. That marked the start of the fourth wave.
“Hua.”
Xue Ying watched as a golden-armored soldier condensed in front of him. That golden-armored soldier stared at Xue Ying coldly. It was filled with boundless coldness.
“Hong-”
Suddenly, the temperature of the entire Eden World began dropping drastically. At the next moment, many places in the world began freezing. Even time-space had started freezing. There were no places the cultivator could dodge at all. If one said that those were merely side effects from the attack, then where Xue Ying was located at would be the central core location of this technique! Dull gray pieces of ice already froze Xue Ying completely. Such a frightening technique could even freeze and cause bodies of Cosmos Gods to crumble alive! Even if they did not die, their bodies would become incredibly slow, greatly diminishing their power, allowing them to be killed easily.
This technique was theoretically impossible for Primal Chaos experts to achieve! Clearly, the fourth wave of the trial included techniques that only Cosmos Gods could display by relying on secret treasures.
‘This is truly amazing.’ Xue Ying seemed to be completely frozen. He remained standing there unmoving, though a smile began appearing at the edge of his lips.
He could still smile despite being frozen?
And in another Eden World.
“Hua.”
Just a breath of time after fighting, General Xuan was teleported out. He had been grievously injured in the previous battle! And the moment this icy cold descended in the fourth wave when General Xuan was frozen by the dull gray ice pieces that were slightly stronger than the Seven-Colored Fire Ring, his injuries continued worsening. A breath of time later, he was teleported out by Emperor Summer.
Thus, the journey of the competition between the three clans for ‘General Xuan’ from the Cang Clan ended here.
The only remaining Primal Chaos Realm cultivator who was still fighting in this competition was Xue Ying who came from the Southern Cloud Nation!
“That’s weird?”
“How come his aura isn’t weakening at all?”
Many guests looked with confusion at the scene happening in the Eden World. After all, this was an Eden World controlled by Emperor Summer, and it was impossible for them to permeate their vision through it. They could only discern what was happening on the projected scenes with their naked eyes.
Xue Ying even turned around to watch as ‘General Xuan’ was teleported out. After that, he disappeared.
“He disappeared?”
“Was he teleported out?”
The higher-ups from the Fan Clan could not help but look carefully in the palace hall, only to discover that Xue Ying’s figure did not appear.
…
Xue Ying wasn’t in a rush to kill the enemies. Under the horrifying domain, he naturally displayed his Nine Rotation Undying Technique at the first moment, preventing that icy coldness from injuring him! Following that, Xue Ying thoroughly ‘inspected’ the technique of the enemies. His experience of fighting with powerful Cosmos Gods was ultimately too little. Naturally, he chose to experience it himself and deduce more of the Supreme Law from it.
His target wasn’t solely to become a Cosmos God.
‘Icy cold, deathly stillness… it seems time-space has been completely frozen as well?’ Xue Ying could not help but be alarmed by this concept of icy coldness.
‘But what I grasped is a concept that transcended beyond the category of ordinary time-space. It is even a concept which directly targets the essence of the entire Origin Realm. I have become one entity with the essence of the Origin Realm. Without breaking apart the cage of the Origin Realm, it is impossible for me to be injured.’ With a thought, Xue Ying’s body disappeared. Even that figure projected in the outer world was gone.
That was a complete vanish.
Many Cosmos Gods could not discern why!
It was precisely this that made achieving the pinnacle of void-ification that horrifying!

chapters.title: Chapter 1088 - The End of the Competition (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1088: The End of the Competition (2)
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Sou.”
The feeling of fusing with the void essence felt beautiful.
Xue Ying strolled within. Space by his body distorted and fluctuated, and he could feel many black fog spherical particles around him. Xue Ying felt like he was part of them. Very soon, he strolled over to the side of that golden-armored soldier who was currently on alert and looking around his surroundings in bewilderment.
“Hong.”
It came without warning.
A large blurred palm formed by five streams of light smashed upon the head of the golden-armored soldier! That soldier did not even have the time to resist. He was brutally slapped!
It might seem like an ordinary slap, yet in reality, this was the complete compression of the Five Phases Sealed Space-a space formed by the perfect fusion of five tenth level techniques! This was truly a brutal and overbearing technique that aimed to destroy the enemy utterly. Even Thunder King Mo Chao’s tenth level Sky Sword Undying Body could not withstand against it. Emperor Summer might give the golden-armored soldier powerful offensive abilities, though he would not make the soldier’s defenses too heaven-defying.
Otherwise, the difficulty of this wave would be overwhelming.
There were still many other waves following this fourth wave where the difficulty gradually increased. Ultimately, this was a trial aimed at the Primal Chaos Realm! It must be achievable by a Primal Chaos expert.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying was slightly startled. Under the complete exertion of the Five Phases Sealing Technique, while catching the enemy unprepared, he was exterminated in one single move, ‘It seems his body survival capabilities aren’t that strong.’
The golden-armored soldier died.
Causing the icy cold in the surrounding to dissipate.
And from nothingness… the figure of Xue Ying walked out.
…
Watching that white-robed young man appearing from nothingness within the Eden World, Fan Yi Qian, Fan San Yuan, Fan Mo Zhu, King Sauron, including Primal Chaos experts from the Summer Clan and Cang Clan were stupefied.
Disappearing into nothingness? Killing the enemy with one single move?
“It appears he hasn’t revealed his true strength despite triumphing over the third wave?” General Xuan was incredibly shocked. It was luck that he could become a disciple of ‘Teacher Yuan’. Even though he might be humble on the surface, he still had a strand of pride in his heart. But now, he was utterly beaten to a daze!
“So this is his true strength? No wonder he could become an Upper Honored Guest.” Fan San Yuan even felt that it was Fan Clan’s fortune to invite such an unparalleled Primal Chaos expert to be their Upper Honored Guest.
One had to know…
Ever since the second War of the Ancient Nations, the most frightening disciple participating in the ‘competition between the three clans’ could at most win the fourth wave! It was too difficult. When was it ever so easy like what Xue Ying accomplished?
“Hahaha!”
Sky-Rending Great Paragon immediately stood. He laughed boisterously, “Wonderful! Fabulous! No wonder he is an Upper Honored Guest of my Fan Clan.”
His laughter reverberated within the palace hall. He even deliberately swept across the Great Paragons from the Summer Clan and Cang Clan who was by the side! Previously, those Great Paragons took liberties and teased him. Being the current chief of the entire Fan Clan, it was only now that Sky-Rending Great Paragon guffawed out loud, deliberately slapping the face of the others! Reaching their level, they would not fight each other since they were ultimately from the same ancient nation. Instead, battles over fame and honor was more commonly seen.
“Beautiful.”
“Amazing.”
“This is the pinnacle of void-ification? Attaining the pinnacle of void-ification at the Primal Chaos Realm? Unfathomable, magnificent!”
“Which pinnacle of void-ification cultivation technique did he learn from? Did the Southern Cloud Nation own such a technique?”
“Why do you even care where he learned it? It is a good thing that he could use it.”
The Cosmos Gods from the Fan Clan were currently beaming with happiness. Sky-Rending Great Paragon, Red Lotus Religious Master and the others were in a pleasant mood because they were able to discern that Xue Ying won the fourth wave easily! This heaven-defying Xue Ying who grasped the tenth level illusory realm technique, Five Phases Sealing Technique and the pinnacle of void-ification was absolutely the most terrifying Primal Chaos expert appearing in the history of the competition between the three clans. It was likely that the fifth wave could not obstruct him at all!
As long as he won the fifth wave, then the Fan Clan would have won the whole competition.
By then, the chance of entering the Origin Realm God Palace would belong to them, the Fan Clan! Sky-Rending Great Paragon and the others had been thinking about it. They began discussing.
“It is the right decision to select him.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon was rejoicing.
10,000 contribution points won the Fan Clan a chance to enter the Origin Realm God Palace. That was totally worth it! Even if it cost 30,000 or 50,000 contribution points, it would still be worth the price!
But he did not know that Ancestor Fan had already promised Xue Ying extra rewards!
…
And seated at the highest position.
Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang, and Ancestor Fan were all in slight shock. The pinnacle of void-ification?
“He actually grasped the pinnacle of void-ification? At the Primal Chaos Realm? He should be a powerful Cosmos God who reincarnated over.” Emperor Summer and the others could not help but think along this line of thought. It was honestly too difficult to grasp it at the Primal Chaos Realm. Like Gu Qi, being a Cosmos God in the Dao of Void, he even had the guidance from a cultivation technique, the < Walker’s Hidden Secret>. As long as he cultivated to the 60th level of grand perfection, he would have attained the pinnacle of void-ification. Nevertheless, he did not achieve it.
One could see how difficult it was to grasp the pinnacle of void-ification.
The difficulty was beyond grasping the <Eternal Night World>, <Three Realms Technique> and <Seven-Colored Fire>. It was absolutely classified as the hardest Primal Chaos Realm cultivation technique to grasp! This was something many Cosmos Gods desired since this technique drastically increased their survival capabilities since breaking the cage of the Origin World was too challenging. Even experts who specialized in the void had a hard time breaking it, much less those who cultivated in other Dao paths.
“It is too difficult to train in it at the Primal Chaos Realm. But he should have reincarnated into this world, and might have reached extremely high attainments in his previous life.” Emperor Summer and the others believed firmly that Xue Ying should be an expert at the level of Southern Cloud King in his previous life. With such a deep foundation, he instead chose to disguise as a Primal Chaos expert. It was entirely possible to attain the pinnacle of void-ification just by relying on the Profound Mysteries at the Primal Chaos Realm.
“Where did the pinnacle of void-ification cultivation technique?”
The three of them were curious.
Because currently, only the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation and Summer Wind Ancient Nation owned cultivation techniques of achieving the pinnacle of void-ification at Primal Chaos Realm! According to logic, Xue Ying should not have learned them. Instead, it should be grasped from another Origin World?
Ancestor Fan smiled. He did not care about this too much since it was normal for experts to exist in other Origin Worlds. For instance, the five ancestors from the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation were reincarnators.
But no matter what, Xue Ying had helped his Fan Clan this time.
“The fourth wave has been settled.” Ancestor Fan smiled at Emperor Summer, “It should be time for you to begin the fifth wave.”
Emperor Summer and Emperor Cang exchanged glances. This pair of old brothers chuckled.
“I still thought we could let Brother Fan set a new record, for the Fan Clan to lose six consecutive times. What a pity that it has been destroyed by a little fellow.” Emperor Summer joked. Saying that, he sent out the fifth wave of enemies. Naturally, given his status, he would not deliberately increase the difficulty. For him to make both Ancestor Fan and Emperor Cang willingly assist him, other than having sufficient power, this major decision of being fair was what Emperor Summer could do! He even deliberately gave many benefits to the Fan Clan and Cang Clan too!
…
“Hong! Hong! Hong!”
The fifth wave consisted of two golden-armored soldiers. This time, Xue Ying chose to bring out his Scarlet Cloud God Spear. Actually, the ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’ was the rotation of the condensation by five phases and could be applied on his palm, other weapons and even on space! Depending on the style of utilization, it could completely press down on an enemy after trapping him in space, or it could be used to strike out with the full power of space!
This time, Xue Ying chose to use his weapon. He applied the Five Phases Sealing Technique on his spear, allowing the spear to become incomparably heavy. Xue Ying then hacked down with a blast.
A golden-armored soldier dissipated from a single smash! And the other too two smashes before it disappeared.
“Hu.”
After winning the fifth wave, Xue Ying was simply headed out of the Eden World. There was no need to continue. After all, there was no need for him, an outsider, to appear too prominent within the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
“Hahaha, Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow, you have done a great job!” Sky-Rending Great Paragon personally came down. He took two to three steps before arriving before Xue Ying. He then passed Xue Ying a cup of wine, enthusiastically speaking, “Come, let me give you a toast.”
Xue Ying was slightly overwhelmed by the favor.
Sky-Rending Great Paragon actually came down to give him a toast at such a setting? One had to know that of the six Great Paragons from the Fan Clan, Sky-Rending Great Paragon was vaguely the one with the highest status since he was the leader handling daily miscellaneous tasks.
Xue Ying took over the cup: “Many thanks, Great Paragon.”
The two of them downed the cup.
“Good.”
By the side, other than the Cosmos Gods from the Fan Clan who were praising him, guests who were not from the three great clans were also doing so. The Summer Clan and Cang Clan looked at Xue Ying with shock. They began discussing quietly. Since the Fan Clan won, they had to accept it! After all, victory and losses were part and parcel of the competition between the three clans.
“Sky-Rending Great Paragon, Ying Shan Xue Ying has done a great job for your Fan Clan, so you must not mistreat him.” A male from the Summer Clan wielding a divine sword behind his back shouted.
“That is natural.”
Sky-Rending Great Paragon laughed out loud. He then turned to Xue Ying and directly transmitted over, “Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow, who would have thought that you even have this pinnacle of void-ification technique. I wonder if you were the one who created it? Or was it an expert from your previous Origin World the one who created it?”
Xue Ying was startled, yet he understood that the other party had ascertained he reincarnated into this world.
That’s right.
He cultivated for such a short period, and comprehending just the Five Phases Sealing Technique alone was quite shocking. Understanding another tenth level Mirage and Illusory Realm technique and now, grasping even the pinnacle of void-ification?
If he said that everything was comprehended in this life from nothing and not from his previous life, Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, and others would not believe it.
Sky-Rending Great Paragon was even acting so politely, taking the initiative to propose a toast to him… this clearly showed that he had determined Xue Ying as a mighty Cosmos God from his previous life before reincarnation. That was why he treated him so respectfully. If Xue Ying were merely a Primal Chaos expert, given the status of Sky-Rending Great Paragon, it was impossible for the other party to condescend himself to treat Xue Ying so politely.
“I got it because of luck.” Xue Ying transmitted. This was not the moment for him to reveal it.
“It seems your previous Origin World is quite strong.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon did not suspect it since it was too difficult for one to create such a cultivation technique.
If Xue Ying were to publicize the fact that he was the one who created it at the Primal Chaos Realm, it would absolutely stun the whole world! Learning it was challenging already, yet creating it had a difficulty way beyond! In the Realm Heart Great Land, only the two great ancient nations owned such a technique. Southern Cloud King and many others could not even create it. Even though Xue Ying had inspected the scaled-armor of General Mo Gu, using it as a direct reference to create the technique, others could not learn it even if they had the absolute art. Nevertheless, he could create this technique, showing how frightening his comprehension skills were.

chapters.title: Chapter 1089 - Fair Trade
chapters.content:
Chapter 1089: Fair Trade
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the royal palace of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Currently, the competition between the three clans had just ended, causing the atmosphere in the hall to loosen up.
“Your Fan Clan is just that close to losing six consecutive times! Who would have guessed that Ying Shan Xue Ying would emerge at this moment.”
“This is luck! It is destined for our Fan Clan to not lose.”
The higher-ups from the three great clans continued chatting.
At the same time, quite a few guests deliberately went to talk to Xue Ying. Those who were invited as guests were at least on the level of Fiery Zhao King and Maple Nest King. The majority of them were experienced and had an acute perception. They would most likely deduce that: “For this Ying Shan Xue Ying to be so heaven-defying, it is highly possible for him to be reincarnated from another world. Furthermore, it is impossible for the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation or the Summer Wind Ancient Nation to let an outsider learn the cultivation technique of attaining the pinnacle of void-ification! Where did he learn it from? Nowhere! Hence, the only possibility was that he had learned it in his previous life back at his hometown Origin World before reincarnating over.”
An expert from another Origin World could achieve the pinnacle of void-ification using Profound Mysteries at the Primal Chaos Realm. That justified Xue Ying’s strength.
“That is an Origin World that could create a cultivation technique of reaching the ‘pinnacle of void-ification’. The foundation of that Origin World shouldn’t be too weak. We must take this chance to interact with him.” Their gaze towards Xue Ying was no longer that of viewing a young fellow from the Southern Cloud Nation. Instead, it was a reincarnated expert from a great Origin World.
“Honored Guest Flying Snow, I am also researching on the Dao of Void. If you are free, you pay a visit to my Misty Fox Prefecture. The two of us could have a proper discussion on Dao.” A plump bald old man laughed.
“It is Xue Ying’s fortune to be invited by a Paragon. Once this matter has ended, I’ll definitely pay a visit to Paragon’s Prefecture.” Xue Ying answered. This was ‘Paragon Misty Fox’ from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Even though he was not from the three great clans, he was a Great Paragon. Although the foundation of the other party might not be as deep as his teacher, Southern Cloud King’s, he was still strong. Xue Ying dared not to scorn such a character.
One by one, they either came to exchange pleasantries and befriended Xue Ying.
Or they directly invited him to their home.
Clearly, Xue Ying was highly favored by these guests.
“The gap…”
The other Primal Chaos experts who participated in the competition between the three clans watched from afar. They felt both envious and helpless at the same time.
Those who were qualified to be guests here weren’t ordinary Cosmos Gods! At least they would rarely interact with them, Primal Chaos experts since the gap in strength was too big.
“These guests seem to interact with Ying Shan Xue Ying and disregard us all.”
“This Ying Shan Xue Ying is ultimately too powerful. It is expected for him to be favored.”
They could only suppress their jealousy.
The majority of them thought Xue Ying was being acknowledged for his strength, yet they did not know those experts were already treating Xue Ying as an expert on the same level.
…
When the banquet ended.
The higher-ups from the Fan Clan naturally left. Xue Ying also befriended a group of Cosmos God friends from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. He received many invitations! Naturally, he was delighted since the entire Realm Heart Great Land was a place of fortune for him to develop his strength. Naturally, he would befriend as many people as possible so that he could accumulate resources that could help him in the future.
“Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow, let us fly together.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon invited Xue Ying over to take his carriage in returning to the Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
“Don’t stare anymore. If the lot of you are as strong as Ying Shan Xue Ying, you would similarly be treated so respectfully.” Monarch Andromeda glanced at Fan San Yuan, Fan Mo Zhu, Fan Yi Qian, and King Sauron by the side, “Let us leave.”
“Yes.”
Fan San Yuan and the few of them could only watch as Sky-Rending Great Paragon left with Xue Ying on the same carriage. They felt complex in their hearts before boarding their carriage, which was brought back by Monarch Andromeda.
…
Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
There was a dark violet short but thick tree. This tree trunk spanned about a dozen meters, yet it was only several dozen meters tall. It had a vast treetop that covered this entire area close to half a kilometer.
Sky-Rending Great Paragon sat down with Xue Ying underneath the great tree. They faced each other with good wine and food placed before them. There were also beautiful female attendants serving them.
“Mn?” Xue Ying could not help but look at this short but thick great tree. The bark, branches, and leaves were all dark violet in color. It seemed to be made from a dark violet jade.
“Have you felt how unique this God Tree is?” Sky-Rending Great Paragon laughed.
“Yes, it is indeed mysterious.” Xue Ying nodded. As he sat under this magnificent tree, he began absorbing energy that nourished his soul. His soul felt really pleasant and comfortable, and he could even feel his soul improving gradually.
“This is the great tree snatched over by Teacher before the first War of the Ancient Nations.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon chuckled, “It has been named by Teacher as the ‘Burning Heart God Tree’. Teacher has precisely attained grand perfection in the <Un-Phase Mystical Technique> underneath this God Tree.”
Xue Ying was startled.
There was such an origin?
Given his identity in Southern Cloud Nation, he knew many information and secrets, yet he had never heard of the ‘Burning Heart God Tree’ before.
Ancestor Fan had reached grand perfection in <Un-Phase Mystical Technique>, which went to show how unique this God Tree was.
“The soul nourishing effect which the Burning Heart God Tree has is not its most important trait since one’s soul would reach a limit after just half a year.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon took up his wine cup. Xue Ying similarly brought his wine cup up. After the two of them toasted and drank down the wine, Sky-Rending Great Paragon continued: “What is most special about the Burning Heart God Tree is on its ‘Burning Heart’. Cultivating underneath this tree, the longer one cultivated under it, the more intense the feeling he would get. This would be hugely beneficial to improving the soul! My teacher has finally perfected the <Un-Phase Mystical Technique> given his realm only after cultivating under this tree!”
“Burning Heart? It seems to be greatly beneficial to cultivating the soul?” Xue Ying could not help but feel his heart itch.
His Mirage and Illusory Realm was precisely a soul technique.
Soul…
That was something mysterious and special.
Like after reaching the pinnacle of void-ification, one’s body would have fused into the essence of the void. It is impossible to injure such a cultivator unless his attacks could break apart the cage of the Origin World.
Of course, there is one exception. That was-to target the soul!
Soul techniques were shapeless and phaseless. They were soundless and would not show signs of coming. They would instead descend on the enemy abruptly without delay! Even if Xue Ying entered the void, his soul still existed, and enemies could always target him using soul techniques! Naturally, once the cultivator activated the ‘pinnacle of void-ification’, he would completely disappear from sight. It was impossible for other parties to target him once that happened.
Even if they assaulted him! Given Xue Ying’s current soul and attainments in the Mirage and Illusory Realm, it took three Cosmos Gods working together before they could bring him down-just like in the first round during the competition between the three clans!
Once he became a Cosmos God, his soul would undergo a qualitative transformation! It would be even harder to deal against him by targeting his soul.
“This secret treasure of yours is the Devil Heart Bell? Do you specialize in the Mirage and Illusory Realm?” Sky-Rending Great Paragon asked.
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Dao paths that focused on the soul aspect are arduous to master.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon laughed out loud, “It’ll be greatly beneficial for you if you were to cultivate under this Burning Heart God Tree. Nevertheless, we only have one single God Tree here! The aura it emits can only be absorbed by a single cultivator. If two cultivators were to absorb it simultaneously, the effect would be weakened.”
“This Burning Heart God Tree is extremely precious. Usually, only the six of us Great Paragons will rotate and use it. Disciples of my Fan Clan or Honored Guests have to contribute greatly before they could have the chance to enter.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon said, “This time, you contributed greatly, and I can permit you to cultivate here for about a year. Even though it might not be beneficial to you for your cultivation, it’ll allow you to nourish your soul to its limit.”
“Many thanks, Great Paragons. Ancestor Fan has already bestowed me with 30,000 contribution points.” Xue Ying immediately added.
“I know about that.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon smiled, “A year is a minor thing to us, but given that you want to achieve something great in the Dao relating to the soul, it’ll be much more beneficial to you to cultivate for a trillion years under the Burning Heart God Tree! Nevertheless, the period is too long, and I am powerless to promise you that.”
Xue Ying felt enlightened.
He understood now.
To gain the chance of cultivating under the tree, he had to pay a comparable price!
“The Origin World which you were previously at could create a cultivation technique attaining the pinnacle of void-ification at the Primal Chaos Realm. It should have a deep foundation too.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon looked at Xue Ying, “My Fan Clan will naturally provide many benefits in exchange for mysterious and powerful cultivation techniques!”
“Peak-graded secret treasures? Cultivating under the Burning Heart God Tree? These are benefits which aren’t recorded in the scroll given to you previously. But everything could be further discussed.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon smiled, “It is a fair trade!”
Dao was fundamental.
Secret impartation techniques that were sufficiently powerful could cause these apex organizations to covet them.
It was impossible for them to give peak-graded secret treasures to outsiders. Even though it was written on the scroll that one could exchange for such treasure for ‘200,000 contribution points’! In reality, Southern Cloud King had not even accumulated that much.
But if there were sufficiently powerful secret impartation techniques, both parties could exchange, and the benefits could be further discussed!
“Sometimes, there are limitations that prevent me from teaching the cultivation technique to other people.” Xue Ying said.
“I understand.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon grinned.
“As for those that I can divulge, let me think through it first.” Xue Ying said. The ‘Nine Rotation Undying Technique’ was created by him. Naturally, he could exchange it for benefits, albeit now wasn’t the right time!
“Haha… everything can be discussed. As I said before, fair trade.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1090 - Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 1090: Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Currently at the Southern Cloud Nation.
Within the royal palace.
‘This disciple of mine has genuinely frightened me.’ Southern Cloud King sat cross-legged on the black grass plains. Behind him, an abyss that was covered in white cold fog existed. As the white cold fog rose, it made the facial appearance of Southern Cloud King increasingly blurred. His eyes were all the more unfathomable, ‘Attaining the pinnacle of void-ification at the Primal Chaos Realm. Such a deep foundation, such great comprehension.’
Given the strength of he, Southern Cloud King, in order for him not to make use of profound mysteries at the Cosmos God level, and merely those at the Primal Chaos Realm to achieve the ‘pinnacle of void-ification’, even if Southern Cloud King had a corresponding cultivation technique, he wasn’t confident of doing so!
‘He is definitely a Cosmos God in his previous life! I wonder who was the one that created this cultivation technique that allowed one to achieve pinnacle of void-ification at the Primal Chaos Realm. Was it an unparalleled existence in the Origin World of his previous life?’ Southern Cloud King pondered, ‘Given his strength and talent, why did he not choose to accept Ancestor Fan as teacher and instead, chose me?’
Given how big the origin and power his disciple had, Southern Cloud King had to think twice!
‘It is impossible for him to threaten me.’ Southern Cloud King was naturally confident of himself. With his foundation, even unparalleled existences could not threaten him. He, of course, had the confidence to deal against this disciple of his.
‘Then why did he take me as his teacher? Was it for treasure? Or freedom? Or is it… he wasn’t willing to get embroiled in the battle between the ancient nations?’ Southern Cloud King considered. The six great ancient nations were powerful, yet the battles that happened between them were dangerous too. If Xue Ying became a core member of the Fan Clan, it was impossible for him to not participate in the war. But the status of an Honored Guest was different. Even though Honored Guests had less power and benefits, they could choose not to accept a mission.
‘Haha, no matter what, since he chose to take me as his teacher, he’ll be my disciple in this life.’ Southern Cloud King chuckled, ‘With a good helper, it’ll be easier for me to manage the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion from now on.’
Ten great religions.
Other than eight which belonged to the six great ancient nations, the remaining ‘Sky Sword Sect’ frequently bullied Southern Cloud Sacred Religion and even dared to invade into the Black Devil Four Nations.
No choice.
The Southern Cloud King wasn’t afraid of others, but neither were those great organizations afraid of Southern Cloud King!
“Xue Ying.” Southern Cloud King took the initiative to summon Xue Ying. Xue Ying’s other avatar was stationed here at the Southern Cloud Capital.
Very soon.
The golden-robed Xue Ying arced through in the form of a stream of light and descended into the cultivation ground of his teacher.
Southern Cloud King smiled at this golden-robed young man as he came from afar. Currently, his gaze towards this disciple was completely different from the past.
“Xue Ying, you have concealed yourself pretty deeply.” Southern Cloud King laughed.
“Teacher knows about it?” Xue Ying laughed back.
“A group of good friends from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation has informed me. Haha, the pinnacle of void-ification! Other than the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation and Summer Wind Ancient Nation, there is actually another cultivation technique that enables a cultivator to grasp the pinnacle of void-ification at the Primal Chaos Realm.” Southern Cloud King looked at Xue Ying, “Right, who created it? Was it your teacher in your previous life? Or an expert from the Origin World in your previous life?”
“It is a Cosmos God from the religion of my previous life.” Xue Ying chose to temporarily hide his secret still.
“It seems the religion of your previous life is quite strong.” Southern Cloud King nodded.
He dared not think that it had been created by a Primal Chaos cultivator!
Because the two cultivation techniques that enabled cultivators of the Primal Chaos Realm to grasp the pinnacle of void-ification had been created by unparalleled existences! A Primal Chaos cultivator creating it? That was just a joke! If this was made known to the public, it would frighten all experts. After all, such abnormal comprehension abilities, despite taking the scaled-armor of ‘General Mo Gu’ as a reference and having experienced two Origin Worlds, was still scary.
“Oh right, when do you plan to break through to the Cosmos God Realm?” Southern Cloud King casually asked, “Since quite a few cultivators have guessed that you were reincarnated into this world, there is no longer a need for you to conceal your abilities.”
“In the upcoming period.” Xue Ying answered.
“Void? Mirage and Illusory Realm?” Southern Cloud King continued asking.
“Dao of Mirage.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“Hu.” Southern Cloud King let out a sigh of relief. He chuckled, “I still thought you planned on breaking through to the Cosmos God Realm in both Void and Mirage and Illusory Realm.”
“No rush. I still plan on accumulating more experience and comprehensions.” Xue Ying humbly replied.
Since everyone thought that he was a Cosmos God reincarnated into this world, he would temporarily hoodwink everyone for now! Since he would be breaking through to the Cosmos God Realm anyway.
“Since you did not take Ancestor Fan as your teacher, and chose to take me instead, all the scriptures that my Southern Cloud Sacred Religion have can be accessed by you as you like. If you have anything you need me, just say. I have many cosmos crystals, but of course, I can’t afford those that are truly precious! Like top-graded secret treasures and many secret impartation techniques could not be bought! I’ll try my best to solve everything that could be solved using cosmos crystals. After all, your growth is intricately linked to the expansion of my
Southern Cloud Sacred Religion. That’ll earn more cosmos crystals for my religion.” Southern Cloud King laughed. He no longer treated this disciple of his as a young junior. Instead, he treated him as a powerful existence near his own level.
“Teacher, please be rest assured. This disciple will definitely not be polite when the time comes that I need your help.” Xue Ying chuckled. Even though he might say it, he would only ask for help when he truly needed it.
“Mn.” Southern Cloud King softly nodded. He had a feeling of having some burden taken off his shoulders.
It was inevitable.
The Southern Cloud Sacred Religion had always been held by him alone! The other helpers of his were too weak.
******
Southern Cloud Capital, Flying Snow Residence.
Xue Ying’s other avatar was temporarily staying here. Within a meditation room in the Flying Snow Residence, the smell of incense pervaded the entire room, emptying the heart and soul of those that were inside.
“<Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique>” As Xue Ying sat on the praying mat, the huge content from the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique scripture replayed in his mind.
Of course, he could not cultivate it yet.
This <Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique> secret technique had harsh demands.
The reason why he chose to research on it was to understand if his avatars could sense each other despite being located in two different Origin Worlds.
“Indeed.”
Xue Ying slightly frowned, “Even though the soul is mysterious, two Origin Worlds have differing Supreme Laws! If the two avatars are located in two Origin Worlds that are far apart… it’ll be hard to sense each other.”
According to the narration from the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.
An avatar that headed to a distant Origin World would be suppressed by the Supreme Law from that world as he was an outsider! His power was limited to that of the Primal Chaos Realm. According to the experience which Southern Cloud King had when using the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’, there were different strengths in the avatars which he sent to other Origin Worlds, and weaker avatars would have weaker souls, making it harder to sense the true body located in the Realm Heart Great Land. His avatars could barely perceive the true body after using all their strength, and only then could they barely transmit their memories.
Of course, powerful avatars could easily sense the true body located in Realm Heart Great Land. Just by slightly concentrating, they could easily exchange their memories.
‘Teacher is a second level Cosmos God. I am only at the first level after breaking through! I wonder if it is possible for my two avatars to sense each other?’ Xue Ying though, ‘It is still possible though!’
Xue Ying was most afraid of this!
Why did he choose to leave behind an avatar on the Realm Heart Great Land? All for the sake of acquiring more resources so that he could walk further on the path of cultivation! If he could not exchange memories, then there existed a type of danger…
The two avatars would gradually form different willpower and thinking. It was fine for a short period since Xue Ying’s Cultivation Heart Realm could allow him to achieve equilibrium after exchanging memories. But if it took a long time before they exchanged memories, like a trillion years or so, that would create a drastic problem!
Which was to bring about a schism between his consciousness!
‘It should be fine. After I reincarnated back to my hometown, if I can’t sense my avatar and exchange memories, I’ll first increase the soul strength of this avatar at the Realm Heart Great Land by absorbing large amounts of Essence of Chaotic Origin! Else, I’ll just let it sleep.’ Xue Ying thought.
Those that could utilize the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique were usually powerful.
Under normal circumstances, they were at least second level Cosmos Gods! Because only after reaching this level could it be possible to use the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.
Xue Ying relied on the ‘energy from Realm Heart Order’ to return to his hometown.
The Realm Heart Order was mysterious.
Even though the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique could send an avatar to a different Origin World, that avatar would be repulsed by the Origin World, preventing him from reincarnating! Only after ‘reincarnating’ into that world could an outsider attain the permit to stay and grow strong by the Supreme Law.
Otherwise, that avatar would be limited to the Primal Chaos Realm. It would limit to how much that cultivator could explore in an Origin World and what he could learn there! Only by reincarnating could the cultivator grow boundlessly. That was the only way to obtain true benefits from the Origin World.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying shut his eyes. He began meditating.

chapters.title: Chapter 1091 - Comprehending the Dao under the Burning Heart God Tree
chapters.content:
Chapter 1091: Comprehending the Dao under the Burning Heart God Tree
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Summer Wind Capital, Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
Xue Ying was the guest, and Sky-Rending Great Paragon was the host. Sky-Rending Great Paragon stood up: “Haha, Younger Brother Flying Snow, you should spend some time properly cultivating under this Burning Heart God Tree and experience yourself how unique the Burning Heart God Tree is.”
“Many thanks, Great Paragon.” Xue Ying said.
“Haha, it is a minor matter.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon laughed before leaving. The female attendants left along with him.
Sky-Rending Great Paragon went back to his own palace and sat on his throne. He looked downwards.
“Great Paragon.” Monarch Andromeda respectfully said, “I’ve already arranged for King Sauron to return back to his hometown. Should I arrange to send Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow back to Southern Cloud Nation too?”
“He is currently cultivating underneath the Burning Heart God Tree, and would likely cultivate for close to a year.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon gave a mysterious laugh. In his opinion, once Xue Ying experienced how unique the Burning Heart God Tree was, he would definitely cultivate for the full one year! Who knows, Xue Ying might even deliberately delay for more time, but by then, he would definitely appear and send the other party off.
“Burning Heart God Tree?” Monarch Andromeda was shocked, “This, this… letting him use it, this…”
“His origin is extraordinary. That time, my teacher personally took the initiative to take him as his student, yet the other party rejected. Initially, I thought he was too green, but now it seems he has something to rely on. Since he owned a cultivation technique leading to the pinnacle of void-ification at the Primal Chaos Realm, he should have some powerful secret impartation technique. I presume he should have a relatively high status in his previous life, and he would have learned some cultivation techniques that could be taught to outsiders!” Sky-Rending Great Paragon chuckled, “After experiencing the uniqueness of cultivating under the Burning Heart God Tree, and the fact that he focuses on the ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’ Lineage, I reckon he will want to cultivate for a long time here. Hmph hmph, but as an Honored Guest, he is not qualified to cultivate under the Burning Heart God Tree even if he has the contribution points! The only way is to bring out something that would sufficiently move the heart of my Fan Clan. Even if we do not get anything, it is merely close to a year of cultivation.”
Monarch Andromeda was enlightened.
Yet Sky-Rending Great Paragon was very confident that Xue Ying would thirst for the Burning Heart God Tree!
“This time, I plan on entering the Origin Realm God Palace. Go prepare well and let Elder Disciple Brother Lu Tian feel my sincerity.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon said.
“Yes.” Monarch Andromeda respectfully nodded.
…
The short but thick Burning Heart God Tree seemed as if it was sculpted from a violet jade. Its huge tree crown covered a vast area.
Underneath the three.
A white-robed young man sat there.
Xue Ying naturally knew what Sky-Rending Great Paragon was thinking. The ‘Burning Heart God Tree’ was a God item that had been hugely beneficial to even Ancestor Fan when he cultivated in the past. This tree was used one after another by the six Great Paragons in the Fan Clan during regular occasions! The reason why he had never heard of it before was likely because his teacher Southern Cloud King had not heard of it. Of course, it was possibly because his teacher had never cultivated in a Dao specializing in the soul. Hence, the Fan Clan chose not to take the ‘Burning Heart God Tree’ out as an ‘enticement’.
Since the other party chose to let him cultivate underneath the ‘Burning Heart God Tree’ for close to a year, the other party would most likely have confidence in the tree.
“I would like to see how mysterious the Burning Heart God Tree is.” Xue Ying calmed himself down before starting his cultivation. As he absorbed the aura emanating from the Burning Heart God Tree to nourish his soul, he would also ponder on the ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’. Likewise for his golden-robed avatar situated in the Southern Cloud Capital.
Even though he wanted to become a Cosmos God.
He was not in a rush to do it this year! Such a short period was fleeting to powerful cultivators.
He had to grasp the opportunity and maximize his time and experience here.
“Comfortable.”
His soul felt really relaxed. He could even feel his soul growing stronger over time. Even though it was slow, if it persisted for close to a year, the total improvement would be shocking!
Gradually, as Xue Ying became deeper and deeper in his cultivation.
All sorts of Profound Mysteries in the Mirage and Illusory Realm began floating in his heart. He also carefully pondered over them.
“Mn?”
After cultivating for several breaths, Xue Ying felt how unique it was. Under his total focus and the condition where his soul was nourished from the aura from the Burning Heart God Tree, he started feeling ‘his soul burning’.
