The more he tried to deduce, the more intense the burn his soul was! And as his soul burned excessively, Xue Ying felt his soul becoming vacant, causing many realizations and inspiration on the Mirage and Illusory Realm to appear.
“The promotion of my spirit?” Xue Ying felt that at this moment, there was nothing he could not do. It appeared as if he knew so many stuff about his spirit.
Because his soul had transcended beyond ordinary limits and reached perfection already.
Xue Ying’s understanding of the spirit became deeper. Correspondingly, the ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’ also fundamentally targeted the soul and the spirit! Hence, as his understanding of the spirit grew more profound, he would naturally understand better in the ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’.
“This is truly mysterious.”
“Unfathomable.” Xue Ying felt startled.
This feeling felt intoxicating.
Initially, Xue Ying thought that his heart realm that reached the third level, ‘My Heart as the World’ was the highest level. That was indeed the highest level in regular cultivation even in the Realm Heart Great Land. But with the support of the ‘Burning Heart God Tree’, his heart realm seemed to reach an entirely higher level. It felt transcendental. Xue Ying did not feel joy or sorrow. It was like looking down on the spirit from a higher dimensional point of view, dissecting it into pieces and deducing the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm.
Naturally, this form of cultivation required past accumulations and experience in the Dao.
Furthermore, it was only most helpful in the soul aspect! Even though maintaining this spiritual state might be beneficial to cultivating other elements, it would not be as useful as helping the cultivator in understanding the ‘soul aspect’.
“It appears that my understanding of the Mirage and Illusory Realm is still filled with deficiencies.” Xue Ying grasped the Devil Heart Bell earlier on and had reached the tenth level realm in the illusory realm. He had already known where to proceed. But breaking through still felt difficult to him. Nevertheless, at this moment, many sparks of inspiration streamed in, allowing him to realize where he could improve on.
…
“This junior disciple brother of mine is truly amazing! Formidable.” Monarch Greedy Peng and Monarch Chun Yu walked side by side. After a few teleportations, they appeared outside the Flying Snow Residence.
One of the guards of the residence came over. The moment he saw who came over, he immediately bowed with respect and great astonishment: “Greetings, Monarchs.”
There would rarely be guests who visited this Flying Snow Residence. Monarch Greedy Peng and the others had come before, so these protectors naturally recognized them. Furthermore, they were fed with information regarding some experts and knew many of them.
“Where is my junior disciple brother?” Monarch Greedy Peng asked.
“Grandpa King has entered closed-door cultivation. He gave an order that he’ll not be meeting anyone if there aren’t important matters.” The protector respectfully replied, “Are there any matter which the two Monarchs require me to pass on?”
In the opinion of the protector, even though Flying Snow King’ Xue Ying’ had a high status, the two who visited were Cosmos Gods. Even if Xue Ying entered closed-door cultivation, he should come out and meet them.
“We should not disturb him.” Monarch Greedy Peng immediately roared.
“Yes.” This protector was shocked by it.
“Let’s go.” Monarch Greedy Peng looked towards Monarch Chun Yu to the side, “It seems that when junior disciple brother is out, he is no longer a Grandpa King but instead, a Monarch.”
Monarch Chun Yu smiled and nodded. Naturally, they isolated what they said from other peering ears.
…
Fan Clan Magic Mountain, underneath the short and thick violet, Burning Heart God Tree.
The white-robed young man remained seated cross-legged there. In the blink of an eye, it had been nine months since he cultivated here! The nourishment of his soul had already reached a limit-it persisted for close to seven months in total, strengthening his soul for about 20%. To achieve this standard of promotion in soul strength, he would likely have to spend several billion cosmos crystals.
“Hua, hua…”
There was the occasional gust of wind and the falling of violet leaves.
Suddenly-
“Hong.”
The white-robed young man suddenly opened his eyes. In his eyes, one could vaguely see the transformation of the myriad existences and the emergence of many beings. It was like the development of a cosmos.
With a blink, everything regained normalcy.
“Initially, I wanted to break through using the Dao of Void, yet cultivating underneath the Burning Heart God Tree is a rare opportunity. That was why I temporarily chose to focus my attention on cultivating the Mirage and Illusory Realm. Who would have thought that I actually broke through in the Mirage and Illusory Realm instead?” Xue Ying felt both startled and joyful in his heart. Of course, even though he had finally taken that step in the Mirage and Illusory Realm, and that his understanding of the laws had reached that stage, he did not break through yet.
The required World Energy for breaking through to the Cosmos God was too high, and it would produce a considerable disturbance. Hence, it was not appropriate for him to do so underneath the Burning Heart God Tree.
“Hua.”
Xue Ying stood up and headed out.
“Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow, are you planning to leave now?” Not far away from the Burning Heart God Tree, several attendants stood up and asked him respectfully. Did Sky-Rending Great Paragon not order to let Xue Ying stay for a year? It had been only nine months!
“I’ll return to my place first.” Xue Ying smiled. Being an Upper Honored Guest, he had his own cavern-dwelling in the Fan Clan Magic Mountain. He decided to first return and break through!
Having said that, Xue Ying immediately flew across the sky.
He had waited far too long for this day!

chapters.title: Chapter 1092 - Cosmos birthed from a Thought
chapters.content:
Chapter 1092: Cosmos birthed from a Thought
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Sir Upper Honored Guest.” There were protectors currently standing outside a luxurious cavern-dwelling at the Fan Clan Magic Mountain. They saw a white-robed young man flying from afar and descending. At that moment, two protectors shouted out together with respect.
“Mn.”
Xue Ying acknowledged before heading in.
Ever since he became an Upper Honored Guest, this was the first time he entered the cavern-dwelling given to him by the Fan Clan. The entire cavern-dwelling became restless as many female attendants who had been waiting for a long time came forward ready to serve: “Sir Upper Honored Guest.”
“I’ll be entering closed-door cultivation for this period, so don’t disturb me.” Xue Ying already owned the order seal of the cavern-dwelling and could control every single array in the place. With a thought, he was able to find out the arrangement of the cavern-dwelling and knew where the cultivation room was at.
“Yes.” The group of female attendants orderly replied.
Very soon.
Accompanied by the booming sounds of the doors opening, Xue Ying entered, and the door closed after that. Everything regained its peace.
“This Sir Upper Honored Guest of ours…” Those female attendants looked towards each other. They felt puzzled. The first thing he came here was to enter closed-door? The Fan Clan gave a place for Honored Guests to stay in, and most would temporarily stay here. If they wanted to cultivate for long periods, they would usually return to their own territories.
******
Within the cultivation room.
The incense had already been lit. It pervaded in the entire room.
On a black praying mat, the white-robed Xue Ying sat cross-legged immensely calm.
“Hong.”
His soul had started transforming silently. It was changing according to the laws of the ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’ which he just comprehended! His soul was being reconstructed entirely using this new foundation he had, and Xue Ying was progressing into a higher level of life! This crossing of his soul was also the crossing of the essence of life into another level, and Xue Ying was moving into the final realm of cultivation-Cosmos God!
There were strong and weak Cosmos Gods.
Just like at the Primal Chaos Realm, there were differing levels, though everyone at the Primal Chaos Realm had a similar essence of life.
It was likewise for Cosmos Gods. Some of the weaker ones included those in the Origin World ‘Primal Chaos Void’: Forefather Tian Yu, Void Primogenitor, and others. They were at the first level of Cosmos God. And ‘Sacred Master’ was a Cosmos God at the third level! The gap between them existed between ‘Dao’ only, while no difference existed in the essence of life between them.
Unparalleled existences like Ancestor Fan and Emperor Summer were actually third level Cosmos Gods! But because they were located at the Realm Heart Great Land with a deeper foundation and more significant accumulations, they had the support of many cultivation techniques. As a result, they were able to perfect the utilization of strength. They even had several frightening secret treasures that could allow them to unleash power one level higher!
For instance, Southern Cloud King was only a second level Cosmos God. He cultivated many cultivation techniques like the <Five Phases Sealing Technique> which he cultivated to grand perfection-the third level. In terms of how much strength he could utilize, it was beyond that of ‘Ancestor Sorcerer’ and ‘World Ancestor’ from the Primal Chaos Void. But what allowed his strength to soar was his top-graded secret treasure, the ‘Twin Realm Blade’, which brought it to a level higher.
Fighting against those one level higher.
That was something which would happen only in the Realm Heart Great Land! A Primal Chaos Realm expert could unleash power at the tenth level. Ordinary Cosmos Gods could unleash power at the second level. Naturally, it was premised on the condition that the cultivator owned an appropriate secret treasure.
Like ‘Fiery Zhao King’ for instance, even though he was a second level Cosmos God, he could not obtain a top-graded secret treasure. Hence, he was inferior in strength as compared to what Southern Cloud King could unleash! There were quite a lot of Cosmos Gods who were similar and did not have any appropriate secret treasures. That was why many Cosmos Gods chose to rely on apex organizations like the Fan Clan. But even if they ‘sold themselves’, they could only get ordinary secret treasures, and rarely would they earn the chance to acquire top-graded secret treasures.
After all, Southern Cloud King relied on a top-graded secret treasure to reach the third level Cosmos God Realm combat power! He was even confident of surviving against Ancestor Fan and the rest.
…
“This feeling.” Xue Ying opened his eyes. His soul had transformed. Furthermore, because his soul was constructed on the ‘laws of the illusory realm’, Xue Ying’s soul was several times stronger than ordinary Cosmos Gods.
“The world in my body.”
With a thought.
“Hong!”
Even though he had relied on bloodline to reach the Primal Chaos Realm using the fastest speed, Xue Ying still used the laws and profound mysteries system when re-cultivating the ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’.
“Hong long long~” The miniature cosmos in his body was filled with primal chaos. The next moment, a boom was heard.
Under the complete law of the ‘illusory realm’, the miniature cosmos was rapidly transforming. Wind, thunder, earth, and fire. All kinds of energy were erupting within. The land was also terraforming, and myriad existences were sprouting. It happened too quickly. The transformation of the world in Xue Ying’s body happened so much faster than what was recorded in the many scriptures. It was with this frightening speed of change that actual living beings began emerging.
Birds, animals, insects, and humans… they were forming under Xue Ying’s guidance.
At the same time as the evolution progressed, the miniature cosmos also expanded! It expanded at an incredibly fast pace.
The only puzzling thing was that the cosmos in his body flickered in and out of existence. It did not seem too real.
“The ‘miniature cosmos’ in my body?” Xue Ying was very clear of it.
Different Dao paths determined the ultimate transformation target of the ‘cosmos’ using the laws and profound mysteries system.
Currently, Xue Ying had only comprehended the ‘Illusory Realm’ branch of the complete ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’ Dao path! Hence, the cosmos that formed was absolutely not an authentic cosmos. Ordinary Cosmos Gods usually created a real cosmos, yet what Xue Ying produced was a ‘Mirage cosmos’. Naturally, life within the Mirage Cosmos had sentience and emotions. They could grow, experience, and learn…
Love, cultivation, giving birth…
Many creatures lived in the Mirage Cosmos. They each had their own feelings and thought they were real. They would live old and die from sickness. Powerful experts would step onto the path of cultivation.
The uniqueness of a ‘Mirage Cosmos’.
One, Xue Ying could easily maintain the flow of time inside at 10,000 times faster than normal time flow! He did not have to bear any burden at all. He could even increase the flow of time, which would gradually bring more pressure on him.
Two, the Mirage Cosmos was more massive than ordinary cosmoses formed by most Cosmos Gods! After all, maintaining an illusory cosmos and a real cosmos had differing difficulties.
But even still.
Cosmos Gods sought to have a ‘Mirage Cosmos’ and not a real one.
Other than the powerful strength which Cosmos Gods in the Mirage and Illusory Realm Dao had.
”Mirage Cosmos’ contained many special points like accelerating time flow to more than 10,000 times that of normal speed. The speed of creatures and even experts reproducing within was much faster than what ordinary Cosmos Gods could do so. As long as Xue Ying was willing to fork a little more price, he could completely bring the beings or materials within the Mirage Cosmos into ‘reality’.
After all, what was illusory and unreal would be real too!
That was the frightening aspect of this Dao path once the cultivator reached the Cosmos God Realm!
“Disciple, what you chased after is real.” Xue Ying grinned.
At his hometown.
He had a disciple named ‘Xing Huo Xun Yi’. Xing Huo Xun Yi directly entered an illusory realm for the sake of cultivating it. Eventually, Xing Huo Xun Yi had immersed himself into the world, living together with a girl in the illusory realm. They even became companions at the end. He sought ways to let his wife live for a longer time and wanted to bring the illusory realm into reality. He had no regrets living life like this.
Eventually, the illusory realm crumbled apart. He could only watch as his wife got destroyed together with the world. During the annihilation of the world, his wife looked at him.
His wife knew she was part of the beings in the illusory realm.
That time…
Xing Huo Xun Yi had indeed become mad. It formed a heart devil.
But under Xue Ying’s tutelage, Xing Huo Xun Yi believed that this path of ‘illusory’ could eventually allow everything unreal to become real. But in his hometown Origin World, the ‘Primal Chaos Void’, there had never been a cultivator who reached the Cosmos God Realm in the Mirage and Illusory Realm. Before this, Xue Ying was the expert with the highest attainment in it. But now, Xue Ying finally broke through to the Cosmos God Realm.
And he knew what he conjectured in the past was true!
…
During the process of transformation, World Energy was frantically pouring into the cultivation room and into Xue Ying’s body to be used for the evolution of the cosmos.
Even though it happened within the cultivation room, isolating as many disturbances from the outside as possible, this time, it was the development of a cosmos. The absorption of World Energy brought about fluctuations in the energy outside within the Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
“Mn?”
The black-robed Sky-Rending Great Paragon stepped on the void arriving outside Xue Ying’s cavern-dwelling.
He looked downwards: “Given such a huge disturbance, it appears that Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow is breaking through to become a Cosmos God?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1093 - High Heavens God Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 1093: High Heavens God Master
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the cultivation room, the surging World Energy maelstrom finally dissipated.
Xue Ying who sat cross-legged opened his eyes. A grin unveiled on his face.
“Sky-Rending Great Paragon?” Xue Ying immediately sensed a guest from the outside world. He stood. Even though he needed to consolidate his newfound strength, it was most efficient doing it under the ‘Burning Heart God Tree’.
“Hong long long~”
Xue Ying went out of the room. Looking up, he saw Sky-Rending Great Paragon standing to the distance.
“Greetings, Great Paragon.” Xue Ying bowed.
“Mn?” A strand of shock flitted across the eyes of Sky-Rending Great Paragon. Xue Ying who just broke through did not conceal his aura at all. He had to apply the Nine Rotation Undying Technique to conceal it! But there was no need to do so at the Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
“Younger Brother Flying Snow…” Sky-Rending Great Paragon could sense the aura of Xue Ying becoming illusory and real at the same time, “You broke through to Cosmos God not in the Void Lineage but in the Mirage and Illusory Realm?”
“It’s all thanks to the Burning Heart God Tree. Adding up my previous and current life, I have accumulated a huge wealth of experience, yet I still lacked by quite a bit to the next realm. Who would have thought that I could take the final step after meditating under the Burning Heart God Tree.” Xue Ying sighed, “The Burning Heart God Tree is indeed mysterious.”
Sky-Rending Great Paragon revealed a grin: “Congratulations.”
Yet in his heart, he was speculating: ‘This Ying Shan Xue Ying could attain the pinnacle of void-ification and should specialize in the Dao of Void most in his previous life! Currently, he actually broke through in the Mirage and Illusory Realm to become a Cosmos God, making it harder to predict how strong he is now.’
“Great Paragon, I’ll first visit the Burning Heart God Tree since I still have some time left before reaching the limit of one year.” Xue Ying laughed.
“Hahaha… go on.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon laughed back. He did not deny in letting Xue Ying know how long he had left.
One year.
Only one year.
Once the period was up, Sky-Rending Great Paragon would certainly force Xue Ying to leave. Want to continue cultivating? He had to conduct in fair trade for it!
…
As the full one year period was reached.
Leaves could be seen falling from the Burning Heart God Tree.
Sky-Rending Great Paragon personally sent Xue Ying off. Naturally, Xue Ying showed an appearance of unwillingness and left reluctantly.
‘I do not believe that you do not wish to continue cultivating under the Burning Heart God Tree.’ Sky-Rending Great Paragon watched the departing figure of Xue Ying, thinking, ‘You are still confident now shortly after breaking through. Once you reached a bottleneck, and when you can’t improve any further, I’m sure you would want to seek another opportunity to cultivate under the Burning Heart God Tree.’
Most Great Paragons only focused on becoming stronger.
But few paid attention to external strength like Southern Cloud King who spent considerable effort to spread his Southern Cloud Sacred Religion and even created the <Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles>. He then relied on the religion to earn vast amounts of cosmos crystals so that he could gather more resources.
Sky-Rending Great Paragon similarly understood the importance of having strong subordinates and various kinds of external strength! In the Fan Clan, Sky-Rending Great Paragon was the one who wielded the strongest force out of the six Great Paragons. Many experts were on his side, and even ‘Ancestor Fan’ permitted him to preside over the operations of the entire Fan Clan.
******
Flying Snow Residence.
“Sou.”
A white-robed young man stealthily entered the cultivation room. He sat together with a golden-robed Xue Ying.
“Time to focus on cultivation.”
“I should use the fastest speed I could to promote the Dao of Void to the next realm too so that I can push the <Avatar Technique> To a higher level.” The two avatars sat cross-legged. They were both focusing on comprehending the Void Lineage.
Void Lineage
“Hong-”
Xue Ying’s accumulation in the Void Lineage was honestly too deep and resounding.
The Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles two secret impartation styles, Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique, Five Phases Sealing Technique, and the Nine Rotation Undying Technique…
At this moment, slightly pondering over the profound mysteries brought in a significant amount of enlightenment.
Previously, he dared not cultivate because Xue Ying knew he would break through.
“It seems I am breaking through in not just one branch of the Void Lineage.” At that moment of comprehension, Xue Ying understood that point.
…
Realm Heart Great Land. Over at a sea region slightly closer to Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, this was a region known as the ‘Icy Mist Sea’. The Icy Mist Sea was vast. Over in this region, there was a vast island governed by a tier-two country called ‘Overflowing Cloud Nation’. It occupied a huge area that was comparable to that of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation! But 99% of its territory wasn’t suitable for creatures to live and reproduce. That was why it could be occupied by a tier-two nation.
“Sou.”
A violet-robed thin male suddenly appeared above it. He was like an emperor looking down at the vast wilderness.
“Brother High Heavens.” The thin male announced. His voice rumbled and resounded in this wilderness.
Fluctuations started forming in the surrounding wilderness.
“Hong long long~”
A massive piece of earth suddenly ‘erected’. One could see it only when he was at a sufficiently far distance… that this erected earth was actually a giant. His enormous upper half had crossed through even the cloud layer.
This giant opened his eyes. His eyes stared at that violet thin and small male.
“Southern Cloud?” The giant’s voice rumbled, “Why have you come to my Overflowing Cloud Nation?”
The violet-robed thin and small male was an avatar of Southern Cloud King.
“Brother High Heavens, sell me your secret treasure, ‘Devil Emperor Gown’.” Southern Cloud King said. This existence in front of him was truly secretive. Not many knew about him in the Realm Heart Great Land.
High Heavens God Master.
He was very famous during the first War of the Ancient Nations. Nevertheless, he had been heavily injured by Summer Wind Ancient Nation’s ‘Ancestor Fan’! Ever since, he disappeared, and rarely could traces of him be discovered.
One had to know that High Heavens God Master was a third level Cosmos God! Nevertheless, he lacked a suitable secret treasure. Reaching his level, to fight against those of a higher realm, one had to have a secret treasure, a treasure that was more formidable than top-graded secret treasures. But it was similarly hard to acquire one! Even though shadows of the High Heavens God Master covered the second War of the Ancient Nations and several important affairs in history, High Heavens God Master was unfortunate not to find a suitable secret treasure for himself.
At the level of High Heavens God Master, few things would attract his attention. One was a secret treasure that could significantly improve his strength, and the other was taking that final step to reach the rumored level ‘Yuan’ had reached!
“Devil Emperor Gown?” High Heavens God Master’s voice continued rumbling, “That fool actually offended me in the past and was eaten by me. His treasures remained on my side ever since. But don’t ever think of exchanging the Devil Emperor Gown with ordinary treasures.”
“State your price.” Southern Cloud King said.
“200 billion cosmos crystals or treasures that would move my heart.” The large body of High Heavens God Master sat there looking down at Southern Cloud King.
Southern Cloud King frowned.
200 billion?
The breakthrough of Xue Ying’s golden-robed avatar created a considerable disturbance during the absorption of World Energy. Southern Cloud King naturally knew it. He went to meet Xue Ying, finding out that he broke through in the ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’ to the Cosmos God Realm! Even though he had stated publicly his wish to purchase Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasures, and there was a ‘Heart Devil Scepter’ at the Cosmos God level, it’s a pity that this was of the ‘Desire’ branch in the Mirage and Illusory Realm Dao.
And Xue Ying broke through in the ‘Illusory Realm’ Lineage. Even if he got the Heart Devil Scepter, Xue Ying could still not unleash a higher level of strength.
Southern Cloud King had once spoken to Xue Ying: “I’ll find a more appropriate secret treasure for you.”
Even though Xue Ying felt the price was too high, Southern Cloud King cut in: “In the future, you can help me out. That’ll cover the price.”
“That is too high.” Southern Cloud King frowned.
Even though he was wealthy, 200 billion cosmos crystals would sufficiently hurt his bones.
This High Heavens God Master had indeed opened his lion’s mouth! Ordinarily, these treasures cost 80 to 100 billion cosmos crystals.
“Do you think I lack cosmos crystals?” High Heavens God Master indifferently answered, “Either you bring out treasures that could move my heart, or you will have to pay 200 billion cosmos crystals.”
…
Other than spreading the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion for the sake of earning cosmos crystals, Southern Cloud King did so to permeate the entire Realm Heart Great Land with his intelligence web. He also knew where the Cosmos God graded secret treasures for ‘Illusory Realm’ in the Mirage and Illusory Realm Dao existed. Because cultivating in this Dao was hard, there were few secret treasures. Only three such treasures existed in history, and the Devil Emperor Gown was the one which he had hope of getting it.
It was much difficult to acquire any of the two other two.
“This is really…” Southern Cloud King was unwilling to part with his cosmos crystals. In the end, he brought out another precious broken map and exchanged for the Devil Emperor Gown with High Heavens God Master.
“With the Devil Emperor Gown, he has the Five Phase Beads too. It seems I have finally found a true helper.” Southern Cloud King was still relatively joyful in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 1094 - Heading down the Unparalleled Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 1094: Heading down the Unparalleled Path
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Southern Cloud Capital, within the meditation room of Flying Snow Residence.
A white-robed young man and a golden-robed young man sat cross-legged within. They were meditating. It had been three years since Xue Ying returned from the Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
Of course.
Given his foundation, Xue Ying had broken through to the Cosmos God level on the second day in the ‘Dao of Void’ after entering closed-door cultivation. It was solely because his accumulations had been too deep in this Dao-even across different directions. This was especially so after he created the ‘Nine Rotation Undying Technique’. Nine different directions aided each other, giving Xue Ying a deeper understanding of the Dao. Currently, these comprehensions and understanding he had were fusing into his body. Naturally, he was continually improving.
Such high-speed breakthrough was preventing Xue Ying from stopping! Neither was he willing to do so.
“It is about time. Now that my cultivation speed has reduced slightly, it is time for me to pause for now. I should first settle my matters here in the Realm Heart Great Land and hurry back home.” Xue Ying stopped cultivating, “Even though I did not push the five branches of <Five Phases Sealing Technique> to the limit, I am not in a rush either. I can continue cultivating after refining my avatars.”
According to the guidance of his teacher, ‘Southern Cloud King’, the ‘Dao of Void’ had a total of nine branches!
The <Five Phases Sealing Technique> contained five of it, of which the difficulty of training in the ‘Earth Phase’ and ‘Origin Phase’ were the highest. The ‘Earth Phase’ had been because of Xue Ying’s accumulation as he observed the emergence of Destruction Devils from Void Ancient Trees in the Lost World Corridor during his past life for many years. The ‘Origin Phase’ was the hardest, and only after he comprehended the essence of the void was he able to succeed in grasping it.
Five branches.
Reaching the pinnacle of every branch would allow him to break through to Cosmos God!
To reach the pinnacle of all five branches, that was an arduous task. But Xue Ying’s deep and profound accumulations enabled him to break through in six branches out of the nine within the short three years to the pinnacle-at the Cosmos God Realm. If this were made known outside, many experts would be shocked.
The reason was that the ‘Dao of Void’ only had a total of nine branches! Even Southern Cloud King had comprehended all nine branches after stepping into the second level Cosmos God Realm and after attaining the top-graded secret treasure ‘Realm Heart Blade’. He had cultivated for many years after becoming an absolute overlord of Realm Heart Great Land before achieving it.
Xue Ying created the Nine Rotation Undying Technique, and comprehended nine branches at the Primal Chaos Realm, reaching the pinnacle of Primal Chaos Realm in all nine branches then. More importantly, the moment he understood all nine branches, each branch could support one another and form a perfect entity! And it was only under the reference of ‘General Mo Gu’s scaled-armor’ was Xue Ying able to attain the pinnacle of void-ification at Primal Chaos Realm.
And it was this complementary effect which brought about all kinds of realization after Xue Ying broke through in a single branch to the Cosmos God Realm, bringing about a resonating effect.
He had a feeling…
Pushing all nine branches to the pinnacle was not a difficult task if given sufficient time! Xue Ying was after all someone who reached the limit of Primal Chaos Realm in all nine branches and lacked just a single step before crossing the border!
‘Even though I’ve reached the limit in six branches, it’s a pity that three of these six belong to the <Five Phases Sealing Technique>. It seems I have to wait for a little more time.’ Xue Ying thought.
…
Even though comprehending the branches of ‘Dao of Void’ to the pinnacle might seem formidable, but Xue Ying would still ultimately be at the first level of Cosmos God.
He had to fuse two branches of the ‘Dao of Void’ as one, producing a qualitative transformation and upgrading his strength one level higher. That was when he could be considered a second level Cosmos God!
After which.
He would have to continue fusing the different branches of the ‘Dao of Void’. The improve in strength after merging each branch together wasn’t significant. Only when all ‘nine branches were completely fused as one’! That was when the Dao of Void had reached grand perfection! At that point, the cultivator would have reached the third level of Cosmos God!
Like ‘Southern Cloud King’, he had comprehended the pinnacle of all nine branches, yet he only fused seven branches together! He was still far off from merging all nine branches as one single Dao.
‘Comprehending the branches is easy, fusing them is hard.’
‘Nine Dao branches as one… it’ll be challenging.’ Xue Ying thought.
There were many Cosmos Gods in the Realm Heart Great Land.
Quite a few second level Cosmos Gods existed, of which some were fortunate in acquiring ‘top-graded secret treasures’, allowing them to fight against those one level higher.
But those who reached the third level of Cosmos God Realm? The number was frighteningly small!
Sacred Master was a third level Cosmos God!
The unparalleled existences in the Realm Heart Great Land were more formidable, but they were still third level Cosmos Gods. What they had were powerful secret treasures that enabled them to wield a greater power! Furthermore, the stronger the secret treasure, the further the cultivator could see in the ‘Dao’ beyond their level. It gave them the capability to dig out even more of their strength.
‘The path of unparalleled.’ Xue Ying looked forward to it.
Unparalleled existences.
Beyond that?
Only after attaining grand perfection in the ‘Dao of Void’ would one become a third level Cosmos God! Beyond that, it would be grasping the Supreme Law! This step was too difficult. None in the Realm Heart Great Land were able to achieve it. Only the mysterious ‘Yuan’ should be an existence of this level.
‘No matter what, my foundation in the Dao of Void is deep.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘I believe after spending a little time training coupled with the guidance of the predecessors, it should not be difficult to become a second level Cosmos God! Accompanied by some secret treasures which I’ll get in the future within the Realm Heart Great Land, I should be qualified to face against Sacred Master after returning to my hometown.”
Sacred Master.
Even Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor dared to fight against him directly.
Ultimately, in his hometown Origin World ‘Primal Chaos Void’, the finesse in secret treasure refinement was too crude, preventing any from fighting against those of one level higher! Hence, one had to depend primarily on personal strength. Sacred Master could ignite his Origin Source Energy. Even though it would boost his strength significantly, he could not fight against those one level higher either. If he could wield power like unparalleled existences ‘Ancestor Fan’ or ‘Emperor Summer’, even if it were for a short time, he would have easily killed Ancestor Sorcerer and the rest.
‘No secret treasures.’
‘But I do not have one after returning to my hometown either.’ Xue Ying understood this point. Everyone did not own such treasures. They had to depend on themselves to fight. Hence, it was hard to shake up Sacred Master still.
He needed more time.
By relying on the Realm Heart Great Land, Xue Ying believed his speed growth would be rapid.
‘Soon, soon…!’ Xue Ying felt delighted and carefree.
That’s right.
He cultivated for an extended period and experienced being reincarnated into this world. After breaking through to the Cosmos God Realm, he finally felt that ‘Sacred Master’ wasn’t an existence that he could not reach.
That time when his teacher Gu Qi died, Xue Ying could only suppress his fury. Deep in his heart, he felt helpless because the gap in power between the two parties was too exaggerated and significant.
‘Begin. Time to push my avatar technique to the next level.’ Xue Ying thought.
After becoming a Cosmos God, currently, he had reached the pinnacle in six branches of the Dao of Void, of which it included the two paths where the techniques Arch Destruction and Spectacular Painting were based on.
Arch Destruction was divided into small success, large success, and grand perfection. It was the same with Spectacular Painting too.
Strictly speaking.
The highest achievement Southern Cloud King had were the three great absolute arts, <Arch Destruction>, <Spectacular Painting> and <Southern Cloud Sacred Body>. The so-called Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles relied on these three great absolute arts as the base.
…
Xue Ying first relied on the many precious materials prepared by his teacher to push his Southern Cloud Sacred Body to the 11th level! By relying on this body, he could then unleash the <Arch Destruction> at a large success power!
“Break!”
Within the cultivation room.
Xue Ying punched out. His body was faintly emanating light. In reality, the Southern Cloud Sacred Body was like a secret treasure. By relying on it, Xue Ying could unleash a greater combat power.
“Hong!” An entire piece of space had been struck. At that moment, finger-sized holes could be seen with the naked eyes appearing. On the other side of the hole was pure blackness. Looking at the darkness with the naked eyes produced terror that caused one to feel chillness in his heart! Xue Ying tried permeating his consciousness in, yet what he saw wasn’t darkness.
Instead, he had a unique ‘viewpoint’ over there. Xue Ying saw a huge region and various places across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. The further it was, the more blurry it became. Xue Ying even ‘saw’ a broader and vaster region beyond the Realm Heart Great Land.
Xue Ying did not feel puzzled over this particular perception he had from this viewpoint. After all, ‘Destruction Relm Teleportation Technique’ relied purely on this move.
‘What concentrated mysterious energy.’ This time, the hole which he blasted open could be seen with the naked eyes-it was the size of a finger!
The mysterious surging energy was much more concentrated than previously when he tried breaking apart the cage.
It enabled more a denser form of energy deep from the outside world to enter.
The hole was rapidly shrinking along time.
Xue Ying immediately used another ‘avatar technique’, which Xue Ying took that moment to absorb the mysterious energy, nourishing his soul along the way.
…
Southern Cloud Capital, Royal Palace.
“Mn?” At the moment when Xue Ying blasted apart a finger-sized hole from the essence of the void of the Origin World, Southern Cloud King, who sat in his cultivation ground within the royal palace opened his eyes. He looked to the distance, crossing through all obstacles of space. He peered through the Flying Snow Residence and revealed a grin, “Arch Destruction? It seems this disciple of mine has broken through to the Cosmos God Realm in the Dao of Void. I wonder if he is a first level or second level Cosmos God in his previous life!”
As for the third level?
He dared not think about it! Firstly, few existed at this level in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Secondly, if he were at that level, given the pride in his heart, why would Xue Ying be willingly to take Southern Cloud King as his teacher?

chapters.title: Chapter 1095 - Nine Major Avatars
chapters.content:
Chapter 1095: Nine Major Avatars
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the cultivation room.
“Mn?” Nine young men looked at each other. They all revealed a grin.
According to what was illustrated by the <Avatar Technique>, Xue Ying could refine nine avatars currently. If he became a second level Cosmos God, he could cultivate and bring the <Avatar Technique> to grand perfection, allowing him to own 10081 avatars!
When more than 10,000 avatars were gathered together, it would be akin to a sea of humans.
Just like ‘Myriad Realm Tavern Master’ back at his hometown, he had so many avatars that gave Xue Ying the feeling of ‘innumerable’. Killing an avatar meant nothing as the other party could rapidly refine another out.
Of course, not every avatar could exert his full strength.
With nine avatars, only two could employ full strength. Under this circumstance, the other seven avatars would be forced to dissipate as the cultivator could not maintain all at the same time! Keeping two souls at full power was the limit what ordinary cultivators could reach under the unseen law suppression.
With 10081 avatars, maintaining nine with optimal soul power was the limit. Only these nine avatars could exert the total strength that cultivator had. The other avatars would be forced to dissipate! Of course, if eight avatars were maintained at peak power, the remaining more than 10,000 avatars could remain form albeit they were weak. Hence, even though ‘Myriad Realm Tavern Master’ had many avatars, an absolute majority of them were weak.
‘So what if they are weaker? More importantly, every avatar represent a life! As long as an avatar survives, I can easily refine other avatars again.’ Xue Ying thought.
Even though he had nine avatars, the Realm Heart Order energy remained only in the soul of the ‘golden-robed Xue Ying’. He had planned to send this avatar back to his hometown! The process was similar to how he came-only the core-most ‘true spirit’ could be sent back to his hometown Primal Chaos Void under the protection from the energy of the Realm Heart Order. Hence, there was no longer any meaning to having a strong or weak soul.
…
The door of the cultivation room boomed and opened.
A white-robed Xue Ying came out. This was also the avatar that trained in the Southern Cloud Sacred Body-the strongest avatar he had that held on to the Five Phase Bead and many other secret treasures. Actually, each avatar could be considered as an actual body-there were no stark differences amongst them. It’s just that he had limited secret treasures and resources. Naturally, all the treasures would be gathered on a single avatar, and this white-robed avatar would also be responsible for external operations.
‘There is still a final matter I have yet to resolve. Once that is done, I can return home.’ Xue Ying revealed a grin.
“Grandpa King.”
Two female attendants bowed respectfully outside the cultivation room.
Xue Ying nodded. His ex-servant, the Magic Dragon, had already been arranged back to the ‘Flying Snow City’. After all, his parents of this life lacked sufficiently strong subordinates.
“Sou.”
Taking a step, Xue Ying disappeared from the vicinity.
He arrived at the royal palace directly, coming close to where his teacher’s cultivation ground was. This place forbade all teleportations.
“Teacher.” Xue Ying landed on the black grass field looking at the distant Southern Cloud King. Xue Ying greeted politely.
“I discovered fluctuations recently of you exerting the Arch Destruction, yet you are out so soon? I thought you might want to cultivate for a longer period after breakthrough.” Southern Cloud King chuckled.
“Aren’t I reincarnated into this world? There is no need for me to consolidate my strength.” Xue Ying joked.
Since everyone was determined he had been a Cosmos God reincarnated into this world, Xue Ying naturally would not go against that.
This was a beneficial plan for him.
“Haha…” Southern Cloud King extended his hand. A luxurious black robe appeared in his hand. Following which, it floated over to Xue Ying.
“This is?” Xue Ying took that robe over with doubt.
“Feel for yourself.” Southern Cloud King grinned. For the sake of this Devil Emperor Gown, he spent a massive effort in acquiring it. Southern Cloud King made use of his entire web of intelligence throughout the Realm Heart Great Land to locate clues of where the ‘Devil Emperor Gown’ could be. He then used a precious treasure of his to trade with High Heavens God Master for this Devil Emperor Gown.
After receiving it, Xue Ying immediately refined and extended his senses into this gown.
He could perceive the difference immediately between the Origin Worlds, Realm Heart Great Land and his hometown Primal Chaos Void as he refined the treasure. The secret treasures refined in the Primal Chaos Void were very crude. Furthermore, cultivators had to spend a long time refining it usually. As for secret treasures in the Realm Heart Great Land, they were fined more exquisitely, allowing the wielders to fight against experts of another level. Furthermore, refining it took only a short period!
“This is?”
After refining it, Xue Ying caressed the silky black gown. At that moment, the black gown began emanating light.
Xue Ying felt his consciousness entering a vast world within.
The world was vast, and it was pervaded by fog.
Many creatures existed in this world. That spiraling fog also headed in the direction of Xue Ying’s soul.
“World? Soul?” Xue Ying was enlightened.
“How is it?” Southern Cloud King chuckled, “I’ve mentioned that I’d find an appropriate Cosmos God-graded secret treasure suitable for this lineage of yours. It is known as the Devil Emperor Gown. Its previous master called himself ‘Devil Emperor’. After building a nation, he procured many subordinates that were extremely loyal to him. Even after his death, those loyalists fought against the enemy countries fearlessly.”
Xue Ying revealed a look of bliss: “This Devil Emperor Gown is based on the fusion of two branches within the Mirage and Illusory Realm Dao path, the ‘Illusory Realm’ and ‘Soul’.”
Mirage and Illusory Realm
Xue Ying had browsed through many pieces of information regarding the secret treasures and found out that there were five branches in the ‘Dao of Mirage’-’World’, ‘Soul’, ‘Bewilderment’, ‘Desire’ and ‘Slaughter’.
‘World’ represented the Illusory Realm and was the Dao path Xue Ying took to become a Cosmos God.
‘Bewilderment’ was just like the ringing sound from the Devil Heart Bell. It was a branch meant to entice and bring confusion to others.
‘Soul’ targeted more of soul-controlling techniques that could control others and ensure eternal loyalty.
‘Desire’ pertained to all sorts of emotional desires like love, hatred, greed, lust, joy, fury, and despair.
As for ‘Slaughter’, it was the only offensive branch the Mirage and Illusory Realm Dao path had. The entire Mirage and Illusory Realm would charge a killing technique before piercing it directly through the soul of the enemy! Those who could not defend against it would see their souls being extinguished! That time when Xue Ying created the ‘Destruction Flower’, he had to condensed killing techniques into reality. But the true ‘Slaughter’ branch of the Mirage and Illusory Realm Dao path directly attacked the soul.
Southern Cloud King laughed after seeing this: “Haha, it is good that you like it.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying did not say much. He directly accepted it and noted down this favor. In the future, he would undoubtedly repay his teacher.
“Hua.”
With a thought, the black and luxurious gown landed on the body of Xue Ying. After wearing it, Xue Ying’s entire self began emitting a horrifying alluring power that would cause others to unknowingly fall for him, live and die for Xue Ying! This was even when Xue Ying had yet to unleash the power of this secret treasure.
If he were to do so, by relying on the secret treasure, an absolute majority of the first level Cosmos Gods could not resist against him! Even if those Cosmos Gods had secret treasures that enabled them to fight against enemies one level higher, it would be pointless since this targeted the soul, and those treasures could not protect the soul.
This was the frightening aspect of experts specializing in soul techniques.
Currently, Xue Ying owned the Devil Emperor Gown, and had become more powerful than many second-level Cosmos Gods who did not have top-graded secret treasures like Fiery Zhao King and Maple Nest King!
“Hu.” With a thought, the black-colored luxurious gown immediately transformed white. Furthermore, Xue Ying concealed his aura, making it seem ordinary. Currently, there was only a beautiful and colorful design inlaid on the bottom part of his robe.
“Good!” Southern Cloud King joyfully exclaimed after seeing this, “With the Devil Emperor Gown and by relying on the ‘Five Phase Bead’, you can exert the Five Phases Sealing Technique to the grand perfection realm! With two great killing moves, it is sufficient for you to move unhindered in the Realm Heart Great Land!”
Xue Ying nodded: “Teacher, I still have another matter.”
“Haha, you can just directly tell me anything.” Southern Cloud King said. Currently, Xue Ying was his most important helper.
” That <Nine Rotation Undying Technique> which I can utilize in allowing me to reach the pinnacle of void-ification can be taught outside.” Xue Ying smiled, “I plan on selling it to the Fan Clan and Summer Clan.”
“You can teach it to other people?” Southern Cloud King was startled, “You could do so with such an amazing cultivation technique?”
Xue Ying nodded.
Of course! He was its creator!
He planned to rely on this cultivation technique to exchange for some precious cultivation techniques. After returning back to his hometown, he did not own any secret treasures that could fight against enemies one level higher. He desired to fight with Sacred Master! Naturally, he had to first have sufficiently strong cultivation techniques. Even though he could not triumph against those of one level higher, Xue Ying could reach infinitesimal close. For instance, the ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’ could allow him to exert power close to the tenth level even without depending on secret treasures.
Even though his teacher, Southern Cloud King, was rich, only the most powerful organizations had the strongest secret impartation techniques.
“You can teach it to outsiders? This has to be carefully considered. You must not lose out on selling it.” The pupils of Southern Cloud King’s eyes dilated. He began pondering over it thoroughly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1096 - Emperor Summer is here
chapters.content:
Chapter 1096: Emperor Summer is here
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying stood obediently by the side. His teacher would definitely be able to sell the <Nine Rotation Undying Technique> at a higher price than him since his teacher was way more experienced than he was in the Realm Heart Great Land—his teacher’s understanding of the various superpowers was deeper than his. Furthermore, his teacher had fought with some unparalleled existences before.
“What do you plan on exchanging it for?” Southern Cloud King looked at Xue Ying.
“Primarily some apex secret impartation techniques for the Dao of Void and Dao of Mirage. If it is possible to acquire a top-graded secret technique, it’ll naturally be good too.” Xue Ying said.
Southern Cloud King frowned: “This <Nine Rotation Undying Technique> is a cultivation technique that allows a Primal Chaos cultivator to attain the pinnacle of void-ification. It is considered quite ‘rare’! Furthermore, some of the most powerful Cosmos Gods seek to attain ‘the pinnacle of void-ification’. This is an ultra-powerful survival technique used in direct combat.”
Xue Ying agreed.
Monarch Nine Cloud had attained the pinnacle of void-ification. It was hard for Sacred Master to kill him. In the end, Sacred Master did not obtain the Third Fire Prison Realm Cauldron!
“Attaining the pinnacle of void-ification is hard in itself. Even Void Lineage Cosmos Gods have a hard time achieving it.” Southern Cloud King said, “To some of the apex Cosmos Gods, it is too hard cultivating the ‘Dao of Void’ to the Cosmos God Realm. That difficulty is too high. Reaching the Primal Chaos Realm is comparatively much easier. Hence, there are quite a few Cosmos Gods who sought to learn this cultivation technique of yours.”
Xue Ying softly nodded.
“But you still want to obtain some apex secret impartation techniques and top-graded secret treasures.” Southern Cloud King shook his head, “Of the six great ancient nations, the Icy Snow Ancient Nation has three unparalleled existences, but they all cultivated in body refinement. Hence, the body refinement techniques of Icy Snow Ancient Nation are the most formidable. As for other secret impartation techniques, they are quite lacking. Even King Sauron was willing to join the Fan Clan for this reason. As for what you seek, the Dao of Void and Dao of Mirage, they aren’t what the Icy Snow Ancient Nation is good at.”
“I know.” Xue Ying chuckled, “This Icy Snow Ancient Nation is very unique.”
In order to cultivate the body to the pinnacle, one had to thoroughly delve into the fleshy body and refine it to the third level Cosmos God Realm! All of them were more perverted existences than his hometown World Ancestor.
The three old ancestors were as such!
“Hmph, but they are too weak in other aspects. What the Icy Snow Ancient Nation could do is rely on strength to snatch cultivation techniques from other places! But would the real experts be afraid of them?” Southern Cloud King said, “As for the Moonflower Ancient Nation and Sky Towering Ancient Nation, their foundation is just too weak! The Primogenitor Ancient Nation doesn’t have too many apex secret impartation techniques suitable for you too.”
Xue Ying nodded.
He understood this at least.
“Hence, what you want to acquire lies only in two superpowers. One is the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, and the other is the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation.” Southern Cloud King said.
There were two existences in total that cultivated the Dao of Void to grand perfection, reaching the third level Cosmos God Realm
One was Emperor Summer! And other was ‘Drifter’, one of the five ancestors in Myriad Realms Ancient Nation.
Hence, it was most suitable to visit those two superpowers to acquire top-grade secret impartation techniques in the Dao of Void.
And in terms of the Mirage related scriptures…’Ancestor Fan’ had cultivated it to the second level Cosmos God Realm. Sky Towering Ancient Nation also had a Cosmos God who cultivated it to the second level. In the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, there was also another who reached the second level in the Dao of Mirage! That’s right, there had never been any existences in the Realm Heart Great Land who ever reached grand perfection, becoming a third level Cosmos God!
Because the path of the soul was just too difficult!
And there weren’t any third level existences in the Dao of Mirage in the long history of this Origin World.
“The Realm Heart Great Land is divided into several regions of superpowers.” Southern Cloud King smiled, “My Southern Cloud Nation is closest to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. A large swathe of the region surrounding us belongs to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation superpower too. Hence, the very first party we should negotiate and talk to is naturally the Summer Wind Ancient Nation! We absolutely must not visit the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation first, else we might just offend the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.”
“Understood.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Summer Wind Ancient Nation might have things which you want. We should go and try. I’ll do my best to negotiate for you. The final decision still lies in your hands.” Southern Cloud King said, “Oh right, do you mind selling your cultivation technique to other ancient nations after selling it to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation right?”
“I don’t mind.” Xue Ying smiled.
His core was his hometown Primal Chaos Void.
This was only a springboard for him. Hence he did not mind selling it to several other ancient nations.
“Since you don’t mind, we’ll have to see if the Summer Wind Ancient Nation is willing to let you do so or not.” Southern Cloud King laughed, “If they don’t allow it, they have to increase the price then!”
…
After arranging everything with his teacher, Southern Cloud King, his teacher naturally sent a voice transmission to the three great clans of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, expressing the desire of Xue Ying to sell the cultivation technique ‘Nine Rotation Undying Technique’ that could allow a cultivator to achieve the pinnacle of void-ification at the Primal Chaos Realm.
Southern Cloud Nation, Royal Palace, Jin Cloud Palace.
An arm-width ‘Rainbow Gold Third Earth Incense’ that was worth more than 100 million cosmos crystals had already been lit. Its fragrance pervaded the entire hall. The long table placed in the chamber was relatively exquisite too! The three female servants by the side were all Primal Chaos Realm Magic Servants.
By the side of the palace, there were two tables. The black luxurious robed Southern Cloud King and white-robed young man Xue Ying were both seated behind their own table waiting silently.
The three female attendants were waiting by each of the three tables.
At this moment…
No other existences were present within half a million kilometers by this Jin Cloud Palace. All the protectors and female attendants had been forced to retreat. Even other disciples of the Southern Cloud King, including Monarch Sky Yin and others were forbidden from coming close here temporarily.
Even though the three female attendants were Primal Chaos Magic Servants, they still felt the unseen pressure since they knew who they would be meeting today.
“Hua.”
A figure condensed from nothingness.
He wore a loose plain robe, directly descending to sit behind that only table opposite of Southern Cloud King and Xue Ying.
“Greetings, Your Majesty Emperor Summer.” Even though Southern Cloud King and Xue Ying were both seated cross-legged, they still bowed and greeted the other party.
Emperor Summer.
He was the most horrific existence in the entire Realm Heart Great Land and was faintly ranked first in terms of power. Just one single point gave him the ability to overlook all other unparalleled existences—he had cultivated two Dao paths to the final grand perfection.
Like Ancestor Fan, Emperor Cang, Drifter and other unparalleled existences including Sacred Master and Old Monster Stone from Primal Chaos Void, they only cultivated a single Dao to grand perfection! One had to know that it was extremely difficult to cultivate one Dao to grand perfection, but to cultivate two Daos to grand perfection was ten to a hundred times more difficult.
Nevertheless, there was this existence Emperor Summer that appeared.
Hence, Ancestor Fan and Emperor Cang were both willing to support him. Even in the three great clans, the ‘Summer Clan’ could directly suppress the other two great clans in terms of the number of Great Paragons and nurturing of talents. They had no choice—Emperor Summer was too formidable! His guidance of disciples was top-notched also!
Emperor Summer cultivated the ‘Dao of Void’ and ‘Dao of Flames’ to grand perfection. Other than that, he cultivated many other Daos. Naturally, his way of teaching his disciples was terrific.
Facing such an existence…
How would Southern Cloud King and Xue Ying dare to slight the other party?
“Ying Shan Xue Ying, I’ve heard that you are willing to sell that Nine Rotation Undying Technique of yours to my Summer Wind Ancient Nation?” Emperor Summer smiled at Xue Ying.
“Yes.” Xue Ying replied. Even if he had no secret treasures, this existence Emperor Summer in front of him was more terrifying than Sacred Master.
“Haha, there are two cultivation techniques in the Realm Heart Great Land that could allow a cultivator to achieve the pinnacle of void-ification at Primal Chaos Realm, and they are both created by me and that Drifter from the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation.” Emperor Summer said, “Yours would be the third of such cultivation technique, and I do want to have a good look so that we can negotiate a good price for it.”
“Alright.”
Xue Ying nodded. Flipping his hand, a scripture that occasionally appeared and disappeared showed. Of course, this scripture had some limitations too. There were many more limitation techniques regarding impartation of absolute arts in the Realm Heart Great Land than in the Primal Chaos Void.
Naturally, an existence like Emperor Summer could completely break apart the restriction and still impart the absolute art created by Xue Ying to others.
But firstly, given the status of Emperor Summer, he disdained from doing so.
Secondly, Emperor Summer could disregard the restriction of the original scripture, but it would affect his ‘Dao Heart’! Reaching the level of Emperor Summer, they only sought to take the last step and would absolutely not do anything that would affect their Dao Heart.
“Hu.” Emperor Summer directly took over this half-translucent scripture, sending his consciousness in. He then started perusing through many of the profound mysteries of the <Nine Rotation Undying Technique>.
“Interesting.” Emperor Summer was slightly startled, “It is actually a cultivation technique focusing on all nine branches, yet fusing them together with such ingenuity and conciseness. Nonetheless, it is slightly more complicated than what Drifter or I created.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1097 - Two Great Secret Impartation Techniques
chapters.content:
Chapter 1097: Two Great Secret Impartation Techniques
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Emperor Summer and Drifter created techniques based on their Dao of Void that had reached grand perfection. Just by relying on the profound mysteries at the Primal Chaos Realm, they were able to attain the effects of ‘pinnacle of void-ification’! As for how complex it was on cultivating them? They did not care. It was not easy just creating the techniques, and strictly speaking, Xue Ying referred to the Destruction Devil ‘General Mo Gu’s scaled-armor mystical inscriptions to come out with the technique.
The mysterious inscriptions on that scaled-armor had been naturally formed from the Origin World during the process of producing Destruction Devils. It could be said that they were created under the ‘Supreme Law’.
Even though Emperor Summer and Drifter were powerful, compared to the natural phenomenon of the Supreme Law, they were still lacking. In terms of conciseness and ingenuity, they lacked that bit!
“It is indeed concise and ingenious.” Southern Cloud King chuckled, “I was shocked after seeing it too.”
“But it has its weakness too. Even though the application of the profound mysteries is more simplified and concise than the technique created by Drifter and me.”
Emperor Summer shook his head, “The difficulty of cultivating it is extremely high. How hard is it to grasp all nine branches? It is not bad for cultivators of the Void Lineage to grasp three to four branches at the Primal Chaos Realm. All nine branches? Too difficult! It is so much harder than grasping the <Five Phases Sealing Technique>.”
“But it has its merits too.” Southern Cloud King added, “This <Nine Rotation Undying Technique> allows the cultivator of the Dao of Void to comprehend all nine branches at the Primal Chaos Realm! If I obtained this cultivation technique in the past, it is possible for me to train in all nine branches to the pinnacle at first level Cosmos God Realm. Furthermore, the fusion of the mysteries is ingenious, and it’ll be helpful towards fusing them in the future.”
Emperor Summer chuckled.
Reaching the pinnacle in all nine branches? Fusing them together? Was it that easy to do?
Emperor Summer said: “Ultimately, it can’t escape the flaw of ‘being difficult to cultivate’. The only benefit it has is that it allows Primal Chaos cultivators a chance to comprehend all nine branches. My Summer Wind Ancient Nation three great clans can purchase this secret technique, but we do hope for you not to teach it to other superpowers other than civilians your Southern Cloud Nation. Our three great clans can give a total of 300,000 contribution points for that! This 300,000 contribution points could be used to exchange for any items in each of the clans.”
The moment someone of his status stated the price, it was impossible to negotiate for a better price after that.
“Forbidden from imparting it to other superpowers?” Southern Cloud King asked, “What if we want to impart it then?”
“Then we can only purchase it at half the price, at 150,000 contribution points!” Emperor Summer said. Honestly, he felt that this cultivation technique was still valuable, at least more so than what he and Drifter created.
Southern Cloud King turned to Xue Ying: “Xue Ying, you make the decision.”
He was still quite satisfied.
If he did not impart it to other superpowers, the Summer Wind Ancient Nation would be purchasing it for 300,000 contribution points! That was sufficient for him to exchange for a top-graded secret treasure! It is too arduous to obtain a top-graded secret treasure in the Realm Heart Great Land. The six great ancient nations had their old ancestors helping them, but experts living outside those nations had to risk their lives and be fortunate just to get one.
Currently, this secret impartation technique could be sold for such a price? That was a huge earn!
But firstly, the secret impartation technique had to be valuable and secondly, it must be unique for it to be sold at this price! Like the <Three Realms Technique> which Southern Cloud King got in the past, he wasn’t the only person that obtained the <Three Realms Technique>. Hence, he wasn’t qualified to sell it at a high price. Furthermore, he only had one copy of the original <Three Realms Technique> scripture, unlike Xue Ying who could impart it to others, and could casually make several original copies!
“Your Majesty Emperor Summer, I wish to see what secret impartation techniques and treasures I can exchange for before making my decision.” Xue Ying said.
“Alright.” Emperor Summer nodded. He waved his hand.
“Hua—”
Many dense golden characters appeared in midair. The three female attendants by the side did not look up at all. This was the benefit of having Magic Servants as they were absolutely loyal.
Xue Ying looked upwards.
Speaking from his inner heart, he wished to sell the technique to other ancient nations so that he could acquire more benefits!
Because Xue Ying was clear that there were too few techniques which unparalleled existences would find valuable and that he could still impart it to others! For instance, the cultivation techniques back at his hometown Primal Chaos Void were much cruder—Sacred Master was the only one who reached grand perfection (Xue Ying had not known Old Monster’s real strength)! But would Sacred Master pass down the absolute art he created? Even if Sacred Master was willing to impart it to Xue Ying, and he was willing to let Xue Ying give it to others, Xue Ying could still not teach it to others!
Because the Primal Chaos Void was too far away from the Realm Heart Great Land. He could only link the memories of both avatars together. Xue Ying had to genuinely learn the secret impartation technique before he could even impart it to others. Secret impartation techniques that led directly to the peak was something he had to reach the peak himself before it was counted as learning it thoroughly. By then, Xue Ying was a third level Cosmos God! And he had to cultivate in the same direction as Sacred Master before he could even achieve it,
Hence, this was a hopeless path!
As for others, their absolute arts led to a lower endpoint—the second level Cosmos God Realm. Unless it was a scripture on the Dao of Soul, otherwise, it was impossible for the absolute art to be sold at a high price!
It had to be outstanding enough!
It had to be hard to get!
His self-created <Nine Rotation Undying Technique> was very hard to get. Furthermore, it had the benefit of being ‘concise and ingenious’. If the technique were similar to what Emperor Summer and Drifter created, then its value would be much lower. It would likely be 20-30% of the current reported price. Xue Ying did not know when he could create another absolute art of equivalent value.
“Mn?” Xue Ying and Southern Cloud King looked upwards at the densely populated golden characters.
“Xue Ying, you currently have 40,000 contribution points! Even if you impart your technique to other ancient nation, the Summer Wind Ancient Nation is still willing to give you 150,000 contribution points. This 150,000 contribution points could be used to exchange for anything from the three great clans. If all of them are added together, you would have 190,000 contribution points. Even if the Fan Clan is stingy, it shouldn’t be a hard task for you to earn another 10,000 contribution points, adding up to 200,000 contribution points which you could exchange for a top-graded secret treasure.” Southern Cloud King transmitted over, “We can still sell it the technique to other ancient nations and exchange for something you wish.”
“I am not in a rush to acquire the top-graded secret treasure.” Xue Ying responded.
What he valued now was still his hometown.
Paying a huge price just for a single top-graded secret treasure? The experts in the Realm Heart Great Land were willing to do so, yet Xue Ying wasn’t. Because he could not bring that secret treasure back home!
“<Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll> isn’t a secret impartation technique that directly leads to the peak? Yet it requires 100,000 contribution points?” Xue Ying asked with a slight startle. Usually, what 100,000 contribution points could exchange were secret impartation techniques that led to the peak. Even though ‘Dao could not be easily imparted’, in reality, the price of purchasing and selling peak secret impartation techniques was lower than that of a top-graded secret treasure.
Because second level Cosmos Gods could absolutely fight against those one level higher once they get an appropriate top-graded secret treasure.
But if they only got a peak secret impartation technique, it would be helpless towards improving their strength.
Of course, there were differences between peak secret impartation techniques, like <Un-Phase Mystical Technique> which was created by Ancestor Fan, this technique cost 300,000 contribution points. If the <Un-Phase Mystical Technique> were disassembled into another powerful peak cultivation techniques, 100,000 contribution points would suffice.
“This scroll states that there are only two levels in the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll>, one being small success and one large success. Second level Cosmos Gods could cultivate it to large success.” Xue Ying said, “But it requires 100,000 contribution points?”
“Yes.” Emperor Summer nodded, “The Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll is created by me. The basic combat technique and body cultivation technique are void techniques applying the ‘Chaotic Origin Energy’ from the outside world after I broke apart the cage of the Origin World. It can be termed as the most apex cultivation technique. At the same level, it is stronger than even the <Five Phases Sealing Technique>. It is the most perfect cultivation technique I created in the Dao of Void. It’s a pity that I could not complete the final level. That’s why it cost 100,000 contribution points only despite having the first two levels.”
Xue Ying muttered to himself, though he felt pleased in his heart!
What he wanted was a cultivation technique that is powerful and heaven-defying!
And this was a Dao of Void cultivation technique applying the mysterious aura after breaking apart the cage of Origin World, the ‘Chaotic Origin Energy’. Emperor Summer even mentioned it as the most perfect cultivation technique at the Dao of Void, and he could not create the third level extension to this technique! It was absolutely the most appropriate technique which he could use to improve his strength.
Even though it was difficult to cultivate it, his foundation in the Dao of Void was sufficiently deep enough. He cultivated all nine branches and was naturally confident of completing it.
“Alright. I’ll choose the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll> and <Heart Realm> then.” Xue Ying stated.
The <Heart Realm> was the most powerful scripture created by Ancestor Fan for Mirage. It was also a scripture that led to the second level Cosmos God Realm, yet it required 80,000 contribution points.
“A total of 180,000 contribution points.” Emperor Summer nodded, “You plan on imparting it to other ancient nations?”
“I have this plan.” Xue Ying nodded, “I already have 40,000 contribution points with the Fan Clan. In addition to this 150,000 contribution points… I can exchange for two great secret impartation techniques, leaving just 10,000 contribution points unused.”
Southern Cloud King could not help but transmit a message after seeing this: “Xue Ying, you are planning on exchanging secret impartation techniques alone? And not for treasures?”
Treasures were the fastest way of increasing his strength!
They were top-graded secret treasures!
“No rush.” Xue Ying transmitted back.
After returning to his hometown, what he needed most was the strongest secret impartation techniques in the Dao of Void and Dao of Mirage. Clearly, he had chosen these two that were known as absolutely strongest at the same level—beyond even the level of Five Phases Sealing Technique! Naturally, their prices were higher! One had to know that 180,000 contribution points could be exchanged for a full 180 trillion cosmos crystals. But nobody would trade for it since contribution points could be exchanged for cosmos crystals but not the other way around!
He would most likely only have this single opportunity to exchange the scriptures so extravagantly of what Summer Wind Ancient Nation had!
These two secret impartation techniques…
They would be his reliance on what he used to fight against Sacred Master back at his hometown!
“You have to go to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation to learn these two secret impartation techniques.” Emperor Summer said, “And learning the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll> is slightly complicated too.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1098 - Fate
chapters.content:
Chapter 1098: Fate
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Everything was settled adequately.
“You can go to the Fan Clan Magic Mountain to learn the <Heart Realm>. As for the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll>, you will have to pay the Summer Wind Ancient Nation royal palace a visit. There will naturally be someone there to receive you.” Emperor Summer took over that original copy which Xue Ying personally penned down and disappeared from the vicinity.
Within the Jin Cloud Palace, there were only the three female attendants, Xue Ying and Southern Cloud King left inside.
Southern Cloud King also let out his breath. Facing Emperor Summer gave him quite a considerable pressure.
“Xue Ying, if you have a more powerful cultivation technique, you can earn even more.” Southern Cloud King lamented.
Xue Ying smiled: “I have to discuss that with my religion.”
Ordinary cultivation techniques were not worth a lot. Like the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll>, that was created by an unparalleled existence, Emperor Summer. It uses the ‘Chaotic Origin Energy’ from beyond the Origin World, fusing it into the Dao of Void and is termed as the strongest technique at the same level! There were only two levels, but learning it once took 100,000 contribution points. If it were the original copy, which Xue Ying could impart to many other cultivators, it would absolutely be more expensive than the Nine Rotation Undying Technique.
What a pity…
The more powerful and the rarer the cultivation technique was, the more difficult it would be in its creation!
“Are you planning on contacting the other five great ancient nations?” Southern Cloud King looked at Xue Ying.
“I’m not in a rush. I shall make my decision first after cultivating these two secret impartation techniques.” Xue Ying replied. The trade involving his Nine Rotation Undying Technique had to be done carefully. After all, Xue Ying would likely not find a second set of cultivation technique appropriate to sell to others.
******
That day.
Summer Wind Capital.
“Hu.”
After entering through the city doors, a white-robed Xue Ying swiftly flew above the Summer Wind Capital. Being an expert in the Mirage and Illusory Realm, his aura was illusory, and others could hardly discern his strength. As long as the cultivator was slightly experienced, he could determine how frighteningly strong this white-robed young man should be!
“Mn?” Xue Ying who was originally planning on visiting the Fan Clan Magic Mountain first to learn the <Heart Realm> suddenly frowned. He turned in a particular direction.
“Karma?” Xue Ying muttered.
A cosmos was relatively smaller. Hence, it was relatively easy to view any karmic ties that existed between beings.
But an Origin World was bigger. The ‘Supreme Law’ was also too high to reach. There were many Cosmos Gods, and the difficulty of sensing one’s ‘karmic ties’ increased greatly. Nevertheless, after becoming a Cosmos God, the cultivator would form his own ‘Cosmic Laws’, and wherever his body existed would push aside the Supreme Law. Hence, it was possible for him to examine all traces, including karma!
The examination of karmic ties included many challenges.
For instance, a longer distance would increase the difficulty of doing so.
And the stronger the other party was, the harder it would be to trace any karmic ties back to that party. Xue Ying’s soul had fused with the ‘Chaotic Origin Energy’ from beyond the Origin World, making it extremely difficult for others to trace down Xue Ying’s karma-even more so than doing so for ordinary Cosmos Gods. Even unparalleled existences might have a hard time finding traces of Xue Ying.
That was why Sacred Master could not find where the avatar of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was!
“Why do I feel that a young fellow whom I have karmic ties with is facing huge trouble within the Summer Wind Capital?” Xue Ying turned towards a direction according to his senses.
“Hua.”
Taking a step, Xue Ying disappeared silently.
…
At the Summer Wind Capital, at the ‘Hidden Wind Valley Prison’ beside Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
“Hu hu.”
The cold wind blew, biting into the bones of those who were present. It whistled amidst the valley. Many cavern prisons could be seen situated in the wall of the valley, with a prisoner being locked up in each of them.
Within one of the prisons.
Ba Tuo Chen sat cross-legged all the way in the prison. His hair draped over his shoulder. Currently, his entire person was dirty and filter. He sat there in silence.
“Dong.” A protector came to the gates, throwing pieces of bizarre metal. There were quite a few-it piled up into a little hill.
“Purify it within one month.” The protector angrily shouted.
Ba Tuo Chen’s cold eyes looked up.
The prison gates weren’t actual substance. Instead, it was an unseen array that forbade the prisoners from leaving.
“Brat, who asked you to offend Prince Sea. Do you believe in your poor luck now?” A protector sneered before leaving after that.
Ba Tuo Chen watched at the bizarre pieces of metal that piled up to a hill. He felt his heart filled with fury, and his eyes flashed with hatred.
That time.
Ba Tuo Chen’s clan was exterminated. His wife deliberately disguised herself and entered his family. To that, Ba Tuo Chen already felt quite distorted in his heart. But due to Xue Ying, he was saved and sent to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, giving him home! That was when he regained his state of the heart. But, just a short one year later, he saw the dark side behind the biggest city in Realm Heart Great Land, the ‘Summer Wind Capital’.
‘This isn’t the time!’
‘When I go out, there’ll be a day when all of them die!’ Ba Tuo Chen roared in his heart. He closed his drooped his eyelids down before waving his hand, causing those pieces of bizarre metal to fly towards him. He began purifying the metal one by one while enduring his feeling.
“Hu.”
Suddenly, Ba Tuo Chen felt something and turned over.
Just outside the cavern that was restricted by an unseen array, there was a young man with his white robe billowing. He walked over through the void. After taking two to three steps, he arrived before this door and said with a chuckle: “Haha, Little Fellow Ba Tuo, what led you to such miserable straits?”
Ba Tuo Chen stared at the white-robed young man outside the gates with a daze. He mumbled: “Senior Ying Shan Xue Ying.”
“Hu.”
Xue Ying waved his hand. He utilized the Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, forming a passage that led directly into the cavern prison. At the same time, he ordered: “Why aren’t you coming out?”
Ba Tuo Chen looked at the distorted spatial passage that formed, yet he did not enter. Instead, he said: “Senior, I offended ‘Prince Sea’ from the Fu Ya Clan. That Prince Sea is actually a subordinate of a Cosmos God from the Fan Clan, ‘Monarch Jade Serpent’. There is no need for Senior to save me.” If his sources of intelligence were right, then Senior Xue Ying should be a tenth level expert from the Southern Cloud Nation. He was incredibly talented and was more terrifying than most tenth level experts.
But no matter what.
That was outside the nation! Within the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, he would still be discriminated, much less when facing against ‘Prince Sea’ who was a subordinate of Fan Clan’s Monarch Jade Serpent.
Even though Ba Tuo Chen’s psychology had been distorted over the one year of torture, he was genuinely thankful to ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying’ as the other party had saved him not for rewards.
