“I asked you to come out, so you come out.” Xue Ying softly roared.
The moment he spoke.
Ba Tuo Chen could not control his body. He went along the passage and walked out. It was only after he left the prison did he regain his consciousness. Ba Tuo Chen felt extremely shocked. He turned back at the jail, realizing that he had left it unknowingly? Was he controlled?
“Master, this Ying Shan Xue Ying is extremely horrifying. Even Cosmos Gods can be controlled willfully by him! I am still too weak currently, and feel a huge threat from him. Hence, I can only conceal my aura in your soul completely for now.” A voice resounded in the soul of Ba Tuo Chen.
“Senior Ying Shan Xue Ying has no malicious intention towards me.” Ba Tuo Chen interacted in his soul.
“What gall! To actually dare barge into the Hidden Wind Valley Prison of my Fan Clan!” A loud, furious shout could be heard from afar. A black-robed muscular man flew in. Behind him closely followed other protectors.
That black-robed muscular man looked at Ba Tuo Chen who escaped with immense acrimony. He coldly chuckled: “Ba Tuo Chen, it is fortunate for you to survive through the ‘soul smelting’. Who would have thought you have the courage to plan and escape from the prison? Do you think the prison of my Fan Clan is somewhere which you could escape from? Also, this helper of yours is quite resourceful to actually dare infiltrate into my Fan Clan’s prison? Everyone go! Kill them all!”
The black-robed muscular man first led with a wave of his whip.
“Hua.”
The whip brought with it a thunderclap as it arced through the sky before fiercely slapping down on his own body. That lash actually caused flesh to lacerate, causing the area where it was lashed on to be drenched with blood.
The black-robed muscular man howled in grief, though only excitement could be seen on his face: “Now you know how formidable it is? Haha.”
As he shouted, he continued waving his whip.
“Pa pa pa pa…”
Whip by whip, all the lashes landed on his body. He wailed in anguish, yet only excitement could be seen.
The other protectors by the side were stunned. They even sent voice transmissions to this comrade of theirs, yet to no avail.
“This…” Ba Tuo Chen was watching dumbstruck from the side. This black-robed muscular male was here in the Hidden Wind Valley Prison mainly to deal against him. That was an order given by Prince Sea, but now, the black-robed male seems to be lashing at himself? He was still a Primal Chaos expert.
Xue Ying sat outside the cavern on midair watching silently.
He did not wish to start a slaughter; Xue Ying wanted to give some face to the Fan Clan.
He was too lazy to reveal his identity and grumble about such matters with the protectors. The reason why he taught this black-robed muscular male a lesson was that Xue Ying could see the substantial karmic ties between Ba Tuo Chen and that black-robed muscular male. Clearly, there was vengeance.
“He is here.” Xue Ying looked up.
To the distant, a black-robed male appeared, causing Xue Ying to reveal a look of astonishment: “Sky-Rending Great Paragon.”
He had informed Sky-Rending Great Paragon before this that he would be coming to learn the Heart Realm. Xue Ying also mentioned the matter of saving someone from the Hidden Wind Valley Prison to Sky-Rending Great Paragon too! Since he was merely saving a Unity Realm fellow, Sky-Rending Great Paragon immediately accepted as it was honestly a minor affair!
“Sou sou sou sou sou sou…”
Many figures started appearing.
The real higher-ups of the Hidden Wind Valley Prison including a Cosmos God and other Primal Chaos experts were all incredibly nervous! Many protectors including that black-robed muscular male who had been lashing on himself previously and regained his consciousness now turned to the distant ‘Sky-Rending Great Paragon’.
“Greetings, Great Paragon.”
They greeted uniformly.
The status of Sky-Rending Great Paragon was honestly too high! He was the chief manager for the entire Fan Clan and had a more unique status as compared to the other five Great Paragons. Yet he actually came to the Hidden Wind Valley Prison? This was a prison located at the outermost boundary in the Magic Mountain, a prison that had a low status. Those who committed a grave crime would have been locked at a more stringent prison.
“Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon smiled at Xue Ying.
Xue Ying also followed along. He controlled the void to bring along Ba Tuo Chen.
“I am just helping a young fellow who is fated to cross path with me, yet Great Paragon actually came down personally.” Xue Ying replied.
“Hahaha, since it is at the Fan Clan Magic Mountain, I’d naturally come and have a look.”
Fan Clan Magic Mountain chuckled. Sky-Rending Great Paragon turned to Ba Tuo Chen by the side, “Is this the young fellow you are planning to save?”
Ba Tuo Chen became even more nervous.
The separate existence in his soul had utterly hidden its aura.
Sky-Rending Great Paragon!
The number two existence in the Fan Clan! He was second only to the Old Ancestor of the Fan Clan. Sky-Rending Great Paragon was someone that stood at the apex across the whole Realm Heart Great Land!
“Shall we enter the Magic Mountain now?” Sky-Rending Great Paragon asked.
“Alright.” Xue Ying nodded. He then turned to Ba Tuo Chen, asking: “Ba Tuo Chen, where are you planning to go?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1099 - Going Home
chapters.content:
Chapter 1099: Going Home
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Senior, I’ve offended an enemy, so it is best for me to leave the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.” Ba Tuo Chen said.
Xue Ying softly nodded. He then waved his hand.
“Si la.”
A spatial passage was formed using the Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique. Ba Tuo Chen looked at Xue Ying with gratitude. He uttered with a low tone: “This grace by senior is something junior doesn’t know when this junior can repay.” Saying that, he turned around and left through the passage.
Xue Ying smiled after seeing it.
My Heart as the World. Xue Ying had never treated the weak tiny existences as ants. Instead, he took mercy on them. In his eyes, Ba Tuo Chen was a pitiful little fellow. First, his entire clan was exterminated, yet he still made an enemy after being sent to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. He was imprisoned in the Fan Clan’s prison, and if Xue Ying did not save the other party, he might not be able to live and see the sun.
“Younger Brother Flying Snow, shall we go?” Sky-Rending Great Paragon said.
“I’ve troubled Great Paragon.” Xue Ying felt that this Great Paragon in front was indeed giving him great respect.
“There is no need to be that polite between us.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon chuckled before bringing Xue Ying away.
Within the prison, the other higher-ups and protectors were all shocked inwardly when they saw the scene.
“It seems this Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow is respected so highly by Great Paragon?” Numerous higher-ups were appalled to find that.
“Hurry up and inform Prince Sea.” The black muscular male still trembled when he thought about how he planned on lashing out at a horrific expert that even Sky-Rending Great Paragon respected.
…
Prince Sea ‘Fu Ya Hai’ was currently in the place of his teacher Monarch Jade Serpent listening to the Dao lecture with other disciples.
“Mn?”
The long narrow eyes of Monarch Jade Serpent flitted with slight bewilderment. He then shouted: “Everyone, withdraw now. Fu Ya Hai, you stay behind.”
At that moment, all the disciples went off.
Prince Sea sat by himself underneath, looking at his teacher above. But closely following that, he also received the transmission.
“You can’t even handle your matter cleanly?” Monarch Jade Serpent frowned at his disciple.
“Teacher, I would not have thought this is related to that Ying Shan Xue Ying. Ying Shan Xue Ying is merely an outsider, so there is no need to regard him that much.” Prince Sea could not help but rebut.
Monarch Jade Serpent coldly snorted: “Fool! Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow is a reincarnator. He could activate the pinnacle of void-ification at Primal Chaos Realm, which goes to show how frightening his origin is! Furthermore, I am not his opponent anymore, given his current strength.” He knew how unfathomable Cosmos Gods that grasped the Dao of Mirage were!
But at the very least, he knew the other party was stronger.
“Ah.” Prince Sea was startled.
“I’ve ordered my subordinates to check out Ba Tuo Chen. He is merely a fortunate brat from the Thistle Flower Nation Ba Tuo Clan. That time, Ying Shan Xue Ying saved him whimsically as he passed by the Thistle Flower Nation. They aren’t too close. It is only that Ying Shan Xue Ying is too benevolent.” Monarch Jade Serpent said, “If you want to deal with Ba Tuo Chen, then do it cleanly! Don’t leave behind any traces.”
“I understand.” Prince Sea nodded. Being a disciple of the Fan Clan, he naturally had his own methods that could prevent others from tracking down what he did to his captives.
‘Letting you escape? Yet you are so fortunate to climb on your relation with Ying Shan Xue Ying? I can’t offend Ying Shan Xue Ying but do you think I can’t eliminate you brat?’ Prince Sea knew that enmity had formed between him and Ba Tuo Chen. Previously, he wanted to make use of this trash. Now that the other party escaped, he had to think of an opportunity to rid the weed and cut the problem at its root!
…
Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, ‘Limitless City’.
Limitless City was the territory belonging to one of Myriad Realms Ancient Nation’s five ancestors, the ‘Limitless City Master’. It was also one of the five great cities in Myriad Realms Ancient Nation. Given the temper of Limitless City Master, he set down stringent laws that made Limitless City one of the most orderly cities in Myriad Realms Ancient Nation.
“Mn?”
Outside in the vast wilderness of Limitless City, a spatial passage distorted, and a young man in dire straits came out. He was Ba Tuo Chen that had been sent here by Xue Ying.
Ba Tuo Chen glanced at the large city in front, muttering to himself: “Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, Limitless City? This place has law and order and is far from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. It seems Senior Ying Shan Xue Ying has done things in my best interest.”
Ba Tuo Chen felt complex.
Even though the prison of Fan Clan might seem terrifying, in his original plan, it was possible for him to escape after spending a long time. But since Xue Ying saved him, it gave him the chance to escape from the prison at an earlier time. That was really ‘setting the bird free into the sky’, allowing his strength to increase at a faster rate.
‘Senior Ying Shan Xue Ying, I am currently small and weak. In the future, I, Ba Tuo Chen, will definitely repay this gratitude.’ Ba Tuo Chen solemnly promised to himself.
“Master, an orderly place isn’t apt for you to grow. What we need is a more chaotic place!” A voice sounded in the soul of Ba Tuo Chen.
“Mn.”
“Master doesn’t need to be anxious. Since Master can pass Old Master’s soul trial, your talent must be high. Master is the most appropriate disciple that Old Monster Stone has sought for ages. As long as Master spend a little more effort in cultivating, it is entirely possible for you to match against existences like that Ying Shan Xue Ying, or even transcend him and stand at the apex across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.”
“Even though it is good that this place is orderly, it isn’t suitable for me to stay. Let’s go, send me away from here.” Ba Tuo Chen glanced at Limitless City.
“Yes, Master.”
At that moment, an unseen ripple enveloped Ba Tuo Chen, causing him to disappear from the place.
******
Xue Ying did not know that this young fellow Ba Tuo Chen who he saved would incur a huge wave in the future. At this moment, under the lead of Sky-Rending Great Paragon, Xue Ying saw the strongest scripture Fan Clan had on ‘Mirage’, the <Heart Realm>.
Holding on to the thick black scripture, a large amount of information rushed into his mind.
“Amazing.”
“Formidable.”
Being a Cosmos God in the Dao of Mirage, his foresight was great. Xue Ying immediately discovered how frightening this <Heart Realm> scripture was! Ultimately, it was a Mirage cultivation technique deduced by the unparalleled existence, ‘Ancestor Fan’, as he cultivated the Dao of Mirage. This was also the strongest Dao of Mirage scripture the Summer Wind Ancient Nation had.
“Sky-Rending Great Paragon, I’ve already learned this cultivation technique and will be visiting the royal palace now.” Xue Ying said.
“Good, haha, if you were to have any more appropriate secret impartation techniques, you can continue to sell them to my Fan Clan.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon chuckled. The reason why he was so polite had not been because of the other party’s strength. More importantly, since this Xue Ying could teach his ‘Nine Rotation Undying Technique’ to others—this was a terrifying cultivation technique that Sky-Rending Great Paragon recognized as something only ‘third level Cosmos Gods’ could create—then Xue Ying must have an extremely high status in the religion during his previous life. It was likely he should still have other appropriate cultivation techniques.
“Certainly.”
Xue Ying acknowledged before disappearing from the Fan Clan Magic Mountain, arriving at the royal palace of the Summer Wind Capital.
…
Deep in the royal palace.
“The imparting of the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll> is slightly complex. Could Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow please proceed forward.” A yellow-robed old man brought Xue Ying into an extremely secretive underground palace. At the center of the chamber, there was a queer floating stone obelisk. At this moment, this stone obelisk had an open door, “After entering the stone pillar, remember to maintain your state of the pinnacle of void-ification. Otherwise, you will feel agony.”
“Alright.”
Xue Ying nodded.
Xue Ying stepped into the obelisk. This was a trade which he had with Emperor Summer. Emperor Summer could kill him with a flip of his hand, and would not formulate such a scheme just to assassinate him.
“Weng.” After entering the obelisk, Xue Ying found that space inside was merely several dozen meters long and ten meters high. The door to the obelisk was shut close shortly after.
Following that, many strands of golden light appeared in the interior of the stone obelisk.
This stone obelisk had somehow become a sieve. Many veined patterns could be seen appearing inside, causing golden light to emanate.
“Hong long long~” The surrounding essence of the void was torn apart, causing large amounts of holes to form. Those pitch-black holes were entrances for the surging Chaotic Origin Energy. These holes were so much bigger than what Xue Ying could create using his Arch Destruction.
“This—”
Xue Ying felt it.
When that incomparably concentrated Chaotic Origin Energy rushed over, because it was too high and dense, Xue Ying could feel pain as it invaded through his fleshy body. This was on the premise that he activated the ‘pinnacle of void-ification’. Otherwise, it would be as that array spirit mentioned—Xue Ying would feel ‘agonizing pain’.
As the Chaotic Origin Energy was transmitted into his body, it similarly poured into the stone obelisk.
Only after the Chaotic Origin Energy poured into the stone obelisk that was glowing in gold did it form many unique black characters that entered the body of Xue Ying and into his soul. That was how Xue Ying learned this cultivation technique.
This cultivation technique was limited innately by the ‘Supreme Law’! It was impossible to learn it during regular times. Only by relying on large amounts of Chaotic Origin Energy was it possible to impart it to another person.
‘It is impossible for my teacher to tear apart such a huge hole in the Origin World, yet this array could do so? Emperor Summer must have spent a great effort to do it.’ Xue Ying thought. For the sake of creating this cultivation technique, Emperor Summer had spent a great effort, yet he was only able to create two levels.
It was like the <Heart Realm>.
Any Mirage and Illusory Realm scriptures were expensive as they pertained to the soul. The Heart Realm was even ranked at the most apex, so it was reasonable to cost 80,000 contribution points.
But an incomplete Dao of void scripture that could lead to the second level Cosmos God required 100,000 contribution points. This was equivalent to a secret impartation technique which led all the way to the peak. Furthermore, imparting this technique was influenced by the Supreme Law. One could see how unique it was.
Soon, the whole place regained its calm. That hole which was formed in the Origin World, had long recovered.
“Weng weng weng.”
The stone door opened.
Xue Ying walked out with excitedly. Amazing, it was truly amazing. This <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll> was absolutely worth the purchase!
“Have you learned it?” The yellow-robed old man smiled.
“I’ve learned it.” Xue Ying replied.
“Then the transaction of Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow with my Summer Clan has ended. I’ll be sending Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow out.” The yellow-robed old man chuckled.
******
Southern Cloud Nation, in the great city ‘Flying Snow City’.
Within the Void God Pagoda.
A golden-robed Xue Ying stealthily came back. Nobody else knew that he had entered the Void God Pagoda.
‘It is time for me to return.’ The golden-robed Xue Ying thought to himself.
He had already gotten the scriptures which he needed.
That was one of the reliances he had on returning to the Primal Chaos Void.
Xue Ying had also become a Cosmos God. Everything had been prepared.
‘I wonder how is Jing Qiu, Yu’er and Qing Yao. I wonder if my hometown Primal Chaos Void is still fine?’ Xue Ying felt immensely anxious.
“Go, time to return home!”
With a thought.
That remaining half energy of the Realm Heart Order which had been remaining dormant in his soul was activated. That scarlet red energy wrapped around the core of Xue Ying’s true spirit!
“Hong.”
The scarlet energy grew.
His soul immediately turned into grits and disappeared. The scarlet energy similarly brought along that strand of the true spirit and vanished from the world.
As for the fleshy body of Xue Ying, it remained there entirely undamaged.
“Sou.”
Another green-robed Xue Ying avatar flew out from the Eden Treasure. After all, the current Xue Ying had nine avatars in total.
The green-robed Xue Ying waved his hand, causing this golden-robed fleshy body to break down into fundamental energy.
The green-robed Xue Ying then looked towards another direction. He could sense that was where the ‘strand of true spirit’ headed: ‘I hope my plan succeeds.’
He left behind avatars to continue fighting on the Realm Heart Great Land.
And there was one which was sent back to his hometown.
…
“Hong.”
A true spirit immediately left the Realm Heart Great Land under protection from the Realm Heart Order energy. It advanced forward through a mysterious space at a higher dimension.
This time, Xue Ying’s true spirit was a Cosmos God true spirit. Hence, his perception of the outer world was much clearer. Xue Ying felt the ‘great terror’ coming from beyond. That higher dimension mysterious space was absolutely something he could not afford to be involved with.
‘I can still sense it.’
Xue Ying could perceive the memory link with the avatars back at the Realm Heart Great Land.
Time might have lost its meaning here. Xue Ying could not discern the flow of time. It only felt like an extremely long period.
The energy bubble continued advancing to another Origin World, the ‘Primal Chaos Void’. Over time, Xue Ying’s perception of the avatars at the Realm Heart Great Land became weaker and weaker. It became harder to synchronize the memories between them.
‘I am ultimately just a strand of true spirit core to my soul! It is merely one-trillionth that of my entire soul.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘It is too weak. Hence, once the distance gets further, synchronizing memories between my avatars will becoming taxing. I believe after returning to my hometown, once my soul becomes stronger, I should be able to sense my avatars then.’
Gradually.
His memories could no longer be synchronized. Xue Ying could only faintly perceive the direction of Realm Heart Great Land where his avatars were at.
The Realm Heart Order energy was continually being consumed.
It became less and less.
‘I’m here.’ Xue Ying’s consciousness felt a joke. Even though it was just a strand of true spirit, it was still the spirit of a Cosmos God and was much stronger than most Void Gods! Xue Ying had genuinely felt himself flying towards an incomparably vast and powerful fluctuation. That was something which he was familiar with—the fluctuation coming from his hometown Origin World, the ‘Primal Chaos Void’.
“Sou!”
Closely following that, under the protection of the remnant Realm Heart Order energy, Xue Ying’s true spirit directly tunneled through the membrane and into the Origin World.
‘I’m back. I, Dong Bo Xue Ying, is finally back! Jing Qiu, I’ve returned home!’ Xue Ying was extremely excited.

chapters.title: Chapter 1100 - Reincarnating in Bright Star Planet
chapters.content:
Chapter 1100: Reincarnating in Bright Star Planet
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Hong.”
Under the protection from the energy of the Realm Heart Order, Xue Ying’s strand of true spirit was directly sent into an embryo. Having experienced it previously where he was born as a Void God, this time, Xue Ying realized how much weaker the life force in the current ‘womb’ was: ‘Even though it is much weaker, I will still be a Transcendent lifeform after birth. My birth parents this time should be World Deities or True Gods.’
Xue Ying rapidly inferred.
Closely following that, as his strand of true spirit fused with the embryo, Xue Ying felt his true spirit ringing before he lost his consciousness totally.
This followed the operation of the ‘Supreme Law’ as Xue Ying reincarnated naturally.
And it was something Ancestor Fan, Southern Cloud King and other existences who could use the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ dreamed of achieving! Because being an outsider, they would be suppressed and repulsed on all aspects by the Supreme Law of the entire Origin World. Even their strength would be suppressed to a low level. But if one were to ‘reincarnate into a different world’, they would obtain the agreement from the Supreme Law.
Clearly…
The teacher of Myriad Realms Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master, Southern Cloud King, Ancestor Fan, and others could not achieve this by themselves.
Xue Ying also depended on the energy provided from the ‘Realm Heart Order’.
One to leave and one to return.
The energy of the Realm Heart Order would thus be depleted. This opportunity would no longer appear a second time!
******
In the vast Primal Chaos Void. This Origin World was bigger than even the Realm Heart Great Land. Furthermore, it was still constantly expanding.
Other than the five great sacred worlds and the innumerable cosmos, the vast void contained many lands too. Some of these lands had been condensed by powerful experts condensing the World Energy, and some were remnant pieces left behind after the shattering of the original ‘Primitive Ancient Sacred World’. During the shattering of the Primitive Ancient Sacred World, a part of the land had been hurled deep into a void maelstrom within the Primal Chaos Void. This land was also isolated from contact with the outer world.
On this small world, the cultivators living within called it the ‘Bright Star Planet’.
“Sou.”
There was currently a couple seated cross-legged on a flying ship.
The flying ship was a few dozen meters long. As it traveled amidst the cloud, it moved at lightning speed.
“Qin’er, we are just one day away from the ‘Black Sky Sect’. Let us hurry over.” The male said. His was garbed in long black robes with a long sword hung over his back. His bearing seemed extraordinary, albeit his eyes were filled with faint anxiety.
“Mn.” A white-robed girl to his side replied. Her eyes were filled with longing as she lightly caressed the swelling belly of hers.
The male also turned to the belly of his wife. He felt increasingly anxious and regretful inwardly: ‘No matter what, I must protect my wife.’
“This little fellow is growing bigger day by day.” The white-robed girl caressed her belly and giggled, “Its a boy. In the future, he’ll definitely become as amazing as Brother Yu.”
The male chuckled too.
That’s right.
He could not forget the first time he peered through the stomach of his wife using his True God Energy. Just a simple scan made his heart tremble because this was his first child, and the only child his true love had.
‘One day, there is still one more day left.’ The male looked ahead. The flying ship continued flying forward.
“Hahaha…”
Suddenly, a piece of black cloud flew over from a distance. A burst of loud resounding laughter was head, “Xie Yi Yu, Cui Qin, I had a tough time finding the two of you.”
The black-robed male and white-robed girl abruptly stood. Staring at the rolling black cloud moving over from afar, the two of them could not help but feel their hearts becoming heavy.
“Old Devil Golden Horn is here.” Both husband and wife turned extremely anxious.
“Brother Yu, what should we do?” The white-robed girl Cui Qin impatiently mentioned, “At this time, for the sake of our children.”
“For the sake of our children, we could no longer care.” The black-robed male gritted his teeth, “I hope this devil would pull back.”
“Senior Golden Horn.” The black-robed male looked at the black cloud that rolled over from afar, shouting out, “We are willing to offer this Void God Weapon, but senior has to swear to us…”
Given the temper of the husband and wife, they would rather sacrifice their lives than to let a devil get a Void God Weapon freely.
But currently, for the sake of their children, they were willing to hand over the treasure.
Feeling the heartbeat of their child, which had yet to be born, both husband and wife had sworn to ensure the safety and growth of their children.
“If the two of you had obediently given it to me, I might still provide a route of survival for the two of you. But now? It’s too late!” The rolling black cloud came in from a distance and folded, surrounding the entire place, “For the sake of chasing after the two of you, I, old ancestor, has used my treasure teleportation seal and even painstakingly searched for all traces where the two of you have been! And now, the two of you want me to let you live? Haha, just come into the stomach of I, old ancestor!”
The black cloud scurried. It was moving at speed close to twice that of the flying ship, quickly engulfing the place.
Both husband and wife felt their hearts turning cold.
“Qin’er.”
Xie Yi Yu looked at his wife by his side. He muttered, “I’ll hold off that old devil. You should run.”
“Brother Yu…” The white-robed girl Cui Qin paled.
“My teacher and I are related by blood. Even though I’ve committed a sin, I doubt Teacher will be that harsh towards you. You must remember to take good care of my child.” Xie Yi Yu said.
“Mn.” Cui Qin had also cultivated for a relatively long period. Even though she was feeling agony, she knew they had no other ways.
Xie Yi Yu extended his hand and gave the belly of his wife one last touch. He felt its warmth, mumbling: “I truly wish I could see and hold you one day. What a pity that we aren’t fated.”
“Sou.”
Following that, Xie Yi Yu turned into a dazzling ray of sword and tore into the sky. He directly charged towards the true body of that Old Devil Golden Horn amidst the rolling black cloud.
A furious roar reverberated across the world.
“Old Devil, die!”
The white-robed girl was already filled with tears. She watched from the flying ship as her husband disregarded everything just to hold off the devil. She also tried her best to control the flying ship: “Hurry, hurry, move!”
As long as she hurled across a certain distance, it would be hard for the other party to track existences of the flying ship. One day would be sufficient for her to return back to her sect. As long as her husband could delay that Old Devil Golden Horn for a day, she would have a high chance of returning into her haven.
“Brother Yu.” The white-robed girl felt her agonizing pain in her heart.
…
In the stomach of the white-robed girl.
A frighteningly strong life was being nurtured.
“Hmm.”
Xue Ying’s consciousness was awakening. His strand of true spirit was too grand. Even after reincarnating with his true spirit as the root into a soul, Xue Ying’s consciousness only awakened after this embryo reached the late stages of the Transcendent level-it was close to birth.
‘Fortunately.’ The moment he awoke, Xue Ying had faintly perceived his other avatars located in the incomparably far Origin World, ‘Realm Heart Great Land’.
‘This soul of mine is still too weak. I can’t link my memories yet. But at least I can perceive the existences of my other avatars, so that is a good matter.’ Xue Ying thought.
How would things end up after reincarnating over?
Xue Ying dared not confirm before doing it.
He was most afraid of one possibility-that the reincarnated soul could not sense the soul of his avatars in the Realm Heart Great Land! That was possible. After all, the souls were located in two different Origin Worlds. If that truly happened, then Xue Ying only had one solution to it-to increase the speed of cultivation of his avatars in the Realm Heart Great Land, cultivating the Dao of Void to the second level Cosmos God Realm so that it could use the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’.
By then, he would send this avatar over using the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.
Even though it might be suppressed, at least the avatar could be used as a ‘bridge’ for synchronizing and linking the memories between his body in the Primal Chaos Void and bodies on the Realm Heart Great Land.
‘Fortunately.’
‘The soul over at the Realm Heart Great Land seems to be produced by using my strand of true spirit as a base. Similarly, the reincarnated soul in the Primal Chaos Void uses my true spirit as a foundation too.’ Xue Ying let out a breath of relief.
When his strand of true spirit was sent into the Realm Heart Great Land, he could synchronize his memories with his avatars.
After reincarnating, with the soul that was formed using his strand of true spirit, it was able to resonate with the soul over at the Origin World.
‘How is the situation outside?’
Xue Ying’s current soul was relatively weak.
But.
He was a horrifying existence who comprehended the Dao of Void and Dao of Mirage to the Cosmos God Realm. Naturally, the profound mysteries and laws he grasped had formed a cosmic system. No matter which Origin World he ended up in, Xue Ying would immediately reach the Cosmos God Realm.
“Hu.”
Relying on the void, his consciousness swept across the surrounding.
“Hong!”
This consciousness that existed in a higher dimension covered the entire ‘Bright Star Planet’ at this moment.
Many experts were living on the Bright Star Planet, but none spotted the inspection sweep. After all, Cosmos Gods were practically standing at the apex across the whole Primal Chaos Void.
‘It seems the parents of this life have met some trouble?’ Xue Ying immediately discovered that.

chapters.title: Chapter 1101 - Black Sky Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 1101: Black Sky Sect
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying relied on karma to determine it. Being a piece of land in the Primal Chaos Void, the ‘Bright Star Planet’ operated according to the Supreme Law. Scouting using karma wasn’t something done easily, but reaching the Cosmos God Realm, the Supreme Law was forced to a retreat. Naturally, karma was shapeless. Xue Ying had just reincarnated into this world. As an extremely new soul and an embryo, he naturally was only connected via karmic ties to two people—his father and mother.
His mother was naturally the white-robed girl that currently had him in her womb still.
And the other would be the black-robed male that was currently fighting with an enemy not too far away.
“Child, even though you are in my stomach, you are already a Transcendent lifeform and should be able to perceive the outer world.” The white-robed girl caressed her stomach from outside. She currently mumbled to herself in tears, “You must remember that your father is called Xie Yi Yu. He died for the sake of saving you.”
The white-robed girl turned towards the distance.
She hoped for a miracle.
But she understood that the possibility of a miracle happening was tiny! Her husband could not survive long in front of Old Devil Golden Horn, and his speed of escaping was far inferior from the other party. Hence, the only outcome would be death.
…
“Xie Yi Yu?”
Xue Ying heard the soft mumble from his mother inside the stomach.
Being a Cosmos God that cultivated for trillions of years, reincarnating into another life was merely a kind of experience to him. It was impossible for Xue Ying to form such deep attachment to his first birth parents in the past within the Snowrock Castle. But since they were related by blood, Xue Ying would naturally treat these two people differently.
‘My birth parents are connected to be via karma. Naturally, I’ll have to repay them properly.’ Xue Ying thought. Actually, he did not care about being tangled with karma after becoming a Cosmos God. But being someone who wasn’t willing to let the weak and small be humiliated, this tremendous karma with his birth parents was something Xue Ying would not let things by. After all, if he had not reincarnated into this life, the stomach of this couple would still give birth to a new soul.
Since he replaced the previous soul, Xue Ying naturally had to repay the gratitude.
‘Father seems to be a True God Paragon, and Mother is an ordinary True God.’ Xue Ying softly inspected their strength, ‘That Old Devil Golden Horn is a True God Ruler? This old devil seems to be entangled with many karmic sins.’
Xue Ying could sense the overflowing grievance and resentment in those karmic ties.
“Weng.”
Given his strength as a Mirage and Illusory Realm Cosmos God, Xue Ying easily scoured through the memories of this Old Devil Golden Horn with a thought. Through this, he understood the identity of his parents.
******
“Si la.”
The rays of the sword moved unhindered.
Xie Yi Yu’s eyes were filled with an intense desire. His fighting spirit was currently ablaze!
At the first moment when he examined the embryo in the stomach of his wife, Xie Yi Yu had made his decision to use his life to protect this family of his—to protect his wife and his child.
He had lived in seclusion with his wife peacefully and blissfully.
Nonetheless, Old Devil Golden Horn still found his way to them!
He had used all his treasures and thought of all means, and now, he could only use his life to hold the old devil back.
‘How I wish I could have a look at him and have him in my embrace.’
‘I hope for you to grow up happily.’
‘My child. The child of I, Xie Yi Yu.’
At this moment, the soul of Xie Yi Yu seemed to be burning. He was willing to fork out all price just to protect his wife and child. This intense desire made his soul burn with incomparable brightness. He had even faintly touched the boundary of the ‘Ruler Realm’. But breaking through was ultimately not an easy task. And Old Devil Golden Horn was currently feeling anxious as he did not wish for the treasure to escape right before his eyes.
“Die for me!” Old Devil Golden Horn was exceptionally anxious.
“Teacher, this disciple knows his mistake, but the child of Qin’er and me is innocent! This disciple could not win against Old Devil Golden Horn, and would likely die in the hands of Old Devil Golden Horn. This disciple only prays for Teacher to save my wife and child given our past relationship and allow them to survive. Teacher, I beg you.” As Xie Yi Yu fought with the old devil, he was similarly sending a transmission to his teacher asking for help.
“Xiu.”
Suddenly, Old Devil Golden Horn turned around and escaped.
Xie Yi Yu who was entangled initially in a fight with Old Devil Golden Horn all the way, discovered with bewilderment that the direction where Old Devil Golden Horn escaped in was different from the direction where his wife headed to.
“Escape? Why would he escape?” Xie Yi Yu felt puzzled.
Old Devil Golden Horn was currently escaping with incomparable terror.
“My teacher came? That’s not right! If Teacher came, he should have directly teleported over! How could Old Devil Golden Horn discover Teacher before Teacher even came?” Xie Yi Yu was puzzled.
After a breath.
Xie Yi Yu finally stopped. He stood in a daze watching as Old Devil Golden Horn rapidly disappeared across the horizon.
After such a long time, his wife should have escaped.
“I survived?” Xie Yi Yu was in a stupor. He who harbored the thought of certain death, had never thought that the matter would proceed in such a baffling way, “Why did Old Devil Golden Horn flee in such panic? Was there a mysterious expert helping me in the dark? Or is there some other reason? No matter what, at least I survived.”
“Hu.”
Suddenly, a figure appeared in midair. It was a yellow-robed old man.
The yellow-robed old man stared at Xie Yi Yu coldly.
“Teacher.” Xie Yi Yu immediately knelt down the moment he saw his teacher.
…
And on another side.
Old Devil Golden Horn who was running in a flurry suddenly trembled. “Peng!” He silently exploded, leaving behind just a bit of his treasures which fell into the lake. In the future, it might be possible for someone to discover it.
At least ‘Xue Ying’ who killed Old Devil Golden Horn disdained from this bit of treasures from a True God Ruler. Inside his own ‘Mirage Cosmos’, he could easily transform illusory materials into real items, and these treasures which he casually created were more precious than what True God Rulers had.
Within the stomach of the white-robed girl Cui Qin.
“Hmph.” Xue Ying did not care about pinching Old Devil Golden Horn to death. It took just a single thought of his.
‘It seems the teacher of my father in this life has arrived?’
Xue Ying did not care. He started surreptitiously absorbing the World Energy to alter the body of his mother while nourishing his own body. Xue Ying was also hurrying the time of his birth.
******
“Teacher.”
The black-robed male Xie Yi Yu and white-robed girl Cui Qin stood next to each other in midair looking at the yellow-robed old man.
The yellow-robed old man ‘Elder Cloud Seal’ coldly stared at the pair of husband and wife in front of him: “Originally, I was thinking that the two of you dying outside was deserved, but what you said is right. Your child is innocent, and that was why I came to save the lot of you.”
His words might sound cold.
But in reality, Elder Cloud Seal was feeling both furious and anxious when his favorite disciple disobeyed the rules of the sect; he wanted to save them, yet he was mad. Previously when Xie Yi Yu transmitted a message to Elder Cloud Seal, begging for his help to save his child. That was when Elder Cloud Seal understood that his disciple was indeed on the verge of dying, giving Elder Cloud Seal the excuse to save them—to save the child of his disciple and not his disciple. In reality, Elder Cloud Seal wasn’t someone that would forgo the teacher-disciple relationship they had over the long years.
“Elder.” The white-robed girl Cui Qin added, “Everything is my fault. It is the fault of us husband and wife. I do hope for elder not to implicate our child.”
“Hmph, Disciple of Sky Mirror Pavilion.” Elder Cloud Seal snorted coldly.
The enmity between Sky Mirror Pavilion and Black Sky Sect were too deep. The ancestors that started both sects were enemies that would kill each other on sight. Over the long years, they battled against each other because of this enmity, deepening the hostility between the sects so much that it was as deep as the sea and as high as a mountain. For instance, the Dao companion of Elder Cloud Seal had died in the hands of an expert from the Sky Mirror Pavilion, and that was just the corner of the enmity between these two great sects.
Nevertheless, Xie Yi Yu and Cui Qin chose to tie the knots…
That was a grave crime in any of the two great sects!
Hence, both husband and wife chose to find a place and hide themselves a long time ago. Nevertheless, as they faced a threat from Old Devil Golden Horn, they were forced to rely on their sects for protection.
“Go, let us return.” Elder Cloud Seal brought the two of them and directly teleported towards the Black Sky Sect.
…
Black Sky Sect.
The ancestor who started the sect was a Unity Realm expert called ‘Black Sky Founder’. He was an expert ranked top 20 in the Bright Star Planet, and had set strict legislation over the sect.
Naturally, even though becoming a spouse of a disciple from an enemy sect might be a grave crime, it wasn’t considered a ‘death crime’. Only those who betrayed the sect would be directly sentenced to death.
“Xie Yi Yu and Cui Qin will be stationed at Black Fiend Peak for eternity.”
The punishment of the Black Sky Sect had finally been given.
Both husband Xie Yi Yu and wife Cui Qin were sent to the Black Fiend Peak. They would be sentenced to the same punishment as others who were equally located in the Black Fiend Peak—to help the sect refine treasures and weapons, ‘stationed at the Black Fiend Peak for eternity’. This meant they would most likely stay here forever unless they broke through and become a Void God. They would directly become an Elder, and by then, their statuses would be different. They no longer had to be trapped here.
“The two of us will be stationed at the Black Fiend Peak for eternity, but they did not mention that our child will stay here forever too. We’ll teach our child properly until his foundation is firm. By then, we’ll let our child join the Black Sky Sect.” Xie Yi Yu and Cui Qin were both filled with joy. They were currently staying at a small courtyard within the Black Fiend Peak. Even though they had arduous work, Xie Yi Yu could finish it alone.
Both husband and wife were waiting.
On the third month since they stayed on the Black Fiend Peak.
The wife ‘Cui Qin’ finally gave birth to a boy. He was a Transcendent at birth.
At this moment, the entire Black Sky Sect did not understand at all what this boy who was given birth on the ‘Black Fiend Peak’ at a desolate corner of the Black Sky Sect meant to them!

chapters.title: Chapter 1102 - I Am Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 1102: I Am Back
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Black Fiend Peak, in a small courtyard of one of the houses.
A chubby white toddler looked to his side. At that moment, another toddler condensed from World Energy.
‘I shall temporarily allow this incarnation to stay here.’
“Sou.”
The chubby white toddler disappeared.
…
Over at a place in the Primal Caos Void far away from the Bright Star Planet, the white toddler appeared. Following that, the appearance of this chubby toddler transformed into a white-robed young man Xue Ying.
‘Time for me to improve the strength of this fleshy body of mine.’ Xue Ying thought.
It wasn’t right for him to wantonly absorb World Energy in the Bright Star Planet. Hence, he merely constructed his soul using the ‘Dao of Mirage’ as a structure to the Cosmos God level! The improvement of a soul absorbed energy from the essence of the Origin World. It was a quiet absorption of World Energy. Hence, it was easy for Xue Ying to divide out an incarnation.
“Hong!”
Following that, as Xue Ying willed, large amounts of World Energy started surging into the body of Xue Ying from the initially cold and desolate Primal Chaos Void. It formed an incomparably huge maelstrom.
The strength of his fleshy body rose rapidly.
Transcendent, Deity, World Deity, True God, Void God, Unity Realm, Primal Chaos Realm… Cosmos God!
This transformation was rapid.
The ‘God Sea’ in his body evolved continually. It evolved into a world and then converged into a point of ‘Mirage Origin’ before developing into a piece of miniature cosmos and finally, turning into the Mirage Cosmos.
Once his realm reached the level, all he needed was to absorb sufficient energy, and Xue Ying could quickly recover his original strength.
“I’ve finally regained my strength.” Feeling his own strength, Xue Ying revealed a grin, “Compared to my body in Realm Heart Great Land, I do not have any secret treasures or the Southern Cloud Sacred Body.”
Ultimately, the requirements towards external materials on training the Southern Cloud Sacred Body were too harsh.
But the biggest issue now was that many precious materials that were formed in Realm Heart Great Land could not be found here at the Primal Chaos Void. After all, two different Origin Worlds had different Supreme Law. The myriad existences formed in both worlds were vastly different. Even cultivation methods were universal only after reaching the Cosmos God Realm.
‘But I can cultivate the stronger <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll>.’
Xue Ying thought.
This time, he brought along two terrifying cultivation techniques as he came back-the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll> and <Heart Realm>
It’s just that grasping the first level of the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll> was very difficult. Firstly, Xue Ying had to attain the ‘pinnacle of void-ification’. After that, he had to break apart the cage of the Origin World, absorbing sufficient ‘Chaotic Origin Energy’ to use! Finally, it had a hefty requirement for one’s realm. Xue Ying had to achieve Cosmos God Realm in eight branches of the Dao of Void. It was clearly harder than the Five Phases Sealing Technique.
‘The flow of time at the Realm Heart Great Land is approximately the same as that in the Primal Caos Void.’ Xue Ying thought. As his soul regained the Cosmos God level strength, it significantly strengthened the connection he had with the avatar located in the Realm Heart Great Land, allowing them to exchange memories.
‘Even though it might seem like a long time, in reality, it took just 120,000 years for me to be sent back to the Primal Caos Void from the Realm Heart Great Land.’ Xue Ying thought.
120,000 years.
Xue Ying had already pushed all nine branches in the Dao of Void to the Cosmos God Realm over at the Realm Heart Great Land. Primarily, after creating the ‘Nine Rotation Undying Technique’, he understood the profound mysteries from the nine branches operating together and the interaction from their fusion. Naturally, Xue Ying quickly broke through in one branch after another. It was smooth. Just 30,000 years after becoming a Cosmos God, all nine branches had been comprehended.
Currently, he could use the Five Phases Sealing Technique! Of course, it was at the ‘small success’ since he could not rely on the Five Phases Bead!
The ‘combat technique’ of the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll> could also be directly activated by him.
But cultivating the ‘Chaotic Origin Refinement Body’ required time. Given that small ‘hole’ which he could form by breaking the Origin World, absorbing that sliver of Chaotic Origin Energy would take him a long time just to succeed in refining his body.
“I shall first form avatars.”
That’s right.
Xue Ying’s avatars in the Realm Heart Great Land were connected in memories. That was when he discovered something joyous.
When he was sent out of the Realm Heart Great Land, his remaining eight avatars could refine a ninth avatar!
‘That’s right. It’s just like World Deities and True Gods within cosmos, they could refine avatars within the cosmos but could no longer do so outside of it.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘But some unique ancient cultivators could still refine them! Clearly, they have to first obtain permission from the ‘Supreme Law’.’
The avatar technique which his teacher, Southern Cloud King, created, was about absorbing Chaotic Origin Energy to allow the soul to transform qualitatively. After absorbing the Chaotic Origin Energy from a higher dimension, the cultivator could still maintain nine avatars despite being suppressed by the Supreme Law.
Currently, an avatar had been sent away.
And over at the Realm Heart Great Land, the region which the Supreme Law covered only counted eight avatars which Xue Ying had! Hence, Xue Ying could naturally refine another.
‘It’s the same logic. When this avatar returned back home, under the Supreme Law of the Primal Caos Void, I only have a single body. I can always refine more avatars.’ Xue Ying thought.
Xue Ying immediately blasted his fist out. This technique was much more exquisite than the Arch Destruction technique, which he displayed in the past. It was a combat technique from the Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll. A single fist vaguely intersected eight spatial passages. At the intersection of the passages, an extremely tiny black hole was formed-about the size of a grain of rice. Mysterious energy surged out from that hole.
Over at the other side of this black hole was the more horrifying higher dimension.
This mysterious energy was also the Chaotic Origin Energy.
“It is here.”
Xue Ying began absorbing this Chaotic Origin Energy to cultivate the avatar technique.
…
After a while, a white-robed Xue Ying and a golden-robed Xue Ying stood in the vast void.
‘What a pity. I can only form two avatars.’ Xue Ying shook his head inwardly, ‘I could only break apart a small hole in the cage. The mysterious energy which I can absorb is far from enough, allowing me to only grasp the first level of the <Avatar Technique>.’
The first level allowed the cultivator to form two avatars.
The second level-nine avatars.
The highest level and grand perfection-10,081 avatars.
The cultivation technique created by Southern Cloud King hinged upon absorbing the ‘Chaotic Origin Energy’ to transform the soul! Once the degree of transformation reached its limit, the cultivator could maintain more than 10,000 avatars at every one time.
‘The avatar technique created by Southern Cloud King is inferior to that of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master and Myriad Realms Tavern Master’s lineage.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
It was hard to train in the avatar technique created by his teacher.
He had to break apart the cage before one could grasp it! And destroying the cage of the world required a tenth level power-that was power a Cosmos God had. That ‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master’ definitely did not have this power! Nevertheless, he could have two avatars.
As for ‘Myriad Realms Tavern Master’, he once assassinated Xue Ying. Even though the other party had ordinary Cosmos God strength, he could maintain more than 10,000 avatars. According to the cultivation technique created by Southern Cloud King, only a second level Cosmos God could achieve that.
Hence, from the effects of cultivation.
That lineage of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master and Myriad Realms Tavern Master was at least more outstanding in its avatar technique holistically than what Southern Cloud King created.
Currently, he was a first-level Cosmos God. Furthermore, he pushed all nine branches of the Dao of the Void to the Cosmos God Realm. If this were the lineage of Myriad Realms Tavern Master, Xue Ying would have cultivated more than 10,000 avatars already.
I wonder who created that lineage which Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master and Myriad Realms Tavern Master had.’ Xue Ying thought. In the past, he conjectured Myriad Realms Tavern Master as the person who created it. But now? Xue Ying dared not think of it that way. Such a heaven-defying cultivation technique should have been created by a third level Cosmos God in the Dao of Void, an existence on the level of Ancestor Fan.
Dao of Void
‘Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.’
Xue Ying’s heart was filled with killing intent.
It was fine for the lineage of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master to assassinate him. But he even chose to rely on Sacred Master to kill Xue Ying!
But to this, Xue Ying did not know that Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master had been killed by Old Monster Stone.
‘Sacred Master could not find the avatar of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master in the past, so it is unlikely for him to find mine. Furthermore, the moment I succeeded in grasping the Chaotic Origin Refinement Body, my body would have part of the distinctive property Chaotic Origin has, making it even harder to find me.’ Xue Ying thought. His soul had transformed after absorbing the Chaotic Origin Energy, rendering a majority of tracing methods useless. Furthermore, he had the more heaven-defying <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll>.
Chaotic Origin Refinement Body… it took too much time, and Xue Ying did not have the patience to cultivate in it temporarily.
‘This avatar of mine will stay here at the Bright Star Planet to cultivate.’ Xue Ying turned to the golden-robed Xue Ying, ‘Even if my true body dies in battle, this avatar could easily refine another. Furthermore, I can also return the gratitude of my birth parents in this life.’
“Sou.”
The golden-robed Xue Ying rapidly disappeared. He went back to the Bright Star Planet.
“It is time for me to go home and have a look.”
Taking a step, Xue Ying disappeared.
…
Primal Caos Void.
Xue Ying appeared from nothingness. His eyes were filled with expectations and longing. It was hard for him to suppress his feelings with his current heart realm.
He was finally back.
In the past, Xue Ying was forced to reincarnate into the Realm Heart Great Land, but now, he was back!
“Mn?”
Looking forward in a daze, currently, Xue Ying had reached the pinnacle in all nine branches of the Dao of Void. Displaying the Chaotic Origin combat technique, Xue Ying could teleport through a further distance, covering more than half the Primal Caos Void with one teleportation. It was impossible for him to teleport to the wrong ‘Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World’ since that was a great sacred world.
‘Where is the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World? It, how did it disappear?’ Looking at the piece of empty Primal Caos Void, Xue Ying could not help but feel a trace of chill down his heart.
This empty void in front of his eyes…
Was where the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World had been. But now, nothing was there!

chapters.title: Chapter 1103 - Investigation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1103: Investigation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying stood in the vast Primal Chaos Void. His heart felt icy-cold; his expression turned pale.
Various thoughts appeared in his mind.
Worry, unease, terror…
“No.”
Xue Ying looked around him, ‘How could one of the five great sacred worlds, the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World disappear? Could it be that I deviated too far off from my destination during teleportation?’
“Hong-”
His senses relied on the void to expand out in all directions. It continued expanding endlessly, engulfing many cosmos and lands. Having pursued after the Destruction Devils for a trillion years, Xue Ying was too familiar with the various situations happening in the Primal Chaos Void. He knew after reincarnating in the Bright Star Planet that the world he was on was ‘Bright Star Planet’ after engulfing the place with his senses.
Because he had been there before in the past!
Similarly, Xue Ying was extremely familiar with the surrounding of Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World too.
‘I am not mistaken. The cosmos around this place shows that this should be where the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World is, but how come it is no longer here?’ Even if Xue Ying was a Cosmos God, he could hardly conceal his anxiety. The Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World was where too many of his loved ones stayed at-his wife, his children, many good friends of his, those from the same sect, the Great Void Heaven Temple…
‘It has only been close to 10 billion years, yet what exactly had happened?’ Xue Ying suppressed his unease. With a ‘sou’, he silently disappeared from the vicinity.
******
“Hu.”
When he appeared again, Xue Ying was located in the vast void just outside one of the original five great sacred worlds, ‘Eastern Unicorn Sacred World’.
‘It is here.’ Xue Ying saw the vast sacred world ahead of him, letting out a breath of relief. Fortunately, the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World remained fine.
According to logic.
Xue Ying spent close to 10 billion years in the Realm Heart Great Land, and this short period was considered short to most cultivators! The Primal Chaos Void should not have too many changes during this ‘short period’, yet the ‘Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World’ disappeared, bringing panic to Xue Ying. He was afraid that even Eastern Unicorn Sacred World was no longer there.
‘The foundation of Eastern Unicorn Sacred World is deeper. There is Blade Emperor, Void Primogenitor and others here. There is also that mysterious and unfathomable Luo City Lord.’ Xue Ying thought.
Luo City Lord was clearly a Primal Chaos expert.
Yet he could easily suppress existences like Void Primogenitor. From Xue Ying’s perspective, even if Ancestor Fan and the others utilized the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to come here, they would still be suppressed to the Primal Chaos Realm and could not be that strong either. It did not seem logical for Luo City Lord to be so powerful.
‘Is Luo City Lord an outsider?’ Xue Ying thought, ‘And merely an avatar came here? An avatar that has been suppressed to the Primal Chaos Realm yet he is still so strong. It is highly possible that his true body is frighteningly strong-beyond that of Ancestor Fan and the others! If he could completely display his full strength, he should be able to eradicate Sacred Master easily. What a pity that he is an outsider, and could barely unleash power equivalent to a second level Cosmos God, and is far weaker than Blade Emperor, Ancestor Sorcerer, and the others.’
Taking a step, Xue Ying entered the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. He casually chose a huge city.
The city remained bustling with activity from many cultivators.
There were businesses at the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World that specialized in trades, with the biggest behemoth being the ‘Seven Star Oceanic Pavilion’. Similarly, its counterpart in the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World was the ‘Eastern Unicorn Palace’.
‘Eastern Unicorn Palace.’ Xue Ying arrived at one of the branches of Eastern Unicorn Palace in this great city. He looked up at the towering structure ahead.
“Welcome, sir to the Eastern Unicorn Palace. Our Eastern Unicorn Palace has practically everything.” A beautiful True God female servant welcomed him.
Xue Ying had easily concealed his aura using the Nine Rotation Undying Technique and even disguised himself as a cold and murderous cultivator. He even wore a silver mask over his face. Currently, he merely hid his aura as a Unity Realm expert. If a mysterious Cosmos God came? The palace master of this branch of Eastern Unicorn Palace would be afraid, even Blade Emperor and the others would be alarmed from his visit!
Very soon, he was guided over to an elegant hall. Good food and wine were served, and he even had a female attendant accompanying him.
Unity Realm… that was considered sufficiently powerful in a great city.
“I’ve been in closed-door cultivation for tens of billions of years.” Xue Ying said, “After coming out, I’ve heard that the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World disappeared?”
“Yes, that was a great battle.” The female attendant smiled.
“Great battle?” Xue Ying felt puzzled.
“According to rumors, it was related to the Sacred Master. I am not that clear as to the details of what exactly happened.” The female attendant replied. Even if she did, she would not say too much. She could undoubtedly talk about ordinary news that spread across the world, but information that was slightly more ‘precious’ had to be bought!
Xue Ying felt his heart turning paralyzed momentarily.
Sacred Master?
That was within his expectations. Forefather Tian Yu and the others would not be so bored to destroy their own sacred world. He reckoned only ‘Sacred Master’ dared to do such a thing.
“I want to understand relevant detailed information regarding the disappearance of the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World and other matters which happened in the recent tens of billions of years.” Xue Ying said.
“How detailed?” The female attendant asked.
“The more detailed, the better.” Xue Ying said.
The female attendant softly nodded. She muttered to herself, irresolutely. It was clear that she was talking to the higher-ups.
“This piece of information involves many matters. It requires one piece of Origin World Rock.” The female attendant said.
“I have some ‘Three-Colored Golden String Rock’ with me.”
Xue Ying waved his hand. Many three-colored half-translucent rocks appeared. There were even golden strands swimming within the rocks. A total of 18 pieces of rocks appeared, “Is it possible for me to use this in exchange for a piece of Origin World Rock?” This had been directly formed from his own Mirage Cosmos. Materials which he took out from his own Mirage Cosmos had to be first fully understood by him.
Like the ‘Five Phases Bead’ and other powerful secret treasures, or even mysterious materials were items that Xue Ying could not create unless he actually went to research them.
Given his current Realm, some of the less precious materials could be dissected, and Xue Ying could consume slight energy to produce them from nothingness. If he were willing, being the only Cosmos God in this Primal Chaos Void that grasped a ‘Mirage Cosmos’, Xue Ying would absolutely be ranked in the first few in terms of wealth! Nevertheless, the truly precious secret treasures and materials could not be exchanged using ordinary materials.
“You can.” The female attendant nodded.
…
Very soon.
A set of information was sent to Xue Ying.
After receiving the violet scroll from the female attendant, Xue Ying opened it up. Many words started appearing on the scroll, and an even greater amount of information started surging into the mind of Xue Ying.
Sacred Master captured the Mirage Palace Master of the Great Void Heaven Temple, ‘Xue Ying’. Xue Ying had fallen in the Ancient Sacred World.
Just 30 million years after the death of Xue Ying, Sacred Master actually quietly infiltrated into the Great Void Heaven Temple. He then assassinated and slaughtered its cultivators.
A great battle abruptly started!
Ancestor Sorcerer, World Ancestor, and others participated in it too.
It seemed Sacred Master was insane during this great battle. Eventually, it caused the entire Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World to collapse. The Great Void Heaven Temple, Primogenitor Island, and Jade Light Sacred Territory only had enough time to teleport away civilians from some of their bigger cities. Countless civilians in other bigger regions of the sacred world had been exterminated during this battle that led to the destruction of the sacred world.
…
Xue Ying’s expression turned ashen-green. Practically almost all living beings on the sacred world had been exterminated?
The information recorded was very detailed. It even recorded how Sacred Master had rapidly captured part of the disciples from the Great Void Heaven Temple at the same time when he assaulted the Great Void Heaven Temple.
‘Weird.’
‘Why did the Sacred Master infiltrate the Great Void Heaven Temple? Given his personality, he did not kill everyone, but instead, captured several disciples from the Great Void Heaven Temple?’ Xue Ying frowned inwardly.
It seemed that the Primogenitor Island and Jade Light Sacred Territory were fishes in the pond that had been pulled into the great battle that led to the destruction of the Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World.
‘Assassinated the Great Void Heaven Temple? Was it related to the Swordmaster or me?’ Xue Ying thought.
That time when Swordmaster broke through, he angered Sacred Master so much so that the other party rushed his way over.
‘The Sacred Master is insane? So mad that he destroyed the entire Seven Star Oceanic Sacred World?’ Xue Ying was a Cosmos God too and understood how easy it was to harm a sacred world. But to completely destroy it with hindrances from Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor wasn’t easy. Nevertheless, Sacred Master still continued doing so. He was most likely infuriated to the point of no return.
‘There is also Jing Qiu, Yu’er, Qing Yao and many other sect mates from the Great Void Heaven Temple.’ Xue Ying wanted to seek information related to his wife and children and many of his loved ones, but these were not appropriate to be bought yet!
Xue Ying temporarily did not want to reveal his identity!
After all, he had experienced a reincarnation from the Realm Heart Great Land before coming back. Even though his current true body had a soul constructed from his original true spirit, there were still qualitative differences in the aura of his soul! Furthermore, he cultivated the Nine Rotation Undying Technique, and it made it easy for him to disguise his aura! Even ‘Sacred Master’ felt that Xue Ying had died. Hence, all the more Xue Ying should conceal his identity.
The enemy was in the light, and Xue Ying was in the dark. This would have better effects!
Naturally, some people were worth trusting like ‘Forefather Tian Yu’ or ‘Void Primogenitor’. It was only because his soul had been dissipated in the past. A strand of true spirit was sent into the Realm Heart Great Land. This was something that involved the Realm Heart Order and reincarnation. It wasn’t an easy task to convince the other Cosmos Gods like Void Primogenitor that he was Xue Ying.
‘I shall temporarily stay in the dark. Currently, I am not strong enough. I haven’t even grasped the first level of the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll>. Mn, I should first understand the situation of Jing Qiu and the others. I hope they are still fine.’ According to the intelligence, the majority of cultivators from the Great Void Heaven Temple had been teleported away by Swordmaster and Forefather Tian Yu into the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. Xue Ying hoped his wife and children were here too.
Xue Ying then casually left this Eastern Unicorn Palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 1104 - I am Dong Bo Xue Ying
chapters.content:
Chapter 1104: I am Dong Bo Xue Ying
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Teleporting over to the Great Void Heaven Temple inside the ‘Eastern Unicorn Sacred World’, the Great Void Palace Hall remained bright and resplendent, lighting up the entire space within.
Within the Celestial Water Hall on the huge floating land.
“What a joke, truly a joke.”
“We are a holy ground. It is fine for experts to die or get injured, but we can’t even protect the wife of Brother Dong Bo. How humiliating this is…” Celestial Water Hall Master sat alone in his dark blue robe within a courtyard. As he drank, one could see the pain and frustration he had on his expression.
There female attendants looking from outside the courtyard doors. They dared not enter.
Ever since the Great Void Heaven Temple experienced a catastrophic change, Celestial Water Hall Master became decadent. Even his disciples did not dare to come to talk to him.
“Struggle? Why bother?” Celestial Water Hall Master mumbled. Those disciples were still filled with fighting spirit. But the more they knew, the more despondent they became. Celestial Water Hall Master did not even have an ounce of confidence left, “Facing the Sacred Master, the Cosmos Gods from our side have tried so hard only to remain in a defensive position. We can’t threaten him at all. There is Sacred Master from within, and Destruction Devils from beyond… Furthermore, the Primal Chaos Void is expanding continuously. It’ll eventually enter a Great Apocalypse. Haha, it’s fine too. Brother Dong Bo, Brother Leading Wing, the few of you had departed first. Very soon, the rest of us will follow.”
Celestial Water Hall Master felt miserable and guilty at the same time.
Towards ‘Xue Ying’ of the past, Celestial Water Hall Master had personally watched as he grew up step by step. The Primal Chaos City where Xue Ying was stationed at, had been the Celestial Water City.
That genius brimming with talent…
He was absolutely outstanding and dazzling!
Xue Ying cultivated for a very short period, yet he chose to spend a trillion years pursuing after the Destruction Devils, even discovering several golden-armored lairs during this period. Xue Ying had contributed so much that dumbstruck the Cosmos Gods! In the end, even though Xue Ying was captured alive by the Sacred Master, he chose to die than to leak out the <Destructive Realm Teleportation technique>.
With such significant contributions and such talent, in the end, Xue Ying fell prematurely. Nevertheless, the Great Void Heaven Temple could not even protect his wife.
“Sacred Master, Sacred Master.” Celestial Water Hall Master mumbled to himself.
He was unquestionably the strongest expert in the Primal Chaos Void, yet that person did not care about conducting such shameless act.
“The gap in power is too big. We can’t threaten him at all.” Celestial Water Hall Master leaned forward on the table. He was drunk in self-pity.
Gradually.
His consciousness became blurred.
“Not good-”
Celestial Water Hall Master immediately felt that things were amiss. Following that, he lost his consciousness entirely and had seemingly fallen asleep on the table.
The female attendants saw the whole thing from outside, yet they were not aware that the Celestial Water Hall Master had fallen into an illusion.
******
There were many desolate grounds in the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. Currently, a huge swathe of land had been given to the Great Void Heaven Temple to control. They also constructed eight Primal Chaos Cities. In one of them, the ‘Celestial Water City’.
Celestial Water City, within the City Master Residence.
The incarnation of Celestial Water Hall Master that was sleeping deeply in the underground meditation room abruptly stood up and left the residence. Following that, he took a step and ‘teleported’ over to a restaurant.
Inside a private room of that restaurant.
The incarnation of Celestial Water Hall Master pushed open the door and entered. There was a masked white-robed young man seated inside.
“Brother Celestial Water.” Xue Ying looked at the incarnation of Celestial Water Hall Master. He waved his hand.
“Hua!”
Five Phases Sealing Technique! This private room was isolated entirely from the outer world. Nobody from outside could find this private room anymore.
The eyes of Celestial Water Hall Master’s incarnation remained calm. In reality, he had utterly fallen control to Xue Ying. Even his ‘teleportation’ had been done by Xue Ying to bring him over.
‘His true body should be unconscious too. Forefather Tian Yu and the rest should have discovered that.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘But it isn’t anything much since they can’t discover this location at all and will not disturb me. As for what happens after the whole affair? It’s fine even if Forefather Tian Yu knows about it!’
There were not many Cosmos Gods whom he trusted. Forefather Tian Yu was one of them.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying looked at the incarnation of Celestial Water Hall Master. He began: “I apologize for doing this.”
The incarnation of Celestial Water Hall Master sat down silently.
“Do you hate Sacred Master?” Xue Ying asked.
Celestial Water Hall Master was ultimately an eighth level expert. He was of the Laws Lineage, and his soul and willpower were both extraordinary. Xue Ying did not own any secret treasures either. He was able to easily control Celestial Water Hall Master purely because his Mirage and Illusory Realm had reached the Cosmos God Realm. Nevertheless, he could still not look through the memories of the Celestial Water Hall Master! And could only guide the other party towards revealing the secrets.
Furthermore, Celestial Water Hall Master would find out everything once Xue Ying stopped using his secret technique and left.
“Of course! I hate him so much that I wish he could die!” The expression of Celestial Water Hall Master turned savage. It seemed he had seen something that frustrated him so much as he gritted his teeth.
According to the illusory realm which Xue Ying displayed, he could ascertain that Celestial Water Hall Master was absolutely not a traitor.
“That time when the Sacred Master sneaked an attack on the Great Void Heaven Temple, how are the losses of the Great Void Heaven Temple?” This was what Xue Ying had been the most concern of. At the same time, he began guiding the inner heart of Celestial Water Hall Master within the Mirage and Illusory Realm that the other party had fallen into, causing many scenes of that battle to appear.
“It was too sudden! That time, Sacred Master captured a group of disciples from the Great Void Heaven Temple alive, of which there were four Hall Masters!” Celestial Water Hall Master said.
Xue Ying’s expression shifted the moment he heard that.
Captured four Hall Masters alive?
Excluding him, the Great Void Heaven Temple only had 12 Hall Masters!
“Are these four Hall Masters still alive?” Xue Ying asked.
That time, Sacred Master forced Forefather and the others to hand over the supposed ‘Destructive Realm Teleportation technique’. Forefather and Swordmaster did not hand it over.” Celestial Water Hall Master replied, “At that time, Sacred Master chose to kill the other disciples he captured alive. Of the four Hall Masters, ‘Leading Wing Hall Master’ and ‘Ancestor Devil’ were killed.”
Xue Ying felt his heart twitching.
Brother Leading Wing? Ancestor Devil?
That time of the 12 Hall Masters, Primal Chaos Hall Master was the leader. There were also Inquisitive Sky Hall Master and the rest. They were all people Xue Ying was familiar with-they could be called his Dao Brothers. As Ancestor Devil came from the same cosmos as he did, Xue Ying had a more unique relationship with him.
But he died?
He died just like that?
“And? How else are the losses of Great Void Heaven Temple?” Xue Ying asked.
“During that battle, other than the death of some of the captured disciples, more than 30% of the core disciples from the Great Void Heaven Temple died.” Celestial Water Hall Master gritted his teeth, “The Sacred Master did it deliberately. He chose to involve the disciples of my Great Void Heaven Temple. Even though Forefather and Swordmaster tried their best to protect, too many died in the end. What infuriated me the most was that for the sake of the supposed Destructive Realm Teleportation technique, he still captured the wife of Brother Dong Bo, ‘Yu Jing Qiu’ alive.”
Xue Ying’s expression turned pale.
He was the most afraid, most afraid…
What he was most worried about had happened!
“Where is Dong Bo Yu and Dong Bo Qing Yao? And what about other disciples of Dong Bo Xue Ying?” Xue Ying continued asking.
“Brother Dong Bo has contributed greatly to our side. After his death, Swordmaster accepted Dong Bo Qing Yao as his disciple. Ancestor Sorcerer also accepted Dong Bo Yu as his disciple. Hence, the children of Brother Dong Bo are still fine. His disciple, Xing Huo Xun Yi did not die during that great battle too. Jade Light Master initially wanted to accept Yu Jing Qiu as her disciple, yet Yu Jing Qiu wasn’t willing to. She remained in the cavern-dwelling which belonged to Brother Dong Bo, staying there unwilling to leave. Hence, the first person Sacred Master captured alive in the past was Yu Jing Qiu.” Celestial Water Hall Master said.
‘She wasn’t willing to go to other places, wasn’t willing to…’
Xue Ying felt his heart racing.
Others did not know, but he knew and had promised before that he would be back in the future! Xue Ying had the ‘Realm Heart Order’, and would definitely return to find his wife! Hence, Jing Qiu stayed there forever, waiting for him to return.
“How is Yu Jing Qiu now?” Xue Ying asked.
“Of the group of disciples Sacred Master captured alive, only she, Myriad Elephant and two other hall masters are alive.” Celestial Water Hall Master said, “Sacred Master locked the few of them in the Ancient Sacred World, torturing and punishing them constantly to force my Great Void Heaven Temple to hand over the ‘Destructive Realm Teleportation technique’. My Great Void Heaven Temple has yet to hand the technique over, so they remained suffering all these while. Fortunately, Brother Dong Bo did not tell his wife about the <Destructive Realm Teleportation technique> in the past. Otherwise, his wife and Brother Myriad Elephant would have died then.”
Xue Ying felt anguished and furious at the same time.
Destructive Realm Teleportation technique…
Sacred Master desired it so much? He once acted against Xue Ying, and now, even moved against the whole Great Void Heaven Temple!
‘Yu Jing Qiu and the others are still suffering currently. ‘Xue Ying understood. Forefather Tian Yu and the others would rather die than to let Sacred Master acquire the technique! After all, the various powers were afraid of one thing-if Sacred Master relied on the ‘Destructive Realm Teleportation technique’ to deduce the Avatar Technique, the whole situation would become even more dreadful.
…
Xue Ying continued asking more questions. He relied on the Mirage and Illusory Realm to produce scenes to find out more about the matter.
“Brother Celestial Water, please pardon me this time for doing this to you.” Xue Ying turned to the incarnation of Celestial Water Hall Master. He easily pried apart the mask on his face, revealing his real appearance, “I am Dong Bo Xue Ying! I do not wish to publicize my identity for now. But you can tell Forefather Tian Yu. He should understand.”
Saying that.
Xue Ying released the Five Phases Sealing Technique and disappeared from the place.
The incarnation of Celestial Water Hall Master trembled. Following that, he regained consciousness.
“I, I suffered from an illusory realm?” The incarnation of Celestial Water Hall Master turned pale.
But following that, everything he experienced previously in the illusory realm returned. In the end, he saw with his naked eyes as the white-robed young man pried apart his mask, stunning Celestial Water Hall Master.
“Brother Dong Bo? He, how is he still alive?” Celestial Water Hall Master fell into a daze.

chapters.title: Chapter 1105 - Xue Ying is back?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1105: Xue Ying is back?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Sou.”
Xue Ying left Eastern Unicorn Sacred World almost instantaneously. He arrived in the boundless Primal Chaos Void. At this moment, the murderous aura which his body released became denser. There were bubbling fury and anxiety which could not be suppressed any longer in his heart.
In the war with Sacred Master, Xue Ying was prepared for many to die! After all, in the ‘Primitive Ancient Sacred World’ and subsequent large-scale wars, the number of deaths and injuries were extreme. Furthermore, each and every one of them was started by Sacred Master! His Ancient Sacred Religion forced countless cultivators to become absolutely loyal to him soul-wise. With an order, those believers of Ancient Sacred Religion could disregard their lives.
‘For the sake of himself, he could cause the entire Primitive Ancient Sacred World to shatter. He could slaughter the entire Sacred World… he did not care even if more died! He is extremely selfish.’ Xue Ying understood that. For the sake of his own ‘Dao path’, Sacred Master would not hesitate even if he had to sacrifice all creatures living in the Primal Chaos Void.
‘Currently, he desires the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique very much.’
‘Hence, he did not kill Jing Qiu and the rest. He harbors some hope. I only have a single chance if I want to save them.’ Xue Ying was clear how difficult it was to save someone.
That was the Ancient Sacred World!
With the ‘Ancient Sacred Incarnation’ protecting it, nobody currently dared to fight with Sacred Master. (Xue Ying did not know that Old Monster Stone had once fought against Sacred Master)
