“Could you display the Destruction Flower?” Forefather Tian Yu still asked to confirm his identity. All of them turned to Xue Ying.
With a chuckle, Xue Ying extended his hand. An illusory realm immediately began condensing a nine-petaled flower. The nine-petaled flower descended and became real from its void-ified state. This encompassed profound mysteries from the Dao of Void and Dao of Slaughter at the ninth level. It appeared once again.
Seeing this nine-petaled flower appearing, everyone chuckled.
Actually, inferring from various clues they gathered previously, they were more than 90% confident. And now, creating a ninth level technique was originally tricky, and this ‘Nine-petaled Flower’ had been the culmination of fusion from the Dao of Void and Dao of Slaughter. Other than Xue Ying, the creator, nobody had learned it!
“Xue Ying, you really came back.” Forefather Tian Yu revealed a grin.
“That’s great!” Blade Emperor sighed, “Even though I’ve heard that the Realm Heart Order is mysterious, I still don’t believe it that you could come back after your soul dissipated previously.”
“How mysterious is the Realm Heart Order?” Ancestor Sorcerer could not help but ask, “I am not puzzled that you could break through to the Cosmos God Realm. But now, the few of us know that you could execute techniques like spatial isolation, the pinnacle of void-ification, avatar technique, and many others. Furthermore, you have such a powerful fleshy body. Did you become a body cultivator too?”
Xue Ying explained: “The Realm Heart Order is mysterious. It enabled me to send a strand of my true spirit to another Origin World. Furthermore, I have the chance to return home.”
“Another Origin World?”
“Oh?”
Ancestor Sorcerer and others who were present sighed ruefully.
“I’ve learned several cultivation techniques there.” Xue Ying said, “But it’s a pity that many cultivation techniques from the Realm Heart Great Land are limited. Learning it is already difficult, but I am forbidden from teaching to others! But still, I have an avatar left behind in the Realm Heart Great Land still. In the future, if I were to learn a technique that could be taught to others, I’ll naturally impart them to everyone.”
The Primal Chaos Void was currently facing the danger of a Great Apocalypse.
If he could do so, Xue Ying would definitely impart the techniques to Swordmaster, Ancestor Sorcerer, Blade Emperor, and others.
‘What a pity that the Realm Heart Order depends solely on fate. If I am not fated, even if the Realm Heart Order is placed in front of me, I wouldn’t be able to see it.’ Blade Emperor sighed. He understood this from his teacher, Luo City Lord.
…
In a cavern-dwelling, within a meditation room deep underneath it.
Dong Bo Yu was currently seated cross-legged here. There was an enormous and complex array floating before him. The array was continuously changing and evolving.
His father Xue Ying had been killed by the Sacred Master. His mother had been imprisoned in the Ancient Sacred World. This gave birth to an intense desire within Dong Bo Yu to cultivate. Even though Ancestor Sorcerer tried his best to help him, Dong Bo Yu was still a Unity Realm expert currently. He was still very far away from the fifth level Unity Realm. Save his mother? Revenge? Even his teacher Ancestor Sorcerer and others had no confidence in doing so.
Even though he was bitterly cultivating, Dong Bo Yu felt despair and panicking deep in his heart.
‘I am the son of Dong Bo Xue Ying.’
‘I must not disgrace my father. In the past, my father did not have such optimal cultivation conditions as I did. If he were still alive, it would not be difficult for him to become a Cosmos God. I can do it too! I must, and will do it.’ Dong Bo Yu had an intense desire, but in reality, his teacher Ancestor Sorcerer shook his head inwardly to it since Dong Bo Yu had not even reached the third level of Heart Realm. Hence, chances of him breaking through to the Primal Chaos Realm were low.
Suddenly—
“Yu’er, come to the Blade Emperor City.” Ancestor Sorcerer’s voice sounded in the mind of Dong Bo Yu.
“Yes.”
Dong Bo Yu stopped cultivating.
“Go to the Blade Emperor City?” Dong Bo Yu came out from closed-door cultivation bewildered. Ancestor Sorcerer had arranged his subordinate to send Dong Bo Yu through ultra-long distance teleportation.
After a moment.
“Sister?”
“Younger Brother?”
Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao met outside the ‘Azure Lake Palace’ within the Blade Emperor City. The Azure Lake Palace was one of the few places where Blade Emperor City opened to meet his good friends.
The palace doors opened.
“Please enter, the two of you.” There was an attendant which guided them in.
“My teacher asked me over.” Qing Yao mentioned, “What about you, little brother?”
“It’s the same for me too.” Dong Bo Yu felt puzzled.
“That’s weird. I wonder if there is something which they can’t tell us directly. Instead, they ask us to come over to the Blade Emperor City?” Qing Yao and his little brother exchanged voice transmissions. Under the guidance by the attendant, they entered the palace. They continued advancing forward until they finally arrived before a lake.
By the side of the lake, there was a table. The Cosmos Gods were seated around it.
Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor were present, Devil Mountain Primogenitor, Great Emperor Cloud Serpent, Jade Light Master, and others… amidst the group of Cosmos Gods, there was a white-robed young man and a girl in light blue gown seated as if they were immortal companions. Xue Ying was currently chatting with the other Cosmos Gods happily. He would occasionally speak with Jing Qiu by his side. As for Jing Qiu, she was listening with a smile.
Suddenly, Xue Ying and Jing Qiu both turned over. They saw the two people that were brought over by the attendant.
Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao fell in a daze as they saw the white-robed male and light-blue-gowned woman.
“Father.”
“Mother.”
Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao could not help but stop. Their eyes started turning red as they watched with disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 1112 - Old Monster Stone shows himself
chapters.content:
Chapter 1112: Old Monster Stone shows himself
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Qing Yao and his brother were finally reunited with their parents. The Cosmos Gods were delighted too-they were happy for the addition of a ‘great general’ on their side! After all, Xue Ying dared to enter the Ancient Sacred World alone.
Even though Xue Ying was currently at the bottom of level-two Cosmos Gods and was comparable to Luo City Lord—he still lacked in some ways when compared to Devil Mountain Primogenitor and Jade Light Master, he stood at the most apex in terms of ‘stealth’, ‘survivability’, and ‘soul’ aspects. Nonetheless, the group of Cosmos Gods felt a boost in their confidence in fighting against the Sacred Master.
“The matter about Xue Ying becoming a Cosmos God should be kept a secret temporarily.” Ancestor Sorcerer chuckled, “Otherwise, Sacred Master would guess what had happened when someone that had his soul dissipated appeared perfectly fine.”
“It is good to keep it a secret.”
Everyone agreed.
After all, Xue Ying was involved with another Origin World, the ‘Realm Heart Great Land’. Should Sacred Master find out about this, he would become even madder with greed.
Xue Ying agreed to it too. That way, he would have lesser trouble.
******
Within the Primal Chaos Void.
Amidst a humongous ocean of fire, there was a huge fire star. This great fire star was none other than the ‘Primitive Sun Star’.
“Teacher, teacher.”
The incarnation of World Ancestor stood in the void while maintaining a distance to that Primitive Sun Star. If this incarnation were to go over, it would likely be burned to ashes.
“Teacher!” The incarnation of World Ancestor transmitted a message over.
“Who is it?”
The Primitive Sun Star was immensely huge. But at this moment, an incomparably large black shadow appeared on the surface of the Primitive Sun Star. It occupied approximately one-third of the entire Primitive Sun Star. This enormous shadow opened its eyes with slight displease. Its dark yellow eyes glared at the thin and small incarnation of World Ancestor who stood at a distance.
“It’s you, Little Devil?” The voice of that incomparably huge black shadow boomed, “What’s the matter, say.”
Some slight displease could be heard in his voice.
He hated being disturbed while sleeping! As for his disciples? Even though Old Monster Stone had some affection for them, it wasn’t deep because he knew that those disciples would be extinguished when this era ended, and the Primal Chaos Void underwent a Great Apocalypse before rebirthing to a new era. Even though he looked forward to a disciple breaking through to the final realm of the Cosmos God, it’s a pity…
He had survived through many eras, and there were quite a few disciples that reached the level-two Cosmos God Realm. Nevertheless, none had ever reached the final Cosmos God Realm.
“Teacher.” The incarnation of World Ancestor knew that ‘disturbing his teacher while his teacher was slumbering’ would cause the other party to be unhappy. But he came only after ascertaining the identity of Xue Ying, “Dong Bo Xue Ying hasn’t died. He is still alive.”
“Dong Bo Xue Ying…” Old Monster Stone who had just awoken, was slightly muddle-headed. Following that, he shook himself awake.
“Hua.”
That incomparably huge eyes immediately transformed, turning into a thin and small old man. He was thinner than World Ancestor-so thin that he looked like a bag of bones.
Hunchbacked with a clutch, Old Monster Stone said: “You said that young fellow hasn’t died? But that time, I’ve scoured through the whole Primal Chaos Void, only to find out that there existed no true spirit of his. Unless he had gotten the Realm Heart Order and went to the Realm Heart Great Land?”
“Teacher, you know about it?” World Ancestor said with a shock. He immediately nodded, “That’s right. Dong Bo Xue Ying mentioned that he relied on the Realm Heart Order to reincarnate over into the Realm Heart Great Land.”
“Haha…”
Old Monster Stone’s laughter boomed like thunder. It caused the sea of fire within the Primitive Sun Star to tremble.
“Who would have thought that he would be so lucky. Where is he now?” Old Monster Stone asked. He was too lazy to check through the entire Primal Chaos Void. He had also reckoned that the aura of Xue Ying would have transformed after reincarnating over.
“Over at the Blade Emperor City.” The incarnation of World Ancestor said.
“Let us go and have a look.” The current mood of Old Monster Stone became relatively good. After all, he had been heavily injured because of Xue Ying. Currently, knowing that the other party was still alive, he felt as if a miracle had happened.
Old Monster Stone took a step before disappearing from the place.
…
When he appeared again, Old Monster Stone had arrived at the Blade Emperor City. The Blade Emperor City was relatively smaller, so Old Monster Stone had easily discovered those Cosmos Gods almost instantaneously.
Blade Emperor City, inside the Azure Lake Palace.
A figure suddenly condensed above the lake. He was Old Monster Stone.
“Mn?” Blade Emperor, Ancestor Sorcerer, World Ancestor, Swordmaster, Jade Light Master, Devil Mountain Primogenitor, Xue Ying, and others were all greatly alarmed. This was the place where Blade Emperor lived in; it had strict security, and nobody could teleport in. Even Sacred Master should not appear directly too.
“Haha, the Ancient Sacred World is also a place where I can enter anytime and leave whenever I want to.” Old Monster Stone held onto his clutch as he walked on the void over.
Ancestor Sorcerer and Blade Emperor both felt a feeling of suppression.
“Senior Stone.” Xue Ying said with a startle. He had seen Old Monster Stone before, but that was when he was still at the Primal Chaos Realm, and he could not perceive how strong Old Monster Stone was.
“There is no need for everyone to be worried. This is my teacher.” Garbed in green, the thin and small World Ancestor stood with a smile.
“The teacher of World Ancestor?”
They were all astonished, though they understood it in a flash.
“Xue Ying, you recognize him?” Forefather Tian Yu transmitted. Swordmaster, Ancestor Sorcerer, Blade Emperor, and others were still solemnly watching. They could feel how frightening the aura emitted by Old Monster Stone was.
Xue Ying nodded.
Old Monster Stone looked at Xue Ying with a slight nod.
The other Cosmos Gods had already ascertained the identity of Xue Ying. Furthermore, that shout of ‘Senior Stone’ gave Old Monster Stone greater certainty that this brat was Xue Ying.
“What a pity, what a pity.” Old Monster Stone shook his head, “I originally wanted to take you in as a disciple, yet who would have thought that you left first for the Realm Heart Great Land. I originally am not good in the Mirage and Illusory Realm, and could merely give you some guidance. But at the Realm Heart Great Land, you could have pointers that are so much better than what I can give. It seems we aren’t fated to be teacher and student.”
Wanted to take me as his disciple? Xue Ying was stunned.
World Ancestor turned to Xue Ying and explained: “Younger Brother Dong Bo, the Vermillion Nightmare Inheritance had been created by my teacher. You could create the tenth transformation of the Vermillion Nightmare, which was why my teacher wanted to take you in as his disciple. Nevertheless, because of a variable after that, you went to the Realm Heart Great Land as a result.”
“Teacher.” World Ancestor smiled, “Don’t you know that Dong Bo hasn’t gone to the Realm Heart Great Land for a long time, yet his strength has greatly improved? This time, he infiltrated the Ancient Sacred World…”
World Ancestor explained briefly.
“Actually, it had been fortunate for me.” Xue Ying added, “I prepared carefully, yet the rumored Ancient Sacred Incarnation did not appear, making everything simple for me.”
“The Ancient Sacred Incarnation?” Old Monster Stone gave a weird chuckle, “Brat, that time after knowing that you died, making me lose the disciple which I wanted to take in, how could I let that Young Devil do as he wished? Hence, I killed my way over, starting a huge battle with him on the Ancient Sacred World! With my strength, that Young Devil could not threaten me if he did not use the Ancient Sacred Incarnation. Hence, he put in all his strength and fought with me. I had been injured, but that Ancient Sacred Incarnation belonging to that Young Devil had been fully consumed. In the end, I found out that the reason why you were captured by Sacred Master was related to Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master! Hence, I pinched to death that scheming Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master the next moment.”
Xue Ying had a look of enlightenment when he suddenly said with astonishment after hearing the last part: “Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master is dead?”
He initially wanted to take revenge.
But even now, he could not find where the avatar of Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master was.
“My path of cultivation is different from that of Sacred Master. I have reached the final realm of Cosmos God in the body cultivation lineage. From now on, I have to rely on myself to break apart the Origin World and step into the next level.” Old Monster Stone chuckled, “I seek after improving myself. Hence, my techniques are slightly more special. I can exist at every single location in the Primal Chaos Void, allowing me to easily scour through the whole place. The avatar of that Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master could hide, but as long as he is located in this Origin World, it would be impossible for him to conceal himself from me!”
Those present—Ancestor Sorcerer, Blade Emperor, and others felt startled.
This was the real senior.
Reaching the final realm of Cosmos God, he was about to progress to another level. Currently, his techniques had reached an unfathomable stage.
“Sacred Master, that Young Devil, had thought of all ways to control the Supreme Law.” Old Monster Stone said, “But it seems he has no hope in doing so within this era anymore.”
“Young Devil? Teacher knows that he is of the Destruction Devil Race?” World Ancestor asked.
“Has he showed his true self this time?” Old Monster Stone nodded after hearing that, “The Destruction Devils are born by the Primal Chaos Void to destroy. Only by becoming a Cosmos God could they escape from the influence of the desire to destroy. He had been amazing, reaching the final realm of Cosmos God using a Destruction Devil body. Reaching this step, he naturally desired to take that final step to wield the Supreme Law.”
“To him, there are fewer experts during the early period of an era, increasing the possibility of success for his schemes. The further it is, the more Cosmos Gods there would be emerging in an era! All of them would stand against him. And once it reaches a certain period, the chances of him succeeding would drop to rock bottom.” Old Monster Stone explained, “Of course, when he fought with me that time, the energy of his Ancient Sacred Incarnation had been fully consumed. Hence, there is practically no chance for him to succeed in this era, and he would most likely know about it too.”
“It is all thanks to you, senior.” Ancestor Sorcerer said, “Otherwise, we would have more battles.”
“Haha, he and I are in the same Origin World.” Old Monster Stone guffawed, “If I were to step into another level, I would be controlling this Origin World in the future. Even though the path he took is different from mine, he would similarly seek to control this Origin World. Given his disposition, I would be doomed if he were to do that. Hence, every time during the most crucial moment, I would act in the dark. For instance, that time when the Primitive Ancient Sacred World shattered in the past, I was the one that acted.”
“So it turns out to be because of this?”
All the Cosmos Gods present were startled.
Two cultivators that reached the final realm sought to take that last step. Hence, both did not wish to see the other party succeeding.
“Alright, feel rest assured. Sacred Master that Young Devil will not bounce about. The more experts you all have, and given the fact that he no longer has the Ancient Sacred Incarnation as his trump card, he would merely torment you all before the Great Apocalypse. I guess he should be scheming for the next era already.” Old Monster Stone sighed, “I’ll accompany the few of you young fellows for now. After a bit, I’ll go back to sleep, and would only wake up when it is time for the Great Apocalypse.”
“All of you should properly cultivate. Right now, the most important target isn’t to overtake Sacred Master but yourself.” Old Monster Stone turned to them.
“This Primal Chaos Void is just like a huge ship that is about to sink! Don’t think that it is still far from sinking. The later it is, the faster the speed of expansion, and the more Destruction Devils there would be. The day of ‘Great Apocalypse’ would arrive at a faster pace—it would happen so much quicker than what you expect.” Old Monster Stone explained, “All of you should still concentrate on cultivating. If you aren’t strong enough, when this ship capsizes, all of you should be prepared to die. I’m used to seeing the scene of everyone dying when an era ends.”
Everyone present trembled.
Great Apocalypse…
“Senior, how long do you think our Primal Chaos Void has before the Great Apocalypse arrives?” Ancestor Sorcerer asked.
Xue Ying and the others watched at Old Monster Stone nervously. Old Monster Stone should have the most experience in this.
“Mn.”
Old Monster Stone muttered to himself. At the same time, his consciousness swept across the entire Primal Chaos Void.

chapters.title: Chapter 1113 - A Strand of Fluctuation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1113: A Strand of Fluctuation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Before this, Xue Ying and the others treated Sacred Master as their nemesis. Only now did they understand that their nemesis should be ‘time’ instead. The moment the Great Apocalypse of the Primal Chaos Void arrived, all of them would be wiped out. Xue Ying could still survive as he had avatars in the ‘Realm Heart Great Land’. But in the future, if he were to return using the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’, Xue Ying would no longer be able to reincarnate into this world. Hence, he would be repulsed by the next era of the Primal Chaos Void!
“It isn’t too long from now.” Old Monster Stone looked at the group of Cosmos Gods in front and glanced at the two young fellows Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao that had been startled by the frighteningly strong suppression, before replying, “The Primal Chaos Void will expand faster and faster. Under the circumstances that you could resist against the Destruction Devils, you should have about 15 trillion years to 20 trillion years.”
“What?”
“So short?”
Everyone present was stunned.
Xue Ying, with his heavenly-defying talent, spent a trillion years just to become a Cosmos God!
The expression of Swordmaster changed, too: “So short?” His comprehension abilities were extremely high. He did not have to temper himself outside the world. Instead, he reached the level-two Cosmos God Realm simply by burying himself in closed-door cultivation, yet he spent 20 trillion years to do so. Swordmaster himself understood that he still had to break through several bottlenecks before reaching the ‘final realm of Cosmos God’. Each fusion of a branch of the Dao was a significant obstacle, and the final fusion of all branches as one was the hardest-to push his comprehension and deduction of the Dao of Slaughter to its furthest. ( Boxno vel. co m )
“No wonder.”
Swordmaster still remembered the words spoken by Sacred Master to him-”I hope that you will be able to reach the final level-three before the final limit of this primal chaos void. By then, this world will be more interesting.”
Sacred Master was similar to Old Monster Stone-both of them had lived for more than an era. They could deduce approximately how long before the Great Apocalypse arrived. During this period, Sacred Master reckoned that ‘Swordmaster’ was the only one who could possibly succeed. As for others? Given the insight of Sacred Master, nobody had any chances at all.
‘I do not have much time left.’ Xue Ying became anxious too.
‘I have broken through in all nine branches of the Dao of Void to the Cosmos God Realm. My accumulations in them are broad and deep too. It shouldn’t be hard for me to step into the level-two Cosmos God Realm. But to reach the final realm, I have to fuse all nine branches together. Fusing two branches is challenging, three branches, four branches… every step is a great threshold.’ Xue Ying slightly shook his head. Even his teacher, the Southern Cloud King, created the Avatar Technique, the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, yet he was still stuck at the level-two Cosmos God Realm.
‘As for the Dao of Mirage? It is harder than the Dao of the Void.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
He still had scriptures to follow for the Dao of Void! In the entire Realm Heart Great Land, several cultivators reached the final realm in the Dao of Void like Emperor Summer, for instance!
Nonetheless, the cultivator who had the highest attainments in the Mirage and Illusory Realm within the Realm Heart Great Land merely reached the level-two Cosmos God Realm.
…
The group of Cosmos Gods felt complicated. Many thoughts began flashing through their minds as they felt complicated. Old Monster Stone slightly shook his head.
He was used to it.
After an era, most of these young fellows would no longer be around.
“Senior Stone.” Xue Ying began, “Does senior know about the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique?”
Old Monster Stone nodded: “I’ve lived until now, and have met quite a few outsiders who came to our Origin World by relying on the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’. I’ve chatted with some of them before too.”
“If I were to grasp the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, bringing others to another Origin World, would it be possible for me to return after the next era emerges in my hometown?” Xue Ying asked.
“One, the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation is very hard to grasp, and yet you think of bringing someone with you?” Old Monster Stone sneered with a shake of his head, “According to my understanding, bringing someone else with you on a Great Destruction Realm Teleportation is extremely difficult.”
“Two, if you were to leave, once the next era emerges after the destruction of the Primal Chaos Void, you would be an outsider after returning, and will be repulsed.” Old Monster Stone said, “Unless you are like I and Sacred Master who survived through the Great Apocalypse. When the new Primal Chaos Void forms, we will be part of the era. That is why we do not get repulsed.”
“Repulsed?” Xue Ying softly nodded.
He understood.
The moment he got repulsed and suppressed, he would only be able to exert strength at the Primal Chaos Realm at most.
But his avatars could still continue cultivating in the Realm Heart Great Land! As for his wife and others, it did not mean much if their maximum strength was limited to the Primal Chaos Realm too.
‘The question is if I could bring others with me when I use the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation.’ Xue Ying thought. It should be the case that he could barely do it after reaching the final realm in the Dao of Void.
“Senior.”
Ancestor Sorcerer asked, “Would it be possible to bring people along the Eden Treasures, inner cosmos, and other inner spatial methods? Could they survive through the Great Apocalypse if that’s the case?”
“If I could do it, I would not have lost all my disciples from the previous few eras.” Old Monster Stone shook his head, “The Great Apocalypse of the Primal Chaos Void occurred when the Supreme Law engulfed all living beings, wiping them out totally. Unless of course if you hide outside the Origin World, at a location where the Supreme Law could not touch you.”
Ancestor Sorcerer softly nodded. He was slightly sad.
He had guessed it, albeit he was feeling unwilling.
Even if he fortuitously reached the final realm, what about the others whom he was close with?
‘Unless I can only survive by myself after reaching the final realm?’ Ancestor Sorcerer then thought of how lonely Old Monster Stone and Sacred Master were, causing him to feel a chill in his heart.
“Properly cultivate for now.”
“There isn’t much time left. In my opinion, Dong Bo Xue Ying and Swordmaster, the two of you cultivate quite fast, and there exists a strand of hope for both of you. It is quite impossible for the others, but who knows if a miracle might happen.” Old Monster Stone sighed, “Alright, concentrate on cultivating then. I hope there could be someone who can stand there with me watching the Great Apocalypse happen and watching as a new world emerges.”
Saying that, Old Monster Stone turned around and left.
He went back to slumber in the Primitive Sun Star.
And the Cosmos Gods that were present felt complex. Swordmaster and Xue Ying were both recognized as people with ‘a strand’ of hope. As for others, it was practically impossible.
…
Ancient Sacred World.
On the black stone bed, Sacred Master sat there cross-legged. His eyes were shut close.
Currently, he was calm. Nevertheless, many thoughts flashed through his mind.
‘Currently, in this era, it seems there are more and more experts appearing. I could not even capture that mysterious expert despite him entering my Ancient Sacred World. It is even harder for me to acquire his cultivation technique. Even when it is the Great Apocalypse, the energy accumulated for my Ancient Sacred Incarnation is too little. It could be considered my loss in this era.’
‘I think it’ll be better for me to focus on the next era! By then, I shall strive for it again.’
Sacred Master continued meditating and cultivating.
******
After that battle in the Ancient Sacred World, Sacred Master became even more low-profile. And just like this, 10 billion years passed peacefully.
And in the Realm Heart Great Land.
Southern Cloud Nation. The name of Monarch Flying Snow became famous. His name shook across the Black Devil Four Nations. None dared to rile him up. Xue Ying had remained in cultivation since his hometown Primal Chaos Void was continually expanding, moving closer and closer to the ‘Great Apocalypse’. That colossal ship-his hometown-was gradually sinking. That made Xue Ying not dare to relax at all. He had to reach the final realm before the Great Apocalypse!
“Chi chi chi~”
Within a newly-constructed meditation room, a flask of wine was being warmed. The white-robed young man Xue Ying sat there drinking as he pondered.
Surrounding him were many art-like worlds. They would, at times, emerge and at times, get annihilated.
“Mn? What happened?”
Suddenly, an unseen ripple swept across the world. It directly permeated into the meditation room and swept across Xue Ying. Even though the fluctuations felt profound, Xue Ying could still sense it. At the same time, he felt his heart shaking and a terror borne from his instinct.

chapters.title: Chapter 1114 - That God Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 1114: That God Palace
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was startled inwardly. He used his feeling of the void to sweep across that strand of fluctuation.
‘What a huge region.’
The feedback from his perception startled Xue Ying.
With how big his region of void perception was, this strand of fluctuation remained boundless even to Xue Ying. If some unparalleled existences like ‘Emperor Summer’ or ‘Ancestor Fan’ came with their true bodies, they might cause Xue Ying to feel terror instinctually under the suppression. But currently, this strand of boundless fluctuation merely swept across yet it terrified a Cosmos God?
‘Unless it is?’ Xue Ying had some guesses in his heart. His eyes could not help but brighten.
He could not care about other things anymore. The meditation room immediately opened. ( Boxno vel. co m )
Xue Ying flew out of the Flying Snow City towards the Southern Cloud Capital in search of his teacher, the Southern Cloud King.
…
Summer Wind Ancient Nation, Emperor Cang City.
A hunchbacked male with messy hair and a god sword behind his back appeared on top of a mountain peak. He looked towards the east: “Has it finally open since I’ve become a Great Paragon? I have waited for a long time.”
…
In another residence within the Emperor Cang City, a mutated beast that was lying on many emerald jade crystals sleeping abruptly opened its eyes. Following that, it transformed into a girl garbed in an emerald gown. She giggled: “The moment is finally here.”
…
Many powerful existences from the six great ancient nations: Summer Wind Ancient Nation, Primogenitor Ancient Nation, Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, Sky Towering Ancient Nation, Moonflower Ancient Nation, and Icy Snow Ancient Nation started extending their senses.
Even many experts from tier two and three nations had felt this fluctuation.
“Mn?” And within a grand old city, a male was wearing a completely white robe. He looked downwards, knocking softly on the armrest and glancing to the distance. He lightly muttered, “Only the Outer City is opened? Uninteresting. I still thought it might incur another War of the Ancient Nations. Previously, those two old men from the Primogenitor Ancient Nation made me suffer greatly. I have not had the chance to properly ‘repay’ them yet!”
This white-robed male shut his eyes.
Below his throne, endless streams of water continued surging forward. And amidst the streams of water, many small cities could be seen with countless beings living within.
******
Southern Cloud Capital.
“Monarch.”
“Monarch.”
Xue Ying arrived at the royal palace. Everywhere he passed, the attendants and protectors would greet him respectfully.
Currently, the Southern Cloud Nation had four Monarchs-Monarch Flying Snow, Monarch Chun Yu, Monarch Greedy Peng, and Monarch Sky Yin! Of which ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ was well known as the chief of the four great Monarchs in the Southern Cloud Nation! Furthermore, there were rumors of how this ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ was not any weaker than Maple Nest King and Fiery Zhao King.
As an expert who wasn’t any weaker than a tier two king, one could imagine his current status. As a result, the Ying Shan Clan had risen along with the currents.
Soon, Xue Ying arrived at his teacher’s meditation ground.
By the abyss.
On top of a black-colored grass field, Southern Cloud King sat here cross-legged in his luxurious black gown.
“Teacher.” Xue Ying greeted.
“You felt it?” Southern Cloud King chuckled.
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded, “Is it that legendary God Palace?”
Southern Cloud King nodded: “Right, it is the Realm Heart God Palace.”
Xue Ying’s eyes dilated.
The Realm Heart God Palace was well-known in this great land. One could see how special it was.
It was located deep within the middle of the ocean that encircled Realm Heart Great Land, the ‘Black Prison Yin Sea’. According to rumors, it was located right at the centermost of the entire Realm Heart Great Land! It was also the origin for all ‘chaos’ and ‘mysterious items’ that could be seen happening in the Realm Heart Great Land.
“Ever since the emergence of the Realm Heart Great Land, many great disputes, including the first and second War of the Ancient Nations happened because of it.” Southern Cloud King sighed, “It had even made me obsessed and mad for it.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying currently felt his blood boiling.
Many secret techniques in the Realm Heart Great Land were perfected. Even though experts numbered like cloud, it felt excessively outrageous for so many secret techniques to be improved to this extent! Like secret treasures, for instance-many secret treasures had been polished to an incredibly refined stage that enabled cultivators to fight against those of a higher realm! Even if they were guided by scriptures, secret treasures that could significantly boost the strength of final realm Cosmos Gods, causing them to reach a stage termed as the unparalleled realm were vital too.
How could such secret treasures be refined by Cosmos Gods?
That’s right.
Those secret treasures that made many level-three Cosmos Gods (final realm) desire for them had been termed as Supreme Secret Treasures. According to rumors, they were incorporated with several operating usages of the Supreme Law. Only the highest transcendental existence in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, ‘Yuan’, could refine them. Many other refining techniques and cultivation techniques that were perfected to this extent had been because they were left behind by ‘Yuan’.
…
Many secret treasures, cultivation scriptures, and unique items had been placed by Yuan within the ‘Realm Heart God Palace’.
“The Realm Heart God Palace is divided into inner and outer cities.” Southern Cloud King sighed, “Usually when it opens, only the Outer City would be opened! Like this time, only the Outer City is opened. If the Inner City was opened… haha, many unparalleled existences and level-three Cosmos Gods including those old fogeys who lived in seclusion and horrific experts reincarnated into this land would emerge. They would kill their way in. That would be terrifying.”
“When the Inner City opens, many huge treasures will appear. If some unique treasures were brought out of the city, it would incite a huge battle between unparalleled existences.” Southern Cloud King explained, “The first and second War of the Ancient Nations happened precisely because the treasures that appeared from the Realm Heart God Palace had been too alluring.”
Xue Ying lightly nodded.
“Previously, when you participated in the Competition between the Three Clans, that Origin Realm God Palace had been one of the treasures from the War of the Ancient Nations. During the second War of the Ancient Nations, it had been acquired after the three Old Ancestors from Summer Wind Ancient Nation worked together.” Southern Cloud King mentioned, “Furthermore, during the period of the second War of the Ancient Nations, the Origin Realm God Palace wasn’t ranked in the top five treasures contested over from the Realm Heart God Palace.”
Xue Ying also knew how several unparalleled existences had fallen in history.
“Adding up the number of times the Inner City had opened in history, I reckoned it could be counted with less than ten fingers.” Southern Cloud King said.
“But regardless if it were the inner or Outer City that opened, there could only be 39 entrants in total who could enter.” Southern Cloud King sighed, “If the Inner City were opened, everyone would contest and kill their way in! It would be total madness! Unparalleled existences would definitely succeed in getting in. As for the Great Paragons, they might not even have the chance to enter. Your teacher, I, had fortuitously entered the Inner City once by relying on many avatars! And sufficient speed.”
“What about the quota to enter the Outer City? Do you have any idea how I could enter?” Xue Ying asked.
The Outer City was sufficient.
The Inner City attracted more of the unparalleled existences.
Even though many treasures from the Outer City could hardly be compared with those from the Inner City, most could be used all the way to the final realm! Like top-graded secret treasures and the occasional treasures that could cause unparalleled existences to feel greed for them.
“Even though there are comparatively fewer treasures when the Outer City opens, some unparalleled existences might want to enter too.” Southern Cloud King said, “And the six great ancient nations would usually team up together to monopolize the opportunity of entering. Because this is merely the Outer City, some of the horrifying existences from Realm Heart Great Land would not team up to fight for the chance to enter. Hence, it would be impossible for anyone to go against the collective effort by the six great ancient nations.”
“Do you plan on entering?”
Southern Cloud King softly shook his head, “It is tough. The other four great ancient nations are weaker, but there is ultimately too few quotas to enter. It is impossible for the ancient nations to give them to experts outside their nations. The Myriad Realms Ancient Nation and Summer Wind Ancient Nation have slightly more quotas, but some unparalleled existences are planning to enter still! ‘Emperor Summer’ would practically send his avatars in almost all the time! Hence, the quota which they are willing to give out is few in number.”
“According to what I know, other than the three great clans from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, there are still many other clans within the ancient nation. Hence, Emperor Summer would usually take out three to four quotas to let those cultivators contest for it within the nation. You are an Upper Honored Guest from the Fan Clan and is qualified to compete for it. But there are only three to four slots… do you know those experts who would contest for the slots? They aren’t Great Paragons from the three great clans! Also, the Great Paragons from the three great clans that had not acquired the slot could participate in the competition. Other than the Great Paragons, there is a whole bunch of other level-two Cosmos Gods.”
“Xue Ying, in my opinion, I think you should focus on cultivating still.” Southern Cloud King chuckled, “Currently, your chance of winning the contest is minimal. Wait until you become a level-two Cosmos God and until you own a top-graded secret treasure before going. By then, it’ll no longer be hard for you to vie for a place. You are still quite young in terms of your cultivation age, so there is no need to feel anxious over.”
No need to feel anxious over?
He was truly anxious! If he missed this chance to enter, the next time when the Realm Heart God Palace opened, his hometown might no longer be there.
“Can I exchange for entrance using contribution points?” Xue Ying asked.
“Not possible. This isn’t within the scope of exchange.” Southern Cloud King shook his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 1115 - Contest
chapters.content:
Chapter 1115: Contest
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“You really want to go?” Southern Cloud King looked at his disciple.
“I’ll do my best.” Xue Ying answered.
Southern Cloud King softly nodded. He then passed all relevant information to Xue Ying directly: “This is the detailed information regarding the ‘Realm Heart God Palace’. Have a look at it. Also, if you plan on entering, you have to rush to the Summer Wind Capital within three days.”
“Many thanks, Teacher.” Xue Ying perused through the information relatively quickly after obtaining it.
…
Summer Wind Capital. The place was flourishing and powerful.
Xue Ying had arrived here. Even though it was stipulated that he had to rush to the Summer Wind Capital within three days, in reality, the gradual process of the ‘Realm Heart God Palace’ opening would take a full 100,000 years! It was most likely Senior ‘Yuan’ that walked ahead of everyone did so to give the experts in the Realm Heart Great Land sufficient time to finalize those entering the Outer City.
‘The six great ancient nations are too powerful. Practically all 39 quotas are occupied by them.’ Xue Ying thought.
According to the information given by his teacher.
The Summer Wind Ancient Nation held on to 12 quotas!
Usually, each of the three great clans in Summer Wind Ancient Nation would have two quotas. That added up to six! Between Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang and Ancestor Fan, usually two of them would enter, with the occasional three! Hence, that left behind just three to four remaining quotas that would be open to the public to compete fairly! Those who were qualified to contest had to rely on the three great clans.
Many of the big and small clans within Summer Wind Ancient Nation relied on the three great clans too. And Honored Guests like Xue Ying relied on the Fan Clan.
Otherwise, they would not be qualified to compete for the quotas.
And those who wished to contest for it… had to arrive within three days at the Summer Wind Capital Royal Palace and take the initiative to register for it. Those who reached the palace after three days would no longer be qualified.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying arrived before the front entrance of the Royal Palace. Naturally, there was a protector that came to welcome him.
“Monarch Flying Snow, are there any reasons for coming today?”
“I came for the Realm Heart God Palace.” Xue Ying answered.
“Monarch wishes to compete for it?”
“Yes.”
“Please come with me, Monarch.”
The protectors were extremely familiar with the process because they had been informed about it. Xue Ying wasn’t the first that came to compete for the quotas.
Flying within the Royal Palace.
After a while, they arrived at a dark palace hall. Deep in the palace hall, there was a yellow-robed old man seated cross-legged. Before this yellow-robed old man was a long table placed with many scrolls.
“Elder Summer.” Xue Ying went forward. He was relatively familiar with this Elder Summer. Previously when he accepted the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll> impartation, it was Emperor Summer who guided him. Elder Summer was also the array spirit of the Royal Palace. Within the Royal Palace itself, he could control a power equivalent to unparalleled existences. Most matters were given to Elder Summer to handle. Being an array spirit, he was powerful and loyal; he would be willing to do anything and everything.
But reaching his level, he had emotions too. Hence, most disciples of the Summer Clan dared not offend this ‘Elder Summer’.
“It is Monarch Flying Snow. Does Monarch Flying Snow wish to enter the Realm Heart God Palace?” The yellow-robed old man opened his eyes and smiled at Xue Ying.
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Monarch, you can take any scrolls.” The yellow-robed old man said, “Each scroll has missions written on it. The time limit for completing the missions is 90,000 years. After 90,000 years, those who are ranked top four in terms of contribution points will obtain the quotas.”
Xue Ying became delighted the moment he heard that.
Four quotas?
It seemed only two out of Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang and Ancestor Fan were going. Hence, four quotas were taken out for them to compete for.
“Many thanks.” Xue Ying went forward to receive the scroll. He bowed before leaving.
Once he received the scroll, it represented the fact that he would be participating in the competition.
“Monarch Flying Snow is participating too.”
“Monarch Flying Snow from the Southern Cloud Nation.”
Within the Royal Palace, there were many protectors and female attendants. After watching everything, they naturally spread the news outwards.
…
Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
Within the courtyard, amid a lake flowing with blazing liquid, there was currently a huge creature seated. As he sat there, his chest reached above the lake. His arms were even half as long as the lake. A frightening blazing aura could be felt coming from his large lone horn.
“Paragon Master.” A sweet and graceful red-robed girl bowed respectfully. She was a Cosmos God. “There is news coming from the Royal Palace stating that ‘Monarch Flying Snow’, the chief of the four great Monarchs from the Southern Cloud Nation, will be contesting for the quotas. This is already the 12th person participating in it.”
“Ying Shan Xue Ying that brat?” The large head with a lone horn lightly shook his head. His eyes were filled with a strand of disdain, “He isn’t worthy of being worried for. Even if he broke through to the level-two Cosmos God Realm, without a top-graded secret treasure, his threat is low. Those who truly threaten me are still those Paragon Masters from our Summer Wind Ancient Nation or many the experts within the three great clans. Continue watching.”
“Yes, Paragon Master.” This sweet and graceful red-robed girl respectfully answered before retreating.
That expert with a lone horn closed his eyes.
He had cultivated to the final bottleneck before fusing all ten branches of the Dao of Flames! He was left with the last branch before stepping into the final realm of Cosmos God.
“I’ve already reached the bottleneck. This final bottleneck is extremely difficult. I have to rely on some external strength. It seems I must obtain a quota for the Realm Heart God Palace this time. There are many opportunities within the Realm Heart God Palace. As long as my luck is good, I might be able to grasp something that could increase the chance of breaking through.” The single-horned expert muttered. If he were part of the three great clans, once he cultivated to such a critical moment, the three great clans would definitely arrange a slot for him.
But it’s a pity that pride filled his bones, making him an Honored Elder of the Cang Clan.
He was one of the Paragon Masters participating in the contest in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation—’Fire Devil Paragon Master’.
…
The news of Monarch Flying Snow ‘Xue Ying’ contesting for the slot to enter the Realm Heart God Palace had been spread to those who were paying notice to it. Amongst them, there were Cosmos Gods from the three great clans that did not get a quota, and there were also experts like Fire Devil Paragon Master who did not come from the three great clans.
“His threat is minimal.”
“He is merely an Upper Honored Guest.”
Many people did not treat this news as something important.
Xue Ying’s strength was indeed ordinary amongst the group of participating experts. Furthermore, he came from outside the nation and did not have a great background. Behind him merely stood ‘Southern Cloud King’. How could he compare with those from the three great clans where there existed multiple Paragon Masters (Great Paragons) in it!
******
And on another side of the Realm Heart Great Land.
In a distant region extremely far away from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. This region was instead closer to the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation. A tier two nation occupied this place, and this was an extremely chaotic and horrifying nation known as the ‘Western Floating Nation’.
Within a private room in a tavern at the Western Floating Nation.
There was a white-robed young man currently drinking and eating the famous delicacies from this restaurant.
“So delicious, extremely delicious!”
“Mn mn, compared to the delicacies in Southern Cloud and Summer Wind Ancient Nation, the food here tastes different.” He was currently enjoying himself as he ate. Eating good food was considered a hobby and enjoyment for him.
“Xue Ying.”
A transmission came.
“Teacher.” Xue Ying immediately replied.
“The three days period is up. This time, there are a total of 21 Cosmos Gods in Summer Wind Ancient Nation contesting for the quotas, of which there are three Paragon Masters—’Nine Venom Religion Master’, ‘Fire Devil Paragon Master’, as well as ‘Great Paragon Fuyi’ who came from the Summer Clan.” At the same time, Southern Cloud King also transmitted relevant information regarding the other 20 Cosmos Gods.
Xue Ying’s expression slightly changed.
It was okay that Nine Venom Religion Master and Fire Devil Paragon Master participated. Even though they were Paragon Masters that owned top-graded secret treasures, they were one whole level lower in terms of danger as compared to ‘Great Paragon Fuyi’ from the Summer Clan. Great Paragon Fuyi was someone as famous as his own teacher, the Southern Cloud King.

chapters.title: Chapter 1116 - Target of Assassination
chapters.content:
Chapter 1116: Target of Assassination
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Even though Paragon Masters were comparative in strength, there were still differences between them.
The stronger Paragon Masters were existences that unparalleled existences could not kill. For instance, Southern Cloud King, Great Paragon Fuyi, Sky-Rending Great Paragon, Black Devil Great Lake’s chief religion master, ‘Yama Religion Master’. Only then were they qualified to be absolute overlords of Realm Heart Great Land! Unparalleled existences did not dare to hold any contempt for them; they dared proclaim themselves as rulers of a region. And the reason why some devils from the Black Devil Great Lake were not afraid of bringing chaos to cities within the Summer Wind Ancient Nation was all because of Yama Religion Master.
Reaching this level, they were qualified to disregard giving any respect to unparalleled existences! The Southern Cloud Sacred Religion was one of the ten great religions. They earned an astronomical amount of cosmos crystals, so much that it even incurred the greed in unparalleled existences, causing them to deal against Southern Cloud King. Nevertheless, Southern Cloud King survived through any direct combat, showing how steep his foundation was!
Those secondary to that level, even though they were comparable in strength, they could still not survive in front of unparalleled existences. That was the predicament for an absolute majority of Paragons.
No other choice.
‘Top-graded secret treasures’ would only improve part of the cultivator’s strength. For instance, a secret domain treasure would only increase the domain of the cultivator to level-three Cosmos God level! A level-two Cosmos God who only had transcendental domain would still die before unparalleled existences!
In terms of numbers, the Fan Clan had six Paragon Masters, the Summer Clan had nine, and currently, Cang Clan had seven! Hence, those who dared say they could survive before unparalleled existences were few in numbers even across the entire Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
And such absolute overlord was very few in numbers across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
‘Great Paragon Fuyi is someone ranked in the top two amongst Summer Clan’s nine Great Paragons.’ Xue Ying was dumbstruck, ‘If he asked for a quota personally, it shouldn’t be too hard for him to acquire it, yet he is here to compete for it? With his identity, even if it were to ensure his reputation is kept, the Summer Clan would still fight for a slot for him.’
“Xue Ying, have you chosen it?” Southern Cloud King asked.
“I’ve chosen.”
Xue Ying waved his hand. A scroll appeared on the table. The scroll rolled open completely. There were many missions on it, and every task would reward the recipient with corresponding ‘contribution points’.
The scroll was inscribed densely with several hundred missions.
Of which there were 50 missions involving assassination.
12 targets of assassination were Paragon Masters, rewarding the recipient contribution points ranging from ‘30,000 to 80,000 contribution points’ upon completion!
The other 38 missions involved killing level-two Cosmos Gods that would reward contribution points from ‘3,000 to 30,000’.
Following that, they were the ‘special treasure missions’.
All sorts of special treasures could be directly traded for contribution points!
For instance, ranking at the highest, ‘Broken Teeth Serpent Bead’. A single bead could be exchanged for 20,000 contribution points!
‘Broken Teeth Serpent Bead? It seems the six great ancient nations desire it a lot. Any of the six great ancient nations are willing to pay an enormous price or even provide the quota just by taking out a single Broken Teeth Serpent Bead.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
The Broken Teeth Serpent Bead originated from the ‘Broken Teeth Mountain Range’.
…
The top treasure land of the Realm Heart Great Land was none other than the Realm Heart God Palace.
And the number one most dangerous place on Realm Heart Great Land was the Broken Teeth Mountain Range! If one observed the mountain range from afar, one would see that the Broken Teeth Mountain Range was the highest mountain peak, and it was in the shape of half-broken teeth! These teeth were towering, which was also why the entire mountain range had been named as the ‘Broken Teeth Mountain Range’. The Broken Teeth Mountain Range occupied an incomparably vast area. It was practically boundless, approximately equivalent to three Summer Wind Ancient Nations. Inside the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, many dangerous grounds existed. According to rumors, two unparalleled existences had fallen before within the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
But many final realm Cosmos Gods and unparalleled existences still went in for adventures.
And according to legends, the most famous item within the Broken Teeth Mountain Range was the ‘Broken Teeth Serpent Bead’. Anyone who obtained a single Broken Teeth Serpent Bead would immediately become an upper VIP in any of the six great ancient nations and could exchange for all sorts of benefits.
Hence, many cultivators still took the risk to foray in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range! And some serial killers who were pursued by would also escape into the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
An absolute majority died within.
And few survived… some were even lucky to obtain vast treasures!
“The target I’ve chosen is a devil in the Western Floating Nation.” Xue Ying transmitted back.
“Western Floating Nation? Mn, be careful.”
“Rest assured, Teacher.”
Xue Ying looked towards the opened scroll.
Of the 50 targets of assassination inscribed on the scroll, five were in Western Floating Nation.
Even though the Western Floating Nation was a country, in reality, that was a gathering place for devils. Even though its environment wasn’t as nasty as the Black Devil Great Lake, it had as many devils as that in the Black Devil Great Lake.
Actually, the strongest person here was the highest-ranking Western Floating Nation King. But he usually called himself ‘Western Floating Old Ancestor’. Western Floating Old Ancestor was also an absolute overlord of this region. He frequently fought against the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation directly! He was extremely arrogant, and would occasionally send his subordinates to bring disaster to other five great ancient nations. Western Floating Old Ancestor was someone the six great ancient nations sought to kill, yet it’s a pity he could not be killed!
As the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation was situated close to the Western Floating Nation, the ancient nation had sent many experts before, killing countless within the Western Floating Nation. It’s a pity that Western Floating Old Ancestor did not care! He was similar to Snow Hook King in this aspect.
Snow Hook King did not care about giving any face to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation too!
But Snow Hook King wasn’t a devil, just that he was too proud.
And ‘Western Floating Nation’ was filled with countless devils.
This time, a bounty was placed by the Summer Wind Ancient Nation on assassinating five higher-ups from the Western Floating Nation. Naturally, no bounty was set on Western Floating Old Ancestor as that was someone even unparalleled existences could not kill.
One was the second-ranking expert from the Western Floating Nation, and was a Paragon Master called ‘Broken Sky Paragon Master’!
The other four were called the ‘Four Vicious of Western Floating’.
‘How would I dare to assassinate Broken Sky Paragon Master? As for the Four Vicious of Western Floating, they are comparable to me in strength. Now that the Realm Heart God Palace is about to open, the devils from the Western Floating Nation would have likely known that bounties were placed on their heads, and they would certainly be on alert. This is even their territory. Hence, it is highly possible for Western Floating Old Ancestor or Broken Sky Paragon Master to come and save them when they face danger. It is difficult to kill them.’ Xue Ying understood this point.
‘With my strength, I could only target ‘Devil Monarch Wind Moon’ as my strengths curb his weaknesses. I must eliminate him as fast as possible before escaping at the next instance.’ Xue Ying had the pinnacle of void-ification, and hence, he was still confident of fleeing.
“Devil Monarch Wind Moon!”
Xue Ying looked at the name on the scroll, and the total reward of ‘11,000 contribution points’. His eyes were filled with excitement.
According to experience, earning 10,000 contribution points would be sufficient to obtain a quota. But because the bounty was great, the difficulty of killing the target was intense too!
“Go.”
Xue Ying kept the scroll and immediately stood up.
…
He had already altered his appearances and used the pinnacle of void-ification to conceal his aura. Xue Ying easily disguised himself as an ordinary Unity Realm expert. A Unity Realm white-robed young man wasn’t worth mentioning in the Western Floating Nation at all. He could not be called a vast expert, yet neither would he be bullied.
“Devil Monarch Wind Moon.”
Xue Ying was currently searching for his target.
With the help of Western Floating Old Ancestor, traces of his target could not be found temporarily. The web of intelligence by the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion could temporarily not find anything on his target too. It seemed Devil Monarch Wind Moon had become low-profile the moment the Realm Heart God Palace opened.
Late at night.
‘Where could he be hiding?’
Using the pinnacle of void-ification, Xue Ying strolled around the residence of Devil Monarch Wind Moon with suspicion.
‘Devil Monarch Wind Moon liked girls the most. Every girl in his hand would end up either tortured to death…’ Detailed information on Devil Monarch Wind Moon flashed through Xue Ying’s mind. He wanted to deduce the position where Devil Monarch Wind Moon could hide accordingly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1117 - Trampled to Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 1117: Trampled to Death
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was like a hunter, searching through Devil Monarch Wind Moon’s cavern-dwelling, residence, and other places he frequently visited as listed on the intelligence reports. He checked through them once through.
‘He isn’t there.’
‘This is the worst possibility.’ Xue Ying went to a restaurant in one of the smaller, desolate cities. He went there to enjoy good wine and good food while pondering to himself, ‘He is a level-two Cosmos God expert, yet just because of the opening of the Realm Heart God Palace, he became frightened to this extent? It seems he dare not stay at his cavern-dwelling and residence either.’
The Western Floating Nation was a famous gathering place for devils in the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
Other than the two Paragon Masters-Western Floating Old Ancestor and Broken Sky Paragon Master…
Closely following behind them were the Four Vicious of Western Floating-these were level-two Cosmos God experts. Even though they did not own top-graded secret treasures, they were not existences to be pushed around. Paragon Masters were only one level stronger than them. It would not be easy to kill these vicious experts! Xue Ying was naturally far weaker than a Paragon Master, yet he was confident of dealing against Devil Monarch Wind Moon.
And the reason for his confidence was the ‘Devil Emperor Gown’. This gown boosted the strength of his soul technique to a level that could threaten level-two Cosmos Gods.
‘Of the Four Vicious of Western Floating, Devil Monarch Wind Moon is weakest in his Heart Realm. He is the only target whom I have confident of eliminating using my soul technique.’ Xue Ying thought.
The other three vicious devils did not have glaring flaws in their heart and spirit; they were comparable to Paragon Masters in their willpower, heart, and spirit. They only lacked a suitable top-graded secret treasure.
‘Now it seems I have no choice but to scour through the entire place.’ Xue Ying was currently utilizing the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique to scout the area while drinking at the same time.
…
Using the Destruction Realm Scouting Technique to scout the area was the crudest yet most direct method! That time when Xue Ying searched for traces of the golden-armored lairs in the Lost World Corridor, he spent a trillion years yet he still did not complete searching for all the lairs. The ‘Destruction Realm Scouting Technique’ could only allow Xue Ying to peer at an area. Hence, it was tedious and slow, and this mission had a time limit of 90,000 years.
‘What a pity that I do not specialize in searching for traces of others. Otherwise, it would be possible for me to find where he is immediately by breaking apart his concealment technique.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
Like Old Monster Stone, he was very good at searching for traces.
Nobody could hide from his eyes in the entire Origin World.
And in this vast Realm Heart Great Land, it was so much harder for Xue Ying to find traces of a single cultivator! Even though he had Southern Cloud King behind his back, Xue Ying did not wish to trouble his teacher.
‘I’ll just slowly search.’
‘Furthermore, I believe there should be experts from other ancient nations taking up this mission too.’ Xue Ying was being very patient.
******
As time passed, it had been 3,000 years since Xue Ying started using the Destruction Realm Scouting Technique.
At night.
‘Mn? This devil?’ Within a small courtyard, there was a white-robed young man, Xue Ying, who currently was eating and drinking. All of a sudden, his eyes brightened up. At this moment, he was spying on a particular residence.
In the ‘Eternal Qie Mansion’ very far away from here.
Within the residence, in an underground prison.
There were many convicts locked here. Some of the prisoners were being tortured, and some had turned mad.
“Mn.”
A luxurious golden-robed male walked within the underground prison. When the convicts saw him from their prisons, the eyes of some of them turned red from madness. Some remained calm and glared at him while biting their teeth. And the majority was cursing and scolding him indignantly: “Oh, Magnificent Eternal Night Primogenitor, I am willing to sacrifice my life for a curse, curse this Devil Eternal Qie to death! Curse him to death!”
“Devil Eternal Qie…”
The grievances coming from countless prisoners shot up into the sky. Many prisoners were glaring at him with hatred.
And that luxurious golden-robed male revealed a grin. He said to a subordinate behind his back: “Very good, continue torturing them. Make sure they grieve more.”
“Yes yes.” The protectors behind him respectfully acknowledged.
The luxurious golden-robed male extended his hand. His right hand expanded right into the prison. At that moment, many prisoners faced a horrifying devouring force. They felt their bodies trembling, and closely following that, they dissipated into powder, A concentrated soul force that was filled with grievances flew into the palm of the luxurious golden-robed male. It appeared as if his palm was an abyss, devouring everything into it.
As he walked, in some of the prisons that were filled with heavy grievances, he simply devoured them.
“Master.” A blurred shadow rapidly got closer from behind. He soon turned into a silver-haired old man.
This luxurious golden-robed male continued devouring. At the same time, he revealed an expectant look, asking: “How is it?”
“Master, the trillion civilians in that small city have all been captured alive.” The silver-haired old man extended his hand. On his palm, there was a golden wristband, “They are all locked in this Eden Treasure.”
“Good, very good. You have done a splendid job.” The luxurious golden-robed male revealed a joyous look, “The next task for you is to torture them. Torture them savagely. The heavier their grievances, the better.”
“Yes.” The eyes of the silver-haired old man were filled with expectations and killing intent.
That luxurious golden-robed male grinned. At the same time, he extended his hand into another prison. That prison was locked with several prisoners too.
“Devil, devil.” The eyes of a young girl were red. Her entire sect had been captured alive. They were all tortured severely before being devoured by this huge devil.
“Is it finally my turn?” The young girl mumbled, “I hate this! Eternal Night Primogenitor, Extreme Night Primogenitor, World Extermination God Emperor, Emperor Summer… all magnificent supreme existences! I pray to you now, this one is willing to sacrifice my soul for the death of this devil!”
When that palm extended into the prison, suddenly-
Under the excited looks of the protectors and the silver-haired old man, suddenly, that golden-robed male fell onto the ground abruptly. Following that, the silver-haired old man and part of the protectors also fell down. They no longer emit any aura.
“Hong.”
All prisoners within the underground prison including those in the golden wristband had been forcibly teleported away.
In a wilderness relatively far away from here.
Many prisoners and the countless civilians in the golden wristband appeared. The seals on those prisoners were dissolved at the same time.
“This, this…”
The prisoners who were originally filled with grievance looked in all directions. They only saw a boundless night sky.
“We are out?’
“We…”
The prisoners and those civilians that were let out of the wristband were stunned.
Following that, many of them knelt down: “Many thanks, senior for saving us! Many thanks, senior for saving us!” Voices could be heard reverberating across the world.
They understood that it was a powerful and unfathomable expert who saved them. They were filled with gratitude since there were very few amidst the world that would be willing to become enemies with the devils in Western Floating Nation just to save them, the weaker ones! After all, the weaker cultivators were ants in the eyes of many powerful experts.
It was good for them not to bully the weak. But to save them just because? That was rare! After all, occasions like this were seen far too frequently in the Realm Heart Great Land.
…
Xue Ying who was drinking in the courtyard had a baleful look in his eyes: ‘Hmph, the karmic ties of these devils are filled with such heavy grievances. Truly unimaginable! They deserve death!’
The Western Floating Nation was a gathering place for devils, and there were far too many devils within! If Xue Ying planned on killing all of them, he might as well begin a war with the entire nation. Nonetheless, even the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation could not exterminate ‘Western Floating Old Ancestor’. He, Xue Ying, temporarily did not plan on being so high-and-mighty. He was too lazy to care about an absolute majority of devils since there were honestly too many in the Western Floating Nation.
Only those who were extremely vile and nasty like the devil called ‘Eternal Qie’ were existences who he could not tolerate!
Most ordinary devils were only more savage in their methods! And ‘Eternal Qie’ sacrifice a trillion beings just for every cultivation. Such devils would bring too much harm as compared to ordinary ones.
‘They deserved death.’
Xue Ying then threw the matter to the back of his mind. He continued scouting for other places in the Western Floating Nation.
******
Eternal Qie Mansion.
The Primal Chaos Realm Devil ‘Eternal Qie City Master’ had died. All prisoners within the underground prison disappeared completely without a trace. This immediately alarmed the higher-ups of Western Floating Nation.
“Shua shua shua.”
Many experts rushed over one after another. They were from the same sect as Eternal Qie City Master.
There were many different sects within the Western Floating Nation.
“Dead?” Three figures stood within the underground prison. They saw Eternal Qie City Master who collapsed onto the ground powerlessly, and the surrounding silver-haired old man and protectors who died in the same manner. Everyone had been ‘wiped’ by Xue Ying as he scouted the whole nation because he found how heavy the grievances were in their karmic ties.
“Junior Disciple Brother Eternal Qie’s treasures are still here. He did not suffer from any other injuries. Instead, his soul has been extinguished?”
“Mn, it is his soul. The souls of other people have been wiped out too.”
“Soul Dao?”
The three Primal Chaos experts looked towards each other. Their expressions changed. Experts who specialized in the Soul Dao were frightening. He could stealthily kill ‘Eternal Qie City Master’, and could similarly kill them instantaneously as well.
“Who is so daring to dare act against Junior Disciple Brother Eternal Qie? Hurry up and inform Teacher! We must not let things rest!”
“We will find the murderer and kill him!”
All of them discussed through voice transmissions. The devils of Western Floating Nation were all tyrannical. With an order by the Western Floating King, they even dared to pay the six great ancient nations a visit and mess up the place.
“Sou.”
A male and female floated over. The leading green-robed male had a cold look on his face.
“Eldest Disciple Brother.”
The three present respectfully bowed. Eldest Disciple Brother was sufficiently strong. He was the only one amongst them in the same sect that had reached tenth level power.
“Have you investigated? How is it?” The green-robed male indifferently asked.
“Reporting to Eldest Disciple Brother, the murderer is an expert in the Dao of Soul.” One of them described, “He stealthily killed Junior Disciple Brother Eternal Qie and his surrounding subordinates. He then teleported away all the prisoners!”
“Instantaneously?” The green-robed male asked.
“Yes, part of the protectors are fortunate to live. They said everything happened instantaneously.”
“Eldest Disciple Brother, those who dare to kill our junior disciple brother should be killed! We must not let things rest! We must find out who the murderer is and kill him!”
Everyone shouted agitatedly.
Even though they knew the murderer was powerful, they had their teacher still! And above their teacher was the higher-ups! In the Western Floating Nation, they were the ones bullying others. When was it that others dared bully them?
“Hmph.”
The green-robed male snorted. His cold eyes swept across the others, “A bunch of fools.”
Everyone present was startled. Even the girl by his side asked in bewilderment: “Eldest Disciple Brother?”
The green-robed male indifferently explained: “Let me be honest to all of you. Several thousand years ago, the Realm Heart God Palace has started gradually opening.”
“Realm Heart God Palace?”
“Realm Heart God Palace?”
All of them were shocked.
Since they were able to reach the Primal Chaos Realm, they understood part of the legends in the Realm Heart Great Land. The Realm Heart God Palace was a legendary place! Cosmos Gods sought to enter, yet few could earn the chance to do so. For instance, Western Floating Old Ancestor and Broken Sky Paragon Master could not enter! Much less them.
“As the Realm Heart God Palace gradually opens, the six great ancient nations have their own contest over the quotas of entry. Over this period, they will set bounties on some of the great devils across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.” The green-robed male explained, “In our Western Floating Nation, only the most apex experts could be listed as targets of bounty. They would earn points by killing us, and eventually, that would determine if they obtain the slot to enter.”
“Hence, several thousand years ago, numerous experts from the six great ancient nations have arrived in our Western Floating Nation.”
“All of them are hunters… searching for prey.”
The green-robed male mentioned with a cold voice.
“But, Eldest Disciple Brother, could the prey of those terrific Cosmos Gods be exchanged for rewards? We are merely small characters, and why would they want to act against us?” The other four Primal Chaos devils felt their hearts trembling. They knew that every time the Realm Heart God Palace opened, it would incur a huge affair across the Origin World.
Because during ordinary times, those frightening Cosmos Gods would not easily find prey to kill since it was too difficult! Only during this competition for the quotas where there were sufficient rewards would they come. Most of the time, even the ‘Four Vicious of Western Floating’ would be frightened to the extent that they hide.
“Yes, their prey is currently the highest level in our Western Floating Nation.” The green-robed male coldly sneered, “But to these terrifying Cosmos Gods, killing us is just like trampling upon ants. Just previously, Junior Disciple Brother Eternal Qie had been ‘trampled to death’ by a frightening existence. Hence from now on, everyone must remain low-profile and be more obedient. Don’t stir up too much trouble. Furthermore, I suspect that the terrifying Cosmos God could be observing us in the dark, yet it is impossible for us to discover it.”
The four present devils felt their hearts shaking. They could not help but look around.

chapters.title: Chapter 1118 - Game
chapters.content:
Chapter 1118: Game
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying did not care about these Primal Chaos devils at all. Even if he did not have a secret treasure with him, he could still easily kill tenth level experts. Furthermore, now that he had the ‘Devil Emperor Gown’, ‘Five Phase Beads’, and ‘Scarlet Cloud God Spear’ with him, Xue Ying was so much stronger than at his hometown Origin World. That was also the reason why he dared to hunt for devils in the Western Floating Nation.
As time passed, in the blink of an eye, it had been 50,000 years since Xue Ying arrived at the Western Floating Nation.
All the listed assassination missions were difficult to accomplish.
And Xue Ying was most confident of killing Devil Monarch Wind Moon. It’s a pity that the other party had hidden quite thoroughly.
‘I do not specialize in tracking. But if there is an expert from some other ancient nation that specialized in it who came here for the same reason as well, why did he not act? Unless nobody dares to set the Western Floating Nation as their target? I don’t believe this!’ Xue Ying thought. Of the listed missions, the bounties rewarded for targets in Western Floating Nation were considered relatively simple! Even though there were other experts in the ‘Black Devil Great Lake’ who were comparable in strength to those in the Western Floating Nation, the environment in the Black Devil Great Lake was vile and nasty. Few experts were willing to enter.
And other devils were gathered in the Moonflower Ancient Nation!
That’s right.
The Moonflower Ancient Nation and Sky Towering Ancient Nation were the two weakest great ancient nations amongst the six. There were even devils hiding within! Nonetheless, these devils were much harder to kill since most of them were seemingly under the protection of unparalleled existences! For the sake of reputation, the ancient nations did not publicly acknowledge this fact.
‘The devils in Western Floating Nation are comparatively easier to deal with.’ Xue Ying waited.
“Hong!”
A horrifying fluctuation erupted from afar.
Xue Ying immediately turned towards the source-northwest of his location-using his perception of the essence of the void. He could clearly sense those ripples coming in that direction.
‘Over there!’
Xue Ying immediately relied on his Destructive Realm Teleportation technique to scout that location!
Looking from a distance…
Under the night sky, that was an ordinary-looking cavern-dwelling located outside the city. It was normal for experts to live in seclusion outside cities in some desolate lands. Deep in this cavern-dwelling, two figures started battling.
“Devil Monarch Wind Moon, die for me!”
That was a muscular male who had icy-white skin. He wielded a great hammer. The presence of that great hammer caused the void to shake. This was a secret treasure much more frightening than the ‘Cloud Sky Hammer’ which Xue Ying once saw in the past. This muscular male emanated a frost aura. With a wave of his hand, he sent an overwhelming strength into the great hammer, smashing it down furiously.
“Hua hua hua.” Facing him was a violet-haired demonic male. He had a total of 13 blades behind his back. Currently, those blades were spread apart in a fan shape.
And at the next moment, each blade started soaring out.
“Shua shua shua…”
Many layers of stacked blade lights surrounded that muscular male.
“Hong!”
The great hammer was sent smashing over.
Countless blade lights were forced away.
“Hong! Hong! Hong!”
As the power from the great hammer was brought down, in the blink of an eye, it pushed away all blade lights and arrived before Devil Monarch Wind Moon.
The violet-haired demonic male ‘Devil Monarch Wind Moon’ turned pale and immediately retreated.
“Shua.”
His speed of escape was fast! As he escaped, those blade lights shot back into the scabbards behind his back.
…
‘Devil Monarch Wind Moon.’ Xue Ying suppressed the wild excitement in his heart.
He had searched high and low for his target, only for him to emerge when he least expected it.
‘Brother Ancient Frost, I would have to thank you for this time.’ Xue Ying was raving with joy inwardly.
Great Monarch Ancient Frost.
He was a level-two Cosmos God from the Icy Snow Ancient Nation. Just like in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, especially the core disciples of the Summer Clan, Cang Clan, and Fan Clan, as long as the disciple had become an experienced level-two Cosmos God, Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, and Emperor Cang would think of ways to bestow upon them with a top-graded secret treasure! If they could not find, they could always help refine it. That was why the Summer Wind Ancient Nation had so many Paragon Masters.
But the situation in Icy Snow Ancient Nation was worse.
Even though the Icy Snow Ancient Nation had three unparalleled existences, all of them were body cultivators! As a result, the peak cultivation techniques in their ancient nations were all for body cultivation. Thinking of cultivating in other techniques? They had to pay an enormous price and exchange them with other ancient nations! Even if they relied entirely on exchanging, how much could they exchange for?
As for weapons, the three old ancestors from the Icy Snow Ancient Nation did not know how to refine weapons, much less refining top-graded secret treasures. Hence, the only way they could acquire such treasures were to snatch from others!
But how could it be easy snatching a top-graded weapon from those who had them?
Most would have huge backing!
