Hence, the situation in the Icy Snow Ancient Nation was quite pitiable. They had many second-level Cosmos Gods, but few Paragon Masters-only a total of seven!
Great Monarch Ancient Frost… in terms of strength and accumulations, he was extremely strong. He was unquestionably at the peak of level-two standard, and would definitely be bestowed with a top-graded secret treasure if he were a core member in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Nevertheless, being a member of the Icy Snow Ancient Nation, he did not own any top-graded secret treasure. Hence, many body cultivator experts from the Icy Snow Ancient Nation sought to enter the Realm Heart God Palace.
‘A group of monsters.’ Xue Ying mumbled inwardly.
The three old ancestors of the Icy Snow Ancient Nation had reached the final realm in body cultivation. All of them even corroborated with one another, resulting in the widespread circulation of body cultivation techniques within the Icy Snow Ancient Nation.
******
Currently, Xue Ying could teleport through a much greater distance. With a step, he left that small courtyard of his and arrived in this wilderness. He saw the escaping Devil Monarch Wind Moon.
Devil Monarch Wind Moon and Great Monarch Ancient Frost. One ran and the other chased. The latter had frozen the surrounding space, preventing his target from escaping easily.
‘Great Monarch Ancient Frost, you are too slow. It is impossible for you to catch up to him.’ Devil Monarch Wind Moon’s speed was much faster than Great Monarch Ancient Frost’s. Most likely after the time taken to brew a cup of tea, the congealed void region of Great Monarch Ancient Frost would no longer cover Devil Monarch Wind Moon.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying held onto the Scarlet Cloud God Spear with one hand. At the same time, he maintained the pinnacle of void-ification, preventing both parties from discovering him.
At this moment, he was looking from afar. Xue Ying was not in a rush to get closer. Even though the void was congealed and he could not teleport over, he could still rely on the Scarlet Cloud God Spear to exhibit the ‘Scarlet Cloud Domain’. This was so much stronger than at his hometown Origin World-an entire level higher! If Xue Ying could bring the Scarlet Cloud God Spear back to his hometown, he could definitely distort the void and escape from Sacred Master easily even as the other party suppressed him using the Ancient Sacred World.
‘Devil Monarch Wind Moon, you can be considered a level-two Cosmos God, but what a pity.’ The edge of Xue Ying’s lips curved upwards. He immediately relied on the Devil Emperor Gown to execute his secret technique.
“Weng-”
An unseen Mirage and Illusory Realm was sent over. This region easily covered the escaping Devil Monarch Wind Moon.
That was the frightening aspect of Xue Ying.
The Soul Dao was unlike other Dao paths. Those who were slightly stronger would only injure the other party slightly. Given how strong the life force powerful experts were, it was difficult to kill one. But the Dao of Soul was different… if a party could not withstand it, he would be doomed instantaneously!
Relying on the ‘Devil Emperor Gown’, Xue Ying’s soul technique had reached the level-two Cosmos God power. Even Southern Cloud King would have to divert part of his heart force to resist against it! And Devil Monarch Wind Moon who was flawed in his heart and spirit was the easiest target Xue Ying determined he could capture amongst the Four Vicious of the Western Floating. And experts in the Dao of Soul like him would have it so easy.
“Mn?” Xue Ying whose lips were originally edged upwards in a grin, suddenly froze. His eyes widened as he looked at Devil Monarch Wind Moon to the distance.
Devil Monarch Wind Moon suddenly stopped.
Turning back.
“Hong!””Hong!””Hong!””Hong!”
Eight pillars began rising from the ground in all directions. Each pillar was covered in brightly lit inscriptions. An immensely huge array covered a vast region. Under this frightening array fluctuation, Xue Ying’s figure that was hidden using the pinnacle of void-ification was forced apart. And Great Monarch Ancient Frost who was originally chasing after his target madly, turned and looked at the distant Devil Monarch Wind Moon with aghast. Furthermore, there was another gray-robed old man within this region of the huge array that was forced to show himself.
Devil Monarch Wind Moon had transformed. His appearance changed. It turned into water, and this stream of water soon condensed into a short and fat old man.
The short and plump old man looked at the distant Great Monarch Ancient Frost, the gray-robed old man and another white-robed young man who was forced to show himself.
“Great Monarch Ancient Frost from the Icy Snow Ancient Nation, Eagle City Master from the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, and Monarch Flying Snow from the Southern Cloud Nation! What a pity that I have only hooked on three fishes.” The short and plump old man said with a booming voice, “If not for Monarch Flying Snow’s soul technique, I could have hooked more fish.”
The expressions on Xue Ying, Great Monarch Ancient Frost, and the gray-robed old man shifted.
This short and plump old man…
Was ‘Western Floating Old Ancestor’. He was extremely famous, and an absolute overlord in the Realm Heart Great Land!
Previously when Xue Ying executed his Mirage and Illusory Realm, he realized things were amiss when it failed to cause the other party to fall! It was impossible for Devil Monarch Wind Moon to resist his soul technique so easily.
‘He disguised himself as Devil Monarch Wind Moon, but previously, he had executed the Wind Moon Blade. Unless Western Floating Old Ancestor had cultivated the Dao of Wind to the Cosmos God Realm?’ Xue Ying immediately thought of it.
“Go!”
To the distant, Great Monarch Ancient Frost did not hesitate to escape. The gray-robed old man ‘Eagle City Master’ similarly disappeared with a flash. His speed of escape was extremely fast.
“Run.” Xue Ying held on his Scarlet Cloud God Spear and immediately executed the Scarlet Cloud Domain. “Shua, shua, shua”, he forcibly twisted the void. Every teleport took him more than 50 million kilometers away. He rapidly left, escaping at a speed much faster than Eagle City Master and Great Monarch Ancient Frost.
‘This Ying Shan Xue Ying is really quick at escaping.’ Great Monarch Ancient Frost felt envious and helpless at the same time. He could only fly slowly.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying from the Southern Cloud Nation?” Eagle City Master glanced at the white-robed young man that escaped rapidly.
“Fleeing?”
The eyes of Western Floating Old Ancestor flashed coldly when he saw that, “Do you think it is that easy to hunt down experts from my Western Floating Nation? Since you dared to come, then be prepared to be killed! Die for me!”
“Hong~”
The huge array was activated. It was like a wave. To the distant, another figure appeared. That was an enormous giant who pulled along a mountain with a single hand-he was the other Paragon Master expert from the Western Floating Nation, ‘Broken Sky Paragon Master’. Broken Sky Paragon Master was filled with killing intent at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1119 - Limitless City Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 1119: Limitless City Master
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“It’s a trap!”
Xue Ying wielded the Scarlet Cloud God Spear while twisting the void. He continued teleporting as he attempted to escape. In his heart, he felt shocked, ‘Such a huge array! And Broken Sky Paragon Master is helping out too?’
“Thinking of escaping?” To the distance, Western Floating Old Ancestor discovered with a glance Xue Ying was the fastest amongst the three escaping cultivators, “Ying Shan Xue Ying? I shall kill you, this little fish, first.”
Western Floating Old Ancestor was clear in his heart.
Great Monarch Ancient Frost from the Icy Snow Ancient Nation had unparalleled existences behind his back. As for Eagle City Master from the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, he similarly had unparalleled existences backing him too! During crucial moments, the unparalleled existences would intervene and protect their subordinates.
Hence, it was tough killing experts from the ancient nations, unless they were quick enough! Or that they were currently in a special ground where unparalleled existences could not enter like the ‘Realm Heart God Palace’ or in some deeper regions in the ‘Broken Teeth Mountain Range’.
“Second Brother, we should first eliminate this Monarch Flying Snow from the Southern Cloud Nation.” At the same time when Western Floating Old Ancestor transmitted a message, his body disappeared from space. When he appeared, he was already by the side of Broken Sky Paragon Master.
“Mn, Monarch Flying Snow has just become a Cosmos God. Killing him is relatively easier. Furthermore, there is only Southern Cloud King behind him!” Broken Sky Paragon Master nodded.
Western Floating Nation King brought along Broken Sky Paragon Master.
“Shua.”
Both of them disappeared, and when they appeared again, they were in front of Xue Ying.
Xue Ying was anxiously escaping. Under the suppression of laws from the Realm Heart Great Land, he drew support from the Scarlet Cloud God Spear to execute the ‘Scarlet Cloud Domain’. Even though he could only teleport through a distance of 50 million kilometers each time, this enormous array covered a distance of 50 billion kilometers. Hence, it would take a while for Xue Ying to escape from it: ‘Not good!’ Suddenly, his pupils dilated. Xue Ying saw Western Floating Old Ancestor and Broken Sky Paragon Master appearing in front of him.
Broken Sky Paragon Master was stronger in terms of combat strength between the two! He could unquestionably exert strength at the level-three Cosmos God standard. Furthermore, he was tyrannical and overbearing.
As for ‘Western Floating Old Ancestor’, his direct combat skills barely reached the level-three Cosmos God standard. Nevertheless, he could alter his aura and could appear at any location in the Western Floating Nation. Congealing space was futile against him.
Furthermore, this body of Western Floating Old Ancestor had once been instantaneously killed by an unparalleled existence. But very soon, another new body of Western Floating Old Ancestor appeared.
He could not be killed!
He could appear anywhere!
With strength barely at the level-three Cosmos God standard, yet the techniques he had were absolutely not something level-two Cosmos Gods could wield! Hence, the Realm Heart Great Land publicly acknowledged that Western Floating Old Ancestor must have obtained a top-graded secret treasure that was geared towards survival.
“Die, Ying Shan Xue Ying!” Western Floating Nation King coldly laughed as he sent down a palm. At that moment, a huge tide of water deluged onto Xue Ying, covering him entirely.
“Shua.”
Nonetheless, Xue Ying distorted the space and teleported to a distance of 50 million kilometers away.
“You are really good at fleeing.” Western Floating Nation King frowned.
“This is the Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique!” Broken Sky Paragon Master mentioned. Western Floating Nation King then grabbed on Broken Sky Paragon Master and disappeared. They then appeared before Xue Ying in a bid to obstruct his escape.
This time, Broken Sky Paragon Master directly threw the mountain peak in his hand.
That was a gigantic mountain which smashed down from high in the sky.
‘Not good!’
Even though this mountain peak had not reached his body, Xue Ying felt his surroundings being suppressed by this mountain peak. The unseen pressure made him feel heavier by a multitude of times. He tried to move space, yet space felt incomparably heavy at this moment. Xue Ying barely teleported over a distance of half kilometers. And that huge mountain peak was more than 50 million kilometers-it came crashing down.
Xue Ying could not dodge. There was no way.
“Hua.”
Seeing that, Xue Ying immediately turned into two.
The two Xue Ying’s stood side by side. One of them had a Five Phase Beads, and the other had a Scarlet Cloud God Spear.
“Open!”
The barehanded Xue Ying raised both his hands into the sky. Those ten fingers of his expanded to massive sizes. At that juncture, every single finger of his was wrapped with five grand pillars of light, forming a huge Five Phases Sealed Space. Xue Ying had reached large success in his Five Phases Sealing Technique. Relying on the ‘Five Phase Beads’, he could genuinely exhibit strength at grand perfection, and that was unquestionably at the level-two Cosmos God standard.
Five Phase Beads
Both parties slapped out.
And that incomparably huge mountain peak continued pressing downwards! As the mountain peak crushed downwards, pitch-black cracks could be seen. Following that, the mountain slammed against the Five Phases Sealed Space, causing space to shatter.
The other Xue Ying who held onto the Scarlet Cloud God Spear immediately raised it upwards. “Hua~” as a void maelstrom surrounded the spear, the spear elongated to a distance of 5,000 kilometers long. With an upward movement, that spear struck against the bottom of that mountain peak. Even though it was slightly weaker, it still had strength at the peak of level-two Cosmos God. At the same time when the mountain peak smashed against the Five Phases Sealed Space, this spear struck over with enormous strength, causing the remaining impact to be easily withstood by Xue Ying with his Chaotic Origin Refinement Body that had the pinnacle of void-ification activated.
“What?”
Broken Sky Paragon Master was furious. He immediately controlled the enormous mountain peak, smashing it down time after time.
And these two Xue Yings’, one defended, and another retreated. Both remained perfectly uninjured.
‘Over at my hometown Primal Chaos Void, Sacred Master is an authentic final realm Cosmos God. By relying on the Ancient Sacred World, he could only injure my Chaotic Origin Refinement Body lightly. Currently, both my avatars could exhibit strength at the peak of level-two. And the shockwaves from the battle is something my body could easily withstand against. It will not even injure me at all.’ Xue Ying was having an easy time.
The Five Phases Sealing Technique was tyrannical and overbearing. It was powerful in direct combat too.
Even though the Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique was weaker in the offense-only at the first level Cosmos God standard, and the reason being that Xue Ying could not exert the full strength of the Scarlet Cloud God Spear! But he could still exert the peak of level-two strength. Furthermore, the Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique was extremely powerful in terms of survival-the combination of its protective body technique, dissipative force technique, distorting void domain, void penetration, and many other techniques.
‘Thinking of killing me? Dream on.’ Xue Ying’s eyes flashed with frost. He relied on the Devil Emperor Gown and formed a Mirage.
The Illusory Realm immediately descended upon Broken Sky Paragon Master and Western Floating Old Ancestor.
Both expressions on Broken Sky Paragon Master and Western Floating Old Ancestor changed. They exchanged glances.
“What a Monarch Flying Snow.” Western Floating Old Ancestor gave a cold snort, “We’ll let you go for now.”
“Sou, sou.”
The two of them disappeared from the vicinity.
Xue Ying grinned when he saw that. He continued escaping after that.
…
Western Floating Old Ancestor and Broken Sky Paragon Master teleported to another location.
“This Ying Shan Xue Ying has just become a Cosmos God. It is fine if he attained such a powerful strength. Who would have thought that his body cultivation is absurdly strong too? Even by relying on the array, I can’t injure him at all.” Broken Sky Paragon Master transmitted. He looked at the teleporting white-robed young man escaping. He could exert strength at the level-three Cosmos God standard without relying on the array already. Nevertheless, with the array fortifying his strength, it would reach a sufficiently strong stage that could threaten these level-two Cosmos Gods.
But.
Xue Ying who clearly just broke through not too long ago wasn’t injured in direct combat with them.
“We can’t kill him at all. Unless we made use of the Time-Space Sphere to trap him.” Western Floating Old Ancestor said, “But his teacher, the Southern Cloud King, could easily utilize the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, forcing his way into the Time-Space Sphere to save his disciple. This brat still specializes in soul techniques, affecting us constantly and preventing us from exhibiting our full strength.”
“Mn.” Broken Sky Paragon Master agreed.
The feeling of being assailed by the Illusory Realm constantly was bad. Broken Sky Paragon Master had to redirect 30% of his heart force to resist against it! Hence, it made controlling his top-graded secret treasure taxing.
“It is fine that we can’t kill Great Monarch Ancient Frost from the Icy Snow Ancient Nation during this short period since he cultivated his body to the peak of level-two. If we delayed it a little longer, the three old men from Icy Snow Ancient Nation would likely act. Instead, it is ‘Eagle City Master’ that we have hopes of killing if we are fast enough.” Broken Sky Paragon Master discussed with Western Floating Old Ancestor.
******
No other way.
Reaching the level-two Cosmos God Realm, especially for those with a huge background, it was very hard to kill them! It would be an enormous success to the Western Floating Nation if they could kill one!
Even Xue Ying had the Chaotic Origin Refinement Body, which was why he had the confidence of participating in the contest. Otherwise, he would not dare to barge into the gathering place of devils and hunt for them.
“Sou sou sou.”
Xue Ying continued teleporting using his domain.
Xue Ying had to escape out of the array region as soon as possible since he was forced to show himself within it. Once he escaped out of it, Xue Ying could rely on the pinnacle of void-ification to hide his traces.
Even though the other party could not kill him!
Those with extremely strong survivability like Xue Ying was most afraid of one thing-being trapped! By then, he had to ask his teacher for help.
“Mn?”
At the same time when Xue Ying escaped, he also discovered disturbances of the battle happening to the distance.
Great Monarch Ancient Frost was also escaping.
Instead, ‘Eagle City Master’ was currently facing danger.
“Even though Eagle City Master is more cunning and has more treacherous techniques, he is weaker in survivability.” Xue Ying could discern with a glance that Eagle City Master was in danger.
Eagle City Master belonged to the sect under ‘World Extermination God Emperor’, one of the five ancestors in Myriad Realms Ancient Nation.
“Hua.”
Suddenly, the world became quiet.
A huge and bright arm seemingly appeared from the other side of the world. It extended over to the side of Eagle City Master. That enormous arm casually dredged up, grabbing Eagle City Master easily. That made the gray-robed old man ‘Eagle City Master’ relax.
“Limitless City Master.” Western Floating Old Ancestor was shocked. He immediately brought along Broken Sky Paragon Master and retreated more than 500 billion kilometers away.
“It is Limitless City Master.” Broken Sky Paragon Master looked at the enormous dazzling arm that covered the whole sky, “Eagle City Master is a subordinate under World Extermination God-Emperor, so why would Limitless City Master act to save him?”
The Myriad Realms Ancient Nation had five ancestors.
The tyrannical and overbearing ‘World Extermination God Emperor’, the savage and brutal Realm Beast King, the transcendental ‘Drifter’…
But of the five ancestors in Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, what brought the greatest fear to cultivators from outside the nation was that Limitless City Master who created the <Ten Holy Scriptures>! Limitless City Master seemed the most gentle and mild out of everyone. He had the most concern for lower beings. Nevertheless, this seemingly gentle and pleasant Limitless City Master had the most unfathomable and unpredictable techniques. In terms of threat, he was unquestionably first amongst the five ancestors from the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1120 - The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind
chapters.content:
Chapter 1120: The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Limitless City Master had green skin. He also had two blood-colored horns protruding from his head. His eyes were special-they were filled with kindness. Even a weak sentient-less creature would not feel threatened at all in front of Limitless City Master. Limitless City Master was like a part of this endless world-he did not give out any aura, and neither did he give out any suppression. He seemed ordinary.
“City Master, I’ll have to trouble you.” World Extermination God Emperor transmitted. Reaching his level, he would not easily ask others for help. But ‘Eagle City Master’ was an important subordinate of his that had to be protected.
“This is a minor matter.” Limitless City Master transmitted over.
Only that his eyes remained firmly locked to the southeast.
Over in that direction…
He could feel a familiar old friend of his.
“I would not have thought that you have returned.” Limitless City Master’s voice conversed with a terrifying existence through thought.
“Haha, I knew that I would definitely be discovered by you after slightly revealing my aura! In the entire Realm Heart Great Land, I can hide my identity against others, but it’s only you that I can’t hide it.” The thought from that terrifying existence was filled with death and destruction. Just by slightly sensing it would cause one’s soul to feel as if he had entered an eternal nightmare.
Limitless City Master responded: “Why? Have you not taken that last step? That time, you were quite unbridled in your actions of leaving Realm Heart Great Land to find your path. I thought you would have grasped the Supreme Law after such a long period. Who would have thought that you still remain the same as us.”
“Take that last step? How is it that easy?” The thought from that terrifying existence replied only after a period.
“You did not grasp the best chance! From now on, you can only force your way to your Dao path.” Limitless City Master transmitted back, “But it was rumored that Luo City Lord from the Origin Great Land formed his own Dao path using force. You might be able to do so!”
“Don’t rejoice in my misfortune.”
The terrifying thought receded and no longer cared to talk.
Forcing one’s Dao path was too difficult.
Limitless City Master also kept his thought. Even though they exchanged a few pleasantries, he still muttered to himself lightly: “Another one that failed. Hmph, thinking of leaving the Realm Heart Great Land for the last gamble without sufficient accumulation?”
******
Western Floating Nation.
Xue Ying watched as that huge arm grabbed onto Eagle City Master before easily disappearing from the scene. He could not help but feel startled.
‘Limitless City Master… when can I reach this realm too?’ Xue Ying was extremely envious. Naturally, he could also bring his family and good friends away to other Origin World once he reached the final realm. After all, the Primal Chaos Void was too far away from the Realm Heart Great Land. If he chose to bring someone with him through the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’, Xue Ying could not travel to a faraway place. He could only find an Origin World that was close to his hometown.
‘Hurry up and leave!’
Holding on to the Scarlet Cloud God Spear, Xue Ying continued flying forward at high speed.
The void distorted. “Shua shua shua!” In the blink of an eye, Xue Ying teleported eight to ten times. He soon rushed out of the final lap. After all, the entire array covered only a distance of 500 billion kilometers, and he was merely a few dozen billion kilometers away from the boundary.
‘I am out.’
Even though the array was formidable, Xue Ying easily penetrated out of it using his pinnacle of void-ification.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying let out a sigh of relief. After coming out, he teleported to a faraway distance before concealing himself using the pinnacle of void-ification. Only then did he relax and watch Great Monarch Ancient Frost battle with Western Floating Old Ancestor and Broken Sky Paragon Master.
‘It seems that Western Floating Old Ancestor and others can’t kill anyone this time.’ Xue Ying thought after seeing that.
That was normal.
How could level-two Cosmos Gods be so easy to kill? Unless unparalleled existences acted together, but all of them were at the highest level in the entire Realm Heart Great Land and they regarded their reputation highly. They would rather indulge some enemies from all over the place since to them, these enemies were a form of training for their subordinates.
“Hong.””Hong.”
Xue Ying suddenly turned around looking towards the south and north. After fusing into the essence of the void, his perception became more acute. He could sense huge battles happening over at two locations.
‘Battles?’
‘I’ve waited for over 50,000, yet not a single battle has happened! Now that Western Floating Old Ancestor and the others acted and after Limitless City Master intervened, it appears that battles are starting in other places too? Have they discovered other members of the Four Vicious of Western Floating?’ Xue Ying immediately investigated.
He first checked to the south.
Far away to the south, there were two parties fighting.
One was a black-armored expert who wielded twin blades. His figure was like an illusion. Every time he sent a blade over, it would cause the surroundings to annihilate and disappear into nothingness. His opponent was ‘Monarch Demonic Heart’, one of the Four Vicious of Western Floating. Currently, Monarch Demonic Heart was having a hard time defending himself against the assailant. Every time he was struck, his body would transform into water.
‘It is ‘Great Commander Hui Yue’, a Paragon Master. He should have been searching for Monarch Demonic Heart a long time ago… and only acted after Western Floating Old Ancestor and Broken Sky Paragon Master moved. Was he then making use of this opportunity to deal against Monarch Demonic Heart?’ Xue Ying understood this point, ‘Even though there is a gap between them, killing Monarch Demonic Heart isn’t something easy.’
Great Commander Hui Yue.
He was a subordinate of Primogenitor Ancient Nation’s ‘Eternal Night Primogenitor’. Eternal Night Primogenitor naturally trusted the Nine Eternal Night Walkers he refined the most. Even though Great Commander Hui Yue wasn’t one of them, because he was strong, his status amongst Eternal Night Primogenitor’s subordinates was the highest.
…
Xue Ying broke apart the world, investigating the battle happening to the north next.
At a very far away distance.
“Mn?” Xue Ying was shocked.
The one being pursued was ‘Devil Monarch Yan Fire’, one of the Four Vicious of Western Floating. He was extremely powerful and wasn’t someone to rile. But at this moment, Devil Monarch Yan Fire was fleeing.
‘It’s him?’ Xue Ying saw the one chasing after Devil Monarch Yan Fire. He was a demonic bald-headed male with red eyebrows. Two little golden serpents hung over his ears. Currently, he was pursuing his target with a wooden rod in his hand.
‘Nine Venom Religion Master?’
He finally saw someone from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
This time, there were three Paragon Masters in Summer Wind Ancient Nation that contested for a slot. There was no need to talk about ‘Great Paragon Fuyi’ for his status was too high. He would most likely be disdained to compete with the others on which target to assassinate. The other two were ‘Fire Devil Paragon Master’ and ‘Nine Venom Religion Master’. Nine Venom Religion Master was famous for using hex poison. He was not an easy person to deal with. Furthermore, by relying on his secret treasure-the wooden rod, his hex poison would become more fearsome.
No wonder ‘Devil Monarch Yan Fire’ was escaping as if his life depended on it.
‘Mn? No harm trying!’ With a thought, Xue Ying immediately rushed over. Currently, he merely needed to teleport once to arrive at a location close to the battlefield. Once he got closer, Xue Ying could only get closer by moving through space since the current environment was sealed.
******
Devil Monarch Yan Fire felt unpleasant. His soul had been permeated with hex poison. Even as a level-two Cosmos God, he still felt many spells of dizziness. Currently, he could only force it down. It was still within bearable limits, but if he continued fighting, it would become dangerous for him.
If there were nobody pursuing after him, he could expel the poison out of his body calmly and peacefully. But now, ‘Nine Venom Religion Master’ was pursuing after him.
“Damn, even Nine Venom Religion Master participated in the contest.”
Devil Monarch Yan Fire would prefer fighting other Paragon Masters and not against this Nine Venom Religion Master.
“Old Ancestor, Old Ancestor, Nine Venom Religion Master is chasing after me. I can’t hold on any longer!” Devil Monarch Yan Fire was transmitting his help. Even though he could still hold on for a little longer, he dared not take the risk.
“I’ll come over at this moment!” Western Floating Old Ancestor did not dare to be slow.
“Just die!”
Nine Venom Religion Master was also doing his best to pursue after his target. He was afraid of Western Floating Old Ancestor appearing directly and taking away his target.
Suddenly-
“Hua.”
Five light pillars appeared abruptly. They enveloped around Devil Monarch Yan Fire. Furthermore, a terrifying Mirage and Illusory Realm permeated into the soul of Devil Monarch Yan Fire simultaneously.
“Not good!” Devil Monarch Yan Fire felt the Mirage and Illusory Realm directly invading his soul. At this moment, he immediately felt himself falling into the illusion. At that juncture, he knew he would be dead the moment he gave in completely. Hence, he threw in all his willpower to struggle, yet under the influence of the hex poison where he could barely maintain his state of mind, it was impossible for him to execute any formidable moves with his weapon in his hand, much less shaking the Five Phases Sealed Space.
“Sou.”
The Five Phases Sealed Space immediately shrunk.
“Hold!” Western Floating Old Ancestor finally appeared. He sent a palm over furiously, yet a spear came out from the void. It directly resisted against the fierce strike from Western Floating Old Ancestor.
With that slight delay, Xue Ying had sufficient time to keep the Five Phases Sealed Space into the Five Phase Beads on his wrist.
‘I actually succeeded?’ Xue Ying felt pleasantly surprised.
He only reckoned that Devil Monarch Yan Fire was not in an optimal state as he was being pursued. Hence, that was why Xue Ying came to gamble! Who knew if he might earn some small advantage? By relying on the pinnacle of void-ification, Xue Ying arrived stealthily beside Devil Monarch Yan Fire. After that, he did not care-he released both the Mirage and Illusory Realm and Five Phases Sealing Technique. Who would have guessed that he had succeeded!
“Ying Shan Xue Ying!” Western Floating Old Ancestor was incomparably furious at this moment.
Initially, he wanted to set an ambush, making sure those Cosmos Gods suffer from losses. Even though he could not kill them, he wanted them to know that Western Floating Nation was not a country to offend.
Under normal circumstances, even though they could not kill the incoming Cosmos Gods, it would be hard for those incoming Cosmos Gods to kill the top devils from Western Floating Nation too! After all, they were under the protection of Western Floating Old Ancestor!
But…
At this moment, Xue Ying actually cut off a piece of their meat. Western Floating Old Ancestor felt both startled and angry at the same time.
“Hurry up and leave!”
Xue Ying felt pleasantly surprised at his accidental harvest. He did not dare to tarry. While maintaining the pinnacle of void-ification, Xue Ying began escaping from the scene.
Regardless of who it was, Western Floating Old Ancestor or Nine Venom Religion Master, none of them were able to discover Xue Ying as he concealed himself using the pinnacle of void-ification.
“I was actually taken advantage of by that brat from the Southern Cloud Nation?” Nine Venom Religion Master wasn’t confident of succeeding this time. But he still attempted when Limitless City Master acted to see his luck. Nonetheless, Xue Ying came in and plucked that fruit which he planted painstakingly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1121 - Southern Cloud King’s Teacher
chapters.content:
Chapter 1121: Southern Cloud King’s Teacher
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
‘I actually succeeded? This is… truly… truly an unexpected harvest!’ Xue Ying felt excited. He maintained the pinnacle of void-ification and controlled space distortion to escape. As he escaped, once he reached outside the sealed spatial region, with a teleport, Xue Ying left the Western Floating Nation entirely.
Since he had already captured Devil Monarch Yan Fire alive, Xue Ying no longer cared about staying at Western Floating Nation.
‘Time to go back.’
He executed the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique.
Xue Ying stepped into the distorted spatial maelstrom. When he appeared, he had already covered more than half the entire Realm Heart Great Land, arriving at the Southern Cloud Nation, Flying Snow City.
“I’m back.”
Flying Snow City, within the Monarch Residence. As Xue Ying returned, he could not help but reveal a vibrant grin.
The Monarch Residence had just been constructed. The entire Flying Snow City was also undergoing large-scale expanding work. The original city became an inner-city, with an outer-city being constructed that was ten times the size of the inner city.
“Monarch.”
“Monarch.”
The rules in the Monarch Residence were more strict. The female attendants all respectfully greeted.
“It is rare for my son to come out.” Knowing that his son had come out, Ying Shan Lie Hu immediately rushed out. Currently, his status in the Monarch Residence was extremely high. Naturally, he was full of mettle. After all, the entire Ying Shan Clan was faintly being led over from this Flying Snow City!
“Father.” Xue Ying greeted.
“Haha, don’t just remain in closed-door cultivating all the time! I’ve heard of how unparalleled existences in Realm Heart Great Land frequently go traveling around the world.” Ying Shan Lie Hu carefully advised him. He did not know of the opening of Realm Heart God Palace, “Oh right, I’ve just bought some good wine over. How about trying it, Xue Ying?”
Ying Shan Lie Hu was very careful.
His relationship with this son wasn’t that close. After all, he did not value Rong Xing Lan in the past. Yet his son was way too dazzling! As a result, Ying Shan Lie Hu was doing his best to get closer from then on with his son, but to no avail, since his son was too powerful. That time, his son had gone into closed-door cultivation for a short period when he handled the danger which engulfed the entire Ardent Fire City personally. And now, the strength of his son became even more unfathomable. It was said that his son had been presented the identity of an Upper Honored Guest in one of the six great ancient nations, the ‘Summer Wind Ancient Nation’!
“Alright.” Xue Ying nodded with a smile, “I’ll have a taste to see how the wine tastes.”
“Wuu…” Ying Shan Lie Hu was only suggesting the idea without expecting his son to accept him. Joyfully, he continued, “Go go go, where shall we go? Why not come visit the newly constructed garden of mine?”
Xue Ying nodded. He was feeling extremely pleasant at currently.
…
Xue Ying was currently feeling extremely good. It was rare for him to drink with his father, Ying Shan Lie Hu, over the night.
Over this period, news of him capturing ‘Devil Monarch Yan Fire’ alive in Western Floating Nation began spreading like wildfire, especially within Summer Wind Ancient Nation and the nearby vassal nations.
In the Summer Wind Capital, inside a wooden house that was relatively quiet.
There was a male wearing loose robes seated cross-legged on a praying mat. There was currently a bead lighted dimly floating over his head. The bead contained golden inscriptions that were continually moving as if they held all sorts of profound mysteries within the Origin World. He was ‘Great Paragon Fuyi’, a famous character across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. His name was made through many fierce and terrifying battles.
The entire Summer Clan might have nine Great Paragons, but the status of Great Paragon Fuyi was different from others. He was actually the most famous master that others feared whenever the Summer Clan carried out campaigns outside!
Even though Southern Cloud King and Western Floating Old Ancestor were absolute overlords, it was more so because they were great at survival.
And Great Paragon Fuyi was not only good at survival, but his direct combat power was also extremely high and frightening.
There was once when the disciple of Great Paragon Fuyi greatly suffered. Consequently, Great Paragon Fuyi killed his way into the Sky Towering Ancient Nation as revenge. With nine great avatars coming out, experts in the Sky Towering Ancient Nation could not obstruct him! He killed his way undefeated into the Sky Towering Ancient Nation. And in the end, that unparalleled existence in ‘Sky Towering Ancient Nation’ had to personally act, yet Great Paragon Fuyi could still exchange moves without dying!
Hence, his reputation was unquestionably formed through battles!
‘Emperor Summer’ also favored this great general subordinate of his that had the greatest combat power. He bestowed upon Great Paragon Fuyi three top-graded secret treasures, and that wasn’t considered much! Great Paragon Fuyi was a pervert that reached the peak of level-two Cosmos God Realm in both ‘Dao of Void’ and ‘Dao of Light’. He fused both Daos together, allowing every avatar of his to be abnormally strong. Hence, when the nine great avatars worked together, ordinary level-three Cosmos Gods were not his opponent. Even Sky Towering King could not defeat Great Paragon Fuyi entirely.
That was why his participation in the contest had startled both Xue Ying and Southern Cloud King.
“Great Paragon.” A young man respectfully said from outside the wooden house, “There is news coming from within the clan, saying that Monarch Flying Snow has already captured
Devil Monarch Yan Fire from Western Floating Nation alive.”
“Oh? Captured alive?” The long narrow eyes of Great Paragon Fuyi opened.
“Yes, it is rumored that Devil Monarch Yan Fire first suffered from the assassination by Nine Venom Religion Master. After a huge battle, Devil Monarch Yan Fire was heavily injured and forced to escape. As he was escaping, Monarch Flying Snow sneaked close to him using the pinnacle of void-ification before directly exhibiting the Five Phases Sealing Technique! Furthermore, it was reckoned that Monarch Flying Snow had utilized the Mirage and Illusory Realm Technique.” The young man explained, “Hence, given his heavy injuries, Devil Monarch Yan Fire wasn’t able to break apart the Five Phases Sealed Space and was kept into the Five Phase Beads in the end.”
“Interesting.” Great Paragon Fuyi slightly nodded, “It seems this contest has become more interesting.”
He wasn’t worried at all about getting a slot.
In terms of treasures, he could compare with some of the unparalleled existences! By taking out a precious treasure, he could completely earn sufficient contribution points for the ‘special treasure missions’! Even though Fire Devil Paragon Master and Nine Venom Religion Master were famous, compared to Great Paragon Fuyi, they were honestly too poor!
…
“What? That Southern Cloud Nation brat has captured Devil Monarch Yan Fire alive? He is so lucky?” The huge figure of ‘Fire Devil Paragon Master’ was currently seated on top of a mountain at Black Devil Great Lake. His figure was big, so much bigger than the small mountain peak he was on. To him, he could simply charge his way through the entire Black Devil Great Lake! There was nothing that he feared.
“The bounty of Fire Devil Paragon Master is worth 12,000 contribution points. Fuyi that old man will definitely be taking one spot among the quotas! It isn’t easy for those Cosmos Gods from the three great clans to admit defeat that easily. Who would have thought that this brat from the Southern Cloud Nation would have appeared.” The eyes of Devil Monarch Yan Fire were filled with murder.
Actually, most did not participate in the contest because ‘they had to get the spot’! For instance, even though Nine Venom Religion Master wanted to go, it was also fine if he did not get the spot. Of course, he would try his best, but even if he did not get it, he could simply wait for the next contest.
Nevertheless, things were different for Fire Devil Paragon Master this time. He had to enter, and hence, he had to find a way to get into the top four. Furthermore, given his pride, he felt that he would get second at least! He would only allow Great Paragon Fuyi to be ranked before him.
“He has just earned 12,000 contribution points. I have to get around 30,000 contribution points before it is possible for me to get second.” Fire Devil Paragon Master frowned.
Earning contribution points through missions were too difficult.
…
“Southern Cloud Nation, Ying Shan Xue Ying?”
A messy-haired male currently meditating in closed-door with a god sword placed on his knees grinned when he got the news, “Quite formidable.”
******
As the news spread, it gave those participating Cosmos Gods a huge pressure, and also gave experts across the entire Realm Heart Great Land a deeper understanding of Monarch Flying Snow from Southern Cloud Nation! For him to steal away the food of Nine Venom Religion Master in ‘Western Floating Nation’, capturing Devil Monarch Yan Fire alive, showed how frightening this ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ was.
Southern Cloud Capital, within the royal palace.
“Southern Cloud, this disciple of yours is quite amazing to capture a level-two Cosmos God alive.” A handsome young man wearing a luxurious golden robe with a golden crown on his head said from the throne. An aura of death and destruction emanated from his body. Even though it felt mild, it still gave Southern Cloud King who sat by the side serving him a huge deal of unseen pressure.
Southern Cloud King answered: “It is because this disciple of mine reincarnated into this world. His strength is still vastly weaker than mine and isn’t worth mentioning.”
He did want this ‘teacher’ of his to pay notice to Xue Ying.
To this cheap teacher of his, he did not have any emotions. Instead, he was fearful of him!
“Are you afraid of me?” The luxurious golden-robed handsome young man smiled at Southern Cloud King. His black hair spread apart somewhere by the side.
“When Teacher caused the entire Realm Heart Great Land to shudder from your prowess, I had just become a Cosmos God. I am naturally reverent of you, Teacher.” Southern Cloud King replied.
“Even though this is our first time meeting, you would understand my temper after staying together for a period. I have left the Realm Heart Great Land for far too long, and do not have many subordinates left. You are at least the most useful amongst them.” The luxurious golden-robed handsome young man softly sighed,” Time is really merciless. Quite a few old friends of mine are no longer around. Oh right, I need you to prepare for me ten pieces of ‘Song Yang Fruit’. I will be preparing to visit the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.”
“Yes, Teacher. It’ll be done in three days.” Southern Cloud King answered.
“There is no need to rush. I have plenty of time.” The luxurious golden-robed handsome young man answered, “Oh right, remember to keep the news about my return a secret. Not many knew about it currently.”
“Yes.” Southern Cloud King hurriedly replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 1122 - Great Paragon Iron Wind
chapters.content:
Chapter 1122: Great Paragon Iron Wind
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The luxurious golden-robed young man nodded slightly. He then stood up and disappeared.
Even though his methods were formidable, Southern Cloud King controlled the arrays of the entire capital. Hence, he was able to perceive that this cheap teacher of his had left.
‘I hadn’t thought that he would actually come back.’ Southern Cloud King frowned, ‘Truly unlucky.’
This was the first time he met his teacher.
In the past, Southern Cloud King fled like a stray dog from his enemies. But whether it was his fortune or not, he had been able to get his hands on a top-graded secret treasure, the ‘Twin Realm Blade’. That was also the reason why he could turn his fate! In reality, this top-graded secret treasure, ‘Twin Realm Blade’, had been left in an ancient remnant deliberately by his current teacher. If he wanted to acquire it, he had to first swear an oath and take the other party as a teacher!
And that oath was restrictive.
Reaching the level of Southern Cloud King, he would not encounter any danger even if he went against the oath. It would only be disobeying his Dao Heart, making it harder to improve further on the road of cultivation. But to the ambitious Southern Cloud King, he would not violate the oath until the very last moment.
‘That time, the only desire I had was to change my fortune. Furthermore, I thought he had already fallen. Who would have thought that he actually came back.’ Southern Cloud King shook his head. In the past, he was in such a desperate situation that he did not hesitate to accept an unparalleled existence as a teacher that was missing for ages.
And now, his teacher came back.
This was the first time they met. And for Southern Cloud King, firstly, he did not wish to violate the oath. Secondly, he did not wish to offend this teacher of his! After all, he had just become a Cosmos God when the other party was an overlord moving unhindered across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. He understood how frightening the other party was.
‘If I truly offended him, the entire Southern Cloud Nation, other than me, would be wiped out.’ Southern Cloud King sighed inwardly.
The presence of the other party represented death in the past!
And now, his teacher might have become stronger. Hence, Southern Cloud King would rather tolerate and endure it instead of offending his teacher at the current moment.
******
Flying Snow City.
Xue Ying accompanied his teacher Ying Shan Lie Hu to drink the entire night before returning to his own courtyard. He sat down cross-legged within the pavilion beside a lake. Looking at the Five Phase Beads that appeared on his wrist, he immediately sent an avatar into one of the beads.
Within the world of the Five Phase Beads.
Xue Ying appeared in midair. With a glance, he saw the cross-legged seated Devil Monarch Yan Fire amidst the vast world currently trying to expel the hex poison in his body. A night passed, and Devil Monarch Yan Fire had also expelled close to half the hex poison in his body. Nevertheless, Devil Monarch Yan Fire did not feel happy at all. Instead, his heart was heavy because he knew death had knocked on his door.
“You came.” Devil Monarch Yan Fire looked at Xue Ying.
Xue Ying chuckled. He waited for a night before coming to see Devil Monarch Yan Fire precisely because he wanted the other party to calm down.
“Devil Monarch Yan Fire, currently, there are two routes you can take.” Xue Ying stated, “The first route is for me to kill you and take away your treasures. The second route is for you to give me your treasures willingly, and I’ll send you over to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation! Even though you might be punished by the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, they would only force you to work for them. At least you could survive then.”
It wasn’t hard for Xue Ying to kill Devil Monarch Yan Fire given that he was trapped in the Five Phase Beads.
As long as both parties started fighting! Given that the Five Phase Beads completely isolated the inner space, it would block off any permeance of World Energy. Without this source of World Energy, Devil Monarch Yan Fire would slowly consume his energy and would be doomed!
“Since I have been captured by you alive, I can only work for the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. What else can I do?” Devil Monarch Yan Fire muttered with disappointment.
He did not have any other choices!
Those devils that were weaker would be killed by the six great ancient nations.
And most Cosmos Gods had practical value! Every ancient nation had a group of ‘hired thugs’ concealed in the dark. Like the Moonflower Ancient Nation and Towering Sky Ancient Nation, these weaker ancient nations took the initiative to hire some huge devils over. They did not forbid those devils; instead, they gave them freedom.
“Very good.” Xue Ying said. He casually extended his hand, sending in a strand of Cosmos God energy directly into the body of Devil Monarch Yan Fire. Devil Monarch Yan Fire did not obstruct it as well.
Xue Ying easily examined through the body of Devil Monarch Yan Fire once through.
All secret treasures that Devil Monarch Yan Fire had flown out. Devil Monarch Yan Fire did not stop.
Reaching this predicament, he knew what to do.
“You will eventually be free one day once you worked sufficiently for the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.” Xue Ying checked through. He was quite pleased with his harvests.
Because by sending a devil alive over, the Summer Wind Ancient Nation would gain an additional hired thug after restricting him! Other than gaining the respective contribution points from the mission, he would still be rewarded with cosmos crystals! This Devil Monarch Yan Fire would most likely earn him upwards of 10 billion cosmos crystals. Even though it was relatively low as compared to the value of what Devil Monarch Yan Fire could bring, it was still a set of benefits.
And to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, they had to pay contribution points and benefits to the Honored Guests for every mission the Honored Guests completed! Some of the more powerful Honored Guests might grumble and decline to accept the mission.
But these ‘hired thugs’ were different. The ancient nation did not have to give them any benefits! They dared not disobey the orders too!
‘After roaming through the world for so many years, I finally fell in the hands of this Monarch Flying Snow.’ Devil Monarch Yan Fire sat cross-legged. Even though he felt sorrowful, he knew what he should do now.
…
Xue Ying stayed within the Flying Snow City. He no longer went hunt for other ‘preys’.
Because he was clear that capturing Devil Monarch Yan Fire alive had simply been due to his great fortune!
According to experience.
It was quite good to kill a target during the quota contest in Summer Wind Ancient Nation which was held every time the Realm Heart God Palace opens! Because ultimately, those listed targets were very tough to assassinate! If not for Xue Ying’s cunningness in stealthily inching closer to the side of the enemy using his pinnacle of void-ification, and if not for the help by Nine Venom Religion Master, and for Western Floating Old Ancestor to be slowed by a step, Xue Ying would not have succeeded.
Hence, he knew he lucked out.
Furthermore, of all targets that were listed, only ‘Devil Monarch Wind Moon’ was someone which Xue Ying’s strength curbed entirely. But Devil Monarch Wind Moon knew his weakness in his heart temperament. Hence, he chose to hide in the treasure brought by Western Floating Old Ancestor all the time! That was why most would discover that the position of Devil Monarch Wind Moon coinciding with Western Floating Old Ancestor’s position, which was how Western Floating Old Ancestor succeeded in disguising as Devil Monarch Wind Moon!
Naturally…
The other Devil Monarchs dared not remain in the Eden Treasure which Western Floating Old Ancestor brought along because Western Floating Old Ancestor wasn’t considered strong. It was only that he could rapidly form a new body after one of his bodies died. Hence, if all four Great Devil Monarchs hid in the same place, some powerful existences like Great Paragon Fuyi might team up and grab all of them in one fell swoop.
‘It is good to kill one or two targets during the quota contest of Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Most of the participants accumulated their points through the special treasure missions rather.’ Xue Ying thought.
‘Those special treasure missions listed by Summer Wind Ancient Nation call for relatively rare and limited resources.’ Xue Ying thought.
Even the three great clans of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation desired those items.
Hence, it would have to be rare.
But no matter how precious these special treasures were, there was one point of similarity-they were hard to find!
Most of those participating in the contest that was relatively strong would have spent most of their time searching for those special treasures. According to history, it was possible to get a quota after earning ‘10,000’ contribution points’ or so! But there were times in history where one had to earn 12,000 contribution points to get a quota, and some times, just 5,000 was sufficient!
Since a participant could get a quota with such little points, one could see how difficult the ‘assassination missions’ and ‘special treasure missions’ were.
…
Xue Ying sat cross-legged in the pavilion enjoying the dull fragrance from the heated wine. Suddenly, he sensed something and looked over.
“Hua.”
A figure condensed out on the lake beside him. He was a yellow-robed male with a protruding forehead.
Xue Ying was shocked. He immediately stood: “Greetings, Great Paragon.”
Impressively, the one that came was one of the nine Great Paragons from the Summer Clan, ‘Great Paragon Iron Wind’. In terms of strength, he was comparable with Broken Sky Paragon Master from the Floating West Nation and was ranked relatively behind. Actually, most Paragon Masters were typically at his level of combat strength too.
But no matter what, the other party was a core of the Summer Clan.
“Monarch Flying Snow.” Great Paragon Iron Wind stepped through the void over with a smile. After reaching the pavilion, he sniffed, “This wine smells quite good. I wonder if it is possible for me to try a few cups?”
“It is Flying Snow’s honor to drink with Great Paragon.” Xue Ying immediately answered.
Great Paragon Iron Wind immediately sat.
Only then did Xue Ying sit.
No other choice.
Even if they were comparable in strength, those from outside Summer Wind Ancient Nation would be weaker by a level when facing against Great Paragons in the nation! After all, the other party had a group of helpers, and furthermore, he was weaker.
“Mn, relatively flavorful.” Great Paragon Iron Wind placed down the wine cup and said with a grin, “I’ve heard the news of Monarch Flying Snow capturing that Devil Monarch Yan Fire alive. I truly admire you for that.”
“It is merely luck.” Xue Ying replied.
“This isn’t just luck. Without Monarch’s void-ification techniques, how were you able to get close without alerting both Devil Monarch Yan Fire and Nine Venom Religion Master? Without your Mirage and Illusory Realm techniques, how could you have such an easy time imprisoning him?” Great Paragon Iron Wind responded.
Xue Ying revealed a smile: “You’ve flattered me.”
Even though he might have said that, he felt quite happy in his heart still.
“Haha, that Devil Monarch Yan Fire did not seek to die right?” Great Paragon Iron Wind asked.
“He didn’t.” Xue Ying said, “He will work for the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.”
Great Paragon Iron Wind softly nodded, saying: “I have a matter which I have to ask Monarch Flying Snow for help.”
Xue Ying felt his heart paralyzing for a moment.
Unless…
“Great Paragon, please say. If it is something I can help, I’ll definitely do so.” Xue Ying continued.
Great Paragon Iron Wind nodded: “Monarch Flying Snow is still very young. Furthermore, you have only become a Cosmos God not too long ago and have yet to reach a bottleneck. I presume you aren’t in a rush to breakthrough. That is why I came this time… I have a good friend of mine in Summer Clan who cultivated to a bottleneck. That is why he wants to enter the Realm Heart God Palace. Hence, I am here requesting for Monarch Flying Snow to forsake and pass this Devil Monarch Yan Fire to me. Rest assured, I will not take advantage of Monarch Flying Snow. I’ll pay you 30 billion cosmos crystals as a form of compensation.”
Xue Ying’s expression slightly changed.
Compensation?
By the time the 90,000 years is up, Xue Ying would obtain 12,000 contribution points by handing this devil monarch over! That was equivalent to 10 billion cosmos crystals. Just this reason alone was worth beyond 30 billion cosmos crystals because he could exchange contribution points for cosmos crystals, but not the other way around! Furthermore, by relying on the contribution points, Xue Ying could obtain a slot to enter the Realm Heart God Palace-that was worth way beyond what was offered!
“Great Paragon, I have also reached a bottleneck in my cultivation. That is why I have to enter the Realm Heart God Palace.” Xue Ying answered.
He wasn’t lying.
Shortly after becoming a Cosmos God, Xue Ying had reached the Cosmos God Realm in all nine branches of the Dao of Void as his accumulations were too thick. After cultivating for another 10 billion years, he had already reached a bottleneck in the fusion between the ‘Sky Phase’ and ‘Earth Phase’, and would be stepping into the level-two Cosmos God Realm soon later.
“Monarch Flying Snow, if you were to accept my conditions, I’ll owe you a favor as well.” Great Paragon Iron Wind added.
Xue Ying felt frustrated in his heart. Favor?
If the other party were Great Paragon Fuyi, the value would be extremely high. As for ‘Great Paragon Iron Wind’? He was only slightly stronger than him, so how useful could his favor be?
“Why, you aren’t willing?” Great Paragon Iron Wind frowned, “Are you thinking it is too little? That good friend of mine has offered 30 billion cosmos crystals, but I can increase it to 50 billion cosmos crystals! This should be sufficient to complement your losses. Monarch Flying Snow, you are still so young! Why are you so anxious? There are so many more opportunities for you in the future.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1123 - Different Methods
chapters.content:
Chapter 1123: Different Methods
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
He would have many more opportunities in the future?
Did he not have to fight for a slot in the future too? Furthermore, his hometown Origin World was expanding continuously. If he did not reach the final realm of Cosmos God before his hometown entered apocalypse, he could not save his friends and loved ones. Xue Ying did not have time to waste.
“Great Paragon Iron Wind .” Xue Ying’s eyes became sharp. He stared at Great Paragon Iron Wind, “This opportunity to enter the Realm Heart God Palace is something I have to acquire. Please pardon me for not being able to acquiesce with your request.”
“You…” The expression of Great Paragon Iron Wind shifted.
“This is my cultivation path. There is no way for me to give in to you on that.” Xue Ying calmly mentioned. His voice was filled with resolution.
I’ve already given you sufficient respect! I did not intend to become an enemy with you, but if you truly wanted to tear apart all decorum… then whatever techniques you have, just send them over! I am not afraid!
Only after reaching the level of Xue Ying would he be qualified to challenge the other party.
“No way for you to give in to me? Good.” Great Paragon Iron Wind immediately stood. He no longer spoke. Taking a step, he disappeared from the vicinity.
Xue Ying stood up watching silently.
…
Summer Wind Capital.
Within a luxurious residence, Great Paragon Iron Wind descended from the sky.
“Brother Iron Wind, how was it?” A green-robed male came over to welcome him. Seeing the expression on Great Paragon Iron Wind, he felt his heart swell.
“Younger Brother Thousand Yang, that Ying Shan Xue Ying mentioned about how ‘This is his cultivation path. There is no way for him to give in to you on that.’ He rather dies than to agree.” Great Paragon Iron Wind softly shook his head, “Ai, I can’t do much as your brother in this case.”
The green-robed male added: “I am already feeling grateful for Brother Iron Wind personally stepping forward for me. Furthermore, I only harbored a strand of hope if that Ying Shan Xue Ying doesn’t desire that strongly to enter, I can make a trade with him. Since he isn’t willing, then it’s fine too. I’ll think of another way.”
“Then what about the contribution points which you have accumulated currently?” Great Paragon Iron Wind asked.
“I’ll think of ways. With some help from my old friends, I could only make up a total of 8,000 contribution points.” The green-robed male softly shook his head, “If I don’t suppress Ying Shan Xue Ying, it’ll be quite hard to enter the top four.”
Great Paragon Iron Wind frowned: “These special treasure missions are too difficult.”
He also wanted to help his good friend get a quota.
His good friend ‘Monarch Thousand Yang’ was a well-known figure in the younger generation of Cosmos Gods within the Summer Clan. He was even the personal disciple of Emperor Summer! Monarch Thousand Yang was heavily favored by a few Great Paragons even.
Nevertheless, as the Summer Clan was the leading clan amongst the three clans, they had many experts. The entire clan was given just two quotas-one given to Paragon Masters, and another given to Cosmos Gods to compete for. Even though ‘Monarch Thousand Yang’ was dazzling, the competition was too intense. Hence, he did not get it in the end and had to compete for the four other quotas set aside for the public.
One had to know that even Great Paragon Fuyi was competing with the external world.
They had no choice. The Summer Clan had too many experts! And there were some latent rules of rotation too.
“8,000 contribution points is insufficient.” Great Paragon Iron Wind pondered bitterly.
“I shall pay Primogenitor Ancient Nation a visit to see if I could get more contribution points.” The green-robed Monarch Thousand Yang said.
…
Within a wooden house.
A loose-robed male sat cross-legged on the praying mat. He was Great Paragon Fuyi. At this moment, he was smiling at the person in front. Not far away, there was a bald old man seated cross-legged too. This bald old man had a black gown draped over him. The black gown contained some crimson floral patterns that emanated a bloody and savage aura.
“Fuyi, this is the ‘Golden Indigo Serpent Fruit’ which you require.” the bald old man extended his hand. On his palm, a crystalline box appeared. The box automatically opened, revealing a queer fruit within. The skin of the fruit was crystalline and translucent. Inside the fruit shimmered with both gold and indigo-these two strands of light were chasing after each other endlessly! And the trajectory of pursuit gave off the sense of Supreme Law.
The Golden Indigo Serpent Fruit was ranked at the frontmost of all special treasure missions. It was only produced in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, and could be exchanged for 30,000 contribution points! If one sold this fruit, it would not be hard to sell it for 80 billion cosmos crystals! But none would sell it. Every consumption of such a rare item in the entire Realm Heart Great Land would mean one less of said item.
“The item that I need?” The bald old man stared at Great Paragon Fuyi.
“This Golden Indigo Serpent Fruit has really fallen into your hands, Namosa, you are cunning enough.” Great Paragon Fuyi smiled.
“Where is it.” The bald old man coldly repeated.
Great Paragon Fuyi waved his hand. At that moment, rings of golden halo appeared-a total of 18 of them.
When the bald old man saw it, his eyes blazed with passion. He wanted to immediately get it yet he dared not snatch it from the other party.
“This is yours.” Great Paragon Fuyi waved his hand, causing those golden halos to fly towards the bald old man. Only then did the bald old man grab those halos. Looking at them, his eyes became red: “I’ve finally gotten it!” In the past, he almost got this treasure, yet Great Paragon Fuyi was stronger than him, killing everyone in the way before bringing away all the treasures.
Great Paragon Fuyi also took the Golden Indigo Serpent Fruit with a single move.
“You are really willing.” The bald old man looked at Great Paragon Fuyi, “Given your identity, your Summer Clan will most likely give you a slot if you asked for it, isn’t it? Why the need to come out and compete for it? And to even offer the Golden Indigo Serpent Fruit to the clan?”
“Competing with the juniors?” Great Paragon Fuyi laughed, “Alright, Namosa, you can leave.”
“Fine.”
The bald old man stood up and left the wooden house. There was a young man waiting there especially to guide him away.
Great Paragon Fuyi closed his eyes. He continued meditating, with a dimmed light bead floating above his head.
Those with different strength would naturally have different heart temperament.
In the eyes of Great Paragon Fuyi, only unparalleled existences would make him feel threatened. He did not care about those peak Cosmos Gods who did not obtain a supreme secret treasure at all. Hence, as a result, he wasn’t willing to lower his identity and compete with the other Cosmos Gods that were within the Summer Clan.
“Great Paragon, we’ve already accumulated more than 10,000 contribution points previously, yet why are we still collecting this Golden Indigo Serpent Fruit? We are making a deficit on offering this item for the special treasure mission as the clan would only give little contribution points.” The young man outside the house asked. This young man was a unique puppet lifeform. Naturally, he was absolutely loyal to Great Paragon Fuyi and was also the strongest subordinate Great Paragon Fuyi had, one that he got due to fortuitous encounters.
“I do not mind giving it to the clan either without getting any contribution points.” Great Paragon Fuyi chuckled, “This is ultimately my clan.”
…
Time passed.
Other than a minority who could maintain calmness in treating the public contest in Summer Wind Ancient Nation, the others were striving hard to earn points. Even Fire Devil Paragon Master dared not slack.
In the blink of an eye, it had been 80,000 years since the start of the contest.
And at this moment, a piece of news was spread!
Black Devil Great Lake, the biggest devil under the three great religion masters, ‘Devil Monarch Yuan First’, died in the hands of Fire Devil Paragon Master! ‘Devil Monarch Yuan First’ was powerful, and also the great personal disciple of Yama Religion Master. Yama Religion Master favored this disciple tremendously. Devil Monarch Yuan First called himself ‘Yuan First’ with the name of the most mysterious existence in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, the transcendental ‘Yuan’, showing how ambitious he was.
Regarding this assassination mission of his, he earned a total of 20,000 contribution points, exceeding the one that Xue Ying captured alive.
“Formidable.”
Xue Ying saw the intelligence transmitted in the inner section of the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion. It stipulated in detail how Devil Monarch Yuan First was killed, “What an amazing Fire Devil Paragon Master, and how lamentable, Devil Monarch Yuan First. You have belittled Fire Devil Paragon Master too much.”
According to the intelligence, Devil Monarch Yuan First did not fear Fire Devil Paragon Master at all. Instead, he treated this as a form of training! Devil Monarch Yuan First was qualified to be confident too! He had experience of killing many Paragon Masters before.
But Fire Devil Paragon Master’s strength was much more terrifying than what the outer world knew!
When he came suddenly, Devil Monarch Yuan First had been heavily injured by ‘Fire Devil Paragon Master’ before being devoured in one go! After being devoured into the stomach, Devil Monarch Yuan First could no longer escape. He was soon digested and died.
‘Yama Religion Master’ had been greatly infuriated as a result!
This eldest disciple was the disciple Yama Religion Master favored the most! As a result, a great horrific battle commenced-Yama Religion Master against Fire Devil Paragon Master. The other two religion masters from Black Devil Great Lake came as support too.
The whole battle brought chaos to the entire world. Relying on the special environment the Black Devil Great Lake had, Fire Devil Paragon Master could not escape momentarily. He was still stuck in a fierce battle with those three great religion masters.
‘Fire Devil Paragon Master isn’t willing to ask for help. The Summer Wind Ancient Nation will definitely send one or two Paragon Masters to help him as long as he asked for it, and he would be saved instantly.’ Xue Ying understood this point, ‘This way, Fire Devil Paragon Master would have gained at least 20,000 contribution points at least.’
It seemed Xue Ying was in dire situations for the contest over the quotas.

chapters.title: Chapter 1124 - The Deadline has arrived
chapters.content:
Chapter 1124: The Deadline has arrived
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying pondered. This time, even though there were four open quotas, Great Paragon Fuyi would definitely get one of them. Hence, it was really a contest over three quotas!
Fire Devil Paragon Master and Nine Venom Religion Master were not easy opponents either.
Also, there was a bunch of Cosmos Gods from the three great clans that transcended him in terms of human connection and intelligence.
“Intelligence.” Xue Ying mumbled to himself.
Intelligence was critical.
Of the special treasure missions, these ‘special treasures’ were too hard to find. Firstly, one had to know where to find them! Fortunately, he had Southern Cloud King behind his back. Otherwise, Xue Ying would be fondling in the dark. Yet the intelligence web of his teacher could not compare with that owned by the three great clans of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
‘The price set by the Fan Clan is too ludicrous.’ Xue Ying shook his head inwardly. It was possible for purchase intelligence from the Fan Clan Commerce Group too. But every piece of intelligence regarding the ‘special treasures’ listed for the contest required a price of 10 billion cosmos crystals! That’s daylight robbery! This was a price close to what the ‘Scarlet Cloud God Spear’ was worth!
‘It is too difficult for me to gain those treasures. Fortunately, I still have my <Nine Rotation Undying Technique>.’ Xue Ying’s eyes were filled with expectations.
Nine Rotation Undying Technique…
He had only sold to the three great clans from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Xue Ying had not sold to the other ancient nations yet! He saved them precisely for this crucial moment to use.
“Sou.”
Suddenly, two avatars appeared above the Flying Snow City. Following that, both left with the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique.
…
One of the avatars came to Sky Towering Ancient Nation.
“Sky Towering Ancient Nation.”
Xue Ying came to the capital of Sky Towering Ancient Nation. Even when was still outside the city, Xue Ying could see an enormous tree located in the ancient nation emanating golden light. The tree was so high it pierced through the cloud layer, and its crown spanned over a tremendous area.
Xue Ying knew that that ancient tree… was also the true body of Towering Sky King-the Towering Sky God Tree!
“Hu.” Xue Ying entered through the city entrance.
Stepping on the void, he soon arrived at the royal palace. The royal palace wasn’t surrounded by walls. Instead, it was encircled by an enormous river that seemed like a belt. One might say that this river was actually the equivalence of the palace walls.
Xue Ying stood outside the royal palace looking at the towering Towering Sky God Tree. He bowed first before transmitting his voice: “Flying Snow greets Towering Sky King.”
“Hahaha…” On the Towering Sky God Tree, an unseen fluctuation enveloped Xue Ying, “Monarch Flying Snow of Southern Cloud Nation, it is rare for you to find me in my Sky Towering Ancient Nation, and for you to enter here and speak to me.”
Being an unparalleled existence, he was exceptionally humble.
Speaking about this, in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, there were only two unparalleled existences that had ‘relatively good temper’. One was Limitless City Master and the other, Towering Sky King!
“Hua.”
Xue Ying could feel himself being warped through space. Everything became blurry before him, and when his vision cleared, Xue Ying found himself within a luxurious palace hall.
Above the palace hall, there was a simple-looking old man wearing golden robes. This was the body that Towering Sky King had which traveled outside for battles. Beneath him, there were two subordinates standing.
“To what do I owe the pleasure of this visit?” Towering Sky King looked down at Xue Ying with a smile.
“I have a Dao of Void secret technique that enabled a Primal Chaos expert to attain the pinnacle of void-ification.” Xue Ying mentioned, “I wonder if King is interested?”
“Is it the <Nine Rotation Undying Technique> which you sold to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation?” Towering Sky King asked.
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded. He was startled at the same time. Towering Sky King even knew about this?
Towering Sky King was relatively interested in the technique. He promised 50,000 contribution points to purchase it! Even though Summer Wind Ancient Nation forked out 150,000 contribution points for it, both great ancient nations had different strength and number of experts. It was quite good for the King to offer 50,000 contribution points. This ‘50,000’ contribution points could naturally only be used to exchange for treasures within the Sky Towering Ancient Nation.
Very soon, another expert from the Sky Towering Ancient Nation appeared above the great hall-’Paragon Master Ya Xi’.
“Paragon Master Ya Xi.” Xue Ying bowed. It was a female Paragon Master this time, “I wish to purchase ‘Future-Seeing Golden Pupil’. I wonder how much contribution points would it require for me to purchase it from the royal clan of the Sky Towering Ancient Nation?”
“50,000 contribution points.” Paragon Master Ya Xi was all grin.
“That is too expensive.” The expression of Xue Ying shifted.
The Future-Seeing Golden Pupil could be exchanged for 15,000 contribution points in the special treasure mission!
Even though the quota contest for entrance to the Realm Heart God Palace led to lower rewards, the ‘Future-Seeing Golden Pupil’ usually required 20,000 to 30,000 contribution points for exchange. Now that it cost 50,000 contribution points for it? That’s twice the amount!
“There have been quite a few cultivators from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation that came seeking for this Future-Seeing Golden Pupil.” Paragon Master Ya Xi wasn’t in a rush.
“Oh, then that’s too bad.” Xue Ying replied. He was not a fool.
Even though earning a quota was important, it was limited to a certain value in the Realm Heart Great Land. To an absolute majority of experts, the ‘Realm Heart God Palace’ would occasionally open. The majority of them entered because of their wish to breakthrough. Some embarked on the journey for ‘top-graded secret treasures’, but in reality, the chances of acquiring one was slightly lower! Hence, the value of a quota to enter should be an entire level lower than what a top-graded secret treasure was priced at.
50,000 contribution points offered by the Towering Sky Royal Clan?
Not worth!
…
Naturally, the reason why he was so calm had been because of the Icy Snow Ancient Nation who bought the <Nine Rotation Undying Technique> too. The Icy Snow Ancient Nation had three unparalleled existences in total. Hence, their foundation was deeper than the Sky Towering Ancient Nation, purchasing the technique for 90,000 contribution points. Xue Ying only spent 30,000 points just to exchange a special treasure which he needed, the ‘Icy Crystalline Pillar Tainted by a Drop of Blood’. This special treasure was worth 16,000 contribution points in reward.
From this perspective, the price offered by the Icy Snow Ancient Nation was honest!
‘This should be sufficient. Submitting Devil Monarch Yan Fire in would earn me 12,000 contribution points. This Icy Crystalline Pillar Tainted by a Drop of Blood could earn me another 16,000 contribution points too, adding up to a total of 28,000 contribution points.’ Xue Ying thought.
One had to know that a majority of Paragon Masters were not so wealthy. Southern Cloud King was considered one of the wealthiest cultivators in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Even so, most Paragon Masters would not use all their wealth and treasures just to get a quota to enter the Realm Heart God Palace.
‘28,000 contribution points.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘The contribution points rewarded for these missions have been lowered. If I were to offer them up, I would lose 20 billion cosmos crystals in value.’
Fortunately, he created the <Nine Rotation Undying Technique>. Otherwise, Xue Ying would not have been so pleased.
…
In the end, that Paragon Master Ya Xi dropped the price for the special treasure. The closer it was to the 90,000 years deadline, the lower the price. It’s a pity that Xue Ying still found it too expensive, and secondly, he reckoned he should have sufficient points.
Xue Ying had exchanged for several other materials in the ‘Icy Snow Ancient Nation’ and ‘Sky Towering Ancient Nation’ too. He even went to exchange for some miscellaneous special treasures from other experts.
In the end, he got a total of 30,000 contribution points!
‘30,000 contribution points.’
‘I do not believe I can’t get a slot.’ Xue Ying was willing to pay such a huge price solely because he had to enter the Realm Heart God Palace.
“Xiu.”
During the last day of the contest, Cosmos Gods came one by one from various locations to the royal palace of Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Some of the Cosmos Gods that did not participate in the contest rushed over too! Naturally, most of those who could enter the royal palace came from the three great clans.
“Southern Cloud Nation, Ying Shan Xue Ying.”
“It’s him.”
“He should have accumulated a lot of contribution points.”
Several Cosmos Gods noticed this white-robed young man that entered the royal palace.
Xue Ying directly proceeded to a secluded hall under the guidance of an attendant. When he reached that hall, Xue Ying saw that royal palace spirit, a yellow-robed old man.
“Elder Summer.” Xue Ying greeted.
“I’ve heard that only you and Fire Devil Paragon Master completed an assassination mission each.” Elder Summer smiled.
“It is also because of luck.” Xue Ying replied. He passed over a wristband to Elder Summer, “This Eden Treasure contains some materials and Devil Monarch Yan Fire that is sealed by me.”
Devil Monarch Yan Fire did not resist in allowing Xue Ying to seal his strength.
Elder Summer took over the wristband. He rapidly examined it before looking at Xue Ying with shock: “Devil Monarch Yan Fire has been captured alive. In a while, an attendant will come over and give you 10 billion cosmos crystals too. Adding up the precious treasures, you have earned 30,000 contribution points in total? This is really high! But whether you can get a quota is another question. You will find out during the final moment who the top four contestants are.”
“I know.” Xue Ying was slightly anxious in his heart too. He prayed for no accidents to happen. According to his experience, 30,000 contribution points should be definitely sufficient.

chapters.title: Chapter 1125 - Top Four
chapters.content:
Chapter 1125: Top Four
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Night descended.
Within a desolate palace hall of Summer Wind Capital, a lone fire was burning. The entire hall was lit by the lone fire. Many Cosmos Gods were scattered across the hall with a table placed before each of them.
