There were delicious wine and delicacies provided for all, and female servants were serving them from the side.
Even though they were joking about, the Cosmos Gods were still looking forward to the announcement of quota allocation.
“This time, only Monarch Flying Snow and Fire Devil Paragon Master have completed the assassination mission. In my opinion, Monarch Flying Snow would definitely be part of the four winners.”
“Thank you for your kind words.”
Xue Ying replied with a toast of the wine glass in his hand.
There were more than 60 Cosmos Gods seated within the palace hall, and all of them came to enjoy the wine and the crowd. After all, the contest over the quotas to enter the Realm Heart God Palace was a huge affair. Many outstanding cultivators outside the nation like ‘Western Floating Old Ancestor’ were not qualified to enter! They could only try their luck during the chaos that would ensue with the opening of the inner city of Realm Heart God Palace.
“Hua.”
Amidst the exchange of toasts and networking, a figure suddenly appeared at the center of the palace hall. It was that yellow-robed old man.
“Elder Summer.” The attention of the group of Cosmos Gods was jolted. They immediately greeted politely.
‘He is here.’ Xue Ying’s heart tightened, ‘It is almost certain for me to get a slot with 30,000 contribution points according to history.’
No other choice.
The other Cosmos Gods would only seek to enter if they reached a bottleneck. Even if they failed, they could still enter the next time.
But Xue Ying was different! Going the next time? Would his hometown Origin World be still around when the Realm Heart God Palace opened?
‘It has begun.’ Monarch Thousand Yang sat there watching silently. His eyes were filled with passion, ‘I’ve prepared a total of 18,000 contribution points far beyond the mission of what Ying Shan Xue Ying earned through his assassination mission. It should be sufficient for me to enter using this amount.’
“Mn.” Fire Devil Paragon Master revealed a grin. He seemed fully confident.
Great Paragon Fuyi sat there with a smile. He was extremely calm about it.
…
Under the gaze of all Cosmos Gods, the yellow-robed ‘Elder Summer’ smiled cheekily: “The time is here. Even if you have other treasures which you want to offer, it is too late. The ranking of the contest has been fixed. Coming in first, Great Paragon Fuyi with 50,000 contribution points.”
“So many? With the identity of Great Paragon Fuyi, he could get a slot easily by ordering for it within the Summer Clan. Yet he still spent 50,000 contribution points of effort just to get a slot?”
Everyone present was speechless.
One had to know that the contribution points provided for each mission during the contest for quota had been lowered! It was a loss to offer treasures during this period. For the amount of 50,000 contribution points, he had suffered a loss of more than 50 billion cosmos crystals! This would bring distress to even Paragon Masters. The Scarlet Cloud God Spear and Five Phase Beads that Xue Ying owned were not worth as much even when added up together.
‘Formidable.’ Xue Ying’s heart sunk. The other party had won first place without dispute.
“Hmph.” The corner of Fire Devil Paragon Master’s eyes twitched. He originally thought he would have earned enough as compared to Great Paragon Fuyi, but in the end, the gap was so big!
“As for the one coming in second this time…” The yellow-robed old man’s grand voice resounded in the palace hall, “Is Monarch Flying Snow at 30,000 contribution points.”
“Shua!”
It was unanimous. All Cosmos Gods turned to that white-robed young man seated there. They were all startled. This Monarch Flying Snow who came from Southern Cloud was too savage.
“30,000 contribution points?”
“He is just a new Cosmos God yet he could provide so many special treasures. He has only earned 12,000 contribution points after capturing Devil Monarch Yan Fire alive. Other than that, he actually prepared treasures worth a total of 18,000 contribution points? That’s madness! During normal circumstances, 10,000 contribution points would have sufficed to get a slot.”
“He is really willing to do so.”
“Did Southern Cloud King support him from the back? He is indeed the wealthiest Paragon Master.”
“Even if Southern Cloud King were wealthier, he would not have supported his disciple so lavishly right? 30,000 contribution points?”
The entire hall went into a hullabaloo in the dark. They were all discussing through voice transmissions.
The status of Great Paragon Fuyi was too high. He was coming close to unparalleled existences! Hence, everyone could understand even if he earned more points.
But Monarch Flying Snow, ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying’, wasn’t even a Paragon Master! For him to earn so many contribution points? That’s frightening.
“This time, coming in third is Fire Devil Paragon Master.” The yellow-robed old man continued, “Earning a total of 26,000 contribution points.”
Fire Devil Paragon Master indifferently smiled. Clearly, he wasn’t so happy at all.
Great Paragon Fuyi was close to twice of what he earned!
And a junior had suppressed him from the top.
‘Fire Devil Paragon Master’ who regarded his reputation exceptionally did not feel comfortable. Actually, even if he succeeded in getting a slot, Fire Devil Paragon Master was still unhappy. He was so prideful that he wasn’t willing to compromise and join the three great clans! He became a superpower all by himself.
“Coming in fourth…” The yellow-robed old man continued.
The palace hall turned quiet.
Quite a few participating Cosmos Gods were starting to feel nervous. There was just one slot left!
‘Choose me. It must be me! I have prepared a total of 18,000 contribution points, so it is almost impossible for me not to get into the top four.’ The eyes of Monarch Thousand Yang were filled with blazing expectations.
“Is Mount Spring Island Master at 20,000 contribution points.” The yellow-robed old man Elder Summer mentioned the last name with a giggle, “Great Paragon Fuyi, Monarch Flying Snow, Fire Devil Paragon Master, and Mount Spring Island Master. Congratulations to the four of you. When the Realm Heart God Palace is fully opened, Emperor Summer will naturally bring everyone along into the Realm Heart God Palace.”
Saying that, Elder Summer left the place.
“Haha, Brother Flying Snow, congratulations to you! For you to spend so much of your wealth to earn a slot into the Realm Heart God Palace, I truly admire your guts!”
“Brother Flying Snow, you really make us envious! I have yet to enter the Realm Heart God Palace ever since I started cultivating.”
The palace hall was filled with a round of congratulations.
There were many who congratulated Xue Ying, Fire Devil Paragon Master, and Mount Spring Island Master. There were even a few who congratulated Great Paragon Fuyi! Even though the temper of Great Paragon Fuyi was relatively pleasant, his usual self still gave off an aura that ‘pushed away all living creatures’. Only Paragon Masters and an extreme few who were close to him would take the initiative to congratulate him.
At that point, several Cosmos Gods immediately started walking out. This time, they came just to see if they had got the slot. Once the quotas were allocated, they saw no reason to remain here.
Great Paragon Fuyi stood up and left a while ago.
As for Fire Devil Paragon Master, he remained shortly as a form of courtesy, replying to other Cosmos Gods before leaving!
“Interesting.” Nine Venom Religion Master chuckled. He actually did not have a single contribution point this time!
Actually, only a minority few were risking everything to enter. The majority were there participating according to circumstances. If they felt they had a great chance to enter, they would naturally earn more points. If they felt that hope was meager, they weren’t willing to fork out a single point!
Like in the past, the four quotas were given to people that had never completed a single assassination mission at all. There was no Great Paragon Fuyi, existences that would certainly get a quota. During most circumstances, the participants would not compete so madly. Getting 10,000 contribution points would suffice for them to get a slot, and in some fortunate cases, 6,000 would be enough too!
And this time?
Because of Great Paragon Fuyi participating in the contest, in reality, there were only three instead of four competing slots!
And because Xue Ying and Fire Devil Paragon Master completed one assassination mission each, it had risen the bar greatly towards earning a slot! The majority participated in the contest depending on luck. Seeing this happening, most had immediately given up because they understood that the contest this time would be tough! Even if they got a slot, it would not be worth paying such a huge price for it.
They had a long lifespan, and at worst, they could enter the next time!
And what turned out was as they guessed—the fourth slot was given to a participant with 20,000 contribution points! That was madness.
‘I actually did not get a slot. Almost, just a bit!’ The expression of Monarch Thousand Yang became ugly. He had already left the place.
…
Xue Ying was feeling extremely delighted. Nonetheless, he could feel the unhappiness this group of Cosmos Gods from Summer Wind Ancient Nation had towards someone attaining a quota from outside the nation! Other than a selected few who he was familiar with, the majority of them discriminated against him. Xue Ying did not care about this either since it was normal.
After all, both the Summer Clan and Cang Clan did not accept outside experts. Only the Fan Clan accepted outside experts.
It was impossible for Xue Ying to force them to treat him as their own person. To this, the Summer Wind Ancient Nation was also a form of support to him! Attaining the opportunity to enter sufficed.
“Xue Ying, you actually earned 30,000 contribution points this time? Forking out so much?” Southern Cloud King immediately asked through a voice transmission. He was relatively joyous as he just got news of the four who earned the quotas from his good friends.
“Since I lucked out in capturing Devil Monarch Yan Fire, I must grab hold of this opportunity. Alas, the competition is too intense that I am not confident of getting a slot just by the assassination mission. Hence, I’d rather earn more.” Xue Ying transmitted back.
“Mn. It is worth getting a slot to enter the Realm Heart God Palace. Properly grasp this chance well. If you were fortunate enough to get a top-graded secret treasure, you would have earned a great deal.” Southern Cloud King was relatively happy.
Xue Ying had naturally made his resolution.
He then went back to his Flying Snow City alone. Xue Ying started closed-door cultivation once he reached his Monarch Residence, waiting calmly for the day when the Realm Heart God Palace fully opens.

chapters.title: Chapter 1126 - Level-Two Cosmos God
chapters.content:
Chapter 1126: Level-Two Cosmos God
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Snowflakes that looked like goose feather fell from the sky and started drifting away.
Inside a pavilion beside the lake, a white-robed Xue Ying sat cross-legged. He was currently enjoying good warm wine. Steam could still be seen coming up from the cup as he drank.
He had many avatars. The other avatars were currently meditating, with one strolling around idly.
Primarily, Xue Ying had reached a bottleneck in the Dao of Void. He had improved until the last bit before fusing the ‘Sky Phase’ and ‘Earth Phase’, yet he could still not harmonize them perfectly.
The world was tranquil. No other female attendants dared to come close and disturb him.
By his side, there was a huge Magic Dragon lying on the ground obediently. Warm air could be seen spouting out from its nose.
“The heavens and earth are boundless. If I had sufficient time to idle around, I would bring along Jing Qiu using the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation and travel across millions of Origin Worlds, experiencing the civilizations and seeing the different sceneries. What a pity that I could still yet to utilize the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation. Furthermore, the danger of my hometown looms ever closer.” Xue Ying muttered to himself.
“One sky and one earth form the world.”
“At that time when I was a Transcendent and a Deity, the world I saw is limited to a cosmos!”
“After that, I discovered that there were many cosmoses, and those are just a part of an Origin World.”
“And now, I understood that there exists a higher dimension where many Origin Worlds are present-so many worlds! And I reckon only existences like ‘Yuan’ knows about the true appearance of this world.”
“The sky and earth seem limited yet boundless at the same time.”
Xue Ying abruptly revealed a grin.
“Hong~”
The surrounding void rumbled. The lake in front shook. Many fishes were panicking from this phenomena as they jumped out of the water! Yet Xue Ying continued pouring more wine for himself casually.
Just not so long ago, he had finally broken through the bottleneck of fusing the Sky Phase and the Earth Phase! And now, he was a genuine level-two Cosmos God.
…
It had been 10 billion years since he broke through to the Cosmos God Realm!
Given his deep foundation in the Dao of Void-all nine branches reaching the Cosmos God Realm, it was only a matter of time before Xue Ying broke through to the level two! It’s just that things happened so coincidentally at the juncture prior to entering the Realm Heart God Palace! This breakthrough had brought about a fundamental boost to his overall strength.
The avatar situated at his hometown Primal Chaos Void had also progressed from level one to level two, bringing about a drastic improvement in strength.
And over here in the Realm Heart Great Land, Xue Ying had already trained the absolute art created by his teacher, Southern Cloud King, to grand perfection. He first improved the <Southern Cloud Sacred Body> to the 12th level! And then relying on the grand perfection Southern Cloud Sacred Body, Xue Ying could now exert both <Arch Destruction> and <Spectacular Painting> at the grand perfection realm. As for the Scarlet Cloud God Spear, Xue Ying could finally exert it to its limit, giving off an air of how Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master was in the past!
“Hahahaha…”
In the meditation room, Xue Ying currently held onto the Scarlet Cloud God Spear. As he began activating all the inscriptions on the Scarlet Cloud God Spear with his improved realm, one could see a faint black maelstrom forming by the head of the spear.
“I can now exert all void related secret treasures, as long as they aren’t top-graded ones, to the limit.” Xue Ying was now confident in fighting against Paragon Masters directly.
Previously, even though he could still exchange some moves with the Paragon Masters, he would be completely suppressed and was forced to escape.
Now, Xue Ying could fight with them for more than a hundred rounds without losing! One reason was that he could completely execute the secret treasures he had, and another reason was his perfection of the <Avatar Technique>.
“Avatar Technique!”
Xue Ying directly sent a fist out! The surface of his skin faintly gave off light. Punching out with this fist, the surrounding world abruptly collapsed, causing a pitch-black hole the size of half a human to form. As a result, Chaotic Origin Energy began surging in from beyond. It appeared that Chaotic Origin Energy from regions slightly further away was diffusing in as well.
It was concentrated and immense!
This was the true power of the <Arch Destruction>! A single punch that was incredibly tyrannical and overbearing!
At this time, techniques like <Arch Destruction>, <Spectacular Painting>, and <Five Phases Sealing Technique> no longer had any differences. At the Primal Chaos Realm, the <Five Phases Sealing Technique> relied on the fusion of five branches to attain power beyond that of the Arch Destruction and Spectacular Painting.
And <Arch Destruction> at grand perfection was a technique that fused five branches together.
The <Spectacular Painting> similarly fused four branches together.
Xue Ying had merely fused two branches now. He had to rely on the Southern Cloud Sacred Body that reached 12th level grand perfection stage before he could exert these two techniques. Hence, the power those two techniques had was naturally similar to what he could unleash with the <Five Phases Sealing Technique>.
The closer one reached the peak, the closer different techniques would be to one another. The only difference lay in the direction of each technique.
For instance, the Scarlet Cloud Domain was a domain.
The Arch Destruction was a frontal attack.
The Five Phases Seal would be a crowd-control attack.
And the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique was utilized to conceal one traces after heading towards another Origin World! But it’s a pity that the Southern Cloud Sacred Body had been created primarily for using the ‘Arch Destruction’ and ‘Spectacular Painting’. As for using the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’, it required one to fuse six branches together. Furthermore, Xue Ying did not have a corresponding secret treasure that could aid him in acquiring this task. Hence, he could only slowly cultivate his way.
Even if he could use it, the meaning wasn’t huge! What he sought was a Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique that could allow him to bring others with him! That was something only final realm Cosmos Gods could achieve.
‘These absolute art scriptures are techniques created by seniors using different concepts. I am currently standing on the shoulders of the predecessors, only then could I grasp them so rapidly.’ Xue Ying understood this point.
The Realm and techniques were fundamentally two different concepts.
Once one had sufficient realm, he had to create his own techniques! Or to learn techniques created by others!
Like the <Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique>, why did the Summer Wind Ancient Nation not impart it to outsiders? Precisely because this secret impartation technique would be too powerful and hard to deal with when cultivated to the later stages!
And why was the <Five Phases Sealing Technique> precious? Well, seeing how Devil Monarch Yan Fire had been trapped by Xue Ying would be clear!
Usually, it was hard for two parties of comparable strength to kill one another.
But the Five Phases Sealing Technique enabled those of comparable strength to exterminate the other party! If one could not escape from it, he would be kept into the Five Phase Beads. That would spell doom!
…
“Hua hua hua~”
The deluge of Chaotic Origin Energy transformed the soul of Xue Ying once more. It reduced the shackles from the Supreme Law, allowing many more strands of light to fly from within Xue Ying’s body, flying to the side before condensing into new bodies. At the same time when bodies were being condensed, his soul was also rapidly turning stronger.
The number of avatars started increasing gradually. A few hundred, thousands, and soon the vast meditation room was densely filled with cross-legged figures, until the point where no more avatars could sit down any longer.
‘It is really hard to kill once I cultivated the Avatar Technique to this stage.’ Xue Ying thought.
As long as one avatar remained alive, he would not die.
It wasn’t considered heaven-defying currently because, without the help of Southern Cloud King, terrifying existences like ‘Limitless City Master’ could still kill him with a thought, wiping out all avatars Xue Ying had within the Realm Heart Great Land! As for the protection of Southern Cloud King? It would not ensure his definite survival since it was still possible for several unparalleled existences to do so, killing all beings within the Southern Cloud Nation other than the king.
It’s just that the Southern Cloud King joined the Fan Clan of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, and Emperor Summer would not touch him for no reason.
And Limitless City Master was one of the few unparalleled existences that had the best temper.
…
No matter what, if he could execute the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique before sending several avatars to different Origin Worlds! Then Xue Ying would be qualified to be one of the absolute heroes of the world!
“10,081 avatars.” Xue Ying spent a full two days before finally finish training in it.
It could be said that Xue Ying had countless bodies now.
But for all nine avatars to have perfect soul and heart force, Xue Ying could only maintain nine avatars at once. Nevertheless, this boosted Xue Ying’s strength significantly and his speed of cultivating!
******
Hometown, Primal Chaos Void, within the Lost World Corridor.
“Senior.”
The stronger expert amongst the Destruction Devils of this era, ‘Emperor Jun’, was currently looking with respect at the figure ahead of him. It was a muscular expert covered in silvery scales. He had a total of 12 silver horns protruding from his forehead and a silvery-scaled tail. His aura wasn’t considered strong. It was merely at the Primal Chaos Realm.
But Emperor Jun was filled with respect to this senior since he had seen this senior before reaching the level-two Cosmos God Realm in the past at the state of subconsciousness.
During this state of dream, this senior had guided and taught him. Only then could he cultivate so rapidly.
“You have currently reached the limit of the level-two Cosmos God Realm.” The silvery-scaled muscular figure coldly said, “Currently, you have to break through as soon as possible. Once you reach the final realm of Cosmos God, you should grab hold of the opportunity to destroy this world. Being a Destruction Devil, the more you destroyed, the more rewards you would get from the Origin World. You would only be rewarded in this era for your actions. When the next era arrives, you would no longer have any benefits.”
“Yes, this junior understands.” Emperor Jun said with a lowered head.
The Destruction Devils were given birth to destroy. The Origin World formed them so that they could destroy.
The more they destroyed, the more benefits they would get.
And this was limited to a single era. When the next era came, they would no longer be ‘rewarded by the Supreme Law’.
“Reach the final realm first before starting your destruction. By then, you would attain a huge reward! That will allow your accumulations to broaden. And then, it would be possible for you to break through the cage in the subsequent eras. Only then would you reach the next level.” That silver-scaled muscular figure said with a wave of his hand. A pitch-black flower floated towards Emperor Jun.
“This cultivation treasure is greatly beneficial to you. Don’t disgrace me by not even reaching the final realm of Cosmos God!” The silver-scaled muscular male said.
“Senior, please be rest assured.” Emperor Jun answered.
“Go.” The silver-armored muscular figure suddenly felt something. He waved his hand, and Emperor Jun immediately retreated after that.
And in this piece of Lost World Corridor.
On the other side of the muscular figure, the voice from a dark-blue-robed male could be heard.
“Luo City Lord.” The silver-armored muscular figure grinned, “It has been a while. Why, do you have an opinion on my actions of guiding a junior Destruction Devil?”
“Brother Golden.” The dark-blue-robed male was none other than Luo City Lord. He sighed nonchalantly, “Why the need? Isn’t it better if we gave these fellows a little more time?”
“So what if more died? As long as another one with the same Dao emerges, it’s fine. Emperor Jun, this junior, is a Destruction Devil. He naturally had to destroy. The more he destroyed, the more benefits he would get. And this opportunity would only last for this era. Only during this era would he be rewarded for his actions. Otherwise, he would lose the opportunity for eternity.” The silver-scaled muscular figure chuckled, “I am merely guiding a Destruction Devil without disobeying the promise. Alright, I’ve just brewed some good wine. How about coming over and have a taste?”
Luo City Lord nodded: “Alright.”
“You are too benevolent. There are countless beings dying every single moment before more emerges. Why do you even care about them?” The silver-scaled muscular figure laughed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1127 - Luo City Lord and Dong Bo Xue Ying
chapters.content:
Chapter 1127: Luo City Lord and Dong Bo Xue Ying
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the Primal Chaos Void, there was a huge ship moving.
This ship contained Xue Ying, Jing Qiu, and their descendants including their children-Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao, as well as those further down the family line.
Majority of those on the ship were currently cultivating in their respective meditation room. Xue Ying and his wife, though, were seated in a wide empty hall. They were both looking through the walls of the ship unto the outside world. The Primal Chaos Void felt lonely, yet all sorts of matter that could wreak havoc lurked amidst it. Through the Primal Chaos Void, one could see a huge cosmos to the distance.
As the ship advanced forward, it rapidly got closer to the cosmos before moving further away from it.
They then saw another floating great land. With the strength of Xue Ying and Jing Qiu, they could see many beings living on it.
“Xue Ying, when your soul was forced to dissipation by the Sacred Master, what I looked forward most is such days.” Jing Qiu and Xue Ying sat cross-legged drinking wines they liked most. Jing Qiu preferred a different taste to Xue Ying. Xue Ying preferred something duller while Jing Qiu preferred wines that tasted more special and thrilling.
“The Primal Chaos Void is truly huge! There are many cosmoses too.” Jing Qiu looked to the distance as the huge ship got closer to one cosmos after another.
“Even though there are several great sacred worlds.” Xue Ying continued, “In reality, the total population summed across the multitude of cosmoses far transcends those living on the sacred worlds.”
It could be said that Xue Ying had traveled across his entire hometown during the process of chasing after the Destruction Devils. He was clear how numerous the cosmoses there were.
“Ever since the shatter of the primitive Ancient Sacred World, the biggest land was only approximately one-hundredth that of its original size like the Ancient Sacred World that belonged to the Sacred Master. The Myriad Ancient Sacred World, Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, and Ancestor Mother World are all way smaller than the Ancient Sacred World! That time when the primitive Ancient Sacred World shattered, its Origin Source Energy dissipated, causing many cosmoses to emerge. Even though the living beings on the cosmos aren’t special when compared to those living on the sacred worlds, their number far surpasses those on the sacred worlds.” Xue Ying said, “Fortunately, every cosmos repels against outsiders. Hence, it is hard for the Sacred Master to spread his religion.”
“Mn?”
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu turned over.
A blurred figure was seen traveling through the wall into the hall. His figure soon condensed into a dark-blue-robed male.
“Luo City Lord.” Xue Ying immediately stood up with astonishment.
“Greetings Luo City Lord.” Jing Qiu also stood up. At the same time, she mentioned, “Xue Ying, the two of you chat.”
She then left.
Within the hall, there were only Xue Ying and Luo City Lord left behind.
Xue Ying felt curious and puzzled. Luo City Lord had a unique status within the Primal Chaos Void. Even though he currently supported the group of Cosmos Gods in resisting against the Sacred Master, there existed an air of mystery around Luo City Lord, and none had ever seen him acting. But no matter what, there was none who dared to belittle this Luo City Lord. And after Xue Ying left home for the Realm Heart Great Land, he became even more reverent towards ‘Luo City Lord’!
He was clear.
An existence that had been forced down to the strength of Primal Chaos Realm by the Supreme Law, yet could still attain a power equivalent to the realm of a level-two Cosmos God, was someone incredibly frightening!
“Dong Bo Xue Ying.” Luo City Lord started.
“To what do I owe Luo City Lord the pleasure of the visit?” Xue Ying asked.
“You have reached the level-two Cosmos God Realm already? Not bad, it seems your talent isn’t any weaker than Swordmaster of the Great Void Heaven Temple.” Luo City Lord said.
Xue Ying became inwardly startled.
He had never mentioned the matter of him breaking through! Yet Luo City Lord knew about it despite not revealing his strength?
“Don’t be nervous. As you stand there, the degree of fusion with the entire Origin World and how the surrounding void is fluctuating according to your willpower… have revealed your current realm. I can easily determine it with a glance.” Luo City Lord said.
Xue Ying was stunned.
The degree of fusion with the Origin World?
Void and willpower?
Even though he understood it, why did Xue Ying find it so incredible still?
In his opinion, he had comprehended the Dao! If he did not utilize it, according to logic, nobody should be able to find out about it.
“You haven’t jumped out of this cage. If one day you did so, you would understand.” Luo City Lord said.
“Luo City Lord has already jumped out of this cage?” Xue Ying immediately asked in alarm.
Luo City Lord nodded.
At this juncture, Xue Ying’s heart unknowingly accelerated.
He had already guessed that Luo City Lord’s realm was unordinary, albeit the other party had always suppressed his strength to the Primal Chaos Realm. Xue Ying guessed that he came from outside the Origin World, but he dared not confirm if he had reached the legendary realm-that of jumping out of this cage called the Origin World, reaching another level of life.
“I came to tell you about a matter.” Luo City Lord said, “Originally, I calculated that this Origin World would enter a Great Apocalypse in 18,032,110,000 years. This should be the case if the expansion of the Origin World proceeded naturally! It’s just that a variable has appeared that would greatly increase the speed of your hometown entering apocalypse.”
“Greatly increased?” Xue Ying’s pupils dilated.
“There is a Destruction Devil called ‘Emperor Jun’ who had extremely great comprehension abilities. It has reached the final limit of the level-two Cosmos God Realm. With the help of another Chaotic Origin Expert, its chance of breaking through to the final realm is extremely high. The moment he broke through, being a Destruction Devil that emerges in this era, it was born to destroy. The more it destroyed, the greater the rewards it would get from the Supreme Law of this Origin World. Emperor Jun would definitely wreak havoc and destroy the entire world. With the wanton destruction by a final realm Cosmos God, it would greatly accelerate the process of this Origin World entering apocalypse.” Luo City Lord explained.
Xue Ying could not help wondering: “The help of another Chaotic Origin Expert? What is a Chaotic Origin Expert?”
“Someone who isn’t weaker than me.” Luo City Lord answered.
Xue Ying understood.
That was a terrifying existence that had jumped out of the cage of Origin World.
“Some amongst those at my level felt that the emergence of a final realm Cosmos God even if it was at the expanse of all sentient beings from an era would be a good era. After all, only final realm Cosmos Gods could live through the apocalypse. There is even a possibility of that existence jumping out of the cage.” Luo City Lord said, “But I feel that we should give equal opportunities to all beings.”
“In this era of yours, there is only Swordmaster and you who still have hope.” Luo City Lord extended his hand, causing a black seed to appear at the center of his palm.
He lightly threw.
The seed landed on the metallic floor of the hall.
“Chi~”
Stealthily, this seed rapidly germinated. Its roots tunneled into the ground, and it grew rapidly like a vine plant. Its leaves were emerald green, and flower buds began appearing at the same time-a total of nine flower buds with different colors.
“A flower, a world.” Luo City Lord said, “Every world has its birth and perish. When your true body enters any of these nine World Flowers, the World Flower would blossom gradually until it withers! It will take a total of 100,000 years! And every world will contain myriad existences emerging and reproducing, though they are all mortals! Nevertheless, even though these worlds will blossom and wither within a short 100,000 years, its void is constantly changing. It is a Supreme Treasure meant for comprehending the Dao of Void.”
“Nine World Flowers represent nine opportunities to experience the different unfolding of the Dao of Void.”
“It is hard to obtain the World Flower, so properly treasure it. I can only do this much for your era.” Luo City Lord said.
Looking at the nine different flower buds of the World Flowers before him, Xue Ying could not help but feel astonished.
He knew that this was a great opportunity…
An absolutely great opportunity! This was something he could never obtain in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
From what he heard, Luo City Lord should have helped Swordmaster too.
“Properly treasure your time and grasp hold of this opportunity.” Luo City Lord glanced at Xue Ying, “You do not have much time. It might seem unfair to you all, but nothing is ever fair!”
“I understand. Many thanks, senior.” Xue Ying felt full of gratitude.
Luo City Lord smiled.
The character of someone was an important factor to Luo City Lord.
It was quite good for him not to incur destruction behind the scene against those with a savage personality. Regardless, it was impossible for him to help such existences.
“Hua.” Luo City Lord immediately disappeared from the vicinity at the next moment.
Xue Ying’s expression became solemn.
He finally understood why Luo City Lord asked very few questions. To this existence, his experience in the Primal Chaos Void would most likely be just a brief journey. Luo City Lord was like a bypasser watching everything.
“World Flower?”
Xue Ying looked at the nine flower buds before him.
With a thought, an avatar appeared by the side. After all, Xue Ying had a total of nine avatars over at the Primal Chaos Void. Currently, the soul strength of this black-robed avatar was rapidly increasing. It was to the extent that the soul strength of other avatars had all become slightly weaker. After a while, the black-robed avatar reached its peak state.
“Every World Flower will last 100,000 years from blossom to wither?” The black-robed avatar then directly entered the bottommost pink flower bud.
As his black avatar got closer, the pink flower bud was expanding in his vision. It grew and grew, and soon became boundless.
He had entered a huge vast world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1128 - Realm Heart God Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 1128: Realm Heart God Palace
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The world was filled with primal chaos.
When Xue Ying landed, the myriad existences had yet to emerge. The entire place was filled with drifting energy, lightning strikes, gale whistling, waves soaring, volcanoes erupting… and the black-robed Xue Ying came to sit cross-legged on a mountain peak. Being a Cosmos God, his immense willpower enveloped the entire world, thoroughly perceiving the constant changes the world was undergoing.
After 1,000 years, the sky and earth were finally divided evenly. The world reached an equilibrium.
Plants, aquatic animals, and insects started forming. Many different kinds of animals appeared too. Soon, the earliest forms of homo sapiens covered in thick hair began walking the world. At this moment, they were all barbaric.
“Hou.”
“Hou.”
A group of wild hunters soon discovered this black-robed man that sat on the mountain peak. Various phenomena could be seen happening around this black-robed man. A vague endless world could even be seen behind him, with the void either collapsing, tearing or severing apart around him. Nonetheless, everything was limited to just 100 meters away from him. These wild men conversed using a simplistic form of language while inching closer at the same time. They were curious about this creature who looked similar to them, yet had smooth skin.
But as they reached the hundred meters mark, they could no longer get closer. Some unseen force was stopping them from proceeding forward.
This group of wild men exchanged glances before they each roared out. Soon, all of them began kneeling down and kowtowing to the black-robed figure.
And thus…
This tribe which existed closest to him drew a totem, one that depicted the scene of the black-robed man seated.
…
Xue Ying was focusing on the constant transformations the void underwent. The mountain peak he sat had a beguiling array surrounded on it. Only those fortunate ones could get closer to him in intervals of a hundred years. Some of the phenomena which he practiced could be comprehended by those who were intelligent enough. Xue Ying wanted to determine if it was possible for Transcendents to emerge in this world where only mortals lived.
A young man got the opportunity of crossing through the beguiling array, reaching Xue Ying before comprehending an absolutely powerful sword technique that could defeat ten thousand with a strike.
There was even an old man who passed through the beguiling array, saw Xue Ying before comprehending a cultivation technique. He lived past the 100 years mark, yet remained stuck as a mortal.
…
Soon, Xue Ying understood.
This ‘World Flower’ changed too quickly from blossoming to wither. As it changed, the void was transforming too, and the internal laws were also being adjusted. Even if one comprehended the law and profound mysteries, the law of the world changed too fast such that what the person comprehended had become ‘out of date’. He would no longer be able to control this world energy. Given this speed of transformation, even a more talented mortal could not jump out of mortality to become a Transcendent. And even so, once the law changed, his strength would rapidly drop until he became a mortal again.
Only Cosmos Gods whereby laws were forced to deviate from them, would not be influenced by this transformation.
“This is so mysterious! Even the laws are changing constantly.” Xue Ying exclaimed, “There is also the transformation of the Dao of Void…”
There were many kinds of Dao of Void that was unfolding before him.
Even if an unparalleled existence practiced techniques for a junior, he could only show eight to ten variations. Yet this World Flower seemed to be showing gradually an entire set of Dao of Void technique that lasted for a full 100,000 years! Xue Ying estimated that it was quite impossible for a final realm Cosmos God to practice and show his technique that would be so complete as to what he was currently viewing.
“A World Flower enables me to perceive the complete Dao of Void! Nine World Flowers represent nine opportunities. If the other World Flowers are different, does it mean that they could still transform into other kinds of variations?” Xue Ying looked forward to it.
His horizons were constantly being broadened.
Even personal disciples of unparalleled existences would not have this kind of treatment. It’s a pity that nine opportunities meant a total of ‘nine 100,000 years’. If only this was longer.
******
Realm Heart Great Land.
Xue Ying arrived at the Southern Cloud Capital.
“Teacher, I want two sets of materials that could allow me to cultivate the Southern Cloud Sacred Body to 12th grand perfection.” Xue Ying found his teacher, Southern Cloud King.
Southern Cloud King was slightly startled: “Two sets?”
Previously, he had given Xue Ying a set already.
Because he had mentioned before that he would be providing his disciple with sufficient materials to perfect his Southern Cloud Sacred Body for free once his realm reached the required level. Of course, this was just one set! Even if he was rich, he would not be able to provide a voluminous amount that could sustain the other party from re-training the body from scratch when an avatar died.
“This is the Devil Heart Bell. It should be sufficient for me to pawn it for two sets of materials.” Xue Ying smiled as he passed the item to his teacher, Southern Cloud King.
Southern Cloud King hesitated momentarily before taking it.
He originally did not care about it.
But his disciple would definitely feel uncomfortable if he continued providing benefits to his disciple for free.
“I did not collect that many materials that could allow one to train from scratch to grand perfection.” Southern Cloud King chuckled, “For you to ask for two sets now? Adding up the previous time, it’ll be a total of three. Why do you need so many? Having one main avatar fighting outside should be sufficient. Furthermore, you still have the Five Phase Beads and Scarlet Cloud God Spear. Training the Southern Cloud Sacred Body will not be that helpful to you.”
“I have a plan.” Xue Ying said.
“It seems you are really taking a huge gamble this time as you enter the Realm Heart God Palace.” Southern Cloud King waved his hand, causing a golden ring to fly over to Xue Ying, “This storage ring contains two sets of materials.”
“Mn.”
Xue Ying received it.
The price of two materials was comparable to a single Devil Heart Bell.
Actually, the ‘Devil Heart Bell’ was no longer useful for him. 10 billion years since he became a Cosmos God, Xue Ying’s attainments in the ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’ had been rising! Even though it was far weaker than the Dao of Void, he still had reached the Cosmos God Realm in three branches out of the five, ‘World’, ‘Bewilderment’, and ‘Desire’! The other two branches remained stuck at the Primal Chaos Realm.
As for fusing them? That was too far away.
One had to know that Xue Ying reached the Cosmos God Realm in all nine branches not too long after breaking through. And currently, Xue Ying had fused both the Sky Phase with the Earth Phase, reaching the second Cosmos God Realm. He was at least improving faster in the Dao of Void than the Dao of Mirage.
No other way.
His foundation in the Dao of Void was too thick!
As for the Mirage and Illusory Realm, even though Xue Ying had been comprehending it all the time, and he had also gotten a precious scripture, the <Heart Realm>, this scripture nonetheless only led to the level-two Cosmos God Realm and was insufficient in its guidance towards the Mirage and Illusory Realm. As for the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll>, just training in the body refining technique required the use of eight branches. Hence, its guidance and theory towards various branches and fusing them were more detailed. Furthermore, his teacher, Southern Cloud King, was also a great expert in the Dao of Void. He had many scriptures. Xue Ying even created the <Nine Rotation Undying Technique> that fused the nine branches together right from the start. Thus, his foundation or external conditions were stellar.
Comparatively speaking, cultivating the Mirage and Illusory Realm was more taxing for him.
The ‘Devil Heart Bell’ was only a tenth Mirage and Illusory Realm technique. It contained two great techniques, one of the beguiling sound and the other of the world. Xue Ying had reached the Cosmos God Realm in both branches already. Hence, he did not have to rely on the Devil Heart Bell to execute the techniques! He could even utilize profound mysteries from three branches.
‘With these two materials, my power will increase by a few times. I must grab hold of every opportunity during this visit to the Realm Heart God Palace.’ Xue Ying thought.
He understood that Xue Ying would no longer have the chance to enter a second time before the destruction of his hometown Primal Chaos Void.
…
Finally.
100,000 years after the Realm Heart God Palace started releasing fluctuations.
“Come to the Summer Wind Royal Palace right now.” Emperor Summer’s voice sounded by the ears of Xue Ying.
Within the meditation room.
There were nine ‘Xue Ying’s that currently sat here in cross-legged. Even though he had more than 10,000 avatars, he could only maintain nine at the peak state.
“It’s time to set off.”
Nine of them stood up together.
“Hua.”
The other eight transformed into light and flew into the Eden Treasure. And Xue Ying merely waved his hand, forming a Destructive Realm Teleportation passage that headed to the outskirts of Summer Wind Capital.
…
Arriving outside the capital, Xue Ying entered through the city doors and soon arrived before the royal palace.
He had reached there almost the same time as Fire Devil Paragon Master did. The two of them were the last two to arrive.
“Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang.” Xue Ying greeted the two.
Emperor Summer remained entirely in black. The unseen aura coming from him felt empty and fleeting, yet supreme at the same time as if it was overlooking down on the commoners. And on the other side, ‘Emperor Cang’ caused his surroundings to feel vast and grand as if inviting the advent of a giant terror. Every single action of his seemed like it would snuff out some of the weaker Cosmos Gods. Yet Xue Ying understood this power of grandiose come from owning supreme-graded secret treasure.
“Everyone is here.” The gaze of Emperor Summer swept across before he nodded, “Bear in mind, none of you is allowed to bring any other sentient creatures with you! Even pets aren’t permitted. Every intelligent creature would be counted as a quota as it enters.”
Everyone including Xue Ying knew of this common knowledge.
Of course, avatars and incarnations weren’t counted because they originated from the same soul.
“Go.”
Emperor Summer and Emperor Cang brought them along.
“Hua.”
Within the next instance, they arrived above the endless Black Prison Yin Sea. Waves could be seen surging up violently, and the seawater was just black.
Emperor Summer immediately dove down with that group of people. It was almost at that instance that he bypassed through the entire sea layer. “Pu pu pu pu…” Deep underneath the sea, layers of obstacles were present-these hindrances came from the Realm Heart God Palace. After penetrating through the stone layer at the seabed, Xue Ying and the others could finally see a chain of grand palaces deep underneath. They emitted light which brightened the entire place. Many strands of mysterious aura pervaded through the numerous palaces that felt like those coming from top-graded secret treasures or more frightening ones that seemingly originated from supreme-graded secret treasures. This feeling moved the hearts of every single Cosmos Gods present.

chapters.title: Chapter 1129 - Forsaken
chapters.content:
Chapter 1129: Forsaken
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, Summer Wind Ancient Nation, Icy Snow Ancient Nation, Primogenitor Ancient Nation, Sky Towering Ancient Nation, and Moonflower Ancient Nation.
The experts from the six great ancient nations rushed over one after another.
“It seems Fuyi and Jarosa are entering as well?” A male who wore a huge black cloak said. He had black skin with several red tattoos imprinted on them. His pair of eyes were red like blood jade. This was none other than ‘Extreme Night Primogenitor’ from the Primogenitor Ancient Nation.
“This is rare. Fuyi, it has been a while since you entered.”
“Jarosa, you went in the previous time and now you are entering again? We should let out juniors have the chance to enter and not just occupy the spots so selfishly.”
A total of eight unparalleled existences appeared at the place. They were Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang, Drifter, Extreme Night Primogenitor, Moonflower King, and others. All of them could execute the avatar technique. Even if ‘Moonflower King’ merely cultivated the Dao of Void to the Primal Chaos Realm, he could still refine a second avatar using the most apex avatar technique.
Southern Cloud King’s avatar technique was considered average in the Realm Heart Great Land. It was far outstripped by the technique belonging to the lineage of Myriad Realm Tavern Master and Scarlet-Browed Mountain Master.
“I have been stuck in a bottleneck for a long time. This time, I come seeking fortune.” Great Paragon Fuyi chuckled.
“It is Senior Moonflower who permitted me entry. I have to listen to him.” Jarosa was an absolute beauty who currently wore a translucent white muslin gown. Despite her appearances, she was actually one of the most infamous devils across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Her brutality and terror were vaguely beyond that of Yama Religion Master and Western Floating Old Ancestor. But ever since she chose to rely on the Moonflower King, she had become brother and sister with him. In addition, since Jarosa was extremely powerful and unparalleled existences could not kill her, many unparalleled existences gave her due respect.
…
The eight unparalleled existences, Great Paragon Fuyi and Jarosa were conversing between each other. Even though Great Paragon Fuyi and Jarosa remained relatively humble, they were clearly respected by the unparalleled existences.
As for the rest?
The unparalleled existences did not care too much about them.
Since they as unparalleled existences could easily kill the others, why care about them then?
Of the remaining 29 existences, half of them were Paragon Masters. And those that were weaker than Xue Ying could be counted with one’s fingers! All of them were absolute talents that had been nurtured by the superpowers across the Origin World. Even if they entered the Realm Heart God Palace, they had the help of experts from their clan. Instead, it was Xue Ying who originated from Southern Cloud Nation that was destined for nobody to shelter him at a place like the Realm Heart God Palace.
“Hua.”
Eternal Night Primogenitor swept across the place with his gaze.
Unseen soul ripples touched every single Cosmos Gods present. Xue Ying felt extremely uncomfortable. He gave Eternal Night Primogenitor a glance. Eternal Night Primogenitor was similarly wearing a black cloak, albeit his cloak contained golden patterns and was brighter and dazzling. Eternal Night Primogenitor had paler skin and was more handsome. His eyes seemed to be able to permeate through the soul of everyone present.
“I’ve checked through before. Nobody dares to bring other sentient beings with them secretly.” Towering Sky King smiled.
“Let’s enter.” Eternal Night Primogenitor ordered. He and Extreme Night Primogenitor immediately brought three Cosmos Gods in.
“Go.”
“Go.”
The six great ancient nations divided themselves into six teams that entered.
Xue Ying naturally followed behind Emperor Summer and Emperor Cang-they had a total of 12 people. Only the team from Myriad Realms Ancient Nation could compare with them in number. As for smaller ancient nations like Moonflower Ancient Nation and Sky Towering Ancient Nation, they had a pitiable two people.
******
The front entrance of the Realm Heart God Palace was huge and towering. At this moment, the great doors were wide open.
Xue Ying followed the team and entered through the doors. As they went past it, the surrounding space started turning illusory. In the blink of an eye, a stone path that was pervaded with white fog appeared. Right ahead of the stone path was a three-way split road.
“All of you should be careful.”
Emperor Summer ordered before two “sou”s could be heard.
Emperor Cang and he went in two different directions. It was clear they had begun their search.
“Good luck, fellow cultivators.” Great Paragon Fuyi smiled before choosing a direction and flew over.
In the blink of an eye, the strongest three existences in the team left.
Leaving behind four Great Paragons, two level-two Cosmos Gods and three level-one Cosmos Gods.
“According to the rules set by the three great clans, we will be splitting apart from now on. What you can get in the Realm Heart God Palace will depend on your own luck.” Paragon Master Pu Su smiled. The others looked at Xue Ying, Fire Devil Paragon Master, and Mount Spring Island Master with either pity, expectation or calmness.
The messy-haired male who had a god sword on his back looked at Xue Ying as if he wanted to say something, yet he did not in the end.
“Let’s go.”
Paragon Master Pu Su started. At that moment, he let out an exotic light that covered six people in total. They were the members from the three great clans of Summer Wind Ancient Nation-three Great Paragons and three level-one Cosmos Gods.
“Hua.”
The flow of time turned illusory before they soon disappeared from the vicinity.
Now, on this stone road pervaded with white flag, just Xue Ying, Fire Devil Paragon Master, and Mount Spring Island Master were left behind.
“Hmph, the three great clans are too stingy! They are not willing to bring us through the Realm Heart God Palace either.” Fire Devil Paragon Master snorted coldly.
“Fire Devil Paragon Master, how about we join hands together?” Mount Spring Island Master tried to earn the favor of the other party. The Realm Heart God Palace wasn’t such a good place to walk alone. By traveling with stronger experts, they had greater chances of finding something good.
Fire Devil Paragon Master glanced at him before snorting: “Bringing you? I am afraid you might pull me down.”
Saying that, Fire Devil Paragon Master chose a path before leaving.
The expression of Mount Spring Island Master sunk. He glanced at Xue Ying by his side and was too lazy to care. He chose a path before leaving.
“Realm Heart God Palace.”
Xue Ying stood on the stone road. He had gotten information from his teacher, the Southern Cloud King, and understood quite a bit on it.
The Realm Heart God Palace was vast and grand. Within it, the terrain would change unpredictably. Nonetheless, when one came in multiple times especially so for existence like Emperor Summer, he would have fumbled about and understood many laws of the place. Nonetheless, it was impossible for Southern Cloud King to acquire detailed information of the Realm Heart God Palace. And Southern Cloud King had only visited this place by a pitiful amount.
The three great clans definitely knew a lot about this place. Emperor Summer had ordered and forbade the three great clans from bringing the Honored Guests with them as well.
Permitting the Honored Guests in was considered a great bestowment by the three great clans! Why would they have to bring those Honored Guests with them to visit some of the more important places in Realm Heart God Palace then?
‘I’ll have to try my luck then.’
Xue Ying thought.
The insides of the Realm Heart God Palace were filled with many traps. The more important the ground was, the more dangerous it would be! If he could succeed in getting past the place, he would get a treasure! Furthermore, he could continue on his adventure to other places.
Even if he failed, he would only be teleported out without dying! But after being sent out of the Realm Heart God Palace, it would mean that one’s journey in the Realm Heart God Palace had thus ended!
Hence, the Realm Heart God Palace was not a place that would allow any cultivators to die.
Instead, the other Cosmos Gods would kill one another for treasures! And all those who died in the Realm Heart God Palace were unquestionably killed by other Cosmos Gods.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying proceeded forward. Looking at the three split paths, he randomly chose the right path before continuing his adventure.
…
“He dares to come in and risk his life without seeking the help of any Paragon Masters?” Fire Devil Paragon Master carefully walked. In his heart, he had marked Mount Spring Island Master and Xue Ying as dead, “The two of them would most likely get out empty-handed.”
Fire Devil Paragon Master was powerful. He was known for his tyranny in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
Even still, he was moving carefully at this moment.
…
The members from the three great clans were also advancing forward.
Paragon Master Pu Su, Great Paragon Lu Tian, and Paragon Master Bewitching Sword were discussing with one another through voice transmissions. As for the other level-one Cosmos Gods, they were able to proceed to certain regions under the protection of the three Paragon Masters.
“It should be the right side.” Paragon Master Pu Su went into a vast maze within.
“Mn, let’s go.”
They had gotten many pieces of detailed information regarding the regions of Realm Heart God Palace from Emperor Summer and Emperor Cang. This enabled them to have an easier time getting through the various predicament they encountered. Furthermore, with three Great Paragons working together, for instance, even though ‘Great Paragon Lu Tian’ dared not say he would survive in front of an unparalleled existence, he could still fight against Great Paragon Fuyi.
And Paragon Master Pu Su cultivated in the ‘Dao of Time’-his techniques were unpredictable and unfathomable.
Paragon Master Bewitching Sword was the youngest Great Paragon in the Cang Clan. Her talent was heaven-defying.
With the three of them working together and with a large amount of information provided by Emperor Summer and the others, their journey would definitely be easier. Furthermore, during crucial moments, they could ask for help!
“I truly do not understand why Ying Shan Xue Ying had chosen not to take Ancestor Fan as his teacher in the past, and instead chose Southern Cloud King. Hmph hmph, I believe he must be regretting it now.”
“That’s right. Even if he had barely entered the Realm Heart God Palace, moving blindly in this place, he would likely be trapped in some dangerous grounds, and would be forced out of this place soon after.”
The three level-one Cosmos Gods were following behind the three Paragon Masters.
It was too easy for them to proceed given that they were sheltered.
…
And indeed, as they had expected, Xue Ying was traveling blindly. Despite carefully advancing forward, Xue Ying still fell into a danger zone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1130 - Light at the end of the Tunnel
chapters.content:
Chapter 1130: Light at the end of the Tunnel
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Light at the end of the Tunnel
As Xue Ying ventured deeper along the stone road, he encountered many split paths. Everything seemed calm and quiet. Suddenly, as he stepped on a piece of stone tile, it sunk downwards, causing an overflowing force to erupt on his body, pulling Xue Ying in. The stone tile soon regained normalcy as if nothing had happened.
Deep underneath, in a dark cave, Xue Ying immediately pulled himself up after falling down. He looked around him carefully.
‘Even as that higher dimensional expert ‘Yuan’ left behind some opportunities to the weak, he had left behind many traps as well.’ Xue Ying muttered to himself. Comparatively, Luo City Lord was more generous. He directly bestowed a World Flower Seed to him. Naturally, this was because they knew each other and secondly, his hometown was rapidly moving towards an apocalypse. That was why Luo City Lord chose to aid him.
‘If I chose to take Ancestor Fan as my teacher, I might have an easier time now.’ Xue Ying mocked at himself.
But he did not regret it.
Xue Ying could not foretell when he first reincarnated into the Realm Heart Great Land that he would create the ‘Nine Rotation Undying Technique’! Otherwise, he would have become a core member of the Fan Clan confidently before accumulating sufficient points to exchange for an avatar technique.
It’s a pity that despite his current realm, it was impossible for him to prophesize what his future would be like.
Hence, Xue Ying chose the safer path and took Southern Cloud King as his teacher! At least he got the avatar technique in his hands early on.
‘The Realm Heart God Palace is treacherous! Getting a treasure isn’t easy even if I comprehended some laws of the place.’ Xue Ying understood this point. The difficulty of acquiring any treasure in the Realm Heart God Palace was extremely high. It was impossible for ‘Yuan’ to give an easy time for these juniors, ‘Even if I moved alone, it is hard to say who would get a bigger harvest in the end.’
“Hua.”
Holding on to the Scarlet Cloud God Spear, Xue Ying carefully advanced forward in the dark underground cave.
According to the intelligence given by his teacher, one must not casually fly in the Realm Heart God Palace! Every movement made must be done under careful consideration! If there’s a path to take, walk along the path. If there were stairs, then walk along the stairs! This would make the journey a little safer. But for existences like Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang, and Great Paragon Fuyi, they were confident of dealing against any danger, which was also why they dared to fly.
Other than the most apex experts, even Great Paragons had to be well-behaved and walk.
‘This place.’ Xue Ying tried extending his senses, only to feel a majestic boundless power pervading the entire world. The region that he could perceive was forced to a small radius. Any further extension of the region would be blocked by an unseen power.
Xue Ying advanced forward.
“Chi chi chi~”
After traveling for an hour, he was still stuck in the dark underground passage, albeit a sound could be heard coming from the front.
“Mn?” Xue Ying’s heart became taut as he became alert.
A black shiny-carapaced insect tunneled out from the wall to the side. Its pair of little eyes stared at Xue Ying. Both of them were several hundred kilometers apart, and this was considered close to Cosmos Gods! Nevertheless, when it tunneled out of the passage walls, Xue Ying’s domain did not reflect any movement.
“Shua.”
It instantly disappeared. At the same time, it appeared before Xue Ying, sending its pair of sharp claws against Xue Ying’s chest. Nevertheless, this figure gradually dissipated.
‘So fast!’ Xue Ying with his spear appeared at another location. Even though the suppression of the Realm Heart God Palace was great, preventing him from teleporting-Xue Ying’s Scarlet Cloud Domain was kept to a 50 kilometers radius after relying on the God Spear-it was sufficient for him to evade against the sudden attack by this monstrous carapaced insect.
‘The speed of this carapaced insect is beyond mine! It seems to have reached the offense power a second-level Cosmos God could exert.’ Xue Ying immediately made his observations.
The black-carapaced insect suddenly lifted its carapaced-wings.
“Chi chi chi~” Violet lightning began swimming away from it.
“Shua shua!”
The speed of the black-carapaced insect soared once again as it madly attacked Xue Ying.
“Peng.”
Even if Xue Ying could dodge the attacks by relying on the Scarlet Cloud Domain, given that the other party’s frightening speed had rose once again, this space of 50 kilometers was no longer useful. Just three moves later, the claws of the black-carapaced insect clashed against Xue Ying’s spear. The black-carapaced insect was forced backwards. Its pair of little eyes glared at Xue Ying.
“Hou~” It let out a vigorous roar.
“Chi chi chi~” Very soon, many other similar high-pitched sounds could be heard from the surroundings.
Xue Ying’s expression changed.
At that moment, many black-carapaced insect started tunneling out from all over the cavern walls-a dense number of several hundred black-carapaced insects came out from different locations on the cavern walls.
‘I’ve just entered the Realm Heart God Palace not too long ago.’ Xue Ying was no longer in a mood of enjoyment. Previously, he considered studying the strength of the black-carapaced insect, but now… what he thought of was not to get forced out from the Realm Heart God Palace by these black-carapaced insects.
According to the intelligence, if Xue Ying could not withstand through the dangers of Realm Heart God Palace, he would be teleported out. That would mark the end of his journey in the Realm Heart God Palace.
Xue Ying wasn’t willing to fail so simply!
“Weng!”
His full strength was released. Relying on the Devil Emperor Gown, Xue Ying let out a full-powered Mirage and Illusory Realm. This grand illusory realm pervaded out in all directions. At that instance, these black-carapaced insects started swaying as if they were inebriated. Following that, they began falling one after another and could no longer resist! Furthermore, they soon tunneled back down deep into the underground cave silently and disappeared from before him.
‘Fortunately, my Mirage and Illusory Realm could restrain them.’ Xue Ying thought.
The Mirage and Illusory Realm was one of his prime killing techniques.
After all, even Great Paragons had to rely on top-graded secret treasures before they could become that strong. Ordinarily, there was no difference in their soul strength with second-level Cosmos Gods. Facing Xue Ying’s Mirage and Illusory Realm, most had to distribute part of their heart force in dealing against the illusory realm, reducing their strength.
…
As time passed.
In the blink of an eye, it had been 20,000 years or so later.
“I, I am finally out!”
Xue Ying finally saw the light. With his vision, he could easily see the end of the tunnel and the vast canyon outside.
Even though he was excited, Xue Ying still completed the final segment of this cave.
When he left the cave, despite Xue Ying’s current heart realm, he could not help but feel excited.
“I’ve been stuck underground for over 20,000 years.” Xue Ying turned back at the passage behind. This underground seemed endless. It was filled with many dangers, and Xue Ying had to utilize all means, using even some of his survival techniques just to survive until now.
‘Fortunately, I’ve exchanged two more materials from my teacher before coming to the Realm Heart God Palace, allowing me to train two avatars to the 12th level grand perfection in the Southern Cloud Sacred Body.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘If not for this, I would have been forced out at the underground.’
Many experts would enter the Realm Heart God Palace when it opened.
And the majority of them had a huge background. Those like Xue Ying could be counted with one’s fingers. But even still, few could obtain sufficient benefits even if they were from clans with unparalleled existences and had gotten detailed intelligence.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying saw the huge canyon before him. There was a metal bridge linking to another canyon.
He immediately went past a small alley and headed towards the head of the bridge.
According to the experienced of his teacher, when one was in the Realm Heart God Palace, one had to walk through the roads, the bridge, and the stairs! Regardless, as long as the cultivator went along the path crafted by the creator of the Realm Heart God Palace, most would suffer from fewer hardships. If Xue Ying did not choose to walk along the metal bridge and fly across the canyon instead! He would have suffered from a huge danger.
Of course, Emperor Summer and the others could resist against them! But with Xue Ying’s current strength, it was better for him to obediently walk across the bridge.
“So cold.”
Walking on the metal bridge, Xue Ying felt frigid. As he walked, unseen frost began permeating through his entire body from underneath his feet. Even if he had the pinnacle of void-ification, he could still not resist against it totally.
The ‘pinnacle of void-ification’ would be curbed most of the time when traveling in the Realm Heart God Palace.
Clearly, to this higher dimension expert who had jumped out of the cage of the world, the pinnacle of void-ification was nothing worth mentioning.
After covering through more than half of the bridge.
“Hua.”
The boundless frost soon condensed into an icy mutated beast. He had a long tail and three heads.
“Kill.”
Immediately, Xue Ying transformed into three.
The aura from the three ‘Xue Ying’s shot up to the sky. One of them had a spear and relied on the spear to execute a ‘combined technique’, causing a huge maelstrom to appear between the three ‘Xue Ying’. Their bodies began emanating a dimmed light, and they punched out simultaneously. At that juncture, the three horrific energy converged onto a single point.
“Hong~”
Grand perfection Arch Destruction! Three avatars unity attack!
That icy mutated beast had a hard time withstanding against the Mirage and Illusory Realm already. Following that, a huge black gouge was torn before his eyes, causing part of his body to shatter instantaneously. The surviving parts had been destroyed by the transmittance of the remnant forces.
“Eliminated.”
The three ‘Xue Ying’s all revealed a grin as they stood on the metal bridge.
He had fought for 20,000 years or so underground, and had already perfected ‘Arch Destruction’ and the ‘Scarlet Cloud Combat Combined Technique’.
The grand perfection Arch Destruction was originally a great killing move formed by the fusion of five branches. Furthermore, it was known for its great power!
With three moves and another combined technique used to fuse them perfectly, the power of this combined technique rose.
It would have reached the boundary of what third-level Cosmos Gods could exert, and that was also the strongest technique Xue Ying could execute currently.
…
On the bridge, Xue Ying encountered three waves of danger before finally reaching the other side. To the distance, he could see a palace hall.
“I’ve finally reached the palaces!” Xue Ying felt excited in his heart.
According to the predecessors, most palaces would have treasures, but they would similarly be more dangerous.
Xue Ying continued heading towards that palace.
“Hua.”
An unseen ripple shackled Xue Ying, and following that, everything became illusory before him.
‘Another danger? Don’t trap me again like previously underground for 20,000 years.’ Xue Ying felt anxious. He had seen the palace already, yet why would he have encountered another danger?
…
The void teleported him.
Xue Ying looked forward in a daze.
This was an enormous public square. At the center of the public square, there was a ten-level pagoda. The surrounding square was covered in a white fog.
“This is?” Xue Ying was slightly stunned.
“Little fellow, the pagoda before you is known as the Chaotic Origin Pagoda. There are a total of ten levels, and you would definitely be able to get a top-graded secret treasure if you climbed to the top five levels. The higher you go, the more benefits you get. Every Realm Heart Order holder would gain this opportunity to climb the Chaotic Origin Pagoda the first time you enter the Realm Heart God Palace. This opportunity exists once in your entire life, so properly grab hold of it.” A voice reverberated in the mind of Xue Ying. Closely following that, large amounts of information related to the Chaotic Origin Pagoda began flowing into his mind.
Xue Ying was shocked.
At that moment, he understood.
Chaotic Origin Pagoda…
Any places in the Realm Heart God Palace with the name ‘Chaotic Origin’ were extraordinary.
And reincarnators that held the Realm Heart Order were qualified to come here only after safely getting through two dangerous grounds the first time they entered Realm Heart God Palace. This was ‘Yuan’, and he gave this opportunity to every Realm Heart Order holder. As for whether the holder could grasp hold of the chance, that was another story.
“Even though danger arrives very suddenly in this Realm Heart God Palace, it appears opportunities come abruptly too.” Xue Ying began hyperventilating.

chapters.title: Chapter 1131 - Cultivating within the Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 1131: Cultivating within the Pagoda
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying looked up at the ten-story pagoda situated at the center of the public square. His heart that had been jolted in excitement gradually regained its calm.
What was the reason he spent so much effort to enter the ‘Realm Heart God Palace’ for? Why did he use his wealth to procure an additional two sets of materials meant to cultivate the Southern Cloud Sacred Body from scratch to perfection? Wasn’t it because he wanted to become stronger? So that he could remain for a longer time in the ‘Realm Heart God Palace’ while increasing his chances of encountering great fortunes?
Even though it was possible for him to become stronger if he chose to cultivate slowly, time waits for no man. Nobody knew when his hometown Origin World might enter an apocalypse.
With guidance by successful predecessors or assistance from experts that had jumped out of the cage to a higher dimensional world, his cultivation would be boosted significantly!
‘I’ve paid so much and struggled until now just for the sake of earning an opportunity! And now, it has come.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Even ‘Yuan’ mentioned it before-this opportunity is once in a lifetime! If I missed it, I would no longer have another chance.’
‘I must grasp hold of this great chance. Otherwise, I would regret it my entire life!’
Xue Ying did not wish to see his hometown Origin World destroyed while wallowing in self-pity all by himself at the Realm Heart Great Land.
That was something he had to avoid at all costs!
Xue Ying walked on the public square alone. He soon arrived at the pagoda. Looking upwards, this pagoda had ten levels in total, and it was so tall that it reached the clouds.
He then lowered his head before entering through the entrance.
The insides of the pagoda were huge. At the center, there was a pillar. Surrounding the pillar consisted of many wooden stairs that led to a higher level!
“Da.” Xue Ying took a step up the wooden stairs before feeling a grand force pushing him downwards. He was forced to take two steps back as a result.
‘It seems I have to finish carving the first level pagoda walls before I can proceed to the second level.’
Xue Ying chuckled before turning his gaze at the central pillar.
The cylindrical pillar contained many profound array diagrams. They were all part of the Dao of Void-a total of ten of them.
‘It seems that I can proceed to the second level after successfully caving all ten array diagrams?’ Xue Ying swept his gaze across the place. At the first level, there were a total of ten sides of walls that were currently empty.
When Xue Ying got information about the pagoda supposedly from ‘Yuan’, he also got news about how to advance through the Chaotic Origin Pagoda!
The ‘Chaotic Origin Pagoda’ had a total of ten levels.
On every level, he had to carve ten array diagrams on the walls of the pagoda. The array diagrams all originated from the central pillar.
And he had to learn them! Before he could succeed in carving them!
Of course, Xue Ying was given a time limit…
He had to succeed in carving an array diagram within a ‘million years’ at least. Otherwise, it would represent a failure!
And according to his final result, Xue Ying would be rewarded differently!
As long as he finished carving all ten walls on the fourth level, he would step onto the fifth level! Even if he failed, Xue Ying would still be given a suitable top-graded secret treasure.
And as he carved on the walls from the fifth level all the way to the tenth level, the higher he reached, the more frightening the rewards would be.
‘This is amazing.’ Xue Ying looked at the ten array diagrams inscribed at the central circular pillar, ‘They are profound mysteries of the Dao of Void. Furthermore, they are all profound mysteries on the fusion between the ‘Sky Phase’ and ‘Earth Phase’. It seems that this Chaotic Origin Pagoda formulates different array diagrams according to the realm of the challenger?’
Xue Ying had seen Luo City Lord before.
He was no longer puzzled that experts that had jumped out of the cage and entered a higher dimension, the ‘Chaotic Origin Experts’, could easily determine his current realm.
What he was startled would be for the Chaotic Origin Pagoda to decide a different trial based on the realm of the challenger!
‘I have at most a million years to understand each array diagram.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Which means I can only stay at a level for ten million years at most.’
Ten million years might seem long.
But in reality, to Cosmos Gods, this was a fleeting period of cultivation.
‘I should spend the full ten million years at every level.’ Xue Ying mad his decision, ‘Furthermore, during this period of time, I should focus entirely on comprehending the Dao of Void! Luo City Lord bestowed upon me a total of nine ‘World Flowers’. It is definitely worth it for me to finish using seven to eight of them during this time period when I attempt the Chaotic Origin Pagoda.’
No matter what, he had to leave behind a flower at least.
It would be used at the final stage prior to fusing all nine branches together and breaking through to the ‘final realm of Cosmos God’.
Xue Ying was currently experiencing the mystical World Flower at his hometown Primal Chaos Void. His understanding towards the Dao of Void was steadily deepening. Actually, Xue Ying had just broken through to the level-two Cosmos God Realm not too long ago, and he had not entered a bottleneck. Hence, it was normal for him to constantly improve. Though cultivating with the ‘World Flower’ significantly accelerated his speed of improvement.
‘Tenth level of the Chaotic Origin Pagoda?’ Xue Ying could guess.
It would become harder to advance upwards the further he went, and time was limited! Clearly, ‘Yuan’ was putting the absolute geniuses who were Realm Heart Order holders and had reincarnated into this world to the test to see how much they could improve in a stipulated period! Apparently, all Realm Heart Order holders were geniuses and only the most dazzling ones were worth nurturing by ‘Yuan’.
Ever since Luo City Lord gave him the World Flower seed, saying that ‘I can only do this much for your era’, Xue Ying understood that even ‘Chaotic Origin Experts’ were not willing to bring out those heaven-defying items-these were likely rare even to them.
Chaotic Origin Pagoda…
That was a form of trials. Only those who performed spectacularly would be worth nurturing by Yuan.
‘Not just Yuan or Luo City Lord, or that mysterious person nurturing ‘Emperor Jun’, it seems the higher dimensional existences wish for us to reach that level.’ Xue Ying suddenly had an epiphany.
Some experts sought to destroy all geniuses when they saw them! To hinder them! They did not wish to see them reaching their level.
But Yuan, Luo City Lord, and the one nurturing Emperor Jun… at least the three Chaotic Origin Experts Xue Ying knew about did not obstruct them. Instead, they were willing to aid and support their improvement!
‘Why am I thinking so much? To them, even final realm Cosmos Gods could barely attempt to break through to the higher realm.’ Xue Ying shook his head inwardly. He understood how difficult it was to take this final step of the breakthrough. All final realm Cosmos Gods he knew-Emperor Summer and the others including Sacred Master and Old Monster Stone had not taken that last step.
‘I shall analyze these hidden secrets only after I reached the final realm.’ Xue Ying no longer thought about it.
Staring at the circular pillar before his eyes, he carefully observed the ten array diagrams on it.
‘Let’s begin.’
…
The ten array diagrams on the first level were based on the foundation on fusing ‘Sky Phase’ and ‘Earth Phase’ from the Dao of Void. They were different usage of this foundation. Xue Ying’s fundamentals were strong primarily because he had reached the Cosmos God Realm in all nine branches and was cultivating in the ‘World Flower’ back at his hometown. Hence, he immediately comprehended all ten array diagrams after a single glance.
If he were willing, Xue Ying could succeed in carving all ten diagrams on the inner walls!
But he was not in a rush!
He had to maximize the ten million times he had here! The longer it was, the greater his improvement would be!
Xue Ying only recently stepped into the level-two Cosmos God Realm. He had also just gotten the ‘World Flower’, and thus, time was what he needed most.
******
Time passed.
During the last day of every million years, he would go on and carve an array diagram on the wall, casually succeeding with a single stroke.
From the start of blossom to wither, each World Flower would last 100,000 years.
