chapters.title: Chapter 1139 - I’ll do it myself
chapters.content:
Chapter 1139: I’ll do it myself
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Even though the <Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique> was the one Xue Ying felt would be the easiest to alter-and he easily improved the ‘Scarlet Cloud Domain’ after learning the Chaotic Origin First Strike-the combat technique still consisted of five techniques in overall. Some were easy while others were difficult, especially so with the ‘Combined Technique’. Naturally, it was comparatively easier to alter it as compared to altering ‘Spectacular Painting’ and ‘Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll’.
And he was close to succeeding in his task.
…
The tenth stage began.
Even though this stage was much harder than the previous stage, the strength of Paragon Master Bewitching Sword was honestly frightening. Furthermore, his combat style was absolutely compatible with Paragon Master Pu Su’s domain! Even though Xue Ying suffered from several incoming attacks, he had easily defended himself with a spear. Hence, he crossed through this stage quite casually.
Hunter, Black Sovereign King, and Great Monarch Bone Clamor did not have an easy time. Of which, Great Monarch Bone Clamor became more gravely injured.
“Damn, damn.”
Great Monarch Bone Clamor was left with just a single floating head. Above his head, a crimson mist was gradually forming bones that were jade-like.
That pair of red eyes of his glared at Xue Ying coldly. This time, his injuries worsened. He even had a feeling that it was quite possible for him to fail on the 11th stage! And this Monarch Flying Snow who did not own and top-graded secret treasure had an easy time surviving until now.
‘I am just lacking by a bit. Just one bit!’ As for the aforementioned person, he remained seated cross-legged focusing on his cultivation. Currently, Xue Ying was making full use of his time.
And finally.
Just before the next stage began, ‘I’ve succeeded.’
Seated at a corner of the palace hall, Xue Ying slowly opened his eyes. There was some suppressed happiness in his eyes. And the avatars situated far away in his hometown Primal Chaos Void were also starting their training in this newly created technique.
Absorbing many profound utilizations of the Chaotic Origin Energy from the Chaotic Origin First Strike, Xue Ying finally improved the <Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique> qualitatively!
A true expert understood how to absorb experiences from his predecessors. Southern Cloud King, for instance, had thoroughly pondered and created a killing move belonging to himself after acquiring the ‘Twin Realm Blade’. He even extrapolated the ‘Spectacular Painting’, ‘Arch Destruction’, and created his own ‘Southern Cloud Sacred Body’ through the killing move that he comprehended. By relying on the Southern Cloud Sacred Body, a weaker cultivator could execute those extrapolated techniques.
And ‘Great Paragon Fuyi’ as a Paragon Master, yet he was so powerful that he could disregard some final realm Cosmos Gods, closing in with those unparalleled existences. This had been of his diligence in building over the foundation the predecessors paved, allowing him to create killing moves that were much stronger than before.
The <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> had merely opened a set of doors in front of Xue Ying.
As for how much Xue Ying could absorb from this supreme-graded secret impartation technique would rely on his comprehension abilities.
‘Continue!’ Xue Ying continued researching into creating more powerful techniques.
******
The thousand-year period was up.
And the 11th stage began! Paragon Master Pu Su, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, Xue Ying, Great Monarch Bone Clamor, Black Sovereign King, and Hunter became serious. They understood at this moment that the slightest bit of carelessness would cause them to be killed. Even though they were ‘killed’, in reality, the Realm Heart God Palace would teleport them out at the very last moment before they died.
The scene before them distorted.
Xue Ying felt his body sinking down. He found himself above a dark ocean.
‘What a heavy restrictive force.’
The six of them currently stood in midair looking down at the vast ocean. This spatial restrictive pressure had reached an incredible stage. It far surpassed that found on the Realm Heart Great Land. Most likely only normal Cosmos Gods could survive under such harsh conditions.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying’s personal void-ification technique could only dissipate away half the restrictive force.
“This looks like a strange place.” Paragon Master Pu Su who currently let out his Time Domain had a change in expression. He transmitted over to Xue Ying and Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, “My domain has been restricted.”
“Mn?”
The pupils of Xue Ying dilated. Suddenly, many black shadows started shooting up from deep underneath the ocean.
“Hua.”
An enormous figure shot up from the oceanic water. This unique sea monster was carrying an old man holding a scepter on its back. The old man had very long thin hair, yet in reality, they were thin snakes.
“Cosmos Gods, the few of you actually dared intrude upon the Gui Ruins Sea? You are all seeking death.” The old man carrying the scepter sneered, “Children, kill them!”
“Sou sou sou…”
Many huge scarlet fishes abruptly flew out. They emanate an aura that brought a chill down the hearts of Xue Ying and the rest. This aura represented an end-the end of all life. Time ended here, and everything would thus end! These huge scarlet fishes numbered thousands. They currently charged up from the sea unto Xue Ying and the rest.
“Kill kill kill!” The old man wielding the scepter delightfully grinned, “So what if you are Cosmos Gods? All will die in the Gui Ruins Sea!”
These huge scarlet fishes were extremely fast. They moved through the void as fast as lightning, leaping onto the six of them.
“Weng~”
Xue Ying immediately cast his Mirage and Illusory Realm. Nonetheless, its effectiveness was extremely low on these huge scarlet fishes. Paragon Master Pu Su released his Time Domain, slightly inflicting confusion on these fishes after they entered. But clearly, the entire Time Domain was shaking and trembling and could not hold on for long. As a result, despite the disturbance from the Time Domain, those fishes eventually found the location where Paragon Master Pu Su, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, and Xue Ying’s true bodies were.
“The past, the future, and the present. It seems despite the constant differences in time displacement, they aren’t affected that much?” The expression of Paragon Master Pu Su shifted.
These huge scarlet fishes did not understand much about battling. Instead, their bodies seemingly represented various laws.
“Hong-”
A dazzling sword light flashed out.
Paragon Master Bewitching Sword held onto his god sword slashing out with a force that moved unhindered in all directions! He stood there calmly watching as those huge scarlet fishes were struck-some had been penetrated by his slash, and some had been jolted from the shockwave. For a moment, he could only protect himself with his sword, and not Paragon Master Pu Su or Xue Ying. Regardless, this frightening Dao of Sword startled everyone present.
“This Paragon Master Bewitching Sword is the youngest Great Paragon the Summer Wind Ancient Nation Cang Clan had! His rise is extremely fast and mysterious. Who would have thought that his Dao of Sword has reached such frightening yet perfected stage.” The pupils of Black Sovereign King dilated.
“What an amazing sword technique.” The body of Hunter oscillated between ethereal and reality. He also noticed this scene.
As for Great Monarch Bone Clamor, he was currently defending himself against those frightening huge scarlet fishes in a panic. There had already been ten fishes chomping away his flesh, causing pieces of flesh to disappear on his body.
‘Bewitching Sword, no wonder he is favored greatly by Emperor Cang and Emperor Summer.’ Paragon Master Pu Su was inwardly astonished by what he saw. Previously, his Time Domain had shaved away a majority of the threat. Only now was it the time for Paragon Master Bewitching Sword to display his true strength.
But…
There were thousands even reaching ten thousand huge scarlet fishes. There were so many of them that they had practically covered the entire sky.
Furthermore, the body of each fish was incredibly tough. They had a vibrant life force too! Despite piercing through their bodies, they were able to rapidly recover from the injuries. Following that as more and more attacked Xue Ying, Paragon Master Pu Su, and Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, Paragon Master Pu Su was forced to act.
“Ah, damn, damn.” Some of the bones on Great Monarch Bone Clamor’s body started burning. He took the initiative to ignite his bones so as to produce grander energy in dealing against his current predicament. He was in dire straits.
‘It seems I can’t hold on for long.’ Great Monarch Bone Clamor understood. Those huge scarlet fish contained that sort of ‘termination’ energy which somehow curbed every single technique of theirs. Furthermore, their life force was so incredibly strong that it felt exaggerated. Killing even a single one of them was hard. And now, the stage had just begun recently yet he consumed one-third his life energy already. Hence, he concluded that it was impossible for him to hold on until the end.
‘It seems Pu Su and Bewitching Sword could no longer help that Ying Shan Xue Ying.’ Great Monarch Bone Clamor understood that he would fail, yet he wished to see other people failing with him.
Indeed.
The number of fishes attacking them gradually increased. Paragon Master Bewitching Sword’s display of strength had truly startled others-his Dao of Sword did not seem any weaker than what Sky-Rending Great Paragon and Great Paragon Lu Tian could exert. Furthermore, his sword defenses were quite perfect too! That showed how outstanding he was! And Paragon Master Pu Su had always been powerful. Nonetheless, as the number of fishes grew, things also began to get hard for them.
Gradually, the two could no longer help Xue Ying.
“Peng.” With a flash, a sword light directly forced more than ten huge scarlet fishes away.
“Monarch Flying Snow, I can’t help you any longer. You should be more careful from now.” Paragon Master Bewitching Sword added.
“No worries! I’ll do it myself.” Xue Ying replied.
Wearing the Devil Emperor Gown and carrying the Scarlet Cloud God Spear, Xue Ying stood in midair calmly facing a huge scarlet fish that came his way.
“Peng~”
With a sweep of his spear, that fish was blasted backward.
“What? He can force the fish back?”
“So easy?”
The other five Paragon Masters were shocked. Even Paragon Master Bewitching Sword felt incomparably astonished.
All of them were clear how frightening these huge scarlet fishes that represented various ‘termination’ laws were. Even though it might seem that Paragon Master Bewitching Sword was having an easy time, his strikes had reached the peak final realm Cosmos God standard and were extremely powerful. Furthermore, the Dao of Sword was aligned with strong close combat skills. That was why he could force ten fish away with a strike. But this merely forced them back or injured them heavily. Killing them took quite a lot of effort.
‘What powerful strength.’ Xue Ying could feel a heavy impact being transmitted back through the spear onto his body, ‘They are really hard to deal with. Fortunately, I’ve had enough time in the previous few thousands of years to alter my Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique perfectly.’
Without the help of others, he might not have succeeded in altering the Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique. By then, he would most likely be expelled out during this stage.
But now?
“Sou sou sou~”
His spear rolled.
Many huge scarlet fishes that attacked Xue Ying were forced back. Some had even been injured by the spear. Nevertheless, the number attacking him only increased.
“Kill them for me! Kill!” That old man standing on the enormous sea creature’s back roared out. Those huge scarlet fishes flew up continuously. Gradually, they began surrounding the six Cosmos Gods, forming six huge ‘school of fishes’ that frantically went on offense. As the battle reached the peak, Paragon Master Pu Su could barely keep himself alive, with only Paragon Master Bewitching Sword being able to slightly aid the others a little.
And the injuries on Great Monarch Bone Clamor began deepening rapidly.
‘No, I can’t hold on any longer!’ Great Monarch Bone Clamor was left with just his head floating in the sky. The surrounding crimson mist formed many whips that lashed out in the sky. Regardless, he still couldn’t obstruct the fishes that covered the entire sky. Those fishes penetrated through the obstruction the whips created and gnawed on the head of Great Monarch Bone Clamor.
Even now, he was still looking at the other five.
The other five were all holding on. Even that white-robed young man ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ could still survive. Furthermore, Xue Ying… had not been touched!
‘He, he has a top-graded secret treasure? He is a Great Paragon?’ Great Monarch Bone Clamor soon felt an invisible force enveloping him.
“Hu.”
Before his death, he was teleported out of the Realm Heart God Palace. And thus, his journey in the Realm Heart God Palace had ended! He was the first out of this batch to be expelled out of the palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 1140 - The 12th Stage
chapters.content:
Chapter 1140: The 12th Stage
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying’s spear technique had already greatly improved. Every strike of his was imbued with Chaotic Origin Energy, allowing them to reach the boundary of level-three Cosmos God. Nonetheless, even if he were more powerful, Xue Ying was still weaker by an entire level as compared to Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, Black Sovereign King and the others who had top-graded secret treasure. In addition, with so many huge scarlet fish attacking Xue Ying simultaneously, Xue Ying’s spear technique was constricted.
“Pu pu.”
As a result, it was practically impossible for Xue Ying to parry against every single fish, letting some through that bit on him.
Yet the surface of Xue Ying’s body was covered in three strands of mist. This was none other than the protective technique from the Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique. These huge scarlet fishes could barely bypass the ‘protective mist’ obstacle before reaching Xue Ying. Furthermore, after going through the weakening effect from Xue Ying’s void-ification technique, the remnant wisp of aura reached the fleshy body of Xue Ying.
Yet his Chaotic Origin Refinement Body was overbearing. This bit of aura could not damage his body at all.
‘Too weak. These fishes can’t injure me even if I stand here.’ Xue Ying felt himself relaxing after seeing this.
No other choice.
The fleshy body tempered from the first level of Chaotic Origin Refinement Body augmented with the void-ification technique gave him a body not any weaker than second level Cosmos God body cultivators! That time when Sacred Master attempted to kill Xue Ying in his Ancient Sacred World, he failed to do so-partly also because he did not have the Ancient Sacred Incarnation with him!
In terms of survivability, Xue Ying could show disdain for the majority of other Paragon Masters before coming to the Realm Heart God Palace. After all, having a top-graded secret treasure did not mean their survivability skills were frightening.
And currently, Xue Ying had researched into a new body cultivation technique. The protective technique, Mist, had reached the boundary of third level Cosmos Gods in strength. With this protective technique, his survivability reached an even more frightening stage! It was absolutely beyond that of Paragon Master Pu Su, Hunter and the others.
…
“Mn?”
“This fleshy body is too powerful.” Paragon Master Pu Su, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, Hunter, and Black Sovereign King noticed this.
When those huge scarlet fish penetrated through the protective mist, they could not even bite off the skin of Xue Ying!
This scene made them speechless.
‘In terms of survivability, he is stronger than me. According to the intelligence reports, he has acquired the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll> from my Summer Clan. It is fine that his fleshy body is powerful, but where did he get that protective technique from? It is clear that the power of those huge scarlet fish has diminished tremendously once they crossed the protective mist.’ Paragon Master Pu Su was inwardly startled. He knew beforehand that Xue Ying had powerful survivability. But it was unexpected for the other party to have such heaven-defying protective technique too!
‘It seems like the protective technique from the Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique, albeit much stronger. Where did Xue Ying learn such a formidable protective technique?’ Paragon Master Bewitching Sword felt suspicious and shocked when he saw that.
…
Seeing that he could not be injured by the fishes, Xue Ying began frantically attacking. He was the only one out of the five experts present who dared to allow those monstrous fish to attack him however they wanted.
“Hua.”
A spear struck out.
At the spearhead, a misty ripple began spreading out and destroying everything. Nevertheless, the scales on those huge scarlet monstrous fish were too firm and tough that they were mildly damaged.
‘Even though the Chaotic Origin First Strike is powerful, it could barely injure these huge scarlet fish.’ Xue Ying changed to another spear technique.
Piercing out, the spear struck against the scales of the huge scarlet fish. It seemed the fish wasn’t injured at all on the surface, yet internally, it was gravely injured. Furthermore, a grievous wound had been torn within the fish, and following that, the back of the fish exploded out. Scales could be seen flying in all directions as a savage wound was formed.
‘At least Piercing Void works.’ Xue Ying thought.
The Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique was comprised of five great moves.
Each move had its unique points, like the ‘Piercing Void’. External protective techniques, array protections, and scaled-armor or robes were all useless as this move would transmit force directly through all protection! Naturally, those who had a powerful fleshy body or had powerful inner and external bodies would not be affected by this technique.
But these huge scarlet monstrous fishes did not cultivate. Instead, they were given birth by the laws. Even though they had great scale defenses and vibrant life force, their internal organs were comparatively weaker.
******
Time passed.
Xue Ying’s speed of killing the huge scarlet fish was slightly slower compared to Paragon Master Pu Su, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, and Black Sovereign King since the other Paragon Masters could execute strength at the peak Cosmos God standard. As for Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, he could occasionally exert an even stronger power, and under this force, it could possibly kill a fish instantaneously.
Cosmos Gods had endless energy. Over time, they were able to wipe away the huge scarlet fishes, reducing the pressure on the five of them.
They spent two hours or so before wiping away all the fishes cleanly.
And that old man wielding a scepter standing on the sea creature chose to dive back deep into the sea once he saw that things were amiss.
“Hu.”
Soon, the scenes before the five of them changed. They were teleported back to the hall once again.
Everyone understood that they had finally passed through the 11th stage.
“It seems only Monarch Flying Snow is uninjured during this 11th stage.” The cold eyes of Black Sovereign King turned to Xue Ying. The edge of his lips moved upwards.
“Indeed, all of us have suffered from injuries. Even Bewitching Sword is lightly injured.” Paragon Master Pu Su chuckled. It was almost impossible to defend perfectly against the dense amount of incoming huge scarlet fishes. Hence, all of them suffered from some losses. Only Xue Ying with his protective technique, pinnacle void-ification, and frightening fleshy body remained perfectly fine. He was the lowest profile of the five, and actually the one with the strongest survival capabilities.
Paragon Master Bewitching Sword also smiled at Xue Ying.
“I have to thank Emperor Summer for this.” Xue Ying laughed.
“As long as we cross through the 12th stage successfully, this trip to the Realm Heart God Palace would not have been a wasted trip.” Paragon Master Pu Su said, “Crossing through the 12th stage and we would be greatly rewarded. Hence, the 12th stage is definitely going to be difficult.”
“We have reached a crucial point.” Hunter softly laughed, “I am satisfied to get through the 12th stage.”
“Indeed, best wishes to everyone.” Paragon Master Bewitching Sword nodded too.
Black Sovereign King went silent. His dark eyes flashed coldly.
12th stage…
If they crossed the 12th stage, they would be greatly rewarded. Most would be forced to give up after that.
Because they were clear that the ’15th stage’ was too difficult for them. It was simply wasting their opportunity if they chose to challenge it. Why not visit other places in the Realm Heart God Palace instead? They might get a greater harvest.
‘The 12th stage.’ Xue Ying was also pondering over it.
This time, acquiring the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> made him more delighted than the slightest chance of obtaining a supreme-graded secret treasure.
But he would not find it bad to have more treasures!
And furthermore, the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> was simply a cultivation technique that he could not impart to others. Furthermore, Xue Ying still lacked an appropriate weapon. For instance, the materials used to refine a weapon meant to execute the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> were frighteningly expensive. He had to sell almost all his treasures, yet it was still not enough. Hence, Xue Ying had to venture deeper into the Realm Heart God Palace and try to get more treasures.
By crossing through the 12th stage, he would at least acquire a treasure worth 100 billion cosmos crystals. If he were fortunate, he might get something better!
‘Stake it all!’
Xue Ying closed his eyes. He went back to meditating and continued to perfect his cultivation techniques.
…
All five present had an intense desire towards crossing the 12th stage.
If they could get through it, the rewards they get would be sufficient that even if they were expelled out of the Realm Heart God Palace, it would be a worthwhile trip. They had fought through 11 stages before this all because of this moment.
“It is here.”
“The 12th stage.”
Paragon Master Pu Su, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, Black Sovereign King, Hunter, and Xue Ying turned solemn. After spending a thousand years to recover, they had recovered their state to the peak.
“Weng.”
The scenes before them distorted.
“This is?”
Xue Ying stood on a dark yellow cloud path. Surrounding the cloud path was primal chaos. To the distance, Xue Ying could see many other cloud paths extending beyond.
A total of five cloud paths formed in a fan shape that led toward a deeper region.
From the deep region.
There seemed to be a figure seated on a throne.
That towering figure swept his gaze towards an expert situated on each of the five paths. He mentioned indifferently: “Kill them.”
“Yes.”
Beneath the throne were a group of protectors.
“Sou sou sou…”
Five teams of protectors each charged out on a respective cloud path each.
“Mn?” Xue Ying felt an unseen force surrounding the cloud paths, “It seems we have to fight against the enemy by ourselves?”
That’s right too.
The further they proceeded, the more frightening the rewards would get. Hence, it was logical for only those who were sufficiently strong to be rewarded.
“Sou sou sou…”
With a flash, Xue Ying disappeared. A cloud of mist began spreading out in all directions. His figure had strangely appeared in all the miniature spatial holes that were in the mist. He was constantly changing positions, and occasionally striking out at an enemy! At the same time, he was also paying notice to the fighting happening out in the four other cloud paths so as to find out what was real and illusory.
He did not have to experience it personally to know that the 12th stage is definitely difficult. Even Paragon Master Pu Su and others weren’t confident of it. Xue Ying naturally had to be more careful.
‘So powerful?’
Xue Ying was shocked.
His personal survivability skills were formidable. Furthermore, he had altered the Scarlet Cloud Domain, allowing him to temporarily survive for a longer period of time.
But Paragon Master Pu Su, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, and Black Sovereign King immediately erupted with their full power. Hunter was the only one that was trying his best to evade against the incoming attacks. He sought to observe what was real and illusory.
“Peng peng peng…”
The battles were intense.
Each team had a total of 16 experts. They worked together perfectly well. Their techniques were all profound and they specialized in different aspects-Dao of Void, Dao of Blade, and many other Daos. There were even some that specialized in the soul.
“Peng peng peng…”
Paragon Master Pu Su and Black Sovereign King were injured continually. Even Hunter who was doing his utmost to evade the incoming attacks was becoming wounded. It was only Paragon Master Bewitching Sword who was in a better situation.
“Peng.” Xue Ying felt an unseen ripple sweeping across him. His body trembled. Following that, a huge great hammer came down on him, forcing him out of the tiny spatial pockets. Following that, blades, spears, and arrays started engulfing him.
And on another side-
“Not good.”
The circumstances Paragon Master Pu Su were in became dire. Even though he tried his best to survive, in the blink of an eye, he suffered from nine waves of killing techniques, causing him to be so grievously injured that he reached a state close to death.
“Weng!”
Unseen energy enveloped him. It directly teleported Paragon Master Pu Su out. If this teleportation did not take place, he would have died!
And thus ended the journey of Paragon Master Pu Su in the Realm Heart God Palace!
‘This is too terrifying.’ Black Sovereign King, Hunter, and Xue Ying were all pushed into a corner at this moment.
‘These protectors are coordinating too well.’ Xue Ying no longer cared about others. He had to survive. Previously, he thought he could still observe what was real and illusory given his domain and survival techniques. Now it seemed that his actions were simply a joke.

chapters.title: Chapter 1141 - Paragon Master Flying Snow
chapters.content:
Chapter 1141: Paragon Master Flying Snow
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The 16 protectors formed a combat formation. They were like an entity.
Furthermore, every protector could turn into the core member of the formation, allowing the formation to transform continuously with killing moves sent without stop!
Facing such an enemy, Xue Ying had to face the incoming attacks while striking back! If he sought to take a step back and determine the real from the illusory, he might be forced into a disadvantaged position. Under the chain of killing moves, he might be defeated before he could react!
“Weng!”
The Mirage and Illusory Realm descended. It encompassed the 16 protectors at the same time. Strictly speaking, this team of protectors that Xue Ying faced was the weakest precisely because of disturbance from the Mirage and Illusory Realm! They could only exert about 50-60% strength of what the other protectors could.
“Sou sou sou sou sou…”
Within the surrounding mist, amidst many tiny spatial pockets, a white-robed young man appeared in nine of these pockets.
Nine great avatars!
“Combined attack!”
“Chaotic Origin First Strike-Misty Ripple!”
“Hong hong hong hong hong hong hong hong hong!”
Nine palms were sent out at the same time from each spatial pocket, generating a scary maelstrom of miasma. At the center of the maelstrom was a black region of dead space. This maelstrom directly clashed against the chain of strikes from the 16 protectors. During this moment, those protectors sent three consecutive strikes only to be forced backward by the maelstrom.
And the nine great avatars were forced to take a step back within the spatial pockets consequently.
“Mn?”
Even though Hunter, Black Sovereign King, and Paragon Master Bewitching Sword were embroiled in a life and death battle, they were also paying close notice to the battles happening at other locations.
“It seems he isn’t disadvantaged in a direct collision?”
They were all shocked.
Because they were clear that the joint attacks by these protectors were completely at a standard equivalent to apex final realm Cosmos Gods!
“It seems Monarch Flying Snow owns a top-graded secret treasure?”
“He could execute such a powerful combat force?”
…
The nine great avatars completely unleashed the Chaotic Origin First Strike simultaneously! If they worked together without forming an array, their total power would increase several times. Nonetheless, during these several thousand years, Xue Ying had improved the <Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique>. He spent the longest time improving the combined technique so as to perfect the coordination between his nine great avatars, maximizing their utilization of power.
This technique that originally had a new third-level Cosmos God power, became several times stronger when nine great avatars used it at the same time using the combined technique.
“I can’t carry on further. These protectors have supreme defenses too. I have to rely on the Piercing Void to break apart their formation.”
After the nine great avatars sent out a palm, they then punched out a fish.
“Hong hong hong…”
With nine fists punching out, what they executed were the Piercing Void Style of the <New Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique>. Nine vague ripples formed a maelstrom, with each ripple made from numerous cracks. Chaotic Origin Energy poured in from each of the cracks. When the maelstrom crashed into the formation of the 16 protectors, the force actually transmitted into the body of a thin protector. Xue Ying targeted him because his blade techniques were the most savage and fierce out of the protectors.
“I don’t believe that your body is as powerful as your offense.” Xue Ying gritted his teeth.
“Peng!”
That thin protector’s body exploded. His armor flew in all directions and died at that instance. Actually, the majority of these protectors had slightly weaker bodies. Otherwise, if they were too strong and all-rounded, the difficulty of the 12th stage would have been unfair!
With the death of a protector, the combat formation fluctuated slightly before stabilizing.
“Kill!”
“Change in team formation, continue the battle!”
These protectors became more frenzied. Even though their techniques were sufficiently powerful that they could injure Xue Ying, Paragon Master Pu Su had persisted for ten over moves before being teleported out. Given how powerful Xue Ying’s fleshy body was, he could at least hold on for more than a hundred rounds! Furthermore, he had nine great avatars, making it harder for the protectors to kill him.
And the loss of a protector would indisputably mean a slight drop in the power of the combat formation.
“Peng.””Peng.””Peng.”
The nine avatars of Xue Ying hid amidst the tiny spatial pockets. They sent out another nine fists together in a combined technique.
New Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique-Piercing Void!
Nine avatars, combined attack!
This technique countered against combat formations. Following as the first protector was killed, in the following rounds, Xue Ying suffered from several strikes before blasting out and killing five protectors consecutively. From that moment on, the protectors could no longer resist against Xue Ying’s strength, allowing him to claim a bright victory amidst those present.
…
Paragon Master Bewitching Sword was the only one that wasn’t injured.
Previously during the 11th stage, he suffered from light injuries solely because there were too many huge scarlet fishes. Yet now, there were only 16 enemies fighting against him! Furthermore, they relied on a combat formation to engage in the battle. Given how frightening the sword technique Paragon Master Bewitching Sword had, he could easily parry against every strike from the enemies. Without a doubt, he had the strongest close combat capability amongst those present! And that was how he gradually whittled down the protectors in direct combat.
Even though his efficiency of killing the enemies was lower than Xue Ying’s, he remained uninjured.
…
Even though Paragon Master Bewitching Sword could remain uninjured, one could still not belittle these protectors.
After all, their attacks came continuously without a break! A cultivator who could not resist against it would be doomed immediately. Paragon Master Bewitching Sword had defended himself without letting in a single attack. That was how he could win the battle without being injured. Other than him, the others could not achieve this at all!
Paragon Master Pu Su was the first to be expelled.
And soon, Hunter could no longer hold on any longer. Over time as his body aggregated and dissipated, his injuries worsened until the very final moment.
“Mn?” Hunter noticed the other three beside him.
It was fine for Paragon Master Bewitching Sword to be unparalleled in close combat.
But Black Sovereign King actually erupted with a hidden technique, forming five Shadow Incarnations! His true body could easily appear in the position where his Shadow Incarnations were, allowing him to hold an upper hand in the battle.
‘He has greatly improved. No wonder he chose to enter the Realm Heart God Palace again this time.’ Hunter lightly sighed.
‘There is also that Monarch Flying Snow. With how powerful the combined technique of his nine avatars could exert, he is unquestionably a Paragon Master!’ Hunter sighed again.
“Hua.”
An unseen ripple descended and brought Hunter out.
Hunter was expelled out of the Realm Heart God Palace, marking the end of his journey here.
…
Xue Ying was the first to clear this team of protectors. Paragon Master Bewitching Sword was the second and Black Sovereign King had been the last.
The three of them stood respectively in their own cloud path looking at the others distantly.
“Black Sovereign King, I wouldn’t have thought that you still have your Shadow Incarnation Technique hidden, revealing it only now.” Paragon Master Bewitching Sword commented.
“Even if I hid it deeper, it still couldn’t be compared to Brother Flying Snow! He isn’t weaker than me in direct combat. Furthermore, his domain technique and survivability are beyond mine. Truly admirable.” Black Sovereign King praised.
Wasn’t that the case?
The strongest killing move of Xue Ying had unquestionably reached the Paragon Master combat power. Furthermore, he had also touched the boundary of third level Cosmos Gods in many other aspects including his survivability and domain. He even knew how to cast the Mirage and Illusory Realm technique! Xue Ying was considered extremely all-rounded amidst the ‘Paragon Masters’.
“Hua.”
Following that, a ripple engulfed the three of them.
The three of them saw as everything distorted before them. They began looking forward to the next thing.
After all, crossing through the 12th stage would reward them incredibly!
******
The main doors of the Realm Heart God Palace shut close. And currently outside the main doors.
Quite a few people were gathered here. Even Fire Devil Paragon Master and Great Paragon Lu Tian were still here. As for Great Monarch Bone Clamor and Paragon Master Pu Su, both were here too. The Time Domain of Paragon Master Pu Su was still surrounding him as his body recovered. Nobody dared to act against him since the avatars of several unparalleled existences like Emperor Summer and Limitless City Master were guarding this place.
Because the experts from various locations would be gravely injured and close to death when they were teleported out. Hence, to prevent any assassinations, Emperor Summer and the others naturally left behind avatars to keep a lookout.
“Hua.” Hunter was teleported out too.
“You are out as well?” Paragon Master Pu Su chuckled, “Is Black Sovereign King still inside?”
“What about that Monarch Flying Snow?” Great Monarch Bone Clamor asked the more important question.
“Don’t wait any longer. Black Sovereign King is extremely cunning. He concealed his Shadow Incarnation Technique from all of us. And that Monarch Flying Snow is even more powerful. He doesn’t seem any weaker than me in close combat. Furthermore, he is stronger than me in survivability and domain techniques.” Hunter shook his head, “In this batch who attempted the 18th Stages, that Monarch Flying Snow could possibly be ranked the first in overall combat power.”
“What?” Great Monarch Bone Clamor was stunned.
“So powerful?” Paragon Master Pu Su did not dare believe it. He hurriedly contacted Paragon Master Bewitching Sword.
There were many experts from other ancient nation present too.
“Monarch Flying Snow is a Paragon Master? He seems to be ranked first amongst all of you in strength?”
“So strong?”
“Is that true?”
“He could pass the 12th stage. How do you think his strength is? Furthermore, before teleporting out, according to what I saw, he should be the first to wipe out his enemies.” Hunter retorted with a question.
After a moment.
Paragon Master Bewitching Sword and Black Sovereign King who had just crossed the 12th trial began leaking out information as their good friends questioned them. Xue Ying was also questioned by several friends of his. Sky-Rending Great Paragon even congratulated him for crossing the 12th stage. Xue Ying could only admit the fact honestly since such matters could hardly be concealed.
And naturally, everyone knew about how Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, Black Sovereign King, and Monarch Flying Snow had cleared the 12th stage.
And Monarch Flying Snow was publicly acknowledged as a Paragon Master. This was broadcasted and spread across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
…
It was naturally fast when news spread between Cosmos Gods in the Realm Heart Great Land. Various superpowers also knew about the emergence of a new Paragon Master.
And this piece of news naturally reached the Southern Cloud Nation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1142 - Sea Domain Origin
chapters.content:
Chapter 1142: Sea Domain Origin
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Haha, it seems Xue Ying has gained quite a lot in his trip to the Realm Heart God Palace. For him to persist in there for more than 100 million years and to be this strong, is it because he has found a top-graded secret treasure?” Southern Cloud King shook his head with a smile, “This disciple of mine seems more fortunate than his teacher, I! Thinking back to the past, how much effort did I put in just to get my top-graded secret treasure?”
In order to get the top-graded secret treasure, ‘Twin Realm Blade’, Southern Cloud King was forced to swear an oath. Furthermore, this ‘teacher’ of his, the Undying Underworld Emperor, who was an ancient existence that existed before the First War of the Ancient Nations, actually came back alive.
Otherwise, given the strength of the Southern Cloud King, it was impossible for Undying Underworld Emperor to do anything to him even if he chose to disobey the oath.
But Southern Cloud King wasn’t willing to do so until a critical moment.
“Paragon Master? This Ying Shan Xue Ying seems really fortunate!”
“I’ve entered the Realm Heart God Palace before. Yet I did not breakthrough nor did I get a top-graded secret treasure.”
The experts that received the piece of news like Fire Devil Paragon Master and others began having thoughts about it. They were either envious, jealous, or rueful.
After all, the Fan Clan only had a total of six Great Paragons after such a long period! It was really not an easy task to become a Paragon Master.
…
Realm Heart God Palace.
Within that grand palace stood three figures-Xue Ying, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, and Black Sovereign. They had just completed the 12th stage.
“News spread really fast.” Xue Ying shook his head.
“Haha, Brother Flying Snow, it is naturally impossible for you to hide your current strength from the world.” Black Sovereign chuckled, “But you are really vigilant. Even though you are this strong, you still let Bewitching Sword and Pu Su help you.”
After all, Pu Su had been expelled before even completing the 12th stage. Xue Ying was clearly powerful, yet he deliberately disguised himself as a weak cultivator. Black Sovereign was saying this to incite disharmony.
He was clear that the Summer Wind Ancient Nation was slightly prejudiced against outsiders. Only the Fan Clan treated outsiders relatively better.
Paragon Master Bewitching Sword merely replied: “Flying Snow is an Honored Guest of my Summer Wind Ancient Nation. It is natural for him to work together with us. With his Mirage and Illusory Realm, we were able to complete several stages without expending as much effort! If Brother Flying Snow could help us in the 12th stage with his Mirage and Illusory Realm, Pu Su wouldn’t have lost.”
Indeed.
The Mirage and Illusory Realm had influenced every single protector, causing the overall combat formation strength to diminish. Hence, it was probable for Paragon Master Pu Su to win his battle.
Xue Ying glanced at Paragon Master Bewitching Sword. He was relatively grateful for his understanding.
In reality, the ‘combined technique’ had been the final move he altered in the Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique. The original combined technique was a three-men combined technique! And now, Xue Ying had altered it for nine avatars to use. Furthermore, it was adapted to allow Chaotic Origin Energy to be applied to his techniques. Xue Ying spent quite a lot of effort to do so. Only when he succeeded in creating this combined technique could he reach his current strength with his nine avatars.
“Ka ka ka~”
And now, three stone platforms started rising on the floor of the palace hall. Each platform had a stone box placed on top of it.
“It’s here.”
The eyes of Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, Black Sovereign, and Xue Ying brightened. They spent so much effort crossing the 12 stages all for this moment! It was time they were rewarded.
The three of them went forward. They moved according to their senses towards their respective stone platform, lightly placing their hands on a stone box each.
“Hua.””Hua.””Hua.”
It was practically simultaneous. All of them opened their boxes, revealing a joyous look, albeit Xue Ying was slightly more ‘shocked’ than excited.
‘It actually…?’ Xue Ying looked at the scarlet spherical bead placed within the stone box. The spherical bead contained many spots of light moving about. It also contained an extremely profound law. The light spots were constantly revolving about, and if one carefully focused on a particular light spot, one would see a unique cosmos.
That’s right, each light spot contained an actual cosmos!
‘Sea Domain Origin?’ Xue Ying paid notice to his peripheral vision at the treasures placed in the other two stone boxes. The treasures bestowed upon them were relatively normal-valued at about 100 billion cosmos crystals.
‘Why would I be given a bead of Sea Domain Origin?’ Xue Ying was incomparably shocked.
Sea Domain Origin.
That was something incredibly precious. It could be used as the foundation in forming a Sea Domain, allowing the user to become a Sea Domain Master. Within the Sea Domain, the master would be strengthened by various supportive forces. Furthermore, being a Sea Domain Master would greatly boost one’s cultivation rate in the Dao of Void.
At the same time, this ‘Sea Domain Origin’ could be used to refine weapons or turn into the core of a puppet. It could also be taken as the core of a cavern-dwelling. This was a precious treasure that one could hope for but not get it. In terms of value, it was worth beyond ordinary top-graded secret treasures and was even rarer than them.
“Why would he be given a piece of Sea Domain Origin?”
“This legendary item has appeared?”
Black Sovereign and Paragon Master Bewitching Sword noticed what Xue Ying got. They were extremely shocked.
One could see how different the favorites of Realm Heart God Palace were treated.
When he completed the ninth stage, despite not entering from the first minor stage-also the 7th stage, and that Xue Ying had been protected by other cultivators, he was still given an equivalent treasure.
And now that he crossed the 12th stage while revealing his true strength, the treasure given to Monarch Flying Snow had been an entire level beyond what was given to others.
“Sou.” Xue Ying kept it.
The pupils of Black Sovereign dilated. At the same time, he surreptitiously transmitted: “Primogenitor, I discovered a bead of Sea Domain Origin. It has been given to Monarch Flying Snow when he crossed the 12th stage.”
…
Eternal Night Primogenitor was currently located in a huge public square within the Realm Heart God Palace. He was currently looking at a complex inscribed diagram in this place. After spending some time studying the diagram, he came to the conclusion that this inscribed diagram contained profound mysteries of the Supreme Law. Furthermore, there were some secrets hidden within. If he could unravel the mystery, he would be greatly rewarded.
Reaching their level, the Realm Heart God Palace had harsher demands to them. Hence, it was harder for them to get any rewards.
“Mn?” The white, tender face of Eternal Night Primogenitor changed as a strand of astonishment appeared in his eyes, “Sea Domain Origin? Monarch Flying Snow from the Southern Cloud Nation had been bestowed with a bead of Sea Domain Origin?”
“This treasure is a waste in his hands. It is destined to be mine.” Eternal Night Primogenitor revealed a grin.
Eternal Night Primogenitor was unquestionably the number one expert in refining magic servants. He refined the Nine Eternal Night Walkers that were all Cosmos God magic servants. Of which the strongest servant could compare against that of Southern Cloud King.
Nevertheless, Eternal Night Primogenitor was not satisfied. He had been seeking to refine an even more powerful magic servant. The refinement process was also some sort of cultivation to him. And naturally, to refine a more powerful magic servant, better materials had to be taken out.
“The Sea Domain Origin is the most appropriate material to be assumed as the core for light and dark.” Eternal Night Primogenitor revealed a smile. He then took a step and broke through the sky.
Not many experts dared to fly wantonly in the Realm Heart God Palace.
…
“Sea Domain Origin? Monarch Flying Snow, congratulations to you!” Black Sovereign sighed, “You really make me envious. The treasures bestowed to me and Bewitching Sword are normal, yet Monarch Flying Snow has been given a bead of Sea Domain Origin that is worth much more. It seems this Realm Heart God Palace favors you a lot.”
“It’s just luck.” Xue Ying began walking out of the palace hall.
“Why? Monarch Flying Snow is planning to leave already?” Black Sovereign asked, “Are you not going to continue until the 15th stage?”
Previously after getting the treasure, they were also informed about where the next three stages would be held at.
Nonetheless, Xue Ying understood his own capabilities. He did not own any top-graded secret treasure, and it was hard completing the 12th stage already. As for the 15th stage? It was hopeless for him!
Now that he chose to leave, he could still venture to other places in the Realm Heart God Palace.
Otherwise, if he were expelled during one of the later stages, that would mark the end of his journey in the Realm Heart God Palace.
“It is time for me to leave. Continuing is a waste of chance here.” Paragon Master Bewitching Sword also began walking out.
“I originally thought of attempting one or two more stages, but since the two of you have given up, I shall give up too. It is better to be a little more prudent.” Black Sovereign said, “Monarch Flying Snow, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, what are your plans now?”
Xue Ying turned to Black Sovereign. He felt a strand of suspicion rising in his heart.
Black Sovereign?
When did he become so nosy?
Furthermore, ancient nations would usually not share the intelligence they got within the Realm Heart God Palace with others. Like the three great clans in Summer Wind Ancient Nation? They weren’t even willing to share it with the Honored Guests.
“Hong!” A booming loud sound could be heard from afar as a frightening ripple spread out in all directions.
“What is going on?”
Xue Ying, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, and Black Sovereign just walked out of the palace hall when they turned to the distance.
“Given how frightening the fluctuations are, it should be made from an unparalleled existence.” Paragon Master Bewitching Sword added.
The moment he finished speaking.
“Hu.”
A brilliant light flashed in the distance. Xue Ying and the others discovered a figure condensing in the sky. This figure was covered in a golden-edged black cape. Currently, the golden edges were lit up. He had a white tender face and looked handsome. When he looked downwards at the group of Cosmos Gods, it felt as if he was peering into the souls of those present.
This unseen pressure startled Xue Ying and Paragon Master Bewitching Sword.
“Eternal Night Primogenitor.” Xue Ying immediately recognized this ancient unparalleled existence.
‘Why is it so coincidental for Eternal Night Primogenitor to come here?’ Xue Ying felt his heart trembling. Thinking about the properties of the ‘Sea Domain Origin’, and recalling back about the pile of words spouted by Black Sovereign abnormally…
“Monarch Flying Snow, be careful! That frightening combat ripples should be made by Eternal Night Primogenitor. He seemed to have rushed over at high speed without slowing down through some of the dangers existing in the Realm Heart God Palace! Yet he actually stopped before us! He most likely came here without kind intentions. I’ll report upwards to His Majesty Emperor Summer. Try to delay for more time.” Paragon Master Bewitching Sword transmitted to Xue Ying. They were all intelligent and acute cultivators and could deduce easily how abnormal was it for Eternal Night Primogenitor to come here.

chapters.title: Chapter 1143 - Eternal Night Primogenitor and Dong Bo Xue Ying
chapters.content:
Chapter 1143: Eternal Night Primogenitor and Dong Bo Xue Ying
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Greetings Eternal Night Primogenitor.” Paragon Master Bewitching Sword and Xue Ying bowed, showing their respect for the unparalleled existence.
Eternal Night Primogenitor looked downwards. His gaze landed on Xue Ying. He said with a cold, clear voice: “Monarch Flying Snow, hand over the Sea Origin Domain and I will spare your life.”
Xue Ying was startled.
He truly came to snatch his treasure?
“Since you aren’t willing, then just die.” Eternal Night Primogenitor indifferently uttered. When he mentioned the Sea Origin Domain, if Xue Ying were willing to hand it over without hesitation, Eternal Night Primogenitor might still spare the other party’s life because that represented a psychological fear in Xue Ying of being unwilling to become enemies with him in view of the gap in strength.
But facing the demands from an unparalleled existence with hesitation, it was clear that Xue Ying wasn’t sufficiently fearful towards ‘unparalleled existence’!
Without sufficient threat, it would be hard to predict what could happen.
Since that’s the case, he might as well just kill the other party!
“What!”
How would Xue Ying have thought that the other party was so tyrannical that he chose to wipe him out after demanding for the treasure all because he hesitated momentarily!
“Eternal Night Primogenitor.” Paragon Master Bewitching Sword shouted out, “Monarch Flying Snow is an Honored Guest of my Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Primogenitor, could you not…”
Black Sovereign glanced at Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, mumbling inwardly: ‘Paragon Master Bewitching Sword is clearly a member of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Why would he lean towards helping Monarch Flying Snow? When was it that members from the three great clans of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation become so close to the Honored Guests?’
‘Are you using the Summer Wind Ancient Nation to suppress me?’ The edge of Eternal Night Primogenitor’s lips moved upwards. It was filled with mockery.
By teaming up with Extreme Night Primogenitor, they could fight against the Summer Wind Ancient Nation without losing out.
Should relationships are torn between them, they would just fight!
It was common for many cities to be wiped during wars between the ancient nations.
“Scram!”
Eternal Night Primogenitor waved his hand, causing a wave of grand golden energy to sweep out against Paragon Master Bewitching Sword. Paragon Master Bewitching Sword attempted to resist against this incoming wave using his god sword, yet he was still forced backward from the vast force, slamming against the distant corridor walls. Furthermore, he could hear incessant ringing sounds in his ears which tunneled and screeched against his soul.
“Eternal Night Primogenitor, I am willing to hand over the Sea Origin Domain!” Xue Ying shouted out. He was not foolish. If he were killed, all his treasures would be gone. He would even lose the opportunity to venture deeper into the Realm Heart God Palace. Hence, it was wiser for him to temporarily lower his head.
“I gave you the chance earlier, yet you did not grasp hold of it. It is too late now!” Eternal Night Primogenitor waved his hand, causing a wave of energy to fall unto Xue Ying.
Xue Ying’s expression paled.
“Hua~”
Mist immediately began forming in the surroundings with numerous tiny spatial pockets appearing. Xue Ying immediately hid in nine of the tiny spatial pockets, with every pocket containing an avatar of his. Facing that wave of endless light executed by Eternal Night Primogenitor when he waved his hands, Xue Ying did not hesitate to display his New Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique, ‘Piercing Void’.
This move could bypass all defenses of arrays and secret treasures, permeating into the body of the enemies. It might be possible for Xue Ying to injure Eternal Night Primogenitor.
So what if Eternal Night Primogenitor was powerful?
In terms of the realm, he was merely at the final realm of Cosmos God. Compared to him who had fused six branches together, it was limited in how much the other party overwhelmed him in the realm! It was only because of his supreme-graded secret treasure that gave the other party his current power. Since Xue Ying would die regardless, why not just fight back?
“Hong hong hong…”
Nine fists punched out at the same time from within the tiny spatial pockets. Nine ripples rotated into a maelstrom that welcomed the incoming golden light.
Piercing Void!
Nine avatars, combined attack!
“Ah.”
When the immensely resplendent golden light reached the maelstrom, it forced its way into the nine tiny spatial pockets, blasting out against the nine avatars. The protective mist that protected each avatar was easily broken, causing the incoming force to strike against the fleshy bodies of the avatars that were currently maintaining the pinnacle of void-ification. The ‘pinnacle of void-ification’ could barely shave off 10% to 20% of the incoming force. After all, such a supreme technique had limited the efficiency of void-ification.
It was fortunate that Eternal Night Primogenitor merely waved his hand casually. And his attack had been shared equally amongst the nine avatars. Hence, the outcome was that part of Xue Ying’s flesh had been corroded.
‘Is this the gap?’ Xue Ying understood in his heart.
Even a level-two Cosmos God body cultivator would be wiped out in a single technique when faced with supreme power.
It was amazing for him to survive under a casual wave.
“Still alive? Your protective technique is slightly interesting. Nine avatars?” Eternal Night Primogenitor slightly frowned. He felt humiliated from failing to kill the other party with a casual wave.
“Hu.”
Eternal Night Primogenitor sent another casual palm over. This palm was grand-it had seemingly covered the world and the Supreme Law! Indeed, by relying on the supreme-graded secret treasure which he brought along, a casual strike of his contained supreme power.
This time, Xue Ying dared not resist against it head-on. Every nine spatial pockets saw a palm extending out. Xue Ying began executing the protective technique from the Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique. In the past, Scarlet Cloud Paragon Master wasn’t afraid of group battles because he had a formidable protective technique. It’s a pity that this ‘protective technique’ was a joke before an ‘unparalleled existence’.
Just like plucking the string of the world…
The five fingers on the enormous palm lightly plucked, messing up the nine palms Xue Ying sent out in a bid to defend himself.
“Peng peng peng peng…” Following that, this white tender palm of Eternal Night Primogenitor softly ruffled across the nine tiny spatial pockets.
All nine spatial pockets were destroyed.
And the protective techniques on all nine avatars were broken apart. They were forced back, slamming against the walls in the palace hall.
And every avatar began shattering. Nonetheless, each body rapidly recovered in view of the powerful lifeforce supporting them. Reaching the level of Xue Ying, having his body shatter into powder did not mean much. More importantly, it was whether if his lifeforce could support his survival. Previously, he had consumed 10% of his total lifeforce from the first strike. And this technique shaved away close to 20% more.
‘My survival capabilities can be ranked in the front amongst Paragon Masters, but it is still too weak before unparalleled existences. What a pity that my realm is lacking. If I could display a more profound level of the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>, how could I be flicked so easily?’ Xue Ying felt unwilling.
In reality, it was amazing for him to survive a few moves before unparalleled existences.
“Mn?”
Eternal Night Primogenitor suddenly sensed something-he could feel a terrifying existence rushing over. Furthermore, the other party made him feel suppressed. Eternal Night Primogenitor was clear that across the entire Realm Heart Great Land, there was only one who would make him feel such pressure-Emperor Summer! He was also faintly recognized as the number one expert in the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
“Trouble.” Eternal Night Primogenitor immediately took out a golden scepter from his waist.
The golden scepter abruptly expanded.
“Hong.”
He casually struck downwards with his scepter!
“Hua!”
Endless streams of resplendent gold light appeared in the surrounding world. These streams were everywhere! And dodging them was impossible. Furthermore, each strand of gold light represented one gold scepter.
“Peng peng peng peng peng peng…” All nine avatars of Xue Ying suffered from the illumination of the gold light. The scepters struck consecutively on his body.
His body felt really hot!
Even his soul felt like it was boiling!
“Hua!”
The nine avatars-under the illumination of the endless gold light and the numerous strikes-were all wiped out. And Xue Ying left behind just his storage treasure and weapons.
Even though the Realm Heart God Palace was a dangerous place, it wasn’t fatal to cultivators.
The only cause of death in the Realm Heart God Palace was death by other cultivators! Just that this scene of an unparalleled existence acting against a junior was something rare.
No matter what, Monarch Flying Snow’s journey in the Realm Heart God Palace had thus ended.
“Damn.” Paragon Master Bewitching Sword could only watch in the distance. Seeing the nine avatars of Xue Ying being killed, he could not help but grit his teeth indignantly.
“Eternal Night, are you so shameless to act against a junior?” A grand voice descended and pressed down against this world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1144 - Peaceful Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 1144: Peaceful Years
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Outside the main entrance of the Realm Heart God Palace, that group of cultivators who had been expelled awhile ago soon received a piece of news that made them speechless.
Emperor Summer had engaged in a great battle with Eternal Night Primogenitor within the Realm Heart God Palace. It produced an incredibly huge disturbance. Eternal Night Primogenitor had fought as he fled. Along the way, he even activated several forbidden traps in the Realm Heart God Palace. In the end, Eternal Night Primogenitor still escaped-he relied on the unique environment of the Realm Heart God Palace, albeit he suffered from quite a serious injury.
This huge battle had been witnessed by several experts still within the Realm Heart God Palace.
And the reason why this battle started? It was actually because Eternal Night Primogenitor killed Monarch Flying Snow from the Southern Cloud Nation, stealing away his treasures. No matter what, Monarch Flying Snow is a member on the side of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Since Eternal Night Primogenitor bullied a junior, Emperor Summer would naturally have to stand out! Otherwise, would it not make the other Honored Guests feel chilled?
“What a huge battle. It is rare for unparalleled existences to fight against one another.”
“Poor Monarch Flying Snow though. He paid a huge price to enter the Realm Heart God Palace. Furthermore, his luck in the Realm Heart God Palace had been good, to spend more than 100 million years in there, he should have acquired a top-graded secret treasure, allowing him to reach Paragon Master in strength! After completing the 12th stage, he even got a precious treasure, the ‘Sea Domain Origin’. What a pity that he lost everything before Eternal Night Primogenitor. Some of the treasures which he had with him, including the Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasure, had been lost. He has definitely suffered from a grave loss this time!”
“That’s right! If I were to lose so many treasures like him, I would feel incredibly heart ached!”
“But it’s not bad already since he has many other avatars and is still alive!”
“So what if he could still live? He was a Paragon Master previously, yet now he lost his top-graded secret treasure, dropping back to an ordinary level-two Cosmos God expert. Furthermore, he lost his Mirage and Illusory Realm secret treasure too. Hence, even his previous capabilities have been diminished.”
This large group of Cosmos Gods outside the main entrance were discussing amongst each other.
The majority of them did not gain much from the Realm Heart God Palace. Hearing what happened to Xue Ying, they felt schadenfreude! After all, the relationship between the six great ancient nations wasn’t good in the Realm Heart Great Land-they frequently battled. Seeing a member from another superpower suffer from a huge loss would delight others greatly.
“What a pity.” Fire Devil Paragon Master sighed. Being a member of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, he still stood on the side of Xue Ying. Currently, he did not envy or feel jealous of Xue Ying. Instead, he felt pity, “Hmph, Eternal Night Primogenitor is an unparalleled existence yet he disregarded his reputation to deal against a junior?”
“Monarch Flying Snow has suffered from a huge loss this time. It seems it would take quite a long time for him to emancipate himself from his losses!”
******
In the history of Realm Heart God Palace, there were cultivators who fell. All of them died because of other cultivators.
As the Realm Heart God Palace was a huge place, those with a closer relationship would usually travel together. If they entered the same region as other opponents, they would battle! But it was rare for them to succeed in killing other opponents! This time, Xue Ying was the only one who got killed in the Realm Heart God Palace. Furthermore, there was the recent news of how Xue Ying had become a Paragon Master expert, yet closely following that, another piece of news came illustrating how Eternal Night Primogenitor had killed him and taken all his treasures. This brought sighs of sorrow across many Cosmos Gods in the Realm Heart Great Land when they heard of it.
“He has just risen momentarily before falling. Fate is truly fickle.”
“What a pitiful Monarch Flying Snow.”
Whenever Cosmos Gods gathered in the Realm Heart Great Land, the moment Xue Ying was mentioned, they would sigh about it.
The majority felt sympathy.
After all, it was extremely difficult for those outside the six great ancient nations to get their hands on a piece of top-graded secret treasure to become a Paragon Master. Monarch Flying Snow had just risen yet on the same day itself, he was killed by Eternal Night Primogenitor. Fortunately, Xue Ying had other avatars in the outside world. Otherwise, if he died there and then, it would be more lamentable.
…
Southern Cloud Nation, Flying Snow City.
Within the Monarch Residence.
Xue Ying sat by himself in silence beside the lake with a warm wine by his side. Right before his death, Xue Ying experienced the full-powered move executed by Eternal Night Primogenitor with his scepter. Under the bombardment of the wave of light, he could not dodge at all! That terrifying power brought chills down Xue Ying’s heart. That was a true eruption of strength by existences of a level above Cosmos Gods!
Eternal Night Primogenitor relied on his supreme-graded secret treasure to execute this full-powered move. Under this strike, Xue Ying’s nine avatars were wiped, and his treasures were lost.
“Even though I lost a great deal, I gained the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> during this trip. It is still a worthwhile trip for me.” Xue Ying was calm.
Even though he was furious from what had happened previously, Xue Ying could only put this aside temporarily when facing against Eternal Night Primogenitor. Calmly meditating and improving his strength was still more important! Furthermore, the day to the apocalypse of his hometown Primal Chaos Void was flogging him constantly, urging Xue Ying to reach the final realm as quick as possible.
“Xue Ying.” A figure appeared in the sky. It was none other than the black-robed Southern Cloud King.
“Teacher.” Xue Ying stood.
Southern Cloud King descended. He walked towards Xue Ying and sat down beside him. After pouring a cup of wine for himself, he chuckled: “I was originally worried that this episode might bring a huge psychological shock to you. Witnessing how calm you are, I feel reassured. Your heart realm is quite good-you are able to remain calm despite facing such a huge loss.”
Xue Ying smiled.
If everything happened according to what the outside world thought…
After attaining a top-graded secret treasure and a bead of Sea Domain Origin, yet he died and lost them shortly after. In addition, even his Devil Emperor Gown, Scarlet Cloud God Spear, Five Phase Beads were lost. This psychological blow would be tremendous! It could make a level-two Cosmos God go mad. Even he could not maintain calm and tranquil after that.
But in reality.
Xue Ying did not acquire any top-graded secret treasures. Instead, he relied on the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> to alter his Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique and the nine great avatars. Only then did he become that strong. As for the treasures that he lost? These treasures were no longer helpful to his strength. To him, it was merely a loss of precious treasures. What he attained was way more precious than what he had-the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> that could make unparalleled existences red with envy.
“It has happened already. There is no point for me to think about it. I am ultimately too weak.” Xue Ying said.
“Quite a few contacted you regarding this right?” Southern Cloud King chuckled.
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded, “There are many who consoled me, and some invited me over for a banquet. Even though many sympathized with me, some even pitied me for my losses. But I reckon quite a few are feeling happy over my suffering.”
Southern Cloud King became even more astonished after hearing what his disciple spoke-how could he be so calm and open about what he recently experienced?
“What are your plans?” Southern Cloud King asked.
“What can I do other than concentrate on cultivating? Unless I should run over and take revenge on Eternal Night Primogenitor? That is simply seeking death.” Xue Ying chuckled casually.
…
Indeed, in the following days.
Xue Ying did not see any guests. He continued cultivating without showing off too much to the world. He even sent an avatar to the Fan Clan.
“Younger Brother Flying Snow.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon welcomed him, “I’ve heard news of you too. That Eternal Night Primogenitor is an unparalleled existence yet he actually moved against you in the Realm Heart God Palace to snatch your treasures. That is simply too excessive. It’s a pity that my Summer Wind Ancient Nation could do nothing against him.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying nodded.
There was too much hatred and grievances between the two great ancient nations. Hence, his matter was just a minor one.
“Sky-Rending Great Paragon, this time, I came because I wanted to cultivate under the Burning Heart God Tree.” Xue Ying said, “I should be able to exchange it with my contribution points right?”
“Oh?” Sky-Rending Great Paragon revealed a grin, “Naturally you can. 10,000 contribution points could be exchanged for 100 million years of cultivation.”
The Burning Heart God Tree was always there.
Two billion years meant 200,000 contribution points! That could be exchanged for a piece of top-graded secret treasure. The other party had a sinister heart.
“I’ll cultivate then.” Xue Ying did not say much. He directly stood.
“Go go go.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon sent Xue Ying over extremely passionately. Currently, Xue Ying still had 40,000 contribution points with him. If he planned on using it to exchange for some treasures, the Fan Clan had to fork them out. As for the Burning Heart God Tree? Cultivating under the Burning Heart God Tree would not affect the tree at all. It would only consume some ‘time’, just several hundred million years.
Hence…
A white-robed young man sat down cross-legged under this short yet thick Burning Heart God Tree that seemed like a violet jade sculpture.
…
Time passed silently.
In his hometown Primal Chaos Void, and in the Realm Heart Great Land, all avatars of Xue Ying were silently cultivating. His strength also rose over time without others knowing about it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1145 - Level-Two Mirage
chapters.content:
Chapter 1145: Level-Two Mirage
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The deep violet leaves from the Burning Heart God Tree fell onto the ground.
A white-robed young man sat here calmly meditating.
“It has been 400 million years. Monarch Flying Snow shouldn’t be trying to prolong his cultivation right?” A female attendant waited from afar, “I’ll wait a little longer. If he does not leave after the year is up, I’ll take the initiative to ask him away.”
Suddenly, the white-robed young man stood up.
“Mn?” This female attendant was startled. She immediately went forward while simultaneously transmitting a voice message to the higher-ups from the Fan Clan, “Monarch Andromeda, Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow has stopped his cultivation.”
She hurried over to Xue Ying, respectfully greeting: “Upper Honored Guest Flying Snow.”
“I’m done with my cultivation. It is time for me to leave.” Xue Ying said. He then looked up as a muscular male flew over. He was Monarch Andromeda whom Xue Ying was very familiar with. Monarch Andromeda greeted enthusiastically: “Brother Flying Snow, Great Paragon has entered closed-door cultivation currently, and he has already given the orders for me to receive Brother Flying Snow. If there are any matters that you need, Brother Flying Snow can just tell me directly.”
“There isn’t anything I need now. Since I’ve exchanged all my contribution points, it is time for me to make my move.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“Haha, it isn’t hard for Brother Flying Snow to earn more contribution points.” Monarch Andromeda smiled. They were clear that this Xue Ying would have used his <Nine Rotation Undying Technique> to exchange for several cultivation techniques and precious materials with other ancient nations. Relying on those materials, he could exchange for more points with the Fan Clan! By then, he could resume his cultivation under the ‘Burning Heart God Tree’ using more points.
“I’ll naturally come back when I wish to.” Xue Ying did not elaborate.
“Alright.” Monarch Andromeda nodded, “I’ll send Brother Flying Snow off then.”
Xue Ying felt rueful.
After he finished his contribution points, Xue Ying no longer brought out any new precious cultivation techniques ever since the Nine Rotation Undying Technique! He could see that the enthusiasm the Fan Clan had toward him dwindling. Even if Sky-Rending Great Paragon were busy, he should have sent a level-two Cosmos God to receive him. Yet ‘Monarch Andromeda’ was merely a level-one Cosmos God.
Maybe Sky-Rending Great Paragon and the others thought that Xue Ying’s losses in the Realm Heart God Palace were too great! Even if he exchanged the Nine Rotation Undying Technique with other ancient nations, he would have to work hard to acquire a piece of top-graded secret treasure.
Without benefits…
And Xue Ying’s strength was something the Fan Clan could disregard, it was normal for the Fan Clan to treat him less enthusiastically.
‘In reality, I have even better cultivation techniques, but I’m not in a rush to exchange them away.’ Xue Ying thought.
That’s right.
He cultivated for 400 million years under the Burning Heart God Tree with a soul that had been strengthened using the droplet of core blood from the ‘Universal Dragon Mother’ in the Realm Heart God Palace. This period of training exemplified how frightening Xue Ying’s talent in the Mirage was! He once tried fusing the ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’ Dao, yet he met many obstacles…
Xue Ying did not immerse himself to force his way through. Instead, he turned towards cultivating the Dao of Void in the past, while gradually allowing the final two branches in the ‘five branches of the Dao of Mirage’ to improve to the Cosmos God Realm. This took him 200 million or so years.
Once he broke through.
All five branches had reached the pinnacle! The five branches of the Mirage and Illusory Realm represented five different directions. Furthermore, under mutual corroboration, Xue Ying had an easier time fusing them together.
He attempted fusing the two branches he had greatest experience and confidence of-the ‘World and Bewilderment’. Just 100 million years or so later, Xue Ying succeeded in fusing them, and it was then he finally stepped into the level-two Cosmos God Realm in the Dao of ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’!
If this was made known publicly…
It would frighten the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
Because the Dao of Soul was well-known for being difficult to cultivate in. Like the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, there were only three in the entire Realm Heart Great Land that had reached the level-two Cosmos God realm. They were respectively Ancestor Fan, Towering Sky King, and a Paragon Master expert in the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, ‘Heart Devil King’. These three desired to see other level-two Mirage scriptures! Especially those that they had not comprehended.
Ancestor Fan had fused three branches together-World, Desire, and Soul! He kept failing to fuse them with ‘Slaughter’ and ‘Bewilderment’.
Towering Sky King had fused the World and Soul together.
And Myriad Realms Ancient Nation’s ‘Heart Devil King’ had fused Bewilderment and Sou together.
In the past-
Ancestor Fan did not care about Towering Sky King. Instead, he sought to acquire the self-created scripture of ‘Heart Devil King’ since it would aid him.
In the vast Realm Heart Great Land, a consensus gradually appeared between peak Cosmos Gods-one of how to jump out of this cage and reach the higher realm! It was likely that they had to reach the peak Cosmos God in the Dao of Soul. It’s a pity that many unparalleled existences existed across the entire Realm Heart Great Land, and many had reached the peak Cosmos God. Yet none had reached the final realm in the Dao of Soul.
“Currently, I have fused the World and Bewilderment branches together. As long as I recorded some of my cultivating comprehensions and guidance, this scripture would be sufficient to be sold at a sky-high price.” Xue Ying was clear of this.
Selling treasures depended on who he sold them to.
Selling to a Primal Chaos expert? He could sell it at a limited price!
Selling to an unparalleled existence? The price he could sell it at would be extremely frightening, especially when it was related to taking that final step!
Ancestor Fan and Towering Sky King were willing to pay a great price since they desired to enter the final realm of Cosmos God in the Mirage Lineage. By then, their soul would transcend all other Cosmos Gods. With a powerful soul, in addition to reaching the final realm in two Daos, they might possibly step out of the cage!
“I am not in a rush to sell this scripture.” Xue Ying understood one point.
With the Mirage Scripture he created, ‘Heart Devil King’ had instantly acquired the favor of one of the five ancestors in Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, the ‘World Extermination God-Emperor’. He had been bestowed with a top-graded secret treasure, and a special ‘Heart Devil Palace’ was even constructed for him. With the protection from World Extermination God-Emperor and even the help from ‘Limitless City Master’, ‘Realm Beast King’, and other unparalleled existences from the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, none dared to kidnap Heart Devil King away.
Want to learn a Mirage Scripture? The Myriad Realms Ancient Nation had publicized a sky-high price! Ancestor Fan wasn’t willing to pay this price to learn it.
It might be possible for level-one Cosmos Gods to learn a soul-related scripture after paying a huge price (Like Xue Ying, he forked out 80,000 contribution points)! As for unparalleled existences (and some final realm Cosmos Gods), they would definitely be charged a tremendous price!
…
Even the Realm Heart God Palace did not own any Dao of Soul scripture that guided the cultivator to the final realm.
The most profound scripture only guided the cultivator to the level-two Cosmos God Realm.
And Xue Ying had reached this realm. Only Ancestor Fan and Towering Sky King desired greatly to learn this scripture! And they would pay a significant price for it! After all, any scripture would be sufficient to change the fate of a creator, turning him into a VIP of several unparalleled existences.
‘Without sufficient strength, I would most likely be imprisoned by the Summer Wind Ancient Nation after taking it out.’ Xue Ying understood this point. That Heart Devil King stayed in the Heart Devil Palace. His true body dared not leave the palace at all! Wasn’t that another form of imprisonment?
******
Southern Cloud Nation, Flying Snow City.
In the blink of an eye, it had been over 300 billion years since the Realm Heart God Palace opened. To the numerous cultivators who had reached the apex, closed-door cultivation lasting 10 billion to a hundred billion years was normal. This period of 300 billion years was quite short to Cosmos Gods of this caliber! Xue Ying even spent a trillion years just chasing after the Destruction Devils!
Within the Monarch Residence beside the lake, there was a white-robed Xue Ying fishing.
Whenever Cosmos Gods mentioned ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ from the Southern Cloud Nation, they would sigh and lament about his fate. They felt Monarch Flying Snow was very pitiful. But in the ‘Flying Snow City’, in the eyes of many clansmen from the Ying Shan Clan, ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ was their greatest pride!
