And now, the Flying Snow City was a grade two city in the Southern Cloud Nation. The majority of the Ying Shan clansmen had moved over, turning this city into the core nucleus of the Ying Shan Clan. Even ‘Old Mother Ying Shan’ stayed here.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying lightly picked up his fishing rod, pulling a huge fish up. That fish was tenaciously nibbling on the fish bait.
“What a greedy fish.” Xue Ying lightly hurled the rod back, causing the fish to be thrown into the lake. Xue Ying waved his hand and kept the rod, “It’s a pity. I’ve used a World Flower yet I wasn’t able to step into the final realm of Cosmos God. It seems taking that last step to breakthrough isn’t that easy. Mn, now is the time for me to act.”
“Hu.”
Xue Ying casually walked out of the Flying Snow City. Having lived in seclusion for so long, it was time for him to rise again!
…
And in his hometown Primal Chaos Void.
Xue Ying was similarly cultivating bitterly over the years. At this moment, an avatar began moving.
“Sou.”
With a step, Xue Ying penetrated through numerous spatial obstacles before arriving above the Nine Cloud Great Land.
“In the treasure cove of Monarch Nine Cloud, there is something-the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron-which Sacred Master desired greatly. What exactly is it?” Xue Ying felt curious. Even though the Monarch Nine Cloud hid his treasure cove securely, Xue Ying was an expert that had comprehended the Dao of Void beyond what Monarch Nine Cloud grasped. He had cultivated to just one step away from the final realm of Dao of Void. Furthermore, Xue Ying had the supreme secret impartation technique <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> with him. Hence, the current method Monarch Nine Cloud used to hide his treasure cove wasn’t worth mentioning before Xue Ying any longer.

chapters.title: Chapter 1146 - Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron
chapters.content:
Chapter 1146: Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying stood above the Nine Cloud Great Land.
With a thought, his body abruptly turned dark. Unseen ripples began spreading out with him at the center. These ‘ripples’ were in reality, movement of the most fundamental essence of void, the black fog spherical particles. Almost a blink of an eye later, all black fog spherical particles on the Nine Cloud Great Land had been swept across once by Xue Ying.
“Over there!” Xue Ying immediately discovered the hidden treasure cove of Monarch Nine Cloud.
“Hua.”
He directly tore apart the void, forming a black crack about his height. On the other end of this black crack, there was a palace. Xue Ying entered the crack and arrived at the other location shown by the black crack.
It seemed simple.
But in reality, this ‘black crack’ was the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique! Furthermore, Xue Ying had long altered the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique created by his teacher Southern Cloud King by applying the principles he learned on controlling the Chaotic Origin Energy from the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>. When Southern Cloud King executed this move, the disturbances created were relatively huge. Yet Xue Ying could form this crack with a thought-it was faster and more stable!
As for the sealing array Monarch Nine Cloud used on concealing his treasure cove, with Xue Ying’s current strength, he had two ways of breaking it. First was using force-just like how Sacred Master broke apart the Five Phases Sealed Space in the past. It’s just that this array-sealed space Monarch Nine Cloud constructed was more stable, and Xue Ying would have to use quite a few great moves to break it using force. The other method of entering would be to rely on the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique. This teleportation technique enabled him to travel to another Origin World. Few techniques could actually obstruct and prevent the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ from entering. It was too rare-at least the palace of Monarch Nine Cloud could not do so.
Hence, no matter if it were the Eden Treasure experts had or places hidden in unique sealed territories, using the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ still gave him the ability to enter.
Most experts would place their precious treasures in the Eden Treasure and bring it along. Reaching Xue Ying’s current realm, he could simply execute the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to enter other people’s Eden Treasure and snatching everything away! And this would, of course, represent the start of a battle!
…
It had been a very long time since any living creature came to visit the ancient and quiet palace.
A black crack appeared in the palace. Following this, a white-robed young man came out from it. He looked around before directly walking forward. In just two to three steps, he reached the corridors. And after taking several more steps, he arrived before a courtyard.
At the central courtyard of Monarch Nine Cloud’s palace, there placed a fiery-red cauldron that emanated a turbulent aura. This aura transformed into the shape of a bird, causing pressure to press down in the surroundings.
In the past when he first came here, Xue Ying felt terrified before this pressure. But now, he could simply disregard it.
“Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron.”
“Why does Sacred Master seek it so greatly? Monarch Nine Cloud could not unveil the profound mysteries behind this Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron. Furthermore, he only heard of the name of this object from Sacred Master.” Xue Ying felt curious. Monarch Nine Cloud was a level-two Cosmos God. It should not be hard for him to refine secret treasures, but why could he not comprehend this powerful piece of secret treasure then?
“You!”
A stooped black-robed male appeared from the side. He was currently staring at Xue Ying with astonishment, “How did you enter? How? Did you just break apart the sealing array of Master? Was that from the black crack?”
He spouted several questions together. It was clear how shocking this had been.
After all, this sealing array was a huge accomplishment of Master in the Dao of Void. Even his Master, the Monarch Nine Cloud, could not break apart similar arrays.
“Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.” Xue Ying answered.
The black-robed male remained confused. He was ultimately a puppet lifeform. Even though he followed Monarch Nine Cloud for a long time, yet he only heard of a tiny bit of what his master had known. Should Monarch Nine Cloud be here, he could possibly guess what kind of secret technique the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ was.
“Talking about this.” Xue Ying looked at the black-robed male. He could not help but feel how amusing things were, “This is our second time meeting.”
“Second time? You are?” The black-robed male was stunned.
“Oh?” Xue Ying was enlightened. After reincarnating and coming back into this world, his soul and aura had transformed. Only when he was with his wife or children would he deliberately hide his aura using his void-ification, before mimicking the aura which he had in the past. Otherwise, if Xue Ying moved by himself, he would not be so bored to do so. It was too troublesome.
“Nothing much.” Xue Ying did not elaborate, “Do you know of the secrets behind this Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron?”
“You came for the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron?” The stooped black-robed male’s expression shifted. Waving his hand, the array in the palace began moving. Immediately, the space around the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron started distorting, causing this cauldron to disappear. That black-robed male growled, “This is the property of my master. You can’t take it away. If you want, you have to complete the wishes of my master, killing Sacred Master from the Ancient Sacred Religion or the other Cosmos God…”
“I am an archenemy with the Sacred Master, but now isn’t the time for me to act. As for you? You aren’t qualified to stop me.” Xue Ying frowned.
“Weng!”
The entire palace abruptly collapsed, turning into a piece of art-it was extremely thin. In the art, that black-robed male was stuck within, though it seemed he was trying anxiously to escape out yet to no avail! Xue Ying did not come with vile intentions. This piece of art was a world, and he did not destroy the myriad existences within.
Only the fiery-red cauldron remained floating above this art.
“Initially, I planned on keeping the entire palace before extracting the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron out. Who would have thought that despite suppressing Monarch Nine Cloud’s palace and other treasures into art, this cauldron remains perfectly untouched?” Xue Ying was startled. He casually waved his hand before keeping this art.
And next, he grabbed hold of the cauldron.
The cauldron was blazing warm, yet it seemed Xue Ying did not care. With a step, he left the Nine Cloud Great Land and returned back to one of his cavern-dwellings.
In terms of sealing and concealing techniques, his cavern-dwelling was beyond that of what Monarch Nine Cloud constructed.
After all, Xue Ying had fused eight branches together. He was merely one strand away from the final realm. He even had a supreme secret impartation technique to study on, allowing his techniques to reach a much more profound stage.
…
Within the caver-dwelling.
A cauldron was placed in the palace hall. Xue Ying sat cross-legged. He then commenced his investigation of the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron by sending a strand of consciousness into it.
“Mn?”
The moment he permeated it, a look of astoundment appeared on his face.
“This is?” Xue Ying carefully examined it. Under his senses, a golden inscription floated on the surface of the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron. It was incomparably esoteric, “This seems related to the profound mysteries behind the Chaotic Origin Energy. Without sufficient understanding of the Chaotic Origin Energy, it is impossible for one to unravel the inscription.”
Under normal circumstances, cultivators would only begin studying the Supreme Law after reaching the final realm of Cosmos God. During this process, most would discover more about the higher dimension and of the Chaotic Origin Energy.
In the Realm Heart Great Land, unparalleled existences could refine ‘Essence of Chaotic Origin’ from the external Chaotic Origin Energy.
Being an expert in the Dao of Void, Xue Ying had already interacted with the Chaotic Origin Energy! But it was only after he got the supreme secret impartation technique did his skills in the Dao of Void increase sharply. And his currently understanding and control of the Chaotic Origin Energy would most likely be beyond the level of Emperor Summer! Even the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll> written by Emperor Summer had been improved by Xue Ying.
“It isn’t that hard.” After a simple examination-just the time taken to brew a cup of tea-Xue Ying grasped this Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron completely.
This Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron that had perplexed Monarch Nine Cloud for ages, and also an item that garnered the desire of Sacred Master, was finally solved by Xue Ying.
“An inner world?” Xue Ying immediately found an existing world within. It was as its name suggested, this Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron contained an inner realm, “What a unique secret treasure. It is so hard even to activate this secret treasure. Furthermore, I can’t enter even with the Great Destruction Teleportation Technique.” These conclusions gave Xue Ying a conjecture-from the way it was activated, this secret treasure could possibly be refined by a Chaotic Origin Expert.
“Sou.”
With a thought, Xue Ying had entered the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron.
He had many avatars, and losing one was a minor matter. Hence, he wasn’t afraid of whether this Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron could threaten his life or not.

chapters.title: Chapter 1147 - The Imprisoned Being
chapters.content:
Chapter 1147: The Imprisoned Being
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
It was a thick boundless land. No plants could be seen growing on it.
When Xue Ying looked around, he found that he had appeared precisely on this great land.
“The Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron actually has three worlds inside.” Xue Ying’s perception of the void was extremely acute. The vast world within the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron was shaped in a sphere, with one layer encompassing the other. He was currently located at the outermost layer. From what he discovered, it appeared that the outer and inner layers did not contain any living creatures, though a frightening aura could be felt coming from the core layer.
“So terrifying.” Xue Ying’s expression changed slightly.
The terrifying aura should be entrenched deeply in the core of the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron. Despite the great distance, Xue Ying still felt trepidation in his heart from the aura.
“Even with my current strength, I am still feeling the pressure?” Xue Ying started advancing prudently.
“Hmph.”
Suddenly, a snort could be heard from afar. It should have come from the core layer. This voice felt as if it echoed out from an abyss, penetrating through layers of the world before reaching Xue Ying. Ordinary Cosmos Gods would have died from the shockwave of this voice.
“Interesting.” Xue Ying wasn’t afraid. Reaching his level, there were not many existences that could frighten him.
He continued on gingerly.
“Hong-”
At the next moment, a powerful ripple pulsed out from the core layer of the world, sweeping across the inner layer and reaching the outer layer.
The world turned dark. It felt like apocalypse had arrived. That ripple instantaneously engulfed the entire outer layer, sweeping across Xue Ying’s body! Yet Xue Ying was protected by many concentric black foggy air streams that when the terrifying gale of power reached them, the streams merely warped and distorted. Those streams remained perfectly fine.
“This gale seems to reach the power of a level-three Cosmos God.” Xue Ying became curious, “No wonder Sacred Master desires to acquire it. He should know some secrets pertaining to the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron.”
Nonetheless, even though Xue Ying was ignorant, he could take his time to investigate it.
“Hu.”
As he slowly advanced forward, Xue Ying soon bypassed the outermost layer world membrane, reaching the inner layer.
The inner layer contained stronger energy. He could see with his naked eyes visible strands of fiery-red aura streams that were like flood dragons swimming about. Part of the fiery-red streams abruptly condensed into a scarlet-armored human. His face was covered in red scales, and his cold eyes were currently staring at the white-robed young man. He spoke: “Are you someone that Yuan let in? Such a low-grade lifeform is merely qualified to be my food.”
His voice was deep and grand. It shook the world.
“Low-grade lifeform?” Xue Ying stared back.
“Hmph hmph hmph.”
The scarlet-armored creature suddenly disappeared. He appeared right before Xue Ying the next moment.
“Haha…” Xue Ying chuckled, “And who are you? How are you related to Yuan?”
His voice was still reverberating when thousands and thousands of drawings appeared in the surrounding void. Xue Ying would occasionally appear in a drawing before flashing and appearing in another. The other party spoke with a smile from one of the many pieces of drawing.
“Do you think you are qualified to ask me?” The scarlet-armored creature waved his claws. “Si si si~” Even though every piece of art was incredibly firm, they were all torn easily. Regardless, Xue Ying did not seem to care. He continued warping his positions here and there, preventing the scarlet-armored creature from reaching him.
“Why did you appear within the cauldron? Were you captured by Yuan?” Xue Ying’s voice echoed in the world.
“Damn.”
The scarlet-armored creature grew increasingly furious.
“Hu hu hu…”
The strands of surging fiery-red streams that were swimming in the air suddenly split apart and condensed into numerous scarlet-armored creatures. They were all incredibly incensed. Within an instance, several hundred scarlet-armored creatures appeared, causing Xue Ying’s expression to shift slightly: “How could this be?” He had already discovered that this scarlet-armored creature was tyrannical. He should be stronger than the Sacred Master, albeit his techniques were crude. Xue Ying could easily trick him using his self-created <Flying Snow Combat Technique>.
Currently, Xue Ying felt that the Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique, Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll, Five Phases Sealing Technique and other techniques he knew were all very crude at his current realm. Hence, he chose to extract some of the more exquisite means and essence of each combat technique, accompanied by the knowledge on how to use Chaotic Origin Energy from the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> to create an entirely new set of combat techniques.
Of course, this set of combat techniques were still in the midst of improvement. It would become stronger over time as his realm deepened.
“Die.”
“Damnable low-grade creature!”
“You think you are qualified to trick me?”
The hundreds of scarlet-armored creatures were all wildly attacking with fury. For a moment, their attacks intercrossed, causing the surroundings to shatter. Even though Xue Ying executed different variants of techniques, they were all broken by force.
“Hu hu hu~” Amidst the horrific black maelstrom, Xue Ying stood at its center. Since he could not dodge the attacks, he could simply fight back.
“Sou sou sou sou sou sou…” A dense number of scarlet-armored creatures began surrounding and charging toward Xue Ying. Within an instance, Xue Ying’s black protective cover had been shattered. Even though he had executed many combat techniques, and occasionally he would destroy the body of a scarlet-armored creature, closely following that, the energy would condense back into another body. They seemed undying.
And Xue Ying was beaten all over the place by the joint attacks!
He would be struck down deep into the ground at times, before being beaten high into the sky! He was beaten to the extent that many images of him could be seen.
No other choice.
With several hundred enemies-each stronger than the Sacred Master-even though their techniques were crude, they could completely suppress Xue Ying.
Even though Xue Ying was beaten pitifully, his skin remained undamaged.
He had already trained to the second level of the Chaotic Origin Refinement Body! And now, Xue Ying even improved it remarkably. It was much more perfect than how it was originally in the Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll. Currently, Xue Ying’s fleshy body was as strong as some of the body cultivators who recently reached the final Cosmos God Realm. One had to know that peak Cosmos God Realm body cultivators were practically undying! Unparalleled existences could not kill them! Maybe they might be able to heavily injure them after sending several killing moves, but body cultivators could escape with a thought! Old Monster Stone had reached the final realm in body cultivation. Reaching his level, his body could dissipate and aggregate any time he wanted-he could appear at any location in the Origin World. They could even hide their karma, preventing enemies from discovering them!
Xue Ying did not know some of the more unique techniques ‘body cultivators’ knew-dissipating and aggregating, concealing his karma and others.
But he was a Dao of Void expert. He had various survival techniques such as the ‘pinnacle of void-ification’, and ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’. His soul was even refined by the Chaotic Origin Energy, preventing others from seeking his karma. Furthermore, the avatars located in the Realm Heart Great Land had been nourished with a droplet of core blood from the ‘Universal Dragon Mother’, making it practically impossible for others to find Xue Ying.
Naturally-
These scarlet-armored creatures that were before him could not injure him at all.
“Interesting. These scarlet-armored creatures seem to be a single life. It should come from that huge aura entrenched in the core of the world?” Xue Ying felt his heart moving, “Let’s go and have a look.
Those who were skilled were courageous too.
“Hua.”
A crack was torn in the void by his side. Xue Ying simply disappeared. He relied on the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to enter the core layer directly.
…
Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron-within the core world of the three layers.
When Xue Ying appeared, he felt blazing warmth blasting against him-it felt even hotter than on the Primitive Sun Star.
Many black fog streams shot out from his body and began protecting him. When Xue Ying appeared, he immediately focused his attention on the only creature located at the core of the world-
An enormous fiery-red monster lay there. It had many enormous tentacles. Glancing over, it should have more than 10,000 tentacles. These enormous tentacles enveloped the entire void. At the center of its head, an enormous eyes currently stared at Xue Ying.
“What creature is this?” Xue Ying became engrossed when he saw it.
The skin on every huge tentacle seemed to contain the circulation of light-encompassing all sorts of profound mysteries. If Xue Ying were given sufficient time, he could slowly dissect all the unique profound mysteries and how to use them out! As for the gigantic eye located at the center of the monster’s head, it currently shot out a gold light. This gold light even contained congealed inscriptions that diffused and landed on his body.
Despite the terrifying suppression the gaze of the other party brought, Xue Ying wasn’t afraid since he had a powerful body and could shrug it off.
“There is actually such a creature? It is simply the incarnation of laws!” Xue Ying felt slightly excited.
“Low-grade creature who is stuck within the cage.” A tentacle of that enormous monster began strutting over.
“Hua.”
When it moved, the light on the tentacle started transforming, inducing a desire in Xue Ying-a desire to analyze and study the inherent profound mysteries. Nonetheless, no time was given to him as the tentacle tore through space and appeared before Xue Ying. Xue Ying also took the strike head-on with a palm-his palm was covered in resplendent light, and many layers of the world appeared within the light.
“Peng!”
As the palm struck out, Xue Ying tried his best to parry against the incoming force, diverting it into the higher dimension. Explosions could be heard from the layers of space in Xue Ying’s palm. And in the end, Xue Ying could only divert away 50% of the incoming attack.
Flying Snow Combat Technique-Myriad Untouchable Technique!
“This attack doesn’t seem any weaker than Eternal Night Primogenitor’s full strike.” Xue Ying felt alarmed.
Eternal Night Primogenitor relied on the supreme-graded secret treasure to exert that force, yet this monster was simply casually sending an attack over.
“Peng.”
Xue Ying’s body was slapped back. Despite being protected by his protection techniques and the pinnacle of void-ification, an enormous injury was still torn on the body of Xue Ying, though it rapidly healed.
“Mn? You did not die?” The enormous monster was shocked. A creature that had not jumped out of the cage survived under a strike from it?
“You have been trapped by Yuan, am I right?” Xue Ying hurriedly said. His voice reverberated in the world. He wanted to delay for more time. Otherwise, he would die moments from the battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 1148 - Visiting the Fan Clan again
chapters.content:
Chapter 1148: Visiting the Fan Clan again
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Hearing what Xue Ying mentioned, that monster became incensed.
“Die!”
Many great tentacles began dancing in the air.
“This is so beautiful!” Xue Ying did not wish to battle. Instead, he wanted to spend more time observing and studying those inscriptions-every time the tentacle struck out, the light emitted from its surface was filled with profound mysteries! Dao of Void, Dao of Flames, Dao of Lightning, Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm… all kinds of profound mysteries existed. They were perfectly mashed on the body of this monster, and every action of it was filled with palpitating power.
This creature had totally eclipsed the Cosmos God Realm.
“Peng peng peng.”
The most perfect defense technique that Xue Ying spent 300 billion years to create, the ‘Myriad Untouchable Technique’ that was part of the <Flying Snow Combat Technique> and his powerful fleshy body enabled him to survive five lashes before his injuries became grave. He wanted to escape, yet under the overwhelming tentacles, Xue Ying was suppressed in space; he could not escape using the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.
“I’ve guessed that the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron could be dangerous to me. Nevertheless, I am not afraid of death as I still have my avatars. But dying here like this is really unexpected.” Xue Ying felt helpless.
He could not do anything about it.
Any casual strike from its tentacle was equivalent to the full-powered attack from Eternal Night Primogenitor. How could he fight?
“Hua.”
Suddenly, a force engulfed Xue Ying, and he disappeared at the next moment.
When the monster sensed that energy, it could not help but roar out furiously! That was the energy coming from this prison. “Yuan! Yuan! Yuan!” Roars kept coming from it, transmitting all the way to the external world. At the same time, its voice caused endless gale to rise.
…
Within his cavern-dwelling, in his palace hall.
Xue Ying appeared by the side of the cauldron.
“I, I am out?” Xue Ying was shocked.
“Hehe, seeing that you can’t hold on any longer, I naturally had to send you out.” A figure flew out from the cauldron. He was a red-robed cheery old man. Currently, he was smiling at Xue Ying, “I am the treasure spirit of the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron.”
Xue Ying was enlightened: “No wonder. Previously when I tried to activate the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron, I found that I could not sense the insides of the cauldron clearly. So it seems that I have never been able to grasp this secret treasure at all. I am extremely grateful to you, Senior Yuan. Otherwise, this avatar of mine would have been doomed.”
The red-robed old man laughed and explained: “The Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron is a special secret treasure that my Master ‘Yuan’ once refined. It is specially used to imprison the ‘Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son’. It is impossible for this secret treasure to be controlled by you all. Otherwise, if you freed the Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son out, all creatures in this Origin World would be completely wiped. That is a major sin!”
“Yes.” Xue Ying agreed. With the power of that monster, who in his hometown could resist?
“He is called the Myriad Tentacle Dragon Son?”
“Mn.”
The red-robed old man nodded, “The Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother is extremely formidable. My master once worked together with other existences to kill her. As for the many Myriad Tentacles Dragon Sons she had, they are barely Chaotic Origin Creatures and aren’t worth mentioning before my master and others-they could casually kill them. The reason why it was imprisoned here had been to give cultivators an opportunity to breakthrough. Those who could activate the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron are existences who have sufficient comprehension toward the Chaotic Origin Energy. Most are peak Cosmos Gods with deep accumulations and comprehensions. With any of your current realm, you could battle against the Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son too, albeit I will protect all of you right before your death!”
“Fighting against the Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son is really fighting against an expert. It is meant as a form of tempering exercise.”
“The Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son is an innate Chaotic Origin Creature and is different from cultivators. Every part of its body is filled with various profound mysteries, and you could study them from outside.”
“These are helpful to you.”
The red-robed old man continued, “Originally, this Origin World of yours is governed by my Master Yuan. Currently, it is being governed by Luo City Master. In the previous eras, Master has announced all possible opportunities that would be given to Cosmos Gods that reached the peak, yet now, not many know about it.”
Xue Ying was enlightened.
This Origin World was previously managed by a Chaotic Origin Expert, and now, it changed?
“But I have to remind you, even though the original intention of Master is for this treasure to be used as a form of training for peak Cosmos Gods, you should have gotten a supreme secret impartation technique, enabling you to activate the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron before reaching the final realm.” The red-robed old man reminded him, “What is more important for you now is to reach the final realm. Don’t bother studying these profound mysteries on the Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son as they are too profound. It might instead become a hindrance to your cultivation.”
“Yes.” Xue Ying was roused awake. That’s right. This was originally meant for those at the final realm to break through to an entirely new level. It wasn’t good for Xue Ying to study too much into it.
“You can enter frequently to battle and temper yourself. Eventually, you would discover your weaknesses and cover them. This would improve your combat skills and deepen your realm, hastening the pace of you to reach the final realm.” The red-robed old man suggested.
“I understand.” Xue Ying nodded.
Saying that, he had gotten help from two Chaotic Origin Experts-Luo City Lord and Yuan. Nevertheless, with the regular opening of the ‘Realm Heart God Palace’ in the Realm Heart Great Land, Yuan clearly had helped many experts before, giving them supreme-graded secret treasures and others. It’s just that nobody had heard of anyone jumping out of the cage to reach a higher level in the Realm Heart Great Land.
“Despite being supported in various ways, it seems jumping out of the cage is still extremely difficult.” Xue Ying understood this, “Yet the Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son is an innate Chaotic Origin Creature?”
******
In his hometown Primal Chaos Void, Xue Ying would frequently send his avatar into the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron to battle with the imprisoned ‘Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son’. Reaching the level of Xue Ying, it was hard to find an opponent who would pressure him sufficiently! But given the innate all-rounded talent of the Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son, it was an extremely good opponent for Xue Ying to fight against and understand more on the different types of techniques used with the different Daos.
And at another place, on the Realm Heart Great Land.
Xue Ying came to the Summer Wind Capital. He was enjoying good food and wine in a restaurant. Nevertheless, his heart was pondering over the experience and reflection he had from fighting against the Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son.
“Even if I bury myself in closed-door cultivation, it is important for me to battle too! Only then would I discover the weaknesses in my comprehended cultivation techniques.” Xue Ying was feeling extremely good.
“Come here.”
Xue Ying looked up at the distant attendant.
The attendant of this restaurant was a True God. He had been paying close notice to his surroundings. When Xue Ying beckoned him over, he immediately ran here.
“How much Night Xi Wine does your restaurant keep? How much can you sell me?” Xue Ying asked.
“The Night Xi Wine is brewed by my Master. Currently, there are still 3,000 jars. Our restaurants have to keep 1,000 jars with us at least.” The attendant immediately replied politely, knowing that he had met a wealthy guest.
“Prepare 2,000 jars for me.” Xue Ying laughed, “The wine is good.”
“Good, good!”
The attendant was in great joy.
Xue Ying was blissfully enjoying the wine, drinking by himself all the way until the sky darkened. Only then did he pay for the wine and left.
He then came over to the Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
“Brother Flying Snow, it has been a long time since we met.” Monarch Andromeda welcomed him enthusiastically, “It has been 300 billion years in the blink of an eye right? I’ve never heard of you leaving the Southern Cloud Nation during this period.”
“Aren’t I here now? Help me spread the word that I want to meet Ancestor Fan.” Xue Ying said.
“Ancestor Fan?” Monarch Andromeda was startled. He then revealed an awkward look.
What identity did Ancestor Fan have?
Was he someone anyone could meet?

chapters.title: Chapter 1149 - Negotiation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1149: Negotiation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Great Paragon, Honored Guest Flying Snow is looking for Ancestor Fan.” Monarch Andromeda reported upwards. The status of Ancestor Fan was too high and he wasn’t qualified to speak to him. But since Xue Ying was a Cosmos God, and he wasn’t a foolish one, Xue Ying should have his reasons for meeting Ancestor Fan.
Very soon.
Sky-Rending Great Paragon came personally.
“Younger Brother Flying Snow, you want to see Ancestor Fan?” Sky-Rending Great Paragon waved his hand towards Monarch Andromeda by the side. Monarch Andromeda slightly bowed before leaving.
“I have a set of cultivation techniques that I want to sell to Ancestor Fan.” Xue Ying stated.
“Oh? Younger Brother Flying Snow has another new cultivation technique? I wonder what it is?” Sky-Rending Great Paragon revealed a joyful look. How deep were the foundations of the three great clans in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation? They disdained from collecting ordinary cultivation techniques. But for the ‘Nine Rotation Undying Technique’, that had been an exceptional technique that fused all nine branches together. It had been comprehended based on the scaled-armor of ‘General Mo Gu’, a Destruction Devil that had been given birth by the Supreme Law. Only then did Emperor Summer view it differently.
“Mirage cultivation technique.” Xue Ying answered, “Level-two Mirage.”
The expression of Sky-Rending Great Paragon changed. It became solemn at the next moment, giving Xue Ying a look that was entirely different from before.
“This is a serious matter! Lying about it is absolutely not tolerated.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon gravely spoke. If one mentioned that the Nine Rotation Undying Technique merely strengthed the foundation of the three great clans, then this level-two Mirage scripture was one that Ancestor Fan sought greatly to aid in his journey of jumping out of the cage. Most level-two soul-related scriptures were highly coveted by any ancient nation across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
“How would I dare to deceive Ancestor Fan?” Xue Ying answered.
“Admirable. Truly admirable. I’ve heard that Younger Brother has suffered from a grave loss in the Realm Heart Great Land. But it seems you could create a level-two Mirage scripture. You have truly brought about a change in your fate.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon was clear how precious this scripture was, “I’ll inform Ancestor Fan right at this moment.”
Xue Ying smiled.
…
Before coming to the Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
Xue Ying had made nine of his avatars execute the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique out of Realm Heart Great Land. To him who had over 10,000 avatars, nine avatars did not mean anything.
“Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.”
Reaching the level of Xue Ying, when he attempted to look at the higher-dimension beyond the cage, he could vaguely see other Origin Worlds.
“Si la-”
With the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, he could easily tear through a miniature tunnel. Though the tunnel was fragile and Xue Ying could only send his soul through! He had to give his fleshy body up.
“Xiu!”
And his soul was able to rush over to another Origin World using the tunnel formed from the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’. This tunnel had been formed using the Chaotic Origin Energy, guided by the profound mysteries of the Dao of Void. He was able to travel through it relatively quickly too.
“Hu hu hu~” Beyond the tiny tunnel was where the higher dimension was located at. It was filled with concentrated Chaotic Origin Energy that could easily corrode the body of Xue Ying. Currently, Xue Ying could only rely on the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to isolate a tunnel that prevented the energy from the higher dimension to reach in. He was like a rat crawling into another Origin World.
And Xue Ying’s soul would control the Dao of Void to guide the Chaotic Origin Energy in maintaining the tunnel.
This tunnel was thin. Most Transcendents could not even see it clearly.
Just after the time was taken to brew a cup of tea.
“Pu.”
Xue Ying felt himself penetrating through the obstacles, entering into a vast Origin World.
This vast Origin World was pervaded by the Supreme Law that suppressed him. Without permission from the Supreme Law, he could not reincarnate in this Origin World! He could merely guide the World Energy with his powerful soul to re-construct his fleshy body. Reaching their level, as long as a strand of soul existed, he could easily recover.
‘What a pity that I am suppressed down to the ninth level Primal Chaos Realm by the Supreme Law.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
Even if he had more powerful techniques or unique styles, everything would be suppressed.
‘Luo City Lord has been suppressed, yet he could still exert strength at the level-two Cosmos God Realm.’ Xue Ying sighed, ‘Chaotic Origin Experts are really different.’
“Mn?”
As Xue Ying’s fleshy body condensed, he turned over to the distance, seeing two enormous armies clashing. A war had started, and it caused the world to shake.
******
His nine avatars had respectively hidden in some of the closer Origin Worlds. This was a survival technique that most Dao of Void experts who could execute the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ would do! In other Origin Worlds, the avatars of unparalleled existences would be suppressed down to the Primal Chaos Realm, and hence, most experts weren’t afraid of being ‘killed’. Furthermore, outsiders were suppressed in all aspects within other Origin Worlds, and it was practically impossible for anyone to trace down where the concealing avatars were.
Hence, hiding in another Origin World was also the best means of survival.
‘I am afraid.’
‘Afraid that Ancestor Fan, Emperor Summer, and others might move against me.’ Xue Ying thought. That was the reason why he chose to negotiate only after fusing eight branches together.
“Younger Brother Flying Snow, please.”
Sky-Rending Great Paragon personally led the way. The two of them flew across the sky. With one teleportation, Sky-Rending Great Paragon had led Xue Ying over to a huge black palace.
There were currently three figures seated above the great palace.
Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, and Emperor Cang. The aura emitted from these three was grand and powerful. The gazes from the three of them landed on Xue Ying at this moment. Ancestor Fan desired to acquire the level-two Mirage scripture! Furthermore, Emperor Summer and Emperor Cang also desired for this scripture to remain within the three great clans. After all, all soul-related level-two scriptures were even more valuable than peak secret impartation techniques! And they were rarer!
“You have a level-two Mirage scripture?” Ancestor Fan was the first to speak. He looked down at Xue Ying, “You created it?”
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Is it different from mine?” Ancestor Fan mentioned. The Mirage scripture he created, <Heart Realm>, had been a fusion of the World, Soul, and Desire. If the level-two Mirage scripture Xue Ying created were any fusion between these three branches, then it would be useless to Ancestor Fan.
Xue Ying chuckled: “It is the fusion between World and Bewilderment.”
Ancestor Fan’s eyes brightened at that moment.
In reality…
Xue Ying had already fused the World and Bewilderment during the 400 millionth year when cultivating under the Burning Heart God Tree. And now that 300 billion years had passed, he had fused ‘World’, ‘Bewilderment’, and ‘Slaughter’ together! But since he was selling it to outsiders, he would sell those that were sufficiently appropriate. There was no need for him to sell everything that he had.
“Since you are here, it means you are intending to sell the Mirage scripture you comprehended to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation?” Ancestor Fan said.
“Yes, but I want to get something I seek as well.” Xue Ying replied.
Ancestor Fan, Emperor Summer, and Emperor Cang understood that this level-two Cosmos God expert would certainly be opening his lion’s mouth! But it was normal since any ancient nation would be willing to fork out an extravagant price for this scripture.
Ancestor Fan squinted. He transmitted: “Emperor Summer, are you able to discover all his avatars? If you could locate all 10,081, capture them at this instance!”
They would naturally be willing to be vicious if it would reduce the price they had to pay.
After all, the path of cultivation was built fundamentally in fierce competition!
“Weng.”
Emperor Summer and Emperor Cang began executing their techniques in the dark. Emperor Summer even covered the entire Realm Heart Great Land with a thought.
“This is weird. I can’t trace any karma of his avatars at all.” Emperor Summer transmitted, “The avatars I find are just several dozens of his that he deliberately publicized. I can’t find any other avatars of his.”
“Brother Cang, what about you?” Ancestor Fan asked.
“I can’t find them either. All my tracing techniques are useless. He hasn’t reached the final realm yet he could implement such formidable concealing technique?” Emperor Cang was shocked. He had reached the final realm in body cultivation. His foundation was even deeper than Old Monster Stone in the Realm Heart Great Land. Nonetheless, he could not find any traces of Xue Ying at all.
A soul that had absorbed some Chaotic Origin Energy would make it hard for other experts to trace him down. Furthermore, Xue Ying’s soul had been nourished by a droplet of precious core blood from the ‘Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother’. It was not something Cosmos Gods could unravel!
‘It seems this Ying Shan Xue Ying has done his preparations well to dare and negotiate with us.’ Ancestor Fan thought.
The three unparalleled existences.
Emperor Summer and Emperor Cang came primarily to keep this scripture within their Summer Wind Ancient Nation; both Emperor Summer and Emperor Cang wanted to improve their Dao understanding of the soul aspect too, and they did not have to be on the Mirage and Illusory Realm Lineage.
But Ancestor Fan truly desired this scripture since he had fused three branches of the Mirage and Illusory Realm already! If he could gain something from Xue Ying’s scripture, successfully fusing the ‘Bewilderment Lineage’, that would mean four branches. One last step and he would have fused five branches to step into the final realm! By then, his soul would reach the final realm, and Ancestor Fan might perhaps be able to jump out of this cage to reach an unfathomable level.
“I wish for you to sell this scripture only to my Summer Wind Ancient Nation.” Emperor Summer stated, “And not to any others.”
“I can’t even impart it to experts in the Southern Cloud Nation?” Xue Ying asked.
“Southern Cloud Nation experts have to become Honored Guests of my Summer Wind Ancient Nation before they could learn this Mirage Scripture from my Summer Wind Ancient Nation.” Emperor Summer replied. It was clear he did not wish for other ancient nations to learn it.
“Then the price will not be the same anymore.” Xue Ying chuckled.
Everything could be discussed.
As long as the price satisfied him, it did not matter if he had to sell it to Summer Wind Ancient Nation alone! It was relatively easy to learn scriptures beneath the Cosmos God Realm. But scriptures that guided cultivators in the Cosmos God Realm could only be learned by Honored Guests of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation!
“State your price.” Ancestor Fan calmly spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 1150 - Void Fire Lotus Flower
chapters.content:
Chapter 1150: Void Fire Lotus Flower
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying chuckled: “Since Summer Wind Ancient Nation wants to monopolize this scripture and forbid me from imparting to others, my price will naturally be different.”
“State it.” Emperor Summer looked down calmly.
Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang, and Ancestor Fan had made preparations to get ripped of. No matter how much they paid, it would be worth it! At least this scripture would belong to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation from then on!
“Firstly, 50,000 kilograms of Chaotic Origin Sand!” Xue Ying directly declared to the three unparalleled existences.
“50,000 kilograms?”
Even though Emperor Summer and the others were prepared, they still felt their cheeks twitching from the demand, and their hearts sinking.
“Do you know how rare the Chaotic Origin Sand is? I can occasionally get some from the higher dimension as I forage for the Essence of Chaotic Origin.” Emperor Summer spoke solemnly, “Every grit of Chaotic Origin Sand is very hard to get and you want a total of 50,000 kilograms? Adding up the Chaotic Origin Sand in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, the total amount is only slightly more than that.”
With the reputation of vaguely being the number one expert in Realm Heart Great Land, for Emperor Summer to haggle over the price showed how frightening Xue Ying’s demand was!
Because the total amount of ‘Chaotic Origin Sand’ collected by the Summer Wind Ancient Nation was much lesser than the required 50,000 kilograms!
“If you plan to monopolize the scripture, this 50,000 kilograms of Chaotic Origin Sand is a must.” Xue Ying uttered, “There must not be one gram less! Otherwise, I will simply sell this scripture to other ancient nation so that I can collect more Chaotic Origin Sand.”
Emperor Summer was startled when he heard: “Why do you want the Chaotic Origin Sand? Is it because you had some comprehensions over the Chaotic Origin Energy?”
“It’s all thanks to Emperor Summer’s <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll>.” Xue Ying deliberately answered. He did not wish to publicize his <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>.
“Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, and Emperor Cang, I believe the three of you should know that it would not be hard for me to gather 50,000 kilograms of Chaotic Origin Sand if I were to sell this Mirage Scripture to other ancient nations.” Xue Ying chuckled, “This is something I have to get. Otherwise, let’s not conduct this transaction.”
The three unparalleled existences hesitated.
“How? Our Summer Wind Ancient Nation has only about 25,000 kilograms of Chaotic Origin Sand in total. This is also because I am a Dao of Void expert and would frequently spend my time collecting the Essence of Chaotic Origin. Only then could our Summer Wind Ancient Nation accumulate to this amount of Chaotic Origin Sand.” Emperor Summer transmitted, “I don’t think we have sufficient time to gather 50,000 kilograms. We have to purchase it from other ancient nations.”
“Do it.”
“Drifter has a relatively good relationship with me.” Ancestor Fan transmitted, “He is also an expert who reached the final realm in the Dao of Void. He should have collected quite a lot of Chaotic Origin Sand. I’ll seek him to purchase some. Also, we can try to purchase as much as we could from the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation and Icy Snow Ancient Nation! Those three old chaps from the Icy Snow Ancient Nation have powerful bodies. They should have been spending their time collecting the Essence of Chaotic Origin from the higher dimension, and I believe they should have accumulated quite a lot of Chaotic Origin Sand too.”
“Mm, that’s decided then.” They made their decisions there and then.
Chaotic Origin Sand.
There weren’t many known uses in the Realm Heart Great Land! It’s only because of the difficulty in collecting it that made its price sky-high! If Xue Ying required 10,000 kilograms, Emperor Summer could simply give him. But a total of 50,000 kilograms? That would practically consume the majority Chaotic Origin Sand reserves in the entire Realm Heart Great Land!
…
“I need time to gather the Chaotic Origin Sand.” Emperor Summer stated, “But I assure you that I can give you the amount within 100 million years.”
“Good.” Xue Ying revealed a joyous look.
This was something he had to have.
Almost 99% of the materials required to refine the weapon for the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> comprised of the Chaotic Origin Sand. The remaining supporting ingredients were instead relatively simple to get. The reason why Chaotic Origin Sand had been used as the main ingredient was as stated from the accompanying refining technique from the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> scripture: it would improve the user’s control of the Chaotic Origin Energy by a hundred to a thousand times. Thus, it would enable the user to execute techniques more profound than what he could with his current realm.
This weapon was a form of intermediary that improved his control over the Chaotic Origin Energy.
“What else do you want?” Emperor Summer asked. They did not believe that Xue Ying would only request for this.
“A weapon.” Xue Ying chuckled.
Even if he gathered all ingredients for refining the Chaotic Origin God Weapon, he still had to refine it slowly over a long period.
And in the future when he wielded a Chaotic Origin God Weapon that significantly boosted his strength, it might incur the suspicions from other unparalleled existences, one that would bring new twists and turns. After all, Xue Ying could not overestimate the ‘bottom line’ of these unparalleled existences. Unparalleled existences were willing to jointly attack a cultivator when they wanted to. Hence, he had to have another piece of a powerful weapon, firstly to improve his strength and secondly, to ease the ‘understanding’ in these unparalleled existences about why he was so powerful.
“That ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’ which you refined, Emperor Summer.” Xue Ying smiled.
“Void Fire Lotus Flower?” Emperor Summer frowned, “Your demands are really harsh!”
“I do not have a choice. I no longer have a weapon with me, so now I need a piece of powerful top-graded secret treasure.” Xue Ying laughed.
Void Fire Lotus Flower!
That was the most suitable top-graded secret treasure for his Dao of Void in the entire Realm Heart Great Land! One had to know that top-graded secret treasures had their differences. Those meant for survival were naturally the most expensive. As for the Void Fire Lotus Flower, one could be used to purchase two to three ‘Twin Realm Blades’. With this top-graded secret treasure accompanied by his nine great avatars, his strength would naturally be different.
“I can promise you this.” Emperor Summer said, “But this should be about there.”
“No, it is still insufficient.” Xue Ying shook his head, “If I were to sell this scripture to several ancient nations, I can gain more benefits.”
Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, and Emperor Cang felt their heart aching.
50,000 kilograms of Chaotic Origin Sand was something they could only gather by exchanging treasures with other ancient nations. This alone formed a huge bulk of the price. In addition, they would be exchanging an extremely precious piece of World-Related Void secret treasure-the ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’.
“I want to cultivate under the Burning Heart God Tree for one trillion years.” Xue Ying said.
Ancestor Fan let out a sigh of relief.
Don’t think that cultivating under the Burning Heart God Tree was very expensive-requiring 10,000 contribution points for every 100 million years of cultivation. In reality, cultivating underneath the Burning Heart God Tree would bring no harm to the God Tree. One trillion years was merely some time and it would not incur a huge loss to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
“And the final request.” Xue Ying chuckled, “500,000 contribution points! I have lost too much in the Realm Heart God Palace. Hence, I require some contribution points. That’s all. Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, and Emperor Cang, these are all my demands. If you all agree to it, this Mirage Scripture will henceforth belong to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation! If Summer Wind Ancient Nation plans on imparting it or selling it to others like the Towering Sky King, you may do so!”
Even though Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, Emperor Cang felt their heart bleeding from the cost, they were clear that if Xue Ying sold the scripture to other ancient nations, he would be able to earn slightly more than this!
“Alright.” Emperor Summer and the others exchanged glances. After that, Emperor Summer stated, “Let’s do this.”
Xue Ying chuckled: “Many thanks, Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, and Emperor Cang. If I could fight for more benefits on my path of cultivation, I’ll naturally do so.”
Ancestor Fan also chuckled: “Even though you are quite ruthless in your demands, it is normal too.”
If the Summer Wind Ancient Nation was willing…
They could collect close to half the costs just by selling to Towering Sky King alone!
In the past, the price set by Myriad Realms Ancient Nation to Ancestor Fan had been even more exaggerated than what Xue Ying wanted! Even though the demands of Xue Ying this time were high, in reality, the ‘Chaotic Origin Sand’ had few uses. Hence, it was possible for the Summer Wind Ancient Nation to get them with a slightly lower price.
…
The transaction was concluded.
Emperor Summer and the others revealed a grin. Xue Ying’s mood was pleasant too. Nobody could see that the three unparalleled existences had attempted to capture all avatars of Xue Ying before this! After all, if all avatars of Xue Ying were captured, unless Xue Ying rather die than to give the scripture over, otherwise he had to give in.
“Also, this matter must be temporarily kept a secret.” Emperor Summer stated, “I require some time to collect the Chaotic Origin Sand. Before collecting the required amount, if this matter of the Mirage Scripture is made known to others, they would be able to piece the clues and know that I am collecting the Chaotic Origin Sand for the Mirage Scripture. This would increase the difficulty of collecting it by much.”
Actually, the current difficulty was very high already! Otherwise, Emperor Summer and the others would not feel so heart aching.
But the moment this trade regarding the Mirage Scripture was made known to others!
Myriad Realms Ancient Nation and Towering Sky Ancient Nation might not even want to sell any Chaotic Origin Sand! Everyone wasn’t foolish. How could they not link the matters about Xue Ying selling the Mirage Scripture to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, and for the Summer Wind Ancient Nation to collect Chaotic Origin Sand?
“Yes.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon acknowledged from below.
“Yes, I’ll certainly not spread this news as well. Furthermore, before Emperor Summer finishes collecting the Chaotic Origin Sand, I’ll not cast my Mirage and Illusory Realm Technique either.” Xue Ying guaranteed. He could not accept any losses since this Chaotic Origin God Weapon was vital to him. Even if he reached the final realm, this Chaotic Origin God Weapon would remain essential.
Xue Ying smiled to Sky-Rending Great Paragon by the side: “Sky-Rending Great Paragon, I do hope for you not to spread this news about me acquiring the Void Fire Lotus Flower temporarily too.”
“Oh?” Sky-Rending Great Paragon’s eyes brightened. He had some guesses, “Is Younger Brother Flying Snow planning on revenge?”
“Naturally!”
Xue Ying softly nodded.
Black Sovereign King…
Xue Ying could not eliminate Eternal Night Primogenitor! But he had never chosen to let Black Sovereign off. That time in the Realm Heart God Palace, there were only two who knew that he had obtained the Sea Domain Origin-one was Paragon Master Bewitching Sword and the other, Black Sovereign! Paragon Master Bewitching Sword was an expert from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation and was enemies with the Primogenitor Ancient Nation.
In addition, Black Sovereign even deliberately delayed for more time by spouting rubbish.
When Eternal Night Primogenitor came, Black Sovereign wasn’t surprised either! Hence, it was unquestionable that Black Sovereign was the one that informed this matter to the Eternal Night Primogenitor, causing Eternal Night Primogenitor to kill him. Fortunately, he had to avatar techniques. Otherwise, Xue Ying would have died!
But Black Sovereign was a Paragon Master and wasn’t an easy opponent. Even his current realm made it hard for him to deal against Black Sovereign. But now that he owned the ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’, things were no longer the same.
“Black Sovereign is a Paragon Master. Furthermore, he has his Shadow Incarnation technique and isn’t easy to deal against.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon chuckled.
“I still have to try. ” Xue Ying smiled back.
Sky-Rending Great Paragon nodded. He knew Xue Ying had once personally witnessed Black Sovereign fighting, and knew of how powerful Black Sovereign was! Since he dared to do so, he should have some confidence. Thinking about this, Sky-Rending Great Paragon felt a jolt in his heart. It seemed the strength of Xue Ying had far surpassed his expectations!

chapters.title: Chapter 1151 - A significant boost in Strength!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1151: A significant boost in Strength!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was still satisfied. Even though he could gather what he wanted by selling to other ancient nations, firstly, he was enemies with ‘Eternal Night Primogenitor’ from the Primogenitor Ancient Nation. Xue Ying was not willing to lower his head and trade with him. This way, he would not be able to gather as much as he wanted as compared to just selling to Summer Wind Ancient Nation alone! Secondly, the most suitable top-graded secret treasure weapon that could conceal his ‘Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes’ in the Realm Heart Great Land and had sufficient power was the ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’.
‘Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes’ made all his avatars powerful! One had to know that under normal circumstances, Paragon Masters wielded a powerful strength only because of their top-graded secret treasure. Other avatars would instead be very weak (the premise was if they could refine avatars)!
And the Void Fire Lotus Flower was a world-related Dao of Void secret treasure that would boost the strength of every avatar!
…
Both parties made an oath.
Reaching their level, swearing an oath would merely influence their Dao Heart! It would not threaten their lives. But regardless of the three unparalleled existences of Xue Ying, they had an intense desire to walk further down the path of cultivation! It was impossible for them to disobey that slight benefit from the oath just to give up on their path of cultivation.
“Ancestor Fan, please have a look.” Xue Ying handed over his Mirage Scripture-it was a golden book. This book flew over-on this scripture, numerous worlds could be seen appearing. Those were illusory worlds.
Being a scripture that he created, Xue Ying could record however much he wanted.
But due to the restriction from the oath, at least in the region of Realm Heart Great Land, only the Summer Wind Ancient Nation was qualified to impart it to others.
“Let me have a look.” Ancestor Fan took over. He immediately flipped through the scripture. This glance took him over an hour. Those present like Emperor Summer and others were very patient. Xue Ying had already started drinking with Sky-Rending Great Paragon.
After the hour, Ancestor Fan kept the scripture. Both his eyes were bright. He looked at Xue Ying with a gaze filled with joy. He chuckled: “It is indeed different. When I cultivated the Mirage, I usually focus more on the heart of humans, sparking their desire, turning them into my puppets and ensuring they immerse themselves in the Illusory Realm. And you instead treated the Illusory Realm as another form of reality. Bewilderment, Desire, Slaughter and Soul seem to be part of this real world?”
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Amazing. Very amazing.” Ancestor Fan nodded. What he wanted to see is how others succeeded in their Dao path! He wanted to absorb the experiences of success.
And it seemed this scripture had given Ancestor Fan a huge inspiration!
Naturally, reaching his level, he would not easily alter his own Dao Path. But he could completely fuse the essence of wisdom from others into his own.
“There is hope for me to fuse four branches together.” Ancestor Fan was incredibly delighted. Worth it. This scripture was worth the price!
What Chaotic Origin Sand…
What top-graded secret treasure…
To Ancestor Fan, nothing could beat the importance of his path of cultivation!
“Haha, it is good that Younger Brother Fan likes it.” Both Emperor Cang and Emperor Summer smiled. Since Ancestor Fan was satisfied, it represented that this trade was worth the price.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying, this is the Void Fire Lotus Flower and is also a World-Related Dao of Void secret treasure that I refined with the Fire Domain Soul Origin as the base material. The Fire Domain Soul Origin is similar in value to the Sea Domain Origin you once got in the past.” Saying that, a fiery lotus flower appeared in his hand. Emperor Summer threw it over to Xue Ying.
Only because of the expensive refining materials that made this top-graded secret treasure incredibly pricey.
“Many thanks, Emperor Summer.” Xue Ying extended his hand. This fiery-red lotus flower landed at the center of his palm. He was relatively excited.
This secret treasure could hide his Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes and also greatly boost his strength.
Otherwise, if any of his avatars could easily exert strength at peak Cosmos God combat strength, it might incur the suspicions from others! With the ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’, others would naturally ‘visualize why’.
“Make full use of it. It is very hard to acquire such World-Related secret treasure.” Emperor Summer was quite unwilling to part with it.
“Yes.” Xue Ying answered.
Secret treasures depended on the users too.
The same secret treasure would display different strength in the hands of different level-two Cosmos Gods.
“Did you cultivate some sort of soul secret technique?” Emperor Summer abruptly suddenly asked, “Even though my Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll could enhance the karmic concealment effects of the soul, it shouldn’t have reached this degree of strength.”
Ancestor Fan and Emperor Cang looked at Xue Ying too.
“Karmic concealment of the soul? Tracing method?” Xue Ying was slightly startled, “Did Emperor Summer discover something?”
Emperor Cang nodded. He had treated Xue Ying as a person on his side. Furthermore, most would discover this matter after a long period: “Yes, we can’t trace your soul. I, Ancestor Fan, and Emperor Summer all couldn’t do so! This kind of concealment technique is comparable to body cultivators who had reached the final realm.”
Xue Ying was momentarily astonished.
Thinking about when he had reached the pinnacle in the Chaotic Origin Pagoda of the Realm Heart God Palace, he was given a droplet of bloody dull green liquid which fused into his soul. At that time, the droplet of dull green liquid gave off a pressure far exceeding that of Emperor Summer and others! Furthermore, this blood caused his avatar to faint and lose consciousness. And after the fusion succeeded, because his avatars could sense the soul or others, it catalyzed a transformation in the souls of other avatars too. Every avatar became more powerful. Xue Ying even suspected that the transformation of his soul would not be so drastic even when he reached the final realm.
“It isn’t a secret technique. It should be a one-time miraculous opportunity.” Xue Ying mentioned.
“Miraculous opportunity?” Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, and Emperor Cang were all enlightened.
The Realm Heart Great Land existed different kinds of opportunities. For instance, one could find miracles happening in the Realm Heart God Palace or on the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, those that surpassed any of their imaginations.
…
Xue Ying then left the place. Sky-Rending Great Paragon personally sent him off. This time, he had to pay more attention to Xue Ying because of his strength. He knew that not too long later, the entire Realm Heart Great Land would witness how powerful this ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ from the Southern Cloud Nation is! His reputation would likely not precede Southern Cloud King himself.
“Brother Flying Snow.”
“Monarch Flying Snow.”
Two Cosmos Gods flew over side-by-side above the Fan Clan Magic Mountain. Seeing Xue Ying and Sky-Rending Great Paragon, they came over. They were quite familiar with Sky-Rending Great Paragon since they came from the same clan and were relatively casual. Both of them greeted Xue Ying with a smile.
“Great Paragon, Brother Orchid Snow.” Xue Ying also smiled back. The two before him were ‘Great Paragon Huge Bark’ and Monarch Orchid Snow.
Great Paragon Huge Bark…
He should have risen in the same era as Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, and Emperor Cang. Currently, in the Fan Clan, there were two Great Paragons that unparalleled existences could not kill-one was the ancient Great Paragon Huge Bark and the other was Sky-Rending Great Paragon from a newer generation. Great Paragon Huge Bark was too ancient, causing him to remain low-profile. He concentrated on his cultivation without caring about the mundane stuff.
After chatting for a few sentences, both parties parted.
“Sky-Rending Great Paragon seems to treat this Ying Shan Xue Ying quite politely.” Monarch Orchid Snow looked at the two cultivators that left from afar. He sighed, “I still thought that with the cold personality of Sky-Rending Great Paragon, he wouldn’t care about this Ying Shan Xue Ying.”
“It is indeed puzzling.” Great Paragon Huge Bark chuckled, “But this Ying Shan Xue Ying is quite pitiful. He just rose only to be killed by Eternal Night.”
“It is indeed quite pitiful and sorrowful, but what to do? Eternal Night Primogenitor had personally acted then.” Monarch Orchid Snow could sympathize with Xue Ying.
******
Xue Ying wasn’t in a rush to leave for the Primogenitor Ancient Nation. Instead, he first returned to the Flying Snow City and spend some time studying the top-graded secret treasure, ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’. At the same time, he sent an avatar over to the Fan Clan Magic Mountain to meditate under the Fan Clan Burning Tree! After all, it had been 300 billion years since he last cultivated there.
“Void Fire Lotus Flower?”
Within the dark meditation room, a white-robed Xue Ying sat here. A fiery-red lotus flower currently floated before him. He easily refined it before thoroughly sensing the profound mysteries inherent within.
“Emperor Summer is indeed the vague number one expert amongst the unparalleled existences living in the Realm Heart Great Land. He is an absolute expert who had created the Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll.” Xue Ying was quite startled and astonished over this piece of top-graded secret treasure. Very soon, he activated this secret treasure. “Hua~” The lotus flower immediately became huge. He also flew above the lotus flower and sat on it.
“Sou sou sou sou sou sou…”
Many avatars began appearing from the side.
This enormous fire lotus flower occupied close to half the meditation room. Above the lotus flower, there were nine avatars currently seated. Above each petal was a Primal Chaos World, and the World Energy here was being controlled by Xue Ying, augmenting the strength of every avatar, causing the aura they emitted to rise until the peak Cosmos God level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1152 - Preying on Black Sovereign King
chapters.content:
Chapter 1152: Preying on Black Sovereign King
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Amazing, this is really amazing.”
The nine Xue Ying were seated above the enormous lotus flower. They were simultaneously meditating and trying out different techniques.
Weapons were ultimately dependent on the users.
Xue Ying had fused eight branches of the Dao of Void. He was just a single step away from stepping into the final realm. Furthermore, he cultivated the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> and even created his own technique called <Flying Snow Combat Technique>. Only with rich experience and thick accumulation could he fully unleash the power of this ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’! The only question now was to fuse the Void Fire Lotus Flower with his self-created <Flying Snow Combat Technique> so as to maximize his combat power!
“Hong!”
Above the enormous fire lotus flower, the nine seated Xue Ying suddenly became blurred. One turning into two, two into three, three into 10,000. Different spatial pockets appeared above the entire lotus flower with each pocket containing a figure of Xue Ying. And at the next moment, each Xue Ying across the numerous spatial pocket began executing different techniques.
The petals of the fire lotus flower abruptly expanded and folded together.
And once the lotus flower became fully closed, everything within could no longer escape. A vast Chaotic Origin Energy also began pervading the place, giving off the sense as if it was an Origin World.
“I’ve finally completed this technique.”
The firey lotus flower bloomed open once again. Currently, there were only nine avatars. “This Void Fire Lotus Flower is totally worth the price. It’s no wonder that every level-two Cosmos Gods desire to own a piece of top-graded secret treasure. The feeling of being able to execute all kinds of final realm techniques is incredibly wonderful! Using this with my <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>, I can see that I have become stronger by a few times once again!”
“It is time for me to pay Primogenitor Ancient Nation a visit. Without the Void Fire Lotus Flower, I do not have much confidence in dealing with Black Sovereign King. But now, I am 70% to 80% confident.” A cold intent flashed in the eyes of Xue Ying.
If this was made known to the outside world, most would be frightened silly.
Killing a Paragon Master? And even a Paragon Master that relied on an ancient nation ruled by unparalleled existences? That was too difficult. Black Sovereign King had been someone who crossed through the 12th stage in the Realm Heart God Palace-beyond what Hunter and Great Paragon Pu Su reached! He was ranked in the front amongst the Paragon Masters. And in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, the number of Paragon Masters who dared to say they could kill him… was fewer than what could be counted with two hands!
…
Primogenitor Ancient Nation, Black Soveriegn City.
Within the residence of Black Sovereign King.
“Black Sovereign King.” An ugly old man bowed respectfully, “I’ve discovered a young fellow in our city who has an extremely high talent. Hence, I went to bring him over.”
“Oh?”
The one seated on the throne was none other than Black Sovereign King.
Black Sovereign King was shocked: “Oh? His talent is extremely high?”
“Yes, it is extremely high. He cultivated for just slightly more than a billion years before reaching the Primal Chaos tenth level realm. It’s just that his wife had died; hence his temper is slightly weird.” The ugly old man respectfully explained, “Of course, he’ll definitely be very obedient before Black Sovereign King.”
“His cultivation speed is so fast? This made me think about Monarch Flying Snow from Southern Cloud Nation that once ventured into the Realm Heart God Palace with me. He is really pitiful, though his bad fortune is my good fortune.” Black Sovereign King chuckled, “Marat, make that cute little fellow stay at my residence for a few days. I’ll have a look then.”
“Yes.” The ugly old man bowed, “Then I shall withdraw then.”
“Go.” Black Sovereign King had quite a benevolent smile.
The subordinates of Eternal Night Primogenitor were divided into two factions.
One was those under the direct line of descent. This faction was led by the Nine Eternal Night Walkers. The Nine Eternal Night Walkers were special magic puppets refined personally by Eternal Night Primogenitor. They were naturally loyal. This sect, other than the magic puppets, were those whose souls had been branded by Eternal Night Primogenitor. They were absolutely loyal Cosmos Gods.
And on the other side, they were Cosmos Gods led by Black Sovereign King and Flame Sovereign King. Being Cosmos Gods, they desired freedom. They chose to become subordinates of Eternal Night Primogenitor was only to gain some benefits from Eternal Night Primogenitor, and would subsequently serve Eternal Night Primogenitor. This faction was extremely huge. Black Sovereign King and Flame Sovereign King were just two Paragon Masters within.
“Why do I feel that my luck is becoming better?” Black Sovereign King chuckled.
Ever since he schemed against Monarch Flying Snow in the Realm Heart God Palace, he found his fortune improving. First was a top-graded secret treasure that he desired. He was able to exchange for it from Eternal Night Primogenitor with the rewards he got from crossing the 12th stage, some savings he had and the contribution of dealing against Monarch Flying Snow. Eternal Night Primogenitor believed in ‘fair transactions’.
‘I’ve succeeded in training the Shadow Incarnation Technique, allowing me to fight for an opportunity to enter the Realm Heart God Palace. It seems my luck is quite good since I was able to reap a huge harvest there. Hence, allowing me to make good use of this opportunity to acquire a second piece of top-graded secret treasure. Not only did I become stronger, but I was also able to borrow on the treasure to experience various profound mysteries of the final realm closely, greatly boosting my chances of breaking through.’ Black Sovereign King pondered, ‘It seems Eternal Night Primogenitor and Extreme Night Primogenitor are planning something huge. I hope they don’t bring the trouble up onto me.’
Even though he chose to rely on Eternal Night Primogenitor, he was ultimately independent.
What he sought was to reach the final realm himself! He wasn’t willing to remain subservient to Eternal Night Primogenitor for eternity.
…
In another location within the Black Sovereign City.
“Mn?”
A black-robed young man Xue Ying sat within a restaurant enjoying good food. After all, this was an ancient nation. He dared not reveal his identity to the public. Ever since Eternal Night Primogenitor killed him in the Realm Heart God Palace, both parties had become enemies! Eternal Night Primogenitor might not place Xue Ying in his eyes, but if Xue Ying chose to come here openly, Eternal Night Primogenitor might just give him a whack again!
‘He isn’t here? Where is he?’ Xue Ying felt bewildered, ‘Only an incarnation is here protecting the Black Sovereign City?’
This was just an ordinary incarnation.
But that was normal too since quite a few experts in the Realm Heart Great Land owned avatars too. Those he knew relied on the Dao of Void or the Ancient Cultivation Lineage! There were even more than half unparalleled existences that could not form avatars! After all, those who had no talent in Dao of Void would not be able to do so!
Usually, when the true body wanted to enter closed-door cultivation or to handle some important matters, they would let the incarnations take charge over the miscellaneous tasks.
‘Where is his true body? I have to thoroughly look for it.’
…
In the following days, Xue Ying seemed to be enjoying the delicacies of the Primogenitor Ancient Nation. In reality, he was carefully searching for traces of where Black Sovereign King could be.
According to logic, he had not mentioned the matter about dealing with Black Sovereign King to others! And even if this was mentioned to the public, Black Sovereign King would treat it as a huge joke! Hence, it should not be the case that Black Sovereign King chose to hide.
‘Not here.’
‘Not here either.’
Xue Ying could not find Black Sovereign King at all. He went to different residences and even places for meditation yet to no avail.
Xue Ying even cast the Mirage and Illusory Realm against some personal servants of Black Sovereign King. Naturally, dealing with those servants, Xue Ying could simply utilize techniques at the ordinary Cosmos God level! He would not reveal his ‘level-two Cosmos God’ techniques. These servants were very weak and Xue Ying could easily scour through their minds without alerting them.
‘Even the personal servants do not know about where he went? Was it because of some important matter?’ Xue Ying contemplated.
Time passed.
Xue Ying did not have any other choice. He could only travel across the Realm Heart Great Land while enjoying the sceneries and the delicacies. Finally, there was a day-the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion passed a piece of news over-they discovered traces of ‘Black Sovereign King’ at the ‘Heavy Wind Nation’!
‘Haha, it is indeed one of the top ten great religions in the Realm Heart Great Land. Its web of intelligence has permeated through so many places that as long as Black Sovereign King isn’t deliberately hiding, he’ll definitely be discovered.’ Xue Ying immediately headed to the Heavy Wind Nation when he obtained this piece of news.

chapters.title: Chapter 1153 - Shadow looms over the Nation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1153: Shadow looms over the Nation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Heavy Wind Nation was an unremarkable tier-three nation in the Realm Heart Great Land.
“Black Sovereign King once came to this restaurant.” Xue Ying arrived at one of the private rooms in the restaurant. Sweeping his gaze across, he reversed the flow of time. It’s just that when the flow of time reached the point where Black Sovereign King had been present, the time flow became distorted, preventing Xue Ying from continuing his investigation, “It is indeed true. The intelligence provided by the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion is not false!”
Even though Xue Ying did not excel in the Dao of Time, existences that could interfere with his reversal flow were at least Cosmos Gods.
“He might still be in this city?” Xue Ying had a spark of feeling.
“Weng.”
With him at the center, unseen ripples began spreading out via the black fog spherical particles. The ripples soon covered the entire city. Such scouting method, by using the essence of void, was highly concealing.
“There are no Cosmos Gods in this city currently.” Xue Ying frowned slightly, “When Black Sovereign King left the Primogenitor Ancient Nation for a small distant nation in the Realm Heart Great Land, it can’t possibly be because he wanted to come here for a meal right? It is more likely that he is currently staying in the Heavy Wind Nation.”
“Let’s check again more thoroughly.”
The suppression on the Realm Heart Great Land was too powerful. There was a limit to the region that Xue Ying could cover through the essence of the void.
He began thoroughly examining the place…
Just an hour later.
“This is?” Xue Ying’s expression changed slightly.
Through the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique, Xue Ying observed all the remote cities within the Heavy Wind Nation. Black fog pervaded the entire city. This fog was mild, causing the city to become gray and blurry. Nonetheless, it was the civilians within that did not behave normally.
Some were killing one another!
And some were teleporting again and again as if they were seeking ways to leave the city yet to no avail.
Some formed groups and were seemingly searching for something within the city.
The entire city had someone turned into a nightmare ground. Civilians were dying in batches every single moment.
“What is happening? Why does it feel like everyone is influenced by the fog? Furthermore, the entire city seems to be controlled by an array that prevented anybody from leaving it?” Xue Ying was startled. He could not pinpoint the problem of that city when he used the Destruction Realm to scout. Just that from the surface, he could ascertain, “There must be someone who is scouring the civilians in the entire city!”
Xue Ying’s eyes were filled with anger.
