“There should be someone within the city sending messages for help! But why is there no reaction from the Heavy Wind Nation at all?” Xue Ying was frustrated, “Is it because of the background of the enemy?”
Heavy Wind Nation was a tier-three nation.
Some powerful devils could terrify the Heavy Wind King! Most of the time, he would have to invite some allies for help. But if the devil had a powerful background, this little nation could only close one eye and endure!
“Damn.”
But Xue Ying could not do so!
‘Seeing’ civilians dying every moment, he knew this was happening because of a scheme.
“Let’s check other cities as well.” Even though Xue Ying felt furious, he still suppressed his emotions and hurried in his observation! Previously, he was seeking for Black Sovereign King and had to probe the residences one by one in each city. But now, he was merely checking out the approximate situation happening in each city, making the entire process faster.
In a short few breaths of time later.
Xue Ying had ‘swept’ through all cities within the Heavy Wind Nation. What astonished him was that a total of 19 cities had similar phenomena happening! And the civilians could not escape! Those with a weaker heart temperament seemed to have turned insane. Those who were stronger were seeking ways to live! But since they could not leave the place, it was destined for the number of beings living to reduce over time. This process, if Xue Ying did not intervene in it, would most likely happen over a million to 10 million years.
“Who is so daring to commit such acts?” Xue Ying was truly furious.
“Sou.”
He disappeared from his original spot, directly teleporting into one of the cities covered in a mild black fog.
“Mn? I can’t even teleport in?” Xue Ying was somewhat surprised. Looking at the black fog before him, he slightly extended his senses before directly entering.
He silently flew into the city.
As he flew and walked, Xue Ying did not find himself being influenced by the fog. He easily flew across the city walls into the city.
“Mn? I can’t leave anymore?” Xue Ying tried leaving, only to find himself being blocked by an unseen force. It felt like the internal city had become a realm by itself, “It’s quite similar to a spatial seal, though it isn’t that powerful. I can enter easily using the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique.”
It could only be considered an internal realm.
Ordinary Primal Chaos experts would most likely be stuck!
“Strangely though, I can’t contact anyone outside?” Xue Ying could not help but feel apprehensive. The communication treasures which he had could not be used at all. Of course, he could still interact with his avatars and incarnations still. He could also perceive the outer world.
Only most Unity Realm experts could not travel a huge distance away from their incarnations in the Realm Heart Great Land.
As for those with avatars? That was even rarer!
‘Since these civilians can’t contact anybody from the outside world using their communication treasures, there are even fewer who could actually get in touch with someone outside.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘But no matter what, the Heavy Wind King should most likely know about this since the same phenomenon has spread across 19 of his cities.’
‘Was it done for some wicked cultivation technique?’
Xue Ying felt that something was amiss.
Arrays that could prevent any communication from reaching outside were not ordinary Cosmos God methods! Furthermore, this had happened across 19 cities simultaneously.
One had to know, even though Heavy Wind King was weak, this kind of weak nation would have joined a ‘Heaven Ancient Union’ with other allies. It was fine for Blood Sacrifice to happen occasionally as it was too fast! But this act against 19 cities over a long period… was something that Heavy Wind King would have informed the entire Heaven Ancient Union. The Heaven Ancient Union should not have easily let things go.
And usually, in terms of strength, a union wasn’t any weaker than the Southern Cloud Nation.
‘Is it because the perpetrator has a powerful background?’ Xue Ying thought.
Even though he felt some pressure, the current Xue Ying would not retreat even when he faced unparalleled existences!
‘I do want to see which devil this is.’ A cold intent flashed in the eyes of Xue Ying. Previously, he came to the Heavy Wind Nation in search of Black Sovereign King for revenge. But now, Xue Ying chose to temporarily place the matter of Black Sovereign King aside.
Killing Black Sovereign King was his personal vendetta.
But facing a huge devil that scourging numerous civilians in the world was something he could not tolerate!
…
Within the city, Xue Ying began releasing ripples. It immediately engulfed the entire city through the surrounding void essence. He was able to confirm how many experts there were in the city after that.
Primal Chaos experts-two of them!
They were currently in one of the residences within the city.
“Over here.”
Xue Ying took a step. He appeared on an empty street looking forward at a residence.
Mild black fog pervaded the surroundings. Even though there were battles happening all over the place, the environment was quite quiet closer to this residence.
“Hurry up and leave!”
A figure appeared by the side of Xue Ying. It was a non-human with a single horn. He looked at Xue Ying and gravely uttered, “This is the origin of the black fog in this city. All the experts within the city have worked together to attack this place, yet more than half have died. We can’t deal with it. You shouldn’t get close.”
“Oh?” Xue Ying looked at this single-horned non-human cultivator before smiling, “I felt that the fog in this city is strange. That’s why I came to have a look. How long has this fog been like that?”
“You deliberately came in?” The single-horned non-human cultivator was stunned. He then mentioned with bitterness, “The few of us desire to leave this place yet we can’t. And yet you came to send yourself to your death? Ai, this black fog has covered this city for close to 10 million years already, and more than half the civilians here should have died! Previously, the few of us had hoped for the king to save us, or other Cosmos Gods from our Heaven Ancient Union to come. But we have waited for so long without seeing any experts who dare to deal with this city. Furthermore, seeing that the devil isn’t in a rush to slaughter us, and instead, is torturing us over a long period, it seems the background of this devil should be extraordinary. Currently, many Unity Realm experts in the city have turned mad. Ai, you are too rash to barge in just like that.”
Xue Ying nodded.
Did nobody come to save them?
“I do want to see who exactly is behind this, an existence that prevented the entire Heaven Ancient Union from intervening.” Xue Ying directly walked towards that residence. Arriving at the main entrance, he directly smashed the main door with a ‘peng’. That door was directly blasted away-forming a streak of light that crashed into the corridor, against the walls and many houses behind…
Yet strangely, the door remained perfectly undamaged-it had penetrated through the cavern-dwelling within a moment.
“Peng.” Finally, a blood-colored ray descended down on that fast-flying door. Only then did the door shatter into pieces.
And after that, a blood-robed man appeared within the residence. He coldly stared at Xue Ying: “Primal Chaos expert? What a pity that another one is here to seek death!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1154 - Black Sovereign King appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 1154: Black Sovereign King appears
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“At least one person has come.” Xue Ying looked at this blood-robed man while coldly declaring, “Who your master? To dare execute a secret technique across the trillion beings living in the entire city. What audacity does he have to disregard the lives of everyone.”
The blood-robed man was stunned.
The master behind his back?
This blood-robed man turned to the black-robed young man with a sneer: “It seems you aren’t foolish. You are able to guess that there is an extremely powerful person controlling everything, yet you still dare to kill your way in? I truly admire you.” Even though he said that with his mouth, the blood-robed man became alert. At the same time, he widened his mouth. “Hua hua hua”, many blood-colored insects began flying out toward Xue Ying. They enveloped him thoroughly practically instantaneously.
“So pitiful.”
“Ai, he is too foolish.”
To the distance, some Unity Realm experts were already looking at this scene. They shook their heads inwardly when they saw what happened. After 10 million years, they all knew that the origin of this disaster came from that residence! But the great army they formed in the past had been defeated-with more than half dying. Ever since then, they no longer had the confidence to deal with the enemy.
“Hua.”
All of a sudden, the numerous blood-colored insects that engulfed Xue Ying dissipated like bubbles. Furthermore, his figure appeared above. He then waved his sleeves and uttered: “Die.”
The moment he waved his sleeves, the world became dark. The entire space had been wrapped. It wasn’t just the numerous blood-colored insects, even the blood-robed owner had been wrapped within. This space became distorted, and everything within became powder after that.
“Hmph.” Xue Ying shook his head inwardly. This blood-robed man was a Primal Chaos expert that came from a neighboring tier-three nation, ‘Monarch Blood Fu’. Xue Ying believed that it was absolutely impossible for the background of the party who caused these phenomena to be so weak since they dared to behave so wantonly!
You’re reading on BOX n o v e l .com Thanks!
Following that, Xue Ying waved his hand again.
“Si la-”
The void was torn apart. The residence below shattered just like a mirror, and every single location was breaking into pieces.
“He killed that blood-robed man?”
“This is an extremely powerful expert. He isn’t any ordinary Primal Chaos expert. He might possibly be a Primal Chaos tenth level expert!” Some of the peak Unity Realm experts who were trapped and watching from within the city felt excited. A strand of desire began forming.
Primal Chaos Tenth Level!
Ordinary Cosmos Gods who did not own any powerful secret treasures would only be at this standard. Even if their Heavy Wind King came, he could barely suppress this tenth level expert.
Such power was sufficient to move unhindered across a nation.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying looked downwards. The surface of the residence had been destroyed by him, causing an enormous array to appear. This array was like a cover protecting an underground palace within. Profound inscriptions could be seen surfacing on the underground palace. The array was constantly operating, emanating a dense evil aura. It should be the true origin of those black fog.
“What a strange array! It should be a powerful Cosmos God who constructed it.” Xue Ying felt slightly wary. The surrounding void then warped and he entered through the void maelstrom.
Within the underground palace.
There was currently a silver-haired Primal Chaos old man seated cross-legged. A weird ugly tree was placed before him. This odd tree had three black crystals inlaid within. Each crystal was constantly emitting light. And the black fog that pervaded the entire city seemed to move according to the fluctuations of these crystals.
“He actually dared to barge in? Really overestimating his strength. The venomous insect of Monarch Blood Fu should suffice to kill him easily… what! Monarch Blood Fu died?” The expression of the silver-haired old man who was seated in the underground palace paled.
Monarch Blood Fu died too quickly-it took just a single move!
The two of them were responsible for guarding this place. Now that his comrade had died instantaneously, he felt terror.
“Magnificent Black Sovereign King.” The silver-haired old man immediately contacted his leader, “There is a Primal Chaos expert who killed his way to our place. Monarch Blood Fu has been killed in a single move.”
“Which Primal Chaos expert is it?”
Even though Realm Heart Great Land was vast, and there were many Primal Chaos experts, most powerful organizations had intelligence on practically all of them.
“I do not know! I don’t recognize him! It is a black-robed young man who executed a Dao of Void technique.” The silver-haired old man anxiously reported.
As the avatar technique required the Dao of Void to use, many experts in the Realm Heart Great Land desired to cultivate in it. Like the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, being one of the top ten great religions, they primarily focused on the Dao of Void.
“Protect the ‘Dark Tree’. Don’t leave the palace. I’ll immediately come over to handle everything.”
“Yes, I’ll not leave this place.” The silver-haired old man immediately replied. He would naturally not leave here! He would most likely be killed in a single move if he went out. Staying in this palace hall, at least there was a profound array that made it hard even for Cosmos Gods to blast their way in.
“Hua.”
The silver-haired old man suddenly had a change in expression because not too far away, a Void Maelstrom formed, and a black-robed young man appeared from within.
“Magnificent Black Sovereign King, he is here! He executed the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique!” The silver-haired old man paled.
The Destructive Realm Teleportation technique was a very defying technique. Few places could obstruct it.
There was even the legendary ‘Great Destructive Realm Teleportation technique’ that was an entire level above! By using that technique, the cultivator could even travel across to another Origin World! Furthermore, the cultivator could even travel into the storage treasure refined and controlled by others!
“What is this tree?” Xue Ying asked. His gaze landed on the ugly and odd tree. This tree was like a dead zone. Not a strand of living energy could be sensed from the bark. The three black crystals inlaid on it made Xue Ying feel weirdly disgusted. What shocked him more was that he could not recognize this tree!
What identity did Xue Ying have? He could not recognize this odd tree! And neither could he recognize the black crystals!
This made him even more prudent! Which was why he chose to disguise himself as a Primal Chaos expert.
“Say!” Xue Ying turned to the silver-haired old man.
“I do not know either. I am forced here.” The old man pleaded.
Xue Ying shook his head slightly.
“Weng.”
An unseen ripple instantaneously pervaded into the mind of the old man. This was just an ordinary Primal Chaos expert. Xue Ying simply used a level-one Cosmos God Mirage and Illusory Realm technique to control him and flip over those memories.
“Mn?” Xue Ying’s expression shifted, “Heaven Ancient Union Master? Black Sovereign King?”
In the memories of this silver-haired old man, he saw two existences.
Heaven Ancient Union Master!
He was a famous cultivator across the Realm Heart Great Land and was a Paragon Master! But those at the level of Xue Ying knew that ‘Heaven Ancient Union Master’ was merely the Union Master on the surface. Behind him was another ‘Heaven Ancient God’! Heaven Ancient God was a peak Cosmos God expert though he did not own any supreme-graded secret treasure.
Xue Ying saw two great experts in the memories of this silver-haired old man. One was Heaven Ancient Union Master, and the other was Black Sovereign King!
The Heaven Ancient Union Master actually gathered several Primal Chaos experts in the dark before passing them over to Black Sovereign King! This batch consisted of a total of 38 Primal Chaos experts, and they were to obey ‘Black Sovereign King’. They were not foolish. Since Heaven Ancient Union Master who had a very high status summoned them over, yet handed them over to another Paragon Master from the Primogenitor Ancient Nation, ‘Black Sovereign King’…
Even fools could guess that this operation implicated many powerful beings. As an existence who could control two Paragon Masters, he must have a powerful background. This operation might even implicate the two unparalleled existences from Primogenitor Ancient Nation! Of course, it could possibly be Black Sovereign King acting alone.
“What a powerful origin.”
“Someone who could summon Heaven Ancient Union Master and Black Sovereign King?” Xue Ying felt apprehensive, “When was it that the Primogenitor Ancient Nation became so close to the Heaven Ancient Union?”
Xue Ying suddenly turned to the side, looking at the void before him.
At the same time, he waved his hand.
“Peng!”
He simply slapped out on the silver-haired old man, causing him to explode immediately.
The Heaven Ancient Union was a union of many nations. Most of the nations were chaotic and had relaxed rules. Many devils even had very high statuses within these nations. This time, those Primal Chaos experts the Heaven Ancient Union Master summoned over were relatively evil. Heaven Ancient Union Master did not wish to create too much problem too as those like Xue Ying would absolutely not be willing to let a trillion beings be slaughtered before him even if he was suppressed by a powerful expert.
To Xue Ying and the others, this was their Dao Heart!
The Dao Heart could not be disobeyed!
Which of them did not refine their Dao Hearts until they were incisive and penetrating?
Summoning these devils, Xue Ying became furious just after a thorough check of the memories. He would definitely not be merciful.
“Hu.” At the same time when he killed the silver-haired old man, Xue Ying stared at the void to his side as a figure appeared. This figure seemed covered in a black fog.
Xue Ying entered using the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique.
And this figure covered in black fog easily controlled the array of this palace.
“Black Sovereign King?” Despite the deliberate concealment of his identity, the other party did not specialize in a Dao path that was good at aura concealment. Not many personally saw Black Sovereign King before in the Realm Heart Great Land, but Xue Ying was one of them. He easily recognized Black Sovereign King with a single glance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1155 - Innermost Joy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1155: Innermost Joy
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Little fellow, you actually dare to disrupt the affair of this Old Ancestor?” Black Sovereign King spoke. He did not wish to reveal his identity, “A little Primal Chaos cultivator like you shouldn’t be that daring. Tell me, who made you come?”
“Nobody.” Xue Ying replied. Seeing that queer ugly-looking tree and the three black crystals inlaid in it, he chuckled, “This Old Ancestor, would you be so kind as to tell me what this ugly tree is?”
Black Sovereign King felt frustrated.
He was so calm?
And he even mentioned that nobody directed him over?
“A Primal Chaos cultivator like you shouldn’t be that foolish. Since nobody directed you over, why are you sending yourself to death?” Black Sovereign King’s voice was filled with killing intent, “Tell me your real purpose.”
“I’ve said it before, nobody directed me. But I do have a question for you. The neighboring 19 cities have turned into a nightmare for the past 10 million years. The entire Heaven Ancient Union treated it as if nothing has happened. A total of 19 cities! So many beings are dying batch by batch. Who was it that could force the Heaven Ancient Union to treat this as if nothing is happening? I reckon that huge character wouldn’t come deal against me just because I’ve killed two Primal Chaos cultivators right?”
Black Sovereign King sneered: “It doesn’t seem like you are lying. Are you from one of the big clans in the six great ancient nations? It’s fine too since I can see how strong you are and which disciple are you from!”
The moment he finished speaking.
Black Sovereign King suddenly struck out with his hand. His body let out an intense dark light that covered the whole palace, including Xue Ying.
“Receive my move.” Xue Ying also blasted out with his fist.
That punch caused numerous cracks to appear across the entire void. Those cracks engulfed ‘Black Sovereign King’ was hiding amidst the black fog. At that moment, the figure of Black Sovereign King was suppressed by the cracks and immediately shattered.
“What?” Xue Ying was immensely appalled.
I haven’t shown my true strength yet!
Xue Ying had merely begun casting his Bewilderment Technique to influence the other party’s judgment. And he prepared another killing move in the dark, one that could wipe out a Paragon Master! Who would have thought that a single Bewilderment Technique shattered the body of the other party?
‘When did Black Sovereign King become so weak? Was his body so weak? Unless it is merely his Shadow Incarnation?’ Xue Ying had his guesses. When he attempted the 12th stage in the Realm Heart God Palace, Xue Ying had witnessed the Shadow Incarnations of Black Sovereign King! Those Shadow Incarnations had the same aura as the true body. It was impossible to discern between which was real and unreal. Only then could it confuse the enemies.
The combat power of the Shadow Incarnations was very strong too! It was a percentage of the true body! But because they did not have any top-graded secret treasures, they could merely be considered to have a level-two Cosmos God strength. In addition, those Shadow Incarnations did not have sturdy fleshy bodies. Hence, even though Xue Ying deliberately bewildered the enemy, using just 10% of his strength, both parties were not using their secret treasures at all. As such, Xue Ying’s power far surpassed that of the Black Sovereign King! Even 10% of his strength was sufficient to cause the Shadow Incarnation to dissipate.
“Hmph hmph, and you still call yourself an Old Ancestor? Or that someone is directing me?” Xue Ying sneered. He casually grabbed that odd ugly tree and gave it a pull, uprooting it entirely from the ground. The three inlaid black crystals that were originally undulating began slowing down and dimming. Xue Ying then kept everything into his storage treasure.
‘Yi? He watches me uproot the odd tree without doing anything?’ Xue Ying thought, ‘That’s fine too since I can continue onto other cities and destroy their core. I shall see when Black Sovereign King can endure until.’
Killing Black Sovereign King was one of his goals.
Of course, Xue Ying wanted to find out who exactly was so daring to commit such acts too.
…
“Dissipated. It’s dissipated!”
“The black fog has dissipated!”
Several experts who were observing the disturbances forming in the residence from afar excitedly discovered that the operating array in the underground palace had stopped functioning. Furthermore, the dull black fog which pervaded the world gradually diffused and disappeared-it was becoming milder over time. Several breaths of time later, no black fog could be seen in the entire city any longer.
The city also regained its normalcy.
All the beings that were still alive in the city, began feeling the loosening and disappearance of the shackles influencing their heart realm. Agitation, gloominess, fury-all sorts of impulsive emotions abruptly disappeared. Being creatures of the Realm Heart Great Land, they were Transcendents by birth. Furthermore, those who could still survive until now in the city were relatively powerful in their heart cultivation.
And the sufferings over 10 million years had tempered the heart realm of many cultivators.
Only now did the black fog disappear, and everything went back to normal.
“It has dissipated.”
Even some of the cultivators who were enduring in their meditation room flew out of their houses. Looking up at the clear sky, quite a few cultivators could not help but cry.
They were originally in despair, yet now, they saw hope.
“We can go out. We can leave now!” Many cultivators attempted to fly out of the city.
Some directly shot into the sky.
They could finally fly to incredibly high height.
Some even tried teleporting out of the city and into the external world. Some were so excited that they began guffawing, while some cried tears of joy, kneeling on the ground bawling all their emotions out… cultivators were ultimately lives. Having left the abyss of despair, even those with a stronger heart realm could hardly remain calm from these ripples.
Xue Ying stood amidst the cultivators that were flying all over the place watching this scene with a smile.
Feeling the ecstasy erupting from numerous cultivators made Xue Ying happy: ‘Many cultivators treated the weak as ants. For the sake of their own Dao cultivation, they do not care even if they exterminate the entire world! Is living solely for the sake of cultivation? If the entire universe is destroyed, and there exists just a single person, what meaning is there to live without any rivals or people around you?’
‘Experts were once weak. Everyone is like us, sentient creatures. Those who slaughtered countless sentient creatures for the sake of themselves have become devils! And I, I will kill all devils.’ Xue Ying smiled.
Just like Ancestor Fan.
Ancestor Fan had similarly cultivated in the Mirage and Illusory Realm. He preferred controlling the desire of others, pulling them into an illusory world, controlling the souls of others so that they would treat him as their master.
Xue Ying instead treated everyone equally. Even creatures living in the illusory realm were beings he determined as having emotions and intelligence. They had their own journey in life and were all true living beings! Hence, he had always treated the illusory realm as reality. In his heart, he recognized that Desire, Bewilderment, Slaughter, and Soul were all part of the world. The world was taken as the foundation and everything else would be fused into it.
…
Xue Ying left the vicinity amidst the jubilation. Those fortunate survivors in this city were incredibly excited. Many amongst them even questioned who had saved them!
Gradually, there was a piece of news that circulated around the place-that it was a black-robed young man who specialized in the Dao of Void that saved this city.
Everyone remembered the appearance of this black-robed young man. These people desired to find out who their ‘benefactor’ was. It’s a pity that they could not find out. It was only after a huge battle that happened later on that led them to find out who this benefactor was! But that was something for the future.
At this moment, Xue Ying arrived in another city. After all, a total of 19 cities in the entire Heaven Wind Nation had been transformed into nightmarish locations, and he merely saved one of them.
…
“Hong!”
Extending his senses through the essence of the void, Xue Ying rapidly located the origin of the disaster in another city.
He directly executed the Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, appearing above the city before blasting out with a punch on the residence below him! When this fist struck, unseen ripples began spreading out. Wherever the ripples touched began breaking into pieces. “Hong long long”-since the matter of fighting against Black Sovereign King forced him to leak this slight strength of his, there was no need for Xue Ying to hide it anymore. He blasted out with 10% of his strength, causing the entire underground structure beneath the residence to collapse.
The fist of a level-two Cosmos God which specialized in penetrative impact easily destroyed the entire underground structure, causing it to explode.
Once the structure exploded, Xue Ying descended. He directly pulled out that similar ugly odd tree inlaid with three black crystals! As for the two Primal Chaos experts that were responsible for guarding it, they both died when the punch was sent!
It was inevitable. Primal Chaos 10th level experts might be able to survive. As for ordinary Primal Chaos cultivators? They could be wiped simply by a level-two Cosmos God. The gap between them was too big.
…
In a remote cavern-dwelling deep in the wilderness.
Black Sovereign King sat in a meditation room within this cavern-dwelling. He was looking solemnly at the drawings which appeared before him in midair-there were a total of 19 drawings that defined the core of the 19 cities he was responsible for. Currently, that ‘black-robed young man’ Xue Ying had destroyed two cores of the cities and was heading to the third.
Black Sovereign King did not care about the lives of those Primal Chaos experts since they were people from the Heaven Ancient Union.
“Primogenitor.” Black Sovereign King transmitted, “This mysterious Dao of Void expert disguised himself as a Primal Chaos expert. But currently, it appears the strength he displayed is at the very least, a level-two Cosmos God! Furthermore, he is rapidly destroying the Calamity Origin in each city rapidly. What should we do now?”
Black Sovereign King was apprehensive.
He was afraid that this black-robed young man had an ultra-terrifying identity in one of the powerful organizations within the Myriad Realm Ancient Nation of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
“Proceed with caution and unearth his foundation. If there is an unparalleled existence bullying you, I’ll immediately come.” Eternal Night Primogenitor transmitted back.
“Yes.” Having the guarantee from the primogenitor, Black Sovereign King felt fully confident. Previously, he was afraid that this mysterious black-robed young man had a powerful background, and Eternal Night Primogenitor would choose to give him up! But now, Eternal Night Primogenitor mentioned that he would be protecting him. Given the identity of the primogenitor, he would not easily go against what he said.
“I do want to see who are you being your disguise!” The eyes of Black Sovereign King flashed with cold intent. Following that, he disappeared with a ‘sou’.

chapters.title: Chapter 1156 - Xue Ying Fighting Black Sovereign King
chapters.content:
Chapter 1156: Xue Ying Fighting Black Sovereign King
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Above a luxurious residence spanning across a huge distance, a black-robed figure appeared. He abruptly punched downwards.
The direction where the fist blasted created ripples. Those ripples started disintegrating every single object they met. Even the stable palace hall began breaking internally—the arrays were destroyed, and the palace hall started collapsing. The two Primal Chaos cultivators that were responsible for guarding it looked around in terror. “Hua, hua”, the two of them broke into fine pieces silently! Firstly, Black Sovereign King was too cold and too lazy to care about these Primal Chaos experts. Secondly, Xue Ying was ruthless! He treated most innocent creatures equally and with gentleness. Nevertheless, Xue Ying did not have the same treatment toward these devils.
“Sou.”
His figure flashed, appearing in that collapsing palace hall from the sky to grab that odd ugly tree.
Clearly, all the cities that were suffering from the disaster originated from that mysterious odd tree and the black crystals inlaid on it.
At the point when he uprooted the tree, the dull black fog that pervaded this city began dissipating. It led to the experts who had rushed over because of the battle disturbances to look with astonishment.
“The black fog is dissipating?”
“This, this…”
“Is it because the residence that is the origin of the disaster has been destroyed? Who is that black-robed young man?” Many experts were watching carefully from the distance. Just like the two cities that were saved by Xue Ying, they experienced the same catastrophe for 10 million years and knew that the residence was the origin for everything. But just like the rest, they could not shake that residence at all! But now, everything had changed.
Suddenly—
Xue Ying looked up above him. A figure appeared. It was a cold, emotionless male garbed in a luxurious black robe. A saber could be seen by his waist too. This person was Black Sovereign King.
Black Sovereign King did not disguise himself this time. He understood that after unleashing his strength, given the top-graded weapon he had and his unique combat style, others would easily find out who he was. Hence, there was no point to hide his identity.
“That is?”
“Is that the Black Sovereign King from Primogenitor Ancient Nation?”
“Mn, it seems like he is the legendary Black Sovereign King.” This city contained many knowledgeable and experienced experts, and recognized some of the legendary experts in Realm Heart Great Land! Since Black Sovereign King did not conceal his identity, these Unity Realm cultivators naturally recognized him.
Black Sovereign King looked down at Xue Ying. He roared with fury: “Who are you? Are you the one who started the disasters in the surrounding cities?”
Xue Ying was startled.
The thief calling others a thief?
“Senior Black Sovereign King, this black-robed senior is the one who resolved the origin of the disaster. He is the one that saved our city.” There were Unity Realm experts who immediately shouted out in response.
“Saved?” Black Sovereign King looked down at the shattered residence. He sneered, “For you to produce an attack of this strength, you are at least a Cosmos God. There are no Cosmos Gods I do not recognize in the Realm Heart Great Land! What shameful things are you exactly planning to do for you to conceal your identity? Or are you scheming something?”
“Scheming something?” Xue Ying guffawed with a shake of his head.
“Maybe it’s you who is casting your secret technique that engulfs the entire city into a nightmare. Now that you are done with your secret technique, you even deliberately went out to save the city? No matter what, in a while, after I capture you, I’ll find out what’s your actual identity and see how you are planning to explain your actions!” Black Sovereign King spoke with justice. The moment he finished speaking, he pulled the saber by his waist.
“Hua—”
A dark blade light immediately descended from the world. It was like a black curtain spreading over toward the direction of Xue Ying.
Xue Ying stood at his original position watching that blade light as it came calmly. He extended both his hands, lightly slapping against the incoming dark blade light.
“Weng.”
Numerous spatial layers immediately stacked before his hands. The dark blade light destroyed space after space. As it destroyed the last layer of space, only 20% to 30% of its original power was left. In the end, it merely forced Xue Ying backward, causing him to plow through an enormous gouge about 500 kilometers long before he stopped.
“You actually have the power of a peak Cosmos God? I wonder which Paragon Master are you? There are only a few Paragon Masters in the Realm Heart Great Land, why the need to hide your identity?” Black Sovereign King coldly sneered. As he spoke, he immediately sent another blade over.
“Hua hua hua!”
Consecutive blade lights were sent. They were either overbearing and tyrannical, or they came stealthily from the dark. For a moment, Xue Ying was filled with darkness. He could not see any light at all.
“Protection.” Xue Ying put his palms together before his chest. A spot of light sparked from his palms that gradually spread outwards. It formed a layer of light protection.
No matter how the dark blade light struck Xue Ying—regardless if they were overbearing, cunning, queer, or penetrative… the light protection withstood all incoming attacks for half a breath of time.
“What a formidable Dao of Void expert. It seems he is quite good at defending. There are only these few Dao of Void Paragon Masters in the Realm Heart Great Land. His battle style is quite similar to that ‘Great Void Paragon’ from Sky Towering Ancient Nation. But Sky Towering Ancient Nation shouldn’t be that daring to intervene in this matter.” Black Sovereign King began guessing as he let out his attacks.
Half a breath later.
The light protection shattered. At the juncture that Black Sovereign King broke the light protection, he immediately teleported to the side of Xue Ying and began close combat.
“Chi chi chi!”
The cunning dark blade light came frantically.
Xue Ying casually brandished his palms around him. Every palm generated numerous spatial layers. Even though it seemed Black Sovereign King initiated a close combat battle, yet in reality, the distance between every blade he sent was incredibly far from Xue Ying. They had to cross through countless spatial pockets before arriving where Xue Ying was. And this had greatly diminished the power of those blades.
“Ding.” Xue Ying who was originally focusing on defending suddenly jabbed out his finger at a random spot.
Unseen ripples began penetrating through the spatial obstacles and transmitted onto the body of Black Sovereign King.
Black Sovereign King’s body trembled momentarily. His expression changed slightly before roaring: “You are quite cunning!”
Xue Ying did not answer. He continued exchanged moves, though, in his heart, he thought: ‘This Black Sovereign King could easily resist against this technique that penetrates directly into his fleshy body. It seems I have to forgo the first plan!’
He only had a single opportunity to utilize his killing move!
The moment he felt the threat of death, Black Sovereign King would definitely escape. If there were more powerful experts behind him, they would definitely come to save him.
Hence, before he executed his killing strike, Xue Ying had to ascertain the exact baseline of Black Sovereign King. As for those intelligence reports which he got from the outer world? They could only be used as a reference. After all, a powerful Paragon Master might just have many survival trump cards.
‘He is truly hard to deal with! His defenses are too high! If I don’t use my absolute move, I can’t force him to reveal his identity.’ Black Sovereign King squinted.
“Chi!”
In the next instant, darkness began engulfing the place, wrecking apart the spatial pockets created by Xue Ying’s palms. It immediately swept against the abdomen of Xue Ying. “Sou”, Xue Ying was forced into a stream of light as he flew backward into the sky. An enormous wound was formed on his abdomen. This immense impact actually made Xue Ying vomit fresh blood.
“Black Sovereign King, you have hidden quite deeply.” A hoarse voice was heard from Xue Ying.
“Haha, everything is half-truths. Let me see who exactly are you!” Black Sovereign King had completely turned mad.
Xue Ying was shocked.
During the 12th stage, he had personally witnessed the strength of Black Sovereign King. But it seemed this powerful blade executed by Black Sovereign King had far surpassed his expectations.
Naturally, the enormous wound formed on his abdomen and spurting of blood were all deliberately acted out by Xue Ying! He controlled his fleshy body to tear out a wound just so as to beguile the enemy. Otherwise, given his current terrifying fleshy body, even that Chaotic Origin Lifeform imprisoned in the Three Fire Prison Realms Cauldron, ‘Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son’, could merely injure him. Comparing Black Sovereign King with the ‘Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son’, he was very much weaker.
If Xue Ying did not pretend to be weak, he could simply stand there and let Black Sovereign King attack him however he wanted! And Xue Ying’s skin could not break at all!
But that would simply frighten Black Sovereign King so much that Xue Ying could no longer execute his plans.
“Sou sou sou…”
One could only see as the heavily injured Xue Ying created several other avatars around him.
“Haha, all Dao of Void experts have avatars. You have finally unleashed your nine great avatars?” Black Sovereign King did not find it puzzling. He then killed his way over while forming 18 bodies at the same time.
‘Shadow Incarnations? He could actually maintain 18 of them?’ Xue Ying was once again startled.
It appeared that Black Sovereign King had become much stronger than when he was at the Realm Heart God Palace.
The number of Shadow Incarnations and the power of his attacks.
“Pu pu pu…”
The 18 Black Sovereign Kings jointly surrounded Xue Ying. But the other Shadow Incarnations of his were very ordinary in strength. Only his true body was sufficiently powerful! His true body could always switch positions with his Shadow Incarnations, allowing Black Sovereign King’s offense to be unpredictable.
Even though Xue Ying had nine great avatars, he still suffered from the incoming attacks. At the same time, he was doing his best to retaliate.
Ultimately, with nine avatars, if he was lucky enough, he could occasionally strike the true body of Black Sovereign King.
“Si.”
A wound was torn on the surface of Black Sovereign King’s body, revealing the pitch-black bones within. The bones were covered in thick dark light.
‘The Great Cleaving Technique doesn’t seem appropriate either.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘It seems I can only begin my second plan.’
After several bouts of close combat battles, and after trying out some of the weaker techniques, Xue Ying discovered that the body of Black Sovereign King was quite formidable. His external fleshy body was relatively sturdy, and his inner organs were quite powerful too. Hence, Xue Ying could only take the gamble with his second plan—the plan that seemed to be the most hopeful of them all. He was about 30% to 40% confident. This was much higher than he once expected.
No other choice. The strength and fleshy body of Black Sovereign King were both stronger than what he once knew!
“All your nine avatars wield final realm strength? What top-graded secret treasure did you acquire to augment all nine avatars simultaneously?” Black Sovereign King became more interested. Currently, he held the upper hand and was having it easy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1157 - Death of Black Sovereign King
chapters.content:
Chapter 1157: Death of Black Sovereign King
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As Black Sovereign King spoke, he did not show any mercy! His techniques were executed ruthlessly.
His Shadow Incarnations were constantly changing positions and many horrific dark blade lights were causing grievous injuries to Xue Ying’s avatars! Xue Ying’s bodies were torn, forming wounds and fresh blood was spouting all over the place. Looking at this from a different viewpoint, Xue Ying’s nine avatars were having a miserable time as their injuries were constantly worsening. But this was all just an act by Xue Ying.
In reality, he did not consume any bit of his lifeforce.
Black Sovereign King did not suspect it! Because he was entirely confident of his strength—that it was normal for the other party to be injured. But Xue Ying could not be treated as an ordinary Paragon Master. After altering the ‘Chaotic Origin Refinement Body’, the level-two Chaotic Origin Refinement Body was equivalent to the fleshy body of a peak Cosmos God body cultivator. Such a fleshy body was something even unparalleled existences had a hard time killing.
“There aren’t many on Realm Heart Great Land who is as strong as you. But they seem different from your style of combat.” Black Sovereign King’s techniques were incomparably ruthless. He sought to unravel the mystery of where this mysterious expert came from.
For him to dare intervene and disrupt such a huge affair?
Did this mysterious expert intervene because of his idea or was it an ancient nation?
“Die for me!” Black Sovereign King’s killing intent soared furiously. The blade lights filled with darkness rained down on Xue Ying.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying suddenly placed both his palms together. A spot of light sparked from his palms, forming a light cover. This light cover expanded and enveloped all the Shadow Incarnations of Black Sovereign King! Black Sovereign King was familiar with this technique. Previously, this mysterious black-robed young man relied on this technique to resist against his offense by half a breath.
Naturally, Xue Ying did not use his full strength previously.
‘It could defend and even be used to trap me?’ Black Sovereign King felt disdain. He exerted his full strength against the dimmed light cover which isolated him entirely from the external world! This light cover seemed simple, yet in reality, it was an improved version of the ‘Five Phases Sealing Technique’. This technique sealed the inner space and isolated it from the external world.
Black Sovereign King did not discover that currently, all nine avatars of Xue Ying were similarly doing the same action—placing their palms together before their chests.
“Weng.””Weng.””Weng.””Weng.””Weng.””Weng.””Weng.””Weng.””Weng.”
The nine great avatars were executing this move at the same time.
Each avatar had formed an enormous light cover, with all nine intersecting and forming a confluent region! This confluent region was also the location that Black Sovereign King was sealed in. The nine sealed spaces were like celestial entities that were constantly flowing, causing the central religion to vaguely transform into a sealed cosmos.
This was none other than the self-created combined technique of Xue Ying’s <Flying Snow Combat Technique>, the ‘Void World Great Seal’!
Void World Great Seal!
Naturally, as the technique was augmented with the top-graded secret treasure, ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’, its power became much stronger. It’s just that Xue Ying did not wish to reveal the Void Fire Lotus Flower and frighten Black Sovereign King. Given the knowledge of Black Sovereign King, he should be able to recognize this piece of a precious top-graded secret treasure, ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’, with a glance. Secondly, he still needed the Void Fire Lotus Flower for the real killing move.
“Weng.”
Beneath the nine avatars, an enormous fiery-red lotus flower appeared.
At this moment.
The surrounding space became distorted. Some of the cultivators who were watching this battle from afar could no longer spectate it. The ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’ was something Xue Ying did not wish to reveal to the world.
The sealing technique did not create a huge burden to each avatar—it merely required 20% to 30% of his heart force to maintain.
At the same time while maintaining the ‘Void World Great Seal’, the nine great avatars sat down cross-legged. Their figures became blurred. One turning into two, two turns into three and three into 10,000. Innumerable spatial pockets appeared above the fiery lotus flower. Furthermore, every pocket contained a Xue Ying! Naturally—only nine avatars were present in reality, though this was just the effect from ‘Multiverse Void’.
Within every spatial pocket, Xue Ying was executing different techniques, and the enormous fiery lotus flower abruptly folded upwards!
All the petals became closed!
It turned into a flower bud!
An incomparably horrifying Chaotic Origin Energy was gathering and erupting within!
…
As Black Sovereign King had seen the light cover before, he did not panic when he was engulfed by it! Reaching his level, what could make him afraid? So what if he was temporarily imprisoned? He could immediately ask Eternal Night Primogenitor for help.
Furthermore, he did not feel that the light cover could trap him at all.
“Break.” Black Sovereign King struck out with his full force, causing the light cover to distort to the extent as if it was going to break. Black Sovereign King revealed a grin before sending another blade.
Nonetheless, the ‘Void World Great Seal’ had taken shape. The Void World Great Seal was under the control of Xue Ying. He deliberately made it distort while ensuring that it did not break.
“Unless the nine avatars are all executing the seal?” Black Sovereign King had some guesses. His expression paled slightly, “I do not believe that your seal will trap me. Break for me, break break break!”
Black Sovereign King frantically struck out with his blade.
The blade light was filled with endless darkness. Blade after blade was sent out fiercely.
“Hong hong hong~”
The energy from the Void World Great Seal was constantly diminishing. Its distortion became wider and more chaotic until finally, the seal shattered with a boom. Black Sovereign King gave a cold sneer. But he was unaware that this seal had been deliberately produced by Xue Ying. If Xue Ying chose to maintain the seal, Black Sovereign King would be trapped for a longer period! He deliberately let it shatter because his killing technique had already begun descending! If the seal wasn’t destroyed by then, it would instead become a hindrance to his killing move.
“This is?”
At the moment when Black Sovereign King shattered the Void World Great Seal, he looked around with terror. Numerous spatial pockets surrounding him were like bubbles popping; the spatial pockets were collapsing inward.
And the direction they were collapsing to was where Black Sovereign King stood.
“No! Primogenitor, save me!” Watching the scene of the pockets collapsing onto him, Black Sovereign King could feel the terror that came right from his soul. He had a feeling of danger, a danger that he was about to die!
“Hong hong hong!”
Almost at that moment.
The place where Black Sovereign King was at became pitch black. This region had already built a passage to the higher dimension. Everything was undergoing destruction.
One of the three killing moves of the <Flying Snow Combat Technique>—’Multiverse Void Great Destruction’.
“Die for me, die!” The nine great avatars appeared above the enormous fiery lotus flower. They were staring at this piece of darkness.
This was the most brutal and violent move out of the three killing moves. At the moment when he discovered how formidable Black Sovereign King’s fleshy body, Xue Ying had chosen to use the most violent killing move and destroy everything! But he was afraid that if this failed, he would no longer have sufficient time to use it again.
“He died.”
Xue Ying sensed it.
He could no longer feel any lifeforce coming from the piece of darkness. Many items were even destroyed in the process, leaving behind just two pieces that were the most dazzling.
“Collect.”
Xue Ying did not care about any other things. He waved his hand before using the void to keep everything into his storage treasure.
“Time to leave.”
He immediately teleported and ran away from the place.
…
Saying it was slow, but in reality, killing Black Sovereign King took just an instance. And Xue Ying had slipped away after taking all the treasures with him.
He stealthily left the region of Heavy Wind Nation.
In a piece of wilderness.
Xue Ying finally stopped. He used the Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to observe the place where the battle had happened. Even until now, his heart was still beating really quickly.
“I actually succeeded. I have killed Black Sovereign King.” Xue Ying felt both excited and joyous in his heart. He understood his strength better now.
Actually, it was normal.
Even if he did not rely on the Void Fire Lotus Flower, every avatar of his had power at the final realm by relying on the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>. When the nine great avatars worked together, he could be considered one of the strongest Paragon Masters. And now, by relying on the ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’, his strength was once again multiplied. Currently, Xue Ying’s strength had entered the level where Great Paragon Fuyi and others stood.
And he had joined the circle of the few terrifying Paragon Masters.
Even though Black Sovereign King’s fleshy body was without weaknesses, he was not a body cultivator and did not own any heaven-defying body refining techniques. Hence, his fleshy body was just slightly stronger than normal. Even if he had more formidable survival techniques, under the most frightening killing move of Xue Ying, his body was still wiped clean, his soul extinguished. Nothing was left behind.
Hence…
Another famous Paragon Master in the Realm Heart Great Land was killed in the Heavy Wind Nation.
“Mn?” Xue Ying’s pupils dilated. By relying on the Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, he saw it.
Over at the battlefield which he fought earlier on, a handsome male appeared above the ruins. He wore a black cape tinted with gold edges. On that white, tender face of his, a pair of cold, callous eyes swept across the surroundings. The eyes of Black Sovereign King were filled with coldness and fury. He already knew his subordinate ‘Eternal Night Primogenitor’ died during the battle, yet he did not know who killed his subordinate.
“Eternal Night Primogenitor.” Xue Ying’s expression became solemn as he watched from afar beyond the Heavy Wind Nation.
It’s him!
Eternal Night Primogenitor!
The one who easily wiped him out in the Realm Heart God Palace before taking all treasures his avatar had.

chapters.title: Chapter 1158 - The indignant Eternal Night Primogenitor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1158: The indignant Eternal Night Primogenitor
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The cold wind whistled in the wilderness. Xue Ying stood there coldly watching that terrifying existence half a trillion kilometers away! Even though his heart was soaring with killing intent, Xue Ying was clear that even though he could face Eternal Night Primogenitor directly with his current combat capabilities, the gap between them was still huge! Xue Ying could merely ‘survive’. He was seeking his death if he were to take his revenge.
‘I’ll wait until my Chaotic Origin God Weapon is refined. By then, the gap between us will be shortened. It isn’t the time for me to act now.’ Xue Ying thought. Right now, his strength was comparable to Great Paragon Fuyi. Nonetheless, this meant he would be entirely suppressed when facing an unparalleled existence.
‘I’ve only saved three out of the 19 cities. It seems I’ll meet some trouble when saving the remaining cities. I shall wait until Eternal Night Primogenitor leaves.’
It wasn’t the time to save them currently.
Eternal Night Primogenitor was filled with fury and was seeking for the perpetrator.
…
“Damn, who exactly is it?” His black cape fluttered noisily against the wind. The handsome Eternal Night Primogenitor looked downwards with his pair of cold eyes. Every inch of the void beneath him solidified. The slightly closer cultivators could feel their bodies congealing. Their minds became empty. Some even lost their ability to think. Before Eternal Night Primogenitor, they were as powerless as ants.
Eternal Night Primogenitor was currently seeking for the one who killed his subordinate.
He employed tracing secret techniques, soul scouring techniques, time reversal techniques…
‘What is going on?’ Eternal Night Primogenitor’s expression sunk over time. No matter what technique he chose to use, at the point when he tried to observe the murderer, something would interfere with his technique.
‘Even I can’t trace down who the person is? Unless it is a peak Cosmos God? But even ordinary peak Cosmos Gods can’t kill Black Sovereign King in an instant.’ Eternal Night Primogenitor thought. When Black Sovereign King called him for help, he immediately rushed over, but was still too late! When Black Sovereign King first transmitted a message over, he was relatively confident. But at the point when he called for help, he had died shortly after.
It showed that the murderer was concealing his strength at the start. At the point when he exposed his fang, he immediately went in for the kill using one single technique!
‘He could kill a Paragon Master instantaneously? Who is it? Is it other unparalleled existences?’ Many ideas flitted across the mind of Eternal Night Primogenitor at that instance. Few in Realm Heart Great Land could kill Black Sovereign King with one single technique. Even Xue Ying took the gamble without being confident of doing so. Others like Great Paragon Fuyi who was comparable to him in strength might succeed in killing Black Sovereign King, but it might be close to impossible for them to do so in an instance.
Those who dared say they could do it!
Were only the unparalleled existences!
‘It is fine they bully the weak like a Paragon Master, but they still choose to hide their tails without showing their face.” Eternal Night Primogenitor squinted. He then thoroughly examined the group of cultivators beneath, especially some of the Unity Realm experts. Eternal Night Primogenitor immediately pervaded their minds with unseen ripples to flip through their memories.
Being the strongest master in refining magic servants in Realm Heart Great Land, Eternal Night Primogenitor’s attainments in the soul were incredibly profound. He could easily flip through the souls of even Primal Chaos cultivators.
Flipping through their memories…
Eternal Night Primogenitor saw a black-robed young man fighting with Black Sovereign King. He even had nine great avatars. And at the most crucial moment-when Xue Ying used the ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’-because Xue Ying deliberately distorted the void, those Unity Realm cultivators could see nothing.
‘Black-robed young man? Nine great avatars? Seeing the techniques he employed during the battle, he is unquestionably a Dao of Void expert. But who exactly is he? There are only two unparalleled existences in the Dao of Void-Emperor Summer and Drifter? But that isn’t right. Before Undying Underworld Emperor returned, Emperor Summer is the number one expert in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. He is extremely proud and wouldn’t conceal his identity to assassinate Black Sovereign King. Drifter? Drifter is aloof. This doesn’t conform to his personality either!’ Eternal Night Primogenitor negated those conjectures, ‘It could possibly be Great Paragon Fuyi since he would do things by hook or by crook occasionally! What about ‘Realm Beast King’ from the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation? Realm Beast King has reached the level-two Cosmos God standard in the Dao of Void. Given the cunning personality of Realm Beast King, this is something he would do.’
‘Who is it exactly?’ Eternal Night Primogenitor became more sullen as he pondered over it.
Because he felt heart ached!
There were too few Paragon Masters in the world.
He only had five such subordinates! Of those five, three were from the ‘Nine Eternal Night Walkers’ he refined! The other two were experts who chose to join him-Black Sovereign King and Flame Sovereign King! Eternal Night Primogenitor hoped for more powerful Cosmos Gods to join him, and he usually treated Black Sovereign King and Flame Sovereign King very well.
But now, Black Sovereign King died!
…
Time passed.
Eternal Night Primogenitor stood above the ruins for the time taken to brew a cup of tea before eventually, he felt helpless and took a step, leaving the place.
…
Xue Ying remained outside Heavy Wind Nation. He watched everything happening without hurrying. He continued waiting silently.
The sky brightened before darkening.
A day passed. Xue Ying who stood just like a sculpture suddenly brightened: “It is time.”
“Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou!”
At various locations in the vast Realm Heart Great Land-either in an ordinary house within a city in an island nation, or a wooden house deep in the mountains, or by the shoulder of a tall mountain, or deep in an underground palace… many black-robed young men appeared in various locations. Xue Ying had a total of more than 10,000 avatars. Other than the 9 avatars who executed the Great Destruction Realm Technique toward other Origin Worlds, the other avatars of his were scattered across the Realm Heart Great Land. They usually maintained low-profile either cultivating by themselves or guiding some disciples in some of the smaller sects. Some even opened a refinement workshop, helping others refine weapons.
Currently, 16 avatars began moving.
They first teleported away from the place they hid. They then executed the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique at the same time toward the 16 different cities where the ugly odd trees were located.
Spatial maelstroms were formed.
And the avatars took a step into it. After penetrating through space, they arrived all at the respective core underground palace where the ugly odd trees were.
“You actually dare trespass a forbidden ground!”
“Kill!”
The two Primal Chaos cultivators who were responsible for guarding the place became both shocked and furious. They were controlling the arrays to deal with the invader while contacting their current leader, ‘Black Sovereign King’. Nonetheless, Black Sovereign King had died so how could they still contact him?
“Hong~”
Xue Ying’s avatars waved their hands, sending out 16 avatars that had weaker bodies and souls-these avatars were only about 10% of his strength. But simply waving his hand caused the two Primal Chaos cultivators to turn into powder. Xue Ying’s avatars then immediately uprooted the ugly odd tree. Seeing the three inlaid black crystals, he chuckled before leaving with his Destructive Realm Teleportation technique!
…
One by one, the avatars were arriving at the palaces with the Destructive Realm Teleportation technique. Out of the Primal Chaos cultivators responsible for guarding the place, only two were pushed aside by Xue Ying. These two were merely more reclusive and eccentric. They were not devils.
Nonetheless, there was an avatar that met huge trouble.
“Weng.”
When this avatar came out from the distorted maelstrom, a figure appeared from the void by the side. He was a handsome male that wore a black cape tinted with golden edges. He was coldly staring at Xue Ying. At the same time, he extended his hand! An endless golden light was let out from his hand. Every finger of his was gold in color. He directly grabbed toward this avatar of Xue Ying.
“I’ve been waiting for you here!” Eternal Night Primogenitor’s eyes were filled with coldness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1159 - Tyrannical!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1159: Tyrannical!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Hmph.” Xue Ying looked at Eternal Night Primogenitor with a sneer. “Hua”, he simply dissipated this avatar of his silently.
“What!” At the same time when Eternal Night Primogenitor acted, he had already planned on influencing the soul of this avatar standing before him and to seal it as quickly as he could! But Xue Ying was a Dao of Mirage expert! Furthermore, his soul had been nourished by a droplet of ‘Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother’. Even though Eternal Night Primogenitor was relatively good the soul aspect, it was only at the level-two Cosmos God standard. If Xue Ying chose to dissipate his body, Eternal Night Primogenitor could not do anything about it.
The reason why he chose to dissipate his soul and not self-detonate was to prevent the shockwaves from causing collateral damage on the innocent beings living in this city.
“Almost!”
With his hands extended, Eternal Night Primogenitor could only watch as that black-robed young man dissipate his soul before him. This incensed him greatly.
If he sealed the soul of the other party, he could at least thoroughly examine his soul and understand who this enemy of his was. Yet after suffering from huge losses, he did not even unravel the true face of the enemy!
“Damn, damn!”
Eternal Night Primogenitor roared out angrily.
“Hong-”
A frightening golden light abruptly blasted out in all directions with him at the center. The two Primal Chaos cultivators who were responsible for guarding the place widened their eyes in despair. Under the illumination from the golden light, they directly dispersed. This palace hall, this residence, and that odd ugly tree simply evaporated under the golden light. In a blink of an eye, as the golden light spread out, it enveloped the entire city, causing it to evaporate too.
“No!” Many cultivators within the city watched in despair as the golden light swept across them.
“I’m finally free.” Some cultivators were apathetic about it.
More importantly, they did not have time to react. After being swept across by the golden light, they dissipated.
The golden light affected a huge region and into the sky.
This enormous golden light was incomparably dazzling!
And at this moment, every Cosmos God in the Realm Heart Great Land was paying notice to this frightening fluctuation.
“What is going on? Why did Eternal Night Primogenitor become so mad that he destroyed a city filled with numerous beings?”
“What is he doing?”
“He is the only one there. I don’t see anybody else fighting with him?”
There were several experts including unparalleled existences who were paying notice to this affair. But they only became more confused. Even ‘Limitless City Master’ who lamented about the loss of lives frowned. He had no choice. He was stronger than Eternal Night Primogenitor by a limit; he merely had the upper hand. Even if they fought, it would require time and that battle would affect more innocent!
“He chose to bury so many other beings because he is angry?” Limitless City Master shook his head slightly, “Ai, currently, among the unparalleled existences in Realm Heart Great Land, only Emperor Summer and Undying Underworld Emperor could possibly suppress Eternal Night Primogenitor. Undying Underworld Emperor is vicious so he is too lazy to care about such matters. Emperor Summer only focuses on cultivation and treats the weak as ants.”
Undying Underworld Emperor.
Before the First War of the Ancient Nations, he was loosely ranked first in the Realm Heart Great Land. Furthermore, he utilized his strength to suppress various powers to gather the benefits from them. Soon, he chose to leave the Realm Heart Great Land in search of breaking through to become a ‘Chaotic Origin Expert’. Over the long years, he had finally returned. Even though he did not succeed, he still remained stronger than Eternal Night Primogenitor by an entire level.
And Emperor Summer was ranked first in the Realm Heart Great Land before ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ returned. When he battled with Eternal Night Primogenitor in the Realm Heart God Palace, it ended up with the other party fleeing with grievous injuries.
Hence, only these two were qualified to teach Eternal Night Primogenitor a lesson!
…
Outside the Heavy Wind Nation, Xue Ying executed the Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to see what was happening. Watching the scene of Eternal Night Primogenitor becoming mad and destroying the entire city, causing countless beings to dissipate, Xue Ying could not help but feel his heart shaking.
“Since Eternal Night Primogenitor can’t deal against me, he chose to implicate the innocent?” Xue Ying gritted his teeth.
“Weng.”
The golden light soon evanesced.
There was an enormous gouge ten times bigger than the original city. At the center of this gouge floated Eternal Night Primogenitor with his black cape billowing in the wind. His pair of eyes were burning with fury as he swept around the place.
Eternal Night Primogenitor gritted his teeth and enunciated every single word: “I don’t care who are you! But since you dared to touch the bones of I, Eternal Wind, I’ll let you know the price of doing so! Just wait and see! You can’t hide for long!”
His voice shook the world.
Everyone could sense the killing intent and fury in the words spouted by Eternal Night Primogenitor.
Following that, Eternal Night Primogenitor disappeared from the place. When he left here, there was just a cold enormous gouge with no living beings left behind.
…
Xue Ying could feel the killing intent in the words spouted by Eternal Night Primogenitor but he did not place it in his eyes. Instead, Xue Ying was staring at the vast and deep gouge. He felt both frustrated and helpless. He originally wanted to free others from the nightmare they were experiencing, yet it ended up like this.
He had seen too much.
Even as he grew stronger, Xue Ying still remained helpless. Even unparalleled existences could not do anything about the actions of other unparalleled existences.
‘If there is a day that I can formulate the Supreme Law, I’ll definitely draw up a ‘Punishment of the Heavens’ down on all who sinned!’ Xue Ying began having thoughts of that at this moment.
The world consisted of myriad existences. Everything was in an equilibrium.
He couldn’t possibly allow experts to wilfully bring calamity on the innocent. He had to reinforce the law with limitations.
‘I am thinking too far ahead.’
Xue Ying softly shook his head.
Maybe those on the level of Yuan and Luo City Lord could control the Origin World to draw down this law.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying transformed into a white-robed young man.
The 19 cities marred in a nightmare he discovered this time were mainly caused by Black Sovereign King and Heaven Ancient Union Master. Furthermore, it involved Eternal Night Primogenitor! Xue Ying felt that such a huge disturbance could not possibly be limited to just 19 cities.
He had to continue his investigation!
Of course, during this process of investigation and battles, experiencing danger would temper cultivators too. Currently, he had fused eight branches together and was just one single step away from reaching the final realm. By traveling more often and experiencing more battles, it could possibly be more helpful to his cultivation. He also had other avatars that were in closed-door cultivation, fully focusing on advancing towards the peak.
******
At the same time when Xue Ying walked surreptitiously across the Realm Heart Great Land in search of other secrets…
The madness of Eternal Night Primogenitor had incurred the attention of many Cosmos Gods across the Realm Heart Great Land. Furthermore, they soon received a piece of news.
Black Sovereign King died!
When Black Sovereign King died, his incarnations that were scattered in various locations responsible for handling miscellaneous tasks dissipated too. Hence, this matter could not be hidden from the public.
Furthermore, the battle between Black Sovereign King and the black-robed young man could be easily investigated because there were numerous witnesses who spectated that battle.
“Black Sovereign King died? He was killed by a mysterious Dao of Void expert, which was why Eternal Night Primogenitor became mad?”
According to the clues, the experts in Realm Heart Great Land were able to deduce it soon. Furthermore, Eternal Night Primogenitor did not deny the circulating news either. Maybe Eternal Night Primogenitor was thinking of relying on this to identify the enemy.
“Who was he killed by?”
“Black Sovereign King is a Paragon Master! How could he be killed? Even Eternal Night Primogenitor did not have sufficient time to save him?”
The entire Realm Heart Great Land shook.
Discussions were started everywhere. Some of the devil gathering places like ‘Black Devil Great Lake’ was filled with sighs of admiration-the strongest of the devils were only at the Paragon Master level. For this frightening expert to dare challenge Eternal Night Primogenitor and to kill off ‘Black Sovereign King’ directly, he was definitely worthy of their admiration.
“Who is it?”
“Who acted and killed him?”
There were plenty of guesses.
And the majority felt that it could possibly be an unparalleled existence.
…
Only the three unparalleled existences in Summer Wind Ancient Nation and Sky-Rending Great Paragon had more accurate guesses.
“This brat is actually this powerful? After acquiring the Void Fire Lotus Flower, he actually succeeded in killing Black Sovereign King?” Emperor Summer was slightly astonished. Things had progressed in a way out of his expectations. He thought that Xue Ying would become slightly stronger amongst Paragon Master after obtaining the Void Fire Lotus Flower. He did not feel that Xue Ying was comparable to Great Paragon Fuyi.
Those at the level of Great Paragon Fuyi did not reach their level just with a single powerful top-graded secret treasure. Instead, they had to be fundamentally powerful.
How could he know that Xue Ying had comprehended the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>? Even without owning a top-graded secret treasure, every avatar of his could still unleash a power in the final realm.
“After acquiring the Void Fire Lotus Flower, he even requested for Sky-Rending to keep it a secret. Who would have thought that he’d acted so quickly.” Ancestor Fan clicked his tongue after receiving the news.
And on Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
Sky-Rending Great Paragon was even more direct. He stepped through the void and traveled down to the enormous Burning Heart God Tree.
Beneath the Burning Heart God Tree, there was a white-robed young man. He was one of Xue Ying’s avatar.
“Younger Brother Flying Snow.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon sighed with lament, “Admirable. Truly admirable for you to actually succeed in killing Black Sovereign King.”
The white-robed young man who sat cross-legged slowly opened his eyes. He revealed a grin: “It ought to be!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1160 - Slaughtering Devils
chapters.content:
Chapter 1160: Slaughtering Devils
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Sky-Rending Great Paragon softly nodded. He laughed: “I can understand your reason for killing Black Sovereign King. But why are you risking your life just to save the commoners in the remaining cities? Even though there are trillions of them, compared to the population in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, it is quite a pitiful number. As long as it doesn’t affect the reproduction and multiplication of creatures in the world, there is no need to put your life at risk like this time. Even after killing Black Sovereign King, you chose to save them and risked your life being captured by Eternal Night Primogenitor. Fortunately, your avatar dissipated quick enough. Otherwise, once you were captured, your identity would be revealed. Are you confident of keeping the ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’ with you once you enter a direct conflict with Eternal Night Primogenitor?”
Surviving and preserving the weapon were two different concepts.
Reaching the level of Xue Ying, unparalleled existences could not kill him when he concealed nine avatars in other Origin Worlds.
But the avatar carrying the weapon was the most important. Once it was killed and the treasure was taken, he would become greatly weakened!
Hence…
Even though ‘Southern Cloud King’ was powerful, he still remained in the capital to maintain his most powerful state! If he chose to leave the capital, without the augmentation from the capital, he would become greatly weakened.
“Slightly confident.” Xue Ying chuckled. He was quite humble.
“Oh?” Sky-Rending Great Paragon looked at Xue Ying. He felt rueful in his heart as he actually watched the development of ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying’! From the identity as an Honored Guest at the Primal Chaos Realm participating in the Competition between the Three Clans in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, Xue Ying had grown so much that he could kill a Paragon Master, ‘Black Sovereign King’, in a short period of time. Currently, he should have the confidence of surviving before unparalleled existences. His strength should have reached the level of he, Sky-Rending and Fuy.
And the number of experts at this level did not surpass the numbers counted with two hands in the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
“Don’t become overly confident.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon still reminded him, “Unparalleled existences rely on supreme-graded secret treasures to unleash power at the supreme level. Even if you are stronger, your avatars could still be killed if the enemy could target your flaws, causing you to lose your treasures. Hence, it is better to remain prudent! It isn’t worth risking your life for the sake of civilians living in some small cities.
“Those cities aren’t worth mentioning when speaking about the Realm Heart Great Land as a whole.” Xue Ying answered, “But to the civilians living in those cities, their deaths meant an end to their life. It doesn’t matter much even if the world is bigger.”
“The path of cultivation.” Xue Ying continued, “Is all about tempering oneself between life and death. So what if I die? The Realm Heart Great Land is endless, and it is impossible for me to take care of the countless deaths happening every single moment. But what happened earlier with the 19 cities… where a one-off large-scale massacre event resulted in the death of trillions of beings would no longer be a tempering for the cultivators in the path of cultivation. Instead, it is a sin! Experts were once weak. When they were weak, they would still fall if they met an expert who chose to slaughter them. Once they became stronger, they would treat the weak as ants. They would not blink their eyes even after killing a trillion beings. Such cultivators were no longer orthodox. Instead, they have turned into devils.”
“And devils must be killed.” Xue Ying coldly stated.
Sky-Rending Great Paragon was slightly stunned.
He could feel that unshakable iron will that was as sharp as a blade! To kill all devils!
Many experts like Sky-Rending Great Paragon did not really care about the weak. But they would not wilfully massacre the weak. Nonetheless, hearing the firm declaration by Xue Ying made his heart palpitate slightly.
“Do you know you would offend many experts if you chose to proceed down this path?” Sky-Rending Great Paragon replied.
“It is just that I am not too willing to see large-scale massacres. And I’ll only offend some devils. Naturally, I am currently too weak. If I had reached the level of ‘Yuan’, I would have already redefined the laws in the Realm Heart Great Land.” Xue Ying said. With great power comes great responsibility.
When he was weak, he could tolerate and watch as things happen. But as he gradually grew stronger, he would naturally want to change the way things work. Reaching where he currently stood, there were still quite many who were stronger than Xue Ying in Realm Heart Great Land. He could only say-he was confident of surviving before any unparalleled existences!
And since he was confident of protecting himself, he would naturally begin initializing some of his plans.
My Heart as the World. Once his Dao Heart was fixed, nobody could shake it!
“Then you must be careful.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon sighed.
“Rest assured. I am not foolish.” Xue Ying chuckled.
Sky-Rending Great Paragon slightly nodded. Looking at this white-robed young man before him, he could vaguely guess that in the near future, this white-robed young man would incur a large round of ‘slaughtering of devils’ in the Realm Heart Great Land. He really wondered where this absolute genius from the Southern Cloud Nation would reach!
…
After killing Black Sovereign King and saving those cities.
Xue Ying brought along the main avatar that had the Void Fire Lotus Flower and continued traveling. This terrifying power could actually dispatch Heaven Ancient Union Master and Black Sovereign King. Those were experts from two drastically different sects. Hence, Xue Ying felt that the one controlling the strings behind should be very powerful. It’s just that no matter how he searched, he could not find any clues at all. Hence, Xue Ying chose to rely on the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion’s intelligence network.
Whenever a large-scale massacre or large-scale man-made disaster happened, Xue Ying ordered for the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion to pay notice to it and inform him at the first instance.
Being one of the top ten great religions in Realm Heart Great Land, the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion had permeated deeply across the Realm Heart Great Land. Hence, their way of intelligence collection was much more formidable than what he could achieve alone.
Shortly after giving the orders.
On the next day, a piece of intelligence came from the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.
“Dust Brahman King, when he first ruled a nation, he set down a statute stating that all civilians of the Dust Brahman Nation that did not become a Deity within 20 years of birth would be captured alive and sent to the ‘Dark Prison’. Civilians who do not become World Deities in 10,000 years would be captured alive and sent to the Dark Prison too! In the Dark Prison, only those who are outstanding would be let out. Few could ever come out from the Dark Prison alive. And according to what the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion knows, practically 99% of those sent to the Dark Prison were killed.
