The Dust Brahman King deliberately left behind a few fortunate survivors so as to force them and fight. Only the absolute minority that was outstanding would be released! This point was made to show the civilians that those who were outstanding had the chance of surviving in Dust Brahman Nation.”
The information was detailed.
As Xue Ying read through it, his expression became cold.
Humans that were born in Realm Heart Great Land were Transcendents! There were many who could become Deities within ’20 years’. But at the same time, close to half failed to do so as well.
As for the legislation stating ‘those who did not become World Deities in 10,000 years’, would see many more civilians being captured alive.
These two statutes…
Practically sent close to half of the newborns to be sent into the Dark Prison!
A nation actually sent half its civilians to the Dark Prison? And almost all of them were killed?
“Powerful clans have powerful bloodlines. Hence, disciples from these clans could easily achieve the ‘10,000 years World Deity’ legislation. This cruel law could not threaten the bigger clans. Instead, the weak could not resist. And that bit of hope where the civilians could possibly be released from the Dark Prison…” Xue Ying felt his killing intent soaring.
Such matters could be concealed from those of the lower level.
But the most apex Cosmos Gods in Realm Heart Great Land still knew about it.
“Dust Brahman King is an Honored Guest of one of the five ancestors in Myriad Realm Ancient Nation, ‘World Extermination God-Emperor’. Dust Brahman Nation also practically obeys the order of World Extermination God-Emperor.” Xue Ying could see this point and understood why the experts did not care about it.
Such matters were actually quite common.
For instance, in one of the four Black Devil Four Nations, ‘Fiery Zhao Nation’, that was the backyard of the Black Devil Great Lake. Once the time period was up, a Blood Sacrifice would ensue! And Black Devil Great Lake properly controlled the frequency of the Blood Sacrifice to prevent the goose that lay eggs from being killed!
But as the one leading the Black Devil Great Lake was ‘Yama Religion Master’, an existence that unparalleled existences could not kill, everyone was helpless about it too.
Hence…
Those who dared commit such acts were either existences that unparalleled existences could not kill or that they had huge backings that were tough and low-profile.
“Dust Brahman Nation.” Xue Ying felt the killing intent soaring in his heart. His eyes were cold.
“Peng.”
The cup in his hand smashed down on the table, frightening many of the attendants by the side.
“I require the most detailed information on Dust Brahman King and on the Dark Prison.” Xue Ying ordered. He had some understanding of the Dust Brahman King. But before acting, it was better for him to understand more.
The Southern Cloud Sacred Religion intelligence network soon passed down the latest and most detailed intelligence.
Xue Ying rapidly read through it. The more he read, the more incensed he got!
He even looked up and executed the Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to observe that ‘Dark Prison’ in the Dust Brahman Nation. The Southern Cloud Sacred Religion intelligence network did not lie. Furthermore, the way they phrased the report was relatively mild. This Dark Prison was even more bloody and cruel.
“Dust Brahman King.” Xue Ying stood.
The attendants immediately came forward.
Xue Ying soon placed down the money for the dishes before leaving.
And the attendants were slightly bewildered as they sent that white-robed young man who emitted a Unity Realm aura with their eyes. They did not know that very soon, a Cosmos God would fall!

chapters.title: Chapter 1161 - Unbounded Illusory Bubble Dissipation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1161: Unbounded Illusory Bubble Dissipation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Dust Brahman Nation, Dark Prison.
“Teacher, another batch of inferior civilians has been sent over.” An old man respectfully bowed. He looked with slight reverence at the white-robed middle-aged man seated cross-legged on a warm stone bed before him.
Almost all the higher-ups in Dust Brahman Nation dreaded this king.
They had no choice. The king was a level-two Cosmos God! Almost nobody in the Dust Brahman Nation could resist. All of them could only obediently listen to his orders.
“Oh?” Dust Brahman King opened his eyes and spoke nonchalantly, “Are you able to collect enough for a bottle?”
“Yes, we could.” The old man mentioned with a slight tremble.
“Then go do it!” Dust Brahman King indifferently said.
“Yes.”
The old man obediently left.
Dust Brahman King coldly laughed. He disdained those foolish devils. As devils, most of them required countless living beings to be used as their cultivation nourishment and hence would require many civilians to be killed. That would eventually incur the notice of some powerful Cosmos Gods.
“Unlike me who governs a nation and relies on the statute of the nation to reap the lives of many. At least I’ll be able to reduce any bad influence to the lowest. Furthermore, by following behind World Extermination God-Emperor… my life is so much more casual than those devils.” Dust Brahman King was relatively contented with his current stance.
…
That old man came to one of the levels in the Dark Prison. The entire Dark Prison was actually a huge cavern-dwelling. Every level was incomparably huge, with many weak little civilians being locked within.
The old man glanced over. The civilians on this level were those who failed to become Deities within 20 years and were very young. It had been just slightly longer than 20 years since they were born. This age… was really just the start to the entire population in Realm Heart Great Land.
“So powerful.”
“Is it an expert sent over by the King?”
“Is he planning on guiding us, tempering us before selecting the most outstanding amongst us?” These young fellows saw the descending old man. The old man was a Primal Chaos expert, and the aura he emitted felt as vast as the sky and the seas to these Transcendents who had not reached the Deity Realm. They felt jittery and terror. At the same time, they were looking forward to what would happen.
They hoped they would become the most outstanding few and survive.
‘Really pitiful. They do not know that they are all going to be killed this time.’ The old man shook his head inwardly. The King would only occasionally leave behind a batch so as to temper them in between life and death and allow the misconception to spread out to the world that it was the same for every batch.
99% of the civilians did not have the chance to struggle. They were simply killed!
“Who made you so weak?” Being a trusted disciple of the King, the old man was used to such bloody matters. He was ruthless. Only by performing beautifully would the King favor him and give him more favors.
The old man took out a crimson bottle.
“What is this senior planning to do?”
“What is that bottle?”
Many young fellows were looking vigilantly as that old man took out a seemingly extraordinary crimson bottle.
At this moment, they did not understand what that represented!
“The Dust Brahman King has a total of three executioners that he favors. You should be one of them.” A voice suddenly sounded in the mind of the old man. That old man widened his eyes as he felt an illusory finger extending from the void to tap on his body. The old man immediately dissipated away like dust. He died just there and then. Even the crimson bottle fell onto the ground.
…
At another location.
Xue Ying arrived at the Dark Prison and landed before the Dust Brahman King.
“Who are you?” Dust Brahman King’s expression shifted as he saw this white-robed stranger appearing before him.
This white-robed young man had just executed the Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique! His aura felt unfamiliar and only at the Primal Chaos Realm.
“What audacity! For you to dare intrude in my territory?” The expression of Dust Brahman King sunk. At that moment, a piece of musical composition faintly sounded in the surroundings. The music also reached the ears of Xue Ying. But being a level-two Cosmos God in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, his soul was ultimately stronger than even peak Cosmos Gods. Why would Xue Ying care about such a puny technique?
“Mn?” Dust Brahman King was startled. A Primal Chaos Cultivator actually resisted his move?
“Dust Brahman King. As the ruler of this nation, you wiped out half of every newborn civilian. And now, with so much blood stained on your hands, do you feel nothing at all?” Xue Ying asked.
Even if one killed so many ants, he would feel his heart shivering right?
Dust Brahman King chuckled: “Of course I feel something. This Dao Friend, on the path of cultivation, those ants are my stepping stones. They allow me to walk further in my cultivation. It is a meaningful death they have and I regard them highly-I am even grateful to them! Without them, how could I have walked thus far in my path of cultivation? Dao has many forms, and this Dao Friend should understand that too.”
“In my Dao, you are like this. A devil.” Xue Ying uttered.
At the same time, with a thought.
He simply killed one of the three executioners in the Dark Prison! According to the intelligence report provided by the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion, Xue Ying understood that there were three executioners. And Xue Ying could see with a ‘glance’ the terrifying karmic sin emanated by the three of them.
“And devils must be killed.” Xue Ying acted.
“Hua, hua, hua…”
Nine white-robed young men appeared at the same time tapping out at different locations.
Dust Brahman King discovered with shock that the surrounding space had become chaotic. Many bubbles started forming in this little palace hall, and every bubble was situated in a different space. As the nine Xue Yings tapped their fingers again, the bubbles started popping consecutively. It brought about a chain of reactions, bringing a multiplying effect on the strength of destruction and the region of destruction. Eventually, all the force converged on the body of ‘Dust Brahman King’ with a final explosion.
“Pa!”
The final bubble wrapped around the space where Dust Brahman King was. With the multitude of simultaneous bubbles converging, it created the final bubble that soon popped too.
Saying it was slow, but everything happened in an instance!
Dust Brahman King only had sufficient time to slap out his palm a single time, yet he failed to break the biggest bubble which wrapped around him. Eventually, the big bubble exploded.
And Dust Brahman King followed suit in the destruction.
His body was wiped, turning into grayish dust.
Dust Brahman King, died!
<Flying Snow Combat Technique>, one of the three killing techniques, the ‘Unbounded Illusory Bubble Dissipation’.
It seemed like an insipid killing technique, yet in actual fact, this technique could disregard all external defenses. It could directly transmit the entire force into the body of the target and was the most terrifying killing technique Xue Ying owned currently. But as Xue Ying was currently dealing against a level-two Cosmos God who did not own a top-graded secret treasure, there was no need to use the ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’. Each of his nine great avatars had a final realm combat strength. With the nine executing a killing technique simultaneously, the resulting attack was sufficient to kill a level-two Cosmos God. If he were to use the Void Fire Lotus Flower, most Paragon Masters could not survive either.
“Karma. It isn’t true that karma would not bite back at you. Instead, it is because the period isn’t up yet. Once it is time, it’ll be the moment you die.” Xue Ying coldly stared. Since he was sufficiently strong, it was time for him to make some changes to the world.
…
Dust Brahman King, died.
It was still a mystery who killed him! The Cosmos Gods that stood at the top of the Realm Heart Great Land were puzzled too. This was a level-two Cosmos God yet he was gone just like this?
Even though various superpowers tried seeking the perpetrator using means like time reversal, they still failed! Once the time was reversed to the particular point where the actual incident happened, it would be distorted, preventing any others from viewing it.
Along with the death of the three most capable executioners of ‘Dust Brahman King’ and the king himself, the Dark Prison immediately dissipated, freeing all the civilians from within. Even though there were other experts who were relatively vicious within the Dust Brahman Nation too, they dared not follow in the footsteps of Dust Brahman King! Those who dared had to be powerful enough.
And even with the strength of Dust Brahman King, did he not throw his life in the end?
And the Dust Brahman Nation had undergone a huge transformation ever since! It even attracted the covet of some Cosmos Gods since this was ultimately a tier-two nation and the original experts living within were not qualified to govern the Dust Brahman Nation.
…
This piece of news also reached one of the five ancestors from the Myriad Realm Ancient Nation, ‘World Extermination God-Emperor’.
“Your Majesty God-Emperor, Dust Brahman King has died. We aren’t able to discover who the murderer is. Nobody is able to view that particular scene that happened in the past.” Some subordinates respectfully stated.
World Extermination God-Emperor was seated on his throne.
He wore a full-bodied armor that was entirely black in color. His body was built like a mountain. Currently, he sat there on his throne looking downwards. In terms of tyranny, World Extermination God-Emperor was famous for being the most overbearing one in the entire Realm Heart Great Land! And also the strongest in this aspect! His cultivation path gave him the qualification to be so.
“Oh? Interesting. Continue investigating. Even though he is merely an honored guest of mine, we must still find out who was the one that committed the act.” World Extermination God-Emperor casually answered.
“Yes.” His subordinate respectfully acknowledged.
Suddenly-
A figure condensed by his side. It was a silver-robed old man who gave off a warm and gentle personality.
“Drifter?” The subordinate by the side was startled when he saw that. This silver-robed old man was one of the five ancestors, ‘Drifter’. He was a transcendental existence.
World Extermination God-Emperor waved his hand, causing his subordinate to retreat and leave.
World Extermination God-Emperor looked down at the silver-robed old man with a smile: “Why did you come to my place?”
“World Extermination, I need some Chaotic Origin Sand.” Drifter mentioned, “Sell them to me.”
“Haha… you should be the one with the most Chaotic Origin Sand amongst the five of us right? Even if you lack a little Chaotic Origin Sand, you should be able to collect them after some time. Why are you here seeking me to purchase Chaotic Origin Sand?” World Extermination God-Emperor asked curiously.
Drifter softly shook his head: “I have some need for them. You don’t have to ask why.”
“Alright, since you need them, I’ll sell them to you.” World Extermination God-Emperor nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1162 - All Chaotic Origin Sand Gathered
chapters.content:
Chapter 1162: All Chaotic Origin Sand Gathered
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As World Extermination God-Emperor and the other unparalleled existences tried but failed to trace down who the ‘murderer’ was, Southern Cloud King received a piece of news.
Within the Southern Cloud Nation, in the royal palace.
“Master.” An old servant respectfully greeted, “This old slave has something to report.”
“Speak your mind.” Southern Cloud King sat cross-legged looking at the servant before him. This servant before him was the Magic Servant ‘Pei Yun’. He was absolutely loyal. This magic servant was also in charge of the intelligence system the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion had! Some of the lower valued information in Southern Cloud Sacred Religion could be handled by other cultivators, but those that were extremely important were usually taken charge by some magic servants and treasure spirits.
Because they were absolutely loyal and would not leak out any pieces of news.
Magic Servant Pei Yun respectfully said: “Master, I suspect that the mysterious murderer who killed Dust Brahman King is Monarch Flying Snow.”
“What?” Southern Cloud King was startled.
This was an expert who had attracted the attention of many experts in Realm Heart Great Land, yet none could trace him down. Even though the intelligence network of his Realm Heart Great Land was formidable, it could not be ranked in the top ten when compared to many other intelligence networks across the entire Southern Cloud Sacred Religion. Yet it was able to discover who the perpetrator was?
“Elaborate now! What is the reason that gave you the assurance Xue Ying was the one that did it?” Southern Cloud King hurriedly asked, “Xue Ying should not have any enmity with that Dust Brahman King.”
“Reporting to Master, Monarch Flying Snow employed our Southern Cloud Sacred Religion intelligence network to collect all information regarding large-scale massacre and large-scale disasters. Any events we discover have to be reported to him. I’ve sent the relevant information over, and just yesterday, I even passed a set of detailed information regarding ‘Dust Brahman King’ and ‘Dark Prison’ over to Monarch Flying Snow.” Magic Servant Pei Yun said.
Southern Cloud King was carefully listening. He felt his heart tightening as he listened.
“Monarch Flying Snow has immediately ordered after receiving this piece of information, that he requires everything related to the Dust Brahman King and the Dark Prison. I even took the initiative to collect them and send them over. But not even an hour later, Dust Brahman King died. He died in the Dark Prison! And the three executioners of the Dark Prison died along with him.” Magic Servant Pei Yun said, “That was too coincidental. Hence, I suspect that Monarch Flying Snow is the one who killed Dust Brahman King. Naturally, this is just my guess.”
Southern Cloud King softly nodded. He ordered: “Pass me all the intelligence which you have on Xue Ying over to me.”
“Yes.” Magic Servant Pei Yun respectfully acknowledged.
The Southern Cloud Sacred Religion intelligence network…
Because it was controlled by magic servants and treasure spirits at the core, Xue Ying wasn’t afraid that he would be revealed after giving the orders.
But these magic servants and treasure spirits were loyal to the Southern Cloud King!
“Xue Ying was the one who did it?” Southern Cloud King did not dare believe it.
He killed the other party so cleanly.
He did not leave behind any traces, and even unparalleled existences could not find out who did it.
That Dust Brahman King who died had not called for help at all! He did not leak out the identity of this murderer. Everything pointed to the fact that it was an extremely powerful existence who killed Dust Brahman King.
‘Xue Ying has fallen so greatly in the Realm Heart God Palace yet he could still reach this level?’ Southern Cloud King pondered.
Very soon.
Large amounts of intelligence related to Xue Ying reached Southern Cloud King.
“Mn?” Southern Cloud King carefully read through them. These pieces of information were quite trivial, though it was the most of what the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion intelligence network could collect.
‘Why did he collect information on those devils and disasters?’ Southern Cloud King felt puzzled.
******
Xue Ying was currently at a small, remote city in Lotus Jasper Nation enjoying the good, unique wine from the pubs. For one to survive by ‘selling wine’ to cultivators, the wine was naturally special! It was even more extraordinary since the wine had spread its reputation far and away.
“Awesome! This is absolutely awesome!”
Xue Ying gulped like a cow. The wine had an insipid green color. As he drank, Xue Ying felt extremely comfortable. It made him want to drink even more!
This wine was appropriate for drinking in big gulps.
“Good wine. Good wine! It has been a while since I last had such good wine.” Xue Ying felt delighted, “Give me more wine.”
A female attendant immediately rushed over, “Sir, how much more do you want?”
“How much does your pub have?” Xue Ying asked.
“This is unique ‘Qu Clan Wine’ that the owner of our pub brewed. It isn’t too hard to brew them, just that it requires a long time. Hence, we do not store much of this wine at our pub. But the clan should have kept a huge amount of them.” The female attendant smiled.
Xue Ying mentioned: “Give me 10% of what your clan has in storage.”
“10%?” The female attendant was frightened by the amount.
There were guests by the side who heard that. One even chuckled: “This brother, the Qu Clan Wine is relatively famous in our Lotus Jasper Nation. Their Qu Clan specializes in selling wine, so they have stored an enormous amount of wine.”
Xue Ying glanced at the female attendant: “Hurry up and bring me the wine.”
One could not blame Xue Ying for asking for so much wine. The life of a cultivator was long, and Xue Ying could not have enough of this wine. To most cultivators, buying wine was considered quite extravagant. But to Xue Ying, he did not care about the price when purchasing any good wine. He even killed Black Sovereign King and Dust Brahman King recently, earning back what he lost at the Realm Heart God Palace. Xue Ying even earned way beyond what he had in the past.
The owner of the pub was incredibly startled. He began negotiating the price with Xue Ying suspiciously. What made the pub owner dumbstruck was that this enormous business had been completed quite quickly.
10% of what the Qu Clan stored was taken away by Xue Ying, and the price reached an enormous amount of 600,000 cosmos crystals! But it was just a pittance to Xue Ying.
…
After buying the good wine he liked, Xue Ying sat on the peak of a remote mountain looking as the cloud moved. He began gulping down the wine in the bottle gourd which he just got.
“Truly enjoyable. This is the best wine I have ever experienced in my life which is meant for drinking in large amounts.” Xue Ying felt his soul shaking from the delight. He had drunk before many different kinds of good wine. Some were fine and delicate, while some were extremely expensive-a single flask costing beyond 600,000 cosmos crystals. Compared to those, the Qu Clan Wine was extremely cheap.
It might be considered extravagant to many cultivators, but this was a pittance to Cosmos Gods.
And Xue Ying liked it a lot.
As he drank, different profound mysteries from the Dao of Void were being corroborated in his mind too. When he was feeling happy, Xue Ying gained even more enlightenment and inspiration as he comprehended.
He sat on the mountain top for ten over days drinking, and was also lost in thoughts for ten over days. Only after that did he continue his journey across the world.
After receiving the wine he liked, he soon received another piece of good news.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying, the Chaotic Origin Sand you need is gathered.” A voice sounded directly by Xue Ying’s ears.
And that Xue Ying who held a wine bottle gourd walking in a sway, suddenly quivered. Following that, he suddenly disappeared from the vicinity, startling many other cultivators. A drunkard disappeared all of a sudden?
******
Summer Wind Ancient Nation, within the royal palace.
Xue Ying went to meet Emperor Summer. Emperor Summer sat there looking at Xue Ying with a different view currently.
For Xue Ying to succeed in killing ‘Black Sovereign King’ within a short moment, this strength was something even unparalleled existences had to pay attention to.
“Greetings, Your Majesty Emperor Summer.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“The 50,000 kilograms of Chaotic Origin Sand you require.” Emperor Summer threw over a storage wristband.
Xue Ying recieved it.
With a check.
He could see all sorts of strange black sand that was glittering within. Every piece of sand was extremely fine just like the sand on the beach. But as one examined one grain of sand, they would feel how much charm it had implicitly-it was even more beautiful than any gemstones. When unparalleled existences were gathering the Chaotic Origin Essence, they would usually discover a small amount of Chaotic Origin Sand. Even though they were ignorant of how to make use of it, they understood that this was a treasure.
Emperor Summer forked out a huge price for the sake of collecting 50,000 kilograms of it.
The entire Summer Wind Ancient Nation had merely gathered about 25,000 kilograms of Chaotic Origin Sand over the long periods. Hence, Emperor Summer was forced to find another Dao of Void unparalleled existence in the Realm Heart Great Land, ‘Drifter’. Drifter himself had collected just over 15,000 kilograms of Chaotic Origin Sand! Second only to Emperor Summer. Both Emperor Summer and ‘Drifter’ had quite an alright relationship. Hence, through Drifter, Emperor Summer was able to purchase the Chaotic Origin Sand from other unparalleled existences in the Myriad Realm Ancient Nation, and that was how he could gather the required amount.
If Emperor Summer were to be the one purchasing it from them, he would most likely be slaughtered figuratively.
Good. Emperor Summer is indeed formidable for you to collect everything in such a short period.” Xue Ying chuckled. He might seem calm on the surface, yet his heart was beating faster.
He desired to own that weapon the most!
The weapon which was most appropriate to be used in conjunction with the supreme secret impartation technique <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>. All the main materials required to refine it had been collected. Even though the remaining supporting materials were quite expensive, the difficulty of collecting them was much lower. The ‘Chaotic Origin Sand’ was different since unparalleled existences had to gather them slowly over a long period. Currently, after collecting this 50,000 kilograms of them, the entire Realm Heart Great Land would no longer have another 50,000 kilograms any longer. To collect this amount, it might take god knows how long!
Since the weapon refinement technique was bestowed by the Realm Heart God Palace, it should be based on the fact that it could be collected on the Realm Heart Great Land.
“What kind of ingenious methods of using the Chaotic Origin Sand did you think of after studying my <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll>? Why are you in such a hurry to require so much Chaotic Origin Sand?” Emperor Summer asked.
“The Chaotic Origin Sand has some auxiliary effect to the utilization of Chaotic Origin Energy. I seek to try it out.” Xue Ying smiled.
“If you are able to research on a technique that made use of the Chaotic Origin Sand, you can sell it to me.” Emperor Summer looked forward to it.
He could not underestimate this Monarch Flying Snow before him.
After all, in terms of realm, unparalleled existences were only at the final realm. And Xue Ying, Great Paragon Fuyi, as well as many other Paragon Masters, had reached the final bottleneck. The gap between their realm was very small. Some Great Paragons had even created unique cultivation techniques that were ingenius in its usage of the profound mysteries, boosting their strength greatly! Emperor Summer similarly desired to have these unique ‘cultivation techniques’.
Because it might inspire him and allow him to deepen his realm. That way, he would have a greater chance of jumping out of this cage.
“If I were to research a method out, I’ll definitely inform Emperor Summer first whenever I planned on selling it.” Xue Ying smiled even more brightly.
…
That day.
Xue Ying left the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Regardless of killing Black Sovereign King or Dust Brahman King, they exemplified one point-unparalleled existences could not trace him back!
Previously, Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan and Emperor Cang had admitted it before.
And after Black Sovereign King died, Eternal Night Primogenitor attempted to trace him down yet to no avail.
And when Dust Brahman King died, World Extermination God-Emperor should have attempted to do so as well.
“Since nobody could find me, I should be relatively safe.” The avatar of Xue Ying which carried the Chaotic Origin Sand temporarily disguised his aura and appearance before returning back to the Summer Wind Capital to stay.
He would temporarily hide here.
Until he got all the materials, that would be when he begins his refinement.
…
Southern Cloud Capital, in the royal palace.
Xue Ying came to the accommodation of his teacher, the Southern Cloud King.
“Teacher, I have a matter which I require your help with.” Xue Ying mentioned.
“Oh? What’s the matter?” Southern Cloud King looked at Xue Ying. He currently had many thoughts in his mind since the intelligence network could practically validate that it was Monarch Flying Snow who killed Dust Brahman King.
Xue Ying waved his hand, causing a scroll to fly over.
“I need all the precious materials recorded on it.” Xue Ying said.
When Southern Cloud King received it, he saw a pile of materials written on it. At that moment, Southern Cloud King frowned. Even though it was quite easy to collect those materials, the total price was quite high-approximately over 100 billion cosmos crystals! This was a huge sum even to Southern Cloud King.
This disciple shouldn’t be requiring them all at this moment right?
“This is a top-graded secret treasure. It should be sufficient to purchase those materials right?” Xue Ying extended his hand, causing a saber kept in a scabbard to appear. The saber was emanating a dark aura.
Southern Cloud King examined this top-graded secret treasure.
He was shocked that his disciple could take out a top-graded secret treasure to pay for the materials. But what made him flabbergasted was the origin of this weapon.
This saber…
Was Black Sovereign King’s weapon!
“Black Sovereign King was also killed by you?” Southern Cloud King looked at Xue Ying with incredible astonishment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1163 - I should do it
chapters.content:
Chapter 1163: I should do it
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Even though Southern Cloud King was informed that Xue Ying was suspected of killing that Dust Brahman King, the thought of ‘Xue Ying killing Black Sovereign King’ had been thrown to the back of his mind the moment it appeared. He was clear how difficult it was to kill a Paragon Master before Eternal Night Primogenitor came to save him!
Black Sovereign King was an existence that Dust Brahman King could not compete with.
Across the entire Realm Heart Great Land, the number of people who could do this, other than the unparalleled existences, could be counted with two hands. Even he, Southern Cloud King, could only achieve it within his capital.
“It is I who killed him.” Xue Ying nodded with a smile. He did not plan on hiding the fact after taking out Black Sovereign King’s weapon.
“You, how did you do it? How could it be possible?” Southern Cloud King did not dare believe it.
“I broke through in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm to level-two Cosmos God Realm. Teacher, you should know how precious it is a level-two Cosmos God Mirage Scripture is.” Xue Ying answered.
After selling it to Emperor Summer and the others, they requested for the news of him reaching level-two Cosmos God Realm in the Mirage to be kept a secret until they finished gathering the Chaotic Origin Sand. That was done to prevent any aftereffects.
“Mirage and Illusory Realm? You broke through?” Southern Cloud King was both stunned and enlightened at the same time, “You sold it to the Summer Wind Ancient Nation?”
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Don’t sell it at such a low cost.” Southern Cloud King reminded, “This scripture is something both Ancestor Fan and Towering Sky King are willing to fork out a huge price to get. Ultimately, this implicates their path of cultivation Dao! Even various ancient nations pay great attention to soul-related scriptures because nobody in the Realm Heart Great Land has a scripture that could guide one to the final realm.”
“Mn, I sold it at quite an appropriate price. Of which I exchanged for the ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’ which is extremely suitable for me. After researching in this weapon for a period, I was able to create some killing moves alongside this top-graded weapon. By relying on one of them, I succeeded in killing the Black Sovereign King.” Xue Ying replied.
Southern Cloud King was both jealous and surprised as he listened.
Void Fire Lotus Flower…
He felt envious listening to it!
But he was clear that the number of top-graded weapons in Realm Heart Great Land that could be used to easily kill Black Sovereign King was pitiful.
“Xue Ying, I wouldn’t have thought that you could grow so fast. I bet your strength is most likely beyond mine now.” Southern Cloud King stared at the saber emitted a dark aura, “This weapon is extremely famous. There is almost none who is willing to exchange a top-graded weapon for cosmos crystals! If we were to value this weapon of Black Sovereign King, then it should be around 300 billion cosmos crystals! Those materials you require cost approximately 170 billion cosmos crystals, leaving behind quite a lot of change! What else do you need? If you don’t want anything, I can simply pay you with the cosmos crystals.”
Southern Cloud King wasn’t willing to take such a huge advantage over his disciple.
“Teacher, that time you bestowed me the Devil Emperor Gown without asking for anything.” Xue Ying answered.
“That was a fair exchange in accordance with your help in protecting my Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.” Southern Cloud King chuckled, “Alright. Everyone knows that the most wealthy Paragon Master in the entire Realm Heart Great Land is your teacher. I do not want to take advantage of this bit of benefits. To me, 300 billion cosmos crystals aren’t sufficient in purchasing such a secret treasure at all.”
Xue Ying pondered momentarily before taking out another scroll. At that moment, many words started floating on the scroll. Xue Ying was recording down a large number of materials that he needed.
“These materials require approximately 100 billion cosmos crystals.” Xue Ying passed over the new scroll to his teacher, “It shall be enough for Teacher to help me gather them. Also, that weapon of Black Sovereign King must not be publicized temporarily. Otherwise, many others might suspect that Teacher or I was the murderer.”
If Southern Cloud King dared to publicize this saber, it would incur a lot of suspicions from all over the place. Because he, Southern Cloud King, and Xue Ying were both level-two Cosmos God experts in the Dao of Void.
“Alright. Then I shall take this little advantage over you. As for the saber? Haha, I am not in a rush. I believe that there will definitely be an opportunity for me in the future to use it in exchange for some benefits I need. As for you, Xue Ying, it is quite impossible to hide your strength once you become strong. You will ultimately have to reveal your strength to the world.” Southern Cloud King turned to Xue Ying, “By then, Eternal Night Primogenitor will know about it. What are your plans? You should understand that with the temper of Eternal Night Primogenitor, you have given him a tight slap on his face. He’ll definitely not let you off so easily.”
“Let him be.” Xue Ying indifferently replied.
Southern Cloud King saw this and asked: “Are you confident of fighting against him?”
Since Xue Ying could easily kill Black Sovereign King, he should be confident of surviving before unparalleled existences.
“I am confident of keeping myself alive.” Xue Ying stated.
“Mn.”
Southern Cloud King nodded softly. He then frowned and asked: “I can understand why you killed Black Sovereign King since you had a huge grievance and enmity with him. For him to cut off your path of cultivation in the Realm Heart God Palace, this is a huge enmity that has to be avenged! But… why did you kill Dust Brahman King? He should have no animosity with you, right? And that 19 cities were obviously under the observation by Eternal Night Primogenitor yet you went on to save them regardless? Unless you really have a thing against evil?”
This disciple of his had asked for all information from the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion intelligence network regarding any large massacres and large disasters.
This made Southern Cloud King feel that this disciple of his seemed to really hate evil?
“That is something I should do.” Xue Ying smiled.
“You should do?” Southern Cloud King was stunned, “What do you mean you should do? You weren’t like this in the past.”
“The reason why I was different in the because is because I was weak. If I chose to foolishly slaughter the devils, I would have died by now.” Xue Ying explained, “With great strength comes great responsibility. Since I have reached this realm, I would naturally not just watch and let things happen before my eyes. Hence, I chose to do what I should be doing.”
Southern Cloud King became taciturn for a while.
He slightly understood it.
Should do?
This was a belief that originated from his heart. It was also the ‘Dao Heart’ of Xue Ying.
“Do you know you will get really tired if you continue on like this?” Southern Cloud King mentioned.
“Tired? Why would I be tired?” Xue Ying shook his head with puzzlement, “To me, doing such things is easy. Cultivation is ultimately about tempering oneself in battles. I am merely killing any devils I find! And seeing those cultivators escaping from despair and becoming rave with joy makes me feel happy too. To me, doing such things makes me feel happy and satisfied.”
Dao Heart.
A cultivator had to hold fast to it and put it into practice!
“Alright, it is I who is wrong. I feel that this would be very tiring. But to you, doing it gives you great joy and satisfaction.” Southern Cloud King shook his head, “But Xue Ying, as you cultivate, your level of life would continually increase. By then, seeing the weak is really akin to seeing ants! Just like how those ‘Chaotic Origin Beings’ who have jumped out of the cage into the higher dimension also view us cultivators trapped in the cage as ants. And to us, those weak World Deities and True Gods are ants as well. There is no need for you to refute it. With a single breath, you could kill countless of them. Aren’t they just ants?”
As Xue Ying listened, he immediately understood that his teacher, Southern Cloud King, knew quite a lot regarding ‘Chaotic Origin Beings’.
“Ants?” Xue Ying asked, “Even though we are Cosmos Gods, we had grown up from a weak child, experiencing countless trials before reaching where we are! Now that we have become Cosmos Gods, do we treat out weak past selves as ants too? Cultivators must never forget about their roots!”
“This isn’t about forgetting our root. This is a rise in cultivation.” Southern Cloud King retorted, “The path of cultivation is difficult. Many cultivators have fallen as they encounter all kinds of difficulties! It isn’t easy for us to reach where we are now. Talent is important. Opportunities are important. Cultivation heart is important. And some luck is definitely a must! It is honestly too difficult to reach where we are currently, so why draw in more danger to yourself for the sake of those weak cultivators? And increase the uncertainty of survival? They have their own path, so just let them be.”
“If I don’t do it, those weak cultivators do not even have the chance to fight.” Xue Ying shook his head, “The path of cultivation is filled with countless difficulties, but large-scale massacres aren’t a form of difficulty or a trial. It is destroying the balance in the entire cultivation world! If everyone only looks after their own hide, then the weak would definitely die. Those who are strong have to take responsibility for this!”
“When I was weak, I could take a step back.”
“But now that I am strong, I naturally have to stand forward.” Xue Ying said.
“But you do know that you will eventually offend enemies that are stronger and stronger.” Southern Cloud King could not help but say, “You do not that before the First War of the Ancient Nation, Emperor Summer isn’t recognized as the strongest cultivator in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Instead, it is another existence.”
Xue Ying nodded: “I know. He is Undying Underworld Emperor. Hearsay it is a terrifying existence who brings despair and death with him.”
“Right, amongst unparalleled existences, he is the most vicious of them all.” Southern Cloud King said.
Xue Ying chuckled: “I naturally know of it since there are a lot of rumors regarding him. But isn’t did he not disappear from the world? Ever since the First War of the Ancient Nation, there is no longer news about him. He should have fallen after such a long period.” It was easy to imagine how cruel this existence was for he was treated as synonymous to death.
Southern Cloud King looked at Xue Ying.
Even though he did not approve of his disciple’s Dao Heart, it did not hinder his admiration for such a person.
“He did not die.” Southern Cloud King said, “He has returned.”
“Returned?” Xue Ying felt puzzled, “What do you mean by that?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1164 - Life of Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1164: Life of Cultivation
Southern Cloud King said: “There were once rumors that spoke of an opportunity that allows cultivators to break through and become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform! Hence, before the First War of the Ancient Nations, there had been a huge battle. At that time, Undying Underworld Emperor was able to grasp this chance. As such, he chose to leave the Realm Heart Great Land in search of his Dao path with the aim of charging out of the cage. Yet after the long years, he has come back apparently without succeeding.”
“Where did he visit to break through and become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform?” Xue Ying felt curious.
“This is something I do not know. Maybe Yuan knows about it.” Southern Cloud King answered.
Xue Ying softly nodded: “Oh right, Teacher, it seems that I can’t find any information regarding Chaotic Origin Lifeforms in any of the scriptures.”
“Haha, this information is precious. Your Teacher has discovered more SGover the long years.” Southern Cloud King chuckled, “In the entire Realm Heart Great Land, there exist opportunities in the Realm Heart God Palace that could guide a cultivator into becoming a ‘Chaotic Origin Lifeform’. Hearsay there are even supreme secret impartation techniques. A set of supreme secret impartation techniques could make any unparalleled existence mad. This is even harder to acquire than a supreme-graded weapon! Other than that, the next best place would be the number one most dangerous place in Realm Heart Great Land, the ‘Broken Teeth Mountain Range’! The Broken Teeth Mountain Range is the true place that hides all forms of top-graded opportunities!”
“The highest peak in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range looks just like half a set of broken teeth, right?” Southern Cloud King chuckled.
Xue Ying nodded.
He knew about this!
Precisely because the enormous mountain peak looked just like broken teeth, which was why it was known as the Broken Teeth Mountain Range. The mountain range spanned over an area equivalent to three times that of the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. It was even publicly known that two unparalleled existences had fallen in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
“That was a set of broken teeth that could heavily injure ‘Yuan’.” Southern Cloud King explained, “According to what I have gathered of the Broken Teeth Mountain Range over the long years, the set of broken teeth is the spoils of war ‘Yuan’ got from killing a powerful Chaotic Origin Expert. At that time, Yuan chose to leave this set of broken teeth in the Realm Heart Great Land, and it soon transformed into the highest mountain peak in the entire Broken Teeth Mountain Range.”
“Corpses of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were even thrown into the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.”
“Hence, the entire Broken Teeth Mountain Range is filled with miraculous opportunities! Worlds formed and unique species emerged. There even exists all kinds of danger. Even unparalleled existences could die. For us who have many avatars, it is still fine since we would only lose an avatar if we died.” Southern Cloud King explained, “You will understand in the future when you choose to venture into the mountain range. The Realm Heart God Palace is free of danger, but the Broken Teeth Mountain Range is full of dangers! Nonetheless, there exist all kinds of opportunities regarding Chaotic Origin Creatures over in that dangerous ground.”
Xue Ying’s eyes brightened as he listened.
‘Yuan’ was someone who treated the Realm Heart Great Land as his territory. He casually threw some spoils of war which he did not require into this place?
Corpses of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms? And not just one of them?
“Undying Underworld Emperor chose to visit the Broken Teeth Mountain Range not too long ago.” Southern Cloud King looked at Xue Ying, “He is different from us. Undying Underworld Emperor has always been fighting for the chance to jump out of the cage and become a higher dimensional existence. His means of doing things are famous for being cruel and vicious. If you continue acting this way, spoiling his matters, you would technically be hindering his path of cultivation and he might not be willing to spare you off.”
“This time, you offended Eternal Night Primogenitor. If this carries on, you might even offend the more frightening Undying Underworld Emperor. Who knows if you might even offend more ruthless unparalleled existences in your journey.” Southern Cloud King turned to Xue Ying, “Even if you became one, you can’t stop them.”
“I could certainly do so once I advance into the higher dimensional lifeform as a Chaotic Origin Expert.” Xue Ying smiled, “As for now, hindering the business of unparalleled existences is simply out of the boundary of what I could do.”
“Be careful.” Southern Cloud King no longer said anything more.
******
Time passed.
After visiting his teacher, the Southern Cloud King, Xue Ying no longer chose to travel around the world. After experiencing two great battles-killing a Paragon Master and a level-two Cosmos God devil, Xue Ying felt his current mood surging. Especially so when he doused himself in the Qu Clan Wine for ten days and more. That gave him plenty of inspirations. And now, Xue Ying had a newfound understanding of the Dao of Void, and a new killing move which was being formulated in his heart.
He had to calm himself down and ponder over it.
It was not easy to break through into the final realm. And creating different techniques by applying different profound mysteries was also a form of tempering. This experience would accumulate and increase his chances of breaking through in the future.
…
Several months after visiting the Southern Cloud King, another piece of news came from the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion intelligence network.
“Elegant Peace Valley City, Blood Sacrifice?”
When Xue Ying who was currently meditating in the meditation room received this piece of news, killing intent began swirling in his eyes.
That time, the ‘Ardent Fire City’ which he reincarnated into had suffered from a Blood Sacrifice. That time, it was because Xue Ying stood out and fought against White Cloud Devil Master! Eventually allowing the Ardent Fire City to survive through the calamity.
And now…
Another Blood Sacrifice was in progress?
“Hmph.” The void before Xue Ying was torn apart. Following that, with a flash, Xue Ying penetrated through the cracks and appeared on the other end.
Offering a city for Blood Sacrifice was commonly seen in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. After the Blood Sacrifice, one could purify the grudges and grievances into the ‘Essence of Blood Spirit’ which was comparable to the ‘Essence of Chaotic Origin’-both were greatly nourishing to the soul. And those who could extract Essence of Blood Spirit from Blood Sacrifices were all infamous devils in the Realm Heart Great Land that had experimented for many times before succeeding.
For instance, Yama Religion Master knew how to extract and purify the Essence of Blood Spirit.
Even though it was commonly seen, it was still a city being sacrificed. Since cultivators could live for a very long time, Blood Sacrifices in Realm Heart Great Land were usually only carried out once in a blue moon. Even places like ‘Fiery Zhao Nation’ where Blood Sacrifices were carried out commonly happened once after a long period. Those cities had to be given sufficient time for the cultivators to reproduce and grow first.
“No!”
“Fight with them!”
The entire Elegant Peace Valley City was filled with despondency.
Many civilians in this city looked upwards as devils moved in teams. There were many children who started crying in fear. Some cultivators even chose to sacrifice themselves for their family, and some tried escaping. Some even turned mad… all sorts of chaos existed in this city. The ‘Elegant Peace Valley City’ was slightly bigger than Ardent Fire City, yet it similarly could not resist against a Blood Sacrifice.
Not all cities were that fortunate for a talented genius like ‘Xue Ying’ to rise within.
As for the coincidence of an ultra-strong expert living in the city? Such matters were rarely seen.
“Hua.”
Within a residence in the Elegant Peace Valley City, a black crack formed, and a white-robed young man walked out of it. His appearance began transforming, turning into someone colder with a more frigid aura.
Even though this city did not have an expert coincidentally living in it, there was someone known as Xue Ying who took the initiative to come.
“Those who dared massacre this city of billion civilians must die!” Xue Ying roared out angrily.
His roar reverberated around the world.
It shook and reached every inch in the Elegant Peace Valley City. Those civilians who had originally fallen in despair heard the voice. Even those devils were stunned as they heard this proclamation.
At that point, hope began rising in the hearts of the civilians!
“Those who dare hinder the Eight Silk Island from carrying out a Blood Sacrifice will be treated as enemies of my Eight Silk Island!” High up in the sky, there was currently a Primal Chaos tenth level expert controlling a soul bottle looking downwards. His voice resounded in return.
Eight Silk Island…
The Eight Silk Island Master was also someone who knew how to extract and purify the Essence of Blood Spirit. He was a peak Cosmos God expert who did not own a supreme-graded weapon.
“Treated as enemies? Hmph!”
A cold snort.
“Hua!”
The sky above the entire Elegant Peace Valley City began shattering just like a mirror. Hundreds of cracks began growing and spreading out. Every single crack spanned across more than half the sky above the Elegant Peace Valley City, or that it passed through the entire team of devils, or a Primal Chaos Realm Devil. Even that Primal Chaos tenth level devil in the sky was penetrated by a crack…
Those ugly cracks distorted and had occupied almost the entire sky of the Elegant Peace Valley City.
Yet it was those cracks that caused the death of all devils in an instance!
As for a Cosmos God from Eight Silk Island that was currently relying on a secret treasure to isolate the entire space of the city from the external world, he paled from the scene: ‘The suppression from the Supreme Law in the Realm Heart Great Land is incredibly powerful, yet a technique he executed could cover the entire city? That is absolute power in the final realm! And he is someone who specialized in the domain? Who is he?’
“Peng.”
Suddenly, the spatial isolation which he cast weirdly rumbled, causing a huge hole to form. Following that, this Cosmos God’s body trembled. His eyes widened and soon, he began dissipating like sand.
All devils from the Eight Silk Island that participated in this operation were wiped!
‘I can’t handle the Eight Silk Island Master yet. But those who participated in the Blood Sacrifice could easily be killed by me. I shall continue wiping out all devils who chose to engage in Blood Sacrifice and see if they still dare to do so in the future.’ Xue Ying appeared where the Cosmos God died. He had a cold look on his face. Following that, a black crack appeared and he disappeared from the vicinity.
…
Xue Ying once again flew back to his meditation room in the Flying Snow City.
An incense remained burning within the meditation room. Its fragrance pervaded the entire room. Xue Ying sat down, calming his surging killing intent before resuming his cultivation.
To him, this was merely a casual act, and part of his cultivation life.

chapters.title: Chapter 1165 - Insect Ancestor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1165: Insect Ancestor
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Those devils were easily killed by Xue Ying. Hence, he paid little attention to it.
But there were others who cared!
“Who is this white-robed male to dare disrupt the Blood Sacrifice of my Eight Silk Island and even killed the experts of my Eight Silk Island Master!”
“Island Master, we must definitely find out who he is! He dared to kill all experts from our Eight Silk Island? That is going overboard! He doesn’t care about our Eight Silk Island at all!”
The palace hall was clamoring.
This palace hall was also one of the most well-known devil gathering grounds in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, the main palace of ‘Eight Silk Island’. The commander of Eight Silk Island, ‘Eight Silk Island Master’, was a peak Cosmos God expert. Even though he did not own any supreme-graded weapon, in terms of strength and influencing power, this Island Master was beyond that of Yama Religion Master, Western Floating Old Ancestor, and many other Paragon Masters who had great survival skills.
Those who could reach the final realm usually had the capability to survive against unparalleled existences.
After all, they had cultivated in one of the Daos to the peak of Cosmos God Realm; they had attained unfathomable supernormal knowledge in an aspect. Even though unparalleled existences could defeat them easily, killing these peak Cosmos Gods were practically impossible.
Just like when ‘Old Monster Stone’ battled against ‘Sacred Master’, both parties were heavily injured from the battle because neither of them chose to flee. Sacred Master had to protect his ‘Ancient Sacred World’ and Old Monster Stone was simply furious! If they wanted to escape, even unparalleled existences could not stop them from doing so.
Hence, ‘Eight Silk Island Master’ being a peak Cosmos God and a huge devil, created one of the havens for many devils.
Usually, they were the ones bullying others. When did they become a target for others to bully?
Other than the six great ancient nations, their Eight Silk Island was not afraid of anyone!
“Everyone, shut up.”
Eight Silk Island Master indifferently stated. Everyone went quiet.
Eight Silk Island Master was very fat-extremely so. He was just like a round of flesh seated on the throne. His small eyes were looking at the scene projected on the ‘Heaven Observation Mirror’. Even though his subordinates proceeded to the ‘Elegant Peace Valley City’ to carry out a Blood Sacrifice, they could still see what was happening using the Heaven Observation Mirror from afar. It was only because Xue Ying’s actions had been too quick that they did not have sufficient time to react before Xue Ying left.
“Insect Ancestor, I’m afraid I’ve let you seen us played for a fool.” Eight Silk Island Master looked at another expert who sat by his side. That was a humanoid who was covered entirely in pitch black scales. He had a pair of thin cicada-like crystalline wings and two soft feelers protruding from his head. He was just like a humanoid insect! His pair of cold eyes would cause anybody to feel trepidation when looked into.
“It is truly unexpected for such an event to occur from a Blood Sacrifice carried out by your subordinates, Island Master.” The voice of that Insect Ancestor was hoarse. His mouth edged upwards, “It seems your luck isn’t that great.”
“It is truly unfortunate for this powerful Cosmos God to live in seclusion coincidentally within this Elegant Peace Valley City. This Cosmos God seems to specialize in the Dao of Void, and his techniques appear to have reached the final realm.” Eight Silk Island Master said, “In the entire Realm Heart Great Land, there are very few final realm experts, yet who would have thought that my subordinates would meet one, and he did not care about me either.”
There were indeed few final realm experts.
Other than the unparalleled existences, the remaining few could be counted with two hands. As for the exact number, it was hard for the experts in Realm Heart Great Land to count.
Because once a cultivator reached the final realm, those who did not own any supreme-graded weapon would either rule a territory, or that they would choose to live in seclusion, cultivating towards the sole goal of becoming a ‘Chaotic Origin Expert’! Those who chose to remain low-profile would not be found out by others.
“It appears that other than you, Insect Ancestor, there appears to be another mysterious peak Cosmos God living in the Realm Heart Great Land too.” Eight Silk Island Master said.
“It is also fortunate for me to have a breakthrough in the territory of yours, Island Master.” Insect Ancestor smiled.
“Haha, it is my pleasure for Insect Ancestor to reach the final realm in my territory. Now that Insect Ancestor has become a peak Cosmos God, I believe your name would soon shake the entire Great Land.” Eight Silk Island Master sighed.
Final realm experts could choose not to reveal themselves.
But the moment they did so, they would startle the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
Because any final realm expert could become an ‘unparalleled existence’! Even if they did not own a supreme-graded weapon, they had the qualification to stir the world.
“Hmph hmph hmph.” Insect Ancestor sneered. His eyes were flashing with killing intent, “That’s right. It is time for my name to shake the great land.”
Eight Silk Island Master chuckled when he saw that: “It appears that someone is bound to be unlucky.”
“I’ve endured for a very long time.” Insect Ancestor indifferent replied. He then proceeded to switch the topic, “Are you planning to let that mysterious expert who killed so many of your subordinates off?”
“That is an expert in the Dao of Void. And it appears that none of us have seen him before. If I chose to deal with him, I would have to search through the entire land inch by inch.” Eight Silk Island Master shook his head. His plump body swayed, “Whatever. I shall just treat it as bad luck this time.”
Other experts of the Eight Silk Island could only suppress their fury when they heard that.
“Since we do not know his identity, it is practically similar to finding a needle in haystacks. Count him lucky.”
“He is definitely afraid of offending Island Master, which was why he did not dare to reveal his identity.”
Everyone added on.
Eight Silk Island Master sneered. He squinted his eyes, suppressing the bubbling cold killing intent in him. Previously when he saw the scene through the Heaven Observation Mirror, he saw how Xue Ying acted. That move of his created several hundred cracks that filled almost the entire sky above Elegant Peace Valley City, killing all his subordinates. With such a huge area of effect and such a great power, Eight Silk Island Master understood-that was a formidable opponent!
‘I shall just take it as my misfortune.’ Eight Silk Island Master thought.
He had many subordinates, and this time, he merely sent a team out.
“Island Master, I have stayed for a long time over at your place. It is also time for me to make my move.” Insect Ancestor stood.
******
Xue Ying calmly meditated within the Flying Snow City. A year later, Southern Cloud King finished gathering all materials written on the second scroll Xue Ying gave him.
That time, the first scroll Xue Ying gave were all precious materials required to refine the Chaotic Origin Weapon-excluding the ‘Chaotic Origin Sand’. Even though it was easier to gather them, that was when compared to gathering the Chaotic Origin Sand. With the intelligence network of Southern Cloud King, it would likely require a slightly longer time to gather them.
As for the second set of scrolls, the materials written were comparatively more low-end. Even though it cost 100 billion cosmos crystals too, the reason was due to ‘large amounts’! As for how precious these materials were, they were much cheaper by an entire level as compared to those listed on the first scroll.
“So fast?” The avatar Xue Ying left behind in the Southern Cloud Capital received the storage wristband passed over by his teacher. He checked through the voluminous amount of materials in it. Even though they were low-end, the amount was huge! And his teacher took just a year to gather them? This exceeded what Xue Ying expected.
Southern Cloud King laughed: “Xue Ying, you are planning on re-fortifying your entire Flying Snow City?”
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded, “Teacher, how do you know?”
“Haha, you should know that I could fight against unparalleled existences within the Southern Cloud Capital.” Southern Cloud King smiled, “Why was that? It’s because the entire city is filled with many arrays. A single unit of strength could be augmented until it reaches a hundred to a thousand units of combat strength. Only then could I fight against unparalleled existences! And all the materials which you need are some of the materials which I had used to fortify the capital royal palace. That time, I collected a lot of them, and still have plenty leftover. And I know where to search for those that I lacked. That was why I could gather them so quickly for you.”
Xue Ying laughed.
“Right, Teacher, that time when you re-constructed the capital royal palace, it should be more expensive than what I spent right?” Xue Ying asked.
“Approximately ten times yours.” Southern Cloud King sighed, “I felt heart ached from that as I pawned almost all my treasures.”
Xue Ying was dumbstruck.
Ten times?
His materials cost about 100 billion cosmos crystals, and he felt he was quite willing to spend already. It was also because Xue Ying had taken the top-graded weapon of Black Sovereign King out to be exchanged! And the price his teacher spent in fortifying the capital was actually ten times that! In other words, several top-graded secret treasures! He was indeed the most wealthy Paragon Master in the world. Even Great Paragon Fuyi and Sky-Rending Great Paragon were tossed far behind by him.
“Why are you planning on fortifying this city?” Southern Cloud King looked at Xue Ying.
“To prevent any unforeseen circumstances.” Xue Ying answered, “Even though I usually handle matters carefully without revealing my identity, but with my journey of killing all devils, I believe that I would offend many huge devils one day! Who knows one day if I might reveal my identity, implicating the Ying Shan Clan as a result. Hence, I have to prepare for rainy days.”
Southern Cloud King softly nodded.
Since his disciple chose to stand out for the weak, there would naturally be typhoons and storms inundating his way.
“Tell me if you need my help.” Southern Cloud King added.
“Teacher has already given me a lot of help.” Xue Ying laughed.
…
That day, he began reconstructing the core Monarch Residence in the entire Flying Snow City. He had more than 10,000 avatars. Even though the other avatars were very weak, it was sufficient for them to carry out such menial tasks.
Only after fortifying Flying Snow City into an invulnerable place did Xue Ying let go of his worries.

chapters.title: Chapter 1166 - Flying Snow City Great Array
chapters.content:
Chapter 1166: Flying Snow City Great Array
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
With more than 100 avatars, everyone began work on inscribing the array using materials worth more than 100 billion cosmos crystals!
Usually, cultivators had to consume a large heart force when executing powerful techniques. But if an array was engraved according to the profound mysteries of the absolute technique, then the cultivator could activate it with just a little heart force! For instance, one of the three great killing techniques of Xue Ying’s <Flying Snow Combat Technique>, the ‘Multiverse Void Great Destruction’, required nine great avatars consuming more than half their heart force before they could use it.
And if an array was inscribed successfully, or two arrays… ten arrays! A hundred arrays!
As long as they were coordinated well, with a thought, all hundred arrays could be activated at the same time. It was equivalent to a hundred ‘Multiverse Void Great Destruction’ being used simultaneously!
Even though each technique was not augmented by the Void Fire Lotus Flower, with sufficient quantity, a qualitative transformation would be the outcome!
Of course…
Dealing against an unparalleled existence was not as simple as using one single strengthened technique. Otherwise, the flaws would be too obvious. It required different techniques being executed flawlessly in conjunction with one another.
Xue Ying had a huge advantage over Southern Cloud King! Even without relying on an array, his avatars could exert power in the final realm. Many techniques which he created for the <Flying Snow Combat Technique> were originally powerful. Hence, just with some slight addition in power using the array would give him the capabilities to fight against unparalleled existence! If Southern Cloud King did not rely on external forces, he was much weaker than Xue Ying. That was why Southern Cloud King had to consume ten times the materials to consolidate his Southern Cloud Capital so that he was able to fight against ‘unparalleled existences’!
Xue Ying’s foundation was thick. His techniques were powerful. Just by using materials worth 100 billion cosmos crystals was something he reckoned as enough!
And if he was more powerful?
So what if Xue Ying was stronger than unparalleled existences in his own city? He could only suppress them and those unparalleled existences could easily leave. Once Xue Ying was out of the city, his strength would return back to its original!
******
The array was spread across the entire city.
It was relatively easy to inscribe the array over a huge area. If such an array was inscribed onto a weapon? One that he could bring along with him anytime? That would be thousand times more difficult.
Fortunately, as the area was large enough, and Xue Ying was inscribing an array fixed to a place, 100 billion cosmos crystals worth of materials sufficed.
“Weng.”
More than a hundred avatars spent more than 10,000 years working on the arrays.
The entire Flying Snow City was covered in arrays. There were even some core arrays in the ‘Monarch Residence’. Xue Ying even chose to bring the most crucial array plate core with him at all times. This array plate core was like a ‘primer’ and also a ‘controller’. Only with it could he control the huge array in Flying Snow City.
“Alright. I’ve finished inscribing the arrays.” Xue Ying stood above Flying Snow City looking down at the entire place. With a thought, he easily sent his consciousness through the arrays which he controlled over the entire city.
The arrays were hidden from plain sight.
They were like arteries and veins covering the entire Flying Snow City!
He was unparalleled. Every single action of his could incite endless energy.
‘Who would have thought that I would succeed within 10,000 years.’ Xue Ying felt relatively happy. In order for the array to be used in conjunction with his techniques, it had a hefty demand on his realm. The entire process of inscribing the array gave him the chance to reflect over his Dao of Void.
“Weng.”
With a thought, Xue Ying easily activated a total of 30 arrays within the place. Some of the arrays were similar, and some were auxiliary ones meant to support other arrays, allowing these arrays to coordinate like gears. And when the arrays were activated, a pitch-black maelstrom formed high above the Flying Snow City. This maelstrom tore apart everything and easily shattered the Origin World membrane wall, connecting this place to the higher dimension and allow Chaotic Origin Energy to enter.
This black maelstrom gave Xue Ying the feeling that if it enveloped experts like ‘Black Sovereign King’, they would most likely turn into ashes in an instance.
In terms of power, this was stronger by a major level than what Xue Ying could exert by relying on the Void Fire Lotus Flower to execute the ‘Multiverse Void Great Destruction’.
It could even threaten an unparalleled existence.
‘With a thought, I could have this power.’ Xue Ying softly nodded.
“Old Ancestor.” Xue Ying took a step before arriving at the highest peak in the Flying Snow City. Old Mother Ying Shan was currently seated cross-legged here just like a dried-up rock. She always sought to step into the Cosmos God Realm, but no matter how she tried, she could not jump out of this boundary.
If one said that reaching the Cosmos God Realm was reaching grand perfection in a single Dao path, and also the endpoint of a single Dao path…
Then after becoming a Cosmos God, one would seek to reach the endpoint for all branches of a single Dao! This step was similarly difficult.
“Oh, Xue Ying, what’s the matter?” Old Mother Ying Shan opened her eyes and smiled at Xue Ying. She felt incredibly satisfied over this Ying Shan Clan descendant of hers. Xue Ying had given her a lot of help in her cultivation-scriptures, external resources… what he could help her had been done. The final hurdle to cross into the Cosmos God Realm ultimately depended on herself!
“Old Ancestor, do you mind summoning all disciples of the Ying Shan Clan back into the Flying Snow City?” Xue Ying said.
“Currently, more than half the disciples are living in the Flying Snow City. Why is there a need to summon all of them?” Old Mother Ying Shan felt puzzled.
The Flying Snow City was the second biggest city in the Southern Cloud Nation. There were many beings living within. The Ying Shan Clan also treated this place as their roots. More than half the disciples were currently gathered here! Even Old Mother Ying Shan stayed here. But other cities they lived in in the past remained untouched. For instance, some Primal Chaos Marquisses liked commanding their own city, which was why quite a few lived outside of Flying Snow City.
“I am afraid that I will have a huge enemy in the near future.” Xue Ying explained, “I am not confident of protecting them if they lived in other places. I am only confident of doing so in the Flying Snow City.”
“Huge enemy?” Old Mother Ying Shan was startled. She did not understand what Xue Ying meant with his words.
Old Mother Ying Shan only treated this Flying Snow City as a place where Xue Ying’s avatar could protect them.
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded with a smile, “To prevent from unforeseen circumstances happening, let all Ying Shan Clan disciples remain in the Flying Snow City for at least one trillion years.”
“Alright, I’ll arrange for that. But there must still be other people governing other cities. And there shouldn’t be a need to force those who aren’t willing to come right?” Old Mother Ying Shan asked.
“Then let them be.” Xue Ying nodded.
Saying one trillion years…
Was because Xue Ying felt he would definitely reach the final realm within this period! His hometown Origin World Primal Chaos Void was continuously expanding. It was getting closer and closer to the Great Apocalypse. Hence, he did not have much time left! But he had already fused eight branches together, leaving behind just the final ninth branch. As long as he continued accumulating in experiences-Xue Ying still had two World Flowers which were not consumed-he believed he should be able to have a breakthrough in a trillion years.
And he had to do so! Otherwise, what would happen to his wife?
******
With the orders given by Old Mother Ying Shan, those Primal Chaos disciples of Ying Shan Clan were startled when they heard them. Those at their level would definitely be ‘implicated’. Regardless, it was only for a trillion years so they sent their true bodies into the Flying Snow City, leaving behind their incarnations to protect their original cities. The Ying Shan Clan controlled many cities, and indeed, a huge batch of disciples had flown into the Flying Snow City when the orders were given. The few that were left behind remained low-profile to protect their cities.
After arranging everything, Xue Ying resumed his cultivation.
And at this moment, a matter occurred that created huge waves across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
An old monster called ‘Insect Ancestor’ rose. He seemed to have enmity with the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, killing countless Primal Chaos experts within the ‘Fan Clan’ and ‘Summer Clan’. There was even a Cosmos God from both the Summer Clan and Fan Clan respectively that fell in the end. After which ‘Ancestor Fan’ personally acted, forcing Insect Ancestor to escape. This was a final realm expert that could not be dealt against easily.
It was hard for unparalleled existences to kill final realm experts.
And after Insect Ancestor escaped, he immediately disappeared from the world. Summer Wind Ancient Nation was also investigating when did they become enemies with Insect Ancestor, yet to no avail. This old monster Insect Ancestor was too mysterious and low-profile. Previously when he created a huge disturbance to the world, that was during the period of ‘Devouring Realm Great Emperor’. At that time, Insect Ancestor was a great general under Devouring Realm Great Emperor.
…
Eight Silk Island.
“Haha, this old monster Insect Ancestor has broken through into the final realm so it is normal for him to go out and enact his revenge. It’s just that when did this old monster become enemies with the lower level Primal Chaos experts in the Summer Clan and Fan Clan?” Eight Silk Island Master sat on his throne thinking about it, “He has been a very famous cultivator for a long time, and even if he becomes enemies with those in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, it should be with the Cosmos Gods and not those at the Primal Chaos Realm? This is puzzling.”
Eight Silk Island Master suddenly had an epiphany: “Second Brother.”
At that moment, a tall and thin male hurried over.
“Big Brother.” The tall and thin male came.
“Previously, our Eight Silk Island was unlucky when we engaged in a Blood Sacrifice against the Elegant Peace Valley City. We clashed against a seemingly final realm expert who was living in seclusion.” Eight Silk Island Master chuckled. He still thought that it was because his luck wasn’t good since the ‘Heaven Observation Mirror’ could only observe part of the region from a long distance. When Xue Ying executed the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to enter the Elegant Peace Valley City, they did not discover him. They even thought Xue Ying had always been living in the city.
“I need to refine some Essence of Blood Spirit. Proceed with another Blood Sacrifice.” Eight Silk Island Master chuckled, “The Realm Heart Great Land is so vast. It is fine for one coincidence, but I don’t believe there could be another time.”
How many final realm experts were there in the entire Realm Heart Great Land?
How could things be so coincidental?
“Rest assured, Big Brother, I’ll definitely arrange things properly.” The tall and thin male replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 1167 - The most beautiful Scene
chapters.content:
Chapter 1167: The most beautiful Scene
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Fu Jun City was a flourishing city. Its population numbered in the trillions. The Fu Jun City’s City Master was a Primal Chaos expert whose words were of enormous weight within his territory.
Musical instruments could be heard echoing in the hall, and there were beautiful ladies dancing gracefully.
Fu Jun City Master was currently organizing a banquet for some guests. Everyone was chatting cheerfully and wittily.
“Hong.”
Suddenly, an unseen ripple engulfed the entire Fu Jun City.
“Not good.” Fu Jun City Master paled. With a teleport, he disappeared from his throne and appeared in the sky.
“Shua shua shua…”
Many figures appeared one after another. Some were his subordinates, and some were guests whom he had invited over.
They saw as the sky was being isolated completely from the external world. Furthermore, there were even devils controlling a black bottle. This black bottle vaguely emitted a fluctuation that engulfed every single section of the city. There were many devils who appeared in various locations of Fu Jun City and began in a large-scale massacre. At the same time when those living beings were killed, a form of unique energy was released that was magically attracted into the black bottle.
“Blood Sacrificial Magic Bottle!”
“It’s a Blood Sacrifice!”
Everyone including Fu Jun City Master paled.
Those who dared to send a city for a Blood Sacrifice and to commit such vicious acts were all led by powerful devils! Those powerful devils were existences even unparalleled existences could not kill.
There were many cultivators in the Realm Heart Great Land who sought to eliminate all evil. But those who had the strength to do so were so few that it felt pitiful-probably only two to three who were willing to do so. What was more lamentable would be that even the powerful unparalleled existences had many qualms about killing those devils since they could not kill those powerful great devils, and the weaker ones did not care if their comrades died. Instead, they even dared to bring chaos to ancient nations.
Hence, most who were willing to take the initiative in getting rid of devils would choose to give up when they took into consideration their own subordinates and civilians. As long as those devils did not disrupt the order in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, and they would acquiesce those actions. Hence, there was no longer anyone who came specially to deal with these powerful great devils.
“We are doomed!”
“Blood Sacrifice, it’s a Blood Sacrifice!”
Fu Jun City Master and the others felt despair. Some of the guests by the side-there were several Primal Chaos experts who sent only their incarnations over since their true bodies had to protect their own territories.
“Fu Jun City Master, forgive us for not being able to help you in this.”
“Ai, these are devils from the Eight Silk Island. We can’t fight against them.” At that moment, some guests immediately dissipated their incarnations.
“Teacher, Teacher, save me!”
“City Master, City Master!”
There were several others who came to the Fu Jun City with the important guests. They came with their true bodies and were profusely calling for help! It’s just that their teachers and city masters merely shook their heads or went silent. Some even looked at their disciples: “Teacher can’t help you this time. Facing the Eight Silk Island, your teacher is merely an ant. Let destiny decide your fate!”
They did not even have the courage to leave behind their incarnations to battle against the devils in fear of antagonizing the Eight Silk Island! They only wanted to leave this place as far as possible.
“No-”
“Teacher-”
Many cultivators fell into despair.
The trillions of living beings in the entire city had almost instantaneously fallen into despair. Even Fu Jun City Master was anxious and feeling bitter.
“Fu Jun City Master?” Accompanying a cold sneer, a team of three Primal Chaos Devils appeared. All of them were stronger than Fu Jun City Master. With the three of them working in tandem, Fu Jun City Master could not resist at all.
“Please spare my life!” Fu Jun City Master simply bowed and begged for mercy.
Some of the subordinates and disciples by the side saw how their master did not even have the slightest determination to fight back, and even chose to beg for mercy. They could not help but feel sorrowful.
