“Mercy? That’s impossible too. You should simply hear our orders and control the array of the entire Fu Jun City and aid them in our operation.” The three Primal Chaos Devils grinned. The city was ultimately too big and there were too many living beings. Hence, they would have to spend quite some time killing all of them! If they relied on the Fu Jun City Master with his arrays, that would hasten the process.
“Fine.” Fu Jun City Master gritted his teeth. Even though he felt grief and indignant that he had betrayed his people, cultivating until now, his Dao Heart had been to place himself first! So what if his clan was extinguished as long as he survived? There were still other branches of his clan, and they would similarly grow bigger over a period.
But if he died, he would no longer have any future.
“Could I save some of my children?” Fu Jun City Master asked.
“Do you wish to die?” The leading Primal Chaos Devil’s expression sunk.
“No no.” Fu Jun City Master did not dare to speak anymore.
…
The entire Fu Jun City had fallen into mass hysteria and desperation. There was also a branch of Southern Cloud Sacred Religion here accepting disciples. Being one of the top ten great religions in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion had permeated into many cities in the world. Fu Jun City was a slightly bigger city, and there was naturally a branch here too.
“Blood Sacrifice. Those devils from the Eight Silk Island have come here to sacrifice the entire city.” This branch of disciples from the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion felt incomparably despair. They immediately reported this news upwards.
They were considered to be at the lowest level in the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion.
And they had never thought that Southern Cloud King would save them since their King would not dare to do certain tasks either. These devils had no worries at all when doing things, yet the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion had.
This news was reported upwards.
And it soon reached Xue Ying.
******
Flying Snow City.
Within a meditation room, there was an incense burning. Its fragrance permeated the entire room. A white-robed Xue Ying sat cross-legged with a calm look on his face. His eyes were closed as he meditated.
Currently, Xue Ying was trying to accumulate sufficient experience to fuse the nine branches together and reach the final realm in the Dao of Void. He was currently integration some comprehensions he had of the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> with some other techniques in the Dao of Void, coming out with the self-created <Flying Snow Combat Technique>. Of which the three great killing moves were what Xue Ying created-of which he felt proud of. Currently, he had an inspiration and was trying to create the fourth killing move.
This process of crafting a killing technique would also give him sufficient experience. Cultivation was as such-once sufficient accumulation of comprehensions and experiences was reached, one would a breakthrough.
“Mn?” Xue Ying suddenly opened his eyes. A strand of fury could be seen, “Sending the Fu Jun City into a Blood Sacrifice? It is the Eight Silk Island again?”
One could see the appearance of the seated Xue Ying transforming into that of a simple-looking male. His white robe had also transformed in style. Even his aura was masked, transforming into that of a cold aura that was filled with killing intent.
“Hua.”
A black crack appeared by the side. Xue Ying disappeared from the place.
Fu Jun City had already been spatially sealed. Hence, Xue Ying could not enter through ordinary means. Instead, he had to rely on the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique!
…
Fu Jun City.
Within an ordinary residence. A black crack appeared in midair, and a simple-looking white-robed male appeared.
Cries and shouts, furious roars, a cacophony of clashing… all kinds of sounds reverberated within the Fu Jun City. Being a Dao of Void expert, Xue Ying was able to perceive everything that happened in Fu Jun City. Even though it was only a short period from when the Blood Sacrifice began to the news spreading out and Xue Ying rushing over, many people were killed already.
‘Watching’ those scenes of carnage happening, the killing intent in Xue Ying’s eyes could no longer be concealed.
“Eight Silk Island! I’ve wiped out a team of yours the previous time yet you guys still dared to send a city for a Blood Sacrifice!” Xue Ying roared out angrily. His furious roar strangely sounded out in every corner of the Fu Jun City. Xue Ying then extended his hand and pointed to the sky-
“Hua!”
A blasting sound could be heard in the sky above.
Several hundred cracks could be seen spreading outwards. The majority of those spatial cracks had covered more than half the entire Fu Jun City, sweeping across the teams of devils. Even the Primal Chaos Devils were instantaneously killed under the spatial cracks. None could resist it.
“No!”
“It’s him again!”
Hearing the furious roar that echoed in every single corner of the Fu Jun City, those devils from Eight Silk Island that were participating in this operation became terrified.
They were very clear how difficult it was to roar out in reverberation throughout the entire city under the law suppression in Realm Heart Great Land. Most Cosmos Gods could not do so! Several of the Primal Chaos Devils that were controlling the Blood Sacrificial Magic Bottle and arrays ‘discovered’ that roaring white-robed male. They could not help but feel their souls trembling.
It’s him! It was that terrifying expert who wiped out the team of devils from Eight Silk Island in Elegant Peace Valley City.
What a coincidence? Why did he appear here at the Fu Jun City again?
They did not have the time to think.
Instead, the terrifying void spread out in a controlled fashion that penetrated through all the devils and wiping out their lives.
And within the city, many of those civilians were originally in despair-many had even turned mad since they understood what ‘Blood Sacrifice’ represented! Even their King was trembling before those powerful devils that dared to send the entire city into a Blood Sacrifice. Nobody could save them! To the entire Realm Heart Great Land, ‘Blood Sacrifice’ was just light a nightmare.
“Eight Silk Island! I’ve wiped out a team of yours the previous time yet you guys still dared to send a city for a Blood Sacrifice!” A voice reverberated throughout the entire Eight Silk Island.
This roar was filled with frightening fury.
But at the same time, when those civilians in despair heard it, they felt their bodies shaking from shock before being replaced with rave joy! Someone who dared to spout such words and dared challenged the ‘Eight Silk Island’ must definitely be an apex expert in the Realm Heart Great Land. Even their King did not dare to say such words.
Hence, hope began rising in the hearts of those civilians.
Following that, they saw the most beautiful scene they would ever see in their entire life-
An enormous spatial crack began swimming through the entire sky just like a huge snake.
To the ordinary civilians, their vision power did not allow them to see the entire city. They merely saw a spatial crack spreading out from one end of the sky. Of all ‘devils’ that were in their peripheral vision-those seemingly frightening devils-were wiped out before this frightening crack.
“That is absolutely beautiful!”
Many civilians chose to etch this scene in their minds. They would never forget it forever in their lives.
“When could I ever have one-ten-thousandth of this power?” Many children and young men began feeling hope. From this moment, they started feeling admiration and even worship for this expert that dared to stand on the other side against the Eight Silk Island-an expert who saved their city, and an expert who could utilize such frightening technique!

chapters.title: Chapter 1168 - The Invasion by Eight Silk Island Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 1168: The Invasion by Eight Silk Island Master
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The civilians in Fu Jun City looked upwards with hope. They watched as enormous distorted spatial cracks appear from the horizons, stretching through the sky before turning all devils into ashes.
Some were so excited that they teared up.
And some began kneeling down bawling.
All sorts of emotional manifestation could be seen in the city.
After all, cultivators would temper their Dao Hearts over time. The only difference between cultivators would be the level of their Dao Hearts. Nonetheless, most that lived for a long period would have sufficiently strong beliefs! The stronger their beliefs, the more things they were involved with and the more unwilling they were to die; there were simply too many things they wanted to do in their lives.
When the Blood Sacrifice descended, they felt unwilling yet helpless at the same time! Hence, when Xue Ying pulled them out of their nightmarish abyss, it was normal for their emotions to manifest out.
“It is that terrifying expert again?” The Cosmos God from Eight Silk Island who was controlling the spatial isolation secret treasure watched in terror as the spatial cracks appeared in the sky. He immediately fled!
“Escaping?”
A cold voice sounded in the mind of this Cosmos God.
“Peng.”
Following that, an unseen ripple blasted on his body, causing this Cosmos God Devil to collapse and dissipate. All devils who participated in this operation were completely wiped out.
…
And in Eight Silk Island.
Eight Silk Island Master sat at the highest position with his subordinates scattered across the palace hall. They were currently watching the proceedings happening in Fu Jun City through the Heaven Observation Mirror.
When Xue Ying roared and executed his large-scale killing move.
“Him again?” The incomparably fat figure of Eight Silk Island Master started shaking in anger. His pair of small eyes were observing everything projected on the Heaven Observation Mirror.
Eight Silk Island Master was a peak Cosmos God. Being an absolute tyrant of an area, he was incredibly overbearing and unparalleled existences could not kill him at all! Hence, it had been far too long since someone dared to offend him. Previously, he treated it as a coincidence, but when the same thing happened again, Eight Silk Island Master understood that everything was not a coincidence at all!
How vast was the Realm Heart Great Land?
How could it be so coincidence for him to meet this expert twice? And furthermore, that mysterious expert only acted after a short period when the Blood Sacrifice began!
It appeared that this mysterious expert should have rushed over after receiving news of the Blood Sacrifice.
“This is simply slapping my face!” Eight Silk Island Master stood up furiously.
The entire palace hall turned quiet.
They looked at their Island Master.
“Si la.”
Eight Silk Island Master abruptly extended his hand. His two hands seemed to control a heaven-defying strength that pulled the void. “Si la”-and a huge spatial door was torn apart. On the other end, one could see the Fu Jun City! That huge fatty figure of Eight Silk Island Master took a step before stepping through this spatial door and arriving outside of Fu Jun City.
“Island Master is about to fight with that mysterious expert.” And the group of Cosmos God Devils from the Eight Silk Island within the palace hall were becoming anxious as they waited for the impending battle.
“That mysterious expert dealt against the team from our Eight Silk Island the previous time. This time, he did it again. Could it be possible that he has some enmity with our Eight Silk Island?”
“We do not recognize him. Maybe it is Island Master who he has an enmity with.”
“When Island Master fights against that mysterious expert, Island Master would not fear for his life since he is powerful. But if that mysterious expert chose to deal with us, it’ll be troublesome.”
These Cosmos God Devils were panicking.
“Rest assured. This island contains many arrays that were constructed by the Island Master over many years. Hence, Island Master could even fight against unparalleled existences head-on without losing. So there should not be any danger for us if we remained on the island.”
“Unless we are going to be hiding on the island forever?”
As they discussed, they were also watching the scene outside Fu Jun City through the Heaven Observation Mirror.
******
Outside of Fu Jun City.
Xue Ying wiped out that Cosmos God Devil before collecting the secret treasures left behind by him, including that spatial isolation treasure. At the next moment, he felt the space being torn by the side, and the sound of a fatty taking a step before crossing through a huge distance-he was coming out from this torn spatial door.
‘It is him, Eight Silk Island Master?’ Xue Ying understood it in his heart.
Every expert who reached the final realm had unfathomable and profound techniques.
Like Xue Ying, due to the level-two Chaotic Origin Refinement Body of his, after perfecting it, his fleshy body could be comparable to the final realm body cultivators. But he could not compete with body cultivators in flesh controlling techniques. Like Old Monster Stone and the others, their bodies could be scattered and gathered at any location within the entire Origin World. Using their bodies as the main conduit, they were able to sense the Origin World and scour through every single part of the world…
These techniques were what Xue Ying did not have!
But in the Dao of Void, after integrating the supreme secret impartation technique, <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>, what Xue Ying executed were techniques even peak experts in the Dao of Void could not comprehend. Their capabilities in the usage of Chaotic Origin Energy were far weaker than what Xue Ying could do. Hence, even though Xue Ying was weaker in his grasp of the Dao of Void, he could still exert strength at the final realm.
‘Eight Silk Island Master is known for the ‘Dao of Strength’. The Dao of Strength is also famous for being overbearing and tyrannical. Once one reaches the final realm in the Dao of Strength, they would become incredibly skillful in all areas. He is a formidable opponent.’ Xue Ying thought.
Across the Realm Heart Great Land, there were only two who reached the final realm in the Dao of Strength. One was Eight Silk Island Master and the other, World Extermination God-Emperor! World Extermination God-Emperor owned a supreme-graded secret treasure was had a more scary power.
“Damn.”
Eight Silk Island Master had already tried his best to rush over, yet he was still one step too slow to save that Cosmos God subordinate of his. He felt so furious at this moment.
Even though he had more than ten Cosmos Gods underneath him, two of them died in this short period. Would he not get angry over this?
“Are you deliberately targeting me?” Eight Silk Island Master stared at Xue Ying. The surrounding void began distorting. “Chi chi chi”, unseen ripples started spreading out with Eight Silk Island Master at the center. It enveloped the surroundings, and also suppressed and restricted Xue Ying. It was clear how angry Eight Silk Island Master was feeling now.
And the surrounding space was being stacked up in layers around Xue Ying. The technique of Eight Silk Island Master could not touch the true body of Xue Ying at all.
“I wonder when did I, Eight Silk, become enemies with you? Do tell me so that at least I understand why.” Eight Silk Island Master growled. His pair of small eyes were glaring at Xue Ying with killing intent.
“Become enemies? This is the first time we meet.” Xue Ying replied.
“First time?” Eight Silk Island Master frowned, “Unless my subordinates killed your good friends and loved ones?”
“That hasn’t happened either.” Xue Ying shook his head.
“Then why are you targeting me time after time? Killing my subordinates?” Eight Silk Island Master angrily retorted.
Xue Ying coldly answered: “Why, since your subordinates dared to send a city for Blood Sacrifice, can’t I kill them as a result?”
“Just because of the Blood Sacrifices which led you to kill them?” Eight Silk Island Master was in disbelief.
“Right, it’s precisely the Blood Sacrifices! Those devils naturally had to die.” Xue Ying indifferently declared.
Eight Silk Island Master was still filled with slight disbelief.
It seemed there was really such a madman on the Realm Heart Great Land?
“There had been many instances of Blood Sacrifices happening in the Realm Heart Great Land until now. Why have I yet to see you move against them? And instead, you chose to target the Blood Sacrifices organized by my Eight Silk Island twice consecutively?” Eight Silk Island Master growled.
“Because prior to this, I have yet to break through and is too weak. There is naturally no need for me to act.” Xue Ying answered.
“Hmph hmph, it seems my Eight Silk Island is really fortunate.” Eight Silk Island Master stared at Xue Ying, “With your strength, you are definitely a famous person so tell me, who are you?”
“Must I be famous if I am strong?” Xue Ying indifferently replied.
Eight Silk Island Master understood.
There might be a possibility-could this be an expert living in seclusion? Of course, the greatest possibility would be for this expert to conceal his identity. After all, he was prepared to tear all decorums with their Eight Silk Island if he dared to commit such acts. If his identity was publicized, this absolute tyrannical devil, Eight Silk Island Master, would naturally take revenge!
“My subordinates are all devils, and I am their commander. Why aren’t you planning to kill me?” Eight Silk Island Master sneered.
“Unparalleled existences can’t even kill you, and I temporarily could not do so either. Hence, there is no need to waste the effort.” Xue Ying said.
“Oh? Your meaning is that if you could kill me, you would?”
“Yes.”
“What a pity… nobody in the Realm Heart Great Land could do so!” Eight Silk Island Master’s eyes let out a frightening killing intent, “Before me, you can’t hide your identity.”
Eight Silk Island Master abruptly punched out.
His plump fists smashed out at the surrounding void, transmitting an endless force onto Xue Ying.
There were only these few peak experts in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, and those who comprehended the Dao of Void were even fewer! Hence, it was possible to deduce the identity of this mysterious person through his combat style! Eight Silk Island Master planned on doing so to find out who this mysterious person was, and to let him understand why devils were called devils!
“You came at the right time.” Xue Ying felt his fighting spirit arising.
He wanted to break through to the final realm. Hence, he needed to temper himself using combat!
He wanted to frighten all devils under the world, and had to prove himself through battles!
And the final realm expert ‘Eight Silk Island Master’ was precisely the most appropriate opponent for him currently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1169 - Shocking the Great Land (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1169: Shocking the Great Land (1)
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Blood Sacrifices were huge affairs.
Just like in the past when ‘Ardent Fire City was Blood Sacrificed’, the three religion masters from Black Devil Great Lake were all watching through the Heaven Observation Mirror. Southern Cloud King, Fan Tian Chong, and experts from various superpowers would also watch the battle through their Heaven Observation Mirror when they received news of it.
It was the same this time-the Blood Sacrifice of Fu Jun City had attracted the attention of several superpowers.
For instance, there were experts from the six great ancient nations that were responsible for tracking all huge events happening in the Great Land. Experts from other bigger organizations were similarly paying close notice to them.
“It is that mysterious person.”
“He has appeared again, wiping out another team from the Eight Silk Island. Does he have some vengeance against Eight Silk Island Master? Why did he target Eight Silk Island?”
“Mn, there must be some vengeance between both parties! It can’t be so coincidental for this expert to appear in both cities that had been sent for a Blood Sacrifice, and for that mysterious person to be so ruthless, wiping out all people from the Eight Silk Island.”
Various organizations were watching and discussing among each other from afar. At this moment, everyone was quite calm and casual about it.
Because they knew that ‘Dao of Void’ experts were famous for being exceptionally good at escaping! They believed that this mysterious person would definitely flee after killing all devils from the Eight Silk Island.
“Eight Silk Island Master is here. He seems mad.”
“What? He did not run?”
“They are fighting! They have begun fighting!”
An uproar rose from those watching the scene!
Two final realm experts fighting were much rarer than Blood Sacrifices!
“Hurry up and report to the King!”
“Hurry up and report to His Majesty God Emperor!”
The entire Realm Heart Great Land was alarmed by this affair. Many unparalleled existences like World Extermination God-Emperor, Realm Beast King, and Moonflower King were even personally watching it through the Heaven Observation Mirror!
“Interesting.” Realm Beast King sat on his throne with good food placed on the table before him. He was currently watching the battle projected on the floating Heaven Observation Mirror while eating the food in big gulps, “It seems this mysterious Dao of Void expert isn’t afraid of revealing his moves once they began battling, allowing others to deduce his true identity? Even if this is an expert from one of the six great ancient nations, given the devilish personality of Eight Silk Island Master, he might take revenge by wantonly massacring in the ancient nation!”
“They truly began fighting?”
“Aren’t he afraid of revealing his identity?”
Various powers were puzzled.
Previously, wiping out those weak devils with a single large-area technique would not easily reveal the identity of the user.
But when one fought against an expert of the same level, he would certainly reveal many more of his techniques.
“Does Monarch Flying Snow have vengeance on Eight Silk Island Master?” Emperor Summer was watching bewilderedly, “But if he fought, he would definitely reveal his techniques. Even though he requested us not to leak the news regarding the ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’, and nobody would be able to guess who this mysterious person is since Monarch Flying Snow has recently broken through. But Monarch Flying Snow should not keep hiding undercover forever right? In the future when he decided to enter the Realm Heart God Palace or enter the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, he would ultimately reveal his techniques! And it would be easy for others to discover his hidden identity.”
Emperor Summer could not understand it.
Few were qualified to rule a place as a tyrannical great devil.
And every one of them had techniques that allow them to survive against unparalleled existences! Hence, even though unparalleled existences were powerful, they were helpless against those great devils since they could not be killed! If they were to shed all pretense of cordiality, even if they killed the subordinates under the great devils, they would not care!
Devils were just selfish!
“What exactly is Younger Brother Flying Snow planning to do? Even if he chose to save those ants, there is no need to battle against Eight Silk Island Master right? It was fine if he acted once, but if he continued behaving and moving out against the devils, he would ultimately reveal himself.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon frowned as he watched the projected scene through the Heaven Observation Mirror.
Currently, those from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation who knew Xue Ying was that mysterious person included the three unparalleled existences and Sky-Rending Great Paragon.
As Xue Ying requested for it during the previous transaction, the three unparalleled existences and Sky-Rending Great Paragon naturally did not reveal it outside.
But Dao of Void experts in the Realm Heart Great Land that had reached the power of this ‘mysterious person’ could be counted with one’s fingers.
And in the future when Xue Ying used his real identity to battle, it would be easy for others to deduce who he was!
“It is slightly foolish. Or maybe he disregards the death of his clan? That’s right too since he reincarnated into this world, and shouldn’t have that much emotional attachment to the Ying Shan Clan.” Sky-Rending Great Paragon watched silently.
…
Various sides were watching the battle through their ‘Heaven Observation Mirror’.
The puzzling thing was that this mysterious person remained on the losing end despite engaging in the battle without withdrawing.
At a wilderness about half a trillion kilometers outside Fu Jun City, both parties were exchanging moves extremely quickly.
“Erupt!”
The incredibly fat Eight Silk Island Master extended both his hands. One hand turned into a sky curtain that covered the heavens, and the other hand appeared from deep underground as if it represented the earth.
One up and one down.
And at the center of the two incredibly vast palms, a black maelstrom started forming from the collapse of space.
The endless force was exerted on the body of Xue Ying.
“Myriad Untouchable Technique.”
The surface of Xue Ying’s body was covered in layers of space. He was currently trying his best to withstand against this heaven-defying destructive force. “Peng peng peng”, the layers of space exploded and broke apart this cage, diverting the incoming force into the higher dimension.
‘This technique is still slightly lacking. How should I improve it to reach grand perfection?’ Xue Ying executed his <Flying Snow Combat Technique>, discovering the flaws and pondering over how he should do to improve it.
In the past, he had always been comprehending in closed-door cultivation.
Only during life and death battles, especially when he did not understand the absolute moves of the other party’s Dao path, would it reflect the flaws of his techniques more glaringly. This allowed him to understand which path of improvement he should head towards. It was significantly helpful to his cultivation.
“Peng.” The remnant force from the black maelstrom struck on Xue Ying. With a flash, Xue Ying’s entire body became just like a thin piece of art, silently withdrawing far away.
“You only know how to dodge? With this little strength of yours?”
Eight Silk Island Master held the upper hand on all areas. He suppressed Xue Ying entirely.
Xue Ying, though, was on the disadvantaged end. Nonetheless, he did not get injured at all!
“Hahaha…” Xue Ying guffawed. He understood that continuously displaying the <Flying Snow Combat Technique> would cause the other party to suspect if he was a ‘final realm expert’! Because Xue Ying had not displayed any techniques making use of the profound mysteries from the ‘Dao of Void final realm’. He had no choice! Without relying on external strength, Xue Ying could not exert this power.
Since he had yet to comprehend it, how could he use it?
The only way he could rely on was the top-graded secret treasure, ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’.
“After reaching the final realm in the Dao of Void, a step further would be utilizing the Chaotic Origin Energy. I am merely experimenting with some of the cruder techniques making use of Chaotic Origin Energy yet you could not injure me at all. That’s fine. Since you want me to display my true power, then I shall satisfy you!” Xue Ying’s laughter reverberated across the world. He abruptly sent out a fist.
And the Void Fire Lotus Flower he had with him was activated.
This technique integrated the <Flying Snow Combat Technique> with the Void Fire Lotus Flower. In the past, before he dealt with Black Sovereign King, Xue Ying had thoroughly comprehended the Void Fire Lotus Flower, perfectly integrating it with his own Flying Snow Combat Technique. That caused his strength to soar by a few times!
“Hong hong hong~”
When Xue Ying punched out, an enormous illusory fist appeared in front of it. This illusory fist covered half the world. This fist contained many layers of illusory fist and was flooded with Chaotic Origin Energy.
Eight Silk Island Master’s expression changed when he saw it. He growled before sending out a fist too.
Final realm experts in the Dao of Strength felt disdain for dodging.
“Hong-”
Both fists.
The fist of Eight Silk Island Master was filled with an abyss of force. And Xue Ying’s strength carried numerous worlds and was flooded with Chaotic Origin Energy.
At the moment when both fists clashed, the entire world shook, causing many pitch-black holes to appear. One could see the higher dimension from here.
And the surging force blasted out in all directions.
This frightening shockwave was felt by all Cosmos Gods across the Realm Heart Great Land.
“Pu.”
Eight Silk Island Master was forced back from the impact. He even spat out fresh blood from the attack as countless spatial pockets were transmitted onto the plump flesh of his. In the end, some injuries were formed on his body.
It was only after a while did he gain his bearings, and that was when he looked at the distant white-robed male with astonishment.
This power was honestly insane!
“Don’t you want to see my true strength? Haha, I specialize in the Dao of Void, and what I specialize most is in avatars. This is just the power of an avatar of mine!” Xue Ying’s laughter shook the world. One could see the surrounding space of that white-robed young man distorting-one by one, similar white-robed males started appearing until a total of nine of them were present. They stared at Eight Silk Island Master with a frightening glare.
The expression of Eight Silk Island Master paled. He could not even fight against one of them, yet there were nine?

chapters.title: Chapter 1170 - Shocking the Great Land (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1170: Shocking the Great Land (2)
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
At this moment, the various superpowers in Realm Heart Great Land became incredibly solemn. Even ‘Emperor Summer’, ‘Emperor Cang’, ‘Ancestor Fan’, ‘Sky-Rending Great Paragon’, and ‘Southern Cloud King’ who knew about Xue Ying’s identity beforehand, felt ripples in their hearts.
Xue Ying merely revealed the power of an avatar of his, and that was sufficient to suppress a final realm expert, the ‘Eight Silk Island Master’. With nine great avatars working together, what level would he reach?
Thinking about it startled even unparalleled existences!
“The strength of this mysterious person…” The blue-robed Great Paragon Fuyi was also relying on his Destructive Realm Teleportation technique to watch that battle from afar, “If one avatar is this strong, nine great avatars working perfectly together would mean he has reached my level.”
Even with the power heart realm Great Paragon Fuyi reached felt waves being created in his heart.
Final realm experts who did not own any supreme-graded secret treasures might grasp more profound techniques than Great Paragon Fuyi, but they were not necessarily stronger than Great Paragon Fuyi in direct combat.
Great Paragon Fuyi once suppressed an ancient nation all by himself! And even with the intervention of Towering Sky King did he merely get suppressed.
But at the current moment, Great Paragon Fuyi had a feeling that this mysterious person could possibly be comparable to him in strength!
…
Various organizations were watching the battle nervously. They had a feeling that another terrifying existence would be emerging in the Realm Heart Great Land once again.
“Are you afraid now, Eight Silk Island Master? Don’t you want to witness my true power? Now that I am showing you my full power, you are instead terrified from it?” The nine white-robed male lightly tapped out at a single point with their finger.
“Hua.”
When the vast void was ‘tapped’ by the fingers, it abruptly flared up. Numerous tiny spatial pockets formed in the vast region of half a trillion kilometers. Every tiny spatial pocket contained a bubble within that started collapsing from the boundary. Just like a chain reaction, those spatial pockets began collapsing outside in. Given the strong perception of Cosmos Gods, they were able to witness this spectacle from afar.
But the rate of collapse was too quick. Within moments, the popping of those bubbles converged onto the center like a tsunami-the place where Eight Silk Island Master was located at.
Eight Silk Island Master tried fleeing. But with all the movements from the bubbles, he would remain always amidst the bubbles.
This was one of Xue Ying’s current three killing moves, the ‘Unbounded Illusory Bubble Dissipation’.
It was this move that Xue Ying used to kill Dust Brahman King, albeit he did not rely on the ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’ in the past. Even though he did not show the Void Fire Lotus Flower to the public this time, Xue Ying had brought it along and had activated the Void Fire Lotus Flower long before, which was why this technique spanned across a wider area and became even more destructive.
“Damn.” Eight Silk Island Master coldly scanned through his surroundings.
His pride as a final realm expert made him disdainful of escaping.
If he chose to run, even unparalleled existences could not hinder him! When the Dao of Strength reached the final realm, the cultivator would treat every inch in the Origin World as his plaything.
But this time, he did not choose to face the attack head-on. Instead, he chose to execute a technique to dissipate the incoming force. After all, who could compete with a Dao of Strength final realm expert in this aspect?
Eight Silk Island Master clasped his palms before his chest.
The surrounding region of about 33 meters around him became hazy. One could see this dull energy rotating in this region with the naked eyes that ground away all incoming force.
“Hong~”
Unbounded Illusory Bubble Dissipation!
Eventually, the biggest bubble exploded in the region where Eight Silk Island Master was! At the moment of destruction, an unseen force was directly transmitted onto Eight Silk Island Master. Nonetheless, this force faced an incredibly huge hindrance that caused Xue Ying’s expression to shift slightly. It seemed the force coming from this technique he executed was being diverted back to deal with his own technique. But fortunately, this was a technique executed in parallel by nine great avatars using the Void Fire Lotus Flower. Hence, the Chaotic Origin Energy being controlled was sufficiently huge and fierce, that even though a large portion of the force was diverted away, some remnant force still blasted out on the body of Eight Silk Island Master.
Eight Silk Island Master paled slightly. He could feel this shockwave permeating deep into his body.
“Pu.” Signs of blood could be seen permeating on his skin. He even spurted out a fresh mouthful of blood.
Eight Silk Island Master stared at the distant Xue Ying.
‘What an amazing defensive technique. His rate of force dissipation is so much more profound than my Myriad Untouchable Technique.’ Xue Ying felt impressed.
“Under the Supreme Law, the execution of an attack is simply an embodiment of different ‘force’.” Eight Silk Island Master looked at Xue Ying, growling, “Under ordinary circumstances, I should not be injured once I focus all my energy in defending. Yet I had not expected for you to control so much Chaotic Origin Energy!”
“I have no intention of becoming enemies with you. I only hope for your subordinates to kill less.” Xue Ying stated.
He did not want to make Eight Silk Island Master mad.
The moment he became mad…
If Eight Silk Island Master did not care about the lives of his subordinates, just him alone could massacre countless of people! And that was something Xue Ying did not wish to see.
Of course, Eight Silk Island Master did not dare to go overboard. Firstly, if he killed beyond a certain point, he would incur the wrath of many unparalleled existences. Secondly, that mysterious existence of Realm Heart Great Land, ‘Yuan’, might be happy to see the strong triumphing over the weak. But if he saw a huge massacre happening beyond the limit, that perpetrator would provoke ‘Yuan’, bringing about dire aftermath.
This was also the reason why Great Devils sent their subordinates to carry out the Blood Sacrifice instead of acting themselves.
‘Yuan’ was standing from a higher dimension looking down at the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Those who dared challenge Yuan would end up miserable.
Nevertheless, Xue Ying was different from ‘Yuan’.
Yuan could feel that some killing was normal for the weak to be eliminated. As long as the killing did not influence the overall order of the Realm Heart Great Land, he would not intervene in the battles.
But Xue Ying felt that it was pointless speaking about the ‘order of the entire Realm Heart Great Land’ to the weak cultivators! If all weak individuals died, the Realm Heart Great Land could no longer develop further! But if some of the weaker individuals died, it simply represented the normal danger one might face in the path of cultivation. When this logic was applied to a group of ultra-strong devils massacring cities, that would no longer be a form of tempering.
It was here that Xue Ying’s ideology differed from Yuan’s.
Yuan was too high up. He treated all cultivators as lower-grade lifeforms. He only had to nurture existences that could ‘jump out of the cage’! His thinking wasn’t wrong. Reaching his level, the countless lifeforms in the Origin World were simply two great levels weaker.
Yuan’s ideology was still relatively moderate.
Some of the more cruel and vicious Chaotic Origin Lifeforms did not mind sacrificing countless beings across a dozen Origin Worlds as long as an ultra-strong expert could emerge out of the cage. That was worth the price!
Currently, Xue Ying was still too weak. He could not influence Yuan and others. He could only continue on his own Dao path.
“You only wish for fewer killings to happen?” Eight Silk Island Master stared at the white-robed young man, “Why do you care so much about these ants? So what if a trillion ants die?”
“They have parents. They have wives and children and are also fighting for their fates… how can we treat them like ants, killing a trillion in one go?” Xue Ying shook his head.
“And if I chose to let my subordinates continue?” Eight Silk Island Master said.
“Then I can only continue killing them!” Xue Ying stared back at Eight Silk Island Master, “I shall wipe out every single subordinate of yours who dared to act! Unless you, Eight Silk Island Master, personally acted. I cannot stop you, but if you were to continue massacring millions and millions of beings… when ‘Yuan’ descends, nobody could save you by then.”
The plump face of Eight Silk Island Master twitched.
Yuan?”
All final realm existences and unparalleled existences might seem fearless, though, in their hearts, they feared ‘Yuan’ the most.
Once one reached their level, they would treasure their lives even more.
They desired to take that most important step of jumping out of this cage.
“What about other organizations? Black Devil Great Lake, Western Floating Nation, Devil Cloud Mountain, and Sacred Fire City?” Eight Silk Island Master continued, “Will you kill them as well?”
“Kill!” Xue Ying nodded, “Those who dare to massacre must be killed!”
At this moment-
There were honestly too many organizations spectating this battle. Even though those watching the battle through various items like the ‘Heaven Observation Mirror’ could not hear what was being spoken, they were all ultra-strong experts! They were able to easily determine through the movements of Xue Ying and Eight Silk Island Master’s mouths, as well as the change in their aura, to determine what they were talking about.
And those words which Xue Ying declared just now, was precisely a warning to all devil organizations across the Realm Heart Great Land. Those who dared to massacre would be killed!

chapters.title: Chapter 1171 - I am ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’
chapters.content:
Chapter 1171: I am ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
There had been cases of experts resisting against devils in the history of Realm Heart Great Land!
But so far, none of those who became enemies with all devils in the Realm Heart Great Land survived! After all, the stronger the expert, the more things they were concerned about. That group of experts standing at the apex of Realm Heart Great Land-unparalleled existences, final realm experts and a few Paragon Masters who could survive against the unparalleled existences.
Among that bunch of experts, there were some who were proud and aloof and some who calmly watched as countless beings were killed.
And even the one who was most concerned about the weak, ‘Limitless City Master’, chose to do so for the sake of balance in the world! As long as nature balance remained unaffected, he would watch coldly as things happen. Reaching his stage of cultivation, few would treat the most ordinary sentient beings as equivalent to them, treating them sincerely while protecting them.
And there were some within these experts that were worried about their clans or organizations.
As a result, nobody at the apex dared to stand against all devil organizations directly!
At least until now… where Xue Ying stood out!
It was not that Xue Ying was fearless.
There were some unparalleled existences with an incredibly heavy demonic personality that could bring disaster to Xue Ying if his identity was revealed!
Nonetheless, Xue Ying had made his preparations.
His avatars would carry the ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’ with them so as to disguise his combat strength. With this power, he would sufficiently terrify many devil organizations across the Realm Heart Great Land.
As for his true identity, ‘Monarch Flying Snow’, in the future when he chose to act, he would simply use the yet-to-be-refined Chaotic Origin Weapon! By relying on this Chaotic Origin Weapon, Xue Ying could execute more profound moves from the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> scripture. Naturally, the techniques his real identity executed would be vastly different from what his avatars use!
‘This is also temporary.’
‘None has reached the final realm in the Dao of Soul. If, and I say if I reached the final realm in my Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, I might be able to resolve this issue of dealing with the devils.’ Xue Ying pondered. Why were the devil organizations moving so wildly? Was it not because the could not die? If Xue Ying could kill them, it would naturally change the state of society in the Realm Heart Great Land.
If he could jump out of this cage and enter a higher level of life, Xue Ying might be able to influence Yuan, Luo City Lord, and others.
Xue Ying had interacted with Luo City Lord before. He felt that Luo City Lord does cherish the weak.
‘I think too much.’
‘The first step I should take is to reach the final realm in the Dao of Void! I have to do so before my hometown is destroyed.’ Xue Ying thought.
…
Deep in the Black Devil Great Lake.
Yama Religion Master and the other two religion masters were watching the battle through the Heaven Observation Mirror.
“Hmph.”
The three of them had ugly expressions.
“Second Brother, Third Brother, this mysterious Dao of Void expert is very tyrannical.” Yama Religion Master could no longer maintain his usual calmness. Frowning, he said, “His strength is strong-it is completely beyond mind! If he did not care about his face and choose to slaughter all the teams we send out, we might not even have the slightest of a chance to retaliate.”
Even though Black Devil Great Lake was ranked relatively high between devil organizations in the Realm Heart Great Land, the three religion masters were Paragon Masters-there were no final realm experts.
“Even Eight Silk Island Master was forced to take a step back. What can we do? We should temporarily lower our heads and see how Sacred Fire City reacts.” A green-robed paled man said.
“Mn.”
“Let’s see how it goes.”
In terms of power, Sacred Fire City was the strongest between the devil organizations.
…
“This Dao of Void expert is too insolent.”
“He chose to become enemies with all of us. Damn, if he dares to reveal his identity, I’ll certainly let him understand the consequences of challenging us.”
******
Even though the Great Devils in the world were feeling incredibly indignant at this moment, reaching their level, they were able to determine how frightening this mysterious expert was! In addition, nobody knew who this white-robed man was. Hence, they had no confidence in threatening and dealing with this man! As a result, no Great Devils dared to make a move against him once Xue Ying gave his declaration.
“Haha, hahaha…” Eight Silk Island Master who stood before Xue Ying guffawed, “Admirable. Truly admirable. I really admire you for becoming enemies with all devil organizations! Currently, your identity hasn’t been revealed. But the moment when all devils could no longer tolerate your existence and when your identity is revealed, hmph hmph hmph, the consequence would be a nightmare for you!”
“Nightmare?” Xue Ying sneered.
So what if he revealed his identity?
Flying Snow City had already been fortified to the extent that not one drop of water could leak. Even unparalleled existences could forget about dealing with him.
But at this moment, two names floated in the mind of Xue Ying-Emperor Summer and Undying Underworld Emperor!
These two existences were special.
Emperor Summer was incredibly famous. He was recognized as the number one expert in the Realm Heart Great Land for a long time. Various organizations knew that Emperor Summer had reached the final realm in the Dao of Void and the Dao of Flames! He even owned a supreme-graded secret treasure, boosting his strength significantly to an entire level beyond other unparalleled existences. ‘Eternal Night Primogenitor’ was forced to retreat after a short skirmish with him.
And Undying Underworld Emperor had been the number one expert across Realm Heart Great Land a very long time ago. Furthermore, he was known for being vicious and terrifying. His current strength was unpredictable too.
‘It is better for me to remain low-profile.’
‘Once my Chaotic Origin Weapon is refined. That should be when I am fully confident in my strength. If I could reach the final realm, it’ll be hard to determine who is the number one expert in the entire Realm Heart Great Land.’ Xue Ying thought. There were few supreme-graded secret treasures in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Fewer owned supreme secret impartation techniques! As for having a ‘supreme secret impartation technique along with an appropriate Chaotic Origin Weapon’, Xue Ying was unsure if there were anybody else other than him!
Even there was another person with it, the scarcity of supreme secret impartation techniques meant that fewer would own an appropriate weapon!
Furthermore, the ‘Dao of Void’ had a huge advantage over other Dao paths-avatars!
The Dao of Void was also one that was closest to the higher dimension as compared to other Daos. Hence, cultivators of this Dao could proceed to other Origin Worlds despite being stuck in the cage! They were able to absorb Chaotic Origin Energy to alter their souls and refine avatars out!
In the same realm.
Those who cultivated the Dao of the Void could form many avatars. Hence, they were completely stronger than those cultivating other Daos.
Naturally, what Xue Ying understood was based on the fact that there had been experts who reached the final realm in other Dao paths. As for the soul aspect like the ‘Mirage’, ‘Heart’, ‘Soul Fire’, and other Dao paths, none had reached the final realm in it! Hence, it was still unknown how strong an expert could be when he reached the final realm in this aspect!
…
“Sou.”
Eight Silk Island Master gave a sneer before his body became illusory. A tear was torn out of the void and he soon disappeared.
This was his way of escaping.
It was too difficult to kill any final realm experts!
‘My public declaration this time should have increased the alertness of some devil organizations right? As long as the number of massacres decreased, it’ll be a success for me.’ Xue Ying began leaving.
“Weng.”
Suddenly, a figure condensed from the void.
He was a relatively handsome male garbed with a black cape tinted with golden patterns. He currently held on to a scepter that was emitting golden light that formed an unseen power that enveloped over Xue Ying.
“Eternal Night Primogenitor.”
“It is Eternal Night Primogenitor.”
“Why did Eternal Night Primogenitor appear?”
Various organizations in the Realm Heart Great Land were startled.
Eternal Night Primogenitor held onto his scepter looking at Xue Ying coldly: “You must be the one that killed Black Sovereign King.”
“Black Sovereign King? Eternal Night Primogenitor must have made a mistake.” Xue Ying chuckled calmly and unhurriedly, “Even with my strength, I am not absolutely confident of killing Black Sovereign King. And in order to kill him before Primogenitor arrives, my confidence is even lower.”
“There are few Dao of Void experts in the Realm Heart Great Land who could kill Black Sovereign King.” Eternal Night Primogenitor sneered.
“How could that prove that it is me?” Xue Ying retorted.
“You care too much about those ants. The previous time, you acted to save those ants, which was why you ended up being intercepted by me once. It’s a pity that I let your avatar dissipate.” Eternal Night Primogenitor coldly said, “There are only so few Dao of Void experts, and only one out of all who are concerned over those weaklings. Hence, there is over a 90% chance that the murderer is you.”
Xue Ying frowned.
He did not wish to admit it.
After all, it was very hard to deal with Eternal Night Primogenitor.
“I am called Heaven’s Will, Heaven’s Will Daoist.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“Heaven’s Will Daoist?” Eternal Night Primogenitor frowned. There were no such apex experts. Did this mysterious person only rise recently? Or was he deliberately using a pseudonym?
“My Heart as the World. Heaven’s Will Daoist.” Xue Ying said.
“Hmph, even if you give yourself more names, you are still the murderer of Black Sovereign King.” The scepter in the hands of Eternal Night Primogenitor started shining out brightly. Endless light rays had already shone on the body of Xue Ying, causing an unseen restrictive force to be applied.
“Eternal Night Primogenitor, you can’t stop me from leaving.”
His voice shook the world grandly.
“Si la.”
A black crack was formed and Xue Ying had already rushed in. With his level-two Chaotic Origin Refinement Body and the auxiliary augmentation from the Void Fire Lotus Flower, Eternal Night Primogenitor’s domain restriction could not trap him at all.
“He escaped?” Eternal Night Primogenitor frowned when he saw the disappearing black cracks.
Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.
There was no way for him to chase after the other party!
Clearly, it was hard for unparalleled existences to kill those at this level.
…
As a result, the name ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’ started spreading across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
Many organizations were even discussing this expert who dared threaten all devil organizations. Even as he stood before ‘Eternal Night Primogenitor’, he could still easily escape. Hence, Heaven’s Will Daoist was publicly recognized as someone with strength second to unparalleled existences. Ordinary final realm experts were not his opponent.
And Xue Ying did not care about the discussions going out in the world. Within the Flying Snow City, he calmly meditated and pondered over the fourth killing move of the <Flying Snow Combat Technique> that was gradually being completed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1172 - The Fourth Killing Move
chapters.content:
Chapter 1172: The Fourth Killing Move
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
What was most important to Xue Ying would be to reach the final realm in his Dao of Void as soon as possible. The reason he chose to give a pseudonym, ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’, was because he did not wish to implicate Southern Cloud Nation and Ying Shan Clan! Currently, his strength was limited. His name would only make those devil organizations think twice! If Xue Ying were to reach the final realm, he could not only save some of the most important people in his life back at his hometown, furthermore, with a Chaotic Origin Weapon at hand, Xue Ying would be qualified to compete for the title as the ‘number one expert in Realm Heart Great Land’.
If Xue Ying ever reached that stage, his influence on those devils would be more terrifying.
“Ultimately, one has to rely on strength.” Xue Ying was clear of this point.
Only with strength could he take on a greater responsibility.
“The fourth killing move…”
In the Monarch Residence, within a pavilion by the side of a lake.
A white-robed young man sat cross-legged enjoying his warm wine. He was currently deep in thoughts. It was the same with his avatars as everyone was concentrating to deduce out the fourth killing move.
“The Void Fire Lotus Flower is a World-related Dao of Void secret treasure. It specializes in discharging a world domain or to convert the World Energy into amplifying one’s power.” Xue Ying thought. The top-graded secret treasure ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’ was refined using the rare treasure, ‘Fire Domain Soul Origin’ as the foundation. The Fire Domain Soul Origin was quite similar to the Sea Domain Origin which he once got-they were both origins of a realm.
Emperor Summer infused various profound mysteries of the final realm Dao of Void during the refinement of this top-graded secret treasure.
The outgoing World Energy would be used to amplify the strength of every avatar, allowing each avatar to become incredibly strong. It was also the method Xue Ying relied on to conceal his ‘Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes’.
“Discharging a world domain, I am the master within this domain.”
“This top-graded secret treasure is most appropriate for deducing a domain-related technique.” Both eyes of Xue Ying contained numerous inscriptions revolving and changing. The fourth killing move he was in the process of creating would be a domain-type technique.
The first three great killing moves.
They were all offensive in nature!
And as he was killing those devils, Xue Ying had to practically engulf an entire city with his techniques. Having done so several times, that surging killing intent had somehow inspired Xue Ying, giving him an idea of what the fourth killing move would be like.
“The world is filled with space.”
“Even the higher dimension beyond the Origin World is a type of space.”
“Space, by nature, is able to sustain the living of the myriad existences and everything. ‘Domain’ is a natural embodiment of space.” Xue Ying understood this point.
He had grasped several domain-related techniques before, such as the Scarlet Cloud Domain or various other domain techniques. But all those techniques were not qualified to be added as a killing move in his <Flying Snow Combat Technique> scripture! Techniques that could be classified as killing moves were techniques Xue Ying recognized as sufficiently perfect. These techniques would have been instilled with part of the profound mysteries of the Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes. They were sufficiently powerful and were techniques not any weaker than the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>.
“Domain…”
Xue Ying sat under the pavilion holding a cup filled with wine. Suddenly, he closed his eyes.
He thought of the higher dimension.
He recollected back to the experienced he had when executing the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique towards other Origin Worlds! His avatars had formed a ‘strand’ of passage as they carefully traveled through the higher dimension filled with endless Chaotic Origin Energy. Their fleshy bodies could not be used to traverse through this tunnel-only their souls could advance forward through the tunnels.
That feeling of suffocation.
The memories of being pressed down by the higher dimension were still fresh!
What Xue Ying sought to do would be to integrate the Dao of Void with the profound mysteries from the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> and make full use of the Chaotic Origin Energy to re-create that similar feeling of ‘domain’ which the higher dimension gave him. Under that domain, the current Xue Ying could only give up his fleshy body. His soul had to rely on the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to travel. How scary was that?
It would suffice for him to create a technique that could display a portion of this effect.
“Weng…”
Outside the pavilion, the void could be seen vaguely trembling.
Every piece of void essence-the black fog spherical particles-were shaking. In order to prevent his training from affecting others, Xue Ying had extended his energy to protect the fishes swimming underneath the lake, though other regions were not covered. For a moment, along with the fluctuations of Xue Ying’s heart force, ‘chi chi chi~’, the lake water, the tiles and bricks on the pavilion, the grass and flowers by the lake, the shrubs, the stone floor, the soil…
Everything seemed to maintain their original appearance.
Yet in reality, the tremble of the black fog spherical particles caused their internal structures to collapse. They were only temporarily maintaining their external appearances.
“Hong!”
All of a sudden, this enormous courtyard was destroyed. The entire world transformed into absolute darkness.
Xue Ying remained seated drinking his wine. The take, the wine flask and the praying mat underneath remained undamaged. The distant fish were still swimming in the darkness. As for all other regions, they had turned into absolute darkness and destruction.
Even though this enormous courtyard had turned into this, no disturbances were leaked out into the external world! Xue Ying forbade anyone from entering his place when he cultivated.
“Hua hua hua~” Those fish were hooked up by Xue Ying to his sides. They were all looking at their surroundings with their wide fish eyes and at Xue Ying.
“Weng.”
Many cracks were formed in the surrounding dark space with Chaotic Origin Energy engulfing in.
As the Flying Snow City was fortified with many arrays, Xue Ying’s current strength could match against the unparalleled existences. As a result, he had an easier time practicing his techniques. He could more easily control a larger amount of Chaotic Origin Energy in his territory.
“Leave no hole undrilled.” Xue Ying opened his eyes looking at the surging Chaotic Origin Energy from the numerous black cracks. The Chaotic Origin Energy weaved in together with the void to suppress on all fronts.
Suppress, suppress!
This suppression technique could suppress ordinary Cosmos Gods to death!
But clearly, it was still insufficient. What Xue Ying needed was a killing move that could cause unparalleled existences to feel ‘slight trouble’. If this technique could not affect unparalleled existences, there would be no purpose in creating it.
“Currently, it is still in its prototypical stage. I still have to perfect it.”
Along with the flowing of ideas in his mind, the surging Chaotic Origin Energy in this enormous courtyard was constantly being fused in different ways with the void.
After spending half a month or so attempting different permutations of integration.
“Hua.”
The courtyard regained its calm. The Chaotic Origin Energy began retreating out, and the void regained its normalcy. The light from the external world also shone onto this area.
As for the stone road, the soil, grass and flowers, the lake water and the pavilion, they began condensing from nothingness and descended back onto their original positions. Even the fish that had stayed by the side of Xue Ying were thrown back into the lake. ‘Ding dong’, the fish jumped out of the lake water looking at their surroundings, before falling back into the lake and continued their life.
Xue Ying poured himself another cup of wine. This courtyard contained ordinary items, and as a Dao of Mirage Cosmos God, he could easily construct them from illusion.
“I shall continue thinking.”
He discovered many problems during the trials over the past half a month. Xue Ying had to spend more time pondering over how to resolve those questions and perfect this technique.
******
At the same time when Xue Ying was perfecting his fourth killing move, those devil organizations across Realm Heart Great Land had been scared witless, especially since Cosmos Gods treasured their lives tremendously! Since this ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’ dared to publicly declare such statement, and as Eight Silk Island Master was stronger than them by an entire level, who would dare to offend this mysterious expert?
“Unless he plans on threatening all devils across the Realm Heart Great Land by himself?”
“Is he that mad?”
Even the devils did not dare believe it.
The Cosmos God Devils were well-informed. They knew of ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’s existence, and the threat this mysterious expert brought to them. But the Realm Heart Great Land was too big! There existed many Primal Chaos Devils with huge backings. As for those who did not have a huge supporter, many of them did not even know about the matter regarding ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’.
…
Time passed.
After three million years since the battle between Heaven’s Will Daoist and Eight Silk Island Master.
“Hahaha, the crazier and more bitter you are, the better! Hahaha, this Old Ancestor precisely requires all of you to hate me, hahaha…” A red-robed old man stood inside an Eden World. There were many souls within which were filled with resentment and hatred. A trillion souls were all howling in resentment. Some powerful experts were trying to struggle out of their restrictions and charge at the red-robed old man.
Nonetheless, the red-robed old man was a Primal Chaos expert. How could he ever be threatened by the souls of Unity Realm Experts?
“Hmph.”
A black crack was formed, and a white-robed male appeared within this Eden World.
Being the owner of this Eden Treasure, the red-robed old man was shocked. How could others enter his Eden Treasure?
When this white-robed male looked at him, the red-robed old man felt his soul becoming congealed.
“Hong.”
Following that, the red-robed old man simply shattered into pieces.
“Truly damnable.” Xue Ying’s gaze swept across the numerous souls. Many of those souls were filled with hatred. At the time of the red-robed old man’s death, the hatred from many of those souls began dissipating.
“I’ll send all of you out.”
With a thought, Xue Ying teleported the souls out of this place! This Eden Treasure contained restrictions from an array, forcing them to maintain the state of a soul.
The weakest among them were True Gods, and they could easily regain their fleshy bodies by absorbing World Energy.
…
Nine million years after the battle between Heaven’s Will Daoist and Eight Silk Island Master.
“Jia Yu, are you regretting it now? Today, your entire clan and the entire city must die!” n old devil stood in midair. He was currently emitting an aura of murder and was being incomparably mad.
A violet-robed girl watched at this in despair.
That time, he offended this old devil for the sake of saving another. And now, this old devil grew so much and chose to come here for vengeance?
“Mn?”
The violet-robed girl ‘Jia Yu City Master’ watched in shock as an enormous white tender palm appeared from nothingness. Following which, it pressed down. That old devil who was originally unbridled did not have time to escape was soon turned into pieces.
…
As time passed, the world witnessed the authenticity in the words spoken by Heaven’s Will Daoist.
Those who dared killed wilfully were all wiped out without pardon.
This had indeed brought fear to many powerful Cosmos God Devils. For a moment, none of them dared to act recklessly.
“We should restrain ourselves.”
“Given how brash this Heaven’s Will Daoist is, he’ll definitely not have a good ending! Wait until his identity is revealed. By then, he would know what is called regret.”
“We should endure and temporarily not fight against him. It is impossible for him to suppress us forever in this Realm Heart Great Land.” These devils had patience. They believed that this Heaven’s Will Daoist would not live for long given how overbearing and tyrannical he was.
…
To Xue Ying, this was a simple ‘action’ of his after receiving news while cultivating. After resolving the problem, he would resume his cultivation.
Ten million years after the battle with Eight Silk Island Master.
“Hahaha, hahaha…” Within the Monarch Residence, in the pavilion by the lake, Xue Ying suddenly guffawed. His laughter was bright and filled with delight.

chapters.title: Chapter 1173 - Taking this path
chapters.content:
Chapter 1173: Taking this path
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying extended his palm with it turning illusory. A maelstrom began forming within with Chaotic Origin Energy gathering at the center of the maelstrom. This maelstrom continued rotating just like how a wave rushed up onto the shore tenaciously.
Ten million waves were rushing out at the same time. There were even undercurrents stirring underneath the waves.
Various energies were either crowding out or sweeping along or pressing on one another…
This was simulated by Xue Ying after he went through the experience of traveling through the higher dimension to his best abilities-it was the best understanding he had of the Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes and the Dao of Void! It was a technique that satisfied him immensely. Even though he had another great killing move under his arsenal-a domain killing technique that was incredibly helpful, Xue Ying was more delighted over the fact that he had deepened his understanding of the ‘Dao of Void’.
Although the gradual progression of the realm seemed mysterious.
In reality, what he felt most intense for was that he lacked a single step toward fusing all branches together-to reach the ‘final realm’. But this single step easily clouded his vision of prodding his way towards the destination.
But with each progression in the realm, it was akin to the dispersion of some ‘fog’, allowing him to see more of his surroundings!
“I feel that I have improved greatly after completing this technique and is one step closer to the final realm!”
“It’s just that I have already applied all my understanding during this period of time on completing this move. Hence, it’ll be hard for me to improve further temporarily.”
“But I do not have much time.”
Xue Ying thought.
A cultivator would breakthrough after accumulating sufficient cultivation. And after that, he would require an even longer time to accumulate again! The journey towards the final realm was destined to be difficult. It required a cultivator to accumulate time after time, breaking through until the final step where the cultivator reached the pinnacle of a Dao! By then, the Dao of Void would no longer puzzle him any longer!
Even Southern Cloud King, Great Paragon Fuyi and many other talented experts were stuck at the bottleneck.
Even though Xue Ying was a peerless talent, it was still very difficult for him to reach the final realm before his hometown Origin World enters apocalypse.
“I shall use another World Flower.” Xue Ying thought.
Recalling back, Xue Ying felt that it was quite extravagant for him to consume the World Flowers one after another back at the Realm Heart God Palace. But the outcome was a supreme secret impartation technique, <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>. Furthermore, it was accompanied by the refinement method of an appropriate Chaotic Origin Weapon. Hence, it was worth the price! This was a supreme secret impartation technique, a scripture that would supplant him with a profound understanding of the Dao of Void. After all, the integration of the ‘Dao of Void and Chaotic Origin Energy’ was by nature an incredibly complex utilization of the Dao of Void.
…
At his hometown, another World Flower bloomed. Xue Ying entered the world to experience everything.
…
As Xue Ying cultivated, he would occasionally come out ‘to kill the devils’.
Whenever some devils dared to start a massacre, Xue Ying would not be merciful at all.
Within Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, underneath a relatively luxurious residence in one of the huge cities, in an underground palace.
A handsome devilish young man sat cross-legged with a black bottle placed before him. He took in a deep breath. At that moment, large amounts of souls started flying into his mouth.
“Mn, my ‘Three Calamitous Fire’ is about to be completed.” The handsome devilish young man grinned. He opened his mouth and spat. A black flame could be seen shooting out. This black flame was filled with a bloody and vicious aura.
“It’s all because of Heaven’s Will Daoist whose presence intimated everyone, making my collection of these souls sluggish. Currently, my realm has reached the required level. I am only lacking in souls.” The eyes of that handsome devilish young man were filled with a strand of fury. Even though he felt indignant, he was helpless. That Heaven’s Will Daoist was too powerful! Even his clan’s Old Ancestor was stronger than the Heaven’s Will Daoist, he could not kill the other party.
His teacher had already given him a strict order to endure temporarily.
But the desire to grow stronger drove him out to gather souls surreptitiously.
“Given how tyrannical he is, he’ll definitely not last for a long time. In the future, he’ll definitely not have a good conclusion.” The handsome devilish young man felt hatred as with many other devils towards that Heaven’s Will Daoist. It was only they who dared not treat him as their enemy.
“Chi.”
A black crack flashed.
And a white-robed male appeared in the underground palace.
When the handsome devilish young man saw the white-robed male appear, he felt as if a bucket of cold water had been poured on him. He watched in a daze; his heart was trembling, his legs softened and his face paled.
“Heaven, Heaven, Heaven’s Will…” The handsome devilish young man was terror-stricken.
Heaven’s Will Daoist.
He suppressed all devil organizations in Realm Heart Great Land all by himself!
He once defeated the final realm Great Tyrant Devil, ‘Eight Silk Island Master’.
‘Black Sovereign King’ of the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation seemingly fell in his hands too.
Even though this handsome devilish male was filled with all sorts of grievances and killing intent, all those thoughts vanished the moment he saw ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’. Instead, he was filled with terror! Too terrifying! How could this Era Overlord be someone he as a Level-Nine Primal Chaos handle?
“I wouldn’t have thought that you have harmed so many living beings.” Xue Ying glanced at the black jade bottle. The souls in the bottle numbered in billions. It was likely for this devil to have harmed even more people. It was only because he conducted his acts relatively well-hidden. Even Southern Cloud Sacred Religion’s intelligence network found out about it recently from a Unity Realm Disciple from the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion. That disciple’s true love had been killed, causing him to trace down where the enemy was dogmatically before he finally found out the truth!
“I am from the Inferno Clan. You can’t kill me.” The handsome devilish young man shouted out in fear.
“Die.”
Xue Ying’s eyes flashed coldly.
The handsome devilish young man widened his eyes. His eyes were filled with terror and shock. He felt regret and unwilling. He did not want to die. He did not wish to die! He still sought to become a Cosmos God. Being a disciple from the Inferno Clan, he had spent his days creating disasters willfully in all places. He did not have enough of those joyful days still!
“Peng.”
His body simply shattered into dust.
“Ai.” Xue Ying looked at that black jade bottle sighing lightly. He waved his hand before keeping it. He was still in the territory of the Inferno Clan. It would be better for him to leave the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation before releasing these pitiful people.
Just a breath of time later.
“Heaven’s Will Daoist!” An indignant roar reverberated across the sky above this city. The Inferno Clan was a clan created by an unparalleled existence. They were different from the experts in Summer Wind Ancient Nation. The five ancestors in the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation were outsiders who relied on the Realm Heart Order to reincarnate in. That was when they chose to reproduce and form clans, though only two great clans were made in the end.
And Inferno Clan was one of the two great clans in Myriad Realms Ancient Nation.
Such a power…
Yet Heaven’s Will Daoist still dared to kill a core member of their clan within the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation? Was this not challenging the entire Inferno Clan?
“This disciple from the Inferno Clan massacred a trillion sentient beings. Since he has become a devil, I’ll kill him like how I killed others!” A voice sounded out across the entire city and following that, Heaven’s Will Daoist left.
…
Time was the true testimonial.
Heaven’s Will Daoist was indeed vicious.
He did not care who the party was or how huge his background was! Those who dared to create calamity were all killed!
He killed until some of the core members from the superpowers started trembling. They were all ruthless in the past, massacring countless just for the sake of ‘entertainment’! Some even caused the death of many weaker lifeforms just because they chose to spar and test out their techniques. To them, they did not care since it was equivalent to killing some ants.
Currently, all of them were given a strict order! In addition to the reputation of Heaven’s Will Daoist created by blood, some of the disciples from the great clans in the six great ancient nations started becoming more conservative.
Southern Cloud Capital.
“Teacher.”
Xue Ying came to visit Southern Cloud King. Southern Cloud King passed a silver wristband over to him, chuckling out: “Xue Ying, even though these precious materials you require aren’t hard to get, there are honestly too many of them, that I spent 80 million years to finish gathering them.”
“It’s quite fast already, at least much faster than I expected.” Xue Ying chuckled. He was clear how much easier it was to procure these precious materials as compared to the ‘Chaotic Origin Sand’. Nevertheless, it was still a complicated task. His human network could hardly be compared to his teacher’s. Furthermore, prior to selling his top-graded secret treasures, unless he made use of the contribution points from Summer Wind Ancient Nation to exchange for most treasures, he would not have sufficient cosmos crystals.
The Chaotic Origin Sand was gathered through the trade with the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
And thus, Xue Ying was not too willing to collect the other materials from the same place! Even though they did not have any refinement recipe and he believed Emperor Summer and others could not determine anything just from the materials alone, Xue Ying did not wish for any screw-ups.
“I’ve finally gathered them.” Looking at the silver wristband, Xue Ying extended his senses across all materials within for an examination before revealing a grin.
All gathered.
He could finally begin his refinement of the Chaotic Origin Weapon!
“Xue Ying.” Southern Cloud King added, “During the past few years, your identity as the Heaven’s Will Daoist has forced those devils to be on alert. But if you continued on with you act, you will eventually tie yourself up with more enmity and grievances! You do not even let disciples from the great clans in the ancient nations off. Hence, you will only form more enemies. It is fine if your identity isn’t revealed. But the moment it is, you would become enemies with the entire world.”
“How could I be enemies with the entire world? I think it’s simply becoming enemies with all devils.” Xue Ying gave a peal of apathetic laughter, “So what if there are more enemies? Even if I have to face all of them by myself, I will still do it! Furthermore, those devils understood what it means to be terrified. I’ll simply kill until they are afraid and no longer dare to commit any vicious acts.”
Southern Cloud King softly nodded.
He felt apprehensive towards this disciple of his who was about to prod into muddied waters. But it appeared his disciple was filled with resolution.
And currently, all devils across the Realm Heart Great Land had indeed been threatened by just ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’ himself!
“You should be careful. There has been none who could truly intimidate those devils in the Realm Heart Great Land for eternity.” Southern Cloud King reminded.
“Teacher, you don’t have to be worried. Even though nobody has done it before.” Xue Ying chuckled, “Paths are meant to be taken by us! I believe that given enough time, there will be someone who would choose to take this path.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1174 - Gratitude towards the Savior
chapters.content:
Chapter 1174: Gratitude towards the Savior
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“I want to eradicate all Blood Sacrifices and massacres in this vast Origin World. Those who dare to slaughter others will die. I might not be able to deal with some of the Great Tyrant Devils, but I will still walk further down this path. Who knows if there would be a day that I can deal with them?” Xue Ying smiled at his teacher.
As Southern Cloud King looked at the smile on his disciple, he finally understood what was the difference between them.
He and an absolute majority of other cultivators focused more on ‘themselves’. Only by living could they possibly climb to the peak of the Dao.
As for his disciple?
His Dao Heart was like a blade. If there was no path forward, he would hack out a path! He was willing to create a new Dao path for all weaker lifeforms! Maybe it was this determined Dao Heart of his which remained ever so persevering and resolute that gave rise to his rapid improvement.
“You would have to jump out of the cage before you can deal against those Great Tyrant Devils.” Southern Cloud King said.
“Who knows if I might be able to do so? Aren’t all us cultivators chasing after this dream?” Xue Ying chuckled, “Teacher, this disciple will first make his move then.”
He was still in a rush to go back and refine his weapon.
The matter of refining the Chaotic Origin Weapon must not be delayed!
******
That day.
Flying Snow City, Monarch Residence. In a secret underground room.
“Hong long long~” The doors to this secret room were shut close. Many inscriptions appeared on them. The entire Flying Snow City had been constructed and fortified by Xue Ying to the extent that nothing could ever enter. And this process of refining the Chaotic Origin Weapon was also the most important task currently in which he had to proceed with extreme vigilance.
A white-robed Xue Ying sat cross-legged on a praying mat within the meditation room. Waving his hand, he lit an incense, causing the fragrant smoke to pervade in the room.
Xue Ying first calmed his heart down.
The entire refinement process for the Chaotic Origin Weapon inscribed on the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> began flashing in his mind. Given his current realm, the refinement process was not a hard task for him. Rather, it was mired in minor details. It was clear that ‘Yuan’ had considered this point before-he had to simplify things for the juniors. This refinement process was thus divided into more than 10,000 different sections, and every section became much easier.
“I should be able to finish refining the weapon in 10 billion years. Even though this refinement process is complex, it isn’t too difficult. It is fine for me to arrange an avatar focusing on this task.” Xue Ying thought.
Even though he could maintain nine avatars at their peak strength, refining a weapon must not be rushed. It had to be taken step by step. Hence, one avatar would suffice.
“Hua.”
All the materials were prepared.
