With a thought, Xue Ying brought out 16 different materials. Among them included some burning with peculiar fire, some in a state of liquid, and some were flowers. Those materials were infused into the fire. Every step required the application of different profound mysteries by Xue Ying in guiding Chaotic Origin Energy into the fire, allowing it to grow stronger until it finally reached an unfathomable stage. This was merely the initiation step of ‘igniting the flame’. The step of melting the Chaotic Origin Sand was truly an arduous task.
…
Many devils living on the Realm Heart Great Land were waiting for the day Heaven’s Will Daoist reveal his identity.
But they did not know…
That this ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’ was currently refining a horrifying Chaotic Origin Weapon.
Time passed.
Throughout this period, even though Xue Ying had left an avatar refine the weapon cautiously, the other avatars remained living life as per normal-cultivating. He previously consumed a World Flower, allowing him to have a newer understanding of the ‘Dao of Void’ and granting him great inspirations. Hence, Xue Ying was spending this period consolidating his knowledge and extrapolating what he knew, increasing his understanding of the Dao.
At the same time, Xue Ying would appear as Heaven’s Will Daoist at many of the massacre calamities that were happening in Realm Heart Great Land.
Even though he had publicly declared that he would kill all devils, and some disciples from great clans of the six great ancient nations had met their end, the Realm Heart Great Land was honestly too big! There could be some devils rising in a certain corner of the Origin World! After all, quite a huge number of cultivators chose to walk down the path of a devil in the long period of cultivation. This ‘devil path’ meant that cultivators could seize resources from others easily. There were also some cultivation techniques that made use of souls, and the more vicious their means of collecting these souls, the faster the speed of cultivation.
As a result, it was natural for many devils to exist across the Realm Heart Great Land which was a vast Origin World. Many of them did not have any background. Hence, the weaker devils had never heard of the name ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’.
Even though those without backgrounds had weaker strength, their destructive capabilities were not any weaker.
…
“It is your glory to die for the religion master.” An old devil sat on a throne looking at the captured cultivators before him.
Suddenly-
A white-robed male appeared from nothingness. He stared at that old devil coldly: “Since you dare harm the innocent, you only have one path awaiting-death.”
The moment the old devil saw Xue Ying appearing, he felt his heart tremble. Even though he did not know of the existence of ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’, the other party was emitting a frightening suppression that pressed him down through the void, terrifying this old devil. He understood that the gap between them was too big. The old devil immediately slid down from his throne onto his knees.
He begged: “Mercy, mercy! Please spare my life, senior! I know my wrong. I’ll change! I am willing to pledge my life for senior!”
This old devil had already become used to lowering his heart before an expert in his long years of cultivating.
Many cultivators beneath became worried when they saw the old devil kneeling down and beg for mercy-they were worried that the expert would choose not to kill the devil and to disregard them.
“Pledge your life to me? Do you think you qualify?” Xue Ying snorted emotionlessly.
A spatial ripple was sent over.
And the body of that old devil silently disintegrated.
Xue Ying turned around toward the cultivators. Waving his hand, he muttered: “Everyone, go and live your life.”
He then simply teleported over to the entrance of a huge city.
…
And that was how Xue Ying spent his years-killing devils and saving innocent beings.
Even though the devils were gritting their teeth, many more felt gratitude towards this senior.
“It is good to live and be alive”
“Grandpa, it is a white-robed man who saved us.”
“Mn mn, your parents have passed away. If you were to encounter a mishap, I truly do not know what to do.” A cultivator hugged a child muttering to himself. In his heart, he felt gratitude toward that savior.
…
“We are alive!” There were companions who held each other crying joyfully after surviving through the calamity.
…
“I’ll never forget this gratitude of saving my life.” Many cultivators etched this gratitude in their hearts.
…
There were many who felt gratitude toward Xue Ying.
And there was even a little lass who had a mysterious origin.
“Princess, the Monarch has already mentioned before that Realm Heart Great Land is very dangerous. It is forbidden for you to enter, yet you still sneaked out. See what happened? You have just left before encountering a Great Devil! If you were to die in the hands of that devil, do you know how broken-hearted the Monarch would feel?” A black-robed man said with a low voice. His voice was filled with slight fear.
The female child by the side simply looked up to the distant horizons: “I know I am wrong. Uncle Qiu, do you know who is the person that saved me?”
“According to the intelligence of Realm Heart Great Land, that white-robed man is an expert who intimidated all devils in the Realm Heart Great Land just by himself. He is called Heaven’s Will Daoist.” The black-robed man said, “This time, it is thanks to Heaven’s Will Daoist. Otherwise, otherwise…”
“Heaven’s Will Daoist?” The eyes of that lass brightened.
“Let’s go. Let’s hurry back home.” The black-robed man said.
“Do you know where Heaven’s Will Daoist stays? I want to go and have a look.” The lass said.
“It is still a mystery who the Heaven’s Will Daoist is. How would I know where he stays?” The black-robed man said.
“All of you, go and investigate for me. I want to find him.” The lass ordered.
“Princess, we have no ways of investigating! Heaven’s Will Daoist is someone who offended all devils across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. It is impossible for him to reveal his true identity so how could we proceed?” The black-robed male said. Just as he finished speaking, starlight began condensing by his side, forming a sparkling luxurious-looking male.
“Monarch.” This black-robed male bowed respectfully.
The sparkling male turned to his daughter still feeling the lingering fear. He chided: “You are really naughty and mischievous! In order to prevent me from finding out where you ran to, you chose not to bring along your communication treasure. Do you know that you have almost died?”
“Isn’t everything fine now?” The lass lowered her head and answered in a soft voice.
“Hmph. It seems you are getting more and more daring. It seems I will have to monitor you more strictly from now on.” The sparkling male grabbed the small hand of that lass, “Let us return.”
“Father, father, I want to see Heaven’s Will Daoist!” The lass shouted out.
That sparkling male was momentarily startled. He indifferent replied: “I’ll arrange my subordinates to carry out an investigation in the Realm Heart Great Land. The moment I find out who the Heaven’s Will Daoist is, I’ll bring you along to visit him, and to show him my gratitude for saving you.”
Saying that, he brought along his daughter’s hand and disappeared from the place.
…
This act of saving countless people resulted in many cultivators feeling grateful to Heaven’s Will Daoist. And Xue Ying felt satisfied with what he had done. That was how he lived his life.

chapters.title: Chapter 1175 - The Fury of Eternal Night Primogenitor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1175: The Fury of Eternal Night Primogenitor
In a luxurious palace hall.
Garbed in luxurious golden robes, a handsome young man with a crown on his hand sat casually on his throne. To his side stood an enchanting girl in black muslin dress pouring wine for the man.
Beneath the man sat two guests who were similarly served by a beautify servant each.
One of the guests was a short black-robed old man. He was none other than the city master of the most infamous gathering place for devils across the Realm Heart Great Land, ‘Sacred Fire City’. Being a final realm expert, the reason why Sacred Fire City was publicly recognized as the top gathering place for devils had been because of his life-long brother-’Iron Eagle Palace Master’, an unparalleled existence.
Across the entire Realm Heart Great Land, other than the unparalleled existences leading the six great ancient nations and Undying Underworld Emperor, there were two other unparalleled existences.
Not all unparalleled existences chose to build an ancient nation.
Iron Eagle Palace Master was one of them. He was known for being the most low-profile unparalleled existence. He did not spread any religion, and neither did he command a huge superpower. Instead, he chose to cultivate in his Iron Eagle Palace without meddling with other affairs. It was because of this life-long brother in addition to Sacred Fire City Master being a final realm expert personally made ‘Sacred Fire City’ the number one gathering place for devils.
The other was a humanoid flying insect. He was covered in black scales and had a pair of crystalline wings on his back. There were also two soft feelers protruding from his head. He was Insect Ancestor, an even more mysterious unparalleled existence.
“Mn, what is it today for guests to have arrived?” The handsome young man chuckled from his throne.
Light began condensing within the palace hall, forming a male covered in a black cape with golden patterns on it. He had a white tender face and cold eyes. He was one of the two famous unparalleled existences governing the Primogenitor Ancient Nation, ‘Eternal Night Primogenitor’.
“You are here, Eternal Night.” The golden-robed handsome young man chuckled. He lightly waved his hand before causing another table to appear at the frontmost location before him, “Come, I am currently receiving both Sacred Fire City Master and Insect Ancestor. You came at the right time. Come and have a taste at the food I prepared.”
Eternal Night Primogenitor swept his gaze across.
Sacred Fire City Master? Insect Ancestor?
There were merely final realm experts who did not own any supreme-graded secret treasures.
“Underworld Emperor.” Eternal Night Primogenitor indifferently stated, “The transaction which we agreed on previously has to be altered.”
“Alter? What is there to be altered?” Undying Underworld Emperor remained laying back on the beauty by his side. He smiled, looking downwards at the primogenitor.
“It was originally possible for me to nurture out the three ‘final realm’ Resentment Spirits which you require initially after spending some time. But now, that Heaven’s Will Daoist is simply too mad. Whenever any huge massacres happen in the Realm Heart Great Land, he’ll act and kill all devils mercilessly. This way, it’ll be very difficult to complete the request you have, Underworld Emperor.” Eternal Night Primogenitor mentioned, “I feel that one ‘final realm’ Resentment Spirit should be sufficient.”
Resentment Spirit.
That was a soul filled with endless resentment and hatred, so much so that the soul would have been transformed in certain ways. ‘Final realm’ Resentment Spirit represented a legend. Such Resentment Spirits were filled with endless hatred and killing intent that it could kill wipe out ordinary Primal Chaos experts just from the aura.
But that was also the limit.
An even stronger Resentment Spirit could never defeat a Cosmos God! Hence, ‘Resentment Spirits’ were simply a small Dao not worth mentioning.
But since ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ required them, Eternal Night Primogenitor had once agreed on it during a past transaction. He was after all the leader of an ancient nation. It would be much easier for him to conduct such matters as compared to Undying Underworld Emperor who had left Realm Heart Great Land for far too long.
“You are one of the two Great Primogenitors in the Primogenitor Ancient Nation. Can’t you even complete such a minor task?” Undying Underworld Emperor shook his head.
“Even if I arranged for such matters to be done in my ancient nation, that Heaven’s Will Daoist will similarly hinder it.” Eternal Night Primogenitor shook his head, “Nurturing a final realm Resentment Spirit requires a voluminous amount of souls.”
Undying Underworld Emperor looked downward at Eternal Night Primogenitor before giving a soft chuckle.
Eternal Night Primogenitor felt his expression changed slightly.
He could feel that the satire filled in the laughter of Undying Underworld Emperor.
Given how proud Eternal Night Primogenitor was, who would dare show disdain for him in this Realm Heart Great Land?
“Eternal Night, we have both agreed in the past, and sworn our oaths. I have also given you 10% of the stuff we agreed on.” Undying Underworld Emperor’s handsome face started becoming cold. His eyes were filled with frost, “Why, are you saying that you can’t complete the transaction now? That you want to alter it? Do you find me someone who is easy to talk to?”
An unseen aura of death started forming in the entire palace hall.
Both Insect Ancestor and Sacred Fire City Master felt their expressions changing from this.
And Eternal Night Primogenitor who was the main target of that terrifying death aura, felt his heart tightening. He even felt a feeling of threat that came as one entered the higher dimension.
‘This Undying Underworld Emperor once suppressed everyone in the past to acquire the opportunity of becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Over the long years, he is finally back. It seems he has failed, though it is certain that he has become much stronger.’ Eternal Night Primogenitor felt frustrated in his heart, yet he could only endure.
A very long time ago, Eternal Night Primogenitor was clear that Undying Underworld Emperor was the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land. It should most likely be comparable to the current Emperor Summer.
As for now?
Eternal Night Primogenitor was unsure. He felt that Undying Underworld Emperor would have become more powerful, and his techniques more profound.
“Underworld Emperor, I dare to bully others, but how would I dare bully you? You should know that Heaven’s Will Daoist is very hard to deal with. He doesn’t seem strong, just that killing him is very difficult. Furthermore, he is determined to hinder my affairs. Hence, it is very difficult to gather the three final realm Resentment Spirits within this timeframe.” Eternal Night Primogenitor answered.
“Even if it is difficult, you should still do it. That had been agreed on by you in the past, so you should complete what you promised. If you were to go against the oath, it is fine too as long as you are willing to accept the consequences of doing so.” Undying Underworld Emperor sneered.
Eternal Night Primogenitor became silent for a breath of time. Only then did he mumbled: “Alright.”
Following that, his figure dissipated.
“Hmph hmph.”
Undying Underworld Emperor snorted coldly a few times.
As for Insect Ancestor and Sacred Fire City Master, they merely looked at each other without speaking. Even though they were not afraid of unparalleled existences, it was better for them not to put themselves in the businesses between unparalleled existences.
…
“Damn!” Eternal Night Primogenitor was genuinely angry at this moment.
It had been so long since someone dared to show disdain on him!
But Eternal Night Primogenitor understood that since Emperor Summer could injure him in a short period, this ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ who was even more unfathomable, could possibly be stronger than Emperor Summer. That was also the reason why Eternal Night Primogenitor felt cautious towards the Underworld Emperor.
But-
When Eternal Night Primogenitor chose to work together with Extreme Night Primogenitor, they dared to fight with the three unparalleled existences from Summer Wind Ancient Nation! Hence, if they truly became enemies, he was confident of dealing against Undying Underworld Emperor by working with Extreme Night. It was just that he had sworn an oath in the past! And he had been the one who requested for it in fear of Undying Underworld Emperor going against his words.
Now that the oath had been fixed, Undying Underworld Emperor was unwilling to alter it. If he chose to go against it, it would affect his heart realm tremendously, making it even more hopeless for him to jump out of the cage.
‘I shall wait a little longer.’ Eternal Night Primogenitor thought.
‘Isn’t it just final realm Resentment Spirits? This time, I shall personally watch. Heaven’s Will Daoist? Hmph hmph, since you dare to intrude in my business, I shall uncover who you truly are.’
…
Eternal Night Primogenitor started moving.
He sent all Cosmos God subordinates who had avatars out to begin collecting souls. He did not choose to do what he did previously, which was to nurture Resentment Spirits in 19 cities openly and allowing nature take its course. Even though its effects were good, it would easily be intervened by the ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’. Hence, it would be better for him to collect all souls before slowly using other methods. Even though it might require more souls, at least it would not affect the overall balance of the Realm Heart Great Land. That ‘Yuan’ did not care about battles between the ants within the cage.
Large amounts of souls were being collected.
Eternal Night Primogenitor was especially paying close notice to it.
In the blink of an eye, this collection had continued silently for more than 100 million years without capturing the attention of Heaven’s Will Daoist while ensuring that things were kept within the boundaries of the balance of the world.
Even though Eternal Night Primogenitor had plans of dealing with Heaven’s Will Daoist, it would naturally be better if Heaven’s Will Daoist did not discover it.
“Harming countless sentient beings? Damn, all of you should die!”
In the night sky, a white-robed male appeared above a vast city. His face was filled with fury and his voice boomed across the world. Waving his hand, a terrifying spatial crack was torn across the sky. It immediately blasted out on one of the Cosmos Gods, directly turning him into pieces! This was merely an ordinary Cosmos God Eternal Night Primogenitor chosen with avatars.
Even Black Sovereign King had died from the hands of the Heaven’s Will Daoist, so Eternal Night Primogenitor would naturally not be willing to take the risk. Neither would Eternal Night Primogenitor be willing to dispatch some of the more important subordinates of his.
“Mn?”
Within this vast city, on the peak of a mountain, Eternal Night Primogenitor who was covered in a black cape with golden patterns was currently looking at the distant white-robed male. Xue Ying acted too quickly. The moment he descended, an ultra-long distance killing move came with it, killing the Cosmos God in one fell swoop! Eternal Night Primogenitor did not even have sufficient time to obstruct him. But since this was merely an avatar, it was fine for it to die.
‘In the end, you are still here to intervene in my affair. I have been very careful, doing things covertly. I did not provoke you yet you chose to provoke me?’ At that moment, Eternal Night Primogenitor’s fury charged up into the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 1176 - Playing Tricks on Eternal Night Primogenitor (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1176: Playing Tricks on Eternal Night Primogenitor (1)
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying originally had an avatar refining the Chaotic Origin Weapon and other avatars cultivating. He wanted to reach the final realm as soon as possible.
And whenever information was sent over by the Southern Cloud Sacred Religion intelligence network, he would casually send an avatar over to kill the devils.
Before killing the devils, Xue Ying had covered the entire city with his senses, yet he did not discover Eternal Night Primogenitor at all. Clearly, as an owner of a ‘supreme-graded secret treasure’, Eternal Night Primogenitor was quite formidable in certain aspects.
‘He actually dared to plunder so many souls?’ Xue Ying’s body flashed before appearing within a dilapidated residence. That Cosmos God had turned into ashes, leaving behind some items of his. Xue Ying’s control was exquisite-he did not damage those items at all. He picked up a black bottle found amidst the pile and examined that a large number of souls were stored within. He could not help but frown; a strand of killing intent rose from his body.
‘It seems that the devil I killed was from the Primogenitor Ancient Nation.’ Xue Ying frowned.
Before he revealed his identity, Xue Ying was not afraid of Eternal Night Primogenitor and Extreme Night Primogenitor.
But if his identity was revealed, things would be disastrous!
Hence, Xue Ying did his best not to provoke Eternal Night Primogenitor and Extreme Night Primogenitor.
‘They are unparalleled existences. Previously, it was his subordinate Black Sovereign King who brought calamity down on 19 cities. And now, it is this ordinary Cosmos God ‘Naufal’ who is viciously collecting so many souls. Naufal is also a Cosmos God who had avatars. I merely killed an avatar of his previously.’ Xue Ying felt anger towards these devils, ‘Is Eternal Night Primogenitor indulging his subordinates?’
Nonetheless, Xue Ying did not have much time to think.
‘Not good!’
Being a Dao of Void expert, he had an acute perception of every black fog spherical particles. At this moment, he felt frightening energy surging his way.
‘Eternal Night Primogenitor.’
This energy was too familiar.
By relying on his perception of the void, he was able to ‘discover’ Eternal Night Primogenitor who was covered in his black cape.
‘Time to leave.’
Xue Ying was too lazy to fight. Instead, he simply executed the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.
“Si la-”
A black crack was formed.
Xue Ying’s body had already suffered from the impact of the frightening incoming energy, yet he still stepped into the black crack. One could see from this how difference the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ and ‘Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ were. The ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ was much more stable! Even under the pressure of such a violent attack, it could still tear a passage open.
After all, the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique was essentially a technique meant to open a passage in the more terrifying higher dimension between two Origin Worlds.
If it was not stable, how could it resist against the turbulent impact from the higher dimension?
“Hua!”
Despite Xue Ying’s utmost control over the void, the surrounding area spanning several tens of thousands of kilometers away from where he was soon turned into ruins.
A figure soon appeared in midair. He was none other than Eternal Night Primogenitor whose black cape was currently billowing in the wind. A layer of frost had currently formed over the face of Eternal Night Primogenitor as he gritted: “He left? Did he just leave after suffering from an attack by me? It appears his body could easily resist against this strike of mine. Even if a Dao of Void expert is good at defenses, his fleshy body should not be so frightening!”
‘Void-ification’, ‘Void Control’, and many techniques made a Dao of Void final realm expert good at survival.
But fleshy body? Most Dao of Void experts did not have such strong bodies.
Emperor Summer had created the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll>. And Xue Ying had integrated different methods of using the Chaotic Origin Energy from the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> to improve the level-two Chaotic Origin Refinement Body. Only these two existences had fleshy bodies that were sufficiently strong that they could be compared to final realm body cultivators.
…
“Hua hua hua~”
Xue Ying appeared above the vast Black Prison Yin Sea. His expression was slightly pale. Signs of blood could be seen trickling from the edge of his mouth.
Even after losing much of its force through by diverting it using the Dao of Void, and given how powerful his fleshy body was, this supreme-graded technique still caused the blood in Xue Ying’s body to flare up. Nonetheless, his lifeforce remained perfectly fine. Fortunately, he had brought along the top-graded secret treasure ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’ with him. If he did not, Xue Ying would have been heavily injured from that sneak attack.
‘By relying on the Void Fire Lotus Flower, I can survive against unparalleled existences. If my Chaotic Origin Weapon is fully refined, why would I be afraid of that Eternal Night Primogenitor?’ Xue Ying felt confident.
He was currently comprehending a supreme secret impartation technique, fusing all sorts of profound mysteries from the scripture into his body. Xue Ying was perfecting his body cultivation technique while pondering over ways to create the Flying Snow Combat Technique, a style that suited him the most! And by relying on the Void Fire Lotus Flower, his strength was no longer weaker than Great Paragon Fuyi’s.
Once he fully refined the Chaotic Origin Weapon, he would most likely be stronger than Great Paragon Fuyi.
He would most likely become the strongest Paragon Master in the history of the entire Realm Heart Great Land!
Eternal Night Primogenitor
******
Even though both parties merely exchanged a single technique.
Or to be strict, it was Eternal Night Primogenitor who sneaked an attack while Xue Ying resisted against it and fled! But firstly, Eternal Night Primogenitor was indignant! The matter regarding the 19 cities previously had been disrupted by Xue Ying! Black Sovereign King was killed as well! And then, he was disdained by ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ without having any means of retaliating. Currently, he started collecting a large amount of soul, yet Xue Ying came once again. How could Eternal Night Primogenitor not be furious?
This sneak attack was naturally a full-powered covert killing move of his!
And such a killing technique could be felt by many unparalleled existences and final realm experts across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
They turned their attention to this place.
“What is happening?”
“It seems like a battle at the supreme level?”
They were currently watching over.
Xue Ying also turned over. He wanted to see what Eternal Night Primogenitor was doing. At that moment, he was able to ‘see’ Eternal Night Primogenitor standing above that ruins which spanned across several tens of thousands of kilometers.
“Damn.” Discovering that piece of ruins made Xue Ying frown. This Eternal Night Primogenitor was really treating those lower-leveled cultivators as ants! He did not even care about controlling his technique.
Eternal Night Primogenitor stood midair.
His gaze was cold as he looked around him. He broadcasted: “Heaven’s Will Daoist, I know you are hiding in the dark.”
A sneer appeared by the edge of Xue Ying’s mouth.
“You have been disrupting my affairs time after time. Do you think your identity will remain eternally hidden?” The killing intent in the eyes of Eternal Night Primogenitor became concentrated, “Aren’t you thinking of disrupting my affair? Hmph hmph, I shall do it personally from now on and see how you could stop me from doing so.”
Even though one could not hear anything when scouting using the Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, the cultivators could determine what Eternal Night Primogenitor was saying through the spatial fluctuations and the movement of the lips.
“Do it personally?” Xue Ying’s expression changed.
He could kill ordinary devils.
But how could he kill Eternal Night Primogenitor? Even unparalleled existences had a hard time killing other unparalleled existences! Even in that dangerous environment, ‘Realm Heart God Palace’, Eternal Night Primogenitor was able to easily escape from Emperor Summer in the end.
And the Realm Heart Great Land was so much bigger. Without any arrays limiting the region, one could escape in all directions.
Even ordinary final realm experts could easily escape from unparalleled existences! As for Eternal Night Primogenitor? He could simply walk off if he wanted within the Realm Heart Great Land.
And even if he chose not to, Eternal Night Primogenitor could easily suppress Xue Ying!
…
“Eternal Night truly doesn’t care about his reputation.” Emperor Summer shook his head softly.
“Shameless.” Emperor Cang became cold when he saw this.
The three unparalleled existences in Summer Wind Ancient Nation had always had a bad relationship with the two Primogenitors in Primogenitor Ancient Nation.
“Mn?”
Limitless City Master was holding on to the railings casting his gaze far across the endless night to another location. When he spoke, his voice transmitted to another location in the Realm Heart Great Land, “Underworld Emperor, Eternal Night has dispatched his subordinates to bring chaos across 19 cities recently, choosing to collect souls. And now, he has threatened the Heaven’s Will Daoist shamelessly. I doubt he is required to do these in his cultivation Dao path. Is it because of you?”
“Haha, I truly can’t conceal this from you, my old friend.” Undying Underworld Emperor transmitted back.
“You have truly chosen a good helper. In the entire Realm Heart Great Land, the two most vicious and shameless unparalleled existences are both Eternal night and Extreme Night. That Moonflower King could barely be added into this category as well.” Limitless City Master chuckled.
“It is merely a fair trade. Limitless, are you willing to do another trade with me?”
“Do a trade with you, Underworld Emperor? Hmph hmph, I am not interested.”
“Yi?”
“He actually showed himself?”
Both Limitless City Master and Undying Underworld Emperor were chatting when they were slightly startled from what they saw.
…
It wasn’t just them. All the apex experts across Realm Heart Great Land who were currently paying their attention over here watched in astonishment. Not far away from that Eternal Night Primogenitor, a black crack formed, and a white-robed male came walking out from it.
Heaven’s Will Daoist!
It’s him!
“You actually dared to show yourself?” Eternal Night Primogenitor looked over at Xue Ying who walked over. He was similarly startled.
“Eternal Night Primogenitor, since you do not care about your reputation, I naturally have to come and have a good chat with you and advise Eternal Night Primogenitor not to do so.” Xue Ying chuckled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1177 - Playing Tricks on Eternal Night Primogenitor (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1177: Playing Tricks on Eternal Night Primogenitor (2)
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Eternal Night Primogenitor stared at the white-robed male before him. After attempting to sneak an attack, he understood that it was impossible to restrict this mysterious ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’ by himself.
“Second Brother.” Eternal Night Primogenitor contacted his lifelong brother, ‘Extreme Night Primogenitor’.
“Hahaha, you can’t handle that Heaven’s Will Daoist? And you are currently seeking my help?” Extreme Night Primogenitor replied with a sneer. Even though both were lifelong brothers that had adventured together since the time before the First War of the Ancient Nations, their personalities were different.
Eternal Night Primogenitor was more proud and aloof. His methods were more cunning. On the surface, he still regarded his reputation highly. Only during crucial moment would he choose to tear down his mask and become someone shameless. He would remain the basic decorum in most cases.
As for Extreme Night Primogenitor, he was someone that disregarded reputation altogether! Even when facing a weak cultivator, he would ‘deceive’, ‘poison’, and employ all means as if it was nothing unusual.
And this pair…
The Dao paths they specialized were completely opposite. Hence, they became quite powerful when both of them teamed up.
“Less nonsense. You should hurry up over and work with me to capture this avatar of Heaven’s Will Daoist.” Eternal Night Primogenitor urged him through voice transmission.
“He is a Dao of Void expert and has many avatars.”
“As long as I capture this avatar of his and seal his soul, preventing him from suiciding, I can easily find out where his avatars are.” Eternal Night Primogenitor said, “I believe it is still possible for us to capture him if we work together on a sneak attack.”
“Alright. But you have to give me the disciple you vied for with me the previous time.”
“Sure! Provided we succeed in capturing his avatar.”
…
As the two of them were plotting in the dark, Xue Ying remained standing in midair looking at that Eternal Night Primogenitor: “Eternal Night Primogenitor, being one of the two primogenitors of the Primogenitor Ancient Nation, why would you disregard your status and deal against these weak cultivators?”
“Are you qualified to question me on what I do?” Eternal Night Primogenitor coldly laughed.
“I naturally am qualified to question you. You can’t kill me, and neither could you threaten me. Instead, I can threaten you.” Xue Ying continued.
Eternal Night Primogenitor’s expression turned sullen.
Being a King… he naturally had many subordinates. There were many matters which he could not personally conduct and had to delegate them to his subordinates.
Given the temper of this Heaven’s Will Daoist, as someone who hated evil, he would definitely not loosen his actions in dealing with devils. And that was relevant to Eternal Night Primogenitor as he had many devilish subordinates. If this ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’ chose to assassinate all devils, this Dao of Void expert would certainly succeed in killing quite a few Cosmos Gods in Primogenitor Ancient Nation.
“Are you threatening me?” The eyes of Eternal Night Primogenitor were flashing with a cold murderous light.
“Eternal Night Primogenitor, why the need?” Xue Ying shook his head, “If you are seeking to collect souls, I believe that Primogenitor Ancient Nation is huge enough, and there would be many criminals that violated the iron-clad laws of the ancient nation. Those criminals are sentenced to death, and you could easily collect their souls. I will naturally not meddle with such matters.”
Eternal Night Primogenitor became silent.
The souls of criminals?
He had naturally collected them! Given the huge region the ancient nation occupied, he did collect quite a large number. But compared to what ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ required, it was far too lacking.
Instead, collecting by the millions across the region would be much faster!
“What you said…” Eternal Night Primogenitor frowned, “Is slightly logical too, but-”
He had not finished speaking.
“Hong! Hong!”
Two frightening energy descended.
One was an incomparably resplendent light, and the other was a darkness that would bring fear to others.
Dark and light. They were akin to two extremes.
Xue Ying only felt the surrounding world rotating constantly. His soul felt dizzy amidst that ‘rotation’, though being a level-two Cosmos God expert in the Mirage and Illusory Realm and having fused a droplet of core blood from the Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother, his soul was sufficiently strong. Xue Ying could still maintain consciousness.
‘It is a sneak attack.’ Xue Ying’s heart moved.
“Hua.”
Silently, this avatar dissipated into nothingness as if it did not exist at all.
“What?”
Another black-caped male appeared on another side. His cape was entirely black, and one could see some blood patterns on it. He was Extreme Night Primogenitor.
Eternal Night Primogenitor and Extreme Night Primogenitor.
“We actually failed?” Extreme Night Primogenitor softly shook his head, “The soul of this Heaven’s Will Daoist is sufficiently strong to maintain conscious completely. He could dissipate this avatar easily.”
All they needed was a moment of entering a daze.
By the time he woke up, his soul would have been sealed! Even though it was possible for the cultivator to maintain some aura concealment technique, Eternal Night Primogenitor and Extreme Night Primogenitor could easily permeate their energy into the soul and find out the aura of the true soul of Heaven’s Will Daoist! And that would enable them to unravel who Heaven’s Will Daoist really was.
Why was Heaven’s Will Daoist so powerful? Why would he make all devils in Realm Heart Great Land helpless?
Precisely because his identity was kept a secret!
“We failed this time. It is even less possible for us to succeed the next time.” Eternal Night Primogenitor felt both furious and helpless.
“Hua.”
A white-robed male appeared from nothingness.
“It is the honor of I, Heaven’s Will Daoist, for two primogenitors to team up against me.” Xue Ying guffawed. Since he took the initiative to step in the light and ‘persuade’ them! Naturally, he could not be on guard! Even though he was confident of surviving with his nine great avatars along with an activated Void Fire Lotus Flower, he still made himself a target by standing in the light!
Who knew what Eternal Night Primogenitor would do? For instance, attacking him with a team of two or three unparalleled existences? Or even for that evil ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ to join in?
He could not afford to lose!
Right now, he did not wish to reveal his identity.
Hence, he rather just send an avatar over without bringing any treasures.
He had over 10,000 avatars, and losing an ordinary avatar was nothing.
“These two primogenitors? Are you still thinking of dealing with me?” Xue Ying looked at both Eternal Night Primogenitor and Extreme Night Primogenitor before chuckling. “Hua”, this avatar of his dissipated once again.
Following that-
Another white-robed male walked out from the void.
“Being a final realm Dao of Void expert, I have many avatars. If I lose one, I can easily replace it with another! And the speed of my avatar dissipating is way slower than the speed I refine another.” Another newly formed avatar smiled at both Extreme Night Primogenitor and Eternal Night Primogenitor.
Eternal Night Primogenitor exchanged glances with Extreme Night Primogenitor.
This Heaven’s Will Daoist…
Was different from most final realm experts. He had reached the final realm in the Dao of Void! He had many avatars! Their initial plan was to capture and seal him alive? But the other party’s soul seemed to be very powerful. They failed in their plan of sneaking an attack with their full power. By then, they knew they could do nothing against this mysterious person.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying stood there. Another white-robed male walked out from the void carrying a flask of wine. That male was currently drinking it.
At this juncture, Eternal Night Primogenitor’s expression turned sullen.
This flask of wine…
It was from ‘Eternal Night City’ inside Primogenitor Ancient Nation. Just now, this avatar of Xue Ying executed the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to travel into the usual meditation room of Eternal Night Primogenitor, grabbed a flask of wine before rushing over here.
“It is very easy for me to kill the devils within the Primogenitor Ancient Nation.” The two Xue Ying both carried a flask of wine drinking and saying at the same time, “Of course, I do not wish to become enemies with the two primogenitors. I only wish to help some of the more pitiful and ordinary cultivators. These two primogenitors, how about showing some mercy and benevolence to those weaker cultivators and allow them a path to survive. Collecting souls? I believe there are other ways just that it’ll take some time.”
Both Eternal Night Primogenitor and Extreme Night Primogenitor looked at each other.
They felt furious and helpless in their hearts.
This was also the helpless faced by the unparalleled existence in Realm Heart Great Land against some of the Great Tyrant Devils. Those Great Tyrant Devils were incredibly arrogant, and they even dared to create chaos within the six great ancient nations!
Why?
That’s because these Great Tyrant Devils could survive against unparalleled existences! They relied on the fact that the clans and businesses of the unparalleled existences were too big that they dared not shed all pretense of cordiality.
And currently, this ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’ was on the contrast with those Great Tyrant Devils. Instead, he sought to help those weaker cultivators. Actually, he was very similar to Limitless City Master! Limitless City Master was also protecting, albeit he protected the balance of the Realm Heart Great Land and for the cultivators to reproduce regularly. But clearly, the scope of ‘balance’ was wider in the eyes of Limitless City Master. Even if a city was slaughtered, he did not care.
And Xue Ying also wanted to protect the balance in his own definition!
He did not care if cultivators die during normal life-death battles.
Instead, if there were some large-scale massacres numbered in the trillions, Xue Ying would certainly intervene in it if he could!
“What should we do?” Extreme Night Primogenitor transmitted over to Eternal Night Primogenitor, “Eternal Night, we can’t identify the origins of this Heaven’s Will Daoist, making it impossible for us to threaten him. As for the task of collecting souls, you should have been collecting them for a very long time already right?”
“I have collected for more than 100 million years. I had been very careful all the time, yet he still found out in the end.” Eternal Night Primogenitor transmitted back.
“Since you were discovered only after 100 million years, you should just agree to his demands for now. It is fine as long as you proceed with collecting the souls more carefully! Furthermore, you should try your best to prevent this Heaven’s Will Daoist from tracing back to you.” Extreme Night Primogenitor transmitted over, “As long as you are careful and more low-profile, it should not be easy for this Heaven’s Will Daoist to discover it.”
“I can only do so for now.” Eternal Night Primogenitor thought.
He felt repressed in his heart, yet he was helpless.
Facing this expert who did not have any concerns, was unkillable and had countless avatars, what could he do?
“Relax, it is impossible for him to keep his identity a secret for eternity. He’ll eventually reveal it one day in the future.” Extreme Night Primogenitor transmitted, “What we should do now is to endure. The day when he reveals his identity is the day we repay all the repressed feelings we have! And it isn’t just us, all those devils who had been suppressed would definitely take vengeance viciously. The day he reveals his identity will be the day he understands why nobody dares to take this path in the entire Realm Heart Great Land.”
“Mn.” Eternal Night Primogenitor nodded, “Let’s endure it for now.”
After cultivating through the years, they had learned to be patient. They looked forward to the moment when Heaven’s Will Daoist revealed his identity.

chapters.title: Chapter 1178 - Completion of the Chaotic Origin Weapon Refinement
chapters.content:
Chapter 1178: Completion of the Chaotic Origin Weapon Refinement
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying smiled at Eternal Night Primogenitor and Extreme Night Primogenitor. He gave a respectful nod before disappearing from the void.
Taking the initiative to show his respect, that was done to leave some face for both ‘Eternal Night Primogenitor and Extreme Night Primogenitor’. He could observe that Eternal Night Primogenitor showed signs of taking a step back, though, given the other party’s identity, it was impossible for him to admit defeat. On the contrary, he as the ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’ had taken a step back, showing signs of respect while giving the other party space to take a step back.
“Eternal Night Primogenitor and the others are the leaders of an ancient nation. I, with my identity as the Heaven’s Will Daoist, showed no mistakes either. But I can’t humiliate them too much in case they fly into a rage out of humiliation.” Xue Ying understood this point.
If Xue Ying was an unparalleled existence, it was fine if he chided the other party and humiliated them since they were existence at the same level.
But now, he was ultimately weaker by an entire level. Since his strength was inferior as compared to the other party, the other party would naturally not be pleased. If he chose to humiliate them in front of the public, Eternal Night Primogenitor and his lifelong brother might just turn mad!
“Go.”
Extreme Night Primogenitor chuckled before disappearing.
Eternal Night Primogenitor also looked to the distance with a cold look. This time, he was ultimately forced to lower his head. He then disappeared from the vicinity.
…
There were very few spectators. The majority of Cosmos Gods did not know that this battle had happened.
Only the unparalleled existences and final realm cultivators felt ripples from the battle being released into the world, and thus, chose to ‘watch’ this battle! Even though few experts were watching it, its impact was incredibly huge.
“Both primogenitors of Primogenitor Ancient Nation worked together to scheme against Heaven’s Will Daoist, yet to no avail. After this battle, it seems it is very hard to stir the heart of Heaven’s Will Daoist.”
“Mn, those devils would most likely have to wait a very long time before the identity of Heaven’s Will Daoist is revealed.”
“Truly formidable. The two primogenitors of Primogenitor Ancient Nation worked together and are extremely frightening. Nonetheless, they were helpless against Heaven’s Will Daoist. It seems only the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation and Summer Wind Ancient Nation could possibly deal with Heaven’s Will Daoist. But most unparalleled existences emphasize greatly on their identity. Few would be like Eternal Night Primogenitor who chose to sneak an attack so shamelessly.”
“Heaven’s Will Daoist should have no worries in the near future!”
Various parties were making their judgments.
For an unparalleled existence to ambush on a final realm expert who did not own any supreme-graded secret treasure? That was quite shameless.
For two of them to work together and sneak an attack?
That was simply immoral.
Only those two unparalleled existences from Primogenitor Ancient Nation were willing to do so. Given the temper of ‘Emperor Summer’ or ‘World Extermination God-Emperor’, doing such acts would only shame and humiliate them! Unless there was a hope of breaking through to the ‘Chaotic Origin’ to which they would disregard everything-just like the First and Second War of the Ancient Nation.
Most of the time, the unparalleled existences would still protect their own face and identity.
Garbed in a luxurious gold robe, a handsome male with a crown on his head sat by himself on the throne. He carried a scarlet wine looking into the distance. He had just cast his gaze across the entire battle that happened earlier.
“Ever since I returned to the Realm Heart Great Land, I have been living an easy and peaceful life.” The handsome young man mumbled softly. A smile grew on the edge of his lips, “It’s only in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range that I could experience the dangerous aura that I felt in the past.”
Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
That was the most dangerous place in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Some Chaotic Origin Lifeforms’ corpses were thrown there. Even unparalleled existences could not guarantee their survival.
Returning to his hometown, there was only the Broken Teeth Mountain Range which was still attractive to Undying Underworld Emperor.
“Yuan.”
“Why can’t he give me another opportunity after I failed?” The handsome young man looked up. His gaze cast across the palace walls and through the vast void. He could vaguely see the higher dimensional space.
He was unwilling.
Really unwilling!
“I am unwilling to remain as an ant stuck in the cage.” The handsome young man muttered.
“Underworld Emperor, you should have seen it as well. That Heaven’s Will Daoist is very hard to deal with. Hence, I do request for Underworld Emperor to give me more time. I am not confident of completing the task within the original time limit.” Eternal Night Primogenitor transmitted over.
The edge of the handsome male sneered: “Eternal Night, that was the oath which you swore in the past. You should be prepared to bear the consequences of failure! As for time? I could give you at most twice the amount as per originally agreed upon. But the promised trade conditions will be halved as well.”
Eternal Night Primogenitor went silent for a while.
“Naturally, if you could complete it within the original timeframe, everything will be done according to the original agreement.” The handsome young man added.
He had already loosened his conditions.
According to the original condition, if the other party failed to commit to his promise once the time limit was up, that would mean a violation of the oath.
If he allowed the other party to have twice as much time, that would at least still be within the scope of the oath.
“Alright, I agree.” Eternal Night Primogenitor acknowledged.
The handsome young man sneered. Black fire could be seen igniting faintly in both his eyes as he mumbled: “Heaven’s Will Daoist? Interesting. He has suppressed all devils in the entire Realm Heart Great Land just by himself. Should I spend a little more effort to find out who he is?”
To the unparalleled existences in Realm Heart Great Land, the aura disguised by Heaven’s Will Daoist seemed completely airtight. But to Undying Underworld Emperor who had experienced countless dangers, it was possible for him to unravel the identity of the other party.
“Foolish.”
The handsome male frowned, “How could I use the energy I gathered so painstakingly on some minor matter to satisfy my ‘curiosity’? It seems that I have been living too easily after returning to the Realm Heart Great Land. Without any dangers present in addition to the breaking off of my opportunity, it seems my state of heart has changed as well. With this state of heart, how could I learn from Luo City Lord to break through the cage simply willpower and determination?”
He then threw the matter about the identity of Heaven’s Will Daoist to the back of his mind.
To Undying Underworld Emperor, ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’ was simply entertainment to him. He felt no threat from the other party.
…
Time passed.
Just like how the most apex experts determined, even though few had experienced the exchange between Xue Ying and the two unparalleled existences from Primogenitor Ancient Nation, the impact still spread out across the world.
The balance in the Realm Heart Great Land became much more orderly.
Even the devil organizations became more low-profile! Even though there were still some vicious and cruel matters happening, they could not compare to the previous large-scale massacres. Xue Ying did not intervene in those matters regarding the cruel murder of experts since he treated those at ‘a Dao path of devils’.
Over the years.
Xue Ying would still occasionally come out using his identity as the Heaven’s Will Daoist, killing devils who dared to massacre others.
There were always some who had less knowledge and wisdom.
There would always be some who harbored hope of surviving.
And there would always be some who could not control the madness in their hearts!
And many other reasons!
In the blink of an eye, 10 billion years passed.
To Cosmos Gods, this was simply a short period of entering closed-door cultivation. To Xue Ying with his slightly shorter cultivation age, even after relying on the ‘World Flower’-he had some improvements in the Dao of Void and had thought of how he would want the fifth killing move to be-what was more important to him in this ’10 billion years’ was…
The Chaotic Origin Weapon was about to be completed!
“Chi chi chi~”
Within the meditation room.
The incense pervaded the entire place. A white-robed Xue Ying sat cross-legged with a black spear floating before him. It seemed cold and simple, yet one would feel an unspeakable heart-palpitating feeling if he examined the spear! That was energy originating from the higher dimension. After all, the core material of this Chaotic Origin Weapon was the ‘Chaotic Origin Sand’.
50,000 kilograms of Chaotic Origin Sand had simply shaved off more than half the supply across Realm Heart Great Land.
Fortunately, the ‘Chaotic Origin Sand’ was too high-end. It was materials used by those at a higher level. Hence, unparalleled existences could not utilize them at all. Even though they knew the sand was extraordinary and was expensive, without knowing how to use it, the sand would remain useless. Instead, it was Xue Ying who exchanged for the sand by relying on his <Mirage> scripture.
Spending 10 billion years of refinement, he had finally reached the final stages.
“Sou.”
A thread of violet-gold liquid was transforming in the void. It gradually turned into an array at an extremely slow speed.
Xue Ying had no choice as this array was too high-end.
He could only rely on the accompanying refinement array diagram which he got from the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> to control it slowly and steadily. Xue Ying had to do it by parts as well!
After two hours or so, the violet-gold liquid finally finished transforming into a perfect array. When the array was formed, it became translucent-seemingly as if it existed within the Origin World while connecting to the higher dimension beyond the Origin World at the same time.
“Pu.”
Along with the control by Xue Ying, he simply applied it on the spear.
At the moment when it was applied.
Countless arrays on the spear immediately lit up. A frightening shockwave rushed out in all directions. The surface of Xue Ying’s body was protected by many spatial layers. The incoming shockwave was so strong that it even broke through all spatial layers and charged onto the body of Xue Ying, causing him to feel an incredible force impacting on him. Xue Ying was slammed back against the wall of the meditation room.
Fortunately, the meditation room was protected by many layers of arrays. It was also the core of the entire Flying Snow City. Hence, it could still prevent the leak of this aura eruption.
Following that, the aura from this black spear vanished. Xue Ying also permeated it with his consciousness, placating this spear according to the manual provided. Chaotic Origin Weapons were originally meant for Chaotic Origin Lifeforms to use. But ‘Yuan’ had specially considered for Xue Ying, using the most commonly seen Chaotic Origin Sand in the higher dimension as the foundation to refine a simplified Chaotic Origin Weapon.
Even the refinement technique was simplified to an extreme.
Only then could Cosmos Gods use such a Chaotic Origin Weapon.
Even the ‘supreme-graded secret treasures’ were bestowed by Yuan. Otherwise, the final realm experts could not use these weapons. Actually, ‘supreme-graded secret treasures’ were imbued with some profound mysteries in the Chaotic Origin Realm.
“Finally I succeeded. I finally refined this weapon.” When Xue Ying felt the horrifying energy inherent within this spear, he was filled with joy.
“This spear will be the one that allows me to step on the path of Chaotic Origin. It shall be called… Azure River.” Xue Ying thought.
Azure River.
This name represented the Azure River County back at his hometown, and also represented his wife and children. Those were the most important people in his life.

chapters.title: Chapter 1179 - The new Final Realm Cultivator
chapters.content:
Chapter 1179: The new Final Realm Cultivator
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying walked before the floating black spear. He looked up at it before placing his hands onto the spear body.
It felt good. The moment his hands contacted the spear, Xue Ying sensed his soul trembling as if it became one with the spear.
“Who would have thought that I will own a Chaotic Origin Weapon!” The eyes of Xue Ying twinkled. There were only a dozen of supreme-graded secret treasures across the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Adding up some of the pieces lost when unparalleled existences fell, at most 20 over supreme-graded secret treasures existed! As for Chaotic Origin Weapon? One had to know that getting a supreme secret impartation technique was harder than acquiring a supreme-graded secret treasure.
And Chaotic Origin Weapons were rarer than even supreme secret impartation techniques.
Unparalleled existences in Realm Heart Great Land had gathered quite a huge amount of Chaotic Origin Sand over the long years. Nonetheless, Xue Ying had swept over and collected almost all of them! Hence, it was possible to deduce that only one single Chaotic Origin Weapon existed in the Realm Heart Great Land.
“Hu.”
As Xue Ying sat cross-legged with the spear placed on his legs, he began refining the spear-his soul was fusing into the spear at the same time.
Refining a Chaotic Origin Weapon was no easy task. According to logic, Cosmos Gods should not be able to refine it. Fortunately, every single part of this spear had been personally refined by Xue Ying. During the complex refinement process, he had already done ‘some preliminary refinements with his soul’. Hence, it was much easier to carry out a secondary refinement now.
Just 300 years later, the Azure River Spear fell under the control of Xue Ying.
“I could originally execute the first three strikes in the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>. But now with the Azure River Spear, I can execute the first five strikes.” Xue Ying felt satisfied. Without the Azure River Spear, he could merely reach this stage after breaking through to the final realm.
“I must make good use of this chance to experience the feeling.”
…
Even though he had become much stronger, the Chaotic Origin Weapon ‘Azure River Spear’ was merely a stepping stone for Xue Ying to comprehend the Dao of Void and Chaotic Origin Energy.
…
Nobody in Realm Heart Great Land was aware that Xue Ying had refined the Chaotic Origin Weapon ‘Azure River Spear’. Instead, everything proceeded as per normal in the vast Realm Heart Great Land. The presence of ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’ improved the order in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. ‘Massacres’ had drastically reduced to an amount fewer than one-hundredth that in the past. This showed the intimidation an era expert could have on society.
In the blink of an eye, another 300 billion years passed.
Xue Ying remained deep in cultivation. Furthermore, by relying on the World Flower and some realization he had after executing the first five strikes using the Chaotic Origin Weapon ‘Azure River Spear’… Xue Ying finally created the fifth killing move of his Flying Snow Combat Technique. It was powerful. Furthermore, this technique had an incredibly useful auxiliary effect in fleeing. This fleeing effect could be considered as similar to that of the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’.
Actually, Xue Ying’s Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique was comparatively weak.
If a final realm expert executed the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, it would be so much more profound and perfect. Not only could he escape, but he could also even bring other lifeforms with him!
On this day.
A piece of news reached Xue Ying.
“What? Paragon Master Bewitching Sword broke through to the final realm?” Xue Ying felt startled when he received this news, “So fast?”
Paragon Master Bewitching Sword had once fought with him together in the Realm Heart God Palace. Even when Eternal Night Primogenitor dealt against him, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword chose to help him. Hence, they were considered good friends.
It’s just…
Paragon Master Bewitching Sword was a new Paragon Master in the Cang Clan from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. He was also the youngest Paragon Master in Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
Nonetheless, he had surpassed all other Paragon Masters at such a young age, surpassing even Great Paragon Fuyi, Sky-Rending Great Paragon, and others to reach the final realm first.
“Final realm.” Xue Ying muttered.
Only after bitterly cultivating for so long did he understood how difficult it was to reach the final realm.
He had already fused eight branches together. He even had the help of the World Flowers, a supreme secret impartation technique and great innate comprehension abilities. Nonetheless, he was still stuck at the final step despite creating five great killing moves already! Xue Ying had accumulated deep experience, yet no matter what, he felt that he was missing by one step. He truly did not know when would he ever take that crucial step.
Great Paragon Fuyi, Southern Cloud King, Sky-Rending Great Paragon, and many others were trapped at the bottleneck.
Across the entire Realm Heart Great Land! Other than the unparalleled existences, the number of final realm cultivators could be counted with two hands.
How few was this?
The Summer Wind Ancient Nation did not have any other final realm cultivators other than the three unparalleled existences! And now, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword was the one final realm cultivator that emerged in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation over such a long period.
‘Final Realm Ceremony? Since Paragon Master Bewitching Sword treated me so well in the past, I should prepare some gifts for him too.’ Xue Ying thought.
…
The Summer Wind Ancient Nation finally had a new final realm cultivator.
A great celebration was being organized by the ‘Cang Clan’ in Summer Wind Ancient Nation. It was held at the core city, the ‘Emperor Cang City’, and experts from all over the place were coming over to congratulate them!
The dozen neighboring countries naturally did not dare to skip this celebration.
Even the other five great ancient nations had some emissaries over to congratulate them. As for the various smaller nations, it was the kings that came personally.
“I have never seen so many Cosmos Gods before at a single place.” The white-robed young man Xue Ying came together with Southern Cloud King. After presenting their gifts, they went into the enormous palace hall and went to their respective seats under the guidance of the attendants.
Glancing over, there were more than 500 Cosmos Gods currently in interacting in this palace hall! And these were people that came just simply to congratulate them. One could see the difference between Realm Heart Great Land and the Primal Chaos Void.
“It is really hard for a new final realm cultivator to emerge. Whenever a new final realm cultivator emerges in the smaller nations, most would not organize such a ceremony either. Only the ancient nations would organize one that is so grand.” Southern Cloud King explained from the side, “Furthermore, this Paragon Master Bewitching Sword has risen very quickly. He rapidly broke through to the Cosmos God Realm, becoming a Paragon Master at a young age and now, he has even reached the final realm. His cultivation period is very short. Even though it is much longer as compared to you, he has only entered the Realm Heart God Palace just once!”
“And now, he has broken through to the final realm. With his frightening speed of cultivation, he should most likely be able to get his hands on a supreme-graded secret treasure in the Realm Heart God Palace.”
“Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang, and Ancestor Fan will definitely do their best to help Paragon Master Bewitching Sword … Hence, it is highly probable for Paragon Master Bewitching Sword to get a supreme-graded secret treasure during the next opening of Realm Heart God Palace.” Southern Cloud King sighed, “There are so many Cosmos Gods who came to congratulate him. Firstly, it was a form of respect for the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Secondly, it was done to befriend Paragon Master Bewitching Sword since he could possibly be the newest unparalleled existence.”
Xue Ying nodded.
“Naturally, during the great ceremony, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword could also practice in public his Dao path that reached the final realm. That is another reason why some Cosmos Gods came.” Southern Cloud King said. His eyes were filled with slight expectations.
He had a great desire-a desire to reach the final realm!
“Final realm.” Xue Ying mumbled to himself.
He was participating in the ceremony of another person this time. Xue Ying wondered when would it be his turn? Only after breaking through to the final realm could he save his loved ones and good friends, bringing them away from the Primal Chaos Void towards other Origin World!
“Isn’t that Monarch Flying Snow?”
“Monarch Flying Snow came with Southern Cloud King. This Monarch Flying Snow is quite low-profile. During the previous opening of the Realm Heart God Palace, hearsay he had the greatest harvest. It’s a pity that he was killed by Eternal Night Primogenitor in the end. Not only did he lose his avatar, but even his treasures were also all snatched away. Originally, he had the power of a Paragon Master. Losing his treasures, his strength had dropped even more drastically. It is quite pitiful of him.”
“It isn’t easy to become a Paragon Master, only to lose everything in such a short period.”
The Cosmos Gods gathered in the palace hall were usually an overlord of a territory. They were either a king or the higher-ups of a nation. It was rare for them to meet anyone of them, yet now during this ceremony, they were all discussing about other people.
Whenever one mentioned ‘Monarch Flying Snow’, they would either feel sympathy or schadenfreude.
Naturally…
They conversed through voice transmissions and did not talk out loud in public! They could disregard Monarch Flying Snow, but they still had to respect Southern Cloud King at least!
“Xue Ying, quite a few Cosmos Gods are still feeling pitiful for you.” Southern Cloud King noticed quite a few Cosmos Gods were turning in their direction. He chuckled. Some were even looking at ‘Xue Ying’ with quite a flavorful gaze, “I wonder what sort of expression would they have if they find out that you are Heaven’s Will Daoist?”
“It is pointless to care about how those Cosmos Gods think about me either.” Xue Ying transmitted back. “What is more important to me is if I could reach the final realm. Currently, the strength I had is acquired by relying on external items.”
“That’s right, reaching the final realm.” Southern Cloud King softly nodded.
Both teacher and disciple desired to reach the final realm greatly.
“He is here.”
The entire palace hall suddenly quietened. At the front of the palace hall, four figures appeared. Emperor Cang, Emperor Summer, and Ancestor Fan were at the center. And ‘Paragon Master Bewitching Sword ‘ stood to the left of Emperor Cang.

chapters.title: Chapter 1180 - Number One Expert in the Mirage and Illusory Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 1180: Number One Expert in the Mirage and Illusory Realm
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Paragon Master Bewitching Sword sat there. His gaze swept around the hall. Whenever he met someone familiar, he would exchange a few words through voice transmissions.
He also turned to the direction of Xue Ying, smiling: “Brother Flying Snow, I still remember how we attempted the 18 Stages together in the Realm Heart God Palace. If I had reached the final realm at that time, I might be able to bring you away.”
Xue Ying was slightly startled with the kind and passionate gaze the other party gave him. He replied: “That time, Brother Bewitching Sword has already tried your best for me! I am thankful for that.”
It was Paragon Master Bewitching Sword who helped him out in the past. If not for Eternal Night Primogenitor who was not willing to shed all pretense of cordiality with Summer Wind Ancient Nation, he might have wiped out Paragon Master Bewitching Sword with a wave of his hand.
Paragon Master Bewitching Sword smiled. He then continued conversing with some of his familiar and good friends.
At the same time-
Emperor Cang was the host of this great ceremony. After all, it was a disciple from his Cang Clan who reached the final realm.
…
Emperor Summer and the other unparalleled existences were clearly in a good mood. They made the ceremony a lively one. This was even the first time Xue Ying witnessed many of the performances. This great ceremony persisted for nine days before it ended.
“Southern Cloud King, the two of us haven’t met for quite some time already. I have arranged a small gathering tonight at the Emperor Cang City. Are you free to join us? Brother Heaven Ancient will also be there. Oh, Monarch Flying Snow will be coming too.”
“Brother Southern Cloud.”
“Southern Cloud…”
As the number of participating Cosmos Gods was huge, it was rare for everyone to meet. Hence, when the banquet ended, they went off in their small cliques.
Even though this great ceremony was lively, everyone was quite reserved. Only after they went off in their smaller groups did everyone became more casual.
Southern Cloud King, being the wealthiest Paragon Master and the creator of one of the top ten great religions, the southern Cloud Sacred Religion along with being one of the great heroes on Realm Heart Great Land, had been invited by many other Cosmos Gods. Many of them also gave him some face by inviting ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ along. A level-two Cosmos God Monarch Flying Snow was considered quite ordinary amidst the group of Cosmos Gods.
“Brother Flying Snow, don’t be in a rush to go off.” Paragon Master Bewitching Sword took the initiative over to invite Xue Ying. He pulled Xue Ying with him, “I have a small-scale gathering which I invited some good friends privately over. You and I once fought together, so you better not reject me.”
Since Xue Ying could not reject, he could only go along.
This made many of the Cosmos Gods dumbstruck.
“When did Paragon Master Bewitching Sword become so close to Monarch Flying Snow?”
“I’ve heard the two of them once attempted the 18 Stages together in the Realm Heart God Palace.”
“How could they become so close just after venturing into the Realm Heart God Palace together?”
Many Cosmos Gods felt envious.
Having reached the final realm, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword did things casually. He invited whomever he wanted to! He was not afraid of offending anyone else. Even devils who reached the final realm could become Great Tyrant Devils that unparalleled existences could not deal with. Furthermore, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword was quite fast in reaching his current level. It was entirely possible for him to acquire a supreme-graded secret treasure. He even had Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang, and Ancestor Fan supporting him behind his back.
Hence, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword merely invited ten over Cosmos Gods he was closer with. He did not invite Southern Cloud King at all.
That night.
Paragon Master Bewitching Sword introduced Xue Ying to some of his good friends, allowing others to know that Monarch Flying Snow was a lifelong friend of he, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword. For a moment, in the eyes of many Cosmos Gods in the Realm Heart Great Land, this Monarch Flying Snow had a teacher, ‘Southern Cloud King’. And now, he had a good friend Paragon Master Bewitching Sword. That improved the treatment of many Cosmos Gods towards Xue Ying.
If Xue Ying asked someone for help, it would definitely be much easier now.
But the current Xue Ying only focused on cultivation. He would occasionally go out to kill some devils using his identity as the Heaven’s Will Daoist.
…
Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
Underneath the violet crown of the short and thick Burning Heart God Tree.
A white-robed young man sat cross-legged here.
Time continued ticking away. With the occasional breeze, there would be a deep violet leaf that looked like a violet jade sculpture falling from the tree.
Ever since Xue Ying conducted the trade for the Mirage scripture, he always had an avatar here cultivating. According to the conditions provided, he was qualified to cultivate under the Burning Heart God Tree for a trillion years! And now, it had merely been over 300 billion years.
Just about 10,000 years after Paragon Master Bewitching Sword broke through to the final realm.
Xue Ying abruptly opened his eyes. His eyes were dark as if they were in possession of frightening destruction.
Blinking his eyes again, they turned back to normal.
“I’ve succeeded in fusing four branches together.”
Xue Ying grinned, “Unknowingly, I have also fused four branches in the Dao of
Mirage and Illusory Ream together, leaving just one final step before fusing all five and reaching the final realm.”
Xue Ying had long reached one step before the final realm in the Dao of Void.
And now, it was the same with the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm!
But the significance behind both of them was different.
The ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’ was a Soul Dao. Its difficulty was much higher. In the entire Realm Heart Great Land, few had entered the Cosmos God Realm in the Dao of Soul! And those who reached the level-two Cosmos God in the Dao of Soul were much fewer than those that reached the final realm in other Daos!
This path was an arduous one.
Every scripture pertaining to it was incomparably precious!
“I’ve fused four branches together.” Xue Ying chuckled, “Indeed, it is as I thought, my talent in the Mirage is much higher than in the Void.”
That was the fact.
As there had been many predecessors in the Dao of Void, Xue Ying had gotten many prior opportunities. For instance, the scaled-armor of General Mo Gu and Monarch Nine Cloud’s four-diagrams absolute art or Void Primogenitor’s Walker’s Hidden Secret. He got many opportunities from the Realm Heart God Palace as well-Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique, Southern Cloud 12 Sacred Styles, and Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll. Furthermore, there were even the nine World Flowers bestowed by Luo City Lord and Yuan’s Realm Heart Great Land where he acquired a supreme secret impartation technique!
All sorts of opportunities in addition to his talent enabled him to walk until where he stood.
Comparatively speaking, Xue Ying did not gain much opportunities in the Mirage and Illusory Realm.
In his hometown Primal Chaos Void, he had been the first and only cultivator to reach the Primal Chaos Realm in the Mirage and Illusory Realm! He had to pave his own path.
And after coming to the Realm Heart Great Land, Xue Ying had to painstakingly earned his chance of studying Ancestor Fan’s <Heart Realm>. Furthermore, he soon surpassed Ancestor Fan to the extent that Ancestor Fan sought to learn the Mirage scripture he created. And now, Xue Ying had fused four branches together… And it appeared that Xue Ying was the only one to reach this step in the Mirage and Illusory Realm across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
Hence, it went without saying that Xue Ying was now the number one expert in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm within the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
…
At a certain location in the higher dimension far away.
An old man and Luo City Lord were seated next to each other while drinking tea.
“Mn?”
The old man suddenly looked towards a particular direction.
“Older Brother Yuan, what’s the matter?” Luo City Lord asked.
“That Dong Bo Xue Ying has fused four branches together in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm.” Yuan was incredibly startled. The Realm Heart Great Land had been created by him, and Xue Ying was one of the few targets he paid huge attention to across many of the Origin Worlds. Otherwise, he would not have passed down a specially-simplified refinement technique of a Chaotic Origin Weapon, and neither would he have bestowed upon him a droplet of Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother’s core blood.
“Fused four branches together? Doesn’t that mean he is just one single step away from the final realm?” Luo City Lord was startled, “And if I am not wrong, he is the only one to have reached so close to the final realm in any Dao of Soul in your Realm Heart Great Land.”
“Right, just he alone!” Yuan was startled.
It was tremendously hard to progress in the Dao of Soul.
Xue Ying felt that he was the number one expert in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm within the entire Realm Heart Great Land. But what he did not know was that he was also the number one expert in the soul aspect within Realm Heart Great Land!
“Many experts across the Origin Worlds aren’t as strong as those in the Realm Heart Great Land.” Yuan sighed, “Some of the cultivators, even after relying on large amounts of opportunities and visiting certain unique grounds within the Chaotic Origin Dimension… there had been over a hundred cultivators who were just one step away from reaching the final realm in the Dao of Soul. But none of them had ever reached that stage in such a short period as compared to Dong Bo Xue Ying!”
“That’s right.” Luo City Lord nodded.
Both of them were aware that there had never been any cultivator who reached the final realm in the Dao of Soul! Not a single one of them! Hence, Yuan had no way of bestowing any scriptures into the Realm Heart Great Land because even though they were experts amongst Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, they did not specialize in the Dao of Soul.
Currently, what they knew most in the Dao of Soul path were those that reached one step before final realm.
“He has cultivated for such a short time!” Luo City Lord sighed, “In addition to the period he cultivated at his hometown Origin World and the time he spent on the Realm Heart Great Land, the total period hasn’t reached two trillion years! To reach this stage in the Mirage and Illusory Realm in just less than two trillion years… that is too terrifying. His talent in the Mirage and Illusory Realm is quite shocking.”
“Mn.” Yuan’s eyes lit up, “I have a feeling that if he were to reach the final realm in the Mirage and Illusory Realm, it shouldn’t be too hard for him to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Haha, he has broken through during his cultivation on me Realm Heart Great Land! And judging by his temper, he cares more for the weak than you and I. He is definitely someone who cherishes friendships and knows how to be grateful. By then, he would most likely join our side.”
“Yes.” Luo City Lord grinned, “Previously, I gave him nine World Flowers too. But everything is dependent on if he could reach the final realm in the Mirage and Illusory Realm! It is hard to have a breakthrough in the final step to reach the final realm for most Dao paths, and reaching the final realm in this Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm will most likely be more difficult! Across many Origin Worlds, there have been only a hundred or so cultivators who reached just one step away from the final realm in the soul aspect. But none of them were able to take that final step.”
Yuan softly nodded: “I have already bestowed upon him with a droplet of Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother’s core blood. To a Cosmos God who had yet to jump out of the cage, this is also the limit to what his soul could reach. We can’t help him either since he currently is standing at the apex in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm. What comes after that is dependent on him! He has to take this path alone.”
“His cultivation speed is really fast, and his talent in this aspect far surpasses that of what he knows.” Luo City Lord nodded, “Even though it is hard to take the final step, he should be the one with the greatest hope.”
“We shall see.” Yuan chuckled, “Everyone has been saying that creating the Realm Heart Great Land is a waste of my time. But they do not know that if given sufficient time and patient, only then could we see a true expert emerging.”
The two of them paid notice momentarily before no longer caring much anymore. They knew that it was not so easy for this Xue Ying to reach the final realm in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm either.

chapters.title: Chapter 1181 - Devastation by Emperor Jun
chapters.content:
Chapter 1181: Devastation by Emperor Jun
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Over at the hometown Primal Chaos Void.
It was much more peaceful and quiet here than Realm Heart Great Land. Nonetheless, this was the calm before the storm!
