The number one expert of the entire Primal Chaos Void, ‘Sacred Master’, was concentrated on meditating and absorbing the belief energy from all civilians living within the Ancient Sacred World. He was relying on his Ancient Sacred Incarnation to convert the belief energy into Origin Source Energy. Likewise, many believers of the Sacred Master were contributing this belief energy as well in other sacred worlds and primal chaos lands. ‘Sacred Master’ was currently accumulating energy. He was preparing himself for the eventual ‘charge’ once the Great Apocalypse arrived to see if he could control the ‘Supreme Law’ of this era, allowing him to advance and become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. If he failed, he would wait for the next era before trying again.
Other Cosmos Gods like Xue Ying were also focusing on their cultivation.
Without reaching the final realm, they would not be able to survive the Great Apocalypse.
…
And over at the Lost World Corridor.
In a sealed space, a black flower was floating. Currently, the petals of the flower were folded up.
Only after a very long time did the black flower started blossoming, revealing a thin evil male who sat cross-legged within. He had a long scaled tail protruding from his back. He was also a Destruction Devil, and the current commander of all Destruction Devils in the Lost World Corridor-Emperor Jun.
Emperor Jun slowly opened his eyes that were filled with a slight bizarre tint.
“Final realm. I have finally reached it!” Emperor Jun could hardly conceal his excitement. Looking at the space before him, he could sense strands of energy pervading every single location. At this moment, these laws were under his control.
“After reaching the final realm, I could at least survive against the Great Apocalypse of this Origin World and continue living in the next era.” Emperor Jun squinted his eyes and contemplated, “According to senior, there are two final realm experts in this Origin World-Old Monster Stone and Sacred Master. Sacred Master was also a Destruction Devil from a very long time ago. Nevertheless, there could only be one existence to grasp the Supreme Law in the end. They are all my opponents.”
After Emperor Jun reached the final realm, he had begun planning on how to jump out of the cage and advance onward to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
And the most common way of becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform would be to control an Origin World, consuming a large amount of energy before allowing one to progress to the next level of life.
As for the other method, it would be to use strength and force one’s way through! By cultivating oneself, it would be entirely possible for the cultivator to force his way out of the cage. By then, it would be easy to grasp control of an Origin World.
“Old Monster Stone and Sacred Master have reached the final realm a long time ago. Their foundation is much deeper than mine.”
“I must grasp hold of this opportunity. Currently, I have been formed by the initiative of the Supreme Law in this era. I am born to destroy. The more I destroy, the more benefits I would get from the Supreme Law.” Emperor Jun thought, “And the moment I act, I must not leave any opportunity for Sacred Master or Old Monster Stone to retaliate. I have to destroy this Origin World as soon as possible and allow it to enter the Great Apocalypse.”
The moment the Origin World entered Great Apocalypse, those who had not reached the final realm would die. Even those Destruction Devils would be extinguished.
Emperor Jun did not care.
What he cared more was how much benefits would he get from the Supreme Law! By destroying, he would be seizing the opportunity of the Supreme Law.
But to Xue Ying and many other cultivators, it was impossible for them to be willing to destroy the world. Living beings were born to seek survival. They would naturally do their utmost to maintain this era.
“I shall consolidate my strength first.”
“And it’ll be the moment for me to act.” Emperor Jun grinned, “Even though Sacred Master and others aren’t any weaker than me, they can’t threaten me or stop me at all.”
…
Several tens of thousands of years later, Emperor Jun was prepared.
“Time to move out.”
Emperor Jun chuckled.
“Si la~” The surrounding void distorted to form a black hole. Emperor Jun took a step in before disappearing from the place.
When he appeared, he was in the Myriad Ancient Sacred World.
“Myriad Ancient Sacred World.”
Emperor Jun came out from the black hole. He looked downwards, watching at the different tribes scattered in the vast wilderness. Many people were living within each tribe. Further away from him, there was even a huge city.
“Hmph hmph hmph.”
Emperor Jun sneered. He hurled his long scaled tail outwards.
And then releasing out a palm that was covered in scales.
“Si la~”
The void ahead of him became distorted. Accompanying it, the land was also completely destroyed. It was to the extent that even deep underground had been run through, causing one to see the other side of the Primal Chaos Void. This distortion began spreading out in all directions, and those tribes simply turned into ashes. The city in the distance was affected by the void distortion and was destroyed along as well.
The city contained many people. There was even a Primal Chaos Realm City Master guarding it!
But it was useless. They had no way of retaliation. It was like wiping clean the drawing on an art-that city simply disappeared from existence.
Emperor Jun was too vicious. He did not plan on starting a massacre. Instead, his plan was to exterminate the entire Myriad Ancient Sacred World! The Myriad Ancient Sacred World was a place where Ancestor Sorcerer and World Ancestor constructed after a very long period. Even a final realm expert had to spend some time to destroy it entirely.
“What?”
On the Ancient Sacred World.
Being a final realm expert, ‘Sacred Master’s senses were incredibly acute. That unbridled full-powered move of Emperor Jun had been easily perceived by Sacred Master at the moment it was executed.
This man who wore a black muslin robe looked to the distance. With a glance, he saw everything that was happening in Myriad Ancient Sacred World.
“He has reached the final realm?” Sacred Master was slightly startled. His expression changed.
Even though both of them were Destruction Devils, Sacred Master did not feel joy. Instead, he felt resentful!
“He plans on destroying the world so as to maximize the bestowment by the Supreme Law? So that he would have a greater chance of grasping the Supreme Law in the future?” The eyes of Sacred Master flashed with coldness. He disappeared from the place. Just like Old Monster Stone who initially planned on paving his own path using his determination, during crucial moments, he would still pull Sacred Master back! Because the day Sacred Master grasped the Supreme Law would be the day that the fate of Old Monster Stone became controlled by Sacred Master.
Furthermore, it was highly probable for Emperor Jun to choose other paths instead of the hardest one-’using strength to break through to a higher level’.
Old Monster Stone had no choice. As a body cultivator, he could only rely on using strength to progress!
Hence…
Emperor Jun would become a greater opponent for Sacred Master in the future.
…
“Mn?”
Even though Old Monster Stone was sleeping in the Primitive Sun Star, he was still alert to the things happening out in the world.
When a frightening force erupted that felt entirely different from what Sacred Master could exert, Old Monster Stone immediately woke.
His enormous body began floating above the Primitive Sun Star.
“A new final realm expert? Or is he a Destruction Devil?” The thin old man took a step before disappearing from the Primitive Sun Star. He similarly would not allow another final realm expert to gain the bestowment of the Supreme Law so easily.
…
“How could this be?”
“We can only ask our teacher for help.” Both World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer were the leaders of Myriad Ancient Sacred World. Naturally, they were able to perceive it at the first moment, albeit they felt their heads aching before the unbridled devastation of Emperor Jun.
In the past, Sacred Master did things wantonly for the sake of spreading his religion. He did not do so just because he wanted to destroy!
Emperor Jun was different.
Even as World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer tried obstructing him, Emperor Jun would continue to execute techniques with a large area of effect. The two level-two Cosmos Gods could not protect the weak at all.
“Hold your hands.” With a cold and angry roar, Sacred Master arrived.
“This Origin World is already getting close to the Great Apocalypse. Is there a need for you to continue killing?” The thin Old Monster Stone arrived as well.
The two of them acted at the same time.
“Sacred Master, you are a Great Devil of the Primal Chaos Void, yet you chose to save these sentient beings?” Emperor Jun chuckled. He simply teleported, moving across more than half the Myriad Ancient Sacred World before continuing his destruction at another location.
“Hong.”
Old Monster Stone appeared by the side of Emperor Jun and smashed out with his punch.
Emperor Jun merely laughed. Countless lines began distorting by the side, causing the force of Old Monster Stone’s punch to dissipate by half. The remaining force was easily evaded by Emperor Jun with a flash of his figure.
“Hong long long~” At the next moment, grayish lightning descended. Sacred Master held on to his pike and was doing his best to stop Emperor Jun from his destruction.
“Haha…”
Emperor Jun continued laughing. Many lines of distortion appeared in the surroundings. After reducing the power of the incoming force, he could easily evade all those attacks.
After all, final realm experts were all formidable in survival. If he planned on evading and escaping, it was hard even for Old Monster Stone or Sacred Master to injure him.
“Si la~” Emperor Jun did not stop executing his techniques at all. With a palm, he brought about a distortion in the void that destroyed everything it touched. His offensive techniques were broader. Sacred Master had reached the final realm in the Dao of Lightning, and Old Monster Stone’s body cultivation lineage was more specialized in close combat. Hence, for a moment, it was hard for the two of them to stop Emperor Jun from his wanton destruction.
“Chi.”
A sword light abruptly appeared.
It simply pierced through the back of Emperor Jun before coming out from his chest.
Emperor Jun looked down at the sharpness of the sword protruding from his chest. Turning back, he saw a white-robed male.
“Swordmaster?” Emperor Jun stared at the white-haired male.
“Swordmaster?” Old Monster Stone and Sacred Master who could not handle Emperor Jun all along looked with shock at this scene. That silent and extremely terrifying sword had only been discovered by both Old Monster Stone and Sacred Master after it pierced through Emperor Jun. They felt an intense threat-one that was more intense than what Emperor Jun made them feel!

chapters.title: Chapter 1182 - The terrifying Swordmaster
chapters.content:
Chapter 1182: The terrifying Swordmaster
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Swordmaster has reached the final realm? When did he breakthrough?” Both Old Monster Stone and Sacred Master were incredibly shocked. At this moment, they could discern that Swordmaster was unquestionably at the final realm. Furthermore, he was stronger than the two of them!
“Hua.”
The figure of Emperor Jun who had his chest pierced abruptly dissipated. He turned into numerous black light before condensing at another location albeit with a serious injury.
He looked at the white-robed male in disbelief: “You, how could you injure me? I have reached the final realm yet why could I not sense your technique at all?”
“So you are saying that you can’t be injured once you reached the final realm?” Swordmaster once again struck out with his sword.
“Xiu.”
The sword light arced through the sky. Even though it seemed dazzling and was still traveling from a far distance, yet in actual fact, the ‘eyes’ had lied to the body. The sword light had penetrated through the body.
“Hong.” The expression of Emperor Jun paled. He once again enacted his body to destroy, turning into numerous threads before condensing at another location.
“I do not believe it. I do not believe it!” Emperor Jun was not willing to believe it. Being a final realm expert, he could not retaliate at all. Every single strike gave him a heavy injury.
Swordmaster merely sneered.
“Xiu-”
He hacked out another strike.
The sword light seemed to be vaster than the sky. Emperor Jun could not help but feel puzzled. “Peng~” His body once again turned into black light after being struck. Even his blood had been transformed into a black light. Fortunately, he was a Destruction Devil! And Destruction Devils were famous for being good at survival. If he were weaker in this aspect, his injuries might have become heavier.
“How could this be? Why can’t I block it at all?” Emperor Jun was both frustrated, shocked and unwilling.
He no longer dared to try it anymore.
The surrounding space by his body warped, and he disappeared from the vicinity.
All final realm experts were relatively amazing at escaping.
“Thinking of fleeing?” Swordmaster concentrated, extending his senses across the entire Primal Chaos Void. Suddenly, he felt the energy eruption from that Destruction Devil. Swordmaster immediately rushed over with a flash. He tore through the void like a sword.
And to the distance, both Sacred Master and Old Monster Stone were watching this scene in a daze.
They were both stunned.
They were flabbergasted.
“How could this be?” Sacred Master even felt a few dizzying spells.
“He is so strong?” Even Old Monster Stone was filled with slight disbelief, “Even if he reached the final realm, it shouldn’t be possible for him to be so overwhelmingly strong! He is an entire level stronger than us!”
The expression of Sacred Master was slightly warped: “How could this be? That Emperor Jun is also a final realm expert, yet why can’t he retaliate at all?”
If it was Sacred Master instead, he would similarly be casually trampled upon by ‘Swordmaster’.
Sacred Master could not dodge the strikes sent by Swordmaster at all! Furthermore, each sword would consume his life force, and if given sufficient time, he would be easily killed.
Unless he chose to escape.
“The power of his sword light is kept concealed. Yet when it erupts, it is frightening! Even when I ignite my Ancient Sacred Incarnation to power up a move, it could only reach this level.” Sacred Master felt a chill in his heart. A full-powered move by an ignited Ancient Sacred Incarnation was a one-off move! Yet it seemed Swordmaster could easily and casually send so many terrifying strikes.
Even though the battle seemed simple, the gravity of the situation caused the hearts of both Old Monster Stone and Sacred Master to shiver.
“If I took the hit, I would get injured too.” Old Monster Stone understood this point. Such a technique was something he could not resist directly, “Who would have thought that the number one expert of this Origin World would be Swordmaster instead.”
“He, he is way stronger than me!” Sacred Master suddenly felt both sullen and indignant.
He was used to being an existence that stood high above the rest.
He was used to being feared by all sentient creatures across the entire Primal Chaos Void. But from now on, it appeared that Swordmaster was completely beyond his level.
…
Emperor Jun’s sudden attack came too fast.
Outside of Myriad Ancient Sacred World, only ‘Old Monster Stone’, ‘Sacred Master’, and ‘Swordmaster’ could sense the attack. They had already rushed over.
As for Xue Ying, even though he had created the <Flying Snow Combat Technique> by applying certain theories from the supreme secret impartation <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>, allowing him to be as strong as a final realm cultivator, he was still lacking in various aspects. For instance, his survival techniques and perception of the Origin World were one level lower than final realm cultivators. He was only amazing in his combat skills.
And the majority of Xue Ying’s avatars were in closed-door cultivation.
With a few responsible for outside miscellaneous tasks.
Within the ‘Great Void Heaven Temple’ on the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, an avatar of Xue Ying was arranged there.
“What?”
“Emperor Jun has a breakthrough to the final realm and he plans on destroying the Myriad Ancient Sacred World? In the end, he was obstructed by Sacred Master, Senior Stone, and Swordmaster? Sacred Master and Senior Stone couldn’t stop Emperor Jun, yet Swordmaster simply sent three swords, heavily injuring Emperor Jun with each strike and causing Emperor Jun to flee as a result?”
Xue Ying, Forefather Tian Yu, Void Primogenitor, Blade Emperor, Jade Light Master, Devil Mountain Primogenitor, and other cosmos Gods were stunned when they received the piece of news.
Emperor Jun had reached the final realm?
Swordmaster was also at the final realm? Furthermore, his strength completely eclipsed that of Old Monster Stone, Sacred Master, and Emperor Jun?
“What is going on?” Xue Ying began utilizing the Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to observe the battles happening.
…
Emperor Jun appeared somewhere in the Primal Chaos Void looking at a Primal Chaos Land ahead of him. There were many living beings on this land.
“Be destroyed.” Emperor Jun waved his hand. With a boom, a horrifying ripple immediately covered the entire land. This land was directly destroyed with not even slag left behind! Clearly, the entire Primal Chaos Land including all weapons could not survive before the power of a final realm expert.
“Time to move on to the next destination.” Emperor Jun did not hesitate. He immediately fled from the place.
“Sou.”
The void warped by the side and Emperor Jun disappeared.
“Si la”, just as Emperor Jun disappeared, a ray of sword light appeared from the void before turning into Swordmaster.
“Damn.” Swordmaster looked before him. He had memorized the entire map of the Primal Chaos Void. According to it, there should be a Primal Chaos Land before him, yet it disappeared entirely.
“Continue chasing!” Swordmaster resumed his pursuit.
Emperor Jun was frantically escaping.
And as he escaped, he would hide all his aura, making it hard for Swordmaster to discover his presence. This was normal. Even if Xue Ying chose to hide his aura, unparalleled existences could not find him!
And indeed, it was almost impossible for Swordmaster to locate Emperor Jun once Emperor Jun chose to conceal his aura. But when there were sufficient disturbances, Swordmaster would be able to pinpoint where Emperor Jun was, before rushing over! Yet it was too late-he remained one step too slow.
“Hahaha, Swordmaster, your strength is indeed amazing, but you can’t kill me! If I choose to continue destroying the world… you can’t stop me from doing it either.” Emperor Jun left behind his voice as a mark in the void, causing it to echo constantly and turning the expression of Swordmaster who just arrived ashen-gray.
“Sou.”
…
This time, Emperor Jun appeared at the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World.
“Hong!”
When Emperor Jun just appeared and was about to send out a palm down on the city below him.
“Xiu.”
A sword light flitted by the body of Emperor Jun, causing it to split open. Emperor Jun immediately forced his body to dissipate. The vile destruction energy condensed once again at another location. He looked with disbelief at the distance Swordmaster: “You, how could you chase up to me?”
He had concealed his aura before acting.
“No, that isn’t right. His weapon seems different.” Emperor Jun looked at the distant Swordmaster before chuckling in a low voice, “Swordmaster, who would have thought that you would have another avatar. Why? This avatar is here especially to protect the entire Eastern Unicorn Sacred World? That’s right too since your religion, the Great Void Heaven Temple is located at the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. It is normal for you to arrange an avatar here. What I am curious about is how many avatars do you have?”
“Sou.”
Emperor Jun disappeared before rushing over to the Myriad Ancient Sacred World once again.
At this moment, Myriad Ancient Sacred World did not have Swordmaster protecting this place. When Emperor Jun appeared at the Myriad Ancient Sacred World, he simply sent a full-powered palm before rushing off again.
“Hu.” Following that, Swordmaster appeared once again.
“This Emperor Jun is too cunning. Unless I have many avatars standing guard at every single location, otherwise, it is impossible for me to catch him.” Swordmaster felt furious. It’s a pity that he only had an avatar, and the avatar which he got from his Ancient Cultivation.
“Even though Old Monster Stone and Sacred Master are at the final realm, they do not specialize in any domain technique. Hence, it is hard for them to protect a sacred world.” Swordmaster shook his head inwardly.
…
It was when Emperor Jun arrived at Eastern Unicorn Sacred World did Xue Ying find out what was happening. He also saw Swordmaster injuring that Emperor Jun with a single strike.
“The power of Swordmaster is amazing. It feels to be about a third of unparalleled existences currently.” Xue Ying could deduce it with a glance because he was similarly at that strength when he wielded the Chaotic Origin Weapon, ‘Azure River Spear’. Naturally, the unparalleled existence here in question was using Eternal Night Primogenitor as the comparison baseline since Xue Ying was the most familiar with him.
Primal Chaos Void.
Nobody owned any supreme-graded secret treasure or Chaotic Origin Weapon here. Seeing how Swordmaster could exert this amount of strength made Xue Ying suspect… that Swordmaster had also gotten a supreme impartation!
“Everyone, be careful. Don’t go out of the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. That Emperor Jun is moving across every single part of the Primal Chaos Void while destroying every single place he chose to go. I only have an avatar that could be stationed here to protect the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. As for other sacred worlds, I am afraid I can’t protect them since my true body has to chase and kill him. Otherwise, the damage might even be greater if I chose not to do so.” Swordmaster transmitted.
He was constantly pursuing after Emperor Jun.
And Emperor Jun could only wreck a location briefly before being forced to escape. Hence, the degree of destruction was relatively low.
But if this continued on, a sacred world would still be destroyed.
“What?”
“He is still destroying?”
“What should we do? That Emperor Jun chose to immediately run away after briefly wrecking a place. If this continues, the entire Primal Chaos Void might even be destroyed! Furthermore, does this mean that the Great Apocalypse will arrive prematurely?”
The Cosmos Gods were all anxious.
Xue Ying understood the issue faced by Swordmaster. Swordmaster only had two bodies. One would remain to protect a place while his true body pursued after Emperor Jun. Hence, many other places were left unprotected and Swordmaster could not do anything about it.
“Swordmaster, let me lend you a hand.” Xue Ying immediately transmitted over.

chapters.title: Chapter 1183 - It’s Dong Bo Xue Ying!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1183: It’s Dong Bo Xue Ying!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Swordmaster stood in the vast sky above Eastern Unicorn Sacred World. He extended his senses across the entire sacred world.
“What a pity that I cultivated the Dao of Destruction. If I cultivated in the Dao of Ripples, Dao of Void or some other Daos which specialized in domains, I might be able to envelop the entire Primal Chaos Void, preventing that Emperor Jun from running.” Swordmaster felt helpless inwardly. He cultivated the Dao of Destruction, Sacred Master cultivated the Dao of Lightning, and Old Monster Stone was a body cultivator. None of them were good at domains.
During ordinary circumstances, they were able to perceive all disturbances happening within the Primal Chaos Void.
If they planned on tracing someone, they would be able to trace down practically all Cosmos Gods!
But reaching the ‘final realm’ meant reaching grand perfection. One could easily conceal his soul aura and prevent others from tracing it! Swordmaster, Sacred Master, and Old Monster Stone might be able to extend their senses across the entire Primal Chaos Void, yet they could not feel where Emperor Jun existed. Unless Emperor Jun chose to exert his strength! If there was a cultivator who specialized in domains, his domain could easily envelop an Origin World. By then, he could easily observe all living beings within the domain.
What Emperor Jun did-’transforming’, ‘concealing aura’, ‘flying’, ‘teleporting’, penetrating through the void’-all kinds of movement could be perceived clearly within the domain. By then, it was impossible for Emperor Jun to escape.
It’s a pity none of them specialize in it!
He was still fine. By relying on the supreme secret impartation technique he acquired, even though he did not specialize in domains, the Destruction Domain which he executed could still cover a sacred world. That was what he currently did-to protect the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World.
But Sacred Master and Old Monster Stone could not cover a sacred world with their domains!
“If a final realm expert plans on escaping, it is hard for unparalleled existences to even kill them. This Emperor Jun remains on the run while wantonly destroying the world… if this continues, our hometown Origin World will be harmed grievously over time.” Swordmaster felt anxious, yet he could not think of any solution.
“Swordmaster, let me lend you a helping hand.” Suddenly, a voice transmission came.
“Mn?” Swordmaster who stood above the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World felt startled, “It’s Xue Ying? Helping me? How could he help me?”
…
“Weng.”
Xue Ying appeared above the sky of Myriad Ancient Sacred World. Looking at the torn land, he shook his head inwardly.
Another Xue Ying appeared above Ancestor Mother World while looking down at the numerous living beings.
An avatar of Xue Ying also appeared above the Ancient Sacred World. Xue Ying did not feel spiteful of these sentient beings that were loyal to the Sacred Master. Instead, he felt pity for them. “Just wait a little longer. All of you would soon be regaining your freedom.”
In addition to the avatar that was originally on the Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, Xue Ying had four avatars executing a domain technique at the same time.
“Hong~”
Myriad Ancient Sacred World.
The two commanders of this sacred world, ‘Ancestor Sorcerer’ and ‘World Ancestor’ were both anxious and desperate.
“What should we do? Swordmaster’s strength has far surpassed our imaginations-he is stronger than my Teacher and the Sacred Master. Even though he completely suppresses that Destruction Devil, Swordmaster can’t kill that devil at all. And that final realm Destruction Devil is still destroying the world wantonly. If this continues on, the entire Primal Chaos Void might enter a Great Apocalypse within a thousand years.” World Ancestor clenched his fists.
He felt unwilling.
If the Origin World entered an apocalypse, all of them would die! He still wanted to attempt and have a breakthrough to the final realm. Now that the Origin World was seemingly entering an apocalypse, he had no hopes of breaking through in this bit of time.
“They can’t stop him at all?” Ancestor Sorcerer felt pain in the heart too.
Old Monster Stone shook his head and sighed: “It’s the end. It seems this era is about to end.”
Sacred Master’s expression turned sullen as he watched coldly in midair.
Sacred Master’s current mood was extremely poor when he saw how ‘Emperor Jun’ continued in his unbridled destruction, maximizing the bestowment he would get from the Supreme Law while not being able to do anything at all.
Suddenly-
A wave of terrifying ripple covered the entire Myriad Ancient Sacred World. This ripple felt like an undercurrent deep in the sea, constantly gushing outwards. Even though it seemed peaceful on the surface-the myriad existences on this Myriad Ancient Sacred World were not affected at all-Sacred Master, Old Monster Stone, World Ancestor, and Ancestor Sorcerer all felt that it was because the power of this undercurrent was repressed.
Just like the great sea, everything felt calm and quiet during peaceful times.
But the moment a tsunami arrived, it would be frightening!
“It seems this ripple has covered the entire sacred world? Where did it come from?” Sacred Master, Old Monster Stone, World Ancestor, and Ancestor Sorcerer began checking the source.
They soon discovered a white-robed young man.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying?”
“It’s him?”
…
Ancestor Mother World.
Xue Ying similarly executed the fourth killing move of the <Flying Snow Combat Technique> here-’Chaotic Origin Ocean’. This was Xue Ying’s accumulation of experience in the Dao of Void that was just a step away from reaching the final realm integrated with his comprehension from the supreme secret impartation he had, and the personal experience of crossing through the higher dimension. After spending a long time did he finally succeed in creating it.
Xue Ying had to be satisfied with a killing move before it could even be added to his Flying Snow Combat Technique, and all the killing moves were all abnormally strong.
“This is?”‘Ancestor Mother’ who had always remained in low-profile within the Ancestor Mother World looked upwards. Looking into the sky, she saw that it was a white-robed male that released the terrifying domain.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying? When did he become so strong?” Ancestor Mother felt a chill in her heart.
At this moment.
The four great sacred worlds that were still present-Ancient Sacred World, Myriad Ancient Sacred World, Ancestor Mother World, and Eastern Unicorn Sacred World were wrapped around by Xue Ying’s Chaotic Origin Ocean. Each of his avatars released a domain that covered a sacred world.
Actually, the Dao of Void was tremendously known for its domain techniques. The ‘Chaotic Origin Ocean’ which was qualified to be listed in the Flying Snow Combat Technique was even more formidable. Even if it was used in the Realm Heart Great Land, it could easily cover a huge region-most cities could be easily covered by it! As for his hometown Origin World, the four sacred worlds were smaller in size and furthermore, the law suppression here was much weaker.
As for the Ancient Sacred World, it had been entirely refined by Sacred Master, falling under his complete control.
The other three sacred worlds were created by Cosmos Gods! And the laws used to create them were laws at the Cosmos God Realm.
It could not compare with the ‘Primitive Ancient Sacred World’ at all! Much less the Realm Heart Great Land that had been created by Yuan. Hence, the law suppression there was stricter. Even an unparalleled existence would be restricted by an unseen force.
“This bit of weak law suppression.” Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
Given his current strength, he could completely disregard the suppression of the law on a sacred world! Even the suppression on the Ancient Sacred World was easily pushed back by Xue Ying,
…
“It’s useless. I will not choose to entangle in a fight with you. As I move, I’ll simply destroy the world. Even though it might be slower, this Origin World would still soon invite the Great Apocalypse.” Emperor Jun coldly sneered. His eyes were filled with excitement from destroying. He was born to destroy. Even though it was possible for him to curb this desire to destroy with his current strength, the craving for it had long been etched deep in his soul.
The more he destroyed, the more satisfied he got.
“Sou.”
He penetrated through the world once again. This time, he arrived at the Ancestor Mother World.
“Destroy.” The moment he arrived here, Emperor Jun hurled out his tail, causing the world to split apart.
But following that…
Emperor Jun’s expression shifted!
He was originally sneering with disdain. He did not place that ‘Ancestor Mother’ who governs this Ancestor Mother World in his eyes. Hence, when he arrived, he immediately started sending out his destructive moves. But just as he began, he felt an incomparably terrifying force coming over.
“Suppress!” The avatar Xue Ying left responsible to guard the Ancestor Mother World was also the strongest of the nine avatars. With a cold flash in his eyes, Xue Ying immediately activated the power of the domain.
Emperor Jun only felt an endless and scary energy gushing out in his surroundings. The original attack hurled out by his tail had been whittled away under this frightening domain.
Emperor Jun felt extremely uneasy as he stood in this domain. He felt himself being hindered at every single part of his body.
“How could there be such a frightening domain here?” Emperor Jun did not dare believe it, “Even my strength has been greatly diminished.”
“Hua.”
A white-robed Xue Ying came out from amidst the void wave. He appeared before Emperor Jun.
“It’s you, Dong Bo Xue Ying?” Emperor Jun did not dare believe his eyes. He gave a savage grin before sending his claw out. Despite the hindrance from the domain, several lines of void distortion still enveloped across Xue Ying.
“The Great Cleaving Technique!”
Xue Ying used his hand as a blade, hacking down before him.
“Hua!”
A black line appeared that split the world into two. It also appeared where Emperor Jun was. The few lines of cracks which were created by the claw of Emperor Jun had simply been broken before this ‘black line’. At the same time, the force of the black line dissipated away until eventually, the distorted lines were broken whereas that black line cut on the body of Emperor Jun.
Emperor Jun’s body merely distorted. His surroundings were like a black hole that easily absorbed the strand of shockwaves.
Nonetheless, it sufficed to startle Emperor Jun: “His strength doesn’t seem to be any weaker than mine?”
How would he know that Xue Ying had killed a Paragon Master before! He even once fought with the Eight Silk Island Master. Hence, Xue Ying did not fear final realm experts at all.
“Xiu.”
A sword light appeared that cut across the body of Emperor Jun, splitting it into two. Closely following that, the body of Emperor Jun turned into black light before condensing in another area. He looked at the newly-appeared Swordmaster before turning to the white-robed Xue Ying: “How could there be two final realm cultivators appearing at the same time?”
Even though he was filled with disbelief and frustration, Emperor Jun still fled. The surrounding void formed many cracks and he soon left through it.
Swordmaster looked at Xue Ying with a grin. He transmitted over: “Ying Shan Xue Ying? Heaven’s Will Daoist?”
Any avatar of his could fight against final realm cultivators.
Thus, how could Swordmaster not deduce that ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying’ was the Heaven’s Will Daoist?
“Paragon Master Bewitching Sword ?” Xue Ying also transmitted over with a chuckle.
Both cultivators specialized in using the sword.
Both had reached the final realm too! The rise of Paragon Master Bewitching Sword was extremely fast as well. By deducing it according to the time of Paragon Master Bewitching Sword reincarnating in the Cang Clan, it was precisely not too long since Swordmaster joined the Great Void Heaven Temple. Furthermore, the other party treated Xue Ying so well, and that bizarre feeling of familiarity coupled with the recognition of Swordmaster’s energy when he fought affirmed Xue Ying’s guesses!
Both of them grinned at each other.
“You can protect four great sacred worlds, and my two avatars could continue chasing after him. It’s just that he can escape in all directions. The Primal Chaos Void is too vast, making it hard for us to stop him from his wanton destruction.” Swordmaster transmitted.
“I have a way.” Xue Ying smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1184 - Domain Shroud
chapters.content:
Chapter 1184: Domain Shroud
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Sou sou sou sou sou…”
At this moment.
Many white-robed Xue Yings began appearing across the vast Primal Chaos Void. Some appeared above Primal Chaos Lands, some by the side of a cosmos, while others amidst the turbulence of Primal Chaos Void. Even though the turbulence was dangerous, it was not a threat to the avatars.
Given his current attainments in the Dao of Void, Xue Ying had more than 10,000 avatars! Only four were required to protect the four great sacred worlds.
As for the remaining five major avatars of Xue Ying, they took the initiative to divide up their souls. Even though the Supreme Law of his hometown Origin World was weak, Xue Ying still suffered from its restrictions.
With more than 10,000 avatars, even though each avatar had a slightly weaker soul, their realms were equivalent.
Relying on the transcendental realms each avatar had, they could still unleash the power of a Cosmos God.
“Weng.”
It was impossible for the avatars to execute the complex killing moves in the <Flying Snow Combat Technique>. They could only execute some of the domain techniques comprehended at an earlier realm.
A weak little white-robed Xue Ying stood amidst the Primal Chaos Void.
The surrounding essence of void-black fog spherical particles-were under the control of Xue Ying. He did not require a terrifying killing move like that ‘Chaotic Origin Ocean’. Instead, he only needed a domain that covered a sufficiently large area! Every avatar poured in their strength to cast down a domain. Xue Ying cultivated both the ‘Dao of Void’ and ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’. Even though the region covered by an illusory realm was bigger, the domain techniques cast using the Dao of Void were more formidable.
Furthermore, the law suppression in the ‘Primal Chaos Void’ was incredibly weak.
When Xue Ying was still at the True God Ruler Realm traveling in the Primal Chaos Void, he could already unleash an incredibly huge domain.
And now?
“Weng.”
Even though these avatars were weak, they were still at the Cosmos God level.
Hence, the void domain they unleashed was similarly great.
One of them, two of them, three…
More than 10,000 avatars scattered across the Primal Chaos Void released their domains simultaneously.
“Mn.”
And all avatars were linked via their souls. Their memories and thoughts were universal.
At this moment, Xue Ying had covered more than half the entire Primal Chaos Void by relying on all the domains released.
“Even though I have covered only about 70% of the entire Primal Chaos Void, many of the places are wilderness. The places I need to protect are just Cosmoses and Primal Chaos Land with sentient beings living on it.” With a thought, some avatars began altering their positions. As Xue Ying’s attainments in the Dao of Void had surpassed that of Monarch Nine Cloud and the rest, he could easily cover the entire Primal Chaos Void with a single teleport.
Primal Chaos Void.
Some regions were incredibly vast yet no cosmoses, lands, and sentient beings were present. They were simply pieces of dead regions.
And some regions were denser like the Cosmoses and Primal Chaos Lands.
Hence, Xue Ying gave up on those desolate places.
With his avatars covering about 70% of the entire Primal Chaos Void, after giving up many of the desolate regions, Xue Ying was able to easily cover almost all regions in the Primal Chaos Void where sentient beings lived!
“Everyone, just die!”
Emperor Jun appeared at a particular location in the Primal Chaos Void. Waving his hand, he covered a Cosmos with his technique.
If one mentioned how powerful the ‘Chaotic Origin Ocean’ was-one would easily perceive the domain when one entered it-then the domain unleashed by the avatars of Xue Ying using the black fog spherical particles were comparatively weaker! Yet the domain had a greater effect in terms of ‘scouting’! Emperor Jun remained unaware of being enveloped by this domain.
“He is here.”
“Sou sou sou!”
Three figures appeared in the distance. One was Xue Ying, and the other were the two bodies of Swordmaster. At the moment they appeared, Xue Ying acted to protect that cosmos.
“So quick?” Emperor Jun was astonished. He had just executed his technique and Swordmaster was here?
“Sou sou.”
The two Swordmasters executed their techniques at the same time.
“Sou.”
Emperor Jun fled once again.
“I found him. Continue chasing!” Xue Ying’s current domain already covered 70% of the entire Primal Chaos Void. Hence, the moment Emperor Jun disappeared and appeared at another location, the entire process of void penetration-the changes of the black fog spherical particles could be ‘clearly seen’ by Xue Ying. Even though Emperor Jun had concealed his aura when he penetrated through the void, it’s a pity that he remained within the domain region of Xue Ying all the while.
“Sou sou sou!”
Xue Ying’s avatar brought along Swordmaster and went chasing after him.
“How could it be so coincidental the previous time? For them to appear right after I executed my technique? That’s too fast!” Emperor Jun carefully penetrated through the void to another region. At the same time, he felt bewildered and unease. Normally, it would take some time for someone else to sense the fluctuations of a move before rushing over.
“Si la.”
Two frightening sword lights appeared from the void and hacked down on the body of Emperor Jun. It immediately caused his body to turn into dark light before condensing at another location. He looked with terror as he watched Xue Ying and the two Swordmasters appear.
“How could this be?”
“Flee!”
Emperor Jun suppressed the boiling blood in his body as he escaped in a flurry.
He just reached another location carefully without having sufficient time to let out a breath of relief when another sword lights descended!
“Si la.”
His injuries continued worsening.
…
“Escape!”
“Escape!”
“Escape!”
Emperor Jun felt that no matter where he escaped to, he would immediately be struck by the sword lights! It was too fast! How would he know that Xue Ying had simply arranged an avatar to bring Swordmaster along in a ‘teleport’, and when Emperor Jun arrived at a location, Xue Ying and Swordmaster would be there too!
With a region coverage of 70%, if Emperor Jun continued escaping a few more times, he would discover that the ‘desolate regions’ were not within the domain.
But after being heavily struck successively, with every single time being attacked by the two Swordmasters simultaneously, Emperor Jun’s injuries were worsening! He even felt death looming close.
“It must be that Dong Bo Xue Ying. He should be a Dao of Void final realm expert, and must have covered the entire Primal Chaos Void with his domain. Hence, no matter where I escaped to, I’ll still be under his observation!” Emperor Jun guessed after being chased by the enemy successively.
Even though he misunderstood that Xue Ying was a final realm expert.
But it was not that excessive since Xue Ying’s current strength was close to a final realm cultivator.
“How could this be? It is fine if a terrifying existence like Swordmaster appear, making me unable to retaliate. And now another Dong Bo Xue Ying appeared? And he even cultivates the Dao of Void?” Emperor Jun felt bitter.
“Sou.”
This time, he simply teleported back to the Lost World Corridor.
The Lost World Corridor was also the lair that produced Destruction Devils. It was a place that completely suppressed cultivators. Xue Ying and the others would be heavily affected if they entered the Lost World Corridor, with their domain techniques and other moves being greatly weakened! That was why searching for ‘lairs’ were so difficult. Over here, Xue Ying could not cover a huge region at all with his domain.
Over here, the Supreme Law was partial towards the Destruction Devils.
“He has escaped to the Lost World Corridor.”
Xue Ying looked at the two Swordmasters by the side before saying, “The Lost World Corridor is also the place where Destruction Devils are born. I can’t cover a huge region with my domain over there. Furthermore, space is unpredictable in that region.”
“He escaped to the Lost World Corridor?” Swordmaster grinned. Another avatar of his disappeared, “That’s fine too. We have forced Emperor Jun back to his hole. Even though we can’t kill him, and I am quite unwilling to let things by, we have at least resolved the issue regarding the Great Apocalypse.”
Xue Ying nodded.
Swordmaster grinned at Xue Ying: “Xue Ying, you have hidden yourself really well. Heaven’s Will Daoist? You are amazing to suppress all devils in the Realm Heart Great Land just by yourself.”
…
At the same time when Xue Ying conversed with Swordmaster.
The other Cosmos Gods were nervously watching the battle. Forefather Tian Yu, Ancestor Sorcerer, World Ancestor, Devil Mountain Primogenitor, Jade Light Master, Great Emperor Cloud Serpent, Blade Emperor, Bone Ancestor, and others were all anxious! They had no choice. One single Emperor Jun might cause the entire Primal Chaos Void to enter the eventual Great Apocalypse prematurely. They who had not reached the final realm would all perish!
“Who would have thought that Xue Ying has reached the final realm as well. That is truly unfathomable.” Blade Emperor exclaimed. Devil Mountain Primogenitor, Jade Light Master, Void Primogenitor, Forefather Tian Yu, World Ancestor, Ancestor Sorcerer, and others were by his side. They were currently watching a projection that showed the scenes happening in the four great sacred worlds. Each of the world contained a white-robed Xue Ying protecting it.
They had also seen the battle of Xue Ying fighting with Emperor Jun.
“No matter where Emperor Jun escaped to, he can’t get out of the domain of Xue Ying! He has been pursued by both Xue Ying and Swordmaster. His injuries are worsening as well! Haha, in the end, he has escaped. It is most likely that he has run back to the Lost World Corridor! The entire Primal Chaos Void only has the Lost World Corridor where the Destruction Devils are heavily protected.” Old Monster Stone also appeared here.
With the group of Cosmos Gods present, the words spoken by Old Monster Stone made them relax.
At least the danger of the Great Apocalypse had been resolved temporarily!
“Swordmaster has broken through to the final realm, and now, Xue Ying has too?” Void Primogenitor shook his head in a sigh. He remained in a shock.
“My Great Void Heaven Temple has two final realm cultivators now?” Forefather Tian Yu blinked his eyes a few times.
This was truly a beautiful misunderstanding.
Their wisdom was limited. They could only see from the surface that Xue Ying’s strength was comparable to the final realm Destruction Devil, ‘Emperor Jun’. Naturally, they thought Xue Ying had reached the final realm.
…
No matter what, the group of Cosmos Gods was delighted. After escaping from the close shave of death, they felt more relaxed and joyful.
And on another side.
Xue Ying chatted with Swordmaster
“Right. That time when I haven’t joined the Great Void Heaven Temple, I actually acquired a Realm Heart Order! It’s just that I am not too willing to reincarnate myself into another Origin World. In the end after I cultivated the Ancient Cultivation Technique, I was fortunate to refine another avatar. Hence, I no longer hesitate to let my avatar reincarnate into the Realm Heart Great Land.” Swordmaster chuckled, “Hence, it seems I have always been in closed-door cultivation without going out to temper myself. In reality though, I have been doing so in the Realm Heart Great Land. Otherwise, how could it be possible for me to reach the Cosmos God Realm without sufficient refinement of myself? And how could I have reached the level-two Cosmos God or peak Cosmos God realm? Cultivation is never that easy!”
“But your speed of cultivation is already very fast.” Xue Ying said, “To have reached the final realm in such a short period!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1185 - The Dao Path towards grasping the Supreme Law
chapters.content:
Chapter 1185: The Dao Path towards grasping the Supreme Law
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Swordmaster chuckled: “I have reached level-two Cosmos God Realm a while ago. It was only after cultivating for a long period of time and gaining the confidence of suppressing Sacred Master using my ‘Dao of Destruction’ did I choose to plunder part of the Origin Source Energy from the Origin World. Furthermore, cultivating with the best conditions and resources in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation along with getting bestowed with a supreme secret impartation at the Realm Heart God Palace, I was able to finally reach the final realm after accumulating sufficient comprehension.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Saying that, you should be the number one expert in our Origin World with regards to both Dao of Void and Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm right?” Swordmaster said, “You should be quite close to reaching the final realm in the Dao of Void already. Why did you not choose to grasp part of this Origin Source Energy?”
“I was worried that a cornered dog would be driven to take desperate actions.” Xue Ying replied, “I am afraid the speed of my improvement in both Dao of Void and Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm would startle Sacred Master, pushing him to do things like Emperor Jun and choose to end this era prematurely. Ultimately, I have yet to reach the final realm! The moment the Primal Chaos Void is destroyed, my true body can’t survive and would be forced to leave via the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique. Once the Origin World is newly formed, I’ll be marked as an outsider when I come back.”
Swordmaster was enlightened: “That’s logical. Given the natural disposition of Sacred Master, he would definitely be provoked to take desperate actions.”
Xue Ying nodded.
Jumping out of the cage to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform! That was the desire of every peak Cosmos Gods!
And according to what he currently understood, there were several ways of jumping out of the cage.
Firstly, to grasp the Supreme Law.
Secondly, to break through using force. Once a cultivator was sufficiently powerful, he would surpass the restrictions governed by the Supreme Law. It would hence be easy to refine and control an Origin World after that.
Most final realm cultivators would choose to grasp the Supreme Law like how ‘Sacred Master’ did-to start a religion and collect belief energy. The wisdom of the people would be used to gather the essence of the Origin World! Given how unique and mysterious a ‘soul’ was, it could be greatly nourishing even to the soul of Cosmos Gods.
If an absolutely great number of sentient beings choose to believe in an expert within the Origin World!
The will of the populace is equivalent to the will of an Origin World!
If the populace believed in an expert, the will of the Origin World would also be directed to support that expert. This would greatly ease the process of grasping the entire Supreme Law, allowing that expert to become the owner of an Origin World! By relying on the huge amount of energy provided by the Origin World, it would naturally be easy to take that final step and become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
Nonetheless, this was a very difficult path to take regardless.
Firstly, one had to wait until the Origin World had sufficient number of people. During the early periods of the Origin World, there were few sentient beings. Hence, the will of the beings would not have a strong influence on the will of the Origin World. Only when the Origin World reached the peak flourishing period where there were many sentient beings-to the extent that the population had reached the limit of what the Origin World could withstand-would the will of the population be able to influence the will of the Origin World!
Secondly, belief! This required the beings to believe in the expert deep from their souls. If the belief wasn’t pure enough, it would be useless. Hence, the Sacred Master chose to imprint a mark into the souls of every current believer of his.
Unquestionably.
The ‘Supreme Law’ would hinder those taking this path. Other experts would as well!
For instance, after ‘Sacred Master’ and others withstood against the Great Apocalypse of the Origin World, during the emergence period, they would choose to slumber! When they awoke, the Origin World would have already been populated with numerous sentient beings, with Cosmos Gods emerging already. The rule of the Supreme Law of an Origin World did so to ensure that the newly-emerged sentient beings had the power to retaliate. Having a ‘balance’ was one of the core attributes of the Supreme Law.
…
Other than spreading religion so as to rely on the help of the populace’s will in grasping the Supreme Law.
There was another way-to grasp the Origin Source!
The Origin World had Origin Source too!
The Origin Source was a form of Supreme Law produced when various ‘final realm Daos’ weaved together perfectly. Any strand of Origin Source would be at the final realm level. In order to grasp it, one had to be at least a level-two Cosmos God.
If one could grasp more than half the total Origin Source Energy! Then it would be possible for the cultivator to rely on it to grasp the Supreme Law.
But what did it mean to grasp more than half of it?
It meant that one had to reach the level-two Cosmos God Realm in many different Dao paths!
“I have already reached the level-two Cosmos God Realm in the Dao of Void. It is the same as well in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm. Hence, I had to be more careful in not provoking the Sacred Master.” Xue Ying said. There was no need to conceal this matter before Swordmaster since Swordmaster was a final realm cultivator in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, and he would soon learn about it.
“You have reached level two in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm too?” Swordmaster was startled.
“I had even done a trade with the Summer Wind Ancient Nation, acquiring the Void Fire Lotus Flower from them. That was why Emperor Summer and the others had already known of my identity as the Heaven’s Will Daoist.” Xue Ying elaborated.
“Haha, no wonder. Mn, that Sacred Master has cultivated for several eras and have reached the final realm in the Dao of Lightning. He has also reached the level-two Cosmos God Realm in the ‘Dao of Destruction’, ‘Dao of Dark’, and ‘Dao of Light’.” Swordmaster said, “Previously, my attainments in the Dao of Destruction had been more profound than his, allowing me to plunder over the controlling rights of the ‘Dao of Destruction’, allowing him to control even less Origin Source Energy. As for you, you cultivated for a period far shorter than mine. If you were to plunder two strands of Origin Source Energy, it will definitely provoke him.”
Xue Ying nodded: “That’s right. I originally wanted to remain low-profile and only act when I reached the final realm!”
If he did not reach the final realm, once Sacred Master chose to flip the tables, Xue Ying could not survive the Great Apocalypse!
Even though it would be helpful to temper his ‘cultivation’ when one or two more final realm enemies existed, if the enemy was too terrifying, it would be a disaster instead!
The reason why Sacred Master wasn’t afraid of ‘Swordmaster’ in the past was because Swordmaster merely specialized in one single ‘Dao of Destruction’. This Dao Path did not specialize in spreading religion or soul control! Neither did it specialize in controlling a large amount of Origin Source! Hence, he still looked forward to the growth of Swordmaster since only he and Old Monster Stone existed in this Origin World. Furthermore, Old Monster Stone was always in slumber, and Sacred Master felt too lonely.
But if Xue Ying grasped two strands of Origin Source despite cultivating for less than two trillion years, it might provoke him instead!
Perhaps he might be confident and feel that Xue Ying could not threaten him.
But it was possible for Sacred Master to flip the tables and bring the world to an end!
“You haven’t reached the final realm?” Swordmaster looked at Xue Ying, “You should have acquired a supreme secret impartation in the Realm Heart God Palace too?”
“Mn, I have entered the Realm Heart God Palace in the same batch as you did.” Xue Ying explained, “Even though I have the supreme secret impartation with me, it is still difficult to reach the final realm.”
Swordmaster nodded. His eyes were filled with a strand of melancholy: “That’s right. It is hard.”
Only after he walked down this path did he find out how difficult it was.
Others might feel that his rate of cultivation was relatively fast, yet they did not know how much he experienced.
“The competition in the Cang Clan was incredibly intense. Previously, I was too weak and could not acquire a slot to enter the Realm Heart God Palace. Only after becoming a Paragon Master did I succeed in getting a slot.” Swordmaster said.
“It is fortunate that you broke through. Otherwise, things might be troublesome if Emperor Jun chose to wreak havoc.” Xue Ying stated.
“It is also thanks to you. I can’t stop him just by myself alone.” Swordmaster chuckled.
Both of them looked at each other.
And they laughed.
That’s right.
It was quite fortunate for them. Both of them could not stop a final realm Destruction Devil from destroying the world alone! That time, ‘Luo City Lord’ had given an opportunity to both Xue Ying and Swordmaster respectively because of pity. Luo City Lord wasn’t certain of what his actions would bring. He was only giving the natives hope. And now, it succeeded!
The two of them had saved the population.
“Swordmaster, since you have broken through, there is no need for me to endure any longer.” Xue Ying said, “After forcing Emperor Jun into the Lost World Corridor, there is no longer a need to tolerate Sacred Master anymore.”
“Sacred Master?” Swordmaster’s eyes brightened, “You mean…”
“Since the two of us can force Emperor Jun to this extent! We should be able to force Sacred Master to hide as well.” Xue Ying’s eyes flashed with sharpness, “His way of spreading his religion is to treat all sentient beings as slaves, directly controlling all their souls. If we could save those people, we might as well do it now.”
Swordmaster looked at Xue Ying: “Are you confident of saving them?”
“Enslaving the beings is merely a form of soul controlling technique.” Xue Ying laughed, “And in terms of controlling the soul, do you think Sacred Master could compare with me, a level-two Cosmos God in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm? I have already examined through their souls, and am confident of saving them. I did not do so in fear of startling Sacred Master in the past.”
“Alright.” Swordmaster was filled with excitement, “Since you are confident of saving those enslaved beings, then we can move any time.”
“This time, we’ll chase that Sacred Master away in one fell swoop!” Xue Ying looked forward to it too.
As for killing him?
Xue Ying of course desired to do so. There were too many people who desired for the death of Sacred Master! But it was useless! Even unparalleled existences could not kill final realm experts.

chapters.title: Chapter 1186 - Forcing Sacred Master to flee
chapters.content:
Chapter 1186: Forcing Sacred Master to flee
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Ancestor Mother World.
Ancestor Mother was prostrating with fear. She carefully looked at Xue Ying who stood in the distance.
“How is this Dong Bo Xue Ying so powerful?” Ancestor Mother felt uneasy.
Suddenly-
Two rays of green swordlight stealthily entered the body of Ancestor Mother. Her huge body trembled before it silently crumbled apart. Only at this moment did the two Swordmasters appear by the side looking coldly at everything. For the sake of ensuring the kill, he acted with both his bodies! Swordmaster cultivated a supreme secret impartation. Even if he did not own any supreme-graded secret treasure or Chaotic Origin Weapon, he was still approximately 30% as strong as Eternal Night Primogenitor.
Killing a level-two Cosmos God?
All it took was just one technique.
“Ancestor Mother is dead just like this?” Xue Ying was relatively startled.
He still remembered the ‘Ancestor Mother Religion’ invading into the cosmos he was born in, bringing about a catastrophe.
And currently, the ‘origin’ of the Ancestor Mother Religion across the whole Origin World-Ancestor Mother-died just like this! She had lived in seclusion for a very long period, and would have many more hidden techniques. In the end, everything was futile before absolute power! Even the final realm Emperor Jun could not defend himself against Swordmaster, so how could Ancestor Mother?
“Go.” Swordmaster transmitted over, “Let’s continue to the Ancient Sacred World.”
“And chase away Sacred Master.” Xue Ying quite looked forward to it. He dared not tarry in fear of alerting Sacred Master to what they planned on doing.
…
Ancient Sacred World.
As the battle started by Emperor Jun had ended, Xue Ying who had been standing guard at this place left as well.
“How could this be?” Sacred Master sat on his black stone bed wearing his black muslin cloth felt complex.
Emperor Jun failed to bring about an apocalypse, thus losing the chance of getting rewarded by the Supreme Law. Sacred Master was naturally happy to see this.
But he felt distressed over the power of Swordmaster and Xue Ying.
“They are maturing too quickly!” Sacred Master did not dare believe it, “It is fine that Swordmaster has reached this realm since he cultivated for a relatively longer period. But how long did that Dong Bo Xue Ying cultivate? And now he has reached the final realm? When was it this easy to have a breakthrough to the final realm? Or is his talent really that heaven-defying?”
Sacred Master had a feeling.
That even if he entered the next era, or the subsequent eras, his chance of grasping the Supreme Law when competing with Swordmaster and Xue Ying would not be high at all.
“With them obstructing me, the difficulty of me spreading my religion will be much harder in the next era.” Sacred Master thought, “That Dong Bo Xue Ying even specializes in the Mirage and Illusory Realm. His control of the soul isn’t any weaker than mine.”
But he did not know that currently, Xue Ying had reached the level-two Cosmos God Realm in the Mirage and Illusory Realm.
“It is time for me to give up on this path to spread religion!”
“I should just comprehend other Daos and try to control as many Cosmic Origin Source as possible. Perhaps by relying on this, I might be able to breakthrough using force?” Sacred Master plotted. Even though he felt the intense pressure, he did not plan on giving up. He was clear how difficult it was to jump out of the cage, “I don’t believe that Swordmaster and Dong Bo Xue Ying would be able to jump out of the cage that easily. It is still hard to determine who the final winner is!”
“Mn?”
Sacred Master felt a strand of fluctuation, “What is going on? Unless they are still chasing after Emperor Jun? Did Emperor Jun not escape already?”
Sacred Master immediately extended his senses in the direction where the fluctuation came. He immediately discovered the Ancestor Mother World, and the death of ‘Ancestor Mother’!
He did not have time to be startled by it.
“Sou sou.”
When two sinister green rays of sword light pierced through the body of Sacred Master. The sword lights came too abruptly, that Sacred Master failed to dodge it in spite of his current strength.
“Hong!”
His body was forced to dissipate.
“Hong long long~” Xue Ying soon appeared above the vast Ancient Sacred World. He began executing the killing move from his <Flying Snow Combat Technique>, the ‘Chaotic Origin Ocean’!
During this period, the dissipating black light from Sacred Master’s body condensed at another location. Being a Destruction Devil, his survivability skills were not any weaker than Emperor Jun’s.
He watched with alarm and anger at the distant Swordmaster and Xue Ying who began releasing his domain.
“Damn.”
Fury coursed through Sacred Master.
He knew.
Swordmaster and Xue Ying had come to deal against him after handling Emperor Jun! His ‘Ancient Sacred Incarnation’ had been consumed fully after that battle with Old Monster Stone. Currently, the accumulated energy remained low, and it was pointless to use it in dealing against Swordmaster.
“Escape.”
Sacred Master had instinctually chose this path.
After all, the battle started by Emperor Jun proved one point! He remained helpless against ‘Swordmaster’. The more they fought, the worse his injuries would become.
“Sou sou!”
The Ancient Sacred Incarnation and Sacred Master’s body immediately fused into one. Furthermore, he immediately roared out with lightning, tearing out a maelstrom passage before tunneling through it.
“Continue chasing!”
Xue Ying and Swordmaster planned on using the same strategy as they did with Emperor Jun.
A weaker avatar of Xue Ying brought the two Swordmasters along as they teleported on towards chasing after Sacred Master!
…
As they chased after Sacred Master, three powerful avatars of Xue Ying were left behind in the Ancient Sacred World.
“Hong.””Hong.””Hong.”
A vast illusory realm descended. This illusory realm occupied an area much smaller than Xue Ying’s Void Domain. After all, a powerful avatar releasing a Void Domain could occupy the entire Ancient Sacred World easily! As for the illusory realm, the three great avatars had to work together before they could barely cover the same area.
“I have to make full use of the time and save them.” Xue Ying’s three great avatars began acting.
Every single sentient being within the Ancient Sacred World-from weak humans to even the most powerful lightning Cosmos God-fell into the illusion. That strongest being was merely a level-two Cosmos God, and currently, Xue Ying had fused four branches of the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm together! He was just one gap away from reaching the final realm. Hence, his illusory realm was frighteningly strong.
“Soul.”
“That strand of energy.”
After falling into the illusion, all sentient beings within the Ancient Sacred World did not retaliate. Their souls remained passive and were obediently controlled by Xue Ying.
Xue Ying then carefully unraveled the energy branded on their souls.
“It might be somewhat troublesome to resolve this brand mark with that lightning Cosmos God.”
“Mn, at least I succeeded.”
“Isolate all of them.”
He first isolated the brand marks before destroying them.
By isolating it, Xue Ying was preventing the Sacred Master from relying on the brand to wipe out these believers.
…
It was not just happening in the Ancient Sacred World. Xue Ying also dispatched many avatars over to big places where the Ancient Sacred Religion were active like Nine Cloud Great Land. Those places were much smaller than the Ancient Sacred World. The number of believers in the Ancient Sacred World occupied up to 90% of what Sacred Master had! It was because the Ancient Sacred World was too big.
…
Sacred Master felt his heart filled with indignance as he was chased by Xue Ying and Swordmaster. He did not even have the time to think about killing all his believers. Instinctively, he still recognized those believers as an energy spring for his Ancient Sacred Incarnation Body, so why would he wipe them out when he had a hard time surviving?
“How could they, how dare they!”
Sacred Master was incredibly furious.
It had been too long.
Over the long years, even across many eras in the past.
Sacred Master was used to being a supreme status. He was used to being revered by many experts. This habit persisted across several eras! Yet at this moment when he was pushed down from his throne and pursued after like a stray dog, Swordmaster felt great humiliation. Yet it was futile even if he was angrier! That Swordmaster completely suppressed him. And Xue Ying’s Dao of Void prevented him from escaping at all.
“Sacred Master, it is impossible for you to escape.” When the three bodies appeared once again, the sword lights had already flitted through his body.
The body of Sacred Master once again exploded violently.
“I am still being chased after no matter where I ran off to.” Yet Sacred Master did not know Xue Ying had dispatched three great avatars over from the Myriad Ancient Sacred World and Ancestor Mother World to the Ancient Sacred World.
Nonetheless, as Sacred Master was busily escaping, he would naturally tunnel to the more desolate areas, and would definitely not take the initiative to visit the few big sacred worlds.
“Hu!”
“Hong!”
The sword lights were whistling.
He was being struck time after time, causing his life force to rapidly reduce. In just that short amount of time, he was struck five consecutive times, causing him to be left with just 30% of original his life force. After all, both bodies of Swordmaster were acting at the same time.
“I can’t let things continue this way. I can only return to the Lost World Corridor.” Enraged, Sacred Master knew he had to take the same path as Emperor Jun did.
“Sou!”
A terrifying lightning tore a passage out. Sacred Master went along this passage into the Lost World Corridor.
Lost World Corridor.
That was the birthplace for the Destruction Devils, and was also an ultra-huge maze! The space there was unpredictable and strange.
“Sou sou sou!”
The three figures of Xue Ying chased into this place.
“Lost World Corridor.” Xue Ying frowned slightly. Other than feeling the suppression in the surroundings, space here was in constant turbulence. Furthermore, there were even ruptures in the space next to them! Hence, Xue Ying could only observe a small region around him! The ruptures broke his domain. With the numerous ruptures and constant turbulence, this place turned into a huge maze.
It was hard even for Cosmos Gods to find traces of Destruction Devils. It was also a protection the Supreme Law laid down for the devils.
“We can’t find him at all. Even if we spend a little more time searching for Sacred Master, he could simply tunnel away, causing us to waste our effort. Let’s go. He could only hide in this place. We are able to chase him down in other places after all.” Xue Ying uttered.
“Mn, let him hide here for eternity then.” Swordmaster nodded with a smile.
…
In a sealed space within the Lost World Corridor.
Sacred Master stood here by himself.
The surrounding was a piece of snowy white emptiness. Looking at it, Sacred Master felt sorrowful.
He was actually forced into such an outcome.
Being pursued until he no longer had a path to take. In the end, he could only escape into the Lost World Corridor! And this Lost World Corridor was actually suppressing him too! Only the Destruction Devils nurtured during this era were given the mission of destruction, and thus would not be suppressed.
“I ended up just like this?” Sacred Master stood there blankly.
Suddenly-
“My believers!” Sacred Master suddenly felt it.
Several avatars of Xue Ying had isolated all the brand marks using the Illusory Realm, breaking all connection Sacred Master had with his believers. Even though it was not all believers, at least 99% of the believers had their brand marks isolated.
“How could he break my soul brand?” Sacred Master did not dare believe it.
He was forced to hide here.
And even his believers were plundered away?
What does he have left?
Even in the subsequent eras of this Origin World, with the huge enemies-Swordmaster and Xue Ying present, his days would definitely be spent in bitterness.
At this moment, Sacred Master felt slightly cold in his heart!
“I am not willing!” The previously calm expression of Sacred Master started distorting. It revealed the look he had as a Destruction Devil. Black fog even started rolling out from his body as he growled, “I am not willing!”
His roar reverberated in this lonely space.

chapters.title: Chapter 1187 - Joy of the Souls
chapters.content:
Chapter 1187: Joy of the Souls
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
After Sacred Master let out a mad roar, he slowly regained his silence.
His eyes were dark and cold.
Given the current fury and killing intent overwhelming his heart, he precisely wanted to control his believers and ‘kill them with one thought’. Even though Xue Ying isolated at least 99% of the brand marks, the Ancient Sacred Religion had still been spreading across the Origin World for a long period. Some of the unremarkable Cosmoses and Primal Chaos Lands were also touched by this religion.
Xue Ying could only save those believers he knew were stated in the intelligence reports.
Even though the fury was surging in the chest of Sacred Master, he did not choose to slaughter the believers. Firstly, these few believers were still able to provide some belief energy to him. Secondly, he wanted to rely on them to understand the changes happening in the great sacred worlds. If all his believers died, then he would have become ‘blind’. He would not know of anything happening in the outer world.
“They have hidden themselves really deeply.”
“Not only has Swordmaster reached the final realm, his strength has surpassed mine too. It seems what I guessed is right-he must have gotten the Realm Heart Order!” Sacred Master’s eyes flashed with coldness, “Otherwise, how could he reach the final realm without tempering himself through life and death battles? It is fine if he reached the final realm, but how could he become so powerful?”
“There is also that Dong Bo Xue Ying! In the past, I had clearly controlled his soul yet he succeeded to suicide. Initially, I thought it was because he knew some secret techniques, but it appears that it should be because of the Realm Heart Order as well.” Sacred Master thought, “Previously, it must be he who intruded my Ancient Sacred World to save his wife, Yu Jing Qiu! And I was so foolish to think how could such a mysterious expert appear?”
“Realm Heart Order.”
Sacred Master gritted his teeth.
He lived through many eras and had long heard of legends regarding the Realm Heart Order. There had been cultivators who got their hands on the Realm Heart Order in the previous eras, reincarnating into the Realm Heart Great Land. Nonetheless, none of those who found the Realm Heart Order reached the final realm!
Most who got the Realm Heart Order were young geniuses.
Regardless of whether it had been Xue Ying or Swordmaster, both of them acquired the Realm Heart Order when they were at the Primal Chaos Realm. Nevertheless, it was very hard even for a genius Primal Chaos cultivator to reach the final realm after reincarnating into the Realm Heart Great Land!
“Who would have thought that I would meet two of them in this era.” Sacred Master felt sullen. He was completely defeated.
Being teamed up by two absolute experts, Sacred Master could not retaliate at all! He could only rely on the Lost World Corridor to survive!
******
At the Ancient Sacred World.
The three avatars of Xue Ying were located at different regions casting an illusory realm on all sentient beings living within the Ancient Sacred World. Everyone fell into a daze. Nobody could retaliate at all, and these beings were under the complete control of Xue Ying.
If any one of them had the slightest intention of resisting, then isolating the brand mark would end up in failure!
“Sou sou sou sou…”
Many figures appeared above the Ancient Sacred World.
The thin Old Monster Stone, white-haired Swordmaster, Forefather Tian Yu, Void Primogenitor, Blade Emperor, World Ancestor, Ancestor Sorcerer, Devil Mountain Primogenitor, Great Emperor Cloud Serpent, Ancestor Pure One, Jade Light Master, Bone Ancestor, and other Cosmos Gods appeared. They looked at the distant white-robed young men currently standing in midair with their eyes closed, before turning downwards at the sentient beings who had all fallen down onto the ground.
Not only humans, even the beasts and beings of various races were deep asleep.
This was an unprecedented silence in the Ancient Sacred World.
“He could even save those believers of Sacred Master from their soul brands?” Blade Emperor exclaimed, “Truly amazing!”
“After the death of Ancestor Mother, all believers she controlled have regained their freedom. But Sacred Master hasn’t die, which means we have to handle those believers one by one.” Swordmaster chuckled, “It is fortunate that Xue Ying has great attainments in the Mirage, granting him the ability to save them! Even though the Ancient Sacred Religion and Ancestor Mother Religion are the two greatest religions in our Origin World, the number of believers in the Ancient Sacred Religion far exceed that of the Ancestor Mother Religion.”
“Mn.”
Everyone present nodded.
“This is a huge achievement!” Forefather Tian Yu sighed.
“Let’s hope everything goes smoothly.” Ancestor Sorcerer was carefully observing the people instead. They were clear how troublesome things were when they were pertaining to souls! In the past, it was practically impossible for others to save a cultivator once his soul was branded with a mark. Asking Ancestor Mother or Sacred Master to release them? Or how about killing Sacred Master and Ancestor Mother so as to return back the freedom of the believers? Or to rely on an expert like Xue Ying in isolating the brand marks?
In the past, all three methods were not practical.
But now, Ancestor Mother died!
And Sacred Master could only hide in the Lost World Corridor to survive.
“Weng~”
Many ripples could be felt spreading in the world.
Swordmaster, Old Monster Stone, Forefather Tian Yu, and others held their breaths as they watched. They could feel that mysterious fluctuation brushing across them.
“Dissipate.” The three great avatars of Xue Ying were doing their best to whittle away those brand marks.
“Dispel.”
At this moment.
The innumerable sentient beings living in Ancient Sacred World-the Ancient Sacred World which was approximately one-hundredth the size of the ‘Primitive Ancient Sacred World’-had their shackles removed at this moment. Those brand marks on their souls were dispelled, and everyone finally regained their freedom! It was a great release for them!
“Ha!”
The numerous sentient beings living in the Ancient Sacred World felt their souls fluctuating. That was a fluctuation originating from incomparable joy! The feeling of freedom, and the feeling of release!
Cultivators were born free!
All of them sought to remain free and unfettered!
Having been enslaved by the Sacred Master for an innumerable period, various generations of the cultivators were even made to unhesitantly kill their own loved ones and to suicide! They were no longer cultivators. Even though they lived, it was similar to walking corpses! Only at this moment when the shackles on their souls were released did they feel the freedom originating deep in their hearts! And a brightly-lit heart was something all of them were entitled to have.
As a result, the souls were letting out cries of joy instinctively! Those cries of joy startled Old Monster Stone, Swordmaster, Forefather Tian Yu, and others who were currently watching this scene happening at the Ancient Sacred World.
The soul was innately mysterious.
When the souls regained their freedom, the instinctive cries of joy generated a fluctuation that engulfed the Ancient Sacred World and these Cosmos Gods. They felt themselves influenced by it-their souls were trembling excitedly!
“Freedom!”
“Freedom!”
It was happening in not only the Ancient Sacred World. Instead, the innumerable humans and beasts of different races that had been saved in other places like the Nine Cloud Great Land were currently regaining their consciousness.
Tears began streaming down their faces. They were so excited and happy that they cried!
Even though their souls had been branded in the past, they remained completely awake. It happened generation after generation. The strangest thing was that despite living like puppets, they still held a loyalty and reverence towards Sacred Master stemming from deep inside their hearts.
