Only at this moment did that strange feeling disappear. Only then did they truly regain their freedom and happiness.
“From this moment, I am truly myself!” The only lightning Cosmos God also looked upwards. He saw that distant white-robed male after bypassing through various spatial obstacles.
Even though many cultivators did not know who saved them, they still had a heartfelt gratitude towards the one who released them from their shackles.
Thankful for saving them out of the dark abyss.
…
At this moment, the three figures of Xue Ying still had their eyes closed. After saving those sentient beings, an innate cry of joy from their souls were currently being emitted.
It was something that startled even Old Monster Stone, Swordmaster, and others watching. As for Xue Ying, he was more deeply affected.
The waves of joy charged up against him.
“Soul.”
“Freedom.”
Unknowingly, Xue Ying began crying.
He felt so moved that he teared.
He felt so moved over the desire towards freedom the souls had.
At this moment, Xue Ying found his direction of fusing the final ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’ branch, ‘soul’ with the other four branches. Previously, he did not understand where he should head towards! But now, he saw the light.
“The souls of the sentient beings are the true foundation of this Origin World.”
“The will of the populace could influence the will of the Origin World! And this path of enslaving the population is wrong!” Xue Ying had a feeling that even though it was possible to grasp the Supreme Law through spreading religion and gaining the belief energy from the population, he had a vague feeling that it was wrong! Even though gaining the belief of the population wasn’t wrong, enslaving the souls was on the contrary, a form of taboo in a deeper level!
Xue Ying had a feeling that this path was destined to not control the Supreme Law!
Like Yuan and Luo City Lord, they did not understand much in the Dao of Soul. Currently, Xue Ying was standing at the highest level across many spaces in the Dao of Soul. Nonetheless, only at this juncture did he generate this feeling.
“I should be able to understand more after fusing all five branches together.” Xue Ying thought.
Previously.
He was not certain of fusing all five branches of the ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’ together. But now, he saw the light and gained back his confidence.
“Give me sufficient time and I am hopeful of walking to the end of this path.” Xue Ying opened his eyes. He saw as many in the Ancient Sacred World were filled with happiness, and could not help but smile.
By saving the people, the people also pointed out the direction for him in his cultivation path.
Give and take. This was also a kind of natural law.
“Xue Ying.”
“Haha, this is absolutely awesome!”
“This is the happiest day in my entire life! Sacred Master who has been threatening us all this while, is frightened into hiding! Haha!”
The voices coming over from the distance from Old Monster Stone, Swordmaster, Forefather Tian Yu, and other Cosmos Gods were filled with happiness and joy! On this day, they saw the death of the vicious Ancestor Mother and how Sacred Master who had brought chaos to the entire Origin World being forced to escape like a stray dog! On this day, they saw themselves facing an impending Great Apocalypse only to be freed from it! On this day, they saw Swordmaster and Xue Ying reaching the final realm. On this day, they saw close to 10% of the entire population in the Primal Chaos Void regaining their freedom, and they heard the cries of joy coming from their souls…
They were all incredibly joyful! They felt delighted! This was a happiness which they never had experienced before.
Xue Ying smiled and went to welcome them!

chapters.title: Chapter 1188 - Origin Source Energy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1188: Origin Source Energy
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Great Void Heaven Temple, within a garden filled with bird songs and fragrant flowers, there was a group of Cosmos Gods gathered. They were currently drinking and chatting happily.
“Come come come, Xue Ying, let us have a drink together.” Void Primogenitor lay by the side of Xue Ying. Both of them were resting on the grass drinking wine, “It’s a pity your teacher can’t get to see this day. If he could, he would definitely be elated.”
Xue Ying softly nodded.
His teacher Gu Qi died in the hands of Sacred Master! It’s a pity that currently, Xue Ying could not kill Sacred Master. Even if he reached the final realm, Xue Ying could still not kill the other party. Perhaps after reaching the final realm in the ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’ would there be some chance of doing so! But this was merely a guess! Because there had never been a cultivator who reached the final realm in Dao of Soul within Realm Heart Great Land.
“Your teacher likes being free and unfettered. He also pities the weak, which was why he had been against the Sacred Master.” Void Primogenitor muttered softly, “He relied on the Dao of Void to flee whenever something was amiss. Nonetheless, Sacred Master never placed your teacher in his eyes before. Once Sacred Master became genuinely angry, he made use of the Ancient Sacred Incarnation energy. Your teacher did not even have the slightest strength to retaliate.”
“I once thought of taking revenge for Gu Qi, but I am afraid of dying in the hands of Sacred Master-dying a pointless death.”
Xue Ying stood by the side listening. That’s right. Before he and Swordmaster became significantly stronger, none of them had any ways of dealing against ‘Sacred Master’. They remained on the defensive side! World Ancestor and Ancestor Sorcerer could still fight directly with Sacred Master without losing, but they could not suppress him at all. As for Forefather Tian Yu, Void Primogenitor, and others at their level, they would lose their lives if they were the slightest careless. They had to rely on their protective secret treasures to survive until they could escape. Either that or they call for the help of World Ancestor, Blade Emperor and others.
It’s pitiful.
They had been living so repressed for a long time.
“No matter what, he could only hide in the Lost World Corridor! With Swordmaster and Xue Ying around, that Sacred Master could only continue hiding.” Devil Mountain Primogenitor declared grandly.
“Hahaha, I’ve cultivated for such a long time, and I finally would have some companions in the following days.” Old Monster Stone grinned, “I see that the two of you have high comprehension abilities and that it is possible to reach the final realm before the Great Apocalypse. But I would not have thought that the two of you would reach the final realm so quickly. We would most likely be companions in the future for a very long time.”
Xue Ying exchanged glances with Swordmaster.
The two of them were clear. Firstly, it had been because of the opportunity granted to them by Luo City Lord. Secondly, both of them had acquired a supreme secret impartation from the Realm Heart Great Land. Only with these two supporting factors did they rise faster than what Old Monster Stone expected. Furthermore, Xue Ying had in reality, not reached the final realm yet! It was only for the sake of intimidating ‘Emperor Jun’ and ‘Sacred Master’ did both Xue Ying and Swordmaster agreed on it.
To let this misconception of Xue Ying ‘reaching the final realm’ continue on!
Reaching the final realm in the Dao of Void would allow the cultivator to have a powerful domain!
It prevented Emperor Jun and Sacred Master from having any thoughts of struggling back!
If they were to know that Xue Ying relied on all his avatars to barely cover most of the regions in the Primal Chaos Void, Sacred Master and Emperor Jun would most likely continue to revolt!
‘I have to reach the final realm as soon as possible.’ Xue Ying thought.
No matter whether it was to save his loved ones and close friends before the Great Apocalypse and seek another alternative to life, or whether it was to become stronger so as to intimidate both ‘Sacred Master and ‘Emperor Jun’, Xue Ying had to rise up quickly.
…
The current Great Void Heaven Temple had an extremely high status since it was a religion with two final realm cultivators!
But for the sake of not harming the Origin Source Energy in the Primal Chaos Void, they did not create another sacred world. Instead, they maintained the balance to allow this Origin World, ‘Primal Chaos Void’, to sustain for a longer period.
“Chi.”
An incense was lit.
Its fragrance pervade within the meditation room. Xue Ying sat by himself cross-legged in it. His consciousness was gradually brushing across the Supreme Law.
Finally, Xue Ying felt a mysterious space existing within the Supreme Law. It seemed limitless and small, so small that Xue Ying could not see it even with his void techniques. At the same time, it seemed so incredibly big that every single part of the Origin World was filled with ‘it’.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying moved his heart.
He easily extended his consciousness into that mysterious spatial pocket.
This was the core of the Primal Chaos Void Origin World, the ‘Origin Source Region’. It was quite similar to the World Heart in the Xia Clan World, albeit more mysterious. Only the soul consciousness could enter this place. Material matters could not enter here! One could not deduce its size using the ordinary three-dimensional perception of objects. Xue Ying only felt that this mysterious Origin Source Region was filled with many colorful intersections of Origin Source. It might seem messy, yet it weaved together a perfect operating entity. Every lump of Origin Source represented a Dao!
In the past when the Primitive Ancient Sacred World collapsed, much of the Origin Source Energy in the Origin World became scattered, condensing into smaller Origin Worlds. At that time, the Origin Source had been ‘gravely leaked’, which led to the emergence of the Lost World Corridor. That was also the place where ‘Destruction Devils’ emerged, accelerating the destruction of the Origin World.
The natural laws of an Origin World led to the birth of a powerful and perfect world.
Even though much of its energy was dispersed into the void.
The law remained supreme.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying’s consciousness ‘examined’ the colorful Origin Source lumps. They intersected with one another in no noticeable order. It was difficult to determine how many lumps of Origin Source there were.
After all, some Origin Source lumps intersected with one another very tightly.
For instance, ‘Light’ and ‘Illumination’ were both tightly-intertwined.
Or ‘Phaseless’ and ‘Boundless’ had many areas of intersection as well.
And amongst the lumps of Origin Source were two that Xue Ying felt very familiar and close to.
One Origin Source was tremendously vast. It pervaded the entire Origin Source Region. It was the Origin Source for the ‘Dao of Void’.
And the other lump of Origin Source seemed illusory and unpredictable. It also pervaded across enormous parts of the region, and was much more mysterious. It seemed to permeate deep within some parts of the Origin Source. It was none other than the Origin Source for the ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’.
“Integrate.”
Xue Ying first tried sending his consciousness into the Dao of Void Origin Source.
“Hong!”
An ocean of information deluged onto his consciousness. It was boundless, great, and filled with impartiality. As long as one reached the level-two Cosmos God Realm in the Dao of Void, he would succeed in leaving behind his soul mark and henceforth control this strand of Origin Source Energy. Xue Ying was just a step away from reaching the final realm. Hence, he had an easier time-he succeeded in branding the Origin Source within a few breaths of time!
After which, Xue Ying spent the time taken to brew a cup of tea to leave behind his soul brand on the Origin Source for the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm.
Deducing from this perspective, even though he was just one branch away from fusing all five branches together, his accumulation in the Dao of Void was still much more profound and vast than in the ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’.
“As long as I succeed in controlling more than half the Origin Source here, I could rely on it to grasp the Supreme Law, allowing me to progress into becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.” Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
To reach the level-two Cosmos God Realm in all the different Daos?
That was difficult.
Many cultivators like Swordmaster, Ancestor Fan, World Extermination God-Emperor, Eternal Night Primogenitor, and others had reached the final realm. Many of them even sought to reach the Cosmos God Realm in the Dao of Void so that they could cultivate several avatars for themselves! But forcing was counter-productive. After all, cultivators had different experiences as they grew. They had different personalities, different Dao Hearts, different opportunities… their understanding of the world were also different. These myriad of factors determined how good they were in some Daos! As for other Daos? They would not be very good in them!
It was hard to advance a Dao to the Cosmos God Realm. It was even harder to reach the ‘level-two Cosmos God Realm’.
More than half the Origin Source here?
Let’s not talk about competition. Just trying to reach the level-two Cosmos God Realm in more than half the ‘Daos’ would be sufficient to bring despair to any final realm cultivator.
“After grasping the two strands of Origin Source, I would be able to control some of the Origin Source Energy for my use.” Xue Ying shook his head inwardly. To a level-two Cosmos God, a strand of Origin Source Energy could significantly boost their strength. But to him who had a final realm combat power, this slight Origin Source Energy could not contribute much at all.
“What a pity that I can’t comprehend them thoroughly.”
The intersections and integrations of the Origin Source made them one entity-the perfect Supreme Law.
Xue Ying could not dissect and comprehend just a strand of Origin Source. He could barely observe the grand Supreme Law from his viewpoint, and it was too complex!
“I believe it’ll be much easier to force a breakthrough to the Chaotic Origin Lifeform before trying to grasp the Supreme Law.” Xue Ying thought. No cultivators were ever confident in declaring that they could comprehend the Supreme Law. It was just too complicated.
…
The hometown Origin World finally regained its peace-Sacred Master and Emperor Jun were no longer making a mess. It appeared as if both of them had resigned their fates to wait for the next era.
In the next era, the Origin World would be reborn with a new land. That was when the Origin Source was at its most powerful! This land was vast, and the suppression from the Supreme Law would be at its strongest! Even a final realm cultivator would be dreaming if he planned on expanding his domain across the entire Origin World Land. During that time, the two of them were still confident of fighting against Xue Ying and Swordmaster.
As for the situation over at the Realm Heart Great Land, it was similarly quiet.
Xue Ying left an avatar cultivating under the Burning Heart God Tree still. Now that he had a vision of where to head towards in fusing the five branches, Xue Ying was naturally pouring all his concentration on the ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’! As the effects of cultivating under the Burning Heart God Tree were good, one avatar would suffice.
And other avatars of his continued to research in the Dao of Void. His accumulations in the Dao of Void were thick; Xue Ying was even researching on the sixth killing move.
And he had no choice in this factor-he already finished consuming all World Flowers! What he could do now is to continue accumulating his experience and more experience until the tipping point.

chapters.title: Chapter 1189 - Death Walker
chapters.content:
Chapter 1189: Death Walker
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Realm Heart Great Land. Within a particular secluded garden.
“Hua hua hua.” A figure was holding on to a flask of wine and a bowl with his other hand pouring himself wine.
Garbed entirely in gold, ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ had a crown on his head as he sat cross-legged enjoying wine by himself. He was currently concentrating all his attention on tasting the flavor of the wine.
Suddenly, a figure appeared by the side. He was the humanoid insect, ‘Insect Ancestor’.
“Insect Ancestor?” Undying Underworld Emperor’s eyes brightened. He immediately placed down his cup of wine and asked, “The reason you came over to my place is because you have everything gathered?”
“Where are the things I want?” Insect Ancestor brought out a piece of translucent amber-like material. One could see some seven-colored liquid moving slightly within it. He threw this piece of bizarre item over.
Undying Underworld Emperor revealed a look of happiness the moment he saw the item. After receiving it, he immediately examined the item and spoke: “Rest assured. You and I have sworn an oath in the past, so how could I violate it? Wu, a hundred droplets without one missing. You are really stingy! But they are quite pure. Haha, Insect Ancestor, you are indeed the great general of Devouring Realm Great Emperor in the past! Devouring Realm Great Emperor treats you quite well, allowing you to get his inheritance. You are even able to retrieve these hundred droplets of ‘Devouring Realm Spiritual Liquid’.”
“Sou.” Undying Underworld Emperor flipped his hand, causing a wristband to appear. He threw it to Insect Ancestor, “This is what you want. I’ve already prepared it for you.”
“Good.”
After receiving it, Insect Ancestor thoroughly examined through once before revealing a joyous look, “Then I’ll make my leave first.”
“Haha, if you still wish to get your hands on any treasure, you could come and find me. We can always use the Devouring Realm Spiritual Liquid to exchange.” Undying Underworld Emperor answered.
“If I have something, I’ll definitely come and find Your Majesty Underworld Emperor.” Saying that, a pair of crystalline wings fluttered from the back of Insect Ancestor. He then disappeared from the place.
“Hmph hmph, he could take out a hundred droplets, meaning to say that the huge inheritance left behind by Devouring Realm Great Emperor must have landed in his hands.” Undying Underworld Emperor watched as Insect Ancestor disappeared. He muttered to himself before grinning at the bizarre item on his hand. A light of excitement could be seen shining in his eyes, “At least I’ve gathered it. After coming back for such a long time, I’ve finally gathered everything I need.”
Devouring Realm Spiritual Liquid was a material the unparalleled existence ‘Devouring Realm Great Emperor’ gathered from the higher dimension, Chaotic Origin Region, in the past.
Every droplet was immensely hard to gather.
This was the most optimal ‘food’ that Devouring Realm Great Emperor used in nurturing his insects. By letting his insects consume the liquid, they were able to advance and power up to a Cosmos God. But ever since Devouring Realm Great Emperor fell, this Devouring Realm Spiritual Liquid had become a legend! Even though Devouring Realm Great Emperor had been jointly killed in the past, he still kept all his most important treasure prior to his death.
And now, it seemed that this great general under the Devouring Realm Great Emperor, ‘Insect Ancestor’, had got it! Insect Ancestor only dared to reveal these things after reaching the final realm!
“The three final realm Resentment Spirits nurtured by Eternal Night. The Origin Blood from Extreme Night. The ‘Sacred Fire Stone’ sent over by Sacred Fire City Master. In addition, the ‘Devouring Realm Spiritual Liquid’ that Devouring Realm Great Emperor once acquired in the past and a complete Chaotic Origin Corpse which I have gotten a long time ago.” Undying Underworld Emperor’s eyes brightened. He was absolutely excited, “Now, I am lacking the final bit of sacrificial offerings to provide sufficient energy for me to refine a ‘Death Walker’.”
“In the past, I have painstakingly refined a Death Walker. What a pity that the last gamble ended up in a defeat. It was only after I relied on that Death Walker to resist the great enemy of mine did I succeed in returning.” Undying Underworld Emperor recalled back to his past. He felt his blood boiling at the thought of it.
He once stepped on the path to charge upwards into becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
This path.
It was not just he who took it. Many experts from other Origin Worlds were also being guided along this path towards becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Initially, he was still supported. But after failing thrice, nobody chose to help him anymore. And now, he was like many other experts who similarly failed-struggling amidst despair.
It was very fortunate for him to return to the Realm Heart Great Land after sacrificing his ‘Death Walker’.
“Fortunately, I still have another Chaotic Origin corpse. Once I succeed in refining it, I would own a ‘half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body’. That is my strongest technique. Only by relying on this would I be confident in venturing deep into the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.” Undying Underworld Emperor grinned, “It is still possible for me to force my way to the next life level by relying on some opportunities found in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.”
This path was extremely arduous. He had racked his brains just to find more ways of aiding in his journey.
“Eternal Night Primogenitor, Extreme Night Primogenitor, and others feel that I am currently stronger than in the past. But in their mind, I am merely slightly stronger. Nonetheless, they do not know that my greatest accomplishment after experiencing all sorts of dangerous situations and is discovering the way to refine a ‘Death Walker’.” Undying Underworld Emperor thought.
Of those who took the same path as he did in the past, some fell while others were outstanding enough to create their own unique path. Even though it was wrong, they still advanced their body to the ‘half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform’ level.
Undying Underworld Emperor did not choose to do that.
Because he knew his Dao path to becoming a ‘Chaotic Origin Lifeform’ would be broken once he took that step. Hence, he thought of ways to perfect the refinement of a ‘Death Walker’, collecting techniques from other peers of his. He even chose to experiment on some materials before eventually pushing his ‘Death Walker’ to a higher step.
Only by using the Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse as the foundation would the refined ‘Death Walker’ be strong!
Only after Undying Underworld Emperor experienced everything did he understand that there had been huge gaps between ‘Chaotic Origin Lifeforms’. For instance, those who walked down the Dao path step by step, cultivating from weak, understanding how to utilize the Dao and even grasp an Origin World as foundation were called strong! There were some innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms who applied ‘Dao’ crudely. They purely relied on their nature. It was entirely possible for some weaker cultivators who owned supreme-graded secret treasures to fight with them!
“The Realm Heart Great Land is created by Yuan.”
“Yuan is one of the most ancient Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. He is also practically standing at the peak, and is not any weaker than those who broke through using determination and force like Luo City Lord.”
Undying Underworld Emperor finally understood the statuses of Yuan and Luo City Lord after experiencing so many things.
“Hearsay that the terrifying great serpent who was killed by Yuan after gravely injured him had its body thrown into a particular world within the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.” The eyes of Undying Underworld Emperor were filled with desire. The Broken Teeth Mountain Range was most famous for having part of the great serpent corpse. What ‘Broken Teeth Serpent Bead’ and others were really just ordinary parts of that great serpent.
…
Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
The more important the location, the more danger it had! Even though Undying Underworld Emperor ventured into the place many times, he dared not barge into some of the forbidden places. Only by having a ‘Death Walker’ would he regain his confidence and foundation.
It was deep in the night.
By the side of the Realm Heart Great Land, in a nameless desolate mountain, a handsome young male wearing a golden robe and a crown descended here.
“It is time for the crucial moment.”
Undying Underworld Emperor waved his hand.
“Hong hong hong!”
Many bronze pillars appeared in the air. A total of 16 pillars were thrusted into the land. They were becoming bigger and thicker. In the blink of an eye, they were like 16 sky pillars shattered in all directions around this desolate mountain.
“Hong long.” Undying Underworld Emperor waved his hand again. An incredibly huge four-hooved mutated beast corpse was thrown onto the mountain. Its body contained many mysterious inscriptions. Its four hooves were even shackled. Currently, those shackles were being connected to the 16 ‘bronze pillars’ that stretched into the heavens. Those shackles contained inscriptions that were moving, reflecting and synchronizing with the inscriptions on the surface of the corpse. The outcome was a huge seal that covered the corpse.
“Even though Extreme Night Primogenitor is merely an ordinary unparalleled existence, its Origin Blood is still hard to get. It contains so much more life force than those in the veins of body cultivators.” Undying Underworld Emperor praised.
After all, the true body of Extreme Night Primogenitor was a blood sea.
A huge cauldron appeared before Undying Underworld Emperor. The cauldron contained nine precious Sacred Fire Stones within. After slightly activating the cauldrons, pale white flames began burning.
Following that, Undying Underworld Emperor carefully controlled the cauldron. One could see a lump of ‘blood sphere’ the size of a human head floating above this cauldron. It was gradually burned by the pale white flame. “Chi chi chi,” there were inscriptions revolving and flashing on the surface of the blood sphere, though its insides were being evaporated into nothingness. Gradually, a unique green light appeared within the fluid.
After burning to the end, it formed a nail-sized green crystal.
Undying Underworld Emperor held his breath.
“Go.”
Pointing out to the distance.
That green crystal flew into the body of that humongous Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse.

chapters.title: Chapter 1190 - Uproar in the Great Land
chapters.content:
Chapter 1190: Uproar in the Great Land
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Because he had refined the Death Walker before, and this refinement technique was gradually perfected by ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ after experiencing through various difficulties, it was naturally easy for him.
“Chi.”
That green crystal was assimilated into the body of that humongous four-hooved mutated beast.
Undying Underworld Emperor stood by the side watching. After an hour was up, he began feeling a minute change in the aura of that beast happening.
“Everything is as expected.”
“After refining the Origin Blood, its purity contains a huge life force that provides a surge in this corpse.”
“Devouring Realm Spiritual Liquid!” Undying Underworld Emperor grabbed onto the amber-like material before throwing it over. That bizarre material flew to the spot above that four-hooved mutated beast. Under the control of Undying Underworld Emperor, a droplet of seven-colored liquid flew out from the ‘amber material’ before landing in the body of the beast. One could see carved inscriptions on the surface of the corpse lighting up. The moment the seven-colored liquid touched the body, it immediately became absorbed.
One droplet, two droplets, three droplets…
Undying Underworld Emperor carefully ‘fed’ the beast. Over time, some vitality began growing in the Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse. Its aura started rolling out. Nonetheless, due to the suppression by the arrays nearby, the aura wasn’t leaked.
After four hours, the hundred droplets of ‘Devouring Realm Spiritual Liquid’ were fully consumed. Signs of motion could even be seen on the abdomen of that corpse as it gasped for breath, taking in the surrounding air albeit without consciousness.
Ultimately, the objective was to control the corpse of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Even though it was a very low grade lifeform, it was not something that could be achieved using ordinary means. For instance, it was easy to generate spirituality in most puppets and weapons! But the difficulty of doing so on a Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse was a multitude harder.
“The crucial moment has arrived. Hmph hmph, I doubt there is anyone who dares to disrupt my sacrificial rites in Realm Heart Great Land right?” Whoever dares to do so will die!” The eyes of Undying Underworld Emperor flashed with a cold intent.
“Awaken!”
Undying Underworld Emperor placed both his palms before his chest. He was already focusing all his attention on controlling the mysterious inscriptions carved onto this corpse.
“Hong! Hong! Hong!”
That humongous breathing corpse of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform lay there like previously, albeit currently, three black maelstroms abruptly appeared on its abdomen.
“I should hurry things.”
With a thought, Undying Underworld Emperor threw out the three final realm Resentment Spirits.
The final realm Resentment Spirits were the pinnacle of all Resentment Spirits. They were nurtured by Eternal Night Primogenitor after he grabbed countless souls and tortured them. These Resentment Spirits had truly ‘great souls’. They were filled with endless resentment, hatred and murderous intent that was sufficient to kill Primal Chaos cultivators! It was impossible for Cosmos God to reach this stage if they solely relied on their anger.
“Sou sou sou!”
No matter how terrifying those three Resentment Spirits were, they were still easily absorbed by those three black maelstroms. None of them could retaliate.
Each of the final realm Resentment Spirits howled resentfully! They were unwilling to be absorbed into the black maelstroms.
“Ah ah!”
“No-”
“Kill, kill, kill!”
As the three black maelstroms swallowed the Resentment Spirits, they expanded to a full half a million kilometers in diameter. They were relatively eye-catching on the corpse of the Chaotic Origin Lifeform now.
Even now, there were the occasional face of the Resentment Spirits displayed amidst the black maelstrom! Each face was howling in pain! After all, they were currently being burned and treated as fuel.
“Come, come, come!” Undying Underworld Emperor could not help but reveal a look of craved excitement.
“Hong long long-”
Each of the neighboring nation occupied a relatively huge area. Even though they were located by the boundary of the Realm Heart Great Land, adding up the total area, it was still a huge region.
Currently, black evil arrays emerged above these regions. Even though it was dawn, those evil arrays easily covered the world-they seemed endless, so wide that they covered a full 15 nations!
Within those regions that were covered, amidst the many cities within, no matter if they were humans, beasts, plant lives or cultivators of other races, they felt a black devouring energy acting on their souls. Some of them were sleeping, some were cultivating, and some were doing forced labor. Nonetheless, all their souls left their bodies at this moment uncontrollably.
“So painful. This is so painful!”
They felt a searing pain within their souls.
“What is going on with us?”
Looking around them, they could see how they were flying up. Numerous souls were flying up at this moment.
They watched as the city beneath them and their fleshy bodies were left behind.
“No, no-”
Regardless of who they were-the infants that were still in the stomach of mothers or kings of a region that had reached the Cosmos God Realm, all of their souls were uncontrollably being forced to leave their fleshy bodies.
A trillion souls were seen flying up from a city.
The capital of a nation had so many souls flying up that they covered almost the entire world. They were similarly being sucked upwards in one direction.
It was vast…
Countless souls were suffering from agonizing pain. They were either struggling or howling, yet it was futile. Even Cosmos Gods could do nothing against this devouring force.
…
Of the 15 nations that were affected, 12 nations were completely engulfed by the arrays. There were so many sentient beings amidst the nations that it felt unimaginable. And now, those souls were being flown to a location.
“Come, come to me!”
Undying Underworld Emperor stood in midair controlling everything.
“Hu.”
The voluminous number of souls were all teleported over from the distance. They were devoured into the three floating revolving black maelstroms above the corpse of the Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
This absorption had to be done gradually! Undying Underworld Emperor was responsible for providing the ‘food’, teleporting over the souls from different regions over! As for other souls, they were merely ‘flying’ over.
“With so many souls, it should be sufficient. I reckon 12 days will be enough. By burning the final realm Resentment Spirits as lure and using the populace as a sacrificial offering, it should be enough to ignite the spirituality in this Chaotic Origin Lifeform that just had its life force sparked alive! Once the spirituality is formed, I could easily refine it into a Death Walker!” Undying Underworld Emperor was quite looking forward to it.
“What!”
“This…”
Across the entire Realm Heart Great Land, the final realm cultivators were really sensitive to the world. They had a profound understanding of the laws.
They felt it at the first moment when these sacrificial arrays were activated.
“Madness! This is simply madness!” Over at Summer Wind Ancient Nation, ‘Emperor Summer’ watched as this happened. By relying on his attainments in the Dao of Void, he easily saw an innumerable souls coming from the neighboring 15 affected nations flying over. That shocked him so much he felt a chill in his heart.
A name immediately surfaced in his mind at that moment!
Undying Underworld Emperor!
Undying Underworld Emperor was a terrifying evil existence that lived before the First War of the Ancient Nations started. Undying Underworld Emperor was vaguely considered the strongest cultivator amidst all unparalleled existences. He represented ‘death’, and countless sentient beings died because of him.
The overall strength of the Realm Heart Great Land in the past could not be compared to the current times. There were almost nobody who could threaten Undying Underworld Emperor at all.
“It’s him.” Emperor Summer ‘saw’ it. He saw the 16 enormous bronze pillars shackling that frightening Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse. He also saw how the three black maelstroms were currently absorbing a voluminous amount of souls.
…
“It’s Undying Underworld Emperor? I’ve heard that he is already this overbearing a very long time ago.” World Extermination God-Emperor sat on his high throne watching the scene. Currently, he was recognized as the most tyrannical and overbearing unparalleled existence, albeit after seeing what Undying Underworld Emperor was doing-the attraction of innumerable souls and the corpse of that Chaotic Origin Lifeform, World Extermination God-Emperor felt his mind pausing.
It appeared there was still a gap between the two.
For instance, there were no experts in the Realm Heart Great Land who could bring out a complete corpse of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
…
“How could he do such things?” Limitless City Master was furious.
…
“Admirable, admirable.” Moonflower King watched from afar. He grinned, “He is indeed the Undying Underworld Emperor. The moment he returned and he chose to create such a huge spectacle.”
…
“His plan actually involved the corpse of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform? Where did he actually get the corpse? Was it from Broken Teeth Mountain Range? Or did he acquire it from outside the world?” Eternal Night Primogenitor and Extreme Night Primogenitor were both watching from afar. Both of them had helped provide part of the resources, albeit they were ignorant of what this Undying Underworld Emperor planned on doing it. At least now they found out about it.
…
“This is?” Insect Ancestor watched from afar. His expression changed slightly, “The Devouring Realm Spiritual Liquid he required is meant for this?”
…
“Truly a madman.” The three old ancestors of Icy Snow Ancient Nation sneered. All three of them chose to advance to the next level by relying on themselves. They disdained from doing such things.
…
Even though the various final realm experts discovered it at the first moment, only three truly acted!
“Sou.””Sou.””Sou.”
Three figures appeared approximately at the same time at a location not too far away from the humongous Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse. They were precisely Emperor Summer, Limitless City Master, and Towering Sky King.
Emperor Summer was even controlling the void to immediately stop the teleporting souls from advancing forward.
“Hold your hands!” Emperor Summer angrily roared.

chapters.title: Chapter 1191 - Overflowing Might of the Devil
chapters.content:
Chapter 1191: Overflowing Might of the Devil
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The disturbance created by Undying Underworld Emperor this time was genuinely huge. It affected a total of 15 nations.
Xue Ying and other Cosmos Gods might not have keen senses like the ‘final realm cultivators’, but they still felt the operation of that huge array. Furthermore, some of the Primal Chaos cultivators who were near the 15 nations felt it too.
“This is?” Xue Ying was originally seated underneath a pavilion, though he abruptly stood and peered through the void.
Using the Destruction Realm Teleportation…
Xue Ying could see a calamity happening by the boundary of the Realm Heart Great Land. Looking at the city at a particular location, he saw numerous souls flying away. Xue Ying then switched his view to another city, only to see a similar scene-souls struggling against the attraction. There were just too many souls flying into the sky that they covered the world.
“Swordmaster, do you know what is going on?” Xue Ying transmitted a message to Swordmaster. At the same time, he also questioned Southern Cloud King.
After all, with his Destruction Realm Teleportation, Xue Ying could easily rely on it to see every part of the Origin World.
“Mn?”
At that moment, he saw it.
Tracing back where the source of the frightening aura came from, Xue Ying saw a humongous four-hoofed beast corpse shackled by 16 bronze pillars. There were currently three black maelstroms revolving above its body. Souls were howling miserably from within the maelstroms. There were even innumerable souls being transported to the location nearby.
Emperor Summer, Limitless City Master, and Towering Sky King were currently facing that handsome young man garbed in golden robe and had a crown over his head.
“It’s Undying Underworld Emperor.” Swordmaster transmitted over from his side, “It appears that Undying Underworld Emperor is holding some sacrificial ritual. That corpse belongs to a Chaotic Origin Lifeform, and he is currently making use of all souls located in the nearby 15 nations including those belonging to the kings-Cosmos God souls! When the sacrificial ritual just began, Emperor Summer and others arrived to stop him from carrying on.”
“That is simply madness.” Xue Ying paled.
Sacrificing so many souls?
Compared to what Undying Underworld Emperor was doing, Blood Sacrificing a city was not worth mentioning. How many cities did a nation have? And this was sending 15 nations to a sacrifice! It should be approximately 1% to 2% of the overall population in the entire Realm Heart Great Land! The Realm Heart Great Land was way more prosperous than his hometown Origin World. One aspect was because the ‘Primitive Ancient Sacred World’ had shattered in his hometown before, greatly damaging its Origin Source and as a result, greatly reducing the population in the world. Another aspect was due to the diligence of Yuan in creating and protecting the Realm Heart Great Land, allowing the population of cultivators here to far surpass that of ordinary Origin Worlds.
1% to 2% of the population in Realm Heart Great Land was comparable to 10% of the population back at his hometown.
Xue Ying had also saved this number of souls after dealing with Sacred Master. He could not forget the impact from the instinctive cries of joy from those countless souls.
“Sacrificing so many lives?” Xue Ying was filled with disbelief and indignance.
As they said, the title of Undying Underworld Emperor represented ‘death’.
But Xue Ying was still astonished by it!
“How dare he!” Fury surged through Xue Ying.
…
This matter was so big that it led to the spreading of news between experts, causing even Primal Chaos cultivators to be aware of it. For a moment, many experts across the entire Realm Heart Great Land were paying close notice to that nameless desolate mountain! They were also watching if Emperor Summer could obstruct ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ from carrying on.
“Emperor Summer, hearsay you are the strongest unparalleled existence within the Realm Heart Great Land in this era?” The handsome Undying Underworld Emperor chuckled, “You are remarkable by cultivating two Daos to the final realm, albeit you are still too green.”
The expression of Emperor Summer fell slightly. Despite that, he roared, “Underworld Emperor, you actually dared to use a secret technique to devour so many souls that it affected a total of 15 nations? Do you know how many nations there are in the Realm Heart Great Land? You are going overboard! I’m afraid that ‘Yuan’ would punish you for commiting such sin!”
“Underworld Emperor, it is better not to do things so excessively after coming back not too long ago. It is a huge sin to kill so many sentient beings.” Limitless City Master also added solemnly.
Towering Sky King stated: “Underworld Emperor, I do hope for you to show some pity for these weak cultivators.”
Undying Underworld Emperor merely sneered: “Alright, let’s not spout any more rubbish. This sacrificial ritual is very important to me. It is better for none of you to obstruct me.”
He extended his right hand.
At that moment, flames began rising from his palm.
That flame contained destruction and death.
The expression of Emperor Summer, Limitless City Master, and Towering Sky King changed when they saw it. From that single move, they were able to determine that Undying Underworld Emperor was absolutely not any weaker than Emperor Summer.
“This Realm Heart Great Land is a land protected by Yuan.” Emperor Summer declared coldly.
“I understand Yuan’s personality more than you do.” Undying Underworld Emperor derided, “Yuan does indeed treat the weak quite well amongst his peers, but it is impossible for him to stop me from doing such a minor matter. It is entirely possible for other Chaotic Origin Lifeforms to use the entire population of an Origin World as training for an expert. I am merely sacrificing 1% to 2% of the population in Realm Heart Great Land, so how big a deal could it be? The Realm Heart Great Land can easily recover this number.”
“The current Realm Heart Great Land has already reached a limit in its population. By sacrificing some, I am simply providing more entertainment and fun for the Great Land.”
Undying Underworld Emperor casually continued, “Yuan would not do anything as long as my actions do not affect the balance.”
“And there’s also the three of you.”
“It is better for you all to leave.” A cold smirk rose by the edge of Undying Underworld Emperor’s lips.
Emperor Summer swept across the place with his gaze before coldly retorting: “Underworld Emperor, both of us are comparable in strength. I might not be able to threaten you, but it is easy for me to disrupt your affair by destroying your array. I urge you to be less arrogant.”
“You dare!”
Undying Underworld Emperor revealed a savage look. It felt as if his voice came from an abyss, “I’ve already utilized the corpse of the Chaotic Origin Lifeform and many precious treasures just for this sacrifice! Whoever dares to disrupt my affair! I swear that I’ll definitely do my utmost to let you know regret! Your descendants, your disciples, your masters, your nation, and all your cities… I’ll kill, kill, and kill everyone of them!”
Emperor Summer, Limitless City Master, and Towering Sky King could not help but feel their hearts trembling when they heard this sound.
They knew that Undying Underworld Emperor was not lying.
Because he had done so before the First War of the Ancient Nation! After all, his name was synonymous with ‘death’!
“I have no longer any hopes of progressing in other cultivation paths, and am too lazy to compete with all of you! Once the sacrificial ritual is completed, I’ll enter Broken Teeth Mountain Range without returning anymore.” Undying Underworld Emperor coldly declared, “You should act more discreetly and not offend me. Otherwise… I believe you will know what I would do.”
The expression of Emperor Summer became uglier.
Madman.
Undying Underworld Emperor was truly a madman! He was also a madman who had no worries and concerns of! He did not have any nations, and neither did he care about any subordinates or organizations. When Undying Underworld Emperor became infuriated, the consequences would be dire.
“Ai, Underworld Emperor, you will eventually regret it for acting so fanatical.” Limitless City Master sighed before disappearing from the scene.
“Let’s go.” Towering Sky King shook his head too.
Emperor Summer gave Undying Underworld Emperor a deep look before disappearing from the place.
They could sense the resolution of Undying Underworld Emperor. Furthermore, this matter was critical to Undying Underworld Emperor. If they disrupted his affair, the consequence was something they could not accept.
“Hmph.” Undying Underworld Emperor coldly laughed.
Without the hindrances by Emperor Summer and others, the countless souls in the sky continued flying once again to the three enormous black maelstroms.
“No-”
“Save us, save us!”
“I don’t want to die, I don’t wanna die!”
The innumerable souls that were momentarily paused in the sky saw as the three powerful experts left. They felt anxiety coursing through them and started shouting out for help frantically.
…
The experts in the entire Realm Heart Great Land became quiet.
Emperor Summer and the other two unparalleled existences had left the scene.
The threat declared by ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ was made known to everybody. Even Xue Ying could deduce the content by relying on his Destruction Realm Teleportation to observe the movement of their mouths.
To Emperor Summer and the others, saving the beings being sacrificed currently from the 15 nations located at the boundary of the world would likely bring more damage to their own nations. Even with the current strength of Emperor Summer, he could only protect a few cities. The Summer Wind Ancient Nation was too big. Having reproduced for so many years, the clansmen of ‘Summer Clan’ had practically spread across every single city in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation! Comparing the choice between letting those from the 15 nations die or watching as his own people die, Emperor Summer and others had easily made their decisions.
Now that the three unparalleled existences that held pity to the weak had left…
As for Moonflower King, Eternal Night Primogenitor, Realm Beast King, and others, it was even more impossible for them to do anything. They were even excited from watching it as it happened.
“How could this be?”
There were also Cosmos Gods that were filled with pity and anger on what was happening.
“Unless we can only watch as things happen?”
“But who dares to stand up? Undying Underworld Emperor could casually take out the corpse of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. He is even the strongest unparalleled existence before the First War of the Ancient Nation even started. Who knows how strong he is currently? He might even be so powerful that ancient nations could not resist against his vengeance! Hence, who is actually courageous to go against him?”
“Ai…”
Many experts felt sorrowful as they watched silently.
“What about Heaven’s Will Daoist? Aren’t he planning to stop all devils from committing grievous sins? Does he dare to stand up this time?”
“It is the Undying Underworld Emperor! How can he be compared to ordinary devils. But it is still a mystery who Heaven’s Will Daoist is. Who knows if he might just appear.” Various parties were discussing about it, though none dared to stand up.
…
Within Flying Snow City.
Xue Ying watched as things unfolded. When he saw Emperor Summer and the rest leaving, his expression shifted.
“Xue Ying, you must not show yourself. Underworld Emperor is a madman. He is the incarnation of death, so it is recommended for you not go offend him.” Southern Cloud King was currently anxiously advising Xue Ying, “As you said before, you would try to endure a little more when you are not strong enough. And you would do things according to how strong you are. Currently, Undying Underworld Emperor is so powerful that it is unfathomable.”
“Xue Ying! The methods of Underworld Emperor are hard to fathom. I’ve heard Emperor Summer say that Underworld Emperor has once visited some of the incredibly mysterious grounds amidst the Chaotic Origin Dimension. If you were to show up, you would definitely be in danger.” Swordmaster transmitted too.
Xue Ying watched.
Through his Destruction Realm Teleportation, he saw the sea of souls flowing from all the cities in the region.
Some were souls of infants, some were souls of weak teenagers, and some were souls of powerful cultivators. There were male and female, old and young, cultivators of different races… their number could simply not be counted. It was pointless no matter how they struggled. At this moment, who in the Realm Heart Great Land could save them?
Must he look on helplessly as they were devoured?
“Undying Underworld Emperor, who would have thought that the time for me to face you has come.” Xue Ying had thought of how possible it was when facing against all devils in the Realm Heart Great Land, that there would be a day he might face the most vicious and terrifying existence-Undying Underworld Emperor!
…
Nameless desolate mountain.
There was the humongous corpse of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform with three huge black maelstroms devouring the souls. By the side, the handsome Undying Underworld Emperor stood in midair watching this coldly. He believed nobody in the Realm Heart Great Land would dare to obstruct him!
“Mn?” Undying Underworld Emperor turned over, “It seems there is still someone who dares to be brazen?”
A black crack flashed in the void. A white-robed male walked out of it. He was none other than ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’.
“Heaven’s Will Daoist!”
“Heaven’s Will Daoist has really appeared.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1192 - Identity revealed
chapters.content:
Chapter 1192: Identity revealed
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Xue Ying, he actually…” Southern Cloud King watched with his Destruction Realm Teleportation from afar. His expression changed. Southern Cloud King could not help but shake his head.
This was something he did not wish to see the most!
Even though he loathed Undying Underworld Emperor, and desired to see the fall of Undying Underworld Emperor, he had ultimately sworn an oath to take Undying Underworld Emperor as his teacher.
And on the other end was a disciple whom he genuinely had a good relationship with. He did not wish to see Xue Ying fight against the terrifying Undying Underworld Emperor!
“Xue Ying has concealed his aura. He specializes in combat techniques, and has never unleashed any of those techniques that ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ used before. His identity should still be kept undercover.” Swordmaster who was similarly concerned over it watched from afar, “What I am afraid is for Undying Underworld Emperor to know some technique which he has never used before.”
The unknown was what made others feel fear of.
The simple act of Undying Underworld Emperor throwing out the corpse of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform had indeed brought terror and shock to all apex cultivators in the Realm Heart Great Land.
“No matter what, since Heaven’s Will Daoist dares to show himself at this moment, I only feel admiration for him. He is amazing.” Many experts felt sullen and helpless when they saw Emperor Summer and others leaving. But now that ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’ appeared, even though they did not feel confident for him, they admired Heaven’s Will Daoist for his courage to dare appear at this moment.
…
No matter what others think.
Xue Ying stood out because of those innumerable sentient beings.
“Hong”. He immediately controlled the void to stop those souls from progressing forward. He was using actions to make his stand known. He then said: “Underworld Emperor…”
He just spoke!
“What gall! Do you think you are qualified to intervene in my matter?” Undying Underworld Emperor’s voice reverberated in the world. He simply sent his palm over just like swatting a fly. That palm was filled with endless darkness and was even bigger than a cosmos. Endless darkness rushed over in the direction of Xue Ying, forcing Xue Ying into a retreat.
“Hua.”
As he moved backwards, a distorted void maelstrom appeared by the side. That maelstrom constructed a pitch-black passage to another location.
“Sou.”
That palm of Undying Underworld Emperor was incredibly powerful. Under the routing of the void maelstrom, Xue Ying’s body resisted against the corrosion from that terrifying darkness before tunneling through the pitch-black passage to a location five million kilometers away.
At that location, Xue Ying appeared with his body filled with blood. His body was currently rapidly recovering.
“This fleshy body of yours has actually been refined to the stage of a final realm body cultivator. Amazing, truly amazing. Even though your life force is weaker by a major level, your defensive techniques are more formidable.” Only then did Undying Underworld Emperor spoke, “Since you were able to take a palm of mine without dying, you are qualified to speak. State whatever you wish to say now.”
Only then did Undying Underworld Emperor look at Heaven’s Will Daoist.
That was just an avatar, yet it was not killed by a palm! Even though he did not use his full strength, Heaven’s Will Daoist had many avatars!
“Underworld Emperor.” Xue Ying stated, “Aren’t you afraid of being punished for your sin of killing so many sentient beings? You mentioned how you understood the temper of Yuan, but it is entirely possible for the thinking of Yuan to change with regards to how he governs an Origin World. According to what I know, ‘Luo City Lord’ should be the newest Chaotic Origin Lifeform, and he is even more pitiful to the weak. Perhaps under the influence of Luo City Lord, Yuan’s thinking might change.”
Undying Underworld Emperor’s expression shifted slightly.
That was entirely possible!
He knew many things, of which that Luo City Lord who ‘relied on his strength’ to have a breakthrough to the Chaotic Origin Lifeform was someone who was more benevolent to the weak as compared to ‘Yuan’.
“Do you think you could bear the punishment of Yuan when the time comes?” Xue Ying asked.
“Hmph hmph, what kind of identity does Yuan have? How could his thinking change so easily?” Undying Underworld Emperor coldly retorted. He had no choice! If he did not refine the Death Walker, he was not confident of going deep into the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
“Other than the possible punishments by Yuan, I, Heaven’s Will Daoist, will also do my utmost to stop you from slaughtering these sentient beings.” Xue Ying’s eyes flashed with a cold intent.
“You dare!” Undying Underworld Emperor angrily roared.
“I naturally dare! Underworld Emperor, you are powerful and it is impossible for me to injure you. But this time, your array has covered a total of 15 nations! With such a huge array, I believe Underworld Emperor should have spent a large effort before succeeding right? I can casually choose a spot before destroying any vital part of the array and it should be fine. Given my attainments in the Dao of Void, I have many avatars… I can easily rely on my Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to appear at any location before proceeding with destroying it. How many places do you think you could defend it from?”
The expression of Undying Underworld Emperor became uglier as he heard.
Undying Underworld Emperor did not know any avatar techniques! If Xue Ying chose to attack with more than hundred avatars of his in various locations, he could only defend one or two places.
It was still quite easy for Heaven’s Will Daoist to destroy the array given his strength.
“If you dare to do this.”
Undying Underworld Emperor growled, “I’ll continue to kill and wipe out all sentient beings. You can’t stop me at all.”
Xue Ying shook his head: “If I don’t stop you, you would continue to massacre all sentient beings in these 15 nations. Since that’s the case, why would I retreat?”
As long as stopped the other party.
Even if Undying Underworld Emperor chose to vent his anger, Xue Ying believed the other party would not wipe out any more than the sentient beings in 15 nations because ‘Yuan’ could possibly come down with harsh punishments after that.
Furthermore, Undying Underworld Emperor might not even dare to vent his anger. The moment he did it once, in the future if he planned on ‘sacrificing’ again, he could no longer do so in such a large-scale as he had killed too many sentient beings.
“You… you…”
Killing intent rose in both eyes of Undying Underworld Emperor.
Emperor Summer and others had taken a step back, but it seemed this Heaven’s Will Daoist was not willing to do so.
Heaven’s Will Daoist remained fine even if he chose to threaten the population.
“Emperor Summer, Limitless, are your Summer Wind Ancient Nation and Myriad Realms Ancient Nation not planning to stop him? Are you just allowing him to disrupt my affair?” Undying Underworld Emperor transmitted.
“My Myriad Realms Ancient Nation doesn’t have such an expert.”
“Neither does my Summer Wind Ancient Nation have such an expert.”
Both of them replied.
Clearly, Summer Wind Ancient Nation, Myriad Realms Ancient Nation, and many other ancient nations were standing by the side without choosing to intervene. Even ‘Primogenitor Ancient Nation’s Eternal Night Primogenitor and Extreme Night Primogenitor were happy to watch from the sides. They disliked Heaven’s Will Daoist, and similarly disliked ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ too! Of these two, the identity of one was a mystery, and he seemed to have no worries and was a final realm expert. As for the other party, he had no worries and concerns either, and was faintly the top expert in Realm Heart Great Land.
Undying Underworld Emperor felt frustrated inwardly.
He could not force others to help him.
Otherwise, when so many unparalleled existences chose to work together, even Undying Underworld Emperor would have a huge trouble.
“Very good.”
“Heaven’s Will Daoist, it seems you are really daring to stand out for these ants. It is amazing also for you to suppress all the devils in Realm Heart Great Land by yourself alone.” Undying Underworld Emperor sneered, “Isn’t it all because nobody knows your true identity? What a pity, I am someone who knows your true identity!”
Xue Ying’s expression changed.
The other party knew about his identity?
Undying Underworld Emperor? Was it real or fake?
“What?”
“He knows the identity of Heaven’s Will Daoist?”
“How could this be?”
“Who exactly is Heaven’s Will Daoist? Who is he? Hurry up and say it! Say it!” Many apex experts across the Realm Heart Great Land that were paying attention to this scene felt either worried or shocked. Some were incredibly excited and were celebrating in joy. Those devils had been waiting for this day to arrive! They looked forward to the day the identity of Heaven’s Will Daoist was uncovered!
None of them could achieve this feat. But since this legendary ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ dared to spout such words, he must have some degree of certainty.
Undying Underworld Emperor looked at Xue Ying with a cold chuckle: “What, you don’t believe me?”
“Weng.”
Undying Underworld Emperor gritted his teeth.
His heart was a strange gold in color-it seemed like a metal. At this moment, a droplet of golden blood became ignited. The eyes of Undying Underworld Emperor glowed with gold. That pair of golden eyes seemed to be able to see through to the future and easily unraveling all fabricated lies. He also saw the real face of that Heaven’s Will Daoist. The soul of Heaven’s Will Daoist that was completely disguised was strangely discerned clearly by this pair of bizarre ‘golden eyes’. All disguises were made useless before them!
And when Undying Underworld Emperor discovered the identity, he was slightly startled. Looking at Xue Ying with a chuckle, he transmitted over: “Southern Cloud Nation, Ying Shan Xue Ying? Am I right?”
He transmitted over clearly because he did not wish to shed all pretense of cordiality.
Xue Ying’s expression changed.
He was discovered.
His identity was truly discovered.
“Talking about it, you are even my grand-disciple.” Undying Underworld Emperor transmitted over, “Hurry up and leave, my obedient grand-disciple. Don’t disrupt my affair. That way, I’ll pardon you this time. Otherwise, don’t blame me for being ruthless.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1193 - The Indignant Undying Underworld Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1193: The Indignant Undying Underworld Emperor
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Many apex experts in Realm Heart Great Land were using various methods to watch the confrontation between Undying Underworld Emperor and Heaven’s Will Daoist.
At this moment, the expression of Heaven’s Will Daoist became ugly! Undying Underworld Emperor was grinning in delight…
“It seems that Undying Underworld Emperor has genuinely unraveled the identity of Heaven’s Will Daoist.”
“Hurry up and publicise it!”
“Make it public!”
“It seems both of them are discussing through voice transmissions. This Undying Underworld Emperor doesn’t seem to be publicising it!”
“Why would Undying Underworld Emperor do so? The moment he reveals the identity of Heaven’s Will Daoist, Heaven’s Will Daoist will certainly go mad and not leave any room for negotiation. He would simply choose to destroy that array. Without the control of the huge array, how would it be possible to control all souls in a total of 15 nations when the law suppression of Realm Heart Great Land is so heavy?”
“I’ve waited for far too long just to find out who Heaven’s Will Daoist is. But this Undying Underworld Emperor doesn’t seem to be making it public!”
Various parties were paying close notice to this.
And the devils were all anxious and excited.
There were some reclusive and aloof cultivators who wanted to know who Heaven’s Will Daoist purely to satisfy their curiosity.
Naturally, there were many zealous admirers of ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’ in the world. Some were experts that grew from the group saved by Heaven’s Will Daoist. Some purely admired Heaven’s Will Daoist because of his conduct. This batch of experts did not wish for the identity of Heaven’s Will Daoist to be revealed since this was a pillar that suppressed all devils! And it must not fall!
…
“Grand-disciple?” Xue Ying transmitted over, “Teacher, this Undying Underworld Emperor is my grand-teacher?”
He had never heard of that relationship existing between Southern Cloud King and Undying Underworld Emperor before.
“He has really discovered your identity? Ai, Xue Ying, the matter of Undying Underworld Emperor becoming my teacher happened after you took me as your teacher! That time, for the sake of acquiring the ‘Twin Realm Blade’, I was forced to swear and oath-to take the owner of the blade, ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’, as my teacher and to serve him from henceforth.” Southern Cloud King transmitted, “I originally thought that he was dead. Who would have guessed that he actually returned after so long! Xue Ying, I urge you to just tolerate it. He has already discovered your identity, so all the more you should endure it. This Undying Underworld Emperor is a madman. Legend has spoken about how he was synonymous with death. That’s because of his habit to kill. If you were to become an enemy with him… he’ll definitely not let you go!”
Xue Ying was enlightened.
Saying which, his teacher Southern Cloud King was really pitiful since he was restricted by an oath.
“Hurry up and retreat.” Undying Underworld Emperor looked at Xue Ying with a smile. He transmitted, “You are my grand-disciple, so you shouldn’t be taking unfair advantage of your teacher and your grand-teacher.”
“I like my freedom when choosing teachers.” Xue Ying transmitted over, “So Underworld Emperor, I think you should still give up. Currently, if you choose to keep the materials used in arranging the array, you can still lower your losses to a minimum. But the moment I act, your losses would be greater.”
Undying Underworld Emperor’s expression sunk: “Ying Shan Xue Ying? Are you genuinely thinking of becoming enemies with me?”
“If you don’t massacre the population, I’ll definitely not become enemies with you. Underworld Emperor… you have been continuing with your vicious slaughters. Even after such a long time, you still aren’t a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Why can’t you just think it true if this is the wrong path?” Xue Ying transmitted over, “Once you walked down a path until the end and could no longer have a breakthrough, perhaps there might be another world with greener pasture. Right now if you gave up on killing and many of your past ideas, and instead choose to cherish all living things, you might be able to gain another set of comprehensions that could entail a progression towards becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.”
Why not turn back and take another path if the current path led to a deadend?
“I’ve tried it before a very long time ago. It is futile. Anyway, you aren’t qualified to talk to me on matters regarding cultivation!” The face of Undying Underworld Emperor sunk, “If you choose to return now, I’ll still treat you as my grand-disciple. In the future if you require any help, I would still help you. Otherwise if you offended me, don’t blame me for being ruthless. Your entire Ying Shan Clan will be wiped out by me. And there’s also the Southern Cloud Nation! The Southern Cloud Nation will also have to pay the price because of you!”
Undying Underworld Emperor was merely saying it.
He would not hesitate to wipe out Ying Shan Clan.
But to wipe out the Southern Cloud Nation?
Southern Cloud Nation was itself close to the strength of 15 tier-three nations. Furthermore, ‘Southern Cloud King’ would also turn mad. A Southern Cloud King with countless avatars turning mad was a destructive force not any weaker than Xue Ying.
…
As he was threatening Xue Ying, Undying Underworld Emperor was also transmitting messages over to Southern Cloud King: “Hurry up and persuade this disciple of yours not to continue with his foolish actions! If he chooses to disrupt my affair, not only will I ensure his Ying Shan Clan is wiped out, even your Southern Cloud Nation will not have a good ending.”
“What? Teacher, your meaning is that Heaven’s Will Daoist is Ying Shan Xue Ying?”
“You actually did not know of this?”
“Such secret will definitely be kept completely confidential. I doubt he will let any other person know about it. Even I do not know about this.” Southern Cloud King replied.
“Hmph.” Undying Underworld Emperor agreed that such matter would be kept absolutely confidential, “That disciple of yours, Ying Shan Xue Ying, is Heaven’s Will Daoist. He currently has plans to obstruct with my affair. Hurry up and persuade him not to do so.”
“Yes, I’ll do so right now.” Southern Cloud King answered.
…
Xue Ying stood in midair. His expression kept transforming as he stared at Undying Underworld Emperor. He transmitted: “Underworld Emperor, it is pointless to find someone to persuade me against my action. You should know that I have reincarnated into this world… I disdained from accepting Ancestor Fan as my teacher in the past and rather choose to become a disciple of Southern Cloud King. Why was that? It’s precisely because my freedom will not be as restricted if I chose to take Southern Cloud King as my teacher. I do not care about the scriptures within Southern Cloud, and neither do I care about the treasures. Do you think that it is possible to persuade me otherwise?”
The expression of Undying Underworld Emperor became uglier from this moment on.
Madness! This is absolute madness!
This Xue Ying should have been reincarnated into this world. He did not care about Southern Cloud King, and even his relationship with the Ying Shan Clan is limited!
“It is useless. I have tried to persuade him, but even though I took him in as my disciple, I did not teach him anything at all. Currently, he is even stronger than me so I can’t control him at all.” Southern Cloud King anxiously transmitted over, “What to do, Teacher, what should I do now?”
“You trash!” Undying Underworld Emperor roared with immense fury. During ordinary times, he would still maintain some decorum when speaking to Southern Cloud King, but now, he was genuinely furious.
“I am also at my wit’s end, Teacher!” Southern Cloud King anxiously answered.
He was doing this to deliberately draw a clear dividing line.
That was agreed upon by Xue Ying and Southern Cloud King to prevent any spilling over of conflict with Undying Underworld Emperor when he became mad unto the entire Southern Cloud Nation.
…
“Underworld Emperor, stop delaying for more time. Are you retreating or not?” Xue Ying roared through voice transmissions.
“Retreat, why would I retreat? I have already burned the final realm Resentment Spirits and constructed everything for the sake of this sacrificial ritual. How could I retreat then?” Undying Underworld Emperor stared at Xue Ying, roaring out, “The moment I chose to do so, the final realm Resentment Spirits would all be wasted. The failure of this sacrificial ritual would also mean a failure in the ignition of spirituality, causing the life force in the corpse to wither away before dying in ashes. I have forked out my Devouring Realm Spiritual Liquid and other treasures. Everything would be gone, everything that I have paid for this ritual would be wasted. How could I ever retreat then?”
He had paid too much price.
The moment he failed, only the corpse of the Chaotic Origin Lifeform would remain fine. Everything else would be wasted.
He did not know when he could gather sufficient treasures for another ritual!
Furthermore, this Xue Ying was a madman. Since he came to stop his sacrifice this time, he would similarly do so again in the future!
“Ying Shan Xue Ying, you should walk down your path, and I will walk down mine. Don’t force my hand.” The surface of Undying Underworld Emperor’s body started burning with gold flames.
“I do not wish to force you, but it’s you who is forcing these sentient beings to a deadend.” Xue Ying pointed out to the floating souls. Those souls were also staring at his direction. All of them were filled with hope, “The path you take will cause the extermination of countless souls. This vicious path of yours must be snuffed.”
“Since you do not plan on retreating, I can only act in accordance to it.” Xue Ying roared out in public for the first time.
“You dare!”
Undying Underworld Emperor also roared back in fury.
His body was filled with endless darkness. His aura seemed to have engulfed the world. Both his palms were imbued with dazzling golden flames that were sent in the direction of Xue Ying.
At this moment, the surroundings seemed to have been pulled into a dark world of death.
In this world of death, there was a terrifying golden flames burning… everything seemed to be related to death.
“So frightening. What a frightening energy.” Xue Ying felt it. This Undying Underworld Emperor was clearly stronger by an entire level than Eternal Night Primogenitor.
This time, a maelstrom appeared over the surface of Xue Ying’s body. He planned on ripping apart a pitch-black hole. This was also the defensive fleeing maneuver Xue Ying had created in his <Flying Snow Combat Technique>-’Myriad Realms Movement Technique’!
But it was a failure this time!
Under the engulf of the golden flames and suppression of the dark world, the maelstrom that appeared over Xue Ying’s body completely crumbled. His body failed to rush out when it was corroded by endless energy. Even though he struggled and tried retaliating, just after two moves and his body was completely burned into ashes.
Nonetheless-
It was useless!
Xue Ying did not dare to take the risk when facing Undying Underworld Emperor. He did not even bring along his Void Fire Lotus Flower! Much less the Chaotic Origin Weapon ‘Azure River Spear’! He merely sent a great avatar over. Without the aid from any secret treasures, his avatar merely had the power of a final realm cultivator. He was still lacking by a level when compared to the true final realm cultivators in terms of survivability and fleeing aspects.
Undying Underworld Emperor only became serious this time, easily killing that avatar.
“Mn?” The expression of Undying Underworld Emperor changed.
He killed a final realm cultivator so easily?
And why were there no secret treasures left behind?
“Sou.””Sou.””Sou.”…
At this moment.
Many white-robed male appeared within the region where the 15 nations were. Within an instance, a total of more than hundred avatars appeared scattered across the various locations.
“No!” Undying Underworld Emperor was alarmed and incredibly furious. He hurriedly transmitted, “Ying Shan Xue Ying, as long as you do not disrupt my affair, everything can be discussed.”
“As long as you do not continue with your sacrificial ritual, to me, everything can also be discussed.” The more than a hundred avatars acknowledged in reply.
“It is you who is not giving my a path to walk!” Undying Underworld Emperor was mad.
“Hong! Hong! Hong!”…
Of those avatars, some were strong and some were weak. The strong ones had reached the final realm in strength. When they exerted their full strength, even the void was torn apart. Some of the constructed array bases were shattered, and in an instant, the core sections of the array located across a dozen regions were destroyed. That huge black array which originally engulfed the sky above the 15 nations started trembling. Following as Xue Ying continued destroying more core sections, that enormous black array eventually dissipated away.
The sky had finally regained its normalcy.
The bright sky seemed beautiful and calm as always.
And the innumerable souls across the 15 nations had broken away from that restriction force. They regained their freedom.
“Go back. Hurry back now.” The souls immediately flew in accordance to their perception where their own fleshy bodies were.
“No, no-”
Undying Underworld Emperor was doing his best to stop Xue Ying from disrupting his array.
But it was to no avail. Xue Ying had too many avatars!
“Ying Shan Xue YIng!” Undying Underworld Emperor let out an indignant roar into the sky.
This roar.
It shook across half a trillion kilometers. Nonetheless, its effect had spread and shook the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
Only at this moment did the apex cultivators in Realm Heart Great Land find out that Heaven’s Will Daoist… is Southern Cloud Nation’s Monarch Flying Snow, ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying’!

chapters.title: Chapter 1194 - Nobody can save you
chapters.content:
Chapter 1194: Nobody can save you
A gray-robed young man stood by his teacher. Both of them were watching the floating Heaven Observation Mirror. Projected on the Heaven Observation Mirror, they saw Undying Underworld Emperor roaring out the name ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying’, which caused the expression of the gray-robed young man to change.
“My benefactor, my greatest benefactor… is actually Monarch Flying Snow?” The gray-robed young man felt his heart trembling. He was also worried for his benefactor Xue Ying and angry at the unbridled madness Undying Underworld Emperor was displaying currently.
“Is there really nobody who could stop a huge devil in Realm Heart Great Land from his wanton destruction? Unless devils are ought to be allowed to massacre? And those who stops the devils are forced to suffer from bitter hardship?” The gray-robed young man clenched both his fists. His eyes were brimming red.
His true love, his children.
All his loved ones and clansmen were saved by ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’! And it was just an unremarkable city Heaven’s Will Daoist saved during the past hundreds of millions of years.
Such matters were as natural as breathing to ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’. He had saved a lot of sentient beings! And over the years, those he saved had some successes in their cultivation-quite a few even reached the Primal Chaos Realm.
“Disciple.” By the side, the teacher of the gray-robed young man said, “I know that your city where your entire clan and family was based in had been saved by Heaven’s Will Daoist. But Undying Underworld Emperor is too powerful. It isn’t appropriate for our Myriad Realms Ancient Nation to become enemies with him.”
“I understand.” The gray-robed young man gritted his teeth.
He hated it.
If only he was sufficiently powerful. That way, he could fight side-by-side with his benefactor! How good would that be!
But currently, he was just a tiny little Primal Chaos cultivator. He did not even have the strength to reach the battlefield in time! Undying Underworld Emperor could easily kill him with just a stare even if he reached the place.
…
“Benefactor.”
“So it seems the true identity of benefactor is Monarch Flying Snow?”
A father and son were both within a residence. Ripples of water projected the scene happening afar.
“Benefactor has done us a great favor. Only because he saved us did I have the chance to become a Cosmos God. It’s a pity that we can’t help our benefactor!”
…
Many cultivators who had the grace of being saved by Xue Ying felt anxious and worried when they got the news about Xue Ying. There were even more weaker cultivators who did not know about the fact that their benefactor’s identity had been revealed. They remained living their ordinary lives, albeit they were filled with gratitude towards Heaven’s Will Daoist for saving them.
“It is the first time that Heaven’s Will Daoist appears after the long years in Realm Heart Great Land, intimidating all devils with his strength. And now, it appears this pillar is going to fall? Sigh!” A Cosmos God sitting cross-legged in a meditation room could hardly conceal the anger on his face.
“I have always been afraid that there is a day ever since the birth of Heaven’s Will Daoist, that his identity is revealed!”
“Undying Underworld Emperor has threatened Monarch Flying Snow earlier, but Monarch Flying Snow disregarded his safety and chose to save sentient beings in the 15 nations! Unless he has something to rely on for daring to do that?”
“But what reliance does he has? Even Summer Wind Ancient Nation and Myriad Realms Ancient Nation aren’t willing to tangle themselves with this madman called Undying Underworld Emperor. So what reliance can Monarch Flying Snow have? Even if he survived fortuitously through the encounter, his loved ones and clansmen would suffer from a calamity.”
Many cultivators were lamenting about it.
The majority of cultivators would still care about their loved ones.
Either they were family or good friends or even clansmen… those who only cared about themselves were few!
