“Haha… who doesn’t know of the huge name of Great Paragon Flying Snow currently? Even Underworld Emperor has to retreat before Flying Snow City.” Emperor Summer laughed.
Xue Ying welcomed them with a smile.
But in his heart, he faintly understood that the other party should most likely be here for something related to the Chaotic Origin Weapon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1201 - Paying a Visit
chapters.content:
Chapter 1201: Paying a Visit
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, and Emperor Cang came. Swordmaster was unlike them; he naturally greeted the three unparalleled existences with a look. As for Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen, he simply gave a cold glare without saying anything.
He had started a feud with the Fan Clan and even killed the experts from Fan Clan before!
Offending the Fan Clan was equivalent to offending the three great clans in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation! Given the temper of Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen, he disdained to lower his head.
“Insect Ancestor.” Ancestor Fan greeted with a smile, “I’ve heard that you have some enmity with a few juniors of my Fan Clan. I wonder when did these juniors offend you? You have followed after Devouring Realm Great Emperor a very long time ago, and there should not be a chance for the juniors of my Fan Clan to become enemies with you right!”
If this was the real Insect Ancestor, he would naturally not be enemies with the Fan Clan.
But Ba Tuo Chen had fused with the final realm insect. He could perfectly disguise himself as the Insect Ancestor. As for the real Insect Ancestor, he had actually died a long time ago. His death was silent, which was why Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen chose to disguise his identity in order to maintain low-profile and cover his rapid rise to power. As for now? Even though he was not afraid of revealing his identity, it would be better for him to act as Insect Ancestor to avoid trouble.
Regardless, his loved ones and good friends were no longer in this world. He stood amidst the vast Realm Heart Great Land by his lonesome self. Instead, it was his benefactor, ‘Xue Ying’, who became the closest to him.
Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen coldly snorted, “It was my disciple where an enmity exist! Hmph hmph, Fan Clan, your juniors are truly overbearing. It’s a pity that I do not tolerate such actions especially when it reaches me!”
“Haha… those are some minor matters only. You are also a good friend of Honored Guest Flying Snow. Honored Guest Flying Snow has a deep relationship with my Fan Clan. How about letting go those past grudges?” Ancestor Fan chuckled. He had a high status and would naturally not care too much about some grudges the disciples of his Fan Clan had. After all, the Fan Clan was too big. It was more so because this ‘Insect Ancestor’ was a lone ranger at the final realm. He had no worries or concerns.
Such enemies were the worst kind.
Because he had no fear. And he could not be killed.
“Rest assured. Those that should be killed are killed! As for the rest, I wouldn’t care much for them.” Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen snorted coldly.
“Haha.” Ancestor Fan chuckled with a nod. He affirm to the cold personality this Insect Ancestor had. He then turned to Xue Ying, “Honored Guest Flying Snow, every one thought that you suffered from grave losses during your exploration at the Realm Heart God Palace. You were killed by Eternal Night Primogenitor and your treasures were snatched! Now it seems that your reward at the Realm Heart God Palace should be a supreme secret impartation!”
Emperor Summer and Emperor Cang both looked at Xue Ying.
“Indeed.” Xue Ying nodded, “I got it fortuitously during my first expedition into the Realm Heart God Palace.”
“I had also gotten mine during the first visit.” Paragon Master Bewitching Sword added from the side.
“The two of you came from the same Origin World and the same religion. Both your innate talent and personality are excellent.” Emperor Summer lamented, “Yuan created the Realm Heart Great Land and the Realm Heart God Palace in the past, yet acquiring a ‘supreme secret impartation’ is much harder than getting a supreme-graded secret treasure! Nonetheless, the two of you actually got your hands on one. As long as you broke through to the final realm, it should be relatively easy for the two of you to get a supreme-graded secret treasure when you visit the Realm Heart God Palace again. Bewitching Sword has already broken through to the final realm, and I believe it’ll come soon for you, Honored Guest Flying Snow.”
Xue Ying shook his head helplessly: “I desire to step into the final realm, but how could it be that easy?”
“I have a question for you. That Chaotic Origin Weapon should be refined using the Chaotic Origin Sand right?” Emperor Summer asked.
“Emperor Summer knows about it?” Xue Ying was startled.
He had only mentioned it to Insect Ancestor and Swordmaster before. Even if Swordmaster chose to tell Emperor Summer and the others, he would first inform Xue Ying.
“It’s merely a conjecture!” Emperor Summer answered, “Your avatar was once killed in the Realm Heart God Palace, which meant you lost all treasures. What you could bring out is only your memories! In addition to the fact that you bought a total of 50,000 kilograms of Chaotic Origin Sand from my side, I could easily deduce from these facts that you should have used it to refine your Chaotic Origin Weapon.”
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded without concealing it, “But as you know, this inheritance can’t be imparted to outsiders.”
Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang, and Ancestor Fan all understood it.
Supreme secret impartation and other precious inheritances were imparted down by Yuan, and they were forbidden from being spread to others!
What they could teach others like the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll> or <Un-Phase Mystical Technique> were created by Emperor Summer and the others.
“Reaching our current cultivation, the next goal would be to jump out of the cage and become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform!” Emperor Summer said. Emperor Cang and Ancestor Fan looked at Xue Ying. Emperor Summer continued solemnly, “We would naturally not trust the news spread by that Undying Underworld Emperor. But we have never heard of Chaotic Origin Weapon before! Hence, we hope you could introduce it to us briefly and let us understand more about it.”
Xue Ying smiled: “This is simple.”
He understood that Emperor Summer and the others had the heart of comprehending the Dao! He could empathize with the intense desire they had to jump out of the cage.
Like Emperor Summer, he was once the number one expert in Realm Heart Great Land. Even ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ could barely suppress Emperor Summer after using his trump card. These experts were all lonely! And Emperor Summer was genuinely too lonely. His desire to jump out of the cage was incredibly intense. If Xue Ying could not satisfy this simple request of theirs, he would be agitating them.
“The Chaotic Origin Weapon is originally a weapon that Chaotic Origin Lifeforms use.” Xue Ying explained, “Ordinarily speaking, Cosmos Gods like us should not be able to use it, and neither could we refine it. But ‘Yuan’ has thought of ways to allow me to refine a Chaotic Origin Weapon personally. Since I have been through the entire creation process-every single material was refined by me-the final refinement that gave me control of the weapon becomes much easier. After all, in order for a Cosmos God to refine this weapon successfully, firstly, the process must be based on a Dao that I am good at. Secondly, it must be simple enough. Hence, this Chaotic Origin Weapon is a weapon meant only for use with the Dao of Void! And comparing it with an authentic Chaotic Origin Weapon, it is too simplified.”
“Oh?” Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang, and Ancestor Fan nodded slightly.
“Please have a look.” Xue Ying extended his hand. The Azure River Spear was placed on his palm. He slightly activated it before causing numerous inscriptions on the spear to light up, “You will understand after witnessing it.”
Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang, and Ancestor Fan thoroughly observed the spear.
At this moment, both Emperor Cang and Ancestor Fan had some difficulty in understanding the inscriptions.
But Emperor Summer immediately understood more than half the inscriptions. The part relating to the Dao of Void was something he grasped easily. But there were still many aspects which he could not understand. If he had the supreme secret impartation with him to guide and dissect the inscriptions, it would be much easier. But just examining the inscriptions was something almost impossible to comprehend since many aspects related to the usage of Chaotic Origin Energy that were way too exquisite and extraordinary.
As for Xue Ying, he purely carved the inscriptions according to the manual provided. He understood those simplified and divided sections of the refinement process, but when all sections were brought together as a whole, he himself could not comprehend it anymore.
“Indeed, it is a Chaotic Origin Weapon meant for the Dao of Void.” Emperor Summer nodded, “It is useless for cultivators on other Daos. Furthermore, it seems to only specialize in the control of Chaotic Origin Energy. Many thanks, Honored Guest Flying Snow! Thank you for allowing us to have a look at the inscriptions on a Chaotic Origin Weapon.”
Xue Ying smiled: “It’s a minor matter.”
How difficult would it be to deduce the cultivation technique purely by examining the inscriptions?
Like supreme-graded secret treasures, there were quite a few of them in the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Activating those treasures would cause the ‘inscriptions’ to light up and appear. But so what if others saw it? Even those at the final realm would feel bewildered when looking at profound mysteries relating to the Chaotic Origin level.
The complexity of a Chaotic Origin Weapon was not any less than that of a supreme-graded secret treasure.
And Xue Ying only succeeded in refining it after decomposing the final outcome into smaller pieces before doing so step by step.
…
In the following days, many cultivators came visiting Xue Ying.
The five ancestors in Myriad Realms Ancient Nation came in two batches to visit him. Those from Sky Towering Ancient Nation and Icy Snow Ancient Nation came as well. Xue Ying received them one by one, and was unusually magnanimous in allowing others examine the inscriptions on the Chaotic Origin Weapon! Actually, in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, only ‘Drifter’ and ‘Emperor Summer’ could understand the majority of the inscriptions, and what they understood were mainly those parts on the Dao of Void.
As for others, they only felt that it seemed complicated, and could vaguely affirm that those inscriptions related to the Dao of Void.
Furthermore, Drifter and Emperor Summer also helped him by publicizing-the Chaotic Origin Weapon was meant for the Dao of Void! Only Dao of Void experts could use it. Furthermore, Cosmos Gods could practically not be able to refine it.
Actually, they were showing Xue Ying some respect by adding the final statement! Emperor Summer was quite close to Xue Ying on an overall standpoint. And Drifter’s personality was quite transcendental. Xue Ying also treated Drifter relatively well, causing Drifter to form good impression of Xue Ying, which was why Drifter chose to say those.
Furthermore, with how powerful Xue Ying was in the Flying Snow City, he could practically be comparable to the number one expert in Realm Heart Great Land!
Undying Underworld Emperor intended to bring some trouble to Xue Ying by relying on this, yet everything failed!
“Hmph, Moonflower King? He wants to see the inscription on my Chaotic Origin Weapon with his status?”
Xue Ying simply expelled the incarnation of the other party.
Xue Ying did not show any respect to Moonflower King, Eternal Night Primogenitor, Extreme Night Primogenitor and other final realm devils. Want to see his Chaotic Origin Weapon? Dream on! Regardless, Xue Ying hated them! He would not show any mercy when killing devils in Moonflower Ancient Nation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1202 - Invitation from Swordmaster
chapters.content:
Chapter 1202: Invitation from Swordmaster
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
It was a cooling night.
Within an underground palace that was originally huge, the insides had been enlarged to an even wider space using void arrays.
The palace had a total of six levels.
The top three levels were where the palace master and his disciples stayed.
The bottom three levels were places for experiments.
Currently at the lowest level, it was a dark place. The ground glowed in crimson color, and a bloody aura permeated the place.
“The experimental materials have all been gathered.” The eyes of the black-robed palace master were filled with excitement. He took out a jade bottle. Following that, he uncorked it, causing many human figures to fly out. Many cultivators were brought out of the bottle, and they were currently looking around them restlessly.
The dark place, the crimson floor and the bloody atmosphere.
Those factors made them even more disturbed.
“I must hurry! Otherwise, there would be some unforeseen circumstances.”
“Damn that Great Paragon Flying Snow! Why must he meddle in other people’s business and care about the lives of these ants?” The black-robed palace master thought, “I am forced to conduct my experiments with great care and caution. I don’t even dare to experiment with too much materials! But this is a crucial one that I have to gather sufficient experimental bodies! I can’t care less anymore. I should hurry up with it.”
The black-robed palace master felt sullen.
His path of cultivation relied on experimenting the fleshy bodies and souls of cultivators.
Ever since the appearance of ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’, he immediately went on high alert. The materials he used for each experiment became much less. For instance, it was common for small-scaled slaughters to occur on the Realm Heart Great Land. Some grudges in the Realm Heart Great Land would easily involve the death of more than 10,000 sentient beings. Xue Ying did not even have the capacity to care about such affairs! He would only meddle in large massacres.
Nonetheless, he required an incredible amount of materials for some experiments.
“The materials I have collected are sufficient for only one experiment. I must succeed it in one try.”
“Time to gamble.”
The black-robed palace master suddenly appeared in midair within this level of space. His enormous illusory figure brought fear to the innumerable sentient beings below. The cold eyes of that huge figure were actually a form of terrorizing technique that made these sentient beings more terrified and panicked, “I only require 10 helpers. Those who can’t survive would simply die!”
The moment he finished speaking, the black-robed palace master began pouring down endless violet sparkles.
As the violet sparkles were falling, a white-robed young man suddenly appeared within the space. He looked at that black-robed palace master coldly.
“Great Paragon Flying Snow!” The black-robed palace master was so frightened that he felt his legs softening.
He had been afraid of this. But no matter what, he was still discovered by Great Paragon Flying Snow in the end!
The black-robed palace master roared: “You can’t kill me! I am only doing this for cultivation.”
“Hu.”
Xue Ying waved his hand, forcing the endless violet sparkles to dissipate along with the void ripples.
“For cultivation?” Xue Ying coldly uttered.
“I am a body cultivator, and am researching on souls. I have to do more experiments!” The black-robed palace master roared, “I am not a devil. I am only doing this for the sake of my experiments.”
Xue Ying swept beneath him with his gaze: “A total of 380 billion cultivators are used just for a single experiment of yours? And you still deny that you are a devil?”
“I am merely using some ants for my experiment. Can this be wrong too?” The black-robed palace master roared.
“Ants? Then in my eyes, you are are also an ant!” Xue Ying waved his hand. The location where the black-robed palace master stood became suppressed into an art. Following that, this art dissipated, and the black-robed palace master turned into nothingness.
Following that, the expression of Xue Ying shifted: “Not good.”
“Hong!”
The entire palace abruptly exploded.
Xue Ying had to control the void during the eleventh hour to protect those innocent sentient beings. He even protected the original disciples of that black-robed palace master and subordinates with ‘less grievances’. As for those with a terrifying grievances covering their bodies, they accompanied the explosion and departed this world.
“Sou.”
Following that, those sentient beings were teleported into the wilderness nearby.
“He actually left behind a trap that would cause the entire cavern-dwelling to explode once he dies?” Xue Ying coldly snorted. This self-destruction mechanism might be threatening to the most ordinary Cosmos Gods. But to him, his domain could easily protect any sentient beings he wanted to.
“This is quite a huge disturbance, eh?”
A voice sounded by the side.
Xue Ying’s expression changed. In the vast wilderness, those sentient beings who had been saved felt excited. Some of the subordinates of the black-robed palace master felt uneasy. But all of a sudden, a terrifying darkness descended. This darkness swept across everything, wiping out all those sentient beings. Xue Ying was also forced backwards from the force. He spat out fresh blood before stopping in midair.
“This is quite a huge disturbance, eh?” That frivolous voice was still echoing by his ears.
Xue Ying stared afar.
A figure appeared in midair. He was none other than a handsome young man who wore a golden robe and had a crown on his head, ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’. He looked at Xue Ying with a bizarre look: “How does it feel for the billions of sentient beings to be wiped out after being saved by you?”
Xue Ying turned ashen gray.
He was of course indignant!
So many innocent sentient beings were wiped out just like that.
“Hahaha…” Undying Underworld Emperor accompanied with a casual laugh, “I already said before. As long as you dare to leave the Flying Snow City, I’ll wipe you out every time I discover you! And those ants you want to save? I’ll simply wipe them out as well. Haha, if you do not do anything, some of them might still be able to survive. But if you do, none would be alive.”
“This time, it is my carelessness. I’ll definitely bring everyone with me back to the Flying Snow City next time.” Xue Ying coldly stated.
“Haha, bring them back to Flying Snow City? Very simple, I’ll simply cause more scenes of massacres.” Undying Underworld Emperor laughed.
“You should be careful, Yuan might act and kill you once you kill too many.” Xue Ying coldly answered.
“Haha, rest assured. I’ll not do it personally. I’ll let my subordinates act.” Undying Underworld Emperor grinned.
“Then I’ll kill all your subordinates!” Xue Ying said.
“Oh? Rest assure, I specialize in inciting wars and massacres.” Undying Underworld Emperor looked at Xue Ying, “By then when you see batches of sentient beings dying, would you feel your heart aching? And frustrated?”
He did not care about those who treated the weaker ones as ants.
He did not care about those who were extremely selfish either.
Undying Underworld Emperor was doing these primarily to target Xue Ying’s personality. After all, Undying Underworld Emperor was still filled with fury! His losses the previous time during the sacrificial ritual were too big.
“When I was weak, even though there were Blood Sacrifices and massacres in the Realm Heart Great Land, I treated them nonchalantly.” Xue Ying said, “I will definitely do all I can to save the innocent. But for those I couldn’t save? I had no choice either. I’ve done my best and have no regrets.”
Saying that, Xue Ying turned around and left.
“Planning to leave?”
Undying Underworld Emperor immediately sent a palm over. It was filled with endless darkness.
Xue Ying simply sneered before taking the initiative to dissipate this avatar of his. He had many avatars, and it was a simple matter for him to refine another out. He did not care about the loss of an avatar.
…
Undying Underworld Emperor did not lie.
He had inciting many confusion and disputes, leading to some huge massacres. Even though he did not act personally, he had been the one fanning the fire behind the scenes.
Fortunately, those who had some background and strength knew how intimidating ‘Great Paragon Flying Snow’ was! None of them dared to carry out large-scale massacres.
“Damn.”
“Madman.”
“It seems this Undying Underworld Emperor hates me a lot.” Xue Ying felt increasingly frustrated in the Flying Snow City.
“Sou.”
A figure appeared.
“Swordmaster.” Xue Ying looked upwards. Swordmaster descended from midair before landing before Xue Ying. He began picking up the Xue Ying’s flask of wine with great familiarity and started pouring wine for himself. After drinking a cup, he smiled: “Undying Underworld Emperor has incited some conflicts. He even caused some large-scale massacres to happen. Those are done against you right?”
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded and said with a cold voice, “This Undying Underworld Emperor is doing these things to vent his anger.”
“That is because he feels his losses are too great. Furthermore, it was a humiliation to him to lose everything in your hands.” Swordmaster answered, “If you are sufficiently strong and could threaten him, he might be more careful.”
Xue Ying nodded.
The moment he left Flying Snow City, he would be stepped on by Undying Underworld Emperor completely!
That explained the wilful behavior of the other party!
“And Xue Ying, even though there is still a period before our hometown enters Great Apocalypse.” Swordmaster said, “It is better for you to reach the final realm as soon as possible! Even though I have reached the final realm, I do not know how to execute the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique. You have to reach the final realm before bringing others away with it.”
“Mn.” Xue YIng nodded. He had never relaxed before in his cultivation.
“Instead of cultivating here and getting stuck at a bottleneck, I think it is more suitable for you to go out and experience some life and death battles.” Swordmaster said, “I plan on going to the Broken Teeth Mountain Range. Come with me. There is also Insect Ancestor, he can come with us if he is willing.”
“Broken Teeth Mountain Range?” Xue Ying’s eyes brightened.
The Broken Teeth Mountain Range was indeed dangerous. Some unparalleled existences could fall within.
But since he had many avatars, Xue Ying was not afraid of falling there.
“Mn, I have just broken through to the final realm and plans on having a look there. Furthermore, I have a destination in mind.” Swordmaster laughed, “Summer Wind Ancient Nation has a deeper understanding of the Broken Teeth Mountain Range than the Southern Cloud Nation.”
“You have a destination?” Xue Ying nodded, “Alright. I am definitely willing to come with you. As for Ba Tuo Chen, let me ask him first.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1203 - The Two Great Clans in Broken Teeth Mountain Range
chapters.content:
Chapter 1203: The Two Great Clans in Broken Teeth Mountain Range
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Very soon.
Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen rushed over to Flying Snow City. The three of them sat down. Xue Ying naturally arranged the best food and wine for the guests.
“Go! I’ll naturally go!” The eyes of Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen were usually filled with coldness distinctive of insects, albeit currently, they were burning with excitement, “I’d the intention to pay a visit to the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, just that my strength is currently too weak. If Big Brother Flying Snow and Brother Bewitching Sword are planning on going, it’ll be something I cannot miss.”
Xue Ying replied: “Ba Tuo Chen, both I and Bewitching Sword have avatars. It is fine even if we met some setbacks in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range. What about you?”
Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen’s body abruptly dissipated, turning into many insects. Following that, they condensed back to his figure. He chuckled: “In terms of strength, I am much weaker than the two of you. But in terms of survivability, even if this true body of mine is extinguished, I can similarly revive just that I need to spend more time! In reality, I am no longer your ordinary kind of cultivator. Instead, I should be considered a final realm insect! Devouring Realm Great Emperor was not willing to fuse his body with an insect in the past because he did not wish to be restricted by it. Nonetheless, he lost his life in the end. If he had turned himself into a final realm insect, he would not have died that easily.”
“Final realm insect?” Xue Ying and Swordmaster nodded slightly after hearing that.
Insects had to be bred. And one would not be as careful as cultivating when breeding insects.
Most breeding methods were crazy.
For instance, one would breed the strongest insect by placing millions and millions of weaker insects together before allowing them to fight and devour each other. This was considered one of the more inferior filtering methods.
Another method would be to feed insects various bizarre materials like those found in Broken Teeth Mountain Range! ‘Devouring Realm Great Emperor’, even though he had formed a new Dao path during the process of breeding insects, but this Dao was still incredibly harsh on the ‘insects’. Similarly, the insects that were bred were also incredibly powerful.
Insects at the same final realm as ordinary cultivators would fly much faster! Their bodies were more terrifyingly strong! A droplet of blood could possibly be a highly toxic poison!
Devouring Realm Great Emperor once researched a fusion method to produce ‘final realm insects’. But every final realm insects had a harsher requirement on the soul of the cultivator! Ba Tuo Chen was extremely fortunate to fuse with the final realm insect successfully.
“Alright.” Xue Ying nodded, “It is good that Ba Tuo Chen is confident of surviving. We are prepared to lose our avatars during our journey there this time.”
“Mn.” Swordmaster nodded, “I believe that the two of you do not have a good understanding of the Broken Teeth Mountain Range. I’ll pass both of you a set of information.”
Information on the Broken Teeth Mountain Range was precious.
Even though Xue Ying had a relationship with ‘Southern Cloud King’ which gave him some understanding of the place, ultimately, Southern Cloud King was too weak and his compendium of information on the place could never compare with that from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. Furthermore, Ba Tuo Chen had received the inheritance of Devouring Realm Great Emperor. He should have some understanding of the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, placing him more knowledgeable than Xue Ying in this aspect!
“The Summer Wind Ancient Nation is indeed amazing. Their understanding of the Broken Teeth Mountain Range far surpasses that of Devouring Realm Great Emperor’s.” Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen checked through before revealing a joyous look, “Many thanks, Brother Bewitching Sword.”
“Since we are going together, it is definitely better for me to share relevant intelligence on the place with the two of you. But that is on the premise that the two of you do not share it with others.” Swordmaster chuckled. His current status was extremely high in the Summer Wind Ancient Nation. This set of information did not mean much. In reality, it was 90% of what the Summer Wind Ancient Nation had on Broken Teeth Mountain Range. The remaining ‘10%’ was something Swordmaster could not share! Those were the core secrets the Summer Wind Ancient Nation found.
Nevertheless, this 90% intelligence far surpassed what other ancient nations like Towering Sky Ancient Nation and Moonflower Ancient Nation could gather.
After all, Emperor Summer had many avatars, enabling him to explore deeper into the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
“Oh, Broken Teeth Mountain Range…” Xue Ying felt his horizons expanding.
The Broken Teeth Mountain Range spanned over a huge area. It was approximately equivalent to three Summer Wind Ancient Nations added.
Even though it might look like a chain of mountains from the outside, in reality, one would enter a bizarre space when he stepped into the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
This bizarre space concealed many unique worlds, with each world containing some natives of the Broken Teeth Mountain Range!
Other than these concealed worlds, within the vast bizarre space, the most dazzling of them were the sky-floating islands! Those sky-floating islands contained chains of mountains connected.
Each sky-floating island occupied a huge area, and danger was omni-present on almost every island. The bigger the sky-floating island, the more dangerous it was.
“The Natives! Death Disaster Clan! Lower-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.” Xue Ying pondered.
Within the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, the Natives stayed in the many concealed worlds. With all the worlds added together… they formed a superpower-the Natives! The Natives of Broken Teeth Mountain Range were extremely powerful.
As for the Death Disaster Clan and lower-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, almost all of them lived in the sky-floating islands.
Of course, the natural environment of sky-floating islands were filled with dangers. But there were opportunities amidst dangers too.
“Hearsay the Natives of Broken Teeth Mountain Range have a strand of diluted bloodline from Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.” Swordmaster said, “Hence, it is comparatively harder for them to reproduce. But every one of them have powerful bodies. Infants that are born would be at the Void God Realm. And every sovereign of a world is practically at the unparalleled level! Of which there are some world sovereigns who are exceptionally powerful, that they are much stronger than even Undying Underworld Emperor! Fortunately, Yuan left behind some prohibition within the Broken Teeth Mountain Range that prevents powerful natives from leaving.”
Xue Ying and Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen nodded.
Almost all of those bizarre communities contained the bloodlines of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms?
“Extreme Night Primogenitor and Realm Beast King once entered some worlds in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range to devour the Natives. As a result, the Natives of those worlds are filled with hatred and enmity towards cultivators from our Realm Heart Great Land! At least they are vigilant against us, and almost none of them would treat us amicably.” Swordmaster said.
“Those two madmen.” Xue Ying understood what Extreme Night Primogenitor and Realm Beast King did from the information provided by Swordmaster.
Realm Beast King loved devouring.
And Extreme Night Primogenitor was interested in the Chaotic Origin bloodline of the Natives. Hence, he was also like eat, eat and eat!
As a result! They created a huge enemy out of the Natives! Other cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land would be greatly inconvenienced when visiting them.
“The Death Disaster Clan and the lower-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms are almost all living in the sky-floating islands. And the sky-floating islands are where we go to search for treasures and opportunities!” Swordmaster said, “There are very few lower-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms there, so it is quite hard for us to meet them! Instead, the Death Disaster Clan is huge and they are one of the two Great Clans in Broken Teeth Mountain Range, along with the Natives being the other.”
The fact that Broken Teeth Mountain Range lived lower-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms was kept a secret.
But from what he understood.
The reason they were termed ‘lower-graded’ Chaotic Origin Lifeforms is because their power was limited. Firstly, their usage of energy was crude. Secondly, unparalleled existences could easily survive before them. Yuan was too lazy to care about these lowest-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, which was why he let them live within the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
On the contrary, the Death Disaster Clan and Natives had a huge number, and the apex experts within each clan were the true terrifying ones! Unparalleled existences could die before them.
“The Natives are very similar to us cultivators. Previously, that Starlight World Master came to lend you a helping hand.” Swordmaster said, “Even though they might be vigilant against us, we could still have some dealings with them! But the Death Disaster Clan has a much lower intelligence. In their opinions, they classify cultivators as either those that can be eaten and those that can’t. It is impossible to reason with them. Since we are directly visiting the sky-floating islands, our opponents this time are primarily from the Death Disaster Clan! And we will definitely meet them.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying and Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen slightly nodded.
“The sky-floating island I plan on going this time have seen two batches of Cosmos Gods from my Cang Clan dying there. Hence, this time I plan on going to find out what is happening!” Swordmaster said, “I’ve done my preparations and can set off at any time.”
Those with avatars like Southern Cloud King were usually willing to venture into the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
They would merely lose their avatars! And if they were fortunate, they could reap a huge harvest!
“Haha, I have many avatars and can leave any time.” Xue Ying laughed.
“I am by myself and can also leave any time.” Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen added.
“Alright, after finishing the wine, we’ll set off today!” Swordmaster was filled with excitement. This was his first time visiting the Broken Teeth Mountain Range after breaking through to the final realm. He currently could be considered an unparalleled. Such power was qualified to probe the Broken Teeth Mountain Range well enough. Dangers where unparalleled existences could not evade and would die… even though they were not few in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, the Broken Teeth Mountain Range was ultimately vast and it would not be as easy to meet such frightening dangers.
Xue Ying did not even care about such matters! He had too many avatars and he planned on going there to temper himself! Everything was done to catalyse his breakthrough so that he could step into the final realm as soon as possible!

chapters.title: Chapter 1204 - Infiltration
chapters.content:
Chapter 1204: Infiltration
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Sou!”
A male with a divine sword on his back, a black-robed humanoid insect, and a white-robed young man appeared above Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
“The mountain range continues unabated.” The three of them looked downwards. They could feel the distortion of the mountain space beneath them.
“Let’s go down.”
The three of them flew at the same time. As they got closer, they could feel the space becoming distorted.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying and Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen revealed looks of curiosity. They felt themselves entering another world! That was due to a change in the ‘Supreme Law’! The original Supreme Law which existed across every single spot in the Realm Heart Great Land was no longer present deep in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range. Instead, it was another type of Supreme Law.
“Strange.”
As the three of them entered the inner space of Broken Teeth Mountain Range, those mountains they saw outside abruptly transformed into sky-floating islands!
It was vast.
The sky-floating islands floated and occupied the entire world.
“Only the sky-floating islands within the Broken Teeth Mountain Range World contain dangers! As for the hidden worlds or the endless space we are at now, they are per se, free of danger.” Swordmaster laughed, “This sky-floating island has the code ‘Yin 3975’.”
With an accurate reference.
Swordmaster, Xue Ying, and Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen immediately teleported and advanced forward.
Even though they remained careful, they were able to reach their destination after teleporting for a dozen times.
“Yin 5299.” The three of them stood in the void watching an enormous sky-floating island before them, “We are here.”
The current sky-floating island before them spanned across more than 150 billion kilometers. It was a comparatively smaller sky-floating island within the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
“The two of you haven’t visited the Broken Teeth Mountain Range before. Let me remind you guys again. All dangers of the Broken Teeth Mountain Range exist within these sky-floating islands.” Swordmaster reminded solemnly, “In a while when we enter, we should do things according to what we discussed.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying and Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen did not dare to be too careless.
The three of them exchanged glances. One could see the excitement in their eyes.
“Sou sou sou!”
They immediately flew towards the sky-floating island.
One could see a continuous chain of mountains on the sky-floating island. If one observed this from the outer world, this chain of mountains would seem to connect with other mountain ranges endlessly! But after entering the ‘Broken Teeth Mountain Range world’, it turned out to be a different bizarre scene.
“What a strange aura.” As they flew closer, Xue Ying’s expression changed. The entire sky-floating island was giving off an incredibly cold yin aura. This aura made him feel uncomfortable.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying could feel the connection with his avatars in the outer world being affected, “I can no longer use my Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique?”
Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique was a heaven-defying traveling technique!
According to the intelligence reports, it was possible to travel using the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique directly within the numerous hidden worlds the Natives lived in, or within the vast void in Broken Teeth Mountain Range! It was also possible to teleport to the across a large distance without relying on ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ before easily entering the Realm Heart Great Land.
Nonetheless, the sky-floating islands contained a mysterious energy that prevented anybody from executing the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique!
“Hmph.” With a thought, Xue Ying began expanding his void domain, yet he felt a cold yin energy blocking him. Relying on the ‘Void Fire Lotus Flower’ which he brought, he could barely expand his domain to cover a region of half a million kilometers! That cold yin energy seemed grand and boundless. Furthermore, the suppression from this energy had actually condensed into ripples where the naked eyes could see.
“How is it?” Swordmaster and Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen both looked at Xue Ying.
“My domain has indeed suffer from an intense restriction-I can only maintain it at half a million kilometers.” Xue Ying transmitted back. And with another thought, he began releasing his illusory realm.
The illusory realm was called down using his soul energy.
“Yi?” Xue Ying revealed a look of shock.
The illusory realm clearly suffered from weaker restrictions. But because the presence of the cold yin energy confined the illusory realm to a region spanning 900 million kilometers. Xue Ying did not pour in all his strength in using some Desire or Bewilderment technique. After all, he was merely doing this to scout the region around them. It would be fine to expand the coverage of the illusory realm!
“The sky-floating island contains many suppression laws.” Swordmaster transmitted, “We can’t teleport here, but those from the ‘Death Disaster Clan’ could. Hence, we are unfortunately at a disadvantaged here.”
“My illusory realm suffers from a weaker restriction. I can maintain it at a region spanning 900 million kilometers.” Xue Ying transmitted back.
“Oh?” Swordmaster and Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen revealed joyous looks.
That was quite a huge region.
“I’ll scout the place around us.” Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen added. Waving his hand, a dozen insects began flying out in all directions.
…
Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen sent his insects out to scout. As for Xue Ying, he released his illusory realm as a measure of safety. Naturally, he avoided Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen and Swordmaster. As for ‘Swordmaster’, he was the strongest combative force in this three-man team! No matter Xue Ying or Swordmaster, they had to bring their secret treasures in. But they were merely ‘top-graded secret treasure’. Even if they died in battle, they could still afford the loss!
Regardless of the risks, they had to bring some secret treasures along since that would increase their chances of securing miraculous encounters.
“I’ve found the path.” Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen led the way. After all, the Cang Clan had sent Cosmos Gods here before.
“Hu hu hu~” In the distance, they saw a lump of white fog floating.
The expressions on Xue Ying, Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen, and Swordmaster changed slightly.
According to the report provided by the Cosmos God from Cang Clan that lost his avatar here, this ‘spherical white fog’ here in the sky-floating island contained an extremely frightening corrosive power. Cosmos Gods would instantly die when they touch it! Even secret treasures would shatter and turn into ashes! One could see what the outcome would be even if a final realm Cosmos God touches it.
It was absolutely one of the most dangerous points of this sky-floating island! Naturally, it was fine as long as they avoided the fog.
They progressed forward.
Because they could only fly slowly, they had merely traveled for five billion kilometers. Along the way, they saw several ‘ambient dangers’.
Xue Ying felt that those ambient dangers should not be created by ‘Yuan’ deliberately. After all, the efficiency of the trials would be limited then! They could possibly be some danger grounds teleported by ‘Yuan’ from some other locations.
“Mn?” Xue Ying suddenly turned over.
“Why?” Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen and Swordmaster were startled.
“Those of the Death Disaster Clan.” Xue Ying lowly muttered.
His illusory realm discovered a black mutated beast-like Death Disaster clansman. That Death Disaster clansman should be watching them from afar. Just as he entered the region of Xue Ying’s ‘illusory realm’, he immediately retreated in alarm.
“The Death Disaster clansmen have started appearing.” Swordmaster transmitted, “Since we found the first, I believe that the first assault will begin not too long later.”
As he said, Swordmaster had unsheathed the god sword behind his back.
Swordmaster went on alert with the sword in his hand; he calmly surveyed his surroundings in preparation for any attacks.
As for Insect Ancestor, he squinted his eyes. Even though he sent out some insects, he did not discover anyone from the Death Disaster Clan.
…
The three of them proceeded ahead.
Xue Ying would occasionally discover the presence of those from the Death Disaster Clan. It was easy to discern them since their bodies were filled with a vicious aura of death! And those Xue Ying discovered from the Death Disaster Clan were almost all black-skinned.
“I feel that they are preying on us, observing us.” Xue Ying transmitted, “I’ve already discovered six different Death Disaster clansmen, and five of them are in the shape of a beast, with one being humanoid. The humanoid clansman wears a robe.”
“Mn?” Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen abruptly turned to one direction with a look of astonishment.
“What happened?” Swordmaster and Xue Ying were puzzled.
“Who!”
A furious roar sounded. A figure appeared in the sky looking out in all directions. His pair of eyes were burning with an exotic flame. With a glance, he easily discovered the three of them that were hiding amidst the trees.
“Sou!”
That figure rapidly covered through the distance of more than 50 million kilometers before reaching where Xue Ying and the others were. This was a male with short red hair. A biting cold killing aura could be felt coming off him. He looked down at Xue Ying and the others, and his eyes were filled with a strand of vigilance. He growled: “Cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land?”
“The Natives?” Xue Ying and Swordmaster naturally recognized him.
“Big Brother Flying Snow, Brother Bewitching Sword, there are a total of 16 Natives at a camp not too far away from us.” Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen transmitted, “They are extremely careful. The subordinates of mine have just discovered them before they were all killed.”
“They should be native warriors sent over to the sky-floating island for experiential training.” Xue Ying made his guesses.
Swordmaster merely laughed: “The few of you are here to temper yourself in the sky-floating island? We are also here on an expedition.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1205 - Working Together
chapters.content:
Chapter 1205: Working Together
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The male with short red hair had a powerful aura. He stood in midair looking down at Xue Ying and the others. Within the three, the aura from the huge humanoid insect, Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen, was the strangest. It was typical of a final realm insect-vicious and overbearing, and should not be trifled with! Swordmaster who had pushed the Dao of Destruction to the final realm gave off a sharp aura. Instead, it was Xue Ying who did not disguise his aura that seemed clearly the weakest.
“Your Majesty, judging from the aura, two out of the three cultivators seem to be at the final realm.” The male with red short hair transmitted back, “How should I handle it?”
“There are two seemingly final realm cultivators?”
“Are there any unparalleled existences from the Realm Heart Great Land?”
At that moment, a few transmissions came one after another.
“The most famous few unparalleled existences from Realm Heart Great Land are not amongst them.” The male with red short hair transmitted back.
“Our intelligence is very out-dated. Who knows if there might be new final realm experts in the Realm Heart Great Land, or who might have gotten a supreme-graded secret treasure! In my opinion, we can ally with these three cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land and turn them into our support!”
“It is still better to be careful! Some cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land are very vicious, especially that Realm Beast King and Extreme Night Primogenitor whom apparently devoured countless souls!”
“We have already degenerated until this stage. If we were to continue on this way, our Blood Flame Clan’ might just face extinction! This time, we have to get the ‘Night Fruit’ and allow His Majesty to reach the next stage in strength. Only when His Majesty reaches the next level could we snatch our world back. Only then could our Blood Flame Clan continue surviving! The Night Fruit contains miraculous effects to us, but it is not useful to the cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land. Hence, they would not compete for it with us.”
“Alright! Let us befriend them and turn them into our assistance, Ying Yi, go and make contact with them.”
“Yes, Your Majesty.”
Very soon, they made their decision.
Saying it was slow, but in reality, the exchange of transmissions happened quickly.
A figure arced through the sky. This was a beautiful silver-haired girl wearing a silver armor. Her armor contained a red design.
“They are cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land and aren’t our enemies. There is no need for Big Brother to be anxious.” The silver-haired girl exchanged a few words with the red-haired male before descending down. She landed at a position relatively close to Xue Ying and others. The silver-haired girl giggled, “I am called Ying Yi. This time, our team is entering the sky-floating island in search of treasures. The sky-floating island is filled with dangers especially so with the Death Disaster Clan. If we were to work together in dealing against the Death Disaster Clan, it is definitely possible for us to venture deeper into the sky-floating island, increasing the possibility of attaining better treasures. What does the three of you think?”
Xue Ying, Swordmaster, and Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen exchanged glances. They began their discussion.
Within the Broken Teeth Mountain Range World.
The Death Disaster Clan and natives were the two great clans. Even though they were huge, the natives were very similar to the cultivators in the outer world-they had high intelligence. Even though they were vigilant against existences in the outer world, it was possible for them to work together! The biggest difference the natives had with cultivators in the outer world… was that their bodies contained a strand of bloodline from Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
“Alright. I believe that your understanding of the sky-floating island is definitely beyond ours. It is a good thing for us to work together.” Swordmaster took the initiative to speak.
“Our Majesty is not too far away from here. Please.” The silver-haired girl smiled before guiding them over.
…
Very soon.
The two parties converged. Even though Xue Ying was prepared to come here and refine himself, what the Broken Teeth Mountain Range lacked the least were dangers! It was definitely a good thing that they could work together with the natives. In reality, some natives were quite xenophobic against cultivators in the Realm Heart Great Land.
Both parties met before briefly exchanging a few words.
Xue Ying and the others understood that the leader of this team was called ‘Blood Flame Ji’. Others also called him His Majesty!
“The Death Disaster Clan has their own territory across the place.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji was a relatively handsome tall and big young man who was currently wearing a green robe. He introduced with a smile, “The moment we invade their territories, we will suffer from their attack. Of course, if we are powerful enough, there is no need to fear them. Our objective is to continue venturing deeper towards the core of the sky-floating island. If you guys feel that it is too dangerous, you guys can leave any time.”
“Since we came here, we aren’t afraid of dangers. At the most, we would just lose a fleshy body.” Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen said with a hoarse voice.
“Good.”
His Majesty Blood Flame Ji immediately applauded at that moment. His subordinates looked at Xue Ying and the other two with a much more amicable look.
“It is definitely delightful to hear that. We envy cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land for you guys are able to have many avatars, giving you the courage to charge forward despite the danger.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji sighed.
“There are very few in our Realm Heart Great Land who owns avatars.” Xue Ying stated.
“But it is much better than us. We want to refine avatars but it is impossible.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji felt complex. If only they had avatars, they would not have degenerate until this stage.
Swordmaster said: “Can we leave now?”
“Let’s go. Shall we lead the way?” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji said.
“Can.”
Swordmaster, Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen, and Xue Ying did not reject.
Both parties moved together. The team of His Majesty Blood Flame Ji-16 of them-moved in front and led the way. Xue Ying and the other two followed behind. Both parties were moving cautiously; they were primarily on a look out for the Death Disaster Clan.
In the blink of an eye, two hours had passed.
Xue Ying remained the ‘illusory realm’ while evading the 16 natives so as to prevent any misunderstandings and conflicts from happening. During these two hours or so, Xue Ying discovered that there were many more Death Disaster clansmen watching them from the sides.
“The three of you should be careful. We have fought with the Death Disaster clansmen before, and they know we shouldn’t be trifled with! But the three of you are newcomers… hence, any new wave of attacks could possibly be done against you all.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji turned around and reminded Xue Ying and the others.
“Many thanks, Your Majesty. We will definitely be careful.” Swordmaster acknowledged with a smile.
Just as he finished speaking-
Six figures suddenly emerged from underground. They directly went on to attack Xue Ying, Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen, and Swordmaster.
It came too suddenly! When the illusory realm sensed the attacks, the Death Disaster clansmen had arrived.
“Scram!”
Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen abruptly roared out. His mouth enlarged strangely. With a roar, a bizarre ripple spread out and caused the six incoming figures to tremble. Furthermore, the black gown on Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen’s body separated, turning into many insects that struck against the six figures.
Every figure suffered from the attacks of many insects. Each of those figures were black-skinned beasts that gave off a dark aura of death.
Final realm insects had many strange and unpredictable methods. Ever since Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen traded with Undying Underworld Emperor, his strength had increased tremendously.
“Hua~ Hua~ Hua~”
The six figures understood that things were amiss. They immediately transformed into black fog and dissipate amidst the void.
“The robe could transform into so many insects? And just by relying on those insects, he is able to force the six Death Disaster clansmen away?” The 16 natives were startled. The methods of Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen seemed very different from the ordinary techniques cultivators had. This gave them a new understanding of the slightly ugly-looking ‘Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen’-that he should not be belittled.
This was not someone to be trifled with!
‘In the past, Ba Tuo Chen was able to resist against the attack of Undying Underworld Emperor with his gown.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘That gown seems perfectly undamaged. Is it a secret treasure that is formed from many insects?’
After all, he was the first ‘final realm insect’ fusion existence in the history of Realm Heart Great Land. Even Xue Ying and Swordmaster understood little about Ba Tuo Chen.
“Haha, Insect Ancestor’s strength is extraordinary.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji chuckled, “But this is merely a probe to determine your strength. The Death Disaster Clan is sending those who are weaker. The true experts haven’t moved yet.”
Following that, the team continued forward.
They traveled across the vast sky-floating island. Of course, the natives understood the ambient dangers of this island more than Xue Ying and the rest; they easily evaded those dangers.
“Hahaha…”
An ugly face formed from a lump of black fog appeared before them. It looked at this team while letting out a ear-piercing laughter. His laughter seemed to pound against the soul directly. That laughter was filled with malice and killing intent!
“It is here.”
Xue Ying, Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen, and Swordmaster felt a tremendous threat coming off from the black face hanging in midair.
“Hua hua hua hua hua hua…”
Within an instance, a dozen figures emerged from the ground. More than 80% of them headed towards the 16 natives, with just five remaining ones-three humanoid Death Disaster clansmen and two beast-like Death Disaster clansmen attacking Xue Ying and the other two.

chapters.title: Chapter 1206 - The weakest in the Team
chapters.content:
Chapter 1206: The weakest in the Team
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
That enormous black face formed from black fog charged towards that Majesty Blood Flame Ji whose temper had always been good.
“Hong!” At that moment, a fiery-red flame blasted out from the body of His Majesty Blood Flame Ji. His aura abruptly grew and expanded. He punched out with his fist, causing the void in front to burn and distort. That black fog face then turned into a girl in black gown. She resisted against the fiery force, killing her way to His Majesty Blood Flame Ji before sending her claw out.
The hands of this black-gowned girl expanded. They were like as sharp as blade.
At the same time, 20 over Death Disaster clansmen worked together to attack the natives. Those natives naturally separated into groups of three, with each group forming a combat formation. They welcomed the incoming assault.
…
Xue Ying was the one with the easiest time. He was not in a rush to act. Instead, he was casually watching the situation of the ongoing battle.
“This native majesty seems to be comparable to unparalleled existences in terms of power. Nonetheless, his techniques are cruder and can’t compare with the cultivators.” Xue Ying made his judgment. The other party was powerful, yet he lacked in his usage of laws and profound mysteries. He should be around 20% to 30% of Eternal Night Primogenitor’s strength.
And the other 15 subordinates of his were not weak either.
Especially after they entered a combat formation, with the weakest formation having the strength at the final realm, and the strongest quite similar to the standard of that majesty.
“No wonder they dared to venture into the sky-floating island. This team is quite powerful. But, Swordmaster should be able to suppress all of them by himself.” Xue Ying thought.
On their side, five Death Disaster clansmen came.
Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen’s black gown turned into numerous insects once again. Those insects engulfed some of the incoming Death Disaster clansmen, albeit things were different this time. The leading Death Disaster clansman was an ugly old man wearing black robe. His figure distorted and transformed into an enormous black head. Opening his mouth, he easily devoured the incoming insects.
Those insects continued struggling.
After that enormous mouth shut close, one could see its head distorting still. It appeared that head was trying to trap those insects.
“Mn?” The eyes of Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen flashed with a murderous light. Flapping his wings, he charged forward.
“Sou sou sou sou…”
The other four figures went ahead at Swordmaster and Xue Ying.
“”Hmph.”
Swordmaster lightly shook his head. He could see that the strongest Death Disaster clansman was the one fighting with Blood Flame Ji. Even though the five enemies circling him this time were quite powerful, they were not enough against Swordmaster.
“Chi chi chi~” The sword lights were resplendent and beautiful. They were like rays of light in the sky, arcing through the Death Disaster clansmen.
Swordmaster’s sword light were gentle.
He seemed to be trying to grasp the strength of every Death Disaster clansman.
But of those Death Disaster clansmen whose bodies were cut by the sword light, some were terrified that they immediately transformed into fog before tunneling back underground. Some who were weaker could not escape and died.
In the blink of an eye, two of the four Death Disaster clansmen died, while the other two fled.
As for that enormous head who was trying to trap the insects, he saw this scene and was frightened so much that he could not hold on any further. He immediately took the initiative to dissipate that head into black fog before tunneling into the ground!
“Ah!”
“No, no-”
“Go and die!”
At the same time when Xue Ying’s side was having an easy time dealing with the Death Disaster clansmen, the natives were meeting the core assault by the Death Disaster clansmen. Under the joint attack by 20 over clansmen, two of the natives’ combat formations had already crumbled. Some of these six members who were part of the two fallen combat formations were heavily injured and killed, and some became crazy.
“Break.” The aura of one of the natives suddenly grew under madness. The strength he could exert was boosted significantly, reaching that of the final realm. His survivability skills also grew.
“Xiu!”
Swordmaster frowned when he saw this. Those two combat formations crumbled too quickly. He did not have the time to save them. Swordmaster immediately acted with the god sword in his hand.
The sword light arced through the sky, striking against those Death Disaster clansmen.
The striking power of Swordmaster’s attack seemed to be slightly weaker than what ‘His Majesty Blood Flame Ji’ could do, though it was more profound, allowing the final outcome to be way more terrifying. Cultivators had the advantage of having profound techniques, much less Swordmaster who had grasped a supreme secret impartation.
“Retreat.”
That black-robed girl who was battling against His Majesty Blood Flame Ji saw the current situation before letting out a sharp-piercing order.
“Hu hu hu~”
All the Death Disaster clansmen transformed into black fog before tunneling deep underground. They were currently escaping. In terms of fleeing ability, the outsiders could hardly compare against those lifeforms within the sky-floating islands, ‘Death Disaster clansmen’. The Death Disaster clansmen could easily teleport and tunnel through the ground here. As for Xue Ying and the others, they could not do so. Unless they were so powerful that they could kill the Death Disaster clansmen within a split second, otherwise, it would be hard to kill any of the Death Disaster clansmen.
“The Death Disaster Clan has retreated.”
“They have left.”
Those natives let out a sigh of relief, albeit the current atmosphere was slightly sorrowful.
Because they lost four comrades in that short instance.
“Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, many thanks for your help. Otherwise, our losses this time would be greater.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji walked over and thanked him. At the same time, his gaze towards Swordmaster had changed. His subordinates also looked at Swordmaster with slight respect. They were clearly more amiable to Xue Ying and the others.
Previously, they thought that there might not be any unparalleled existences amidst the two seemingly final realm existences.
That was merely a guess!
And now after the battle, it gave His Majesty Blood Flame Ji a new realization that the strength of ‘Paragon Master Bewitching Sword’ far exceeded the strongest expert in the Blood Flame World, ‘His Majesty Blood Flame Ji’. Paragon Master Bewitching Sword should most likely be comparable to unparalleled existences.
It would naturally be best that they befriended experts on this level! That way, they would have a higher chance of acquiring the Spiritual Yin Fruit.
‘Paragon Master Bewitching Sword’ was an unparalleled existence. That Insect Ancestor was also not someone to be trifled with. Instead, it was the white-robed young man Great Paragon Flying Snow whom they understood to be a level-two Cosmos God according to the terminology of Realm Heart Great Land, who should be the weakest in the team of three.
“Since we agreed to move together, we are allies. I’ll naturally act to help everyone. It is just that I might be a tad bit late.” Swordmaster said.
“Why are they taking the risk despite being insufficiently strong?” Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen frowned, “Their strength doesn’t seem to be of help to you, Your Majesty Blood Flame Ji, so why let them send themselves to death?”
“This isn’t sending themselves to death. This is a tempering exercise.”
“Even though we four of us died, Fei Yun Lin was able to succeed in awakening his bloodline, significantly boosting his strength.”
Those natives retorted.
Xue Ying and the other two felt suspicious when they heard that.
They were not that ignorant of natives. After years of exploration by the ‘Summer Wind Ancient Nation’, their understanding of the natives was relatively deep. The natives were scattered across many hidden worlds. Each world represented a clan! The reason why they could awaken their bloodline and become stronger was because of the Chaotic Origin Lifeform bloodline they heard according to legends.
And one of the ways of awakening the bloodline was through life and death tempering!
With the danger of possibly dying during the battles, they would have a higher chance of awakening their bloodlines which would boost their strength tremendously. But many more would fall during such tribulations.
Hence…
Usually, those who entered the sky-floating islands were of a certain standard.
For instance, it was fine if an entire team of powerful natives came since they could still ensure they survived. But for those who were weaker-three natives forming a combat formation could barely reach the final realm strength-it was too dangerous to venture into the sky-floating islands! Cultivators of Realm Heart Great Land had avatars and were not afraid of losing them. But there was no need for natives to do such things in most cases.
“We are here to temper ourselves in life and death battles.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji briefly spoke, “Since we chose to temper ourselves, we are naturally prepared to die. This time with Paragon Master Bewitching Sword helping out, our degree of safety is much higher. But we have to remind the few of you too! With your strength, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, you are making the Death Disaster Clan feel threatened. The weaker Death Disaster clansmen would not dare to come. But this is a sky-floating island. This is a place where the Death Disaster Clan dwells. The more powerful members would usually live in the core areas. Even though their intelligence is ordinary, they can inter-communicate.”
“They know our strength now. In the upcoming battles, things would be more dangerous. I don’t think your strength will be able to protect all of us forever, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword.” Blood Flame Ji said, “What we can do is to hurry deeper before they finishes exchanging information and proceed with another planned ambush.”
“Alright, Your Majesty, as the few of you understand this sky-floating island better, you guys lead the way.” Swordmaster said.
“We cannot tarry any further. Let us set off at this moment with a faster speed.” Blood Flame Ji brought the group flying ahead at high speed. Knowing the strength of Xue YIng’s group, they were not worried that they could not catch up.
Xue Ying and the other two remained following closely behind.
“Have you heard what His Majesty said? Bewitching Sword has revealed your strength, which means it is likely for the Death Disaster Clan to send experts who are more powerful the next time.” Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen transmitted.
“We have never thought of sweeping away the Death Disaster Clan. What we can do is to bring away the treasures prior to being pursued by the Death Disaster Clan.” Xue Ying transmitted back with a smile.
“Xue Ying, you are our killing trump card. Perhaps we might have to rely on you the next time.” Swordmaster transmitted.
“We’ll know in a while how good this killing trump card is.” Xue Ying replied.
“Brother Flying Snow, it seems this team of natives feel that you are the weakest! But they do not know that I am the weakest.” Insect Ancestor Ba Tuo Chen chuckled. They felt incredibly relaxed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1207 - Clans-Ground
chapters.content:
Chapter 1207: Clans-Ground
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying and the team of natives rushed to the core of this sky-floating island at the fastest speed. With the natives leading the way, things were incredibly smooth.
And on another side.
“Hua hua hua…”
A lump of black fog condensed. It turned into many Death Disaster Clansmen. Some of them were beasts and some were humans. The leading one was that black-robed girl.
“King, these invaders are very powerful.”
“We can’t defeat them just with us!”
They were all looking at that black-robed girl.
That black-robed girl examined her black claws and gave it a twirl. At the same time, her eyes were filled with coldness as she nonchalantly said: “The invaders have already surpassed the strength of our team. The few of you should retreat. Remember, evade them. Don’t send yourselves to death! Our losses this time is huge. I’ll report this news upwards and let the elders worry about it instead.”
“Yes, King.” All the subordinates replied respectfully with their heads looking downwards.
The black-robed girl then turned into a fog. In a flash, he disappeared.
These subordinates also transformed into black fog before tunneling underground.
The sky-floating island was the place of their birth. Over here, they held the initiative to fight or to retreat.
…
The core of this sky-floating island was a huge mountain that had practically been dug empty. Within the mountain was a palace dug. It was quite amazing for the Death Disaster clansmen to have constructed these palaces. Some of the weaker Death Disaster clansmen had intelligence similar to many wild animals, of which only the elite experts were more intelligent. Of course, those at the top and core members had the highest intelligence. But compared to cultivators and the natives, they were far too lacking.
An unseen ripple fluctuated.
At the next moment, a lump of black fog appeared before the fluctuating ripples. It transformed into a black-robed girl.
Amidst those ripples, a pitch black mutated beast face appeared. He stared at the black-robed girl.
“King Fu Suo, why have you returned to the clans ground?” That ugly-looking beast face muttered.
“I have an important matter to report to the Emperor! Hurry up and pass the word.” The black-robed girl shouted. She felt disdainful from speaking to these protectors.
“Report to the Emperor?” The face of that beast felt startled, “King Fu Suo, you really have something which you have to report to the Emperor?”
“Why would I lie about such matters?” The black-robed girl roared, “Don’t waste my time any longer. Hurry up and go.”
That beast-like face hesitated momentarily. Even though this group of Death Disaster clansmen who stayed in the clans ground held Death Disaster clansmen living outside in contempt, since this was an important matter which had to be reported to the Emperor, nobody would be that daring to lie about it.
“Hua.”
The unseen ripple immediately split apart to form a passage.
“Please go to the Elder Hall to wait.” An enormous beast with a fiery head and black body growled by the side.
“Hmph.” The black-robed girl was too lazy to give this protector a glance. She hurried over to the Elder Hall.
There was a huge mountain which occupied an immensely huge area. It was also the core area of the entire sky-floating island.
The black-robed girl did not randomly intrude the place. Instead, she came directly to the Elder Hall.
Elder Hall…
That was an enormous palace hall. This hall looked dimmed, and had three thrones within it. At the center of this simple hall, there was an enormous water pool filled with black liquid. A bizarre slanted tree could be seen growing in this pool. Currently, two fruits were hanging off that tree. The skin of the fruits were thin-one could easily see the sparkle of light within them.
This tree was about 33 meters tall. At the top of the tree, there was an exotic ‘grayish eye’.
The grayish eye was also emitting an incorporeal power.
“King Fu Suo, please wait here for a moment.” The two protectors outside the Elder Hall looked coldly at King Fu Suo.
King Fu Suo snorted before standing outside and waited.
GIven her temper, if not for the fact that the intruders were very powerful this time and she had to report upwards, she would be too lazy to pay the clans-ground a visit. The strength of the invaders had reached a stage that would cause the clan to enter high alert. If she did not report such matters upward and it was determined through investigations after the matter. She would be in deep trouble.
“King Fu Suo, what is it that requires you to report to the Emperor? Do you not know that the Emperor and the Elders are currently in deep sleep?” A tall and thin male walked over. He dragged a thin and long tail with him on the ground. The tall and thin male sneered, “You should know that the Emperor and Elders would definitely be furious if they were to be awakened from their sleep. If the matter isn’t that important, you might even be punished from it.”
“King Qi Du, I’ve discovered some invaders in my territory.” King Fu Suo coldly replied, “The invaders include a team of natives and three cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land. The commander of the natives aren’t any weaker than me! And one of the three cultivators from Realm Heart Great Land is stronger than me. He is at least at the peak of king level.”
“Oh?” The tall and thin male revealed a look of astonishment, “There are even intruders from the Realm Heart Great Land? And one at least at the peak of king level?”
It was rare for cultivators from Realm Heart Great Land to come.
Even though most Cosmos Gods with avatars in Realm Heart Great Land would pay the Broken Teeth Mountain Range a visit frequently to try their luck, the Broken Teeth Mountain Range was ultimately too big. This sky-floating island did not encounter many cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land. There had only been once when a ‘at least peak of king level’ cultivator came.
Most of the time, they encountered the natives!
“Now that you know the invaders are extraordinary, hurry up and report to the Emperor.” The black-robed girl said.
“No rush, no rush. Waking the Elders or Emperor are exceptional matters which I have to discuss with other kings first.” The tall and thin male said.
“Still planning to discuss?” The black-robed girl was slightly anxious, “By the time you finish discussing, the invaders would have reached.”
The tall and thin male merely sneered.
A ‘king’ who did not belong to the clans-ground wasn’t qualified to question how the clans-ground handle matters.
The clans-ground was the place that ruled the sky-floating island.
“Hmph.” The black-robed girl snorted after seeing what was happening, “I’ve already informed about what has happened. If any unforeseen circumstances happened, and the Emperor plans on putting the blame on someone, you can’t say it’s me.”
“Rest assured.” The tall and thin male answered. At the same time, he transmitted over and conversed with other kings.
After some trivial discussions.
After the time taken to brew a cup of tea.
“After our discussion, given that there is a peak king within the group of invaders, he could very well be at the unparalleled level in Realm Heart Great Land. It is fine if we wake Second Elder and Third Elder! We will temporarily not awaken the Grand Elder and Emperor.” The tall and thin male said.
“The enemy is still concealing some of his strength.” The black-robed girl said.
“Haha, don’t we still have us kings? Hmph hmph, we have been given birth amidst the death of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. As for those bereaved clans from the Chaotic Origin bloodline, their body contains the blood of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms too.” The tall and thin male sneered, “Compared to our two great clans, the cultivators are much weaker. Furthermore, we are in the sky-floating island. We hold the terrain advantage and this is sufficient in dealing against them.”
“The cultivators have to walk step by step from weak. Their usage of energy is incredibly profound. I think we should wake the Grand Elder at least.”
“The two elders are also at the peak king level. It wouldn’t be too late to wake the Grand Elder should the group of kings in our clans-ground fail to resist against the intruders.”
The tall and thin male chuckled, “Just wait here while I go awaken the two elders.”
At the same time when the tall and thin male walked out of the Elder Hall-
A figure hurried over.
“Quick quick quick, there are intruders! The intruders have already crossed the outer perimeter. They are traveling at an extremely fast speed and will soon be reaching the clans-ground.” A single-horned male wearing black robe roared as he rushed over. He was one of the kings currently responsible for guarding the outermost perimeter of the clans-ground, “There is also a cultivator from the Realm Heart Great Land who is very powerful. He is at the peak king level, similar to the elders.”
“What, so fast?” The tall and thin male was startled.
When the black-robed girl in the Elder Hall heard that, she shouted out: “King Qi Du, I’ve already informed you to be quick. See! They are already reaching the clans-ground now!”
The tall and thin male, King Qi Du, no longer spoke. He immediately transformed into black fog and went over to see the elders.
Deep under one of the mountains here.
There was an enormous lake of water. The water lake contained a liquid deep green in color. A huge black body lay within this liquid. Because it was too big, part of its body surfaced out from the liquid.
And around this lake, there were three smaller lakes.
Those three smaller lakes contained a body laying within.
“Second Elder, Third Elder.”
The tall and thin male, King Qi Du came and immediately transmitted the message over. Many ripples tunneled into the two figures sleeping within the smaller lakes.
Very soon.
Those two smaller lakes fluctuated as the bodies began opening their eyes.
“Hu, hu.”
The two figures transformed into black fog and disappeared. Following that, they appeared by the side of King Qi Du.
“King Qi Du, why did you wake us?” The two elders stared at King Qi Du.
King Qi Du slightly bowed, saying: “There are invaders. The invaders consist of a team of natives and three cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land. There is an expert in the three cultivators from Realm Heart Great Land who uses sword. His strength is determined to be at the peak king level. Cultivators usually have incredibly high realms, and the few of us are having a hard time surviving, much less resisting against them.”
…
And on another side.
Xue Ying’s group of cultivators and the team of natives had just defeated a team of Death Disaster clansmen that ambushed them. This team of Death Disaster clansmen should not be too clear of their strength. Given Swordmaster’s power, he easily killed five Death Disaster clansmen, forcing the remaining 20 over Death Disaster clansmen to escape in fear.
“Our speed is sufficiently fast. The Death Disaster Clan should not know much about us. Hurry! We are about to reach the core clans-ground of the Death Disaster Clan.” The natives were all incredibly excited. That Majesty Blood Flame Ji even transmitted a message to Xue Ying and the other two, “We will use our fastest speed to rush to the clans-ground. Just grab whatever treasures you see. After that, we’ll hurry away.”
“Understood.”
Xue Ying and the others looked forward to it. They were about to reach the core area, the clans-ground?

chapters.title: Chapter 1208 - Act!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1208: Act!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the simple and cold Elder Hall.
The two elders sat on the thrones. Following that, many figures flew in from outside and entered the hall. They were either humanoid or beast-like figures. As for the black-robed girl, ‘King Fu Suo’, she stood aside watching everything coldly.
“Everyone is here.” The humanoid black-scaled monster-like Third Elder looked below with his gray eyes.
“Elder.”
11 figures bowed respectfully in order. Even the black-robed girl King Fu Suo lowered her head slightly to show her respect.
Second Elder and Third Elder exchanged glances.
Third Elder even started: “This time, the invaders include those natives and cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land. King Qi Du is currently waiting at the clans-ground waiting for the orders of mine and Second Elder. The other 10 kings and King Fu Suo will be moving together with us. King Fu Suo, you are fine with it right?”
The black-robed girl King Fu Suo smiled and bowed: “This one is willing to work for the good of the clans-ground.”
“Mn.”
Third Elder nodded.
King Fu Suo ranked at the top amongst the group of ‘Kings’. In the past, she failed during the Elder Ranking Battle and was unwilling to be dispatched elsewhere. Hence, she chose to lead her subordinates away from the clans-ground.
Regardless, King Fu Suo was very powerful. The two elders were willing to use her.
“Within the invaders, there are three cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land. The one who uses sword is also an unparalleled existence. I and Second Elder will be dealing with him together!
