As for the remaining two cultivators, one should be at the final realm and the final one is a level-two Cosmos God who isn’t worth mentioning. King Fu Suo, you should deal against those two. And the other Kings… will work together and eliminate the natives as fast as possible before going over to help King Fu Suo!”
“Yes.”
Including King Fu Suo, the 11 ‘Kings’ acknowledged the order.
“Let’s not waste time. Let us kill the enemies outside our clans-ground! Go!” Third Elder and Second Elder stood at the same time.
All the Kings immediately parted to the side.
“Sou sou!”
The two elders immediately flew out of the palace hall. Following that, the other 11 Kings followed suit.
They transformed into black fog filled with an aura of death before disappearing from the clans-ground, leaving behind just King Qi Du guarding the place.
The Death Disaster clansmen could easily travel and teleport. Hence, they aren’t worried of the safety in the clans-ground because they could return anytime!
…
“Sou sou sou…”
The group of them were currently heading towards the clans-ground with their fastest speed.
Passing through the sky-floating island filled with dangers, the leader of the natives, His Majesty Blood Flame Ji were also informing the others about some of the more dangerous places.
“Hong.”
Suddenly, a terrifying aura descended.
13 figures appeared from the void. Regardless of Insect Ancestor’s scouting technique, Xue Ying’s illusory realm or the natives’ vigilance, they discovered the enemies only when the enemies appeared!
All of these 13 figures emitted a terrifying aura. Xue Ying and Insect Ancestor both felt an intense feeling of threat.
There were two figures leading the team.
One was a humanoid scaled-monster and the other was a hunchbacked old man surrounded with green fog. The two of them gave off a grand aura that was more tyrannical than what Xue Ying felt from Eternal Night Primogenitor.
And the 11 figures behind them were either humanoid in appearance or beast-like. Their auras were all grand and powerful, and the black-robed girl who attacked them previously was just one of the members.
“Be careful! They are the Second Elder and Third Elder from the clans-ground, accompanied with 11 Kings!” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji’s expression changed greatly. He alerted the others.
“Second Elder and Third Elder?”
Xue Ying, Insect Ancestor, and Swordmaster felt their hearts tightening.
Because the natives had been sincerely working with them, and had informed them about the most terrifying ‘Emperor’ and the three elders underneath him in this sky-floating island! The Grand Elder was the strongest, with the Second and Third Elder being secondary. The remaining few were all ‘Kings’.
“Brother Bewitching Sword, Big Brother Flying Snow, other than the Emperor and Grand Elder, almost all the apex Death Disaster experts of this sky-floating island have left their territory.” Insect Ancestor transmitted, “Even though we are fast-and we have been moving with the natives towards the clans-ground at the fastest speed, and that we have never been delayed because of the ambient dangers, we were still intercepted. We haven’t gotten any treasures yet from the sky-floating island.”
“The treasures of Broken Teeth Mountain Range aren’t that easy to get.” Xue Ying transmitted back.
“Let’s do it according to our original plan.” Swordmaster transmitted.
They had never thought that they could defeat the Death Disaster Clan directly.
It was impossible for them to resist entirely against the Death Disaster Clan! They could only do their best to survive, and take the risk to see if they could get any treasure. Most treasures were usually found at the core area of the sky-floating islands.
“Fortunately.”
Xue Ying celebrated inwardly.
The gap separated by a level was crazily huge. For instance, even though Xue Ying’s avatars were all at the final realm powered up using the Void Fire Lotus Flower, there was still a gap with unparalleled existences!
If that ‘Emperor’ came, just him alone would be more terrifying than the Second Elder, Third Elder and the 11 Kings combined.
…
In view of this, Blood Flame Ji waved his hand.
By his side, he immediately kept three comrades of his. At the same time, four appeared.
The newer people were clearly stronger.
“Since the two elders have come, if they could not push us back, the Great Elder would most likely come next! This time, we came with all the strength our Blood Flame Clan has. We must succeed.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji transmitted, “We are already all the remaining experts the Blood Flame Clan has. Once we acquired the ‘Spiritual Yin Fruit’, there might be hope of taking back our hometown. Otherwise, our clan would be just like many other clans that fell in the history of Broken Teeth Mountain Range.”
“Let us stake our lives. We have to acquire the Spiritual Yin Fruit.”
“Let’s do it.”
The eyes of these clansmen were ignited with fighting spirit.
Xue Ying, Insect Ancestor, and Swordmaster were slightly startled. This Majesty Blood Flame Ji actually kept the three weaker comrades and let out four stronger ones? Clearly, this Majesty Blood Flame Ji had brought along many other clansmen in his Eden Treasure! Judging from the aura of these people, they were clearly stronger and were approximately at the power of final realm experts.
This made them sigh. The natives of Broken Teeth Mountain Range were indeed powerful. They had so many Paragon Masters as well. But what they did not know was that this team consisted of the remaining few apex experts from one of the worlds.
…
Saying it was slow.
In reality, the moment the Death Disaster Clan appeared, the natives had already switched the people.
And the battle immediately erupted!
“Hou~” The figure of the Second Elder became illusory. He transformed into an incomparably huge green giant. This giant was so tall and big that its toe nail was bigger than the surrounding tree. Lowering his head, he let out a fierce roar, forming unseen ripples that engulfed Swordmaster.
As for Third Elder, he also roared before charging over. His entire body was covered in black scales. His tail, claws and other parts of his body were all like terrifying weapons.
Waving his hand, his arms were like a blade that cut through the void, forming a pitch-black light ray that shot towards Swordmaster.
“Hmph.”
Swordmaster stood in midair. He held onto his sword and slashed it.
The entire world started moving along with the sword. Even though the Third Elder and Second Elder seemed to be seemingly fiercer, they were still affected by the incoming attack by Swordmaster! They had no choice since their realms were too low! Even though they had great power, their utilization of techniques was too crude before Swordmaster who grasped a supreme secret impartation. Swordmaster was versatile after comprehending the supreme secret impartation.
This was one of the reasons why supreme secret impartations were so precious.
Like supreme-graded secret treasures, final realm experts could only rely on the profound mysteries inherent in them to augment their techniques. Without using any inherent techniques, they could not fully utilize the weapons!
But supreme secret impartations… were all about imparting ‘Daos’. It was more holistic. It could even allow the cultivator to interact with other Daos and absorb them. This would considerably increase the number of techniques they could use.
“Die.” The black-robed girl King Fu Suo was being incredibly tyrannical. With a claw, she forced Insect Ancestor back, causing his body to disperse as insects.
“Big Brother Flying Snow, this enemy is too powerful. I can’t resist her.” Insect Ancestor transmitted.
“Leave her to me.”
After coming to sky-floating island, this was the first time Xue Ying battled.
“Sou sou sou sou sou sou…”
An enormous Void Fire Lotus Flower appeared. Nine white-robed young men appeared above the lotus flower.
This startled the black-robed girl King Fu Suo. She sneered: “So what if you have many avatars? Just die for me!” Her claws abruptly became big. They were also covered with endless darkness as they were sent in the direction of Xue Ying.
“Break.”
The nine white-robed young man punched out at the same time.
Many illusions of fists appeared and converged into an enormous fist. This fist was filled with surging Chaotic Origin Energy. Following that with a boom-the fist smashed against the huge incoming claws.
That black-robed girl’s expression changed. She was forced to take a few steps back from the impact. At the same time, an unpredictable force entered into her body.
“The weakest of the three cultivators?” The black-robed girl King Fu Suo was filled with disbelief, “This, this is the weakest? This should be the second strongest invader this time! He is even harder to deal with than the leader of those natives!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1209 - The Killing Trump Card, Dong Bo Xue Ying
chapters.content:
Chapter 1209: The Killing Trump Card, Dong Bo Xue Ying
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Various parties were fighting on the battlefield. They were also paying notice to the overall situation.
The black-robed girl King Fu Suo could fight directly against His Majesty Blood Flame Ji without losing! She was someone who left the clans-ground only after failing to get promoted during the elder’s ranking match, and was unquestionably strong.
Being recognized as just a level-two Cosmos God-a cultivator with the least threat, he could actually fight on equal grounds with King Fu Suo? This startled everyone.
“Let us get closer to the clans-ground as we battle.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji was in great joy when he saw that. At the same time, he transmitted out to everyone.
“Good, let us head closer to the core area.” Swordmaster was still having a relatively easy time. Even though he could not defeat the two elders, he could still rely on his sword to handle the two frighteningly strong elders, preventing them from dealing against the rest.
“His strength?” The black-robed girl King Fu Suo furiously sent out techniques. Every move of hers was filled with an aura of death. They were extremely powerful too. But Xue Ying was having an easy time since the other party was merely strong, yet her techniques were too crude. Hence, Xue Ying still held the upper hand.
“Chaotic Origin Ocean!”
Xue Ying was also casting the Chaotic Origin Ocean simultaneously.
“Hong long long~”
At that moment, a fierce domain came pressing down on everyone. Accompanied by the ‘World Energy’ from the Void Fire Lotus Flower, this was the strongest technique the current Xue Ying could execute. It was fine if those two elders could resist it, but the other ‘Kings’ from the Death Disaster Clan felt a heavy restriction holding their bodies down now. Every movement they made were affected! Their strength had greatly diminished!
Even though the Chaotic Origin Ocean did not span over a huge region on the sky-floating island, it could still wrap around the entire battlefield.
It was easy for those from the Death Disaster Clan to escape out of the domain region, but they came this time to kill these invaders! Flee? How could they hold those intruders back then?
“How is he weak?” At this moment, including the elders, all the Kings were cursing inwardly.
This white-robed cultivator was making all of them feel uneasy.
It was much easier to deal with the techniques of the Majesty Blood Flame Ji from the natives. But the techniques from this white-robed young man were much more profound, and he could still handle against the black-robed girl King Fu Suo despite maintaining the domain.
“We can’t hold these natives back.”
“With this domain, we aren’t able to unleash our full strength.”
The 10 Kings who were attacking the natives felt anxious.
This team of natives were much stronger than illustrated in the intelligence report! ‘His Majesty Blood Flame Ji’ primarily did so to beguile the enemies and to temper his own clansmen. Now that the Death Disaster Clan had came out from their nest, His Majesty Blood Flame Ji naturally brought out the other four great experts hidden in his Eden Treasure. With those four great experts as cores, they formed four great combat formations.
And these four great combat formations with the Majesty Blood Flame Ji working together were much stronger than reported.
Even still, the natives were on the disadvantaged end. They could only survive and do their best to advance forward.
But now that the ‘Chaotic Origin Ocean’ came out, both parties were equalized!
The speed the natives could advance forward had greatly boosted!
“Awaken the Grand Elder!” The incomparably towering Second Elder directly transmitted.
“Awaken the Grand Elder.”
“Awaken the Grand Elder.”
Because they were quite close to the clans-ground, after two transmissions, the message had reached the ears of King Qi Du who remained back at the clans-ground.
King Qi Du did not dare to tarry. He immediately went to awaken the Grand Elder.
******
At a place where three smaller lakes surrounded a huge lake, in one of the smaller lakes, the Grand Elder was here sleeping.
“Grand Elder, Grand Elder.” King Qi Du called out anxiously. The ripples from his voice was continuously transmitted into the body of the Grand Elder.
The Grand Elder gradually opened his eyes.
Following that, his body dissipated like fog before condensing before King Qi Du.
The Grand Elder stared at King Qi Du coldly.
“Grand Elder.” King Fu Suo transmitted anxiously, informing him about the intelligence report, “The current situation with the enemy is as such: Second Elder and Third Elder are currently leading 11 Kings including King Fu Suo to deal with the intruders. But currently, they ordered for me to wake Grand Elder up. There might be some unforeseen circumstances and this one isn’t sure if this one should awaken the Emperor too?”
“There’s no need. If the enemy is truly powerful, there is no need for the elders to order you just to wake me up. Without reaching the final moment, there is no need to wake the Emperor. Otherwise, we might infuriate the Emperor.”
“Yes, this one understands.” King Qi Du acknowledged.
The Grand Elder glanced at King Qi Du coldly before disappearing like fog.
Only then did King Qi Du let out a sigh of relief.
The Grand Elder…
If one mentioned that the Second Elder and Third Elder were both peak Kings, then Grand Elder had already broken through the King realm to reach a higher level!
The Grand Elder’s strength was most likely more terrifying than the addition of the other 10 Kings.
…
The natives and 10 Kings fought without having a victor. As they fought, they were rushing over to the clans-ground as well. They were already very close to it.
“Soon, we are reaching soon!”
The natives were all incomparably excited. This came this time to gamble their lives. If they failed, it would be incredibly hard for them to flip the board-their entire Blood Flame Clan would most likely be extinguished! Fortunately, they met a team of cultivators while they were training their clansmen at the outer perimeters! The cultivators were sufficiently powerful even.
“Sou.”
Swordmaster, Xue Ying, and Insect Ancestor had an even easier time.
Swordmaster was too powerful; his techniques were incredibly profound. With a sword, he was able to resist against the two elders. At the same time, he would occasionally strike against King Fu Suo, frustrating her very much now as she was already having a tough time dealing against the white-robed young man on top of the scarlet fire lotus flower.
“Hmph.” Suddenly, a cold snort sounded. The surrounding temperature started reducing drastically; a layer of frost even started forming on the ground. Xue Ying and the others felt their hearts trembling as a cold deathly aura began permeating into their bodies.
A figure appeared in midair.
He was a black-robed old man who had his hands folded. With his hair swaying with the wind, he stared coldly at the group of intruders, opening his mouth before spurting out black clouds from it.
The world transformed enormously.
It suddenly became dark. Xue Ying’s Chaotic Origin Ocean was even shattered against the endless darkness.
“Break.”
Since the start of the battle, this was the first time Swordmaster used his full strength. A ray of dazzling sword light cut its way through the endless darkness, causing a line to appear. Along with a few successive sword lights, the dark world eventually collapsed.
At the moment when the darkness dissipated, dark shackles were revealed. These shackles began wrapping around Swordmaster frantically.
“I’ll delay him.” Swordmaster felt the pressure too. He had a feeling that he was currently facing against Emperor Summer or Undying Underworld Emperor. Fortunately, even though this Grand Elder was powerful, his techniques were too crude. Swordmaster could still barely hold his ground. If it was an expert like ‘Emperor Summer’ or ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’-with sufficiently powerful strength and profound realms that were overwhelming, Swordmaster would not be able to hold this expert back.
Even when facing Grand Elder, Swordmaster could only restrict him back!
“The Grand Elder is so powerful?” Insect Ancestor was shocked.
“Hmph.” Second Elder, Third Elder and the other 11 Kings were in great joy. At the same time they felt their confidence rising.
“Forget about these two cultivators. Let us congregate our strength and deal against the natives first.” Second Elder and Third Elder gave the orders.
“Yes.”
Second Elder, Third Elder, and King Fu Suo changed targets at the same time. They headed towards that group of natives, combining strength with the other 11 Kings.
Xue Ying and Insect Ancestor felt anxious.
Insect Ancestor was helpless. Even though his survivability skills were amazing and his techniques were quite bizarre, he was still weak in his overall combat strength!
And that group of natives were currently holding back 11 Kings. The moment they died, the Kings would change targets back to the cultivators, and Xue Ying understood that he could not survive against that!
“Xue Ying, protect them.” Swordmaster was doing his utmost to hold back the Grand Elder. At the same time, he was anxiously transmitting a message.
“Big Brother Flying Snow, we can only see you killing trump card now.” Insect Ancestor transmitted too.
“Alright.”
He had no other choices now.
The eyes of Xue Ying standing on the Void Fire Lotus Flower flashed with a cold light.
“Hong-”
A frightening ripple abruptly engulfed the entire place.
It surrounded the natives, the two Elders, and the 11 Kings, causing their bodies to tremble. At the same time, a total of eight Kings fell from the sky-they had lost their consciousness.
As for the remaining two Elders and three Kings, they all revealed looks of agony and terror; they were currently barely keeping awake, causing them to immediately teleport and escape.
Within an instance.
There was just the Grand Elder left behind! He who was originally filled with a powerful aura, currently revealed a look of indignance. Even though his strength was weakened, it fell to just half of what he had at peak. As for Swordmaster and Insect Ancestor, they both stared at Xue Ying with disbelief. The effects of his killing trump card was so good?
It had practically wiped out all enemies in one fell swoop!

chapters.title: Chapter 1210 - Number one in the Dao of Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 1210: Number one in the Dao of Soul
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Just a single move actually wiped out all Death Destruction clansmen. They either died or they escaped. The remaining Grand Elder also suffered from a drastic decrease in strength. His advantage over Swordmaster was no longer that huge either. Grand Elder resisted against the incoming impact while glaring at Xue Ying indignantly.
“This-”
If one mentioned that the Blood Flame Clan was still mentally prepared of what Swordmaster and Insect Ancestor could do, then this remaining apex expert had truly given them an unbelievable joy of surprise!
“He, he actually wiped out all the enemies?”
“It’s that Monarch Flying Snow?”
“He seems to be the weakest of the three cultivators, but his strength is actually this powerful?”
They were all incomparably excited.
This time, they took a gamble on the fate of their entire Blood Flame Clan. It was still possible for the Blood Flame Clan to rise and get their home back. But if they were defeated, it would mean extinction-the fate of the Blood Flame Clan would fall just like many other clans of Natives. Previously, Second Elder and Third Elder tried leading the group of Kings to ambush them, given them the idea that it would be the final bout of battle.
Who would have thought that everything was turned upside down! They finally saw the light at the end of the tunnel!
“Hurry! Hurry over to the clans-ground. We should get the Spiritual Yin Fruit before the awakening of the Death Destruction Emperor!” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji transmitted excitedly.
“Hurry!”
“The clans-ground!”
These natives were incomparably excited. They charged to the clans-ground under the guidance of His Majesty Blood Flame Ji.
They were making full use of time! They had to achieve what they came here before the Emperor of the Death Destruction Clan appear. That was much more frightening than the Grand Elder!
“Xue Ying, how is your killing trump card so frighteningly amazing? I doubt Ancestor Fan could achieve such an outcome!” Swordmaster asked Xue Ying as he resisted against the Grand Elder while advancing forward to the clans-ground.
It was clear that Swordmaster was having an easier time since he could still converse while battling.
“Big Brother Flying Snow, this is simply overpowered! Even though the intelligence reported that the Death Destruction Clan is slightly weaker in their soul and willpower, what you did feels kind of exaggerated.” Insect Ancestor was filled with disbelief.
“I had put in all my strength previously.” Xue Ying transmitted with a smile. He made eight ‘Kings’ to lose their consciousness and souls, making them turn into fog. In the end, they left behind just their weapons and treasures like that ‘vicious blood claws’ or ‘a seemingly ordinary wooden pole’. These items were all kept by Xue Ying.
The Death Destruction Clan was a clan with incredibly low intelligence.
99% of the entire clan were like wild beasts. Whenever they saw an outsider, they would only think of them as either ‘edible’ or ‘non-edible’! Only the strongest experts in the clan had passable intelligence. But they would still kill all intruders! It was hard to work with them.
It was still possible to work with the natives and to trade with them.
But the Death Destruction Clan?
The Death Destruction Clan would even devour one another. The place they stayed were simple too, and their weapons were crude. But one thing of note was that the materials used in crafting those weapons were extraordinary! They were either naturally formed or were some unique material from the sky-floating island.
“Even though the intelligence of the Death Destruction Clan is low, according to rumors, they are a clan that emerged from the corpses of powerful Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Being such unique lifeforms, even if they have a lower intelligence or a lower heart realm, their soul would still have a powerful resistance towards the outside world.” Xue Ying understood this point. According to what cultivators had found out of the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, even though the souls of the Death Destruction Clan were unique, and that their intelligence and heart realm were low, their resistance against soul techniques…
Were weaker than cultivators who climbed slowly from young!
Even natives were not any much better than the Death Destruction Clan-they were slightly better in resisting against soul techniques. But none of them could compare with the cultivators.
The cultivators were the strongest in heart realm.
“Usually, soul techniques would have amazing effects on them.”
“But there are such pitiful number of Cosmos Gods in the entire Realm Heart Great Land that reached level two in the soul aspect.” Xue Ying sighed inwardly, “The majority doesn’t even have any avatars! Hence, they do not dare to risk their lives.”
“And soul-related secret treasures that reach the level-two Cosmos God power are too rare. One have to reach the level-one Cosmos God Realm in order for them to activate and control such treasures. But the moment they lose this avatar of theirs, they would similarly lose their secret treasures.” Xue Ying thought. Even though the majority of Realm Heart Great Land understood this point-that soul techniques were good at dealing with the Death Destruction Clan, it was still hard to apply them on a huge area.
Most level-two Cosmos God techniques had great effects against ‘Kings’ from the Death Destruction Clan.
But they were useless when dealing against Emperors.
No matter what, this was a technique that targeted a huge area. It was also the ‘killing trump card’ Xue Ying had when joining this expedition! When dealing against a group of enemies, Xue Ying would be the one to handle them. When dealing against the strongest experts, Swordmaster would be the main person!
“What realm has Xue Ying reached in his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm?” Swordmaster could not help but think about it.
He only knew that Xue Ying had traded with Summer Wind Ancient Nation with his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm scripture, acquiring the Void Fire Lotus Flower and 50,000 kilograms of Chaotic Origin Sand from it.
But he did not know that the current Xue Ying had fused four branches of ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’ together. He was currently trying to fuse all five branches! Furthermore, as he was saving the enslaved cultivators from Sacred Master, Xue Ying’s understanding of the Dao of Soul had increased, allowing him to get a clear direction of where to head towards with his fifth branch. Hence, Xue Ying stood at the top in the Dao of Soul in the Realm Heart Great Land, and even many more Origin Worlds.
For instance, secret treasures like the ‘Demonic Emperor Robe’ only had two branches fused together!
Yet Xue Ying was gradually fusing five branches together. A full-powered soul technique by him would naturally produce the most heaven-defying result the Realm Heart Great Land ever had in history!
“Don’t be overly excited.” Xue Ying transmitted, “This killing trump card of mine would definitely startle the Death Destruction Clan. They would most likely be awakening their Emperor! This Grand Elder could maintain at 50% of his strength under my soul technique, which means my technique would have lesser effect on that Emperor! Hence, we must hurry.”
“Right.”
“Hurry hurry hurry! I truly do not wish to meet that Emperor.”
Swordmaster was fighting against the Grand Elder on one hand. At the same time, he was also moving in the direction where the clans-ground was. Xue Ying and Insect Ancestor’s speed were much faster.
…
Emperor.
There would be an emperor ruling each Death Destruction Clan tribe in a sky-floating island. It was the most terrifying existence in the entire sky-floating island. It solely occupied all the best resources in the Death Destruction Clan, and would usually remain deep asleep in cultivation! According to the intelligence given by Swordmaster, the Death Destruction Clan would usually cultivate in sleep.
Devour was a form of cultivation.
Sleeping while absorbing resources was also cultivation.
On the sky-floating island, one must not think of being able to defeat an ‘Emperor’ directly! If one had the strength of Undying Underworld Emperor or Emperor Summer, he might still be able to wrestle away the resources. As for Xue Ying and the rest? It was a success for them if they could bring those treasures away successfully.
“Damn.”
“There is actually such a powerful cultivator.”
“Emperor! Awaken the Emperor!”
“Hurry up and awaken the Emperor!”
Clans-ground.
Second Elder, Third Elder and the three extremely powerful ‘Kings’ like King Fu Suo had teleported back here after fleeing. The black-robed girl ‘King Fu Suo’ was considered the weakest at her level.
Only at their strength could they barely remain conscious under Xue Ying’s frighteningly strong soul technique. They could only execute their fleeing techniques.
They were either startled, angry, or panicking.
Awaken the Emperor!
Only the ‘Emperor’ had the capabilities to handle the enemies.
“Awaken the Emperor?” King Qi Du who was situated at the Elder Hall looked in shock at Second Elder and Third Elder as they returned awful conditions.
“Hurry!” Second Elder and Third Elder even took the initiative in hurrying over to where the Emperor slept.
“What is happening?” King Qi Du followed both elders while questioning the other three following kings.
“Dead. The other Kings that went are dead. We are the only surviving Kings.” A four-hooved silver beast growled.
“What! The others are all dead?” King Qi Du was startled.
His strength was considered quite ordinary in the group of Kings.
If he went? He would have died!
King Qi Du felt afraid and shocked when he heard the news.
“What is going on? How could this be? Even that unparalleled expert who uses his sword should not be able to kill those Kings that easily.” King Qi Du anxiously asked through voice transmissions. They had already known that Swordmaster was powerful, so the Kings should have prepared themselves mentally. Furthermore, Grand Elder even went to deal with him this time.
“It’s that level-two Cosmos God cultivator, the one who seems to be the weakest! He is actually the most terrifying one.”
“That is too scary.”
Those Kings who fortuitously survived felt terrified the moment they thought back to when the illusory realm descended, causing them to feel bewilderment and intense desire.
They merely maintained a strand of consciousness at that time. If things went on, they might even fall for the illusory realm. Even still, the power they could unleash was pathetic when they were in that state.
“Hong-”
Second Elder and Third Elder brought along the four Kings to the enormous lake. This lake contained a dark green liquid. A huge black figure was lying within. Because it was too big, part of its body had surfaced out of the lake. It was in deep sleep and did not seem to move. It felt like a dead creature.
Cultivators and natives could not sense how unique this slumbering Emperor was.
But those from the Death Destruction Clan-the Elders and Kings could perceive a frightening energy hidden within the lying ‘Emperor’. If they could devour the Emperor, they might undergo some qualitative transformation. It’s just that they could not even bite off the skin of the Emperor with their current strength!
“Emperor.” Second Elder and Third Elder respectfully lowered their heads. They began calling for their Emperor!

chapters.title: Chapter 1211 - A Gray Eye
chapters.content:
Chapter 1211: A Gray Eye
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
And on the other side.
The team containing the natives and the cultivators like Xue Ying had rushed into the clans-ground one after another. Even though the clans-ground was protected by an unseen ripple, it was weak.
“Cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land!” The Grand Elder felt immensely angry. He had never encountered an illusory realm which felt so uncomfortable. That illusory realm made him feel bewildered and enticed, it was continuously pulling on his soul. He had already broken through and reached the Emperor level, yet he still had to fork out part of his heartforce to resist against that illusory realm, causing his combat efficiency to reduce greatly.
His techniques were originally crude. Now that they had become much weaker, he could barely suppress Swordmaster anymore. Swordmaster could still easily fly and escape from him.
“Hu.”
Charging past the ripple, they saw the towering mountain which was the clans-ground.
Xue Ying began condensing many avatars the moment he saw that mountain. “Sou sou sou”, many white-robed young men began flying in various directions! This was a total of more than 10,000 avatars. In this expedition to the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, his primary combat force were the nine avatars! The other avatars were much weaker and were barely at the ordinary Cosmos God level.
But it sufficed to ‘seek treasures’. Xue Ying casually let out several hundred avatars.
“Weng!” Insect Ancestor even guffawed. His black robe transformed into countless insects that flew in all directions seeking for treasures.
“Damn.” The Grand Elder felt incensed. During most of the time, they-the Death Disaster Clan-were the ones that devoured experts from other clans. When was it that others could charge into their clans-ground and steal their treasures?
What a pity.
Almost all the elite Death Disaster clansmen within the clans-ground had retreated. Because they knew that facing against the terrifying soul technique cast by the cultivator from Realm Heart Great Land, even Kings could not survive, much less those who were weaker!
…
Broken Teeth Mountain Range was a place created by ‘Yuan’. It was also a training ground provided by ‘Yuan’ for the cultivators.
Dangers and treasures existed hand-in-hand here!
But there were too many sky-floating islands. The treasures that could be found in one sky-floating island was limited! Furthermore, the higher-ups from the Death Disaster Clan had treated them as precious items, and had already hidden them away. Only some that the Death Disaster Clan disliked and disdained would be thrown outside.
The ‘Death Disaster Clan’ was ultimately a different type of lifeform as compared to cultivators! Most items that were incredibly precious to the cultivators were useless to the Death Disaster Clan.
Instead, it was the natives and the ‘Death Disaster Clan’ that treated similar items as treasures.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying’s several hundred avatars were flying in different directions seeking for treasures.
“That is?” One of his avatars discovered a waterfall. At the base of the waterfall, there was a bizarre stone.
This stone was black. It contained a luster. If one carefully examined it, the surface of the black stone contained layers of patterns stacked. Those patterns felt like scales; they were beautiful.
“Mysterious Scaled Rock?” Xue Ying immediately recognized it. He flew over hurriedly. This avatar of his controlled the void before grabbing the pieces of Mysterious Scaled Rocks.
Mysterious Scaled Rocks were very precious. They were immensely tough-unparalleled existences could not destroy them easily. They could only be used when mixed with other auxiliary ingredients when refining a weapon, and were definitely precious materials used for refinement.
“So many Mysterious Scaled Rocks? A total of 625 of them?” Xue Ying felt pleased.
With so many Mysterious Scaled Rocks, their value could be comparable to a peak-graded secret treasure!
“This is indeed the Broken Teeth Mountain Range. The first thing I discovered is comparable to a peak-graded secret treasure.” Xue Ying felt incredibly happy. But in reality, how many cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land could kill their way to the core clans-ground of a sky-floating island in Broken Teeth Mountain Range? Even if they could, how many had this many avatars to rapidly search the place for treasures?
…
Prior to entering, Xue Ying had discussed with Swordmaster and Insect Ancestor-the treasures they found in Broken Teeth Mountain Range would be distributed according to how much they contributed! Of course, who ever needed an item immensely could also take it away, but he had to repatriate the other two parties.
After all, in their group, Xue Ying specialized in attacking a group with his soul technique! And Swordmaster was the most powerful in terms of direct combat force. As for Insect Ancestor, he was responsible for seeking treasures since his many insects were the best way to do so.
“Nothing else.”
Xue Ying’s several hundred avatars, other than finding those Mysterious Scaled Rocks, he did not find any other more items.
Suddenly-
“Hong!”
A terrifying aura erupted.
Xue Ying, Insect Ancestor, and Swordmaster immediately focused on that particular location deep in the mountains where the natives killed their way in. Xue Ying had avatars that were close to this place too.
The erupted aura was seriously frightening. It was so grand that it caused the expressions on Xue Ying, Swordmaster, and Insect Ancestor to change. There was even black fog formed from death aura condensing high above the clans-ground mountain. It was forcefully pressing down on the entire area.
“Blood Flame Clan? You are here to steal my Spiritual Yin Fruit again?” A grand voice sounded that caused the entire world to tremble.
“It’s the Emperor!”
“It is awakening now!”
“We should hurry off!”
Swordmaster, Insect Ancestor, and Xue Ying immediately discovered that things were amiss.
“Hurry up and leave! My insects discovered four treasures. What about you guys?” Many insects began flying towards Insect Ancestor, condensing back into his black robe.
“I discovered one.” Xue Ying replied. His avatars were also flying over from various places.
“Hurry up! Currently, the natives are pinning down the Emperor. But in a while, he will come and deal with us.” Swordmaster anxiously added.
“Monarch Flying Snow, i request for you to help our Blood Flame Clan. My Blood Flame Clan will definitely thank you greatly after that.” An anxious voice transmitted into the ears of Xue Ying.
“I’ll leave several avatars behind to help them out.” Xue Ying mentioned it to Swordmaster.
He had many avatars.
Of the avatars he left behind, there was only one with a powerful combat strength! The other were weaker, and would primarily be used to beguile the enemies.
“Alright.”
Swordmaster waved his hand, keeping Insect Ancestor and Xue Ying into his Eden Treasure.
Within this Eden Treasure, Xue Ying’s willpower was not affected. He could still execute his illusory realm technique outside of it.
“Go!”
After keeping his comrades, Swordmaster no longer had any worries and immediately focused on escaping!
“Sou!”
His speed rose to a maximum! This time, they had acquired sufficient rewards from this sky-floating island. In order to escape, he still required quite some time. Swordmaster was not confident if he could escape from the ‘Emperor’! Hence, he had to hurry off. If this body died, it was fine if he lost his avatar. What was worse would be the loss of all treasures.
Coming over to the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, on the one hand, he came to temper himself, and on the other hand, he came to collect more treasures! Some treasures were helpful to cultivation.
“Chase!” Grand Elder was dead-set on chasing after him. He was clear that the moment Swordmaster ‘threw him behind’, given Swordmaster’s abillity at concealing his aura, it would take some time for Swordmaster to be discovered.
Hence, he had to ‘follow’ Swordmaster all the while! When the Emperor came, it would be time for these invaders to pay the price!
In the other region.
Within Elder Hall.
Xue Ying’s ultra-strong avatar had arrived. He easily saw what was happening in the Elder Hall with a glance.
A strange piece of blood crystal was seen floating on the forehead of His Majesty Blood Flame Ji, causing his strength to soar by a few times to reach the unparalleled level! His subordinate clansmen were in a combat formation, and all of them had a droplet of blood floating on their forehead-their auras were much stronger.
But the enemies were similarly powerful.
The Second Elder, Third Elder, they were all comparable to unparalleled existences! Even King Fu Suo and other Kings were powerful.
More importantly, the one currently suppressing ‘His Majesty Blood Flame Ji’ was a black giant! His entire body was black and had three eyes. Each movement of his enormous arms brought along some feeling of profundity, forcing His Majesty Blood Flame Ji to spurt out blood every single strike. Fortunately, His Majesty Blood Flame Ji was a native and had incredibly strong fleshy body.
“Risking your life? Burning your bloodline? It’s useless!” This black giant sent another slap, forcing His Majesty Blood Flame Ji down underground. Blood Flame Ji’s fleshy body warped and recovered its original shape. As he battled savagely, he was also rushing towards a unique slanted tree by the side of the lake.
“Why is he staking his life so much for that strange tree?”
Xue Ying did not care about anything else.
He simply use all his strength to cast down an illusory realm.
“Hong-”
An illusory realm descended and covered the entire Elder Hall. The expression of Second Elder, Third Elder, and other Kings paled greatly. They immediately teleported and tried to escape. As for ‘King Fu Qi’, because he understood that the enemies had killed their way into the clans-ground, he had already escaped far away. He was clear that he would lose his life in a single exchange against that terrifying cultivator from the Realm Heart Great Land.
The other Death Disaster clansmen were fleeing in all directions.
But the ‘Emperor’ remained unmoved.
“Mn?” This black giant turned over to the newly-appeared white-robed young man just outside the Elder Hall. When the terrifying illusory realm descended, the Emperor had to use part of his heartforce to resist against it, causing his strength to decrease by 30%.
Even though he was powerful--way more than the Grand Elder!
In reality, he and the Grand Elder were both Emperors! The soul of the Grand Elder had a qualitative difference from Second Elder and the others. But there was no huge differences between the Emperor and the Grand Elder.
“Hurry!” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji immediately transmitted to his subordinates when he saw this, “Snatch the Spiritual Yin Fruit!”
“The Spiritual Yin Fruit!”
Those Blood Flame clansmen rushed over in frantically.
…
Xue Ying was also observing that bizarre tree. The lake where this tree grew was black in color. This tree grew out in a slanted angle to a height of about 33 meters. The ‘skin’ on the two fruits growing on it seemed thin-it was possible to see the revolution of light within it.
“It seems this fruit is extraordinary, though the intelligence report hasn’t recorded it before.” Xue Ying suddenly paid attention to the peak of this bizarre tree. There was a ‘gray eye’ on it. This gray eye seemed to be inlaid into the tree. The might it emitted constantly covered the Elder Hall.
It’s just that at this moment, the aura produced by the Emperor was overwhelming. Hence, Xue Ying did not notice that gray eye previously.
But looking over at it now-
Xue Ying’s eyes met with that gray eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 1212 - The Indignant Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1212: The Indignant Emperor
This gray eye located at the peak of the bizarre tree was constantly emanating a grandeur of power for the longest of time. The inner structure of this eye felt even more incredible. At Xue Ying’s current realm, he could easily examine a single dust particle and magnify it into a vast land. He could also see how the structure of a dust interact with the operating laws of an Origin World.
But at this moment!
When Xue Ying looked at this gray eye, he revealed a look of startle. He could not help but thoroughly examine this gray eye further.
The gray eye was becoming bigger rapidly in his vision. Bigger and bigger it grew…
It was endless!
The material structure of the gray eye was that mysterious!
Xue Ying’s fleshy body which was comparable to that of a ‘peak Cosmos God body cultivator’ contained different kinds of unfathomable areas. Every droplet of blood contained profound mysteries. The same logic! This ‘gray eye’ was more profound than the fleshy body of Xue Ying.
“It is too beautiful.”
“Its beauty has reached a new pinnacle.”
Xue Ying mumbled to himself. He was entirely engrossed at the gray eye.
“Monarch Flying Snow, we are prepared to leave. Do you need us to bring you out as well?” Suddenly, a sound echoed in his mind.
Xue Ying glanced at the distant Majesty Blood Flame Ji who currently fought with the ‘Emperor’ from the Death Destruction Clan.
“Leaving? You are confident of doing so?” Xue Ying replied bewilderedly. It took some time for them to escape out of the boundary of the sky-floating island.
“We have our ways.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji transmitted, “We are about to move. Do you plan on leaving with us?”
“You don’t have to care about me. This is just an avatar of mine.” Xue Ying transmitted back. He was indifferent. With so many avatars, he did not care if some of them dissipated! Furthermore, he wanted to examine that gray eye further.
His Majesty Blood Flame Ji transmitted: “Monarch Flying Snow, my Blood Flame Clan will definitely repay this favor. Let us meet again outside the sky-floating island.”
“Alright, let us convene outside the island.” Xue Ying replied.
At the same time, Xue Ying felt curious.
This team of natives was currently charging towards that bizarre tree. And that ‘Emperor’ from the Death Destruction Clan was currently hindering them. At the same time, he was furiously attacking that Majesty Blood Flame Ji.
“Hong, hong, hong…” Every single move of the black giant was filled with unimaginable might. It’s just that his techniques were too direct and simple, and His Majesty Blood Flame Ji was similarly reacting crudely! Fortunately, under Xue Ying’s full-powered illusory realm, the power of the ‘Emperor’ was forced down to 70% of his original strength. That was how His Majesty Blood Flame Ji could survive.
“He is truly defiant.” Xue Ying’s expression changed slightly.
The strength of the black giant could match against the strengthened ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ prior to being weakened. One had to know that ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ could not maintain that sort of terrifying state for a long time. If both parties fought… Undying Underworld Emperor might hold the upper hand initially.
But over time, if Undying Underworld Emperor could no longer maintain his strongest state, he would have been beaten down by this ‘Emperor’. Naturally, it was unquestionably for Undying Underworld Emperor to survive.
‘In the vast Broken Teeth Mountain Range, this is merely an ordinary sky-floating island, yet the Emperor is this powerful.’ Xue Ying was dumbstruck.
Even though the techniques of the cultivators were profound, and they could still survive against those who were weaker.
But one could never fight against a powerful expert with numbers!
The moment the gap between both parties reached a certain level, the weaker party would easily be swept.
‘Hearsay the natives have a strand of bloodline from the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, strengthening their fleshy bodies to an exaggerated extent. And this Majesty Blood Flame Ji seems to have an even more terrifying body.’ Xue Ying deduced.
He slightly paid attention to what was happening in the battle before going back to studying that gray eye again. He carefully observed and pondered over it. At the same time, a grin was slowly forming on his face.
…
At this moment, that ‘Emperor’ was furious. He was so furious that he wanted to deal against Xue Ying.
Because this damnable cultivator actually forced him to use up part of his heartforce to resist against the illusory realm, causing his strength to deteriorate! Furthermore, the other Elders and Kings had escaped. Even the ‘Grand Elder’ did not come to aid him! The Grand Elder transmitted a message saying that he was currently chasing after the cultivator that used sword!
He had no helpers.
His Majesty Blood Flame Ji and the four grand formations under him-each grand formation was comparable to His Majesty Blood Flame Ji!
The Emperor had to resist against them at the same time. He was slightly short-handed, and was unable to deal against Xue Ying momentarily! Because he knew that the moment he did so, those natives would seek an opportunity to snatch the Spiritual Yin Fruit away.
“Hong.”
In one of the formations belonging to His Majesty Blood Flame Ji.
The three great experts in this formation each had a queer blood armor on them. When the three blood armors were activated, many inscriptions formed and merged as one entity, boosting the power of this combat formation to another level! In terms of strength, this formation could compare with the standard of that ‘Grand Elder’! It was much stronger than even His Majesty Blood Flame Ji. Once the strength of this formation increased, it immediately charged towards that bizarre tree.
“Blood Flame Clan, you even brought your clan protection treasure with you?” The Emperor was startled.
The Blood Flame Sacred Armor.
They only had a total of three of them! It was also the clan protection treasures the Blood Flame Clan had. Before an ultra-strong expert emerged from the clan, three powerful elders of the clan would bring along a Blood Flame Sacred Armor each. When they worked together, it should suffice in protecting the clan.
Such clan protection treasures were absolutely precious and could not be lost! Yet they even brought along their clan protection treasures when venturing into the sky-floating island? One had to know that if not for the appearance of that white-robed young man, if the Grand Elder, Second Elder and Third elder were still alive, the situation of the Blood Flame Clan would be more dire. The moment they died in battle, the clan protection treasures would be lost forever!
“Has the Blood Flame Clan gone mad?” Emperor could not understand. It had fought many times with the Blood Flame Clan, and understood that the most important treasures of this sky-floating island, the ‘Spiritual Yin Fruit’, had a special effect on awakening the bloodlines of those from the Blood Flame Clan. Hence, many generations of experts from the Blood Flame Clan would venture here to snatch the Spiritual Yin Fruit away.
But they had never turned this mad before!
“Damn.”
The strength of the Emperor was affected. His Majesty Blood Flame Ji and his four grand formations were not to be trifled with. Furthermore, the strength of one formation was even boosted to the level of Grand Elder who was not too different from the Emperor. The Emperor primarily specialized in close combat with his fleshy body. He was bad at domain-related and large-scale techniques. Hence, he could not hinder the enemies currently.
“Hu-”
When the strength of that formation became boosted significantly, it reached a level comparable to the Emperor. With a sudden charge at a close distance along with the help of other comrades, it was able to arrive before the bizarre tree in a blink of an eye.
“No!”
The indignant Emperor could not care about anything else. He immediately went to grab the Spiritual Yin Fruit growing on the tree.
There were only two fruits growing in total on this tree.
The Emperor and that combat formation had practically grabbed one at the same time!
“It hasn’t mature yet you guys came to snatch it away?” The Emperor howled.
“When would it be our turn if it has matured?”
His Majesty Blood Flame Ji and the others were in great joy.
Even though it had not matured completely, it would still give an effect of 50% its original.
“Let’s go!”
His Majesty Blood Flame Ji and his subordinates converged. The combat formation suddenly disappeared, leaving behind just His Majesty Blood Flame Ji alone. His Majesty Blood Flame Ji grabbed hold of a withered leaf before pinching it.
“Weng!”
An unseen ripple enveloped His Majesty Blood Flame Ji. He gave Xue Ying a smile.
Following that, he disappeared!
“Damn, damn, damn!” The Emperor roared up into the sky. His furious roar reverberated across the entire Elder Hall and spread outwards. That terrifying shockwave inundated towards Xue Ying, causing Xue Ying to pale and retreat! Fortunately, he had the strength of a final realm expert, and his fleshy body was sufficiently strong. Hence, he did not dissipate after a single roar.
“Thinking of fleeing?”
The Emperor took a step before killing his way towards Xue Ying.
He was incredibly furious! If not for this cultivator, he would have a huge group of helpers that could easily obstruct that team from the Blood Flame Clan. Furthermore, he would definitely have an absolute advantage!
But because of this cultivator, all his helpers were frightened into escaping. He did not blame his subordinates because a group of Kings had already died in the hands of this cultivator.
Originally, he planned on improving his strength further with two mature fruits. But now, he was left with a half-ripened fruit that was useless to this Emperor! It might be useful to ‘Kings’ still, but in order to wait for the fruit to grow and mature, it would be an extremely long wait once again.
“So fast.”
Even though Xue Ying hurried away, the Emperor could teleport. Previously, he did not deal against Xue Ying because he was too busy obstructing those natives. But now, with a single flash, he had chased up to the escaping Xue Ying. A pitch-black palm came down! Xue Ying felt that he could not dodge. He tried his best to resist against it, but it was simply ridiculous when compared to the frightening technique.
“Peng.”
This major avatar of Xue Ying was easily injured when faced with unparalleled existences.
But when facing this ‘Emperor’, even ordinary unparalleled existences would be heavily injured in one move! Only His Majesty Blood Flame Ji could reach that level under the activation of his bloodline. Furthermore, his fleshy body was incredibly strong, allowing him to hold on for such a long period. Nonetheless, he was still injured heavily.
“Hu-” Under the terrifying power, this fleshy body of Xue Ying was smashed. Nothing was left behind. Nevertheless, Xue Ying remained indifferent at the time his avatar dissipated. There was even a smile on his face. With more than 10,000 avatars, losing an avatar was something he did not care.

chapters.title: Chapter 1213 - Great Rewards
chapters.content:
Chapter 1213: Great Rewards
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
When this avatar of Xue Ying was exterminated, another infiltrated the Elder Hall.
After all, Xue Ying left behind several avatars when he decided on helping the natives. Of course, there was only one major avatar.
‘This gray eye.’ When this avatar of Xue Ying arrived before the bizarre tree, even though that eye constantly emitted a grandeur in the Elder Hall, he did not hesitate to extend his hand towards it. But the moment his palm touched that gray eye-
“Hong!”
Xue Ying seemed to see a vague towering figure. It was too big! Way bigger than Xue Ying’s imagination. Its bulk seemed to be even bigger than a sacred world.
Furthermore, this was an existence that could not be measured purely in terms of size. Its existence seemed to encompass a myriad of laws. There were many bizarre spatial layers wrapping over his body as if it came from the past, the present, and the future. This was an incredibly frightening existence-way beyond the ‘Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son’ Xue Ying once saw.
If the Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son was an ant, then this towering figure was like a giant dragon! It stood beyond the nine heavens.
‘It is-’ Xue Ying could barely discern the appearance of it. This was a creature ten claws. On its body, there were many eyes.
“Hong!”
The moment Xue Ying’s finger contacted the gray eye, he vaguely saw that terrifying existence.
Following that, an overwhelming force burst out on his body. It was way beyond the full-powered attack struck by the ‘Emperor’ in anger. This avatar of Xue Ying silently dissipated.
“Hmph.”
The pitch-black ‘Emperor’ appeared by the entrance of the Elder Hall. He snorted, “What a fool. He actually dared to touch the eye. If he was a native, he would definitely not be so foolish.”
Even though the Emperor was not an expert in domain-related techniques, he was like a fish in water within the sky-floating island. An unseen energy had already covered the entire clans-ground! And he had discovered the avatars of Xue Ying.
“Sou sou sou!”
Even though he found out where the avatars were, he still had to teleport to each one of them before killing.
After wiping out the avatars, the Emperor still felt furious. He did not care about the losses of his subordinates. Ultimately, his own strength was more important. In most occasions, this ‘Spiritual Yin Fruit’ was monopolized by him. Nonetheless, one of the fruits was stolen this time, and the remaining one was half-ripened-it was useless to him at his level.
“This Blood Flame Clan actually came with so many experts and even brought along their clan protection treasures. Furthermore, they should have consumed the Spirit Leaf bestowed by ‘Great Sage Nine Tails’ upon them right?” The Emperor muttered to himself. Great Sage Nine Tails was one of the eight great sages standing at the peak of the scarce lower-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms living within the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
“There is still that cultivator who uses sword.” The Emperor soon disappeared. He went to chase after Swordmaster.
******
Swordmaster who grasped a supreme secret impartation was versatile in all aspects.
He was good in all areas-offense, defense, survival, and fleeing techniques. Without being held back by Xue Ying, Insect Ancestor or the natives, Swordmaster could focus all his attention and strength on fleeing-he transformed into a dazzling ray of sword that traveled at a startling speed.
He traveled back the approximate route taken to enter.
He did not hesitate as he flew out of the place!
Xue Ying’s primary avatars remained in the Eden Treasure brought by Swordmaster. He casted the illusory realm on the outside world, influencing the Grand Elder who was pursuing after them! And the significantly weakened Grand Elder could not threaten Swordmaster at all, especially so when his techniques were crude.
“Hong~”
That terrifying black giant stepped across the void before stomping down on Swordmaster.
His leg was seriously too big-in that instance, Swordmaster could not get out of this area. He had to defend against it!
“Peng~” Many sword lights were sent scattering around. Swordmaster was also forced backwards. Even when Grand Elder was at his peak state, Swordmaster had not suffered from such a huge disadvantage. He could barely hold back the Grand Elder.
But when facing the 30% weakened ‘Emperor’, Swordmaster was simply forced back! He could not fight against the other party. He could only focus on surviving.
“So terrifying.”
“Xue Ying, is this as you mentioned earlier, the Emperor who is weakened by 30%?” Swordmaster transmitted while doing his utmost to escape from the Emperor.
“I’ve seen him when he was at his peak-he isn’t any weaker than an angered Undying Underworld Emperor.” Xue Ying replied from within the Eden Treasure.
“Even after his strength is diminished, he is still more frightening than Emperor Summer-at least by a factor! Fortunately, his techniques are all cruder and I could barely resist against them. Otherwise, if his realm has reached Emperor Summer’s and others, I would definitely fail to escape from this sky-floating island.” Swordmaster transmitted.
“How could there be such a powerful expert coupled with a profound realm? If such an existence exists in any sky-floating island, it’ll not be a training for us cultivators!” Xue Ying transmitted back, “Swordmaster, we’ll have to rely on you now. If we fail to escape from the sky-floating island, it is fine if we lose our avatars. What’s worse is that we would lose all our treasures.”
“Rest assured.”
Swordmaster was doing his best.
If there was no interference from Xue Ying’s illusory realm, Swordmaster was only 50% confident of escaping! But now, he was 90% confident of getting out of the sky-floating island alive.
After all, Swordmaster who owned a supreme secret impartation was ranked at the forefront in survival and fleeing techniques amongst his peers.
…
Traveling at high speed, after two hours later, ‘sou’, the sword ray finally rushed out of the sky-floating island.
“Hou~” The black giant stood by the boundary of the sky-floating island roaring out indignantly. He glared coldly at the sword ray that was shooting out into the distance.
That moving sword light soon transformed back into Swordmaster. Swordmaster easily teleported away with a flash.
“Damn.”
The Emperor was furious.
Those treasures stolen by the three cultivators were not worth much to the Death Destruction Clan-which was why they were thrown around the clans-ground without being concealed deliberately. Nonetheless, the Emperor felt humiliated that he let those cultivators take away his treasures successfully.
Still, the Emperor did not continue pursuing since the other party could easily teleport in the outer world. It was impossible for them to reach up to them. Hence, he could only return back where he came unwillingly.
******
In a void outside the sky-floating island.
Xue Ying, Swordmaster and Insect Ancestor stood here taking stock of what they acquired happily!
“Haha, our harvest is truly great this time! If only we could grab them so casually and easily, we would be earning a great deal!” Insect Ancestor sighed.
Swordmaster softly shook his head: “It is all because of Xue Ying’s killing trump card that swept away so many apex experts from the Death Destruction Clan. At the same time, we met the team of natives. With their guidance, we were able to evade from the ambient dangers in the sky-floating island. In addition, those enemies were also pinned down by the natives! Which was why we could have such a huge harvest.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded, “Let’s distribute the treasures according to the usual rule. Let us first bring them back in case our avatars are killed and we lose all treasures.”
“Alright.”
“Let’s place them in the Flying Snow City.” Insect Ancestor and Swordmaster had absolute trust in Xue Ying.
“Hua.”
A black crack appeared by the side. A white-robed avatar appeared. The Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique was only restricted within the sky-floating islands in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
This avatar brought along the treasures and teleported back to the Flying Snow City.
“Monarch Flying Snow!”
To the distance, His Majesty Blood Flame Ji and a group of figures flew over.
“After hearing that indignant roar from that Emperor of the Death Destruction Clan, we knew you guys have come out. After circling the place, we finally you. You guys have teleported really far away.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji chuckled.
“We teleported slightly further to prevent that Emperor from pursuing us.” Swordmaster said.
His Majesty Blood Flame Ji thanked them: “It is all thanks to you guys and Monarch Flying Snow. Otherwise, we wouldn’t have gotten the Spiritual Yin Fruit. As I said before, my Blood Flame Clan will definitely pay back this gratitude. These are some of the secret treasures which our Blood Flame Clan discover from you cultivators in our history. They are all here.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji threw out a storage treasure filled with items.
The secret treasures of cultivators were things they could not use.
Because powerful secret treasures were too complex, and the natives usually relied on the strength of their bloodline!
When that wristband came to Xue Ying: “Oh?” He discovered all sorts of secret treasures. There were high and low graded ones-the highest were two peak-graded secret treasures.
“There are two peak-graded secret treasures.” Xue Ying told Swordmaster and Insect Ancestor.
“It’s all because of you that he gave us these.” Swordmaster said. Insect Ancestor nodded.
“Let us distribute them again later.” Xue Ying added. Reaching his level, he cared more about improving his realm. Just like Ancestor Fan and the others, they could fork out many treasures for the sake of improving their realm.
He then arranged another avatar to bring those treasures back home.
Xue Ying turned to His Majesty Blood Flame Ji and the others: “Your Majesty, do you know about that gray eye situated on the top of that tree where the Spiritual Yin Fruit grow on?”
Thay gray eye was the biggest reward Xue Ying had in his trip to the sky-floating island this time!
Even though he faintly saw that incredibly terrifying existence when he touched the gray eye! Xue Ying was clear how important this ‘gray eye’ was to him. He could see the structure of a unique ‘illusory realm’ on this gray eye! Furthermore, it was incredibly mysterious and profound.
Actually, it was likely that only Xue Ying could understand the structure of this gray eye in the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
Those without sufficient realm would not understand a treasure even if it was placed before them.
Xue Ying was currently in the process to fuse the five branches of ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’ together. He even saw the direction which he planned to take. Even without external support, it was highly possible for him to reach the final realm! He had already reached the apex across many Origin Worlds with regards to his attainment in the ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’-Xue Ying was just a membrane away from reaching the final realm.
Hence, when he saw this gray eye, under the interference from the complex structure of the gray eye, Xue Ying discovered part of what belonged to the ‘illusory realm’ within it!
And this illusory realm structure was even incomplete!
Even if Ancestor Fan and others came, they could not discern it due to lack of experience.
“The illusory realm structure inside this gray eye is incomplete. It still require the integration with other gray eyes before it could be used!” Xue Ying thought. Cultivating to his stage, Yuan, Luo City Lord and many other Chaotic Origin Lifeforms who stood at the apex could no longer guide him. But some innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms had bodies containing various laws.
And precisely on this gray eye was the existence of an illusory realm at the level of Chaotic Origin.
Even though that terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeform did not comprehend this illusory realm-he could use it innately! It would still guide him significantly in his comprehension.
If one said that Xue Ying required a long time to fuse the five branches together when he cultivated slowly, understanding this complete ‘illusory realm structure’ would greatly reduce the time he might take to reach the final realm.
“It seems this unfathomable creature I saw faintly is dead?” Xue Ying thought, “That gray eye doesn’t contain any life force. But even if it is dead, its grandeur remains. It could easily wipe away an avatar of mine when I touch its eye. That is truly frightening. According to legends, the Broken Teeth Mountain Range contains many corpses of terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeforms slain by Yuan.”
Even though there existed several low-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, they were so weak that Yuan disdained them.
Those who were frighteningly strong were left as corpses in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
“Gray eye?” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji was surprised, “I know. I of course know about it. According to what I know, this terrifying eye exists in many sky-floating islands. It was said that those eyes were left behind from the corpse of a terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeform. It is very powerful and cannot be touched.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1214 - Exploring the Sky-Floating Islands
chapters.content:
Chapter 1214: Exploring the Sky-Floating Islands
“Many sky-floating islands have them?” The eyes of Xue Ying brightened.
“Right.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji nodded, “This terrifying eye is scattered in several sky-floating islands. Just my Blood Flame Clan alone recorded 522 of them. But Monarch Flying Snow, I have to inform you that it is impossible to take those eyes away. Touching any of those eyes would bring down punishment on you. Those who are weaker will immediately be suppressed to death by the grandeur released from the eye.”
“I wonder if you could sell me records regarding information on the sky-floating islands where those ‘eyes’ exist in?” Even though Xue Ying felt that it was unreasonable for him to ask for it, he still chose to do so.
Information on the sky-floating islands were absolutely core to the cultivators living in Realm Heart Great Land and the natives!
They were collected by the hard work of the seniors! Even though the ambient danger might seem ordinary on the surface, only by experiencing them would one know how dangerous it was! Generation after generation, those natives continued gathering more information. They would even trade with other natives. Regardless, detailed information on each sky-floating island was precious and would not be easily given away.
“Monarch Flying Snow, my Blood Flame Clan owns you a huge favor.” Blood Flame Ji looked at Xue Ying. The other apex experts from the Blood Flame Clan were also discussing this.
“It is natural that we can give you the intelligence you require.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji said. If Xue Ying asked the Blood Flame Clan when they were powerful, it would be hard to obtain them. But now, the Blood Flame Clan was left with just them. Blood Flame Ji was even the sole commander of the entire Blood Flame Clan! Previously, Xue Ying had helped them tremendously.
Without Xue Ying, they might very well be exterminated!
Furthermore, the natives were segmented into many social groups, and the ‘Blood Flame Clan’ was an outspoken and straightward clan-they would draw the lines between gratitude and grudges clearly! If they met some cultivators who were scheming and selfish, it would not be that easy for Xue Ying to obtain those pieces of information.
“But I have to state this clearly.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji said, “Even though my clan knows that 522 sky-floating islands contain that terrifying eye! It is impossible for our Blood Flame Clan to explore every sky-floating island so thoroughly. Previously, that sky-floating island is very important to my Blood Flame Clan because of the Spiritual Yin Fruit. That is why we know that place so clearly. As for the 522 sky-floating islands, my clan is only confident of having absolute detail in 18 of them! There is also another 89 islands that we are slightly more knowledgeable of. As for the rest, we are only crudely aware of them.”
“That’s sufficient. I am thankful for Your Majesty already.” Xue Ying replied.
“Haha, there is no need for Monarch Flying Snow to be as such. If not for you, my Blood Flame Clan might not have survived through this ordeal.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji said. Saying that, he flipped his hand before passing a scroll over to Xue Ying.
Xue Ying received it.
His consciousness scoured through the scroll; large amounts of information entered his mind.
“I originally wanted to invite Monarch Flying Snow and the rest of you over to our Blood Flame World as guests. It’s just that we are currently in a difficult situation. Wait until we get back our Blood Flame World. I’ll dispatch an emissary over to the Realm Heart Great Land to invite Monarch then.” His Majesty Blood Flame Ji said.
“I live in Southern Cloud Nation’s Flying Snow City! And I shall wait for Your Majesty to invite us over then!” Xue Ying laughed. At this moment, he felt gratitude towards Blood Flame Ji. Previously, Xue Ying chose to help the other party because they were his comrade, and it was a minor matter to him if he lost some avatars. Hence, he did not hesitate to help. But now, he actually got precious information from them!
Just casually helping the other party and he got repaid tremendously!
Indeed, as they said, to give and to receive!
If Xue Ying had dark thoughts then and watched the natives fight with the Emperor emotionlessly without intervening, or that he reckoned the natives could delay the Emperor for more time! He would not have gotten away with such a good deal.
…
Both parties bid farewell.
When the team from the Blood Flame Clan disappeared, Swordmaster said: “Xue Ying, you were mentioning about the gray eye situated on top of the tree that bore the Spiritual Yin Fruits?”
“As you know, I left behind to help His Majesty Blood Flame Ji and the rest. That was why I saw the gray eye.” Xue Ying said, “That was an incredibly mysterious eye that is of help to my cultivation. Now that we have finished exploring this sky-floating island, where shall we head to next?”
“Haha, Big Brother Flying Snow, you are planning to visit the 522 sky-floating islands where that mysterious eye is found in right?” Insect Ancestor chuckled.
Xue Ying smiled: “Strictly speaking, we have finished exploring one and there are just 521 of them left.”
“We do not have any precise objective actually.” Swordmaster nodded, “The main goal of exploring the sky-floating islands is still to temper ourselves and for the sake of finding more opportunities. Xue Ying, since those mysterious eyes are useful to you, we’ll just visit those islands that have them. Furthermore, with the information provided by His Majesty Blood Flame Ji and the rest, we would have an easier time in these islands too.”
Even though the Summer Wind Ancient Nation had collected very detailed information on some sky-floating islands…
Those places had been explored by Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan and others.
Instead, the Blood Flame Clan provided information on many sky-floating islands where the Summer Wind Ancient Nation did not venture deeply before.
“Many thanks.” Xue Ying said, “Then we shall proceed according to the degree of danger. We shall first explore those islands that are less dangerous, and places where we have the most detailed information.”
Insect Ancestor nodded.
“You decide.” Swordmaster said straightforwardly.
…
Hence, the three of them began exploring the sky-floating islands based on the information they had.
These pieces of information were quite detailed!
And they chose to do it according to its level of danger!
The Blood Flame Clan had given them information as payment for a debt of gratitude. Hence, most of those places had never been deeply explored by experts from the Realm Heart Great Land.
The sky-floating islands were in varying shapes and sizes. There existed a myriad of things. For instance, the ‘gray eyes’ were helpful to Xue Ying with his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm. Similarly, there were peculiar scenarios that were helpful to Swordmaster too!
A tall blood-colored mountain towered on the sky-floating island. It emitted a destructive grandeur that brought chills down the spine of others. Swordmaster became engrossed the moment he saw it. From thus, Swordmaster discovered a new direction for him to move in.
…
“What treasures! So many Scarlet Bamboo Fruits!”
There was a pile of red fruits swaying gently in the wind. It gave off an alluring scent which attracted many insects. These insects brought all the fruits away, while at the same time, they spoke: “Big Brother Flying Snow, Brother Bewitching Sword, these Scarlet Bamboo Fruits are greatly helpful for insects. I want them all.”
“Alright, you can have them.” Xue Ying and Swordmaster chuckled. The two of them did not have a use for things that were helpful for insects. They would only be used to exchange for other treasures.
…
“This is too amazing.”
On a gray river where the water was galloping, Xue Ying sat cross-legged watching the river.
The environment was shaped by the river. It continued meandering over a vast distance spanning approximately 50 billion kilometers.
Xue Ying felt the revolution of a higher dimensional Dao of Void. That was a unique application at the level of Chaotic Origin level.
“Xue Ying, let’s hurry up and leave! The Death Destruction Clan is here.”
“Big Brother Flying Snow, let us leave!”
Insect Ancestor and Swordmaster abruptly shouted.
“Go go go!”
Xue Ying who had stayed for a long time observing the gray river, immediately escaped with Insect Ancestor and Swordmaster.
******
Over the years, the three of them began exploring many sky-floating islands. They started exploring places that had more detailed information coupled with a lower difficulty. In these places, Xue Ying’s illusory realm technique could easily sweep away all ‘Kings’ and even influence ‘Emperors’ of the Death Destruction Clan. Swordmaster was incredibly powerful. His techniques had been perfected over the years. As for Insect Ancestor, his insects had already begun probing in all directions.
And the result-they actually succeeded in exploring 32 sky-floating islands. There were differing harvests in each of them. Some of the miraculous encounters that were helpful to cultivators were placed aside. Just the treasures added could make unparalleled existences envious.
Of course, the three of them would still distribute them accordingly.
Within the three of them, Xue Ying and Swordmaster focused more on cultivation. As for Insect Ancestor, he preferred exotic materials.
“This is mysterious.”
The 32 sky-floating islands where they explored one after another were done according to the provided intelligence. Hence, they were able to discover that mysterious gray eye in every island.
The structure of each eye had made Xue Ying feel engross as he observed and peered at the deepest level.
“Currently, I have examined a total of 33 mysterious eyes. 25 of them are gray eyes, and the remaining eight are golden. The gray eyes are formed from a type of illusory realm, and the golden eyes are formed from another.”
“The illusory realm of the gray eyes should be used to attract the enemies, causing them to lose themselves and be submerged into an illusion. As for the golden eyes, those are more of illusory realms that directly kill.”
Xue Ying was able to memorize the internal structures of those eyes easily. After all, he was the cultivator who stood at the apex in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm across many Origin Worlds! Naturally, he was able to deduce that the original master of those ‘gray eyes’ and ‘golden eyes’ should be a terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeform. That lifeform could only perfectly execute these inborn techniques. Instead, it did not understand the profoundness of those techniques.
As they entered the many sky-floating islands, Xue Ying would send his avatars to touch the eyes he discovered.
Every single contact would cause his avatar to be suppressed and destroyed. And it was at that moment where Xue Ying could perceive that frightening Chaotic Origin Lifeform.

chapters.title: Chapter 1215 - An enormous Lake
chapters.content:
Chapter 1215: An enormous Lake
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Even though Xue Ying could only vaguely perceive that Chaotic Origin Lifeform-he could not even count the number of ‘eyes’ accurately-Xue Ying could easily imagine what would happen when the dense number of eyes stared at the enemy. The enemy would fall into an illusory realm before being killed! With attacks coming from both fronts, even if the enemy survived, his soul would be heavily influenced, diminishing the combat power he could unleash.
‘Such a Chaotic Origin Lifeform is bigger than even a sacred world! I reckon a nation like Summer Wind Ancient Nation would easily be smashed into smithereens when this lifeform smash into it.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly. Fortunately, such terrifying existences were handled by other similarly powerful Chaotic Origin experts like ‘Yuan’ or ‘Luo City Lord’.
…
Over at the capital of Summer Wind Ancient Nation, within the Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
Underneath the low and thick Burning Heart God Tree, a white-robed young man sat cross-legged underneath its huge crown.
To prevent Undying Underworld Emperor from discovering him, this avatar cultivating under the Burning Heart God Tree had altered his appearance and aura. But given the security of the Summer Wind Capital and vigilance of the Fan Clan, it was almost impossible for Undying Underworld Emperor to extend his senses into this place.
“Hua.”
