Half of Great Emperor North River’s treasures would be given to him?
Xue Ying was clear how powerful this number one expert below Supremes, ‘Great Emperor North River’ was, and how many treasures he had! It was said that the treasures in ‘Broken Tooth Mountain Range’ was endless. It was even so alluring to cultivators that led them to take the risk and gamble their luck here. Nonetheless, in reality, most of the apex treasures had already been occupied!
The five Great Supremes, the eight Great Sages within the low-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, and the group of Great Emperors…
These who were powerful had already occupied all top-class treasures!
Only those items that they were disdainful were given to the cultivators to compete for.
“Why, you don’t believe me?” Great Emperor North River looked at Xue Ying.
“What does Great Emperor have in mind for saying these?” Xue Ying looked at Great Emperor North River.
“As I said before! My treasures and all treasures I get in the future will be split into half with you! Everything will be equally divided.” Great Emperor North River looked at Xue Ying, “I have never even mentioned this with any of my 36 god generals! You are the first person to be qualified for me to say these things to.”
“There is no free lunch in this world. I doubt the treasures of Great Emperor are that easily given.” Xue Ying said, “What do I have to fork out?”
“Hahaha… it isn’t something much either. As long as you become my sworn brother.” Great Emperor North River said, “You will also stand as my equal in the territory I have, as Great Emperor Flying Snow! Whatever you say is also my words.”
“Equal status?” Xue Ying frowned, “Then if I say we should stop invading those worlds?
“Then we shall stop!” Great Emperor North River laughed.
“What about the regions that Great Emperor has conquered earlier? Would they regain their freedom as well?” Xue Ying asked.
“As I said before, your words are mine!” Great Emperor North River looked at Xue Ying.
Xue Ying felt that Great Emperor North River was overly sincere.
He was willing to abandon the world.
And to split half his treasures with him. Why was that?
“Brother Flying Snow! You shouldn’t underestimate yourself.” Great Emperor North River laughed, “The reason why I did my best to conquer so many worlds is so that I have more experts that I can use! And for them to hear my orders. Only then could I gain more benefits in the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range, and only then can I get what I desire.”
“Currently, even with my name of the Great Emperor, most of my subordinates remain free and unfettered. There are few and far between who actually listen to my orders. Then what use is there for me to be a Great Emperor?” Great Emperor North River looked at Xue Ying, “But with your help, things would be different.”
“Before you, numbers have lost its meaning.”
Great Emperor North River shook his head, “The weaker god generals are simply a joke before you! And there are few on the level of God General Skeletal Dragon. Even though they can barely maintain their strength, it is meagre to me.”
Xue Ying agreed.
God General Skeletal Dragon was originally weaker by a level as compared to Great Emperor North River.
Before his illusory realm, the other party would have been left with 30% of his strength! The gap between him and Great Emperor North River would have been widened. It would be hard to say if he could escape alive from Great Emperor North River.
“Even other Great Emperors will similarly be weakened before you! I am originally ranked closest to becoming a Supreme. If the other Great Emperors are greatly weakened, they would no longer be my opponent.” Great Emperor North River looked at Xue Ying, “And even the five Great Supremes! The five Great Supremes are Emperors who have reached grand perfection. Their souls and initial Emperors have no qualitative differences. It’s only their will that is more extraordinary. Before your soul technique, their strength would still be weakened! By then, they are more or less comparable to me.”
“Hence, when both you and I work together, we can fight against even the Supremes!”
“When you and I work together, a group of Emperors working hand in hand is simply a joke before us.” Great Emperor North River looked at Xue Ying, “Even Supremes would have a hard time dealing with many Emperors working together. But we no longer have this flaw should we work together! It is an optimal combination that would give us the capabilities to move unhindered across the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range! The resources that we can get will far surpass what we have now!”
Great Emperor North River looked at Xue Ying: “Brother Flying Snow, you should understand my sincerity now!”
Xue Ying was enlightened.
That’s right.
Great Emperor North River was just slightly weaker than the Supremes. With his help, he could definitely fight against Supremes without losing! Even if there was a gap, it would be negligible.
As for jointly attacking them? They would all be a joke before his soul technique!
“What do the few of us cultivate until this stage for?” Great Emperor North River’s eyes were blazing with fervor, “That is to enter that mysterious Chaotic Origin level! At that level, only then can it be truly called jumping out of the cage! What we are now are still ants stuck within the cage.”
Xue Ying agreed in his heart.
Jump out of the cage?
When he peered into the higher dimension using the ‘Destruction Realm Teleportation Scouting Technique’, he could easily observe another nearby Origin World. Those that were further would be more fuzzy in his vision! He heard stories of how those who reached ‘final realm’ would have more magical techniques. Like Old Monster Stone, his body could exist everywhere-he could teleport across the entire Origin World.
That was a technique only a peak Cosmos God had.
If he could jump out of the cage, his techniques would simply be unimaginable! The closer he was to that level, the more he could feel how unique it was. That was the fundamental difference between getting out of the cage!
If the desire of Cosmos Gods to reach the ‘final realm’ was one unit, then the desire to get out of the cage would be a hundred units, a thousand units, or even ten thousand units!
“We Natives are different from you cultivators.” Great Emperor North River said, “Talking about which, we have the same origin as the Death Destruction Clan.”
Xue Ying felt his heart displacing.
“You do know that in the legends, there are two incredibly terrifying corpses of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms left in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range.” Great Emperor North River said, “These two corpses are from genuine Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, and the techniques they have are simply unfathomable. They had once fought with ‘Yuan’, and even injured Yuan. In the end, these two corpses were thrown into the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. They are so powerful, that the remnant aura left behind by them is sufficient to snuff ordinary Kings to death. It could even suppress Emperors!”
Xue Ying thought of those gray eyes and how his avatars would simply be wiped the moment they touched it.
“We Natives and the Death Destruction Clans can trace our origins to the two corpses of powerful Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.” Great Emperor North River said, “We Natives have a better time since our bodies are left with a trace of bloodline from the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms without dampening our intelligence. We can easily give birth to more children and reproduce further.”
“The Death Destruction Clan is different! Why is the Death Destruction Clan given this name? That’s because they had been given birth from death. They do not have any parents, and are purely given birth from the deathly aura in the sky-floating islands.” Great Emperor North River explained, “Hence, 99% of their clan do not have high intelligence and could be likened to that of wild beasts! They only know how to kill and devour!”
Great Emperor North River looked at Xue Ying: “And it’s because of the remains of those two great Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, that made us stronger than you cultivators. We have another so-called ‘Emperor realm’.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded.
Emperor realm.
That was indeed another level!
Within cultivators, even those who had ‘supreme secret impartation’ like Swordmaster, could only reach grand perfection King combat strength!
Those who had supreme-graded secret treasures as an external auxiliary support! Eternal Night Primogenitor, Ancestor Fan, Emperor Cang, Extreme Night Primogenitor, Towering Sky King and other unparalleled existences were also approximately at the grand perfection King level.
Emperor Summer and Undying Underworld Emperor had both reached the final realm in two Daos. Only then did they break apart this realm limit!
“The Emperor realm is too difficult for cultivators.” Xue Ying said.
“Difficult?” Great Emperor North River sneered, “I’ve heard the news that as the realm of cultivators deepen, some could even control the origin of an Origin World, becoming the master of the Origin World. With a huge Origin World as foundation, they would immediately become a powerful Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Some could spread a religion and make use of the masses will power to influence the origin of the Origin World and take control of the world. Some who have an even higher realm are more amazing-they can rely on their strength to break through! By relying on laws, they can forcibly reach a higher realm.”
“All of you have walked to where you are step by step since you were weak.”
“And once you reach the Chaotic Origin level, that is done on the basis of understanding the laws. Your utilization of energy is incomparably profound too.” Great Emperor North River bitterly said, “We are different. We might be overall stronger than you cultivators now, but that is merely because our clans have a more unique origin. What we cultivate is the strength of our bloodlines. This strength might allow us to power up very quickly at the start, but it’ll only be harder over time.”
“And to reach grand perfection Emperor! That is already the limit known to us.” Great Emperor North River said, “Yuan had once told our clans that as long as grand perfection Emperors take another step! We could then undergo the final awakening of our bloodlines. This would overturn our bloodlines, allowing us to become authentic ‘ancestors’ of our clans-that means we have become authentic Chaotic Origin Lifeforms too. As ancestors of our clans, this is a level that those low-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range could not compare.”
“But this step is achievable in the legends, yet none have ever done so in Broken Tooth Mountain Range.” Great Emperor North River looked at Xue Ying, “We feel that this final awakening of the bloodline is immensely difficult. Other than ourselves, we need all sorts of external materials to catalyse this evolution.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1231 - Great Benefactor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1231: Great Benefactor
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Don’t see how wild and borish the members of the Death Destruction Clan are, their Kings are quite intelligent, and their Emperors are naturally not stupid.” Great Emperor North River said, “Just like us Natives, the Death Destruction Clan is also pursuing after the final awakening and to metamorphosize! We are all competing for the precious external materials! As the Death Destruction Clan is given birth on the sky-floating islands, they have a greater advantage than us. They occupy a greater amount of resources.”
“Brother Flying Snow.” Great Emperor North River looked at Xue Ying, “I’ll need your help! When we work together, we have fewer flaws than even Supremes.”
Xue Ying looked at Great Emperor North River.
The eyes of Great Emperor North River were sincere.
Xue Ying was clear that they who had eternal life, would feel incredibly unsatisfied the moment they felt how they were like ants trapped in the cage. Naturally, an intense desire to jump out of the cage and increase their level of life would form.
But--
Xue Ying did not like the way Great Emperor North River did things!
For the sake of his goals, he would do things unscrupulously. Many worlds of the Natives, including some of the weaker ones did not plan on pledging loyalty to him. As a result, Great Emperor North River planned to kill all of them! He would rather exchange for those who would be subservient to him. By relying on these cruel methods, he planned to intimidate the Natives and force more worlds to pledge their loyalty to him.
‘He is too unscrupulous. It is not worth it to become sworn brothers with him.’ Xue Ying thought.
“Great Emperor.”
Xue Ying said, “If you and I work together, then what if some other experts and Supremes ask us for help in the future?”
“Naturally, we can’t promise that easily.” Great Emperor North River said, “Without your help, only then can we have a greater advantage! After all, the amount of resources is limited. Once others have them, we would have less.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying said, “Then I do hope for Great Emperor to forgive me. I temporarily do not wish to tie myself completely on this ship with you.”
Great Emperor North River was stunned. He was stunned momentarily.
“I very much prefer to be free. When I face many things, I like to decide for myself how I do things. I am not very willing to be tied together with another person.” Xue Ying said. Firstly, he did not like the personality of Great Emperor North River! Secondly, he did not really care about those resources that the Natives and Death Destruction Clan were desiring for! Cultivators paid more attention to the rise of their realms.
Since that’s the case, why would he tie himself together with Great Emperor North River and to kill and fight with him?
“You are willing to help the Starlight Clan, and some of the weaker worlds. Could you help me too?” Great Emperor North River looked at Xue Ying.
“Naturally I could.” Xue Ying chuckled, “But it depends on what it is.”
“Haha, I’ve long heard of the personality of Brother Flying Snow. You hate all evil, and should most likely not be used to the way I handle things.” Great Emperor North River chuckled, “But I really need your help to deal against a Supreme in the Death Destruction Clan.”
“Oh?”
Xue Ying understood, “Alright, this I can promise.”
Even though he had several techniques, he did not wish to infuriate Great Emperor North River either, causing him to leave behind the Starlight World and many other worlds in ruins!
Furthermore, the one he was dealing with was a Supreme from the Death Destruction Clan.
The Death Destruction Clan had three Supremes in total. But because they were all given birth from death, the three Supremes were all incredibly vicious and evil! They were all indubitably great devils! Fortunately, there was the presence of the two Native Supremes, hindering the three Supremes during crucial moments. Only then could the Natives live such peaceful days.
“I dare not think about this previously, but now that there is Brother Flying Snow around, I am slightly confident.” Great Emperor North River was greatly delighted when he heard the promise of Xue Ying, “I have to prepare properly. Once I am done, I’ll inform Brother Flying Snow.”
“I’ll leave behind an avatar in the Starlight world. If Great Emperor plans on finding me, you can visit the Starlight World.” Xue Ying said.
“Alright. I’ll definitely not mistreat you for helping me out.” Great Emperor North River chuckled, “My original plan of invading the worlds will be stopped at this moment. It can be considered as making amends for what I did previously.”
Xue Ying’s happiness grew when heard that: “Then I have to thank Great Emperor. I believe many worlds will also feel gratitude for you, Great Emperor.”
“They should be thankful to you!” Great Emperor North River replied.
…
After chatting with Great Emperor North River, they left.
Xue Ying went off with the incarnation of Starlight Master.
“We are leaving just like that?” Starlight Master transmitted a question.
“Mn.”
“Great Emperor has created such a huge disturbance. This Magpie Flower Banquet is meant to welcome you, yet after exchanging a few words, he let you off just like this?” Starlight Master was filled with sweat.
Xue Ying glanced at him without saying much. He simply flew out.
“Wait for me!” Starlight Master’s incarnation immediately chased after him.
This incarnation was not important! But that piece of ‘Magpie Flower petal’ was immensely so!
…
After this banquet ended.
The name of Monarch Flying Snow gradually spread out. It was especially startling to the higher-ups of the Natives across the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range.
‘Oh? His soul technique could easily cause Emperors to fall for it. Even God General Wind Smoke fell instantaneously to his technique?’ A tall and thin violet-robed old man thought. His aura was abnormally terrifying. It spread out in all directions, causing lightning to form from nothing and snake around him. He was one of the two Supremes the Natives had, ‘Supreme Lightning Firmament’.
He had awakened his bloodline to grand perfection and could feel the energy from another level.
That was a terrifying energy.
And he sought to grasp it. To do so, he had to jump out of this world and out of the laws set by ‘Yuan’. Only then could he penetrate through the endless space and enter all sorts of mysterious grounds.
‘I’ve never heard of such soul techniques, though I believe even Supremes have to spend quite a lot of heart force to resist against it.’ The violet-robed old man thought, ‘That North River is quite cunning. He immediately went to invite that Monarch Flying Snow at the first instance.’
…
‘Monarch Flying Snow? There actually exists someone with this soul technique?’
The entire body of Supreme Vast Ancient was surrounded with a heat wave. Those who were slightly weaker could not even look at him with their eyes. Supreme Vast Ancient naturally emitted a eye-piercing light that was like a huge fireball.
‘Even though his direct combat skills are ordinary, so low that it can be ignored, his soul technique could even affect me. It appears that an amazing expert has appeared from the Realm Heart Great Land.’ Supreme Vast Ancient thought. Over the years, he had never cared about the cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land. But this time, he had to think twice.
Even in his heart, the ‘threat’ from this Monarch Flying Snow was higher than from the Great Emperors.
…
‘This North River is cunning enough. He immediately took the initiative to invite Monarch Flying Snow and even organized a banquet! His actions are fast enough. By the time I got the news, it is too late.’ A black-robed single-horned male shook his head slightly.
…
‘I am a step too slow. Hopefully, that Monarch Flying Snow doesn’t choose to join North River.’ The World Energy condensed into an absolute beauty. She watched from the distance in the direction of the Starlight World, murmuring to herself, “North River is incredibly ambitious. The other three Great Emperors under His Majesty Supreme Vast Ancient have been schemed by him even, losing the gambling match. This time, if he has the help from that Monarch Flying Snow, my clan might just have a third Supreme appearing.’
******
The news spread naturally fast across the higher-ups of the Natives. Everyone was paying notice to this Monarch Flying Snow.
And Xue Ying had returned to the Starlight World in the meantime.
There was also news that spread soon after-
The army of Great Emperor North River that was originally intending to invade the Native Worlds, had completely retreated!
“They have completely retreated.”
“The entire army under Great Emperor North River has retreated. The region originally governed by Great Emperor Glorious Earth has also regained its freedom.”
“The retreating army has even declared that Great Emperor North River has agreed to Monarch Flying Snow’s request to stop invading those worlds!”
“It is Monarch Flying Snow’s sympathy for those worlds that Great Emperor North River agreed to retreat.”
Many pieces of news were spreading like wildfire.
Most of those worlds had already become despondent over their situation. Now that the army of Great Emperor North River had retreated, their hometown was able to regain its usual peace. They could return and live their lives freely as in the past. Only after regaining their freedom from ‘despair’ did they learn how to appreciate their freedom more.
And they knew that Monarch Flying Snow had an agreement with Great Emperor North River, which was why Great Emperor North River chose to retreat.
Various parties were filled with gratitude.
This was a huge favor garnered by saving everybody’s hometown worlds! This was a huge favor of saving their clans!
“Great benefactor!”
“Monarch Flying Snow has saved our clan!”
“Given the personality of Great Emperor North River, it is impossible for him to stop invading for no reasons. After all, given that it is such a huge territory, Monarch Flying Snow should have done something for him to give it up.”
“It’s all thanks to Monarch Flying Snow.”
Many worlds sent out their teams to Starlight World so as to visit this great benefactor of theirs, ‘Monarch Flying Snow’.
…
Many teams came continuously.
“Monarch.”
“Monarch Flying Snow.”
These emissaries originated from different worlds. Many of them were brought personally by the World Master of a territory. Their eyes were all filled with incredible gratitude when they visited Xue Ying. They had all prepared their gifts! Such a huge favor of saving their hometown and their clan… was something they could not restrain on! Whatever they thought would be useful to this cultivator, ‘Monarch Flying Snow’, they had them prepared.
When Xue Ying faced these teams that came without stopping, he was slightly dumbstruck when he saw the treasures that piled up like a mountain.
‘It seems Great Emperor North River deliberately mentioned about me asking a plea of leniency for them? So that he is making me the benefactor of those clans?’ Xue Ying understood the way Great Emperor North River think.

chapters.title: Chapter 1232 - Treasures piled up like Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 1232: Treasures piled up like Mountain
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
‘He is afraid that even though I might promise to help him, I could still scheme against him without using my full strength during critical moments?’ Xue Ying thought. At the same time, he was dealing with the teams coming from different worlds. Those who were leading the teams-the World Masters and the Elders were filled with gratitude towards Xue Ying. They came to thank him profusely.
“Great Benefactor Monarch, my Floating Origin World is truly unable to repay this great favor of saving my clan. From now on, if there are any orders, Monarch can just tell us and my Floating Origin World will definitely do it!”
“Monarch Flying Snow, we were total strangers previously, and because of Monarch’s sympathy, our clan has been saved…”
Those who came to visit him were exhibiting their emotions through speeches.
The eyes of some visitors were brimming red, and some even cried tears of joy! Their tears were not just filled with gratitude. Instead, it came thinking back how many clansmen had sacrificed their lives for the clan!
It was arduous time.
Fortunately, the presence of Monarch Flying Snow saved their worlds.
And Xue Ying did not put on airs. Instead, he received them one by one. He even organized a great banquet for many of the teams originating from different world to participate.
“Monarch Flying Snow is indeed extraordinary.”
“With the identity of Monarch, even weaker god generals are forced down before him. Those on the level of God General Skeletal Dragon would be greatly weakened as well. With such a strength, Monarch is still treating us so politely.”
“I’ve heard that Monarch has single-handedly intimidated all devils in Realm Heart Great Land while saving many others at the same time.”
“Ah! Do share everything you know about Monarch in the Realm Heart Great Land!”
Many parties were discussing about it during the banquet.
They came from different worlds. In the past, some of them might not have any relationship with one another! And some were even enemies! But today, they had a common benefactor-Monarch Flying Snow! This resulted in the banquet being held at full swing, with the atmosphere being exceptionally vibrant. That’s because everyone understood that their hometowns would no longer suffer from any invasions from now on.
As long as the Great Emperor North River did not attack them!
Then their hometowns would be very safe. Because this belonged to the territory of Great Emperor North River, and other Great Emperors would not be qualified to act.
…
It was during this banquet that Xue Ying met and acquiesced with many World Masters. He also received an incredible amount of presents.
‘So many presents.’
‘It has even piled up to a mountain.’
Xue Ying sat at the banquet extending his senses into the storage Eden World. He could see the mountain-like gifts piled there.
Many of these treasures even gave off a grand aura.
There were two supreme-graded secret treasures! And a total of 106 top-graded secret treasures! As for the precious materials, they could not be counted.
‘Madness. This is madness.’ Xue Ying was slightly numb, ‘Right now, I should be the wealthiest cultivator across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.’
Others said that there were innumerable treasures in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, yet in reality, the Natives were stronger! As they went on many expeditions, most of the treasures had ended up in their hands! For instance, supreme-graded secret treasures, top-graded secret treasures… these treasures had extraordinary aurae and one could easily discern how precious they were! Even though the Natives attempted to use them, it ended up to no avail as they cultivated primarily on their bloodline!
But even if they could not use them, they would still keep them when they saw one!
For instance, Extreme Night Primogenitor and others once devoured a great deal of Natives, stealing a huge amount of treasures from the Natives too. There were unparalleled existences who came to transact with the Natives as well! It’s just that what the Natives needed were incredibly rare. Most of them were items that were of help to improve their bloodlines. Most of these treasures were usually required by the Death Destruction Clan too!
And the difficulty of acquiring those items on the sky-floating islands was much harder than finding any top-graded secret treasures!
‘The many worlds have even discovered two pieces of supreme-graded secret treasures. One is of the Dao of Flame and the other of the Dao of Strength.’ Xue Ying thought. For instance, Eight Silk Island Master cultivated in the Dao of Strength. If he acquired this mysterious pole, he would immediately become an unparalleled existence! And ‘Sacred Fire City Master’ cultivated the Dao of Flames.
It’s a pity that both Sacred Fire City Master and Eight Silk Island Master were great devils. It was impossible for Xue Ying to trade with them.
‘Emperor Summer should have cultivated the Dao of Flames and Dao of Void.’ Xue Ying thought. Emperor Summer currently only had a void-type supreme-graded secret treasure!
‘Top-graded secret treasures…’
Xue Ying mumbled to himself.
There were many of such treasures! The Summer Wind Ancient Nation was one of the six great ancient nations. The Fan Clan had six Great Paragons, the Summer Clan had nine Great Paragons, and the Cang Clan had seven Great Paragons. There were also a group of Paragon Masters that were not from the three great clans like Great Paragon Fu Yi and other minority who owned several top-graded secret treasures. But adding all of them up, there would only be a total of a dozen top-graded secret treasures.
He himself had more than a hundred! That was more than what an ancient nation had accumulated over a long period!
‘After all, they were given by so many Native Worlds.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly. Adding up the huge amount of precious materials, his wealth had indeed leaped across almost all unparalleled existences. Even Undying Underworld Emperor who once attempted to charge along the path of becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform might not be as rich as he!
‘There are a total of nine void-related top-graded secret treasures, with three stronger than the Void Fire Lotus Flower.’ Xue Ying sighed.
Some of the top-graded secret treasures in Realm Heart Great Land had been acquired from the Realm Heart God Palace. Some were from the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. Others had been refined by final realm experts!
And those in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range…
Were almost all left by ‘Yuan’.
Yuan left behind many opportunities for the cultivators.
He wanted the cultivators to fight and compete for them! He even wanted them to fight with the Natives! Who would have thought that Xue Ying had actually done something that made many Native Worlds grateful to him. And as a result, these worlds even flipped their storage so as to find useful treasures for cultivators to give them to their benefactor! After all, giving these items used by cultivators would not make them feel as heart-aching as giving materials that were greatly useful for the Natives. They were definitely willing.
Supreme-graded secret treasures were precious, though they could not use them! They would only be using these treasures to trade with the cultivators from Realm Heart Great Land. For the sake of thanking their benefactor, they could simply give them away!
The banquet ended soon after.
Xue Ying executed his Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to send those treasures back to his Flying Snow City.
‘Where shall I go next?’ Xue Ying flipped through the sets of intelligence reports on the sky-floating islands. They had been given by the many worlds. With this huge amount of intelligence provided, Xue Ying’s understanding of the Broken Tooth Mountain Range’s sky-floating islands had immediately surpassed all others from the Realm Heart Great Land!
‘Wu.’
‘There are still 1,200 other islands containing the mysterious eyes.’ Xue Ying nodded, ‘Indeed, the Blood Flame Clan alone can’t make up for number. I have to think of some ways of exploring all 1,200 islands.’
‘But I’m not in a rush either. Even though cultivating the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm might be important, it isn’t as important as that of the Dao of Void.’
His hometown Origin World was becoming bigger, and the date of the apocalypse was looming ever closer.
Xue Ying had to reach the final realm in the Dao of Void before the Great Apocalypse!
‘Islands that are useful to my cultivation of the Dao of Void.’ Xue Ying pondered, ‘According to the intelligence, there are quite a few sky-floating islands with opportunities left behind for the Dao of Void. But first, those opportunities are not as helpful to me as the ‘World Flowers’ bestowed by Luo City Lord! Secondly, I have experienced quite a few opportunities in the 500 over sky-floating islands I’ve been to in the past. Hence, right now, what I need is to meditate and consolidate my comprehension.’
‘And when talking about meditating, there is indeed a supreme treasure within the Broken Tooth Mountain Range.’
‘The Seven Bell Pagoda!’
Xue Ying’s eyes brightened.
The Seven Bell Pagoda was a treasure similar to the ‘Burning Heart God Tree’ or ‘Origin Realm God Palace’ in the Realm Heart Great Land. They did not have to be controlled.
Nonetheless, the Seven Bell Pagoda was much stronger than the Burning Heart God Tree and Origin Realm God Palace. It was even considered as the number one supreme treasure for meditating and cultivation in Broken Tooth Mountain Range. Even though they were not as important to the Natives and the Death Destruction Clan, they were similarly competing for it in madness. Eventually, it ended up in the hands of ‘Great Emperor Shamanic Wind’.
The Seven Bell Pagoda was incredibly special. It had seven bells hanging by the side of the pagoda. The moment one lightly pushed them with his energy, the seven bells would ring consecutively. The ringing sound would then pull the cultivators into a mysterious state of cultivation.
Nonetheless, it could only be rung once every trillion years.
After being sounded once, the bells would no longer give out any sound even if one pushed them. One had to wait for a trillion years before the bells would regain its mysterious energy.
Those Great Emperors who cultivated their bloodline and even Supremes had once made a trade with ‘Great Emperor Shamanic Wind’ in exchange for a round of training! Cultivating in that state of mind, they would have a much easier time trying to comprehend their own bloodline.
‘I feel that I have accumulated sufficiently in the Dao of Void. I have a supreme secret impartation guiding me, and I have even created five great killing techniques. I also experienced training in more than 500 sky-floating islands. If I were to enter closed-door cultivation now, I might be able to have a breakthrough,’ Xue Ying thought. It would definitely be helpful for Xue Ying to enter closed-door cultivation in the number one supreme treasure for meditation in Broken Tooth Mountain Range.
‘Time to visit Great Emperor Shamanic Wind!’
Xue Ying left behind an avatar at the Starlight Clan. At the same time, he secretly left for the ‘Shaminic Wind World’.
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind was similarly a subordinate of Supreme Vast Ancient! His strength was comparable to the Great Sages of low-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. But in a gambling match not too long ago, including him and two other Great Emperors, they had all lost to Great Emperor North River! They did not publicize their gambling match. If they really entered a life and death battle, it was hard to say who would win or lose since their strengths were quite similar.

chapters.title: Chapter 1233 - Great Emperor Shamanic Wind
chapters.content:
Chapter 1233: Great Emperor Shamanic Wind
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Hu.”
Xue Ying easily penetrated through the void. In the blink of an eye, he arrived at the Shamanic Wind World.
Being the world of a Great Emperor, Shamanic Wind World had incredibly strict security. The moment Xue Ying entered this world, he did not even have the time to enjoy the view when he heard a furious roar.
“You actually dared to intrude the Shamanic Wind World!” A furious roar reverberated through the world.
A group of soldiers penetrated through the void before appearing where Xue Ying was. The leading soldier currently glared at Xue Ying.
“I’ll have to trouble you to convey the word that I wish to see Great Emperor Shamanic Wind.” Xue Ying said.
“Hmph, you still dare to be unreasonable! What kind of identity does the Great Emperor have? Do you think he is someone you can meet anytime you want?” The leading soldier retorted, “Hurry up and scram! It is still possible for us to spare your life. Otherwise, don’t blame us for being merciless.”
The identity of the Great Emperor was incredibly high.
They acted on the behalf of the Supremes in governing a large region! Many ‘World Masters’ of various worlds were usually unqualified from meeting the Great Emperor.
The aura of World Masters were at the initial Emperor level, yet they were not qualified to meet the Great Emperor. Xue Ying’s aura was much weaker. Hence, why would these soldiers care about him?
“I am Monarch Flying Snow. I am here especially to meet Great Emperor Shamanic Wind.” Xue Ying asked once again. Since he came to ask the other party for help, his attitude was naturally better. He reported his name, and hopefully, these soldiers would know about him.
“Monarch Flying Snow? What Monarch Flying Snow! What gall for you to dare call yourself a Monarch!” The leading soldier roared, “Soldiers, move out and bring him away!”
Xue Ying felt awkward at that moment.
It appeared the other party had never heard his name before?
He reckoned that the previous banquet would result in his name being spread practically to all people in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range.
But apparently, he was wrong!
His name did spread rapidly across those of the highest level in Broken Tooth Mountain Range. As for those who originated from the territory initially governed by ‘Great Emperor Glorious Earth’, since the invading army had retreated, those worlds would know of Xue Ying.
Nonetheless, other regions… if their statuses were sufficiently high, they would receive the news. For those who had a lower status, they actually did not know of Monarch Flying Snow!
There was also another reason!
Xue Ying came too quickly! He immediately came to pay Great Emperor Shamanic Wind a visit after receiving the World Masters. If there was a gap in between his visit, it was possible that his reputation would spread, and other experts at least of the ‘King’ level would know about him. But for now? This news had not spread out among those at a weaker level!
“Hong.”
When the leading soldier gave the order, the other soldiers immediately moved.
“Hold!”
A terrifying ripple descended. That came from an Emperor. One could see a green-robed lady walking out from the void. The terrifying power from her had engulfed that group of soldiers.
“God General Aviary Feather.” These soldiers who startled and immediately greeted when they saw a god general. Even though Great Emperor Shamanic Wind did not have as many god generals as Great Emperor North River had-he had a total of eight! But Great Emperor Shamanic Wind trusted them, and these god generals had great power.
“Greetings Monarch Flying Snow.” The green-robed girl bowed with a smile at Xue Ying,” These patrols have yet to hear of Monarch’s name. I hope for Monarch to forgive their ignorance.”
The other soldiers were dumbstruck when they saw that.
God General Aviary Feather actually treated this white-robed young man with such great politeness?
“Why aren’t you apologizing to the Monarch!” The green-robed lady reprimanded the soldiers.
These soldiers were at a loss. Few Natives dared to call themselves Monarchs. Where did this Monarch Flying Snow come from?
Even though they did not understand what was happening in their hearts, they still bowed respectfully: “Please forgive us, Monarch!”
“I can’t blame you for this.” Xue Ying chuckled. After gaining the gratitude of so many World Masters, he thought his name had spread across all Natives.
“The Emperor is incredibly delighted that Monarch Flying Snow has arrived at our Shamanic Wind World. He sent me to welcome you. Who would have thought that an accident had almost happened with these patrols.” The green-robed girl enthusiastically said, “Monarch, please.”
“Please.”
Both parties immediately broke through the void and headed towards the Shamanic Wind God Palace.
Leaving behind those soldiers who were still at a loss.
“Monarch Flying Snow? Which monarch is this? There are a total of eight Monarchs under the two Supremes, but never have we heard of one called Monarch Flying Snow. We should have known about it if a new Great Emperor emerges.”
“Nope, I have never heard of him either.”
“But Madam God General treated him with such politeness. Even though we have never heard of him before, the Great Emperor still sent God General Aviary Feather over to personally welcome him.”
“I’ll ask general and see if he knows.”
They began transmitting their questions around.
Those at the highest-level in Shamanic Wind World did know about it.
“What?”
“Some of the weaker god generals have fallen immediately before Monarch Flying Snow? Their lives are under the control of him?”
“Even the number two god general under Great Emperor North River, ‘God General Skeletal Dragon’, suffered from a huge loss of his power when fighting against Monarch Flying Snow. He was actually forced to escape before an ordinary World Master from the Starlight World?”
“Great Emperor North River has befriended this Monarch Flying Snow, and gave an order to give up on conquering all words that belonged to Great Emperor Glorious Earth originally?”
These soldiers could not help but be dumbstricken when they heard the news.
Great Emperor North River did not treat Great Emperor Shamanic Wind so politely. Hearing that Great Emperor North River even schemed to win the gambling match for the territories of Great Emperor Glorious Earth, yet he chose to give up those territories because of Monarch Flying Snow? That was madness!
“No matter what, his origin is huge.” These soldiers understood this point. Ordinary Emperors would be swept by this Monarch easily. He was not someone they could offend.
******
Shamanic Wind God Palace.
“I’ve just heard the news regarding Monarch Flying Snow and is still lamenting about the fact that there is such an expert under this world who could cause Emperors to fall into an illusion. Yet who would have thought that Monarch is here to visit me. That is simply making me delighted.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind took the initiative to welcome Xue Ying.
“Great Emperor is being too polite.” Xue Ying was also scrutinizing Great Emperor Shamanic Wind.
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind had a saber by his waist. His hair was draped over his shoulders, and his robes were loose. He seemed to be a casual and unconstrained person.
“Come come come, come and have a seat. Monarch came to our Broken Tooth Mountain Range from the Realm Heart Great Land. Even though you spent quite some time at the Starlight World, I believe you have yet to enjoy many of the unique delicacies and wines in Broken Tooth Mountain Range right?” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind passionately laughed. At this moment, many female servants brought over good food and wine. Great Emperor Shamanic Wind did not treat other Monarchs so politely even.
But it was clear his treatment towards Xue Ying was different.
Because he was competing with other Great Emperors! And Xue Ying was a cultivator, and only cared about his realm. He did not care about those items that were of help to the bloodline.
Previously, Great Emperor Shamanic Wind and other Monarchs were still worried that this ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ might have joined Great Emperor North River and be completely tied onto the ship of Great Emperor North River! Now that Monarch Flying Snow is here to visit him, it seems he should not have agreed to join the ship of Great Emperor North River.
One party had the heart to befriend another, and the other party had something to request for.
Naturally, both host and guest chatted happily.
“I wonder what Brother Flying Snow is here for? Do tell me about it.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind finally said.
“Great Emperor, we cultivators care more about our realms. I came this time with the hope of borrowing the Seven Bell Pagoda for cultivation.” Xue Ying said, “I know that the Seven Bell Pagoda is publicly recognized as the ‘number one supreme treasure for meditation and cultivation’ in Broken Tooth Mountain Range. And after activating it, it could no longer be used for the next trillion years. I came this time to ask Great Emperor for help in this matter. Whatever matter Great Emperor has in mind, Great Emperor can tell me too.”
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind chuckled when he heard that.
Even though the treasure could only be used once every trillion years…
In reality, he had consumed enough! Even if he used the treasure more, it would no longer be helpful to his bloodline. He usually used it for trading with others.
“This is a minor matter.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind chuckled, “As for my conditions, I do have a small request that I wish Brother Flying Snow could accept.”
“Great Emperor do tell.” Xue Ying let out a sigh of relief.
“I wish for Monarch to send a few avatars with me to Emperor Yan Island.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind said, “No matter if this matter ends in success or failure, Brother Flying Snow can use the Seven Bell Pagoda once it is done.”
Xue Ying had gotten so much intelligence, so he naturally knew what place the Emperor Yan Island was.
Emperor Yan was one of the ’13 Emperors’ beneath the three Great Supremes of the Death Destruction Clan. They were comparable to the Great Emperors in strength! These 13 Emperors from the Death Destruction Clan had occupied the best few sky-floating islands in the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range. They were incomparably huge and were filled with dangers. The ambient danger of the island was fine. Yet this ‘Emperor Yan Island’ was also the island with the most experts in the 13 Emperor sky-floating islands!
‘With Monarch Flying Snow’s help, I will no longer be afraid of being ambushed by a group of enemies.’ Great Emperor Shamanic Wind was joyful in his heart. Previously, he had wanted to ask Monarch Flying Snow for help, yet this Monarch Flying Snow was asked over by Great Emperor North River already! In the blink of an eye, Monarch Flying Snow actually took the initiative to visit him! Since the other party had a request, he could simply ask the other party for help. Both parties could gain what they wished and this would end up in a win-win situation!

chapters.title: Chapter 1234 - Entering Emperor Yan Island
chapters.content:
Chapter 1234: Entering Emperor Yan Island
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying accepted without hesitation. Great Emperor Shamanic Wind was also happy with the outcome. They began planning in detail what they should do next.
“I understand.”
“I know. Great Emperor can be rest assured.” Xue Ying nodded while he listened.
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind explained the plan once through before reminding once again: “Finally, Brother Flying Snow, it is best if you conceal your aura and disguise your appearances. Your name should have already spread across the strongest experts in the Natives. Even though news spread relatively slowly within the Death Destruction Clan, Emperor Yan is ultimately one of the 13 top Emperors. It has also the most subordinates. Hence, its source of information is relatively quicker. Perhaps it might have heard of some news related to you. If it recognized you immediately, things might be troublesome since it could prepare for your arrival!”
“Alright. It will certainly be unable to recognize me.” Xue Ying was filled with confidence. Ever since he created the number one killing technique using the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, his skills of disguise had become very much profound. Even his body would exist as part of the illusion. Hence, he was definitely the person with the best disguising means in Realm Heart Great Land.
“I will have to make some preparations. Shall we set off tomorrow?” Both eyes of Great Emperor Shamanic Wind were emitting light.
“I can move out at any time.” Xue Ying directly answered.
…
On the next day.
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind brought along five god generals and Xue Ying with him towards the ‘Emperor Yan Island’. Great Emperor Shamanic Wind had too few god generals-a total of eight! He selected five god generals that were the strongest of them. Ultimately, Great Emperor Shamanic Wind relied on certain alluring terms or relationship with those god generals to make them willing to toil for him.
“We are at the Emperor Yan Island.”
After teleporting over.
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind, Xue Ying, and the others stood at the void looking at the incomparably huge sky-floating island. A cold and dark aura could be felt congregating above the sky-floating island. This island was so big that it startled Xue Ying, and the reason was that this was his first time seeing such a huge island!
“After entering the Emperor Yan Island, we’ll act according to the plan.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind said. He was mainly staring at the five god generals under him, “We can’t afford to fail. If we fail just once, we would reveal Monarch Flying Snow, making Emperor Yan wary about him. Even if we could ask Monarch Flying Snow for help the next time, it might not be as easy.”
“Monarch, please be rest assured.”
“We’ll act according to the orders of Monarch.” The five god generals spent most of their time enjoying their freedom. But at this moment, they understood how important this task was. Great Emperor Shamanic Wind looked forward to obtaining that ‘precious treasure’, and it was only due to the rise of Monarch Flying Snow did he gain hope that it was possible to do so! The moment he failed, Great Emperor Shamanic Wind would definitely turn mad.
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind looked at Xue Ying: “In a while, we’ll have to rely on Brother Flying Snow.”
“We would still have to rely on Great Emperor and fellow god generals for the main combat.” Xue Ying chuckled back.
“Without Monarch Flying Snow, we would only be forced out.”
“Only with Monarch Flying Snow do we have the confidence.”
The five god generals were straightforward. They did not show any signs of arrogance before Monarch Flying Snow. An expert who was undoubtedly the strongest in the ‘Dao of Soul’ across Realm Heart Great Land and Broken Tooth Mountain Range was something that would make even the five Great Supremes think twice! After all, the soul of an expert was still ultimately the root of one’s existence!
“Move out.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind lightly ordered.
“Sou sou sou sou sou sou sou!”
The seven of them immediately charged downwards into the Emperor Yan Island. They also contacted against the cold and dark aura pervading Emperor Yan Island. The moment their bodies contacted the aura, Xue Ying could not help but tremble. This was a frosty feeling that pervaded entirely through his body! Even though his fleshy body was sufficiently strong, he still could not help but feel uncomfortable.
‘This is indeed the Emperor Yan Island. In the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range, it should be ranked in the top ten islands.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Such an island would definitely have a tremendous amount of opportunities. But at the same time, it is incredibly dangerous. None in the history of Realm Heart Great Land could truly infiltrate the entire island.’
Emperor Yan was ranked middle in terms of personal strength between the 13 Emperors. Nonetheless, he was ranked first in terms of the overall organizational strength! He was the emperor with the most subordinates! Just by relying on the huge number of subordinates he had, he was able to scour through and occupy an incredible amount of treasures on this sky-floating island. At the same time, this island had strict security. It was certain for intruders to be discovered quickly. Given the strength of the cultivators in Realm Heart Great Land, even Emperor Summer could not break through the outermost sentries.
Penetrating through the fog-like dark aura, the seven of them felt their surroundings changing. They had arrived on the island.
The plants and trees on the Emperor Yan Island were all dark. They seemed distorted and monstrous!
“Proceed ahead.”
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind did not hesitate. He immediately release an unseen force that covered the other six members of the exploration party, imbuing the group with a gale that allowed them to advance forward.
It was incredibly fast! Swordmaster could never compare with the speed Great Emperor Shamanic Wind was currently traveling at!
‘This speed.’ Xue Ying felt speechless. He was indeed the Great Emperor Shamanic Wind, the Great Emperor ranked top in terms of speed in the Natives. Nonetheless, the opponent this time, ‘Emperor Yan’, was similarly ranked in the top within the 13 Emperors with his speed.
The seven of them were wrapped like a bun.
This lump of wind did not seem to suffer from any hindrances as it traveled through the forest.
“Intruders!” The security of Emperor Yan Island was ultimately too strict. Just a few breaths later, Great Emperor Shamanic Wind, Xue Ying and the others had been discovered by a sentry.
“Elder, we discovered intruders.” The sentry immediately reported upwards.
…
Being wrapped by the wind force, Xue Ying and the others were traveling at an unfathomable speed. It was so fast that Xue Ying could not discern his surroundings with his naked eyes. He could only rely on his domain to perceive his surroundings.
This was the strength of a Great Emperor! Great Emperor Shamanic Wind who was famous for his speed, could easily travel at speeds that Kings could not even discern clearly at all!
“Hong~”
A horrific ripple descended. This forceful wave exploded, destroying many trees in the surrounding region of spanning more than 50 million kilometers.
A towering giant covered in scales stood there with its hands raised aloft. It was currently carrying a huge hammer. Itts figure was so big that ordinary trees were merely at the height of his knee. This scaled giant opened its mouth, revealing its sharp teeth. It grinned, letting out a world-shaking laughter that rolled out in waves, causing the world to tremble: “Hahaha, isn’t this Great Emperor Shamanic Wind? Previously, you have been forced out by us, battered and exhausted. Why aren’t you learning from your lesson? Why are you here seeking to be beaten again? I urge you to scram! Otherwise, there is no need for my master Emperor Yan to act. Just the few of us Elders is sufficient to force you into an escape. I remembered you have been kicked fiercely on the butt by my brother, right? Hahaha…”
Xue Ying was startled when he saw that.
This scaled giant should be an elder responsible for the outer perimeter security of Emperor Yan Island! In terms of his strength, it felt so much stronger than the ‘Emperor’ that Xue Ying encountered on the very first sky-floating island he ventured in Broken Tooth Mountain Range. This was nothing out of the ordinary though since the other party was an elder of ‘Emperor Yan’, one of the 13 strongest Emperors.
“How impudent!”
“Arrogant!”
At that moment, there were god generals shouting back angrily!
Of the five god generals Great Emperor Shamanic Wind brought along, one of them spat out, “hong-”
A black flame vaguely glowing in violet light burst out immediately into the world. The surrounding trees that caught fire turn into nothingness instantaneously. The flames also engulfed that elder. At that moment, the scaled giant furiously moved the huge hammer in its hands. Nonetheless, the flame was shapeless. It easily wrapped around the giant, burning that scaled giant and causing him to howl in agony.
“I asked you to scram yet you don’t? Then we shall wait and see!” The scaled giant did not think of just relying on itself to fight against Great Emperor Shamanic Wind. Its original intention was to chide this Great Emperor Shamanic Wind and ask him to scram! Even though Great Emperor Shamanic Wind had killed his way many times in history over, he had never succeeded in entering the core of the island.
The scaled giant teleported and disappeared from the vicinity.
…
The rules amongst the Natives were rigid.
But the internal regulations inside the Death Destruction Clan were laxer. Even the elders of the Emperor with the most subordinates, ‘Emperor Yan’, could meet it directly anytime.
Emperor Yan Palace.
This was a palace that mimicked the architecture of the Natives. This palace was constructed with the support from a huge mountain nearby, and was relatively big.
“Hu.”
The scaled giant entered the palace. It took several steps before arriving within a desolate enormous hall. With a glance, it saw the seated Emperor Yan on a cold crystalline bed! Emperor Yan was slightly thin and seemingly shriveled. Its entire body was covered in a layer of scales. It also had a pair of scaled wings. The Emperor sat just like that on the crystalline bed with its claws laying against its knees, with its back slightly hunched and its scaly wings covering the upper half of its body. Its eyes were close as if it was deep asleep.
“Emperor Yan, that Great Emperor Shamanic Wind has come again!” The scaled giant immediately announced after entering the hall. His voice echoed across the palace, causing the place to shake slightly from it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1235 - It’s him, Monarch Flying Snow!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1235: It’s him, Monarch Flying Snow!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The eyelids of Emperor Yan twitched before it slowly opened its eyes. A pair of silver eyes stared at that scaled giant standing within the huge palace hall: “Shamanic Wind is here again?”
“Right. He brought along six subordinates. I showed myself to ask them out, yet this Great Emperor Shamanic Wind actually retaliated.” The scaled giant muttered. He already recovered from the light burn he had.
Emperor Yan’s control of this sky-floating island had already reached an incredibly high degree. By relying on the dark aura pervading across the island, Emperor Yan could easily perceive a ‘thread of wind’ moving at high speed. This thread of wind seemed gentle and silent, yet it was filled with great tyranny.
“Hmph.” Emperor Yan lightly moved its claws.
It easily tore through the space and cause a projection on another location on the island to appear.
A lump of wind could be seen moving at high speed.
Within this lump of wind were Great Emperor Shamanic Wind, Xue Ying, and the five god generals. At this moment, Xue Ying had disguised his aura to be similar with that of the five god generals.
“He’s here again! He really doesn’t know when to give up.” Emperor Yan frowned. A strand of killing aura could be seen forming from him. It was incredibly prideful. Even though it was ranked in the middle between the 13 Emperors, with the large number of experts it had, it was slightly disdainful of the other 12 Emperors! As a result, its status within the Death Destruction Clan was comparable to that of Great Emperor North River. Great Emperor North River also had 36 god generals beneath him! But Great Emperor North River was personally stronger-his strength was closest to that of a Supreme.
“I can’t even kill him, and now he is here to torment me again.” Emperor Yan felt frustrated.
“Everyone, come over!”
Emperor Yan directly shouted out.
The sound echoed by the ears of every elder in the sky-floating island.
“Sou sou sou sou sou sou…”
Many elders immediately rushed over after hearing the order from their Ancestor Yan. Even if they were asleep, these elders immediately awoke and came over.
It took some time! Ultimately, those elders that were asleep had to take more time.
“Mn.” Emperor Yan looked downwards, “Everyone is here. I believe you can see that Great Emperor Shamanic Wind has intruded into my sky-floating island again!”
A total of 55 elders were gathered below. This was also all the elders Emperor Yan had. It’s also because the experts from the Death Destruction Clan rarely left the island-most of them would usually train, sleep and eat! Even if they left the island, they would do so to ‘eat’ and to seize resources from others! Furthermore, being subordinates of Emperor Yan, without the permission given from Emperor Yan, they were not allowed to leave the island.
At this moment, they could see the projection in midair. Within that lump of wind were a total of seven experts including Great Emperor Shamanic Wind.
“This Great Emperor Shamanic Wind is truly shameless. Previously, he was forced to escape so disgracefully, yet he is here again.”
“How many times has he been beaten by us?”
“It’s just his ‘Shamanic Wind’ bloodline is incredibly good at survival. We have once asked Emperor Yi for help. Even when Ancestor Yan and Emperor Yi worked together with the group of us, we aren’t able to kill him.”
These elders were all relatively frustrated.
“It would be troublesome if we allow Shamanic Wind to reach my palace.” Emperor Yan sat there ordering, “Elder Qi, let’s use the old strategy. Bring 21 elders with you to obstruct Shamanic Wind. Set off at this moment!”
“Yes.” A tall and thin black-skinned old man with wrinkles on his face said. This Elder Qi swept his gaze across, “Let us set off.”
“Go.”
“Let’s see what new move does this Great Emperor Shamanic Wind have this time.”
Of this group of 22 elders, some were humanoid and some were beastial. There were towering figures and short figures. One thing in common between them was their powerful and grand aura. All 55 elders under Emperor Yan had incredibly strong fleshy bodies. Because their fleshy bodies were strong, they could fight against most dangerous situations!
Hence, they were used to facing against Great Emperor Shamanic Wind already.
They would first send 22 elders with powerful fleshy bodies. Each elder was at the god general level. With so many working together, they could even face against a ‘Supreme’ for a period of time. Hence, they sufficed to get into a tangle with Great Emperor Shamanic Wind and his subordinates. They could rely on this to determine if Great Emperor Shamanic Wind had any new means of breaking through the security or not! Usually when Great Emperor Shamanic Wind dared to come, he would have some reliance.
“Hmph hmph hmph.” Emperor Yan simply sat cross-legged at his crystalline bed watching the projection. His silver eyes were cold.
******
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind, Xue Ying, and the other five traveled for quite some time before the enemies appear.
“Hong long long~”
A total of 22 elders teleported at the same time. The surrounding World Energy had become chaotic consequently.
“Great Emperor Shamanic Wind, you still dare to come!”
“This time, what new move do you have?”
“Previously, I’ve kicked your butt once! Are you thinking of being trampled on again this time?”
“Hahaha, receive my axe!”
“Previously, I’ve eaten half the body of a god general. It was such a sumptuous meal! If you were slower by a split second, I would have just eaten that god general alive!”
These elders from the Death Destruction Clan immediately acted. As they specialized in different techniques, when they exerted their moves at the same time, the entire world became chaotic. It was like boiling porridge. All sorts of techniques came crashing on the other six experts standing next to Great Emperor Shamanic Wind! That’s right. Even though they were scolding Great Emperor Shamanic Wind with their mouths, they still targeted their attacks away from Great Emperor Shamanic Wind.
Because they knew that attacking Great Emperor Shamanic Wind was simply pointless! Only by killing a god general under Great Emperor Shamanic Wind would they be able to incite pain in Great Emperor Shamanic Wind.
“Hmph.”
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind took the initiative to retaliate.
His left hand slightly beckoned ahead of him. At that moment, the world that had turned into boiling porridge, became engulfed in a fierce air current. This air current was present everywhere and easily wrapped around those elders from the Death Destruction Clan. Each elder had been restricted from the large amount of current, forcing their strength to suffer from a decline.
If one carefully distinguished, one could see that each strand of air current is actually formed from the twisting of a trillion micro-threads. These threads could easily cut the bodies of unparalleled cultivators.
Nonetheless, this domain technique could merely restrict these elders. With this technique, these elders would merely lose about 10% to 20% of their strength. They simply disregarded the technique and killed their way over. The five god generals under Great Emperor Shamanic Wind acted at the same time. Great Emperor Shamanic Wind personally unsheathed the saber by his waist. This saber turned into a gale that crashed down on those elders.
“Brother Flying Snow, it is time for you to act.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind turned to Xue Ying by the side.
“Alright.” Xue Ying chuckled. He had already been prepared.
Xue Ying then turned to the 22 elders that were currently being fighting with Great Emperor Shamanic Wind and his subordinates.
“Weng-”
Mirage and Illusory Realm, descend!
This number one killing technique of the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm was about dragging a sentient being into a world filled with his strongest desire. It was to the extent that the target could not ‘differentiate the illusion from the truth’! When Xue Ying created this Mirage and Illusory Realm, it was to a certain extent, filled with partial truths! If he were willing to pay the price, he could easily pull any sentient being within the illusion out into reality.
These 22 elders were originally battling madly. Yet when this terrifying Mirage and Illusory Realm enticed and pulled their souls in, there were elders falling into the illusion one after another.
In an instant.
A total of seven elders fell for the illusion! 11 elders were barely maintaining their consciousness with just 10% to 20% their strength remaining! Only four of them could maintain 30% of their original strength. Naturally, these four did not have a will power stronger than God General Skeletal Dragon. Instead, the fleshy bodies of members from the Death Destruction Clan were typically strong. This batch of elders had an even stronger fleshy body that did not require the elders to consume much heart force in controlling them. Hence, these four existences could maintain 30% of their original strength!
In reality, the universal will of the elders under Emperor Yan were slightly weaker than the 36 god generals under Great Emperor North River.
“Receive!” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind who was already prepared immediately captured the elders.
The seven who fell prey for the technique were the easiest. They were simply captured.
As for the 11 elders that were left with just 10% to 20% of their strength, the gap between them and Great Emperor Shamanic Wind was too great! Hence, under the domain of Great Emperor Shamanic Wind, he easily captured those elders that were restricted by the air current easily without them retaliating.
In the blink of an eye, 18 elders were completely captured.
As for the remaining four who could still maintain 30% of their strength, Great Emperor Shamanic Wind had to strike out once at each elder! The blade lights were perfected. They easily trapped each elder from the Death Destruction Clan. Those elders from the Death Destruction Clan could not even escape by dissipating their bodies since the endless wind had trapped the deepest core of their bodies. Similarly, with a strike on each elder, they were all captured alive!
…
Emperor Yan sat on his crystalline blade. His silver eyes were paying close attention to the projection in midair.
The other 30 over elders were also closely observing the battle. They wanted to see what new move did Great Emperor Shamanic Wind have. Only by understanding the situation better could they decide on a more informed action to take.
“What?” Emperor Yan’s original calm expression abruptly became shocked. It looked with disbelief as everything happened within the projection.
All 18 elders were captured instantaneously.
The remaining four were also captured after one blade! The blades sent out by Great Emperor Shamanic Wind were too fast. Emperor Yan did not have sufficient time to react when all elders sent this time were captured.
“This, how could this be…” Emperor Yan felt his heart trembling. It had never met such a situation before. Even when it faced ‘Supremes’, it had never fallen into such a despondent situation.
“Ancestor Yan, I know! I know! That white-robed young man is definitely the rumored Monarch Flying Snow! It must be him! It’s him, Monarch Flying Snow!” One of the 30 over elders below, one with a humanoid head and beastial body let out a sharp and shrill sound with terror.
The original quiet palace hall was filled with the sharp shouts from this elder ‘it must be him! It’s him, Monarch Flying Snow’, which echoed in the hall.
Emperor Yan turned to this elder shouting angrily: “Hurry up and tell me who this Monarch Flying Snow is! Why have I never heard of him before?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1236 - Emperor Yan and Monarch Flying Snow
chapters.content:
Chapter 1236: Emperor Yan and Monarch Flying Snow
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the dark palace hall, Emperor Yan and other elders were staring at this elder with a human head and beastial body. This elder was startled by its outburst and immediately knelt down on all four hooves, respectfully saying: “Ancestor Yan, just a few days ago when I was asleep, I sent my incarnation to meet my Brother Russ. When I was chatting with Brother Russ, Russ mentioned about an amazing Monarch Flying Snow appearing within the Natives. I’ve heard that his soul technique could even cause Emperors to fall into oblivion. He also mentioned that Monarch Flying Snow is a cultivator from the Realm Heart Great Land. But Russ felt that this could not possibly be true, and I concurred with him that this could possibly be rumors. When were cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land so powerful? But just now, a group of elders have actually fallen completely into deep sleep, leaving behind just a few elders whose strength have diminished to the extent that they were easily captured. Hence, the first person I thought of is this Monarch Flying Snow.”
“Why did you not tell me this?” Emperor Yan gritted his teeth. At the same time, he revealed his fags.
This elder slightly panicked, adding: “Previously, I thought it was just rumors. And Ancestor Yan was cultivating. Since it was not an important matter, I did not dare to disturb Ancestor too.”
Emperor Yan became silent.
Information traveled relatively slowly within the Death Destruction Clan. In addition, there was a distinct difference between them and the Natives. Hence, they were unable to infiltrate into the Natives. The personality of members from the Death Destruction Clan was not too suitable to become spies either! Even though Emperor Yan had many experts under him, and he was well-informed, this was only true on a relative basis! Great Emperor Shamanic Wind could not fail this time since this was the only time he was closest to success. That was why he requested for Xue Ying to alter his appearance and aura. In reality, Great Emperor Shamanic Wind felt that Emperor Yan… should not know of the existence of ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ either.
‘Where did this Monarch Flying Snow appear from?’ Emperor Yan pondered.
Its total power was ranked first between the 13 Emperors!
And what it relied on was the group of elders under him. But now, a total of 22 elders were captured alive! Emperor Yan became panicked when he thought of the drastic reduction of his power.
‘A cultivator that came from the Realm Heart Great Land could actually execute a soul technique that would even cause Emperors to fall into oblivion? Furthermore, judging from previously, only a minority of the elders have directly fallen asleep. The majority could still move and exert some strength.’ Emperor Yan thought, ‘If it were me, I should still be left with much of my strength.’
His subordinates could still maintain 30% of their strength.
It estimated that it should be able to maintain at 50% of its strength. With 50% of its strength, it was 100% confident of escaping from Great Emperor Shamanic Wind! After all, this was the sky-floating island and it could easily teleport and escape.
“All five elders of the forbidden ground, follow me.” Emperor Yan raised.
“Yes.”
The five elders with the strongest aura respectfully acknowledged. They were also the strongest five subordinates Emperor Yan had.
“Sou sou sou sou sou sou…”
Emperor Yan and the other five elders transformed into streams of light that shot out of the palace hall and through the void towards the direction where Great Emperor Shamanic Wind was.
…
This team of Great Emperor Shamanic Wind, Xue Ying and others captured a total of 22 elders. They were grinning from ear to ear. It appeared that they had succeeded in half the plan!
“As long as Emperor Yan is slightly intelligent, we would have successfully completed our task. Even if he is foolish and plans on continuing to resist, losing 22 elders that have incredibly strong fleshy bodies would mean the remaining few elders aren’t able to resist against Brother Flying Snow’s soul technique. Only the five elders from the forbidden ground are slightly harder to deal with. But we have a large chance of success even if we killed out way in.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind grinned. He had waited far too long for this day.
Xue Ying smiled by the side. He remained calm.
He came this time to conduct a trade. What he cared more was to obtain the chance of cultivating within the ‘Seven Bell Pagoda’ so as to break through to the final realm in one fell swoop!
As for the Death Destruction Clan?
Honestly speaking, the three Great Supremes of the Death Destruction Clan were all incredibly huge devils. The 13 Emperors, other than one who was slightly more low-profile and rarely acted outside its island, which of the 12 Emperors had not killed countless others? Devoured countless Natives?
‘The Death Destruction Clan feels very similar to the Destruction Devils. They are born to kill and devour others. The only difference is that the Destruction Devils are emissaries formed by the Supreme Law to carry out destruction in a single era.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘As for the Death Destruction Clan, 99% of the members are less intelligent and would rarely leave the sky-floating islands. As for the experts of the Death Destruction Clan, their intelligence is quite high. They have huge ambitions, and the moment they left the sky-floating islands, they would definitely be devouring others.’
Comparatively speaking, the Natives were relatively ordinary. They reproduced via normal human means. They had emotions and were relatively similar to cultivators.
The Death Destruction Clan was naturally formed by the sky-floating islands.
“They are here.”
“They have come.”
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind, Xue Ying, and the other five god generals looked ahead of them.
A total of six figures appeared.
The leading figure was thin. Its body was filled with scales. At this moment, its wings had unfolded and it was shockingly huge! It was so much bigger than even the five other elders from the forbidden ground, and it seemed these elders were merely one-thousandth the size of the wings.
Emperor Yan unfolded its wings, sweeping its pair of silver eyes across Great Emperor Shamanic Wind before landing on Xue Ying.
“Is this Monarch Flying Snow?” The first words spoken by Emperor Yan were directed at Monarch Flying Snow.
“Have you heard of Brother Flying Snow’s name?” On the contrary, Great Emperor Shamanic Wind was startled. He rejoiced inwardly for he had asked Xue Ying to alter his appearance and aura.
Xue Ying no longer maintained his disguise at this moment. He released his ordinary aura, and regained his usual white-robed young man look which he had in the Realm Heart Great Land. At the same time, he chuckled: “Others say that news spread slowly within the Death Destruction Clan. Who would have guessed that Emperor Yan actually knows of my name.”
“It was one of my elders that heard of your name, Monarch Flying Snow.” Emperor Yan couldn’t care less about Great Emperor Shamanic Wind. Instead, he continued looking at Xue Ying: “It originally thought that the news about Monarch Flying Snow are just rumors. Only after seeing Monarch Flying Snow’s strength did it realize that everything is real! My defeat this time to Monarch Flying Snow isn’t an injustice at all.”
“Have you admitted your defeat?” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind chuckled.
“Shamanic Wind, you have failed how many times before this? And I did not lose to you this time. Instead, I lost to Monarch Flying Snow.” Emperor Yan said, “For him to have the capabilities of causing even Emperors to fall into oblivion, he is definitely the first to do so in the history of Realm Heart Great Land and Broken Tooth Mountain Range! It is very normal for me to lose to such an expert.”
Xue Ying was incredibly astonished.
This was still the first time he met someone from the Death Destruction Clan who could speak so fluently and logically!
“Monarch Flying Snow, why are you helping Shamanic Wind? In terms of treasures, my Death Destruction Clan have the most. We are a clan that is born on the sky-floating islands.” Emperor Yan said, “If you come and help me, I can get you any treasure you seek. How about that?”
“Trying to rope me in?” Xue Ying was even more surprised at this moment.
The personality of those from the Death Destruction Clan, even if the higher-ups had greater intelligence, most were not willing to compromise, much less taking the initiative in roping another party in.
Emperor Yan was an oddity.
But it seemed the intelligence was true! Emperor Yan was an exceptional case. It preferred to have other Emperors from the Death Destruction Clan work for it and become its elders! Of course, one of the reasons was because its ‘blood’ was greatly useful to the other elders. But on the other hand, it knew how to make use of its advantages.
Hence, it was able to become the strongest among the 13 Emperors.
“What Brother Flying Snow requires is something you don’t own.” The expression of Great Emperor Shamanic Wind slightly changed. He was afraid of Xue Ying accepting the other party.
“What do cultivators need?” Emperor Yan looked at Xue Ying, “I’ve heard that you cultivators cared most for supreme-graded secret treasures and on the cultivation of the realm? Haha, I have a good friend who has a piece of supreme-graded secret treasure! I could even think of ways to help you acquire one or two pieces more. Everything can be given to you freely! As for your cultivation of the realm, any external materials you need can be duly discussed.”
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind’s expression truly changed when he heard that.
“Help me? How about that? You are a cultivator and aren’t part of the Natives. Helping Great Emperor Shamanic Wind is similar to helping me.” Emperor Yan unfolded its enormous wings. It spoke with incredibly politeness. Clearly, it favored this Monarch Flying Snow incredibly.
“I would have to say my apologies to Emperor Yan.” Xue Ying answered.
At that moment, a drastic transformation could be seen happening on the expression of Emperor Yan. Its eyes had become much colder.

chapters.title: Chapter 1237 - Entering Closed-Door Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1237: Entering Closed-Door Cultivation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Being rejected by Xue Ying, Emperor Yan felt both disappointed and frustrated. On the contrary, Great Emperor Shamanic Wind revealed a joyous look. He knew that victory was almost in his grasp since Xue Ying agreed to stand on his side! Unless Emperor Yan decided for a life and death struggle.
“Why do you help him instead of me?” Emperor Yan’s silver eyes stared coldly at Xue Ying. It was suppressing its anger, “I’ll do my best to get you everything you want.”
“Emperor Yan, it is best to stop struggling anymore.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind sneered, “Since Brother Flying Snow chose not to help you, you should not make things difficult for him either.”
Xue Ying stood by the side with a calm look.
And Emperor Yan understood that it was impossible to change the mind of the other party.
“Have you made your decision?” At this moment, Great Emperor Shamanic Wind was feeling incredibly happy. Other than the excitement he had from the fact that he was about to get the treasure he sought, he was also revelling in the feeling of forcing Emperor Yan to lower its head! He had fought with Emperor Yan for far too long, and had been defeated so many times by the other party. Nonetheless, he could finally suppress Emperor Yan today! Forcing Emperor Yan to make a decision! That itself was making Great Emperor Shamanic Wind exuberant.
“Decision?” Emperor Yan folded its scaled wings, wrapping it around its body. Its silver eyes stared at Great Emperor Shamanic Wind.
“If you want to act, that’s fine too!” The eyes of Great Emperor Shamanic Wind revealed signs of madness.
