He placed his hand by the scabbard on his waist, “I do want to see how many elders do you have left alive after this battle, Emperor Yan! I can at least ensure that all the elders that have been captured alive by me will die. And most likely your ranking within the 13 Emperors will droplet after this battle.”
Emperor Yan became silent for a while. Only then did it ask: “How much do want?”
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind chuckled. His laughter was exceptionally bright: “Not much. Since I captured 22 elders, I only need 22 droplets!”
“Are you mad?” The expression of Emperor Yan shifted, “22 droplets? Do you know how long it takes for a droplet of ‘Streaming Light Spiritual Milk’ to condense?”
“I am not mad.”
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind said, “Over the long years, Emperor Yan should be able to take out 22 droplets right? If you give them to me, we’ll leave. We will also return all the captured elders back to you.”
“Nine droplets at most!” Emperor Yan gritted, “At the worst, we’ll just fight! We from the Death Destruction Clan can easily teleport on the sky-floating island. You can’t chase up to us. By then, you can’t even get a single droplet of Streaming Light Spiritual Milk!”
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind became cold: “Then half your elders will have to die! As for the Streaming Light Spiritual Milk, I’ll simply destroy the spirit lake producing the spiritual milk as well as some other treasure grounds on this island! I’ll simply wreck the whole place apart!”
Emperor Yan became even more frustrated.
“I’ll take a step back. 20 droplets! There can not be a single droplet less!” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind deliberately took a step back. In reality, he was giving a way out for the other party without losing any much.
Emperor Yan’s expression was ugly. It looked at Xue Ying by the side. It knew that the outcome would be dire if they truly fought. Emperor Yan looked at Xue Ying, murmuring: “Monarch Flying Snow, can you guarantee that you will not help Great Emperor Shamanic Wind anymore in snatching my treasures once I give fork out 20 droplets of Streaming Light Spiritual Milk this time?”
“Be rest assured. There is only the Streaming Light Spiritual Milk on your sky-floating island that I regard highly. I can guarantee that I’ll not return here anymore.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind said. At the same time, he transmitted it to Xue Ying.
“Yes, I can guarantee that.” Xue Ying nodded.
Emperor Yan nodded slightly.
Monarch Flying Snow and Great Emperor Shamanic Wind had extraordinary reputation. They would not easily go against the words they just said.
“Alright.” Emperor Yan glanced at Great Emperor Shamanic Wind, “Shamanic Wind, I can only say that you are lucky for being able to employ the help of Monarch Flying Snow. Otherwise, it is impossible for you to obtain these 20 droplets of Streaming Light Spiritual Milk.”
Previously, just for a droplet of Streaming Light Spiritual Milk, Emperor Yan underwent a trade with Great Emperor Shamanic Wind that squeezed almost all treasures of Great Emperor Shamanic Wind dry!
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind could not accept that at all!
One could not blame Emperor Yan for asking such exorbitant price. Amongst the strongest experts in the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range, the Streaming Light Spiritual Milk was exceptionally miraculous to ‘Great Emperor Shamanic Wind’s Shamanic Wind Bloodline. It was less attractive to other Great Emperors. Of course, to most Emperors, it was still greatly helpful! The elders of Emperor Yan could earn a droplet of the spiritual milk whenever they contributed greatly.
“Sou sou sou…” Emperor Yan waved its claws, causing many bottles to fly out. A total of 20 bottles could be seen flying over, “Every bottle contains a droplet of Streaming Light Spiritual Milk.”
The five elders from the forbidden ground standing behind Emperor Yan were slightly indignant when they saw that.
The five of them had only gotten two droplets since the beginning!
And now, their commander-the leader of the 13 Emperors, ‘Emperor Yan’, was actually forced to lower its head and hand over 20 droplets of Streaming Light Spiritual Milk. This was an absolute humiliation to them!
“I’ve finally gotten it.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind waved his hand, causing the 20 bottles to arrive before him. He immediately uncorked them and checked through them. As he examined the items, his eyes were twinkling! He had been looking forward to this for far too long!
“Haha, Emperor Yan, I am truly happy for what I have gotten today. I am not a stingy person either.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind guffawed. He immediately released the captured 22 elders.
“It is time for you to leave now that you have gotten the Streaming Light Spiritual Milk.” Emperor Yan looked at him coldly.
“Go go go! It seems Emperor Yan isn’t feeling too happy now so it’s best that we don’t stay here.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind grinned from ear to ear, “Brother Flying Snow, let us set off.”
“Sou-”
The group of seven was immediately wrapped by a lump of wind which left the place.
Emperor Yan watched silently. The five elders from the forbidden ground and the 22 newly-released elders were silent too.
This time, they had been disgraced!
Of the entire Death Destruction Clan, Emperor Yan’s status was second only to the three Great Supremes! Yet he was actually forced to lower his head and hand over the treasures.
“Ancestor Yan, you could simply teleport and leave this place without heeding to their threats. But because of us…”
“If not for Ancestor Yan, we would have been killed by Great Emperor Shamanic Wind.”
These elders were saying as a way of expressing their gratitude. At the same time, they were flattering Emperor Yan too.
After all, the reason why they had been loyal to Emperor Yan, and even call him ‘Ancestor Yan’ was primarily because of the ‘bloodline’ of Emperor Yan which was helpful to most of them. That was why they were so loyal.
“There is no need to say much. I’m afraid that Shamanic Wind would most likely spread news of this disgraceful event out not too long from now, and the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range will soon know about it.” Emperor Yan coldly said, “But I wasn’t defeated in the hands of Shamanic Wind. Instead, I lost in the hands of Monarch Flying Snow!”
Saying that, Emperor Yan teleported away.
The remaining five elders from the forbidden ground and 22 elders exchanged glances. They knew Emperor Yan was not feeling well. Hence, they all obediently left the place.
Nonetheless, they did not have any signs of ‘taking revenge’! Because that Monarch Flying Snow was truly frightening! Those who were weaker amongst them would simply fall asleep before the other party! And those that were stronger would become greatly weakened, be trampled on easily before being captured alive.
…
Shamanic Wind World.
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind returned with great excitement. He even passed a lot of treasures to Xue Ying to express his gratitude and to maintain good relation between them! Because an expert in the Dao of Soul who could greatly cause their strength to diminish, would be someone who could influence the overall outcome of battles.
“This is the Seven Bell Pagoda.”
Great Emperor Shamanic Wind, Xue Ying and the eight god generals before the pagoda.
Each pagoda floor of the Seven Bell Pagoda was ordinary. And hanging by the side of the pagoda were seven bells that did not make it seem any special.
“Brother Flying Snow, after you enter, simply control your energy to push one of the bells. The seven bells would ring one after another, and that would guide Brother Flying Snow into a special cultivation state.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind explained, “You can only send an avatar in.”
“I know. Many thanks, Great Emperor.” Xue Ying could no longer wait.
“Haha, it is I who should thank Brother Flying Snow for your help.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind chuckled.
“Hua.”
One could see Xue Ying immediately forming an avatar that walked into the Seven Bell Pagoda. The soul strength of this avatar was even increasing! It kept increasing until it reached a peak perfection state. Nonetheless, at the same time, many other avatars that Xue Ying brought along became weaker in their souls. This was due to the restriction from the unseen laws.
Currently, in Realm Heart Great Land, of the many avatars Xue Ying had, the avatar that was protecting Flying Snow City, the one cultivating underneath the Burning Heart God Tree, and this new avatar that was proceeding into the Seven Bell Pagoda had their souls maintained at the perfect peak.
The other avatars that were fighting outside only had a soul strength that reached 70% at the highest! This was sufficient. Due to the fusion with the core blood of Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother, Xue Ying’s soul was exceptionally powerful. Even if it was at 70% of his maximum soul strength, the Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique could be easily executed. He even had the strength to use other moves.
…
Within the pagoda.
Xue Ying immediately discovered how special it was after entering. The internal structure seemed incredibly mysterious. Every single square beam was constructed in a diverse manner. Just as he sat down, Xue Ying immediately began relaxing his mind. It seemed as if the restriction of the fleshy body on his soul had reduced.
‘Seven Bell Pagoda is also called the ‘number one supreme treasure for meditation and cultivation’. Let’s see how mysterious it is.’ With a thought, Xue Ying controlled the void to push one of the hanging little bells.
“Ding ding dang dang~” A beautiful ringing sound could be heard

chapters.title: Chapter 1238 - The Urgent Undying Underworld Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1238: The Urgent Undying Underworld Emperor
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The moment Xue Ying heard this ringing sound, he felt it beautiful.
But gradually as other ringing sounds consecutively resonated, with the different sounds reverberating in the unique structure of the pagoda, it produced a special ripple that influenced Xue Ying’s soul. At this moment, Xue Ying’s soul was guided into a unique state.
“Hu~”
Silence!
His soul had never felt this quiet before. It was like the emergence of an unseen ripple that spread over his soul, wrapping around it so as to maintain the silence.
‘How can a soul be this quiet?’
It felt like he entered a boundless darkness. Everything he knew had disappeared. All laws and myriad existences were no longer present! This kind of darkness and silence had permeated through every single part of his soul. It felt so quiet as if his soul had entered a void. At this moment, there was only the soul and his existence! With a thought, he could easily perceive his fleshy body.
His current perception of the fleshy body had reached an unprecedented level. It felt like his body was a limitless land.
‘It seems the experts of the Natives relied on this Seven Bell Pagoda to research the bloodline in their fleshy bodies?’ There was no need for Xue Ying to conduct any research because the evolution of his body relied completely on his understanding of the laws. It was unlike that of the Natives who had traces of Chaotic Origin Lifeform bloodlines in their bodies. They could simply cultivate their bloodline and they would be able to wield unfathomable strength.
‘I shall forsake my fleshy body for now.’
With a thought.
His soul that was at an unprecedented peace easily isolated the perception of his fleshy body.
This isolation resulted in his soul entering a ‘true’ darkness. There was nothing in this darkness! Even his fleshy body did not exist!
But amidst this extreme silence, the comprehension speed of his soul had become truly ‘activate’!
‘I have never felt so comfortable before. It feels like my soul is not restricted by anything, and all potential has been dug out.’
‘I should focus on cultivating the Dao of Void.’
Large amounts of profound mysteries regarding the Dao of Void began appearing. Xue Ying began his deduction, causing different kinds of weird ideas to appear. His cultivation speed was much faster than what he could achieve during ordinary times. It felt as if his soul was suppressed by the laws and his fleshy body during normal cultivation. There was simply too much influence holding back his cultivation! And this was the first time he felt such immense efficiency in cultivation.
‘This feeling is amazing!’
He sighed inwardly.
Following that, using his incredibly active thinking, he rapidly researched into the Dao of Void.
He had already created five great killing techniques from the Dao of Void. With huge amounts of accumulations and some opportunities that he experienced after exploring more than 500 sky-floating islands, at this moment, everything appeared and began clashing in his mind…
And without suffering from any restrictions, his thinking continued mutating in many different directions, rapidly moving down all these possible paths.
******
Outside the pagoda.
Xue Ying, Great Emperor Shamanic Wind, and the eight god generals were here.
“It feels wondrous right?” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind looked at Xue Ying.
“It is amazing!” Xue Ying revealed a complex look. The avatar that was cultivating in the pagoda naturally had his memories linked to all other avatars. It was precisely because of that which made the experience exceptionally unique.
This avatar cultivating in the Seven Bell Pagoda had reached another ‘dimension’ in his soul and comprehension ability. At that dimension, his thinking was incredibly active, and his soul did not suffer from any restrictions. Hence, he cultivated very quickly at that state.
As for the other avatars Xue Ying had, they seemed to be situated at one dimension lower!
Even though the memories of his avatars were interchangeable, the thinking of other avatars was clearly falling behind.
“There is even such a supreme treasure in the world.” Xue Ying looked at the Seven Bell Pagoda with bright eyes. In the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, the Natives simply used the Seven Bell Pagoda to experience the bloodline in their bodies. But to cultivators, this support would be way more than that! It felt as if some kind of shackle had been removed, digging out all theoretical innate potential he had.
“Haha, Brother Flying Snow, where are you planning to go next?” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind chuckled, “If there is anything you need my help, you can just tell me.”
“There is something I have to do but I don’t require Great Emperor to act.” Xue Ying looked to an armored god general to the side, “God General Stone Light, I plan on exploring more sky-floating islands. Some Emperors from the Death Destruction Clan on those islands could resist my illusory realm technique. Even though they are just left with 10% to 20% of their original strength, that is still something I can’t handle. I will need the help of God General Stone Light. You can of course select any treasures on the island.”
“Why is there any need to trouble Big Brother Stone Light for such matters! I can come!”
“Monarch Flying Snow, I can do it as well! With you around, I am confident of dealing with any of the 13 Emperors.”
“How can we let Big Brother Stone Light occupy such a good matter!”
At that moment, the other god generals all volunteered themselves.
They were slightly envious and jealous.
Firstly, accompanying Monarch Flying Snow to the sky-floating islands was an absolutely beneficial matter which they were dreaming for! With Monarch Flying Snow around, the only members from the Death Destruction Clan that they were terrified of were just the three Great Supremes. They did not care about any other existences. Furthermore, didn’t Monarch Flying Snow mention ‘you can select any treasures’? Even though they were god generals, they still coveted treasures on the sky-floating islands, albeit they were not confident of getting those treasures by themselves.
Secondly, by adventuring together, they would naturally become closer!
This was a great opportunity to befriend Monarch Flying Snow! It was worth it even if they did not take any treasures! With a good friend like Monarch Flying Snow, there would be practically nobody who dared to become enemies with them in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range.
“Monarch Flying Snow asked me for help! So you guys better not snatch my role away.” God General Stone Light roared, “Why, you plan on competing to see who gets the job?”
Xue Ying chuckled.
He felt that it sufficed for a god general to help. Furthermore, these were all subordinates of Great Emperor Shamanic Wind. He could not possibly bring them all away right?
And in terms of strength, God General Stone Light was ranked first amongst the eight god generals!
…
Hence, in the following days, Xue Ying brought along God General Stone Light to explore the sky-floating islands. With sufficiently detailed intelligence, he naturally visited those islands where there were mysterious eyes.
He planned on memorizing more of the internal illusory realm structures of those mysterious eyes.
Even though he had created the number one killing technique using the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, since these mysterious eyes were vastly useful to him, it would be better for him to memorize more of them! This would then smoothen his journey of reaching the ‘final realm’ for the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm.
******
And in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range.
A piece of news had begun spreading.
With the help from ‘Monarch Flying Snow’, Great Emperor Shamanic Wind killed his way into Emperor Yan Island before capturing 22 elders alive. In the end, he forced Emperor Yan to hand over the Streaming Light Spiritual Milk. This news was spreading like wildfire! Great Emperor Shamanic Wind was even fanning the flames on this news since he wanted to let everyone know that his relationship with Monarch Flying Snow is great! At the same time, he was relying on this to vent his frustration!
He had been defeated in the hands of Emperor Yan for far too many times. This time, he was able to finally force Emperor Yan to lower its head. Such a matter was something he naturally had to let everyone in Broken Tooth Mountain Range know about! Otherwise, how could he get his dose of delight by keeping things mum?
“This Monarch Flying Snow is truly influential.”
“Emperor Yan is forced to lower its head even in its sky-floating island?”
“He captured 22 elders alive? It seems god generals are useless in numbers before this monarch.”
Various parties were discussing about it.
And the name of Xue Ying was becoming more well-known. The three Great Supremes from the Death Destruction Clan and the two Great Supremes from the Natives were also paying attention to this Monarch Flying Snow!
…
As this news spread, it naturally reached the ears of cultivators in Realm Heart Great Land.
Those like Emperor Summer and Undying Underworld Emperor paid close attention to the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. They would usually try to obtain intelligence regarding some of the Natives.
Especially ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ since he had entered the Broken Tooth Mountain Range many times after failing his task of becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. This time, he was the first to know about the matter among unparalleled existences regarding ‘Monarch Flying Snow’.
“What? Are you sure what you said is real?” The handsome young man wearing a gray robe uttered with disbelief.
When he was in Broken Tooth Mountain Range, he would usually wear a crown and luxurious gold robe. Nonetheless, Undying Underworld Emperor would maintain low-profile in Broken Tooth Mountain Range, choosing to don on a gray robe instead.
No other choice.
He was not qualified to be arrogant among the Natives. More importantly, he did not have avatars like Xue Ying or Emperor Summer!
“It is naturally real! The news has already spread for a few days.” A plump old man was drinking opposite of him, saying, “Underworld Emperor, did you not say you are the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land? Why do I feel that you are much weaker than Monarch Flying Snow? Before Monarch Flying Snow, most Emperors would simply fall. Some god generals were even trembling with fear and trepidation before him. Even Great Emperors were competing to befriend this Monarch! I don’t think the five Great Supremes dare to neglect this matter either.”
Undying Underworld Emperor became silent.
Envy?
He was indeed filled with slight envy. If he had such a high status in Broken Tooth Mountain Range, he would have a much easier time handling things.
Other than envy, he was also slightly anxious!
‘Has he cultivated his Mirage and Illusory Realm to this stage already? There are a few in the entire Realm Heart Great Land who has cultivated to level-two Cosmos God Realm in the Dao of Soul. But none of them is ever this frightening. Unless he has cultivated to the final realm? Or he has some supreme secret impartation?’ Undying Underworld Emperor started panicking. He did not know that there had never been an existence who reached the final realm in the Dao of Soul. Naturally, a supreme secret impartation would not exist as a result.
‘Since he could cause even Emperors to fall, then I would have to fork out quite a huge amount of heart force even if we final realm cultivators could resist against his Mirage and Illusory Realm.’ Undying Underworld Emperor thought. The Heart Realms of cultivators were incredible. But they would most likely only be comparable to the five Great Supremes in terms of their abilities to resist the power from the Mirage and Illusory Realm. Hence, it was certain for them to be weakened before such a technique.
‘What should I do?’
‘He has many avatars. He could even get responses en masse with a call in Broken Tooth Mountain Range! Experts are competing to befriend him, so he has many resources. Furthermore, he has his Dao of Void and the Chaotic Origin Weapon too. Given his accumulations and the opportunities in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, his chances of reaching the final realm would be much greater.’
‘If this continues on, he will only become stronger.’ Undying Underworld Emperor felt an unprecedented anxiety.

chapters.title: Chapter 1239 - Underworld Emperor pays Xue Ying a Visit
chapters.content:
Chapter 1239: Underworld Emperor pays Xue Ying a Visit
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The look on Undying Underworld Emperor kept changing.
The impact of this news hit him too greatly. Previously, even though Xue Ying had disrupted his ‘sacrificial offerings’, causing him to stumble on his refinement of the Death Walker, deep in his heart, he did not feel that Xue Ying could ever threaten him.
Firstly, it was destined for this ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ to take a very long time before he could reach the final realm. This was easily seen by the number of final realm cultivators in Realm Heart Great Land. Ultimately, breaking through to the final realm was too difficult.
Secondly, even if Monarch Flying Snow broke through to the final realm! Undying Underworld Emperor felt that even if Monarch Flying Snow had a Chaotic Origin Weapon, he could still match up to the other party after igniting his heart blood. Hence, it was impossible for Monarch Flying Snow to threaten his life. Even if he wasn’t too willing to ignite too much heart blood, he could easily escape into the ‘Broken Tooth Mountain Range’. After all, he did not have much to worry about at Realm Heart Great Land.
Reaching his level, he no longer had any other concerns. His sole goal was to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform! He had failed in his crusade previously. Hence, he was left with the path in Broken Tooth Mountain Range!
‘At the worst, I’ll simply hide in Broken Tooth Mountain Range.’ Undying Underworld Emperor was originally calm.
But now, he was stumped!
‘This Monarch Flying Snow is too famous in Broken Tooth Mountain Range. All parties are competing to get close with him. If I were to escape into the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, he just has to give a command, and most likely, there would be several Great Emperors and even Supremes willing to act for him! I’ll be doomed if that happened!” Undying Underworld Emperor felt anxious.
‘I am not very safe in the Realm Heart Great Land either way. In the end, I still underestimated Monarch Flying Snow.’
‘The moment he breaks through to the final realm! With his Chaotic Origin Weapon, his strength would not be any lesser than after I ignite my heart blood. He even has that terrifying Mirage and Illusory Realm Technique which could cause Emperors to fall! I would most likely be weakened greatly as a result.’ Undying Underworld Emperor thought, ‘The moment I am weakened, I would no longer be his opponent. I would simply be chased by him! And once I consumed my heart blood, my strength would further decrease. And once that happened, I would simply lose my life.’
Undying Underworld Emperor could easily foresee what might happen.
More importantly…
His rationality told him that this was something very possible!
With the terrifying cultivation speed this Monarch Flying Snow had, he was clearly a talented monster! Just the battle at Flying Snow City showed how profound his understanding in the Dao of Void was. He even had a supreme secret impartation! Furthermore, his reputation in ‘Broken Tooth Mountain Range’ had become so great that it was destined for him to acquire many benefits. Many World Masters even took the initiative to shower him with gifts. Monarch Flying Snow should be able to obtain some of the wondrous opportunities in the sky-floating islands easily as well.
Hence, with so many parties helping him, this Monarch Flying Snow would most likely be breaking through to the final realm not too far from now!
‘The moment he reaches the final realm, I’ll be doomed.’
‘He has that illusory realm technique coupled with his prowess in close combat. I would definitely die even if I ignite all my heart blood. Even if I choose to escape to the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, I would be seeking my death either!’
‘I have nowhere to go!’
The eyes of Undying Underworld Emperor became cold and even slightly mad.
He was not willing to admit defeat so easily. In the past, he had competed with many other terrifying experts from different Origin Worlds. He even gradually researched out a way of refining the Death Walker, and succeeded once doing so! As a result, he became famous! Eventually, he was forced to sacrifice his Death Walker. That was how he escaped back to his hometown Realm Heart Great Land successfully.
One had to know, there were many more experts who were not weaker than him-some were even more outstanding! Eventually, they all died and fell in that world filled with despair.
‘Monarch Flying Snow, we shall see what you choose in the end.’ Undying Underworld Emperor made his decision.
“I shall first return. We can meet again in the future.” Undying Underworld Emperor stood.
“Why are you in a rush this time?” The plump old man chuckled as he drank the wine.
“Mn, it is due time for me to return.”
Undying Underworld Emperor did not elaborate. He turned around before leaving.
If he knew about Xue Ying’s reputation in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, he would definitely not enter the Broken Tooth Mountain Range either! This place was too dangerous for him!
…
Undying Underworld Emperor returned back to the Realm Heart Great Land silently without others being aware of it. The Realm Heart Great Land was restricted by the laws set by ‘Yuan’. Hence, the true experts from the Broken Tooth Mountain Range could never enter. Naturally, there was nobody who could threaten him. But this was ‘temporary’. The moment Xue Ying broke through, that would mean imminent calamity for him.
“Hu hu hu~”
The gale whistled. Snow also fell from the sky.
Xue Ying sat by himself under his pavilion drinking wine. The wine was kept warm. There was also an unseen ripple protecting the pavilion, preventing the gale from entering it. Snowflakes were whirling around amidst the fierce weather. Despite the world being dark and dimmed, the pavilion remained peaceful and quiet with the fragrance from the wine pervading it.
“Mn?” Xue Ying frowned. He looked over at a direction.
A ripple descended.
The surrounding wind stopped blowing. The snow scattered apart. That ripple rapidly caused the world energy to condense into a figure. It was a handsome young man wearing luxurious golden robe and a crown.
‘Undying Underworld Emperor actually came to my place?’ Xue Ying felt strange. Even though unparalleled existences had visited his Flying Snow City, it was unexpected for Undying Underworld Emperor to come! After all, the enmity between both parties was something the entire Realm Heart Great Land knew.
“Underworld Emperor, what are you here for?” Xue Ying said.
“Why aren’t you inviting me in for a sit?” Undying Underworld Emperor said with a smile.
Xue Ying’s eyebrows twitched. If this was the true body of Undying Underworld Emperor, he might not dare to get close to the other party. He would simply sweep his Chaotic Origin Weapon ‘Azure River Spear’ over. He would definitely not let the other party enter Flying Snow City at all. But since this was merely an incarnation, he naturally did not place Underworld Emperor in his eyes. Since the other party came with manner, he would treat the other party likewise.
“Have a seat, Underworld Emperor.” Xue Ying remained seated. He did not stand to invite the other party since he did not like Undying Underworld Emperor at all.
“Hahaha…” Undying Underworld Emperor came in laughing. He sat himself down comfortably before taking up the wine flask by the side naturally. Waving his hand, he condensed a cup using the world energy before pouring for himself. He drank a cup before saying, “This wine seems ordinary. But since this is the wine of Monarch Flying Snow, its value would have increased by many times over.”
Xue Ying carefully observed this Undying Underworld Emperor.
The other party actually spoke so politely and even flattered him. This did not seem like the personality of Undying Underworld Emperor at all. Previously, the enmity between both parties was huge. He had disrupted a huge affair of Underworld Emperor! And Undying Underworld Emperor even became so furious that he sought to wipe out the entire Flying Snow City just to vent his anger. And now, he came to flatter Xue Ying?
“Monarch Flying Snow, you and I do have a huge grievance previously.” Undying Underworld Emperor said, “But talking about that, I believe that your personality is too unyielding-you can’t condone any devils at all. You aren’t targeting me in particular. Rather, you are targeting all devils.”
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded, “It is good that Underworld Emperor understands that.”
“But you ultimately disrupted my affair.” Undying Underworld Emperor said, “In this path of cultivation, you actually cut off my Dao Path, and as a result, created an enmity with me where both of us can’t exist under the same heaven together!”
Xue Ying continued listening silently.
“But now, this enmity can be dissolved.” Undying Underworld Emperor added with a smile.
“How?” Xue Ying replied.
“Haha, Monarch Flying Snow has hidden yourself incredibly deep. Currently, your reputation in Broken Tooth Mountain Range has spread far and wide. The 13 Emperors, the eight Great Emperors, the five Great Supremes… I believe nobody dares to underestimate you at all. You can easily become a VIP of any Supremes. Most Great Emperors would have to take the initiative in inviting you over and give you gifts in the future as well.” Undying Underworld Emperor said.
Xue Ying’s eyebrows twitched. He chuckled: “Underworld Emperor’s intelligence is really fast and abundant.”
“It’s only because the Natives and our Realm Heart Great Land do not converse much. Otherwise, this news would spread out across the world already. I believe in a thousand years or so, the unparalleled existences would know about this.” Undying Underworld Emperor said, “The reason I came over is to find Monarch Flying Snow for help. Once you help me, we can be friends in the future. I’ll no longer slaughter those weak little ants.”
“What do you need help with?” Xue Ying asked. If both parties ended up in a bigger conflict, things would not be optimal either since Xue Ying could not stop Undying Underworld Emperor from slaughtering more.
“Help me gather a total of 15 ‘Dark Flowers’ before sending me into the ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’.” Undying Underworld Emperor said, “As long as you help me with this, our enmity will be dissolved. I can even promise to help you do things! As for me no longer killing more? Haha, as long as I can enter the Snake Tooth Corridor, I’ll definitely not return to the Realm Heart Great Land. Naturally, I could no longer create more chaos in the Realm Heart Great Land.”
Xue Ying’s expression changed when he heard that.
Every single dark Flower was incredibly previous. Its value was not any less than a droplet of ‘Streaming Light Spiritual Milk’.
But 16 flowers, given his influence in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, was still doable if he thought of ways to make use of the favors from others!
But ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’ was a legendary forbidden ground in the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range!
Want to enter?
That was even a legend in the intelligence reports of the Native Clans! Only the five Great Supremes could possibly enter. Most Great Emperors had never entered that place.
If he planned on entering the mysterious Snake Tooth Corridor, he would have to ask the five Great Supremes for help! If those Supremes had an opportunity to enter, they would have long entered. Even Great Emperors could not get this privilege.
“You plan on entering the Snake Tooth Corridor?” Xue Ying looked at Undying Underworld Emperor. This request was simply too much.

chapters.title: Chapter 1240 - 10 Trillion Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 1240: 10 Trillion Years
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Right.” Undying Underworld Emperor’s gaze was filled with glowing passion, “Given Monarch Flying Snow’s current status in Broken Tooth Mountain Range, I believe you should be able to do it right?”
“Underworld Emperor, how much do you know of the Snake Tooth Corridor?” Xue Ying felt puzzled. Undying Underworld Emperor actually tried to secure an opportunity of entering the Snake Tooth Corridor from him.
Undying Underworld Emperor mumbled: “The Snake Tooth Corridor is a rumored forbidden ground in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. Hearsay that forbidden ground contains a secret of advancing into the Chaotic Origin Level. Currently, even the five Great Supremes are seeking opportunities there.”
“Right, the five Great Supremes are seeking opportunities themselves.”
Xue Ying continued, “As they say, this forbidden ground contains the secret of advancing into the Chaotic Origin Level. Which of the five Great Supremes do not wish to become one? It is impossible for them to give this opportunity to others. Even the eight Great Emperors and 13 Emperors desire to enter. I can tell you clearly! In the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range, there had never been a transaction that occurred over the chance of entering the Snake Tooth Corridor. The Supremes do not even trade between themselves, and they do not even bestow it upon the eight Great Emperors and 13 Emperors.”
“Never has that happened before! My reputation as Monarch Flying Snow might be useful to the eight Great Emperors and 13 Emperors. But before the five Great Supremes, they would merely take another glance at me. You want to secure a chance of entering the Snake Tooth Corridor? Dream on.” Xue Ying calmly said.
He did not lie.
Because he had gotten sufficient intelligence and understood quite a lot from Great Emperor North River and Great Emperor Shamanic Wind. There were even other Great Emperors inviting him over during the recent days.
He definitely belonged to the highest rung in Broken Tooth Mountain Range. Hence, Xue Ying understood quite a lot of secrets.
And the statuses of the five Great Supremes were transcendental!
The 13 Emperors and eight Great Emperors were still fighting and competing with one another! Yet the five Great Supremes did not care about the power struggle. They did not even care about treasures! Because they had already reached grand perfection in the Emperor realm. Hence, most opportunities in the sky-floating islands were useless to them. The only useful place to the five Great Supremes was the legendary forbidden ground-the Snake Tooth Corridor!
What they were competing over was the chance of entering the Snake Tooth Corridor.
Because only by entering the Snake Tooth Corridor could they gain an opportunity of advancing into the Chaotic Origin Level. Otherwise, it was too difficult for any of them to cultivate and promote to the next level.
Every single opportunity was incredibly precious. It was sufficient for the Supremes to fight with one another! This chance would never be let to someone else. How could they ever give up on the chance of ‘succeeding in the Dao’? As a cultivator, it was a pipe dream for Xue Ying to ask for this chance to enter. His illusory realm technique might be effective to Great Emperors, but to the five Great Supremes, it would not be as persuasive.
Even if the five Great Supremes were weakened by 20% to 30% of their strength, they would still not fear other Supremes!
They did not care about conquering many worlds, or fight with others. Their only ambition was to jump out of the cage and become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform!
“Not even a single chance?” The expression of Undying Underworld Emperor changed. He could not interact with those of the highest rung in Broken Tooth Mountain Range. Hence, what he understood was bits and pieces.
“No chance.”
Xue Ying shook his head, “Underworld Emperor, entering the Snake Tooth Corridor has never been something you could ask for. You have to compete for the chance yourself. Perhaps you might be able to grasp an opportunity of entering while exploring the many sky-floating islands.”
“Compete? How can I compete?” Undying Underworld Emperor looked at Xue Ying, “If I had refined my Death Walker, I would naturally be qualified to compete. But now, how could I? I do not even have the slightest chance of escaping from the five Great Supremes.”
“I can help you to gather the 15 Dark Flowers.” Xue Ying said, “But you have to swear an oath.”
“Hahaha…”
Undying Underworld Emperor began guffawing. His laughter was filled with madness, “Monarch Flying Snow, you really know how to joke. Do you know how difficult it is for me to take another step after cultivating to my current realm? Ordinary treasures aren’t helpful to me at all. Even the Dark Flowers are simply accessories. If I can’t enter the Snake Tooth Corridor, then everything is useless! They are all pointless!”
“Originally, I could have secure a chance to enter. With the Death Walker, I would definitely be able to fight for it.” Undying Underworld Emperor glared at Xue Ying. His eyes were filled with madness, “But because of you, you disrupted my sacrificial rite.”
Xue Ying calmly watched as Undying Underworld Emperor raved on madly.
“Are you going to obstruct me again if I begin another sacrificial rite?” Undying Underworld Emperor uttered.
“Definitely so!” Xue Ying nodded.
“You… if you dare to obstruct me, I’ll similarly massacre countless of other beings.”
Xue Ying shook his head: “If I do not obstruct you, you would similarly sacrifice many sentient beings. Of course, you can begin your massacre. Once you massacred to a certain limit, ‘Yuan’ would naturally send down his punishment!”
If the other party succeeded in refining the Death Walker, then nobody could stop this Underworld Emperor from wreaking havoc.
Even though he did not know how powerful the Death Walker was!
But Undying Underworld Emperor was already exaggeratedly strong. By igniting his heart blood, he could fight against god generals. If he was so fixated at refining the Death Walker out, it would definitely boost his strength significantly. Otherwise, why the need to refine it?
The moment he did so!
Nobody could ever stop him anymore!
“Very good, very good.” Undying Underworld Emperor said with madness. His figure abruptly disappeared.
The negotiation crumbled!
“Things are getting out of hand.” Xue Ying murmured to himself. But he did not have the choice. He did not even have the power to give Undying Underworld Emperor an opportunity of entering the Snake Tooth Corridor.
…
At another location.
On the throne of a towering palace hall, a luxurious golden-robed Undying Underworld Emperor sat with a crown on his head. His eyes were burning with flames. “Hong”-the surrounding of his body began burning in flames. This flame shot out in all directions. The terrified female attendants in the hall turned into nothingness. This palace hall was even burned into ashes. And now, Undying Underworld Emperor stood amidst the ruins.
“I have no other path to take.”
“You are the one who is forcing me down this path!”
The current state of Undying Underworld Emperor was filled with madness.
If he obediently chose not to massacre, even if Xue Ying broke through to the final realm, the other party would most likely be merciful and not kill him.
But to Undying Underworld Emperor, there was no point of living if he could not advance into the Chaotic Origin level! Living without hope is a form of torture. He had lived for far too long, leaving just the intense desire of evolving towards the next level of life. He desired to reach that unfathomable stage that felt like breaking out of his cocoon and becoming a butterfly.
He once felt that higher level of life at a close distance. As a result, his desire to break through became even more intense.
“I shall try one final time.”
“Previously, I succeeded in escaping back. I have already lived for this long! It is impossible for me to have a breakthrough by orthodox means of cultivation. Only the mysterious ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’ could give me the chance of success.” The eyes of Undying Underworld Emperor were burning with flames, “Before Monarch Flying Snow breaks through to the final realm, I shall take the last gamble. I do not hope of refining the complete Death Walker. Even if I could control a simplified version, it should suffice.”
The complete Death Walker made use of a half Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body. Its strength was comparable to the five Great Supremes.
If he succeeded in refining it, he would immediately be able to fight with other Supremes. Naturally, he would be qualified to compete for the chance of entering the Snake Tooth Corridor in Broken Tooth Mountain Range!
Even if it was an incomplete Death Walker, its strength was sufficiently strong.
“I shall stake it.”
Undying Underworld Emperor no longer had any paths of retreat.
‘This Monarch Flying Snow cultivates incredibly quick. He should be able to break through to the final realm in 10 trillion years. I have to succeed within this timeframe,’ Undying Underworld Emperor thought. To Cosmos Gods, 10 trillion years was considered short. Undying Underworld Emperor felt that he had overestimated Xue Ying by taking this timeframe as an estimate.
In the past, Luo City Lord once gave Xue Ying and Swordmaster a chance. That was merely because of his kind intention. He was not certain that the two of them could reach the final realm before the Great Apocalypse. One could see how difficult it was to reach the final realm.
But after that, not only Swordmaster or Xue Ying, both of them grew at a pace that surprised even Luo City Lord and Yuan!
Swordmaster had already broken through to the final realm! And Xue Ying had walked to an unfathomable distance in the Dao of Soul path.
’10 trillion years.’
Undying Underworld Emperor felt that time was tight. But it was still possible for him to accomplish his task within this period.
…
That day.
Undying Underworld Emperor arrived at the Southern Cloud Capital.
“Teacher.” Southern Cloud King remained incredibly obedient. He had no choice. He did not dare to disobey this Undying Underworld Emperor.
“Hmph.” Undying Underworld Emperor snorted. He disliked Southern Cloud King precisely because Monarch Flying Snow was the disciple of Southern Cloud King! It’s just that he still needed the help of Southern Cloud King currently.
“Help me gather these materials.” Undying Underworld Emperor threw a scroll to Southern Cloud King, “You must gather them within 10 billion years. Otherwise, be prepared for your entire Southern Cloud Capital to be wiped out with you.”
Southern Cloud King’s heart trembled as he received the scroll.

chapters.title: Chapter 1241 - Underworld Emperor couldn’t be left alive!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1241: Underworld Emperor couldn’t be left alive!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
After throwing the scroll over, Undying Underworld Emperor simply left.
As Southern Cloud King received the scroll, he panicked in his heart: “In the past, Undying Underworld Emperor would maintain decorum when asking me to help him do stuff. But now, if I couldn’t complete the task on time, he would wipe out my Southern Cloud Nation! He was actually so overbearing and ruthless! Things seem amiss?”
After a moment.
Southern Cloud King sent an avatar over to find Xue Ying at the Flying Snow City.
“Teacher.” Xue Ying was still seated at his pavilion. When he saw his teacher coming over, he immediately stood and greeted the other party.
“Xue Ying, I’ve just met Undying Underworld Emperor and find that things aren’t right.” Southern Cloud King explained what had just happened once through.
When Xue Ying finished listening, he answered: “It’s all because of me.”
“Because of you?” Southern Cloud King felt puzzled.
“He could possibly be feeling gravely threatened.” Xue Ying sighed, “It actually stemmed from my fame in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range.”
“Your fame in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range? What fame?” Southern Cloud King was even more bewildered at this moment. The cultivators from Realm Heart Great Land usually had to keep on their toes when they visited the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. They had to be careful when facing the Death Destruction Clan. They similarly had to be careful when facing the Natives too! Even unparalleled existence wouldn’t dare to bring their supreme-graded secret treasures if there was no need to!
“It’s like this.”
Naturally, Xue Ying did not hide from his teacher. He told the other party everything that happened.
As Southern Cloud King listened, he gradually became shocked.
Oh god!
Being strong enough to fight against god generals, he even dared to go against Great Emperor North River! Great Emperor North River did not get angry. On the contrary, he came personally with politeness to invite Xue Ying over to a banquet! Many Great Emperors even came to invite him. And when ‘Great Emperor Shamanic Wind’ worked together with Xue Ying, they were able to force ‘Emperor Yan’, the strongest of the 13 Emperors to lower its head!
“You, you…” Southern Cloud King felt that his horizons had been broadened. Currently, he was looking at his disciple with great astonishment.
Frightening!
Truly frightening!
There had never been a cultivator from Realm Heart Great Land who could be so highly regarded like Xue Ying in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range! Even those at the level of the eight Great Emperors and 13 Emperors were competing to get into Xue Ying’s grace.
“Have you reached the final realm in your Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm? Are soul techniques so formidable?” Southern Cloud King could not help but ask.
“I haven’t. I’ve only reached the limits before the final realm.” Xue Ying replied, “I have gotten some great opportunities in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. By relying on that, I was able to comprehend a Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique! And that was how I was able to reach my current stage of level.”
“Since you have the capability of forcing many Emperors in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range down, you should be able to weaken many final realm cultivators significantly! Most level-two Cosmos Gods and Paragon Masters… would even fall asleep directly before you. And that includes me.” Southern Cloud King shook his head in lament, “Even though I have many avatars, you could simply destroy all of them with a single thought.”
At this moment.
Southern Cloud King started feeling alarmed over this disciple of his! Soul techniques were too terrifying. The moment an avatar fell for it, given that all avatars were connected via their memories, all of them would similarly fall into the illusory realm!
Southern Cloud King even chose to temporarily break all memory connections he had with his avatars that were located in other Origin Worlds! Since it was taxing to maintain the memory linkage with avatars that were located in different Origin Worlds, he could easily severe the connection by choosing not to maintain it: ‘I shall synchronize our memories once every few years so as to prevent any diversion of personality.’
Soul techniques were too frightening. Even if Southern Cloud King was the teacher, being a cultivator, he still instinctively acted as a means of self-preservation.
“I should be able to deal with level-two Cosmos Gods with a thought.” Xue Ying nodded. Currently, the only ones he could not handle were only final realm cultivators in Realm Heart Great Land.
“That Undying Underworld Emperor should have found out about this. He is afraid of me.” Xue Ying calmly stated.
“Afraid of you?” Southern Cloud King was puzzled.
“Yes. He wishes to enter the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. But if I were to discover him in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, I could easily summon a group of experts to kill him.” Xue Ying explained, “Furthermore, because I can easily obtain treasures and opportunities-those World Masters and Great Emperors took the initiative to give them to me-given my accumulations in the Dao of Void and in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, I could possibly have a breakthrough in any of the two Daos to the final realm.”
Southern Cloud King agreed.
That’s Right.
He felt that this disciple of his could possibly reach the final realm in any of the two Daos! Naturally, this was because the cultivators in Realm Heart Great Land did not know how difficult the Dao of Soul was!
“If I were to reach the final realm in my Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, my soul technique would become more formidable. Perhaps I could easily wipe him out by relying on my soul technique.” Xue Ying said, “Even if I couldn’t he would be weakened to a stage where he was only left with 20% to 30% of his original strength. Killing him would be an easy task.”
Currently, his soul technique was this powerful already. Once it reached the final realm, it would be greatly overpowered.
Xue Ying felt that it was entirely possible to kill a peak cultivator with a thought!
“If I were to have a breakthrough in the Dao of Void! I could rely on my Chaotic Origin Weapon and perhaps find another helper. By then, it is entirely possible to kill him either way.” Xue Ying muttered.
Southern Cloud King felt startled inwardly.
He took in this disciple easily without doing much for him… and he became so amazing now! In the blink of an eye, he could even threaten the life of Undying Underworld Emperor!
“That is why he plans on struggling.” Xue Ying shook his head, “I do not wish to force him into dire straits. As long as he doesn’t massacre the innocent, I might even be willing to swear an oath not to deal against him. It’s a pity that his goal is to advance into the Chaotic Origin Level. The condition he proposed is way beyond my limits. I can’t satisfy it. I am afraid he should have begun some sort of schemes since he is definitely someone who would not resign himself to death.”
“Mn, he would definitely not resign himself to death.” Southern Cloud King concurred.
…
In a huge city.
Undying Underworld Emperor arrived above this city at night. He coldly looked down at this city.
There were a huge amount of cultivators that lived here. There were male and female, old and young. There were solitary cultivators, and some who worked as attendants or servants to earn cosmos crystals.
“Absorb!”
Undying Underworld Emperor abruptly took a deep breath.
An endless darkness suddenly engulfed the entire place. All the civilians within the city could not retaliate at all. Their souls left their bodies. This single breath by Undying Underworld Emperor formed an abyss that caused all souls to fly into it. Some cultivators in this city had avatars outside, and they immediately began spreading the news about it.
Undying Underworld Emperor felt disdain from concealing his actions either.
Not only were the civilians spreading the news. This disturbance was even felt by several final realm cultivators.
“Mn? What is this Underworld Emperor doing?” Ancestor Fan could perceive what was happening from afar. He focused his attention to the site while feeling incredibly confused, “Even if he plans on collecting a large number of souls, he could easily entice the weaker cultivators to do it for him. Why would he be doing it himself?”
Yet he did not know.
Undying Underworld Emperor was currently making full use of his time to conduct more experiments. If he planned to entice the weaker devils, that would require time! Nothing could ever beat doing it himself in terms of speed!
“Devour!”
Undying Underworld Emperor finally absorbed all souls into his body-they were stored at an inner space.
He stood silently at his current location when a white-robed young man finally appeared by the side.
“Underworld Emperor.” Xue Ying looked down at the city. He saw the lack of souls in the bodies of the civilians. It had become a dead city. At that instance, Xue Ying turned to Undying Underworld Emperor with indignance, “What are you planning to do?”
Sacrificing just a single city was definitely insufficient.
“What I plan to do?”
“Since you aren’t giving me a path to take, I can only pave it myself.” Undying Underworld Emperor sneered at Xue Ying, “Monarch Flying Snow. The famous Monarch Flying Snow. I’m afraid you could possibly become the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land. What a pity. You can’t stop me from doing what I want to do.”
Finishing his words, Undying Underworld Emperor disappeared.
He deliberately stayed here for Xue Ying!
“Damn.”
The expression on Xue Ying became ugly. He could still kill ordinary devils. Nonetheless, Undying Underworld Emperor was someone he could not handle even if he acted.
…
Time passed.
The huge reputation Xue Ying created in Broken Tooth Mountain Range began spreading across the highest rung in Realm Heart Great Land. Emperor Summer, World Extermination God-Emperor, Towering Sky King, Ancestor Fan, Eternal Night Primogenitor, Extreme Night Primogenitor and others were dumbstruck when they heard the news. Ancestor Fan even exclaimed with shock: “His Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm should have reached the pinnacle pinnacle. He could possibly have broken through to the final realm!”
They could even ascertain that Great Emperors treated Xue Ying as a VIP!
The 13 Emperors were all wary of this Monarch Flying Snow!
And large number of World Masters had once sent a lot of treasures-top-graded and even supreme-graded ones to him!
That was simply madness!
The highest run of Realm Heart Great Land were stunned. Some final realm cultivators who did not own any supreme-graded secret treasures were green with envy! They were filled with admiration and jealousy! At the same time, they felt helpless too.
As the unparalleled existences and final realm cultivators came to visit Xue Ying, Xue Ying was actually paying close notice to news on Undying Underworld Emperor.
“Undying Underworld Emperor.”
Xue Ying’s mood was not good.
In just a short 3 years.
After Undying Underworld Emperor raked in a large batch of souls, he still frequently did so in the dark. Currently, the six great ancient nations in Realm Heart Great Land treated Xue Ying with respect. By relying on the intelligence from various sources, he found out that the one reaping the souls were all done by Undying Underworld Emperor!
“Underworld Emperor musn’t be left alive!” Xue Ying gritted his teeth, “I have to think of ways to eliminate him.”
If this continued, Xue Ying did not know how many would die.
Could he simply hope for ‘Yuan’ to appear? Given the temper of Yuan, he would not do anything against any actions short of affecting the balance in Realm Heart Great Land.

chapters.title: Chapter 1242 - Scheme
chapters.content:
Chapter 1242: Scheme
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Summer Wind Ancient Nation, Royal Palace.
Within a garden, Emperor Summer, Emperor Cang, and Ancestor Fan were seated together. They were currently drinking and chatting, and the topic was none other than the most famous character currently in Realm Heart Great Land-Monarch Flying Snow!
“Hearsay Extreme Night Primogenitor went to visit Monarch Flying Snow. Extreme Night Primogenitor even personally swore an oath to resolve the enmity between them!” Emperor Cang laughed, “Talking about that, of the two primogenitors in the Primogenitor Ancient Nation, Extreme Night Primogenitor was truly a realist. He could easily lower his head without second thoughts. Instead, it was the other, Eternal Night Primogenitor, who is more of a swindler!”
“Haha, I bet Eternal Night Primogenitor is currently feeling agitated.” Ancestor Fan chuckled, “The intimidation from Ying Shan Xue Ying is way more frightening than before. He could easily summon a group of World Masters from Broken Tooth Mountain Range with a call! Of which all of them would hear his orders.”
“Mn.” Emperor Summer nodded, “His rise can’t be stopped.”
“That’s right. Nobody can stop him.” Ancestor Fan sighed, “It is very hard for other cultivators to obtain any treasures in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. But this Ying Shan Xue Ying doesn’t have to take the risk. Instead, many natives are willing to give them to him.”
“There’s no use envying him. You can’t blame anyone but yourself for being far weaker than him in your Mirage and Illusory Realm.” Emperor Cang added from the side.
“His Mirage and Illusory Realm is simply too powerful!” Ancestor Fan shook his head.
Two Daos.
One being the Dao of Void and the other the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm. Both Daos made others perceive clearly the terrifying rate at which Xue Ying was improving!
Furthermore, he had help from many opportunities in Broken Tooth Mountain Range. That gave him an even greater advantage.
“Mn? Talking about Monarch Flying Snow and he is here.” Emperor Summer suddenly laughed. All three of them turned towards a location in midair. There, a white-robed young man walked out before landing down with a smile. He was not the slightest arrogant. Instead, he politely greeted: “Greetings, Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, and Emperor Cang.”
“Come have a seat, Monarch Flying Snow!” Emperor Summer welcomed him.
“We were just talking about you and here you are.” Ancestor Fan added, “Flying Snow, currently, there are some unparalleled existences talking about how you would most likely become the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land! You would be standing above both Emperor Summer and Underworld Emperor.” After finishing his words, Ancestor Fan gave Emperor Summer a grin.
“I haven’t even reached the final realm and is still too far away.” Xue Ying humbly replied.
Emperor Summer retorted: “I do agree with it though. Even though I have gotten a supreme secret impartation, I do not have any Chaotic Origin Weapon. Hence, it is impossible for me to execute the final killing technique imparted down from the supreme secret impartation. But for you, once you reached the final realm in your Dao of Void, with your supreme secret impartation coupled with your Chaotic Origin Weapon, that Underworld Emperor would only be comparable to you.”
Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
The Chaotic Origin Weapon was meant to be used with the supreme secret impartation! Even if one acquired a supreme secret impartation, without the appropriate Dao of Void supreme-graded secret treasure, it was impossible for him to execute the final killing technique.
Broken Tooth Mountain Range
“If Monarch Flying Snow were to reach the final realm in your Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, things would become harder to predict. Currently, some Emperors could be easily taken down with your technique. If you were to reach the final realm in that Dao, with a thought, all of us final realm cultivators would simply be immersed in your illusory realm. I do not find that bit puzzling.” Emperor Cang sighed, “The Dao of Soul is innately complex and difficult. It should produce various mystical effects once you reach grand perfection in it.”
Any Daos had their specialties once they were taken to the grand perfection realm.
Hence, most final realm cultivators were incredibly good at surviving even if they did not own any supreme-graded secret treasures! As for how powerful the Dao of Soul when it was taken to grand perfection? That was something they could not predict.
“I do wish to reach the final realm too! But it is simply too difficult.” Xue Ying shook his head and sighed.
“Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, and Emperor Cang.” Xue Ying continued, “Actually, I came today to ask for a favor from the three of you.”
“Oh? The powerful Monarch Flying Snow could casually summon several World Masters for help. Why the need to find us for help?” Ancestor Fan teased.
“Monarch Flying Snow, do tell what you need us to do.” Emperor Summer answered instead for the three of them.
Emperor Cang also looked at Xue Ying.
They were curious. This Monarch Flying Snow had countless treasures. Currently, he was incredibly powerful too! All six great ancient nations naturally respected him. Certain experts like Extreme Night Primogenitor and Moonflower King had already visited him and sworn an oath to dissolve any enmities! It was only the resentful ‘Eternal Night Primogenitor’ who was still hesitating over his pride. With such huge influencing abilities, what could the three of them do for Xue Ying?
Xue Ying nodded. He spoke with a solemn look: “I wish to eliminate Undying Underworld Emperor!”
“Eliminate Undying Underworld Emperor?”
The three of them were greatly shocked. They were filled with disbelief.
“He is currently the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land.” Emperor Summer said, “The moment he unleashes his trump card, not even I am his opponent. And you are planning to eliminate him?”
“There is no need to be worried over a direct combat.” Xue Ying said, “I am confident. I can easily ask several World Masters over for help. 30 of them, 50 of them, or even 100 of them! That is nothing too difficult for me.”
The expressions of Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, and Emperor Cang changed when they heard that.
More than a hundred World Masters?
Yuan had left behind a law to restrict any entrants from Broken Tooth Mountain Range to be at most initial Emperors. As for the ‘Death Destruction Clan’ who were filled with madness in their blood, they were completely forbidden from entering the Realm Heart Great Land! Even though Initial Emperors had slightly cruder techniques, they were comparable in strength with Emperor Summer. Emperor Summer could easily defeat a World Master by relying on the profundity of his techniques.
But if five or six of them worked together, Emperor Summer would be disadvantaged.
“We have only heard from others about this. But hearing it from Monarch Flying Snow personally, I finally understood your influence in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range.” Ancestor Fan lamented.
Xue Ying did not elaborate.
Much less World Masters.
He could even seek Great Emperors and a group of god generals for help!
As for World Masters? There were too many of them he could find for help.
“A group of World Masters is sufficient to deal with Undying Underworld Emperor once they enter a combat formation. The moment that Undying Underworld Emperor finishes utilizing his trump cards, it is possible for me to kill him.” Xue Ying said, “Currently, the most troublesome part is… if he plans on escaping without fighting back, it is almost impossible for me to find him.”
“Mn.”
“Right. You can’t find him if he plans on escaping.”
“It is hard even to trace down ordinary final realm cultivators. Undying Underworld Emperor has reached final realm in two Daos. How could you find him if he focuses solely on escaping? Those native World Masters are amazing, but their understanding of the laws is too crude. It is impossible for them to trace down Undying Underworld Emperor at all.”
The three of them said.
Xue Ying agreed. This was also the main reason why final realm devils could bring down calamities in Realm Heart Great Land. The moment they chose to escape, they could hide their aura and conceal their movements. It would be nile impossible to find them then.
“That is why I came here today.” Xue Ying said, “To ask the three of you and see if there is anything I can do to trace him down.”
“It is difficult to trace down Undying Underworld Emperor!” Emperor Summer answered.
Xue Ying’s eyes brightened. Emperor Summer mentioned that it was difficult! He did not say it was ‘impossible’!
“Does Emperor Summer have a way of doing so?” Xue Ying asked, “If Emperor Summer could help me kill that Undying Underworld Emperor, I do have a piece of flame-type supreme-graded secret treasure that I can gift Emperor Summer.”
Emperor Summer’s eyes brightened when he saw that.
He had a void-related supreme-graded secret treasure, though he did not have one for his Dao of Flame.
“What a huge sum.” Emperor Cang sighed.
“You are really willing to spend it for the sake of killing Undying Underworld Emperor.” Ancestor Fan sighed as well, “Perhaps you might become the strongest cultivator in Realm Heart Great Land in the future. But now, you are already the richest in Realm Heart Great Land. You have so many Native Clans from the Broken Tooth Mountain Range helping behind your back. It is impossible for us to compete.”
Xue Ying continued asking: “Do you have any ways of tracing him down and killing him?”
“Undying Underworld Emperor has ultimately reached the final realm in two Daos. Even though both were offensive in nature, his abilities in concealment remains incredibly strong. I can’t even trace him down.” Emperor Summer shook his head, “But there is someone in the Realm Heart Great Land who could do so.”
“Who?” Xue Ying asked.
“Limitless City Master!”
Emperor Summer said, “I have talked to Limitless City Master before. Hearing from him, in the past when Undying Underworld Emperor returned to the Realm Heart Great Land, he was still able to discover Underworld Emperor despite the other party hiding. But the path of cultivation of Limitless City Master was unique. His personality is weird too. I am not confident at all of asking him for help. You can only rely on yourself for this, Monarch Flying Snow.”
“Limitless City Master?” Xue Ying slightly nodded.
Even if he asked a group of experts for help, Undying Underworld Emperor could easily escape in the Realm Heart Great Land and conceal his aura.
And it seemed only Limitless City Master could help him in this endeavor of tracing down the Underworld Emperor?
But Limitless City Master…
Xue Ying was not confident as well. The other party was the final realm cultivator with the weirdest personality across Realm Heart Great Land.
‘I should just attempt it. No matter what, I should think of ways to ask Limitless City Master for help.’ Xue Ying thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 1243 - Meeting Limitless City Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 1243: Meeting Limitless City Master
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
To many weak little cultivators and even some ordinary Cosmos Gods, Limitless City Master was the unparalleled existence with the best temperament!
But to other final realm cultivators and unparalleled existences, Limitless City Master had the weirdest personality.
Also.
He was publicly recognized as being the cultivator with the strangest and mysterious techniques! He was even ranked at the top of the five ancestors in Myriad Realm Ancient Nation! His survival capabilities were heaven-defying, and his scouting ability was recognized as number one across all Realm Heart Great Land.
“A guest is coming.”
With a body covered in green skin, Limitless City Master stood at the top of the highest palace in the City Master Residence where white fog surrounded the place. He had a blood-colored horn protruding on his head, yet his eyes gave off a gentle feeling. Even the weak ordinary animals did not feel any threat from Limitless City Master at all. He seemed to be part of the Realm Heart Great Land-as a being that did not give off any aura or grandeur of power. He was simply ordinary.
If he chose to conceal his traces, nobody would most likely be able to find him.
Limitless City Master looked ahead.
Ripples were formed over there, and a white-robed young man walked out from it. He stepped on the void before coming close to Limitless City Master.
“It is rare for Monarch Flying Snow to visit my Limitless City.” Limitless City Master chuckled.
“I do apologize to City Master for taking the liberty to visit you.” Xue Ying walked over.
“Destiny is already fixed. There is nothing presumptuous of you to pay me a visit.” Limitless City Master said. He then pointed out with the green arm of his, “Monarch, please have a seta.”
Both parties walked to the side.
Both parties sat down opposite on an ordinary stone stool with a stone table placed in between.
Limitless City Master personally poured wine for Xue Ying. It was an ordinary wine.
“I’ve heard the news of Monarch’s soul technique that is so powerful it could cause several Emperors in Broken Tooth Mountain Range to fall.” Limitless City Master said, “Even though we cultivators have reached the final realm, we would most likely be significantly weakened under Monarch’s soul technique. Dare I ask if Monarch has reached the final realm in the Dao of Soul?”
“I have not.” Xue Ying replied truthfully, “It was due to some fortuitous encounters that I comprehended some special techniques.”
Limitless City Master said: “In the vast Origin World, everything revolves around the Supreme Law. Flowers and trees grow, ants and insects would reproduce. Many intelligent beings emerge over time, though the ‘soul’ remains the most special. It is the foundation of all lives, and even the foundation of the Origin World.”
Xue Ying agreed.
The ‘Essence of Blood Spirit’ refined by blood sacrificing many sentient beings had a better effect than the Origin World Stone.
And even when many sentient beings chose to believe and be loyal to a person, the will of the masses would influence the will of the Origin World. The Origin World would thus acknowledge allegiance to that person, simply promoting him to become the master of the Origin World!
The soul… was indeed the most special substance of an Origin World, and was also the true foundation of all sentient beings. Thus, it was incredibly difficult to walk further down this path!
“I’ve seen through how the myriad existences work in the Origin World, yet I can’t see through the soul.” Limitless City Master said.
“I personally can’t comprehend much of it either.” Xue Ying said, though he was feeling apprehensive. The first thing Limitless City Master talked about with him was on the soul and how the world worked. He discussed about the myriad existences and sentient beings of an Origin World. It was better for him to simply get to the point: “City Master, actually I have something I have to trouble City Master for.”
“Do say.” Limitless City Master remained gentle.
“Undying Underworld Emperor has already become mad. If we don’t stop him, he would most likely cause a huge calamity to befall.” Xue Ying said.
“Why is Monarch saying this?” Limitless City Master said, “Why would Underworld Emperor become mad at his current realm?”
“Not too long ago, he came to find me.” Xue Ying said in detail.
He explained the threat of Undying Underworld Emperor once through.
“His demand was too high. It is simply impossible for me to satisfy it.” Xue Ying shook his head, “Since the discussion failed, he closely began collecting souls frantically. I’ve investigated what was happening. It appears he is conducting some kind of experiments on the soul.”
Limitless City Master nodded: “Underworld Emperor once took on the path to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. After failing, he returned once again with the idea of wanting to refine the Death Walker so that he could visit the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. In the end, you disrupted his affair. Now that your influence in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range has rose to a tremendous level, he felt that his hopes of entering the Snake Tooth Corridor is simply too minute. Naturally, he chose to take the last gamble. That is the personality of Underworld Emperor.”
“I’m afraid many innocent beings would be sacrificed during his final gamble.” Xue Ying said, “Are we going to watch as all these small and weak beings die like this? I can’t do that. Hence, I am prepared to eliminate Undying Underworld Emperor.”
“Eliminate Underworld Master?” The eyes of Limitless City Master revealed curiosity.
“I’ll bring over a large number of World Masters from the Broken Tooth Mountain Range before forming a group to kill Underworld Emperor together.” Xue Ying said, “Being a final realm cultivator, the moment he chose to escape by concealing his aura, it’ll be hard for us to trace him down. What I know is that City Master, you are currently the only one in Realm Heart Great Land who could trace down Undying Underworld Emperor. Hence, I came seeking for your help, City Master.”
“I do have the capabilities of tracing him. If Emperor Summer could not do so even at his current realm, then I would most likely be the only one.” Limitless City Master admitted.
“I wish City Master could help me.” Xue Ying said, “If City Master requires anything, do say. I can even present a piece of supreme-graded secret treasure to City Master if you agree to help out.”
“Monarch is indeed the wealthiest expert in Realm Heart Great Land currently. Hearing your offer has greatly enticed me.” Limitless City Master then shook his head helplessly, “But it’s a pity that I can’t help you.”
“Can’t help me?” Xue Ying was both anxious and puzzled, “Why can’t you help me? All City Master has to do is to mark the location of Undying Underworld Emperor. No matter where Underworld Emperor escapes to, you would be able to find him. As for the matter of killing him, it’ll be done by the World Masters I invited. There’s no need for City Master to act.”
Limitless City Master replied: “Monarch, please return.”
“Doesn’t City Master care about the weak beings too?” Xue Ying anxiously added, “I can help City Master regardless if you need treasures or opportunities.”
“It is unrelated to this.” Limitless City Master shook his head.
“Unless City Master has some friendship with Undying Underworld Emperor?” Xue Ying anxiously asked. He did not have any choice since Limitless City Master was the only one who could help locate Undying Underworld Emperor down.
Limitless City Master chuckled: “How can I have any friendship with him? If he dies, I might even drink a few cups of wine delightedly.”
“Then why?” Xue Ying did not understand.
They had no friendship.
He even requested the other party for help with many benefits, yet Limitless City Master chose not to agree.
“I can trace him down. Not only could I trace him down, I can even trace down all other final realm cultivators and unparalleled existences.” Limitless City Master said, “But have you ever heard of me killing a final realm cultivator?”
Xue Ying was stunned.
That’s right.
He had heard from Emperor Summer that Limitless City Master could trace down Undying Underworld Emperor. That was why he immediately came to ask the City Master for help. But he missed out on the fact that since the City Master could locate Undying Underworld Emperor, he would most likely be able to locate other final realm cultivators too.
But why were the various huge devils like Eight Silk Island Master so free and unfettered still?
“Because I can’t kill.”
Limitless City Master answered.
“You can’t kill?” Xue Ying felt even more puzzled.
“All of us sentient beings are part of this world.” Limitless City Master chuckled, “The weakest being the ants, and the strongest being the Cosmos Gods. All of us are part of the Origin World. We are part of the manifestation from the Supreme Law. Everything revolves under the Supreme Law. The sentient beings reproduce and cultivate. They form emotions for one another. Everything is a kind of manifestation from the Supreme Law. Just like how you are here seeking me for help, it is also part of the way the Supreme Law works.”
Xue Ying was startled.
“I do not really care about treasures or opportunities.” Limitless City Master said, “I don’t care about supreme-graded secret treasures either. I have long reached the final realm, and has always been comprehending the Supreme Law.”
“My mind is constantly fusing with this Origin World. Only then could I deepen my perception of how the Supreme Law works.”
“The Supreme Law is incredibly mysterious.”
“With the way the Supreme Law revolves, balance is naturally derived. I am merely an observer how the law maintains order.” Limitless City Master smiled at Xue Ying, “I am not willing to see the balance being disrupted. Every final realm cultivator is nurtured by this Origin World as the strongest and most stunning magnificent being. Observing them makes me happy. If I were to kill them, I would be disrupting the balance of the world, and that is something I dislike the most.”
“Especially so for myself. It is fine if I went out to fight. But If I were to kill a final realm cultivator, it would influence the state of the world. As a result, I would be embroiled in the law, causing karma to tie up on me. If that happens, the difficulty for observing the order would significantly increase.”
“Undying Underworld Emperor is currently the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land. If Monarch Flying Snow were to invite a group of World Masters and I helped you to kill him…”
“It would affect the balance too much, causing a change to the law of order. Hence, the difficulty for me to observe the law would increase by 1,000 to 10,000 times.”
“Hence, I seek Monarch’s understanding that I can’t help you in this.” Limitless City Master said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1244 - Supreme Shi Fa
chapters.content:
Chapter 1244: Supreme Shi Fa
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying understood. After reaching the final realm, what was next would be to advance forward to the ‘Chaotic Origin Level’! Old Monster Stone for instance, was wholeheartedly focusing on his Dao path to ‘have a breakthrough with his strength’. Limitless City Master had his own path. He planned on analyzing the Supreme Law by observing the law of order! And by participating in the affair to kill Undying Underworld Emperor, it would significantly affect his Dao path.
It would make his Dao path 1,000 to 10,000 times harder. Hence, Limitless City Master would definitely not be willing to do it!
‘Breaking the Dao path’ of any expert would definitely cause the other party to go mad!
“City Master, this is where you are wrong.” Xue Ying did not give up. Instead, he shouted, “Do you think your Dao path is the right one? No, it is wrong.”
“Wrong? Oh, where am I wrong?” Limitless City Master took the initiative to ask.
“Soul… is the foundation of cultivators.” Xue Ying solemnly explained, “And does City Master know what the deepest desire of the soul is?”
“What is it?” Limitless City Master felt curious. This white-robed young man standing before him was the one who walked the furthest down the Dao of Soul in the history of Realm Heart Great Land.
“Freedom!”
