Xue Ying softly declared. He could not forget the joyful cheer let out by those sentient beings after they were saved from being enslaved by Sacred Master. It was the cheer of freedom! Souls were born to be free.
“Every soul desires to be free.” Xue Ying explained, “They desire freedom. They desire to transcend. By continuously cultivating, only then could one be able to jump out of the cage and become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. And you, City Master, you are afraid of breaking the law of order. You remain cautious so as to prevent from getting polluted by karma. You are like an observer watching carefully by the side, yet you do not know that you have unknowingly become a protector of the ‘law order’, becoming part of the law.”
“We are all simply a manifestation of the Supreme Law.” Limitless City Master shook his head.
“We have been nurtured and manifested from the Supreme Law, but we aren’t part of the Supreme Law. The Supreme Law is our cradle. We ultimately desire to jump out of this cage!” Xue Ying stared at Limitless City Master, “If you resigned yourself to being part of the law, and that you dare not influence the law on a large scale basis, then it would be impossible for you to transcend.”
“What you said is logical.”
Limitless City Master shook his head, “But I have my path! There’s no need for you to convince me anymore.”
Xue Ying became silent.
He did not feel willing.
But he understood that an existence who had broken through to the final realm and was still growing, would definitely not be easily convinced.
Unless he had met all sorts of issues during his cultivation! Only by reflecting upon it would he alter his Dao path. It was useless for a bypasser to convince him otherwise, especially when Xue Ying did not understand the City Master’s Dao path at all!
…
Flying Snow City.
“No wonder the weaker cultivators find him the warm and gentle. Even though the regulation in his Limitless City is strict, as long as order is maintained, nothing would happen.” Xue Ying shook his head, “To turn himself into an observer of the law of order, he is not willing to participate in worldly affairs. It is natural for him to be transcendental. This personality… indeed makes him the weirdest.”
He could understand the other party more now that he found out about his Dao path.
Compared to this Limitless City Master, Eternal Night Primogenitor, Extreme Night Primogenitor, Ancestor Fan, Emperor Summer, Undying Underworld Emperor, Towering Sky King, Moonflower King and others were more realistic. They had their own likes and dislikes.
“What should I do?”
“Without his help, nobody could locate Underworld Emperor.”
“Unless I have to ambush and kill him directly?” Xue Ying did not find it too possible. Undying Underworld Emperor would definitely escape once he found out that things were amiss. To prevent the other party from escaping? This possibility could be ruled out! After all, the profound means Undying Underworld Emperor had were way beyond what the native World Masters could achieve.
Just as Xue Ying was distressed over the matter, the avatar he left at Starlight World received the transmission from Great Emperor North River.
“Monarch Flying Snow, I am prepared. It is time for us to move.” Great Emperor North River transmitted over.
“Time for us to move? Good!” Xue Ying immediately acknowledged.
He could only put aside the matter of killing Undying Underworld Emperor temporarily and ponder through what other good ways there were.
First, he would help Great Emperor North River out. After all, he had promised the other party.
******
North River World.
Xue Ying arrived at the palace hall.
“Brother Flying Snow.” Seated at his throne waiting, the green-robed ‘Great Emperor North River’ stood up when he saw Xue Ying enter. There were other god generals in the palace hall too-a total of ten of them. They were also the top ten god generals within the 36. Most of the time, they were usually noble and free. This time for all of them to be summoned over, this showed how grave and important this matter was to Great Emperor North River.
“Great Emperor.” Xue Ying smiled, “Are you done preparing?’
“I am!”
Great Emperor North River said high-spiritedly, “Brother Flying Snow, shall we set off now?”
Xue Ying nodded: “I wonder where are we going? Which of the three Great Supremes are we targeting?”
“Supreme Shi Fa.” Great Emperor North River replied.
Xue Ying nodded. Supreme Shi Fa was considered relatively strong between the three Great Supremes of the Death Destruction Clan. But he was similarly savage and ruthless, and was absolutely a huge devil. Perhaps it was because he had been born from death, Supreme Shi Fa found that bringing death to other beings was a form of ‘charity’. Hence, he liked doing so. He would frequently descend on a Native World before conducting a ceremony. After which, he would grant all living beings on that world ‘death’.
Supreme Shi Fa felt that this was benevolence. This was doing a favor for everyone.
To the many Natives, they felt it was too frightening! Even Xue Ying considered this to be an absolute innate devil!
“In the past, even though I’ve visited the Shi Fa Island before, I was still forced out without even seeing the Supreme himself. This time, only with Brother Flying Snow do I have the confidence of entering.” Great Emperor North River chuckled, “This is a huge favor that I’ll certainly remember. After we return from Shi Fa Island, I’ll definitely not treat Brother Flying Snow badly.”
“Let us go on our expedition before saying anything else. After all, the other party is a Supreme.” Xue Ying said. Any one of the five great Supremes were not easy to deal with.
“Alright. Go, let us set off!”
Great Emperor North River laughed.
He walked with Xue Ying side by side, with the other 10 god generals following behind. They tore through the void and left the North River World.
…
Shi Fa Island.
Since this island was occupied by a Supreme, it was naturally ranked in the first three of all sky-floating islands in Broken Tooth Mountain Range in terms of land mass. Here, opportunities and danger came hand in hand. This island was way more terrifying than the island occupied by one of the 13 Emperors, ‘Emperor Yan’! Just a single ‘Supreme Shi Fa’ was intimidating enough.
“Sou sou sou sou sou sou!”
A total of 12 figures descended directly on this Shi Fa Island.
Even though Shi Fa Island was vast and huge, it was paved with many stone roads. These stone roads intersected at many locations, and were all over the island.
Xue Ying was inwardly stunned when he saw it. Even though he had been to many sky-floating islands in the past, the other islands were incredibly primitive. Only at the clan-ground did he find the architecture to be more unique! One had to know that the worlds cultivators lived in contained various delicacies, styles of building, city layout… they were varying! But the sky-floating islands had been comparatively primitive.
‘This Supreme Shi Fa is indeed a Supreme. He has at least done some simple construct in this sky-floating island.’ Xue Ying thought.
Supreme Shi Fa, according to the intelligence, existed amidst reality and illusion.
His enemies would silently die without knowing.
He had the strangest way of killing his enemies compared to his peers.
The 12 of them had not started moving-they just landed on Shi Fa Island-when a faint black light shot out from the stone road by the side on the 12 of them.
“We have been discovered.” Great Emperor North River lightly chuckled.
“North River, you actually dared to intrude on our Shi Fa Island!” Accompanied with a furious roar, a huge figure in black armor appeared. He wielded an enormous black lance as he stood in midair.

chapters.title: Chapter 1245 - The First Fight with a Supreme
chapters.content:
Chapter 1245: The First Fight with a Supreme
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying looked at this armored expert who wielded a black lance. He could recognize the other party with a glance. He was a great general under Supreme Shi Fa-’Nofando’.
Great Emperor North River did not get angry. Instead, he chuckled at that pitch-black tall and sturdy male: “Nofando, instead of making a big fuss, why not look at who is standing beside me first?”
That pitch-black figure swept his gaze. He saw a white-robed young man standing beside Great Emperor North River. This great general ‘Nofando’, could not help but feel his heart tightening. After a few years of news circulating, even the highest rung in Realm Heart Great Land knew about Xue Ying’s matter in Broken Tooth Mountain Range. Even though the Death Destruction Clan was not as good in its information gathering system, the great generals under one of the five Great Supremes, ‘Supreme Shi Fa’, did still know about the name of ‘Monarch Flying Snow’.
“It is actually Monarch Flying Snow. No wonder you dared to come, North River.” Nofando stared at Xue Ying.
“I am only this courageous.” Great Emperor North River smiled.
Suddenly-
“Hua.”
The void by the side split open to form a passage. From the distorted void passage, eight figures in total came walking out. The leading person was a benevolent-looking old man wearing a golden robe, and behind him were experts of the Death Destruction Clan with aura that was ever-imposing.
“Supreme.” Great General Nofando immediately came to the side. He bowed and greeted respectfully at the Supreme.
“Supreme Shi Fa.” Great Emperor North River was no longer as relaxed as before. He became much more solemn now.
The ten god generals under Great Emperor North River became much more nervous.
“Supreme is it?” Xue Ying was curious, though his heart tightened at the advent of a battle.
The reputation of a Supreme preceded him.
Ultimately, the intimidation power of Supremes was tremendous! Before them, ordinary unparalleled existences in Realm Heart Great Land could be easily killed by a single blow from Supremes! Even ‘Emperor Summer’ would be easily killed instantaneously without any means of retaliation. Even ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ could only escape from Great Emperors after igniting his heart blood, yet it was worth being proud for him to withstand a few moves before a ‘Supreme’.
This was a ‘Supreme’!
Even the strongest ‘eight Great Sages’ among the low-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms in Broken Tooth Mountain Range were greatly weaker than a Supreme. They would simply be trampled upon!
‘According to what Great Emperor North River said, Supremes have reached consummation in their bloodlines. Taking another step and they would truly awaken their bloodlines, becoming the ancestors of their race!’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
Such power was too frightening.
Emperor Deep Stone and other eight Great Sages were simply trampled upon by them.
Even the number one ‘Great Emperor North River’ among all Great Emperors was weaker by a level as compared to Supremes. Without Xue Ying helping out, he would simply be seeking death for coming to Shi Fa Island.
‘It seems he is no longer similar to others from the Death Destruction Clan already.’ Xue Ying looked at this old man wearing golden robe walking over on the void, ‘Supreme Shi Fa’. The body of Supreme Shi Fa did not give out any dark, evil aura. Instead, he made others feel warm and comfortable. Garbed in a dazzling golden robe, he had a smile on his face. This ‘Supreme Shi Fa’ smiled at Xue Ying before turning to Great Emperor North River: “North River, knowing that you have invited Monarch Flying Snow from the Realm Heart Great Land before, I would have guessed that you are coming to my place.”
“I’ll naturally come.” Great Emperor North River solemnly said, “Supreme, are you still planning on hindering me this time?”
“Hindering you? I have never hindered your path.” Supreme Shi Fa chuckled, “If I planned on stopping you, I could simply entice you deep into the island. And once you are deep inside, I’ll send a group of my subordinates to kill you… We can simply bombard you. It won’t be too hard for me and my subordinates to kill you either.”
Great Emperor North River’s expression shifted slightly.
Right.
This was reality!
He could bring with him a group of subordinates. The Supremes could simply summon all their subordinates to kill him. It’s just that over the years, the five Great Supremes did not do so! Reaching their level, they were disdainful of doing such acts.
“There are many experts who covet the treasures on my island. It can’t be that I would let them take those treasures whenever they want, right?” Supreme Shi Fa chuckled, “It must be a fair trade! Or they could try breaking through my subordinates and defeat me, that way they could naturally take the treasures away. It’s a pity that you can’t do it. Who can you blame?”
Xue Ying agreed by the side.
Even though most treasures in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range were located in the sky-floating islands! The Natives could always compete for them.
And what they competed on were their strength!
‘Interesting. They say most members of the Death Destruction Clan aren’t willing to trade. But it seems this Supreme Shi Fa is willing to do so.’ Xue Ying clicked his tongue. Xue Ying could not feel any evil and vicious aura from Supreme Shi Fa at all, ‘The only thing is that he likes ‘doing charity’, causing many to return back to death. This personality is quite frightening.’
…
As different thoughts raced through Xue Ying’s mind, Great Emperor North River said solemnly: “Supreme, are we going to fight this time as well? With the help of Brother Flying Snow, I doubt your subordinates are of any use.”
“Of course we have to battle.” Supreme Shi Fa answered.
Great Emperor North River, the ten god generals, and Xue Ying felt their hearts tightening when they heard that.
Were they about to battle?
Supreme! How strong was one?
“Very good, Supreme, don’t blame me for teaming up with others to deal against you.” The eyes of Great Emperor North River were filled with frost.
“We do have to battle, but it is fine for me to fight against this cultivator from Realm Heart Great Land, Monarch Flying Snow.” Supreme Shi Fa grinned at Xue Ying, “I am not interested in the native experts. I am instead slightly interested in Monarch Flying Snow. Monarch Flying Snow, I’ve heard that you could cause some Emperors to fall. I do wish to experience your soul technique.”
“Me fighting against the Supreme?” Xue Ying was stunned.
No matter what, he could reduce the strength of a Supreme slightly. Even if the Supreme had 10% of his strength, he could easily wipe Xue Ying out! After all, the gap between Eternal Night Primogenitor and other unparalleled existences with the Supremes was still a frighteningly huge gulf.
“Hahaha, you just have to care about executing your moves.” Supreme Shi Fa laughed, “I will not bully a weak little cultivator.”
Xue Ying felt slightly uncomfortable in his heart.
Weak little cultivator?
In the eyes of the Supremes, all cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land were weak! Emperor Summer and Undying Underworld Emperor would be sending themselves to death if they came. Fortunately, there was the law restriction by ‘Yuan’, preventing the Supremes from entering Realm Heart Great Land.
Even though he understood this point, it was not a pleasant feeling to be looked down upon.
“Alright.”
The moment Xue Ying spoke, his eyes widened.
“Hong-”
The Mirage and Illusory Realm had already descended upon that Supreme Shi Fa!
Even though his executed technique did not affect the subordinates of the Supreme standing by the side, including Great Emperor North River and the ten god generals as well, all of them could feel a fatalistic allure from the ‘eyes’ of Xue Ying. That made them turn towards the eyes of Xue Ying subconsciously. This was also a killing technique which he comprehended from the ‘gray eyes’. His eyes had similarly become incredibly alluring, resulting in a force that could cause others to yield to him.
It was fortunate that others were watching from afar. They did not suffer from the direct illusory realm, allowing them to easily resist against the technique. Though they were all startled inwardly from the technique.
“Such a formidable soul technique. I wonder how much of my strength would be left if I were to be struck by it.” Great Emperor North River and other experts were all slightly startled by the fact.
“Mn?”
Supreme Shi Fa was originally fine, when suddenly, his expression changed.
“Hong-”
A terrifying dark aura erupted from the body of Supreme Shi Fa, charging out in all directions. It engulfed the surrounding world instantaneously, causing the place to turn dark. Others like ‘Nofando’ and experts from the Death Destruction Clan had been forced backwards. Some were even injured from the shockwave. All of them revealed a look of terror.
“Stop.” Great Emperor North River roared.
Many surging sword lights began appearing around Great Emperor North River. Those sword lights filled the place, protecting Xue Ying and the ten god generals.
“Chi chi chi~”
The dark aura clashed with the surging sword lights, causing the sword lights to be diminished over time.
“This, this is simply too powerful.” Under the protection of the sword lights, Xue Ying looked around as the sword lights clashed with the dark aura. He felt an innate terror arising in his heart! He had a faint feeling that his body would be shattered the moment he contacted this dark aura.
“Hmph!”
The distant Supreme Shi Fa suddenly let out a cold snort. He forced back his aura and opened his eyes at Xue Ying: “Monarch Flying Snow, you could keep your soul technique now.”
Xue Ying immediately brought the technique back.
“What a formidable illusory realm.” Supreme Shi Fa sighed, “I could maintain my consciousness against it and even deliberately chose to enter the illusory realm to have a look. Who would have thought that I had suffered from it, causing some aura of mine to leak out. Now that I have experienced such a soul technique, it has indeed broadened my horizons. Monarch Flying Snow, and also North River, you may enter!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1246 - Black Leaf Lake
chapters.content:
Chapter 1246: Black Leaf Lake
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying was dumbstruck.
Most experts would usually try to resist against his illusory realm, yet Supreme Shi Fa took the initiative to enter it instead. He was simply too confident of himself! But clearly, he had suffered from some losses; he was forced to use all his strength to break apart the illusory realm, which was why the terrifying aura leaked out from his body. The aura from any Death Destruction Clan members was originally vicious and terrifying, and this ‘Supreme Shi Fa’ was concealing it during normal occasions. When he chose to release his aura, it was sufficient to kill even Kings. And Emperors like the God Generals would be injured and forced to retreat. Only ‘Great Emperors’ could still resist the shockwave of this aura with a slight ease.
“We may enter?” Great Emperor North River revealed a joyous look , “Thank you Supreme Shi Fa then.”
“With Monarch Flying Snow around, even if I planned on stopping you, it is impossible.” Supreme Shi Fa said, “Go, let me bring you guys in. It’ll take too long for the few of you to fly in slowly.”
Great Emperor North River did not reject.
At the same time, he was observing Xue Ying in the dark, and observing Supreme Shi Fa too. He was curious. How much had Supreme Shi Fa’s strength been influence under Monarch Flying Snow’s soul technique? But since he dared to take the initiative in entering the illusory realm, it would not have affected the supreme greatly if he chose to simply resist against it.
‘It would most likely be taxing even if I worked together with Monarch Flying Snow against a Supreme.’ Great Emperor North River thought, ‘But it would at least shorten the gap between me and the Supremes! Furthermore, with Monarch Flying Snow around, I am not afraid of being attacked by a group. What a pity that Monarch Flying Snow would not always be there following me. He even helped Shamanic Wind before previously!’
“Hu.”
An unseen energy was released by Supreme Shi Fa. Great Emperor North River was still protecting Xue Ying and the ten god generals with his energy.
“Sou!”
They simply penetrated through the void and arrived deep inside the core of this island.
“We are here.”
Supreme Shi Fa’s voice sounded.
Everything changed before his eyes. And when Xue Ying looked again, he saw he was beside a fiery-red lake. The fiery-red lake was emitting a shockingly high temperature that caused the void to distort. There were also many pieces of floating black leaves above this lake. Those black leaves were covered the entire region spanning more than 10,000 kilometers. They were in concentric circles, with the inner black leaves becoming bigger than those on the outside.
The core black leaves had a diameter of 50 kilometers long, while those leaves at the outermost perimeter was merely sufficient for three to five ordinary people to stand on.
Other than the black leaves, there were many violet flowers blossoming too.
Just glancing over, Xue Ying could see approximately 100 beautiful flowers, and likewise, the flowers closer to the center were bigger. Paired with those biggest black leaves at the center was a huge violet flower blossoming. That violet flower occupied about one-third the size of a core black leaf.
“Hu-”
These black leaves and violet flowers that scattered across the lake emitted an unseen aura of suppression. It suffocated the experts present.
“North River.” Supreme Shi Fa chuckled by the side, “The Black Leaf Lake is here. I won’t stop you. The flower dew you collected would all be yours. But you should know that the flower dewdrops of the Black Leaf Lake aren’t that easy to collect.”
“Rest assured. I have made my preparations.” Great Emperor North River first collected the ten god generals. He was afraid that Supreme Shi Fa might strike the god generals while he was collecting the dew. As for Xue Ying? Xue Ying came this time as a precaution, though he had brought several avatars of Xue Ying with him and they were kept in the Eden Treasure which Great Emperor North River had with him.
Even if the avatar located outside suffered from a sneak attack, it would not affect the final outcome.
Great Emperor North River exchanged glances with Xue Ying.
“Great Emperor, you can just go and collect the flower dew. I’ll simply look around.” Xue Ying was curious about this place.
“Alright.” Great Emperor North River nodded. He casually flew towards the outermost piece of black leaf. After lightly landing on this leaf, he rushed over to the closet violet flower…
After Xue Ying witnessed Great Emperor North River taking out a complex item and use it to collect the dew, he went back looking at his surroundings. The surrounding structure extended forever. Even this lake was within an enormous garden enclosed by walls.
“This time, it is because of Monarch Flying Snow’s presence. Otherwise, that North River would not have arrived before the Black Leaf Lake.” Supreme Shi Fa walked over to the side of Xue Ying, chuckling, “Monarch Flying Snow, given your attainments in the Dao of Soul, why would you help this North River? I believe other Great Emperors are competing over to get closer to you right? If you don’t help North River, North River can’t do anything to you either.”
Xue Ying smiled.
He helped Great Emperor North River because he wanted to stop the war. Of course, since Great Emperor North River had remained polite to him, he chose to acquiesce to the other party.
“Great Emperor North River could give me what I want.” Xue Ying immediately diverted the topic after that, “Supreme, why is the suppression from this Black Leaf Lake so frightening?”
Standing by the side of the lake, he had a suffocating feeling.
“You will only feel some slight suppression by standing by the side of the lake.” Supreme Shi Fa chuckled, “If you were to step on that black leaf, and the closer you get to the center, the strongest the suppression would get. Even I could not step on the center black leaves.”
“Even Supremes can’t go there?” Xue Ying was startled.
What kind of strength did a Supreme have? Just the suppression alone was sufficient to hinder a Supreme from entering into the centermost leaf?
“This Black Leaf Lake is related to one of the two incredibly terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that fell in the past.” Supreme Shi Fa sighed, “He had already died, and the remnant energy he left behind had transformed into this Black Leaf Lake that was sufficient to stop even me from entering close to it. I truly do not know how frightening those two existences were if they were still alive.”
Xue Ying nodded. After all, existences who could injure Yuan would most likely be close to his level.
“Even though there are more than 100 Black Leaf Flowers, the capabilities of North River in resisting against the suppression aren’t better than mine. He would most likely only be able to collect half the dew from the Black Leaf Flowers. Furthermore, this half of the Black Leaf Flowers is also the smallest ones.” Supreme Shi Fa lightly chuckled, “The closer to the center, the bigger the flower would be. Like that violet flower located at the core? It spans across several thousand kilometers, and the dew it has would most likely be more than all other flowers added.”
“Can I go on to have a look?” Xue Ying asked.
“Naturally you can.” Supreme Shi Fa chuckled, “But you have to be careful. Don’t touch the lake water as it is blazing hot. With your strength, you would most likely turn into ashes.”
“I understand.”
Xue Ying immediately flew over heading towards the outermost black leaf.
“He also went over?”
“This Monarch Flying Snow also went over?” Some of the subordinates under Supreme Shi Fa were discussing with one another. The majority of them were unsatisfied! Not all Death Destruction Clan members had good temper.
And Great Emperor North River chuckled when he saw Xue Ying coming. He transmitted: “Brother Flying Snow, do be careful.” He then went back to collect the dew.
Lightly descending, the tips of his legs stepped on the black leaf. The black leaf was pliable and tough, and easily supported Xue Ying.
‘What a frightening suppression.’
Xue Ying was not interested in the flower dew. Firstly, he did not need them. Secondly, he did not have any unique item meant for collecting them.
He was instead more curious about the suppression of the Black Leaf Lake. The centermost leaf was strong enough to prevent even Supremes from entering over.
“Da da da…”
Xue Ying seemed to be strolling as he walked.
After all, there were many leaves scattered across the entire region, and Xue Ying moved relatively quickly one leaf over to the next. The black leaves underneath his feet also gradually became bigger, and that suppression feeling was getting stronger too.
‘What a powerful suppression.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
The suppression was directed to the soul.
Over time as he got closer, it felt like an endless mountain pushing down on his soul.
‘It is really difficult to move.’ Xue Ying tried his best to continue on.
“What?”
Supreme Shi Fa was startled when he saw that, “He actually walked so far?”
“How could he unknowingly walk to such a far distance?” The other Death Destruction Clan experts were all incredibly startled.
“This, how could this be possible?” Even though Great Emperor North River came here to collect the flower dew, he was still constantly aware of his surroundings. When he discovered that Xue Ying had walked in to such a far distance, he could not help but feel astonishment. He regarded the ‘Black Leaf Lake’ highly. He had already collected a huge amount of information on it, and knew he would unlikely be able to walk this far.
Black Leaf Lake
Gradually.
Xue Ying began showing how laborious it was. But he actually reached another piece of leaf that was closest to the center. That leaf spanned five kilometers in diameter.
‘Mn? Even though I find that it is difficult, I am just left with the last lap before reaching the core leaf.’ Xue Ying was incredibly stunned. Even though his soul had absorbed the core blood from the ‘Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother’ before, he was still ultimately a level-two Cosmos God. And the core blood of Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother made the soul of this avatar stronger than ordinary final realm experts.
The gap was too great between him and Supremes.
But in terms of willpower, Xue Ying was much higher than these members of the Death Destruction Clan and the Natives who relied simply on their bloodline energy. This was also the advantage cultivators had.
And as he was comprehending the killing technique for the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, his soul had some unique qualitative transformation. Furthermore, he was the number one expert in the Dao of Soul. He could easily control his soul energy to turn into a vast world, using it to resist against the suppression of the soul!
“This can’t be!” Supreme Shi Fa was startled.
“Unless…” Great Emperor North River who was collecting the flower dew suddenly stopped. He turned to Xue Ying.
Under their observation, Xue Ying continued without stopping. He finally stepped onto the biggest piece of black leaf in the entire Black Leaf Lake.
“Weng!”
Right at the moment Xue Ying stepped on the core leaf, that biggest Black Leaf Flower also emitted a dazzling violet light that shone in all directions. It also shone on Xue Ying himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1247 - Reveal
chapters.content:
Chapter 1247: Reveal
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The light emitted from that biggest violet Black Leaf Flower spanning across several dozen kilometers long was incredibly bright. It was so dazzling that it could easily make one intoxicated. Even Supreme Shi Fa, Great Emperor North River, and other observers were both astonished and allured by the light. They watched the white-robed figure continue walking to the central-most black leaf, feeling startled, jealous, envious, and disbelief…
All sorts of emotions began sprouting out in these bystanders. They felt complex.
“He could actually enter and reach the center?” Even with the identity of Supreme Shi Fa, he could not help but mumble to himself. The Black Leaf Lake was located on his island. He tried so many times, yet his soul could not withstand against the terrifying suppression, forcing him to stop.
“Who would have thought that despite me inviting him for help, in the end, he is the one to gain the most!” Great Emperor North River stopped collecting the flower dew. Being the newest Great Emperor that rose, yet was already currently the strongest Great Emperor, the reason was due to his effort in grabbing all opportunities coming his way. At this moment, he understood that the terrifying suppression let out by the center black leaf as well as the mysterious light emitted by the violet flower would definitely mean a ‘huge opportunity’ at hand!
He desired such an opportunity.
But it was impossible for him to reach the center. He was not qualified to compete for it. Much less him, even the Supreme could not reach the center.
For a moment, everyone watched jealousy. Yet they could not do anything.
“What is that?”
Suddenly, Supreme Shi Fa and others were startled.
While the center Black Leaf Flower was emitting a violet light in all directions, suddenly, everyone saw many spots of light flying upwards. Those droplets of dew could be seen vaguely by everyone. Under the illumination from the light, those droplets actually refracted the light. And under this spectacle, there was a mysterious silhouette shadowed beneath the dewdrops. These dewdrops had seemingly been attracted by an unseen energy as they flew in the direction of Xue Ying, fusing into his body.
“Are those the flower dewdrops?”
“Black Leaf Flower dewdrops? Not right. They seem slightly different.” Supreme Shi Fa and Great Emperor North River could only make their guesses.
******
As Xue Ying reached the center black leaf, that flower immediately let out an intense violet light. As this light shot out refracted by the dewdrops, he could see a strange object within. Even though he could determine that these dewdrops were extraordinary, and his instinct had a desire for them, Xue Ying did not evade from those dewdrops since this was merely an avatar of his. He let those dewdrops land on his body and allowing it to absorb them.
“Hong!”
At the moment those dewdrops touched his body, Xue Ying felt his consciousness ring.
He finally ‘saw it’.
He saw with incomparable clarity amidst an endless dark Chaotic Origin Space, there was a humongous lifeform flying. It had several dozen claws, and had a dense number of eyes all over its body. These eyes were either gray or gold, though they were all closed at this moment.
Because Xue Ying had seen too many gray and gold eyes, even if these eyes were closed, he could determine with a glance that those were the mysterious eyes he once seen on the sky-floating islands.
To the distance, there was a bright radiance. It came from a huge Origin World. That world was also releasing ripples that charged out into the surrounding Chaotic Origin Space.
And this incredibly huge lifeform flew over slowly. It seemed slow, yet it took just several seconds to fly across the diameter of an Origin World simply because it was too big!
And it was only by comparing it with the vast Origin World could Xue Ying judge that this ‘huge lifeform’ was about one-tenth the size of an Origin World!
‘It’s body is this huge?’ Xue Ying was astonished.
This life form was simply too beautiful.
It was a beauty that incorporated the ‘laws’.
And each gap between the scale formed a space. Different regions of its huge body contained different distortion of time. No matter how time changed, this humongous lifeform would exist-past, present and the future! It was eternal! Xue Ying even had a vague feeling that reaching this level, that huge lifeform should be ‘eternal and undying’.
It seemed like it should appear in the future!
But Xue Ying faintly understood that this huge lifeform should be one of the two incredibly terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that died and was left in the ‘Broken Tooth Mountain Range’. It even injured Yuan! Nonetheless, it still fell in the end! Xue Ying wondered if it was killed by Yuan or the collective effort by Yuan and other Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
‘It is truly beautiful!’ Xue Ying exclaimed in his mind.
Those claws contained the terrifying Law of Destruction.
As its body swam, it made Xue Ying feel the incredibly mysterious Profound Mysteries of the Void.
Its body was constantly generating a terrifying attractive force. But if one came close to it, its body would produce a terrific repulsive force instead. And it was this intertwining attraction and repulsion that caused the dark Chaotic Origin Space to ripple, forming waves of Chaotic Origin Energy.
“Weng.”
Suddenly.
The eyes on that huge lifeform opened. They turned to a direction.
More than a thousand eyes-half of them were golden, and the other half were gray. Even if they were not staring at Xue Ying, Xue Ying still felt an endless allure from the gray eyes. And those gold eyes were filled with a terrifying offensive power. Both of them were perfectly fused, reducing the resistance of enemies while attacking their souls at the same time. It was due to the perfect coalesce of those two attributes that made it such a frightening killing technique!
“Peng!”
Closely following that, the scene in which he saw in his consciousness shattered.
And Xue Ying regained his consciousness shortly. That Black Leaf Flower before him was still letting out an alluring violet light. As Xue Ying went over, he discovered the petals of the flower slowly blooming. And when it fully blossomed, there were several dewdrops within. Right at the core was an inlaid crystalline bead that seemed like a ‘raindrop’ instead.
Because it was entirely transparent, and it contained a moving luster. Looking at it, it seemed like dew.
But Xue Ying knew that this was not a dew.
‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet.’ Xue Ying’s heart was racing.
“Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet!”
Not just Xue Ying, even Supreme Shi Fa who stood by the shore of the lake watching everything and Great Emperor North River who had already stopped collecting the flower dew looked over to that droplet situated at the center of the stamen with great familiarity.
Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet!
The supreme treasure of Broken Tooth Mountain Range!
The Broken Tooth Mountain Range had two great supreme treasure. One being the ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’ and the other, ‘Snake-Tooth Bead’.
They were sufficient to make any ultra-strong experts in Broken Tooth Mountain Range red with madness. Because the moment one got them, they could rely on these supreme treasures to enter the legendary forbidden ground in Broken Tooth Mountain Range, the ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’. The Snake Tooth Corridor was too dangerous. Even its entrance was incredibly frightening. If Supremes were to enter without any protection, they would undoubtedly die. They had to bring with them the Snake-Tooth Bead or the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet.
“Not good!”
When the Black Leaf Flower completely blossomed and revealed that Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet, the originally terrifying suppression which existed everywhere suddenly disappeared.
At the moment it disappeared, Xue Ying understood that things would turn for the worst!
Originally when he stood here, nobody could come thwarting or wrecking his business due to the terrifying suppression which prevented even Supreme Shi Fa from entering.
“Sou.” Xue Ying’s immediate reflex was to extend his hand, causing his arms to grab that Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet as fast as lightning!
“Hong! Hong!”
Both Supreme Shi Fa and Great Emperor North River began moving.
“Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet.” Supreme Shi Fa would not have thought that at the center of his Black Leaf Lake hid a Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. Even though there were quite a few ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplets’ and ‘Snake-Tooth Beads’ in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, they were all scattered across the vast place and getting any of them was incredibly hard! In history, almost all of these supreme treasures were obtained by Supremes precisely because it was too difficult to even find them!
The number of times any Great Emperors got them were not many at all.
And Supreme Shi Fa had entered the Snake Tooth Corridor three times in total! Precisely because he had entered before did he wish to enter again!
“Supreme Shi Fa, hold your hands!” Great Emperor North River was taking it seriously. His reaction was even faster than Supreme Shi Fa! In addition, he was originally on the Black Leaf, he was much closer than the supreme. Great Emperor North River merely needed to take a step to cross this distance of more than a thousand kilometers.
Even though Supreme Shi Fa could teleport.
In reality, flying was much faster than teleportation at this distance! Teleportation required some time to traverse from one space to another.
“Scram!” Supreme Shi Fa roared angrily. He waved his palm out. This was the first time he acted against Xue Ying and others.
“Brother Flying Snow, illusory realm!” Great Emperor North River roared at the same time.
“I understand!” Xue Ying did not hesitate at all. The terrifying Mirage and Illusory Realm descended down with full-force on that Supreme Shi Fa.

chapters.title: Chapter 1248 - Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet
chapters.content:
Chapter 1248: Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
A sword also appeared in the hands of Great Emperor North River. He slashed out, causing a stream of river to form. This river surrounded and protected both Xue Ying and Great Emperor North River.
And as Supreme Shi Fa suffered from the illusory realm, it could be seen that his slap had been affected by it-it became much weaker and slower. Nonetheless, it still made Xue Ying feel threatened.
“Peng~”
This slap was accompanied with the descend of endless darkness, causing the sword river created by Great Emperor North River to distort. Great Emperor North River immediately brought Xue Ying to a retreat!
Over at those places where the palm and sword river clash, the endless dark aura transformed into tiny snakes that tunneled in! These snakes seared under the obstruction from the sword lights, turning smaller and smaller until they were fully consumed. Nonetheless, there were still some tiny black snakes which reached Xue Ying. Great Emperor North River angrily roared and slashed out, successfully breaking apart from the darkness albeit barely.
“Supreme Shi Fa, you can’t stop us.” Great Emperor North River shouted.
The shockwave generated from the clash of both parties shot out in all directions. It also rushed up onto Xue Ying’s body, causing him to feel breathless. His skin even started tearing apart, and waves of pain assaulted his senses.
“Brother Flying Snow, you can’t even resist against this?” Great Emperor North River transmitted over to Xue Ying. He could not stop the full-powered strike from a Supreme completely. Nonetheless, just the shockwaves alone were sufficient to cause Xue Ying’s body to break down. This was something ordinary Kings from the Death Destruction Clan and Natives could easily withstand from.
“I am ashamed.” Xue Ying felt helpless. He was simply too weak and had to use his body to resist against the attack. Even though his fleshy body was considered formidable among cultivators, and his capabilities at dissipating force were quite amazing too, he could hardly compare with the Natives who had Chaotic Origin Bloodlines, much less with those from the Death Destruction Clan. The fleshy bodies of members from the Death Destruction Clan were way stronger than that of those part of the Natives.
Supreme Shi Fa stopped.
He stood on a piece of black leaf watching silently. The surrounding was in a complete mess. Quite a few flowers had even been destroyed from the remnant force. Nonetheless, Supreme Shi Fa did not care. Those flowers would bloom over time.
“Your luck is truly good.” Supreme Shi Fa said with a muffled voice.
“It is Brother Flying Snow who has good luck.” Great Emperor North River laughed. The previous exchange gave him confidence. It appeared that Supreme Shi Fa only had approximately 70% of his original strength left! Even though he was much stronger than Great Emperor North River still, this slight advantage made it hard to determine a victor even if they fought for more than 100,000 years to a million years! Furthermore, he still had ten god generals with him.
Those god generals were deliberately chosen from the 36 God Generals, and were the strongest. Under the influence from the illusory realm, the subordinates of Supreme Shi Fa could not do anything to them.
“I can’t stop you all.” Supreme Shi Fa nodded and admitted, “But there is only one Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. How are the two of you planning to divide it?”
Xue Ying exchanged glances with Great Emperor North River.
How should they split it?
“Brother Flying Snow, we are both currently tied to the same ship. None of us can leave.” Great Emperor North River transmitted, “Only by working together can we leave safely.”
“Monarch Flying Snow.” Supreme Shi Fa lightly landed on a piece of black leaf. He said: “Given your current strength, there is no meaning for you to visit the Snake Tooth Corridor. After all, you haven’t even reached the final realm! How about this, we can do a trade. Give up on this North River and pass the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet to me. Tell me what you want and I’ll do my best to help you accomplish it.”
This was still the first time one of the five Great Supremes gave this promise to Xue Ying.
“North River.” Supreme Shi Fa looked at Great Emperor North River once again, “Even though this Monarch Flying Snow is under your protection and you can kill him anytime, hearsay he has countless avatars. Killing these few avatars of his won’t affect him at all. As for the ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’, without Monarch Flying Snow’s help, do you think you can escape out of my Shi Fa Island? For the sake of this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet, I am willing to throw wind to my reputation, summoning all my subordinates to deal against you! By then, you would not only lose the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet, you would lose your life too!”
The expression on Great Emperor North River became uglier.
Right.
If Xue Ying chose to help Supreme Shi Fa, Great Emperor North River would indeed encounter a tremendous danger. If this was during a normal occasion, the Supreme would feel disdainful from teaming up against him.
But the ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’ involved a chance to enter the Snake Tooth Corridor. To the five Great Supremes, it meant a chance to break through and become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. That was also the reason why these Supremes would choose to be unscrupulous and pay no heed to their reputation!
“Brother Flying Snow, you must not believe in Supreme Shi Fa.” Great Emperor North River transmitted over, “Unless you do not know about the personality of those from the Death Destruction Clan? They are erratic, and deep in their bones are all the traits a devil can have!”
Xue Ying went silent.
Great Emperor North River became even more anxious.
He desired to acquire the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet, yet he was worried about losing his life.
‘This is so mysterious.’ At this moment, Xue Ying held on to the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. He could feel waves of fluctuations coming from it. After sending his consciousness into the droplet, he could even feel an illusory realm within. It was a ‘Thousand-Eyed World’! An incredibly mysterious world!
‘Is this the reason why the Bewilderment effect from the gray eyes and the Slaughter effect from the golden eyes could coexist?’ Xue Ying pondered over it. Being a great expert in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, he was very clear about this fact. For instance, the first killing technique he created using the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm could cause enemies to fall into oblivion.
And the essence of the first killing technique was an illusory realm which was used to engulf the enemies! It would pull the souls of enemies into this illusory realm.
As for the golden eyes, Xue Ying had memorised many illusory realm structures of them too. He even had an avatar accompany the number one god general under Great Emperor Shamanic Wind, ‘God General Stone Light’, to explore and find more gray and gold eyes. Hence, he was constantly memorizing more illusory realm structures of those mysterious eyes.
And by consolidating what he had learned of the illusory realm structure from the gold eyes, Xue Ying had a rough idea of how his second killing technique would be.
But the first killing technique could not be used simultaneously in dealing against an enemy with the second killing technique.
Because both killing techniques were based on an illusory realm!
One illusory realm was used to bewilder the enemy.
And another illusory realm was to extinguish the enemy.
Both illusory realms were vastly different.
And the soul of the enemy could only be pulled into an illusory realm. He could no longer enter a second illusory realm after entering the first. Those two illusory realms were conflicting! Nonetheless, when he was still a level-one Cosmos God, when he had yet to fuse the five branches from the Dao of Mirage together, the techniques he learned were much cruder and simpler. For instance, a Bewilderment technique would only contain the Bewilderment effect. And the ‘World’ simply encompassed and Illusory Realm. And ‘Slaughter’ meant a killing technique targeted at the soul! Hence, they could be used simultaneously.
Reaching the current strength of Xue Ying, a single technique of Mirage and Illusory Realm encompassed many profound mysteries. He ‘World Lineage’ had already been fused into the technique. Only then could it be so terrifying.
Hence, an illusory realm could not be used at the same time with another.
‘So it seems.’ Xue Ying was personally experiencing this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet.
There was a faint illusory realm in this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet.
And this world perfectly fused the Bewilderment Illusion from the gray eyes with the Slaughter Illusion from the gold eyes.
‘This Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet is incredibly useful to me.’
‘The gray eyes and the gold eyes gave me a preview of two different paths.’
‘And this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet is able to fuse both different paths as one. That is also the true killing technique the terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeform has.’ Xue Ying concluded. How frightening was it to fuse two great killing techniques as one? When the enemy was resisting against the Bewilderment effect, their heartforce would suffer from a huge drop. And precisely at this moment, another soul attack would come, causing the enemy to most likely suffer from a grievous injury. An injured soul would be more taxing if it was used to resist against the Bewilderment effect once again.
Both techniques were complementary.
‘The Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet is incredibly important to me. But if I were to be its sole owner? I doubt Supreme Shi Fa would agree, and neither would Great Emperor North River as well.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Even if I temporarily agree with any of them during this dangerous situation, they would still kill me once we leave the island.’
‘Supreme Shi Fa is a member of the Death Destruction Clan and can’t be trusted. As for Great Emperor North River, he could possibly be trusted.’
‘But I can’t own it. I can only negotiate with him?’
Xue Ying’s thoughts raced through the different scenarios.
He was quite curious about the Snake Tooth Corridor too.
But he temporarily did not have a strong desire to enter! Firstly, he rather hoped to enter the final realm first. Only then could he save some of his loved ones and good friends before his hometown Origin World entered Great Apocalypse. Secondly, it was the ‘Illusory Realm’ inherent in the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet that was more important to him. Risking his life in the Snake Tooth Corridor? He would wait until he reached the final realm before even considering that.
“Great Emperor North River, do you really wish to have this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet?” Xue Ying transmitted over.
“Honestly speaking, I desire to have it.” Great Emperor North River’s heart started racing. He looked at Xue Ying, transmitting back, “My path of cultivation is just one step away from reaching grand perfection in the Emperor Realm. But I am the youngest among all Great Emperors and have never entered the Snake Tooth Corridor before! If I could enter, perhaps I might be able to break through to become a Supreme. Nonetheless, if Brother Flying Snow wishes to have it, we can definitely have a good talk over it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1249 - Backstab
chapters.content:
Chapter 1249: Backstab
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying did not dare believe him. Currently, the desire Supreme Shi Fa had for the ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’ made him completely willing to team up and attack them. Hence, for the sake of his life, Great Emperor North River would definitely make a compromise. Nonetheless, when they were about to leave this Shi Fa Island, Great Emperor North River would most likely backstab him for the sake of theThousand-Eyed Water Droplet.
“Great Emperor North River, what Supreme Shi Fa said is right.” Xue Ying transmitted, “I haven’t reached the final realm. I am merely curious about the Snake Tooth Corridor, and do not have a strong desire to enter.”
When Great Emperor North River heard that, his heart moved.
“But this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet is slightly unique. I wish to take some time off comprehending it.” Xue Ying continued, “How about this, let me do some research on the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet for a trillion years. After a trillion years, it’ll be yours. How about that? If you are willing that I would take this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet and run away, how about this, I can leave this avatar that holds the droplet with you. It’ll stay by your side and even in your Eden Treasure. Both of us can even swear an oath over it! I believe you should know how important an oath is to us cultivators!”
“Good good good.” Great Emperor North River joyfully answered, “I do not know how I should repay Brother Flying Snow over such a great favor. I owe Brother Flying Snow greatly this time. Once the matter is over, Brother Flying Snow can tell me how you want me to repay you.”
“How about we swear an oath now?” Xue Ying asked.
“Definitely. I’ll swear an oath with Brother Flying Snow.” Great Emperor North River hurried.
Both of them quietly agreed upon the conditions and also swore an oath.
Xue Ying did not have any better ideas.
Trust in ‘Supreme Shi Fa’? He did not dare believe a Supreme from the Death Destruction Clan!
Then he could only place his trust in Great Emperor North River!
If he did not give the other party sufficient benefits, Xue Ying felt that given the personality of ‘Great Emperor North River’, he would immediately become hostile with Xue Ying once they were out of this island.
But he had no choice…
He was weak! He could only resort to this!
“Monarch Flying Snow, you should make your decision properly. Are you planning to trust me or him?” Supreme Shi Fa asked.
“Supreme, I apologize.” Xue Ying answered.
“Good. I hope that you do not regret.” The expression of Supreme Shi Fa became cold. He knew that the reputation of the three Supremes from the Death Destruction Clan was not stellar. Hence, it was normal for the other party to place his trust in Great Emperor North River.
Supreme Shi Fa turned to Great Emperor North River: “North River, you are really lucky. Do you want me to send you off?”
“There’s no need.” Great Emperor North River answered, “I do not need much time even if we fly out slowly!”
“Sou!”
Great Emperor North River waved his hand and kept Xue Ying. He then began flying out of the island, transforming into a stream of light that shot across the sky-floating island.
…
Within the Eden Treasure.
Xue Ying’s group of avatars were here.
‘The Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet.’ Xue Ying held onto the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet, carefully perceiving it. He was completely engrossed in it. This droplet was a marvel!
The ‘Illusory Realm’ inherent within the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet was incredibly mysterious. Every single illusory realm structure that he memorized previously from the gold and gray eyes he saw had been fused into it. This droplet seemed to encompass everything without fail.
‘The essence of a world is to be all-encompassing.’
‘Everything could be encompassed within.’
‘The Illusory Realm in this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet is not perfect enough. After all, that Chaotic Origin Lifeform this droplet came from has died, causing the mysteriousness of the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet to deteriorate.’ Xue Ying thought. But if the lifeform was still alive, how would he have the chance to thoroughly comprehend it?
Just as Xue Ying was in the process of comprehending the droplet.
Suddenly, a figure appeared by his side. It was the incarnation of Great Emperor North River.
“Great Emperor.” Xue Ying turned to Great Emperor North River, “Why? Are we out of the sky-floating island already?”
“Very soon.” Great Emperor North River nodded with a smile, “This time, I would have to thank Brother Flying Snow for your help. Because of Brother Flying Snow, I was able to collect quite a few Black Leaf Flower dewdrops. Furthermore, Brother Flying Snow even promised to give the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet to me after a trillion years. This favor is something that I do not know how to repay! Even though I could collect and gift one or two pieces of supreme-graded secret treasures to you, their value is still too far off as compared to this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. Hence, I am unable to repay this great favor of yours, and can only etch it in my heart.”
‘Etch in his heart?’ Xue Ying was stunned. Did he not say he was planning to gift supreme-graded secret treasures to Xue Ying as repayment for the favor? Xue Ying immediately felt things were amiss.
“Also, the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet is too precious. I honestly am not reassured to let Brother Flying Snow hold it for a trillion years. It is still better for me to keep it in my hands. That way, I would feel more assured.” The smile on Great Emperor North River became even more vibrant.
Xue Ying’s expression transformed: “North River, you plan to--”
“Right. You aren’t that foolish.” Great Emperor North River waved his hand. “Hong long long”, streams of sword light surged over like waves. Great Emperor North River grinned at Xue Ying.
Xue Ying immediately tried executing his Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique. Nonetheless, as he was still within the sky-floating island, he could not teleport out.
“I am truly blind!” Xue Ying’s eyes became cold.
“Hong!”
His many avatars were powerless against the river of sword light from Great Emperor North River-they were all extinguished.
And only the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet was left behind.
Great Emperor North River immediately revealed a look of excitement. He extended his hand and grabbed onto that Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. His body was even trembling slightly: “The Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. I finally got it! What a fool. A trillion years? Even though you swore an oath, who knows if something might happen after a trillion years. I feel more assured by keeping it with me.”
“Haha, my harvest this time is incredibly huge. I’ve collected sufficient flower dew and even got the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet.”
“This Monarch Flying Snow is truly foolish. He actually believed in my oath? Hahaha…” Great Emperor North River sneered.
When he was weak, he once lived in the Realm Heart Great Land.
The cultivators of Realm Heart Great Land did not know that he was a native from the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. Hence, he relied on ‘swearing oaths’ to deceive quite a few cultivators!
“What you cultivators care about is something I don’t!” Great Emperor North River sneered. Some members of the Natives were learning from the ‘cultivators’, and cared about cultivating their hearts. These natives were concerned over oaths. But some experts did not care about it! And Great Emperor North River was in this group!
…
Great Emperor North River acted right when he reached the boundary of the sky-floating island. By relying on the suppression from the sky-floating island, he was able to prevent Xue Ying from executing his Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.
And at the moment he killed Xue Ying, he exited the sky-floating island.
“North River, you have indeed acted.” A figure appeared not too far away. It was Supreme Shi Fa who teleported over.
“Hmph hmph.” Great Emperor North River looked at Supreme Shi Fa, “What a pity. I am already out of the sky-floating island. You can’t deal against me any longer.”
Saying that, he teleported and disappeared from the vicinity.
Supreme Shi Fa watched. He lightly sneered: “What a pitiful Monarch Flying Snow. As I said before, you will definitely regret it! If you were to stand on my side, I might still give you some benefits. Standing on the side of North River would mean your treasures being taken. Ultimately, you are still too weak! You still have to rely on others on combat despite excelling in soul techniques.”
“North River, it is expected that you would backstab Monarch Flying Snow.”
“But you have become enemies with that Monarch Flying Snow over this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. His personal combat strength might be ordinary, but his threat is incredibly huge.” Supreme Shi Fa’s eyes were filled with coldness. The Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet which appeared before his eyes had fallen into the hands of Great Emperor North River. Supreme Shi Fa naturally could not let Great Emperor North River enjoy this satisfaction.
******
“He has indeed turned hostile against me.”
“Both of us swore an oath, yet he still chose to backstab me?” Over at the Starlight World, an avatar of Xue Ying currently sat in a courtyard enjoying wine by himself. He revealed a look of fury.
Xue Ying knew that he would be in a dire situation no matter who he chose.
He had promised to give away the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet, and only wanted to cultivate for a trillion years with it. Both parties sworn an oath, and in addition, Xue Ying’s influence in the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range meant that the future days of Great Emperor North River would not be good if the other party chose to backstab him! Nonetheless, it still happened in the end.
“Damn.”
Xue Ying felt helpless.
He had no choice in this matter-he was too weak! Even if the Great Emperors and Supremes were to be weakened to just 10% of their strength, it was simple for them to pinch Xue Ying to death.
“Brother Flying Snow, you actually found a Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet at Shi Fa Island, yet it was snatched by North River?”
“Monarch Flying Snow, hearsay you helped North River, yet North River backstabbed you and took the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet away? He backstabbed you so emotionlessly despite your help. He mustn’t be left alive! Monarch Flying Snow, let me help you. We should kill our way to the North River World and find that Great Emperor North River!”
“Brother Flying Snow! That North River is such a bully! We must not tolerate this behavior!”
Many responses came one after another at that moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1250 - Fleeing
chapters.content:
Chapter 1250: Fleeing
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
These Great Emperors had extremely good sources of information. They actually received the news so quickly, and a majority of them even took the initiative to ask if Xue Ying needed help.
What a joke.
Most of them became greedy the moment they heard about the ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’.
Even though Great Emperor North River was slightly stronger than the other Great Emperors, they were ultimately of the same level! It’s only because of the 36 God Generals Great Emperor North River had that made him the strongest. But with the appearance of Monarch Flying Snow, the 36 God Generals would choose to run. None of them dared to fight! As for Great Emperor North River? With the help of Monarch Flying Snow, they could easily trample upon Great Emperor North River!
Xue Ying felt puzzled inwardly. The sources of information for the other Great Emperors were too quick. Did Supreme Shi Fa from the Death Disaster Clan leak it out?
No matter what.
He himself could not suppress this anger!
“Good. Brother Shamanic Wind, Great Emperor Xuan Tu, Brother Dong Jian, I’ll have to trouble the three of you then.” Xue Ying transmitted over to the three Great Emperors. Xue Ying had participated in several banquets invited by quite a few Great Emperors, of which his relationship with the three aforementioned was the best. Hence, he immediately asked the three for help.
And a total of five actually took the initiative to ask if Xue Ying needed help!
From this, it could be seen that the relation Great Emperor North River had with other Great Emperors was really poor.
No choice.
Great Emperor North River was an unscrupulous person. For the same of occupying that huge territory Great Emperor Glorious Earth had, he designed a wager and succeeded in his plan. His treatment of other Great Emperors under the same ‘Supreme Vast Ancient’ could be seen from this already! Naturally, Great Emperor North River would definitely not be merciful when dealing with Great Emperors under the other Native Supreme, ‘Supreme Lightning Firmament’.
This man was simply too ruthless.
In the past, Xue Ying promised to help out this ruthless emperor for the sake of evading a huge calamity from befalling Starlight World and many other worlds. In addition, Great Emperor North River knew how to behave himself in the past. Nonetheless, his backstab was both emotionless and ruthless.
…
In the void within Broken Tooth Mountain Range.
A white-robed Xue Ying, a violet-robed beauty, Great Emperor Shamanic Wind who had loose hair draped over his shoulders and a saber by his waist, and a grave and stern middle-aged male gathered in midair.
“Brother Flying Snow, you were too trusting of that North River.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind said, “In the end, you suffered from a loss.”
“Don’t talk about this anymore. Brother Flying Snow, North River should have just dealt against you recently right?” The violet-robed beauty ‘Great Emperor Xuan Tu’ said.
“Yes. It was just a moment ago. I was still lamenting over the fact that fellow Emperors have such great and fast sources of information.” Xue Ying said.
“The news was released by Supreme Shi Fa.” The grave and stern male, ‘Great Emperor Dong Jian’ said, “Supreme Shi Fa did not obtain the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet found on his sky-floating island. Why would he allow North River to celebrate? Furthermore, North River does things unscrupulously too. Hence, we should take this chance to teach him a lesson. Time waits for no man, it is best that we hurry over to the North River World.”
“Agreed. Let’s hurry there.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Hu.”
The four of them broke apart the void and executed the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique. They soon arrived within the North River World.
“Hong long long~”
The four of them appeared above the North River God Palace looking downwards.
“Who!”
“Who dares to offend our North River Palace?”
Directly executing the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique into the residential area of North River God Palace was slapping Great Emperor North River on the face! At this moment, many figures rushed up into the sky. Most of them were incredibly furious. They were subordinates of Great Emperor North River. Currently, Great Emperor North River even had a good relationship with ‘Monarch Flying Snow’. Who dared to be so impudent and killed their way here?
Looking up, the leading god generals and other guards were slightly stunned.
Of the four perpetrators above, one was ‘Monarch Flying Snow’, and the other three were Great Emperors!
“How is it?” Great Emperor Xuan Tu asked.
“I can’t find him. I can’t find him at all in the entire North River World. He should not have returned.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind said.
“Neither did I.” Xue Ying shook his head too. Even though his domain could not cover the entire North River World, it could still cover the majority of it. He similarly did not discover any traces of Great Emperor North River.
Great Emperor Dong Jian looked downwards, sneering out: “North River requested Monarch Flying Snow for help, yet he chose to backstab Monarch Flying Snow for the sake of treasures! Currently, he doesn’t even dare to return to the North River World yet the few of you are still serving him? What a joke!” Saying that, Great Emperor Dong Jian simply waved his hand. “Si la-”
A pitch black crack tore apart the world, causing the North River Palace to shatter like glass.
These god generals and protectors were frightened by the scene.
It was fine for three Great Emperors to work together. What’s worse was even ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ came together. They, god generals, would simply be swept and killed.
“Let’s go.”
The four of them immediately teleported away.
And the current North River Palace was left in ruins, leaving behind the god generals who exchanged glances.
“Let’s go ask Big Brother An Dou.”
“Let’s ask God General Skeletal Dragon.”
These god generals immediately sent out voice transmissions, asking God General An Dou and other generals who had followed Great Emperor North River to the ‘Shi Fa Island’.
Very soon--
“Let’s go. Let’s all go. We shouldn’t care about the North River World any longer.”
“The Great Emperor backstabbed Monarch Flying Snow emotionlessly, killing his avatars and snatching away his Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet! If the other Great Emperors were already this greedy for the supreme treasure, most likely other Supremes would be too. Monarch Flying Snow would definitely not let things slide!”
“Why would Great Emperor care about us now that he has the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet? Let us return to our worlds. We shouldn’t participate in the battle between the Great Emperors.”
“With Monarch Flying Snow around, we at the level of god generals shouldn’t be participating. It would be regretful if we were to die from this.”
Those ten god generals replied.
And the few god generals who were left within the ruined North River Palace became stunned. It seemed their leader ‘Great Emperor North River’ had gotten a huge benefit and left to enjoy it himself. He no longer cared about them.
“Let’s go. What are we doing here for?”
“Go go go.”
One by one, the god generals left. Even the weaker protectors also went back to their hometowns.
******
Xue Ying and the other three Great Emperors were madly searching for Great Emperor North River in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, but to no avail. Great Emperor North River was not a foolish person. He would definitely not show himself.
“Mn?”
The four of them were at a particular location when Great Emperor Dong Jian frowned. He said: “I have gotten news that the subordinates arranged by Supreme Vast Ancient outside Snake Tooth Corridor discovered Great Emperor North River entering the Snake Tooth Corridor not too long ago!”
The Snake Tooth Corridor was a legendary forbidden ground.
Only the five Supremes were qualified to dispatch subordinates over and survey the place. If the other Great Emperors were to send their subordinates over, they would be simply killed.
“Not too long ago?” Great Emperor Xuan Tu frowned, “Doesn’t it mean that he has simply left for the Snake Tooth Corridor immediately without hesitating after obtaining the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet?”
“Even though I do not like this North River and that he is a ruthless person, he is still someone decisive.” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind nodded, “He should have left the Shi Fa Island, let go of the ten god generals before heading to the Snake Tooth Corridor directly!”
“Let’s go have a look.” Xue Ying said.
“Go. Let’s pay the Snake Tooth Corridor a visit.” Great Emperor Xuan Tu nodded.
“Sou sou sou sou…”
The four of them simply teleported through the void. If ordinary experts dared to visit the corridor, they would be killed. But ‘Great Emperors’ were different. It was hard even for Supremes to kill them. Naturally, none could hinder the Great Emperors from visiting the Snake Tooth Corridor personally.
“Hu.”
After penetrating through the void, they soon arrived before a towering snake head. This snake head seemed to be sculpted from stone. Its size was way bigger than any sky-floating island in the mountain range.
That snake head was wide-opened. It revealed its fangs amidst its bloody mouth, and deep down its throat was pitch black. Somehow when this snake opened its mouth, it produced a frightening black maelstrom that devoured the surrounding energy. This maelstrom actually spanned across a region which Xue Ying approximated to that of ‘Southern Cloud Nation’! And it was this frightening black maelstrom that formed a passage which led deep down the mouth of the snake.
That passage also led down to the legendary ground, the ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’.
According to legends, one could see the two rows of snake teeth when traversing within!
“So terrifying.” Xue Ying merely stood afar watching yet he could feel the destructive tearing force from the maelstrom.
Hearsay even Supremes would be torn apart if they were to force their way into the black maelstrom.

chapters.title: Chapter 1251 - Final Realm (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1251: Final Realm (1)
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Mn?”
“It’s the three Great Emperors and Monarch Flying Snow.”
Those who stayed here keeping watch of the place for a long time noticed the three Great Emperors and Xue Ying. They did not stop them.
After all, they knew that a Great Emperor along with the help of Monarch Flying Snow could easily combat against a Supreme.
“That place feels terrifyingly powerful right?” Great Emperor Shamanic Wind looked at that grand and incomparably huge dark maelstrom and the savage-looking snake head, sighing: “Hearsay this snakehead is one of the two Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that died. Even after its death, it still generated a maelstrom that remains eternal. If any of us were to force our way in, we would be sending ourselves to death.”
Xue Ying nodded as he looked at that huge snakehead that seemed to be sculpted from stone. The snakehead was comparable in size to the dark maelstrom-approximately that of the Southern Cloud Nation. How big was the entire snake then?
Such a lifeform was unimaginably big! It was indeed an inborn Chaotic Origin Lifeform, and also a well-known figure. Comparing Chaotic Origin Lifeforms like ‘Emperor Deep Stone’ and ‘Myriad Tentacles Dragon Son’ were simply comparing ants to a dragon.
“North River has already fled into the Snake Tooth Corridor. We can’t continue pursuing him after that.”
“Count him lucky for fleeing fast enough.”
“Many thanks to you three Great Emperors. Since North River has entered the Snake Tooth Corridor, let us place this matter aside temporarily.”
Xue Ying bade farewell to the three Great Emperors and left by himself.
…
This event involved the ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’. That was a supreme treasure which could provide a chance of entering the Snake Tooth Corridor. Furthermore, this event also involved one of the five Great Supremes, ‘Supreme Shi Fa’, Great Emperor North River, and that cultivator from Realm Heart Great Land, ‘Monarch Flying Snow’. Hence, this piece of news spread incredibly quickly. It rapidly spread across all experts in Broken Tooth Mountain Range.
Everyone was discussing about this matter.
They were jealous of ‘Great Emperor North River’, and pitied ‘Monarch Flying Snow’.
“He helped Great Emperor North River fight against Supreme Shi Fa. But other than his soul technique, he is ultimately too weak! When faced with Great Emperor North River, he did not have the slightest ability to resist. Hence, he was killed easily.”
“He is ultimately a cultivator, and cultivators are all weak.”
“He is too weak. It is natural that he could not keep the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet.”
“The Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet is a treasure of our Broken Tooth Mountain Range. How could a cultivator from the Realm Heart Great Land be qualified to own it?”
Even though many experts in Broken Tooth Mountain Range respected Monarch Flying Snow, they were still disdainful of cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land. They had always been unconvinced over the fame of ‘Monarch Flying Snow’. Now that Monarch Flying Snow suffered from a huge loss, they naturally felt delighted.
******
News spread relatively slowly between Realm Heart Great Land and Broken Tooth Mountain Range. But just five years after the event happened, it gradually reached Realm Heart Great Land.
Within a dark palace hall.
There were several pillars inscribed with strange array diagrams. On every pillar hung a powerful vengeful soul.
“Hu.” A strand of consciousness descended. The surrounding World Energy condensed into a handsome male wearing a cape. He was none other than the incarnation of Eternal Night Primogenitor.
When the incarnation of Eternal Night Primogenitor descended, it immediately startled the vengeful souls. These souls struggled and howled! They glared angrily at Eternal Night Primogenitor. Some of them opened their eyes to give Eternal Night Primogenitor a look before going back to sleep. Some were coldly staring at Eternal Night Primogenitor. An ultra-strong vengeful soul was attached to a pillar, and there were a total of 12 of them.
“I wonder what this Undying Underworld Emperor plans to do?” Eternal Night Primogenitor mumbled to himself.
“Eternal Night, you are here.” Seated above on a throne, Undying Underworld Emperor who was wearing a golden robe and a crown opened his eyes. He stared down at Eternal Night Primogenitor, “What are you here for since you aren’t planning to help me?”
Eternal Night Primogenitor said: “Underworld Emperor, you can’t blame me for this. You should know how famous that Ying Shan Xue Ying is, and how much influence he has in Broken Tooth Mountain Range. Many treasures and opportunities were even given to him willingly by the experts from Broken Tooth Mountain Range! Hence, it is highly possible for him to break through to the final realm in the future. The moment he reaches the final realm, he might possibly become the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land! I do wish to survive! Fortunately, I requested ‘Extreme Night’ for help, asking him to plead to Monarch Flying Snow on my behalf. After several promises, that Monarch Flying Snow agreed to dissolve our enmity.”
“Hmph, you are simply afraid of death.” Even though Undying Underworld Emperor understood the other party, he still sneered.
“I have no choice.” Eternal Night Primogenitor shook his head.
He felt humiliated too.
But he was worried that Xue Ying might chase him down and kill him in the future. He did not even dare to ask for mercy since both of them were enemies. In the end, he asked ‘Eternal Night Primogenitor’ for help. Xue Ying agreed to the conditions. Just a year after the incident over the ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’ happened, Eternal Night Primogenitor went to meet Xue Ying alone, making amendments and immediately swore an oath there and then.
Cultivators cared a lot about oaths!
Actually.
Xue Ying was not forcing these great devils like Undying Underworld Emperor, Eternal Night Primogenitor, Moonflower King, and other final realm devils down a path of no return! As long as those devils promised to abide by the conditions, Xue Ying would agree not to pursue them. The reason Xue Ying chose to do so was because he knew these final realm devils would become mad and cause a huge calamity to fall if he did not give them a path to live.
The majority of them had obediently came to make amends and swore new oaths.
Only those like ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ who was one-heartedly pursuing his ambition of becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform did he choose to rely on his cultivation. He no longer had his original confidence, and sought to enter the ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’. As a result, he chose to go hostile with Xue Ying. Currently, he was even madly collecting large amounts of souls. Many other living beings had died because of this. And Xue Ying did not stop him at all!
“It seems that he, Ying Shan Xue Ying, has suffered from an especially huge loss in Broken Tooth Mountain Range?” Undying Underworld Emperor sneered, “He was actually so fortunate to obtain the ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’, yet it was stolen from him because of his inadequate strength. Great Emperor North River treated Ying Shan Xue Ying politely previously, but then he chose to backstab within a split second? Hmph hmph, seems like the experts in Broken Tooth Mountain Range are merely showing Ying Shan Xue Ying respect on the surface during normal times. But for things related to the great opportunity of becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform, what could he, Ying Shan Xue Ying, be considered?”
“Right, the experts in Broken Tooth Mountain Range merely felt he is valuable.” Eternal Night Primogenitor nodded, “After all, we cultivators are much weaker than the experts in Broken Tooth Mountain Range. It was fortunate that Yuan set down a restriction law to prevent the top experts of Broken Tooth Mountain Range from entering into our Realm Heart Great Land.”
…
The peak cultivators in Realm Heart Great Land.
