Some of them were forced under Xue Ying’s intimidating strength and chose to take the initiative and admit defeat. Some were filled with envy and jealousy. Many even sneered gleefully when the event in Broken Tooth Mountain Range happened.
“See how brash he was? He might possibly become the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land, but now in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, don’t those experts in Broken Tooth Mountain Range control the power still?”
“He is ultimately too weak.”
“Others might think he could possibly have a breakthrough, but this bottleneck might last forever.”
Many parties were discussing in dark.
What everyone said was logical too! It was indeed very difficult to reach the final realm. Because of the Chaotic Origin Weapon, and the rumors that Monarch Flying Snow owned a supreme secret impartation coupled with the various opportunities he had in Broken Tooth Mountain Range, many determined that Xue Ying had a large chance of breaking through to the final realm. But no matter how huge this chance was, it was merely a ‘chance’. It was possible for Xue Ying to be stuck at this bottleneck forever.
******
As the outside world continued discussing over Xue Ying, Xue Ying remained living his life carefreely in his Flying Snow City.
What did others say about how he would become the strongest in Realm Heart Great Land?
What did others say about how it was possible for him to get stuck at the bottleneck for a very long time?
What did others say about how he was easily bullied in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range?
“Xue Ying, was that matter over the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet real?” Southern Cloud King came personally to ask.
“Teacher, please have a seat.” Xue Ying was currently watching the clouds leisurely. When he saw his teacher come, he grinned.
“I’ve asked you a question.” After Southern Cloud King sat, he immediately poured himself a cup of wine, downed one before staring at Xue Ying again.
“It’s true! That’s normal too since my combat strength is simply too miniscule in Broken Tooth Mountain Range.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“Ai! What a pity! The chance of entering the legendary forbidden ground in Broken Tooth Mountain Range has appeared before your eyes, yet it was fleeting.” Southern Cloud King said. Previously, he did not know what the Snake Tooth Corridor was. But this time when the news came out, he thoroughly asked others, only to find out some unique secrets regarding the Snake Tooth Corridor. Even the five Great Supremes in Broken Tooth Mountain Range desired to enter that place.
“There’s nothing much to be pitied. I have never thought that I could own that Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet by myself.” Xue Ying said. He had always remained calm without having any excessive expectations, “It’s just that I have judged Great Emperor North River wrongly. We have already sworn an oath and even agreed to the condition that I would have an avatar remain by his side. Nonetheless, he was still not feeling assured. He chose to offend me and take the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet away.”
Southern Cloud King nodded after hearing it: “Mn. It’s a pity. Xue Ying, if you were strong enough to fight against those like Emperor Summer, in addition to your illusory realm technique, there would no longer be a need to fear being trampled by others.”
Xue Ying laughed.
Ultimately, he was too weak. Hence, nothing much could be said about that.
…
The matter over the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet had spread across the entirety of Broken Tooth Mountain Range and Realm Heart Great Land. Yet Xue Ying remained low-profile and continued cultivating.
On this day.
Within Flying Snow City, in the Monarch’s Residence.
Xue Ying sat in the pavilion watching the fish swimming within the lake. Suddenly, he thought back to the scene that he saw.
It was of a terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeform flying in the vast and endless Primal Chaos Space.
“Every movement of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform at this level is simply mystical.” Xue Ying’s memories were good. He clearly remembered every single part of what he saw. It was fine if he did not understand other profound mysteries inherent within the Chaotic Origin Lifeform as it swam away, but the ‘Dao of Void’ was what he specialized in. At this moment when he thought back to that scene, he gradually pondered and grasped over part of the profound mysteries in it.
As it swam away…
A single movement brought it easily across a distance of an Origin World. His control over the Dao of Void had reached a stage that made Xue Ying sigh.
“It is simply too perfect.”
Xue Ying could not see any flaws in its motion.
Everything seemed absolutely of one entity!
He appreciated this scene like an art. He appreciated every single extraordinariness when that huge Chaotic Origin Lifeform swam away.
“The Sky Phase and Earth Phase are completely undivided!”
“The Thread Phase remains so beautiful still.”
“The Violent Phase could reach such a level of strength!”
As Xue Ying appreciated the scene, gradually, a piece of inspiration began flashing in his mind.
His avatar locked in the ‘Seven Bell Pagoda’ had always been comprehending over the Dao of Void. It gained quite a lot from this closed-door cultivation. Xue Ying had always been trying to create the sixth killing technique from the Dao of Void, and at this moment, he finally had the spark of inspiration. In the past, many comprehensions he had were like beads being threaded together.
“The Sky Phase, Earth Phase, Void Phase, Violent Phase, and Origin Phase are all connected with the Empty Phase holding them together! With the ‘Thread Phase’, these phases form a closer relation…” In the mind of Xue Ying projected the scene of that Chaotic Origin Lifeform’s tail waddling. Every single motion comprised of many ‘Thread Phases’ intersecting perfectly with one another.
“Three Thread Phases should be sufficient.”
“Three Thread Phases fused together with the ‘Poly Phase’ merging them as one.”
“And once everything is merged, the motion would return to a Nirvinic state!”
Xue Ying revealed a look of excitement. He had always wanted to fuse all nine branches together. He even accumulated sufficient experiences and comprehensions, only leaving behind just this one last bit of spark of inspiration.
And it was only now did he finally began to realize. From appreciating the swimming movement of that terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeform to gaining a spark of inspiration, Xue Ying entered an incredibly focused state of cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1252 - Final Realm (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1252: Final Realm (2)
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Over at his hometown Origin World, the ‘Primal Chaos Void’, a small boat was flying in the void and Xue Ying currently sat at its head.
His cultivation had reached currently reached a critical moment.
Not just his avatar in Realm Heart Great Land or the avatar here in his hometown, even the avatar meditating underneath the ‘Burning Heart God Tree’ stopped meditating in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm temporarily. All avatars were currently focusing on the Dao of Void!
“Sky, Earth, Void, Origin, and Violent. These five phases are intersected. The Empty Phase holds the other phases and the Thread Phase interconnects them!”
Xue Ying lightly brushed his right hand away.
“Si la-”
A black crack was torn apart in the world. It tore apart even the Primal Chaos Void and the membrane of this Origin World. Chaotic Origin Energy surged in from outside of this black crack. This crack was approximately half a dozen kilometers long! It was as thick as a finger!
“Si la! Si la! Si la!”
Every time he brushed his right hand out or drew in the air using his finger, the Origin World would be cut apart, forming cracks behind.
Xue Ying was testing his techniques here. The avatar in the Realm Heart Great Land’s Seven Bell Pagoda was deducing and consolidating his comprehension. After all, cultivation in the Seven Bell Pagoda was extremely efficient. With inspirations streaming in, Xue Ying was constantly perfecting his techniques. Every time he perfected a technique, Xue Ying would test it out.
“Si la, si la.”
The tearing sound of the Origin World membrane was heart-thumping.
Gradually, this voice became weaker and weaker. And the crack torn became even more inconspicuous.
About ten days later.
“Hu.”
It was a soft voice as if coming from a breath.
His palm lightly ruffled, causing a continuous chain of crack to appear in the world. This crack was very long-spanning across 150 kilometers. It was very thin, so thin that the naked eyes could hardly discern it. Its trajectory was even filled with some rhythm. This crack was not purely a straight or a curved line.
“Almost there. It is sufficient for me to reach this stage of control. After this, I should be fusing the three ‘Thread Phases’ together, and then with the ‘Poly Phase’, returning them to a nirvinic state.” Xue Ying pondered.
The Dao of Void had a total of nine branches-Sky, Earth, Void, Origin, Slaughter, Thread, Empty, Poly, and Nirvana Phases.
“Weaving of the Thread Phase, fusing the Poly Phase as one before returning them to a Nirvanic state.”
Xue Ying mumbled to himself.
His right hand plucked the air again.
Albeit this time, every finger was slightly swaying.
“Hu, hu, hu.”
Three lines of cracks that tore the membrane of the Origin World appeared one after another. When the third crack appeared, they began converging onto one single line. The outcome was a pitch-black hole about ten meters in diameter.
“Not right. This is too crude.”
He once again plucked his fingers out.
He continued testing and adjusting it.
With the memories from his avatars linked, his comprehensions were constantly merging and improving. Some ideas he had were eliminated after testing them out. And thus, Xue Ying was gaining more experience! He was constantly getting closer to success over time. As Xue Ying owned a Chaotic Origin Weapon, and had peak-graded secret treasures, he had felt the Dao of Void at the ‘final realm’! Hence, he knew that he was constantly moving towards his goal.
…
“So it seems that I should be fusing five threads as one.” After experimenting for half a year, only then did Xue Ying discover his error. This inspiration garnered from his experiment led him to create the sixth killing technique. It was formed by taking reference to that terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeform flying in the void. But precisely because there was a gap between his experiment and what he ‘saw’ in his memory when that Chaotic Origin Lifeform swam, only then did he know what the right state of combination was.
Indeed, it was fusing five threads into one.
The swimming motion of its tail consisted of three threads.
But its huge body was of ‘one thread’. And the surrounding Chaotic Origin Energy perfectly fusing together with its body was also of ‘one thread’.
Only then did it form ‘five threads’.
“Five threads fusing as one.”
“One to guide it, one for power, and three as the foundation.”
“I am left with fusing all the phases as one before returning them to Nirvanic state!”
Xue Ying sat cross-legged at the head of the boat. At this moment as he continuously tested his technique, each time made his technique even more violent. It had produced a commotion so big that even ‘Swordmaster’ and ‘Old Monster Stone’ came to have a look. The two of them watched from afar, chuckling before leaving. It was very normal for Xue Ying to produce such a disturbance during his cultivation.
******
Now that he had the embryonic form of the technique, and even with the aid from the Seven Bell Pagoda, Xue Ying still spent 20,000 years before succeeding.
He had met too many issues during this process.
For instance, fusing the five threads as one. Each thread contained millions and millions of variations. They had to intersect with one another perfectly across many places, perfectly fusing together as one.
“Hong.”
On the day 20,000 years since he cultivated at the head of the boat, Xue Ying’s eyes suddenly brightened. He punched his fist out.
“Hong-”
The surrounding void where his fist struck out became quiet. It suddenly shattered, breaking apart of membrane wall in the Origin World. This terrifying fluctuation directly blasted out into the endless Chaotic Origin Space.
This fist was just like how that huge Chaotic Origin Lifeform fly. It was grand and unblockable!
Tyrannical!
Powerful!
Xue Ying had finally fused all nine branches together as one in his Dao of Void. The final part was also using ‘Nirvana’ as the final state, to turn everything into nirvinic destruction.
“I’ve created the sixth killing technique, and have also reached the final realm.” Xue Ying’s heart was palpitating really quickly. There was a smile which could hardly be concealed on his face. The sixth killing technique was formed from the fusion of all nine branches perfectly! He finally comprehended the complete Dao of Void.
“Final realm. I’ve finally reached the final realm!”
“The final realm in the Dao of Void!”
“Hahaha, hahaha…”
Xue Ying could not control his laughter.
It had been too long.
Ever since he knew his hometown was constantly moving towards the Great Apocalypse, he could feel a huge burden pressing down on his body! He could not accept his hometown being destroyed, watching as his loved ones died and leaving behind just himself alone. This loneliness would make him mad! Hence, he did not dare to relax. After reaching a bottleneck from fusing eight branches together, he had no other choice but to try and create a technique that he recognized to be more perfect.
He constantly pursued after perfection. The first killing technique, the second technique, the third technique… every technique was created and every technique increased his experiences.
Finally, once he accumulated sufficient experiences, everything followed through.
With the inspiration from the perfect utilization of profound mysteries when that Chaotic Origin Lifeform swam away, he had an enlightenment to create the sixth killing technique. This was also a technique that made use of all nine branches fusing as one.
“The feeling of the Dao of Void at final realm is indeed different.” Xue Ying chuckled. Standing at the head of the boat, he could survey through all spatial particles in the entire Origin World. He could easily engulfed the entire Origin World, and saw Swordmaster, Old Monster Stone, Forefather Tian Yu, Blade Emperor, and his wife Jing Qiu, his children Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao…
He could see them without them feeling anything.
After all, this was a perception done through the essence of void, the black fog spherical particles.
But there was one who sensed Xue Ying.
“Oh?” Within an ordinary cosmos, the incarnation of Luo City Lord had become a blacksmith and was currently focusing on crafting a blade. Suddenly, he had a feeling which caused him to look upwards. His gaze cast across a huge distance before landing at Xue Ying. With a smile, he said: “Dong Bo Xue Ying, congratulations to you! You have reached the final realm in the Dao of Void before the Great Apocalypse arrives. Now you can save all the people that matter to you.”
Xue Ying currently understood the identity of Luo City Lord too.
There were legends over Luo City Lord even in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range.
This was a newly emerged Chaotic Origin Lifeform who broke through using his cultivation. And according to rumors, he had already reached the highest level of peak and should not be too far off in his strength as compared to ‘Yuan’. If one had to describe him, this Luo City Lodr should not be any weaker than the two terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that fell in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range!
This was the difference between cultivators and natural Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
Even if natural Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were stronger, their control over their power was much weaker. Cultivators had reached where they were step by step. Hence, their control over the laws and profound mysteries were simply too exquisite. Even if Luo City Lord was comparable in his strength with those terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, his survival capabilities would most likely be ten to a hundred times stronger.
Even ‘Emperor Summer’ from the Realm Heart Great Land and those World Masters in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range were initial Emperors in strength!
But when they faced with Great Emperors!
World Masters were practically powerless, yet Emperor Summer could still escape. Even if Emperor Summer fought with a few, he could still escape without dying.
“If not for Luo City Lord’s World Flowers, I might not know when I would be able to break through.” Xue Ying replied humbly.
“Opportunities can be given by others. Strength still has to be grasped by the cultivator.” Luo City Lord chuckled, “Alright properly cultivate. If you could reach the final realm in your Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, I would feel admiration for you.”
Final realm in the Dao of Void?
A peak level Chaotic Origin Lifeform like Luo City Lord who overlooked many Origin Worlds did not care too much!
Instead, it was the Dao of Soul that nobody had ever reached the final realm. If Xue Ying could achieve it, Luo City Lord would naturally feel admiration for him. Any other Chaotic Origin Lifeform would feel admiration.
“I’ll definitely try my best.” Xue Ying no longer felt any pressure.
Without the suppressive feeling from the Great Apocalypse, he had sufficient time to cultivate.
But he was clear that despite seeing his path in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, it was not easy to reach it! One could see how difficult it was even with his Dao of Void as Xue Ying attempted to break through. He had already reached the bottleneck a long time ago. He even had a supreme secret impartation guiding him, yet he only reached the final realm after creating six killing techniques.
Luo City Lord lowered his head and went back forging the blade embryo in his hand. He lightly mumbled: “I wonder what kind of mystical effect would there be if one reached the final realm in the Dao of Soul. Dong Bo Xue Ying? He might possibly be able to break through to the Chaotic Origin Realm! By then, I do not have to stay here looking over this place for eternity anymore.”
The sound of forging continued.
“Blacksmith, Blacksmith, bring out your toughest blade for me! I want the toughest and strongest blade! If I could find one, I would definitely treat you well.” A voice came from outside as a huge hunk rushed in.
“Coming!” Luo City Lord shouted back with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1253 - The Opportune Moment is Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 1253: The Opportune Moment is Here
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Eastern Unicorn Sacred World, located at a relatively desolate residence, Xue Ying and his wife Jing Qiu were found staying here.
“Jing Qiu, Jing Qiu.” Xue Ying immediately shouted from outside a meditation room. His voice transmitted into it.
“Hong long.”
The meditation room boomed open. Jing Qiu walked out helplessly. She gave her husband a glare that was filled with unhappiness: “Xue Ying, don’t you know that I am currently in a closed-door cultivation? If there’s no important matter, you shouldn’t be disturbing me. I was halfway through an experiment yet it had been disrupted by you. And here you are laughing so happily. Even though your wife is not as strong as you, cultivation is still important to me!”
“Haha, let’s not cultivate or what today. We should take a break. Come come come, we husband and wife should have a drink and celebrate!” Xue Ying pulled his wife with him.
“Celebrate?” Jing Qiu was confused, “Celebrate what? What is there to celebrate?”
Xue Ying deliberately chose not to say. He pulled his wife into a garden before sitting down.
He brushed his hand.
A bunch of flowers immediately blossomed to the side, releasing a fragrance that pervaded the place. New trees were also sprouting to the side. Some butterflies began emerging and fluttering around the flowers. The birds were chirping happily. All sorts of beasts began appearing in the distant lake in jubilation.
“Jing Qiu, let me pour you some wine. This is the wine I personally brewed. It is called the Rain Wood Wine.” Xue Ying poured.
Jing Qiu was slightly puzzled. She looked around her and could not help but ask: “You should hurry up and tell me what exactly is it that is worth this celebration?”
Xue Ying passed the wine to his wife: “Let us have a toast first.”
“Alright alright, up to you.” Jing Qiu felt helpless.
Only after both husband and wave toasted and drank one cup of wine did Xue Ying speak to her in a soft voice: “Let me tell you a big secret!”
“I do want to hear what exactly is this big secret of yours.” Jing Qiu placed down her cup.
“I’ve reached the final realm in my Dao of Void.” Xue Ying grinned.
Jing Qiu was stunned.
Following that, she widened her eyes and stared at Xue Ying!
“Truly?” Jing Qiu spoke after being stunned for quite some time.
“Truly!” Xue Ying nodded.
Jing Qiu became joyous! They had long known that their hometown Origin World was moving closer to the Great Apocalypse. Those like Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao were cultivating very diligently. But in reality, they knew that the chances of them surviving after the Great Apocalypse were slim. Even Forefather Tian Yu and others felt that this was an extravagant wish.
The biggest possibility was for Xue Ying to reach the final realm in his Dao of Void before the Great Apocalypse!
After reaching the final realm, his control over the void would greatly increase. He could execute the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ and bring with him other living beings.
“But this is something I am temporarily mentioning to you. Best keep it a secret for now.” Xue Ying reminded, “I still have something important to do in the Realm Heart Great Land. It won’t be too late publicizing this after I’m done with my matter.”
“Alright.” Jing Qiu nodded. Important matters had to be done.
“It’s good that we have a chance to survive from now.” Jing Qiu let out a sigh of relief.
Xue Ying laughed too. Both husband and wife had seen passed life and death. They had already done so when they broke though into the Transcendent stage. They believed Dong Bo Yu and Qing Yao would have accepted that as well after cultivating to where they were now. Nonetheless, both husband and wife hoped they could protect their children for a little longer.
…
Realm Heart Great Land, Southern Cloud Nation, Flying Snow City.
The avatar Xue Ying left protecting the Flying Snow City held onto his Chaotic Origin Weapon familiarizing himself with the strength he had after breaking through.
“This is mysterious.” Xue Ying sat in the cultivation room holding onto the Azure River Spear. He revealed a look of astonishment.
Ever since his Dao of Void broke through to the final realm.
Xue Ying’s consciousness could easily permeate through the black fog spherical particles. Those particles were like cells in his body-they were easily controlled by Xue Ying. Xue Ying could even peer through the walls of the Origin World, seeing the vast Chaotic Origin Space outside! The huge Origin World was constantly emitting ripples that caused the surrounding Chaotic Origin Energy to resonate in response.
“With my Azure River Spear, my perception of the Chaotic Origin Space has clearly become stronger. I could see through a further distance.” Xue Ying sighed.
“There is also the sixth and seventh technique in the supreme secret impartation.”
The Chaotic Origin Sixth and Seventh Strike were the two final techniques. They were extraordinary.
Even if he broke through to the final realm, he could not execute them despite being guided by the supreme secret impartation. He had to have an appropriate Chaotic Origin Weapon before he could do so! It was precisely by relying on these two techniques could Xue Ying transcend beyond the strength of ordinary unparalleled existences. Actually, without the Azure River Spear, just by relying on the first five Chaotic Origin Techniques, Xue Ying could fight against unparalleled existences by relying on some top-graded secret treasures like how Swordmaster did!
“The final two techniques.” Xue Ying sighed. He naturally would not be imitating them so foolishly. Instead, he was extracting their essence and fusing them into his technique.
That would perfect his own techniques further.
******
Enhancing his Dao of Void techniques at the final realm further using the essence from the supreme secret impartation before executing them using his Chaotic Origin Weapon.
One day.
Xue Ying was consolidating his comprehensions. He was trying out his domain techniques. After all, the Dao of Void was well-known for its domains.
“Weng.”
Relying on the Azure River Spear, his perception of the void multiplied.
At this moment.
His consciousness permeated through the black fog spherical particles and continued spreading out. Almost in the blink of an eye, his senses covered the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Every single location in the Realm Heart Great Land, inclusive of where Eternal Night Primogenitor, Extreme Night Primogenitor, those three old ancestors from the Icy Snow Ancient Nation were being seen clearly by Xue Ying. Other than the Realm Heart God Palace, the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, and three other places, Xue Ying could perceive every other location clearly.
These three places were where Emperor Summer, Drifter and Limitless City Master cultivated.
It was done to prevent himself from being discovered.
Xue Ying felt that the array restriction left behind by Emperor Summer and the others would be activated the moment his senses extended into them. Hence, Xue Ying chose not to alert them.
“I, I could actually examine the entire Realm Heart Great Land with my Dao.” Xue Ying was slightly stunned.
The Realm Heart Great Land was too big. It was much bigger than most Origin Worlds.
Its Supreme Law suppression was incredibly powerful too!
Usually, there was a limit to what the domain a final realm cultivator could extend to. And this region was still lacking compared to the entire Realm Heart Great Land. Even when the ‘Primitive Ancient Sacred World’ was still one whole, even though that place was much smaller than the Realm Heart Great Land, final realm experts could not cover the entire place with a thought!
“If not for my Azure River Spear.” Xue Ying attempted to sense the world without using the Azure River Spear.
The region he perceived immediately shrank.
Even with the techniques from the supreme secret impartation, the region he could perceive was only about two times larger than that of the ‘Summer Wind Ancient Nation’ territory! It was still too far off as compared to the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
“I could actually envelop the entire Great Land. Since that’s the case, doesn’t it mean Undying Underworld Emperor can’t escape out of my scouting region?” Xue Ying revealed a joyous look.
If the enemy continued hiding in his domain.
Even if the enemy escaped to another location and altered his aura, the enemy was still constantly being observed by Xue Ying. Xue Ying could easily discern the disguised identity clearly. Naturally, the enemy could not escape! But if Xue Ying merely had the supreme secret impartation, he could only perceive a region twice that of the Summer Wind Ancient nation. The moment the enemy escaped out of his domain, the enemy could easily alter his appearance and aura. Xue Ying could no longer trace down the enemy when that happened!
“But my domain could cover every single location in the world.” Xue Ying revealed a happy look.
‘If I did not care about being discovered, I can easily examine what Emperor Summer, Drifter and Limitless City Master are doing.’ Xue Ying thought. He knew he would be found out immediately if he did so.
Just like how Emperor Summer and the others when they were trying to trace Xue Ying, Xue Ying could likewise discover that someone was searching for him.
“Undying Underworld Emperor! It seems the heaven wants you to die!”
Killing intent began pouring out from Xue Ying’s eyes. This madman was currently reaping countless of souls from living beings all over the world. Xue Ying had never done anything to stop the other party because Limitless City Master, the only person who could trace down Underworld Emperor, was not willing to help him at all. But Xue Ying was fortunate! He had a supreme secret impartation and a Chaotic Origin Weapon. That enabled his domain region to expand to a vast region that covered the entire Realm Heart Great Land!
Hence, the enemy could not escape!
Even his avatar in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range was arranged with his domain covering the intersecting point. If Undying Underworld Emperor chose to escape to the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, he would die even faster!
“Very good.” Xue Ying suppressed his killing intent, “It has been so long already, so spending some more time for me to consolidate my strength won’t do much difference.”
He could still increase his strength temporarily. Hence, Xue Ying chose to consolidate his strength prior to acting.
As for those that were more complex like the Chaotic Origin Refined Body, given Xue Ying’s current realm, he could attempt to create the third level, but it was clearly difficult. That was not something he could achieve in a short period.
Once he finished his consolidation of strength, he would act!
…
Other than telling his wife and being discovered by Luo City Lord, nobody else knew that Xue Ying had broken through.
At 600 years after he broke through, once Xue Ying finished consolidating his strength and perfecting the techniques he often used.
‘It should be about time. I have reached a limit as to how much I could improve. It is time for me to act.’ Xue Ying thought. Previously, he planned on finding a group of World Masters to team up against Underworld Emperor. Nonetheless, he had become stronger now and it was sufficient to complete the mission alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1254 - Doomsday for Undying Underworld Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1254: Doomsday for Undying Underworld Emperor
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Standing in his meditation room holding the Azure River Spear, Xue Ying released his Void Domain.
The domain rapidly covered the entire Realm Heart Great Land while avoiding several places. Xue Ying immediately discovered where Undying Underworld Emperor was-it was a hidden palace located underground in the wilderness. Within that palace, Xue Ying saw many halls used as experimental grounds by Undying Underworld Emperor, and large amounts of souls were currently being experimented on.
There were 12 stone pillars. Each pillar hung a powerful vengeful spirit.
There were also some special souls that made Xue Ying feel weird.
“How many souls have been consumed for these experiments?” Xue Ying’s eyes glowed red when he saw that. Even though the number of living beings who died did not surpass what had happened in the past when 15 nations were sacrificed, it should still roughly add up to an ordinary tier-three nation population. “What a madman. Since he plans on going down this vicious path of cultivation, he should definitely be killed.”
“Si la-”
A black crack formed. Xue Ying took a step in before disappearing from the vicinity.
Great Destruction Realm Teleportation!
******
Within the towering palace.
Undying Underworld Emperor was still patiently conducting his experiments. He had not even begun his experiments on that intact Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse which he had. In his opinion, it was still too early! Some preparatory tests had been done. And only after he was 90% confident of the result would he begin his tests on the corpse. In addition, it had merely been several tens of thousands of years since the failure of negotiation with Xue Ying previously.
“The experiments are going really smoothly.”
“I was able to refine the complete Death Walker in the past. Since I could not meet all conditions currently-I couldn’t sacrifice a huge amount of souls-it isn’t too difficult for me to refine an incomplete Death Walker. My plan was to complete it in a trillion years originally, but after my experiments, it seems I do not need the full period! I should be able to succeed in 100 billion years.” Undying Underworld Emperor’s mood was pleasant.
“The moment I succeed, hmph hmph, Ying Shan Xue Ying, that’ll be the moment I destroy your Flying Snow City. And if you plan on teleporting away your Ying Shan Clan? I’ll simply wipe out your entire clan. Only then could I vent the anger in my heart.” Undying Underworld Emperor looked forward to it.
The complete Death Walker contained a half Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body which was comparable to Supremes.
An incomplete Death Walker, according to what Undying Underworld Emperor knew, should be able to compete with Great Emperors!
Using that to wipe out the Flying Snow City? That was as simple as lifting his hand!
“Hmph hmph, wait for it. Nobody can save you by then.”
“Unless you reach the final realm before my refinement.” Undying Underworld Emperor did not believe it was possible.
“Si!”
Suddenly, in the area within the towering palace, a black crack formed, with a white-robed young man walking out of it. He was also the outstanding Monarch FLying Snow. Wielding a black spear, he coldly stared at Undying Underworld Emperor, roaring: “Underworld Emperor, your doomsday has arrived!”
“Ying Shan Xue Ying?” Undying Underworld Emperor was startled. At this moment, the aura from Xue Ying felt grand and sharp. Even though his aura could be disguised, that Chaotic Origin Weapon in his hand made Undying Underworld Emperor understand that Monarch Flying Snow might take the risk, though he would definitely not risk bringing his weapon out. It was a small thing to lose his avatar, but losing his Chaotic Origin Weapon would be a loss he could not accept.
Since the other party dared to bring his Chaotic Origin Weapon, he should be absolutely confident. It appeared that the worst case scenario had still happened!
“You, you broke through to the final realm?” The voice of Undying Underworld Emperor was slightly hoarse.
“Hou~”
“Ya!”
Quite a few of the 12 vengeful spirits shackled to the pillars let out an ear-piercing roar when they saw this outsider.
Xue Ying also stared back at those spirits. A majority of those vengeful spirits were filled with madness and fury. Xue Ying was only filled with pity for these spirits: ‘Rest assured, I’ll soon take this revenge for you all.’
“I have reached the final realm. Why? Are you surprised?” Xue Ying stared at Undying Underworld Emperor.
“Surprised! Definitely surprised!”
Undying Underworld Emperor understood.
This was the biggest crisis he had ever met in his life! During his expedition of charging up to the Chaotic Origin Realm, he once encountered many dangers. But at that time, there were many experts, and he was merely one of them. Hence, he could still flee successfully.
But here in the Realm Heart Great Land, at this moment, nobody could save him.
“I guessed that you might possibly break through to the final realm, albeit not so fast!” Undying Underworld Emperor rose.
“You should be surprised that your doomsday has arrived so quickly! Let’s not continue with the nonsense. Receive my move!” A sharpness flashed in Xue Ying’s eyes, “hong”, the Mirage and Illusory Realm had descended. It was also the only killing technique in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm that Xue Ying grasped-the Resplendent World! That resplendent and alluring world forced Undying Underworld Emperor to encounter an incredibly alluring force.
“Not good.” Undying Underworld Emperor became sullen.
In terms of soul and willpower.
The Mirage and Illusory Realm’s influence on his heart force was comparable to that against the Supremes.
But those five Great Supremes in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range had powerful bloodlines. They did not care about their realms and profoundness of their techniques. Even if they had little heart force, they could still exert the majority of their strength! But cultivators were different. Techniques which cultivators executed were profound, and the moment their heart force is impacted, the deterioration of their strength would be obvious.
‘The influence on my strength is greater than what I expected.’ Undying Underworld Emperor knew that things were amiss.
“Hong!”
The Azure River Spear in Xue Ying’s hand pierced out.
This pierce caused the surrounding world to collapse as it rapidly press down on Undying Underworld Emperor. And in the metallic heart of Undying Underworld Emperor, two droplets of core blood were ignited one after another, causing a special golden energy to cover his palms. He did not hesitate to meet Xue Ying’s pierce. This pierce might seem ordinary, yet in reality, when it was pierced out, it had already struck against one of the golden palms.
“Peng--”
Undying Underworld Emperor was forced back. He clashed against the palace wall behind, causing it to collapse and form a gouge of several hundreds of thousands of kilometers. Undying Underworld Emperor continued flying back before he finally stopped after a distance.
“Fallen Star Strike.”
A step was all it took for Xue Ying to get out of the underground palace. Once he reached the sky, he sent down another strike with his spear.
“Hong!”
The world shook.
Strands of gray Primal Chaos Light surrounded the spear. They revolved before converging at the spearhead, forming a dark star. When the spear was hacked downwards, it was akin to a dark star shooting across the sky before crashing down against that Undying Underworld Emperor. This strike was too fast. Undying Underworld Emperor was merely dizzy momentarily before this dark star appeared before him. He barely defended himself with his hands, and closely following that, he felt a wave of pain coursing through his palm. “Ka ka ka,” the bones in his palms fractured. And that spear continued down before smashing on the body of Undying Underworld Emperor.
In the end, Undying Underworld Emperor flew across the sky once again. This time, fresh blood spurting out from his mouth.
“The gap is actually this big!” Undying Underworld Emperor defended himself twice consecutively. He wanted to feel for himself how wide the gap was. He estimated that he was currently approximately 30% to 40% that of Monarch Flying Snow’s current strength!
“His Mirage and Illusory Realm has affected me greatly, reducing the amount of strength I can unleash to just 50%. If I extrapolated this, it seems even if I poured in all my strength without suffering from any disturbances, I would still be slightly weaker than him?”
Even when he used all his strength, he was only about 70% that of Xue Ying’s strength!
Even though he had known this would happen…
The fact that Xue Ying would likely become the strongest cultivator in Realm Heart Great Land once he broke through! Reality still brought a chill down Undying Underworld Emperor: “It is simply too dangerous this time.”
He could smell the aura of death approaching him.
…
Even though both parties had just began fighting, the disturbance created had reached an incredibly violent stage! Xue Ying was using his full strength augmented by a Chaotic Origin Weapon after reaching the final realm, and on the other side, Undying Underworld Emperor’s strength was extraordinary too.
How frightening was it when both parties fought? Even the palace that Undying Underworld Emperor prepared had been destroyed instantaneously!
This disturbance created from their exchange…
Was immediately felt by all Cosmos Gods in the Realm Heart Great Land.
“What is happening?”
“Why is there such a terrifying fluctuation?”
All of them extended their senses. Some relied on the Heaven Observation Mirror to see while others used their personal strength. Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, Emperor Cang, Swordmaster, Limitless City Master, Towering Sky King and many other Cosmos Gods were watching from afar. They were originally puzzled, but the moment they ‘saw’ the origin of that terrifying fluctuation, they were stunned.
They could ‘see’ two figures that blasted their aura into the world. One was Monarch Flying Snow and the other was the vicious and infamous Undying Underworld Emperor. Furthermore, the current Undying Underworld Emperor was clearly injured.

chapters.title: Chapter 1255 - The Strongest Expert in Realm Heart Great Land
chapters.content:
Chapter 1255: The Strongest Expert in Realm Heart Great Land
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Peng! Peng! Peng!”
One could see shockwaves rushing out in the region where Xue Ying fought with Undying Underworld Emperor! And at the core region where the battle happened, one could merely see a shattered region flooded with Primal Chaos Energy. Reaching their level, how fast was each exchange? In the blink of an eye, a dozen exchanges had already happened! Those who were weak could not see what was happening in the battle.
And currently, those that were watching the battle were the top experts in Realm Heart Great Land. They could see that ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ was completely disadvantaged. He was even spurting out blood! His body was constantly being injured by Xue Ying!
One side fell
And it was ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ who held an absolute upper hand, with the losing side being ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’.
“I don’t have the slightest chance of winning in direct combat.” Undying Underworld Emperor abruptly roared.
“Hou!”
His body erupted to form an illusory figure. It was a huge lion totemic figure. This huge lion covered the world, and its power was so great that even Xue Ying’s expression changed slightly. ‘What exactly is this technique? I’ve never heard of it in Realm Heart Great Land before. Was it a trump card that Undying Underworld Emperor created during his expedition to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform?’
The enormous illusory lion widened its mouth before sucking in.
The world became dark.
It could not be dodged. Xue Ying was sucked in with one mouth.
At the moment he was devoured, Xue Ying could feel savage ripples attacking his soul. Nonetheless, being an existence who had walked to the peak across many Origin Worlds in the Dao of Soul, his defenses were naturally airtight. The ‘illusory world’ formed from his soul energy easily dissolved all incoming attacks. Those thoughts that were filled with ‘grievances’, ‘death’, and ‘slaughter’, were being dissolved.
“Peng!” Xue Ying remained incredibly awake. He did not stop. He waved the spear in his hand before rushing out of this weakening illusory lion.
“He is really not affected by it.” The expression on Undying Underworld Emperor became uglier. He was an existence that cultivated the Dao of Death to the final realm. During his expedition towards becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform, he once met a terrifying expert that reached an incredible realm with the same Dao as him. That expert specialized in controlling the dead. When he fell, some of his treasures ended in the hands of Undying Underworld Emperor. Given Undying Underworld Emperor’s understanding and current realm, this was considered a killing technique of his.
“These techniques are useless to me.” Xue Ying’s spear came down with a grand suppression pressing down on Underworld Emperor.
…
Both parties continued fighting. Over time, the degree of difference in strength became more obvious.
Undying Underworld Emperor once battled with experts from different civilizations. The strongest technique he had was the Death Walker. Secondary would be the ‘Metallic Flame Heart Blood’. Naturally, other techniques like the ‘Sacred Lion Killing Curse’ were becoming less important over time.
In the end, he chose to give up his Death Walker in order to escape back to his hometown alive.
And he was constantly igniting the Metallic Flame Heart Blood he had! He had ignited more than half of it already! Furthermore, it was clear that he did not have the upperhand when fighting with the other party. And Xue Ying did not seem to have any weak points. His attacks came stronger and stronger, and his soul technique was frightening strong. In the end, all kinds of strange methods Undying Underworld Emperor tried employing were futile. Undying Underworld Emperor was gradually becoming more injured over time during the battle.
“Good. Kill, kill him!”
“Kill this Undying Underworld Emperor! Monarch Flying Snow, kill him for us!”
The entire Realm Heart Great Land—either they were from the six great ancient nations or from the tier-two and tier-three nations, or organizations in the light and dark, or those that were famous or living in seclusion, currently, many experts were rushing to watch the battle. They even spread the word to their good friends, causing the experts watching the battle to soar.
A Heaven Observation Mirror could be watched by many cultivators.
“It is unbelievable that Undying Underworld Emperor would have this outcome as well!” An old man excitedly stated, “Ever since he returned safely, I had been looking forward to this day. And it is finally here!”
“Congratulations Teacher! Monarch Flying Snow will definitely be able to kill this Undying Underworld Emperor.” A group of disciples were congratulating their teacher. The original clan of their teacher was wiped by Undying Underworld Emperor. That was before the first War of the Ancient Nations.
At this moment.
Many experts were clapping their hands and shouting in jubilation. They were even looking forward to the outcome.
Ultimately, ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ was too ruthless when he conducted his business. He was selfish, and would kill to acquire what he wanted! According to the legends, he was synonymous with ‘death’! There had never been an unparalleled existence that was as mad and vicious as Undying Underworld Emperor. During his stint of killing, he had already created many enemies! Some of the weak cultivators in the past even became Cosmos Gods now!
But Undying Underworld Emperor did not care about that!
Because he was the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land! Those enemies did not dare to appear before him.
“Good.”
Southern Cloud Capital, within the royal palace.
Southern Cloud King was currently watching the projection on the floating Heaven Observation Mirror. By his side were Old Mother Ying Shan, Monarch Greedy Peng, Monarch Chun Yu and many others. They were either true bodies or incarnations, and were here watching the spectacle showing on the Heaven Observation Mirror.
“That’s awesome, Junior Disciple Brother Flying Snow!” Monarch Greedy Peng could not help but praise. They were all watching excitedly.
Even though Southern Cloud King did not say anything, his eyes were emitting light.
He truly hated ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ so much that he wished the other party was dead! He admitted that the ‘Twin Realm Blade’ which he got in the past had allowed him to change his fate. But firstly, he got the treasure only after passing through countless dangers. And now, Undying Underworld Emperor was threatening him, forcing him to collect many precious materials for the other party. The price of the precious materials had far surpassed that of a piece of top-graded secret treasure.
And if he failed to collect the materials, Undying Underworld Emperor would wipe his entire Southern Cloud Capital.
This threat truly infuriated Southern Cloud King, an absolute genius! But he had no choice since he could not retaliate against Undying Underworld Emperor at all.
…
Not just him.
There were too many cultivators that desired to see Undying Underworld Emperor die!
But Undying Underworld Emperor had always been too high up. He was already the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land before the first War of the Ancient Nations. This time after returning, his fame became all the greater. Even ‘Emperor Summer’ admitted he was weaker than Undying Underworld Emperor by a level.
Southern Cloud King even gave up previously. He felt that there was no help. He gave in to fate, allowing his teacher squeeze him dry! Those enemies of Undying Underworld Emperor could only etch their hatred deep in their hearts. They did not dare to think about ‘revenge’! Because the gap was too great.
Nonetheless, this battle they were watching had excited them!
Monarch Flying Snow, ‘Xue Ying’, was beating Undying Underworld Emperor up with absolute strength, gravely injuring the other party. Furthermore, this gap in strength was clear.
“It appears that the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land has changed.” Emperor Summer stood in his royal palace watching the battle. He sighed, “As we expected, this Monarch Flying Snow has finally taken the throne of being the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land.”
“Talking about this, I could still remember the moment when he just became an Upper Honored Guest of my Fan Clan.” Ancestor Fan lamented.
“It is expected that he would become the strongest in Realm Heart Great Land.” Emperor Cang added, “Of the group of final realm cultivators in Realm Heart Great Land, only Monarch Flying Snow has a Chaotic Origin Weapon! Furthermore, his soul technique is even famous across Broken Tooth Mountain Range. With those two techniques added together, it is definitely possible for him to triumph over Undying Underworld Emperor entirely.”
Swordmaster who stood with the three of them revealed a grin: “Xue Ying has hidden himself really deeply.”
Currently, almost all unparalleled existences and final realm cultivators felt his was normal.
Because Monarch Flying Snow had been too dazzling previously.
When he was still a level-two Cosmos God, any avatar of his could fight against a final realm expert! His soul technique was so formidable that it created waves in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. His Chaotic Origin Weapon was also coveted for by many! He was absolutely the most terrifying level-two Cosmos God in the history of Realm Heart Great Land.
And now that he broke through to the final realm, he was promoted to become the most frightening final realm cultivator!
…
That day as the experts were feeling complex from watching the battle, Undying Underworld Emperor’s injuries also worsened.
“Die!” Undying Underworld Emperor hissed madly.
“Hong~”
Many insects started appearing. They flew towards Xue Ying.
Xue Ying stood there. With a thought, the consciousness from the insects were wiped, and all of them fell down.
Undying Underworld Emperor’s expression became ugly when he saw that. He knew it was useless even if he brought out all the venomous insects which he collected, albeit he still attempted it by bringing them out. Perhaps there might be some miracle that he hoped for in his heart.
‘How? What should I do now?’ Undying Underworld Emperor gritted his teeth.
‘I can’t care anymore. I have to live. At the worst, I’ll never show myself forever in the future.’
“Sou.”
Undying Underworld Emperor immediately tunneled into a dark corridor before disappearing from the vicinity.
“Escape?”
“He escaped?”
“Undying Underworld Emperor actually fled?”
The observers understood this point.
“It seems he has completely admitted defeat.” Many experts could see from this. It was common in Realm Heart Great Land. Those final realm devils frequently relied on this technique since it was hard for others to catch them if they chose to run.
“No matter what, this battle has shown that the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land is Monarch Flying Snow from now on. As for Undying Underworld Emperor, he can only run if he sees Monarch Flying Snow.” Many experts were already discussing since they felt that this battle had ended.
“Unless this event is going to end after he fled?” Some who hated and wanted Undying Underworld Emperor to die felt unwilling.
But they understood.
It was easy to defeat final realm experts but hard to kill them!
“Escape?” Xue Ying stood in midair. He held onto the Azure River Spear. At this moment, his consciousness had already fused into the ripples and covered the Realm Heart Great Land. Furthermore, for the sake of preventing Undying Underworld Emperor from escaping, he even extended his senses into the territories of Emperor Summer, Drifter, and Limitless City Master. He did not care about alerting those experts anymore.
His domain had covered throughout every single area of Realm Heart Great Land,
And the trajectory of escape chosen by Undying Underworld Emperor was completely ‘seen’ by Xue Ying.

chapters.title: Chapter 1256 - The Pride of Old Mother Ying Shan
chapters.content:
Chapter 1256: The Pride of Old Mother Ying Shan
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
An absolute majority of experts felt that this battle had ended. Only an extreme few hoped for ‘a miracle’. They truly desired for Undying Underworld Emperor to die!
As for Emperor Summer, Drifter, and Limitless City Master, the three of them could sense an issue.
“This Void Domain has covered the royal palace already. Drifter is still at the Myriad Realm Ancient Nation and is very far away from my Summer Wind Ancient Nation. It is almost impossible for him to reach my place! Hence, the only person who could extend his Void Domain here is Monarch Flying Snow.” Emperor Summer watched from afar, “The place where he fought with Underworld Emperor is incredibly far from my Summer Wind Ancient Nation too, yet his Void Domain could reach my place? Or could it be that he relied on many avatars?”
In reality.
Even if one relied on avatars, the domain region would still be very lacking.
Xue Ying’s strongest avatar could only cover twice the region covered by Summer Wind Ancient Nation by relying on his supreme secret impartation. And he could maintain nine peak avatars simultaneously. But the Realm Heart Great Land was too big! There were still many vast oceans, and ancient nations like ‘Icy Snow Ancient Nation’ which was so frighteningly big.
…
At a more desolate region by the boundary of Realm Heart Great Land.
“Hong long long~”
At the end of the land was a surging storm. Beyond the storm was the membrane of the Origin World.
“I’ve already reached the limit of the land.” Undying Underworld Emperor stood by the boundary of the storm. He did not care about it at all. Instead, he was slightly nervous, “This should be sufficiently far away from the field which we fought earlier-more than half the entire Realm Heart Great Land! I haven’t heard of anyone who could cover such a huge region by relying on his domain.”
“There are many boundary zones too. I’d casually chosen this place. Even if it was coincidentally discovered by an avatar of Monarch Flying Snow-the possibility is low-I can simply escape even if I was discovered! As long as I enter a region outside his domain, he would no longer be able to find me.”
“Unless he can trace me down.”
“Hmph.”
“Given my realm and my soul control, I can prevent all traces of my aura from leaking. Only Limitless City Master could trace me, but the Dao of Limitless City Master ensures his unwillingness to join in any huge affairs that would tie him down with huge karma.” Undying Underworld Emperor nodded.
He felt that the possibility of Monarch Flying Snow finding him was very low.
“Underworld Emperor, where are you prepared to flee to?” A voice sounded.
Undying Underworld Emperor felt his body shaking. He turned around, only to see a white-robed young man holding a spear. That man had crossed through the void and arrived where he was. That man was Monarch Flying Snow, who accompanied him all the way here. Xue Ying did not show any mercy. He struck out with his spear techniques, forcing Undying Underworld Emperor to ignite his Heart Blood to try to defend against it. Underworld Emperor tore apart another passage in a bid to escape once again.
“I was discovered? Unless he had an avatar which was coincidentally located in the region where I arrived at?”
…
“Stop running anymore!”
Undying Underworld Emperor just appeared by another boundary of the Realm Heart Great Land in a forest when another spear closely struck out on him. The body of Undying Underworld Emperor was torn apart, though his body rapidly condensed back after turning into darkness. He fled again.
…
Escape, escape, escape!
Undying Underworld Emperor consecutively fled for ten over times, and gradually, he felt his heart turning cold!
Even if Xue Ying’s avatars were maintaining their domains, how could it be so coincidental for the position he chose to be right smack within where the Void Domains cover?
“Unless he can trace me? Or is Limitless helping him?” Undying Underworld Emperor stopped. He stood at the boundary of the world above an ocean. Turning around, he saw as Xue Ying came once again. At this moment, the eyes of Undying Underworld Emperor were filled with resolution. As he defended against Xue Ying’s killing technique, he was also transmitting over anxiously: “Monarch Flying Snow, you want me to die? Then I shall let many others get buried along with me!”
Xue Ying stopped. He did not continue striking. Instead, he stood there watching Underworld Emperor: “Get buried with you?”
“I really admire you. You can trace me? Or have you persuaded Limitless City Master?” The eyes of Undying Underworld Emperor were filled with madness. His soul was shaking-this shudder came from a madness brimming before his death, “Even though you are stronger than me, I can always bury many other beings alongside my death.”
“How long can you survive given your current injuries?” Xue Ying coldly retorted.
“You can give it a try. Aren’t you concerned over those ants? Why, either you let me go or I’ll let everyone die with me!” Undying Underworld Emperor growled.
Xue Ying examined Undying Underworld Emperor.
This Underworld Emperor was making him feel a strand of terror.
Because he was a madman that had no concerns and burdens! Furthermore, he was strong-only second to him. It was impossible for Xue Ying to hide the Ying Shan Clan and all the people whom he cared for in Flying Snow City. But the moment they left, if Undying Underworld Emperor chose to go against his words, that would be another case of slaughter.
“I feel that if I were to let you live, it’ll be a greater threat to the world. Furthermore, I do not believe that you can kill many more cultivators in front of me.” Following that, the eyes of Xue Ying became sharp. He struck the spear in his hand out once again.
“Hong!”
“Monarch Flying Snow!” Undying Underworld Emperor’s mad howl filled the world.
…
As Undying Underworld Emperor continued escaping with Xue Ying chasing behind, the two of them battled all over the Realm Heart Great Land. The disturbance created by their exchange was huge. The moment they resumed fighting, all experts in Realm Heart Great Land could easily perceive it and continue observing what was happening.
They also saw the conversation between Xue Ying and Undying Underworld Emperor.
Undying Underworld Emperor threatened to ‘bury the innocent with him’, yet Monarch Flying Snow still continued striking back!
“Good!”
Many experts shouted in approval when they saw Xue Ying’s act of continuation.
Inclusive of Emperor Summer, many other experts were sighing over what they saw! They were startled that Xue Ying could still continue his chase after ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ regardless of how the other party escaped! They were also sighing over the fact that a giant who trampled above many cultivators, ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’, would most likely be dying soon.
“Beautiful.” Within Southern Cloud Capital, Southern Cloud King who remained quiet all the while, said his first word. He was fixated at the Heaven Observation Mirror.
He was afraid that Xue Ying could not trace down Undying Underworld Emperor when the other party escaped.
But the moment he saw Xue Ying continue his pursue after Underworld Emperor, he felt exuberant.
And when Undying Underworld Emperor threatened to bury the masses with him, Southern Cloud King felt worried that his disciple would soften his stance.
“Finally, am I going to be absolved of my worries? Is this madman going to die soon?” Southern Cloud King watched excitedly.
“Amazing. He is incredibly amazing. I actually have such a junior disciple brother. The strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land is actually my junior disciple brother.” Monarch Greedy Peng sighed.
“He is so powerful that it feels terrifying. And I am actually his senior disciple sister.” Empress Ghost Li was also praising from the side.
“Even Undying Underworld Emperor is about to get killed by Xue Ying?” Old Mother Ying Shan felt that this was like a dream.
She could still clearly remember.
In the past, there was a talented brat from Monarch Ying Shan Lie Hu’s lineage that was given birth as a Void God. His genius brat rose incredibly quickly. That time, this brat still wanted to get the spearhead of that ‘Scarlet Cloud God Spear’, and it was she, Old Mother Ying Shan, who bought it for him! After that, when the ‘Ardent Fire City Blood Sacrifice’ event occured, it was this little prince Ying Shan Xue Ying that erupted with a frightening combat power that shocked the world. Ever since then, his name spread across the Black Devil Four Nations and the Black Devil Great Lake.
A Tenth Level Primal Chaos cultivator then became an Upper Honored Guest of the Fan Clan.
After he became a Cosmos God, he went on an expedition to ‘Realm Heart God Palace’. In the end, he was killed by Eternal Night Primogenitor. And that was when he became low-profiled.
This hibernation…
Actually did not last for he acted under the identity as the ‘Heaven’s Will Daoist’ and single handedly intimidated all devils in the world.
“And now, he is about to get Undying Underworld Emperor killed.” Old Mother Ying Shan mumbled to herself, “Such an absolute expert actually originated from my Ying Shan Clan.”
At this moment, Old Mother Ying Shan was filled with happiness and pride.
…
At the moment when Undying Underworld Emperor was constantly being pursued without being able to get rid of Xue Ying, and the fact that Xue Ying disregarded his threat, the experts in Realm Heart Great Land determined that Undying Underworld Emperor would be dying soon. Many were even cheering in joy!
But-
Xue Ying felt distressed. Because he had to pay a corresponding price in his bid to kill Undying Underworld Emperor!
“Die, everyone, just die!” Whenever Undying Underworld Emperor fled to a huge city, he would take the initiative to attack the city below.
“Hong!”
A turbulent Void Ocean rippled and tried to resist against the attack by Undying Underworld Emperor. Xue Ying then charged over. Even though he specialized in domain suppression and was doing his utmost and fastest speed to reach the Underworld Emperor, many living beings were still killed! Many living beings did not even have the time to react before they were wiped out from the world! This infuriated Xue Ying. No matter the price, he would have to eliminate this devil!
“It seems that he can no longer hold on for long.” Xue Ying could ascertain that the injuries of Undying Underworld Emperor were getting serious. The other party should only be left with just 20% of his life force.
“I can no longer hold on any further!”
Undying Underworld Emperor was clearer about his own situation than Xue Ying.
Because every time they battled, he would have to ignite his Heart Blood. And after igniting his Heart Blood, he would only have 30% to 40% of Xue Ying’s strength! If he did not ignite his Heart Blood, he would most likely be 10% to 20% of Xue Ying’s strength, and he would die even faster.
“My Heart Blood is running out.”
Currently, there were just three pitiful drops of blood left in his Metallic Flame Heart Blood.
Undying Underworld Emperor was in despair.

chapters.title: Chapter 1257 - The Battle into the Chaotic Origin Dimension
chapters.content:
Chapter 1257: The Battle into the Chaotic Origin Dimension
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“I have no other choices. I can only seek life in death!” Undying Underworld Emperor gritted his teeth. Even though he did not wish to choose, he would not even have the choice to do so once he finished consuming his Heart Blood in front of Xue Ying’s suppressive attacks.
“Hong hong~”
As a pair of golden palms defended against the terrifying spear attack, the surrounding night sky had already shattered, revealing many black cracks. One could see those cracks leading to the ‘Chaotic Origin Dimension’ on the other side. Chaotic Origin Energy was even pouring through the cracks. That was a higher dimension, a place where only those at a higher level of life could live.
“Sou!”
Undying Underworld Emperor did not hesitate. He immediately went through the crack and charged into the Chaotic Origin Dimension.
“Mn?” Xue Ying’s expression changed. Though he did not hesitate and charged into the Chaotic Origin Dimension as well.
“What!”
“Undying Underworld Emperor fled into the Chaotic Origin Dimension, and Monarch Flying Snow followed after him? They did not execute the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique at all. Instead, both of them charged into the dimension directly? Are they tired of living?”
“With one chasing after the other, they even fought their way into the Chaotic Origin Dimension? Don’t they say that cultivators who have yet to jump out of the cage, would be corroded by the Chaotic Origin Energy after entering the Chaotic Origin Dimension until they eventually die?”
“What do you know? Do you know how strong Undying Underworld Emperor is? Ordinary unparalleled existences aren’t his opponent at all. That Monarch Flying Snow is even more amazing than Undying Underworld Emperor. Reaching their level, they should be able to survive for a short period in the Chaotic Origin Dimension right?”
Many observers in the Realm Heart Great Land were stunned as they watched.
They actually took the initiative to bring their battle into the Chaotic Origin Dimension?
Clearly, they were not seeking death.
This battle had already proceeded beyond their imaginations. According to the ordinary Cosmos Gods, unless they knew some unique maneuver techniques, they would die undoubtedly if they enter the Chaotic Origin Dimension nakedly.
“Monarch Flying Snow’s desire to kill Undying Underworld Emperor is truly strong.” Emperor Summer watched and sighed. He knew that if one charged out of the Origin World using his fleshy body, as long as he did not travel too far away from the Origin World, he could still survive for a period outside. For instance, his Chaotic Origin Refinement Body Technique relied on the Chaotic Origin Energy for refinement of the fleshy body.
“What is the situation like between the two of them?” Ancestor Fan hurriedly asked. He did not know what was going on now.
Emperor Cang and Swordmaster turned to Emperor Summer as well.
“Have a look.” Emperor Summer waved his hand, causing a projection to appear by the side. It was the scene happening in the Chaotic Origin Dimension.
Undying Underworld Emperor charged into the Chaotic Origin Dimension. The surrounding Chaotic Origin Energy had been pushed apart by his momentum. And Xue Ying who wielded his Azure River Spear charged over at an even faster speed!
…
Currently in the entire Realm Heart Great Land, there were few who could still watch the battle. Most unparalleled existences could not do so!
“Xue Ying!” Over at Southern Cloud Nation, Old Mother Ying Shan anxiously shouted.
They killed into the Chaotic Origin Dimension?
“Impulsive. He is too impulsive.” Southern Cloud King was also incredibly worried, “Even if he killed Undying Underworld Emperor, the slightest carelessness might cause his death. And if he loses his Chaotic Origin Weapon in the Chaotic Origin Dimension, it would be too late for regrets.”
Unparalleled existences relied on supreme-graded secret treasures in Realm Heart Great Land to reach their height of power. Currently, Xue Ying’s immense strength was partly due to his Chaotic Origin Weapon, and partly due to his Mirage and Illusory Realm technique.
“I really wonder what is the situation now.”
“We can’t see what is happening there.”
“They have gone into the Chaotic Origin Dimension. It is impossible for us to find out what is going on now.”
Many experts became more nervous and anxious.
This was a battle happening between the two most terrifying existences in Realm Heart Great Land, and all of them yearned to find out the outcome of the battle.
******
Within the Chaotic Origin Dimension.
“Hong.”
Xue Ying did not hesitate. He followed closely along the black crack and into the Chaotic Origin Dimension.
After spending 600 years consolidating his cultivation after breaking through, he once attempted to create the third level of Chaotic Origin Refinement Body! He also took the initiative to enter the Chaotic Origin Dimension because it was normal for those at his level to enter. With the activation of his Azure River Spear, he easily blasted out an enormous hole 100 meters in diameter, causing large amounts of Chaotic Origin Energy to surge in. That was not too different from entering the Chaotic Origin Dimension personally.
He sent his avatar into the Chaotic Origin Dimension and experience what it was like without bringing his Chaotic Origin Weapon!
And it was because he had the experience of entering the Chaotic Origin Dimension. That was why he did not hesitate to follow Undying Underworld Emperor!
“Hong-”
Once again, he entered.
Even though he had experience, Xue Ying still felt obsessed over it.
The ‘Dao of Void’ was unique. It was more appropriate than a majority of other Dao paths for viewing the mysteries of the Chaotic Origin Dimension. After Xue Ying charged into the dimension, he easily controlled and pushed aside almost all the surrounding Chaotic Origin Energy with support from his Azure River Spear. Nonetheless, there was endless Chaotic Origin Energy here, and some remnant of the energy still contacted Xue Ying’s fleshy body, leading to rapid corrosion!
His fleshy body was like air. The Chaotic Origin Energy easily penetrated through his fleshy body and into his soul. During this process of penetration, it also brought about a corrosion.
It was also due to his Azure River Spear, and his immense void-ification control after reaching the ‘final realm in Dao of Void’ that gave him the ability to reduce the corrosive effect on his fleshy body. Hence, this minute amount of Chaotic Origin Energy had a weakened corrosion effect on his Chaotic Origin Refinement Body. It was sufficient for him to recover back to his original state using his current recovery speed.
“Hu hu hu~”
The Realm Heart Great Land was an incredibly huge Origin World.
It emitted an infinite force that constantly pushed away the surrounding Chaotic Origin Energy. In reality, the effects of the Chaotic Origin Energy were the weakest nearest to the Realm Heart Great Land. After all, the surrounding forcefield from the Realm Heart Great Land weakened it greatly. Hence, the closer one was to the Realm Heart Great Land, the more sparse the Chaotic Origin Energy was! And of course, the further one was from the Realm Heart Great Land in the Chaotic Origin Dimension, the more concentrated the Chaotic Origin Energy would be!
An Origin World contained an incredibly huge energy.
Which was why Chaotic Origin Lifeforms would become much stronger after conquering over an Origin World. After all, an Origin World was condensed from an incredible amount of World Energy.
“He still killed his way in.” Undying Underworld Emperor glanced back at Xue Ying who followed closely behind. His expression became uglier over time, “Then we shall see! Would he be willing to give up this avatar of his for the sake of killing me? Once you lose this avatar of yours, you would also lose that Chaotic Origin Weapon.”
Undying Underworld Emperor rushed forward madly.
When they first charged out of the Realm Heart Great Land, the Chaotic Origin Energy was still quite sparse and thin. After all, the Supreme Law from the Realm Heart Great Land was still influencing its surroundings, reducing the corrosive effects from the Chaotic Origin Energy.
But as they proceeded further.
The world became darker and quieter. The Chaotic Origin Energy also became more concentrated. This energy was constantly brushing across the fleshy body and soul of Undying Underworld Emperor! His body and soul were constantly ‘corroded’.
“You can’t escape!” A furious roar actually reached the ears of Undying Underworld Emperor through the Chaotic Origin Energy.
By the time the voice reached his ears, a spear had already appeared before Undying Underworld Emperor.
“So fast!” Undying Underworld Emperor was still anxious and unwilling. In the past when he left the Realm Heart Great Land, it was done so because he got an opportunity of advancing into the Chaotic Origin Realm. He got a movement technique bestowed upon him by ‘Yuan’. Only then could he travel through the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Over the years, his terror of the external world and of the Chaotic Origin Dimension gradually decreased. He even entered the Chaotic Origin Dimension many times.
He had the experience! Furthermore, he also comprehended many techniques of entering this dimension.
He felt that he would have an advantage over a newly-emerged final realm expert when battling in the Chaotic Origin Dimension, even if the other party was a Dao of Void expert.
But he was wrong!
Firstly, Xue Ying had trained in the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll> before. This was a body refinement technique that Emperor Summer had which uses the Chaotic Origin Energy. Xue Ying was constantly trying to perfect it. Hence, he also chose to enter the Chaotic Origin Dimension on multiple occasions and was already experienced in entering this dimension. Furthermore, Xue Ying also relied on using the Chaotic Origin Energy to cultivate his fleshy body. As a result, his fleshy body was better at resisting against the corrosion from the Chaotic Origin Energy.
Secondly, the Dao of Void had the greatest advantage in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. No matter if it was used to void-ify the fleshy body to reduce the impact, or to travel in the dimension, the Dao of Void could exhibit its greatest advantage here. Comparatively, other ‘Daos’ would become much weaker in the Chaotic Origin Dimension.
Thirdly, his Chaotic Origin Weapon ‘Azure River Spear’ increased Xue Ying’s control of the Chaotic Origin Energy, allowing him to survive for a longer period in the Chaotic Origin Dimension.
With so many reasons, Xue Ying could easily reach up to Undying Underworld Emperor.
“Peng.”
The spear came over furiously.
Undying Underworld Emperor resisted against it with his hands, allowing this fierce smash to force him back. That way, he would get further away from the Realm Heart Great Land.
“Come. If you are daring enough, come! Let us continue deeper into the Chaotic Origin Dimension.” As Undying Underworld Emperor flew backwards, he was staring at Xue Ying still. At the same time, he was becoming crazier as time passed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1258 - A New Era
chapters.content:
Chapter 1258: A New Era
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying could feel that the Origin World Realm Heart Great Land was still very close behind him even as he flew at high speed! But that’s because of the enormity of the ‘Realm Heart Great Land’! The location where they battled was still influenced by the forcefield from the Realm Heart Great Land. Nonetheless, they could perceive an increase in the concentration of the Chaotic Origin Energy as they flew. This concentration had already exceeded the amount Xue Ying used to train in.
Fortunately, with the support from the Azure River Spear, Xue Ying was able to split apart the Chaotic Origin Energy, forming a passage that minimized the corrosion effect.
“Hong hong hong.”
Xue Ying’s speed was incredibly quick. The moment he reached Undying Underworld Emperor, he did not show any mercy.
As for Undying Underworld Emperor, he did not care about his life; he continued tunneling in deeper and deeper! Yet during this process, his fleshy body was starting to change in color. It was becoming grayish white.
“He can’t hold on any further.” Xue Ying revealed a joyous look.
“I, I actually can’t hold on any further? The previous battle in Realm Heart Great Land gravely injured me. If my body was perfectly fine, I should be able to hold on for a longer period!” Many scenes began flashing through the mind of Undying Underworld Emperor-from when he was weak all the way until he became an overlord of the entire Realm Heart Great Land. He was so dazzling at that time that all other experts in Realm Heart Great Land were terrorized by him. Others felt that he was the incarnation of death. His strength even earned him the favor of ‘Yuan’, who as a result sent him down on an expedition to advance into the Chaotic Origin Realm.
And when he left his hometown, only then did he realize that there was a mountain higher! And many more geniuses could be found outside! He failed. Just like a majority of other experts from different civilizations, they all failed. Many other experts died during the expedition, and some were banished. As for him, it was fortunate that he could return home.
“After escaping back home, I actually met this genius called Monarch Flying Snow. And what is most terrifying are his soul techniques.” Undying Underworld Emperor looked at Xue Ying. Suddenly, he grinned. This smile that emerged from that decaying grayish-white face of his startled Xue Ying. Xue Ying had a premonition.
“Sou-”
The dark rays around the body of Undying Underworld Emperor suddenly spun, causing him to escape at a faster pace.
“Escape? He still thinking of fleeing at this moment?” Even though the other party’s fleshy body had been corroded gravely, and he was close to death, using a movement technique would isolate the corrosion, and if the other party succeeded to escape, he could definitely survive.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying similarly executed the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique and went chasing after Underworld Emperor. After reaching the final realm, he could easily execute the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique using his fleshy body.
“Hu.”
He continued chasing after Undying Underworld Emperor, and rapidly reached up to the other party.
Clearly when comparing the movement techniques of both parties, the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique based on the Dao of Void was much faster.
“Die!” When Xue Ying reached up to Undying Underworld Emperor, he immediately lashed out his spear against the other party, blasting Underworld Emperor out of his technique. After all, a movement technique could not take any other sort of interference!
Xue Ying personally also came out of his movement technique.
“Chi chi chi!”
Even though Xue Ying was prepared and had already done his best in using the Azure River Spear to isolate the surrounding Chaotic Origin Energy…
This concentrated Chaotic Origin Energy was still too terrifying!
Even though it was a flash of movement, both of them traversed through a distance a thousand times longer than when they were both flying and fighting! Previously when they were still embroiled in a fierce battle, they were located relatively close to the Realm Heart Great Land. But now, they were much further from the Realm Heart Great Land. Despite relying on the Azure River Spear to control the surrounding Chaotic Origin Energy, Xue Ying could still how heavy this energy was. It was heavier by more than a thousand times as compared to moments ago. Large amounts of Chaotic Origin Energy were brushing across his fleshy body and soul, corroding them both rapidly. His skin was turning grayish-white on the surface, and this grayish white was spreading into his body. Nonetheless, Xue Ying’s soul was suffering from a comparatively lighter injury.
“Under this corrosive effect, my fleshy body can withstand for just a breath of time even with the help from the Azure River Spear.”
