“Nonetheless, my soul could hold on for a dozen breaths.”
Xue Ying immediately understood this point.
“Sou.”
He then chased up to Undying Underworld Emperor, stabbing out the spear in his hand. This spear elongated and with a ‘pu chi’, it penetrated through the chest of Undying Underworld Emperor. Previously when Undying Underworld Emperor just executed the movement technique, his fleshy body could not take it any longer. Currently in this environment of concentrated Chaotic Origin Energy, his fleshy body began crumbling apart-he did not have the slightest strength to retaliate from this spear strike.
“Peng!” When Undying Underworld Emperor was pierced through, he stared at Xue Ying.
Following that, his body completely dissipated in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. The robe on his body became tattered under the corrosion. His storage treasures were similarly corroded by the energy, revealing many items stored within. These items were also rapidly corroded. Only a few remained perfectly fine in this hostile Chaotic Origin Dimension.
For instance, some of the more special materials like that complete corpse of Chaotic Origin Lifeform, or the ‘Emperor Crown’ of Undying Underworld Emperor-that was his supreme-graded secret treasure--the Death Emperor Crown.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying waved his hand. He controlled the void to keep these items. At the same time, he grabbed that ‘Death Emperor Crown’ with one hand.
Lowering his head, he examined the Death Emperor Crown.
This was the supreme-graded secret treasure that Undying Underworld Emperor ruled the world with. It was also the best evidence he had of killing Undying Underworld Emperor! Relying on this, he could easily intimidate the entire world! Since he could kill Undying Underworld Emperor, would there be any devils who think they were stronger than Undying Underworld Emperor?
“Hu!”
Xue Ying immediately executed the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique. He rapidly headed back to the Realm Heart Great Land.
In this short period, his skin and part of his muscles had already turned grayish-white. This speed of corrosion was simply too quick.
…
Emperor Summer, Drifter, Limitless City Master, and a few other unparalleled existences were currently spectating the battle between Xue Ying and Undying Underworld Emperor outside of the Realm Heart Great Land. When Undying Underworld Emperor’s body turned grayish-white during the final moments, after he executed the movement technique deeper into the Chaotic Origin Dimension, they could no longer see what was happening.
“The body of Undying Underworld Emperor has been corroded to the extent that he can’t hold on for long.”
“And Monarch Flying Snow actually pursued after him as well?”
They were all startled when they saw Xue Ying execute the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique along with Underworld Emperor.
“He is truly thinking of killing Undying Underworld Emperor this time!”
“But he is too impulsive! Previously even though one was chasing after the other, they were in reality still located close to the Realm Heart Great Land. And now that they executed the movement technique, they would have gone very far away. That is a location deep into the Chaotic Origin Dimension. The corrosion effects there are much more frightening! Given the fleshy body of Undying Underworld Emperor, as long as Monarch Flying Snow interferes with Underworld Emperor’s movement technique, Undying Underworld Emperor would certainly die!”
“Since Monarch Flying Snow chose to pursue after Undying Underworld Emperor, Undying Underworld Emperor would definitely die. But can Monarch Flying Snow return alive?”
“Even though he has many avatars, this avatar of his owns the Chaotic Origin Weapon!”
Emperor Summer and the others started becoming anxious.
The projection they formed were spectated by Emperor Cang, Ancestor Fan, Swordmaster and several other unparalleled existences.
Everyone’s thoughts were unique too.
On one aspect.
They were shocked over the strength Monarch Flying Snow wielded. They felt that Xue Ying could kill the previous number one expert in Realm Heart Great Land, ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’ given his strength and his ability to trace someone down! Since he could kill Undying Underworld Emperor, then it was certain he could kill all other unparalleled existences.
Even if an unparalleled existence had many avatars, Monarch Flying Snow might even be able to kill all of them! The enemy could barely live if they chose to send an avatar out to other Origin Worlds.
With such tremendous intimidation…
It was sufficient to pressure the entire world! Much less devils, even unparalleled existences could feel the threat.
“It is fine that Monarch Flying Snow is strong. More importantly, escaping is futile in front of his tracing abilities.” Emperor Summer sighed, “Previously, an ordinary final realm expert could recklessly bring calamity to the world precisely because even I can’t trace him down once he chose to hide his traces. The only one who could do so, ‘Limitless City Master’, chose not to participate in such purging activities.”
“Only Monarch Flying Snow has both the ability to kill and trace a cultivator down. Hence, no cultivators could escape before him.”
“But if he doesn’t have his Chaotic Origin Weapon any longer, his intimidation would be greatly reduced.”
Emperor Summer continued, “But he is still slightly impulsive in his pursuit this time.”
Xue Ying executed his movement technique and continued his chase precisely because the corrosion on him was slightly weak when he was located near the Origin World! That was why he dared to continue chasing after the other party!
“But Monarch Flying Snow would most likely not do things that he does not have confidence in doing so. For instance when he once wanted to attack Undying Underworld Emperor with a group of World Masters, he did not act because he could not employ the help of Limitless City Master.” Ancestor Fan retorted, “And since he dared to chase after the other party, he should be confident of doing so.”
“If he killed Undying Underworld Emperor while bringing his Chaotic Origin Weapon back to the Realm Heart Great Land, that’ll be incredibly frightening!” Emperor Cang sighed, “By then, I believe everybody would revere him in the Realm Heart Great Land.”
“That’s right.” Emperor Summer nodded. Reaching that stage, even he did not have the confidence of resisting against Xue Ying in his territory.
Since Emperor Summer was facing such a situation already…
Then other unparalleled existences would absolutely be far worse when dealing with this Monarch Flying Snow even if they were back at their territories!
“Mn?”
“This is--”
All the unparalleled existences in the Realm Heart Great Land as well as many other Cosmos Gods had sensed it practically at the same time! Many Heaven Observation Mirrors also saw the origin coming from that terrifying fluctuation.
“Hong!”
That came from a blast on the membrane wall of the Origin World that formed a hole spanning several hundred meters long. After which, a figure flew out from it.
It was a white-robed Xue Ying who held onto his Azure River Spear with one hand, and the Death Emperor Crown on the other.
“The Emperor Crown? Death Emperor Crown?”
“Isn’t that the Death Emperor Crown of Undying Underworld Emperor?”
Seeing Monarch Flying Snow returning with his Azure River Spear, many unparalleled existences felt their hearts trembling. The hope that Monarch Flying Snow would lose his Azure River Spear had simply been crushed! After all, nobody was willing for an existence who could threaten all of their lives to appear above their heads.
And the other weaker Cosmos Gods were simply quaking in fear when they saw that ‘Death Emperor Crown’.
They understood.
That was the supreme-graded secret treasure of Undying Underworld Emperor! Since the supreme-graded secret treasure was taken by Xue Ying, the fate of Undying Underworld Emperor was sealed.
“He is back! He is back!” In Southern Cloud Nation, Southern Cloud King, Old Mother Ying Shan and many others were feeling incredibly excited.
“This is way too scary!”
“Undying Underworld Emperor is dead! He is finally dead!”
Tides started rising in the hearts of many experts across the entire Realm Heart Great Land.
And ‘Yama Religion Master’ from the Black Devil Great Lake sighed when he saw that white-robed young man returning with the Azure River Spear and Death Emperor Crown on his Heaven Observation Mirror: “It appears that Realm Heart Great Land has entered a new era now! An era that belongs entirely to Monarch Flying Snow, and an era where no devils could emerge.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1259 - A Change of Era
chapters.content:
Chapter 1259: A Change of Era
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Eternal Night Primogenitor and Extreme Night Primogenitor were both standing side by side. Their capes were billowing with the wind as both of them watched the origin of that terrifying disturbance--it caused a blast in the membrane wall of the Origin World. From this pitch black hole flew out a white-robed figure. He held on to the Azure River Spear with one hand, and the Death Emperor Crown in another. That unseen killing aura could be felt by many others even if they were separated by a huge distance.
“You are lucky, Eternal Night, for giving in slightly before this.” Extreme Night Primogenitor chuckled, “Otherwise, the next unparalleled existence to die could very well be you after Undying Underworld Emperor.”
“Right.” Eternal Night Primogenitor was also watching the origin of disturbance. His eyes were faintly glowing in golden light, “Fortunately I gave in. I had a premonition that the moment he broke through to the final realm, even if it was in the Dao of Void, he would be able to suppress even Undying Underworld Emperor. Before his soul technique, I would become even weaker. Even if I were in my Eternal Night City, I might still lose my life. But the outcome has far surpassed my imagination! Even Undying Underworld Emperor was killed so easily.”
Even though the entire process took several twists and turns, the previous number one cultivator of Realm Heart Great Land died so cleanly!
“Underworld Emperor is already very formidable. In the end, he showed all kinds of techniques, many of which I could not even see through. I even felt a huge threat from them.” Extreme Night Primogenitor laughed, “It’s just that his techniques were futile against Monarch Flying Snow.”
“It seems that from now on, there is an additional spear over our heads. If we were to violate our promises, we would be killed.” Eternal Night Primogenitor laughed at himself.
They were unparalleled existence.
Including them and many other ordinary final realm existences were originally free and unfettered. Some times, they could ‘do things as they wished’. So what if they massacred a city? So what if they sacrificed a city for blood? They were not afraid of the consequences at all since nobody could threaten their lives! Even the supreme ‘Yuan’ would not do anything to these ants as long as they did not affect the balance of life reproduction in Realm Heart Great Land.
But now, they dared not ‘do things as they wished’.
It was useless even if they hid themselves in their territories! The bigger and higher graded the arrays they construct in their ‘territories’, the greater the price! And for unparalleled existences to increase their strength further, it would take an extravagant price! For instance, the territories that Emperor Summer and Eternal Night Primogenitor had were quite formidable, yet the boost to their strength was not that great precisely because they could not construct sufficiently peak arrays without sparing any thoughts to the resources they had.
Those who were weaker would instead become greatly strengthened with arrays in their territories.
Ordinary final realm cultivators for instance, were weaker when they did not own any supreme-graded secret treasures. And thus, the arrays in their territories would boost their strength greater-they would be able to fight against ‘unparalleled existences’ in their territories.
As for Xue Ying!
Reaching his level, the price of constructing more appropriate arrays for his current realm would be too high. It was even harder to find materials that could withstand the power from the seventh strike of his <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> secret impartation! Undying Underworld Emperor was helpless too. If he chose not to stint on constructing arrays in his territory, he might be able to unleash a strength equivalent to igniting his Heart Blood!
Furthermore, he could spend a huge price to fortify his territory further! Even if he could achieve a strength equivalent to igniting his Heart Blood, he still had to flee when Xue Ying sent a huge number of ‘World Masters’ to attack him!
“He is powerful!”
“His soul techniques are incredibly mysterious.”
“He can even summon a large number of World Masters easily.”
Unparalleled existences felt reverence and fear.
This frighteningly outstanding ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ was absolutely the strongest final realm cultivator with the greatest intimidation in history.
“After killing Underworld Emperor, he even chose to blast the membrane wall of the Origin World after coming back, creating a huge disturbance while holding on to that Death Emperor Crown. It seems he plans on intimidating the world. From now on, the Realm Heart Great Land is going to be different!” Many experts could deduce that from what Xue Ying chose to do as he brought the Death Emperor Crown back.
******
And that was the truth.
Other than the huge devils who chose to lower their heads while promising not to engage in any vicious acts, the other more arrogant ones that chose to wait and see and were not willing to lower their heads, immediately went to find Xue Ying! They incarcerated themselves and wanted to beg for mercy!
“Monarch, I am willing to swear an oath now. I…”
“It is too late.”
…
“Monarch, I haven’t killed anymore. I have stopped killing for a long time!”
“But you have killed in the past.”
…
In just one night.
The entire Realm Heart Great Land changed. Some of the famous huge devils on the list-quite a few were Paragon Masters-as long as they did not lower their heads before Xue Ying fought with ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’, they were all killed!
“Hmph.”
Xue Ying stood in the night sky watching a disappearing devil, “If I were to show you mercy, who would show mercy for the trillion living beings you killed?”
Actually Xue Ying wanted to kill all devils including Eternal Night Primogenitor, Moonflower King, Eight Silk Island Master, and others. Because the blood stained in the hands of these devils was immense.
But previously, when he had not broken through to the final realm, Xue Ying was not strong enough.
Many huge devils could guess that the day this Monarch Flying Snow broke through to the final realm would also be their doomsday. Hence, many lowered their heads! If they did not give them a chance to ‘live’, these devils would most likely turn mad.
Hence, he could only ‘compromise’.
As long as those devils lowered their heads and immediately swear an oath to restrict themselves, Xue Ying would forgo what happened in the past!
“Right now, I have the strength to be the judge, jury and executioner! Begging for mercy?” Xue Ying’s heart was cold, “If I did not kill enough, who would intimidate the subsequent devils? How can I bring forward the new era?”
******
Many Cosmos God level devils had already lowered their heads and made an oath. Those who did not lower their heads were all killed!
After that terrifying day termed as ‘Devil Extinguishing Night’, the general atmosphere in the Realm Heart Great Land shifted. There were no longer any ‘Blood Sacrifices’ in the Realm Heart Great Land because those few great devils who knew how to refine the Essence of Blood Spirit dared not to act viciously anymore. There was no longer any meaning to sacrificing living beings for blood since they would be seeking death.
And from now on, the moment any devil was discovered, there was no need for Xue Ying to act. Many experts who disliked evil that had never appeared in the past would take the initiative to execute them.
…
“The era has changed.”
“He has really altered the entire Realm Heart Great Land.”
Many Cosmos Gods were startled as they saw the transformation happening in the Realm Heart Great Land.
…
Over time, many new-born cultivators on the Realm Heart Great Land were startled: “What? Why would there be Blood Sacrifices in the past? How could it be true that a city with a trillion lives were sacrificed without leaving any single one alive? Did that even happen?”
“The great devils in the past could easily kill a trillion living beings? Impossible! How could there be such mad devils?”
Since they had never seen them before, they naturally did not believe in those stories.
Because now, what they could see were all ‘devils’ being slaughtered in the Realm Heart Great Land the moment they appeared! Many cultivators would even take the initiative to kill them when they found one! They were all filled with ‘justice’. In reality, all the supposed devils that emerged nowadays were just some small fries compared to those that were gathered in the devil gathering grounds in the past.
“Old Devil Green Fiend! You can’t flee!”
“Many training teams have fallen one after in the past, and the few of us thought they met with some dangers! Who would have thought that you are the culprit! Just die for us!”
Seven figures chased after a green-robed old man who was escaping in panic.
And far away at the peak of a mountain.
There were two figures stood there. One was the white-robed Xue Ying, and the other was Emperor Summer dressed in loose black robes. The two of them stood side by side watching everything.
“Haha, Flying Snow, you are really amazing. It feels like it was yesterday when you killed Undying Underworld Emperor. Currently, the atmosphere of the entire Realm Heart Great Land has changed. The few of us do not even dare to think that the Realm Heart Great Land could be like this.” Emperor Summer chuckled, “Even this person dared to call himself an Old Devil? He was even pursued after by so many cultivators!”
“How could it feel like yesterday? It has been more than 200 billion years already.” Xue Ying could not help but retort. To Emperor Summer, it felt like a short period. But to Xue Ying, this was an incredibly long period.
200 billion years.
That was sufficient for many generations of talented Primal Chaos cultivators to emerge! And now, there were many more sentient beings living in the Realm Heart Great Land. That’s because every city was slightly safer, and even Primal Chaos devils could hardly be seen.
“200 billion years is really a fleeting moment.” Emperor Summer sighed, “But talking about this, I kind of prefer living in such a world.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1260 - Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm Second Killing Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 1260:Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm Second Killing Technique
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“I do like such a world too.” Xue Ying stood at the peak of the mountain looking at this vast world. At the same time, a smile appeared on his face.
He once had a goal to alter an entire world, ensuring that devils could no longer act as they wished. He felt that this was a lofty goal and many others did not find his ambition doable. At that time, the experts in Realm Heart Great Land were already used to this order. They were used to ‘final realm experts’ being free and unfettered, and nobody could threaten them.
Nonetheless, everything changed!
“But do you see the inherent danger?” Emperor Summer said.
“The inherent danger?” Xue Ying was stunned.
“Population.” Emperor Summer explained, “Even though the speed of reproduction for cultivators is slow-most are only safe when they live within the cities, and the space within cities is limited, 200 billion years has ultimately gone by. Currently, there are more and more cities constructed, and the number of cultivators is also increasing constantly. The burden this has on the Realm Heart Great Land would also become heavier. According to my understanding, the Realm Heart Great Land is different from other Origin Worlds. Other Origin Worlds would enter a Great Apocalypse, causing the entire world to start from ground zero. But the Realm Heart Great Land is created by ‘Yuan’. It is eternal. It will not enter any Great Apocalypse, so its population will only increase until a point where the Realm Heart Great Land could no longer withstand it.”
Xue Ying nodded slightly: “That’s true too.”
“Even though this increase of population in the past 200 billion years is still within limits of what the Realm Heart Great Land could withstand, if this continues on, there’ll be a day that the Realm Heart Great Land suffers from grave consequences.” Emperor Summer said, “Or perhaps ‘Yuan’ might impose a new law. Regardless, he’ll definitely suppress the population living in Realm Heart Great Land.”
“Haha, the law that Yuan sets wouldn’t include slaughtering the cultivators mindlessly.” Xue Ying replied. For instance, the Realm Heart God Palace that was left behind was prepared for final realm cultivators-like the supreme-graded secret treasures for instance. Clearly, ‘Yuan’ still left behind many opportunities for the weaker cultivators.
Emperor Summer nodded too.
The two of them no longer spoke any further. Because they would not know what ‘Yuan’ might do.
He could be slightly benevolent, for instance altering the law and increasing the difficulty of cultivators reproducing! This would naturally limit the expansion of population.
He could possibly be cruel-with the strong feasting on the weak…
Everything was possible.
“Let’s go.”
The two of them disappeared from the vicinity.
…
In the Fan Clan Magic Mountain.
“Teacher, I’ve read through the scriptures within the clan, finding out that our Fan Clan owns the ‘Burning Heart God Tree’ which is tremendously helpful to cultivators cultivating the Dao of Sou. Currently, I am just one step away from breaking through to the Cosmos God Realm. Is it possible for me to cultivate under the Burning Heart God Tree?” A young man asked another black-robed old man.
“The Burning Heart God Tree?” The black-robed old man stared back, “My Fan Clan is currently basking in the light of that Monarch Flying Snow. He has left a lot of treasures and opportunities for us. How about this, I’ll send you to the ‘Fantasy Devil Palace’ instead. As for the Burning Heart God Tree, it is best for you not to think about that.”
The young man questioned back: “Why not? I’ve read through the scriptures, and they stated that our Ancestor has created the <Un-Phase Mystical Technique> after cultivating under the Burning Heart God Tree. Furthermore, he rarely cultivates under the Burning Heart God Tree too. It should be possible for disciples in the clan to exchange for a chance to cultivate there. However, it seems that I can’t find this item on the scroll of exchange.”
“It is right that you can’t find it!” The black-robed old man transmitted back, “Currently, that Monarch Flying Snow is still cultivating under the Burning Heart God Tree!”
“Monarch Flying Snow?” The young man widened his eyes.
Monarch Flying Snow.
Currently, his influence in the Realm Heart Great Land was too big. He was publicly recognized as the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land! That was someone who could kill the previous strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land, ‘Undying Underworld Emperor’, stunning many other unparalleled existences and ordinary final realm cultivators. Many other cultivators even worshipped this ‘Monarch Flying Snow’.
It was due to a good relationship the Summer Wind Ancient Nation had with Monarch Flying Snow, that was why they were given quite a lot of benefits. Currently, their reputation was stronger by an entire level as compared to the Myriad Realms Ancient Nation.
“Now you know why? I’ll send you to the Fantasy Devil Palace. It is best for you to stop thinking about the Burning Heart God Tree temporarily. Wait until that Monarch Flying Snow leaves. By then, you will have your chance.” The black-robed old man advised him.
“Teacher, did you just say that Monarch Flying Snow is cultivating in our Fan Clan Magic Mountain? I, I, I have been living here for so long yet I do not know about that!” The young man was incredibly excited, “Teacher, can I visit him?”
When he was young, he had grown up hearing stories of this Monarch Flying Snow.
“Visit him? Monarch Flying Snow is still cultivating, how can you disturb him?” The black-robed old man snorted, “The Old Ancestor has already given the orders not to disturb him.”
“Oh.” The young man felt crestfallen when he heard that.
“Teacher, could you tell me which direction is the Burning Heart God Tree in?” The young man asked.
The black-robed old man shook his head with a smile. He pointed out to a direction: “Over there.”
That young man looked in that direction. His eyes were filled with excitement and expectations.
In that direction…
Right on the Fan Clan Magic Mountain, the number one expert in Realm Heart Great Land, ‘Monarch Flying Snow’, was cultivating there!
…
In reality, many Cosmos Gods knew that ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ was closer with the Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
For instance, ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ would frequently discuss the Dao with Emperor Summer. Both of them would frequently drink and appear at a particular location in Realm Heart Great Land sparring! The two of them were both final realm experts in the ‘Dao of Void’. Both of them had gotten a supreme secret impartation too! Hence, it would be greatly helpful for the two to fight with one another.
And the relationship between ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ and ‘Ancestor Fan’ was also spread.
Ancestor Fan deliberately released this news. He wanted to let all Cosmos Gods in the world know that Monarch Flying Snow had an avatar cultivating for long periods in the Fan Clan Magic Mountain! This brought envy and jealousy to many other Cosmos Gods because they desired to interact with this Monarch Flying Snow. Other than being powerful, ‘Monarch Flying Snow’s influence in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range was huge too! And he had many treasures and opportunities.
Did they not see that Emperor Summer, Ancestor Fan, Paragon Master Bewitching Sword, and Emperor Cang were thus benefited from this relationship?
Did they not see that Southern Cloud King could walk unhindered all over the world?
Did they not see that Old Mother Ying Shan had broken through to the Cosmos God Realm?
“Hu~”
Under the Burning Heart God Tree, the white-robed Xue Ying sat cross-legged. The violet leaves fell with the wind. As Xue Ying opened his eyes, his eyes were filled with a strand of regret.
“I have yet to succeed.” Xue Ying muttered to himself, “It’s too bad that I merely got a fleeting moment to examine that Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. If I could have more time thoroughly comprehending it, I might be able to create the third killing technique of the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm now.”
Over the long years…
Xue Ying had already swept through all the mysterious eyes on the sky-floating islands within Broken Tooth Mountain Range. He had also memorized the illusory realm structures within those mysterious eyes. At that time, he created the first killing technique using the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm according to the structure of the gray eyes-the Resplendent Illusory Realm! And after examining all the structures of the golden eyes, approximately 80 billion years since he killed Undying Underworld Emperor, Xue Ying created the second killing technique using the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm-the Slaughter Illusory Realm!
“It is as I expected, these two great killing techniques can’t be used on a single enemy at the same time.” Xue Ying shook his head.
The Resplendent Illusory Realm was used to entice the enemy and bewilder him.
The Slaughter Illusory Realm was instead used to wipe out the soul of the enemy. If it could not kill the enemy, it would injure the enemy instead!
Both were entirely different illusory realms.
And the soul of the enemy could only enter one illusory realm at a single time.
“Unless my illusory realm encompasses both the ‘Resplendent’ and ‘Slaughter’ at the same time. But that is too difficult.” Xue Ying really wished to have another look at the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet because the internal structure of the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet was a vast thousand-eyed world.
“Great Emperor North River!”
When Xue Ying thought about this, he felt slightly unwilling.
If only he had the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet, he might be able to create the third killing technique. The third killing technique was a perfect fusion of the first two great killing techniques. Naturally, it would be qualitatively different. Perhaps Xue Ying might be able to reach the ‘final realm’ in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm by relying on it! But it was just a pipe dream since reaching the final realm was not that easy. Xue Ying had to experience many more obstacles before achieving it. But if he could create that killing technique, his understanding of the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm might reach a deeper level.
Nonetheless, everything was broken apart.
‘This Great Emperor North River seems to enter the Snake Tooth Corridor without planning to return.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Is he afraid of me taking revenge on him? So he plans on staying inside forever? But he has to come out once the energy in the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet is consumed. Otherwise, he would stay within for eternity.’
Even if the other party came out, it would be because the energy within the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet had been consumed, causing it to dissipate!
“The Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet.” Over these years, Xue Ying had visited many other sky-floating islands, yet he had never once encountered any Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet or Snake-Tooth Bead! It was very difficult to acquire any of these two great supreme treasures according to history. Usually, only the five Great Supremes had a chance of getting them. For instance, the ‘Black Leaf Lake’ previously created a suppression on the soul without any other ambient dangers. It was fortunate that Xue Ying could acquire a Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. Ever since then, he had never seen another one.
“Seems like I am fated not to get another Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet? Whatever. Even if I do not have the droplet, I could still create the third killing technique. Perhaps, my understanding and accumulation in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm might reach a deeper level.” Xue Ying was consoling himself. He then calmed his heart down before continuing with his cultivation while attempting to fuse the two great killing techniques of the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1261 - An Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1261: An Invitation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Flying Snow City, within the Monarch Residence.
Underneath the pavilion by the lake, Xue Ying was seated opposite of Emperor Summer. The two of them were currently discussing about Dao.
“The Chaotic Origin Refinement Body is created by me. Younger Brother Flying Snow, you should just trust me.” Emperor Summer anxiously added, “Treating the Chaotic Origin Dimension as the womb, you can then nurture your fleshy body. I believe if this process is successful, you would have a Chaotic Origin Lifeform fleshy body. This should be the orthodox path!”
“We have both tried many times before. I always find that it is too simple for us to view success by treating the ‘Chaotic Origin’ as the womb. Taking a step from the final realm to the Chaotic Origin Realm isn’t that simple.” Xue Ying retorted, “Breaking through to the next level would never be this easy when we have both experienced how hard it is to reach our level step by step.”
“I don’t find it easy as well! Using the Chaotic Origin Dimension as the womb before nurturing a new fleshy body is an incredibly difficult process in itself. But I still wish for Brother Flying Snow to help me. With your help, the two of us can go down and research this path.” Emperor Summer said.
“It is a pity that I can’t accept this first step of using the dimension as the womb.” Xue Ying shook his head, “Emperor Summer, I believe it’ll be better for both of us to walk our own path. We shall see who could create the authentic third level Chaotic Origin Refinement Body in the end.”
Emperor Summer could not help but shake his head when he heard that.
Over the past 200 billion years, the two of them had been frequently discussing about Dao. And what they talked about most was how to attain the third level Chaotic Origin Refinement Body in the <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll>!
This cultivation technique was originally created by Emperor Summer! It’s a pity that Emperor Summer had only created the first two levels of the Chaotic Origin Refinement Body.
Xue Ying had a supreme secret impartation, the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>. His understanding of and usage in the Dao of Void and Chaotic Origin Energy, along with many special techniques he comprehended gave him the skillset to perfect the fundamentals laid by Emperor Summer. After reaching the ‘final realm’, he even tried to create the third level Chaotic Origin Refinement Body! Furthermore, ever since his soul created a new killing technique, it improved his fleshy body further.
When the two of them began conversing on the Dao, they originally had a huge gain.
Because Emperor Summer similarly owned a supreme secret impartation on the Dao of Void known as the <Void Blossom>.
And Xue Ying’s supreme secret impartation was the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>. This technique was absolutely compatible with his Chaotic Origin Weapon, the Azure River Spear.
Since both of them had different supreme secret impartation… coupled with the fact that both of them could not leak the supreme secret impartation to others, they could only share their understanding on certain ideologies.
Over the years…
The two of them were still agreeable on many points at the start. They even came out with the ‘preliminary version’ for the ‘third level of Chaotic Origin Refinement Body’. This was an imperfect version. Even if it was not perfect, both of their fleshy bodies had reached a level comparable to Kings at grand perfection. Even with their fleshy bodies, they had power that could fight against Eternal Night Primogenitor and other unparalleled existences.
And because of this ‘preliminary version’ that they came out with, both of them became high-spirited. They saw hope of jumping out of the cage.
Hence, they continued interacting and researched further into the body refinement process.
Nonetheless, over the years, several branches began forming. And the path both of them took gradually grew further apart!
“How difficult is this path? If I were to walk down this path alone, when could I ever break through? If there were another person supporting me along this journey, it might be possible for both of us to break through at the same time.” Emperor Summer sighed. He had discovered the high innate talent Xue Ying had, discovering many possible points of breakthrough on the body refinement aspect. But if he, Emperor Summer, were to walk down this path alone…
Even though he had the supreme secret impartation <Void Blossom>, making it possible for him to achieve the first step of using the Chaotic Origin Dimension as the womb, nurturing and condensing the fleshy body was the hardest step. That was something he was not confident of.
That was why he wished to pull Xue Ying along with him.
But Xue Ying clearly wanted to walk a path he felt confident of.
“We have sufficient time to take our own path. In the future if the path I took led me to a deadend, I’ll have a try at the direction you pointed out, Emperor Summer.” Xue Ying laughed. His talent on body cultivation was not that high either. It was only because he created a new killing technique using the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, catalyzing a qualitative transformation of his fleshy body…
If his soul was strong! His fleshy body would be influenced. And it was because of this cause and effect that provided new inspiration for Xue Ying.
…
The two of them temporarily placed aside their differences. They continued discussing about the comprehension and understanding they had regarding the third level of Chaotic Origin Refinement Body.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying suddenly stopped. He looked up to the distance.
“What happened?” Emperor Summer was puzzled. It was not appropriate for him to extend his senses in the Flying Snow City.
“There is a guest.” Xue Ying chuckled. A figure condensed not too far away. It was a tall and thin male dressed in white robe. That tall and thin male descended before speaking with politeness: “Zha Fu greets Monarch Flying Snow.”
“You are?” Xue Ying asked.
He could discern with a glance that this was an expert of the Natives from Broken Tooth Mountain Range. As for who he was, Xue Ying did not know.
After all, there were too many Emperors at the initial level in Broken Tooth Mountain Range. And this Emperor that came did not seem to be famous.
“I am an emissary of Supreme Vast Ancient.” The tall and thin male chuckled: “And I came on orders of the Supreme to invite Monarch over.”
“Supreme Vast Ancient?” Xue Ying felt startled, “I wonder why Supreme wants to meet me?”
“This is something I am unsure of. Supreme ordered for me to come fetch Monarch over.” The tall and thin male replied.
“It is better for you to go since Supreme Vast Ancient wants to meet you.” Emperor Summer chuckled.
“Alright.” Xue Ying nodded.
An avatar then condensed by the side. This avatar said to the tall and thin male: “Go. Let’s go meet the Supreme.”
…
They directly executed the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique before arriving by the boundaries of Vast Ancient World.
Xue Ying and the tall thin male ‘Zha Fu’ appeared. Zha Fu looked around him before saying: “Monarch Flying Snow, please follow me.”
‘Supreme Vast Ancient.’ Xue Ying pondered in his heart.
He had also interacted with the five Great Supremes over the past 200 billion years.
Because he desired to comprehend the ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’. And such treasures that could be used to enter the ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’ would most likely be found only in the five Great Supremes! Hence, Xue Ying chose to visit them one after another. The five Great Supremes treated him politely too since they agreed to meet him. It’s a pity that when he pointed out that he wished to comprehend the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet without consuming any energy within-Xue Ying even promised to stay behind in the cavern-dwelling of the Supreme to comprehend, all five Great Supremes simply replied saying they did not have any ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’
That time when he went to meet Supreme Vast Ancient, Supreme Vast Ancient had a terrific temper. He said: “I have a piece of Snake-Tooth Bead, but not any Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. Of these supreme treasures which are used to enter the Snake Tooth Corridor, there were indeed more Snake-Tooth Bead found in history than the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. Other than the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet which Monarch Flying Snow discovered earlier, there are only three droplets found that are publicized. And they have all been consumed in the Snake Tooth Corridor.”
“Sou, sou.”
Vast Ancient Palace. This was a grand and magnificent palace. Being the accommodation of one of the two Great Supremes of the Natives, Supreme Vast Ancient had great influence in the world.
The security here was strict. There were many protectors.
But Xue Ying did not meet any obstruction. Those protectors and even god generals treated Xue Ying with extreme respect. They knew that this ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ was not only good in his soul technique, his close combat power could be ranked at the front of the god generals.
“Greetings Supreme.” Xue Ying saw that existence ahead of him, and immediately bowed.
“Monarch Flying Snow is here.” Supreme Vast Ancient sat there looking at the vast void. He pointed to a stone stool by the side, “Come, have a seat.”
Xue Ying went over before sitting down.
At this moment, Supreme Vast Ancient had completely concealed his aura. His expression remained simple and cold. Just the fact that he concealed his aura showed his hospitality. Otherwise, he would simply release his powerful aura, a fireball that was very frightening even at Xue Ying’s current level. After all, Xue Ying’s fleshy body had yet to break through. He merely grasped the preliminary version of the third level of Chaotic Origin Refinement Body, and that was at the grand perfection King level.
“I wonder why Supreme is looking for me?” Xue Ying asked. Since he did not have to visit the sky-floating islands anymore, Xue Ying did not leave behind any avatars in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. If there were any other matters, they could look for him in the Flying Snow City.
“As I said before, I have a bead of Snake-Tooth Bead.” Supreme Vast Ancient said.
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded.
Supreme Vast Ancient then flipped his hand, causing two smooth and round black beads to appear. These two beads were incomparably deep. It would allure those looking at it. The more one examined it, the more one would feel that this black bead was like a huge world devouring the myriad existences. Xue Ying could naturally maintain his state of mind, though he was still startled when he saw them: “Two Snake-Tooth Beads?”
“Yes, two beads.” Supreme Vast Ancient nodded, “I originally have one. I am not in a rush to enter the Snake Tooth Corridor either. After all, I have been there several times before, and would like to prepare myself further before entering again! Who would have thought that as I journeyed through several sky-floating islands recently, I found yet another Snake-Tooth Bead.”
“Congratulations Supreme.” Xue Ying said. Some sky-floating islands were indeed filled with great dangers. And those places were places that Xue Ying could not explore deeply. But Supremes had the chance to enter. The Thousand-Eyed Water Droplets and Snake-Tooth Beads were usually found in extremely dangerous places.
“I can give you one Snake-Tooth Bead.” Supreme Vast Ancient looked at Xue Ying.
“Why would you give me such supreme treasure for no reason at all?” Xue Ying smiled as he looked at the Supreme. Though his heart began racing when he thought about that-who would not want to enter the Snake Tooth Corridor?
Supreme Vast Ancient continued: “You have to enter the Snake Tooth Corridor with me. Furthermore, after entering it, you must listen to my orders.”
“What does Supreme require me to do?” Xue Ying did not get angry. It would be weird if the other party gave him this supreme treasure for no reasons at all. But no matter what, that place was the legendary forbidden ground, the ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’. It would be a huge opportunity for him if he could enter that place!

chapters.title: Chapter 1262 - Entering the Snake Tooth Corridor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1262: Entering the Snake Tooth Corridor
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Monarch Flying Snow, what you need to do is simple.” Supreme Vast Ancient said, “Just follow me into the Snake Tooth Corridor. After that, just do everything according to my arrangement without acting on yourself. You should be rest assured though since there are quite a few dangerous places in the Snake Tooth Corridor which require the protection from the ‘Snake-Tooth Bead’! Once the energy within the Snake-Tooth Bead is consumed to a certain amount, we would have to return. If we fail to return to the Broken Tooth Mountain Range before the energy in the Snake-Tooth Bead is fully consumed, then we would not be able to return.”
Xue Ying understood.
The Snake Tooth Corridor was incredibly dangerous, especially at its entrance and exit-those places could not be survived solely with one’s body. Instead, one had to rely on the energy within the ‘Snake-Tooth Bead’ or the ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’.
Entering and exiting the place required energy.
If the energy in the Snake-Tooth Bead was fully consumed before exiting the place, then one would most likely lose his or her life in the corridor maelstrom.
“Hence, we have to return when the Snake-Tooth Bead is left with just 30% energy.” Supreme Vast Ancient smiled at Xue Ying, “But you are different. You have many avatars. You can still continue your exploration in the Snake Tooth Corridor all the way until the energy in the Snake-Tooth Bead is consumed! I don’t think it would be of any influence to you if that avatar of yours failed to return right?”
Xue Ying nodded.
“Hence, before I head out, you have to listen to me. When I am about to leave the place, you could take the chance to explore on your free will.” Supreme Vast Ancient said, “Do you agree to my request?”
“Haha, since Supreme is willing to bestow a supreme treasure like the ‘Snake-Tooth Bead’ to me, and all I have to do is to help you out with an avatar, this would definitely be a beneficial task to me.” Xue Ying laughed.
Supreme Vast Ancient revealed a grin at that moment.
He did not feel that this Monarch Flying Snow would reject him. Nonetheless, he was afraid that the personality of the other party was too obstinate and unwilling to listen to his orders.
“I wonder how many avatars do I have to send in?” Xue Ying asked.
“An avatar is sufficient.” Supreme Vast Ancient explained, “The Snake-Tooth Bead would only protect a single avatar.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying nodded.
He had many avatars. Even if he lost an avatar within the Snake Tooth Corridor, it would be a minor matter.
This opportunity to enter the forbidden ground was something he could only hope for!
“Before I bestow the Snake-Tooth Bead to Monarch Flying Snow, I wish for Monarch Flying Snow to swear an oath.” Supreme Vast Ancient said. He did not dare to trust Xue Ying for such a supreme treasure.
“Alright.” Xue Ying did not hesitate. He immediately swore an oath.
Supreme Vast Ancient felt delighted too. He knew that cultivators emphasized greatly on oaths.
…
Both parties agreed with one another without hesitation, and Supreme Vast Ancient had already done his preparations. As for Xue Ying, he merely had to send an avatar over and did not require much preparations. That day, the two of them headed to the Snake Tooth Corridor.
“Hong hong hong~”
They immediately came to the Snake Tooth Corridor where that terrifying black maelstrom was.
This maelstrom contained an immense tearing force. Judging from the ringing sound it produced made Xue Ying wary. Though the sound coming from the maelstrom was not the most frightening aspect of it. Instead, the maelstrom had generated unseen ripples that penetrated through the fleshy body and soul, causing Xue Ying to feel fear from his heart. Looking up at the towering snake head which was as big as the territory of Southern Cloud Nation: ‘This Chaotic Origin Lifeform is close to the level of ‘Yuan’. Even if it has died for an unknown period of time, just some of its power is unimaginable! Terrifying. Truly terrifying! Furthermore, deducing from the size of an ordinary snake where its head is just a small section of its body, even though this Chaotic Origin Lifeform might have some differences as compared to a normal snake, its body should be much bigger!’
Since the snake head was as big as Southern Cloud Nation already, how long would the body be?
The ‘Summer Wind Ancient Nation’ might seem big-way bigger than the Southern Cloud Nation, but it was huge because of its land area! When comparing both nations in terms of length, Summer Wind Ancient Nation was merely a few times longer.
And this ‘snake’ body… should be way beyond the length of Summer Wind Ancient Nation.
“Who is that?”
“Supreme Vast Ancient? Monarch Flying Snow?”
The five Great Supremes had arranged for surveillance around the Snake Tooth Corridor. These guards immediately discovered the presence of Xue Ying and Supreme Vast Ancient.
One was a Supreme and the other the famous Monarch Flying Snow. These guards naturally did not dare to interfere.
“I still feel the shock whenever I come closer to it.” Supreme Vast Ancient said, “Such an innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform has a body so big that it far surpasses our imagination. And ‘Yuan’ actually reached where he is from a weak little cultivator. His body size is comparable to ours, yet he is so strong that he could even triumph over this terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeform before us. Thinking about it, I feel envy and admiration for him.”
Xue Ying nodded.
“Let’s enter.” Supreme Vast Ancient said, “Don’t worry. As we get closer to the Snake Tooth Corridor, the energy within the Snake-Tooth Bead would naturally activate.”
“Sou sou.”
The two of them rapidly went towards the black maelstrom.
As they flew closer, Xue Ying felt some special changes on the Snake-Tooth Bead placed in his bosom. That Snake-Tooth Bead immediately emitted a black light that covered the body of Xue Ying. Similarly, Supreme Vast Ancient had a black protection covering him too.
“Both of them have gone in.”
“Supreme Vast Ancient and Monarch Flying Snow have both entered the Snake Tooth Corridor.”
The guards standing by the distance felt shocked. It was fine that Supreme Vast Ancient entered. But Monarch Flying Snow actually entered the Snake Tooth Corridor alongside? The guards assigned by the other four Great Supremes immediately reported upwards.
This news spread really quickly.
And the Supremes got the news shortly after.
“They have gone in? Even Monarch Flying Snow has entered the Snake Tooth Corridor? Since both of them entered the corridor together, it seems likely that Supreme Vast Ancient has bestowed the supreme treasure to Monarch Flying Snow. Supreme Vast Ancient should be planning to explore the entire consciousness region this time round?” Supreme Lightning Firmament made his deduction after obtaining the news.
“What a Vast Ancient! He actually acquired two supreme treasures.”
“His fortune is terribly good.”
The other four Supremes felt envious.
Both the Snake-Tooth Bead and Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet were incredibly hard to get. Getting one was fine, but getting two was much harder! Supreme Vast Ancient originally had a Snake-Tooth Bead. It’s just that he planned on completing his preparations before entering the corridor. Who would have thought that during this period, Xue Ying first rose up and Supreme Vast Ancient actually found another Snake-Tooth Bead.
As a result, it facilitated this trip.
And other Supremes could only be envious of it.
…
“Hong long long-”
Their surroundings continued ringing.
Just as they flew into the black maelstrom, they felt a tearing force on their bodies. They could no longer control their bodies and were engulfed along the maelstrom.
It was fortunate they were protected by the black light. This black protection light might seem thin, yet it could isolate the destruction from the external force. Nonetheless, Xue YIng could feel the vast energy within the ‘Snake-Tooth Bead’ being consumed.
“Sou sou.”
Supreme Vast Ancient and Xue Ying could only follow along the devouring force and flow down into the Snake Tooth Corridor.
As they proceeded ahead through the maelstrom, they could see space becoming distorted and shattered. They traveled at a rapid pace.
But this bloody mouth of the snake was too big. After all, just the snakehead itself was as big as the territory of Southern Cloud Nation. Just the time taken as they were engulfed into the maelstrom took an hour. Only then did the surrounding tearing forces from the maelstrom started dropping. Soon, Supreme Vast Ancient and Xue Ying regained control of their bodies.
“Are we in the mouth of the snake now?” Xue Ying looked around him. He saw an enormous snake tooth not too far from him.
That snake tooth was emitting a heart-palpitating aura.
“We should not stay here. The wind here would consume the energy in the Snake-Tooth Bead.” Supreme Vast Ancient urged, “Continue forward!”
Xue Ying nodded. Actually, as the power from the maelstrom dropped, the consumption of energy in the Snake-Tooth Bead had similarly reduced. But clearly, Supreme Vast Ancient cared about the usage of every single point of energy in the bead.
“Sou sou!”
Supreme Vast Ancient brought Xue Ying and flew at high speed through the vast mouth of the snake.
They flew for quite some time before finally flying past an enormous snake tooth. This snake tooth was way taller than any mountain peak in Realm Heart Great Land.
“Where are we going?” Xue Ying asked.
“You just have to follow me. You will naturally know once we reach.” Supreme Vast Ancient chuckled. He was clearly familiar with this place. Having been here multiple times, he was not too willing to waste any strand of energy, bringing along Xue Ying at high speed towards the destination.

chapters.title: Chapter 1263 - The Consciousness of the Snake
chapters.content:
Chapter 1263: The Consciousness of the Snake
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Every snake tooth was as tall as a towering mountain. They were also emitting an endless aura of slaughter, causing Xue Ying to feel an instinctive terror.
This was normal. The snake teeth were the ‘weapon’ of this Chaotic Origin Lifeform. After all, where did the name ‘Broken Tooth Mountain Range’ came about? Precisely because there was a broken tooth within this mountain range, and that tooth was also the tallest mountain in the entire Realm Heart Great Land! There was even a legend regarding this mountain formed from a broken tooth--that it injured ‘Yuan’. Only then did Yuan deliberately left it behind.
“Mn?” Xue Ying also discovered the changes.
He was brought under the lead of Supreme Vast Ancient, and they had already passed by eight snake teeth! There were two rows of snake teeth on the left, and another two rows to the right!
In other words, there were four rows of snake teeth within the mouth of this snake.
And currently, they merely flew past eight teeth. One could see how slow they were flying!
‘Yi? The eight teeth in front are all emitting a darkness that makes me feel heart-palpitating. As for this snake tooth right in front of me, it is giving out a very sharp feeling.’ Xue Ying watched with bewilderment. There was a towering tooth not too far away, and compared to the one that was further behind, this tooth that was closer is sharper, and its aura emitted was completely different.
…
As they flew, Xue Ying discovered that the aura of every eight teeth would be different. Some teeth even looked different.
After flying for half a day, they also flew past more than 80 teeth.
“That is?” Xue Ying’s eyes brightened. He saw a towering black snake tooth appearing. And around that tooth was many cracks of void, “The Dao of Void?”
He felt it.
This newly-seen snake tooth contained the Dao of Void as its essence. Furthermore, it was a Dao at a higher level.
For a moment, Xue Ying felt an itch in his heart. He wanted to get closer and examine it!
“Monarch Flying Snow, I know you have reached the final realm in the Dao of Void.” By his side, Supreme Vast Ancient glanced to the distance and transmitted, “These eight snake teeth indeed do contain many profound mysteries of the Dao of Void. There are many opportunities inherent within too. But if we were to get closer and enter those teeth, we would have to consume the energy from the Snake-Tooth Bead. It is better for you to follow me obediently for now. Once I return, it won’t be too late for you to come here again.”
“Rest assured. Since we have an agreement and I even swore an oath, I will naturally not violate it.” Xue Ying said.
“It is good that Monarch understands.” Supreme Vast Ancient no longer elaborated further. Actually, he knew what the Snake Tooth Corridor meant to cultivators. Only then did he deliberately reminded the other party.
He could not possibly waste a strand of energy just because of Xue Ying.
“Eight Void Snake Teeth.”
“Truly…”
As Xue Ying flew, he became more delighted. He even had some comprehension just from looking at those teeth, ‘I’ll definitely come back and have a closer look once I’m done with my task with Supreme Vast Ancient.’
“Sou sou.”
The two of them continued flying deeper.
Excluding the snake teeth which they did not see clearly in the black maelstrom, just counting on the number they saw, they flew past 120 teeth before finally reaching a junction.
There was a side road leading forward, and another path leading upwards.
“Come along this way.”
The corridor was incredibly spacious.
It was becoming more and more quiet. There was only the occasional gale flitting by, causing some of the protective energy from the Snake-Tooth Bead to be consumed.
Supreme Vast Ancient and Xue Ying proceeded upwards, though Xue Ying had some thoughts. He asked, “Supreme, when we entered this place, that black maelstrom energy is too terrifying. We can’t even control our bodies and can’t even fly! We can only follow along the turbulent force. If that’s the case, how shall we leave? It can’t be that we have to go against the maelstrom right?”
“Haha, naturally, we can’t go against the maelstrom. The black maelstrom is the entrance-we enter along the mouth of the snake. As for the exit, it is actually through the corridor of its nose.” Supreme Vast Ancient chuckled, “That devouring force generated in that mouth is actually contrasted to an external expelling force in its nose. It’s just that the flow of force has been covered by the dark maelstrom.”
“I see.” Xue Ying nodded.
“But there is no need for Monarch Flying Snow to care about leaving this place.” Supreme Vast Ancient smiled, “Unless you have some special treasures which you plan on bringing out with you.”
…
The corridor was made up of the arteries and veins within the snake head. Naturally, there were many side roads along the way.
Of course, these ‘nodes’ were very stable. There were even certain areas that did not contain any gale or ripples. Standing there, the energy in the Snake-Tooth Bead would not be consumed!
As the corridor became narrower, furthermore, as they had been flying for a very long period, Xue Ying could not help but ask: “Where exactly are we going?”
“We are reaching soon.” Supreme Vast Ancient smiled, “You will know in a while. Don’t be too shocked.”
“Shocked?”
Xue Ying could only suppress his curiosity.
Even though the corridor was becoming narrower, it was still over 50 million kilometers wide. It’s just that this area was considered quite narrow compared to the ‘snake head’.
“That is-”
Right in front was a huge blood-colored membrane wall. The blood wall obstructed the path ahead.
Saying that it was a blood wall, in reality, it contained the flow of light and was like a huge blood waterfall.
“Go through it!” Supreme Vast Ancient was slightly excited.
“Sou sou.”
Both of them entered this blood wall.
This blood wall membrane did not block them. Instead, they felt a special energy going through their bodies. The blood membrane wall was thick too! They only passed through the wall after several breaths of time of flying.
“We are here!” Supreme Vast Ancient laughed before stopping down.
Xue Ying was instead looking with shock ahead of him.
It was a piece of vast space. Within this space, there were many veins that were emitting a warm light! This network of veins intersected at many areas. There were also several hundred huge balls of light scattered across this place. Every light ball was connected to a vein. Even though the light ball was huge, there were differing sizes between one another.
“Where is this?” Xue Ying was puzzled. Judging by the distance they flew, he made his deduction, “Is this the snake brain?”
“The snake brain is much bigger than this space. More accurately speaking, this is the consciousness of this terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeform.” Supreme Vast Ancient explained.
“The consciousness?” Xue Ying was astonished.
The consciousness of a living being was its most special area.
“Go. Let’s head to the first light ball.” Supreme Vast Ancient was filled with excitement. He immediately brought along Xue Ying in.
The vascular network in the consciousness was much narrower. Even though the two of them were currently flying in the thickest vein passage, it was merely half a million kilometers wide. This vascular network consisted of many intersecting nodes too. It was incredibly quiet in those ‘nodes’, and no ‘black wind’ could be seen blowing in those areas! That’s right, there was still black wind blowing within the consciousness, corroding the body of Xue Ying and others that were here.
After flying for a short period.
Supreme Vast Ancient stopped over at a node. He pointed to the light ball in front of them: “I’ll wait for you here. You should proceed forward and enter the light ball ahead. I can feel that this light ball is calling out to me! But it’s a pity that every light ball within the snake consciousness contains a huge suppression on the soul. Even though there are different levels of suppression, this light ball before me is something I can’t enter! Its suppression level is comparable to the Black Leaf Lake. I think you should be able to enter.”
“Oh?” Xue Ying understood now.
The light balls within the consciousness have an innate suppression on the soul?
No wonder, no wonder the other party asked him over.
“I wish you would follow your promise and listen to my orders.” Supreme Vast Ancient said, “After entering the realm, I want you to bring out whatever you deem could be taken out. If you were to hide anything or that you did not use your full strength to bring them out, that’ll be violating the oath.”
Supreme Vast Ancient once again reminded Xue Ying.
He passed a Snake-Tooth Bead to Xue Ying precisely because he needed Xue Ying’s help.
“Alright. Supreme should be rest assured. You can do a body search after I come out later on.” Xue Ying laughed. What a joke. Why would he violate the oath just for some external items? Even a Chaotic Origin Weapon would not be qualified for him to violate his oath. After all, his path of cultivation would be severed if he did so.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying followed along the slimmer vein and flew towards the light ball.
“Hu hu hu.” The black wind was also blowing in his direction. And the layer of black light covering his body easily resisted against the wind. It’s just that the energy in the Snake-Tooth Bead was slowly being used.
“Mn?” Just when he was half a million kilometers away from the light ball, Xue Ying felt an intense suppression on his soul. This suppression rapidly rose as he got closer to it.
“I do want to see what is within the light ball.” Xue Ying felt curious as he flew over.

chapters.title: Chapter 1264 - Realm Fragment
chapters.content:
Chapter 1264: Realm Fragment
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“The suppression is quite strong.”
Xue Ying followed along the pathway. As he walked closer to the light ball, the light ball became bigger, and the suppression increased to a degree that even Xue Ying felt uneasy.
Supreme Vast Ancient stood at the vascular node watching nervously: ‘Please enter, you must enter! This is the light ball within the consciousness that calls out to me most intensely.’
The reason he chose to fork a ‘Snake-Tooth Bead’ for Xue Ying to enter had been primarily because of this light ball.
‘He went in!’ Supreme Vast Ancient revealed a joyous look.
…
“Hu.”
As Xue Ying clashed against the light ball, he entered the dimension within.
“This Light Ball Dimension.” Xue Ying revealed a look of astonishment. This light ball dimension spanned across a region of billions of kilometers. Within it floated many solidified Realm Fragments. With a glance, Xue Ying could see seven Realm Fragments that seemed like ‘enormous paper’. Each Realm Fragment contained a source of fire that gave off a blazing heat.
Seven Realm Fragments with every one containing a dazzling item within.
There was one which contained a black dagger! This black dagger was located right at the center of the Realm Fragment.
There was also a ball of leaping blue fire that was also situated at the center of another Realm Fragment.
“Which shall I go?” Xue Ying could feel the inherent danger within these Realm Fragments.
“Mn.”
“It shall be the one with the black dagger.” Xue Ying made his decision. This was the only Realm Fragment that contained a weapon!
“Sou.”
Xue Ying flew directly towards that Realm Fragment. As he got closer to it, the enormous paper-like ‘Realm Fragment’ also absorbed him in.
“I am inside.” Xue Ying felt his surroundings changing. He soon found himself standing on an enormous wasteland. This wasteland consisted of many black-armored soldiers standing in formation. And right at the center of the wasteland was a throne situated on a mountain. A black-armored caped figure occupied the throne. He was also playing with that black dagger in his hands. Glancing at Xue Ying with his eyes, Xue Ying immediately felt a stifling pressure pushing down on him.
“Kill.” The black-armored soldiers were originally standing unmoving like puppets. But the moment Xue Ying descended, all the black-armored soldiers began charing at Xue Ying.
They were like a tsunami-every black-armored soldier turned into a stream of light that shot over.
Streams of light covered the world. They came in at all directions.
“Disappear!”
Facing this onslaught by the countless black-armored soldiers, Xue Ying remained calm. He stood at his original position on the wilderness while casting his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique.
“Hong---”
The illusory realm descended. It enveloped every single inch within this Realm Fragment, including that black-armored caped soldier seated on the throne. This illusory realm pounded against every black-armored soldier without mercy! This technique was really effective. One could see the black-armored soldiers dissipating like bubbles! Before, this wilderness was filled with soldiers, and at the next, other than Xue Ying, only 13 figures were left behind.
Other than the black-armored caped soldier, there were still 12 taller and bigger black-armored generals who remained perfectly fine on the surface.
“Sou sou sou…” These 12 generals could resist against the illusory realm. It was clear they were much stronger. They immediately charged wildly at Xue Ying.
“Peng peng peng.”
Each of them was wielding a dagger and they attacking styles were strange and mysterious-exceeding the capability of Xue Ying to understand. Xue Ying’s defending technique was practically useless as those daggers easily penetrated through it, striking against his body. Nonetheless, with the black protective cover on his body, it easily withstood against these attacks.
“I doubt Supremes could defend against this onslaught even if they relied on their personal strength.” Xue Ying’s expression changed.
Right at this moment, Xue Ying discovered that many black-armored soldiers were starting to condense once again at a location further from him.
“Seems like they will appear even after I wiped them out?” Xue Ying immediately executed his body technique. The body techniques of Dao of Void experts were quite amazing. Even though the 12 black-armored generals were powerful, their body techniques were clearly crude.
Xue Ying swept away all the black-armored soldiers with his illusory realm.
At the same time, he relied on his body technique to get closer to that black-armored caped figure seated on the throne. After all, Xue Ying’s target was that toy in the hands of that commander-the ‘black dagger’. That dagger emanated a vast energy which should also be the source of this Realm Fragment.
“Sou.”
The black-armored soldiers were like reforming bubbles-they appeared after being popped! And those black-armored generals were constantly hurled aside by Xue Ying. Even if they blockaded the path of Xue Ying, Xue Ying could still rely on his black protective light cover.
“Give me!” Xue Ying simply charged at the throne. He was like an apparition, forming ten thousand figures that were all real at the same time, albeit each figure appeared at a different layer of space. These figures all charged towards the throne at the same time.
“Hong.”
The black-armored caped figure stopped playing with the dagger. He gave a cold sneer before slashing out that dagger.
“Si la--”
A dagger slashed past Xue Ying.
“Hong!”
Xue Ying only felt his ringing in his consciousness. When he awoke, he discovered that he was already outside that Realm Fragment. That single strike actually blasted him out!
“I am out?” Xue Ying extended his senses before paling, “That single strike actually consumed so much of my energy in the Snake-Tooth Bead?”
Even though Xue Ying relied on the black protective light cover to survive against that single dagger strike, it consumed a relatively huge energy-approximately one-hundredth that of the energy within the Snake-Tooth Bead.
Looking at the Realm Fragment before him.
That Realm Fragment remained blurred. Xue Ying could only see the most dazzling source of the entire Realm Fragment-that black dagger! As for those soldiers, generals, and the black-armored cape figure, Xue Ying could not see them clearly from his viewpoint!
“What is going on with those soldiers? They could rebirth so many times? That black-armored caped figure is also exaggeratedly strong.” Xue Ying murmured inwardly. Nonetheless, Supreme Vast Ancient did remind him that anything could happen within the light ball dimension in the consciousness. And it would be a success if Xue Ying could bring anything out.
“Let me try again.”
Xue Ying attempted to enter that Realm Fragment with the black dagger.
“Hong long.”
After entering the realm when he descended on the wilderness, many black-armored soldiers were still present. And that black-armored caped figure was still there on his throne playing with the ‘black dagger’ seemingly as if nothing had happened.
All the figures immediately turned to Xue Ying. Clearly, they were about to start their onslaught once again.
“Leave!” Xue Ying did not hesitate. He chose to give up. Given his attainments in the Dao of Void, he was able to easily leave this Realm Fragment.
…
“The Realm Fragment with the black dagger is too dangerous.” Xue Ying turned to the other six Realm Fragments.
His gaze landed on one of the enormous Realm Fragments. The source of this Realm Fragment was a ‘fiery-red feather’. Xue Ying estimated that it should be easier to deal with this?
He made his decision purely on instincts.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying flew towards that Realm Fragment and was once again absorbed into the realm.
Similarly, this was a broken world. The boundaries of the world were filled with nothingness. At the center of this dimension, there was a gigantic tree. And at the top of the tree floated that fiery-red feather. Three birds were currently flying around it. There were also a huge number of other birds resting on that tree.
Similarly, the moment Xue Ying entered this Realm Fragment, all the birds turned to Xue Ying at the same time. Their eyes were filled with viciousness and killing intent.
An ear-piercing screech could be heard feeling the dimension.
Many ripples started moving in Xue Ying’s direction, causing his black protection light cover to fluctuate. Clearly, the energy in his Snake-Tooth Bead was being consumed.
“Disappear.” Xue Ying immediately cast his Mirage and Illusory Realm down in this broken world. And one by one, those birds disappeared with pops, leaving behind just three of the stronger ones flying around the ‘fiery-red feather’.
“There are just three birds left behind? It seems nobody is controlling this feather either? This Realm Fragment feels to be much easier than the black dagger Realm Fragment?” Xue Ying murmured inwardly. In the other Realm Fragment, there were still 13 existence left after he cast his illusory realm. This Realm Fragment seemed to be slightly weaker.

chapters.title: Chapter 1265 - Accidental Surprise?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1265: Accidental Surprise?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
There were only those three huge birds flying around the fiery-red feather. At this moment, all three birds had stopped flying. They were glaring at Xue Ying. The one that was the biggest, a green bird, let out a ear-piercing screech.
“Screech----”
It formed a ripple that the naked eyes could see, sweeping towards Xue Ying in a fan shape. This ripple spread incredibly quick and easily covered approximately 20% to 30% of this Realm Dimension area within an instance. Naturally, it also affected Xue Ying.
Even though the black protection light cover had isolated the damages, just hearing the sound made Xue Ying unwell.
“Sou.””Sou.” The other two birds had instead turned into streams of light as they shot at Xue Ying. As for that huge green bird, it remained by the fiery-red feather as its sole protector.
“Peng peng.”
These two birds flew with a strange trajectory. Within an instance, they appeared before Xue Ying. Xue Ying did not have the time to react. Instead, he was assaulted by the birds, causing his body to fly far backwards. At the same time as he flew back, Xue Ying’s figure immediately divided into 10,000 avatars. He also began casting the Dao of Void technique to confuse the opponents.
“Sou sou,” those two birds continued their attack. They did not show any mercy and swept across all figures they could.
Even though they were fast, sweeping across all 10,000 figures gave Xue Ying sufficient time to hide, dodge before rinsing the whole process again.
‘Their techniques are clearly frightening, but they seem really stupid?’ Xue Ying thought.
Previously, those opponents he faced in the Realm Fragment with the black dagger were similarly foolish.
If he did not enter the realm, they were like sculptures.
Their offenses were also made of the same styles and techniques.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying rapidly flew towards that fiery-red feather.
Those two birds seemed to be awaken at that moment. With a flash, they arrived by the side of the fiery-red feather, joining the huge green bird to prevent the enemy from stealing the feather.
“Peng peng peng…”
Both parties continued fighting.
Xue Ying relied on the formidability of his black protection light cover while attempting to grab that fiery-red feather. As those three birds were around the feather, they required a slight movement to disrupt Xue Ying’s techniques regardless of how crude their techniques were.
‘I have to try my best to confuse and split them apart.’ Xue Ying felt heart pain. Every time he clashed with those birds, the energy in his Snake-Tooth Bead would be consumed. He tried to divide out into many figures, teleporting through the void while simultaneously casting his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique. Only after trying several hundred times did he finally extend his hands and succeeded in his gamble at grabbing that feather.
The moment he grabbed that feather, this fragment of a world began distorting. It was like a stone being thrown into a peaceful lake.
As ripples formed, the fragmented world silently collapsed.
It felt like a dream! Disappearing like this without leaving behind any signs of its existence.
Xue Ying stood in the void holding onto that fiery-red feather. He turned towards the other six floating Realm Fragments.
‘The Realm Fragment dissipated just like that?’ Xue Ying murmured to himself inwardly, ‘What exactly are those birds? Are they illusions? Not right! They can clearly injure me.’
“Hong--”
Right while he was contemplating over it, an unseen energy from this light ball dimension actually expelled Xue Ying out of it.
“Mn?” Xue Ying felt himself dazzling and flashing past the dimension before landing back at the vascular network outside.
“Hahaha, you are out! You are out! Monarch Flying Snow, hurry and come over to my side.” Located not too far away at a particular node within the vascular network, Supreme Vast Ancient’s eyes brightened up when he saw Xue Ying coming out, especially at that piece of fiery-red feather in Xue Ying’s hand. He immediately shouted out delightedly.
When Xue Ying heard that, he immediately flew towards Supreme Vast Ancient.
“Supreme, what exactly is going on in this Light Ball Dimension? Why is it so strange?” Xue Ying felt puzzled. At the same time, he looked down at the fiery-red feather in his hand. This fiery-red feather had a frightening temperature. Fortunately, his body was protected by the black light.
“Hurry up and give it to me!” Supreme Vast Ancient urged.
“Alright.” Xue Ying passed it over.
Supreme Vast Ancient received the feather, carefully controlling the black protective light energy to uncover his right hand. That right hand of his lightly grabbed this fiery-red feather without any protection.
“Chi chi chi~”
Even though the temperature of the feather was high, and the hand of Supreme Vast Ancient had turned red with flames burning, his right hand remained perfectly undamaged.
“Good, very good. This is a supreme energy.” Supreme Vast Ancient was incredibly excited, “An energy of fire.”
Xue Ying watched from the side.
He did not cultivate in the Dao of Flames. Previously, the aura coming from the ‘black dagger’ and the ‘fiery-red feather’ were both mysterious and unfathomable, yet Xue Ying understood that they should be related to the Dao of Flames too. It was clear that Supreme Vast Ancient was filled with excitement and joy over it.
Supreme Vast Ancient flipped his hand before placing the fiery-red feather into his bosom. He then smiled at Xue Ying: “Monarch Flying Snow, it is all thanks to you. Otherwise, I would never have been able to enter. Who would have thought that you actually succeeded in getting it.”
“What exactly is going on within the Light Ball Dimension?” Xue Ying asked, “Why is it so strange? I was facing some enemies within. After killing them, they actually rebirthed as if they were illusions! And they seemed incredibly powerful.”
“I can’t say for certain.”
Supreme Vast Ancient chuckled, “But the consciousness, as you know, is the place where our souls cultivate in. And this huge snake is an incredibly terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Its consciousness is more special and unique. It’s just that it had fallen, and its soul had dissipated. Nonetheless, this ‘sea of consciousness’ remains mysterious and profound. Sometimes, they hide some material items. Sometimes, they hide some memory pieces.”
Xue Ying nodded.
“But whenever you acquire any item within the Light Ball Dimension, you would be expelled out of it. And it will be impossible for you to enter the same Light Ball Dimension henceforth.” Supreme Vast Ancient said, “I guess this should be a law set by Yuan to forbid us from taking too many things.”
“Mn.” Xue Ying nodded.
Previously in that dimension, he felt that the most mysterious item was that black dagger. It’s a pity that the difficulty of acquiring it was too high-beyond his current level. After all, that ‘black-armored caped figure’ was directly holding on to the black dagger, and he easily forced Xue Ying out of the Realm Fragment with a strike.
“But Supreme.” Xue Ying continued, “Only after entering did I discover that the dangers I faced within the Light Ball Dimension would merely consume the energy within the Snake-Tooth Bead. You are waiting at the node while I am risking it inside? This would consume the energy of my Snake-Tooth Bead at a much faster pace! Perhaps the energy of my Snake-Tooth Bead would have long been consumed before you even return back. That way, I wouldn’t be able to seek out those places I wish to go. Isn’t this slightly unfair?”
The oath had been sworn.
