Xue Ying had to listen to the orders of Supreme Vast Ancient as long as the other party did not return back. But naturally, it was possible for him to ‘negotiate’ and switch the conditions.
Supreme Vast Ancient was startled. He laughed: “Rest assured. You have already gotten the most important item for me. As long as you succeed in acquiring another two items, you can move freely without caring about me any longer.”
He was very satisfied already with one piece.
If he were to get three pieces… that would be worth celebrating. Furthermore, Supreme Vast Ancient was clear that entering the Light Ball Dimension was not easy since it held suppression on the soul! And getting anything within was even harder. There were even some Light Ball Dimensions that contained just memory pieces.
“Alright.” Xue Ying nodded with a grin. Being granted ‘free will’ after getting three pieces of treasures was also abiding by the ‘orders of Supreme Vast Ancient’.
“Go! Let’s visit the next place.” Supreme Vast Ancient chuckled.
He had already arranged where to visit.
He would be visiting the subsequent places based on importance.
Both parties continued flying along the vascular channel. They passed through many nodes. These intersecting vascular channels would lead to many different Light Ball Dimensions.
Right when the two of them were flying--
“I failed yet again. Damn.”
Accompanied by a relatively furious voice, a green-robed man flew out of a Light Ball Dimension with a cold expression. He came out empty-handed with a disappointed look.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying and Supreme Vast Ancient who were originally flying became stunned. They turned over.
That green-robed man similarly looked up.
Their gazes matched.
“Supreme Vast Ancient, Monarch Flying Snow?” That green-robed man was dumbstruck.
“Great Emperor North River?” Xue Ying was similarly aghast.

chapters.title: Chapter 1266 - Another Side of the Broken Tooth Mountain Range
chapters.content:
Chapter 1266: Another Side of the Broken Tooth Mountain Range
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Even though Great Emperor North River had entered the ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’ for more than 200 billion years, there were many safe zones within the Snake Tooth Corridor too. For instance, the ‘nodes’ were areas where the gale could not reach. Or for instance, within the Light Ball Dimensions, if Xue Ying did not take the initiative of entering a Realm Fragment, he would not suffer from any attacks either. By staying in these safe zones, one would naturally not consume any energy within the supreme artifact (Snake-Tooth Bead or Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet). One could simply cultivate forever here!
‘Supreme Vast Ancient and Monarch Flying Snow? Why would it be so coincidental for me to meet the two of them?’ Great Emperor North River felt his heart trembling. He even thought that Monarch Flying Snow came to take revenge! After all, his act of snatching a supreme artifact like the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet was sufficient in making Great Emperors risk their lives for it.
But then, he felt it was unlikely the case.
For both Supreme Vast Ancient and Monarch Flying Snow to enter, they would have to use up two supreme artifacts! It was unlikely done just simply because of some minor vengeance.
“It is such a coincidence to see Supreme and Monarch Flying Snow here at the Snake Tooth Corridor.” Great Emperor North River revealed a grin. He chuckled, “Monarch Flying Snow, I feel ashamed previously for doing what I did. I had to do it because of the intense desire in me. Furthermore, you also agreed that you would be giving me the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet in the end. I am merely taking it earlier, that’s all. Even though I wiped an avatar of yours, you have many avatars so there was no damage done to you…”
“Hmph.” The expression of Xue Ying sunk as he glared at that Great Emperor North River who currently stood on a vascular channel emitting light.
Great Emperor North River immediately added when he saw that: “I know I was the one that breached the contract. And I understand that Monarch Flying Snow is furious now. How about this, let me offer a gift of apology. I have here a piece of supreme-graded secret treasure which I am willing to offer to Monarch so as to appease your anger.”
Xue Ying did not have the slightest good will towards this Great Emperor North River at all.
In the past, he promised to help the other party merely because he wasn’t willing to see many of the Native Worlds suffering from calamities. Great Emperor North River had already promised him with many benefits for his aid in acquiring the ‘Black Leaf Flower Dew’. In the end, the other party did not give him anything. Instead, Great Emperor North River wiped his avatar out.
Xue Ying had already seen through the other party.
This North River… was simply too ruthless! For the sake of his Dao path, he would not hesitate to do anything.
“Monarch Flying Snow.” Supreme Vast Ancient chuckled by the side, “This North River has bullied you. Now that both of us have met him here, it is destined for us to exterminate him! If you do not oppose it, how about we work together to eliminate him?”
“Supreme!” Great Emperor North River paled. He cried out in alarm, “Supreme, why is there a need to force me to such ends?”
Xue Ying similarly stunned.
Eliminate Great Emperor North River?
The three of them had the energy from the supreme artifact (Snake-Tooth Bead or Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet) protecting them. But this did not mean they were unparalleled! Because this protective energy could only be affected from some environmental changes in this forbidden ground. It could only be used to protect themselves and not be used to attack! If it could be used to attack, Xue Ying would have easily acquired the ‘black dagger’ from the Light Ball Dimension earlier on.
And because these supreme artifacts could not be used for offense, they (Snake-Tooth Bead and Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet) were merely used as a layer of heaven-defying armor!
And even if the defenses of the armor were greater, one would still be bombarded backwards when they suffer from a strike!
That was why they could not stabilize their bodies when they were sucked into the dark maelstrom earlier. Instead, they were engulfed along with the maelstrom into the Snake Tooth Corridor! In other words, the moment Xue Ying, Supreme Vast Ancient, and Great Emperor North River fight, they would be flying uncontrollably around the place. If Supreme Vast Ancient were to fight with Great Emperor North River only, even though Great Emperor North River is disadvantaged, he could still control the outcome of the battle.
But the moment Xue Ying’s soul technique came out, that black protective light cover could not defend him at all! And Great Emperor North River’s strength would be greatly reduced. This gap would increase to that between a ‘god general’ and a ‘Supreme’.
With such a huge gap, he would simply be trampled upon!
He would most likely be struck to the void by the side in one or two moves.
One had to know that they were always flying along the passage. Why? Because most regions outside the channel were open to the fierce gale. It would greatly consume the energy within their supreme artifacts (Snake-Tooth Bead and Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet). Furthermore, this gap in strength was too big. Supreme Vast Ancient could entirely ‘capture’ Great Emperor North River alive before sending him into some dangerous places which would thus consume all energy in his Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet.
And the moment the energy in his supreme artifact is depleted, that would also be the moment Great Emperor North River fall.
“Supreme…” Xue Ying was astonished in his heart. Supreme Vast Ancient had just entered the Snake Tooth Corridor without willing to waste any energy of his. But now, he was willing to use them in dealing with North River?
How would Xue Ying understand.
Supreme Vast Ancient was already displeased with Great Emperor North River for the other party gathered 36 god generals for the sake of competing for resources with the Supreme. Nonetheless, Supreme Vast Ancient could only suppress the other party yet he could not nip in the bud of the problem. This time with the help of Xue Ying, Supreme Vast Ancient was confident of dealing with the Great Emperor North River easily. Secondly, it was also because Supreme Vast Ancient had achieved his goal of acquiring that fiery-red feather. He did not mind about consuming some energy in his Snake-Tooth Bead for his harvest in this expedition into the Snake Tooth Corridor was huge enough. Supreme Vast Ancient also wanted to rely on this opportunity to gain favor from Xue Ying so that Xue Ying would be willing to lend a helping hand to him in the future.
“Monarch Flying Snow, how about it?” Supreme Vast Ancient chuckled.
Xue Ying did not hesitate when he saw that: “Alright, Supreme. Many thanks!”
“Sou sou.”
Supreme Vast Ancient and Great Emperor North River both turned into streams of light at the same time. They charged right at Great Emperor North River.
“Very ruthless, Vast Ancient. You plan on borrowing Monarch Flying Snow’s help to eliminate me.” Great Emperor North River gritted his teeth. He fled in the other direction along the vascular channel.
Even though Supreme Vast Ancient had to bring Xue Ying along, his speed was clearly much faster.
“Sou--”
One chasing after the other!
Even though they were relatively far at the start, the distance between them were shortening rapidly.
“I can’t care less any longer.” Great Emperor North River glanced backwards before rapidly passing through the node of a vascular channel, turning into many side paths before rushing towards the nearest Light Ball Dimension he could reach.
“He is escaping into the Light Ball Dimension?” Xue Ying felt puzzled.
Rushing into a Light Ball Dimension was simply running into a dead-end!
“Mn? Unless…” The eyes of Supreme Vast Ancient squinted.
“Sou sou sou!”
Great Emperor North River did not hesitate to enter that Light Ball Dimension. Xue Ying and Supreme Vast Ancient practically rushed into it almost at the same time. Though at the moment when Xue Ying crossed the border, he was startled: ‘This Light Ball is huge! It seems to be the biggest within the entire sea of consciousness. Nonetheless, it is not producing any suppression at all?’
“Hu.”
After crossing through the membrane wall of the Light Ball, they arrived at another dimension.
And the next reaction Xue Ying had after entering was his eyes widening with his mouth widening unknowingly. Given his current realm, he was still shocked at the scene. This was simply the most startling scene he had ever seen since his birth.
“This, this, this…” Xue Ying was watching in a daze.
Standing at the inner void, he could see the surrounding wall membrane moving in some bizarre rhythm.
Xue Ying could see the whole Broken Tooth Mountain Range beyond the ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’ through these walls! And observing the Broken Tooth Mountain Range from within this Light Ball Dimension was completely different from what he could see in the past.
An incomparably huge meandering snake appeared within his vision.
Here, the Snake Tooth Corridor was also the snakehead! And the body of the snake was faintly appearing, meandering throughout the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range. Those ‘Native Worlds’ were in reality, spatial pockets that had been formed above this enormous snake. And those worlds relied precisely on this enormous snake corpse to exist.
On the other side.
It was that similarly enormous thousand-eyed existence. It had dozens of claws, and many more-numbered beyond a thousand eyes. Its entire corpse seemed complete. Those ‘sky-floating islands’ seemed to be part of this enormous creature’s body. Just like those ‘gray eyes’ and ‘gold eyes’, they were precisely at different locations of this corpse.
Every weird tree had a mysterious eye situated on top of it. In reality, those trees were miniature vascular networks within the enormous corpse.
Given its complete corpse, it was practically impossible to take any of the mysterious eyes away from its corpse, especially when this was such a frightening existence! Many mysterious items in the sky-floating islands would produce a terrifying shockwave the moment one contacted them.
“This… this… the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range is actually formed from the corpses of the two Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.” Xue Ying felt dumbstruck.
Those sky-floating islands existed above the thousand-eyed lifeform.
And those native worlds appeared above the body of that enormous snake.
No wonder he suffered from an incomparable pressure the moment he stepped into any sky-floating islands. Xue Ying could not even execute the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ within. One had to know that he could execute this technique even in the Chaotic Origin Dimension, yet he could not within the sky-floating islands! Clearly, the environment had been suppressed by the remnant force generated by that thousand-eyed lifeform corpse.
“Many experts have been seeking for the rumored corpses from the two most powerful Chaotic Origin Lifeforms here. You cultivators are also seeking for them. But almost nobody knows that the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range is actually condensed out from these two corpses. We have always been on top of these corpses.” Even though this was not the first time witnessing it, Supreme Vast Ancient remained engrossed at the scene.
And not too far away, Great Emperor North River did not care about the scene any longer. He had seen it before, and was instead watching Xue Ying and Supreme Vast Ancient with wariness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1267 - Departure
chapters.content:
Chapter 1267: Departure
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying originally had much puzzling thoughts over the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, for instance, why there were so many ambient dangers within the sky-floating islands-a corrosive gas existed that could instantaneously kill unparalleled existences. That was more dangerous than what fighting against a Great Emperor! Many of such kinds of ambient dangers existed. Regardless, unparalleled existences had the chance of escaping when they fought with ‘Emperors’ from the Death Destruction Clan at least.
Yet the environment was noxious! That felt slightly illogical.
Because ‘Realm Heart Great Land’ had been created by Yuan, and the place was overall quite safe. The Broken Tooth Mountain Range was also supposedly created by ‘Yuan’. Even if it was done for training, why the need to create such noxious environment that was so abnormally strong? It would likely cost a great price to engineer such an environment. In reality, those ambient dangers did not test the cultivators. Instead, it relied on ‘luck’ and experiences.
Like by sending avatars to ‘die’ and accumulate experience.
This would not help with training the cultivators. Then why the need to pay such a huge price in creating these ambient dangers without even serving any purpose?
According to the legends, there were many dangers within the Broken Tooth Mountain Range that were teleported over by ‘Yuan’ from other locations. Regardless, there were various kinds of sayings. But when Xue Ying pondered over it for in detail, he found that there were many contradictions.
‘So it seems.’
‘Everything has been condensed from the two corpses.’ Xue Ying was enlightened, ‘That’s right too. These two Chaotic Origin Lifeforms are tremendously huge. A corpse of theirs is comparable to the size of one-tenth of an ordinary Origin World. And two of such huge corpses could indeed be used to form the huge Broken Tooth Mountain Range.’ Xue Ying nodded.
Just the surface of a corpse was one-tenth of an ordinary Origin World.
In reality, these Chaotic Origin Lifeforms had even longer length. Like that huge snake for instance-this snake was even longer than an Origin World. Its corpse lay meandered, yet it still spread across the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range.
‘But these two corpses should have been prepared by Yuan.’ Xue Ying thought.
Like the Snake Tooth Corridor for instance.
Or the law restriction set between Broken Tooth Mountain Range and Realm Heart Great Land which prevented those of a certain level from entering the Realm Heart Great Land.
The Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet and Snake-Tooth Bead were two supreme artifacts that could only be activated after entering the Snake Tooth Corridor. That should also be a law fixed by Yuan. It was naturally easier for him to fixate such laws on the foundation of the two Chaotic Origin corpses before evolving them into worlds.
“Amazing. What an amazing technique.” Xue Ying said. He finally understood the capabilities of existences like ‘Yuan’ world creation.
“Yuan is naturally formidable. Even I have heard of some legends regarding him. He is ranked at the top of all Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.” Supreme Vast Ancient sighed, “Even I was quite fortunate to awaken to the final level, becoming the Ancestor of my clan. Even though the clan is powerful, the few of us who have awakened are only nascent ancestors. We would most likely have to experience and overcome many more trials and tribulations before we could even reach the level of these two Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Even then, we would still be weaker than ‘Yuan’.”
Xue Ying nodded.
Yuan had left behind two terrifying corpses for the sake of grooming the juniors, creating an entirely new world-the Broken Tooth Mountain Range.
And it was likely that many more Chaotic Origin Lifeforms had died in the hands of ‘Yuan’.
…
As Xue Ying conversed with Supreme Vast Ancient, they temporarily ignored Great Emperor North River.
“Vast Ancient, are you truly thinking of not giving me any routes to walk on?” Great Emperor North River said.
Xue Ying looked at Great Emperor North River, feeling puzzled. This Light Ball Dimension seemed to be a dead-end. Even though there were many strange objects around, there did not seem to be any paths of escape. Unless Great Emperor North River still had some sort of hidden trump card?
“North River, you are too ruthless.” Supreme Vast Ancient said, “Even the five Supremes are merely opponents in your eyes. I admit that the gap between us isn’t that huge. You have even employed the help of 36 God Generals. Most Supremes are merely too lazy to make a big fuss over you, yet you offended Monarch Flying Snow, and that is a huge mistake in itself. Just Monarch Flying Snow alone could influence the outcome of the battle. He is way more useful than a group of God Generals. Today, even two Supremes could not eliminate you easily. But with Monarch Flying Snow around, eliminating you becomes an easy task.”
The expression of Great Emperor North River became colder by a few notches.
That’s right.
He was still confident of escaping even when there were two Supremes around.
But Xue Ying could weaken him greatly-all the way until he reached the level of a God General. And for a God General to battle against a Supreme? That was seeking death!
“I originally thought of focusing on my cultivation before grasping a chance to step into the Supreme Level.” Great Emperor North River growled, “But who would have thought that the two of you came in despite me conserving the energy of my Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. What’s more is for the two of you to come together at once? When did it become so easy to acquire a Supreme Artifact?”
“North River, I merely wanted to comprehend the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet without consuming any energy within. I’ll naturally return it to you once the time comes. I even sworn an oath. Unless you think I would rather choose to cut my path of cultivation and backstab you?” Xue Ying said, “Since you did not plan on giving others a path to walk on, you can only blame yourself for karma!”
“I believe that you will not violate the oath. But once the news regarding the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet spread, even Supremes would get greedy over it. Who knows if something might happen?” Great Emperor North River retorted back.
“Can’t you and I work together to fight back against the Supremes?” Xue Ying replied.
“There might be possible variables emerging once the time frame increases. It is still better for me to get it and enter the Snake Tooth Corridor.” Great Emperor North River sneered.
By the side, Supreme Vast Ancient added: “If you did not backstabbed Flying Snow, you might possibly still get this Supreme Artifact and possibly another in the future.”
“I, North River, am satisfied to acquire one piece of Supreme Artifact while still at the Great Emperor level. I have never thought wistfully of getting another artifact.” Great Emperor North River indifferently replied, “And given the personality of Monarch Flying Snow, I doubt he even liked my personality in the first place. If not for my ambition of wanting to conquer those worlds, and if not for those ants, this Monarch Flying Snow wouldn’t have chosen to help me.”
“Have you made your decision?” Supreme Vast Ancient suddenly said.
Xue Ying felt puzzled.
Decided?
What had he decided on?
“You guys aren’t even giving me a path to retreat, so what choice do I have?” Great Emperor North River sneered, “Hmph, each of you five Great Supremes do not dare to take a gamble. Instead, all of you have been holing up within the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. Alright, let me go. Who knows I might achieve the final awakening one step earlier than all of you.”
Great Emperor North River then turned to Xue Ying with a grin: “Monarch Flying Snow, you are the strongest expert in the Dao of Soul within the history of Realm Heart Great Land and Broken Tooth Mountain Range. After helping me, you did not choose to give me a path of retreat. Haha, that’s fine too since this is my way of doing things. I do not give myself any path to retreat either. Haha, perhaps the next time we meet, I might even be a Chaotic Origin Lifeform, haha…”
The moment he finished speaking, Great Emperor North River directly clashed against a piece of huge black rock by the side.
“Gu dong~”
Ripples formed on the surface of that black rock. When Great Emperor North River clashed against it, he simply tunneled within the rock and disappeared from the place.
“What!” Xue Ying was startled.
Great Emperor North River did not choose to escape. Instead, he fled into this seemingly Light Ball Dimension which did not have any paths.
Supreme Vast Ancient did not act against him after the other party arrived here. And it felt like Great Emperor North River had some kind of reliance.
And now, everything was clear.
So he could escape to a faraway place by relying on this black rock by his side.
“What exactly is this black rock?” Xue Ying asked immediately.
“Come over and extend your senses. You will know about it after that.” Supreme Vast Ancient explained, “This is left behind by Yuan for us. He had also left behind this rock as another path for you cultivators from the Realm Heart Great Land! This is the biggest Light Ball Dimension within the consciousness. We are also able to witness the real side of Broken Tooth Mountain Range. At the same time… there is a path that leads out of the Broken Tooth Mountain Range and also out of the Realm Heart Great Land into a slightly more special territory within the Chaotic Origin Dimension.”
As Supreme Vast Ancient spoke, his eyes were filled with envy and expectations.
Xue Ying had already arrived by the huge black rock. He permeated it with a strand of his consciousness.
“Hong-”
“Since you are unable to progress further, then go and visit other civilizations. Tempering yourself under a different environment with experts of a different civilizations might allow you to grasp that Dao to ‘Eternity’, allowing you to jump out of the cage and the restrictions for many civilizations. By then, you would become a magnificent Chaotic Origin Lifeform.” A grand voice resounded in the consciousness of Xue Ying.
Xue Ying immediately understood it at that moment.
This voice should come from ‘Yuan’. And this should be the final path for those experts in Realm Heart Great Land and Broken Tooth Mountain Range that failed to break through within the ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’.

chapters.title: Chapter 1268 - Memory Fragment
chapters.content:
Chapter 1268: Memory Fragment
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Hong.”
Having permeated the huge black rock with his consciousness, other than hearing the echo from that vast voice, Xue Ying could feel a teleportation passage at the same time.
This was a technique more profound than the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’. Just slightly sensing it and Xue Ying could feel the other end of where this teleportation led to--a region that was incomparably far away! It was too far from the Realm Heart Great Land. Compared to the distance Xue Ying once traveled between his hometown ‘Primal Chaos Void’ and the Realm Heart Great Land, the distance this huge black rock teleported the user to was a few times further!
That civilization was like poles away!
Furthermore, Xue Ying could vaguely feel ‘violence’ and ‘chaos’ over at the other region. Just by slightly extending his senses over and Xue Ying could feel the terrifying law affecting himself through this immense distance. As a result, Xue Ying suffered from a drop in strength.
“Have you felt it?” Supreme Vast Ancient said from the side: “That region is not an ordinary Origin World. It is impossible for an Origin World to influence our strength just by slightly perceiving it at such far distances. Furthermore, reaching our level, it is not useful to send us to other ordinary Origin Worlds for training. I suspect it should be some unique region within the Chaotic Origin Dimension.”
Xue Ying nodded after hearing it.
It felt bizarre indeed.
For a region to influence his strength at such a far distance just by slightly perceiving it, this region was really a frightening one.
“It is so far away from our Realm Heart Great Land such that it is almost impossible for us to return once we leave here. Furthermore, ‘Yuan’ mentioned for us to train ourselves in a different culture and compete with experts of different civilizations.” Supreme Vast Ancient added, “It is likely for us to meet opponents on the same level as us. I have reached the grand perfection Emperor realm yet it might be possible for me to meet a rival?”
“This huge black rock seems to lead us to a bizarre region.”
“And we Supremes aren’t willing to take the last gamble unless we are desperate.” Supreme Vast Ancient said.
Xue Ying nodded.
“Once you are done with my task, you can come and investigate the place further. Let us continue our mission.” Supreme Vast Ancient chuckled.
“Let’s go.” Xue Ying smiled and accompanied the Supreme.
At the point when they were leaving, Xue Ying could not help but look around him once again. He saw the corpses from the two terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that made up Broken Tooth Mountain Range, and then he glanced at that huge black rock once again.
“Sou sou.”
The two of them exited this place.
…
Xue Ying went along with Supreme Vast Ancient and continued traveling along this consciousness region and into many other Light Ball Dimensions.
As Xue Ying accelerated forward in one of the vascular channels, there reached a point that he was forced to slow down.
“Hu hu hu.” A black gale could be heard whistling and blowing on them. Even though this black wind was not as frightening and violent as the black maelstrom located at the entrance of the Snake Tooth Corridor, it was still sufficiently corrosive and rapidly consumed the energy in the Snake-Tooth Bead that Xue Ying brought along. He disregarded the black wind, and instead chose to carry on. Nonetheless, the suppression from the Light Ball Dimension ahead of him was getting heavier endlessly.
The closer he got, the more frightful the pressure was.
“I can’t hold on any longer.”
Xue Ying felt spells of dizziness striking him. His consciousness was starting to blur and waves of pain struck his soul.
“Retreat!”
He could only transformed into a stream of light before rushing backwards. Only after he retreated to a certain distance did he finally feel the rapid weakening of the suppression. Xue Ying became much more relaxed after that.
“You are so close to it! Nonetheless, since even you Monarch Flying Snow can’t enter, who else could?” Supreme Vast Ancient shook his head.
“The suppression is too terrifying.” Xue Ying sighed. He was confident of his soul techniques, but he was still forced to retreat.
“Haha, let’s go to the next one.” Supreme Vast Ancient did not care about it. He continued bringing Xue Ying along.
Those that Supreme Vast Ancient could enter had been attempted long before.
And those dimensions that he was sending Xue Ying to were those that he could not enter currently. Which was why he decided to let Xue Ying attempt it.
…
Yet another Light Ball Dimension.
Even though the suppression coming off from this region was strong, Xue Ying felt delighted once he got closer to the origin of the dimension: ‘It seems to be much easier than the previous one? It is possible for me to enter!’
Indeed as he expected, even though the pressure was immensely huge near the origin of the crack, Xue Ying was still able to enter the Light Ball Dimension right before he reached his limit.
“Good!” Standing afar at a node, Supreme Vast Ancient revealed a joyous look when he saw that.
“Weng.”
Within the Light Ball Dimension.
After Xue Ying entered, he saw many crystalline ‘snowflakes’ floating about. With a glance, he could see that there were more than 100 million of such snowflakes floating within this Light Ball Dimension, causing the entire place to feel dreamy.
“This is?” Xue Ying immediately had his guesses, “”memory fragments?”
He had heard from Supreme Vast Ancient before, that some Light Ball Dimensions contained remnant pieces of memory fragments. These memory fragments within the consciousness were of varying types. And all memory fragments located within a Light Ball would be of the same category.
There were no dangers whatsoever within a memory fragment.
When that terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeform fell, only the imprinted pieces of memory fragments were left behind.
“What is this?” Xue Ying extended his consciousness into one of the floating snowflakes.
At the moment his consciousness touched that snowflake, he felt ringing in his mind.
He ‘saw’ a huge snake. That huge snake was currently laying amidst the grayish Chaotic Origin Dimension. It was furiously hissing out in madness. Clearly, it was angry. At the next moment, this snake whipped its tail out, easily piercing it through trillions of dimensions. It felt as if a trillion incarnations of its tail had been condensed! And these snake tails numbering in the trillions pierced through an equivalent number of dimensions onto a similarly frightening existence.
That existence gave off a grand aura. An unseen force field of law surrounded him and interfered with that strike. Xue Ying could not see the appearance of the other party at all.
And then this memory fragment disappeared.
‘A battle?’ Xue Ying thought, ‘And it seems to be just a single move?’
He could see that this battle was happening in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. The Chaotic Origin Energy that was incredibly corrosive to him was just like air to that snake! A single strike by that snake had struck across so many dimensions! And that expert who was fighting with this snake, did not seem to be any weaker. Even if his strength was not at the standard of ‘Yuan’, it should not be too far away.
After that, Xue Ying continued with other memory fragments.
More than 100 million fragments…
Xue Ying consecutively perused through a hundred memory fragments, only to find out that they were all lashes from that snake tail. It was a technique that easily pierced through a trillion dimensions! This technique seemed to even strike at the enemy in the end.
‘Finally there seems to be a different memory.’ Xue Ying saw another piece of memory fragment. Within that memory fragment, the enormous snake was flying within the vast Primal Chaos Void. Xue Ying could see clearly how big its body was-seemingly longer than even an Origin World. Nonetheless, the area it occupied seemed smaller than an Origin World.
Only after watching through several million memory fragments did Xue Ying finally have an idea what they were.
There were a total of three types of fragments which he just saw. One was a piercing technique executed by the snake tail. Another type was of the snake flying. And the last type was a void-ified scene that formed behind the snake while it was sleeping. Every time it slept, it would completely void-ify its surroundings.
‘Even though there are more than a hundred million memory fragments, I casually chose just a few million memory fragments, and they all belonged to these three categories.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘And it is highly likely for all fragments to be just these three types.’
‘Unquestionably, these three types of memory fragments pertained to the Dao of Void.’ Xue Ying’s eyes brightened.
He was incredibly delighted.
It was normal for one to encounter memory fragments. Supreme Vast Ancient and the others had already experienced them before. But this was the first time Xue Ying encountered memory fragments, and they were actually memory fragments pertaining to the Dao of Void! Xue Ying was naturally excited.
The enormous snake was an innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Those techniques that it executed were all inborn techniques, albeit they had been executed to a certain extent by the enormous snake. Otherwise, it was not qualified to challenge ‘Yuan’. These three techniques gave Xue Ying a newfound direction of what it meant to be for his Dao of Void at the ‘Chaotic Origin level’. Strictly speaking, they were three different directions.
Like the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes>, they enabled Xue Ying to trace the void back to its roots--the Chaotic Origin Energy.
Or the supreme secret impartation that Emperor Summer grasped, <Void Blossom>, that was a life force nurturing technique that did not seem to be any weaker than the Chaotic Origin Energy.
Different directions would determine the energy control one would have.
‘I am still very far away from the Chaotic Origin level.’ Xue Ying was clear of this point. How difficult was it for a level-two Cosmos God to have a breakthrough into the final realm? How many difficulties had he broken through did he finally succeed?
And moving on from the final realm to the Chaotic Origin level…
In reality, that was a fundamental jump from being an Origin World Lifeform into a Chaotic Origin Lifeform! How many world geniuses were stuck at this step? Ever since the emergence of the Realm Heart Great Land, Undying Underworld Emperor, Emperor Summer, Limitless City Master, Ancestor Fan and many others failed to advance into a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Like Xue Ying, his hometown Origin World had never seen anybody become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform either!
This was a step so difficult that it could not be imagined!
One had to have a firm determination and heart. One had to prepare himself and continue prodding forward without wavering.
“Chi.”
Xue Ying stood within this Light Ball Dimension while condensing out another white-robed figure. One man had transformed into two.
‘I should be fine to leave an avatar here since I would not face any danger in this location. Hence, there is no need for this avatar to be protected by the energy of the Snake-Tooth Bead. By allowing this avatar to remain here, I can continue to examine these memory fragments. After which, the avatar carrying the Snake-Tooth Bead will leave this Light Ball Dimension and head to other places.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1269 - An Unstable Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 1269: An Unstable Body
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Outside the Light Ball Dimension.
Xue Ying walked along the vascular channel before arriving before a hopeful Supreme Vast Ancient.
“How was it?” Supreme Vast Ancient asked.
“It’s a dimension filled with memory fragments. There weren’t any treasures at all.” Xue Ying answered.
“Oh.” Supreme Vast Ancient pondered before turning to another region. memory fragments would only be beneficial to those who personally examined them! Under that soul suppression, he could not enter. Hence, this Light Ball Dimension was useless. But he did not care either since ‘memory fragments’ would only be useful when they were related to what he cultivated in. Otherwise, its usefulness could be discarded.
…
The first time Xue Ying entered the consciousness, he acquired that piece of ‘fiery-red feather’. Hence, he thought that it was not that hard to bring a treasure out.
But subsequently, he found he was wrong.
Because there were only several hundred Light Balls within the consciousness! Excluding those that he could not enter and those that had been visited by Supreme Vast Ancient before, there were only 56 Light Ball Dimensions that he could enter. Of these 56 Light Ball Dimensions, only 33 had treasures within! An absolute majority of them contained frightening grandeur that easily swept Xue Ying away. He could not take the treasures away at all.
In the end, it was possible for Xue Ying to take the treasures away in just seven Light Balls, and that was merely a possibility.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying staggered out of a Light Ball Dimension. After landing on the vascular channel, it could be seen that he currently held a piece of black scale.
“You got it?” Supreme Vast Ancient immediately revealed a joyous look when he saw that. He immediately flew over without caring about consuming the energy from his Snake-Tooth Bead.
“I got it in the end after passing through many dangers.” Xue Ying looked at the black scale in his hand with lament. What attracted him most in that Light Ball Dimension was actually a fang. That fang was incredibly sharp, yet the suppression from that fang was too strong, preventing Xue Ying from even getting close to it. It might be possible for an expert on the level of Supreme Vast Ancient to force his way to that item.
As for this black scale, even though it was difficult, Xue Ying succeeded after five tries.
“Good.” As Supreme Vast Ancient took over the black scale, he discovered a deeply submerged destructive energy. At that instance, he revealed a grin and turned to Xue Ying, “Monarch Flying Snow, as mentioned, according to our agreement, you are free to go once you helped me get three pieces of treasures.”
“Initially, I thought it was slightly easy for me to gather three treasures. Who would have thought that after trying so many times, I have consumed more than half the energy in my Snake-Tooth Bead.” Xue Ying helplessly said, “Those who had to return would most likely be forced to go back.”
But he did not plan to return.
He wanted to make full use of the Snake-Tooth Bead until its very last bit of energy.
“Haha, it is all thanks to Monarch Flying Snow this time.” Supreme Vast Ancient was satisfied with his harvest. He continued, “My Snake-Tooth Bead is still filled with plenty of energy and I am planning to visit other places. Do you want to come?”
“No thanks.” Xue Ying answered.
Supreme Vast Ancient nodded: “Then I’ll make my move first.”
“Sou!”
He immediately transformed into a stream of light and left. The entire Snake Tooth Corridor was huge. Even the ‘brain’ of the snake very spacious. Its consciousness region was a slightly more special place, though it was merely a little corner of the entire head. Supreme Vast Ancient soon pierced through the membrane and left the consciousness. He chose to visit other places of the Snake Tooth Corridor.
“Sou.” Xue Ying soon left the consciousness too.
After spending a few breaths later, he crossed through the blood-colored membrane of the consciousness, following along the path which he took to come. His flying speed was much slower than Supreme Vast Ancient’s. He finally arrived at his destination only after three days.
“I am finally here.”
Xue Ying arrived at a towering ‘Snake Tooth’. This snake tooth was pitch black, and it contained many cracks surrounding it.
“Sou!”
He immediately charged up to the peak of the snake tooth.
“Chi chi chi.” Many void cracks appeared. Xue Ying easily evaded them before they appeared at his position. Right when he reached the peak of the black snake tooth, he could easily see how sharp the peak was. Xue Ying could easily imagine what would happen when this snake tooth was used to bite on the enemy-it was likely much more frightening than the simplified Chaotic Origin Weapon he had.
The peak of the towering black snake tooth was so sharp that it felt like an array formed from countless weaving blades. Xue Ying began closely examining it. This tip of the tooth began magnifying under his vision… eventually, it became bigger than even a great land. Xue Ying could clearly see the internal structure of this ‘tip’.
‘Interesting.’ Xue Ying was startled. He frowned, rapidly descending downwards before finding a location near the top right between two intersecting edges.
That was when he began comprehending over the mysteries behind this snake tooth.
******
There were no dangers whatsoever here by the broken void region, and neither would it consume energy from the Snake-Tooth Bead. Hence, Xue Ying could cultivate all he wanted.
One avatar of his remained in the Light Ball Dimension perusing through those memory fragments and comprehending them.
While the other avatar with the Snake-Tooth Bead sat at the peak of the void snake tooth.
In reality, Xue Ying had been attracted the moment he saw the internal structure of the ‘void snake tooth’, at how it was formed by many intersecting blades. Why? Because this structure was seemingly similar to the <Third Level of Chaotic Origin Refined Body> which he deduced. The third level of the Chaotic Origin Refined Body was what Xue Ying planned on relying to perfect his body cultivation.
The ‘preliminary version’ previously was created after the clash of wisdom between he and Emperor Summer. And this preliminary version enabled both he and Emperor Summer to own the strength of ordinary unparalleled existence just solely with their body.
Nonetheless, the ‘preliminary version’ remained too simple and crude. It had many areas that could be improved on.
That was when Xue Ying and Emperor Summer chose to part ways on which path to take!
‘This void snake tooth.’ Xue Ying became engrossed in it.
The internal structure of intersecting blades felt truly mysterious.
Xue Ying was absorbing the essence of it.
Before fusing them with what he already grasped. Finally, the ‘second version’ of the third level of Chaotic Origin Refined Body was formed.
In the blink of an eye.
1.8 billion years since Xue Ying entered the Snake Tooth Corridor.
At the peak of a towering black snake tooth, a white-robed Xue Ying remained seated between two ‘blades’. He revealed a grin: ‘I’ll definitely succeed this time! I shall have a try since it is considered quite perfect in my opinion!’ Xue Ying extended his right hand before starting transforming right from the smallest constituents.
That was also the process of creating a body cultivation technique, to attempt it by using one’s body. During this process, one would frequently cause his body to crumble and dissolve.
But as long as the soul remained fine, the cultivator could easily re-condense the fleshy body with a thought.
“Chi chi chi~” Xue Ying attempted with his right hand, only to see the nails on his right hand becoming sharp like a divine weapon. The skin on his fingers had also become incredibly tough-they were like formed by weaving many blades together, causing great strength and energy to accumulate by his right hand.
‘Not good.’
Xue Ying’s expression changed after he altered his right hand.
His right hand contained a powerful energy, causing his body to suffer from a huge burden. It seemed as if his entire body would collapse should he continue on with the process.
Even by maintaining a ‘powered right hand’, the energy in his body was rapidly consumed.
‘Why would this be? The energy in my body is consumed at such a rapid pace despite just maintaining my transformed right hand?’ Xue Ying felt anxious. Even his fleshy body would collapse after the time taken to brew a cup of tea.
‘I failed.’
Xue Ying shook his head.
Theoretically, it was possible to reach eternal once the fleshy body was perfected. For instance, the energy consumption for the ‘preliminary version’ of the third level of Chaotic Origin Refined Body could be neglected. It was also very stable.
And now, this ‘second version’ which he comprehended felt unstable. Just maintaining his right hand required a huge price.
‘But this is already the most perfected version I comprehended.’ Xue Ying shook his head. He questioned himself, and knew he could not improve it further. But it appeared that the outcome was still far too lacking as compared to what he expected it to be.
‘What about its strength?’ Xue Ying attempted with a hurl.
“Si la---”
The five fingers on his right hand, regardless if they were his nails or skin, perfectly converged the energy from the many intersecting blades. Xue Ying easily clawed out five cracks with them. Looking at it, Xue Ying felt startled. This was after all, the Snake Tooth Corridor. It was amazing for him to produce such an outcome: ‘Even though I haven’t reached the grand perfection level, its power has finally reached the Emperor level.’
Both he and Emperor Summer sought after grand perfection.
Theoretically speaking, reaching grand perfection with the third level Chaotic Origin Refined Body would allow the cultivator to attain at least a half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body! That meant ‘grand perfection Emperor’ strength. The two of them even sought to rely on this and jump out of the cage, becoming a true Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
‘No matter what, I have at least attained the power of an initial Emperor.’ Xue Ying smiled at himself, ‘Becoming a true Chaotic Origin Lifeform is never easy. The journey to becoming a half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform is still immensely far.’
Previously, the ‘preliminary version’ of the Chaotic Origin Refined Body contained the power of a grand perfection King.
And now, even though it was not stable, Xue Ying had at least reached the strength of an initial Emperor. It should be approximately 30% of what he could achieve after using the Chaotic Origin Weapon, Azure River Spear.

chapters.title: Chapter 1270 - Wasn’t it just an avatar?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1270: Wasn’t it just an avatar?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
‘I can’t even stabilise it. It seems that there are too many flaws.’ Xue Ying calmed himself before pondering over the cultivation technique he created. He even left for other towering black snake tooth mountains-a total of eight void snake tooth mountains was present, and void cracks existed around all of them. Just by looking at those cracks would terrify anybody. Xue Ying stopped in midair. He could only see part of the snake tooth mountain, and soon, he faintly understood where the problem lay.
Xue Ying shook his head: ‘The profound mysteries inherent in the black snake tooth are clearly at the Chaotic Origin level. It’s level is much higher than mine. I have been over-engrossed! Nonetheless, the snake tooth is meant to attack. At the peak of the snake tooth mountain, that structure which was weaved from multiple blades, is also used to attack and kill. I want to absorb the essence and fuse them into my body cultivation. Nonetheless, the offensive nature is too strong that it has made stabilizing my body much harder!’
Could an object that was meant for offense purely be stable?
Possible!
For instance, the Chaotic Origin Weapon! Or this void snake tooth! They were items used to attack and could similarly be stabilized for eternity.
But comparatively speaking, stabilizing a hybrid body was simple, yet stabilizing a body filled with offensive nature was much harder.
‘It’s a pity that I do not have other materials to refer to.’ Xue Ying shook his head.
Even though he had perused through the memory fragments.
He merely saw some scenes and could not truly analyze them unlike this snake tooth which he could examine its true structure. Thus, Xue Ying could refer to it and alter his internal body structure.
‘The Chaotic Origin Weapon is based on the Chaotic Origin Sand. It is a dead material.’ Xue Ying shook his head, ‘This snake tooth was at least part of a living being.’
‘I should visit other places.’
Xue Ying memorised the internal structure of the snake tooth and could no longer improve during this short period of time. Hence, there was no meaning to staying here any longer.
“Sou!”
He turned into a stream of light and continued flying along the Snake Tooth Corridor in search for more opportunities.
…
In the following days, Xue Ying scoured through every single part of the Snake Tooth Corridor. He had no choice. Even though he once asked Supreme Vast Ancient for information on the Snake Tooth Corridor, and Supreme Vast Ancient had filled him in on a lot of details, Supreme Vast Ancient merely answered him on matters regarding the ‘Dao of Void’: “Those eight void snake teeth are the most conspicuous. As for other opportunities, I haven’t discovered any that are related to the Dao of Void. Naturally, I do not specialize in the Dao of Void and can’t say for certain even if an item pertaining to the Dao of Void is in front of me. Hence, it is very possible for me to miss them.”
As for the ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’, even though the Snake Tooth Corridor was a rumored forbidden ground, it did not contain any item related to it.
******
In his hometown ‘Primal Chaos Void’, Myriad Ancient Sacred World.
Within a little city.
Xue Ying and Jing Qiu were both seated in a pub by the road. They were both enjoying good food and wine from this pub.
The attendants of the pub were diligently serving the guests, flying within the pub while serving the food and wine.
“Third Brother, have you collected sufficient resources to pay for a teacher?”
“Big Brother, rest assured. I have almost gathered enough. The next time the Fu Tian Sect accepts disciples, I should be able to join it. By then, I must cultivate to the Void God Realm.” By the side, the attendants were relatively free. There were currently two of such attendants conversing with each other.
And given the current realm of Xue Ying and Jing Qiu, they could easily hear what was exchanged between the two True Gods despite it being carried through voice transmissions.
Jing Qiu softly said: “There are still countless sentient beings cultivating in this era diligently. Nonetheless, the entire Primal Chaos Void is constantly expanding and nearing the Great Apocalypse.”
“It is still quite early.” Xue Ying chuckled, “There are still over 10 trillion years.”
“Right. But the moment this era enters an apocalypse, the entire Origin World would disappear. Xue Ying, you could only bring a few away.” Jing Qiu looked at those young attendants who were filled with vitality.
Xue Ying nodded.
It was not an easy task to bring other sentient beings out of this Origin World despite his current realm in the Dao of Void.
He even had to do it a few times just to bring his loved ones and good friends away. Hence, it was destined for only a few minority people to be brought away!
“This era…” Currently, Xue Ying was the strongest expert in both his hometown and in the Realm Heart Great Land. But he still similarly had many matters left undone. For instance, avenging the murderer of Gu Ji--Sacred Master! This ‘Sacred Master’ was the one that resulted in the death of many. Xue Ying would naturally not be willing to let him live.
“But in the next era, the few of us would have to resist against the Supreme Law. We would also enter a deep sleep during the early beginning of the next era.” Xue Ying understood this point, “I might be stronger than Sacred Master, so it is possible for me to enter a slumber for a longer period. There could possibly be new variables during this period.”
It was impossible for one to resist against the Supreme Law within the Origin World.
Even powerful Chaotic Origin experts like ‘Yuan’ and ‘Luo City Lord’ would suffer from the restriction from the law within an Origin World. The strength they could exert was limited too.
“This is the best era to kill him.”
“But that time, we merely injured Sacred Master after working together. More than half his life force was still remaining. Given the strength that I could currently maintain, it is merely at an unparalleled level. I am only slightly stronger than Swordmaster.” Xue Ying was clear that it was impossible to wipe out an ordinary final realm cultivator at that level of strength.
Even if he had many avatars, it could still not be done.
Currently, Sacred Master was hiding in the Lost World Corridor, making it even harder to trace him down. After all, the moment Sacred Master transformed himself into an ordinary Destruction Devil, Xue Ying would not be able to recognize him! He ultimately did not have the capability to ‘seek’ a final realm expert.
“I should wait until I am stronger.”
“That will be when I begin my sweep across the entire Lost World Corridor. No matter what, i must not allow Sacred Master to live until the next era.” A cold glint flashed in the eyes of Xue Ying. Previously, he was not confident. But this latest improvement in his Chaotic Origin Refinement Technique gave him back his confidence. As long as he improved it further, he would be fully confident of wiping Sacred Master out.
…
Within the consciousness located in the forbidden ground ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’, situated at the biggest Light Ball Dimension.
Xue Ying came back here once again. After exploring the corridor, the current energy level in his Snake-Tooth Bead had been consumed until the last bit.
Standing within this Light Ball Dimension, Xue Ying looked at those two enormous corpses covering the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range-that of the enormous snake and the thousand-eyed monster.
“I am already unparalleled in the Realm Heart Great Land and Primal Chaos Void. Even though there are still many Emperors in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range who are stronger than me, they cultivated mainly using their bloodlines. That is useless to me.” Xue Ying shook his head, “But even after cultivating until this level, my Mirage and Illusory Realm hasn’t yet reached the final realm, much less the Chaotic Origin level. I could not even stabilize my level at the ‘initial Emperor realm’ using my Dao of Void, and I am still very far away from reaching the Chaotic Origin level.”
“How difficult is it for me to focus entirely on cultivation and rely on that to break through to the Chaotic Origin level?” Xue Ying lamented.
Perhaps there might be a higher chance by cultivating other Daos and try grasping the source of an Origin World?
Or by spreading religion and utilize the belief of the masses to grasp the source of the Origin World? Nonetheless, it was quite difficult to gain the beliefs of cultivators who by nature, like freedom. Xue Ying felt disdainful of relying on controlling the souls of the cultivators too.
“I should visit other civilizations.”
“I really wonder what kind of region that is for it to make me feel innate fear despite being so far away? And for it to weaken my strength?” Xue Ying came before that huge black rock. Great Emperor North River once entered through this black rock not too long ago! The five Great Supremes had come here before, though they could sense how dangerous it was, and would definitely not make this decision of entering so easily.
Xue Ying was too young.
Even if he did not go out on adventuring, it was possible for him to reach the Chaotic Origin level given his current cultivation speed.
But…
“Isn’t it just an avatar?”
Xue Ying did not care about an avatar since he had so many of them!
“Go, let’s go and have a look.” Xue Ying was filled with curiosity. He immediately went on to touch that huge black rock with his body, causing his entire figure to fall and be absorbed into it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1271 - Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 1271: Arrival
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Sou!”
Xue Ying felt his entire body being swept along into a blood bubble. Following that, he was pushed along with the bubble through the vast Chaotic Origin Dimension.
‘This is too quick!’ Xue Ying looked around him. He could see the outer world through the ‘bubble’. But everything was blurry. Even a huge ‘Origin World’ had disappeared instantaneously from his vision. He could not discern the shape of that Origin World before he was gone. And then, it was “shua shua shua…”
Many Origin Worlds flashed by.
Xue Ying even saw the occasional gigantic Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. He could barely differentiate their silhouette before those lifeforms disappeared from his vision.
‘Who is that? Who could travel through the Chaotic Origin Dimension with such expertise?’ A huge multi-headed monster watched as a line of crack tore through along a direction with his hundreds of eyes. He could not help but mumble inwardly, ‘What a terrifying Chaotic Origin expert. Even though I believe he is filled with disdain for me, it is better if I hide myself further away.’ This multi-headed monster immediately teleported towards another direction.
…
It was much quicker than when Xue Ying arrived at the Realm Heart Great Land using the Realm Heart Order. It was also much faster than when he executed the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.
The ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ was a technique where he stealthily constructed a narrow gap through the concentrated Chaotic Origin Energy. And now, this blood bubble was instead charging through it! The Chaotic Origin Energy could not interfere with the bubble at all. Even those high-leveled ‘Chaotic Origin Lifeforms’ could barely see a shadow of figure before it disappeared from their senses.
That was how quick.
This blood bubble engulfed Xue Ying along by more than 300 Origin Worlds. Xue Ying had memorized every single Origin World that he passed by, albeit not in detail.
“Hong long long~”
Suddenly, a huge golden world could be seen appearing in his vision.
That golden world currently emitted countless golden lightning that clashed with the ‘Chaotic Origin Energy’ in the Chaotic Origin Dimension! This startled Xue Ying and made him puzzled: ‘How could this be? Most Origin Worlds I see co-exist perfectly in the Chaotic Origin Dimension! The fluctuations released by the Origin Worlds would repel the Chaotic Origin Energy, preventing both energy from interacting. Why would the energy of this world have such a huge opposing force with the Chaotic Origin Dimension instead?’
He was still puzzled over what he just saw when the blood bubble pulled Xue Ying along into that golden lightning world.
Too quick!
The blood bubble arced through the Chaotic Origin Dimension and left behind a blood shadow. Even though this golden lightning world was incredibly violent, forking out lightning that clashed against the surrounding Chaotic Origin Dimension, it could not shake this ‘blood bubble’ at all. This blood bubble charged through all incoming shockwaves and lightning before entering the ‘golden lightning’ world.
“Mn? What is happening?”
“Who has entered our world?”
“Sou, sou, sou.”
As Xue Ying forced his way into the world under the protection from the blood bubble, three figures soon appeared from within the golden lightning world. They were all emitting aura that a Chaotic Origin expert had-it was vast and pressing down on all directions. It even made the surrounding golden thunder and Chaotic Origin Energy much docile.
The three of them carefully looked around them. They utilized all kinds of tracing and time reversal techniques.
“There is nothing?”
“We had clearly sensed an external item charging into our world! How could we discover nothing at all? The previous time, we discovered something similar yet to no avail.”
“This is puzzling.”
After the three discussed with one another, they concluded that they could not do anything about it, and could only temporarily retreat.
******
“Peng peng peng.” Xue Ying was located within the blood bubble. He felt that wild golden lightning striking down against this blood bubble, causing Xue Ying to feel the threat of death. But everything had been resisted by this blood bubble.
‘Such wild violent energy. The world which I sensed in the past within the Light Ball Dimension inside the Snake Tooth Corridor should be this world.’ Xue Ying determined.
“Hu--”
The blood bubble had already rushed into the golden lightning world. With a flash, it vanished into thin air.
‘This speed.’
Xue Ying currently stood amidst the wilderness revealing a bitter smile.
He had clearly sensed himself penetrating into the golden lightning world when he found himself arriving on this wilderness already! As its speed was too fast, Xue Ying did not have sufficient time to see what just happened! That was normal too. Even a huge object like an Origin World had been flitted by given the speed of travel by the blood bubble. It was so fast Xue Ying could not even perceive the Origin World clearly.
‘If I activate it, I can head on to the next world?’ Xue Ying looked down at the wristband around his hand. A blood imprint appeared, and after transmitting the message, it disappeared.
The energy inside the blood bubble could be activated two more times.
And every time he activated it, Xue Ying would be sent to another world.
Three worlds with different civilizations…
This was an opportunity that ‘Yuan’ presented to those who reached deep in the consciousness within the Snake Tooth Corridor.
‘Great Emperor North River should have come to this world too.’ Suddenly, the expression of Xue Ying changed. He could feel every part of his body changing as if a skyscraper falling apart.
‘Why would this be? Why would my body be…’
Xue Ying started panicking.
His entire body was collapsing apart.
And it was happening right from the smallest constituents-the particles.
Not just this, Xue Ying felt his senses of the surrounding void becoming blurred. Being an ‘final realm Dao of Void’ expert, his control of the void was incredibly powerful. Nonetheless, the ‘space’ in this world did not seem to listen to him. The majority of the profound mysteries of the Dao of Void he controlled did not seem to be useful within the space of this world.
‘Void-ification?’
Xue Ying attempted to void-ify his body. The surrounding void became slightly warped, yet his body remained the same and was still collapsing apart.
‘How could this happen? Why would my control of the Dao of Void at the final realm be useless here?’
‘The lower-levelled laws would be different in different Origin World. Nonetheless, the ‘Dao’ at the Cosmos God level should be universal.’ Xue Ying suddenly became distracted, ‘But if I were to enter a region that isn’t an Origin World?’
Judging from how he was teleported in…
That golden lightning world was constantly forking out into the Chaotic Origin Dimension. It was incredibly violent and wild, and both energy could not co-exist perfectly together.
‘And this great land.’ Xue Ying looked downwards. He extended his hands and lightly touched it-the soil and stone were heavy. Xue Ying could even feel a trace of concentrated Chaotic Origin Energy in them! It was as if every grit of soil and stone had been condensed from Chaotic Origin Energy, and they were all incredibly heavy. Ordinary True Gods could not even pick up a stone the size of a fist! Its gravitational energy was exaggeratedly strong too.
The entire world emitted the wild aura of ‘chaos’ and violence’. Its laws were geared more towards those aspects too.
‘This shouldn’t be an Origin World.’
‘An Origin World is a haven that nurtures the myriad existences. How could it possibly contain such wild untamed energy?’ Xue Ying thought.
‘I understand now.’
‘The Dao at the Cosmos God level is only universal across many Origin Worlds. But this isn’t an Origin World. Even my Dao of Void has been greatly impacted.’ Xue Ying understood this point, ‘And the ‘Chaotic Origin Refined Body’ that I created according to the Dao of Void should be inharmonious with the essence of this place, causing it to collapse as a result?’
Even though his body was collapsing, Xue Ying had ultimately calmed himself down sufficiently because he discovered a piece of good news amidst the bad ones!
‘It seems my Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm isn’t influenced at all?’ Xue Ying was pleasantly surprised.
The Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm was also a Dao of Soul.
It targeted the soul!
And the soul…
Should be fundamental regardless of which Origin World or this world that he currently entered. Hence, the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm could be executed no matter where he went.
‘But my body.’
Xue Ying became slightly flustered. His body was collapsing apart from its constituents. Unless he had to rely on his ‘soul’ to travel around?
‘I just attempted to control the Dao of Void. Other than failing many times, I found out that some profound mysteries is still applicable?’ Xue Ying rapidly deduced. His soul was exceptionally strong. Even after coming to this world, he could still link and synchronize his memories with his avatars located in the Realm Heart Great Land and Primal Chaos Void! For a moment, all his avatars were focusing on finding out how he should get out of his current situation.
He had to resolve his predicament as fast as possible!
At least he had to maintain his fleshy body!
…
Just as Xue Ying was seated cross-legged on the wilderness doing his utmost to slow down the crumble of his body and deducing the newer profound mysteries… the unstable ripples emitted by his body actually attracted an uninvited guest.
“Sou!” To the distance, a black light shot out from beyond the horizons right at Xue Ying.
Xue Ying looked upwards.
That was a bird covered entirely in black feathers. It had a pair of fierce jade green eyes, and its wings spanned several thousand meters. Currently, this bird had treated Xue Ying as its food and was charging down at him!

chapters.title: Chapter 1272 - Ascendant?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1272: Ascendant?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As this bird threw itself down, its pair of wings formed a gale filled with wind blades. It cut through the sky with a whistle, slicing down against the region where Xue Ying sat. Around Xue Ying appeared a black flower. This black flower folded up and protected Xue Ying. Those wind blades sliced down on the black flower, causing the flower to shake as if it was going to collapse.
Xue Ying felt an alarming joy: ‘What an amazing lifeform. Even though I did not spend much energy to ‘transform illusion into reality’ with my Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, these techniques still hold the power of ordinary Cosmos Gods. Nonetheless, the wind blades generated by this bird with its wings are already this powerful and could easily reach the strength of a level-two Cosmos God?’
The killing technique of turning illusion into reality.
He researched this technique while he was still at the Primal Chaos Realm. After he stepped into the Cosmos God Realm in his Dao of Void, Xue Ying no longer research on this type of technique since it would only reach the limit of level-two Cosmos God at most. After all, techniques created using the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm were not good in direct combat. If he chose to further improve this technique, it would be a waste of time.
‘I finally met a living being in this world.’ Xue Ying felt joy.
“Weng!”
With a thought.
The Mirage and Illusory Realm engulfed that bird. That bird was originally wild and violent. Following which, its eyes turned dim and its body slammed onto the ground powerlessly. This impact caused innumerable sandstones to fly upwards—which was quite incredible given their weight.
‘Seems weird.’ Xue Ying frowned slightly. He had only pulled the consciousness of this bird into an illusion, yet evidently, its consciousness was only slightly stronger than a wild beast. It had once met some ‘humanoid’ experts, and some had been eaten by it even! It had even perceived some existence that was so strong that it felt an innate sense of danger. When that occurred, it immediately escaped further away.
In the memory of the long life the bird had, Xue Ying did not gather much useful information. There had been cases of humans injured by it. Some were even devoured voraciously. Before that, Xue Ying was able to procure memories of those humans drinking and chatting happily. Adding up, he was only able to gather several thousand sentences of words. Xue Ying rapidly deduced the language used by the natives of this world from thus.
And the information he could infer from these several thousand words was quite pitiful.
‘It really knows very little.’
‘Whatever. I shall just let it go.’ With a thought, Xue Ying released the consciousness of this bird. It was simply too easy for an expert like Xue Ying in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm to influence this wild animal.
That savage bird soon regained its consciousness. It woke up groggily. Finding that it was sprawled on the ground, as it looked around, it spotted Xue Ying. It was at this moment as if it had seen something terrifying. That bird immediately flapped its wings and left this place, disappearing in the horizons.
Xue Ying watched silently: ‘Somehow, I did not see any human experts in the memory of this savage bird that could teleport? Is it difficult for one to teleport in this world?’
He was a Dao of Void expert. Teleportation was like an innate ability for him. Yet currently, most of the profound mysteries in the Dao of Void he comprehended were inharmonious with this world. Even his Chaotic Origin Refined Body was collapsing apart.
‘I shall not think anymore.’
‘I should focus first on stabilizing this fleshy body of mine.’
Xue Ying went back to his task of stabilizing his body.
His other avatars located in the Realm Heart Great Land and Primal Chaos Void were similarly focusing on getting him out of this predicament, and they had found a direction to work towards! Even though much of the ‘profound mysteries at the final realm of the Dao of Void’ had been inharmonious in this world, some were still useful. The current method Xue Ying thought of… was to base these workable laws and profound mysteries to deduce out a different set of laws that were compatible in this world.
Furthermore, he had to alter the ‘Chaotic Origin Refined Body’ and simplify it further.
That way, it would reduce the conflict it had with this world!
If he re-created his fleshy body by using a cultivation technique that was completely aligned to the laws and profound mysteries of this world, there would no longer be any conflict. Nonetheless, his body would be too weak! Hence, he had to seek a balance between ‘strength’ and ‘balance’.
And this required time!
…
A huge ship was currently flying amidst the clouds. This ship was luxurious, and there were many soldiers standing on the deck guarding the ship.
There was also a pair of young and beautiful girls standing on the main deck. They were currently holding on to the railings and looking down on the vast earth. A beautiful and glistening lake could be seen far away. Glancing over, many huge ‘wild beasts’ could be seen drinking water from the lake.
“The scenery of the Great Wilderness is really beautiful.” A girl in light blue robe laughed. Looking down at the Great Wilderness lighted up by the sun, “I truly wish to follow the footsteps of my big brother, wandering by myself in the Great Wilderness.”
“Young lady, the Great Wilderness is incredibly dangerous.” A green-robed female attendant replied, “There are very few tribes living in this Great Wilderness, and all of them are having a hard time surviving here. After all, they have to fight back against the wild beasts! It is still fine if young lady brings a large group of protectors along. But wandering in the Great Wilderness alone? You should at least have the strength of a God Monarch. Crown Prince is currently a peak God Monarch already.”
“Xi’er, so what you are saying is that my strength is insufficient?” The girl in light blue snorted at the female attendant.
“Young lady’s bloodline is noble. Young lady is also being tutored personally by the City Masters. It is naturally easy for young lady to reach the God Monarch realm. As for now? This attendant feels that young lady is still lacking by a bit.” The green-robed attendant giggled.
“You are becoming more and more undisciplined to dare tease against the young lady you are serving.” The girl in light blue coldly snorted. But after a while, she smiled. She had known this attendant for far too long. Ever since they were young, they had lived together and were like blood-siblings. She naturally did not mind the other party teasing her.
The light-blue-robed girl went back to enjoying the beautiful scenery of the Great Wilderness.
With a ship full of experts, those wild beasts in the Great Wilderness dared not offend them.
“Mn?” The eyes of the girl in light blue brightened suddenly. She immediately pointed out, “Hurry up and look over! There is someone there.”
“Yi?” The attendant was similarly startled, “There is really someone there?”
…
Xue Ying was seated cross-legged in the Great Wilderness. He also noticed that huge ship flying over currently. The ship was grand and large, and no ‘savage birds’ or other wild beasts dared to attack it.
‘I’ve spent half a day deducing out the laws. I could at least maintain my fleshy body at a strength of a final realm cultivator.’ Xue Ying felt slightly helpless. He relied on the laws and profound mysteries that did not suffer from any conflict with this world as foundation to construct a simplified ‘Chaotic Origin Refined Body’ cultivation technique! Even though it was greatly simplified, it still contained much profound mysteries that were in conflict with the laws of this world.
Otherwise, it was impossible for Xue Ying to deduce a sufficiently powerful body refinement technique just by relying on those profound mysteries.
As for a weaker version? Xue Ying felt disdainful of it.
‘Currently, I could at least keep my body stable.’
‘Even though part of my body is constantly crumbling apart, my body is also constantly recovering at a faster rate.’ Xue Ying thought. His body was constantly being ‘injured’ and ‘recovering’ at the same time. Naturally, since the rate of recovery was faster, he could maintain a form of stability!
And at least his fleshy body could maintain a strength at the final realm.
One had to know that the previous preliminary version of the third level Chaotic Origin Refined Body was at the unparalleled level! He even came out with the second version that reached the initial Emperor level.
And now, he fell back to the boundary of final realm level! He even had to constantly suppress his injuries.
‘I guess from now on, I would have to make use of the time to regain my strength.’ Xue Ying thought.
“Hu—”
That huge ship flew over to Xue Ying. At the head of the ship, that girl in light blue looked curiously at Xue Ying. A cold and strict-looking old man appeared by her side. This old man said: “Third Lady, do be careful. Those who dare to adventure in the Great Wilderness are often lawless. It is best for Third Lady to maintain a distance with him.”
“Housekeeper Yun, what is happening with him? Why do I find that something is wrong with him?” The girl replied with a question.
This old man stood at the head of the ship. Suddenly, a third eye opened up by his forehead. This third eye emitted a faint jade light that surveyed that man. With a glance, the old man sneered: “This man is barely at the God Monarch level, though the injuries on his body are serious. He is currently doing his best to recover. An initial God Monarch dares to roam in the Great Wilderness? Hmph hmph, he is truly seeking death.”
“He is injured. Let us help him. It is possible for a powerful beast to attack him anytime in the Great Wilderness.” That girl in light blue added.
“Third Lady is too benevolent.” The old man shook his head, “Such person who has unknown origins, or is it—yi?”
That old man suddenly revealed a look of astonishment.
“What happened?”
“Housekeeper Yun?”
Several commanders by the side all turned to Housekeeper Yun. Housekeeper Yun was the true leader of this team on the ship. Naturally, the nominal commander was still the Third Lady.
The third eye located in the forehead of that old man was constantly flashing out jade light. It thoroughly looked down at Xue Ying: “He actually hasn’t condensed a God Heart? Without condensing a God Heart, he could actually cultivate to the God Monarch realm. Judging from this, he should be a body cultivator. But to reach this stage by relying on his fleshy body? Furthermore, I do not sense any aura of bloodline on him. He should not be a native from the Divine Realm. I can only conclude that he should be an Ascendant from the lower realm!”
“It’s an Ascendant?”
“Hearsay there are many lower realms, yet few could reach our Divine Realm.”
At that moment, everyone began discussing about this newfound conclusion.
There were very few Ascendants in the Divine Realm.
“An Ascendant who hasn’t condensed a God Heart has reached the God Monarch Realm just by cultivating his body.” The cold and strict-looking old man looked at Xue Ying, revealing a smile, “Third Lady, this old servant feels that what Third Lady said is logical. It is worth helping such an expert.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1273 - Chaotic Origin Ancestral God
chapters.content:
Chapter 1273: Chaotic Origin Ancestral God
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying sat cross-legged in the wilderness. Looking up, he saw that huge towering ship. The ship had two flags stuck to it with two different characters imprinted on each of the flag. Even though Xue Ying only knew some speech characters here and did not know how to write, he understood the underlying meaning of the two characters on the two flags with a glance.
Clearly, the way characters were inscribed would be filled with their profoundness once a particular realm is attained.
And the meaning of the characters on one flag was ‘High Mountains’, while the two characters on the other flag represented the meaning of ‘Imperial Wind’.
“What a strange way of scouting.” On that huge ship, the cold and strict-looking old man opened a third eye on his forehead. When that jade green eye of his looked downwards, Xue Ying had a feeling of being seen through. Naturally, his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm was completely unaffected. If Xue Ying wanted to, he could conceal his strength. Nonetheless, he still chose to reveal part of it.
It was acceptable for him to hide his soul strength while revealing the degree of power his body had. Because the body of the wild beast he encountered as well as those of the protectors and the cold old man seemed strong. For instance, that cold and strict-looking old man’s fleshy body gave off an aura that was above his!
“Hu!”
At the next moment, six figures flew down from the ship in the air with that cold old man leading the officers.
This cold old man stared at Xue Ying, lightly chuckling out: “The few of us are from the High Mountain Imperial Wind Clan. Seeing that you are alone in this Great Wilderness seemingly injured, my clan’s young lady chose to help you and bring you along. Are you willing to head to the High Mountain City with us?”
“I am currently in dire straits and am fortunate to reach where I am now. Naturally, I am willing to follow you all.” Xue Ying had already stood up.
He needed a quiet and safe place to meditate and regain his strength.
