On another aspect, Xue Ying wanted to mix around with the experts of this world so as to understand this world better.
“What are you called? Where are you from?” The cold old man asked.
“This one is called Flying Snow. I do not have any home and have always been wandering alone.” Xue Ying politely answered.
The cold old man nodded slightly: “That’s right too. The hometown you ascended from should be from a particular space from the lower realms. Flying Snow, you can call me Housekeeper Yun. Now then, come with us.”
Saying that, the old man brought along the five officers up back to the huge ship.
Xue Ying immediately followed after.
After flying onto the ship.
“I am Imperial Wind Qing Yin.” A girl in light blue robe came over with curiosity as she stared at Xue Ying. She chuckled, “I’ve heard from Housekeeper Yun that you are an Ascendant?”
Xue Ying smiled.
Ascendant?
What was that?
Housekeeper Yun had also previously mentioned this term Ascendant, yet Xue Ying was clueless about that. Now when this girl who clearly had a high status asked him about that, Xue Ying could only smile back.
“This is also our Third Lady.” Housekeeper Yun’s cold eyes looked at Xue Ying and continued, “It is also on the orders of our Third Lady that we came to save and bring you along with us.”
“Flying Snow thanks Third Lady for saving me.” Xue Ying immediately thanked.
“It’s just a minor matter.” This Third Lady ‘Imperial Wind Qing Yin’ continued with another question: “Hearsay the hometown of you Ascendants are completely different from our Divine Realm. Could you tell me more about that? I have always been curious about this, yet it’s a pity that I am unable to descend to the Lower Realm.”
“Cough cough cough.” Xue Ying suddenly coughed a few times. His face turned red, and a strand of blood trickled down from the edge of his mouth.
He could only feign his injuries!
He did not dare to reply! After all, Xue Ying was clueless about what being an Ascendant was. He was completely clueless about the entire Divine Realm. If he casually replied and revealed his identity, who knew what might happen? The origin of this team did not seem small. Perhaps they might have ways of contacting with their clan. If Xue Ying revealed his identity, the other party might knew about that instantly. And once things became huge, it would no longer be beneficial for him.
Hence, it was better for Xue Ying to remain low-profile and assimilate into this world.
“You are injured? Do you require our help?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin hurriedly looked towards Housekeeper Yun, “Housekeeper Yun, could you have a look and see if there is anything you could do to help heal his injuries?”
“His injuries are quite special. I can’t determine what is happening. I only know that his body is suppressing the injuries, yet he remains injured.” Housekeeper Yun shook his head.
“It’s nothing big. Previously, I haven’t been able to concentrate on healing my body. Only when I am in a safe place could I spend more time and effort to healing my body.” Xue Ying added.
Powerful cultivators usually had strong life force and were tenacious. Since Xue Ying mentioned that he was confident of healing himself, others naturally believed him.
“Mn, then you should be careful.” Third Lady ‘Imperial Wind Qing Yin’ reminded him, “Housekeeper Yun, hurry up and bring him to a safe place to rest so that he can recover properly.”
“Alright, Third Lady.” Housekeeper Yun acknowledged.
…
“Zhi ya.
Within an unremarkable cabin, Housekeeper Yun pushed open the door. He nonchalantly said: “You can stay in this cabin. Also, the personality of our Third Lady is kindhearted. She is unlike you Ascendants who have climbed up step by step and are all cunning and ambitious. You better not scheme behind the back of Third Lady. Perhaps you might deceive our Third Lady, but it is impossible for you to deceive me. And those who dare to deceive our High Mountain Imperial Wind Clan will die a terrible death, do you understand?”
“Housekeeper Yun, please be rest assured. I owe Third Lady a favor for saving me. Why would I turn gratitude into enmity?” Xue Ying answered.
“Hmph, there are so many cases of gratitude turn enmity. I’ve already mentioned what I should. It is best you remember them in your heart.” Housekeeper Yun gave Xue Ying a final glance with his cold eyes before leaving.
He shut the door close.
Only then did Xue Ying let out a sigh of relief.
He had just entered this world, and this was his weakest and most ignorant period! Xue Ying was afraid he might reveal himself, inciting a wave of enemies that would only spiral into a greater calamity for him!
‘How could this place be normal! This is the location that Yuan has chosen to send those who could enter the forbidden ground, ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’ and have chosen to take the final gamble of cultivation.’ Xue Ying shook his head, ‘It should be a place that could threaten even the ‘Supremes’ that have reached grand perfection Emperor realm right?’
Hence, it was better for him to remain low-profile when he just entered this place.
…
Xue Ying did not search the memories of others on the ship to prevent raising any suspicions.
He only relied on the ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm’ and other techniques to gain the good will of others, deliberately attracting some people to share more stories with him. Gradually, Xue Ying understood more and more. He also found out more about what ‘Ascendants’ were.
‘So it seems.’ Xue Ying finally understood, ‘This is the Divine Realm? And there are many lower-graded spaces that are termed as the Lower Realm by them? And only those who are the strongest could possibly ascend into the Divine Realm?’
“Brother Flying Snow.”
The person by the side who was currently chatting with Xue Ying was a protector who stood guard by the railings. The protectors were usually free and bored. He laughed, “I previously have only heard of Ascendants only. You are still the first Ascendant I ever met! In the legends, even though there were quite a few Ascendants who entered our Divine Realm, they are all scattered in the realm and naturally, it is hard to encounter any of them. In addition, even if you stand before me, I would not be able to recognize you! This time, it is because of Housekeeper Yun. Housekeeper Yun’s ‘Jade Light God Eye’ was able to determine that Brother Flying Snow has no bloodline from any Chaotic Origin Ancestral God. That was how he ascertained that you are an Ascendant.”
“It is also thanks to Housekeeper Yun that I could come up to this ship.” Xue Ying chuckled. He also etched down the words ‘bloodline from the Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods’.
Those who did not have any bloodline from a Chaotic Origin Ancestral God were determined to be Ascendants?
Then all the people in this Divine Realm would have a bloodline from a Chaotic Origin Ancestral God?
This Chaotic Origin Ancestral God should be a Chaotic Origin Lifeform? Was he alive or dead?
If he was a living powerful Chaotic Origin Lifeform in this world, that would be quite terrifying!
“You have to thank Third Lady. It is all thanks to Third Lady. Third Lady is really a good person. She chose to help you.” That protector added, “If not for Third Lady’s suggestion, why would Housekeeper Yun spend his energy to observe you with his god eye?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1274 - Within High Mountain City
chapters.content:
Chapter 1274: Within High Mountain City
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The Divine Realm was vast.
Currently, a huge ship was flying amidst the clouds. According to what Xue Ying found out, it would take two more months before they arrived at the High Mountain City.
Xue Ying spent his days on the ship deducing out the laws for the Dao of Void of this world. He was gradually altering his Chaotic Origin Body Refining Technique, reducing the severity of damage his body was suffering. At the same time, Xue Ying was also dealing with this Third Lady ‘Imperial Wind Qing Yin’
“What happened to that person called Xiang Pang Yun? He did not kill your little brother in the end right?” Within a cabin on the huge ship, Imperial Wind Qing Yin was currently seated next to Xue Ying. She nervously asked Xue Ying about the aftermath.
“During the most dangerous and critical moment, I was fortunate to have a breakthrough, giving me the strength to kill Xiang Pang Yun in the end.” Xue Ying chuckled. Reminiscing about that scene when he was young made Xue Ying lament about it. Just that his parents and little brother were no longer around now. Even though Xue Ying could re-create their lives using the ‘Mirage Cosmos’, was there any point in doing that?
“Hu.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin let out a sigh of relief: “That’s good. I could feel myself panicking from hearing that.”
“Third Lady, since this Flying Snow could ascend into the Divine Realm, he is definitely an amazing character in the Lower Realm. Those who dare to be his enemies would definitely end up badly.” Housekeeper Yun chuckled by the side.
“That’s true too.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin nodded. nodded.
Suddenly, Imperial Wind Qing Yin said: “Oh right, God Monarch Flying Snow, what are you plans now?”
“As I mentioned before, I do not have any home in the Divine Realm and has always been wandering around.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“Why not stay behind in our High Mountain City?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin added, “The Great Wilderness is incredibly dangerous. It is safer to stay in the city.”
“I do have the intention to stay in the city and cultivate for a period. After encountering a crisis, I realize that my strength is still inadequate.” Xue Ying nodded.
“As an early stage God Monarch, you still dare to wander into the Great Wilderness.” Housekeeper Yun sneered from the side.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin disregarded it and continued: “It is good that God Monarch Flying Snow has the intention to cultivate within the city. Oh right, God Monarch Flying Snow, what is your original strength?”
“It should be roughly at the middle stage god Monarch Realm.” Xue Ying answered, “It is only because of my serious injuries which I haven’t recovered from that resulted in my current weakened state. I believe I should be able to regain my full strength in one and a half years.”
During these days, his body cultivation technique was gradually being altered, reducing the severity of his injuries and allowing his body to become stronger.
“Oh?”
Housekeeper Yun was astonished in his heart.
Middle stage god Monarch Realm?
Ascendants truly cultivated step by step since they were weak. They did not even have any assistance from a Chaotic Origin Ancestral God bloodline! Hence, Ascendants were usually stronger by an entire level than the natives of the Divine Realm at the same realm. If this God Monarch Flying Snow fully recovered his strength, regaining his middle stage god Monarch Realm, he would most likely be comparable to he, Housekeeper Yun.
After all, he was merely a late stage God Monarch, albeit with the magical ability ‘Jade Light God Eye’! Hence, he was stronger than ordinary late stage God Monarchs.
“Good.”
Imperial Wind Qing Yin immediately revealed a joyous look, “You are an Ascendant at the middle stage God Monarch Realm. I’ll definitely be able to convince my father and big brother. By then, God Monarch Flying Snow could simply take up a position with no obligations as a ‘Cultivation Mentor’. A Cultivation Mentor has no dangerous missions to undertake. Furthermore, you would be bestowed with some good benefits too. You are also qualified to enter the ‘Scripture Library’ to peruse some cultivation materials we have. If God Monarch Flying Snow is willing, you could even exchange for more benefits using contribution points.”
Xue Ying felt his heart getting moved.
Scripture Library?
What was the most direct way of researching the laws of a world?
Definitely by taking reference to cultivation techniques of other experts! Other experts had already summarized their cultivation path. As long as Xue Ying had a look, it would definitely make grasping the laws of this world much easier.
“Do you have scriptures for Ascendant?” Xue Ying asked.
When Imperial Wind Qing Yin heard the question, she became delighted. She smiled so brightly that even her eyes had become crescents: “The cultivation scriptures for Ascendants are really rare. But our High Mountain Imperial Wind Clan do store some of them.”
“Then Flying Snow will have to thicken my face.” Xue Ying gratefully replied, “Many thanks Third Lady.”
“Don’t be overly happy still. Not everyone is qualified to be a Cultivation Mentor.” Housekeeper Yun nonchalantly said, “You will still have to get the approval of Master and Young Master.”
Imperial Wind Qing Yin was confident about it: “Rest assured. Father and Big Brother will definitely agree to it.”
Housekeeper Yun felt helpless when he saw that.
And Xue Ying merely laughed in response.
He had lived with this Third Lady for just a month. Yet during this period, he could sense that the Third Lady was genuinely kind-hearted. She had treated Xue Ying really well and considered Xue Ying’s well-being before doing anything. No wonder Housekeeper Yun threatened himself not to ‘scheme against the Third Lady’.
‘No matter what, I have just arrived in this world. This grace I gained from Third Lady could only be repaid in the future.’ Xue Ying thought. Regardless, he planned on staying within the High Mountain City for a period! After all, he just needed to find a safe place. No matter where it was, Xue Ying could research into the laws of the world.
…
There were a total of several hundred people on this ship, including the officers, soldiers, protectors and servants.
With Xue Ying’s attainments in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, he had easily increased his ‘charm’, increasing the goodwill of others towards him. But this could not be done too distinctly and the will of experts were not that easily moved. Hence, there were still several who did not show any goodwill towards Xue Ying, especially a protector who seemed to ‘hate’ him a lot.
This protector was known as ‘Tie Cheng Liu’.
Tie Cheng Liu was tall and big. His eyes were cold. His relations even with other protectors were very ordinary. Whenever he looked at Xue Ying, his eyes would be filled with cold and hatred. Given Xue Ying’s acute senses in the soul, Xue Ying easily felt some ‘vicious intent’ coming from the other party.
‘I have just come to this world and have never met him before. Why would he despise me so much?’ Xue Ying felt puzzled.
But he did not care about it.
It was just a protector who was merely a peak stage God General. That protector might be one step away from becoming a God Monarch, yet this step was as wide as a chasm. Hence, the disparity in their strength was enormous.
“We are here.”
“We have reached the High Mountain City.”
On a particular day, the ship resounded with cheers.
Standing at the head of the deck, Third Lady, Housekeeper Yun, the officers, soldiers, and many other servants revealed looks of joy! After all, none of them dared to relax when traveling out in the Great Wilderness.
‘High Mountain City.’ Xue Ying was also watching from afar. That was a huge city. But it did not seem as vast as the cities in Realm Heart Great LAnd. According to Xue Ying’s deduction, this High Mountain City was just several hundreds of thousands of kilometers wide.
After all, the soil and stone of this world were exaggeratedly heavy.
And the difficulty of constructing a city like this was not any less than constructing the capital of Southern Cloud Capital!
******
The main governor of the High Mountain City none other than the Imperial Wind Clan!
On this day when the ship reached the High Mountain City, within a palace in the residence of the Imperial Wind Clan.
Xue Ying saw the Crown Prince of the Imperial Wind Clan, who was also the acknowledged inheritor of the Imperial Wind Clan---Imperial Wind Lei!
“Third Sister, is this the Ascendant that you have been praising about?” A tall and big male sat there. Lightning could be seen revolving faintly in his eyes. They gave off an extraordinary grandeur.
“Greetings Crown Prince.” Xue Ying slightly bowed.
When Imperial Wind Lei saw that, he chuckled: “I’ve always heard that Ascendants are incredibly proud and arrogant. And that is truly a justified reputation.”
“They have been the strongest experts back in their hometowns in the Lower Realm. It is natural for them to be filled with pride.” Seated by the side, Imperial Wind Qing Yin explained, “It is said that Ascendants have a hard time cultivating in the Divine Realm. However, God Monarch Flying Snow has reached the middle stage God Monarch realm. This is not an easy task at all.”
Imperial Wind Lei slightly nodded: “It is indeed an arduous task. Since my little sister has said it, God Monarch Flying Snow, you shall take on the role as a Cultivation Mentor in my Imperial Wind Clan from now on. I will also arrange a place for you to stay within the city.”
“Many thanks, Crown Prince.” Xue Ying obediently replied.
…
That’s right.
After meeting this Crown Prince Imperial Wind Lei, Xue Ying merely said two sentences-’Greetings Crown Prince’, and the other being ‘Many thanks, Crown Prince’ before being arranged to leave. That Crown Prince Imperial Wind Lei was clearly more enthusiastic about hearing out from his sister on her experience of ‘venturing into the wilderness’.
A residence occupying an area spanning a quarter kilometers was arranged for Xue Ying to stay in. Xue Ying was also bestowed with two huge boxes of treasures.
“Teacher Flying Snow, the things are here. The few of us will make our move first.”
“Many thanks everyone.”
Xue Ying sent the soldiers from the Imperial Wind Clan off with his eyes. Looking at this residence, he immediately smiled.
This place would most likely be a place he called ‘home’ for a long period in this world.
…
On the second night after arriving at High Mountain City.
Xue Ying was calmly meditating in the meditation room. At night, there was a red and a silver-white moon hanging in the sky. The brilliance from the moon shone across the courtyard. It was quiet.
“Mn?” Xue Ying frowned.
His soul was incredibly perceptive.
And he had felt the suppression of killing intent coming in his direction!
‘There are assassins?’ Xue Ying felt puzzled, ‘This is just my second day here in the High Mountain City yet there are people who want to kill me already?’

chapters.title: Chapter 1275 - Kill (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1275: Kill (1)
Previously, he had been traveling by ship for around two months. During those two months, he was mostly chatting with the protectors on the ship, which as a result gave Xue Ying a deeper understanding of ‘High Mountain City’. Even though the political situation in High Mountain City was complicated and tricky, a ‘God Monarch’ was absolutely considered an expert. He came here from the remote Realm Heart Great Land, and was a newcomer. He did not know many people, much less enemies.
Yet there were experts who wanted to assassinate a God Monarch?
‘I do wish to see who is it.’ Xue Ying remained seated calmly with his eyelids drooping downwards.
And at this moment, along the streets outside the courtyard, there were three figures who stealthily came over hidden in the void. These three experts were filled with killing intent when they saw the courtyard before them.
“There are no mistakes right?”
“Rest assured. It is this courtyard! That Ascendant is living here.”
“Fifth Sister, Ninth Brother, let us go according to the plan. Fifth Sister, release your domain. Ninth Brother, you shall assassinate him. It is best that you kill him in one move. Even if you did not, I’ll closely follow up.” The tallest and biggest green-robed man transmitted to the other two.
“Third Brother! Have trust in us! Fifth Sister and I should be sufficient.”
“Third Brother, watch us!”
The other two thinner and smaller experts were confident of themselves. They had worked together for far too many times.
The two of them gave each other a glance.
“Sou sou!”
They entered the courtyard where Xue Ying lived at the same time. At that moment when they entered, they had already let out their techniques.
“Hu hu hu.” One of the thin small male was actually a girl in red robe. She lightly blew, causing a stream of green fog to rush out. This fog seemed to contain spirituality as it engulfed that meditation room where Xue Ying was cultivating in! Every single structure in the meditation room began corroding apart rapidly with sounds of ‘chi chi chi’ after being engulfed by the green fog.
‘What a formidable green fog.’ Seated cross-legged in the meditation room, Xue Ying raised his eyebrow with slight astonishment.
This world felt abnormal to him. Even the soil and stone were incredibly heavy as if every single grit of them were condensed from Chaotic Origin Energy. Its gravitational strength was also incredibly high! As a result, the shockwave produced from any battle was usually confined to a smaller area. As the substance here was incredibly heavy, in addition to some fortification by arrays and secret techniques, one required the strength of a Cosmos God to destroy the walls! And it was naturally difficult to corrode the walls into powder silently.
The venomous fog continued flowing in. It covered every inches of space.
The stability of the void in this world was frightening. Xue Ying had yet to comprehend a ‘teleportation technique’ until now. Hence, facing this venomous fog, he could only resist against it directly! There was no way he could dodge!
“Hmph.”
Xue Ying remained seated there. He merely snorted, and a void maelstrom appeared around Xue Ying. This maelstrom repelled that green venomous fog outside. Even as that fog corroded away the maelstrom, it could still not penetrate through the layers of void maelstrom. Given Xue Ying’s current comprehension in the laws, his utilization of his energy had reached an unfathomably profound stage. This venomous fog merely came from an ‘early stage God Monarch’. Other God Monarchs might think that it was hard to deal with this technique that blocked off all paths of escape, yet it was simple to resolve by Xue Ying.
“He actually remained seated there?” Ranked in the ‘ninth position’, the black-robed male felt frustrated inwardly. His entire person warped and soon turned into a slender crimson snake.
This slender crimson snake did not even reach a meter long.
“Xiu!”
With a flash, this snake left behind a crimson arc as it charged against Xue Ying.
Yet Xue Ying remained seated calmly, though there was a spear placed on his knees. This was a spear he exchanged for with what he had been bestowed after becoming the Cultivation Mentor for the ‘High Mountain Imperial Wind Clan’. This spear was considered a relatively normal weapon in this world, yet compared to the weapons in Realm Heart Great Land, it was cruder.
Nonetheless, it had a special feature--its heaviness!
‘Turning into a snake?’ Xue Ying grabbed that spear with one hand before sending it out at a particular direction. This spearhead pierced right at that incoming slender crimson snake.
“Hmph hmph hmph, what a joke.” When that crimson snake came, it felt disdainful after seeing Xue Ying’s actions. Its entire body was as sharp as a divine weapon. Furthermore, it was much more agile, way more than a true weapon.
“Chi chi chi~”
At the moment when the snake reached Xue Ying, many insects abruptly appeared amidst the green fog that surrounded Xue Ying. These insects converged together and began devouring away the void maelstrom. That unseen void maelstrom was actually being destroyed bit by bit.
‘Perhaps there is no need for me to act?’ That biggest muscular male in green robes came closely behind with a black saber in his hand.
Three great experts assassinating!
Yet Xue Ying only pierced out that spear of his in response, causing the void around the spearhead to implode and collapse like a bubble. This void bubble had coincidentally engulfed around the region where that ‘crimson snake’ was.
“What is happening? This, what is this! Break for me!”
Even though that snake was slightly startled, he was still confident of his strength and tried breaking the bubble apart.
But the moment its body that was as sharp as a divine weapon struck against the boundaries of the void bubble, it felt itself being blocked by layers and layers of obstacles. This body slam of it did not seem to do anything. Following which, the void bubble continued collapsing inwards!
One could see the location where the spearhead was… produced a void bubble that engulfed around the snake, collapsing into a dark hold. That snake frantically struggled yet to no avail.
Even though ‘Third Brother’ and ‘Fifth Sister’ were both shocked, they did not have the time to help. Regardless, they were relatively confident of ‘Ninth Brother’ since Ninth Brother’s body was as tough as a divine weapon.
“Peng.”
The spear in Xue Ying’s hand pierced out on a black point. This black point was precisely the void bubble that had collapsed.
And at the next moment, that black dot exploded!
It revealed the crimson snake which had been broken into three pieces. Those eyes of that snake were filled with terror. Currently, it was heavily injured. It anxiously shouted out: “Third Brother, Fifth Sister, save me!”
“Peng.””Peng.”
Xue Ying remained seated there. He casually pierced out his spear two more times consecutively.
And how fast was it when Xue Ying pierced out his spear?
Every time he pierced out, it would strike against a black point that had been formed from a collapsed void bubble which engulfed around that crimson snake! When this spear pierced out against the black spot, the black point would explode.
And this happened three times in total.
The first strike split the crimson snake into three pieces. It was still struggling and shouting out for help.
The second strike caused the snake to shatter, leaving behind just some pieces of its body. It was completely in despair already.
And the third time the strike came, it completely destroyed the snake, leaving behind nothing at all.
Everything happened too quickly!
Reaching his level, every pierce of the spear happened at an extremely quick speed. And the two other experts, one was still controlling the venomous fog and insects trying hard to break apart the void maelstrom, while the other was anxiously trying to strike out with the blood-colored saber in his hand. Nonetheless, he was still too slow.
“This is an early stage God Monarch Ascendant? And he is even heavily injured?”
“Damn.”
That Third Brother and the red-robed girl began panicking.
The intelligence was so wrong.
Even under the domain of the red-robed girl, the target killed ‘Ninth Brother’, the one with the strongest body amongst them in a single exchange. This strength was something even a middle stage God Monarch could not do so. The other party should be a peak stage God Monarch!
A peak stage God Monarch was very different from an injured early stage God Monarch. The disparity in their strength was more than ten times greater!
“The intelligence is false. The strength of the enemy is beyond what we are told! Retreat, retreat!” That green-robed man might be frustrated, yet he still transmitted out and fled without hesitation.
“Don’t think that it is so easy to run after trying to assassinate me!” Xue Ying was originally seated cross-legged there. But now, he moved.
“Hua.”
This motion of his arced through the sky.
Being an expert at the final realm of Dao of Void, even though Xue Ying’s body refinement strength had regained back its ‘middle stage God Monarch realm’ (comparable to middle stage King Realm within the Broken Teeth Mountain Range), he had deduced and grasped part of the profound mysteries of the void in this world. That strengthened his techniques beyond a level that experts in this world who ‘relied merely on the strength of their Chaotic Origin Ancestral God bloodline’ could achieve.
“He is too fast!” That green-robed man tried escaping.
As he escaped, Xue Ying continued pursuing behind.
But Xue Ying’s speed was twice his speed! This caused the expression of the green-robed man to change.
“Pu.”
Similarly, a spear pierced outwards! That green-robed man felt his surrounding void collapsing apart. It was like a huge bubble collapsing, and the speed it collapsed was too quick! He did not even have sufficient time to beg for mercy! The entire void bubble collapsed into ‘one black spot’. That green-robed male merely felt himself turning small-as small as an ant. At the same time when the space he was in collapsed, the green-robed male felt the void around him becoming denser! He felt himself being pressed down!
And in the outer world, an incredibly huge spear struck out at this black spot world that which had completely trapped the assailant. It was at this moment that the black spot world exploded!
Force coming in from both directions!
“Hong!”
Saying it was slow, yet in reality, this was merely a strike by Xue Ying. How quick was it? That green-robed muscular man could only wave out the blood saber in his hand in response!

chapters.title: Chapter 1276 - Kill (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1276: Kill (2)
“Break for me!” That green-robed man struggled despondent. He even had a vague feeling that his life would most likely be reaped tonight.
The full-powered attack by this man was not weak. It was even accompanied by the effects of defending himself. As he slashed out his saber, an unseen blade light was formed around his body. He tried to charge out of this exploding black point world.
But this technique by Xue Ying.
It was also an explosion produced by suppressing the void to an extreme. It was a complete explosion from all aspects. The green-robed man’s saber could not resist against it. That saber in his hand could only divert part of the incoming force, with the remaining acting on his body. As a result, his fleshy body began disintegrating amidst the explosion.
“Hong.”
“I’m out!”
Accompanied by his blood saber, part of his remnant fleshy body came out of the world. This remnant fleshy body distorted and coagulated back to a humanoid shape.
But Xue Ying indifferently pierced out again. It was the same technique. He was not merciful at all! Actually, the reason he executed this technique was because this had been the strongest technique he had temporarily grasped! No other choice. Most of the profound mysteries he comprehended in the past could not be used here-they suffered from a conflict with the current world energy. Hence, what he could do was to deduce out techniques that were a fraction of the strength of what he had.
Those that were powerful, techniques that could help him escape, techniques that dealt against a group…
After deducing several of such simplified techniques, Xue Ying went back towards researching on how to stabilize his Chaotic Origin Refined Body! As long as his body became stronger, the techniques he executed would naturally become stronger.
“Peng.”
Under the second strike, this green-robed male was exterminated.
Even though he was at the ‘middle stage God Monarch realm’, and he was stronger than Ninth Brother in close combat! But his body survivability was weaker by a level. When facing the terrifying spear technique of Xue Ying, he was forced to use his body to resist. Naturally, he was less durable than ‘Ninth Brother’.
“And there is one last one.” Xue Ying turned to the courtyard.
That girl in red robe had already fled elsewhere.
“Do you think you can escape from me?”
Xue Ying immediately transformed into a stream of light, scuttling out of his courtyard before continuing his pursue.
…
Currently, Xue Ying had yet to discover anybody who could teleport in this world! He had not researched the technique out either. There was a benefit to this-it made it hard for the enemies to escape!
Even though the girl in red robe who was ‘ranked fifth’ stood furthest since she was casting long range techniques-the venomous fog and venomous insects, and had run the first moment she found things were amiss, Xue Ying had nevertheless killed the middle stage God Monarch expert too quickly. It took just two pierces. Hence, this slight bit of time was insufficient for the girl to escape far away.
‘Too powerful.’
‘That is too frightening! How could his spear technique be so frightening? Ninth Brother’s body is as tough as a divine weapon yet it lasted just three strikes?’ The red-robed girl felt terror in her heart. Ninth Brother was much stronger than many other middle stage God Monarchs. If she were to go, she would most likely be exterminated in a single strike.
‘Not good.’
The red-robed girl discovered a stream of light breaking through space behind her. It was so fast that it felt like a nightmare!
‘He has reached up to me!’ The red-robed girl was greatly startled, “Big Brother, why haven’t you come!”
When they decided to escape, she and ‘Third Brother’ had already called for help!
But Big Brother and the others would most likely take the cup to brew a cup of tea to come from their territory. With such a long period, how could they be saved?
“Mercy! Mercy! God Monarch Flying Snow, please spare my life!” The red-robed girl hurriedly asked for mercy. She had even stopped running. She turned around and gave Xue Ying a pitiful look.
A beautiful girl begging pitifully.
What would Xue Ying do?
“Spare your life?”
Xue Ying kept his spear. This scene made the red-robed girl sigh a breath of relief: ‘He kept his spear? It seems he won’t kill me.’
Following that, Xue Ying extended his right hand!
His right hand extended out, forming a void that wrapped around the red-robed girl. The red-robed girl felt the void in her surroundings collapsing. She was also rapidly becoming smaller. That palm of Xue Ying was also becoming bigger in her vision. The surrounding structure was also becoming bigger.
“Hu.” Xue Ying grabbed hold of this void ball with one hand. This ball was about the size of a finger. It was currently placed on his palm.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying turned into another stream of light and went back home: ‘I am truly too slow. The gravity of this world is simply too strong. Even I myself is flying really slowly. This High Mountain City isn’t that big, yet it would most likely take some time for me to travel around.”
WIthin his residence.
Xue Ying sat cross-legged inside the house with that void bubble placed on his palm. Inside the void bubble contained that ‘red-robed girl’. Currently, that red-robed girl had fallen asleep without resistance.
Because Xue Ying had already executed his Mirage and Illusory Realm secret technique. This red-robed girl could not resist against it at all. She simply fell asleep. By relying on this, Xue Ying easily flipped through her memories.
‘So it seems.’
‘In this Divine Realm, the three Great Royal Clans are the ones with the highest statuses?’ Xue Ying finally understood the power hierarchy now.
Previously, he had been chatting with those protectors on the ship. He could only gather bits and pieces of information.
Yet now as he scanned through the entire memory, Xue Ying was enlightened.
The Divine Realm…
According to the legends, it was created by three Chaotic Origin Ancestral God.
The three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods left behind direct bloodlines, forming the three Great Royal Clans! The three Great Royal Clans were naturally powerful, and behind them were the unfathomable Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods! Naturally, everyone in the Divine Realm revered the three Great Royal Clans.
Other than this.
The Divine Realm was vast and it contained many organizations competing with one another.
The three Great Royal Clans were transcendental instead. They overlooked the competition by other organizations!
The ‘High Mountain City Imperial Wind Clan’ was also one of the many organizations in the Divine Realm. In the Divine Realm, the natives held absolute positions in governing the world. There were comparatively fewer Ascendants, and their strength were much weaker. Most Ascendants joined the native organizations.
‘Three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods created this world?’ Xue Ying was shocked, ‘For them to create this world, they are unquestionably Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Furthermore, they are very powerful too!’
Also.
These three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods were alive! And there was one of them behind each of the three Great Royal Clans.
‘Yuan brought us to such world for training?’ Xue Ying felt dumbstruck inwardly.
‘Whatever. The statuses of the three Great Royal Clans are transcendental. I doubt I would be able to reach them, much less the ‘Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods’ that are simply spoken only in the legends.’ Xue Ying thought. The statuses of the Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods were too special. The natives in this Divine Realm had bloodlines of the Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods. Clearly, they had been populating over a long period. And should any natives of the Divine Realm traced their bloodline upwards, they would be able to trace back to one of the Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods.
Only the Ascendants had no bloodlines from the Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods!
‘It seems that the ones attacking me today comes from an organization called ‘Bat Mountain’ in High Mountain City?’ Xue Ying thought.
Bat Mountain had an incredibly deep foundation in the High Mountain City.
The Bat Mountain Master was also a peak stage God Monarch expert. He was one of the Cultivation Mentors in the ‘High Mountain Imperial Wind Clan’! After all, there was only one High Mountain City Master-the master from the High Mountain Imperial Wind Clan! All other organizations were loyal to the High Mountain Imperial Wind Clan.
…
At night.
Within a residence, there were five figures standing on a multi-storied pagoda. They were currently looking at a direction-the residence where Xue Ying stayed!
“Big Brother, are we simply going to continue watching and not enter?” The other four felt anxious.
“Damn.”
The leading one was a triangular ugly old man. He was a famous person in the High Mountain City, ‘Bat Mountain Master’. He was ranked in the top 10 within High Mountain City.
Bat Mountain Master stared at the distant residence. He said with a hoarse voice: “Third Brother, Fifth Sister, Ninth Brother, not only did the three of them failed, they were unable to escape as well. Within two breaths of time, all of them were killed. Even though I could defeat the three of them easily, I am not confident of wiping them out in just two breaths of time.”
The other four became silent.
That’s right.
When escaping, everyone would scatter in different directions! If one chased after a party, the other two could have fled to a far distance.
To kill all three was not an easy task. And to do it within two breaths was simply frightening.
“Housekeeper Yun’s Jade Light God Eye has never discerned something wrongly.” Bat Mountain Master growled, “I also know that Housekeeper Yun has once examined this Ascendant and concluded he was at the early stage God Monarch realm. Furthermore, he was suppressing his injuries, which was why I agreed to send Third Brother and the others to act. Who would have thought… that Housekeeper Yun has lucked out.”
“Big Brother, what should we do?”
“What should we do next?” All of them looked at Bat Mountain Master.
Bat Mountain Master coldly stated: “Everyone return first.”
“Yes.”
The four of them acknowledged the orders. Even though they were filled with unwillingness on the surface, they felt relieved in their hearts.
They only became subordinates of Bat Mountain Master because of his strength. As for how deep was the relationship between them? That was just surfacial!
“Three God Monarchs of mine died, and I’m afraid City Master and the others would know about this soon. I have lost a great deal of face this time. But nonetheless, this God Monarch Flying Snow isn’t to be riled. I have to consider how I should deal with this.” Bat Mountain Master’s eyes were cold. The High Mountain City Master, ‘Imperial Wind High Mountain’, had once conquered the entire High Mountain City with his strength. He was also the true and highest governor of the entire High Mountain City. Now that three God Monarchs under Bat Mountain Master were dead, how could it be hidden from the overlord?

chapters.title: Chapter 1277 - Getting out of Closed-Door Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1277: Getting out of Closed-Door Cultivation
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“This God Monarch Flying Snow isn’t to be provoked. But the one who passed down the wrong information, Tie Cheng Liu, must not be forgiven either.” The eyes of Bat Mountain Master were cold. He ordered with a hoarse voice, “Eighth Brother, go capture that Tie Cheng Liu back.”
“Yes, Big Brother. We must not forgive this Tie Cheng Liu. What bullsh*t did he say! An early stage God Monarch who is heavily injured?!” A handsome male wearing violet robe gritted his teeth. Actually, he was partly responsible for this matter too. Ever since the creation of ‘Bat Mountain’ in High Mountain City, it had done quite a few assassinations and plunder. This time, it was Tie Cheng Liu who took the initiative in asking him out for a drink while mentioning the Ascendant ‘God Monarch Flying Snow’. Tie Cheng Liu still said: “That God Monarch Flying Snow has been roaming in the Great Wilderness for an incredibly long period. Hearsay he was originally at the middle stage God Monarch realm, and should have acquired quite a few treasures. Now that he is suffering from a grievous injury, his strength will definitely not be on par as before-it has not only weakened to the early stage God Monarch realm, there is also an injury which he can’t dispel from his body. Hmph hmph, if my strength was sufficient, I would definitely eliminate him and steal his treasures!”
Hence, this Eighth Brother brightened up at the news. He went to report this upwards.
Actually, the higher-ups of the Bat Mountain knew that Tie Cheng Liu wanted to rely on them to eliminate ‘God Monarch Flying Snow’. They were clear of the motivation too.
And they even authenticated the intelligence over ‘God Monarch Flying Snow’!
After investigating… they knew that Housekeeper Yun once used his ‘Jade Light God Eye’ to examine Xue Ying. And they were absolutely confident over the prowess of the Jade Light God Eye! Furthermore, for the sake of guaranteeing success in this mission, they had not only dispatched ‘Fifth Sister and Ninth Brother’, they even sent the middle stage God Monarch ‘Third Brother’ over! This mission should have a probability of over 90% of success. Who would have thought that ‘God Monarch Flying Snow’ was not only fine, his strength even surpassed their imaginations.
Even ‘Bat Mountain Master’ who was ranked top ten in High Mountain City was stunned.
…
Within an ordinary residence.
The tall and big ‘Tie Cheng Liu’ sat there by himself enjoying wine. His eyes were cold.
Ever since an unforeseen circumstance which happened in the past, he became colder and madder! His social skills also deteriorated.
“Ascendant? All Ascendants should die! They should all die!” Tie Cheng Liu mumbled, “What is it about Ascendants that made others treat them differently? Hmph hmph, I believe that given the style of Bat Mountain, there should be an outcome in these few days.”
Tie Cheng Liu sat there drinking wine while seemingly recalling back about some experience he had.
His eyes became crazier over time.
Suddenly--
“Hong.”
A violet stream of light descended within the courtyard. It turned into a handsome male wearing violet robe. Tie Cheng Liu who was seated there drinking wine immediately turned over. Seeing the unfriendly look on that handsome male, Tie Cheng Liu felt his heart skipping a beat. He immediately greeted: “Brother Blood.”
“Because of you fool, Third Brother and the others have lost their lives.” The violet-robed handsome male gritted his teeth. He had even forgotten that the reason why they acted had been because of ‘God Monarch Flying Snow’s harvest by himself within the Great Wilderness as well as his weakened strength! After all, those who could stay in the Great Wilderness for long periods would usually be rich.
Even though the Great Wilderness was dangerous, those corpses of the Wilderness Beast were sufficiently precious.
“What?” Tie Cheng Liu paled.
“Come with me. Big Brother wants to see you.” The handsome male immediately walked over with huge steps.
“Sou!”
Tie Cheng Liu did not hesitate to flee. Meet Bat Mountain Master? He could guess what the outcome would be.
The handsome male grinned savagely. He extended his right hand, causing it to erupt with large violet rays of light. Those violet light rays distorted according to the wishes of the controller and were currently flying towards Tie Cheng Liu who was escaping. It rapidly engulfed and imprisoned Tie Cheng Liu after that.
Even though between the two of them, one was a peak stage God General and the other an early stage God Monarch.
It might seem like there was only a step difference.
But…
God Generals, God Monarchs, and God Emperors. Each was a difference in major realm. The gap in their strengths would also become more obvious, especially so for the, the natives of the Divine Realm. They cultivated in their bloodlines which came from Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods. And each increase in major realm would see their strengths transforming qualitatively.
******
High Mountain City Imperial Wind Clan. The Imperial Wind Clan occupied an area spanning several tens of thousands of kilometers. Given the unique environment of the Divine Realm, for a clan to occupy such a huge region showed how powerful they were.
High Mountain City contained many big and small forces. Even though different organizations were competing with one another, none of them dared to disobey the Imperial Wind Clan! For ‘Cultivation Mentors’ like Xue Ying or Bat Mountain Master, or other ordinary soldiers and officers like Tie Cheng Liu, they were not considered the core of the Imperial Wind Clan. Only the disciples of the Imperial Wind Clan and a select few absolutely loyal members like Housekeeper Yun and other old servants were people whom the Imperial Wind Clan trusted.
“Hong long long.”
A stone door located within the territory of Imperial Wind Clan located on a peak dozens of kilometers high opened.
Two figures stood outside this stone door.
One was the young master of the Imperial Wind Clan, ‘Imperial Wind Lei’. His status within the clan was second only to his father. The other was Housekeeper Yun. Even though Housekeeper Yun had a relatively high status within the Imperial Wind Clan, he was merely ranked three across all housekeepers. Though he was qualified to welcome the ‘patriarch’ here with the young master for other reasons.
The stone door opened. From within came out a middle-aged male who’s hair had turned grayish white from the vicissitudes of life. As he walked out, both Imperial Wind Lei and Housekeeper Yun subconsciously bowed their bodies in respect.
“Father.” Imperial Wind Lei bowed.
“Master.” Housekeeper Yun bowed too.
This person standing before them was none other than the overlord of the entire High Mountain City! He was unquestionably the highest commander, ‘Imperial Wind High Mountain’!
Imperial Wind High Mountain nodded slightly. He turned towards Housekeeper Yun, “How is the result from your visit to the ‘Dawn City’?”
Housekeeper Yun respectfully answered: “Master, all the gifts have been sent back. The Dawn Religion Master is not willing to accept Third Lady as disciple.”
The pupils of Imperial Wind High Mountain dilated when he heard that. His eyes could even be seen twitching as he lightly said: “Given the strength of Dawn Religion Master, it shouldn’t be a difficult task for him. Yet he rejected in the end.”
He understood.
Dawn Religion Master was not willing to participate in this muddied waters.
“Father, I don’t believe that our High Mountain City can’t win against that ‘Devil Heart Cult’.” The eyes of Imperial Wind Lei flashed with lightning. Sounds of rumble could be heard in the surrounding void. There were even thunder snakes forking out.
“Old Thief Devil Heart has improved greatly. There must be a reason why he could be ranked 987th on the ‘God Emperor Ranking List’ by the Heaven’s Will Clan. Even though it is near the back, it speaks volume for he could be ranked.” Imperial Wind High Mountain shook his head, “Even though I as the father isn’t willing to believe, the truth is clear, that Old Thief Devil Heart has greatly surpassed me already. Even if I relied on the terrain advantage of the High Mountain City, I might not be able to defeat Old Thief Devil Heart.”
The God Emperor Ranking List recorded the 1,000 most terrifying God Emperors within the entire Divine Realm.
Given how vast the Divine Realm was with so many organizations, for one to be ranked in the top 1,000 meant that one was an overlord.
“The Heaven’s Will Clan is also one of the three Great Royal Clans. Their judgment is definitely right.” The eyes of Imperial Wind High Mountain were cold, “That time when I became arch enemies with Old Thief Devil Heart, I knew that Old Thief Devil Heart would definitely not let things by given his personality. Now that he has become stronger, I doubt he would hold back any longer once he finishes preparing. After all, I doubt he would want to sacrifice too many things when battling against my High Mountain City. The point when he strikes is also the moment he is fully prepared!”
“Father, by relying on the terrain of High Mountain City, they should forget about having an easy time against our Imperial Wind Clan.” Imperial Wind Lei was clearly getting anxious.
“One must not be impatient.”
Imperial Wind High Mountain said, “Housekeeper Yun, I’ll be going with Jin’er to the Eastern Wood City! The Ninth Prince of Eastern Wood City once came to our High Mountain City and showed interest over Qing Yin. This time, I’m planning to go and see if I could matchmake both Qing Yin and the Ninth Prince of Eastern Wood City. As long as Eastern Wood City is willing to intervene, given the noble position of Eastern Wood City, he should be able to arbitrate and prevent the vengeance from going through.”
“The Ninth Prince of Eastern Wood City?” Imperial Wind Lei revealed a look of anxiety, “Father, unless you truly want to let little sister marry that…”
If she were to get married to the Ninth Prince, it would be letting a sheep enter the den of a tiger!
And even if little sister suffered from a wretched fate, their High Mountain City would not dare to go against the Eastern Wood City.
“The reputation of the Ninth Prince is indeed awful. But currently, only he could help my High Mountain City.” Imperial Wind High Mountain coldly uttered, “For the sake of the entire Imperial Wind Clan, I believe Qing Yin will understand.”
Imperial Wind Lei went silent.
That’s right.
‘Old Thief Devil Heart’ had already entered the God Emperor Ranking List. Who could help them at this moment? Those whom Imperial Wind High Mountain was slightly familiar with were mostly on the same level as he. Those who were stronger by an entire level were not willing to become enemies with Old Thief Devil Heart. Only a few like ‘Dawn Religion Master’ could deal against this matter easily, yet its a pity that Dawn Religion Master was not willing to help them.
As for the Eastern Wood City Master?
His status was even higher. It’s a pity that Imperial Wind High Mountain was not qualified from interacting with such existences. Only that Ninth Prince from the Eastern Wood City once passed by the High Mountain City.
“This matter is settled just like this.” Imperial Wind High Mountain understood. Currently, they were the ones who were filled with intentions of getting closer with the Eastern Wood City, though they did not know how the other party would react! They could only send someone who had relatively closer relationship with the Ninth Prince, his second son ‘Imperial Wind Jin’ over. They would first reveal their intention, and if possible, Imperial Wind High Mountain wanted to meet that Eastern Wood City Master personally!
“Oh right, during these days when I was in closed-door, how was the city?” Imperial Wind High Mountain asked.
Imperial Wind Lei answered: “The city is relatively peaceful, though there was an Ascendant called ‘God Monarch Flying Snow’ who came to our High Mountain City. He had been saved by Third Sister. I temporarily allowed him to take on the responsibility as a Cultivation Mentor of our Imperial Wind Clan. Just a few days ago, Bat Mountain should have dispatched three God Monarchs to assassinate that God Monarch Flying Snow, yet they all died in his hands.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1278 - Within the Scripture Library
chapters.content:
Chapter 1278: Within the Scripture Library
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Oh, how is the strength of God Monarch Flying Snow? Is it at the peak stage of God Monarch?” Imperial Wind High Mountain asked.
He did not care about the internal struggle of organizations within High Mountain City. As long as the city remained stable, it was a minor affair for assassinations to be carried out in the dark. Furthermore, Imperial Wind High Mountain believed that the ‘internal struggle’ would be a more optimal way of training experts out. If the entire High Mountain City remained peaceful, the number of experts emerging would be greatly reduced too.
This was something he did not wish to see.
The more experts there were, the better! They were ultimately his subordinates! What he cared most was those at the ‘peak stage God Monarch’ level. Because given sufficient experts at this level, ten of them could possibly fight against an ‘early stage God Emperor’. This was also the reason why peak stage God Monarchs like ‘Bat Mountain Master’ had great power within High Mountain City. Imperial Wind High Mountain was relatively lenient on them.
‘Ascendants do not have any Chaotic Origin Ancestral God bloodlines. They painstakingly cultivated to where they currently are. Hence, they are usually stronger by an entire level as compared to those at the same level. If it was a peak stage God Monarch Ascendant, he might be able to fight against an early stage God Emperor. This expert would definitely be a huge support should Old Thief Devil Heart come.’ Imperial Wind High Mountain thought.
“He hasn’t reached the peak stage God Monarch.” Imperial Wind Lei shook his head, “Housekeeper Yun once used the Jade Light God Eye to examine him.”
Imperial Wind High Mountain turned to Housekeeper Yun.
Housekeeper Yun respectfully explained: “Master, I once met a heavily injured God Monarch Flying Snow on the journey back home with Third Lady in the Great Wilderness. At that time, I was able to execute the Jade Light God Eye and examine his foundation. That was how I discovered he has not Chaotic Origin Ancestral God bloodline, and is definitely an Ascendant! Furthermore, he doesn’t seem to have condensed his God Heart yet. Instead, he refined his fleshy body to a degree that reaches the early stage God Monarch level. Furthermore, his injuries seem to be hard to eradicate. But after that, he said it himself that he was originally at the middle stage God Monarch level! It was only because of his injuries that he suffered a drop in strength. This matter happened more than two months ago. Even though the period is short, he could easily eradicate the three God Monarchs under Bat Mountain, which I reckon that he should have regained his strength during the past two months.”
“It is normal for him to eradicate three God Monarchs, two at the early stage God Monarch level and one at the middle stage God Monarch. Furthermore, that middle stage God Monarch has no magical ability as well.” Imperial Wind Lei added.
“Oh.” Imperial Wind High Mountain was somewhat disappointed. He nodded, “An Ascendant at the middle stage God Monarch level could fight against those at a higher level. It is not surprising for him to kill three weaker God Monarchs. Mn, just pay more attention to this matter will do!”
Even though he was disappointed.
But a middle stage God Monarch Ascendant was comparable to a ‘peak stage God Monarch’ native from the Divine Realm. His strength would most likely be comparable to Bat Mountain Master, and it could be said that he had gained an additional Great General. It’s a pity that he looked most forward to a ‘peak stage God Monarch Ascendant’.
“Yes, father. I’ll pay close attention to it.” Imperial Wind Lei acknowledged.
But regardless of who it was, Imperial Wind High Mountain or Imperial Wind Lei, they did not place much importance on this matter. With the threat of ‘master of Devil Heart Cult’ looming close, they did not have time to wait for a ‘middle stage God Monarch Ascendant’ to grow. Furthermore, even if a ‘peak stage God Monarch Ascendant’ came, the help he could provide would be limited against the master of the Devil Heart Cult.
‘The Ninth Prince from the Eastern Wood City.’ Imperial Wind High Mountain looked forward to it. He currently placed all hopes of survival on other organizations. It did not feel good for him to sacrifice his daughter for this.
But he had no choice.
The struggle within the Divine Realm was cruel. Many organizations had fallen, and Imperial Wind High Mountain was not willing for his ‘Imperial Wind Clan’ to become the next. Hence, he was willing to pay all prices to ensure the survival of his clan.
******
“Tutor Flying Snow.”
“Tutor Flying Snow, please.”
Within the High Mountain City Imperial Wind Clan, after Xue YIng arrived, he met quite a few personal guards of the Imperial WInd Clan. These personal guards were incredibly passionate to him. After all, their sources of information were relatively quick. Furthermore, God Monarchs were considered experts in the High Mountain City, and for him to kill three others, that was something that could not be hidden. At least the personal guards of the Imperial Wind Clan knew about ‘Bat Mountain’ suffering from a huge loss under this God Monarch Flying Snow! And all of them were not willing to slight this God Monarch Flying Snow at all. His identity as an ‘Ascendant’ was something many other feared.
Even though there were few Ascendants, each and every one of them were extraordinary.
Xue Ying chuckled: “Eradicating those three insects from Bat Mountain has indeed boosted my reputation significantly.”
He advanced forward without being stopped.
Soon, he arrived at the Scripture Library of the Imperial Wind Clan.
“Tutor Flying Snow.” There were naturally protectors within the Scripture Library. These protectors welcomed Xue Ying with great passion.
“I should be qualified to select a cultivation scripture to peruse right?” Xue Ying smiled.
“Tutor Flying Snow, being a Cultivation Tutor, you are naturally qualified. But you can only select one scripture from the first to third level in the Scripture Library.” The protector enthusiastically explained. Cultivation Tutors were indeed lofty positions with no practical obligations. But only those with some special strength or abilities could be qualified to become one.
Xue Ying then entered the Scripture Library.
The Scripture Library had six levels in total.
And Xue Ying was free to select any scripture from the first three levels.
He began casually flipping through those books. Currently, these scriptures were only detailed with basic introduction on the first page. The other pages were all empty!
…
When Xue Ying came to select the scriptures, the news about him arriving in the Imperial Wind Clan rapidly spread too. If one said that the intimidation of the name ‘God Monarch Flying Snow’ was ordinary previously, ever since the loss suffered by Bat Mountain in the hands of Xue Ying, ‘God Monarch Flying Snow’ had immediately become a famous character in the entire High Mountain City. Those with slightly better sources of information would understand that this God Monarch Flying Snow could possibly become an expert ranking in the top ten within High Mountain City.
Even if he could not enter, the gap in strength would not be huge either.
Otherwise, why would those three God Monarchs be wiped out so easily? And why did
‘Bat Mountain Master’ tolerate his subordinates being killed until now?
“Quick quick quick, let’s go have a look!”
“Previously, I wanted to meet God Monarch Flying Snow, yet it’s a pity that he has always been in closed-door cultivation, and the few of us dare not disturb him. This is a good time for us to interact with him.”
“Wah, hurry up and look! Bat Mountain Master actually came.”
“It is Bat Mountain Master!”
Many others saw an ugly triangular-headed old man arriving at the Imperial Wind Clan’s clans-ground. He was also one of the few Cultivation Tutors in the Imperial Wind Clan, and was naturally not hindered.
“Interesting.”
“Slightly after God Monarch Flying Snow appeared, Bat Mountain Master came.”
“It might even be possible for a huge battle to occur.”
…
Even though it was noisy outside, Xue Ying continued flipping through the scriptures patiently. To him, competition was a minor thing. Researching into the laws of this world was more important to him! He vaguely understood the meaning portrayed by Yuan from his words of ‘tempering in different civilizations’, ‘grasping that slight bit of eternal Dao’ and ‘jumping out of the restrictions faced by different civilizations to become a magnificent Chaotic Origin Lifeform’.
The Eternal Dao.
It was like the Dao of Cosmos Gods that could be used in different Origin Worlds.
And clearly, this world that he entered was not an Origin World. Hence, the Dao of a Cosmos God could not be used here. Then whose Dao could be used? When Xue Ying thought about how this world was created by three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods, he faintly guessed---’Dao at the Chaotic Origin level’ could be used!
‘Tempering myself in different civilizations will allow me to give up on many simple and crude profound mysteries. What is left behind are those that could be used in different civilizations. That is true eternity. That is the foundation to becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.’ Xue Ying had this conjecture.
No matter what.
He should first recover his peak strength that he once reached in the Realm Heart Great Land before speaking about anything else.
And it was too slow to rely on comprehending it himself! Naturally, absorbing the essence of experts of this world would be much faster.
‘Even though the natives of this Divine Realm cultivates in their bloodlines, they are clearly more proficient in many other cultivation techniques. They could even cultivate out a magical ability?’ Xue Ying thought, ‘The Death Destruction Clan and Natives of Broken Teeth Mountain Range similarly had Chaotic Origin bloodlines, but those bloodlines came from two fallen Chaotic Origin Experts. The cultivation techniques they had were comprehended by themselves, unlike this Divine Realm where the natives were left behind and reproduced from the bloodline of the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods… Those three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods should have left behind some guidance for their descendents right?’
‘But ultimately, bloodline is fundamental for them. Their comprehensions of the Dao are limited.’
‘What I need are scriptures of Ascendants.’
Xue Ying thought.
He had already discovered two scriptures of Ascendants, though it’s a pity they were not of the Dao of Void!
Ascendants did not have any Chaotic Origin bloodline.
They had all kinds of different ways to cultivate. But similarly, they could strengthen themselves by absorbing energy from the world. Xue Ying even felt that this was not any weaker than the ‘laws and profound mysteries lineage’. After all, these different routes would lead to the same destination. For instance, ‘Hex Cultivation’ or ‘Ancient Cultivation’ would eventually allow the cultivator to grasp a final realm ‘Dao’.
It was likewise for the majority of these Ascendants too! Only a few Ascendants could absorb the bloodlines from the natives of the Divine Realm to strengthen themselves. ZBut this was considered a forbidden technique in the Divine Realm! And Xue Ying only found out about this by scouring through the memories of others.
‘There are indeed many scriptures collected by the High Mountain City Imperial Wind Clan. They have several dozen scriptures for Ascendants, yet it’s a pity that only two are for the Dao of Void. One is for the God General Level while the other for the God Monarch level.’ Xue Ying picked up a deep green book. This book was written with the name of the cultivation technique---<Sky-Rending Void Sword Technique>.
‘No matter what, it is great that I could find something I could use.’ Xue Ying grinned. Any techniques that could reach the God Monarch Realm, judging by his hometown cultivator level--that would be a technique at the final realm level.
Only in the Divine Realm where cultivators cultivated the Chaotic Origin Ancestral God bloodlines would look down on Ascendant scriptures that were incredibly hard to cultivate and were only for God Monarchs. That was why this scripture was placed on the third level.
“Tutor Flying Snow, have you chosen?” A protector asked when he saw Xue Ying bring out a deep green book.
“Yes, this book will do.” Xue Ying passed it over.
The protector took it over and said: “Please wait, Tutor Flying Snow, I’ll go find the original copy. Tutor Flying Snow can only peruse through the book within the Scripture Library.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying nodded. He was looking forward to it. This would be the scripture that opens up the curtain of this world, greatly saving him a lot of time and effort.

chapters.title: Chapter 1279 - Void Sword Origin Energy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1279: Void Sword Origin Energy
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Just a moment later, that green-robed protector rushed over, saying: “Tutor Flying Snow, the original scripture has been found.” Saying that, he passed it over to Xue Ying.
Xue Ying gave it a glance after receiving it before smiling: “I need a meditation room to study this.”
“There are many meditation rooms in the Scripture Library. Any of those rooms that are left open could be chosen, Tutor Flying Snow.” The protector immediately led Xue Ying ahead. Xue Ying randomly chose a room before closing the stone door with a rumble.
…
The meditation rooms in the Scripture Library were ordinary--they were merely quiet. It just had a simple requirement--that was to isolate the cultivator from other disturbances. Hence, constructing it was cheap.
Most came to study cultivation scriptures for a short period. As the ‘cultivation scriptures’ were complex, other than spending time memorizing them, most cultivators also tried studying the ‘original copy’ of the book since the ‘original copy’ was written by the author only after he grasped the complete <Sky-Rending Void Sword Technique>. Those characters inscribed on the scripture were filled with profound mysteries that could be of great help to cultivation.
And only by observing the original copy for the first time could the cultivator learn it.
‘<Sky-Rending Void Sword Technique>, this is a cultivation technique created by an ‘Ascendant’ of this world.’ Xue Ying immediately flipped it open. His consciousness also permeated into the scripture as he began memorizing it.
Truthfully speaking.
Xue Ying was quite curious about the supposed Ascendant.
The natives of the Divine Realm were all descendants of ‘Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods’. Facing living beings from the Lower Realm, they naturally were filled with superiority over them. But similarly, the natives of the Divine Realm were filled with trepidation when facing ‘Ascendants’ from the Lower Realm too. They admitted that every Ascendant was extraordinary! Furthermore, at the same level, Ascendants were usually stronger by an entire level than natives of the Divine Realm. It was normal for Ascendants to fight against those at a level higher than them.
‘Amazing.’ Given how powerful Xue Ying’s soul was, he memorized this sword technique very quickly.
And after reading it, his eyes were filled with admiration and shock.
Admiration!
The utilization of laws and profound mysteries for this sword technique had reached a pinnacle. It did not seem any weaker than the techniques he created himself! Xue Ying even felt many techniques he comprehended in the Realm Heart Great Land were inferior to this sword technique after suffering from the resistance of this world.
‘My attainments in the Dao of Void, even with the help from a supreme secret impartation, discussion with Emperor Summer, and comprehension of the Void Snake Teeth, enabled me to come out with an unstable ‘Chaotic Origin Refined Body’.’ Xue Ying thought.
‘Early stage Emperors’ in the Realm Heart Great Land were comparable to the ‘early stage God Emperors’ of this Divine Realm.
‘Furthermore, I am currently also suffering from repulsion of this world, significantly deteriorating my strength.’ Xue Ying grinned, ‘But after absorbing the essence of this sword technique, it should take me less time to comprehend the laws and profound mysteries of this world.’
Closing his eyes, the entire cultivation process for this terrifying sword technique appeared in his mind.
This sword technique mainly cultivated in the ‘Void Sword Origin Energy’. Every strand of ‘Void Sword Origin Energy’ was as sharp as a divine weapon! After grasping this technique, every single spit would cause a sword ray to fly out. Or to shoot out a sword ray using one’s finger, or even transforming the entire body into multiple sword rays! Because the entire body was seemingly made up of Void Sword Origin Energy.
The body could be termed as a ‘Void Sword Origin Body’. This body was like a divine weapon, aggregating and dissipating easily. Its attack was frighteningly strong too.
In reality, this Void Sword Origin Energy was a special way of using the ‘Dao of Void’. Its way of utilization was strong--not any weaker than a supreme secret impartation.
The ‘Void Sword Origin Energy’ was split into six levels. The first level required an early stage God General to grasp it.
The first three levels were for the ‘God General Realm’.
The latter three levels were for the ‘God Monarch Realm’.
‘Amazing, really amazing.’
‘There is only one Great Dao.’
‘The entire Dao of Void was completely integrated together to form the ‘Void Sword Origin Energy’. The soul has also fused into every strand of energy. The entire body could be said to be made up of Void Sword Origin Energy. It is used for combat, and also the determining factor of how strong the body and soul is.’ Xue Ying sighed, ‘This creator wanted to try and break apart the cage to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform by relying on this Void Sword Origin Energy.’
Even though Xue Ying was filled with admiration, he did not feel that this was his path. His Dao of Soul had reached an incredibly profound realm. With both his soul and fleshy body supportive each other, Xue Ying could more accurately sense the flaws of his ‘fleshy body’. That was how he could cultivate incredibly quick along the path of body refinement.
Naturally, he wanted to continue and deepen his study of the Chaotic Origin Refined Body! That was the path most appropriate for him.
Even when both he and Emperor Summer were cultivating the same body, they had split apart into two different Dao paths because their Chaotic Origin Refined Body focused on different aspects.
Even though Xue Ying was filled with admiration over the cultivation technique for the ‘Void Sword Origin Energy’, more importantly, he paid attention to the various profound mysteries of Dao of Void applied in this technique.
‘This world is unlike the two Origin Worlds that I experienced in the past.’
‘These Ascendants believed in the ‘Great Dao being flawed’.’ Xue Ying shook his head, ‘And the final realm Dao in the Origin Worlds has reached grand perfection.’
One was ‘flawed’.
The other was ‘grand perfection’.
After slightly pondering over this matter, Xue Ying felt that the laws and profound mysteries used in the Origin Worlds were indeed more perfected. And now after entering this world, it was filled with ‘violence’ and ‘chaos’. Even though the laws were stronger, they seemed to be cruder! Many laws and profound mysteries were lacking, yet despite these flaws, one could similarly cultivate and reach the ‘Chaotic Origin Realm’.
‘Whatever, I shall just take in what is useful for me.’ Xue Ying no longer pondered over the issue. He continued comprehending this sword technique.
This took him half a day.
During this process, he read through the entire book two more times before deciding to stop! Because this original copy was no longer useful to him. His own attainments in the Dao of Void were not any weaker than the creator of this scripture.
‘This is the Void Sword Origin Energy?’ Xue Ying extended his right hand, causing a crystalline sword ray to appear at his fingertip. He spent just half a day to deduce the Void Sword Origin Energy to the fifth level realm.
‘I shall carve those that are useful to me in my heart. This original copy is no longer useful to me. I shall return back and properly meditate and consolidate on what I just learned, and I reckon I would be able to reach the peak stage God Monarch Realm in about three to five years time.’ Xue Ying stood. He directly pushed open the stone door to the meditation room.
…
The stone door rumbled and opened.
“Tutor Flying Snow, why have you come out so quickly?” That green-robed protector immediately hurried over.
“This is the original copy.” Xue Ying passed it over.
The green-robed protector received it before checking at the scripture. Only then did he smile: “Tutor Flying Snow, there are currently quite a few people waiting for Tutor Flying Snow outside the Scripture Library. I believe that Tutor Flying Snow would most likely startle them given how early you exited.”
“Waiting for me?” Xue Ying felt puzzled.
“One of them include Bat Mountain Master.” The green-robed protector transmitted over.
Xue Ying felt his heart moving.
Bat Mountain Master?
That was an expert that ranked in the top ten within High Mountain City too. Xue Ying had killed three subordinates of that party not too long ago! Xue Ying would definitely not show any mercy to those who wanted to reap his life! Furthermore, he had prepared himself for dealing with Bat Mountain Master. It’s a pity that Bat Mountain Master had not acted ever since.
“Many thanks. I wonder who you are?” Xue Ying smiled at this green-robed protector.
“I am Imperial Wind Wen Yi.” The green-robed protector transmitted back.
“Oh, so you are a disciple from the Imperial Wind Clan.” Xue Ying said. Those who could take on the important responsibility as a protector of the Scripture Library were not weak.
“A disciple of the Imperial Wind Clan? There are many members of the Imperial Wind Clan since its emergence.” The green-robed protector smiled, “I am merely from the side branch of the clan. I was merely able to reach the early stage God Monarch Realm barely currently. No matter how hard I cultivated, it is tough for me to improve any further. I wonder if it is possible for me to ask from Tutor Flying Snow for some guidance?”
Xue Ying glanced at him, causing this green-robed protector to feel apprehensive.
“You may come visit me when you have the time.” Finishing his words, Xue Ying left the hall.
If this was before he learned the scripture, Xue Ying would not dare to guide others. But after learning it, he had some understanding of the Dao of Void in this world and could at least guide others.
The green-robed protector revealed a joyous look.
This was the path of cultivation! Any cultivator would make use of all opportunities to improve. They knew that Ascendants usually had a deep understanding of cultivation. Hence, their guidance would usually target the essence.
“Mn?”
After Xue Ying walked out from the Scripture Library, he could see several other cultivators seated sporadically around, of which one was a ugly triangular-headed old man who was seated with a white-robed middle-aged man. Both of them were currently chatting and drinking.
Because he had once scoured through the memories of a God Monarch that attacked him in the past, Xue Ying naturally recognized that ugly triangular-headed old man--Bat Mountain Master.

chapters.title: Chapter 1280 - Mountaintop Battle Platform
chapters.content:
Chapter 1280: Mountaintop Battle Platform
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Not only did Xue Ying recognize Bat Mountain Master, he also recognized the other expert seated opposite of Bat Mountain Master, ‘God Monarch Jian Yin’. Bat Mountain Master was one of the few Cultivation Tutors in High Mountain Imperial Wind Clan. Both his status and Bat Mountain Master’s are very unique. Because both of them are publicly acknowledged as one of the ten strongest existences across the entire High Mountain City!
One had to know that even though it was tough to reach the peak stage God Monarch realm, there were still more than 20 of such experts in High Mountain City! Nonetheless, there were only a few who could be ranked in the top--the City Master, the Young Master ‘Imperial Wind Lei’, Housekeeper Tong, Xing Pavilion Master, God Monarch Jian Yin, and Bat Mountain Master. The other God Monarchs were relatively similar in strength. It was hard to determine the true top ten unless a true life and death battle happened.
Publicly acknowledgment represented these six who were clearly stronger than the others!
“Mn?”
“God Monarch Flying Snow is out!”
“He actually came out so soon? I thought he would stay within the Scripture Library for at least one or two years.”
Scattered across the place, quite a few people brightened up when they saw Xue Ying come out. This included Bat Mountain Master and God Monarch Jian Yin.
The natives of the Divine Realm were born with an eternal life. To them, ‘three to five years’ were incredibly short! It was normal for the length of perusing a scripture within the Scripture Library to last one or two years.
“Hahaha…” The laughter of Bat Mountain Master was ear-piercing, echoing in the surroundings.
“What is so funny, Bat Mountain Master?” Xue Ying asked, cutting off the laughter by Bat Mountain Master.
Only then did Bat Mountain Master stand. He grinned at Xue Ying: “I’ve heard that another Ascendant has come to our High Mountain City once again. Today after meeting God Monarch Flying Snow, you are indeed extraordinary.”
“He is very extraordinary.” The white-robed middle-aged male chuckled by his side, “How could any ordinary expert eliminate three of your chaps so easily?”
The expression of Bat Mountain Master became slightly rigid.
Xue Ying turned to the other middle-aged male: “God Monarch Jian Yin?”
“God Monarch Flying Snow actually recognized me?” The white-robed middle-aged male gave a strange laughter, “It seems God Monarch Flying Snow has a pretty good source of information.”
“How could I not know of the famous God Monarch Jian Yin?” Xue Ying laughed.
“God Monarch Flying Snow.” The ugly triangular-headed old man ‘Bat Mountain Master’ said with a hoarse voice, “Three of my subordinates have gone over previously to ask for your advice. I wonder if they are still alive?”
At this moment, the entire place became silent.
The others did not dare to intervene. Even God Monarch Jian Yin was watching by the side.
“They came to kill me, and I am here standing all well and alive. Do you think they are alive?” Xue Ying looked at Bat Mountain Master.
Bat Mountain Master frowned slightly. He replied with a hoarse voice: “Oh, then I do want to see how strong God Monarch Flying Snow is. What do you think about sparring?”
“Alright.”
Xue Ying nodded.
Many observers revealed looks of excitement. They naturally looked forward to a battle between two great experts. Didn’t they all rush over to see this spectacle?
