One was publicly acknowledged as ranking in the top ten within High Mountain City, while the other was an Ascendant whose strength was mysterious yet could kill three God Monarchs easily.
‘It seems this Bat Mountain Master is incredibly wary.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Previously, he did not dare to deal against me after I killed his subordinates. Instead, he came over to the Imperial Wind Clan to ask if I wanted to spar with him.’
The other three God Monarchs assassinated him, and were hence killed by him.
If Bat Mountain Master acted in the past! And Xue Ying retaliated, it would be normal for one party to fall.
But doing it within the Imperial Wind Clan ensured no deaths. Even ‘sparring’ was done on a specially-arranged battle platform. By sparring, they were only competing to see who was stronger, and reaping the life of the other party was forbidden.
‘This Bat Mountain Master should be skeptical about his strength. That was why he chose to arrange a spar with me within the Imperial Wind Clan. If the verdict after the battle is that he is confident of killing me, he would most likely do so in the dark after I left the Imperial Wind Clan?’ Xue Ying sneered. He did not place this Bat Mountain Master in his eyes. He came to this world primarily for cultivation.
By cultivating in different civilizations, he would also be tempering himself and gaining new experiences so as to grasp the Eternal Dao, jump out of the cage and become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform!
…
The entire Imperial Wind Clan started moving.
“Hurry up! Bat Mountain Master is about to begin fighting with God Monarch Flying Snow over at the battle platform on Lighting Mountain Peak.”
“Let’s hurry over!”
“Bat Mountain Master has suffered from a huge loss previously. He is finally moving after all these while.”
Many disciples of Imperial Wind Clan immediately rushed over to the ‘Lightning Mountain Peak Battle Platform’ meant for sparring by the Imperial Wind Clan.
And at this moment, at a certain garden of the Imperial Wind Clan.
A young man with white tender skin walked side by side with a girl in emerald gown. That girl in emerald gown was none other than ‘Imperial Wind Qing Yin’.
“Little Sister.” The young man muttered, “Are you still angry?”
“Haven’t I said before that I’ll hear everything that Father, Big Brother and Second Brother said?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin answered.
The young man softly nodded: “It is indeed the incapability of our Imperial Wind Clan that we are forced to marry you with that Ninth Prince from the Eastern Wood City.”
“Let’s not talk about this anymore. I do not blame Father. Neither do I blame Big Brother or Second Brother.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin turned to her second brother, “Actually, watching the internal struggle within High Mountain City and after venturing into the Great Wilderness, I know that the strong feasts on the weak. Currently, we are weak when faced with that Devil Heart Cult Master. Let’s not talk about these, Second Brother, when are you leaving for Eastern Wood City?”
“I am still preparing.” Imperial Wind Jin said, “I have to get ready many gifts and think of ways to ensure that this matter will go smoothly. Ai, even though we have agreed to let you, little sister, get married to that Ninth Prince, whether Eastern Wood City will agree is another matter.”
Imperial Wind Qing Yin nodded softly. She smiled: “That’s right. It is another matter if they agree or not.”
Even if she took the initiative of wanting to get married to the other party, the other party might not accept!
“Mn?” Imperial Wind Jin suddenly revealed a look of astonishment. He said, “Little Sister, I just got the news that the Ascendant you saved, God Monarch Flying Snow, is heading to the Lightning Mountain Peak Battle Platform with Bat Mountain Master. Apparently, they are about to spar.”
“Oh? God Monarch Flying Snow? Bat Mountain Master?” A strand of curiosity appeared on Imperial Wind Qing Yin.
“Go go go, let us go and have a look.” Imperial Wind Jin said.
Getting married to the remote Eastern Wood City was a matter he had to inform Imperial Wind Qing Yin and get her willingness to participate.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin might seem to comply with them, but these few days, her mood was clearly gloomy! Imperial Wind Jin wanted to bring his little sister over to watch the ‘spar between God Monarch Flying Snow and Bat Mountain Master’ so as to drive away her moodiness.
******
Lightning Mountain was located at the north-west corner of the Imperial Wind Clan territory.
There was a battle platform situated on the peak of Lightning Mountain. This platform was used specially for sparring.
When Imperial Wind Jin brought his little sister ‘Imperial Wind Qing Yin’ over to the Lightning Mountain Peak, there was already a great number of spectators gathered--more than 10,000 in number. Fortunately, they were within the Imperial Wind Clan and not anyone is qualified to enter their grounds! If this was a public battle in the city, the number of spectators would most likely be at least 10,000 more!
“Third Sister.”
After Imperial Wind Jin and Imperial Wind Qing Yin arrived, they heard a familiar voice. Glancing over, they saw a huge and muscular Imperial Wind Lei seated not too far away.
“Big Brother.”
“Big Brother.” The two of them rushed over.
“Have a seat.” Imperial Wind Lei loved his little sister dearly. He felt slightly guilty in his heart. Being a proud person, he was forced to rely on his little sister to get his entire clan out of their current predicament. He felt humiliated because of this.
“Who would have thought that so many people have come to watch the spar. This spar was actually agreed spontaneously, and quite a few experts within High Mountain City are still in closed-door cultivation and haven’t heard of this news.” Imperial Wind Jin swept across lamenting about it, “Even so, there are so many people here already.”
Imperial Wind Qing Yin looked distantly at that battle platform.
There were currently two figures facing each other on the platform.
‘I wonder how strong is this God Monarch Flying Snow.’ Bat Mountain Master squinted at Xue Ying, scheming in his heart, ‘If his strength is terrifyingly strength, at least I would only lose my reputation if I lost the battle here. I wouldn’t lose my life! But if he is much weaker than me, hmph hmph hmph! He will get a taste of what he did to my subordinates in a few days.”
Bat Mountain Master was a cunning person. He was also incredibly careful.
“God Monarch Flying Snow, defeat Bat Mountain Master!” A clear distinct voice was heard.
Xue Ying looked over with astonishment. He saw Imperial Wind Qing Yin currently shouting out from afar. At the same time, she was also smiling, seemingly looking forward to the battle.
“Third Lady seems to be looking forward to the battle?” Xue Ying laughed. How would he know that Imperial Wind Qing Yin was shouting out just so to vent the oppression in her heart.
“Hmph.”
Bat Mountain Master frowned when he heard this shout. He merely endured once he noticed the words shouted by Third Lady.
“God Monarch Flying Snow, it seems Third Lady regards you quite favorably? I do want to see how strong you are.” Bat Mountain Master’s hoarse voice sounded. Even as his voice was still reverberating in the arena, he had executed his move silently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1281 - Bat Dragon Swimming Away
chapters.content:
Chapter 1281: Bat Dragon Swimming Away
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The moment they finished talking, the battle started.
All spectators that had already seated down around the battle platform began concentrating. Even the proud Imperial Wind Lei and other experts like God Monarch Jian Yin were focusing on the battle because Bat Mountain Master had a strength comparable to them.
“Hu!”
A terrifying frost descended without sign, engulfing around Xue Ying and condensing into an ice mountain 33 meters tall!
“He was struck by the technique just like that?”
“He did not even succeed in breaking out of the technique?”
Both Imperial Wind Lei and Imperial Wind Jin were startled. Imperial Wind Qing Yin became nervous. Who in High Mountain City did not know that ‘Bat Mountain Master’ was a master of ice? His techniques were executed without any signs. With a thought, he could easily freeze a tall mountain 500 kilometers before shattering it into pieces! In the Divine Realm, any grit of soil or stone was extraordinary. A mountain spanning across 500 kilometers… was something even Cosmos Gods had to spend a long time to destroy. Yet Bat Mountain Master could do so with a thought, showing how powerful he was.
And now, Xue Ying had been fully frozen into a tall ice mountain 33 meters tall. This was also the limit to what Bat Mountain Master could suppress his technique to!
“Just this slight power?” A voice sounded. One could see that frozen figure strangely walking out. The ice mountain remained perfectly undamaged.
Xue Ying walked out and smiled at Bat Mountain Master: “Bat Mountain Master, there’s no point using such futile techniques. Let me witness your Bat Dragon.”
His current control of the void in this world had reached a point where he could void-ify his body completely easily.
Completely void-ifying his body--turning his body into one entity with the void!
How could the ice mountain trap the void?
Even though that frost energy have an incredibly strong corrosive power, after being weakened by void-ification, Xue Ying’s Chaotic Origin Refined Body easily withstood it.
“Do you think it is that easy to witness my Bat Dragon?” Bat Mountain Master sneered.
“Peng!”
The ice mountain exploded.
One could see 300 ice shuttles condensing in the void. Every ice shuttle contained concentric circles of black mark. If one carefully examined them, those black marks were actually formed from countless inscriptions. At the same time that these ice shuttles form, they shot out at Xue Ying.
And Xue Ying immediately flew out in an arc.
“Shua!”
His flying motion was rapid. Even though those ice shuttles moved at a fast pace, the ‘arcs’ that Xue Ying traveled along were too ‘fine’. He easily evaded those ice shuttles.
“He is indeed an Ascendant. The way he utilizes his techniques is simply too profound. Even though Bat Mountain Master might seem stronger, he could not touch God Monarch Flying Snow at all.” Many spectators gasped in surprise. Just the way Xue Ying executed his movement techniques sufficed in making them exclaim in admiration.
“Mn?”
Bat Mountain Master stood afar. Watching the other party easily fly along a slender arc evading all ice shuttles he fired at him, furthermore, the other party was also inching closer to where he stood. This caused Bat Mountain Master to pale, ‘It seems this Hundred Slaughter Extermination Array is ineffective.’ This was also his best group attack technique. Every ice shuttle was incredibly strong, and with 300 shuttles sweeping across the place, a huge group of enemies would fall before them.
Even though this technique specialized in dealing against a crowd, it showed miraculous effects when dealing against a lone enemy too. Nonetheless, God Monarch Flying Snow’s movement technique was too formidable. He easily evaded all those shuttles.
“Hong.”
That arc soon condensed out into a human figure.
Xue Ying pierced his spear on an ice shuttle right in front of him. The spearhead clashed against the shuttle, forming a void bubble that caused this shuttle to decompose. It soon turned into a ‘black point’. And with a pierce, it easily caused the shuttle to explode!
‘Every ice shuttle contains the strength of an early stage God Monarch.’ Xue Ying made his judgment, ‘With 300 of them working together? Even though every shuttle is moving too directly, with sufficient quantity, this weakness can be covered. I wonder how strong is his Bat Dragon, a technique that he is famous for.’
After deliberately testing out the strength of this ice shuttle.
Xue Ying’s figure flashed. He charged right at Bat Mountain Master. Xue Ying’s spear struck out like an illusion.
“Hou~”
That triangular head of Bat Mountain Master remained as ugly as ever. He stared at the incoming spear and abruptly roared out.
At the same point as he roared, his triangular head started warping. Many black scales began sprouting out and turning into a triangular black scaly head. His body soon manifested into a long slender body that had a pair of sharp claws.
This was a beast spanning across 330 meters. It was covered entirely in black scales, and was a flying beast called--’Bat Dragon’!
At the same time the Bat Dragon roared, it charged out at Xue Ying.
“Hong!”
The spearhead clashed with one of the Bat Dragon’s claws.
An enormous void bubble appeared, enveloping around the entire Bat Dragon. This bubble attempted to shrink! But the black scales covering the Bat Dragon contained the revolution of countless inscriptions that simply formed a layer of frost armor. “Peng.” Even with the furious pierce by Xue Ying, and the explosion of the collapsing void bubble, only some parts of the frost armor covering the Bat Dragon shattered. The scales on the Bat Dragon remained perfectly undamaged.
“Ascendant, are you tickling me as a middle stage God Monarch?” This Bat Dragon roared. Its tail formed a shadow image as it lashed out at Xue Ying.
…
Xue Ying’s control of his strength was perfect. Whenever he executed his technique like the void bubble, it did not spread out to its surroundings! Like previously when Xue Ying dealt with those three God Monarchs that assassinated him, he did not even produce any shockwaves that might cause his residence walls to collapse!
Even though Bat Mountain Master had an alright control of his strength, at this moment after turning into a ‘Bat Dragon’, just a slight bit of his power had caused the ground to shake. The entire battle platform was constantly vibrating.
“Hong hong hong~”
Both parties continued battling, forming sounds of ringing along the way.
This was a battle platform meant for sparring. Hence, it had arrays covering it and isolating any shockwaves from the battle.
“What a terrifying shockwave.”
The spectators paled as they watched.
That Bat Dragon of 330 meters long swam within the battle platform chasing after God Monarch Flying Snow furiously. Every single strike by the Bat Dragon brought with it a terrifying strength. And it appeared that God Monarch Flying Snow could not injure this ‘Bat Dragon’ at all.
“This Bat Dragon Body that Bat Mountain Master cultivated is amazing.” Imperial Wind Lei praised, “God Monarch Flying Snow’s control of his strength is incredibly exquisite too. Even though he is merely able to unleash the strength of a middle stage God Monarch and is on the disadvantaged end, he hasn’t suffered from any injuries.”
“So what if he remains perfectly fine? He can’t even injure Bat Mountain Master.” The younger brother Imperial Wind Jin shook his head.
“Bat Mountain Master is ultimately one of the few experts within High Mountain City.” Imperial Wind Lei retorted, “God Monarch Flying Snow is amazing enough to achieve this outcome in the battle. If he could attain the strength of a peak God Monarch, the one who would suffer is definitely Bat Mountain Master! Mn?”
“This is--”
The spectators were aghast at this moment.
Because God Monarch Flying Snow who had always been pursued after by the Bat Dragon, had suddenly raised his spear with both his hands before hacking down on the other party!
“Si la~”
After this furious hack, the trajectory traveled by the spear tore out a spatial crack that lashed out on the body of the Bat Dragon. The frost armor covering that body immediately exploded. Even his black scales were torn. In the end, a vicious-looking wound was formed with large amounts of fresh blood spurting out.
“What?” The spectators were shocked. Bat Mountain Master was even more frightening, ‘He could injure me?’
Bat Mountain Master was too careful. He was too afraid of death.
At the next moment, he immediately altered his combat strategy. Now, he began swimming away at an extremely fast speed. He had currently placed survival as the primary objective with the occasional slash of his claws or sneak attack with his tail!
‘It is quite rare to meet someone so afraid of death.’ Xue Ying sneered.
The technique he just executed was the strongest killing move he had after grasping the <Sky-Rending Void Sword Technique>.
After all, with a scripture he could refer to, his rate of learning had greatly improved. He could understand the laws and profound mysteries of the Dao of Void in this world at a faster speed. Given his foundation, his rate of deduction was quick too. Xue Ying had even condensed the fifth layer of the ‘Void Sword Origin Energy’ easily. By relying on this newfound comprehension and his own accumulations, he created this new ‘Sky-Rending Void Technique’.
This technique was barely at the peak stage God Monarch strength! Though Xue Ying’s control of strength was exquisite, allowing him to injure even the ‘Bat Dragon Body’ of Bat Mountain Master.
“Hong hong hong~”
Both parties continued fighting for dozen more exchanges.
Bat Mountain Master was unable to injure Xue Ying previously. Now that he was on alert, it was even harder for him to injure Xue Ying at all! And this new technique of Xue Ying, the ‘Sky-Rending Void Technique’ had struck Bat Mountain Master once every three to five rounds! And every single strike caused pieces of flesh from Bat Mountain Master to fly.
“Stop stop stop! That meandering ‘Bat Dragon’ shouted out as it flew in the sky.
Xue Ying stopped with astonishment.
At the next moment, the Bat Dragon immediately transforming and shrinking. It eventually turned into that triangular-headed ugly old man, ‘Bat Mountain Master’.
Bat Mountain Master was filled with a smile. He sighed in admiration: “God Monarch Flying Snow is truly amazing. I admit defeat. You have won this spear. God Monarch Flying Snow is indeed stronger by than me by an entire level!”
Xue Ying was startled momentarily.
The other party truly did not care about losing his face.
“Good. God Monarch Flying Snow and Bat Mountain Master are really formidable experts. Today, not only did I get to witness Bat Mountain Master’s ‘Bat Dragon’, I get the honor of witnessing God Monarch Flying Snow’s spear technique as well.” Imperial Wind Lei stood up and exclaimed with a smile.
“Crown Prince, it is God Monarch Flying Snow’s spear technique that is amazing. I doubt I could survive after a few bouts of his techniques.” Bat Mountain Master’s hoarse voice could be heard accompanied with a giddy laughter.
And at this moment, standing by the side of her two senior brothers, Imperial Wind Qing Yin was looking at Xue Ying with shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 1282 - Taking up a Teacher
chapters.content:
Chapter 1282: Taking up a Teacher
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Imperial Wind Qing Yin felt complex. Initially, it was her kindness that led her save Xue Ying in Great Wilderness. It was also her admiration and respect for someone that dared to venture into the Great Wilderness alone.
Thereafter when she found out that Xue Ying was an ‘Ascendant’, her curiosity for him grew.
In addition…
Xue Ying had just landed on this world. In order for him to assimilate himself into this world quickly, he stealthily casted some Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm technique. Even though it was not done fully without restraints, it had greatly increased his ‘charm’. That time on the huge ship which Xue Ying took out of the Great Wilderness, an absolute majority of guards held favorable feelings for Xue Ying. Only an extreme few like ‘Tie Cheng Liu’ disliked Xue Ying.
And ‘Imperial Wind Qing Yin’ who was influenced by the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm became even more favorable to Xue Ying! She even took the initiative to invite Xue Ying as a Cultivation Tutor.
‘I haven’t had thought that he would be so formidable.’ Imperial Wind Qing Yin thought.
“God Monarch Flying Snow.” Imperial Wind Lei said with a clear bright laughter.
“Hu hu.”
Xue Ying and Bat Mountain Master both flew out of the battle platform and came to the side of Imperial Wind Lei.
“Crown Prince.” Xue Ying and Bat Mountain Master bowed slightly.
“God Monarch Flying Snow, this is where you are wrong. You have been so low-profiled previously. Who would have thought that you are so strong--even stronger than Bat Mountain Master.” Imperial Wind Lei laughed at Xue Ying.
“Talking about that, I do have to thank Crown Prince and Third Lady.” Xue Ying stated.
“Thank me?” Imperial Wind Lei felt startled. Imperial Wind Qing Yin was similarly stunned; her mouth was wide open.
Xue Ying continued with a smile: “Actually, I would have been on the disadvantaged end when fighting with Bat Mountain Master previously. It’s because of Crown Prince and Third Lady that I could take on the role as a Cultivation Tutor. And consequently, I was able to exchange for a scripture called <Sky-Rending Void Sword Technique> within the Scripture Library. It was this scripture that inspired me to comprehend a new killing technique, boosting my strength to a whole new level beyond Bat Mountain Master.”
“What?” Bat Mountain Master felt astonished. The other party comprehended a new killing technique after perusing a scripture in the Scripture Library? In other words, God Monarch Flying Snow was weaker than he just before the other party entered the Scripture Library?
And it was because he had been too careful that led to his action of ‘initiating a spar’ within the Imperial Wind Clan that brought about his defeat?
‘No matter what, I can’t injure him even if I acted earlier on.’ Bat Mountain Master consoled himself.
Xue Ying continued talking to Imperial Wind Lei and Imperial Wind Qing Yin: “That is why I have to thank Crown Prince and Third Lady! Especially Third Lady for saving me when I was at my weakest moment.”
“Haha, this is fate.” Imperial Wind Lei laughed, “How about this, God Monarch Flying Snow, Bat Mountain Master, God Monarch Jian Yin, and fellow ladies and gentlemen, all of you are invited to my Floating Mountain Palace. I’ll be hosting a banquet tonight celebrating the addition of a new expert--God Monarch Flying Snow--in our High Mountain City.”
…
High above High Mountain City, there were three floating mountains. The energy holding them up was an array at the center.
Imperial Wind Clan constructed a palace above these mountains, transforming this place into the most luxurious entertainment ground in High Mountain City. Currently, there were many experts gathered here in the Floating Mountain Palace. The reason why so many God Monarchs came is to befriend ‘God Monarch Flying Snow’, someone who could even suppress Bat Mountain Master.
“God Monarch Flying Snow, this one is called Chuan Qing. I am just an unremarkable soldier from the Mysterious Fire Army stationed in High Mountain City.” A silver-haired old man chuckled.
“So it is God Monarch Chuang Qing from the Mysterious Fire Army.” Xue Ying acknowledged with surprise.
After scouring through the memories, Xue Ying had a deeper understanding of the various organizations within High Mountain City. He was also relatively familiar with the experts within this place. This ‘Mysterious Fire Army’ represented one of the three transcendental Great Royal Clans in the entire Divine Realm, the ‘Golden Sacred Clan’. Even though the three Great Royal Clans were transcendental and rarely participated in any struggle of the organizations under the world, they still relied on various methods to influence the Divine Realm.
For instance, the ‘Heaven’s Will Clan’. There would be a ‘Heaven’s Will Pavilion’ in almost every great city. For instance, one of the famous great experts in High Mountain City, ‘Xing Pavilion Master’, was the pavilion master of the Heaven’s Will Pavilion located in High Mountain City.
Or the ‘Golden Sacred Clan’ for instance. There would similarly be a small team from the Mysterious Fire Army in almost every huge cities. Most often, they were a team of five. This slight strength would naturally not influence the outcome of any competition between huge organizations. But it would allow the Golden Sacred Clan to have a greater understanding of the world.
“God Monarch Flying Snow, your battle with Bat Mountain Master has happened too quickly. I haven’t had the time to come and spectate before it ended.” Xing Pavilion Master came over to talk to Xue Ying too.
Many experts came to interact with them.
Those who dared to come without any invitation were at least a God Monarch.
Everyone was clear that this huge expert would definitely be able to influence the competition between various organizations in the High Mountain City. In the Divine Realm, ‘teleportation’ had already become a legend! When two cities battled, they had to fly slowly on their battleships before arriving at the battlefield! Just the time taken to fly would take an incredibly long amount of time. Furthermore, they had to bypass the Great Wilderness.
Hence, it was quite rare for great cities to enter into a war.
A great city was like a nation! Like Xing Pavilion Master and God Monarch Chuang Qing, even though behind them was the royal clan, they had long taken root in High Mountain City.
“God Monarch Flying Snow.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin took the initiative to come. She reached the side of Xue Ying before sitting down. There were many other attendants who hurried to pour wine for her.
“Third Lady.” Xue Ying revealed a grin. In the entire High Mountain City, the person whom he had the most favorable feelings for was this Third Lady.
“God Monarch Flying Snow is really impressive! So many God Monarchs are treating you so enthusiastically. Even my Big Brother has gifted you a residence and many attendants.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin muttered with slight melancholy.
Xue Ying was stunned.
This tone did not seem right. He could only deal with it with a smile: “If not for Third Lady’s timely rescue, I might still be trying to survive in the Great Wilderness.”
“Given your strength, God Monarch Flying Snow, I believe you could easily arrive at the nearest Great City after you endured through the most dangerous period.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin softly snorted, “You do know that the previous time I left the High Mountain City is for the goal of seeking Dawn Religion Master as my teacher?”
“I don’t.” Xue Ying felt apprehensive inwardly. Why would I know that you are seeking for a teacher?
Imperial Wind Qing Yin’s eyes were moving rapidly. She softly continued: “It’s a pity that Dawn Religion Master wasn’t willing to accept me as his disciple. That’s right too since I haven’t broken through to the God Monarch Realm yet I have a pile of other issues. Why would Dawn Religion Master accept me?”
Xue Ying continued listening from the side without intervening.
“Not too long from now, I would be visiting Eastern Wood City, or…” Imperial Wind Qing Yin’s voice became softer. No matter what the outcome was, whether she would become a plaything of that Ninth Prince from the Eastern Wood City or for Eastern Wood City to decline them, the Imperial Wind Clan would still face an impending disaster. It was highly unlikely for Imperial Wind Qing Yin to get a teacher any longer after that.
“God Monarch Flying Snow.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin said.
“Mn?” Xue Ying was startled.
“Can you be my teacher?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin suddenly asked.
“Become your teacher?” Xue Ying was startled, “Third Lady, what you cultivate is your bloodline. Is it related to the Void?”
“It isn’t.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin replied.
“Then I can’t really teach you much.” Xue Ying felt helpless.
“I am just asking if you can be my teacher?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin stared at Xue Ying.
“I am a Cultivation Tutor of the Imperial Wind Clan. If Third Lady requires me to provide some guidance, I naturally could do so.” Xue Ying replied.
“I need a true teacher.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin continued staring at Xue Ying.
Xue Ying felt as if this little miss of a great clan had fallen into some sort of remembrance. But to accept her as his disciple? Xue Ying hesitated momentarily before nodding with a smile: “Alright. I can accept Third Lady as my disciple.”
He owed this Third Lady a favor. So let he acquiesce to her request!
He came to this world as a guest without the desire to accept any disciples. But since he owed Third Lady a favor, even if he did not accept the other party as a disciple, he would still find an opportunity to repay this favor.
“Qing Yin formally greets Teacher.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin immediately stood and gave a formal kowtow.
Xue Ying accepted this kowtow.
And not too far away, both brothers Imperial Wind Lei and Imperial Wind Jin watched silently. They were clear that the only opportunity for the entire ‘Imperial Wind Clan’ to survive was with Eastern Wood Clan! Even though their little sister would suffer from a fate worse than death given the reputation of the Ninth Prince from Eastern Wood City, they had no choice. They were doing so for the survival of everyone in the Imperial Wind Clan.
Take on a teacher?
This God Monarch Flying Snow was a great expert ranked in the forefront of the entire High Mountain City. It was not a disgrace for Third Lady from the Imperial Wind Clan to take on this expert as her teacher.
“How many of these people would really live and die for our Imperial Wind Clan.” Imperial Wind Lei and Imperial Wind Jin watched at the various God Monarchs in the palace hall.
The disciples of the Imperial Wind Clan were born with the imprint of ‘Imperial Wind Clan’
But many other experts might perhaps fend off the enemy for the Imperial Wind Clan in the beginning, but the moment the city could barely hold off any longer, those experts might choose to stand by the side. For ‘Devil Heart Cult Master’ to grasp this city, he would require a huge number of experts too. Devil Heart Cult would not be willing to accept a dead city either. Hence, the experts like ‘Bat Mountain Master’, ‘Xing Pavilion Master’, ‘God Monarch Jian Yin’, and many others…
The controller of the city could change!
But these experts would remain!
…
After taking on a teacher, Imperial Wind Qing Yin was clearly feeling better. She chatted with Xue Ying on many topics, and Xue Ying was also listening to her.
Finally, it was the end of the banquet.
Xue Ying left along with the crowd. It was at this moment that Bat Mountain Master came to the side of Xue Ying. He transmitted a message with a smile: “Brother Flying Snow, the reason why my Bat Mountain had some conflict with you previously is all because of a brat called Tie Cheng Liu.”
“Tie Cheng Liu?” Xue Ying nodded slightly. After scouring through the memories, he had found out about the truth. He knew of that protector who was filled with hatred and dislike for him on that huge ship despite him releasing his ‘charm’.
“I wish to ask Brother Flying Snow how you want to deal with Tie Cheng Liu? I originally wanted to kill him directly, but I wish to ask Brother Flying Snow for your opinion on this.” Bat Mountain Master transmitted over.

chapters.title: Chapter 1283 - Venting out his anger
chapters.content:
Chapter 1283: Venting out his anger
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“How do I want to deal with him?” Xue Ying looked at Bat Mountain Master.
“We will act according to how Brother Flying Snow wishes to.” Bat Mountain Master transmitted back.
Xue Ying felt that this Bat Mountain Master did not have any ‘pride seeped in his bones’ as an expert. But even though Bat Mountain Master did not have this pride, it did not alter the fact that the other party was one of the numerous experts in High Mountain City. It was hard for Xue Ying to handle the other party prior to using his ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’! And after probing through the memories, Xue Ying had never heard of anybody who was incredibly talented in soul techniques, at least in High Mountain City.
Hence, Xue Ying would not use his soul technique when dealing with any experts! Because the moment he did so, this news would leak and he would no longer be having any peaceful days after that.
“I wish to meet this Tie Cheng Liu first.” Xue Ying transmitted back.
“Good good good. That Tie Cheng Liu is currently at my Bat Mountain.” Bat Mountain Master was being incredibly cordial.
Both parties then left Floating Mountain Palace for Bat Mountain.
…
Bat Mountain occupied a relatively huge area within High Mountain City. It had a chain of structures and a large number of subordinates.
Inside a huge palace.
Xue Ying entered with Bat Mountain Master. There was already several God Monarchs waiting inside.
“Why aren’t you all greeting God Monarch Flying Snow?” The moment Bat Mountain Master entered, he shouted.
“Greetings, God Monarch Flying Snow.” These God Monarchs bowed politely.
The higher-ups of Bat Mountain had heard of it before. Their leader, ‘Bat Mountain Master’ actually lost to God Monarch Flying Snow by an entire level during the spar! Bat Mountain Master was injured despite transforming into his ‘Bat Dragon Form’. And God Monarch Flying Snow remained perfectly fine! This made they, who respected ‘Bat Mountain Master’, similarly reverent of God Monarch Flying Snow.
“Brother Flying Snow, hurry up, have a seat.” Bat Mountain Master enthusiastically urged Xue YIng over. Both he and Xue Ying were seated at the highest throne positions.
After getting seated, Bat Mountain Master roared out: “Bring that Tie Cheng Liu over!”
“Yes.”
Very soon.
Tie Cheng Liu was brought over. He was currently shackled. As he moved, he staggered and stumbled. He was pale and was soon chained to the great hall. Looking up, he saw both Bat Mountain Master seated with Xue Ying at the throne positions.
“How could this be?” Tie Cheng Liu was stunned.
Did Bat Mountain Master not sent experts over to assassinate God Monarch Flying Snow? Did he not lose three powerful God Monarchs in the process? Given such huge losses, both parties should have become enemies. Why would Bat Mountain Master invite God Monarch Flying Snow over, and even ask him to sit at the highest position?
He was clear how grave the loss was to ‘Bat Mountain’ when three God Monarchs died. These days, he had been tortured really pitifully, and was clear how furious Bat Mountain was.
“I originally wanted to sentence you to death.” Bat Mountain Master looked down and said with a cold, hoarse voice, “But Brother Flying Snow wishes to meet you. That is why you survived until now.”
“Brother Flying Snow?” Tie Cheng Liu felt his heart becoming filled with rage when he heard that.
Bat Mountain Master! You are a great expert publicly acknowledged as one of the top ten rankers in High Mountain City. After losing three God Monarchs, you still called the ‘murderer’ your brother? Do you even care about your reputation?
“Tie Cheng Liu, I doubt we have ever met before we encounter each other on that ship.” Xue Ying said.
“We are total strangers.” Tie Cheng Liu muttered.
“I doubt we have ever become enemies before.” Xue Ying asked.
“Indeed we haven’t.” Tie Cheng Liu nodded.
“We haven’t even spoken a single sentence prior to today as well.” Xue Ying continued.
“Yes.” Tie Cheng Liu acknowledged.
On the ship, Xue Ying relied on his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm to boost his charm. Only a select few did not have any favorable feelings towards Xue Ying. And out of everyone, only this Tie Cheng Liu showed dislike towards Xue Ying. Xue Ying did not care about it either in the past.
“You haven’t even spoken a single word with Brother Flying Snow yet you wish for his death?” Bat Mountain Master could not help but commented on this.
“That’s right. I am curious about this matter too.” Xue Ying looked at Tie Cheng Liu, “Is it because of your Junior Disciple Sister?”
The moment Tie Cheng Liu heard the words ‘Junior Disciple Sister’, his expression became ugly. Madness filled his eyes as he sneered at Xue Ying: “God Monarch Flying Snow is really acute.”
Xue Ying nodded.
He knew after probing through the memories that there had been an Ascendant that came previously to the High Mountain City. And at that time, three came at once! A male brought along two wives with him. One man and two women, they were all Ascendants. That male Ascendant was called ‘God Monarch Dong Fang’, and both his wives were incredibly outstanding and beautiful. They had stayed within the High Mountain City for an incredibly long period.
At that time, Tie Cheng Liu had a junior disciple sister called ‘God Monarch Xiao Shuang’ who was once saved by ‘God Monarch Dong Fang’. Furthermore, both parties gradually became closer and eventually, God Monarch Dong Fang announced that he would be marrying God Monarch Xiao Shuang.
God Monarch Xiao Shuang was also an early stage God Monarch.
Instead, ‘Tie Cheng Liu’ who was a Senior Disciple Brother, was merely at the peak stage God General Realm! He was weaker by an entire level. Tie Cheng Liu had completely fallen for his junior disciple sister, though it was unrequited.
After God Monarch Dong Fang wedded ‘God Monarch Xiao Shuang’, Tie Cheng Liu began harboring hatred. He began selling his treasures to purchase poison and sought to poison God Monarch Dong Fang! God Monarch Dong Fang was even injured as a result. But as a form of respect for God Monarch Xiao Shuang, he did not kill Tie Cheng Liu. Instead, he sealed the strength of Tie Cheng Liu completely, hanging him on a flagpole within a pub in High Mountain City for a full three days. During this period, nobody dared to release Tie Cheng Liu.
“She is my Junior Disciple Sister!” Tie Cheng Liu gritted his teeth, “That time, my father accepted her and taught her how to cultivate. That is how she could reach where she is currently. She is originally mine. It is that God Monarch Dong Fang who was so shameless and despicable that he stole my wife.”
“She isn’t your wife. God Monarch Xiao Shuang has never regarded you highly at all.” Bat Mountain Master sneered.
“If not for my father, would she have this day?” The eyes of Tie Cheng Liu became red, “My father fell in the Great Wilderness, yet she has entirely forgotten about him!”
“God Monarch Xiao Shuang has never forgotten about it. She had helped you time after time. God Monarch Dong Fang even treated you relatively well, giving you the chance to poison him.” Bat Mountain Master grinned, “And in the end, God Monarch Dong Fang even softened and gave you a route of survival.”
“What route of survival? This shameless and despicable person…” Tie Cheng Liu became even madder after that.
“Is this related to me?” Xue Ying suddenly said.
Tie Cheng Liu glared at Xue Ying: “You and he are both Ascendants!”
Xue Ying felt speechless.
Previously, he pondered over this issue and could only think of this reason. But it felt too exaggerated.
This Tie Cheng Liu hated the Ascendant ‘God Monarch Dong Fang’, and it actually implicated him?
“All you Ascendants know how to entice girls. At that time, those female attendants and even Third Lady treated you with passion.” Tie Cheng Liu gritted his teeth.
“Truly a madman.” Xue Ying shook his head. Now that he ascertained the reason why the other party wanted his death, he was no longer interested in hearing his ramble. He simply said, “Bat Mountain Master, kill him.”
“Good.” When Bat Mountain Master heard that, he answered cleanly.
He initially thought this God Monarch Flying Snow would be like the previous Ascendant ‘God Monarch Dong Fang’, benevolently giving Tie Cheng Liu a path of survival.
“Kill me?” Tie Cheng Liu became even madder as if he wanted to say something.
“Peng.”
Bat Mountain Master merely glanced at him. Endless frost began condensing around Tie Cheng Liu, freezing him into a huge block of ice several meters tall. Following that, this ice piece shattered, causing Tie Cheng Liu to turn into pieces.
In terms of statuses, Bat Mountain Master had a relatively high status in High Mountain City. Even Young Master Imperial Wind Lei treated him politely and with respect.
And this ‘Tie Cheng Liu’ was merely an ordinary guard. He was not even a disciple of the Imperial Wind Clan! When his father was around, it was still fine. But now, his father died. His Junior Disciple Sister ‘God Monarch Xiao Shuang’ left along with God Monarch Dong Fang a while ago. Bat Mountain Master naturally had no apprehensions.
The matter of Tie Cheng Liu had rendered Xue Ying relatively speechless.
‘That God Monarch Dong Fang is seeking death for not killing this madman.’ Xue Ying shook his head. As for Bat Mountain, even though he did not have any good feelings for Bat Mountain! Firstly, he did kill three God Monarchs of Bat Mountain without suffering from any losses. Secondly, he did not wish to reveal his terrifying soul technique because of this Bat Mountain. And Bat Mountain Master had treated him really cordially. The other party was ‘shameless’ enough to make amends with him by lowering his position. Hence, Xue Ying decided to forget about this matter thereafter.
High Mountain City, within Xue Ying’s new residence.
After the display of his strength, Young Master Imperial Wind Lei no longer treated him similarly as in the past. He even bestowed upon Xue Ying a luxurious residence covering a huge area of 50 kilometers and a large number of female attendants and servants. To Young Master Imperial Wind Lei, he would definitely be doing all he could to pull in even a new expert like Xue Ying given the impending doom his clan was facing. As long as it was someone who knew how to repay favors, he would definitely do his utmost to fend off the enemies in times of crisis.
The following days were quiet.
Other than God Monarchs visiting him continuously and this disciple of his, ‘Imperial Wind Qing Yin’ coming over to seek guidance from him, Xue Ying had always remained in meditation, comprehending the laws of the Dao of Void of this world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1284 - Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 1284: Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within Xue Ying’s residence, there was a pavilion 330 meters tall.
Xue Ying was seated by himself before a long table with a flask of wine he liked placed on it. He currently frowned as he cast his gaze past the railings onto the vast High Mountain City.
‘Of the many penetrative techniques, the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique has the highest possibility of being used in this world.’ Xue Ying thought.
With guidance from the <Sky-Rending Void Sword Technique> scripture, Xue Ying was able to naturally understand the laws for the Dao of Void in this world at a quicker pace, especially after meditating on it for 2,000 years. Xue Ying’s current attainment in most of his Dao of Void techniques had reached the ‘peak stage God Monarch’ level on average! Even his Chaotic Origin Refined Body had once again been improved to the peak God Monarch level.
Nonetheless, he was still unable to grasp any void penetrative techniques!
‘This world is simply too overbearing. Everything is suppressed by it. Even the void has somehow become solidified, making it practically impossible to teleport.’ Xue Ying shook his head inwardly. If one said that the previous Origin Worlds he was in were like ‘water flow’ where he could easily teleport and penetrate through the waves of water, then the void in this world was like a completely solidified block of ice.
Teleportation? That was simply a dream!
‘The Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique is insufficient too.’ Xue Ying could peer through the essence of the void. As Xue Ying looked through the black fog spherical particles, he discovered that the other end of those holes were filled with terrifying golden lightning.
The violent chaotic golden lightning seemed to destroy everything it touched. When Xue Ying extended his consciousness through the black fog spherical particles, it was easily exterminated the moment he discovered the golden lightning just beyond.
It was too scary.
Since he could not even scout using the Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, then it would be even less likely to open a path with it.
‘Great Void Movement? The void is solidified to this extent, making it impossible to move through.’
‘Even my Scarlet Cloud Domain could not distort the void at all.’
Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
Teleportation, Great Void Movement, void warp, Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique… all those techniques were inapplicable in this world.
This was also the reason why void penetration could only be executed by a handful of cultivators in the history of Divine Realm despite having so many experts.
‘What they executed should be a technique similar to the ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.’ Xue Ying guessed.
It was possible to achieve it via the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique theoretically.
Because this was an apex penetrative technique. Its original purpose was meant to force a thin passage open through the vast Chaotic Origin World so as to move from an Origin World to another!
‘Even though the spatial suppression of this ‘Divine Realm’ is incredibly intense, its suppression is roughly comparable to the suppression in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Since I could penetrate through the Chaotic Origin Dimension, it should be theoretically possible for me to do so here!’ Xue Ying thought, ‘The only problem is… the original ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ made use of many laws and profound mysteries that are inharmonious in this world.’
‘I have to alter the technique.’
‘Using the profound mysteries for the Dao of Void in this world as the foundation, I shall re-create the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique entirely.’
Xue Ying frowned.
This was not an easy task.
The Dao of Void was a complete law in other Origin Worlds! But it was chaotic and violent in this world, and its laws were incomplete in the first place! Which was why the Ascendants agreed that the ‘Great Dao’ was lacking.
‘Using an incomplete Dao.’
‘It is really challenging for me to recreate the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique under this condition.’ Xue Ying began concentrating his attention on deducing out the new Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique. After all, he had grasped that technique when he was still a level-two Cosmos God, perfecting the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique after reaching the final realm--Xue Ying could bring people through the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Currently in this world, Xue Ying was still confident at least in re-creating the simplified version of Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.
******
At the same time when Xue Ying was deducing the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, bad news came within the Imperial Wind Clan.
Inside a luxurious palace hall.
Imperial Wind High Mountain sat at the throne. Imperial Wind Lei, Housekeeper Tong, and the three clan elders of Imperial Wind Clan were here too. They were also the core members of the entire Imperial Wind Clan.
“Jin’er sent a message from Eastern Wood City.” Imperial Wind High Mountain looked down and said.
“What did Second Brother say?” Imperial Wind Lei asked. The others felt their hearts tightening. The Divine Realm was huge. After 2,000 years of traveling, Imperial Wind Jin finally brought the team of emissaries and arrived at Eastern Wood City. They spent more than a hundred years in Eastern Wood City sending gifts and improving the relationship they had with various parties. They were even willing to marry Imperial Wind Qing Yin to that Ninth Prince of Eastern Wood City! But all the messages transmitted back were of failures.
“They failed.” Imperial Wind High Mountain voice was calm. But anyone could feel that he was suppressing his indignance and unwillingness amidst this calm veneer.
“Failed?”
“This…”
Everyone present felt their moods sinking.
Even though they had expected it since no good news ever came back before this, knowing the final outcome still made them panicky.
“Have we wasted all of our precious treasures by gifting them away?” A red-robed Imperial Wind Clan Elder could not help but roar angrily.
“Why? Do you think those greedy fellows in Eastern Wind City would ever return them? Hmph hmph, Eastern Wood City.” The eyes of Imperial Wind High Mountain flickered with frost. Sending gifts to various parties and roping them were done so that they could employ the help of others in Eastern Wood City. Nonetheless, everything fell apart in the end. Naturally, they would not be getting back their treasures.
“Master.” Housekeeper Tong frowned, “Why did Second Prince determine firmly that there is no longer hope?”
“Because Jin’er passed back news saying that Old Thief Devil Heart has already become a subordinate of Hidden Willow Valley Master.” Imperial Wind High Mountain answered, “Why would Eastern Wood City offend Hidden Willow Valley Master just because of our High Mountain City?”
Imperial Wind Lei, Housekeeper Tong, and the three Clan Elders were stunned.
Hidden Willow Valley Master?
Hidden Willow Valley…
There were many Chaotic Origin Lifeforms in the Divine Realm. ‘Hidden Willow Valley Master’ was someone that ranked in the top three. His original form was a bizarre and towering tree that was called ‘Hidden Willow’. When he stayed rooted there, even a group of God Emperors can’t injure him! His strength was something even the three Great Royal Clans had to respect.
Most likely only the three legendary Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods could exterminate this Hidden Willow Valley Master.
‘Hidden Willow Valley Master’ had an incredibly high status.
Even if the master of High Mountain City, Imperial Wind High Mountain took the initiative to join Hidden Willow Valley Master, the other party might feel disdainful of this request!
Due to the huge improvement of Devil Heart Cultist Master’s strength--even getting ranked on the ‘God Emperor Ranking List’ by the Heaven’s Will Clan---Hidden Willow Valley Master accepted Devil Heart Cultist Master in the end. As Hidden Willow Valley Master was ultimately a tree, he rarely moved. Nonetheless, he was still a terrifying existence ranked ’12th’ on the God Emperor Ranking List.
And all experts ranked top 30 on the God Emperor Ranking List were unfathomably strong.
“Would helping suppress that Devil Heart Cultist Master incur the wrath of that legendary Hidden Willow Valley Master? It is such a small matter!” A Clan Elder could not help but comment about it.
“If there is sufficient enticement, the Eastern Wood City Master might agree.” Imperial Wind High Mountain said indifferently, “But just some ordinary treasures and marrying my daughter to that Ninth Prince… isn’t something that Ninth Prince cares a lot about, muchless the Eastern Wood City Master.”
The Ninth Prince of the Eastern Wood City Master was an old hand at plucking flowers.
Women were simply women…
Even though the Ninth Prince once traveled to the High Mountain City and felt attracted by Imperial Wind Qing Yin, he did not wish to offend Imperial Wind High Mountain and force his way through. That was why the Ninth Prince chose to leave soon after. Clearly, the Ninth Prince did not place a huge importance on the matter of obtaining ‘Imperial Wind Qing Yin’.
“Now that Old Thief Devil Heart has joined Hidden Willow Valley Master, who out there could help us?” Housekeeper Tong mumbled.
“Why not escape! Let us run away from the High Mountain City.” A Clan Elder suggested.
“Escape?” Imperial Wind Lei sneered, “Some of the weaker clan members of my Imperial Wind Clan might survive if they escaped to other cities. But I doubt Old Thief Devil Heart would ever let us go. He would undoubtedly trace us down before killing us one by one.”
…
On that day.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin also received this news.
“Third Sister, there is no longer hope from the side of Eastern Wood City!” Imperial Wind Lei said to his little sister.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin was stunned: “Didn’t Second Brother arrived at the Eastern Wood City some time ago?” Even though she felt unwilling, Imperial Wind Qing Yin would still sacrifice herself for her clan. Without the protection of an expert, the entire Imperial Wind Clan might be wiped out! Even she as part of the direct line of the clan would not survive.

chapters.title: Chapter 1285 - Success!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1285: Success!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“Devil Heart Cultist Master has already joined the sect of Hidden Willow Valley Master. Who would be willing to mediate in this matter for the sake of our little High Mountain City?” Imperial Wind Lei sneered. His eyes were filled with bitterness. He was a proud person! He once ventured into the Great Wilderness alone to hone his skills. And now, he was vaguely ranked second in the High Mountain City--just second to his father! His little sister was prepared to sacrifice herself for the entire Imperial Wind Clan. This was something already humiliating to him! But for the sake of all clan members, he could only agree to it. Nonetheless, even after they visited Eastern Wood City with courtesy and politeness, Eastern Wood City still declined!
Utter humiliation!
But what could they do?
“Is there anything we can do?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin anxiously asked.
“Third Sister, at least you don’t have to go to that Eastern Wood City anymore. Furthermore, Father and I will think of solutions. That Old Thief Devil Heart hasn’t broken through too long ago. I reckon he should have many things to handle. He would most likely only attack our High Mountain City after a long period. And with time, I believe there would be greater variables and possibilities. Even in the worst scenario, we can still rely on High Mountain City to resist that Old Thief Devil Heart! Hmph hmph, and even if we die, we must kill off as many experts as we could so that Old Thief Devil Heart has to pay a sufficient price.” Imperial Wind Lei coldly snorted.
“Big Brother, this isn’t an optimal solution! Think of some other ways!” Imperial Wind Qing Yin continued.
“Haha!” Imperial Wind Lei lightly caressed the head of his little sister, chuckling out, “You don’t have to worry about this anymore. Let I and your father handle it.”
Imperial Wind Qing Yin still felt uneasy in her heart. But she could do nothing about it.
Imperial Wind Lei soon left.
Watching the back of her leaving big brother, Imperial Wind Qing Yin felt terrified in her heart. Even though she did not have to get married to that Ninth Prince, thinking about the impending calamity faced by her entire clan made her feel heartache. Her father, big brother, second brother, and even her elder sister that married away as well as many other familiar faces of her clan would most likely cease to exist after that! This was like stabbing a blade through her heart.
She was willing to sacrifice herself to save her clan, yet Eastern Wood City declined their offer!
“What should we do, what should we do?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin was panicking as she knew she could do nothing while watching doom arrive.
******
Even though the higher-ups of the Imperial Wind Clan were feeling uneasy, they did not leak the news out. Hence, the entire High Mountain City remained relatively peaceful.
Not many people knew about the enmity between Devil Heart Cultist Master and Imperial Wind High Mountain.
“Hua!”
Located above a wasteland at an incomparable distance away from High Mountain City, a black crack formed. A white-robed figure then walked out of it. He was Xue Ying.
“Hahaha, at least I succeeded!” Xue Ying stood in midair watching the boundless Great Wilderness. He revealed a joyous look, “Even though the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique I created according to this world is still simplified, at least I could penetrate through the void of this Divine Realm from now on.”
“And with this cultivation technique, even though Divine Realm might be huge, I have a highway to travel on.” Xue Ying felt incredibly pleased.
Previously, it was too troublesome to travel in this world.
He could only fly slowly!
Flying from one city to another, even if it was the nearest city, one would have to fly for dozens of years. For those that were even further, it was normal for one to fly for a million to 10 million years.
‘Eastern Wood City’ and ‘High Mountain City’ was considered relatively close. Otherwise, the Ninth Prince wouldn’t have traveled to the High Mountain City.
Because traveling was honestly too troublesome.
As a result, it was tough even for the three Great Royal Clans or some powerful experts to govern their nations strictly.
The natives of this Divine Realm depend on their bloodlines. But how many of them would ever have a bloodline that could utilize the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique?’ Xue Ying shook his head, ‘As for Ascendants, there are even fewer of them. To find one that cultivates the Dao of Void is akin to finding a needle in a haystack! The Great Dao is flawed. Using a flawed Dao of Void to re-create the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique isn’t something easy either. It is due to my prior experience and a clear direction that I succeeded.’
As a result, only a handful of cultivators in the Divine Realm could penetrate through the void.
And now, there was one more expert who could do so in Divine Realm!
Many famous overlords like Hidden Willow Valley Master could not do so either. They had to fly slowly from one point to another!
‘It seems that I can do many more things from now on.’ Xue Ying revealed a grin.
…
High Mountain City.
Xue Ying sat cross-legged before a long table. Many scrolls were placed on the table.
“Dao of Void.”
Xue Ying picked up a scroll and read through it carefully.
These scrolls were intelligence that he purchased from the ‘Heaven’s Will Pavilion’. The Heaven’s Will Pavilion was created by one of the three Great Royal Clans, ‘Heaven’s Will Clan’. It could be found practically in the entire Divine Realm, and was the best gatherer of information.
‘The cultivators of this world do not seem to excel in the Dao of Soul. I don’t see anyone who is better than me in this aspect.’ Xue Ying shook his head inwardly, ‘Even though this world has many innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, there isn’t a single one who specializes in soul techniques.’
There seemed to be more innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms here than in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
In addition, there were more experts here. As a result, more battles would ensue, resulting in many more corpses from Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
Reaching the realm of Xue Ying, analyzing the corpses of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms would aid him greatly! Because those Chaotic Origin Lifeforms did not reach where they were from weak. Instead, they were strong since birth, and many of their bodies had laws that were manifested! By analyzing their bodies, Xue Ying could understand more profound mysteries of the Dao. Like that ‘Thousand-Eyed Existence’ which died in Broken Teeth Mountain Range, those mysterious eyes had guided Xue Ying along his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm path.
But it was clear that Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that specializes in the soul were frighteningly strong. And Xue Ying did not seem to find any, at least in this world!
‘It seems I can only rely on myself for the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm.’ Xue Ying thought.
The fortunate thing was that this world did not suppress the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm at all. It could be perfectly executed.
“Teacher, Teacher!” An enchanting voice could be heard.
Xue Ying revealed a grin when he heard that. He turned his head over.
There were not many whom he was close in this world. His disciple, ‘Imperial Wind Qing Yin’, was the closest person he had in this world. Waving his hand, another empty wine cup appeared on the long table.
“Third Lady.” In the distance, two female attendants bowed respectfully.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin seemed to rush over in quick steps. Every step took her across a huge distance. She soon arrived before Xue Ying and sat down by the table. She was not polite either. Picking up the wine flask, she immediately poured for herself some wine: “Teacher! I came today to accompany you to drink.”
“What accompany me to drink? It’s you who likes to drink.” Xue Ying laughed, “Before accepting you as my disciple, I haven’t thought that you liked drinking so much.”
“Who asked Teacher to collect so many good wine! There are so many which could not be found even in my High Mountain City.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin giggled.
Xue Ying laughed at that comment. He did indeed have many wine.
The majority was brought over from Realm Heart Great Land. This wine had some special aspects and could be found in this world too. After all, the Divine Realm was huge! Who knew where another new type of wine could be found?
“Tsk tsk.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin downed a few cups before saying, “Yi, Teacher, what are you looking at?”
“Some information that I purchased from the Heaven’s Will Pavilion.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“Can I have a look?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin asked curiously.
“Sure.” Xue Ying nodded.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin then picked up a scroll and flipped it open. She nodded: “Oh, it is information regarding cultivation scriptures created by Ascendants for the Dao of Void? And they are of the God Emperor rank? Teacher, even though Ascendants are formidable, and there are many who have reached the God Monarch Realm, few actually broke through to the God Emperor Realm! This boundary is incredibly difficult to break!”
“God Emperor Ascendants are indeed rare.” Xue Ying nodded, “And God Emperor Ascendants who specialized in the Dao of Void are even fewer.”
In the Divine Realm, there were only eight God Emperor Ascendants recorded that specialized in the Dao of Void!
As a result, there were very few God Emperor graded cultivation scriptures written for the ‘Dao of Void’ by Ascendants.
“Teacher, there are only eight kinds of Ascendant cultivation scriptures you are seeking for in the entire Divine Realm, and some are most likely kept in secrecy!” Imperial Wind Qing Yin could not help but exclaim after reading through the reports.
“They are indeed few and far between.” Xue Ying agreed.
But there were still some that existed!
Most often than not, Ascendants would trade with other super powers. For instance, writing an original copy of book in exchange for certain treasures with other sects! An expert could definitely reproduce several original copies.
There were eight God Emperor Ascendants in the ‘Dao of Void’. Five of them had been publicized with quite a few original copies existing out in the world. Most of them had been kept by big sects. After all, any scriptures targeted for the ‘God Emperor Realm’ were precious.
“They are scattered across the Divine Realm. It is almost impossible to pinpoint any of them down.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin folded the scroll and no longer continued looking.
Xue Ying merely smiled. He continued reading through the scrolls. Currently, he was seeking for a target.
To others, the Divine Realm was vast.
But to him, after grasping the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation, he could easily arrive at any great cities within the Divine Realm.
“Gu gu.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin continued drinking, “Teacher, come come come, drink with me!”
“Alright.” Xue Ying acknowledged. Yet he did not know that Imperial Wind Qing Yin rarely drank prior to the threat that arose because of the Devil Heart Cult.

chapters.title: Chapter 1286 - Hunting in the Great Wilderness
chapters.content:
Chapter 1286: Hunting in the Great Wilderness
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As Xue Ying flipped through the scrolls, he sighed sorrowfully.
This world had so many experts! Even though it was lacking in laws, the number of experts here numbered beyond that in the Realm Heart Great Land and Broken Teeth Mountain Range! There were even three Chaotic Origin experts here!
According to the information, five of these eight ‘Dao of Void’ Ascendant God Emperors were early stage God Emperors, two were middle stage God Emperors, and one was a late stage God Emperor! Of them, only two could penetrate through the void using the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, and those two had never leak their cultivation scriptures before! Clearly, those who had grasped this survival movement technique felt disdainful of publicizing their cultivation techniques.
‘There are five kinds that are circulating around. Three are at the early stage God Emperor rank, and two at the middle stage God Emperor rank.’ Xue Ying pondered.
‘Most of these scriptures are kept by the bigger sects.’
‘Usually, one would have to join a big sect to acquire any of these scriptures. One has to contribute correspondingly as well for the sect.’
It was relatively easy to acquire any ‘God Monarch’ graded cultivation scriptures in this world; there were too many God Monarchs after all. Furthermore, training a new God Monarch by relying on these scriptures would not threaten the bigger sects. Nonetheless, it was incredibly difficult to acquire any ‘God Emperor’ graded scriptures. For instance, High Mountain City Imperial Wind Clan had merely collected three types of God Emperor graded scriptures in total, and they were all placed in the highest level within the Scripture Library.
One had to show ‘absolute loyalty’ before it was possible to get a chance to read the God Emperor graded scripture!
‘It is very difficult to acquire these five Ascendant scriptures--even more so than the scriptures created by natives of the Divine Realm.’ Xue Ying shook his head. The rarer an object is, the greater its value! 99% of the experts in the Divine Realm were natives. They cultivated their bloodlines. Hence, there were many more ‘God Emperor graded scriptures’ meant for bloodline cultivation. In comparison, God Emperor ranked Ascendant scriptures were much fewer!
‘Become absolutely loyal to a sect?’ Xue Ying immediately rejected this notion.
He merely took up a position with no obligation in the High Mountain City! It could not be considered absolute loyalty. Naturally, Xue Ying was not qualified to read through the God Emperor graded scriptures.
Sects that could collect God Emperor graded Ascendant scriptures were oft stronger than High Mountain City! In the vast Divine Realm, High Mountain City was only an ordinary sect.
‘There are two routes I could take.’
‘First is to find a treasure that could make even the big sects covet for it before exchanging for the scripture.’
‘And the other way is to participate in a top-grade auction currently held at the Heaven’s Will Pavilion in ‘River Origin City’. Amongst which is an early stage God Emperor graded cultivation scripture <Void Devil Insect Scripture>. I shall try my best to purchase that scripture. Furthermore, there is no need for me to purchase it either. It is fine as long as I get the chance to read through it once.’ Xue Ying contemplated.
Trade with a big sect?
Those big sects were incredibly wealthy. The God Emperor graded scriptures they had were their foundational treasures! To learn them without becoming loyal to the sect? One had to fork out a sufficiently enticing treasure.
‘Ai.’
‘In the past when I entered the Snake Tooth Corridor, I was prepared to sacrifice this avatar of mine. I have never brought any treasures with me at that time.’
‘Even this spear that I am currently using has been exchanged from the Imperial Wind Clan. I am simply too poor! It is not possible for me to exchange anything with the bigger sects! I can only think of ways to gather treasures so that I could participate in the auction at River Origin City.’
An auction.
It was natural for many peak experts to participate in it. Only then would the competed price be pushed up high!
Hence, the Heaven’s Will Pavilion had deliberately released the news and publicized some of the huge treasures they planned on auctioning! The River Origin City was also one of the great cities ranking in the top 100 within the Divine Realm. In addition to the large-scale advertisement, the competition for the treasures would certainly be intense.
‘There are still 1,200 years before the auction begins. River Origin City is incredibly far from the High Mountain City. Traveling by ship would take more than a million years. This auction has been publicized for a very long period already. Nonetheless, I could simply rely on my Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to arrive there. Hence, I have ample of time. Mn, I shall make use of these 1,200 years to gather as many treasures as possible. And to do so, I can only pay the Great Wilderness a visit!’ Xue Ying immediately made his decision.
The Great Wilderness was incredibly dangerous.
But it contained many top-graded Desolate Beast corpses that were precious. Most of them were even helpful to the bloodlines of the natives.
“Qing Yin.” Xue Ying suddenly said. He was still drinking with his disciple.
“Teacher?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin looked at Xue Ying.
“I am prepared to enter a closed-door cultivation. If there are any important matters, just directly send a voice transmission to me.” Xue Ying said.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin was stunned. She nodded: “Alright. It is important for Teacher to enter closed-door cultivation.”
Xue Ying smiled.
He was planning to go for a hunt in the Great Wilderness. 1,200 years from now, he planned to participate in the auction at River Origin City! During this period, it was better for him to tell others that he was in ‘closed-door cultivation’! Even if there were some important matters, his disciple would send a voice transmission and he could easily rush back with his Great Destruction Realm Teleportation.
‘Teacher is planning on entering closed-door cultivation.’ Imperial Wind Qing Yin felt desolate, ‘And it would most likely last for more than 100 million years. I reckon the Devil Heart Cultist Master would come before Teacher even exit.’
Disciples from the branch family of the Imperial Wind Clan and non-famous clan members might be able to escape alive.
But those higher-ups and core members, including the children of ‘Imperial Wind High Mountain’ would most likely be slaughtered without mercy.
…
After seeing his disciple away.
Xue Ying announced that he would be entering a closed-door cultivation!
Within the meditation room, with a flash, his body immediately transformed into an ordinary-looking black-robed young man.
“Let’s go.” Xue Ying immediately tore apart a black crack by his side. Following that, he tunneled through it and disappeared from the vicinity.
When he appeared, Xue Ying was at a Great Wilderness a huge distance away from the High Mountain City. It would most likely take hundreds of thousands of years to reach here via ship.
‘The hunt in Great Wilderness begins.’
That black-robed young man stood in midair surveying the vast Great Wilderness around him. ‘To me, ordinary Desolate Beasts are too invaluable. I would have to find a peak stage God Monarch Desolate Beast at least! If I am lucky, I might even meet an ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeform.’
Xue Ying sighed.
Great Wilderness…
It was absolutely dangerous to the majority of natives in Divine Realm because many God Monarch Desolate Beasts existed here.
But to God Emperors, the Great Wilderness was like a highway! Because there existed practically no God Emperor Desolate Beasts! Hence, even the huge ships of High Mountain City could fly for 2,000 years towards Eastern Wood City without any worry of meeting dangers because they would practically not encounter any God Emperor rank threats. Most God Emperor beasts were ‘low graded innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms’.
Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms! Their bodies were manifestation of laws. Even though they were low-graded, to the experts of this world, every part of their bodies was treasure! The majority of them could be used to cultivate their bloodline! Even to Ascendants, Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were greatly helpful to their cultivation too.
And to Xue Ying, if he could find an innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse that was the manifestation of the Dao of Void, its value would far surpass that of an Ascendant scripture!
‘What a pity.’
‘These innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms are all intelligent. They are too many experts in the Divine Realm. It is impossible for these innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform to foolishly roam in the Great Wilderness. Most of them would have hidden themselves. Some are under the protection of the more powerful and bigger innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform.’ Xue Ying sighed ruefully.
Like Hidden Willow Valley Master for instance.
Hidden Willow Valley Master was an innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform. If the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods did nothing, nobody could handle Hidden Willow Valley Master at all. There were a dozen weaker innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that chose to rely on the protection of Hidden Willow Valley Master.
Those innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms who dared to roam alone in the Great Wilderness…
Were usually those that had heaven-defying talents and it was incredibly hard to kill them.
‘If I could kill one, I would have reaped a huge harvest.’ Xue Ying thought. Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms might perhaps not be strong in combat, but their bodies were all tyrannical. Hence, killing them was hard, at least much more so than killing natives of the Divine Realm and Ascendants at the same level! But Xue Ying could rely on his ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’, giving him the hope of killing some of the weaker ones.
Yet finding one was already an arduous task.
…
Xue Ying’s goal of entering the Great Wilderness was to seek for ‘peak stage God Monarch’ Desolate Beasts. These were the strongest Desolate Beasts already and were incredibly rare.
Otherwise, those God Monarchs would not dare to temper themselves in the Great Wilderness.
‘It is really like finding a needle in a haystack.’
Xue Ying continued searching for them.
He relied on his Void Domain. After searching for a year or so, he finally discovered a Desolate Beast deep in a lake.

chapters.title: Chapter 1287 - River Origin City
chapters.content:
Chapter 1287: River Origin City
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Desolate Beasts had poor control of their aura. Even as they tried concealing it, Xue Ying’s Void Domain could easily ascertain a beast was at the peak stage God Monarch Realm.
‘After spending a year of searching, I finally found a peak stage God Monarch beast.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly. Desolate Beasts that were at the peak stage God Monarch Realm had sufficient value. These beasts represented the limit. Usually, only God Emperors could kill them. Of course, most ‘peak stage God Monarch’ Ascendants could do so too, ‘Fortunately, I have 1,200 years, which would give me enough time.’
“Hu.”
Xue Ying feigned ignorance. He flew across this lake.
As he was flying across a particular point above the lake.
“Hua!” An enormous, translucent figure suddenly shot out from the lake. Its body spanned across half a dozen kilometers. This charge was as fast as lightning. Its soft and translucent figure immediately bound around Xue Ying!
“Si la!”
Xue Ying moved his right hand down.
This simple action caused a void crack to extend and hack down on the soft translucent figure. That translucent figure had a face on it. With its soft body fluctuating, it easily dissipated away the force from this strike. But at the same time, the strike by Xue Ying caused its speed to slow. Xue Ying immediately retreated along the gap created by his strike.
“peak stage God Monarch Realm? Haha, it is rare for me to encounter such delicious food.” On that enormous translucent figure, a warped face could be seen. Its voice rumbled in the world.
As its voice was still rumbling.
It once again charged out at Xue Ying. Its translucent body did not suffer from any obstacles and flew at an incredibly fast speed. Even if Xue Ying relied on his Dao of Void to fly, it was merely faster by a thread! Furthermore, Xue Ying did not plan on escaping. His goal was to kill this Desolate Beast.
“Hong, hong, hong…”
This Desolate Beast continued flying forward in an attempt to bind and trap Xue Ying.
And Xue Ying treated this Desolate Beast as his target. He executed various Dao of Void techniques, yet he could not harm this Desolate Beast at all: ‘This Desolate Beast has an enormous survival capability. My attacks are simply tickling it. Its body is so much stronger than Bat Mountain Master’s ‘Bat Dragon Body’.’ With a fluctuation, that soft translucent body could easily dissipate away all incoming force by Xue Ying.
“You are really good at dodging. I shall not accompany you to play anymore.” This enormous translucent Desolate Beast suddenly said. At the same time, its translucent body formed multiple translucent threads. As there were too many threads formed, its enormous body started shrinking.
All those translucent threads came at Xue Ying.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying extended his finger and lightly tapped out.
“Hua.”
An enormous void bubble engulfed this translucent and soft Desolate Beast. It also enveloped all those incoming threads. The void bubble then collapsed until it became a black point! And with a tap of Xue Ying’s finger, it exploded. And after this explosion, it revealed the Desolate Beast which was perfectly undamaged.
“Damn.” This Desolate Beast was starting to become frustrated and angry. The translucent threads that shot out from its body soon turned into nine long whips.
“Hu, hu, hu, hu…”
The nine translucent whips had incredibly fierce power. They lashed out at Xue Ying simultaneously.
But even if its power became fiercer, in reality, Xue Ying had an easy time dealing with it.
‘Even though this Desolate Beast is at the peak stage God Monarch Realm, its survival capabilities are way too strong. My Dao of Void techniques can’t harm it at all.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly. If he could harm the other party, he could kill it after spending some time. But now, he could not injure it at all! It would be a waste of time to continue fighting with it.
‘Even I can’t harm it at all. It should be considered a rare kind of Desolate Beast at the peak stage God Monarch Realm.’ Xue Ying speculated.
That’s right.
Even though he came to the Great Wilderness to hunt, Xue Ying had not collected sufficient information on all ‘peak stage God Monarch’ Desolate Beasts.
Firstly, the publicized information by the Imperial Wind Clan in High Mountain City regarding peak stage God Monarch Realm was limited. Secondly, Xue Ying could purchase sufficiently large amounts and detailed pieces of information on Desolate Beast from the Heaven’s Will Pavilion, But the price was exorbitant. Xue Ying also sought to rely on this chance to temper himself! To him, as long as he encountered a ‘peak stage God Monarch Realm’ Desolate Beast, most would be his prey. Without having an in depth understanding of the Desolate Beasts, it would make this a more effective training session!
As for danger?
To him, peak stage God Monarch Desolate Beasts could never threaten his life.
‘Whatever. It only has these few techniques. I can no longer train myself any longer.’ With a thought.
“Hong--”
Xue Ying looked at that enormous translucent Desolate Beast. That Desolate Beast was originally attacking Xue Ying crazily and wantonly, yet when the terrifying Mirage and Illusory Realm descended on the soul of this Desolate Beast and at the same time, Xue Ying punched out on this Desolate Beast, this Desolate Beast was killed! That fist punched by Xue Ying was merely done ‘to conceal and prevent any ultra-strong experts of this Divine Realm from reversing time to check through what happened in the battlefield. After all, his soul techniques were invisible. And even with the reversal of time, the other party would only see Xue Ying punching this Desolate Beast to death!
“Pu.” A fist struck out.
