Presenting three stalks of Ember Mist Flowers just for a chance to view the scripture.
The higher-ups of the Cloudy Sunlight Palace naturally knew of this. Some of them were even ‘tempted’ since it was too easy to kill a God Monarch! They did not dare to act recklessly within the Cloudy Sunlight Palace, but once Xue Ying left the palace, some of them had rushed out as well. It’s a pity that Xue Ying was already long gone after executing his Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.
******
His objective at the Cloudy Sunlight Palace was met easily.
Following that, Xue Ying exchanged another identity. He disguised himself as a blade martial artist before entering the ‘Faman City’. Who would have thought that there was a God Emperor that acted once he entered the City Master Residence! He came to assassinate Xue Ying! Without given a choice, Xue Ying could only ‘go along the flow’ and wipe out the other party. After killing him, Xue Ying immediately left by executing his Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique!
After that, he had to change his identity before paying the ‘City of Rain and Wind’ a visit. This time, even though he was ambushed once again, that was after he acquired the scripture. The moment he stepped out of the City Master Residence, even before he located a secluded place to execute his Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, the enemy had moved in on him! And this time, it was two early stage God Emperors that acted.
As a result, Xue Ying could only eliminate the problem. He then left once again by executing his Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.
…
High Mountain City. Inside Xue Ying’s closed meditation room. A violet-robed male suddenly appeared here. He was Xue Ying that had changed his appearances.
‘After moving from place to place, I still have the easiest time negotiating with Cloudy Sunlight Palace. The other two cities have moved in against me. Adding up that attempt in River Origin City, I have killed five early stage God Emperors in total.’ Xue Ying shook his head. He did not show mercy. After all, the three latter assailants came to kill him without having any relevant information on Xue Ying. Thus, Xue Ying would definitely not show any mercy in his retaliation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1295 - The Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 1295: The Arrival
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
‘But at least I have learned all the scriptures.’ Xue Ying grinned.
He got the original copy of <Void Devil Insect Scripture>. Xue Ying also learned the other two Middle Stage God Emperor scriptures--<Heaven and Earth> and <Realmless>. In this Divine Realm, the crystalline of the peak wisdom and intelligence of all Dao of Void Ascendants over the long years had resulted in just one single ‘late stage God Emperor’ scripture and two Middle Stage God Emperor scriptures.
That late stage God Emperor scripture had never been spread outside. Hence, it was impossible for others to learn it.
And it was because the Middle Stage God Emperor scriptures had been circulating in the outside world that gave Xue Ying a chance to learn them by exchanging for it.
‘Absorbing the wisdom of other experts and using them for myself.’ Xue Ying sat down and began meditating.
An expert should learn from others.
Learn from the world!
Learn from the myriad existences!
Learn from other cultivators!
One should absorb the comprehensions from different sources and turn them into essence for himself. From there, he could then open a new path solely for himself at a faster rate.
…
These three scriptures were amazing. Even the Early Stage God Emperor <Void Devil Insect Scripture> was quite astounding. After all, they were all stable cultivation techniques. The <Void Devil Insect Scripture> specialized most in flying and maneuver techniques. When flying, the cultivator would be able to swim just like a magical insect. Even though the cultivator could not penetrate through the void, the cultivator would have a speed that outstripped other Early Stage God Emperors. Even most Middle Stage God Emperors could not reach up to a cultivator that grasped this technique!
But even though this cultivation technique had astounding survival capabilities, it was slightly weaker in its combative aspects.
And the two Middle Stage God Emperor scriptures, <Heaven and Earth> and <Realmless> , were even more amazing! These two were body cultivation techniques.
The goal of <Heaven and Earth> was to refine a body into an enormous world. The fleshy body of the cultivator was akin to an endless, thick land. The bones were like mountains. The blood would be taken as a void flow. Many celestial bodies were even floating on the void flow, moving along with the stream of the void. This world was incredibly vast. It contained celestial bodies, space, and land.
It was a world perfectly fused together by many aspects of a body.
After cultivating this technique to late stage, one would be forced to reveal his powerful ‘true body’ during battles. Even in the Divine Realm, a cultivator would have a body 5,000 kilometers long! It was way bigger than many God Emperors in the Divine Realm. With such a huge body, the cultivator would have extraordinary strength too! Every action of his was tyrannical. Being an Ascendant, it was possible for him to deal with Middle Stage God Emperors and possibly fight on even grounds with late stage God Emperors.
As for <Realmless> , even though it was a body cultivation technique too, its essence was completely different from what <Heaven and Earth> espoused.
Heaven and Earth fused practically the entire structure of the world into the fleshy body.
And Realmless could be explained with one word--emptiness!
Every particle in the fleshy body was just like a vast space. The entire fleshy body was akin to a huge space encompassing many mini spatial pockets. With layer folding over layer, an expert who cultivated this technique would have a perfect body of spatial layers stacked on top of one another. The cultivator who grasped this technique would also have a strange way of fighting.
Despite being suppressed in the Divine Realm, this cultivator could enlarge his body, turning himself into a giant of half a million kilometers tall! And if he chose to make himself small, the cultivator could make himself as small as an ant!
When a late stage God Emperor exert his full strength on a cultivator who grasped Realmless, this cultivator could easily absorb the incoming force and dissipate them across the spatial layers! Even as this cultivator stood there and allow the enemy to attack him, he would be completely uninjured. Even the 30 strongest existences in this realm could merely injure this cultivator. Killing him was an impossible task.
In terms of survivability…
<Realmless> was beyond that of <Heaven and Earth> .
<Heaven and Earth> was comparatively more balanced in terms of survivability and direct combat-all aspects were comparable to a late stage God Emperor Native.
‘The creator of this cultivation technique has spent effort and sweat on understanding these Dao paths.’ Xue Ying was clear that he might be able to learn them, but what would happen after that? How could he follow the steps of the predecessor to reach where they stood currently?
‘These two cultivation techniques are flawed.’
‘The ambition of the creator of <Heaven and Earth> is too great. In order to turn the body into a world, it requires too much adoption of the revolving laws, making it an extricate and complex technique.’ Xue Ying shook his head, ‘Even though this cultivation technique is at the Middle Stage God Emperor level, I find it way too complex. What then would it be once it reaches the late stage, perfection, and then the Chaotic Origin level? Thinking about it brings nightmare.’
Of course, every expert had a different understanding of the ‘Dao’.
Xue Ying felt that this path would lead to a dead end, yet others might think it was a path with the greatest hope.
‘The <Realmless> is too extreme too. It strives for perfection in survivability.’ Xue Ying thought.
…
These three great scriptures had essences that Xue Ying could extract. Xue Ying also entered closed-door cultivation to ponder over what could be learned and applied from them. His avatars situated far away in the Realm Heart Great Land, and his hometown Primal Chaos Void were also comprehending these scriptures. They were primarily absorbing the laws and profound mysteries that could be fused into his own Chaotic Origin Refined Body.
Gradually, Xue Ying regained his past strength of ‘Early Stage God Emperor’ in his Chaotic Origin Refined Body. His original unstable body cultivation technique was also being altered; it absorbed the essence of <Realmless> and the operation of <Heaven and Earth> . His Chaotic Origin Refined Body was becoming more stable as this process continued. Furthermore, due to the exposure of different profound mysteries behind the Dao of Void in this world that reached the Early Stage God Emperor level, Xue Ying’s understanding of the Dao became deeper.
******
In the blink of an eye, it had been eight million years since Xue Ying came to this world.
…
There was a huge ship flying at high speed amidst the cloud.
On this ship, many protectors emitting God Monarch aura could be seen.
“Hu.”
A muscular figure walked out of the cabin and came to the head of the ship. He wore a thick black gown. Behind him followed five other figures. These five were all emitting the aura of an Early Stage God Emperor.
“We are reaching High Mountain City soon?” This muscular old man asked.
“According to the current speed, we will reach in five days.” A green-robed girl extended her senses before concluding this.
“Five more days!” The muscular old man looked afar. The edge of his lips curled upwards, “Imperial Wind High Mountain, you have only five days left to enjoy.”
“Big Brother, ever since you broke through to the next level, this Imperial Wind Clan has been dispatching many caravans to other cities. Even though they publicized them as caravans, they are actually carrying large numbers of disciples from the Imperial Wind Clan! Many disciples from the Imperial Wind Clan are already scattered across the different cities! And there are way too many cities! Most of those disciples are nameless, making it hard for us to trace down all of them.” A white-robed male commented.
“What can we do?”
The muscular old man said nonchalantly, “They are doing this in broad daylight. With the disciples of the Imperial Wind Clan sent to so many cities, and all of them are keeping a low profile, finding them is a huge challenge. Nonetheless, there is no point for us to trace down every last disciple.”
Search for those disciples?
Usually, they had to rely on certain tracing techniques. But prior to that, they first had to find the karmic ties between the disciples! It was difficult to generate karma with those ordinary disciples from the Imperial Wind Clan, and even so, the karmic ties were so thin that tracing it down to an exact location was tough.
“In the future, we can only pay attention to this. The moment we discover any uprising sect using the name of the Imperial Wind Clan, we will just exterminate it.” The muscular male said, “As long as none of them rise, there is no need for us to pay attention to those weak little disciples.”
“Yes, there is no need for us to care about them.”
“The Imperial Wind Clan is a small sect in the entire Divine Realm. It is a pipe dream for a God Emperor to emerge from their clan.”
They were filled with disdain.
How low was the probability of a God Emperor emerging?
Even so, Devil Heart Cultist Master would find ways to eliminate them!
“Let’s eliminate Imperial Wind High Mountain and his precious children, as well as all core experts from the Imperial Wind Clan. Let us destroy the entire Imperial Wind Clan located in the High Mountain City. Once this is achieved, my vengeance will also be temporarily served! I am considered quite benevolent in this aspect.” The muscular male chuckled. His smile contained some viciousness, “Though I have to say, this Imperial Wind High Mountain is quite courageous to remain in the city without escaping.”
“It is impossible for him to escape! We can trace him down any time! He has no place to escape to.”
“It is likely that he plans on relying on his terrain and territory in the High Mountain City to fight with us.”
“Fight with our Devil Heart Cult? Haha, what a joke! I doubt the High Mountain City can resist against us for the time taken to brew a cup of tea.”
The other five God Emperors were sneering.
Given the current strength of Devil Heart Cultist Master that had just entered the God Emperor Ranking List, it was rare for him to have only five Early Stage God Emperor subordinates. The reason was because Devil Heart Cultist Master had just broken through not too long ago. Most cultivators at his level would usually have a dozen or so God Emperor subordinates.
“Even though the strength of High Mountain City is ordinary, all of you have to remain vigilant. The other party is planning to risk his life in this battle. Not only must we wipe them out, we have to keep our personal losses to a minimum.” Devil Heart Cultist Master turned around to the five of them.
“Yes, Big Brother.” These five God Emperors acknowledged.
Devil Heart Cultist Master nodded before entering the cabin.

chapters.title: Chapter 1296 - Disciple and Teacher
chapters.content:
Chapter 1296: Disciple and Teacher
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The crystalline snowflakes fell gracefully in the world.
Xue Ying and Imperial Wind Qing Yin were both enjoying wine and listening to the Qin. Not too far away, there was a beautiful girl focusing on playing the Qin. The melody from the Qin filled the garden, and Xue Ying enjoyed it very much.
When that girl stopped playing the Qin, she smiled at Xue Ying and Imperial Wind Qing Yin.
“May I have some constructive suggestions from God Monarch Flying Snow and Third Lady?” This female Qin musician smiled.
“Every time I listen to Sister Leng play the Qin is just like being in a dream. It feels really really beautiful!” Imperial Wind Qing Yin praised. Her eyes were sparkling with joy.
Xue Ying smiled. Even though he quite liked music, he had never spent the time enjoying them. Ever since his disciple Imperial Wind Qing Yin strongly recommended this number one Qin musician in High Mountain City, ‘Leng Xin’, he immediately nodded and agreed to let this female Qin Master come play the Qin at his residence. Even though Xue Ying had been concealing his strength, he was still able to defeat Bat Mountain Master with the strength he unveiled. Hence, this ‘Leng Xin’ female Qin Master had to perform conscientiously.
When it first started, Xue Ying merely felt that it was stunning.
But after listening to it a few times, Xue Ying gradually felt that this ‘Qin Music’ had many points of similarity to his ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’. There was the ‘Bewilderment’ branch in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm that could utilize sound to execute.
‘She is indeed the number one Qin Master in High Mountain City. For her to become the top Qin Master and to be so famous, she should have reached an incredibly profound level in the Dao of Sound. Her Ancestral God Bloodline should specialize in this Dao too. Even though she is still crude in many ways she utilizes the sound, the freedom in her heart has reached a level that I can’t compare.’ Xue Ying thought.
Xue Ying comprehended two great killing techniques one after another in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm. One to cause the enemies to fall into oblivion, and the other to wipe out the soul of the enemies. These two techniques were comprehended from the ‘gray eyes’ and the ‘gold eyes’. Nonetheless, Xue Ying could not fuse them perfectly together.
But after hearing to the Qin Music, he found his problem.
‘I have always known that the most innate desire of any soul is ‘freedom’. That is also the ultimate destination of the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm.’ Xue Ying sighed, ‘I once saw the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet in the past and has always been doing my utmost to recall back to what I saw, and to borrow that memory in fusing both great killing techniques together. In reality, I have been too deliberate and forceful! Even though I know that ‘freedom’ is the essence of the soul, I have yet to use this core principle in fusing both great killing techniques.’
Xue Ying sighed at himself.
This was cultivation.
Even if the other party gave a cultivator the complete technique, without going through the entire bitter process of training in the technique, it was impossible for the cultivator to understand the essence of this technique.
Once he understood this point, his avatars located in both Realm Heart Great Land and his hometown Primal Chaos Void began entering closed-door cultivation. Xue Ying had a feeling that he would be able to fuse both great killing techniques for the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm in the near future.
…
This was also an enlightenment for his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm that he gained after listening to this Qin Music, making Xue Ying thankful to this female Qin Master that he frequently invited over.
“God Monarch Flying Snow hasn’t given your comments yet.” The female Qin Master turned to Xue Ying.
“Miss Leng’s Qin Music is bold and unrestrained. It gives others the feeling of comprehending the Dao.” Xue Ying hesitated for a while before deciding to pour his thoughts out, “But Miss Leng could try to collect other cultivation techniques under the Dao of Soul and learn from them. Perhaps this might be helpful to Miss Leng.”
The reason why Xue Ying chose not to say this previously is because he had been worried about forcing the other party to delve further into the Dao of Soul which might cause her to lose the original feeling of freedom. But speaking from the perspective of cultivation, it was good for the cultivator should she suffer from some bitterness and hardship.
“Sound?” The female Qin Master felt puzzled, “Music is music and sound is sound. Isn’t that the case?”
“Try comprehending it and perhaps it might help you.” Xue Ying emphasized.
“Many thanks God Monarch for your guidance.” Even though the female Qin Master felt puzzled, she still chose to listen to the guidance by this Ascendant God Monarch and find some cultivation scriptures related to sound. In the past, he had relied purely on her bloodline. She reached her current attainments in music purely by relying on utilizing his bloodline and talent.
Xue Ying nodded.
Even though he was speaking to this female Qin Master with his disciple, there were still various laws and profound mysteries emerging in his mind. Reaching his level, multi-tasking was something as simple as eating and drinking.
‘Those two seniors are able to create the Middle Stage God Emperor scriptures, <Heaven and Earth> and <Realmless>. And I am currently trying to reach the Middle Stage God Emperor Realm in my Chaotic Origin Refined Body, yet I am still met with many more questions.’ Xue Ying pondered. Currently, his Chaotic Origin Refined Body was stable at the ‘Early Stage God Emperor’ realm. He even came out with several versions that could allow his body to unleash strength at the Middle Stage God Emperor level, albeit they were not stable.
‘But cultivating in other civilizations is indeed helpful to me.’ Xue Ying understood the rationale behind why ‘Yuan’ sent them over.
Different civilizations had different laws. Like the Realm Heart Great Land and this world, both contained vastly different laws. Xue Ying had to adapt to the laws of this civilization. This process of acclimatization helped him in perfecting his ‘Dao’.
Only when a cultivator could head to all worlds would he have grasped an eternal Dao. Only then would he be qualified to jump out of the cage and become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
“God Monarch Flying Snow, come to my residence right at this moment.” A voice transmission was heard.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying who was holding on to his wine cup and still pondering over his Chaotic Origin Refined Body became startled, “Is this a transmission from the City Master, Imperial Wind High Mountain?”
“Father?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin was similarly stunned. She had received the summon too.
“Qing Yin, the City Master has summoned you over too?” Xue Ying looked at his disciple’s expression before chuckling out.
“Yes.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin nodded.
“Then let us go over.” Xue Ying said. He turned to the female Qin Master, Leng Xin, “Miss Leng, Qing Yin and I have some matters. You should return first.”
The female Qin Master Leng Xin bade her farewell and left.
Xue Ying also brought along Imperial Wind Qing Yin to the City Master residence.
******
The City Master residence was also where the Imperial Wind Clan was located at. It occupied an immense area.
Within the main palace.
There were a huge number of experts gathered here. There were the personal disciples of the Imperial Wind Clan, Bat Mountain Master, God Monarch Jian Yin, Xue Ying and other experts. The majority of the experts gathered were at least Middle Stage God Emperor Realm and beyond. It was quite rare to find those at the level of Imperial Wind Qing Yin. She was qualified to enter only because she was the daughter of the City Master.
“Brother Flying Snow, why do you think the City Master has summoned so many people over? Almost all the experts in the city has been called over.” Bat Mountain Master walked over. His triangular head was indeed ugly, though he had an enthusiastic expression on his face.
“Who knows?” Xue Ying did not mind. He stayed in the High Mountain City primarily to cultivate without others disturbing him.
“It has been a very long time since High Mountain City gathered so many experts. I think that things are amiss.” Bat Mountain Master guessed. It was not just him, many other experts were panicking in their hearts.
Without saying the reason for summoning so many experts abruptly, everyone could faintly guess what it was for.
“He’s here.”
“The City Master is here.”
The palace hall quietened down. The gray-haired middle-aged man who had seen through the vicissitudes of life, ‘Imperial Wind High Mountain’, came in from the side door of the palace. Beside him followed Housekeeper Tong.
Imperial Wind High Mountain had revitalized the entire Imperial Wind Clan single-handedly. He was an ambitious and formidable person given that he had reached the God Emperor Realm while at the same time, led the sect to where it stood now. Nonetheless, the expression of Imperial Wind High Mountain was solemn. After reaching the throne position, he did not sit. Instead, he looked down at everyone and started: “I know everyone could guess the reason why I summoned everyone over!”
The group of audience below looked upwards at Imperial Wind High Mountain.
“There is a powerful enemy currently rushing his way over to my High Mountain City.” Imperial Wind High Mountain looked down at everyone, “He should be here in about an hour.”
“What?”
“A powerful enemy?”
“An hour’s time?”
The entire palace became chaotic and frenzied. This news came too abruptly.
“City Master, what powerful enemy is he? Why is he attacking our High Mountain City?” Unrest started spreading among the audience.
Imperial Wind High Mountain frowned slightly before snorting lightly. The palace hall began quieting once again.
“The enemy is very powerful. He has a vengeance with my Imperial Wind Clan that cannot be resolved.” Imperial Wind High Mountain looked downwards and gave a cold sneer, “I know what everyone’s thinking now. That enemy has a bone to pick with the Imperial Wind Clan and not with you all, am I right?”
The expressions on many experts shifted slightly.
“I, Imperial Wind High Mountain, has governed the High Mountain City for so long and has treated everyone here pretty well. Now that my clan is facing danger, I hope everyone could contribute your strength as well.” Imperial Wind High Mountain might be ‘requesting’ for everyone to help, but everyone present could sense the overbearing will Imperial Wind High Mountain had! Clearly, everyone present had to agree. Otherwise, the consequences would be dire since they were in the residence of the Imperial Wind Clan, a place covered in arrays that the Imperial Wind Clan controlled.
Hence, how could any of them dare to resist?
“The few of us will naturally do our best!”
“City Master, we have been showered with kindness from the Imperial Wind Clan. We would naturally not retreat at this moment.” There were experts who immediately stated their stand. None of them were fools. They knew that it was too late for them to run now.
“Mn.” Imperial Wind High Mountain nodded, “Rest assured. When the powerful enemy comes, I’ll personally meet him head on. Many experts from my Imperial Wind Clan will also be there to help out. The lot of you are strengthened by the array of the city too, and the enemies won’t be that strong either.”
Those present could only choose to believe since they had no other route of retreat.
Xue Ying stood in the crowd listening silently.
Powerful enemy?
For Imperial Wind High Mountain to force all experts here to fight back, the enemy had to be threatening to the clan.
Standing by his side, Imperial Wind Qing Yin hesitated momentarily before stealthily transmitting over to Xue Ying: “Teacher, the enemy is incredibly powerful. Our Imperial Wind Qing Yin can’t resist against him. Teacher, it is better that you hide further away and remain low-profile. Once you find the chance, you should hurry up and flee. There’s no need to die with my Imperial Wind Clan.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin and the others had been strictly ordered not to spread this news out.
“Can’t resist?” Xue Ying felt his heart panicking. He turned to his disciple.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin nodded slightly to him. At the same time, she continued, “Teacher, this is a calamity that my Imperial Wind Clan is currently facing. It is the fortune and joy of I, Qing Yin, to meet Teacher before the great calamity arrives. It’s just that this calamity is too dangerous so Teacher must not participate too deeply. It is pointless. The enemy is too strong--so much more than my Imperial Wind Clan.”
Xue Ying could sense the urgency in his disciple, and the concern for him.
Qing Yin and the others were already prepared to fight to the death? This foolish disciple!
Xue Ying smiled at Imperial Wind Qing Yin. He transmitted back: “Rest assured. Your Teacher has never done things that I am not confident of.”
The moment Imperial Wind Qing Yin heard that, she felt rest assured. At the same time, she felt sullen for her Teacher who did not care about the life and death of his disciple.

chapters.title: Chapter 1297 - Leave None Alive!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1297: Leave None Alive!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The palace hall was slightly restless. As for Imperial Wind High Mountain, he sat on his throne with a cold expression.
He chose to stay behind because he was prepared to fight to the death!
The Imperial Wind Clan had been growing over the years. It had many members in its clan. Some of them were young, and some were slightly weaker. But all those who had been determined to be worthy of training had been sent out to various cities over the past eight million years or so. He even ordered for those leaving clansmen to live in seclusion and not to walk out under the banner of the ‘Imperial Wind Clan’.
“Hmph. My Imperial Wind Clan has so many members. How many of them do your Devil Heart recognize? Even if you could come out with a list of members, how many experts in your Devil Heart Cult specializes in tracking down someone? And to go searching for them one by one, city by city?”
“My Imperial Wind Clan has brought out everything we could to construct the arrays. By relying on the terrain, we plan on fighting back!”
“You want to exterminate my Imperial Wind Clan? Let me see how many experts of yours will die!” Imperial Wind High Mountain was at this moment filled with rising killing intent. He wished to kill as many enemies as he could before he dies!
…
Bat Mountain Master and God Monarch Jian Yin walked over to the side of Xue Ying. The three of them were Cultivation Tutors for the Imperial Wind Clan.
Brother Flying Snow, Brother Jian Yin.” Bat Mountain Master greeted, “It seems the City Master has already chosen to forgo the outer city by summoning all of us over to the residence of the Imperial Wind Clan! He plans on guarding the inner city. Since the enemy is able to force the Imperial Wind Clan into giving up the outer city, they must be terrifying.”
“What Bat Mountain Master said is logical. Brother Flying Snow, how do you see it?” God Monarch Jian Yin looked at Xue YIng.
“Let’s wait and see.” Xue Ying did not elaborate further.
Both Bat Mountain Master and God Monarch Jian Yin felt suspicious inwardly. They came primarily because they wanted to form a battle line with God Monarch Flying Snow. With the three peak stage God Monarchs standing at the front, they could even deal with an Early Stage God Emperor. But now, it seemed that Xue Ying did not seem to be positive or proactive.
Xue Ying cast his gaze across the main entrance of the palace and into the outer world.
The entire High Mountain City merely occupied an area of several hundred thousand kilometers. And this included the outer city. The residence of the Imperial Wind Clan merely occupied tens of thousands of kilometers. All the core arrays were constructed within the main residence of the Imperial Wind Clan, and this was also the inner city.
Currently, unrest filled the palace hall. Time passed gradually amidst this uneasy atmosphere.
“They are finally here!” Imperial Wind High Mountain abruptly stood. The killing intent emitting from his body could not be concealed at all. It was heaven-shaking. Following that, he immediately charged out of the hall.
“Second Brother, Third Sister, take good care of yourselves!” The Crown Prince Imperial Wind Lei gave his little brother and sister a glance before similarly rushing out of the palace hall. Housekeeper Tong similarly followed after them.
“Sou sou sou…”
One after another, figures flew out. More than half the peak stage God Monarch experts of the Imperial Wind Clan had charged out of the palace hall. They moved into various combat formations with great familiarity.
And other experts like Xue Ying remained calm. They did not rush out impatiently. Instead, they walked out to the entrance of the palace hall and watched as the battle unfolded.
“They are here.”
“The battleship.”
All of them looked far ahead. There was a huge ship floating.
Beneath the ship, a huge city-protective array appeared covering High Mountain City just like a barrier.
Suddenly, a huge hand extended from that ship. This hand expanded to several kilometers long the moment it came out. With booming sounds, it smashed against the barrier protecting the city. This barrier became slightly distorted before it blasted apart. That huge ship did not seem to have slowed. Instead, it followed along the hole formed into the High Mountain City.
“How could that be so easy?” The group of experts gathered within the palace hall in High Mountain City paled.
“Even though the City Master has given up on the outer city and did not pour his full force to protect it, the city-protective array was actually destroyed with a single palm strike. How frightening is the enemy!”
“An Early Stage God Emperor should not be able to achieve this.”
“Unless…”
Thoughts began flashing in the hearts of the experts.
Every single minor realm jump at the God Emperor was hard. 99% of ‘God Emperors’ in the Divine Realm were Early Stage God Emperors. It was simply too difficult for one to break through to the middle stage! And most Middle Stage God Emperors were qualified to be ranked on the God Emperor Ranking List. This list contained the top 1,000 experts across the entire Divine Realm! Thus, it could be seen how rare ‘Middle Stage God Emperors’ were.
…
The huge ship came. It easily destroyed the city-protection array for the outer city. And now, it entered the city.
Huge number of Divine Realm natives living in the city looked up at what was happening. They were alarmed by what was happening. Some even chose to hide in their houses so that they would not get involved in the battle.
“Hurry up and hide!”
“All of you, hide in the underground meditation rooms.”
The entire city became chaotic.
And that huge ship did not care about the ordinary citizens at all. In a breath of time, it flew over to the residence of the Imperial Wind Clan.
“Imperial Wind High Mountain.” A voice rumbled across the world. It was filled with frightful killing intent. The entire High Mountain City immediately became quiet.
A muscular old man who was wearing black robe walked out of the huge ship. He stood in midair. Behind him were five other God Emperors that followed.
This muscular old man looked over at the residence of the Imperial Wind Clan. He gave a cold sneer: “Imperial Wind High Mountain, your doomsday is here! The entire Imperial Wind Clan will be uprooted by me on this very day!”
“Devil Heart!” Imperial Wind High Mountain stood above his residence. The energy from the arrays constructed in the clan residence was currently pouring into his body, significantly boosting his strength. At this moment, he was covered in many layers of light. It was so much more dazzling than that Devil Heart Cultist Master. Imperial Wind High Mountain furiously roared in response, “You wish to exterminate my Imperial Wind Clan? Hmph hmph, let me see how many of the experts you brought today will go back alive.”
“You regard yourself too highly.” The muscular old man said with a clear voice, “I am Devil Heart. Currently, as long as any expert in the High Mountain City who isn’t part of the Imperial Wind Clan chooses not to be my enemy, I’ll not make it hard for you too. Today, the Imperial Wind Clan has to be exterminated. Don’t be so foolish and join them in their funeral.”
Following that, the muscular old man waved his hand: “Move!”
“Yes.”
On the order, the five God Emperors behind him as well as large number of God Monarchs on the battleship flew out. They formed a huge combat formation with practiced ease and began attacking the residence of the Imperial Wind Clan right before them.
The muscular old man, ‘Devil Heart Cultist Master’ also acted alone. He began his siege.
“Stop them!”
Imperial Wind High Mountain took the initiative to engage Devil Heart Cultist Master. Currently, the entire residence of the Imperial Wind Clan was protected by the arrays. Furthermore, due to the small region the arrays covered and the continual strengthening of the arrays by the Imperial Wind Clan over the past several millions of years, the arrays protecting the Imperial Wind Clan was sufficiently strong.
“Si la.”
Imperial Wind High Mountain immediately passed through the clan-protecting arrays and began his sneak attack. After attacking, he immediately went back hiding behind the arrays.
By controlling the core array of the entire setup, he naturally could enter the array as he wished. Before Devil Heart Cultist Master destroy the arrays, he could not enter.
“Hong long long~”
The five God Emperors commandeered 300 God Monarchs in a formation. This formation was much stronger than their commander, ‘Devil Heart Cultist Master’ alone.
Nonetheless, Devil Heart Cultist Master himself could exert a strength that was close to half of what his subordinates could!
…
“Everyone, prepare to battle.” Imperial Wind Lei swept his gaze across Bat Mountain Master, Xue Ying, God Monarch Jian Yin, and a large batch of experts, “My Imperial Wind Clan has never treated everyone badly. Today is also the day that everyone repay the kindness! I hope that nobody will betray the clan during the most critical moment. Otherwise, the strength from the array will no longer be used to power you up. Instead, it’ll suppress you! The experts of my Imperial Wind Clan have congregated into several combat formations. They are powered up by the arrays too. By then, it’ll be a simple task for us to kill all traitors. This is a critical moment that defines the existence of my Imperial Wind Clan, and we are unable to tolerate any single betrayal.”
Many experts felt a restraining fear covering their hearts.
“Right now, everyone should hear out my arrangement.” Imperial Wind Lei immediately began dispatching the experts.
He grouped those experts that were not part of the Imperial Wind Clan into several combat formations. Each formation would have an expert from the Imperial Wind Clan leading it. This way, even if the other experts from the combat formation decided to change sides, the Imperial Wind Clan expert would be able to prevent the traitors from forming a perfect formation.
“We can only temporarily delay the enemies off.”
“Let us deal with them for now.”
Bat Mountain Master and other experts had ugly expressions. Neither did they dare to resist.
They knew of the God Emperor Ranking List, and how terrifying ‘Devil Heart Cultist Master’ was for him to be listed on it! Did they not see how easily the other party dispatch five God Emperors and 300 God Monarchs? Even by adding up all the experts in High Mountain City, they could merely form over 300 God Monarchs. But some of them were not present today. For instance, the experts from the ‘Heaven’s Will Pavilion’ or the branch team from the ‘Mysterious Fire Army’. Quite a few would not listen to the arrangements by Imperial Wind Clan.
“Hong hong hong…”
Incessant ringing sounds could be heard from the sky.
Imperial Wind High Mountain and other experts from the Imperial Wind Clan were flying through the array membrane and carrying out more sneak attacks.
Even if they did, the Devil Heart Cult still held an overwhelming advantage. They were constantly bombarding the array, causing it to tremble.
“Not good.” Standing by the entrance of the palace hall, both brother and sister, Imperial Wind Jin and Imperial Wind Qing Yin looked at the ground. Many areas on the surface of the clan residence had started cracking. Clearly, the offense of the enemy was too great, causing some arrays to break. One had to know that the light barrier was in reality formed by the stacking of energy from several dozen arrays. Following as some arrays started breaking, the strength of the light barrier would become weaker.
“Little Sister.” Imperial Wind Jin looked at his little sister, “Big Brother is useless for failing to protect you.”
“It’s fine.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin smiled, “Let us watch Father, Big Brother, and the others battle from here.”
“Mn.” Imperial Wind Jin nodded.
They were too weak. Hence, there was no meaning in participating in the battle.
Furthermore, they knew that they would definitely be defeated this time. The two of them were not willing to hide. Instead, they would rather watch from the side as their clansmen battled.
“Hong~”
Following that, many more areas in the residence began cracking apart. Quite a few arrays could not hold on and started shattering apart. In the end, the dimmed barrier in the sky finally let out a booming sound, and a huge hole was blasted apart by the five God Emperors.
“Broken. It’s broken apart.” Many experts including Bat Mountain Master started panicking. They did not wish to die with the Imperial Wind Clan.
“They are coming!”Imperial Wind Qing Yin started feeling nervous.
“Little Sister, let us watch. Let us watch Father and the others battle.” Second Brother Imperial Wind Jin watched with gritted teeth.
“Kill them all! Wipe out the entire Imperial Wind Clan and leave none alive!” Devil Heart Cultist Master’s voice resounded mightily across the world.
“Yes!” The five God Emperors and 300 God Monarchs acknowledged his order!

chapters.title: Chapter 1298 - Teacher Moving In
chapters.content:
Chapter 1298: Teacher Moving In
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Each of the five God Emperors led along 20 God Monarchs. This was also the biggest advantage the Devil Heart Cult had against the Imperial Wind Clan! The Imperial Wind Clan merely had one Early Stage God Emperor, ‘Imperial Wind High Mountain’. Furthermore, other than the commander, Devil Heart Cult had a total of five Early Stage God Emperors! And once they brought along a group of God Monarchs in combat formations, they were simply invincible.
Even if the Imperial Wind Clan had help from their arrays, the gap between God Monarchs and ‘God Emperors’ was too distinct. This was a qualitative difference between a major level.
Not everyone could fight against those on a higher level like Ascendants.
“Eliminate the children of Imperial Wind High Mountain first.”
“His eldest son Imperial Wind Lei is quite powerful. Currently, he has also formed a combat formation with a group of experts. I’ll go over and eliminate him.”
“Let me handle his other son and daughter, that one called Imperial Wind Jin and Imperial Wind Qing Yin. Haha, I’ll eliminate them at this instance.”
“Sou sou sou sou sou!”
The five teams went separately, leaving behind 200 God Monarchs. These 200 God Monarchs were prepared and had moved into several formations. They began their siege as well!
…
If the Devil Heart Cult formed one single formation and the Imperial Wind Clan formed one single formation, the Imperial Wind Clan might be able to resist back by relying on the arrays.
But once the Devil Heart Cult separated into different teams, the experts from the Devil Heart Cult were able to exhibit their advantages. Those five God Emperors immediately led along their teams--they were like five sharp fangs!
“Face the enemies!” An Elder from the Imperial Wind Clan roared out furiously.
“Kill!” The experts from the Imperial Wind Clan were roaring out too.
They all harbored the thought of dying in the battle and were frenzied.
“What? They are planning on dealing against us right from the start?” Imperial Wind Jin and Imperial Wind Qing Yin looked upwards. They could see a cold male leading 20 God Monarchs in a formation rushing over in their direction! That cold male was currently looking in the direction of the two siblings. Clearly, his target was the two of them.
“I wanted to witness my Imperial Wind Clan kill more enemies. Who would have guessed that there are God Emperors coming to deal with us right at the first moment.” Imperial Wind Jin looked at his little sister by the side.
“We shall be making our moves first.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin remained calm as she faced death. She looked around her. There were so many familiar people--her father, her two brothers, some of her sisters in the clan, and finally her teacher! Imperial Wind Qing Yin looked at Xue Ying, transmitting over: “Teacher, protect yourself well.”
Xue Ying looked at this lass and could not help but laugh.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin was stunned. Her teacher was laughing?
“Imperial Wind High Mountain, haha, these should be your children!” That cold male even took the initiative in announcing it.
In the distance, Imperial Wind High Mountain was being beaten around by Devil Heart Cultist Master. Even as if relied on the strength of the arrays, he could barely survive. Imperial Wind High Mountain noticed his children who stood by the entrance of the palace hall. Seeing what was happening, he could not help but feel pain in his heart: “Jin’er, Qing Yin, the two of you shall first make your moves. Father will be following behind shortly.” But following that, Imperial Wind High Mountain was stunned.
Because there was a member arranged in the combat formation standing by the entrance of the palace hall--a white-robed Xue Ying--who did not care about the formation. Instead, he looked upwards at the team led by the God Emperor rushing downwards.
“Dong.”
Xue Ying took a step, moving up onto the void.
This step onto the void actually produced a terrifying void storm. It was like a powerful wave crashing on the incoming team, directly blasting out a shockwave on the cold male and his team of 20 God Monarchs! Even though they had formed a combat formation, how exquisite was the laws and profound mysteries that Xue Ying comprehended? Furthermore, the <Scarlet Cloud Combat Technique> of the past could break a formation, and now, it was perfected and more powerful.
“Be careful.” The expression of that cold male changed slightly. Even though he was astonished, he still had ample confidence over the combat formation formed by him and his 20 God Monarchs.
But once the void wave landed on their formation, it produced an outcome that forced all of them to a stop! This wave was too fierce!
Furthermore, at the moment when the wave crashed into them, there was a strange wave that ignored the protection from the enemy’s combat formation. It simply permeated into the bodies of that God Emperor and 20 God Monarchs.
“Peng.””Peng.””Peng.””Peng.””Peng.””Peng.”…
The cold male felt a strange energy erupting in his body. But being a God Emperor, he cultivated on his bloodline energy and could naturally suppress that violent energy down.
But the other 20 God Monarchs were forced backwards. Quite a few spurt out blood as they flew backwards. Some even had half their bodies blasting apart! These God Monarchs were trying their best to recover their fleshy bodies!
“What!” The cold male was shocked.
His subordinates were heavily injured and forced backwards? Leaving just him, a God Emperor alone?
And that took just a step.
When Xue Ying took a step, he no longer concealed his aura. The aura from his powerful Chaotic Origin Refined Body rushed up into the sky! If not because he wanted to help his disciple, he might be willing to live his life with a low-profile under seclusion.
Following that, Xue Ying took another step, causing his body to turn blurred. Those who were present including Devil Heart Cultist Master could not see the figure of Xue Ying clearly! Even if this image was slowed by a million times, Xue Ying’s figure would still be blurred. Because what he executed was a movement technique from the <Void Devil Insect Scripture> . Given his realm, he had easily grasped this movement technique.
With a blurred figure that was frighteningly fast, Xue Ying arrived before the cold male in a single instance.
“Who, who is he!” The cold male felt alarmed. This white-robed young man before him was terrifying him intensely. But being a God Emperor expert, he was confident of himself. With a distortion of his figure, he turned himself into a thousand-legged bug. This thousand-legged bug was approximately 100 meters long. It meandered before leaping at Xue Ying. That bloodied mouth of it was hollowed and attempted to devour Xue Ying.
This action itself created a powerful swallowing force that sucked Xue Ying over.
“Pu.”
At that moment, a spear appeared in the right hand of Xue Ying. This spear was entirely black in color. It seemed ordinary, yet in reality, it was the Golden Fire Divine Spear concealed.
With a spear in his hand, Xue Ying first executed a piercing motion!
The thousand-legged bug continued moving. Even though its mouth was wide-opened and was trying to devour Xue Ying, it was able to hurl its tail immediately and clawed out at Xue Ying all done simultaneously. And Xue Ying’s spearhead clashed against one of those claws.
“Fighting head-on with me?” The thousand-legged bug sneered in its heart. Its black carapace was most formidable. Destroying it was hard.
“Weng.”
Nonetheless, when the spear clashed against its claw, an endless wave was sent permeating into its body. Furthermore, this wave was also oscillating within its body, eventually turning into three waves of energy. These waves were also superposing on one another, causing them to become more and more terrifying. The thousand-legged bug began twisting. It wanted to suppress the frightening superposed wave, yet with an eventual ‘boom’ , its body exploded into three sections. Large amounts of its scale went flying all over.
“No, no.” The thousand-legged bug which was left in three sections tried its best to merge its bodies back. Nonetheless, it was slower by a lot.
It did not dare to turn back into its human form since it was weaker and harder for it to escape.
“Pu!”
Another spear was sent out.
How fast was Xue Ying’s spear? This spear pierced out on the thousand-legged insect that had just condensed. Even though the insect tried escaping, how could it ever be faster than Xue YIng? Xue Ying’s blurred figure was like a shadow. With a pierce, that thousand-legged insect exploded into pieces once again, albeit with a more serious injury.
“Be gone!” Xue Ying pierced out once again.
And this time, an enormous void bubble appeared. This void bubble engulfed every single piece of flesh the thousand-legged insect had. Following that, the bubble collapsed until it became one black point. At this moment, the spear pierced out and create an explosion on the bubble.
The thousand-legged insect was wiped out!
It left behind just some remnant items.
The entire battlefield became quiet. Those four teams that were similarly led by other God Emperors and that ‘Devil Heart Cultist Master’ who had been completely suppressed Imperial Wind High Mountain, as well as Bat Mountain Master and the other experts in the city who did not wish to join the funeral were all stunned!
Saying it was slow, but in reality, everything happened incredibly quickly.
Xue Ying took a step, and all enemy God Monarchs flew back! His powerful aura also erupted!
He took another step and three consecutive pierces, and an Early Stage God Emperor was killed!
“This, this is my teacher? Standing by the side of her brother, Imperial Wind Qing Yin watched in a daze. Her mind was completely in a mess.

chapters.title: Chapter 1299 - Scattering in All Directions
chapters.content:
Chapter 1299: Scattering in All Directions
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
As the Great Wilderness contained many Desolate Beasts, Imperial Wind Qing Yin had practically spent most of her life living in High Mountain City. Being the daughter of the City Master, she was definitely a proud girl of the heavens. Nobody dared to scheme against her within High Mountain City. Despite living under this environment, she did not become arrogant. Instead, her personality was kind. After all, living that life of hers, she would almost never encounter any darkness. Instead, she had seen the dark side of life.
And she knew everything.
Her clan was currently facing an impending crisis. Both her father and big brothers who had sheltered her from practically everything were alarmed from that. They required her to sacrifice herself, and she was willing to take responsibility for her clan! Nonetheless, that ‘Eastern Wood City’ had never placed a girl in their eyes. They were not willing to participate in their affairs. She, Imperial Wind Qing Yin, could do nothing. She could only watch as doomsday arrived.
What she could do is to walk with her elders together to death!
As the arrays broke, and the terrifying enemy, ‘Devil Heart Cultist Master’ led his team of experts over, she knew death was imminent.
But at this moment--
“Teacher?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin watched in a daze. She felt like she was floating. The world was spinning around her.
“Oh my god.”
“This, this, this…”
“This is God Monarch Flying Snow?”
“This is mad!”
The surrounding spectators were stunned.
“What!” Despite being under the influence of the arrays, that muscular ‘Devil Heart Cultist Master’ could still completely suppress Imperial Wind High Mountain. Nonetheless, he felt his heart tightening when Xue Ying produced a void wave with a step that blasted the group of God Monarchs away. Following that, his subordinate God Emperor Piercing Wind was killed in a short period--in just three spears.
‘How could he be this powerful? That carapace of God Emperor Piercing Wind is tough, and his survival capabilities are good. Even I would have to strike him several dozens of times before I could kill him. This white-robed male actually killed him in just three moves?’ Devil Heart Cultist Master felt a chill down his spine. But he could see that even though the aura of this white-robed male was strong, it was at most at the Early Stage God Emperor Realm. Furthermore, when Xue Ying pierced his spear on the body of the Thousand-Legged Insect, its carapace did not break. Instead, it was the internals of the insect that exploded apart. ‘The outer carapace is useless. This white-robed male is able to send his attack directly into the body of God Emperor Piercing Wind! Also, he was able to generate a void wave with a step that blasted the God Monarchs away. Clearly, combat formations are useless against his techniques.’
Devil Heart Cultist Master felt alarmed. This utilization of strength was incredibly amazing.
“Big Brother, this white-robed man should be God Monarch Flying Snow as recorded in the intelligence! He is an Ascendant. But his strength is clearly stated as a God Monarch in the report.”
“Middle Stage God Monarch? This is clearly a strength at the Early Stage God Emperor rank! And he is an Ascendant too.” Devil Heart Cultist Master immediately understood it. An Ascendant who reached the Early Stage God Emperor Realm could definitely fight against a Middle Stage God Emperor! Furthermore, Ascendants could employ their techniques really exquisitely. They were unlike the natives of the Divine Realm who merely unleashed the potential of their bloodlines. Instead, they would frequently execute techniques that astonished the world.
And due to the apprehension of Devil Heart Cultist Master, he naturally became relaxed against Imperial Wind High Mountain.
And Imperial Wind High Mountain similarly paid attention to the fate of his children.
‘What, God Monarch Flying Snow, he…’ Imperial Wind High Mountain was stunned. ‘God Emperor Piercing Wind’ who had similar strength to him was actually killed under three moves, ‘So it seems that the strongest expert in High Mountain City isn’t me. Instead, it is God Monarch Flying Snow! No, it should be God Emperor Flying Snow instead!’
At this moment, Imperial Wind High Mountain felt ecstasy deep in his heart!
He could kill an Early Stage God Emperor in three moves!
This was absolutely a huge backing he could rely on!
He would definitely grab on to it! He had to! Once he did so, the fate of his Imperial Wind Clan would transform!
…
Various parties had differing thoughts. But all of them were stunned by the newly-unveiled strength of Xue Ying.
“Hmph.” After Xue Ying killed one God Emperor, he did not stop. Sweeping his gaze across, his vision landed on one of the other four God Emperors under Devil Heart Cultist Master. That was an ugly gray-robed male who was enveloped in a grayish-white aura. He was originally leading 20 God Monarchs in a combat formation and was killing many experts from the Imperial Wind Clan. When Xue Ying showed his true strength, the attention of this gray-robed male could not help but be caught by it.
“Sou!”
Xue Ying began moving. He once again executed the Void Devil Insect Scripture. His body became blurred, and his speed was incredibly fast. He simply leapt at the gray-robed male.
“Not good.” The gray-robed male paled. He did not hesitate to retreat.
“Everyone retreat!” When Devil Heart Cultist Master saw, he anxiously shouted out. At the same time, he transmitted angrily towards Xue Ying, “God Emperor Flying Snow, if you dare, fight with me!”
Saying that, he went to help his subordinates.
After all, he only had five God Emperors. One was killed previously, and if he let this continued on, even if he exterminated the Imperial Wind Clan, how many God Emperors would he have left? Furthermore, this Ascendant God Emperor was merely at the early stage, yet his techniques were unpredictable. He could deal with other Early Stage God Emperors as easy as breathing!
“You wish to go?” Imperial Wind High Mountain tried his best to delay Devil Heart Cultist Master. He employed the energy of the arrays to suppress down on the other party.
“How could he be this quick?” The expression on that fleeing gray-robed male became ugly. Behind him, the blurred figure had appeared practically in the blink of an eye. That was simply too quick!
“Hu.”
Xue Ying stared at this fleeing gray-robed male with a cold expression. Just as he was prepared to strike down, the grayish-white aura that surrounded this gray-robed male began expanding. He took the initiative to dissipate his body, turning into a concentrated grayish energy that flew in all directions. This was ‘God Emperor Ghost Flame’, and the one with the heaviest killing aura out of the five God Emperors of Devil Heart Cultist Master. He was also the most vicious and evil out of them. And now, he was frightened by Xue Ying so much that he manifested his Ghost Flame Body and attempted to escape.
“Be gone!” Xue Ying simply raised the spear in both his arms. Following that, he hacked the spear downwards!
“Hong!”
The space before him was crushed flat.
“This is--”‘God Emperor Ghost Flame’ who had manifested himself into his Ghost Flame Body felt the space around him transforming rapidly. It was rapidly being crushed flat. From an ordinary space, it turned into a two-dimensional space like a piece of paper! Under this crushing force, the Ghost Flame Energy that was originally flying at ‘high speed’ was forced flat. And now, God Emperor Ghost Flame struggled against the spatial suppression.
He had a feeling that once he was crushed into a ‘piece of paper’, he would be dead!
That’s right.
The current Xue Ying had naturally surpassed his teacher, Southern Cloud King. This ‘Spectacular Painting’ exhibited a strength that far exceeds what it was in the past. Furthermore, this technique executed by Xue Ying was meant to kill instead of trapping the enemy. He did not show any mercy at all!
“Hong hong hong~” The Ghost Flame struggled, yet it was being blotted out and consumed.
Eventually, the flame completely dissipated once the space was completely flat! God Emperor Ghost Flame still had some remnant ‘Ghost Flame’ burning. He felt joy in his heart and wanted to escape up into the heavens.
Nonetheless, when the flat space was collapsing apart, a terrifying spear appeared right before him.
“Hong!”
The entire space before Ghost Flame exploded like beancurd.
And this remnant ‘Ghost Flame’--what was left of God Emperor Ghost Flame--was wiped out from the world.
This technique was also known as the ‘Arch Destruction’!
Spectacular Painting, Arch Destruction, … these were techniques that made Southern Cloud King famous. Xue Ying had a deeper foundation. Naturally, he optimized both techniques and perfectly fused them together. One technique would be used to trap the enemy spatially, and the other technique to shatter apart space. When both techniques were executed as combo, the final damage was greater! It was primarily because Xue Ying saw this God Emperor turning himself into a grayish-white Ghost Flame that made Xue Ying decide to use the combo technique.
“Another is dead!”
“Heavens.”
“Hurry up and run!”
The other three God Emperors under Devil Heart Cultist Master were frightened. Primarily, all those God Emperors killed by Xue Ying had powerful survival capabilities--one had powerful external defenses, and one had the best evasive capabilities after turning his body into Ghost Flame. One was killed in three techniques and the other in to! The remaining three God Emperors asked themselves and knew that they would not survive past three techniques under God Emperor Flying Snow.
“How could there be such an expert appearing in High Mountain City? Hurry up and run!” The three remaining God Emperors immediately fled anxiously in different directions.
“Damn!”
A furious roar could be heard.
Devil Heart Cultist Master immediately took the initiative in rushing over to Xue Ying. he finally got rid of Imperial Wind High Mountain. Nonetheless, Xue Ying’s speed at killing God Emperor Ghost Flame was too fast and the other party did not have sufficient time to save his subordinate.
“God Emperor Flying Snow, if you are daring enough, fight with me!” The hair of Devil Heart Cultist Master started flying in all directions. He was incredibly indignant at this moment.
Xue Ying glanced at the three God Emperors that escaped far away before turning back to Devil Heart Cultist Master. Bringing up his spear with one hand, he said: “As you wish.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1300 - You wish to run?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1300: You wish to run?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
His voice was still reverberating.
When Xue Ying had already executed the Void Devil Insect Scripture and flew over. With a spear in his hand, Xue Ying charged right at Devil Heart Cultist Master.
“You came at the right moment!” Devil Heart Cultist Master could feel the bellyful of stifle exploding at this moment. Extending both his arms, he immediately produced endless frost that submerged Xue Ying. Every single inch of space was being frozen. On the surface of Devil Heart Cultist Master’s body, a layer of frost had formed. This frost energy was clearly more tyrannical than Bat Mountain Master’s.
Xue Ying immediately felt that things were amiss before he even encountered the frost energy. He understood that he must not be ‘frozen’ and immediately swiped his spear out.
“Hua hua hua.”
The spearhead revolved about an arc, forming waves of energy. Layer and layer of spatial fluctuation spread out in all directions, blocking against the incoming frost energy! This was much more formidable than the survival technique Xue Ying created in the past, the ‘Myriad Realms Movement Technique’. This newly-created technique absorbed some of the profound mysteries in <Realmless> . In addition to his current realm, that was how he could execute this spear technique.
That frost energy became greatly weakened as it moved through the layers of spatial fluctuation. When it reached Xue Ying, even though the frost energy was still powerful, the damage dealt to Xue Ying’s Chaotic Origin Refined Body that was voidified could be neglected.
“What.” Devil Heart Cultist Master’s expression changed. This God Emperor Flying Snow could actually resist against his frost energy directly.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying killed his way over. He abruptly pierced out his spear after a whirlwind cut right at Devil Heart Cultist Master.
Devil Heart Cultist Master felt the void turning distorted before him. He had a feeling that this spear could not be evaded: ‘I don’t care! Get destroyed by me!’ Devil Heart Cultist Master punched out a destructive force with both his fists. It was to the extent that both his fists turned crimson. As his fists were punched out ahead of him, they became bigger, turning just like two tiny hills that boomed out when they met against the incoming spear.
Xue Ying was clear that how amazing the fleshy body of this Devil Heart Cultist Master is. Previously, the other party had easily destroyed the city-protective array with just one single hand of his.
But Xue Ying had longed for an opponent to test his techniques ever since he started cultivating in High Mountain City!
“Hong!”
The spear pierced against the two hill-like fists.
“Mn?” Xue Ying’s expression changed. He felt a frightening force transmitting through his spear onto his body. Despite being weakened by his void-ification, this force still came in waves just like an erupting volcano. Xue Ying was forced backwards uncontrollably, stopping only after he flew back for a few hundred meters.
His color became uglier. Opening his mouth, he spurt out blood that was imbued with flames.
‘This fleshy body of mine is merely at the Early Stage God Emperor level. By relying on the profoundness of my techniques, I was able to better utilize my energy. That is how I can deal against the killing techniques executed with flaws by the enemy. When dealing with enemies at the same level, I could kill them easily as a result. But when I am fighting against a Middle Stage God Emperor, even though the other party might be crude in the way he utilized his techniques, his strength was originally high in the first place. Hence, the final result is still me losing out.’ Xue Ying thought.
“Mn?” And Devil Heart Cultist Master who stood in midair without moving was similarly feeling unpleasant. That spear executed by Xue Ying was the killing technique that he used in dealing against ‘God Emperor Piercing Wind’. It disregarded the defenses and went directly into the body of Devil Heart Cultist Master. The surging ripples were constantly amplifying in his body, and they converged together to a limit before exploding!
Just like God Emperor Piercing Wind’s ‘Thousand-Legged Insect Body’ that exploded inwardly.
Even though Devil Heart Cultist Master’s fleshy body was stronger--both inside and outside--the explosion that occurred within his body still made Devil Heart Cultist Master feel sweetness in his throat. He forced back that mouthful of blood back into his stomach.
‘My Frost Protection could not defend against his attack at all.’ Devil Heart Cultist Master thought. His frost layer covering his body was also the strongest defensive technique he had. Facing against a technique that disregarded the frost layer totally, he finally understood how ruthless and unfathomable the techniques of an Ascendant God Emperor were.
“Come again.” Devil Heart Cultist Master roared out.
“Sure.” Xue Ying similarly went forward.
This time, Xue Ying would not fight head-on so foolishly. He executed his Void Devil Insect Scripture Technique, causing his body to turn blurry. Xue Ying then went around Devil Heart Cultist Master and maximized the advantage of his movement technique to sneak more attacks against the enemy! Various Dao of Void techniques were executed one after another as Xue Ying attempted to find the most effective technique against Devil Heart Cultist Master. And Devil Heart Cultist Master was similarly engaging Xue Ying with all his strength. This time, he lost two God Emperors. No matter what, he could not let things go easily.
“Hong hong hong~”
Devil Heart Cultist Master was incomparably frenzied. Surrounding him, the frost energy spread out wildly. Yet his arms, legs and other parts of his body were creating a terrifying blazing energy.
“Die!”
Devil Heart Cultist Master was completely mad. He had even turned himself into a giant of several kilometers tall. His palms slapped out at the ant-like Xue Ying. With one strike, one palm of his was filled with frost and the other palm filled with blazing heat. This fusion strike created a loud boom that shook the entire High Mountain City. Devil Heart Cultist Master was also forced into an anxious situation. Even though enlarging his body made him stronger by five times, his speed and soul strength were clearly compromised. For the sake of winning, Devil Heart Cultist Master was doing all he could.
…
“This, this…”
The other experts were watching the gigantic ‘Devil Heart Cultist Master’ fight against Xue Ying. Devil Heart Cultist Master had already flew out of the region where the arrays of the Imperial Wind Clan covered. Because he would be suppressed by the energy of the array if he stayed within.
All the experts in the residence of Imperial Wind Clan felt their hearts trembling.
‘He is indeed a God Emperor that ranked in the top 1,000.’ Imperial Wind High Mountain felt his heart trembling, ‘If not for God Emperor Flying Snow, I doubt I could survive after ten or so breaths of time under the onslaught of Old Thief Devil Heart even if I had the help from my arrays.’
“This is Brother Flying Snow?” Bat Mountain Master felt nervous, “I, I, Bat Mountain, actually dispatched some experts to assassinate Brother Flying Snow?”
He felt a wave of lingering fear!
Fortunately, he challenged God Monarch Flying Snow on the battle platform inside the Imperial Wind Clan residence! Where it was forbidden to kill! And it was fortunate he actually made amends and apologized to the other party.
‘Damn that Tie Cheng Liu.’ At this moment, Bat Mountain Master could not help but curse a few sentences at Tie Cheng Liu who was dead.
“Teacher Flying Snow…” Imperial Wind Jin looked upwards and then at his little sister who stood by his side.
…
Currently, there were several other experts within High Mountain City that did not participate in the battle like Xing Pavilion Master from the Heaven’s Will Pavilion and God Monarch Chuang Qing from the branch team of Mysterious Fire Army who were watching the battle. They were looking at the towering giant above the residence of Imperial Wind Clan fight against God Emperor Flying Snow.
“Brother Flying Snow is actually this powerful. He shouldn’t be a God Monarch. He should be a God Emperor instead.” God Monarch Chuang Qing looked with a startle, “Indeed, he is an Ascendant God Emperor. Even though the commander of Devil Heart Cult has put in all his strength, Brother Flying Snow doesn’t seem to be on the losing end.”
And Xing Pavilion Master from the Heaven’s Will Pavilion watched from afar with a book in his hand. The book was naturally recording what was happening accompanied with many words.
Other than collecting information of various parties, the Heaven’s Will Pavilion was the one that established the ‘God Emperor Ranking List’.
Devil Heart Cultist Master was an expert on the ranking list. Hence, this battle was naturally important because it involved the movement of the rankings between God Emperors.
‘Who would have thought that there could actually be a huge battle happening in this small isolated city I am in, High Mountain City. And this battle requires me to be responsible for recording this battle that could possibly result in a change in the God Emperor Ranking List.’ Xing Pavilion Master was slightly nervous. As he recorded the scene of the battle, he was also recording what he saw, ‘God Emperor Flying Snow’s body technique is amazing. He is much faster than Devil Heart Cultist Master and completely grasped the initiative of the battle. He has many profound techniques too. Nonetheless, he is unable to deal against Devil Heart Cultist Master. But even though Devil Heart Cultist Master is pouring in his full strength, he could not hit God Emperor Flying Snow at all…’
The three fortuitous God Emperors of Devil Heart Cultist Master that had escaped high up into the sky had boarded the huge battleship. They stood on the deck of the battleship watching the battle happening below.
‘Almost, that was close.’ The three of them exchanged glances and felt the lingering fear. They did not dare to participate in the battle any longer because their combat formations were clearly useless against that God Emperor Flying Snow! God Emperor Flying Snow’s attacks could even ignore their defenses, directly transmitting into their bodies. They dared not test it out if they could survive.
Various parties were watching the battle with bated breaths.
And Devil Heart Cultist Master was already slightly frustrated now.
“Hou--” The gigantic Devil Heart Cultist Master opened his mouth, shooting out an icy-fire ball.
Xue Ying’s expression changed slightly. He immediately retreated. At the same time, he tapped out with his spear.
An unseen ripple clashed out against that icy-fire ball, causing it to explode with a huge boom!
‘Useless. Everything is useless. Even when I have manifested my body in an extreme state, allowing me to execute stronger techniques, I can’t hit him at all.’ Devil Heart Cultist Master felt incredibly frustrated at this moment. He originally felt that this God Emperor Flying Snow was too slippery. But after his transformation, this frustration became greater.
He felt sullen and unpleasant. At the same time, Xue Ying thought: ‘It seems that defeating a Middle Stage God Emperor using the fleshy body of an Early Stage God Emperor is impossible.’
That’s right too.
Nobody could do so in the entire Divine Realm!
Of course, it would be a different thing once he cast his Mirage and Illusory Realm technique. But that way, it would not be his Dao of Void strength. Furthermore, there were too many experts here. Devil Heart Cultist Master was also strong. Even if he could weaken the strength of the other party, he would not be able to cause his target to fall into oblivion! As long as the other party maintained a sliver of consciousness, he would be able to spread the news about his ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm technique’ out to the rest of the world.
Seeing how he caused a huge hullabaloo across the entire Broken Tooth Mountain Range after he executed his Mirage and Illusory Realm technique.
In this world, if Xue Ying were to reveal his soul technique, he would definitely not have any peaceful days in the future! Furthermore, given that this world contained more experts, Xue Ying chose not to temporarily publicize his Mirage and Illusory Realm Technique.
“Sou.”
Devil Heart Cultist Master abruptly shrank once again. In the blink of an eye, he regained his original appearance.
He swept his gaze towards Imperial Wind High Mountain who stood in a distance before shouting out: “Imperial Wind High Mountain, you are really lucky! That there is an Ascendant God Emperor who is willing to help you. However, I do wish to see if this Ascendant is planning on staying in your High Mountain City forever!”
Imperial Wind High Mountain felt his heart trembling.
That’s right.
Why would an Ascendant God Emperor stay in a small city like his High Mountain City forever?
“Also God Emperor Flying Snow.” Devil Heart Cultist Master turned to Xue Ying before coldly laughing, “Very good. I can’t deal with you for now but I, Devil Heart, will etch this enmity in my heart forever. Hmph hmph.”
Angrily spitting, Devil Heart Cultist Master turned around and chose to leave.
“Are you thinking of leaving now?” Xue Ying started, “Becoming afraid after just a short while?”
“Afraid?”
Devil Heart Cultist Master’s indignance had reached a limit. He turned to Xue Ying. It was clear that he had a clear upperhand in this battle. Nonetheless, that Ascendant was too slippery.
But following that, Devil Heart Cultist Master’s expression changed greatly.
Because the aura of Xue Ying was rising! Previously, he was clearly an Early Stage God Emperor. But at this moment, both arms of Xue Ying were becoming thicker. Furthermore, many layers of black membrane started appearing on the surface of his arms. His aura became more violent and unstable. Xue Ying who owned a pair of thick arms was much more muscular now. His aura, wild and powerful--one that far surpassed what he had previously.
‘Unless he hasn’t showed his true strength just now?’ Devil Heart Cultist Master felt his heart trembling at this thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 1301 - Trembling Heart and Weakening Legs
chapters.content:
Chapter 1301: Trembling Heart and Weakening Legs
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying could feel a wild strength coursing through his arms. He nodded inwardly. Back when he was still at the Realm Heart Great Land, his Chaotic Origin Refinement Body had reached the early stage Emperor Realm (Early Stage God Emperor), just that it was not stable! After coming to this world, with the inborn talent of Xue Ying and the reference from scriptures written by experts of this world, Xue Ying had recovered his strength relatively quickly. Furthermore, he had also stabilized his body cultivation technique too.
It was to the extent where Xue Ying even deepened his understanding of the Dao after re-training his body cultivation technique under a different civilization! He had ideas on how to reach the ‘Middle Stage God Emperor Realm’. Xue Ying even came out with quite a few versions of the Chaotic Origin Refinement Body that could enable him to unleash a Middle Stage God Emperor strength! Just that it was not stable.
His path was strayed from the creators for <Realmless> and <Heaven and Earth> . To him, scriptures written by other experts could only inspire and aid him. Xue Ying planned on creating his own Dao path that would reach the ‘Middle Stage God Emperor Realm’, and this was a challenging task. After all, unlike the natives who had traces of Chaotic Origin Ancestral God bloodline and could improve just by digging out their potential, Xue Ying had to rely on himself step by step to improve.
And it was this strong and matchless foundation that enabled Ascendants to fight against those at a higher level!
‘Even though it is not stable and is consuming the energy of my fleshy body rapidly, I am also recovering at a very fast pace. I could still last for an hour at my current state of Chaotic Origin Refinement Body.’ Xue Ying thought. According to the rate of consumption, even if he did not battle, he would be left with just 30% of his life force after an hour! This was also the limit he set for himself since he had never succeeded in grasping teleportation or avatar techniques given the law suppression of this world! Hence, Xue Ying had to do all he could to protect this sole avatar of his.
‘An hour is sufficient for me!’ Xue Ying’s aura rose violently. Holding the black spear with one hand, he took a step and charged right at Devil Heart Cultist Master.
‘His aura rose greatly. It is so much stronger than previously. Has it reached the Middle Stage God Emperor level?’ Devil Heart Cultist Master felt uneasy in his heart, ‘He is an Ascendant. If he wields the power of a Middle Stage God Emperor, he would be able to fight with Late Stage God Emperors and might possibly kill me.’
‘Not good, he is here!’
The eyelids of Devil Heart Cultist Master twitched. Xue Ying’s blurred figure had come over at an extremely fast pace.
“I bet you must be using some sort of forbidden technique! You can’t last long at that state!” Devil Heart Cultist Master roared while observing the expression of Xue Ying. At the same time, he used both his hands to defend against the incoming spear by Xue Ying.
“Hua.”
And when Devil Heart Cultist Master extended both his palms, a layer of ice and fire formed before him one after another… Adding up to a total of three ice and three fire layers. This was also the first time Devil Heart Cultist Master poured his full strength in defending against Xue Ying since the start of the battle! Previously, Devil Heart Cultist Master had been pouring his full strength to attack. Nonetheless, Xue Ying was so slippery that he evaded all his attacks. And now, Devil Heart Cultist Master did not dare to act so recklessly as before. He was afraid that he might be heavily injured when this spear came, losing his life in just two or three strikes!
That was definitely doable by a Middle Stage Ascendant God Emperor!
Hence, he had to do his best to defend!
“Pu.”
The spear pierced through the outermost fire layer. A terrifying ripple was permeating through rapidly, one layer after another until it reached the frost protection covering the body of Devil Heart Cultist Master. Even as this ripple passed through so many obstacles, its strength was merely weakened by 20%. But that still showed how remarkable this defensive technique executed by Devil Heart Cultist Master was.
“Mn?” Devil Heart Cultist Master widened his eyes. He felt a ripple three times stronger than before entering his body. It vibrated wildly before converging and exploding inside!
If this was before, he could still withstand against the force. But when the force became three times stronger…
“Pu!”
Devil Heart Cultist Master could not help but open his mouth and spurt out fresh blood. Even some pieces of his damaged inner organs flew out. Wounds started appearing on his skin. He looked at Xue Ying with shock and terror. The other party was truly a Middle Stage God Emperor!
“How could it be--”
“Go!”
