Devil Heart Cultist Master had a feeling that he would lose his life after ten similar strikes! Under this life and death battle, what could ten strikes mean?
Hence, knowing that his life was endangered, Devil Heart Cultist Master did not hesitate to flee despite being heavily injured.
“Sou--”
Frost energy began circulating and spreading out in all directions. This energy tried to suppress and reduce the speed of Xue Ying. The body of Devil Heart Cultist Master had turned crimson as if he was a meteorite. He was currently moving at high speed towards the huge battleship stopped in midair. That battleship contained three of his God Emperors and a group of God Monarchs! That should be sufficient to delay this God Emperor Flying Snow for some time.
“Do you think you can escape from me?” Xue Ying took a step. His body became blurred. Even though his Chaotic Origin Refinement Body was currently focused on both his arms and as a result increased his strength, there was only a negligible boost to his speed! Nonetheless, once he executed the Void Devil Insect Body Technique, his speed was much faster than Devil Heart Cultist Master’s after breaking through the suppression of the frost energy.
“What!”
“This, this…”
“Hurry up and run!”
“Run in different directions!”
The three God Emperors and the group of God Monarchs on the battleship were originally spectating the battle. They all felt that this mission would fail with an equilibrium outcome for both their commander and that God Emperor Flying Snow! And their commander would soon leave after retreating to the battleship!
But, once God Emperor Flying Snow erupts with his full strength, he had heavily injured Devil Heart Cultist Master with a single strike. Clearly, the strength of both parties were no longer at the same level! This gap was distinct. Even though it was not as clear as that of how Xue Ying killed the two Early Stage God Emperors previously, he should still be able to kill their commanders in just a few moves.
“Hurry up and separate!”
“Run!”
The three Early Stage God Emperors and the group of God Monarchs were so afraid that they began scattering. They ran in different directions. All of them did not wish to join their commander to die!
When the fleeing Devil Heart Cultist Master saw this, his expression changed. Once the tree falls, the monkeys will scatter. Since this huge tree was about to fall, these subordinates would naturally escape. They were not willing to help him delay for more time.
“Hong~”
Behind him, Xue Ying had came sending a furious strike over.
Even though there was still a gap between them, the surrounding space had abruptly shrunk. It was none other than the ‘Spectacular Painting’ technique. Devil Heart Cultist Master only felt the surrounding space becoming suppressed at a rapid pace. He felt his fleshy body being ‘pressed and ironed’ out at high speed. And Devil Heart Cultist Master was doing his best to resist back! But that terrifying spear had been executed with a unique set of laws and profound mysteries, allowing its force to transmit through this spatial suppression. Clearly, this technique had become much stronger once Xue Ying’s Chaotic Origin Refinement Body became more powerful.
“Pu pu pu.” Devil Heart Cultist Master was being pressed. Wounds started appearing on his body, and fresh blood were flying all over the place.
This space that was rapidly pressed down into a sheet of paper was about to collapse.
But Xue Ying closely followed that with an ‘Arch Destruction’.
“Peng.”
Yet another spear came crashing down, causing this originally unstable space to explode completely!
“Hong hong hong~”
And Devil Heart Cultist Master who was within the space, felt his surroundings breaking apart. His body was also being torn under this terrifying energy. The frost layer over his body was resisting against the incoming force. His arms were also doing his best to execute some techniques to defend against it. Nonetheless, he still failed to withstand against the full-fledged force.
Amidst the explosion, he decisively gave up his lower-half of his body. Every part beneath his waist started shattering apart. His upper body could barely maintain its usual appearance. Under the protection of both his arms, this upper half of his body made its way out of the exploding space.
Once he flew out, he immediately poured his life force to recover from his injuries. Nonetheless, this consumed close to half his life force, something that could not be replenished in a short period.
At the same time, Devil Heart Cultist Master could no longer care less. Under the terrified state of his, he flipped his hand and brought out a piece of unique branch strip. This was an item bestowed to him after he joined the sect of ‘Hidden Willow Valley Master’, and also a precious item for survival given by Hidden Willow Valley Master to experts of his sects. His survival item was a consumable item! And with the identity of Hidden Willow Valley Master, he would feel disdain to give a second time to his subordinate unless that subordinate contributed greatly. Hence, Devil Heart Cultist Master would rather let his subordinates die than to use this most precious survival treasure of his. But now, he could no longer care less! He would be killed by God Emperor Flying Snow if he hesitated further!
“Weng.”
This branch strip immediately let out a powerful energy that engulfed Devil Heart Cultist Master.
“Sou!”
He immediately turned into a deep green light that flew over to the horizons at a frightening speed. This flying speed was much faster than his previous by a few times. It also far surpassed that speed Xue Ying could reach by executing the Void Devil Insect body technique.
“Escaping?” Even though Xue Ying was slower by an entire level, he continued chasing after the other party.
One chasing after the other fleeing party. In the blink of an eye, they flew out of High Mountain City, disappearing in the distance Great Wilderness.
…
The group of experts in High Mountain City were in a daze. Including Imperial Wind High Mountain, they were stunned. Honestly, the situation of the battle transformed to drastically.
When Tutor Flying Snow erupts with his strength, he heavily injured Devil Heart Cultist Master in one single strike, forcing the other party to escape. The next two moves even caused Devil Heart Cultist Master to be left with just half his body. Following that, Devil Heart Cultist Master brought out a special branch strip that significantly boosted his speed! Tutor Flying Snow also chased after the other escaping party out of High Mountain City, and both of them had headed into the Great Wilderness.
The battle happened honestly too quickly that everyone present felt their heads spinning. What did the battle that just happened mean to them? Thinking about it, they felt their hearts trembling and their legs weakening!

chapters.title: Chapter 1302 - Already Eliminated
chapters.content:
Chapter 1302: Already Eliminated
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Even the experienced Xing Pavilion Master from the ‘Heaven’s Will Pavilion’ who had been recording the whole process of battle looked out to the distance. He felt his throat becoming dry. He mumbled to himself: “One technique is sufficient to injure Devil Heart Cultist Master heavily. Three techniques to shatter the body of Devil Heart Cultist Master. It seems that he is really a Middle Stage Ascendant God Emperor and is comparable to a Late Stage God Emperor.”
What did having the combat strength of a Late Stage God Emperor mean?
The group of experts in High Mountain City all understood it. Just like that City Master of ‘Eastern Wood City’ who had a noble identity, it was because he was a Late Stage God Emperor. Previously, Imperial Wind High Mountain attempted to marry his daughter to the Ninth Prince of Eastern Wood City. Even though they gifted many presents and also did it through several other high-level connections in Eastern Wood City to seek the help of ‘Eastern Wood City Master’, in reality, the emissary team sent out from High Mountain City was not qualified to even meet the Eastern Wood City Master!
Even across the entire Divine Realm, a Late Stage God Emperor would usually be an overlord of a territory! Even the three great royal clans treated them with respect!
‘A Middle Stage Ascendant God Emperor has the combat strength of a Late Stage God Emperor. He could even suppress Old Thief Devil Heart who ranks in the God Emperor Ranking List savagely with three moves!’ Imperial Wind High Mountain felt his heart trembling.
Old Thief Devil Heart was ranked in the top 1,000 across the entire Divine Realm.
Yet he was beaten savagely in three moves!
One could see how frightening Tutor Flying Snow was!
‘This is a great opportunity! A great opportunity! My daughter Qing Yin could actually become the disciple of such an expert. He even saved my entire Imperial Wind Clan because of this.’ Imperial Wind High Mountain looked towards his daughter, Imperial Wind Qing Yin.
The brothers Imperial Wind Lei and Imperial Wind Jin could not help but look at their little sister. The two of them felt envious, and happy for their sister at the same time.
“Strength of a Late Stage God Emperor?”
“Heavens!”
“Such an expert actually lives in seclusion within this small little High Mountain City of ours?”
Various experts were startled.
They could only look up to such experts since any Late Stage God Emperor was considered a transcendental expert in any location within the Divine Realm.
“I wonder if Senior Flying Snow could kill that Devil Heart Cultist Master or not.” Many experts were casting their gaze in the direction where both Devil Heart Cultist Master and Xue Ying rushed towards, far out into the Great Wilderness. These experts could not see the other two. They were honestly too quick.
“Hu hu hu--”
The wind whistled.
Devil Heart Cultist Master was currently flying at a frightening speed. His figure left behind a bright radiance of green light. Currently, he was completely recovered. Of course, this was only on the surface since replenishing his life force took an incredibly long amount of time.
‘The treasure bestowed by Valley Master has boosted my speed to a stage where most Late Stage God Emperors can’t reach up to me. It is also much faster than that God Emperor Flying Snow.’ Devil Heart Cultist Master looked backwards. At least, he could not see the other party with his naked eyes. But he did not dare to slow down and remained flying at top speed ahead. His priority now was to put as much distance as he could between him and Xue Ying.
He continued flying at this top speed for the time taken to brew a cup of tea before the green luminance covering his body dissipate.
Devil Heart Cultist Master looked at the branch strip in his hand. This branch strip was currently crumbling apart. The energy of this treasure had been completely consumed.
‘After flying for so long, I should have hurled him far behind.’ Even though Devil Heart Cultist Master had this thinking, he still did his best to fly ahead. He did not bring out his battleship and other treasures. Even though he did not have to control these flying items, their speed was not as fast as his current speed.
…
In the Great Wilderness.
Xue Ying had already grasped control over his fleshy body, causing the particles of his body to transform and recover back to the original stable form of the Chaotic Origin Refinement Body. He was currently resting on a piece of rock within the Great Wilderness drinking a flask of wine.
He would not be so foolish to chase after the other party since he was running away at such high speed. How tired would that be!
‘Mn, his speed has slowed. It seems the energy of his treasure should have been used up.’ Xue Ying relied on his tracing technique to sense an approximate position where Devil Heart Cultist Master was. After all, the current karmic ties between both parties were huge.
‘I shall wait a little longer. It would take quite a bit of time for me to chase up to him using my Void Devil Insect Movement Technique.’ Xue Ying estimated the amount of time needed. In the meantime, he continued drinking.
‘It should be about time.’
‘Time to go.’
Xue Ying flipped his hand and kept the flask of wine. His arms became thick, and layers of black membrane started covering his arms. His aura once again became wild and unstable. Extending his right hand, a black spear appeared.
“Si--”
A black crack formed by the side. With a flash, Xue Ying entered through this crack.
Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique!
Even though Devil Heart Cultist Master was running with all his might, in reality, the distance between both parties were not that far since the other party was just flying! Using the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique that could allow him to reach any position in the Divine Realm was really using a butcher’s knife to kill a chicken! Xue Ying was primarily too lazy to use his Void Devil Insect Movement Technique to chase after the other party.
“Si.” From the black crack, Xue Ying appeared. Only once he sensed where Devil Heart Cultist Master was did he casually execute the Void Devil Insect Body Technique and chase after the other party.
Just about ten breaths of time later.
The escaping Devil Heart Cultist Master looked behind to see a miniature figure chasing him with terror. That was God Emperor Flying Snow who wielded a spear!
‘He has actually reached me?’ Devil Heart Cultist Master panicked, ‘I hurled him so far behind yet he did not let me off and has continued chasing me until now?’
No choice.
Xue Ying had long reached the final realm of the Dao of Void. His attainments in the Dao of Soul had also reached an unfathomable stage. Furthermore, his soul had once been nourished with a droplet of the heart blood of Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother. When he was a level two Cosmos God, Emperor Summer could not even trace him down, much less now. In this world, the only people who could trace down Xue Ying would most likely be the three creators of this Divine Realm, the Chaotic Origin experts.
“Sou sou sou--”
Even though Devil Heart Cultist Master was running with all his might, Xue Ying’s figure was reaching closer to him. That blurred figure was also becoming bigger in the vision of Devil Heart Cultist Master.
“You can’t escape from me.” Xue Ying said.
“God Emperor Flying Snow, I have no animosity or grievances with you. You also killed two of my God Emperors. How about we let things end here? I can swear that from now on, I’ll never go to the High Mountain City anymore, and neither would I take vengeance against the Imperial Wind Clan.” At the same time as he was escaping, Devil Heart Cultist Master transmitted over anxiously to Xue Ying, begging for mercy.
“No animosity or grievances?” Xue Ying shook his head, “Why do I remember the words you mentioned at High Mountain City, ‘that I, Devil Heart, will remember this enmity’?”
Devil Heart Cultist Master felt bitter.
How had the times changed!
“God Emperor Flying Snow, please show some mercy and spare my life! Tell me what you want me to do? I’ll definitely promise you.” Devil Heart Cultist Master anxiously asked for mercy! Because Xue Ying was getting very close to him.
And in return, Xue Ying pierced his spear out emotionlessly.
When this spear struck out.
The surrounding void was like a bubble that wrapped around Devil Heart Cultist Master. It rapidly collapsed until it became a single black point. Devil Heart Cultist Master shrunk along with this bubble. He was both furious and in despair. Why, why would he be so unlucky? Why would God Emperor Flying Snow choose not to spare his life?
…
Just a few moves later.
Devil Heart Cultist Master was shattered, turning into powder amidst the chaotic space. He left behind just some treasures which Xue Ying collected.
“Hmph.” Xue Ying coldly snorted. Why did he continue chasing after Devil Heart Cultist Master and did not show any mercy for the other party?
Because he could sense how heavy the karmic ties were on Devil Heart Cultist Master. They were filled with so much grievances! Facing this huge devil, Xue Ying would naturally not show any mercy! Devil Heart Cultist Master had even called himself ‘Devil Heart’. He did things without showing mercy or following any order. After becoming enemies with Imperial Wind High Mountain, Devil Heart Cultist Master planned on wiping out the Imperial Wind Clan! One could see his personality from this.
‘Now that I have eliminated the commander of the Devil Heart Cult and two other God Emperors, with three other escaping, I should be done with the cleaning up.’ Xue Ying chuckled. He then began his journey back home.
He did not continue chasing after the other three.
Given his Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, Xue Ying could easily conceal and alter his aura, preventing the enemies from tracing him down. It would be an easy task for him to chase after and kill the three God Emperors. But Xue Ying’s nature made it such that he could not tolerate those huge devils. As for ordinary cultivators, he would be too lazy to participate in their life and death battles.
Of the commander and five God Emperors in the Devil Heart Cult!
Those that could be considered as huge devils included only the ‘Devil Heart Cultist Master’ and that vicious ‘God Emperor Ghost Flame’. That time when Xue Ying first killed ‘God Emperor Piercing Wind’ was due to the sinister attitude of God Emperor Piercing Wind. The other party wanted to deal against the weakest Imperial Wind Qing Yin, which was why Xue Ying chose to eliminate him first. After that, he chose to kill God Emperor Ghost Flame primarily due to the huge karmic grievances tying his body. It was even denser than the karmic ties surrounding Devil Heart Cultist Master. Xue Ying naturally did not show any mercy.
As for the three that escaped… they were considered relatively ordinary in the Divine Realm, and did not show any personality of casually massacring others. Instead, they were merely embroiled in ordinary battles.
Actually, in this Divine Realm, due to how vast the Great Wilderness was, most people would live their lives within the cities. Very few massacres would occur as a result!
And those three God Emperors that escaped did not know that the reason they could live was because their karmic grievances did not reach a limit that Xue Ying could not tolerate.
******
High Mountain City.
Finally, a blurred figure flew over.
The residence of Imperial Wind Clan had already gathered a huge number of experts. Even Xing Pavilion Master from the Heaven’s Will Pavilion and God Monarch Chuang Qing from the branch team of Mysterious Fire Army had arrived. They were anxiously awaiting for Xue Ying. The moment they saw the white-robed figure appearing, all of them felt their hearts trembling and excitement coursing through their bodies. After all, this was someone with a combat strength of a Late Stage God Emperor.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying descended.
“God Emperor Flying Snow.”
“Senior Flying Snow.”
“Tutor Flying Snow.”
Everyone immediately greeted him with great respect.
Xue Ying swept his gaze across and nodded: “God Emperor Devil Heart has been killed by me!”
At present, Imperial Wind High Mountain, Xing Pavilion Master and others felt their hearts tightening. Even though they attempted to trace down the karma of the other party and realized they could not sense Devil Heart Cultist Master and reckoned that the other party had died, hearing the words from Xue Ying made their hearts heavy. That was ultimately an ultra-strong expert ranked in the God Emperor Ranking List, and he was killed just like that?
“Teacher.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin came over and shouted.
Only when Xue Ying see his disciple did he smile. He chuckled: “Qing Yin, this matter has been settled so you don’t have to worry so much any longer.”
The surrounding people stared at Imperial Wind Qing Yin with envy. They could feel that this Ascendant God Emperor clearly treated his disciple Imperial Wind Qing Yin differently. He should have acted this time all because of this disciple.
“Senior Flying Snow.” Imperial Wind High Mountain thickened his face and said, “My Imperial Wind Clan is unable to return the favor for senior’s act of saving grace.”
“Alright.” Xue Ying cut his words, “I still have some matters to settle and won’t be accompanying you guys any longer. Qing Yin, follow me.”
“Yes, Teacher.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin obediently acknowledged.
Xue Ying turned around and left.
He did not have any idle time to accompany this group of people.
“This, this is truly a huge backing!” Imperial Wind High Mountain watched as Xue Ying left with his daughter, Imperial Wind Qing Yin. He could not help but feel excited.
This was definitely a backing he had to grab on!
Never had he, Imperial Wind High Mountain, have the opportunity to interact with such a huge backing!
And of the surrounding experts, Xing Pavilion Master held onto his book and continued recording: “After the karmic ties of Devil Heart Cultist Master disappeared, God Emperor Flying Snow flew back from the Great Wilderness, proclaiming that God Emperor Devil Heart has been killed by him.” This news was rapidly reported upwards. Xing Pavilion Master felt stirred and this incident would definitely cause a change in the ‘God Emperor Ranking List’!

chapters.title: Chapter 1303 - Indifference
chapters.content:
Chapter 1303: Indifference
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
At night.
Within a hall in the residence of Imperial Wind Clan, Imperial Wind High Mountain, Housekeeper Tong, and the three Clan Elders of the Imperial Wind Clan, including the brothers Imperial Wind Lei and Imperial Wind Jin were gathered here.
“Master, Third Lady has returned.” An expert came into the palace hall and announced respectfully.
The eyes of Imperial Wind High Mountain, Imperial Wind Lei, Imperial Wind Jin, Housekeeper Tong, and the three Clan Elders brightened. Imperial Wind High Mountain even ordered: “Alright, you retreat first.”
They had been waiting.
Waiting for Imperial Wind Qing Yin to return. They even ordered for someone to let her in the moment Imperial Wind Qing Yin returned.
“I wonder what are the thoughts of Senior Flying Snow.” Housekeeper Tong mumbled.
“I hope he will choose to continue his stay in High Mountain City.” Imperial Wind High Mountain was slightly nervous. The entire Imperial Wind Clan was in great jubilation after crossing through the calamity. And Imperial Wind High Mountain also began having ‘ambitious thoughts’. If an expert with a combat strength at the Late Stage God Emperor was willing to remain in High Mountain City, it would be greatly beneficial to their Imperial Wind Clan.
Footsteps could be heard coming from outside. Imperial Wind Qing Yin came in. When she saw her father, brothers, and the Clan Elders gathered here, she could not help but falter.
“Qing Yin, hurry up and come in. Have a seat first.” Imperial Wind High Mountain ordered with a smile.
“Yes, father.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin sat down nervously.
“Third Sister, Senior Flying Snow has done a great deal for our Imperial Wind Clan. Has he given any orders on what we Imperial Wind Clan should do as repayment?” Imperial Wind Lei asked.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin shook her head: “Nope. Teacher hasn’t asked the Imperial Wind Clan to do anything for him.”
“Has Senior Flying Snow considered leaving our High Mountain City?” Imperial Wind Lei continued with another question. Imperial Wind High Mountain and the others became nervous when this question was asked.
If he saved their Imperial Wind Clan and then leaving after that!
Then the future for Imperial Wind Clan would not be so different from now. Their High Mountain City would remain as one of the many small and desolate cities across the vast Divine Realm, and it would remain as unremarkable as ever! According to their deduction, the probability of God Emperor Flying Snow leaving was high. Firstly, such experts would usually have their own goals and ambitions like resources or treasures. Few would ever live in a small city. Secondly, God Emperor Flying Snow had remained low-profile and lived in seclusion before. He should not be someone who liked dispute. This time, after killing ‘Devil Heart Cultist Master’, his name would definitely spread across the whole Divine Realm. By then, it would definitely cause some dispute regarding his raking. And once he left the High Mountain City, he would likely find some other cities to live in seclusion so as to prevent others from finding him. The Imperial Wind Clan had at least tried before. They could not trace down this ‘God Emperor Flying Snow’ at all. According to the intelligence, it was practically impossible for one to trace an Ascendant God Emperor at all.
“Nope.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin looked at his father and others with bewilderment. She shook her head, “Teacher hasn’t said he will be leaving!”
At that moment, Imperial Wind High Mountain and the others heaved a sigh of relief.
“Teacher has only mentioned that he dislikes disturbance. He has asked me to inform Father and you guys not to disturb him if there’s nothing important.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin added.
“That should be the case!” Imperial Wind High Mountain revealed a grin, “Cultivation is incredibly important for Senior Flying Snow. Given his identity, not everyone is qualified to meet him. All of you hear this carefully, if there is nothing important, don’t go over and disturb Senior Flying Snow.”
“Yes.” Imperial Wind Lei and the others acknowledged.
Imperial Wind High Mountain smiled even more vibrantly.
Disliked disturbance?
As long as ‘Senior Flying Snow’ remained in the High Mountain City, various sects from the surrounding cities would have to treat his Imperial Wind Clan differently! It would also be much easier for their Imperial Wind Clan to do trade with other cities.
‘This Senior Flying Snow dislikes disturbances. But there will always be some everyday affairs that have to be handled. Since he doesn’t have any attendants, the most appropriate ones to send some would naturally be from our Imperial Wind Clan.’ Imperial Wind High Mountain felt more delighted in his heart.
“Qing Yin.” Imperial Wind High Mountain asked, “Senior Flying Snow doesn’t want others to disturb him. But it should be fine for you as a disciple to meet your teacher right?”
“I can meet Teacher anytime.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin replied.
“Alright.” Imperial Wind High Mountain chuckled, “Qing Yin, your teacher, Senior Flying Snow, has done a great deal for our Imperial Wind Clan. This favor is something that we have to remember deep in our hearts. Understand?”
“Mn, I understand.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin nodded.
…
It was clear that the Imperial Wind Clan wanted to board the ship of ‘God Emperor Flying Snow’!
And on this night.
The Eastern Wood City had received this news too.
“Mn?” Eastern Wood City Master sat alone on the peak of a mountain in his city. He was constantly fusing with this world as one entity. Wearing a green robe, his aura was vast and distanced just like the great world. Opening his eyes, he revealed astonishment, “A Middle Stage Ascendant God Emperor actually appeared in that little High Mountain City? And his strength is comparable to Late Stage God Emperors?”
“God Emperor Flying Snow?”
Eastern Wood City Master slightly frowned.
Talking about this, the Eastern Wood City was the strongest sect over a large swathe of area around him! A little city like the High Mountain City had to look up at the Eastern Wood City with bated breaths. But now, an expert with a combat strength of a Late Stage God Emperor actually appeared within this region! One had to know that Eastern Wood City Master was merely a Late Stage God Emperor.
‘He could injure God Emperor Devil Heart in one single move and shatter his body in three. This strength is definitely that of a Late Stage God Emperor’s. Fortunately, judging by his personality, he doesn’t like competition. He has been living in seclusion within High Mountain City without exposing his strength.’ Eastern Wood City Master nodded slightly, ‘I have to send a team of emissary to visit this God Emperor Flying Snow.’
No matter what, he had to send over some goodwill.
Eastern Wood City Master was someone who did not like fighting too! It’s just that cultivating the Ancestral God bloodline had harsh demands on resources and treasures! In addition, the entire Eastern Wood Clan relied on him. Hence, Eastern Wood City Master had to compete for various resources too.
…
Those with relatively good sources of news would know of Devil Heart Cultist Master’s fall in just one or two days. And they understood that an additional overlord had emerged in this Divine Realm! Fortunately, that expert was located in a region covered by Eastern Wood City Master, and his influence to experts in other regions could be be neglected.
******
High Mountain City, Flying Snow Residence.
Located high up a pavilion.
Xue Ying sat cross-legged by himself. He was pondering over his Chaotic Origin Refinement Body.
Even though he had come out with several versions that could increase the strength of his body to that of a Middle Stage God Emperor, they were all unstable! It would either increase the strength of his arms, or his legs, or his abdomen and back… Xue Ying had yet to find a way to strengthen his entire body while maintaining stability.
‘Who would have thought that my strength is made public because of my disciple’s matter.’
‘It’s fine too! If some trouble comes, perhaps it might allow me to experience more tribulations.’ Xue Ying was fully confident. Actually, even if his strength was made public, reaching his level, few would come seek him for trouble!
‘Wait until the God Emperor Ranking List changes… my name will then be broadcast far and wide. If Great Emperor North River is in this world, he would find out about this.’ Xue Ying smiled and looked forward to it.
The world that Great Emperor North River had been transported to should most likely be this world as well.
He had an enmity with North River.
‘I wonder how will North River react.’ Xue Ying remained indifferent.
And this indifference stemmed from his strength.
Just by relying on his Dao of Void, even though his Chaotic Origin Refinement Body had yet to be stable, he could still maintain the strength of a ‘Late Stage God Emperor’ for an hour. This was comparable to a Great Emperor’s strength in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range!
He even had his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm that could influence ‘Grand Perfection God Emperors’--that was also comparable to Supremes in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range!
When he dealt against the Devil Heart Cultist Master, Xue Ying had never cast the ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’ at all.
If he were to release his full strength.
With the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm coupled with the strength of a ‘Late Stage God Emperor’ rendered using his Dao of Void, Xue Ying could even fight with Supremes! Even if he were on the disadvantaged end… survival was no issue. Even if he had other trouble in this Divine Realm, he had his ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’! It was because of his strength that Xue Ying could continue living in seclusion within High Mountain City despite killing Devil Heart Cultist Master.
“Master.” A protector came over to the bottom of the pavilion, announcing, “Xing Pavilion Master from the Heaven’s Will Pavilion has come to pay a visit.”
“Oh, let him in.” Xue Ying ordered.
“Yes.” The protector rapidly withdrew.
Soon.
Xing Pavilion Master began climbing up to the pavilion. When he saw that white-robed young man seated there, he bowed respectfully: “God Emperor, the newest God Emperor Ranking List is out.” Saying that, a scroll appeared in his hand.
Xue Ying chuckled. Waving his hand, that scroll began flying over: “It is fine for you to send a subordinate over for such a minor matter. Yet you, a Pavilion Master, has come personally?”
“God Emperor shouldn’t be teasing me! I am merely a pavilion master for the Heaven’s Will Pavilion in High Mountain City. It is my honor to pass this scroll to God Emperor.” Xing Pavilion Master said.
Xue Ying smiled and began unscrolling it. He began looking through the changes made to the God Emperor Ranking List because of him. Every single time the God Emperor Ranking List changed, a new version would be released.

chapters.title: Chapter 1304 - Great Emperor North River
chapters.content:
Chapter 1304: Great Emperor North River
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The God Emperor Ranking List recorded on the scroll was detailed. Extending his senses, Xue Ying was able to get a brief overview of all experts listed. If he wanted to acquire a more detailed intelligence on that expert, he would have to purchase it with an equivalent price!
“Oh, 268th?” Xue Ying nodded slightly. That was quite far.
In this world, there were more than 30 Grand Perfection God Emperors (Supremes), and Late Stage Ascendant God Emperors! Hidden Willow Valley Master was an example of someone at this level.
And those with Late Stage God Emperor combat power numbered more than 250! Of which there were about 30 or so Middle Stage Ascendant God Emperors!
Since he was ranked at 268th, there were still quite a few Late Stage God Emperors and Middle Stage Ascendant God Emperors that ranked behind Xue Ying.
‘I reckon that it is because of my unstable aura when I had erupted with my strength that resulted in this ranking. Killing Devil Heart Cultist Master personally exemplified by killing power, which eventually ended up with my rank at the 268th position.’ Xue Ying pondered. He then turned towards Xing Pavilion Master from Heaven’s Will Pavilion, smiling, “Xing Pavilion Master, the Heaven’s Will Pavilion has thought highly of me. They did not actually place me at the very last position of all Late Stage God Emperors and Middle Stage Ascendant God Emperors!”
“This is formulated by the higher-ups. I am not qualified to influence their decision.” Xing Pavilion Master answered.
“Haha.”
Xue Ying softly laughed, “I do not mind. I even find this ranking to be quite fair.”
Xing Pavilion Master accompanied with a laugh.
“Alright, if there is nothing else, you may withdraw first.” Xue Ying said.
“Yes, then I’ll make my move.” Xing Pavilion Master respectfully went back. He had no choice since he, Xing Pavilion Master, was merely a Peak Stage God Monarch. And this God Emperor Flying Snow was an absolute overlord in the entire Divine Realm. Xing Pavilion Master naturally had to treat him politely, and do things perfectly! After all, he was stationed at the Heaven’s Will Pavilion in High Mountain City, and the one he could not offend the most is none other than this God Emperor Flying Snow.
Xue Ying looked at the scroll before him, lightly muttering: “268th… currently, my Chaotic Origin Refinement Body is unstable. Just by relying on the strength of my Dao of Void, this position is considered slightly high!”
As he harped on it, Xue Ying chuckled before keeping the scroll.
To him, this was merely an entertainment! The ranking was not too important at all. Improving his strength was core. After all, the primary reason he came to this world is to temper himself.
******
The God Emperor Ranking List was updated.
It incited the attention of many experts in this world on the Ascendant God Emperor who jumped straight to the 268th position. After all, the matter about Xue Ying killing Devil Heart Cultist Master, other than those who paid extra attention on the fall of experts in the Divine Realm, would only be noted by the Heaven’s Will Pavilion. It was the ‘God Emperor Ranking List’ that many others paid attention to by the God Emperors and practically all God Monarchs across the Divine Realm.
“Mn?”
Located in a tiny remote city, a green-robed male was currently enjoying wine in a pub. Suddenly, his expression changed slightly.
He just received the new information given to him by Heaven’s Will Pavilion!
“God Emperor Ranking List?” The green-robed male muttered to himself, “God Emperor Flying Snow? Ascendant?”
He immediately sent a transmission to the Heaven’s Will Pavilion for a request to purchase a more detailed information regarding God Emperor Flying Snow.
After a slight moment.
“God Monarch.” An attendant from the Heaven’s Will Pavilion in this tiny remote city rushed specially to this pub and passed a set of scroll to the green-robed male, “The information cost three pieces of Lightning Rock.”
“Here you go.” The green-robed male threw over three pieces of Lightning Rock.
“Yes.” The attendant received it before leaving.
That green-robed male immediately turned his attention to the scroll.
This report recorded everything that had been compiled on ‘God Emperor Flying Snow’, for instance, about how he had been brought back from the Great Wilderness by the Third Lady of High Mountain City’s Imperial Wind Clan, ‘Imperial Wind Qing Yin’. Many important matters had also been recorded clearly based on a time frame.
“Hmph, looking at this time frame, the Heaven’s Will Pavilion could actually not find any related information on him before the Third Lady of Imperial Wind Clan brought him back from the Great Wilderness.” The green-robed male sneered. It was normal for a low-profiled God Monarch to not have any information recorded against him.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying, you came to this world too?” The eyes of the green-robed male were filled with a cold intent.
He, was none other than Great Emperor North River!
He came here much earlier than Xue Ying.
He could not trace down Xue Ying, and Xue Ying could similarly not trace him down. In the past, Great Emperor North River once snatched away the ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’. Xue Ying and the others wanted to kill him, yet they could not locate where Great Emperor North River was accurately.
Those who cultivated the Chaotic Origin Bloodline might not specialize in concealing their aura, but this skill would tremendously increase once the cultivator reached the realm of ‘Late Stage God Emperor’. The majority of them were good at tracing others. The Supremes for instance could perfectly conceal their aura! Xue Ying had encountered Supremes in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range before. If Supremes chose to hide their aura, Xue Ying would not be able to sense it. And ‘Great Emperor North River’ was a Great Emperor and also an existence closest to the Supreme within Broken Teeth Mountain Range! His control of the aura was perfect. Others could not trace him down at all.
Coming to this world, being a guest from another place, he naturally remained low-profile.
After concealing his aura, he disguised himself as a God Monarch and chose to live in seclusion within a tiny city! He would only go out occasionally.
“Ying Shan Xue Ying.” Many thoughts began flitting across the mind of Great Emperor North River.
Judging by the time he came, his name, the techniques he specialized and his identity as an Ascendant in addition to his decision to live in seclusion as a hermit, this person fitted all criteria Xue Ying had! Nothing could be so coincidental like this.
‘According to the intelligence report, his Dao of Void strength has already reached a level comparable to Late Stage God Emperors?’ Great Emperor North River frowned, ‘In addition to his soul techniques, even I might be disadvantaged when I fight against him?’
‘Improving my strength is more important.’
‘I shall play with this Ying Shan Xue Ying again after reaching the Supreme Realm.’ Great Emperor North River sneered inwardly. He already had a deep foundation. He even cultivated for a long time within the Snake Teeth Corridor and saw some improvement then. In the past when he was discovered by Xue Ying and Supreme Vast Ancient, he was forced down this path and was sent into this world. After coming over, he discovered that this world was much better at digging the potential of bloodlines than back at the Broken Teeth Mountain Range!
And thus began his journey to collect the scriptures. And through them, he began comprehending and meditating.
Great Emperor North River was confident that he would reach the Supreme Realm.
‘We shall see.’ Great Emperor North River casually placed this matter aside.
…
Time passed.
After Xue Ying killed Devil Heart Cultist Master, his name spread across the Divine Realm. Many cities, at least for those surrounding ones, sent emissaries over to visit him. Even Eastern Wood City had sent a team over.
Xue Ying was too lazy to meet most of those emissaries. He let Imperial Wind Qing Yin deal with them instead! It was only the emissary team from Eastern Wood City that Xue Ying had to personally meet.
After that, his days regained their peace.
As Xue Ying had killed quite a few God Emperors one after another, he was relatively rich. Many of those treasures were useless in the eyes of Xue Ying. He only selected some that were helpful for bloodline cultivation and gave them to his disciple ‘Imperial Wind Qing Yin’. She was after all, the only disciple he accepted in this world. Imperial Wind Qing Yin was originally a Peak Stage God General. After being bestowed with the treasures, she rapidly reached the God Monarch level.
In reality, any God General expert could easily break through after consuming treasures that were given in quantities that would make even God Emperors heart ache.
Hence, it was nothing extraordinary that Imperial Wind Qing Yin broke through in the end.
Instead, it was her big brother, ‘Imperial Wind Lei’, who was an expert second only to Imperial Wind High Mountain in the High Mountain City previously, that had surprised everyone. Before the calamity that befell the Imperial Wind Clan, his strength had reached a level that enabled him to suppress experts like Bat Mountain Master and God Monarch Jian Yin slightly! After experiencing this huge calamity, whereby hope was birthed from despondence, Imperial Wind Lei actually broke through to the Early Stage God Emperor Realm 300,000 years after the death of Devil Heart Cultist Master! It brought joy to the entire Imperial Wind Clan. Imperial Wind Qing Yin had even been excited for a period. Even Xue Ying sent some congratulatory gifts over to Imperial Wind Lei.
In the blink of an eye, it had been about 80 million years since the fall of Devil Heart Cultist. Master
High Mountain City, within the Flying Snow Residence.
There were several musicians currently performing. Several female dancers were also dancing lightly and gracefully to the tune.
Xue Ying, Imperial Wind Qing Yin, and the number one Qin Master in High Mountain City, ‘Leng Xin’, were seated here chatting happily. They were also enjoying the performance. Ever since Xue Ying had been enlightened from listening ‘Leng Xin’ play the Qin, Xue Ying gained another hobby--that was to listen to music and watch dance performances.
“Teacher, this is a dance music personally composed by Sister Leng. How do you find it?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin asked.
“Teacher?”
“Teacher?”
Imperial Wind Qing Yin looked at Xue Ying in puzzle.
At this moment, Xue Ying had his eyes closed as if he was thinking about something. Imperial Wind Qing Yin no longer spoke when she saw that.
“Hong long long~” At this moment, the consciousness of all avatars of Xue Ying--those at his hometown Primal Chaos Void and Realm Heart Great Land--were ringing. Countless profound mysteries were fusing together into an intricate and unfathomably profound technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 1305 - Third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm Killing Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 1305: Third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm Killing Technique
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
At the final moment when this perfect technique formed, an Illusory Realm naturally formed in the heart of Xue Ying.
It was vast and filled with endless life. At the same moment, it was hidden with fatal dangers.
Life and death. They were like two sides of a coin, entangled mutually. It made the entire realm all the more colorful as if death existed in life and darkness formed from lightness. This kind of entanglement resided across the entire Illusory Realm. Simply speaking, the core of the ‘operating laws’ for this Illusory Realm was these two aspects.
With a two-sided core, Xue Ying also fused other comprehension he had of the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm into it.
Everything went smoothly.
“Hong long long~” The souls of every avatar of Xue Ying rang. A transformation was taking place currently. Their souls were becoming emptier and clearer. With this state of soul, Xue Ying would be able to deduce the same techniques with a faster speed targeted to the essence than before.
Not just that, with a more congealed soul, it would bring about a ‘qualitative transformation’ to his strength.
‘My soul.’
‘It feels powerful.’
‘It seems to be stronger than my fleshy body.’
Xue Ying had a powerful feeling of illusion as if his soul had reached a stage that could be fused into the origin of this world. As long as this world existed, his soul would exist alongside! Of course, this was a vague feeling. But there was still a gap missing between.
“Hu.”
Suddenly, within the Flying Snow Residence of High Mountain City, Xue Ying who had his eyes closed originally, abruptly opened them. His eyes became deeper.
The Qin Master Leng Xin and Imperial Wind Qing Yin were originally worried for Xue Ying as he had closed his eyes abruptly without responding to their words. But once they saw Xue Ying opening their eyes, they could not help but feel their souls falling into oblivion. It was as if they had seen the most enchanting eyes in this world, causing them to willingly become intoxicated for them.
‘My fleshy body.’ Xue Ying could feel cries of joy across his body. His soul actually unknowingly nourished his fleshy body, allowing it to develop towards a more perfect state.
This transformation of his fleshy body was a minor matter!
What Xue Ying focused more on was his soul!
‘My soul… this feeling…’ Xue Ying could sense the powerful origin of this Divine Realm through his soul. The origin of this world was cruder than that of any ‘Origin Worlds’. But it was much bigger. The soul was the most special energy any living being had. For instance, Blood Sacrifices could be carried out in the Realm Heart Great Land to refine the ‘Essence of Blood Spirit’. Some powerful souls could even be refined into Essence of Blood Spirit that had a much better effectiveness than absorbing the origin.
Clearly, the energy of the soul was similar to the energy of the origin of the world, albeit it was more special.
‘I could feel that I am just one step away from fusing into the origin of the world.’
The moment he did so, his soul would remain eternal as long as the origin of the world remained undamaged.
How frightful was this?
Even if a Chaotic Origin expert could control an Origin World! He could not destroy the origin of that world because that would cause the total annihilation of the entire Origin World!
‘Reaching the final realm in the Dao of Soul could actually enable me to reach this stage?’ Xue Ying thought.
He had just comprehended the third killing technique of the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm.
This third killing technique perfectly fused the first killing technique, ‘Resplendent’ and the second killing technique, ‘Slaughter Illusory Realm’ together. Its power had also far surpassed the previous two techniques. This qualitative transformation made Xue Ying feel that he was incomparably closer to reaching the ‘final realm in the Dao of Soul’. Now that he had created this technique, he was just one strand away from the final realm!
‘It seems reaching the final realm in the Dao of Soul is vastly different from reaching the final realm in other ordinary paths.’ Xue Ying thought.
That’s right too.
After all, the foundation of life is the soul!
And the difficulty of cultivating the Dao of Soul is also much harder than cultivating other Daos.
…
“Mn?” Xue Ying looked around him. Within this hall, Imperial Wind Qing Yin, Qin Master Leng Xin, and the group of performing dancers and musicians had all fallen down.
‘It seems that I have unknowingly influenced them after breaking through.’ With a thought, Xue Ying sent out a wave that brought back the consciousness of those within the hall. They were even staring vacantly into space now.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin looked at Xue Ying with some daze: “Teacher, why, why have I fallen asleep?”
“It was because of me. I have unknowingly influenced all of you with my technique. Oh right, I am planning to enter closed-door cultivation for a period. If there is nothing important, don’t disturb me.” Xue Ying ordered.
“Yes, Teacher.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin acknowledged.
“Mn.”
Xue Ying nodded and immediately stood up. He gave a slight nod to Qin Master Leng Xin before leaving the place.
******
Within the meditation room.
Xue Ying carefully observed the transformation that had happened after his breakthrough. Firstly, it was his Chaotic Origin Refinement Body. It was originally unstable at the Middle Stage God Emperor level and could last for just an hour during battle. But now that his fleshy body had been nourished by his soul, making it more perfected, it actually increased his overall strength by 50%. The originally unstable state remained unstable as previously, just that there was a huge decrease in the consumption of his body strength. Thus, his body’s rate of recover could resist this consumption of strength.
In other words, he could persist in this state for eternity.
‘The influence of the soul on the fleshy body is merely done on the original foundation of the fleshy body, perfecting it further.’
‘And my Chaotic Origin Refinement Body is more on metamorphosizing and altering the essence of my body.’
Xue Ying understood that the soul merely nourished and improved the overall quality of his fleshy body. If he planned on cultivating his fleshy body to the ‘Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform state’ and to become a Chaotic Origin expert, he still had to improve his understanding of the Dao of Void.
‘Just a bit more.’
‘This third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique is just a bit away from the final realm.’ Xue Ying shook his head.
Because the previous two killing techniques were already very powerful.
And the third killing technique had another great boost to its strength! Hence, speaking from this perspective, it was relatively close to being a final realm technique.
But…
When a technique had not reached the final realm, it would mean it did not!
‘Final realm’ represented grand perfection!
Like when his Dao of Void reached the Level Two Cosmos God Realm, by relying on the supreme secret impartation, Xue Ying was able to exert strength comparable to a final realm expert. But this did not mean his technique had reached that realm qualitatively.
This third killing technique absorbed the essence from that thousand-eyed existence’s ‘gray eyes’ and ‘gold eyes’. Xue Ying even succeeded to fuse them together, forming a technique that was this powerful! Nonetheless, the overall profoundness behind the technique was lacking.
These slight flaws…
Prevented his soul from reaching grand perfection!
‘I was too engrossed at trying to pull the soul of an enemy into oblivion and to wipe out that enemy’s soul.’ Xue Ying thought. Because this third killing technique’s primary aim was to fuse the two previous killing techniques. Hence, before he succeeded, he had based this third killing technique on the previous two techniques.
‘This technique of mine is too extreme.’
Xue Ying understood what the problem was.
‘The next killing technique… will be the one that corrects this deficiency.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘At the same time when I create the fourth killing technique, I should be also be reaching the final realm in my Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm! I truly look forward to that day!’
******
After breaking through, Xue Ying reflected upon it and consolidated his strength.
This did not use up a lot of time actually. The reason why Xue Ying chose to enter closed-door cultivation is because after grasping the third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique, Xue Ying planned on leaving High Mountain City once again.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying sat cross-legged. Waving his hand, a scroll appeared before him.
The scroll recorded details regarding ‘Dao of Void Chaotic Origin Lifeforms’. Xue Ying had paid the Heaven’s Will Pavilion in High Mountain City a visit to gather information on Ascendant Scriptures under the ‘Dao of Void’. He also visited to gather all relevant information on Chaotic Origin Lifeforms with the Dao of Void Lineage. In reality, he had already received useful information, just that he did not feel that it is the right moment to act upon it.
‘Iron Dragon City owns the corpse of a Dao of Void Chaotic Origin Lifeform!’ Xue Ying looked at what was recorded in the intelligence.
Every part of the body of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms was the manifestation of laws.
Some Chaotic Origin Lifeforms only had minor parts of their bodies manifesting the Dao of Void. Those lifeforms were not really helpful to Xue Ying.
Instead, Chaotic Origin Lifeforms with the ‘Dao of Void Lineage’ represented creatures that specialized in Dao of Void techniques. An absolute majority of the laws manifested on their bodies were part of the Dao of Void Lineage. This was also what Xue Ying sought. It’s just that Chaotic Origin Lifeforms with a Dao of Void Lineage is rarely seen.
‘Iron Dragon City Master is ranked seventh on the God Emperor Ranking List.’ Xue Ying thought.
Those with power of a Supreme numbered more than 30 in this world!
Iron Dragon City Master was ranked seventh! He had five children and all of them had been nurtured to the God Emperor level. Naturally, only the Crown Prince is a Late Stage God Emperor! The strength of the sect under Iron Dragon City Master was an entire level higher than that of Hidden Willow Valley Master’s sect.
‘If I could get the Dao of Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse kept by Iron Dragon City Master, it’ll be greatly helpful to me.’ Xue Ying thought. The intimidation power of Iron Dragon City Master was too big. He had never thought of snatching it over. Instead, he wanted to try and conduct a trade for it. Even still, he only waited until he created the third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique before he chose to act.

chapters.title: Chapter 1306 - Iron Dragon City
chapters.content:
Chapter 1306: Iron Dragon City
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying stood within the meditation room. Suddenly, his appearance began changing. Even the shape of his body started transforming. The quality of his aura became different as well--it was as cold as a ten-thousand-year snow. Altering the aura was simple. Reaching the realm of Xue Ying, he could easily alter his soul and aura. Instead, warding off ‘scouting’ techniques was the hard task.
In this world, due to the presence of bloodline, the experts had some unique magical abilities.
Some magical abilities enabled the user the power to determine the true strength of a target! For instance, Housekeeper Yun’s ‘Jade Light God Eye’. His Ancestral God Bloodline originated from one of the three Chaotic Origin Experts that created this world. Naturally, it contained all kinds of mystical effects. If a God Emperor specialized in scouting, his techniques would naturally be more formidable than what Housekeeper Yun could achieve.
Previously, Xue Ying was not fully confident of his skills to ward off all scouting techniques!
But now…
‘Given my attainments in the Dao of Soul, I believe that nobody beneath the Chaotic Origin level could see through my strength.’ Xue Ying thought. After comprehending the third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm technique, his soul once again went through another qualitative transformation. It reached a stage just before the next ‘essence transformation’. If he broke through slightly further, his soul would have completely broken through the boundaries to the next level of life. By then, his soul could fuse with the origin of a world. As long as the world existed, Xue Ying would not die!
Hence, Xue Ying believed in his current abilities to alter his soul and aura. He was confident that nobody could see through the disguise of his soul.
‘And with a sword.’ Xue Ying extended his hand, causing a divine sword to appear. He smiled to himself before slinging the scabbard over his back.
This was his disguise--as a white-robed swordmaster wielding a divine sword.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying’s aura began growing stronger. It climbed all the way until it reached that of a Late Stage God Emperor! His aura was filled with sharpness.
Of course, this was due to how special his soul was. That was how he could easily disguise his aura. If Xue Ying was willing to, he could disguise as a Grand Perfection God Emperor, albeit there was no point!
“Si la.”
Suddenly, a black crack appeared within the meditation room.
Xue Ying took a step before tunneling through it and headed towards the Iron Dragon City.
******
Iron Dragon City.
This was an incredibly huge and luxurious city. Iron Dragon City Master could rank seventh amongst the 30 or so Grand Perfection God Emperors. Naturally, his strength was extremely frightening. One had to know that even the innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform, ‘Hidden Willow Valley Master’, who could protect a group of other innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms as a Grand Perfection God Emperor, was merely ranked 12th.
“Iron Dragon Hall.” Xue Ying turned into a stream of light as he flew through the sky and descended before a towering hall. This residence occupied a vast area. It was even one level bigger than High Mountain City--a total of more than half a million kilometers long!
“Hou~”
The occasional roars could be heard from within.
Xue Ying could discern it the moment he heard this sound. That roaring sound should come from an innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform, the ‘Nine-Horned Armored Dragon’. In this Divine Realm, there were only two innate Chaotic Origin ‘Nine-Horned Armored Dragons’. And both of them lived in the Iron Armored Dragon Hall! It could be said that both of them were partners with Iron Dragon City Master. They needed Iron Dragon City Master to protect them! And the cultivation scripture that Iron Dragon City Master created, the <Undying Iron Dragon>, was made more efficient with the help from the Nine-Horned Armored Dragon. All five children of Iron Dragon City Master had been nurtured by him to the God Emperor Realm primarily due to his huge expenditure of treasures. And in this clan of lineage under Iron Dragon City Master, he had actually grown more than a hundred God Emperors! Naturally, those two ‘Nine-Horned Armored Dragons’ were part of the reasons why.
‘The innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms in this world are truly pitiful. There are too many experts around. Even though innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms are good at survival, they would still die once they suffer from the joint attack by numerous experts.’ Xue Ying lamented.
In the Broken Tooth Mountain Range, corpses of innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were not really useful. That was why the five Great Supremes were too lazy to hunt them down.
But in this world… it was clear that they had a higher skill level.
“May I ask what this God Emperor has come to my Iron Dragon Hall for?” There was a guard who stood right before the hall. When he saw this white-robed male with a divine sword on his back, he immediately went to question him. But once he sensed that cold terrifying aura from the other party, he could not help but feel his heart tightening. As a result, he chose to adopt a more polite position.
“This one is known as Azure Cloud. I am here to visit Iron Dragon City Master.” Xue Ying said.
“My City Master doesn’t meet any visiting guests so easily.” A guard frowned. Even though the aura of this white-robed male was powerful, they were not afraid! After all, their city master was a Grand Perfection God Emperor! They even had a total of eight Late Stage God Emperors. Even though the majority of them had gone on to construct a city, there were still three Late Stage God Emperors living in the residence, including many more Middle and Early Stage God Emperors.
“I hope that you can inform the City Master regardless.” Xue Ying said.
“Alright. Wait here a moment.” In the end, the guard chose to relay the message after considering Xue Ying’s strength.
Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
This was indeed the Iron Dragon Hall! If he merely disguised himself as a Middle Stage God Emperor, the other party might not have sufficient reasons to help him relay this message.
After the time taken to brew a cup of tea, that guard returned and mentioned to Xue Ying: “My Clan’s Crown Prince has invited this God Emperor over. Please come with me.”
“Alright.” Xue Ying immediately followed. Crown Prince? The Iron Dragon City Master had five children, and the strongest amongst them was the Crown Prince. He was also a Late Stage God Emperor! According to the brief introduction by the intelligence report, this Crown Prince from the Iron Dragon Hall was usually the main manager of the Iron Dragon Hall. After all, given the strength of Iron Dragon City Master, he would feel disdain from doing such miscellaneous tasks. He was completely focused on meditation and to attempt and break through to the Chaotic Origin Level.
Any Grand Perfection God Emperor could be said to have a half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body. All of them were standing by the gates of becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform! Those who cultivated in their bloodlines would undergo a final awakening before becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
“This way please.” The guard led Xue Ying, “I advise you not to wander around the place. There are many forbidden areas within my Iron Dragon Hall, and those places forbade visiting guests from entering.”
“Understood.” Xue Ying followed after him.
Within this residence that spanned half a million kilometers, this protector flew at quite a slow pace. Hence, it took Xue Ying quite a while before he reached the garden.
“Crown Prince, God Emperor Azure Cloud is here.” The guard respectfully announced.
Xue Ying looked over.
There was currently a black-robed male seated against a chair. He seemed to be casual. By his side were two absolutely stunning women serving him--they were feeding him wine and fruits.
This black-robed male was relatively handsome. When he saw Xue Ying, he swept his gaze across with slight tyranny. He waved his hand lightly: “Go back. If God Emperor Azure Cloud is fine with it, you can come over and have some wine.”
“Why wouldn’t I be since I get the chance to drink within the Iron Dragon Hall?” Xue Ying sat with a smile.
This black-robed male was also the Crown Prince of Iron Dragon Hall--’Iron Dragon Cloud Mountain’. He was ranked 85th on the God Emperor Ranking List! The reason why he could reach this stage is mainly due to the help from his father, and also some unique treasures! But no matter what, since he could be ranked by the Heaven’s Will Clan at the 85th position, it showed his strength! In addition, this powerful Iron Dragon City was under the command of this Crown Prince. It was normal for his every action to be filled with overbearingness. It was a habit that formed naturally from being in such a high position for a long period of time.
“God Emperor Azure Cloud, a Late Stage God Emperor? I don’t see the name of God Emperor Azure Cloud in the God Emperor Ranking List by Heaven’s Will Clan.” The Crown prince of Iron Dragon Hall chuckled. It was natural that the Iron Dragon Hall had many scouting techniques. He even arranged a Middle Stage God Emperor to check through this God Emperor Azure Cloud before--and he confirmed that this was indeed a Late Stage God Emperor.
“I’ve always been living in seclusion for the past years. Hence, I have never entered the Ranking List.” Xue Ying said.
“Haha, no matter if Brother Azure Cloud is really living in seclusion or that you have some magical abilities that enable you to conceal your aura, I don’t really care.” The Crown Prince of Iron Dragon Hall laughed, “What I care more is why did Brother Azure Cloud come to my place?”
He did not care about the identity of the other party.
Given his strength and his father as a huge backing! He was not afraid of even the three Great Royal Clans.
Even though there were the ‘three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods’ behind the three Great Royal Clans, the people living in the entire Divine Realm were strictly speaking, descendants from the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods! Hence, as long as one did not poke the beehive and assault the territory of any of the three Great Royal Clans, even when battles happened with the three Great Royal Clans, the Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods never appeared.
But when one killed his way to the territory of the three Great Royal Clans, that would mean challenging the authority of the Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods!
“The reason I am here is for the Dao of Void Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse.” Xue Ying said, “I wish to purchase this corpse. I wonder how much is the Iron Dragon Hall willing to sell it to me for?”
“Haha…” The eyes of the Crown Prince of Iron Dragon Hall brightened. He laughed, “So Brother Azure Cloud is actually here for the corpse. I believe you should know how difficult it is for one to acquire the corpse of a Dao of Void Chaotic Origin Lifeform! In the entire Divine Realm, there are only a total of three Dao of Void Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Two are still alive, and the corpse of one is with me. They specialized highly in survival. Hence, the difficulty of killing it is much harder than killing most of the other Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying nodded.
This was also the reason why he came after grasping the third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 1307 - The Price
chapters.content:
Chapter 1307: The Price
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
When the Crown Prince of Iron Dragon Hall saw that, he immediately stood and waved his hand to the side. The two female attendants obediently left, leaving behind just the Crown Prince and Xue Ying.
“This corpse is of the Dao of Void Lineage. It is incredibly precious. With my father’s personality, he isn’t willing to sell it. But since Father could not use it, he has long given it to me, giving me the power to decide what I should do with it.” The Crown Prince grinned at Xue Ying, “If you wish to buy it, you have to trade for it using a ‘Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead’ and a piece of ‘Dried Realm Leaf’.”
Xue Ying’s pupils dilated.
Ever since he killed Devil Heart Cultist Master which caused him to reveal part of his strength, he had bought over quite a lot of intelligence from the Heaven’s Will Pavilion. For instance, reports introducing all kinds of treasures that existed in the Divine Realm. Otherwise, wouldn’t it be tragic if he could not recognize a treasure placed right before him, and as a result, missed out on it?
The Dried Realm Leaf was a miraculous item used by the natives of Divine Realm for cultivation. It’s an incredibly rare item that assisted one in cultivating his or her bloodline energy. In the history of Heaven’s Will Pavilion, there were three times that a piece of Dried Realm Leaf was auctioned. During these three times, the lowest price this leaf was sold at was for 3,900 Chaotic Origin Jades. And the highest price was 5,800 Chaotic Origin Jades! Of course, the entire Divine Realm had more than just these three pieces. Quite a few were owned by Grand Perfection God Emperors that bestowed them to their disciples and subordinates.
No matter what, this Dried Realm Leaf was worth approximately 5,000 Chaotic Origin Jades! That was a crazy price. One had to know that when Xue Ying participated in the previous auction, that Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse was sold at a final price close to 20,000 Chaotic Origin Jades.
But the Dried Realm Leaf was simply lacking compared to the ‘Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead’!
The Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead was way more precious and rare. Never had it been seen in an auction! According to what Xue Ying understood, there were only three Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Beads in total that was discovered in the history of the Divine Realm. Any bead could be sold at sky-high price--far exceeding most corpses of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
Even though corpses of Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were similarly rare, in terms of rarity, the majority of experts in the Divine Realm might feel that it was not worth as much as the ‘Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead’. After all, the corpse did not have as many uses as the Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead.
“Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead? Crown Prince, aren’t your demands too high?” Xue Ying asked.
“Ha, high?”
Grand Perfection God Emperors
The Crown Prince of Iron Dragon Hall sneered, “It’s not high at all. There are only three Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeforms in the Divine Realm, and one of it is with me. As for the other two, one is under the protection of a Great Royal Clan, the ‘Extreme Star Clan’. The final one might be roaming around free and unfettered in the Divine Realm, but its survival capabilities were the highest. There had been six Grand Perfection God Emperors that once worked together, yet they could not hold that Chaotic Origin Lifeform back. If you missed the opportunity to get mine, where could you find another? In reality, there were quite a few who wanted to get their hands on this corpse. And to all of them, I gave the same condition. Without the Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead, nobody could ever think of getting it! Whoever could bring a Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead first and I’ll give this corpse to him.”
“Then I don’t need to give another Dried Realm Leaf right?” Xue Ying clarified.
“My daughter’s cultivation is currently lacking a piece of Dried Realm Leaf. If you could acquire that Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead, I believe you should be able to get a Dried Realm Leaf easily.” The Crown Prince of Iron Dragon Hall looked at Xue Ying, “I have mentioned the conditions, Brother Azure Cloud. You can come again after acquiring the Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead and a piece of Dried Realm Leaf to exchange for my Void Lineage Chaos Origin Lifeform corpse.”
“Can I have a look at the corpse first?” Xue Ying asked.
“Definitely.”
The Crown Prince was incredibly forthright. Flipping his hand, a Storage Eden Treasure appeared on his palm, “I have already released the restrictions. You should be able to view what is inside this Storage Eden.”
Xue Ying looked over.
After sending his consciousness in, it did not suffer from any hindrance and directly permeated into the Storage Eden.
At that moment when he saw the enormous meandering corpse that was as huge as a chain of mountains, even though it had fallen, its corpse was still emitting a bizarre wave. Xue Ying could see the manifestation of laws and profound mysteries on every part of its body. It was covered in many green scales. There were spikes all over its back and its tail too. These spikes contained patterns… that were incredibly profound.
Xue Ying swept his gaze across.
Just by looking at the surface of this corpse, the scales, the spikes, the claws… almost 90% of its body had manifested the Dao of Void laws. They were similarly profound and filled with mysteries at the Chaotic Origin Level. Different parts of its body manifested different kinds of laws. They were all different usages of the Dao of Void at the Chaotic Origin Level.
“You should have seen it now.” The Crown Prince then kept the corpse and smiled at Xue Ying.
Xue Ying felt a blazing heat spreading through his heart.
He had to get it!
What he just saw was merely a glimpse! One had to know that Xue Ying had to examine the internal structure and its inscription within a single eyeball of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform for a while before he could memorise it. In order for Xue Ying to memorize that enormous corpse, it would likely take him 100 to 1,000 years just for its surface! As for the internal part of the corpse, and even to analyze its body, Xue Ying would most likely be spending an incredibly long amount of time.
And the time taken to consolidate and comprehend the profound mysteries would be even harder to estimate.
‘As mentioned by the wise, the world is our teacher! Nonetheless, after reaching my current realm, the Dao of Void profound mysteries in the world aren’t as profound as what I have comprehended.’ Xue Ying shook his head. In this Divine Realm for instance, there were many flaws in the laws. It was even suppressing on the cultivators with great tyranny.
What he pursued after was to reach the Chaotic Origin Level.
This was no longer contained in the world. Even though <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> was formidable, only the sixth and seventh strikes were related to the Chaotic Origin Level, and those were merely shallow usages of the laws. By relying on those two strikes, a cultivator could only reach a level comparable to some low-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
To him, a ‘Void Lineage’ Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse was absolutely a good target of reference for study and research. It would aid him greatly in his cultivation.
“As I said before, this Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse has been given to me by my father. The final decision lay in my hands.” The Crown Prince looked at Xue Ying, “If you were to somehow get your hands on the treasures I need, you can come find me anytime.”
“I’ll try my best.” Xue Ying stood up.
“I shall not be sending you off.” The Crown prince laughed. He grinned while watching Xue Ying leave.
The Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead was what the Crown Prince desired most for!
Given his identity, he still could not get it.
‘If I were to have a Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead, I could improve my strength by 50%. By then, even Grand Perfection God Emperors can’t deal against me.’ The Crown Prince thought. He was originally strong, and was ranked at the front of even Late Stage God Emperors. He was comparable to Great Emperor North River back at the Broken Teeth Mountain Range! Few treasures could boost his strength greatly. And Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead was the one that would strengthen him the most.
…
After leaving the Iron Dragon Hall, Xue Ying went to find a quiet alley before leaving the place with his Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.
He first went to another tiny remote city. After altering his aura and disguising himself as a Peak Stage God Monarch expert, he went to purchase detailed information regarding the ‘Dried Realm Leaf’ and ‘Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead’. Previously, even though he had gotten a lot of information on the treasures within the Divine Realm, those were brief ones. The more detailed the information is, the more expensive it would be.
‘So expensive.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
Just purchasing detailed information on both the Dried Realm Leaf and Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead cost Xue Ying 8,000 Lightning Rocks.
‘There are actually quite a few cultivators who own the Dried Realm Leaf.’ Xue Ying swept his gaze across. The intelligence system of Heaven’s Will Pavilion was formidable. It introduced a total of 15 cultivators who owned a leaf at least.
‘As for the Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead, there are only three beads in total.’ Xue Ying had once seen the locations of where these three Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Beads were. Those who could secure a treasure like the Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead would naturally have an incredibly huge origin; they were all extraordinary in power.
‘It seems I have to kill.’
Xue Ying thought, ‘Let’s see who has committed the most sins.’
Xue Ying did not choose the one that were easiest to deal with. Instead, he chose those that had committed the most grievous crimes! Like that Crown Prince from the Iron Dragon Hall, if he was a huge devil that done many sins, Xue YIng would have assassinated him instead and snatch the treasure away. But this Crown Prince from the Iron Dragon Hall would only involve himself in ordinary battles. He did not have a huge amount of karmic grievances tying his body. Thus, Xue Ying was not willing to snatch the treasure away. Instead, he chose to conduct a normal trade.
Furthermore, that was also the residence of Iron Dragon City Master! Iron Dragon City Master was a frightening foe! And Iron Dragon City Master in his residence where he was augmented by his arrays would be of another level.
He was not someone Xue Ying could provoke easily!
And starting a series of killings was something he planned for. Because Xue Ying did not own a lot of treasures. Even though he had killed Devil Heart Cultist Master and several other God Emperors, what those treasures worth was so far off from treasures like the Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead and the corpse of a Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform! Xue Ying had to still kill others and snatch their treasures before he could gather sufficient amount to exchange for what he wanted. And everything was done within the limits that Xue Ying set for himself--to not kill those ordinary experts.
Instead, those he planned on killing were the great devils.

chapters.title: Chapter 1308 - God Emperor Crane Pit
chapters.content:
Chapter 1308: God Emperor Crane Pit
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying looked through the report recorded on the scroll. The Heaven’s Will Pavilion could discover a total of 15 cultivators who owned a Dried Realm Leaf. Of these 15 cultivators, according to the Heaven’s Will Pavilion, the biggest devil was one known as ‘God Emperor Crane Pit’.
God Emperor Crane Pit was a Middle Stage God Emperor. He was also the favourite disciple of the Grand Perfection God Emperor, ‘Palace Master Ghost Sea’. Palace Master Ghost Sea was an ultra big devil, and God Emperor Crane Pit was one of his three disciples. He was similarly vicious and had killed countless others. Nonetheless, he had a powerful teacher. He was also considered quite strong among those at the Middle Stage God Emperor Realm, ranking at the end of the God Emperor Ranking List.
‘According to the Heaven’s Will Pavilion, God Emperor Crane Pit is truly a huge devil.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Let me personally find out how much karmic grievances are tied to his body.’
With a heart born to kill.
Naturally, it would produce negative karma. With a thought, Xue Ying could easily find out through the different karmic ties where God Emperor Crane Pit was.
‘Mn? He seems to be at a tiny remote city now?’ Xue Ying was startled, ‘High Wind City?’
Xue Ying immediately went over using his Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique.
High Wind City.
This was an unremarkable tiny city in the vast Divine Realm. Nonetheless, it still occupied an area spanning hundreds of thousands of kilometers. There were an incredible number of natives living here too, with many different small sects within. The Heaven’s Will Pavilion had a branch here as well.
“It’s Big Missy.”
“Big Missy is out!”
There were many pedestrians on the street. Currently, they were all staring over at a few people…
It was a pair of young ladies. Behind them followed two protectors. This pair of young ladies… one was a female attendant and the other was the Big Missy in this High Wind City, known as ‘High Wind Yu Rong’. The High Wind City Master had a total of four children--three sons and one daughter. This daughter of his was incredibly intelligent and talented. Currently, she had reached the Peak Stage God Monarch Realm.
Due to cultivating his bloodline, the stronger she was, the more transcendental High Wind Yu Rong became. Looking at her made others feel like they were looking at the world’s most beautiful being.
