Every time she came out, she would attract the attention of many others.
High Wind City Master knew of how attractive his daughter was. Hence, he had already forbidden his daughter from going to other cities so as to prevent twists and turns from occurring.
“Miss, that person’s expression seems impudent. I shall go and teach him a lesson.” That green-robed female attendant gritted her teeth when she saw that person looking over by the side of a window of a pub.
“Don’t be so agitated!” High Wind Yu Rong was slightly startled. Impudent expression? Why did she not feel anything about that? She should be able to feel malice and greed from such expression given her ‘Heart of Ice Realm’. She gave her surroundings a check, and immediately discovered a male with a roman nose holding on to a wine cup by the window on the second floor of a pub not too far away. That guy was currently looking at her with greed and excitement as if he saw a wonderful prey.
Those eyes were making High Wind Yu Rong feel uncomfortable.
But why did her ‘Heart of Ice Realm’ not sense anything from him?
“Miss, he is going overboard. We must not let him go so easily.” The green-robed female attendant was indignant. When the two protectors discovered that, their expressions changed.
“Haha, is this Big Missy High Wind Yu Rong?” That roman nosed male laughed out from his position, “Come up and accompany me with a drink.” Saying that, he extended his left hand, causing it to elongate to a distance of several hundred meters. It swiftly bypassed the distance between them. High Wind Yu Rong paled when she saw that. She immediately took her female attendant to a retreat, yet an unseen energy had enveloped around her, easily restricting her movements.
With a pull, that huge hand cupped around the waist of High Wind Yu Rong and grabbed her up to the pub.
“Big Missy!”
“Big Missy!”
The two protectors and the green-robed female attendant were terrified. At the same time, they felt fear for this man because Big Missy High Wind Yu Rong was a Peak Stage God Monarch. She was ranked in the top 10 within the entire High Wind City. But the enemy could capture their Big Missy with one fell swoop. How powerful was he? God Emperor?
“Hurry up and report to the City Master.”
“Hurry up!”
They were all incredibly anxious. That green-robed female attendant could not help but rush over to that pub.
“Big Missy has been captured!”
“She was captured by that man in that pub.”
Many pedestrians on the street were greatly shocked when they saw that. High Wind Yu Rong was the most dazzling and enchanting girl in the entire High Wind City. As she became more powerful, her temperament also became transcendental. Every Native of the Divine Realm could only admire her from the side. They did not dare to show any intention of blasphemy. But now, Big Missy was actually captured? That naturally infuriated many. But they understood how frightening the enemy was for him to capture Big Missy so easily.
Even though they were infuriated, they felt helpless.
…
On the second floor of the pub, the surrounding guests were stunned when they saw the perpetrator capture the Big Missy of High Wind City. There were only a minority--two of them--who rushed down the pub.
That roman nosed male placed High Wind Yu Rong in his embrace. He put her on his lap, sweeping his gaze across his surroundings. “Hong--”
An unseen ripple swept out, causing all guests including the pub attendants to disappear, leaving nothing behind.
“This.” High Wind Yu Rong was frightened so much that she paled.
She understood how frightening this enemy was.
But for him to casually kill the innocent, it made her heart tighten.
‘Who exactly is he? I have strength of a Peak Stage God Monarch. Even Early Stage God Emperor can’t capture me so easily in one single move. Unless he has the strength of a Middle Stage God Emperor?’ High Wind Yu Rong deduced that easily. The other party was strong and ruthless. High Wind Yu Rong could feel anxiety coursing through her body. But now that her strength was completely sealed, she could not control her communication treasure at all.
“Don’t be afraid.”
The roman nosed male chuckled, “I killed them, but I am not willing to kill you! As long as you accompany me obediently, I’ll never kill you before I get tired of you.” Saying that, he gave the face of High Wind Yu Rong a sniff, “Mn, your smell is making me intoxicated.”
“Who are you exactly? With your strength, I doubt you are someone unknown.” High Wind Yu Rong could not help but blurt out after being sniffed by another person.
“I naturally had to alter my appearance. Otherwise, I would be recognized by someone else. Wouldn’t I have frightened the entire High Wind City then?” The roman nosed male laughed. He began caressing High Wind Yu Rong with both his hands. With a ‘si la’ , he easily tore apart part of High Wind Yu Rong’s clothes, making her even more indignant. But now that her strength was sealed, she could not resist at all.
“Hold your hands!”
A furious roar could be heard.
One figure after another flew into the second floor of the pub. The leading one was a muscular male. He was also the High Wind City Master. Behind him were many other Peak Stage God Monarch experts. These experts had already entered a combat formation with their aura.
“Let go of my daughter!” High Wind City Master roared angrily. Nonetheless, he remained vigilant in his heart.
“Let go?” The roman nosed male chuckled. His appearances began transforming. Some white fur could be seen appearing on his head. There were also some golden scales over his face.
“God Emperor Crane Pit?” High Wind City Master paled.
God Emperor Crane Pit was an infamous person known for killing. He was also known for loving beauties.
More than 90% of the time he killed was for beauties!
“Your daughter will be one of my collection from now on.” God Emperor Crane Pit nonchalantly declared, “As for your High Wind Clan, you have two choices. One, be annihilated by me completely. Two, you, High Wind City Master, can suicide and allow me to choose another 100 beauties from your High Wind Clan. I will then be benevolent in allowing the others from your clan to live.”
“God Emperor Crane Pit, this is my High Wind City. You best not push us so far.” High Wind City Master was angry.
Two choices.
One was to get annihilated.
And the other was to suicide and allow the other party to choose 100 beauties. That was an utter humiliation for the High Wind Clan!
“Hurry up and choose. Let me give you ten breaths of time. By then, if you haven’t made your decision, I’ll choose for you and annihilate your entire High Wind Clan.” God Emperor Crane Pit picked up the wine cup and send it to the mouth of High Wind Yu Rong, “Come, let us drink it together.”
High Wind Yu Rong immediately shook her head profusely.
But an unseen energy controlled her and prevented her from struggling. She could not help but open her mouth and let the wine be poured into her.
“Once you are in my hands, you can’t suicide or retaliate. It’ll be best if you listen to me obediently and make me happy. Otherwise, you should know… then sometimes, death is the happiest thing to you.” God Emperor Crane Pit chuckled. It’s just that his laughter made the heart of High Wind Yu Rong cold. She felt despair. Not just for her fate, but also for the fate of the entire High Wind Clan.
“Ten, nine, eight…” God Emperor Crane Pit leisurely counted down.
High Wind City Master trembled.
His other God Monarch experts were also panicking. They were all anxious transmitting messages over. Some who were young looked at Big Missy, watching as she suffered from humiliation. They were incredibly angry.
“Five, four, three…” God Emperor Crane Pit appreciated the despair in the face of others.
High Wind City Master wanted to fight to the death instead.
But the history of God Emperor Crane Pit had proven that those who retaliated would be exterminated.
‘How could this be? Is there anyone who could come and save me, and to save my clan?’ High Wind Yu Rong was completely hopeless now.
Suddenly, a figure stepped on the void and entered the second floor of the pub.
It was a white-robed male with a divine sword strapped to his back.
“Who?”
Everyone turned over.
God Emperor Crane Pit frowned and looked over too. There was actually someone who dared to come in now? Was he seeking for death?
This white-robed male with a divine sword gave off an ordinary aura. It was at the God Monarch level. Sweeping his gaze across, he said: “God Emperor Crane Pit, you are kidnapping another woman? With such heavy karmic grievances tying your body, you are truly…” As the white-robed male spoke, his aura abruptly expanded. It was so powerful that it brought terror to others. That aura also caused the expression of God Emperor Crane Pit to change. That white-robed male simply shook his head and sighed before pointing out.
“Peng!”
The body of God Emperor Crane Pit shook. The surrounding void became warped and distorted. Following that, the eyes of God Emperor Crane Pit became dark. He fell with a ‘pu tong’ ; his body softened onto the ground. By his side, High Wind Yu Rong immediately stood up. She looked with disbelief at the corpse of God Emperor Crane Pit that no longer gave off any aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 1309 - Palace Master Ghost Sea
chapters.content:
Chapter 1309: Palace Master Ghost Sea
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
God Emperor Crane Pit was killed!
A powerful Middle Stage God Emperor. Compared to Devil Heart Cultist Master, God Emperor Crane Pit was even one of the three disciples of Palace Master Ghost Sea, a Grand Perfection God Emperor (Supreme Realm). And he was simply killed like that? Did this white-robed male who wielded a divine sword on his back not care about retaliation and revenge from Palace Master Ghost Sea?
‘So terrifying.’ High Wind City Master watched with aghast as that white-robed male walked over, ‘He simply pointed his finger out and God Emperor Crane Pit is killed. He even caused the entire void to distort. Few could do this amongst Late Stage God Emperors. Usually, this is achieavble only at the Grand Perfection God Emperor Realm.’
Killing a Middle Stage God Emperor with one single move.
That was indeed frightening. 99% of Late Stage God Emperors were not this strong.
But little did he know… that Xue Ying was merely executing his Dao of Void technique on the surface, when in reality, he casted his ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique’. Before comprehending the third killing technique, some of the weaker God Generals in Broken Teeth Mountain Range (Middle Stage God Emperors) would fall into oblivion before him, much less his supremely powered-up third technique. God Emperor Crane Pit was completely powerless! His soul was simply extinguished without a chance of retaliation.
“Many thanks Senior for saving my daughter, and my entire High Wind Clan.” High Wind City Master immediately bowed and thanked Xue Ying with tears of gratitude.
“Many thanks Senior for saving us.” A light enveloped the surface of High Wind Yu Rong, replacing the torn clothes she had. She looked at this white-robed male before her who gave off a sharp aura. She felt both grateful and an unfathomable sense of admiration.
“You don’t have to thank me.” Xue Ying walked over. He waved his hand and collected the corpse of God Emperor Crane Pit. Looking at High Wind City Master and High Wind Yu Rong, Xue Ying continued, “Given the personality of Palace Master Ghost Sea, I doubt he would let things by when his disciple God Emperor Crane Pit died. I am not afraid of him, but it will be better for you all to prepare yourself well. Don’t get yourself implicated because of him.”
“Yes.” High Wind City Master felt his heart tighten.
But he was not panicking either.
Because the current situation was much better than before!
God Emperor Crane Pit gave him two choices previously. No matter what, he, High Wind City Master, would have to die. That’s because God Emperor Crane Pit was incredibly vigilant! Once an enmity was formed, the Early Stage God Emperor High Wind City Master had to die! Even though it was hard for an Early Stage God Emperor to break through, perhaps there might be one day when he actually reached the Middle Stage God Emperor Realm. By then, he would be qualified to threaten God Emperor Crane Pit. Hence, High Wind City Master had to die!
And now?
This mysterious expert before them was the one who killed ‘Crane Pit’. Even though Palace Master Ghost Sea was infamous, he was ultimately a Grand Perfection God Emperor (Supreme). In this affair, they, the High Wind Clan, was the one who got bullied. As long as they temporarily avoided the High Wind City, Palace Master Ghost Sea would feel disdain to pursue after them.
“Go prepare yourself well.” Xue Ying lightly waved his hand. He turned around and left the place. Following that, he turned into a stream of light and flew out of the second floor of the pub.
Some distance away along the streets, there were quite a lot of pedestrians watching at the commotion. These Natives of the Divine Realm were innately powerful. Even though it was quite far away, and there were some structures blocking their view, most of them could still ‘see’ everything that had happened on the second floor of the pub. They also knew that ‘God Emperor Crane Pit’ was killed by that whie-robed male.
“So powerful.”
“He killed the other party in one move!”
“God Emperor Crane Pit did not have the slightest chance to retaliate.”
“This High Wind Clan is really fortunate. They were met with such a huge calamity and High Wind City Master is seemingly going to die, yet a powerful expert like this appeared in the High Wind City. He saw that things were not fair and killed God Emperor Crane Pit for justice, saving them in the end.”
“God Emperor Crane Pit is one of Palace Master Ghost Sea’s three disciples. He has a huge origin! Yet this expert dared to kill him?”
“Hmph, given the strength of this expert, he might perhaps be a Grand Perfection God Emperor as well! Naturally, he dared to kill God Emperor Crane Pit without caring about Palace Master Ghost Sea.”
Many Natives of the Divine Realm were watching and discussing about the matter. At the same time, they rapidly left the place.
This was no longer a safeground. They must not stay here for too long.
Second floor of the pub.
“Hurry up!”
High Wind City Master was decisive. He swept his gaze across the place before ordering, “We were bullied. Even though Palace Master Ghost Sea will feel disdain from pursuing after small characters like us, we might possibly be implicated. So hurry up! The entire High Wind Clan will now split into ten teams before leaving for the Great Wilderness. We shall temporarily avoid this place of misfortune. Once the matter dies down, we can always return.”
“Yes.”
“Yes.”
All of them acknowledged the order.
“Sou sou sou…”
They immediately transformed into streams of light and left the second floor of the pub. The entire High Wind Clan used their fastest speed to gather their members. They had to remain alert! If they harbored any thoughts of fluke, that Palace Master Ghost Sea might perhaps destroy their entire clan with a casual strike.
…
Xue Ying transformed his appearances once again. Now he was wearing a black robe. And his aura became much more warm. It was at the level of an Early Stage God Monarch now. Xue Ying remained in this High Wind City.
In an unremarkable pub along the streets in High Wind City, Xue Ying ordered several dishes and a flask of wine.
He slowly enjoyed the wine and the delicacies alone.
‘Palace Master Ghost Sea is quite an overprotective person. He should have immediately gone out by now.’ Xue Ying thought. After killing God Emperor Crane Pit, a powerful expert like Palace Master Ghost Sea should have an incredible acute sense of karma. Once his disciple’s karmic ties disappeared, he would immediately come and investigate what happened, ‘If he flew over slowly, by the time he comes, I as the ‘murderer’ would have been long gone! Hence, Palace Master Ghost Sea would most likely employ the help of an expert to rush over at the fastest speed.’
Even though it was rare to find a cultivator who could use a movement technique like the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, there were other similar techniques too.
Of all the Ascendant God Emperors who cultivated in the Dao of Void, only that strongest Late Stage God Emperor knew how to execute it! But experts were like clouds in the Divine Realm. There were so many variants of bloodline talents. Some could allow the cultivator to penetrate through an ultra-long distance! Though there were few of them, each and every one of them had high statuses. The weakest had the strength of a Late Stage God Emperor. In addition, they could easily escape once they saw that things were amiss. Hence, few could deal with these experts.
Those who could teleport through an ultra-long distance in the Divine Realm were highly valued even by the three Great Royal Clans. They were all upper VIPs!
The statuses of Grand Perfection God Emperors were incredibly high in the entire Divine Realm. Such experts numbered only 30 or so in this world! And the majority of them could easily employ the help of an expert that could undergo an ‘ultra-long distance teleportation’!
“Mn?”
Without finishing half of his wine, and after finishing two plates of his dishes, Xue Ying looked upwards at a far distance.
Over there.
A starlight suddenly became resplendent! That meteorite passage contained two figures moving along. One was a plump male who wore a loose robe. He had a horn that emitted a weird starlight on his head. The other was a thin and small old man wearing a black robe and had an intense killing aura coming from him. Sweeping his gaze, even though quite a few cultivators living in High Wind City did not see the experts in the void, all of them could feel a suppressive feeling on their souls.
‘He is here.’ Xue Ying put down the wine cup and paid attention to what happened there, ‘Palace Master Ghost Sea, the entire High Wind Clan has already fled in different groups, leaving behind just ordinary civilians. I hope you do not implicate these ordinary people. Otherwise, even though I am unwilling to fight with a Supreme Expert, I will not concede so easily.’
In the Realm Heart Great Land, when Xue Ying was weak, he still dared to fight head-on with Undying Underworld Emperor! He even interrupted the other party’s sacrificial ritual in the past!
It was a good matter that Xue Ying killed God Emperor Crane Pit. But he did not wish to implicate the ordinary civilians as a result!
The moment the enemy showed signs of acting.
That would be when Xue Ying retaliate!
…
At the same place where God Emperor Crane Pit died--second floor of the pub.
Two figures including Palace Master Ghost Sea came.
The surrounding flow of time began reversing. It reversed until the moment when ‘God Emperor Crane Pit’ grabbed High Wind Yu Rong. Only then did the scene regained its normalcy. Scene by scene, they saw as God Emperor Crane Pit killed the other guests and attendants with a single glance. They saw as he teased High Wind Yu Rong and forced the High Wind Clan into an ultimatum… but the moment a white-robed male wielding a divine sword appear in the projection, just as that white-robed male looked over, the entire projection shattered.
“It’s him.” Palace Master Ghost Sea growled, “I can’t even see clearly what exactly happened at that time. What a powerful strength, but white robe? Wielding a divine sword? There is no such expert ranked in the top 100 within the entire Divine Realm. He acted so sneakily without daring to show himself. He even concealed his aura and disguise his appearances, so I doubt he could be that strong.”
Why would a Grand Perfection God Emperor be so sneaky? They would simply act in the light! Even if they did something ugly! All of them were incredibly proud and unbridled.
‘Since he did not dare to act using his true self, this white-robed male must be afraid of you, Palace Master Ghost Sea. Hence, he disguised himself when he dealt against God Emperor Crane Pit.” The plump male by his side chuckled.
“I’ll absolutely not let him go for killing my disciple.” The eyes of Palace Master Ghost Sea were filled with frost.

chapters.title: Chapter 1310 - Ranked One on the God Emperor Ranking List
chapters.content:
Chapter 1310: Ranked One on the God Emperor Ranking List
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“There should be many who saw what happened in that battle right?” The plump male chuckled.
“Mn.” Palace Master Ghost Sea nodded.
At that moment, an unseen ripple began spreading out in all directions. It rapidly permeated through the souls of the closest tens of thousands of natives. The strongest among these citizens was just a Middle Stage God Monarch. Before a ‘Grand Perfection God Emperor’, the gap was simply too big and their souls were easily scoured through.
Of these tens of thousands of natives, only a few hundred or so had witnessed personally what happened at the second floor of the pub.
After all, when the most dazzling Big Missy of High Wind City was captured, many citizens around were nervously watching! Even though they did not dare to stay behind at the original crime scene, and many had gone back to hide in their abodes, how would they know that their souls would similarly be searched despite so.
Not just Palace Master Ghost Sea, even the plump male, ‘Star Wind City Master’ was also searching through the souls of others.
“What!” Suddenly, the expression of Palace Master Ghost Sea changed.
“This…” Star Wind City Master was similarly stunned.
They had flipped through the memories of many, and had seen the battle. Everything ended after the white-robed male pointed his finger, and the void surrounding God Emperor Crane Pit became distorted. God Emperor Crane Pit then fell down onto the ground, dead.
“One move?”
“Just one move? And he did it so casually?”
Palace Master Ghost Sea’s expression became uglier.
Previously, he thought that the enemy was afraid of he, ‘Palace Master Ghost Sea’, because he was so sneaky about his identity. But now that they saw the battle, where the other party killed God Emperor Crane Pit in one single move.
“It’s just one single move.” Star Wind City Master commented about it with a sigh, “There are only at most three to five Late Stage God Emperors who can kill Grand Perfection God Emperor in one move. The most frightening thing is that this white-robed male hasn’t gotten close to God Emperor Crane Pit. He simply tapped out with one finger and God Emperor Crane Pit died despite being distanced. For him to kill the other party so easily, it is highly possible that he is a Grand Perfection God Emperor.”
“Not really. This murderer could have altered the battlefield, deliberately projecting a scene for the other ordinary natives to ‘see’.” Palace Master Ghost Sea gritted his teeth, “This could be a feigned projection and not reality.”
“What Brother Ghost Sea said is possible. But there are many signs of battle left behind around the pub. Judging by the damage done by the distorted void on the walls, tables and stools around it, there is more than an 80% chance of the scene being real. If he is disguising, I can only say that he has disguised the entire battlefield too perfectly.” Star Wind City Master said.
“Help me check through if there are any God Emperor experts in this city.” Palace Master Ghost Sea asked.
“Alright.”
Star Wind City Master nodded.
…
Xue Ying continued drinking the wine. Suddenly, star motes could be seen appearing around him. These little star motes had spread across the entire city.
‘This domain does actually cover quite a huge area.’ Xue Ying revealed a look of shock. These star motes should be created by that Star Wind City Master who could execute the ‘Starlight Penetration’. All those star motes were currently investigating the strength of every sentient beings within the city. Nonetheless, given that Xue Ying’s soul had reached an unfathomable stage, he had easily disguised himself such that even if the scouting technique of Star Wind City Master was stronger by ten times, it would still be futile.
‘The two of them.’ Xue Ying looked upwards.
He saw that Palace Master Ghost Sea and Star Wind City Master had already flown out of the pub. They flew midway into the sky and were currently observing the entire city.
‘With Star Wind City Master present, Palace Master Ghost Sea would not vent his anger on the innocent.’ Xue Ying thought. The personality of Star Wind City Master was relatively good. He befriended various parties, yet had a personality that did not like killing the weak. Even though Star Wind City Master had a weak combat power, he was still a Late Stage God Emperor! Nonetheless, it was due to his Starlight Penetration magical ability that improved his overall standing in the Divine Realm. Many Grand Perfection God Emperors even called him Dao Brother. The three Great Royal Clans were incredibly courteous towards him as well.
Hence, Palace Master Ghost Sea would most likely be a little more reserved around Star Wind City Master.
“You dare to kill my disciple! Yet you dare not publicize your identity?” A voice filled with anger sounded across the entire city. Many Natives of the Divine Realm living in the High Wind City were frightened so much that their hearts tremble. The entire city became silent as the voice of Palace Master Ghost Sea echoed across, “I, Ghost Sea, will remember this vengeance for eternity!”
Soon, that voice filled with anger stopped.
Palace Master Ghost Sea swept his gaze across the place momentarily before speaking to Star Wind City Master.
“Sou!”
Starlight appeared once again. The two of them soon disappeared amidst the starlight. They had left High Wind City.
Actually, even though Palace Master Ghost Sea was a huge devil and would frequently massacre a clan, it was still rare for him to ‘exterminate a city’! In addition, the murderer this time was Xue Ying. Palace Master Ghost Sea’s target was also Xue Ying. If that Early Stage God Emperor ‘High Wind City Master’ was still around, Ghost Sea could very well capture him. Nonetheless, the current city was filled with only weak cultivators. With a friend of Star Wind City Master around him, he naturally did not dare begin killing wantonly.
‘This vengeance is something you will remember for eternity?’ Xue Ying chuckled.
Devil Heart Cultist Master had once said these words in the past too.
Xue Ying laughed and went back to drinking and eating those delicacies. He was incredibly leisure and did not show any fear for Palace Master Ghost Sea. After all, the reason he disguised his identity was primarily because he came from another world! Not just him, even the other ‘Great Emperor North River’ had maintained low-profile primarily because he was also from another world. Since they were outsiders, it would naturally be better for them to stay low-key here!
The moment they attracted everyone, it was fine if normal experts were the ones that came to find them. But what they were afraid of were those three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods! Those were the experts that created this world. Both Xue Ying and Great Emperor North River had ample reasons to show fear for them!
Once he became famous…
It would mean that this world no longer held much attraction to him. It would also be the time for him to leave this world!
…
After filling his stomach and finishing his wine.
‘I have gotten my hands on the Dried Realm Leaf. Now I am just left with the Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead.’ Xue Ying pondered. There was more Dried Realm Leaf ultimately in the Divine Realm. Hence, collecting it was much easier. Xue Ying could simply collect it from the loot after killing a devil--simple and easy. Instead, it was the ‘Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead’ that Xue Ying would have a harder time acquiring since there was only three of them in the entire Divine Realm!
Those who owned one had huge origins.
One was Gold Feather City Master, a Late Stage God Emperor. He was even ranked at the front of other Late Stage God Emperors, ranking at a startling 39th in the ‘God Emperor Ranking List’! Compared to Grand Perfection God Emperors (Supremes), he could even fight without losing that badly.
The second was an Ascendant God Emperor, God Emperor Chun Yu, also a Middle Stage God Emperor. Being an Ascendant God Emperor, he was ranked 162nd on the God Emperor Ranking List!
And the last was ‘Cloud Flow Pavilion Master’, a Middle Stage God Emperor. He was not an Ascendant, and simply had a strength at the Middle Stage God Emperor Realm. Compared to God Emperor Crane Pit, he was not so much stronger. Nonetheless, he had the Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead. How many Late Stage God Emperors yearned for that? Even Grand Perfection God Emperors longed for it and were willing to steal that item for their juniors. But why did nobody snatch it from him?
Because this Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master was the favourite grandson of ‘Cloud Phoenix City Master’. And Cloud Phoenix City Master… was the number one most terrifying existence on the God Emperor Ranking List!
‘The three of them aren’t easy targets.’ Xue Ying thought.
‘Gold Feather City Master is the strongest. Being a Native of the Divine Realm, even though he is clearly a Late Stage God Emperor, his strength has practically reached that of the Supreme Level! But still, he relied on external items like ‘Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin’ Bead’. Otherwise, he would most likely drop down to around 80th to 90th position on the God Emperor Ranking List.’ Xue Ying thought. It was this target who was the strongest that Xue Ying did not fear.
It was easy to deal with those who relied on external treasures and bloodline. Under his third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique, treasures and bloodlines were ineffective! It would be quite good if the other party could maintain his consciousness.
‘An Ascendant God Emperor, even if he is at the Middle Stage God Emperor, will be quite formidable in his soul and willpower. If not for my third killing technique, it would most likely be hard for me to bring him down.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘But now, it isn’t too difficult for me to deal with him.’
‘The most troublesome target is instead, this Cloud Flow Pavilion Master.’ Xue Ying frowned.
Cloud Flow Pavilion Master lived in the Cloud Phoenix City! Over there lived the number one most terrifying expert in Divine Realm! She could rank one amongst all Grand Perfection God Emperors for a reason. According to her battles, she had once killed a Grand Perfection God Emperor in history. And more than ten Grand Perfection God Emperors that lived in the Divine Realm would be defeated and even heavily injured before her! It was primarily because Grand Perfection God Emperors had to fight and train, which resulted in such frightening outcomes.
Those that were killed had been too confident of themselves--they provoked Cloud Phoenix City Master.
‘She could kill even Grand Perfection God Emperors.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Unless this Cloud Phoenix City Master has a strength comparable to Grand Perfection Ascendant God Emperors?’
Ascendants could fight with those on a higher level.
Late stage Ascendant God Emperors could fight with Grand Perfection Native God Emperors! As for Grand Perfection Ascendant God Emperors? How frightening would that be?
In this Divine Realm…
According to what Xue Ying deduced, there had been two Grand Perfection Ascendant God Emperors that appeared in history, yet both of them disappeared!
‘According to the intelligence reports, of the three of them, Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master has been too pampered. As a result, he became relatively arrogant and has committed the most sins. But he is merely arrogant and wilful! His personality isn’t that bad. There are even times when he had been made use by devils.’ Xue Ying thought. The background of Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master was too big. Naturally, there were others who sought connection with and made use of him.
‘As for Gold Feather City Master, his sins are done primarily because he is a ruthless person. It hasn’t reached the stage that classify him as a devil.’ Xue Ying thought. This Gold Feather City Master was a ruthless person. He did not show any mercy. It was considered normal amongst experts in the Divine Realm. Gold Feather City Master had merely killed more often when he embroiled in various battles.
‘And the final Ascendant God Emperor is the most low-profiled out of them. He mainly focuses on cultivation and rarely battles with others.’
‘Three Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Beads. I need to get one of them. What should I do?’
Xue Ying pondered.

chapters.title: Chapter 1311 - Dream
chapters.content:
Chapter 1311: Dream
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
That Ascendant God Emperor was first ruled out by Xue Ying. The other party maintained a low profile and focused entirely on cultivation. Xue Ying appreciated this kind of cultivators. Hence, it was impossible for Xue Ying to scheme against them for no reason at all.
Instead, it was ‘Gold Feather City Master’ and ‘Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master’ that Xue Ying planned on acting against!
Gold Feather City Master would take the initiative to snatch the treasures of others. He would battle and kill. He was selfish and ruthless. Whenever he acted, he would cut the weeds and eliminate the roots. For the sake of getting stronger, he would practically do everything from killing to scheming. He was absolutely ambitious. To such a person, even though he was not categorised under an example of a ‘huge devil’, Xue Ying would not show mercy against him.
As for Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master, he was completely different from Gold Feather City Master! He did not show any intention to kill. But many other clans had been exterminated because of his strength! The number of beings that died because of him could count Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master as a ‘devil’. It’s just that most of the time, he did things because others borrowed his strength to do so!
‘But this Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master isn’t completely innocent either! He is ultimately a Middle Stage God Emperor. How could he not know what his subordinates do? It’s just that those subordinates of his know how to pamper him and make him happy. Hence, he would take a laissez-faire attitude towards those tasks.’ Xue Ying pondered.
‘Alright.’
‘It’s him then, Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master.’
Xue Ying made his decision.
Even though the intimidation from the number one expert on the God Emperor Ranking List, Cloud Phoenix City Master, was huge, Xue Ying was confident of fleeing with his life using the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique! The other party might be the strongest cultivator in the Divine Realm, but she did not know how to teleport through an ultra-long distance. Those few cultivators who could do so in the Divine Realm, other than the Ascendants, relied on innate bloodline magical abilities!
The Ancestral God Bloodline of Cloud Phoenix City Master might not specialize in ultra-long distance teleportation, yet her combat strength was frighteningly strong.
‘Time to go.’
Xue Ying paid for his food and left the High Wind City. He then entered Cloud Phoenix City inconspicuously.
******
Cloud Phoenix City was incredibly huge. It occupied close to five million kilometers in distance. And at the center of the city was a chain of mountains that spanned across several hundreds of thousands of kilometers. The peak of the mountain was situated above the cloud layer. The entire mountain chain contained palaces connecting with one another on top. They were also given the name of ‘The Cloud Phoenix Residences’.
‘The Cloud Phoenix Residences.’
Xue Ying looked up at that chain of mountains. He cast his gaze across the cloud layer and saw that huge residence located at the mountain peak, ‘The strongest expert in the Divine Realm lives up there.’
Beyond her were the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods that created this world.
‘Fortunately, Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master isn’t someone who would stay in the Cloud Phoenix Residences forever.’ Xue Ying grinned. Given the arrogant and willful personality of Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master, he was someone who likes pleasure. He even created a ‘Caged Cloud Pavilion’ just for his own pleasure. Being the Pavilion Master, this place was a heaven for him. Naturally, he would spend most of his time within the Caged Cloud Pavilion.
He would also visit other places in the Cloud Phoenix City occasionally seeking for more pleasure.
As for leaving the city? If he were to visit other places in the Divine Realm, it would create an incredibly huge disturbance. Most of the time, there would be three Late Stage God Emperors following behind Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master just to protect him! No other choice, given how powerful Cloud Phoenix City Master was, there were more than 20 Late Stage God Emperors chose to become her subordinates!
But Late Stage God Emperors valued cultivation too. Within Cloud Phoenix City, there would usually only be one Late Stage God Emperor that followed after Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master.
‘The only grandson of Cloud Phoenix City Master.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly, ‘Hearsay Cloud Phoenix City Master once had a son and a daughter. During the years when she was imprisoned by a powerful enemy, her children died, leaving only her grandson alive.’
Cloud Phoenix City Master only reached where she was after experiencing countless difficulties.
‘I’ve reached the Caged Cloud Pavilion.’
Xue Ying relied on his karmic senses. After walking around leisurely, he soon found himself before a huge pavilion. This pavilion occupied a relatively vast area, and was so high it reached the cloud layer. It was also the most famous ground of entertainment in the entire Cloud Phoenix City.
‘He is there.’ Xue Ying looked upwards.
…
Caged Cloud Pavilion.
“Pavilion Master.” A black-robed young man was all smiles. His eyes were fox-like. There were currently six young women behind him. All of them had top-notch appearance and temperament. It’s just that when these young women look at the back of the black-robed young man, their eyes were filled with a strand of hatred. Nonetheless, they had no choice, The lives of many relatives and clansmen were in the hands of this black-robed young man.
“Come in.” A voice could be heard from inside.
Only then did the black-robed young man pushed the door carefully.
Within the hall.
There was an incredibly plump male seated. Beside him was a violet-robed female attendant currently serving him. He was eating in big gulps. This incredibly plump male… was none other than ‘Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master’, the only grandson of Cloud Phoenix City Master.
“Oh?” This Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master looked over. He saw six outstanding young women walking in. Each of the women had different personalities, and when the six of them stood together, it felt like a piece of art. Just watching it was simply a form of enjoyment.
“These are ‘six sisters’ that this subordinate has spent a great deal of time and effort before finding.” The black-robed male immediately began fawning the other party, “Their taste is something that Pavilion Master would definitely enjoy once you try it.”
“Mn.” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master revealed a grin, “Good good good, very good. You may withdraw, Chen Fu.”
Even though he knew that some of his subordinates were using their connections to intimidate others, but because they knew how to coax him happy, he did not mind. This black-robed young man before him was one of the three most favored subordinates he had, an Early Stage God Emperor known as ‘God Emperor Chen Fu’. He specialized in instructing girls.
The black-robed young man, ‘God Emperor Chen Fu’ immediately laughed and retreated respectfully. He also closed the door properly after that.
And now, there was just Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master, the violet-robed female attendant and the six young women left in the hall.
“All of you come over.” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master immediately beckoned for those girls with his chubby hand.
“Yes, Pavilion Master.”
The six young women immediately went over.
That violet-robed female attendant smiled as she watched this. She was completely loyal to her master, and would do her best to serve him. She was also the most trusted aide of Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master. Many affairs could not be hidden from this female attendant. To Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master, this female attendant was his family! And others including God Emperor Chen Fu were like his pets!
Suddenly--
Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master felt a dizzy spell hitting his mind.
“Where is this?”
Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master looked around him with astonishment. He was now in a sinister jail cell.
“What is going on? Why have my strength been sealed?” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master discovered with terror that he was tied to a pillar. By his side, there were several other pillars too with others tied to each of them.
“It’s Chen Fu and the others.” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master could recognize them with a single glance. Tied to the other pillars were his three most favored aides.
The three of them gradually regained consciousness.
“What is happening?”
“This, this…”
“Pavilion Master is here too.”
“Pavilion Master, hurry up and call City Master to save us!”
The three of them were shouting out in terror.
“My strength is sealed. I am unable to transmit any messages.” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master started becoming anxious.
“Zhi ya.”
The door to this sinister-looking jail cell suddenly opened. A white-robed male who carried a divine sword on his back came in. He swept his cold gaze across the four of them, before turning back to Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master: “Cloud Flow Pavilion Master, you have committed an incredible amount of crime. Today is the day you die.” Saying that, he pulled out the divine sword on his back.
“I did not, I did not!” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master was filled with terror at that moment.
“Why aren’t you admitting it? Do you still need me to say it out one by one? That Iron Flame Clan which was exterminated because of you, the Sword Universe Religion…” The white-robed male began stating.
“It’s not me! It’s them! It’s them who did it!” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master shouted back.
Those three subordinates that were tied became terrified. It’s just that they did not push the blame at this moment in fear of offending Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master.
“Rest assured. The three of them will die.” The white-robed male said.
They were stunned.
“This is unrelated to us!”
“We are only subordinates of Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master. It is the Pavilion Master who instructed us.”
“We can’t not listen to orders! Please show some mercy and spare our lives!” These three immediately began asking for mercy. No matter what, they had to live first.
“You all--” When Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master saw that, he became indignant.
“Stop shirking from what you have done. The three of you have committed countless sins. And Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master, you have indulged in them. All of you deserved to die.” The white-robed male immediately unsheathed his sword. He then jabbed out at one of the bound subordinates. That subordinate’s body trembled and then he turned into ashes.
“Sou sou sou.”
Three consecutive strikes and the three subordinates turned into powder.
The white-robed male walked towards Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master.
Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master was filled with immense terror: “Don’t kill me, don’t kill me! What do you want? I’ll give you everything you want! My grandmother is Cloud Phoenix City Master. I’m sure you know that I can treat as if nothing has happened today. Whatever you want, I can definitely help you achieve it.”
“It’s too late. The moment you indulged in your subordinates to commit crime is the moment your death day arrives.” The white-robed male pulled his sword out once again.
Despair and fright began coursing through Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master, showing out on his expression.
“Hu.”
…
“No, no--” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master abruptly opened his eyes. He discovered that he was still in the hall. By his side, the six young women and violet-robed female attendant had similarly fallen onto the ground. At this moment, all of them were waking up. And bewilderment filled their faces.
Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master immediately climbed upwards. He looked at himself, cheering out: “I did not die! I am alive!”
He revealed joy.
“What about my treasures? Why are they missing?” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master was terrified. Everything he had in his storage treasure disappeared.
“This is merely a small warning, Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master. If you continue behaving like this, the next time we meet is the day you die.” A voice boomed out in the soul of Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master.
When Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master heard that, he paled.
He knew.
That everything which happened seemingly in a dream was actually done by a mysterious expert. He could silently pull him into a dream, and could definitely kill him silently as well. He was completely powerless against that perpetrator.
Actually, Xue Ying did not kill him first, because his grandmother was the number one expert in the Divine Realm, the Cloud Phoenix City Master. If Xue Ying were to kill him, Cloud Phoenix City Master would definitely become mad. She could possibly disrupt Xue Ying’s peaceful life. Secondly, Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master was not really a devil. It’s just that he had watched his subordinates commit those deeds with one eye closed.
These two reasons were why he spared the life of Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master.
“Hong.” A figure blasted apart the door. It was a cold old man that rushed in. When this cold old man saw that Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master was safe, he heaved a sigh of relief. At the same time, he added: “Pavilion Master, Chen Fu and the other two are dead.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1312 - I Have Everything
chapters.content:
Chapter 1312: I Have Everything
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“They are dead?” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master felt his heart tremble. Extending his senses, indeed, he could not sense the karma of Chen Fu and the other two anymore.
‘What happened in the dream is real.’ Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master felt terrified. In that dream, all three of his subordinates died. And he died too! But now, he found out he was the only one left alive. Especially when he found out all the treasures he had with him were gone meant that the perpetrator could easily kill him.
One had to know that many treasures were refined by the cultivator. They could be concealed within a droplet of blood. Since the perpetrator could take all his treasures away, it was clear he had controlled the life of Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master.
The other party dealt simply with all three of his subordinates. This brought terror to Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master so much that he softened down onto the ground.
“Hurry up and inform my Grandmother. Tell her that I might die anytime!” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master urged anxiously.
“Report to the City Master?” The cold old man felt puzzled. Why did Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master not inform her himself? But how would he know that all treasures Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master had were gone. Even his communication treasure was stolen.
“Hurry!”
Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master urged a second time.
“Yes.” The cold old man acknowledged.
Very soon.
“Hong~”
A terrifying aura soon descended, and a long white-haired beauty came in. She emitted an aura that felt like an endless world. Even though the cold old man was a Late Stage God Emperor, he still trembled with fear and trepidation currently because an existence like ‘Cloud Phoenix City Master’ could kill him and other Late Stage God Emperors with a single move. After all, the other party was a terrifying existence who had killed Grand Perfection God Emperors personally before. And in the entire God Emperor Ranking List, Cloud Phoenix City Master was the only one who could do so.
Of course, there were some Grand Perfection God Emperors like the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform, ‘Hidden Willow Valley Master’ that Cloud Phoenix City Master could not deal with. Hidden Willow Valley Master was after all, a huge tree with a heaven-defying amount of life force. But Cloud Phoenix City Master could still give sufficient ‘pressure’ to the other party.
Beside Cloud Phoenix City Master followed a red-haired girl. This red-haired girl similarly had an extraordinary aura. She was an innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform with the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor, ‘God Emperor Fire Phoenix ‘. She and Cloud Phoenix City Master were like sisters.
“Cloud Flow, what happened?” Cloud Phoenix City Master looked at her grandson. Her voice became much gentler. As she looked at him, she thought of how both her children had died in the past.
“Everyone, retreat. Retreat at this moment.” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master immediately roared.
At that juncture, everyone else in the hall left.
Only Cloud Phoenix City Master, God Emperor Fire Phoenix, and Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master were still in it.
“Grandmother, I almost died.” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master said with terror.
“Oh? Tell me more.” Cloud Phoenix City Master frowned. Killing intent began leaking from her.
“Yes.” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master began describing everything that had happened previously.
As Cloud Phoenix City Master listened to his story, she frowned: “The other party could send you into an illusory realm silently. You are after all, a Middle Stage God Emperor. The three strongest subordinates of yours that died are Middle Stage God Emperors too. But all of you are powerless against it! The souls of the other three have been exterminated… There are always people coming in and out of the Caged Cloud Pavilion. I even arranged for Late Stage God Emperors to guard this place, yet none of them have discovered any disturbances.”
“Illusory realm, silently and soundlessly.” God Emperor Fire Phoenix added from the side, “But I have never heard of anyone who could cast such powerful illusory realm. Cultivating the illusory realm is already very hard since it is considered a direction of the soul.”
“Mn.” Cloud Phoenix City Master nodded, “Firstly, a new expert who has reached unfathomable heights in the soul could have possibly emerge. Secondly, it could be a Native of the Divine Realm who grasped a powerful magical ability that specializes in this aspect through his bloodline? Thirdly, it could also possibly be a new innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform that came into our world. Perhaps this lifeform might be good at illusory realms.”
“No matter what, that person has the gall to enter my Cloud Phoenix City and deal against my grandson.” Cloud Phoenix City Master coldly uttered, “But at least he gave a warning and did not injure my son. In the future, I shall punish him severely before letting him go after that.”
While Cloud Phoenix City Master spoke, she waved her hand.
The surrounding time flow began reversing. Initially, everything that had happened before was projected. Nonetheless, when Xue Ying executed the illusory realm, that scene which had happened earlier did not show at all!
“I can’t reverse the time flow?”
Cloud Phoenix City Master sneered.
She waved her hand lightly, causing a mirror to condense out from the cloud. This mirror began showing everything that happened previously.
And what was shown on the mirror… within the hall, Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master, the female attendant and six sisters had all fallen deep asleep.
The door was pushed open.
And a white-robed young man who had a divine sword on his back walked in just like that. Several other people had similarly fallen outside the door. Of which included that God Emperor Chen Fu. When this white-robed young man entered, he waved his hand, causing all the treasures on Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master to fly ou and fall into his hands.
“Si la.” Following that, a black crack formed. That white-robed young man took a step in and disappeared from the vicinity.
“Mn?” Both Cloud Phoenix City Master and God Emperor Fire Phoenix were startled.
Even though the two of them were incredibly powerful, few in Divine Realm could execute an ultra-long distance teleportation.
“An illusory realm of unprecedented strength and ultra-long distance teleportation. Who exactly is he?” Cloud Phoenix City Master could feel an immense threat from this white-robed young man. At least if he planned on killing her grandson, she could do nothing about it at all. Since she could not help her grandson to block off the illusory realm.
“A white-robed young man with a divine sword? Who is he? There are no such person in the top few experts within the Divine Realm.” God Emperor Fire Phoenix felt puzzled, “Is he an Ascendant? Or a Native of the Divine Realm? Or an innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform?”
Even though the other party was in a humanoid shape, he could still be an innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
For instance, she, God Emperor Fire Phoenix , was an innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform that transformed into the shape of a human.
“Now you know.” Cloud Phoenix City Master looked at her grandson Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master, “I do not have the capability to help defend you against all enemies. This mysterious expert could easily and silently kill you. In the future, you should remember to restrict those subordinates of yours.”
“I know, I understand now.” Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master immediately acknowledged. After this close shave with death, he did not dare to continue and indulge in everything that his subordinates were doing. Even though he did not care about the weak, he did not show any interest in killing either. What he liked was simply ‘enjoyment and pleasure’.
“Mn.”
Cloud Phoenix City Master felt her heart relaxing. The other party did not kill off her grandson. Clearly, he did not wish to form an enmity with her. Since he did not kill her grandson this time, as long as her grandson restricted his subordinates further, she believed the perpetrator would not kill him in the future too.
Perhaps it might be some sort of ‘awakening’ to her grandson too, allowing her grandson to understand that there it was still possible for his life to be threatened.
“But still, who exactly is he?” Even though Cloud Phoenix City Master did not feel any threat from him, she understood that this mysterious expert held a huge threat to many other God Emperors.
“Sister, with his strength, I doubt he will hide forever. Over time, his identity will eventually be revealed.” God Emperor Fire Phoenix chuckled, “By then, we can go and have some spar with him.”
…
Xue Ying had already returned to the Iron Dragon City.
‘I have finally gathered everything.’ Xue Ying looked forward to it. He had gathered both Dried Realm Leaf ahd Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead. These items that were very helpful to the Natives of the Divine Realm were quite useless to him. Instead, it was that ‘Void Lineage’ innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse that made him long for. Even though there were other innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms over at the Realm Heart Great Land too, there were too few of them, and not a single one of these lifeforms had a Void Lineage.
In this world, there were many more innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms yet only three of them had a Void Lineage.
Getting one was sufficient for his cause.
After all, that was a corpse with a Void Lineage… and an absolute majority of its body was the manifestation of the Dao of Void. This was unlike those Desolate Beasts. The body of an innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform was huge. Xue Ying had to analyze every single scale of it. Just analyzing through every single part of its body once would take an incredibly long amount of time. Hence, this corpse was the best object for him to research and deepen his understanding on the ‘Dao of Void’. It was much more precious than any other scriptures.
Iron Dragon Hall, before the entrance.
The protector saw that it was a white-robed male with a divine sword on his back who came, and could not help but be startled. Because not too long ago, this God Emperor Azure Cloud had just visited them.
“God Emperor Azure Cloud.” The protector asked, “Is there any reason why God Emperor is here again?”
“Please send the message that I want to meet the Crown Prince.” Xue Ying said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1313 - Who Could Handle Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1313: Who Could Handle Me?
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Very soon.
Xue Ying got the approval to enter this Iron Dragon Hall. The hall was spacious, and Xue Ying continued following the protector.
“Mn?” Suddenly, the protector who was leading ahead felt his body tremble. He was so frightened that he immediately bowed respectfully without daring to raise his head up.
Xue Ying was startled. He could not help but stop and look upwards.
There was currently a simple gray-robed male walking casually within the residence. He seemed to be enjoying the scenery around him. Many other female attendants and protectors bowed their heads without daring to look upwards. This simple gray-robed male looked ordinary. Others could not see how special his aura was, yet with Xue Ying’s current soul, his senses had reached an unfathomably acute stage. He could sense an endless energy ready to erupt from that male. That was an energy that made even Xue Ying quake in slight fear!
‘Iron Dragon City Master.’ Xue Ying was surprised, ‘I once saw Palace Master Ghost Sea from far. Palace Master Ghost Sea is a Grand Perfection God Emperor too, yet the intimidation I felt from him is not as intense as I that from Iron Dragon City Master.’
One could easily determine this through the God Emperor Ranking List.
Palace Master Ghost Sea was considered one of the bottom rankers among Grand Perfection God Emperors.
And Iron Dragon City Master was ranked seventh on the list!
One had to know…
Some of those who ranked in the top 10 belonged to the strongest experts in the three Great Royal Clans. Those were the closest descendants of the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods! There were also some terrifying Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Since Iron Dragon City Master could be ranked at the seventh position, it went to show how terrifying he was in combat.
“Mn?” The simple gray-robed Iron Dragon City Master gave Xue Ying a glance. He felt slightly puzzled. He could discern that Xue Ying was currently emanating a Late Stage God Emperor aura (disguised). This strength was something he did not care, just that he could not recognize the identity of Xue Ying! Clearly, this was a disguised identity.
‘It seems he is a guest of Cloud Mountain too.’ Iron Dragon City Master no longer cared about this matter. Most of the miscellaneous tasks were left to his eldest son to handle. As for him? He was completely focused on breaking through to the Chaotic Origin Level!
After Iron Dragon City Master left.
Only then did the protector dare to stand straight. He said to Xue Ying: “God Emperor Azure Cloud, this way please.”
Xue Ying nodded. He thought: ‘There are different levels between Grand Perfection God Emperors. That number one on the God Emperor Ranking List, Cloud Phoenix City Master, has killed a Grand Perfection God Emperor before. She should most likely be comparable to Grand Perfection Ascendant God Emperors. And this Iron Dragon City Master isn’t someone to provoke either!’
Grand Perfection Ascendant God Emperors… should most likely represent the highest level beneath ‘Chaotic Origin Level’.
…
Within the garden.
Xue Ying saw the Crown Prince of Iron Dragon Hall. He was still in his loose black robe and was as casual as before. When he saw Xue Ying, this Crown Prince chuckled: “I’ve just met Brother Azure Cloud yesterday. It has only been a day and Brother Azure Cloud is back? Unless you have some good news?”
The Crown Prince was indeed puzzled.
Because Xue Ying’s actions were too quick. He first went to collect relevant intelligence, spending just a bit of time. After that, he went to enjoy some delicacies after killing ‘God Emperor Crane Pit’ before going over to Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master’s to collect the Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead! He then used the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique to rush over.
Heaven’s Will Pavilion was still investigating the recent death of God Emperor Crane Pit. they were still in the midst of discovering who the murderer was! Hence, Heaven’s Will Pavilion had not broadcast this news to the public.
“Crown Prince once mentioned that I can trade for that Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse using a piece of Dried Realm Leaf and a Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead, right?” Xue Ying asked.
“Right. This condition is non-negotiable. I cannot lower it further!” The Crown Prince nodded. He laughed, “Of course, you can always use some other treasures that are worth a few times more to exchange for it. I wouldn’t mind.”
Regardless of whether it is that Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse or the Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead, both were incredibly precious and rare items in the Divine Realm.
Something that was several times more valuable?
That would be an item that could greatly aid in the breakthrough to becoming a Grand Perfection God Emperor. It was impossible for the Divine Realm to form such precious items. These were instead, directly bestowed by the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods to the three Great Royal Clans. It was impossible for them to be sold outside.
“I have the Dried Realm Leaf and Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead prepared.” Xue Ying said.
Crown Prince was stunned.
He swept his gaze to his side. The two other girls immediately retreated, leaving behind just Xue Ying and the Crown Prince.
“You have prepared them?” The Crown Prince did not dare believe it. He even grasped the karmic ties to the three existences--Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master, Gold Feather City Master, and God Emperor Chun Yu since the three Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Beads in this Divine Realm were in the hands of them, ‘The karmic ties of the three seem fine. They are clearly still alive.’
‘Furthermore, he has just come to find me yesterday and today, he says he has them gathered? Unless he has already prepared the items beforehand?’ The Crown Prince pondered, ‘That’s right too. My conditions have been mentioned earlier to others who wanted to acquire the corpse of that Chaotic Origin Lifeform. He could possibly have heard it from others and have prepared beforehand. It’s just that the Dried Realm Leaf is something additional I wanted, and he spent just a day to prepare for it?’
‘The three of them are living perfectly fine!’
‘So he must have traded it with one of the three?’ The Crown Prince made his guesses.
In the opinion of Crown Prince, it Xue Ying did not kill and snatch the treasure of any of them, he must have naturally traded for it.
“Haha…” The Crown Prince laughed, “Brother Azure Cloud mentioned that you have them prepared. I wonder if it is possible for me to have a look?”
Xue Ying nodded. He waved his hand.
At that moment, the two treasures floated before him.
One was a seemingly dried up tree leaf that did not contain any life force. The veins on this leaf was incredibly clear. And it contained a faint special energy that revolves on top of this dried leaf.
The other was a golden bead with lightning moving on its surface. Within the bead, everything was gray and hard for others to perceive. The surface of the bead contained many inscriptions of laws, and it was the energy within that circulated along these law inscriptions to form the golden lightning. The energy inherent within felt incredibly vast and powerful.
As Xue Ying examined this Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead, he could not help but exclaim in admiration again. Because what was stored within the Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead is the vast and endless Chaotic Origin Energy! After being filtered through the bead, that Chaotic Origin Energy became golden lightning. It was truly mystical.
“Good!” The eyes of the Crown Prince brightened when he saw that. He became excited. He had desired the Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead for far too long.
“Admirable, admirable. Brother Azure Cloud actually has everything prepared so quickly.” The Crown Prince laughed. He flipped his hand before bringing out a storage treasure. Xue Ying extended his senses. That storage treasure did not hinder his senses as before. Looking at that meandering huge corpse lying in the Eden Treasure, Xue Ying could not help but grin.
“Then this transaction is done?” The Crown Prince laughed at Xue Ying.
“Naturally.” Xue Ying nodded.
The Crown Prince held on to the storage treasure while looking at those two floating precious items before Xue Ying with a smile. He did not say anything.
Xue Ying understood. He waved his hand, causing both the Dried Realm Leaf and Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead to fly over.
“Awesome!” The Crown Prince waved his hand. The moment he did so, he grabbed both the
Incoming Dried Realm Leaf and Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead. Following that, he looked at Xue Ying with a smile that did not seem like one.
“Crown Prince, what is the meaning of this?” Xue Ying’s expression fell.
When experts traded, if they were cultivators, they might perhaps be restricted by the oath. But to those who cultivated bloodline, it was hard for them to be restricted by oaths. One could only try to trade for it using the safest form of transaction.
“Hahahaha, Brother Azure Cloud, you actually trusted I, Iron Dragon Cloud Mountain, with such treasures?” The Crown Prince laughed, “What a pity. I could not even trust myself. Now that the treasures are in my hands, you should forget about getting it anymore.”
“So is this robbery?” Xue Ying stated.
“I am robbing your treasures, so what? I urge you to leave now. Nobody dares to be impudent against me in the Iron Dragon City.” The Crown Prince sneered. This was the Iron Dragon City! With the help of some arrays within the territory, he even dared to fight with Grand Perfection God Emperors. Furthermore, his father was ranked seventh in the God Emperor Ranking List. Even though it was despicable for him to greed after those treasures, who could handle him?
“Foolish!” Xue Ying’s eyes became cold.
“Hong!”
A terrifying illusory realm blasted down on the Crown Prince, hauling his soul directly into it.
TheCrown Prince only felt the world turning. His soul felt like it is sinking deeper and deeper. He struggled, yet he only felt his bodily feeling becoming blurred. He tried his best to maintain his consciousness: “Father, save me!” Under this slight consciousness, he barely sent a transmission to his father, the Iron Dragon City Master. He felt waves of pain in his soul, and under this intense pain, his soul was becoming weaker. For a moment, he could no longer retaliate. After that, he fell into oblivion.
He felt himself falling deeper, deeper, deeper…
He fell into that vast illusory realm which was filled enticement.
“Hu.” Xue Ying took a step before grabbing the fleshy body of the Crown Prince. Waving his hand, he immediately took all the treasures. Not just the Dried Realm Leaf or the Golden Lightning Chaotic Origin Bead, even all the treasures that the Crown Prince had were kept by Xue Ying, “You are simply too confident of yourself. Do you think nobody can deal against you even when you are in the Iron Dragon City?”
“Who dares to be impudent in my Iron Dragon Hall!”
A cold voice sounded. That simple gray-robed male’s figure blurred. He then appeared within the garden. At this moment, he stared at Xue Ying coldly, releasing a tremendous killing intent that felt like a tsunami.

chapters.title: Chapter 1314 - Battling against a Grand Perfection God Emperor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1314: Battling against a Grand Perfection God Emperor!
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Iron Dragon City Master felt both alarmed and very much indignant. He had never thought that his already Late Stage God Emperor eldest son, ‘Iron Dragon Cloud Mountain’, would seek his help in his own residence, only to be captured by the enemy within such a short period.
‘Furthermore, I did not sense any disturbances from a battle happening. It seems that everything has ended before they began fighting?’ Iron Dragon City Master did not dare believe it. He was originally in the residence. If a battle truly broke out, how could it be hidden from him?
“Iron Dragon City Master.” Xue Ying said.
“Who are you?” Iron Dragon City Master coldly demanded, “What exactly are you scheming against my son for?”
From how Iron Dragon City Master saw it, this must be a plot. Only then could the other party take down his Late Stage God Emperor son silently! And it seemed that the real target was him, Iron Dragon City Master, instead.
“Say! What do you want? Tell me everything.” Iron Dragon City Master coldly stated, “I warn you not to harm my son. Otherwise, I’ll absolutely not let you off.”
Xue Ying shook his head: “Iron Dragon City Master, I truly did not scheme against you son, and neither did I scheme against you! Everything is a consequence of what your son did.”
“Hmph.” Iron Dragon City Master coldly laughed, “Don’t say these. What do you want before you could let my son go?”
“Let him go? That’s fine too. Treasures worth 100,000 Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades.” Xue Ying stated the condition, “If you bring out this much treasures, I’ll let him off.”
This Crown Prince of Iron Dragon Hall had previously tried to snatch his treasures. Nonetheless, he did not harbor any thoughts of killing Xue Ying. Since that’s the case, Xue Ying naturally was willing to spare the life of this Crown Prince! It’s just that… even though he had taken all the treasures with the Crown Prince, this little treasures might perhaps make the heart of the Crown Prince ache but to ‘Iron Dragon City Master’, it was only a small part of what Iron Dragon City Master had!
Hence, Xue Ying planned on making the lot of them feel true heart ache!
“Treasures worth 100,000 Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades?” Iron Dragon City Master was slightly startled. Even though he felt his heart ache, he was shocked at how ‘low’ the demand of the other party was! He thought the other party might want some harsh demand like for instance, asking him, Iron Dragon City Master, to do certain tasks.
“Can you assure that you will let my son off after I give you the treasures?” Iron Dragon City Master growed.
“You do not have the choice.” Xue Ying answered.
Iron Dragon City Master gritted his teeth. Regardless, he still waved his hand and threw a storage wristband to Xue Ying. When Xue Ying received it, he extended his senses over and could not help but feel startled. Indeed, this was an expert ranked seventh on the God Emperor Ranking List. He had accumulated a lot of treasures. But most likely after adding what the Crown Prince had and these treasures worth 100,000 Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades… even Iron Dragon City Master would feel his bones hurting.
“Here you go.” Xue Ying casually threw over Iron Dragon Cloud Mountain.
When Iron Dragon City Master took over his son, his son began gradually waking up. Only then did Iron Dragon City Master heave a sigh of relief. He immediately kept his son into his Eden Treasure.
Only after that did Iron Dragon City Master turn to Xue Ying. His killing intent became more concentrated. He even had a strand of sneer by the edge of his mouth: “You are indeed daring. I thought you would release my son after escaping out of the city. Who would have thought that you would pass my son back directly within my Iron Dragon Hall? It seems you are quite confident of yourself.”
“That’s right. After my cultivation strength increased, I haven’t had the chance to fight with a Grand Perfection God Emperor.” Xue Ying chuckled, “Since I have an opportunity now, I would of course like to battle with Iron Dragon City Master.”
“Oh? Hahaha…” Hearing that, Iron Dragon City Master began guffawing. His voice caused the entire void to tremble just like thunder, “You dare to fight with me? Then I shall see how strong you are.”
The entire Iron Dragon Hall abruptly began surging like a gathering storm.
Many arrays began activating.
Countless lightning started swimming around the place, isolating the whole area. It was clear that Iron Dragon City Master did not wish to let the shockwave from the battle affect other parts of his residence.
“Come.” Iron Dragon City Master looked at Xue Ying. He felt disdain from using the arrays of the residence to suppress Xue Ying. At the same time, the body of Iron Dragon City Master started transforming. His robe disappeared, leaving behind black scales that covered his body. Scales started appearing on his face too, and two twisted horned began protruding out of his forehead. By his backbone, a six to seven meters long scaled tail emerged.
Both legs of Iron Dragon City Master started becoming thicker with the joints reversed.
Both his hands became sharp claws.
At this moment, Iron Dragon City Master was like a standing Dragon Beast! The scales on his body were covered in layers of energy--the inner layer consisted of colorless energy, with a blood-colored energy covering on the middle layer and an outer layer that produced screeching sounds. It constantly destroyed the surrounding void as the void naturally recovered as well. At this moment, the full-blown aura of Iron Dragon City Master had erupted, causing the surrounding world to tremble.
“It is rare even for Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform’s body to be as strong as yours, Iron Dragon City Master.” Xue Ying praised, “You deserve your reputation as the second strongest combatant in the Divine Realm.”
In terms of overall strength, Iron Dragon City Master was ranked seventh. But in terms of direct combat, he was ranked second, second only to Cloud Phoenix City Master.
“Don’t you want to spar with me? You even said that you have some successes in your cultivation and plan on fighting with me? But you know, choosing me is the most foolish decision you will ever make.” The moment Iron Dragon City Master finished speaking, even though he remained standing there, his tail had abruptly hurled out!
At the same time, this tail rapidly elongated.
This tyrannical energy suppressed the surrounding void, causing cracks to appear on those layers and reveal the golden lightning outside the membrane of this world!
This scaly tail had elongated and lashed out at Xue Ying. It was simply too wild and powerful, so much that Xue Ying was alarmed.
“Weng.”
With a thought, a terrifying illusory realm had descended upon Iron Dragon City Master.
Iron Dragon City Master only felt an enormous world hauling his soul forcefully. Since he could cultivate to where he stood, his soul and willpower was naturally extraordinary, allowing him to resist against the force. At the same time, this enormous world was also pounding out at his soul, causing him to feel waves of pain. It felt as if a blade was hacking on his soul. This feeling was incredibly unpleasant. He had to spend an absolute majority of his heart force to resist this soul attack, preventing him from using his full strength in dealing against that mysterious expert.
The original tail lash that was filled with power suddenly became much weaker. The technique was no longer as expertly executed as before.
“Peng.”
Xue Ying waved his right hand, causing many layers of space to appear before the tail lash. These layers easily resisted against that much cruder greatly weakened tail lash.
‘The Mirage and Illusory Realm third killing technique is amazing. Even the Late Stage God Emperor Crown Prince could barely maintain consciousness momentarily before he falling into it.’ Xue Ying thought.
Grand Emperors were one major level in itself.
The soul and willpower between God Emperors did not have too much of a difference. Back at Realm Heart Great Land, Xue Ying had used his Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique to deal against Middle Stage God Emperors (God Generals), and now, his Third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique had a qualitative difference. It became much stronger. Most Late Stage God Emperors would fall for it easily!
As for ‘Grand Perfection God Emperors’, from Xue Ying’s observation according to Iron Dragon City Master’s executed technique, his strength should have diminished by 70% - 80%.
‘What is this technique, this…’
Iron Dragon City Master felt alarmed and uneasy.
This was too unpleasant.
With his soul being tugged on by an enormous and vast world, he knew that the moment he fell into this world, he would be doomed. He had to use his entire strength to resist against it! And the remaining heart force would then be used to deal against the enemy. His control of his fleshy body had weakened too. His soul could not even control this powerful fleshy body of his perfectly, much less his executed techniques.
“Peng.” That white-robed male did not unsheathe his sword. Instead, that man slapped down on his claws.
This slap actually forced Iron Dragon City Master back a few steps with waves of energy tunneling into his body.
‘I have to augment my strength using the arrays.’ Iron Dragon City Master could no longer cared. Given his identity as a seventh ranker on the God Emperor Ranking List, previously, he felt disdain from controlling the array because ordinary arrays could not increase his strength greatly at his level. Even when he was in his territory, this array could not help him much. But at this moment, he couldn’t care less. Anything that could help him is something he would immediately use.
“Hong long long~” The arrays became activated. Some enveloped the body of Iron Dragon City Master, and some began suppressing on Xue Ying: ‘Not good, I can no longer control the arrays perfectly.’
An absolute majority of his heart force was spent on resisting the pull of that frightening illusory realm.
And the remaining heart force had to control his fleshy body in battling against the other party while controlling the array at the same time. The arrays of the Iron Dragon Hall were incredibly complex, yet now that his heart force was weakened, he could only control part of the arrays.
‘Where exactly did this expert appear? How did my son meet him?’ At this moment, Iron Dragon City Master felt anxious. He had never thought that he would actually fall into such predicament within his own residence.

chapters.title: Chapter 1315 - Lasting Ages
chapters.content:
Chapter 1315: Lasting Ages
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
‘What amazing strength.’ Even though Xue Ying held an absolute upper hand, he could feel how frightening Iron Dragon City Master was. Even though the other party’s combat techniques had become much cruder, his executed strength greatly weakened, and Xue Ying could prevent the enemy from touching him by relying on the profundity of his techniques--Xue Ying overwhelmed the other party, and he could attack the other party however he wanted!
But…
‘His body is too strong.’ When Xue Ying unsheathed the sharp sword on his back, just as he slashed his sword on the neck of Iron Dragon City Master, Iron Dragon City Master’s body was protected by the three layers of energy along with his scales. Furthermore, the outermost energy layer was constantly destroying the surrounding void. In the end, Xue Ying could only rely on some techniques that avoided the enemy’s external defenses, causing them to permeate directly into the body of the enemy.
