It was apparent that Xue Ying could not damage the scales of Iron Dragon City Master at all!
“Chi chi chi,” every time they clashed, the divine sword would tremble from the rebounding impact against the three unseen layers of energy on the body of Iron Dragon City Master.
‘Just this protective energy of his could heavily injure Late Stage God Emperors. Fortunately, I did not fight head-on against him.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
No matter what he did, using his palm or relying on his sword, Xue Ying executed his techniques using the Dao of Void. He forced Iron Dragon City Master to stumble backwards and fly like a sack. Nonetheless, the body of Iron Dragon City Master remained perfectly undamaged. His skin was perfectly fine as well. The internal organs of Iron Dragon City Master were so powerful that it reached a stage Xue Ying could not do any damage to!
…
Xue Ying felt that he could not ‘injure’ the other party.
But it was Iron Dragon City Master who felt sullen and awful.
His soul suffered from the pull of the immense world. He was constantly resisting against it with most of his strength, leaving behind just some of his heart force for battle. Furthermore, the techniques of this white-robed male before him were exquisite as well: ‘Damn, if only I could unleash 100% of my strength, I can easily break apart those techniques of his! But now, why do I feel that my fleshy body is incredibly heavy? And using any technique is so difficult?’
His body felt as heavy as a mountain. It was too clumsy.
Until now, he had not truly struck Xue Ying once!
‘I am being teased!’
‘Even with the help of the arrays, I am still being played around.’ Iron Dragon City Master felt sullen and startled at the same time. He was astonished how frightening this soul technique was! As for close combat? He did not really place it in his eyes since he could see that despite being a ‘target’ and struck around by the other party, the fundamental energy protecting his fleshy body remained fine.
Iron Dragon City Master was known as the second strongest close combatant in the Divine Realm primarily because of his terrifying fleshy body! As his heart force was affected, his strength became greatly weakened. Nonetheless, his fleshy body remained as strong as ever.
“Iron Dragon City Master is indeed amazing. Admirable. Truly admirable.” Xue Ying chuckled. Suddenly, he retreated. Waving his hand, a black crack formed beside him, “Farewell.”
Xue Ying took a step into the crack before disappearing from the place.
And the enormous world that pulled his soul disappeared after that. Only then did Iron Dragon City Master feel himself regaining his complete peak state. Looking at the merging black crack, he mumbled to himself: “Ultra-long distance teleportation? Such a terrifying soul technique yet he could still teleport through an ultra-long distance?”
Such enemies were too frightening.
By relying on his ultra-long distance teleportation, he could simply descend anywhere. With a soul technique, he could easily engulfed the entire residence. Other than Iron Dragon City Master who could still resist against it, the others within the residence would most likely fall prey to it!
‘Even I have to fork out much of my heart force to resist against it. If, if his soul technique is slightly stronger! I might perhaps fall into oblivion within that illusory realm?’ Iron Dragon City Master could not help but feel a chill down his spine. If his soul could not resist, then the fleshy body that he cultivated to such heaven-defying stages would be entirely useless!
‘The soul is the root.’
‘When did such a terrifying soul expert appear in the Divine Realm? If he improved further, he would be able to sweep across all God Emperors just by relying on his soul technique.’ Iron Dragon City Master felt his heart tremble.
Even until now, the other party’s strength did not seem to be any weaker!
Iron Dragon City Master looked at the damaged structures around him. Those were some of the walls that had been damaged in the battle previously. The City Master waved his hand, causing the Crown Prince of Iron Dragon Hall, ‘Iron Dragon Cloud Mountain’ to appear. The black-robed Iron Dragon Cloud Mountain looked around him. He found that it was in a damaged state. The arrays above were even in an operating state. It was clear that the arrays of the entire Iron Dragon Hall had been activated.
“Father, have you captured him?” Iron Dragon Cloud Mountain immediately asked.
“Captured him?” Iron Dragon City Master looked at him coldly, “Tell me, who is he? How did you meet him? Tell me everything right from the start.”
Iron Dragon Cloud Mountain saw the cold look on his father. He could not help but feel a shiver down his spine. Iron Dragon Cloud Mountain obediently began describing: “It’s like that. Yesterday, that God Emperor who called himself Azure Cloud came to find me. He wished to purchase that Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse…” Iron Dragon Cloud Mountain did not dare to hide anything. He told his father every single thing that happened.
“… Since I am at the Iron Dragon Hall, I dare to fight even a Grand Perfection God Emperor. Furthermore, Father is around too. He had foolishly given his treasures to me. Hence, it is natural that I became greedy…”
“And this is what happened!”
Iron Dragon Cloud Mountain finished his explanation.
Iron Dragon City Master was speechless. The other party took the initiative to come and trade with him, yet his son greed over the treasures of the other party.
“The foolish one is you!” Iron Dragon City Master was so angry that he did not say anything. He could see that the temper of this mysterious expert ‘God Emperor Azure Cloud’ is good. He was not a selfish or ruthless kind of person. Otherwise, he would have simply killed his son without suggesting a trade before stealing the treasure away.
“It’s I who is foolish. But Father, where is he?” The Crown Prince continued asking the question.
“Your father, I have almost been reaped in his hands.” Iron Dragon City Master coldly said, “Even after exerting my full strength, I am still on the disadvantaged end!”
“On the disadvantaged end?” The Crown Prince was stunned.
“He then executed an ultra-long distance teleportation technique before leaving.” Iron Dragon City Master said coldly, “With such frightening strength and frightening soul technique, he even knows how to teleport through an ultra-long distance… you actually provoked such an expert? I truly admire you.”
“Father, I am wrong! I am wrong!” The Crown Prince answered. He felt helpless. Originally, he thought he had everything under his control. Who would have guessed such a terrifying expert would appear.
“Also, remember this! You must never leak this matter out.” Iron Dragon City Master coldly ordered, “You are forbidden to leak out anything related to this God Emperor Azure Cloud.”
The Crown Prince immediately added, “Rest assured, Father. I’ll absolutely not leak anything out. This time, my Iron Dragon Hall have suffered huge losses. All the treasures I have with me are taken away! How can I leak out such precious information? Hmph hmph, I believe not too long from now, there will similarly be other experts who would fall in the hands of this God Emperor Azure Cloud.”
Iron Dragon City Master glanced at him: “Not just your treasures, for the sake of your little life, I was forced to fork out treasures worth 100,000 Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades.”
“Ah.” The Crown Prince was stunned.
That was an incredible loss!
He felt heart ached when he woke up to his treasures missing. Who would have thought that the other party would ruthlessly slaughter the wealth of his father too.
“If I had known about this, wouldn’t it be better if I obediently traded with him?” The Crown Prince felt a pang of regret.
“It is lucky that you could live on. If you were to encounter those that were more ruthless, they would have killed you.” Iron Dragon City Master coldly said.
Crown Prince nodded.
That’s right. The other party could suppress even his father. Naturally, they would not be afraid of their Iron Dragon City.
…
Even though this battle represented an exchange between two peak experts in the Divine Realm, Iron Dragon City Master had completely kept it a secret! Actually, he had already controlled the arrays to isolate everything when they fought. They prevented other people within the residence from finding out about this battle. Since the enemy could rapidly capture his son, Iron Dragon City Master understood how frightening such an enemy was.
Not all battles at this level were appropriate to be publicized, especially when God Emperor Azure Cloud could possibly be ‘disguising his identity’ too.
******
Xue Ying returned back to the High Mountain City.
This battle also gave Xue Ying a newfound realization. Even though he had a Middle Stage God Emperor Dao of Void strength that enabled him to fight with Late Stage God Emperors, his offensive strength was comparatively too weak. He only relied on the profoundness of his techniques to fight with Late Stage God Emperors. If he encountered ‘Grand Perfection God Emperors’, even if the other party was greatly weakened, Xue Ying could not harm them even as they stood there.
Of course, his Third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm Technique was heaven-defying too! It even weakened the strength of someone so powerful like Iron Dragon City Master--reaching a level that Xue Ying could easily make fun of the other party.
‘If my Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm was to improve by another level! Then even with the soul and willpower of a Grand Perfection God Emperor, they would not be able to resist against it.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘I should be able to sweep across everyone below the level of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform!’
He truly looked forward to the day he reached the final realm in his Mirage and Illusory Realm!
‘I should continue deepening my understanding of the Dao of Void too.’
Xue Ying planned on moving ahead on both Daos.
This time, he had acquired the corpse of a Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform, giving Xue Ying lots of hope and expectations for the days ahead.
…
Time passed.
Even though both ‘Iron Dragon City Master’, ‘Cloud Phoenix City Master’ and ‘Fire Phoenix God Emperor’, these three Grand Perfection God Emperors knew of the emergence of a powerful soul expert in the Divine Realm and were looking forward to the day this mysterious expert acted again, they became sullen after realizing that nothing of such sort happened. This mysterious expert seemed to have disappeared from the world. Xue Ying, was indeed someone who held no interest in the competition of this world. Currently, he was madly engrossed in his research of that Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse.
Time passed quickly. The world continued changing along. It had been 300 trillion years. Another new generation had risen in this world again. Of course, the Grand Perfection God Emperors that stood at the peak of remained the same.

chapters.title: Chapter 1316 - Great Emperor North River’s Plot
chapters.content:
Chapter 1316: Great Emperor North River’s Plot
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Deep within the Great Wilderness, there was a continuous chain of mountain that had existed for trillions of years.
At this moment.
The entire mountain range trembled lightly. Every part of this enormous mountain range was shaking.
“Hong.”
All of a sudden, an even more intense tremble coursed through the mountain range.
A dazzling light appeared, illuminating the entire mountain range in a single instance. At the next moment, the entire mountain range disappeared, turning into powder. Only after that did the light disappear, revealing a figure that floated at the center. He wore green, and his aura felt so vast it made the world shake. He was none other than Great Emperor North River who just came out from his bitter closed-door cultivation.
“Hahaha, hahaha…” North River guffawed. His laughter brought thunder to the world. He was currently laughing unbridledly.
“Finally, finally, I’ve finally achieved this step.” Both eyes of Great Emperor North River were filled with excitement, “At my hometown, we call this the Grand Perfection Emperor Realm, otherwise known as the Supreme Realm! The Natives here call it Grand Perfection God Emperor! That’s right, Grand Perfection! The energy of my fleshy body has theoretically reached absolute perfection; I am currently also able to unleash my bloodline energy to its maximum efficiency.”
Indeed, it was a pinnacle.
If he wanted to attain the ‘Ultimate Awakening’, he would have to break this limit! Jump out of the cage and become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. But clearly, achieving this was much harder than breaking through from the ‘Late Stage God Emperor’ (Great Emperor Realm) to the Grand Perfection God Emperor Realm.
‘My goal of coming to this world has been met now that I am a Grand Perfection God Emperor.’ North River calmed down. His aura also started gradually weakening until it was completely concealed. One could feel nothing from him at all. This was what Grand Perfection God Emperor represented! He had a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body, which meant that his control of his body had already reached the pinnacle.
‘This world is no longer useful to me! It’s about time to head to the next world.’ Great Emperor North River looked down at his wristband. On this wristband was a blood-colored imprint, ‘I reckon that the new world would be more interesting.’
Yuan arranged for three worlds.
He believed that the later worlds would be more formidable!
‘But before I leave, there is a person that I have to eliminate. Otherwise, he would definitely interfere with my affairs during crucial moments. That’ll be troublesome.’ The eyes of Great Emperor North River were filled with coldness, ‘Ying Shan Xue Ying. I left the Broken Teeth Mountain Range and you followed soon after that. How can my path of cultivation be obstructed by you!’
He guessed that Xue Ying would likely follow suit after he headed to the other two worlds! Since that’s the case, he would take this chance to eliminate Xue Ying in this world as it no longer held any usefulness to him.
‘Let’s have a look at the intelligence of Heaven’s Will Pavilion.’
‘Mn, Ying Shan Xue Ying is quite low-profile. Ever since he arrived in this world, he has remained in that High Mountain City.’ Great Emperor North River laughed coldly. He had already paid the advance payment. Every single report related to God Emperor Flying Snow gathered by the Heaven’s Will Pavilion would be reported to him.
‘Since he is always at the High Mountain City… then I’ll have to prepare thoroughly. The moment I act will be the moment he dies.’ Great Emperor North River pondered, ‘Even though I have reached the Grand Perfection God Emperor Realm, I doubt it’ll be enough to kill him.’
Deducing from the intelligence.
This Xue Ying should have reached the Middle Stage God Emperor Realm in his Dao of Void. Being a cultivator of the laws and profound mysteries, his strength was sufficient to fight against Late Stage God Emperors (Great Emperors)! In addition to his terrifying soul technique… he could even fight with Grand Perfection God Emperor.
‘I have to find help.’ Great Emperor North River immediately turned into a stream of light. He then rapidly disappeared by the horizon.
No other choice. In this world, Great Emperor North River could only fly slowly!
Great Emperor North River had once wandered into the Realm Heart Great Land and climbed up step by step. He even became the fastest cultivator to reach the Great Emperor Realm in the history of Broken Teeth Mountain Range! Naturally, he had the skills. 20 trillion years after he broke through to the Grand Perfection God Emperor Realm…
“Sou.”
A silver white flying ship flew past. This flying ship was equipped with three pairs of bizarre wings that enabled it to fly at top speed amidst the clouds.
On the flying ship.
There were three experts seated. They were drinking wine and chatting.
Of these three, one was naturally the green-robed ‘Great Emperor North River’. Another had an enormous blood cape behind him. This was a crimson-skinned single-horned male. Both his eyes were blood red in color. Even though he had concealed his aura, his gaze could cause most God Emperors to feel terror. The final person was a green-robed green-browed old man.
If experts from the outside world were to see these three, they would be stunned.
Because this crimson-skinned single-horned male was ‘Specter Religion Master’, a frightening expert ranked ninth in the God Emperor Ranking List! Anything goes when he did things. Speaking from a certain perspective, the degree of threat from him was beyond that of the ‘seventh ranked’ Iron Dragon City Master because the flying speed of Specter Religion Master was ranked second. This terrifying speed sufficed to give him the power to tyrannize others.
That green-robed green-browed old man was also ranked fifteen on the God Emperor Ranking List, ‘Wise Wizard City Master’.
There were over 30 Grand Perfection God Emperors, and for him to be ranked fifteen proved the strength of Wise Wizard City Master.
“Specter, does this person who calls himself North River qualified to work together with the two of us?” The green-robed green-browed old man glanced at Great Emperor North River.
“Hahaha.” Specter Religion Master’s laughter was ear-piercing. He swept his gaze across Great Emperor North River and grinned, “Wise Wizard, if you don’t believe me, you can try it personally. But if you were to suffer from a loss by then, don’t blame me for not warning you.”
“Suffer from a loss?” Wise Wizard City Master was startled.
“I’ve fought with Brother North River before. He isn’t any weaker than me.” Specter Religion Master said.
When Wise Wizard City Master heard that, he nodded slightly: “Make sure you all remember your promise.”
“Rest assured.” Great Emperor North River nodded, “After killing that God Emperor Flying Snow, his treasures will be yours. If it doesn’t add up to a total of 100,000 Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades, I’ll make up for the deficiency.”
“Alright.” Wise Wizard City Master nodded.
“Rest assured. Since this person could make Brother North River so careful, asking the three of us work together to deal against him… he would most likely have quite a lot of treasures. By then, everything will belong to you.” Specter Religion Master grinned. As for he, he had already gotten what he needed from Great Emperor North River. Of course, he was only given half of that. The remaining half would be given once the mission succeeded.
“I don’t care who he is. With the three of us working together, it is possible to kill a Grand Perfection God Emperor.” Wise Wizard City Master was fully confident.
Three Grand Perfection God Emperors working together.
Their rankings were relatively near the top. More importantly, the reason Great Emperor North River selected the two of them… was because all three could coordinate perfectly! With three Grand Perfection God Emperors coordinating together perfectly, their strength would stack up, giving rise to a multiplier effect that was better than seven to eight Grand Perfection God Emperors coordinating badly together.
‘I must succeed in one fell swoop. Ying Shan Xue Ying, you can only blame yourself for obstructing my path of cultivation.’ Great Emperor North River was filled with rising killing intent. He did not wish to be pulled back by Xue Ying in all three consecutive worlds. He was clear that as long as the other party had the chance… Xue Ying would not hesitate to kill him.
Since that’s the case, it would be better to nib the disaster right at its bud!
******
High Mountain City.
Ever since Xue Ying chose to stay here, this peaceful city became safer. Ever since Devil Heart Cultist Master fell, there were no longer any rise of huge waves. After all, an expert with the combat strength of a ‘Late Stage God Emperor’ was sufficiently intimidating to others.
“Hu~”
The wind blew, causing part of the branches to fall.
“Teacher, this is a wine my clan’s caravan collected from another city. It is also the one I like the most. Teacher, come and have a taste too!” Imperial Wind Qing Yin took the initiative to pour wine for his teacher. She looked at Xue Ying expectantly.
Xue Ying picked up the cup. After tasting it, he felt his body quivering and his mind buzzing.
“What is this wine?” Xue Ying blinked.
“Doesn’t it feel great?” The eyes of Imperial Wind Qing Yin brightened. She immediately added, “Firstly, it feels like frosty water being poured on my head. After that, my entire body feels like it is fleeting. Even my soul feels light. This taste is truly extraordinary. This wine could only be drank by a God Monarch. Those who are weaker could not withstand it. I like this wine the most.”
“Like?” Xue Ying licked his lips. His fleshy body was much stronger than this female disciple of his. Even after swallowing this wine down, he only felt a prickling sensation in his mind. As for the supposed fleeting soul feeling? Given how strong and powerful his soul was, it was hard for this wine to cause his soul to float.

chapters.title: Chapter 1317 - Arrival of the Enemy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1317: Arrival of the Enemy
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“You don’t like it?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin seemed crestfallen.
“It is quite nice, just that it doesn’t suit my liking.” Xue Ying chuckled before placing down the cup.
“Oh.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin flipped her hand, causing another flask of wine to appear, “I still have more. Teacher, try this.”
This female disciple conscientiously collected many different flasks of wine, and was currently bringing them out for his teacher to taste.
In the end, Xue Ying gladfully accepted three types. And Imperial Wind Qing Yin joyfully sent over many flasks of those wines because she had prepared plenty of each of those wines.
“Let’s not talk about wine anymore. How is your cultivation? Why are you still a Peak Stage God Monarch? What issues have you encountered that stopped you from breaking through?” Xue Ying asked.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin felt awkward at that moment.
At that time when Xue Ying returned from the Iron Dragon City, he had very soon given that Dried Realm Leaf to his female disciple. This ‘Dried Realm Leaf’ was a treasure meant to assist those in bloodline cultivation. It was incredibly effective. Even the Crown Prince of Iron Dragon Hall deliberately asked for it clearly preparing it for his children. After Xue Ying gave it to his female disciple, her cultivation naturally flew. In addition, Xue Ying frequently rewarded his female disciple with other treasures.
After all, he had killed God Emperor Crane Pit and three God Emperors under Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master.
He even swept clean the treasures that Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master had, plundering the Crown Prince of Iron Dragon Hall and extorted treasures worth 100,000 Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades from Iron Dragon City Master. Actually, the majority of these treasures were useless to his cultivation. And the best ones were left for Late Stage God Emperors and Grand Perfection God Emperors to use. Xue Ying naturally did not bestow them to his female disciple.
Ultimately, his female disciple was still a God Monarch! If Xue Ying were to give her something too valuable, it might possibly incur some disaster.
The Dried Realm Leaf was considered the most precious item. The other miscellaneous treasures were not that expensive. But there was so much of them that they added up to a value of more than 10,000 Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades. And most of them were treasures meant to help Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master in his cultivation.
“I feel that I am about to break through soon.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin said.
“Hmph. Why have I heard that your elder brother, Imperial Wind Lei, broke through to Middle Stage God Emperor after I came out from my closed-door cultivation?” Xue Ying asked, “Have you gave some treasures to your elder brother?”
The Imperial Wind Clan’s ‘Imperial Wind Lei’ was incredibly talented.
Before Xue Ying came, Imperial Wind Lei was the strongest Peak Stage God Monarch. And after breaking through to the Early Stage God Emperor Realm, his strength could even suppress his father, ‘Imperial Wind High Mountain’. This time when Xue Ying came out of cultivation, he received the news that Imperial Wind Lei had broken through to the Middle Stage God Emperor Realm.
“No, no, that’s not it.”
Imperial Wind Qing Yin was so frightened by that, that she began explaining, “Teacher, here you see, the treasures are still with me.” Saying that, a storage wristband appeared on her wrist.
Xue Ying swept across with his gaze. His consciousness permeated into the wristband. The Dried Realm Leaf was still around! And the majority of the other treasures was left untouched.
“Treasures are meant for you to use! If you don’t, how are you going to breakthrough?” Xue Ying frowned, “In the upcoming 100 million years, you must use at least 10% of these treasures! Hurry up and make your breakthrough to the Early Stage God Emperor Realm.”
Early Stage God Emperor Realm…
To most Natives of the Divine Realm that cultivated in their bloodline energy, if they had sufficient treasures with an alright comprehension ability, it was still possible to reach this stage.
Like the Iron Dragon City Master for instance, he had nurtured all his children to the God Emperor Realm.
Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master as someone who disliked cultivation and only enjoyed pleasure, was still nurtured to the Middle Stage God Emperor Realm.
“Yes, yes.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin obediently acknowledged. She heaved a sigh of relief inwardly.
She had indeed passed some of the miraculous treasures to her elder brother ‘Imperial Wind Lei’. After he used it, in addition to his close to 300 trillion years worth of accumulation, enabled him to breakthrough to the Middle Stage God Emperor Realm.
And when her elder brother went into closed-door cultivation, Imperial Wind Qing Yin even lent the ‘Dried Realm Leaf’ temporarily to him! This sibling relationship between them had formed over long years and she trusted her elder brother very much.
And indeed, her elder brother Imperial Wind Lei had broken through to the Middle Stage God Emperor Realm. After he broke through, he passed the Dried Realm Leaf back to his little sister. Treasures like Dried Realm Leaf were very helpful to the weak. The stronger one was, the less helpful it would be. Once a cultivator reached the Middle Stage God Emperor Realm, this treasure would no longer be helpful.
‘I’ll wait until Qing Yin broke through to the God Emperor Realm. By then, I can leave this world as well.’ Xue Ying thought.
He had received the Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse. After that, this world was no longer attractive to him any longer. At the most, before he left, he would have a spar with the number one expert in Divine Realm, ‘Cloud Phoenix City Master’! There was also the cultivation scripture written by the strongest Dao of Void Ascendant. Xue Ying hoped to conduct a trade with him. Once this was done, it would be time for him to leave.
In this world…
The only person Xue Ying cared about was this female disciple of his. After all, she took him as her teacher. Hence, Xue Ying had to arrange everything properly. He had guessed that this female disciple had given some treasures to her elder brother ‘Imperial Wind Lei’ to use. Because there were some treasures among those that he gave, were very helpful to Early Stage God Emperor Realm.
‘That’s fine too. It would be helpful if her elder brother is stronger.’ Xue Ying thought.
Right as Xue Ying was enjoying his wine and understanding more about the cultivation of his disciple, suddenly--
“Weng~”
The entire High Mountain City let out a ripple.
For a moment, every single section of the High Mountain City boomed. Some structures even collapsed because of that.
“What is going on?”
“This ripple…”
The entire High Mountain City was completely riled up. Many Natives of the Divine Realm looked upwards. That terrifying ripple had just shook the entire world within High Mountain City! It felt as if the entire High Mountain City might be destroyed at any single time.
“Mn?” Xue Ying frowned. He immediately stood up.
“Teacher, what happened outside?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin was slightly panicked.
“Don’t worry.” Xue Ying said. He brought his disciple out of the house. Both of them stood in the corridor and looked out at the vast sky. With a glance, he easily saw that figure glowing in a blood aura standing in midair. This glance made the expression of Xue Ying change.
‘It’s him? The Ninth Ranker on the God Emperor Ranking List, Specter Religion Master? Why has he come to High Mountain City?’ Xue Ying was both startled and puzzled.
Being an outsider who descended into this world, the number of people he became enemies with could be counted with one’s fingers.
There should be no association between him and Specter Religion Master!
Then…
Why did Specter Religion Master come to High Mountain City? Furthermore, it was clear he did not come with kind intentions!
…
At this moment.
Specter Religion Master stood above High Mountain City. He emitted an unseen aura that caused the entire world to tremble. Every single part beneath him within the High Mountain City trembled, causing much of its structure to collapse. Some structures that were supported with arrays resisted against the impact. Many Natives of the Divine Realm paled. Because that aura gave them a feeling of suppression and terror.
Grand Perfection God Emperor! This represented the highest level of life within the Divine Realm! With a thought, they could easily cause the entire region spanning half a million kilometers to turn into ruins! How would the citizen from High Mountain City not feel afraid from that?
“It’s Specter Religion Master.”
“Specter Religion Master.”
That enormous crimson-skinned figure who had a blood cape behind him, a twisted horn and blood eyes looked downwards. This figure of Specter Religion Master was something unique amongst the Grand Perfection God Emperors.
Many experts within High Mountain City recognized this figure.
And it was because they recognized him that made them feel uneasy!
Ninth Ranker on the God Emperor Ranking List?
Such an expert had never visited the High Mountain City before.
‘Why would he come to the High Mountain City?’ That ‘Xing Pavilion Master’ from High Mountain City’s Heaven’s Will Pavilion felt uneasy. He immediately reported upwards.
“Sou! Sou!”
Two figures flew out from the Imperial Wind Clan Residence. They were none other than the incarnations of Imperial Wind High Mountain and Imperial Wind Lei. The two of them did not feel safe. The reputation of Specter Religion Master had fiercely struck the two of them, so much so that they did not dare go out personally with their true bodies. They might easily be killed with a flip of the hand by Specter Religion Master.
“It is the honor of our High Mountain City to grace the presence of Specter Religion Master.” Imperial Wind High Mountain bowed respectfully, “This one is the High Mountain City Master. I wonder if there is a reason why Specter Religion Master come to our High Mountain City? If there is anything you need us to do, my Imperial Wind Clan will definitely do our best.”
“It is natural that I have something to do.”
Specter Religion Master grinned. He swept his gaze across the entire High Mountain City before landing at a particular corridor within Flying Snow Residence--that white-robed young man who stood beside Imperial Wind Qing Yin.
At this moment.
The entire High Mountain City was quiet. Even those infants did not dare to cry under this soul suppression. Many Natives of the Divine Realm even looked up at ‘Specter Religion Master’ who was currently releasing waves of blood energy.
“God Emperor Flying Snow, get yourself here and die for me!” Specter Religion Master shouted. His voice rumbled like lightning, causing explosions across every single area in the city. Some of the weaker Natives fell down onto the ground powerlessly as they tried to block off the sound; many even bled from their ears.
“God Emperor Flying Snow?” Imperial Wind High Mountain and Imperial Wind Lei who were both respectfully waiting for orders, paled when they heard that.

chapters.title: Chapter 1318 - Battling against Specter Religion Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 1318: Battling against Specter Religion Master
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Disaster!
Who did not know that his Imperial Wind Clan was tied with ‘God Emperor Flying Snow’? In the past, God Emperor Flying Snow stood out and resolved a huge issue for his Imperial Wind Clan by eliminating a huge enemy--Devil Heart Cultist Master. Furthermore, the Third Lady of Imperial Wind Clan, ‘Imperial Wind Qing Yin’, was even the disciple of God Emperor Flying Snow. God Emperor Flying Snow had also been living in seclusion within High Mountain City. Various sects in the entire Divine Realm would have most likely treated the Imperial Wind Clan as being part of God Emperor Flying Snow’s sect.
‘Would he implicate our Imperial Wind Clan?’ Imperial Wind High Mountain and Imperial Wind Lei both felt uneasy.
“Specter Religion Master came to the High Mountain City just to deal with God Emperor Flying Snow?”
“He wants God Emperor Flying Snow to die?”
Many experts within High Mountain City held their breaths.
And Specter Religion Master remained looking downwards at that white-robed young figure standing above the corridor within the Flying Snow Residence.
“Teacher, Teacher, what is happening? This, why would he…” Imperial Wind Qing Yin panicked, “What should we do? Should we think of ways to escape?”
Over the years, she could feel how great her teacher treated her. He had given her many treasures, and she even treated him as her closest relative. But now, the enemy was actually a Grand Perfection God Emperor! And he was ranked ninth on the God Emperor Ranking List! That was a terrifying existence that stood at the highest peak across the entire Divine Realm. How could Imperial Wind Qing Yin not feel fear from it?
She was afraid that her teacher would die!
“Qing Yin, don’t be afraid.” Xue Ying chuckled. He then turned around and looked up at Specter Religion Master. Taking a step, his figure turned illusory. His current realm had reached a more profound realm, and Xue Ying perfected the Void Devil Insect Body Technique even further. Taking a step, a string of illusions was left behind and Xue Ying had already arrived before Specter Religion Master.
“Specter Religion Master.” Xue Ying asked with bewilderment, “I’ve heard of your name. It’s just that I have always been living in High Mountain City, focusing entirely on cultivating without participating in any battles outside in the Divine Realm. Before this, I have never met you before, Specter Religion Master. So dare I ask why Specter Religion Master came to the High Mountain City just to kill me?”
“You still have the gall to act? My disciple Qu Chen has died. And I’ve investigated that he died in your hands.” The blood-colored eyes of Specter Religion Master were filled with killing intent, “And even until now, you are still acting ignorant of this fact?”
“Your disciple, Qu Chen?” Xue Ying was stunned.
Specter Religion Master was a famous great devil. He even started a religion of his own! And he had a total of 103 personal disciples!
The demands Specter Religion Master had of his disciples were harsh. If his disciples fell when they were adventuring outside, to Specter Religion Master, this represented that the disciple was weak, and he did not care about it. Currently, more than half his disciples had fallen, so why would he suddenly kill his way here for one disciple?
“Are you mistaken?” Xue Ying frowned.
“I am not wrong. The murderer is you! Hmph hmph, God Emperor Flying Snow, you dare to kill my disciple, Qu Chen, yet you don’t have the guts to admit it?” The killing intent of Specter Religion Master became denser. He stared thoroughly at Xue Ying and seemed to be ready to act at any time.
Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
He had never done it.
Furthermore, given his current realm, it was impossible for the other party to trace through karmic ties to him! In addition, Specter Religion Master did not care about the life and death of his disciples before. This time, the other party cared so much about this fact and even threw the blame onto him… showed that Specter Religion Master was deliberately doing this!
“Specter Religion Master, since you are going to attack me, then less rubbish. Just do it!” Xue Ying coldly stated, “Finding some lame excuses will only make me look down on you.”
Specter Religion Master was startled. He then grinned after that: “Haha, interesting, interesting! Then I shall--”
“Less nonsense!”
Xue Ying extended his hand. A black spear appeared within it.
“Hong!”
He grabbed hold of the spear with both his hands before hacking down fiercely on the other party.
…
“What? They began fighting just like that?”
“It seems God Emperor Flying Snow is the one who took the initiative to attack?”
The spectating experts across High Mountain City were greatly astonished. In their opinion, this was a Grand Perfection God Emperor, ‘Specter Religion Master’! When one met such a huge expert, one should know how to explain and even present treasures to see if he could resolve any enmities. Otherwise, one should think of ways to escape too! When in the world would one speak two sentences before striking out against a Grand Perfection God Emperor?
“Weng~” Arrays started appearing above the High Mountain City, completely engulfing around the city.
Xue Ying and Specter Religion Master were currently both above the city.
Controlling the arrays, Imperial Wind Lei and Imperial Wind High Mountain exchanged glances.
“Ai, initially, I wanted to hold on to this powerful influence, God Emperor Flying Snow, so that my Imperial Wind Clan could gain more benefits. During these years, we have indeed benefited from this relationship. Even you, Lei’er, has borrowed on the treasures given to Qing Yin to reach the Middle Stage God Emperor Realm.” Imperial Wind High Mountain shook his head, “Who would have thought that such a huge calamity would arrive without any warning. I wonder why Specter Religion Master wants to kill God Emperor Flying Snow? If this affair implicates our Imperial Wind Clan, it is futile for our Imperial Wind Clan to resist against him.”
One move was all it needed to turn the entire High Mountain City into powder! Under such technique spanning across a huge region, only the Middle Stage God Emperor Imperial Wind Lei could barely survive. By then, Specter Religion Master could send another move out and Imperial Wind Lei would die without question.
“God Emperor Flying Snow has always been staying in the High Mountain City. He should not have any animosity with Specter Religion Master.” Imperial Wind Lei worriedly added.
“Who knows! Perhaps he might have had some past dealings with Specter Religion Master prior to coming to High Mountain City.” Imperial Wind High Mountain felt very uneasy. They recognized that God Emperor Flying Snow had always been hiding his strength. Before coming to the High Mountain City, God Emperor Flying Snow should have such a terrifying strength already. It was impossible for one to improve so quickly. He was initially an Early Stage God Monarch, and after a few days of coming to High Mountain City, he had the strength to deal with the Peak Stage God Monarch ‘Bat Mountain Master’. Eight million years later, he had the capabilities to slay Devil Heart Cultist Master?
Hence, they judged that the other party must have hidden his strength since the start.
In reality, Xue Ying had indeed improved quickly earlier on as he regained his strength after obtaining the ‘cultivation scriptures’.
“Ninth on the God Emperor Ranking List.” Imperial Wind High Mountain’s expression turned pale.
He was not confident about God Emperor Flying Snow at all.
“Hong hong hong~”
Both parties fought at an incredibly fast speed. Xue Ying even controlled the void to reduce the amount of shockwaves affecting High Mountain City.
Even though High Mountain City was currently maintaining their arrays, under the remnant force formed from the battle with ‘Specter Religion Master’, it would easily break apart the arrays!
This battle was too chaotic that those below could not see what was happening.
Imperial Wind High Mountain, Imperial Wind Lei, Xing Pavilion Master, Bat Mountain Master and other experts were anxiously watching. They only saw layers and layers of shockwaves formed from the battle.
“Hong~”
Just like a huge ice piece, an enormous space floated in the air. That ‘ice piece’ also trapped Specter Religion Master within it, and it was exerting pressing down onto itself with more and more force.
And at the next moment, Specter Religion Master trampled with his right leg. His right leg thickened by an entire diameter, and once it stepped down, the enormous ‘ice piece’ vibrated and rapidly cracked.
“Xiu xiu xiu…” Xue Ying flew up once again. He sent out consecutive strikes with his spear.
Every single spear shadow formed a dark void maelstrom. This maelstrom engulfed and pulled Specter Religion Master in. At the center of the maelstrom was crazy meat-grinder that caused everything to turn into darkness!
For a moment, several hundred black void maelstroms formed in midair. As they revolved, an even bigger maelstrom formed as a result. And this maelstrom was pulling on Specter Religion Master constantly. The frightening speed of Specter Religion Master could not be exhibited in this environment, especially when the maelstrom merged together to form a bigger one. The crimson skin of his started cracking apart, revealing the red muscles beneath it. Even though his muscles were tough, a wound still formed in the end, causing droplets of blood to fall onto the dark void maelstrom before being ground into nothing.
“We can see it.”
Ever since the disappearance of the enormous ‘ice piece’ suppression, many experts in High Mountain City could see the battle happening above.
When several hundred dark void maelstroms engulfed around Specter Religion Master, they were all stunned.
“What, Specter Religion Master is injured?”
“This, this…”
“Specter Religion Master is actually injured?”
When they saw the droplets of blood spurting out, the experts in High Mountain City were stunned. Even ‘Imperial Wind Lei’ and ‘Imperial Wind High Mountain’ who initially held no confidence for Xue Ying were shocked by the outcome.
What was happening?
God Emperor Flying Snow did not seem to be disadvantaged on his fight with Specter Religion Master? This was a Grand Perfection God Emperor! Someone ranked ninth on the God Emperor Ranking List!

chapters.title: Chapter 1319 - The Final Outcome
chapters.content:
Chapter 1319: The Final Outcome
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Xing Pavilion Master from High Mountain City’s Heaven’s Will Pavilion watched nervously. He held onto a scripture and recorded the scene of the battle. At the same time, he mumbled to himself with great shock: “No wonder. No wonder God Emperor Flying Snow did not ask for mercy or present any treasures to dissolve any enmity after speaking two sentences. Instead, he took the initiative to strike. So it seems he isn’t any weaker than Specter Religion Master!”
‘Two Grand Perfection God Emperors are fighting! I, Xing Yi, am actually qualified to record the battle between two Grand Perfection God Emperors?’ Xing Pavilion Master felt as if everything was dream-like. He was merely responsible for the Heaven’s Will Pavilion in a small remote city like High Mountain City. In the entire Divine Realm across many of its Heaven’s Will Pavilions, he was considered one of the lowest ranking Heaven’s Will Pavilion’s Pavilion Master.
Yet in reality, he was at this moment recording a battle at this high level.
‘Grand Perfection God Emperor? That damned Tie Cheng Liu.’ Bat Mountain Master watched at that frightening battle happening above. That terrifying dark void maelstrom was currently engulfing Specter Religion Master. Any casual shockwave from that attack could easily snuff out the life of he, Bat Mountain Master!
In the past, he, Bat Mountain, actually dared to send three God Monarchs to assassinate this expert?
‘Fortunately, God Emperor Flying Snow is magnanimous and forgiving.’ Bat Mountain Master thought.
Yet he did not know.
That in past when Xue Ying came, his strength had not recovered. If he wanted to attack Bat Mountain, he would have to rely on his soul technique. Furthermore, being an outsider of this world, Xue Ying was not willing to reveal his soul technique. But now with his current strength, Xue Ying could easily exterminate Bat Mountain Master with a flip of his hand. It’s just that in the past, he did not do so. After which, Bat Mountain Master actually made amends with him. All these years, Bat Mountain Master fawned on the Flying Snow Residence and naturally, Xue Ying did not follow up with the matter.
******
“Mn?”
Even though the other party could harm him, Specter Religion Master did not mind. This skin-deep injury did not reduce his life force at all.
‘He is a Late Stage Ascendant God Emperor? His techniques are clearly weak, yet they are unpredictable and strange. Dealing against them is tough.’ Specter Religion Master’s expression shifted slightly, ‘No wonder North River invited Wise Wizard and I to deal with this God Emperor together.’
Xue Ying had many techniques that could not injure him at all previously.
In the end, it was still the dark maelstrom and several hundred spears that stacked up each maelstrom together, bringing enough damage that could injure Specter Religion Master.
‘I shall not play with him any longer.’ The eyes of Specter Religion Master turned frigid.
“Hou--”
Specter Religion Master opened his mouth.
A terrifying ear-piercing screech was let out of it, forming waves that could be seen with the naked eyes. These waves easily broke apart the dark void maelstroms ahead of him. It continued all the way until it reached Xue Ying.
“Mn?” Xue Ying suffered from the impact of this sharp screech. Even though he immediately resisted against it using his spear techniques, those unseen ripples still struck his entire body. His Void-ification enabled him to dissipate much of the incoming force. Despite having a Late Stage God Emperor fleshy body currently, he still felt his body turning numb, and a dizzying spell striking his mind. Nonetheless, his soul was sufficiently strong. That gave him the ability to resist against these waves.
‘Has Specter Religion Master begun employing his killing techniques?’ Xue Ying thought. He had long memorised the intelligence from Heaven’s Will Pavilion---regarding the three great killing techniques that made Specter Religion Master reach his ninth position on the God Emperor Ranking List.
“Hu.”
The back of Specter Religion Master abruptly protruded out, forming a pair of skeletal wings. These wings were even covered with crimson skin. As he flapped those wings of his, Specter Religion Master’s speed exploded.
“Hu hu hu~” Nine images leapt forward together.
Xue Ying knew that Specter Religion Master was so fast that he could appear in any of those images.
This was not ‘instantaneous movement’ or a magical ability. It was purely speed! His speed was much faster than what Xue Ying could achieve with his ‘Void Devil Insect Body Technique’ by approximately two times! And this gap felt truly exaggerated. It was normal too since Specter Religion Master was the second fastest cultivator in the entire Divine Realm. Even Cloud Phoenix City Master and several other Grand Perfection God Emperors were not as fast as he.
“Chi chi chi.” Specter Religion Master’s original hands had already transformed into a pair of enormous claw. The crimson skin on the claws were completely crystallized. And it was this pair of claws that were his strongest weapon.
Specter Religion Master would occasionally screech, influencing Xue Ying with waves of ear-piercing sound.
With his extreme speed, he circled around Xue Ying, slashing out with his claws that Xue Ying had to block with his spear.
‘Even though he is stronger than me, his technique execution is relatively crude, allowing me to fight on equal grounds with him easily.’ Xue Ying might be disadvantaged, yet his defenses were tight. Even though Grand Perfection God Emperors sought to perfect their techniques, employing more profound laws in them, many were ultimately cultivators that walked down the path of bloodline.
Competing in the profoundness of their techniques? How could they compare with Xue Ying and others who comprehended laws and profound mysteries since they were mortals! Ascendants also comprehended Daos.
They did not have any bloodline energy and were forced to comprehend the ‘Dao’ that they specialized in to grow stronger.
“I can’t deal with him alone. North River, Wise Wizard, act now.” Specter Religion Master transmitted to both his allies.
…
Great Emperor North River and Wise Wizard City Master, these two Grand Perfection God Emperors had long arrived at High Mountain City.
The two of them completely concealed their aura, disguising themselves as Early Stage God Emperors. Reaching the level of Grand Perfection God Emperor, it was impossible for others to trace them down using karma! As for aura? It was impossible for others to discern if they were authentic either!
“A Late Stage Ascendant God Emperor. Brother North River, it is little wonder that you wanted all three of us to work together.” Wise Wizard City Master grinned, “But with this little power, it is possible for the three of us to kill him once we work together.”
“Mn.” Great Emperor North River nodded. Nonetheless, he had a vague feeling that things were amiss.
Because looking at that Xue Ying who was currently fighting with Specter Religion Master, Great Emperor North River could see that Xue Ying was currently only using his Dao of Void techniques.
‘He has reached Late Stage God Emperor Realm just with his Dao of Void alone? He could even fight with Bloodline Grand Perfection God Emperors?’ Great Emperor North River thought, ‘If he casted his soul technique, the three of us might even be greatly affected.’
‘Fortunately.’
‘His soul technique could only cause the weakest God Generals to fall. The strongest God Generals could still resist against it.’ Great Emperor North River thought, ‘Now that I have reached the Grand Perfection God Emperor Realm, it should likely only reduce our strength by approxmiately 20% to 30%, right?’
‘Even though we are weakened, it is still possible for the three of us to coordinate and help each other.’ Great Emperor North River considered.
Those were two helpers that he chose conscientiously.
If he casually chose two other Grand Perfection God Emperors, it would be hard for them to be of great help to him. They would only have an advantage in numbers.
But the current group of three… if their techniques were executed together, the outcome would no longer be the same.
‘Even if we were weaker by 20% to 30%, it is entirely possible for the three of us to kill him.’ Great Emperor North River thought.
Great Emperor North River exchanged glances with Wise Wizard City Master.
“Move in!”
…
“Hong! Hong!”
Two figures moved in as quick as lightning. They rushed up into the sky. It was like puncturing through soap bubbles, they easily pierced through the protective arrays covering High Mountain City.
The aura of these two figures were abnormally terrifying.
“Roar!”
Of which the green-robed green-browed old man roared out. His body metamorphosed into a Mist Dragon! This Mist Dragon immediately charged out at Xue Ying, causing large amounts of green fog to engulf him. Xue Ying’s expression changed. It was useless even if he executed his spear technique since the fog could not be blocked. It rapidly surrounded and engulfed him.
Being wrapped around by layers made Xue Ying pale. His strength and speed were greatly weakened.
“Si la--”
That green-robed male pulled out his sword, causing sword lights to form. Those sword lights could easily slash the world into heaven. One of the sword lights that was as fluid as water reached Xue Ying. And it was at this moment that the fog surrounding Xue Ying split apart, leaving just a slender gap that allowed the sword light to enter. It did not hinder the sword light at all.
“North River!” When Xue Ying saw the green-robed male and the terrifying Grand Perfection God Emperor strength let out by him, Xue Ying naturally recognized with a single glance that this green-robed male was none other than ‘Great Emperor North River’, the person who originated from the same place as he did.
…
The various experts within High Mountain City were still stunned with God Emperor Flying Snow’s strength, and even Imperial Wind Qing Yin revealed a joyous look, feeling that her teacher could at least defend himself when…
“This is?”
These experts were startled.
They saw two figures easily breaking apart the protective arrays and rushed up into the sky. Their aura were as abnormally strong as Specter Religion Master’s.
Those nine images!
That Mist Dragon!
And those sword lights that could cut the world into half!
“Three, three Grand Perfection God Emperor?” Everyone was hoodwinked.
That Xing Pavilion Master from Heaven’s Will Pavilion who was responsible for recording the battle scene felt his throat becoming dry. Three Grand Perfection God Emperors ganging up against an expert? This was rare in the history of the Divine Realm. Every single time such an event happened would stir the entire Divine Realm.
Xing Pavilion Master immediately reported upwards: “Three Grand Perfection God Emperors are currently ganging up against God Emperor Flying Snow. It is currently happening right here at High Mountain City!”
This news rapidly reached the headquarters of Heaven’s Will Pavilion.
As almost all the peak experts in the Divine realm had ordered for intelligence reports to be sent from the Heaven’s Will Pavilion over a long period, whenever something unusual popped out, these experts would be informed about it.
And this news regarding three Grand Perfection God Emperors attacking one expert? It was something that absolutely had to be informed to all customers!
This news rapidly spread out across the Divine Realm to all the various huge sects!

chapters.title: Chapter 1320 - Sweeping Across All Enemies
chapters.content:
Chapter 1320: Sweeping Across All Enemies
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
‘Not good! God Emperor Flying Snow is in danger!’ The two God Emperors Imperial Wind Lei and Imperial Wind High Mountain could see what was happening currently.
“Wise Wizard City Master transformed into a ‘Mist Venom Dragon’ that weakened the strength of Senior Flying Snow. Specter Religion Master’s speed is preeminent. Senior Flying Snow already had a hard time defending against him. And now, there is another green-robed man who is a Grand Perfection God Emperor. That sword is even more frighteningly strong. If Xue Ying were to focus his strength in defending against this sword, he would no longer have the capability to defend against Specter Religion Master.” Imperial Wind Lei nervously commented.
“Indeed, if he focuses on defending against Specter Religion Master, he would not be able to multi-task and defend against that sword.” Imperial Wind High Mountain was anxious too.
Because the moment God Emperor Flying Snow died, their Imperial Wind Clan would not have a good outcome!
Even though God Emperor Flying Snow was at this moment, exhibiting the strength of a ‘Grand Perfection God Emperor’, facing the coordination of three Grand Perfection God Emperors, Xue Ying had within moments, ended in desperate straits. Imperial Wind High Mountain and Imperial Wind Lei could not even think of any ways this God Emperor Flying Snow could escape alive.
…
When Xue Ying saw that fluid-like sword cutting through the world, the moment he saw that green-robed man, he no longer had any perplexities in his heart.
‘Indeed, it is you, Great Emperor North River! No wonder Specter Religion Master is finding a reason to deal with me.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘You are quite vigilant. Now that you have broken through to the Grand Perfection God Emperor Realm, you still think of ways to invite Specter Religion Master and Wise Wizard City Master, both Grand Perfection God Emperors to kill me together.’
‘Fortunately, my strength has far surpassed that when I was in Realm Heart Great Land.’
As Xue Ying faced this current predicament, a joint attack by three Grand Perfection God Emperors, he did not care that much in his heart.
‘In the end, I still have to cast my soul technique!’
“Hong.”
The eyes of Xue Ying became icy-cold.
And at this moment, the three God Emperors that worked together to deal against Xue Ying, Great Emperor North River, Wise Wizard City Master, and Specter Religion Master all felt an enormous illusory realm appearing that was currently pulling their soul in frantically! Furthermore, this illusory realm was constantly striking out on their souls like waves.
Previously, even though Xue Ying had executed his Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique against God Emperor Crane Pit, Cloud Flow Little Pavilion Master, Iron Dragon Hall’s Crown Prince, Iron Dragon City Master, and others…
That was done under a disguised identity! Others did not know who he was.
But at this moment when he executed it, Xue Ying understood that he would no longer have any peaceful days in High Mountain City. This news that he could cast a terrifying soul technique would most likely spread across the entire Divine Realm. ‘Iron Dragon City Master’, ‘Cloud Phoenix City Master’, and others had most likely been searching for him for a long time.
‘So be it. It doesn’t matter if I reveal my strength now. Given my strength, as long as the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods do not act, I do not fear anyone else. As for the Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods, they are ultimately Chaotic Origin Experts that have jumped out of the cage. They are even the creators of this world. With their identities, they should not be finding excuses to attack me.’ Xue Ying thought.
Many thoughts flashed through the mind of Xue Ying.
As for the other three Grand Perfection God Emperors, they were all filled with shock and terror.
“Hong!””Hong!””Hong!”
The souls of Specter Religion Master, Wise Wizard City Master, and Great Emperor North River were all being pulled by a terrifying illusory realm. They felt fear and were currently doing their utmost to resist against it. What was left of their ‘heart force’ had to be used for battle. As a result, they could hardly control their fleshy body perfectly any longer, making their technique execution much cruder than before. Naturally, their offense had become greatly diminished.
‘How could this be? This, this soul technique?’ Specter Religion Master was stunned. He even chose to retreat at the first moment he could, ‘That damned North River, he actually did not tell us that this God Emperor Flying Snow could execute such terrifying soul technique. His soul technique is so powerful that it has reached this stage! I have to use close to 90% of my heart force to resist against it.’
“North River! You are ruthless, truly ruthless! You did not even share with us such an important intelligence regarding the enemy. Very good, very good!” Specter Religion Master transmitted over angrily as he fled.
If one said that Specter Religion Master had fled at the very first moment from fear…
Then even though that Wise Wizard City Master was terrified, he did not panic. Because his Mist Venom Dragon Body was known to be ‘undying’. Even Cloud Phoenix City Master could not kill him.
‘Just so close and my soul could no longer hold on any further. If that happened, wouldn’t I die?’ Wise Wizard City Master was filled with rage at this juncture. He immediately transmitted to Great Emperor North River, “North River, this God Emperor Flying Snow has such a terrifying soul technique yet you didn’t tell us about that. This time, not only must you pay me 100,000 Chaotic Origin Crystal Jade, you must also make up for us.”
“Hong~”
At the same time when Xue Ying executed his soul technique, he struck out with his spear at the escaping Specter Religion Master.
“Hua--”
Even though Specter Religion Master was doing his utmost to escape, how could he be faster than a spatial technique? One saw a huge Void Bubble appearing and engulfing around Specter Religion Master! The Void Bubble stacked on top of one another. This was an imprisonment technique, and Specter Religion Master was trapped within. He immediately resisted and struck against the bubble.
Nonetheless, this Void Bubble constantly dissipated away the incoming force. Since Specter Religion Master could only use 10% of his current heart force, even though his fleshy body was exceptionally strong, allowing him to unleash 20% to 30% of his previous strength, it remained at the Late Stage God Emperor standard. Hence, he could not destroy apart the Void Bubble.
“North River!” Xue Ying casually dealt against Specter Religion Master with one single move.
Xue Ying turned illusory and charged right at Great Emperor North River!
This was his true target.
‘When did his soul technique become this strong?’ Great Emperor North River was stupefied. Even though Wise Wizard City Master and Specter Religion Master both transmitted a message to him, Great Emperor North River was too lazy to care about them! In his heart, he was more terrified at the soul technique unveiled by Xue Ying, ‘Back at Broken Tooth Mountain Range, quite a few God Generals could still withstand against his soul technique. Yet now, I could barely resist that illusory realm after expending 80% of my heart force?’
“Hong.” Xue Ying killed his way over. At the same time, he fiercely hacked out with his spear.
“Hua.”
The surrounding space was like an enormous ice piece. It formed into one single block. Furthermore, it was rapidly suppressing the place, turning it into a flat two-dimensional space. And soon, it was pressed into as slender as a blade.
‘Not good, I am just left with 30% to 40% of my strength. That is only comparable to a Late Stage God Emperor.’ Great Emperor North River was anxious.
Even though most Grand Perfection God Emperors dug out their bloodline energy to a pinnacle, allowing them to attain a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body, different bloodlines meant different strengths. For instance, ‘Specter Religion Master’ and ‘Iron Dragon City Master’ had exaggeratedly strong fleshy bodies. The fleshy body of Iron Dragon City Master was too strong that his direct combat skills were second only to Cloud Phoenix City Master! And Specter Religion Master’s fleshy body enabled his pure speed to reach second in the entire Divine Realm.
These cultivators who had incredibly strong fleshy bodies could remain as powerful as before even when they had just some heart force left. Even as they stand there and allow the enemies to strike them, it was hard for the enemies to injure them at all.
Or for instance, ‘Wise Wizard City Master’. Wise Wizard City Master could turn himself into a Mist Venom Dragon that was supposedly undying. He was ranked in the top three of Divine Realm in terms of restricting enemies. But his other aspects like direct combat skills were much weaker.
Various parties had their strengths and weaknesses.
As for Great Emperor North River, he specialized in offense! Yet his fleshy body was much weaker than Wise Wizard City Master’s and Iron Dragon City Master’s. It could only be determined to be at the Grand Perfection God Emperor standard.
“Pu.” Eventually, the space that was suppressed into a thread shattered. Great Emperor North River also spurt out fresh blood from the impact. Many injuries appeared across his body and fresh blood sprayed around the place.
“Hong.” Xue Ying rushed over at high speed once again, striking out with his spear fiercely.
The spearhead had yet to reach when an unseen ripple struck into the body of Great Emperor North River. Even though Great Emperor North River was doing his best to resist against it, this move could not be blocked; it permeated into his body directly! It began resonating in his body and eventually, superimposed onto one huge explosion! And that bombarded Great Emperor North River to the extent that he spurt out blood uncontrollably, with shards of his organs flying out.
‘Not good, my techniques are an entire level less profound than his. And now, I can hardly employ much of my heart force, causing me to lose control of my defending techniques.’ Great Emperor North River understood this point, ‘My fleshy body isn’t as strong as Specter Religion Master’s either. If this continues, Ying Shan Xue Ying could kill me in a dozen moves.’
A dozen moves at the level of Xue Ying was incredibly fast.
And Great Emperor North River was naturally decisive since he could reach his current realm.
“Kill.” Xue Ying immediately sent another spear over.
‘It’s time for me to leave.’ Great Emperor North River did not hesitate in activating the blood imprint on his wristband.
“Weng.”
A blood-colored bubble wrapped around Great Emperor North River. This pierce by Xue Ying’s spear felt like stabbing into the void. It simply pierced across. That blood-colored bubble did not let a single ripple in. Following that with a ‘shua’ --the blood-colored bubble brought Great Emperor North River along and disappeared from this world.
“He escaped?” Xue Ying could not help but grit his teeth when he saw that.
He knew that killing North River was difficult because the other party was just like Xue Ying--had a way to leave this world anytime.
‘My Chaotic Origin Refinement Body has reached the Late Stage God Emperor Realm. But clearly, its power is lacking. If I had reached the Grand Perfection God Emperor Realm! With the profoundness of my techniques coupled with my soul technique, I could have killed Great Emperor North River in one single strike.’ Xue Ying thought. Following that, he turned around, only to see Specter Religion Master rushing out of the Void Bubble--he was currently rushing as fast as possible in a bid to escape from Xue Ying. The Mist Venom Dragon was similarly rushing in a different direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 1321 - Alarmed
chapters.content:
Chapter 1321: Alarmed
Above High Mountain City, these two Grand Perfection God Emperors, Specter Religion Master and Wise Wizard City Master were currently escaping in different directions! Wise Wizard City Master had even turned into a Mist Venom Dragon, supposedly an undying body. It’s just that he was similarly afraid of Xue Ying: ‘This God Emperor Flying Snow is too terrifying! If his soul technique is slightly stronger, my life might even be reaped in his hands. I have to rush away as fast and as far as possible!’
After all, they ganged up on God Emperor Flying Snow this time. This was a huge enmity they created. Naturally, it would be better if they hid further away.
“Sou!”
Specter Religion Master’s speed rose to a limit: ‘Given my speed, this God Emperor Flying Snow will definitely not reach up to me. Mn? Not good!’
Just in that short moment, Specter Religion Master had already flown out of the walls surrounding High Mountain City and into the Great Wilderness. But his expression suddenly changed. In the sky before him, a black crack formed and a white-robed Xue Ying came out of it. He simply obstructed the path forward for Specter Religion Master.
“You can’t escape from me!” Xue Ying looked at him.
“Ultra-long distance teleportation?” The face of Specter Religion Master greatly lost color.
In the entire Divine Realm, those who had grasped the ultra-long distance teleportation technique could be counted with one’s fingers. Yet this God Emperor Flying Snow could actually execute it?
Specter Religion Master was both furious and terrified at the same time. He immediately turned around and altered his path of escape.
“Hong.”
Xue Ying was too lazy to bring out his spear. He simply pressed down with his right hand, causing the void ahead to be pressed into a piece of paper. Even though Specter Religion Master’s soul was constantly suffering from a pull into the enormous illusory realm, the strength of his fleshy body gave him the ability to resist against the spatial suppression.
“Peng~” This space that was pressed into a two dimension finally shattered.
And Xue Ying had already arrived before Specter Religion Master.
“Stop!” Specter Religion Master immediately roared.
“Mn?” Xue Ying actually stopped.
“We have been led astray by North River this time. That was also why we attacked you, God Emperor Flying Snow. It is our mistake.” Specter Religion Master said, “I am willing to make amends and resolve this affair. Is that fine with you?”
The body of Specter Religion Master was relatively huge. His entire body was covered in crimson skin and he had a blood cape billowing behind him. With a pair of blood-colored eyes… Specter Religion Master was someone famous for being tyrannical across the Divine Realm. Nonetheless, he was currently lowering his head obediently and trying to make amends with the other party. This was a scene rarely seen in the Divine Realm.
“Make amends?” Xue Ying looked at Specter Religion Master with a smile that did not seem like one, “Tell me your conditions.”
Xue Ying was clear.
Specter Religion Master was different from ordinary Grand Perfection God Emperors. His body was too strong and his speed too fast. Xue Ying had to rely on techniques that affected a large distance to restrict him. But techniques with a huge distance had weaker damage. Given how strong the fleshy body ‘Specter Religion Master’ had, techniques with huge AOE could be neglected. Hence, Xue Ying had to restrict the other party first before sending out several damaging moves!
Nonetheless, Specter Religion Master was too fast. By the time a few techniques elapsed, he would have long pulled apart a distance.
And Xue Ying had to repeat the whole process once again.
‘Given how strong the fleshy body of Specter Religion Master is, it would take me several hundred techniques to kill him.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Furthermore, he is fast and slippery, making it impossible to maintain a long-lasting offense on him.’
It would at least take the time to brew a cup of tea to kill Specter Religion Master!
Such a long period…
When Specter Religion Master could not see hope, he might just pull the entire population in High Mountain City with him in a funeral.
Others did not know of Xue Ying’s personality, and might reckon that such ultra-strong expert would treat weak ants coldly. But in reality, Xue Ying was not willing to see the population living in High Mountain City die because of him. Even though he could save others, he would only save his female disciple and a few other people. It was impossible for him to save everyone in the city.
“Treasures worth 50,000 Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades.” Specter Religion Master bowed slightly, “I am willing to fork this to resolve this affair.”
“Religion Master, is your life worth so little? Furthermore, the few of you had wanted to take my life before this.” Xue Ying said, “Treasures worth 100,000 Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades and this matter will be done as such.”
Specter Religion Master’s eyes brightened. He was already waiting for this God Emperor Flying Snow to open his lion’s mouth. This value of 100,000 Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades was entirely within his limit. He immediately replied: “Alright! Treasures worth 100,000 Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades shall be it. Also, Brother Wise Wizard wants to resolve the enmity with you too, God Emperor Flying Snow, I wonder if it is possible?”
“Wise Wizard City Master?” Xue Ying glanced at that Mist Venom Dragon which had flown out of the city. At this moment, the Mist Venom Dragon had already stopped moving and was floating far away looking in this direction.
Xue Ying could not kill Wise Wizard City Master for now, yet Wise Wizard City Master wished to resolve the enmity. Clearly, he was frightened!
Wise Wizard City Master…
He had never felt the threat of death for a very long time. With his Mist Venom Dragon Body, nobody other than the three Chaotic Origin ANcestral Gods in Divine Realm could deal with him. But with Xue Ying’s presence, Wise Wizard City Master actually felt the breath of death on him! As long as Xue Ying’s soul technique improved further, it would reach a stage beyond the limit of what the soul Wise Wizard City Master could withstand.
Even if he could escape now, there might perhaps be a day in the future after Xue Ying improved, and that would be when his doomsday arrived.
Living through days of terror was painful. If he could resolve the enmity, it would be best if he did so.
“That’s fine too. What can he fork out? “Xue Ying said.
“Sou.”
To the distance, that Mist Venom Dragon immediately flew over in the direction of Xue Ying.
…
High in the sky, both Wise Wizard City Master and Specter Religion Master were being incredibly polite. They postured themselves quite lowly and were negotiating with Xue Ying how they could make amends.
And inside the High Mountain City.
The group of people, Imperial Wind High Mountain, Imperial Wind Lei, Imperial Wind Qing Yin, and others including that ‘Xing Pavilion Master’ from Heaven’s Will Pavilion were stunned silly.
“Heavens.”
“Three Grand Perfection God Emperors teamed up against God Emperor Flying Snow, yet they were simply defeated?”
“One versus three, and he defeated three Grand Perfection God Emperors alone?”
“This, this… have I seen clearly?”
They were completely hoodwinked.
Three Grand Perfection God Emperors. One mysterious Grand Perfection God Emperor escaped (Great Emperor North River), and the other two (Specter Religion Master and Wise Wizard City Master) were currently negotiating and making amends.
This was no longer simply being defeated.
In the Divine Realm, it was normal for Grand Perfection God Emperors to fight with one another! Most of the time, it was hard for one to kill the other party even after defeating him as the gap in strength wasn’t too great. Hence, it was near impossible for one to lower his head and seek amends with the other party! Only those with transcendental status like ‘Cloud Phoenix City Master’ could force other Grand Perfection God Emperors to make amends! But Specter Religion Master and Wise Wizard City Master were currently doing so.
“Wise Wizard City Master is also making amends? Doesn’t he have his Undying Body!” Many people were stunned by this scene.
“How strong is God Emperor Flying Snow exactly?”
“He, is he that strong?”
One cultivator defeated three other Grand Perfection God Emperors.
And he was so intimidating that the others were scared silly and chose to make amends with him?
“Such an expert is actually living in seclusion within my High Mountain City?” Imperial Wind High Mountain was in disbelief.
“In the entire Divine Realm, there is only one other existence who is this heaven-defying--the number one in the God Emperor Ranking List, Cloud Phoenix City Master.” Imperial Wind Lei felt his heart trembling, “And this expert actually took Third Sister in as his disciple?”
Along the corridor in Flying Snow Residence, Imperial Wind Qing Yin was also in a daze.
She was originally worried for Xue Ying, especially so when three Grand Perfection God Emperors jointly attacked her teacher at the same time. Her heart was beating so fast it almost jumped out of her body. But closely following that, she fell into a daze.
“My Teacher, my Teacher, he…” Imperial Wind Qing Yin did not dare believe what she just saw.
“With his strength, he is at least ranked second on the God Emperor Ranking List.” Xing Pavilion Master forced himself awake. He immediately recorded what just happened. At the same time, he reported upwards constantly, “It has to be decided through a battle to determine if he or Cloud Phoenix City Master is stronger. Perhaps he might be able to defeat Cloud Phoenix City Master and become the strongest expert in the Divine Realm!”
The number one expert on the God Emperor Ranking List?
Xing Pavilion Master did not dare believe that this huge battle was recorded personally by him.
…
Gradually as this news spread, many experts in the Divine Realm were shocked by it. It was fine for those God Monarchs to be stunned silly, even the Grand Perfection God Emperors were completely shocked.
Fighting three by himself?
Defeating three other Grand Perfection God Emperors? Forcing Specter Religion Master and Wise Wizard City Master to make amends?
“Hurry up! Where is the scene of the battle?”
Many experts immediately asked for the scene of the battle. And this recording was something that they had to purchase from the Heaven’s Will Pavilion.
Xing Pavilion Master was indeed proud.
Because!
He personally recorded down the battle! And so many experts were thoroughly examining it! As a result, the Heaven’s Will Pavilion had earned quite a lot.
In reality, earning this sum of crystal jades was a minor matter. Instead, this huge event had even jolted the three Great Royal Clans into action!

chapters.title: Chapter 1322 - The Three Great Royal Clans
chapters.content:
Chapter 1322: The Three Great Royal Clans
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
High Mountain City, Flying Snow Residence.
Specter Religion Master and Wise Wizard City Master were not in a rush to leave. Instead, they prepared, through Heaven’s Will Pavilion, a sumptuous banquet and invited Xue Ying over!
“It’s all because of North River that we came to attack you, God Emperor Flying Snow.” Specter Religion Master sat there articulating out his frustration, “If the two of us knew about Brother Flying Snow’s strength, we would never have joined him!”
“That’s right! He even chose to escape so quickly! We can’t track him down either. Hmph, let’s see how capable this North River is in hiding forever. The moment he shows himself, I’ll definitely not show him any mercy.” Wise Wizard City Master gritted out angrily.
“Right! We must not spare him at all!” Specter Religion Master was similarly filled with indignance.
The two of them had been annoyed by what just happened.
Prior to coming, they did not know that God Emperor Flying Snow specialized in soul techniques! If they knew that his soul techniques were this terrifying, they wouldn’t have come. Every single one of them that took on the path of cultivation understood that soul was fundamental! If a cultivator’s soul techniques threatened even ‘Grand Perfection God Emperors’, then his attainments in the soul would absolutely have given him the crown across the entire Divine Realm.
How could such a character be treated as an enemy?
Great Emperor North River knew about this, which was why he deliberately concealed this fact! As long as Great Emperor North River hid the truth, Specter Religion Master and Wise Wizard City Master would not have thought that their target would be so brilliant in his soul attainments. The two of them were used to sweeping across their enemies and would not have thought that it was possible for their lives to be threatened.
“Since this North River chooses to hide, it’ll be close to impossible for him to show himself in public.” Xue Ying said. It was hard for them to return after leaving this world.
“After offending you, God Emperor Flying Snow, how would he dare to show himself?” Wise Wizard City Master laughed. Because Xue Ying could not deal with him temporarily and Wise Wizard City Master’s ranking was lower than Specter Religion Master’s, his accumulations would have been lower.
