Hence, Xue Ying simply demanded ‘treasures worth 500,000 Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades’ from him. After that, the enmity between the two would be resolved.
“Mn?” Xue Ying suddenly looked upwards.
The starlight became resplendent.
Many dimmed paths formed from starlight appeared in High Mountain City. From thus came three figures. One was a male dressed in simple gray robes, ‘Iron Dragon City Master’. The other was the plump ‘Star Wind City Master’. The final figure was an enchanting woman carrying an enormous saber behind his back, ‘Red Yao Ship Captain’.
“Iron Dragon City Master, Sister Red Yao, and the rest are here too?” Wise Wizard City Master looked up with surprise and chuckled, “They have come really quickly.”
“Iron Dragon City Master actually came so fast. This is really rare.” Specter Religion Master added.
The two of them deliberately invited Xue Ying to a banquet because they were delaying for them. They understood that this battle would definitely spread across the Divine Realm, and there would certainly be quite a few experts visiting God Emperor Flying Snow! By then, a large group of Grand Perfection God Emperors would be present, and they could show that they had already patched their conflict with God Emperor Flying Snow.
If God Emperor Flying Snow chose to ‘take revenge’ in the future, he would definitely be frowned upon by others.
Reaching this level, experts still regarded their reputation highly.
“Brother Flying Snow.” Iron Dragon City Master laughed, “I wanted to find you, yet I had such a hard time doing so.”
Xue Ying immediately stood up with a smile: “Flying Snow plans on cultivating in seclusion and pass my life peacefully. I hope to see Iron Dragon City Master’s understanding in this.”
“Understand, I definitely understand. How can I not dare to? I’m afraid that I might no longer be your opponent now.” Iron Dragon City Master chuckled.
“Iron Dragon City Master, Sister Red Yao, Brother Star Wind, hurry over and have a seat.” Wise Wizard City Master shouted over.
The three of them--Iron Dragon City Master, Red Yao Ship Captain, and Star Wind City Master responded and came over.
“God Emperor Flying Snow, how about sparring with me?” Red Yao Ship Captain looked at Xue Ying.
“Spar?” Xue Ying turned back at her.
Red Yao Ship Captain’s ranking was not considered high. She was ranked relatively normal among the Grand Perfection God Emperors, and was comparable to Wise Wizard City Master.
“I should rephrase it--I would like to get some pointers from God Emperor Flying Snow!” Red Yao Ship Captain laughed.
“I want to have a proper spar with you too, Brother Flying Snow.” Iron Dragon City Master said.
Xue Ying nodded with a smile.
He could feel the suppressed desire and fighting spirit in both of them. Reaching the level of grand perfection, the next step would be to attain the ultimate awakening! Iron Dragon City Master and Red Yao Ship Captain would not pay attention to the affairs of the mortals usually. What they sought was to breakthrough and reach the Chaotic Origin Level. Currently, Xue Ying’s strength had come close to the number one expert on the Grand Emperor Ranking List. They naturally desired to have a battle and temper themselves.
…
On this day.
Many experts came to the High Mountain City. Almost half of all Grand Perfection God Emperors in the Divine Realm actually came! Even that strongest Ascendant in the Dao of Void--Late Stage Ascendant God Emperor ‘God Emperor Flying Swallow’ came too!
******
And on this day too.
The three Great Royal Clans were similarly paying attention on this God Emperor Ascendant living in seclusion within High Mountain City, ‘God Emperor Flying Snow’!
“Hua hua hua~”
On an island with a trillion stars rotating around it--those stars were approximately half a thousand kilometers long and were all emitting bright light. With a trillion stars illuminating the place, it made this island seem dream-like! This island had a transcendental status in the entire Divine Realm. It was none other than the Extreme Star Island, an island belonging to one of the three Great Royal Clans, ‘Extreme Star Clan’.
On the Extreme Star Island.
Within a towering palace.
There was a male and a female seated at the two thrones. Beneath them were seated with nine elders of the Extreme Star Island.
“Have you verified the news?” That luxuriously-dressed black-robed male looked down and asked nonchalantly.
“Your Highnesses, this news has just been verified personally with the Heaven’s Will Clan recently. The Heaven’s Will Clan had also investigated the matter using their ‘Heaven’s Will Well’. Indeed, everything is true.” An elder respectfully answered, “That God Emperor Flying Snow has defeated three other Grand Perfection God Emperors by himself. Both Specter Religion Master and Wise Wizard City Master are well-known. But there is an additional mysterious Grand Perfection God Emperor who uses the sword. Even though we have never heard of him before, the strength exhibited by him is incredibly terrifying. The three of them has been defeated all at once, showing how strong God Emperor Flying Snow is! Furthermore, I have personally contacted Specter Religion Master and Wise Wizard City Master about this affair as well. They replied, saying that God Emperor Flying Snow knows a terrifying soul technique that could weaken the two of them down to just 20% to 30% of their original strength.”
“Soul technique?” The black-robed male exchanged glance with the white-robed female beside him,
“Big Brother, there has never been such an expert appearing in our Divine Realm, an expert that specializes in soul techniques.” The white-robed girl said, “The emergence of this expert must be made known to father.”
“Mn!” The black-robed male nodded slightly, “Alright, let us talk to father about it.”
The two of them had really honorable statuses.
Precisely because…
They were the children of one of the three Great Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods, ‘Extreme Star Ancestral God’!
It’s just that that the siblings were incredibly respectful even to their father. After all, their father was a Chaotic Origin Expert that had jumped out of the cage. Unless something important happened, they would usually not disturb him.
“In the past, Cloud Phoenix City Master has once caught the attention of father and the rest. But after that, there is no longer any news about them. Cloud Phoenix City Master remains in our world.” The white-robed girl said, “I wonder if this God Emperor Flying Snow could attract the attention of them.”
“No matter what, the soul is also the foundation of life. He has grasped such unfathomable understanding of the soul and is qualified for us to report it to our father.” The black-robed male flipped his hand and brought out a piece of translucent token. This token contained countless stars moving on it. They looked exactly the same as the stars revolving around the Extreme Star Island.
This token was a supreme protective treasure! He and his little sister were given one piece each. It could be used as a protection and a form of contact with their father.
The nine elders beneath saw this and immediately revealed respectful looks.
In the Extreme Star Clan… only these two highnesses were qualified to contact the Chaotic Origin Ancestral God.
“Father.” The black-robed male held on to the token and immediately established communication.
…
Golden Sacred Clan.
The two Golden Sacred Brothers, after some thorough investigation--they event sent out a Grand Perfection God Emperor in their clan over to the ‘High Mountain City’ to understand about the matter--had similarly informed their father, one of the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods, Golden Sacred Ancestral God.
…
Heaven’s Will Clan.
The three sisters of the Heaven’s Will Clan had reached the news the fastest. They were similarly filled with disbelief and had already received the order from their mother previously. They naturally understood that this ‘God Emperor Flying Snow’ was qualified to be reported to their mother.
“Previously in the Divine Realm, even though there were Grand Perfection Ascendant God Emperors as well, there has never been one who excelled in soul techniques like this.”
“Soul is the root of life. If one reached a profound level in the Dao of Soul, it should be unlike other Dao paths.”
The three sisters discussed with one another. They were filled with curiosity.
At the same time, they contacted their mother--Heaven’s Will Ancestral God.

chapters.title: Chapter 1323 - Interaction
chapters.content:
Chapter 1323: Interaction
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
In the small-scale world just tens of thousands of kilometers wide, an enormous female sculpture 1,000 meters tall could be seen standing by the side of a huge mountain. This mountain that was situated beside the female sculpture seemed slightly shorter.
The weak living beings in this world were kowtowing piously to her.
“Empress Heaven’s Will.”
“Empress Heaven’s Will.”
Countless people were kowtowing.
After all, to such a weak world, the number of Transcendents could be counted with one’s fingers. And a thousand-meter sculpture was simply magical.
Suddenly--
That gigantic female sculpture actually opened her eyes. Her eyes were filled with a strand of surprise.
“Sou.” A blurred figure flew out from this huge sculpture and landed on a small island far away. It was a beauty wearing a long moon white gown. Her appearance represented the manifestation of laws at the Chaotic Origin level. Ordinary living beings would worship her when they saw her.
At this moment, two other figures descended too. They were males. One was constantly letting out light from his entire body, and the other had a trillion stars revolving around him vaguely.
“Heaven’s Will.”
“Little Sister Heaven’s Will.” The two of them were incredibly passionate.
The three of them were none other than the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods.
Empress Heaven’s Will sat down. She lightly brushed her sleeves out, causing two huge stones to appear by the side. Both Golden Sacred Ancestral God and Extreme Star Ancestral God sat down immediately.
“Have the two of you received the news too?” Empress Heaven’s Will smiled.
“Yes. Hearsay it is an Ascendant.” Golden Sacred Ancestral God said, “That has grasped the soul aspect so much so that he could force Grand Perfection God Emperors to use 80% to 90% of their heart force to resist against it! Such a soul technique is simply unfathomable. I haven’t heard of it before.”
“Neither Have I.” Extreme Star Ancestral God shook his head, “When I interact with other Chaotic Origin Experts, I haven’t heard of this either.”
“Right.” Empress Heaven’s Will nodded slightly, “We haven’t heard of such an expert over the long years since we reached the Chaotic Origin Level. Our statuses amongst the Chaotic Origin Experts are considered quite ordinary, yet we have interacted with quite a few Chaotic Origin Experts too. We were even fortunate to meet the magnificent Overlord! Logically speaking, we should be relatively well-informed, yet we have never heard of this before, which means it is really rare to find someone who is so tyrannical in soul techniques… and it might even be fewer than the number of Chaotic Origin Experts!”
Extreme Star Ancestral God and Golden Sacred Ancestral God nodded. Their eyes brightened.
Those lowest-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were excluded as their intelligence was ordinary and they could not perfectly execute their strength; they were so weak that they could not even win over some with Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body! Those who could cultivate until they attained a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body had reached a stage where they could perfectly unleash the strength of their fleshy body. Some Ascendants could even execute their strength profoundly, enabling them to easily kill some of the weaker Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
True Chaotic Origin Experts were actually rare!
Excluding those that controlled an Origin World since those were even rarer.
Even those who could obtain the ultimate awakening… were pitifully few in number!
“Previously, we have also presented some Ascendants with ‘Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Bodies’.” Empress Heaven’s Will said, “Even though the magnificent Overlord has sent an emissary to receive them, he did not really seem to care much about those we sent.”
“Mn, those Ascendants might have obtained a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body, but the possibility of them breaking through to the Chaotic Origin Level is incredibly low. Why would the magnificent Overlord care about them?” Golden Sacred Ancestral God added, “Hearsay the oldest magnificent Overlord, ‘Yuan’, is doing his utmost to nurture the weak cultivators. Only then did other Overlords choose to follow in his footsteps.”
Extreme Star Ancestral God continued: “This time, an expert with such terrifying attainments in the Dao of Soul actually appeared in our world. The magnificent Overlord will definitely be pleased once he knows about that.”
“Once the magnificent Overlord is happy, perhaps we do not have to be stationed here in this Lightning World any longer.” Empress Heaven’s Will said.
“If we take another step and reach the World Realm, we would definitely not be needed to do so.” Extreme Star Ancestral God was relatively unwilling.
No other choice.
Even though they had jumped out of the cage and become Chaotic Origin Experts…
The three of them had succeeded in the easiest paths amongst all Daos, the ‘ultimate awakening’! Once they succeeded in the ultimate awakening, they would immediately become a ‘high-graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform’. They would be much stronger than those weaker ordinary innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms and could casually pinch any cultivator with a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body to death. But ‘High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms’ were considered the lowest level amongst the Chaotic Origin Experts because this was the easiest way of breakthrough.
Those who had ‘Chaotic Origin Bloodline’ would have a relatively simpler time cultivating. As a result, there were quite a few Grand Perfection God Emperors (Supremes) in the vast Chaotic Origin Space.
Hence, when the number added up, quite a few did succeed in ultimate awakening!
It was those who could grasp and control a world that were formidable! They were one level higher than they who underwent ultimate awakening. They could control an Origin World, and were known as ‘World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeforms’. They were considered apex experts amongst the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms already. If they were in their own Origin Worlds, they would be truly unparalleled.
“Only those that comprehended the Dao could possibly have a chance to grasp an Origin World after jumping out of the cage and becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.” Golden Sacred Ancestral God said while shaking his head, “And only those at that level could make the magnificent Overlord look differently. As for us? Hmph hmph…”
“Don’t feel discouraged.” Empress Heaven’s Will said, “We have undergone the Ultimate Awakening, returning to our ancestral roots. It is possible for us to dig the potential of our bloodline energy constantly too.”
“If only the magnificent Overlord is willing to help us, then perhaps there might be greater hope.” Golden Sacred Ancestral God said with a shake of his head, “Heaven’s Will, you are the strongest amongst the three of us. You are also just one step away from breaking through. This time, after presenting that Ascendant called God Emperor Flying Snow, if the magnificent Overlord rewards you for your effort, perhaps you might be able to breakthrough, Heaven’s Will. By then, I and Extreme Star will have to rely on your help.”
“Fellow brothers, you do know how difficult this breakthrough is.” Empress Heaven’s Will might be saying this, though her eyes were filled with hope.
“Fellow brothers, then I shall directly report this to the magnificent Overlord.” Empress Heaven’s Will swept her gaze across both Golden Sacred Ancestral God and Extreme Star Ancestral God.
“Alright.” Golden Sacred Ancestral God and Extreme Star Ancestral God both nodded. They were even slightly nervous about it.
Because they would not dare to disturb that magnificent Overlord if they did not have any important tasks.
******
At the same time when the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods contacted the magnificent Overlord.
In that Divine Realm.
Within High Mountain City in the Flying Snow Residence.
Xue Ying was currently meeting an Ascendant God Emperor.
“God Emperor Flying Swallow.” Xue Ying smiled and raised his wine cup, “I’ve heard of your name, God Emperor, and have desired to meet you one day. Never have I thought that such an event would happen that resulted in three Grand Perfection God Emperors attacking me at the same time. But nonetheless, this gave me a chance to meet God Emperor earlier than expected.”
“God Emperor Flying Snow is not any weaker than me judging by your Dao of Void alone. You have similarly grasped the ultra-long distance teleportation technique.” God Emperor Flying Swallow chuckled, “Furthermore, you have a more formidable soul technique in your arsenal. I’m afraid that in this Divine Realm, at least for those on the God Emperor Ranking List, only Cloud Phoenix City Master is capable of fighting with you, God Emperor Flying Snow.”
Xue Ying laughed.
This person before him was none other than the only Late Stage Ascendant God Emperor that comprehended the Dao of Void!
“After reaching the Late Stage God Emperor Realm, it is incredibly difficult for me to improve any further.” God Emperor Flying Swallow sighed, “We are unlike those Natives of the Divine Realm. Those Natives are born with Chaotic Origin Bloodline that made them undying. Any child Native from the Divine Realm could easily be called a king in almost all of the lower realms. Even after reaching the God Emperor Realm, each step we take is much harder than them, yet there is already a group of Grand Perfection Native God Emperors.”
Xue Ying nodded in agreement.
Without the power of bloodline, it was very difficult to improve by relying on oneself.
Reaching the final realm! According to the categorising of combat strength, they would only be at the King Realm (God Monarch)! This world had many innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that could be used as research references for these Ascendants. That gave a greater hope for them to continue perfecting their understanding of the Daos, allowing them to wield the strength of a God Emperor… but to take the next step and grasp a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body was simply too difficult!
Because!
As long as a bloodline cultivator completely dug out the potential of his bloodline energy, he would have reached the pinnacle of grand perfection, also known as ‘Grand Perfection God Emperor’.
But Ascendants like Xue Ying had been carving their own paths out from scratch. They had to create a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body from scratch. The difficulty was simply too great. Each step they took had to be firm. Only then could they fight with those of one level higher than them. Even if they were to grasp a ‘Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body’, those with Chaotic Origin Bloodline could simply undergo the ‘Ultimate Awakening’.
And Ascendants like Xue Ying would have to comprehend the ‘Dao’ at the Chaotic Origin Level after obtaining a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body! They had to rely on themselves to reach the Chaotic Origin Level. This was also known as ‘using strength to break out of the cage’.
Those that spread religion and refined part of an external origin source to grasp the source of an Origin World would be very powerful after they became Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
But if one broke through step by step without relying on external assistance until he reached the Chaotic Origin Level, that would simply be unfathomable!
This was practically an impossible Dao path.
Many sought ways to refine the source of an Origin World after training their fleshy bodies to the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform level. It was simply because ‘forcing out of the cage’ had a difficulty more than ten times that of any other methods! As a result, most would rather take an easier path.
“The path is too difficult. There are countless of worlds beneath the Lightning World, with generations and generations of Ascendants. Before you appear, God Emperor Flying Snow, I am the only one who has reached the pinnacle in the Dao of Void across many worlds.” God Emperor Flying Swallow shook his head bitterly, “Yet I have only reached the Late Stage God Emperor Realm, and to obtain a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body is light years away for me. Today, I came hoping to exchange cultivation scripture with Brother Flying Snow. I know you should be taking a different path than mine, but we should be able to corroborate on our Dao. It’ll be greatly helpful for you and I in acquiring the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1324 - Dao
chapters.content:
Chapter 1324: Dao
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
“God Emperor Flying Swallow, what you said is precisely what I wanted to do.” Xue Ying said.
Reaching the final realm in the Dao of Void.
This represented reaching grand perfection purely on the profound mysteries of the void! Advancing further, in reality, was absorbing other profound mysteries into the ‘Dao of Void’. Using the Dao of Void as the core to absorb other profound mysteries, one would eventually comprehend ‘Dao’ at the higher level. Like ‘Emperor Summer’ for instance, even though he specialized in the Dao of Void, the direction he sought was to use the Chaotic Origin Dimension as an embryo to form a fleshy body at the Chaotic Origin Level. As for Xue Ying, he planned on using the Dao of Void as the root, relying on the Chaotic Origin Energy to alter and perfect his fleshy body. This process of alteration was also the process where his ‘Dao’ was perfected until his fleshy body reaches the Chaotic Origin Level! By then, his ‘Dao’ would also be at the Chaotic Origin Level.
The reason Xue Ying did this is because firstly, the influence <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> had on him. And secondly, his soul was sufficiently powerful, which in turn nourished his fleshy body as a result, With the soul nourishing his body, Xue Ying was able to understand the flaws his body had, and a clearer direction of where he should head towards.
“I came from a weak little world, cultivating step by step until I reach my current realm. In the world where I came from, Transcendents are rarely seen. And I ascended from that world using the identity as the strongest expert that world ever had in its history, climbing up world by world… every single time I ascended, the stronger the energy of the world I have to withstand.” God Emperor Flying Swallow said, “I had taken on more than a hundred teachers, relying on countless cultivation scriptures and even create quite a few of them.”
God Emperor Flying Swallow flipped his hand, causing a transparent scripture glowing in gold to appear: “<80 Styles of Swallow>. This is the highest attainment that I have in the Void Lineage after cultivating for many years. I have always been pursuing the 81st style because it would mean attaining Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body if I were to achieve it.”
Saying that, he passed a transparent scripture over.
Xue Ying flipped his hand, bringing out a gray dullish scripture: “<Chaotic Origin Refinement Body>. During my path of cultivation, I have absorbed the wisdom of many predecessors too. I have taken on several teachers, comprehended the world and researched on the manifestation of laws on Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Only then did I reach my current level. Similarly, it is only at the Late Stage God Emperor Realm.”
This Chaotic Origin Refinement Body.
It was originally a body refinement cultivation technique created by Emperor Summer, <Chaotic Origin Dao Scroll>. When Xue Ying received it, there were only two levels, allowing the cultivator to own a fleshy body comparable to final realm body cultivators.
After that as Xue Ying improved further, his understanding surpassed what he learned from the scripture! He created an even higher level. Emperor Summer once came to exchange idea with Xue Ying and comprehended on the same Dao. But at that time, the two of them could only bring the Chaotic Origin Refinement Body to ‘Grand Perfection King Realm’ (Grand Perfection God Monarch). It was one step away from the Emperor Realm (God Emperor Realm), and that was when the Daos of both of them split into different directions.
No other choice. Each of them chose a different direction to head towards.
Xue Ying continued having breakthroughs in this Dao path. From Early Stage God Emperor to Middle Stage, before finally reaching Late Stage. Every step taken was hard. Fortunately, his soul was known to be the strongest beneath Chaotic Origin Level! Hence, his comprehension ability had reached an unfathomable stage. And consequently, his soul nourished his fleshy body instead, guiding him along. This made it much easier for Xue Ying. He even researched on that Void Lineage innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse for 300 billion years. Only then was he able to reach the Late Stage God Emperor Realm.
How difficult was this path!
“Hu.” God Emperor Flying Swallow lightly let out a breath as he received the scripture.
Xue Ying similarly took the scripture solemnly.
This was the crystallization of their wisdom! As he knew how difficult his cultivation had been, Xue Ying respected the other party even moore.
“80 Styles of Swallow…” After Xue Ying read through it, he fell immersed into the Dao espoused within the book.
The <80 Styles of Swallow> started from the first style. It was incredibly weak. Xue Ying estimated that the first style was only at the level of a ‘True God Ruler Realm’. Furthermore, it was a combat technique and not a body cultivation technique.
First style, second style, third style…
It grew continually.
Xue Ying could also see the improvement process of God Emperor Flying Swallow. This was originally a heaven-defying combat technique. As Xue Ying went deeper, the killing technique gradually turned into a technique meant to nourish and alter the fleshy body, turning the fleshy body into a body more suitable for battle! And during this process, the fleshy body was constantly becoming stronger and transformed into a state suitable for the new combat style.
‘Altering the fleshy body from the perspective of making it appropriate for the combat style.’
‘Using battle to cultivate.’
This direction might not be more profound than the <Heaven and Earth>, <Realmless>, or <Void Devil Insect Scripture>. There was no differing degrees of profoundness in the Dao paths. Instead, each Dao path was different in its journey distance! Clearly, God Emperor Flying Swallow had reached the Late Stage God Emperor Realm in his Dao path. At least in this Divine Realm, no other Ascendants had walked as far as God Emperor Flying Swallow. Xue Ying as an outsider was not considered.
“You actually cultivated using the Chaotic Origin Energy.” God Emperor Flying Swallow looked at Xue Ying with incredible admiration, “Truly admirable. God Emperor Flying Snow actually thought of using the energy from ‘Chaotic Origin Crystal Jade’ to cultivate. When we were weak, each piece of Chaotic Origin Crystal Jade is incredibly precious.”
Xue Ying chuckled without elaborating on that statement.
In the Origin World, breaking apart the membrane wall would enable Chaotic Origin Energy to surge into it.
But in this world… trying to gather Chaotic Origin Energy was much more difficult. Firstly, one could use Chaotic Origin Crystal Jade as a source of energy--that was a pure condensation of essence from the Chaotic Origin Energy. Secondly, one could also gather Chaotic Origin Energy from other unique grounds! There were primarily only these two methods. Of course, one could also try to absorb the Chaotic Origin Energy from certain treasures.
During the early stages when Xue Ying arrived in this world, even though his body was not stable due to the clashing of laws with this world, the Chaotic Origin Energy in his body remained huge. And after he grasped the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, he originally planned on visiting some special grounds to absorb the inherent Chaotic Origin Energy. But after that, he discovered that each piece of Chaotic Origin Crystal Jade stored an incredible amount of ‘Chaotic Origin Energy’. Furthermore, it was relatively lukewarm when he absorbed it. Thus, he had always been using the Chaotic Origin Crystal Jade to cultivate.
“Shall we have a spar?” Xue Ying chuckled.
“Alright!” God Emperor Flying Swallow brightened and nodded.
Battles were also a form of training for the Dao of Void.
…
Over at High Mountain City.
There were two girls seated opposite of each other in a restaurant.
“Sister, we have been waiting here for three days already.” God Emperor Fire Phoenix complained.
“Don’t be in a rush. Let us go only after the other God Emperors left.” Cloud Phoenix City Master sat there leisurely. She came naturally to visit Xue Ying. But with her temper, she was too lazy to meet other God Emperor experts. With so many Grand Perfection God Emperors coming to visit Xue Ying, Cloud Phoenix City Master rather wait before visiting him last.
“We have waited for so long and am not in a rush for these few days.” Cloud Phoenix City Master revealed a smile, “Who would have thought that God Emperor Flying Snow is actually the one who dealt with my grandson in the past, and he is this formidable too. It is a fortunate affair for this expert to emerge in our Divine Realm.”
Cloud Phoenix City Master was indeed delighted.
She had remained unparalleled in this Divine Realm for a very long time! With her strength, there was a huge gap between her and the second ranker on the God Emperor Ranking List.
Currently in the Divine Realm, there were two kinds of Grand Perfection God Emperors. One was Cloud Phoenix City Master, while the other included the rest with Grand Perfection God Emperor strength. With Xue Ying’s soul technique, he was able to diminish the strength of Grand Perfection God Emperors! If Cloud Phoenix City Master chose to fight directly, even though those Grand Perfection God Emperors could perfectly unleash their strength, Cloud Phoenix City Master could still suppress them entirely. Those who were weaker might even fall!
“There were Grand Perfection Ascendant God Emperors that appeared in this world before.” Cloud Phoenix City Master said, “But after that, they disappeared! I reckon they should have left this world. In order to achieve this, I bet it must be related to the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods.”
“But… I have always been unable to leave this world.”
Cloud Phoenix City Master sneered, “Is it because they find me too weak?”
God Emperor Fire Phoenix went silent.
She was clear that her elder sister had remained unparalleled in the Divine Realm for far too long--she felt lonely! Even though Cloud Phoenix City Master had pursued after the Ultimate Awakening to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform, she still yet to succeed.
“God Emperor Flying Swallow has left.” Cloud Phoenix City Master stood up, “Go, let us go meet that God Emperor Flying Snow.”
“Are we finally meeting him? This God Emperor Flying Swallow has been delaying for so much time that I feel impatient already.” God Emperor Fire Phoenix stood up.
“Cultivate your heart!” Cloud Phoenix City Master helplessly shook her head.
“I’m an innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Is there even a need for me to cultivate my heart?” God Emperor Fire Phoenix lightly snorted. Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, even the most ordinary ones, were born as an Emperor (God Emperor). One day, she met and befriended Cloud Phoenix City Master. With the help from Cloud Phoenix City Master, she gradually grasped her strength and perfected her control. And now, she had become a Grand Perfection God Emperor.
…
Xue Ying just sent God Emperor Flying Swallow away, and after sitting down for a while to ponder over the battle he had previously with God Emperor Flying Swallow when he suddenly felt two aura coming over.
“There are guests.” Xue Ying stood up.
“More guests?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin who was pouring wine for her teacher fell into a daze. She took back the wine flask and turned over, only to see two figures landing. One was a white-robed girl and the other a fiery-red-robed girl. These two clearly did not conceal their identities.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin was able to recognize them with a glance. She could not help but blurt out: “Cloud Phoenix City Master, God Emperor Fire Phoenix?”
Cloud Phoenix City Master… was the first ranker on the God Emperor Ranking List!
“God Emperor Flying Snow, shall we go and have a walk?” Cloud Phoenix City Master chuckled.
“I’d be delighted to!” Xue Ying laughed. He understood why Cloud Phoenix City Master came. Turning around, he gave his disciple a look, “Qing Yin, I’ll come back in a while.”
He then left with Cloud Phoenix City Master and God Emperor Fire Phoenix.
Imperial Wind Qing Yin looked up at everything.
“Teacher…” Imperial Wind Qing Yin murmured to herself.
Over these three days, under the orders of her Teacher, she had similarly met many Grand Perfection God Emperors.
And Imperial Wind Qing Yin had a weird feeling… that the gap between her and her teacher was simply too big! Imperial Wind Qing Yin even had a feeling that everything was simply a dream.
“It’s real. He is my teacher.” Imperial Wind Qing Yin said to herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1325 - Arrangements
chapters.content:
Chapter 1325: Arrangements
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Outside High Mountain City, deep in the Great Wilderness.
God Emperor Fire Phoenix stood by the side watching the battle. She was currently spectating the two--a white-robed male and a white-robed female standing in confrontation! Xue Ying and Cloud Phoenix City Master were both in white, just that their temperaments were entirely different. Cloud Phoenix City Master was currently emitting a vast aura that covered the world and suppressing everything. Even the world was trembling under her aura. As for Xue Ying, his aura felt illusory. At the same time, it made others revere him. After all, Xue Ying’s soul was unparalleled amongst all beneath ‘Chaotic Origin Experts’. Under this full-blown release of his aura, it gave off a sense of reverence.
“God Emperor Flying Snow, I hope that you can use your full strength. Ever since I reached my current realm, it has always been me bullying others in the Divine Realm. Never had there been another person who could threaten me at all.” Cloud Phoenix City Master was filled with fighting spirit.
“I’ll certainly not disappoint you, Cloud Phoenix City Master.” Xue Ying was similarly excited to battle.
“Hong!”
The eyes of Cloud Phoenix City Master sharpened, causing everything across a region of several million kilometers to distort. A terrifying fluctuation pervaded through every single part of this area.
Xue Ying heard an ear-piercing chirping sound as if it was a bird calling out! This chirp caused the world to distort. It also permeated into the body of Xue Ying, shaking his soul, his organs, and even made his muscles and bones shake. For a moment, Xue Ying could not control as his body softened down. This startled him greatly: ‘The moment this domain is executed, it actually caused my strength to drop by half? If she killed her way over, I might die after two to three moves!’
Compared to a true Grand Perfection God Emperor, his fleshy body was much weaker.
Cloud Phoenix City Master
‘Using her bloodline energy, she altered the laws of the world with her domain.’ Xue Ying thought.
The body of any Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform contained the manifestation of laws.
Hence, as long as these Grand Perfection God Emperor underwent the Ultimate Awakening and turning back through their ancestral roots, they would also become a member of the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Because their control of their bodies was stronger, they would immediately become ‘High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms’ the moment they broke through! And their Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body was like a ‘world’. For instance, the Broken Teeth Mountain Range was in actual fact, created from the corpses of the two huge Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
With a world as their body! They could naturally call down laws in their domains.
The strongest Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms could even injure ‘Yuan’. The body of these lifeforms was comparable to an Origin World.
Clearly, the domain released by Cloud Phoenix City Master at this moment had manifested part of the laws inherent in her bloodline! She had a great chance of undergoing an ‘Ultimate Awakening’ as compared to the other Grand Perfection God Emperors.
‘Mirage and Illusory Realm.’ With a thought, Xue Ying brought down a huge illusory realm that tried pulling the soul of Cloud Phoenix City Master within.
‘Mn?’ The expression of Cloud Phoenix City Master changed slightly. She immediately used up 70% of her heart force in resisting against this illusory realm, ‘What a formidable soul technique.’
Having to divert most of her heart force in resisting against the illusory realm, she was left with just 30% that could be used in battle. Hence, her strength had immediately started reducing.
The originally terrifying domain immediately dissipated!
Because this domain itself required Cloud Phoenix City Master to use 20% to 30% to maintain it. She naturally gave it up and focused more on exerting her own strength.
“Si--”
Cloud Phoenix City Master flew into the sky. Her hands swept out like wings.
The world split into two!
A black spear appeared in the hands of Xue Ying. Spinning his spear, Xue Ying formed layers of maelstroms that continually defended against the incoming blades produced by Cloud Phoenix City Master.
‘Fortunately.’ Xue Ying sighed in relief. When the domain dissipated, he could maintain his peak combat strength. As Cloud Phoenix City Master could only use 30% of her heart force, she could barely control just half her peak strength. This was comparable to the standard of Iron Dragon City Master.
Once the gap in their strength became this tiny, the profoundness of the realm and techniques could be used to easily cover it.
…
“Hong hong hong~”
The battlefield between both parties turned dark.
The strongest two existences in the Divine Realm were currently battling.
“Sister’s strength has actually dropped by such a huge extent?” God Emperor Fire Phoenix watched from afar with astonishment, “What a terrifying God Emperor Flying Snow. His soul technique is this frightening?”
Both parties fought to an equal.
The speed of Cloud Phoenix City Master was outstanding. Her techniques were beautifully executed too. Both her hands were like her wings, fleeting and sharp.
Nonetheless, Xue Ying was much more unpredictable. The surrounding space around him stacked up in layers under his control. As he wielded his spear, the surrounding space would occasionally be pressed down into a piece of paper! It would occasionally turn into a bubble prison! At times, it would even stack up in layers. Even though both parties seemed to be separated by an inch, they were as far as heaven and earth. As a result, Cloud Phoenix City Master could not touch Xue Ying at all!
And Xue Ying’s offense naturally became greater once they were executed in combination with many of these profound techniques.
Even though Cloud Phoenix City Master’s techniques were enchanting, she was still weaker by a level. She relied on her overwhelming strength to force the battle into a stalemate.
“Be careful!”
“Zhi Ya, what a close shave!” As God Emperor Fire Phoenix watched, she became nervous, “This God Emperor Flying Snow is simply too cunning. Fortunately, Sister’s body is strong enough.”
******
This battle persisted for an hour.
Only then did both parties stop.
To Xue Ying, the gains could be neglected! Because he had fought with other Grand Perfection God Emperors before, and the majority of those battles were conducted without the presence of the soul technique. The moment he unleashed his soul technique, the other party would immediately admit defeat.
“It has been so long since I was injured.” Cloud Phoenix City Master looked at Xue Ying with a rueful look, “Today, I have been injured several times by God Emperor Flying Snow.”
“Such injuries to City Master could be disregarded.” Xue Ying chuckled. Previously during the battle, Xue Ying had sensed that the body of Cloud Phoenix City Master was the strongest out of all Grand Perfection God Emperors he ever met. Even Iron Dragon City Master had a weaker body as compared to Cloud Phoenix City Master.
“Being injured by God Emperor Flying Snow shows that my techniques are not perfect.” Cloud Phoenix City Master commented happily.
She was unlike Ascendants.
Ascendants comprehended the Dao.
And she cultivated by digging out the potential of her bloodline energy. Once she reached grand perfection, she would then begin delving into the ‘laws’ inherent within her bloodline, applying them in battles. She even comprehended that terrifying domain and many other killing techniques! Nonetheless, during this battle, she discovered many of her flaws. Naturally, she sought to cover them.
And this process was also a process of improvement.
“Cloud Phoenix City Master, I have a matter which I have to trouble you for.” Xue Ying asked.
“Oh, do say.” Cloud Phoenix City Master answered.
“I hope that my disciple, ‘Imperial Wind Qing Yin’, could become your disciple.” Xue Ying was direct. He originally planned on leaving this world stealthily after his disciple reached the Early Stage God Emperor Realm. But now that his name had spread far and wide, it would definitely be better if he arranged things before leaving in case some enemies targeted his disciple.
“Imperial Wind Qing Yin?” Cloud Phoenix City Master was stunned momentarily. She looked at Xue Ying, “God Emperor Flying Snow, unless you are leaving this Divine Realm too?”
“Leaving?” Xue Ying was stunned.
Cloud Phoenix City Master continued: “In the history of the Divine Realm, there had been many Grand Perfection Ascendant God Emperors. But the moment they appear, they would disappear soon after. Reaching this level, it is impossible for them to die silently. There is no need for the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods to kill them either. I guess it must be they who left this world. God Emperor Flying Snow, you are an Ascendant too. Furthermore, your attainments in the Dao of Soul have reached an unfathomable level. I feel that you are much more amazing than all other Grand Perfection Ascendant God Emperors! And I find it normal that the three Great Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods would bring you away from this world.”
Xue Ying was silently startled.
He had guessed that this might be the case.
He could easily deduce it from various clues dispersed around the world. After all, there should have been Grand Perfection Ascendant God Emperors emerging in this world!
This time when so many experts came to visit him, Xue Ying had interacted with them and naturally understood that his guesses were right! Because these Grand Perfection God Emperors once fought with those terrifying Grand Perfection Ascendant God Emperors before.
‘Leaving this world? The three Great Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods?’ Xue Ying felt fear inwardly.
If he wanted to leave this world, he would prefer leaving himself.
Letting the three Great Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods bring him away?
Perhaps the three Great Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods might not have any unkind intentions and were simply helping him.
But they could possibly have some ‘plots’! And he would be doomed then! Comparatively speaking, Xue Ying trusted Luo City Lord and ‘Yuan’ more!
“The three Great Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods have never once contacted me before.” Xue Ying said, “But I still have to make some preparations. I am not assured about my disciple. Hence, I hope to gain your help, Cloud Phoenix City Master.”
“This is a minor matter.” Cloud Phoenix City Master said, “But I do have ambitions too. How about this, why not let Imperial Wind Qing Yin take my little sister, Fire Phoenix, as her teacher. My little sister isn’t a Native of the Divine Realm, and is an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform! Even though she could only execute a strength at the Grand Perfection God Emperor Level, her survival capabilities are much stronger than other Natives of the Divine Realm. Furthermore, she would not leave this Divine Realm.”
Xue Ying immediately revealed a joyous look: “Good good good! I wonder if God Emperor Fire Phoenix is willing to agree to it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1326 - Leaving The Divine Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 1326: Leaving The Divine Realm
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
In terms of survival capabilities.
Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were much better than Natives of the Divine Realm and Ascendants if everyone had the same strength.
The difficulty of killing some Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms with the strength of ‘Early Stage God Emperor’ or ‘Middle Stage God Emperor’ was very high. If this life form could unleash the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor, then it was impossible for anyone short of the three Great Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods to kill them. It was the case for Hidden Willow Valley Master and God Emperor Fire Phoenix .
“Rest assured. Fire Phoenix and I are close-knit sisters. Such minor affair is not a problem.” Cloud Phoenix City Master immediately turned to God Emperor Fire Phoenix.
“Sou.”
With a flash fire, God Emperor Fire Phoenix had already come close to them. She looked at Xue Ying with shock: “God Emperor Flying Snow, are you prepared to leave the Divine Realm already?”
“Not yet. I am just making my preparations.” Xue Ying said. The way he mentioned it was vague.
“Good, good, good. You can be at ease that your disciple will be protected by me!” God Emperor Fire Phoenix immediately nodded, thought she gave a cunning smile at the end, “But I have a request.”
“Do say.” Xue Ying said.
To the side, Cloud Phoenix City Master was momentarily shocked. Reaching their level, it was a very simple matter to accept and protect a disciple. Yet she wanted to ask for something in return? Given the identity of God Emperor Flying Snow, other Grand Perfection God Emperors would likely aid him since it was such a minor affair! It was only because she, Cloud Phoenix City Master, was the number one expert on the God Emperor Ranking List, that Xue Ying chose to ask her instead.
Hence, hearing that her little sister planned on asking for something in return, Cloud Phoenix City Master could not help but feel helpless.
“In the future if you were to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform, I hope you will remember to take me away from this world.” God Emperor Fire Phoenix looked at Xue Ying.
“Becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform?” Xue Ying chuckled, “Alright, I can promise you this. Just that do you trust me that much?”
“I feel that your chances of becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform is as miniscule as others.” God Emperor Fire Phoenix shook her head, “Hearsay it is incredibly difficult for Ascendants to breakthrough to the Chaotic Origin Lifeform as you guys do not have any Chaotic Origin Bloodline. But there should be some advantages you Ascendants have. Perhaps you might become one in the future? Wouldn’t that mean that my fate would change from then on?”
Xue Ying nodded with a smile: “Alright, I hope that your wish will be realized as well.”
He had a faint understanding.
That among all Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, these that were the most ordinary--God Emperors (Emperor Realm)--did not really have good days as well.
******
There was no time to lose.
Xue Ying was afraid that the three Great Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods might come and take him away. Just like how they took away the other Grand Perfection Ascendant God Emperors! Hence, on that day, Imperial Wind Qing Yin formally joined the tutelage of God Emperor Fire Phoenix.
“Disciple greets Teacher.” Even though Imperial Wind Qing Yin was slightly confused, she still obediently listened to Xue Ying’s words, and was currently taking in God Emperor Fire Phoenix as her teacher.
“Good, good, good.” As God Emperor Fire Phoenix looked at her new disciple, she found her quite satisfying, “I am planning to return to the Cloud Phoenix City today. You should follow me.”
Imperial Wind Qing Yin turned to Xue Ying with some hesitation.
She clearly trusted Xue Ying more.
“Go.” Xue Ying said, “I am planning to devote myself to cultivation in seclusion. Now that everyone knows me, High Mountain City is no longer an appropriate place for me to stay. I plan on leaving. You should go to Cloud Phoenix City. It is more appropriate for you to cultivate there.”
“Teacher plans on leaving?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin was startled. She was clearly unwilling to part with her teacher.
“We met in the past. And today is the time we part.” Xue Ying said.
“Alright.” God Emperor Fire Phoenix added from the side, “Your Teacher Flying Snow is planning on entering closed-door cultivation. You should not disturb him any longer. I’m afraid that when he enters closed-door cultivation this time, he’ll unlikely respond to you even when you send a transmission over.”
Xue Ying was startled for a while before nodding: “That’s right. This time, I am not willing to accept any form of disturbance during my cultivation.”
Imperial Wind Qing Yin was incredibly unwilling.
She could not even send any voice transmissions to her teacher?
“When can I see Teacher again?” Imperial Wind Qing Yin asked.
“Possibly a very very long time later.” Xue Ying felt complex in his heart.
He was unclear himself when he might see this disciple again once he left this world.
…
On that day itself as night came.
Xue Ying left behind a storage treasure for his female disciple before silently leaving.
“It is time for me to leave this world.”
Xue Ying stood in the Great Wilderness just outside High Mountain City. He was currently giving this city one last look.
After arriving in this world, Xue Ying had practically lived in seclusion within this place.
‘I should not delay any longer. The more I do, the more likely the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods might arrive to bring me away.’ Xue Ying immediately turned to the wristband on his arm. Blood inscriptions started appearing on it. Following that with a thought, Xue Ying activated it.
“Sou!”
A blood-red bubble wrapped around him completely.
Following that, his surroundings became blurred.
“Shua.”
He disappeared from this world and headed to the next.
******
Half a month after Xue Ying left this world.
The three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods stood amidst a piece of gold lightning. They were currently waiting patiently.
“He is here.” Golden Sacred Ancestral God said.
The three of them raised their heads.
Only to see a colossus object flying in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Only after it came close did it transform into a human. This was a thin old man with a sharp mouth and monkey-like cheeks.
“Big Brother Cheng.” Empress Heaven’s Will took the initiative to welcome him. Golden Sacred Ancestral God and Extreme Star Ancestral God followed closely behind. After all, in terms of social network, Empress Heaven’s Will had befriended many more Chaotic Origin Experts than the two of them. For instance, this incoming expert had an incredibly good relationship with Empress Heaven’s Will.
“Who would have thought that it is Big Brother Cheng who came personally this time.” Empress Heaven’s Will was incredibly enthusiastic, “Both you and I haven’t met for a very long time already, right?”
“Little Sister Heaven’s Will.” This thin old man cast away his beard, sighing, “It has indeed been a long time. Looking at Little Sister Heaven’s Will, it seems you are close to breaking through? Haha, by then, there is no need for you to be stationed in this Lightning World Tribe any longer.”
“How can I compare to Big Brother Cheng? Big Brother Cheng, are you responsible for this matter today? The Overlord actually let you come to bring that little fellow away?” Empress Heaven’s Will asked.
The thin old man was relatively delighted: “Currently, Big Brother has let me take on the role as a tiny patrol in the fifth region under the Overlord. Your Lightning World Tribe is currently within the fifth region, and is also within the region I am responsible for. Naturally, I came to greet and usher that little fellow.”
“Patrol?”
The three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods including Empress Heaven’s Will were shocked.
They had been ‘born as Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms’.
And the region governed by the Overlord totaled nine huge regions! A total of nine huge regions meant there were nine patrols!
Chaotic Origin Experts were split into two categories.
The first category included Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Like those who had a Chaotic Origin Bloodline and had undergone an Ultimate Awakening, because their ancestors could be traced back to an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform, they themselves would return back to their ancestral roots once they completed the Ultimate Awakening. As a result, they would join the tribe of their ancestors, becoming an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
As for the second category, they included cultivators who cultivated step by step from scratch. They would either grasp an Origin World and step into the Chaotic Origin Level, or they forced their way through to the next level. Those of the second category were usually stronger.
Comparatively speaking…
Those of the first category were discriminated.
For him to take on the responsibility as a ‘patrol’ meant he was absolutely a great general under the Overlord.
“Big Brother Cheng is truly amazing! If I recall correctly, the other eight patrols aren’t Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, right? Big Brother is born as an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform yet you could become a patrol. This is truly amazing!”
“Big Brother Cheng.” Both Golden Sacred Ancestral God and Extreme Star Ancestral God could not help but flatter the other party.
Nonetheless, this came from their inner hearts.
This Big Brother Cheng was definitely the pride of their tribe!
“It is the Overlord who knows how to appreciate us.” The thin old man stroked his beard, “Oh right, where is that little fellow at? Is it truly the case that he is as you said, so powerful in his soul that he could cause a cultivator with Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body to suffer from great injuries?”
“How do we ever dare to lie about such a huge thing! Big Brother Cheng, please, come and have a seat. We will immediately bring that little fellow known as God Emperor Flying Snow over.” Empress Heaven’s Will said.
The three of them brought this patrol over to their residence first.
At the same time, they multi-tasked and began searching for that God Emperor Flying Snow in the Divine Realm.
“Mn? He isn’t at the High Mountain City?”
“Where is God Emperor Flying Snow?”
“Where is he?”
The three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods examined the Divine Realm and were shocked by what they sensed.
Following that, they immediately scour through the entire Divine Realm! They even checked through the entire Lightning World Cluster.
Nothing. Nothing. They could not find him at all!
“He is gone?” The thin old man stroked his beard with a frown.
“Right. He had abruptly disappeared after entering the Great Wilderness just outside High Mountain City.” Empress Heaven’s Will and the other two Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods were incredibly nervous. They had executed all kinds of methods they had, and succeeded in tracing down to the final scene where Xue Ying left. Nonetheless, they merely ‘saw’ Xue Ying arriving at the Great Wilderness before disappearing from the world. As for the scene of that blood-red bubble appearing, that was something they could not trace down at all.
“For him to disappear so silently without the three of you discovering it either.” The thin old man frowned. In his heart, he had a feeling of what just happened.
Being an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform, for him to reach his high position and be on the same level as other Chaotic Origin Experts who had grasped an Origin World showed how extraordinary he was.
“The three of you are truly… you should have captured him immediately the moment you discovered him.” The thin old man frowned.
“We have never thought that it is possible for him to disappear from the Lightning World Cluster.” Empress Heaven’s Will and the other two felt helpless. They had some postulations about what had happened, yet no matter what, they did not dare to intrude into this matter any longer.
The thin old man stood: “Alright. Let this end here. I have to report to the Overlord.”
Saying that, the thin old man waved his sleeves before breaking apart this Divine Realm and left for the vast Chaotic Origin Dimension.

chapters.title: Chapter 1327 - (Final Volume) Ravenous Hunger
chapters.content:
Chapter 1327: (Final Volume) Ravenous Hunger
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The blood-red bubble wrapped around Xue Ying and was moving at a terrifying speed through the Chaotic Origin Dimension.
“Shua shua shua” , it passed through many huge Origin Worlds. Those Origin Worlds were also becoming blurred in the vision of Xue Ying--they simply flashed past his eyes.
‘This is the second time, yet I still find this speed to be exaggeratedly fast.’ Xue Ying had a feeling that if a grit of Chaotic Origin Sand were to move at this speed and smash onto his body, he would likely turn into smithereens!
This time, he flew past a total of more than 1,200 Origin Worlds. It was much further than before.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying was greatly shocked with his eyes wide opened.
Previously as he advanced forward, there were connecting threads of cracks through the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Those cracks extended for hundreds of billions of kilometers--it was much longer than any single Origin World. Xue Ying could not even see the end with his eyes. These void cracks looked savage and had been present across a huge region. It seemed to Xue Ying like they had divided the Chaotic Origin Dimension into two.
“Sou!”
The blood-red bubble continued flying over at high speed. As it got close to those void cracks, Xue Ying saw an unremarkably small world amidst it.
This world was so very small! It was like a lone island amidst the sea. Xue Ying only spotted it at the moment when the bubble rushed into this unremarkable ‘tiny world’. Xue Ying did not have the time to discern the shape of this tiny world when he was already in it. He merely felt that this tiny world could be destroyed any time by the shockwaves formed from the void cracks left behind surrounding it.
…
“Weng.”
At the moment he entered this world.
Xue Ying felt the scene change before his very eyes.
This was a relatively wide ancient palace. At the corner of the palace was an array.
He was currently standing at the center of this array.
“Another cultivator is here again?” A tall and thin black-robed male appeared within the palace. He walked towards Xue Ying with a smile.
‘Not good.’ Xue Ying did not have the time to speak when he found part of his fleshy body collapsing apart.
Having experienced it the previous time, Xue Ying did not panic. He understood that it was due to the difference in the laws of this world as compared to the Lightning World previously.
“Haha, your fleshy body is unable to be maintained any longer?” The black-robed male chuckled, “This world has different laws as compared to yours back at your hometown. You have to adapt to the laws of this world. Adapting to the different laws… is incredibly beneficial to the eventual step of breaking through to the Chaotic Origin Level! After all, Chaotic Origin Laws could be used in any region.”
Xue Ying could hardly care about speaking. He directed all his attention towards adapting to the laws of this world.
He was currently altering his fleshy body according to the laws.
An hour later.
Xue Ying’s fleshy body deteriorated to the ‘Middle Stage God Emperor Realm’. But at least it was completely stabilized.
‘Seems to me that I’d have to spend at least a million years to recover my fleshy body back to its Late Stage God Emperor Realm.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Though I should be able to attain an unstable form of Late Stage God Emperor body at a much faster speed.’
Xue Ying should be able to maintain a Late Stage God Emperor fleshy body in about eight to ten years!
To this, Xue Ying was relatively delighted. This whole process of cultivating back his realm would allow him to deepen his understanding of the Dao of Void. It would also hasten the pace of reaching the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body. As for ‘becoming a Chaotic Origin’? Xue Ying was temporarily not in a rush. His first target was to attain a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body using the Dao of Void first. As for his ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’, Xue Ying planned on reaching the final realm first!
“Dao Friend, have you stabilized your fleshy body?” The black-robed male said when he saw Xue Ying open his eyes.
Xue Ying was momentarily stunned.
Dao Friend?
“This one is called Flying Snow. You are?” Xue Ying asked. He could not feel any strand of aura from this person before him.
“Haha, I am the hall spirit of this Guiding Hall.” The black-robed male chuckled.
“Hall spirit?” Xue Ying nodded slightly. He then asked with some perplexity, “Guiding Hall?”
“Guiding, to guide. It is naturally meant to guide all you Ascendants that enter this world.” The black-robed male chuckled, “I reckon that there should be some legends in your worlds! Different worlds would have different legends. Some say this is the ‘Cultivation Holy Land’, and others mention this as a ‘World of Despair’. Some even call this the ‘Exiled World’ or the ‘Land of Survival’. Regardless, surviving here is not easy, yet it is relatively helpful to your cultivation.”
Xue Ying was inwardly shocked when he heard that.
World of Despair?
Exiled World
These two names represented that this world would likely not be as comfortable as the Lightning World he previously were. And what did he mean by ‘surviving is not easy’?
“Dao Friend, please have a look.” The black-robed male waved his hand after saying that, causing the illusory scene of a shrunken version of the world to appear.
“Danger exists in every location of this world.” The black-robed male pointed out to this shrunken world, “These five areas flashing with lights are also the five assembly places for cultivators! These are also the only safe places to live and cultivate in peace. Once you are out of any assembly spot, you will find danger around you. There exists an innumerable amount of Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, and all of them are seeking to hunt you cultivators down.”
Xue Ying could not help blurting out: “Innumerable?”
The Broken Teeth Mountain Range had a total of several dozens of Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
Even though the Lightning World had more, they were still absolutely inferior! The Natives of the Divine Realm and Ascendants living in the Lightning World held absolute advantage.
But this world…
It seemed that there were a pitiful number of cultivators congregated in five different locations? And all other regions were filled with Chaotic Origin Lifeforms?
“How many are there?” Xue Ying could not help but ask, “10,000? 100,000?”
“The Gold Devil River spans across the entire world. Within this river lives around 30,000 Chaotic Origin Lifeforms alone. Have a look at this map, there are so many other areas bigger than the Gold Devil River.” The black-robed male said, “As for how many are there exactly, I cannot give you an answer. Oh right, this here--’Sea of Abyss’, is an area you must never get close to.”
The black-robed male pointed to a piece of black sea solemnly.
This sea did not seem to cover a huge region--approximately one-tenth of the entire map.
“The Sea of Abyss is the most dangerous place in the entire world. You must remind yourself never to enter the Sea of Abyss at all.” The black-robed male said, “Even after you become the strongest expert of this world, you still must not enter that place.”
“Why not?” Xue Ying asked.
“It’s a forbidden ground! Rest assured, once you go to the assembly locations, you will know. Those who live for long in this world are clear how terrifying this Sea of Abyss is.” The black-robed male said.
Xue Ying nodded.
Following that, his expression changed. He felt his stomach grumbling.
“So hungry.” Ever since Xue Ying broke became a Transcendent Lifeform, he had never had this intense feeling of hunger before.
But at this moment.
He could feel a ravenous hunger carrying impulses from his stomach to his entire body, seemingly telling him that it needed food now! This ravenous hunger engulfed his entire body, making Xue Ying tremble.
This feeling of hunger was becoming stronger by the second.
“Food.” Xue Ying flipped his hand. He had some fruits within his storage wristband. Flipping his hand, a huge red fruit appeared. He devoured it in two mouths, yet after it got digested, it did not seem to have any effects on resolving his hunger.
“I’ve said before.” The black-robed male grinned when he saw this, “Surviving in this world is not easy! Under the laws, the stronger the sentient being, the more food he requires. Otherwise, this feeling of hunger will only become stronger until he succumbs to it!”
“Succumb to hunger?” Xue Ying was stunned.
It was possible for those at their level to die from hunger?
“Ordinary food is useless. If you wish to satiate your hunger, there is practically only one option--to kill those Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms and eat their meat! There is sufficient energy held in the flesh of the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Only then could you ensure your survival.” The black-robed male said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1328 - The Journey
chapters.content:
Chapter 1328: The Journey
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
So hungry!
His stomach was even starting to consume the energy in his body. If this continued on, his fleshy body and muscles would soon be digested, turning him into a bag of skeleton. Half a year later and he would have completely used up his energy reserve, resulting in death.
Xue Ying could not care about anything else now. He immediately diverted part of the energy of his body towards his stomach to satiate his hunger temporarily. Coming to this world, due to the difference in laws, his body had dropped down by a realm, becoming just a Middle Stage God Emperor! And now, he was dissolving part of the structure of his body into energy.
“How long do you think you can survive just with your fleshy body?” The black-robed male sneered at Xue Ying from the side, “How can your weak little fleshy body compare with that of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform? You all are ultimately weaklings that have yet to jump out of the cage. Those Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms might not be intelligent and have not dug out much of their potential--which as a result, are stuck at the God Emperor Level. But they are born in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Every single piece of their body contains energy comparable to that stored within Chaotic Origin Crystals. Only by eating their meat could you satiate your hunger! Hence, you should hurry up and go hunt down some Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.”
Xue Ying nodded.
There was some qualitative differences between their fleshy bodies with those of Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
It was only due to the difference of their realms that made them comparable to Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms in strength.
“Alright.” The black-robed male said, “You should hurry up and choose one of the five great assembly locations to go to. I’ll send you to a place close to one of them. And you have to escape to the inner section of the assembly location all by yourself.”
“Escape?” Xue Ying understood why the other party said that.
“Yes. Chaotic Origin Lifeforms are rife in this world. Even though I might send you to a location close to one of the assembly locations, you would still face ambushed by the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. This is also the simplest trial. If you could not survive, you would simply be eaten by the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms! That would mean an end to your path of cultivation. I believe you should not be willing to die like this after bitterly cultivating to this stage and even coming to this world, right?” The black-robed male chuckled, “If you aren’t willing to resign yourself to fate, then you should prepare yourself well. The moment you give permission for me to send you over, I’ll immediately do so.”
“How long can I stay here for?” Xue Ying asked.
“It is getting dark soon.” The black-robed male looked outside, “Once the sky brightens, I’ll have to send you off no matter what.”
“Alright.”
Xue Ying nodded.
He could not care about anything else now. Xue Ying immediately sat down and began recovering his strength.
He had to leave when the sky brightens?
If he wanted to recover his previous Chaotic Origin Refinement Body, it would take at least eight to ten years before he could maintain it at the ‘Late Stage God Emperor’ Realm. This slight bit of time was definitely not sufficient.
But ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique’ was something he should be able to succeed in grasping according to the laws of this world given his current Dao of Void Realm before dawn! As long as he created a version of ‘Great Destruction Realm Teleportation’ Technique’ that could be executed in this world, his survivability would greatly increase.
“Si la.” Xue Ying immediately sat down. He lightly waved his hand, causing the void to form ripples. Xue Ying could even see the membrane of this world faintly. Beyond those walls contained turbulent Chaotic Origin Energy and many mysterious inscriptions that seemed like chains swimming in the sea. Seeing the dense number of mysterious inscription shackles stifled Xue Ying. He even felt that he could not resist against it at all.
It was not just a difference of one level.
“What are you doing?” The black-robed male laughed, “Researching on the void? Are you planning on researching out a void penetration technique?”
Xue Ying looked at him with bewilderment.
“You should just forget about that. Many Ascendants have come to this sacred world from other worlds. Those who have arrived here are at least Late Stage God Emperors.” The black-robed male explained, “There are bloodline cultivators, cultivators who comprehend the Dao, cultivators who refined the world… cultivators with different paths. There are even some who specialize in movement movement techniques! Nonetheless, it is impossible to penetrate through the void in this sacred world!”
The black-robed male shook his head, “Nobody could do so! Comparatively speaking, it is much easier to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.”
“It is impossible for us to teleport?” Xue Ying’s expression changed slightly.
If that’s the case, then this world was very much dangerous. The moment he fell into a predicament of being attacked by a group of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, it would be hard for him to escape out of it.
“Don’t your worlds call this place an ‘Exiled Land’ or the ‘World of Despair’? If everyone could penetrate through the void, how can this world be qualified to bring despondence to everyone?” The black-robed male teased.
…
Even though the hall spirit of this palace told Xue Ying about it, Xue Ying remained seated there and giving it a try.
After attempting for two hours later, Xue Ying confirmed that the other party had not lied.
‘What a terrifying suppression.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘This suppression comes in various aspects like gravity. It is fine if this suppression is more intense by a thousand times as compared to the Lightning World. The void is even sealed shut, making it completely impossible to penetrate through the void.’
In the previous Lightning World, teleportation and great movement techniques had been suppressed. However, in this world, even the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique was completely forbidden.
It seemed the world that Yuan sent him in was gradually becoming more cruel.
“I prefer calling this world the Sacred World.” That black-robed male harped on, “To you cultivators, even though this world is much more dangerous, it is filled with greater opportunities! The voluminous amount of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms is also an opportunity for all of you. If you grasped it properly, it’ll be possible for you to reach the Chaotic Origin Level. Hence, even though this place is a World of Despair, it is also a holy land for cultivation!”
Xue Ying chuckled. He turned his attention to researching on his Chaotic Origin Refinement Body.
The sky darkened…
And once the night ended, the sky brightened.
“It is time to leave.” The black-robed male said, “Choose an assembly location.”
Xue Ying stood up. He sighed inwardly. It was just a short night, and the improvement to his Chaotic Origin Refinement Body was simply negligible.
“Where did the previous Ascendant go?” Xue Ying had a thought and immediately asked.
“The previous one?” The black-robed male chuckled, “It’s the Scarlet Cloud City.”
“Then I shall go to the Scarlet Cloud City too.” Xue Ying answered.
There was a huge possibility that the previous Ascendant of this world was Great Emperor North River!
Because it had not been too long since Great Emperor North River came to this world.
“Alright.” The black-robed male waved his hand and engulfed Xue Ying, “Go. I hope you can live for a longer period in this world.”
******
Xue Ying felt his surroundings change. When he appeared, he found himself standing amidst the wilderness.
He was surrounded by overgrown weeds that were taller than humans.
“Mn?” Xue Ying gradually floated up. He floated to a height taller than the surrounding thicket, casting his gaze far and wide.
With his vision, he could easily spot a grand city some distance away. This was none other than one of the five assembly locations in this ‘Cultivation Sacred World’.
‘I have to rush to that city. Hearing from that hall spirit, there are some Ascendants who died before reaching the assembly location?’ Xue Ying thought. Hearsay those who could ascend to this world were at least a Late Stage God Emperor! Clearly, all of them had cultivated to a profound stage and had come here seeking to reach a higher level.
‘I have to be careful.’
“Sou.”
Xue Ying completely concealed his aura before executing the Void Devil Insect Body Technique and proceeded in the direction of the city.
His figure had completely fused into the void. Even the naked eyes could not see Xue Ying.
‘What a powerful suppression.’ Xue Ying murmured inwardly. The suppression was simply too strong. His flying speed in this world was way slower than it was at the Lightning World! Any single piece of rock in the Lightning World could not be moved by a True God. Yet the gravity here was a thousand times stronger.
“Chi.”
Suddenly, an illusory figure appeared in the distance. It stared at Xue Ying.
Xue Ying was startled: ‘I am discovered.’
He had completely concealed his aura and fused into the void. Nonetheless, he was still discovered by a lifeform.
At this moment, Xue YIng could not care less. He immediately executed his illusory realm domain. Compared to his ‘Void Domain’, his soul technique now was much stronger! Xue Ying sent his domain over as a probe. He had temporarily not attacked the lifeform.
“Sou sou sou…”
The region covered by the illusory realm domain was huge--a full half a million kilometers.
When this came down.
Xue Ying discovered with shock that other than the Chaotic Origin Lifeform that was staring at him, at this moment, many other Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were rushing in his direction within this half a million kilometers region. Furthermore, there were many other Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that were entering his illusory realm domain currently!
It appeared that these Chaotic Origin Lifeforms belonged to the same tribe.
All of them had a half-translucent body with violet spots on it. Almost every single part of their bodies were formed by the manifestation of shadow and death. This was clearly a race specialized in shadow and death. They had differing degrees of aura, and the strongest of them could match those on the level of ‘Fire Phoenix God Emperor’. Furthermore, Xue Ying’s illusory realm domain had easily discovered a total of 53 Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, of which 16 had reached the Grand Perfection God Emperor Level!
‘So cunning.’ Xue Ying was frightened by what he perceived, ‘It is actually summoning its companions? And it is so terrifying?’
Currently, Chaotic Origin Lifeforms of the same race were pouring into the region of Xue Ying’s illusory realm domain.
‘I can’t care less anymore’.
‘Kill!’
Xue Ying fled to the side at high speed while at the same time, executing the third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique. He no longer dared to delay any further.

chapters.title: Chapter 1329 - Assist
chapters.content:
Chapter 1329: Assist
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm Killing Technique. That was a technique that would cause even Grand Perfection God Emperors in the Lightning World to tense up.
At this current juncture, the moment the technique was executed.
Those vicious Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that killed their way over, felt a tremendous illusory realm pulling on their souls. Being Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, their souls were naturally much stronger than cultivators who had yet to reach the Chaotic Origin Level! But, they were the most ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Instead, their willpower was inferior to these low-graded cultivators!
“Weng, weng, weng.”
At this moment, there were 61 Chaotic Origin Lifeforms in the region of Xue Ying’s domain. Eight fell instantaneously from the illusory realm.
These eight were the weakest of them all. All of them were approximately Middle Stage God Emperors! Their souls were comparatively the weakest, and their willpower the most lacking in the bunch of lifeforms. They could not withstand the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique at all--they were exterminated instantaneously!
But the other lifeforms had resisted the illusion!
Since those that could exert the strength of a Late Stage God Emperor could resist against the illusion, there was no need to talk about those with the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor.
‘The survival capability of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms are much stronger than the Natives of the Divine Realm. It is much stronger than even cultivators.’ Xue Ying sighed ruefully. He had known that killing an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform was an arduous task. In the Lightning World, any Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms with the combat strength of a ‘Grand Perfection God Emperor’ like Fire Phoenix God Emperor and Hidden Willow Valley Master would only be killed by the three Chaotic Origin Ancestral Gods.
Their foundation was too solid and robust.
Their fleshy bodies were innately strong and their souls outrageously powerful.
They were only lacking in their realm and willpower.
“This cultivator is very terrifying.”
“This soul technique…”
These translucent Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were currently conversing with one another.
Even though those with the strength of a Late Stage God Emperor could maintain consciousness, they had to divert 70% to 80% of their heart force to resist against it. Hence, their strength were greatly weakened, and their speed temporarily slowed.
“Sou! Sou! Sou!” As for those Chaotic Origin Lifeforms with the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor, they did not seem to slow down at all and were continuing their charge at Xue Ying.
“Hu.”
