“Previously, he relied on coercion tactics and now he still dares to come?”
“That Xie Fan is simply thick-skinned.”
“He is Xie Fan! In terms of shamelessness, he is ranked in the top few within the city.” These cultivators murmured between each other.
…
Xue Ying was currently within the garden receiving the incoming guests.
The garden occupied a region spanning 50 kilometers. There were more than a thousand tables with praying mats scattered across the place. Some were by the side of the lake, and some were at the body of the mountain! Cultivators that came to participate in the auction this time casually found a place to sit. They started drinking some of the good wine prepared by Xue Ying, waiting silently for the auction to begin! Those wine tasted slightly more ordinary. Xue Ying had simply created them from within the Mirage Cosmos. Hence, he had a huge amount of them!
“Brother Flying Snow, why did you not simply disregard that Xie Fan? He’ll definitely remember this vengeance.” A cultivator who was conversing with Xue Ying asked.
“Remember this vengeance? Previously, he threatened me to trade with him. At that time, we have already become enemies! Why do you think I’m still afraid of him?” Xue Ying shook his head with disdain, “But what is unexpected is for him to actually think of visiting my cavern-dwelling today after becoming enemies? What a joke.”
Reality speaking.
Xue Ying felt that this person called ‘Xie Fan’ was quite a marvel!
It was normal for some experts to be vicious and cruel. It was also fine that great devils were unscrupulous and ruthless. But this ‘Xie Fan’ was a two-faced person. He would usually backstab the other party without caring about his reputation. One had to know that the female expert that coerced Xue Ying earlier, ‘Mo Shu’, was too lazy to deal with him after Xue Ying forced her away. She was even too lazy to come participate in this auction!
Experts had their pride.
But Xie Fan… belonged to a category of those that did not have pride. He was someone nefarious!
When that cultivator saw this happening, he laughed: “Then you should be a little more careful. He isn’t someone you can provoke easily.”
“I understand. Many thanks, Brother You Ya.” Xue Ying chuckled.
Time passed.
As the guests came, Xue Ying briefly welcomed them and occasionally chatted for a few sentences.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying’s pupils suddenly dilated. He saw a person coming in from afar.
“North River?” Xue Ying was hugely startled.
“God Monarch Flying Snow.” Great Emperor North River entered with a smile, “You have forbidden that Xie Fan from entering. Initially, I thought I could not enter either.”
“I wouldn’t have thought that you would come. Hence, I did not inform my guards.” Xue Ying said.
“Both you and I came from the same world. We are fated. Is there any need for you and I to talk about killing each other?” Great Emperor North River said, “Both you and I are pursuing after the dream of jumping out of the cage and becoming a Chaotic Origin. Furthermore, in this Sacred World, it is at least forbidden to kill within the city. How do you think about temporarily placing aside our grievances…?”
Xue Ying looked at Great Emperor North River.
Great Emperor North River was wearing green. His eyes were filled with sincerity.
But Xue Ying was clear… this Great Emperor North River was someone ambitious and ruthless! That time back at Broken Teeth Mountain Range, he actually backstabbed Xue Ying simply because he wanted to.
“Do you think I still trust you?” Xue Ying sneered, “The consequences would most likely be for you to sneak attack me at a particular time.”
“You don’t trust me this much?” Great Emperor North River felt helpless.
“Hmph.” Xue Ying sneered, “It is very simple for you to make me trust you. Just give me the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet.”
In the past, Great Emperor North River had once been pursued after him and was forced to leave the Broken Teeth Mountain Range. Hence, the energy of that Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet would most likely not be fully consumed yet.
“This is definitely not possible.” Great Emperor North River shook his head, “This is the most precious treasure I have. How can I give it to you?”
For it to be left behind by one of the two terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, ‘Thousand-Eyed Existence’, which was incarnated as the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, Great Emperor North River with his more knowledgeable wisdom understood how much more precious that ‘Thousand-Eyed Existence’ was compared to these ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. That was a Chaotic Origin Lifeform with a strength close to ‘Yuan’s. The value of that Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet… was most likely be worth a few times compared to the corpse of a Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
How could he give it to Xue Ying?
“No matter what, let us just place aside our grievances in this Sacred World. Time can validate my words.” Great Emperor North River said with a smile before walking away. He simply found a place to sit and began drinking.
Xue Ying looked at him.
He did not expel him.
There was no need to!
‘We shall see.’ Xue Ying temporarily placed this matter aside.
…
After a while.
Xue Ying saw the sky color, and watched as many experts had gathered in various sections of the garden. Today, a total of 600 over cultivators had come. That was close to 20% of the experts in the entire Scarlet Cloud City! In reality, those who came to fight for the auction were even fewer.
“Fellow cultivators.”
Xue Ying’s voice sounded across every section in the garden, “I shall not delay any further. Let this auction begin! This time, the object being auctioned is this Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse.”
Saying that, he waved his hand.
At that moment, a corpse that was likened to a 200 meters over volcano landed on the ground. It immediately attracted the attention of all 600 cultivators present. Of which some showed a fervent desire in their gaze!
“The minimum bid is three different Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeforms at the Grand Perfection God Emperor level. Every single minimum increment is fixed at 100,000 cubic meters of food. And now, fellow cultivators could call out your price.” Xue Ying said.
“Three corpses.” The one that started bidding was a green-robed girl. Her voice was enchanting.
“Four corpses!” A red-haired male simply said. This red-haired male had a grand aura. Even amidst many experts in this garden, his aura remained tyrannical and powerful. Xue Ying knew that he should be one of the wealthiest cultivators participating in the auction today. He called himself ‘Great Emperor Heaven Calamity’. In terms of strength, he was close to that of the three City Masters. He once fought with the three City Masters and was able to fight to a draw.
Hence, it was agreed publicly that his strength lay in the top five!
And he was also the strongest existence with a flame lineage within Scarlet Cloud City! As he was a Dao Cultivator too, it was natural for him to desire this Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse that did not exist within this Sacred World.
“Five corpses.”
“Five corpses with 100,000 cubic meters of food.”
“Five corpses with 200,000 cubic meters of food.”
After the price rose to five corpses, it no longer increased by a lot.
Xue Ying listened silently.
“Five corpses with one million cubic meters of food.” It was a black-robed male who reported this price. He was also ranked in the top dozens within Scarlet Cloud City, an expert called ‘Yan Yang’.
“Five corpses and two million cubic meters of food.” The red-haired Great Emperor Heaven Calamity coldly stated.
“Six corpses.” The black-robed male ‘Yan Yang’ continued calling out the price calmly.
Great Emperor Heaven Calamity glanced at him before saying: “Six corpses and one million cubic meters of food.”
Yan Yang went silent after that.
At that moment, there was no longer new prices being called.
“Are there any higher bids?” Xue Ying finally spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 1337 - Breakthrough in Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 1337: Breakthrough in Strength
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
The place remained silent.
“If there is no higher price, this Flame Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse will belong to Great Emperor Heaven Calamity…” Xue Ying swept his gaze across the surroundings. After several breaths did he finally declare, “Good, this auction ends here! This Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse belongs to Great Emperor Heaven Calamity from now on.”
The moment he finished speaking.
That red-haired Great Emperor Heaven Calamity took a step before appearing by the side of Xue Ying with a flash of red light. He threw over a storage treasure to Xue Ying directly. Following that, he waved his hand and collected that volcano-like Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse and left the place.
“Mn?” Xue Ying immediately examined through the storage treasure. When he did so, he revealed a joyous look.
Within this Storage Eden Treasure were many corpses of huge Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. There was still a grand aura coming off from them--it was way stronger than the aura that came from the one he sold! This was mainly due to the tribal life of these Chaotic Origin Lifeforms here. Each tribe contained a voluminous number of lifeforms. In addition, the one he sold could not be found in the Sacred World. That was the reason he could exchange for so many other corpses.
…
“Damn!” Within his cavern-dwelling, a short and small old man who sat cross-legged with a frosty look, ‘Xie Fan’, had gotten a piece of news at the earliest moment from his good friend.
Even though the reputation of Xie Fan was awful and he was a nefarious person…
There were other experts within Scarlet Cloud City that did not really care about this nefarious personality of Xie Fan. Even though the experts might sneer in their hearts when they befriended Xie Fan, they still paid a great deal of attention to him for he was powerful! Xie Fan could even be ranked in the top 10 among all experts within Scarlet Cloud City. How powerful was he? Xie Fan was even the left and right arm of the City Master ‘Weather Leaf’. Hence, it was natural for a group of experts to maintain a good relationship with Xie Fan, sending the piece of news regarding the conclusion of the auction to him.
“Six Grand Perfection God Emperor corpses and one million cubic meters of food. Heaven Calamity is truly wealthy.” Xie Fan sneered, “In the end, that Flying Snow took advantage of him.”
In the eyes of Xie Fan.
Cultivators could be grouped according to those that were weak and those that were strong!
He felt that ‘Flying Snow’s strength was very ordinary. He did not have the qualifications to earn that huge sum of wealth! He was showing a great deal of respect for being willing to exchange for that corpse with three Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses of his. This was also due to the prohibition in Scarlet Cloud City. Otherwise, he would have simply killed the other party and snatched his treasures.
‘Hmph hmph, I shall let him revel in it first. It is impossible for him to remain in the city eternity.’ Xie Fan thought.
…
“Sister, the auction is completed. Its selling price is beyond the limit of what we can bear. Great Emperor Heaven Calamity bought it using six corpses coupled with a million cubic meters of food.”
“Go back first.”
On an enormous ice bed.
There was a black-robed beauty seated on it. She was the other expert that had coerced Xue Ying before for his treasure, ‘Mo Shu’. She did not attend the auction at all. She had even asked several good friends of hers to bid for the item.
“Damn, I can only think of a way to trade with Heaven Calamity. Once he no longer needs that corpse, I believe he would be willing to sell it to me.” The eyes of Mo Shu were burning in flames.
How long would one take to examine and comprehend a complete Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse?
It was hard to say!
Because a cultivator that had not become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform would never be able to comprehend the manifested laws on the corpse of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. This was also the reason why he did not bring out that Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse he got from the Crown Prince of Iron Dragon Hall to trade. Even though Xue Ying’s gain in comprehending that corpse was becoming lower and lower over time, he would definitely not part with it so easily.
Xue Ying would wait until his current realm advance to the next stage before comprehending the corpse again!
…
As the auction reached its end, many cultivators began leaving from Xue Ying’s cavern-dwelling.
Great Emperor North River glanced at Xue Ying for a while before leaving too, though he felt the pressure in his heart: ‘This Ying Shan Xue Ying has great talent. He has cultivated for a very short period in the Realm Heart Great Land, yet his strength using the Dao of Void is comparable to mine! His soul technique is even unrivalled across many worlds. At least until now, I haven’t heard of someone that could compare with him in terms of soul techniques.’
Great Emperor North River was indeed feeling huge pressure from Xue Ying.
More importantly!
Xue Ying’s improvement was too quick.
‘Back at the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, he is far weaker than me.’
‘At the Lightning World, he is able to force me to escape.’
‘Here in this Sacred World where Chaotic Origin Lifeforms exist in large numbers, he should be able to cultivate and secure more resources easily. I believe he would improve and reach the next stage? If he has succeeded in refining a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body in conjunction with that terrifying soul technique of his, who would be his opponent?’ Great Emperor North River sighed inwardly, ‘Fortunately, it is hard for they-Dao Cultivators-to refine their fleshy body to that of a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform! It is at least a hundred to a thousand times harder than we who cultivate in our bloodlines.’
With a Chaotic Origin Bloodline in their body, it meant they had a basic foundation built into it.
All they needed to do was to dig out the potential!
And Dao Cultivators… had to grasp the laws and profound mysteries before creating a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body Technique from scratch! The difficult was much higher.
‘Xie Fan? Hmph hmph, I believe he would definitely have a miserable time after becoming enemies with this Ying Shan Xue Ying.’ Great Emperor North River sneered coldly. He had already decided to do his utmost in evading Xue Ying within this world. Regardless, he could always activate the imprint on his wristband to head to the third world, ‘In this world, Ying Shan Xue Ying would not dare to act as long as we remain in the city. But it’ll be free for all once we go out of the city.’
‘As long as I can reach the Chaotic Origin Level, hmph, what would a little Ying Shan Xue Ying be?’
Great Emperor North River immediately threw the thought of vengeance to the back of his mind.
To him, becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform is more important!
******
After the auction ended, Xue Ying began his days of keeping a low profile.
With a total of six Grand Perfection God Emperor Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, he would have a huge harvest from researching them! All kinds of comprehensions began accumulating in his mind. As he had sufficient food, Xue Ying began his patient cultivation within his cavern-dwelling.
60,000 years after he came to this world, he had regained the strength of his body back to the ‘Late Stage God Emperor’ level. It was absolutely stable.
But following that…
Xue Ying fell into a bottleneck.
The difficulty of breakthrough from ‘Late Stage God Emperor’ to a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform body was simply too great. Xue Ying could feel his comprehensions deepening over time, yet he just could not grasp a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body.
‘Let’s not talk about a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body. I can’t even boost my strength to that of a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body temporarily.’ Xue Ying understood where the problem lay.
Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body.
This represented a perfect body one could have below the ‘Chaotic Origin Lifeform’ Level! Theoretically, it was a stage where one could no longer have any improvement.
Want to break through?
That’ll be forcing through to the next level! It would enable the cultivator to reach the highest ‘Overlord’ Realm amongst all Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, with countless time-space territories under their governance! Being protected by them!
‘Let’s take it slowly.’
Xue Ying was incredibly patient.
He first thoroughly comprehended all the miscellaneous parts he had completely, spending a total of 80 million years.
Following that, he began analysing the Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses he had--a total of six of them. Xue Ying spent a total of three billion years to do so.
Following that, he continued with a more detailed analysis and corroboration…
‘Grand Perfection.’
‘A body of absolute perfection beneath the level of Chaotic Origin Lifeform?’
As Xue Ying accumulated in experience, he gradually had some idea of what to do.
And Xue Ying began attempting it according to those ideas he had!
“Hong.”
As he sat within the underground palace in his cavern-dwelling, Xue Ying’s body began having huge transformations.
His legs became thicker within moments. But following that, with sounds of ‘ka ka ka’, many bones in his legs started breaking apart…
‘This isn’t it either.’
“Hong.”
The skin covering Xue Ying’s body suddenly became thick. He seemed much more muscular and bigger, yet following that, the superficial skin and meat started collapsing apart.
‘Not right either.’
…
As he continued failing--many issues cropped up along the path towards grasping a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body--Xue Ying was still fully confident of himself. He was clear that attaining a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body within a short period is simply impossible. He was prepared to perfect this over a long period of time. And one of the reasons why he could do this is because of those Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses he had, giving rise to a thick foundation and understanding of the Dao.
On this day 8.8 billion years after he had come to the Sacred World.
Xue Ying once again constructed an entirely new body structure. This was already his 19th attempt! There was a long gap time between each attempt primarily because he had to deduce a new cultivation technique each time.
“Hong.”
Xue Ying’s entire body abruptly become bigger. He was approximately 100 meters tall, and his skin was faintly illuminated in grayish light. His aura felt grand and powerful.
At this moment, many tiny part of his body started collapsing apart.
‘The degree of collapse is still within a limit I can bear! Given my body, I should be able to hold for the time taken to brew a cup of tea before it’ll completely collapse?’ Xue Ying revealed a grin. He did not dare to apply his understanding of the Dao of Void onto his entire body the previous few times. The best attempt he had previously could only last half a breath of time before his body collapsed! That was simply too short.
And once his body could maintain this state for the time taken to brew a cup of tea!
It represented a possibility of using it for battle!

chapters.title: Chapter 1338 - Application for a Hunting Team
chapters.content:
Chapter 1338: Application for a Hunting Team
Translator: Chaos_ Editor: Chaos_
Within the cavern-dwelling in the garden.
“Hu hu~” The cold wind whistled like a blade. Amidst the dark world, that cold wind carried with it many miniscule ice crystals. And those ice crystals were smashing against the roof of the house, the corridor, and the stone floor with cracking sounds.
Xue Ying was currently seated under a pavilion in a white robe. A flask of wine was being warmed by his side, and around him were various unique fruits.
Carrying a crystalline wine goblet, Xue Ying tasted the wine while lightly muttering: “It has been 10 billion years since I arrived here in the Sacred World! I no longer have much food left. It is time for me to join a hunting team and hunt for food.”
Previously during the auction, as Xue Ying had earned a total of a million cubic meters of food, that was how he could remain safe within the city for a total of 10 billion years!
Even though these Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses were very valuable--Xue Ying even brought a Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse from the Lightning World. Nonetheless, Xue Ying did not wish to sell them away temporarily! Because he still needed to comprehend some of the laws and profound mysteries manifested on those Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses.
‘Ever since I had a slight breakthrough the previous time, my fleshy body has been maintained at the level of a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform. My body could maintain this state for the time taken to brew a cup of tea… and ever since then, it has been around one billion years yet my improvement is negligible.’ Xue Ying shook his head inwardly.
His previous breakthrough was a result of an enlightenment after his hefty accumulations.
After that, Xue Ying continued perfecting this body cultivation technique. He wanted to increase the time he could maintain that state for… once his body could remain stable and stop dissolving apart, it would be the time he succeeded in grasping a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body. It would also mean he had reached the pinnacle beneath ‘Chaotic Origin Lifeform’.
‘If I want to improve further?’
‘The first option is to spend time slowly perfecting it. And for me to cultivate peacefully in this Sacred World, I have to prepare sufficient food.’
‘The second option is to collect more Void Lineage Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses. It’ll be even better if I could secure a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse with a Void Lineage! According to intelligence, there are a total of three Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Prisoners.’ Xue Ying thought. There existed a total of 35 Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Tribes within the Sacred World.
But only the three strongest Void Lineage tribes had Chaotic Origin Prisoners.
Even though the Chaotic Origin Prisoners were all High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms! And they could easily kill Xue Ying and the other cultivators with a flip of their hands using their true strength, in reality, they were trapped and imprisoned. The further they got from their territories, the stronger the restriction would shackle them, causing their strength to fall!
In the entire Sacred World…
Only the most terrifying ‘Sea of Abyss Master’ had a strength that brought despair to everyone. But other than that, the other Chaotic Origin Prisoners could still be killed.
A trapped dragon could get teased by a prawn. A tiger out of its den could be bullied by dogs. These Chaotic Origin Prisoners were heavily shackled and restricted. It was normal for there to exist a probability of them dying.
Even the magnificent Overlord left behind a message…
The cultivator who contributed the greatest towards killing the Sea of Abyss Master would be awarded with something shocking.
‘It seems the most terrifying ‘Overlord’ existence amongst Chaotic Origin Experts hopes for us to kill these Chaotic Origin Prisoners.’ Xue Ying naturally looked forward to it.
The manifestation of laws on the corpse of a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform would likely be much stronger than what was seen on an ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
‘The third option is to go out and hunt. I can also temper myself in battles, and to corroborate my Dao of Void during battles.’ Xue Ying thought. He could discover his flaws during battles, and perfect them after that.
Securing food, acquiring the needed corpses for cultivation, training himself in battles…
Xue Ying naturally had to leave the city.
The magnificent Overlord created the Sacred World and left behind such a nasty environment where cultivators had to fight to survive. Naturally, the Overlord felt that by experiencing more life and death struggles, it would aid these cultivators in their endeavors to become ‘Chaotic Origin’.
‘Hunting team.’
Xue Ying immediately began checking through his communication treasure.
The newest hunting team was led by someone called ‘Daoist Hidden Horizon’ with the final goal to kill a Grand Perfection God Emperor Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform, ‘Mount Primal Chaos Serpent’. The team size was set to a minimum of 50 cultivators, and now, 33 cultivators had applied for it already.
‘Mount Primal Chaos Serpent?’ Xue Ying nodded his head slightly. This was also a Chaotic Origin Lifeform tribe with a slightly more precious bloodline in this Sacred World.
According to the rules.
The hunting team would return after killing a Mount Primal Chaos Serpent.
During the process of heading there and returning… the hunting team would naturally encounter other Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. They would also battle for food. Once they returned, they would then distribute the food according to the contribution of each member throughout the entire journey! And the ‘Scarlet Cloud Hall Spirit’ would check through the battles that had happened before allocating a fair share to everyone. As for the main target of the hunting team, ‘Mount Primal Chaos Serpent’, the creator of the hunting team would be given main priority over it! Of course, the creator of the hunting team would have to then complement for any deficiencies during the allocation.
“Brother Hidden Horizon?” Xue Ying revealed a grin. He had briefly chatted with this Daoist Hidden Horizon during the auction.
Daoist Hidden Horizon was qualified to be ranked in the top few dozens within Scarlet Cloud City.
“Apply!”
Xue Ying did not hesitate.
At that moment, the list of this hunting team had one more person, totaling up to 34! This news was also being transmitted to all cultivators within Scarlet Cloud City.
…
Xie Fan was currently meditating within his own underground palace located in his cavern-dwelling.
He sat cross-legged with his eyes closed. He did not keep any of his aura, causing the surrounding time-space to distort and collapse. He, ‘Xie Fan’, was ranked first in terms of heaviness amongst all cultivators within Scarlet Cloud City. His body was unfathomably strong too. Even Weather Leaf relied heavily upon him! Actually, after reaching this level, only the three City Masters were slightly stronger than him.
Even in a life and death battle, Xie Fan could fight with the three City Masters in duels without losing out terribly! The City Masters could not hold an overwhelming upper hand against him.
After all, the closer one got to the peak, the smaller the gap in their strength would be.
With such a strength, even if Xie Fan had a devilish personality, many other cultivators were not willing to offend him.
Xie Fan was not foolish either…
Those that were powerful would still win his respect.
Only those ordinary Grand Perfection God Emperors that he truly felt disdain for. He could fight one-on-one and smash a ‘Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform’ to death! The survivability of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were much higher, yet he could eliminate one in a duel. Hence, that would mean he could easily wipe any ordinary Grand Perfection God Emperors in this city that occupied 80% of its number away
That was why he did not care about those existences. It was also the reason why he chose to visit Xue Ying and bully him. Who would have guessed that Xue Ying did not care about his coercion at all.
“Big Brother Xie Fan.” There was a sudden transmission.
“What’s the matter?”
Xie Fan opened his eyes. He felt slightly displeased for being interrupted during his cultivation. He even chose to block most ordinary news sent by the Scarlet Cloud Hall. After all, there were too many news regarding the batches of hunting teams, and with them coming all the time, it would be hard for him to stay peaceful during his cultivation.
“Do you remember asking me to keep ahead of news regarding that Flying Snow? That Flying Snow has already applied to join the newest hunting team.”
“He has joined them?”
Xie Fan immediately checked.
Those previously screened news immediately appeared. He soon received a new set of news.
Its news regarding the hunting team headed by ‘Daoist Hidden Horizon’. There were currently 34 cultivators already, and the newest joiner was rch Flying Snow!
“Hmph hmph, he has finally joined the hunting team. I still thought you are planning to stay in the city for eternity.” Xie Fan sneered. Just by sitting and eating within Scarlet Cloud City could deplete all food stash one had. Xie Fan had longed for this day, “A Dao Cultivator that could barely exhibit the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor? This is commonly seen in the Scarlet Cloud City yet he dare not show any respect for me? He even stopped me from entering his cavern-dwelling during the auction? Very good!”
“Apply.”
Xie Fan did not hesitate. He immediately joined this hunting team.
And the hunting team had an additional name after that--’Devil God Xie Fan’!
‘Flying Snow Brat, let’s see what are you going to do about it? Are you going to leave?’ Xie Fan sneered. According to the rules, it was possible for one to leave the hunting team anytime before the team left Scarlet Cloud City! After all, cultivators might have sudden enlightenments that would lead them to enter closed-door cultivation. Or perhaps they might ‘leave the team’ for special reasons.
But if one left the party, he had to compensate ‘one cubic meter of food’! This was to prevent the cultivators from joining and leaving any time they wanted!
One cubic meter of food was sufficient to last 10,000 years. Hence, nobody would leave the party for no reason at all.
‘I have you in my sight.’
‘Are you going to leave the party this time or the next? Are you going to continue leaving forever? Without food, you would simply starve to death. No matter what, you still have to go out and hunt for food.’ Xie Fan sneered. His status was high, and his strength was great too. Hence, he did not worry much about food.
…
Xue Ying peered out at the surroundings as the wind whistled while drinking his wine. Suddenly, he revealed a look of astonishment.
Because after he applied to join the team, very soon, two cultivators also applied to join it. One of them even had a vengeance for him.
‘Xie Fan?’ Xue Ying’s lips edged upwards, ‘He has joined the hunting team this time too? Previously, I slapped him on the face, expelling him from my cavern-dwelling and forbade him from entering it. It seems he is bent on taking revenge.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1339 - Setting Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 1339: Setting Off
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Xie Fan’s eyelids were drooped. He sat cross-legged within the underground palace in his cavern-dwelling waiting silently.
Ever since he applied to join the hunting team, he was waiting for Xue Ying ‘to leave the team’.
‘Yi? He actually remains unmoved?’
‘Since he has applied to join the team, he should be constantly alerted on any new joiners. He should know at the first moment that I have joined the team. But he has not left. Unless, he dares to go out still?’ Xie Fan revealed a queer look.
Xie Fan immediately transmitted a message to Xue Ying through his communication treasure: “Flying Snow Brat, this time, I am also joining the hunting team you are in. Despite this, you still dare to go with me?”
“Xie Fan, you have been keeping track about news on me right? And you immediately joined after I joined? I, Flying Snow, is really well-loved.” Xue Ying immediately replied too.
Xie Fan’s expression sunk.
He had indeed arranged for a subordinate to keep track on news regarding Xue Ying! With his strength, he naturally had several Grand Perfection God Emperor subordinates he could rely on. As ordinary Grand Perfection God Emperors did not have an easy time hunting down Chaotic Origin Lifeforms for food, they would have an easier time relying on ‘Xie Fan’. In the entire Scarlet Cloud City, those ranked in the top dozen would usually have a group of cultivators relying on them!
The strength of those ranked at the front were mostly at the level of ‘Grand Perfection God Emperor Dao Cultivators’. The gap between them was minute.
Within the 3,000 over cultivators in the city, there were quite many cultivators who were willing to rely on the experts. In reality, experts like ‘Daoist Hidden Horizon’, ‘Great Emperor Heaven Calamity’, ‘Xie Fan’, ‘Mo Shu’ and many others might have many cultivators willing to rely on them, yet they did not take in those cultivators easily. Because the moment they accepted a cultivator, they would have to protect and provide food for them.
Even though it might increase their overall strength, it was also a sort of burden. Hence, they would have to select those that were helpful for them.
Like those that specialized in domain? Or those that specialized in long-range scouting? Or those that were fast?
They had to select the specialists!
“Haha… you are quite daring. Now, you have increased my respect for you.” Xie Fan sneered back.
“In the future, you will have to admire me for my capabilities.” Xue Ying immediately cut off the communication.
At that moment, the expression of Xie Fan became colder.
He immediately transmitted to his subordinates: “All of you, join the newest hunting team now.”
Since those Grand Perfection God Emperors chose to rely on ‘Xie Fan’, most would usually listen to his orders. Xie Fan had a total of 25 subordinates, and this time, he chose to dispatch 15 of them!
“Yes.”
“Big Brother Xie Fan, it seems this hunting team consists of that cultivator called Flying Snow. Are you planning on dealing with him?”
“He is truly seeking death.”
“I have applied!”
All of them immediately applied for a position on the hunting team.
The original list of 36 members had risen to 51 in just a moment! It satisfied the minimum size required for this assignment.
******
‘That’s fast!’
Xue Ying was startled. The size of the hunting team had jumped in just a short moment to 51 cultivators, ‘It seems that the newest batch of members that just joined the team, according to the intelligence provided by Brother Lightning Xiao, is related to that Xie Fan.’
“Monarch Flying Snow, gather at the Scarlet Cloud Hall as soon as possible.” The Scarlet Cloud Hall Spirit transmitted over.
Once there was sufficient cultivators, they could set off immediately.
‘It seems this Xie Fan is quite useful. At least he has shortened my wait.’ Xue Ying smiled and stood up. He walked out of the pavilion. The ice crystals that were swept along by the gale flew all over the place. Yet they simply turned into smithereens once they reached three inches away from Xue Ying’s body.
The entire Scarlet Cloud City spanned just several hundred thousand kilometers.
With Xue Ying’s speed, even if he walked casually, he would still arrive at Scarlet Cloud Hall within moments.
Within the Scarlet Cloud Hall’s main palace.
Quite a few cultivators had currently gathered here. There were also many cultivators arriving.
Xue Ying entered the palace and saw a long black-haired male that were crowded by others, ‘Daoist Hidden Horizon’. Daoist Hidden Horizon had a gentle personality that was like water. Compared to Xie Fan, the reputation of Daoist Hidden Horizon was much better.
“Brother Flying Snow.” Daoist Hidden Horizon immediately greeted when he saw Xue Ying.
“Brother Hidden Horizon.” Xue Ying went over and greeted with a smile.
“Xie Fan and his group of experts have joined this hunting team. Are you certain you want to continue?” Daoist Hidden Horizon asked, “This Xie Fan has made it a point to take his revenge. He has fixed his gaze on you. From how I see it, he would join any hunting team you decided to join. Going out with him… is simply too dangerous for you. I think it’ll be better if you rely on ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’ or ‘His Highness Wu Xiao’. As for Weather Leaf? Xie Fan is the left and right arm of Weather Leaf so the two other Vice-City Masters are the only ones who can ensure your safety.”
“Vice-City Masters? It shouldn’t be easy for any of the two Vice-City Masters to accept me right?” Xue Ying chuckled.
“You have to have sufficiently formidable techniques.” Daoist Hidden Horizon answered.
The three City Masters were all powerful.
They would rarely leave the city. But the moment they did so, they would reap a frighteningly huge harvest.
Because their teams were powerful! Not only were they powerful, the team they created was powerful too. They would either invite the other experts ranked at the top few dozens, or they would ask some lone experts within Scarlet Cloud City. When the entire team worked together… it would naturally be terrifying. If Xue Ying were to join this team, Xie Fan would naturally be helpless against him.
“Many thanks Brother Hidden Horizon.” Xue Ying said.
“Admirable. In a while when we leave the city, I suggest for you to stay closer to my people.” Daoist Hidden Horizon immediately said when he saw that, “These cultivators are my comrades. So it’ll be best if you get along well with them now.”
Xue Ying thus went to introduce himself to those cultivators.
Since Daoist Hidden Horizon could rank in the top few dozens, he would naturally have a team of cultivators under him. Adding Daoist Hidden Horizon, he had a total of 22 cultivators with him.
Actually…
When recruiting a regular team, one had to consider the strengths of the experts and how well they could coordinate with one another, as well as on how to provide large amounts of food for so many experts. According to the history of Scarlet Cloud City, a regular team could be maintained at around 20 cultivators, and few would rarely exceed 30.
Soon, the other 35 members who applied to join this hunting team arrived.
The final 16 people led by Xie Fan were also the final group of people to join them.
“Hu.” The short and small old man Xie Fan had droopy eyelids. His eerie eyes swept across the palace. The moment he saw Xue Ying, Xie Fan began grinning even more terrifyingly.
“Flying Snow Brat.” Xie Fan looked at Xue Ying.
“Alright, everyone is here.” Daoist Hidden Horizon interrupted, “Also Xie Fan, this time, our final goal is to kill a Mount Primal Chaos Serpent. The journey is quite far so I hope for us to work together. If someone in the team were to fall, it’ll be a humiliation to the rest of us.”
Xie Fan chuckled: “Rest assured. I’ll definitely take the big picture into consideration.”
“Remember the old rules of our Scarlet Cloud City. It is forbidden for one to kill other team members.” Daoist Hidden Horizon reminded. The hunting team would be leaving the Scarlet Cloud City. Outside the city, danger existed everywhere. If there were inter-team conflicts… it would be even more dangerous.
“I understand. I’ll definitely not kill other members of the team.” Xie Fan acknowledged.
“Mn.” Daoist Hidden Horizon nodded slightly.
This was what he could do.
According to the history of cultivators hunting outside the Scarlet Cloud City, even though it was forbidden for cultivators to kill one another! It was still especially possible for team members to not help one another during ‘critical moments’ when they were surrounded by large groups of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. It was entirely possible for members of the team to fall!
Even though Xie Fan and the others did not dare to attack Xue YIng directly, they had a total of 16 people. As long as they chose to ‘watch by the side’, they could very well create a vile situation for Xue Ying.
And by relying on the ‘Chaotic Origin Lifeforms’ to kill Xue Ying!
Xue Ying watched silently by the side: ‘Plotting against me?’
This team was split into three factions.
The first belonged to the 22 experts led by Daoist Hidden Horizon. Daoist Hidden Horizon treated Xue Ying amiably and was willing to help him too. The second faction included Xie Fan and his group of 15 experts. They would most likely deliberately force Xue Ying into a ‘predicament’ during critical moments. The final faction included others with Xue Ying inside--they were the factionless cultivators.
Some of the factionless cultivators were aloof and felt disdain of joining any experts. Many more were already exquisitely chosen by the strongest of experts.
“This team actually contains both Daoist Hidden Horizon and Xie Fan. We should have an easy time now.”
“That’s right, with the two of them around, the team has become very much stronger.”
“Xie Fan is here? Is it because of that Flying Snow?”
“Who cares about him! How would it matter if Flying Snow lives or dies?”
Those factionless cultivators began conversing between one another.
Two of the strongest few dozens experts in the Scarlet Cloud City actually joined this hunting team… that was quite rarely seen. Usually, one hunting team would only consist of a peak expert.
“Set off!” Being the creator of the team, Daoist Hidden Horizon had also become the leader.
…
“Sou sou sou…”
Inclusive of Xue Ying, the group of 51 figures immediately turned into shadows and left the city.

chapters.title: Chapter 1340 - Each with Their Strengths
chapters.content:
Chapter 1340: Each with Their Strengths
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
‘What is this energy?’ Xue Ying tried perceiving his surroundings. His side of hunting team consisting 51 cultivators were currently flying at a low altitude. Yet an unseen energy could be felt around them. One controlled time-space, and the other was much stranger--it seemed to isolate the inside from the outside, making it hard for anyone in the outer world to perceive this team.
“Brother Hidden Horizon’s domain has been released.”
“Mn.”
Daoist Hidden Horizon presided in the overall situation. He then looked at two other cultivators--one a gray-robed man and another a cold golden-armored male, “Barbaric Insect, the two of you can act now.”
The gray-robed man nodded slightly. Waving his sleeves, a dense number of tiny insects began flying out away from the team.
And on the golden armor of that cold male, it abruptly dissolved into many mechanical beings that flew out in all directions.
Xue Ying watched from the side. He nodded inwardly: ‘This is indeed the team of Daoist Hidden Horizon. There are experts that specialized in domains, and experts that specializes in long-range scouting techniques. All of them have their strengths.’
Those insects and machinery beings could travel far away from the team. They could begin looking out for enemies right from a huge distance away.
“Hu.”
The team stealthily flew towards their destination. Xue Ying and the other cultivators did not take the initiative to release their energy. Instead, they proceeded under the guidance by that gray-robed man, ‘Barbaric Insect’.
…
As they flew, they would try to evade any Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that they sensed. The team’s flying speed was occasionally fast and slow. They would also take a detour if needed be.
They did not encounter any danger during the first hour at all. Xue Ying even had a feeling that he was here on a tour: ‘Initially when I first arrived here in this Sacred World, I was teleported to a location not too far away from the Scarlet Cloud City. I utilized my void techniques and flew slowly, yet I was still ambushed within moments! At that time, I had seen the map shown in the Guiding Hall. The map had demarcated the locations of the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, and they were scattered densely across the world. However, we have not encountered a single lifeform after such a long time… it seems that the subordinates of Daoist Hidden Horizon are selected very carefully.’
Each line of work had a specialist in it.
Coming from so many different worlds, the experts here had varying strengths. And the subordinates of Daoist Hidden Horizon and Xie Fan were at the very least Grand Perfection God Emperors! After all, Grand Perfection God Emperors occupied 80% of the population in Scarlet Cloud City.
Those that could wield a Grand Perfection God Emperor combat strength had all reached an unfathomable level in their own Dao paths.
They might even be more outstanding than the three City Masters in certain aspects!
“Big Brother Xie Fan, this time, the hunting team created by Daoist Hidden Horizon consists mostly of his subordinates and ours! Most dangers aren’t worth a mention to us, but it is quite troublesome to scheme against that Flying Snow.”
“Rest assured, Hidden Horizon’s target this time is the ‘Mount Primal Chaos Serpent’. That is an incredibly dangerous place. That is also the reason why he made the minimum size of the team 50! Because he isn’t confident of completing the task if there were too few cultivators.” Xie Fan explained confidently and leisurely, “When genuine danger befalls us, we just have to give it a slight push. Once he is by himself without the help of other team members, do you think he can survive under the collective attack by many Chaotic Origin Lifeforms just with the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor? Hmph hmph.”
“Right, there are many opportunities on the way there and back, especially so during the battle with the Mount Primal Chaos Serpent. That in itself is dangerous! This Flying Snow might survive through one or two counts of dangerous situations, but it is impossible for him to survive all the way. He is dead for certain.”
“And this hunting team has even planned to go out and hunt for a Mount Primal Chaos Serpent, yet he dares to join the hunt? If I were him, I would be more careful and just simply join a hunting team that targets the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms neighboring around the city.”
Xie Fan and his group of people conversed with each other.
According to the plans of Xie Fan…
Securing food in this hunt was secondary. More importantly, he planned on borrowing the power of the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms to kill Xue Ying. As long as he succeeded, Xie Fan would have vented out his anger. Furthermore, all of them knew that Xue Ying currently owned at least six Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses. This totaled to an incredibly high value.
“He is definitely dead.”
…
“This Flying Snow would most likely die in this journey.” Several other lone cultivators lamented about it inwardly.
“He is seeking his death for provoking Xie Fan.”
“But once he dies, the treasures he left behind will be considered the spoils of war for the entire team. Hearsay he has six Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses! By then, we should be able to secure quite a huge loot at the end.” These lone cultivators actually looked forward to it. With six corpses added up together, one would have enough food to last for tens of trillions of years. Even if it was divided equally in the team, everyone would gain a great deal from it.
These lone cultivators did not have good lives.
They did not have any relationship with Xue Ying either. Hence, they would naturally watch emotionless from the side and would rejoice should Xue Ying fall since they would have a share in his treasures.
…
“Since Flying Snow dares to come on this journey, he should have prepared amply for it.” The only cultivator in the team that could match against Xie Fan, ‘Daoist Hidden Horizon’, gave Xue Ying a glance. Reaching the level of Daoist Hidden Horizon, his perception and judgment would naturally be different. He was happy to provide some help. If Xue Ying had certain powerful trump cards that he kept hidden, his timely aid would be very much worth the effort.
For Daoist Hidden Horizon to conduct himself as such--helping others when they needed it--his interpersonal relationship was naturally outstanding.
“Hidden Horizon, be careful. There is currently a group of Ant Dragons rushing towards us.” The gray-robed male transmitted.
“Ant Dragons? How many are there?” Daoist Hidden Horizon asked.
“There are 86 of them who are rushing towards us currently. Even more Ant Dragons are also rushing towards our current location.” The gray-robed man transmitted.
“Cheng Yu.” Daoist Hidden Horizon ordered, “Bring everyone off.”
“Yes.”
The fastest cultivator in Daoist Hidden Horizon’s team was a gray-skinned male with a blue horn called ‘Cheng Yu’. He immediately released his energy. One could see a dimmed gray energy bursting out from his body. It engulfed the entire team of 51 people.
Following that.
“Hong!”
This dimmed gray energy covered the team, significantly boosting everyone’s speed to more than three times their original.
“Mn?” Xue Ying then felt the surroundings of the team suddenly flashing with ‘hua hua hua’. The speed of the team seemed to explode up immensely. He could not help but feel shocked when he saw that.
“Fellow cultivators, we have already been discovered by the closest Chaotic Origin Lifeforms and are now using our fastest speed to proceed ahead.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted.
“We have been discovered?”
“We must use the fastest speed to hurl them behind.”
“What Chaotic Origin Lifeform is it that discovered us?”
Most of the cultivators did not panic. They had lived in Scarlet Cloud City for a very long time, and had been out hunting for lifeforms frequently. Meeting dangers during the hunt was something they were used to. Even if they died, it would simply represent they failed on their journey towards chasing after the ‘Chaotic Origin Dao Path’. At that time when they chose to leave their hometown and come to this world termed as a ‘World of Despair’ or the ‘Lands of the Exiled’, or even the ‘World of Survival’, they had become mentally prepared themselves to die.
Either they succeeded.
Or they fell down on this path.
“Big Brother Hidden Horizon, the Ant Dragons are obstructing our path ahead. Are we planning on rushing through or evade them?”
“Rush through.”
Daoist Hidden Horizon simply ordered, “The entire Ant Dragon Tribe is incredibly huge. Now that they have discovered us, we would encounter more danger if we took a detour.”
He made his decision according to what had been observed by his subordinates.
Very soon--
The entire hunting team saw many Chaotic Origin Lifeforms appearing in front of them. These life forms that were called ‘Ant Dragons’ by the cultivators had an appearance of an ant. It also had a long and sharp tail. Its tail was also the most offensive part of its body. These Ant Dragons secured victory by relying on numbers. According to the intelligence, at a location neighboring their city, there lived at least 100,000 Ant Dragons! There was even a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform ‘Ant Dragon’ that had been imprisoned near Scarlet Cloud City.
As they were scattered vastly apart, Xue Ying and the others merely had to deal with the dozens in front of them.
“Remember, we don’t aim to kill. We aim to break away with the fastest speed.” Daoist Hidden Horizon ordered.
“Hong!”
A huge group of Ant Dragons--the smaller ones were approximately 100 meters tall with tails spanning approximately 300 meters. The larger ones were a thousand meters tall and were akin to a tiny hill. They were all madly rushing in the direction of Xue Ying and others.
In this Sacred World.
Cultivators hunted down Chaotic Origin Lifeforms for food. It was similarly so for Chaotic Origin Lifeforms--they did not show any mercy for the cultivators.
“Hu.” The Ant Dragons began crashing with this team of cultivators. Various techniques immediately started being thrown around. The team under Daoist Hidden Horizon and the team under Xie Fan coordinated incredibly well together. Daoist Hidden Horizon was even quite kind in exhibiting certain domain techniques that protected the lone cultivators including Xue Ying.
‘Stop meddling into other people’s business.’ Xie Fan glanced at the distant Daoist Hidden Horizon, thinking to himself, ‘You might be able to help him now, but I doubt you can continue lending your help throughout the entire journey.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1341 - Poison Demon Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 1341: Poison Demon Dragon
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
The cultivators had an overwhelming advantage. In terms of individual strength, other than two ‘Late Stage God Emperor’ lone cultivators, the weakest had the strength of Grand Perfection God Emperors! As for that group of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, the ‘Ant Dragons’, even though they their survivability was much stronger, most of them were much weaker--quite a few Ant Dragons were at the strength of Middle Stage God Emperors, with some at Late Stage and some Grand Perfection God Emperors.
Furthermore, the cultivators had different strengths. They could coordinate well perfectly. And as a result, the cultivators were able to exert an incredibly strong combat power. Just like how the small team of eight that once saved Xue Ying and easily suppressed close to a hundred ‘Shadow Reapers’, one could see how frightening this group of Grand Perfection God Emperors would be after going through careful selection.
At this moment.
Daoist Hidden Horizon had a team of elite under him! Xie Fan was similarly leading a group of elites that could coordinate very well together. The majority of the other lone cultivators were also Grand Perfection God Emperors.
As for the Ant Dragons?
All of them had similar techniques. Hence, it was hard for them to cover up their weaknesses!
Especially so when the cultivators were only seeking to cast away from the group of Ant Dragons. They were not seeking for a battle.
“Hong--”
Once they charged through, they immediately broke through the group of Ant Dragons. Those Ant Dragons could not hinder their movement at all.
“Die.” Xie Fan’s aura struck out like a tsunami. It caused the surrounding time-space to distort, moving in the directions of two Ant Dragons and flinging them away.
“Hou~~~” One of the Grand Perfection God Emperor Ant Dragons roared. It struggled in resistance.
But another Late Stage God Emperor Ant Dragon had already come close to Xie Fan during this intermission. Xie Fan punched out at the chest of that Ant Dragon, causing its enormous body to tremble. Following that, the soul and aura of that Ant Dragon was wiped.
‘One punch is enough for him to kill a Late Stage God Emperor Ant Dragon?’ They were not in a dangerous situation currently. Xue Ying still had the time to observe around him. When he saw the power in Xie Fan’s fist, his pupils could not help but dilate, ‘Even Cloud Phoenix City Master could not do this. Killing a Chaotic Origin Lifeform with a single punch? He is indeed a Dao Cultivator who has attained the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body, and is also the one with the heaviest body in the entire Scarlet Cloud City. In terms of strength, he might perhaps be comparable to Cloud Phoenix City Master, yet his techniques are greatly more profound and transcendental! His one punch did not seem to injure the body of the Ant Dragon, yet it died…’
Xue Ying felt a chill down his spine.
The other party dared to threaten Xue Ying within Scarlet Cloud City. Indeed, it was because of overwhelming strength.
“Sou.”
Xie Fan flipped his hand before keeping the corpse of that Ant Dragon. He then continued charging forward with the team.
The cultivators had practically charged out of the obstruction by these Ant Dragons in practically two breaths of time. A total of three Ant Dragons died, two at the Middle Stage God Emperor Level, and one at the Late Stage God Emperor Level. The one that Xie Fan killed was a Late Stage God Emperor. The other two Middle Stage God Emperor Ant Dragons were both killed by the team under Daoist Hidden Horizon.
After all, they were primarily escaping out of the blockade and killing those Ant Dragons was done casually on the way. That was why the kill rate was so low!
‘Formidable.’ Daoist Hidden Horizon glanced at Xie Fan.
Each party had their own strengths.
He, Daoist Hidden Horizon, could not compare with Xie Fan in close combat battles. He was only slightly stronger than most Grand Perfection God Emperors. Instead, what Daoist Hidden Horizon was good at is ‘domains’. His domain technique could bring out the innate strengths of the entire team.
‘With Xie Fan around, our hunt for the Mount Primal Chaos Serpent will be much more certain.’ Daoist Hidden Horizon thought.
…
The team continued flying towards their destination at high speed.
With the help of that cultivator ‘Cheng Yu’, the team cast away those Ant Dragons far away.
“We are out.”
“We have escaped from their blockade.”
“No more dangers now.”
The two cultivators in charge for scouting their surroundings, the gray-robed man and cold golden-armored male, confirmed that they had escaped from the Chaotic Origin Lifeform blockade.
Previously if they were to delay further by fighting back, many more Ant Dragons would have surrounded them, making it very hard to deal with. They would then be doomed!
The most fundamental point to take note when hunting outside the city is never to fight back zealously!
Because there were simply too many Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. If they were to delay long enough, the number of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms would only increase. 100, 200, 500, 1000… if they delayed for a day or two, it was normal for tens of thousands of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms to arrive! By then, no matter how strong the cultivators were, they would definitely die under the onslaught of so many Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
“Continue advancing forward.”
Daoist Hidden Horizon ordered.
The team’s advancing speed abruptly reduced. A time-space domain once again enveloped the entire team including that strange domain that somehow made the team disappear from the outer world.
This was the best and safest way of advancing!
And it was four hours later that they were discovered once again.
******
They did not continue fighting zealously. The team continued rushing ahead.
‘This team is very powerful. We don’t seem to encounter any danger along the way. I joined the hunting team firstly, to hunt for food and secondly, to temper myself. But it seems the entire journey is very safe and leisure.’ Xue Ying thought. That’s right too. This team included the team of Daoist Hidden Horizon and the team of Xie Fan as the core. Hence, the overall strength was naturally strong.
“Be careful.” Daoist Hidden Horizon suddenly transmitted to everyone in the team, “There is a large group of ‘Poison Demon Dragon’ numbering around 300 rushing in our direction.”
“Hu.”
At that moment, a dimmed gray energy covered the team. The speed of the team once again rose. They did not care about hiding anymore. Instead, they were using the fastest speed to escape.
“More than 300 Poison Demon Dragons?” Many cultivators in the team felt tingling in their hearts.
Poison Demon Dragons were a name given by the cultivators. As different Chaotic Origin Lifeform specialized in different techniques, their degree of threat to the cultivators was different too! The threat that came from the Poison Demon Dragon was on the slightly higher end. More importantly, the number of such dragons they encountered this time was quite large.
If it was most hunting teams, they might see members dying in the battle once they encountered Poison Demon Dragons on the size of more than 300!
Fortunately, this team was sufficiently strong.
“They are here. Be prepared to battle. I hope everyone can work and coordinate well together.” Daoist Hidden Horizon solemnly transmitted.
“Hong, hong, hong, hong, hong, hong…”
A group of figures suddenly appeared north west of them. They were moving incredibly fast. The ‘Poison Demon Dragon’ was entirely in gray. They were like land dragons! Spikes could be seen protruding from their body. They even had huge spikes protruding out in a fan-like shape from their back. Their tails were very long, and were filled with spikes too… glancing at them, Xue Ying could ascertain that there were at 1.81 million spikes on the entire body of the Poison Demon Dragon.
And each spike had ‘concentrated poison’ imbued!
It was a concentrated poison that could cause the expressions of these ordinary Grand Perfection God Emperors to change! It was because of this poison that made the degree of threat of ‘Poison Demon Dragons’ high.
“Kill.”
The Poison Demon Dragon that was charging at the forefront emitted a sound.
They were similarly intelligent beings and did not plan to show any mercy to the cultivators.
“Kill.” Suddenly, black-white ribbons appeared on the surface of Daoist Hidden Horizon’s body. These ribbons flew out in all directions, tying around many of those Poison Demon Dragons! Those Poison Demon Dragons that had been restricted abruptly became much slower and weaker.
‘Daoist Hidden Horizon specializes in domain techniques. But he is bloodline cultivator.’ Xue Ying understood from the intelligence that the effectiveness of those black and white ribbons would be kept to a maximum when they entangled around nine enemies at most! Once the number of enemies restricted exceeded nine, the effectiveness of restriction by the ribbons would also continue to decrease.
Many black and white ribbons could be seen scattered across the team.
There was also a black-white ribbon floating around Xue Ying, though it did not restrict the enemies. It would only appear during critical moments to help Xue Ying. After all, when there were too many restricted enemies, the individual strength of each ribbon would weaken.
“Flying Snow Brat, let us come save you.” Xie Fan guffawed. He brought along his team of 15 experts and charged in the direction where Xue Ying was.
As they were all within the team, the sixteen people including Xie Fan had surrounded Xue Ying in an instance.
The 17 of them were gathered together, and this was one-third of the entire team. Hence, more than 100 Poison Demon Dragons had been attracted in their direction.
“Peng peng peng.”
“Hong.”
Xie Fan’s team consisted of many experts specializing in different techniques. Some displayed a domain, and some transformed into countless images. Some were emitting sound waves, and some battled directly with the dragons. Some even attacked from a distance away… They were perfectly coordinating with one another. As each individual expert was strong coupled with the help from other members, this team of 16 perfectly countered against the joint attack by that huge group of Poison Demon Dragons! They were filled with a wealth of experience.
As for Xue Ying?
Even though he was in the team too, the group of 16 including Xie Fan did not help Xue Ying at all!
And currently, there were seven Poison Demon Dragons attacking Xue Ying at the same time! It was normal for there to be seven Poison Demon Dragons. An absolute majority of cultivators were also encountering this number, just that the other cultivators had the help of one another. Hence, the pressure they faced was much weaker.
But nobody was helping Xue Ying at all.
‘Perhaps this large group of Poison Demon Dragons might be able to kill him.’ Xie Fan sneered when he saw that. He casually punched out and kill a Late Stage God Emperor Poison Demon Dragon. Another fist forced back a Grand Perfection God Emperor Poison Demon Dragon, forcing it to roll backwards. In the entire battlefield, there was only Xie Fan who could be this tyrannical.

chapters.title: Chapter 1342 - Destination
chapters.content:
Chapter 1342: Destination
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
On the battlefield, Xie Fan’s efficiency of killing the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms was the highest.
And as a result, it provoked quite a few Poison Demon Dragons.
“Pu pu pu…” More than 10 Grand Perfection God Emperor Poison Demon Dragons began attacking Xie Fan together. They would even occasionally shoot out the poison spikes on their bodies at Xie Fan.
Xie Fan felt it was not worth dodging. The domain produced by his extreme heavy body had reduced the speed of those poisonous spikes such that when they reached his body, they could not even pierce through it! He, Xie Fan, was also the right and left arm of the City Master ‘Weather Leaf’. And the reason was because he was the one that could resist most enemies in the team of Weather Leaf.
When these Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms chose to group up on him? Xie Fan did not place them in his eyes. Given his body that was refined as a Dao Cultivator, these Poison Demon Dragons could not injure him at all!
Even though he was not injured, he was still impeded as a result.
“Die, die!” Xie Fan unhurriedly dealt against the enemies. At the same time, he was paying attention to the situation over at Xue Ying’s side.
‘What? That damned Hidden Horizon!’ Xie Fan’s expression changed.
Xue Ying was indeed in an awful situation.
With just a Late Stage God Emperor fleshy body, he was ranked at the back in the group of cultivators present at the battlefield.
Fighting against seven by himself? With three Grand Perfection God Emperor Poison Demon Dragons and four Late Stage God Emperor Poison Demon Dragons, more importantly, Xue Ying had to deal with the occasional poisonous spikes shot his way… this was the biggest threat from the Poison Demon Dragons. How would Xue Ying dare to take those spikes head on? He could only display his spear techniques and execute them in defenses against the incoming poisonous spikes while fighting back against the incoming Poison Demon Dragons.
‘Not good.’
If there were no poisonous spikes, he could still hold his ground against those Poison Demon Dragons.
But when so many poisonous spikes were coming his way, Xue Ying had to expend half his heart force in parrying against them. For a moment, Xue Ying was in a dire situation. All of a sudden, seven Poison Demon Dragons shot out their poisonous spikes at him, greatly shocking Xue Ying.
“Chi~” Suddenly, a black ribbon floated in the surroundings. It swept outwards explosively, flinging back all those incoming poisonous spikes.
‘So powerful!’ Xue Ying was both surprised and delighted. He understood his strength and could still sweep away the incoming poisonous spikes. But seeing the power of that ‘black-white ribbon’…
Indeed, Daoist Hidden Horizon relied on this domain technique to gain a status equivalent to that Xie Fan.
…
Xue Ying had a thrilling time dealing against those dragons.
“Pu.”
There was the occasional claw from the Poison Demon Dragon that slashed through the layers of void defenses. In the end, it clashed against the body of Xue Ying, forming a black-colored flame that forced Xue Ying back and made him spurt out blood.
Daoist Hidden Horizon was clearly helping him only during the critical moments.
When the incoming strikes were not fatal, he would let Xue Ying get injured! He would only help out during the very important moments like when Xue Ying was in a dire situation previously and so many poisonous spikes were shooting his way. According to logic, with so many poisonous spikes entering his body… that would be more frightening than getting clawed by a few hundred times.
After all, what the cultivators of Scarlet Cloud City feared about the Poison Demon Dragons was their poisonous spikes.
…
The team of cultivators fought and escaped at the same time.
Their speed was relatively fast. In addition, as the Middle Stage and Late Stage God Emperor Poison Demon Dragons fell consecutively, the cultivators faced less and less obstruction. Eventually, the team of cultivators was able to fling away those Poison Demon Dragons behind.
‘We killed a total of 21 Middle Stage God Emperor Poison Demon Dragons and 80 Late Stage God Emperor Poison Demon Dragons.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘It’s a pity that we did not kill a single Grand Perfection God Emperor Poison Demon Dragon.’
In terms of value.
The Poison Demon Dragons they killed were incomparable to a single Grand Perfection God Emperor Poison Demon Dragon.
Because the size of a Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform was so big that the roast meat it could produce was equivalent to more than 10,000 times that of a Middle Stage God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform! It was also worth about 200 to 300 times that of a Late Stage God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform! Of course, Chaotic Origin Lifeforms from different tribes would have different values.
No choice.
It was also hard for ‘Xie Fan’ to kill a Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform. It depended on what tribe it was. It had to be of a tribe with relatively weak survival capabilities, and only in the situation of ‘one versus one’ would he have sufficient time to kill!
In the case when a huge group of Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms worked together, the moment one of them became heavily injured, it would simply retreat. Hence, killing any lifeform was hard in that situation.
This was also the reason why that ‘Flame Lineage’ Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse that Xue Ying had could only be sold for six Grand Perfection God Emperor corpses and one million cubic meters of food despite it being unique in this Sacred World. Even so, it had incurred the greed in quite a few cultivators! Xie Fan wanted him dead. Firstly, it was for his reputation. Secondly, it was for the six Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses.
******
“Brother Hidden Horizon, many thanks for your help.” After the team regained its stealth cover, Xue Ying transmitted a message over to Daoist Hidden Horizon.
Daoist Hidden Horizon looked at Xue Ying and transmitted over: “Brother Flying Snow, there is no need for you to thank me. I am only doing what I can to help you. If the situation is dire, I’ll definitely do my best to protect my group of good friends that have been following me.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying was clear.
Regardless of sentiment and responsibility, Daoist Hidden Horizon had to first protect his own team! As an outsider, it was rare for the other party to lend a helping hand to him.
As they flew…
In the blink of an eye, it had been a day since they left Scarlet Cloud City. Even though they encountered more dangers, the level of danger was not as high as when they encountered that group of Poison Demon Dragons.
From day to night, and night to dawn.
“Hu hu hu~” The great snow fluttered about in the air amidst the endless wilderness.
This team of cultivators were also flying in concealment.
“Fellow cultivators, according to the scouts, there are a few Mount Primal Chaos Serpents right ahead--a total of 32 of them with 15 Grand Perfection God Emperors.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted, “This time, I created this hunting team with the goal of hunting down a Grand Perfection God Emperor Mount Primal Chaos Serpent. There are not too many Mount Primal Chaos Serpents ahead. Their threat to us is low. As long as we succeeded in killing one of them, we’ll immediately head back home!”
“Just 32 of them?”
“It seems we’ll have an easy time.”
“15 Grand Perfection God Emperors. And this time, we have close to 50 Grand Perfection God Emperors.”
Everyone present heaved a sigh of relief.
The Mount Primal Chaos Serpents had a slightly more precious bloodline among the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. In terms of individuals, it was harder to deal with them than the Poison Demon Dragons. They were also the hardest to deal with and most terrifying enemies they would face in this journey.
But no matter what… there were not a lot of enemies!
Hence, the overall degree of danger was still slightly lower as compared to when they encountered the Poison Demon Dragons.
‘It feels weird that this journey is too smooth?’ Xie Fan frowned slightly. This time, they traveled for more than a day from Scarlet Cloud City. And the most dangerous enemies they encountered were actually the Poison Demon Dragons? There were also only 32 Mount Primal Chaos Serpents which they were able to encounter? If there were more than a hundred, that Xue Ying would definitely die. But now, Xie Fan was temporarily out of ideas.
He did not dare to directly deal with Xue Ying in the team because that would mean challenging against the underlying laws of the Scarlet Cloud City.
When they came out to hunt, they would normally encounter danger in all directions.
Yet he chose to kill his teammate?
From then on, who would dare to join his team?
“Hu.”
The team rapidly came close to their target.
That group of Mount Primal Chaos Serpents had also sensed the incoming enemies. They immediately killed over indignantly.
“Mn?” The gray-robed man’s color changed slightly. He immediately transmitted, “Hidden Horizon, the other Mount Primal Chaos Serpents have also received the news and are rushing over in our direction. The closest group contains a total of 69 Mount Primal Chaos Serpents. We have to complete our task as soon as possible. Otherwise, there will only be more and more Mount Primal Chaos Serpents coming.”
Mount Primal Chaos Serpent had a relatively more precious bloodline and fewer number.
Even though it was not to the extent like the Ant Dragons where there were more than 100,000 tribal members, should the battle persist for an hour or more, the number of Mount Primal Chaos Serpents rushing their way might reach a number around 700 to 800! That would be sufficient to wipe their entire team out.
Furthermore, other than the Mount Primal Chaos Serpents, the other closer Chaotic Origin Lifeforms would also rush over.
“Maintain high alert and continue scouting the surroundings. The moment things are amiss, we’ll immediately flee.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted to the gray-robed male and the cold golden-armored male.
“Yes.” The two who were responsible for scouting understood what was happening around them.
“Hu.”
Finally, the team clashed with the Mount Primal Chaos Serpents.
The Mount Primal Chaos Serpent had a snakehead on each end of the body! It did not have a tail. Or perhaps, its snakehead was also its tail! Its meandering body was illusory and translucent. Only its two snakeheads seemed the most savage and vicious.
“Kill!” The team charged forward.
“Devour those cultivators.” This group of Mount Primal Chaos Serpents had a strange aura. They would occasionally appear and disappear in the void.
“Execute according to the original plan.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted to his subordinates. Currently, the eyes of this gentle cultivator, Daoist Hidden Horizon, started getting filled with killing intent. This time, he had to acquire a Mount Primal Chaos Serpent at least!

chapters.title: Chapter 1343 - Desperation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1343: Desperation
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
The battle erupted almost instantaneously.
There were only 32 Mount Primal Chaos Serpents with 15 Grand Perfection God Emperors and the others all Late Stage God Emperors. Xue Ying’s group of cultivators had a total of 47 with Grand Perfection God Emperor combat strength and two Late Stage God Emperor combat strength. Xie Fan and Daoist Hidden Horizon were even one of the few peak experts in Scarlet Cloud City. Furthermore, the cultivators were able to coordinate well with one another as well.
But…
They merely had some slight advantage on the battlefield.
“Brother Flying Snow, let us help you.”
“Don’t be afraid. There’s us.”
Xie Fan and his team of cultivators remained encircled around Xue Ying. They were fighting with the Mount Primal Chaos Serpents while at the same time, deliberately indulging in the ‘Mount Primal Chaos Serpents’; they did not help Xue Ying at all.
A ‘Grand Perfection God Emperor’ Mount Primal Chaos Serpent was currently embroiled in a battle with Xue Ying.
‘This is a Mount Primal Chaos Serpent? It is indeed extraordinary.’ Xue Ying did not become furious. Instead, he was delighted.
He came out of the city primarily to temper himself!
“Hua~”
This Mount Primal Chaos Serpent had an illusory body. It easily wrapped around Xue Ying.
As it was illusory, one could not touch the body of that Mount Primal Chaos Serpent at all. It felt like non-existent. But when that illusory body wrapped itself around Xue Ying, Xue Ying felt the suppression in the surrounding world becoming significantly stronger. As a result, his strength had been weakened by half.
“Si~ Cultivators, die!” The Mount Primal Chaos Serpent had two heads. One of its head was like a stone as it charged forward with an abnormally terrifying power. As for the other head, it was lit with black light. As it moved, it’s speed was so fast it formed many after-images. Every time it widened its maw, Xue Ying was so frightened by it that he had to execute his spear techniques to parry against that incoming maw. Xue YIng did not dare to be bitten at all.
Of the two snake heads the Mount Primal Chaos Serpent had, one was as heavy as a mountain and so tough it could not be damaged. The other was sinister and filled with poison. If a Grand Perfection God Emperor cultivator got bitten by it, half the cultivator’s life would be gone. A few more bites and the cultivator would likely die.
This Mount Primal Chaos Serpent…
Could not be touched or injured.
One of its two snake heads was like a mountain and could not be damaged! At least no cultivator now had the strength to break this ‘stone head’ a Grand Perfection God Emperor Mount Primal Chaos Serpent had. The only possible way to kill it was via the other ‘poisonous head’. The poisonous head contained the life core of a Mount Primal Chaos Serpent. By destroying its poisonous head and breaking apart its life core, the Mount Primal Chaos Serpent would die.
Xue Ying had been restricted by the illusory body of the serpent, causing his strength to drop by nearly half. As he faced the onslaught by the two snake heads, Xue Ying had barely resisted against them.
‘This is just one Mount Primal Chaos Serpent. Fortunately, the defenses of my spear techniques are quite tight, allowing me to hold my ground albeit barely.’ Xue Ying did not dare to be too careless. He executed all the spear techniques he had with all his strength.
As for killing it?
He did not have any thought of killing it at all.
Even the cultivator with the strongest offense present on the battlefield, ‘Xie Fan’, could kill some of the Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms with weaker survival capabilities. As for a Grand Perfection God Emperor ‘Mount Primal Chaos Serpent’, they had to work together to kill it!
…
At this moment, Daoist Hidden Horizon was working with a total of 11 other cultivators in fighting against a Mount Primal Chaos Serpent. The other members of his team were currently holding back all other Mount Primal Chaos Serpents so as to ensure there was a good environment in dealing against the serpent.
12 of them worked together.
Daoist Hidden Horizon had unleashed his black-white domain in suppressing against that single Mount Primal Chaos Serpent while the other cultivators were attacking it with all their power.
“Hong.”
A lightning sword struck downwards.
“Hou~” An enormous head illusion appeared, roaring out angrily. As it roared, it produced a shockwave that shot down at the Mount Primal Chaos Serpent.
Various attacks descended.
That surrounded Mount Primal Chaos Serpent could still move around. Its illusory body obstructed its surroundings, reducing the force of those incoming attacks. Its invulnerable ‘stone head’ had also become bigger, swallowing that ‘poisonous head’ into it! With one head biting the other… it created a chain.
“Kill.”
Daoist Hidden Horizon and the others could continue sending tremors and force down through the stone head in a bid to destroy that ‘poisonous head’ within it.
The 12 cultivators had already prepared for it, yet when they executed their plan, they still felt it was a challenging task.
“It is simply too difficult to kill.”
“It’s Primal Chaos Body could easily dissipate a majority of our attacks.”
“There is still that undying stone head protecting that poisonous head.”
