Fortunately, Daoist Hidden Horizon and other cultivators could sense that they were damaging that hidden ‘poisonous head’. The injuries of this Mount Primal Chaos Serpent was getting more and more serious. And it was due to this factor that they had the confidence to continue.
“Hidden Horizon, that closest 69 Mount Primal Chaos Serpents are currently rushing over. They are getting closer and closer. I am afraid that we do not have sufficient time to kill a Mount Primal Chaos Serpent before they arrive.”
“Hidden Horizon, why not ask Xie Fan for help?”
Daoist Hidden Horizon became anxious when he heard the transmissions from his comrades.
The moment those 69 Mount Primal Chaos Serpents arrive, the number of Mount Primal Chaos Serpents here would rise to 101 of them! Even though their team could still resist against the serpents, they would definitely be on the disadvantaged side! And this was only the nearest wave of enemies. There were still many other waves of Mount Primal Chaos Serpents rushing their way over.
“Xie Fan.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted.
“Why? You can’t handle it and are finding me for help?” Xie Fan transmitted with a weird smile.
“What are the conditions.” Daoist Hidden Horizon asked.
“Previously, you have been interfering in my plot to kill that Flying Snow!” Xie Fan transmitted with a sneer.
“I can promise you that I’ll stop helping him.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted over. This Mount Primal Chaos Serpent involved his cultivation. He had to get it.
Xie Fan transmitted in reply: “We haven’t really met any great danger on the way here. If our journey back is similar to our journey here, even if you don’t help him, he might still survive. Furthermore, he’ll only be losing one helping hand if you don’t help him… this isn’t sufficient for me to act for you.”
“What are your conditions. Just state them directly.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted hurriedly.
“Two Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.” Xie Fan transmitted back.
“You…” Daoist Hidden Horizon was inwardly furious, “I can give you a million cubic meters of food. This is my highest limit.”
He had accumulated slightly less riches.
He merely had a total of three Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses! But this time once he succeeded in the hunt, he would definitely be selecting the Mount Primal Chaos Serpent. He had to make up for the other 50 cultivators in the team. And that in itself would require him to bring out all three Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses he had.
Because one Mount Primal Chaos Serpent was usually equivalent to three other Chaotic Origin Lifeforms of the same level!
“One million cubic meters? Are you insulting me?” Xie Fan sneered.
“How about one Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform? I’ll owe you that temporarily and find another chance to procure one for you.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted.
“Just one of it? And you are thinking of giving it to me in the future? In my opinion, you can slowly kill that serpent yourself.” Xie Fan sneered. Because Daoist Hidden Horizon had helped Xue Ying previously, incurring his dislike. Furthermore, the conditions provided by Daoist Hidden Horizon were simply too low!
…
Even though Daoist Hidden Horizon was indignant, he could do nothing about it. He could only continue striking that Mount Primal Chaos Serpent with all his strength.
“Hurry up and help me!”
“Help me!”
This Mount Primal Chaos Serpent was starting to ask for help.
At that moment, the other Mount Primal Chaos Serpents were rushing their way over. Even that serpent which was originally attacking Xue Ying, had immediately threw Xue Ying aside and charged towards Daoist Hidden Horizon.
“Stop them!”
“Xie Fan, you all should not watch by the side either!”
Those in the team of Daoist Hidden Horizon were starting to get anxious. Xue Ying and the other lone cultivators naturally went to lend a helping hand. As for Xie Fan and his team of cultivators, they merely sneered in response, though they had to act and deal against those Mount Primal Chaos Serpents too.
Xie Fan’s team of cultivators were merely leisurely striking out at the lifeforms.
“Xie Fan, there are still 69 other Mount Primal Chaos Serpents rushing their way over. I hope for you to help me once.”
“So what if they come? As for helping you? Two Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses.” Xie Fan sneered. He was even hoping for the situation to get more dangerous! Even if all 69 of them came, he was confident of surviving. By then when the number of Mount Primal Chaos Serpent crossed 100, that ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ would definitely die.
When that happened, wouldn’t all the savings in the storage treasure of Monarch Flying Snow land in their hands?
Even though Monarch Flying Snow died in battle, his treasures would be considered the spoils of war for the entire team. But Xie Fan had a total of 16 people on his side. According to the contribution of this journey, they might perhaps be entitled to half the rewards.
‘Come on, come on.’
Xie Fan looked forward to it.
Finally.
“Kill those cultivators!”
“Kill them!”
The distant group of Mount Primal Chaos Serpents broke through the sky and let out a heaven-shaking roar.
A total of 69 of them charged in. Their power was heaven-shaking.
“Hong~”
The moment they joined the battle, the situation of the entire battlefield flipped!
Xie Fan and his group of cultivators were doing their utmost to defend against the onslaught. The 16 of them were still encircled around Xue Ying albeit they did not help him at all.
“He is doomed.”
“This Flying Snow is most likely about to die.” Those lone cultivators were working together. They did not dare to participate in the conflict. They were originally weak, and if they were to help Xue Ying? Perhaps they might die.
“Flying Snow, I can no longer help you. You should be a little more careful.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted.
He had no choice.
The current situation for Daoist Hidden Horizon was getting worse and worse.
Because they were currently attacking that single Mount Primal Chaos Serpent which was constantly calling out for help, drawing in more than half the Mount Primal Chaos Serpents present over in their directions. At this moment, Daoist Hidden Horizon was incredibly nervous. He was controlling his black-white domain with utmost effort. The black-white ribbons spread out and continued shackling around those Mount Primal Chaos Serpents so as to delay more time.
“He did not have the help of any other comrades.”
“He seems to have been forsaken.”
“Kill him first.”
Those Mount Primal Chaos Serpents were incredibly intelligent too, especially so for that huge group of Mount Primal Chaos Serpents that were currently attacking Xie Fan and his team of 15 other cultivators. They had discovered that Xue Ying were left alone. Immediately, three Grand Perfection God Emperor Mount Primal Chaos Serpents went to attack Xue Ying.
They were too lazy to care about the internal conflict between the cultivators… as long as they could kill a cultivator, it would make them feverish.
Just like how the cultivators were killing the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms for food.
The Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were similarly filled with desire to kill the cultivators.
“Peng, peng, peng.”
Xue Ying had a taxing time dealing with one single Mount Primal Chaos Serpent previously. At this moment when three Grand Perfection God Emperor Mount Primal Chaos Serpents were rushing his way, he had almost instantaneously been forced into desperation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1344 - Burst out! And return!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1344: Burst out! And return!
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying had a hard time holding on against the three enemies. He was in a desperate situation and was forced to execute his spear techniques to his limit.
“Peng!”
The stone snakehead of that Mount Primal Chaos Serpent was just like a tiny mountain as it rammed forward. Xue Ying fell backwards. Three pieces of bones in his body fractured and fresh blood spurt out. But following that, his body rapidly recovered.
‘This is what I call dangerous!’ Xue Ying started turning frenzied.
When he left the city this time, the only other time he faced such a dangerous situation was back when he faced the Poison Demon Dragons. That allowed him to hone his spear techniques and to deepen his understanding of the Dao of Void. However, now that he was embroiled in another life and death battle, Xue Ying still discovered new problems in his techniques.
Furthermore, his current predicament was way more awful! Xue Ying was fighting for his life. He was also discovering new problems in his understanding and application of the Dao of Void.
In order to reach the ‘Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body’, not only must he refine his body to the pinnacle beneath the level of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Xue Ying had to comprehend an equivalent Dao of Void at the pinnacle level too!
Perfecting his spear techniques…
Perfecting his fleshy body…
Actually, both were similar in that they were an advancement in the Dao!
Just three breaths of time later, Xue YIng no longer dared to continue fighting.
‘If this continues, my injuries would worsen and by then, I can no longer maintain my state of peak for too long.’ Xue Ying thought.
‘Time to burst out with my strongest fleshy body!’
‘I shall use all my strength to battle and verify my spear techniques.’
“Hong!”
The aura from Xue Ying’s body suddenly exploded.
…
As Xie Fan battled against the Mount Primal Chaos Serpents, he was also paying close attention to Xue Ying: ‘Haha, he is completely being trampled. Even though his spear techniques are quite formidable, he would definitely die within the time taken to brew a cup of tea!’
Following that.
“Hong!”
‘What?’ Xie Fan was stupefied.
Currently, Xue Ying’s body had grown bigger and taller. He reached a height of 10 meters! The skin on his body was covered in gray light. Xue Ying was originally quite handsome, and now, he became more muscular and heroic. His aura was also more vigorous and berserk!
The strength of this aura was comparable to Xie Fan’s.
‘Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body?’ Xie Fan was stunned, ‘No, his aura is berserk and unstable! He shouldn’t have reached the true Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body level. Instead, he has burst out to this level temporarily.’
Maintaining this state of fleshy body meant Xue Ying had taken a step across the boundary to the next level!
“Scram!” Xue Ying lashed out with his spear techniques. Many concentric spatial circles were created and lashed out against the stone head of a Mount Primal Chaos Serpent by the side, forcing that Mount Primal Chaos Serpent backwards.
After he erupted with the true strength of his fleshy body.
Being a Dao Cultivator, his control of the Dao of Void enabled him to maintain a level comparable to that of Xie Fan and Daoist Hidden Horizon.
“Peng.””Peng.” He clearly held an advantage in strength. Naturally, he was able to defeat the three Mount Primal Chaos Serpents easily! With the strength of Xue Ying, it would most likely take eight to nine Grand Perfection God Emperor Mount Primal Chaos Serpents to defeat him.
‘This is incredibly awesome!’ Xue Ying continued executing his spear techniques.
The same spear techniques.
Once his fleshy body reached another level, the strength he unleashed was of an entirely different level!
…
Xie Fan and his group of 15 other cultivators were stupefied.
‘No wonder he did not care about respecting me! So this is what he relied on?’ Xie Fan thought, ‘Hmph, I can sense that his body is unstable, and his aura is slightly chaotic. I doubt he can maintain this state for too long! Let’s see what he can do once his berserk state ends.’
“Big Brother Xie Fan, this is troublesome! With this strength, even though he could only maintain it for a short period, that Daoist Hidden Horizon would definitely do his utmost to help him.” Xie Fan’s subordinates understood that things were amiss.
Xie Fan snorted coldly.
Actually, he understood deep in his heart.
A Grand Perfection God Emperor who could boost his strength to an apex level temporarily… naturally had an entirely different status!
“This Flying Snow is actually that powerful?”
“He should likely be comparable with Xie Fan already. At least they are at the same level.”
“Right, Xie Fan is more tyrannical and powerful in his combat style. But this Flying Snow has a more unpredictable combat style and is similarly amazing in close combat.”
Those lone cultivators were stunned when they saw that.
And currently present on the battlefield, it was Daoist Hidden Horizon who rejoiced the most.
When Daoist Hidden Horizon looked at Xue Ying who had grown to a height of 10 meters, his heartbeat could not help but accelerate: ‘What a Monarch Flying Snow! I have been guessing that there must be a reason why he dares to not show any respect for Xie Fan and Mo Shu. Furthermore, he even dared to join the hunting team despite Xie Fan following in it! So it seems he can burst out with such strength temporarily!’
“Monarch Flying Snow, do you have a way of striking the poisonous head through the stone snakehead of that Mount Primal Chaos Serpent?” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted over.
“Yes I have!” Xue Ying transmitted back. He had already comprehended a Dao of Void technique that could permeate force through the body of the enemy.
“I hope that you can help me kill this Mount Primal Chaos Serpent for me! It is already heavily injured and is left with just 30% of its complete life force.” Daoist Hidden Horizon anxiously transmitted over. Even though it was just left with 30% of its life force, his team members did not really have powerful offensive techniques. Naturally, they could not compare with Xue Ying in his powered mode.
“As long as you help me kill this Mount Primal Chaos Serpent, I am willing to give you a Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse as thanks! But you would have to wait for a period of time before I can procure one for you.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted over.
“Haha, this is just a minor matter.”
Xue Ying held onto his spear, stepped through the void and rushed over.
As the other cultivators were still fighting with the Mount Primal Chaos Serpents, Xue Ying did not really encounter any huge obstructions as he rushed over. He could easily strike one or two Mount Primal Chaos Serpents away.
Following that, he rushed through the cultivator encirclement by Daoist Hidden Horizon’s men.
“I hope for you to act.”
Daoist Hidden Horizon and his people had many techniques. They were either restricting or permeating through the body of the serpent. Various techniques were still being unleashed at this moment.
“I am here.”
Xue Ying took huge strides. His lashed out with a spear on that enormous stone head of the Mount Primal Chaos Serpent. At this moment, its stone head had devoured the poisonous head and was carefully protecting its life core.
“Weng.”
An unseen ripple immediately permeated through the obstacles and struck on the poisonous head.
A booming sound was let out! That Mount Primal Chaos Serpent’s injuries became much more serious.
“Hurry up and save me!”
“Save me!” This Mount Primal Chaos Serpent immediately let our roars of help.
“Good! Hurry up and continue!” Daoist Hidden Horizon was in great joy. Their joint attacks were simply too inefficient. Now with Xue Ying’s help, their efficiency of killing the serpent had been boosted tremendously.
“Peng peng peng…”
Xue Ying continued striking the head of that Mount Primal Chaos Serpent furiously. It wanted to dodge and escape, yet it had long been trapped. Hence, he was forced to withstand every incoming strikes! There was also some strange energy continuously tunneling to his poisonous head, corroding his life force away.
“Peng peng peng!” Xue Ying struck out consecutively for 21 times before the soul and aura of that Mount Primal Chaos Serpent became completely exterminated. That enormous stone head also relaxed its mouth, causing the poisonous head to appear. Its stone head shrank to its natural size, and its poisonous head also turned back to its normal size.
“Hahaha…” Daoist Hidden Horizon was in great joy. He waved his hand before collecting the corpse of this Mount Primal Chaos Serpent that he had desired to get. At the same time, he transmitted to every other single member, “I have gotten the Mount Primal Chaos Serpent. Everyone, time to rush back home!”
“Time to go!”
“Go!”
Nobody chose to continue fighting. They were instead doing their best to cast away from the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
The benefit of fighting while running was that they could select the path they took to escape while doing their utmost to hurl behind the other Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that were coming their way.
Other than that Mount Primal Chaos Serpent which Daoist Hidden Horizon kept, they killed nine other Late Stage God Emperor Mount Primal Chaos Serpents before this team of hunting team finally escaped from the pursuit of the serpents.
“Hahaha, we are out!” Daoist Hidden Horizon was currently grinning from ear to ear. His mood had become much more pleasant.
And Xue Ying had long regained back to his original appearance.
At this moment, he was just left with 20% of his life force! He was now constantly recovering by taking in pieces of Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades since he would have to be prepared for any battle on the journey back home.
‘This Chaotic Origin Refinement Body of mine is still filled with flaws. Currently, I can only maintain a height of 10 meters at most once I burst out with my full power.’ Xue Ying thought. This was the smallest he could maintain currently! As his body was unstable, he could not shrink his body to a smaller size.
“Hmph.”
Xie Fan glanced at Xue Ying. He was clearly feeling disdain.
Xie Fan felt unpleasant and unhappy for failing to bring about the death of this Flying Snow. But he understood… that with the current strength of Xue Ying coupled with Daoist Hidden Horizon’s team of people helping Xue Ying, they would have no chance of ensuring the death of Xue Ying.
…
At the same time when this hunting team headed back.
Over at a vast river.
Many beasts started walking out from the river. They were dense in number and all of them had a grand aura. They were clearly Grand Perfection God Emperors--a total of 500 of them. After they came out of the river, another tall and big man soon followed. His body was covered in a scale that was similar to the other beasts. He had crimson-colored eyes. Every step he took on the void caused it to shake and tremble.
His wrists and ankles were shackled. Those shackles extended beyond and into the void.
As he walked out of the river, the golden inscriptions on those shackles lit up, causing them to turn red. Many golden inscriptions were activated, letting out sounds of ‘chi chi chi’ and causing an endless grandeur to press down on his body.
“Those damned Overlords. There will be a day when all the territories governed by you Overlords are destroyed, leaving behind just the few of you alone.” This tall and big male gritted his teeth.
After he came out, batches and more batches of beasts followed behind. They all had the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor too.
A total of 1,000 Chaotic Origin Lifeform guards!
This was clearly a Chaotic Origin Prisoner coming out for an inspection tour!
Every Chaotic Origin Prisoner was suffering from torture day in and out. The only way they could bring relief to themselves would be to kill more cultivators!
“Mn?”
That tall and big male suddenly turned towards a direction. He had received news from the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms under him that there was currently a team of cultivators not too far away from them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1345 - Run run run!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1345: Run run run!
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
“Cultivators?” Those crimson eyes of that tall and big male flashed with frostiness.
Not only did he hate cultivators, he also desired to kill cultivators so as to alleviate the torture he was suffering day in and out.
“Wu!” The tall and big male shouted.
“Sou.” One of the 1,000 Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms came out and appeared beside the tall and big male, respectfully bowing its head: “King!”
The Chaotic Origin Prisoner was a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform. It was also unquestionably the commander of this ‘Hidden Devil Hunter’ team.
The tall and big male said nonchalantly: “Currently not too far away from us, there is a team of cultivators. You lead 500 protectors according to my orders.”
“Yes.” The Hidden Devil Hunter ‘Wu’ respectfully acknowledged.
Very soon.
The 500 Hidden Devil Hunters left. They could converse with their commander via spiritual communication at all times. This was also one of the techniques a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform could do.
‘I hope to capture them all this time round.’ The tall and big male soon led his subordinates and went forward from another direction.
According to their life-long experiences, these cultivators were incredibly slippery. The moment they discovered danger, they would immediately flee with a frightening speed! Every hunting team had a cultivator specialized in speed. It was so fast that it surpassed other cultivators at the same level. Even these Chaotic Origin Lifeforms could not surpass them.
And it was due to this advantage in speed that gave the cultivators the initiative in fleeing from any encirclement by the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
The tall and big male was deliberately sending 500 of his subordinates… deliberately leading the cultivators into a trap. Even still, whether they would succeed was a different matter altogether!
******
The world is currently filled with snow that looked like goose feathers, turning the wilderness into a world of white.
Xue Ying and the other 50 cultivators did not stop at all. They continued proceeding forward under concealment.
“Brother Flying Snow, this time, it is thanks to you that I was able to acquire this Mount Primal Chaos Serpent.” Daoist Hidden Horizon walked alongside Xue Ying. The other subordinates of Daoist Hidden Horizon were originally filled with dislike for Xue Ying, yet now, they were treating him politely and with great respect.
“Even without me, I believe Brother Hidden Horizon can achieve your goal after spending a little more time.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“You can’t say this! If we delayed further, there will be more Chaotic Origin Lifeforms coming our way. Even though we might be able to kill that Mount Primal Chaos Serpent, according to the previous circumstances, there would be a higher chance that we do not have sufficient time to kill it. Instead, we would be forced to give up and choose to flee instead. I must ensure we do not fall into a desperate situation.” Daoist Hidden Horizon said.
Everyone might be willing to fight against certain degree of dangers.
But watching openly as they stepped into ‘despair’ was something even the members under Daoist Hidden Horizon were not willing to do. They would rather rebel and escape with their lives.
“Haha, if you feel that you still owe me greatly, you can always give me one more Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse after returning to the Scarlet Cloud City. I will definitely not reject your goodwill.” Xue Ying joked about.
“You still want more? I promised to give you one corpse and that is on credit! I wish we can kill a few more on the way back.” Daoist Hidden Horizon pursed his lips.
Both of them continued chatting casually. They were seemingly in a good mood.
“Hidden Horizon, we have been discovered by 80 over Hidden Devil Hunters.” The gray-robed male transmitted.
“We have been discovered?” Daoist Hidden Horizon frowned, “How many Grand Perfection God Emperors are there in the 80 over Hidden Devil Hunters?”
“Preliminary observation suggests that there are close to half of them.” The gray-robed male replied.
“Then let us attack them! This time, we have hunted slightly less lifeforms. We should kill more on the way back.” Daoist Hidden Horizon calmly decided.
Daoist Hidden Horizon then transmitted to all the other cultivators: “Fellow cultivators, we have been discovered by a team of Hidden Devil Hunters--a total of over 80 and close to half are Grand Perfection God Emperors! Prepare to fight.”
“Over 80 of them?”
Hidden Devil Hunter
The team was clearly relaxed.
Hidden Devil Hunters belonged to a slightly bigger tribe. Estimatedly there were more than 50,000 Hidden Devil Hunters in the tribe! With such numbers… their bloodlines were certainly not precious, and they were quite ordinary in strength too. A single Mount Primal Chaos Serpent could even fight with three Hidden Devil Hunters at the same level!
Just over 80 Hidden Devil Hunters?
They could completely suppress them!
“Brother Flying Snow, you must help me. Let us work together and kill one or two Grand Perfection God Emperors.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted.
“Alright. I came out not to sightsee, but to secure more food as well.” Xue Ying replied. This time, other than that Mount Primal Chaos Serpent, they had not hunted any other Grand Perfection God Emperors.
“Hong!”
The battle soon began.
Xue Ying and the others had even more Grand Perfection God Emperors than those Chaotic Origin Lifeforms! When they worked together and coordinated perfectly, they could simply sweep over the enemies.
Furthermore, this time with the help of a powered Xue Ying aiding Daoist Hidden Horizon and the rest, they even killed a Grand Perfection God Emperor ‘Hidden Devil Hunter’.
“Hong.” Xue Ying who had grown to a height of 10 meters exuded a wild aura. He smashed his spear on the head of a Hidden Devil Hunter, causing its skull to bend. That Hidden Devil Hunter’s soul soon dissipated.
“Success!”
“It is dead!”
Daoist Hidden Horizon and the others were filled with joy.
Xue Ying also let out a sigh of relief. His body immediately shrank back to its original appearance. Just battling for ten breaths consumed 20% of his life force! The life force that he regained after consuming his Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades had been used up again.
‘It is truly not easy. Even with the restriction by Daoist Hidden Horizon and a group of Grand Perfection God Emperors working together, even when I used all my strength, we spent ten breaths before killing a Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly. The Hidden Devil Hunters were considered one of the more ordinary types of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.Yet killing a Grand Perfection God Emperor took so much effort.
“What?” Xie Fan was filled with slight envy when he saw that.
He and his subordinates did not succeed in killing a Grand Perfection God Emperor.
They had no choice.
Both Daoist Hidden Horizon and Xue Ying could erupt with a strength comparable to the apex experts in Scarlet Cloud City. Yet Xie Fan was just by himself.
“Hidden Horizon.” Xie Fan could not help but transmit a message over, “Come help me too.” Daoist Hidden Horizon’s black-white domain had the best effect in suppressing the overall strength of the enemy.
“Hmph hmph, now you want to ask me for my help?” Daoist Hidden Horizon glanced at the distant Xie Fan.
“If you helped me, by then, you will be given a greater share after judgment by the Scarlet Cloud Hall Device Spirit.” Xie Fan transmitted in reply. If it were other apex experts from the Scarlet Cloud City, they might prefer keeping their honor. Previously, both parties had entered a conflict and such apex experts would usually not ask Daoist Hidden Horizon for help! But clearly, ‘Xie Fan’ did not care about his reputation.
Despite angrily rebuking the other party previously, in the blink of an eye, he was filled with smiles and was trying to negotiate once again.
“You are asking for my help?” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted, “Alright, then let me help you out once.”
“Many thanks.” Xie Fan grinned.
“But we can’t stay here for long. I’ll help you once again when we encounter the next wave of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.” Daoist Hidden Horizon said.
“Fellow cultivators, let us set off again. We should not continue fighting anymore.” Daoist Hidden Horizon ordered.
They must not get overzealous in the battles outside the city.
They had to complete each battle within a short period.
…
Xue Ying’s hunting team continued fleeing at high speed.
The team was filled with laughter. Many cultivators were clearly in a pleasant mood as they had just killed a Grand Perfection God Emperor previously.
But all of a sudden--
“What?” Daoist Hidden Horizon’s expression suddenly changed. He stared at the gray-robed man, “Are you sure you saw correctly?”
“I am certain of it.” The gray-robed man nodded.
“What happened?” The other cultivators all turned to Daoist Hidden Horizon.
Daoist Hidden Horizon immediately transmitted a message to everyone: “There are more than 800 Hidden Devil Hunters rushing in our direction currently. Furthermore, there are more than 600 Grand Perfection God Emperors within them!”
This actually contained 500 protectors that were dispatched by the Chaotic Origin Prisoner! These 500 protectors had met several other smaller teams of Hidden Devil Hunters and had gathered them together. In the end, a huge team of more than 800 of them were formed.
“What?”
“More than 800 Hidden Devil Hunters?”
“With over 600 Grand Perfection God Emperors?”
They fell into a daze. They even felt waves of coldness striking their bodies.
The Hidden Devil Hunters were slightly more common. This team of cultivators were confident of fighting to a draw with 200 ‘Grand Perfection God Emperor’ Hidden Devil Hunters! And despite encountering 300 over Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters… they were still confident of escaping after fighting with them. As for 400? The team would start seeing some losses! 500? The team would have more grievous injuries. It was normal for half of the team to die.
But more than 600 out of the 800 lifeforms were Grand Perfection God Emperors?
The moment they began fighting…
If they were lucky, several could survive. Otherwise, it could be very possible for the entire team to be wiped!
“Run run run!” Xie Fan angrily shouted, “Hurry up and run!”
“Hurry up!” Daoist Hidden Horizon also ordered.
“Sou!”
A gray dimmed light enveloped the entire team as their speed was boosted to the pinnacle! They began their mad escape!

chapters.title: Chapter 1346 - Illusory Realm, Descend!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1346: Illusory Realm, Descend!
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
“How could this be? Why would we encounter such a huge Hidden Devil Hunter group?”
“More than 800 of which 600 are Grand Perfection God Emperors? This ratio of Grand Perfection God Emperors is simply too high!”
“Are are simply too unlucky this time.”
“We actually encountered such a terrifying group of Hidden Devil Hunters.”
The team used their fastest speed to escape.
They were all anxious and filled with disbelief! Because it was simply too rare for them to encounter such a huge group of Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Most of the time, this would only be found near the territories of ‘Chaotic Origin Prisoners’ where the bulk of the tribe would be congregated at! Their path of journey back had been arranged carefully--they ensured they moved along a trajectory far away from any Chaotic Origin Prisoner territories!
At this moment.
This hunting team of cultivators did not actually knew that they had coincidentally met a ‘Chaotic Origin Prisoner’ whom was out for a patrol.
When the Chaotic Origin Prisoner went out for a patrol, it had appeared at a location that was coincidentally close to the cultivators. And as a result, he rapidly arranged for an ambush.
Otherwise if that Chaotic Origin Prisoner was still in his territory! The distance to the cultivators would be simply too far, such that even if it received news about the cultivators, it would not have sufficient time to reach the cultivators.
“Fellow cultivators, don’t worry. We have discovered those 800 Hidden Devil Hunters way before they reached us! At our current speed which is much faster than theirs, we should be able to cast them behind in a while! It is impossible for them to track us down anymore.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted.
“Mn.”
“Let us hurry up and cast them far behind.”
Even though both parties were quite far apart, the cultivators would never feel at ease if they did not escape from the Hidden Devil Hunters.
Because the moment they were caught up by the enemies, they would be wiped out!
…
But it seemed the cultivators were not really fortunate. Not too long after they fled.
“Not good. There is a ‘White Stone God’ tribe ahead containing more than 200 of them that discovered us.” The cold golden-armored male anxiously transmitted over.
“What? White Stone God?” Daoist Hidden Horizon was greatly astonished.
“More than half of them are Grand Perfection God Emperors.” The cold golden-armored male added.
Anxiety wrecked through Daoist Hidden Horizon.
White Stone Gods… were much stronger than the Hidden Devil Hunters! A White Stone God could fight against two Hidden Devil Hunters on the same level.
And now, approximately 200 White Stone Gods were chasing after the cultivators. In terms of strength, they were not any weaker than the cultivators.
“The White Stone Gods are pursuing after us from the front, and the Hidden Devil Hunters are coming from the back. If we took a detour… it is possible for them to catch up to us.” The cold golden-armored male transmitted, “Hidden Horizon, this are the locations of some other tribes we have already discovered by the periphery. Those tribes have temporarily not discovered us yet.”
“Mn.”
Daoist Hidden Horizon contemplated over the current situation based on how the different Chaotic Origin Lifeform tribes were distributed on the map.
Currently, two tribes had discovered them.
One was behind chasing after them. It was the most terrifying Hidden Devil Hunter tribe with more than 800 coming in their direction.
One tribe was ahead of them. They were currently charging in their direction, rapidly closing the gap between. That was also a group of 200 White Stone Gods.
By the periphery, there were many other tribes that had yet to discover them too.
‘The Hidden Devil Hunters are slightly further than us. If we were to charge forward, we should have sufficient time to break apart the blockade by the White Stone Gods.’ Daoist Hidden Horizon made his decision.
Following that.
Daoist Hidden Horizon immediately informed the current situation to every other cultivator in the team.
“What? There are still White Stone Gods?”
“More than 200 White Stone Gods ahead of us?”
They were starting to panic.
It seemed the current situation was quite awful.
“Right now, the best way for us is to charge forward with our fastest speed! The Hidden Devil Hunters are slightly further behind us. It is definitely possible for us to break through the blockade of the White Stone Gods before they reach us.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted his suggestion to the others.
“Alright.”
“Let us charge through.”
Everyone had gotten a map showing the distribution of the tribes around them, and knew this was the best decision.
“Brother Flying Snow, I know you can’t maintain your peak state for too long. But you have to fight for it.” Daoist Hidden Horizon transmitted.
“Rest assured.” Xue Ying nodded. He was the calmest person in the team. Because to him, this was a trip of improvement! He did not feel any danger from the 800 Hidden Devil Hunters chasing in their direction.
“They are here.”
“Prepare for battle!”
As both parties were charging at each other, the cultivators and the group of White Stone Gods soon clashed.
The White Stone Gods were giants made entirely from white stone. They had different shapes and sizes and were all humanoids. They were even carrying weapons on their hands! Some carried stone rods and some stone axes. Others had stone hammers. All those weapons were made from ‘white stone’.
“Kill.”
“Kill those cultivators!” More than 200 White Stone God roared out. They waved their enormous weapons with incredible strength, charging out in the direction of the cultivators.
Xue Ying and the other cultivators had already unleashed their strength and were coordinating with one another. They were either restricting those White Stone Gods with their domains, or to use some cunning techniques in interfering them. Others included combined techniques… all sorts of weird techniques were sent in the way of the enemies. As for Xue Ying, he had transformed himself into a ten-meters giant with a gray light covering his skin. At this moment, he was relying on the profoundness of his techniques to exhibit a strength not any weaker than a Grand Perfection God Emperor White Stone God! With how unpredictable his techniques were, Xue Ying could even triumph over the enemies!
“Go!” They easily forced the 100 White Stone Gods to fly far away. When those White Stone Gods fell onto the ground, it created a huge tremor.
“Hurry up and cast them away!” Daoist Hidden Horizon immediately released his black-white domain. When those black-white ribbons scattered, it could turn the outcome of the battle around!
…
Very soon.
The team of cultivators charged past the blockade by those White Stone Gods. The moment they broke through, they immediately increased their speed and fled.
“The team of Hidden Devil Hunters are getting closer to us.” Nobody present dared to relax. According to their current situation, the group of Hidden Devil Hunters had shortened the distance between them by more than half.
‘The period that my body can maintain at peak state is too short.’ Xue Ying regained back to his original body, leaving behind just 20% of his original life force!
He had no choice.
Even if his body was perfectly fine, he could only maintain his peak state after consuming all the life force he had for the time taken to brew a cup of tea.
‘My current fleshy body is unable to persist in some slightly longer battles.’ Xue Ying shook his head inwardly.
“What!”
“No!”
The expression of the gray-robed man paled. His eyes were filled with terror.
The entire team turned to him. Even Daoist Hidden Horizon was stunned. He asked: “Barbaric Insect, what happened?”
“It’s a prisoner!” The gray-robed man was currently transmitting to everyone. He said with slight despair, “A Chaotic Origin Prisoner! It is right ahead. A Chaotic Origin Prisoner is currently bringing more than 700 Hidden Devil Hunters with it! It is the Chaotic Origin Prisoner of the Hidden Devil Hunter tribe. I understand now. Everything is a plot, a scheme! It should have just gone out for a patrol, and this Chaotic Origin Prisoner actually discovered us… hence, it sent out a large group of Hidden Devil Hunters to force us in the direction it wanted us to go. This prisoner then led another team of subordinates to sandwich us. We are doomed, doomed!”
The team was in complete silence.
They were all stunned; their hearts were filled with despair.
“I have cultivated for so long, walking step by step in this journey from my hometown. I became the first person in my cosmos to jump out of the cosmic restriction… until now… I saw so many cultivators from different civilizations falling, and it is my turn today?” An old man wearing a loose gold robe murmured to himself.
“The prisoner is out on patrol. We are doomed.”
Many cultivators began reminiscing what they had been through back in their lives. Having chosen to come to this world, they were already mentally prepared to die.
Yet when the day came, they felt complex in their hearts.
All of them understood their current situation. This was a ‘Chaotic Origin Prisoner’ out on patrol. And it coincidentally discovered them, plotting out a ‘chess game’. Actually, such occurrences were rare! Because there were only so few Chaotic Origin Prisoners in the entire Sacred World and most of the time, those prisoners would remain in their territories.
The moment they came out of their territories, they would suffer from a more severe penalty! Hence, they would occasionally go out for a patrol!
And it was rare for a prisoner to appear out in the wild!
The cultivators also rarely gathered. They would only leave the city to hunt.
But now, for both situations to occur at the same time?
This probability was incredibly low. It did happened before in history!
“Hidden Horizon.” Xie Fan’s eyes were filled with madness. He immediately transmitted a message over to Hidden Horizon, “There is only one way to survive and that is to split up! One team of Hidden Devil Hunters are chasing from behind, and another team of Hidden Devil Hunters are led by a Chaotic Origin Prisoner ahead of us… both forward and backward are a dead-end for us! Hence, we can only escape along the two sides! With their numbers, if we choose to escape together, we’ll definitely die. We have to split up. Perhaps, one team might be able to survive!”
Daoist Hidden Horizon turned to Xie Fan.
Right.
It was best they split up.
“By then, both you and I can select the elites from the team and form one that doesn’t exceed 10 people.” Xie Fan continued, “We have 51 cultivators in total, and forming a team not more than 10… I believe the number of Hidden Devil Hunters chasing after us will not be as many. Furthermore, with all the elites gathered in our team, it is definitely more possible for us to escape.”
Daoist Hidden Horizon hesitated for a moment: “Who are you planning to select?”
“This is the name list I came up with.” Xie Fan immediately transmitted a list over.
“What? Monarch Flying Snow isn’t inside?” Daoist Hidden Horizon hesitated.
“He is just left with 20% of his original life force! Furthermore, he can only maintain his peak state for a very short period. With just 20% of his life force left, his contribution will be negligible. If we were to escape… it is definitely possible for the battle to persist for a long time.” Xie Fan transmitted, “Why not let him stay in the other team. Once he releases his wild aura, it might perhaps attract more attention too.”
Saying it was slow.
But in reality, both parties had conversed very quickly.
“I’ll have to alter this name list first.” Daoist Hidden Horizon gritted his teeth. This list had nine people in total! He and Xie Fan occupied two spots, leaving just seven other cultivators they could choose. Both Xie Fan and he… would have to give up on many subordinates. This brought grief and indignation to Daoist Hidden Horizon.
But he understood this was the only strand of survival.
“Kill!”
“Kill those cultivators!”
“Kill all of them!”
The Hidden Devil Hunter group ahead had appeared within their vision. They were all moving at a rapid pace, arcing through the sky and killing their way over. Behind them was a tall and big male. That tall and big male was shackled with manacles and leg-irons over his limbs. Those shackles would shine constantly with golden inscriptions as if there was a terrifying suppression pressing down on this tall and big male.
Yet that tall and big male watched coldly at everything. He watched as his subordinate Hidden Devil Hunters charged towards that team of cultivators.
“Let us split up. Perhaps there might be a chance for us to survive.” Xie Fan abruptly roared out to the others.
Both he and Daoist Hidden Horizon did not hesitate to bring those seven cultivators, turning into a stream of light and left at a high speed in one direction.
“What?”
When the other cultivators saw what happened, they understood that Xie Fan and Daoist Hidden Horizon had given up on the rest.
Xue Ying was stunned. Following that, he understood. That’s right, he was just left with 20% of his life force. He could not maintain his peak strength for long.
“Run!” Some cultivators chose to escape.
“Fight for it!”
“Let us fight with them! Perhaps, we might break through to the Chaotic Origin Level under this deadly situation.” Some cultivators stood their ground.
Various cultivators went on different routes.
“Interesting.”
Xue Ying nodded slightly.
He took a step.
“Sou.”
Arcing through the sky, Xue Ying took the initiative of inviting that group of Hidden Devil Hunters coming his way.
“Illusory Realm, descend!” Xue Ying looked ahead. He waved his hand out and pressed into the void.
“Hong!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1347 - Unfathomable
chapters.content:
Chapter 1347: Unfathomable
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Many Hidden Devil Hunters arced through the sky and charged towards these cultivators. They naturally split apart! And they started pursuing different cultivators. Of course, Xue Ying and the others stood at the center without running. And in the opinion of the Hidden Devil Hunters, they could reach them the fastest! Hence, more than half the Hidden Devil Hunters charged in the direction of Xue Ying and the rest.
Xue Ying took a step and moved through the sky. He arrived at the front before taking the initiative to battle against this huge group of Hidden Devil Hunters.
He extended his right hand and pressed into the void!
‘Illusory Realm, descend!’ With a thought, Xue Ying casted his strongest ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’ killing technique.
“Hong.”
An enormous illusory realm descended all of a sudden.
“What is this…” Those Chaotic Origin Lifeforms felt an enormous illusory realm hauling their souls into it. This force was pulling their souls into that illusory realm, and once their souls fell into it, they would enter oblivion for eternity. At that moment, every single Hidden Devil Hunter did their utmost to resist the pull. “Boom boom boom…” Those Hidden Devil Hunters that were originally moving through the sky fell down. Some of the incredibly weak ‘Middle Stage God Emperor’ Hidden Devil Hunters smashed down onto the ground; no more life aura could be sensed coming from them. They had died there and then! There were even two Late Stage God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters that had fallen unconscious and fell onto the ground. Both of them similarly died.
In the blink of an eye.
Of the 200 or so Hidden Devil Hunters rushing towards Xue Ying, 29 had died in a single instance! The other Hidden Devil Hunters like those that were Late Stage God Emperors had only 30% to 40% of their original strength left. Those that were weaker could only exhibit 10% to 20% of their strength. As for the Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters, all of them had to consume a large amount of their heart force in resisting against the pull. As a result, they were weakened by more than half their original strength.
“How could this be?”
“King, King, there is a terrifying world currently pulling on our souls. It is trying to pull our souls into that enormous world where we would fall into oblivion for eternity. King, I am just left with 10% of my original strength.” Some of the Late Stage God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters were so frightened by it that they began retreating.
They were intelligent and were clear that with just 10% to 20% of their original strength, those cultivators could simply massacre them.
“Oh? All Middle and Late Stage God Emperors retreat at this moment.” A voice sounded in the minds of all Hidden Devil Hunters.
This was the voice of the king.
And at the next instance, ‘sou sou sou’…
Hidden Devil Hunters further away that had not fallen into the region of Xue Ying’s illusory realm, as long as they were Middle Stage or Late Stage God Emperors began retreating at this moment.
…
And thus.
A miraculous scene appeared. When Xue Ying took a step to welcome the Hidden Devil Hunters, as he extended his hand and pressed into the void, 29 Hidden Devil Hunters that were charging immediately fell down onto the ground, dead. Furthermore, more than 100 weaker Hidden Devil Hunters immediately started retreating.
Those that dared to continue fighting were the Grand Perfection God Emperors!
‘An enormous world?’ That tall and big male standing behind pondered. His limbs were shackled by manacles, and those manacles were constantly illuminated by golden inscriptions. Waves and waves of torture and restrictions were suppressing him at that moment, though he was used to it.
At this moment, he was shocked by what he saw.
‘An enormous world that could pull the souls of others? This is a soul technique that is cast on a large region. As long as one enters that region, he’ll be affected by the attractive force from the enormous world.’ The tall and big male contemplated, ‘In this world, there is actually an expert in soul appearing within the cultivators? I have never heard of this before.’
The tall and big male was clear in his heart.
He was a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform. If he was not suppressed by any restrictions, he could wipe out all cultivators in this world with a flip of his hand!
But now, he was being imprisoned and tortured. The further he got from his territory, the stronger the suppression and penalty he would suffer from. For instance, if he were to travel to the Scarlet Cloud City, his strength would fall to a level where any cultivator could kill him! In this world, other than the ‘Sea of Abyss Master’ who was also the strongest Chaotic Origin Prisoner, other Chaotic Origin Prisoners would definitely remain vigilant when they went out for a patrol. The further they got from their territories, the more protectors they would bring.
‘It seems number is useless before this soul domain?’ The tall and big male frowned slightly.
******
There were 18 other cultivators behind Xue Ying who did not flee. They were prepared for a battle to the death. They even harbored a strand of hope in their hearts that they might perhaps break through before dying to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
Nonetheless, right when they were about to fight with their lives, everything that Xue Ying just did completely stunned them.
“This, this, this…”
“What is happening?”
“I don’t see any techniques being executed?”
They were hoodwinked.
Xue Ying had indeed extended his hand and pressed into the void. It might look as if he had thrown a technique out, yet soul techniques could not be seen with the naked eyes! Xue Ying’s application of the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm had also avoided the cultivators. Hence, these cultivators did not understand what exactly did Xue Ying just do. He was still quite far away from the Hidden Devil Hunters yet 29 Hidden Devil Hunters died and more than 100 of them were frightened to a retreat!
This was something they had never heard before!
Unfathomable!
“Kill!” Those Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters were the fastest. They had instantaneously reached the cultivators with their charge as the cultivators had not fled.
More than 50 Hidden Devil Hunters began surrounding and attacking Xue Ying. There were other Hidden Devil Hunters targeting other cultivators too.
“Fight!” Xue Ying ordered, “Fellow cultivators, there is no need to be worried. Their strengths have been greatly weakened. It isn’t of concern now.”
Xue Ying wielded his spear.
“Hu.”
Even without erupting his peak fleshy body state--his current ordinary fleshy body was at the Late Stage God Emperor Realm, being a Dao Cultivator, he could still exhibit the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor! Furthermore, those cultivators that were prepared to fight to the death had also began executing their techniques and were helping one another.
“Peng.” Xue Ying’s casual strike had blasted a Hidden Devil Hunter backwards.
Waving his spear, Xue Ying began executing his Void Devil Insect Body Technique, causing his body to turn blurry. Even though there were more than 50 Hidden Devil Hunters attacking him, only seven or eight of them could attack Xue Ying at any one time. Hence, Xue Ying easily parried against those weakened Hidden Devil Hunters that currently only had the strength of a Late Stage God Emperor.
“Yi?”
“They seem weak.”
“How could they become so weak? It feels like they are only Late Stage God Emperors.”
“But their fleshy bodies are still very strong. They are fleshy bodies of a Grand Perfection God Emperor.” Those cultivators had discovered this problem.
Those Hidden Devil Hunters that originally had an aura of a Grand Perfection God Emperor still had a powerful fleshy body. It’s just that their offensive techniques were greatly weakened. When they worked together, the 18 of them and Xue Ying--a total of 19 cultivators--had easily suppressed more than 200 Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters.
“Monarch Flying Snow, what is this technique of yours? It is simply too formidable. Those Hidden Devil Hunters have been greatly weakened. Let’s not talk about 200, even when more than 500 come, we can still easily suppress them.” A metallic giant waved his great hammer. With a smash, he smacked a Hidden Devil Hunter back. “Peng peng peng”, he consecutively blasted seven to eight Hidden Devil Hunters away, completely sweeping across them!
“Monarch Flying Snow, truly admirable.”
“Monarch Flying Snow, we owe our lives to you.”
They were originally prepared to die.
And now that they saw hope, they were incredibly excited. At the same time, they admired Xue Ying for his miraculous technique! Such a technique… was something even the three Great City Masters lacked.
“Let us go save the others.” Xue Ying transmitted.
“We will listen to you, Monarch Flying Snow.”
“Monarch Flying Snow, we will save whoever you ask us to.”
They transmitted over.
…
Xue Ying and the others that that remained at their original position were also the first to battle.
The other cultivators that had escaped in other directions also paid attention to what just happened. They all stared at Xue Ying’s unfathomable technique blankly.
It was one man who caused 29 Hidden Devil Hunters to die and more than 100 to escape.
Following that, he led 18 cultivators to suppress more than 200 Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters? It seemed every Hidden Devil Hunter had become much weaker and were easily defeated.
“Let’s stop running!”
Daoist Hidden Horizon was shook by what he saw. Following that, he immediately made his decision and transmitted to his subordinates, “Hurry! Hurry up and return! We must converge with Monarch Flying Snow! This is our own way to survive.”
“Return!”
“Return!”
This team consisting of Daoist Hidden Horizon, Xie Fan, and others… Daoist Hidden Horizon and the other seven did not hesitate to return.
Xie Fan momentarily hesitated before rushing over in the direction of Xue Ying as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 1348 - Xie Fan’s True Self
chapters.content:
Chapter 1348: Xie Fan’s True Self
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Of those fleeing cultivators, the team with Daoist Hidden Horizon and Xie Fan in it were the most decisive and also the team that escaped the furthest.
The other cultivators hesitated momentarily after being abandoned. Only then did they choose either to flee or to remain at their original position. Even those that escaped… had not really ran very far away. Furthermore, Xue Ying was also leading the 18 cultivators to lend a helping hand to them.
“Hurry up! Let us converge with Monarch Flying Snow.”
“We must hold on! Hold on until the moment we reach Monarch Flying Snow. That way, we can survive.”
They were all rushing in the direction of Xue Ying.
Nonetheless, many of the Hidden Devil Hunters had already dispersed in their pursuit after the cultivators. Hence, battles started happening all over the place. These ‘Hidden Devil Hunters’ that fought with them were not weakened whatsoever. They could still exhibit their peak strength, forcing those cultivators into an unspeakable misery. Even as the group of cultivators helped one another, with 50 Hidden Devil Hunters attacking them at the same time, they were soon on the brink of death.
“Hurry up! Monarch Flying Snow and the others are reaching soon.”
“Hold on a little longer!”
They were all madly fighting for their lives.
And all of a sudden--
The surrounding 50 over Hidden Devil Hunters abruptly weakened. As they fought, those Hidden Devil Hunters would either be suppressed to a level where they had a hard time struggling against it, or they would be smacked away and even be suppressed utterly…
“They have become weaker.”
“All of them are much weaker. It seems they only have the strength of a Late Stage God Emperor.” These cultivators were in great joy. Everybody in this eight-man team had the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor. At this moment, they felt that dealing with the group of Hidden Devil Hunters was simply too easy. They easily overwhelmed those hunters. Other than the Hidden Devil Hunters that still had an abundance of life force, making it hard to kill, other aspects of those Hidden Devil Hunters were completely weaker.
“Converge onto me.” Xue Ying led the 18 cultivators over.
“Alright.”
“They are here!”
“Monarch Flying Snow, many thanks for saving our lives.”
“Monarch Flying Snow, this technique of yours is incredible. Despite being so far away, those Hidden Devil Hunters have become significantly weaker. Haha, not a single Hidden Devil Hunter could take on a technique of mine.” These cultivators were incredibly excited. This feeling whereby they were unparalleled felt good!
At this moment, they were filled with gratitude and admiration for Xue Ying.
Admiration… was an admiration towards experts.
They were very clear how defying this technique that could sweep across a large group of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms is! The moment ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ returned to Scarlet Cloud City, his status would definitely rise. If Monarch Flying Snow was willing to form a team, a large number of cultivators would likely be willing to join it.
…
Xue Ying continued leading his group to save other cultivators. As long as those cultivators entered his region of Illusory Realm Domain, they would be saved.
Nonetheless.
As quite a few cultivators had fled in different directions, saving all of them was slightly troublesome too.
“Ai, in the end, three cultivators have died.” After saving the scattered cultivators, they were just left with one final team that had not linked up with them--the nine-man team consisting of Daoist Hidden Horizon and Xie Fan! Actually, this was also due to Xue Ying saving other cultivators first, preventing Daoist Hidden Horizon and his team from reaching Xue Ying.
Of course, he was deliberately doing this--placing the team containing Daoist Hidden Horizon and Xie Fan last.
Firstly, it was because Daoist Hidden Horizon and Xie Fan had taken the initiative to abandon other cultivators. Secondly, it was also because this team is the strongest group within the 51 cultivators. Hence, they should be able to last the longest.
“Brother Flying Snow, it is my fault! Hurry up and help us out! We can’t hold on any longer.” The nine of them including Daoist Hidden Horizon were currently suffering from a combined attack by a force of more than 80 Hidden Devil Hunters! Daoist Hidden Horizon and Xie Fan were apex cultivators within Scarlet Cloud City. With the two of them and seven other cultivators coordinating, they could still barely hold on against the enemies.
“Monarch Flying Snow, are we saving them?”
“That Xie Fan had plotted against you several times.”
“They have chosen to give us up previously.”
The cultivators were transmitted to Xue Ying and waiting on his orders.
Clearly, this group of cultivators that had been saved by Xue Ying treated him as the absolute core within the team! Even others that were once following Daoist Hidden Horizon were now standing on Xue Ying’s side. Even though they understood the decision made by Daoist Hidden Horizon and Xie Fan, they no longer held any emotions for them the moment Daoist Hidden Horizon and Xie Fan made the decision. There were even some cultivators who held hatred and anger over this!
“Let us save them first. That Chaotic Origin Prisoner is still staring at us from afar.” Xue Ying transmitted.
“Alright.”
“Let’s save them.”
With an order, the other cultivators followed after him.
“Monarch Flying Snow, the 800 over Hidden Devil Hunters that have been chasing after us from another direction are soon reaching our position. But the Middle Stage and Late Stage God Emperors among them have retreated, leaving behind over 600 Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters still.” The cold golden-armored male transmitted over to Xue Ying. He was also one of them who had been abandoned.
The team selected by Daoist Hidden Horizon were all specialist. There was only one of them who specialized in long-range scouting--which was that gray-robed man, ‘Barbaric Insect’.
“The other group of Hidden Devil Hunters are about to reach us?” Xue Ying felt his heart tightening.
When both parties came together.
There would be a total of 1,200 Grand Perfection God Emperors! Even if they were all weakened, there were still too many of them! Furthermore, there was still that ‘Chaotic Origin Prisoner’. Xue Ying had remained vigilant against that Chaotic Origin Prisoner. At this moment, he had not shown his strongest strength yet in battle. Furthermore, he was still constantly recovering by absorbing the Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades so that he could prepare himself for dealing against the threat from that ‘Chaotic Origin Prisoner’.
“Hurry up!”
“Brother Flying Snow, hurry over! We can’t hold on for any longer!” Daoist Hidden Horizon anxiously transmitted over.
Xue Ying’s group of cultivators were doing their best too. At this moment, more and more Hidden Devil Hunters were attacking the group with Daoist Hidden Horizon.
“Weng--”
Prior to the advent of that Illusory Realm Domain, one cultivator in Daoist Hidden Horizon’s team still fell! Hence, the total death in this battle had reached four.
“They have become weaker.” Daoist Hidden Horizon and Xie Fan discovered this point with astonishing delight. Xie Fan even glanced at Xue Ying who was currently rushing over. He felt complex: ‘This Monarch Flying Snow has hidden such an unfathomable technique. Even though he is slightly weaker in direct combat, with this technique of his, his ability to rally supporters is likely to be stronger than even the three City Masters.’
Xie Fan felt regret and annoyed, yet it was too late. After all, he had viciously offended this Monarch Flying Snow.
“Monarch Flying Snow, it is I who offended you previously. Everything is due to my foolishness. Everything is my fault. Just treat me like a fart and let it off.” Xie Fan immediately transmitted to Xue Ying.
When Xue Ying heard what Xie Fan sent, he was slightly stunned.
The other party was one of the apex experts in Scarlet Cloud City. Yet he did not care about his reputation at all! Previously, the other party attempted to deal with him. If not for his strength, Xue Ying would have died.
“Brother Flying Snow, I feel truly ashamed.” Daoist Hidden Horizon even came to apologise.
“Let us deal with this Chaotic Origin Prisoner before speaking.” Xue Ying cut them off.
“Right, there is still a Chaotic Origin Prisoner.” Currently, this team had treated Xue Ying as the core.
“With Monarch Flying Snow around, we’ll definitely survive!” Xie Fan even shouted out loud, “Perhaps we might be able to kill that Chaotic Origin Prisoner! All of you must listen to Monarch Flying Snow’s orders. Those who dare to slight him, I, Xie Fan, will definitely not let him off!”
Xue Ying took a deep breath.
It seemed he finally experienced the shamelessness of Xie Fan for the first time!
“How shameless.”
“This Xie Fan…” The other cultivators were speechless.
…
When all the cultivators gathered together.
On another side, the other 600 over Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters had also charged over.
“Everyone is here.” That tall and big male who had remained unrushed behind nodded slightly, “As long as we eliminate that cultivator who specializes in soul technique, the other cultivators would be doomed.”
“Hua.”
The tall and big male took a step. He stepped through the void, moving at an incredibly fast speed. There were also many other Hidden Devil Hunters standing guard around him.
At this moment, approximately 1,200 Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters were madly charging at Xue Ying and the cultivators. Even though they had been greatly weakened, their bodies were so strong that they did not fear death.
“Face the enemies!” Xue Ying solemnly stared at that distant tall and big male. The tall and big male gave off a very heavy pressure as if he was carrying a world with him, constantly suffering from endless torture and suppression. Nonetheless, that talland big male had a calm expression. His crimson eyes were only staring at Xue Ying!
Clearly, in the eyes of this Chaotic Origin Prisoner, that white-robed young cultivator was his only true opponent.

chapters.title: Chapter 1349 - Battling against the Chaotic Origin Prisoner
chapters.content:
Chapter 1349: Battling against the Chaotic Origin Prisoner
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying and the other cultivators felt their hearts tightening. A ‘High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform’ represented a true genuine Chaotic Origin Expert. Just like how bloodline cultivators would become High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms the moment they awaken their bloodline! Even though he was being oppressed severely, just his remaining strength was sufficient to make the cultivators feel suppressed.
It was like a gigantic shackled dragon overlooking several ants.
The tall and big male stepped on the void. His voice boomed across the world: “Brat in White, your soul technique is quite formidable. Ever since I was imprisoned in this world, I have never thought that a cultivator like you would emerge. If I could kill you, that’ll definitely be a great harvest.”
The moment he finished speaking.
His body abruptly disappeared. But the manacles and shackles could still be clearly seen. Those manacles and shackles were brightly lit with the revolution of golden inscriptions. Those shackles even extended into the void.
‘Even when his strength has been suppressed to this level, his use of techniques is at a level beyond ours.’ Xue Ying understood this point, ‘Even when he conceals himself, we can’t see him properly. Fortunately, the shackles and manacles have revealed his position.’
The shackles and manacles merely revealed the location where the enemy was.
But how the tall and big male planned to attack? What weapon was he using? They remained ignorant of it.
If he stabbed a sword over, he might not even know it was coming.
“Protect Monarch Flying Snow!” Daoist Hidden Horizon solemnly said.
“Everyone, focus on protecting Monarch Flying Snow!”
“If Monarch Flying Snow dies, all of us will definitely die!”
The cultivators did not dare to be careless at all.
Daoist Hidden Horizon even released his Black-White Domain. One could see many black and white ribbons appearing in the surroundings. They were also constantly protecting Xue Ying. Under the cover of those black-white ribbons, the tall and big male that was originally hiding appeared too!
“Another suppression?” The tall and big male frowned as he glanced at Daoist Hidden Horizon. Daoist Hidden Horizon cultivated bloodline. His strength had also reached the apex level within Scarlet Cloud City. This domain of his was not easily broken. Enemies had to resist against it with their bodies. If the tall and big male had retained his full strength, he would not care about this suppression. But now that he was withstanding against an incredibly huge suppression, this layer of domain caused the strength of the tall and big male to drop once again.
‘My Illusory Realm is flawed.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Facing against this High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform whose soul level is simply too high, my Illusory Realm could not shake him at all.’
Even when one suffered from suppression, the quality of his soul would remained unchanged.
Hence, Xue Ying’s Illusory Realm was just like a cool breeze against the Chaotic Origin Prisoner. It did not influence his strength at all.
‘Instead, it is Brother Hidden Horizon’s domain that is useful.’ Xue Ying murmured.
But he forgot.
His Illusory Realm Domain was contributing the most against the Chaotic Origin Prisoner! Because it was the huge number of protectors every Chaotic Origin Prisoner had that gave the greatest headache to the cultivators. Just like now where there were 1,200 Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters. If all of them could exhibit their full strength, they would be much more threatening and harder to deal with than the Chaotic Origin Prisoner.
Under Xue Ying’s soul technique, all Hidden Devil Hunters had become significantly weaker; they only had the strength of a Late Stage God Emperor! One had to know that this group of cultivators could fight to a draw with 200 Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters. Even though there were 1,200 of them now, all of them were greatly weakened…
Hence, Xue Ying and the cultivators still held an absolute advantage over the Hidden Devil Hunters. Those Hidden Devil Hunters could fight on merely due to their exuberant life force.
…
“Die.” The tall and big male was forced to show himself by the Black-White Domain. He lightly muttered before suddenly exploding forward.
“Hua--”
Leaving behind a blurred black light, the tall and big male moved at a frighteningly fast pace towards Xue Ying.
“Protect Monarch Flying Snow.” A metallic giant immediately charged out against that incoming black light.
That black light flashed. It was truly agile and unpredictable, easily bypassing that metallic giant and continued towards Xue Ying.
“Hong.” Xue Ying’s body abruptly grew to 10 meters tall. His entire body was covered in a dim gray light cover. His aura also became more wild and chaotic. With a spear in his hand, he spun it, causing layers of space to fold around him. That black light did not evade. Instead, it continued on since its target was ultimately Xue Ying! That black light forced through the layers of space before eventually clashing with the spear. And the outcome was that black light forced backwards. It distorted before turning back to that tall and big male.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying remained standing at his original position. He merely felt a strand of sharp energy coursing through the spear into his body, wrecking destruction within it. Fortunately, this force was weakened after transmittance through the spear. And the remnant force was something Xue Ying could still withstand.
“Ai.” The tall and big male sighed, “What a joke. I can’t even kill a little brat.”
Xue Ying’s expression changed inwardly.
He had exhibited the strength of an apex cultivator in Scarlet Cloud City. He even had the help of a domain suppression from another apex cultivator, Daoist Hidden Horizon. Nonetheless, he did not have the slightest advantage at all.
“Mn?” The tall and big male looked at Xue Ying. Suddenly, he grinned, “It seems you haven’t reached the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body level? Your body seems to be unstable. I feel that your life force is weakening constantly.”
“Protect Monarch Flying Snow!” Daoist Hidden Horizon ordered, “Execute according to plan one with the Chaotic Origin Prisoner as the target.”
“Yes.”
“Alright.”
“Let’s charge!”
Daoist Hidden Horizon originally had several cultivators serving him. Even though they felt dissatisfied after being abandoned by Daoist Hidden Horizon, they still listened to his order this time as it was done with the aim to protect Xue Ying.
At that moment, “sou sou sou”…
A total of eight cultivators charged towards the tall and big male. Even though all of them were ordinary Grand Perfection God Emperors, they could still exchange several moves with the Chaotic Origin Prisoner with their combined techniques.
“Monarch Flying Snow, as long as you promise me, our grudges would be resolved at this moment. You don’t have to take revenge against me and I’ll do my utmost in dealing with that Chaotic Origin Prisoner.” Xie Fan transmitted to Xue Ying.
Xue Ying gave Xie Fan a look.
“I am afraid.” Xie Fan gave a weird chuckle, “I once plotted against you. If you were to plot against me, I doubt I can still return to Scarlet Cloud City alive.”
“You are being too vigilant. Even if I want to plot against you, I might not succeed.” Xue Ying transmitted back. What he would do is not to lend Xie Fan a helping hand! This was also an unspoken rule within the team. Just like how Xie Fan did so against Xue Ying, watching by the side and allowing Xue Ying to struggle by himself. But even if he did so, the chance of Xie Fan falling is low.
Because Xie Fan was very powerful.
Xie Fan’s fleshy body was incredibly strong. He was even ranked amongst the top of all cultivators in Scarlet Cloud City. Even if 20 Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms attacked him at the same time, Xie Fan could still withstand against their attacks and escape alive. Hence, Xie Fan would definitely mix himself within the team, maintaining a close distance with other cultivators. As a result, it would be hard for Xue Ying to craft a ‘ghastly situation’ for him.
Just like how Xie Fan had given up on plotting against Xue Ying the moment he discovered Xue Ying could exhibit the strength of an apex expert. This was also the reason why.
“Heh heh, how can I not remain vigilant? If Monarch Flying Snow uses the reason of unable to resist against the Chaotic Origin Prisoner and allow all of us to flee on ourselves, and then you choose to bring all other cultivators in the team while leaving me alone, won’t I die?” Xie Fan transmitted.
Xue Ying was speechless.
“Leaving behind you alone and bringing others away?” Xue Ying replied, “You are simply looking down on me.”
If the team divided into several sections before escaping in different directions, this could still be explained.
Bringing all others to escape while leaving behind Xie Fan? That was deliberately forcing him to death! That was simply too despicable. This was something Xie Fan would do, and thus, he was similarly guarded against Xue Ying.
“I know Monarch Flying Snow would never commit such an act. Haha, as long as Monarch Flying Snow gives your promise, we’ll resolve our grudges! I’ll immediately render my help too… it seems this Chaotic Origin Prisoner has targeted just you alone, Monarch Flying Snow! Even if you wish to escape, he’ll likely follow behind you. I doubt you can maintain that peak state with your body for too long. But if I were to help you, things will no longer be the same. Only I can fight with him head-on.” Xie Fan transmitted.
“Hand over another three Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses and we will let bygones be bygones.” Xue Ying transmitted.
Even though Xie Fan felt his heart aching, he still squeezed a smile out: “Alright! If Monarch Flying Snow were to display your strength earlier, why would I even dare to become your enemy? Haha, from now on, we are brothers!”
Xue Ying felt his cheek twitching.
Brothers?
Xie Fan waved his hand and threw a storage treasure over to Xue Ying: “There are three Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses inside. I’ll pass them to you first.”
At the moment he threw the storage treasure over, Xie Fan suddenly thought back… in the past, he once threatened Xue Ying to trade that Flame Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse with three of his Void Lineage Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses. Who would have thought that this would be the outcome.
‘No matter what, by lowering my head this time and offering gifts to you, I have at least one less huge enemy.’ Xie Fan thought.
He bullied the weak.
But to those that could threaten his life, he would treat them incredibly good. He could readily give and take. After all, he had never cared about his face and reputation before.
In reality, both parties spent just a single instance conversing.
“Chaotic Origin Prisoner, die for me!” Xie Fan suddenly shouted out. With a “sou”, he charged towards that tall and big male.
Xue Ying held on to the storage treasure that Xie Fan threw over. He sighed inwardly. This Xie Fan immediately threw the three Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses the moment they finished talking. Clearly, he wanted to prevent Xue Ying from going back on his word. Xue Ying watched at the battle that happened afar: ‘Whatever. Even on this journey back, plotting against Xie Fan is not easy at all. It is impossible for me to ensure his death. If we were to become enemies, given how careful and vigilant he is, he’ll definitely not give me another opportunity after we have returned to the city. Making him lose three Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses is sufficient to give him a heart ache.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1350 - Returning Home
chapters.content:
Chapter 1350: Returning Home
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Daoist Hidden Horizon’s Black-White Domain suppressed that Chaotic Origin Prisoner from a distance. Of those present, only Daoist Hidden Horizon’s domain was useful. Several techniques other cultivators had were simply futile against the Chaotic Origin Prisoner.
With eight cultivators working together, they fought with the Chaotic Origin Prisoner.
Even though that tall and big male was having a slightly hard time during the beginning, he still easily escaped from the obstruction by the eight cultivators after several techniques! These eight cultivators… were able to ensure self-preservation. But they lacked in capability to obstruct the motion of that Chaotic Origin Prisoner.
“Chaotic Origin Prisoner, die for me!” Xie Fan abruptly let out a wild and violent roar. At the same time, five cultivators along with Xie Fan charged towards that tall and big male.
“Hong~”
Xie Fan’s aura was erupted completely.
The time-space around him started becoming distorted. Under his frightening domain, even that tall and big male was affected by this gravitational field.
“Kill!” The five cultivators that were rushing together with Xie Fan were originally his subordinates! But at this moment, they had merged together as one single entity with Xie Fan’s domain. They were like five stars revolving around Xie Fan, creating force waves that struck against that tall and big male.
“Die for me!” Xie Fan was incomparably tyrannical. He extended his hand valiantly. Even Xue Ying had the feeling that this hand could not be dodged.
Xie Fan was ultimately a Dao Cultivator that had formed a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body. His techniques were naturally profound.
“Ai.”
The tall and big male lightly sighed again.
With the Black-White Domain and this Gravitational Domain influencing him at the same time, he could temporarily not evade from this attack by the short and small old man.
“Peng peng peng…” The tall and big male began fighting with the short and small old man, ‘Xie Fan’. Even though Xie Fan’s close combat techniques were not as profound as Xue Ying’s, and that tall and big male’s techniques were much more profound--occasionally two to three techniques out of ten would strike against Xie Fan’s body. But Xie Fan merely gave a weird chuckle as he withstood against it: “This is a Chaotic Origin Prisoner? A High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform? Just these little techniques are such a disappointment.”
A strand of fury appeared in the crimson eyes of that tall and big male.
But he had no choice.
The manacles and shackles were constantly suppressing his strength, weakening it to a low level. Coupled with the Black-White Domain, the Gravitational Domain and some combined techniques by the cultivators… at this moment, he was having a hard time. The strength he could exhibit now might barely injure Xie Fan, yet Xie Fan’s life force was recovering at a speed faster than he was injured. Hence, he simply disregarded this slight injuries.
…
