‘It seems they are able to fight to a standstill.’ Xue Ying had recovered back to his original appearance. He had no choice. Previously, he relied on the Chaotic Origin Crystal Jades to recover just 10% of his strength--from 20% to 30%. Several breaths later, his life force dropped back to just 20% again.
Other than attacking the Chaotic Origin Prisoner.
The other 30 cultivators were dealing with the surrounding group of Hidden Devil Hunters. Those cultivators were still having an easy time against those Hidden Devil Hunters.
“Ah!”
The golden light on the manacles and shackles of that tall and big male suddenly glowed. That tall and big male let out a subconscious roar of agony. He even stopped fighting temporarily. During this momentary gap, he was fiercely slapped by a palm on the chest by Xie Fan, breaking through his robes and striking into the flesh of that tall and big male. As that male’s robe was broken, others could see countless golden inscriptions revolving on the skin of that tall and big male.
These golden inscriptions were like a mark, causing the skin of that tall and big male to dry up and form many wounds. Within those wounds, the bones were even covered in golden inscriptions, multiplying the force onto it.
The branded skin, intersecting wounds, withering flesh and muscles, many bone fractures…
It seemed as if this tall and big male was about to collapse at any time.
It was because of this terrifying torture suppression that made a powerful High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform fight with several brats that had yet to jump out of the cage for so long. Even those brats that had yet to jump out of the cage… the majority of them had attained a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body. Nonetheless, this was simply a joke to any High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
“It is here again.” The tall and big male howled furiously.
Being tortured and suppressed constantly. Occasionally, there would be a burst of intense pain! Every time it bursts out, it would bring him agonizing pain.
“Pu pu pu.”
The cultivators that were responsible for combining their attacks had broken apart the robe on that tall and big male, bombarding on his body. This worsened the injuries already present on the weakened male! Even if he was ‘incomparably weak’, Xie Fan and the other cultivators’ full-powered attacks merely worsen the injuries already present on the tall and big male by a slight bit.
“Retreat!” The tall and big male let out an abrupt roar.
“Hong.”
He no longer continued battling. Instead, he transformed into a black light and retreated far away. That black light even moved through various unpredictable arcs that evaded the cultivators including Xie Fan.
“Chase! Don’t let him escape!” Xie Fan roared.
Even though they pursued after the male using all they could…
That Chaotic Origin Prisoner ‘tall and big male’ did all he could, suppressing the injuries he had before eventually escaping out of the blockade. The moment he was out, with his frightening speed, that Chaotic Origin Prisoner easily fled from the cultivators. The Chaotic Origin Prisoner ‘tall and big male’ was even too lazy to care about those Hidden Devil Hunters under him. To the Chaotic Origin Prisoner, losing some did not mean much to him!
******
“Obstruct them.”
“Trap them behind and don’t let them escape!”
“This is a group of Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters! Trapping one means an additional harvest for us!”
All the Hidden Devil Hunters had received the orders given by the Chaotic Origin Prisoner, ‘the tall and big male’. They immediately began their retreat. There were 1,200 over of them! Even if Xue Ying and the other cultivators tried to obstruct them, they could not do so. They could only watch as those Hidden Devil Hunters fled away. In the end, they barely trapped 19 Hidden Devil Hunters.
No other choice. It was easy to defeat the hunters! But trapping them was hard.
“Haha…”
“We have 19 of them!”
the cultivators were in great joy.
“Fellow cultivators, hurry up and kill them!” Xue Ying urged. He casted his Illusory Realm, standing by the side without showing any intention to participate. After all, casting his Illusory Realm was already the biggest contribution he had to the team.
The other cultivators immediately began landing strikes on the group of Hidden Devil Hunters. Under the situation where those hunters could not escape coupled with the combined attacks by Daoist Hidden Horizon, Xie Fan, one Hidden Devil Hunter by one died after another! These 19 Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters soon turned into the spoils of war for the cultivators.
“Hahaha, 19 Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. It seems our spoils of war for this battle is so great! We did not even dare to think about it previously! It seems only the hunting teams formed by the City Masters could achieve this right?”
“What level are those teams formed by the City Masters? They have quite a few apex experts, and their overall strength is way stronger! Our team was able to achieve this all because of Monarch Flying Snow!”
“Right, there is Monarch Flying Snow! Those Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms could only exhibit the strength of a Late Stage God Emperor as a result.”
The cultivators were excited and exhilarated.
Because these items would be divided by everyone! Even though the Scarlet Cloud Hall Spirit would distribute according to their contribution and Monarch Flying Snow would definitely be getting the majority! Because the total harvest was huge, everyone would be getting an amount ten times more than they would usually get if they joined some ordinary hunting team.
“Fellow cultivators, let us hurry back and not stay here for too long.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“Go, let us return!”
“Let’s hurry back!”
The team was currently in good mood as they went back home.
The journey back to Scarlet Cloud City was much more leisure. After all, they could even fight back and win against 1,200 Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms led by a Chaotic Origin Prisoner! As long as they maintained caution on the way back, they would naturally have an easy time. They even hoped to encounter some small ambushes on the way back because they could easily kill eight to ten Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms every time they were attacked.
‘There are simply too many of them! Such a technique that could allow us to kill Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms is something this Monarch Flying Snow has, and it is definitely ranked first in the entire Scarlet Cloud City.’ Xie Fan could not help but feel startled from the result.
There were more than ten cultivators in the team that had overwhelming abilities to fight in a one-on-one battle with the Chaotic Origin Prisoner!
But in terms of group attack, especially against Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, Xue Ying’s illusory realm was the most heaven-defying.
“Haha, we are back!”
“We are finally back in Scarlet Cloud City!”
“I am even hoping not to return and to kill more Chaotic Origin Lifeforms so that I can accumulate more food.”
These cultivators were both delighted and unwilling when they saw the distant Scarlet Cloud City.
Because their harvest this time was simply too big!
They even turned to Xue Ying with a passionate gaze. How they desired to join the team formed by Xue Ying!

chapters.title: Chapter 1351 - The Three City Masters
chapters.content:
Chapter 1351: The Three City Masters
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
“They are here.” The two experts responsible for guarding the place on the city wall were jolted awake as they saw a team of cultivators appear from the void.
“It is the team containing Daoist Hidden Horizon and Monarch Flying Snow.”
The two experts felt their hearts racing.
Currently, the entire Scarlet Cloud City was restless. The strongest--the three City Masters, and even the weaker ones--those cultivators with a combat strength of Late Stage God Emperors had been mentioning a name for the past half a day--’Monarch Flying Snow’.
Monarch Flying Snow’s technique was something that had never been heard before in the history of the entire ‘Sacred World’! With just himself, he was able to significantly weaken 1,200 Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, forcing them down into the level of a ‘Late Stage God Emperor’! This technique was simply unfathomable.
Before Monarch Flying Snow, the strongest advantage the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms had--’their great numbers’--had been wiped!
“Monarch Flying Snow, let us head to the Scarlet Cloud Hall.”
“Right now, I believe many cultivators are seeking to meet Monarch. It is better for us to head to the Scarlet Cloud Hall first and distribute those Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses!”
The team continued advancing at high speed towards the walls of the Scarlet Cloud City.
The cultivators were escorting Xue Ying, the unspoken leader of the team! Even Daoist Hidden Horizon and Xie Fan were lamenting in their hearts… They felt that acquiring ‘food’ was way easier when they hunted with Xue Ying.
“Wait one moment.”
Xue Ying swept his gaze across. Seeing the two experts that were responsible for guarding the post, he immediately shouted. He then went forward and landed on that wall.
As he descended, the group of cultivators followed suit.
“Monarch Flying Snow.” The two sentries came forward and greeted him. They appeared much more polite and humble.
“Brother Jun Qian, Brother Fu Shan, why are you treating me like a stranger? You can simply call me Brother Flying Snow.” Xue Ying chuckled, “In the past when I first came to Scarlet Cloud City, I had been surrounded by a large group of Shadow Reapers. It is because of the two of you that alerted God Eagle Snake and his team to save me.”
These two experts were none other than Jun Qian and Fu Shan.
Jun Qian and Fu Shan had completely changed their attitude towards Xue Ying. Seeing that Xue Ying was being polite, they immediately grinned. Both of them became much more prideful after that because they were clear that Xue Ying’s current status would likely not be any weaker than the three City Masters!
“With the strength of Brother Flying Snow, I believe you can easily survive against that group of Shadow Reapers yourself.” Fu Shan chuckled.
Jun Qian added with a grin: “We have also heard the news. Brother Flying Snow has weakened over 1,200 Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms with your technique. When we first heard of it, we were simply stunned.”
Xue Ying laughed.
Every cultivator in the team owned a communication treasure. Ultimately, Xue Ying’s executed technique was simply too terrifying! Hence, it was normal that the cultivators in the team would tell everyone else. And soon, it spread across throughout the Scarlet Cloud City.
“I’ll make a move first. We still have to pay the Scarlet Cloud Hall a visit.” Xue Ying said, “When the two of you are done with your sentry duty, both of you should visit me at my cavern-dwelling.”
“Definitely, definitely.”
Both Jun Qian and Fu Shan agreed.
The reason why they chose to take on the role as ‘sentries’, a mundane and boring job in exchange for food is because hunting for food outside the city is too dangerous to them! If they could get closer to Xue Ying, the two of them would have an easier time should they join Xue Ying’s team on a hunt. Now, everyone knew how frightening the harvest would be in the team that ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ joined! Even if they were distributed just a slight bit of the total harvest, they would still earn a startling amount.
“Go.” Xue Ying immediately flew through the sky.
The other cultivators followed behind. They flew directly towards the Scarlet Cloud Hall. All of them even revealed looks of expectation.
It was the ‘allocation of food at the Scarlet Cloud Hall’ that they most looked forward to during each hunt! And this time, they were exceptionally looking forward to the distribution since they had hunted down a total of 28 Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
…
Following as Xue Ying’s team returned, the cultivators in the entire Scarlet Cloud City began receiving the news.
Within the cavern-dwelling of Vice-City Master ‘Wu Xiao’, in his underground palace.
“Breathe in…”
“Breathe out…”
A humanoid lifeform that was 3,000 meters tall lay down within the palace apparently deep in sleep. It was entirely silver-white in color and was currently emitting a faint white light. Every single pore on its skin was a deep void passage with countless machineries hovering around them. There were also many machines flying into his body constantly.
A single hair of his, magnified by a trillion times, comprised of a huge cosmos in reality. The cosmos was even filled with many battleships and mechas battling within the cosmos.
“Mn?”
Suddenly, he stopped breathing. Those mechas that were originally hovering around his body returned back into it.
He sat up before stroking his head.
“He is back?” Wu Xiao lightly muttered.
In the entire Scarlet Cloud City, even the entire Sacred World, Wu Xiao had the biggest background.
His old ancestor… was one of the few strongest and most terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that had jumped out of the cage, an Overlord! And he, Wu Xiao, was also the strongest descendent left behind by his ancestor, and also the one closest to ‘jumping out of the cage to become a Chaotic Origin’!
It was similarly hard to become a Chaotic Origin even for a descendent with the bloodline of an Overlord.
With a terrifying bloodline and discipline to train, Wu Xiao was naturally powerful! If one said that Xie Fan had the ‘heaviest’ body within Scarlet Cloud City, then Wu Xiao had the strongest body and strength in the entire Scarlet Cloud City! He was even good at scouting techniques. Just by relying on his terrifying bloodline, he was able to fight with the other two City Masters, ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’ and ‘Weather Leaf’.
“Smaller, smaller, smaller.” Wu Xiao lightly muttered.
His body began shrinking rapidly. It seemed like every part of his body was being forced down. Various ripples were even generated on the surface of his skin. Wu Xiao’s body was just like a huge and terrifying celestial body! To him, shrinking his body would incite many changes within it.
‘Ai, other cultivators in this Scarlet Cloud City could easily maintain an ordinary height, yet I have to suppress mine.’ Wu Xiao felt helpless. His bloodline was unique. Cultivating to his current realm, his body had also become this huge. His old ancestor had an incredibly huge body too. It was just slightly smaller than an ‘Origin World’. Even though he could not compare to his old ancestor, he still had a huge figure.
In this Sacred World, his height was suppressed to 3,000 meters. It was his ordinary height. If he suppressed it further, it would result in various changes within his body.
But he had no choice.
The cavern-dwellings within Scarlet Cloud City were standardized. Many halls were only a thousand meters tall. If he did not shrink his body further, he would not be able to enter any of those halls! Furthermore, he could not really converse with other cultivators while he was 3,000 meters tall right?
‘I’ve never heard of a cultivator like that Monarch Flying Snow who has such terrifying technique. I must go experience it personally.’ Wu Xiao immediately left his underground palace.
…
And at another location filled with fragrance, there was a handsome bald young man seated on a grassfield. This bald young man had a warm and gentle smile. His eyes seemed filled with great benevolence.
He was none other than the ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’.
Of the three strongest experts in Scarlet Cloud City, Wu Xiao had the greatest background! And Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was a cultivator that unquestionably grew up step by step from a weak little mortal world. He experienced countless difficulties and setbacks. He had reached an unfathomable level on this Dao of ‘Witchcraft’. One had to know that many other cultivation paths were usually weaker than ‘Dao Cultivators’!
Dao Cultivators grasped the essence of laws. They had to comprehend the way to attain a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body. Hence, it was nothing unusual for Dao Cultivators to fight against higher-levelled cultivators of other paths.
Wu Xiao was an exceptional case.
And ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s witchcraft actually gave him sufficient strength to defeat ordinary ‘Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform’ Dao Cultivators! Dao Cultivators that could defeat other cultivators of an entire level higher, could not actually triumph over Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor.
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s strength… was comparable to Weather Leaf’s. Weather Leaf was a terrifying Dao Cultivator that had cultivated two Dao paths to the Half-Chaotic Origin Level! Nonetheless, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor could still compete with Weather Leaf to a standstill. One could see how outstanding , Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was for him to climb to his level step by step starting as a mortal.
His outstanding talent had even attracted the attention of several Chaotic Origin Experts!
‘During my previous journey to the ‘Chaotic Origin Chaos Corridor’, I was at least unparalleled in the corridor I went. In the end, I came to this legendary World of Survival! Wu Xiao could be said to have the help of a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. But Weather Leaf has climbed up step by step from mortality just like me. He isn’t any weaker than me as well.’ That warm eyes of Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor were filled with expectations, ‘And now, this Monarch Flying Snow has appeared. He at least far transcends my ability to deal with a large group of Chaotic Origin Experts. What exactly is that technique of his? Is it some sort of domain? Or a soul technique?’
At this moment, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was filled with curiosity towards Xue Ying.
He stood up and left his underground palace too.
…
‘Hearsay he is a Dao Cultivator too?’ In the entire Sacred World, the only cultivator who had grasped two Daos at the Half-Chaotic Origin Level, ‘Weather Leaf’, simply sent a message using his communication treasure to Xue Ying.

chapters.title: Chapter 1352 - Great Banquet
chapters.content:
Chapter 1352: Great Banquet
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Within the Scarlet Cloud Hall.
A total of 47 cultivators including Xue Ying were gathered here. Within the palace hall, many scenes were projected in midair. Those were scenes on all the battles that happened in their hunt this time! Clearly, the ‘Scarlet Cloud Hall Spirit’ could easily see through what happened within the entire Sacred World.
The Scarlet Cloud Hall Spirit would also decide on the final distribution according to each cultivator’s contribution.
“Monarch Flying Snow will be awarded 50% of the total spoils of war.”
“Daoist Hidden Horizon will be awarded 5% of the total spoils of war.”
“Devil God Xie Fan will be awarded 4% of the total spoils of war.”
The device spirit continued reverberating within the Scarlet Cloud Hall.
Everyone accepted wholeheartedly that Xue Ying was given half of the total spoils of war! In reality, this was considered quite low. It should be normal for Xue Ying to be distributed 80% to 90% of the total spoils of war. The reason why the Scarlet Cloud Hall allocated 50% to Xue Ying is because according to the distribution rules set by the Scarlet Cloud Hall, even if one contributed more, they would only be given half at most!
This rule would be enforced when employing the ‘Scarlet Cloud Hall Spirit’s help for distribution.
If one felt that it was unfair?
Then the cultivators would have to prepare a better allocation strategy between them! It was fine as long as everyone agreed to it.
For instance, if Xue Ying chose to set up a new hunting team the next time, he could establish in public that 80% of the total spoils of war is given to him! The remaining 20% would be distributed among other cultivators. As long as everyone agreed, they would naturally implement it. Actually… if Xue Ying chose to set up a hunting team, even if he fixed his own allocation to 90%! A large group of cultivators would still rush to join him!
“Brother Flying Snow, you are truly admirable. Brother Flying Snow did not show your strength on the journey there this time. Instead, Brother Flying Snow only chose to show your technique when we encounter a grave danger on the way back. Even still, Brother Flying Snow could easily be allocated with ’53 Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses’.” Daoist Hidden Horizon said from the side with respect.
Primarily, the harvest this time consisted of the 82 Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses. But there were differing levels between those Chaotic Origin Lifeforms too. For instance, the ‘Mount Primal Chaos Serpent’ was equivalent to three Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters. Or the ‘White Stone God’ for instance, one of it was equivalent to two Hidden Devil Hunters at the same level.
And it was due to this difference in value that the 82 Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms in addition to some Late Stage and Middle Stage God Emperors as well as the belongings left behind by the four deceased cultivators totaled up to an equivalent of 106 ordinary Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms!
And Xue Ying would be distributed half of it!
“As we have agreed, this is what I owed you.” Daoist Hidden Horizon threw over a storage treasure.
Xue Ying received it. Examining the storage treasure, he saw a Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunter within.
“For the sake of acquiring the Mount Primal Chaos Serpent during this hunt, I have originally planned on getting some of my accumulated food to make up for the distribution to other cultivators.” Daoist Hidden Horizon sighed, “Yet in the end, not only do I not have to make up for it. I still accumulated more food instead.” He was allocated 5% of the total harvest. That was equivalent to slightly more than five Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Subtracting the Mount Primal Chaos Serpent, he still earned some.
‘So much!’
Xue Ying checked through his harvest.
He was allocated a total of 53 lifeforms. Daoist Hidden Horizon gave him one, and in addition to the five that Xie Fan would be giving him, Xue Ying had earned a total of 57 Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
Such a harvest…
Other than Xue Ying, no other cultivators could earn so much this easily.
‘Even if the three City Masters are strong, there is a limit to how much stronger they are as compared to other apex cultivators.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Hence, their ability to secure food is only several times better than Daoist Hidden Horizon and the rest.’
Even though they were slightly stronger than the others, the three City Masters could secure more food precisely because they were incredibly powerful in certain aspects.
‘Let’s not talk about direct combat strength. Currently, I should be ranked first in terms of securing food in Scarlet Cloud City right? I might even be first in the entire Sacred World.’ Xue Ying thought.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying suddenly saw a message, ‘It’s them?’
During the recent half a day, there were too many cultivators who had messaged him! The cultivators in his team and the other cultivators within Scarlet Cloud City…
But currently, the three cultivators that messaged him were existences Xue Ying had to treat solemnly.
‘The three City Masters are inviting me over at the same time?’ Xue Ying nodded slightly.
It would be held at Weather Leaf’s cavern-dwelling!
Weather Leaf, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor, and Wu Xiao had arranged for a banquet inviting all cultivators in Scarlet Cloud City. Of course, the primary guest would still be ‘Xue Ying’. Xue Ying would also become the VIP of this banquet!
“Monarch Flying Snow is indeed amazing. The moment you returned, the three City Masters have arranged a banquet for you.”
“We could even benefit from the association.”
“The previous time such a huge event was held had been done so by Weather Leaf and Wu Xiao for Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor.”
The cultivators in the Scarlet Cloud Hall began commenting about it.
“Since the three City Masters have invited us.” Daoist Hidden Horizon added, “Let us hurry over then.”
“Mn, let’s go.” Xue Ying nodded.
Xie Fan followed behind: “Let’s go together!”
…
Very soon, Xue Ying and the group of cultivators arrived before the cavern-dwelling of City Master ‘Weather Leaf’. There were already many cultivators who had arrived by the entrance of the cavern-dwelling. They were not in a rush to enter. Instead, they were currently chatting with each other.
“Monarch Flying Snow.”
“Greetings Monarch Flying Snow.”
At that moment, many cultivators began greeting enthusiastically. Their gazes towards Xue Ying were passionate too. After all, to an absolute majority of cultivators, ‘surviving’ in this Sacred World was too tough! For instance, a Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform would provide sufficient food for 30 billion years. To live for a trillion years, one had to secure food from 30 over Grand Perfection God Emperor lifeforms!
Killing a Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform was hard. Most of them would usually hunt down Middle Stage or Late Stage Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. And they would have to go out and hunt for them, relying on more hunts to secure enough food! But when their frequency of hunting increased, they would face more danger.
Of course, if they were to go on a hunt with Xue Ying, it would be safer and easier. Perhaps they might secure food sufficient for several dozens of billions of years.
‘How long has it been since he arrived and he is already famous. This banquet is even organized by the three City Masters for him.’ Standing far away, Great Emperor North River watched as Xue Ying was escorted by a group of cultivators into the cavern-dwelling. Great Emperor North River currently felt complex, ‘As for me, I have to risk my life for food.’
After arriving at the Sacred World for so many years, Great Emperor North River had already gone on several hunts.
Most of the time, he could only secure food enough to last him for more than a million years! If he was lucky, he could gain enough for more than ten million years. Of course, the team that Great Emperor North River joined would almost practically hunt in the neighboring regions around the city. If he were to participate in those hunts that headed far away, it would be much more dangerous. Nonetheless, he could secure more food and it was normal for the food to last more than 100 million years to a billion year.
However, the degree of danger was simply too high the further they went!
For cultivators on the level of Daoist Hidden Horizon, if they were unfortunate, they might encounter a ‘Prisoner going out on a patrol’ It was fortunate that there was Xue Ying. Hence, only four fell. Otherwise, the entire team set up by Daoist Hidden Horizon would be completely wiped!
“Hu.” Great Emperor North River soon entered the cavern-dwelling of Weather Leaf without raising much attention.
…
Xue Ying came to an elegant garden while crowded with cultivators. The garden had many tables and seats arranged, with many more female puppets serving the guests.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying easily spotted the three cultivators standing not too far away chatting with one another. The aura from those three were the most dazzling and unique. Other cultivators present had also joined their social circles.
‘The three City Masters?’ Xue Ying swept his gaze across. He first noticed the City Master ‘Weather Leaf’.
It was genuinely tough to reach the Half-Chaotic Origin Level on any Dao paths that involved grasping the laws and profound mysteries. This was much stronger than ‘Old Monster Stone’ and ‘Sacred Master’ back in his hometown world.
Yet Weather Leaf was someone who reached the Half-Chaotic Origin Level in two Daos. That was simply unrivalled even in this Sacred World.
‘I wonder how many Origin Worlds and how many unique worlds must there be for the chance of such outstanding cultivator like Weather Leaf to emerge.’ Xue Ying felt admiration for the other party.

chapters.title: Chapter 1353 - Sparring
chapters.content:
Chapter 1353: Sparring
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
“Brother Flying Snow.” The handsome bald young man ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’ shouted. By his side, Weather Leaf and Wu Xiao both turned towards Xue Ying too.
Xue Ying immediately walked over. At the same time, he thoroughly examined all three of them.
This was his first time meeting the three City Masters.
‘Wu Xiao.’
The moment Xue Ying looked over, Wu Xiao had immediately attracted his gaze!
Wu Xiao gave Xue Ying a strange feeling. It felt like he was looking at a world! And Wu Xiao was more like an enormous celestial body. He did not seem like an ordinary life form.
‘He cultivates his bloodline. But according to legend, he is the descendant of an extremely powerful Chaotic Origin Expert; his bloodline is thus extraordinary.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Looking at him gives me the feeling as if I am looking at a celestial body! Others have mentioned that he has the strongest body in the entire Scarlet Cloud City and also the one with the greatest strength. I wonder what level has he reached?’
But closely following that, Xue Ying sensed the charisma from both Weather Leaf and Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor.
Weather Leaf simply stood there. He was like an existence that had transcended beyond this world. There seemed to be Chaotic Origin forming around his body, giving off the feeling like new worlds were being born constantly.
And Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was the opposite. He seemed to be encompassing everything as he stood there. His smile was warm and gentle, yet everything around him was under his control.
‘Wu Xiao’s strength originates from his body. This degree of strength is also greatly attributed to his bloodline.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘As for Weather Leaf and Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor… both of them have reached a very profound level in their realms. Most ordinary cultivators who have attained a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body could hardly be compared to the two of them.’
…
Xue Ying walked over. He paid attention to the three of them.
At the same moment, the three City Masters were also paying attention to Xue Ying, scrutinizing him. They could feel how unique the aura belonging to ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ is. It was also making them feel favorable to him.
‘Just his aura alone could influence us?’ Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor and the other two City Masters were both startled inwardly.
“Flying Snow greets the three City Masters.” Xue Ying greeted them.
“Today when I first heard of Monarch Flying Snow’s capability, I was greatly shocked and filled with disbelief. But now that we met, I am no longer puzzled.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor smiled, “Monarch Flying Snow’s attainments on the Dao of Soul have far transcended all of us. No wonder all 1,200 Grand Perfection God Emperor Hidden Devil Hunters would be significantly weakened by this.”
“Admirable.” The City Master Weather Leaf was a man of few words. It was rare that he had spoken a word.
“Is the Dao of Soul this powerful?” Wu Xiao could not help but ask, “Monarch Flying Snow, can you let us experience it?”
“Brother Wu Xiao, the other cultivators have all arrived. Let us wait until the banquet ends. By then, it won’t be that late for you to experience it.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said.
Wu Xiao gave a sheepish laughter before nodding: “No rush.”
******
The banquet soon began.
Xue Ying and the three City Masters sat close to each other. The four of them discussed Daos. Even though they went in different paths of cultivation, they could still gain something by listening to the experiences of how others grew.
“Ah, Brother Flying Snow is also someone who grew step by step from being a mortal until your current realm?” Wu Xiao was shocked, “You, Brother Nine-Headed, and Brother Weather are all the same! All of you have grown up from being a weak little mortal. As for me, when I am given birth, I already have an approximate strength of a Primal Chaos Realm Expert as mentioned by you, Brother Flying Snow. Several other clan members in my clan are also comparable to me at birth, though they were partially weaker than me in certain aspects. Nonetheless, most of them are unable to control their strength perfectly. Could it be growing up as a mortal gives you a huge advantage over others? Talking about this, my old ancestor has also reached his realm starting as a mortal!”
Xue Ying sighed when he heard that.
The Natives of Broken Teeth Mountain Range were usually Initial Stage Void Gods when they were given birth!
As for the clan members of Wu Xiao, they were more terrifying--they had the strength of a Primal Chaos Expert at birth! To these newly-birthed babies that had jumped out of the River of Time at birth, they could not feel envious at all. Because the gap between them was simply exaggerated. Like Xue Ying, in the cosmos that he was born in, ordinary experts within it could not even reach the Primal Chaos Realm. It was only ‘Swordmaster’ who had been the most heaven-defying in his hometown cosmos, reaching the Primal Chaos Realm before leaving it and proceeding towards the ‘Great Void Heaven Temple’.
But members of Wu Xiao’s clan were at this level when they were born!
“Compared to you, Brother Flying Snow, the environment I was born in is much more nasty.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor chuckled, “Witchcraft is the strongest cultivation system in my hometown. Witches, for the sake of acquiring powerful bloodlines, could easily massacre a nation. When witches and witches fight, it is brutal. For the sake of growth, it is normal for one to bring about the extinction of a civilization. It is even normal for a witch to direct a new civilization in the dark while treating the entire civilization as an experiment…”
Xue Ying gradually understood as he listened.
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s ‘Witchcraft’ was quite similar to the ‘Hex’ or ‘Voodoo’ system that Ancestor Sorcerer from his hometown cultivated. Comparatively speaking, the ‘Witchcraft’ cultivated by Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was more cruel! More selfish! And more powerful!
…
When the banquet was about to end.
“Brother Flying Snow, do you mind sparring with me?” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor
“Sparring?” Xue Ying was startled.
Currently, all the cultivators in the Scarlet Cloud City were gathered here in this garden. Even some of the sentries had dispatched their incarnations over.
Having an open spar?
“Relax. Even though it is forbidden to kill within the Scarlet Cloud City, it is normal for us to spar with one another.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor chuckled, “As for me, I wish I can experience the soul technique of Brother Flying Snow.”
“I haven’t even requested for it and you snatched my turn already, Nine-Headed.” Wu Xiao downed a cup of wine; he felt helpless.
Xue Ying turned to Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor with a smile. He nodded: “Alright, since Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor wishes to spar with me, I’ll naturally agree.”
Both of them took a step before appearing above the lake at the center of the garden.
Both parties stood on the lake facing each other.
“Are they about to fight?”
“Is this a spar?”
When the cultivators of Scarlet Cloud City in the city saw this, many of them began cheering and revealing looks of excitement. Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was after all, one of the three experts standing at the peak. Xue Ying’s technique was also mysterious.
“You can have the first move.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said, “Let me experience your soul technique.”
“Be careful.”
Xue Ying stated. He then began casting his strongest Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique.
“Hong!”
An enormous Illusory Realm descended. It began pulling on the soul of Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor. At this moment, Xue Ying felt like he had met the ‘strongest soul’ ever! The difficulty of pulling that soul was incredibly difficult. This supposed strongest soul… was referring to the strongest opponent Xue Ying had beneath Chaotic Origin Experts. If he added himself, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s soul could definitely not be compared to his.
‘It seems the influence on him isn’t too huge.’ Xue Ying estimated.
“Mn?”
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor frowned slightly, ‘What a terrifying illusory realm.’
He thought his soul would not be influenced or moved by everything having grown up as a mortal. But at this moment, he was intensely affected.
“Receive my move!” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor then spoke.
“Hua--”
Behind the handsome bald young man ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’, an overflowing projection appeared. It was the illusion of nine huge snakes. Every snake was also emitting an entirely different energy. One could see eight of those snakes slithering through the sky, forming eight types of energy that included water, fire, lightning, life, destruction…
Eight different kinds of energy.
That formed a faint colorful light cover that enveloped the lake. At the same time, it also engulfed Xue Ying within. Xue Ying felt an incredibly heavy suppression pressing down on him.
“Monarch Flying Snow is indeed amazing. I can no longer exhibit my Nine-Realm Domain.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor commented with a shake of his head. At the same time, the faint colorful light realm began folding, turning into an enclosing prison that was rapidly shrinking. And Xue Ying was stuck at the center of this prison.
‘Not good!’ Xue Ying felt danger. He did not hesitate to release his full power, causing his body to grow to a height of 10 meters. The surface of his body was also covered in a faint gray light. With a spear in his hand, he immediately whirled. At the same time, layers of space began forming around him, stacking up on one another to push back against that rapidly enclosing eight-colored prison.

chapters.title: Chapter 1354 - Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1354: Invitation
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
“Peng!”
The eight-colored prison that was rapidly shrinking abruptly exploded. At the same time when it exploded, the different types of energy began converging--for instance, both water and fire energy would combine to form a Water-Fire Giant! Or lightning and fire energy converging into a Lightning-Fire Giant! There was also lightning and destruction energy merging into a Destructive-Lightning Giant…
Many giants started appearing. A total of nine giants were formed in the end.
These nine giants all had the strength of an ordinary Grand Perfection God Emperor. They then coordinated perfectly together against Xue Ying.
‘Amazing.’ Xue Ying kept his fleshy body at its peak state. Even as he tried his best to deal with those giants using his spear, he still remained on the disadvantaged end. After all, the combat techniques of these giants were more profound than even his spear techniques.
‘This soul illusory realm has greatly affected me, preventing me from turning them into a Nine-Headed Combat Body.’ Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor shook his head lightly. This enormous illusory realm had forced him to use just 20% of his heart force in resisting against it. But it was precisely this 20% heart force that prevented him from perfectly executing his technique. He was different from Wu Xiao. Wu Xiao relied on his powerful body to battle.
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s control of his personal strength was incredibly complex. Hence, it required an immense amount of heart force.
Controlling nine different types of Grand Perfection God Emperor Bloodline energy while ensuring they were perfectly coordinated? How big would the burden be on one’s heart force?
‘Transform.’ Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor thought.
“Hou~”
Out of the nine giants, one of them dissipated. The other eight giants immediately fused together into one entity with eight snakeheads! This giant gave off a wild terrifying power as it charged at Xue Ying.
Xue Ying was forced into a flurry by the consecutive techniques executed by ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’. He immediately whirled out his spear in response to this charging eight-headed giant.
‘Fortunately, his heart force had been influenced, preventing him from perfectly executing his ‘Nine-Colored Domain’ and ‘Nine-Headed Combat Body.’ Xue Ying thought. He had long received intelligence on Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor. Nonetheless, even if the strength of Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor is weakened greatly, Xue Ying still had a hard time dealing against the other party.
“Hu.”
That terrifying vicious eight-headed giant suddenly disappeared.
In the distant, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor chuckled out: “Brother Flying Snow, the consumption rate of this fleshy body of yours is simply too big. I think it is best that you spend more time cultivating so as to grasp a stable Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body.”
“I am still lacking a lot.” Xue Ying sighed. Just battling for a short period caused him to consume 40% of his life force.
Furthermore, even though he could temporarily boost his fleshy body to the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body Level, he had yet to reach this official realm. Hence, his technique execution was flawed. Compared to a genuine ‘Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body’ Dao Cultivator, Xue Ying was likely only 70% to 80% of the other party’s strength. Xie Fan for instance was qualified to be ranked top ten within Scarlet Cloud City. As for Xue Ying, not counting his soul technique, he could barely enter the bottom ranks of apex experts in the city.
Of course, if his soul technique was considered and taking his powered mode into account, Xue Ying would definitely be able to rank in the forefront.
After all, only the City Masters could still suppress him when he boosted his fleshy body to the peak.
‘My body is still too weak. I can’t maintain my peak state for long.’ Xue Ying thought.
“Amazing.”
“Monarch Flying Snow is this strong even though he has yet to achieve the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body? Doesn’t this mean that once he grasped the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body, he’ll immediately join the ranks of the City Masters?”
The other cultivators were slightly startled. They could see that Xue Ying’s Dao of Void was only surpassed by a dozen or so within Scarlet Cloud City! As for his soul technique, he could even weaken Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor, lowering it to a level comparable to his strength.
…
Xue Ying and Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor flew back to their original positions.
“This soul technique is indeed extraordinary.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor praised.
“Brother Flying Snow, I’ll not let you fight with me. Your body is simply too weak. You just have to cast your soul technique against me. Bring it on.” Wu Xiao urged.
“Let me experience it too.” Weather Leaf said.
“Alright.”
Xue Ying did not hesitate.
An enormous illusory realm descended once again. This time, it pulled the soul of Weather Leaf and Wu Xiao.
This pull made Xue Ying feel that ‘Weather Leaf’s soul was comparable to Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s. It was only slightly stronger. But it was limited to how much stronger it could be. It was only due to Xue Ying’s acute senses that gave him the ability to discover this slight gap of soul strength between both parties. As for ‘Wu Xiao’, even though Wu Xiao’s body was incredibly strong, his soul was barely approximately 60% that of Weather Leaf’s and Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s!
Under his Illusory Realm, Wu Xiao had to part away with a huge amount of heart force to resist against it. But as his fleshy body was too strong, he did not need much heart force in controlling it.
“It has greatly affected me, preventing me from executing my strongest technique.” Weather Leaf nodded.
“I might even be weaker than you, Nine-Headed.” Wu Xiao sensed before saying it, “This soul technique is simply too unbearable.”
Xue Ying immediately kept his technique.
“It is little wonder that you can significantly weaken so many Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. I can only exhibit 60% to 70% of my strength.” Wu Xiao said, “The more heaven-defying thing is that this soul technique of yours targets all enemies. It’s the same even when there are 1,200 Hidden Devil Hunters. The result would still be the same even if there are 3,000 or 10,000 of them.”
“Mn, as long as they enter my Illusory Realm, they would all be affected.” Xue Ying nodded.
The moment his Illusory Realm descend, all enemies within the region would feel their souls being pulled by the illusory realm. Unless Xue Ying deliberately avoided those enemies.
“Amazing.” Weather Leaf added another rare word. He then took up his cup and began drinking, apparently deep in thoughts.
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was similarly seemingly contemplating over some stuff. His eyes were flashing with different colors.
…
The banquet finally ended.
The three City Masters hosted this banquet primarily to discuss Dao with Xue Ying. They even planned to have a spar with Xue Ying during this event. Throughout the banquet, they did not really care about other cultivators.
When the banquet was concluded and as the cultivators began leaving…
“Brother Flying Snow.” Weather Leaf and Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said almost practically at the same moment.
“Mn?” Xue Ying was stunned. He turned to the two of them.
Weather Leaf exchanged glances with Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor before they laughed.
“You first.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said, “After you are done, I’ll speak with Brother Flying Snow.”
“Alright.” Weather Leaf nodded, “Brother Flying Snow, come with me. Let us speak in private.”
Xue Ying looked at the two City Masters: ‘I wonder what does the two City Masters want from me?’
“I’ll wait here for you and tell you the details later.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor sat there casually.
Xue Ying nodded.
He stood and left with Weather Leaf, entering into a side hall within this cavern-dwelling.
Both parties sat down respectively.
Weather Leaf pondered for a while before starting: “I have always been desiring to kill that Chaotic Origin Prisoner within ‘Wind Devil Valley’. However, that Chaotic Origin Prisoner is incredibly vigilant. Ever since he suffered from an ambush from me, currently, whenever he leaves his territory, he would bring with him a total of 3,000 protectors. All of them are Grand Perfection God Emperors. Even though I can request the help of some experts within Scarlet Cloud City, those 3,000 protectors… render me helpless! Now that Monarch Flying Snow has appeared, it also brought me hope. Brother Flying Snow, I wish for you to help me. Come with me and my team as we proceed to kill that Chaotic Origin Prisoner in Wind Devil Valley. You may raise any conditions you want!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1355 - A Promise
chapters.content:
Chapter 1355: A Promise
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying pondered for a while before replying: “Killing a Chaotic Origin Prisoner is very difficult. It is also very dangerous! A Chaotic Origin Prisoner will suffer from torture and suppression constantly. It is expected that the Chaotic Origin Prisoner would control himself to prevent his weakened body from getting heavily injured. But the moment he realizes he is in danger of dying, he’ll definitely go mad, putting in everything on the line for the battle! According to my knowledge, there are some in the history of Scarlet Cloud City who attempted to kill a Chaotic Origin Prisoner. More often than not, those cultivators would end up in failure and die a tragic death.”
Previously when he encountered the group of Hidden Devil Hunters, he had fought with the Chaotic Origin Prisoner leading the Hidden Devil Hunters.
Xue Ying saw the broken body of the other party. He saw huge injuries and withering muscles. He even saw many fractures on the bones. It was apparent that once the wave of punishment came down on the Chaotic Origin Prisoner, his bodily injuries would worsen to a grave degree. Most Chaotic Origin Prisoners would not be willing to let themselves be injured during battles.
“Yes, it is dangerous. But with the help of Monarch Flying Snow, our chances would be significantly higher.” Weather Leaf said.
“City Master, what can you give me in return?” Xue Ying continued.
Weather Leaf hesitated momentarily.
What could he give?
Food? In terms of food, nobody in the Sacred World would dare to say they could acquire food more easily than Monarch Flying Snow! His soul technique gave him the capability to venture through the Sacred World alone, easily killing all Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
“You have acquired six Dao Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses earlier right?” Weather Leaf said, “I’ll help you get 15 more Dao Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses while assuring you that all of them are Grand Perfection God Emperors. You should know that most of them are located far away from our Scarlet Cloud City. Some of them are even close to the other assembly grounds.”
“I can easily exchange them using food.” Xue Ying shook his head.
“But some of them live close to the other four cities. It is very hard for you to exchange them.” Weather Leaf said.
“I can always fork out more food.” Xue Ying retorted.
Weather Leaf felt helpless.
Meeting this rich and imposing Monarch Flying Snow, he as a City Master felt helpless.
“I cultivate in the Dao of Void and Dao of Mirage.” Xue Ying said, “If City Master could find something that is of great help to me on these two Daos, I would perhaps help you out.”
“Alright.” Weather Leaf nodded slightly. Some precious treasures flitted through his mind. He had contact with the other four cities. The cultivators in the Sacred World originated from many different worlds. Some might even be the descendants of Chaotic Origin Experts! He knew some supreme treasures used for cultivation and all he could do is to prepare them in exchange for Xue Ying’s help.
“Then let us leave this matter as such. I shall make my move first.” Xue Ying smiled and stood up.
Weather Leaf nodded slightly.
He really had no choice.
In terms of influencing power in Scarlet Cloud City, this Monarch Flying Snow would likely not have any less than he as a City Master! Furthermore, it was even possible that more cultivators would rather follow after Monarch Flying Snow. Without sufficient payment, would this Monarch Flying Snow be willing to risk his life for his goal? Impossible!
‘My Mirage and Illusory Realm holds a miraculous effect against ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. However, to Chaotic Origin Prisoners, it is useless. My life would hence be threatened when facing a Chaotic Origin Prisoner. I can’t promise to help him this easily.’ Xue Ying thought. Chaotic Origin Prisoners were High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Their souls were too powerful, so powerful that Xue Ying’s current Mirage and Illusory Realm were futile.
And when he boosted his fleshy body to the peak, Xue Ying would merely be ranked at the bottom of the strongest apex cultivators within Scarlet Cloud City. Moreover, he could only maintain this state for the time taken to brew a cup of tea. That was simply too dangerous!
‘Even though this is only an avatar of mine, and I would remain perfectly fine given my avatars located in my hometown Origin World and Realm Heart Great Land, this opportunity of mine would be cut the moment I die.’ Xue Ying treasured his days of cultivation in the Sacred World.
…
After leaving the side hall, he arrived at the outdoor garden.
Almost all cultivators in the garden had left. Currently, there was only the Vice-City Master ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’ left drinking wine alone. Even Wu Xiao had left.
“Brother Flying Snow.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor pointed to his side with a smile, “Have a seat.”
“I’ve made City Master Nine-Headed wait.” Xue Ying said.
“Our lives are eternal. Such a short wait isn’t worth mentioning.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor looked at Xue Ying, “Weather Leaf wishes to get your help to kill that Chaotic Origin Prisoner located in ‘Wind Devil Valley’ right?”
“Yes.” Xue Ying nodded, “But I did not agree.”
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor felt his heart palpitating.
Did not agree?
It seemed that getting the help of this Monarch Flying Snow isn’t easy.
“I believe that Brother Flying Snow will accept my request then.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said.
“Oh, do tell me more.” Xue Ying replied.
“I too wish to kill a Chaotic Origin Prisoner. In the entire Sacred World, there are a total of 21 Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. And of those 21, only three clans exist that contain a Chaotic Origin Prisoner. These three Chaotic Origin Prisoners might be different kinds of High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, but they all belong to the Void Lineage. What I wish to kill is one of these three Chaotic Origin Prisoners, the ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said.
Xue Ying felt his heart skip a beat.
Quiet Icy Mountain Master?
There were only three Chaotic Origin Prisoners with the Void Lineage. This was something he naturally knew! To Xue Ying, the complete corpse of a Void Lineage High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform was worth way more than those Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses. That was a qualitative transformation! But usually, those of the Void Lineage were slightly good at surviving. Hence, killing them was more difficult.
This ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’ might live in the Quiet Icy Mountain, yet it was genuinely part of the Void Lineage.
“After killing it, the heart and all blood of this Quiet Icy Mountain Master will be given to me. As for other parts of the corpse, they will be given to you.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor looked at Xue Ying, “How about that?”
“Oh?” Xue Ying was moved by this condition.
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was a ‘Witch’. He primarily cultivated by collecting bloodlines of other Chaotic Origin Lifeforms before fusing them into his body. What he cared most was the heart and blood.
And Xue Ying in reality needed just the manifested laws on the corpse for cultivation. For instance, parts like the scales, the muscles, the bones, teeth, and other body parts.
“You only need the heart and the blood?” Xue Ying asked again.
“Right, I can even give you 10% of the blood.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor replied.
“What about other members of the tea?” Xue Ying asked, “After the two of us divide the corpse equally, what are they getting?”
“Since I am asking them for help, I have naturally already satisfied their requests.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said. How would the other cultivators have such a high request like ‘Monarch Flying Snow’? But he had no choice. The most precious resource in the Sacred World, ‘food’, could easily be acquired by Monarch Flying Snow. As for his soul technique… it was the biggest help one could ask for in the hunt for a Chaotic Origin Prisoner.
“You may feel rest assured. Since I have promised you these conditions, I’ll naturally announce it during team formation.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor soothed Xue Ying’s worries.
“Your meaning is…” Xue Ying chuckled, “Using treasures that haven’t been received before asking me to risk my life for it?”
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor waved his hand before throwing a golden wristband: “There are nine Void Lineage Grand Perfection God Emperor corpses. They are entirely different from the six that Heaven Calamity traded with you. This is temporarily what I have collected. The remaining few live close to other assembly grounds. Collecting them is incredibly difficult. These… just treat them as my gift for you, Brother Flying Snow.”
Xue Ying took over. He examined the wristband, discovering the nine Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses within. All of them were Grand Perfection God Emperors. Xue Ying could not help but feel joy coursing through him.
Of the 21 kinds of corpses… he had gathered 15 of them.
Tsk tsk!
This Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was incredibly generous. In comparison, City Master ‘Weather Leaf’ was less straightforward!
Xue Ying mumbled inwardly in his heart.
“Give me 300 billion years.” Xue Ying said, “I have just arrived not too long ago in the Sacred World and do need some time to cultivate. Give me at most 300 billion years. By then, I’ll set off together with you, City Master Nine-Headed, to deal with that Quiet Icy Mountain Master! If we were to succeed, we would divide the corpse of the Quiet Icy Mountain Master accordingly as you mentioned, City Master Nine-Headed. 300 billion years… City Master Nine-Headed, do you have the patience to wait?”
“Alright, it’s a deal then!” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor immediately replied.
If this was in the outer world.
Just 300 billion years was simply too short! To these terrifying existences that were very close to the Chaotic Origin Lifeform Level, it was a fleeting moment. However, in the Sacred World where food was a scarce resource, 300 billion years was considered quite long.
But to Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor, 300 billion years would pass easily for him.
“It’s a deal.” Xue Ying chuckled.
He promised the other party primarily because of the huge enticement from the Quiet Icy Mountain Master’s corpse. Even without Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s help, in the future when he was sufficiently strong, he would still organize a team to kill a Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Prisoner.

chapters.title: Chapter 1356 - Collected All of Them
chapters.content:
Chapter 1356: Collected All of Them
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Both parties agreed on it.
And Xue Ying immediately left after that.
Weather Leaf also came out from the side. He walked to the side of Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor.
“Succeeded?” Weather Leaf said.
“I succeeded after sending nine Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses as a gift.” The edges of Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s lips curled upwards. He glanced at Weather Leaf, “Did you not give him anything?”
Weather Leaf remained quiet for a while: “He can acquire food easily. Just by relying on himself, he can exchange for most of the Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses. The reason he agreed to your conditions is more so for the ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’! Otherwise, do you think he’ll be willing to risk his life with you for this little gift?”
“I know you are jealous.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor replied.
The relationship between both parties was subtle.
Both of them had reached where they were after climbing up as a mortal. Both of them also had the highest realm within the Scarlet Cloud City.
“Have you decided?” Weather Leaf asked, “That you are going to break through to the Chaotic Origin Level through awakening of your bloodline?”
“Mn, I’ve decided.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor nodded.
“Are you willing to?” Weather Leaf questioned again, “Given your strength and accumulations, it might be possible for you to have an enlightenment breakthrough, reaching the next level using force and becoming the strongest ‘Overlord’ class amongst the Chaotic Origin Experts… even if you can’t, if you were to receive a favorable impression from an Overlord, he can send you to an Origin World and allow you to reincarnate within. The willpower of that Origin World might suppress you, yet it is entirely possible for you to grasp that Origin World and become a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform.”
Overlord Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform was the highest class.
World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform was considered not bad. At least the cultivator would be unparalleled within the Origin World that he controlled!
As for a High-Grade Chaotic Origin Lifeform, that was comparatively much weaker!
“Cultivating to my level, the price of sending me into an Origin World is simply too pricey! It is much harder than sending some weaker cultivators into an Origin World.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor shook his head, “I have stayed in the Sacred World for far too long, and there has never been an Overlord who showed any intention of doing so.”
He had already lost hope.
He was clear.
An Origin World… would suppress even experts within it. For instance, ‘Sacred Master’ and ‘Old Monster Stone’ had survived through the Great Apocalypse before entering a new era. Both of them would be forced into deep slumber! That was the suppression rendered by the will of an Origin World. It gave the lifeforms of the next era sufficient time to grow.
As for an expert on the level of Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor, he was too powerful and too terrifying! By reincarnating him into the next era, he would incur a huge conflict with the will of the Origin World. Hence, the price of sending him into a reincarnation was simply too great.
Even if he succeeded!
He would be forced into deep slumber! Or perhaps, he would be suppressed within the Source of the Origin World… having various restrictions shackled onto him. The stronger the expert, the greater the restrictions. How powerful was an Origin World? It could easily suppress a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
“Even if I become a Chaotic Origin through bloodline awakening, turning into a High-Grade Chaotic Origin Lifeform, I believe that with my accumulations and experience… I can similarly cultivate to the next level--’World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform’. It might even be possible for me to become an ‘Overlord Class Chaotic Origin Lifeform’.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor confidently declared.
Weather Leaf did not add anything after that.
In reality, undergoing a bloodline awakening meant incarnating oneself into an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform! The path of growth would also be inline with the path of an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform. This path had a considerably lower potential.
For instance, an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform that had reached the highest level like the ‘Thousand-Eyed Existence’ or the ‘Myriad Tentacles Dragon Mother’ might injure Yuan and other Overlords, yet they still fell in the end.
As for Overlords…
Even though there were few of them, none had fallen!
Hence, it was clear which path would lead to a higher position.
Nonetheless, the difficulty of becoming an ‘Overlord’ was simply too high.
“It is up to us to choose which path to walk on.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said, “I am unlike you who has already gained the notice of many Chaotic Origin Experts. There are even Overlords who have promised to reincarnate you into an Origin World in the worst case scenario.”
Weather Leaf shook his head: “But my path is still to break through by force.”
How terrifying was it for an existence to reach the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Level in two Daos? There was just him within the Sacred World who achieved this.
“Your path is much harder to walk.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor turned around and left. His heart was filled with sorrow. Given his strength, no Chaotic Origin Experts were there to nurture him. He had to fight for it himself.
…
Xue Ying returned to his cavern-dwelling. He checked through the 15 different Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses that he had already collected. The moment he saw them, he felt delighted.
‘I am still lacking six more.’
‘These six are much harder to acquire. However, City Master Nine-Headed hasn’t openly collected these corpses prior to meeting me. He should have simply exchanged some with his other good friends.’ Xue Ying thought. Because in history, there were cases of teams from Scarlet Cloud City heading to other cities to trade.
Some of the rarer Chaotic Origin Lifeforms over at their side might exist in other cities.
This was also the reason why Weather Leaf dared to put out the condition of helping him collect them.
“I, Flying Snow, is planning to collect six kinds of Void Lineage Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses respectively. I am only planning to buy one of each kind! One of them can be exchanged for three times the amount of food.” The six kinds of lifeforms were listed clearly. Xue Ying directly publicised this to all cultivators within the Scarlet Cloud City through his communication treasure.
Three times the food!
This was slightly rarer. It was quite good for corpses to be exchanged for twice the amount of food.
But Xue Ying was rich. He naturally did not care about it.
“Brother Flying Snow.”
“Monarch Flying Snow.’
“Flying Snow…”
Many messages came.
They were all here to exchange food!
After all, with more than 3,000 experts in Scarlet Cloud City, there were more than 100 that had one of these six kinds of corpse.
Xue Ying immediately contacted the cultivators sequentially before confirming the matter about exchanging food.
“The transaction is complete.” Xue Ying soon transmitted to all cultivators about it.
…
Something like exchanging for three times the food would only happen serendipitously.
The moment it appeared, everyone would immediately take the initiative to offer for a trade. It’s a pity that Xue Ying only required one of each kind! Of these six Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, some were stronger and some weaker. Some could be exchanged for two ordinary ones. Hence, in the end, Xue Ying forked out a total of 25 different Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses to acquire all six kinds of lifeforms at three times the rate.
‘I have gathered all 21 kinds of Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeforms in the Sacred World at the Grand Perfection God Emperor level.’ Xue Ying was overjoyed. He was currently in his underground palace taking out one corpse after another before starting his study on these Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses.
******
Great Emperor North River had also received the public message sent by Xue Ying.
First, he released the news that he was openly trading for Void Lineage corpses! Closely following that, he announced that the trade was complete.
‘Three times the food.’
Great Emperor North River checked through the news within his cavern-dwelling, ‘To Ying Shan Xue Ying, collecting food is a very easy task. It’s good too. Even though I might have a hard time getting food, the whole process of gathering for them is a form of training.’
Right.
This a form of training on the line between life and death! Cultivators understood this. They did not really like it though they were forced to stand out with their lives as they hunted for food.
‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet.’
Great Emperor North River flipped his hand, causing a Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet to appear on his palm. Great Emperor North River looked at it, ‘This Ying Shan Xue Ying has always desired to acquire this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. Hmph hmph… this has been left behind by a terrifying existence on the level that had incarnated into the Broken Teeth Mountain Range after his death. I must not let this Ying Shan Xue Ying get it so easily.’
Great Emperor North River was clear that the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet was useless to him! The Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet was only useful in the forbidden ground, ‘Snake Tooth Corridor’. And now, it was no longer helpful to his cultivation.
But this was his most important treasure. Great Emperor North River understood that it was something Xue Ying desired to get too.
‘I must not take the initiative to ask if he wants. I should wait until he begs for it from me. By then, I’ll ensure he pays a hefty price for it.’ Great Emperor North River planned.
This was something that Xue Ying wanted.
In the end, Great Emperor North River violated his oath and snatched it away. And now, Great Emperor North River wished to earn a great sum of food by relying on this ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’.
Nevertheless…
Time passed.
Ten thousand years, a million years, ten million years, more than a hundred million years…
Great Emperor North River was forced to go out to hunt for food yet Xue Ying had never come seeking him for it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1357 - Seeking Help
chapters.content:
Chapter 1357: Seeking Help
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Outside Scarlet Cloud City within the wilderness.
30 cultivators were currently doing their best to fight with strands of ‘thunder light’. Those thunder light rays were incredibly fast and unpredictable. Furthermore, there were many of them--a total of 200 ‘thunder light’.
“Si la!”
A thunder light through the body of Great Emperor North River. There seemed to be a claw that tore part of the flesh on Great Emperor North River, also tearing apart a leg of his!
“Open!” Great Emperor North River had a savage look. Sword lights rushed down at that thunder light like the flow of a river. It also forced that strange thunder light to retreat.
Great Emperor North River’s body rapidly recovered.
“Hurry up, break away from them!”
“Hurry up and retreat!”
“Quick quick quick!”
Some of these cultivators were panicking. Quite a few of them were facing life-threatening danger. Among them was a tall and sturdy white-haired old man. What was strange about this white-haired old man is that he was blind. And currently, many threads of sword lights revolved around him while taking the chance to strike out against those ‘thunder light’ in the surroundings. Those ‘thunder light’ were in reality four-limbed reptilian Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that were completely bathed in lightning.
The white-haired blind old man was none other than the creator of this team, ‘Heart Eye Sword Ancestor’. It was also because of him that this team had yet to lose any member. Quite a few cultivators were experiencing grave dangers yet a single sword light easily forced the Chaotic Origin Lifeform back.
With 13 sword lights revolving around ‘Heart Eye Sword Ancestor’ lending out aid to his comrades anytime, he was also taking the opportunity to kill some Middle Stage and Late Stage God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
They battled and retreated at the same time!
As they gradually got rid of the enemies, their speed of retreating rose until they finally cast away from the enemies completely.
“Sou.”
The 30 cultivators did not care about revealing themselves. They all traveled in streams of light at a terrifying speed rushing towards Scarlet Cloud City.
Because they were already relatively close to Scarlet Cloud City. Rushing back at this speed, they were able to return back to the city after a while.
“Brother Heart Eye.”
“Brother Heart Eye, you guys have returned so quickly this time?”
The two sentries on the wall chuckled.
The white-haired blind man shook his head: “We are quite unfortunate to actually meet a group of ‘Gray-Clawed Lightning Snake’ just outside the city. There were more than 200 of them, and close to half were Grand Perfection God Emperors!”
“What? So many Gray-Clawed Lightning Snakes?”
“Brother Heart Eye is amazing. He actually brought everyone back alive.”
The two sentries praised.
“It is all thanks to Brother Heart Eye.”
“Without Brother Heart Eye, I might just lose my life in this hunt. We actually met the group of lifeforms that are hardest to deal with around the city, the Gray-Clawed Lightning Snakes.” One of the cultivators in the team commented.
…
Great Emperor North River turned sullen.
Even though this team had encountered quite a few dangerous situations, the majority of them were used to it. Great Emperor North River ultimately arrived at Scarlet Cloud City not too long ago. This was also the most dangerous encounter he had after arriving at Scarlet Cloud City.
‘I have almost died on several occasions.’ Great Emperor North River recalled back to several moments where he almost died. He could not help but his heart shivering from the thought of it.
‘Hunting outside really depends on luck. If we were slightly unlucky, there would be a large group of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms attacking us. That would result in a possibility of dying.’ Great Emperor North River thought, ‘Even though I have always chosen to hunt near the Scarlet Cloud City which is comparatively safer, the more I hunt outside however, there would still be one unlucky occasion where I encounter grave danger.’
It was comparatively safer outside the city. One had to know that a terrifying existence like the ‘Sea of Abyss Master’ had once come to the Scarlet Cloud City. Perhaps, there might be newer groups of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that chose to patrol near this city too.
‘It is simply too dangerous.’
‘If this continues, and I encounter another similarly dangerous situation, can I still survive?’ Great Emperor North River felt slightly anxious.
Even though he had the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor, this was commonly seen in the Scarlet Cloud City! The number of such experts occupied 80% of the entire city’s population!
‘Or perhaps I could choose to join those hunting teams that hunt further away from the city? Even though it might be more dangerous, the food I acquire could last me several hundred million years or even longer.’ Great Emperor North River thought.
‘Or I could become the subordinate of an apex expert, becoming a member of his team?’ Great Emperor North River pondered.
There were a dozen apex experts within Scarlet Cloud City.
Whenever any of them organised a team, many cultivators would apply madly for it! Because when venturing outside, apex experts would usually do their best to protect their own subordinates. Only under the premise that his own members were protected would these apex experts help some of the other idle cultivators.
‘But my strength doesn’t give me any advantage. Who would be willing to take me in?’ Great Emperor North River shook his head inwardly.
During these years, he had experienced for himself the strength of apex experts.
For instance, ‘Heart Eye Sword Ancestor’ was ranked top ten within Scarlet Cloud City. Each of his 13 Divine Swords could exert a strength comparable to a Grand Perfection God Emperor! With 13 Divine Swords coordinating together, his combined strength was frightening. This time, it was he who controlled 13 Divine Swords that brought all members of the hunting team out of their life-threatening predicament.
…
Scarlet Cloud City, within the Scarlet Cloud Hall.
This team that Great Emperor North River was in proceeded with allocation the spoils of war according to the contract agreed beforehand. ‘Heart Eye Sword Ancestor’ actually took away 80% of the total amount! And the remaining 20% would be distributed between other cultivators according to their contribution.
They had no choice. Even when Heart Eye Sword Ancestor chose to take away 80% of the total harvest… everyone was still willing to join. This was because Heart Eye Sword Ancestor’s technique was quite appropriate for lending aid to his team members. Hence, hunting outside the city, with Heart Eye Sword Ancestor around, would practically not contain any danger. This time, they were relatively unlucky. Nonetheless, everyone still came back alive. This was also the reason why he chose to take 80% of the total amount!
‘Food that could last me for 12 million years.’ Great Emperor North River received the food distributed to him.
Once the allocation of food is completed, everyone dispersed.
Great Emperor North River walked by himself on the streets.
‘Food that could last me for 12 million years. If this continues, I would have to go out and hunt for food more than a thousand times just to survive for 10 billion years?’
‘Ultimately, I have only bee here in the Scarlet Cloud City for a short period. There are many experts that came from different worlds. They have different cultivation paths and interacting with them gave me huge benefits. With sufficient time, I might even have improvements, allowing me to join the ranks of the apex experts and be on the same level as Cloud Phoenix City Master.’
‘I need time. I need time to properly cultivate.’
Unknowingly, Great Emperor North River walked to the entrance of a cavern-dwelling.
He turned and looked up at the front door to this place.
It was none other than Xue Ying’s cavern-dwelling!
‘Ying Shan Xue Ying! In the end, I still have to come and ask him for help.’ Great Emperor North River gritted his teeth, ‘I have always been waiting, waiting for him to seek me for the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet, which I can then sell at a hefty price. But he… has never come. In the end, I have to find him myself.’
He was clear.
If Xue Ying took the initiative to buy it from him, he could take the opportunity to sell it at a high price.
But if he, North River, came to sell the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet to Xue Ying, Xue Ying would certainly press down the price.
‘I can’t wait any longer.’
Great Emperor North River immediately walked towards the cavern-dwelling.
There was a puppet protector standing by the entrance. This puppet shouted: “Stop!”
“Tell your master that I, North River, is here to meet him.” Great Emperor North River said.
The puppet protector paused momentarily. Clearly, he was sending a message to Xue Ying. Very soon, the puppet protector replied: “Monarch North River, please enter. My master is currently waiting for you inside the cavern-dwelling.”
Only then did he enter.
There was a female puppet servant specially there to guide him along the corridors. Soon, he arrived in a garden.
Inside this garden.
A white-robed Xue Yingsat cross-legged in the pavilion. By his side, there was an incense burning with its fragrance pervading in its surroundings. There were also several female servants waiting upon him with good food, fruits, and a flask of warm wine.
Both eyes of Xue Ying were shut. Clearly, he had been cultivating.
‘These days are no longer the same. I had to risk my life for just a little food. Yet food is something Ying Shan Xue Ying can get with a stretch of his hand.’ Great Emperor North River had this kind of thinking precisely because he just experienced a life-threatening danger earlier on. And now that he saw how Xue Ying was spending his days, he could not help but feel jealous and envious.
“Mn?” Xue Ying stopped his cultivation. He opened his eyes before glancing at Great Emperor North River who walked over from the corridor afar, “North River? You actually came to seek me? This is truly rare.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1358 - Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet
chapters.content:
Chapter 1358: Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
“I’m sure you can guess by now why I came to find you.” Great Emperor North River said.
“What for? Unless you are planning to become my subordinate?” Xue Ying looked at North River, “Do you dare?”
North River’s expression shifted slightly.
Within Scarlet Cloud City, Xue Ying was a mighty force that few could contend! There were simply too many cultivators who wished to become his subordinate.
“The reason I came is because of the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet.” Great Emperor North River coldly uttered, “If we were in some other worlds, I’ll definitely not sell it to you. But now, I need food. Hence, I am willing to sell this bead of Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet to you! State your price. If it is satisfiable, I’ll give it to you.”
“Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet?” Xue Ying felt his heart skipping a bead.
He had always desired to get his hands on it.
If one said that many other external treasures within the Sacred World could help Xue Ying cultivate his ‘Dao of Void’, then there was only the mysterious Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet left behind by that terrifying ‘Thousand-Eyed Existence’ that could aid him in his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm. He only had a momentary chance to examine the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet in the past before it was snatched away by Great Emperor North River.
“Ten Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.” Xue Ying stated.
Great Emperor North River felt his heart twitching.
Ten?
That could only last him several hundred billion years right?
“Not enough. It is largely not enough.” Great Emperor North River coldly laughed, “Ying Shan Xue Ying, to you, acquiring Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms is simply too easy.
