You just have to go out once and you can easily gather dozens of them. Right now, you wish to purchase the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet with just ten Chaotic Origin Lifeforms? This is something left behind by the Thousand-Eyed Existence. That is a terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeform that could even injure the magnificent ‘Yuan’. I’m sure you should know how much more valuable it is compared to these ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.”
“Ten isn’t enough?” Xue Ying frowned.
“A thousand!”
Great Emperor North River stared at Xue Ying, “You just have to gather a thousand Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform and this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet will belong to you.”
Xue Ying felt his eyebrows twitching. He looked at Great Emperor North River with a smile that did not seem like one: “A thousand? With so much food, I doubt you would have to go out and risk your life anymore isn’t it? I suggest you go out more often and train yourself. This training is definitely helpful to you for your cultivation. I feel that ten is more than enough.”
“No, it is vastly not enough.” Great Emperor North River shook his head.
“There is only me who needs the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet. Other than me, are there anybody who would still purchase it in the Scarlet Cloud City?” Xue Ying asked.
“If I released the news that this is a material left behind by the body of a humongous Chaotic Origin Lifeform that was close to the size of an Origin World, how much do you think I can sell this ‘Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet’ for?” Great Emperor North River retorted.
Xue Ying sneered: “Do you think others would believe you if you were to release this news? Actually, other cultivators would understand with a glance that this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet isn’t helpful to them. Who would then be willing to fork out a huge price? In this Sacred World, all other cultivators are much weaker than me on the Dao of Soul. It is impossible for you to sell at a high price.”
“Perhaps I might be able to.” Great Emperor North River looked at Xue Ying.
“Don’t threaten me.”
Xue Ying coldly said, “Firstly, with my strength, I am already unparalleled in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range! The five Great Supremes of the Broken Teeth Mountain Range have to show some respect to me too. The moment a bead of Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet appear, I believe they would give it to me.”
Great Emperor North River trembled.
That’s right.
Perhaps there might be a moment in time when a new Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet is discovered in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range. With Xue Ying’s current strength, he could kill most Grand Perfection God Emperors. How would the five Great Supremes dare to slight him then?
“Secondly, if I want you to die, it isn’t that hard actually.” Xue Ying stared at Great Emperor North River.
Great Emperor North River felt many thoughts flash through his mind. That’s right. All Xue Ying had to do is to request the help of the organizer of a hunting team. It was likely that an apex expert would be willing to show some respect to Xue Ying! If they were to go out and hunt for food, without the aid of any other comrades, he, North River, would easily lose his life.
“That time when I just arrived at the Scarlet Cloud City, haven’t you said that we should place aside our grievances temporarily in this world?” Xue Ying said, “I have never thought of acting against you, so are you sure you want to threaten me?”
North River’s expression became uglier.
Given Xue Ying’s current fame, it was easy for Xue Ying to threaten him, making his days harder to pass by. Xue Ying could make it so that no team members would help him when he hunted outside. They could completely watch as he died. Just like previously, if ‘Heart Eye Sword Ancestor’ chose not to help, he would have long died.
Or perhaps not!
If North River was in a desperate situation, he could activate the imprint on his wristband and proceed to the third world.
Xue Ying looked at him. He understood that North River could always head to the third world. Hence, he was not in a rush to force the other party.
But Xue Ying believed that Great Emperor North River was someone ambitious--he would not be willing to leave this world for no reason.
Three worlds.
Each world was a huge opportunity given by Yuan! And they had to treasure all of them.
“Alright, 100 Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms and I’ll sell this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet to you.” Great Emperor North River gritted his teeth.
“100? Forget it. I’ll take a step back. 20 and not one more.” Xue Ying coldly stated.
Great Emperor North River looked at Xue Ying before finally agreeing to it: “You are ruthless. Alright, take it.”
Xue Ying did not say anything else. He simply threw over a storage treasure.
Great Emperor North River similarly threw the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet over.
“Hua.”
The Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet was like a bead of droplet. As it flew across, it was constantly reflecting light.
Xue Ying extended his hand and watched as the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet fell onto his palm.
‘I’ve finally gotten it.’ Xue Ying felt a wave of excitement course through his heart. Even though it was possible for another bead of Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet to appear in Broken Teeth Mountain Range, such supreme treasures were simply too rare! It was normal for one to wait more than a trillion years before another appeared.
The earlier he acquired it, the earlier he could comprehend it.
“Hu.” Great Emperor North River examined the 20 Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses in the storage treasure. He could not help but feel elated. No matter what, at least he had achieved his goal, albeit much fewer than expected.
‘Go.’
Great Emperor North River simply turned and left.
Xue Ying watched at the departing back figure of Great Emperor North River. Once he left, Xue Ying immediately turned to comprehending this Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet on his hand. He had many avatars, and part of them were comprehending on the Dao of Void while the others on the Dao of Mirage. Xue Ying had never given up on any of his two Daos. Even though he had walked further in the Dao of Void, the ‘Dao of Mirage’ was simply more heaven-defying.
It was already this strong now. The moment it reached the final realm, Xue Ying had a vague feeling that he could fuse his soul into the source of the world. By then, as long as the world remained, he would never die! This was something he could confirm. There were many that he had yet to affirm and would only find out once he broke through.
Soul was the root of a living being.
Hence, Xue YIng naturally looked forward to the day he reached the final realm in his Dao of Soul!
******
Time passed.
Xue Ying spent close to 10 billion years comprehending through all the 15 Void Lineage Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses that he just received.
He then analyzed all 21 Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses again and again. He even corroborated what he learned from each corpse with other corpses to deduce out many new cultivation techniques. After which he would experiment with them!
During these days of cultivation.
Xue Ying would occasionally organize some ‘hunting teams’. The moment he organized one, even when he arranged to take away 90% of the spoils of war, many cultivators across the entire Scarlet Cloud City still came in crowds to apply for it. It was fine when apex cultivators decided to join--they were there just to interact and befriend Xue Ying. Other ordinary Grand Perfection God Emperors, especially Late Stage God Emperors were fighting to join.
Nonetheless, Xue Ying had limited the size of each team to 50 at most!
After all, he was merely hunting outside the city and there was no need for so many cultivators to join.
…
During the first hunt that Xue Ying organized, they brought back a total of 75 Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses! There were many more Late Stage and Middle Stage God Emperor corpses. Even when 10% was left to distribute between other members, most could still receive sufficient food to last billions of years! Easily acquiring food to last billions of years in a short hunt that was both safe and easy, most cultivators naturally sought to join Xue Ying.
He organized several hunting teams. Firstly, he did it to help some friends like God Eagle Snake and Scarlet Demon. Secondly, he did it to temper himself! Xue Ying would usually leave some Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that were not suppressed by the Mirage and Illusory Realm before experimenting with his techniques.
In the blink of an eye, 100 billion years passed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1359 - Scriptures
chapters.content:
Chapter 1359: Scriptures
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Within a palace hall.
Xue Ying sat opposite of a male with deep blue hair. That male had messy hair and lush beard. It’s just that both eyes of his were filled with endless wisdom. At the center of his forehead, there was a slit which faintly covered a third eye.
“It is rare for Monarch Flying Snow to come seek me.” This deep-blue-haired male chuckled.
“Monarch Ardent Creek.” Xue Ying said, “The reason I came today is because I wish to have a glimpse of Monarch Ardent Creek’s cultivation scripture.”
Scarlet Cloud City had more than 3,000 experts.
Advertisement
Yet genuine Dao Cultivators were few and far between! An absolute majority of them were sent to this world because of the Chaotic Origin Bloodlines in their bodies. As for Dao Cultivators that specialized in ‘Dao of Void’, even fewer of them existed.
Of the top few apex cultivators in Scarlet Cloud City, there was only one ‘Grand Perfection God Emperor Dao Cultivator’ who reached that level in the Dao of Void--Monarch Ardent Creek!
Of the Late Stage God Emperors that cultivated in the Dao of Void, there were only eight of them!
“<Eight Revolutions of the Celestial River> is indeed my biggest achievement. By relying on this, I was able to cultivate a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body.” Monarch Ardent Creek nodded, “This cultivation scripture isn’t something I will easily teach others.”
“Tell me the conditions you have, Monarch Ardent Creek.” Xue Ying was straightforward.
“I would not care if others came to ask me for this. But since it is Monarch Flying Snow, I would still respect your decision.” Monarch Ardent Creek waved his hand before throwing a piece of wooden talisman over. When Xue Ying received it, he immediately began extending his senses into the wooden talisman which poured information into his mind with a “hong~”
<Eight Revolutions of the Celestial River>. This was the only complete Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body cultivation technique that he had acquired.
Advertisement
In reality, the <Chaotic Origin Seven Strikes> that Yuan bestowed upon Xue Ying in the past did not include the cultivation technique to grasp a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body precisely because… the Dao path towards becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform had to be taken by oneself! Only when one walked down this path himself could he have absolute control over the technique. Other Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms for instance had Chaotic Origin Laws manifesting on them innately. But prevented them from maximizing the execution of their strength.
Hence, one could not learn the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body Technique of others!
That would mark a wrong path!
This was also the reason why ‘Emperor Summer’ and ‘Xue Ying’ chose to take different routes in the past. Both of them had their own determined direction.
The <Eight Revolutions of the Celestial River> was also one of the many ways that was drastically different from Xue Ying’s.
Eight Revolutions of the Celestial River…
At the very beginning, this was an array technique!
Advertisement
Monarch Ardent Creek specialized in array techniques the most! He evolved his array techniques into the void! After that, he turned his array techniques into a celestial river. That marked the complete Cosmos God Final Realm! When the Celestial River revolved, it would also represent an advancement in realm. <Eight Revolutions of the Celestial River> had even interacted with some structural profound mysteries of the Chaotic Origin Dimension.
‘This Eight Revolutions of the Celestial River is made of many structural layers. It feels quite similar to the structure of an Origin World, just slightly more crude.’ Xue Ying thought. The structure of an Origin World was actually not complex. But the more one experienced it, the more delicate one would find it. Even though it might not be complex. It was perfect. It was a space where even weak lifeforms could live within.
One had to know that places like the Lightning World and Sacred World were so harsh that weaklings could not survive in them.
An Origin World.
The lowest level being ants or some worms. The highest being a Chaotic Origin Lifeform that could enter albeit with his strength suppressed.
“Many thanks Monarch Ardent Creek. Monarch can just tell me if you need some help from me.” Xue Ying said. Because everyone took different paths, he could at least learn from others and absorb them into his Dao path.
“We are all taking this Dao of Void so let us help each other. If Monarch Flying Snow obtains the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body, I hope Monarch Flying Snow could let me take reference to the cultivation technique that you create.” Monarch Ardent Creek said.
Advertisement
“That is definite.” Xue Ying added.
“I still have one more request that I hope Monarch Flying Snow could agree to.” Monarch Ardent Creek said.
“Do say.” Xue Ying answered.
“I know that Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor has invited Monarch Flying Snow into his team to hunt down the Chaotic Origin Prisoner, ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’.” Monarch Ardent Creek said, “I believe other than the heart and blood, the corpse would eventually be given to Monarch Flying Snow. Am I right?”
Xue Ying felt his heart move. He nodded slightly without confirming anything.
Monarch Ardent Creek continued: “I wish that I can comprehend this Chaotic Origin Prisoner corpse together with Monarch Flying Snow. We can limit the cultivation time to 100 million years. How about that?”
“Comprehend the corpse together for 100 million years?” Xue Ying muttered to himself irresolutely, making Monarch Ardent Creek nervous.
To Dao Cultivators, there was a huge allure in comprehending the corpse of a Chaotic Origin Prisoner.
Advertisement
“Alright. By then you and I can comprehend it together. We can also exchange knowledge and corroborate what we learn.” Xue Ying nodded. He could accept it if it was just 100 million years.
…
It was only Monarch Ardent Creek who put forward some conditions. The other eight Void Lineage Late Stage God Emperor Dao Cultivators in Scarlet Cloud City did not. Instead, Xue Ying took the initiative to exchange it with two Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses. These eight cultivators were incredibly elated, and were willing to gain the favor of Xue Ying, giving him an easy time exchanging for the other eight scriptures.
Even though these eight scriptures were only at the Late Stage God Emperor Level, they represented different paths and Xue Ying could refer to them for some guidance.
And thus, Xue Ying borrowed the experiences of other cultivators before absorbing the essence into his own path.
Xue Ying also comprehended the 21 Chaotic Origin Lifeforms at the same time.
He even frequently went out to spar with other cultivators in the following days! The experts within Scarlet Cloud City were willing to show respect to Xue Ying, sparring with him and allowing Xue Ying to validate his techniques in battle. Even though it was not a true life and death battle like he had with the Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, it would still be useful as the techniques of cultivators were more strange and unpredictable.
They came from different worlds and specialized in different techniques. Some even made Xue Ying dumbstricken.
******
Nine scriptures, comprehending the corpses and sparring.
Xue Ying’s accumulations continued thickening. His Chaotic Origin Refinement Body was also gradually perfected.
“Hu~”
The gale whistled. Great snowflakes flew down from the sky.
Xue Ying sat by himself under a pavilion watching the floating snowflakes fall.
‘How difficult is it for me to reach the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body?’ Xue Ying thought. Even though his experiences were aplenty, he had still yet to reach where he desired in both Dao of Void and Dao of Mirage. He was just slightly away from reaching the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body. It was still difficult for him to stabilize his body completely! As for his ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’, the third killing technique which he previously created was heaven-defying enough. Even when he had the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet, he still could not come out with the fourth killing technique.
‘Unknowingly, 300 billion years have passed. It is about time for me to set off.’
Xue Ying chuckled. He turned around towards the corner of a distant corridor.
By the corner, a handsome bald young man came walking over! He was none other than one of the three City Masters in Scarlet Cloud City, ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’.
“City Master Nine-Headed.” Xue Ying stood.
“How is Brother Flying Snow’s cultivation?” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor chuckled, “Is it appropriate for us to go hunt for the Chaotic Origin Prisoner now?”
“It has been 300 billion years since we made a contract, City Master Nine-Headed.” Xue Ying said, “Since City Master Nine-Headed has given me sufficient time to cultivate until now, no matter what, I’ll immediately set off when City Master Nine-Headed asked me to.”
“Ever since the full 300 billion years have passed, I have always been investigating the whereabouts of Quiet Icy Mountain Master. It is only now that I finally discovered that he is out on another patrol.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said, “The moment I discovered it, I immediately came to find Brother Flying Snow.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1360 - 300 Billion Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 1360: 300 Billion Years
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Chaotic Origin Prisoners were constantly being tortured and punished. Their sufferings would occasionally become heavier. Given enough time… they would be tortured to the extent that they had to go out for a ‘patrol’! Otherwise, the pain and suffering would only increase .
Only when they left their territories for a patrol would cultivators have a chance to kill them.
In their territories, the Chaotic Origin Prisoners were too powerful. It was nile impossible to kill them. But once they went out for a patrol, the further they were from their territories, the weaker they would be.
“Quiet Icy Mountain Master is going out on patrol today?” Xue Ying’s eyes brightened. He immediately continued, “Let us not delay then! Let us hurry and set off.”
“Brother Flying Snow, how is your strength currently? How long can you maintain your peak state?” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor asked, “Even though we do not need you to risk your life in the battle, by then even though you can easily deal with the large number of protectors, that Chaotic Origin Prisoner ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’ would most likely target you. I need to know how strong you are Brother Flying Snow, so that I can make sufficient preparations.”
Advertisement
“I can maintain my peak state for close to an hour.” Xue Ying said.
When Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor heard that, he let out a sigh of relief.
That was a very long period!
Because according to what he knew beforehand, Xue Ying could only maintain his peak state for a very short period. That way, their task of protecting ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ would become very heavy. But it did not seem like that would happen now. An hour was sufficient for them to do many things.
“Admirable. Truly admirable. It has just been a short 300 billion years and Brother Flying Snow has improved by such a large margin.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said.
“It’s a pity that I have yet to become a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform.” Xue Ying replied.
“If you say this, you will only bring envy and jealousy to other Late Stage God Emperor Dao Cultivators.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor laughed. Xue Ying knew that his cultivation speed was very fast. Firstly, it was due to his superior soul, boosting his speed of comprehension. Another aspect was after his soul reached his current realm, it nourished his fleshy body after that, paving way for a path that his fleshy body could proceed with.
Advertisement
Once he knew where he wanted to go, his speed of improvement would naturally be much faster.
…
On that day itself.
Within Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s cavern-dwelling.
“Fellow cultivators.” Beside Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor stood Wu Xiao and Xue Ying. Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor swept his gaze across all other cultivators in the hall.
Those who could stand here.
A minority of them were apex experts! And the remaining ones had the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor. They were also specialists in certain aspects!
Advertisement
“We have a total of 56 in our team with the best cultivators in certain aspects from Scarlet Cloud City gathered here.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said, “For everyone to keep your promise and come help me, Nine-Headed, I, Nine-Headed, will definitely remember this in my heart. As long as we succeed this time, what I promise to give everyone will definitely be fulfilled. Furthermore, if I were to succeed in my Ultimate Awakening, becoming a Chaotic Origin! I’ll definitely not forget this favor given by everyone here.”
“Big Brother Nine-Headed, you have helped us in the past. This time, we’ll naturally do our best for you too.”
“Brother Nine-Headed, we have so many experts. We even have Monarch Flying Snow and
City Master Wu Xiao with us. Those Chaotic Origin Lifeforms can’t stop us at all. That Quiet Icy Mountain Master will definitely die.”
At that moment, quite a few Grand Perfection God Emperors said.
And the apex experts were comparatively more aloof.
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor had clearly only invited the extraordinary. He nodded with a smile: “That’s right. With Brother Flying Snow and Wu Xiao around, I am more confident.”
Advertisement
Xue Ying and Wu Xiao chuckled.
The two of them understood. Even though Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor might seem humble, in terms of combat techniques, he and Weather Leaf were the most terrifying ones! Even though Wu Xiao might be comparable to them in strength, he had fewer techniques. He relied more on his fleshy body to fight.
“Is everyone ready?” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor swept his gaze. Seeing that nobody had opposed him, he continued: “Then let us set off now!”
The group of 56 cultivators immediately flew out of City Master Nine-Headed’s cavern-dwelling.
Xue Ying also noticed that ‘Monarch Ardent Creek’ was in the team. He could not help but send a message over: “I would not have guessed that Monarch Ardent Creek has joined as well. In the name list that City Master Nine-Headed passed me at the start, I don’t remember seeing Monarch Ardent Creek in it.”
“Nine-Headed has invited me from the start, though I am not in a rush to join. It’s just that after agreeing with Monarch Flying Snow on sharing the corpse, I would naturally have to do something about it.” Monarch Ardent Creek transmitted. Even though he was strong, he could be considered an average apex cultivator and was not qualified to ask for the Chaotic Origin Prisoner corpse! Hence, he was too lazy to join previously.
But now, he chose to do so!
Because Xue Ying would eventually be the one getting the corpse of the Chaotic Origin Prisoner. Hence, Monarch Ardent Creek would have to do his best to help Xue Ying.
Advertisement
“Sou sou sou…”
They soon crossed the city walls and headed out for the vast wilderness.
…
“They have set off.”
“Their task is to hunt down a Chaotic Origin Prisoner. It is even one of the hardest to deal with, the Quiet Icy Mountain Master.”
Within Scarlet Cloud City, many experts stood within their cavern-dwelling watching as a team of cultivators flew in the distance.
This team contained two Vice-City Masters and Monarch Flying Snow! There were too many elites gathered in it. It was one of the few rare occasions where a huge operation began in Scarlet Cloud City.
“What do you guys think? Do you think they will succeed?”
“If Monarch Flying Snow was not around, there would only be 10% to 20% chance of success. But with the help of Monarch Flying Snow, I believe they have a 50% chance of succeeding.”
“Mn, it has been a long time since any of us hunted down a Chaotic Origin Prisoner successfully.”
Many cultivators were discussing this matter.
And at this juncture.
Weather Leaf was seated within the garden of his cavern-dwelling watching as that team of cultivators left Scarlet Cloud City.
‘Nine-Headed has gone to hunt that Chaotic Origin Prisoner.’ Weather Leaf lightly shook his head, ‘It’s a pity that a rare friend has chosen to go down this path of Ultimate Awakening.’
He understood the plight of his good friend.
Forcing to the next stage?
That path was too difficult! It was almost impossible.
And to grasp an Origin World? Nobody was willing to help Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor reincarnate in an Origin World!
Even if this easiest path of Ultimate Awakening had stumped many Grand Perfection God Emperors before it.
‘I pray for his success.’ Weather Leaf thought, ‘At least his fortune is quite good since he got the help of Monarch Flying Snow. That would at least give him hope of killing the Quiet Icy Mountain Master.’
Outside the city.
“Weng.”
Many machineries that could not be seen by the naked eyes began flying out from the surface of Wu Xiao’s body. The machines were even smaller than the particles of ordinary cultivators! There were so many of those machines that they could not be counted. They began flying off in different directions. These machines might be small, yet they were incredibly tough. Even if a Grand Perfection God Emperor sought to destroy it, he would have to spend lots of effort doing so.
These minute machineries were classified under many categories. They had different scouting methods too. With the machineries mutually verifying what they saw using different methods, it was almost impossible for anything to escape their notice.
Wu Xiao was unquestionably the best scout in Scarlet Cloud City when comparing how wide his scouting range was.
“Chi chi chi.” There was also another cultivator who had an enormous lone eye filled with different profound mysteries. He was able to easily observe what was happening over a huge region around him.
…
Inclusive of Wu Xiao, there were three experts responsible for scouting. They were all employing different techniques.
Many domains descended too.
The entire team of cultivators disappeared from plain sight as they advanced within the wilderness.
“This is the current location of Quiet Icy Mountain Master as well as the approximate distribution of other Chaotic Origin Lifeforms around according to what we know.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor began sending intelligence to each member of the team through his communication treasure, “We will be moving according to this first path.”
“Mn.”
“We should be able to reach in two days.”
Xue Ying and the other cultivators agreed with the arrangement of Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor. His preparations were ample.

chapters.title: Chapter 1361 - Blockade
chapters.content:
Chapter 1361: Blockade
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying could sense that this team was clearly much more formidable than the team Daoist Hidden Horizon once created. It was only after a day was this team finally discovered by a group of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, welcoming their very first fight after leaving Scarlet Cloud City.
In reality, this battle happened only because Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor and the other cultivators discussed and agreed that ‘taking a detour’ was not appropriate. They would be better off crushing the enemies directly!
“Kill!”
This team clashed with a large group of black birds. Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor gave a cold and furious roar. At the same time, the illusion of nine huge serpents appeared behind him. Those nine huge serpents swayed on the spot, with each serpent letting out an entirely different energy from others. Nine kinds of energy soon merged together to form a nine-colored domain that suppressed the entire battlefield.
“Hahaha, this is so fun!” Wu Xiao laughed joyfully. With a sway of his body, he turned himself into a 3,000-meters silver-white giant. He extended his hand towards a Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform bird. That black bird struggled and tried escaping, yet following that, with a palm by Wu Xiao, he sent waves of energy that restricted this black bird, preventing it from escaping at all. In the end, that enormous palm succeeded in grabbing that black bird.
And once he grabbed hold of it!
The center of his palm caved in like a black hole, swallowing this bird into it.
A Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform was actually captured alive in one fell swoop! This strength simply stunned Xue Ying.
Some of the apex experts in Scarlet Cloud City could kill a Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform if they battled one on one! As for the three City Masters, they were way stronger. Of which ‘Wu Xiao’ who had the most frightening fleshy body might have fewer techniques compared to the other two City Masters ‘Weather Leaf’ and ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’, but his techniques were powerful.
It was primarily due to his strong body! Just his fleshy body gave him the capability to stand side by side with the other two existences.
At this moment, he had easily captured a Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeform. One could easily determine how strong he was.
“Celestial River.” Monarch Ardent Creek also began executing his techniques. A strange river soon appeared in the surroundings. This river contained layers of void images. If one carefully observed those images, they would see that there were eight void images in total as if they accounted for different spatial dimensions. When those Chaotic Origin Lifeforms entered the region of this river, they would get lost. They could not even find their allies or enemies!
Hence, the cultivators had an easy time defeating the enemies.
…
There was no need to talk about Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor and Wu Xiao.
The other apex cultivators were excellent in their own ways. Adding up all the Grand Perfection God Emperor Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, there were only about 10 to 20 of them. Each of them could deal with this number, much less when they were currently working together! Furthermore, some of those Grand Perfection God Emperor experts chosen into the team had been because they were sufficiently outstanding in certain aspects. Once they coordinated with each other, the overall effect was miraculous!
It was a complete one-sided slaughter.
“Brother Flying Snow, remember, you must not cast your soul technique on this journey there.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor transmitted over, “The moment your soul technique is made known to Quiet Icy Mountain Master, he’ll most likely choose to run. I’ll inform you when you should execute the technique.”
“City Master Nine-Headed, please be rest assured.” Xue Ying smiled, “Oh right, I have executed the soul technique before when I went out with Daoist Hidden Horizon. After that, I have used it on multiple occasions too. Would Quiet Icy Mountain Master not have received the news on this?”
“You can feel rest assured about it.”
City Master Nine-Headed confidently transmitted over, “Within the Sacred World, there are many Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, forming many tribes. Different tribes practically do not talk to each other! At least from our observation, it seems those of the same tribe would move together. But different tribes do not really interact at all. Any small hiccups we face on this journey there are really handled by us easily. Hence, that is why I ask for you to conceal your soul technique in the meantime.”
“But remember, the moment we encounter the Chaotic Origin Lifeform tribe under Quiet Icy Mountain Master, the ‘Quiet Destruction Wolves’, you must be vigilant. Because the moment you reveal your strength, it would frighten Quiet Icy Mountain Master, preventing us from finding another opportunity to kill him.”
“I understand.”
…
They advanced onwards.
Their journey there was quite relaxed. With the strength of this team, as long as they were a little careful in not provoking a huge enemy, they would not encounter any danger.
A torrential rain began pouring. Many huge fishes flew up from the surface of the lake and killed in the direction of the cultivators.
“Hong~”
Another huge battle ensued.
Xue Ying wielded his spear and somewhat retaliated against the enemies. After all, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor remained near Xue Ying to protect him! He did not allow Xue Ying to encounter any of the slightest danger at all.
“Monarch Flying Snow?” There was a sudden transmission.
Xue Ying extracted a strand of his consciousness to check the message.
“I am a Vice-City Master ‘Xun Yi’ from Sky Noon City. It is through the Sky Noon Hall Spirit and Scarlet Cloud Hall Spirit that I was able to contact you.”
“City Master Xun Yi?” Xue Ying was startled, “I wonder if there is anything you need me for?”
Xun Yi.
He was the only Dao of Void Cultivator in the five assembly grounds of Sacred World who had become a Vice-City Master.
“I’ve heard that you are currently moving together with Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor and the others to deal with Quiet Icy Mountain Master?” Xun Yi chuckled.
“City Master Xun Yi’s source of news is spectacular.” Xue Ying replied. The five cities had some interaction with one another. Hence, it was normal for Xun Yi to hear about this matter.
“Don’t blame me for being offensive, but City Master Nine-Headed wants the heart and blood of that Quiet Icy Mountain Master because he wanted to undergo an Ultimate Awakening! He has planned for this several times. That Quiet Icy Mountain Master had long been frightened by it and is constantly on alert. Furthermore, of the three Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Prisoners, Quiet Icy Mountain Master is the strongest of them all.”
“He remains on alert and is strong too. Hence, the possibility of your team killing him is rather low.” City Master Xun Yi transmitted, “Even with Monarch Flying Snow’s heaven-defying soul technique that could easily cause trouble to all those protectors, I can’t see the success rate of this mission past 50%.”
Xue Ying admitted that what Xun Yi said was logical.
Quiet Icy Mountain Master was the hardest of the three Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Prisoners to deal with.
“Monarch Flying Snow, you are a Dao Cultivator, and I also need the corpse for comprehension. I doubt any of the three Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Prisoners would make a difference for you.” City Master Xun Yi transmitted, “Hence, I am inviting you over to pay my Sky Noon City a visit once this matter is over. I’ll organize a team to deal with one of the three Void Lineage Chaotic Origin Prisoners, the ‘Golden River Master’. The Golden River Master is way easier to deal with as compared to the Quiet Icy Mountain Master. The moment we succeed, I only need to comprehend the corpse for one billion years. You can also comprehend it together with me. After one billion years, the entire corpse will belong to you. How about that?”
Xue Ying had yet to grasp a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body. He still needed much more accumulations.
As for City Master Xun Yi… he had already grasped a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body and was very powerful. What he needed was an ‘enlightenment’ or an ‘inspiration’. Perhaps, that might allow him to have a breakthrough! If he did not have a breakthrough within a billion year, that Chaotic Origin Prisoner corpse would no longer be useful for him.
“Let us discuss this matter after my mission.” Xue Ying transmitted.
“Also, Monarch Flying Snow, I have to warn you that you are in the most dangerous situation within your team. The moment that Quiet Icy Mountain Master enters a despondent situation, he’ll definitely aim you first! Once he kills you, with his group of protectors guarding him, he can easily flee from the place. He might even counterattack against you all. Hence, you must remember to stay alert. If you were to die under the retaliation of the Quiet Icy Mountain Master, that’ll not be worth the price.”
“Many thanks City Master Xun Yi for your warning.” Xue Ying became more vigilant after that.
It was simply not worth it if he was forced to leave this world by activating the imprint on his wristband.
******
Because Quiet Icy Mountain Master had gone out for a patrol, his position was also changing.
Xue Ying and the rest had to change their paths many times. They spent a total of 2.5 days before finally arriving at their destination smoothly——one of the returning paths that Quiet Icy Mountain Master would be taking.
“We will currently be blockading one of the returning paths that Quiet Icy Mountain Master will be taking. If he wishes to return to his territory? It is definitely impossible for him to avoid us.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor swept his gaze across his surroundings, “This is also the moment I have the biggest hope. I hope everyone can lend me your strength.”
“Rest assured.”
“City Master Nine-Headed, since we have agreed, we’ll definitely do our best.”
All of them acknowledged.
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor nodded: “Alright. Currently, let us advance closer to this Chaotic Origin Prisoner.”
“Sou!”
The team once again moved forward.
As they had taken a huge detour, they were already on the path of return for the other party. In addition, when the team traveled at their fastest speed, it was much faster than that could be traveled by Quiet Icy Mountain Master who was constantly being tortured and restricted! They were not worried that the other party could escape from them.
“Hu~”
They had always been moving forward carefully.
The distance between both parties was also constantly shrinking.
It’s just that the Chaotic Origin Prisoner ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’ had been ambushed multiple times before. He was no longer as careless. The closer it was to him, the more scouts he would employ, and the denser it would be.
“It’s the cultivators.”
“Kill them!”
Finally, Xue Ying’s team of cultivators were still discovered by a team of Quiet Destruction Wolves.
They had no choice as the scouts were placed too closely!
“We have been revealed.”
“Whatever!”
“Let us charge forward using the fastest speed.”
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor and the others did not show any mercy. They immediately dashed forward with all they could.
…
The Chaotic Origin Prisoner ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’ wore a dark gold gown. His hair was also draped over his shoulders. He gave off an extraordinary aura.
It’s just that his limbs were being shackled. All those shackles even extended into the void! Golden inscriptions were constantly lighted up on those shackles, forcing down waves of tortures on every single part of his body.
‘There will definitely be a day. A day when we, Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, inflict back the torture and slavery we encounter by a thousand or 10,000 times more on those Overlords!’ Quiet Icy Mountain Master’s heart was filled with rising hatred. Any High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that had been imprisoned on the Sacred World would suffer from bitter hardship. They were even used as ‘grindstones’ for these weak little cultivators.
They were forced to live through these days filled with despair, agony, and humiliation.
‘Overlord…’
Even though he was filled with grievances and anger…
Thinking about those weak little beings cultivating before standing at the highest peak across the entire Chaotic Origin Dimension, turning into a terrifying being like those Overlords… Quiet Icy Mountain Master could not help but feel terrified. Those Overlords were simply too powerful! An Overlord would protect a very large region himself as well as many other Origin Worlds.
‘They will die. These weak beings, those Origin Worlds, all of them should be food for us Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.’ Anger coursed through Quiet Icy Mountain Master.
“King.”
“King, we discovered a team of cultivators.”
“King, there is a team of cultivators. We discovered ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’ among them.”
“King, we have discovered Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor.”
Many voice transmissions sounded in the heart of Quiet Icy Mountain Master.
Quiet Icy Mountain Master’s expression changed when he heard them.
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor?
As he had been assaulted several times by ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’, Quiet Icy Mountain Master already treated the other party as a thorn in his eyes. Furthermore, he had already passed down detailed information regarding Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor to his subordinates. The moment they discovered Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor, they were to immediately report it to him.
“He came again?” The eyes of Quiet Icy Mountain Master flashed with murderous light.

chapters.title: Chapter 1362 - Pursuing after the Quiet Icy Mountain Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 1362: Pursuing after the Quiet Icy Mountain Master
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Because this team that Xue Ying was in had been revealed, they no longer cared about hiding their presence. Instead, they used their fastest speed to dash over.
Quiet Icy Mountain Master was also receiving consecutive pieces of news.
“Among the team of cultivators include Scarlet Cloud City City Master ‘Wu Xiao’, ‘Great Emperor Heaven Calamity’, ‘Monarch Ardent Creek’…”
“The team of cultivators are flying over at a speed approximately three times faster than ours! They are moving too fast and are currently charging directly towards us.”
More and more information came in one after another.
Quiet Icy Mountain Master’s expression became grave and stern.
“Chi chi chi~” Suddenly, the light of those golden inscriptions marked on the shackles intensified. That Chaotic Origin Prisoner ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’ could not help but let out a low growl from agonizing pain. This pain had seeped deep into every single part of his body. It had also seeped deep into his soul. After all, this was a torture arranged by the Overlords specially for them.
‘They are actually obstructing our path of return, and have gathered quite a few formidable cultivators.’ Quiet Icy Mountain Master gritted his teeth pondering.
He had two choices.
Firstly, he could send out all his protectors to obstruct the cultivators. He had a total of 3,000 protectors by his side and 2,000 additional responsible for scouting nearby! With a command, he would have a huge number of protectors defending him and that would most likely give him some time. And when he moved alone, he would use his fastest speed to return to his territory! Even though his fastest speed might not surpass that of the fastest cultivator in Scarlet Cloud City, the gap was not too big.
If his subordinates could tangle with the cultivators for a slightly longer period, he would have the chance to return back after taking a detour!
After all, the closer he was to his territory, the stronger he would be!
But the moment his periodic torture erupts… the closer he got to his territory, the more intensified it would be. That was why he was forced to go ‘out for a patrol’.
‘It is simply too dangerous.’
‘If I sent out all my protectors, the moment they fail to delay the cultivators for a slight bit of time, the cultivators would have chased up to me! If I were to face them alone, I would be in life-threatening danger. If I were to be closer to my territory by then, I might perhaps survive. Otherwise, I would lose my life.’ Quiet Icy Mountain Master thought. Even though he was suffering from intense agonizing torture, he did not feel willing to die like this.
He was still waiting.
Waiting for the day an expert of their Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms come to save them!
‘The other option is to escape with all my protectors! Even though it is impossible for me to escape from the cultivators, I can still battle and is safer.’ Quiet Icy Mountain Master thought.
Escaping together, he would have 3,000 protectors around him! And 2,000 more in the surrounding area to converge on him.
During the process of escaping, he could always order his subordinates to converge on him.
When the battle began, the number of protectors he would have could increase to 6,000 or even 7,000… with so many protectors, even if that team of cultivators was strong, they would be helpless.
‘I shall escape together with them.’
Quiet Icy Mountain Master made his decision.
Actually.
If he knew about Xue Ying’s soul technique that could easily eliminate all the protectors, he would have chosen the first path!
With so many protectors delaying time for him, he would then escape alone! And that would give him some hope of escaping. After all, the closer he got to his territory, the stronger he would be, and the faster he would get.
It’s just that he was unaware of Xue Ying’s soul technique.
Hence, he chose the safer and more ‘certain’ second path.
******
The protectors of Chaotic Origin Prisoner ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’ started streaming in and converging on his position. Very soon, 5,000 protectors had gathered. They were even escaping in a detour. At the same time when they ran, many more subordinates were gathering on them.
Everything happened within the examination of Xue Ying’s team of cultivators.
“That Chaotic Origin Prisoner has really chosen the method of escaping with his protectors.” Wu Xiao sneered.
“Only with his protectors would he feel safer.” City Master Nine-Headed sneered, “He does not dare to gamble, nor is he willing to. He is afraid of dying in our hands! After all, he is a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform. If he died in the hands of us cultivators who aren’t even Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, it’ll be a huge humiliation to him. It’s a pity that his thinking is wrong. We have Monarch Flying Snow.”
“With Monarch Flying Snow, he is definitely dead this time.”
“Right, he is definitely going to die.”
Quite a few cultivators in the team had once dealt with Quiet Icy Mountain Master before.
“Hu!”
The entire team was engulfed by a huge golden bird.
The huge golden bird was resplendent and dazzling. With a wave of its wings, it easily arced through the sky, moving at a speed so fast that it alarmed Xue Ying. This was unquestionably the fastest cultivator in Scarlet Cloud City.
…
Ever since Quiet Icy Mountain Master chose to escape, Xue Ying’s team of cultivators was no longer encountering any huge hindrances. The path of pursuit was smooth.
“We see him.”
“He is there!”
Xue Ying and the other cultivators easily saw that huge group of Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
Quiet Icy Mountain Master was still in his humanoid form. He had over 6,000 ‘Quiet Destruction Wolves’ around him. These Quiet Destruction Wolves were all entirely black in color. Their bodies were faintly translucent, and close to 6,000 of them were all Grand Perfection God Emperors! There were also several hundred Late Stage God Emperors.
“Hong.”
“Hong.”
The two teams no longer escaped. Instead, they charged towards each other.
One team had a huge number. After all, every Quiet Destruction Wolf was already big, and there were more than 6,000 of them covering the whole place. As for the cultivators, they only had 56 in total. They were comparatively much fewer in numbers.
But Quiet Icy Mountain Master did not dare to be careless because he was clear how powerful this team of cultivators was! Even though he had many subordinates, no matter what, 6,000 of them could not fight with the 56 at the same time. When the ‘team of cultivators’ worked together, they could completely charge through those protectors! Of course, if there was any issue with the coordination in the team of cultivators, they would be in deep trouble.
“Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor, you really do not know how to give up.” Quiet Icy Mountain Master’s voice cut through the void.
“That’s right. I do not know how to give up, which is why I am here again. I urge you to just obediently die. That way, you no longer need to suffer from any pain, and there is no need for me to come disturb you.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor answered.
“You aren’t even a Chaotic Origin Lifeform yet you dare to act so arrogantly before me.” Quiet Icy Mountain Master shook his head.
“You are constantly being tortured and your strength suppressed. Hence, you aren’t very much stronger than us. Don’t be too proud of yourself. You have been imprisoned here by the magnificent Overlords. And there is only one outcome for you—death! Even so, it is better that you just die now.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said.
As both parties conversed, the distance between them shrank.
“Hmph, you have come multiple times previously to kill me yet you here I stand alive. Furthermore, there were even cultivators who had been eaten by me.” Quiet Icy Mountain Master licked his lips, “The taste of cultivators intoxicate me. You are all truly delicious.”
Before being imprisoned.
He had not really cared about eating cultivators.
But now… after the Overlords imprisoned them and tortured them, when they ate ‘cultivators’, they would feel their pain lessening. They might even have a momentary period where they felt extreme pleasure.
Being tortured day and night, they got used to it. When they suddenly felt an intense pleasure coursing through their bodies… even as a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform, they still looked forward to it.
“Kill.” The expression of Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor turned frosty as he shouted.
“Children, kill them for me.” Quiet Icy Mountain Master’s eyes were filled with killing intent too.
“Hong hong——”
Both parties finally clashed.
The cultivators were like a sharp blade easily cutting through the incoming enemies. They simply charged forward.
As for the Quiet Destruction Wolves, even though they were forced aside and injured, their life force was vibrant. At present, only ‘Wu Xiao’ could kill one in a strike. Even Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor had to take several moves to kill a Grand Perfection God Emperor Quiet Destruction Wolf. In addition, those wolves were working with one another. Filled with humongous life force, those Quiet Destruction Wolves were able to fight and hold back the cultivators.
With the advantage of an enormous number, under the circumstance that Xue Ying had not executed his soul technique, this team of cultivators had to do their utmost before they could continue advancing forward.
‘We just have to break apart their coordination and they will start dying.’ Quiet Icy Mountain Master watched as the cultivators charged over, though he was fully confident. His past experiences led him to understand that it was impossible to break through the defenses of the cultivators only when they were perfectly coordinating with one another! After all, being attacked by several thousand Grand Perfection God Emperor Quiet Destruction Wolves was seriously terrifying.
The moment any issue cropped out.
When a cultivator seemed to be fighting by himself! It was very possible for losses to accrue, especially when a cultivator only had the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor without being aided by his comrades. Under the situation when 10 to 20 Quiet Destruction Wolves attacking him at the same time, he would most likely be exterminated in an instance.
‘I have to find an opportunity to break apart their coordination.’ Quiet Icy Mountain Master examined carefully. He even retreated slightly to maintain a distance with the cultivators.
“Is it time to act?”
“Nine-Headed, are we going to act now?”
“We cannot delay any further.”
Many transmissions were sent. The cultivators were all paying attention to Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor.
“We are very close to him.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was also carefully paying notice to their target, “We can easily dash across this short distance. Alright, Brother Flying Snow, time for you to cast your technique.”
“Haha, I have been waiting for this, City Master Nine-Headed.” Xue Ying who was constantly being protected by the team began activating his technique.
“Hong~”
An enormous illusory realm descended, enveloping a huge region of Quiet Destruction Wolves. At this moment, the approximate 5,000 Quiet Destruction Wolves that were closer to them had fallen into the region of this illusory realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 1363 - Coldness in his Heart
chapters.content:
Chapter 1363: Coldness in his Heart
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
These Grand Perfection God Emperor ‘Quiet Destruction Wolves’ were all very intelligent. At this moment, they discovered startlingly, that their souls were being ‘pulled’ by a terrifying force. They could feel their consciousness falling into an enormous illusory realm! Deep in their hearts, they felt that this illusory realm was simply too frightening. The moment they fell into it, they would die.
All of them did their best to resist the pull. However, the majority of them had to expend a majority of their heartforce in dealing with this illusion. As a result, their combat techniques became much more crude and weaker.
“Haha, their strengths have greatly weakened.”
“They only have the strength of a Late Stage God Emperor. There is simply no cause for anxiety as we can sweep across them easily!” The cultivators discovered this with great joy. Like Vice-City Master ‘Wu Xiao’, his enormous silver-white stature of 3,000 meters tall was incredibly fierce. With both his hands, he casually swatted across his surroundings. “Peng peng peng”, more than 300 Quiet Destruction Wolves were forced away by his slap. Those wolves were even injured, causing blood to splatter around the place.
After all, Late Stage God Emperors were one entire level weaker than Grand Perfection God Emperors. The gap between them and apex cultivators was even bigger! Apex cultivators could easily suppress them with a single strike. It was only due to their great life force that they did not die so easily. However, an existence like ‘Wu Xiao’ or ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’ that were stronger by a certain percentage than apex cultivators could still easily sweep through these weakened Quiet Destruction Wolves.
“Awesome. This is simply awesome.” Great Emperor Heaven Calamity guffawed. His strength was close to the three City Masters. At this moment, his blade ruled the world. Many Quiet Destruction Wolves were forced away.
“These Quiet Destruction Wolves are significantly weakened. However, their bodies are still very powerful. They can easily retreat. Killing them isn’t an easy task.”
“There’s no need to care about those Quiet Destruction Wolves. As long as we kill that Chaotic Origin Prisoner, we would have succeeded in a huge task. As for the Quiet Destruction Wolves? Do you think we would lack food once we succeed?”
“Monarch Flying Snow’s soul technique is amazing. The moment you execute it, we immediately hold an absolute advantage.”
After the cultivators saw how miraculous Xue Ying’s technique was, they became confident. Many cultivators even began smiling.
Even though the Quiet Destruction Wolves were working together, the cultivators were also coordinating! Furthermore, their coordination was much better. It was natural they could suppress the large amount of Quiet Destruction Wolves.
“Stop them!”
“Stop these cultivators.”
Standing behind the group of Quiet Destruction Wolves, the expression on the Chaotic Origin Prisoner became uglier. His eyes were filled with fury as he immediately transmitted down his orders to every protector!
At this moment.
Quiet Icy Mountain Master felt an unprecedented danger. He stared at that white-robed young man ‘Xue Ying’ who stood in between the group of cultivators. At the same time when Xue Ying cast his Illusory Realm technique, given the level of life Quiet Icy Mountain Master as a ‘High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform’ was at, he could easily sense that this enormous Illusory Realm was cast by that white-robed young man.
‘There is actually a cultivator who could significantly weaken the strength of all my protectors in the region?’ Quiet Icy Mountain Master looked as the Quiet Destruction Wolves continued attacking the cultivators unafraid of death, yet they were easily blasted away. He could not help but be anxious, ‘Now that the protectors can’t stop them, what should I do?’
Escape?
He did not have sufficient time!
His Quiet Destruction Wolves could not stop the cultivators for long. Those cultivators could easily reach up to him in a short time. By then when the cultivators surrounded him, he would most likely die.
‘There is only one way.’ Quiet Icy Mountain Master’s eyes flashed with a vicious light, ‘That is to use all I have to kill that white-robed young man. As long as he dies, my protectors will no longer be weakened. This dangerous predicament would resolve itself naturally. Perhaps I could even wipe out this team of cultivators.’
‘Let me risk it all!’
Quiet Icy Mountain Master made his decision.
Even though he had been assaulted several times before, he had never exerted his full strength before! And this time, he understood right from the start that he had to do so just to fight for that slim chance of survival!
“Hu.”
Quiet Icy Mountain Master immediately turned into a stream of light as he charged at the team of cultivators.
The team of cultivators was similarly dashing in his direction.
…
Xue Ying was completely protected by the team of cultivators. Vice-City Master ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s true body was even constantly standing by the side of Xue Ying personally guarding him! He was controlling his ‘Nine-Headed Combat Body’ remotely, using it to battle. But Xue Ying knew that this was a killing technique Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor used during normal occasions. It did not show that he was using all his trump cards.
“Hong hong hong.”
Vice-City Master ‘Wu Xiao’s 3,000 silver-white body rushed out as the vanguard. He simply swept away all incoming Quiet Destruction Wolves and parried against Quiet Icy Mountain Master. The other apex cultivators and the ‘Nine-Headed Combat Body’ were as ferocious. They were also attacking Quiet Icy Mountain Master.
“Hua.”
Over at the region where the battle happened, it would occasionally be squashed flat like a piece of art.
The group of experts had somehow turned into characters within the art as they battled in it.
The space would also occasionally turn into a Rubik’s Cube, curling into different spatial lattices. Wu Xiao was simply striking out rampantly at every single spatial lattice, rapidly attacking ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’. He did not give Quiet Icy Mountain Master any chance of breaking free.
“Scram!” Quiet Icy Mountain Master seemed to have turned mad. He seemed to really want to kill Xue Ying, yet this group of Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were frantically obstructing him.
“Hong.”
Quiet Icy Mountain Master was powerful. Any casual punch caused a piece of spatial pocket to explode and shatter. Sending punches over, only Wu Xiao, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s ‘Nine-Headed Combat Body’ and Great Emperor Heaven Calamity could directly face those punches without losing out.
“When he battles, all the injuries in his body would show effect.” By the side of Xue Ying, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor revealed a grin. He casually continued, “The more strength he exerts, the heavier his injuries would be. Over time, his injuries would gradually get more severe, and that is a good thing for us. He can’t fight a lasting battle. You should see, he’ll soon use all his life-saving measures!”
“It seems City-Master Nine-Headed is confident.” Xue Ying transmitted back.
“I can’t say I am certain. But there had been cases of cultivators killing other Chaotic Origin Prisoners in the history of the Sacred World. Hence, we still have some deduction as to when the Chaotic Origin Prisoner would exert his full strength.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said, “Previously, we have never pushed Quiet Icy Mountain Master to such a despondent level. Hence, we aren’t too clear what his life-saving measures are. But our overall strength holds an advantage. That is why I feel it is quite hopeful to kill him. All we have to do during the crucial moment… is to protect you! If you were to die, we can only choose to escape.”
As they spoke, Quiet Icy Mountain Master abruptly let out a painful howl.
He started transforming.
Previously, he was still in a humanoid appearance. Accompanied with his painful roars, his body started twitching and squirming, and he soon transformed into a translucent ‘Quiet Destruction Wolf’ that was entirely balck in color. It’s just that his body contained countless golden inscriptions branded on it. Many wounds could be seen on the surface of his body and claws. Golden marks were even inscribed on the withering muscles within those wounds. His bones even had large amounts of golden inscriptions moving, with fractures seen on those bones.
Looking at him, him seemed ‘pitiful’. He was simply a Quiet Destruction Wolf with heavy injuries.
Nonetheless, his aura had become terrifyingly strong! Even though he was being suppressed, the surface of his black skin seemed to vaguely manifest laws from the void lineage.
“He has actually revealed his true body.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor transmitted to everyone, “Remain vigilant. He is about to use his life-saving measures.”
“This is the first time we see Quiet Icy Mountain Master in his true body.”
“He is going mad soon.”
“But becoming mad means he is about to die.”
All the cultivators present became more careful.
Xue Ying also wielded his spear in preparation against the distant Quiet Icy Mountain Master. Even though the other party was shackled with many suppressing restrictions marked on his muscles and bones, it was hard for any Chaotic Origin Prisoner to transform back to its original appearance. Because once he transformed back to his original body, it would involve activating many suppressing restrictions placed on him, causing his injuries to become graver. His pain would also reach an unfathomable level.
Nonetheless--
They were all Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Only when they transformed back to their true bodies could they exhibit their peak strength.
“Die for me!” Quiet Icy Mountain Master’s eyes were filled with murder. His four hooves trampled on the ground, causing his body to turn blurry. Everywhere he passed would see a sharp void edge cutting through space, cutting through the void and onto every single cultivator.
His current speed was something that even Wu Xiao could not hinder.
Large amounts of sharp void edges… had actually turned all cultivators flustered.
‘Mn?’
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s expression changed, ‘He is actually this powerful when he revealed his true strength?’
‘Combat Body, fuse!’
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s eyes flashed with murder.
The nine huge serpents behind him began condensing back their energy, causing the Nine-Headed Combat Body in the distance to dissipate. Furthermore, it caused the entire body of ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’ to grow. At the same time, the Nine-Headed Combat Body started fusing and manifesting on his true body! One had to know that being the expert who reached the deepest and most profound level in ‘Witchcraft’ across all history, he had carefully collected nine essences from the multitude of Chaotic Origin Bloodlines. He had also refined his body past the level of most Grand Perfection God Emperors. With a body that was stronger than average, the moment it fused together with his Nine-Headed Combat Body, this would mark his trump card and strongest killing technique.
“Die for me!” Quiet Icy Mountain Master who had already charged past the obstacles began completely executing his strongest technique.
He was very clear.
After transforming back into his true self, the rate of his injuries worsening started accelerating. He could not fight a prolonged battle. The moment he showed his true body, he would have to execute his strongest killing technique. Either he succeeded in one fell swoop or he would fail and get defeated.
“Weng~”
When Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor obstructed the motion of Quiet Icy Mountain Master, suddenly, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor felt his surroundings becoming abnormally quiet.
It was incomparably silent.
It felt as if all sound had disappeared. Under this absolute silence, even Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor felt a subconscious ‘coldness’ growing in his heart. It was frigid. Even his consciousness was ‘frozen’, slowing his thinking to a snail pace…
‘Not good.’ Xue Ying discovered to his dismay, that ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’ who was not any weaker than Wu Xiao had somehow slowed down by an entire level. It seemed that he could not obstruct that Quiet Icy Mountain Master who had reached a degree of supreme speed.
“Hua.”
Quiet Icy Mountain Master gritted his teeth. A strange water layer floated on the surface of his body. This layer of water covered even his claws.
The moment this layer of water showed up, his speed actually rose by 60%! His body clashed against the void, causing the void to be cut and torn apart. His power had significantly been boosted.
It seemed!
For the sake of killing Xue Ying in one fell swoop, Quiet Icy Mountain Master had used all the techniques he had.
‘This should be sufficient to kill one with the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor.’ Quiet Icy Mountain Master thought. When the three City Masters planned to kill a Grand Perfection God Emperor, it would take quite a lot of techniques! And if Quiet Icy Mountain Master planned to succeed, he would naturally have to use all techniques he had.
“Hong.”
Xue Ying’s body abruptly expanded. From previously as an elegant and fine prince, he became muscular. His body also grew to about two meters or so. A deep gray light began covering the surface of his body.
“I am also an apex expert.” Xue Ying whirled his spear around, causing stacks of spatial layers to form in defenses against the incoming Quiet Icy Mountain Master. Quiet Icy Mountain Master had a layer of water covering the surface of his body, allowing him to easily knock past the multiple spatial layers. Eventually, he clashed with that spear, forcing Xue Ying to fly backwards instantly. After parrying against it with his spear, that strange force became weaker, leaving just some of it to enter his body. However, his current Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body was sufficiently strong. Xue Ying only spurted out some fresh blood from the strike.
‘What!’ Quiet Icy Mountain Master immediately felt his heart turning cold, ‘This white-robed young man is this strong too?’
With this strength, he was only slightly weaker than Wu Xiao and Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor. How could he kill this white-robed young man in that single instance?
‘I am doomed!’ Quiet Icy Mountain Master understood that this time, he was facing a crisis that he could not escape from.

chapters.title: Chapter 1364 - Success
chapters.content:
Chapter 1364: Success
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was truly stunned. His surroundings had become quiet. He even felt his body turning cold and his thinking lagging by a step. Even though he did try his best to stop Quiet Icy Mountain Master, the other party was moving too fast. And once Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s reaction was slowed… Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor understood that he could not stop the other party at all.
Given his strength, he could survive without doubt. But he could not protect Xue Ying.
‘I should have arranged two more apex experts to protect Monarch Flying Snow.’ At this moment, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor felt a strand of regret. He was simply too confident of himself! Of course, it was because Xue Ying had the strength of an apex expert on the Dao of Void. If Xue Ying merely had the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor would not have dared to be so confident. He would definitely arrange two to three more apex experts to protect Xue Ying.
‘It is up to Monarch Flying Snow now.’
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor could only watch as everything happened before him. This feeling of watching Monarch Flying Snow fight with Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor gave Quiet Icy Mountain Master a strand of panic.
A layer of water formed on the surface of Quiet Icy Mountain Master’s body. His claws and hooves were even covered in this water layer. That strange water layer… as determined by Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor, should be a Dao of Void utilization at the Chaotic Origin Level that boosted Quiet Icy Mountain Master’s strength by several percentage points.
“Peng.”
Both parties clashed.
And the result was Monarch Flying Snow being forced backwards with his spear. Even though he spurted blood as he flew, his life force did not seem to have diminished.
‘Very good. He could only injure Monarch Flying Snow lightly!’ Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor felt elated. After all, the group of cultivators were currently working together. Some of the domain techniques they could cast had already been released and were suppressing Quiet Icy Mountain Master. Injuring an apex expert in one move… happened only after the Chaotic Origin Prisoner ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’ threw in all his techniques.
“Chaotic Origin Prisoner, die!” At this moment, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor had regained the clarity of his thoughts. He flipped his hand, causing nine tentacles to extend out of his palm. Those tentacles headed at Quiet Icy Mountain Master.
“Sou.”
When Quiet Icy Mountain Master saw Xue Ying spurt some blood and was merely forced back by his full-powered technique, he knew that Xue Ying was also an apex expert. Hence, he did not hesitate to escape!
“Hold them back!”
“I order for you all to disregard everything and hold them back at this instance.”
Quiet Icy Mountain Master sent an order down to all his protectors under him.
As for himself, he maintained his true body and fled madly using his fastest speed…
“Stop him!”
“Stop him.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor and the other cultivators might be trying their best, yet when Quiet Icy Mountain Master turned crazy, he could still easily charge through the blockade after exchanging with some injuries.
“Chase after him!”
The cultivators were anxious.
However, the surrounding Quiet Destruction Wolves poured in and continued entangling the cultivators. They were all unafraid of death and killing them was no easy task.
“Hurry!”
“Hurry!”
The cultivators worked together. With Vice-City Master Wu Xiao charging at the front of the ‘arrowhead’, the other cultivators were coordinating perfectly with him.
And they were dashing forward! Even though they were being hindered by these Quiet Destruction Wolves, they were still moving pretty fast.
An hour later.
They finally hurled behind the 6,000 over Quiet Destruction Wolves completely!
“We have finally cast them back.”
“It is no easy task.”
Xue Ying also felt himself letting a sigh of relief. He had no choice. Dealing with those Quiet Destruction Wolves was not easy. They came on them batch after batch! There were even many more Quiet Destruction Wolves rushing in from the outer perimeter to stop them from moving. It was quite amazing they could escape out of the blockade after an hour.
“Continue chasing!”
“Chase after the Chaotic Origin Prisoner!”
…
An enormous golden bird enveloped the team of cultivators. Every flap of its wing easily brought the team through the sky. They were moving at an incredible speed.
Even though they could not locate ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’ with their naked eyes, the cultivators had already sent out countless ‘spies’ to track down the movement of Quiet Icy Mountain Master. Even as a Chaotic Origin Prisoner who could completely conceal his aura and keep it hidden, he could not hide his shackles at all.
“Xiu.”
Quiet Icy Mountain Master was escaping in a flurry. He continued rushing towards his territory using the fastest speed he could muster.
Nonetheless, he was simply too far away!
There was no choice. Every time he went out for a ‘patrol’, he would have to travel out further so as to reduce the pain he suffered.
“King, we are unable to stop them from escaping.”
“We have let them go.”
One by one, his subordinates began transmitting over.
Quiet Icy Mountain Master felt both sorrowful and angry in his heart: “Truly a bunch of trust. With over 6,000 of you, you actually let them escape so quickly?”
He was doing his utmost in running.
By maintaining his true form, his injuries were constantly deteriorating. The golden inscriptions marked on the surface of his body were constantly flashing. They were simply resplendent because now was the period where the punishment came! During the eruption of the punishment, the further he got from his territory, the weaker the torture he would feel. Nonetheless as he ran towards his territory, the pain he was suffering from continued worsening.
‘They are here.’
Quiet Icy Mountain Master saw them.
Approximately two hours or so later, he finally saw a huge golden bird arcing through the sky in his direction. It was moving at a speed much faster than his.
Within the huge golden bird was that group of cultivators. They contained Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor whom he despised, and that white-robed young man who specialized in soul technique.
“Chaotic Origin Prisoner, you can’t escape from us!” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s voice reverberated in the world.
“Hong——”
A Nine-Colored Domain came over, suppressing the fleeing Quiet Icy Mountain Master and reducing his speed considerably.
“Hong hong hong…” The group of cultivators immediately began their mad attack. They felt much more delighted than the previous time because they did not have to deal with the entanglement from the protectors. They could throw in their full strength against their target! Some combined attacks with others, while others struck with their entire strength at the Quiet Icy Mountain Master.
Even though Quiet Icy Mountain Master was still relatively far from his territory, his strength had already increased by 30%.
Nonetheless, his current situation was dire.
Because without being held back by any obstacles, the cultivators’ power had more than doubled.
“No!”
Quiet Icy Mountain Master frantically retaliated.
But it was futile. With layers of obstacles, and Vice-City Masters Wu Xiao and Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor acting as vanguard, Great Emperor Heaven Calamity and other cultivators surrounding him, they continued sending waves of attack at him. As for the Grand Perfection God Emperors, they were located at the outermost perimeter and were combining techniques.
This Chaotic Origin Prisoner had reached an impasse. Right now, he could not even kill a single cultivator.
‘He is dead for certain.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
Facing a group of cultivators alone.
Once his techniques were made known to the cultivators, how would the cultivators still give the Chaotic Origin Prisoner a strand of chance?
“Don’t rush headlong into it. We should be a little more careful and a little more patient.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor reminded the other cultivators, “Currently, he is maintaining his true body. His injuries are constantly worsening. As long as we delay for more time, he will definitely die! There is no need for us to risk our lives.”
“Understood.”
“Haha, it seems this Chaotic Origin Prisoner is slightly mad.’ The cultivators were perfectly coordinating with one another as they fought with the struggling Chaotic Origin Prisoner.
A formidable High-Grade Chaotic Origin Lifeform!
Under punishment restrictions, was being forced by a bunch of Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeforms to the very last moment of his life.
‘Who would have thought that I would die in the hands of some brats who aren’t even a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.’ The Chaotic Origin Prisoner Quiet Icy Mountain Master felt his injuries worsening. He was constantly getting closer to the end of his life, and was very much filled with grief and indignation. Those layers of shackles extended deep into every single part of his body. If only he could release his full strength, he would simply wipe out these ants in one single move.
But it was futile.
‘There would be a day, a day when us Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms send an expert down to this world and save those imprisoned comrades of ours. He would also wipe out all those cultivators. Also, those powerful Overlords that protected countless dimensions… would definitely fall one day. When that day comes, the entire endless Chaotic Origin Dimension would belong to us!’ Quiet Icy Mountain Master howled in his heart.
…
Finally.
Under the besieged by the group of cultivators, that Quiet Icy Mountain Master finally lost his last wisp of aura. He simply fell down onto the icy plains. The wounds on his body, muscles, and bones remained unchanged.
“He is dead.”
The cultivators went taciturn momentarily. They watched at the corpse of this High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
They understood that if not for the punishment and suppression, how would it be possible for them to kill a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform even if they worked together?
Following that…
An uproar. Cheers and discussion ensued.
“We finally succeeded!”
“Haha, we finally eliminated the Quiet Icy Mountain Master!”
“We succeeded!”
“Not a single one of us died.”
The cultivators were clearly in exuberance.
“Congratulations Brother Nine-Headed.”
“Congratulations City Master Nine-Headed for getting what you desired.” The cultivators came to congratulate the Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor. And Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor similarly went over to the corpse of that Quiet Icy Mountain Master with excitement. He gave it a thorough examination before keeping it with a wave of his hand. Just as kept the corpse, a ‘peng’ was heard and that Storage Eden Treasure shattered apart, causing quite a few materials to scatter around. That Quiet Icy Mountain Master corpse appeared once again.
Those present began guffawing.
“Haha, this is the corpse of a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Most storage treasures are unable to hold it in.”
“Nine-Headed, you haven’t even prepared a storage treasure for it?”
The cultivators teased him.
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor felt helpless. A powerful lifeform would bring about an intense suppression within a dimension! Like the hometown cosmos that Xue Ying came from, a Primal Chaos Expert would produce a powerful suppression on a cosmos. Or a storage treasure for instance… the more formidable the storage treasure was, the stronger the pressure it could withstand. Even though this Quiet Icy Mountain Master had fallen, the suppression produced by the corpse of a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform… was way stronger than any suppression produced by these Grand Perfection God Emperors.
“Sou.” In the end, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was forced to bring out a strange, enormous sack that was able to keep the entire corpse of a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
“Fellow cultivators.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor turned to the group of people. His entire face was filled with smiles, “This time, it is thanks to everyone here that we are able to successfully slaughter a Chaotic Origin Prisoner! I’ll distribute the corpse of this Quiet Icy Mountain Master according to what we promised. After returning, I’ll bring the heart and blood away while the remaining parts would be given to Brother Flying Snow. This success can be greatly attributed to Brother Flying Snow too.”
The cultivators present all turned to Xue Ying.
That’s right.
It was largely attributed to Monarch Flying Snow. Without Monarch Flying Snow, how could they deal with Quiet Icy Mountain Master under the protection of 6,000 over Quiet Destruction Wolves?
