Xue Ying added: “It is due to the teamwork of everyone that we were able to kill this Chaotic Origin Prisoner.”
“That’s right, it is the hard work of everyone!” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said, “I’ll definitely do what I promised everyone. Right now, it is time for us to return home!”
“Go go!”
“Time to go home!”
“This feels awesome! We cultivators could even kill a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform. This is splendid!”
“Why are you so delighted? That is a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform suppressed down to a very weak level.”
“But that is still a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform!”
The cultivators were clearly in a splendid moment. They chatted with one another happily. Soon, a faint light covered the team, causing their presence to disappear from the world. That was when they began their journey back home.

chapters.title: Chapter 1365 - Sea of Abyss Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 1365: Sea of Abyss Master
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
There was a forbidden ground in the Sacred World known as the ‘Sea of Abyss’.
The Sea of Abyss occupied approximately one-tenth of the entire Sacred World. It was also known that the only Chaotic Origin Prisoner imprisoned in the Sea of Abyss was also the most terrifying one in the entire Sacred World. It was so huge it occupied the majority of the Sea of Abyss! The law suppression of the Sacred World was incredibly strong. For an existence to maintain the body size more than half the Sea of Abyss… showed how strong he was.
“Hu~”
At the center of the Sea of Abyss, there was an enormous dark air maelstrom. This maelstrom was constantly stirring up the entire Sea of Abyss.
Underneath this maelstrom, deep in the sea.
There was currently a gigantic humanoid being seated cross-legged on the seabed. Even as he sat on the seabed, his head had reached a height just tens of thousands of kilometers away from the surface of the sea. If he extended his arms, he could touch the the shore surrounding the Sea of Abyss. To the cultivators, this was the Sea of Abyss. But to this imprisoned Chaotic Origin Prisoner, it was a very small prison! This prison was not much bigger than his body size.
His breathing was constantly causing terrifying maelstroms to form.
He was none other than the strongest Chaotic Origin Prisoner imprisoned in the Sacred World! Even when he left the Sea of Abyss, suffering from a constantly increasing suppression and weakening strength, when he reached any of the five assembly grounds of the cultivators, the entire city worth of cultivators could barely fight against him.
“Mn?”
The seated ‘Sea of Abyss Master’ had messy hair. It was like seagrass. As he opened his eyes, a pair of dark irises could be seen.
‘That brat from Quiet Icy Mountain has died?’ The Sea of Abyss Master slightly frowned. He would usually sit on the seabed of the Sea of Abyss, yet he could easily extend his senses across every single part of the Sacred World. There were not too many Chaotic Origin Prisoners locked in the Sacred World. Even though they had just reached the ‘High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform’ level and were not as strong as him, they were still his comrades!
He, Sea of Abyss Master, was an expert amongst High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. In addition, he had a noble bloodline, so he was naturally terrifying.
‘With his strength and several thousand protectors, this should not be the case.’ Sea of Abyss Master felt puzzled. He then gave an order to his subordinates.
“Hua hua hua.”
Many humanoid lifeforms could be seen in the Sea of Abyss. These humanoid lifeforms had two legs, yet they did not have the usual two arms! Instead, they had 16 tentacles! They were termed by cultivators as ‘Sea of Abyss Attendants’ and were also the subordinates of the Sea of Abyss Master.
“King.”
There were five Sea of Abyss Attendants that respectfully bowed and waited for the King’s order.
“Bring your subordinates and head to the Quiet Icy Mountain. Go find out how Quiet Icy Mountain Master died.” The Sea of Abyss Master slightly turned his head. In the process, there were sounds of shackles clashing as he ordered nonchalantly; his voice booming in the sea.
“Yes, King.”
These five Sea of Abyss Attendants immediately acknowledged.
Very soon.
They brought along 500 subordinates of theirs and left Sea of Abyss for the Quiet Icy Mountain.
‘Yet another comrade has died.’ The cool eyes of the Sea of Abyss Master were faintly filled with fury. Following that, he shut his eyes and continued enduering the endless torture.
******
As the team of Sea of Abyss Attendants was rushing towards Quiet Icy Mountain, Xue Ying’s team of cultivators spent another two more days before finally returning back to Scarlet Cloud City.
On the journey back, the cultivators were much more relaxed. Xue Ying had also casted his Mirage and Illusory Realm multiple times, allowing the team to hunt down more Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
Finally, the team went to the Scarlet Cloud Hall first for a simple distribution of the food.
“Haha, forgive me for not inviting everyone to a banquet. I have been waiting for this day and can no longer endure anymore. Today, I’ll immediately enter closed-door cultivation.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said, “I hope to seek everyone’s understanding in this.”
“Brother Nine-Headed, all of us understand that! You should focus on your cultivation and fight for it! It has been a long time since our Sacred World has anyone who broke through to the Chaotic Origin Level.”
“Right! All of us are waiting for City Master Nine-Headed to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform so that we can gain some benefits too!”
The cultivators present laughed.
Because…
Those that came to this world had only one desire—to have a breakthrough out of the cage onto the higher life level as a Chaotic Origin Lifeform! Hence, they understood the thinking of City Master Nine-Headed
“Many thanks brothers. Brother Flying Snow, come with me to my cavern-dwelling. I’ll pass you your share of that Quiet Icy Mountain Master corpse too.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said.
“Alright.” Xue Ying’s heart was filled with blazing passion as well.
“Sou sou.”
After bidding farewell to the other cultivators, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor and Xue Ying soon left and arrived at City Master Nine-Headed’s cavern-dwelling. They entered the underground palace within the cavern-dwelling.
“Brother Flying Snow, do wait a moment.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said. At the same time, he waved his hand, causing an enormous corpse of Quiet Icy Mountain Master to appear. This corpse was approximately 6,000 meters long. As it lay there, one could see various forms of wounds on its body and fractures on its bones. The only difference was that the shackles had strangely disappeared.
“I’ll first enter and extract its heart.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor turned into a stream of light and disappeared after finishing his words. He entered through the mouth of Quiet Icy Mountain Master and tunneled into it.
Xue Ying waited patiently.
An hour later.
“Sou.”
A stream of light soon flew out from the body of Quiet Icy Mountain Master. It turned into a Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor. At the same time, he smiled at Xue Ying: “I have extracted the heart. Now, I’ll be drawing out its blood. This is much easier.” Saying that, an unseen energy immediately permeated into the body of that enormous corpse. One could see strands of blood fly out from the wounds on its body, its mouth, its nose, and other holes.
Those strands of blood converged before flying towards Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor.
This blood was dark blue in color. Every droplet of blood seemed to be filled with void energy.
“It is indeed a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform.” The eyes of Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor brightened. He finally stopped with his collection, “Brother Flying Snow, this corpse should still have about 10% of its blood left. And now, this corpse will be yours.”
“Brother Nine-Headed, then I will be congratulating you in advance for your success before you enter your closed-door cultivation.” Xue Ying chuckled. At the same time, he kept the corpse of that Quiet Icy Mountain Master. But as he kept it, his expression changed. “Peng”—that Eden Treasure which he used to store the body simply exploded. Fortunately, that Eden Treasure was not filled with any other things. Hence, it did not cause many items to fly out.
“Hahaha…” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor guffawed, “Previously, I wasn’t able to keep the corpse. And now, you are committing the same mistake as me too?”
“This is my first time storing a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpse.” Xue Ying felt helpless.
“I have a Chaotic Origin Sack here with me. You can have it.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor passed Xue Ying that queer sack which he previously used to keep the Quiet Icy Mountain corpse.
“Thank you.”
Xue Ying said.
Even though he had many storage treasures, due to his inexperience, he did not really dare say which could withstand the pressure from a a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
Looking at this magical beige sack in his hand, he opened it before activating the vacuum function. “Sou”, an unseen ripple formed around that corpse, sucking it into the sack. Following that, Xue Ying tied the sack.
“Brother Nine-Headed, I shall make my move then.” Xue Ying said.
“I’ll be entering closed-door cultivation too. Congratulations Brother Flying Snow in advance as well for grasping the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said.
Xue Ying left.
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor waited for Xue Ying to leave before shutting his underground palace doors. He was meeting nobody at all and had begun his closed-door cultivation. He was about to begin another attempt at breakthrough to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Reaching his level where he no longer saw any hope in forcing a breakthrough, he had decided to go with an Ultimate Awakening instead. And he understood very deeply how he should go about doing it.
One body that could hold nine different Chaotic Origin Bloodlines while perfectly fusing them together.
His control of bloodlines had already reached an unfathomable stage. The bloodline from the ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’ was one he reckoned as the greatest possibility and most crucial material he had currently towards breaking through to the next level.
******
‘Nine-Headed has gone closed-door cultivation.’
Weather Leaf was also in his underground palace independently meditating.
He had received the news two days ago, and understood that the cultivators that went with City Master Nine-Headed had successfully slaughtered that Quiet Icy Mountain Master.
‘With the help from Monarch Flying Snow, the strength of several thousand protectors have been significantly weakened. Nine-Headed had attempted it several times and even once invited me to help, yet all of them ended in failure. However, this time, he actually had it so easily.’ Weather Leaf sighed inwardly, ‘Nine-Headed… I pray for your success in your Ultimate Awakening.’
If he were to fail…
The next time Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor could have a chance at breaking through would definitely be a very long time later.
After all, this was the closest moment Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor had at succeeding.
…
And just as Xue Ying returned to his cavern-dwelling, he saw Monarch Ardent Creek.
“Monarch Flying Snow.” Monarch Ardent Creek chuckled, “As we agreed previously, we shall comprehend it together for 100 million years.”
“Haha, since I gave my promise, I’ll naturally not go against my words. Furthermore, with Monarch Ardent Creek comprehending it with me, the two of us can bounce ideas off one another. Perhaps I might be able to grasp a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body much faster than expected.” Xue Ying chuckled.
“I am also doing it for cultivation, so pardon my disturbance.” Monarch Ardent Creek said. Even though they had agreed on it, he still felt a bit ashamed.
Because when one cultivated truly, he would do it independently.
“Brother Ardent Creek, I can comprehend it for trillions and trillions of years. However, you only have 100 million years so it is best we make full use of the time to cultivate.” Xue Ying said.
“Yes yes yes.” Monarch Ardent Creek chuckled before entering the cavern-dwelling as well.
On that day itself.
Xue Ying shut his doors off from all visitors. He and Monarch Ardent Creek began studying the corpse of Quiet Icy Mountain Master. The two of them would also occasionally exchange ideas and go about discussing the Dao.

chapters.title: Chapter 1366 - The Fame of Monarch Flying Snow
chapters.content:
Chapter 1366: The Fame of Monarch Flying Snow
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Deep within the Sea of Abyss.
“King, that Quiet Icy Mountain Master was killed by a team of cultivators led by Scarlet Cloud City’s Vice-City Master ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’.” The five Sea of Abyss Attendants lowered their heads respectfully. One of them continued reporting, “The team of cultivators could succeed because they have an incredibly terrifying cultivator who specializes in soul techniques. The moment he cast his technique, it would cover a region spanning half a million kilometers. Every single ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeform that is located within the region will be significantly weakened. Hence, the protectors are unable to protect their King. Eventually, Quiet Icy Mountain Master was killed.”
“Soul technique?” Seated on the seabed, that towering ‘Sea of Abyss Master’ opened his eyes. His cool, dark eyes were filled with some astonishment.
Soul…
The soul was also the root of a living being. Having been imprisoned in the Sacred World for ages, he had never heard of any cultivator who could exhibit such prowess in the soul aspect.
Ultimately, the status of this Sea of Abyss Master was slightly lower. If his status was sufficiently high, he would understand that there had never been a cultivator beneath the level of Chaotic Origin who understood the soul this much.
“His soul technique is so powerful that it could prevent those Grand Perfection God Emperor protectors from protecting Quiet Icy Mountain Master?” Sea of Abyss Master questioned.
“According to my investigation, those with the strength of a Middle Stage God Emperor among us ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms would die indubitably if we enter that soul domain! Some of those with the strength of a Late Stage God Emperor might die, though the remaining few would just be left with 10% to 20% of their strength. As for the Grand Perfection God Emperor protectors, they would usually be left with half their strength!” A Sea of Abyss Attendant respectfully replied.
The Sea of Abyss Master became alarmed.
So formidable!
“What is he called?” Sea of Abyss Master asked.
“I have questioned those Quiet Destruction Wolves yet did not successfully find out what he is called. That cultivator who casted the soul technique has just emerged recently. After that, we went to question many other Chaotic Origin Lifeform tribes along the way before finally getting some response, that those cultivators call this soul technique expert ‘Monarch Flying Snow’.” A Sea of Abyss Attendant said, “This Monarch Flying Snow seems to stay in Scarlet Cloud City and has an extremely high status there.”
‘Monarch Flying Snow?’ Sea of Abyss Master noted that name, ‘When the time comes for me to go out on a patrol, I’ll definitely find a chance to eliminate this Monarch Flying Snow.’
Originally.
Of the cultivators in this Sacred World, the one he desired to kill the most was ‘Weather Leaf’. But now, his priority had changed to Monarch Flying Snow!
Because he had heard of cultivators who reached the ‘Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform’ Level in two Daos before. But for someone to be this terrifying in soul technique was still unprecedented news to him! If such a terrifying expert crosses the final hurdle and becomes a Chaotic Origin Lifeform, a Chaotic Origin Lifeform that specializes in soul technique is simply too frightening! He had to eliminate him first.
‘No rush, no rush.’
‘The next time I go out for a patrol will also be the moment I act.’ The Sea of Abyss Master closed his eyes. And the other five Sea of Abyss Attendants immediately withdrew from the place.
Realm Heart Great Land, Broken Tooth Mountain Range.
Xue Ying was wearing a white robe. He stood alone before a towering mountain on a Floating Sky Island looking up at it.
This mountain was entirely crimson in color. There were various bizarre patterns inscribed on the mountain rocks. Those patterns were filled with endless mysteries.
‘The Thousand-Eyed Existence is a terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeform that could injure even ‘Yuan’. Its corpse has also transformed into many Floating Sky Islands.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Those mysterious eyes are just one part of its body. There are many more exotic grounds on these Floating Sky Islands manifested from the corpse of the Thousand-Eyed Existence. This mountain before me should be formed by fine powder of its bone.’
A pinch of powder became a mountain.
Xue Ying had stood here comprehending the mountain for a very long time. Because this mountain was filled with profound mysteries from the Dao of Void.
‘Even though they are all bits and pieces of it unlike those complete Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses which I have in the Sacred World, this slight bit is outstanding enough.’ Xue Ying thought.
They had their own uses.
The Chaotic Origin Lifeform corpses in the Sacred World could allow him to see various complete void secret techniques manifested. It’s just that those ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms could at most exhibit the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor. Hence, Xue Ying simply felt disdain for some of those manifested secret techniques! They were only useful towards increasing his accumulations in the Dao of Void.
As for the Floating Sky Islands?
Those were too scattered!
The mysterious eyes were conspicuous. In the past when Xue Ying checked out the Floating Sky Islands, he had examined so many of those mysterious eyes, memorised their internal structure before finally succeeding in deducing his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm Killing Technique.
And that eye was the most complete technique he had discovered.
Other body parts of the Thousand-Eyed Existence were filled with even more dispersed profound mysteries just like this mountain before him. It was approximately one-trillionth of a certain terrifying secret technique that the Thousand-Eyed Existence could execute. It was simply too little. If only it could be the manifestation of one-tenth of the secret technique, Xue Ying could still briefly deduce out something. But this was just too scattered and dispersed! He could only take reference to it! It was hard for Xue Ying to deduce the complete secret technique from it.
No matter what, it was still ultimately useful.
Especially now that he had acquired a ‘High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform’ corpse. Even though it was lacking the heart and some blood, the corpse was still complete. Xue Ying could discover many secret techniques that the Quiet Icy Mountain Master had used! After that, by viewing some of the remnants left behind by the ‘Thousand-Eyed Existence’, it would allow him to accumulate greater experience and understanding. It would also be greatly helpful to his research of the Quiet Icy Mountain Master.
“Be careful.”
“This Floating Sky Island contains many dangerous areas. We must not lose our lives due to carelessness.”
There were currently five Cosmos Gods from the Realm Heart Great Land advancing carefully on this Floating Sky Island. They were constantly using their scouting techniques and were gingerly inching forward. At the same time, they were prepared for the appearances of any Destruction Devils.
After traveling for an hour, these five Cosmos Gods finally arrived at their destination. They saw a towering mountain in the distance. At the same time, they felt aghast.
“It’s the ‘Stone Volcano’. The Stone Volcano is the most secretive ground on this Floating Sky Island. It is filled with all sorts of treasures. Why would there not be a single Destruction Devil guarding this place? According to logic, there should be some Destruction Devils patrolling this place.”
“It is really weird.”
“We have increased our vigilance, harboring the thought of bringing one or two treasures back even at the expense of sacrificing these avatars of ours. Who would have guessed that we have reached the Stone Volcano without encountering a single Destruction Devil.”
Even though the five of them were puzzled, they still continued advancing.
Those Cosmos Gods in Realm Heart Great Land who comprehended the avatar technique would usually pay Broken Tooth Mountain Range a visit frequently just to gamble on their luck. In the worst case scenario, they would merely lose their avatars.
“Mn?”
As the five of them got closer, they discovered a white-robed young man standing at the foot of the Stone Volcano.
The white-robed young man was currently looking at that towering mountain with a calm look.
“Monarch Flying Snow.” The five of them were greatly startled.
Xue Ying turned over.
“Greetings Monarch Flying Snow.” The five Cosmos Gods respectfully bowed.
Xue Ying could recognize them with a single glance, that they were Cosmos Gods from Realm Heart Great Land. He nodded: “There are no longer any Destruction Devils around the Stone Volcano. The few of you can take any treasures you want. But when you leave, you should be a little more careful.”
“Many thanks Monarch Flying Snow!” The five of them trembled with fear.
Though they were delighted in their hearts.
“So it seems Monarch Flying Snow is here! No wonder there are no Destruction Devils at all!”
“How would those Destruction Devils dare to show up? Hearsay even the Supremes amongst the Destruction Devils were defeated by Monarch Flying Snow.” These five Cosmos Gods transmitted between one another. They were clearly in jubilation.
At that time.
Xue Ying pursued after Undying Underworld Emperor by himself. Even when Undying Underworld Emperor escaped into the Chaotic Origin Dimension, Xue Ying continued pursuing after him before finally slaughtering Undying Underworld Emperor.
That battle had established Xue Ying’s status as the ‘strongest cultivator in Realm Heart Great Land’.
Nonetheless…
Xue Ying became more dazzling over time in the Broken Tooth Mountain Range as well. Hearsay he battled countless times with the Supremes, and the Supremes were all defeated in the hands of Monarch Flying Snow! Currently, Monarch Flying Snow was unquestionably the strongest expert in Realm Heart Great Land and Broken Tooth Mountain Range. Not just Broken Tooth Mountain Range or Realm Heart Great Land, everyone respected Monarch Flying Snow a lot.
He came to the Floating Sky Island? All Destruction Devils on this Floating Sky Island retreated. None of them dared to disturb him at all.
“Truly terrifying. The current Monarch Flying Snow could easily defeat the five Great Supremes from the Broken Tooth Mountain Range. Didn’t they say that the five Great Supremes are closest to becoming Chaotic Origin Lifeforms? Doesn’t this mean that Monarch Flying Snow is going to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform soon?”
“Who knows! Regardless, the strength of Monarch Flying Snow is way stronger than the past when he defeated Undying Underworld Emperor. My teacher has once said that the strength of Monarch Flying Snow has reached an unfathomable level. He might even be able to break through to the Chaotic Origin Level anytime.”
These five Cosmos Gods were discussing between one another quietly.
Monarch Flying Snow had already become a legend on the Realm Heart Great Land. Even in the eyes of Cosmos Gods, he was simply a terrifying existence.
…
As for Xue Ying, he continued his observation of every single pattern on the Stone Volcano before him and continued pondering over it.
Suddenly, he flinched.
His avatar in the Sacred World, avatars in his hometown Origin World, and avatars in the Realm Heart Great Land. These avatars were all linked in memory! At this moment, their comprehensions were clashing when all of a sudden—
An entirely new Chaotic Origin Refinement Cultivation Technique floated in his mind. Even though he had deduced many different versions prior to this, this time, Xue Ying had a feeling of delight.
Perhaps he had succeeded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1367 - Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 1367: Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
The cultivation technique that he comprehended this time gave him a feeling of perfection.
Xue Ying lightly breathed in. He looked forward to the next step.
‘Breakthrough!’
With a thought, he easily controlled his fleshy body, allowing it to transform. His fleshy body that was at the Late Stage God Emperor level began evolving at this moment according to the latest Chaotic Origin Refinement Body Technique that he designed. Looking at his body, it did not seem to have any drastic changes. His skin trembled lightly, and it seemed like the body composition had been restructured. There was even a layer of luster covering his body, making it seem as if it was the most perfect treasure.
And beneath his skin… the internal structure of the body was undergoing an intense transformation.
This was directed down to its most minute component. Countless inscriptions spread across every minute particles. Xue Ying’s body was currently metamorphosing. His bones, his muscles, his organs, his bloodline, his blood, eyes, and other parts were all transforming. This transformation was perfect. Everything seemed to flow in the right direction, giving rise to an absolutely stunning piece of art.
“Weng.” The world membrane directly shattered, causing Chaotic Origin Energy to surge in. It continually poured into the body of Xue Ying.
This time, the transformation happened really quickly. It took merely ten breaths of time.
And everything went back to normal after that.
‘I’ve broken through.’ Xue Ying grinned. He did not create a huge disturbance. It was due to his huge accumulation that finally pushed him past the tipping point.
Both his inner and outer body were transparent to Xue Ying. Xue Ying could sense how perfect his current body composition was. Xue Ying could not even think of what he should do to have another further improvement to it.
This was already a body that had reached the pinnacle of perfection.
‘I finally understood what many cultivators in the Sacred World are all stuck at the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body Level. Not just the Bloodline Cultivators or the Dao Cultivators, it is tough for any of them to reach the next level.’ Xue Ying shook his head. Bloodline Cultivators could still follow by their bloodline and undergo an Ultimate Awakening! But Dao Cultivators had to rely on themselves.
‘I already felt that it has reached perfection.’
‘And that there are no longer any paths for me to continue.’ Xue Ying had this feeling.
Even though he knew there was a higher level, becoming a ‘Chaotic Origin Lifeform’, and he knew that a more perfect lifeform body existed…
But under his current knowledge, the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body he had was already at the pinnacle of perfection.
‘According to the legends.’
‘Dao Cultivators have to rely on their strength and break through the limits of Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body, smashing apart the shackles to grasp the ‘Dao’ at the Chaotic Origin Level! They would then immediately become an Overlord, also the highest level existence ever known.’ Xue Ying thought.
Those who chose to spread their religion and gain the belief of other cultivators… and other methods meant to grasp the source of an Origin World would make the cultivator the master of the Origin World! By relying on the source energy of an Origin World to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform, one would become a ‘World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform’. Such existences were powerful and were second only to the Overlord. They could even fight back against Overlords within the Origin Worlds that they controlled.
However, such existences had yet to grasp the ‘Dao’ at the Chaotic Origin Level.
Like those Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms for instance, they focused on digging out the potential of their bloodline energy, allowing them to evolve to the next level. But even as they dug out all the potential they had! Compared to the Overlords that grasped ‘Dao’ of the Chaotic Origin Level, they were still lacking by a bit.
‘Not just the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms or the extremely powerful World Realm Chaotic Origin Experts, all of them can exert endless might, yet none of them has actually grasped the essence of ‘Dao’ at the Chaotic Origin Level.’ Xue Ying sighed.
That level.
Despite reaching that level, they still failed to grasp the essence of ‘Dao’ at the Chaotic Origin Level.
How difficult was it for him?
But the moment he did so!
It would mean breaking through by force! He could break through all shackles and reach the highest level of life.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying took a step before disappearing from the Broken Teeth Mountain Range.
…
He had already left the Origin World, Realm Heart Great Land and came to the endless Chaotic Origin Dimension not too far away.
“Hong~”
Endless ripples could be felt being generated by the enormous Realm Heart Great Land, rushing out against the surrounding Chaotic Origin Energy while forming many waves at the same time. As a result, the concentration of Chaotic Origin Energy near the region of Realm Heart Great Land was very thin. At this moment, Xue Ying was moving out of the Realm Heart Great Land. He could feel the corrosion from the surrounding Chaotic Origin Energy acting on his body, yet it did not do anything to his Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body at all.
“Sou.”
His body traveled through an arc, easily maneuvering within the Chaotic Origin Dimension. His current Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique was executed with greater perfection than before, allowing him to travel to a far distance with great ease.
Soon, he stopped.
‘The Chaotic Origin Energy is much more corrosive here.’ Xue Ying thoroughly experienced it. It was silent and dark. The Chaotic Origin Energy was also much more concentrated here. They were gushing across his body. Nothing he did could stop the Chaotic Origin Energy from affecting both his body and his soul.
At this moment, his Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body was constantly suffering from damage. Even the natural recovery of his body could not reach up to the rate of damage.
His soul was similarly injured.
‘It seems my body can hold on for approximately two hours.’ Xue Ying estimated, ‘And my soul seems to be able to hold on for a very long time? It seems fine even if it stays here for six to ten hours?’
The previous time, his soul was not this strong.
Ever since he fused both his first Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique with his second, forming the third killing technique, his soul had undergone a qualitative transformation. This transformation strengthened his soul’s resistance against the corrosive effects from the Chaotic Origin Energy,
‘I am ultimately not a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. It is not appropriate for me to live here.’ Xue Ying thought. He turned around to look at that enormous Realm Heart Great Land.
The Realm Heart Great Land remained dazzling amidst the dark Chaotic Origin Dimension.
It was surging with energy that pushed back the endless Chaotic Origin Energy that existed here…
As Xue Ying was located too far away, the Realm Heart Great Land seemed slightly smaller.
‘Time to return.’
With a thought, he executed the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique before returning back.
******
At his hometown Primal Chaos Void.
This avatar of Xue Ying had also broken through to the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body Level. At the same time, he came to the Lost World Corridor.
He moved by himself within the Lost World Corridor.
‘Void Domain.’
Xue Ying released his Void Domain.
Now that he had reached the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body Level, his Void Domain had become much more profound. Once it was executed, it easily pushed back the various suppression from the Lost World Corridor, continuously expanding out. However, as it expanded further away, the suppression of the Lost World Corridor on his domain rose exponentially. Ten times, hundred times, thousand times. And very soon, Xue Ying was forced to stop.
‘It seems I cannot cover the entire Lost World Corridor with my domain yet.’ Xue Ying frowned with a shake of his head, ‘The Origin World forms the Lost World Corridor and even protects those Destruction Devils.’
It was impossible for Xue Ying to scout through a huge region.
If he wanted to do so?
He would have to visit those places and investigate region by region. That would require a tremendous amount of time! Sacred Master was ultimately a Final Realm Cosmos God. He could completely conceal his aura and isolate all karmic tracing techniques. If he disguised himself as an ordinary Destruction Devil, Xue Ying could not find out who he was even if the other party stood in front of Xue Ying.
‘If he dares to leave the Lost World Corridor for a massacre, I can make use of that chance to exterminate him. But if he doesn’t plan on leaving the Lost World Corridor, there is nothing I can do temporarily.’ Xue Ying shook his head.
He had never thought of letting Sacred Master off!
He had a huge enmity with the Sacred Master. There were so many living beings that died in the hands of the Sacred Master.
‘I shall let you hide in it forever.’
Xue Ying turned around and left the Lost World Corridor with a step.
And at this moment, Sacred Master who was living in seclusion within the Lost World Corridor, was completely ignorant that Xue Ying had attained a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body. Nonetheless, his plan was to continue hiding here until the Great Apocalypse. He wanted to wait for the next era before executing any plan he had.
…
Sacred World.
Scarlet Cloud City, within Xue Ying’s cavern-dwelling.
Xue Ying was currently seated cross-legged enjoying his wine. At the same time, he was also enjoying the fragrance of the flowers within the garden and the tranquil from the whistling sound of the wind blowing at the leaves.
“Monarch Flying Snow, hearsay you have left closed-door cultivation? Is it because you have succeeded in grasping the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body already?” He received some transmissions.
“I broke through fortuitously.” Xue Ying replied.
“Then what about the matter I mentioned previously? About going to hunt down a Chaotic Origin Prisoner?”
“I have just broken through and do still need some time to experience my newfound power. I am not in a rush to go for another operation either.” Xue Ying transmitted back. He had clearly rejected the other party.
After succeeding in the task of hunting Quiet Icy Mountain Master down.
There were quite a few others who invited him to hunt down Chaotic Origin Prisoners too. But Xue Ying temporarily chose to reject all of them.
‘When can I become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform?’ Xue Ying pondered.
Reaching his current stage.
He was somewhat at a loss.
Force his way? Rely on his comprehension skills to grasp the ‘Dao’ at the Chaotic Origin Level? The difficulty was simply too high!
Even grasping the Origin Source of his hometown Origin world was similarly difficult.
‘Force through to the next level.’
‘Mn, to me, there are two methods I can employ to force a breakthrough.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘The first way is to shatter apart all body restraints and directly raise my Dao of Void to the next level, allowing me to officially reach the Chaotic Origin Level. That way, my body would similarly reach the next level too.’
‘The other method is to rely on my soul.’ Xue Ying pondered.
He had a feeling that both his soul and body would complement one another.
This was a logic everyone understood.
Even the Final Realm ‘Old Monster Stone’ was also improving his understanding of the soul. ‘Ancestor Fan’ from the Summer Wind Ancient Nation and many other cultivators were also spending plenty of effort on the soul aspect.
Previously, Xue Ying had once perfected his fleshy body further using his strengthened soul.
And now that he had reached the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body Level, his soul was temporarily insufficient in powering his body. But what if he had some improvements in his soul, reaching the final realm?
‘The soul could aid in my fleshy body. But I wonder if I could rely on this to reach the Chaotic Origin Level? That is hard to say. This is ultimately just my conjecture.’ Xue Ying thought. He had never heard of any legend spoken where one broke through in one fell swoop by relying on the complementary effects of both the soul and the fleshy body.
But many experts had felt that this was the accurate path.
Xue Ying similarly thought so too.
‘This path of forcing my Dao of Void to a higher level is done by many other experts.’ Xue Ying thought.
That Luo City Lord for instance had done that!
But Luo City Lord did not walk down the path of Dao of Void.
‘Even though there have been cases of experts breaking through to the next level by force, becoming Overlords! This is simply an arduous path to take.’
‘The other path which is to fuse both my soul and fleshy body, is something I have at least not heard of anyone achieving so. But I have lay down a solid foundation and am just a slight bit away from reaching the final realm in my Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm.’ Xue Ying nodded inwardly. He made his decision. In the following days, he would spend most of his concentration on comprehending the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm so that he could reach the final realm in the shortest period.
As for breaking through to the next level in his Dao of Void? That was destined to be a very long journey ahead.

chapters.title: Chapter 1368 - Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor Becoming a Chaotic Origin
chapters.content:
Chapter 1368: Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor Becoming a Chaotic Origin
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
60 million years later after Xue Ying refined his Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body.
On this day itself.
Xue Ying was seated in the garden of his cavern-dwelling. Ever since he had comprehended the third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm killing technique, he was just one slight bit away from reaching the final realm in his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm.
‘Even though I have gotten the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet from North River, in reality, the assistance that Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet has to me is negligible.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘My current Dao of Mirage is very close to reaching the final realm now. What I need is a spark of inspiration and enlightenment.’
“Mn?”
Xue Ying suddenly had a feeling. He looked over in a particular direction.
“Hong long long~”
The cloud layer in the sky descended rapidly. Everything became dark. It was originally a bright sunny day when the entire world became pitch black. And this happened within a single breath.
Dark clouds covered the entire Sacred World and a terrifying energy was accumulating right ahead of him. This power was so strong it even changed the expression of Xue Ying: ‘What is happening?’
‘This power?’
‘What exactly happened?’
This disturbance was too great.
Other than a few in Scarlet Cloud City who were shut close from anything happening in the external world, the majority immediately came out and looked up at the sky. Looking at how powerful the energy was gathering amidst the dark clouds, all of them immediately felt terror. They could sense that this accumulated energy would most likely turn them into powder in an instance. This was a terrifying energy that they could not resist at all.
“Fellow cultivators, do you know what has exactly happened?”
“The sky over our Sky Noon City is filled with rolling dark clouds. The energy accumulated is simply too terrifying. Those dark clouds… seem to have covered the entire sky and we can’t see the end.”
“It is the same for our Scarlet Cloud City! The entire sky is filled with dark clouds.”
“Similar here at Ice Star City…”
Some of the apex cultivators in the five assembly grounds conversed with one another. They were able to determine soon that those dark clouds that were filled with a frightening energy should have covered the entire Sacred World.
…
Xue Ying flew up to the sky and looked at it.
There were more than a thousand figures who flew up into the sky within Scarlet Cloud City too. They were all looking at the dark clouds that gathered high in the sky, and were puzzled and filled with reverence too.
“Hua hua hua~” Suddenly, a faint golden light appeared deep in the dark clouds high in the sky. The golden light was moving. It was so resplendent as it shot down and illuminated the world. This golden light gradually turned into an enormous maelstrom. At the outer perimeter of this maelstrom was the moving dark clouds. It was so big that it affected the whole world.
“There seems to be a golden light maelstrom forming in the sky above our Scarlet Cloud City! Those dark clouds are revolving around it.”
“Our Sky Noon City does not have such a phenomenon.”
“Neither does our Rising Light City.”
As they conversed.
They soon discovered startingly that this golden light maelstrom had appeared only above Scarlet Cloud City,
“Hua!”
Closely following that.
Waves and waves of energy began shooting down from the golden light maelstrom right into one of the cavern-dwelling within Scarlet Cloud City. This energy did not seem to damage any structure at all. Instead, it went deep into the cavern-dwelling.
‘That seems to be Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s cavern-dwelling?’ Xue Ying turned over and could discern it with a single glance. He then revealed a look of astonishment, ‘Such a huge disturbance with such frightening might… And it appears the energy is entering his cavern-dwelling. Unless… he has succeeded?’
“Sou.” Xue Ying immediately took a step and traveled through the void. He soon arrived at the entrance outside Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s cavern-dwelling.
Many cultivators were also rushing over to Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s cavern-dwelling. Scarlet Cloud City was only spanning across several hundred thousand kilometers in total. Given the speed of cultivators, they were able to reach in a short period, and had gathered outside the cavern-dwelling now.
“City Master Nine-Headed has previously gone into closed-door cultivation to fight for the chance of breaking through to the Chaotic Origin Level. Has he succeeded?” Standing by the side of Xue Ying, Monarch Ardent Creek could not help but ask. Monarch Ardent Creek’s eyes were filled with surprise and envy.
“City Master Nine-Headed originally doesn’t have any Chaotic Origin Bloodline. He has cultivated to where he is step by step as a weak little mortal.” Xue Ying looked ahead at the cavern-dwelling, and at the terrifying energy descending into the cavern-dwelling. He continued, “He is able to pick and fuse other Chaotic Origin Bloodlines into his body. Even though those are external bloodlines, it remains a fact that every bloodline could enable him to exert the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor. Furthermore, he could even fuse all nine types of bloodlines together perfectly. Hence, his accumulations and experience on digging the potential of bloodline… is unquestionable the best across the entire Sacred World.”
Witchcraft was also a Dao path. And Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was the strongest expert to take this path.
“Given his current accumulations, since he has determined that the heart and blood of Quiet Icy Mountain Master is what he required to breakthrough. Furthermore, he has also disregarded the price and organized several teams of cultivators to deal with that Quiet Icy Mountain Master before. This desire to do it likely shows how certain he is.” Xue Ying continued, “And now that such a huge disturbance has been created, it should be likely the case that he has broken through to the Chaotic Origin Level.”
“Right.”
The silver-white giant ‘Wu Xiao’ walked over and nodded, “This disturbance is indeed formed by a cultivator undergoing Ultimate Awakening into the Chaotic Origin Level. He is currently undergoing a complete life metamorphosis, transforming into that of a higher level being—a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.”
“Life metamorphosis?” Xue Ying looked towards Wu Xiao. He understood that Vice-City Master Wu Xiao was the strongest and most powerful descendant of a powerful Chaotic Origin Expert. Hence, he should know more about the secrets pertaining to Chaotic Origin.
“It’s just that I am very curious about something.” Wu Xiao looked at the cavern-dwelling ahead, chuckling out, “The Ultimate Awakening which I understood in the past is usually activated by the Chaotic Origin Bloodline the cultivator already had innately before returning back to his roots as an ancestor, turning into an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform. As for Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s ‘Witchcraft’ cultivation system, it primarily focuses on gathering external bloodlines before fusing them into his body. Strictly speaking, including the nine bloodlines he had previously in his body, he would have ten different bloodlines after adding Quiet Icy Mountain Master! He had dug out the potential of the first nine bloodlines to the Grand Perfection God Emperor stage. As for the final bloodline, it belongs to a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform… all of those ten bloodlines in his body are very strong. I wonder how he would be after he undergoes an Ultimate Awakening?”
Xue Ying was startled. He laughed: “I doubt there has never been an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform with ten types of bloodlines.”
“That’s right. This is a special mixed bloodline that he created personally.” Wu Xiao continued watching.
“No matter what, it seems he has succeeded.” Weather Leaf walked over too. Looking at the cavern-dwelling, he said, “As long as he succeeded in becoming a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform, giving the talent of Brother Nine-Headed, it should be possible for him to become a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform one day.”
Wu Xiao nodded in agreement: “Collecting ten types of bloodlines and still succeeding in awakening them? This is absolutely unprecedented. It is indeed highly probable for him to reach the next grade as a ‘World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform’ one day.”
As the cultivators in the cavern-dwelling discussed over the matter, Weather Leaf, Xue Ying, Wu Xiao, North River, Xie Fan, Great Emperor Heaven Calamity… even though some of them were aloof, some were evil, and some were extremists, at this moment, they felt complex as they watched a fellow cultivator become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
Because this had been what they desired and had been pursuing all along.
Suddenly——
A faint illusory figure shot up into the sky from deep within Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s cavern-dwelling. It shot up beyond the cloud layer. The golden light maelstrom and the dark cloud layer which were originally spinning rapidly began dissipating.
This dimmed illusory figure flew up into the sky before revealing his true body.
It was a huge serpent. This serpent was quite special because it had a total of nine heads, and four claws on its meandering body. Its body was slightly translucent and entirely black in color.
It was simply too big.
It was so big that it had covered the entire sky. Its size was bigger by more than 10,000 to 100,000 times that of Scarlet Cloud City. Xue Ying and the other cultivators could barely see nine snakeheads. Furthermore, as they were located very far away, they could not even see all nine heads clearly! That snake tail even extended beyond the horizons. Nobody in the Scarlet Cloud City could see it clearly with their naked eyes.
At this moment, it began concealing some of its might. Even though a faint aura was still pervading in the atmosphere, it was enough to make the cultivators in Scarlet Cloud City acknowledge allegiance to him.
“You——”
The nine snakeheads let out a ringing screech. Its screech was high in pitch and filled with immense joy.
‘So this is a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform? A High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform that isn’t suppressed?’ Xue Ying was inwardly startled. Those Chaotic Origin Prisoners were restricted severely. That was how they could fight them on equal grounds. If those were High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms such as the one standing before them that could exhibit their complete strength, they would have wiped the cultivators out in one breath.
‘Chaotic Origin.’ Weather Leaf looked up. His eyes were shining in glimmering light.
‘Chaotic Origin? It seems he is stronger than most High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform.’ Wu Xiao felt astonished. He had seen quite a few High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms before. But it was still the first time for him to see a new lifeform give off such intense aura. Indeed, after Nine-Headed broke through using ten different bloodlines, it was extraordinary. And it seems to be unprecedented, at least in my experience.’
A huge serpent with nine heads and four serpents?
That was a lifeform he had never seen before!
There was not an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform tribe with this appearance. It seemed Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor had created an entirely new tribe.
“Sou.”
The nine-headed four-clawed serpent abruptly turned into a faint light and descended onto the Scarlet Cloud City. It directly fell onto his cavern-dwelling, turning back into a handsome bald young man. He was none other than Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor.
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor chuckled and swept his gaze across the surrounding cultivators: “I have fortuitously broke through after my closed-door cultivation, finally jumping out of the cage becoming a Chaotic Origin! I am filled with endless joy and gratitude for all my fellow cultivators.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1369 - Oneself as a World
chapters.content:
Chapter 1369: Oneself as a World
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
“Congratulations Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor in your breakthrough to Chaotic Origin.”
“The rest of us have cultivated for trillions and trillions of years. We have always been seeking to break out of the cage and advance to a higher level of life. We even desired to have a look and experience a whole new world, journeying to this Sacred World for a fight. It’s just that this journey is simply arduous. Many comrades have failed. Today, seeing Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform has given us a new ray of hope.”
The cultivators present spoke one after another. They were feeling complex.
Even though they were Dao Brothers in the past, everyone understood that the Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was no longer the same!
“It is because of everybody’s help that I have this day.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor swept his gaze across, stopping slightly longer on Xue Ying, “If not for the collective effort by everyone, it is impossible for us to kill that Quiet Icy Mountain Master. I have once said that if I could break through to the Chaotic Origin Level, I’ll definitely not treat everyone unfairly. All my accumulations over the long years in Sacred World have lost their use to me. I shall be bestowing them to everyone here.”
Saying that, he began sending storage treasures over to the crowd of cultivators. They had been members of the team of cultivators that once participated in the hunt for Quiet Icy Mountain Master.
Xue Ying also received one of them. Examining the storage treasure, he saw some special materials in it. There was even a scripture. Xue Ying sent a strand of consciousness onto the book before revealing a look of astonishment——”Brother Flying Snow, I have recorded everything that I know of regarding the void when I was undergoing the process of breakthrough fusing the Quiet Icy Mountain Master’s bloodline and my nine other bloodlines. I hope that it is of use to you.”
…
The cultivators that once participated in the hunt checked through the gifts left behind by Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor. Quite a few revealed looks of joy.
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was ultimately someone that researched into ten different bloodlines. He had once researched deeply into other forsaken bloodlines too. Hence, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor had a deep understanding on the topic of bloodlines! Those Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms might not even know more about bloodlines than this ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’. He had single-handedly created a whole new tribe, and that was an entirely new bloodline formed from the fusion of ten different bloodlines.
He was indeed a genius.
A mortal could grow all the way until he became a Chaotic Origin Lifeform! That was simply amazing.
Prior to Xue Ying’s arrival, the most dazzling cultivator in the Sacred World was Weather Leaf! ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’ did not receive much attention from other Chaotic Origin Experts simply because he had fused nine types of bloodlines before, and other Chaotic Origin Experts felt that it was not too possible for him to pave his own Dao path! But now, he has created an entirely new Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform tribe. His degree of brightness… had far surpassed the current Xue Ying.
After all, Xue Ying’s Dao of Soul might be terrifying yet he had not reached the Chaotic Origin Level!
In the eyes of many Chaotic Origin Experts, it was highly possible for Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor to advance into a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Perhaps he might even reach a higher level.
At this moment.
He was giving out some scriptures filled with his understanding and comprehension of the Dao, bringing joy to many cultivators.
“Many thanks Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor.”
“Thank you Brother Nine-Headed.”
All of them thanked him. They were filled with gratitude.
“I am merely giving everyone a little helping hand. Ultimately, it still depends on you to breakthrough to the Chaotic Origin Level.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said.
Wu Xiao nodded. Even with his background and origins, he was still stuck at this stage prior to advancing to the Chaotic Origin Level.
“Fellow cultivators, I cannot stay in this world for too long. In a while when the emissary is here, I’ll have to leave.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor looked at his surroundings, “I have once been fighting like everyone here in the Sacred World towards becoming a Chaotic Origin. And now, if there is anything you all want to ask me, you may. I’ll try my best to answer them.”
The present cultivators became excited when they heard that.
“Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor, are there anything you can point us to on the Ultimate Awakening of the bloodline? How can we succeed?” There were cultivators asking that at the next instance. Everyone became quiet. After all, a majority of cultivators in Scarlet Cloud City had a Chaotic Origin Bloodline! Dao Cultivators were still the minority.
“Succeed in awakening?” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor hesitated momentarily before saying, “It is impossible for me to guide you on how to breakthrough to the Chaotic Origin Level. If you want me to give some tips… then I can give you a very simple one——continue accumulating! Like me, I have researched many Chaotic Origin Bloodlines, allowing me to thicken my accumulations and experiences. Furthermore, I have even researched the bloodline of a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform. With sufficient accumulations, I was able to discern the path ahead. Most of you are born with a Chaotic Origin Bloodline. However, there are differing strengths, like some who could exert the strength of a Grand Perfection God Emperor and some the strength of an apex expert. The huge difference here lies in how much experience you have accumulated.”
“Once you reached the sufficient level of accumulation, perhaps there might be a day when you broke through.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor chuckled.
Those present nodded.
Accumulate more knowledge and experiences…
Saying it was simple, yet this was a logic that applied to many!
“Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor.” Xie Fan asked, “Are there any differences between a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform and us with a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body? We have killed too many ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms in the Sacred World, yet we do not find how special those ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms are.”
“That’s right, Brother Nine-Headed, what exactly are the differences?”
“Do share with us.”
Many cultivators began pursuing this question. Curiosity had caught their attention.
Xue Ying was also listening attentively.
“Don’t treat those ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms as Chaotic Origin Experts.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor shook his head, “You all should know that only from the level of a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform… could one be qualified as a Chaotic Origin Expert! That’s because this is a qualitative transformation. Those ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms are ants amongst the ‘Chaotic Origin Lifeforms’! I can kill a trillion with just a wave of my hand, trampling countless with just a single step. They are simply too weak. It is only because of their fortune that they were born as Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. But most of them are unable to dig out much strength from their bloodlines. If they could, they would be able to evolve their bloodlines and become qualified to reach the High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform Level.”
“To those ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, evolving their bloodline once meant becoming a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform. That is reaching heaven with a single step.”
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor scanned across those that were present, “As for the differences between you all with a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body and High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms…”
“Mn.”
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor muttered to himself irresolutely.
Those present were still paying attention to everything he said.
“Cultivators are born and nurtured by a world.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said, “Some are given birth within Origin Worlds while others came to being in other places.”
Everyone nodded.
The transformation of a world brought about the myriad existences and life. They were just one of the many that had been given life.
“Cultivators originated from the source of a world. They are nurtured by it.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said, “And the strength of cultivators come from the source of a world.”
The strength of cultivators originated from the source of a world?
Reaching the level of Xue Ying, they understood this point. For instance, the ‘avatar technique’ could allow one to refine several avatars. And all of them could maintain their peak strength, allowing a cultivator to become much stronger in an overall level. However, if one was born in a world like the ‘Lightning World’, it was impossible for him to cultivate in an avatar technique.
Growth…
Comprehending the laws…
Everything came from the source of a world.
“Cultivators can continuously absorb the energy in a world.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor continued, “This energy is the energy provided by the world to us.”
“And if we become a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform.”
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor lightly said, “That feeling is no longer the same. It’s just like I am a world myself. I am a miniature Origin World. Even though my energy could hardly be compared to the thick foundation of a huge Origin World, I am on an equal level in terms of life with an Origin World!”
“You are a world yourself?” Xue Ying and other cultivators began having thoughts when they heard that.
“Just like the avatar technique, before reaching the Chaotic Origin Level, it is possible to borrow the source of a world to form many different avatars. Each avatar could maintain a peak strength. Another avatar? That would mean twice the strength of what you could exhibit. But how did it come about? That is formed with the assistance of the laws of the world.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said, “And now, if I want to employ an avatar technique, that would mean cutting myself into two.”
“I am a single entity! I am a world!”
“If I were to split into two avatars of equal strength, then my strength would be split into two.”
“Every new additional avatar would mean more energy being divided out.”
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor looked at the present cultivators, “Do you understand that now? As a cultivator, you could still rely on a world. But High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms have to rely on themselves! Of course, our level of life is no longer the same. For instance, in my eyes, looking at this Sacred World is akin to looking at another Chaotic Origin Lifeform. I can easily see its surface and the myriad existences in the entire Sacred World. I can ‘see’ all the Chaotic Origin Prisoners hidden in this world.”
“You can see all of them?”
Xue Ying and the others also knew of several cultivation techniques like the ‘Destruction Realm Teleportation Scouting Technique’. That actually comprised of a viewpoint from a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
And when a true High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform looked at a world, it would be akin to seeing a huge piece of art. Everything was clearly drawn on the piece of art.
…
They chatted for two hours or so. Furthermore, when the cultivators from the other four cities found out that ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’ had broken through to the Chaotic Origin Level, they were similarly excited and were asking him questions via communication treasures.
Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor could only answer part of them.
Because he had only become a Chaotic origin Lifeform recently!
Instead, most of them were discussing cultivation.
“They are here.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor looked upwards.
One could see a red-nosed old man appearing above Scarlet Cloud City from the flash of a light.
This red-nosed old man had a wine gourd hanging by his waist. As he stepped on the void, he came down, sweeping his gaze across the other cultivators. That decelerated the thinking and consciousness of those cultivators, they could not hear any sound at all.
“Nine-Headed.” The red-nosed old man came to the side of Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor. The surrounding cultivators could only see them but not hear anything.
“I am the patrolman for the seventh region under His Majesty Overlord, ‘Scarlet Peak Daoist’.” The red-nosed old man chuckled, “You can fuse ten bloodlines into your body, fusing them into an entirely new bloodline and becoming the ancestor of a whole new Chaotic Origin Lifeform race. Currently, this matter has been made known to many Chaotic Origin Experts, bringing about a great deal of admiration for you. Your understanding towards bloodlines has been affirmed to be profound. It is highly possible for you to break through to the World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform in the future.”
“I have recently broken through and am still quite far away from reaching the World Realm.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor replied.
“Our Overlord is also the very final one to break through out of all eight Overlords. However, he is tyrannically strong and has the might to rule across countless territories. Our Overlord has a favorable impression of you currently. Let me bring you over to meet him.” The red-nosed old man said.
“I’ll have to trouble you, patrolman.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor said.
“It is fine to call me Scarlet Peak.” The red-nosed old man said. Given his identity as a patrolman, he would usually feel disdain for most High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. However, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was unlike others. He had an incredible amount of potential. That was why he treated the other party so politely.
“Brother Scarlet Peak.” Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor remained quite humble.
“Go go go!” The red-nosed old man waved his hand before bringing Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor away. In a flash, they left this Sacred World.
…
When the red-nosed old man and Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor left, only then did Xue Ying and the other cultivators regain their sense of hearing. Their sluggish consciousness also became normal.
They looked up towards the direction where the red-nosed old man and Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor left.
Everyone understood that Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor was currently leaving for a whole new world that was much bigger and wider. That was also the world for Chaotic Origin Experts.

chapters.title: Chapter 1370 - Secret Techniques
chapters.content:
Chapter 1370: Secret Techniques
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
‘At least I have finally seen someone jump out of the cage to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.’ Amidst the crowd of people, Xue Ying’s current mood was vibrant.
In his hometown Origin World, in Realm Heart Great Land, at the Lightning World, and even after coming to this Sacred World… over the long years, he had never seen someone personally becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform! The difficulty of becoming a ‘Chaotic Origin Lifeform’ had somehow created an unseen pressure on Xue Ying. But now that he saw someone whom he once fought side by side, and even asked him for help, ‘Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’ succeeded! He reached the Chaotic Origin Level!
Excitement, envy, fighting spirit.
His current mood was stimulated!
‘Becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. One could achieve an Ultimate Awakening even via external bloodlines. I don’t believe I can’t succeed.’ Great Emperor North River was similarly filled with fighting spirit. He immediately turned around and headed back to his cavern-dwelling.
‘I just have to reach the level of strength Brother Nine-Headed once was, and it should be possible for me to succeed in an Ultimate Awakening.’ Amidst the group of apex cultivators, several Bloodline Cultivators had similarly seen their ‘target’. Before this, they did not find themselves to be much weaker than City Master Nine-Headed. They could reach his strength after improving by a few percentage points. Even though it was tough, they saw a ray of hope.
‘Brother Nine-Headed has undergone an Ultimate Awakening by using the bloodline of Quiet Icy Mountain Master as the catalyst to fuse his other nine bloodlines. He even created an entirely new Chaotic Origin Tribe.’ Weather Leaf’s eyes were similarly emitting a dazzling light, ‘Since he could pave a new path, I, Weather Leaf, believe that I can similarly break through by force on day!’
‘He, Nine-Headed, has reached where he is step by step from a mortal. He did not have any Chaotic Origin Bloodlines. Instead, he took the initiative to fuse other Chaotic Origin Bloodlines into his body. With ten bloodlines, he finally underwent an Ultimate Awakening. I am the strongest descendant left behind by my ancestor. I have been greatly nurtured yet I merely have a single Chaotic Origin Bloodline. The standard of the cultivation resources I have is way better than Nine-Headed, so I don’t believe I can’t awaken!’ Wu Xiao similarly turned around and left by himself.
For a moment.
The crowd of cultivators began comparing themselves with ‘City Master Nine-Headed’. They felt that their ‘goal’ was in sight! All of them were filled with an unprecedented intense fighting spirit.
Over the long years, many of the cultivators had lost hope. They lost courage and confidence of whether they could become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform! After all, they had seen far too many geniuses that were more heaven-defying than they failed to break through. That just gnawed away their confidence. But now, seeing that one had succeeded, they were no longer the same mentally.
…
In the following days.
Not just in Scarlet Cloud City, the cultivators in the other four assembly grounds were similarly excited.
“Monarch Flying Snow, I am planning to organize a team to kill the Chaotic Origin Prisoner ‘Transient Light River Master’. I am sincerely asking you to join my team! With you around, our chance of success would be more than ten times greater. If you have any condition, you can just tell me. It is incredibly important to me for my Ultimate Awakening, so I hope Monarch Flying Snow could lend a helping hand. If I were to reach the Chaotic Origin Level, I promise I’ll definitely repay Monarch Flying Snow for your effort.”
“I am temporarily not planning to visit other assembly grounds if there is no special reason.” Xue Ying replied.
“We can pick you up.”
“There’s no need.”
“But I urgently require this Chaotic Origin Prisoner Bloodline for my Ultimate Awakening.”
Xue Ying simply ignored the other party.
He had no choice.
There were simply too many cultivators asking him for his help to hunt down the Chaotic Origin Prisoners! The success of City Master Nine-Headed had motivated many other Bloodline Cultivators to feel that——the bloodline of a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform that was similar to their bloodlines should have a significant help to their Ultimate Awakenings.
…
Everything in the world was about fairness.
Xue Ying simply would not care about those who shouted ‘that is essential for my breakthrough to the Chaotic Origin Level’, or ‘I promise I’ll repay you for your effort’. Because many cultivators desired to obtain the corpse of a Chaotic Origin Prisoner. Even if they were Dao Cultivators, they could use it for comprehension and cultivation!
Nonetheless, if the conditions were sufficiently alluring, Xue Ying would still be willing to lend a helping hand.
In the following 50 trillion years or sol.l
He had consecutively accepted six invitations. Three of them came from other assembly grounds! These six times were all targeted at Chaotic Origin Prisoners.
Of the six operations, they succeeded twice!
It seemed the fall of Quiet Icy Mountain Master had somehow made other Chaotic Origin Prisoners across the Sacred World restless. After all, there were few Chaotic Origin Prisoners in total—just tens of them! When one fell, the others were alarmed. They all sought ways to find out what exactly happened. And the result was they discovered ‘Monarch Flying Snow’s terrifying soul technique. Those Chaotic Origin Prisoners that were within the neighboring region had become much more vigilant. Out of the six operations, four ended in failures. The Chaotic Origin Prisoners had fled to a location close to their territories, allowing them to regain sufficient strength that prevented the cultivator team from killing them. Hence, the cultivators were forced to give up.
But no matter what.
Adding up Quiet Icy Mountain Master, they had killed three Chaotic Origin Prisoners in total! This success rate was abnormally high. Hence, there were still many cultivators asking Xue Ying for help.
******
Scarlet Cloud City, within the cavern-dwelling.
Xue Ying was in his own underground palace. His body was vaguely translucent. At this moment, a water layer had covered his body. This body protection… was in actuality made up of many small water droplets. Those water droplets were constantly moving and were protecting every part of his body perfectly. If one magnified the layer of water, this water droplet was in reality, a ‘spatial pocket’ that was constantly moving.
“Xiu.”
Xue Ying moved. He easily arced through the sky.
“Si la——”
When the layer of water droplets covering his body moved, they were like sharp edges that could cut through all objects! Xue Ying’s speed of explosiveness over the short distance was simply terrifying. It was more than twice as fast as when he used the Void Devil Insect Body Technique in the past.
“Hu”, Xue Ying stopped at the other end of the underground palace.
“Xiu xiu xiu…”
He was constantly moving within the underground palace. From one end to the other end. The layer of water droplets covering his body easily cut through everything.
‘My speed has become much faster.’ Xue Ying stopped. He revealed a joyous look, ‘In terms of speed, I should be ranked around tenth in Scarlet Cloud City.’
In Scarlet Cloud City, there were some cultivators with a bloodline that made them exceptionally fast! They were even much faster than Weather Leaf and Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor in the past.
Xue Ying’s current speed was terrifying enough for he could rank around tenth in Scarlet Cloud City, a place filled with experts.
‘This was the technique that Quiet Icy Mountain Master relied on before he died.’ Xue Ying nodded, ‘I have been researching his corpse for such a long time before I succeeded in deducing this secret technique out.’
It was just like how he once deduced the First Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm Killing Technique in the past after memorising the structures of those mysterious eyes that originated from the Thousand-Eyed Existence.
Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms could dig out the potential of their bloodline. They would gradually become stronger and bigger over time. Their bodies would even transform, causing more laws and profound mysteries to be manifested! Some ‘secret techniques’ that they learned through their bloodlines could be observed by others based on certain body structures. Because they were ultimately unlike Dao Cultivators who focused on grasping the the laws and profound mysteries. Instead, they grew stronger by digging the potential of their bloodlines.
Hence, even though they could execute certain secret techniques, they did not understand their essence. The secret techniques they executed were learned through their bloodlines.
When Xue Ying and other cultivators carried out their research on the internal structures of the corpse, they would then create similar secret techniques that were simplified versions according to the laws and profound mysteries they observed.
Secret techniques…
Actually, most secret techniques were created during the process of growth and accumulation.
Xue Ying created the Third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm Killing Technique which eventually resulted in a transformation on his soul.
‘At least I succeeded in re-creating this ‘Water Droplet Technique’. I shall next study and deduce out the ‘Void Congealing Technique’.’ Xue Ying went back to his research. The body of Quiet Icy Mountain Master had manifested in various profound mysteries on its body structure and many hidden secret techniques. In Xue Ying’s opinion, the most terrifying one was the ‘Water Droplet Technique’ and the ‘Void Congealing Technique’.
The Water Droplet Technique could be used to protect his body, boosting his survival capabilities! At the same time, it could also boost his flying speed significantly.
Xue Ying would naturally try his best to deduce this secret technique out.
As for the other ‘Void Congealing Technique’, in the past, it was used to remove all sound from Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor’s hearing senses. It even caused him to feel cold and his thinking to slow by a step! This technique was comparatively more mysterious. Quiet Icy Mountain Master was able to use it once, yet he could no longer use it anymore for a period.
Hence, it was evident that using this technique was quite taxing on the suppressed and restricted Quiet Icy Mountain Master.
The difficulty of grasping it would naturally be higher.
‘Congealing the void?’ Xue Ying became immersed in it.
…
In the entire Sacred World, the cultivators across all five assembly grounds were passionately cultivating. All of them wished to be the second Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor in breaking through to the Chaotic Origin Level.
Deep under the Sea of Abyss.
There was a towering figure which was seated cross-legged on the seabed. He was so big that when he extended his hands, he could easily cover the entire Sea of Abyss. The Sea of Abyss was even too small to be used as a bath tube for him.
“Weng weng weng~” The shackles on his body suddenly shone brightly in gold light. Many golden inscriptions began lighting up on those shackles. Some of those shackles which looked him down on the seabed began loosening too. They started floating and giving off waves of bright light.
“Hmph.”
A low growl of agonizing pain.
The Sea of Abyss Master abruptly opened his eyes. They were filled with coldness.
‘Is it finally time for me to go for a patrol?’ The eyes of the Sea of Abyss Master were filled with a strand of excitement that could hardly be suppressed.
Being the most terrifying prisoner in the entire Sacred World…
The torture and restriction on his body were much stronger. Other Chaotic Origin Prisoners could go for a ‘patrol’ anytime they wanted! But only the ‘Sea of Abyss Master’ was restricted to the extent that he could not stand up during most occasions! He could only sit down cross-legged until the moment those shackles began loosening and separating from the seabed. That was when he could leave the Sea of Abyss.
‘This is truly painful.’ The body of the Sea of Abyss Master trembled. This pain was increasing significantly over time. It was also forcing him to leave the Sea of Abyss.
Only when he went out for a patrol.
Only when he traveled to a distance far from his territory would the intense pain lighten.
‘Those damned Overlords! They are forcing me, forcing me! All of you are going to regret this!’ The Sea of Abyss Master abruptly stood.
When he stood up, it caused the sea water of the entire Sea of Abyss to sway, forming huge waves all over.
“Hong long~”
When the towering figure of the Sea of Abyss Master stood up, the vast ‘Sea of Abyss’ started falling!
His legs were on the seabed.
And as he stood, the sea was merely at the waist level of the Sea of Abyss Master.
He looked up wards and let out a furious roar. “Hong long long~” That terrifying roar brought about an intense tremor up in the sky above the Sea of Abyss. The membrane wall of the world shattered, revealing many thin shackle-like inscriptions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1371 - Trample Down
chapters.content:
Chapter 1371: Trample Down
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Scarlet Cloud City.
“The Sea of Abyss Master is out for a patrol! The Sea of Abyss Master is out for a patrol!” Xue Ying was currently researching on the Quiet Icy Mountain Master corpse placed in his underground palace when he received this message abruptly; he was greatly shocked by it, ‘What? The Sea of Abyss Master?’
He could not care about anything else. Waving his hand, he kept the corpse.
Xue Ying immediately rushed out of his underground palace towards the Scarlet Cloud Palace.
“Sou sou sou…”
For a moment, the entire Scarlet Cloud City was filled with streams of light flashing about. All 3,000 over cultivators had arrived without any of them missing. Including those that had ‘gone closed-door cultivation’, immediately rushed out the moment they received this news.
“Sou.” Xue Ying also entered the Scarlet Cloud Palace. Currently, the Scarlet Cloud Palace was gathered with a large number of cultivators. Some were solemn, and some were filled with looks of feverish expectation.
“Fellow cultivators, please have a look.”
A golden-robed old man who was holding on to a wooden cane took out a mirror on his hand. The mirror was currently showing the scene at the Sea of Abyss. A towering giant currently stood within the Sea of Abyss with the sea level raised to just his waist level! He was so big that the Sea of Abyss felt like a small pond to him. Many shackles that were illuminated in golden light permeated directly into the body of this giant. He could not escape from those shackles at all.
‘He is out.’ Many cultivators present became restless.
Every single assembly ground had done an arrangement for some cultivators to be responsible for guarding the Sea of Abyss! The cultivators had varying techniques. For instance, there was one in Scarlet Cloud City who owned a unique ‘magic mirror’ that gave him the ability to constantly observe what was happening at the Sea of Abyss! This magic mirror had always been placed in the Scarlet Cloud Palace, allowing the puppets in the Scarlet Cloud Palace to stay on a constant look out at the Sea of Abyss.
The towering giant ‘Sea of Abyss Master’ stepped ahead. He took two steps before getting up onto the land. Those shackles restricting his body began activating, causing the inscriptions on them to revolve and causing his body to start shrinking.
