Quite a few of them were feeling uneasy the moment they saw the Sea of Abyss Master stay. But they did not think too much. They felt that everything was within their control. But now, this mad laughter from the Sea of Abyss Master… brought a chill down everyone’s spine!
“Not good!”
“He, what is
“Unless he has stayed outside Scarlet Cloud City for so long not because he wanted to kill us. Instead, he had been waiting for us to gather?”
“Why? This doesn’t make sense! If he had sufficient strength, he would have wiped us out!”
“Impossible! He is being suppressed and tortured. And Monarch Flying Snow’s technique removed all threat from the ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Just with him alone… how is it possible for him to threaten all of us cultivators? This isn’t a trial anymore!”
For a moment, everyone had many thoughts about this.
…
“Very good, all of you cultivators from the five cities have gathered!” The laughter from the Sea of Abyss Master was still reverberating around the world when his body suddenly transformed. It was rapidly becoming bigger! From 600 kilometers, it rose to 5,000 kilometers, 50,000 kilometers… his body continued becoming bigger and bigger. The injuries on his body rapidly disappeared. Many queer watery blue seals started appearing on his skin. The entire world trembled. Furthermore, the World Energy in this Cultivation Sacred World began gushing towards the Sea of Abyss Master.
Strictly speaking, the body of the Sea of Abyss Master was rapidly devouring the surrounding World Energy. Even as this Cultivation Sacred World was being suppressed, he could still forcibly devour the energy!
The laws in the surrounding area started transforming too. This Sea of Abyss Master… just his existence seemed to be on the same level as this world. He was the source of a world in itself! And now, the Sea of Abyss Master has become much more terrifying. Instead, his body was pushing back the law suppression of this Cultivation Sacred World, causing the neighboring laws to start distorting.
“This, what is this?”
“This…”
Close to 20,000 cultivators all looked up dumbstruck. They felt a chill down their spines.
The Sea of Abyss Master was rapidly becoming bigger. His existence had even affected the neighboring laws. The entire Scarlet Cloud City was within this law region. Xue Ying and the other cultivators could not help but acknowledge allegiance to the other party… It was too powerful! The gap between their strength was so big it brought despair to everyone.
“Chi chi chi~” The surrounding void was being broken apart, revealing the countless inscription shackles that pressed down on the world.
Those mysterious shackles had firmly sealed down the entire Cultivation Sacred World!
But now, the law transformation brought about by the Sea of Abyss Master clashed with the laws of this Cultivation Sacred World.
“This, this is absolutely not a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform! It is impossible for a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform to be this powerful within the Cultivation Sacred World.” Wu Xiao could not help but feel his heart tremble when he saw the Sea of Abyss Master becoming rapidly bigger.
‘Not good, it seems there is a huge problem. I have to flee now!’ Great Emperor North River was decisive. He immediately activated the imprint within his wristband in an attempt to leave this world.
“Weng!”
He just activated it when the surrounding laws suppressed the array, making the teleportation by Great Emperor North River a failure.
And at this moment, the transforming Sea of Abyss Master glanced in the direction of ‘Great Emperor North River’. He had a sneer on his lips: “Oh? It seems quite a powerful teleportation technique? What a pity it is useless before me.”
Even though this was something left behind by ‘Yuan’, that was just a technique left behind on the huge stone within the forbidden ground ‘Snake Teeth Corridor’ in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range a long time ago. Every cultivator could enter the huge stone and be imbued with this technique. This movement technique could be activated thrice! Such a large-scale bestowment technique would not be considered precious. It could also not break apart the law suppression around a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
“Impudent!” A roar resounded across the entire Cultivation Sacred World.
The figure of a towering black-robed thin male appeared in midair. He glared angrily at the Sea of Abyss Master. One could see the shackles within the body of the Sea of Abyss Master lighting up in gold. The suppression rose to a limit! Every shackle was madly suppressing the strength of the Sea of Abyss Master. It also forced his body to shrink.
Xue Ying and the others could recognize that this black-robed tall and thin male was none other than the Hall Spirit of the Guiding Hall. As they saw the body of the Sea of Abyss Master becoming smaller, they could not help but look forward to it.
“Just a Hall Spirit dare to shout before me?” The Sea of Abyss Master seemed to grit his teeth and roar. He tried his best to retaliate, yet his body was still being suppressed.
These were several array techniques set up by the Overlord in the past to suppress the Chaotic Origin Prisoners. And now, they were all activated.
Even though the magnificent Overlord had set up arrays that were meant to deal against Chaotic Origin Prisoners at the ‘High-Graded’ level, though to prevent unforeseen circumstances from happening, the energy of the arrays had reached the World Realm Level! This required quite a lot of effort from an Overlord.
“Weng weng weng~!”
Countless inscription shackles outside the membrane of the Cultivation Sacred World let out light. They were also frantically devouring the neighboring Chaotic Origin Energy. Currently, those arrays were maximized. Those huge arrays had been completely activated to suppress this Sea of Abyss Master.
This was the limit of the arrays.
And the body of the Sea of Abyss Master was being suppressed smaller and smaller. Finally, it stopped at a height of 4,000 kilometers.
“What?” The black-robed tall and thin male was greatly shocked. He was ultimately a Hall Spirit. At this moment, he had activated the arrays to their maximum limit, yet it could only suppress the other party to a height of 4,000 kilometers! One had to know… that a Chaotic Origin Lifeform that could maintain a height of 4,000 kilometers despite resisting against the limit of the array showed how powerful he was before! Yet this body with a height of 4,000 kilometers was still filled with endless grandeur.
“Heh heh… what techniques do you still have?” The Sea of Abyss Master looked at that illusory black-robed male figure. He gave a savage grin, “Just a world meant for tiny ants to train in? I doubt that there would be a powerful World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert protecting it. Haha! You are just a tiny hall spirit. There’s nothing you can do.”
The black-robed male felt bitter in his heart.
World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert? How was it possible for an expert of such status to remain here protecting this world!
Each Chaotic Origin Expert was equivalent to a world! Every avatar they form would see part of their strength being split. Hence, most of the time, such experts would only maintain one main avatar at the strongest state for external battles! And another weaker one within their own Origin World! Just a main avatar… would be used to protect important places. Why would any expert come to protect the Cultivation Sacred World, a place meant to train brats?
After all, there was a limit to how many World Realm Chaotic Origin Experts there could be.
‘This, how could this be possible! It is hard for High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms to break through to the World Realm Chaotic Origin Level! As a Chaotic Origin Prisoner, you are constantly being suppressed and tortured! Your body hasn’t reached the Grand Perfection Realm either. The moment you reached the Grand Perfection Realm, you would have been sentenced to death. It is impossible for you to remain here.’ The black-robed male was astonished.
He was clear.
This Sea of Abyss Master should have reached the Grand Perfection Realm without breaking through! Under that circumstance, he had forced himself to comprehend a technique to break to the World Realm.
That was simply too heaven defying!
Furthermore…
Because choosing High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that were not at the Grand Perfection Realm while ensuring they give sufficient pressure to the cultivators meant most of these life forms would have a noble bloodline, just like this Sea of Abyss Master.
‘He could become a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform with his noble bloodline under the suppression of this Cultivation Sacred World?’ The back-robed spirit felt cold in his heart. Ever since the start of the Cultivation Sacred World, this had never happened before! Because only one out of a million High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms would reach the World Realm! And the difficulty of becoming one in the Cultivation Sacred World was a hundred to a thousand times harder,
The probability of such an event happening was too low. And until now, the Cultivation Sacred World had only six Sea of Abyss Masters in total.
And now, an additional one had appeared that could break through to become a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform?
‘Doomed.’
‘All the cultivators in this world are going to be doomed.’ The black-robed male felt that things were amiss. Yet he was helpless about it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1378 - One Death per Step
chapters.content:
Chapter 1378: One Death per Step
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Even though he wished to save these brats, the black-robed male was ultimately a Hall Spirit. He was helpless. Furthermore, what he cared more about this was: ‘I have already reported upwards to the patrol. I wish the patrol could reach here in time and kill this newly-emerged World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Otherwise, if he were to escape, then there would be one additional calamity.’
For a lifeform with such a noble bloodline and could breakthrough despite being tortured and pressured in the Cultivation Sacred World showed how huge his potential would be. If he were to succeed in escaping out of this world, it was entirely possible for the other party to reach the peak as a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
“Hehe~” At a height of 4,000 kilometers, the Sea of Abyss Master whose skin was covered with many inscriptions tried struggling against the shackles that permeated and locked down his soft tentacles.
“Break out, break out!”
All six tentacles of the Sea of Abyss Master pulled out. He had a vicious look on his face and his eyes were filled with madness.
But no matter how much he resisted, those shackles were still stuck in his body!
‘If I don’t destroy these suppression arrays, I can’t escape.’ The Sea of Abyss Master continued struggling with all his strength. He wanted to grow bigger, and his tentacles continued pulling out those shackles. He wanted to break apart the links between the shackles with those huge arrays.
“Weng weng weng——”
Those shackles were locked very tightly! It suppressed the Sea of Abyss Master, a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform into just 4,000 kilometers tall. As the Sea of Abyss Master pulled those shackles away, it forced the entire Cultivation Sacred World to tremble. Many regions of void even started shaking apart. In the blink of an eye, every single inch of the void in the Cultivation Sacred World started recovering and breaking, recovering and breaking. It revealed those shackles that sealed the world behind the membrane.
Those inscripted shackles were like an enormous prison wrapping around the Cultivation Sacred World. It also sealed the entire Cultivation Sacred World tightly.
“Weng.” The Cultivation Sacred World shook. Those inscripted shackles that made this world prison-like shone resplendently.
At this moment, the Sea of Abyss Master felt unwilling: ‘I am actually unable to struggle out of those shackles. Having become a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform, I could still not destroy the arrays of this world. I can’t escape!’
This outcome was neither good nor bad.
His conspiracy…
In his original plan, the worst case scenario would be for the punishments seals in this world to simply kill and wipe him out the moment he erupted strength as a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform! That was simply sorrowful. But it was also the worst case scenario he had thought of. Nonetheless, he had no choice. He had to break through. Otherwise, there would not be any hope at all.
And the best case scenario would be for him to destroy the sealing arrays! He would destroy the entire Cultivation Sacred World and wipe out all cultivators before leaving casually! When the terrifying Chaotic Origin Experts arrive, he would have long fled to god knows where.
But the current situation was neither good nor bad! The sealing arrays were not so heaven-defying to sentence him to death! But it was not so weak that he could escape out of it easily.
“Big Brother!” The Sea of Abyss Master finally stopped struggling. Instead, he relied on his bloodline to extend his senses out across the endless void onto another powerful Chaotic Origin Lifeform. That was the nearest World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform who was from the same clan as him. Even within the vast Chaotic Origin Dimension, he could sense his clan members despite being so far apart.
Both parties had to be of the same bloodline! And they had to be sufficiently strong. They had to be at least a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
The bloodline of the Sea of Abyss Master was noble. And in this bloodline of his, there were a total of three such World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeforms!
“Mn? Cheng Hao?” Far away in the endless void, there was a towering giant that had been sleeping. The time-space around him was sealed, and it would be hard for any other Chaotic Origin Experts to discover him when they passed by this area.
At this moment, he opened his eyes.
His eyes were much bigger than the Sun Star in the Primitive Sacred World. His body was also covered in countless water rays. It seemed as if many worlds were emerging amidst the rays of water. Those worlds made from the water rays even had weak ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms living within.
“Haha, Cheng Hao, my brother, you have broken through to the World Realm?” This towering giant revealed a grin. Of those from their bloodline, there were simply too many High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. One had to reach the World Realm before they could be called his brother.
“Yes, I have just broken through. Yet I am still imprisoned in a world. No matter how I struggle, I still can’t get out of it. I need help, and it has to be fast! The World Realm experts under the cultivators’ Overlord should have received this news and are rushing over with the fastest speed.” The Sea of Abyss Master transmitted through his spirit.
“The region you are in is a territory of the cultivators?” The towering giant had a headache from it.
“Big Brother, I beseech for your help.” The Sea of Abyss Master anxiously added.
He understood that this was the territory of the cultivators. Those truly terrifying Chaotic Origin Lifeforms would not easily get themselves involved in this.
“Alright! Rest assured, I’ll report this upwards. There will definitely be a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform who is nearest to you coming to save you. I’ll also definitely come over to save the fourth World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform in our clan! In terms of accumulations, we are ultimately stronger than the cultivators.” The towering giant said. He had located the Sea of Abyss Master through his bloodline sensing and had immediately reported upwards about the mission to save!
At that point, the Sea of Abyss Master felt his heart relaxing.
Even if he might not be able to escape himself, he could still ask his clan for help. Even though the World Realm Chaotic Origin Experts the cultivators had were powerful, most of them would only be unparalleled when they hid within their own Origin Worlds! They could only protect it. They might be more formidable than the World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeforms in their attacks, yet the most terrifying were still the Overlords! The magnificent Overlords had profound strengths. They were the ones that could protect immense regions.
But there were only eight Overlords in total. They were too few in numbers.
…
After arranging for his escape, the Sea of Abyss Master cast his attention to the large group of cultivators within Scarlet Cloud City. To him, these weak cultivators that were not Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were simply ants. They could not compare with his current level of life! Only after arranging for his escape did he choose to trample those ants to death!
“Hurry up and run! Hurry up! Everyone must scatter now.”
“Everyone, scatter! Run in different directions! Every single moment you can delay is one extra moment. As long as you delay until the moment a Chaotic Origin Expert comes and kills the Sea of Abyss Master, that would mean that you are saved!” The black-robed male figure transmitted out to every other cultivator, urging them.
The cultivators had already escaped in all directions. They had practically moved simultaneously by themselves.
Each of them were protected by the energy from the arrays. This was some of the array energy directed by the b lack-robed male.
‘Exterminate.’ Sea of Abyss Master thought.
Within the region he held absolute control in, an unseen energy descended. Every cultivator within felt their bodies sinking, and at that time, their speed had greatly decreased. Nonetheless, they were able to resist it.
“Just a little Hall Spirit yet you can direct some energy to protect these brats? Do you think it’ll be useful?” The Sea of Abyss Master sneered. The slight protection energy might allow the cultivators to disregard all ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, yet it was a joke against the World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform ‘Sea of Abyss Master’! The Sea of Abyss Master could resist against the sealing arrays. How powerful was he?
“Hu.”
He took a step and disappeared. He was simply too fast. He immediately went on to trample on the nearest cultivator. That cultivator looked upwards with despair, only to see a huge mountain like leg covering the world. It came crashing down! And had instantly turned the cultivator into paste.
Even though the Sea of Abyss Master was struggling to resist against the arrays while communicating with his big brother within his clan… giving time for those cultivators to escape, yet the slowest had only covered a distance more than 50 million kilometers which the Sea of Abyss Master could cover in one step.
His speed was simply way faster than the cultivators’.
“Hahaha…” The Sea of Abyss Master swept his gaze across. He had already decided on his first target——Monarch Flying Snow!
Xue Ying had also long started running.
He even tried activating the imprint on his wristband, yet to no avail. The law suppression generated by the Sea of Abyss Master had covered a huge region around him, making it impossible for Xue Ying to leave. Actually, if ‘Yuan’ was willing to refine a life protection treasure by paying sufficient price, he could create something that would resist against the laws of a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform… but Xue Ying and Great Emperor North River had merely received a movement technique left behind in the forbidden ground Snake Teeth Corridor.
If World Realm Chaotic Origin Experts did not notice it, Xue Ying might be able to escape.
But under their eyes? Within their laws? This movement technique was not sufficient.
‘I have even decided to head to the third world if I did not receive anything from the Overlord once this battle ends. Who would have thought that the Sea of Abyss Master could break through to become a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform.’ Xue Ying felt helpless. Yet he was different from an absolute majority of cultivators in the Cultivation Sacred World. He had avatars and was not worried of death.
‘It seems that there could be slip-ups in the training provided by Overlords.’ Xue Ying thought.
…
The Sea of Abyss Master had decided that his first target would be Monarch Flying Snow. And as Xue Ying had grasped the new Water Droplet Secret Technique, his speed was ranked among the top few across all escaping 20,000 over cultivators! Naturally, he would be one of the few that had fled the furthest.
After locking on the position of Monarch Flying Snow, the Sea of Abyss Master began walking over step by step.
He was not in a rush to kill Xue Ying. Instead, he was killing a cultivator each step he took along this direction! He wanted to trample a cultivator to death every step as he continued towards Xue Ying’s direction.
“He is here.”
One step, one death.
The enormous leg of his was more than 500 kilometers. It was simply too fast, making his step unavoidable.
‘Who would have thought that I would die in the hands of a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform.’ A cultivator turned around and looked behind him. Furthermore, his speed had even slowed as he understood it was pointless no matter how fast he ran. The enormous leg came crashing down. The eyes of this cultivator remained calm. “Pu——” He turned into smithereens.
Following that.
The Sea of Abyss Master continued moving forward.
‘Is it my turn? No!’ Great Emperor North River was also escaping. He was only a Grand Perfection God Emperor and was not good at speed. Hence, he was considered quite average among the escaping cultivators. At this current juncture, he could sense the Sea of Abyss Master killing one every step he took. And he was closely reaching Great Emperor North River.

chapters.title: Chapter 1379 - No regrets taking on this Path!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1379: No regrets taking on this Path!
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Because he had to kill every cultivator, the Sea of Abyss Master simply needed one step to kill one. He did not have to use his full force in accelerating. Instead, he was simply strolling.
The towering giant with a height of 4,000 kilometers casually strolled. He might seem slow, yet in reality, time had been influenced. In the blink of an eye, he had stomped a hundred cultivators one after another.
“Hu.” Cultivators that were fleeing were simply trampled to death. To the Sea of Abyss Master, he felt disdain from using his techniques. He could simply stomp those ants to death.
‘I can’t escape.’
Great Emperor North River understood it in his heart.
‘I, North River, had struggled while on death’s door when I was weak in the Realm Heart Great Land. It was only when I became stronger did I choose to return to the Broken Teeth Mountain Range. I rose rapidly, becoming the strongest Great Emperor in Broken Teeth Mountain Range. Even the five Great Supremes dare not slight me.’
‘For the sake of entering the forbidden ground Snake Teeth Corridor, I have simply stolen the Thousand-Eyed Water Droplet from Ying Shan Xue Ying.’
‘As I was observing the Snake Teeth Corridor, in the end, I was forced to enter the huge stone and risk my life.’
‘Lightning World! Cultivation Sacred World!’
‘Is my path of cultivation going to stop here?’
‘I am unwilling. I am truly feeling unwilling to let it stop here.’ Great Emperor North River thought. If he wanted power and enjoyment, he would not have fallen out with Xue Ying in the past.
What he, Great Emperor North River, was chasing after is to reach the peak in the path of cultivation. He sought to become a Paragon and to jump out of the cage and become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform!
He was willing to use other lives as sacrifice to pave the way for his Dao path.
It’s just that today… He was finally stopping on this path. Because his life was about to end.
‘At least my life has been exciting enough. Of the countless clansmen originating from the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, how many could truly become a Paragon? And how many of them could witness and experience the fight with High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms and even a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform?’ Great Emperor North River watched as a huge leg fell from the sky behind him. In his mind, there were too many scenes that had flashed. When he was weak and had to survive in the Realm Heart Great Land, his diligence and hard work in cultivating, rising up step by step, fighting all sorts of battles and using all kinds of schemes…
The huge leg landed! It was reflected in the eyes of Great Emperor North River. At this moment, the edge of Great Emperor North River’s lips curled upwards.
“Peng!”
Great Emperor North River turned into smithereens. He had disappeared from the world.
And from thus, there was no longer this cultivator called Great Emperor North River.
…
Great Emperor North River’s death was nothing out of the ordinary. The Sea of Abyss Master was simply strolling, and with each step, he would kill a cultivator. Great Emperor North River might perhaps be outstanding in the Broken Teeth Mountain Range, yet he was simply ordinary here.
It was only Xue Ying who was running at the front while constantly paying notice to the Sea of Abyss Master behind, noticed the death of Great Emperor North River.
Great Emperor North River was unlike Xue Ying who had avatars.
‘He died just like that?’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly.
‘Perhaps he might be ruthless and emotionless. He might be unscrupulous. But his Cultivation Heart is firm at least.’ Xue Ying lamented over it momentarily before he chose not to care anymore. Because there were simply too many cultivators that died. And the majority had been people Xue Ying befriended in the Cultivation Sacred World.
…
Just a breath of time and the Sea of Abyss Master had trampled more than a thousand cultivators to death. He might seem to be moving slowly, yet too many cultivators had fallen. If this continued, the 20,000 over cultivators could not hold for too long either.
And in this direction where Xue Ying was running at, almost all ordinary Grand Perfection God Emperors had been killed, leaving behind just ten over apex experts that were much faster.
‘Is it my turn?’ Great Emperor Qian Qu turned over. He even stopped.
‘If only I could break through by force at this moment, I’d reach the Overlord rank. Just a suppressed World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform will not be of any threat to me.’ Great Emperor Qian Qu thought. His eyes were burning with a frightening light. The ambition he had from the start of his cultivation until now was burning. Great Emperor Qian Qu wanted to attempt breaking through right before death.
Either he breaks through or he dies!
Perhaps the possibility of breaking through is less than one-trillionth. But he still wanted to take the gamble.
The huge leg descended.
Great Emperor Qian Qu started. He stared hard at it.
“Peng.”
Great Emperor Qian Qu, dead!
“Brother Qian Qu.” Monarch Sky Pure who was running in a different direction felt the pain when he saw that.
“Brother Qian Qu has taken his move.”
“Yet another.”
Great Emperor Qian Qu’s influencing power was much greater than Great Emperor North River’s. His fall had incited the melancholy in the hearts of many cultivators. They sighed over the death of Great Emperor Qian Qu, and understood that it would soon be their turn.
…
“Peng peng peng…”
Currently in the direction where Xue Ying was running in, those that were trampled to death were either the Grand Perfection God Emperors or the apex experts that were not very fast. All of them were famous.
But not a single one of them could retaliate. And no miracles had happened.
Miracles. What were miracles? They happened very rarely!
Cultivation ultimately required accumulation! If one did not have sufficient accumulation, then even when death came, breakthrough was simply a pipe dream! Many cultivators had broken through before death because they had sufficient accumulations and were left with the final step.
‘I have cultivated until now without regrets!’ Vice City Master Xun Yi guffawed. He watched as the Sea of Abyss Master trampled down onto him.
Xun Yi was the Vice City Master from Sky Noon City.
He was also a Void Lineage Dao Cultivator! In terms of his accumulation in the Dao of Void, he understood it at a more profound level than Xue Ying did. It’s just that even though he was quite fast in terms of speed, he was still slower than Xue Ying. Xue Ying had comprehended the Water Droplet Secret Technique from the corpse of ‘Quiet Icy Mountain Master’. That was how Xue Ying could be so fast.
Hence, in terms of purely speed, there were quite a few other cultivators that were much faster than the three City Masters of the past in Scarlet Cloud City.
Specialists were good at their trades!
“Peng.”
A leg came down.
Xun Yi laughed. There were even many layers of void that appeared in his surroundings as he still tried to defend himself. Nonetheless, he was exterminated in an instance.
This was the first death of a Vice City Master from the five cities.
…
“Peng peng peng…”
After the death of Vice City Master Xun Yi, more experts continued falling, making the cultivators that were rushing in other directions feel agony and depressed.
“It’s Monarch Flying Snow.”
“Is Monarch Flying Snow going to die here as well?”
Even though the cultivators were dashing off in different directions, they were all paying attention to that Sea of Abyss Master. They also saw how the Sea of Abyss Master was about reaching Xue Ying on his path. And Xue Ying was also the second fastest cultivator fleeing away along the direction that the Sea of Abyss Master was moving towards!
Monarch Flying Snow was much more influential in the Sacred World!
His attainments in the soul aspect had made many other cultivators across all five assembly grounds admire him. Soul was the foundation of life. It was simply amazing that he could attain such proficiency in the soul! It could be said… that within the recent half a month, Monarch Flying Snow was absolutely the most dazzling and striking expert across the entire Cultivation Sacred World
Cultivators from the other cities had even envied the cultivators living in Scarlet Cloud City simply because Monarch Flying Snow was living there.
“He, is he going to be trampled to death too?”
“Ai, even those with amazing talents might fall the next day. Before absolute strength, resisting is futile.”
They were all paying attention to it.
Weather Leaf, Xie Fan, Wu Xiao, Great Emperor Heaven Calamity, and many experts from all cities were also watching it.
Xue Ying stopped. He no longer chose to flee.
As he turned around, he saw the Sea of Abyss Master that was so tall his legs had reached the clouds. “Peng peng peng”, another three apex experts fell one after another. Following that, the huge leg appeared within the horizons of Xue Ying. It covered his world. Somehow, everything became pitch black and the huge leg came crashing down——
At this moment, Xue Ying did not feel sorrowful at all. This was ultimately just an avatar of his.
Just that as he stood here at this moment, he thought back to the thousand over cultivators that had died in the direction he ran. The ordinary cultivators like Great Emperor North River, and the apex experts like Great Emperor Qian Qu, and even a City Master like Xun Yi were all dead! Perhaps there might be some differences in their strength, yet all of them were outstanding characters.
They came from different worlds and experienced different things. But all of them had a strong Dao Heart.
Their desires, their ambitions… all of them wished to jump out of the cage and become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
Stepping on this path…
They were all prepared to die.
After living through a life chasing after the Dao, it was fine even if they died.
They had no regrets. They could face death calmly and smile at death.
‘Life and death. All of them have willingly taken this path and have no regrets!’ Xue Ying looked upwards as the huge leg descended. He was also calmly facing it.
Sometimes, there was no need to retaliate when faced with absolute strength.
He could choose what manner he wanted to face it.
‘Even if one was a weak tiny ant, he can think of himself as unparalleled in his heart.’
‘Freedom.’
‘Freedom.’
Xue Ying had an unprecedented vigor in his eyes.
“Peng!”
The huge leg descended.
And Xue Ying turned into smithereens!
At this moment, the cultivators that were paying notice to the Sea of Abyss Master sighed. Such an outstanding cultivator like ‘Monarch Flying Snow’ had fallen!

chapters.title: Chapter 1380 - Dao of Mirage, Final Realm!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1380: Dao of Mirage, Final Realm!
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Every since Xue Ying comprehended the Third Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm Killing Technique in the Lightning World, his soul had a qualitative transformation. Furthermore, it was infinitely reaching the final realm. He could even sense the Origin Source of a world, and was so close towards fusing with the source. The moment he fused with it, then his soul would remain undying as long as the source of the world existed!
But he was almost there. This slight gap made Xue Ying feel suffocated.
Ever since his cultivation reached the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body Realm, Xue Ying had practically poured all his concentration on the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm. He wished to fuse both his fleshy body and soul together.
But despite his huge desire to break through, he still could not do so!
After leaving the Lightning World and arriving at the Cultivation Sacred World, Xue Ying had cultivated here for several hundred billion years. Nonetheless, the final thin layer in his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm could not be pried open still.
And at this very moment——
As the huge leg of the Sea of Abyss Master landed, sneering at him as if he was stomping an ant to death, Xue Ying did not really care about himself at this juncture. Instead, he was watching as the cultivators face death calmly, and how it was pointless to resist against absolute strength. Nonetheless, his heart could decide how he should deal with this.
Even weaker cultivators would still think of themselves as unparalleled in their hearts.
The freedom in their hearts…
That was the beauty of every life.
‘Freedom.’
‘Freedom.’
Xue Ying could still recall when he saved those that had been enslaved by ‘Sacred Master’, with their souls being controlled. At the time when he saved them, those countless souls had been rejoicing…
At this moment.
Seeing the cultivators dying calmly gave Xue Ying a sudden epiphany: ‘The most marvelous aspect about this world is the living. Every single life has his or her own dreams. Precisely because all living beings have their own will makes this world so much more brilliant and exciting! If a world has nothing living in it, it’ll be a piece of dead world. If all living beings in a world are controlled, then those beings are simply walking corpses; they do not have any wish or desire.’
‘If a world has a soul, then the living beings living in the world are also the soul of the world.’
‘Only when a world has a soul would it be exciting to live in.’
‘A world without soul is colorless.’
Xue Ying had long accumulated sufficient experience and understanding on the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm. At this moment when the epiphany came, he switched the direction of his thinking.
In the past, he had been looking at the Dao from the perspective of a world. He wanted to perfect his ‘Mirage’, yet he was always lacking something. But now when he changed his perspective, looking at the Dao from that of each ‘living being’… Every living being was an unremarkable part of a vast world. But it was because of each living seed… that made a world so exciting.
The five branches of the Dao of Mirage were currently being guided by the ‘Soul Lineage’.
And now, he who had already accumulated to the pinnacle was suddenly enlightened. It was like the ‘Dao’ had been perfectly completed, just like adding the finishing touch to a painting! At this moment, his comprehension was fusing together as one.
Most often, when one reached the limit in his accumulations, all he needed was just an inspiration.
And after he understood everything, with a ‘hong’, Xue Ying’s soul started the final metamorphosis.
He could sense the Origin Source of a world initially. At this moment, it was like he had entered the embrace of a mother, where everything was within reach. Xue Ying’s soul naturally fused into the origin of this world, which was also its soul! The soul was the most mysterious energy. It was condensed and formed from the essence of the Origin Source of the world. That was also why collecting the ‘Blood Spirit Essence’ from other living beings would have a better effect than using the Origin World Rock.
And this soul that had reached the final realm, also known as grand perfection, seemed to permeate through everything easily. The source of the world could not obstruct it at all.
Because of a breakthrough in comprehension!
Because of the fusion of his soul into the origin of a world! Xue Ying was currently filled with endless happiness!
And that’s why his eyes had revealed an unprecedented vigor.
“Peng!”
As the leg trampled down, Xue Ying’s body shattered.
Even though his fleshy body might have been exterminated, his soul remained undying.
While the origin of a world exists… his soul would remain eternal!
…
Weather Leaf had fled in another direction. His left and right hand, ‘Xie Fan’ was also escaping behind him. They paid notice to what was happening over at Xue Ying’s direction.
Watching that huge leg descend from above the clouds, it trampled Monarch Flying Snow to death.
‘Even if one has a greater talent or is more powerful, he’ll similarly die.’ Xie Fan gritted his teeth. His eyes were filled with madness, ‘Monarch Flying Snow is dead. Very soon, everyone else will die too. By then, it’ll be me, and Weather Leaf…”
‘Unless.’
‘Unless someone breaks through to the Chaotic Origin Lifeform Level. Perhaps we might be able to survive.’ Xie Fan thought. Bloodline Awakening would only allow one to become a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform! Currently, even though the Sea of Abyss Master was being suppressed completely by the arrays, he was still a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Despite being suppressed, he could most likely still kill a new High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
Of course, if one broke through to become a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform, he could still survive! At least he could escape much more easily! As for the Sea of Abyss Master, he was being shackled all over. His speed would be greatly influenced. Even though he was much faster than the cultivators, compared to a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform, his speed might still be slower.
‘But reaching the Chaotic Origin Level isn’t this easy.’ Xie Fan thought.
He did not have a Chaotic Origin Bloodline. If he wanted to have a breakthrough, he would have to force his way up. That would mean less hope for him.
‘Perhaps?’ Xie Fan still harbored a strand of hope.
Any cultivator that had reached the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body Realm could still possibly have a breakthrough.
…
‘Brother Flying Snow.’ Weather Leaf signed.
He was proud.
At Scarlet Cloud City, he was only close with Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor. The two of them had reached sufficiently profound levels in their realm. As for Wu Xiao? Even though he was as strong as them, Wu Xiao relied on his heaven-defying bloodline. His accumulations in his realm could hardly be compared to the two of them.
In the end, Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor relied on the bloodline of Quiet Icy Mountain Master to guide all nine bloodlines he had to an Ultimate Awakening, breaking through to the Chaotic Origin Level. Furthermore, he even created an entirely new Chaotic Origin Lifeform Tribe.
Weather Leaf admired Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor a lot, and he similarly admired Xue Ying. Xue Ying was also currently the cultivator he admired most in the Cultivation Sacred World.
‘He has reached such deep levels in the path of soul, yet… ai, it is going to be my turn soon.’ Weather Leaf thought.
Following that, he continued running for his life.
The Sea of Abyss Master merely proceeded to kill the cultivators from one direction to another. As long as he was sufficiently fast, he could delay for a longer period. Perhaps, he might be able to survive? No matter what, he must not give up.
******
‘Monarch Flying Snow has also fallen.’ Wu Xiao watched silently, ‘Whatever, it is about time for me to leave.’
In the entire Cultivation Sacred World.
There was only one person that was confident of escaping——Wu Xiao!
Wu Xiao was the most outstanding descendent a magnificent Overlord had. Even as the descendent of an Overlord, it was as hard for him to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. He came here by himself to experience and to train. And his old ancestor——that magnificent Overlord, had long left something behind in his soul. As long as he activated it, it would immediately pull his soul away.
According to what his old ancestor said, as long as he did not meet an Overlord Class Chaotic Origin Lifeform, he would be able to escape.
Even though he had a way of surviving, Wu Xiao was not willing to use it if he was not pushed to the brink of death. Because the moment he used it, his soul would be pulled back to the Old Ancestor! And that was simply a humiliation to Wu Xiao.
‘It seems I have no other choice.’
“Weng.”
With a thought.
He activated it.
His body started crumbling apart. And his soul had been engulfed by a dazzling white light. With a flash, it disappeared from this world.
“Mn?”
The Sea of Abyss Master who was currently massacring the cultivators, felt something in his domain. The soul of a cultivator had actually left it. That white flash even made the Sea of Abyss Master tremble. Of course, that slight bit of energy had merely injured him lightly, yet it still made the Sea of Abyss Master revere the quality of this energy.
That energy came from the so-called most terrifying ‘Overlord Class Chaotic Origin Lifeform’ known to all Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. Furthermore, it even left some fear in him.
He understood.
That in the vast Chaotic Origin Dimension, when Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms dug their bloodline to the pinnacle, they would become Overlord Class Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. All of them were incredibly powerful and had unfathomable techniques. There was even an Overlord Class Chaotic Origin Lifeform with a Time-Space Bloodline that was once killed by the Cultivator Overlords, yet he was able to revive himself over a long period of time.
That magnificent existence was ranked at the bottom of those Overlords, yet he could continually revive himself from time-space, remaining eternally undying.
Every ‘Overlord Class’ magnificent existence had their own heaven-defying techniques. They could also injure the Cultivator Overlords too.
Nonetheless——
The eight Cultivator Overlords were one level higher than the Innate Chaotic Origin Overlords. All of them had comprehended the essence of the highest level of energy. They had completely comprehended their ‘Daos’. Perhaps they might be injured, but want to kill them? It was impossible for others to kill their ‘Prime Avatar’, much less the other avatars that were located within their own Origin Worlds. By borrowing their own Origin Worlds, World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were practically unparalleled, much less Overlords.
‘That is the strength of an Overlord! That cultivator is being protected by an Overlord?’ The Sea of Abyss Master thought.
“Hmph.”
The Sea of Abyss Master no longer thought about it. Right now, he was suppressed by the sealing arrays. Even though he could barely maintain some of his strength, it was insufficient to break apart these shackles. He could not leave this ‘Prison World’. That’s right, this Cultivation Sacred World was a huge prison to him.
He continued walking, killing more cultivators with his steps.
******
As long as the origin of the world existed, his soul would be undying.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying felt mystical. The Origin Source of this Cultivation Sacred World was like an enormous lump of light. His soul had fused into it.
Even if the fall of his avatar damaged his soul, it had recovered instantaneously.
‘Dao of Mirage, final realm…’
Xue Ying was currently familiarizing himself with it.
As he just broke through, he needed some time to familiarize with the new energy in his body. However, he knew that many cultivators were constantly dying at this moment. Hence, Xue Ying had to think of something and determine if he could save those cultivators.
‘How can I save the cultivators before a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform?’ As Xue Ying thought through, no matter what, even though his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm had reached the final realm, he still was not at the Chaotic Origin Level. So how could he save the others?
As he pondered, he examined his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm and thought through how he could make use of the ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’ on himself.
“Mn?” Xue Ying suddenly revealed a look of joy.
‘It appears that after fusing with the Origin Source of a world, I can do this?’ Xue Ying was delighted. He felt that the dispersed World Energy within this Cultivation Sacred World could be completely controlled by him! Even part of the energy from the origin of this world could be moved! According to legends… by refining the Origin Source of a world and becoming the master of the Origin World, then that would mean he could completely control all energy of the Origin World.
Even though he could control just part of the Origin Source energy, he could still control the entirety of the dispersed World Energy.
It’s a pity that this was a slightly smaller world that could not compare with an Origin World.
‘Fuse with the Origin Source of the World? Even though it is far weaker than refining the Origin Source, I can still control part of its energy.’ Xue Ying was excited in his heart. He could not be said to be the master of this world, yet he was considered an ’emissary’.
‘It seems there is hope!’
“Hu.”
Xue Ying immediately began executing his plan. He had to do it quick so that he could save as many cultivators as he could.

chapters.title: Chapter 1381 - The Shock of all Chaotic Origin Experts
chapters.content:
Chapter 1381: The Shock of all Chaotic Origin Experts
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Weather Leaf was currently fleeing, yet his heart was becoming colder over time.
Because the towering giant behind, the Sea of Abyss Master, remained walking leisurely. Even though he might seem casual, he had trampled more than a hundred cultivators to death in an instance.
“Sea of Abyss Master, could you spare me? I am willing to listen to all your orders!” Not too far away from Weather Leaf, Xie Fan immediately transmitted his messages over to the Sea of Abyss Master that was quite close to him. The short and small old man ‘Xie Fan’ looked at the Sea of Abyss Master. His eyes were filled with humility as if he wanted to fawn on the other party. He did not care about his reputation at all.
Amidst the cultivators that had been trampled, there were still an extreme few who begged for mercy and were willing to cast their loyalty on the Sea of Abyss Master.
Because some cultivators felt that as long as they survived! Then everything was possible.
“Peng.”
Nonetheless, a huge leg descended, reflecting upon the widened eyes of Xie Fan. Following that, he turned into smithereens.
And the eyes of the Sea of Abyss Master became much colder.
Begging for mercy?
I’ve been tortured for so many years. I have suffered agonizing pain. All these weak tiny cultivators must die! Not a single one can be let go!
“Peng, peng, peng…” The Sea of Abyss Master continued trampling upon the cultivators. At this moment, his fury was burning bright. On one side, it was the indignance that he had suppressed over the long years that was being vented at this current moment. On another side, it was because he could not escape from the shackles, and could not leave this world. He was still worried… that if a Cultivator Chaotic Origin Expert arrived, he who was being suppressed by the sealing arrays would most likely die.
The threat of death had not dissipated.
So how could the Sea of Abyss Master be in a good mood to let these weak tiny cultivators off?
All of them must die! He must stomp all of them to death! Not one could be let go!
“Weather Leaf.” When the Sea of Abyss Master saw the escaping Weather Leaf, his expression became even more savage. Of these weak tiny ants, the one had desired to kill the most was that cultivator called Monarch Flying Snow. And the following one would be this Weather Leaf. As Monarch Flying Snow had died, it was time for Weather Leaf to die.
“City Master Weather.”
“Is Brother Weather going to fall too?”
The other cultivators that were fleeing felt sympathy. They could foresee that they would soon end up in the same outcome as Weather Leaf.
The majority of the cultivators in the Cultivation Sacred World had no avatars!
Because most of them came from a world like ‘Lightning World’ that wasn’t an Origin World. Most of them could not cultivate avatar techniques there! It was only possible for avatars to be refined by cultivators that came from Origin Worlds. And even so, cultivators in those Origin Worlds could refine avatars dependent on what they cultivated, like ‘Dao of Void’ or certain other unique cultivation techniques.
Hence, it was rare for cultivators to have avatars!
And in the Cultivation Sacred World, the majority of them had Chaotic Origin Bloodlines. It was hard for these Bloodline Cultivators to refine avatars out. As for Dao Cultivators, perhaps due to their birth world or their ‘Daos’, the majority did not own any avatars too.
Only a minority in total had avatars.
‘It seems I can’t escape from this.’
‘I, Weather Leaf, has reached Half-Chaotic Origin Level in two Daos. Given my accumulation, it is possible for me to have a breakthrough before death.’
Weather Leaf no longer ran. He turned around instead.
He stared at that towering giant figure. In the eyes of Weather Leaf that were filled with severity and madness, not a single strand of fear could be seen. Instead, it was pure madness.
Fight it!
Either he breaks through or he dies!
“Haha…” The Sea of Abyss Master stepped down. He even let out a maniacal laughter that was light thunder. Only a few of these tiny cultivators would bring him sufficient excitement and joy as he trampled upon them.
“Hong!”
His leg descended from beyond the clouds.
Quite a few cultivators felt their eyes twitching. This cultivator had been publicly acknowledged as the most talented one before Xue Ying arrived in Cultivation Sacred World, yet he was about to die now?
Weather Leaf looked upwards. He did not blink at all.
“Hu.”
A palm that was similarly huge at approximately 500 kilometers long appeared. It had a white tender skin and a crystalline shine covered in a layer of warm energy. This enormous palm seemed to appear slowly, though it gave a slight dredge! And ‘Weather Leaf’ was pulled into his palm. Following that, the palm simply kept back.
“Peng!”
As the huge leg came down, it stepped onto the snowy plain, causing the snow-filled ground to tremble and shatter.
It stepped on nothing!
Weather Leaf did not die!
The eyes of the Sea of Abyss Master widened. He saw as a towering figure, a white-robed young man, stand before him. He was similarly 4,000 kilometers tall! Both parties exchanged glances, and that white-robed young man gave a grin.
“You, you…” The Sea of Abyss Master did not dare believe it, “Monarch Flying Snow?”
He could recognize with a glance that this was the first target he chose among the weak cultivators! But he had clearly stomped the other party to death earlier.
Yet this Monarch Flying Snow before him was 4,000 kilometers tall. He did not give off a powerful life aura, and it was still at the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body Level.
How could this be?
The surrounding was in his law domain. The laws of this Cultivation Sacred World had even been forced away. It should be impossible for even World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeforms to teleport into his law domain! How could this Monarch Flying Snow appear from thin air? Furthermore, just a weak tiny ant who was not a Chaotic Origin Lifeform… how could he maintain his body at 4,000 kilometers within his law domain?
“You did not die?” The Sea of Abyss Master could not help, “How could you not die?”
“You can’t kill me.” Xue Ying said.
That’s right.
Previously, his fleshy body had been destroyed. But now that he could control the World Energy in the entire Cultivation Sacred World and part of the World’s Origin Source Energy, he was able to rapidly condense a fleshy body right before the Sea of Abyss Master because he merely had a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body! Using the Origin Source Energy of a World, condensing such a weak fleshy body could be done in an instance!
After condensing his fleshy body, Xue Ying supported it with part of the Origin Source Energy from the world. Every single action of his was even boosted with the World Energy across the entire Cultivation Sacred World. Hence, he could easily maintain a height of 4,000 kilometers within the law domain of the Sea of Abyss Master.
Much less 4,000 kilometers, he could easily maintain a height of 40,000 kilometers of 400,000 kilometers.
Just that for the sake of saving the cultivators… 4,000 kilometers would be more appropriate.
‘This law domain.’ Xue Ying felt it. The suppression from this law domain was not that strong. At least for him whose every action included the magnificent power from the world. But laws were still laws! In the law domain, teleportation was forbidden. Even Xue Ying could not do so. Rather, he could easily condense his fleshy body at any place within the world. But once his fleshy body was formed, he could no longer teleport.
Unless he flew out of the Sea of Abyss Master’s law domain.
As long as he left the region.
Being the World Emissary! Xue Ying could easily teleport within the Cultivation Sacred World.
…
“This, this…”
“This is Monarch Flying Snow?”
“Did he not die? Why would he appear from thin air and is so big too?”
At this moment, many other cultivators that were fleeing in different directions felt dumbstruck. For a moment, they could not comprehend what just happened.
He broke through to the Chaotic Origin Level?
Clearly it wasn’t! The aura of Monarch Flying Snow was still at the Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Level. How could he maintain his body at such a height?
‘I, I’m saved?’ On the palm of Xue Ying, Weather Leaf was slightly stunned. This palm was close to 500 kilometers long. And Weather Leaf was currently looking up at the towering Monarch Flying Snow as well as the other similarly tall Sea of Abyss Master. He could not help but feel confused, ‘But he hasn’t reached the Chaotic Origin Level, so how could this…’
He dared to stand at odds with a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform despite not becoming a Chaotic Origin Lifeform?
That was completely illogical!
“I do not know how you were able to survive, and neither do I know how you can maintain such a huge fleshy body in my Law Domain, but you are ultimately just a tiny ant who isn’t even a Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Just die!” The 16 tentacles of the Sea of Abyss Master danced, shattering even the surrounding void. It brought with it a huge destructive force as it came down on Xue Ying.
“Sou.”
Xue Ying moved.
When he acted, his body left behind countless images.
Each image grabbed hold of a cultivator. Another simply grabbed yet another cultivator…
The Sea of Abyss Master tried to attack, only for Xue Ying to save several more cultivators in his direction. After that, Xue Ying went on to save even more cultivators from other directions.
“So fast.”
“His speed…”
The Sea of Abyss Master originally wanted to kill Xue Ying, yet Xue Ying was too fast. He easily cast the Sea of Abyss Master behind and went on to save other cultivators.
In terms of speed, the Sea of Abyss Master was being dragged down by the shackles from the sealing arrays, reducing his speed significantly. He had an advantage over the weak cultivators. When he encountered Xue Ying, someone who had been boosted by the World Energy and had a speed not any slower than a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform, the Sea of Abyss Master was slightly stunned.
“Everyone leave.” As Xue Ying saved the cultivators, he controlled the World Energy as well. This surging World Energy swept along the scattered 10,000 over cultivators, significantly boosting their speed.
“Save? Do you think you can save them?” The Sea of Abyss Master was not foolish. If he followed behind Xue Ying, it was impossible for him to reach Xue Ying at all.
But, there were cultivators running in different directions.
If he pursued them, it would still be relatively easy for him!
“Hu.”
The Sea of Abyss Master began dashing at high speed. He used his fastest speed to dash towards the cultivators in a particular direction.
“Die for me!” The Sea of Abyss Master exerted his full strength, waving all 16 tentacles of his. Those tentacles were like sky pillars as they came down. This was when the Sea of Abyss Master exerted his full strength, causing it to cast down over a huge region. It was still possible for him to kill dozens of cultivators with one strike.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying naturally dashed over at the first moment. “Sou sou sou…” His speed was several times faster than the Sea of Abyss Master’s, allowing him to obstruct those waving tentacles of the Sea of Abyss Master. He held a spear of over 10,000 kilometers in his right hand, waving it as he tried to block all incoming tentacles.
“Block me? You are just an ant who isn’t even a Chaotic Origin Lifeform and you dare to block me directly?” The Sea of Abyss Master became crazier, “Die!”
“Peng peng peng peng peng peng!”
Those 16 tentacles fiercely struck out. Even if they were suppressed completely by the shackles, they were still powerful.
“Weng~”
Xue Ying was forced backwards until he flew to a distance several hundred thousand kilometers away. And only after he took three steps back did he finally stabilize himself.
‘Even though the Cultivation Sacred World is very stable, with a voluminous amount of ordinary Chaotic Origin Lifeforms living here and trapping even Chaotic Origin Prisoners, in terms of its Origin Source and World Energy… it is a thousand or ten thousand times weaker as compared to an Origin World. I can control so must World Energy yet I am suppressed by a greatly weakened World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform.’ Xue Ying mumbled inwardly.
But at this moment.
Other than Xue Ying, all other living beings were shocked.
“He, he… he actually parried against the World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform?”
“But according to his aura, Monarch Flying Snow is not even a Chaotic Origin Lifeform right?”
“Even if the Sea of Abyss Master has been significantly weakened, he is still at the High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform Level. How can this be! How is it possible?”
The cultivators were puzzled.
Previously, they witnessed how fast Xue Ying was in saving the cultivators and evading the attacks. They originally thought it was some unique movement technique. But clashing directly, even if he was forced backwards, was a whole new level. It represented both parties were of the same level. Even if the Sea of Abyss Master was greatly weakened, the current strength of that Xue Ying should be at the High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform Level. It was considered even at the peak of all High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
How could this be possible?
“Monarch Flying Snow, how is this possible?” In the distance, the tall and thin black-robed male watched and was astonished by what he saw. He as a Hall Spirit could not fathom what he was seeing.
“Are you deliberately concealing your strength? You must have become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform already right? You are already a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform! And you are just disguising yourself with the aura of a weak cultivator, am I right?” The Sea of Abyss Master roared. Even though he roared, he was still filled with plenty of perplexities. For instance, he as a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform should be able to sense Xue Ying if he underwent an Ultimate Awakening and broke through to become a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
On the other hand, when he trampled Xue Ying to death, he had discovered that Xue Ying did not have any Chaotic Origin Bloodline at all.
Hence, according to logic, he would have to break through by force! But that would result in the other party becoming grand Overlord, an existence that could pinch him to death easily.
“Impossible, this shouldn’t be the case.” The Sea of Abyss Master was completely dazed.
…
Much less them, even the Chaotic Origin Experts that were watching the proceedings in the Cultivation Sacred World were confused too.
Within the endless Chaotic Origin Dimension.
There was a huge spherical floating stone. This stone was as huge as a planet. On it were several small houses.
Just outside a house, there was a red-nosed old man standing there. He had a wine gourd hanging by the side of his waist. His gaze was cast in the direction of the Chaotic Origin Expert. He was none other than the patrol of this seventh region——World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert, ‘Scarlet Peak Daoist’. Of course, this avatar that was responsible for watching over many places was just an avatar, a very ordinary avatar.
His Prime Avatar was responsible for guarding and for battling! It could not be here just acting as a sentry.
And his Prime Avatar was very far away from the Cultivation Sacred World.
‘This Sea of Abyss Master did not reach Grand Perfection in that trapped state within the Cultivation Sacred World. And he had even chosen to conceal his strength, breaking through to Grand Perfection first before advancing into a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform in one fell swoop! This consecutive breakthrough… shows how frightening his potential is. Given enough time, it might even be possible for him to reach the peak level of a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform. We must eliminate this threat.’ Scarlet Peak Daoist watched from afar.
Currently, the magnificent Overlord had already sent one of the Prime Avatars belonging to a World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert nearby.
However, it would take some time for him to travel through the endless Chaotic Origin Dimension.
‘I hope he can reach early and eliminate the threat. Otherwise, it might just grow into a calamity.’ Scarlet Peak Daoist sniffed. He sighed inwardly.
He continued watching.
He watched as the Sea of Abyss Master trampled those cultivators to death.
As he watched, Scarlet Peak Daoist felt a slight heartache. But he could do nothing as his Prime Avatar was too far away. And this weak little avatar could not achieve anything even if it went.
“Mn?”
Scarlet Peak Daoist suddenly widened his eyes.
What did he see?
A white-robed young man 4,000 kilometers high? That cultivator called Monarch Flying Snow?
‘This, how could this be possible? He did not have any Chaotic Origin Bloodlines, and he hasn’t reached the Chaotic Origin Level either… but, but he… what? He could parry directly against a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform?’ Scarlet Peak Daoist was even more startled after that. Seeing as the full-powered attack from 16 tentacles belonging to Sea of Abyss Master had just forced Xue Ying backed a few steps, Scarlet Peak Daoist was even more stunned.
He could not understand this.
It was illogical!
…
“This…” Across the endless Chaotic Origin Dimension, quite a few Chaotic Origin Experts had paid notice to this little Cultivation Sacred World. Because they were all worried that the Sea of Abyss Master might be saved. Nonetheless, they were able to witness something unimaginable.
“How can this be? Overlord, is it possible for a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform to exert equivalent strength to a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Expert?”
…
Many Chaotic Origin Experts felt that their years of experience had been undermined. Quite a few could not help but ask the magnificent Overlords.
“I can confirm that he hasn’t become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform!” An Overlord sent down the news.
“He has controlled the World Energy of that world. This is strange. He hasn’t refined the Origin Source of the World yet he could completely grasp the World Energy and control part of the Origin Source Energy of that world. Dong Bo Xue Ying, this brat is really interesting. Perhaps it might be related to his comprehension in the soul?” Overlord ‘Yuan’ also gave an answer.
At this moment.
The high existences amidst the endless Chaotic Origin Dimension, the Chaotic Origin Experts were paying notice to this cultivator that had completely overthrown their understanding of cultivators, ‘Dong Bo Xue Ying’.

chapters.title: Chapter 1382 - Finally Becoming Chaotic Origin (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1382: Finally Becoming Chaotic Origin (1)
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Xue Ying’s previous attainments in the soul had already triumphed the entire Chaotic Origin Dimension. And now, his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm had reached the final realm!
When a Dao reached the final realm, it would have new abilities. Ordinary final realm Dao Cultivators, could completely conceal his aura, hide his karma, have a significant improvement in his movement and fleeing techniques, and many other more.
As for a Dao on the soul aspect…
Never had anybody reached the final realm!
Xue Ying was the first. When he broke through, his soul could easily fuse into the Origin Source of the world. As long as the Origin Source of the world existed, his soul would remain eternal. He could simply condense a fleshy body at any location in this world with a thought! By controlling part of the Origin Source Energy, he could even activate the World Energy across the entire world, significantly boosting his strength.
His strength was dependent on the world.
The stronger the world, the greater the strength he could exhibit! And this was only one of the amazing points after reaching the final realm in the Dao of Soul. There were other aspects too yet Xue Ying did not have the time to ponder over time after his recent breakthrough.
…
Xue Ying held on to the spear. His spear had been condensed from World Energy. Its surface was even covered in World Energy, making it very powerful.
The other hand of his was continually pulling the cultivators away!
He also controlled the World Energy to push the cultivators away, allowing their speed to significantly increase. At the same time, he was pulling those cultivators onto his palm too to prevent the Sea of Abyss Master from trampling them to death.
“Damn.”
The Sea of Abyss Master was becoming wild and angry.
He wanted to kill those cultivators, yet Monarch Flying Snow was much faster than he, easily saving everyone.
Even if he rampantly threw his tentacles around to kill those cultivars… this Monarch Flying Snow seemed to be able to react in time and save them.
“Hu hu hu…” Ever since Xue Ying became a little more vigilant, ensuring his distance from the Sea of Abyss Master is kept to a minimum, then he would have time to easily snatch away the cultivators right before the Sea of Abyss Master.
“If you dare, fight with me!” The Sea of Abyss Master roared angrily, “Don’t run around! Just come and fight me if you dare!”
“Hu.”
His tentacles waved. That white-robed young man’s figure blurred, preventing those tentacles from touching him at all.
His speed was too fast!
“Damn, damn. These array shackles!” The Sea of Abyss Master blasted his tentacles around. Those shackles that were pulled taut had completely affected his strength, weakening the Sea of Abyss Master greatly. The biggest effect it had on him was his speed! His speed… was most likely at a rate that even new High-Grade Chaotic Origin Lifeforms could surpass him.
He was filled with grief and indignation.
Watching as Xue Ying’s figure moved around like an apparition, easily saving everyone and following him blindly. That prevented him from killing anybody at all.
“How could this be?” The Sea of Abyss Master could not understand what was happening.
…
As the World Energy engulfed all cultivators, greatly increasing their escaping speed, finally, there were some cultivators that ran out of the law domain belonging to the Sea of Abyss Master.
The moment they reached outside of the law domain.
“Sou sou sou…”
Those cultivators disappeared one after another.
Xue Ying swept his gaze across with a smile. It’s he who controlled the World Energy to teleport those cultivators away! Even though the law suppression in this Cultivation Sacred World prevented one from teleporting, what it suppressed was outsiders. The World Master would naturally not be affected. As a World Emissary, Xue Ying could move part of the Origin Source Energy. Hence, he could easily achieve this as well.
“Mn?” The Sea of Abyss Master also noticed that those cultivators that fled outside his law domain had actually disappeared.
“They escaped?” The Sea of Abyss Master immediately moved. He tried to engulf all cultivators within his law domain.
Nonetheless, the cultivators had fled in all directions.
If he ran in one direction, cultivators escaping in another direction would easily escape out of his law domain.
“Sou sou sou…” One after another, more cultivators left his law domain and were teleported away. The Sea of Abyss Master was helpless. His law domain was clashing with the laws of this Cultivation Sacred World. Hence, he could only maintain this region of size.
And the number of cultivators Xue Ying saved increased over time.
He had single-handedly hauled close to 2,000 cultivators. The other cultivators had been teleported away using his World Energy after they left the law domain.
‘The last one.’ Xue Ying pulled up the final cultivator, glanced at that incredibly indignant Sea of Abyss Master who had already stopped.
“I’ll come back and find you in a while.” Xue Ying immediately transformed into a stream of light and flew away.
If he used his entire strength to fly, his speed was much faster.
After he flew out of the Sea of Abyss Master’s law domain, Xue Ying teleported away.
******
When he appeared, he was before an ancient palace. This palace sat here lonely. The time-space around it was distorted.
This was none other than the ‘Guiding Hall’, the most mysterious place in the entire Cultivation Sacred World.
The Guiding Hall was a place where every cultivator would first arrive. After that, the Guiding Hall would then bring the cultivators away to one of the five assembly grounds! After they left, even though they might travel all over the Cultivation Sacred World to hunt for food, they had never been able to find this Guiding Hall anymore.
At this moment.
The Guiding Hall was actually filled with a vast number of cultivators.
“The Guiding Hall.”
“We have actually arrived at the Guiding Hall.”
The cultivators looked around them. They were all exclaiming in surprise.
“Did Monarch Flying Snow send us over? Didn’t they say it is impossible to teleport in the Cultivation Sacred World? How could we get teleported here then?”
“How strong is Monarch Flying Snow exactly?”
“Too formidable. He can even fight with that World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform directly? Even if the strength of the Chaotic Origin Lifeform has been significantly weakened, that is simply too powerful. I highly doubt that Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor who has become a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform could fight with him directly.”
They were all discussing with one another.
Seeing the emergence of a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform, they were then being pursued and killed. But now, they had escaped from death… all of them felt their hearts rippling. At the same time, the one that shocked them the most is Monarch Flying Snow! They had personally seen Monarch Flying Snow trampled to death, yet he survived after that? And was this strong too?
“We can’t really determine the strength of Monarch Flying Snow now.”
“He must have become more powerful! If we broke through to the Chaotic Origin Level, perhaps we might be able to understand.” The cultivators discussed with one another.
But they did not know that even if they broke through to the Chaotic Origin Level, they would still not understand.
“Hu——”
A towering white-robed young man 4,000 kilometers tall appeared by the side. He lightly placed down his left hand and opened it, causing those 2,000 cultivators to feel puzzled as they looked around them. Following that, they turned towards Xue Ying with a bow, showing him their gratitude.
“Many thanks Monarch Flying Snow for saving our lives.”
“Many thanks Monarch Flying Snow for saving us.”
They said to him.
Even the 10,000 over cultivators that had been teleported over began bowing in gratitude. As the close to 2,000 cultivators walked out from Xue Ying’s palm, only then did Xue Ying keep his palm and shrink his body size down back to his normal appearance.
“Hu.”
A black-robed tall and thin male appeared. He looked at Xue Ying with sparkly eyes.
“Have you become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform?” The black-robed male could not help but ask.
“I haven’t.” Xue Ying replied.
The black-robed male was slightly disappointed. At the same time, he was more bewildered.
“I have sent all cultivators over here. You can temporarily send them away.” Xue Ying said.
“Rest assured. Hand it over to me.” The black-robed male confidently said. Since the cultivators were in the Guiding Hall, he was naturally confident of his skills.
Xue Ying nodded softly: “I’ll go over to deal with that Sea of Abyss Master.”
“Be careful.” The black-robed male reminded. Even though he could not understand how Xue Ying could survive and become so powerful, he understood that what Monarch Flying Snow showed was genuine. He would definitely become an incredibly powerful existence across the endless Chaotic Origin Dimension, “He is ultimately a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform and he knows many secret techniques that are frightening. You have merely just exchanged one move with him earlier so you must remember not to be too careless.”
“Rest assured.” Xue Ying laughed.
He had never been afraid before.
As long as the Origin Source of this world existed, he would not die in this world.
Xue Ying looked at the other cultivators. He exchanged looks with Weather Leaf and some other friends that he was closer to, nodding to them before sighing inwardly. Several thousand cultivators had still died.
‘Time for me to return.’ With a thought, Xue Ying teleported away.
******
In the endless wilderness.
The Sea of Abyss Master sat there with many shackles permeating into his body. He waited silently, waiting for someone to save him.
‘I can’t even kill all those tiny ants. But honestly, how does Monarch Flying Snow have that kind of strength?’ The Sea of Abyss Master pondered over the question. Even until now, he could not understand it.
“Hu.”
In the distance, a towering white-robed figure appeared.
“You are here.” The Sea of Abyss Master abruptly stood. His eyes were filled with killing intent.
“Yes I am. I was just saving the others, which I guess have disappointed you.” Xue Ying chuckled, “But now, we can fight all we want!”
An opportunity to battle with a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform was rare. He naturally had to treasure this opportunity.
Even though the other party was suppressed! That’s just now too since Xue Ying could only exert part of the Origin Source Energy of this world and he might not be able to overcome a full-powered Sea of Abyss Master.
“Alright. Even though you have saved more than half of those tiny ants, it’s fine. If I could kill you, that’ll be much more worth it than killing those ants.” The eyes of the Sea of Abyss Master flashed with a murderous light.
“Bring it on.” Xue Ying held onto his spear.
…
In his hometown Primal Chaos Void.
Xue Ying stood by himself within the vast Primal Chaos Void. Even though he could not slowly research into what was new after reaching final realm in his Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm and had to go save the other cultivators in the Cultivation Sacred World! Xue Ying’s other avatars in the Realm Heart Great Land and his hometown Primal Chaos Void were all thoroughly comprehending and experiencing the new Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, trying to think of new ways to utilize the Dao.
‘Mirage and Illusory Realm.’
Xue Ying’s right hand pointed out. A ball of light formed on his fingertip. Next, a world appeared within the ball of light. It was transforming with many living beings gradually emerging. The flow of time in that world moved much faster than the outer world.
‘How should I make use of it? What kind of auxiliary effect does it have on me? How can I use it against the enemy? Is it of any help to my fleshy body?’
Xue Ying pondered.
Gradually, more and more newfound comprehensions began appearing in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 1383 - Finally Become Chaotic Origin (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1383: Finally Become Chaotic Origin (2)
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
In the quiet Primal Chaos Void, Xue Ying was filled with joy. He discovered that there were many things that he could comprehend.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying had almost instantaneously poured his concentration on fusing both his ‘fleshy body and soul’.
Because after deducing for a while, many ideas about how he could fuse the ‘Dao of Void’ that reached Half-Chaotic Origin Level and his ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’ emerged.
‘Fusion of the fleshy body and the soul. This path is possible.’
All his avatars back in his hometown Origin World and Realm Heart Great Land were focusing on grasping this point.
Because this path was a Dao path that could enable him to jump out of the cage to reach the Chaotic Origin Level.
“Mn?”
Just as he started deducing, Xue Ying had an idea in his heart given his current realm what would be expected.
Reaching the ‘Final Realm’ in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm represented reaching Grand Perfection in this Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm.
And the ‘Half-Chaotic Origin Level’ of his Dao of Void was actually in reality, absorbing various other laws and profound mysteries on the original ‘Dao of Void Final Realm’ foundation. Like Xue Ying, Monarch Ardent Creek, Xun Yi, and other Dao of Void cultivators, even though they had all decided to advance to the Half-Chaotic Origin Level on their original foundation of the Dao of Void, they had different Dao paths.
Xue Ying’s Dao path was to evolve his Dao of Void to imbue laws on the ‘Chaotic Origin Void’. If he were to break through by force, every action of his would be filled with endless Chaotic Origin Energy.
‘Previously, I have felt that I can no longer improve any further after reaching the Half-Chaotic Origin Level in my Dao of Void. There is no longer any path ahead.’
‘But now, I feel that if the Dao of Soul is to fuse with other Daos, I can easily catalyze a transformation in my Dao of Void.’
Xue Ying was immensely delighted.
Just like the final touch that would turn a painting into a masterpiece, or the final touch on a painted dragon that would give it the soul, one would naturally break through the pinnacle and reach a whole new level.
And similarly, the ‘Dao of Void’ at the Half-Chaotic Origin Level was the body. This Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm that had reached the Final Realm was the final touch!
‘My fleshy body…’ Xue Ying could feel he had reached the limits in his fleshy body. But now, after reaching the final realm in his soul, gradually as he deduced out the method to fuse his fleshy body and his soul, both of them started having complementary effects and were both improving slowly.
