‘Previously, I have absorbed many profound mysteries in my Dao of Void. Only then could I reach the Half-Chaotic Origin Level. As long as I absorb the Final Realm Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm into it! Then I would directly grasp the ‘Dao’ at the Chaotic Origin Level, breaking through by force.’ Xue Ying was filled with excitement. He could clearly see the path ahead and could even deduce what he should be doing!
The fusion of both fleshy body and the soul was a Great Dao!
Both of them were innately complementary.
Hence, fusing them was simply a smooth-sailing journey!
‘Dao at the Chaotic Origin Level.’ Xue Ying was exuberant. How many cultivators had desired to reach that level? Even the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms wished to dig out the energy of their bloodline until the pinnacle. Nonetheless, their understanding and control of the ‘Dao’ was still far inferior.
According to what he understood from the Cultivation Sacred World…
Only the Overlords had grasped Dao at the Chaotic Origin Level! And all of them could exhibit unfathomable means.
‘Even though it is very smooth.’
‘I feel that if I continue cultivating on, I would not face any bottleneck at all in this path towards fusing my fleshy body and soul together, allowing me to succeed in one fell swoop.’ Xue Ying had a premonition that he was constantly improving at this moment, ‘Nonetheless, Dao at the Chaotic Origin Level is too vast. Even if I am improving at a godly speed, it would take several billion years for me to complete my fusion.’
As it was too smooth, he could easily predict how long he would need to ‘break through by force’!
Several billion years.
For a cultivator that had yet to jump out of the cage to deduce out Dao at the Chaotic Origin Level, this cultivation speed was already frightening. Several billion years was a short period to most cultivators.
…
Xue Ying’s current mood was pleasant. At this moment, this endless Chaotic Origin Dimension, this endless time-space… nobody knew that an Overlord was about to emerge in a Origin World closing in to a Great Apocalypse!
‘I shall temporarily keep it a secret and not reveal it to the public.’
‘Otherwise, I might encounter some terrifying existence that doesn’t wish for a new Overlord to emerge. And he might think of ways to eliminate me.’ Xue Ying thought.
As long as he did not say, who would know?
Furthermore.
His soul had fused into the Origin Source of the World. As long as the Origin Source of the World existed, he would not die! His avatars were also scattered across the Cultivation Sacred World, Realm Heart Great Land, and his hometown Origin World. It was not an easy task to eliminate him entirely.
‘The Dao of Soul is truly frightening.’ Xue Ying praised in his heart, ‘The moment I reach the final realm, it could be said that I am undying. Fusing it with my Half-Chaotic Origin fleshy body could even allow me to break through by force.’
He understood.
The Final Realm Dao of Soul was much more frightening than ‘Dao of Void’ that had reached Half-Chaotic Origin Level. His success in breaking through by force to the Overlord Level was 99% due to this ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’.
Until now, Xue Ying did not even know that he was the first existence that had cultivated the Dao of Soul to the final realm!
‘Origin Source of the World.’
With a thought, Xue Ying easily fused his soul into the ‘Origin Source of the World’. The ‘Origin Source of the World’ might seem small, so small that no material could enter; it was smaller than even the Black Fog Spherical Particles! But at the same time, it seemed huge… because it was fused together with every section of the entire Origin World. Its energy was also reflected upon the entire Origin World.
Hence, one could not illustrate it using size.
It was also the start, the core, and the root of this Origin World!
‘What a powerful Origin Source.’ After Xue Ying entered the Origin Source of the world with his soul, he could not help but feel startled.
In terms of size, there might be some worlds created by Chaotic Origin Experts that were bigger than this Origin World. But those worlds were usually very crude! Like the ‘Realm Heart Great Land’ for instance that was roughly on the size of an Origin World, in reality, it had been created by the most ancient Overlord ‘Yuan’, and he had paid a huge price for it.
The Origin Source of an Origin World was not crude at all. Instead, the laws infused within were all practically perfect.
All sorts of Daos were Daos that reached grand perfection.
Furthermore, when all of them fused together…
It formed into the complete law of an Origin Source. Its natural revolution gave it the ability to absorb the Chaotic Origin Energy from the vast Chaotic Origin Dimension and use it to nourish the living beings within the Origin World.
‘It’s just that my hometown Origin World seems dilapidated?’ Xue Ying could feel that the enormous Origin World seemed broken. It was also constantly expanding and would destine to be completely destroyed at the end. After destruction, all its energy would be absorbed back by the ‘Origin Source’. The Origin Source would then turn everything back into Primal Chaos. It would then absorb the external Chaotic Origin Energy and repeat the process of forming a perfect world.
If a world was broken, then let it be destroyed and form a new one in its stead.
This was one of the natural processes of the Origin Source.
‘Even if it is broken and the Origin Source of the World is damaged, its Origin Source Energy is still very powerful.’ Xue Ying was startled to find out. Currently, he could barely move part of the Origin Source Energy. But he could feel… this was a thousand to ten thousand times stronger than what he could control in the Cultivation Sacred World. There was no choice as the gap between the two worlds was too great.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying suddenly had a thought.
As he released his Mirage and Illusory Realm Domain…
“Hu.”
He realized that his Mirage and Illusory Realm Domain could cover a huge region! One had to know that before reaching the final realm in his Dao of Void, several avatars of his could cover more than half the entire Primal Chaos Void with their Void Domain.
And now, his final realm ‘Mirage and Illusory Realm Domain’… could easily cover the entire Origin World with a thought. There was even some unused energy! Clearly, this was not the limit of the Mirage and Illusory Realm Domain.
‘Is this the shape of my hometown?’ Xue Ying’s Illusory Realm Domain had covered his entire hometown including those scattered Primal Chaos Lands and cosmoses. There were simply too many living within those cosmos…
The weakest were those mortals.
And the strongest were the Cosmos Gods. Everyone was within the Illusory Realm Domain of Xue Ying. Even though he had engulfed them with his Illusory Realm, Xue Ying did not pull them into an illusion.
He was simply observing them…
‘It is diverse.’ Xue Ying praised. At this moment, he could control all living beings across the entire Origin World. Even the strongest final realm expert, Swordmaster, could not resist his Illusory Realm Domain. Xue Ying could easily pull them into it! And via the Illusory Realm Domain, Xue Ying could control the world.
“Yi?”
Xue Ying’s eyes brightened. He thought of one possibility and started getting excited. His heart accelerated. “Pu dong, pu dong”, it jumped really quickly.
‘The so-called legend that is to spread a religion! And make all living beings pay allegiance to me. The allegiance of the population and its will would affect the will of the world. It’ll also make the Origin Source of the world bow before me, allowing me to refine it easily and become its master. I can rely on this to reach the Chaotic Origin Level.’ Xue Ying thought. When an Origin World reached its late stages with the population nearing the limit, the will of the people would also represent the majority of the will of the Origin Source! If the population paid allegiance to me, it would naturally represent that the world paid allegiance to me too.
‘This path is very difficult.’
‘Different Origin Worlds have different difficulties in achieving this. For instance, the majority of the Origin Source Energy in my hometown is spent on nurturing the countless cosmos.’ Xue Ying thought.
Even though the cosmos might seem small within the Origin World, their numbers were immense!
Those countless cosmos had consumed the majority of the Origin Source Energy in the world.
‘And in reality, it is the mortals that consume the most Origin Source Energy across the cosmos.’ As Xue Ying had entered the Origin Source of the world, he could easily discern this.
For instance, only a Transcendent would emerge out of every 100 million mortals! And out of many Transcendents, only one Deity would emerge.
A voluminous number of Deities would have on World Deity appearing.
A huge number of World Deities would see just one True God forming.
Hence, speaking from the perspective of the Origin Source Energy, the total consumption by the hundred million mortals was much greater than consumed by one Transcendent.
And the huge number of World Deities would definitely consume more Origin Source Energy than a True God.
Hence——
At least in his hometown Origin World, 80% of the Origin Source Energy was used on the mortals!
In order to influence the will of the world, one had to influence the will of the mortals. The hardest part of this is the short lifespan of the mortals. Even if a generation of mortals died, a new generation would form, and one had to continue influencing them.
‘With that crude method of Sacred Master, he would only control an Origin World by spreading his religion. It is simply a joke.’ Xue Ying shook his head inwardly. He had seen before many experts in the Cultivation Sacred World, making him feel that the plot by Sacred Master is simply crude.
‘When the population acknowledges allegiance to me, the Origin Source of the World would do so.’
‘And now… I can completely make the world acknowledge me.’ Xue Ying felt his heart beating really quickly.
‘Let’s try it.’
And with a thought…
…
On a cosmos.
On a certain planet.
“Our Jun City’s Martial Institution trials are about to begin. Everyone, form a line, verify your identity before entering.” A teacher announced from within the institution. Outside the institution, there were many young men who queued up nervously. Many soldiers surrounded the place as well as they stood guard. The trials of the Martial Institution was an incredibly grand and important affair.
Not too far away, the parents and seniors of those young men waited expectantly.
Suddenly, these parents, seniors, soldiers, family, teachers of the institutions, all of them entered an illusion.
Not just them.
The entire Jun City, the entire Empire, the entire planet, the entire cosmos! Across all cosmos, Primal Chaos Void, Sacred Worlds…
Every single living being had at this moment fallen into an illusory realm.
And in the illusion… a white-robed young man appeared. They were being fed with a thought, that this white-robed young man called Xue Ying, was also the master of this Origin World.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying is the Master of the Origin World!”
“Dong Bo Xue Ying is the Master of the Origin World!”
At this moment, every single living being had admitted it right from deep down their hearts.
…
Even Forefather Tian Yu, Swordmaster, and other experts had fallen into the illusion. But Xue Ying did not feed this idea to him because these Cosmos Gods could not influence even 1% of the Origin Source.
‘I succeeded.’
At this moment when all the living beings admitted that ‘Xue Ying was the Master of the Origin World’.
Xue Ying felt it.
The Origin Source of this world… completely opened up its embrace and admitted him as the master.
‘The will of the population is also the will of the world.’
‘As the population admits that I am the Master of the Origin World, I am.’ Xue Ying chuckled. There was no need for them to acknowledge him as the ruler. All he needed to do is for everyone to agree to it.
Nonetheless, this was very difficult to achieve.
Still, the soul technique at the final realm had given him immediate success.
“Weng.”
Xue Ying’s soul began refining the Origin Source of the World. Previously, he was the ‘World Emissary’ and could barely fuse into it. But now that he was crowned as the master of the Origin Source, Xue Ying had an easy time refining it… practically a breath of time later, Xue Ying’s soul had completely refined the Origin Source.
At this moment, the Origin Source of the World became another body of Xue Ying.
“Hong!”
The incomparably huge Origin World was just like his fleshy body.
‘What a mysterious feeling.’ Xue ying marveled. This feeling that the Origin World is his fleshy body… he could feel it being broken. He could feel the world expanding constantly and becoming weaker.
But even as it was broken, the terrifying Origin Source Energy is also rapidly altering Xue Ying.
It was transforming Xue Ying’s body and soul…
And an advancement in the level of life!
Being the Master of an Origin World, he would naturally have to be a Chaotic Origin Expert. After the Origin Source of the World became part of him, it had also pushed his level of life to the World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert Level!

chapters.title: Chapter 1384 - Chaotic Origin Expert Dong Bo Xue Ying
chapters.content:
Chapter 1384: Chaotic Origin Expert Dong Bo Xue Ying
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
“Hong.”
His consciousness was ringing. The originally huge and vast Origin World had become part of him. Currently, Xue Ying’s perception of the Origin World was just like how a mortal view his own palm.
‘Truly beautiful.’
Xue Ying’s level of life rapidly rose. His consciousness continued moving higher and higher and soon, it was riding above the entire Origin World.
Xue Ying currently looked down on the entire Origin World. It was beautiful. It looked just like a light-emitting disk! Under his current ‘examination’ as a Chaotic Origin Expert, his hometown Origin World was precisely a disk that shone brightly. It was truly beautiful. It’s just that this disk was gradually expanding. Though Xue Ying could see with a glance that it was also bump and full of potholes as if its essence was thinly spread across. One could see many issues lying within.
This was an Origin World moving closer towards the Great Apocalypse.
“Hu hu hu~”
Xue Ying could clearly sense how easy the ‘Origin Source of the World’ was purifying the Chaotic Origin Energy from the endless Chaotic Origin Dimension, protecting the beings living in the Origin World. This transformation was incredibly efficient. However much it consumed would be however fast it could convert the energy. It’s just that the Origin Source of the World had a limit to how much energy it could withstand. Hence, the living beings it could support within was limited too.
‘My power is truly endless within the Origin World. Even if I consume it fast, I can easily replenish them through the Origin World.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘Nonetheless, my avatars outside in the external world would have a much harder time replenishing their energy.’
Currently, the fleshy body and soul of his avatar back at his hometown Origin World were rapidly transforming.
Both his fleshy body and soul were advancing towards the level of a World Realm Chaotic Origin Level. The fleshy body and soul at this level was too terrifying. It required a tremendous amount of energy! Only the ‘Origin Source’ of an Origin World could support this rate.
Many Chaotic Origin Experts would usually dispatch a ‘Prime Avatar’ outside primarily responsible for guarding important places or to battle! And several other avatars would be used just for patrolling, observation, and guiding the descendents. Such avatars were usually very weak!
‘At this moment, I am unrivalled within this endless Chaotic Origin Dimension.’
His avatars at his hometown, on the Realm Heart Great Land and the Cultivation Sacred World were all part of his energy.
Being a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
His energy would naturally have a limit. If an avatar was powerful, others would be weak!
Currently, an avatar of his contained 90% of his energy! The other trillion avatars would only add up to 10% of his total energy! Hence, the energy held within the weak avatars of Chaotic Origin Experts responsible for patrol and sentry were usually very weak. But even if they were weak… their quality was still at the Chaotic Origin Expert Level. Just a strand of energy was sufficient for them to Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
‘The energy that a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform has is too frightening.’
‘Even if the Prime Avatar is destroyed, the amount of energy required for a weak avatar to reach the degree of a Prime Avatar is immense… it’ll take a very very long time just to absorb sufficient energy from the endless Chaotic Origin Dimension.’ Xue Ying thought, ‘And the efficiency of absorbing it from the Origin Source of the World is much faster.’
As Xue Ying perceived the energy at the Chaotic Origin Expert Level, he gradually understood how battles were carried at this level.
For instance, if a Prime Avatar was to die in battle!
Most could easily nurture another Prime Avatar from within the Origin World before sending it out again!
As for absorbing the Chaotic Origin Energy using those weak avatars? The efficiency was too low!
“Yi?”
‘Most World Realm Chaotic Origin Experts can only absorb energy from the Origin Source of the World of their own Origin Worlds. But I am different.’ Xue Ying had an idea, ‘My soul could easily fuse into any ‘master-less’ Origin Sources. I can rapidly absorb energy from these Origin Sources.’
Xue Ying suddenly discovered that he had one unique aspect that made him different from other World Realm Chaotic Origin Experts.
That was he could form many avatars scattered across the master-less worlds and guard those places! That way, if he discovered an enemy, he could easily dissipate his Prime Avatar and let the avatar closest to the enemy absorb from the ‘Origin Source of the World’ to the level of a Prime Avatar.
‘Is this also an advantage of a cultivator that has reached the final realm in the Dao of Soul?’ Xue Ying was inwardly astonished.
It seemed that the breakthrough in the Dao of Soul had such a huge benefit to the Chaotic Origin Expert.
…
Before Xue Ying’s level of life advanced, jumping out of the cage to become a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform, all the living beings within the entire Origin World gradually woke up from the illusory realm. They had even forgotten about the thought of ‘recognizing Xue Ying as the Master of the Origin World’. Even after refining the Origin Source of the World, Xue Ying easily made them forget what they experienced in the illusory realm.
And thus, the living beings within the Origin World resumed their daily lives.
Even though Forefather Tian Yu, Swordmaster and other Cosmos Gods were not imparted with any thoughts, they felt startled and bewildered after waking up. Because Xue Ying did not conceal from them the fact that they were struck with an illusion.
‘Have I fell into an illusion? What a powerful illusory realm?’ Swordmaster was startled, ‘Was it Xue Ying?’
Ever since Xue Ying’s strength rose beyond the five Great Supremes in the Realm Heart Great Land, other Cosmos Gods like Emperor Summer and Swordmaster had frequently come to find him for teachings. They once experienced the soul technique of Xue Ying too.
Even though Swordmaster would find himself falling for it, he could barely resist the process.
But this time, he seemed to have been struck by the illusory realm silently.
‘It seems Xue Ying’s strength has increased again?’ Swordmaster was inwardly startled. But he did not know that Xue Ying had already become a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
…
Of course there was someone that knew of Xue Ying’s breakthrough.
He was none other than Luo City Lord who was currently drinking tea in a teahouse. He had watched as the surrounding beings stop all forms of activity for a breath of time, falling into a daze. Luo City Lord could sense that all living beings in the entire Origin World were struck similarly and only regained their consciousness after a breath of time.
‘Is it a Mirage and Illusory Realm? Has he reached this realm already? Is it the final realm?’ Luo City Lord was slightly startled and curious about it.
‘Dong Bo Xue Ying seems to have really walked until this level.’
‘Mn? This world has a master?’
‘World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform?’
How acute were Luo City Lord’s senses? He could easily confirm that this Origin World was no longer master-less. Following that, he discovered Xue Ying’s rapid transformation in his fleshy body and soul.
‘Haha…’ Luo City Lord laughed, he laughed exceptionally vibrantly, ‘It seems that after reaching the final realm in the Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm, the cultivator would rapidly advance to become a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform?’
‘Among all World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeforms, Dong Bo Xue Ying should be the one who specializes most in soul techniques. I wonder how far he can walk until? Could he become an Overlord?’
As long as one grasped Dao at the Chaotic Origin Level, that would represent becoming an Overlord!
Like ‘Yuan’, being the most ancient Overlord, he was the first to become a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform. And it was over years of accumulations did he finally become an Overlord.
‘Since this world has an owner, there is no need for me to stand guard here over it.’ Luo City Lord nodded slightly.
He was an Overlord.
And he was responsible for protecting vast regions of territory. Xue Ying’s hometown Origin World was precisely within the region of his territory! As Luo City Lord was afraid that this Origin World might encounter a true ‘Calamity’, he chose to arrange an avatar to guard and be a sentry over this place. Even though this avatar was weak, his realm was sufficient. Naturally, he could discover any potential danger at the first instance.
As for the Great Apocalypse? Luo City Lord did not really care about it.
The Great Apocalypse and Nascent Rebirth of an Origin World was just a natural process. It was not a ‘Calamity’.
‘I haven’t guarded it for too long and now I no longer need to do so.’ Luo City Lord chuckled.
This Origin World originally belonged to ‘Yuan’s territory.
But after Luo City Lord broke through, the other Overlords immediately re-shuffled the territories! They passed on a huge region for Luo City Lord to guard. After all, protecting a vast region was quite a tough job to the Overlords.
After re-partitioning the territories, this Origin World now belonged to Luo City Lord’s territory.
Of course——
Once a world had a new master, the World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert would be able to fight against Overlords in their own Origin World! Hence, there was no need for him to protect this place.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying, congratulations!” Luo City Lord transmitted with a chuckle.
…
“Many thanks to Luo City Lord for protecting my hometown Origin World.” Xue Ying transmitted over. He also gradually found out about this at Cultivation Sacred World that the Overlords were responsible for guarding over large pieces of regions. Even the Origin Worlds were protected by them.
“I did not really protect it for very long. It is a minor matter. But now, you are still breaking through so there is no need for you to split your attention.” Luo City Lord said.
“Mn.”
Xue Ying was indeed in the process of breaking through.
His fleshy body and soul were advancing to the next level, and he was also familiarizing himself with it.
‘The Origin World seems slightly broken. I shall first let it recover.’ With a thought, “hong~” The energy across the entire Origin World moved according to Xue Ying’s will. Originally, the Origin World that was slowly expanding started contracting. The degree of contraction was incredibly huge. The ‘Primal Chaos Void’ within the Origin World was also contracting, and the cosmos were pulled along with it.
The distance between each cosmos was also reduced, by half, one-fifth, one-tenth, one-twentieth…
Under Xue Ying’s observation, the entire Origin World rapidly recovered. This ‘disk’ that seemed broken and filled with potholes started recovering back to its original splendor. The disk contracted, and those potholes were also becoming smaller! Once the disk shrank to one-hundredth of its original size did the Origin World finally stop shrinking.
At this moment, this ‘disk’ that the Origin World manifested itself as, was incredibly delicate and glossy.
If one said that the initial Origin World was where even a brat that had not become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform could easily enter through the Great Destruction Realm Teleportation Technique, then now, it was a grand Overlord! Others could hardly penetrate into it.
It was completely sealed. No gaps were revealed.
Of course, one could still enter after gaining the permission from the World Master…!
The difference between an Origin World with a Master and one without was huge!
‘It seems to have recovered rapidly.’
Xue Ying could feel his control over the Origin World was similar to how he controlled his body.
‘No wonder others said that I can compete with Overlords within my Origin World.’ Xue Ying thought in admiration. If he sent out a punch… he could fuse the complete energy of the Origin World onto the fist. This fist would also be unfathomably strong.
Just like an Overlord, if he were to enter an ownerless Origin World, he could easily destroy it by releasing his full power.
Because the energy of an Origin World was scattered. And it could not resist against the overwhelming force! For the sake of bringing forth a Great Apocalypse, the Origin World even gave birth to Destruction Devils naturally! An Origin World could not execute effective techniques simply because it consisted only of the most fundamental laws.
But with a master…
The master could pour in all energy of this Origin World into himself! He would also be unparalleled.
******
In his hometown Origin World, on a small Primal Chaos Land where no living beings were on.
Xue Ying stood here with a bewildered look on his face.
Currently, his body was perfected. With a thought, countless grayish inscriptions could even be seen moving on his body. His eyes were deep and dark.
‘My body and my soul have both reached the Chaotic Origin Level. And this is the World Realm Chaotic Origin Level.’ Xue Ying perceived the energy in his body. His gaze could easily cast through the Origin World into the vast endless Chaotic Origin Dimension. He could even look at the Origin Worlds far beyond. His visibility had been broadened.
If he deliberately chose to, he could lock on to a region and thoroughly examine it.
This was the natural ability the ‘eyes’ a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform had.
‘Every movement of mine seems to be filled with power. Right now, any punch of mine would contain the profound mysteries at the Chaotic Origin Level.’ Xue Ying frowned and shook his head, ‘But even if I can use it, it doesn’t mean I have comprehended the essence.’
Just like a mortal, he could use a bow and arrow to attack an enemy.
But how was the bow and arrow crafted? Why could it be so strong? What profound mysteries were held in the bow itself? And how unique was the arrow?
The mortal did not have to know them yet he could still use it.
But if one comprehended the essence, then things were no longer similar! For instance, by clearly understanding how the bow and arrow was crafted, one could know how to make the bow stronger! Or what material one could use to craft the arrow to increase its power! Or perhaps, one could even refine the material itself! Once one thoroughly understood it, he could go on and craft the most perfect bow and arrow!
That was the case for ‘Overlords’. They comprehended Dao at the Chaotic Origin Level and could push their level of life to the highest level——the Overlord Class. During battles, they could also greatly unleash their strength completely different from others.
‘Chaotic Origin Experts have to cultivate and comprehend the profound mysteries too. The more they grasp, the greater the strength of their body and soul they could unveil.’ Xue Ying thought.
If one dug the strength of his body to the pinnacle, that would mean reaching the peak of a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
If one wanted to advance further… to the Overlord Class?
One had to comprehend ‘Dao’ at the Chaotic Origin Level. This was also what every World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert desire.
…
Xue Ying had accumulated the deepest knowledge in both the ‘Dao of Void’ and the ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’.
Hence, Xue Ying could easily grasp part of the profound mysteries of the ‘Dao of Void’ at the Chaotic Origin Level inherent on his body. He could even execute several techniques with it! At the same time, he was also examining his soul, deducing several techniques out. Every World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform had something they were good at. And for now, Xue Ying specialized in both Dao of Void and his Mirage and Illusory Realm.
‘Oh right, there is something important I have to do.’ Xue Ying turned towards the boundary of the Primal Chaos Void, ‘Sared Master! It is time for me to eliminate him!’
“Peng.”
With a thought, the Lost World Corridor that originally nurtured the Destruction Devils, shattered apart. All Destruction Devils hiding within, other than Sacred Master, had all died.
“There is no need for my Origin World to have any Destruction Devils.” Xue Ying muttered lightly. Destruction Devils were born to bring forth destruction. Xue Ying disliked it a lot. There were naturally other means to train the living beings in his Origin World. These Destruction Devils that loved massacres, would best be eliminated. At the Realm Heart Great Land for instance, they did not have any Destruction Devils at all.
“Sacred Master.”
Xue Ying sneered.
Even after becoming a Chaotic Origin Expert, his killing intent towards Sacred Master had not decreased.
…
‘What?’
Sacred Master who had been hiding in the Lost World Corridor all along, felt that the entire Origin World had transformed. He was shocked. Reaching his level, he could sense that the Origin World was no longer moving towards a Great Apocalypse.
And all of a sudden, the Origin World was rapidly recovering. The Origin Source of the World was also growing in strength! It seemed to have contracted the Primal Chaos Void?
The Lost World Corridor was becoming closer to the ‘Ancient Sacred World’ too.
‘What is happening?’ Sacred Master was stunned.
The Primal Chaos Void had always been expanding. Why did it contract all of a sudden? And its rate of contracting was too terrifying.
It seemed to be half its original size? One-tenth? One-twentieth?
Sacred Master was at a loss!
‘What exactly is happening?’ Sacred Master had a strand of terror gnawing at his heart. He had guessed of something possible, ‘Does it mean that a new master has emerged in this Origin World?’
He always sought to grasp an Origin World, though it seemed an expert had achieved it?
“Peng!”
The surrounding Lost World Corridor dimension suddenly exploded and shattered.
Sacred Master looked around him vacantly. Everything seemed to shatter. The entire Lost World Corridor seemed to disappear. Even the Destruction Devils were wiped, leaving behind just he, Sacred Master.
“Hu.” A white-robed young man appeared in front.
Sacred Master looked at that white-robed young man who stepped through the void over. The other party’s aura seemed vast and grand. He, Sacred Master, could not help but soften and kneel down. Just as he knelt down, Sacred Master immediately gritted his teeth to stand. He glared at Xue Ying as he tried resisting against the unseen pressure, so much that his lower body was trembling. He bit his teeth so hard that blood started trickling.
“Dong Bo Xue Ying!” Sacred Master stared at Xue Ying, “Have you succeeded in reaching this stage? Have you grasped this Origin World and become a Chaotic Origin Expert?”
Xue Ying merely looked at him. He did not say much.
“Do you want to kill me or to torture me?” Sacred Master growled. He knew that given what he had done in the past, it was normal even if Xue Ying chose to torture him for long periods. Currently, he was like an ant before Xue Ying, where he had no strength to resist at all.
“Torture?”
Xue Ying shook his head, “It is best that you disappear from this world forever.”
“Weng.”
Sacred Master was wiped! Not even a single dust was left behind from his existence.
Xue Ying shook his head slightly. At the moment when he saw Sacred Master, he could see how vast the gap in life they were. And Xue Ying chose to simply wipe the other party away.
‘Teacher.’ Xue Ying thought about his Teacher Gu Qi. He had never chatted with the true body of Gu Qi before.
‘There is a chance.’ Xue Ying grinned.
‘There is also father, mother, and many other people.’ Xue Ying chuckled.
He could easily sense all living beings that had emerged in the history of this ‘Origin World’! From the first era since the emergence of this Origin World, right from the first life… and all lives that had been birthed in the history of the Origin World were within Xue Ying’s control. Naturally, all living beings in this era were also within his grasp. And now, his father, his mother, little brother, Uncle Tong, Uncle Zong, his Teacher Gu Qi…
As long as they were lives that appeared in the history of this Origin World before, from being as weak as a mortal to as strong as a CosmosGod!
As long as they had not become Chaotic Origin! Xue Ying could move their souls from the era that they died before to the present, easily making them eternal.
This was a technique that the ‘Origin World Master’ could execute.
Life and death? Past and future?
They no longer held much meaning to the master of an Origin World. No matter what, in his Origin World, past or present, life or death, as long as they had not become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform, they were all within the grasp of the Origin World Master.
‘My current soul is way stronger than that when I was a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform.’ Xue Ying exclaimed inwardly, ‘I have predicted that it would take me approximately one billion years before I can completely fuse my Dao of Void at the Half-Chaotic Origin Level with my Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm perfectly. But it seems my soul has become much stronger than before.’
The soul of a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform is indeed several times higher than the soul of a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
Currently, in his mind, his Dao of Void was constantly absorbing the profound mysteries from his ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’ that reached the final realm. They were also fusing together at a very rapid pace.
‘Estimatedly…’
‘I should be able to succeed in fusing them within four hours?’ Xue Ying mumbled inwardly, ‘By then, I’ll become an Overlord?’

chapters.title: Chapter 1385 - Could not Hold on any Longer!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1385: Could not Hold on any Longer!
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
‘Reaching the realm of a Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform with a final realm in the Dao of Soul, I would not encounter any bottlenecks in my cultivation towards Overlord. This is an absolute path.’ Xue Ying felt puzzled inwardly, ‘Dao Cultivators at the Half-Chaotic Origin Level are quite commonly seen. There are several dozens of them just within Cultivation Sacred World itself. There are definitely many more of them across the endless Chaotic Origin Dimension. But why have I never heard of a cultivator becoming an Overlord simply after reaching the final realm in his Dao of Soul?’
He had never heard of this before!
So that meant…
Before him, there should not be any cultivator who succeeded!
In the vast endless Chaotic Origin Dimension, he could very well be the only one to reach final realm in the Dao of Soul!
‘Right.’
‘So, the reason why the Sea of Abyss Master could not understand what happened when I borrowed the strength of the World Energy to fight with him, is because he hasn’t heard of this before.’ Xue Ying was becoming more and more confident that this was the reason.
******
At Cultivation Sacred World.
The Sea of Abyss Master who was completely permeated with shackles, roared. Those shackles were pulled taut, making it hard for the Sea of Abyss Master to move or do anything at all. His 16 tentacles waved in the world, letting out clanging sounds as they flew at Xue Ying.
“Peng peng peng~”
Both parties fought, creating blasting sounds along the way.
Of the two 4,000 kilometers giant fighting, the Sea of Abyss Master had countless inscriptions carved on his body. Even his skin membrane layer contained endless profound mysteries. During battle, some of the energy moving on the surface of his body shows the usage of laws at the Chaotic Origin Level. Compared to him, Xue Ying was clearly much cruder! At this moment, the aura Xue Ying gave off had not even reached the Chaotic Origin Level! His combat techniques were very crude too as they were still at the Half-Chaotic Origin Level.
Fortunately, Xue Ying had part of the Origin Source Energy boosting his strength. The World Energy in the entire Cultivation Sacred World was also for him to control. In addition to his overwhelming advantage in his speed, that was how he could still fight.
Even so… out of eight to ten moves, Xue Ying would not be able to block one of them.
“Hu.”
A tentacle pierced over like a shadow.
Xue Ying tried defending himself with his spear, yet when the tentacle came, it produced a mysterious ripple which caused its speed to seem fast and slow at the same time. Time and space had been affected. Xue Ying actually parried against nothing with his spear.
“Pu.” That tentacle pierced through the chest of Xue Ying. It was fortunate that Xue Ying was covered everywhere with a thick layer of World Energy. When the tentacle barely pierced through the layer of World Energy, it pierced into his chest. Nonetheless, the Origin Source Energy easily suppressed the wound around the chest from worsening.
Xue Ying rapidly retreated. His injuries recovered as he did.
‘My speed is much faster than his. His techniques and moves are so slow yet I still could not defend against him?’ Xue Ying had a sullen feeling as if he was a fool. Those techniques which he was proud of had seemed to be a sideshow against the profound techniques of the enemy! It was also due to his overwhelming advantage in speed that gave him a chance to fight back.
“Sou sou sou…”
Xue Ying was trying to play to his strength. He maximized his advantage in speed. The Sea of Abyss Master tried defending against Xue Ying. But the other party’s speed was too slow. The ‘black-robed tall and thin male’ was even controlling those array shackles with varying force, pulling it taut at times and letting it loose, frustrating the Sea of Abyss Master. This enormous inferiority in speed had made him suffer from the occasional strikes.
“Pu.” The spear pierced into the neck of the Sea of Abyss Master.
Every single part of his body was covered with a thick skin membrane layer. As the skin membrane layer was pierced, it immediately emitted a vibrant water light as if there was a millstone shaving away the force from Xue Ying’s spear! This technique which incorporated the World Energy had simply been blocked by the ‘surface skin membrane layer’. Xue Ying could not even break through the skin at all.
‘Even though these sealing arrays are suppressing his strength, his fleshy body is still that powerful.’ Xue Ying understood in his heart that the current sealing arrays could not injure the Sea of Abyss Master at all! It was only suppressing the other party. And the fleshy body of the Sea of Abyss Master had completely recovered. Even if he stood there allowing Xue Ying to strike him, Xue Ying would still fail to break through his skin.
This was the gap between one with the combat strength of a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform and one with the combat strength of a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
…
During the process of the mad fighting, as he directly defended against an attack sent by eight tentacles, suddenly, with a ‘peng’, the spear in Xue Ying’s hand exploded into powder. As a result, Xue Ying was forced to retreat and pull a distance between them.
“You don’t even have a good weapon.” The Sea of Abyss Master sneered.
Xue Ying had no choice.
The spear in his hand had been condensed from some of the Origin Source Energy in this Cultivation Sacred World before covering it on the outside with a layer of World Energy! Its toughness was limited. It was due to the slightly lower combat strength exhibited by the Sea of Abyss Master that let the spear survive until now.
“Mn?”
Xue Ying suddenly felt something. He revealed a joyous look.
At this moment, the avatar back at his hometown Origin World had easily relied on the Mirage and Illusory Realm to influence the will of the Origin World. It had also began refining the Origin Source of the World.
‘I am about to break through.’ With a thought, Xue Ying disappeared from the location. This fleshy body had dissipated back into World Energy and returned back to the world. His soul, instead, went back to the Origin Source of this Cultivation Sacred World.
“Mn?”
“He escaped after his weapon shattered?”
The Sea of Abyss Master was stunned. This cultivator called Monarch Flying Snow had suddenly disappeared?
‘How did he escape from my law domain?’ Even until now, the Sea of Abyss Master could still not understand, ‘According to the previous exchange, his realm is still at the Half-Chaotic Origin Level and is very weak. His techniques are very crude too… if not for his overwhelming speed and the protection from the concentrated World Energy around, I’d have eliminated him.’
Suddenly, the expression of the Sea of Abyss Master changed as he turned towards one direction.
“Hong~”
The entire Cultivation Sacred World trembled. The world shook. The World Energy was also rapidly converging onto one point as a terrifying aura started emerging.
‘Chaotic Origin Expert?’ The Sea of Abyss Master paled.
‘No.’ The Sea of Abyss Master widened his eyes in disbelief, ‘This is a World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert!’
Under normal circumstances, it would take a very long time for a weak avatar belonging to a Chaotic Origin Expert to absorb the surrounding Chaotic Origin Energy before it could become a Prime Avatar.
Only during the advancement in life would it rapidly devour all energy!
Just like how Nine-Headed Snake Ancestor broke through previously to become a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
Or like how the Sea of Abyss Master broke through to become a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Even under the suppression from the world, he could still devour all energy.
This breakthrough in the level of life… absorbed energy at an exaggerated pace. He could advance in a very short period!
‘It seems that there is a World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert emerging over there.’ The Sea of Abyss Master was incredibly certain. The consumption of the surging World Energy over there was so great that it forced the Origin Source of the Cultivation Sacred World to devour Chaotic Origin Energy wildly from the surrounding Chaotic Origin Dimension.
…
Xue Ying stood in the vast wilderness. He controlled the World Energy to isolate his surroundings so as to prevent anyone else from spying on him.
‘Prime Avatar.’ Xue Ying revealed a grin.
This Prime Avatar contained 90% of his current strength.
And all his other avatars scattered in his hometown Origin World and Realm Heart Great Land occupied just 10% of his energy. He had no choice. Even though his avatars were scattered around the place, in reality, they had the same consciousness and belonged to one single entity! Hence, the amount of energy he could temporarily contain had reached a pinnacle.
‘If I have sufficient time, I can properly study the profound mysteries inherent in my body and my soul.’ Xue Ying shook his head with a smile, ‘But there is no need for that either. Currently, I should focus more on fusing my ‘Dao of Void’ and ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’. I only need four hours before I’d succeed in fusing them, allowing me to grasp ‘Dao’ at the Chaotic Origin Level.’
‘But right now, my current strength is sufficient to deal with the Sea of Abyss Master.’ Xue Ying felt confident.
No matter what, the Sea of Abyss Master was merely a new World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
And he was one as well!
But his strength was not being suppressed or restricted at all.
“Hu.”
With a teleport, Xue Ying proceeded to where the Sea of Abyss Master was.
******
When Xue Ying appeared again right before the Sea of Abyss Master, the Sea of Abyss Master fell into a daze.
Don’t say him, even the Hall Spirit, that ‘black-robed tall and thin male’, and many other Chaotic Origin Experts that were paying attention to this place, were all shocked.
“World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert!”
“He broke through?”
“So fast?”
“Refining the Origin Source of a World requires him to gradually influence the will of the populace. This is a very time-consuming matter. How could he achieve it so quickly?”
Even though there were some Chaotic Origin Experts scattered across some mysterious places in the Chaotic Origin Dimension, they were still relatively happy that a new World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert had emerged! Just that Xue Ying’s breakthrough was too fast!
…
“You have truly astonished me.” The Sea of Abyss Master started at Xue Ying. He became solemn, “Why, are you planning to kill me now?”
“Naturally I am planning to kill you.”
Xue Ying nodded, “Remember not to conceal any techniques you have from now on.”
“Just based on you, a new World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert, and you think you can kill me?” The Sea of Abyss Master roared, “My bloodline is noble. Even though these sealing arrays have reduced my strength, it doesn’t alter the fact that my body is strong. You can’t kill me.”
“Oh, let us try it.” Xue Ying abruptly moved.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying was too lazy to use the World Energy any longer. Because the Origin Source of this Cultivation Sacred World was simply too weak. By using the World Energy, he could barely reach the peak of a High-Graded Chaotic Origin Lifeform. To the current Xue Ying, his strength would only increase by about 10% and that was unneeded.
At this moment, as he moved, one could see many figures appearing around the Sea of Abyss Master.
The Sea of Abyss Master became even more grave. He knew that every single avatar was a real body! This technique contained profound mysteries with a touch of Dao of Void at the Chaotic Origin Level. Furthermore, after reaching this level, his body would contain many mystical abilities. He could descend down in different spaces at the same time. And since the Sea of Abyss Master was suppressed, he could not dodge it at all.
“Pu.” A palm pierced over.
The palm was like a blade. It was imbued with the sharpness from a revolving void.
“Chi——”
That palm forced through the ‘skin membrane layer’ on the chest of the Sea of Abyss Master. His skin was covered in water light. Layers and layers of them shaved off the incoming force by Xue Ying. Xue Ying also frowned slightly as his palm blade finally pierced through the skin membrane layer! And then through the actual skin. His skin was tough too. It felt thick and heavy. Only after it cut through the skin, reaching the flesh layer did Xue Ying’s palm stop.
‘What a terrifying fleshy body.’ Xue Ying was inwardly startled, ‘It’s strength is approximately five times that of mine.’
Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms were nurtured naturally by the Chaotic Origin Dimension. They were famous for having overbearing bodies.
Cultivators that did not own any Chaotic Origin Bloodlines, even if they became a World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert! Their fleshy body would still be one level weaker. In addition to the noble bloodline that the Sea of Abyss Master had, his fleshy body was considered extremely strong even among new World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeforms. It was at least way stronger than Xue Ying’s!
But…
Even though cultivators that were birthed from Origin World had no Chaotic Origin Bloodlines, they had an enormous advantage! World Realm Chaotic Origin Experts that emerged from this background would have an Origin World as their base! In their own Origin World, they could fight against even Overlords! Their survivability was way higher than those World Realm Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
“You injured me?” The Sea of Abyss Master frowned slightly when he saw the wound and blood trickling down from his chest.
He immediately contacted his clan member via his bloodline: “Big Brother! I have actually encountered a new World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert in this Prison World! His strength might be ordinary, yet I am being suppressed. If he were to continue attacking me, I’m afraid I can only last for an hour at most!”
“Cheng Hao, my brother, you can be rest assured. After reporting upwards, the Primogenitor knows about everything you have experienced and have determined that you have the potential. He favors you a lot! As a result, he and other Primogenitors have increased the strength of assault, dispatching quite a few World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeforms over to save you. Those that are closest would not need an hour at all.”
At this moment, the Sea of Abyss Master heaved a sigh of relief. At the same time, he replied: “Big Brother, the Primogenitor really favors me a lot?”
“Haha, by then, I’ll bring you over to meet the Primogenitor.”
…
The Sea of Abyss Master was in a good mood after finding out that his comrades were about to reach, and those that were dispatched to battle were not new World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.
‘I shall let you rejoice temporarily. In a while, the outcome is going to change.’ The Sea of Abyss Master looked at Xue Ying before him. As his speed had been reduced, he could still fight with the previous Half-Chaotic Origin Lifeform Body Xue Ying who borrowed the strength of World Energy. But now, facing Xue Ying who was similarly a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform, he was completely utterly being suppressed!
Xue Ying’s body became blurred. He appeared at different locations around the Sea of Abyss Master, left of him, right of him, front and back of him. Xue Ying was continuously bombarding his attacks.
And many wounds appeared on the body of the Sea of Abyss Master, albeit they were shallow.
Xue Ying did not care. In his mind, he had poured all his focus on deducing out how to fuse the ‘Dao of Void’ and ‘Dao of Mirage and Illusory Realm’ together. As he did not encounter any bottleneck during fusion, it was proceeding really smoothly. More and more comprehension started pouring in his heart. He did not even have to focus on his body, yet the strength he could execute was gradually becoming stronger.
“Hong.”
Xue Ying’s blurred figure appeared behind the Sea of Abyss Master. One fist blasted out by the side waist of the other party.
This fist.
It exploded with a strange ringing sound. Following that, the point where the fist hit started collapsing. The skin membrane layer, the skin layer, and the flesh layer of the Sea of Abyss Master collapsed as well, causing a grievous wound to form. This wound was much bigger. Part of the flesh had even collapsed and disappeared.
‘What?’ After suffering from this savage strike, the Sea of Abyss Master paled greatly. He was even starting to feel terrified, ‘How could this be? He has just broken through as a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Even if he is digging out the potential of his body and is researching out many secret techniques, the rise of his strength should be a slow and gradual process. How can it increase so quickly over this short period?’
He could not understand at all.
But he was genuinely afraid now! Because Xue Ying had many bodies circling around the Sea of Abyss Master and were all punching at him. It caused many areas of his body to collapse, worsening his injury at a rapid pace.
“Big Brother, Big Brother!” The Sea of Abyss Master sent another anxious message, “I can’t hold on for too long! Now, I can only hold on for the time taken to brew a cup of tea.”
“What? Didn’t you say you can survive for an hour? The time taken to brew a cup of tea? That’s too tight! I’ve immediately informed ‘Yan’. He is the closest to you. I’ll ask for him to rush over to your location.”
“Hurry, hurry!” The Sea of Abyss Master impatiently said.
He did not wish to die like this.
After being tortured for so long in the Cultivation Sacred World, he endured everything just so he could become a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform in one fell swoop. He had looked forward to escaping away before growing stronger and having his revenge against those cultivators in the future. If he were to die now? He felt really unwilling to!
Another five breaths of time passed.
“Mn?” Xue Ying’s eyes brightened.
His offensive techniques transformed again.
As he hurled his right arm out, it was like a spear brandishing downwards. Even though it had not touched the Sea of Abyss Master, space started breaking into pieces like a multi-layered cake. The space where the Sea of Abyss Master stood had been cut into more then ten thousand layers. It’s just that the Sea of Abyss Master’s body was too strong. Even though many wounds appeared, his body remained stable.
“Peng.”
His right arm swung out at the head of the Sea of Abyss Master~ At that moment, ten thousand layers of space shattered apart as if a chain reaction. Its power was also constantly becoming stronger. The first several thousand layers were still fine, but reaching the bottom few thousand layers, the spatial power became increasingly terrifying. It even shattered the body of the Sea of Abyss Master.
‘What?’ More than half the legs of the Sea of Abyss Master disappeared. His upper body was filled with wounds too. He stared at Xue Ying with horror, ‘This technique is so strong? I might just die in three to five moves! He, he, his strength has reached the Middle Stage World Realm Chaotic Origin Level already?’
Three to five moves.
The gap between their strength was distinct now. With such an offensive power, Xue Ying could indeed be categorised as a Middle Stage World Realm Chaotic Origin.
‘How could his strength increase so rapidly? This is a monster! A monster!’ The Sea of Abyss Master looked at Xue Ying. His eyes were raving with madness. His desire, his hope, and his hatred were all gone!
He understood that he was doomed.
‘I have nothing to say even if I die in the hands of this monster.’ The Sea of Abyss Master had become entirely despondent. He directly transmitted via his soul to his other clan members.
“Big Brother.”
“What happened? I have already informed Yan! Yan is also rushing over at the fastest speed. He said he could reach in the time taken to brew a cup of tea.”
“There is no need to come anymore! I can no longer hold on any further.”
“What! Why can’t you hold on any further?”
“The one that killed me is a new World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert called Monarch Flying Snow! He has recently broke through and is already a Middle Stage World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform. His potential is immense. If you could eliminate him, it’s best that you eliminate him early.”
Following that, the Sea of Abyss Master no longer transmitted anything via his soul anymore.
“Peng~”
Xue Ying’s arm came down once again. As it slapped downwards, the ten thousand spatial layers above had a chain reaction, blasting out against the Sea of Abyss Master. In the end, the life core that the Sea of Abyss Master had focused on protecting broke, leaving behind just some flesh and blood. Once the life core broke, it meant the Sea of Abyss Master had died! That was also a flaw that one as an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform had.
They were born powerful, yet the moment their life core broke, they would fall. Hence, they would usually focus on protecting their life core.
…
At another location far away.
A towering giant looked ahead in a daze. He could feel that ‘Cheng Hao’ from his clan died!
“Didn’t he say he can hold on for an hour? If not, at least for the time taken to brew a cup of tea? Yet he died? He simply died like that? The Primogenitors have started another assault all for you.” The towering giant murmured to himself, “Monarch Flying Snow? He is a Middle Stage World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform shortly after breaking through?”
No matter what.
This towering giant immediately reported whatever happened here to the Primogenitor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1386 - Weapon
chapters.content:
Chapter 1386: Weapon
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Hometown Origin World.
In a courtyard belonging to Xue Ying and his wife Jing Qiu, Xue Ying was currently meditating under a pavilion preparing for his breakthrough in one breath to become an ‘Overlord’.
News about becoming a Chaotic Origin Expert, news about killing Sacred Master as well as the movement of the Primal Chaos Void… Xue Ying did not share this with Forefather Tian Yu, Swordmaster, Blade Emperor, Ancestor Sorcerer and others because too many things were implicated with this news. It would have a huge impact! Hence, Xue Ying preferred finding a time specially to share this with the others.
As for now? Cultivation was more important!
“Hu.” A figure appeared on the grass.
When Xue Ying saw who it was, he immediately stood: “Luo City Lord.”
“I know you have just broken through and need to consolidate your strength. I originally do not plan on disturbing you, yet there is something which I need your help with urgently.” Luo City Lord said.
“Luo City Lord, do say.” Xue Ying immediately answered.
“You have done a splendid job earlier on killing the Sea of Abyss Master.” Luo City Lord said, “He could endure being imprisoned under nasty conditions, suppressed and tortured. He could even tolerate not breaking through to Grand Perfection. Once he was done preparing, he immediately broke through to Grand Perfection and to the World Realm Chaotic Origin Level in one breath. This Chaotic Origin Lifeform had immense potential, and his hope of reaching Grand Perfection World Realm was high too. Perhaps, he might even become an Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Primogenitor. And you killing him has helped us eliminate a calamity from growing.”
Xue Ying listened.
“Primogenitors are Overlord Class Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms.” Luo City Lord explained, “Even though they haven’t grasped the essence of the Dao, they have dug out the potential of their bloodline energy to a pinnacle. Each one of them is hard to deal with. Only when all Overlords work together would we have a chance of killing a Primogenitor. Like for instance, those two Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeforms you once saw at the Broken Teeth Mountain Range? They were both Primogenitors.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying was enlightened.
“This Chaotic Origin Dimension is endlessly vast. It is filled with all kinds of mysteries. The Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Primogenitors are just our biggest enemies. There are also other kinds of danger lurking in the dark.” Luo City Lord said, “Even though we Overlords are the strongest overall in the Chaotic Origin Dimension, there are ultimately too few of us, just eight of us.”
“Let us not talk about these temporarily. You’ll know about it in the future.” Luo City Lord said, “The potential of that Sea of Abyss Master has attracted heavy emphasis by some Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Primogenitors. They have increased their assault on us. Even the eight of us Overlords are temporarily implicated. They are also sending several World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeforms over to rescue the Sea of Abyss Master. Even though the Sea of Abyss Master has been killed by you, those Primogenitors will definitely get infuriated. Those World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeforms that have arrived would also wantonly destroy the place. We have once painstakingly constructed that Cultivation Sacred World and they’ll definitely destroy it including some of our important grounds. What we need you to do is to temporarily delay them! Our experts would also rush over.”
“Alright, I’ll do my best to delay them.” Xue Ying immediately gave his promise.
Only now did he understand.
The cultivators did not really have an advantage in the Chaotic Origin Dimension! No wonder, no wonder Luo City Lord, Yuan, and others were doing their best to nurture the weak cultivators. They hoped for new Chaotic Origin Experts to emerge since their side was insufficient!
…
In a serene and hidden tunnel amidst the Chaotic Origin Dimension, this was also a void tunnel, stealthily bypassing many huge obstacles that the cultivators set up. No choice, the Chaotic Origin Dimension was simply too vast! Even though the cultivators had set up many obstacles and blockades, it was impossible for them to completely prevent their enemies from finding a way through the vast Chaotic Origin. All they could do is as some form of sentry.
Currently, a stream of light was moving in the dark tunnel.
He was completely covered in golden scales, and had 12 golden horns protruding from his head. His eyes were even dark yellow in color! He had a total of eight muscular arms and they were also covered in golden scales. There were also inscriptions floating on the scales all over his body.
He was Yan!
A Late Stage World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform, because he was the closest, had been ordered to come and save the other party.
‘What, he died?’ Yan was slightly frustrated.
‘He was killed by a new World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert called Monarch Flying Snow? He has reached the Middle Stage World Realm Chaotic Origin Level after breaking through?’ Yan’s eyes were filled with killing intent, ‘He can’t stop me at all.’
He was very confident.
After all, both parties were just one minor level different. He could easily kill that one called Monarch Flying Snow easily. And after that, he could destroy some of the important grounds belonging to the cultivators since he still had more support coming from behind.
‘The Primogenitor has ordered the destruction of all 15 worlds created by the Overlord in this area.’ Yan continued rushing onwards. He understood that the Primogenitors were indignant and had begun their assault. Destroying these 15 cities was just the target for this region.
******
Cultivation Sacred World.
Xue Ying’s body rapidly shrunk under his normal state. He waved his hand before easily collecting the remnant fleshy of the Sea of Abyss Master. In the sky, those shackles rapidly disappeared.
‘At least I have eliminated him.’ Xue Ying turned towards the distant ruined Scarlet Cloud City before sighing inwardly.
Not too long ago, he had not jumped out of the cage to become a Chaotic Origin Lifeform.
But now, he killed a World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform. Still, it would take approximately four hours before he became an Overlord. Hence, this was nothing surprising.
“Monarch Flying Snow.” A voice transmitted from afar.
Xue Ying sensed it too and turned over.
It was a red-nosed old man who had a wine gourd hanging by his waist. He came in from out of the world, flying towards Xue Ying with a smile: “I am ‘Scarlet Peak Daoist’, the patrol for this seventh region belonging to the Overlord. Previously, during my journey here, I saw personally everything that you did, Monarch Flying Snow. This sudden breakthrough of yours advanced all the way until the Middle Stage of World Realm Chaotic Origin Level. Truly spectacular.”
“He had been suppressed and restricted by the array shackles. Killing him isn’t that great of an achievement.” Xue Ying said.
“Has the Overlord told you about the matter?” Scarlet Peak Daoist continued.
“Luo City Lord has told me about it.” Xue Ying nodded.
“Those Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Primogenitors must have wanted to save the Sea of Abyss Master. But now that they failed, they are surely infuriated. It is normal for them to start a war with us on all fronts.” Scarlet Peak Daoist explained, “I am just a weak avatar in charge of patrolling and acting as sentry for this region. This avatar of mine doesn’t even have one-thousandth of the strength at my peak so it is impossible for me to participate in the battle here. We can only rely on you, Monarch Flying Snow.”
“I understand.” Xue Ying chuckled.
He only had one Prime Avatar.
The other avatars were weak, especially so when the patrol region is huge, forcing him to create many more avatars just to prowl the region.
“Monarch Flying Snow.” Scarlet Peak Daoist continued, “I have to remind Monarch that those who dare to charge into our region, and those who are originally coming to save the Sea of Abyss Master, are all very formidable. It is entirely possible that they have reached the Grand Perfection World Realm Chaotic Origin Level.” Scarlet Peak Daoist said, “It is good that you can delay them. But if the enemies are too strong, it is fine too. Letting them destroy three to five worlds is inevitable. But given sufficient time, our experts will arrive to lend help.”
After all, they did not have high demands for Xue Ying as a new expert.
Allowing a Middle Stage World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeform fight against Grand Perfection World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeforms? That was simply too difficult.
“I’ll try my best.” Xue Ying replied, “Oh right, Patrol Scarlet Peak, I have one matter which I require Patrol Scarlet Peak’s help with.”
“Do say.” Scarlet Peak Daoist continued, “We are all Chaotic Origin Cultivators that have jumped out of the cage. We should help each other so that we can stand straight in the vast Chaotic Origin Dimension.”
The moment Xue Ying heard that, he understood that the ordinary relationship between Chaotic Origin Experts were quite good.
“I am lacking a weapon.” Xue Ying added, “Now that I have broken through, I have yet to find an appropriate spear.” At this level, most weapons would break during battle if they were not optimal. Without a good weapon, he could only rely on his body to fight.
“Weapon?” Scarlet Peak Daoist turned bitter, “I feel ashamed to say that this is just a weak avatar meant for patrol. How would I bring along a powerful weapon? Hence, I don’t even have one with me.”
Xue Ying was stunned.
That’s right. Why would a weak avatar bring something important with him?
“Then Patrol Scarlet Peak, do you have any Chaotic Origin Weapon refinement techniques that you can share with me about?” Xue Ying added, “I don’t really know much about refining Chaotic Origin Weapons. But once I have the technique to do so, I’ll naturally be able to refine one out.”
“Weapon refinement isn’t that easy.” As Scarlet Peak Daoist spoke, he passed Xue Ying a wristband, “This is a communication treasure refined personally by Overlord ‘Yuan’. I doubt you have one so you can temporarily use this so that I can communicate with you in a while when you face the enemies. As for the technique to refine a Chaotic Origin Weapon, let me directly transmit it to you. These techniques are relatively easy to acquire among us Chaotic Origin Experts.”
After Xue Ying received it, a huge amount of information began pouring into his mind.
They were precisely Chaotic Origin Weapon refining techniques. A total of 12 of them.
“Also, these are some of the special materials which I collected after patrolling across various regions in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. After all, I would occasionally collect some of them during my long years of patrol. I shall give them to you now, Monarch Flying Snow.” Scarlet Peak Daoist threw over a storage treasure.
Xue Ying examined through it.
How fabulous!
There were many materials with different colors within. All of them had extraordinary aura. IN the vast Chaotic Origin Dimension, it was normal for different kinds of mysterious materials to form. For them to be chosen and collected by Scarlet Peak Daoist shows how special they were. Materials like ‘Chaotic Origin Sand’ were things that Scarlet Peak Daoist felt disdain from collecting because it was too commonly seen. After all, the Chaotic Origin Sand could be found everywhere in the Chaotic Origin Dimension.
“Many thanks, Patrol Scarlet Peak.” Xue Ying said.
“It is a minor matter. But I reckon the enemy is going to reach soon. How would you have enough time to refine a weapon out?” Scarlet Peak Daoist shook his head.
Xue Ying chuckled: “Patrol Scarlet Peak, follow me.”
Saying that, he took a step. The void before them was torn open, revealing many mysterious inscripted shackles that obstructed the paths of Xue Ying and Scarlet Peak Daoist. Both of them then left this Cultivation Sacred World.
The moment they went out.
They were in the vast Chaotic Origin Dimension.
“These scars.” Xue Ying could not help but look at the cracks that ran through the endless Chaotic Origin Dimension. Many of those cracks extended to a distance one could not even see. Before reaching Chaotic Origin, Xue Ying could not see the end of the extension. But now, at least he could see it! Nonetheless, these cracks that existed in many locations were still vast and long.
“These are blade traces left behind by the Overlords.” Scarlet Peak Daoist watched with marvel, “The blade traces have been in the Chaotic Origin Dimension for a very long time without dissipating. Most World Realm Chaotic Origin Lifeforms do not dare to charge through those blade scars since they will simply be wiped out into nothing.”
Xue Ying was startled.
So powerful?
Luo City Lord merely left behind some blade scars and they were this powerful?
“Of the eight Overlords that comprehended ‘Dao’ at the Chaotic Origin Level, Overlord ‘Yuan’ is the most well-rounded. He is also the only one who could create new Origin Worlds. Like Overlord ‘Star Edge’, he is the one that terrifies the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform most simply because ‘Star Edge’ specializes in assassination. If he plans on entering stealth, even the Innate Chaotic Origin Lifeform Primogenitors cannot really discover him. As for Luo City Lord’s blade, that is the most frightening blade across this limitless Chaotic Origin Dimension.”
Xue Ying nodded.
As he listened, he comprehended the Chaotic Origin Weapon refinement technique passed to him previously by Scarlet Peak Daoist.
It was very complex.
But——the ‘Mirage Cosmos’ in his body had evolved into a higher level. It was now a vast Mirage Dimension. Hence, refining a weapon was much easier because he could simply create one out of nothing.
‘Alright, I shall do it this way.’ Xue Ying immediately made his decision.
“Hu.”
Xue Ying waved his hand. At that moment, ripples started appearing in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Large amounts of Chaotic Origin Sand in this region flew into the hands of Xue Ying. His control of the void had already reached a profound realm.
“Hua hua hua~” The Chaotic Origin Sand was also the most commonly seen material in the Chaotic Origin Dimension. Just three breaths later, Xue Ying had collected a total of half a trillion kilometers of Chaotic Origin Sand.
‘In the past, collecting half a trillion kilometers of Chaotic Origin Sand is not easy. But now, I can collect this amount so easily.’ Xue Ying sighed inwardly. Just like how a mortal dug up the earth, Chaotic Origin Sand existed everywhere and Xue Ying could now grab hold of a large amount in one go. One had to know that even Void Lineage Final Realm Comos Gods could do collect the sand as well, showing how easy it was.
‘Refine.’
With a thought.
Using the Chaotic Origin Sand as the base material and part of the materials given by Scarlet Peak Daoist as supporting ingredients, in addition to some auxiliary materials created in his Mirage Dimension, Xue Ying began his refinement of the Chaotic Origin Weapon.
The inscribed patterns on the weapons, once activated, would rapidly cause even more Chaotic Origin Sand to form.
Just five breaths later.
‘I succeeded.’
Xue Ying grinned. He who was good at the Dao of Void, would have a very easy time refining weapons.
“Hu.”
With a wave of his hand, a black spear appeared within the Chaotic Origin Dimension. This spear was like a sky pillar. It contained many inscriptions revolving on it too.
“Chaotic Origin Weapon? So fast?” By his side, Scarlet Peak Daoist was dumbstruck.
Xue Ying extended his hand. This weapon rapidly shrank until around two meters or so. Xue Ying then held it with one hand.
“This weapon is very crude. I can only refine it via quantity.” Xue Ying said. To others, refining half a trillion kilometers of Chaotic Origin Sand was complicated, yet to Xue Ying, he could easily do it in his Mirage Dimension with a thought, “This weapon is very ordinary. It’s only good point is that it is tough.”
This weapon of his was considered low end among many weapons that World Realm Chaotic Origin Experts had.
But he had no choice. He was forced to do this since he was short of time.
It was sufficient as long as it could withstand hits.
After all, he would be breaking through to the Overlord Class. By then, it would be wise to refine an even better weapon by spending his time doing it slowly. As for now, this weapon would suffice temporarily.
“Mn?” Scarlet Peak Daoist’s expression shifted slightly as he looked to the distance. He said, “Monarch Flying Snow, I can sense that the enemy has appeared. I’ll bring you over.”
“He is here really quickly.” Xue Ying was slightly startled too. He had just finished refining his weapon.
With a thought.
A weak avatar was formed. It flew into the Cultivation Sacred World. He chose to leave an avatar here in case of unforeseen circumstances.
“Go.” Xue Ying and Scarlet Peak Daoist rushed over into the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1387 - Overlord (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1387: Overlord (1)
Translator: Chaos_  Editor: Chaos_
Scarlet Peak Daoist brought along Xue Ying through the vast Chaotic Origin Dimension.
The Chaotic Origin Dimension was too vast and immense. Even Chaotic Origin Experts had to spend a long time traveling through it.
“Sou.”
A blood stream of light abruptly transformed into two figures. They were Scarlet Peak Daoist and Xue Ying.
“Look, right over there!” Scarlet Peak Daoist pointed ahead, “That Chaotic Origin Void Tunnel has been opened. The enemy is about to appear.”
Xue Ying hurriedly looked over. Given his current perception of the Chaotic Origin Void, he got a weird feeling coming from that piece of Chaotic Origin Space. It seemed as if a fixed passage was able to tunnel out of afar.
‘He is here.’ Xue Ying could clearly sense it.
An enormous organism tunneled out from that passage. The moment it appeared, his figure rapidly expanded back to its original size. His figure was so big that it was approximately one-hundredth that of an Origin World. Even as he stood there, he caused the surrounding Chaotic Origin Energy to surge. And his body’s natural-releasing laws were charging against the Chaotic Origin Energy.
He had 12 golden horns protruding from his head in total. They were all piercing out in different directions. His eight arms were muscular and strong. They were also covered in Chaotic Origin Level laws.
Time flows differently at different parts of his body. Time was fast in some regions, and time was slow in others. Space itself was even intertwined. Some parts of space had folded on various parts of his body. His existence… was just like a miniature Origin World.
“It’s him? Yan?” Scarlet Peak Daoist looked from afar. His expression changing as he transmitted over to Xue Ying, “Monarch Flying Snow, Yan is a World Realm Late Stage Chaotic Origin Lifeform. His accumulations are thick too. He isn’t someone you should provoke. Every moment you can delay is every extra time we have. It is fine even if you failed. Remember, do not fight directly against him. The gap between your strength is too big. This weak avatar of mine is not going to stay here any longer in case I get involved in the battle between you two.”
Saying that, Scarlet Peak Daoist rapidly transformed into a blood-colored stream of light and left in the direction of the Cultivation Sacred World.
…
In the vast Chaotic Origin Dimension, a silver-haired three-eyed male was currently rushing through at high speed. He was a famous World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert from the cultivator faction, ‘Sirius’. Sirius… was a Grand Perfection World Realm Chaotic Origin Expert. He was absolutely qualified to take on the role as a Great General under the eight Overlords. Currently, he was rushing to the rescue as per the order given.
Not just him, there were other experts rushing over to lend aid to this region.
Because the enemy had begun a large-scale assault with this location where the Cultivation Sacred World was being one of the important battlefields.
Among the experts that were lending aid, Sirius was the fastest. But he would still take approximately two hours to arrive.
“Yan?” As Sirius was traveling, he was also scouting from afar. He immediately discovered the emergence of ‘Yan’.
If he were to go over, he was confident of killing the other party in a one-on-one duel after spending some time.
“Monarch Flying Snow.” Sirius immediately transmitted over through the imprint linking to Xue Ying’s newly-given communication treasure. Now that his imprint had been publicized via his energy, other Chaotic Origin Experts could contact Xue Ying too.
“I, Sirius, is rushing over at this moment as per the orders. You must be careful! Maintain a certain distance from him! If you are slightly closer, this Prime Avatar of yours might be in danger of dying. Remember this.” Sirius transmitted over, “I have fought with Yan before. This is the detailed intelligence regarding him.”
…
Xue Ying received warnings from Scarlet Peak Daoist and then from Sirius. After that, he also received intelligence regarding the enemy.
‘Maintain a sufficient distance?’ Xue Ying held on to a black spear and stepped on the vast Chaotic Origin Energy as he walked over. At the same time, his body rapidly expanded… Eventually, he was just slightly smaller than Sirius, and also half the size of the other party. This was already the limit that Xue Ying could maintain without affecting his strength.
“You are Monarch Flying Snow? And also the one that killed Cheng Hao?” Yan stood there. His dark yellow eyes looked towards Xue Ying. Even though they were still very far apart, they could still see each other clearly.
“Cheng Hao? Are you saying that lifeform who was imprisoned in the sea of Abyss? If that’s him, then indeed, I was the one that killed him.” Xue Ying continued walking forward. Every step took him across a huge distance as he executed his movement technique.
The two ‘miniature Origin World’-sized lifeforms, even if they did not use any profound mysteries, would be able to stride through a huge distance simply by walking.
‘A new World Realm Chaotic Origin has the strength at the Middle Stage already?’ As Yan walked over, he was also pondering over it. If their life core was destroyed, they would die. Hence, they were usually more careful and vigilant. As they dug out their bloodline potential, they would usually first dig out their survival potential to a limit! Of these Innate Chaotic Origin Experts, most of them were usually strongest in survival!
‘I should first eliminate this Prime Avatar of his.’ Yan did not feel any threat at all.
Both parties were getting closer and closer.
“Monarch Flying Snow, remember not to get too close. You should just rely on executing long-range techniques.” Sirius reminded anxiously.
“Monarch Flying Snow, be careful! You must remember not to get too close to him.” Scarlet Peak Daoist was greatly startled too, “Maintain a certain distance from him.”
Xue Ying did not care.
Both parties continued getting closer and closer.
“Hehe~” Yan’s dark yellow eyes were filled with killing intent.
“Weng.”
